entries.en:
"Nope," he says. "We're done with that. End of conversation."

He raises a hand as if to pre-empt any objections.

"I'm not going to get involved in another political boondoggle only to have you back out. That's the last we're going to speak of this."
entries.zh:
"不行，\"他说，\"这事到此为止。谈话结束。"

他抬起一只手，像是要先堵住你的反驳。

"我不会再掺和进一桩政治烂摊子，结果你半路抽身。这话我们说到这儿为止。"

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches the abandoned station.

It's been long stripped of anything useful. You briefly consider using the vast structure for storage, but there is little doubt that a handful of stealth microsats have already noted your visit.

Anything left here would be picked clean by scavengers by the time you'd returned.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet驶近这座废弃空间站。

这里早被拆得干干净净，凡是有用的东西都没剩下。你一度动念，想把这座庞然大物拿来当仓库，但几乎可以肯定，早有几颗隐形微型卫星记下了你的造访。

等你下次回来，留在这儿的任何东西都早被拾荒者搜刮一空了。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.

The huge planet spins languidly below your $shipOrFleet, deep in a cryosleep of its own between the far-flung stars of the galaxy. Gravitational compression and the barest trickle of radioactive decay warm the interior well above the interstellar medium, feeding active weather systems which slowly churn across the cold face of the world.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam, I-" your sensors officer pulls up the live feed from a sensor subsuite. This gets the attention of Tactical.

After a moment, even you can see it: a disruption, a gout of sudden turbulence like a dozen giant hurricanes turning over.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName 。

巨大的行星在你的$shipOrFleet下方慵懒地转动，似乎在银河中恒星之间的深空中陷入了它自己的低温休眠。重力压缩和微量的放射性衰变让其内核温度远高于周遭的星际物质，也驱动着该星球冰冷的表面上缓慢移动的气候系统。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，我——" 你的传感器技官调出了某个备用传感器回传的直播画面。这也引起了战术官的关注。

片刻之后，甚至连你也能看到：某种扰乱，一团突如其来的湍流宛如十几场巨型飓风在旋转翻腾。

entries.en:
"Massive storm system. Sudden heat anomaly, um, relatively speaking. Some kind of upwelling," your sensors officer responds, rapid-fire. You know they don't like not having a clear answer.

"Powering up gravimetrics. If there's something hiding under those clouds, that'll show it."

They tap at their console, calibrating a new subsuite of the $shipOrFleet sensor network. The minutes tick by as the systems self-adjust to the planet, the estimated accuracy of readings steadily rising on the shared display. The readout sharpens, clarifies, begins to map the mass-density of $entityName.

At the same time, the anomaly subsides, leaving storm-cells the size of moons spinning through the atmosphere.
entries.zh:
"巨大的风暴系统。某种，呃，相对周遭环境来说突发的热量异常。某种上升流。" 你的传感器技官连珠炮一般地说道。你明白干这行的不喜欢事情没有个清楚的答案。

"启动引力仪，如果有什么的东西藏在云层之下，这肯定能探测到。"

他开始敲动控制台以校准$shipOrFleet传感器阵列中的子系统之一。几分钟过后，系统逐渐适配了面前的行星，你面前显示屏上的数据预估精确度也在稳步上升。采集到的数据更加精细，清晰，并且逐步开始显示 $entityName 的质量密度图。

与此同时，异象也开始平息，只留下了卫星大小的风暴群在大气层中呼啸旋转。

entries.en:
Sensors looks increasingly agitated, rapidly switching between sensor interfaces to collate telemetry.

"Captain, I cannot ascertain the cause. A huge burst of energy was released into the atmosphere, an upwelling like... the mass readings don't show any unexpected structures or objects, natural or otherwise."

Tactical frowns, ever suspicious, and says "This happens just when our $shipOrFleet arrives? I don't like it."
entries.zh:
传感器官看上去愈加烦躁，他不停的在传感器界面之间来回切换，整理遥测数据。

"舰长，我无法确定其来源。一股巨大的能量被释放进了巨星的大气层，就跟一股上升气流一般... 但质量数据没有显示任何不正常的物体或构造，不论自然与否。"

战术官狐疑地皱了皱眉，"而这一切恰好在$shipOrFleet到达时发生？我不喜欢这一点。"

o.en: All stations at ready. Sensors, call alert if there's any change.
o.zh: 全体就位。传感器官，如有任何变化，紧急通告。

o.en: I don't like it either. Nav, get us out of here.
o.zh: 我也不喜欢。领航官，带我们离开这儿。

entries.en:
Your orders are acknowledged and carried out; your sensors officer keeps their team at high alert, and all others are at the ready.

Below, $entityName spins complacently, its shadow-side occasionally lit with patches of lightning as titanic atmospheric currents do battle.
entries.zh:
你的命令被按部就班地执行；你的传感器技官让其组员保持最高警戒，所有其他人也都各就各位。

在你下方，$entityName 悠然自得地自转着，其暗面不时被角力中的巨型气流所激发的闪电点亮。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.

Upon your return, your sensors officer is determined not to be caught off-guard again. The sensor net is set to high intensity and the gravimetric suite is loaded with the previously collected calibration data.

There's no sign of unusual turbulence; just the crawl of atmospheric bands, lightning storms flickering where their edges meet like battling fleets in a far-off nebula.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。

你回来后，你的传感器技官铁了心要避免再被打个措手不及。传感器网络现在被调到了高功率，并且之前的校准数据也已上传到了重力观测系统之中。

之前异常的湍流已经不见踪影；只有缓缓移动着的大气带，气带交接之处，闪烁的闪电看上去像是在远方星云中交战的舰队。

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam!" Your sensors officer's voice is strained. "Picking up - from the light - they came from out of nowhere!"

Navigation interrupts, "$ShipOrFleet drive bubble in the red, instability increasing... holding... alert to multiple penetrations. N-space fissures detected inside the volume."

A pause as the bridge crew takes in the eruption of alerts on their displays. Tactical takes initiative and activates the combat alarm to send all crew to battle stations. Frantic activity from all posts, chatter between the stations coordinating response.

Sensors calls over the low din: "It's homing in on our active sensor emissions."
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam！" 你的传感器技官声音紧绷，"探测到 —— 从光源方向 —— 它们凭空出现了！"

领航官急声打断，"$shipOrFleet驱动泡进入红区，不稳定度持续上升... 维持... 警报：多处空间穿透。探测到该空域内出现多维空间裂隙。"

舰桥人员凝视着显示屏上爆发的警报，陷入了短暂的沉默。战术官果断拉响了战斗警报，全员进入战备岗位。各战位传来急促的操作声与协调响应的通讯杂音。

低沉的嘈杂声中，传感器官报告道："它正在锁定我们的主动传感器信号。"

o.en: Order a sensor sweep, full power, focused on the anomalous drive-bubble penetrations
o.zh: 下令进行全功率传感器扫描，集中探测异常驱动泡穿透点

o.en: Go to maximum emission control! EMCON zero-zero alpha, immediate execute.
o.zh: 启动最大化能量排放管控！EMCON 零-零 阿尔法，立即执行。

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam!" Your sensors officer's voice is strained. "Picking up - from the light, anomalous readings. Running systems-check..."

Navigation interrupts, "$ShipOrFleet drive bubble warning... and holding. This is strange, I'm detecting an N-space fissure inside the volume."

A pause as the bridge crew takes in the alerts and odd readings. Hyperspace ambushes are a known risk but they don't look like this.

Nonetheless, Tactical takes the initiative to activate the combat alarm to send crew to battle stations.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam！\" 你的传感器技官声音紧绷，\"探测到 —— 从光源方向 —— 异常读数。正在运行系统自检..."

领航官急声打断："$ShipOrFleet驱动泡警告... 维持住了。奇怪，我在这片空域里探测到一处多维空间裂隙。"

舰桥人员盯着接连弹出的警报和异常读数，沉默了片刻。超空间伏击虽是常有的风险，可眼前这一幕却不像那么回事。

尽管如此，战术官还是当机立断拉响了战斗警报，让全员进入战备岗位。

entries.en:
You wait.

Alarms are reset, battle restraints engaged. Activity on the bridge gradually quiets as all officers, crew, and systems reach a state of readiness, even anticipation - fight or flight.

The incursions crawl closer to the center of your display volume, expanding unwaveringly and intentionally.

All eyes are on command interfaces, and all attention is on your next order.
entries.zh:
你等待着。

警报已重置，战斗约束系统就位。舰桥上的活动逐渐平息，所有军官、船员与系统都进入了待命状态，甚至带着期待 —— 准备战斗或撤退。

入侵体缓慢爬向显示屏区域的中心，其扩张显得坚定不移且目标明确。

所有目光都聚焦于指挥界面，全部注意力都等待你的下一道指令。

entries.en:
At your command, the unperceived chorus of a multitude of ship systems and machinery dies down with a deepening sigh into muted quietude.

All that remains is the breath and bodies of your bridge crew, a strange assertion of your shared humanity.

Backup e-lighting, simple chemical things, provide an eerie glow. A series of dimly pulsing commands illuminate your executive interface - a flock of ardent subsystems ready to awaken from minimum operation at your touch.

* * *

A hidden blackness feels the brush of a shadow. Less than a morsel, unworthy of wakefulness. By some analog of distributed instinct a few listless tendrils explore this disturbance, this ripple in the darkness behind the night.
entries.zh:
随着你一声令下，舰船各个系统的无形合唱逐渐沉寂，化为逐渐深沉的叹息，最终归于压抑的静默。

唯有舰桥乘员的呼吸与躯体尚存，这成为你们共同人性的一种奇异确证。

备用电子照明 —— 简单的化学光源 —— 投下了诡异的微光。一系列幽暗脉动的指令点亮了你的指挥界面，犹如一群炽热的子系统正从最低能耗状态中等待被你唤醒。

* * *

一片潜伏的黑暗感知到了阴影的轻触。这微不足道的扰动，尚不值得苏醒。凭借类似分布式本能的机制，数条慵懒的触须开始探查这夜幕之后、黑暗之中的涟漪。

entries.en:
"Aye $playerSirOrMadam! Executing." Sensors barks, then deftly executes a series of overrides.

Your $shipOrFleet status is up on the central display - drive bubble an unsteady amber, incursions of N-space fissures marked in garish red. A blink of white as active sensors trigger and-

-pressure on the drive bubble spikes, an amber flash, a cacophony of alarms...

* * *

A hidden blackness waiting, lurking, jolts awake. Tendrils lunge eagerly, hungrily, through fissures in the dark behind the night.
entries.zh:
"明白 $playerSirOrMadam！正在执行。" 传感器技官迅速回应，并熟练执行了一系列系统覆写。

你的$shipOrFleet状态呈现在中央显示屏上 —— 护盾泡呈现出不稳定的琥珀色，多维空间裂隙的入侵点以刺目的红色标注。白光一闪，主动传感器启动，随后 ——

—— 驱动泡压力骤增，随着一道琥珀色的闪光，警报声此起彼伏...

* * *

一片潜伏的黑暗被惊动苏醒。无数触须贪婪而急切地穿过夜幕之后那黑暗中的裂隙。

o.en: Sensors, what are we looking at?
o.zh: 传感器技官，我们看到的是什么？

entries.en:
"It's an abyssal light, $playerSirOrMadam."

Your sensors officer quickly realizes that this statement is as obvious as it is unilluminating.

"And. We don't know exactly what it... is. There's fragmentary pre-Collapse data. Some academicians speculate that it might be a spontaneous buildup of dark energy, maybe, around a temporary hyperspace quasistructure, a sort of knot in higher dimensions that alters the physical effects of... whatever it is."

You catch your ops chief making the spacer hand-sign for 'all seals confirmed safe', a sort of ward against evil.
entries.zh:
"是深渊光点，$playerSirOrMadam。"

你的传感器技官很快反应过来这一表述既不言自明又毫无意义。

"然后，我们也不清楚它到底... 是什么。我们有些大崩塌前的数据碎片。有些学者认为这可能是某种暗物质自发聚集形成的个体，它或许围绕某一超空间准结构体而形成，而某种高维的枢纽影响着这... 不知是什么鬼东西的物理性质。"

你看到你的行动长官比了个 "全密封口确认安全" 的手势，算得上是某种辟邪的仪式。

entries.en:
"They're not known, um, to be dangerous," your sensors officer continues, tapping at the console. "The drive field should keep us safe."

"It does appear to be highly unstable. They always are, and they're difficult to properly scan. I think if we tried an active scan or fired off an interdiction pulse it would collapse; the resulting discharge might allow us to chart local hyperspace topography."
entries.zh:
"据我们所知，它们，呃... 不危险，" 你的传感器技官边敲打着操作台，边继续道，"驱动场应该能保证我们的安全。"

"但这确实看上去非常不稳定。它们总是这样，很难好好地扫描它们。我认为一旦我们进行主动扫描或者发出阻断脉冲 ，它就会坍塌；随后引起的能量释放有可能能让我们制作附近的超空间测绘。"

entries.en:
Your ops chief, normally unflappable, almost flinches.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. No, $playerSirOrMadam."

You let the silence linger, letting ops know that denial is not enough of an answer.

"Captain." Ops looks at you directly. "It's said to be... bad luck to meddle with things this deep in hyperspace." Ops stands up straighter, "I've no technical opinion; I raise the point only as a matter of crew morale. Mere dockside superstition, I'm sure."
entries.zh:
你一贯镇定自若的行动长官差点被吓了一跳。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。没有，$playerSirOrMadam。"

你用一段刻意蔓延开的沉默告诉行动长那个简单的否认并不能算是回答。

"舰长。" 行动长官转头直视着你，"人们常说，和超空间这么深处的东西打交道是...不吉利的。" 行动长官挺起了身子，"我没有任何技术上的见解，我只是从船员士气的角度提出这个问题。这当然都只是些流传星港的迷信说法罢了。"

o.en: Understood, I'll be mindful. Thank you chief.
o.zh: 明白了，我会留意的。谢谢，行动官。

o.en: Such superstition has no place on my bridge, is that understood?
o.zh: 我的舰桥上没有这些迷信的容身之处，明白了吗？

entries.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam," your ops chief says, then turns back to the main display, determined to make nothing more of it.
entries.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 你的行动长官欲言又止，然后转身看向了主显示界面，看上去不打算再提起此事。

entries.en: "Understood, $playerSirOrMadam." Your ops chief turns back to the main display, determined to make nothing more of it.
entries.zh: "明白，$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 你的行动长官说到，然后转回去看向主显示界面，看上去不打算再提起此事。

entries.en:
A cold light fills the viewscreen, stark against the utter darkness of the hyperspace abyss. It seems to pulse, shifting dimmer and then brighter, following no discernable pattern. It does not flicker like a flame, nor like a failing comms signal, but like... something at the edge of your consciousness. It is...

You find you are able to anticipate the rhythm, more seen than heard, the dancing light filling your vision...

A polite cough from your sensors officer brings you back to the present. "$PlayerSirOrMadam?"
entries.zh:
冰冷的光线从显示屏中渗出，和背后漆黑一片的超空间深渊形成了鲜明的对比。光源似乎在波动，时暗时明，但又没有任何规律可循。它并不如火焰般跳动，也不像逐渐消逝的通讯信号，更像是... 你意识边缘的某物。它是...

你发现你能跟上它的节奏，与其说是听见，更像看到，起舞的光线充斥于你的视野之中...

你的传感器技官礼貌地轻声咳嗽了一声，把你拉回现实。"$PlayerSirOrMadam？"

entries.en:
The cold light fills the viewscreen, stark against the abyss. The subtle pulse of the light begs for attention, but gives no promise of comfort.

You give your head half a shake, centering your attention on your bridge officers to give your next order.
entries.zh:
冰冷的光线从显示屏中渗出，和背后的深渊形成了鲜明的对比。隐晦的光线脉冲吸引着人的眼球，却没让人感到一丝的舒适。

你摇了摇头，将你的注意力拉回到你的舰桥船员身上，准备下达你的下一个命令。

entries.en:
Cold light fills the primary display, stark against the abyss. The subtle pulse begs for your attention yet offers no promise of comfort.

After a moment you consciously pull your eyes from the pitiless sight, centering your attention on your bridge officers to give your next order.
entries.zh:
冰冷的光线从主显示屏中渗出，和背后的深渊形成了鲜明的对比。隐晦的光线脉冲吸引着你的眼球，却没让你感到一丝的舒适。

片刻过后，你刻意地将目光从那无情的景象上移开，并将你的注意力拉回到你的舰桥船员身上，准备下达你的下一个命令。

entries.en:
Cold light begins to grow in the primary display. A subtle pulse begs for your attention.

"Captain, I-" It's your navigation officer, who glances at sensors and receives a nod. "The light is moving. Coming closer."

You consciously pull your eyes from that comfortless light - diminished but not bereft of its call through even the meager medium of the primary display.

It's come to you.
entries.zh:
冰冷的光线从主显示屏中渗出，隐晦的光线脉冲吸引着你的眼球。

"舰长，我——" 是你的领航员在说话，对方瞥向传感器，随即点头确认道，"那光在移动，且正在靠近。"

你刻意地将目光从那令人不适的光源上移开 —— 尽管透过主显示屏的有限媒介，它的召唤力已经减弱，却又未消失。

它正向你而来。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.

A preliminary surface scan reveals certain inconsistencies in expected mass-densities for this category of planetoid.

Your sensors officer orders additional sweeps, at higher power and resolution. A picture of the situation starts to come together: large deposits of useful elements have been extracted and the dig-sites, whether surface deposits or deep veins, have been carefully returned to something approximating their natural state. Shafts have been infilled, tailings spread evenly and packed over the extraction fields.

Sensors consults with your operations chief, who did a stint in fringe mining earlier in their career. Ops looks grim.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。

初步表面扫描表明面前星体的质量密度和常规有所偏差。

你的传感器技官下令进行了更高功率和解析度的进一步扫描。这让事情开始水落石出：大量有用的资源已经被采集，而不论是星体表面还是深层矿脉的采集场都被小心翼翼地恢复到了大致自然的状态。矿坑被填满，尾渣则被平铺在采集场之上。

传感器技官咨询了你的行动长官，后者在生涯初期曾涉猎过边缘星区采矿业。行动长官脸色阴沉。

entries.en:
"Don't look right, $playerSirOrMadam," Ops says, turning a weathered face to you.

"Aye, could've been an indie miner or scav. Could've. But there's nothing - no temporary works, no pillaring, no tread tracks. Should be dead power cells and ration wrappers scattered like stars in the dark. Ain't nothing."

Ops scowls. "No one cleans up like this, not even Tachy autominers. No profit in it. Especially not out here."
entries.zh:
"看起来不对劲，$playerSirOrMadam。" 行动长官把那张饱经风霜的脸向你转了过来。

"对，这应该是有独立矿工或者垃圾佬什么的来过。应该是这样。但这却什么都没有 —— 没有临时工事，没有矿坑支柱，没有履带印。按理说，这多少得有点废电池或者口粮包装什么的像漫天星一样乱扔在脏地方里才对。可这却什么都没有的。"

行动长官皱眉道，"没人会打扫的这么干净，就连速子自动采矿机都不会。这样做赚不到好处。尤其是在这种破地方。"

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.

The faint signs of a massive mining operation remain and are just as suspiciously neat as before, as tidy as a penitent Luddic rock-gardener. Sensor records do not show any significant changes since the last scan.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。

大规模采矿行动留下的薄弱痕迹仍在，而一切就和之前一样，如同苦修中的卢德园丁所作的石雕，整齐得让人生疑。扫描结果显示和上次扫描时没有显著的变动。

entries.en:
"Ah," $hisOrHer eyes dart around, but find no way to avoid an uncomfortable subject.

"It was during the Second AI War, you see. 12, 13 cycles ago? A Galatia Academy research flotilla stumbled onto a secret Hegemony project in the Tia-Taxet system. Between war paranoia, phase-raiders, and the general hyperwave comms breakdown... ", $heOrShe closes $hisOrHer eyes, "The Hegemony attacked. No Academy ships survived. Incredible loss. Survivors, some. I spoke with one on Syrinx, in fact. They ended up in a prison-hab for the rest of the war."

"It doesn't get talked about much, at least in the Hegemony. But even the Academy didn't push as hard as they could have for reparations... " $HeOrShe trails off, then looks up. "Anyway, that's in the past."
entries.zh:
"啊。" $hisOrHer的眼神躲避着你，但是却无法找到办法来绕开这个令人不适的话题。

"这是第二次 AI 战争时期的事情了，你知道吧，大概 12 还是 13 个星历年之前？有一支 Galatia 学院的研究舰队不慎发现了 霸主 在 Tia-Taxet 星系的一个秘密项目。当时 霸主 正面临相位船的袭扰，还有超波通讯系统的崩坏，更别说战时本来就多疑..." $heOrShe闭上了眼睛，"结果 霸主 发起了攻击，学院舰船无一幸存，损失惨重。倒是有一些生还者，我在 Syrinx 上跟其中一位聊过，他们直到战争结束都关在牢里。"

"这事现在很少被人提起了，至少 霸主 那边是这样的。但就算是学院也没有那么积极地索要赔偿..." $HeOrShe声音渐渐低了下去，然后抬头看向你，"总之，都是过去的事了。"

o.en: Say your farewells and cut the comm link

entries.en: "The Academy operates only a small contingent of dedicated research ships, especially after the ISS Enki incident," $heOrShe says, "So they will contract out transport jobs to freelancers like myself."
entries.zh: "学院只保有一小队研究舰，尤其是出了 ISS Enki 事件之后。" $heOrShe说道，"所以他们的运输工作都外包给了我这样的自由业个体户。"

o.en: What happened to the ISS Enki?
Say your farewells and cut the comm link

o.zh: 这 'Galatia 学院' 是什么？

o.en: Does the Academy pay well for transport jobs?
o.zh: 学院的运输工作报酬如何？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks surprised for a moment, but recovers quickly. "Ah, of course. Our mission profile is logged in our transponder code."

"The Galatia Academy is the foremost institution of learning and research in the Persean Sector. It's affiliated with no particular faction so that knowledge can be preserved and new discoveries shared by all."

$HeOrShe is almost abashed at this show of idealism, "At least, that's the idea. There's always political back-and-forth, but it really is a neutral ground for a good cause. I'm proud to run these jobs."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe一瞬间看上去有些惊讶，但是很快便反应了过来。"啊，对啊。我们的任务信息已经登入了我们的应答器号码之中。"

"Galatia 学院是英仙座星域最为尖端的学术和研究中心。学院拒绝与任何第三方势力挂钩，以便所有知识都能被保存，所有新发现都能被共享。"

说完了这么理想化的一段演讲，$HeOrShe看上去有些羞耻。"至少，说是这么说的。政治上的各种往来总是存在的，但学院确实是个想做善事的中立之地。我为能帮他们跑活而自豪。"

o.en: Does the Academy pay well for transport jobs?
o.zh: 学院的运输工作报酬如何？

o.en: Say your farewells and cut the comm link

entries.en:
"Oh, well enough. Not top-rate, not bottom. I'll give you a little tip," $heOrShe winks. "The real reward is the connections you make. You got the big doers-and-sayers from every faction wanting to send their best and brightest to the Galatia Academy. I'll introduce myself personally, 'As captain, I will see to your child's absolute safety', and so on. They love that."

"Then," $heOrShe says with emphasis, "You get jobs from those big-money big-influence folks."
entries.zh:
"哦，够好了，不算一流，不算垫底。我给你提个醒。" $heOrShe眨了眨眼，"真正的好处是你能结交的人脉。每个势力呼风唤雨的大人物都会把他们最聪明的后代送到 Galatia 学院。这时我就能自我介绍，说些 '作为舰长，我会保证你孩子绝对安全。' 之类的话，他们会特别受用。"

"然后。" $heOrShe强调道，"你就能从这些大人物和金主那边接活儿了。"

o.en: Say your farewells and cut the comm link

entries.en: "Any time," $heOrShe says, pleased to pass on some spacer wisdom. "Speaking of time, I think it's about mine to burn on. Safe travels, captain."
entries.zh: "不客气。" $heOrShe说道，看到能传授点宇宙民的经验给你，对方显得颇为高兴，"说到这，我想我客套的也差不多了。一路顺风，舰长。"

o.en: Say your farewells and cut the comm link

entries.en: "As you will," $heOrShe says, rolling $hisOrHer eyes. "I guess you know where you're going, then. A good day to you, captain," $heOrShe concludes, intentionally using a dirtsider farewell.
entries.zh: "你说的是。" $heOrShe翻着白眼说道，"那我猜你也是个明白人了。一路好走，舰长。" $heOrShe刻意用了滚地佬的告别方式说道。

entries.en: "Well. Ah. It's in the Galatia system." $HeOrShe does an admirable job trying not to sound condescending, "In orbit around Pontus. Beautiful views, if you ask me. But I'm a sucker for ring systems."
entries.zh: "呃...啊。在 Galatia 星系。" $HeOrShe避免了瞧不起人的口气来说这段话，这一点值得赞赏，"学院在 Pontus 轨道上。按我说风景非常美丽。不过我也确实喜欢环系统。"

o.en: Does the Academy pay well for transport jobs?
o.zh: 学院的运输工作报酬如何？

o.en: Say your farewells and cut the comm link
Took you long enough to answer your comms.

entries.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "My time is in great demand."
entries.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我的时间很紧。"

entries.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says stoically. "Your presence at the announcement of my Supreme Executorship was not unnoticed."

He lowers his head slightly, a slow nod. An acknowledgement that you acted as honorably as the situation allowed, even if you are no friend, much less an ally.
entries.zh:
"$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 淡淡地说，\"你出席我获任最高元首的宣告仪式，我不是没看见。"

他微微低头，缓缓一点。那是承认：在局势允许的范围内，你已尽可能做得体面，尽管你不是朋友，更不是盟友。

entries.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "I do not welcome your conversation, so make it quick."
entries.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我不欢迎这场谈话，所以有话快说。"

entries.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "You are sworn to my lost brother and we shall soon do battle. What have you to say?"
entries.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"你已向我那迷失的兄弟宣誓效忠，我们很快就要交战。你还有什么话说？"

entries.en:
The comms stall on the crest of the Persean League navy.

After several minutes, you pass the link to your comms officer to watch.
entries.zh:
通讯画面停在英仙座联盟海军的徽记上。

几分钟后，你把这条线路交给通讯官盯着。

The comms stall on the crest of the Persean League navy.

After several minutes, you pass the link to your comms officer to watch.
entries.zh:
通讯画面停在英仙座联盟海军的徽记上。

几分钟后，你把这条线路交给通讯官盯着。

entries.en:
You review a few reports from your senior officers, supply and fuel levels. A bizarre suggestion from a junior officer to switch to a four shift rotation...

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," you hear your comms officer. "I have Achilles... Achilles Andrada for you."
entries.zh:
你翻了几份高级军官的报告：补给与燃料存量。一名下级军官提出了改用四班轮换制的古怪建议...

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，\"你听见通讯官的声音，\"Achilles... Achilles Andrada 要找你。"

entries.en: He appears before you, posture rigid, uniform perfectly ordered.
entries.zh: 他出现在你面前，身姿僵直，制服一丝不苟。

entries.en: "Captain $playerLastName," Achilles says in stoic acknowledgement. "My time is in great demand."
entries.zh: "$playerLastName 舰长，\"Achilles 以克制的礼节应道，\"我的时间很紧。"

o.zh: 我为你在速子科技一位富有的高管那里打通了一条支持渠道。

o.en: I've secured support for your cause from a Tri-Tach agent on Achaman Station.
o.zh: 我在 Achaman 站上为你的事业争取到了一名速子科技特工的支持。

o.en: I've come to pledge my support for your cause. Because Fortuna Kato asked.
o.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。因为 Fortuna Kato 开口了。

o.en: Fortuna Kato is paying me to pledge you my support. So here I am.
o.zh: Fortuna Kato 出钱让我向你效忠。所以我来了。

o.zh: 我答应过向你效忠，但我无法真正支持你的事业。

o.en: The Prime Demarchon, Reynard Hannan, is conspiring against you.
o.zh: 大统领 Reynard Hannan 正在密谋对付你。

o.en: I've come to pledge my support for your cause. Because Finlay Siyavong told me to.
o.zh: 我来是为了对你的事业表示支持。因为 Finlay Siyavong 让我来。

o.en: I've come to pledge my support. Because it's what the Persean League wants.
o.zh: 我来表示支持。因为这是英仙座联盟想要的。

entries.en:
"Oh, you're the officer from Fleet, aren't you," she says, misidentifying you.

"Did you find Scylla? You Fleet people haven't told me anything useful at all. It makes me wonder what my taxes are going toward, to be perfectly honest."
entries.zh:
"噢，你是舰队来的军官吧，" 她说道，显然认错了你。

"找到 Scylla 了没有？你们舰队的人一点有用的消息都没告诉我。说实话，我都开始怀疑我的税钱到底花到哪儿去了。"

o.en: I'm calling about your daughter, Scylla.
o.zh: 我致电是有关你女儿 Scylla 的事。

entries.en: "I know, dear, you already mentioned it," she says.
entries.zh: "我知道，亲爱的，你已经提过这件事了，" 她说道。

entries.en:
"Of course it is," she says, humoring you. "It's always the fate of the worlds with Scylla, isn't it?"

"I know this is all very important to you, captain." Her voice takes on a more incisive tone. "But if she's hiding from someone, if she's hiding from you, I'm sure it's for a good reason. And like I told Mister Siyavong when he came by, I don't know where my daughter or Elissa are - and I wouldn't tell him if I did."

She crosses her arms.
entries.zh:
"当然，" 她敷衍道，"有 Scylla 在的世界，不都是这般命运吗？"

"我知道这一切对你至关重要，舰长。" 她的语气变得尖锐，"但如果她在躲避某人，如果她在躲避你，我相信她应该有充分的理由。就像我告诉来过这里的 Siyavong 先生那样：我不知道我女儿或 Elissa 在哪里 —— 就算知道也不会告诉他。"

她抱起双臂。

entries.en:
"Of course," she says. "Scylla is a good daughter."

"Sometimes it's a long time between them, and I get worried." She glances back toward her holotainment unit. "It'd be nice if she came for a visit."
entries.zh:
"当然，" 她说道，"Scylla 是个好女儿。"

"只是有时太久没消息，我会担心。" 她瞥了眼身后的全息娱乐装置，"要是她能来看看我就好了。"

o.en: Wonderful. Well, I shouldn't take any more of your time...
o.zh: 太好了。那么，我就不多耽误你的时间了...

o.en: I need to get back to my $shipOrFleet. Goodbye.
o.zh: 我需要回我的$shipOrFleet去了，再见。

entries.en: "Oh... isn't that nice." She smiles. "You must be very successful."
entries.zh: "哦...真不错啊。" 她微笑着，"你一定非常成功。"

o.en: I don't think I've emphasized how important it is for me to find Scylla and Elissa.
o.zh: 我想我还没有强调过找到 Scylla 和 Elissa 对我有多重要。

o.en: It's extremely important. The fate of the Persean Sector is at stake!
o.zh: 这至关重要。英仙座星域的存亡正悬于一线！

o.en: Comms more often? She's been in contact? But you said...
o.zh: 更常联系？她一直有联系？可你刚才说...

o.en: I'm not from Fleet, ma'am. I run an independent operation.
o.zh: 女士，我不是舰队的人。我经营独立业务。

o.en: I found Scylla on Laicaille Habitat, then... (explain)
o.zh: 我在 Laicaille 栖息地找到了 Scylla，然后... (解释)

entries.en:
"Now you be careful out there," she says. "I know you're young, but you're not immortal. And I heard on the holo all about these terrible pirates who..."

Her impression of what happens between the Fringe and Core is somehow both ridiculously exaggerated and entirely insufficient. The holo-networks of Fikenhild are famously more entertaining than informative.

Eventually you manage to extract yourself from the comms-link.
entries.zh:
"你在外面可要当心啊，" 她说道，"我知道你还年轻，但你可不是不死之身。我在全息网上看到那些可怕的太空海盗，他们..."

她对边缘星区与核心星区之间现状的描述，既夸张到可笑又片面得可怜。Fikenhild 的全息网络向来以娱乐性远胜与真实性著称。

最终你设法结束了这次通讯。

entries.en:
It takes a few minutes for the comms answer.

Adonya appears, flustered. "Y-yes, hello? Who is this on comms?"

You can hear the babble of holo-entertainment over the link.
entries.zh:
通讯应答延迟了几分钟。

Adonya 出现在画面中，神色慌张。"喂 —— 喂，你好？是哪位在通讯？"

你能从链接里听到全息娱乐节目的嘈杂背景音。

entries.en: You explain that you found Scylla on Laicalle Habitat and helped her initiate a very important project at the Galatia Academy.
entries.zh: 你解释说你在 Laicaille 栖息地找到了 Scylla，并帮助她在 Galatia 学院启动了一个非常重要的项目。

entries.en:
With Zal's assistance, Scylla helped Provost Baird develop a method to open the Gate System.

It was a high-pressure project, and dangerous. Not for her, of course. Her job was on the theory and numbers side. Adonya nods, an extra wrinkle of concern on her forehead.

It didn't quite work out as expected, you explain, however you did manage to make history by using the so-called Janus Device to traverse the Gates, the first such trip in over 200 cycles. And it was made possible through Elissa Zal's engineering based on theoretical developments by Academician Scylla Coureuse.
entries.zh:
在 Zal 的协助下，Scylla 帮助 Baird 院长开发了开启星门系统的方法。

那是个高压且危险的项目，当然，危险不是针对她。她的工作集中在理论与计算方面。Adonya 点点头，额头上忧虑的皱纹更深了。

你解释道，结果并未完全符合预期，但你们确实利用所谓的 "双面神" 装置 穿越了星门，并创造了历史 —— 这是两百多个星历年以来的首次实现此类航行。而这一切的实现，都建立在 Scylla Coureuse 院士的理论突破与工程师 Elissa Zal 的实践基础之上。

entries.en:
"Oh!" Adonya lights up at your words. "I'm so happy she found Elissa again, what a nice girl. A little strange, though. Always up to something. But that's my Scylla."

"I think she gets her taste from me," Adonya says in a  conspiratorial half-whisper.

"You should have met her father! You'd have liked him, I think. Stars above, he could be a troublemaker. But he was fun," she nods to herself.
entries.zh:
"噢！" 你的话让 Adonya 容光焕发，"我真高兴她又和 Elissa 重逢了，多好的姑娘，就是有点怪，总在琢磨些什么。不过这就是我的 Scylla。"

"我觉得她的品味是随我，" Adonya 用说悄悄话的语调说道。

"你真该见见她父亲！我想你会喜欢他的。天哪，他可会惹麻烦了。但很有趣，" 她自顾自地点点头。

o.en: And, um, that's all there is to tell.
And then Scylla and Zal disappeared. I don't know where to.
o.zh: 然后 Scylla 和 Zal 就失踪了，我不知道她们去了哪里。

o.en: Then they disappeared together. I'm trying to find them.
o.zh: 然后她们就一起消失了，我正在寻找她们的下落。

entries.en: "Oh, okay," she says.
entries.zh: "哦，好的，" 她说道。

entries.en: "Oh, okay," she says, unconcerned.
entries.zh: "哦，好吧，" 她漫不经心地说道。

entries.en: "Oh," she says, apparently unconcerned. "Good luck."
entries.zh: "哦，" 她说道，显然有些漫不经心，"祝你好运。"

entries.en:
"Thank you for stopping by, captain. I know you must be very busy and an old woman's worries are probably the last thing on your mind, but it was good of you to take the time."

She pauses for a moment. "If you find her, tell her she could send comms more often. I do so love hearing from her."
entries.zh:
"感谢你过来一趟，舰长。我知道你一定很忙，一个老太婆的担忧大概是你最不关心的事，但你能抽时间过来真是太好了。"

她停顿片刻。"如果你找到她了，就告诉她可以多来联系些。我真的很喜欢收到她的消息。"

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet gets within range of the $nameInText that you've been contracted to run a black-box sensor package on.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet接近了 $nameInText，合同要求你对其使用黑匣子扫描软件包。

o.zh: 运行黑匣子扫描软件包

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet gets within range of the $nameInText that you've been contracted to run a black-box sensor package on.

However, a hostile fleet is tracking your movements, leaving you no time to stop and run the sensor package.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet接近了 $nameInText，合同要求你对其使用黑匣子扫描软件包。

附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的行动，使你无暇停船使用扫描软件包。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet gets within range of the $nameInText that you've been contracted to run a black-box sensor package on.

Unfortunately, your fleet's base sensor strength is not sufficient to perform the scan to the mission's specifications.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet驶入了$nameInText的探测范围 —— 你受雇要在这目标上跑一套黑箱传感套件。

不巧的是，你舰队的基础传感强度不足以按任务要求完成这次扫描。

entries.en:
You tap a button to execute the black-box sensor package and wait for it to finish. On completion, it provides an escrow key that authorizes the agreed-upon payment to be transferred to your account.

Presumably, it will transmit the scan results on a secure channel when you're near a comm relay, and then delete itself from your systems.
entries.zh:
你按下了一个按钮来运行黑匣子扫描套件，并等待它完成。完成后，它提供了托管密钥，用于授权将商定报酬转入你的账户。

看来当你接近通讯中继站时，它将自动使用安全通道传输扫描结果，然后从你的设备中自我删除。

entries.en:
Kanta's minion transfers you the relevant data to perform the operation: a cursory nav entry providing no useful tactical info, a quick skim tells you. Your approach is all up to you. It would definitely be prudent to launch the attack with your transponder off, for starters...

$HeOrShe bares $hisOrHer protruding diamond canines - a hot look among certain crowds, you're sure. "Remember to have fun," $heOrShe says, then cuts the link.
entries.zh:
Kanta 的手下将行动相关信息转交给你：一个简单的坐标，没有任何有用的战术信息。简单看过后你认为实际的操作方式全看你自己的安排。当然，攻击时关掉应答器肯定是上策...

$HeOrShe露出了自己的钻石尖牙 —— 你估计这玩意在某些团体里是种热门的造型。"记得玩得高兴。" $heOrShe说道，随后切断了链接。

entries.en: "Of course you will," $heOrShe says, "For when Kanta demands blood, she will have blood. One way or another."
entries.zh: "你当然得干。" $heOrShe说道，"Kanta 要流血，便总得有人要流血。"

entries.en: "I am certain," $heOrShe says, "That Kanta will herself be most pleased by the blood and ruin you create for her."
entries.zh: "我敢肯定，" $heOrShe说到。"Kanta 将会对你为她所造成的鲜血和毁灭而满意的。"

entries.en:
$marketName fills your bridge tactical display, a spatter of hollowed icons representing dead targets. The last one blinks out. This should make the Warlord Kanta happy, if she is even capable of that emotion anymore.

You wave a hand to collapse the tactical display, and it winks out obediently. The holomatrix snows then reforms a navigational overview, your $shipOrFleet holding station in the center.
entries.zh:
$marketName 占满了你的舰桥战术显示界面，代表目标被击毁的空心图标不断飞溅而出。随着最后一个目标熄灭，这该能让军阀 Kanta 高兴了，如果她还能有那种感情的话。

你轻轻挥手，战术显示界面随之折叠关闭。四散的全息噪点随后重聚成了导航总览界面，你的$shipOrFleet正稳稳驻留在画面正中央。

o.en: Assert that you decline Kanta's demand
o.zh: 坚持拒绝 Kanta 的要求

entries.en:
"More's the pity," the pirate says coldly, drawing the line of a tear down $hisOrHer face.

The comms cut to a distorted skull overlaid on scenes of ultraviolence; a common affectation of dedicated, professional pirates.
entries.zh:
"那还真是可惜了。" 海盗冷声说道，一边用手指在自己脸上划出一道泪痕。

通讯画面切换成一个扭曲的骷髅标志，覆盖在极端暴力的画面之上；这是那些专注且专业的海盗惯用的装点手法。

entries.en:
The pirate puts on a look of concern, probably false. "This is not a negotiation, captain. The Warlord demands blood and ruin, so it you will provide."

"It comes either from $affk_marketName, or from you," $heOrShe casually drops $hisOrHer datapad. "The choice is yours."
entries.zh:
海盗装出了一副担忧的模样。"这不是在谈判，舰长。军阀要求鲜血与毁灭，所以你必须奉上。"

"这要么来自 $affk_marketName，要么来自你。" $heOrShe随手丢开了$hisOrHer的数据平板。"选择权在你。"

entries.en:
The pirate looks amused. "There is not," $heOrShe shrugs with feigned calm.

"What Kanta demands, Kanta gets. Our choice is whether to stand in the way of her rage - to what, prove something? It proves nothing. This is the way of the Persean Sector, captain."

"So," $heOrShe taps a short rhythm on $hisOrHer control console. "If it is suicide you think will result, then Kanta can provide your death just as well as some faction-navy. Choose."
entries.zh:
海盗看上去被逗乐了。"没别的办法。" $heOrShe假装冷静的耸了耸肩。

"Kanta 需要，Kanta 得到。我们的选择要么是挡在她的愤怒前来 —— 来干嘛？证明什么？什么都证明不了。在英仙座星域就是这么做事的，舰长。"

"所以" $heOrShe在$hisOrHer的控制台上按了几下。"如果你觉得最后会是自杀，那 Kanta 就和那些势力的海军一样能让你死。选吧。"

o.en: Never mind, I don't actually have any.
o.zh: 抱歉，我其实并没有这种东西。

o.en: Select AI cores to turn in
o.zh: 选择上缴的 AI 核心

o.en: I'd like to turn in these AI cores that I've acquired...
o.zh: 我想上缴我找到的这些 AI 核心...

entries.en:
"A dangerous catch you have there - there's no telling what could happen if one got into the hands of terrorists. I ... that is, we, are sure to be rewarded by the Lion for surrendering this to Diktat Intelligence straightaway."
OR
"It's a good thing you came directly to me; a less understanding officer might have you arrested for transporting material deemed a threat to the interests of the Sindrian Cause. Your loyalty shall be rewarded."
entries.zh:
"你手里的这些战利品很危险，假如一个这种东西落入到恐怖分子的手中，没人知道会发生什么。如果立即把这交给辛达强权情报局的话，狮心统帅他肯定会奖励我的...哦不对，我们的。"
OR
"幸好你是直接来找我，其他不太会变通的官员可能会以运输危害辛达主义利益的物品罪而将你逮捕。你的忠诚应该获得嘉奖。"

entries.en: "A fascinating offer. Why, if one of the major factions caught you with these, they might just seize them outright. Tell you what - I'll do you a favor and give you a good price."
entries.zh: "的确是个好主意。怎么说？如果其他主要势力的人查到你带着这些东西，他们可能会直接罚没它们。听我的，我会帮你处理这事，还能给你开个好价钱。"

entries.en: "We don't generally like the public to be aware that these exist, citizen, but the Hegemony is treaty-bound to take possession of any such objects and ensure they're destroyed."
entries.zh: "我们通常不希望公众知道这些东西的存在，公民。根据条约的规定，任何此类物品都必须接受 霸主 当局的管控并确保它们被销毁。"

entries.en: "You were right to bring these to me. I shall contact the Knight Commander to take possession of these abominations so that they may be properly cleansed."
entries.zh: "你把这些东西带给我是个明智的决定。我会通知骑士长来接手这些可憎之物，以便让它们能被妥善地净化。"

entries.en:
"You bring demon cores, seeds of Moloch!" $HisOrHer eyes go wide.

"Aye, these abominations must be destroyed before they may spread further corruption! The blessed Path led you here because we have the tools and the knowledge to do it properly. And of course," $heOrShe allows a slight smile, "your righteous devotion will not go unrewarded."
entries.zh:
"你带来的是恶魔核心，是摩洛克的种子！" $HisOrHer眼睛瞪得老大。

"不错，这些可憎之物必须销毁，免得它们再把腐化散播开去！蒙福的左径把你引到这儿，正因我们有工具、也有见识把这事办妥当。当然了，\" $heOrShe露出一丝笑意，\"你这份虔诚的奉献，不会得不到回报。"

entries.en: "An excellent find, citizen. The polity of Kazeron, and of course the Persean League as a whole, will recognize and reward your fulfillment of patriotic duty in assisting in finding these dangerous objects."
entries.zh: "真是个杰出的发现，公民。Kazeron 政权，当然还有 英仙座联盟 全体，都会表彰你在协助寻找这些危险物体时所履行爱国义务。"

entries.en: "An excellent find, citizen. We can't allow factions that would seek to impose their tyranny over our Sector to accumulate these dangerous objects."
entries.zh: "真是个杰出的发现，公民。我们不能坐视不管，任由那些妄图将暴政强加于我们星域的势力获得更多这些危险物品。"

entries.en: "You hold quite the object of fascination there, though you are surely aware that you lack the expertise and capital necessary to exploit its full potential. The Tri-Tachyon Corporation would be more than pleased to offer you a fair market price for your goods."
entries.zh: "您所掌握的东西真令人着迷，不过您肯定意识到了自己缺乏必要的专业知识和资本来发掘它的全部潜力。三一速子科技公司 将非常乐意为您的货物开出合理的市价。"

entries.en: $PersonRank $personLastName thanks you and the conversation moves on to other matters.
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personLastName 感谢了你，然后将谈话转向了其他事务。

entries.en: $PersonRank $personLastName salutes in an energetic display of loyalty to the Sindrian Cause before allowing you to turn to other matters.
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personLastName 敬了个礼，积极地展示自己对辛达主义事业的无限忠诚，然后才让你讨论其他事务。

entries.en: $PersonRank $personLastName thanks you on behalf of the Hegemony Council and the conversation moves on to other matters.
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personLastName 代表 霸主 当局感谢了你，然后将谈话转向了其他事务。

entries.en: $PersonRank $personLastName verifies the transfer before moving the conversation to other matters.
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personLastName 在确认了交接事项之后便将话题转向了其他事务。

entries.en: $PersonRank $personLastName thanks you for your devotion to the cause of an independent Persean Sector.
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personLastName 感谢了你对维护英仙座星域的独立自由所作出的奉献。

entries.en: $PersonRank $personLastName says a quick prayer and thanks you on behalf of the Church.
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personLastName 简短地做了段祷告，并代表教会感谢了你。

entries.en:
"Unto holy fire we consign this evil."

$PersonPost $personLastName says a prayer with you, and gives thanks on behalf of the local section of the Luddic Path.
entries.zh:
"愿以此邪物，付与圣火。"

$PersonPost $personLastName与你一同祷告，并代卢德左径本地支部致谢。

entries.en: $personName smiles like a carnivorous animal you saw in a holodoc once.  "It's a deal."
entries.zh: $personName 笑得像是你曾在全息影像中看到过的食肉动物一样，"成交！"

entries.en:
"This will be your starting place; a short book of wisdom assembled from the musings of the Lion of Sindria. Citizens of the Sindrian Diktat, followers of the Glorious Vision, find that these words may uplift them in all aspects of daily life."

$HeOrShe leans in, "Personally, I like to read a few lines before sleep and upon waking. I find it focuses my mind and aligns my will with the necessity of the Movement.

Returning to $hisOrHer former posture, $heOrShe continues, "Serve the interests of the Sindrian Diktat. You may be so lucky that a place for you may be found in our Movement - find an administrator and they may assist you in taking on a commission in service of the Supreme Executor."
entries.zh:
"这将是你的起点，从辛达瑞亚之狮的沉思中总结出的智慧结晶。辛达强权 的公民，光荣愿景的追随者，发现这些话可以在日常生活的各个方面提升他们。"

$HeOrShe俯下身来，"就我个人而言，我喜欢在睡前和醒来时读几行。我发现能让我更专注，使我的意志与运动的必要性一致。"

$heOrShe靠了回去，继续说，"为 辛达强权 的利益服务。你可能会很幸运地发现自己在我们的事业中有一席之地 —— 去找管理员，他们可以帮你接受服务于最高元首的雇佣。"

o.en: I'll be sure to study it. Constantly. (lie)
o.zh: 我会研读它的，夜以继日。

o.en: I'll be sure to study it. Constantly.
o.zh: I'll be sure to study it. Constantly.

entries.en: "Excellent," $heOrShe says with a decisive nod.
entries.zh: "很好。" $heOrShe坚定地点了点头。

entries.en: "Excellent," $heOrShe says with a decisive nod.
entries.zh: "很好，" $heOrShe 果断地点了点头。

entries.en: "It is you who will thank me, in time," $heOrShe says without irony.
entries.zh: "你迟早会感谢我的。" $heOrShe说，话语中没有讽刺的味道。

entries.en:
You notice a small eye-twitch.

"The office of the Supreme Executor does not provide handouts. It is the strong who find themselves drawn to the glorious vision of Supreme Executor Admiral Philip Andrada, and who, through his Movement, shall return civilization to the Persean Sector and then the former Domain."

$HeOrShe looks up, you presume at a portrait of Andrada. "It is only, ONLY through service to his unique and glorious vision for a new humanity that excellence may be achieved."

$HisOrHer gaze lowers toward you, now. "The only question you must answer is: how do you fit into that vision?" $HisOrHer eyes narrow, "Or will you find yourself among the dregs of history?"
entries.zh:
你注意到对方的眼角轻微抽搐了一下。

"最高元首办公区不提供施舍。只有强者会被最高元首 Philip Andrada 将军的光辉愿景所吸引，并通过实际行动将文明带回英仙座星域，光复人之领。"

$HeOrShe抬起头看向了什么东西，你觉得那是 Andrada 的一幅画像。"只有，只 —— 有 —— 通过服务于他独特而辉煌的新人类愿景，才能取得卓越的成就。"

$HisOrHer的目光又投向了你。"你必须回答的唯一问题是：你将在这个愿景中扮演怎样的角色？" $HisOrHer的眼睛眯起，"或者你只是甘愿当历史的尘埃？"

entries.en:
$Rank $PersonName nods dutifully, and something similar to but distinct from pleasure crosses $hisOrHer face.

"Submission to Supreme Executor Admiral Philip Andrada's glorious new vision for the future is the first step. Let me send you some literature..."
entries.zh:
$PersonName $Rank 尽职地点着头，一些类似但又不同于愉悦的东西在$hisOrHer的脸上闪过。

"服从于最高元首 Philip Andrada 将军对光辉未来的伟大愿景是第一步。让我先发给你几篇宣传材料..."

entries.en:
"Serve the interests of the Sindrian Diktat," $heOrShe says without hesitation.

"You may find yourself, through submission to the Glorious Vision of our Movement, in a position to serve the Sindrian Diktat. Speak with an administrator and they may assist you in taking on a commission."
entries.zh:
"为 辛达强权 的利益服务。" $heOrShe毫不犹豫地说。

"顺从我们的光荣愿景，你自然就身处为 辛达强权 服务的行列中。和管理员谈谈，管理员会和你商谈雇佣事宜。"

entries.en:
$Rank $PersonName's face tightens a little, somehow.

"You do not simply speak with," $heOrShe takes on a corrective tone, "the Supreme Executor, the Lion of Sindria, Admiral Philip Andrada."

A pause for breath, then $heOrShe continues, "And I would warn you to show proper deference to the greatness of the man."
entries.zh:
$PersonName $Rank 的脸看上去绷得更紧了一些。

"你不能浅显地..." $heOrShe带着纠错的口吻说，"与最高元首，辛达瑞亚之狮，Philip Andrada 将军对话。"

$heOrShe停下来喘了口气，然后继续道，"我要警告你，必须对这位领袖的伟大之处表示出你的热诚。"

entries.en:
$Rank $PersonName nods, just a little.

"As you surely realize, the Lion of Sindria receives countless petitions from his loyal followers. I shall log your request."
entries.zh:
$PersonName $Rank 稍微点了点头。

"你肯定已经知道，辛达瑞亚之狮收到过无数来自他忠实追随者的请愿书，我将记录你的请求。"

entries.en:
You make arrangements for the old man, the youth, and their robot to be shuttled to your $shipOrFleet.

They don't seem especially dangerous. Surely no one in the Hegemony or Sindrian Diktat is putting much effort into tracking their movements.
entries.zh:
你做好将老人，小伙子，以及他们的机器人送到你的$shipOrFleet上的安排.

他们看上去不算多么危险。霸主 和 辛达强权 想来也不会在追踪这种人上浪费多少精力。

o.en: I'd be careful about trusting your feelings around here, old man.
o.zh: 老头，在这种地方我可不敢轻信我的感觉。

o.en: What's with the robot, got some kind of AI in there?
o.zh: 这机器人又是怎么回事，里面有什么 AI 吗？

entries.en:
The old man looks like a hermit who's been living out in the wastes for countless cycles. His robes are dusty, his skin creased and tanned.

He smiles mysteriously as you approach, and speaks both to you and the mop-haired kid, more a youth of not yet 20 cycles.

"I have a good feeling about this one."
entries.zh:
老人看上去像是一个在荒郊野岭居住了无数星历年的隐士。他的袍子上满是灰尘，他的皮肤晒得又黑又皱。

在你向他走去的同时，老人给了你个神秘的笑容，然后同时向你以及一个头发杂乱，看上去不到二十岁的小伙子说话。

"这个人我感觉不错。"

entries.en:
The old man looks like a hermit who's been living out in the wastes for countless cycles. His robes are dusty, his skin creased and tanned.

He smiles mysteriously as you approach, and you can see he is accompanied by a mop-haired kid, a youth of not yet 20 cycles.

"I have a feeling that you're not the captain we're looking for," he says amiably. "Your $shipOrFleet is far too large. We seek simple transport, not a warfleet."

With that, he puts his hands together and gives a nod, almost a bow.
entries.zh:
老人看上去像是一个在荒郊野岭居住了无数星历年的隐士。他的袍子上满是灰尘，皮肤则被晒得又黑又皱。

在你向他走去时老人脸上露出了神秘的微笑。这时你也注意到有个看上去不到二十岁的毛头小伙陪伴在他身边。

"我觉得你不是我们要找的舰长。" 他和蔼地婉拒道，"你的$shipOrFleet规模太大了，我们只想找个普通的运输船队，不想找个战舰舰队。"

说完话，他双手相握着向你点头致意，感觉像是鞠了一躬一样。

o.en: If you're some kind of terrorist, I don't want to know.
o.zh: 如果你真是什么恐怖分子，那别和我扯上关系。

o.en: If you're some kind of terrorist, I want to know.
o.zh: 如果你真是什么恐怖分子，让我开开眼。

o.en: If you're some kind of terrorist, I want to charge more.
o.zh: 如果你真是什么恐怖分子，那得加钱。

o.en: It's probably best that I not ask.
Let me guess- you need transport, no need to involve the authorities.
o.zh: 我猜猜 —— 你需要运输，而且不需要跟官方打交道。

entries.en:
The youth starts to speak, "Because he's a- " and the old man lifts a finger in warning, shutting the kid up.

"Just some old history that most people have forgotten by now. It is best that you not ask, I think."
entries.zh:
年轻人开始说话，"因为那是 ——" 老人举起一根手指警告，让孩子停止讲话。

"只是一些大多数人已经忘记的旧历史。我认为你最好不要问。"

entries.en:
The old man nods like he expected this. The kid looks offended, "We could buy an old ship for that much! I bet I could get it working in no time, then we just-" the old man raises a hand to quiet him.

"I can offer you 17,000 credits upon arrival," he says calmly, "and no more."

The kid crosses his arms and sulks.
entries.zh:
老人点点头，仿佛他预料到了这一点。孩子看起来很生气，"这么多星币，够我们买一艘旧船了！我打赌我很快就能让它飞起来，然后我们就 ——" 老人举手让他安静。

"抵达后我可以支付给你 17,000 星币。" 他平静地说，"不能再多了。"

孩子交叉双臂，生着闷气。

entries.en:
The anger and disappointment on the kid's face is palpable. The old man puts a hand on his shoulder, with just a small motion diverting the rush of youthful emotion.

As you step away, you overhear the old man speaking softly, "There is another..."
entries.zh:
小伙子脸上的愤怒和失落再清晰不过了。老人把手放在他肩膀上，这一简单的动作便止住了气血上涌的年轻人。

你离开时，你听到老人轻声说，"还有一个..."

o.en: The job sounds too hot for me. Find another captain.
o.zh: 这份工作对我来说是个烫手山芋。找其他舰长吧。

entries.en: The old man's smile returns, like he expected you to say this.
entries.zh: 老人的笑容又回来了，就像他预料到你会这么说一样。

entries.en:
"They led you to me, did they not?" he says, as if it means anything.

The kid gets a look of awe, eating this line up like ancient wisdom.
entries.zh:
"把你带到我面前的不正是你的感觉吗？" 老人说到，好像这话有什么意义似的。

那小伙子则满脸崇拜，完全把这句话当成了什么古人的大智慧。

entries.en: The old man says nothing, the hint of a smile on his lips. The kid looks back and forth between you and the old man, waiting to see what will happen next.
entries.zh: 老人一言不发，只是嘴角挂着一丝若有若无的笑意。孩子在你和老人之间来回看了看，等待接下来会发生什么。

entries.en: The old man makes a show of exchanging a glance with the kid, who looks worried. "I don't think we look like terrorists, do you?"
entries.zh: 老人与孩子交换了个眼神，而孩子看起来很担忧。"我不觉得我们看起来像恐怖分子，你觉得呢？"

entries.en: "You don't need to worry about our little friend here," the old man says.
entries.zh: "你不用担心我们这位小伙伴。" 老人说道。

o.en: I don't need to worry about it.
Actually, I need to know if that thing is safe.
o.zh: 可是，我确实需要知道那玩意是否安全。

entries.en: The old man nods, satisfied.
entries.zh: 老人满意地点点头。

entries.en:
The kid finds his tongue. "Of course it's safe! We bought it from some scavengers and then I took it apart and put it back together myself."

It sounds like he's been holding back an outburst this whole time.

"I can fix anything!" he adds.
entries.zh:
那小伙子终于说得出话来了。"它当然安全！这是我们从一些拾荒者处买来的，我亲自把它拆解又重新组装了一遍。"

听得出来他憋话憋坏了。

"我什么都能修好！" 他补充道。

o.en: Sure. If I need some farm equipment repaired I'll let you know.
o.zh: 成。要是我有啥农具需要修理我会来找你的。

o.en: I could use a junior engineer in my fleet.
o.zh: 我的舰队可以再招个下级工程师。

o.en: So what's this about, old man?
o.zh: 所以，老头，这是怎么回事？

entries.en:
This sets the kid off.

"I'm not just some dune-farmer," the youth says, raising his voice, "I'm a great pilot just like-" the old man reaches out and touches him on the shoulder. The kid takes the hint.

"What my young friend means to say is that we have another task in mind."
entries.zh:
这把小伙子惹急了。

"我可不是什么荒地农夫。" 年轻人提高了声音说到，"我是个优秀的驾驶员，就像 —— " 老人伸出手拍了拍他的肩膀，年轻人反应了过来。

"我年轻的伙伴想说的是我们另有需要。"

entries.en:
The youth is taken aback by this respect granted to him by a space captain. He looks like he's actually thinking about it. "I can't, I mean thank you, but I'm a great pilot just like-" the old man reaches out, holding him back.

"What my young friend means to say is that his destiny lies elsewhere."
entries.zh:
年轻人明显被一位星舰舰长给与他的敬意吓到了。看上去他真的在考虑你的提议。"我做不到，感谢您，但我是个优秀的驾驶员，就像 —— " 老人忽然伸手让他打住。

"我年轻的伙伴的意思是他的命运另在他处。"

entries.en: "A simple run to Volturn. You'll be paid and then you can forget all about us," the old man says, his mysterious smile returning.
entries.zh: "就是简简单单地往 Volturn 跑一趟。你会拿到钱，然后就可以忘了我们。" 老人说到，神秘的笑容又回到了他脸上。

entries.en: "You are quite correct, captain," the old man says. "You shall be paid 10,000 credits upon arrival in Volturn, in the Askonia system. It is as you say: we should like to avoid any patrols or inspections."
entries.zh: "你说得对，舰长。" 老人说，"抵达 Askonia 星系的 Volturn 后，你将获得 10,000 星币的报酬。正如你所说：我们应该避开任何巡逻队或检查。"

o.en: Why do the authorities want you so badly?
o.zh: 为什么当局会那么想抓到你们？

entries.en:
You receive a comms transmission from an obviously illicit orbital repeater which provides directions to a dropoff point for the old man, the kid, and their robot. And the promise of anonymous payment.

As they walk down the shuttle's ramp, the kid exclaims, "Wow, a planet made entirely of water!"
entries.zh:
你从一个明显非法的轨道中继器里收到了前往老人、孩子和机器人下船地点的路线，以及先前许诺好的报酬。

当他们走下穿梭机的斜坡时，那孩子惊呼道："哇，一个完全由水构成的星球！"

o.en: It's just a moon, kid. With a rocky core.
o.zh: 就是个卫星，孩子。内核是岩石。

entries.en: The kid manages not to look disappointed at this revelation.
entries.zh: 那孩子努力不让自己对这番真相流露出失望。

entries.en:
You receive a comms transmission from an obviously illicit orbital repeater which provides directions to a dropoff point for the kid, and their robot. And the promise of payment.

The kid walks sullenly down the shuttle's ramp, his loyal robot trundling behind. As he steps onto the rolling deckplates of Volturn, he looks back.

"Take care of yourself, I guess," he says. "That's what you're best at, isn't it."
entries.zh:
你从一个明显非法的轨道中继器里收到了前往小伙子和机器人下船地点的路线，以及先前许诺好的报酬。

小伙子无精打采地走下了穿梭机的阶梯，他忠心的机器人跟在后面。当他踏上了 Volturn 的海上平台后，他转过身来。

"多多保重你自己吧。" 他说到。"你最擅长这个了，不是吗？"

o.en: We all do what we gotta do to survive, kid.
o.zh: 孩子，为了活命，我们都得做该做的事。

entries.en:
The kids gives you a look, a mix of sadness and a checked rage that you can tell will risk boiling over for a long time to come.

He turns to his robot. "Com'on, let's go," he says.
entries.zh:
孩子们露出混合着悲伤与压抑愤怒的表情，你看得出来，这种情绪在很长一段时间内都将面临沸腾失控的风险。

他转向自己的机器人。"来吧，走了。" 他说道。

entries.en: He looks like he's going to take the bait, but the robot bleeps at him, defusing his anger.
entries.zh: 看上去他几乎要上钩了，但是机器人对着他哔哔了几声，他冷静了下来。

entries.en: You're unable to safely deliver your passengers to Volturn right now.
entries.zh: 你目前无法将你的乘客安全地送达 Volturn 。

entries.en: The old man smiles and simply says, "Thank you, my friend," then turns up the hood of his robe and leads the strange party into the underworld of Volturn.
entries.zh: 老人笑了笑，简单地说到。"谢谢你，我的朋友。" 随后带上了他长袍的兜帽，带着他奇怪的一行人深入了 Volturn 的地下世界。

o.en: I have someone of interest to transfer to your flagship, officer.
o.zh: 长官，我有个你会感兴趣的人，正准备送到您的旗舰上。

o.en: I have some persons of interest to transfer to your flagship, officer.
o.zh: 长官，我有些你会感兴趣的人员，正准备送到您的旗舰上。

o.en: I'm transporting a couple sand farmers. It's a charitable act.
o.zh: 我就是搭载了几个沙漠农夫，这是做慈善。

o.en: You have no right to kidnap my passengers.

entries.en:
"Transporting sand farmers," the Diktat officer repeats, "For charity."

More than a hint of disbelief slips out at the final word.
entries.zh:
"运输沙漠农夫，" 辛达强权士官重复道。"做慈善。"

他最后一个字中露出了不止一星半点的怀疑。

entries.en:
Then anger cracks across $hisOrHer face, "That is the most preposterous lie I've ever-"

A ping from the other bridge comes across the comms, interrupting the beginning of $hisOrHer tirade. The Diktat officer gives you a killing look then exchanges quiet words with some underlings; your comms officer gives you a tentative nod.
entries.zh:
$hisOrHer终于愤怒地爆发了。"这是我听过最扯淡的 ——"

一声哔声从对面舰桥的通讯台传来，打断了$hisOrHer正要开始的长篇大论。辛达强权的军官死死瞪了你一眼，掉头跟几个手下低声交谈了几句；你的通讯军官试探性地点了点头。

entries.en:
Your quick-thinking bridge crew has provided a fake manifest on your behalf, of course.

Of course they would have a plausible but misleading pre-generated crew and passenger manifest ready for just such a situation. If you offered it with enough confidence - and very little delay - it might just work.

You wait with saintly patience as the Diktat officer has an underling run the fake manifest through the latest Diktat search and verification algorithms.
entries.zh:
你反应机敏的舰桥组员早就理所当然地替你提交了一份伪造的载员名册。

正是为了应付这种情况，他们理所当然地预先备好了一份看似合理却极具误导性的载员名册。只要你不带半点犹豫、自信满满地把它递交上去，搞不好真能糊弄过去。

你心怀圣人般的沉稳耐心等待，看着这位辛达强权军官吩咐手下用强权最新的检索与核验算法去过一遍那份伪造的舱单。

entries.en:
You hear an angry call of "Run it again!" that perhaps was not intended to get picked up by comms. It takes a few more minutes.

"Very well," the Diktat officer says with what sounds like clenched teeth, "Your manifest has been verified. Technically."

With a sharp motion, $heOrShe signals to $hisOrHer comms to cut the link.
entries.zh:
透过通讯台，你听到愤怒的声音要求 "再查一遍！"，或许对方没注意你能听到。之后又过了几分钟。

"好吧。" 辛达强权士官咬牙说到。"你的乘员名单至少在技术意义上确认属实。"

$heOrShe随即挥手让$hisOrHer的通讯员切断链接。

entries.en:
You have the old man and the kid transferred to the Sindrian Diktat flagship. They even want the robot "for evidence", so you have that old piece of junk sent as well.

"Your service to the Supreme Executor will be noted in the official records," $personRank $personLastName says like $heOrShe is reading a script for $hisOrHer bridge crew. "Your loyalty to the Great Movement is commended, and your reward for turning in a known terrorist and his accomplice will now be transferred."

$HeOrShe performs a bizarre salute and shouts something about "final victory"; your comms officer manages to extract you from the comm-link without further engagement.
entries.zh:
你把老人和小伙子送上了 辛达强权 旗舰。他们甚至为了 "收集证据"，把那个机器人也要了过去。

"你为最高元首做出的贡献会在官方记录里留下一笔。" $personRank $personLastName 以给属下念台词的口吻说到。"你对伟大运动的忠心值得赞许，而交出著名恐怖分子和他同伙的奖赏会稍后转到你手上。"

$HeOrShe 给了你个奇怪的敬礼，然后嚷嚷了几句关于 "最终的胜利" 什么的；你的通讯军官总算找到机会将你从对话中解放出来。

entries.en:
"Captain," the Sindrian Diktat officer says in a level tone, "We have reason to believe that you carry a terrorist known to the Sindrian Security Directorate."

$HeOrShe barely lifts a finger, and a supplementary data package is transmitted to you. Your comms officer attaches the contents to a secondary display: it's the old man from Asharu. Much younger in this looping holo, wearing the military uniform of some minor polity instead of robes.

"It would expedite my investigation if this individual found his way to my flagship." $HeOrShe smiles the coldest, smallest smile in the Sector.
entries.zh:
"舰长，" 辛达强权 的军官沉稳地说道，"我们有理由怀疑你搭载了一位辛达安全部所认定的恐怖分子。"

$HeOrShe轻抬了下手指，你便收到了一个带有补充信息的数据包。你的通讯军官将内容放到了你的副显示屏上：这是 Asharu 上那个老人。他在这个全息回放里看上去年轻得多，身上穿着某个小势力的军服，而非长袍。

"我想，要是这位先生能来我旗舰上坐一坐，定能大大加快调查的进展。" $HeOrShe给了你一个你在星域中见过最冷，最微小的笑容。"

o.en: I'll need a moment to review my passenger manifest. (stall)
o.zh: 我需要时间检查下我的乘客列表。 (拖延时间)

o.en: I'm transporting a couple sand farmers. It's a charitable act.
o.zh: 我就是搭载了几个沙漠农夫，这是做慈善。

o.en: You have no right to kidnap my passengers.

entries.en:
The Diktat officer looks less patient now, the polite smile barely a memory.

"Captain," $heOrShe says in full knowledge of your lies, and knowing you know $heOrShe knows, "I trust you've thoroughly reviewed your passenger manifest."
entries.zh:
辛达强权士官看上去没什么耐心了，之前的礼貌微笑早已不见。

"舰长。" $heOrShe说到，口气明显已知道你在撒谎，而且知道你对此自己心里也有数。"我相信你已仔细检查过了你的乘客名单。"

entries.en:
"We shall take no prisoners!" the Diktat officer shouts, "Those who harbor terrorists are themselves terrorists, and will be treated as-"

The link cuts out. Your comms officer gives you an apologetic look.
entries.zh:
"我们将不留俘虏！" 辛达强权士官吼道。"包庇恐怖分子者皆是恐怖分子，我们会将其 ——"

通讯链接被切断了，你的通讯军官面带着些许歉意看了你一眼。

entries.en:
The old man goes calmly to the shuttle for transfer.

"Your service to the Supreme Executor will be noted in the official records," the Diktat $personRank says as if $heOrShe is reading a script for $hisOrHer bridge crew. "Your loyalty to the Great Movement is commended, and the reward for turning in a known terrorist will now be transferred to your accounts."

$PersonRank $personLastName performs a bizarre salute and shouts something about "final victory"; your comms officer manages to extract you from the comms-link without further exchange.
entries.zh:
老人安静地走向了穿梭机等待交接。

"你为最高元首做出的贡献会在官方记录里留下一笔。" 辛达强权 $personRank 以给属下念台词的口吻说到。"你对伟大运动的忠心值得赞许，而交出著名恐怖分子的奖赏会稍后转到你手上。"

$PersonRank $personLastName 给了你个奇怪的敬礼，然后嚷嚷了几句关于 "最终的胜利" 什么的；你的通讯军官总算找到机会将你从对话中解放出来。

entries.en: "Then," $heOrShe seems to find pleasure in $hisOrHer words for the first time, "You are resisting a lawful search performed under the authority of the Supreme Executor. A hostile act of terrorism against our dear Sindrian Diktat."
entries.zh: "那么，" $heOrShe似乎终于从$hisOrHer自己的话语中感受到了愉悦。"那你就是在抵抗最高元首权威下合法的检查。这乃针对我们敬爱的 辛达强权 的恐怖主义行为。"

entries.en:
And that's the end of it. You start to wonder how things might have gone differently if you'd carried out the job and snuck what was clearly some kind of former military officer and his protege into contact with a faction of the Askonian underground...

You call to navigation to lay in a new course.
entries.zh:
事情就这么了结了。你不由得想了下如果你把那个前军官和他的小徒弟按约定送到了某个 Askonia 地下组织的手上后事情会怎样发展...

你叫领航官指定一道新航线。

entries.en:
The smile disappears, like it barely existed.

"I see."

The Diktat officer turns away, motioning to $hisOrHer bridge crew, "In the name of the Supreme Executor I order you to power down your systems and prepare to be boarded," then looks back over $hisOrHer shoulder, and adds "Our search will be... thorough."
entries.zh:
对方的笑容消失了，好像从没存在过一般。

"我明白了。"

辛达强权的士官转过头去，对$hisOrHer的舰桥组员比了个手势，"以最高元首的名义，我令你关闭护盾，准备被登舰。" $hisOrHer往后望了下，补充道："我们会...仔细检查。"

o.en: No, that isn't going to happen.
I'm transporting a couple sand farmers. It's a charitable act.
o.zh: 我就是搭载了几个沙漠农夫，这是做慈善。

entries.en:
The Diktat troopers sent to search your fleet seem more interested in bullying your crew and breaking delicate machinery than performing a legitimate search.

Your passengers are easily hidden, but you can tell by the expression on your engineering chief's face that serious damage has been done.
entries.zh:
登舰检查的辛达强权士兵与其说是进行合法检查，更像是来破坏精密设备和欺压你的船员的。

把你的乘客藏好不难，但是你的总工程师的表情清楚地告诉你损害不轻。

entries.en: "All glory to the Lion of Sindria," $personRank $personLastName with a final smirk before severing the comm-link.
entries.zh: "荣耀归于辛达瑞亚之狮。" $personRank $personLastName 脸上带着讥笑中断了通讯链接。

entries.en: The Diktat officer gives the barest nod. Your comms officer takes this as a cue to freeze the transmission.
entries.zh: 辛达强权的军官微不可见地点了下头。你的通讯军官抓住这个机会暂停了通讯。

entries.en: In a briefing room, the old man watches the holo of his younger self with a wistful smile. The kid is there, looking terrified. Their robot beeps and performs some kind of idling cycle.
entries.zh: 在简报室，老人望着他年轻时的全息投影，嘴边挂着一个怀念的微笑。小伙子也在，他看上去害怕极了。他们的机器人则在哔哔地进行着某种待机循环。

entries.en:
"Now there's a man I have not seen in a long, long time," he says quietly. "By now, even I was starting to think he might be dead."

He looks to you now, a glimmer of that younger self appearing in his face. "Give me over to them, captain. The boy must go to Volturn without me. He will be safe if they have me."

The kid is aghast. "No!" he shouts, "They'll kill you!"
entries.zh:
"我可很久，很久没有见到过这个人了。" 他轻声说到，"到这时候，连我都以为他已经死了。"

他看向你，脸上能看出些许当年的样子。"把我交给他们，舰长。这个少年必须独自前往 Volturn。只要辛达有了我，他就安全了。"

小伙子惊呆了。"不！" 他叫道，"他们会杀了你！"

o.en: I'm not handing anyone to the Diktat.
o.zh: 我不会把任何人交给强权。

o.en: No, this ends here. I'm handing you all over.
o.zh: 不，到此为止了，我会把你们都交出去。

entries.en: Unfortunately the kid speaks up. "Wow, is that you? I knew it! You were part of-" The old man holds up a hand to stop the outburst. He closes his eyes.
entries.zh: 不幸的是，小伙子开口了，"哇，那是你吗？我就知道！你是——" 老人抬手制止了这位十分激动的小伙子。他闭上了眼睛。

entries.en:
"What!?" the kid shouts, "You can't do that! You're just-" he lunges at you, and is bodily intercepted by the arm of one of your guards. After a yelp and a moment of struggle, the kid folds to an electrostun rod.

The old man does not give the commotion even a glance. Instead, his eyes are steady on yours. Looking deeply for something.

"So this is how you choose, $playerName." He looks thoughtful, "Fate may surprise us yet."
entries.zh:
"什么？！" 小伙子吼道，"你不能这样做！你就是个 ——" 他向你扑来，被你的一个卫兵伸手拦住。他短暂的挣扎之后挨了一电击棍，呻吟一声安静下来了。

老人对刚刚的骚动视而不见。他的眼睛直直地盯着你的眼睛，试图探寻你深处的什么东西。

"所以这便是你的选择，$playerName。" 他似乎陷入沉思。"命运或许还能给我们一个惊喜。"

entries.en:
The old man looks more tired than surprised.

The kid shouts, "Great! You can fight 'em off with your $shipOrFleet! I can help at the gunnery station, I'm a great shot. I promise I'll be careful and-"

You and the old man exchange a look. "Come, young one," the old man says, taking the youth by the shoulder. "We must let the good captain get to work."
entries.zh:
老人看上去与其说是惊讶，更多是疲惫。

小伙子叫道。"好！你的$shipOrFleet可以把他们都打跑！我可以帮忙操作炮台，我打的可准了。我保证我会小心而且 —— "

你跟老人交换了个眼神。"来吧，年轻人。" 老人拉住小伙子的肩膀说到。"我们得让舰长开始工作了。"

entries.en:
"What!?" the kid shouts, "You can't do that. You have to fight! You have a $shipOrFleet! You're just going to let those Diktat goons order you around?" He lunges at you, and is bodily intercepted by the arm of one of your guards. After a yelp and a moment of struggle, the kid folds to an electrostun rod.

The old man does not give the commotion even a glance. Instead, his eyes are steady on yours. Looking deeply for something.

"He has so much to learn, $playerName." He looks thoughtful, "Fate may surprise us yet."
entries.zh:
"什么？！" 小伙子吼道，"你不能这样做，你得反击！你有$shipOrFleet！难道就让这些辛达强权的混混们随便差遣你吗？" 他向你扑来，被你的一个卫兵伸手拦住。他短暂的挣扎之后挨了一电击棍，呻吟一声安静下来了。

老人对刚刚的骚动视而不见。他的眼睛直直地盯着你的眼睛，试图探寻你深处的什么东西。

"他要学的还有很多，$playerName。" 他看上去在沉思。"命运或许还能给我们一个惊喜。"

o.en: Not worth my time. Find someone else.
o.zh: 这不值得我花时间。找其他人吧。

o.en: I'd like to ask you about Faro Inesis.
o.zh: 我想问问 Faro Inesis 的事。

entries.en:
He sighs.

"Isn't that nice. I suppose you won't let up until I tell you all about how I feel about him, is that right?"
entries.zh:
他叹了口气。

"可真好。看样子不把我对他那点看法一五一十抖出来，您是不肯罢休了，对吧？"

o.en: I just want to know if he can be trusted.
o.zh: 我只想知道，这人信不信得过。

o.en: Correct. So how do you feel about him?
o.zh: 说得对。那你怎么看他这个人？

o.en: If it bothers you, I won't ask. Please accept my apologies.
o.zh: 要是这话题让你不自在，我就不问了。对不住。

entries.en:
He thinks for a moment.

"Yes and no. He'll uphold contracts and agreements, and he will tell you the truth. To the letter, at least. Maybe not the full picture, if you don't ask very carefully."

Arroyo frowns and looks away.

"But I'm not sure he... likes anything. For himself. He follows the trends and fashions, the popular holos. But it's other people's words, not his own. It's like..."

He shakes his head.
entries.zh:
他想了想。

"也算也不算。合同、约定，他照守；真话，他也照说。至少字面上句句属实。至于全貌嘛，你要是不问得够仔细，那就未必了。"

Arroyo 皱起眉，把目光挪开。

"可我拿不准他...自己究竟喜欢什么。他追潮流、赶风向，什么全息片火就看什么。可那都是别人嘴里的话，不是他自己的。就像..."

他摇了摇头。

entries.en:
"Fine." He crosses his arms and looks away.

"Runs a tight operation. Efficient. Fantastic profit margins."

"But I'm not sure he... likes anything. For himself, I mean. He follows the trends and fashions, the popular holos. But it's other people's words, not his own. It's like..."

He shakes his head.
entries.zh:
"行吧。" 他抱起胳膊，别过脸去。

"摊子管得严，效率高，利润厚得吓人。"

"可我拿不准他...自己究竟喜欢什么。我是说，他自己。他追潮流、赶风向，什么全息片火就看什么。可那都是别人嘴里的话，不是他自己的。就像..."

他摇了摇头。

entries.en:
Arroyo looks back at you, through the link. Uneasy.

The silence draws out.

"I don't want to talk about Inesis. Running any good schemes? You owe me at least a commodity futures tip-off, I swear."
entries.zh:
Arroyo 隔着通讯链接重新看向你，神色不自在。

沉默一点点拖长。

"Inesis 我不想谈了。最近有什么好买卖？你至少欠我一条大宗商品期货的内幕消息，我可记着呢。"

entries.en:
Arroyo stares. The moment draws out.

"What are you doing?"
entries.zh:
Arroyo 直直地看着你。这一刻被拉得很长。

"你这是干什么？"

o.en: Apologizing. I'm sorry to have upset you.
o.zh: 道歉啊。惹你不痛快了，对不住。

entries.en:
He leans back, into shadow. His expression is hard to parse.

"Don't. I... don't like apologies."

He looks away, perhaps out his window at a gorgeous landscape.

"I don't want to talk about Inesis. Running any good schemes? You owe me at least a commodity futures tip-off, I swear."
entries.zh:
他往阴影里一靠，脸上的神情叫人看不透。

"别。我...不爱听人道歉。"

他别开眼，也许是望向窗外那片绝好的景致。

"Inesis 我不想谈了。最近有什么好买卖？你至少欠我一条大宗商品期货的内幕消息，我可记着呢。"

entries.en:
"What she believes is that if she makes a show of how much she doesn't care about anything, anyone, it'll look like she's the most ruthless and focused executive in the Company. Just see how much she's willing to destroy to succeed! There must be something to it, right?"

He sits back, fists clenched. "It's a waste of capital! Human resources, too. Do you know how expensive it is to train good techs, competent management? Of course loyalty can be bought, but then her performance gets attached to the Company brand and makes buying it more expensive for the rest of us. So now I'm paying higher labor premiums? To boost HER career?"
entries.zh:
"她认为，如果自己表现出对任何事情、任何人都漠不关心，那就会显得她自己是公司里最无情、最专注的高管。看看她为了成功愿意付出多大的代价！这一定有她的道理，对吧？"

他坐了回去，一边握紧拳头。"这是在浪费资金！人力资源也一样在浪费。你知道培养优秀的技术人员和有能力的管理人员要花多少钱吗？当然，忠诚是可以买到的，但她的表现会与公司品牌形象联系在一起，徒增我们其他人的购买花销。所以我现在就要支付越来越高的劳动保险费？只是为了让 '她' 平步青云？"

o.en: I had no idea you were such a humanitarian.
o.zh: 我真没想到你居然是这样一个秉持人道主义的人。

o.en: So her plan is to get me killed?
o.zh: 这么说，她的计划会置我于死地？

o.en: So her plan was to get those mercs killed?
o.zh: 这么说，她的计划是要让那些雇佣兵送命？

o.en: Surely you can use this against her.
o.zh: 你肯定能用这一点来对付她。

entries.en:
He gives you a look.

"Don't even start."
entries.zh:
他看了你一眼。

"别给我来这套。"

entries.en:
"Probably not." He gives you a look.

"But she'll use your death if she finds a way to make it useful. And she will."
entries.zh:
"可能不会。" 他看了你一眼。

"但如果她能找到从你的死亡中获利的方法，她就会这么做。而她一定会找到的。"

entries.en:
"Probably not." He gives you a look.

"But she'll use their death if she finds a way to make it useful to her. And she will."
entries.zh:
"可能不会。" 他看了你一眼。

"但如果她能找到从他们的死亡中获利的方法，她就会这么做。而她一定会找到的。"

entries.en:
He gives you a look.

"We'll see."
entries.zh:
他看了你一眼。

"我们拭目以待。"

entries.en:
"My advice is don't get involved. And you're not going to listen, are you."

He looks away, thinking. His hands held together in front of his mouth, not quite the form of Luddic prayer.

"Seen a few fleet operators fall right off the map. She's looking for something. Big risk. I'd bet if I knew what it was I'd say it wasn't worth it."
entries.zh:
"我的建议是不要掺和进来，而你也没打算听我的，对吧。"

他移开目光，陷入沉思。双手在嘴前合十，但这姿势并不怎么像卢德教徒的祈祷姿势。

"已经有好几个舰队在地图上彻底消失了。她正在寻找一些东西。而且风险巨大。我敢打赌就算我知道那是什么，我也会说那绝对不值得。"

entries.en:
"My advice is, if you get involved? Watch your back. Mind yourself. Don't trust her."

He looks away, thinking. His hands held together in front of his mouth, not quite the form of Luddic prayer.

"Seen a few fleet operators fall right off the map. She's looking for something. Big risk. I'd bet if I knew what it was I'd say it wasn't worth it."
entries.zh:
"我劝你一句：真要插手，就把背后看紧点，处处留神，别信她。"

他移开目光想着什么，两手合拢抵在嘴前，差一点就是卢德式祷告的手势。

"见过好几个跑船的直接从星图上没了影。她在找什么东西，风险大得很。我敢打赌，真知道她找的是什么，我准会说不值当。"

o.en: We'll just have to find out.
She wants me to find something called the 'Threat'.
o.zh: 她要我去找一个叫'威胁'的东西。

entries.en:
"My advice is, if you get involved? Watch your back. Mind yourself. Don't trust her."

He looks away, thinking. His hands held together in front of his mouth, not quite the form of Luddic prayer.

"Seen a few fleet operators fall right off the map. She's looking for something. Big risk. I'd bet if I knew what it was I'd say it wasn't worth it."
entries.zh:
"我劝你一句：真要插手，就把背后看紧点，处处留神，别信她。"

他移开目光想着什么，两手合拢抵在嘴前，差一点就是卢德式祷告的手势。

"见过好几个跑船的直接从星图上没了影。她在找什么东西，风险大得很。我敢打赌，真知道她找的是什么，我准会说不值当。"

o.en: We'll just have to find out.
She wants me to find something called the 'Threat'.
o.zh: 她要我去找一个叫'威胁'的东西。

entries.en:
His eyes meet yours through the link.

"We won't. I'm going to be rich, get richer, and enjoy my splendid home. You can go do something very stupid if you have to. Just hope it doesn't get us all killed."
entries.zh:
他和你透过视频画面对上了视线。

"并非如此。我会变得越来越有钱，然后回家享受我的豪宅。如果你非要去干什么非常蠢的事，那你就去。我只希望这不会害死我们。"

entries.en:
His eyes meet yours through the link.

"I'm going to be rich, get richer, and enjoy my splendid home. You should do the same."

He looks away again, presumably at achingly beautiful mountain vistas. "But you won't."
entries.zh:
他和你透过视频画面对上了视线。

"我会变得越来越有钱，然后回家享受我的豪宅。你也应该一样。"

他又把目光转向别处，大概是在看壮阔美丽的山景。"但你却不会如此。"

entries.en:
His eyes meet yours through the link.

"That sounds like the third worst idea I've ever heard."
entries.zh:
他和你透过视频画面对上了视线。

"这听起来像是我这辈子听过的第三糟糕的主意。"

entries.en:
He falls back in his chair with an unhappy sound.

"Not now."
entries.zh:
他倒在椅子上，不高兴地说。

"现在不想说。"

entries.en:
He leans back in his chair.

"Sure."
entries.zh:
他靠回在椅子上。

"那是当然。"

entries.en:
He leans back in his chair.

"Sure."
entries.zh:
他靠回在椅子上。

"不客气。"

entries.en: "You did, didn't you." He glares. Then makes an exasperated sigh.
entries.zh: "是你做的，对吧。" 他瞪着你，然后愤怒地叹了口气。

entries.en: He glares at you for a moment. Then sighs, looking away.
entries.zh: 他瞪了你一会儿，然后叹了口气，随即看向别处。

o.en: She told me you didn't have the 'killer instinct for senior leadership'.
o.zh: 她跟我说，你缺乏 '高层领导所需的杀手本能'。

entries.en:
"She would," he says.

"What I know is that business is about people. Business is deals, and people make deals. I'm a people person. That's why I'm looking out for you, $playerFirstName. Remember that."

Then makes an exasperated sigh.

"Now. Glamor-Rotanev," he frowns and puts his hands together.
entries.zh:
"像是她会说的话。" 他说道。

"我所知道的是，商业的关键是人。商业本质是交易，而交易是由人促成的。我擅长与人打交道，这也是我为何会关照你，$playerFirstName。记住这一点。"

随后，他发出一声满是恼怒的叹息。

"好了，来谈谈 Glamor-Rotanev。" 他皱起眉头，双手交握放在身前。

o.en: I, uh, couldn't say. I was interested in your impression of her.
o.zh: 我，呃，不好说。我更想知道你对她的看法。

entries.en: He glares at you for a moment. Then sighs, exasperated.
entries.zh: 他瞪了你一会儿，然后愤怒地叹了口气。

entries.en:
"No, you can't just back out of this," he says with a glare. "You need to know who you're dealing with."

He pauses for moment, considering you.

Then sighs, exasperated.
entries.zh:
"不行，这事你不能就这么撒手不管。" 他瞪着你说，"你得搞清楚自己在跟谁打交道。"

他停顿片刻，一边打量着你。

随后，他满是恼怒地叹了口气。

o.en: I found a dead ship. Full of recordings of hatred for this Glamor-Rotanev.
o.zh: 我发现了一艘废弃的舰船。上面充斥着对 Glamor-Rotanev 的仇恨留言。

entries.en:
"Of course!" Arroyo says with a laugh. "Oh, that's our Zunya alright."

He takes a deep breath and rubs his forehead, suddenly somber. "Let me tell you about her."
entries.zh:
"那是当然！" Arroyo 笑着说道，"哦，这才是我们认识的 Zunya 嘛。"

他深吸一口气，揉了揉额头，神情突然变得严肃起来。"我来跟你讲讲她的事吧。"

entries.en:
"Good. Me too." He picks up a TriPad.

"Anything else going on? Maybe something nice? Something that won't get poison slipped in my dinner or get me arrested by a covert-ops snatch-squad?"
entries.zh:
"很好。我也一样。"他拿起 TriPad。

"还有别的事吗？来点好消息？那种不会有人往我晚饭里下毒、也不会害我被秘密行动组的抓人小队逮走的事？"

entries.en: "Sure," he says. "And I'm not surprised Andrada had something like this cooking... from the beginning of his hostile takeover, from the sounds of it. It makes sense given his fundamentals."
entries.zh: "当然，\"他说，\"我也不意外 Andrada 早就炖着这么一锅东西...听上去，从他开始那场敌意收购的时候起就在炖了。以他的基本面来看，这很合理。"

entries.en:
"Imagine you're an egotistical maniac," he gives you a look. "Not merely egotistical a normal, justified amount, like me. Imagine a real loose fitting."

"If you really needed a backup, you could create children. Clones are a step better, though. More control. A more perfect vessel because you can count on them looking like you, more or less. Appeals to the ego, right?"

"Setting that aside, your first option would be life-extension, of course. But what if you're a paranoid dictator under tech restrictions and constant threat of hostile covert ops? Hard to find life-extension care you can trust."
entries.zh:
"想象你是个自大狂，\"他瞥了你一眼，\"不是像我这样，只自大到正常、合理的分量。想象一个彻底脱了缰的。"

"如果你真需要一个备份，你可以生孩子。克隆体要更进一步：更好控制。也更像一件完美的容器——你差不多能指望他们长得像你。这对自大狂很有吸引力，对吧？"

"撇开这个不谈，你的首选当然是延寿手段。可要是你是个偏执的独裁者，受着技术管制，还时刻面临敌对秘密行动的威胁呢？你很难找到信得过的延寿医疗。"

entries.en:
He rubs his fingers through his beard, thoughtful.

"They're delicate operations, potentially long recovery time. Need to stay awake to make sure no one gets any ideas. So do it quick and sophisticated. Domain-era tech like that has a limited pool of practitioners, and they're closely watched."

"Imagine if even one technician was compromised. Could do it subtle, switch a few codes in a custom protein-nanite top-up... built-in delay, make whatever went wrong look natural. Or like the fault of someone else."

Arroyo puts his hands behind his head, and leans back in his luxurious chair.

"Glad I'm not him."
entries.zh:
他手指捋过胡须，若有所思。

"那些手术都很精细，恢复期可能很长。你得保持清醒，好确保没人动歪心思。所以要做得又快又精。那种人之领时代的技术，能上手的人本来就没几个，而且都被盯得很紧。"

"想想看，只要有一个技师被人拿住了。动手可以很隐蔽：在定制的蛋白纳米补剂里换掉几个编码...设好延迟，让出问题的地方看起来是自然发生，或者像是别人的过失。"

Arroyo 双手枕到脑后，往他那张奢华的椅子里一靠。

"幸好我不是他。"

o.en: Are you saying Philip Andrada was murdered by a life extension treatment?
o.zh: 你是说 Philip Andrada 是被人用延寿治疗害死的？

entries.en:
"Does it matter what got him?"

He manages the suggestion of a shrug; not easy in his pose.

"I'm saying it could be done. And if I wanted to live a long, happy life - and I do - then I wouldn't go around making major powers of the Persean Sector my enemy."
entries.zh:
"他是怎么倒下的，有区别吗？"

他勉强做出一个耸肩的样子——以他这个姿势，可不容易。

"我是说，这种事办得到。而我要想长命百岁、过得舒坦——我确实想——那我就不会到处把英仙座星域的大势力都树成敌人。"

entries.en:
"Never said it wasn't," he says. "If you detect a certain exasperation in my manner credit it to your recklessness."

He takes a steady, calming breath.

"And I can't say I'm the least bit surprised Andrada had this scheme cooking for... since the beginning of his hostile takeover, from the sounds of it. Makes sense given his fundamentals."
entries.zh:
"我可没说过它不重要，\"他说，\"你要是在我身上瞧出一股不耐烦，那得记在你自己的鲁莽账上。"

他稳稳吸了一口气，把心气压下去。

"而且我一点也不意外 Andrada 早就炖着这么一锅计划...听上去，从他开始那场敌意收购的时候就在炖了。以他的基本面，这很说得通。"

entries.en:
"Oh yes," he says confidently.

"And I'll consider my advice to you in this conversation to be sufficient payment for the tip-off. So don't try angling for a cut. You've got to do the work yourself."

He smirks.
entries.zh:
"哦，那当然，"他答得很笃定。

"至于这次谈话里给你的这些建议，我就当作够付你那份情报的钱了。所以别想着再从我这儿分一杯。活儿得你自己去干。"

他嘴角一撇，笑了。

entries.en:
"If I were you," he says, "I'd forget about all of it, sell my fleet, and invest in something stable so I could live a long, comfortable life."

He glares at you pre-emptively. "And if you don't like that advice, you shouldn't have asked in the first place."
entries.zh:
"要是我是你，\"他说，\"我就把这一切都忘掉，把舰队卖掉，投点稳当的产业，好让自己长长久久、安安稳稳地过完这辈子。"

他抢先瞪了你一眼。"你要是不爱听这建议，当初就不该来问。"

entries.en:
"This is about those files, isn't it."

He gives you an accusing look.

"You decrypted them. And now... what?"
entries.zh:
"这是为了那些文件，是吧。"

他用责备的目光看着你。

"你把它们解开了。然后呢...你想怎么样？"

o.en: Explain about the seven clone-sons of Philip Andrada
o.zh: 说明 Philip Andrada 那七个克隆儿子的事

o.en: Is this going to stress you out? Should I stop?
o.zh: 这事会让你压力太大吗？要不要我不说了？

entries.en:
He looks suspicious.

"Production problems in the fuel industry, disruption of the supply chain? Hmm," he taps at a TriPad. "I've got capital to work with on the fuel angle..."

Arroyo looks up from reviewing his charts and portfolios. "Or is this more. It is, isn't it."
entries.zh:
他面露怀疑。

"燃料产业的生产出了问题，供应链断了？嗯，\"他敲了敲 TriPad，\"燃料这块我手上有资金可以动..."

Arroyo 从他那堆图表和投资组合上抬起头。"还是说，这事比那更大。是的，更大，对吧。"

o.en: Explain about the seven clone-sons of Philip Andrada
o.zh: 说明 Philip Andrada 那七个克隆儿子的事

o.en: Never mind, I don't want to stress you out.
o.zh: 算了，我不想给你添压力。

entries.en:
You begin to explain about the files, about what appear to be seven clone-sons of Andrada in seven star systems. You've confirmed most of the files' content, finding clones of Andrada raised in various unique circumstances... and there may be a conspiracy targeting them.

Arroyo is leaning on one hand, the fingers digging deep into his temple.
entries.zh:
你开始讲那些文件，讲那似乎是七个散布在七个星系里的 Andrada 克隆儿子。文件的内容你已核实了大半：这些 Andrada 的克隆体成长于各不相同、各自独特的环境...而且，似乎有一场阴谋正冲着他们而去。

Arroyo 一手支着头，手指深深掐进太阳穴。

o.en: Plus, Andrada himself appears to be incapacitated. Braindead, probably.
o.zh: 再说，Andrada 本人似乎也废了。大概是脑死亡。

entries.en:
You begin to explain about the files, about what appear to be seven clone-sons of Andrada in seven star systems.

Arroyo is leaning on one hand, the fingers digging deep into his temple.
entries.zh:
你开始讲那些文件，讲那些似乎是 Andrada 克隆儿子的人——七个，分散在七个星系。

Arroyo 一手支着头，手指深深掐进太阳穴。

o.en: Plus, Andrada himself appears to be incapacitated. Braindead, probably.
o.zh: 再说，Andrada 本人似乎也废了。大概是脑死亡。

entries.en:
You begin to explain about the files, about what appear to be seven clone-sons of Andrada in seven star systems. You've confirmed a few, and each seems to have been raised in unique circumstances...

Arroyo is leaning on one hand, the fingers digging deep into his temple.
entries.zh:
你开始讲那些文件，讲那似乎是七个散布在七个星系里的 Andrada 克隆儿子。你已确认了其中几个，而每一个似乎都是在各自独特的环境里养大的...

Arroyo 一手支着头，手指深深掐进太阳穴。

o.en: Plus, Andrada himself appears to be incapacitated. Braindead, probably.
o.zh: 再说，Andrada 本人似乎也废了。大概是脑死亡。

entries.en:
He takes a deep breath, then slowly lets it out.

"I see," he says finally. "So what?"
entries.zh:
他深吸一口气，再缓缓吐出来。

"我明白了，\"他终于开口，\"所以呢？"

entries.en: "I think we're done with that." He picks up a TriPad. "Anything else?"
entries.zh: "我看这事就到此为止吧。\"他拿起 TriPad，\"还有别的事？"

o.en: Don't you think this is important?
o.zh: 你不觉得这事很重要吗？

o.en: Why aren't you surprised by the clones?
o.zh: 你为什么对克隆体一点也不意外？

o.en: I think we're done with this subject.
o.zh: 这个话题就到此为止吧。

o.en: This is important. What's your read on the situation?
o.zh: 这事很重要。你怎么看眼下的局面？

entries.en:
"No. I'm already stressed out because you brought this up, whatever 'this' is."

He leans back. "Besides, I have good chems for this sort of thing."

"Now, explain."
entries.zh:
"不。你一提这事我就已经有压力了，管它'这事'是什么。"

他往后一靠。"再说，这种事我有上好的药剂。"

"现在，说吧。"

o.en: Explain about the seven clone-sons of Philip Andrada
o.zh: 说明 Philip Andrada 那七个克隆儿子的事

entries.en:
"I'm already stressed out imagining what insane scheme you've tied yourself up in this time."

"Now, explain."
entries.zh:
"光是想象你这次又把自己缠进了什么疯癫的勾当，我就够有压力的了。"

"现在，说吧。"

o.en: Explain about the seven clone-sons of Philip Andrada
o.zh: 说明 Philip Andrada 那七个克隆儿子的事

entries.en:
"Well, I already agreed to help." Arroyo looks you over. "Just don't push your luck."

"What's the plan?"
entries.zh:
"行吧，我已经答应帮忙了。\"Arroyo 把你上下打量一遍，\"只是别得寸进尺。"

"计划是什么？"

entries.en:
His look is skeptical, bordering on dismissive.

"Back on this, huh," he says.

But he does appear to be listening.
entries.zh:
他的目光带着怀疑，几乎算得上不屑。

"又绕回这事了，"他说。

不过他看起来确实在听。

entries.en: "Then why the big pitch?" He shakes his head, annoyed.
entries.zh: "那你刚才那一大通兜售算什么？" 他烦躁地摇了摇头。

entries.en: "I guess you do have a Tri-Tachyon commission," he admits rather begrudgingly.
entries.zh: "看来你手里确实有张速子科技的委任状，"他不情不愿地承认。

entries.en: "I'm not as annoyed with you as all logic suggests I should," he says. "For some reason."
entries.zh: "按道理我该对你很不耐烦，可我并没有那么不耐烦，\"他说，\"不知道是什么缘故。"

entries.en:
"I told you I didn't want to get involved," he says. "Remember when you came to me waving around some top-level secret files you stole from the... who was it - oh, right, the leader of the Sindrian Diktat's secret police with a reputation for torture and assassination? Remember that?"

He looks away, shaking his head. "I make it a policy never to get involved with someone named after an animal. Never ends well."
entries.zh:
"我跟你说过，我不想掺和。\"他说，\"还记得你跑来找我，手里挥着几份顶级机密文件，从那个...谁来着的——哦对，辛达强权秘密警察的头子，一个以酷刑和暗杀出名的家伙——从他那儿偷来的？还记得吗？"

他别过脸去，摇了摇头。"我有个原则：绝不跟名字是动物的人打交道。从来没好下场。"

entries.en:
"Sure," he says agreeably, tapping at a TriPad. "I'll have my people set up the shell companies. I wager we'll be moving cargo within two or three shifts."

It sounds almost as if Arroyo may enjoy running a smuggling operation into a star system burning in civil war.
entries.zh:
"行啊，\" 他爽快地应道，一边戳着 TriPad，\"我让我的人去把空壳公司搭起来。我打赌，两三个班次之内咱们就能开始运货了。"

听着倒像是 Arroyo 挺享受这桩买卖：往一个正烧着内战的星系里走私。

entries.en:
"Sure," he says agreeably, tapping at a TriPad. "I'll have my people set up the shell companies. I wager we'll be moving cargo within two or three shifts."

"Meeting concluded. And I'm busy, so." He waves you off, looking back to his TriPad.
entries.zh:
"行啊，\" 他爽快地应道，一边戳着 TriPad，\"我让我的人去把空壳公司搭起来。我打赌，两三个班次之内咱们就能开始运货了。"

"会开完了。我这儿还忙着呢，就这样。" 他摆了摆手把你打发走，目光又落回 TriPad 上。

entries.en:
You cut the comms, leaving him to his business.

It sounds almost as if Arroyo may enjoy running a smuggling operation into a star system burning in civil war.
entries.zh:
你切断了通讯，留他忙自己的事去。

听着倒像是 Arroyo 挺享受这桩买卖：往一个正烧着内战的星系里走私。

entries.en:
His expression makes it clear he does not welcome the topic.

"Help? I told you to lay low and you agreed."
entries.zh:
他的神情明摆着不欢迎这个话题。

"帮忙？我跟你说过要低调蛰伏，你也答应了。"

o.en: I want you to back Achilles' faction. He's a reformer.
o.zh: 我要你支持 Achilles 那一派。他是个改革者。

o.en: Uh, no plan just yet. I'll get back to you.
o.zh: 呃，暂时还没计划。我回头再来找你。

o.en: I want you to assist Hector, the true heir to Andrada.
o.zh: 我要你协助 Hector——Andrada 真正的继承人。

o.en: I want you to help supply the uprisings against the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 我要你帮那些反抗辛达强权的起义者供应物资。

entries.en:
His expression makes it clear he does not welcome the topic.

"Now why exactly would I want to get involved in that 'situation'?"
entries.zh:
他的神情明摆着不欢迎这个话题。

"那么，我到底为什么会想掺进那个'局面'里去？"

entries.en:
