entries.en:
The chaos spreads outward, crew and locals alike staring, and those drunkest and angriest standing. One pulls a knife, which prompts a pirate three tables down to draw a gun, at which point your instinct to find cover kicks in.

You hear your name shouted like a curse, and an already broken vidscreen on the support column behind you explodes into burning plastic fragments, the soft-round from a boarding pistol putting it well out of its misery.

Your bodyguards respond with controlled bursts from energy weapons set to low-power, giving cover to your withdrawal. Smoke, screams, and flashes of discharge fill the bar. Stumbling outside, you see passers-by clearing out as fast as they can. A noodle stand cook gives you a frightened look as they duck behind armored shutters. There'll be no quiet business done in this bar for the shift, that much is clear.
entries.zh:
混乱蔓延开来，船员和本地人都瞪着你，还有几个最醉的 —— 也是最愤怒的人，站了起来。有人掏出了刀子，隔着三张桌子的另一名海盗见状掏出了枪，于是你开始本能的找掩体。

你听到有人像骂脏话一样吼出你的名字，同时，你身后支撑柱上原本就坏掉了的显示屏绽成了无数燃烧着的塑料碎片，看来是谁接舷战配枪中打出的软质子弹结束了这东西的一生。

你的保镖们抬起能量武器，将发射模式调整成低功率模式，节制地开火掩护你撤离。刹那间，酒吧里充满了烟雾、尖叫、还有武器发射的闪光。你刚跌跌撞撞地跑出门，就看到街边路人都在快速逃跑，某个面条摊的厨子蹲在装甲卷帘门后面，惶恐地看了你一眼。很明显，今天酒吧里没什么能安静谈事的地方了。

entries.en:
The chaos begins to spread outward, crew and locals alike staring, and those drunkest and angriest standing. A couple executives in the back roll their eyes and activate a privacy field as their bodyguards step out of the shadows to protect their small pocket of peace.

You hear your name shouted like a curse, and a makeshift missile shatters on the support column behind you, cracking a vidpanel into fractal nonsense.

Your bodyguards form a human shield to cover your path to the exit. Stumbling into the corridor outside, you can hear alarms and the buzz of surveillance drones which signal the rapid approach of one or another of the corpo security franchises. There'll be no quiet business done in this bar for the shift, that much is clear.
entries.zh:
混乱蔓延开来，船员和本地人都瞪着你，还有几个最醉的 —— 也是最愤怒的人，站了起来。后排的几个高管翻了个白眼，启动了隐私场，他们的保镖从阴影中走出，保护着他们小小的安宁之地。

你听到有人像骂脏话一样吼出你的名字。同时，一发临时制成的投掷物在你背后的承重柱上轰然碎裂，将一块视频面板砸成了毫无意义的碎片。

你的保镖们组成人墙，护卫你走出酒吧。你刚跌跌撞撞地跑出门，就听到警报声和监视无人机的嗡嗡声，看来公司有一个安保部门正在迅速接近，虽说分不清具体是哪个。很明显，今天酒吧里没什么能安静谈事的地方了。

entries.en:
A patron does a double-take, and with recognition comes a look of intense hatred.

"You!" The shout cuts through the clatter and noise of the bar like a shot. The burly spacer stands, and readies a meaty fist...

Only to be thrown back onto a table with a smash of glassware by one of your bodyguards - generally discreet, but paid well to take initiative at times like these.
entries.zh:
一个顾客再三确认了下你的长相，认出你的身份后，对方的脸被仇恨扭曲。

"你！" 他的吼声如枪声般盖过了酒吧的喧嚣。这个壮硕的太空佬站了起来，举起了他满是横肉的拳头...

结果就是被你的保镖直接扔到了一张桌子上，玻璃碎了一地 —— 你的保镖们平时虽然行事低调，但是这些时候先下手方能为强。

entries.en:
A server appears by your side, a glass of what looks exactly like your favorite drink on a silver tray.

"Compliments of the house."
entries.zh:
一位服务员出现在你面前，手中的银盘上正是你最爱的饮品。

"本店的一点心意。"

o.zh: '本店'？这不应该是我本人的店吗？

o.en: No thanks. I'm, uh, not thirsty.

entries.en: The server nods and politely disappears. A sip reveals that it is perfectly to your taste.
entries.zh: 服务员礼貌地点了点头，离开了。轻抿一口，确实完美符合你的口味。

entries.en: You take the drink and the server politely disappears. A sip reveals that it is perfectly to your taste.
entries.zh: 你接过饮料，服务员礼貌地点了点头，离开了。轻抿一口，确实完美符合你的口味。

entries.en: "Technically yes, $playerSirOrMadam, though your organization leases to the proprietor. Who, by the way, extends their compliments."
entries.zh: "理论上是的，$playerSirOrMadam，不过是您的组织把店租给业主的，另外，那位业主向您致以问候。"

o.en: I wish to pay like any other customer. I insist.
o.zh: 我希望和其他顾客一样付钱。我坚持这一点。

o.en: No thanks. I'm, uh, not thirsty.

entries.en:
"Of course, $playerSirOrMadam. I'll see that the price of the drink is subtracted from the facility fees."

With that, the server politely disappears. You examine the drink you just bought, then take a sip. It is, in a word, perfect.
entries.zh:
"当然可以，$playerSirOrMadam。我会将饮料的费用从物业费里扣除。"

说完，服务员礼貌地离开了。你审视了一下刚买的饮料，轻抿一口。一个字，好。

entries.en: The server nods and politely disappears.
entries.zh: 服务员礼貌地点了点头，离开了。

entries.en:
The clatter of drinkware, the eruptions of boasting and harsh laughter, are interrupted by a commotion.

"$PlayerName!"

A skinny crewman in torn jumpsuit shouts your name and leaps on a table, kicking aside glasses and earning himself curses. His eyes are wide, his face sweaty with stims.
entries.zh:
杯盏碰撞的叮当声、此起彼伏的吹嘘与粗野大笑，被一阵骚动打断了。

"$PlayerName!"

一个穿着破烂连体服的瘦削船员喊着你的名字，纵身跳上一张桌子，踢翻了一片酒杯，招来一片骂声。他双眼圆睁，一张脸被兴奋剂浸得满是汗水。

entries.en:
"Warlord Kanta sends her hate!"

The ugly autopistol in his hand vomits a burst of low-power rounds before it jerks with an off-pitch snap - then, in in the relative quiet following the fusillade, you hear a piece of metal hit a ceiling-vent with a distinct metallic ping.
entries.zh:
"军阀 Kanta 给你们送仇恨来了！"

他手里那把丑陋的自动手枪喷出一串低威力弹丸，接着便伴着一声走了调的脆响卡了壳——随后，在那一轮乱射之后相对的寂静里，你听见一块金属撞上天花板通风口，发出清脆的一声叮。

entries.en:
The would-be assassin stares alarmed at his smoking hack-fab gun, giving it a shake before resqueezing the trigger. A fruitless effort.

Taking a moment to perform damage assessment, you discover that you are entirely unharmed.

A couple pirates behind you were hit by the makeshift autopistol's slugs, but they are enraged rather than wounded - their armored vacsuits served them well.
entries.zh:
那个没得手的刺客惊惶地盯着自己冒烟的土制手枪，晃了晃，又去扣扳机。徒劳无功。

你花了一瞬检视自身伤势，发现自己毫发无伤。

你身后有两名海盗被那把拼装手枪的弹丸击中，但他们只是被激怒，并未受伤——他们那身装甲真空服救了他们。

entries.en:
Patrons of the bar quickly draw weapons of their own to return the promise of violence, much magnified and of far more reliable make.

Crackling gunfire erupts, and the clap and flash of DEW discharge drowns out shouts and screams.

The lighting flickers and strobes, the atmo quickly filling with smoke and the shredded forgecloth which had been affixed to ceilings and walls to damp ambient sound.
entries.zh:
酒吧里的客人纷纷拔出自己的武器，把这份暴力的许诺加倍奉还——火力更猛，做工也可靠得多。

噼啪的枪声骤然炸响，定向能量武器放电的爆响与闪光淹没了喊叫与尖叫。

灯光忽明忽暗地频闪，空气里很快灌满了烟雾，还有被撕碎的吸音布——那本是贴在天花板和墙壁上用来吸音的。

entries.en:
Your bodyguards extract you from the growing chaos, out a side-door.

Assembling outside you see what passes for local MuniSec: a few semi-official armed gangs, stationing themselves threateningly at corridor-intersections to stare down interlopers. They give your party of accompanying bodyguards a respectful glance, and look on - you didn't start the trouble, so you may go.

Display of arms is no crime. The crime is the unauthorized and unprovoked (in the immediate sense) attempt on your life, for this disrespects the local ward-boss who should have been informed of the assassination ahead of time. Hungry airlocks will be fed after this incident if any collaborators (or scape-goats) can be connected to the act.
entries.zh:
你的保镖把你从越来越乱的场面里带出来，从一扇侧门溜了出去。

在外头聚齐后，你看到了这地方所谓的 MuniSec：几支半官方的武装帮派，气势汹汹地守在走廊交叉口，瞪着外来者。他们朝你这队随行保镖投来一个还算尊重的眼神，便继续观望——乱子不是你挑起的，所以你可以走了。

亮出武器不算罪。罪在这桩未经许可、也无端 (就眼下而言) 的取你性命的勾当——它冒犯了本地管区的头目，行刺之前本应先知会他一声。此事过后，只要能攀扯出任何同谋 (或替罪羊)，饥饿的气闸就有东西可喂了。

entries.en: An autonomous warning beacon has been left emitting a distorted wail between official channels. Whatever message it was meant to convey has been corrupted.
entries.zh: 被留在此处的自主警告信标在多个官方使用的频道上发出扭曲的哀嚎声。无论它要传达什么信息，应该都已经损坏了。

entries.en:
This autonomous warning beacon emits a looping message.

"This world is corrupted by technological sin and its abomination stands testament to the result of straying from the path of virtue. Trespass is forbidden. Any who scorn this warning shall become both corrupt of body and outlaw by the holy justice enforced by this order of the Knights of Ludd."
entries.zh:
这个自主警告信标循环发出着一条讯息。

"这颗星球已经被科技原罪所腐化，而它可憎的面貌正是背离了美德之径的明证。严令禁止擅自闯入此地。任何蔑视这一警告的不法之人，必遭腐化，并将受到卢德骑士团的神圣制裁。"

entries.en:
This autonomous warning beacon emits a looping message.

"DANGER: This star system is known to contain potentially active autonomous weapon systems. Access to this system by unauthorized parties is forbidden by Hegemony Navy diktat 224.34."
entries.zh:
这个自主警告信标循环播报着一条讯息。

"警告：已知此星系部署有潜在活跃的自律性攻击系统。根据霸主海军敕令 224 项 34 条之规定，禁止任何未经授权的第三方对象进入。"

entries.en:
It's time to face it, you are not what you once were.

The cycles wear on you. Combat maneuvers jar your creaking bones and your skin is tanned by the radiation of distant stars whose light grows dimmer in your eyes.

But the things you have seen! Death to wonder; the works of dead empires and fresh faces green crew on their first op; tactical lasers glittering in the debris of forgotten battles.

You've lived a life beyond the imagination of the planet-bound. But it is a life hard-lived.
entries.zh:
是时候面对现实了：你已不复当年。

岁月一轮轮地磨着你。战术机动颠得你这把老骨头咯吱作响，远方星辰的辐射把你的皮肤晒得黝黑，而那些星光在你眼中也日渐暗淡。

可你见识过多少东西！从死亡到奇迹；覆灭帝国的遗作，初次出任务、满脸稚气的新船员；战术激光在遗忘战场的残骸间闪烁。

你这一生，是困守行星的人无法想象的。可这也是艰辛的一生。

o.en: No! It does not have to end

entries.en:
Your story could end here, starfarer. You can retire, enjoy yourself, and finall get some rest.

The question is, where and how?
entries.zh:
你的故事可以就此收场，远行者。你大可退下来，享享清福，终于好好歇一歇。

问题是，去哪里，又怎么过？

entries.en:
"It's true," he says with a slight smile. "However distantly. It is a name that comes with a great deal of... undeclared cargo, let us say."

"I am, however, my own man." Bellamy shrugs. "And I expect anyone of good manners will respect this, and not be so thick-headed as to ask if I am part of her organization. Because I am not."

He fixes you with a look, however indulgent, that makes it clear that this line of inquiry may be considered finished.
entries.zh:
"是真的，\" 他微微一笑，\"不过隔得远。这个姓氏嘛，捎带着不少...这么说吧，未申报的货。"

"不过我自成一方。\" Bellamy 耸耸肩，\"懂规矩的人自会尊重这一点，不至于不开窍到追问我是不是她那组织里的人。因为我不是。"

他定定地看了你一眼，纵然带着几分宽容，意思却很明白：这个话题可以到此为止了。

o.en: Are you... related to Warlord Kanta?
o.zh: 你...跟军阀 Kanta 有亲缘关系？

entries.en:
He turns a fearsome look upon you and holds it for a moment.

Then laughs at your insolence.
entries.zh:
他转过头，凶狠地盯了你片刻。

随即被你的放肆逗笑。

entries.en:
Bornanew looks almost surprised at your words. He does not pray, or thank Providence. He simply looks directly at you through the waver of the comm-link.

"Thank you, captain. Against all odds, you've cast a light upon my path toward redemption."

Perhaps apologetic for the moment of earnestness, he quickly adds, "I am prepared to leave when you are ready for me. I shall await word of your shuttle."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 似乎对你的话感到惊讶。他没有祈祷，也没有感谢上天。他只是透过通讯链接的网纹直视着你。

"谢谢你，舰长。在困难重重之时，你为我的救赎之路投下了光芒。"

也许是为这片刻的真诚感到有些不好意思，他很快补充道，"我已经可以出发了，就看你什么时候准备好让我登船。我会等着你安排的穿梭机的消息。"

o.en: Assemble your officers to plan a raid to capture the nanoforge
o.zh: 召集你的军官，制定劫掠计划以夺取纳米锻炉。

entries.en:
Horus transfers to your $shipOrFleet in orbit, greeting you and Bornanew tersely then making little in the way of conversation.

Menes' invitation provides you with a flight path and Demarch-level traffic control override codes. Horus would certainly receive similar treatment had he declared his presence openly.

As it is, it's probably a violation of Persean League ethical guidelines for you to be using these to attend a personal party, but from what you can overhear of the pilot's comms, the locals have a casual attitude toward the arrangement.
entries.zh:
Horus 来到了你停泊在轨道$shipOrFleet中，简短地向你和 Bornanew 打了个招呼，然后就没怎么说话。

Menes 的邀请函为你提供了一条飞行路线，和统领级别的交通管制覆盖代码。如果 Horus 公开来访，他也能享受到类似的待遇。

就目前而言，你用这些代码去参加一个私人派对，很可能违反了 英仙座联盟 的道德准则，但从你无意间听到的驾驶员通讯来看，当地人对这种安排的态度很随意。

entries.en:
Menes Yaribay's compound is a scrubbed-looking slab of trendy architecture set on a bluff overlooking Olinadu's primary habitation cluster.

A smattering of outbuildings and hangars, attached by fat trunks of conduit and glowing walktubes, sprawl across the less-fashionable view-angles of the compound toward the refineries and holding tanks of the planet's industrial center.
entries.zh:
Menes Yaribay 的庄园是一片经过精心打理的时尚建筑群，坐落在一处悬崖上，俯瞰着 Olinadu 的主要居住区。

一些附属建筑和机库零零散散地分布在庄园不太显眼的角落里，粗大的管道和发光步道连接着它们，并且一直延伸向行星工业中心的冶炼厂和储油罐。

entries.en:
"Captain $playerLastName shall attend," Horus adds quietly. "So that we might fully resolve this matter."

"Of course, cousin, of course!" Menes, sweating, puts on a fragile grin in order to distribute reassuring nods to his extended entourage.

Menes leads you and Horus into his inner sanctum, flashing a grimace as he operates a series of obtrusive and, to your eyes, largely ornamental biometric checks.
entries.zh:
"$playerLastName 舰长也得出席。" Horus 轻声补充道。"这样我们才能彻底解决这件事。"

"当然，堂兄，当然！" Menes 汗流浃背，勉强挤出一丝笑容，以便他在向那庞大的随从队伍点头示意的时候，让他们安心下来。

Menes 带着你和 Horus 进入了他的密室，在操作那一系列繁琐、且在你看来很大程度上是装饰性的生物识别检查装置时，他面露苦涩。

entries.en:
The air cools by a degree, perhaps two, the armored mass of the walls felt as a dullness through your feet. The subdued lighting, drapery, and framing of the space suggest the interior of a bank vault or a shrine, though not to the praise of any Luddic virtue.

Quite the contrary, depending on one's outlook.
entries.zh:
空气的温度降低了一两度，厚重装甲墙壁的质量化作一股沉闷的质感从你的脚下传来。幽暗的灯光、帷幔以及整个空间的布局，让人联想到银行金库，或圣地的内部 —— 当然，这圣地并非是为了颂扬卢德主义的美德。

它与那完全相反，不过如何看待这一切，就见仁见智了。

entries.en:
On a pedestal of carved wood, in a spot of light like holy revelation, a single glove is upthrust. Its fingers appear frozen in the midst of beginning to curl back toward a relaxed state after giving you a little wave.

After an appropriate pause, Menes speaks up, hopeful. "What do you think, cousin?"
entries.zh:
在木质雕花基座上，一束如同神启般的光芒中，一只手套赫然挺立。它的手指似乎凝固在刚刚向你挥了挥手后，正要蜷回放松状态的瞬间。

经过适当的停顿后，Menes 满怀希望地开口了，"你觉得如何，堂兄？"

entries.en:
"What's this supposed to be," says Horus, deadpan.

Menes clears his throat, then begins in a low, dramatic voice, "The glove worn by Ludd when stepping upon the sacred Earth of Gilead. Ludd removed the glove and kissed the ground, according to the Luddic's religion."
entries.zh:
"这是什么玩意儿？" Horus 面无表情地说道。

Menes 清了清嗓子，然后用低沉而浮夸的声音开口道，"这是卢德踏上 Gilead 的圣土时戴着的手套。根据 卢德教会 的说法，卢德当时脱下手套并亲吻了大地。"

o.en: And it's almost certainly a fake.
o.zh: 而这几乎可以肯定是假的。

entries.en:
Menes looks shocked.

Horus gives you a look of his own. "Of course it is," he says. "And here I thought only a Luddie would be foolish enough to believe in this sort of thing."

"Cousin!" Menes exclaims, appalled.

"Do not 'cousin' me!" Horus shouts, now, after an icy restraint held for so long.

"Remember how I saved you last time? The promises you made? And here, you've wasted stars-know how many credits on more nonsense, a bomb waiting to explode under the gens!"
entries.zh:
Menes 看上去很震惊。

Horus 别有深意地看了你一眼。"这当然是假的。" 他说。"我还以为只有卢德佬会傻到相信这种东西。"

"堂兄！" Menes 惊骇地喊道。

"别叫我 '堂兄'！" Horus 在顶着冰冷的表情克制了一路后，终于吼了回去。

"还记得我上次救了你的事吗？你做的保证呢？现在，你又为更蠢的事浪费了天知道多少星币，就弄回来了一颗埋在氏族脚底下的定时炸弹！"

o.en: Keep your mouth shut, for now

entries.en:
"What would Reynard Hannan do if he knew what you were up to here, do you think?"

Menes shakes his head, speechless.

"He would loose the Church on us! And their bloody-minded Pathers! Think, think for once, 'cousin'." Horus spits the word poisonously. "Think of anyone in the Sector aside from yourself. Think of your gens!"

"The Chu- Path?" Menes sputters pathetically. "If Captain $playerLastName said it's a fake, it shouldn't be-"

"Oh, so now it's a fake?" Horus cuts him off. "Enough! Here is what will happen."
entries.zh:
"你觉得，如果 Reynard Hannan 知道你在这里搞什么鬼，他会干出什么事来？"

Menes 摇了摇头，哑口无言。

"他会唆使教会来对付我们！还有他们那些丧心病狂的左径分子！你想想，你好好思考一次，'堂弟'。" Horus 恶毒地吐出这个词。"想想星域里除了你自己以外的任何人。想想你的族人！"

"教 —— 左径？" Menes 可怜地结巴道。"如果 $playerLastName 舰长说它是假的，那应该就没 ——"

"哦，你愿意承认它是假货了？" Horus 打断了他。"够了！接下来该这样做。"

entries.en:
"Captain $playerLastName and $playerHisOrHer pet Knight of Ludd shall take possession of the damnable trinket. Immediately. As a sign of good faith to our Luddic 'friends' in the Church of Galactic Redemption."

He gives you a look, "See that they appreciate what I've done for them."

Back to Menes. "From now on I am taking personal control of your accounts. No frivolities without approval from my office."

Menes begins to make a sound of objection but is cut off as Horus raises a single finger. A Reaper torpedo, armed and ready to launch into the unshielded breach.

"You and I," Horus says, "Shall continue our conversation in private." He doesn't turn to you again. "Captain, if you would kindly?"
entries.zh:
"$playerLastName 舰长和$playerHisOrHer的卢德骑士小跟班会马上拿走这个该死的玩意。来表达我们对 银河救赎教会 的卢德 '朋友们' 的诚意。"

他看了你一眼，"务必让他们懂得感激我为他们所做的一切。"

然后他又看向 Menes。"从现在开始，我要亲自控制你的账户。没有我办公室的批准，不得有任何不正经的开支。"

Menes 刚要出言反对，但 Horus 竖起一根手指就打断了他。就像一枚已经填装完毕的死神鱼雷，随时准备着射向护盾的缺口。

"你和我。" Horus 说，"我们得私下谈谈。" 他没有再看向你。"舰长，还请你回避。"

entries.en:
Despite knowing what it is - or, rather, isn't - it feels almost like sacrilege to simply reach over to touch this object of such presumed expense and such evident disgrace. A vessel assigned such power and import, faith and violence, despite its reified deceit.

It is the glowing prize at the center of this temple, this shrine to the ego of Menes Yaribay bought with the lucre of the Kazeronian empire, fueled by faith and blood from over two hundred cycles since someone who took the name Ludd did something, probably, half-remembered then gilded in glorious myth on a planet named Gilead.
entries.zh:
尽管知道它是什么 —— 或者更确切地说，知道它不是什么 —— 但伸手去触碰这件已经蒙羞，只是仍被认为价值连城的物件，却依然像是亵渎神明。它承载着的能量和意义、信仰与暴力就是如此强大，哪怕它早已被物化，沦为了骗局。

它是这座神殿中心熠熠生辉的奖杯，这圣地供奉着 Menes Yaribay 的自负，由 Kazeron 帝国的财富铸就，而浇灌了它两百多星历年的信仰和鲜血，则来自于一个名为卢德的人在名为 Gilead 的星球上的所行之事，其记载大概已残缺不全，却在后来被镀上了辉煌的神话色彩。

entries.en: The quiet of the air circulation looms. Horus clears his throat.
entries.zh: 寂静的弥漫让空气的流通声也清晰可闻，Horus 随即清了清嗓子。

entries.en:
As you touch it, a piercing alarm shatters the stillness of the treasury. Menes' hand slaps his other wrist with surprising speed. He raises it to his mouth to mumble a stand-down order to his security.

The alarm stops, leaving a painful echo in your ears.
entries.zh:
就在你摸到它的一瞬间，刺耳的警报声打破了密室的寂静。Menes 速度惊人，抬手拍向另一侧的手腕。然后他将手腕抬到嘴边，咕哝着向安保人员下令取消警报。

警报停止了，刺耳的余音在你耳中回荡着。

o.en: Tuck the glove into a pocket
Carry it openly back to the party
o.zh: 光明正大地拿着它回到派对上

entries.en:
One set of hangar bay doors dutifully open, and your shuttle descends through the glowing atmo-field. Such gadgetry is an ostentatious addition to a personal residence, but it avoids the bother of visitors (and their shuttles) having to undergo pressure-cycling.

An enthusiastic Menes is already approaching your shuttle's access ramp as it sets itself down and signals the all-clear.

Horus Yaribay puts out his hand in a 'you first' gesture.
entries.zh:
一扇机库门应声打开，你的穿梭机穿过闪耀的气场缓缓降落。这种装置对于私人住宅来说显得过于奢华，但它省去了访客 (和他们的穿梭机) 必须经历气压调节的麻烦。

当你的穿梭机降落并发出一切正常的信号时，热情的 Menes 已经走近了穿梭机的舷梯。

Horus Yaribay 伸出手，示意 "你先请"。

entries.en:
The cousins of Gens Yaribay watch you leave.

Horus' eyes are black. Menes's are red with betrayal.
entries.zh:
Yaribay 氏族的堂兄弟目送着你离开。

Horus 目光阴沉。Menes 则因遭到背叛而眼睛发红。

o.en: Make your way back to the party to find Bornanew and leave
o.zh: 回到派对，找到 Bornanew 然后离开

entries.en:
The cousins of Gens Yaribay watch you leave.

Horus' eyes are cool, unblinking. Menes' are red with betrayal.
entries.zh:
Yaribay 氏族的堂兄弟目送着你离开。

Horus 目光冰冷，眼睛一眨不眨。Menes 则因遭到背叛而眼睛发红。

o.en: Make your way back to the party to find Bornanew

entries.en:
Everyone turns and the conversation goes silent as you return to the main room. Alone.

You spot Bornanew, cornered by the man Ulmus Pond whose voice rings out for two words over-loudly as he realizes the fact of your entrance a moment later than the others.

His eyes are huge and bulging, like a fish.
entries.zh:
你独自一人回到主厅，所有人都转过身来，谈话声戛然而止。

你发现了 Bornanew，他被那个叫 Ulmus Pond 的人堵在角落里。Pond 比其他人晚了一拍意识到你的出现，随即声音格外响亮地喊出了两个词。

他的眼睛又大又凸，就像条鱼。

o.en: Hello $global.jethroName. I think we should go now.
o.zh: 你好啊，$global.jethroName。我觉得我们该走了。

entries.en:
Everyone turns to stare at you as the conversation goes silent the instant you return to the main room. Alone.

You spot Bornanew, cornered by the man Ulmus Pond whose voice rings out for two words over-loudly because he realized the fact of your entrance a moment later than everyone else. His eyes are huge and bulging, like a fish.

They seem to widen even more as Pond sees that you are simply holding Menes' prize relic. Bornanew, even, struggles to maintain his composure as he realizes what you have in your hands.
entries.zh:
你独自一人回到主厅，所有人都转头盯着你看，谈话声则戛然而止。

你发现了 Bornanew，他被那个叫 Ulmus Pond 的人堵在角落里。Pond 比其他人晚了一拍意识到你的出现，于是声音格外响亮地喊出了两个词。他的眼睛又大又凸，就像条鱼。

当 Pond 看到你就这么把 Menes 的宝贝圣物拿在手里时，他的眼睛好像睁得更大了。就连 Bornanew，也在意识到你手里拿着什么东西之后有些不淡定了。

o.en: Hello $global.jethroName. I think we should go now.
o.zh: 你好啊，$global.jethroName。我觉得我们该走了。

entries.en:
Pond gapes, enhancing the piscine effect.

Bornanew places an untouched drink of something fizzy and golden into Pond's hand, then walks with you back toward the shuttle bay.

"I presume you have... it?" he asks quietly, eyes forward.
entries.zh:
Pond 瞠目结舌，显得更像条鱼了。

Bornanew 把一杯原封未动的金黄色气泡饮料塞进 Pond 手里，然后和你一起返回穿梭机泊位。

"你应该拿到了...那东西？" 他目视前方，轻声问道。

o.en: Yup. Have a look for yourself. (give him the glove)
o.zh: 是啊，你自己看看吧。 (把手套给他)

o.en: I do. Did you see their faces, $global.jethroName?
o.zh: 我拿到了，你看到他们的表情没，$global.jethroName？

entries.en:
Pond gapes at you, furthering the piscine effect.

Bornanew places an untouched drink of something fizzy and golden into Pond's hand, then walks with you back to the shuttle bay.

"I think, perhaps," he says quietly, eyes forward, "that you should have put the glove somewhere out of sight."
entries.zh:
Pond 瞠目结舌，显得更像条鱼了。

Bornanew 把一杯原封未动的金黄色气泡饮料塞进 Pond 手里，然后和你一起返回穿梭机泊位。

"我觉得，大概，" 他目视前方，轻声说道，"你该把那只手套藏起来的。"

o.en: Maybe. But did you see their faces, $global.jethroName?
o.zh: 或许吧，但你看到他们的表情没，$global.jethroName？

entries.en: He accepts the glove, a little surprised, quickly placing it within some hidden pocket of his robes.
entries.zh: 他带着一丝惊讶接过了手套，然后迅速把它放进了长袍的某个隐秘口袋里。

entries.en: He simply nods, placing his hands together. He doesn't do anything more, but you swear he's praying.
entries.zh: 他只是点点头，双手合十。他没做别的动作，但你敢肯定他是在祈祷。

entries.en: "I did," he says ruefully.
entries.zh: "我看到了。" 他怅然地说道。

entries.en:
He accepts the glove, taking only a split second to suppress his look of shock. Bornanew quickly disappears the glove to some hidden pocket of his robes.

"I think, perhaps," he says in a whisper, "that should have remained hidden."
entries.zh:
他接过手套，只一瞬间就掩饰住了震惊的表情。Bornanew 迅速把它放进了长袍的某个隐秘口袋里。

"我觉得，大概，" 他低声说，"你该一直藏着它的。"

o.en: Don't worry. Menes is going to be on his best good behavior from here on out.
o.zh: 别担心，Menes 从今往后肯定会老实做人的。

entries.en: Bornanew spares you a single rueful look.
entries.zh: Bornanew 向你投来了一个怅然的眼神。

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName - with your Knight of Ludd! Let me welcome you both to my humble..."

As Menes sees Horus step off the shuttle his face contorts through a fascinating sequence of expressions before settling into an alarmed rictus of welcome.

"C-cousin Horus. What an unexpected surprise!"

Menes' eyes, watery with a minor aspect of terror, dart to yours then away before the accusation fully solidifies.
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长 —— 还有你的卢德骑士！欢迎你们光临寒..."

接着 Menes 就看到了走下穿梭机的 Horus，他的脸先是闪过一系列耐人寻味的表情，最后定格成了惊恐的僵笑来迎接他。

"H-Horus 堂兄。真是意外之喜！"

Menes 的眼睛因轻微的恐惧而湿润，他飞快地瞥向你，又在眼中那份指责成型前，匆忙移开了视线。

entries.en:
Horus' smile in return is cool as he steps forward to the offered hands with only one of his own. "Menes. Where has the last cycle gone? It feels as though your inaugural flight to Olinadu was just yesterday."

Menes manages to respond with an obliging laugh.

Bornanew, quite forgotten, follows you and the Yaribays.
entries.zh:
Horus 回以冷淡的微笑，他走上前，只用一只手去回应对方伸出的双手。"Menes。这年过得可真快啊，感觉你第一次动身来到 Olinadu 还是昨天。"

Menes 勉强挤出讨好的笑声作为回应。

完全被遗忘掉的 Bornanew，则跟在你和 Yaribay 氏族的两人后面。

entries.en:
Menes leads your party past gilded statues guarding the portal to the main complex; the forms are evocative of splashes of molten gold frozen by happenstance into sensual humanoid figures.

You watch as Horus, lean and intense as some small predator, endures the patter from Menes, a man of more generous form and character. Menes plays down the 'frontier quality' of renovations, the poor selection of artworks, the difficulty of accessing the best artists and engineering firms to contribute to his home in 'all but exile'.

Occasionally a robotic or human servitor appears to offer drinks or nibbles, and you've a growing feeling that Menes has picked up a glass from one only to place it back on the tray of another without ever taking a sip.

A fresh glass in hand, Menes tentatively leads Horus into what can only be his prize entertaining space.
entries.zh:
Menes 领着你们一行人走过了几尊守在主建筑入口前的鎏金雕像。雕像的造型宛如飞溅的熔金在机缘巧合之间凝成了千姿百态的性感人形。

你看着精干而凌厉的 Horus 就像一只小型猛兽一般，忍受着心宽体胖的 Menes 一直喋喋不休。Menes 轻描淡写地嫌弃着自家 "边陲质感" 的装潢和品味匮乏的艺术品，以及在他这 "形同流放" 的家里，想请到顶尖艺术家和工程公司相助是多么困难。

偶尔会有机器人或人类侍者出现，呈上饮品或小吃。但你越看越觉得 Menes 纯粹只是从托盘上拿起一杯酒，而后又放到另一个托盘上，自始至终一口都没喝过。

手中又换了一杯新酒后，Menes 试着将 Horus 领进他最引以为傲的主招待厅。

entries.en:
The space is at once cavernous and intimate; the sightlines and carved, wrought, or woven details calculated to replicate a feeling of cozy warmth like the den of some thoughtful patron of art, history, and literature.

A double handful of well-dressed remoras mill about, interrupting their conversations to turn as Menes enters. They look to be a collection of industrialists, financiers, distant gens-relatives, and at least one officer from atop the local military detachment who appears a little worse for his drink.
entries.zh:
这处空间既深邃又私密；无论是整体景致，还是雕刻、金工与织物的细节，无不历经考究，刻意营造出一种私密书房般的温馨舒适氛围，仿佛这的主人是某位在艺术、历史与文学上都造诣颇深的雅士。

十来个衣着光鲜的附庸四处走动，当 Menes 现身时，这些人纷纷停下交谈，转身相迎。他们看起来像是实业家、金融家、远房宗亲，以及至少一名来自当地驻军高层的军官，不过那位似乎已经有点醉意了。

entries.en:
Most start to give a politic nod and wave of acknowledgement at Menes' entrance, but stop and stare as they recognize Horus at his side. Few eyes linger on you and Bornanew, who steps apart as though he were a mere assistant or servitor.

One skinny man in a finely embroidered suit is not put off by Horus' entrance, and rushes to greet your party, eyes agog mostly at the gens patriarch, but sparing a glance at least for the newest additions to Menes' collection.
entries.zh:
Menes 进来时，大多数人开始礼貌地点头挥手致意，但当他们认出他身旁的 Horus 时，就都停下了动作，转而直勾勾地看着他们。很少有目光停留在你和 Bornanew 身上，而后者只要往旁边一站，就仿佛只是个助理或侍者。

一个穿着精致刺绣西装的瘦高男人并没有被 Horus 的到来吓着，他冲过来迎接你们一行人，两眼放光，主要盯着氏族的族长，不过也瞥了一眼 Menes 的新藏品。

entries.en:
He nearly trips over himself to speak. "The great Horus Yaribay! Your reputation precedes you, if half of what-"

Horus holds up a hand, silencing the man, and turns aside. "Menes, what is this?"

"Ha- ha, ah, this is Ulmus Pond," Menes replies quickly, his drinkless off-hand waving to shoo Pond away. "Ulmus, not now. Perhaps see that Captain $playerLastName's Luddic friend here has a fresh drink? Thank-you."

"Now, cousin Horus, I must offer a thousand apologies." Menes himself turns, also cutting Pond out of the conversation. "Had you signalled ahead we could have arranged for a proper reception..."
entries.zh:
他急着要说话，都差点把自己绊倒了。"伟大的 Horus Yaribay！您的大名如雷贯耳，如果传闻有一半 ——"

Horus 抬手让那人安静下来，然后转向身侧。"Menes，这是怎么回事？"

"哈 —— 哈，啊，这是 Ulmus Pond。" Menes 赶紧回答，他挥了挥没拿酒杯的另一只手，想把 Pond 赶走。"Ulmus，现在不是时候。你可以先看看 $playerLastName 舰长的这位卢德朋友需不需要来杯喝的？谢谢你了。"

"好了，Horus 堂兄，我万分抱歉。" Menes 自己也转过身，同样把 Pond 排除在了对话之外。"如果你提前说一声，我们就能安排一场正式的招待会..."

entries.en:
"Never mind that," Horus says, looking around with a displeased curl to his lip. His gaze slips over Pond like he's nothing.

Ulmus Pond, for his part, hides the evil look that crossed his face in that moment to slink after Bornanew.
entries.zh:
"别纠结那些了。" Horus 不满地撇撇嘴，环顾四周。他的目光从 Pond 身上扫过，仿佛他什么都不是。

Ulmus Pond 则强压下了那一瞬间掠过他脸上的邪恶神情，随后悄悄跟在 Bornanew 后面溜走了。

entries.en:
Horus snaps his fingers, summoning a tray, and selects something effervescent. He takes a slow sip, not allowing his expression to display any sort of pleasure in the act. It seems to him more like a necessary palate-cleanser.

"Show it to me," he says to Menes. An order.
entries.zh:
Horus 打了个响指，有人应声端上一个托盘，让他挑了一杯有气泡的饮品。他缓缓地抿了一口，并且没让任何愉悦的表情出现在脸上。对他来说，这更像是种必要的漱口水。

"让我看看那东西。" 他对 Menes 说，语气如下令一般。

o.en: Shuttle down with Horus Yaribay to Menes' compound.
o.zh: 与 Horus Yaribay 一起搭乘穿梭机前往 Menes 的庄园。

entries.en: Pond grins wider, and begins to speak. "The feeling, I'm sure-"
entries.zh: Pond 笑得更灿烂了，开口道。"我也同感 ——"

entries.en: Pond laughs too loudly. "Dear Menes, where did you find such a fantastic character? Without you, I'm certain we'd all die of boredom out here."
entries.zh: Pond 笑得非常大声。"尊敬的 Menes，你从哪找来了这么有趣的人？没有你，我们肯定都会无聊死的。"

entries.en: Pond laughs a little too loudly. "Of course we've just met, but dear Menes spoke of a Knight from some unseemly background, and it's a tale which can't but seize the imagination, am I wrong?"
entries.zh: Pond 笑得有点太大声了。"我们当然是刚认识，但尊敬的 Menes 提到过一位出身不太体面的骑士，这个故事不由得让人浮想联翩，我说错了吗？"

entries.en: Pond's grin widens. "My thoughts are the same, and you know what they say about great-"
entries.zh: Pond 的笑容更灿烂了。"我的想法和你一样，你知道，人们常说英雄所见 ——"

entries.en: Pond's grin hardens ever so slightly. "I'm sure I'd be delighted to speak more later about-"
entries.zh: Pond 的笑容变得有些僵硬。"我很乐意稍后再多谈谈关于 ——"

entries.en: Pond laughs too loudly. "How odd! Dear Menes, where did you find such a fantastic character? I, for one, cannot wait to discover what this evening has in store."
entries.zh: Pond 笑得太大声了。"真奇怪！尊敬的 Menes，你从哪找来了这么有趣的人？就我个人而言，我迫不及待地想知道今晚要有什么好戏看了。"

entries.en:
"It's probably- I'm certain- I, I," Menes stutters, "The power will come back soon. Those rad-addled Olinadu contractors," he attempts a nervous laugh.

You feel the dull thuds, nearly subsonic, through the armored mass of the vault. Breaching charges for the first layer of defense. You know the big one will come soon, and where.

Menes is in a growing panic.
entries.zh:
"可能是 —— 我敢肯定 —— 我，我，" Menes 结巴道，"电力很快就会恢复的。都怪那些脑子被辐射照坏的 Olinadu 承包商。" 他试图挤出个紧张的笑容。

你感觉到，近乎次声波般低沉的撞击声透过保险库厚重的装甲传来。这是突破第一道保护层的爆破炸药。你知道更大的冲击就要来了，也知道会从哪里来。

Menes 越来越惊慌失措。

o.en: Perhaps, Menes, we should take cover...
o.zh: Menes，也许我们应该找个地方躲起来...

entries.en:
When the marines finally breach the vault proper, it is with overwhelming force of sound and light. No unprotected human can withstand this assault on the senses; you are blinded, shocked, and rendered immobile. All you can do is cling to the kernel of self at the center of a storm of pain.

* * *

The return is slow, an awakening from a terrible and drugged sleep to emergency medical personnel and Menes' somewhat tardy security teams in their gleaming armor.

You and Bornanew leave the compound among the other victims. Bandaged, bruised, head aching, ears ringing.
entries.zh:
当陆战队员最终攻破保险库本体时，随之而来的是排山倒海般的强光与巨响。没有未穿戴防护的人类能承受这种感官冲击；你瞬间被致盲，意识被震慑，动弹不得。在这场席卷一切的痛苦风暴中，你唯一能做的，就是死守住那一点残存的意识。

* * *

意识的回归很缓慢，仿佛从一场可怕的药物昏睡中醒来。你看到了急救人员和 Menes 那些姗姗来迟、身穿闪亮盔甲的安保团队。

你和 Bornanew 混在其他受害者中离开了庄园。他们身上缠满绷带，遍体鳞伤，头痛欲裂，耳鸣不止。

entries.en:
Hours later, after a series of transfers to obscure your movements from the heightened official surveillance, you step back onto your own shuttle - and the attentions of your personal medical team.

A chime on your TriPad confirms that the operation was a success. A holo of the simple work-glove that human beings fought and died over rotates mockingly.

"Evidence," Bornanew says, tired but alert. His eyes are alarmingly bloodshot. "The seed of schism and war. Now whence did this come?"
entries.zh:
几个小时后，你通过一系列转乘摆脱官方加强的监视，回到了自己的穿梭机上 —— 也回到了你私人医疗团队的照料下。

你的 TriPad 上响起一声提示音，确认行动成功。那个人类曾为之战斗、牺牲的，普通工作手套的全息影像嘲弄般地旋转着。

"证据，" Bornanew说道，他虽然疲惫但很警觉。他的眼睛布满了血丝，看起来很吓人。"分裂与战争的种子。这东西是从哪来的？"

o.en: I don't suppose we could ask Menes.
o.zh: 我们大概没法去问 Menes。

o.en: What did you make of that Ulmus Pond?
o.zh: 你对那个 Ulmus Pond 有什么看法？

entries.en:
"No," he manages a smile for just a moment. "I would suppose not."

He looks back down at the holo.
entries.zh:
"是啊，" 他勉强挤出一丝微笑。"我也这么想。"

他低头看向全息影像。

entries.en:
"A Pather agent," he says conclusively.

"We spoke briefly," he says. "In the aftermath. He insisted the medical team check him. Wasn't hurt."

Bornanew takes a deep breath, wincing. "But he slipped up. Heretical theology. Devil in the details. You can tell where one learned the Word, or, rather, a corruption of the Word, from the details."

"He may be connected, but first we should ask the glove." He looks back down at the holo.
entries.zh:
"一个左径特工。" 他断言道。

"事后我们简单聊了几句，" 他说。"他坚持要医疗队检查他。他根本没受伤。"

Bornanew 深吸一口气，厌恶般开口道。"但他露馅了。异端神学。魔鬼就藏在细节中。你可以从细节中分辨出一个人是在哪里学来的 圣言，或者说，学来的腐化版 圣言。"

"他可能和这事有关，但我们得先查查这只手套。" 他又低头看向全息影像。

entries.en:
"A nanoforge engineer could tell us much of this object," he says. "Who made it. When, and where. By the truths found in the false glove, we may judge answers we receive from those we... ask." His last word is muted by the shuttle's maneuverings.

"The Church's nanoforge is on Asher. Canaan system. The techs there will submit to the authority I bear. Our inquiry will be secret."

He pauses, and looks away. "So far as anything is, in the Church."
entries.zh:
"纳米锻炉工程师可以告诉我们这东西的信息，" 他说。"像谁造的。什么时候造的，在哪造的。看看这只假手套里藏着什么真相，我们也许就能判断出我们从那些...被问过的人那里得到的答案信不信得过了。" 他说 "问过" 时，声音被穿梭机的颠簸声盖了过去。

"教会的纳米锻炉在 Canaan 星系的 Asher 上。那里的技术人员会服从我所代表的授权。我们的调查会被保密。"

他顿了一下，移开了视线。"至少，在教会所能做到的范围内保密。"

o.en: We should confirm our hard evidence before Menes puts the pieces together here.
o.zh: 我们得在 Menes 搞清楚发生了什么之前，把事情实锤了。

entries.en:
Bornanew nods agreement.

The shuttle approaches your flagship and prepares to dock.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 点头同意。

穿梭机靠近了你的旗舰，准备停泊。

entries.en:
Your comms officer intercepts you on the way to the medbay looking determined but apologetic.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. The local security authority has issued a blanket order for all fleets to stay in orbit pending an investigation into an, ah, attack against the demarchon of Olinadu."
entries.zh:
在去医务室的路上，你的通讯军官拦住了你，表情坚定但带着歉意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。本地安全部门发布了全面指令，要求所有舰队留在轨道上，等待对 Olinadu 统领遭遇的，呃，袭击事件的调查。"

o.en: We're not registered with traffic control, correct?
o.zh: 我们没有在交通管制那边登记过，对吧？

entries.en: "Affirmative, $playerSirOrMadam," they reply. "However we can assume that the present higher state of alert will detect the $shipOrFleet's de-orbit burn."
entries.zh: "是的，$playerSirOrMadam，" 对方回答。"但是可想而知，在这样的高度戒备状态下，$shipOrFleet 进行离轨机动很容易被侦测到。"

o.en: Then we'd better go fast when we go.

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam." They salute and step back so the med tech can finish waving a scanner - the high-pitched hum just inside your hearing - in search of broken bones. $global.jethroName undergoes a similar procedure in the next bay.

Before the hour you are discharged with a smart stimpack strapped to your side, under your uniform jacket, to control the pain and keep you alert.

You're not out yet. You can easily see that the local authorities don't discover Menes' trinket if your $shipOrFleet is searched, but that search would waste valuable time and disrupt operations.
entries.zh:
"是，$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 他们敬了个礼，退后一步，好让医疗技师继续挥舞扫描仪检查是否有骨折 —— 那高频的嗡嗡声刚好在你的听力范围内。$global.jethroName 正在隔壁的隔间接受类似的检查。

在你出院前，他们给你在制服夹克内侧绑上了一个智能兴奋剂包，用来控制疼痛并保持清醒。

事情还没结束。你很清楚，就算你的$shipOrFleet被搜查，当局也找不到 Menes 的小玩意，但搜查会浪费宝贵的时间并干扰接下来的行动。

entries.en:
You enter the great nave of the Cathedral of Holy Exodus.

Among towering columns are affixed recovered landing pods of the early Luddic refugee ships, now integrated into the vaults, painted with gilt and green, bedecked with candles and hanging glass ornaments which break the beams of the sun - filtered through ranks of high windows - into thousands of rainbow shards, endlessly refracting.

It is an ecstasy of light, a galaxy unto itself.

Bornanew pauses beside you, looking upward. Could one old work-glove and a lie tip all of this down to shatter upon the ground?
entries.zh:
你走进 Exodus 神圣大教堂的宏伟中殿。

高耸的立柱之间，固定着早年卢德派难民船中回收的登陆舱 —— 如今这些登陆舱已被整合进拱顶建筑结构中，周身涂有鎏金与绿色的彩绘，还装饰着蜡烛与悬挂的玻璃饰品。阳光穿过一排排高耸的窗户洒落，经这些饰品折射后，化作无数道彩虹碎片，光影交错，不断折射。

这是一场光影的狂欢，自成一片星河。

Bornanew 在你身旁驻足，抬头仰望。一只破旧的工作手套，一句谎言，真能让眼前这一切轰然倒塌，碎落满地吗？

entries.en:
Bornanew steps forward, prompting the Knight-Captain to raise the carbine he had held at his side. A hint of victory settles into Keepfaith's eyes.

"You dare assault a curate in this holy place?" she says, projecting her voice to all corners of the room, ringing harshly. "Is there no low to which this too-old novice won't sink?"
entries.zh:
Bornanew 迈步向前，骑士长举起了一直握在身侧的卡宾枪。Keepfaith 的眼中闪过一丝胜券在握的光彩。

"你竟敢在这圣地袭击一名神职人员？" 她高声叫喊，声音传遍房间的每个角落，带着刺耳的回响，"这个一把年纪的新丁，还有什么卑劣事做不出来？"

entries.en:
He steps forward again, pushing the barrel of the Knight-Captain's carbine into his chest. The Knight-Captain looks desperately uncomfortable. "Brother," he says again, pleading.

"Do your duty, Knight-Captain!" shouts Keepfaith.

Bornanew takes another step, bodily pushing back the Knight-Captain, still cradling the carbine. Finger on the trigger.
entries.zh:
他再次向前迈步，将骑士长那把卡宾枪的枪管顶在自己胸口。骑士长脸上露出极度不安的神情。"修士弟兄，" 他再次开口，语气中满是恳求。

"履行你的职责，骑士长！" Keepfaith 高声喊道。

Bornanew 又向前走了一步，身体压迫着骑士长后退，而卡宾枪的枪管仍抵在他胸口。他的手指扣在了扳机上。

entries.en:
He steps forward again, pushing the barrel of the Knight-Captain's carbine into his chest. The Knight-Captain looks desperately uncomfortable. "Brother," he says again, pleading.

"Do your duty, Knight-Captain!" shouts Keepfaith.

Bornanew takes another step, bodily pushing back the Knight-Captain, still cradling the carbine. Finger on the trigger.

"履行你的职责，骑士长！" Keepfaith 高声喊道。

Bornanew 又向前走了一步，身体压迫着骑士长后退，而卡宾枪的枪管仍抵在他胸口。他的手指扣在了扳机上。

Among towering columns are affixed recovered landing pods of the early Luddic refugee ships, now integrated into the vaults, painted with gilt and green, bedecked with candles and hanging glass ornament which break the beams of the sun - filtered through ranks of high windows - into thousands of rainbow shards endlessly refracting.

It is an ecstasy of light, a galaxy unto itself.

Bornanew pauses beside you, catching his breath, looking upward. Could one old work-glove and a lie tip all of this down to shatter upon the ground?
