entries.en:
* * *

You step off the rickety bus, a boxy thing of agriplastic and mold-pressed wood scrap hiding a battery and motor, with a crowd of day-laborers and pilgrims.

This is not one of the major shrines of the Pilgrim's Path, of course, but the Cathedral of Holy Exodus is held in high esteem in the local system and beyond.
entries.zh:
* * *

你从吱呀作响的巴士上踏下，这辆方方正正的交通工具由农用塑料和模压木屑制成，内部藏着电池与发动机，在你身旁则是一群零工与朝圣者。

这里虽然并非是朝圣之路上的主要圣地，但 Exodus 神圣大教堂在本星系乃至更远的星区都备受尊崇。

entries.en:
* * *

You step off the rickety bus, a boxy thing of agriplastic and mold-pressed wood scrap hiding a battery and motor, with a crowd of sweating day-laborers and pilgrims. Bornanew, still shaky on his feet as he recovers from his injuries, takes your arm as he steps down to the road.

This is not one of the major shrines of the Pilgrim's Path, of course, but the Cathedral of Holy Exodus is held in high esteem in the local system and beyond.
entries.zh:
* * *

你从吱呀作响的巴士上踏下，这辆方方正正的交通工具由农用塑料和模压木屑制成，内部藏着电池与发动机，在你身旁则是一群零工与朝圣者，而伤势未愈、步履不稳的 Bornanew 则在下车时扶住了你的手臂。

这里虽然并非是朝圣之路上的主要圣地，但 Exodus 神圣大教堂在本星系乃至更远的星区都备受尊崇。

entries.en:
"And it is the seat of not more than a few 'divergent' notions of doctrine," Bornanew tells you in a low voice.

"At least according to the 'Ineffablist' school backed by the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis, among others. Here, though a minority of the Church ecumene, there is a local majority of so-called 'Mundanians'. Do not misunderstand me; they are not schismatics." He lets a moment of silence pass.

"Nonetheless."
entries.zh:
"恐怕这里也滋生了不少 '分歧' 的学派。" Bornanew 压低声音对你说。

"至少在那些支持宗师大人的 '不可言传派' 信徒看来是这样。不过，在当地 —— 尽管在整个教区中占少数 —— 所谓的 '世俗派' 却占了多数。别误会我的意思，他们并非是分裂教派。" 他停顿了片刻，陷入沉默。

"但话虽如此。"

entries.en:
"The Mundanians," he continues, "hold that Ludd's individual humanity provides a... spiritual focus. A manner of relation, a holy sympathy. Physical objects said to be associated with Ludd may play a role, hence the practice of veneration through - not of - relics. At least that is how they would describe it."

"The ban on venerating the worldly individual of Ludd is clear, but what of proximal objects? The Word is not so definitive."
entries.zh:
"世俗派，" 他继续说道，"认为卢德个体的人性提供了一种... 灵性焦点。也就是一种关联方式，一种神圣共鸣。据说与卢德相关的实体物品可能扮演着某种角色，因而产生了通过遗物 —— 而非崇拜遗物本身 —— 进行敬奉的习俗。至少他们是如此描述的。"

"对作为世俗个体的卢德进行崇拜是被明确禁止的，但那些具有关联性的物品呢？圣言对此并未给出定论。"

entries.en:
"Mundanians," he continues, "hold that Ludd's individual humanity provides a... spiritual focus. A manner of relation, a holy sympathy. Physical objects said to be associated with Ludd may play a role, hence the practice of veneration through - not of - relics. At least that is how they would describe such heresy. It is the apologia of Idolators."

"The ban on venerating the worldly individual of Ludd is clear, but the Word is less direct on the matter of proximal objects."
entries.zh:
"世俗派，" 他继续说道，"认为卢德个体的人性提供了一种... 灵性焦点。也就是一种关联方式，一种神圣共鸣。据说与卢德相关的实体物品可能扮演着某种角色，因而产生了通过遗物 —— 而非崇拜遗物本身 —— 进行敬奉的习俗。至少他们是如此描述这类异端的，但这实则是偶像崇拜者的辩解。"

"对作为世俗个体的卢德进行崇拜存在明确的禁止，但圣言对关联物品的问题则不甚直接。"

entries.en:
"And, ah," Bornanew's brow furrows. "Mind your use of such nomenclature. It would be inconvenient to cause offense at some inopportune moment."

"Besides, name-calling is unseemly for a Knight who ought hold himself to higher standards. I am sworn to face conflict directly by the truth of the path illuminated by faith."
entries.zh:
"还有，呃，" Bornanew 眉头微皱，"请注意你对此类称谓的使用，若在不当的时机冒犯了他人，那可就麻烦了。"

"况且，对于一位理应恪守更高标准的骑士而言，辱骂行为有失体统。我曾立誓要凭着信仰照亮的真理之路而直面冲突。"

entries.en: "Best not to cast such words about thoughtlessly."
entries.zh: "最好不要轻率地说出这类言辞。"

o.en: So you're just going to walk in, unarmed, and make an arrest?
o.zh: 所以你打算就这么赤手空拳走进去，然后实施逮捕？

o.en: You mention this now? We should have prepared.
o.zh: 你怎么现在才提这事？我们本该早作准备的。

o.en: Opposition? Shall I call in a squad of marines?
o.zh: 抵制？需要我调一支陆战队过来吗？

o.en: Not to worry. I'm prepared. (pat your weapon)
o.zh: 别担心，我已经准备好了。 (轻拍你的武器)

o.en: With your injury... you're sure you want to do this?
o.zh: 以你现在的伤势...你确定要这么做？

o.en: So you're just going to walk in, unarmed, to arrest a curate?
o.zh: 所以你打算就这么赤手空拳走进去，要逮捕一名祭司？

o.en: Opposition? Shall I call in a squad of marines?
o.zh: 抵制？需要我调一支陆战队过来吗？

o.en: Not to worry. I'm prepared. (pat your weapon)
o.zh: 别担心，我已经准备好了。 (轻拍你的武器)

entries.en:
He replies calmly, eyes on the path ahead.

"There was... passive opposition to my investigation. I intend to arrest Subcurate Cedra Keepfaith. Opposition may become... less passive."
entries.zh:
他冷静地回复道，眼睛看向道路前方。

"我的调查遭遇了一些...消极的抵制。我打算逮捕助理祭司 Cedra Keepfaith。这样抵制或许会变得...不那么消极了。"

entries.en:
He takes one more deep breath, then replies calmly, eyes on the path ahead.

"There was... passive opposition to my investigation. I intend to arrest Subcurate Cedra Keepfaith. Opposition may become... less passive."
entries.zh:
他又深吸了一口气，然后冷静地回复道，眼睛看向道路前方。

"我的调查遭遇了一些...消极的抵制。我打算逮捕助理祭司 Cedra Keepfaith。这样抵制或许会变得...不那么消极了。"

entries.en:
Menes is uncharacteristically quiet for a long moment.

"I see," he says, looking away. "Tell me if you find him. I have... questions."

His face is blank, his eyes watery. The silence stretches long.
entries.zh:
Menes 反常地沉默了很长一段时间。

"我明白了，" 他移开了目光。"如果你能找到他，请和我说一声。我有...问题要问。"

他面无表情，眼眶湿润。沉默不断弥漫着。

o.en: Of course. I'll, um, let you go now. (Cut the link)
o.zh: 当然。我，呃，先不打扰你了。 (切断通讯)

entries.en:
Menes is uncharacteristically quiet for a long moment.

"I see," he says, looking away. "Tell me if you find him. I have... questions."

His face is blank, his eyes watery. The silence stretches long.
entries.zh:
Menes 反常地沉默了很长一段时间。

"我明白了，" 他移开了目光。"如果你能找到他，请和我说一声。我有...问题要问。"

他面无表情，眼眶湿润。沉默不断弥漫着。

o.en: I'll do that. And I'll, um, let you go now. (Cut the link)
o.zh: 我会的。那我，呃，先不打扰你了。 (切断通讯)

entries.en:
Menes says nothing for a long moment. It is unsettlingly uncharacteristic of him.

Finally, he sighs, and looks away. "And he did. I suppose you've confirmed his story."
entries.zh:
Menes 沉默了许久，这对他来说太反常了，令人不安。

最后，他叹了口气，移开了目光。"这样啊。那我猜你已经证实了他的说辞。"

entries.en:
You explain the crimes of Ulmus Pond, and his fate.

Menes is uncharacteristically quiet when you finish.

"I see," he says, looking away. His face is blank, his eyes watery.

The silence stretches long.
entries.zh:
你解释了 Ulmus Pond 的罪行，以及他的下场。

你说完后，Menes 反常地保持着安静。

"我明白了，" 他移开视线。面无表情，眼眶湿润。

沉默不断弥漫着。

o.en: I'll... let you go now. (Cut the comm link)
o.zh: 我...先不打扰你了。 (切断通讯链接)

entries.en:
A tap confirms that Bornanew is receiving a split of the comms feed.

"Indeed!" Menes says, perking up. "In truth, I consider myself something of an antiquarian. It provides me with a... a connection to the great individuals who have come before and changed the worlds for," he pauses for drama, "...good or ill."

"If I may, if I may," he says, growing more excited by the moment, "I did peek at your dossier before accepting the comm link. I'm given to understand you're something of an adventurer? Perhaps you've stumbled on historical objects of interest in your travels?"
entries.zh:
你轻触平板，确认 Bornanew 正在接收分流的通讯信号。

"的确如此！" Menes 说着，精神一振。"实际上，我自认为是个古董爱好者。它为我提供了一种...一种与那些改变了世界的前人们的联系，" 他为了营造戏剧效果而故意顿了一下，"...无论是好是坏。"

"如果可以，如果可以的话，" 他越说越兴奋，"在接受通讯链接前我稍微看了一下你的档案。我听说你是个冒险家？或许你在旅途中偶遇过什么有历史价值的物品？"

o.en: What I've experienced in the depths of the starry sea would drive lesser minds to madness.
o.zh: 我在星海深处的经历足以让心智脆弱者陷入疯狂。

o.en: I took my ship to reach the stars.... but I've gone much, much farther than that.
o.zh: 我驾船驶向群星...但我所抵达的远方远不止于此。

o.en: I've seen things you wouldn't believe. Attack ships on fire off the Orion-Perseus abyss...
o.zh: 我见过你们难以相信的景象。攻击舰在 猎户-英仙座深渊 外燃烧...

entries.en:
A tap confirms that Bornanew is receiving a split of the comms feed.

"Indeed!" Menes says, perking up. "I consider myself something of an antiquarian. It provides a... a connection to the great individuals who have come before and changed the worlds for," he pauses for drama, "...good or ill."

"If I may, if I may," he says, more excited by the moment, "I did peek at your dossier before accepting the comm link. You've made some people very angry, haven't you. How... disreputable."

You're not sure you've seen someone's eyes twinkle before, but you swear that his just did.
entries.zh:
你轻触平板，确认 Bornanew 正在接收分流的通讯信号。

"的确如此！" Menes 说着，精神一振。"我自认为是个古董爱好者。它提供了一种...一种与那些改变了世界的前人们的联系，" 为了营造戏剧效果而故意顿了一下，"...无论是好是坏。"

"如果可以，如果可以的话，" 他越说越兴奋，"在接受通讯链接前，我偷看了你的档案。你惹恼了一些人，对吧。真是...声名狼藉。"

你不确定自己以前有没有见过别人眼中光芒闪烁，但你发誓他刚刚就是这样。

entries.en:
"I'm given to understand you're something of an adventurer," he continues. "A rogue element, if you will. You play by your own rules. I like to think I'm of like mind," he says with a wink.

"Perhaps you've stumbled on historical objects of interest in your... adventures?"
entries.zh:
"我听说你是个冒险家，" 他继续说。"一个特立独行的人，如果你接受这个评价的话。你按自己的规矩行事。我觉得我也是同道中人，" 他眨了眨眼。

"或许你在你的...冒险中偶遇过什么有历史价值的物品？"

o.en: What I've experienced in the depths of the starry sea would drive lesser minds to madness.
o.zh: 我在星海深处的经历足以让心智脆弱者陷入疯狂。

o.en: I took my ship to reach the stars.... but I've gone much, much farther than that.
o.zh: 我驾船驶向群星...但我所抵达的远方远不止于此。

o.en: I've seen things you wouldn't believe. Attack ships on fire off the Orion-Perseus abyss...
o.zh: 我见过你们难以相信的景象。攻击舰在 猎户-英仙座深渊 外燃烧...

entries.en:
"Splendid!" Menes gushes, "Absolutely splendid!"

"You simply must join one of my little weekly gatherings. Just a little get together of what few cultured minds may be found in this ghastly backwater. We'd adore hearing about your adventures. Oh, a legitimate spacer captain would lend some spice to the event! I am excited."
entries.zh:
"太棒了！" Menes 滔滔不绝，"简直太棒了！"

"你一定要来参加我每周一次的小聚会，这不过是在这处穷山恶水里为数不多文化人的小聚会。我们很想听听你的冒险故事。喔，一位真正的太空舰长会给这次活动增色不少的！我很激动。"

entries.en: "And I'll have to make sure to invite-" Menes is smiling, distracted by his own party planning. "-ah, a guest? I'm sure it'd be no bother. Who did you have in mind?"
entries.zh: "而且我得确保邀请 ——" Menes 微笑着，被自己的派对计划分了心。"—— 啊，一位客人？我觉得没问题。你打算带谁来？"

o.en: A hardened criminal who changed his name and became a Knight of Ludd.
o.zh: 一个改名换姓并当上卢德骑士的大罪之人。

o.en: A man who broke his Knightly vows only to hide among terrorists and become a hermit.
o.zh: 一个违背了骑士誓言，躲进恐怖分子中成为隐士的人。

o.en: A Knight who lost his way - but never his faith - now seeking absolution by way of epic quest.
o.zh: 一个虽迷失了方向，却从未失去信仰，现在正通过史诗般的任务寻求赦免的骑士。

entries.en:
"Oh!" Menes claps his hands together in delight. "That would be just the perfect, perfect thing!"

"Bring your friend," a mischievous look grows on his face. "I have an object in my special collection," his eyebrows bounce, "that'll launch his tabard directly into orbit! You'll see, you'll see. Oh, this is so perfect."
entries.zh:
"哦！" Menes 高兴地拍着手。"太完美了，那真是太完美了！"

"带上你的朋友，" 他脸上露出恶作剧般的神情，"我的特别收藏里有一件物品，" 他的眉毛跳了跳，"能让他的教袍直接飞到轨道上去！你会看到的，你就期待着吧。哦，太完美了。"

entries.en: You close the comms, then summon Bornanew to a briefing room to discuss the next phase of the plan.
entries.zh: 你关闭了通讯，然后把 Bornanew 叫到简报室讨论计划的下一阶段。

entries.en:
Bornanew's head is lowered as he enters, carrying his paper notebook as well as an off-brand datapad.

The notebook slaps onto the table a little harder than would be considered strictly polite.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 进来时低着头，手里拿着他的纸质笔记本和一个杂牌数据平板。

笔记本拍在桌子上的声音比严格意义上礼貌的程度要响一些。

entries.en: "-I'd hardly describe myself as a 'hardened' criminal, and although technically a Knight of Ludd, I'm merely a novice - and one in poor standing at that."
entries.zh: "—— 我没想过把自己说成是个 '大' 罪之人，而且虽然严格意义上是卢德骑士，但我只是个新晋骑士 —— 而且还声名不佳。"

entries.en: "I think it is uncharitable to the point of slander to describe the people of Mazalot as 'terrorists' so easily. And although it was a remote farming community, I was hardly hermit, to say nothing of-" He stops mid-rebuttal and looks up.
entries.zh: "我认为，轻易地将 Mazalot 上的居民描述为 '恐怖分子'，这不厚道到了近乎诽谤的程度。而且虽然那是个偏远的农耕社区，我也算不上是隐士，更别说 ——" 他反驳到一半就停了下来，抬起头。

entries.en: "Although technically a Knight of Ludd, I'm merely a novice - and one in poor standing at that. As for this 'epic quest' you describe, it's more of-" He stops speaking and looks up at you.
entries.zh: "虽然严格意义上是卢德骑士，但我只是个新晋骑士 —— 而且还声名不佳。至于你描述的这个 '史诗般的任务'，它更像是一种 ——" 他停了下来，抬头看着你。

o.en: Relax, $global.jethroName. We're just making you more exciting for Menes.
o.zh: 放松点，$global.jethroName。我们只是想让 Menes 觉得你更有趣。

o.en: You knew what this would entail. Think of the good it will accomplish.
o.zh: 你知道我这么说的目的。想想它带来的好处。

entries.en: "Yes," he sighs. "A barefaced ruse, I understand."
entries.zh: "好吧，" 他叹了口气，"一个赤裸裸的骗局，我明白。"

entries.en: "Yes," he sighs. "I shall hold that thought as dearest comfort."
entries.zh: "好吧，" 他叹了口气，"我会把这个想法当作最亲切的安慰。"

entries.en: "Nevertheless, that went well. Very well."
entries.zh: "不管怎么说，事情进行得很顺利。非常顺利。"

entries.en: "A snoop?" Bornanew asks, "Is this some sort of hack? Would that even be possible? One presumes that the administrator of a Persean League polity can afford the best computer security."
entries.zh: "窃听器？" Bornanew 问道，"这算某种黑客攻击吗？这能行得通吗？可想而知，英仙座联盟 政体的管理员能付得起最好的计算机安全方案。"

entries.en:
Bornanew looks at you for a long moment.

"Do you think Horus Yaribay will help?"
entries.zh:
Bornanew 看了你好一会儿。

"你认为 Horus Yaribay 会帮忙吗？"

o.en: He wants to appease the Hegemony. And Luddics are a significant demographic...
o.zh: 他想与 霸主 和解。而卢德信众是非常重要的群体...

entries.en:
He looks at you, and you see that he knows he has no argument for you.

Bornanew sighs. "Nonetheless, theft is a sin. And I did swear a sacred oath that I would never steal again."
entries.zh:
他看着你，你知道他无法反驳。

Bornanew 叹了口气。"尽管如此，盗窃是罪。而且我曾发过神圣的誓，我再也不会行窃了。"

o.en: Then I'll steal it. You can just show up and be yourself.
o.zh: 那我来偷。你只需要露面，当好你自己就行了。

entries.en:
"Yes, I- That's not-"

He exhales sharply. "Not only is theft a sin. I did also swear a sacred oath that I would never steal again."
entries.zh:
"是的，我 —— 那不是 ——"

他猛地呼出一口气。"不仅盗窃是罪。我还曾发过神圣的誓，我再也不会行窃了。"

o.en: Then I'll steal it. You can just show up and be yourself.
o.zh: 那我来偷。你只需要露面，当好你自己就行了。

entries.en: "But I, I-" he stutters to a halt. "I suppose, in the strictest sense this is... captain, I do not like it. Is there no alternative?"
entries.zh: "但我，我 ——" 他结结巴巴，有点说不下去了。"我觉得，从最严格的意义上说，这...舰长，我不喜欢这样。没有别的选择了吗？"

o.en: No one gets hurt. And it's a fake which they stole from your people in the first place.
o.zh: 没人会受伤。而且那是个赝品，是他们先从你们那里偷来的。

o.en: I could send a marine raid in to steal it so we don't have to.
o.zh: 我可以发动陆战队劫掠来把它弄到手，这样我们就没必要自己上了。

o.en: I could threaten to bombard the planet until Menes surrenders the relic.
o.zh: 我可以威胁要轰炸这颗星球，直到 Menes 交出遗物。

o.en: Fine. Let's think of something else.
o.zh: 好吧。我们想点别的办法。

entries.en: Bornanew nods, still looking displeased.
entries.zh: Bornanew 点点头，看起来仍然不太高兴。

entries.en: Bornanew gives you a distraught look.
entries.zh: Bornanew 露出了心烦意乱的表情。

entries.en:
Bornanew gives you a distraught look.

"I pray that is merely a joke in poor taste."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 露出了心烦意乱的表情。

"我祈祷这只是个品味低劣的玩笑。"

entries.en: Bornanew nods, still looking a bit as though he's eaten something foul.
entries.zh: Bornanew 点点头，看起来还是像吃了什么难吃的东西。

entries.en: Menes, still grinning and rattling on about his plans, sends you credentials to allow the docking of a shuttle at his private complex on the surface of Olinadu.
entries.zh: Menes 依旧咧嘴笑着，喋喋不休地谈论着他的计划，并向你发送了凭证，允许一架穿梭机在他位于 Olinadu 地表的私人庄园中降落。

o.en: We'll meet you before long, I'm sure.
o.zh: 我们很快就会碰面的，我确定。

entries.en:
He nods as you lay out your reasoning. The Hegemony wants a stable Luddic population. Horus wants a stable Hegemony in order to negotiate a peaceful settlement.

"If Horus intervenes to defuse the situation before a greater conflict is fomented... Horus the peace-maker..." Bornanew drums his fingers on his notebook.

"Which is exactly what he wants to be, if what you say is true. This could be over quickly. And quietly." He closes his eyes and holds his hands together as if saying a quiet prayer.
entries.zh:
在你陈述理由时，他点了点头。霸主 需要安定的卢德信徒。而 Horus 需要安定的 霸主，以便协商和平解决方案。

"如果 Horus 在冲突被煽动得更剧烈之前介入，化解了局势...和平缔造者 Horus..." Bornanew 用手指敲打着他的笔记本。

"如果你说的是真话，这正是他想要的。这件事可能很快就可以了结。而且悄无声息。" 他闭上眼睛，双手合十，像是在默默祈祷。

o.en: Then it's decided. I'll speak with Horus first.
o.zh: 那就这么定了。我会先和 Horus 谈谈。
我们讨论一下其他方案吧。

entries.en:
Bornanew nods, putting his hand back on his book as if drawing knowledge from it.
OR
"Of course, captain," Bornanew says.
OR
Bornanew looks down at his notebook and turns a page, then turns it back. "Of course, yes."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 点点头，把手放回他的书上，好像在从中汲取知识。
OR
"当然，舰长，" Bornanew说。
OR
Bornanew 低头看着他的笔记本，翻了一页，然后又翻了回来。"好，当然。"

o.en: I understand that you're a collector of interesting objects.
o.zh: 我听说你是一位有趣物品的收藏家。

entries.en:
He rambles, and you make a good show of asking for additional details, drawing his attention toward the object at hand and away from whatever in Ludd's name Bornanew is doing.

A piercing alarm interrupts Menes mid-thought. His eyes go wide and snap toward the central atrium which holds the glove- and Bornanew. He takes off at a run.
entries.zh:
他滔滔不绝，你则装出一副饶有兴趣的样子，追问更多细节，把他的注意力引向眼前的物品，让他无暇顾及 Bornanew 到底以卢德的名义做什么事。

一阵刺耳的警报声打断了 Menes 的思绪。他双眼圆睁，猛地转向存放手套 —— 以及 Bornanew 所在 —— 的中庭。他立马朝那里飞奔起来。

entries.en:
You both find Bornanew, still on his knees, with one hand stretched out to touch the glove - one finger upon it - lips still moving, eyes still blankly huge as if overcome by religious mania.

Menes gives out a wordless cry of alarm, and begins lifting his cuff to call security.

Your off-hand instinctively curls around a control interface for one of the clever little thieves-tools you have hidden about your uniform.
entries.zh:
你俩发现 Bornanew 还跪在地上，手伸向手套 —— 一根手指搭在上面 —— 嘴唇微动，双眼依旧空洞地圆睁着，就好像已经被宗教狂热所吞噬。

Menes 无言地惊叫起来，抬起袖口呼叫安保人员。

你下意识地摸向了制服里的控制接口，那是你藏在身上的精巧偷窃工具。

o.en: He's only touched it, no need for-
o.zh: 他只是碰了一下，没必要 ——

entries.en:
Menes hesitates as you speak, then barks a codeword into his comms.

You freeze, understanding what this sort of protocol looks like. The lights flare into harsh illumination and a trio of gun turrets pop from subtle cupolas - one each tracks instantly to you and Bornanew while the third spins in a slow covering pattern.

The human guards arrive a moment later, uniforms bright-white, boots squeaking on the floor. Menes breathes heavily, watching the security net tighten.

Bornanew, meanwhile, has not moved but to turn his head toward you and Menes.
entries.zh:
在你说话时，Menes 犹豫了一下，然后对着通讯器吼出了一个口令。

你僵住了，你明白这种程序意味着什么。灯光骤然亮起，刺眼夺目，三座炮塔从隐蔽的炮座中弹出 —— 其中两座立刻分别锁定了你和 Bornanew，第三座则缓慢旋转进行掩护。

人类卫兵没一会就赶到了，他们身穿亮白色的制服，靴子在地板上吱吱作响。Menes 喘着粗气，看着安保包围圈收紧。

而 Bornanew，他除了把头转向你和 Menes 之外，一动未动。

entries.en: "Menes, Yaribay sir. I pray your forgiveness. I- I was overcome by... I had to..." Bornanew trails off, pathetically.
entries.zh: "Menes，Yaribay 先生。我请求你的原谅。我 —— 我一时情难自已...我不得不..." Bornanew 声音渐弱，显得十分可怜。

entries.en:
It takes a second, but Menes starts to laugh.

And laugh, and laugh deep in his belly, almost a shout. He suddenly throws an arm over your shoulder, putting you off balance, as he struggles to contain himself.
entries.zh:
沉寂片刻后，Menes 大笑起来。

他笑得前仰后合，笑声发自肺腑，都快变成呐喊了。然后他突然把胳膊搭在你的肩膀上，让你踉跄了一下，他则努力控制着自己的笑声。

entries.en:
"You there," Menes calls out, "Knight $global.jethroName, get yourself off the floor. Come wash your face, you look absolutely disgusting. Back to the party! Drinks are on me, ha-ha!"

As almost an afterthought he calls to the security team, "You lot, clean this up and get out of here... ruining the mood."
entries.zh:
"你，" Menes 喊道，" $global.jethroName 骑士，快起来。去洗把脸，你这模样太恶心了。回派对去！酒我请，哈哈！"

他就像事后才想起来一样，对安保团队喊道，"你们几个，把这里收拾干净，然后滚蛋...净破坏气氛。"

entries.en: "You're right!" he shouts, "Captain, by the stars, you are right."
entries.zh: "你说得对！" 他喊道，"舰长，群星啊，你说得太对了。"

entries.en:
You and Bornanew, he given a basin and washcloth by a servitor, are hauled back into the party, and the entire crowd regaled with the story of Bornanew being overcome with awe at the relic and then caught setting off the security alarm.

Menes seems to find it more hilarious with every telling - and each additional round of drinks. His dutiful entourage joins in the laughter each time. The skinny man, Ulmus Pond, has a particularly manic, piercing laugh.

It is some time before you are able to get a quiet word in with $global.jethroName.
entries.zh:
在侍从为 Bornanew 递上了脸盆和毛巾后，你们二人被拉回了派对中，然后整个聚会的人都听说了 Bornanew 因为敬畏圣物而开始发癫，结果触发安全警报的故事。

Menes 似乎每讲一次都觉得这事越发好笑 —— 而且每喝一轮，他的笑点还会更低。他那些忠实的随从们也每次都跟着大笑。那个瘦骨嶙峋的男人，Ulmus Pond，他的笑声尤其疯狂而刺耳。

过了好一会儿，你才找到机会和 $global.jethroName 悄悄说上几句话。

o.en: What in Ludd's seven hells was that?
o.zh: 看在卢德七大狱的份上，你到底在干啥？

entries.en:
"I beg pardon for your blasphemy, captain," Bornanew says with a hint of strain in his voice. "Ludd's conception of hell was, so much as the Word reveals, a description of mortal torment in a Domain without God."

"But I do have the glove. What remains is-" an almost malicious smile briefly appears, "a fake."
entries.zh:
"舰长，我原谅你的亵渎之言，" Bornanew 的声音带着一丝勉强，"据圣言所示，卢德对地狱的构想，是凡人在一个没有神明的 人之领 中所受的折磨。"

"但我确实拿到手套了。现在还在那里的 ——" 他的脸上短暂浮现出一个近乎恶意的微笑，"是个赝品。"

entries.en: "Little, but for the monotony of my humiliation, however justly earned," Bornanew says with a hint of strain in his voice. "But I do have the glove. What remains is a-" an almost malicious smile very briefly appears, "fake."
entries.zh: "没什么，不过他们对我的嘲讽也太没劲了，尽管我罪有应得，" Bornanew 的声音有些紧张。"但我确实拿到手套了。现在还在那里的 ——" 他的脸上短暂浮现出一个近乎恶意的微笑，"是个赝品。"

entries.en: He lifts a finger to his lips, and with his other hand pats a fold in his Knight's robes.
entries.zh: 他竖起一根手指放到唇边，另一只手拍了拍骑士长袍上的一个褶皱。

o.en: You had a fake glove? This whole time?
o.zh: 你有个假手套？还一直都带着？

o.en: Good work, $global.jethroName. Great work, in fact.
Next time, be sure to let me in on your plan.
o.zh: 下次，务必先把计划告诉我。

entries.en:
His eyes keep watch on Menes as he replies.

"It's just a glove, captain. The color matches. I didn't think Menes would notice." His mouth quirks. "He didn't."

"He will notice eventually, however. We should... become distant from this place."
entries.zh:
他一直盯着 Menes，开口回答道。

"这只是一只手套而已，舰长。不过是颜色对得上。我不觉得 Menes 会注意到。" 他嘴角抽动。"他也确实没注意到。"

"不过他早晚会发现的。我们该...有多远跑多远了。"

entries.en:
* * *

It is a feat of diplomacy that you manage to extract yourself and Bornanew as quickly as you are able.

A faked containment failure alert from your chief engineer merely opens the door. Passing through requires shaking everyone's hand, exchanging pleasant words, and going through the motions of good-byes several times over - then each time the ritual is interrupted by some tangent or anecdote from Menes, he ensures that it is begun again from the start.

At last you find yourself back in your shuttle, a half-full glass still in your hand.
entries.zh:
* * *

你能这么快就带着 Bornanew 脱身，实属一项外交壮举。

你的总工程师伪造的收容失效警报只是为你打开了脱身的门。要穿过它，还得和每个人都握手，说些客套话，一遍又一遍地走完告别的流程 —— 然后每当这个仪式被 Menes 讲的题外话或趣闻打断，他都要让仪式从头再来。

最后你终于回到了自己的穿梭机上，手里还拿着半杯酒。

entries.en:
"Do you know what this is?" Menes whispers to you.

"The Right-Hand Glove of Blessed Ludd," Bornanew answers, stepping forward, voice filled with trembling reverence.

"Removed by the Blessed Ludd, whereupon that prophet fell to the sacred Earth of Gilead to kiss that holy ground. Blessings be upon Ludd; Good is the Word; By the Holy Pneuma; By the Divine Light which illuminates the righteous Path through the Garden of Temptation..."
entries.zh:
"你知道这是什么吗？" Menes 向你低声问道。

"圣卢德的右手手套，" Bornanew 回答道，向前迈了一步，声音中充满了颤抖的敬畏之情。

"由那位圣卢德亲手摘下，随即那位先知俯下身躯，亲吻 Gilead 的神圣土地。福泽归于卢德；圣言至善；凭那圣灵；凭那照亮了穿越诱惑花园的正道之圣光..."

entries.en:
Bornanew himself falls to his knees, half-whispering, half-sobbing in prayer, rocking back and forth, his eyes wide and focus vague.

This is a display you have never seen from $global.jethroName, completely at odds with his usual air of reserve.

Menes steps back with you, looking somehow appalled and delighted at the same time. He stares at Bornanew like a voyeur.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 跪倒在地，半是低语半是啜泣地祈祷着，前后摇晃，双眼圆睁，目光涣散。

这是你从未在 $global.jethroName 身上见过的模样，与他平时沉稳的作风截然不同。

Menes 和你一同退后，看起来既震惊又欣喜。他像个偷窥者一样盯着 Bornanew。

o.en: He's overwhelmed... you must understand, Menes.
o.zh: 他被震撼到了...还请你理解，Menes。

entries.en: "Yes, yes," he replies under his breath.
entries.zh: "对，对，" 他低声回答道。

entries.en:
Bornanew keeps at it, absolutely rapt upon his prayer toward the glove, tears and phlegm running down his face. It is, truly, a pathetic and uncomfortably intimate sight.

Menes keeps staring, an open half-smile on his lips.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 继续着，完全沉浸在对手套的祈祷中，泪水和鼻涕顺着他的脸淌下来。这景象让人同情，也令人感到不适和尴尬。

Menes 一直盯着他，嘴角挂着若有若无的微笑。

o.en: Menes. We should let him be for a moment, don't you think? Menes?
o.zh: Menes。我们应该让他一个人待一会，你不觉得吗？Menes？

entries.en: "Hmm? Oh. Oh yes. Of course, captain," he says, still watching.
entries.zh: "嗯？哦。对的。当然，舰长，" 他说着，眼睛却还一直盯着看。

o.en: Gently pull Menes' away and ask about other items in the collection
o.zh: 轻轻把 Menes 拉走，询问他收藏的其他物品

entries.en:
It takes a slightly more than polite tug to overcome Menes' inertia, but finally he's dislodged from Bornanew's spectacle toward another of the handful of chambers making up this 'inner sanctum'.

Menes keeps glancing back toward Bornanew as he explains the story of one or another object: A captain's uniform of the Fourteenth Battlegroup, sword and all, from the period of the Cold Passage; a bottle of spirits from some core Domain star system near Old Earth; a pistol once owned by the Warlord Leonis; the crystalline xenocoral of a species extinct for half a billion years collected by the Exploraria.
entries.zh:
要让 Menes 动起来，你使的劲有些超出了有礼的范畴，不过最终还是成功把他从 Bornanew 的演出里拉走，带到了 '内部密室' 中的另外一个房间里。

Menes 讲述着一件件物品的故事，一边不时回头看看 Bornanew：藏品中有 第十四战斗群 冷寂远航 期间的一套指挥官制服，连佩剑都在；有产自旧地球附近某个 人之领 核心星系的酒瓶；有曾属于军阀 Leonis 的手枪；还有 探险队 收集的、已灭绝五亿年的异星珊瑚晶体。

o.en: Astounding. Makes one think how we would handle the Cold Passage. Menes?
o.zh: 太惊人了。让人不禁思考我们要怎么应对 冷寂远航。Menes？

o.en: Incredible. What would it take to persuade you to hold a tasting? Menes?
o.zh: 难以置信。得付出什么才能让你办一场品酒会呢？Menes？

o.en: Fascinating. Do you think Leonis shot anyone with this, Menes?
o.zh: 真有意思。你觉得 Leonis 用这把枪射杀过什么人吗，Menes？

o.en: Intriguing. I wonder if I might find more such xenolife on the fringe. Menes?
o.zh: 真奇妙。不知道我能不能在边缘星区找到更多这样的异种生命。Menes？

entries.en: "Huh? Oh yes, naturally I've ruminated often upon how my own character might be tested by such hardship. I admit, my life has been one of relative ease, but I like to think that I identify with certain qualities of those early heroic figures whose steadfastness effected the..."
entries.zh: "嗯？哦是的，我当然常常思考，如果遭遇那样的艰难困苦，自己的品格会受到怎样的考验。我承认我的生活相对安逸，但我相信，我与那些早年间的英雄人物有着一些相通的品质，正是他们的坚定不移促成了..."

entries.en: "Ah? Oh yes, I cannot deny the temptation to open it for some appropriate event, given an appropriately appreciative audience- my dear cousin Horus for instance; I considered his marriage to Asherah, but I thought- no, not yet. I wonder at times if the delight of it is held by the anticipation, the thought..."
entries.zh: "啊？哦没错，在某些恰当的场合我确实会忍不住想打开它，当然，还得有懂得欣赏的观众才行 —— 比如我亲爱的堂兄 Horus；我曾考虑过在他和 Asherah 结婚时打开，但又觉得 —— 不，还不是时候。有时我会想，它的乐趣是不是就在于期待，在于想象..."

entries.en: "Oh? Oh, well, I do have a story for you! During negotiations with the buyer I thought, let us have a firearms expert examine this, and wouldn't you know that I happened to be hosting a wealthy financier who's done some work with Tri-Tachyon - and say what you will for the Company, they are good at what they do - and she happened to have a brother with an interest in a firm..."
entries.zh: "哦？哦，好吧，我正好有个故事要讲给你听！在和卖家谈判时，我想，咱们要不找个枪械专家来鉴定一下，你猜后来怎样，我当时正好招待了一位和 速子科技 有合作的富有的金融家 —— 不管你怎么评价那公司，他们在自己的领域里确实很专业 —— 而她碰巧有个兄弟在一家公司里有股份..."

entries.en: "Eh? Ah! Well I daresay, it is you who might answer that question fully, though I've always considered myself something of a naturalist, or xeno-naturalist if you will ha-ha, and so what if I were to finance an expedition of discovery of sorts? 'Menes Yaribay, patron of knowledge'; I like the sound of that. Imagine, to explore new worlds, encounter unknown lifeforms, seek out and explore the far fringes..."
entries.zh: "呃？啊！好吧，我得说，这个问题还得你自己才答得出来，虽然我一直自认为是个自然学家，或者说异星自然学家，哈哈，那么如果我资助一次某种形式的探索之旅呢？'Menes Yaribay，知识的赞助人'；听起来不错。想象一下，去探索新的世界，邂逅未知的生命形态，寻找、探索遥远的边疆..."

entries.en:
It takes longer than before to open the link. Menes' image flickers into being.

"Oh, Captain $playerName." He sets down a glass. "Have you quite completed your assessment of the... item?"
entries.zh:
建立链接的时间比以前长。Menes 的影像闪烁着成型了。

"哦，$playerName 舰长。" 他放下手中的杯子。"你检测完那个...物品了吗？"

entries.en:
It takes longer than before to open the link. Menes' image flickers into being.

"Captain $playerName," he pauses, looking down. "Don't let me delay your... assessment. I've entrusted you with quite a treasure."
entries.zh:
建立链接的时间比以前长。Menes 的影像闪烁着成型了。

"$playerName 舰长，" 他顿了一下，低下头。"别让我耽误了你的...检测。我可把那件珍宝托付你了。"

o.en: I'm still consulting with experts. Top experts.
o.zh: 我还在咨询专家。顶尖专家。

entries.en:
"Indeed? I suppose an object of such quality and... value," he emphasizes the word, "requires very careful examination."

He pauses, glancing down for a moment.

"I... I should hate to delay you. Though I am in no rush for the full payment of course, ha-ha." He laugh is unconvincing.
entries.zh:
"真的吗？我想，这样一个品质上乘而且...价值不菲的物件，" 他强调了这个词，"确实需要非常仔细的检查。"

他顿了一下，低头看了一眼。

"我...我可不想耽误你。当然，我也不急着要全款，哈哈。" 他的笑声很没说服力。

entries.en:
It takes longer than before to open the link.

Menes' image flickers into pseudoreality and is still but for the occasional wave of algorithmic correction.

"Captain, oh captain," he says finally, his voice more brittle than before. There are dark circles under his eyes. "Things have not been well."
entries.zh:
建立链接的时间比以前长。

Menes 的影像闪烁着，凝成了一幅伪现实的画面。影像基本静止，只是偶尔会因算法修正而泛起一阵波动。

"舰长，哦舰长，" 他终于开口了，声音比之前要脆弱。还顶着一对黑眼圈。"情况不太好。"

entries.en: "What do you know of Ulmus Pond?" he asks fiercely.
entries.zh: "你知道什么和 Ulmus Pond 有关的事？" 他厉声问道。

entries.en:
A troubled look crosses his face.

"Your concern is..." he looks away, and the moment draws longer. He's breathing heavily. Into his drink, perhaps?
entries.zh:
他脸上掠过一丝忧虑的神情。

"你的关心很..." 他移开视线，沉默使这瞬间显得格外漫长。他呼吸沉重。也许是，把气呼到了酒里？

entries.en:
"So you heard," his eyebrows raise. A spark of suspicion.

"The glove is not the point, my dear captain." He frowns. "My sanctuary was violated. My things stolen." He stares at you for a long moment, breathing heavily. Into his drink, perhaps?
entries.zh:
"看来你听说了，" 他扬起眉毛。眼中闪过一丝怀疑。

"手套不是重点，我亲爱的舰长。" 他皱起眉头。"我的密室被弄坏了。我的东西被偷了。" 他盯着你看了好一会，呼吸沉重。也许是，把气呼到了酒里？

entries.en:
"No!" he says too-loudly, and upon realizing it, corrects himself, "No. Now is good. We must speak, you and I."

Menes is breathing heavily. Into his drink, perhaps.
entries.zh:
"不！" 他说得太大声了，意识到之后，又镇静了一些，"不。现在就很好。我们必须谈谈，就你和我。"

Menes 呼吸沉重。也许是，把气呼到了酒里？

entries.en: "My security chief suspects an inside job. Betrayal, captain, is what that means."
entries.zh: "我的安全主管怀疑是内鬼干的。这意味着背叛，舰长。"

o.en: Your chief could be covering for their own massive security failure.
o.zh: 你的主管可能只是在掩盖他们的重大安保失误。

o.en: Now that you mention it, that Ulmus Pond seemed a little off...
o.zh: 你这么一说，那个 Ulmus Pond 确实有点不对劲...

entries.en: He watches you, looking more sad than anything. Then shakes his head.
entries.zh: 他看着你，那表情比起别的，更像是悲伤。随后他摇了摇头。

entries.en: "Ha, yes. So it could be." He doesn't sound convinced, but carries on. "Betrayal in another form, perhaps?"
entries.zh: "哈，是的。也许是这样。" 他听起来并不信服，但还是继续说着。"也许算是，另一种形式的背叛？"

entries.en: His eyes go wide, and his arm grabs at the side of his desk, pulling him to a more formal sitting position.
entries.zh: 他睁大眼睛，伸手抓住桌子边缘把自己拉起来，摆出了一副更正式的坐姿。

entries.en: "What do you know of Ulmus Pond?" he asks fiercely.
entries.zh: "你知道什么和 Ulmus Pond 有关的事？" 他厉声问道。

entries.en: A long pause. "Have you heard from Ulmus?" he asks. "Ulmus Pond. You recall him, surely."
entries.zh: 通讯频道陷入了长久的沉默。"你有 Ulmus 的消息吗？" 他问道。"Ulmus Pond。你肯定记得他。"

o.en: I haven't seen him since your party.
o.zh: 离开你的派对之后我就没见过他。

o.en: I haven't seen him since your party. (lie)
o.zh: 离开你的派对之后我就没见过他。 (说谎)

o.en: He's dead. On Chalcedon. A Pather called Sedge shot him.
o.zh: 他死了。死在 Chalcedon 上。一个叫 Sedge 的左径分子枪杀了他。

o.en: I caught him. He promised to confess everything to you.
o.zh: 我抓到他了。他保证会向你坦白一切。

o.en: I caught him on Chalcedon. He sold you a fake relic. The Knights hold him now.
o.zh: 我在 Chalcedon 抓到他了。他卖给你的圣物是假的。骑士团现在关押着他。

o.en: I caught him on Chalcedon. He sold you a fake relic. The Path has him now.
o.zh: 我在 Chalcedon 抓到他了。他卖给你的圣物是假的。现在他落到了左径手里。

entries.en:
A joyless smirk flits over his face.

"But you were not. The raiders were careful, very careful. Careful." He stares at you for a long moment, breathing heavily. Into his drink, perhaps?
entries.zh:
他脸上掠过一丝毫无喜悦的假笑。

"但你没死。那些袭击者很小心、非常小心。小心。" 他盯着你看了好一会，呼吸沉重。也许是把气呼到了酒里？

entries.en:
"So you heard," his eyebrows raise. A spark of suspicion.

"The glove is not the point, my dear captain." He frowns. "My sanctuary was violated. My things stolen. My... friends assaulted." He stares at you for a long moment, breathing heavily. Into his drink, perhaps?
entries.zh:
"看来你听说了，" 他扬起眉毛。眼中闪过一丝怀疑。

"手套不是重点，我亲爱的舰长。" 他皱起眉头。"我的密室被弄坏了。我的东西被偷了。我的...朋友们遭到了袭击。" 他盯着你看了好一会，呼吸沉重。也许是，把气呼到了酒里？

o.en: I was nearly killed at your 'party', Menes. We were both there.
o.zh: 我差点死在你的 '派对' 上，Menes。我们当时可都在那。

o.en: I'm truly sorry to hear that. I wanted to check in...
o.zh: 真的很抱歉听到这样的消息。我只是想来看看情况...

o.en: Is this about losing the... relic?
o.zh: 是因为丢了...圣物的事吗？

o.en: Perhaps I should comms another time...
o.zh: 也许我该换个时间再和你联系...

o.en: You wouldn't happen to know where I could find Ulmus Pond, would you?
o.zh: 你不会刚好知道我得去哪里才能找到 Ulmus Pond，对吧？

entries.en: Bornanew looks up. "Do you think he would assist us in this matter?"
entries.zh: Bornanew 抬起头。"你觉得他会在这件事上帮我们吗？"

o.en: He'd hate everything about this scheme.
o.zh: 他会讨厌关于这个计划的一切。

entries.en: "I see," he says. "Perhaps we should consider a different option."
entries.zh: "我明白了，" 他说道，"也许我们应该考虑其它方案。"

entries.en: "I see," he says. "Perhaps we should consider a different option."
entries.zh: "我明白了，" 他说道，"也许我们应该考虑其它方案。"

entries.en: "I see," he says. "Perhaps we should consider a different option."
entries.zh: "我明白了，" 他说道，"也许我们应该考虑其它方案。"

entries.en: "I see," he says. "Perhaps we should consider a different option."
entries.zh: "我明白了，" 他说道，"也许我们应该考虑其它方案。"

entries.en:
"I'm, uh..." Bornanew turns red.

"I... in the due course of investigation... if - no, not if - when we prove that the glove is a fake we demonstrate that the deal was made on invalid terms. But we need the glove first for physical evidence. It's... yes, it does involve a conscious deception... please don't look at me like that, captain," he says, almost indignant.

"It doesn't involve any killing, at least. I do pray it won't come to that."
entries.zh:
"我，呃..." Bornanew 脸一红。

"我...在调查的过程中...如果 —— 不，不是如果 —— 等我们证明手套是假的，也就同时证明了这笔交易的基本条款无效。但我们首先需要手套作为物证。这...对，这确实是一种刻意的欺骗...请别用那种眼神看我，舰长，" 他说着，语气似乎带着愤慨。

"至少这不涉及杀戮。我曾真诚祈祷过事情不发展到那一步。"

o.en: I'm just surprised. It's a good idea, $global.jethroName.
o.zh: 我只是很惊讶。这是个好主意，$global.jethroName。

entries.en: He sighs. "I beg you spare me praise in this particular instance."
entries.zh: 他叹了口气。"我求你别在这种特殊情况下夸我。"

entries.en: He presses his hands together and nods.
entries.zh: 他双手合十，点了点头。

entries.en: He presses his hands together, though gives you a brief, suspicious look.
entries.zh: 他双手合十，但向你投来了短暂的怀疑眼神。

entries.en:
You can see the inner conflict on Bornanew's face.

He knows he is asking far, far too much. But he wants to. If he had the credits, he would give them to the cause of the Church without a second thought. But he is a Knight of Ludd, sworn to poverty but for the allowance granted to him by his order - or by the indulgence of the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis.

He sees that you see all of this. And, knowing that words can only do harm, he makes the barest movement toward a shrug. A way of saying, you know who I am; what I am; what I need ask. Your choice is yours.
entries.zh:
你可以从 Bornanew 的脸上看出他内心的挣扎。

他知道他要求得实在太多了，但他需要这些。如果他有星币，他会毫不犹豫地把它们贡献给教会的事业。但他是一名卢德骑士，发誓安贫乐道，除了因被指派任务而领到的资金，以及因大祭司 Jaspis 的宽容而得到的津贴外，他一无所有。

他清楚你对这些事情十分了解。而且，他知道言语只会造成伤害，于是只轻微地耸了耸肩。意思是，你知道我是谁；我是什么；我需要什么。选择权在你的手上。

entries.en: "That's true," Bornanew says. "You might be able to talk Menes into accepting payment in the form of smaller installments. Then if we can resolve the entire matter of the glove quickly, perhaps you would only have to pay the initial deposit..."
entries.zh: "那确实，" Bornanew 说。"你或许能说服 Menes 接受分期付款。那么如果我们能迅速完全解决手套的问题，也许你就只需要支付首期定金..."

entries.en:
"Yes," Bornanew admits.

"I don't believe Menes will take an offer seriously unless you can demonstrate that you possess immense wealth. A half million credits, at least. To be safe." He taps his book, "Though if you could talk him into accepting payment in the form of installments, you might only have to pay a fraction of the full price to take possession..."
entries.zh:
"是的，" Bornanew 承认道。

"除非你能证明你拥有巨额财产，否则我不觉得 Menes 会认真对待报价。保险起见，至少得有五十万星币。" 他敲了敲他的书，"不过，如果你能说服他接受分期付款，你可能只需要支付全价的一小部分就能拿到..."

entries.en:
"An excellent point," Bornanew says, looking hopeful.

"This gives you exceptional credibility with Menes -- after all, you're a fellow demarch! I would wonder if you couldn't defer payment entirely, or convince him to accept a small percentage as a deposit to be paid later. And then if we resolve the matter of the glove quickly..."
entries.zh:
"这是个很好的切入点，" Bornanew 说，看起来颇有信心。

"这让你在 Menes 面前有了极大的信誉 —— 毕竟，你是一位民选统领！我甚至在想你是不是可以完全推迟付款，或者说服他先接受一小部分作为稍后支付的定金。然后如果我们能迅速解决手套的问题..."

o.en: I'll pretend to be a collector looking to buy a unique item.
o.zh: 我会假装成想购买独特物品的收藏家。

entries.en: "Menes likes you," he says. "He likes people who are rich and exciting. He wants you to like him. I suspect he could be persuaded to reveal his source. Or, if not, we could discover it if we had possession of the false relic..."
entries.zh: "Menes 喜欢你，" 他说。"他喜欢有钱而且经历刺激的人。他也希望你喜欢他。我猜你可以说服他透露他的渠道。或者，如果这行不通，但假如我们得到了那件假圣物，我们就能自己搞明白..."

o.en: Buy the relic from Menes? That could be expensive.
o.zh: 从 Menes 那里买下圣物？那可能会很贵。

entries.en: "It could be," he says. "And before you ask, the Church will not approve additional funding. The Reverend Archcurate herself has spent her covert budget too freely on my case already."
entries.zh: "可能会，" 他说。"而且我得提前说明一下，教会是不会批准额外拨款的。宗师大人已经在我的事情上太过随便地花费了她的秘密预算。"

o.en: Let's discuss me posing as a buyer again.
o.zh: 我们再讨论一下我扮成买家的事情吧。

o.en: I could pretend to have a relic to sell. Any ideas?
o.zh: 我可以假装有件圣物要卖。有什么主意吗？

entries.en:
"To what end? We want Menes to reveal from whom he acquired the duplicate." He taps his notebook, thinking. Then looks back at you.

"What if you were a buyer."
entries.zh:
"这是为了什么？我们要的是让 Menes 透露他从谁的手里弄到了那个复制品。" 他敲了敲笔记本，思考着。然后又抬头看向你。

"如果你是个买家呢。"

o.en: If the Church isn't paying... you're asking me to pay.
o.zh: 如果教会不付钱...你是要我付钱。

o.en: I am not exactly overflowing with credits at the moment.
o.zh: 我现在手头并不是特别宽裕。

o.en: I may be rich, but you intend to destroy the glove, right?
o.zh: 我也许有钱，但你是打算毁掉那个手套的，对吧？

o.en: It sounds like we should just steal the glove.
o.zh: 听起来我们应该直接偷走那个手套。

o.en: I may not have credits, but I do operate an independent colony...
o.zh: 我也许没那么多星币，但我确实运营着一个独立的殖民地...

o.en: I may not have credits, but I am a member of the Persean League...
o.zh: 我也许没那么多星币，但我是 英仙座联盟 的成员...

o.en: I do happen to know someone extremely rich. Rayan Arroyo.
o.zh: 我碰巧认识一个极其有钱的人。Rayan Arroyo。

o.en: Let's do it. I'll pretend that I want to buy a 'genuine' relic.
o.zh: 就这么办。我会假装我想买一件 '真正的' 圣物。
我们先讨论一下其他方案吧。

o.en: Are you... proposing that I cheat Menes Yaribay?
o.zh: 你是在...建议我哄骗 Menes Yaribay 吗？

entries.en:
"Well. Menes likes you," he says. "He likes people who are rich and exciting, and important. He wants you to like him. He wants to be associated with people who are like what he imagines you are."

"Offering to buy his 'relic'... he would like that, I think."
entries.zh:
"好的。Menes 喜欢你，" 他说。"他喜欢有钱、经历刺激、身份重要的人。他也希望你喜欢他。他希望能和他想象中的你这样的人搞好关系。"

"你提出要买他的 '圣物'...他会喜欢的，我觉得。"

entries.en: "If you have the credits," Bornanew says, "Or if you can leverage existing assets and status, perhaps you can simply buy the glove from Menes."
entries.zh: "如果你星币够多，" Bornanew 说，"或者如果你能利用现有的资产和地位，也许你可以直接从 Menes 那里买下手套。"

entries.en:
"That is a problem," Bornanew admits.

"I don't believe Menes will take an offer seriously unless you demonstrate that you possess immense wealth. A half million credits, at least. To be safe." He taps his book, "Though if you could talk him into accepting payment in the form of installments, you'd only have to pay a fraction of the full price to take possession of the glove..."
entries.zh:
"这是个问题，" Bornanew 承认道。

"除非你能证明你拥有巨额财产，否则我不觉得 Menes 会认真对待报价。保险起见，至少得有五十万星币。" 他敲了敲他的书，"不过如果你能说服他接受分期付款，你可能只需要支付全价的一小部分就能拿到手套..."

entries.en: Bornanew bows his head in thanks, his relief palpable, his hands clasped together.
entries.zh: Bornanew 感激地低下头，双手紧握在一起，他松了一口气的样子显而易见。

entries.en: "To Kazeron." He smiles easily as he pockets his notebook, then says "I've never been."
entries.zh: "去 Kazeron。" 他轻松地笑了，把笔记本放进口袋，然后说，"我从没去过那儿。"

entries.en:
Bornanew bows his head to your words. His expression is grim.

Menes has not been discreet. As a celebration of his first cycle as the new demarchon of Olinadu, he invited a holodoc team for a puff-piece interview and viewing of his 'collection'. Your tactical team reviews the holos, constructing schematic of the interior of Menes' complex, inferring layout and defenses from this and other publicly available information.
entries.zh:
听到你的话，Bornanew 低下了头，表情严峻。

Menes 并没有谨慎行事。为了庆祝他担任 Olinadu 新统领满一个星历年，他邀请一个全息纪录片团队进行了宣传性的采访，并展示了他的 '藏品'。你的战术团队检视了这些全息影像，构建了 Menes 庄园内部的示意图，并根据这些和其他公开信息推断出布局和防御。

entries.en:
It is estimated that roughly 100 marines will be required to pull off the operation.

Your marines will be equipped with an eclectic mix of equipment to allow them to pose as high-level pirates. They will be secretly infiltrated into Olinadu as, variously, spacer crew on shore-leave, contract technicians, and ne'er-do-wells looking to spend ill-gotten gains somewhere away from heavy law enforcement.

It goes without saying that you shall need to approach Olinadu with your $shipOrFleet's transponder off. Menes' overly charitable outlook on your character and generalized inattention to his official duties should allow you to join his 'party' with little oversight about how you actually got there.
entries.zh:
据估计，大约需要{100 名陆战队员}才能完成这次任务。

你的陆战队员将配备乱七八糟的装备来冒充高级海盗。他们将以各种身份秘密渗透到 Olinadu 上，比如上岸休假的太空船员、合同制技术员，以及想在远离严密执法的地方挥霍不义之财的无赖。

不用说，你需要在$shipOrFleet{应答器关闭}的情况下接近 Olinadu。Menes 对你身份的过分慷慨和他对公务的普遍疏忽，应该能让你几乎不受监督地加入他的 '派对'，并且不会让人在意你是怎么去到那里的。

entries.en:
To avert suspicion and ensure optimal timing, you and Bornanew will personally attend Menes' party when the raid is executed.

The raid will commence when two of a series of randomly generated time-slots are passed without receiving a stand-down signal. This signal will be, by all appearances, a routine status query to your $shipOrFleet, and appear to be perfectly routine behaviour for a justifiably neurotic independent $shipOrFleet operator.

Bornanew is watchful throughout the planning process, only occasionally advocating for lower-force protocols when a particularly bloodthirsty marine squad leader expresses more enthusiasm than strictly required for certain tactical details.
entries.zh:
为了避免怀疑并掌握最佳时机，你和 Bornanew 将在劫掠进行时亲自参加 Menes 的派对。

在一系列随机生成的时段中，如果中止信号连续两个时段未被发出，那么劫掠行动就将会启动。无论从何种角度看，这个中止信号都只是你对自己$shipOrFleet的例行状态查询，对于一个有理由时刻保持警惕的独立$shipOrFleet指挥官来说，这种行为再正常不过了。

Bornanew 在整个制定计划的过程中都保持慎言，只是偶尔在某个特别嗜血的陆战队长对一些战术细节展现出超出必要限度的热情时，他才主张采用较低强度的方案。

entries.en:
Sometimes acquiring something is as simple as taking it.

Both you and Bornanew - who is unenthusiastic, but professional throughout - are outfitted with an inconspicuous set of tools: a sheet-diamond rated cutter, EM glitcher, lockbreakers.

Bornanew sets aside some of the bulkier accoutrement with a shake of his head.
entries.zh:
有时候，想获取某个东西，就和直接把它拿走一样简单。

你和 Bornanew —— 他虽然不情愿，但全程都很专业 —— 都配备了一套不显眼的工具：一张金刚石切割薄片、电磁干扰器、开锁器。

Bornanew 摇了摇头，把一些比较笨重的装备放在一边。

entries.en:
Your tech officer installs a schematic of Menes' complex and a suite of scramblers on your datapad, a remote interfacer is hidden inside a fashionable stylus.

You perform the operation of various gadgets with your armorer, and review the choreography of the heist with your tactical officer. It is not a perfect plan, but with a combination of initiative, redundancy, and exceptional access...

Bornanew is standing very still, his fist against his jaw.
entries.zh:
你的技术军官在你的数据平板上载入了 Menes 庄园的示意图和一套干扰器，远程接口隐藏在一支很潮的触控笔里。

你和你的军械员一起操作各种装置，并和你的战术军官一起复核了这次抢劫的流程。这并非天衣无缝的计划，但凭借主动出击、多重保障以及绝佳的渠道...

Bornanew 一动不动地站着，拳头抵着下巴。

entries.en:
"It won't work," he says.

"With all due respect, your tactician is no thief. And neither are you. It must be me."
entries.zh:
"这行不通，" 他说。

"恕我直言，你的战术军官不是小偷。你也不是。得让我来。"

entries.en: "I am. I did," he says. "But more necessary than my conscience is our success. I shall bear my burden."
entries.zh: "是。我发过誓，" 他说道，"但比我的良心更重要的是我们的成功。我将承下这份重担。"

entries.en:
"Why should Menes leave you alone with the relic, or at all?" He looks over at you.

"I am a Knight of Ludd, devoted and taciturn. I shall simply... display the power of my faith."
entries.zh:
"为什么 Menes 会让你单独和圣物待在一起，或者让你单独留下？" 他看着你。

"我是个卢德骑士，虔诚而沉默寡言。我只需要...展现我信仰的力量。"

o.en: Aren't you opposed to theft? You swore an oath.
o.zh: 你不是反对偷窃吗？你发过誓的。

o.en: It's a pretty good plan. And I have the tools.
o.zh: 这是个相当不错的计划。而且我有工具。

o.en: I, too, have my faith. Is that nothing?
o.zh: 我也有我的信仰。那难道不算什么吗？

o.en: Tell me what your plan is.
o.zh: 告诉我你的计划是什么。

o.en: You're not going to let this go, are you.
o.zh: 你不会就这么算了的，是吧。
如果你坚持的话，那行吧。

entries.en: He crosses his arms. "I am not."
entries.zh: 他双手抱胸。"我不会。"

entries.en:
"Pray forgive me, captain; I do no question your faith." He presses his hands together.

"But Menes Yaribay cannot see into your soul. He will see your uniform, and my robes. That will be enough."
entries.zh:
"请原谅我，舰长；我没有质疑你的信仰。" 他双手合十。

"但是 Menes Yaribay 看不透你的灵魂。他只会看到你的制服和我的教袍。那就足够了。"

entries.en:
"We attend Menes' party. Be interesting. Be yourself. Get Menes to show off the glove."

"I know this trade, captain. Have faith." He pauses for a moment, acknowledging some irony in his own words. "It works best if you act natural."
entries.zh:
"我们直接参加 Menes 的派对，表现得有趣些。做好你自己，让 Menes 炫耀那个手套。"

"我懂该怎么做这笔买卖，舰长，要有信心。" 他顿了一下，承认了自己话中的某种讽刺意味，"如果你能表现得自然些，效果就最好。"

entries.en:
"If you can persuade Horus to intervene in the situation before it gets out of hand-" Bornanew sighs loudly, catching himself. "Forgive my choice of word; jocularity is not my intent."

He begins again, "If Horus sees it in his interest to force Menes to surrender the glove - and its source - then all might be resolved peaceably."
entries.zh:
"如果你能说服 Horus 在事情脱手之前介入 ——" Bornanew 大声叹了口气，回过神来，"请原谅我的措辞；我无意开玩笑。"

他接着说道，"如果 Horus 认为强迫 Menes 交出手套 —— 并解释其来源 —— 符合他的利益，那么一切都可能和平解决。"

o.en: Then it's decided. I'll speak with Horus first.
o.zh: 那就这么定了。我会先和 Horus 谈谈。
我们讨论一下其他方案吧。

o.en: I should invite Horus Yaribay to this 'gathering'.
o.zh: 我应该邀请 Horus Yaribay 参加这个 '聚会'。

o.en: Let's discuss inviting Horus Yaribay to this party.
o.zh: 我们讨论一下邀请 Horus Yaribay 参加这个派对的事吧。

entries.en:
"Ah," Bornanew meets your eyes knowingly. "I see where the arc of your rhetoric leads, and I cannot deny its endpoint. A Knight of Ludd does employ violence."

"'To protect the faith, to protect the faithful...'" He is quoting something - his oath?
entries.zh:
"啊，" Bornanew 会意地看着你的眼睛。"我明白你言辞的走向，我也无法否认其终点。卢德骑士确实会使用暴力。"

"'为了保护信仰，为了保护信徒...'" 他引用起了一些东西 —— 这是他的誓言？

o.en: Exactly. Like Ludd, righteous with hammer and sword in hand!
o.zh: 正是。就像卢德一样，手持锤与剑，伸张正义！

entries.en: "Yes, well. The sword is a symbol, an image, captain. Imagine waving a sword around in this age." He shakes his head.
entries.zh: "是的，嗯。剑是一种象征，一个意象，舰长。想象一下，在这个时代挥舞一把剑的样子。" 他摇了摇头。

entries.en: You think to yourself that this isn't the time to bring up your experience at the Rao compound on Eventide.
entries.zh: 你心想，现在不是提起你在 Eventide 上 Rao 家庄园里的经历的时候。

entries.en: You think to yourself that this isn't the time to bring up your experience at the Rao compound on Eventide.
entries.zh: 你心想，现在不是提起你在 Eventide 上 Rao 家庄园里的经历的时候。

entries.en:
"Nonetheless, if you insist, then I shall be forced to concede," Bornanew says.

"If we... if you can execute a raid; if you can do it without implicating the Church; if seizing this fake relic quickly and quietly will lead us to its maker and thereafter to a swift conclusion of the whole matter... then maybe the Church can avoid schism and disaster."

"If, and only if, it is necessary," he concludes.
entries.zh:
"尽管如此，如果你坚持，那么我也不得不让步，" Bornanew 说。

"如果我们...如果你能发动一次劫掠；如果你能在不牵连教会的情况下做到；如果迅速而神不知鬼不觉地夺取这个假圣物能引导我们找到它的制造者，从而迅速结束整件事...那么也许教会就能避免分裂和灾难。"

"如果，而且仅如果，这是必要的，" 他总结道。

o.en: It is necessary. I shall make the arrangements.
o.zh: 这是必要的。我会安排好。

o.en: Let's discuss other options before deciding.
o.zh: 在决定之前，我们先讨论一下其他方案。

entries.en:
Bornanew frowns.

"If this raid can be executed without implicating the Church, and if seizing this false relic quickly and quietly will lead us to its maker and a swift conclusion to the whole matter... then it may be a worthwhile path."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 皱了皱眉。

"如果这次劫掠可以在不牵连教会的情况下执行，并且如果迅速而神不知鬼不觉地夺取这个假圣物能引导我们找到它的制造者，从而迅速结束整件事...那么这条路也许值得一试。"

o.en: It is necessary. I shall make the arrangements.
o.zh: 这是必要的。我会安排好。

o.en: Let's discuss other options before deciding.
o.zh: 在决定之前，我们先讨论一下其他方案。

entries.en:
A holo of the complex spins in ghostly form in the shared visual workspace.

Your tools are multitude. All you really need to do is get yourself invited into the inner sanctum.
entries.zh:
庄园的全息影像在共享视觉工作区中如幽灵般旋转着。

你有很多工具。你所需要做的就是让自己被邀请进入那个内部密室。

o.en: It's decided. I'll steal that glove.
o.zh: 就这么定了。我来偷走那个手套。
我们讨论一下其他方案吧。

entries.en:
Your tactical officer has already spearheaded an effort to discreetly collect what public information is available on Menes Yaribay's compound. Sensors has arranged passive scans to correlate with on-record plans of the structure. Comms found a PR puff-piece holo in which Menes gives a personal tour of part of his 'collection'.

All you really need to do is get yourself invited into the inner sanctum.
entries.zh:
你的战术军官已经带头谨慎地收集了关于 Menes Yaribay 庄园的公开信息。传感器技官进行了被动扫描，来与记录在案的建筑平面图进行核对。通讯军官则找到了一份公关宣传全息影像，其中 Menes 亲自带领参观了他的部分 '收藏品'。

你所需要做的，就是让自己被邀请进入那个内部密室。

o.en: I've got the tools and the intel. I'll steal that glove.
o.zh: 我手头上有工具和情报。让我来偷走那个手套。
我们讨论一下其他方案吧。

entries.en:
You can tell he doesn't like the idea.

"That seems... it would be a blunt approach," he says. "And risky."
entries.zh:
你能看出来他不喜欢这个主意。

"那听上去...是种粗暴的做法，" 他说。"而且有风险。"

o.en: I often find the direct approach the most effective.
o.zh: 我发现直截了当的方法常常最有效。

o.en: Don't tell me you've never stolen before, $global.jethroName.
o.zh: 别告诉我你从没偷过东西，$global.jethroName。

entries.en:
Later, in the briefing room, you find Bornanew standing over a detailed schematic of Menes' complex. It rotates slowly in the shared display volume, gradually shadowing and illuminating his face.

It takes a moment, but you see that his eyes are closed and his lips are moving.

A prayer, you suspect.
entries.zh:
之后，在简报室里，你发现 Bornanew 站在 Menes 庄园的详细结构图前。结构图在共享显示屏中缓缓旋转，交错的光影让他的脸庞明暗不定。

过了一会儿你才发现，他的双眼紧闭，嘴唇微动。

你猜，那是在祷告。

o.en: I'll simply send my marines in to seize the relic.
o.zh: 我会直接派遣陆战队员夺取圣物。

o.en: Let's discuss the raid option again.
o.zh: 我们再讨论一下劫掠的方案吧。

entries.en:
"Captain, I must remind you that an interfactional incident must be avoided." He says this more evenly than you might have expected.

Bornanew looks down at this notebook, then up, "And I myself pray," he says in a low and quiet voice, "that I might avoid the shedding of innocent blood in this, this which is meant to be part of my act of penance."
entries.zh:
"舰长，我必须提醒你，必须避免势力间的冲突。" 他的语气比你预想的要平静。

Bornanew 低头看着他的笔记本，然后抬起头，"而我本人祈祷着，" 他的声音低沉而安定，"在这件事上，我能避免滥杀无辜，这本应是我赎罪的一部分。"

o.en: Does not a Knight use violence to stop from greater violence?
o.zh: 难道骑士不是用暴力来阻止更大的暴力的吗？
我们应该偷走那个手套。

o.en: Let's discuss the heist option again.
o.zh: 我们再讨论一下抢劫的方案吧。

entries.en:
Your tactical officer has already spearheaded an effort to discreetly collect what public information is available on Menes Yaribay's compound. Sensors has arranged passive scans to correlate with on-record plans of the structure. Comms found a PR puff-piece holo in which Menes gives a personal tour of part of his 'collection'.

All you really need to do is get yourself invited into the inner sanctum.
entries.zh:
你的战术军官已经带头谨慎地收集了关于 Menes Yaribay 庄园的公开信息。传感器技官进行了被动扫描，来与记录在案的建筑平面图进行核对。通讯军官则找到了一份公关宣传全息影像，其中 Menes 亲自带领参观了他的部分 '收藏品'。

你所需要做的，就是让自己被邀请进入那个内部密室。

o.en: Then it's decided. I'll have tools, it'll be fine.
o.zh: 那就这么定了。我会带上工具，没问题的。

o.en: Let's discuss other options before deciding.
o.zh: 在决定之前，我们先讨论一下其他方案。

entries.en:
"Do you know what this is?" Menes whispers to you.

"It looks like a glove, demarch," Bornanew answers in feigned misunderstanding, stepping forward.
entries.zh:
"知道这是什么吗？" Menes 低声问你。

"这看起来像一只手套，统领。" Bornanew 走上前，就像没听懂似的回答道。

entries.en:
"Not any glove," Menes says with more than a hint of vexation.

He begins again in a reverent whisper, "The glove worn by Ludd upon stepping upon the sacred Earth of Gilead. Ludd removed the glove and kissed the ground, according to the Luddic religion. Isn't that right, sir Knight? And this... is it."

Bornanew looks at you, his eyebrows rising slightly as if to give a cue. "This would be a most impressive find," he says. "If it is as you say."
entries.zh:
"这可不是别的手套。" Menes 颇为恼火地说。

他又开始虔诚地低语，"这是卢德踏上 Gilead 的圣土时所戴着手套。根据卢德教的说法，卢德 当时脱下手套亲吻了大地。对不对，骑士先生？而这...就是那只手套。"

Bornanew 看着你，眉毛微微扬起，好像在暗示你什么。"如果你说的是真话，" 他说，"那这个发现可够惊人的。"

o.en: Well I'm impressed, Menes. A relic from a pivotal moment of the Sector's history!
o.zh: 我真是大吃一惊，Menes。这可是来自星域历史中一个关键时刻的圣物！

entries.en:
"Thank-you captain!" Menes says, relieved and more than a little pleased that someone appreciates his trinket.

"Setting aside its purely religious significance," he gives an annoyed glance at Bornanew, "it represents a, a heralding of the changing tide of history! The ebbing influence of the Domain-era megacorporations, the rising of what some call - not my words of course, sir Knight - an atavistic populism. Truly, it is this small piece of the vastness of the story of Humanity which called to me when it was first described to me..."
entries.zh:
"多谢，舰长！" Menes 说道，松了口气的同时，还因为有人欣赏他的小玩意儿而高兴起来。

"先不说纯粹的宗教内涵，" 他恼怒地瞥了 Bornanew 一眼，"它还代表着...代表着历史潮流的转变！人之领时代巨型企业的势力在衰退，而一些人所谓的返祖式民粹主义正在抬头 —— 这可不是我说的，骑士先生。说真的，当我第一次听到这样的描述时，我有感觉到，自己在被这人类浩瀚故事中的小小碎片呼唤着..."

o.en: I, too, feel its call. Would you consider selling the piece?
o.zh: 我也感觉它在呼唤我。你考虑出售这件藏品吗？

entries.en:
"Oh, captain." Menes chuckles approvingly. "I couldn't possibly sell this, the prize of my collection. Nothing can compare!"

"-Although," he quibbles with himself, "I do possess a captain's uniform of the Fourteenth Battlegroup in excellent condition, and indeed a pistol once owned by the Warlord Leonis which I believe was used to execute prisoners at... well, you understand my point of course."
entries.zh:
"喔，舰长。" Menes 赞许般轻笑起来。"我不可能卖，这是我收藏中的珍品。没什么能和它比了！"

"—— 虽然说，" 他自言自语地狡辩道，"我确实还有一套保存完好的 第十四战斗群 舰长制服，还有一把曾经属于军阀 Leonis 的手枪，我敢说，以前那把枪被他用来处决过犯人，在...嗯，你懂我意思。"

entries.en:
"Of course," Bornanew says from behind Menes, who has fully turned his back to the Knight. "If it is indeed the real glove of Ludd."

You maintain your composure while watching the look that crosses Menes' face.
entries.zh:
"那当然。" 已经被 Menes 以背身相待的 Bornanew，就这么在他身后开口道。"如果这的的确确是卢德的那个手套的话。"

你保持镇定，留意着掠过 Menes 脸上的神情。

o.en: The Knight has a point, Menes. I couldn't make an offer without verification.
o.zh: 骑士说的有道理，Menes。没检验过的话，我可没法开价。

entries.en:
Menes laugh is more than a little strained.

"Now now, captain, I have not said I was offering the glove for any kind of sale. And," he glances back at Bornanew, "a lesser man than I might take offense at your implications, sir. My source has impeccable standards, and I assure you the provenance of the piece is most distinguished."
entries.zh:
Menes 勉为其难地笑了笑。

"别这样，舰长，我可没说这手套是要拿去卖的。还有，" 他回头瞥了 Bornanew 一眼，"换个气量比我再小点的人，你的暗示怕不是就要把他弄急了，这位先生。我的货源标准肯定没问题，我给你打包票，这东西的来历可是相当显赫。"

entries.en:
This isn't working. It's a good thing you prepared a backup plan.

You'll simply call in a marine raid while keeping Menes distracted. You give a grim nod to Bornanew and with only a small pause he follows your lead, asking Menes an insightful question about another item in his collection.
entries.zh:
这招行不通。幸好你有备用计划。

你决定在拖住 Menes 的同时直接呼叫陆战队劫掠。你严肃地向 Bornanew 点了点头，他愣了片刻，便领会了你的意思，向 Menes 提出了关于他另一件收藏品的深刻问题。

entries.en:
He doesn't see the shock on Bornanew's face. "Is that so?" Menes asks, sounding pleased.

Bornanew quickly shakes his head, no, and makes a little cut-off motion with his hand.
entries.zh:
"是这样吗？" Menes 问道，他看上去很高兴，不过没注意到 Bornanew 脸上的震惊。

Bornanew 飞快地摇头，并且用手比了个 "不" 的手势，他想要制止你。

o.en: Absolutely. I wasn't supposed to tell, but it's why I'm here. (commit)
o.zh: 当然。我其实不应该告诉你的，但这就是我来这里的原因。 (坚持说谎)

o.en: No, no, just a little joke. My apologies. (back off)
o.zh: 不，不，开玩笑而已，抱歉啊。 (退让)

entries.en:
Bornanew closes his eyes, and you hear his sigh of relief.

Menes glances at him, giving a funny look, then back at you. "Ah, of course. Ha-ha." He clears his throat. "Odd folk, you spacers," he says as if to himself.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 闭上眼睛，你听到他如释重负地叹了口气。

Menes 瞥了他一眼，神情古怪，然后转回来看你。"啊，当然。哈哈。" 他清了清嗓子，自言自语一样地说道。"你们这些宇宙民啊，真是怪人。"

entries.en:
As you commit to the lie, Bornanew gives you a look of absolute weariness.

Menes turns to him, "This is true? This is why you're here, isn't it. The backing of the Church, of course!"

"Yes," Bornanew says robotically, his attempt at a pleasant countenance looks like an appalling mask of pain.

Even Menes seems to sense something is off. "Are you feeling well, Knight?" he asks. "Perhaps you aren't used to the quality of drink I serve."
entries.zh:
你坚持要说这个谎，Bornanew 则投来了极其疲惫的眼神。

Menes 转向他，"这是真的？所以你才会来，对吧。教会当然会支持了！"

"是的。" Bornanew 机械式地回应着，他试图挤出的愉快表情，看起来就像一张骇人的痛苦面具。

就连 Menes 也察觉到有点不对劲。"你不舒服吗，骑士？" 他问道。"难道是喝不太惯我准备的饮料？"

o.zh: 是谁把这手套卖给你的？

o.en: Ulmus Pond sold you the glove, didn't he.
o.zh: Ulmus Pond 把这手套卖给你的，对吧。

o.en: I'll need to have the glove tested.
o.zh: 我得先检测一下这手套。

o.en: I'll provide a quarter deposit, right now, of 250,000 credits.
o.zh: 我现在就付四分之一的定金，250,000 星币。

o.en: I'll provide a quarter deposit, right now, of 200,000 credits.
o.zh: 我现在就付四分之一的定金，200,000 星币。

o.en: I'll provide a quarter deposit, right now, of 225,000 credits.
o.zh: 我现在就付四分之一的定金，225,000 星币。

entries.en:
"Rayan Arroyo, you say?" Menes perks up. "Yes, I do believe I've met the man. An honest dealer. No-nonsense. Good head on his shoulders. Fantastic taste... have you met his tailor? Stars above, a wonder! I should have them cloned."

"Well," he nods to himself, "I admit this does change my perspective. You should have mentioned him before!"
entries.zh:
"你说 Rayan Arroyo？" Menes 精神一振。"对，我记得我见过那个人。他是个诚实的商人。做事干脆，头脑聪明...你见过他的裁缝吗？我的天，那可是个奇才！我真该把那人给克隆了。"

"嗯，" 他自顾自地点点头，"我承认，这确实改变了我的看法。你早该提到他的！"

o.en: Surely my status as a fellow demarchon of the League means something.
o.zh: 我也是联盟的民选统领，这个身份肯定有点分量吧。

o.en: It may not be part of the League, but as a fellow executive of an independent colony...
o.zh: 虽然不是联盟的一份子，但我经营着独立殖民地，也算得上是一位民选领导人...

o.en: My commissioned status with the Persean League must count for something.
o.zh: 我受雇于 英仙座联盟，这个身份肯定有点分量吧。

entries.en:
"No doubt!" Menes exclaims, "Why, I should have commended you earlier for your service to the League. I was so caught up in your reputation as a spacer - you know, adventures and schemes and the like - it completely slipped my mind that you're on our side."

He slaps a hand across your back. "We appreciate your work, you know. Imagine if the Hegemony came for us - or, precious Ludd, imagine if the Church rolled in to force us all to pray night and day, ha!" He looks toward Bornanew, "Ha-ha! A joke, friend, a joke."
entries.zh:
"那没问题。" Menes 惊呼起来。"哎，我早该夸夸你为联盟所做的贡献了。我就记着你是个太空佬了，你懂的，冒险啊阴谋之类的太吸引人，搞得我忘记你是我们这边的了。"

他拍了拍你的后背。"我们很感谢你所付出的一切。想想看，要是 霸主 来收拾我们 —— 又或者，想想教会冲进来逼着我们日夜祈祷的样子，卢德在上！" 他望向 Bornanew，"哈哈！说个笑话而已，朋友，开个玩笑。"

o.en: Your cousin Horus Yaribay trusted me with his diplomatic credentials...
o.zh: 你的堂兄 Horus Yaribay 给过我他的外交凭证...

entries.en:
"But of course," Menes says, pouring on a gracious act. "Silly me, so caught up in your reputation as a space captain... having a respectable title - you must understand - it is simply unexpected."

"We're the League!" He slaps a hand across your back. "We have to stick together, you know. Or the Hegemony will get us - or, precious Ludd, the Church might roll in to force us all to pray night and day, ha!" He looks toward Bornanew, "Ha-ha! A joke, friend, a joke."
entries.zh:
"那当然。" Menes 说着，摆出了一副亲切的样子。"我突然犯蠢，就记着你是个太空舰长了...你得理解我一下，你能有个体面的名号，实在有点出人意料。"

"我们是联盟的人！" 他拍了拍你的后背。"要知道，我们得团结一致，不然 霸主 就会来收拾我们 —— 又或者教会可能会冲进来，逼着我们日夜祈祷，卢德在上！" 他望向 Bornanew，"哈哈！说个笑话而已，朋友，开个玩笑。"

entries.en:
"But of course," Menes says, pouring on a gracious act. "Silly me, so caught up in your reputation as just a space captain... having a respectable title - you must understand - it is simply unexpected."

"Well, I'm sure you'll join the League soon enough!" He slaps a hand across your back. "We have to stick together, you know. Or the Hegemony will get us - or, precious Ludd, the Church might roll in to force us all to pray night and day, ha!" He looks toward Bornanew, "Ha-ha! A joke, friend, a joke."
entries.zh:
"那当然。" Menes 说着，摆出了一副亲切的样子。"我突然犯蠢，就记着你不过是个太空佬了...你得理解我一下，你能有个体面的名号，实在有点出人意料。"

"嗯，我相信你很快就会加入联盟的！" 他拍了拍你的后背。"要知道，我们得团结一致，不然 霸主 就会来收拾我们 —— 又或者教会可能会冲进来，逼着我们日夜祈祷，卢德在上！" 他望向 Bornanew，"哈哈！说个笑话而已，朋友，开个玩笑。"

entries.en: Menes smirks, and holds out his TriPad, ready to accept your transfer code. Perhaps he feels like he's calling your bluff.
entries.zh: Menes 得意地笑着，递出他的 TriPad，准备接收你的转账代码。也许他觉得这样可以试探你是不是在虚张声势。

entries.en: Menes smirks, and holds out his TriPad, ready to accept your transfer code. Perhaps he feels like he's calling your bluff.
entries.zh: Menes 得意地笑着，递出他的 TriPad，准备接收你的转账代码。也许他觉得这样可以试探你是不是在虚张声势。

entries.en: Menes smirks, and holds out his TriPad, ready to accept your transfer code. Perhaps he feels like he's calling your bluff.
entries.zh: Menes 得意地笑着，递出他的 TriPad，准备接收你的转账代码。也许他觉得这样可以试探你是不是在虚张声势。

entries.en:
You tap your TriPad to his and it gives a happy little ping.

"Ah," Menes looks down to confirm. "So you are serious. I must admit, your decisiveness is impressive. Most spacer captains, they're all talk. You," he lifts his eyebrows like a conspirator, "mean business."
entries.zh:
你用你的 TriPad 碰了一下他的，设备欢快地发出一声轻响。

"啊，" Menes 低头确认。"原来你是认真的。不得不说，你的果断惊艳到我了。大多数太空舰长，他们就只会动动嘴皮子。但你，" 他扬起眉毛，像个同谋一样，"你是会动真格的。"

o.en: $global.jethroName, will you explain why this is necessary?
o.zh: $global.jethroName，你来解释解释为什么做检测很有必要？

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName trusts you implicitly," Bornanew explains, "So as $playerHisOrHer advisor, I must act the skeptic. I assure you, Demarchon Yaribay, it brings me no pleasure to appear to question and besmirch your fine reputation."

He speaks with such sincerity, for just a moment you can almost believe $global.jethroName isn't lying.

"Consider it a policy of 'trust, but verify'. We trust you, of course. But what of your source? We would never wish to see you cheated, but alas, I know too well that sin which lives in the human heart... If anything, I believe your only weakness is being too kind a spirit, too generous a benefactor."
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长其实很相信你。" Bornanew 解释道，"所以作为$playerHisOrHer的顾问，我必须得当好质疑者的角色。我和你保证，Yaribay 统领，质疑又或者玷污你的良好声誉，并不能给我带来任何乐趣。"

他讲得很真诚，有那么一瞬间，你都要觉得 $global.jethroName 没在撒谎了。

"你就把这当作 '信任，但要核实' 的流程吧。我们当然信你。但你的货源呢？我们肯定不希望看到你被人骗，但，唉，我太了解人心底的那些罪恶了...要说你有什么弱点的话，你唯一的弱点就是心肠太好，给赞助的时候太慷慨了。"

entries.en:
Menes begins to nod, especially as Bornanew hits the last part of his 'explanation'.

"Yes," he exhales, "I suppose you're right. I am, if anything, too giving. This was so true on Kazeron, where the resentful and dishonest sought to tear me down and entrap me in one scandal after another."

"Out here, the social environment is more rarified, more, dare I say it? Honest. Even if it is a hopeless backwater, I do try to illuminate the locals with the light of Kazeronian culture..."
entries.zh:
Menes 开始点头，尤其是在 Bornanew "解释" 到最后一部分时。

"嗯。" 他呼了口气，"你说得对，要说我的缺点，那就是我太乐于付出了。特别是在 Kazeron 那时，一群心怀怨恨、不诚实的人就总想着把我拉下马，搞出一桩又一桩丑闻来陷害我。"

"在这里的话，社会环境就更纯粹，人们也更...我能说质朴诚实吗？但就算这穷乡僻壤已经无可救药，我还是努力用 Kazeron 的文化之光来照亮这里的人..."

o.en: I have a financial backer, Rayan Arroyo... (lie)
o.zh: 我有个资助人，Rayan Arroyo... (说谎)

o.en: In fact, the Church is backing my purchase. (lie)
o.zh: 事实上，教会在资助我买下这东西。 (说谎)

o.en: Sorry, more spacer humor. The Church truly is backing my bid. (commit)
o.zh: 抱歉，不过又是个宇宙民的冷笑话。教会确实在资助我。 (坚持说谎)

entries.en:
You draw your TriPad and demonstrate.

"By the stars, he did," Menes says, eyes wide. "I knew I recognized your name from somewhere! There must have been a comms sent to the upper gens about this ploy Horus was running. That's cousin Horus for you, isn't it? Always pushing his little projects."

"Well," he looks as if he's reappraising you, "If you're good enough for cousin Horus, I suppose I could be convinced to make certain allowances."
entries.zh:
你拿出 TriPad 展示给他看。

"我靠，他真给了。" Menes 瞪大了眼睛，"我就说我好像在哪听过你的名字！肯定有人和氏族上层说过 Horus 在搞的这个计划。Horus 堂兄就是这样的，不对吗？他总是在捣鼓一些小项目。"

"嗯，" 他似乎在重新审视你，"既然你能让 Horus 堂兄满意，我想我也可以做点让步。"

entries.en: Menes looks almost convinced. One more solid point should do it.
entries.zh: Menes 看起来快被说动了，再来一个理由就行。

entries.en: "Well, I suppose that does it!" Menes claps his hands together.
entries.zh: "好，那这事就这么定了！" Menes 拍了拍手。

entries.en:
"Certainly! I'll have my secretary make the arrangements. But first - a toast to the start of what I am sure will be a bountiful partnership! Back to the party!"

"Even you," he slaps a hand on Bornanew's shoulder, pulling him along, "Surely you know how to celebrate a deal, my dour unbeliever? Perhaps not, so I'll show you!"
entries.zh:
"当然了！我会让我的秘书来安排。但，首先 —— 来为即将开启的、我确信会成果丰硕的合作干杯！回派对去吧！"

"就连你，" 他把手拍在 Bornanew 的肩膀上，拉着他往前走，"肯定也懂要怎么庆祝一笔交易吧，严肃的无神论者？可能你不懂，那我来教你！"

entries.en: Menes will need convincing. If you made a few good arguments, he will surely fold.
entries.zh: 你得说服 Menes。如果你能给出几个有力的理由，他肯定可以让步。

entries.en: Menes still needs convincing. A couple more good points should do it.
entries.zh: 你需要继续说服 Menes。再来几个理由应该就可以了。

o.en: Let's discuss veracity. I need... reassurance.
o.zh: 来聊聊真实性吧。我得...要点担保。

o.en: Considering my offer, I require full confidence in the item.
o.zh: 考虑到我能给的报价，我得对这东西彻底放心才行。

o.en: Let's discuss credits. Would a half-million open the question of a sale?
o.zh: 来聊聊出钱的事吧。50 万星币有得谈吗？

o.en: Let's discuss credits. Would 700k open the question of a sale?
o.zh: 来聊聊出钱的事吧。70 万星币有得谈吗？

o.en: Let's not waste time. One million credits.
o.zh: 我就不啰嗦了，一百万星币。

entries.en: "Tested," Menes says, the word apparently putting a bad taste in his mouth. "What would this entail, some technician coming in for a visit?"
entries.zh: "检测。" Menes 重复着，显然这个词弄得他有点难受。"你想干什么？拉个技术员过来一趟？"

entries.en:
"The captain will need to take the glove as a... temporary loan." Bornanew speaks, startling Menes. The Knight had moved silently to a position behind you and Menes.

"Nanoforge facilities provide the means to determine the date and manufacture of the glove. It would ensure that it matches the correct era, age, and style. The Church has records, you see. Detailed records."
entries.zh:
"舰长得把手套...暂时借走。" Bornanew 一开口就吓了 Menes 一跳。他不知何时来到了你和 Menes 后面。

"纳米锻炉可以识别出手套的制造日期和工艺。这样，我们就能确定它的制造时代、年份和风格是不是对的了。你看，教会对这些都有记录，很详细的。"

entries.en:
"Inconceivable," Menes says, scowling. "This is a unique relic of immense value. I can't let you simply walk away with it."

"Besides, this is completely unnecessary," he continues. "Gens Yaribay has a reputation for honest dealing going back generations!"
entries.zh:
"你们也太敢说了。" Menes 皱着眉头，"这圣物独一无二、价值连城。我可不能让你们就这么把它带走。"

"而且根本就没必要。" 他继续道。"Yaribay 氏族世世代代都是以诚信经营闻名的！"

entries.en:
He scoffs. "What do you take me for, a simpleton Luddie farmer from Chalcedon?"

His eyes dart at Bornanew to see if this one landed. $global.jethroName appears to be looking toward another display in one of the side-rooms.

Menes turns back to you, his brow furrowed at Bornanew's impassiveness. "Come now, captain, I was told you're a serious spacer. Ruthless in battle and savvy in trade. Was I so misinformed?"
entries.zh:
他嗤之以鼻。"你把我当什么了？Chalcedon 上头脑简单的卢德佬农民吗？"

他瞟了一眼 Bornanew，想看看这话有没有效果。然而 $global.jethroName 一副正看着某个侧厅里另一件展品的样子。

Menes 转了回来，Bornanew 的无动于衷让他皱起眉头。"得了吧，舰长，我可听说你是个正经宇宙民。打仗勇猛，经商精明。难道我的情报出错了？"

entries.en: Something shines in Menes' eyes. "I speak hypothetically, of course," he says, "but I wouldn't begin to think of a sale for anything less than a million credits."
entries.zh: Menes 眼中亮起精光。"先说好，我只是假设一下，" 他说，"但如果不到一百万星币，我根本不会考虑把它卖掉。"

o.en: Outrageous. I couldn't imagine it's worth more than 800,000.
o.zh: 太离谱了。我怎么想都不觉得这东西能超过 80 万。

o.en: I'll consider a million. But only if it's real.
o.zh: 如果它是真货，那我会考虑出一百万。

entries.en:
Menes sighs dramatically. "What am I, a charity?"

"I suppose," he muses, "I suppose I'm in an oddly generous mood to even be discussing this."
entries.zh:
Menes 夸张地叹了口气。"你把我当什么了？慈善机构？"

"我觉得，" 他若有所思，"我觉得我今天真是够大方的，竟然会和你聊这个。"

o.en: You're practically a saint. Now the matter of veracity...
o.zh: 你可真是个圣人。那现在就是真实性的问题了...

entries.en: Menes sighs dramatically, "I suppose - and this is because I'm feeling charitable - I would entertain the notion of a mere 900,000 credits." He looks at you sharply, "And that's only because you're a fellow demarch."
entries.zh: Menes 夸张地叹了口气，"那我想 —— 这还是我突然想做慈善啊 —— 我可以考虑一下 90 万，区区 90 万。" 他目光锐利，"而且还因为你也是一位民选统领。"

o.en: You're practically a saint. Now the matter of veracity...
o.zh: 你可真是个圣人。那现在就是真实性的问题了...

entries.en: You think you hear a snort from Bornanew, but perhaps he just scuffed the floor.
entries.zh: 你好像听到 Bornanew 哼了一声，但也可能他只是用脚蹭了蹭地板。

entries.en: Menes sighs dramatically, "I suppose - and this is because I'm feeling generous - I would entertain the notion of a mere 900,000 credits." He looks at you sharply, "And that's only because you've a League commission. It's practically charity!"
entries.zh: Menes 夸张地叹了口气，"那我想 —— 这还是我突然想慷慨些 —— 我可以考虑一下 90 万，区区 90 万。" 他目光锐利，"而且还是因为你受雇于联盟。我已经是在做慈善了！"

o.en: You're practically a saint. Now the matter of veracity...
o.zh: 你可真是个圣人。那现在就是真实性的问题了...

entries.en: "One million credits." Menes can't help but allow a glowing smile to break across his face.
entries.zh: "一百万星币。" Menes 没忍住，脸上露出了灿烂的笑容。

entries.en:
You and Bornanew are hauled back into the party, and the small crowd regaled with insinuations about a 'large purchase' by an unnamed 'wealthy spacer captain'.

Menes grows less discreet, winking and nudging with each retelling - and with each additional round of drinks. His dutiful entourage joins in to toast a 'new business deal' and theorize about extensions to Menes' complex.

You can see the skinny man, Ulmus Pond, watching you. He has a particularly manic, piercing laugh.

It is some time before you are able to get a quiet word in with $global.jethroName.
entries.zh:
你和 Bornanew 被拉回派对上，一小群人被关于未透露姓名的 "富有太空舰长" 进行 "巨额采购" 的暗示给逗乐了。

Menes 越来越不拘小节，每次讲这事都挤眉弄眼、推推搡搡 —— 而且每喝一轮，他还会更张扬。他忠实的随从们也跟着起哄，为一笔 "新生意" 干杯，并猜测着 Menes 的庄园扩建计划。

你可以看到那个瘦骨嶙峋的男人，Ulmus Pond，他也盯着你，还发出了尤其疯狂且刺耳的笑声。

过了好一会儿，你才找到机会和 $global.jethroName 悄悄说上几句话。

o.en: $global.jethroName. $global.jethroName, can you finish my drink? I can't.
o.zh: $global.jethroName，$global.jethroName，你能帮我喝完这杯吗？我喝不下了。

entries.en:
"He's a Pather agent," Bornanew says as if it were the most obvious thing in the world. He meets your look.

"We spoke briefly," he explains. "The circumstantial evidence is convincing enough, but it was his heretical understanding of theology which I found truly damning."

"I propose we retire from this, ah, celebration as soon as we can with the glove. Then investigate Pond."
entries.zh:
"他是个左径特工。" Bornanew 迎上你的目光，口中说得好像这是世界上最显而易见的事一样。

"我们简短地聊了几句。" 他解释道，"间接证据已经够有说服力了，但看他对神学的异端理解，我觉得真的可以锤死。"

"我觉得我们该赶快带着手套从这，嗯，庆祝活动中脱身。然后去调查 Pond。"

entries.en:
"Um," Bornanew shifts uncomfortably.

"I... Yes, I can take that for you, captain." He carefully takes your drink from you without spilling, and then gently places it on a protruding piece of architecture.

"Did you bring any anti-inebriants? Perhaps we should get you back to your flagship. Here, just take my arm..."
entries.zh:
"呃。" Bornanew 不自在地动了动。

"我...行吧，舰长，我来帮你拿着。" 他小心翼翼地接过了你的酒杯，一点也没洒，然后轻轻地把它放到了旁边的一块建筑凸起上。

"你带解酒药没？我们该送你回旗舰了。来，扶着我的胳膊..."

entries.en:
* * *

It is a feat of diplomacy that Bornanew manages to extract you as quickly as he does.

You have little difficulty playing up a state of stumbling drunkenness as Bornanew makes excuses, explaining that he will "pray for the captain's intemperance", much to the amusement of Menes' guests.

It is not your most dignified moment, but it ensures you can avoid the ritual of shaking everyone's hand, exchanging pleasant words, and going through the motions of good-byes.
entries.zh:
* * *

Bornanew 能这么快就把你捞出来，实属一项外交壮举。

你装都不用装就能走出步履蹒跚的醉态，Bornanew 则在为你找借口，解释说他会 "为舰长的酗酒祈祷"，把 Menes 的客人们都整乐了。

这大概算不上你最光彩的时刻，但它确实让你免了和每个人握手、寒暄以及走告别过场的仪式。

entries.en:
* * *

It is a feat of diplomacy that you manage to extract yourself and Bornanew as quickly as you are able.

A faked containment failure alert from your chief engineer merely opens the door. Passing through requires shaking everyone's hand, exchanging pleasant words, and going through the motions of good-byes several times over - then each time the ritual is interrupted by some tangent or anecdote from Menes, he ensures that it is begun against from the start.

At last you find yourself back in your shuttle, a half-full glass still in your hand.
entries.zh:
* * *

你能这么快就带着 Bornanew 脱身，实属一项外交壮举。

你的总工程师伪造的收容失效警报只是为你打开了脱身的门。要穿过它，还得和每个人都握手，说些客套话，一遍又一遍地走完告别的流程 —— 然后每当这个仪式被 Menes 讲的题外话或趣闻打断，他都要让仪式从头再来。

最后你终于回到了自己的穿梭机上，手里还拿着半杯酒。

entries.en: On a pedestal of carved wood, in a spot of light like holy revelation, a single glove is upthrust. It's fingers appear frozen in the midst of just starting to curl back toward a relaxed state after giving you a little wave.
entries.zh: 在木质雕花基座上，一束如同神启般的光芒中，一只手套赫然挺立。它的手指似乎凝固在刚刚向你挥了挥手后，正要蜷回放松状态的瞬间。

entries.en:
"I can see you are a practical dealer. Skeptical, even," he says. "This is understandable in a spacer. I know well of the sorts of figures you must deal with- corrupt Hegemony officers, pirates, ... treacherous, blood-thirsty Pather fanatics," he gives a quick glance at Bornanew to see if he's pierced the Knight's shell.

$global.jethroName is serenely pondering the glove, only half-listening by all appearances.
entries.zh:
"我看明白了，你这买家很务实。甚至说得上多疑。" 他说，"不过你是个宇宙民，可以理解。我懂你都得和什么人来往 —— 腐败的 霸主 军官、海盗...狡诈嗜血的左径狂信徒。" 他迅速瞥了 Bornanew 一眼，想看看自己有没有戳穿这骑士的伪装。

$global.jethroName 心平气和地端详着手套，看起来没怎么在认真听。

entries.en:
"Veracity?" An annoyed look crosses Menes face.

"I have nothing to prove; the good name of Yaribay speaks for itself. Besides, we are not even discussing a sale."
entries.zh:
"真实性？" Menes 的脸上闪过一丝恼怒。

"我没什么要证明的；Yaribay 氏族的好声誉就够了。再说了，我又没和你聊要卖这东西的事。"

entries.en: "Veracity. Hmm." Menes doesn't look pleased, but he doesn't look as annoyed as before.
entries.zh: "真实性。唔。" Menes 看起来不太高兴，但也没之前那么恼火了。

entries.en: "I'm afraid I could not reveal my source just now," Menes says haughtily. "They are very exclusive, and, and... sensitive."
entries.zh: "我怕是现在还不能透露货源。" Menes 一脸傲慢。"他们非常排外，而且非常...谨慎。"

entries.en:
"No, n- it's not- you can't-" Menes sputters for a moment, then crosses his arms. "I cannot confirm or deny your statement."

"And even if Ulmus did," he continues, "I trust you to act honorably and not reveal this information. There are fanatics out there, you understand, who would do terribly unkind things to him if they found out."

"Why do you think I only do private showings? There's no telling what idea some Luddie might get." He sniffs, taking in Bornanew once more, "You know what I mean. A proper Luddic who actually believes in anything with real passion."

Bornanew presses his hands together and gives a little nod.
entries.zh:
"不 —— 那不是 —— 你不能 ——" Menes 语无伦次了一会儿，然后双手抱胸，"我没法确认，也没法否认你的说法。"

"而且就算真是 Ulmus，" 他继续说着，"你那么正直，肯定不会泄露这个消息的吧。你也懂，外面有狂信徒，他们要是知道了，会对他做一些残忍的事。"

"你觉得我为什么只私人展示？鬼知道那些卢德佬会冒出什么念头。" 他抽抽鼻子，又看了 Bornanew 一眼，"作为一个真的、对一切都抱有热情的正派卢德信徒，你知道我什么意思。"

Bornanew 双手合十，微微点头。

entries.en:
"Do you know what this is?" Menes whispers to you.

"It looks like a glove, demarch," Bornanew answers in feigned misunderstanding, stepping forward.
entries.zh:
"知道这是什么吗？" Menes 低声问你。

"这看起来像一只手套，统领。" Bornanew 走上前，就像没听懂似的回答道。

entries.en:
"Not any glove," Menes says with more than a hint of vexation.

He begins again in a reverent whisper, "The glove worn by Ludd upon stepping upon the sacred Earth of Gilead. Ludd removed the glove and kissed the ground, according to the Luddic religion. Isn't that right, sir Knight? And this... is it."

Bornanew looks at you, his eyebrows rising. "Could it be?" he asks, allowing some melodrama to enter his voice.
entries.zh:
"这可不是别的手套。" Menes 颇为恼火地说。

他又开始虔诚地低语，"这是 卢德 踏上 Gilead 的圣土时戴着手套。根据 卢德教 的说法，卢德 当时脱下手套亲吻了大地。对不对，骑士先生？而这...就是那只手套。"

Bornanew 看着你，眉毛微微扬起。"真的吗？" 他问道，声音里带上了一丝戏剧腔。

o.en: I'm impressed, Menes. A relic from a pivotal moment of the Sector's history!
o.zh: 我真是大吃一惊，Menes。这可是来自星域历史中一个关键时刻的圣物！

entries.en:
"Precisely my reaction upon first hearing word of this unique artifact!" Menes beams, more than a little pleased that someone appreciates his trinket.

"Setting aside its purely religious significance," he gives a glance at Bornanew, "it represents a, a heralding of the changing tides of history! The ebbing influence of the Domain-era megacorporations, the rising of what some call - not my words of course, sir Knight - an atavistic populism. Truly, it is this small piece of the vastness of the story of Humanity which called to me when it was first described to me..."

Menes seems prepared to continue this for quite some time.
entries.zh:
"我第一次听说这件独一无二的艺术品时，反应和你一模一样！" Menes 面露喜色，为有人欣赏他的小玩意儿而高兴起来。

"先不说纯粹的宗教内涵，" 他瞥了 Bornanew 一眼，"它还代表着...代表着历史潮流的转变！人之领时代 巨型企业的势力在衰退，而一些人所谓的返祖式民粹主义正在抬头 —— 这可不是我说的，骑士先生。说真的，当我第一次听到这样的描述时，我有感觉到，自己在被这人类浩瀚故事中的小小碎片呼唤着..."

Menes 似乎准备就这个话题滔滔不绝地说下去。
