o.en: Novice Bornanew is dead. I have his body. And his murderer.
o.zh: 见习修士 Bornanew 已经殉道了。我带回了他的遗体，还有谋杀他的凶手。

o.en: Novice Bornanew is dead. I have returned with his body.
o.zh: 见习修士 Bornanew 已经殉道了。我带回了他的遗体。

o.en: Novice Bornanew is dead. I have returned with his body.
o.zh: 见习修士 Bornanew 已经殉道了。我带回了他的遗体。

o.en: I have returned with Novice Bornanew to complete his penance.
o.zh: 我已带着见习修士 Bornanew 归来，以完成他的赎罪。

o.en: I have returned with Novice Bornanew to complete his penance.
o.zh: 我已带着见习修士 Bornanew 归来，以完成他的赎罪。

entries.en: You have Bornanew's luggage taken to his quarters by a couple crew who clearly expected heavier lifting, then have him meet you in a debriefing room to plan your next move.
entries.zh: 你让几个船员把 Bornanew 的行李送到他的住处，他们显然没想到行李这么轻。然后，你让 Bornanew 到任务简报室与你会面，计划下一步行动。

entries.en:
"Indeed I was." He's steady. "You know of this. There I met Wrestling Sedge of the Luddic Path, and there I left my vows. For a time."

A pause. "You followed my path, and spoke with the man Sedge. He told you where I went from there, Mazalot, where you found me."
entries.zh:
"我确实到过那里。" 他很镇定，"你知道这事。我在那里遇到了 卢德左径 的 Wrestling Sedge，也在那里放弃了我的誓言，暂时放弃。"

他停顿了片刻。"你跟随着我的足迹，和那个叫 Sedge 的人谈过。他告诉你我离开之后去了哪，Mazalot，也就是你找到我的地方。"

entries.en:
"Indeed I was." He's steady as he speaks. "You know of this. There I met Wrestling Sedge of the Luddic Path, and there I left my vows. For a time."

A pause. "And you killed the man Sedge," he says. "The Path will have no love for you there, but I trust that you will be prepared for... that."
entries.zh:
"我确实到过那里。" 他开口时很镇定，"你知道这事。我在那里遇到了 卢德左径 的 Wrestling Sedge，也在那里放弃了我的誓言，暂时放弃。"

他停顿了片刻。"而你杀了那个 Sedge，" 他说。"那里的左径分子不会想看到你的，但我相信你已经为...那种情况做好了准备。"

entries.en:
"Gens Yaribay has a controlling interest in the military corporation which exercises the monopoly of violence for the polity of Olinadu. The Pathers are an ever-present threat, so those who don't cooperate... well, that is the stick which compels. The carrot, on the other hand, is a stream of investment credits facilitated by Gens Yaribay brokers."

"The locals cooperate with this arrangement, and agreed to vote Menes Yaribay to an executive position, perhaps understanding that he'd play the role as a figurehead rather than a serious administrator. Olinadu receives investment and safety while, from all accounts, Menes Yaribay simply wants to be liked."

"Compared to the alternatives," says Bornanew, "he is an ideal overlord."
entries.zh:
"Yaribay 氏族在一家军事公司中拥有控股权，而这军事公司垄断着 Olinadu 政体中暴力手段的行使权。在左径分子的长久威胁下，对于那些不合作的人...嗯，这就是强迫的大棒。而胡萝卜，则是由 Yaribay 氏族经纪人促成的一系列星币投资。"

"当地人配合这项安排，并同意投票选举 Menes Yaribay 担任行政职位，也许他们明白他会扮演一个傀儡，而不是严肃的管理者。Olinadu 获得了投资和安全，而从各方面来看，Menes Yaribay 只是想被人喜欢。"

"与其他选择相比，" Bornanew 说道，"他是一个理想的统治者。"

entries.en:
"Certain tawdry media outlets in the outer League worlds and beyond report rumor and gossip about affairs, social vendettas, and... how shall I put this... decadent festivities undertaken by Menes. More so in his younger years, at least." Bornanew turns pages in his notebook, not reading, but recalling as he goes through the motions with his hands.

"His enthusiasm for such pursuits has waned from the cycles of his youth, and his interests have shifted. At heart, I suspect Menes is still a man who wishes for all to hear his name, and for all who hear it to be very impressed."
entries.zh:
"联盟外围世界和其他地方的某些低俗媒体，报道过关于 Menes 的风流韵事、社交仇杀以及...我该怎么说呢...放纵派对的谣言和八卦。至少在他年轻的时候更是如此。" Bornanew 翻动笔记本，他没在阅读，而是伴随翻书的动作进行着回忆。

"他对这类追求的热情，已经随着青春的流逝而减退，他的兴趣也发生了转移。我猜，Menes 骨子里依然希望所有人都听到他的名字，并且让听到的人都对他印象深刻。"

entries.en:
"Unfortunately for his ambition, he is a natural dilettante in all pursuits. He avoids challenge, seeking instead flattery and the appearance of success which may be purchased with credits." Bornanew reports this without obvious outward judgment, as if discussing the results of a gravimetric survey.

"To his gens, Menes has given only scandal and debt. I suspect he was placed in the Olinadu administration to limit his ability to further damage their reputation."

Bornanew smiles grimly now. "It is some irony that he has potentially stumbled into more trouble than ever."
entries.zh:
"可惜他的野心终究无法实现，因为他在所有的追求上都半途而废。他不愿直面挑战，而偏爱用星币买来的成功表象和奉承之语。" Bornanew 的讲述并未掺杂明显的个人评判，就好像在讨论重力勘测的结果。

"而对于他的氏族，Menes 只带来了丑闻和债务。我怀疑，氏族之所以要把他安排进 Olinadu 的行政部门，就是为了防止他进一步损害氏族的声誉。"

说到这，Bornanew 露出了可怕的笑容。"说来有些讽刺，他现在可能陷入了前所未有的大麻烦。"

entries.en:
Bornanew closes his book of notes.

"It has been made clear to me that the Church would like this problem, this false idol, to quietly disappear," he says. "It can only tear open old rifts within the Church which would weaken the resolve of the Faithful. It would turn walker against walker in troubling times which promise naught but more trouble."

"I am prepared to ask nicely, but I do not believe Menes will agree to give someone like myself his glove."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 合上了他的笔记本。

"我已经清楚地了解到，教会希望这个麻烦，这个虚假圣物，能悄无声息地消失，" 他说。"它只会在教会内撕开旧伤，削弱信徒们的信念。在动荡的时期，它会让循道者们自相残杀，而这只会带来更多麻烦。"

"我准备好了客客气气地去请求，但我不觉得 Menes 会愿意把他的手套交给像我这样的人。"

o.en: But you think he might listen to someone like me.
o.zh: 但你觉得他可能会听从像我这样的人。

o.en: We could offer to buy it.
o.zh: 我们可以提出要买下它。

o.en: I could talk to Horus Yaribay. He leads his gens, presumably.
o.zh: 我可以和 Horus Yaribay 谈谈。他应该是他们氏族的领袖。

entries.en:
"Yes, the... artifact." Bornanew looks down, clasping his hands together, then taking them apart and setting them deliberately on the table.

"Ludd's right-hand glove," an abashed smile appears.

"A standard work-glove of Domain manufacture. Light vac-suit compatible. The story is that Ludd removed it to touch the ground of Gilead."
entries.zh:
"好，那件... 遗物。" Bornanew 低下头，双手紧握然后松开，接着小心翼翼地把手放到桌子上。

"卢德的右手手套，" 他露出了尴尬的微笑。

"一件人之领制造的标准工作手套。兼容轻型真空服。据故事中记载，卢德摘下它是为了触摸 Gilead 的土地。"

o.en: And you don't think it's real? The original, I mean.
o.zh: 而你不认为它是真的？我是说，原本的那个。

o.en: Seems like a lot to get worked up about.
o.zh: 听起来这摊子事确实够让人头疼。

o.en: What's Ludd going to do with two right-hand gloves?
o.zh: 卢德要两只右手手套干嘛？

entries.en:
"It's a real glove," he says, "That much is true."

"It's just a work glove, one of many designs prevalent through the immediate pre- and post-Collapse Persean Sector."
entries.zh:
"那是真的手套，" 他说，"这一点毋庸置疑。"

"它不过是只工作手套，在 大崩塌前后 的英仙座星域流行的众多设计之一。"

entries.en: "I think," he begins, "it is a matter of seeking a physical connection with the sacred."
entries.zh: "我想，" 他开始道，"这是个寻求与神圣事物建立物理联系的问题。"

entries.en: Bornanew laughs. "Yes, exactly."
entries.zh: Bornanew 笑了。"对，没错。"

entries.en: "My objection is that the glove, even if it is the glove, is not important. What is important is Ludd's message, Ludd's sacrifice; it is the act of a divine moral force touching the soul of humanity with supreme grace."
entries.zh: "我的反对意见是，这只手套，即使它真的是那只手套，也并不重要。重要的是卢德所留的信息，卢德付出的牺牲；那是神圣的道德之力以无上恩典触动人类灵魂的过程。"

entries.en:
"What is a glove to the light of Revelation?" The words come out forcefully.

"Even if it were Ludd's glove - and that we can't, and should not, be sure of - would God love you more for possessing it? Touching, looking upon, and worshipping it?"

His brow furrows. "Then some would try to extract DNA from the glove. Clone Ludd, they say, to re-open a connection to God." He shakes his head furiously, "As if you could fool God with the twin of the prophet's body!"

"Or the glove that body might have worn."
entries.zh:
"在启示之光面前，一只手套算得了什么？" 他的话语掷地有声。

"就算那是卢德的手套 —— 我们没法确认，也不应该去确认 —— 神难道会更爱你吗？就因为你拥有了它？或是触摸了它，注视着它，崇拜着它？"

他眉头紧锁。"然后有些人就会试图从手套中提取 DNA。他们会说，这是为了克隆卢德，来重新建立与神的联系。" 他愤怒地摇着头，"好像你能用先知身体的复制品来欺骗神一样！"

"或者哪怕用先知可能戴过的那个手套。"

entries.en:
"It's the fool's logic of 'magic' of the lowest kind, the heretical notion that humanity might manipulate the Divine to our own ends. Creation turned on its head!"

You've never seen Bornanew like this, his voice like a river; his physical size giving power to his words. Seeing you see this, he realizes it himself.

"I apologize for my outburst, captain," he says, looking down.
entries.zh:
"这是最劣等 '魔法' 的那套愚蠢逻辑，是人类为了私心或许能操弄神物的异端邪说。造物秩序都被颠倒了！"

你从未见过 Bornanew 的这副模样，他的声音如洪流；魁梧的体格为他的话语赋予了力量。看到你发现这一点，他自己也反应了过来。

"我为我的失态道歉，舰长，" 他说着，目光下移。

o.en: Let's try to focus on the matter, ah, at hand.
o.zh: 我们还是，呃，专注于手头上的事情吧。

o.en: No need to apologize. I can't help but agree.
o.zh: 不必道歉。我完全同意你的看法。

o.en: But magic isn't real. So what harm is focusing on a glove, fake relic or not?
o.zh: 但魔法不是真的。所以关注一只手套，无论它是不是假的圣物，又有什么害处呢？

entries.en: He nods, suppressing a smile, looking down at his notebook. He puts his hands together again.
entries.zh: 他点点头，压住了自己的微笑，一边低头看着笔记本。接着又把双手合拢。

entries.en: He meets your gaze. "I shall interpret your words as forgiveness. It is nonetheless unseemly for a Knight to let uncontrolled passion rule their actions."
entries.zh: 他与你对视。"我将把你的话理解为原谅。尽管如此，让不受控制的激情支配自己的行为，对一位骑士来说很不得体。"

entries.en:
"Of course, of course." He rubs his chin, calmer now.

"The problem is not that it might work, but that such self-trickery will lead the Faithful astray from the Word. And if we don't follow the Word, then what use have we for revelation? Are we to simply discard God's gifts?"

He sits, looking into the distance somewhere. "Ludd chose the revealed path not because it was easy, and not because it was without suffering. Ludd chose because it was Good."
entries.zh:
"当然，当然。" 他摸着下巴，变得平静多了。

"问题不在于魔法是否能奏效，而在于这种自欺欺人的行为会让信徒们偏离圣言。如果我们不遵循圣言，那启示对我们又有什么用呢？我们难道要就此抛弃神的恩赐吗？"

他坐下来，望着远方的某个地方。" 卢德选择了那条被启示的道路，不是因为它轻松，也不是因为它没有痛苦。卢德选择它，是因为那是善的。"

entries.en:
He glances at you with a fleeting grimace of self-reflection.

"With further apology for the ramble through theology, captain; the matter of the false relic should be our focus."
entries.zh:
他瞥了你一眼，脸上闪过自我反省的苦笑。

"再次为这段神学漫谈道歉，舰长；假圣物的事情才应该是我们的重点。"

entries.en:
Mention of Cotton dims Bornanew's expression. "He's read the Word, too, of course. In his way."

He sighs, deeply. "Let his crimes, worldly and spiritual, serve as bloody warning of the path those... that those uncertain of their faith might be compelled to follow. I pray it weren't so."

"Which, with apologies for the ramble through theology, brings us back to the false relic."
entries.zh:
提到 Cotton 让 Bornanew 的表情黯淡下来。"当然，他也读过圣言，以他自己的方式。"

他深深地叹了口气。"让他那些物质上和精神上的罪行，作为血淋淋的警告，警示那些... 那些信仰不坚定的人可能会被迫走上的道路。我祈祷事实并非如此。"

"那么，再次为这段神学漫谈道歉，我们还是回到假圣物的问题上来吧。"

entries.en:
Bornanew gives you a look.

"It's a tedious story. And unimportant."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 看了你一眼。

"那是个冗长的故事。而且不重要。"

entries.en:
"I propose you contact Menes directly. If you show interest in his pursuits, I believe he will be well-disposed toward someone of your... repute. He could provide us with information to plan our next move."

Bornanew shuts his notebook.
entries.zh:
"我建议你直接联系 Menes。如果你对他的追求表现出兴趣，我相信他会对像你这样...有声望的人抱有好感。他可能会提供我们计划下一步行动所需的信息。"

Bornanew 合上了他的笔记本。

o.zh: 那么，动身去 Olinadu 吧。

entries.en: "Your repute. As you well know," he says rather definitively. "And so will Menes."
entries.zh: "你的声望。你自己很清楚，" 他相当肯定地说。"Menes 也会有所了解的。"

entries.en:
"I propose you contact Menes directly. If you show interest in his pursuits, I believe he will be well-disposed toward someone of your... repute. He could provide us with information to plan our next move."

Bornanew shuts his notebook.
entries.zh:
"我建议你直接联系 Menes。如果你对他的追求表现出兴趣，我相信他会对像你这样...有声望的人抱有好感。他可能会提供我们计划下一步行动所需的信息。"

Bornanew 合上了他的笔记本。

o.en: Just one problem- the League wants me shot on sight.
o.zh: 还有个问题 —— 联盟的人见到我就会开火。

entries.en:
Bornanew opens his notebook.

He stands for a moment, eyes closed. "It is not ideal," he says.

"You will have to approach Olinadu with your transponder off. But I believe Menes will consider your official outsider status... interesting. Adventurous. It might even provide a sense of 'roguish charm'."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 打开了他的笔记本。

他站了一会儿，闭着眼睛。"情况很不理想，" 他说。

"你得关闭应答器才能接近 Olinadu。但我相信 Menes 会认为你的局外人身份...很有趣。富有冒险精神。甚至可能有一种 '流氓魅力'。"

entries.en: He meets your look. "I know," he says with a hint of smile.
entries.zh: 他迎上了你的目光。"我知道，" 他微笑着说。

entries.en: He meets your look. "You have my faith," he says with a hint of smile.
entries.zh: 他迎上了你的目光。"我相信你，" 他微笑着说。

entries.en:
He gives you a look. "My speculation on behalf of his character, captain."

Bornanew shuts his notebook somewhat more forcefully than the first time.
entries.zh:
他看了你一眼。"这是我对他人格的推测，舰长。"

Bornanew 合上笔记本的动作比上一次更用力了些。

o.zh: 那么，动身去 Olinadu 吧。

entries.en: Bornanew shuts his notebook again.
entries.zh: Bornanew 再次合上了他的笔记本。

o.zh: 那么，动身去 Olinadu 吧。

entries.en: "You have my thanks, captain," he says. "That will serve my needs most adequately."
entries.zh: "感谢你，舰长，"他说。"那完全能满足我的需求。"

entries.en: "Of course, captain," he says. "That will serve my needs most adequately."
entries.zh: "当然了，舰长，" 他说。"那完全能满足我的需求。"

entries.en: "If you would, please," Bornanew says with a nod that isn't quite a bow. "It would be most appropriate for my service of penance."
entries.zh: "如果可以的话，拜托了，" Bornanew 点头说道，姿态还算不上鞠躬，"那最适合我履行赎罪的职责。"

entries.en: Bornanew nods, not quite a bow. "My apologies, I did not intend to spurn your hospitality. It is a virtue."
entries.zh: Bornanew 点了点头，还称不上是鞠躬。"抱歉，我无意拒绝你的款待。这是一种美德。"

entries.en: Bornanew nods, not quite a bow. "You are right, of course."
entries.zh: Bornanew 点了点头，还称不上是鞠躬。"当然，你说得对。"

entries.en: "Such extravagance is not necessary for a mere novice, captain," he says uncomfortably.
entries.zh: "对区区一个见习修士来说，没必要这么铺张，舰长，" 他不安地说道。

o.en: A private workspace will allow you to best perform your duties.
o.zh: 私人的工作空间能让你更好地履行职责。

o.en: Nonsense. You're my guest and I'll treat you as such.
o.zh: 别胡说了。你是我的客人，而我也自会以礼相待。

o.en: If you wish, you will be given a crew-berth.
o.zh: 如果你愿意，我可以给你安排一个普通船员的床位。

o.en: You've done your research. Tell me about Menes Yaribay himself.
o.zh: 你做了不少研究。跟我说说 Menes Yaribay 这个人吧。

o.en: How did a Kazeron aristocrat get put in charge of Olinadu?
o.zh: 一个 Kazeron 的贵族怎么会被派去管理 Olinadu？

o.en: Tell me more about the relic at the center of this. What is it?
o.zh: 再多跟我说说事件中心的那个圣物。它到底是什么？

o.en: Wait, why's the real glove on Tartessus if Ludd removed it on Gilead?
o.zh: 等等，如果卢德是在 Gilead 摘下的手套，那为什么真品会在 Tartessus？

o.en: What's the plan? Ask Menes nicely for the glove?
o.zh: 计划是什么？客客气气地找 Menes 要手套？

o.en: Kumari Kandam? You were on Chalcedon. With the Path.
o.zh: Kumari Kandam？你之前在 Chalcedon。和左径的人在一起。

entries.en: "You could." Bornanew emphasizes 'you'. "The Church refuses to acknowledge the false relic."
entries.zh: "你可以这么做。" Bornanew 强调了 '你' 这个字。"教会拒绝承认这件假圣物。"

entries.en: "Interesting." Bornanew rubs his chin. "If you believe Horus will be receptive to you bearing this... news. I wonder if it may be as simple as that."
entries.zh: "有意思。" Bornanew 摸着下巴。"如果你认为 Horus 会愿意听你带来的这个...消息。我在想事情是不是真的那么简单。"

entries.en: "It is... yes, that is possible," he says begrudgingly. "I would like to know more before we act, however. I pray this may prove simpler than could be hoped."
entries.zh: "这...对，可能可以，" 他不情愿地说，"不管怎样，在行动之前，我想了解更多细节。我祈祷这件事能比预想的更简单。"

entries.en: "Yes," he says with the hint of a smile.
entries.zh: "是的，" 他微笑着说。

entries.en: He nods and proceeds.
entries.zh: 他点点头，继续说着。

entries.en: "This is providential," he says, nodding. "Your previous dealings with Horus Yaribay could open an easier path to resolving the Church's problem."
entries.zh: "这是天意，" 他点着头说。"你之前和 Horus Yaribay 的交集，或许能为解决教会的问题开辟一条更简单的道路。"

entries.en:
"The question, then, is how Horus Yaribay, the nominal gens leader, views Menes Yaribay's recent interest in religious artifacts."

Bornanew flips through his paper book, not really taking the time to read the dense notes therein. He runs a finger across lists of names.

"Not long ago Menes Yaribay was assigned the office of demarch, in essence the executive administrator, of Olinadu in the Kumari Kandam system. It is not a prestigious post. Olinadu is a small mining colony and the system is rife with Luddic Path activity. It is a dangerous, corrupt place."

Bornanew eye's return to you. "This is why I need your help."
entries.zh:
"那么，问题就在于，名义上的氏族领袖 Horus Yaribay 如何看待 Menes Yaribay 最近对宗教圣物的兴趣。"

Bornanew 翻着他的纸质本子，但并没有花太长时间去读里面密密麻麻的笔记。他的手指划过一列列名字。

"不久前，Menes Yaribay 被指派到 Kumari Kandam 星系的 Olinadu 担任统领，实际上就是行政总管。这不算是个显赫的职位。Olinadu 是一个小型矿业殖民地，而且那个星系里 卢德左径 活动猖獗。是个危险、腐败的地方。"

Bornanew 的目光回到你身上。"这就是我需要你帮助的原因。"

entries.en:
Of course you know the Yaribays. You were given Horus Yaribay's diplomatic credentials to arrange a meeting with High Hegemon Daud.

Horus Yaribay might owe you a favor, depending on how he views the situation.
entries.zh:
你当然知道 Yaribay 氏族。你曾从 Horus Yaribay 那里得到他的外交凭证，用以安排与至高霸主 Daud 的会面。

Horus Yaribay 或许欠你一个人情，但这取决于他如何看待这件事。

entries.en:
Of course you know the Yaribays. You were given Horus Yaribay's diplomatic credentials to arrange a meeting with High Hegemon Daud and have, on at least one occasion, used those credentials to call a favor on account of Gens Yaribay's prestige.

Hopefully he didn't find out.
entries.zh:
你当然知道 Yaribay 氏族。你曾从 Horus Yaribay 那里得到他的外交凭证，用以安排与至高霸主 Daud 的会面，而且你利用凭证和 Yaribay 氏族的声望来至少谋取过一次私利。

希望他没有发现。

o.en: Explain, but leave out the abuse of credentials part
o.zh: 进行说明，但略去滥用凭证的部分

entries.en:
Bornanew looks concerned as you describe your dealings. "Your conscience, your soul, is between you and- well, I am not your judge or confessor."

"From a practical standpoint, I would advise caution in asking too much of Horus of Gens Yaribay, to his face or behind it. He may know but choose not to act on your transgression."
entries.zh:
在你描述你的所作所为时，Bornanew 显得很担忧。"你的良心，你的灵魂，是你和 —— 好吧，我不是你的审判官或告解神父。"

"从务实的角度来说，我建议你谨慎一些，无论是在当面还是背后，都不要对 Yaribay 氏族的 Horus 索取太多。他可能知道你的越轨行为，但选择不采取行动。"

entries.en: A brief look of concern crosses Bornanew's face, and he pauses as if composing an awkward question. He puts his hand back down on the table, seeming to dismiss the notion, and responds in a different tone.
entries.zh: Bornanew 脸上的担忧一闪而过，他停顿了一下，好像在为一个尴尬的问题组织语言。然后他把手放回桌上，似乎打消了这个念头，换了一种语气回应。

entries.en:
Of course you know the Yaribays. You were given Horus Yaribay's diplomatic credentials to arrange a meeting with High Hegemon Daud. During that meeting, you handed over the key required for an encrypted channel between Horus Yaribay and Baikal Daud.

Horus Yaribay might owe you a favor, depending on how he views the situation.
entries.zh:
你当然知道 Yaribay 氏族。你曾从 Horus Yaribay 那里得到他的外交凭证，用以安排与至高霸主 Daud 的会面。在那次会面中，你交出了 Horus Yaribay 和 Baikal Daud 建立加密通讯所需的密钥。

Horus Yaribay 或许欠你一个人情，但这取决于他如何看待这件事。

entries.en: You know of Gens Yaribay of Kazeron, one of the three dominant ruling family-corporations. Theirs is most inclined toward rapprochement with the Hegemony, focusing less on heavy military industry and more on interfactional ventures.
entries.zh: 你知道 Yaribay 氏族，那是 Kazeron 三大统治级的家族企业之一。他们最倾向于与 霸主 和解，对军事重工业的投入较少，而更多地聚焦于势力间的合资企业。

o.en: Yes, I've heard of the Yaribays.
o.zh: 是的，我听说过 Yaribay 氏族。

entries.en:
Novice Bornanew speaks from the head of the table on which he has placed a paper notebook. He seems disinclined to use the shared workspace of the holo visualization suite; you're not even sure he brought a datapad.

"...collector who now possesses this duplicate relic is a man by the name Menes Yaribay, a minor member of Gens Yaribay of Kazeron," he looks to you for a sign of recognition.
entries.zh:
见习修士 Bornanew 在桌首发言，面前放着一本纸质笔记本。他似乎不太愿意使用全息可视化套件的共享工作区；你甚至不确定他有没有带数据平板。

"...现在拥有这件复制圣物的收藏家名叫{Menes Yaribay}，是 Kazeron 上 Yaribay 氏族的一个小角色，" 说到这，他用眼神询问了一下你是否认识这个人。

entries.en:
Oak ignores you.

"The novice still wears a crown of pride," Oak says toward Bornanew. "Still he has much to repent."

Bornanew turns slightly aside, keeping his eyes toward the Excubitor Orbis. "I shall be staying here a while, I think," he says softly.
entries.zh:
Oak 忽略了你。

"这位见习修士仍然高戴傲慢之冠，" Oak 对着 Bornanew说到。"他仍然有许多需要反省的地方。"

Bornanew 稍稍转向一旁，注视着行星教卫。"我应该还会在这呆一段时间，我想，" 他轻柔地说到。

entries.en:
Oak ignores you.

"The novice still wears a crown of pride," Oak says toward Bornanew. "Still he has much to repent."

Bornanew's look hardens. He matches the remorseless gaze of the Excubitor Orbis with his own. "If it be so by Providence," he says.
entries.zh:
Oak 忽略了你。

"这位见习修士仍然高戴傲慢之冠，" Oak 对着 Bornanew 说到。"他仍然有许多需要反省的地方。"

Bornanew 的目光变得冷峻了起来。他对视着行星教卫无情的目光。"既然天意如此，"他说到。

entries.en:
"No," says Oak. "The novice still wears a crown of pride. He has much to repent."

Bornanew turns aside and says quietly to you, "I shall be staying here a while, I think."
entries.zh:
"不，" Oak 说到。"这位见习修士仍然高戴傲慢之冠。他仍有许多要反省的地方。"

Bornanew 转向一边并悄声对你说到，"我应该在这呆一段时间，我想。"

entries.en:
"No," says Oak. "The novice still wears a crown of pride. He has much to repent."

Bornanew does not turn aside from Gideon Oak, matching his remorseless look with his own. "The Excubitor Orbis believes there is much sin for which I must pay. I shall be staying here, as it pleases him."

Oak, for his part, looks very much less than pleased at Bornanew's commentary. His clerk looks mortified.
entries.zh:
"这位见习修士仍然高戴傲慢之冠，" Oak 说到。"他仍然有许多需要反省的地方。"

Bornanew 并未回避 Gideon Oak 的视线，而是以同样毫不退缩的目光迎向对方。"行星教卫 大人认为我身负诸多仍需偿还的罪孽，而我也自然将留在此地，如他所愿。"

在听到 Bornanew 的言论后，Oak 本人显得极为不悦，他的文书则面露窘迫。

entries.en:
"Yes," says Bornanew, still caught in a staring-contest with Oak. "You are. I shall be staying here a while, I think."

The world's smallest smile makes a new crease on the Excubitor Orbis' face as he turns to you.

"Novice Bornanew owes you much. But still he wears a crown of pride. Still he must repent."
entries.zh:
"是的。" Bornanew 说到，一边仍然延续着与 Oak 的眼神交锋。"你的事情已经结束了。而我应该会在这呆一段时间，我觉得。"

当行星教卫的脸转向你的时候，这颗星球上最细微的微笑在他的脸上创造出了一条新的皱纹。

"见习修士 Bornanew 欠你太多。但他仍然高戴傲慢之冠。他仍需要反省。"

entries.en:
"But I have a feeling that our paths shall cross again," $global.jethroName says, pulling his simple bundle of possessions onto his shoulder.

Bornanew follows his fellow Knights to the doorway casting its long wedge of light into the armored hangar.
entries.zh:
"但我有一种预感，觉得我们的道路终将再次交汇，" $global.jethroName 一边说着，一边将朴素的行李挎上肩头。

Bornanew 随着其他骑士走向门口，一道漫长的楔形光柱自门扉投射进装甲机库。

entries.en:
"Our paths shall cross again," $global.jethroName says, eyes in shadow. He pulls his simple bundle of possessions onto his shoulder. "Hammer in one hand, sword in the other."

Oak, ever displeased, turns his back without further comment and begins marching to the far end of the hangar. After a moment, the other Knights, and Bornanew, follow.

They shrink to silhouettes in the long wedge of light cast into the armored hangar, then disappear.
entries.zh:
"我们的道路终将再次交汇，" $global.jethroName 说道，眼睛看着影子。他把他那精简的包裹背在了肩上。"一手持锤，一手执剑。"

Oak，这位一直都不高兴的人，一言不发的转身并开始走向机库的另一端。不一会儿，其他的骑士们，还有 Bornanew，也跟了上去。

在投射进机库的那道楔形的光束中，他们的影子渐渐缩小成轮廓，直至消失。

entries.en:

Bornanew, limping slightly, follows his fellow Knights to the doorway casting its long wedge of light into the armored hangar.

Your shuttle returns you to your $shipOrFleet.

A ping from your TriPad indicates a funds transfer.
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机返回了你的 $shipOrFleet。

你的 TriPad 发出了收到转账的提示。

entries.en:
You glance at your comms. Everything has been planned ahead of time, and care taken to hide tactical teams among the general population of offworld crew taking a bit of shore-leave. Signal discipline has been unerring.

The coded response, hidden in routine status reports, shows all teams are prepped and ready to move.
entries.zh:
你瞥了一眼通讯设备。一切都提前计划好了，战术小队已经小心地混入了正在休假的外来船员中。信号纪律一直准确无误。

隐藏在例行的状态报告中的加密回应显示，所有小队都准备就绪，随时可以行动。

entries.en:
Bornanew places the glove carefully into a clear-sided containment vessel, the kind used by salvors to take biological samples. Illuminated by the vessel's interior glowstrips, the glove seems to be held in a reliquary shining with holy light.

"Mere evidence," Bornanew says, seeing your look. "Now the question is, where did this come from?"
entries.zh:
Bornanew 小心地将手套放进了一个透明的密封容器里，就是那种打捞员用来采集生物样本的容器。在容器内部发光条的照耀下，这手套仿佛被供奉在闪耀着圣光的圣物匣中。

"只是个证据而已，" Bornanew 注意到你的眼神后说道。"现在的问题是，这东西是哪来的？"

o.en: What did you make of that Ulmus Pond?
o.zh: 你对那个 Ulmus Pond 有什么看法？

o.en: I don't suppose we could ask Menes.
o.zh: 我们大概没法去问 Menes。

entries.en:
At last you find yourself back in your shuttle.

Bornanew sets a drinking bulb of cold water in your hand, then places a clear-sided containment vessel, the kind used by salvors to take biological samples, in the seat next to you. Illuminated by the vessel's interior embedded glowstrips, the glove seems to be held in a reliquary shining with holy light.

"Physical evidence," Bornanew says, seeing your look. "Nothing more."
entries.zh:
你终于回到了自己的穿梭机上。

Bornanew 递给你一个装有冷水的饮水球，然后把一个透明的密封容器放在你旁边的座位上，就是那种打捞员用来采集生物样本的容器。在容器内部嵌入式发光条的照耀下，这手套仿佛被供奉在闪耀着圣光的圣物匣中。

"物证，" Bornanew 注意到你的眼神后说道。"仅此而已。"

o.en: Thanks. What did you make of that Ulmus Pond?
o.zh: 谢了。你对那个 Ulmus Pond 有什么看法？

Bornanew raises an eyebrow at you. "I wouldn't suppose, no."

He looks back to the glove in its containment vessel. "The glove might answer our questions, however."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 对你扬了扬眉毛。"我猜也是，没法问。"

他回头看着容器里的手套。"不过，这手套也许能回答我们的问题。"

entries.en:
"He's a Pather agent," Bornanew says as if it were the most obvious thing in the world. He meets your look.

"We spoke briefly," he explains. "The circumstantial evidence is convincing enough, but it was his heretical understanding of theology which I found truly damning."

"He may be connected, but first we should ask the glove." He looks back down at the glove in its containment vessel.
entries.zh:
"他是个左径特工。" Bornanew 迎上你的目光，口中说得好像这是世界上最显而易见的事一样。

"我们简短地聊了几句。" 他解释道，"间接证据已经够有说服力了，但看他对神学的异端理解，我觉得真的可以锤死。"

"他可能和这事有关，但我们得先查查这只手套。" 他又低头看向容器里的手套。

"We spoke briefly," he explains. "The circumstantial evidence is convincing enough, but it was his heretical understanding of theology which I found truly damning."

"He's also a liar. So." He looks down at the glove once more.

"他还是个骗子。所以。" 他又低头看了看那只手套。

entries.en:
"A nanoforge engineer could tell us where this came from," he says. "Who made it. When, and where. By that truth, we can judge the answers we receive from those we... interview." His last word is muted by the shuttle's maneuverings.

"The Church operates a nanoforge on the planet Asher, in the Canaan system. The engineers there will cooperate with the authority I bear, and despite mostly being nonbelievers, their discretion is already paid for by the Church. Our inquiry will be safe."

He pauses, and looks away. "So far as anything is, in the Church."
entries.zh:
"纳米锻炉工程师能告诉我们这东西是哪来的，" 他说，"具体来说是谁造的。什么时候造的，在哪造的。通过这些事实，我们就能判断出我们从那些... 被采访的人那里得到的答案信不信得过了。" 他说 "采访" 时，声音被穿梭机的颠簸声盖了过去。

"教会的纳米锻炉在 Canaan 星系的 Asher 上。那里的技术人员会配合我所代表的授权。虽然说他们大多是无信者，但教会已经付过钱让他们保密了。我们的调查会很安全。"

他顿了一下，移开了视线，"至少，在教会所能做到的范围内很安全。"

o.en: We should confirm our hard evidence before Menes starts asking questions.
o.zh: 我们得在 Menes 开始问问题之前，把事情实锤了。

o.zh: 反正我觉得我们在这待得够久了，是时候走了。

entries.en:
Bornanew nods agreement.

The shuttle approaches your flagship and prepares to dock.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 点头同意。

穿梭机靠近了你的旗舰，准备停泊。

entries.en:
The primary defenses are destroyed, the command and control section holed and venting fiery atmo. The superstructure's own spin is pulling the station apart like slow butchery.

You destroyed the nanoforge, but did not secure the evidence Bornanew needed to find the mole in the Cathedral of Holy Exodus on Tartessus.

"It is the best that could be done," Bornanew says, eyes downcast. His notebook is closed, before him. "I must submit myself to the Excubitor Orbis for judgment. On Hesperus."
entries.zh:
主要防御体系已被摧毁，指挥控制区也被击穿，炽热的大气正喷涌而出。空间站的结构正因自身的旋转而缓缓撕裂，如同缓慢的肢解。

你摧毁了纳米锻炉，却未能获取 Bornanew 所需的证据 —— 那些能在 Tartessus 的 Exodus 神圣大教堂揪出内应的证据。

"这已是所能做到的最好结果了，" Bornanew 垂目低语道。他的笔记本正合着，摆在他的面前。"我必须向行星教卫大人请罪，就在 Hesperus。"

entries.en:
The prize, turned over to your Tech officer's analysis team by a crew of sweating salvors, is a largely uncorrupted backup archive. Standard Domain tech, it hardly looks like the Pathers even knew it was quietly doing its job behind a thin access panel.

The technicians descend upon it with a suite of interfacers, passing every scrap of data to the analysts working in an isolated computing environment to reconstruct the system, starting with comms buffers and metadata.
entries.zh:
这份战利品被一群大汗淋漓的打捞员移交至你的技术军官的分析团队手中 —— 那是一个基本完好的备份档案库。标准的 人之领 科技，而且似乎左径分子甚至未曾察觉到，它就藏在一块薄薄的检修板后默默运作着。

技术团队带着全套接口设备蜂拥而上，将每一点数据碎片传递至隔离计算环境中的分析员手中，从通讯缓冲区和元数据开始，着手重建整个系统。

entries.en:
You watch from the command center as marine squads launch the opening salvo from seemingly innocuous cargo containers. Powered armor units burst forth like locusts; combat techs inject malware into the station network, demolitions breach emergency blast doors, and assault teams cut a swath to key targets.

Nodes on the adaptive objective graph, woven through the station tactical display, are achieved one after another. Points blink from blood-red to amber or green, depending on found conditions. Indeed, some comms relays and data clusters auto-destruct upon unauthorized access, but others quietly fail, allowing techs to seize the contents.

The last red-indicated volume is the industrial section housing what is indeed the station's nanoforge; the Pathers had regrouped for a last stand. And so it is.
entries.zh:
你在指挥中心注视着陆战小队从看似普通的货运集装箱中发起首轮突袭。动力甲单位如蝗群般涌出；作战技官将恶意软件注入空间站网络，爆破组炸开紧急防爆舱门，突击队则向关键目标席卷而去。

在自适应目标图谱上，贯穿空间站战术界面的节点被一个接一个攻克。根据探测到的状况，节点指示灯从血红色闪烁着变为琥珀色或绿色。诚然，部分通讯中继站与数据集群在遭遇未授权访问时会自毁，但另一些则会默然失效，让技术人员得以截获内容。

最后标注为红色的区域是容纳着空间站纳米锻炉的工业区；左径分子已在此重组，准备负隅顽抗，正如预料。

entries.en:
They were caught off-guard. Despite the large numbers of armed zealots of the Path, your strike teams concentrated force where their defenses, fighting to the death, could not hold.

Teams return to waiting evac drones and shuttles, trailed by tethered spoils: memory blocks torn from their cradles, a few bagged prisoners.

A blue-white flash illuminates the returning victors. Behind them, the industrial section spins itself apart, structural plates shattered into glowing shards, struts tortuously bent, and that atmo which hasn't burned off in a glowing plume forms a rapidly expanding, dissipating cloud, illuminated from within by dying light.
entries.zh:
他们被打了个措手不及。尽管左径的武装狂热者人数众多，但你的突击队将火力集中于他们拼死抵抗却无法固守的防区。

各小队返回待命的撤离无人机与穿梭机，身后牵引着战利品：从基座上扯下的记忆模块，以及几名被拘束袋所捆缚的俘虏。

一道蓝白色闪光映亮了凯旋的队伍。在他们身后，工业区正在自我崩解 —— 结构板碎裂成炽热的残片，支撑梁扭曲变形，未被燃烧殆尽的大气在炽热烟柱中形成急速膨胀消散的云团，内部透出垂死的微光。

entries.en:
You convene your officers, and Bornanew, to evaluate the situation.

Pather resistance is expected to be fierce; the core of their militants have a zealous faith, little fear of death, and are often experienced fighters. However they eschew top of the line technology and combat enhancement, whether cybernetic or biochemical.

Bornanew clears his throat and speaks. "Certain classes of combat drugs are accepted among Luddic Path militants. They favor, ah, 'natural' sources." He takes in the confused looks. "Plants," he adds.

Capturing high-value datastores before they're wiped creates exceptional difficulties. The assault must be lightning-quick, and disabling rather than destructive as much as possible.
entries.zh:
你召集麾下的军官与 Bornanew 共同评估局势。

左径分子的抵抗预计将极为激烈；其核心武装分子信仰狂热，悍不畏死，且多为经验丰富的战士。然而他们排斥顶尖科技与战斗强化手段，无论是赛博改造还是生化增强。

Bornanew 清了清嗓子，随后开口说道："某些类别的战斗药剂在卢德左径武装分子中被允许使用。他们偏好，呃，'天然' 的来源。" 他察觉到众人困惑的目光，便继续道，"也就是植物提取物。"

在数据存储单元被清除前夺取高价值目标将带来极大的困难。突击行动必须迅如闪电，并尽可能采用瘫痪手段而非毁灭性打击。

左径分子的抵抗预计将极为激烈；其核心武装分子信仰狂热，悍不畏死，且多为经验丰富的战士。然而他们排斥顶尖科技与战斗强化手段，无论是赛博改造还是生化增强。

在数据存储单元被清除前夺取高价值目标将带来极大的困难。突击行动必须迅如闪电，并尽可能采用瘫痪手段而非毁灭性打击。

o.en: I've come a long way looking to purchase something... unique. (lie)
o.zh: 我远道而来，是为了买点...特别的东西。 (说谎)

o.en: Your nanoforge assembled a very interesting item. I have questions.
o.zh: 你们的纳米锻炉组装了一件非常有趣的物品，而我有些疑问。

o.en: I come as fellow-walker of the Faith... I have grave concerns.
o.zh: 我以循道同袍的身份前来此地... 我深感忧虑。

entries.en: Your comms request is denied with a burst of obsolete EW malware.
entries.zh: 你的通讯请求被一股过时的电子战恶意软件的爆发所阻断。

entries.en: Bornanew places his hands together, and turns back to Pond.
entries.zh: Bornanew 双手并拢，然后转身面向 Pond。

entries.en:
"This was before," Pond says. "His people are still... they're everywhere. They'll kill me."

He looks at Bornanew hopefully. "You said you'd keep me safe. As a Knight."

$global.jethroName closes his eyes and sighs.
entries.zh:
"之前不是这样，" Pond 说道，"他的人仍然... 他们无处不在。他们会杀了我。"

他满怀期望的看着 Bornanew。"你说过你会保证我的安全，作为一名骑士。"

$global.jethroName 叹息着闭上了眼。

entries.en:
"This," Pond coughs violently, holding his throat, "-before. Pathers... everywhere. Kill me."

He looks at you fearfully after a glance at Bornanew. "... help me."
entries.zh:
"这，" Pond 剧烈咳嗽着，一边捂住了喉咙，"—— 之前。左径分子...到处都是。杀了我。"

他瞥了一眼 Bornanew 后便惊恐地望向你。"...救救我。"

entries.en:
Bornanew looks at you, then to Pond. His expression softens, just a little.

"Captain," he says. "They will kill him for his failure. And not well. Let me turn him over to the Knights. They will offer him a path to redemption, harsh though it may be."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 看了看你，又看向 Pond，他的表情略微缓和下来。

"舰长，" 他说，"他们会因他的失败而处决他，而且手段不会仁慈。请让我将他移交给骑士团，他们会给予他一条赎罪之路，尽管可能十分严苛。"

o.en: As you like, $global.jethroName. Pond is your responsibility.
o.zh: 如你所愿，$global.jethroName，Pond 由你负责。

o.en: No. Pond earned his own fate and I'll have it no other way.
o.zh: 不，Pond 是自食其果，我不会放过他的。

entries.en:
Bornanew looks at you, then to Pond.

There's an edge in his expression that you had not seen before.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 看了看你，又看向 Pond。

他神情中透出一种你前所未见的锋芒。

entries.en:
"This was before," Pond says. "His people are still... they're everywhere. They'll kill me."

He looks at you hopefully. "You've got to help me."
entries.zh:
"之前不是这样，" Pond 说到。"他的人仍然... 他们无处不在。他们会杀了我。"

他满怀期待地看着你，"你得帮帮我。"

entries.en:
Bornanew looks at you, then to Pond. Then speaks.

"I shall bring you to an agent of the Knights of Ludd. You shall confess all your sins, beginning first with that of heresy. They shall assign your penance."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 看了看你，又看向 Pond，随后开口道。

"我将带你面见一位卢德骑士团的代理人。你必须忏悔所有罪孽，首当其冲的便是异端之罪。他们会裁定你的赎罪。"

entries.en:
Bornanew looks at you, then to Pond. Then he speaks.

"I shall bring you to an agent of the Knights of Ludd. You shall confess all your sins, beginning first with that of heresy. They shall assign your penance, and it will be as harsh as you deserve."

"But you will live."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 看了看你，又看向 Pond，随后开口道。

"我将带你面见一位卢德骑士团的代理人。你必须忏悔所有罪孽，首当其冲的便是异端之罪。他们会裁定你的赎罪，其严苛程度将与你犯下的罪过相称。"

"但你会活下来。"

entries.en: Pond looks stricken, but he nods. "Yes, I... I'll do that. Menes. He is a kind man."
entries.zh: Pond 面色惨白，但还是点了点头说："好，我...我会去的。Menes，他是个...仁慈的人。"

o.en: Get out of here. And if you don't tell Menes, I will.
o.zh: 滚出去。另外，如果你不去告诉 Menes 的话，那就由我来。

entries.en: Pond looks stricken, but he nods. "Yes." Another cough. "Menes, kind."
entries.zh: Pond 面色惨白，但还是点了点头说："好的。" 他又咳了一声，"Menes，好人。"

o.en: Get out of here. And if you don't tell Menes, I will.
o.zh: 滚出去。另外，如果你不去告诉 Menes 的话，那就由我来。

entries.en: Pond looks stricken, but he nods. "Yes, I... I'll do that. Menes will understand why I had to do... what I had to do."
entries.zh: Pond 面色惨白，但还是点了点头说："好，我...我会去的。Menes 会理解我为何不得不...去做那些事。"

o.en: Get out of here. And if you don't tell Menes, I will.
o.zh: 滚出去。另外，如果你不去告诉 Menes 的话，那就由我来。

entries.en: Pond looks stricken, but he nods. "Yes. Menes." Another cough. "Will understand."
entries.zh: Pond 面色惨白，但还是点了点头说："好的。Menes，" 他又咳了一声，"会理解的。"

o.en: Get out of here. And if you don't tell Menes, I will.
o.zh: 滚出去。另外，如果你不去告诉 Menes 的话，那就由我来。

o.en: Go to Menes. Confess. He's fool enough to forgive you.
o.zh: 去向 Menes 坦白吧。他够蠢，会原谅你的。

o.en: Go to Menes. Confess. He's kind enough to forgive you.
o.zh: 去向 Menes 坦白吧。他够仁慈，会原谅你的。

o.en: $global.jethroName, will the Knights take this man?
You did this to yourself. Now deal with it.
o.zh: 这都是你咎由自取的，现在自己收拾残局吧。

entries.en:
The clerk clears her throat.

"Excubitor Orbis," her eyes dart at you and Bornanew. "$playerSirOrMadam. Novice."

"There is a matter of the Demarchon of Olinadu. A Menes Yaribay? He claims he was promised payments for the, um, purchase of a relic."

You hadn't thought Oak could look any more displeased.
entries.zh:
文书清了清嗓子。

"行星教卫大人，" 她的目光在你和 Bornanew 之间游移，"这位是 $playerSirOrMadam，以及见习修士。"

"有一件关于 Olinadu 统领的事。一位名叫 Menes Yaribay 的人？他声称有人承诺为一笔，呃，圣物交易支付款项。"

你认为 Oak 的脸色已经不可能再更难看了。

entries.en:
The clerk coughs, "We, ah," she flips a page on a paper notebook.

"While the Church does not recognize the purchase of,  um," her eyes flicker to the crucible, which has stopped glowing, but ticks away as it cools. "The object in question. However, due to the promise made by a... representative," she looks quickly at Bornanew, then away. "It was proposed that a... polite settlement with Mister Yaribay be made using the reward credits originally authorized by the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis..."

"Do it," says the Excubitor Orbis.

You can't quite see if Bornanew is blushing, because his head is bowed toward Oak.
entries.zh:
文书轻咳一声，"我们，呃，" 她翻动纸质笔记本的一页。

"尽管教会并不认可这笔，嗯，" 她的目光飘向熔炉，而后者已停止发光，但在冷却时仍发出着嘀嗒的轻响，"所涉物品的交易。然而，鉴于某位...代表曾作出承诺，" 她迅速瞥了 Bornanew 一眼，随即移开了视线，"故建议使用...宗师大人 Jaspis 最初批准的任务赏金与 Yaribay 先生达成一项体面的和解方案..."

"那就这么办。" 行星教卫说道。

你不太确定 Bornanew 是否已经面红耳赤了，因为他正低头面向 Oak。

However, due to the promise made by a... representative," she looks quickly at Bornanew, then away. "Do it," says the Excubitor Orbis.

"那就这么办。" 行星教卫说道。

entries.en:
The clerk shuffles nervously, flipping open a notebook, pausing a moment, then flipping it closed. She looks at the Excubitor Orbis.

He nods at her, then looks back to you.
entries.zh:
文书紧张地整理着文件，一边翻开了笔记本，但在停顿片刻后又将其合上了。她看向了行星教卫。

他对她点头示意，随后将目光转回到你身上。

o.en: We've delivered the false relic and destroyed its source.
o.zh: 我们已经上交了伪造圣物并摧毁了其源头。

o.en: I believe this fulfills Novice Bornanew's 'quest' of penance.
o.zh: 我认为这已经完成了见习修士 Bornanew 的赎罪 '任务'。

entries.en:
"I t-think that's everything," the clerk says, looking between you and Oak.

Excubitor Orbis Gideon Oak exhales, meeting your gaze. Then, without a word, he turns away and begins walking back to the far doorway casting its long wedge of light into the armored hangar.

After a respectful pause, the clerk and guards rush to follow.
entries.zh:
"我...我想就这些了，" 文书说道，目光在你和 Oak 之间游移。

行星教卫 Gideon Oak 长吁一口气，一边与你眼神交汇。随后一言不发地转身走向门口，一道漫长的楔形光柱自门扉投射进装甲机库。

在片刻恭敬的停顿后，文书与守卫们也匆忙跟了上去。

The clerk clears her throat.

"Excubitor Orbis," her eyes dart at you and Bornanew. "$playerSirOrMadam. Novice."

"There is a matter of the Demarchon of Olinadu. A Menes Yaribay? He claims damages from an... incident. He claims that a valuable object was stolen during a violent raid on his personal compound. And, um, there is a list of potential suspects..."

You hadn't thought Oak could look any more displeased.

"行星教卫大人，" 她的目光在你和 Bornanew 之间游移，"这位是 $playerSirOrMadam，以及见习修士。"

"有一件关于 Olinadu 统领的事。一位名叫 Menes Yaribay 的人？他声称自己因某起...事件而遭受损失。他声称在其私人庄园遭暴力劫掠时，有一件贵重物品被盗，而且，呃，还有一份潜在嫌疑人名单..."

你认为 Oak 的脸色已经不可能再更难看了。

The clerk coughs, "We, ah," she flips a page on a paper notebook.

"While the Church does not recognize the legitimacy of, um," her eyes flicker to the crucible, which has stopped glowing, but ticks away as it cools. "The object in question. It was proposed that a... polite settlement of affairs with Mister Yaribay be made using the reward credits originally authorized by the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis for..."

"Do it," says the Excubitor Orbis.

You can't quite see if Bornanew is blushing, because his head is bowed toward Oak.

"那就这么办。" 行星教卫说道。
