entries.en:
Bornanew lets out a breath.

"You must not," he looks worried. "Setting aside... objections of the heart, complete destruction would almost certainly destroy the evidence required to identify the agent of the Path who has infiltrated the Cathedral of Holy Exodus."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 长吁一口气。

"你绝不能如此，" 他面露忧色，"暂且不说...内心的抗拒，彻底的摧毁行动几乎必然会销毁指认渗透 Exodus 神圣大教堂的左径内应所需的证据。"

o.en: You've given me a lot to think about.
o.zh: 你给了我很多思考的方向。

o.en: You suggest that leniency will prompt cooperation? From Pathers?
o.zh: 你认为宽恕能促成合作？左径分子会配合？

o.en: Archcurate Jaspis seems less forgiving of Pathers than you.
o.zh: 大祭司 Jaspis 对左径分子可似乎没你那么宽容。

o.en: If I do not prove absolute domination of my enemy, they will not fear me.
o.zh: 如果我不能展现对敌人的绝对压制，他们便不会畏惧我

entries.en: He raises an eyebrow at your noncommittal response, but nods acceptance, hands clasped.
entries.zh: 他对你这模棱两可的回答挑了下眉，但还是双手合十，点头应允了。

entries.en: "I do," he says. "They are merely human, as are we all. Despite a history written in blood, I do not find that our species thrives on hatred."
entries.zh: "确实，" 他说道，"他们也只是凡人，与我们无异。尽管我们的历史浸透鲜血，但我并不认为仇恨能促使我们这类生灵的走向繁盛。"

o.en: You've given me a lot to think about.
o.zh: 你给了我很多思考的方向。

o.en: I shall do as you ask - so far as is possible.
o.zh: 我将尽力按你所请行事 —— 在可行的范围内。

o.en: If they force me to, I will do what is necessary.
o.zh: 如果情况迫不得已，我会采取必要的手段。

o.en: Archcurate Jaspis seems less forgiving of Pathers than you.
o.zh: 大祭司 Jaspis 对左径分子可似乎没你那么宽容。

entries.en: He nods acceptance, thankful, with hands clasped.
entries.zh: 他点头接受，神情感激，双手始终合十。

entries.en:
Bornanew takes a long breath. His eyes are dark, reflecting red pinpoints from the display.

"Doubtless such destruction would send an uncompromising message to these heretics who attempt to sew schism in the fields of the Mother Church. But." He raises his hand as if to grasp at his argument. "Total obliteration poses a serious risk of destroying the evidence needed to track down the agent of the Path who has infiltrated the Cathedral of Holy Exodus. We need those data stores."

He pauses, then turns to you. "Find the data first, through a marine raid, or some subterfuge. Then destroy the station. All would be served justice thus."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 深吸一口气。他眼眸深暗，倒映着显示屏上的红色光点。

"如此的毁灭无疑会向那些试图在教会母亲的田园中播撒分裂的异端传递毫不妥协的信息。但是，" 他举起手，仿佛要抓住自己的论点，"彻底的摧毁极有可能销毁追查渗透 Exodus 神圣大教堂的左径内应所需的证据，我们需要那些数据存储单元。"

他停顿片刻，随后转向你，"先通过陆战队劫掠或某种计策夺取数据，再摧毁空间站，如此方可伸张全部的正义。"

o.en: I expected more talk of leniency from you, $global.jethroName.
o.zh: 我还期待你多谈谈宽大处理呢，$global.jethroName。

o.en: I believe that Archcurate Jaspis would approve of this 'message'.
o.zh: 我相信大祭司 Jaspis 会赞同这条 '消息'。

entries.en:
"Indeed." He casts his gaze up and far away. "I thought her harsh, before. Cynicism of age. But I see now with the eyes of a man."

"And I, for my part, made the choice to trust you." He looks to you.

"So, captain, the path is yours. I shall follow." He clasps his hands together, bowing his head slightly.
entries.zh:
"确实如此。"他抬眼望向远处，"我曾以为她相当苛刻，有一种年龄滋生的愤世嫉俗。但如今我已经能以成人之眼再度看待。"

"而我，做出了信任你的选择。" 他看向你。

"所以，舰长，道途由你抉择。我自当追随。" 他双手合十，微微颔首。

entries.en:
"Perhaps. Though alongside their fear, you will earn their hate, and confirm in their minds all they say of you," he says. "You may well leave eternal enemies in your wake."

"Or corpses, I suppose," he adds grimly.
entries.zh:
"或许如此。不过除了恐惧，你还会受到他们的憎恨，并让他们心中关于你的所有传言都得到印证，" 他说，"或许，你将在身后留下永恒的敌人。"

"又或许，你会留下遍地尸骸，" 他阴沉地补充道。

o.en: You've given me a lot to think about.
o.zh: 你给了我很多思考的方向。

o.en: Archcurate Jaspis seems less forgiving of Pathers than you.
o.zh: 大祭司 Jaspis 对左径分子可似乎没你那么宽容。

o.en: I'll just win the battle without hurting anyone, is that what you want?
o.zh: 你的意思是让我在不伤及任何人的情况下取胜？

o.en: If they force me to, I will do what is necessary.
o.zh: 如果情况迫不得已，我会采取必要的手段。

entries.en:
"Indeed." He casts his gaze up and far away. "Let not the sins of our mothers..." he says quietly, then looks back to you.

"Take my words not as judgment, but as a personal... a prayer, I suppose. Whatever her words, whatever her actions, she did choose to entrust her support to me in this, my task. And I, for my part, chose to trust you."

"So, captain, the path is yours." He drops his gaze and clasps his hands together.
entries.zh:
"确实如此。" 他抬眼望向远方。"莫让母辈之罪..." 他轻声说着，目光回到你身上。

"请别把我的话当作评判，而是一种私人...祈愿吧。无论她说了什么，做了什么，她确实选择在这件事上支持我。而我，也选择信任你。"

"所以，舰长，道途由你抉择。" 他垂下眼帘，双手合十。

entries.en:
He raises a skeptical eyebrow at you, but nods, hands clasped.

"I'd like nothing more, captain. Truly."
entries.zh:
他挑起眉毛，带着几分怀疑看着你，但还是点了点头，双手合十。

"我别无所求，舰长。真的。"

entries.en:
"In truth, it is not," he says. "I shan't ask the impossible."

He clasps his hands together. "I trust you will achieve what you must, how you must."
entries.zh:
"事实上，情况不会如此，"他说，"我不会强求不可能的事情。"

他双手合十。"我相信你会以必须的方式，达成必须的目标。"

entries.en: He raises a skeptical eyebrow at you, but nods, hands clasped.
entries.zh: 他挑起眉毛，带着几分怀疑看着你，但还是点了点头，双手合十。

entries.en:
"Did you?" he asks.

"You have made virtue of using a swift and strong hand in such matters. A Knight must learn to harden his heart when the situation calls for such... efficacy."
entries.zh:
"你真这么想吗？" 他问道。

"你向来擅长在此类事务中展现迅捷而强硬的手腕。一位骑士必须学会铁石心肠，当情势需要这种...效率时，"

o.en: So, how do you think we should approach this one?
o.zh: 那么，你认为我们该如何应对此事？

o.en: Shall we ask nicely how they did it?
o.zh: 难道我们该客客气气地问他们是怎么做到的？

o.en: These are fanatics. They'd sooner die than talk.
o.zh: 这些都是狂信徒，他们宁死也不会开口的。

o.en: We could simply blast this station apart and sift the wreckage for datastores and prisoners.
o.zh: 我们大可直接将这座空间站炸成碎片，再从残骸里筛找数据存储单元和俘虏。

o.en: 'Carefully," isn't enough. You suggest we talk to them?
o.zh: '谨慎行事' 可不够，你是建议我们和他们谈判？

o.en: I shall proceed with the operation.

entries.en: Bornanew lowers his head for just a moment, mumbling a short prayer to himself, then leaves the bridge to you and your officers.
entries.zh: Bornanew 垂首片刻，喃喃自语着简短的祷词，随后将舰桥留给你和你的军官们。

entries.en:
"Carefully," Bornanew says, turning to you. "As ever. Violence is among the tools of the Knight, but it must be that: a tool, not an end unto itself, 'lest it fill my heart with wrath, my soul with hate, to thereafter leave no home for love of the Creator, nor the Word.'"

Is that part of a credo of the Knights of Ludd? It isn't one you've heard before.
entries.zh:
"谨慎行事，" Bornanew 说道，一边转向你，"就像过去那样。暴力虽然是骑士的手段之一，但它必须仅止于此：仅作为工具，而非目的本身，'以免怒火充斥我心，憎恨浸染我魂，从此再无敬爱造物主与圣言的容身之处。'"

这是卢德骑士团信条的一部分吗？你此前未曾听闻这般教诲。

entries.en:
"Decisively," Bornanew says, turning to you. "You have taught me that much. Violence is among a Knight's tools, and I must not cower from its use."

"A marine raid to seize datastores, comms buffers, and prisoners. Then the nanoforge and all of its support equipment should be destroyed."
entries.zh:
"果断行动，" Bornanew 说道，一边转向你，"你教会了我这一点。暴力是骑士的工具之一，我绝不能畏缩不前。"

"派遣陆战队劫掠夺取数据存储单元、通讯缓冲区及俘虏。随后摧毁纳米锻炉及其全部的辅助设备。"

entries.en:
"You cannot truly know until you ask," says Bornanew, choosing to entertain your presumed levity. "The Creator gave even the Path free will, and I would accept peaceable surrender if given."

He turns to you. "And violence is among the tools of a Knight, but it must be that: a tool, not an end unto itself, 'lest it fill my heart with wrath, my soul with hate, to thereafter leave no home for love of the Creator, nor the Word.'"

"Consider: a marine raid to seize datastores and comms buffers. Then," he examines the tactical display, "you have demolitions experts? The nanoforge and all of its support equipment must be destroyed."
entries.zh:
"不问便不得真知，" Bornanew 说道，他选择配合你那份戏谑的语气，"造物主甚至赐予左径自由意志，若对方选择和平投降，我自当接受。"

他转向你，说道："而暴力虽然是骑士的手段之一，但它必须仅止于此：仅作为工具，而非目的本身，'以免怒火充斥我心，憎恨浸染我魂，从此再无敬爱造物主与圣言的容身之处。'"

"试想：派遣陆战队劫掠夺取数据存储单元与通讯缓冲区。随后，" 他审视着战术界面，"你麾下有爆破专家吧？必须摧毁纳米锻炉及其全部的辅助设备。"

entries.en:
Bornanew gives you a weary look.

"You may jest, and I understand your need." He turns back to the tactical display. "However I shan't close my eyes to the nature of my duty; you have taught me that much. Violence is among a Knight's tools, and I must not cower from its use."

"Consider: a marine raid to seize datastores, comms buffers, and prisoners. Then, you have demolitions experts? The nanoforge and all of its support equipment must be destroyed."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 向你投来疲惫的一瞥。

"你或许在开玩笑，我也理解你的需求。" 他转回战术界面前，"但我不会对自身职责的本质视而不见；你教会了我这一点。暴力是骑士的工具之一，我绝不能畏缩不前。"

"试想：派遣陆战队劫掠夺取数据存储单元、通讯缓冲区及俘虏。随后，你麾下有爆破专家吧？必须摧毁纳米锻炉及其全部的辅助设备。"

entries.en:
"Perhaps," says Bornanew. "But do not let the fearsome reputation sown by the Luddic Path blind you to what they truly are - human. Fearful and fallible as you or I."

"They might be convinced to reveal something. Or if you can acquire comms buffers, they may prove illuminating." He looks at you, "I believe there is a mole, an agent loyal to the Path within the Holy Cathedral of Exodus with access to the vaults. I need to narrow down my list of suspects."

"To say nothing of destroying this nanoforge and any data on the glove held in datacores." He considers a moment, then says "Metadata from the scan of the glove may be useful, also."
entries.zh:
"或许如此，" Bornanew 说道，"但别让 卢德左径 散播的凶名蒙蔽你对其本质的认知 —— 他们也是凡人，与你我一样充满恐惧与过失。"

"或许能说服他们透露些什么。或者如果你能弄到通讯缓冲区，或许会有突破性发现。" 他看着你，"我相信内应是存在的 —— 一个效忠左径、能接触圣库的代理人潜伏在 Exodus 神圣大教堂内。我需要缩小嫌疑人的范围。"

"更不必说必须摧毁这座纳米锻炉及数据核心中所有关于手套的资料。" 他思索片刻，继续补充道，"手套扫描的元数据或许也有用处。

entries.en:
"Of that I admit I have little doubt." Bornanew gives you a weary look.

He turns back to the tactical display. "I shan't close my eyes to the nature of my duty; you have taught me that much. Violence is among a Knight's tools, and I must not cower from its use."

"Consider: a marine raid to seize datastores, comms buffers, and prisoners. Then... you have demolitions experts? The nanoforge and all of its support equipment must be destroyed."
entries.zh:
"这一点我确实毫不怀疑。" Bornanew 向你投来疲惫的一瞥。

他转回战术界面前，"我不会对自身职责的本质视而不见；你教会了我这一点。暴力是骑士的工具之一，我绝不能畏缩不前。"

"试想：派遣陆战队劫掠夺取数据存储单元、通讯缓冲区及俘虏。随后...你麾下有爆破专家吧？必须摧毁纳米锻炉及其全部的辅助设备。"

entries.en:
"I apologize for dissembling," he looks down for a moment, then back to you. "Talk? Perhaps," he says.

"Don't let the fearsome reputation of the Luddic Path blind you to what they are - as human and fallible as you or I. We were given free will, and I would accept peaceable surrender if it were given."

"That is unlikely, however. Consider: a marine raid to seize datastores and comms buffers. Then... you have demolitions experts? The nanoforge itself must be destroyed."
entries.zh:
"我为之前的隐晦致歉，" 他低头片刻，随即又看向你，"谈判？或许可行，" 他说道。

"但别让 卢德左径 散播的凶名蒙蔽你对其本质的认知 —— 他们与你我一样是凡人，也会犯错。我们都被赋予了自由意志，若他们愿意投降，我会接受和平解决。"

"但这可能性微乎其微。试想：派遣陆战队劫掠夺取数据存储单元与通讯缓冲区，随后...你麾下有爆破专家吧？纳米锻炉本身也必须被摧毁。"

entries.en:
He thinks for a moment.

"I pray it is so. It would require some exceptional ruse or the charisma of a pr- no, let me not blaspheme by saying it. But you understand that it is, as I believe spacers say, 'a long shot'."
entries.zh:
他沉吟片刻。

"我祈愿如此。但这需要非凡的计策，又或是感召力能够堪比先 —— 不，恕我僭越，不当妄言。但你也明白，用太空行话来说，这件事 '希望渺茫'。"

entries.en:
He thinks for a moment, a dark look threatening to grow.

"I pray it is so. But these are heretics, poisoned by a false Word and a dark Path. It would require some exceptional ruse or the charisma of a pr- no, let me not blaspheme by saying it. But you understand that it is, as I believe spacers say, 'a long shot'."

He contemplates the tactical display for a moment. "As well, there is something to be said for the element of surprise."
entries.zh:
他沉思片刻，阴郁之色逐渐浮现。

"我祈愿如此。但这些是异端，被虚假的圣言与黑暗之道所毒害。这需要非凡的计策，又或是感召力能够堪比先 —— 不，恕我僭越，不当妄言。但你也明白，用太空行话来说，这件事 '希望渺茫'。"

他凝视战术界面片刻，又说道："况且，突袭本身也有其战术价值。"

entries.en: Bornanew is conscious, you are told. You chief medical officer warns you against unnecessary stress; the healing process is fragile.
entries.zh: 你被告知 Bornanew 已恢复意识。你的医疗主管提醒你最好避免不必要的压力；康复过程仍十分脆弱。

entries.en: Bornanew joins you on your flagship's bridge. Tactical gives him a skeptical look.
entries.zh: Bornanew 登上了你旗舰的舰桥，战术军官向他投去了怀疑的一瞥。

o.en: We're going to break these Pathers wide open.
o.zh: 我们要彻底粉碎这帮左径分子。

entries.en: He bows his head, hands clasped.
entries.zh: 他垂下头，双手合十。

entries.en: He raises an eyebrow, then takes in your bridge crew.
entries.zh: 他挑了挑眉，随后打量起你的舰桥船员。

entries.en:
"Captain," he says. "We are here to find out who gave the Luddic Path a detailed scan of the original glove." He nods toward the display of the station, "There will be comms buffers and, somewhere, a datacore of the glove scan - with metadata." The display bristles with weapons emplacements highlighted by tactical overlays.

"And we are here to eliminate their ability to produce another false relic." He looks distant, and speaks "'Hammer in one hand, sword in the other, I pray to see it done.'"
entries.zh:
"舰长，" 他说，"我们来此是为了查明谁向卢德左径提供了原版手套的详细扫描数据。" 他朝空间站的全息示意屏点头示意，"通讯缓冲区里会有线索，而某个地方必然存放着手套扫描的数据核心 —— 连同元数据。" 屏幕上布满了被战术覆盖图高亮标注的武器阵列。

"并且，我们也要彻底摧毁他们制造另一件伪造圣物的能力，" 他的目光变得缥缈，一边低声念道，"'一手执锤，一手持剑，唯愿功成。'"

entries.en:
You decide to let Bornanew rest. You've got this.

All you need to do is beg, trick, or force the Pathers to reveal the source of their scan of the original glove. That glove has somehow remained, presumably untouched, in the vault of the Holy Cathedral of Exodus back on Tartessus this whole time.

Pathers are not known for keeping good digital records, but to nanoforge a copy of the glove, they would have had to. There may be metadata still in the computer systems connected to the nanoforge.

Or someone who simply knows the answers which you seek.
entries.zh:
你决定让 Bornanew 先休息，让这里交给你处理。

你只需设法乞求、哄骗或逼迫左径分子透露他们获取原版手套扫描数据的源头。那副手套始终保存在 Tartessus 的 Exodus 神圣大教堂圣库中，想必一直未被触动。

周所周知，左径分子向来不会妥善保存数字记录，但若要纳米锻造手套的复制品，他们将不得不留存数据。与纳米锻炉相连的计算机系统中或许仍存有元数据。

又或者，你可以直接找到知晓答案的人。

entries.en:
A cloud of icons, sigils, words forms. Names, front companies, ships, codewords, and references to theological agitprop. Bornanew follows closely, his hands not nearly as deft with the interface as your dedicated techs.

You can see in his body language the exact moment that he finds something he recognizes.
entries.zh:
图标、徽记、文字如层云般涌现 —— 姓名、空壳公司、舰船、密码，以及神学煽动宣传的引述。Bornanew 目不转睛，虽然他操作界面的手法远不如你的专职技术员娴熟。

你能从他身体语言中精准捕捉到他认出某条信息的瞬间。

entries.en:
"Keepfaith," Bornanew says. Fumbling with his datapad, the shared workspace highlights all references to that string of letters, then focuses, arranging comms logs and metadata into blocks, compressing everything else down into unobtrusive corners.

He leans back, his eyes darting around some internal catalogue. His paper notebook appears in his hands and he flips to a page as if to check something.
entries.zh:
"Keepfaith，" Bornanew 说道。他笨拙地操作着数据平板，共享工作区随即高亮显示了所有包含该字串的引用，继而聚焦排列出通讯日志与元数据区块，将其余内容压缩至不显眼的角落。

他向后靠去，目光快速扫视着某种内部目录。纸质笔记本突然出现在他手中，他翻动书页，仿佛在核对着什么。

entries.en:
"Cedra Keepfaith," he explains. "A subcurate of the Holy Cathedral of Exodus on Tartessus, in the Eos Exodus system. She has authority over the scriptorium."

He sees your look, then explains. "Books. They repair and reproduce books for the library. And," his voice drops, "the vaults. She would have access."
entries.zh:
"Cedra Keepfaith，" 他解释道，"Tartessus Exodus 神圣大教堂的助理祭司，隶属于 Eos Exodus 星系，她掌管着文书院。"

他观察着你的神色，一边继续说明："书籍，他们为图书馆修复和复刻典籍。而且，" 他压低声音，"包括圣库，她具备进入的权限。"

o.en: So this Keepfaith is your Pather mole?
o.zh: 所以这个 Keepfaith 就是你们那儿的左径内应？

entries.en:
"She would fit," he says, thinking. "My impression was that her ambitions in the Church have not been satisfied for many years, be that fair or no. She was not humble upon our meeting."

"These logs appear to reference correspondence with her. She turned down credits, it appears. Would gratification of spite be payment enough?"

He turns to you, done with speculation. "Certainly she did not act alone, but this connects her to the act. She must be arrested and taken to the Inquisitors for investigation and judgment."
entries.zh:
"她很符合，" 他沉吟道，"我的印象是她在教会中的抱负多年来未得满足，不论这是否公平。她既不谦逊，也不愿妥协。"

"这些日志似乎提及了与她的通信往来。她拒绝了金钱报酬，难道她只想满足自己的怨恨吗？"

他转向你，结束了推测。"她绝非单独行动，但这些证据足以证明她已参与其中。必须逮捕她，并将她移交给审判官进行调查与审判。"

entries.en:
A junior officer pokes their head into the briefing room, "$PlayerSirOrMadam, my apologies. The chief thought you'd want to see this."

Two burly salvors, still in their sweaty suit-liners, haul a crate and set it on the deckplates with a solid thump. With an impish grin, one of them looses the catches and together they pull the top-cover away.

It's filled with work-gloves. All of like chirality.
entries.zh:
一名下级军官探头进入简报室，"$PlayerSirOrMadam，抱歉打扰，但长官认为您会想看看这个的。"

两名身材魁梧、还穿着汗湿内衬服的打捞员拖着一个板条箱，将它 "咚" 地一声搁在甲板上。其中一人带着顽劣的笑容松开搭扣，两人随即一同掀开了顶盖。

箱子里装满了工作手套，全部像是从同一只手上摘下来的一样。

entries.en:
Bornanew lets out a breath.

"I ought to have anticipated this." He sounds annoyed with himself. "Costs no more to run a batch of one than of..." He reaches in, picking up a glove, then pressing into the cargo container to feel for density. "Five-twelve?" He turns to you. "Perhaps five hundred eleven, without our other hard-won specimen?"

He wipes his hands, as if something unpleasant had got on them. "These will need to be destroyed."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 呼出一口气。

"我早该料到这点。" 他的语气里带着自责，"生产单只手套的成本基本等同于批量生产..." 他伸手取出一只手套，又探进货柜里按了按以感知密度。"512 只？" 他转向你，"或许是 511 只，除去我们费尽心思缴获的那份样本之外？"

他擦了擦手，仿佛沾上了什么不洁之物一般。"这些必须全部销毁。"

entries.en:
It is done with swift enthusiasm by a crew monitored by your ops chief.

The last step is the capture of Bornanew's mole on Tartessus.
entries.zh:
在你的行动长官的监督下，船员们以迅猛的热情完成了任务。

最后一步是前往 Tartessus 逮捕 Bornanew 所指认的内应。

entries.en:
A cloud of icons, sigils, words forms. Names, front companies, ships, codewords, and references to theological agitprop. Your tech officer's hands blur as they manipulate an interface invisible to you; his subtle cybermods blink rapidly. And then stop, steady.

"Captain, we may have something."

Their eyes refocus on the real world again, taking a moment to adapt to mundanity. "Something for your, ah, consultant. The Knight."
entries.zh:
图标、徽记、文字如层云般涌现 —— 姓名、空壳公司、舰船、密码，以及神学煽动宣传的引述。你的技术军官的双手在不可见的界面上飞速操作，他那精密的赛博改造体闪烁着高速的光点。随后停顿，归于稳定。

"舰长，我们可能有所发现。"

他的目光重新聚焦回现实世界，稍作适应后才继续说。"有些信息或许适合你的，呃，顾问。就是那位骑士。"

entries.en:
"A word. Maybe a code? A name? It comes up several times, relating to Tartessus and the template they fed into the forge."

"The word is 'Keepfaith'. One word. Maybe it means something special to the Ludd... ics?"
entries.zh:
"一个单词。或许是暗号？人名？它多次出现，与 Tartessus 和他们输入锻炉的模板数据都有所关联。"

"这个词是 'Keepfaith'。一个单词，可能对卢德...教徒有特殊的含义？"

o.en: Clean up some representative samples for me.
o.zh: 替我理出一些代表性的样本。

entries.en:
"Aye, $playerSirOrMadam," they reply, and their eyes become unfocused, face slack, cybermods blinking rapidly once more.

You turn, bracing yourself for a negotiation with your medical chief to allow a brief conversation with Bornanew.
entries.zh:
"遵命，$playerSirOrMadam，" 他们回应道，随即目光再次涣散，面容也松弛下来，赛博改造体重新开始高速闪烁。

你转过身，准备与医疗主管交涉，争取与 Bornanew 进行简短对话的机会。

entries.en:
"Keepfaith," Bornanew says, repeating the last word of your question.

He leans back in his bed, his eyes darting around some internal catalogue. His notebook appears in his hands - it is impressive to have snuck an outside object past the wary eye of your senior medical officer - and he flips to a page to check something.

"Subcurate Cedra Keepfaith. Authority over the scriptorium of the Holy Cathedral of Exodus, on Tartessus, in the Eos Exodus system."
entries.zh:
"Keepfaith，" Bornanew 重复着你问题中的最后一个词。

他向后靠在病床上，目光快速扫视着某种内部目录。笔记本突然出现在他的手中 —— 能避开你资深医疗官的警觉视线将外部物品带进来可实属不易 —— 他翻动书页核对内容。

"助理祭司 Cedra Keepfaith，她掌管着 Eos Exodus 星系 Tartessus Exodus 神圣大教堂的文书院。"

entries.en: "Apologies," he says, closing the notebook, then tapping its cover. "Books. They repair and reproduce books for the library. And," his voice drops, "the vaults. She would have access."
entries.zh: "抱歉，" 他合上笔记本，一边轻敲着封面，一边说道，"是书籍，他们为图书馆修复和复刻典籍。而且，" 他压低声音道，"也包括圣库，她具备进入的权限。"

o.en: So this Keepfaith is your Pather mole.
o.zh: 所以这个 Keepfaith 就是你们那儿的左径内应？

entries.en:
"She would fit," he says, thinking. "Her ambitions... were great, and unfulfilled."

"These logs show correspondence. She turned down a payment of credits from the Path." He takes several slow breaths. "Would spite be payment enough for her?"

"Didn't act alone." His eyes close, his breaths coming roughly now. "But she was their access. Must be arrested. Taken to the Inquisitors."

The distinct sound of your chief medical officer clearing their throat sounds from the doorway.
entries.zh:
"她很符合，" 他沉吟道，"她的抱负...曾很宏大，却未得实现。"

"这些日志显示他们存在通信往来，而她拒绝了左径的金钱报酬。" 他缓缓吸了几口气，"难道她只想满足自己的怨恨吗？"

"这并非是单独的行动。" 他闭上眼睛，呼吸也变得粗重，"但她是他们的接触点，必须逮捕她，移交审判官。"

门口不远处传来医疗主管清晰的清嗓声。

o.en: Get some rest. We're going to Tartessus.
o.zh: 抓紧休息吧，我们得去一趟 Tartessus。

entries.en:
It appears to be "Moloch's own luck," as one captured Pather describes it in the aftermath.

Your teams seize comms buffers, datastores, and a demolitions squad reduces the nanoforge to only so much glowing rubble, spilling jets of atmo and feed-gases into space which occasionally ignite in floral bursts amidst the debris.
entries.zh:
这似乎是 "恶魔摩洛克的眷顾"，一名被俘的左径分子在事后如是说。

你的小队控制了通讯缓冲区与数据存储单元，而爆破组已将纳米锻炉化为一片炽热的废墟，大气层与燃料气体喷涌着进入太空，在残骸间不时迸发出花朵般的火焰。

entries.en:
"Your brutality will only prove how far you are from the Word! Our... our deaths will be as martyrs."

You feel as though $hisOrHer heart isn't quite in it, somehow.
entries.zh:
"你的暴行只会证明你离圣言何等遥远！我们...我们的牺牲将成为殉道。"

你却隐约感到$hisOrHer的信念并非那么坚定。

o.en: My capital ships will break your station apart. You have no chance of victory.
o.zh: 我的主力舰会将你们的空间站撕成碎片，你们毫无胜算。

entries.en:
The Pather frowns. "An obvious boast, typical of a Molochian." $HeOrShe makes a show of looking at you through the comms, "You couldn't have taken Sedge. He was a greater warrior than you or I, by far."

"They do say he was shot in the back by a spacer. The low cunning of you people does suggest your capacity for cold-blooded murder."
entries.zh:
左径分子皱起眉头。"虚张声势，典型的摩洛克信徒作风。" $heOrShe刻意透过通讯画面端详着你，"你不可能拿下了 Sedge，他远比你我都更加善战。"

"据说他是被一名太空佬从背后射杀的。你们这些人卑劣狡诈的本性，确实体现出你们冷血谋杀的能力。"

o.en: I killed Wrestling Sedge, and I would kill you without remorse. The choice is yours.
o.zh: 我已经杀了 Wrestling Sedge，并且我在杀你的时候也不会有半分犹豫，自己选吧。

entries.en:
"You persist with that, with that lie," $heOrShe examines you uncertainly.

"Of course, they do say he was shot in the back by a spacer. Maybe the low cunning of your kind makes you capable of such cold-blooded murder."
entries.zh:
"你还在坚持，坚持那个谎言，" $heOrShe将信将疑地审视着你。

"不过，据他们所言，他就是被一名太空佬从背后射杀的。也许你们这类人卑劣狡诈的本性真能让你们使出如此冷血的谋杀手段。"

entries.en: "It is true," $heOrShe says ruefully. "Your name is a curse upon the sector. A harbinger of suffering."
entries.zh: "确实如此，" $heOrShe懊丧地说，"你的名字是这片星域的诅咒，是苦难的先兆。"

o.en: You know of me. My reputation for ruthlessness precedes me.
o.zh: 你知道我的名声，我冷酷无情的作风早已传遍这片星域。

entries.en:
"So it is you," $heOrShe says, brow furrowed. "I had thought... surely not... why, pray, would Providence set such evil upon my Path?"

If anything, $heOrShe looks sad rather than defiant.
entries.zh:
"原来是你，" $heOrShe眉头紧锁，"我还以为...绝不可能是...为何天意将如此邪恶降临于我道？"

若要说有什么变化，$heOrShe此刻的神情更像是悲伤而非反抗。

o.en: I am a great enemy known to all Pathers. How could you doubt my threat?
o.zh: 我是所有左径分子皆知的大敌，你怎敢质疑我的威胁？

entries.en:
And despite your fearsome reputation, you'll let them in on a little secret: it's cheaper, you explain, to accomplish your mission parameters without a fight. Thus the credits you gain, that Mammonite lucre, is ever greater than before.

"I knew it," $heOrShe smirks righteously. "It's always credits in the end with your kind, isn't it."
entries.zh:
尽管你声名可怖，但你却向他们透露了一个小秘密：你解释说，达成任务目标的同时避免战斗会让成本更低。因此你获得的星币 —— 那些玛门之仆的肮脏钱财 —— 将比以往更多。

"我早料到了，" $heOrShe正义凛然地讥笑道，"你们这种人最终总是为了星币，不是吗。"

o.en: Trust that I am mercenary. I'm avoiding a fight to save credits.
o.zh: 你要相信我是个唯利是图之人，而我避免这场战斗也是为了节省星币。

entries.en: Cowed by your brutal posturing, the Pather leader provides you with security codes and your ops team mounts what appears to be a lightning-raid which catches the defenders completely by surprise.
entries.zh: 慑于你凶残的威吓，左径头目交出了安全代码。你的行动小组随即发起一场闪电般的劫掠行动，守军被彻底打了个措手不及。

o.en: Carry out the ruse to seize datastores and destroy the nanoforge
o.zh: 执行佯攻计划，夺取数据存储单元并摧毁纳米锻炉

o.en: My patience with you is spent. (cut comms)
o.zh: 我对你的耐心已经用完了。 (切断通讯)

o.en: I cannot deal with a mad heretic. Pray now for a quick death. (cut comms)
o.zh: 我无法与疯狂的异端交易，即刻祈祷以求个痛快了断吧。 (切断通讯)

entries.en:
You explain that there's one way that this is going to go, no devotion or zealotry can overcome the truth of the power of your $shipOrFleet - all ends result in $hisOrHer annihilation, and that of $hisOrHer followers, and of the station.

$HeOrShe has a choice, you explain. Call it a Molochian bargain, if it makes them feel better. Either this is a major loss of personnel, materiel, and the station, or it can be a minor loss of certain assets for a scheme $heOrShe doesn't even really believe in.

Is $heOrShe so loyal to Sedge's sect that $heOrShe is willing to die for it - even after it's already falling apart?
entries.zh:
你阐明这件事只有一种结局，任何虔诚或狂热都无法与你的$shipOrFleet所代表的真实实力相抗衡 —— 所有结果终将导向$hisOrHer及其追随者，连同这座空间站的一并消亡。

你解释道，$heOrShe仍有一次选择的机会，不妨称之为恶魔摩洛克式的交易，如果这么说能令他们好受些。要么承受人员、物资与空间站的重大损失，要么就仅仅在那个连$heOrShe自己都未必真心认同的阴谋上，付出特定资产的小小代价。

难道$heOrShe对 Sedge 势力的忠诚，竟足以令其甘愿为之赴死 —— 即便该势力早已分崩离析？

entries.en:
"Your lucre..." A troubled look crosses $hisOrHer face, as if $hisOrHer heart isn't in this condemnation.

"You cannot simply buy your path away from perdition. Many a Mammonite has tried before, and they- they are still judged."
entries.zh:
"你的肮脏钱财..." 一抹困扰的神色掠过$hisOrHer的脸庞，仿佛$hisOrHer的谴责并非发自真心。

"你无法靠钱财从永恒的惩罚中买通出路。多少玛门之仆曾尝试过，而他们 —— 他们终将受审。"

o.en: Let's make it easy. I'll give you 50,000 credits to assist your relocation.
o.zh: 不妨让事情简单点。我给你 50,000 星币，帮你换个地方重新开始。

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods, frowning. "Be that as it may, the corrupt seed of heresy lies in your heart. It is no simple matter to remove such a thing. Your path will take you through blood and pain before it can be pure."
entries.zh: $heOrShe点点头，眉头紧锁着说："即便如此，异端的腐化种子已经埋藏在你的心中。要拔除这样的东西绝非易事，你的道路必将历经鲜血与痛苦，才能重归纯净。"

o.en: I have walked the Pilgrim's Path. We may not see eye-to-eye, but I am a fellow walker.
o.zh: 我曾行走于朝圣者之路。我们或许见解不同，但我亦是循道同袍。

entries.en: "So it is known," $heOrShe says with a sigh. "You... confound me. Your cooperation with a goon of the Knights, a bully and torturer of a false light... I try to see some greater Plan in it, but I cannot."
entries.zh: "这确实人尽皆知，" $heOrShe叹道，"你...令我困惑。你竟与骑士团的打手合作，那些虚假之光之下的暴徒与施虐者...我试图从中窥见某种更宏大的计划，却无能为力。"

o.en: I have walked the Path. I support your cause, in the end, even if you don't believe it.
o.zh: 我曾行走于卢德之道。我终究支持你们的事业，即便你不相信。

entries.en:
"Yours is a path of blood, but there are those who say your soul is not lost to Perdition."

$HeOrShe glares at you sullenly.

"I did not say I was amongst them."
entries.zh:
"你的道路浸透鲜血，但也有人认为你的灵魂尚未堕入永恒的惩罚。"

$heOrShe阴沉地瞪着你。

"但我可没说过我是其中之一。"

o.en: I have been merciful in my actions, whatever you think of my beliefs.
o.zh: 无论你如何看待我的信仰，我的行动始终秉持仁慈。

entries.en: "How lost you are, and how far from the light." $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head, "If the rumors are true, then perhaps some part of you hears a whisper of the Word. That can be the only explanation."
entries.zh: "你迷失得有多深，离光明又有多远。" $heOrShe摇着头说，"如果传闻属实，或许你心中某个角落仍能听见圣言的微语，这是唯一的解释。"

o.en: Surely my humanitarian reputation precedes me.
o.zh: 想必我人道主义的作风早已传遍这片星域。

entries.en:
"I admit, I have heard word of the one with whom this deal was struck." $HisOrHer brow furrows. "I cannot say I fully understand it, but we are... requested not to harm you, if it is so possible."

The Pather looks up and away for a moment. "This is a strange Path I find myself walking," $heOrShe says, as if to some greater power. "I pray that its truth may be revealed before long..."
entries.zh:
"我承认，我听说过与你达成交易的那个人的名号。" $hisOrHer眉头紧锁，"虽然不能说完全理解，但我们...被要求尽可能避免伤害你。"

左径分子抬眼望向远处片刻。"我正行走在一条奇特的道途上，" $heOrShe说道，仿佛在向某种更高力量诉说，"我祈愿其中的真理能早日昭示..."

o.en: I have given the Path a great gift, and that deal has held.
o.zh: 我曾赠予左径一份大礼，而那项约定至今有效。

entries.en: Cowed by your promises of mercy, the Pather leader provides you with security codes and your ops team mounts what appears to be a lightning-raid which catches the defenders completely by surprise.
entries.zh: 慑于你承诺的宽恕，左径头目交出了安全代码。你的行动小组随即发起一场闪电般的劫掠行动，守军被彻底打了个措手不及。

entries.en: Cowed by your promises of mercy - and, perhaps, your credits - the Pather leader provides you with security codes and your ops team mounts what appears to be a lightning-raid which catches the defenders completely by surprise.
entries.zh: 慑于你承诺的宽恕 —— 或许还有星币的缘故 —— 左径头目交出了安全代码。你的行动小组随即发起一场闪电般的劫掠行动，守军被彻底打了个措手不及。

o.en: Carry out the ruse to seize datastores and destroy the nanoforge
o.zh: 执行佯攻计划，夺取数据存储单元并摧毁纳米锻炉

o.en: My patience is spent. There can be no deal, and that's on you. (cut comms)
o.zh: 我的耐心已经用完了。现在没有交易可言，要怪就怪你自己吧。 (切断通讯)

o.en: Your heresy has corrupted you too far. I pray the infinite accepts you. (cut comms)
o.zh: 你的异端思想已将你腐蚀至深，但愿无限能接纳你。 (切断通讯)

entries.en:
You explain that no devotion or zealotry, however righteous, can overcome the power of your $shipOrFleet, or the others that would follow if you failed to win the day.

Is $heOrShe so loyal to Sedge's plan that $heOrShe is willing to die for it - even after it's fallen apart? Besides, a schism across the whole of the ecumene of the Luddic faith would lead to a sectarian war which could see millions of Faithful dead. And not even for the cause of the Path, but for a falsehood!

$HeOrShe has a choice, you explain. Call it a Molochian bargain. Either this is a major loss of personnel, materiel, and the station, or it can be a minor loss of certain assets - for a failed barbaric scheme $heOrShe doesn't even really believe in.
entries.zh:
你阐明道，无论多么正义的虔诚或狂热，都无法匹敌你麾下$shipOrFleet的威力，又或是在你失利后那些必将接踵而至的其他力量。

难道$heOrShe对 Sedge 计划的忠诚，竟足以令自己甘愿为之赴死 — —即便该计划早已彻底失败？况且，如果卢德信仰的普世教会陷入分裂，将引发一场可能导致数百万信徒丧生的教派战争，而这甚至并非是为了卢德之道的事业，却只是为了一场骗局！

你解释道，$heOrShe仍有一次选择的机会，不妨称之为恶魔摩洛克式的交易。要么承受人员、物资与空间站的重大损失，要么就仅仅在那个连$heOrShe自己都未必真心认同的阴谋上，付出特定资产的小小代价。

entries.en:
You explain that you will require comms buffers and datastores pertaining to Sedge's scheme. You will need the datastores of the nanoforge as well, and must be given access in order to destroy it.

Few need be hurt, if they cooperate; it can be done quickly and without compromising $hisOrHer leadership status if $heOrShe secretly gives you their primary security codes. Blame it on the injection of a semi-sentient computer virus, a 'daemon' of the sort Molochians conjure in their AI-labs.
entries.zh:
你说明自己需要与 Sedge 计划相关的通讯缓冲区和数据存储单元，同时也需要纳米锻炉的数据存储单元，并要求获得访问权限以将其摧毁。

若他们配合，则几乎无人会受伤；若能秘密地提供主安全代码，行动就可以迅速完成，且不会损害$hisOrHer的领导地位。届时完全可以将一切归咎于一种半感知计算机病毒的入侵 —— 那种摩洛克信徒在其 AI 实验室里炮制的 '恶魔' 程序。

o.en: Those are the terms. My wrath is great and won't be long contained.
o.zh: 这些就是条件，我现在火很大，可忍不了太久。

entries.en:
"Why should I trust you - you, who threaten me so?"

$HeOrShe is clearly unhappy with your terms. "You're a slave of not only Mammon and Moloch, but Wrath itself. Suffering is your daily bread."
entries.zh:
"我凭什么信任你 —— 在你如此威胁于我之后？"

$heOrShe显然对你的条件相当不满。"你不仅是恶魔玛门与恶魔摩洛克的奴隶，更是暴怒本身的奴仆。苦难是你的日常食粮。"

entries.en: $HisOrHer eyes are watering, $hisOrHer hands wringing. Just one more push should convince $himOrHer...
entries.zh: $hisOrHer眼眶湿润，双手紧绞。只需再推一把，就能彻底说服$himOrHer...

entries.en:
"Cease your threats!" $HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer head in $hisOrHer hands. "You are a monster out of Hell, and surely that is where I shall find myself for making this deal... but this has gone on long enough. I must protect my people."

"I must accept your terms," $heOrShe says, defeated. "I pray this is the Path."
entries.zh:
"住口，别再威胁了！" $heOrShe将$hisOrHer的脸埋入自己的掌心，"你简直就是从地狱里爬出的怪物，而与你交易的我也终将坠入深渊...但这场闹剧该结束了，我必须保护我的人。"

"我...必须接受你的条件，" $heOrShe颓然道，"愿这仍是卢德之道所指。"

entries.en:
You explain that you will require comms buffers and datastores pertaining to Sedge's scheme. You will need the datastores of the nanoforge, and must be given access in order to destroy it.

No one need be hurt; it can be done quickly, without bloodshed, and without compromising $hisOrHer leadership status if $heOrShe secretly gives you their primary security codes. Blame it on the injection of a semi-sentient computer virus, a 'daemon' of the sort Molochians conjure in their AI-labs.
entries.zh:
你说明自己需要与 Sedge 计划相关的通讯缓冲区和数据存储单元，同时也需要纳米锻炉的数据存储单元，并要求获得访问权限以将其摧毁。

没有人会受伤；若能秘密地提供主安全代码，行动就可以迅速且和平地完成，同时也不会损害$hisOrHer的领导地位。届时完全可以将一切归咎于一种半感知计算机病毒的入侵 —— 那种摩洛克信徒在其 AI 实验室里炮制的 '恶魔' 程序。

o.en: Accept my terms. It is the Path of least harm for all.
o.zh: 接受我的条件，这是对所有人伤害最小的道途。

entries.en: "Why should I trust you to keep your word?" $HeOrShe is clearly unhappy with your terms. "You're no servant of Providence following the holy Word passed to us by Ludd. How can there be light in your heart?"
entries.zh: "我凭什么相信你会信守承诺？" $heOrShe显然对你的条件相当不满。"你并非是上天的仆从，也不曾遵循卢德所传的圣言，你心中怎会有光明？"

entries.en: $HeOrShe looks upon you, face now more open than before, as if almost convinced...
entries.zh: $heOrShe注视着你，神色比先前坦率许多，仿佛已被说动大半...

entries.en:
"Cease, I beg you." $HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer head in $hisOrHer hands. "I pray this is the correct Path, that you are not the monster you appear."

"I must accept your terms," $heOrShe says, "I shall pray for forgiveness. And may any hellfire of this world or the next fall upon myself first and not those I seek to protect."
entries.zh:
"停下，我求你了。" $heOrShe将$hisOrHer的脸埋入自己的掌心，"我祈愿这仍是正确的道途，祈愿你并非表面那般是个狰狞的怪物。"

"我必须接受你的条件，" $heOrShe说道，"我将祈求宽恕。愿现世或来世的任何地狱之火，先降临于我，而非我所求庇护之人。"

entries.en: He nods, awaiting your next decision.
entries.zh: 他点点头，等待你的下一步决定。

entries.en: "Well," Bornanew says from beside you. "Let it not be said that you did not attempt diplomacy."
entries.zh: "也罢，" Bornanew 在你身旁说道，"至少没有人能指责你未曾尝试过外交的手段。"

o.en: I truly hoped that would have gone better.
o.zh: 我真希望刚才的谈话能更顺利些。

o.en: Good. Now we can do this my way.
o.zh: 很好，现在我们可以按我的方式来处理了。

entries.en: Menes is blathering on about something or other while Bornanew pretends to listen.
entries.zh: Menes 喋喋不休地讲着什么，Bornanew 则假装在听。

entries.en: Traffic control is mercifully efficient when arranging transport for a Knight of Ludd.
entries.zh: 在为一位卢德骑士安排通行路线时，交通管制的效率高得令人欣慰。

entries.en:
Before long, Novice Bornanew steps aboard your flagship carrying only a small satchel of his possessions.

Your TriPad pings acknowledgement of a funds transfer from the Church of Galactic Redemption.
entries.zh:
没过多久，见习修士 Bornanew 登上了你的旗舰，只带着一个小挎包，里面装着他的随身物品。

你的 TriPad 发出提示音，确认收到了来自 银河救赎教会 的转账。

o.en: I've ordered an officer's stateroom cleared for you.
o.zh: 我已经下令为你清理了一间军官舱室。

o.en: You'll be given a berth, like any member of the crew.
o.zh: 你会分到一个床位，和其他船员一样。

o.en: You'll be given a berth, like any member of the crew. Penance is penance.
o.zh: 你会分到一个床位，和其他船员一样。苦修就是苦修。

entries.en: Your sensors' officer runs a continuous passive sweep. A certain voluminous and outwardly nondescript station section is putting out a great deal of waste heat. It's not confirmation, but it could suggest an industrial size nanoforge operating at low throughput.
entries.zh: 你的传感器技官持续进行着被动扫描。某个外观普通的庞大空间站区域正释放着大量废热，虽然不能完全肯定，但这可能暗示着一台工业级纳米锻炉正在低负荷运转。

entries.en: "A Mammonite's lie, I expect." $HisOrHer faces twists with contempt. "Look at you, spacer, so far from the light of the Path."
entries.zh: "玛门之仆的谎言罢了。" $hisOrHer的面容因轻蔑而扭曲，"看看你，太空佬，离圣道之光何其遥远。"

entries.en:
"A walker, so you claim. Aye, you are known to us. A minion of the so-called 'Church' which is naught but a shadow of the domain wearing a mask of twisted piety."

$HeOrShe almost looks pitying. "Are you so far gone, so blind to the light, that you cannot see it?"
entries.zh:
"循道者，你自称如此。不错，我们早有耳闻。所谓 '教会' 的爪牙，不过是 人之领 投下的阴影，披着扭曲虔诚的面具。"

$heOrShe几乎露出怜悯之色，"你是否已堕落到如此地步，对光明盲目至此，竟无法看清真相？"

entries.en: "Questions?" $HeOrShe smirks, eyes scanning some intel report. "What questions might a Molochian have? How to more completely suborn the human soul? How to extract ever increasing lucre from sin?"
entries.zh: "疑问？" $heOrShe露出讥笑，一边扫视着情报报告，"恶魔摩洛克的信徒能有什么疑问？如何更彻底地腐化人类的灵魂？如何从罪孽中榨取更多肮脏的钱财？"

entries.en:
"They are... as human and fallible as any of us. To convince them, would be a miracle." He looks at you skeptically.

"If... that fails. Acquire hard data. The scan of the original glove, the metadata may tell us. Comms buffers. Archives. All useful." He looks at you, "I have a list of suspects. A mole in the Holy Cathedral of Exodus. Need evidence. Who to... put to inquisition."

Defensive, he adds, "The rumors... slander. Mostly." His eyes are closed, his breathing shallow. "And... destroy the forge. Must be destroyed."
entries.zh:
"他们... 与所有凡人一样充满过失。要说服他们，无疑是奇迹。" 他将信将疑地看着你。

"如果... 这样行不通，那就去获取实体数据。原版手套的扫描文件、元数据或许能提供线索，通讯缓冲区、档案库，都会有用。" 他注视着你，"我有一份嫌疑人名单，关于 Exodus 神圣大教堂的内应。需要证据，才能决定... 对谁进行审判。"

他戒备地补充道："那些传闻... 大多是诽谤。" 他双目紧闭，呼吸浅促。"还有... 摧毁锻炉。务必彻底销毁。"

entries.en:
"The Pathers' reputation... they are as human as any. Not all heretical zealots. Fallible, fearful." He looks at you skeptically.

"I have a list of suspects. A mole in the Holy Cathedral of Exodus. Need evidence. Who to... put to inquisition. Acquire hard data. The scan of the original glove, the metadata may tell us. Comms buffers. Archives. All useful."

He looks at you. "Inquisition... the rumors. Slander. Mostly." His eyes are closed, his breathing shallow. "And... destroy the forge. Must be destroyed."
entries.zh:
"左径分子的名声... 他们终究也是凡人。并非所有异端狂热者都坚不可摧，他们也会犯错，会恐惧。" 他将信将疑地看着你。

"我有一份嫌疑人名单，关于 Exodus 神圣大教堂的内应。需要证据，才能决定...对谁进行审判。去获取实体数据。原版手套的扫描文件、元数据或许能提供线索，通讯缓冲区、档案库，都会有用。"

他戒备地补充道："审判庭... 那些传闻，是诽谤，大多是。" 他双目紧闭，呼吸浅促。"还有... 摧毁锻炉。务必彻底销毁。"

entries.en:
"No!" He speaks a little too forcefully; a blinking light turns yellow.

"Risky... need acquire hard data. Scan of the original glove, the metadata. Comms buffers. Archives." He takes a deep breath then looks at you, "I have a list of suspects. A mole in the Holy Cathedral of Exodus. Need evidence. Who to... put to inquisition."

He pauses, then says, "Inquisitors. The rumors... slander. Mostly." His eyes are closed, his breathing shallow. "And... destroy the forge. Must be destroyed."
entries.zh:
"不！" 他语气略显激烈；一盏指示灯转为黄色。

"太冒险了...去获取实体数据。原版手套的扫描文件、元数据、通讯缓冲区、档案库。" 他深吸一口气，随后看向你，"我有一份嫌疑人名单，关于 Exodus 神圣大教堂的内应。需要证据，才能决定...对谁进行审判。"

他停顿片刻，继续说道："审判庭。那些传闻...大多是诽谤。" 他双目紧闭，呼吸浅促。"还有...摧毁锻炉。务必彻底销毁。"

entries.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam." Your chief medical officer appears behind you. "The patient needs rest. I must insist."
entries.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 你的医疗主管出现在你身后，"病人需要休息，我必须坚持这一点。"

o.en: I will decide when he needs rest, doctor.
o.zh: 医生，他何时需要休息由我来决定。

entries.en:
Your med chief's face is crossed by a network of fine wrinkles, evidence of many cycles of service. They say nothing, but turn their head at a small and precise angle.

Bornanew's breathing is slow, regular. His eyes closed. Unconscious.
entries.zh:
你的医疗主管眼角细密的皱纹似乎在讲述着漫长岁月的服役故事。此人一言不发，只是精准地微微侧过头。

Bornanew 呼吸缓慢而规律，双目紧闭，已失去意识。

entries.en:
The expression on your med chief's face doesn't change, but the network of fine wrinkles tells of sufficient cycles of service such that they will stand firm against your overstep of authority.

"Nonetheless," your chief medical officer says, turning their head a small and precise angle.

Bornanew's breathing is slow, regular. His eyes closed. Unconscious.
entries.zh:
你的医疗主管面不改色，眼角细密的皱纹似乎在讲述着漫长岁月的服役故事，绝不会任凭你越权决定。

"话虽如此。" 你的医疗主管微微侧过头，角度拿捏得精准分毫。

Bornanew 呼吸缓慢而规律，双目紧闭，已失去意识。

entries.en:
It looks like he tries to shrug, and fails.

"It was... it was..." he trails off, and closes his eyes. "I was terrified, captain. A coward. And yet, what else could be done?"

He opens his eyes. "It may be that is enough for a Knight." He shifts slightly, under the bandages and tubes. "The machines, drugs. They take the pain away. It still hurts."
entries.zh:
他似乎想耸耸肩，却没能成功。

"那时候... 那时候... " 他的声音渐渐低了下去，缓缓闭上了眼睛，"我吓坏了，舰长。我就是个懦夫。可事到如今，又能有什么别的办法呢？"

他睁开双眼。"或许，这样就足以称得上是一名骑士了。" 他缠满绷带、插着管子的身体微微动了动，"那些仪器，那些药物，确实能止痛。但我仍然感到折磨。"

o.en: $global.jethroName. That was a brave thing you did on Chalcedon.
o.zh: $global.jethroName。你在 Chalcedon 的行动真是英勇。

o.en: $global.jethroName. That was a stupid thing you did on Chalcedon.
o.zh: $global.jethroName。你在 Chalcedon 的行动真是愚蠢。

o.en: You should thank the medical team, they're the ones that saved you.
o.zh: 你该好好谢谢医疗团队，是他们救了你。

o.en: We're in the $bffi_patherStationSystem. There's a Pather base.
o.zh: 我们现在在 $bffi_patherStationSystem，这里有一处左径分子的基地。

entries.en: You leave Bornanew to the stern care of your chief medical officer.
entries.zh: 你将 Bornanew 交由医疗主管照料。

entries.en:
The attending medtech gives you a stern look as you step into the medbay despite the fact that you are the captain of the $shipOrFleet.

Bornanew's face is pale and bloated. His abdomen is covered in bandages and trailing tubes connected to a suite of murmuring autodocs.

"$playerFirstName," he says. "I appear to live." He takes a breath. "And to you I owe thanks. Captain, I mean. Apologies."
entries.zh:
你虽是$shipOrFleet的舰长，但当你踏入医疗舱时，值班医生还是投来一记严厉的目光。

Bornanew 面色苍白浮肿，腹部缠着层层绷带，数根导管从绷带下延伸而出，连接着一旁嗡嗡运转的自动医疗设备。

"$playerFirstName，" 他开口道，"看来我还活着。" 他缓了缓，"这条命，多亏了你。我是说，舰长。抱歉。"

entries.en: "I have," he says. "And shall again, 'til they tire of it."
entries.zh: "我已经这么做了。" 他说道，"而且我还会继续下去，直到他们厌烦为止。"

entries.en:
"Ah. Then Ulmus told us true." A flicker of a smile crosses Bornanew's face.

"We must... destroy the nanoforge. And find out who the mole is, in the cathedral. Tartessus." He closes his eyes and takes a slow breath.
entries.zh:
"啊哈。这么说 Ulmus 没有骗我们。" 一丝笑意掠过 Bornanew 的脸庞。

"我们必须... 毁掉那台纳米锻炉，还要查出 Tartessus 大教堂里的内应是谁。" 他闭上眼睛，缓缓地吸了一口气。

o.en: I intend to negotiate with the Pather in charge here.
o.zh: 我打算与此地主事的左径分子谈判。

o.en: I intend to send a marine raid. Seize datastores, destroy the forge.
o.zh: 我打算发动陆战队劫掠，夺取数据存储设备，摧毁锻炉。

o.en: I intend to attack directly. Destroy the station.
o.zh: 我打算直接发起进攻，摧毁这座空间站。

entries.en:
True anger flashes through  $hisOrHer eyes. "What choice have I? Shall I submit to the creeping decay of the Church's heresy? Submit to the Knight-Inquisitors that I might be tortured into false confession? It is they who slowly tear apart the Faith, not I! It is they who scorn the Word, not I!"

"Question not my piety, nor my devotion! Give me arms, or none, and I shall face you and your brutes of the so-called Knights of Ludd to the end of my blood!" $HeOrShe pauses a moment, almost overcome, to breathe heavily. "I was not made for such skulduggery." The words come more softly now. "It is a Mammonite's trade. But what choice is given? Will you make me a martyr now, or no?"
entries.zh:
$hisOrHer的眼中怒火骤燃。"我又有何选择？难道要我屈从于教会异端那蚕食人心的堕落？难道要我向审判骑士低头，任由他们酷刑逼供，迫使我编造供词？是他们在一步步撕裂信仰，不是我！是他们在亵渎圣言，不是我！"

"休想质疑我的虔诚信仰，更别怀疑我的忠诚信念！无论赐我武器与否，我都会和你，还有你手下那群自诩卢德骑士团的暴徒抗争到底，流尽最后一滴血！" $HeOrShe顿了顿，情绪几近失控，粗重地喘息着。"我从不是玩弄阴谋诡计的人。" 他的声音低沉了许多，"这都是玛门之仆才会做的勾当。可我别无选择，不是吗？如今，你难道要逼我殉道？"

entries.en:
"Question me not!" True anger flashes across $hisOrHer eyes. "What know you of verity? You are blind to God, blind to the Word, you worship only credits and power. This I see full well!"

"Would you have me submit to the creeping decay of the Church's heresy? Submit to the Knight-Inquisitors that I might be tortured into false confession?"

$HeOrShe pauses, breathing heavily for a moment, then more quietly says, "I was not made for such skulduggery. It is a Mammonite's trade." The words come more softly now. "Will you now fight or no? Better to die a martyr than a hypocrite."
entries.zh:
"别想质问我！" $hisOrHer的眼中怒火骤现。"你懂什么？你对神明视而不见，对圣言充耳不闻，一心只崇拜金钱与权力。这些我看得一清二楚！"

"你难道要我屈从于教会异端那蚕食信仰的堕落？屈从于审判骑士，任由他们对我严刑拷打、逼我编造供词不成？"

$HeOrShe顿了顿，粗重地喘息片刻，随后声音低沉下来："我从不是玩弄阴谋诡计的人。这种勾当，本就是玛门之仆的拿手好戏。" 他的话语愈发轻柔，"如今你到底要战还要和？与其做个伪君子，不如殉道而亡。"

entries.en:
"So you accuse me of sin, Molochian?" Anger flashes across $hisOrHer eyes. "What choice have I? Submit to the creeping decay of the Church's heresy? Submit to the Knight-Inquisitors that I be tortured into false confession?"

"Question not my piety, nor devotion. Give me arms, or none, and I shall face you or your brutes of the so-called Knights of Ludd to the end of my blood!"

$HeOrShe pauses a moment, almost overcome, to breathe heavily.

"I was not made for such skulduggery." The words come softly now. "It is a Mammonite's trade. But what choice is given?" $HeOrShe glares at you. "Will you make me a martyr now, or no?"
entries.zh:
"所以你指控我有罪，摩洛克信徒？" $hisOrHer的眼中闪烁着愤怒，"我还有什么选择？屈服于教会异端那缓慢的腐化？还是向骑士审判官低头，受尽折磨后屈打成招？"

"不要质疑我的敬畏，也不要质疑我的虔诚。不管给我武器，还是赤手空拳，我都要与你 —— 或你那些所谓的卢德骑士团的走狗 —— 血战到底！"

$heOrShe停顿片刻，几乎难以自持，沉重地喘息着。

"我生来就抗拒这般阴谋诡计。" 此刻对方话音转轻，"那是玛门之仆的勾当。但谁会给我选择的余地？" $heOrShe怒视着你，"你现在就要让我殉道吗，嗯？"

entries.en:
"We're all given our place," $heOrShe says, both annoyed and discouraged. "The Path is not easy, nor does it provide comfort. For that, we were given the Word."

$HisOrHer eyes are searching, $hisOrHer devotion to this aspect of the cause obviously wavering. "Sedge was strong, and many followed him. Besides, he was backed by-" $HeOrShe catches $himOrHerself. "Backed by a better Walker by far, blessed be his Path."

"Well, it's done now, isn't it? That scheme is dead, and you bring here the technology of death."
entries.zh:
"我们都各安其位，" $heOrShe说道，语气里夹杂着恼怒与沮丧，"卢德之道既非坦途，亦无安逸，正因如此，我们才被赐予圣言。"

$hisOrHer眼神游移，对事业的忠诚显然已经开始动摇了。"Sedge 曾是强者，众人追随。何况他背后有 ——" $heOrShe突然压低嗓门，"...有一位远胜于我的循道者所支持，愿他的道途蒙福。"

"如今都结束了，不是吗？那计划已死，而你却将死亡的科技带到此地。"

entries.en:
$HisOrHer eyes narrow. "It doesn't matter now; I hear he was murdered, shot in the back by some spacer mercenary who is more machine than flesh."

"Merciful Providence forgive me," $hisOrHer tone softens slightly, "for to speak ill of the dead, and a martyr to our cause at that, but. The man was a beast and I am better pleased to find him on the other side of the infinite."
entries.zh:
$HisOrHer眯起双眼。"现在说这些也没用了。我听说他已经遇害了，被某个太空佬从背后开枪打死 —— 那家伙早就半人半机器，没多少肉了。"

"愿上天宽恕，" $HisOrHer的语气稍稍缓和了些，"毕竟说死人坏话总归不地道，更何况他还是为我们的事业牺牲的。但我还是要说，那家伙就是个畜生，如今他下了地狱，我心里反倒痛快得很。"

o.en: Then praise the Path! You're free of the beast and his schemes.
o.zh: 那就赞颂卢德之道吧！你已经摆脱了那野兽和他的阴谋。

o.en: It is I who shot Sedge. Though I'm less machine than you'd hope.
o.zh: 是我射杀了 Sedge，尽管我并非是你期望的那种杀戮机器。

entries.en:
"Mind, do hide your forked tongue." The Pather has a mean smile. "I see your obvious ploy, to turn me from the Path. But as is said by teachers wiser than I, 'the devil will lie by the truth itself'." $HeOrShe makes a show of looking you over through the comms.

"Nonetheless. I do find myself free of his... customs of leadership."
entries.zh:
"留神，收好你的花言巧语。" 这位左径分子脸上挂着一抹不怀好意的笑，"你这点伎俩我看得明明白白，无非就是想诱我背离正道。不过有句先贤留下的话是这么说的 ——'邪魔歪道，亦会借真话行骗'。" $HeOrShe刻意透过通讯画面端详着你。

"话虽如此，摆脱了他那套所谓的领导作风，我倒真是一身轻松。"

entries.en:
"Hah!" The Pather has a mean smile. "An obvious boast, typical of a Molochian." $HeOrShe makes a show of looking at you through the comms, "You couldn't have taken Sedge. He was a greater warrior than you or I, by far."

"Nonetheless, I weep not to be free of his... leadership."
entries.zh:
"哈！" 这名信徒脸上露出一抹不怀好意的笑，"虚张声势，典型的摩洛克信徒作风。" $HeOrShe故意借着通讯器的画面上下打量着你，"你不可能拿下了 Sedge，他远比你我都更加善战。"

"话虽如此，能不用再受他管辖，我可是半点都不觉得惋惜。"

entries.en:
"Hah!" The Pather has a mean smile. "An obvious boast, typical of a Molochian." $HeOrShe makes a show of looking at you through the comms, "You couldn't have taken Sedge... except by cowardly ambush, or some other deception. He was a greater warrior than you or I, by far."

"Nonetheless, I weep not to be free of his... leadership."
entries.zh:
"哈！" 这名信徒脸上露出一抹不怀好意的笑，"虚张声势，典型的摩洛克信徒作风。" $HeOrShe故意借着通讯器的画面上下打量着你，"你不可能拿下了 Sedge... 除非你耍阴的搞伏击，或者用了什么见不得人的诡计。他远比你我都更加善战。"

"话虽如此，能不用再受他管辖，我可是半点都不觉得惋惜。"

$HisOrHer eyes narrow. "It doesn't matter now; I hear he was murdered, shot in the back by some spacer mercenary who is more machine than flesh."

"Merciful Providence forgive me," $hisOrHer tone softens slightly, "for to speak ill of the dead, and a martyr to our cause at that, but. The man was a beast and I am better pleased to find him on the other side of the infinite."
