$HisOrHer眯起双眼。"现在说这些也没用了。我听说他已经遇害了，被某个太空佬从背后开枪打死 —— 那家伙早就半人半机器，没多少肉了。"

"愿上天宽恕，" $HisOrHer的语气稍稍缓和了些，"毕竟说死人坏话总归不地道，更何况他还是为我们的事业牺牲的。但我还是要说，那家伙就是个畜生，如今他下了地狱，我心里反倒痛快得很。"

o.en: Then praise the Path! You're free of the beast and his schemes.
o.zh: 那就赞颂卢德之道吧！你已经摆脱了那野兽和他的阴谋。

o.en: It is I who killed Sedge. After he murdered the man I was speaking to.
o.zh: 是我杀了 Sedge，就在他谋杀了正和我交谈的那人之后。

entries.en:
"So you have," $heOrShe admits. "I had thought that not possible - and assured it was not by Brother Sedge."

The Pather looks away. "That man would have told me anything to get his way, I think. And if somehow I didn't agree... I give thanks that it did not come to that."
entries.zh:
"你确实做到了。" $heOrShe 坦言，"我本来以为这根本不可能 —— Sedge 修士也跟我打包票说绝无可能。"

这名左径分子移开了视线。"现在想来，那人为了达到目的，什么话都编得出来。当初我要是执意不答应... 还好，总算没走到那一步。"

o.en: Light or no, I am honest. You sow false relics to cause war among the Faithful.
o.zh: 且不论那什么光明，我所言都句句属实。你散播伪造的圣物，意在挑动信徒间的纷争。

o.en: Blind am I, and faithless? I see you sow false relics to cause war among the Faithful.
o.zh: 我又已盲目，又心怀异念？我分明见你散播伪造的圣物，挑动信徒间的纷争。

o.en: You speak of sin while you sow false relics to cause war among the Faithful?
o.zh: 你口口声声着罪孽，所作所为却是散播伪造的圣物，挑动信徒间的纷争？

o.en: Your 'skulduggery' is undone anyway. I found your relic and tracked it to here.
o.zh: 你的 '阴谋诡计' 早已败露。我已经找到了你们的圣物，并一路追踪至此。

o.en: If it is an honest fight you want, then why the false relics scheme?
o.zh: 若你想要一场光明正大的对决，那又何必设下这伪造圣物的阴谋？

o.en: Why are you so willing to violate the tenets of your faith for Wrestling Sedge?
o.zh: 你为何要为了 Wrestling Sedge 而甘愿违背自身信仰的教义？

o.en: You're a hopeless fanatic. There is no reasoning with you.
o.zh: 你就是个无可救药的狂信徒，根本没法跟你讲道理。

o.en: Your heresy has twisted your faith. There is no reasoning with you. (cut the comms)
o.zh: 你的异端邪说已经扭曲了你的信仰，根本没法跟你讲道理。 (切断通讯)

entries.en:
The Pather's face twists with anger. "Then burn with the rest, Molochian!" $HeOrShe disappears in a haze of compression artifacts.

The link plays a crackling buzz of a suppressed electronic warfare signal for a moment before your comms officer, considerately, shuts it off for you.
entries.zh:
左径分子的脸庞因愤怒而扭曲变形。"那就和其他家伙一起化为灰烬吧，摩洛克信徒！"$HeOrShe 的身影在一阵压缩失真的噪点干扰中消失无踪。

通讯链接发出了一阵电子战压制信号产生的蜂鸣爆音，你的通讯军官随即贴心地帮你切断了连接。

entries.en:
The Pather's face twists with anger.  "Then burn with the rest, Molochian!" $heOrShe says, then disappears in a haze of compression artifacts.

The link plays a crackling buzz of a suppressed electronic warfare signal for a moment before your comms officer, considerately, shuts it off for you.
entries.zh:
左径分子的脸庞因愤怒而扭曲变形。"那就和其他家伙一起化为灰烬吧，摩洛克信徒！"$heOrShe说道，随后在一阵压缩失真的噪点干扰中消失无踪。

通讯链接中响起一阵短促的、压抑的电子战信号杂音，刺耳地噼啪作响，随即你的通讯军官便贴心地帮你切断了连接。

o.en: We seek not your death, but to stop a scheme that will itself kill countless Faithful. (explain)
o.zh: 我们并非要取你性命，只是要阻止一场将会葬送无数信徒性命的阴谋。 (解释)

o.en: I can destroy you. Choose to lose all - or make a deal, and lose little. (explain)
o.zh: 我完全可以灭了你。自己选吧，要么失去所有 —— 要么和我做个交易，只要付出一点代价。 (解释)

o.en: I'd like to discuss a matter involving Menes Yaribay.
o.zh: 我想讨论一件与 Menes Yaribay 有关的事。

entries.en:
"Cousin Menes," he says, and sighs.

"What is it he's done this time?"
entries.zh:
"Menes 堂弟，" 他说着，叹了口气。

"他又干什么了？"

entries.en:
"I shall make my own way to Olinadu, thank you. Have your people coordinate with my people."

"We'll sort out Menes' indiscretion and set things right with the Church," he says brusquely, then turns away.

"After all I've done for that ungrateful-"

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"我会自己去 Olinadu 的，谢谢。让你的人和我这边的人协调一下。"

"我们会处理好 Menes 的轻率行为，把教会的事情办好，" 他唐突地说，然后转过身去。

"毕竟我已经做得够多了，为了那个不知感激 ——"

通讯中断了。

entries.en: Now you have a party to attend - with an uninvited guest of honor.
entries.zh: 现在你该去参加派对了 —— 和一位不请自来的贵客一起。

entries.en:
"The past matters of my gens do not oblige discussion with outsiders, $playerSirOrMadam," he says stiffly.

"However. I do appreciate your... consideration in bringing the current matter to my attention."
entries.zh:
"我们氏族的陈年旧事，我没义务和外人讨论这些，$playerSirOrMadam，" 他语气僵硬。

"不过，对你...考虑把这件事告诉我这一点，我很感谢。"

entries.en: "Thank-you captain, that is fabulous advice," Horus says in a tone demonstrating very little appreciation for your input.
entries.zh: "多谢，舰长，这提议真是太棒了，" 对你的建议，Horus 的语气中毫无感激。

entries.en:
"He did," Horus stares at you.

"It appears as though I am going to have to become involved," he says. "Personally."

"Again." His jaw is clenched. It looks uncomfortable.
entries.zh:
"他邀请了你，" Horus 盯着你。

"看来我不得不介入了，" 他说，"亲自介入。"

"又一次。" 他咬紧牙关。看起来非常不舒服。

o.en: You need to keep better track of your cousin's schemes, huh.
o.zh: 看来你得更留心你堂弟的那些计划了，是吧。

o.en: He might spark a religious conflict that could tear the Sector apart.
o.zh: 他可能会引发一场宗教冲突，足以将整个星域撕裂。

entries.en:
Horus blinks, and turns his head aside as if he didn't hear you correctly. His eyes snap back to yours through the comm-link.

"Elaborate upon your statement, if you would be so kind."

A harsh note enters his tone, despite ostensibly polite words.
entries.zh:
Horus 眨了眨眼，把头转向一边，仿佛没有听清你的话。然后他透过通讯链接猛地对上了你的目光。

"请详细解释一下你刚刚说的事，如果你愿意的话。"

尽管表面上的措辞很客气，但他的语调里已经带上了一丝严厉。

o.en: He bought a sacred Luddic relic for his personal collection.
o.zh: 他买了一件神圣的卢德遗物作为自己的收藏品。

entries.en:
Horus takes this in, looking into the middle distance, processing for a moment. He takes a slow breath.

"You are certain? Do the Luddics know about it?"
entries.zh:
Horus 听完之后看向远方，花了些时间来消化这个消息。接着他缓缓地吸了一口气。

"你确定？卢德教徒们知道这件事吗？"

o.en: Oh, they know. They hired me to... handle it.
o.zh: 哦，他们知道。他们雇我来...处理这件事。

o.en: How do you get on with Menes? Not well?
o.zh: 你和 Menes 的关系怎么样？不太好？

entries.en: "He is family." Horus gives you a flinty look. "State your meaning."
entries.zh: "他是我的家人。" Horus 目光冷峻地看着你。"把话说明白些。"

entries.en:
He closes his eyes and rubs his temples. After a moment, a mutter emerges, "Good grief."

He takes several more long breaths.
entries.zh:
他闭上眼睛，揉了揉太阳穴。片刻之后，他咕哝了一句，"我的天啊。"

然后他又深呼吸了好几次。

o.en: Menes invited me to some kind of party to view this relic.
o.zh: Menes 邀请我参加派对，去鉴赏这件圣物。

entries.en:
Bornanew assists your comms officer in navigating through various levels of Church bureaucracy.

Before long, you have the senior nanoforge engineer of Asher on a comms-link.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 协助你的通讯军官，在教会的层层官僚机构中斡旋推进。

没过多久，你便通过通讯链接联系上了 Asher 的一位资深纳米锻炉技师。

entries.en:
"Yes, hello? Uh, good day? I was told there was an investigation."

She seems to examine you through the link. "You don't look much like a Knight of Ludd."
entries.zh:
"喂？你好？呃... 日安？我听说这边正在进行一项调查。"

她似乎正透过通讯链接打量着你。"你看起来可不太像一名卢德骑士。"

o.en: I need an object analyzed. Very closely.
o.zh: 我需要对一件物品进行分析，要极其细致的那种。

entries.en: "Exactly," she's pleased that you put it together. "Got bad news though, cap. Your glove doesn't match anything in this library."
entries.zh: "正是如此。" 见你反应过来，她面露喜色，"不过有个坏消息要告诉你，舰长。你那只手套和资料库中的任何记录都对不上。"

o.zh: 偏移痕迹能否被隐藏、伪造？

o.en: So it's not a known forge.
o.zh: 这么说，这并非出自某个已知的锻炉。

entries.en: "Could be," she admits. "Takes a clever setup and a talented operator though. If this is fake drift, then it goes real high up. Don't know who'd be capable of it that'd waste that kind of effort on a glove."
entries.zh: "有这个可能。" 她坦言，"但这需要精密的设备和经验老道的操作人员。如果这个偏移痕迹是伪造的，那幕后之人的来头可不小。我实在想不通，究竟是谁会不惜耗费这般心力，在一只手套上大做文章。"

entries.en:
"Maybe, maybe not," she says.

"The Church doesn't put much into material analysis. What you'd do, ideally, is collect statistically significant samples, run scans on every new product that shows up, put anything interesting through a detailed scan like this, build a library. It's not cheap," she says wistfully.

"But here they're mostly interested in making sure their hyperdrives work to min-spec. The Church of No-fun." She looks at Bornanew, "Sorry."

He nods, untroubled.
entries.zh:
"有可能，也可能没有。" 她说道。

"教会在物质分析方面投入甚少。理想情况下，你应该收集具有统计学意义的样本，对每一款新问世的产品进行扫描检测，将所有可疑物品都拿来做这种精细扫描，进而建立起一套完备的资料库。这法子可一点都不便宜。" 她不无怅惘地补充道。

"但在这儿，他们关心的多半只是确保超光速引擎能达到最低性能标准。无趣的教会。" 她看向Bornanew，补了一句："抱歉。"

Bornanew点了点头，神色淡然，并未介怀。

o.zh: 偏移痕迹能否被隐藏、伪造？

o.en: So it's not a known forge.
o.zh: 这么说，这并非出自某个已知的锻炉。

entries.en:
"That's all I got, captain," she says, reversing the specimen insertion procedure and returning your containment vessel. "Good mystery. Hope it doesn't get you shot."

She hands the vessel to Bornanew, then claps her hands together. "That'll be 10,000 credits."
entries.zh:
"我这边能查到的就这些了，舰长。" 她说着，将样本取出装置恢复至初始状态，随即将你的密封容器递了回来。"这案子可真是够离奇的。但愿你别因此惹祸上身，落得个被灭口的下场。"

她把容器交给 Bornanew，随后拍了拍手。"承惠 10000 星币。"

o.en: You serve the Church. Is this not corruption, $jethroName?
o.zh: 你效力于教会，这难道不算是腐败吗，$jethroName？

entries.en:
She looks between you and Bornanew.

"Didn't you tell your captain about the fee?" She asks.

You'd swear, Bornanew is almost blushing.
entries.zh:
她的目光在你和 Bornanew 之间游移。

"你没跟你们舰长说费用的事吗？" 她开口问道。

你敢肯定，Bornanew 这会儿脸在泛红了。

entries.en:
You transfer the credits to Senior Engineer Tanaica's accounts while $global.jethroName holds the vessel.

Presumably she'll forward payment for lab expenses to the Church-approved Manufactoria Guild.
entries.zh:
在 $global.jethroName 保管容器的间隙，你将星币转入了高级工程师 Tanaica 的账户。

想必她会把这笔实验收入转交给教会认可的制造业公会。

entries.en:
You transfer the credits to Senior Engineer Tanaica's accounts while $global.jethroName holds the vessel.

Presumably she'll forward payment for lab expenses to the Church-approved Manufactoria Guild. Or not.
entries.zh:
在$global.jethroName 保管容器的间隙，你将星币转入了高级工程师 Tanaica 的账户。

想必她会把这笔实验收入转交给教会认可的制造业公会。或许吧。

entries.en:
He recovers quickly. "I, of course," he awkwardly hands the ersatz reliquary to you then draws an off-brand datapad from his robes. Engineer $personLastName blinks at it.

"I can pay from the, uh, accounts of The Reverend Archcurate Sophronia Jaspis... here."
entries.zh:
他很快镇定下来。"当然，由我来付。" 他略显局促地将那件仿制圣物匣递给你，随即从长袍里掏出一个杂牌数据平板。工程师 $personLastName 见状，不由得眨了眨眼。

"我可以... 呃，从宗师大人 Sophronia Jaspis 的账户里支取，喏，这样。"

entries.en:
His neutral expression flickers.

"I... yes, the captain is correct. You are paid to serve the Church, and this," he hefts the ersatz reliquary, "is business of the Church."

"Right you are," says Senior Engineer Tanaica through a tight smile. "Good day, captain."

Her eyes flick at Bornanew. "Novice."
entries.zh:
他面无表情的神色掠过一丝波动。

"我...没错，舰长说得对。你领受薪俸，本就是为教会效力，而这个，" 他掂了掂那件仿制圣物匣，"正是教会的公事。"

"说得对。" 高级工程师 Tanaica 笑容紧绷地应道，"日安，舰长。"

她的目光扫过 Bornanew，吐出几个字："见习修士。"

entries.en:
Bornanew's tone was righteous, but without heart. You suspect he was not going to make an issue of the 'payment' until you brought it up.

As you return to your shuttle he gives you a look- guilt?

"Such things are not uncommon even in the shadow of the Church," he says. "And elsewhere. I'm sure you well know."

Bornanew returns his attention to his datapad. He's making his 'thinking face'."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 的语气听似义正词严，实则毫无诚意。你暗自揣测，若不是你主动提起，他根本不打算就这笔 '酬金' 的事多说一个字。

你们返回穿梭机的途中，他投来一道复杂的目光 —— 是愧疚吗？

"即便是在教会的眼皮子底下，这类勾当也算不上稀罕事，" 他开口说道，"放眼其他地方更是屡见不鲜。我相信你对此心知肚明。"

说罢，Bornanew 便将注意力重新落回数据平板上，脸上摆出了他那副标志性的 '沉思神情'。

entries.en:
"I see." $PersonName takes a moment more to examine you, humming to herself.

"Forensic material analysis. Skilled work." $HeOrShe frowns. "It won't be cheap."

She looks at some other display and starts tapping at an input. "You'll have to bring the sample down, of course."
entries.zh:
"明白了。" $PersonName 又打量了你片刻，嘴里轻轻哼着调子。

"法医级材料分析，这可是技术活。" $HeOrShe皱起眉头，"收费可不低。"

她看向另一个显示屏，开始在输入设备上操作起来。"当然，你得把样本送过来才行。"

o.zh: 前往工程师实验室的穿梭机

entries.en:
Senior Engineer Tanaica places the glove and its containment vessel onto a shelf which retracts into the towering white casing of the analysis suite. Transparent panes, probably diamond-matrix, reveal arcane inner workings.

She hits a command to evacuate the atmo from the sample slot, and sets a manipulator to extract the glove and place it on the scanning bed. All of this she performs with a casual ease born of practice. She speaks as she taps away at the control interface.

"If it came from a high-quality nanoforge like what the Heggies or League's got, this might not tell us much."

Some kind of protective barrier shunts down, hiding the glove from view. A holo of the glove emerges from a display unit, gaining resolution until a doppelganger rotates in the air before you.
entries.zh:
高级工程师 Tanaica 将手套及其密封容器放置在一个置物架上，置物架随即缩进了分析设备高耸的白色外壳中。几块透明面板，大概是金刚石方窗，展示出其精密的内部结构。

她按下指令，抽干了样本槽内的空气，又操控机械臂取出手套，将其放置到扫描台上。这一系列操作，她做得行云流水，显然是经验使然。她一边在控制界面上快速操作，一边开口说道：

"要是这手套出自像 霸主 或 英仙座联盟 那样的高质量纳米锻炉，这台设备可能也查不出什么名堂。"

一道防护屏障应声降下，将手套完全遮蔽。与此同时，一块显示屏投射出手套的全息影像，影像的清晰度不断提升，最终，一个与手套一模一样的立体投影在你眼前缓缓旋转。

entries.en:
"Hm. Good output, this. But I'm thinking not good-perfect. Ludd...ics," her eyes dart at Bornanew, "No offense, but they don't go in for training much native talent. S'why you lot pay me."

"Anyway, when you get into really delicate products, your forge quality starts to matter. A work-rated vac-glove though?" She rolls her eyes. "This better be good."

The analysis suite is making some kind of humming sound, and there's a clunk. The engineer doesn't react, so neither do you. Her display erupts with numbers and icons, then something she does pulls a cutaway from the holo-glove, which scales as the rest of it disappears.

Another segmentation of scale iterates, then another.
entries.zh:
"嗯。分析结果不错，不过还不算完美无缺。卢德...教会，" 她飞快地瞥了 Bornanew 一眼，又补充道，"无意冒犯，但他们向来不怎么注重培养本土人才。这也是你们这些人花钱雇我的原因。"

"话说回来，要是分析那些真正高精尖的产品，锻炉的工艺水准就很关键了。可这玩意儿不过是一只工业级的真空手套？" 她翻了个白眼，"希望这东西值得我费这番功夫。"

分析设备发出一阵嗡嗡声，随即传来 "咔嗒" 一声。工程师对此毫无反应，你便也不动声色。她面前的显示屏瞬间被密密麻麻的数字和图标铺满，紧接着，她操作了一番，手套的全息投影上便浮现出剖面视图；随着投影的其他部分逐渐隐去，这个剖面的比例也随之放大。

投影的剖面缩放与分割又进行了一次，紧接着是新一轮的迭代。

entries.en:
"We can see signs of what we call 'drift' here," she says. A colored indicator ring flashes around an orderly pattern of small-scale structures deep within the glove, the representation of individual atoms, perhaps, just visible like the grain of sandstone.

"These defects are unique to the faults in an individual nanoforge. More or less."

"Like a fingerprint," Bornanew says.

"No." The engineer shrugs. "But sure, if you like."
entries.zh:
"我们能在这儿观测到我们所说的 '偏移痕迹'。" 她说道。手套内部深处，一片排列规整的微结构外围，一圈彩色指示环正不停闪烁；这些微结构大概就是单个原子的映射，如同砂岩的颗粒一般，隐约可见。

"这些缺陷应当是专属某台缺陷纳米锻炉的特征。"

"就像指纹一样。" Bornanew 说道。

"不一样。" 工程师耸耸肩，"不过嘛，你要这么理解也无妨。"

entries.en:
"Someone's been naughty," she says, sounding more delighted than upset. "The glove is new, but the model is old. A closed-source pre-Collapse template. There are fabrication-rights codes embedded in its structure."

With a tap, another colored indicator ring flashes on a sheared-square section of material containing a complex pattern. "Tells the forge not to make unauthorized copies."

"Closed products from the Domain-era tend to be far higher quality than forges running post-Collapse hacks." She smiles, "This isn't that, but it's close. Tells us two things."
entries.zh:
"有人从中捣鬼了嘛。" 她语气里的愉快多过不悦。"这手套是新的，但型号早就过时了。是 大崩塌 前的闭源模板。它的结构里还嵌着制造授权码呢。"

她轻轻一点，在一块带有复杂纹路的方形裁切材料上，又一圈彩色指示环亮了起来。"这是用来避免锻炉进行未授权复制的。"

"大崩塌前 人之领 的闭源产品，质量可比大崩塌后那些靠破解程序运行的锻炉造出来的东西好得多。" 她笑了笑，"这玩意儿虽然比不上那些正品，但也差不多了。这也说明了两件事。"

entries.en:
"One, this was made by an industrial-grade Domain-era forge. Heavy industry stuff. Bit of a waste to use it to make a glove," she glances at you, "If you ask me."

"Two, either this forge is loaded with valid fabrication rights and it's damaged, or it's been hacked to bypass the embedded copy protections. And it's damaged. I mean, stars and ruin, look at this mess," she zooms in on the 'drift' patterns while making a disgusted look.

$global.jethroName speaks up now, "Three, we're dealing with a sophisticated forgery operation."

The engineer shoots a look back at him, "Neat."
entries.zh:
"第一，这东西出自一台旧的人之领时期的工业级锻炉。妥妥的重工业设备。用它来造一只手套，多少有点大材小用了，" 她瞥了你一眼，补充道，"反正我是这么觉得的。"

"第二，这台锻炉要么是内置了合法制造授权，只是本身已经损坏；要么就是被人破解了，强行绕过了预装的防复制保护机制。但不管怎样，它肯定是坏了。不是我夸张，你瞧瞧这乱七八糟的样子。" 她一边放大那些 "偏移痕迹" 的纹路，一边露出嫌恶的表情。

$global.jethroName 这时开口说道，"第三，我们这是遇上了一桩手法高超的造假案。"

工程师回头瞥了他一眼，只淡淡说了句，"还不赖。"

o.en: What forge made this? Where's it from?
o.zh: 这是哪台锻炉造的？它出自哪里？

entries.en:
"Right," she manipulates the interface again.

The drift-pattern from the glove remains locked, and she brings up similar - but distinct - examples of patterns in an expanding grid. Small labels show a string of glyphs, most of which contain the names of industrial combines, shipyards, and polities known to you. Some you recognize as dating to the Collapse. Others are unfamiliar.

"This is the drift library we've got here on Asher. Useful stuff, but other factions got better."
entries.zh:
"当然，" 她再次操作起界面。

保持锁定着手套上的偏移纹路，她又调出了一系列相似却又截然不同的纹路样本，如网格般不断铺开出去。每个样本旁的小型标签显示着一串符号，其中绝大多数标注的都是你熟知的工业联合体、船厂与政权的名称。有些轨迹你一眼便能认出，可追溯至大崩塌时期；还有些则从未见过。

"这是 Asher 的偏移纹路数据库。虽说内容还算实用，但其他势力手里的资料可比这强多了。"

o.en: So you can match the 'drift' to the forge.
o.zh: 所以你能把这些 '偏移痕迹' 和对应的锻炉对上号？

o.en: Use Bornanew's authority to meet with a nanoforge engineer
o.zh: 借 Bornanew 的权限面见纳米锻炉技师

entries.en:
Bornanew's authority - that of the Archcurate Sophronia Jaspis, in truth - is as good with the local traffic authority as it is with the Manufactoria Guild bureaucrats.

Your shuttle descends into the atmosphere of Asher. The view shades toward a warm, murky gray as you descend through the stratospheric fines perpetually refreshed by towering dust storms. The display blots out entirely and switches to a false-rendering as you enter the lower atmosphere.

There is no hazard; the storms are impressive in scale but low in mass due to the deathly thin atmosphere.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 的权限 —— 说穿了，就是大祭司 Sophronia Jaspis 的权限 —— 在当地交通管理部门与制造业公会的官僚机构那里足以通行无阻。

你的穿梭机缓缓驶入 Asher 的大气层。随着穿越那片由巨型沙尘暴常年补给的平流层尘雾，窗外的景致渐渐晕染成一片温暖而浑浊的灰蒙之色。当进入低空大气层时，显示屏彻底黑屏，随即切换为模拟成像模式。

这并非什么危险状况。那些风暴虽然声势浩大，但因这颗星球的大气稀薄至极，其物质密度其实很低。

entries.en:
You return to your shuttle.

Bornanew's attention is uncharacteristically focused on his datapad. He's making his 'thinking face'.
entries.zh:
你回到了自己的穿梭机上。

Bornanew 一反常态地盯着他的数据平板，脸上挂着那副标志性的 '沉思表情'。

entries.en:
"Ulmus Pond," he says. Then looks up at you.

"That strange little man from Menes Yaribay's party. Obviously an agent for the Luddic Path. That the Path would have eyes and influence on Menes is no surprise. But if he's the one that supplied the glove..."

"We need to get to him," he says. "Confront him. Compel him to talk."
entries.zh:
"Ulmus Pond。" 他开口道，随即抬眼望向你。

"就是 Menes Yaribay 团队里那个古怪的小个子男人。他显然是 卢德左径 的特工。卢德左径 能在 Menes 的地盘安插眼线、培植势力，这一点并不奇怪。但如果那只手套是他提供的..."

"我们必须找到他，"他语气笃定，"当面对质，逼他开口。"

o.en: Guess we're going back to Olinadu.
o.zh: 我猜我们得回趟 Olinadu 了。

entries.en:
"Ulmus Pond," he says. Then looks up at you. "He's a Pather agent," Bornanew says as if it were the most obvious thing in the world.

"We spoke briefly at Menes' party," he explains. "The circumstantial evidence is convincing enough, but it was his heretical understanding of theology which I found truly damning."

"We need to get to him," he says. "Confront him. Compel him to talk."
entries.zh:
"Ulmus Pond。" 他开口道，随即将目光投向你。"他是 卢德左径 的特工。" Bornanew 的语气，仿佛是在说一件再显然不过的事。

"我们在 Menes 的宴会上有过短暂交谈。" 他解释道，"种种旁证本就足以令人信服，但真正让我确定他有罪的，是他那套离经叛道的神学谬论。"

"我们必须找到他。" 他语气坚决，"当面对质，逼他开口。"

o.en: Guess we're going back to Olinadu.
o.zh: 我猜我们得回趟 Olinadu 了。

entries.en:
"Guess so," he replies. "We may not wish to draw any attention from Menes, of course..."

The shuttle docks with your flagship.
entries.zh:
"我想可以，"他回答道。"我们可不想引起 Menes 的注意..."

穿梭机与你的旗舰对接。

o.en: I'll handle it. I can be very discreet.
o.zh: 我来接手。我会谨慎行事。

entries.en:
"Guess so," he replies. "But perhaps... Menes' might not be pleased to see us show up."

The shuttle docks with your flagship.
entries.zh:
"我想可以，"他回答道。"只是...Menes 见到我们估计不会给我们好脸色。"

穿梭机与你的旗舰对接。

o.en: I'll handle it. I can be very persuasive.
o.zh: 我来接手。我向来擅长说服别人。

entries.en: You step off the shuttle.
entries.zh: 你走出穿梭机。

entries.en:
Bornanew's datapad trembles in Pond's hands. He cannot designate a star system until Bornanew holds the pad steady for him. A target.

"This Pather, Ulmus," Bornanew says, glancing at the datapad then placing it in his satchel. The threat retreats from his voice. "Tell us his name."

Tears stream down Ponds' face; the man looks deflated, and absolutely defeated. "Sedge," he says.

Bornanew shoots a look at you.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 的数据平板在 Pond 手中颤抖。直到 Bornanew 帮他稳住数据平板，他才得以指定一个星系。

"这个左径分子，Ulmus，" Bornanew 瞥了眼数据平板，随即将其揣进包里，语气里的杀意已然敛去，"告诉我们他的名字。"

Pond 泪流满面，整个人瘫软下来，脸上写满了彻底的绝望。"Sedge。" 他哑声回答。

Bornanew 猛地转过头来看向你。

o.en: I recall handling that problem already.
o.zh: 我记得我已经解决这个问题了。

entries.en:
Pond nods, tears streaming down his face. He seems not to know what to do, and simply sits there slumped like a ragdoll, his mouth half-open.

You leave him in his cheap apartment, stepping over the ruined door. Bornanew pauses a moment to lean it against the hollow door frame like an insufficient apology.
entries.zh:
Pond 点了点头，泪水不住地从脸颊滑落。他看起来茫然无措，就那样像个破布娃娃似的瘫坐在原地，嘴巴半张着。

你将他留在这间廉价的公寓里，抬脚跨过那扇残破的门板。Bornanew 驻足片刻，把门板斜靠在空荡荡的门框上，就像一句苍白无力的道歉。

entries.en:
Pond nods, tears streaming down his face. He sits slumped like a ragdoll, mouth half-open, until Bornanew pulls him to his feet.

"Move, walker." Bornanew's voice is his own again. "The path of redemption is not easy, but it is as Ludd would ask."

You follow Pond from his cheap apartment, stepping over the ruined door. Bornanew makes a brief comms request, and soon a pair of furtive, hooded figures collect Pond from your custody.
entries.zh:
Pond 点了点头，泪水不住地从脸颊滑落。他像个破败的布偶般瘫坐着，嘴巴半张着，直到 Bornanew 伸手将他拽起身来。

"动起来，循道者。" Bornanew 的语气恢复了惯常的冷硬，"救赎之路向来难行，但这正是卢德的旨意。"

你跟着 Pond 走出他那间廉价公寓，抬脚跨过残破的门板。Bornanew 发出了一条简短的通讯请求，片刻后，两名行踪诡秘、头罩兜帽的人影便现身，将 Pond 从你们手中接走。

entries.en:
Pond nods, tears streaming down his face. He sits slumped like a ragdoll, mouth half-open, until Bornanew pulls him to his feet.

"Move, walker." Bornanew's voice is his own again. "The path of redemption is not easy, but it is as Ludd would ask."

You follow Pond from his cheap apartment, stepping over the ruined door. He gives you and Bornanew one last look, his face drained of emotion, then disappears down one of the labyrinthine alleyways of the settlement.
entries.zh:
Pond 点了点头，泪水不住地从脸颊滑落。他像个破败的布偶般瘫坐着，嘴巴半张着，直到 Bornanew 伸手将他拽起身来。

"动起来，循道者。" Bornanew 的语气恢复了惯常的冷硬，"救赎之路向来难行，但这正是卢德的旨意。"

你跟着 Pond 走出他那间廉价的公寓，抬脚跨过残破的门板。他最后看了你和 Bornanew 一眼，脸上木然空洞，了无情绪，随即转身消失在聚居地蛛网般错综复杂的小巷深处。

entries.en:
Bornanew watches him go, then stands with you for a quiet moment. Water drips, and the wind moans a low keen through the top of the settlement.

He taps at his datapad, and yours pings with incoming coordinates.

"I suspect this sect of the Path will not surrender their secrets without a fight," he says. "They have invested much in this conspiracy."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 目送他远去，随即与你并肩静立片刻。雨珠滴答坠落，风穿掠过聚居地的上空，呜咽着发出低沉的哀鸣。

他轻点了几下自己的数据平板，你的终端随即叮的一声收到了一组新的坐标。

"我猜这帮左径分子绝不会轻易透露秘密。" 他开口道，"这场阴谋，他们投入的赌注可不小。"

entries.en:
Bornanew watches him go, then stands with you for a quiet moment. Water drips, and the wind moans a low keen through the top of the settlement.

He taps at his datapad, and yours pings with incoming coordinates.

"I suspect this sect of the Path will not surrender their secrets without a fight," he says. "They have invested much in this conspiracy."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 目送他远去，随即与你并肩静立片刻。雨珠滴答坠落，风穿掠过聚居地的上空，呜咽着发出低沉的哀鸣。

他轻点了几下自己的数据平板，你的终端随即叮的一声收到了一组新的坐标。

"我猜这帮左径分子绝不会轻易透露秘密。" 他开口道，"这场阴谋，他们投入的赌注可不小。"

entries.en: You look at your TriPad, reading the coordinates given up by Ulmus Pond.
entries.zh: 你看向手中的 TriPad ，浏览着 Ulmus Pond 提供的坐标。

entries.en:
"I pray we find our answers," Bornanew says as you return to the shuttle. "And I fear now that the Pathers know that we know their aims."

You secure yourself in your seat as the access hatch seals itself. The shuttle begins to lift toward orbit.
entries.zh:
"但愿我们能找到想要的答案。" 在你们返回穿梭机时，Bornanew 开口说道，"只是我现在有些担心，左径分子可能已经察觉到我们知晓他们的图谋了。"

你系好安全带坐定，舱门随即自动闭合。穿梭机缓缓启动，进入轨道。

o.en: Fear not, $global.jethroName. My $shipOrFleet will be ready.
o.zh: 不必担心，$global.jethroName。我的$shipOrFleet很快就会准备妥当。

o.en: When I end this, $global.jethroName, it is the Path that shall fear me.
o.zh: 等我了结这一切，$global.jethroName，就该是那帮左径分子担心了。

entries.en: Bornanew does not reply.
entries.zh: Bornanew 一言不发。

entries.en: Bornanew does not reply.
entries.zh: Bornanew 一言不发。

entries.en:
The comms signal hits a holding signal and waits. And waits. You have your comms officer take over to watch the link and make a few inquiries.

Within minutes, a comms request alert appears. It's Bornanew on an internal link.
entries.zh:
通讯信号接入等待信道，陷入漫长的等待。你吩咐通讯军官接手监控链路，并去询问相关情况。

短短几分钟后，一则通讯请求提示弹了出来。是 Bornanew 通过内部链路发来的。

entries.en:
"Captain," he says. "I apologize for the interruption."

"Ulmus Pond is not on Olinadu."
entries.zh:
"舰长，" 他开口道，"抱歉打扰你。"

"Ulmus Pond 不在 Olinadu。"

o.en: You're sure. How do you know this?
o.zh: 你确定？你是如何得知此事的？

entries.en: "The Knights have... sources," he says carefully. "I am sworn not to reveal them."
entries.zh: "骑士团自有...渠道。" 他措辞谨慎，"我发过誓，绝不会泄露这些秘密。"

entries.en:
"Yes." Bornanew clears his throat.

"The word is that he has fled to Chalcedon on a tramp freighter, a smuggler, known to move materiel for the Luddic Path."
entries.zh:
"没错。" Bornanew 清了清嗓子。

"情报显示他已搭乘一艘走私货船逃往 Chalcedon，那艘船负责为 卢德左径 运送物资。"

entries.en: He turns his head. "He might, if he had to. But I suspect that Ulmus is not an innocent man."
entries.zh: 他转过头来。"若是迫不得已，他或许会这么做。但我怀疑 Ulmus 并不无辜。"

entries.en: "I pray that if we move quickly, we can find him on Chalcedon."
entries.zh: "但愿我们动作够快，能在 Chalcedon 找到他。"

entries.en:
Nav responds instantly to your orders.

Bornanew's image flickers with compression-grain from his cheap datapad.

"I pray that Ulmus Pond's hasty flight has not unwittingly forewarned heretic militants..."
entries.zh:
导航系统即刻响应了你的指令。

Bornanew 的影像因他那台廉价数据平板的压缩而失真，不断闪烁着噪点。

"希望 Ulmus Pond 这次仓促出逃没有在无意间惊动那些异端武装..."

o.en: If we're quick, we won't need to pray. (cut the link)
o.zh: 要是动作够快，我们就不需要 '但愿' 了。 (切断通讯)

entries.en:
Chalcedon rotates in the primary display before you.

Bornanew is at your side, tapping at his off-brand datapad, looking for all the worlds like a toy in his large hands.

"My sources indicate that a man matching the description of Ulmus Pond is almost certainly in a safehouse... here."

A highlighted point appears on the globe, some logistical center in the scablands trailing like a stain from the primary spaceport.
entries.zh:
Chalcedon 在你面前的显示屏上缓缓转动。

Bornanew 就站在你旁边，手指在他那台杂牌数据平板上不停操作，这玩意儿在他宽大的手掌里，看着活脱脱就是个小玩具。

"我的渠道查到，有个和 Ulmus Pond 长相吻合的人，大概率藏在一处安全屋里... 喏，就在这儿。"

星图上立刻跳出一个高亮标记点，位置在痂地荒原的一处后勤中心 —— 这片荒原从核心空港外蔓延开，看着就像块甩不掉的污渍。

entries.en:
Bornanew watches the point as the globe obligingly comes to a gentle stop. The highlighted section detaches from the globe, which collapses away, and spreads into a tactical overview.

"He acts like a man drowning, grasping for help without concern for his rescuers." He turns from the globe toward you, "In OPSEC terms, of course. He could have easily disappeared."

A bitter smile appears, "As once I did."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 注视着那个标记点，星图随即很配合地缓缓停了下来。高亮区域从星图上分离出来，星图则随之隐去，展开成一幅战术总览图。

"他现在的样子就像个溺水的家伙，只顾着拼命去抓救命稻草，根本不管伸手拉他的人是谁。" 他从星图前转过身面向你，补充道，"当然，从 OPSEC 的角度来说，他本可以轻轻松松就销声匿迹的。"

一丝自嘲的笑意浮现在他脸上，"就像我当年一样。"

o.en: Tactical, prep a shuttle. Let's have a chat with Ulmus Pond.
o.zh: 战术军官，准备一艘穿梭机。我们去会会 Ulmus Pond。

entries.en:
Bornanew has his notebook and cheap old datapad packed in a satchel made of what looks like leather. You've heard of the primitive process the Luddics are said to use to produce the material; the skin of an animal is stripped then stewed, somehow, with its own waste products. It sounded unbearably primitive when described. Anti-Luddic misinformation, perhaps, because you don't detect the smell of feces at all.

"How shall we approach this?" Bornanew asks. "Like in MuniSec dramas- one of us is friendly to the subject, the other hostile?"
entries.zh:
Bornanew 把他的笔记本和一台廉价的旧数据平板，都装进了一个看似皮质面料的挎包里。你曾听说过 卢德教会 制造这种材料的原始工艺：他们会剥下兽皮，再用某种方式将兽皮与动物自身的排泄物一同熬煮。当初听到这种说法时，只觉得这工艺粗陋得令人难以忍受。不过这或许是反卢德派的不实传言，因为你此刻丝毫没有闻到粪便的臭味。

"我们该从哪着手？" Bornanew开口问道，"就像地方安全部的剧里演的那样，一个唱红脸，一个唱白脸？"

entries.en: Bornanew nods. Perhaps you're imagining it, but you feel like a coldness comes into the set of his eyes.
entries.zh: Bornanew 点了点头。或许只是你的错觉，但你分明察觉到，他的眼神里掠过一丝寒意。

entries.en: Bornanew nods. Perhaps you're imagining it, but is that relief in the set of his eyes?
entries.zh: Bornanew 点了点头。或许只是你的错觉，但他的神情里，是不是藏着一丝释然？

entries.en: Your personal security team has been briefed, and are dressed as a mix of common spacers, local techs, and Luddic laborers. Their arsenal is multitude and well-concealed.
entries.zh: 你的私人安保小队已经接受过任务指示，队员们的装扮各不相同，有的扮成普通太空船员，有的化身本地技术员，还有的则伪装成卢德教派的劳工。他们携带的武器种类繁多，且都藏匿得十分隐蔽。

entries.en: Your own hand finds your trusty sidearm, a matte polycarbonate pistol. An ideal firearm for use in tight spaces, its mass rests securely in your holster.
entries.zh: 你伸手握住腰间那把得心应手的随身武器 —— 一把哑光聚碳酸酯材质的手枪。这枪特别适合在狭窄空间内使用，此刻正稳稳地嵌在枪套里。

entries.en: You, of course, have your clutch of devilish little grenades built to resist milliradar detection. Fearful and unexpected, they trigger with a practiced twitch from your hand.
entries.zh: 当然，你还揣着几枚小巧却致命的特制手雷，这种手雷能躲开毫米波雷达的探测。只需你手指熟练一动，它们便会出其不意地引爆，叫人防不胜防。

entries.en: And you have hidden a vicious ceramic vibroknife on your person. It is not a tool to be underestimated, for when deployed by surprise it can even disable light power-armored opponents.
entries.zh: 你身上还藏着一把锋利无比的高周波陶瓷匕首。这绝非一把可以小觑的武器 —— 一旦出其不意地用出，即便是身着轻型动力装甲的对手，也能被它一击制伏。

entries.en: You are protected by a subtler weapon, a tiny capsule of spray-poison within your cuff. Hold your breath as it is deployed with a casual wave, and the target next to you will simply die as if of a massive, unexpected heart-attack.
entries.zh: 你还藏着一件更隐蔽的武器 —— 袖口处的一个微型毒液喷雾胶囊。只需不动声色地挥下手，同时屏住呼吸，身旁的目标便会当场毙命，仿佛死于一场突发的急性心脏病。

entries.en: You, of course, have a monomolecular wire hidden in a false fingertip, ready to deploy into an invisible cutting edge with but a short, sharp twist. It is a venerable weapon favored by assassins of a certain class.
entries.zh: 当然，你的仿生指尖里还藏着一根单分子丝 —— 只需短促而用力地一转，它就能伸展开来，化作一道无形的利刃。这是一件备受刺客青睐的经典武器。

entries.en: You, of course, need trust nothing more than your limbs. Starship combat is mass and energy applied at scale; absurdly reduced to the scale of the human body, the mechanics applied are not completely dissimilar.
entries.zh: 当然，你最该信任的，莫过于自己的四肢。星舰的战斗，本质是宏观层面的质量与能量运用；而将这套运作机制缩小到人类躯体的尺度，二者的原理也并非全然不同。

entries.en: Your hand finds the hilt of your officers' sword at your side, the mass of a steel blade a comfort shared with warriors dating to the primitive conflicts of Old Earth.
entries.zh: 你伸手握住腰间的军官佩剑剑柄，钢制剑身沉甸甸的分量，恰似一份自旧地球原始冲突起，便为历代战士所共有的慰藉。

entries.en:
Wrestling Sedge shows you his broken smile.

"Captain $playerFirstName, again. And again the man with too much faith, Bornanew. Jethro Bornanew. See?"

Sedge's pistol is unwavering.

"This time I remember for you."
entries.zh:
Wrestling Sedge 冲你扯出一抹扭曲的笑。

"又是你，$playerFirstName 舰长。还有你这个死脑筋的家伙，Bornanew，Jethro Bornanew。看清楚了吗？"

Sedge 手中的枪稳稳端着，分毫未动。

"这一回，我会替你好好记住。"

o.en: Subvocalize a call to your security team
o.zh: 低声向你的安保小队发送指令

o.en: We were just having a chat with Mister Pond here.
o.zh: 我们刚才正和 Pond 先生在这儿闲谈呢。

o.en: Sedge. I should have shot you when I had the chance.
o.zh: Sedge。当初有机会，我真该一枪崩了你。

entries.en:
Wrestling Sedge shows you his broken smile.

"Captain $playerFirstName! It is good to see you. And again the man with too much faith, Bornanew. Jethro Bornanew. See?"

Sedge's pistol is unwavering.

"This time I remember for you. But," he frowns, "unlucky for me to find you on this path."
entries.zh:
Wrestling Sedge 冲你扯出一抹扭曲的笑。

"$playerFirstName 舰长！真高兴见到你。还有你这个死脑筋的家伙，Bornanew，Jethro Bornanew。看清楚了吗？"

Sedge 手中的枪稳稳端着，分毫未动。

"这一回，我会替你好好记住。只是 ——" 他皱起眉头，"没想到会在这条道途上撞见你，真是晦气。"

o.en: Subvocalize a call to your security team
o.zh: 低声向你的安保小队发送指令

o.en: We were just having a chat with Mister Pond here.
o.zh: 我们刚才正和 Pond 先生在这儿闲聊呢。

o.en: Sedge. I should have shot you when I had the chance.
o.zh: Sedge。当初有机会，我真该一枪崩了你。

entries.en: You and Sedge exchange a look as muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window. He makes a dissatisfied grunt.
entries.zh: 你们和 Sedge 对视一眼，此时周围建筑里传来闷响的枪声与尖叫，声音穿过那块勉强算作窗户的半透明塑料板，顺着采光井发出诡异的回音。他不满地闷哼一声。

entries.en: Sedge makes a dissatisfied grunt. Muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window.
entries.zh: Sedge 不满地闷哼一声。周围建筑里传来闷响的枪声与尖叫，声音穿过那块勉强算作窗户的半透明塑料板，顺着采光井发出诡异的回音。

entries.en: Sedge makes a grunt which sounds like agreement. Muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window.
entries.zh: Sedge 闷哼一声，听着像是表示赞同。周围建筑里传来闷响的枪声与尖叫，声音穿过那块勉强算作窗户的半透明塑料板，顺着采光井发出诡异的回音。

entries.en: As your hand moves toward your belt, Sedge's pistol twitches at your center of mass. He meets your eyes, his gleaming with fearless intensity, and gives a tiny shake of his head. Muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window.
entries.zh: 你手刚朝腰带伸去，Sedge 的枪口就对准了你的躯干要害。他迎上你的目光，眼神里透着毫无惧色的狠戾，同时轻轻摇了摇头。周围建筑里传来闷响的枪声与尖叫，声音穿过那块勉强算作窗户的半透明塑料板，顺着采光井发出诡异的回音。

entries.en:
"Because I must do this." Sedge's pistol twitches toward your center of mass. "It is the Path."

Muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window.
entries.zh:
"因为我必须这么做。" Sedge 的枪口猛地对准你的躯干要害，"这就是卢德之道。"

周围建筑里传来闷响的枪声与尖叫，声音穿过那块勉强算作窗户的半透明塑料板，顺着采光井发出诡异的回音。

entries.en: "The Path cannot bend. Not now," he says gruffly. His gun twitches at Ulmus Pond and makes a grinding shriek like a tool dropped into a rotary engine.
entries.zh: "卢德之道已定，绝无动摇的余地。至少现在不行。" 他语气粗砺地说道。枪口猛地对准了 Ulmus Pond，随即发出一阵刺耳的摩擦声，像是有工具被扔进了旋转的引擎里。

entries.en: Ulmus' blood splatters across the window panel, turning the room a muddy red. In that moment, Bornanew launches himself at Sedge.
entries.zh: Ulmus 的鲜血溅满了整面窗板，整间屋子都被染成了浑浊的暗红色。就在这一刻，Bornanew 猛地朝 Sedge 扑了过去。

entries.en:
The pistol grinds again, catching Bornanew mid-leap.

His massive body, twitching and bleeding, crashes into Sedge's legs, setting the Pather off-balance.
entries.zh:
手枪又一次刺耳地咆哮，射中了飞扑过去的 Bornanew。

Bornanew 血流如注，壮硕的身躯抽搐着撞上了 Sedge 的腿，让他踉跄了一下。

o.en: Draw your weapon and stop Sedge

entries.en:
In one smooth motion you draw your sidearm and place a shot in Sedge's head.

With a sigh, his body slides back against the wall, his eyes blank, his expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.
entries.zh:
你流畅地拔出随身武器，一枪击中 Sedge 的头部。

随着一声叹息，他的身体沿着墙壁滑落，双目空洞，面容凝固在茫然的惊愕之中。

entries.en:
In one smooth motion you draw a grenade, sliding a finger along just-so to set yield to minimum, and gently toss it toward Sedge's head. You see the beginning of a confused start on his face before the flash, and a loud clap uncomfortable almost to the point of pain.

Sedge slides back against the wall, his face caught in the eternal surprise of death. Blood begins to trickle from his nose, his eyes, his ears, his mouth. The skin of his face blooms red. It will look like a bloated purple mass in only minutes.
entries.zh:
你流畅地掏出一枚手雷，手指轻划将当量调至最低，随即朝 Sedge 头部轻轻抛去。在爆炸发出闪光前，你看到他脸上才开始浮现出困惑的表情，紧接着是一声令人耳膜刺痛的巨响。

Sedge 沿着墙壁滑落，面容永远凝固在死亡的惊愕中。鲜血开始从他的鼻孔、眼眶、耳道与嘴角渗出。他的面部皮肤迅速泛红，估计不出几分钟就会肿成青紫色的肉团。

entries.en:
In one smooth motion you draw and activate your ceramic vibroknife, sweeping it in an arc which intersects Sedge's throat. There is no resistance.

With a wet sigh, his body slides back against the wall, his face down, his eyes staring blankly up at you, his expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.
entries.zh:
你流畅地抽出陶瓷振动匕首并激活，随即挥出一道弧线划过 Sedge 的咽喉，全程毫无阻力。

随着一声湿漉漉的叹息，他的身体沿着墙壁滑落，脸庞低垂，双眼空洞地朝上瞪视，面容凝固在茫然的惊愕之中。

entries.en:
In a motion born of long hours of training, your leg snaps toward Sedge at the speed of thought. It meets the center of his head with full force, cracking his head back in a violent jerk.

A single shudder passes through his body, from his thick neck, already purpling from devastated bone and tissue, to his booted feet. His head slumps to the side at an unnatural angle, blood running from what remains of his nose, and his mouth and eyes.
entries.zh:
在经过长久训练的本能驱使下，你的腿电光火石的速度踢向 Sedge。全部力量正中他的头颅中央，使其头部在剧烈的猛颤中向后折断。

一阵战栗自上而下穿过他的身子，从那因骨骼与组织毁损而泛紫的颈部，到包裹着靴子的双脚。他的头颅以不自然的姿态歪向一侧，血液从残破的鼻孔、口腔与眼眶中涌出。

entries.en:
In one smooth motion you raise your hand and activate the poison spray, angling upward and away from the bleeding body of Bornanew. A misting of the air disappears in a blink as if it were never there.

With a wet cough and a whining, choking sound, Sedge's body slides back against the wall. His eyes blink once at you, expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.
entries.zh:
你流畅地抬手激活毒雾进行喷射，角度向上避开 Bornanew 流血的身躯。一阵雾气在眨眼间消散无踪，仿佛从未存在。

随着一声湿咳与窒息般的呜咽，Sedge 的身体沿着墙壁滑落。他朝你眨了一次眼，面容凝固在茫然的惊愕之中。

entries.en:
In one smooth motion you draw your sword and sweep it in an arc intersecting Sedge's throat.

With a wet sigh, his body slides back against the wall, his face down, his eyes staring blankly up at you, his expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.
entries.zh:
你流畅地抽出佩剑，随即挥出一道弧线，剑锋划过 Sedge 的咽喉。

随着一声湿漉漉的叹息，他的身体沿着墙壁滑落，脸庞低垂，双眼空洞地朝上瞪视，面容凝固在茫然的惊愕之中。

entries.en:
In one smooth motion you draw the false fingertip of the monomolecular wire and throw it in an arc which intersects Sedge's neck. There is no resistance.

With a wet sigh, his body slides back against the wall, his head askew. His eyes blink once at you, expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.
entries.zh:
你流畅地弹出单分子线伪装的指尖，随即抛出一道弧线，缠绕割过 Sedge 的脖颈，全程毫无阻力。

随着一声湿漉漉的叹息，他的身体沿着墙壁滑落，脸庞低垂，双眼空洞地朝上瞪视，面容凝固在茫然的惊愕之中。

entries.en:
Bornanew lives, by a thread.

In the moments since the exchange, a time hollowed out by violence and filled with the fleeting intensity of adrenaline, your security team appears.

Finding you unhurt, they attach stabilization packs and trauma strips to the fallen Knight. He's left an incredible pool of blood in the cheap apartment. It drips down the narrow stairs.

The other two bodies lie dead.

It is unclear how fully Ulmus Pond was exploited by or truly believed in the Pather cause, but his loyalty - if he ever had any - died with him.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 还活着，但已命悬一线。

在暴力掏空的短暂时刻里，肾上腺素带来的强烈感知尚未消退，你的安保小队已赶到现场。

确认你没有受伤后，他们为倒地的骑士固定了稳定气囊与创伤贴条。他在廉价公寓里留下了触目惊心的血泊，鲜血正沿着狭窄的楼梯滴落。

另外两具尸体已无生命迹象。

尚不清楚 Ulmus Pond 究竟是被左径事业所利用，还是真心信仰，但他的忠诚 —— 若曾经存在的话 —— 已随其性命一同消逝。

entries.en:
You carry Bornanew's leather satchel to the shuttle. Your team carries his unconscious body.

As it lifts, he is laid across several seats. The designated medic keeps close watch over the small ad-hoc network of medical machines.

Bornanew's datapad opens to your touch, allowing you to access the coordinates given by Ulmus Pond. And a recording of the brief interrogation. $global.jethroName planned for the possibility of his incapacitation, or death. And gave you access to his work.
entries.zh:
你拎着 Bornanew 的皮质挎包登上穿梭机，你的小队抬着他失去意识的身体。

升空时，他被平放在几个座椅上。随行医护紧盯临时搭建的小型医疗设备网络。

Bornanew 的数据平板在你触碰下解锁，允许你访问 Ulmus Pond 提供的坐标，以及那段简短审讯的录音。$global.jethroName 预见到了自己丧失行动能力或死亡的可能性，因而向你开放了他的工作资料。

entries.en:
A medical team rushes past you, to Bornanew, as you step out onto your flagship.

He'll live, you are assured. But it'll hurt; this is left unsaid by your flagship's chief medical officer.

It is quite clear to you now that this is a Pather conspiracy, and they will kill to keep it from unravelling. Your next step is to the source of the fake relic: a lonely orbit on the fringe of the Persean Sector.

In the $bffi_patherStationSystem.
entries.zh:
医疗队从你身旁冲过，奔向 Bornanew，此时你已踏上旗舰。

他性命无虞，这是你得到的保证。但痛苦在所难免；旗舰医疗主管对此缄口不言。

此刻你已经完全明了，这是左径分子的阴谋，他们将不惜杀戮以掩盖真相。下一步便是前往伪造圣物的源头：位于英仙座星域边缘星区的一处孤寂的轨道。

就在 $bffi_patherStationSystem 星系。

entries.en:
Bornanew's datapad trembles in Pond's hands. He cannot designate a star system until Bornanew holds the pad steady for him.

"This Pather, Ulmus," Bornanew says, glancing at the datapad then placing it in his satchel. The threat retreats from his voice. "Tell us his name."

Tears stream down Ulmus' face; the man looks deflated, and absolutely defeated. Then he looks up and his eyes go wide.

"Sedge!"
entries.zh:
Bornanew 的数据平板在 Pond 手中颤抖。直到 Bornanew 帮他稳住数据平板，他才得以指定一个星系。

"这个左径分子，Ulmus，" Bornanew 瞥了眼数据平板，随即将其揣进包里，语气里的杀意已然敛去，"告诉我们他的名字。"

泪水从 Ulmus 脸上滑落；这男人形容委顿，如同彻底溃败般。随后他猛然抬头，双目圆睁。

"Sedge！"

entries.en:
You stand with Bornanew in an uncomfortably narrow alley. The sky above sends nasty rivulets of fluid down the conduits and moldy canopies that diffuse the light into a flattening murk.

Your security team is invisible, discreet in nearby alcoves and rooftops.

$global.jethroName runs his hands over a door, as if feeling under it's moisture-warped surface for a clue.
entries.zh:
你与 Bornanew 站在一条狭窄得令人不适的巷道里。顶上的天空将污浊的流体沿管道与霉变的雨棚滴落，将光线散射成一片单调的昏蒙。

你的安保小队隐没在附近的壁龛与屋顶，悄无声息。

$global.jethroName 双手抚过一扇门，仿佛是在潮湿变形的表面之下探寻线索。

entries.en: "Ready, captain?" he asks. "Remember, you're the good guy."
entries.zh: "准备好了，舰长？" 他问。"记得，你是唱红脸的。"

entries.en: "Ready, captain?" he asks. "Remember, you're the bad guy."
entries.zh: "准备好了，舰长？" 他问。"记住，你是唱白脸的。"

entries.en: Bornanew takes a step back then slams a powerful leg into a worn spot, about waist-high. With a sharp crack, the entire door falls inward, crumbling hinges and locking mechanism still attached.
entries.zh: Bornanew 后退一步，随即以强劲的腿力猛踹门上一处约齐腰高的磨损部位。随着刺耳的碎裂声，整扇门向内倒塌，铰链与锁具仍残留在崩毁的门框上。

entries.en: "I am," he says.
entries.zh: "明白，" 他答道。

entries.en:
Bornanew charges inside. You follow his steps through an entryway, plastic rain cloaks mildewing, through a prefab kitchen and wash unit stained the yellow of old teeth. A sitting area, chair toppled. There's a muffled thump from above.

Bornanew glances at you, his eyes giving a bounce upwards. Ulmus Pond.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 冲进屋内。你随他穿过门廊，塑料的雨披已生霉斑，你们经过预制厨房与泛着旧牙般黄渍的洗漱单元，来到椅子翻倒的起居区，楼上随即传来闷响。

Bornanew 瞥向你，眼神向上一挑。Ulmus Pond。

entries.en:
A moment of frantic search reveals the narrow stairwell behind a loose wall-panel.

Bornanew pounds up the stairs, and you follow.

In his half-second lead, Bornanew has caught Ulmus Pond in a bearhug, Pond's skinny arms still grabbing at the loosened attachment-points of a sheet of translucent plastic which lies between him and the lightwell; escape. Pond loses his grip with a cry of despair as Bornanew pulls him away.

The window panel snaps back into place.
entries.zh:
片刻急促搜索后，你们发现松动的墙板后藏着狭窄的楼梯井。

Bornanew 冲上楼梯，你紧随其后。

他抢先半秒，已用熊抱擒住 Ulmus Pond，后者瘦削的双臂仍抓着那片半透明塑料板的松动接合处，塑料板横在他与采光井之间，那是逃生通道。当 Bornanew 将他拖离时，Pond 在绝望的哭喊中松脱了手。

窗板 '啪' 地弹回原位。

o.en: Find where Ulmus Pond is hiding
o.zh: 寻找 Ulmus Pond 正藏在哪儿

entries.en:
"Ulmus Pond," Bornanew roars with overbearing gusto, "This is no season to be opening a window!"

"Sit, I insist, before you hurt yourself! We are doubly blessed to find you so well. You must understand our fear- no answer to comms, rumors of kidnappings... Menes has been worried sick about his very good friend."

The bear-hug has turned into something like a side-grab as Bornanew sets Pond bodily onto the cot beside him. You're not sure if the creaking is from the cheap furniture or Pond' ribs.
entries.zh:
"Ulmus Pond，" Bornanew 放肆地大吼道，"这可不是开窗透气的时候！"

"听我的，赶紧坐下，别伤着自己！能看到你安然无恙，我们真是喜出望外。你得理解我们的担心 —— 通讯彻底失联，绑架的流言满天飞...Menes 都快为他最好的朋友担心坏了。"

方才的熊抱渐渐变成了侧身挟持，Bornanew 硬是把 Pond 按到身旁的行军床上。你听着那咯吱作响的动静，说不清这声音是廉价家具在呻吟，还是 Pond 的肋骨在响。

o.en: More than worried. He suspects you, Pond. We're going to get answers.
o.zh: 不止是担心。他还怀疑你，Pond。我们得有个答复。

o.en: Easy $global.jethroName. Ulmus only had good intentions I'm sure.
o.zh: 冷静点 $global.jethroName。我相信 Ulmus 只是出于好意。

entries.en:
"A- answers?" Pond's eyes go wider still as he gasps for breath. "I, um, appreciate your concern but I'm fine, here. Nothing is the matter, truly!"

"Look at him, captain," Bornanew says. "He's an innocent. He'd tell us straightaway if some ill-intentioned party were taking advantage of his good nature."
entries.zh:
"什么答案？" Pond 一边急促地喘气，眼睛睁得更大了，"我、呃，谢谢你们关心，我在这儿挺好的。真的，没出任何事！"

"舰长你看，" Bornanew 说道，"他就是个老实人。要是有不怀好意的家伙想利用他这份善良，他肯定会直接跟我们说的。"

o.en: No, I think Ulmus is behind it. We should do an active scan on his brain.
o.zh: 不，我觉得是 Ulmus 在背后搞鬼。我们得对他的大脑做一次主动扫描。

o.en: Perhaps you're right, he does look pretty innocent.
o.zh: 或许你说得对，他看起来一脸无辜。

entries.en:
Bornanew tips his head, giving you a confused look.

"The good captain here thought someone," he pauses to give you a consternated expression, "-might be taking advantage of Menes. $PlayerHeOrShe wants to eliminate all suspects."

"I, for one, insisted to Menes that you must be the victim of some terrible scheme, and that I would pray for you, and, better yet, as a Knight of Ludd carry out my sworn duty to protect the faithful and innocent alike."

Bornanew gives Pond a squeeze to emphasize how safe he is, now.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 歪了歪头，一脸困惑地看向你。

"咱们这位好心的舰长觉得，有人 ——" 他顿了顿，冲你露出一副忧心忡忡的神情，"—— 可能在利用 Menes。$PlayerHeOrShe打算把所有嫌疑人都一网打尽。"

"至于我，我可是跟 Menes 再三强调，你肯定是陷入了某个歹毒的圈套。我还说会为你祈祷，而且啊，身为一名卢德骑士，我更要履行自己的神圣誓言，守护所有虔诚向善、清白无辜的人。"

Bornanew 用力握了握 Pond 的肩膀，像是在强调他现在已经安全了。

o.en: Ulmus is behind it. We should perform an active scan on his brain.
o.zh: 是 Ulmus 在背后搞鬼。我们得对他的大脑做一次主动扫描。

o.en: On second thought, I don't think Ulmus had anything to do with it.
o.zh: 仔细想了下，我觉得这事跟 Ulmus 一点关系都没有。

entries.en:
"Ulmus?" Bornanew looks at you, shocked at the idea.

"...'active' scan?" Ulmus manages to squeak.

"The captain would never," insists Bornanew. "You're a merchant, a middleman. You just wanted to help your friend Menes find a unique object for his collection. Isn't that right?" He gives Ulmus another squeeze.

"Y-yes, that's right," Ulmus says, looking between you and Bornanew. "I, uh, I set up connections. Deals. I help people!"
entries.zh:
"Ulmus？" Bornanew 看向你，这个想法让他面露震惊。

"...'主动' 扫描？" Ulmus 勉强挤出一丝尖细的声音。

"舰长绝不会这么做的。" Bornanew 一口咬定，"你就是个商人，一个中间人而已。你只是想帮你的朋友 Menes 找件稀罕物，充实他的收藏，对吧？" 他又用力捏了下 Ulmus。

"是... 是这样的，没错。" Ulmus 说着，目光在你和 Bornanew 之间游移，"我、呃，我就是牵线搭桥。我只是帮人忙而已！"

o.en: So you admit you 'helped' Menes buy a fake relic from the Pathers!
o.zh: 这么说你承认了，是你 '帮' Menes 从左径分子手里买下了那件假圣物！

entries.en:
Bornanew tips his head, giving you a confused look.

"The captain here told me," he pauses to give you a consternated expression, "-he thought you were working for Pathers, to sell Menes a fake relic to cause discord and make off with his credits. The captain told me $playerHeOrShe wanted to test an invasive brain-interfacer $playerHeOrShe found in some ruin on the fringe to discover the truth inside your head."

Pond's eyes go wide at the mention of 'brain-interface'.

"I, for one," Bornanew says reassuringly, "insisted that the plan was crude and unnecessary. Surely you're the victim of a terrible scheme..."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 歪了歪头，一脸困惑地看向你。

"咱们这位舰长告诉我，" 他顿了顿，冲你露出一副忧心忡忡的神情，"—— 他怀疑你在为左径分子效力，故意卖给 Menes 一件假圣物，挑起纷争后卷走他的星币。舰长还说，$playerHeOrShe打算用一台在边缘星区废墟里找到的入侵式的脑部扫描仪做测试，逼你吐露藏在脑子里的真相。"

一听到 "大脑扫描仪"，Pond 顿时双眼圆睁。

"至于我，" Bornanew 语气温和地安抚道，"我一直坚持认为这个计划既拙劣又毫无必要。你显然是陷入了某个歹毒的圈套..."

o.en: Ah... yes, that's right. We really should try the brain-interfacer.
o.zh: 啊... 对，没错。我们确实该试试那个脑部扫描仪。

entries.en:
"I didn't know they were Pathers!" Pond shouts.

Bornanew pretends shock at the notion, looking at Ulmus and shaking his head.

"Or that it was a fake! I swear, I'm a legitimate entrepreneur! I've been set up. I have enemies, Menes has enemies, they- they must have set me up!"
entries.zh:
"我当时根本不知道他们是左径分子！"Pond 大喊。

Bornanew 闻言，故作震惊地看着 Ulmus，连连摇头。

"我也不知道那东西是假的！我发誓，我就是个正经的生意人！我是被人陷害的。我树敌不少，Menes 也有仇家，一定是他们 —— 一定是他们设计陷害我的！"

o.en: Yet you ran. Right back to your Pather masters on Chalcedon.
o.zh: 可你还是跑了。径直逃回你在 Chalcedon 的左径主子身边去了。

entries.en:
Bornanew tips his head, giving you a confused look.

"Now's not the time to play coy, captain. Your illegal brain-interfacer," he stresses the words, "which you proposed could 'scientifically prove' Pond's connection to a Pather network with only 'minimal damage'."

Pond looks rapidly between you and Bornanew, both scared and confused. "Minimal da-" he begins, then shifts course to avoid the subject entirely. "I didn't know they were Pathers!" he pleads.

"Or that it was a fake! I swear, I'm a legitimate entrepreneur. There's no need for brain-scans or, or- I've been set up! I have enemies, Menes has enemies, they- they must have set me up!"
entries.zh:
Bornanew 歪了歪头，一脸困惑地看向你。

"现在可不是装糊涂的时候，舰长。你那台非法的脑部扫描仪，" 他特意加重了语气，"就是你说能 '以最小损伤，科学证明' Pond 和左径分子有牵连的那玩意儿。"

Pond 慌忙在你和 Bornanew 之间来回张望，满脸惊恐又茫然。"小损伤 ——" 他刚开口，又立刻岔开了话题，"我当时根本不知道他们是左径分子！"他急切地辩解。

"我也不知道那东西是假的！我发誓，我就是个正经的生意人。根本没必要搞什么脑部扫描，更别提 —— 我是被人陷害的！我树敌不少，Menes 也有仇家，一定是他们 —— 一定是他们设计陷害我的！"

o.en: But you ran, Ulmus. Right back to your Pather masters here on Chalcedon.
o.zh: 但是你还是跑了，Ulmus。径直逃回你在 Chalcedon 的左径主子身边去了。

entries.en:
"I-I had no... you don't understand," Ulmus squirms.

Bornanew jumps in to direct Ulmus' narrative. "He must have been threatened," he says. "Blackmail! Of course. You help us find out who's really behind this! We'll make sure you're safe."
entries.zh:
"我...我根本没有...你不明白。" Ulmus 扭动着身体辩解道。

Bornanew 立刻插话，主导着 Ulmus 的陈述走向："他肯定是受到了威胁，" 他说道，"是勒索！没错。你帮我们找出这一切的真正幕后黑手！我们保证会护你周全。"

o.en: If, and only if, $global.jethroName, he helps us. Otherwise he goes to the Inquisitors.
o.zh: $global.jethroName，有且只有一个条件 —— 他必须配合我们。不然的话，就把他交给审判官。

entries.en:
"Surely there is no need to bring them in it," Bornanew puts on a look of saintly compassion.

"I know in my heart that Ulmus wants to confess and be absolved of his sins, of his crimes. He wants to leave this terrible time behind him and live a good life."

Pond's eyes go teary. "Y-yes, yes. I'll confess! I'll do penance, I'll pray! I'll tell you whatever you need. By Ludd, I beg forgiveness!"
entries.zh:
"实在没必要把他们牵扯进来。" Bornanew 摆出一副圣洁悲悯的神情。

"我打心底里清楚，Ulmus 是有心忏悔，赎清自己的罪孽与过错的。他盼着能摆脱这段不堪的过往，好好过完往后的日子。"

Pond 的眼眶泛起了泪光。"是... 是的，没错。我愿意忏悔！我愿意苦修赎罪，我愿意虔诚祷告！你们想知道什么，我都坦白！以卢德之名，我乞求宽恕！"

entries.en:
Pond sniffles.

"There was... a Walker of the Path. He asked me to talk to Menes, to, to, to make the offer. He said Menes couldn't resist an artifact of such quality. And- and I was to arrange transport. Then make it appear legitimate. Set the documents straight, make it look correct."

Bornanew draws his cheap datapad from his satchel, the screen already set to a map of the greater Persean Sector.
entries.zh:
Pond 吸了吸鼻子。

"当时... 有个左径使者找上门。他让我去游说 Menes，去、去促成这笔交易。他说 Menes 绝对抵挡不住一件如此成色的圣物的诱惑。而且 —— 而且还得由我来安排运输。之后要把整件事做得天衣无缝，把相关文件都伪造得天衣无缝，看起来毫无破绽。"

Bornanew 从挎包里掏出他那台廉价的数据平板，屏幕上已经显示着英仙座星域的星图。

o.en: Show him, Ulmus. It's us or the Inquisitors.
o.zh: 告诉他，Ulmus。要么跟我们合作，要么就等着被交给审判官。

entries.en:
"Are you man, or a bit of vermin slipping out the window?" Bornanew bellows as he lifts Pond bodily, setting him on a sagging cot. You're not sure if the creak is the cheap furniture or Pond's ribs.

"The Knights have sent me a long way," his voice lowers threateningly, "to deal with you. Pray your answers are to my liking lest I deliver you unto the Knight Inquisitors. They have methods of seeking truth hidden far from God's merciful light."
entries.zh:
"你算个男人，还是只知钻窗逃窜的鼠辈？" Bornanew 怒吼着，把 Pond 整个人拎起来，扔到一张摇摇晃晃的行军床上。那咯吱作响的动静，你分不清是这廉价家具发出来的，还是 Pond 的肋骨在响。

"骑士团派我远道而来，" 他的声音压低，透着威胁的意味，"就是为了收拾你。祈祷你的回答能让我满意吧，否则我就把你交给骑士审判官。他们有的是办法，能挖出那些藏在神明慈悲目光之外的真相。"

o.en: Easy $global.jethroName. Ulmus only had good intentions I'm sure.
o.zh: 冷静点 $global.jethroName。我相信 Ulmus 只是出于好意

o.en: Why wait for them? My techs can simply open up his brain...
o.zh: 何必等他们？我的技术人员直接把他的脑子撬开就行...

entries.en:
Pond's eyes go large and pleading- with his escape closed off, you are his only salvation.

"Yes, yes," he speaks quickly. "The captain has it right! Menes, he wanted something special. I'm just a middleman, a, a communicator. I just make deals!"

He licks his lips, looking between you and Bornanew, "Menes was so pleased, I had no idea it wasn't real. I'm no relic-dealer or, or a curate or- you have to believe me, I'm innocent!"
entries.zh:
Pond 双眼圆睁，眼神里满是哀求 —— 逃生的路已经被堵死，你成了他唯一的救命稻草。

"是是是，" 他语速飞快地说道，"舰长说得没错！是 Menes，他就想要件稀罕玩意儿。我只是个中间人，一个传话的而已。我不过就是牵线搭桥做买卖！"

他舔了舔嘴唇，目光在你和 Bornanew 之间游移不定，"Menes 当时开心得不行，我根本不知道那东西是假的。我可不是什么圣物贩子，也不是什么祭司 —— 你们一定要相信我，我是无辜的！"

entries.en:
Pond's eyes go large, his face pale, his breaths coming in sharp gasps.

Bornanew tips his head at Pond and gives you a confused and consternated look.

"No, no," Pond pleads at you, "No, no need for that, I'll- you see, it wasn't me, this is all a misunderstanding. I make deals. I'm a great communicator. Menes will tell you. It was business, just business!"
entries.zh:
Pond 双眼圆睁，脸色煞白，呼吸急促得如同喘息。

Bornanew 冲 Pond 歪了歪头，又转头看向你，脸上满是困惑与忧虑的神情。

"别，别这样，" Pond 向你哀求道，"不，没必要这么做，我... 你要知道，这不是我的错，一切都是误会。我只是个做买卖的，最擅长的就是牵线搭桥。Menes 可以为我作证。这只是一桩生意，纯粹的生意而已！"

o.en: I apologize, Ulmus. It was a joke. I believe you.
o.zh: 我向你道歉，Ulmus。刚刚是开玩笑的，我相信你。

o.en: $global.jethroName, look, we're going to have to switch this up.
o.zh: $global.jethroName，听着，我们得调整一下计划。"  #"真窝囊。要不我直接崩了他？" (伸手去摸腰间的配枪)  #"Pathetic. How about I just shoot him?" (reach for your sidearm)  #"Pathetic. How about I just shoot him?" (reach for your sidearm)  #"Pathetic. How about I just shoot him?" (reach for your sidearm)  #"Pathetic. How about I just shoot him? (reach for your sidearm)

entries.en:
"You confess you knew 'it' was fake," Bornanew growls. "We haven't even told you of what you are accused. You are stained with guilt!"

Pond seems to shrink under Bornanew's accusations.
entries.zh:
"你亲口承认了，你早就知道 '那东西' 是假的。" Bornanew 怒声低吼，"我们甚至都还没告诉你，你被指控的罪名是什么。你身上的罪孽已经昭然若揭！"

在 Bornanew 的厉声指控下，Pond 整个人仿佛都缩成了一团。

o.en: They must have threatened you, Ulmus. You wouldn't hurt anybody.
o.zh: 他们肯定是威胁你了，Ulmus。你不会去伤害别人。

o.en: Knight Bornanew is right. You're guilty and deserve punishment.
o.zh: Bornanew 骑士说得对。你有罪，理应受到惩罚。

entries.en:
"Yes, that's it!" Pond cries, "They said they'd do terrible things if I didn't cooperate! Torture, murder, terrible things. Pathers will do anything!"

"Pather heretics," Bornanew says, his voice icy. "You do know, Ulmus Pond, how we Knights deal with Pather heretics?" Bornanew stands and reaches into his satchel.

Pond goes paler, somehow. "N-no, no. I'll confess! I'll do penance, I'll pray! I'll tell you whatever you want. Tell him!" He looks to you.
entries.zh:
"对，就是这样！" Pond 大喊道，"他们说我要是不配合，就会要我好看！酷刑、谋杀，全是些丧尽天良的勾当。左径分子什么都做得出来！"

"左径异端，" Bornanew 开口，声音冰冷刺骨，"你应该很清楚吧，Ulmus Pond，我们骑士团是怎么处置左径异端的？" Bornanew 站起身，伸手往包里摸索。

Pond 的脸色雪上加霜，白得不能再白了。"不... 不要。我全都招！我愿意苦修赎罪，我愿意虔诚祷告！你们想知道什么，我都坦白！快帮我说句话啊！" 他眼巴巴地看向你。

o.en: We want to help. Tell us who did this to you, Ulmus.
o.zh: 我们想帮你的。告诉我们是谁做了这些，Ulmus。

o.en: The Knights punish heretics. Forgiveness is for God.
o.zh: 骑士团惩戒异端。宽恕与否，唯有神能定夺。

entries.en:
Bornanew gives a consternated shake of his head. Pond, terrified, looks between you and Bornanew.

"The Captain," Bornanew says, "wanted to put you into protective custody. Said you wouldn't hurt anyone, you were threatened." Bornanew meets your eyes again and says, deliberately, "I don't believe you."

"But that's it!" Pond cries, "They said they'd- Pathers will do anything!"

"Pathers," Bornanew says, his voice icy. "You do know, Ulmus Pond, how we Knights deal with those heretics." Bornanew reaches into his satchel.

Pond goes paler, somehow. "N-no, no. I'll confess! I'll do penance, I'll pray! Tell him!" He looks to you.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 满脸忧虑地摇了摇头。Pond 吓得魂不守舍，目光在你和 Bornanew 之间来回游移。

"舰长，" Bornanew 开口说道，"本想把你送去保护性羁押，说你本性不坏，只是受人胁迫。" 他再次迎上你的目光，一字一句地沉声说道："我不信你这套说辞。"

"可我说的全是实话啊！" Pond 失声大喊，"他们说要 —— 左径分子是什么事都做得出来的！"

"左径分子，" Bornanew 开口，声音冰冷刺骨，"你应该很清楚吧，Ulmus Pond，我们骑士团是怎么处置左径异端的？" Bornanew 站起身，伸手往包里摸索。

Pond 的脸色白得不能再白了。"不... 不要。我全都招！我愿意苦修赎罪，虔诚祷告！快帮我求求情！" 他眼巴巴地看向你。

o.en: We want to help. Tell us who did this to you, Ulmus.
o.zh: 我们想帮你的。告诉我们是谁做了这些，Ulmus。

o.en: The Knights punish heretics. Forgiveness is for God.
o.zh: 骑士团惩戒异端。宽恕与否，唯有神能定夺。

entries.en:
"There was... a Walker of the Path," Pond sputters. "The Luddic Path."

"He told me to talk to Menes, to, to make the offer. He said a Mammonite couldn't resist an object of such unique quality. And- and I was to arrange transport from the Fringe. Make it appear legitimate. Set the documents straight."

Bornanew draws his cheap datapad from his satchel, the screen already set to a map of the greater Persean Sector.
entries.zh:
"当时... 有个左径的循道者找上门。" Pond 结结巴巴地说道，"就是卢德左径的人。"

"他让我去游说 Menes，去、去促成这笔交易。他说像他那样的玛门之仆绝对抵挡不住一件如此成色的货物的诱惑。而且 —— 而且还得由我来安排从边缘星区出发的运输。之后要把整件事做得天衣无缝，把相关文件都伪造得天衣无缝。"

Bornanew 从挎包里掏出他那台廉价的数据平板，屏幕上早已显示出英仙座星域的星图。

o.en: Show him, Ulmus. Who's behind this. Where.
o.zh: 指给他看，Ulmus。幕后主使是谁，藏在哪里。

o.en: This is how you make it out of here alive, Ulmus. Show him.
o.zh: 这是你活着离开这儿的唯一办法，Ulmus。指给他看。

entries.en:
Bornanew gives you a warning look. Pond simply deflates, looking utterly lost. "There was... a Walker," he sputters. "Of the Luddic Path."

"He told me to talk to Menes, to, to make the offer. He said a Mammonite couldn't resist an object of such unique quality. And- and I was to arrange transport from the Fringe. Make it appear legitimate. Set the documents straight."

Bornanew draws his cheap datapad from his satchel, the screen already set to a map of the greater Persean Sector.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 向你投来一记警告的眼神。Pond 整个人瞬间蔫了下去，神情茫然无措。"当时... 有个循道者找上门。" 他结结巴巴地说道，"信奉卢德左径的。"

"他让我去游说 Menes，去、去促成这笔交易。他说像他那样的玛门之仆绝对抵挡不住一件如此成色的货物的诱惑。而且 —— 而且还得由我来安排从边缘星区出发的运输。之后要把整件事做得天衣无缝，把相关文件都伪造得天衣无缝。"

Bornanew 从挎包里掏出他那台廉价的数据平板，屏幕上早已显示出英仙座星域的星图。

o.en: Show him, Ulmus. Who's behind this. Where.
o.zh: 指给他看，Ulmus。幕后主使是谁，藏在哪里。

o.en: This is how you make it out of here alive, Ulmus. Show him.
o.zh: 这是你活着离开这儿的唯一办法，Ulmus。指给他看。

entries.en:
Bornanew sighs deeply, dropping his previous countenance, and looks at you with almost a sadness in his eyes. "This is not as we agreed. I ask now that you stand aside and allow me to complete this unsavory task."

With that, his face goes blank and he turns, seizing Pond by the neck with one hand and lifting him off the cot with a choked sound.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 重重地叹了口气，敛去了之前的神色，眼神里带着几近悲悯的情绪看向你。"事情的发展偏离了我们的约定。我现在要求你让开，好让我完成这项令人不快的任务。"

话音刚落，他的神情变得面无表情。随即转身，单手扼住 Pond 的脖颈，伴随着一声窒息般的闷响，将他从行军床上拎了起来。

entries.en:
"Ulmus," he growls and, with his other hand Bornanew lifts his cheap datapad to within reach of Pond's flailing arms. The screen is already set to a map of the greater Persean Sector.

"Show us where the glove came from. Then you may breathe."
entries.zh:
"Ulmus，" 他低吼一声，随即 Bornanew 腾出另一只手，将自己那台廉价的数据平板举到 Pond 胡乱挥舞的手臂能够得着的地方。屏幕上早已显示出英仙座星域的星图。

"指给我们看，那只手套是从哪儿来的。说了，你才能活命。"

entries.en: "What, it seems, I must," he says flatly.
entries.zh: "看来，我是非这么做不可了。" 他语气平淡地说道。

entries.en:
Bornanew's datapad trembles in Pond's hands. He cannot designate a star system until Bornanew concedes by lowering him back onto the cot.

Gasping and choking, Pond marks a system. It is difficult to make out his words. Something about "pather".

"This Pather, Ulmus," Bornanew says, glancing at the datapad then placing it in his satchel. "Tell us his name."

Tears stream down Ulmus' face; the man looks deflated, and absolutely defeated. Then he looks up and his eyes go wide.

"Sedge!" he rasps.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 的数据平板在 Pond 手中颤抖。除非 Bornanew 松手把他放回那张简陋的床上，否则他根本没法指定任何星系。

Pond 气喘吁吁、喉咙发紧，终于标记了一个星系。他的话含混不清，好像提到了 "左径分子"。

"这个左径分子，Ulmus，" Bornanew 瞥了眼数据平板，随即将其揣进包里，语气里的杀意已然敛去，"告诉我们他的名字。"

泪水从 Ulmus 脸上滑落；这男人形容委顿，如同彻底溃败般。随后他猛然抬头，双目圆睁。

"Sedge！" 他嘶哑地喊道。

entries.en:
Bornanew's datapad trembles in Pond's hands. He cannot designate a star system until Bornanew concedes by lowering him back onto the cot.

Gasping and choking, Pond marks a system. It is difficult to make out his words. Something about "pather".

"This Pather, Ulmus," Bornanew says, glancing at the datapad then placing it in his satchel. "Tell us his name."

Tears stream down Ponds' face; the man looks deflated, and absolutely defeated. "Sedge," he rasps, finally.

Bornanew shoots a look at you.
entries.zh:
Bornanew 的数据平板在 Pond 手中颤抖。除非 Bornanew 松手把他放回简易床，否则他根本没法指定任何星系。

Pond 气喘吁吁、喉咙发紧，终于标记了一个星系。他的话含混不清，好像提到了 "左径分子"。

"这个左径分子，Ulmus，" Bornanew 瞥了眼数据平板，随即将其揣进包里，语气里的杀意已然敛去，"告诉我们他的名字。"

Pond 泪流满面，整个人瘫软下来，脸上写满了彻底的绝望。"Sedge。" 他最终哑声回答。

Bornanew 猛地转过头来看向你。

o.en: I recall handling that problem already.
o.zh: 我记得我已经解决这个问题了。

entries.en: "You're sure?" $global.jethroName's voice is flat.
entries.zh: "你确定？" $global.jethroName 的语气平淡无波。

o.en: No. I, uh, believe Ulmus only ever had good intentions. Right?
o.zh: 不。我，呃，觉得 Ulmus 一直都是处于好心，对吧？

o.en: Yes. I'm sure you can handle it.
What's Ulmus Pond's role? What does finding him do for us?
o.zh: Ulmus Pond 扮演了什么角色？找到他对我们有什么用？

o.en: What if these are pirates, or a major faction misleading us?
o.zh: 要是这些是海盗，或者是某个主要势力在误导我们呢？

o.en: Before we act, let us speak of your Knights' 'sources'.
o.zh: 动手之前，咱们先说说你们骑士的 '资源'。

o.en: Could your queries have revealed our intentions?
o.zh: 你的那些打探会不会已经暴露了我们的意图？

entries.en:
"It is always possible." Bornanew meets your eyes, steady. "The Knights pursue heretics and criminals as routine, and my inquiries were worded to imply my interest lay not upon Ulmus Pond himself, nor the Menes situation. Though, of course, you and I are already known to be associated with both."

"Expediency anticipates risk. I beg you trust my judgment in this matter."
entries.zh:
"这种可能性一直存在。" Bornanew 目光坚定地与你对视，"骑士追捕异端和罪犯本就是例行公事，我提问时特意措辞，让人觉得我的关注点既不在 Ulmus Pond 本人身上，也不在 Menes 的事态上。但你我与这两者的关联，显然早已是人尽皆知。"

"想要高效行事必须考虑风险。还请你相信我在这件事上的判断。"

entries.en:
"I cannot," he says. "But I assure you they are as reliable as any heretic, guilty soul, or criminal." His look softens, "Do trust that I am not simply asking around a spacer bar for a lead."

A moment, then he gives a nod, almost a bow. "Um. I do not condemn your methods. Your directness has oft proven effectual."
entries.zh:
"我不能保证，" 他说道，"但我可以告诉你，这些资源，和任何异端或是罪犯一样可靠。" 他的语气缓和下来，"你放心，我可不是在太空酒吧里随便打听线索。"

顿了顿，他微微点头，近乎躬身致意："呃，我不是要指责你的做法。你这种直来直去的方式，向来都很管用。"

entries.en: "It could be either." Bornanew folds his hands together. "But we must look first where the light of truth shines brightest, dim though it may be, or known only by distinction against the shadow of deceit."
entries.zh: "两种情况都有可能。" Bornanew 双手交握，"但我们必须先看向真相之光最亮的地方 —— 即便它微弱不堪，或是只能在欺骗的阴影衬托下才显露出轮廓。"

entries.en: "He would be - have been - well placed as a bridge for some element of the Luddic Path to influence Menes Yaribay. He would be the source of the relic."
entries.zh: "他能够 —— 或者已经成为 —— 卢德左径 中某些人影响 Menes Yaribay 的绝佳桥梁。他就是那件圣物的源头。"

entries.en:
"A reasonable concern." Bornanew rubs his chin. "First and without doubt, a notable member of a Persean League gens is involved."

"The rest are deduction and speculation." He starts counting off fingers, "The Cathedral of Holy Exodus has much to lose if corruption is revealed in their house; I suspect an insider or an infiltrator."

Next finger, "Within the greater Church, there is a loosely organized sect who, ah, back the theological legitimacy of relics. They would doubtless have forceful opinions on the subject of a duplicate relic, and that in secular hands."
entries.zh:
"是个合理的担忧。" Bornanew 摸着下巴。"首先，毫无疑问，有一位 英仙座联盟 旗下氏族中的名人牵涉其中。"

"其余的都是推断和猜测。" 他掰着手指头数道，"如果 Exodus 神圣大教堂内部被揭露存在腐败行为，那他们将损失惨重；而我怀疑是泄密者或间谍。"

他伸出下一根手指，"在更广义的 教会 内部，有一个组织松散的教派，他们，嗯，坚定支持圣物的神学合法性质。面对一件圣物复制品，更别提还是落入世俗之手的复制品，他们无疑会有强烈意见。"

entries.en:
Another finger, "The Luddic Path has much to gain from discord within the Church, and they have proximity to... the problem."

Next finger, "Though it is possible that the criminal underworld has found a means of profit here, possibly Kanta's organization. The pirate queen has an especial taste for desecration, though has demonstrated no particular hatred for the Church beyond her habitual misanthropy." He lets his hands fall.

"Beyond that, I grasp for tenuous threads, captain."
entries.zh:
他又伸出一根手指，"卢德左径 能从教会内部的纷争中拿到很多好处，而且他们与这次...问题关系密切。"

接着是下一根手指，"尽管有可能是作恶多端的黑道集团发现这一行有利可图，或许是 Kanta 那一派。那个海盗女王有着亵渎圣物的特殊癖好，但在一贯的厌世行径以外，她没有表现得特别憎恨教会。" 他垂下了双手。

"除了这些，我就只剩一些微不足道的线索了，舰长。"

entries.en:
"My apologies," he says, opening a battered notebook. "I am unused to this sort of, of bookkeeping."

"Yes, 50,000 upfront, and another 50,000 credits upon resolution. It is hoped that the false artifact might be removed from consideration, one way or another."

He gives you a questioning look. "Without causing an interfactional incident, that is."
entries.zh:
"抱歉，" 他说着，翻开了一本破旧的笔记本。"我不太习惯做这种，这种记账的事。"

"对的，先付 50,000，问题解决后再付 50,000 星币。不管通过何种方式，我们希望这件虚假圣物能被排除出人们的视线之外。"

他用探询的目光看着你。"也就是说，不能引发势力间的冲突。"

o.en: About the matter of your fake relic...
o.zh: 关于你那件假圣物的事...

o.en: I accept. I shall assist you in your, uh, quest.
o.zh: 我接下了。我会在你，嗯，执行任务时协助你。

o.en: Arrange a shuttle for Bornanew and close the comms
o.zh: 为 Bornanew 安排一架穿梭机并关闭通讯

o.en: Just how much penance are they going to make you do?
o.zh: 他们到底要让你做多少赎罪的事？

o.en: It sounds like you don't consider this object to be a legitimate holy relic.
o.zh: 听起来你并不认为这圣物是真的。
和我说说关于你赎罪任务的事。

o.en: Before I agree, I need to know of potential factional conflicts.
o.zh: 在答应之前，我需要了解一下可能存在的势力纠纷。

o.en: Now that I've agreed, I need to know of any potential factional conflicts.
o.zh: 既然我已经答应了，我得了解一下可能存在的势力纠纷。

o.en: I will take my time to consider your request, $global.jethroName.
o.zh: 我会花时间考虑你的请求，$global.jethroName。

o.en: Make some excuse and close the comms.
I will take more time to consider your request, $global.jethroName.
o.zh: 我会再花点时间来考虑你的请求，$global.jethroName。

o.en: Remind me, there was mention of payment...
o.zh: 我想起来，你好像提到了报酬的事...
