entries.en:
As your officers perform routine approach procedures, Comms signals for your attention.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam, there is an incoming link using a Knights of Ludd signifier. A... Jethro Bornanew wishes to speak with you. Just a novice of the Knights, it looks like."
entries.zh:
当你的军官们执行常规接近程序时，通讯设备发出了信号来吸引你的注意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，有人发来了使用卢德骑士团身份标识的通讯链接。一个叫...Jethro Bornanew 的人希望与你通话。看起来只是骑士团的一位新晋骑士。"

entries.en:
"Um. It is so obvious?" Bornanew almost looks guilty. Almost.

"The Reverend Archcurate did say that my feelings on the subject are... not easily veiled."

"This investigation requires discretion." He brings his hands together. "I shall be mindful of my disposition."
entries.zh:
"唔，有那么明显吗？" Bornanew 看起来几乎有些内疚，几乎。

"宗师大人确实说过，我对这个物件的看法...不太容易掩饰。"

"这次调查需要谨慎行事。" 他双手合十。"我会注意自己的态度。"

entries.en:
"This is only the beginning, I am certain," he says with resigned humor. "Violation of Knightly vows is no small falsity, and I am uncertain even that I am truly meant to 'solve' this task set before me."

He pauses, then speaks more quietly, "I fear that my failure might be intended to chasten Jaspis. The Reverend Archcurate, I mean." He looks upward, and lets out a sigh. "She has put altogether too much faith in me."
entries.zh:
"我敢肯定，这只是个开始，" 他带着无可奈何的幽默说。"违反骑士的誓言可不是小错，而且我甚至不确定我是否真的被指望 '解决' 摆在面前的这个任务。"

他停顿了一下，然后更小声地说道，"我担心我的失败可能会被迁就于 Jaspis。我是说，那位宗师大人。" 他向上看了一眼，叹了口气。"她实在太过信任我了。"

entries.en:
"It is... trying," he says. "I am not, I am sure, meant to 'solve' this quest set before me to my violation of Knightly vows. Remorse, contrition... those I give freely, and wholly."

He speaks more quietly, "I speculate that my failure and disgrace is being arranged to humble the influence of the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis." He shakes his head, "She has put altogether too much faith into me."
entries.zh:
"这...很考验人，" 他说道，"我确信，我并没有被指望去 '解决' 这个因我违背骑士誓言而被摆在我面前的任务。至于懊悔与忏罪...我甘愿献上，毫无保留。"

他的声音更低了，"我推测，这些正被安排到我身上的失败和耻辱，就是为了削弱 Jaspis 宗师大人的影响力。"他摇了摇头，"她实在太过信任我了。"

entries.en:
Bornanew puts his hands together, and lowers his head for a moment.

"I thank you for that, captain. In the meantime, I will do what research and inquiries I can with the resources I am provided."

"If you wish to assist my quest, then come to Gilead. The Knights have provided me an entry in the comms directory in order to further my penance."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 将双手合十，低头片刻。

"谢谢你，舰长。在此期间，我会利用已有的资源，尽我所能进行研究和调查。"

"如果你打算帮我完成任务，那就来 Gilead 吧。骑士团向我提供了通讯目录的进入许可，让我能继续进行我的赎罪。"

entries.en:
Bornanew puts his hands together, and lowers his head.

"I understand. If you change your mind, come to Gilead. The Knights have provided me an entry in the comms directory in order to further my penance."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 将双手合十，低下了头。

"我明白了。要是你改变了主意，那就来 Gilead 吧。骑士团向我提供了通讯目录的进入许可，让我能继续进行我的赎罪。"

entries.en:
Bornanew puts his hands together, and lowers his head for a moment.

"I understand. If you change your mind, return here, to Gilead. The Knights have provided me an entry in the comms directory in order to further my penance."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 将双手合十，低头片刻。

"我明白了。要是你改变了主意，那就回来 Gilead 这儿。骑士团向我提供了通讯目录的进入许可，让我能继续进行我的赎罪。"

entries.en:
Bornanew puts his hands together, and lowers his head.

"I thank you for that, captain. In the meantime, I will do what research and inquiries I can with the resources I am provided."

"If you wish to assist me in my quest, contact me here on Gilead. The Knights have provided me an entry in the comms directory in order to further my penance."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 将双手合十，低下了头。

"谢谢你，舰长。在此期间，我会利用已有的资源，尽我所能进行研究和调查。"

"如果你打算在我进行任务时提供帮助，那就来 Gilead 这里联络我。骑士团向我提供了通讯目录的进入许可，让我能继续进行我的赎罪。"

entries.en: "Truly?" He sighs, deflated at this revelation. "The arighting of one errant novice cannot be worth that sum."
entries.zh: "真的？" 他叹了口气，听到这个消息后显得很沮丧。"纠正一个误入迷途的见习修士可不值得花那么多钱。"

entries.en:
"Of course," he says, opening a battered notebook. "The Church anticipates expenses. Well," he grimaces, "Reverend Archcurate Jaspis does."

"Yes, 50,000 upfront, and another 50,000 credits upon satisfactory resolution. It is hoped that the false artifact might be removed from consideration, one way or another."

He gives you a questioning look. "Without causing an interfactional incident, that is."
entries.zh:
"当然，" 他说着，翻开了一本破旧的笔记本。"教会 会预支费用。好吧，" 他皱眉，"是 Jaspis 宗师大人会预支费用。"

"对，先付 50,000，问题解决后再付 50,000 星币。不管通过何种方式，我们希望这件虚假圣物能被排除出人们的视线之外。"

他用探询的目光看着你。"也就是说，不能引发势力间的冲突。"

entries.en: "Yes, it is still an ongoing concern," he says. "Have you given my request more thought?"
entries.zh: "是的，这个问题依然需要处理，" 他说，"你有更仔细地考虑我的请求吗？"

entries.en:
As your officers perform routine approach procedures, Comms signals for your attention.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam, there's an incoming link using a Knights of Ludd signifier. A Jethro Bornanew wishes to speak with you. Just a novice, it looks like."
entries.zh:
当你的军官们执行常规接近程序时，通讯设备发出了信号来吸引你的注意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，有人发来了使用卢德骑士团身份标识的通讯链接。一个叫 Jethro Bornanew 的人希望与你通话。看起来只是位见习修士。"

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName. I do not forget your assistance." He makes a crooked smile.

The link is poor-quality; his voice is hollowed, lacking the warmth you remember.

"I would ask, beg if I must, for your service once more."
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长，我没有忘记你的帮助。" 他露出了一个歪斜的笑容。

链接信号质量很差；他的声音空洞，少了你记忆中的那份温暖。

"我想请求，如果必须的话我会乞求，求你能再帮助我一次。"

entries.en:
"What I ask, it is a part of the penance I must serve." He raises a hand, as if to stop your objections, "I do also believe it will also serve a spiritual and intrinsic good."

"And," he clears his throat, "for your assistance, a substantial reward of credits has been authorized by the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis."

"The service..." He releases a breath. "An object considered holy by some in the mother Church has appeared in the possession of a wealthy collector."
entries.zh:
"我的请求，是我必须进行的苦修的一部分。" 他抬起手，仿佛要阻止你的反对，"我也相信，这同样能带来精神上和本质上的益处。"

"并且，"他清了清嗓子，" 为了酬谢你的协助，Jaspis 宗师大人已经批准了一笔可观的星币奖励。"

"要帮的忙..." 他呼出一口气。"一件被教会母亲中的某些人视为圣物的物品，出现在了一位富有收藏家的手中。"

o.en: Did this collector not make a large enough tithe?
o.zh: 这位收藏家交的什一税不够多吗？

entries.en:
"No," he says, looking up. "That would have been simple. This object, this 'relic', is by all appearances still untouched on Tartessus, in the archives of the Cathedral of Holy Exodus."

"The curates of the archive were in some panic at word that they had lost a holy relic. They checked very, very carefully. I too have personally confirmed that it remains in their keeping."
entries.zh:
"不，" 他说着，抬起了头。"那样反而还简单了。但这件物品，这件 '圣物'，怎么看都还原封不动地保存在 Tartessus，在 Exodus 神圣大教堂的档案室里。"

"档案室的祭司们听说他们弄丢了一件圣物，一度陷入恐慌。他们非常、非常仔细地检查过了。我也亲自确认过，圣物保管在他们那里。"

o.en: So it's a fake. No problem.
o.zh: 所以那是个赝品。没啥大麻烦。

o.en: And this is embarrassing to the Church?

entries.en: "Ah," he gives a weary smile. "The collector is quite secular, and has no relationship with the Church."
entries.zh: "啊，" 他疲惫地笑了笑。"这位收藏家相当世俗，和教会没有任何关联。"

entries.en:
"But it could be," $global.jethroName says hesitantly. "It raises... questions."

"And those may become a problem. It is a complex situation and potentially dangerous."
entries.zh:
"其实可能有，" $global.jethroName 迟疑地说。"它引出了...一些问题。"

"而这些问题可能会变成麻烦。情况很复杂，而且有潜在危险。"

entries.en:
"It could be," $global.jethroName says. "This collector has not been silent about his new acquisition."

"Naturally, the Church does not approve. At the same time, mere disapproval is no reason to cause a diplomatic incident, to say nothing of... well, it is a complex situation. And potentially dangerous."
entries.zh:
"有可能，" $global.jethroName 说。"这位收藏家没对他的新藏品保持低调。"

"很自然地，教会 对此很不赞成。但同时，仅仅不赞成，并不能成为引发外交事件的理由，更不用说...总之，情况很复杂。而且有潜在危险。"

entries.en:
"If you choose to assist me," he says, "then I shall share with you what, ah, 'intel' I have managed to piece together."

He looks almost embarrassed for a moment, then forces himself proceed. "Credits, yes. I have also been instructed to offer a payment of 50,000 credits when - if - you join my investigation, and an additional 50,000 credits upon completion of my quest."

"If it is possible." He sighs, "And that I cannot promise."
entries.zh:
"如果你选择协助我，" 他说，"那么我将与你分享我设法拼凑出来的，呃，'情报'。"

他看起来尴尬了一阵，然后强迫自己说下去。"对，星币。我还得到指示，当 —— 假设如此 —— 你加入我的调查，那么我会提供 50,000 星币的报酬，任务完成后再追加 50,000 星币。"

"如果能完成的话。" 他叹了口气，"这一点我无法保证。"

o.en: A call from Jeff? Of course, put him through.
o.zh: Jeff 打来的？当然，接通就好。
接受 Bornanew 的通讯链接

o.en: I'm interested in discussing cryosanctum services...
o.zh: 我想谈谈低温避难所的服务...

entries.en:
Gallu Blanc's eyebrows raise minutely as he reviews your financial data.

"Impressive," he says. "This gives us much leeway in terms of the highly exclusive, cutting-edge services that Mbaye-Gogol can offer to its best clients."
entries.zh:
Gallu Blanc 翻看你的财务资料时，眉毛几不可察地抬了抬。

"可观，\" 他说。\"有了这个，Mbaye-Gogol 便有充分余地，把只留给上等客户的那些门槛极高、最前沿的服务向您开放。"

entries.en:
"Not insubstantial," he concedes.

"That may open up some," he emphasizes that word, "possibilities for some of the more exclusive services Mbaye-Gogol offers to its better clients."
entries.zh:
"不算小数目，" 他姑且承认。

"这或许能打开一些，\" 他把'一些'两字咬得格外重，\"可能，让 Mbaye-Gogol 面向体面客户的几样更讲究的服务有了余地。"

entries.en:
Gallu Blanc's eyebrows raise minutely as he reviews your financial data. It is perhaps the most human expression you've seen him make.

"You are too humble by half, captain," he says. "You have over a million credits in your accounts. This gives us much leeway in terms of the highly exclusive, cutting-edge services that Mbaye-Gogol can offer to its best clients."
entries.zh:
Gallu Blanc 翻看你的财务资料时，眉毛几不可察地抬了抬。那大概是你见过的、他最像活人的一个表情。

"舰长，您这份自谦可过了头，\" 他说。\"您账户里明明有一百多万信用点。有了这个，Mbaye-Gogol 便有充分余地，把只留给上等客户的那些门槛极高、最前沿的服务向您开放。"

o.en: You'll find that I have over a million credits in my accounts. (share data)
o.zh: 你去查便知，我账户里有一百多万信用点。 (共享数据)

o.en: You'll find that I have over a half million credits in my accounts.
o.zh: 你去查便知，我账户里有五十多万信用点。

o.en: I, ah, prefer not to reveal the financial secrets of my operation.
o.zh: 我，呃，不大想透露自己这摊生意的财务底细。

entries.en:
"Your enthusiasm is most compelling, but we always put the client first."

He produces a pained little smile, like a vacuum-dessicated corpse.
entries.zh:
"您的热忱着实动人，只是我们向来把客户摆在第一位。"

他挤出一丝勉强的笑，活像一具被真空抽干的干尸。

entries.en:
"I couldn't waste any more of your valuable time, captain," he says. "I wish you profitable ventures."

He cuts the comms.
entries.zh:
"不敢再耽误舰长您的宝贵时间了，\" 他说。\"祝您财源广进。"

他切断了通讯。

entries.en:
"Of course, captain," he says with the patience of the interstellar medium. "I assure you that Mbaye-Gogol is committed to your absolute privacy in all matters. Our reputation spans generations, after all."

"I understand that you've a very active career. Perhaps it is premature to discuss these matters before you feel prepared to commit to trusting our timeless institution."
entries.zh:
"当然，舰长，\" 他不急不躁，耐心得如同星际介质。\"我向您保证，Mbaye-Gogol 在任何事上都会守住您绝对的隐私。毕竟我们的名声传了几代人。"

"我明白您事业繁忙。在您还没准备好把信任托付给我们这间历久弥长的机构之前，谈这些或许为时过早。"

o.en: Indeed. I'm sure I'll return before long.
o.zh: 正是。用不了多久我便会再来。

o.en: No, I'd like to discuss it now. So I have something to work toward.
o.zh: 不，我想现在就谈。也好有个奔头。

o.en: I don't think I can afford your services right now.
o.zh: 眼下我怕是消受不起你们的服务。

entries.en:
"I understand that you've a very active career," he says with the patience of the interstellar medium.

"I wish you good fortune. Perhaps we may discuss these matters again before long?"
entries.zh:
"我明白，舰长您事业繁忙，" 他说，那份耐心活像星际介质，漫无边际。

"祝您诸事顺遂。或许用不了多久，我们还能再谈谈这些事？"

o.en: Indeed. I'm sure I'll be back soon.
No, I'd like to discuss it now. So I have something to work toward.
o.zh: 不，我想现在就谈。也好有个奔头。

o.en: You'll find that I have over a million credits in... various investments. (fabricate data)
o.zh: 你去查便知，我有一百多万信用点... 散在各处投资里。 (伪造数据)

entries.en:
Gallu Blanc bears your show of middling competence patiently, and nods politely when the files are finally submitted.

"You have a very... diverse portfolio, captain," he says mildly. "Properly utilized... well, in any event, this gives us a great deal of leeway in terms of accessing the highly exclusive, cutting-edge services that Mbaye-Gogol offers only to its best clients."
entries.zh:
Gallu Blanc 耐着性子看你演完这出不上不下的戏，等文件终于递上来，才礼貌地点了点头。

"舰长，您这份资产... 可真够驳杂的，\" 他语气平和。\"善加运用... 总之，有了它，Mbaye-Gogol 只向最上等客户开放的那批门槛极高、最前沿的服务，您便大有周旋的余地。"

entries.en:
You put on a good act as an impatient independent warlord who has more a mind for strategy and tactics than the details of record-keeping and accounts, feigning annoyance at your purser as they 'struggle' to assemble the requested data.

In fact, your officers begin to assemble a falsified list of gray and black-market holdings, many associated with known criminal syndicates and pirate gangs. It's the sort of portfolio that would send both a Hegemony inspector and a Luddic curate into a rage, one that is difficult to quickly verify, but also one which would be quite plausible for a successful individual in your position.
entries.zh:
你把一个没耐心的独立军阀演得十足：满脑子战略战术，懒得管账簿账目这类细务；事务长'费劲'拼凑你要的资料时，你还装出一副不耐烦。

事实上，你的手下已开始拼凑一份伪造的资产清单，罗列着灰色渠道与黑市里的产业，不少还挂着已知犯罪集团、海盗帮派的名头。这份家底能让霸主的监察官和卢德教会的教士同时气得跳脚，一时半会儿查不清真假，可摆在你这么个混出名堂的人身上，又再合情合理不过。

o.en: Apologies, Mister Blanc. This will take... a moment.
o.zh: 抱歉，Blanc 先生。这得... 稍等片刻。

entries.en:
He folds his hands together.

"How may the Mbaye-Gogol Cryosanctum assist you in your journey through time?"
entries.zh:
他双手交叠。

"在您穿越时光的旅途上，Mbaye-Gogol 低温圣所能为您做些什么？"

entries.en:
You explain your requirements in somewhat elliptical terms. It is a politically and ethically sensitive proposal, after all.

As Blanc picks up on your intimations, he almost looks amused. "Hardly a unique case, $playerSirOrMadam."

"We welcome many guests with... unique medical situations to the Mbaye-Gogol Cryosanctum."

"May we suggest a secure, mid-term care package for 100,000 credits? It has a 50-cycle guarantee of integrity with very reasonable rewewal options."
entries.zh:
你把要求说得颇为含混。毕竟这提议在政治和伦理上都烫手。

Blanc 听懂了言外之意，几乎显出点觉得有趣的样子。"这算不上什么特例，$playerSirOrMadam。"

"Mbaye-Gogol 低温圣所接待过许多... 医疗状况颇为特殊的客人。"

"可否向您推荐一份稳妥的中期托管方案，十万信用点？含五十周期的完好担保，续期条件也相当公道。"

entries.en:
The arrangements are made.

An anonymous shuttle carries an unmarked cryosleep-unit into the bowels of Nomios. The telemetry from the subtle tracking device you had installed on the unit cuts off as soon as it is wheeled through the first set of doors.

Leonidas will be safe, here. And the Sector safe from Leonidas.

For now.
entries.zh:
手续办妥了。

一艘查不出来历的穿梭机把一具没有任何标记的低温休眠舱送进 Nomios 深处。你悄悄装在舱上的追踪器，在它被推过第一道门的一瞬间便断了信号。

Leonidas 在这里会平安无事，星域也终于不必再提防 Leonidas。

暂时如此。

entries.en:
"I believe I recall the details of the situation," Blanc says, stone-faced.

"May we suggest a secure, mid-term care package for 100,000 credits? It has a 50-cycle guarantee of integrity with very reasonable renewal options."
entries.zh:
"这桩情形的细节，我应当还记得，" Blanc 面无表情地说。

"可否向您推荐一份稳妥的中期托管方案，十万信用点？含五十周期的完好担保，续期条件也相当公道。"

entries.en: He nods slowly, unblinking.
entries.zh: 他缓缓点头，眼睛一眨不眨。

o.en: I'd like to arrange long-term storage for a unique case. (store Leonidas in the cryosanctum)
o.zh: 我想为一个特殊个案安排长期存放。 (把 Leonidas 存进低温圣所)

entries.en:
"You have exceptional taste, I can tell, captain," Blanc says, eyes widening slightly.

"If you provide us with a budget of, perhaps, five million credits, you will be treated as though you were one of the legendary immortal monarchs of Old Earth."

"The custom-tuned cryosarcophagus and top-of-the-line cryomedical monitoring team - rotated and replaced throughout your stay - come without question. Your awakening, a kind of second birth, would be attended by the finest care that the investments Mbaye-Gogol has made into the future of human health can provide."

"Many of our Directors have themselves made a... similar decision."
entries.zh:
"舰长，看得出您品味不凡，" Blanc 说着，眼睛微微睁大。

"只要您拿出个，比方说，五百万信用点的预算，我们便能当您是古地球传说里那些长生不老的君王来伺候。"

"量身调校的低温棺、顶尖的低温医疗监护团队自不待言 —— 您住多久，团队便轮替更换多久。您醒来时，如同再世为人，会有 Mbaye-Gogol 为人类健康未来投下的心血所能换来的最周全照护。"

"我们不少董事自己也做过... 类似的选择。"

o.zh: 再看看你们别的方案吧... (返回)

entries.en: "Very well, Captain $playerName. We shall make the arrangements..."
entries.zh: "很好，$playerName 舰长，我们这就去安排..."

entries.en:
"I'm not sure this is the right choice for you, captain. But," he lays a patient expression over his disapproval, "perhaps we may establish a... baseline."

"The budget option discards most of the unnecessary appendages, and indeed most of the corpus itself. These components help offset the expense of offering such a... reasonable option, you see."
entries.zh:
"我拿不准这是否适合您，舰长。不过，\" 他把一层耐心盖在不以为然上，\"或许我们可以先立个... 基准。"

"经济套餐会去掉大部分用不上的四肢，其实连躯干本身也去掉大半。这些部件正好拿来抵扣推出这般... 实惠价格的开销，您懂的。"

o.en: So you'd chop off my head?
o.zh: 所以你们要把我的脑袋切下来？

entries.en:
"Not exactly," he says, blandly correcting you. "The procedure is quite controlled, and retains a reasonable portion of the spinal cord to ease reconstruction."

A pause.

"It was also found that the standard cryocephalic unit permits the storage of certain... additional small organs considered by some to have sentimental value, as well. A popular option."
entries.zh:
"倒也不是，\" 他不动声色地纠正。\"流程控制得很严，还会保留相当一段脊髓，方便日后复原。"

他顿了顿。

"另外我们发现，标准的头部低温舱里还容得下某些... 额外的小器官 —— 有人觉得它们别有纪念意义。选这项的人不少。"

o.zh: 再看看你们别的方案吧... (返回)

entries.en: "Very well, Captain $playerName. We shall make the arrangements..."
entries.zh: "很好，$playerName 舰长，我们这就去安排..."

entries.en:
"Ah, the deluxe." An attempt at a pleasant expression creaks into being on his face.

"This is the full-body option. We provide a custom-tuned cryosarcophagus which, I must note, is a far more sophisticated piece of equipment than the standard emergency survival tube spacefarers are familiar with. And it is not quite infinitely more reliable than the crude, mass-fabricated things many of our own ancestors were lucky enough to survive on their journey to the Persean Sector."

You'd swear Blanc is nearly enthusiastic about the subject.

"We guarantee a slot in our top-of-the-line cryorevival facilities and provide enhanced recuperation procedures. As we like to say, 'Your future self will feel younger than you do today'."

He smiles, teeth like dead ivory.
entries.zh:
"啊，豪华款。" 他脸上一点点挤出个讨喜的表情，僵硬得像生了锈。

"这是全身方案。我们提供一具按您量身调校的低温棺 —— 我得说，比起寻常跑船人熟悉的那种标准应急求生舱，可要精密得多。不过，比起当年我们不少祖先靠着侥幸活下来、一路驶到英仙座星域的那些粗制滥造的量产货，它的可靠性倒也算不上高出无穷倍。"

你简直要以为 Blanc 对这个话题生出了几分热忱。

"我们保证在顶尖的低温复苏设施里为您留一个位置，另附强化康复疗程。用我们的话说：'未来的您，会比今天的您更觉年轻'。"

他笑了，一口牙白得像死象牙。

o.zh: 再看看你们别的方案吧... (返回)

entries.en: "Very well, Captain $playerName. We shall make the arrangements..."
entries.zh: "很好，$playerName 舰长，我们这就去安排..."

o.zh: 聊聊低温圣所的套餐吧。

entries.en:
"Of course," he says with the mildest disapproval. "A common option for... those of limited means."

"Much of the body is preserved, though to fit the smaller, and more efficient, long-term cryo units, certain reversible procedures are undergone to remove as much unnecessary volume and mass as possible."
entries.zh:
"自然，\" 他微微露出点不以为然。\"这是... 手头不宽裕的人常选的。"

"身体大部分都留着，只不过为了塞进更小、更省地方的长期低温舱，得先做些可逆处理，把不必要的体积和分量尽量去掉。"

o.en: Tell me more of this... reversible procedure.
o.zh: 详细说说这个... 可逆处理。

entries.en:
He smiles icily.

"The commonplace organs are removed - to bring down the cost of cryosanctum, you see. And then, much of the fat, muscle, and bones are..."

Blanc licks his lips. You'd swear his tongue makes a rasping sound, but that may simply have been signal interference.

"Think of it as... folding. Folding was an ancient art on Old Earth, I am told," he muses. "The resulting package is quite compact, retaining all the distinctive elements of mind and body, to be... reconstructed at a future date."
entries.zh:
他冷冰冰地一笑。

"寻常那些器官会取出来 —— 您也知道，好把低温圣所的价钱压下来。然后，大部分脂肪、肌肉、骨头就..."

Blanc 舔了舔嘴唇。你几乎敢担保他的舌头发出干涩的摩擦声，不过也可能只是信号干扰。

"不妨想成... 折叠。听说折叠是古地球的一门古老技艺，\" 他悠悠地说。\"折好之后十分紧凑，心智与身体所有要紧的特征都留着，等将来某个日子再... 重新拼回去。"

o.zh: 再看看你们别的方案吧... (返回)

entries.en: "Very well, Captain $playerName. We shall make the arrangements..."
entries.zh: "很好，$playerName 舰长，我们这就去安排..."

entries.en:
"Certainly."

Blanc's mouth arranges itself into something he was probably told looked pleasant.

He makes a subtle motion, and a form appears in the comms-link. A list of packages. You skim the text - various levels of insurance, guarantees, bodily integrity maintained... regrowth of damaged elements upon thawing, neural integrity treatments...
entries.zh:
"当然。"

Blanc 把嘴摆成一个大概有人告诉过他算是和悦的形状。

他不动声色地做了个手势，通讯画面里浮出一份表格，列着各类套餐。你扫了几眼 —— 各档保险、担保、躯体完整保全... 解冻时受损部位的再生、神经完整性疗程...

o.en: Tell me more about the budget package.
I see you have a midline package...
o.zh: 我看你们还有个中档套餐...

o.en: I'm interested in the deluxe package.
These feel limiting. Do you have something truly exceptional to offer?
o.zh: 这些看着都束手束脚，你们有没有真正不同凡响的东西？

entries.en:
Gallu Blanc's smile couldn't thaw ice-phase hydrogen.

"Although I do not usually deal directly with clients, I take pleasure in facilitating services for exceptional individuals."

He nods minutely, a glacial magnanimity.

"How may the Mbaye-Gogol Cryosanctum assist you in your journey through time?"
entries.zh:
Gallu Blanc 那点笑意，连冰相氢都化不开。

"我虽不常直接接待客户，却乐意为非同寻常的人物张罗这些服务。"

他几不可察地点了点头，那份宽宏大量冷得能结出冰来。

"在您穿越时光的旅途上，Mbaye-Gogol 低温圣所能为您做些什么？"

entries.en:
Gallu Blanc's smile couldn't thaw ice-phase hydrogen.

"I am pleased to hear of your interest. Although I do not usually deal directly with clients, I do take pleasure in facilitating services for certain... exceptional individuals."

"And although you are not insignificant, captain," his tone is magnanimity itself, "-please take no offense, but I must inquire about your financial situation. We offer something approaching immortality and its price... is dear."
entries.zh:
Gallu Blanc 那点笑意，连冰相氢都化不开。

"听闻您有兴趣，不胜欣喜。我虽不常直接接待客户，却也乐意为某些... 非同寻常的人物牵线搭桥。"

"而您也绝非无名之辈，舰长，\" 那口气本身就是一派宽宏大量，\"—— 还请别见怪，只是我不得不先问一句您的财务状况。我们提供的，是近乎永生之物，而它的价码... 着实不菲。"

entries.en: "Hmm," the $post looks over a secondary display, casually tapping through a few reports.
entries.zh: "嗯，" $post 扫视着侧面一个显示屏，随意地翻阅了几个报告。

entries.en:
You make the arrangements, and before the passing of a workshift, a small batch of emergency supplies is transferred to your $shipOrFleet for repairs.

"The funds you receive from $theFaction are meant to cover operational expenses," $personName says brusquely. "Your commission ID will be flagged for one full cycle due to this emergency supply transfer, so don't make a habit of not having a backup plan."
entries.zh:
你安排妥当之后，还没有过一个 星历日，你的$shipOrFleet就收到了一小批用于维修的应急补给。

"你从 $theFaction 收到的雇佣金理应负担行动产生的支出。" $personName 唐突提起，"本次应急补给传输后，你的雇佣协议 ID 将会被标记一整个星历年，所以说，别养成出航没有后备方案的习惯。"

entries.en:
"Hmm. Your $shipOrFleet is in decent shape, but your readiness has suffered. Seeing as how you bear a $faction commission, it looks like I might be able to justify providing you with assistance."

$HeOrShe gives you a severe look. "Are you sure you want to call this in now? A commissioned captain is only authorized to receive emergency supplies once per cycle."
entries.zh:
"嗯...你的$shipOrFleet状况还好，但战备情况有些糟糕，既然你持有 $faction 的雇佣协议，那看来我也大概有理由为你提供援助。"

$HeOrShe严肃地看着你。"你确定现在就要接受我方援助吗？每名雇佣舰长每个星历年只有一次领取紧急补给授权。"

entries.en: The $post simply nods.
entries.zh: $post 简单地点了下头。

entries.en: "It looks like your $shipOrFleet has taken some hits. Seeing as how you bear a $faction commission, it looks like I can justify providing you with assistance."
entries.zh: "看来你的$shipOrFleet略有损伤，既然你受到 $faction 的雇佣，那我提供援助可能也算得上理所应当。"

entries.en: "Your $shipOrFleet has taken some serious damage. You have a $faction commission and this is a clear case of need, so I shall provide you with emergency supplies."
entries.zh: "看来你的$shipOrFleet受损严重。既然你持有 $faction 的雇佣协议，现在也明显需要援助，那我也理应为你提供紧急补给。"

entries.en: "Hmm," the $post looks over a secondary display, casually tapping through a few reports.
entries.zh: "嗯，" $post 扫视着侧面一个显示屏，随意地翻阅了几个报告。

entries.en:
"Looks like you've got a handle on your $shipOrFleet's upkeep. I'll not give supplies away for them to end up on the black market."

$HeOrShe holds up one rough hand, "Not accusing you, captain. It's simply a matter of policy that I must justify any emergency supply transfer. If I can't prove they're used to serve $faction interests, then I have to answer for the expense."
entries.zh:
"看来你的$shipOrFleet保养状况良好，我可不能随便发给你补给，然后让你把它们在黑市上卖掉。"

$HeOrShe举起一只肤质很粗糙的手："我并没有责备你，舰长，只是按照政策，每次发放应急补给都需要有正当理由。如果我不能证明这些补给服务于 $faction 利益的话，我就只能自己支付补给开销了。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe back looks to you, perplexed. "You own your own planet and you've come to me begging for supplies?"

"I'll count this as a joke in poor taste, $playerSirOrMadam."

$HeOrShe doesn't look amused, and doesn't manage to imbue $hisOrHer words with quite the tone of respect $hisOrHer words alone would imply.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe茫然地盯着你。"你明明自己治下都有星球了，还要来找我要补给？"

"就当你开了个不恰当的玩笑吧，$playerSirOrMadam。"

$HeOrShe看来不怎么开心，也没有像平常一样在语言中体现出$hisOrHer常有的那种尊重语气。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe glances at a secondary display, checking your $shipOrFleet ID.

"This isn't a charity, spacer," $heOrShe says, turning back to you. "I'd only even consider your request if you held a $faction commission. And you don't. So don't waste my time."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe扫视着侧方一个屏幕，核对着你的$shipOrFleet ID。

"太空佬，这不是搞慈善。" $heOrShe背过身说道，"除非你持有 $faction 的雇佣协议，我才会考虑你的申请，而你没有。所以别浪费我的时间。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe glances at a secondary display, checking your $shipOrFleet ID.

"Charity may be a virtue, spacer," $heOrShe says, "but I'd only even consider your request if you were actually in need - and commissioned in service of the Church of Galactic Redemption."

"Mind you that greed is a vice, so pray on that as you move along."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe扫视着侧方一个屏幕，核对着你的$shipOrFleet ID。

"虽然慈善是美德，宇宙民。" $heOrShe说道，"但我只有在你真正有需求，并且持有 银河救赎教会 的雇佣协议了的前提下才会考虑你的申请。"

"也提醒你一下，贪婪乃是原罪，所以以此祷告，上路吧。"

entries.en:
The $post gives you a strange look, then glances at a secondary display. Then, looking slightly alarmed, back at you.

"Wait, are you-" $HisOrHer eyes dart to the display. "You're $playerName! Get yourself off of my comm-link."

$HeOrShe mashes at the cut-off button.
entries.zh:
$post 奇怪的看了你一眼，之后又瞟了一眼另一个显示屏，最后则稍显警惕的瞪着你。

"等等，你是不是 ——" $HisOrHer快速看向显示屏，"你是 $playerName！快滚出我的通讯链接！"

$HeOrShe猛拍按钮，切断了通讯链接。

entries.en: Something comes up, $hisOrHer eyes narrow, expression growing harder. More tapping. Then $heOrShe turns to you, frowning.
entries.zh: $hisOrHer似乎发现了什么，眯起了眼睛，面色越发凝重。$heOrShe又敲了几下按键，随后转向面对着你，眉头紧锁。

entries.en:
Something comes up, $hisOrHer eyes narrow, expression growing harder. More tapping. Then $heOrShe turns to you, frowning.

"You don't become the $post without having seen a few tricks over the cycles. I just didn't expect a captain bearing a $faction commission to attempt the old cargo dump on me."

$HeOrShe sighs, shaking his or her head. "I'm flagging your commission ID for a cycle. Now get off my comms."
entries.zh:
$hisOrHer似乎发现了什么，眯起了眼睛，面色越发凝重。$heOrShe又敲了几下按键，随后转向面对着你，眉头紧锁。

"干到 $post 这个位置上的，早就对这些小把戏见怪不怪了。我只是没料到，一位持有 $faction 雇佣协议的舰长，竟然会对我使这招老掉牙的卸货把戏。"

$HeOrShe叹了口气，摇了摇头。"我把你的雇佣 ID 标记了一个星历年。现在滚出我的通讯频道。"

entries.en:
"I may walk with Ludd, but you don't become the $post by taking every spacer's word on faith alone. I'd hoped a captain commissioned by the Church would never attempt a cargo dump scam on me, but here you are."

$HeOrShe sighs, shaking his or her head. "I'm flagging your commission for a cycle, that you might reflect and pray for forgiveness. Now remove your sinning face from my comms."
entries.zh:
"我虽行卢德之道，但若仅凭每位宇宙民的一面之词就轻信不疑，可就无法担当 $post 一职了。我希望为教会服务的舰长永远不会试图把丢货的骗局用在我头上，可你倒好。"

$HeOrShe叹了口气，摇了摇头。"我把你的雇佣 ID 标记了一个星历年，请你事后进行反思并祷告以求宽恕。现在请你将你罪恶的脸孔移出我的通讯频道。"

entries.en:
"I'm a $post for the Hegemony, not some two-credit League world. I've seen the old dump-the-cargo done by an upstart who thinks they're more clever than the system before, and I will again. You should be hauled before a court martial. But lucky you, I've got enough bureaucratic make-work, so I'm going to pretend this was one big, stupid mistake."

$HeOrShe sighs, shaking his or her head. "I'm flagging your commission ID for a cycle. Now get off my comms."
entries.zh:
"我可是 霸主 的 $post，不是什么鸟不拉屎的联盟世界。我已经见惯了觉那些得自己比政府聪明的小崽子们玩丢弃货物那一套，而且之后也还会见到。你本该受到军法处置，但是算你走运，我手上要处理的文件够多了，所以这次我就当你犯了个大糊涂。"

$HeOrShe叹了口气，摇了摇头。"我把你的雇佣 ID 标记了一个星历年。现在滚出我的通讯频道。"

entries.en:
"I'm no gens-get, captain; I earned my position by serving from Laicaille to Salamanca and I didn't become $post because I'm a fool. I just didn't expect a League captain to attempt the old smuggler's dump on me."

$HeOrShe sighs, shaking his or her head. "I'm flagging your commission ID for a cycle. Now get off my comms."
entries.zh:
"舰长，我可不是什么关系户。我是从 Laicaille 到 Salamanca 一路干上来的，而我这个 $post 职位可不是靠傻气当上的。我只是没想到联盟的舰长会玩走私犯常用的丢货把戏。"

$HeOrShe叹了口气，摇了摇头。"我把你的雇佣 ID 标记了一个星历年。现在滚出我的通讯频道。"

entries.en:
"You don't become the $post here without knowing a few tricks employed by terrorists and smugglers. I'd have expected if you'd pledged to the Sindrian Diktat you'd know better than to attempt the old cargo dump scam. Stars beyond, you'd get us both sent to Cruor!"

$HeOrShe sighs, shaking his or her head. "I'm flagging your commission ID for a cycle. You'd best hope the Spider doesn't take an interest. Now get off my comms."
entries.zh:
"能坐上 $post 这个位置的人，多少都清楚恐怖分子和走私犯惯用的伎俩。我本以为宣誓效忠 辛达强权 的你会更明点事理，不至于傻到去玩那种丢货的把戏。群星在上，你这会让我俩都被发配到 Cruor！"

$HeOrShe叹了口气，摇了摇头。"我把你的雇佣 ID 标记了一个星历年 。你最好祈祷蜘蛛不会关注此事，现在滚出我的通讯频道。"

entries.en:
"I see your trick, captain, and while I admire your drive to maximize profit, I cannot respect that you're too incompetent to dump your supplies further afield before requesting assistance. You understand that if I was found misappropriating Tri-Tachyon property, they'd bond me into debt-service? I've got wealth, but not much. It'd be life."

$HeOrShe sighs, shaking his or her head. "I'm flagging your commission ID for a cycle. Now get off my comms."
entries.zh:
"我看透了你的伎俩，舰长。虽然我佩服你最大化利润的动力，但你在远处丢弃补给再来寻求帮助的愚蠢伎俩却让人不敢恭维。你知道，要是被抓到挪用 速子科技 的资产，我可是要被迫以工作抵债的？我虽然有钱，但是不多。这是要抵一辈子的。"

$HeOrShe叹了口气，摇了摇头。"我把你的雇佣 ID 标记了一个星历年。现在滚出我的通讯频道。"

o.en: Do you have any supplies to spare?
Do you have any supplies to spare?

entries.en: You try to establish a comm link, but your request is denied.
entries.zh: 你试图建立通讯链接，但你的请求被拒绝了。

entries.en: The $post nods approval as your payment is transferred, and immediately executes the datastream to transfer the agreed-upon hyperspace and slipstream data.
entries.zh: 见你的付款转移完毕，$post 点头确认，随后操作着数据流把你们说好的超空间和滑流数据转了过来。

entries.en: The $post nods approval as your payment is transferred, "A fine move, my good captain," $heOrShe says, then executes the datastream to transfer the agreed-upon hyperspace and slipstream data.
entries.zh: 见你的付款转移完毕，$post 点头确认道："你做得没错，我亲爱的舰长。" $heOrShe这么说着，操作着数据流把你们说好的超空间和滑流数据转了过来。

entries.en:
"A good deal," the $post says as your payment is transferred. $HeOrShe immediately executes the datastream to transfer the agreed-upon hyperspace and slipstream data.

"Pleasure doing business with you," $heOrShe adds.
entries.zh:
"不错的买卖。" $post 见你的费用转来了便说道。$HeOrShe即刻操作着数据流把你们说好的超空间和滑流数据转了过来。

"交易愉快。" $HeOrShe加了一句。

entries.en:
The $post nods approval as your payment is transferred, and says "May your path be blessed and, by Providence, be a safer one hereon."

$HeOrShe executes the datastream to transfer the agreed-upon hyperspace and slipstream data.
entries.zh:
见你的付款转移完毕，$post 点头确认，然后说着 "愿你的道途蒙福，此行之后，皆为平安。"

$HeOrShe操作着数据流把你们说好的超空间和滑流数据转了过来。

entries.en: "It's good to share what we know out here, ya never know what ghosties are hiding nor where," $heOrShe says, nodding as your payment is transferred. "And I don't mind the credits," $heOrShe adds with a wink, then executes the datastream to transfer the agreed-upon hyperspace and slipstream data.
entries.zh: "能把我们知道的分享出来是件好事，你永远也想不到那些小幽灵会在哪里藏些什么。" $heOrShe说道，"而且我也不讨厌星币。" $heOrShe说着眨了眨眼，然后操作着数据流把你们说好的超空间和滑流数据转了过来。

entries.en:
The $post nods approval as your payment is transferred, and says "A wise choice, my... friend. One can never be too careful out here. "

After a slightly long pause and a strange smile $heOrShe executes the datastream to transfer the agreed-upon hyperspace and slipstream data.
entries.zh:
见你的付款转移完毕，$post 点头确认道："理智的选择，我的... 朋友。在外小心点总是没错的。"

稍长的一阵停顿和一个奇怪的微笑后，$heOrShe操作着数据流把你们说好的超空间和滑流数据转了过来。

entries.en: $HeOrShe takes your denial in good spirit and asks if there is anything else you wished to discuss.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe态度良好地接受了你的拒绝，然后询问道你还有没有别的想商谈的事。

entries.en: $HeOrShe sniffs. "I was only contemplating it as a favor to you, of course."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe哼了一声。"我不过是念着帮你的忙，才随口想想罢了。"

entries.en: "I hate missing out on a profitable deal, but I respect your position," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh: "我不想失去一个能赚钱的生意，但我也尊重你的情况。" $HeOrShe说道。

entries.en: "Providence provides for those that provide for themselves, you know." $heOrShe says charitably.
entries.zh: "上天眷顾那些自强不息的人，你知道吧。" $heOrShe仁慈地说道。

entries.en: "Now don't be blaming me if you get lost out here," $heOrShe says with good humor.
entries.zh: "这样的话你迷路了可就不能怪我了哦？" $HeOrShe幽默地说道。

entries.en: "Pity," $heOrShe says. "Now you be careful out here; you wouldn't want to get eaten by ghosts."
entries.zh: "真可惜。" $HeOrShe说道，"那你在外小心些；你不会想被幽灵吃掉的。"

entries.en:
You note that Caden is standing, unsteadily, on a platform built of military supply pallets. His hand idly brushes a pocket, then drops.

An arcane arrangement of equipment surrounds him, draped in protective forgecloth - shield against stray EM and minor impacts. They stand like a humming, cloaked honor-guard.

He's speaking again.
entries.zh:
你注意到 Caden 站在一座用军用补给托板搭起的台子上，身子晃得厉害。他的手无意识地蹭了蹭口袋，又垂了下去。

他四周是一圈古怪的设备，蒙着防护用的锻造布——用来挡杂散电磁和轻微撞击。它们像一队披着罩布、低声嗡鸣的仪仗卫兵。

他又开口了。

entries.en:
"...glorious project of Andradaism, the transcendent philosophy, has been usurped by... traitors! Traitors and cowards and degenerates! Thin-blooded spacers and worse things; clones concocted by Tri-Tachyon scientists who've forgotten the soil of- of-"

A clang. He looks aside again, in response. Then back into the feed.

Confused. He's lost his place. "Traitors, all," he mutters.
entries.zh:
"...Andrada 主义那项光辉的事业，那套超凡的意识形态，已经被...被叛徒窃取了！叛徒、懦夫、败类！血统稀薄的太空佬，还有更下作的东西；速子科技那些科学家炮制出来的克隆体，他们早忘了自己的根在——在——"

咣的一声。他应声又朝旁边看去，随后转回镜头。

他一脸茫然，忘了自己讲到哪儿。"全是叛徒，"他低声嘟囔。

entries.en:
After a moment, he seems to regain his focus.

"With the- the greatest weapon known to Man, my name will be written in history alongside that of Supreme Executor Philip Andrada! The Lion of Sindria! In fire... fire and the blood of traitors! And-"

A series of bangs echo through the holo-cast. Caden looks aside, alarm showing in his yellowed eyes.

There's shouting, and a distinctive stuttering in the audio feed - overload from weapons fire.

He grabs for a datapad, stumbles, and knocks it to the floor. He follows, diving after it, and- it's hard to make out what's happening.

The lights flicker.
entries.zh:
过了片刻，他像是重新找回了神。

"凭着——凭人类已知最强大的武器，我的名字将和最高元首 Philip Andrada 一起载入史册！辛达瑞亚之狮！在烈火中...在烈火与叛徒的血中！还有——"

一连串闷响透过全息转播回荡开来。Caden 朝旁边看去，泛黄的眼睛里露出惊惶。

有人在喊叫，音频里出现那种特有的断续杂音——武器开火造成的过载。

他伸手去抓一块数据板，脚下一绊，把它撞落在地。他跟着扑下去，然后——很难看清发生了什么。

灯光闪烁。

entries.en:
A brightness overwhelms the feed, sending spiralling ghost-images as the noise-reduction algorithms fail to anticipate the flash.

It's possible, just possible, there's the suggestion of the silhouette of a contorted human figure. Distorted, splayed unnaturally by the force of-
entries.zh:
一片强光淹没了画面，降噪算法没能预判这次闪光，甩出一圈圈螺旋状的鬼影。

那或许——仅仅是或许——有一道扭曲人形的轮廓。它被那股力量扯得变形、张成不自然的姿态——

entries.en:
The feed goes dark.

Then errors and warning overrides grow like a greedy red-orange flame, rising, rising- Comms hits an override and it disappears.
entries.zh:
画面黑了下去。

紧接着，错误与警告覆写像一团贪婪的红橙色火焰蔓延开来，升腾，升腾——通讯系统触发强制中断，它消失了。

entries.en:
Your comms and sensors officer have a rapid exchange of jargon, poring over incoming telemetry. Alerts over hyperwave. Nav almost jumps out of their seat when the drive-field alarm sounds, then cancels itself.

A silent moment, and they turn to face you.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." It's Sensors. "I think..."

A glance to Tactical, who looks ashen-faced. It takes a moment, but they blink and give a single nod.

"Sindria. Planet-killer."
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官和传感器技官飞快地交换着一串术语，紧盯着涌入的遥测数据。超波频道上警报不断。驱动场警报响起又自行解除，导航官几乎从座位上弹了起来。

静了一瞬，他们转过身面向你。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。\"是传感器技官。\"我想..."

众人看向战术军官，他脸色灰白。他愣了一瞬，才眨了下眼，点了一下头。

"Sindria。行星杀手。"

entries.en:
Caden.

Face red, uniform dishevelled. His sidearm ready nearby.

He's in some kind of bunker or deep mine. Cyclopean columns strung with makeshift conduits march into darkness.

"This is Guard High Deputy Executor Horacio Caden, the next in line for... for..."

He breathes heavily, face red. Sweating again. His eyes dart to somewhere off-view.
entries.zh:
Caden。

满面通红，制服凌乱。佩枪就搁在手边。

他身处某处地堡，或是深井矿坑。独眼巨人般的巨柱上缠着临时拉设的管线，一路没入黑暗。

"我是卫队高级副执政官 Horacio Caden，法定的下一任...下一任..."

他喘得厉害，脸涨得通红。又在冒汗。目光朝画面之外某个方向飞快一瞥。

entries.en:
Caden.

Face red, uniform dishevelled. His sidearm ready nearby.

He's in some kind of bunker or deep mine. Cyclopean columns strung with makeshift conduits march into darkness.

You recall the reports about the defeat of his personal fleet officered by the cream of the Lion's Guard and composed of the finest ships the Sindrian Diktat could outfit.

Despite escaping with his life, it does not look as though he's taken the loss well.
entries.zh:
Caden。

满面通红，制服凌乱。佩枪就搁在手边。

他身处某处地堡，或是深井矿坑。独眼巨人般的巨柱上缠着临时拉设的管线，一路没入黑暗。

你想起那些报告：他私人舰队的军官都是狮心卫队中的精锐，舰船则是辛达强权所能装备的最好货色，可这支舰队还是败了。

他虽保住了性命，却显然没能咽下这场败仗。

entries.en:
Caden loosens his collar, takes a breath, then looks directly into the feed.

"This is Guard High Deputy Executor Horacio Caden, the next in line for... for..."

He breathes heavily, face red. Sweating again. His eyes dart to somewhere off-view.
entries.zh:
Caden 松了松衣领，吸一口气，然后直直看向镜头。

"我是卫队高级副执政官 Horacio Caden，法定的下一任...下一任..."

他喘得厉害，脸涨得通红。又在冒汗。目光朝画面之外某个方向飞快一瞥。

entries.en: You review your operations logs which contain a live projection for the arrival of $fleetTypeNameInText at the $fleetDestinationName - $fleetDays days.
entries.zh: 你查阅作战日志，其中有一条实时预测：$fleetTypeNameInText将在$fleetDays天后抵达$fleetDestinationName。

o.en: You made arrangements ahead of time and expect the fleet to arrive shortly
o.zh: 你已提前安排妥当，预计舰队很快就会抵达

o.en: I've given your ship, the Hamatsu, to Kanta.
o.zh: 我已经把你的船，Hamatsu 号，交给了Kanta。

o.en: Uh. Kanta seems to have your ship, the Hamatsu.
o.zh: 呃，Kanta 似乎拥有你的船，Hamatsu号。

entries.en:
"You just... gave it to her?" She closes her eyes, and takes a deep breath. To make peace with the truth?

No; her eyes open, filled with anger. "You just GAVE it to her? Jorien 'would skin her own mother for a laugh' Kanta, the robot-freak who is physically unable to just. Let. Go. Like it was some hulk to be traded away for a favor? You have no idea, no idea at all what you've done! None! How could you not even THINK?"

You are unable to get a word in, and the last thing you see on the comm-link is Ibrahim's motion-blurred hand smashing the cut-off.
entries.zh:
"你刚刚...把它给了她？" 她闭上眼睛，深吸一口气，慢慢接受了事实...

...不，她的眼睛瞪开，充满愤怒。"你就这么给她了？就这么给了 Jorien '为了图一乐能活剥亲妈' Kanta，那个生理上就无法就.此.罢.手的机器人怪胎？你就把它当成可以拿来换取好处的废船残骸？你根本不知道，根本不知道你做了什么！一点都不知道！你怎么能连想都不想？"

你没法插话，而你在通讯链接上看到的最后一件事，是 Ibrahim 那只动作模糊的手砸向切断通讯的按钮。

entries.en:
"So you just... let her have it?" She closes her eyes, and takes a deep breath. To make peace with the truth?

No; her eyes open, filled with anger. "You won't even admit outright that you just GAVE it to her? Jorien 'would skin her own mother for a laugh' Kanta, the robot-freak who is physically unable to just. Let. Go. Like it was some hulk to be traded away for a favor? You have no idea, no idea at all what you've done! None! How could you not even THINK?"

You are unable to get a word in, and the last thing you see on the comm-link is Ibrahim's motion-blurred hand smashing the cut-off.
entries.zh:
"你就...随她拿走了？" 她闭上了双眼，深深吸了一口气。大概是在接受现实？

并没有；她睁开了双眼，眼中充满了愤怒。"你都不愿意干脆承认是直接 '给' 了她？Jorien '为了图一乐能活剥亲妈' Kanta，那个生理上就无法就.此.罢.手的机器人怪胎？你就把它当成可以拿来换取好处的废船残骸？你根本不知道，根本不知道你做了什么！一点都不知道！你怎么能连想都不想？"

你没法插话，而你在通讯链接上看到的最后一件事，是 Ibrahim 那只动作模糊的手砸向切断通讯的按钮。

o.zh: 商议派一支特遣队去某处与你的 $shipOrFleet 会合

entries.en:
There's a short delay as your comms officer corrects for time-space distortion between your $shipOrFleet and your command-control center.

"Secure hyperwave link established, captain," comms reports. "Encryption is green, line open. What are your orders?"
entries.zh:
你的通讯官需要校正你的$shipOrFleet与指挥控制中心之间的时空畸变，通讯因此短暂延迟。

"加密超波链路已建立，舰长，\" 通讯官报告道，\"加密状态正常，线路畅通。请指示。"

o.zh: 筹划部署一支作战特遣舰队

o.zh: 不必了，只是测试一下设备。

entries.zh: 你可以下令派一支补给舰队，运来所需的船员、燃料和补给；具体数量由你的军需官根据舰队当前的需求评估决定。

entries.en:
"Understood, $playerSirOrMadam. Where do you want to send the task force?"

A star chart unfolds in the primary bridge display.

There's a baseline cost to send out a fleet and, of course, additional expense the further the destination is from one of your military bases.
entries.zh:
"明白，$playerSirOrMadam。你想把特遣舰队派往哪里？"

主舰桥显示屏上展开了一幅星图。

派出舰队有一笔基础开销；当然，目的地离你的任何一座军事基地越远，额外费用也越高。

entries.en:
"Acknowledged, $playerSirOrMadam," your quartermaster salutes then defers to your navigation officer, who asks "Where shall we meet the support fleet, captain?"

A star chart unfolds in the primary bridge display.

There's a baseline cost to send out a fleet and, of course, additional expense the further the destination is from one of your military bases.
entries.zh:
"收到，$playerSirOrMadam，\" 你的军需官敬了个礼，随后把话交给领航官，后者问道：\"我们该在哪里与补给舰队会合，舰长？"

主舰桥显示屏上展开了一幅星图。

派出舰队有一笔基础开销；当然，目的地离你的任何一座军事基地越远，额外费用也越高。

entries.en: "Yes $playerSirOrMadam," your comms officer says with a nod.
entries.zh: "是，$playerSirOrMadam，" 你的通讯官点头说道。

entries.en: "Of course, $playerSirOrMadam," $heOrShe says with flawless professional grace.
entries.zh: "当然，$playerSirOrMadam，" $heOrShe以无可挑剔的职业风度说道。

entries.en:
"Understood, $playerSirOrMadam."

"Where do you want to send the task force, captain?" $heOrShe asks, pulling up a star chart in your shared comms-display workspace.

There's a baseline cost to send out a fleet and, of course, additional expense the further the destination is from one of your military bases.
entries.zh:
"明白，$playerSirOrMadam。"

"你想把特遣舰队派往哪里，舰长？" $heOrShe一边问，一边在你们共用的通讯显示屏上调出一幅星图。

派出舰队有一笔基础开销；当然，目的地离你的任何一座军事基地越远，额外费用也越高。

entries.en:
"Understood, $playerSirOrMadam."

"Where do you want the resupply fleet to meet you, captain?" $HeOrShe pulls up a star chart in your shared comms-display workspace.

There's a baseline cost to send out a fleet and, of course, additional expense the further the destination is from one of your military bases.
entries.zh:
"明白，$playerSirOrMadam。"

"你想让补给舰队在哪里与你会合，舰长？" $HeOrShe在你们共用的通讯显示屏上调出一幅星图。

派出舰队有一笔基础开销；当然，目的地离你的任何一座军事基地越远，额外费用也越高。

entries.en:
The scan finds no overt contraband, but there is enough suspicion of your involvement in black market activities that the patrol commander is not appeased by this.

"Prepare to receive a boarding party. We'll be conducting a very thorough, hands-on inspection."

You consider it very likely the inspectors will do some small - but just borderline excusable - damage to the combat worthiness of your ships during the course of this "thorough" inspection.
entries.zh:
扫描没有发现公开的违禁品，但对由于你参与黑市活动的嫌疑充分，巡逻队指挥官对此并未善罢甘休。

"准备好迎接一个登船小组。我们要亲自动手进行一次非常彻底的检查。"

你认为在这次 "彻底" 的检查过程中，检查人员很可能会对你的舰船的战备造成一些还算勉强可以接受的少量损害。

o.en: Comply and prepare for an inspection
Refuse and cut the comm link

entries.en: As you'd half-expected, several of your ships report minor but painful losses of operational capability. Fortunately, the inspectors seemed to be more interested in causing "accidental" damage than looking for actual contraband, so no objectionable cargo was found.
entries.zh: 情况和你预计得差不多，你的几艘船报告说在作战能力上受到了轻微但令人不快的损失。幸运的是，检查人员似乎更热衷于制造 "意外" 损害，而不是去实际寻找违禁品，因此他们没有发现问题货物。

entries.en:
$PersonRank $personName looks vaguely displeased.

"Well, everything looks clean this time."

The comm link is cut before you have a chance to respond.
entries.zh:
$PersonRank $personName 看上去有些失望。

"好吧，看来并没有什么异常。"

没等你做出回应，通讯链接就被切断了。

entries.en:
"Well, well. Just as I suspected, we've got a smuggler here. Per standard $faction procedure, you're required to eject the contraband into space, for pickup or incineration at the discretion of the patrol commander."

$PersonRank $personLastName looks rather pleased, and you suspect that "pickup" rather than "incineration" might be the order of the day.
entries.zh:
"好啊。正如我所料，我们这还真逮到了个走私犯。遵照 $faction 的标准流程，你必须将违禁品抛弃到太空中，由巡逻队指挥官全权决定是拾取还是焚毁。"

$PersonRank $personLastName 看上去相当高兴，你猜今天的命令应该是 "拾取" 而不是 "焚毁"。

o.en: Surrender the contraband and cut the comm link
o.zh: 上交违禁品并切断通讯链接

o.en: Refuse and cut the comm link
Talk your way out of it
Refuse and cut the comm link

entries.en:
The $faction $personRank pauses and looks off-screen.

"But what about these cargo pods, which, let me check - why, they do contain illegal cargo. Not yours, are they? No? Excellent. We'll be confiscating the contents, then."
entries.zh:
$faction $personRank 停了下来，并把视线从屏幕上移开了。

"请你解释下这些货舱是怎么回事，为什么它们装的是违禁品？这不是你的，对吧？不是？很好，我们之后会没收这些玩意。"

entries.en:
"This one requires some discretion." You note the glow of REDACTED blocks peppered across the briefing as $personName scrolls through details. "A fleet of Domain-era derelict drone warships was spotted in the $bcb_systemName, $bcb_dist light-years from here."

"They're usually dormant, guarding some probe that fell off the records. Catches surveyors by surprise. This is different." $HeOrShe looks grim. "A fleet of these things wandering off on their own is, frankly, terrifying. They're not supposed to have independent hyperspace capability or much in the way of fuel capacity, for that matter."

"Whatever this swarm is up to, it needs to be stopped. The reward is $bcb_reward credits - higher than normal, both for the hazard and for your discretion." $Post $personLastName smiles with black humor, "Wouldn't want to alarm the citizens, ha-ha."

"You'll take it, right? We need to conclude the matter within $bcb_days days."
entries.zh:
"面对这个目标时你得守口如瓶，" 当 $personName 展示任务细节时，你注意到简报中布满了 [数据删除] 的字样，"我们在距离这里 $bcb_dist 光年的 $bcb_systemName 中发现了一支人之领时代的无人战舰舰队。"

"它们通常处于休眠状态，保护一些未被记载的探测器，惊吓探索者。但这支舰队不同，" $HeOrShe神色凝重，"坦白说，一群这样的东西随意游荡是很可怕的。他们不该拥有超空间航行的能力或者足够的燃料储量。"

"不管这些东西想干什么，都必须阻止它们。奖励是 $bcb_reward 星币 —— 高于正常水平，既考虑到风险，也考虑到保密要求，" $Post $personLastName 带着黑色幽默笑了起来，"毕竟不能惊扰到那些安居乐业的市民们，哈哈。"

"你会接受的，对吗？你需要在 $bcb_days 天内完成这个任务。"

entries.en:
"I'd take this one on myself if I had a warfleet to command," $heOrShe makes an expression like $heOrShe bit into something sour, "$bcb_targetName is a betrayer, a deserter from $thePersonFaction. An example has to be made. We know $bcb_targetHeOrShe is hiding out in the $bcb_systemName, which is $bcb_dist light-years from here."

"There's a reward of $bcb_reward credits and it'd need to be done within $bcb_days days. Are you up for it?"
entries.zh:
"如果我有一支舰队的话，我会亲自搞定这个人。" $heOrShe脸上露出的表情好像$heOrShe刚咬到了什么酸到极点的东西，"$bcb_targetName 是个叛徒，来自 $thePersonFaction 的逃兵，我们必须杀鸡儆猴。我们知道$bcb_targetHeOrShe藏在 $bcb_systemName 中，距离这里 $bcb_dist 光年。"

"奖励是 $bcb_reward 星币，任务需要在 $bcb_days 天内完成。你愿意吗？"

entries.en:
"This task troubles my soul." $Rank $personName looks more angry than troubled. $HeOrShe takes a deep breath. "I must pray for forgiveness; wrath is unbecoming to spiritual health."

"Let me proceed. We have been betrayed; a turncoat from $thePersonFaction has stolen ships and spread mutiny. We have good intel that $bcb_targetHeOrShe is hiding in the $bcb_systemName, $bcb_dist light-years from here, awaiting some kind of rendezvous."

"They must be intercepted within $bcb_days days. Your payment would be $bcb_reward credits and my personal thanks. Will you perform this service?"
entries.zh:
"这项任务令我心神不宁。" $Rank $personName 看起来更像是生气而非烦恼，$HeOrShe深吸了一口气，"我必须祈求宽恕；愤怒不利于保持精神健康。"

"让我继续说明。我们被背叛了；勾结了 $thePersonFaction 的叛徒偷了船并开始散播叛乱。我们得到可靠情报，$bcb_targetHeOrShe藏在 $bcb_systemName 中，距离这里 $bcb_dist 光年，对方似乎正等待着某种碰头。"

"他们必须在 $bcb_days 天内被拦截。奖励是 $bcb_reward 星币和我个人的感谢。你愿意帮忙吗？"

entries.en:
"This one I admit I would relish to take on myself if I was back in my fleet command days. A deserter, a mutineer," $heOrShe sneers, "Call it what you like, a turncoat from $thePersonFaction is hiding out in the $bcb_systemName, just $bcb_dist light-years away."

"There's a reward of $bcb_reward credits and it'd need to be done within $bcb_days days. Are you up for putting down a traitor?"
entries.zh:
"我承认，如果我还在指挥舰队，我会很乐意承担这个任务。逃兵，叛变者..." $heOrShe冷笑道，"随你怎么称呼这玩意儿，$thePersonFaction 的叛徒就藏在 $bcb_systemName 里，离这里 $bcb_dist 光年。"

"奖励是 $bcb_reward 星币，任务需要在 $bcb_days 天内完成。准备好干掉这个叛徒了吗？"

entries.en:
"We need an enemy station taken out," $heOrShe taps $hisOrHer datapad a couple times with a finger, watching you, just letting that sink in. "It's a big job," $heOrShe says steadily, "With a reward to match. $bcb_reward credits."

$Rank $personName pulls up a display showing $bcb_fleetName, in the $bcb_systemName. "That's $bcb_dist light-years away and we expect the operation to be done within $bcb_days days so that our... other arrangements may proceed. You don't have to worry about them, just focus on the job and you'll be paid. Think you can handle it?"
entries.zh:
"我们需要拿下一个敌方空间站。" $heOrShe用手指轻敲了几下$hisOrHer的数据平板，看着你，"这是一项艰巨的任务。" $heOrShe平静地说，"但也会有相应的报酬，$bcb_reward 星币。"

$personName $Rank 向你展示了位于 $bcb_systemName 中的 $bcb_fleetName。"位于 $bcb_dist 光年外，我们希望任务能在 $bcb_days 内完成，这样我们的...其他工作可以继续进行。你不必担心那些事，只要专注于这项任务，就能得到报酬。你觉得你能行吗？"

entries.en:
"This one," $heOrShe focuses the briefing, "Is not for the faint of heart. An elite mercenary... well, you don't need to know the details. Let's just say $bcb_targetHeOrShe made the wrong people very, very unhappy. $bcb_TargetHeOrShe is hiding out in the $bcb_systemName - that's $bcb_dist light-years away."

"The reward is $bcb_reward credits - lots of hazard pay - and with good reason. Don't take $bcb_targetHimOrHer lightly. Time to complete is $bcb_days days."

$HeOrShe looks at you with grim resolution. "Just so you know, you'd not be the first to try this job. Never heard back from the other guy. There's no shame if you want to stay away from this one."
entries.zh:
"这家伙，" $heOrShe强调道，"不适合贪生怕死之辈去对付。那个精英雇佣兵...哦对，你不需要知道细节。我们只需要知道$bcb_targetHeOrShe让某些不该惹的人非常非常地不愉快就好了。$bcb_TargetHeOrShe目前正藏身在 $bcb_dist 光年之外的 $bcb_systemName 里。"

"报酬是 $bcb_reward 星币，包含有一大笔危险津贴，原因也很明显。千万别小瞧了$bcb_targetHimOrHer。时限为 $bcb_days 天。"

$HeOrShe用冷得让人坐立不安的眼神看着你。"顺便说一下，你并不是第一个试着接下这活的人。不过另一个家伙在接手之后就杳无音讯了。所以就算你打算放弃这个目标，那也没什么丢脸的。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe pulls up a blurry holo taken on a docking concourse. "This particular mercenary has been causing a lot of problems for an operation a friend of mine is running. I'd like to see you solve my friend's problems... for good."

$PersonName swipes the holo away and pulls up a sector map, "We've set $bcb_targetHimOrHer up on a wild goose chase in the $bcb_systemName, only $bcb_dist light-years away. $bcb_TargetHeOrShe thinks $bcb_targetHeOrShe is tracking down a dead-drop of advanced weapons," $heOrShe smiles ruthlessly.

"I'm arranging this as a favor for my friend, and my friend has agreed to pay whoever takes the job $bcb_reward credits. Time to complete is $bcb_days days. Can you take care of it?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe展示了一张在港口大厅拍摄的模糊全息照片。"这个雇佣兵给我一个朋友的行动带来了很多麻烦。我想让你帮忙解决我朋友的问题...一劳永逸地解决。"

$PersonName 将照片拉到了一边，然后打开了星图。"我们诱使$bcb_targetHimOrHer去 $bcb_dist 光年外的 $bcb_systemName 中调查一些虚无缥缈的东西。$bcb_TargetHeOrShe现在应该觉得$bcb_targetHeOrShe能在那找到一些先进武器的藏匿点。" $heOrShe无情地笑着。

"我安排这件事是为了帮我的朋友一个忙，我的朋友同意向任何接受工作的人支付 $bcb_reward 星币。任务时间为 $bcb_days 天。你能处理好吗？"

entries.en:
"Ah, this one is a piece of work," $heOrShe brings up a case file. "Luddic Path operative. Connected to a few bombings, piracy, the usual. $bcb_TargetHeOrShe is hiding out in the $bcb_systemName, that's a $bcb_dist light-year hop."

"A few of the local syndics pitched in, so the job's reward is $bcb_reward credits. You'd have $bcb_days days to take $bcb_targetHimOrHer out. Interested?"
entries.zh:
"啊，这有份工作，" $heOrShe拿出一份案件档案。"卢德左径分子。司空见惯地跟几起爆炸案和海盗活动什么的有关。$bcb_TargetHeOrShe藏在 $bcb_systemName 中，去那一趟要 $bcb_dist 光年。"

"本地一些有头有脸的大人物也搅合了进来，所以这份工作的报酬给到了 $bcb_reward 星币。你有 $bcb_days 天来搞定$bcb_targetHimOrHer。感兴趣吗？"

entries.en:
"Ah, this one, yes," $heOrShe pulls up an intel file. "An adherent of the so-called 'Luddic Path'. Believes we'd all be better off smashing our computers and living in caves or some nonsense. You wouldn't believe the damage they cause when they can bring themselves to use real technology to meet their goals. This one is hiding out in the $bcb_systemName, $bcb_dist light-years away, and has caused great personal offense."

"I shall provide a reward of $bcb_reward credits for taking care of this fanatic. You'd have $bcb_days days to complete the mission."
entries.zh:
"啊，这个，是这样。" $heOrShe打开一份情报文件。"这有群所谓的 '卢德循径派'。他们认为我们最好应该把我们的电脑全砸了，再住进山洞还是其他什么鬼地方里。你不会想知道当他们给自己搞到了足够技术力之后为了实现目标能带来多大的损害。这家伙藏在 $bcb_systemName，距离这里 $bcb_dist 光年，已经产生了不小的人身威胁。"

"我会给你 $bcb_reward 星币去干掉这个狂信徒。你有 $bcb_days 天的时间来完成任务。"

entries.en:
"This one is a sensitive matter," $heOrShe goes quiet for a moment.

"One of our... former knights has broken their vows to join a sect of the so-called Luddic Path. A heretic recently confessed, confirming our intel on the betrayer. They're hiding out in the $bcb_systemName, $bcb_dist light-years from here."

"The Church has granted an indulgence for this execution in consideration of the heinous crimes and heretical acts committed in the name of the prophet. A recompense of $bcb_reward credits is offered as well. It would be expected that the job be complete within $bcb_days days. Do you accept?"
entries.zh:
"这是个比较敏感的麻烦。" $heOrShe沉默了一会儿。

"我们的一队...前任骑士，违背誓言并加入了所谓的卢德循径派。最近一位寻求赦免的异端者证实了我们关于这位背信者的情报。他们藏身在 $bcb_systemName，距离此地 $bcb_dist 光年。"

"鉴于他们假借先知之名所犯下的滔天罪行和异端行径，教会已经恩准这份处决令。同时将提供 $bcb_reward 星币作为酬报。我们期待你能在 $bcb_days 天内完成这个任务。你接受吗？"

entries.en:
"Just look at this do-gooder." $HeOrShe pulls up a standard ID holo of a military officer in uniform. "Too upright and honest to know when it's time to compromise a bit to make things easier on everyone. Get paid, look the other way, doesn't hurt anyone who doesn't deserve it, right?" $personName shakes $hisOrHer head at stubborn law-abiders.

"$bcb_TargetHeOrShe's commanding a $bcb_patrolFaction patrol fleet operating out of $bcb_targetMarketName in the $bcb_systemName, $bcb_dist light-years away. You'll find $bcb_targetHimOrHer patrolling either near there, a nearby jump-point, or one of their orbital strategic assets like a comm relay and the like."

$HeOrShe dismisses the ID holo with a contemptuous flick. "Take $bcb_targetHimOrHer out. You'll get $bcb_reward credits. I'll give you $bcb_days days to complete the job. Think you can handle that?"
entries.zh:
"看看这个大好人。" $HeOrShe调出了一个身穿制服的军官的全息影像，"太正直和诚实了，不知道什么时候该妥协一点，好让每个人都过的轻松些。拿钱，睁一只眼闭一只眼，不伤害不该伤害的人，对吧？" $personName 对着固执的守法者摇了摇$hisOrHer的头。

" $bcb_TargetHeOrShe正指挥着 $bcb_patrolFaction 巡逻舰队，在 $bcb_dist 光年之外 $bcb_systemName 中的 $bcb_targetMarketName 上活动着，你能在那里找到$bcb_targetHimOrHer，不在的话可以去看看附近的跳跃点，或者是附近的轨道战略资产，比如通信中继站等等。"

$HeOrShe轻蔑地关掉了全息影像。"干掉$bcb_targetHimOrHer，你会得到 $bcb_reward 星币的报酬。我会给你 $bcb_days 天时间来完成这项工作。你觉得你能搞定吗？"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe taps on one of the entries to enlarge the report. A face scowls at you from an arrest record holo.

"This one's a pirate hiding out in the $bcb_systemName, that's $bcb_dist light-years away. Had a falling out with an associate who talked. That gave us enough to confirm the intel."

"The reward is $bcb_reward credits and you'd have $bcb_days days to carry out the job. How about it?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe点了点其中一个条目，列出了它的详细信息。全息通缉令上的那张脸正对你皱着眉头，

"这是个藏在 $bcb_systemName 中的海盗，距离这里 $bcb_dist 光年。我们掌握了一名从那个人的组织里脱离出来的线人，足以让我们确定情报的真实性。"

"奖励是 $bcb_reward 星币，你有 $bcb_days 天来完成这项工作，如何？"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe taps on one of the entries to enlarge the report. A face scowls at you from an arrest record holo.

"This charming individual believes they're some kind of pirate." $PersonName gets a carnivorous look in $hisOrHer eyes, "$bcb_TargetHeOrShe stole from me. This is unacceptable." $HeOrShe leans back, casually, "The lost credits are irrelevant, of course. What's important is the message such brigandage sends. We simply can't have pirates stealing wealth from those who rightfully possess it."

"The target is hiding in the $bcb_systemName which is $bcb_dist light-years distant. I shall reward you with $bcb_reward credits once you have put down the menace, and I shall give you $bcb_days days to do so. Are we agreed?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe点了点其中一个条目，列出了它的详细信息。全息通缉令上的那张脸正对你皱着眉头，

"这应该是某种海盗。" $PersonName 让$hisOrHer的眼睛投射出一种要生啖其肉的目光，" $bcb_TargetHeOrShe从我这里偷了东西，这完全不可接受。" $HeOrShe向后靠了靠，一副无所谓的样子，"当然，丢了点星币无关紧要。重要的是这种抢劫行为传递的信息。我们不能让海盗从合法拥有者那里偷走辛苦挣来的财富。"

"目标藏在 $bcb_systemName 中，那离这里 $bcb_dist 光年远。搞定目标后我会给你 $bcb_reward 星币，时限是 $bcb_days 天。成交？"

entries.en:
"This one requires some discretion." You note the glow of REDACTED blocks peppered across the briefing as $personName scrolls through details. "A fleet of Remnant drone warships was spotted in the $bcb_systemName, only $bcb_dist light-years from here."

"These things are left over from one of the AI Wars - some pencilneck decided they weren't worth the cost of cleaning up. But this fleet is more active than usual so there's been some concern from up the chain of command." $HeOrShe skewers you with a look, "Way up."

"Whatever they're up to, some important people will sleep better if it's stopped. The reward is $bcb_reward credits - higher than normal, both for the hazard and for your discretion. Command wants this done within $bcb_days days."
entries.zh:
"面对这个目标时你得守口如瓶，" 当 $personName 展示任务细节时，你注意到简报中布满了 [数据删除] 的字样，"在 $bcb_systemName 发现了一支余辉舰队，距离这里只有 $bcb_dist 光年。"

"这些东西是在某次 AI 战争遗留下来的 —— 一些书呆子认为它们不值得花大力气去清理。但这支舰队比以往更加活跃，因此上级指挥部门对此表示担忧，" $HeOrShe的双眼直直地盯着你，"非常担忧。"

"不管这支舰队要做什么，它们停转了会让一些大人物睡得更香。奖励是 $bcb_reward 星币 —— 高于正常水平，既考虑到风险，也考虑到保密要求。指挥部希望这个任务能在 $bcb_days 天内被完成。"

entries.en:
"I speak in strict confidence," $heOrShe looks sternly at you. "A long range patrol spotted a fleet of Remnant drone warships in the $bcb_systemName, $bcb_dist light-years distant. That patrol didn't make it back."

"We did find an intel drop left by that patrol, and in it we found this." $Rank $personLastName pulls up a grainy image, little more than a silhouette in false color. An angular shape. "It's unlike anything we've got on the AI War leftovers. Analysis shows no similarities in component profiles, so it's not even some kind of hack-job." With a swipe the $rank dismisses the image.

"Take it out. The reward is $bcb_reward credits. If that seems high, it's because you'd be dealing with something unusual. Unusual means risky, and STRATCOM thinks an unusual problem could use an unusual solution, thus-" $heOrShe indicates you with an open palm. "Are you in?"
entries.zh:
"接下来我说的都必须严格保密。" $heOrShe一本正经地看着你，"一支远程巡逻队在距离这里 $bcb_dist 光年远的 $bcb_systemName 发现了一支余辉舰队。那支巡逻队没能返航。"

"我们设法找到了巡逻队传输的情报，并在里面发现了这个。" $personLastName $Rank 向你展示了一张充满了噪点的模糊图像，里面只有一个人为用颜色标注出来的轮廓，外形看起来有棱有角的。"它看起来不像我们遇到过的任何一个 AI 战争时期的残留物。元件特征分析显示它和余辉战舰没有相似之处，所以这应该也不是什么拼凑出来的东西。" 轻轻一划后，$rank 将这张图片删除了。

"去干掉它。任务的奖励是 $bcb_reward 星币。这报酬看起来很高，毕竟你要去处理一些不同寻常的东西。不寻常意味着有风险，而 STRATCOM 认为不寻常的问题就应该采取不寻常的解决方案，因此 —— " $heOrShe摊开手指向了你，示意你就是那个解决方案。"你接这活吗？"

entries.en:
"This one comes straight from the office of the Hegemon," $heOrShe watches you carefully. "A long range patrol picked up a probe-drop in the $bcb_systemName, $bcb_dist light-years distant. This is what it found."

$Rank $personLastName pulls up a shared display, swiping through REDACTED warnings and biometric confirmations. You see the grainy image of a large orbital structure, subsections highlighted in false color and labeled by some Hegemony analyst.  "A functional Remnant station - I believe 'nexus' is what Tri-Tach called them - leftover from the AI Wars. Some pencilneck thought these were too expensive to clear out. Ticking time-bombs if you ask me. You never know when it might start pumping out warships or PKs." With a swipe the $rank dismisses the image.

"The Hegemon finally decided to do something about it - unofficially. That means an operator like you," $heOrShe says in a way that suggests the navy should be taking care of this. "The reward is $bcb_reward credits for hazard and discretion. You'll have $bcb_days days to take this thing out."
entries.zh:
"这是直接从至高霸主办公室派发的任务。" $heOrShe细细端详着你，"一支远程巡逻队在 $bcb_systemName，也就是 $bcb_dist 光年外的地方回收了一个探测器，而这就是探测器上记载的东西。"

$personLastName $Rank 调出了一副共享显示的图像，在大量 [数据删除] 的警告和生物识别确认信息中，你看到了一个大型轨道结构的模糊图像，一些子结构已经被 霸主 分析师用显眼的颜色标出。"仍在运作的余辉空间站 —— 我认为 '中枢' 是 速子科技 对它们的称呼 —— 那是 AI 战争的遗留物。一些书呆子认为它们不值得花大力气去清理，但要我说，这是一颗定时炸弹。你永远不知道它什么时候会开始大量生产战舰甚至是行星杀手。" $rank 轻轻一划将这张图片删除了。

"至高霸主最终决定做点什么 —— 以非官方手段。也就是雇用一位像你这样的特工。" $heOrShe说，但语气中透出一幅认为这是海军该处理的事的感觉，"奖励是 $bcb_reward 星币，考虑到了危险和你的慎重。你将有 $bcb_days 天来搞定它。"

entries.en:
"I speak now of a matter most disturbing," $heOrShe says, making the sign of Ludd's hammer. "We have received word from a far-travelling prospector of the faith that there is a functional Remnant station - I believe the technical term is 'nexus' - $bcb_dist light-years away, in the $bcb_systemName. A long range scout sent by the Knights has confirmed this."

"This 'nexus' dates to one or the other of the AI Crusades. The Hegemony considered them 'too expensive'  to properly cleanse." $HeOrShe looks up and seems to quote something, "'Thus does evil prevail when good falters not for want of courage, but mere empty stomach or weary limb." $Rank $personName turns $hisOrHer eyes back to you, filled with some new fervor. "It has been left to the Church to take action."

"We have not the fleets the Hegemony does and it would be... impolitic to flaunt the moral failure of our wavering ally in the battle against these artificial demons. So the Church comes to you with an offer of $bcb_reward credits, with due consideration of the risk and your discretion. We would expect this task to be done within $bcb_days days."
entries.zh:
"这是最令人不安的事情。" $heOrShe说着比了个代表卢德之锤的手势，"我们从一个远行的勘探者那里收到消息，说有一个余辉空间站 —— 术语应该是 '中枢' —— 正在 $bcb_systemName 中运作着，那离这里 $bcb_dist 光年。骑士团派去的远程侦察队证实了这一点。"

"这种 '中枢' 可以追溯到 AI 圣战时代。霸主 认为清理它们 '成本太高' 了。" $HeOrShe抬起头，似乎想要引述什么，"恶将取胜，只当善因缺乏勇气，因饥肠辘辘，因四肢乏力而踌躇不前。" $personName $Rank 重新将$hisOrHer的目光投向了你，那之中充满了热情。"但教会不能坐视不管。"

"我们没有 霸主 那样的舰队，而这...在对抗那些人造恶魔的战斗中，向我们摇摆不定的盟友展示我们站在道德的制高点上是不明智的。因此，教会在充分考虑风险和你的谨慎的情况下，向你提供 $bcb_reward 星币，并希望你能在 $bcb_days 内完成这个任务。"

entries.en:
"One of our undercover walkers has found records long hidden by the Hegemony. They have hidden the existence of a fully functional Remnant station, or 'nexus' as the Tri-Tachyon apostates call it, some $bcb_dist light-years away, in the $bcb_systemName."

"It is truly an obscenity in the eyes of Providence that such a citadel of corruption would be left standing all these cycles since the great AI Crusades. We can only speculate why the Hegemony has hidden them, but," $rank $personName speaks with greater fervor, "Truly it is our righteous Path to purge these machine-demons from God's holy vacuum."

"If only I could lead a fleet to do this task - alas, the Path's warships are stretched thin, and to amass a fleet able to take such a target would invite... attention. So, we set aside our pride and offer you $bcb_reward credits to do this holy duty - within $bcb_days days, for always evil labors while the good rest idle. Will you do it?"
entries.zh:
"我们的一名卧底探员发现了 霸主 隐藏已久的记录。他们向大众隐瞒了一个能正常运转的余辉空间站的存在，或者叫 '中枢'，用速子叛教者的话来说 ，它位于 $bcb_systemName 中，距离我们 $bcb_dist 光年。"

"自伟大的 AI 圣战以来，如此腐败的堡垒一直矗立在那里，这在上天的眼中是一种亵渎。霸主 隐藏它们的存在的原因我们不得而知，但是，" $personName $rank 带着更大的热情说道，"这正是我们从神圣真空中清除这些机器恶魔的正义之路。"

"要是我能带领一支舰队去完成这项任务就好了 —— 唉，左径战舰已经为数不多了，而要集结兵力去攻下这样一个目标会带来...不必要的关注。所以，我们舍弃了我们的荣耀，并向你提供 $bcb_reward 星币来完成这个神圣的任务 —— 在 $bcb_days 天之内，只因善者停歇之时，邪恶蠢蠢欲动。你愿意接受吗？"

entries.en:
"This job is for a trade fleet. The owner needs to receive a stern message."

$HeOrShe pulls up what looks like an internal customs inspection order, with attached fleet disposition report. "We've put in a word to a, ah, friendly officer in the customs department to hold them up for inspection in the $bcb_systemName, $bcb_dist light-years away." $HeOrShe smirks, "Very convenient, that. Less convenient is the patrol on guard to ensure they don't leave too soon, so I'll leave it to you to figure out how to get around that little complication."

"You'll get $bcb_reward credits for taking them out. The time frame is tight - you've got at most $bcb_days days before they get around to the inspection, and then they'll get away. How's that sound?"
entries.zh:
"这是个贸易舰队的活儿。舰队的主人需要收到严厉的警告。"

$HeOrShe拿出了一份内部海关检查命令，并附上舰队处置报告。"我们已经和海关部门的一个...嗯，友好的官员捎了几句话，让他们在 $bcb_dist 光年远外的 $bcb_systemName 把目标拖住。" $HeOrShe得意地笑着说，"很方便，不是吗？不过有些不太方便的是，为了确保目标舰队不会太早离开，巡逻队必须守在那附近，你必须自己找个方法解决这个小问题。"

"给你的报酬是 $bcb_reward 星币。时间很紧，任务得在他们进行检查之前完成，在他们离开之前估计最多只能拖住 $bcb_days 天。听起来怎么样？"

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。

entries.en:
The $post looks like they've seen a ghost.

"Captain $playerLastName, by the grace of holy Ludd and all that is blessed, what unholy creation have you brought here? What have you done to your $shipOrFleet?"

The questions are rhetorical, judging by the chimes and pings from your tactical officer's console- targeting alerts from defense batteries.
entries.zh:
$post 的脸色就像他活见鬼了一般。

"$playerLastName 舰长，藉着圣卢德的恩典和他的祝福，你都带来了什么不洁的造物？你都对你的$shipOrFleet做了什么？"

这些问题是对你的质问，从你战术军官的控制台传来的警报声和提示音便可知晓 —— 那是被防御炮台锁定的警报。

entries.en:
Your comms officer calls for your attention.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. There's an incoming comms request, marked urgent, from the portwatcher. They want to speak with you personally."
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官对你示意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。港区监视者发来一条紧急通讯请求，要求与您本人通话。"

entries.en:
"The curates technologia have already passed judgement on your... your unholy combination of human craft and demonic 'technology'," $heOrShe says.

"Go now from this place and never return! Take your technological abominations and be accursed in the eyes of God and the Church. You are henceforth an abomination to be destroyed on sight!"

$HeOrShe clasps $hisOrHer hands together, mumbling some prayer.
entries.zh:
"技术祭司会已经对你... 对你用人类工艺与恶魔 '科技' 亵渎的结合作出了裁决，" $heOrShe说。

"立刻离开此处，再也不要回来！带上你用技术亵渎的造物，在神与教会的注视下被诅咒吧。自此刻起，你就是人人得而诛之的可憎之物！"

$HeOrShe双手合十，喃喃念着祷词。

o.en: Cut the link and take evasive action

$HeOrShe双手合十，喃喃念着祷词。

"The curates technologia have already passed judgement on your... your unholy combination of human craft and demonic 'technology'," $heOrShe says. "Your commission is revoked. You are excommunicated, declared outlaw and enemy of the Faith."

"Go now from this place and never return! Take your technological abominations and be accursed in the eyes of God and the Church. You are henceforth an abomination to be destroyed on sight!"

$HeOrShe clasps $hisOrHer hands together, mumbling some prayer.
entries.zh:
"技术祭司会已经对你... 对你用人类工艺与恶魔 '科技' 亵渎的结合作出了裁决，"$heOrShe说。"你的雇佣协议已被撤销。你也已经被逐出教会，并作为信仰的叛徒与公敌遭到通缉。"

"立刻离开此处，再也不要回来！带上你用技术亵渎的造物，在神与教会的注视下被诅咒吧。自此刻起，你就是人人得而诛之的可憎之物！"

$HeOrShe双手合十，喃喃念着祷词。

entries.en:
"The blessing of Ludd be upon-" The $post's eyes go suddenly wide at a red flash from a secondary display.

"By the holy pneuma," $heOrShe gasps.
entries.zh:
"愿卢德的祝福与你 ——" $post 突然瞪大了双眼看向旁边显示屏所显示的红色警告。

"圣灵在上啊，" $heOrShe深吸一口气。

entries.en:
"The blessing of Ludd be upon-" The $post's eyes go suddenly wide at a red flash from a secondary display.

"By the holy pneuma," $heOrShe gasps.
entries.zh:
"愿卢德的祝福与你 ——" $post 突然瞪大了双眼看向旁边显示屏所显示的红色警告。

"圣灵在上啊，" $heOrShe深吸一口气。

entries.en:
"What by blessed Ludd's holy right glove have you done to your $shipOrFleet? Is that the cursed work of Moloch my eyes do perceive in your $shipOrFleet?"

$HeOrShe looks over $hisOrHer shoulder, "Summon the subcurate technologia! For immediate consultation!"

The $post turns back to you. "You have but a moment to explain what my sensors suggest, captain."
entries.zh:
"以卢德神圣的右手手套之名，你对你的$shipOrFleet做了什么？莫非我眼中所见的，你那$shipOrFleet上的污秽，是莫洛克那被诅咒的造物？"

$heOrShe回头喊道："传唤技术助理祭司！即刻前来商议！"

$post 转回身面对着你。"你只有片刻时间来解释我的传感器探测到了什么，舰长。"

o.en: Is it my... unique modifications you object to?
o.zh: 你们反对的是我那...独特的改装吗？

o.en: There seems to be some kind of misunderstanding.
What exactly do your sensors suggest?
o.zh: 你们的传感器具体探测到了什么？

entries.en:
"Unique mod-" $HeOrShe sputters.

"It is devilry! You've joined human craft with abomination. It is an unholy thing!"  $HeOrShe makes some kind of hurry-up hand signal over $hisOrHer shoulder.

"You condemn your soul to the abyss. And you condemn yourself as mortal enemy to the Church and accursed in the eyes of God and all who hold faith." $HisOrHer expression is grim.

The $post turns and exchanges a few words with someone you can't see.
entries.zh:
"独特的改装 ——" $heOrShe语无伦次。

"这是魔鬼的行径！你将人类的工艺与亵渎之物结合。这是不洁的造物！" $heOrShe在肩后做了个催促的手势。

"你将自己的灵魂抛入了深渊，更使自己沦落为教会的死敌，在神与所有信徒眼中永受诅咒。" $hisOrHer的神情十分严峻。

$post 转身与你看不见的人低语了几句。

entries.en:
"Methinks there is not, $playerSirOrMadam, and you merely dissemble with a devil's tongue to gain advantage." $HeOrShe makes some kind of hurry-up hand signal over $hisOrHer shoulder.

"Judgement shall be pronounced ere long upon what my heart fears."

The $post turns and exchanges a few words with someone you can't see.
entries.zh:
"我认为并非如此，$playerSirOrMadam，你不过是用魔鬼的巧舌进行诡辩，以为自己谋取私利罢了。" $heOrShe在肩后做了个催促的手势。

"我心中所惧之事，不久便将接受判决。"

$post 转身与你看不见的人低语了几句。

entries.en:
"Overt devilry. You've combined human craft with abomination." $HeOrShe makes some kind of hurry-up hand signal over $hisOrHer shoulder.

"By this unholy 'technology' you condemn your soul to the abyss. And you condemn yourself as mortal enemy to the Church, accursed in the eyes of God and all who hold faith!"

The $post turns and exchanges a few words with someone you can't see.
entries.zh:
"明目张胆的魔鬼行径。你竟将人类的工艺与亵渎之物结合。" $heOrShe在肩后做了个催促的手势。

"因为这不洁的 '科技'，你将自己的灵魂抛入了深渊，更使自己沦落为教会的死敌，在神与所有信徒眼中永受诅咒！"

$post 转身与你看不见的人低语了几句。

entries.en:
"You're certain?" $heOrShe asks. $HisOrHer face has gone pale, as if $heOrShe has been informed that $heOrShe has been condemned.

The briefest flash of emotions: pain, fear, outrage, sadness, acceptance. The eyes that turn back to the comm-link are that of an enemy across battle-lines.
entries.zh:
"你确定吗？" $heOrShe问道。$hisOrHer的脸色发白，如同被告知自己已被判处死刑一般。

情绪在转瞬之间闪过：痛苦、恐惧、愤怒、悲伤、接受。当目光重新投向通讯链接时，已化作战场对面的敌人的眼神。

entries.en:
"There is no negotiation with evil, no compromise." The $post's words are for $hisOrHer crew, not you.

The link shudders into static, the last image is of hands clasped in a brief prayer.
entries.zh:
"与邪恶既不可谈判，也不可妥协。" $post 此言是对$hisOrHer的船员所说，而非对你。

通讯链接噼啪作响，化作一片雪花，最后一幕是双手合十的短暂祈祷画面。

通讯链接噼啪作响，化作一片雪花，最后一幕是双手合十的短暂祈祷画面。

o.en: I am commissioned by the Church!

entries.en: "You are no longer," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh: "你不再受雇了，" $heOrShe说道。

o.en: Hold your condemnation for a moment, for I share your Faith.
o.zh: 请暂且收起你的谴责，因为我与你怀有相同的信仰。

entries.en: "I abjure your heresy ," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh: "我唾弃你的异端邪说，" $heOrShe说道。

o.en: Let's discuss this before jumping to conclusions...
o.zh: 在草率定论之前，我们不妨先谈谈...

o.en: Perhaps we come to an 'arrangement'? Just name a price...
o.zh: 或许我们可以达成一笔 '协定'？那不妨开个价...

entries.en: "Corruptor, mammonite!" $heOrShe spits.
entries.zh: "腐化者，玛门之仆！" $heOrShe唾骂道。

o.zh: 这是非理性的冲动之举，$post。

entries.en:
"An abomination, a devil-$shipOrFleet from Hell itself is before us! We pray to Providence to pass this test which has been given unto our unworthy-"

The $post's words are for $hisOrHer crew, not you, and the link shudders into static. The last image you see are hands clasped in prayer.
entries.zh:
"一具污秽的造物，一支来自地狱本身的魔鬼$shipOrFleet就在我们眼前！我们祈求天命让我们这些卑微者通过这降临的考验 ——"

$post 此言是对$hisOrHer的船员所说，而非对你。随后，通讯链接在噼啪作响中化作一片雪花，最后一幕是双手合十的短暂祈祷画面。
