entries.en:
You approach the private booth, doing your best to look both important and well-connected. It seems to work; the $cpm_manOrWoman looks up from $hisOrHer TriPad and motions for you to join $himOrHer.

"Captain $playerName. Please, sit." $heOrShe gives a small smile at catching you off-guard, and pours a tiny glass of something decadent from the bottle. "I've heard so much about your accomplishments. It's all very enterprising. Bravo."

$HeOrShe raises the tiny glass, "To opportunity," sips, then places the glass down beside $hisOrHer TriPad. "I have a proposal for you. An opportunity."
entries.zh:
你走近这个专属座位，尽量让自己看起来像个有影响的大人物。你的伪装奏效了，这个$cpm_manOrWoman从$HeOrShe的 TriPad 上移开了目光，一边向你示意，请你过去和$HeOrShe聊聊。

"请坐，$playerName 舰长。" $heOrShe在你不知所措的时候露出一丝微笑，然后从瓶子里倒了一小杯纨绔子弟才会享用的琼浆，"我听说过你的很多成就，你是个很有事业心的人，我很欣赏。"

$HeOrShe举起小酒杯，"敬机遇！" 抿了一口后，对方将酒杯放在了$HeOrShe的 TriPad 旁边。"我有个提议给你，一个机遇。"

entries.en:
"I need a steady supply of $cpm_needed units of $cpm_commodityName from a reliable colonial administrator. My organization would expect first delivery within $cpm_missionCycles cycles. Once established, I would arrange for monthly payments of $cpm_monthlyPayment credits over $cpm_contractCycles cycles, for a total of $cpm_totalPayment credits."

$HeOrShe slides $hisOrHer TriPad across the table for your review. It states the terms of the contract as described. "I believe this arrangement could benefit both of us for a long time."
entries.zh:
"我需要一个能稳定提供 $cpm_needed 单位的 $cpm_commodityName 的殖民地供应商。我的公司预计第一批货物需要在 $cpm_missionCycles 个星历年内完成交付。一旦协议达成，我会每个月付款 $cpm_monthlyPayment 星币，协议持续 $cpm_contractCycles 星历年，总计是 $cpm_totalPayment 星币。"

$HeOrShe将 TriPad 从桌面上滑过来请你过目，它显示了刚才所述的合同条款。"我相信这次合作对我们双方都有好处。"

entries.en:
You approach the private booth, doing your best to look both important and well-connected. It seems to work; the $cpm_manOrWoman waves back $hisOrHer bodyguards and motions for you to join $himOrHer.

"Is it Captain $playerName? Of course it is." $HeOrShe pours $himOrHerself something from the fabulously expensive bottle at the center of the table. "My informants have told me so much about you. Your accomplishments," $hisOrHer eyebrows lift, "Your exploits. I admire your pursuit of power. No, don't deny it," $heOrShe says, swirling $hisOrHer glass, "You do it well, and that is why we are speaking."

$HeOrShe empties $hisOrHer glass, then says "I would very much like us to work together."
entries.zh:
你走近私人隔间，尽力通过姿态展示自己既重要又有人脉。这似乎奏效了；$cpm_manOrWoman向$hisOrHer的保镖挥了挥手，以示可以让你与$himOrHer进行会谈。

"你就是 $playerName 舰长？没错，当然是。" $HeOrShe拿起桌子中央的某种昂贵饮料，给自己倒了一杯。"我的线人告诉了我很多关于你的事。" $hisOrHer扬了扬眉毛，"你的成就，你的功绩。我钦佩你对力量的追求。别急着否认。" $heOrShe边说边摇晃着杯子，"你做得很好，这就是我愿意与你谈话的原因。"

$heOrShe喝光了$hisOrHer杯中的饮料，然后说："我非常希望有能与你共事的机会。"

entries.en:
"I require a steady supply of $cpm_needed units of $cpm_commodityName from a colonial administrator who is willing to ensure reliability by any means necessary."

"Any." $HeOrShe pounds $hisOrHer glass on the table to emphasize the point.

"My organization would expect a first delivery within $cpm_missionCycles cycles. Once established, I would arrange for monthly payments of $cpm_monthlyPayment credits over $cpm_contractCycles cycles, for a total of $cpm_totalPayment credits."

$HeOrShe pours two glasses from the bottle. "If you agree, I will accept you on your word." $HeOrShe produces a chilling smile and motions toward the glasses. "This partnership could prove to be very profitable, $playerName."
entries.zh:
"我需要一位殖民地管理员稳定供给 $cpm_needed 单位的 $cpm_commodityName，不惜任何代价。"

"任何。" $HeOrShe把$hisOrHer的杯子砸在桌子上以强调这一点。

"我的组织希望能在 $cpm_missionCycles 星历年内实现第一次交付。一旦合同成立，我会在 $cpm_contractCycles 星历年内每月向你支付 $cpm_monthlyPayment 星币，总计 $cpm_totalPayment 星币。"

$HeOrShe倒满了两杯饮料。"合同成立只需要你的口头答应。" $HeOrShe露出了令人不寒而栗的微笑，一边推了推眼镜，"这次合作将为我们双方带来巨大的利润，$playerName。"

entries.en:
"I need a steady supply of $cpm_needed units of $cpm_commodityName from a reliable colonial administrator. I would expect full production brought online within $cpm_missionCycles cycles. Once established, I would arrange for monthly payments of $cpm_monthlyPayment credits over $cpm_contractCycles cycles, for a total of $cpm_totalPayment credits."

"This could prove quite lucrative if you could guarantee the stable supply chain our operation requires," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh:
"我需要一个能稳定提供 $cpm_needed 单位的 $cpm_commodityName 的殖民地供应商。我的公司预计第一批货物需要在 $cpm_missionCycles 个星历年内完成交付。一旦协议达成，我会每个月付款 $cpm_monthlyPayment 星币，协议持续 $cpm_contractCycles 星历年，总计是 $cpm_totalPayment 星币。"

"如果你能保证我司所需的稳定供货，这可是相当有利可图的。" $heOrShe说道。

entries.en:
"I require a steady supply of $cpm_needed units of $cpm_commodityName from a colonial administrator who is willing to ensure reliability by any means necessary. My organization would expect your operation to be set up within $cpm_missionCycles cycles. Once established, I would make monthly payments to you of $cpm_monthlyPayment credits. These would continue for $cpm_contractCycles cycles, for a total of $cpm_totalPayment credits."

"If you agree, I will accept you on your word," $heOrShe says. "We make a good team, $playerName. Who would dare stand against such a partnership?" $HeOrShe produces a chilling smile.
entries.zh:
"我需要一位殖民地管理员稳定供应 $cpm_needed 单位的 $cpm_commodityName，不惜一切代价。我的组织希望能在 $cpm_missionCycles 星历年内完成第一次交付。一旦合同成立，我会每月向你支付 $cpm_monthlyPayment 星币，我们的合同将持续 $cpm_contractCycles 星历年，你将得到总计 $cpm_totalPayment 星币。"

"合同成立只需要你的口头同意。" $HeOrShe说道，"我们可以成为很好的合作伙伴，$playerName，谁敢对抗如此坚固的联合呢？" $HeOrShe露出了令人不寒而栗的微笑。

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName." The pirate $personRank looks almost apologetic on the comm display. "This is about the big $cpm_commodityName transport operation you're involved in. An anonymous competitor wants to send a message. Not to you, of course. You'll be dead. To the individual who hired you. I just figured I should let you know why out of professional courtesy."

"I mean, it's not all bad news," $heOrShe shrugs, "I'm going to be paid very, very well. Enough to retire somewhere nice." $HeOrShe sighs wistfully, then interrupts $himOrHerself to raise a scolding finger, "Paid on completion, mind you. So don't even think of trying to buy me off."
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长。" 出现在通讯显示屏上的海盗 $personRank 看起来歉意十足，"我会找上你是因为你牵涉进了一起巨额 $cpm_commodityName 的运输中。某位匿名竞争者想要传递一条消息，不是给你的，因为你马上就要死了。这消息本来是给你的雇主的，不过出于职业道德，我想我应该让你死得明白些。"

"我想说，其实这也不坏。" $heOrShe耸了耸肩，"我会得到非常不错的报酬，足够享受不错的退休生活了。" $HeOrShe带着渴望的眼神叹了口气，然后训斥似的竖起了一根手指，"对了，我这任务是完成后才能收款的，所以别想收买我。"

entries.en:
The long-haul cryosystems were built to last for centuries of interstellar travel so it's no surprise that most of the pod-support machinery reads as functional. While safe sleeper revival is beyond the capability of your fleet, a colony established within 10 light-years of this location could benefit from a huge influx in population if it built facilities to awaken long-haul sleepers.

Your executive officer cautions that it's unknown whether having sleepers make up a large percentage of a colony's population would cause any physical or psychological issues down the line.
entries.zh:
长途冷冻设施是为进行长达数个世纪的星际旅行为目的设计建造的，因此不出意料的，大部分的冷冻舱维持机构的读数显示其运作正常。虽然你的舰队没有能力安全地复苏休眠者，但在 10 光年范围内建立的殖民地可以通过建设低温复苏设施来获得庞大的人口流入量。

你的行政官员提醒你，目前还尚未明确复苏者在殖民地的人口中占比过高是否会引发潜在的生理或心理问题。

entries.en: "Aye, captain," $heOrShe says. "We'll have to ration some supplies and it'll be a tight burn back to base, but we should be able to maintain similar combat readiness for another 60 days."
entries.zh: "是，舰长，\" $heOrShe说道，\"我们得省着点用补给，返航回基地的燃料也会很紧张，不过再撑 60 天，我们应该还能保持差不多的战备状态。"

entries.en: "Affirmative, we'll match course."
entries.zh: "收到，我们会保持同航向。"

entries.en:
"Aye captain, it'll be my pleasure," $heOrShe says.

Before long your primary bridge display is overwhelmed by a swarm of cargo drones and teams of their zero-g trained handlers. Your operations chief oversees this process of controlled chaos with cool efficiency and reports the transfer completed before even a single shift has elapsed.
entries.zh:
"是，舰长，这是我的荣幸，" $heOrShe说道。

没过多久，成群结队的货运无人机和受过零重力训练的搬运班组便挤满了主舰桥显示屏。你的作战主管冷静高效地监督着这场乱中有序的转运，还没等换一班岗，就报告转运已经完成。

o.en: "Want to make a few credits on the side? (sell)

entries.en: You review your operations logs which contain a live projection for the arrival of $fleetTypeNameInText.
entries.zh: 你查阅作战日志，其中有一条关于$fleetTypeNameInText抵达时间的实时预测。

entries.en: You review your operations logs which contain a live projection for the arrival of $fleetTypeNameInText.
entries.zh: 你查阅作战日志，其中有一条关于$fleetTypeNameInText抵达时间的实时预测。

o.en: Heading back to the core soon? I could sell you some cargo.
o.zh: 最近要回核心星域吗？我可以卖些货物给你。

o.en: Want to make some credits on the side? I need to offload extra cargo.
o.zh: 想赚点外快吗？我有些多余的货物要出手。

entries.en: "Understood, we'll maintain position."
entries.zh: "明白，我们会保持阵位。"

entries.en:
Your $post explains that $heOrShe can assemble a task force for either a combat or support mission profile then have the fleet dispatched to a system of your choosing. There it will meet you at the standard rendezvous: the inner system jump-point.

There are expenses to consider when assembling and outfitting such a fleet, of course.
entries.zh:
你的$post解释说，$heOrShe可以组建一支特遣舰队，按作战或支援任务配置编组，再派往你指定的星系。舰队会在标准会合点与你碰头：星系内圈的跳跃点。

当然，组建并装备这样一支舰队，开销也是要考虑的。

o.en: Plan the deployment of a combat task force
o.zh: 筹划部署一支作战特遣舰队

o.en: Never mind, just reviewing combat readiness.
o.zh: 不必了，我只是看看战备情况。

entries.en:
"Greetings $playerSirOrMadam," $personName gives you a snappy salute.

"Would you like to order deployment of a resupply mission or combat task force?"
entries.zh:
"向您问好，$playerSirOrMadam，" $personName 利落地敬了个礼。

"您要下令派出补给队，还是战斗特遣舰队？"

entries.en:
"Pleasure to see you again, $playerSirOrMadam," $personName gives you another salute.

"Would you like to order deployment of a resupply mission or combat task force?"
entries.zh:
"很高兴又见到您，$playerSirOrMadam，" $personName 又敬了个礼。

"您要下令派出补给队，还是战斗特遣舰队？"

entries.en:
As your $shipOrFleet moves into a close holding orbit, an executive summary of the hypershunt's specifications is helpfully presented by your TriPad's pseudo-AI assistant.

The bridge sounds an alert as several previously undifferentiated shapes detach themselves from the superstructure and smoothly accelerate towards your fleet just as you finish reading, "-and for reasons of safety, automated defense drones are no longer a standard feature."

Your tactical officer waves for your attention, "We're close enough to the magfield generated by the megastructure that the anticipated combat volume should be unaffected by the star's corona. Mostly. However," they examine their console, "The hostiles, they're... unknown profile. Incoming fast." They are starting to look concerned, and in a brittle voice say, "This might be something new, captain."
entries.zh:
当你的$shipOrFleet进入了近距离保持轨道时，你的 TriPad 上的拟 AI 助手帮你调出了一份超空间分流器的规格概要。

舰桥里警报声大作：有几个先前无法正常识别的复杂几何造物从你面前的巨构中分离了出来，平稳地朝你的$shipOrFleet加速移动。这时你正好才读到，"—— 而且出于安全考虑，不再将自主防御无人舰作为标准配置。"

你的战术军官向你挥手，示意有情况要汇报，"我们现在离巨型设施的磁场足够近，预计我们在这里作战可以免受星冕的影响，大概，但..." 对方查看了一下控制台，"敌舰... 舰型未知。而且来得很快。" 气氛开始变得不安，对方用发紧的声音说道，"这是些没人见过的东西，舰长。"

entries.en:
As your $shipOrFleet moves into a close holding orbit, an executive summary of the hypershunt's specifications is helpfully presented by your TriPad's pseudo-AI assistant.

The bridge sounds an alert as a swarm of previously undifferentiated shapes detach themselves from the superstructure and begin to accelerate towards your fleet just as you finish reading, "-and for reasons of safety, automated defense drones are no longer a standard feature."

Your tactical officer waves for your attention, "We're close enough to the magfield generated by the megastructure that the anticipated combat volume should be unaffected by the star's corona. Mostly. However," they examine their console, "The hostiles, picking up AI War remnants, and..." a brittleness enters their voice, "Unknown... a couple unknown profiles. Incoming fast."
entries.zh:
当你的$shipOrFleet驶入近距离保持轨道，你 TriPad 上的拟 AI 助手贴心地呈上一份超空间分流器的规格概要。

你刚读到"——出于安全考量，自动防御无人机已不再是标准配置"，舰桥便响起警报：一群先前分不清轮廓的东西正从主体结构上脱离，朝你的舰队加速扑来。

你的战术官挥手唤你注意，"我们已经进入这座巨构生成的磁场范围，预计交战空域大体不受恒星日冕影响。大体上。不过，" 对方查看了一眼控制台，"来袭目标里，扫到了第一次 AI 战争的余辉，还有..." 声音里透出几分生硬，"未知...有两三个未知型号。来得很快。"

entries.en:
Salvage crews board the structure at key points and soon reports come in of extensive wear and damage. It is difficult to assess the entire structure in detail, but it is clear that it is not operable in its current state.

However, as with most mega-scale Domain technology from the late pre-Collapse era, the $nameInText features fantastic self-repair capabilities which requires only sufficient resources to be made available.
entries.zh:
打捞人员登上了设施的关键部位，并很快回报了大量的损伤与消耗。虽然很难对整个设施进行详细的评估，但很明显，它在目前的状态下是无法运作的。

幸好，和其他大崩塌前最后建造的 人之领 巨型技术遗物一样，$nameInText 具有奇迹般强大的自主修复能力，只需要提供足够的资源就可以进行自我修复。

entries.en: This structure is currently undergoing automated self-repair which should be completed in short order.
entries.zh: 该设施目前正在进行自动化的自我修复，应该会在短期内完成。

entries.en: This structure appears to be fully functional.
entries.zh: 该设施看起来运作正常。

entries.en:
Your TriPad chimes in with a helpful analysis: if brought online, this structure allows a colony within 10 light-years to establish 1 additional industry, provided it has a hypershunt tap installed and can maintain a healthy supply of transplutonics.

Ancient schematics in the TriPad's memory indicate a particular cargo area dedicated to storing these "taps", but salvage crews report that it is empty.

That Tri-Tachyon would have this information so readily available in their standard orbital works expert system database gives you just a moment of pause.
entries.zh:
你的 TriPad 提供了一个有用的分析结果：如果启动，这个设施允许 10 光年内的殖民地建立一个额外的工业设施，前提是在殖民地安装一个{超分流阀门}，并能保证充足的稀有元素供应。

储存在 TriPad 记忆体中的古老蓝图显示，设施中有一个用于存放这些 "阀门" 的专用货物区，但打捞人员报告说它是空的。

速子科技 居然在他们的标准轨道工业设施专家系统数据库里准备了这么详尽的信息，这让你稍微愣了一下。

o.en: Offload sufficient resources to repair the structure
o.zh: 提供足以修复结构的资源

entries.en:
Your crews finish offloading the raw materials and you send an activation signal to the structure's distributed repair nodes.

There's barely any reaction at first, just a smattering of previously undetected relays pinging one another through the superstructure. Your science officer assures you that the repair rate will increase exponentially, pulling up a display showing the relay pings expanding outward and the energy transmission curve steadily rising. After only minutes, despite little visual change, the overall heat output on sensors has increased dramatically. Whatever is quickening in the heart of this celestial machine...

"Captain," your science officer interrupts your thoughts hesitantly, "We may wish to pull the fleet back by a hundred klicks or so." You nod and give the order.

The $nameInText should be online in short order.
entries.zh:
船员完成了原料的卸载，你向该设施的分散式维修节点发送了激活信号。

一开始几乎没有任何反应，只是由有少数几个之前没发现的中继节点开始在超构造体中相互传递信息。科学专家保证修复速率将会以指数形式成倍增加，并拉出一个显示屏向你展示中继节点的信息传递在逐渐向外扩展，同时能量传输曲线稳步上升。短短的几分钟之后，尽管外观没有什么变化，但传感器显示的总体热输出已经急剧上升。不管是什么，有什么东西正在这个天体级大小的机器的心脏里加速...

"舰长，" 科学专家有些犹豫地打断了你的思考，"我们最好让舰队后撤一百星里左右。" 你点点头，下达了命令。

$nameInText 应该在短时间内上线。

o.en: Explain that you can't afford to pay
o.zh: 解释说你缴不起这笔费用

o.en: Explain that you can't afford to pay
o.zh: 解释说你缴不起这笔费用

entries.en: $PersonRank $personName looks up from $hisOrHer console briefly. "Stand by while we scan your cargo. We'll continue this conversation once the scan is complete."
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personName 把目光从$hisOrHer的控制台上移开，抬眼看了你一下。"在我们扫描你们的货物时，请在旁等待。扫描完成之后我们再继续谈。"

entries.en:
"Oh? That's something you're going to regret."

The comm link is cut before you have a chance to respond.
entries.zh:
"哦？那你会后悔的。"

没等你做出回应，通讯链接就被切断了。

o.en: Surrender illegal goods; pay the toll and fine ($tollAmount credits)
o.zh: 上缴违禁品，缴纳关税与罚款 ( $tollAmount 星币)

entries.en: $PersonRank $personName looks up from $hisOrHer console. "Looks like everything checks out. The toll and inspection fees come to a total of $tollAmount credits."
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personName 把目光从$hisOrHer的控制台上移开，抬眼看向你。"看来全部都查清了，关税和检查费总共为 $tollAmount 星币。"

entries.en: $PersonRank $personName looks pleased. "Well, well. Look what we have here! We'll be confiscating all the contraband, of course. The toll, inspection fees, and the fine for possession of illegal goods with intent to sell come to a total of $tollAmount credits."
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personName 看起来很高兴。"好啊，看看我们发现了什么！当然，所有违禁品我们都要没收。关税、检查费，再加上对持有违禁品并意图销售的罚款，一共 $tollAmount 星币。"

entries.en: $personName looks at the report, looks at you, looks at the report again, and cuts off the comm link without saying a word. Your scanners detect the signatures of weapons powering up.
entries.zh: $personName 看了看报告，又看了看你，接着再看了看报告，随即一言不发地切断了通讯链接。与此同时，你的扫描器检测到了武器启动的特征讯号。

entries.en: After a long wait, your terminal chimes softly and displays the scan results transmitted by the $faction $otherFleetName.
entries.zh: 经过漫长的等待，你的终端终于轻响了几声，并显示由 $faction $otherFleetName 传来的扫描结果。

o.en: I believe I met your sister on Umbra.
o.zh: 我确信曾在 Umbra 遇见过你的妹妹。

entries.en:
Dardan lets out a sigh.

"I already know about her little crusade. I'd thank you not to mention her- unless she's finally decided to do the right thing and return to the Gens?"

He barely waits before he says "Didn't think so."
entries.zh:
Dardan 叹了口气。

"关于她那个小小的圣战，我早已知情。请你别再提她了 —— 除非她终于决定做正确的事，比如回归氏族？"

他没等你回答就说道："想来不是。"

entries.en: "Like I said," he says, his tone of voice making it clear he is quite finished with this conversation.
entries.zh: "我说过了，" 他说道，语气中明确表示谈话到此为止。

entries.en:
He gives you a wretched look. "Tell me you didn't."

"No," he holds up a hand. "Don't tell me at all. I don't want to know. Drop it. We're not talking about this."
entries.zh:
他投来痛苦的一瞥。"告诉我你没这么做。"

"不，" 他抬起一只手，"什么都别说了，我不想听。到此为止，我们别再谈这个了。"

entries.en: "By the bloody stars, please and thank-you," he mutters under his breath,
entries.zh: "看在血色星辰的份上，真是谢谢你了，" 他低声咕哝道，

o.en: My impression was that she wishes to stay where she is.
o.zh: 据我的印象，她还是想留在原处。

o.en: I gave her material support for the ARC. She seems capable of looking after herself.
o.zh: 我为她提供了 Askonia 革命者委员会的物质支持，她似乎能照顾好自己。
我们还是谈谈别的事吧。

entries.en:
After a short wait, your connection request is accepted.

"Yes, what? Is it important?" Kato barely looks up from his datapad.
entries.zh:
短暂的等待过后，你的连接请求被接受了。

"嗯？什么事？重要吗？" Kato 的目光几乎没有离开他的数据平板。

entries.en: "You're quite finished? I'm a very busy man." Kato frowns as his datapad chimes.
entries.zh: "你说完了吗？我可是很忙的。" Kato 的数据平板响起提示音，他皱起了眉头。

o.en: We'll be grateful for anything you can spare.
o.zh: 我们将对你能给予的任何帮助表示感谢。

o.en: It was a mistake - we don't actually need help.
o.zh: 之前是搞错了 —— 我们实际上不需要援助。

o.en: We didn't issue a distress call.
o.zh: 我们没有发出过求救呼号。

o.en: We'll be grateful for anything you can spare.
o.zh: 我们将对你能给予的任何帮助表示感谢。

entries.en: "Happy to help a stranded spacer. Do try not to make a habit of getting in trouble, though."
entries.zh: "很高兴能帮到一位遇困的宇宙民。不过，你可别养成总是陷入麻烦的坏习惯。"

entries.en: "You're getting a bit of a reputation for getting yourself in trouble, you know. Try to be more careful in the future."
entries.zh: "你知道吗？你在给自己找麻烦的方面已经有点名气了。以后你还是多注意一些。"

entries.en: "I'll help you for the sake of your crew. One can't help but think you're being dangerously irresponsible, if you keep needing to be bailed out like this."
entries.zh: "看在你船员的份上，我会帮你。但如果你总是这样需要别人来救你出去的话，人们自然会认为你是个极其不负责任的家伙。"

entries.en: "Take this - I don't think it's enough, but it's all we have to spare."
entries.zh: "拿上这些吧。虽然我觉得应该不够，但我们最多也只能分给你这么多了。"

entries.en: "What we can spare doesn't look like it'll be enough, but you should be thankful to get anything at all considering the number of times you've had to call for help recently."
entries.zh: "我们能给予你的物资似乎不够你用。但考虑到你最近接二连三地遇到情况，你无论收到多少援助，都应该心怀感激。"

entries.en:
"But... my scans show you've got plenty of fuel and supplies. I don't appreciate my time being wasted like this."

The comm link is cut before you have a chance to respond.
entries.zh:
"但...我的扫描结果显示你的燃料和补给很充裕。我可不喜欢做这种浪费时间的事。"

没等你做出回应，通讯链接就被切断了。

entries.en:
"I can see the cargo pods you've dumped overboard, you know.  I'm not blind. And my sensors indicate the presence of fuel or supplies in those.

I can understand trying to scam a fellow spacer. It's the sheer incompetence of the attempt that's so insulting."

The comm link is cut before you have a chance to respond.
entries.zh:
"你应该知道，我眼睛没瞎，看得到你们扔出去的那些货物舱。然后我的传感器扫描显示这些货舱里都是燃料和补给。

我知道你是想要耍一下其他太空佬。但你这种纯属低能的做法也太侮辱人了。"

没等你做出回应，通讯链接就被切断了。

entries.en:
"Well, at least you owned up to it. Still, a distress call is not something to send out lightly."
OR
$HeOrShe frowns, and says "Careful, you don't want to earn yourself ... a reputation. It's dangerous out here."
entries.zh:
"好吧，至少你承认了。但记住，求救呼号并不是可以随便轻率发出的东西。"
OR
$HeOrShe皱起了眉头，说道："注意点，你应该也不想给自己烙下...这种名气的，毕竟外面的世界危机四伏。"

entries.en:
"Is that so? Well, I guess we'll hang around here for a bit and wait for who did."

You get the feeling $heOrShe has some doubts about what you've said.
entries.zh:
"是这样的吗？好吧，我想我们得在这里停留一会儿，等之前求救的人过来。"

你感觉到$heOrShe对你的说辞有些怀疑。

entries.en:
"Must be a relief we showed instead of some pirates, eh?"

"Now, what was it you needed?"
entries.zh:
"怎样？出现的是我们而不是海盗，是不是松了一口气？

那么，现在你需要什么？"

entries.en:
"Oh, it's you. I've heard about you. You're on your own."
OR
"You?" $HeOrShe laughs without mirth then cuts the comm sharply.
entries.zh:
"哦，是你。我听说过你的所作所为，你自己解决吧。"
OR
"是你？" $HeOrShe不怀好意地笑了笑，然后猛地切断了通讯。

entries.en:
"Must be a relief we showed up, eh?"

"Now, what was it you needed?"
entries.zh:
"我们肯露面，你该松了口气吧，嗯？"

"说吧，方才要什么来着？"

entries.en: "Need some help after all, do you?"
entries.zh: "你还是需要些帮助，是吧？"

o.en: Thank $himOrHer profusely, but offer no payment
o.zh: 感谢$himOrHer的慷慨，但不提供报酬

entries.en: "Thanks, much appreciated. That'll go a long way to offset our costs."
entries.zh: "非常感谢，这能抵消掉我们大部分的援助开销。"

entries.en: "Yeah, if you could afford to pay your own way, you probably wouldn't be in this situation in the first place, would you?"
entries.zh: "是啊，如果你一开始就付得起回去的路费的话，就压根不会陷入这种状况，不是吗？"

entries.en:
"I trust you, captain," $heOrShe says carefully, "There's a sensitive matter regarding the facilities of a long-time competitor of mine..."
OR
"We've built up a good rapport, I think," $heOrShe says, watching you carefully. "I have a sensitive matter to discuss regarding the facilities of a... competitor."
entries.zh:
"我相信你，舰长。" $heOrShe小心地说，"我有一个敏感问题...是关于我的长期竞争对手的设施的..."
OR
"我想我们已经建立了良好的关系。" $heOrShe说道，诚惶诚恐地看着你，"我有一件敏感的事情要讨论...关于一位竞争对手的设施。"

entries.en: A $dcom_manOrWoman in an expensive business suit is clutching a TriPad with what seems like barely-restrained rage. Just staring into space.
entries.zh: 一个身着昂贵西装的$dcom_manOrWoman抓着 TriPad，似乎正在强忍愤怒，呆呆地盯着空气。

entries.en:
The mercenary $personRank looks very pleased, and perhaps a touch overconfident as the comms display stabilizes.

"Tsk, tsk," $heOrShe says. "One can't expect to raid the holdings of major business concerns $dcom_marketOnOrAt $dcom_marketName and not have to deal with the consequences." $HeOrShe smiles, satisfied, as $heOrShe motions to someone off-display. The tell-tale glint of combat alerts appear in $hisOrHer eyes.
entries.zh:
随着通讯显示稳定下来，这名 $personRank 雇佣兵欣喜的面孔出现在画面中，看上去甚至有点自负。

"啧啧啧..." $heOrShe说道，"某些人可不能指望在 $dcom_marketName 打劫了一家大型商业公司的私有财产之后还能逃之夭夭。" $HeOrShe满意地笑着，随后向屏幕外的某些人示意了一下。$HeOrShe的眼中满是战意。

o.en: If that's so, sending you was a mistake.
o.zh: 既然如此，那他们真不该派你来。

o.en: Carefully approach the angry $dcom_manOrWoman in the expensive suit
o.zh: 小心地接近那名身着昂贵西装的$dcom_manOrWoman

entries.en:
You exude understanding. If someone needed to vent a little flux, why, you'd be the perfect audience. It takes only halfway through a light drink before you have the angry $manOrWoman opening up about $hisOrHer problems.

You murmur vague agreement at the injustice done to honest folk, the irony of laws used as a shield by dishonest actors. Someone could do something, maybe.
entries.zh:
你展现出了自己善解人意的一面，成为了某人需要倾倒苦水时完美的倾诉对象。只用了喝掉半杯低度酒的功夫，你就轻松地撬开了这个$manOrWoman的话匣子。

老实人倾诉着自己所遭受的不公，你轻声附和，感叹法律居然会屡屡成为骗子们的挡箭牌。也许总得有人站出来做点什么。

o.zh: 也许的确需要有人做些什么了。

entries.en:
"It'd be a rational response. Proportional, even," $heOrShe says intensely, $hisOrHer rage now the deathly cold of a cryovolcano. "If their warehouse $dcom_marketOnOrAt $dcom_marketName was raided by an unassociated third party," $heOrShe smiles vengefully, lifting a drink in a salute to you, "I could arrange $dcom_reward credits to find their way into your account if that happened. I'll provide all the necessary tactical details, of course."

A quick review of $hisOrHer TriPad suggests that you'd need around $dcom_marines marines to carry off the operation. You note that it lies within $dcom_marketFactionArticle $dcom_marketFaction logistics zone, so performing such a raid may anger the local authorities. Even taking stealth measures may not entirely avert suspicion.
entries.zh:
"这将是个合理的回应。甚至是，必要的。" $heOrShe言辞激烈地说道，此刻$hisOrHer的怒火已然冻结，只剩冰火山一般致命的冷酷。"假设他们在 $dcom_marketName 的仓库被哪个第三方势力劫掠了..." $heOrShe露出了仇恨的微笑，向着你举杯致意，"我就会把 $dcom_reward 星币的资金送到你的账户上。当然，我会提供所有必需的战略细节。"

你快速地扫了一遍$hisOrHer的 TriPad，看起来要完成这项行动你会需要大约 $dcom_marines 名陆战队员。你意识到那座仓库位于 $dcom_marketFactionArticle $dcom_marketFaction 的后方，这样的劫掠可能会激怒地方当局。即使做好保密措施也不一定能完全避免被怀疑。

entries.en:
"If my competitor's warehouse $dcom_marketOnOrAt $dcom_marketName was raided by some third party," $heOrShe nods at you, $hisOrHer meaning clear "I would arrange for $dcom_reward credits to be transferred to your account."

"My tacticians' analysis suggests that $dcom_marines marines would be sufficient." $HeOrShe pauses a moment, then adds "And I would suggest going in quietly; this is $dcom_marketFactionArticle $dcom_marketFaction logistics zone and my intent is to send a message, not a broadcast."
entries.zh:
"如果我对头在 $dcom_marketName 的仓库被哪个第三方势力袭击了..." $heOrShe向你缓慢地点着头，$heOrShe的意思很明白了，"我会把 $dcom_reward 星币的资金打到你的账户上。"

"我的战术官们分析指出 $dcom_marines 名陆战队员就足够了。" $HeOrShe停顿了一下，然后补充说道，"我还是要建议你别弄得太张扬了。这毕竟是 $dcom_marketFactionArticle $dcom_marketFaction 的后方，而我只想要捎个信而已，不是要大张旗鼓地广播一通。"

entries.en:
You review a ground-level feed from a marine's suit cam. Flashbulbs of demolition charges stutter then after half a breath a heavy roll of thunder catches up with the photons.

With the raid completed and proof uploaded to a secure darknet address, your datapad pings softly to indicate that an anonymous payment has been received.
entries.zh:
你通过陆战队员的随身摄像机获得了实时地面图像传输。爆破的闪光和爆炸声断断续续，随后爆发出一声伴随着耀眼闪光的巨响。

劫掠完成后，相关证明被上传到一个安全的暗网地址，数据平板柔和地 "叮" 了一声，表明你收到了匿名付款。

entries.en: "I need a package delivered. The destination must be kept a secret. Simple."
entries.zh: "我需要递送一个包裹，目的地必须保密。很简单的任务。"

entries.en: At the end of the bar, a rakish $ddro_manOrWoman is met by a variety of low-life characters who scurry away again almost immediately. Giving orders, perhaps.
entries.zh: 在吧台的尽头，不少看起来生活水平不高的人在和一个潇洒的$ddro_manOrWoman碰头后几乎立刻就跑开了。对方似乎在发号施令。

entries.en:
Your nav officer reports that your $shipOrFleet has arrived at the coordinates provided by $ddro_personName. The $ddro_thing is held gently in a cargo drone's manipulator arms, ready for deployment.

The go-button flashes softly on your command interface.
entries.zh:
你的领航军官报告道，你的$shipOrFleet已经到达由 $ddro_personName 提供的坐标位置。$ddro_thing 已经被小心地安置到了货运无人机的机械臂上，随时准备投放。

执行按钮在你的命令界面上轻轻地闪烁。

o.en: Drop it off in a stable orbit
o.zh: 把货投放到稳定轨道上

entries.en:
The bay doors open, and the cargo drone extends its arms. Then, gently, its manipulators release.

It is now done. Whatever 'it' is.
entries.zh:
舱门开启，货运无人机伸长它的机械臂，然后轻轻地松开了物品。

任务完成了，无论 "那东西" 是什么。

o.en: Ask about the secret package delivery
o.zh: 询问秘密运输任务的细节

o.en: Find out what the rakish $ddro_manOrWoman at the end of the bar is up to
o.zh: 看看吧台尽头的那个潇洒的$ddro_manOrWoman在做什么

entries.en:
The $ddro_manOrWoman watches your approach. "You want in on the business, that right?" $heOrShe says, amused at your audacity.

"Let me give you a job so easy that any rad-addled spacer could manage it. But," $heOrShe shrugs regretfully, "It's a real shame how many of 'em just can't follow instructions and end up getting tossed out an airlock." $HeOrShe laughs like this is a good joke.

"Deliver the item to the specified location in $ddro_systemName, $ddro_dist light-years away." $HeOrShe flips a TriPad out of $hisOrHer coat. The display shows $ddro_aOrAnThing. "This is it. The reward is $ddro_reward credits. Don't be seen making the drop, and don't tell anyone about it."
entries.zh:
$ddro_manOrWoman注意到了你的接近。"你也想参与这桩生意，对吗？" $heOrShe刚说完，就被你的大胆给逗乐了。

"先来个简单的活吧，就算你脑袋被辐射烤焦了也能办到。不过..." $heOrShe遗憾地耸了耸肩，"很多人就是因为不能遵守指示，才落得个被丢出气闸的下场，想起来还挺可惜的。" $HeOrShe突然哈哈大笑，如同这是个很棒的笑话那般。

"将东西送到 $ddro_dist 光年外的 $ddro_systemName。" $HeOrShe麻利地从外套里翻出了一个 TriPad，而上面正显示着 $ddro_aOrAnThing。"就这玩意儿。报酬是 $ddro_reward 星币。记住交货的时候不要被人看见，更不要走漏风声。"

entries.en:
$PersonName looks you over silently for a moment, then nods, seemingly satisfied.

"I don't want any questions, it's a simple task. Deliver this item to the specified location in $ddro_systemName, $ddro_dist light-years away. Don't be seen making the drop, and don't tell anyone about it. The reward is $ddro_reward credits." $HeOrShe taps at $hisOrHer datapad and your display is overlaid with $ddro_aOrAnThing.

"That is all there is to it. Do you accept my terms?"
entries.zh:
$PersonName 沉默着看了你一会儿，然后点了点头，似乎很满意。

"别问我任何问题，这个任务已经很简单了。把这玩意儿递送到 $ddro_dist 光年外 $ddro_systemName 的指定位置。交货的时候别让人看见，也别走漏风声。奖励是 $ddro_reward 星币。" $HeOrShe按了按数据平板，你的显示器上显示出了那 $ddro_aOrAnThing 的信息。

"就是这么回事，你接受这些条件吗？"

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet was recently detected - or is currently being tracked by - a nearby fleet, and dropping off the item at the specified location is extremely inadvisable.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet最近刚被侦测到或者正在被跟踪，现在递交物品到指定位置是非常不明智的。

entries.en:
After an interminable wait watching Sindrian Diktat propaganda montages, the comm-link connects you with a stiff-looking junior officer in the uniform of the Lion's Guard, Andrada's personal ideologically-disciplined military order.

"Victory to the Lion of Sindria!" $heOrShe greets you with alarming enthusiasm. "How shall you serve the Supreme Executor's vision?"

You feel somewhat put on the spot by this demand.
entries.zh:
在对 辛达强权 宣传片的观看中度过了漫长的等待时光后，通讯链接里出现了一位表情严肃的下级军官，此人还穿着狮心卫队的制服，那是属于 Andrada 个人的思想纪律严明的军事组织。

"胜利属于辛达瑞亚之狮！" $heOrShe和你对话时带着惊人的热情，"你打算如何为最高元首的愿景服务？"

这种开口问话的方式让你觉得有些不太舒服。

o.en: I want to talk to Andrada.
I wish to petition the glorious Supreme Executor Admiral Andrada.
o.zh: 我想向光荣的最高元首 Andrada 将军请愿。

o.en: Aren't you supposed to ask how you can help me?
o.zh: 你不是该问问有什么能为我效劳的吗？

o.en: I don't know. Tell me how I serve the glory of the Lion's vision.
o.zh: 我不知道。你来告诉我如何为雄狮的愿景效力吧。

entries.en:
"Okay," $heOrShe says.
OR
$HeOrShe nods.
OR
"Sure," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh:
"好吧，" $heOrShe说道。
OR
$HeOrShe点了点头。
OR
"当然，" $heOrShe说道。

entries.en:
"Indeed," $heOrShe says.
OR
$HeOrShe nods, quite outwardly collected.
OR
"Quite," $heOrShe says.
OR
$HeOrShe waves $hisOrHer hand placidly. On with it, the gesture suggests, but without a fuss.
OR
"Best not tarry long on one subject," $heOrShe says. "Lest it overstay its welcome."
OR
$HeOrShe nods. "Well then?"
entries.zh:
"确实，" $heOrShe说道。
OR
$HeOrShe点了点头，神色镇定自若。
OR
"正是，" $heOrShe说道。
OR
$HeOrShe不慌不忙地摆了摆$hisOrHer手。那意思像是在说：接着谈吧，不过也别太急。
OR
"一个话题，最好别聊得太久，\" $heOrShe说道，\"免得讨人嫌。"
OR
$HeOrShe点了点头。"那么？"

entries.en:
"Okay." $heOrShe says, giving you a skeptical look. "Perhaps there's a more profitable discussion we could have."
OR
$HeOrShe almost frowns. "My time isn't cheap, you know."
OR
"I could be charging by the minute," $heOrShe says to $himOrHerself under $hisOrHer breath.
OR
"Sure," $heOrShe says, with a hint of skepticism.
entries.zh:
"好吧。\" $heOrShe说着，怀疑地看了你一眼，\"也许我们能聊点更有赚头的事。"
OR
$HeOrShe几乎要皱起眉头。"我的时间可不便宜，你知道的。"
OR
"我可是按分钟收费的，" $heOrShe压低$hisOrHer嗓音，对$himOrHerself嘟囔道。
OR
"行吧，" $heOrShe说道，语气里带着几分怀疑。

entries.en:
"As you will," $heOrShe says.
OR
$HeOrShe nods, hands together.
entries.zh:
"随你便，" $heOrShe说道。
OR
$HeOrShe双手合十，点了点头。

entries.en:
"I see," $heOrShe says.
OR
$HeOrShe nods.
OR
$HeOrShe frowns.
entries.zh:
"我明白了，" $heOrShe说道。
OR
$HeOrShe点了点头。
OR
$HeOrShe皱起了眉头。

entries.en:
"As you will," $heOrShe says.
OR
$HeOrShe nods, hands together.
entries.zh:
"随你便，" $heOrShe说道。
OR
$HeOrShe双手合十，点了点头。

entries.en:
"Affirmative," $heOrShe says.
OR
"What else do you wish to discuss?"
OR
$HeOrShe nods, taking a moment to glance at another display.
entries.zh:
"确认，" $heOrShe说道。
OR
"您还想谈点什么？"
OR
$HeOrShe点了点头，顺手瞥了一眼另一块显示屏。

entries.en:
"Affirmative," $heOrShe says.
OR
"Understood," $heOrShe says.
OR
$HeOrShe nods.
entries.zh:
"确认，" $heOrShe说道。
OR
"明白，" $heOrShe说道。
OR
$HeOrShe点了点头。

entries.en:
"Aye," $heOrShe says.
OR
"Aye," $heOrShe says. "Channel clear."
entries.zh:
"哎，" $heOrShe说道。
OR
"哎，\" $heOrShe说道，\"频道畅通。"

entries.en:
"I see," $heOrShe says with a warning look.
OR
"As you will," $heOrShe says disdainfully.
OR
$HeOrShe narrows $hisOrHer eyes, watching you.
OR
$HeOrShe nods slowly, watching you carefully.
entries.zh:
"我明白了，" $heOrShe说道，眼神里带着警告。
OR
"随你便，" $heOrShe不屑地说道。
OR
$HeOrShe眯起$hisOrHer眼睛，盯着你。
OR
$HeOrShe缓缓点头，始终留意着你的一举一动。

entries.en:
The comms system provided by the Knights of Ludd for its members appears to be intentionally low-bandwidth.

"Good day, captain," he says, voice hollowed of its usual warmth.

The image of $global.jethroName Bornanew twitches occasionally before reforming based on the automation's best guess to fill the gaps in the feed.
entries.zh:
卢德骑士团为其成员提供的通讯系统似乎故意采用了低带宽设计。

"日安，舰长，" 他说道，声音失去了往常的温暖。

$global.jethroName Bornanew 的影像不时出现抖动，随后基于自动化系统的推测填补数据缺口并重新生成画面。

entries.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears, face red, eyes staring with blank hatred.

"You shall be extinguished by the might of the Lion's Guard!" he shouts. "Glory to the Sindrian Diktat, eternal victory to the Supreme Executor!"

The comms snap off.
entries.zh:
卫队最高副首长 Caden 出现在画面里，面色通红，对你怒目而视。

"你们将被狮心卫队的力量所碾碎！" 他喊道。"荣耀归于 辛达强权，永恒的胜利归于最高元首！"

不等你的回答，通讯链接就被切断了。

entries.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears; he barely looks at the comms.

"Independent fleet: maintain distance and you will not be fired upon. Hear and obey," he declares.

"Final victory to the Supreme Executor!" Caden shouts with genuine enthusiasm.
entries.zh:
卫队最高副首长 Caden 出现在画面里，几乎没正眼瞧通讯器。

"独立舰队：保持距离，就不会遭到攻击。听着，照办，" 他宣告道。

"永恒的胜利归于最高元首！" Caden 热情十足地高喊。

entries.en:
The image of Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears. He is not even looking at the comms-feed.

"Independent fleet: maintain distance and you will not be fired upon. Hear and obey," Caden declares, taking a breath.

"Final victory to the Supreme Executor!" he shouts.
entries.zh:
卫队最高副首长 Caden 的形象出现了。他甚至脸都没有朝着通讯器。

"独立舰队，保持距离以防被我方攻击。倾听并服从！" Caden 宣告道，一边深吸了一口气。

"胜利终归最高元首！"他怒吼道。

entries.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Ah, Captain $playerName. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" he booms enthusiastically. "It stirs the heart to see a loyal follower of the Supreme Executor's vision, and," he leans in, "One who will stand with me when the time comes, when strength and loyalty will be required to secure the future of the Persean Sector."

He leans back, satisfied. "Stay strong and vigilant - as Supreme Executor Andrada taught us. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!"
entries.zh:
卫队最高副首长 Caden 出现在你面前的画面里。"啊，$playerName 舰长。荣耀归于 辛达强权！" 他热情地夸赞道："能看到另一位最高元首愿景的忠实追随者，真的令人感到振奋。而且..." 他凑近了些，"当需要力量和忠诚来护卫英仙座星域的未来之时，他将与我并肩作战。"

他向后靠了靠，表示满意。"保持坚强和谨慎 —— 正如最高元首 Andrada 教导我们的那样。荣耀归于 辛达强权！"

不等你的回答，通讯链接就被切断了。

entries.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat, captain!" he booms enthusiastically. "It stirs the heart to see another proud follower of the Supreme Executor's vision upholding the Great Cause."

He blinks, perhaps realizing that he doesn't actually have anything to say to you. "Stay strong and stay vigilant just as Supreme Executor Andrada taught us. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!"
entries.zh:
卫队最高副首长 Caden 出现在你面前。

"荣耀归于辛达强权，舰长！" 他热情洪亮地喊道，"又见到一位拥护最高元首伟大愿景、共举伟业的忠实追随者，真叫人心里发热。"

他眨了眨眼，大概是发觉自己其实没话跟你说。"保持坚强，保持警惕，正如最高元首 Andrada 教导我们的那样。荣耀归于辛达强权！"

entries.en:
She frowns and looks you over, assessing.

"Hello, this is Callisto Ibrahim of Ibrahim Interstellar Transport and Salvage."
entries.zh:
对方皱着眉头打量着你，似乎在评估着什么。

"你好，我是 Ibrahim 星际运输与打捞公司的 Callisto Ibrahim。"

entries.en:
After a short wait, your connection request is accepted.

"Hello captain," Coureuse says, her attention on a flickering bank of holographic data tables. "I'm sorry I'm so busy. What is it you need?"
entries.zh:
短暂的等待过后，你的连接请求被接受了。

"你好，舰长，" Coureuse 说，她的注意力集中在一堆闪烁的全息数据表上，"对不起，我现在太忙了。你需要什么帮助呢？"

entries.en:
After an interminable time watching a Hegemony logo, the comm-link connects you with what appears to be a junior cadet. You suspect they haven't even graduated from the naval academy.

"Hello citizen," the cadet chirps at you brightly, "You've reached the office of the High Hegemon. Tour bookings of the Hegemon Council campus are currently unavailable. If you'd like to know more about how you can assist the restoration of the Domain, please accept the informational packet upload now."
entries.zh:
霸主 的标识转了好长一段时间后，一位海军学员模样的人接受了你发起的通讯请求。你怀疑此人甚至还没有从海军学院毕业。

"您好，公民。" 学员用洪亮清脆的语气飞快地叨念了起来，"这里是 至高霸主 的办公室。目前无法预订 霸主议庭 园区的游览行程。如果您想了解更多关于如何恢复人之领荣光的信息，请接受信息数据包上传。"

entries.en: "I hope you enjoy this tasteful celebration of the Hegemony's history," the cadet says, "From the heroic flight of Admiral Molina to save the Persean Sector from collapse to the victory of High Hegemon Daud over the Tri-Tachyon and AI invaders."
entries.zh: "我希望你能享受 霸主 历史带来的感官盛宴，" 接待你的学员说，"从 Molina 上将在大崩塌后的混乱中拯救英仙座星域的那次史诗级远航，一直到至高霸主 Daud 战胜 速子科技 和 AI 入侵者。"

o.en: I'd like to meet the High Hegemon.

entries.en: "I'm sorry, but the High Hegemon is unavailable." The cadet smiles blandly.
entries.zh: "不好意思，至高霸主事务繁忙。" 接待你的那名学员温和地微笑着。

entries.en:
The comms take a moment to connect.

"I'm very busy," says Elek. You can see the back of his head as he configures something on a secondary interface. "Out with it, please, whoever you are."
OR
After a moment, the comms flicker into a stable connection.

Elek's attention appears to be focused on his datapad, but he sighs deeply, then sullenly drops it onto his desk. "Is the comms buffer insufficient for your purposes? I hope your communication proves informative."
entries.zh:
通讯过了一小会儿才接上。

"我很忙，\" Elek 说道。你能看见他的后脑勺，他正在一块副屏上配置着什么。\"有话快说，不管你是谁。"
OR
片刻后，通讯闪了闪，稳定了下来。

Elek 的注意力似乎都在他的数据板上，但他深深叹了口气，闷闷不乐地把它丢到桌上。"是通讯缓冲不够你用吗？但愿你这通联络真能有点信息量。"

entries.en:
After a moment the comms connect.

"Yes?" A holographic planetoid whizzes past Elek's head. "Did we not just speak? I'm in the middle of calibrating my model."
entries.zh:
片刻后，通讯接通了。

"又怎么了？\" 一颗全息小行星从 Elek 头边飞掠而过。\"我们不是刚说过话吗？我正校准模型呢。"

entries.en:
You enter the comms ID, hand hovering over a glowing 'confirm' sigil. Your comms officer nods, ready to respond to whatever surprises Gargoyle thinks would be amusing to send through the link this time.

The display resolves from a mesmerizing fractal battleground to a familiar face grinning impishly at you.

"Ah, $playerFirstName! Are you back to find something interesting to do? I've got all sorts of wonderful ideas."
entries.zh:
你输入了 ID，手指悬在闪烁着 "确认" 符号的按钮上方。你的通讯军官点了点头，随时准备应对 Gargoyle 再次通过链接传来什么令人惊讶的 "惊喜"。

显示屏上的复杂而令人着迷的战场画面逐渐消散，取而代之的是一张熟悉的脸，正顽皮地对你笑着。"啊，$playerFirstName！你又回来了，是想找点有趣的事情做吗？我这里有一大堆绝妙的点子。"

entries.en:
You speak first with some kind of secretary who politely persuades you to wait patiently.

After a short time, the image of the Archcurate Jaspis appears. She makes little effort to look toward the comms feed as she putters around her office.

"We are blessed by the day," she says.
entries.zh:
先和你通话的是一个秘书样的人，她礼貌地劝你稍等一会。

一小段时间后，大祭司 Jaspis 的影像出现了。她在办公室里踱来踱去，基本没怎么看通讯画面。

"吾等皆临时日之祝福。" 她说道。

entries.en:
The Excubitor Orbis appears before you.

"Captain $playerName," he says by way of greeting, a stern gaze already fixed on you.

The moment draws longer. He seems determined to make you speak first.
entries.zh:
行星教卫 出现在了你的面前。

"$playerName 舰长。" 他以问候的语气说道，同时严肃地盯着你。

这一刻变得越来越长。他似乎打定了主意要你先开口。

o.en: I'd like to be commissioned by $theFaction
o.zh: 我想与 $theFaction 签订雇佣协议，担任军职。

entries.en:
"Hmm," he looks you over through the comm-link.

"That's nice. Go talk to someone who wants to deal with the bureaucracy to make it happen."
entries.zh:
"嗯，" 他透过通讯链接打量着你。

"不错，去找个愿意处理行政流程的人谈谈吧。"

entries.en: He looks you over through the comm-link.
entries.zh: 他透过通讯链接上下打量你。

o.en: I'd like to be commissioned by $theFaction
o.zh: 我想与 $theFaction 签订雇佣协议，担任军职。

entries.en:
After a short wait spent watching propaganda blurbs scroll past the crest of the Hegemony navy, the comm-link connects you with the office of Admiral Rao.

"So," the hero of the Siege of Raesvelg looks you over. "What's a freelancer doing at this insignificant outpost?"
entries.zh:
在短暂的等待中，你可以看到 霸主 海军的宣传海报在他们的舰队上方滚动着，然后你向 Rao 上将办公室发起的通讯请求被接受了。

"所以，" 在 Raesvelg 之围中诞生的英雄看着你，"一个自由职业者跑到我这穷乡僻巷来做什么？"

entries.en:
The comm-link only holds briefly on the crest of the Hegemony navy before Admiral Rao appears.

"$TitleHeg," he says. "Back around Ragnar long? I hope not." The hint of a smile flickers.
entries.zh:
通讯链接在霸主海军的徽标上只停了片刻，Rao 上将便现了身。

"$TitleHeg，" 他开口道。"回 Ragnar 这一带待很久了？但愿没有。" 一丝笑意一闪而过。

entries.en:
The comms-link takes a moment to establish. Skiron adjusts the feed parameters as she greets you.

"Greetings captain. All proceeds in accordance with protocol."
entries.zh:
通讯链接的建立花费一点时间。Skiron 一边向你问好，一边调试着返回的参数。

"你好，舰长。一切都将按纪律进行。"

entries.en:
The comms-link takes a moment to establish. Skiron adjusts the feed parameters as she greets you, clearly unused to holo-comms.

"Captain. Your crew have been most helpful in establishing a colonial comms network. Have you been able to reach Command? We are most anxious to receive new orders, especially given our upgraded capacities."
entries.zh:
通讯链接的建立花费一点时间。Skiron 一边向你问好，一边调试着返回的参数，显然她还不熟悉全息通讯。

"舰长。你们的船员在建立殖民地通讯网络方面提供了很大的帮助。你们能联系到指挥部吗？我们非常渴望接到新的命令，尤其是在战力得到升级的情况下。"

entries.en:
After an interminable wait watching volatiles futures scroll past the crest of the Tri-Tachyon corporation, the comm-link connects you with a perfectly coiffed junior secretary from the office of CEO Artemisia Sun.

"The Tri-Tachyon Corporation welcomes you to Eochu Bres. How can we help you today?"

No human would be this cheerful. You realize that this is some kind of sub-delta holo-simulacrum interface.
entries.zh:
你看着在 三一速子科技公司 大楼徽标附近划过的挥发物期货广告，度过了一段漫长的等待时光。最后，一位从属于 CEO Artemisia Sun 办公室且梳妆打扮十分完美的初级秘书接受了你的通讯链接请求。

"三一速子科技公司 欢迎您来到 Eochu Bres。请问我们能帮您什么忙吗？"

没有哪个活人表现得如此欢快，你意识到了这不过某种次 delta 级的全息模拟影像。

o.zh: 我想和 Artemisia Sun 谈谈。

entries.en:
You leave four guards and the pilot at your shuttle. Two more guards follow you, and the lanky pirate lieutenant sent to meet you nods that this is correct.

You're led through a primary access corridor toward the center of the station. You adjust quickly to disjointed agrav fields, an effect you suspect is intentional as ranks of pirates of all shapes and ages eye you for weakness, murmuring crude comments and jostling for prestige.
entries.zh:
你把四名警卫和驾驶员留在穿梭机上。又有两名警卫跟着你，派来引见的瘦高个海盗上尉点头表示没错。

你被带领穿过通向空间站中心的主通道。你很快就适应了这里杂乱无章的人工重力场，你怀疑这是故意所为。与此同时，各种各样、各个年龄的海盗在盯着你寻找着破绽，或是低声说着粗话，或是推搡着争抢风头。

entries.en:
It's time to face it, you are not what you once were.

The cycles wear on you. Combat maneuvers jar your creaking bones and your skin is tanned by the radiation of distant stars whose light grows dimmer in your eyes.

But the things you have seen! The works of dead empires, the fresh faces of green crew on their first op; tactical lasers glittering in the debris of forgotten battles.

You've lived a life beyond the imagination of the planet-bound. But it is a life hard-lived.
entries.zh:
是时候面对现实了，你已不再是当初的自己。

岁月在你身上流逝。战斗机动让你的骨骼咯吱作响，远处恒星的辐射将你的皮肤晒得黝黑，那些星光在你眼中也日渐黯淡。

可你见过多少奇观！已死帝国的造物，首次出勤时新兵稚嫩的面孔；被遗忘的战场残骸中闪烁的战术激光。

你度过了一种超乎行星居民想象的人生。但那是一种饱经风霜的人生。

o.en: No! It does not have to end
o.zh: No! It does not have to end

entries.en:
Your story could end here, starfarer. You can retire, enjoy yourself, and finally rest.

The question is, where and how?
entries.zh:
你的故事可以在此结束，星际远航者。你可以退休，享受生活，最终安歇。

问题在于，在哪里，以何种方式？
