entries.zh: "STRATCOM 想找人帮忙。他们似乎想要瘫痪 $dhi_marketName 上的 $dhi_industry，以此为某些更进一步的计划做准备。"

entries.en: You recognize a high ranking officer of $TheFaction in a private booth- and it looks like they recognized you, because an adjutant is sent over to invite you over for 'a word'.
entries.zh: 你在一个私人隔间里认出了 $TheFaction 的一个高级军官 —— 而且看起来对方也认出了你，因为一位副官被派过来邀请你过去 "聊聊"。

o.zh: 询问瘫痪 $dhi_marketName 上的 $dhi_industry 这一计划的细节

o.en: Join the high-ranking officer for 'a word'

entries.en:
You follow the adjutant to the private booth; they give a salute and redeploy toward the bar.

"Captain." $Rank $personName greets you without flourish. "Please, do sit. Make yourself comfortable." $HeOrShe motions toward a pitcher of cool, clear water. $HeOrShe is always on-duty from the looks of it.

"STRATCOM requires an irregular force to disrupt the $dhi_industry $dhi_marketOnOrAt $dhi_marketName for at least $dhi_disruptDays days." A few flicks on a datapad and a holo-map floats above the table. The intel is comprehensive: estimated garrison stats and deployment disposition. "The target is $dhi_dist light-years away. The special operations office has agreed to pay $dhi_reward credits if you can complete this mission."

You examine the data and estimate that roughly $dhi_marines marines would be required to pull off this operation. The $faction $rank watches you make your calculations, patiently awaiting your response.
entries.zh:
你跟着副官走进了包间；对方敬了个礼，然后再度朝吧台走去。

"舰长。" $personName $Rank 以一种质朴的方式欢迎着你，"请坐吧，不必拘谨。" $HeOrShe指了指桌上那壶清凉的净水，看上去$HeOrShe似乎总是处于随时待命的状态。

"STRATCOM 需要一支非常规部队来瘫痪 $dhi_marketName 上的 $dhi_industry，至少持续 $dhi_disruptDays 天。" 对方在数据平板上轻敲了几下，接着一张全息图浮现了出来。情报十分全面，囊括预估的驻军规模和防御布置。"目标距离这里 $dhi_dist 光年。特别行动办公室已经同意，如果你能完成任务，你将能得到 $dhi_reward 星币。"

你检查着那些数据，估算出大约需要 $dhi_marines 名陆战队员才能完成这项任务。在你进行评估时，$faction $rank 在一旁注视着你，耐心地等待着你的回复。

entries.en:
You follow the adjutant to the private booth; they salute awkwardly and retreat to the bar.

"Captain." $personName greets you without flourish. "Please, sit. Make yourself comfortable." $HeOrShe is more formal and sober than most pirates you've encountered. There's a current of barely-suppressed rage beneath the polite words; this one is driven by some abstract notion. Ideology, perhaps. Or vengeance.

"The Warlord requires disruption of the $dhi_industry $dhi_marketOnOrAt $dhi_marketName for at least $dhi_disruptDays days." A flicks on the datapad summons a map, and specifications. The intel is comprehensive: estimated garrison stats and deployment disposition. "The target is $dhi_dist light-years away. I have arranged payment of $dhi_reward credits if you complete this mission."

You examine the data and estimate that roughly $dhi_marines marines would be required to pull off this operation. The $faction $rank watches you make your calculations, awaiting your response.
entries.zh:
你跟着副官走进了包间；对方敬了个礼，然后再度朝吧台走去。

"舰长，" $personName 没有过多寒暄，直接向你打招呼，"请坐吧，不必拘谨。" $HeOrShe比你遇到的大多数海盗都要正式且严肃。礼貌的话语之下，隐藏着一股难以抑制的怒火；这个人被某种抽象的概念所驱使。某种理念，又或者是仇恨。

"军阀要求你瘫痪在 $dhi_marketOnOrAt $dhi_marketName 运营的 $dhi_industry 至少 $dhi_disruptDays 天。" 对方在数据平板上轻触一下，调出了一幅地图和详细资料。情报十分全面，囊括预估的驻军规模和防御布置。"目标距离这里 $dhi_dist 光年。如果你完成这项任务，我将安排支付 $dhi_reward 星币作为报酬。"

你检查着那些数据，估算出大约需要 $dhi_marines 名陆战队员才能完成这项任务。在你进行评估时，$faction $rank 在一旁注视着你，等待着你的回复。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe pulls up a shared display. The intel is comprehensive: estimated garrison stats and a deployment disposition report. "We require an irregular force to disrupt $dhi_industry $dhi_marketOnOrAt $dhi_marketName for at least $dhi_disruptDays days." A flick of the display and a map is overlaid. "Target $dhi_dist light-years away. Special operations has allocated $dhi_reward credits as payment upon mission completion."

You examine the intel report and estimate that roughly $dhi_marines marines would be required to carry off this operation. The $faction $rank watches you make your calculation, patiently awaiting your response.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe打开了显示器，上边的情报十分全面，囊括预估的驻军规模和防御布置。"我们需要一支非常规部队来瘫痪 $dhi_marketName 上的 $dhi_industry，至少持续 $dhi_disruptDays 天。" 对方在数据平板上轻敲了几下，一张地图覆盖了之前的信息。"目标距离这里 $dhi_dist 光年。特别行动办公室对该任务的奖励是 $dhi_reward 星币。"

你检查着情报，估算出大约需要 $dhi_marines 名陆战队员才能完成这项任务。在你进行评估时，$faction $rank 在一旁注视着你，耐心地等待着你的回复。

entries.en:
You feel almost imperceptible vibrations as the assault shuttles return to your $shipOrFleet, their work complete. You listen for a moment to the open broad-comm channel; the line crackles and squeals with the last gasps of electronic warfare distorted through chaff and the warp of fresh plumes of charged particles. It's a familiar sound; you can almost smell it.

Tactical has casualty reports prepared for review. You acknowledge with a nod and shut off the comms.
entries.zh:
当突击穿梭机返回你的$shipOrFleet时，你感受到了几乎无法察觉的震动，看起来他们的工作已经完成。你听了一会儿开放的广播频道，在电子战余波的影响下，带电粒子在传输线路中的行进轨迹仍未恢复正常，通讯线路中时不时传来异响和尖啸。这种声音再熟悉不过了：听着它，你仿佛可以闻到线路烧焦的味道。

战术分析组已经总结好了伤亡报告。你点头示意，然后关闭了通讯。

entries.en:
The comms fizzle and crack, then stabilize.

"Well well well, finally I meet Captain $PlayerName, the killer of Andrada's babies."

$HeOrShe looks you up and down, or at least makes a pretty good show of looking like that's what $heOrShe is doing. "Can't say I blame you much for doin' em in, but they'll be paying good - real good - to do you in."

"Figured I'd do the courtesy of telling you before I took my shot, is all. You ready, then?"
entries.zh:
通讯嘶嘶作响，噼啪一阵，随后稳定下来。

"哎呀呀呀，总算见着 $PlayerName 舰长了，Andrada 家那些小崽子的杀手。"

$HeOrShe上下打量着你，或者至少装得很像$heOrShe正在上下打量你的样子。"说你把他们做了，我倒也不太怪你，可他们出的价很不错 —— 相当不错 —— 要你的命。"

"我想着，动手之前先跟你打个招呼，算是礼数。就这些。那么，你准备好了？"

o.en: Sure, let's get this over with. I do appreciate the courtesy, though.
o.zh: 行，那就了结吧。不过这份礼数，我领情。

entries.en:
The comms fizzle and crack, then stabilize.

"Well well well, finally I meet Captain $PlayerName, the killer of Andrada's babies."

"Or, well." $HeOrShe looks you up and down, or at least makes a pretty good show of looking like that's what $heOrShe is doing. "That was what they were saying right up until they weren't and they cancelled the contract on me. Did get to call in the termination clause out of it, though knowing the Sindies it's going to take a cycle to get paid out."

"Still," $heOrShe grins, "Got some good kit out of it."
entries.zh:
通讯嘶嘶作响，噼啪一阵，随后稳定下来。

"哎呀呀呀，总算见着 $PlayerName 舰长了，Andrada 家那些小崽子的杀手。"

"或者说，嗯。\"$HeOrShe上下打量着你，或者至少装得很像$heOrShe正在上下打量你的样子。\"他们一直是这么说的，直到忽然不这么说了，然后撤了我的合同。不过好歹让我援引了终止条款，虽说以这帮辛达人的作风，想拿到赔款得等上一个星历年。"

"不过嘛，\"$heOrShe咧嘴一笑，\"还是从这事儿里弄到了些好装备。"

o.en: I would thank you not to repeat that slander. I am loyal to the Supreme Executor!
o.zh: 我倒要请你别再重复这种诽谤。我忠于最高元首！

o.en: Congrats, I suppose. Why are you telling me this?
o.zh: 那恭喜了。你为什么要告诉我这些？

entries.en:
"Ah." $HisOrHer expression is pointedly neutralized. "That's... good for you."

"Burn bright?"
entries.zh:
"啊。\"$HisOrHer的表情刻意归于平淡。\"那...对你是件好事。"

"星火长明？"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe shrugs.

"Was already on an intercept course. Figured it'd be good maneuvers practice for that lot," $heOrShe indicates with a thumb over $hisOrHer shoulder.

The link doesn't quite catch what sounds a lot like jeers in return.

"Yeah, yeah," the spacer says back over $hisOrHer shoulder. "Anyway. You burn bright, ya hear?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe耸了耸肩。

"本来就在拦截航线上。我想着，对那帮家伙来说，这正好练练机动，"$heOrShe用拇指朝$hisOrHer肩后指了指。

通讯链接没太收清那头传来的回应，听着很像是一片嘲骂。

"行了行了，\"那太空佬扭头朝$hisOrHer身后回了一句。\"总之。星火长明，听见没？"

entries.en:
The comms fizzle and crack, then stabilize.

"Well well well, finally I meet Captain $PlayerName, the killer of Andrada's babies."

"Or, well." $HeOrShe looks you up and down, or at least makes a pretty good show of looking like that's what $heOrShe is doing. "That was what they were saying right up until they weren't and, hmm, the 'reformed' Sindrian Diktat cancelled the contract on me. Did get to call in the termination clause out of it, though knowing these Sindies it's going to take a cycle to get paid out. Even if they are 'reformed'."

"Still," $heOrShe grins, "Got some good kit out of it."
entries.zh:
通讯嘶嘶作响，噼啪一阵，随后稳定下来。

"哎呀呀呀，总算见着 $PlayerName 舰长了，Andrada 家那些小崽子的杀手。"

"或者说，嗯。\"$HeOrShe上下打量着你，或者至少装得很像$heOrShe正在上下打量你的样子。\"他们一直是这么说的，直到忽然不这么说了，然后，嗯，'改革后'的辛达强权撤了我的合同。不过好歹让我援引了终止条款，虽说以这帮辛达人的作风，想拿到赔款得等上一个星历年。哪怕他们'改革'了也一样。"

"不过嘛，\"$heOrShe咧嘴一笑，\"还是从这事儿里弄到了些好装备。"

o.en: Congrats, I suppose. Why are you telling me this?
o.zh: 那恭喜了。你为什么要告诉我这些？

entries.en:
The comms fizzle and crack, then stabilize.

"Well well well, finally I meet Captain $PlayerName, the killer of Andrada's babies."

"Or, well." $HeOrShe looks you up and down, or at least makes a pretty good show of looking like that's what $heOrShe is doing. "That was what they were saying right up until Sindria blew up. It's going to be a struggle to get the termination clause paid out in the bureaucratic aftermath of yet another planet blowing up." $HeOrShe sighs, looking down for a moment.

"Still," $heOrShe recovers with a grin, "Got some good kit out of it. I don't think anyone who authorized the armaments transfers is even alive, or not in prison somewhere ha-ha."
entries.zh:
通讯嘶嘶作响，噼啪一阵，随后稳定下来。

"哎呀呀呀，总算见着 $PlayerName 舰长了，Andrada 家那些小崽子的杀手。"

"或者说，嗯。"$HeOrShe上下打量着你，或者至少装得很像$heOrShe正在上下打量你的样子。"他们一直是这么说的，直到 Sindria 炸上了天。又一颗星球炸了，在这堆官僚烂摊子里想把终止条款的赔款要回来，可有得折腾了。"$HeOrShe叹了口气，低头片刻。

"不过嘛，\"$heOrShe咧嘴一笑，重新打起精神，\"还是从这事儿里弄到了些好装备。我觉得当初批准那批军械移交的人，没一个还活着，要不就是在哪儿蹲着大牢，哈哈。"

o.en: Congrats, I suppose. Why are you telling me this?
o.zh: 那恭喜了。你为什么要告诉我这些？

entries.en:
"No trouble at all," $heOrShe says. "Could do with more politeness. Doesn't cost a credit, and life in the Sector's harsh enough as-is."

$HeOrShe trails off.

"Welp. Guess I'd usually say 'burn bright', but..."

The merc shrugs.
entries.zh:
"不麻烦，\"$heOrShe说。\"这世道多点礼貌总没坏处。又不花一个星币，何况星域里的日子本来就够难了。"

$HeOrShe话音渐弱。

"好吧。按说我一般会说'星火长明'，不过..."

那雇佣兵耸了耸肩。

o.en: Say, my scans show some... unusual hulls in your fleet.
o.zh: 我说，我的扫描仪显示你的舰队里有些...不寻常的船体。

entries.en:
"Oh, these old things?" $HeOrShe laughs.

"I'm joking of course - well spotted! Give my regards to your sensors officer!"

$HeOrShe looks around, as if admiring $hisOrHer own ship. "The Sindies gave us some of their goodies as a downpayment on the job. Some cutting-edge stuff. Not bad once you rip out some of their 'special modifications' and all the portraits of Andrada. Underneath? Not what you'd expect from a pack of AM-farmers who spend all day marching around and beating up Luddies."

$HeOrShe snaps $hisOrHer fingers. "And you know what?"
entries.zh:
"哦，这些老古董？"$HeOrShe笑了。

"当然，我开玩笑的——眼真尖！替我向你的传感器军官问好！"

$HeOrShe环顾四周，像是在欣赏$hisOrHer自己的船。"辛达人给了我们些好东西，算是这次活儿的定金。都是些尖端货色。把那些'特殊改装'和满墙的 Andrada 画像拆掉之后，还真不赖。剥开这层皮呢？可不是你指望从一帮整天列队游行、专揍卢德信徒的反物质农夫手里看到的东西。"

$HeOrShe抬起$hisOrHer手，啪地打了个响指。"你知道怎么样？"

entries.en:
"It all came together when my techs were reviewing the software integration with our fire control. I've got some good techs - great even. The trick with 'em is you gotta listen when they get all fidgety. Not so good at talking, usually, but when they know their stuff..."

The merc sits back in $hisOrHer command seat, getting comfortable.

"Well, there's me getting off-track. Point is, the interfaces? All custom post-Collapse Tri-Tachyon!"
entries.zh:
"是我的技师们在检查火控软件集成的时候，一切才对上号的。我有几个好技师 —— 甚至可以说是一流的。跟他们的诀窍就是，他们开始坐立不安的时候你得听。他们通常不太会说话，可一旦他们真懂行..."

那雇佣兵靠回$hisOrHer的指挥座，摆了个舒服的姿势。

"唉，我又扯远了。重点是，那些接口？全是大崩塌后速子科技定制的！"

o.en: The AI-piloted, automated Remnants from the first AI war are a bit of a giveaway.
o.zh: 第一次 AI 战争里那些 AI 驾驶的自动化余辉，已经够说明问题了。

entries.en:
"Yes!" $HeOrShe exclaims, clapping $hisOrHer hands.

"Thick as thieves, it turns out! Sindies and Tachies!"
entries.zh:
"没错！"$HeOrShe拍着$hisOrHer手叫道。

"结果呢，好得穿一条裤子！辛达人和速子人！"

entries.en:
"What!" $HeOrShe exclaims, clapping a hand to the side of $hisOrHer head.

"I suppose those are a little obvious," $heOrShe admits. "Should have thought of it first thing. Too much time in the fringe hunting strays, not enough having a fine drink with the likes of yourself."

"Anyway, thick as thieves, those Sindies and Tachies!"
entries.zh:
"什么！"$HeOrShe叫了一声，一只手拍上$hisOrHer的脑袋侧面。

"我想那些确实有点太显眼了，\"$heOrShe承认。\"我本该头一个就想到。在边缘星区追杀那些流窜的家伙待得太久，像你这样能好好喝一杯的人见得少了。"

"总之，好得穿一条裤子，那些辛达人和速子人！"

entries.en:
"Anyway," $heOrShe says, some of the joy leaving $hisOrHer voice as it trails into silence.

"I suppose we ought to get on with it." $HeOrShe rests $hisOrHer chin on a hand.
entries.zh:
"总之，"$heOrShe说，声音渐渐低下，$hisOrHer那点欢快也随之褪去。

"我想我们该动手了。"$HeOrShe把$hisOrHer下巴搁在一只手上。

entries.en:
"Yeah. Well."

$HeOrShe takes a long breath.

"Was a good chat. It'll be a shame when you're dead."
entries.zh:
"是啊。好吧。"

$HeOrShe长长地吸了口气。

"聊得挺痛快。等你死了，那就可惜了。"

o.en: Yeah. You too. I'll try to make it quick?
o.zh: 是啊。你也是。我会尽量下手快些？

entries.en:
The merc perks up.

"Yes?"
entries.zh:
那雇佣兵来了精神。

"什么？"

entries.en:
"I appreciate it," $heOrShe says.

"Well. Better you cut the comms, then."
entries.zh:
"我领情，"$heOrShe说。

"好吧。那还是你来切断通讯吧。"

entries.en:
The merc laughs, scandalized.

"Stars! I'd be in such trouble. Not just with the Sindies, but with the guild and the association, and... well, lots of folks."
entries.zh:
那雇佣兵笑起来，像是被冒犯了。

"群星在上！那我麻烦可就大了。不光得罪辛达人，还有行会、协会，还有...呃，很多人。"

o.en: I don't see them here right now, do you?
o.zh: 我现在可没在这儿看见他们，你看见了吗？

entries.en:
"No... no I don't," $heOrShe says with a grin.

"Let's make a deal. I won't tell 'em if you won't. And," $heOrShe points a finger-pistol, "you make sure to treat your crew right so they don't tell either. Deal?"
entries.zh:
"没...我没看见，"$heOrShe咧嘴一笑。

"咱们做个交易。你不说，我也不说。还有，\"$heOrShe比了个手指枪，\"你得好好待你的船员，好让他们也不往外说。成交？"

entries.en:
The merc laughs again, then puts $hisOrHer hands together.

"Well, see you around then. Burn bright, captain!"
entries.zh:
那雇佣兵又笑了起来，随后把$hisOrHer双手合在一起。

"好吧，那就后会有期。星火长明，舰长！"

entries.en:
"$entity.dmi_name sends $entity.dmi_hisOrHer regards," the $entity.dmi_hunter snarls. "If you don't remember $entity.dmi_himOrHer, perhaps you remember a shipment of $entity.dmi_commodity that you were entrusted with."

The comm link goes dead in a crackle of static.
entries.zh:
"$entity.dmi_name 叫我代$entity.dmi_hisOrHer向你问声好，" $entity.dmi_hunter 大声说道，"如果你不记得$entity.dmi_himOrHer是谁了，你应该还记得一批委托你运送的 $entity.dmi_commodity 吧！"

通讯链接在一阵静电杂音中被掐断了。

entries.en: "I propose a large task, and for it I offer a suitably large reward: I require disruption of the $dsp_industry $dsp_marketOnOrAt $dsp_marketName."
entries.zh: "这有一项重大任务，并且我愿意为此提供相当丰厚的报酬：我需要有人去瘫痪 $dsp_marketName 上的 $dsp_industry。"

entries.en: "Now that we trust one another, it would serve my plans to sew chaos $dsp_marketOnOrAt $dsp_marketName. Would you be so kind as to disrupt the $dsp_industry there for me? I will reward you handsomely."
entries.zh: "鉴于我们已经互相信任，我就直说了：在 $dsp_marketName 上搞出一些麻烦会对我的计划有帮助，你能帮我瘫痪那里的 $dsp_industry 吗？酬劳是不会少的。"

entries.en: Some kind of underworld boss lounges in a booth, judging by their motley cordon of augjacks staring down any that dare stray near. No good can come of this.
entries.zh: 一个黑道大佬模样的人懒洋洋地躺在隔间里，旁边那些保镖死死盯着任何胆敢靠近的人。看来能在这儿接到的恐怕不会是什么好工作。

o.zh: 询问瘫痪 $dsp_industry 一事的细节

o.en: See what kind of trouble you can get into with the underworld boss in the booth
o.zh: 看看隔间里的黑道大佬会让你搅什么浑水

entries.en:
As you approach, one of the cybermodded thugs steps in your way, a big metal smile at finally having a challenger to beat down. One of your bodyguards, subtly shadowing you just for such an occasion, steps up.

Yours has better augs and training. Theirs, the brash scars of black-market mod infections and a fatal desire to prove that they can't be faced down.

From the booth, a soft clapping begins. "A good show, very well done. Though I adore bloodsport, I've only barely touched my first drink." Then, to the thug, "You! Stand down- and you, captain. Join me."
entries.zh:
当你靠近时，一个接受过生化改装的暴徒拦住了你，脸上挂着无机感十足的笑容，透露出终于找到痛殴对象的喜悦。而你的一位保镖也默默走上前，此人正是为了应对这类场合而暗中随行着你。

你的保镖拥有更好的改造与训练，至于那黑道老大的手下，不过是个接受了黑市渠道的生化改装后徒有凶相的暴徒罢了。

隔间里响起了一阵轻快的掌声。"精彩的表演，干得漂亮。尽管这种血腥斗殴我已经见多了，但这次我还是连酒都差点忘了喝一口。" 对方随即对暴徒呵斥道，"你！退下 —— 而你，舰长，到我这儿来吧。"

entries.en:
$personName loves talking about $himOrHerself, and is quite content to do so without input from another party, be they one of the attendant thugs or yourself.

The conversation, such as it is, eventually comes around to the stand-off between your respective bodyguards. "I see you run a tight operation, captain," $heOrShe says, barely sipping $hisOrHer potent drink.

A second glass of it sits before you, politely sipped and otherwise ignored. "Good guards, admirably professional. Well paid?" $HeOrShe lifts an eyebrow, and proceeds before you can respond. "I could use some of that. You see- most freebooters, brigands, pirates if you like; they're sloppy. They make a mess of things, it's all bang and noise and no follow-through."

"Now you," $heOrShe says, "Could do something for me."
entries.zh:
$personName 热衷于谈论自己的事，并且相当满足于在没有他人参与的情况下自顾自地说下去，这个 "他人" 可以是其他随行的暴徒，也可以是你。

这场所谓的谈话，最终还是绕到了双方保镖对峙的一事上。"似乎你很有你自己的一套，舰长。" $heOrShe说道，一边浅浅地抿了一口$hisOrHer的那杯烈酒。

第二杯同样的酒摆在你面前，你出于礼貌抿了几口，之后就再没动过。"不错的保镖，专业得令人钦佩。薪水很高吧？" $HeOrShe挑起了一侧眉毛，在你能做出回应之前继续说道，"我正需要这些。你看 —— 大部分的强盗、土匪以及海盗，如果你喜欢这么叫，他们过于草率。他们总把事情搞得一团糟，在弄出一阵砰砰的噪音后虎头蛇尾。"

"而你..." $heOrShe说，"可以为我做点什么。"

entries.en:
"I could use your ground game. Bring the $dsp_industry $dsp_marketOnOrAt $dsp_marketName offline for at least $dsp_disruptDays days. That's $dsp_dist light-years away - you know the one. No massacres, no terror bombing, just business. Keep it clean. More profit had when the target sees the wisdom of peaceable cooperation, right?"

$HeOrShe makes a face, as if deeply considering $hisOrHer offer. "$dsp_reward credits for the job."

You estimate that you'd need around $dsp_marines marines to carry off this operation.
entries.zh:
"我需要你的陆战队。瘫痪 $dsp_marketName 上的 $dsp_industry 至少 $dsp_disruptDays 天。那里离这儿 $dsp_dist 光年 —— 你知道那是什么地方。这不是屠杀任务，也不是恐怖行动，只是生意相关，做的利索点。当行动目标意识到和平合作更为明智的时候，更多的利润就来了，不是吗？"

$HeOrShe摆出了一副认真的模样，好像在细细斟酌自己该为这个任务给出怎样的报酬好。" $dsp_reward 星币。"

你估计你需要大约 $dsp_marines 名陆战队员来完成这个任务。

entries.en:
"Like I said," $heOrShe says, "I require operation of the $dsp_industry $dsp_marketOnOrAt $dsp_marketName, $dsp_dist light-years away, disrupted for at least-" $heOrShe furrows $hisOrHer brow, considering. Then, with cold indifference, says "$dsp_disruptDays days. That should do it. If you carry out this task for me, I would reward you with $dsp_reward credits."

"So you can make an informed decision, here's tac-intel." $HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer datapad and soon you have a very competent recon overview on $dsp_marketName. You estimate that you'd need around $dsp_marines marines to carry off this raid.
entries.zh:
"总之，" $heOrShe说，"我需要你去瘫痪 $dsp_marketName 上的 $dsp_industry，那地方在 $dsp_dist 光年外，确保它被瘫痪至少 —— " $heOrShe皱起$hisOrHer的眉毛思考着，然后冷冷地说，" $dsp_disruptDays 天。这应该足够了。帮我完成这个任务，我将奖励你 $dsp_reward 星币。"

"这是目标的资料，能让你做出明智一些的决定。" $HeOrShe戳了戳$hisOrHer的数据平板，很快你就得到了关于 $dsp_marketName 的十分详尽的情报。你估计你需要大约 $dsp_marines 陆战队员来完成这次劫掠。

entries.en: The task is done to $dsp_personName's specifications, and whatever blackmail or intimidation it was intended to underline is surely moving forward.
entries.zh: 该任务已按照 $dsp_personName 的要求完成，无论那人打算开始向对方进行什么敲诈或恐吓，这下都应该有效得多了。

o.en: Sounds reasonable - we'll provide the fuel.
o.zh: 听起来挺合算的，我会提供燃料给你们。

o.en: No need for payment - I'm not one to gouge someone when they're down.
o.zh: 报酬就免了，我不是乘人之危漫天要价的家伙。

o.en: How about I take on some of your crew instead?
o.zh: 要不我先帮忙救走你的一些船员？

o.en: I'm sorry, we don't have enough to spare right now.
o.zh: 抱歉，我目前没有能匀出来给你们的燃料。

entries.en:
"Alright then, we'll do it the hard way."

The comm link is cut before you have a chance to respond.
entries.zh:
"好吧，那我们就来硬的吧。"

没等你能做出回应，通讯链接就被切断了。

entries.en:
"We'll just have to make do somehow, then. I expect you'll let others know of our plight."

The comm link is cut rather abruptly.
entries.zh:
"那我们就只能再想想办法了。我希望你能向其他人告知我们受困于此。"

通讯链接被突然切断了。

entries.en: "Is that so? I think we'll just have to open up your fuel tanks and make sure. Because our sensors certainly show otherwise."
entries.zh: "是这样吗？我想我们只能打开你的油箱来确认一下了，毕竟我们的传感器可不会撒谎。"

o.en: Ok, ok! You can have the fuel.
Give it your best shot, why don't you.
o.zh: 那么过来拿啊，拿到算你的哦。

entries.en: "Any chance of selling us that fuel, then?"
entries.zh: "那么，能不能把那些燃料卖给我呢？"

entries.en: You have $player.fuel fuel available.
entries.zh: 你有 $player.fuel 单位燃料可用。

entries.en: You have $player.fuel fuel available.
entries.zh: 你有 $player.fuel 单位燃料可用。

entries.en:
"That's a tough choice to make, but if the alternative is leaving some crew behind in cryopods to hopefully return for later..."

$HeOrShe pauses, clearly thinking things through.

"With fewer crew to support, we can scuttle some of our ships.

That'll get us some anti-matter from reactor cores, and with fewer ships, what fuel we have will go farther. We just might be able to make it back.

Let me see... will you take on $entity.distressCrewTakeOn crew? That should be within your $shipOrFleet's capacity."
entries.zh:
"这会是个艰难的抉择，但仅剩的选项是把一些船员留在冷冻舱里，希望以后还能返回这里..."

$HeOrShe停顿了一下，看来是把事情都考虑清楚了。

"如果承载的船员减少，我们就能凿沉一些舰船。

这样我们就可以从反应堆核心里回收一些反物质。而且由于舰船数量减少，我们凭现有的燃料就能走得更远。我们也许能够这样回去。

让我想想... 你愿意接受 $entity.distressCrewTakeOn 名船员吗？这应该在你的$shipOrFleet的人员承载范围内。"

entries.en:
"What, you want to steal some of my crew under the guise of offering to 'help'? I don't think so!

You're obligated to render what aid you can, so - how about that fuel?"
entries.zh:
"什么，你想打着提供 '帮助' 的幌子偷走一些我的船员？门都没有！"

你有义务尽可能地提供帮助。那么，燃料呢？"

entries.en:
"That's a tough choice to make, but if the alternative is leaving some crew behind in cryopods to hopefully return for later..."

$HeOrShe pauses, thinking things through.

"Let me see... will you take on $entity.distressCrewTakeOn crew? That should be within your $shipOrFleet's personnel capacity.

It won't let us scuttle enough ships to reduce fuel consumption and be able to strike for the core worlds, but at least they'll be safe."
entries.zh:
"这可是个艰难的抉择，但仅剩的选项是把一些船员留在冷冻舱里，希望以后还能返回这里..."

$HeOrShe停顿了一下，看来是把事情都考虑清楚了。

"让我想想... 你愿意接受 $entity.distressCrewTakeOn 名船员吗？这应该在你的$shipOrFleet的人员承载范围内。

虽然这不足以让我们放弃足够多舰船，以减少燃料消耗争取回到核心世界。但这至少能先让那些人脱险。"

entries.en:
The shuttle makes its final approach to the port district, the pilot overseeing small pings of attitude thrusters.

Your comm link chimes. An incoming request appears - an encrypted voice-only connection from source unknown.
entries.zh:
穿梭机准备在港口区域降落，驾驶员盯着姿态控制推进器的脉冲信号。

你收到了通讯请求，那是一个传入请求 —— 未知来源的加密语音连接。

o.en: Ignore it and head to the bar
o.zh: 忽略它并直接前往酒吧

entries.en:
You accept the comm request. A voice crackles from the staticy display of your TriPad.

"Captain $playerName. I know why you're really here. I believe you and I can resolve this situation personally, though I must remain anonymous due to political considerations."

"I recognize that your capability to employ deadly force is not insignificant. I wish to propose a path of least bloodshed."

"You will have to trust me, captain. And, naturally, I cannot simply give you what you want; it will come at the price of $extr_storyCost credits. I hope you find this an acceptable compromise, given the alternative."
entries.zh:
你接受了通讯请求，TriPad 上充满静电干扰的图像里传出了声音。

"$playerName 舰长。我知道你来这里的真正原因，我相信我们可以私下解决这个问题，但出于政治考虑，我必须保持匿名。"

"我很清楚你动用致命武力的能力不容小觑。因此我想给出一些建议，能避免不必要的流血牺牲。"

"舰长，您一定要相信我。当然，我不能就这么把你想要的送给你；它的价格是 $extr_storyCost 星币。我希望对你来说这是笔合算的交易。"

o.en: Cooperate with the voice and pay the credits
Close the connection and head to the bar

entries.en:
The voice provides you with a numbered burner account for the credits transfer.

"Excellent, captain," the anonymized  voice says, "I confirm receipt of your payment. From this point it'll take only a short time for the arrangements to be made."

The voice gives you instructions to head to a particular bar, $extr_barName, near the concourse. "Goodbye, Captain $playerName," it says one last time.

With the sinking feeling that your target - and credits -might be further away from you with each passing minute, you enter the bar.
entries.zh:
对方为你提供了一个一次性账户用于转账。

"太好了，舰长，" 那个声音说，"我确认已经收到了你的付款。现在我需要一点时间来做些安排。"

这个声音指示你去一个特定的酒吧，名为 $extr_barName，它在广场附近。"再见，$playerName 舰长，" 声音最后这么说到。

时间一分一秒地过去，你的目标 —— 以及星币 —— 可能都会离你而去，带着这种消沉的感觉，你走进了酒吧。

entries.en:
The proprietor looks up as soon as you step into the dim tube-lit interior. "Hey!" You tense, at the tone. "You can't just let your friend sleep here, I'm not running a hotel yeah?" This must be $extr_barOwner.

$extr_barOwner pulls you toward a dark end of the bar where a figure appears to be passed out drunk; a rad-reflective hood has fallen over their face. You pull it back, and it is indeed your extraction target. Looking a little pale, unconscious, and drooling, but the face matches your intel.

"I don't want any trouble, maybe your friend's on chems, I don't ask questions. But see, I took care of 'em right? No call to municipal. Now you take your friend and go now. Go, get out!" He tries to shoo you toward the door as you lift the slack body.
entries.zh:
你一走进昏暗的灯管照明的室内，店主就抬起头来。"嘿！" 你被这语气吓了一跳。"你不能就这么让你的朋友睡在这里，我这可不是开旅馆的，明白吗？" 这个人一定就是 $extr_barOwner 了。

$extr_barOwner 把你拉到酒吧的一个角落里，那里有一个似乎喝醉了的人，一个防辐射面具一样的东西罩住了他的脸。你把那东西拿开，发现这人果然就是你的营救目标。对方的脸色有些苍白，失去了知觉，还流着口水，但你知道这张脸和你的情报相符。

"也许你的朋友在磕药，但我不想惹麻烦，我不会问不该问的。你看，我把他照顾得很好吧？我没打市政电话。所以现在你带着你的朋友走吧。走，出去！" 当你抬起那松弛的身体时，他试图把你推出酒吧。

entries.en:
Outside the bar you pass the unconscious form to one of your bodyguards, whose subtle augments make carrying the limp form a matter of casual ease.

The automedic on the shuttle back reports that the agent was heavily and expertly sedated.

Returned to consciousness in secure quarters on your flagship, the agent is suspicious and uncooperative until you give the confirmation phrase you were provided. Calmer now, they have no explanation for how they ended up in $extr_barName.

Maybe it doesn't matter; you just have to get them back, get your pay, and the job is done.
entries.zh:
离开酒吧后，你把这个失去知觉的家伙递给了你的一个保镖，对方使用了一些巧妙的技巧，让搬人看起来变得轻松了不少。

在穿梭机上，检查报告显示特工被人用熟练的手法注射了大量镇静剂。

在你旗舰上的安全区域恢复意识后，特工一开始满腹狐疑，完全没有展现出合作的态度 —— 直到你对上了暗号。冷静下来后，他也无法解释自己为什么会在 $extr_barName。

也许这无关紧要，你只需要把他找回来，拿到工资，任务就完成了。

entries.en:
$extr_barOwner rolls his eyes, "Your other friend showed me your holo, said look, my other friend the space captain is coming to pick this one up."

"Now you get going, I don't want people thinking my drinks are bad or maybe $extr_barOwner runs a place with no class. Go, go!"
entries.zh:
$extr_barOwner 翻了翻白眼："你的另一个朋友给我看了你的全息照，说：看，我的另一位朋友，这位舰长会来接这个人。"

"现在快走吧，我不想让人们认为我的酒不好，或者 $extr_barOwner 经营的餐厅没有档次。走，走！"

entries.en:
$extr_barOwner sighs loudly, "I tell you, then you go right? Now here's what I tell you: I didn't see anything. I'm running a spacer bar, not a children's creche. People come in, people go out. I don't look too close, I don't ask important questions, it's 'good run?', or 'price of fuel ain't what it was eh?'. That's the business."

"We made a deal, now you're leaving. Out, out!"
entries.zh:
$extr_barOwner 大声叹了口气："我告诉你，然后你马上就会走的对吧？现在我告诉你：我什么都没看见。我开的是太空佬酒吧，不是托儿所。人来人往。我不会多管闲事，也不会问重要的问题，只会问 '近况如何？' 或者 '燃料又涨价了不是吗？'，这就是本分。"

"我们说好了的，现在你快走。出去，出去！"

o.en: Wait, how did you recognize me?
o.zh: 等等，你怎么认出我来的？
我的 '朋友' 是怎么来的？

entries.en: "Command has assigned me a somewhat atypical extraction mission. Due to, ah, public-political implications, it is best performed by a mixed-capability independent unit such as yours."
entries.zh: "指挥部给我分配了一个特殊的撤离任务。由于...嗯，公共政治影响，这种任务最好由你们这样的复合独立舰队来执行。"

entries.en: "Command has given me an unconventional extraction mission; a mixed-capability unit with experience interacting with, ah, non-aligned militants may be most appropriate for the situation."
entries.zh: "指挥部分配给我了一个非常规的撤离任务，具备多样化的作战能力，同时和那些，呃，所谓的无所属武装分子经常打交道的小型部队最适合这种情况。"

entries.en: "Command has given me a sensitive mission. Your independent, mixed-capability unit would be best suited to carrying it out due to... religious elements."
entries.zh: "指挥部给了我一个高度敏感的任务。由于...宗教因素，你这种具备多样化的作战能力的独立小型部队最适合执行它。"

entries.en: A nervous cadet holding a drink approaches you, "Um, captain. My uh- I mean, the $extr_manOrWoman over there wants a word." The cadet glances at a dark corner of the bar.
entries.zh: 一个紧张的学员拿着酒靠近你，"呃，舰长。我的...呃我是说那边的$extr_manOrWoman想要和您说句话。" 学员往酒吧阴暗角落瞥了一眼。

entries.en: A nervous cadet holding a drink approaches you, "Um, captain. My uh- I mean, the $extr_manOrWoman over there wants a word." The cadet glances at a dark corner of the bar.
entries.zh: 一个紧张的学员拿着酒靠近你，"呃，舰长。我的...呃我是说那边的$extr_manOrWoman想要和您说句话。" 学员往酒吧阴暗角落瞥了一眼。

entries.en: A nervous cadet holding a drink approaches you, "Um, captain. My uh- I mean, the $extr_manOrWoman over there wants a word." The cadet glances at a dark corner of the bar.
entries.zh: 一个紧张的学员拿着酒靠近你，"呃，舰长。我的...呃我是说那边的$extr_manOrWoman想要和您说句话。" 学员往酒吧阴暗角落瞥了一眼。

entries.en: "Impressive work, captain," the $faction $post says. "I'm told that you've helped us perform quite a coup on the intel front. The analysts are terribly excited."
entries.zh: "令人印象深刻，舰长。" $faction $post 说，"我听说你在帮助我们取得情报一事上取得了巨大成功。分析师们非常兴奋。"

entries.en:
"You've done some good work, captain," the $faction $rank says. "Our agent... will recover."

$HeOrShe leans back, eyes focusing on something abstract. "The pirates on the other hand, with the intel we've gained on their organization, their movements, their patsies in the civil service - we shall bring them the swift justice they've earned."
entries.zh:
"做得不错，舰长。" $faction $rank 说，"我们的特工...会痊愈的。"

$HeOrShe靠在椅背上，眼睛盯着一些说不清道不明的东西。"另一方面，我们获得了有关海盗的组织，行为模式，以及他们在政府部门的替罪羊的情报，我们将迅速给予他们应得的正义。"

entries.en:
"Good work captain," the $faction $rank says, "I must admit that I was not fully convinced that our agent could be safely extracted. The Pathers... it's never a proper stand-up battle with them." $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head.

"Intel tells me our agent will provide information that shall let us roll up a great number of Pather infiltrator rings. No details of course, you know how this business is. I need not tell you how many lives you've saved."
entries.zh:
"干得好，舰长。" $faction $rank 说，"我必须承认，我根本没有料到我们的特工能被安全救出。左径分子...跟他们的战斗总是如此残酷。" $HeOrShe摇着$hisOrHer的头。

"情报人员告诉我，我们的特工提供的信息可以让我们找到大量渗透进来的左径分子。我不会透露细节，但你知道这意味着什么。我想我不必强调你救了多少人的命。"

o.en: Ask about the 'atypical extraction' mission involving a major faction
o.zh: 询问涉及主要势力的 "特殊撤离" 任务

o.en: Ask about the 'unconventional extraction' mission involving pirates
o.zh: 询问涉及海盗的"非常规撤离"任务

o.en: Ask about the 'unconventional extraction' mission involving Pathers
o.zh: 询问涉及左径的 "非常规撤离" 任务

o.en: Talk to the $extr_manOrWoman who ordered the cadet to apprehend you
Talk to the $extr_manOrWoman who ordered the cadet to apprehend you
Talk to the $extr_manOrWoman who ordered the cadet to apprehend you

entries.en:
The $manOrWoman sits in the dark. $HeOrShe is dressed as a common tech, but speaks as though $heOrShe holds, or has held, command.

"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says. "My superiors recognize that your unique talents could serve our faction." There is no drink on the table, and no invitation to sit. "We need an agent extracted from $extr_marketFactionArticle $extr_marketFaction colony $extr_marketOnOrAt $extr_marketName. A flagged taskforce cannot do this due to... political considerations. Our offer is $extr_reward credits."

"The oppo may be expecting you. We have intel on their defenses," the $manOrWoman places a datapad on the table for your inspection.

You quickly review the contents and estimate that you'd need around $extr_marines marines to carry off the operation.
entries.zh:
只见一个$manOrWoman坐在黑暗的角落里。虽然穿得和普通的技术官差不多，但从话语间能听出$heOrShe才是这儿负责发号施令的人，就是不知道是以前还是最近才上任的。

"$playerName 舰长，" $heOrShe说，"我的上级意识到你出众的才干能为我们势力效力。" 桌子上没有酒，对方也没有邀请你坐下。"我们需要从 $extr_marketName 撤离一名特工，那里属于 $extr_marketFaction 的势力范围。由于某些... 政治上的考量，我们无法动用正规编制的特遣队执行这项任务。当然，我们将会提供 $extr_reward 星币作为报酬。"

"对方很可能对你的到来有所提防，我这里有些目标周边防御布置的情报。" $manOrWoman把数据平板放在桌上供你检查。

你快速浏览了一遍内容，估计需要大约 $extr_marines 名陆战队员来执行这项任务。

entries.en:
The $manOrWoman sits in the dark at a table with no drink. $HeOrShe is dressed as a common tech, but speaks as though $heOrShe holds, or has held, command.

"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says. "One of our top agents infiltrated the retinue of a pirate warlord $extr_marketOnOrAt $extr_marketName. They have been apprehended. Extraction by any means is now our mission objective, though political considerations make use of the flagged navy in this operation... awkward. Our offer to you is $extr_reward credits for successful return of our agent."

"The pirates will be expecting you, but we have intel on their defenses," the $manOrWoman places a datapad on the table.

You quickly review the contents and estimate that around $extr_marines marines are needed to execute the operation.
entries.zh:
这个$manOrWoman坐在桌旁的昏暗处，桌上并没有摆酒。虽穿得和普通技术官差不多，但从话语间能听出$heOrShe才是这儿负责发号施令的人，就是不知道是以前还是最近才上任的。

"$playerName 舰长，" $heOrShe说，"我方的一名高级特工渗透了在 $extr_marketName 的一名{海盗}军阀。他已经暴露并且受到监禁。当前的任务目标是以任何可行手段将其撤离 $extr_marketName，但如果我们动用正规编制的海军将会造成政治上的... 不便。对此，我们提供 $extr_reward 星币，作为让我方特工安全返回的报酬。"

"{海盗}可能会预料到你的袭击。但我们有关于他们防御系统的情报。" 这个$manOrWoman把数据平板放在桌上供你检查。

你快速审了一遍内容，并预计你需要大约 $extr_marines 陆战队员来执行这项任务。

entries.en:
The $manOrWoman sits in the dark at a table with no drink. $HeOrShe is dressed as a common tech, but speaks as though $heOrShe holds, or has held, command.

"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says. "One of our top agents infiltrated a militant Luddic sect $extr_marketOnOrAt $extr_marketName. They have been apprehended. Extraction by any means is now our mission objective, though religious considerations make use of the flagged navy in this operation... awkward. Our offer to you is $extr_reward credits for successful return of our agent."

"The Pathers will be expecting you, but we have intel on their defenses," the $manOrWoman places a datapad on the table.

You quickly review the contents and estimate that around $extr_marines marines are needed to execute the operation.
entries.zh:
这个$manOrWoman坐在角落的暗处，桌上没摆酒。虽然打扮和普通的技官差不多，但从话语间能听出$heOrShe才是这儿负责发号施令的人，就不知道是以前还是最近才上任的。

"$playerName 舰长。" $HeOrShe说，"我方的一名顶级特工渗透了在 $extr_marketName 的激进的卢德教派。他已经被发现并且被监禁了。当前的任务目标是以任何可行手段将其撤离 $extr_marketName，但如果我们打着海军的旗号去的话会造成宗教文化上的...不便。对此，我们提供 $extr_reward 星币，作为我方特工安全返回的奖励。"

"左径可能预料到你的到来。但我们有他们防线的情报。" $manOrWoman把一个数据信息板放在桌上供你检查。

你快速审了一遍内容并预计你需要大约 $extr_marines 陆战队员来执行这项任务。

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says. "As I said, we need the agent extracted from $extr_marketName. Command has authorized a payment of $extr_reward credits for a successful mission."

"The oppo may be expecting you. I suggest you go in quiet because, as you know, it's $extr_marketFactionArticle $extr_marketFaction colony. The situation is enough of a mess as it is."

$HeOrShe pauses a moment. Some hidden frustration? "We do, however, have a fair piece of intel on their defensive capabilities," $personLastName says, fingers moving rapidly to transfer a datafile for your inspection - a detailed tactical report.

You quickly review the contents and estimate that you'd need around $extr_marines marines to carry off the operation.
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长，" $HeOrShe说，"如我所说，我们需要从 $extr_marketName 撤离一名特工。指挥中心已经授权为完成此次任务支付 $extr_reward 星币。"

"对方可能对袭击有所防备，我建议你保持低调。毕竟，你知道的，那可是 $extr_marketFactionArticle $extr_marketFaction 的殖民地。光是有特工在那落网，就已经够糟了。"

$HeOrShe说着说着，话语一顿，或许是在强压心底的沮丧？"不过，我们掌握了关于对方防御能力的情报，内容还算详实。" $personLastName 说到这里，指尖连点几下，将一份详细的战术报告传了过来，供你参考。

你快速审了一遍内容并预计你需要大约 $extr_marines 名陆战队员来执行这项任务。

entries.en:
"One of our agents infiltrated the retinue of a pirate warlord $extr_marketOnOrAt $extr_marketName. We know that they have been apprehended. Extraction by any means necessary is now our mission objective, and I believe you are best suited to carry out this mission." $HeOrShe sighs, "We cannot use the flagged navy in this operation due to... politics. So we come to you. Retrieve the agent and we will pay you $extr_reward credits."

With a few taps at $hisOrHer console you receive an incoming data stream, "Intel on the pirates' defenses. We won't be sending you in blind, at least."

You quickly review the intel and estimate that you'd need around $extr_marines marines to carry off this operation.
entries.zh:
"我方的一名高级特工渗透了在 $extr_marketName 的一名海盗军阀。此人已经被发现并且被监禁了。当前的任务目标是以任何可行手段将其撤离 $extr_marketName，我相信你最适合执行这个任务。" $HeOrShe叹气到，"如果我们让海军大张旗鼓地参与这项行动的话会带来一些政治上的...不便。所以我们找到了你。我们提供 $extr_reward 星币，作为我方特工安全返回的奖励。"

$hisOrHer在控制面板上轻触几下，你收到一个数据流传入，"这是海盗的防御布局。至少我们不会让你盲目地冲进去。"

你快速审了一遍内容并预计你需要大约 $extr_marines 陆战队员来执行这项任务。

entries.en:
"One of our agents infiltrated a militant Luddic sect $extr_marketOnOrAt $extr_marketName." $HeOrShe meets your eyes, "Yes, Pathers. We know our agent was apprehended. Extraction by any means necessary is now our mission objective, and I believe you are best suited to carry out this mission." $HeOrShe sighs, "We cannot use the flagged navy in this operation due to... religious considerations. So we come to you. Retrieve the agent and we will pay you $extr_reward credits."

With a few taps at $hisOrHer console you receive an incoming data stream, "Intel on the Pathers' defenses. We won't be sending you in blind, at least."

You quickly review the intel and estimate that you'd need around $extr_marines marines to carry off this operation.
entries.zh:
"我方的一名特工渗透了在 $extr_marketName 的一个卢德武装教派。" $HeOrShe和你交换了一下眼色。"对，就是 卢德左径。我们得知这名特工已经被扣押了。当前的任务目标是不择手段将其救回，而我相信你是执行这个任务的最佳人选。" $HeOrShe叹气到。"毕竟出于...宗教上的考虑，我们不能让海军打着自己的旗号去执行这一行动。因此我们必须拜托你。救回我们的特工，我们将支付你 $extr_reward 星币作为报酬。"

$hisOrHer在控制面板上轻触几下，随即你收到了一份数据，"这是左径分子的防御布局。我们至少不会让你盲目地冲进去。"

你快速浏览了一遍情报，估计你需要至少大约 $extr_marines 名陆战队员来执行这项任务。

entries.en:
You feel a twitch through the agrav plates as the assault shuttle docks. You nod your approval to the medic and marines escorting the rescued agent - they return a salute. The agent is too dazed to recognize you as their savior.

No matter.
entries.zh:
当突击穿梭机在码头上停靠时，你感受到了着陆的震动。你向护送获救特工的军医和陆战队员致意，他们向你敬礼，获救的特工因为意识过于模糊，没有认出你就是他们的救星。

无所谓了。

entries.en:
The extracted agent, bloodied but alive, is escorted to secure quarters by a medic and two guards.

Curses and impotent oaths of vengeance come in over the comms. You nod to your comms officer, who terminates the open channel.
entries.zh:
被解救的特工浑身是血，但还活着，他被一名医护人员和两名警卫护送到了安全的地方。

通讯频道中传来咒骂与无力的复仇誓言。你向你的通讯军官点头，接着对方关闭了公用频道。

entries.en:
The extracted agent, exhausted, alive, and in need of a long shower is escorted to secure quarters by a medic and two guards.

Curses and impotent oaths of vengeance come in over the comms. You nod to your comms officer, who terminates the open channel.
entries.zh:
被解救出来的特工筋疲力尽，虽然还活着，但看起来需要好好地休整一阵子了，他被一名医护人员和两名警卫护送到了安全的地方。

通讯频道中传来咒骂与无力的复仇誓言。你向你的通讯军官点头，接着对方关闭了公用频道。

entries.en: "Oh, captain," he looks apologetic. "I'll return to your question in just a moment, for I've quite entirely forgotten my manners."
entries.zh: "哦，舰长，" 他看上去略带歉意。"我们稍后再谈你的事，你瞧我，完全把待客的礼数都给忘了。"

entries.en:
The comm-link connects to the office of Fortuna Kato.

A liveried secretary politely takes your request for audience, then thanks you for your patience.
entries.zh:
通讯线路接通了 Fortuna Kato 的办公室。

一名穿号衣的秘书客气地记下你的觐见请求，又谢过你的耐心等候。

entries.en: "If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice.
entries.zh: "哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，话音刚起，人已经出现在画面里。

entries.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice.

"I trust Horus Yaribay is well?"
entries.zh:
"哎呀，$PlayerName 舰长，稀客，" 你刚听见 Fortuna 的声音，她人已经现身。

"想来 Horus Yaribay 近来安好吧？"

entries.en: "If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice. "I trust you are attending to your own business, as I am to mine."
entries.zh: "哟，$PlayerName 舰长，\" Fortuna 说道，听见声音的同时人已出现在画面里，\"想必您忙着自己的事，我也忙我的。"

entries.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice.

"I trust Reynard Hannan is well?"

It does not sound like an earnest inquiry, somehow.
entries.zh:
"这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，话音未落，人已经出现在画面里。

"想来 Reynard Hannan 近来安好吧？"

可不知怎么，听着不像真心在问。

entries.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, appearing at the instant you hear her voice. Her tone contains more than a touch of acid.

"I trust Reynard Hannan is more than pleased with your conspiracy of self-serving fools."
entries.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" 话音刚起 Fortuna 便已现身，语气里的酸味可不止一点。

"想来 Reynard Hannan 对你们这伙只顾自己的蠢货攒的局，满意得不能再满意了吧。"

entries.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, a distinct edge in her voice.

"I was disappointed to hear of your support for Horus Yaribay's nearly treasonous scheme - in direct contradiction to the agreement you and I came to on Yesod."

She raises an eyebrow. "Oh yes - I know about it. Horus should count himself lucky that I am so fond of him, and so patient. I shudder to think how it would look if the All-League Council were to hear of his... pursuits."

"Watch yourself, captain," she says.
entries.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，话里带着明晃晃的刺。

"听说你替 Horus Yaribay 那套近乎谋逆的把戏撑腰，我很失望——这和你在 Yesod 同我谈定的约定，可是正面相左。"

她挑了挑眉。"没错——我都知道。Horus 该庆幸我待他有几分情分，又耐得住性子。真要让全联盟议会听见他那些... 勾当，我都不敢想会闹成什么样。"

"自己当心，舰长，" 她说道。

entries.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, a distinct edge in her voice.

"I was disappointed to hear of your support for Horus Yaribay's nearly treasonous scheme - in direct contradiction to the agreement you and I came to on Yesod, however purely mercenary it was."

She raises an eyebrow. "Oh yes - I know about it. Horus should count himself lucky that I am so fond of him, and so patient. I shudder to think how it would look if the All-League Council were to hear of his... pursuits."

"Watch yourself, captain," she says.
entries.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，话里带着明晃晃的刺。

"听说你替 Horus Yaribay 那套近乎谋逆的把戏撑腰，我很失望——也和你在 Yesod 同我谈妥的那份约定正面相左，纵然那约定从头到尾不过是桩买卖。"

她挑了挑眉。"没错——我都知道。Horus 该庆幸我待他有几分情分，又耐得住性子。真要让全联盟议会听见他那些... 勾当，我都不敢想会闹成什么样。"

"自己当心，舰长，" 她说道。

entries.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, an edge already in her voice.

"I trust your newfound patron, Reynard Hannan, is well?"

She smirks, then adds "You will learn soon enough how well you deserve one another."
entries.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，一开口就带了刺。

"你那位新攀上的靠山 Reynard Hannan，想来一切安好吧？"

她嘴角一挑，又补了句："过不了多久你就知道，你们俩有多般配了。"

entries.en:
"If it isn't Captain $PlayerName," Fortuna says, an edge already in her voice.

"I trust your newfound patron, Reynard Hannan, is paying you well?"

She smirks, then adds "You will learn soon enough just how you deserve one another."
entries.zh:
"哟，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长嘛，" Fortuna 说道，一开口就带了刺。

"你那位新攀上的靠山 Reynard Hannan，给的价码还满意吧？"

她嘴角一挑，又补了句："过不了多久你就明白，你们俩是怎么凑到一块的了。"

entries.en:
Then she goes quiet, eyes downcast. Thinking. Somehow not quite satisfied, never satisfied.

Looking more her age than timelessly regal.
entries.zh:
随后她静了下来，垂下眼帘。她在想事。不知怎的，总有些不够满足，永远不满足。

这一刻，她看上去更像她这个年纪的人，而不是那位超脱岁月的君主。

entries.en:
She lets out a deep breath, then looks up.

"Until we speak again, $titlePL," she says, her attention already on the next project.

The link cuts.
entries.zh:
她长长吐出一口气，然后抬起头。

"下次再谈，$titlePL，"她说着，心思已经转到下一个项目上。

通讯切断。

entries.en:
She looks up, quickly, as if she was caught daydreaming. She recomposes herself nearly instantly, and releases a breath.

"Until we speak again, $titlePL," she says.

The link cuts.
entries.zh:
她猛地抬起头，像是被人撞见在走神。几乎瞬间她就恢复了常态，吐出一口气。

"下次再谈，$titlePL，"她说。

通讯切断。

entries.en:
Your comms officer tries to establish a connection to the fusion lamp's governor interface, but the terminal is secured. Each failed login dumps the display feed back to an advertisement for the "Fabrique Orbitale Plasma Dynamo".

Bronzed, athletic sophisticates lounge in the midst of an unlikely display of glassware in primitive-chic luxury as several suns set on some watery horizon; the suns' glows flare to fill the screen with a rising fanfare, which crescendos, then fades to the Fabrique Orbitale logo and its distinctive orbiting-O.

You terminate the feed.
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官尝试与聚变射灯的控制终端建立连接，但终端已经被保护了起来。每次登录失败后，摄像头传输回的影像中都会开始播放轨道工厂制造公司的等离子发电机广告。

画面上，一堆奢华到离谱的复古风格玻璃家具中间，躺着一位有着古铜色皮肤的健壮靓仔。他背后，好几个太阳缓缓落下，在地平线处的水面上闪耀着光芒。伴随着昂扬上升的乐声，太阳的光辉充满了屏幕。随后，乐声渐弱，轨道工厂制造公司独特的 O 形商标逐渐显现在屏幕上。

你终止了视频信号。

entries.en:
Your comms officer establishes a connection to the fusion lamp's governor, then switches the command terminal to your display interface.

"Welcome, [CUSTOMER NAME]! Please review the spectrum customization options for your Fabrique Orbitale [PRODUCT NAME] below. If you require assistance from a customer service expedition, please contact [COMMS ID CORRUPTED]."
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官建立了与聚变射灯控制装置之间的连接，并将终端界面切换到了你的显示屏上。

"欢迎您，[客户姓名]！以下是由轨道工厂制造公司生产的 [产品名称] 的光谱频率设置选项。如果您需要客服人员的协助，请联系 [通讯 ID 已失效]。"

entries.en: Thank you for using the Fabrique Orbitale Color Selector (tm)!
entries.zh: 感谢您使用轨道工厂制造公司颜色选择器 (tm)！

entries.en:
"Please enjoy the multitude of color options provided to ensure optimal comfort and health to your [COLONISTS / EMPLOYEES / CUSTOMERS / OTHER]."

After a moment's contemplation, you decide to set the color to...
entries.zh:
请享受我们提供给您的多种可选颜色，以保证您的 [殖民者/雇员/客户/其它人员] 的舒适和健康。

经过片刻的沉思，你决定将颜色设置为...

o.zh: 光化学反应的蓝色，就像 Isirah

o.en: Calming green, like no star in the galaxy
o.zh: 平静的绿色，在群星中独一无二！

entries.en: Thank you for using the Fabrique Orbitale Color Selector (tm)!
entries.zh: 感谢您使用轨道工厂制造公司颜色选择器 (tm)！

entries.en:
"Please consult your Fabrique Orbitale Orbital Fusion Lamp Non-AI Classified Expert System Manual Agent (tm) for instructions on how to reconfigure the Orbital Fusion Lamp Product (tm) for other industrial and military applications."

Your breath catches at the words "military applications", but there is no more information forthcoming. And, needless to say, you're not in possession of a Fabrique Orbitale Orbital Fusion Lamp Non-AI Classified Expert System Manual Agent (tm).
entries.zh:
"请咨询您的 '轨道工厂制造公司轨道聚变射灯非 AI 专家系统手册智能助理 (tm)'，以获取更多关于轨道聚变射灯产品 (tm) 的配置指南和其它工业或军事应用。"

听到 "军事应用" 这几个字，你不禁心头一紧，但信息里并未给出更多的解释，更不用说你手头根本没有 "轨道工厂制造公司聚变射灯非 AI 专家系统手册智能助理 (tm)"。

o.en: Adjust the lamp's visible emission range
o.zh: 调整聚变射灯的可见光发光波长范围

entries.en:
The mercenary $personRank looks a little surprised that you accepted $hisOrHer terms.

"A pleasant surprise, captain. You've made things very easy on everyone today. If only everyone were so cooperative," $heOrShe takes a moment to contemplate such a world, then shakes $hisOrHer head.

"I bid you thank-you and good-bye."

The comms snap off. You consider your next move.
entries.zh:
看起来雇佣兵 $personRank 对你接受$hisOrHer的条件感到有些惊讶。

"真是意外之喜，舰长。这一次你让事情进行得十分顺利。要是每个人都能展现出这样的合作诚意就好了。" 有那么一阵子$HeOrShe似乎在脑海中构架出了那样一个美好的世界，然后摇了摇自己的头。

"十分感谢，再见。"

通讯链接被断开了，你开始思考接下来该做些什么。

entries.en:
"Then it's done," the mercenary $personRank says, looking pleased. "I couldn't ask for a more pleasant transaction. Perhaps we shall do business again one day?"

$HeOrShe smiles, then cuts the comm link.
entries.zh:
"那么事情就告一段落了，" 雇佣兵 $personRank 说，脸上写着满满的高兴。"没有比这更令人愉快的交易了。也许今后我们还有机会再做做生意？"

$HeOrShe笑了笑，然后切断了通讯链接。

entries.en:
The $rank nods solemnly as you accept $hisOrHer terms. You order $fwt_theThing ejected into space. The Pather blasts it into a spray of exotic particles.

"Now," $heOrShe intones, closing $hisOrHer eyes "We pray."

The Pather captain transmits a classic Luddic prayer, begging forgiveness and doing least-harm to holy Creation and so on.

You terminate the comms at what feels like an appropriate moment to bow out.
entries.zh:
当你接受$hisOrHer的条件时，$rank庄严地点点头。你下令将 $fwt_theThing 弹射到太空中。接着左径分子把它炸成了一团奇异的粒子。

"现在，" $HeOrShe合上$hisOrHer的眼睛吟诵着，"让我们祈祷。"

左径舰长念叨着经典的卢德祷文，乞求宽恕，将对神的造物的摧残降到最低限度之类。

你在合适的时机里终止了通讯。

entries.en:
"Tri-Tachyon property transponder detected. The Tri-Tachyon corporation thanks you for your c-c-c-" // "...please contact service repre-"

INTERRUPT

set memory value: $playerName SUSCEPTIBLE_TO_TERMINATION_THREAT true
transaction protocol END
entries.zh:
"已检测到 速子科技 财产应答特征。速子科技感谢 你的 合 - 合 - 合 - " // "...请联系服务代 - "

中断

设置内存 : $playerName 易被 死亡威胁影响 = true
商贸_协定 END

entries.en:
"Tri-Tachyon property transponder not detected. Please re-eject the Tri-Tachyon property. Please re-// T-T-Tri-Tachyon corporation thanks you fo-" // "...please contact a service repre-"

INTERRUPT

set property: $playerName -> GREEDY true
set property: $playerName -> DISHONEST true
evaluate() // trust metric result LESS_THAN transaction_protocol_min true

transaction protocol END
entries.zh:
"未检测到速子科技财产应答特征。请再次交出速子科技财产。请 再 - // 速 - 速 - 速子 - 速子科技 感谢 - " // "...请联系服务代 - "

终止

构建逻辑 : $playerName -> 贪婪 true
构建逻辑 : $playerName -> 不诚实 true
评估 () // 信任计量结果小于交易协议最小值 = true

商贸_协定 END

entries.en:
The $faction $personRank looks more than a little surprised that you accepted $hisOrHer terms.

"Well. Good." $HeOrShe nods. "An unexpected but wise decision." $HeOrShe seems unsure of what else to say at this point, then shrugs and snaps the comms off.

You consider your next move.
entries.zh:
$faction $personRank 对你竟然接受了$hisOrHer的条件感到非常惊讶。

"嗯，非常好。" $HeOrShe点了点头，"一个出乎意料，但十分明智的决定。" $HeOrShe似乎不确定这时候还该说些什么，于是耸了耸肩并断开了通讯。

你开始考虑接下来该做些什么。

entries.en:
The $faction $personRank looks pleased as $heOrShe transmits payment.

"Excellent! Great. Good doing business with you, $playerName." You exchange a few hollow pleasantries and cut the comm link.
entries.zh:
在$HeOrShe转移款项时，这位 $faction $personRank 看起来十分高兴。

"完美！太棒了。和你做生意十分愉快，$playerName。" 你们在敷衍地相互寒暄了几句之后就切断了通讯链接。

entries.en:
"Beautiful, captain," the Tri-Tachyon $rank confirms the cargo transfer and looks to be almost in the throes of some kind of spiritual force. $HisOrHer arms are raised, $hisOrHer face radiating pleasure. "Nothing could be easier. And here," a subtle flicker of cybernetic implants, "Is your payment."

"I sincerely hope that chance aligns such that we may do business again - and soon," $heOrShe says. "Bright stars and long burns. Be sure to add me on TriLink!"

You close the channel, then dismiss the notification that appears on your TriPad.
entries.zh:
"完美，舰长。" 对方确认了货物转移，这位速子科技的 $rank 看起来几乎沉浸于某种精神力量之中。$hisOrHer的双臂高举，$hisOrHer的脸上洋溢着愉悦之色。"真是轻松愉快。还有这个，" 一个似乎是某种控制器的植入体闪着微光，"这是给您的报酬。"

"我由衷地希望我们能再次合作 —— 并且越快越好，" $HeOrShe说。"祝您闪耀群星，航程不熄。务必记得在 TriLink 上添加我！"

你关闭了通讯频道，接着又关掉了数据平板上出现的通知。

entries.en:
"Ah." The Tri-Tachyon $rank's perfect smile disappears. You catch the subtle flicker of active cybernetics in $hisOrHer eyes, though you could not say for sure what $heOrShe is doing.

"I see," $heOrShe says. "A missed opportunity. I sincerely believe that next time you'll see the efficacy of my proposal. Until then, bright stars and long burns."

You start reaching to terminate the comms. "I nearly forgot," $heOrShe says quickly, "-be sure to add me on TriLink so that I can-"

You hit the button. A moment later, you dismiss the pop-up notification on your TriPad.
entries.zh:
"啊。" 速子科技 $rank 脸上完美的微笑消失了。你捕捉到了$hisOrHer眼中正活跃的赛博植入体微光闪烁，尽管你不能确定$HeOrShe在做什么。

"我明白了，" $HeOrShe说。"真是个被错失的机会。我真诚地相信，下次您会看到我的建议的有效性。在那之前，祝您闪耀群星，航程不熄。"

你正伸手准备终止通讯。"我差点忘了，" $HeOrShe快速地说道，"—— 务必在 TriLink 上添加我，这样我就能 ——"

你按下了终止按钮。又过了一会儿，你关掉了数据平板上弹出的通知。

entries.en:
"So you're just giving $fwt_itOrThem to me?" The pirate captain still looks skeptical. "Good, I suppose. Smart move. Very economical." $heOrShe mutters while confirming the handover on a battered datapad.

"That's that then, captain. No battle, no glory..." $heOrShe looks away wistfully, "It's these new times, I tell you. All business, no adventure, why back in-"

The link is terminated on the other end without fanfare.
entries.zh:
"所以你就这么打算把 $fwt_itOrThem 给我了？" 看起来海盗船长对你的举动抱持着怀疑的态度。"我想这样也不错，明智之举，非常划算。" $HeOrShe一边在破旧的数据平板上确认交接的过程，一边在那里嘟囔着。

"那就这样吧，舰长。不用战斗，也没有荣誉可言..." $HeOrShe带着忧郁的眼神望向远方，"我想这是个全新的时代了。一切都是生意，没有任何冒险，为什么要回到 ——"

通讯被毫无预兆地从另一端切断了。

entries.en:
You shock the Pather by seeming to accept $hisOrHer words at face value. Truly, $heOrShe prays for you?

You get the Pather explaining exactly how you've stumbled into a path of sin and how you might yet be saved. You nod, serious and appearing conflicted.

Meanwhile, your fingers type out precise instructions to your operations chief.
entries.zh:
你表面上对$hisOrHer的教义信以为真，这令左径分子大感震惊。$HeOrShe这是在为你祈祷吗？当真？

你听着这位左径分子详细解释你是如何误入罪孽之路，以及如何才能得到拯救。你点着头，神情严肃，似乎内心正在挣扎。

与此同时，你用手指向行动长官敲出了精确的指令。

entries.en:
Sounding almost in tears, you make a show of repenting, accepting a transmission of Luddic Path holovids - speeches by a Brother Cotton figure prominently in the files.

"It is time," the Pather says, "To take your first step." You nod, then turn and give the order to eject $entity.fwt_theThing so that it may be cleansed in the holy vacuum.

A blip drifts across the tactical display; the Pather blasts it into a spray of exotic particles.
entries.zh:
你继续上演着你的忏悔秀，带着仿佛已经热泪盈眶了的哭腔接受了 卢德左径 的全息视频传输 —— 这些文件的图标很显眼地表明了这是 Cotton 修士的演说。

"是时候了，" 左径分子说道，"是时候迈出你的第一步了。"你点了点头，转身下令将 $entity.fwt_theThing 弹出舱外，让它能够在神圣的虚空中得到净化。

一个光点掠过了你的战术显示器，左径分子把你扔出去的东西炸成了一团奇异的粒子。

entries.en:
"Now," $heOrShe intones, closing $hisOrHer eyes "We pray."

The Pather captain transmits a classic Luddic prayer, begging forgiveness and doing least-harm to holy Creation and so on.

You terminate the comms at what feels like an appropriate moment. Next, you congratulate your ops chief on putting together a sensor-equivalent approximation of $entity.fwt_theThing on such short notice.
entries.zh:
"现在，" $HeOrShe合上眼睛吟诵着，"让我们一起祈祷。"

左径舰长念叨着经典的卢德祷文，乞求宽恕，将对神的造物的摧残降到最低限度之类。

你找了个合适的时机终止了通讯。接着，你向你的行动长官表示称赞，称赞其能从如此简短的说明里领会到你的意图，弄出了一个传感特征与 $entity.fwt_theThing 相似的东西。

entries.en:
The comms plays a catchy Tri-Tachyon jingle before the logo fades into the impeccable Tri-Tachyon $rank.

"I'm here to give you $entity.fwt_payment credits." $HeOrShe smiles, perfectly. "Got your attention? Of course, of course; it's human nature."

"However," $heOrShe holds up a hand and you note the strange affect of a ruinously expensive handmade mechanical wrist chronometer, "You shall have to give me something in return. Something I know that you have, $entity.fwt_thingDesc. A simple, fair trade. No threats, no deception, just an honest business dealing. Transfer $fwt_itOrThem to my flagship and I shall give you the credits."
entries.zh:
通讯频道播放着 速子科技 那悦耳的拨号提示音，接着他们的商标逐渐变淡，一位衣着光鲜的速子科技 $rank 出现在了你的面前。

"我来此的目的是为了交给您 $entity.fwt_payment 星币。" $HeOrShe的脸上挂着无可挑剔的微笑，"引起您的注意了？当然，当然，这是人的天性。"

"然而..." $HeOrShe举起了一只手，你注意到对方手上昂贵的机械腕表正在散发着奇怪的光效，"您必须给我一些东西作为回报，我知道您有那件东西，$entity.fwt_thingDesc。这是一场简单而公平的商业交易，没有威胁，没有欺骗，有的只是诚信。把 $fwt_itOrThem 交给我，我就会把星币给您。"

entries.en:
The comms-link crackles to life. "Greetings, starfarer!" $Rank $personName grimaces regretfully, "Bad news: you possess something my superiors desire and now you must surrender it to me."

You realize that $heOrShe is talking about $entity.fwt_thingDesc.

"Now, is this going to be easy or hard? Think, now," $heOrShe says with false charity, "But don't take too long, please."

The demand is outright robbery and any law-abiding faction would be embarrassed to condemn you for defending yourself, if you chose to do so.
entries.zh:
通讯线路闪了几下之后接通了。"你好，星际远行者！" $personName $Rank 故意做出了一副深表遗憾的扮相，"这有个坏消息：你手上有我上司想要的东西，现在你必须把它交给我。"

你意识到$heOrShe指的应该是 $entity.fwt_thingDesc。

"现在，你想怎么解决这件事呢？轻松愉快还是炮火纷飞？现在思考一下也行，" $heOrShe强装出一副客气样子，"但请不要花太长时间。"

这毫无疑问是彻头彻尾的抢劫行为，如果你选择用武器自卫，那么任何要点脸面的势力都无法指责你的作为。

o.en: Decline, close comms, and power up weapons
o.zh: 拒绝，关闭通讯，并开始给武器充能

entries.en:
"Bright stars, captain. I regret to inform you that my visit is not merely social," $heOrShe looks genuinely regretful. "I hate doing this, but I shall make it quick so that we may move on with our lives once this small awkwardness is finished."

$Rank $personName clears $hisOrHer throat, "You have something my superior wants. I'm sure you know what it is. Hand it over now and I'll give you the $entity.fwt_payment credits my employers have generously set aside for this transaction."

You realize that $heOrShe is, of course, talking about $entity.fwt_thingDesc.

$HeOrShe releases a breath, "That wasn't so bad, right? And you'll be paid for your trouble. Quite a deal." $HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer console idly, then looks up and adds "I shudder to consider having to kill you."
entries.zh:
"繁星在上，舰长。很遗憾地告诉你，我的来访可不仅仅是为了社交。" $HeOrShe看上去一脸遗憾，"我讨厌这样做，但为了度过这段小小的尴尬，让我们的生活能继续稳步向前，我得快点处理完这事。"

$personName $Rank 清了清嗓子："你有我上司想要的东西。我相信你知道我指的是什么。现在把它交出来，我会付给你 $entity.fwt_payment 星币，这是我的上司为这笔交易准备的款项。"

你意识到$HeOrShe正在说的东西是 $entity.fwt_thingDesc。

$HeOrShe吐出一口气。"还不错，对吧？你的辛苦是有回报的，毕竟我的上司提供的星币可不少。" $HeOrShe懒洋洋地在$hisOrHer的控制台上按着什么东西，然后抬起头补充道，"想到要和你开战，我还真有点害怕。"

o.en: Decline, close comms, and power up weapons
o.zh: 拒绝，关闭通讯，并开始给武器充能

o.en: Hand over $entity.fwt_theThing in exchange for a payment

entries.en:
The comms-link crackles to life. "Bright stars and steady burns, captain! It's your lucky day," $heOrShe says with a conviction you feel like you can't trust, "You've found something very special that my, ah, superiors have been looking for. They've sent me all the way out here to pay you $entity.fwt_payment credits for handing it over to me for safekeeping."

You realize that $heOrShe is talking about $entity.fwt_thingDesc.

"The cost of fuel these days, why, I'm doing you a favor." $HeOrShe pauses, then says "This is an opportunity that can profit us both. I hope you can see that."
entries.zh:
通讯线路在一阵闪动中接通了。"群星闪耀，航行不息，舰长！" $HeOrShe虽然言之坦荡，但却给你一股这人信不过的感觉，"你不久前刚找到了一件非常特别的东西。那正是我，呃，我的上司一直在寻找的。那些人大老远来地派我来这就是为了让我能用 $entity.fwt_payment 星币向你买下它。"

你意识到$HeOrShe说的东西应该是 $entity.fwt_thingDesc。

"想想最近的燃料价格。怎样？就当是我帮你跑了个腿？" $HeOrShe停顿了一下，继续说道，"这可是个能让我俩都赚一笔的好机会。我希望你能明白这一点。"

o.en: Accept the deal, and hand over $entity.fwt_theThing

entries.en:
The comm display ripples as the merc captain appears.

"Clear air and clean jumps, captain," $heOrShe greets you with a convivial nod. "I have all the respect in the Sector for you, so I'll be direct about this: you've got something my employer has hired me to acquire from you by any means necessary." The merc shrugs, non-quite apologetic, "It's a living."

You realize the $heOrShe is talking about $entity.fwt_thingDesc.

"I'll give you a minute to think it through. Be a real pity if I had to slag your flagship over a trifle." $HeOrShe then leans back in $hisOrHer chair, humming something to $himOrHerself.
entries.zh:
随着通讯图像的一阵波动，一个雇佣舰长出现在了画面当中。

"祝您空行无阻，跳跃利落，舰长！" $heOrShe友善地向你点头致敬，"向您致以星域中最崇高的敬意。接下来我就直说了：我的雇主对你手里的某件东西很感兴趣。而对方雇了我，要求我不惜一切代价从你这里拿下。" 雇佣兵耸了耸肩，还带着些问心无愧的感觉，"别惊讶，这不过是个谋生手段罢了。"

你意识到$HeOrShe提到的东西应该是 $entity.fwt_thingDesc。

"我给你一分钟考虑一下。毕竟如果我必须为了那点小事就要把你的旗舰轰成渣的话，那还真是太可惜了。" 随后，$HeOrShe便靠在了椅子上，并哼着一首不知名的小曲。

o.en: Decline, close comms, and power up weapons
o.zh: 拒绝，关闭通讯，并开始给武器充能

entries.en:
The comm display ripples as the merc captain appears, one leg up on $hisOrHer command console.

"Clear lanes and clean jumps, captain," $heOrShe greets you with a cheerful nod. "Today's your day! Some jingling mudboots paid me a stack of credits to pay you a stack of credits. $fwt_payment credits, to be exact. All you gotta do," $heOrShe takes the leg off the console and leans in to the holocomms, "Is hand over that special something what my employers desire with all their empty hearts."

You realize the $heOrShe is talking about $entity.fwt_thingDesc.

"It's all profit from here on out, captain." $HeOrShe seems quite confident that you'll betray your contract for a few credits. "I have no desire to use your flagship for target practice, no $playerSirOrMadam. Just focus on the credits."
entries.zh:
通讯图像波动了一阵子，接着一个雇佣舰长出现在了画面中，还潇洒地把一只脚搭在$hisOrHer的控制台上。

"航线通畅！跳跃顺利！舰长！" $HeOrShe带着愉快的表情向你点头致意，"多么美好的一天！但有个混蛋给了我一堆星币并想让我把它们转交给你。确切地说，$fwt_payment 星币。而你要做的..." $HeOrShe把腿从控制台上拿了下来，俯身靠向全息通信画面，"就是交出那个特别的东西，那个我的雇主们心心念念的东西。"

你意识到$HeOrShe正在说的东西是 $entity.fwt_thingDesc。

"这可是满满的利益，舰长。" $HeOrShe似乎很确信你会为了这些星币而抛弃原先的合同，"我不想用你的旗舰来练习打靶，$playerSirOrMadam。所以让我们用星币来解决吧。"

o.en: Decline, close comms, and power up weapons
o.zh: 拒绝，关闭通讯，并开始给武器充能

o.en: Accept, and hand over $entity.fwt_theThing in exchange for a payment
o.zh: 接受交易，交出 $entity.fwt_theThing 并获取报酬

entries.en:
The comm display stutters then stabilizes, the merc captain appearing before you.

"Soft burns and clear orbits, captain," $heOrShe greets you with a brilliant smile. "Let's just get one thing out of the way first: my contract explicitly rules out threat of violence. So no threats, just an offer. And if you don't take it," $heOrShe shrugs, "Well, then I don't get my bonus. So please do consider it."

"Which brings me to you. My employers would like to pay you $fwt_payment credits for something you alone have. I think," $heOrShe says coyly, "You know what it is." $entity.fwt_ThingDesc.
entries.zh:
通讯显示一开始断断续续的，过了一会才稳定下来，一个雇佣舰长出现在你面前。

"祝您航行平稳！轨道通畅！舰长，" $HeOrShe带着灿烂的笑容向你致意，"让我先澄清一件事：我的合同不允许我使用暴力威胁。所以我不会胁迫您，只能给您提建议。如果您不接受..." $HeOrShe耸耸肩，"好吧，那样我就拿不到奖金了。所以请您务必考虑一下。"

"我来到这里的目的呢，是代我的雇主用 $fwt_payment 星币从您那里买一个东西。我想..." $HeOrShe看起来有些难以启齿，"您应该知道我说的是什么。" 你当然知道对方指的是 $entity.fwt_ThingDesc。

o.en: Accept the deal, and hand over $entity.fwt_theThing

entries.en:
The comms flicker with snow, and as the $faction $rank begins to speak you realize it's due to ill-maintained equipment of the Pather flagship.

"The blessed Path led me to you. Will you suffer the hammer and the sword? Or will you repent - by surrendering $entity.fwt_theThing, which you carry to no good end?"

"Don't think me a mere fanatic, captain," $heOrShe says. "I pray for heretic and apostate alike each day, and I pray now that I may destroy $entity.fwt_TheThing in cleansing vacuum rather the hellfire-death of your flagship. Accept my mercy."
entries.zh:
通讯伴随着大量的噪点和不稳定的闪烁，当 $faction $rank 开始说话时，你意识到这是由于左径旗舰的设备维护不当。

"受祝的道途指引我来到你身边。你是愿受剑与锤的苦难？还是就此悔过，交出引你走入歧途的 $entity.fwt_theThing？"

"不要认为我疯狂，舰长。" $HeOrShe说，"我每日为异端和叛教者祈祷，正如现在，我祈祷着我能于神圣的虚空中毁灭 $entity.fwt_TheThing，而非让你的旗舰在升腾于地狱的烈火中陨落。接受我的怜悯吧。"

o.en: Bluff to get rid of the Pather
o.zh: 虚张声势以摆脱左径分子

entries.en:
The display flickers with holo-snow before resolving into a swaggering pirate captain.

"Ah look at you there, what a fine $shipOrFleet. A little birdie told me you have $fwt_thingDesc and come next shift I'm going to be the one a-holding $fwt_itOrThem. Do you see my meaning, captain? It'd be a crying shame if anything happened to your fine $shipOrFleet."

$HeOrShe pretends to be pondering deeply, "Now, 'way I see this going, are you gonna make the smart choice and hand $fwt_itOrThem over all peaceful-like, or are you gonna be sucking vacuum after I blow your $shipOrFleet out of orbit? Think, now, think."
entries.zh:
显示器投影着大量的全息噪点，等到它变清晰后，你看到了一个趾高气昂的海盗舰长。

"啊，看看你带领的$shipOrFleet，非常漂亮，不是吗？有个小道消息告诉我现在你手上有 $fwt_thingDesc，但是在下个星历日，我就会成为持有 $fwt_itOrThem 的人了。你明白我的意思吗，舰长？如果你的$shipOrFleet遭遇了不幸，那就太令人惋惜了。"

$HeOrShe装模作样地深思熟虑起来："现在我就在这里等着。你是会做出明智的决定，友好地把 $fwt_itOrThem 交给我呢？还是等我把你的$shipOrFleet炸出轨道后，在真空中挣扎呢？好好想想吧。"

o.zh: 拒绝，关闭通讯，并开始给武器充能

entries.en:
Your stare bores into the pirate like twin tachyon lances as you bellow your words, "You dare claim property of the Warlord Kanta?"

The blood drains from the pirate captain's face. "She... but... by, stars and blood. Captain, please accept my apologies! I would never... she doesn't need to hear of this, isn't that right? Please- please accept a token of $fwt_piratePayment credits for this unfortunate delay."

$HeOrShe is almost pleading now, "So, captain. Captain, you won't mention this little incident?"
entries.zh:
你瞪着海盗，目光凶狠得就如同你正在用内置于双眼中的速子长矛在对方身上挖洞，同时你怒吼出的话恶狠狠地敲击着对方："你竟然敢宣称自己拥有军阀 Kanta 的资产？"

海盗舰长顿时面无血色。"她！但是...繁星和...和鲜血在上。舰长，请接受我的道歉！我永远不会...她不需要知道这些琐事，对吧？请 —— 请接受我微不足道的 $fwt_piratePayment 星币，来弥补因我的愚蠢造成的耽误。"

$HeOrShe现在几乎是在恳求，"所以，舰长。舰长，您应该不会向别人提起这微不足道的不愉快对吧？"

entries.en:
The pirate nods grimly, "Yes... yes of course." $HeOrShe studies you, attempting to divine if you'll tell Kanta of $hisOrHer transgression.

And if so, what steps might be taken to change one's name and appearance. Then, perhaps, the wisdom of crewing on a long salvage expedition on the fringe of the Persean Sector far, far away from anyone with the name 'Kanta'.

You take this cue to terminate the comms and roll your eyes at the pirate's cowardice.
entries.zh:
海盗恐惧地点了点头："对，是的...当然了。" $HeOrShe仔细地看着你，揣测着你是否会将$hisOrHer的罪过告诉 Kanta。

海盗舰长思索着，如果你真的上报了此事，那应该如何更名改姓呢？那之后，在远离任何一个名叫 "Kanta" 的人的外围星域当一个拾荒远征队的船员或许是明智的选择。

你趁着这个间隙切断了通讯，并对海盗舰长的懦弱不屑地翻了个白眼。

o.zh: 询问与 Galatia 学院有关的事

o.en: Request a meeting with the provost

entries.en:
"Ah, it comes to be now. A recent member, are you not?"

His expression is pleasant, though reserved.

"Allow me to wish you welcome to the Persean League. Do you come to me regarding some matter to be raised in the League Council?"
entries.zh:
"啊，原来是这么回事。你是新近加入的成员，对吗？"

他神情愉快，但带着拘谨。

"请允许我欢迎你加入英仙座联盟。你来找我是为了在联盟理事会上提出某项议题吗？"

o.en: I'm here on behalf of Provost Baird, in fact.
o.zh: 事实上，我是代表 Baird 院长而来。

entries.en:
"Ah, it comes to me now. A recent member, are you not?"

Then he frowns.

"And I recall now, you had some involvement in... you are an associate of my cousin Menes, I believe."
entries.zh:
"啊，我现在想起来了。你是新近加入的成员，对吗？"

随即他皱起眉头。

"我现在记起来了，你曾牵涉到...我想你是我表弟 Menes 的合作伙伴。"

o.en: I wouldn't say I'm an associate. We had only a passing acquaintance.
o.zh: 谈不上是合作伙伴，我们只有一面之缘。

o.en: I cleaned up the mess he made with the Church, yes. Someone had to.
o.zh: 我确实收拾了他在教会留下的烂摊子，总得有人去处理。

o.en: I'm here on behalf of Provost Baird, in fact.
o.zh: 事实上，我是代表 Baird 院长而来。

entries.en:
"Passing. I see." He re-examines you. "To your credit."

"Allow me to wish you welcome to the Persean League. Do you come to me regarding some matter to be raised in the League Council?"
entries.zh:
"一面之缘，我明白了。" 他重新审视着你，"值得称道。"

"请允许我欢迎你加入英仙座联盟。你来找我是为了在联盟理事会上提出某项议题吗？"

entries.en:
"Of course." He blinks.

Horus quite intentionally leaves it at that. No apology, no thanks.
entries.zh:
"当然。" 他眨了眨眼。

Horus 刻意就此打住。没有歉意，也没有谢意。

entries.en:
"Yer'll get it now!" the pirate shouts, and turns to $hisOrHer crew "Make for combat!"

The link flickers and terminates as the pirate's electronic warfare matrix comes online.
entries.zh:
"那就来打吧！" 海盗大喊着看向$hisOrHer船员 "准备打仗！"

随着海盗的电子反制系统上线，通讯链接开始闪烁，随后便被切断了。

entries.en:
"Watch yourself, speaking that name," one old ore-pusher tells you, taking a long draw from your gifted drink. "I know folk who crossed him and they ended up dead. He's got eyes and ears everywhere. Clever enough to bend the tech-bans to his advantage, ya'know. Most true believers? Cowards pulling a con or got their brains adrift - not him though, no; he's made the Path his own and knows how to use it."

"Welp," he finishes the drink with one long gulp, "This'll be you then," and scuttles off just as a trio of burly thugs in mining guild uniforms approach.
entries.zh:
"说出那个名字的时候你得悠着点，" 一个年迈的矿石商人告诉你，并拿起你赠送的饮品长饮了一口。"据我所知，那些辱骂他的人，最后都死了。他到处都有耳目。他足够聪明，能将科技禁令玩弄于股掌之中。大多数真正的信徒们？这些胆小鬼们被哄骗或是放空大脑 —— 但他可不一样，他已经完全掌控了左径并且知道如何利用它。"

"好了，" 他一大口喝完了饮品，"只能和你说这么多了。"然后他快步离开，这时三个穿着采矿协会制服的魁梧暴徒靠近过来。

o.en: Evening, friends. Next round on me?
o.zh: 晚上好，朋友们。我再请一轮？

o.en: Any of you happen to know Brother Cotton?
o.zh: 你们中有谁恰好认识 Cotton 修士吗？

o.en: Looks like I was just leaving...
o.zh: 看来我正好需要离开了...

entries.en:
"We reject the gilt bribery of Mammon," says one of the heavies, spitting at your feet. The others look similarly uninterested in your offer.

"What's our brother's good name doing in the mouth of this heretic?" the first one says to the others, "Might be we have to remove it ourselves."
entries.zh:
"我们拒绝恶魔玛门的金钱贿赂。" 其中一个打手说着，并向你的脚上吐了一口。其他人看起来一样对你提供的金钱不感兴趣。

"我们修士的好名声在这个异端口中变成了什么样？" 第一个人对其他人说，"看来我们需要亲自消除影响了。"

o.en: I'm here to talk. Cotton will know me.
o.zh: 我是来谈谈的。Cotton 会认识我。

o.en: And here I thought Ludd taught a religion of peace.
o.zh: 我以为卢德教是一个和平的宗教。
简单地向你的保镖点点头

entries.en: "What's Brother Cotton's good name doing in the mouth of this heretic?" the biggest one says to the others, "Might be we have to remove it ourselves."
entries.zh: "Cotton 修士的好名声在这个异端口中变成了什么样？" 个头最大的人对其他人说，"看来我们需要亲自消除影响了。"

o.en: Just tell Cotton I'm here. I'll wait.
o.zh: 就告诉 Cotton 我在这里。我会等着。
简单地向你的保镖点点头

entries.en:
One of the heavies puts an arm out to stop you, prompting your guards - unobtrusively hovering in the shadows - to step forward, ready to draw weapons.

The moment seems to freeze- the proprietor stops polishing a glass, the conversation two tables over goes quiet, and fearful eyes all turn toward the confrontation.
entries.zh:
其中一个暴徒举起手来拦住你，你躲在暗处的保镖们带着一副剑拔弩张的气势怼上了前去。

这一刻似乎凝固了 —— 店主停住了手中擦杯子的活儿，两桌客人间的谈话戛然而止，人们用慌张的眼神注视着这场对峙。

o.en: I meant no offense. I just wish to see your boss.
o.zh: 我没有恶意。我就是想见一下你们老大。

o.en: Mind yourself- I can have this place razed from orbit with a word.
o.zh: 小心点 —— 我一句话就能从轨道上把这里夷为平地。

entries.en:
You begin with the time-honored conversation-starter of buying strangers a round 'to celebrate a good haul'.

It is a hard sell here; off-worlders drink their vices furtively to maintain a thin veneer of Luddic deniability. You focus instead on the unbelieving Epiphany natives who regularly work with starfarers. Casually inquiring about import-export business opportunities, understood by all to be a roundabout pitch for a smuggling job, you ask, by the way, have you heard of a 'Brother Cotton'?

Invoking this name kills conversations like an EMP. One table mumbles excuses and leaves their untouched drinks, fearful that you're an informer, an enormous fool, or both.
entries.zh:
你用由来已久的惯常方式开启话题，向陌生人们请一轮，来庆祝一次大丰收。

在这里这很难奏效；外地人都默默喝着自己的劣酒，以简单地掩饰自己对卢德教的否认。你作为代替选择关注那些经常与远行者做生意的 Epiphany 不信教的本地人。你随便地问起一些关于进出口贸易的机会，所有人都了解这是关于走私工作的委婉表达。然后，你顺便问了起来，你们听说过 'Cotton 修士' 吗？

提起这个名字就像扔了一枚 EMP 炸弹一样破坏了这场对话。整张桌子上都在嘟哝着找借口离开，留下他们还没有碰触的饮品在原地。他们担心你是一个告密者，或是一个超级大傻瓜，或者两者都是。

entries.en:
Several emotions cross Coureuse's face all at once.

"Um. Captain. All science is..." She sighs, "No, I can't do this."
entries.zh:
Coureuse 的表情五味杂陈。

"呃。舰长。所有的科学都伴随着..." 她长叹一口气，"不，还是算了。"

entries.en:
"Look. The provost told me what to tell you and not tell you. She was very clear about her objections to my... attitude. About questioning her leadership. And here I am, at the Galatia Academy. The Hegemony still has a warrant out for my arrest. To say nothing of the League, or, Ludd help me, the Pathers."

"She's got me," Coureuse says.

She takes another deep breath before looking back into the holodisplay.
entries.zh:
"你看，院长嘱咐我，对你要有所说有所不说。她明显不喜欢我的态度，质疑她的领导地位的态度。但我只能呆在 Galatia 学院。霸主 还有一份针对我的有效逮捕令。更不用说 英仙座联盟 和，卢德保佑，那些左径分子了。"

"她抓住了我的把柄，" Coureuse 说道。

她再次深呼吸，然后又重新盯着全息显示屏。

entries.en:
"I wouldn't send you out with this prototype if I thought for sure it was a, a, a deathtrap or something. That's all I can say."

She looks down and reaches to terminate the comm link, hesitates. "And um, good luck?"
entries.zh:
"如果我完全确定这个原型装置是个，是个，是个死亡陷阱，或者是什么类似的东西的话，我是不会把它交给你的。我只能说这么多了。"

她犹豫着要不要切断通讯链接。"最后，呃，祝你好运？"

o.en: Should I be worried about this Janus prototype?
o.zh: 我应该对这'双面神'感到担心吗？

entries.en:
Baird slams her hand on the console, terminating the link.

Her personal comms chime, then chime again. She picks it up. "Speak."
entries.zh:
Baird 把手拍在控制台上，终止了通讯。

她的个人通讯响起，但她没有接。在第二次响起时，她才拿起设备，"说。"

entries.en:
She listens for a moment, then clicks off the comms without replying.

Her hand trembling, she removes her spectacles, and you hear a small snap.
entries.zh:
她安静地听了一会，一言不发地挂掉了通讯。

她用颤抖的手摘下了眼镜，你听见一声轻微的脆响。

entries.en:
She turns away, body rigid.

"Have you a knife for me too, captain?"
entries.zh:
她转过身，用僵硬的背影对着你。

"我们的关系也到此为止了吗，舰长？"

entries.en: "Don't waste my air on sentiment," Baird spits. "You are clearly not the foremost hyperspace theoretician in the Persean Sector."
entries.zh: "别在感伤上浪费我的口舌，" Baird 怒斥道。"你明显不是英仙座星域最著名的超空间理论学家。"

entries.en: "No," she answers, gazing out the window.
entries.zh: "的确。" 她凝望着窗外，回答道。

entries.en:
Baird stares out the window, broken spectacles dangling from her hand.

An opened Gate, your $shipOrFleet poised triumphant in flight from the cascading hyper-vortices of its great maw, spins slowly and silently from the holoprojector.
entries.zh:
Baird 盯着窗外，坏掉的眼镜在她手上无力地晃着。

星门开启，你的$shipOrFleet穿过仿若无底洞的级联超涡流，昂扬飞出。全息投影仪映射出的景象里，只剩下那漩涡安静旋转的模样。

o.en: It looks like my work here is done.
o.zh: 看来我的工作就到此为止了。

o.en: You got what you wanted, didn't you?
o.zh: 你得到了自己想要的，不是吗？

o.en: I truly believe in your project. I would not betray you.
o.zh: 我是真心看好你的方案。我不会背叛你的。

o.en: History doesn't always turn out the way you expected.
o.zh: 看来历史并不总是像你预期的那样发展。

o.en: 'You reap what you sow.' Didn't Ludd say that?
o.zh: '种因得果。' 卢德不是这么说过吗？
好了。说说关于报酬的事。

entries.en: She sighs. "Sebestyen," she says wearily. "Will handle it."
entries.zh: 她叹了一口气。"Sebestyen，" 她疲惫地说道。"会处理这方面的问题。"

entries.en:
For a moment, Baird says nothing. Then, with the scorn of raw, biting vacuum-

"Get out."
entries.zh:
好一阵子，Baird 都没有开口。直到她用如同真空般阴森刺骨的语气说道 ——

"滚出去。"

entries.en: Baird turns slowly to give you a look. Her eyes are red. She turns back to the window.
entries.zh: Baird缓缓转身看了你一眼。她的双眼发红。接着又转向了窗外。

entries.en: "Yes," says Baird without emotion.
entries.zh: "是的，" Baird 面无表情说道。

entries.en:
The heavy wooden doors give at your touch, and you step through, surprising the guards in mirror-faced helmets. The waiting room of courtiers eyes you spitefully. What business does some upstart rocket jockey have that's more important than securing their legacy?

* * *

You step through the airlock doors into the shuttle bay, the very stars at your fingertips.
entries.zh:
沉重的木门在轻触之下自动敞开，你缓步走出，惊动了外面头盔光鲜如镜的警卫。等候室里的政客们用鄙夷又不屑的目光看着你。他们只觉得好奇，这个看似刚上道的毛头小子，能有什么更重要的事情，比他们自己的利益事项还来得更优先？

* * *

你穿过气闸门走入了穿梭机停机坪，星空触手可及。

entries.en:
"Provost... oh." His face falls.

"This must be about- I mean, tell me, whatever is this about?"

Now you've got his full attention.
entries.zh:
"院长... 哦。" 他的脸色沉了下来。

"这一定是关于... 呃，不如你告诉我，来和我谈话是为了什么？"

他的注意力现在完全回到你身上了。

o.en: I need diplomatic credentials from you. I need to talk to High Hegemon Daud.
o.zh: 我需要你的外交证件，我要和至高霸主 Daud 谈谈。

o.en: The provost has a message, if you're ready to hear it.
o.zh: 院长让我带了一封口信，不知你是否准备好听了。

entries.en:
"What?" he says, incredulous. "The High Hegemon? Why should- oh, the... situation. I see."

Ah, now there's that look of resignation you've come to expect from those being blackmailed by the provost.

"Yes, of course. Provost Baird," he says. "I expect she's provided you with a message for me?"
entries.zh:
"什么？" 他难以置信。"和至高霸主本人？为什么是我 —— 哦，是因为... 那件事。我明白了。"

啊，现在你终于看到了那种认命般的表情，你已经习惯在那些被院长敲诈的人脸上看到这样的表情了。

"是啊，当然了。那 Baird 院长，" 他说。"我猜她应该给了你一条转交给我的口信吧？"

o.zh: 发送 Baird 录制的信息

entries.en:
He thinks about it.

That look of resignation you've come to know from those being blackmailed by the provost comes across his face, and you know it's already worked.

"Send it," he says softly.
entries.zh:
他开始沉思。

你已经习惯在那些被院长敲诈的人脸上看到那种认命般的表情了，而这种表情正浮现在他的脸上，你就知道这招管用了。

"发过来吧，" 他轻声说道。

o.zh: 发送 Baird 录制的信息

entries.en:
The comm line clicks to a holding pattern displaying the crest of Gens Yaribay, an elegant piscine motif echoing the Persean League's colors.

You watch Kazeron commodity futures scroll through the bottom of the display. After a couple of minutes catching up on bulk non-ferrous projections, the comm display chimes.

Horus reappears, looking somewhat more collected.

"Captain. $playerName, was it? Yes of course. Provost Baird explained her proposal and I do believe that we may arrive at a mutually beneficial arrangement."
entries.zh:
通讯线路被切换至等候界面，显示出 Yaribay 氏族的徽标，那是一枚优雅的鱼形纹样，呼应着英仙座联盟的代表色。

屏幕下方滚动着的是 Kazeron 的期货行情。你看了好几分钟的大宗有色金属走势预测后，通讯器响了起来。

Horus 重新出现在显示屏上，神色看起来比刚才镇定了几分。"舰长 $playerName，是吗？没错，正是。Baird 院长解释了她的提案，我认为我们可以达成一次对双方都有利的安排。"

entries.en:
"You shall receive Yaribay diplomatic credentials," he says.

"Mind yourself well with these, captain. If you were to commit some untoward scheme using the good name of Gens Yaribay, we would declare the cryptokey stolen. And then, well, it need not be said that any decent authority would treat with you... appropriately."

Horus clears his throat, keen to move on from the topic.
entries.zh:
"我会给你你想要的 Yaribay 外交证件，" 他说道。

"但你最好用在正途上，舰长。要是你敢打着 Yaribay 氏族的名号搞些小动作，我们会宣布你持有的密钥是偷来的，之后任何正当机构都会知道该如何... 妥善处治你。"

Horus 清了清嗓子，意在换个更愉快的话题。

o.en: Of course. You have nothing to worry about.
o.zh: 当然了。你没有什么可担心的。

o.en: I don't need to be reminded to follow the rules.
o.zh: 用不着你提醒我遵守规矩。

entries.en:
"Naturally." He looks around uncomfortably. "I trust Baird's... good judgment. Naturally."

"Now, I know not what ruse the provost is pursuing. But if indeed you establish a line of communication directly and privately to the High Hegemon," a small smile appears on Horus' face, "That would be splendid."

"For my half of this arrangement requires the delivery of comms encryption codes to our friend Baikal Daud. One mustn't have COMINT snooping on important negotiations, yes? So do see that done."
entries.zh:
"那是自然。" Horus 局促不安地环顾四周。"我相信 Baird 看人... 不会看错。自然如此。"

"眼下，我不知道院长在打什么如意算盘。但如果你真能成功和至高霸主本人建立一条直接而私人的联络渠道，" Horus 的脸上浮现出一丝微笑，"那就再好不过了。"

"因为我的那一半安排的要求，就是把通讯加密代码交到我们的朋友，Baikal Daud 的手上。毕竟，重要的谈判可不能让 COMINT 偷听，对吧？所以务必把这事办妥。"

entries.en: Horus looks as if he is about to speak, but holds himself for a second, then thinks better of it.
entries.zh: Horus 像是话到嘴边，却顿了一瞬，转念又咽了回去。

entries.en:
"He'd be a fool not to," Horus says.

"We offer a peaceful solution to the League-Hegemony conflict that would profit all. Daud may be hive-scum, but he's clever. Practical. To pull himself out of that hole on Chicomoztoc he must be a man who understands the compromises one must make to survive."

"In fact, I admire the man," says Horus Yaribay, seeming to surprise himself. "Despite his beginnings. I believe he will accept a compromise that allows us to keep what makes our League great. What does it matter the flag we live under?"
entries.zh:
"他不会傻到拒绝的，"Horus 轻蔑地说。

"我们针对联盟-霸主双边冲突提出的和平解决方案对双方都有好处。Daud 或许只是个巢区混混，但至少他很聪明。老实说，既然能从 Chicomoztoc 的贫民窟走到现在的地位，他一定也懂得人必须作出妥协才能求得生存的道理。"

"其实我还挺欣赏这个人的，"Horus Yaribay 说道，好像自己吃了一惊似的。"虽然他的出身并不显赫。我相信他会接受这个妥协，它能让 英仙座联盟 不至于失去那些让我们变得伟大的东西。我们高举的是谁的旗帜，又有什么关系呢？"

o.en: I'll be sure to put in a good word for you with the Hegemon.
o.zh: 我一定会为你说几句好话的。

o.en: It seems to matter to lots of people. Otherwise we wouldn't have flags.
o.zh: 看起来对不少人来说还是有关系的。不然我们就用不着旗帜了。

o.en: Does this compromise involve you retaining the wealth of gens Yaribay?
o.zh: Yaribay 氏族将会保留自己的财富，也是这项妥协的一部分吗？

entries.en: Horus smiles. "Excellent. I thank you."
entries.zh: Horus 微笑，"很好。谢谢你。"

entries.en:
"I appreciate the offer, captain. Truly I do."

Horus smiles somewhat uncomfortably.

"But given your history with the Hegemony... I'm not certain Daud will accept your, ah, good word in quite the spirit that we might hope for."
entries.zh:
"多谢你的好意，舰长。真心实意的。"

Horus 笑得有些不自在。

"只是你和霸主那段旧账摆在那儿... 我拿不准 Daud 会不会照咱们盼的那个意思，领你这份，呃，美言。"

entries.en:
Horus looks aside, considering.

"I suppose. But the masses can be swayed. They are fickle. And, ultimately, they will do what they must."
entries.zh: Horus 低头沉思。"大概吧。但是群众可以被操控。他们很善变。而且，到头来，他们只能被迫接受。"

entries.en:
Horus narrows his eyes.

"Indeed. And by necessity. The permission of the elite is essential for peaceful political change. I need not justify my position to you; the argument is one of practicality, and it stands self-evident."
entries.zh: Horus 眯起眼，"的确是。而且有这个必要。精英阶层的同意对和平的政治演变来说是必不可少的。我不用向你证明我的立场，这是基于实际情况的论断，而且也确实站得住脚。"

entries.en:
"Assimilation of the League worlds is Hegemony policy and an obvious condition of their reconstruction of the Domain, to say nothing of the foundation of their claim to legitimacy."

You get the sense that he is repeating an argument he has made many times before.

"Publicly the Hegemony's demand is 'unconditional'. How can they ask that, after Mayasura? They must compromise."

"But I understand their position. They maintain a hard face to buoy support from the masses and lower officers. And," he shakes his head once, "The Luddic Church, in its way."
entries.zh:
"对联盟管辖的星球进行同化是霸主的政策之一，也是他们重建人之领的计划中不可或缺的一环，不过他们合法性的基石就另当别论了。"

Horus 看向一边，你感觉到他是在重复某个之前多次提出的论点，"公开的说法是，霸主 的要求是 '无条件的'。在 Mayasura 的事情之后，他们还能继续这样做吗？他们必须妥协。"

"但我能理解他们为什么这样做。他们维持着坚强的外表，以赢得群众和下级军官的支持，再加上，" 他摇了一下头，"卢德教会也有自己的考量。"

entries.en:
"The top leaders of the Hegemony, particularly High Hegemon Baikal Daud must see things more clearly than they let on. They understand that they must hold the banner high and speak of iron resolve to the bloody end - right up until the moment they can present their people with a great victory: peaceful reconciliation. Victory without war. Imagine!"
