He looks suddenly self-conscious. "I apologize, captain. My eldest does tell me I have a way of carrying on, and it is not untrue."
entries.zh:
"霸主的高级领导人，尤其是至高霸主 Baikal Daud，看待问题的眼光一定比他们明面上的表现更加透彻。他们心里清楚，他们必须高举旗帜，宣称要以钢铁般的决心血战到底 —— 直到他们能为自己的人民献上一场伟大胜利的那一刻：和平和解。不战而胜。想想吧！"

他好像突然意识到了自己在说什么。"我向你抱歉，舰长。我的长子总说我止不住长篇大论，他说的确实不假。"

entries.en:
"Perhaps not. Not yet among the great gens of Kazeron, where it matters. Gens Hannan would have us head an empire, another Sindria. Meanwhile Gens Kato attempts to build bridges with the other League worlds. While I respect their accomplishments, they take anti-Luddic sentiment down to the level of rabble-rousing fanaticism."

"Besides, what other world in the League can match the might of Kazeron? Our stable of allies is anemic. Were it to come to total war, stars forbid, I think the Hegemony would prevail." He looks troubled, "And then the jackals would tear our vulnerable worlds apart. I fear the Persean Sector could not recover from a second Collapse."

"This is the only way. I hope you agree, captain."
entries.zh:
"也许你是对的。至少和 Kazeron 的几大氏族相比来说不受欢迎，这才是最关键的。Hannan 氏族会领着我们走向帝国之路，变成第二个辛达。而 Kato 氏族则注重与其他英仙座联盟的星球增进关系。虽然我很敬佩他们的成就，但他们将反卢德情绪推向了煽动暴民式的狂热。"

"另一方面，联盟里的哪个世界能比肩 Kazeron 的力量？我们稳定的盟友屈指可数。如果事态演变成全面战争的话，群星在上啊，我觉得霸主一定会获胜。" 他看起来心烦意乱，"然后这些恶狼会把我们弱不禁风的世界们一个个撕碎的。若真是那样，恐怕英仙座星域是没法从另一次 '大崩塌' 中恢复过来了。"

"这是唯一的办法。我希望你也是这么想的，舰长。"

o.en: I try not to get involved in local politics.
o.zh: 我希望尽量避免掺和进你们的政治。
的确。这是个崇高的目标。

o.en: This Sector hasn't done much for me lately.
o.zh: 我最近就没在这片星域里过过几天好日子。

entries.en: "You can't stand on the line forever, captain," he says. "Someday you'll have to choose."
entries.zh: "你不可能一直骑墙来左右逢源，舰长，" 他说道。"总有一天你要选边站的。"

entries.en: "I'm glad to hear that, captain," he says. "Maybe you can do some good- beginning with High Hegemon Daud."
entries.zh: "很高兴听到你这么说，舰长，" 他说道，"也许你也可以出一份力 —— 就从至高霸主 Daud 开始吧。"

entries.en: "I am sorry to hear that, captain," he says. "I hope whatever comes of your mission, whatever it is, it changes your mind on the matter."
entries.zh: "很遗憾听到你这么说，舰长，" 他说。"我希望你这次任务的回报，不论它到底是什么，能够改变你的看法。"

o.en: How can you be sure the High Hegemon wants to talk to you?
o.zh: 你怎么能如此确定至高霸主会想和你谈话？

o.en: Do you really believe the League can reconcile with the Hegemony?
o.zh: 你真的相信联盟能和霸主和解吗？

o.en: I don't imagine the Yaribay outlook is popular on Kazeron.
o.zh: 我猜 Yaribay 氏族的意向在 Kazeron 上应该不怎么受欢迎吧。

o.en: I'm off to see the High Hegemon.
o.zh: 我该去见见至高霸主了。

entries.en:
"Yes, do I know you?" Horus Yaribay asks impatiently, his attention clearly elsewhere.

"Have we business?"
entries.zh: "你好，我们认识吗？" Horus Yaribay 不耐烦地问道，他的注意力显然集中在别处。"你想谈什么生意？"

o.en: Explain that you are acting as Provost Baird's representative
o.zh: 解释你是作为 Baird 院长的代表前来

o.en: I am $playerName, a demarchon of the League.

entries.en:
The main bridge is a hive of activity, with additional officers brought in to coordinate the assaults by tactical teams on the strongholds of Cotton's Pathers. A volley of quick orbital strikes from your $shipOrFleet disrupt power and communications, leaving planetside comms-chatter a confused staticky buzz of automated alerts and hand-equipment operators speaking in code.

Your part is simple now: let the marines do their work while you provide orbital cover for the extraction shuttles.

Displays flicker with vidfeed, a live order-of-battle chart ticks off nodes as casualties tick up. You watch, and wait for your raiders to return.
entries.zh:
主舰桥如同巢区般活跃了起来，更多的军官被召集进来配合战术小组发动对 Cotton 左径据点的袭击。你的$shipOrFleet投射出一连串疾速的轨道打击中断了供电和通讯，使得星球附近的通讯频道中只剩下充斥着静电干扰的自动警报声乱成一团，以及使用手持通讯设备的操作员之间用加密代码交流的声音。

现在你要做的事很简单：为撤离穿梭机们提供轨道支援火力掩护的同时，让陆战队员们完成他们的任务。

回传的实时影像闪烁不定，即时战局指挥图上的战术要点被逐一保全，但伤亡也在不断攀升。你看着这一切，等待着你的突击队凯旋。

entries.en: You meet the successful extraction team in the shuttle bay. The smell of vacuum and combat fills your nose: burnt, acrid, and metallic.
entries.zh: 你在穿梭机舱里会见了得手的营救小组。真空与战斗的气息扑面而来：那是灼烧，辛辣和金属的气味。

entries.en:
A couple marines in power armor undersuits escort Clone Loke into your custody. He looks around curiously. Seeing you, he stops, makes a bland, lopsided smile, and says "Ludd blesses you, friend."

You have him escorted to the brig for safekeeping.

Your personal comms starts buzzing; scattered planetary defenses are starting to activate. Tactical reports a tentative radar sweep from some kind of ground battery.
entries.zh:
两个穿着动力装甲的陆战队员押送着克隆人 Loke 来到你的关押室。他好奇地环顾四周。看到你，他停了下来，温和地斜着嘴笑着，说："愿卢德保佑你，我的朋友。"

你把他押进牢房看管。

你的个人通讯器响了起来，分散的行星防御系统开始启动。战术军官报告称某些地面炮台进行了试探性的雷达扫描。

o.en: Nav, get us out of here.
o.zh: 领航官，带我们离开这里。

entries.en:
You convene your senior officers to discuss the option of seizing the Loke clone from Brother Cotton's forces. SIGINT is spotty due to Pathers' low-tech operations and HUMINT nearly impossible due to their fanaticism. Nonetheless, your officers have identified several possible fortified compounds connected with Cotton's sect.

Any attack on Cotton will be viewed by Pathers as an attack on all. Once the shooting starts you anticipate security forces to activate planet-wide, so this has to be a quick operation. Hitting Cotton's strongholds all at once in a surprise raid will require many marine squads, but it will ensure the greatest odds of finding the Loke clone.
entries.zh:
你召集你的上级军官们商议从 Cotton 的军队那里夺走 Loke 克隆人的选项。由于左径的低科技指挥方式，通讯嗅探只能获得些许零星的情报。而在他们的狂热之下，人员渗透也是几乎不可能。尽管如此，你的军官仍然找出了几个可能的与 Cotton 的教派相联系的加强监狱。

任何对于 Cotton 的攻击都会被左径们看作对他们全体的攻击。一旦射击开始，你估计整个星球的守备力量都会被激活，因此这必须是一次快速的行动。一次性劫掠 Cotton 的各个据点需要很多陆战队，但这可以确保找到 Loke 克隆人。

entries.en:
Your shuttle approaches the naval shipyard in Chicomoztoc orbit. The planet spins below you like a murky brown ocean.

A Hegemony patrol pings your shuttle as the superstructure of the naval dockyard grows like the ribs of some genemod leviathan. The visitor passkey satisfies the patrol's inquiry, and they maneuver toward the next transport on approach.

The landing bay still bears the faded logo of Bhilai Astra Group, a Domain-era manufacturer of heavy weapons and a key supplier to the 200th Legion. It looks like a post-Collapse fragment of the corporation has taken over this asset and now contracts exclusively to the Hegemony Navy.
entries.zh:
穿梭机接近了 Chicomoztoc 轨道上的这座海军船坞。在你脚下旋转着的这颗行星看起来好像一片浑浊的，棕色的海洋。

在你感叹这座船坞的上层建筑看上去像是某种经基因改造巨兽的肋骨一样时，一支 霸主 巡逻队注意到了你。你的访客密码通过了巡逻队的认证，他们转而靠近下一艘接近中的运输船。

登陆台附近还能看到已经褪色的比莱空间集团的标志，这个集团是 人之领 时期的一家重武器制造商，同时也是第 200 军团的主要供货商。看上去在大崩塌后，这家公司的一支残部接管了这处设施，他们现在只和 霸主 海军签订合同。

entries.en:
Daud raises an eyebrow. "Huh. Didn't expect an idealist."

He reverses and hefts the bottle, like a practice swing, and smiles. "Here's to hope then."
entries.zh:
Daud 扬了扬眉毛。"哈。没想到你还是个理想主义者。"

他翻转并举起酒瓶，像是在练习挥动它一样，然后笑着说。"那就敬希望一杯。"

entries.en:
"I get it," Daud says. "The name is for the Hegemony. All the people in it. The Propaganda Ministry has a list of these they come up with. It's not really intended for you."

Daud considers something, frowning, "Or me. And yet..."

He reverses and hefts the bottle ironically, like a practice swing.
entries.zh:
"我能理解，" Daud 说。"这个名字是为了 霸主 而取的。为了所有人。宣传部还有一大堆这种名字。这名字本来就不是为你而取的。"

Daud 思索了一下，皱了皱眉，"也不是为我取的。然而..."

他略带讽刺地翻转并举起酒瓶，像是在练习挥动它一样。

entries.en:
Daud doesn't move, just thinks for a moment. "No, not a poet. A thug, a heavy. A warrior perhaps? Is that what Anahita Baird thinks you are?"

He reverses and hefts the bottle, like a practice swing.

"Maybe she'll be in for a surprise," he says with a shrug.
entries.zh:
Daud 没有动，只是略加思考。"不，你不像是个诗人。更像个暴徒，重磅打手之类的。要么是个战士？Anahita Baird 是这样看你的吗？"

他翻转并举起酒瓶，像是在练习挥动它一样。

"或许这会让她大吃一惊呢，" 他耸耸肩说道。

entries.en:
"Probably," he says with a frown. "The name is for the Hegemony. All the people, you know. The Propaganda Ministry has a list of these things. It's not really intended for you." Daud considers, "Or me. And yet..."

He reverses and hefts the bottle, like a practice swing. "Here's to hope," he says ironically.
entries.zh:
"可能吧，" 他皱了皱眉说，"这名字是为 霸主 取的。为了所有人，你懂吧。像这样的名字，宣传部还有一大堆呢。这名字本来就不是为你而取的。" Daud 思索了一下，"也不是为我取的。然而..."

他翻转并举起酒瓶，像是在练习挥动它一样。"敬希望，" 他略带讽刺地说。

entries.en:
Daud sets the bottle down.

"You're here to tell me our new provost wants to renew the old deal. She'll have to make additional concessions, isn't that right? I suppose you'll want to provide me with the details."

He taps his datapad, opening a channel for you to upload the relevant material Baird provided.
entries.zh:
Daud 放下酒瓶。

"你是说，我们的新院长想续签旧协定。她得给点额外的优惠，不是吗？我猜你就是来跟我谈细节的，"

他点了点他的数据平板，为你打开了一个新频道，用于上传 Baird 提供的相关材料。

entries.en:
As you complete the connection with your datapad, Daud speaks. "What we did to Kallichore was justice. He risked the entire Galatia system, hundreds of thousands of citizens. That might be just one subsector of just one metroplex down there," he waves vaguely in the direction of Chicomoztoc.

"But," his voice hardens, "I will not allow any 'grand experiments' that endanger these people. I expect Baird realizes that any misstep will be met with the overwhelming force of the Hegemony navy."

"She's not stupid," he says thoughtfully, looking at the cruiser through the diamond-matrix pane, "But ambition can make a fool of anyone."

He turns fully toward you, "Do you trust Baird?"
entries.zh:
等你完成了数据传输后，Daud 开口了。"我们对 Kallichore 做的事不过是执行正义。他把整个 Galatia 星系置于危险之中，那可是数十万公民的安危啊。对整个 霸主 来说，那或许不过是大都会中的一片分区，" 他朝 Chicomoztoc 的大致方向挥了挥手。

"但是，" 他的声音变得厚重，"我不会允许任何 '伟大实验' 危及到那些人。我希望 Baird 能意识到，任何失误都会招致 霸主 海军那压倒性的武力回应。"

"她并不傻，" 他透过金刚石方窗望向那艘巡洋舰，若有所思地说，"但野心会蒙蔽人的双眼。"

他转过身来面对你，"你信任 Baird 吗？"

entries.en:
Daud looks you over. "You'll lead an interesting path, I'm sure," he says skeptically. "By now you must know that Baird does not truly know the meaning of loyalty. Not really, and yet..." he puts a hand to his chest, "Here too am I. Hearing her out. So I will not think too poorly of you for your unlikely devotion."

"Tell Baird I accept," he says.
entries.zh:
Daud 盯着你。"你会走上一条有趣的道路，我能肯定，" 他略带怀疑地说。"你应该也早已发现，Baird 并不理解忠诚的含义，完全无法理解，不过..." 他把一只手放在胸前，"我不也是在听她的提案吗。我不会因为你不忠诚而看不起你。"

"告诉 Baird 我接受了，" 他说。

entries.en:
"Don't wait too long. The captain must make the judgment and give the order whether or not they have all the information they need. It is scientists who have the luxury of gathering data forever, asking questions and never quite giving answers, only theories."

He nods at you, "And you, captain, are no scientist."

"Tell Baird I accept," he says.
entries.zh:
"别等太久了。一名好的舰长无论是否得到了所有必要的信息，都必须作出决断并下达命令。永远只有科学家才享有收集数据和询问问题的奢侈，他们给出的从不是答案，而是理论。"

他对你点了点头，"而你，舰长，你可不是个科学家。"

"告诉 Baird 我接受了，" 他说。

entries.en:
"Good," he says. "I am of similar mind. Nonetheless," he puts a hand to his chest, "Here too am I, entertaining her envoy."

"Tell Baird I accept," he says.
entries.zh:
"不错，" 他简洁地说。"我的想法也差不多。不过即使这样，" 他把一只手放在胸前，"我不也是在招待她的使者嘛。"

"告诉 Baird 我接受了，" 他说。

entries.en:
"She will be receiving additional demands. She won't like them. She will accept."

He turns, pacing. "The Gates are the question behind the entire Hegemony, are they not? Is the Domain out there waiting to reward those who kept faith, blindly loyal for generations?"

He stops. "Or was there some grand catastrophe, and nothing awaits us but ruins and the dead? Or will monsters from Ludd's own nightmares pour out to devour us all- unless we are armed and steadfast, ready to meet their threat?"
entries.zh:
"她将收到一些额外的要求，她不会喜欢这些，但她没得选择。"

他转过身，踱起步来。"星门，才是悬在整个霸主背后的根本问题，不是吗？人之领 到底是不是还在等着我们？它是否愿意褒奖那些几个世纪以来，一直坚守着这一信念，保持着盲目的忠诚的人们？"

他止住了脚步。"还是说，发生了什么重大灾难，等待着我们的只有断壁残垣和遍野横尸？又或者那些卢德信徒的梦魇是真实存在的，那些怪物们会一涌而出，淹没我们 —— 除非我们已经做好反击准备？"

entries.en:
"Captain, I need to know if we are history's fools or heroes. Not few among my comrades would say it is disloyal, even cowardly, to ask the question."

He faces you. "I think it is cowardly not to."

"All my busy helpers will be back in a moment, so make it quick. Did that Yaribay blueblood want anything important?"
entries.zh:
"舰长，我很想知道我们到底是历史的英雄还是罪人。我的同志们有不少会觉得，问出这个问题，乃是不忠诚，甚至是怯懦的表现。"

他面朝你说道，"但我认为，回避这个问题的人才是懦夫。"

"我的助手们再过一会就该回来了，所以我们赶快收尾吧。那个什么 Yaribay 贵族有对你提什么要求吗？"

entries.en:
The bay is crowded with transports, military and civilian. Some high-roller has even landed a shimmering S-type Kite, much to the annoyance of the ground crews. A young ensign checks your pass with their datapad then leads you and your bodyguards past the crowd of civilian officials and media drones.

You arrive at a checkpoint still setting up for civilian access. The ensign indicates your guards, "They will have to wait here. And, ah, captain, $playerSirOrMadam. You will have to leave your sidearm with the armorer."
entries.zh:
机库内挤满了军用与民用运输船，某位挥金如土的乘客甚至在这里停了一艘流光溢彩的 S-型风筝，这让地勤人员颇为恼火。一名年轻的少尉用手中的数据平板仔细核实了你的通行证后，带着你和随行保镖穿过了成群的文职官员和传媒无人机。

你来到了一处尚未完工、暂供平民进出的检查站。少尉指了指你的保镖："他们必须在此等候。另外，呃... $playerSirOrMadam。你还得把你的配枪暂存在军械员这里。"

entries.en:
The armorer hands it to another man, not in uniform. You look him over: military bearing, subtle cybernetic augments, civilian clothing with the subtle bulk of light personal armor.

"Rivas. High Hegemon Daud's chief of security," the ensign tells you.
entries.zh:
军械员把你的配枪交给另一个没穿制服的人，你打量着他：军人风度，低调的电子植入增强体，便于战斗的便装。

"这位是 Rivas，至高霸主 Daud 的安全总管，" 少尉介绍道。

entries.en:
Rivas handles your sidearm as if it were his own. With a light touch he slips the cellmag out, checks its status, then reloads it. He hands the weapon back to you.

"Captain," he says. "It is the High Hegemon's opinion that if you have earned yourself a Hegemony commission, you may bear your weapon in his presence."
entries.zh:
安全总管娴熟地操作起你的武器，好像这是他自己的武器似的。只是轻轻一按，他就将能量弹匣滑出，检查了它的状态后，又把弹匣重装回去。随后他将配枪交还给你。

"舰长，" 他说道。"至高霸主认为，如果你能为自己赢得一份 霸主 的雇佣协议，那么你理应享有在他面前携带武器的权利。"

entries.en:
Rivas examines your sidearm as if it were his own. With a light touch, he removes the cellmag and passes it to the armorer. He returns your unloaded weapon to you.

"Captain," he says, and with a word gives you permission to re-holster your sidearm.
entries.zh:
安全总管娴熟地检查起你的武器，好像这是他自己的武器似的。他轻轻一按，取出了弹匣，并将它递给了军械员。随后他将未装弹的配枪交还给你。

"舰长。" 他说道，示意你收好自己的配枪。

entries.en:
Rivas examines your sidearm as if it was a bomb. With the lightest touch, he has the cellmag and casing removed, handing both to the attending armorer. He stares down at you for a long minute.

"Captain $playerName," he says finally, as if identifying you in a perp lineup.
entries.zh:
安全总管检查起你的武器，好像这不是一把枪，而是一颗炸弹似的。他如履薄冰地按了一下，取出弹匣和里面的子弹，把它们都交给军械员。随后他盯着你看了足足有一分钟。

"$playerName 舰长，" 他终于开口了，语气像是在犯人们的列队指认中认出了你一样。

entries.en:
Rivas examines your sidearm as if it was a bomb. With the lightest touch, he has the cellmag and casing removed, handing both to the attending armorer. He stares down at you for a long minute.

"Captain $playerName," he says finally, as if identifying you in a perp lineup.
entries.zh:
Rivas 端详你的配枪，活像在检查一枚炸弹。手指轻轻一拨，弹匣与枪身便被卸下，一并递给一旁的军械士。他垂眼盯着你，久久不语。

"$playerName 舰长，" 他终于开口，那神情像是在嫌疑人列队里认人。

entries.en:
Rivas turns to the ensign and says "I'll escort the captain to see the High Hegemon."

The ensign begins to salute but catches themself - Rivas is not military, at least not now - then simply nods, "Sir," before turning back toward the landing bay.
entries.zh:
Rivas 转向少尉，"我会护送这位舰长去和至高霸主见面。"

少尉想要敬礼，但立刻意识到了什么 —— 毕竟 Rivas 并非军人，至少现在不是 —— 然后只是点了点头，"是，长官，" 便返回了登陆台。

entries.en:
Rivas leads you past a half dozen checkpoints set through the guts of the shipyard. At each checkpoint you both submit to a flicker of biometric scan, then a guard nods to Rivas and allows you both passage.

Finally you enter a utilitarian vestibule.

Emergency vac-suit lockers, fire suppression equipment, and safety notices line the walls. A diamond-matrix pane separates this compartment from the enclosed space-dock visible beyond - a perfect, new Eagle-class hull looms, and a gantry hangs toward its bow, festooned with ribbons and a Hegemony banner.
entries.zh:
Rivas 带着你走过六七个设立在造船厂腹地的检查站。每到一个检查站，你们都要接受一次生物特征扫描，守卫向 Rivas 点头示意后方可通行。

终于，你们来到了一处实用主义风格的前厅。墙边满是紧急真空服锁柜、灭火装备和安全告示牌。金刚石方窗外是封闭的太空船坞 —— 一艘崭新而完美的雄鹰-级舰体停靠在那里，一座装饰有飘扬的彩带和霸主旗帜的龙门架正对舰首。

entries.en:
Rivas steps to the side, his bulk revealing High Hegemon Baikal Daud sitting on a simple folding stool, his splendid uniform coat hanging from a rack, fussed over by a stylist and an advisor.

Daud looks at you impassively then, without breaking eye contact, commands his entourage: "Give us the room. Five minutes."

They leave, Rivas following after meeting your eyes one last time.
entries.zh:
Rivas 走到一旁，显露出原本被挡在他的大块头后面的至高霸主本尊 Baikal Daud。他坐在一个简易小折凳上，华丽的制服外套挂在一边的衣帽架上。一位造型师和一名顾问在旁边念念有词。

Daud 面无表情地观察着你。然后他一边保持着眼神接触，一边命令他的随行人员道："给我们腾点空间。五分钟就够了。"

造型师和顾问离开了，Rivas 紧随其后，但还不忘再盯你一眼。

o.zh: 我还以为你会更高大些。

entries.en:
Rivas steps to the side, his bulk revealing High Hegemon Baikal Daud sitting on a simple folding stool, his splendid uniform coat hanging from a rack, fussed over by a stylist and an advisor.

Daud looks at you impassively. Without breaking eye contact he commands his entourage: "Give us the room. Five minutes."

They leave, Rivas following after meeting your eyes one last time.
entries.zh:
Rivas 往旁边一让，魁梧身形后面露出至高霸主 Baikal Daud —— 他坐在一张简陋的折凳上，华美的军礼服外套挂在衣架上，造型师和顾问正围着他忙活。

Daud 面无表情地看着你，目光不离，径直吩咐随从："都出去。给我们五分钟。"

众人退下，Rivas 临走前又与你对了一眼。

o.en: I thought you'd be taller in person.
o.zh: 我原以为你本尊会更高些。

entries.en: "Captain $playerName," he says, and stands, indeed a smaller man than you expected.
entries.zh: "$playerName 舰长，" 他说着站起身来，身形的确不如你想的那般高大。

entries.en:
"Yes," he says, standing. Indeed a smaller man than you expected. "I'm starting to appreciate Baird's sense of humor."

He doesn't sound particularly amused.
entries.zh:
"是啊，\" 他一边应着一边起身。果然比你预想的矮小。\"我算是慢慢品出 Baird 的幽默感了。"

听语气，他可半点不觉得好笑。

entries.en: He smirks, and stands. "They angle the holos like that. Say it's for image."
entries.zh: 他微笑着站起身来。" 他们故意从那个角度录的全息影像。说是为了个人形象之类的。"

entries.en:
His voice holds a deep authority, however, and though you've heard it in holo-casts, with just a few words in-person you can feel why - and how - he leads the Hegemony.

Daud taps his datapad, activating a privacy field that dulls the ambient murmur of the shipyard's ventilation.

"How's Provost Anahita Baird's project going?" he asks, "Bridged any Gates?"
entries.zh:
他的语气中带着厚重的威严感。尽管你已经在全息广播中听过很多次这个声音了，但在面对面交谈时，他简单的几句话就让你能感觉到他为什么能 —— 以及如何 —— 领导霸主。

Daud 点了点他的数据平板，启动了隐私场，掩盖住周围的船坞通风系统发出的噪音。

"Anahita Baird 院长的项目进行得怎么样了？" 他问道，"成功连接星门了吗？"

o.en: That's what I wanted to talk to you about.

entries.en:
His voice holds the same deep authority you recognize from before. And in-person the effect is greater; not some cheap comms-mod or propagandists' trick. You can feel why - and how - he leads the Hegemony.

Daud taps his datapad, activating a privacy field that dulls the ambient murmur of the shipyard's ventilation.

"Ground rules," he says. "There's nothing to discuss about your pet colonial project. We're not here for that."

"Let's talk about Provost Baird," he says, lightening his tone only the barest detectable quantum. "Bridged any Gates yet?"
entries.zh:
他的声音里透着深深的权威感，尽管你在全息广播中听过他的声音，但只需几句话的亲自交谈，你就能感受到他为何以及如何领导着 霸主。

Daud 轻轻敲击着他的数据平板，启动了一个隐私场，使船坞通风的低沉嗡鸣变得微弱。

"先定下我们的基调。" 他说道，"关于你的殖民项目，我们没有什么可讨论的。我们不是为此而来的。"

"让我们谈谈 Baird 院长。" 他说道，语气不可察觉地轻了一点，"她成功连接星门了吗？"

o.en: That's what I wanted to talk to you about.
While we're here, maybe we can revisit our terms...
o.zh: 既然我们都在这里，也许我们可以重新讨论一下我们的协议...

entries.en:
"I know," he says, and lifts a bottle of spirits from out of a small box - baijiu from Eventide. It looks expensive.

"This is for the newest member of the Hegemony Navy. Eagle-class. After I crack this over hull 0451, it will become the 'Enduring Hope'. How's that for a name?" He pauses, waiting for your answer.
entries.zh:
"我知道了..." 他边说边从身旁的精致木盒里拿出一瓶看起来价值不菲、产自 Eventide 的白酒。

"这是为了庆祝 霸主 海军的最新成员，一艘 雄鹰-级。等我把这个瓶子砸到 0451 号的船体上，它就正式成为 '不灭希望' 号。这名字怎么样？" 他顿了顿，等着你的回答。

o.en: I like it. Looks toward something better.
I don't know. Were you expecting a poet?
o.zh: 我也不知道。你觉得我是个诗人吗？

o.en: Laying it on a bit thick, isn't it?
o.zh: 这名字得有点过了，不是吗？

entries.en:
He ignores you, lifting a bottle of spirits from out of a small box - baijiu from Eventide. It looks expensive.

"This is for the newest member of the Hegemony Navy. Eagle-class. After I crack this over hull 0451, it will become the 'Enduring Hope'. How's that for a name?" He pauses, waiting for your answer.
entries.zh:
他好像没有听见你说了什么，从身旁的精致木盒里拿出一瓶看起来价值不菲、产自 Eventide 的白酒。

"这是为了庆祝 霸主 海军的最新成员，一艘 雄鹰-级。等我把这个瓶子砸到 0451 号的船体上，它就正式成为 '不灭希望' 号。这名字怎么样？" 他顿了顿，等着你的回答。

o.en: I like it. Looks toward something better.
I don't know. Were you expecting a poet?
o.zh: 我也不知道。你觉得我是个诗人吗？

o.en: Laying it on a bit thick, isn't it?
o.zh: 这名字得有点过了，不是吗？

entries.en: Daud glances at his datapad, "You've got 20 seconds, captain. Any last words?"
entries.zh: Daud 的目光漫不经心地扫过他的数据平板，"你还有 20 秒，舰长，还有什么想说的吗？"

entries.en:
"I'll listen to what he has to say," Daud says, and offers his datapad. You upload the cryptokeys.

"I trust the Yaribays to do what is best for the Yaribays," he says, tapping at the datapad to accept your upload. "Maybe that'll be enough."

He looks over to hull 0451, "Or maybe it won't."
entries.zh:
"我会听听他有什么高见，" Daud 说着，将手中的数据平板递给你。你上传了密钥。

"我相信 Yaribay 族人的做法一定是对他们自己氏族最好的做法，" 他点了点数据平板，接受了你的上传。"也许这就足够了。"

他望向 0451 号船体，"又或者还不够。"

entries.en: "You do a lot worth knowing about," Daud shoots back. "I speak from experience when I say it's not a life I can recommend without reservation."
entries.zh: "你身上有很多值得了解的地方，" Daud 回击道，"出于我的亲身经历，这种生活我无法毫无保留地推荐给你。"

entries.en:
"Of course he does. Gens Yaribay is only a minor stakeholder in the shipyards of Kazeron, and holds major cross-faction investments."

Daud smiles coolly, "But I will take the 'good word' of Baird's knee-breaker under advisement."
entries.zh:
"他当然会这么想，Yaribay 氏族和 Kazeron 上的造船厂并没有太多利益往来，与此同时他们手上可是握有不少举足轻重的跨势力投资项目。"

Daud 冷淡的笑了笑，"不过我会把 Baird 那位打手的 '美言' 纳入考量的。"

entries.en: "Take it to the complaints department," Daud pops a thumb at the Eagle-class cruiser behind him.
entries.zh: "那你得去找管投诉的部门，" Daud 反手指了指他身后的 雄鹰-级 巡洋舰。

entries.en:
Daud smirks, shaking his head.

"Is 'measuring up' really what's important right now?" he says.
entries.zh:
Daud 咧嘴一笑，一边摇了摇头。

"现在 '大小' 真的这么重要吗？" 他说道，语气并非疑问。

entries.en: "Not negotiable," Daud says icily. "You've been out there. You've seen what happened - twice. It won't happen again."
entries.zh: "没有任何讨价还价的余地，" Daud 冷冷地说。"你也亲眼看到过滥用 AI 的后果 —— 两场战争。不能再有第三次了。"

entries.en: Baikal Daud taps his datapad, dropping the privacy field.
entries.zh:
Baikal Daud 在数据平板上按了按，解除了隐私场。

仿佛接到了信号一般，至高霸主的随行人员陆续回到了他身边，这些人大都絮絮叨叨着让至高霸主要注意全息形象，要他再熟悉熟悉演讲中的论点，他的制服是否需要改动之类的问题。

安全主管 Rivas 也出现了，将你从设备杂物间带出来，穿过安检站，回到你的穿梭机。

entries.en:
As if on cue, the High Hegemon's small entourage returns with a babble of worries over how he'll look on the holo-cast, the need to review talking points for the speech, and his uniform...

Security Chief Rivas looms, corralling you from the gantry utility room and back through the security checkpoints to your shuttle.
entries.zh:
像是掐准了时候，至高霸主那一小群随从一拥而回，七嘴八舌地操心他在全息转播里上不上镜、演讲的口径要不要再过一遍，还有他那身制服...

安保主管 Rivas 逼人的身影压了过来，把你从栈桥检修间赶出来，一路径直押过层层安检，送回你的穿梭机。

entries.en: He raises an eyebrow at you. "Succinct."
entries.zh: 他朝你挑了挑眉。"还挺简练。"

entries.en:
Baikal Daud taps his datapad, dropping the privacy field.

As if on cue, the High Hegemon's small entourage returns with a babble of worries over how he'll look on the holo-cast, the need to review talking points for the speech, and his uniform...

Security Chief Rivas looms, corralling you from the gantry utility room and back through the security checkpoints to your shuttle.
entries.zh:
Baikal Daud 在数据平板上点了一下，撤去了隐私力场。

像是掐准了时候，至高霸主那一小群随从一拥而回，七嘴八舌地操心他在全息转播里上不上镜、演讲的口径要不要再过一遍，还有他那身制服...

安保主管 Rivas 逼人的身影压了过来，把你从栈桥检修间赶出来，一路径直押过层层安检，送回你的穿梭机。

o.en: Horus Yaribay gave me cryptokeys to pass to you.
o.zh: Horus Yaribay 嘱咐我将他的密钥转交给你。

o.en: You seem to know a lot about what I do.
o.zh: 你好像很了解我做过的事情。

o.en: I want to put in a good word for Horus Yaribay. He desires peaceful reconciliation.
o.zh: 我想替 Horus Yaribay 说句好话，他想让 霸主 和 英仙座联盟 和解。

o.en: I believe the trade tariffs are too high. Especially for me.
o.zh: 我觉得你们的税费太高了。尤其是对我收的。
不错的巡洋舰，但我有更好的。

o.en: The Hegemony AI Inspectors are too aggressive. Perhaps something could be done?
o.zh: 霸主 AI 审查人员都太激进了，你能不能做点什么？

o.en: That's everything I wanted to talk about.
o.zh: That's everything I wanted to talk about.

o.en: Shuttle to the naval shipyard to meet the High Hegemon
o.zh: 乘穿梭机前往海军船坞，与至高霸主见面

o.en: I am an envoy from Gens Yaribay of Kazeron. Transmitting credentials now.
o.zh: 我是 Kazeron 的 Yaribay 氏族派出的特使，正在传输证件信息。

entries.en:
The state-change across the cadet's face as they realize you aren't some tourist is instantaneous.

"Affirmative $playerSirOrMadam," their tone is military-crisp.

"Received and thank-you $playerSirOrMadam. I will confirm with OPSCOMM. An officer will speak to you shortly. Please maintain link. This comms out."

The display flickers back to the crest of the Hegemony.
entries.zh:
意识到你不是普通游客后，这位下级军官的面部表情迅速发生了变化

"是，$playerSirOrMadam，" 他换上一口军队腔调。

"已经收到，谢谢你，$playerSirOrMadam。正在和 OPSCOMM 核对。稍后一位军官会与您通话。请保持通讯。完毕。"

屏幕上闪烁着 霸主 的徽标。

entries.en:
In moments, the crest disappears and you speak with a real officer, some kind of secretary to the High Hegemon. They begin efficiently verifying your credentials, then pause.

"Captain $playerName?" Finally they seem to look at you and realize who you are, "Of course, I should have realized that you bear a commission. Our records indicate that you have done much good in service of the Hegemony, and much to prove the value of the High Hegemon's auxiliary policy."

"You're lucky." The officer turns back to their display, tapping away. "It will be your great honor to meet with the man himself. Please do forgive the ad-hoc nature of the arrangement; the High Hegemon is a very busy man."
entries.zh:
不一会，霸主 的徽标消失了，你和一位真正的军官通上了话，可能是至高霸主的秘书。他开始迅速且高效地核实你的证件，然后突然停了下来。

"$playerName 舰长？" 他终于看向了你，好像认出了你是谁，"啊，真抱歉，我早该注意到你和 霸主 签有一份雇佣协议。我们的记录显示你在服役期间为 霸主 出过不少力，这也侧面证明了至高霸主的辅助军政策的确行之有效。"

"你可真是走运。" 这名军官重新看向显示屏，点按着什么。"能和他见面是一种荣幸。希望你能理解这种临时设置的会面，要知道，至高霸主是个很忙的人。"

entries.en:
Before you know it, you have a time, a place, and a visitor passkey to present. A public map database search confirms that you have been asked to arrive at some kind of naval shipyard in orbit of Chicomoztoc.

The officer-secretary did not take time to explain the purpose of meeting at this odd venue.
entries.zh:
在你反应过来之前，就已经收到了时间、地点以及一个访客密码。你检索了地图数据库，确定了你要去的这个地点是 Chicomoztoc 轨道上的一处海军船坞。

这位军官兼秘书并没有解释为什么要在这种奇怪的地方会面。

entries.en:
In moments, the crest disappears and you speak with a real officer, some kind of secretary to the High Hegemon who verifies your credentials and schedules you for a brief face-to-face meeting with Baikal Daud.

"Captain $playerName." They speak as if they remember your name, and do not like being reminded of it.

"The High Hegemon is a very busy man, but he has expressed an interest in speaking with an envoy of Gens Yaribay." But not you, they don't say.

"The arrangement is somewhat ad hoc due to scheduling," they say without a hint of apology. "I assure you that it is necessary."
entries.zh:
不多时，徽标隐去，接上话的是位真正的军官，看模样是至高霸主身边的某位秘书。对方核过你的证件，替你排了一场与 Baikal Daud 短暂的面谈。

"$playerName 舰长。" 那口气像是记得你的名字，而且很不愿意被人提醒起它。

"至高霸主日理万机，不过他表示愿意见一见 Yaribay 氏族派来的特使。" 至于不愿见的是你，这话他们没说出口。

"因日程所限，安排得仓促了些，\" 他们说得毫无歉意。\"请相信，这实属必要。"

entries.en:
In moments, the crest disappears and you speak with a real officer, some kind of secretary to the High Hegemon who verifies your credentials and schedules you for a brief face-to-face meeting with Baikal Daud.

"Captain... Captain $playerName, I see. Yes, we can fit you in. The High Hegemon is a very busy man, but he has expressed an interest in your matter. Please forgive the ad hoc arrangement. I assure you that it is necessary."
entries.zh:
不一会，霸主 的徽标消失了，你和一位真正的军官通上了话，可能是至高霸主的秘书。他开始迅速且高效地核实你的证件，并为你安排了一次与至高霸主 Baikal Daud 的简短会面。

"舰长... $playerName 舰长，我明白了。没问题，我们可以为你安排一次会面。至高霸主是个很忙的人，但他对你要谈的事情抱有兴趣。希望你能理解这种临时设置的会面。我向你保证这是必要的。"

entries.en:
In moments, the crest disappears and you speak with a real officer, some kind of secretary to the High Hegemon. They don't look pleased.

"$PlayerName." A tap, tap at the desk console. "Your record does little to recommend you. But. The High Hegemon will not turn away an accredited envoy from gens Yaribay."

"In the interest of diplomacy, we will set aside your record while you carry out your duties in service of the Yaribays. When you meet the High Hegemon, you will bring no sidearm. You will be searched. You will be expected to obey all reasonable requests or be ejected from Hegemony space."

The officer-secretary pauses a moment, just looking at you. "We'll be watching," they say, "very closely," before turning back to the desk console.
entries.zh:
不一会，霸主 的徽标消失了，你和一位真正的军官通上了话，可能是至高霸主的秘书。他看起来面色不善。

"$PlayerName。" 这位军官在控制台桌面上按了一下。"你的档案里可没几件好事。但是至高霸主不会就这么打发走一位经 Yaribay 氏族认可的使者。"

"出于对外交利益的考量，在你履行作为 Yaribay 使节的职责期间，我们将暂时忽略你的档案。和至高霸主见面期间，你不能携带任何武器。我们将会对你搜身。我们期望你能遵从这些合理的要求，否则你将被逐出 霸主 领地。"

这位军官兼秘书顿了顿，只是盯着你看。"我们将关注你的一举一动，" 他说，"密切地关注。" 随后便把注意力转向了控制台。

o.zh: DEV 设定 启动星门 已完成
DEV 开始 启动星门

entries.en:
Dev start for GA ATG testing.

Remember to leave then return to the Galatia Academy.
entries.zh:
Dev 开局用以测试 启动星门

记得要先离开 Galatia 学院再回来

entries.en:
$Post $personLastName looks at you carefully before responding.

"I might recall hearing of a man by this name once. I would not know where he would be, or what he has done of late. And if I did, I would not tell. But if I were to leave a message with a friend who may have a friend who might be that man..."

$HeOrShe looks up to the stars and sighs. "It is not my Path to judge what business you might have, begging all the forgiveness of Providence."
entries.zh:
$Post $personLastName 在回应之前仔细地看着你。

"我可能曾经听说过一个叫这个名字的人。我不知道他最近在哪，也不知道他最近干了什么。就算我知道，我也不会告诉你。但如果要我去给我的朋友留条信息，他可能有一个朋友就是那个人..."

$HeOrShe仰望群星叹气道。"愿上天原谅，我不该去揣测你有什么打算。"

o.en: Are you offering to arrange a meeting?

entries.en:
"Might be," $heOrShe says nervously. "Come down port-side. There's a teahouse where the outworlders gather, where the guardians of virtue watch vigilantly for the influence of Moloch and Mammon."

The spacer bar, in other words. As much as a teahouse-speakeasy can pass for a decent bar in this place.
entries.zh:
"可能是。" $heOrShe紧张地说，"从左舷下来。这儿有一个外来人员聚集的茶馆，里面的惩戒团成员正警惕着恶魔摩洛克和玛门的影响。"

换言之，就是那家太空佬酒吧。在这种地方，一家有点地下副业的茶馆已算得上是个条件不错的酒吧了。

o.en: Tell Cotton I'll meet him there.
o.zh: 告诉 Cotton 我会在那里见他。

o.en: Perhaps our paths should not cross just yet.
o.zh: 也许现在见面还不是时候。

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods, not meeting your eye. "Then it shall be. Blessings upon you captain."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe点了点头，没有直视你的眼睛。"就是这样了。祝福你，舰长。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods, meeting your eyes. "Then it shall be. Blessings upon you, $playerBrotherOrSister."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe盯着你的眼睛点了点头。"那就这么定了，祝佑你，$playerBrotherOrSister。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods, not meeting your eye. "Perhaps your path will take you far from here. Captain."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe点了点头，没有直视你的眼睛。"也许你的道途将带你远离这里。舰长。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods, meeting your eyes. "Perhaps, $playerBrotherOrSister, your Path does not yet meet with that of the good man."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe盯着你的眼睛点了点头。"那么也许，$playerBrotherOrSister，你的道途还不会和那个好人相遇。"

entries.en:
"Ah ha-ha," $heOrShe laughs nervously. "Would that I could help you, friend, would that I could help you. Alas, I have no notion of such a thing and besides, what need have I for credits when devotion to the Creator nourishes my soul and keeps me tight to the Path?"

"I shall surely pray for you, captain, that the hammer, when it comes, falls softly," $heOrShe says. "Would you look at the hour? I must adjourn to see to my prayers. Until our paths cross again, blessings upon you."

$HeOrShe cuts the comm link on you somewhat abruptly, leaving you with a staticky holding pattern.
entries.zh:
"啊哈哈..." $heOrShe紧张地笑着，"但愿我能帮到你，朋友，但愿我能帮到你。呃，我都没有注意到这样一件事。另外，当我对于造物主的奉献滋润着我的灵魂，让我与这道途紧密相连的时候，又需要星币做什么呢？"

"我当然会为你祈祷，舰长，让那铁锤到来的时候可以轻轻地落下，" $heOrShe说，"你可以看一下时间吗？我必须停下去进行祷告了。祝福你，直到我们的道途再次交会。"

$HeOrShe突然切断了与你的通讯链接，仅留你在等候界面中。

entries.en:
$personLastName raises an eyebrow. "Begging sweet Ludd's forgiveness, spacer, but if I did know such a good man, I would be wary of letting his name escape my lips too easily."

"Condemn not the ignorant for they know not their error, as the book says, but Grace of the Path, protect me - and you - from inquiries best not made lest a terrible swift hammer full upon us." $HeOrShe smiles nervously.

"Let us speak of other things," $heOrShe says. "The weather! Unpleasant lately, no?"
entries.zh:
$personLastName 扬起了眉毛。"愿亲爱的卢德恕我无罪，宇宙民，但我真要认识那么一个好人，我是不会轻易吐出他的名字的。"

"无知者无罪，如教典所言，但卢德之道的光辉啊，请保佑我 —— 还有你 —— 不为多嘴多问而获罚。" $HeOrShe紧张地微笑道。

"我们聊点别的吧。" $HeOrShe说道，"天气！最近真糟啊，对吧？"

entries.en:
$personLastName raises an eyebrow. "Begging sweet Ludd's forgiveness, my fellow $playerBrotherOrSister, but if I did know such a good man, I would be wary of letting his name escape my lips too easily."

"But we're all pilgrims of the faith here, are we not?" $HeOrShe lets the hint of a smile appear, enjoying the chance to tease at hidden knowledge. "A pilgrim like you should visit a more worldly shrine. Come down port-side. There is a teahouse where the outworlders and Mammonites gather. There you will find your answer."

The spacer bar, in other words. As much as a teahouse-speakeasy can pass for a decent bar in this place.
entries.zh:
$personLastName 扬起了眉毛。"愿亲爱的卢德恕我无罪，我的 $playerBrotherOrSister，但我真要认识那么一个好人，我是不会轻易吐出他的名字的。"

"但我们都是信仰的朝圣者，是吧？" $HeOrShe露出了一丝微笑，似乎很享受这个话里藏话的机会，"像你这样的朝圣者应该去看看凡尘中的圣地。从左舷下来。这儿有一个外来人员和玛门之仆聚集的茶馆。你会在那里找到想要的答案的。"

换言之，就是那家太空佬酒吧。在这种地方，一家有点地下副业的茶馆已算得上是个条件不错的酒吧了。

o.en: Let him know that I'll meet... him... there.
o.zh: 告诉他我会去那里...见...他。

o.en: Perhaps our paths should not cross just yet.
o.zh: 也许我们的道还不该相交。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe gives you a hard look.

"The Luddic Path, you say. 'May be involved'? Look, I can see where you're going and I don't believe it is a good idea."

$personLastName sighs. "The security forces are occupied with hunting the most extreme militants already and, say what you will, but they have a... sense of professionalism about it. They know to respect most of us Faithful. Usually."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe给了你一个难看的表情。

"你是说，卢德左径，'可能参与其中' ？瞧，我都知道你要说什么而且我不认为这是个好主意。"

$personLastName 叹了口气。"安保力量已经在忙于追捕最极端的武装分子，随你怎么说，但他们把一种... 职业精神投入其中。他们知道要尊重我们卢德信徒中的大多数人。通常如此。"

entries.en: Their leader nods warily and the pack retreats to their own table. You can feel their eyes on your back.
entries.zh: 其中领头的人谨慎地点了点头，一行人退回到他们自己的桌子上。你可以感觉到他们在背后盯着你。

entries.en: Their leader nods warily and the pack retreats to their own table. You can feel their eyes on your back.
entries.zh: 其中领头的人谨慎地点了点头，一行人退回到他们自己的桌子上。你可以感觉到他们在背后盯着你。

o.en: Server, a pot of tea please!
Server, a round for the large gentlemen over there!
o.zh: 服务员，请那里的大块头绅士们喝一轮！

entries.en:
You station yourself in a nice, solid corner; back to the wall, good sightlines to exits. Your guards unobtrusively follow suit.

The tea arrives shortly and the server makes no smalltalk, eager to not give the impression that they have any association with you.
entries.zh:
你坐到一个精心考虑过的合适角落，背向墙壁，这样可以很好地看到出口处，你的保镖们也小心翼翼地有样学样。

茶很快端了上来，服务员没有说什么话，急切地想表明他们与你没有任何瓜葛。

entries.en:
You buy a round for the Pather heavies and they eye you as they order something else, leaving your gifts untouched.

You station yourself in a nice, solid corner; back to the wall, good sightlines to exits. Your guards unobtrusively follow suit.
entries.zh:
你为这些左径暴徒们请了一轮。但他们依然盯着你，点了其他喝的，没有碰你请的东西。

你坐到一个精心考虑过的合适角落，背向墙壁，这样可以很好地看到出口处，你的保镖们也小心翼翼地有样学样。

entries.en:
You note the change of shift as chronometers and tastefully obsolete datapads notify the working regulars - miners and spacer crew, mostly - to finish their drinks and stumble off to their assignments.

The proprietor sets down a bottle and approaches you. "Hear me, I beg," she says. "I've nothing to do with him or his. You... you can't refuse them here, captain."

She glances toward the table with the heavies. They're watching you both, very closely. "I was told- the back room. He's waiting now. I- I saw nothing today."
entries.zh:
换班的时候到了，在天文钟和精美的旧式数据平板的催促下，这里有工作的常客们 —— 大多数是矿工和太空船员 —— 把酒喝完，开始步履蹒跚地走回岗位。

老板放下了手里的瓶子，靠向你。"我求你听我说，" 她说。"我跟他和他的人没有任何关系。你...你不能在这里拒绝他们，舰长。"

她瞥了一眼打手那一桌。他们正盯着你们两人，盯得非常仔细。"有人告诉我...后面的房间，他现在在那里等着。我...我今天什么也没看见。"

o.en: Don't go to the back room just yet.
o.zh: 现在先不去后面的房间。

entries.en: "Speak not the prophet's name, unbeliever," the thug on the right hisses.
entries.zh: "先知名讳不可直呼，无信者。" 右边的暴徒愤怒地低吼。

entries.en:
The lead heavy's resolve wavers, and he turns to his left. The backup pulls out a chunky device, a handmade comms unit, and mumbles a query. It emits a scratchy, distorted response.

Whatever was said, it must have been good news. The heavies visibly relax and the leader, now more suspicious than hostile, says "Brother Cotton would parlay. Be here to meet. After next shift."
entries.zh:
带头的打手决心有些动摇，他转向左边。后边的人拿出一个厚重的装置，是一个手制的通讯器，然后嘟哝着询问着。它发出一种带杂音的扭曲回应声。

不管说了什么，那一定是好消息。打手们明显放松了，他们中的领导者现在更像是怀疑态度，而不是敌意，说到："Cotton 修士打算赌你一把。在这里见面，在下次轮班之后。"

o.en: I need to find someone kidnapped by Brother Cotton.
o.zh: 我需要找到一个被 Cotton 修士绑架的人。

o.en: I'm looking for someone who is a... guest of Brother Cotton.
o.zh: 我在找某位...Cotton 修士的客人

o.en: I'll pay you good credits to know where to find Brother Cotton.
o.zh: 我会给你一笔大额的星币来换取 Cotton 修士的位置情报。

o.en: I wish to speak with Brother Cotton. Can you help?
o.zh: 我想和 Cotton 修士谈话，你能帮我吗？

entries.en:
A silent ring of adamantine material, derelict of a former age.

You activate your command interface and tap over to the Janus Device prototype controls. After a barely discernible pause, an alert appears.

UNKNOWN GATE SIGNATURE, SCAN REQUIRED

The Gate awaits, as cold as a tomb.
entries.zh:
一座沉寂已久的环状结构，由坚固的材料制成，是来自上个时代的遗迹。

你激活了面前的命令界面，找到 "双面神" 设备原型机的控制面板。一段不易察觉的卡顿后，面板上出现了一则警告消息。

[未知星门特征，需要扫描]

星门就在那里等着，冰冷得好像一座坟墓。

entries.en:
You hold your breath and lower your finger. Nothing happens. You look down at the splash of red text on your command interface.

FUNCTION TERMINATED: DETECTED IN-SYSTEM HYPERCOMMUNICATION ACTIVITY INDICATIVE OF POPULATION CENTER // probably no one will see this abort case but want to make sure no one does something stupid -sc
entries.zh:
你屏住呼吸，按了下去。什么也没发生。你看了看命令界面上的警告。

功能已中断：检测到大量星系内超通讯信号，星系内存在人口中心 // 大概没人会看到这个中止提示，但想确保没人做蠢事  - sc

entries.en:
You know immediately that something is wrong. The hyperspace manifold display lights up with garish colors in violent whorls and jags, the representation's color-key glitching out on parameters beyond any anticipated scale. You hear a discordant tone - the hyperspace storm alarm, weirdly sounded here in normal-space.
And something else.

Echoing somewhere which exists only in your mind; like a wail of pain.

Your sensors officer shouts a warning, "Wavefront approaching!"
entries.zh:
你立刻意识到，事情好像不对劲。超空间流形显示屏骤然亮起，刺眼的色彩在剧烈的漩涡与锯齿形图案中翻涌，图像的色键在远超预期的参数波动中失真。你听到一阵刺耳的声音 —— 奇怪，那是超空间风暴警告，可你的舰队分明是在正常空间。
还不止这些。

只存在于你脑海中的某个地方回响，听上去仿佛是痛苦的哀号。

你的传感器技官大喊，"超波的波阵面接近！"

entries.en:
An Apogee-class derelict drifts nearby the Gate. This isn't a Gate-hulk, one of the dead ships left from the chaos of the collapse. The damage is much more recent; the hull still retains heat from normal ship operation.

Your sensors officer sweeps the hulk, feeding you status updates. There don't seem to be signs of hasty cuts to cargo bay doors, as Pirates and sometimes Pathers are wont to make. Might mean something, might mean nothing.
entries.zh:
一艘废弃的 至高点-级 就这样被丢在星门附近。然而这并不是那种在大崩塌的混乱中被遗弃的典型星门废船，它的舰体上有最近才留下的损伤痕迹；甚至船体上还留着点正常航行过的余热。

传感器技官快速扫描了船体残骸，并向你汇报情况。货舱门似乎没有发现仓促切割的迹象，海盗和左径分子通常会留下这种痕迹。你不知道这是否意味着些什么。

entries.en:
The initial salvage team finds the hull in relatively good condition for a derelict ship.

The salvor's reports trickle in. A makeshift instrument package has been added to one of the Apogee's sensor bulbs. It has certain features that resemble the Gate scanner provided to you by Coureuse though this one is damaged beyond repair. A cursory sweep of weapons and shields indicates that whatever attack crippled this ship, it must have come as a surprise: the weapons are unfired, and the shield capacitors lack any trace of recent flux build-up.

Your ops chief scowls, "Mark me, it's treachery when you see it like this. Couldn't tell you who did it. Sensor logs are scrubbed down to the crystal. Registry says the ship was hired out of Madeira, crew of mixed civie spacers."
entries.zh:
打捞小组初步分析发现，对一艘遗弃舰来说，这艘船的船体状况还算比较良好。

后续的打捞报告纷至沓来。这艘 至高点-级 的其中一座传感器球里搭载了一套拼凑的仪器。这些仪器的一些特征和 Coureuse 给你的星门扫描仪非常符合，遗憾的是它们已经被严重毁坏，无法修理。对武器和护盾系统的粗略调查表明，不论是什么攻击使这艘船瘫痪，这攻击一定来的非常突然：武器根本没有开火，护盾对接的寄存器近期也没有积攒幅能的迹象。

行动长官皱了皱眉，"听着，这样的攻击一定是来自内部的背叛。但不知道是谁干的。传感器日志完全被擦除了。登记信息上写着这艘船是从 Madeira 租来的，船员都是互相之间毫无关联的平民。"

entries.en:
You personally see off the party of Luddic faithful who maintained vigil from your flagship. Their fleet is returning; their collective devotion uninterrupted.

"Blessings of Ludd upon you, captain," says their leader. "I shall speak well of you to the Prophet Returned."

You know to nod in acceptance without raising any theological questions, and give a polite wave as their shuttle leaves the bay.
entries.zh:
你亲自目送走了之前仍对你的旗舰保持警戒的卢德信徒队伍。他们的舰队平安返回，他们的集体朝拜没有受到干扰。

"愿卢德降福于您，舰长。" 他们的领队说到，"我会在归来的先知面前为您美言。"

你知道这时最好别提出任何神学方面的问题，只需要点头表示接受，并在他们的穿梭机离开机库时礼貌地挥手致意就好。

o.en: Use the Janus prototype on the Gate
o.zh: 对星门使用"双面神"原型

entries.en: She looks abashed. "I'm not doing a very good job of this, am I. Teaching was never- sorry, let me answer your question."
entries.zh: 她看起来有些惭愧。"我讲的真烂啊，是吧。教学从来都不是 —— 抱歉，我还没回答你的问题呢。"

entries.en: "Oh!" She looks up, "I'm so sorry captain. There's just so much going on, that I..."
entries.zh: "哦！" 她再次抬起头，"真不好意思。要忙的事情太多了，我..."

entries.en:
Coureuse takes a breath, centering herself.

"This prototype can interact with the Gate manifold itself. It is my supposition that the Gate network is not so much collapsed as it is... folded up. It's there, but inaccessible. Maybe. We'll need to test certain properties, and," she looks at an ancillary display, catches herself, and turns back to you.
entries.zh:
Coureuse 深吸一口气，把身体摆正。

"这台原型设备可以与星门网络进行直接交互。我的猜想是，星门网络与其说是崩溃了，不如说是... 被折叠起来了。网络还在那里，只是无法访问。或许吧。我们需要测试一些特性，而且，" 她看向一块辅助显示屏，缓了缓，然后再次看向你。

entries.en:
"It was your scan of the Mote induction device from the Ziggurat hull that opened the door. It showed us..." She pauses, then her voice rises with excitement. "Such unimaginable things!"

"Or," she catches her enthusiasm with a skeptical look. "What it showed was highly improbable within the current body of accepted theory. There are entirely new subfields of hyperspace physics out there, in there, whatever - just waiting for first observation!"
entries.zh:
"你对 通灵塔-级 上搭载的光尘发生装置的扫描结果打开了全新的领域。它向我们展现了..." 因为激动，她的声音高了八度，"我们想都不敢想的东西！"

"或者说，" 她作出一个怀疑的眼神强行压下热情，"它所展现出来的东西在目前公认的理论范围内几乎是不可能的。全新的超空间物理的分支领域打开了...出现了，反正无论怎么说 —— 等待着它的首次观测！"

o.en: Fascinating. How will I be assisting in these new discoveries?
o.zh: 听起来真有意思。我该怎么促成这项新发现呢？

o.en: Okay, calm down. I need to know how to carry out my mission.
o.zh: 好好好，冷静点。我只是想知道我该怎么完成我的任务。

entries.en:
"Right, of course. We're transferring the Gate scanner to your $shipOrFleet now. I'll give you the rundown on the operation."

Coureuse pulls up a new shared holo display, a wireframe depiction of a Domain-era Gate.

An icon standing off about three diameters from the ring itself seems to represent your flagship. You recognize a diffuse bubble around it as the influence of a drive field.
entries.zh:
"对，当然了。我们现在就把星门扫描仪转交给你的$shipOrFleet。我会给你简要讲解一下任务流程。"

Coureuse 调出新的共享全息影像，这是一座 人之领 时期星门的线框模型示意图。

在距离星门约三倍于其直径的地方有一个小点，看上去应该代表着你的旗舰。你认出了包裹这个点的弥散泡，它代表的是驱动场的影响范围。

entries.en:
"You'll have to be stationed fairly close to the Gate. And you must ensure that there are no active drive fields within the Gate diameter itself."

She focuses back on the display, "Once you're in place, execute the precoded instructions. The data will encrypt itself and be sent back to me when you're in range of a hypercomm relay."

"We'll need to calibrate the hyperdimensional transform of course, so you'll need to scan six different Gates. We've already scanned the Galatia Gate, so it has to be six other Gates. Then comes the next step."
entries.zh:
"你得和星门保持相当近的距离。此外，你还必须确保星门附近没有其他活跃的驱动场。"

她的注意力再次回到显示屏上，"你就位以后，只需要执行预先设定好的指令。扫描数据会被加密，待你靠近一处通讯中继站后就会自动传输到我这里。"

"当然，我们还需要进一步校准超维度转换，所以你得{扫描六个不同的星门}。Galatia 星门已经被我们扫描过了，你需要扫描六个别的星门。然后就可以继续下一步了。"

entries.en:
"...Provost Baird said I shouldn't talk about it," Coureuse says. "But seeing as how you're in the line of fire..."

Without thinking, she glances away, then speaks quietly. "We've been calling it the Janus Device. I admit, it's premature to give it a name, but when the hyperphysics team gets excited..." She shrugs helplessly. "There's no stopping them."

"It's just-" Coureuse notices a blinking display, "The equipment transfer is complete, captain. You're good to go."
entries.zh:
"Baird 院长嘱咐我不要声张出去，" Coureuse 说道。"不过看在被推上火线的家伙是你的份上..."

像是不经意般，她把眼睛瞥向一边，小声地说道，"我们把它称为 '双面神' 装置。我承认现在给它起名还为时尚早，可一旦超物理学小组兴奋起来，" 她无奈地耸了耸肩。"就没有什么能拦住他们的了。"

"那装置是 ——" Coureuse 注意到了显示器上的闪光，"设备转交已经完成了，舰长。你可以走了。"

o.en: Great, time to scan some Gates.
o.zh: 太好了，该去扫描几个星门了。

o.en: What was that you were saying?
o.zh: 你刚才是不是想说什么？

entries.en:
She sighs unhappily. Coureuse looks more tired than you've ever seen.

"The team is eager and- and I appreciate their work. But my strength is theory, not hardware applications. It's... it's all so clumsy. And our fabrication equipment! The techs try their best, but the provost expects the world and more. She wants to push the schedule faster. It's simply too fast! I need time to refine the math, to run more equipment tests, to get top of the line components-" Coureuse stifles a yawn. "And get some sleep."

She looks away, "If Elissa was here, this would all be so simple."
entries.zh:
她烦闷地叹了口气，看上去非常疲惫不堪。

"我的团队很积极，而我也... 我感谢他们的努力工作。但我的强项是理论，我不擅长把理论变成实际应用。这东西真的太... 真的太笨重了。我们的制造设备也好不到哪去！技术人员们都尽力了，但院长怎么也不满足。她总想着把日程加快加快再加快... 时间根本不够！我需要更多时间来优化数学计算，进行更多设备测试，搞到更多优质的部件 —— " Coureuse 打了个打哈欠。"还有好好地睡些觉。"

她看着别处，"要是 Elissa 还在的话，这一切都会变得特别简单。"

o.zh: 这个 Elissa 是什么人？

entries.en:
"Someone I know. Knew. A friend, or- anyway, her name is Elissa Zal. We did... work. Together. A long time ago. She's a genius with hardware. But um, I made some mistakes, and..." She trails off as she realizes she doesn't want to continue.

One of her many displays pops an alert which chimes urgently. Coureuse snaps out of it, and dismisses the alert.
entries.zh:
"一个我认识的人。过去认识。算是朋友吧，我也 —— 总之，她的名字是 Elissa Zal。我们曾经...共事过。很久以前了。她是个硬件方面的天才。但是，嗯，我犯了些错误，结果..." Coureuse 停住了，她不想再往下说了。

她的一台显示屏发出了警报声，听起来很紧急。Coureuse 拿出显示屏解除了警报。

entries.en:
"Um," Coureuse looks at you like she's thinking; to trust you, to hide something?

"Yes. I mean at first yes. Things became complex. She got in a lot of trouble. And I don't want to make it any worse."

One of her many displays pops an alert which chimes urgently.
entries.zh:
"呃，" Coureuse 若有所思地看着你，是该信任你，还是该瞒着你？

"算是吧。一开始算是。后来事情就变复杂了。她遇上了不少麻烦。而我不想让事情变得更糟。"

她的一台显示屏发出了警报声，听起来十分紧急。

o.en: Elissa Zal, the ah friend of yours? And Cavin Pharoh.
o.zh: Elissa Zal，你那些狐朋狗友里的一个。和 Cavin Pharoh 一起的那位？

entries.en:
"Um," Coureuse looks at you like she's thinking; to trust you, to hide something? "Not exactly. I mean yes, she is and is. Or was. But she got in a lot of trouble. Not with Cavin; after that. Worse. And I don't want to make it even worse."

One of her many displays pops an alert which chimes urgently.
entries.zh:
"呃..." Coureuse 若有所思地看着你，是该信任你，还是该瞒着你？"不完全是。我是说，她算是...或者说曾经是...我的朋友。但她遇到了不少麻烦，和 Cavin 无关，是在那之后发生的。反正这次更糟，我不想让事情继续恶化。"

她的其中一台显示屏发出了警报声，听上去十分紧急。

o.en: Elissa Zal. She got me to bring you that... uh, potent krill paste.
o.zh: Elissa Zal。是她让我给你带来那个... 呃，味很冲的磷虾酱。

entries.en:
"Yes, the very one." Coureuse smiles, "That was kind of you."

She sighs, "I can't talk about it, really. Something happened a long time ago, and I wish it hadn't gone the way it did. You know? And then Elissa got in a lot of trouble. But she found a way to... to contact me. So we can talk. And we have been." Coureuse goes quiet and looks at you as if deciding whether to hide something or to trust you.

One of her many displays pops an alert which chimes urgently, breaking the spell.
entries.zh:
"对，就是她。" Coureuse 微笑，"谢谢你。"

她叹了口气，"我不能说太多，真的。很久之前，出过一些事，我真希望事情没有按那样发展。你明白吗？然后 Elissa 就扯上了不少麻烦。不过她还是找到了个办法来... 来联系上我。这样我们就能互相说点话。我们确实也说了。" Coureuse 不再出声，她看向你的眼神好像在思考着是该信任你还是该隐瞒一些事情。

她的一台显示屏发出了听起来十分紧急的警报声，打破了这沉默。

entries.en: "Sorry captain, I need to get back to work. We put together a new hyperwave rig- they're waiting for me in the test chamber. Good luck."
entries.zh: "抱歉，舰长，我该回去工作了。我们最近在研究一种超波设备 —— 他们都在测试间里等着我呢。祝你好运。"

entries.en:
The comm image stabilizes on Coureuse in her laboratory-office, surrounded by holographic projections of data tables.

"Oh," she says, looking up, "Captain $playerName. Yes, ah, Provost Baird said I'm to fill you in on the new development."

She sweeps away several displays-worth of work; arcane glyphs and diagrams collapse into unobtrusive icons.
entries.zh:
通讯器中，Coureuse 站在她的实验室兼办公室里的图像稳定下来，周围还有许多全息投影，显示着各种数据图表。

"哦。" 她抬起头，"$playerName 舰长。啊，Baird 院长让我向你汇报最新进展。"

她把占了好几个屏幕的研究工作划到一边，屏幕上挤满的古怪的符号和图形收缩成不起眼的图标。

entries.en:
"First," she says, "this is a prototype device. I told the provost that we're only part-way through the test procedures - we've been using the Galatia Gate as a test case - but I suppose if we make ongoing calibrations and update the firmware via hypercomm..."

Coureuse mumbles to herself as she starts tapping out a new checklist.
entries.zh:
"话说在前面，" 她说，"这只是一台原型设备。我跟院长也说过我们才刚进行了一部分测试程序 —— 我们一直在用 Galatia 星门作为实验对象 —— 但我认为，如果我们能够进行实时设备校准，并通过超通讯进行固件升级..."

Coureuse 一边自言自语，一边打出了一份新的核查清单。

o.en: What exactly is it you want me to do?

entries.en:
"Transmit your commission codes, please," $heOrShe says, the imperious tone relaxing slightly. "Captain."

You do, and they are confirmed.

The Hegemony $rank's demeanor changes dramatically.

"I apologize for the harsh tone, captain," $heOrShe says, "Command is really breathing down my neck on this one. It's all strictly need-to-know from those egg-heads in the tech ministry." $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head, and the meaning is clear: those meddling scientists clearly don't appreciate the grit and operational flexibility required by true military officers.
entries.zh:
"那么请传输你的雇佣协议代码，" $heOrShe说话的语气中少了一丝霸道，多了一分放松，"舰长。"

你完成传输，对方确认了接收完成。

这位霸主 $rank 的态度来了个大转弯。

"对刚才那些话我很抱歉，舰长。" $heOrShe说，"上面的人说这个任务是十万火急。技术部那些书呆子要求这任务的细节禁止向无关人员透露。" $HeOrShe摇了摇头，明摆着是想说：那些爱管闲事的科学家显然不了解，想成为一名真正的军官，需要什么样的勇气和随机应变能力。

o.en: What if I told you what was really going on here.
o.zh: 不如我把事情一五一十地告诉你。

o.en: Well, keep up the good work, $rank. Hegemony-strong!
o.zh: 嗯，好好努力，$rank。愿 霸主 强盛！

entries.en:
$Rank $personLastName blinks, and thinks for a moment. "If you were to speculate at our purpose, I cannot confirm or deny the veracity of anything you say."

"You may of course... speak freely, captain," $heOrShe says deliberately.
entries.zh:
$Rank $personLastName 眨了眨眼，觉得事情不是那么简单。"如果你怀疑我们的目的，那我们也无法证实或否认你说的一切。"

"你当然可以...畅所欲言，舰长。" 他换上一口军队腔调。

o.en: Never mind. Keep up the good work. Hegemony-strong!
o.zh: 没事了。好好努力。霸主最强大！

entries.en:
You summarize the story of the Gate research from Tomas Kallichore's failed Galatia experiment onward, leaving out inconvenient details about your own involvement. You tell of Tri-Tachyon's secret research, and the High Hegemon's tacit approval of the Galatia Academy resuming the project.

The Hegemony $rank's face freezes as you speak, and remains unnaturally still, you sense, through sheer effort of will.

"An interesting story, captain." $HeOrShe blinks rapidly, "What is your point in telling it?"
entries.zh:
你概括地讲述了自 Tomas Kallichore 那次失败的实验以来，对星门进行的研究的故事，为了方便故意省略了自己在其中的戏份。你从 速子科技 的秘密研究项目讲起，一直讲到至高霸主默许 Galatia 学院重启这一项目。

这位霸主 $rank 的表情凝固了，你能感受到对方在用纯粹的意志力掩饰着什么。

"真是有趣的故事，舰长。" $HeOrShe快速地眨了眨眼，"可是你讲这个故事的用意是什么呢？"

o.en: Your scan won't work. Mine will. I'll do the scan and give you my data.
o.zh: 你的扫描不管用，但我的管用。不如让我进行扫描，完成后我会把数据发给你。

entries.en:
There's a very long pause. "You do have a commission. I am indeed empowered to integrate your forces into a Hegemony operation on an ad-hoc basis, if conditions deem it necessary."

And more quietly, $rank $personLastName says "Daud, Rao, and the rest pushed the rules much further than this back in the Second AI War... $playerName, I am activating you as an auxiliary asset to this operation."
entries.zh:
一段很长的停顿。"你的确签署有一份雇佣协议。而我则有权将你的舰队临时整合进一次 霸主 的行动中，前提是条件允许的话。"

$personLastName $rank 压低声音说道 "在第二次 AI 战争中，Daud，Rao 以及其他人无视规矩的程度可比这严重多了... $playerName，我正式授权你的舰队作为本次行动的辅助军。"

entries.en:
"Regular forces will withdraw to a safe distance, then I am ordering you to perform your scan of this Gate. Upon completion, you will transmit your data to my flagship."

$HeOrShe stands up a little straighter, "Are my orders understood, Captain $playerName?"
entries.zh:
"常规部队会后撤到安全距离，然后我会命令你扫描这座星门。扫描完成后，你要把数据传输至我的旗舰。"

$HeOrShe挺直了身板，"理解我的命令了吗，$playerName 舰长？"

o.en: Yes $rank. I will carry them out immediately.

entries.en: "Then the mission is a go. Please proceed, captain." says the Hegemony $rank with a little smile, and cuts the comm.
entries.zh: "那么任务正式开始。请吧，舰长。" 这位 霸主 $rank 微笑着说道，随后切断了通讯。

entries.en:
The Hegemony $rank appears before you.

"Citizen!" $heOrShe barks, "This is a special naval operation zone - stay clear, or you will be fired upon."
entries.zh:
一位 霸主 $rank 出现在你面前。

"公民！" $heOrShe厉声说道，"这里是一处特别海军行动区域 —— 远离这里，否则我们就开火了。"

entries.en:
The Hegemony $rank appears before you.

"Citizen!" $heOrShe barks, "This is a special naval operation zone - stay clear, or you will be fired upon."
entries.zh:
一位 霸主 $rank 出现在你面前。

"公民！" $heOrShe厉声说道，"这里是一处特别海军行动区域 —— 远离这里，否则我们就开火了。"

entries.en:
The Hegemony $rank appears before you.

"Citizen!" $heOrShe barks, "I'm expecting that scan data. Get to it!"
entries.zh:
一位霸主 $rank 出现在你面前。

"公民！" $heOrShe厉声说道，"我等着你的扫描数据呢。快去办事吧！"

o.zh: 我和霸主签有一份雇佣协议，$rank

o.en: I need you to move your fleet away from the Gate.
o.zh: 我需要你把你的舰队从星门附近移开。

o.en: I am prepared to use force if you do not withdraw.
o.zh: 如果你不让开，我就要使用武力了。

o.en: Your operation will fail without my help.
o.zh: 没有我的帮助，你的行动是不可能成功的。

entries.en:
As the Hegemony fleet maneuvers to match, your sensors officer reports, "Lots of strangely equipped logistics ships. It's not a cache or resupply, they're just milling around. Getting some funny signals on the hyperspace manifold. It looks like some of the early Galatia Academy efforts to probe the Gates."

The Hegemony appears to be trying to join the race, though they're far behind.
entries.zh:
随着你逐渐靠近 霸主 舰队，传感器技官汇报道，"很多后勤舰船上搭载了奇怪的设备。他们不是在执行运货或补给任务，只是在漫无目的地乱转。我在超空间流形上捕捉到了些有趣的信号。它们看起来和 Galatia 学院早期对星门进行探测时产生的信号非常相似。"

看起来 霸主 也想在重启星门这件事上分一杯羹。可惜他们早已输在了起跑线上。

entries.en:
The Hegemony $rank's officious facade cracks for a moment. $HeOrShe looks shocked that you'd even make such a demand.

"Your request is absolutely denied," $heOrShe spits. "Citizen."
entries.zh:
这位 霸主 $rank 严肃的神情有那么一瞬间僵硬了。$HeOrShe看上去对你的如此要求感到很吃惊。

"这是不可能的，" $heOrShe吐了吐口水，"公民。"

entries.en:
$HisOrHer face hardens. "Threatening an officer of the Hegemony is a crime, captain. Count yourself lucky that I have a more important mission than teaching you some respect."

$HeOrShe cuts the comms.
entries.zh:
$HisOrHer的表情僵住了。"威胁 霸主 军官可是犯罪行为，舰长。你很走运，我刚好有重要任务在身，没空教你什么叫尊重。"

$HeOrShe切断了通讯。

entries.en:
After the scan is completed you order your comms officer to transmit a copy of the data to the nearby Hegemony fleet using the operational frequency provided.

With only one good data set, it's not like they'll have a major leg-up on Gate research compared to the Galatia Academy. Or Tri-Tachyon, for that matter.
entries.zh:
扫描完成后，你命令通讯军官用 霸主 提供的军用频段将一份数据副本传送给附近的霸主舰队。

霸主 手上只有这一份数据，他们几乎不可能在星门研究方面追上 Galatia 学院的进度。当然，也不太可能追上 速子科技。

entries.en: "Excuse me, citizen?" You sense $rank $personLastName reaching for the disconnect button.
entries.zh: "是吗，公民？" 你感觉 $rank $personLastName 似乎正欲切断通讯链接。

o.en: I know about the Gate scans.
o.zh: 我知道关于星门扫描的事情。

entries.en: $HeOrShe blinks. "I cannot confirm or deny any speculation concerning the nature of this confidential operation."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe眨了眨眼。"我无法证实或否认你对于这项机密任务的性质的猜测。"

o.en: Explain that you are scanning Gates as well
o.zh: 解释说你也在扫描星门

o.en: Never mind. Keep up the good work.

entries.en:
You summarize the story of the Gate research from Tomas Kallichore's failed Galatia experiment onward, leaving out inconvenient details about your own involvement. You speak of Tri-Tachyon's secret research, and the High Hegemon's tacit approval of the Galatia Academy resuming the project.

The Hegemony $rank's face freezes as you speak, and remains unnaturally still, you sense, through sheer effort of will.

"Interesting story, captain." $HeOrShe blinks rapidly, "What is your point in telling it?"
entries.zh:
你概括地讲述了自 Tomas Kallichore 那次失败的实验以来，对星门进行的研究的故事。为了方便，你省略了自己在其中的戏份。你从 速子科技 的秘密研究项目讲起，一直说到至高霸主默许 Galatia 学院重启这一项目。

这位霸主$rank的表情凝固了，你能感受到对方想掩饰什么。

"真是有趣的故事，舰长。" $HeOrShe快速地眨了眨眼，"可是你讲这个故事的用意是什么呢？"

o.en: Your scan won't work. Mine will. I'll do the scan and give you my data.
o.zh: 你的扫描没用，但是我的有用。让我进行扫描，我会把数据发给你。

o.en: Actually, never mind. Let's talk about something else.
o.zh: 其实没什么，我们谈点别的吧。

entries.en:
There's a very long pause. "There exist provisions to integrate non-naval forces into a Hegemony operation on an ad-hoc basis. If conditions deem it absolutely necessary to achieve strategic goals."

Another pause. "High Hegemon Baikal Daud opened the armories to civilian fleets during the Siege of Chicomoztoc." And more quietly, "And then Rao's antics at Ratatosk..."

The Hegemony $rank winks, then nails you with a stern look. "Captain, I am officially activating you as an auxiliary asset to this operation."
entries.zh:
经过很长的停顿。"的确有这么一条规定，允许我们临时将 霸主 海军以外的舰队作为辅助力量整合进某次行动中。前提是没有别的方式能达成我们的战略目标。"

又是一段停顿。"至高霸主 Baikal Daud 在 Chicomoztoc 被围困时，把军械库开放给了平民舰队。" 对方的声音更低了，"还有 Rao 在 Ratatosk 的古怪战术..."

这位霸主 $rank 挤了挤眼，然后看向你，好像已经下定了决心。"舰长，我正式授权你成为这次行动的辅助人员。"

entries.en:
"Regular forces will withdraw to a safe distance, then I am ordering you to perform your scan of this Gate. Upon completion, you will transmit your data to my flagship."

$HeOrShe stands up a little straighter, "Are my orders understood, Captain $playerName?"
entries.zh:
"常规部队会后撤到安全距离，然后我会命令你扫描这座星门。扫描完成后，你要把数据传输至我的旗舰。"

$HeOrShe挺直了身板，"理解我的命令了吗，$playerName 舰长？"

o.en: I will carry them out immediately.

entries.en: "Then the mission is a go. Please proceed, captain." says the Hegemony $rank with a little smile, and cuts the comm.
entries.zh: "那么任务正式开始。请吧，舰长。" 这位 霸主 $rank 微笑着说道，随后切断了通讯。

entries.en:
An appalled look manages to sneak through the Hegemony $rank's martial facade.

"Hegemony naval operations are strictly confidential," $heOrShe says. "Citizen."
entries.zh:
这位 霸主 $rank 严肃的脸上露出了一丝惊讶的神情。

"霸主 海军的行动是严格保密的，" $heOrShe说道，"公民。"

entries.en:
A silent ring of adamantine material, derelict of a former age.

You query the status of the Gate scanning package and your sensors officer gives you a quick head-shake. Their station interface is spotted with amber warning messages.

"Captain, there's some kind of interference coming from the nearby Hegemony fleet. The scanner can't make a lock."
entries.zh:
一座沉寂已久的环状结构，由坚固的材料制成，是来自上个时代的遗迹。

你询问星门扫描设备的运转状态，传感器技官只是摇了摇头，他面前的操作面板上满是橙色的警告信息。

"舰长，附近的 霸主 舰队对我们造成了一些干扰。扫描仪无法锁定目标。"

entries.en:
As your $shipOrFleet follows the automated traffic control signals into a parking orbit, your comms officer calls for your attention.

"Captain, I have an Academician Sebestyen on-link. He says it's urgent."
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet遵从自动交通管控系统的信号进入停泊轨道时，你的通讯军官叫住了你。

"舰长，有位名叫 Sebestyen 的院士想和您通话。他说是件急事。"

entries.en:
Sebestyen appears, looking anxious, which is not unusual.

"Captain $playerName! Whoever I just spoke with- well there's something to be said for common courtesy, and- oh, I should say. Hello! I hope you are well?"

Before you can answer, he continues "I apologize, but Provost Baird wants to meet with you and it's, um, important. That is to say, ah, this pertains to your previous involvement in a... study at the Galatia Academy." He pauses for a moment to let this sink in. "So do please come meet with the Provost at your earliest convenience. Thank you captain."

Sebestyen shuts off the comms without his usual attempts at small-talk.
entries.zh:
Sebestyen 出现在屏幕上，看起来很焦急，这可不常见。

"$playerName 舰长！还有不知道刚刚和我通话的那位谁 —— 替我向他问好 —— 哦，差点忘了。您好！最近还顺利吧？"

不等你回答，他便继续说道，"真是不好意思，但是 Baird 院长想和你见一面，呃，有些很重要的事情。也就是说，啊，和您之前参与的一项... Galatia 学院发起的研究有关。" 他顿了顿以便你有时间思考。"所以，麻烦你方便的时候来见一见院长。谢谢你，舰长。"

Sebestyen 没有像往常那样说几句客套话，就直接切断了通讯。

entries.en:
You enter Provost Baird's office and the thick wooden doors close softly behind you.

"Captain," Baird says, turning to you from her desk. "Good. Sit. We have much to discuss."

Going by past experience, you feel that this will be more of a lecture than a discussion.
entries.zh:
你走进院长的办公室，身后厚重的木门轻缓的关上。

"舰长，" 原本望着办公桌的 Baird 转过身来。"很好。坐吧。我们这次可有的谈了。"

根据以往的经历，你感到这次见面与其说是谈话，不如说是上课。

entries.en:
"We've rebuilt the theoretical work held in the Kallichore Archive. Academician Coureuse's research now supersedes those developments."

"The Mote induction device from the Project Ziggurat hull you discovered and scanned was key, for it demonstrates truly unorthodox hyperphysics. Tri-Tachyon's use of AI has made a breakthrough, though I suspect that the human element of Tri-Tachyon has only rudimentary theoretical understanding of what they've created."

"We're ahead of them in that respect, captain, so it shall be we who reap the ultimate prize. However."
entries.zh:
"我们已经重建了 Kallichore 的档案中的理论工作，Coureuse 院士的研究已经可以取代已有的进展。"

"你从通灵塔计划的船体中发现并扫描的光尘发生装置非常关键，因为它展示出了极为非常规的超物理学技术。速子科技使用的 AI 是这项突破的主要原因，不过我估计速子科技的人员对他们创造出的这东西的了解，还停留在极其基础的纯理论阶段。"

"在这方面我们已经领先他们了，舰长，所以斩获头奖的一定是我们。但是。"

entries.en: Baird turns back to her desk, ignoring your small rebellion.
entries.zh: Baird 转过身去，继续望着办公桌，对你的小情绪视而不见。

entries.en:
"Our hands are tied." Baird looks up, as if defying some overbearing god.

"Tomas Kallichore played Tri-Tachyon and the Hegemony off each other. It was a delicate balance and he lost control. The Hegemony was forced to act and I was forced to step forward to clean up his mess."

"It is clear that a side had to be chosen, so I have chosen the Hegemony. They are a known quantity whereas Tri-Tachyon is mercurial - and their indiscreet abuse of AI core technology threatens to open Pandora's Box for a third time."

"To this end, I must assure High Hegemon Daud that the Galatia Academy has his interests in mind as we push toward the next breakthrough. I need you to make direct contact with the top executive of the Hegemony."
entries.zh:
"我们能做的不多，" Baird 抬头看天，好像在反抗什么霸道的神明。

"Tomas Kallichore 制衡着 霸主 和 速子科技 之间的关系。但他没有掌握好这个脆弱的平衡，霸主 被迫采取行动，之后我也不得不站出来收拾他的烂摊子。"

"我们必须选一边站，这是再清楚不过了，于是我选择了 霸主。如果说 霸主 是个已知量，那速子则恰恰相反 —— 何况他们随意滥用 AI 核心科技，随时都可能第三次打开潘多拉之盒。"

"为此，我必须向至高霸主 Daud 保证，Galatia 学院在努力达成下一次突破的同时，也会考虑他的利益。我需要你去见 霸主 的最高领导人一面。"

entries.en:
"Presumably we can reassert most of the terms of the agreement Provost Tomas Kallichore had previously promised and subsequently failed to deliver to High Hegemon Daud. With," is the provost gritting her teeth?, "Additional provisions and information-sharing due to Kallichore's squandering of that trust."

"Daud needs to know that there won't be any more dramatic, destructive public experiments on his watch."
entries.zh:
"Tomas Kallichore 院长之前和至高霸主 Daud 达成过一份合约，在这合约里他做出了很多许诺，但之后都未能达成。我们或许可以对这份合约的大部分条款重新做出保证。我们还会提供，" 院长这是在咬着牙说话吗？"额外的资源供给和信息共享，作为对 Kallichore 打破这份信任的补偿。"

"Daud 需要知道，我们不会再在他的眼皮子底下做出任何引人注目还危及安全的公开实验。"

o.en: So I go to Chicomoztoc and ask to see the High Hegemon?
o.zh: 所以我得去 Chicomoztoc，然后要求和至高霸主见面？

entries.en:
"Of course not," Baird says curtly.

"The High Hegemon does not simply speak with people like you. Besides, imagine what the Luddics would think if you went to Daud's office saying 'the Galatia Academy wants to talk to you about firing up Moloch's grand experiment again'. He'd be a fool to rattle that nest of small-minded millennialists."

"What you're going to do is get diplomatic credentials from a highly-placed Persean League VIP. Your cover story is you're acting as an envoy between the Yaribay faction of Kazeron and the Hegemony."
entries.zh:
"当然不是，" Baird 简短地说。

"至高霸主不会和你这样的无名小卒谈话。更何况，如果 卢德教会 那帮人看到你走进 Daud 的办公室，说 Galatia 学院想和你谈谈重启恶魔摩洛克的伟大实验，他们恐怕会炸开了锅。他可不会傻到捅那帮头脑简单的千禧年主义者的马蜂窝。"

"你需要去拿到一名身居高位的 英仙座联盟 VIP 的外交证件。你的伪装身份是 Kazeron 的 Yaribay 氏族和 霸主 之间的一名外交特使。"

entries.en: "You are a member of the Persean League in good standing, are you not," she says. "I trust you're familiar with the political situation."
entries.zh: "你是 英仙座联盟 中声誉良好的成员，对吧，" 她说道，"我相信你熟悉当前的政治局势。"

entries.en:
"A major player in Persean League internal politics. Gens Yaribay is one of the big three Kazeron dynastic family-corporations, and they favor a... let's call it a 'compromise' which would see the Persean League unite with the Hegemony."

Baird removes her spectacles for a moment, "League-Hegemony reconciliation..."

She shakes her head incredulously. "What is important is that the Hegemony - and the Church - will accept an envoy bearing Yaribay diplomatic credentials having a private talk with High Hegemon Daud."
entries.zh:
"英仙座联盟 内部的政治巨头，Yaribay 氏族是 Kazeron 上三大家族企业之一，他们偏好一种... 就说是 '妥协' 吧，希望 英仙座联盟 和 霸主 能够统一。"

Baird 暂时取下了她的眼镜，"联盟与 霸主 和解..."

她难以置信地摇了摇头。"重要的是 霸主 —— 以及教会 —— 能够接受持有 Yaribay 外交证件的特使与至高霸主 Daud 之间的私人谈话。"

entries.en:
"My 'take' is that they're the only one out of the three gens of Kazeron who favor a... let's call it a 'compromise' which seeks to unite the Persean League with the Hegemony."

Baird removes her spectacles for a moment, "League-Hegemony reconciliation..."

She shakes her head incredulously. "What is important is that the Hegemony - and the Church - will accept an envoy bearing Yaribay diplomatic credentials having a private talk with High Hegemon Daud."
entries.zh:
"我的 '看法' 是：他们是 Kazeron 三大氏族中唯一主张...姑且称之为 '妥协' 的一方，并试图促使 英仙座联盟 与 霸主 的统一。"

Baird 暂时取下了她的眼镜，"联盟与 霸主 和解..."

她难以置信地摇了摇头。"重要的是 霸主 —— 以及教会 —— 能够接受持有 Yaribay 外交证件的特使与至高霸主 Daud 之间的私人谈话。"

entries.en:
Baird smiles coolly.

"Horus Yaribay's eldest attends the Galatia Academy. There was an incident. There usually are when the children of unimaginable wealth go out into the world. They're unaccustomed to boundaries. Imagine the shame: the scion of Gens Yaribay facing expulsion," says the provost. "Unthinkable; it'd be a bigger scandal than that Kato child trying to play revolution on Umbra."

"I'll provide you with a message for Horus Yaribay. Tell him we want to use him as cover to whisper in Hegemon Daud's ear. Horus also wants his eldest child to graduate with distinction from this prestigious academy," Baird holds her hands up in mock-innocence, "Whatever is to be done?"
entries.zh:
Baird 冷漠地笑了。

"Horus Yaribay 的长子在 Galatia 学院读书。然后发生了一点点小事故。腰缠万贯但涉世未深的孩子们步入社会时还不通人情世故，出一两件事故也是很正常的。但想想这是多大的耻辱，Yaribay 氏族的继承人面临被开除的风险。" 院长说道。"难以想象对吧；这可比那个 Kato 氏族的孩子在 Umbra 上大搞独立运动更令人唏嘘。"

"我会让你给 Horus Yaribay 送一条口信。告诉他我们想利用他的身份作为掩护，来跟至高霸主 Daud 推心置腹两句。Horus 肯定也希望他的长子能够在这所声名藉甚的学院学业有成。" Baird 假仁假义地朝两边抬起双手，"这可如何是好呢？"

entries.en:
"The Hegemony, for all its posturing about loyalty and honor," Baird smirks, "is an old collection of infighting factions and ministries. Their internal conflicts are all by the book, of course. Usually. But the book, as our Luddic friends can attest, tells a different story depending on who is doing the reading."

"Let me be blunt, captain. Many in the Hegemony would see me - and you - imprisoned or executed for what we've done. The Luddic Church hardliners pray to make an example of the Academy again, and there are enough Faithful in Hegemony ranks that keeping their secrets from the Church is difficult. Kallichore made the mistake of providing his enemies with an excuse. Now hostile eyes watch for another slip-up."

"I happen to know that Baikal Daud is open-minded about my great project, though he cannot act openly. He is, after all, the High Hegemon."
entries.zh:
"霸主 以忠诚、传统和荣誉作为伪装，" Baird 轻笑道，"它内部可是有数不清的派系和部委，为了不同的目标而无止境地进行着权力斗争。他们的斗争一般都是按部就班地按剧本来的。但是这剧本，正如我们的卢德朋友所证明的那样，根据不同的读者讲不同的故事。"

"我就直说了，舰长。霸主 的大部分人员知道了我们所做的事情，一定巴不得把我们 —— 我和你 —— 关进牢里，甚至是就地处决。卢德教会 的强硬派祈祷着把我们杀鸡儆猴，而且 霸主 统治阶层里信仰卢德的人太多了，很难对 卢德教会 守住秘密。Kallichore 犯了个错误，那就是给了敌人一个借口：现在有很多敌视的眼光盯着 Galatia 学院，就等着我们下一次失误。"

"我恰好知道 Baikal Daud 对我的伟大计划的看法比较开明，但他没法公开宣布这件事。毕竟他是至高霸主。"

entries.en:
"Yes, of course. I recall that incident."

Baird looks over her spectacles.

"A fine mess."
entries.zh:
"是，当然记得。那桩事我还记着。"

Baird 从眼镜上方看了过来。

"真是一团糟。"

o.en: So are you sure you want me to talk to Daud?
o.zh: 那您当真要我去跟 Daud 谈？

o.en: There's no need for this gens business. I can deal with Daud directly.
o.zh: 没必要扯上这些氏族里的弯弯绕。Daud 我直接应付得来。

o.en: Which they started. And I finished.
o.zh: 是他们先挑的头。收场的却是我。

entries.en:
"Yes, of course." Baird smirks. "The ministries, with their jealous fiefdoms, are not eager to repeat the circumstances which led to that conversation."

"What I am doing, captain, is providing you with a politically acceptable cover story. You've made enemies aplenty. Many in the Hegemony would see me - and you - imprisoned or executed for what we've done. The Luddic Church hardliners pray to make an example of the Academy again, and there are enough Faithful in Hegemony ranks that keeping secrets is difficult. Kallichore erred in providing his enemies with an excuse. Now hostile eyes watch for another slip-up."

"I happen to know that Baikal Daud is open-minded about my great project, though he cannot act freely. He is, after all, the High Hegemon. You of all people should understand this."
entries.zh:
"那是自然。\" Baird 嘴角一挑。\"各部门各守着自家的一亩三分地，谁也不想再闹出上回那样一场谈话。"

"舰长，我这是在给你备一个政治上说得过去的说辞。你得罪的人够多了。霸主里头不知多少人，恨不得把我们 —— 我，还有你 —— 因为我们做过的事投进大牢，甚至拉出去枪毙。银河救赎教会的强硬派天天祷告，盼着再拿学院杀鸡儆猴；霸主队伍里信卢德的又太多，想守住什么秘密都难。Kallichore 错就错在给了对头一个把柄。如今有的是敌视的目光盯着，就等我们再出一回纰漏。"

"我恰好知道，Baikal Daud 对我那桩大计是抱开放态度的，只是他身不由己。毕竟他是至高霸主。这道理，你比谁都该懂。"

entries.en:
"Yes." She puts on a small, satisfied smile.

"It'll teach Daud that he has to compromise. He wants a connection to Gens Yaribay and he's going to have to deal with me on terms I set - with you."
entries.zh:
"不错。" 她浮起一抹心满意足的浅笑。

"这能叫 Daud 明白，他非让步不可。他想攀上 Gens Yaribay 这条线，就得按我定的规矩来谈 —— 还得带上你。"

entries.en:
"For what I think ought to be obvious reasons he will not be enthusiastic to speak with you."

She puts on a small, satisfied smile.

"But I'm going to teach Daud that he has to compromise. He wants a connection to Gens Yaribay and he's going to have to deal with me on terms I set - with you - to get it."
entries.zh:
"出于某些我觉得不说自明的理由，他不会乐意同你交谈。"

她露出一抹志得意满的浅笑。

"可我正要教 Daud 学会妥协。他想和 Yaribay 氏族搭上线，就得照我划下的道、经你的手来谈，才拿得到。"

entries.en:
"Yes, well done," Baird says facetiously. "I hope you'll allow yourself to play the part in a slightly more subtle maneuver, however."

She puts on a small, satisfied smile.

"I'm going to teach Daud that he has to compromise. He wants a connection to Gens Yaribay and he's going to have to deal with me on terms I set - with you - to get it."
entries.zh:
"是啊，干得漂亮，\" Baird 语带调侃。\"不过这回的戏码要更讲究些，还望你肯配合把角色演下去。"

她露出一抹志得意满的浅笑。

"可我正要教 Daud 学会妥协。他想和 Yaribay 氏族搭上线，就得照我划下的道、经你的手来谈，才拿得到。"

entries.en:
"A demarchon." Baird speaks the title with dismissive amusement.

"It is the gens that control Kazeron - and half the member-worlds, besides. And Kazeron is the League."

"If you do not bear accreditation in the name of Hannan, Yaribay, or Kato then you're not going to be taken seriously."
entries.zh:
"统领。" Baird 带着轻蔑的趣味念出了这个头衔。

"掌控 Kazeron 的是氏族势力 —— 此外还包括半数成员星球，而 Kazeron 即代表联盟。"

"若你持有的授权不是以 Hannan、Yaribay 或 Kato 氏族的名义，便不会有人拿正眼看你。"

entries.en:
"Go to Kazeron, in the Thule system," Baird says. "Remind Horus Yaribay of how he and I stand."

"Then, when you meet High Hegemon Daud, tell him that the rewards of the Galatia Academy's research will be exclusive this time. I'll provide you the documents to give him."
entries.zh:
"去 Thule 星系的 Kazeron，" Baird 说，"提醒 Horus Yaribay 我们的立场是什么。"

"等你见到至高霸主 Daud，告诉他这次 Galatia 学院的研究的回报是独家的。我稍后会给你准备交给他的文件。"

entries.en:
"Go to Kazeron," Baird says. "Remind your fellow League demarchon Horus Yaribay of how he and I stand."

"Then, when you meet High Hegemon Daud, tell him that the rewards of the Galatia Academy's research will be exclusive this time. I'll provide you the documents to give him."
entries.zh:
"去 Kazeron，" Baird 说，"提醒你的联盟同僚，那位 Horus Yaribay 统领，我们的立场是什么。"

"等你见到至高霸主 Daud，告诉他这次 Galatia 学院的研究的回报是独家的。我稍后会给你准备交给他的文件。"

o.en: What's your take on Gens Yaribay?
o.zh: 你对 Yaribay 氏族有何看法？

o.en: Why would this Yaribay person help me? Or you?
o.zh: 这个姓 Yaribay 的为什么会想帮我？或者帮你？

o.en: Why would Gens Yaribay help you?
o.zh: Yaribay 氏族为什么会帮你？

o.en: Why can't you talk directly to the Hegemon?
o.zh: 为什么你不亲自去和至高霸主见一面？

o.en: I've met with Daud before. It was a tense conversation.
o.zh: 我从前见过 Daud。那次谈得挺僵。

o.en: Get credentials from Yaribay, talk to the Hegemon. Got it.
o.zh: 从 Yaribay 那里搞到证书，然后和至高霸主谈几句。明白了。

o.en: I'm technically a demarchon of the League. I could speak with Daud.
o.zh: 严格来说，我是联盟的统领之一。我可以与 Daud 面谈。

o.en: Inform the agent that the Provost is expecting you for a meeting
o.zh: 通知工作人员院长正准备见你一面

entries.en:
The provost turns from you, to look out the diamond-matrix windows of her office. "Once the High Hegemon's cooperation is settled, we can proceed to the active experimentation stage."

You can tell she's smiling now, as if she can't help herself, "Coureuse's team is putting the finishing touches on a Gate scanner. We'll need more data, and we need you to collect it. Go and speak with her about this. Do whatever she requires."
entries.zh:
院长转过身去，看向她办公室的金刚石方窗。"等我们确定了至高霸主会合作，就可以进行到主动实验阶段了。"

你看出她在笑，好像不能自已。" Coureuse 的团队马上就要完成{星门扫描仪}了。我们需要更多的数据，这需要你来收集。去跟她谈谈吧，尽量满足她的需求。"

entries.en: You understand well enough by now that this is your cue to leave, and on cue you feel the doors open behind you. The mirror-masked guard awaits.
entries.zh: 你知道这代表着你该离开了，不出所料，你感到身后的大门被打开了，戴着镜面面罩的守卫等在那。

entries.en:
"Provost Baird. Captain $playerName," Coureuse greets you.

"Explain the Janus Device," Baird says, "For the captain here."
entries.zh:
"Baird 院长，$playerName 舰长，" Coureuse 向你们问好。

"解释一下 '双面神' 装置 吧，" Baird 说，"这位舰长对此还一无所知呢。"

entries.en:
She looks nervous. "The prototype device," she begins, "Yes. In the um broad strokes, to scan for the Gate aperture, we direct a self-modifying phased hyperwave pulse which causes a resonation in lower dimensions which-"

She looks up from the projected schematic and notices she's losing her audience. "Let's skip ahead to the application section." The schematics flicker through several labyrinthine arrangements and settle on an action flowchart. "Here we are."

"The principle of the Janus prototype is similar to the scanner, but far more energetic. By tuning the pulse to the unique resonant signature of a particular Gate aperture, one might - theoretically - activate that link. A second input would then target a known Gate egress, though avoiding destructive interference in the Calabi-Yau manifold is tricky..."
entries.zh:
她看上去有些紧张。"这台原型设备是，" 她开口道，"是的，大体来讲，为了扫描星门圆环，我们使用的是一束能自修改的相位超空间脉冲波，这个脉冲波能在低维度引发共振，然后共振会导致 —— "

她抬头看向投影图，注意到你应该完全没有听懂，"我们直接说这装置该怎么用。" 示意图在几个迷宫般的界面中闪烁，最终停在了一张运行流程图上。

"这台 '双面神' 装置 原型机的原理和星门扫描仪很相似，不同之处在于它输出的能量远远超过任何普通扫描仪。如果我们对这束脉冲波进行微调，让它完美符合某个特定的星门圆环的共振特征，我们就能 —— 理论上能 —— 激活那个链接。另一个输入数据可以是任何已知的星门出口，不过想要在卡拉比-丘流形中避免毁坏性的干扰还是有些困难的..."

o.en: So this would reopen the Gate network?
o.zh: 所以这东西能重启星门网络？

entries.en:
Baird cuts in, "Not exactly. Thank you for your attention to detail, Scylla, but if I may summarize: at this level of energy input, a temporary link should be created between two Gates."

The provost gets a distant look, "Then, with sufficient energy in stable resonance injected into the entire Gate system..."
entries.zh:
Baird 打断道，"倒也没那么困难。谢谢你细心的讲解，Scylla，不过我想总结一下：利用如此高的能量输入，我们应该能在两座星门之间建立暂时的连接。"

院长眺望着远方，"然后，如果我们对整个星门网络灌进足够多的，能够稳定共振的能量..."

entries.en:
This time, Coureuse interrupts, "But the data! It shows that the system, the resonance, it is fundamentally chaotic! There are clearly some other, some factors... we're seeing results the model doesn't account for, and at higher magnitudes the results could be, be-" She searches for words, some way to bind chaos and destruction into quantified language.

"That's enough, academician," Baird says forcefully. "The captain is a highly skilled professional and doesn't need to hear all of this to do their job."
entries.zh:
这次换 Coureuse 插话了，"但是这些数据！数据显示星门系统，这些共振从根本上就是混沌的！一定还有其他的什么影响因素... 我们观测到的一些结果根本就不符合我们建立的模型，而且在更大尺度上，结果可能会，会是 ——" 她寻找着一些能量化描述混乱和破坏的词语。

"够了，院士，" Baird 厉声说道。"我们的舰长是一位训练有素的专业人士，不用听你的长篇大论，也能做好他们的工作。"

o.en: The Provost is right, I am more of a big-picture type leader.
o.zh: 院长是对的，我是个大局型的领导者。

o.en: Academician, what exactly does 'chaotic' mean in this context?
o.zh: 院士，你说的 '混沌' 具体是什么意思？

entries.en:
Baird turns to you, leaving Coureuse cowed, "Academician Coureuse will return to work refining the details as more data is gathered. As a great man once said, 'Technological advance is an inherently iterative process.'"

"Captain," she says, "The first prototype Janus Device is being transferred to your $shipOrFleet. Test it on a Gate manifold you have scanned. Record everything with your sensor suite and the modified instruments we have provided. This may be the most important experiment in the history of the Persean Sector."
entries.zh:
Baird 转向你，不顾看上去有些畏畏缩缩的 Coureuse，"Coureuse 院士会继续她的工作，从更多数据中提炼更有用的信息。一位伟人曾说过，'技术进步本质上是一个迭代过程。'"

"舰长，" 她说，"我们的第一台 '双面神' 装置 原型机现在正被转移到你的$shipOrFleet上。找一个你已经扫描过的星门流形测试一下它吧。用你的传感器和我们提供的设备记录一切数据。这可能是英仙座星域历史上最重大的实验了。"

o.zh: 星门... 流形。当然了，没问题。

entries.en:
Coureuse speaks up one last time, "Just, just don't use it in an inhabited system. Like the incident when Kallichore... the Hegemony... it wouldn't be good."

"Thank you," Baird says acidly, "For the reminder. Academician."

The provost turns to you now, "Obviously we shall not repeat my predecessor's mistake. Test this somewhere quiet." She turns from the holodisplay, a dismissal "I await your results, captain."

Baird terminates the comms.
entries.zh:
Coureuse 最后一次开口，"只是，只是别在有人居住的星系里试用。想想 Kallichore 时期的那次事故... 然后霸主... 恐怕没有好事的。"

"谢谢你，" Baird 尖刻地说，"你的温馨提示很有用。院士。"

院长现在转向了你，"我们当然不能重蹈前任院长的覆辙。还是找个安静的地方测试这设备吧，" 她的注意力回到了全息显示屏上，给出了逐客令，"我等着你的结果，舰长。"

Baird 关闭了通讯。

entries.en:
Kanta speaks again, raising a gauntleted arm for emphasis, "We know the Family is safe so we will not take your blood."

"Not yet," her voice grinds like the servos of a blast-door.

"Lucky you," the doctor whispers, smiling, then speaks louder, "The great Warlord is wondering, why would a thief dare show their face before mighty Kanta? The warlord makes an art of correcting those who hold the misguided belief that they may steal from her."

His spindly arm extends to indicate something piled in the dark around Kanta's throne; round shapes in the shadows, a glint of ivory.
entries.zh:
Kanta 抬起一只戴着手套的胳膊强调，又说道："咱家知道家族是安全的，所以咱家不会要你的命，至少今天不会。"

"你很幸运，" 医生微笑着小声说道，然后大声说，"伟大的军阀很想知道，为什么一个小偷敢在强大的 Kanta 前露脸？军阀会用艺术性的方法纠正那些错误地认为可以从她那里偷走东西的人。"

他纤细的手臂伸出，指示着堆在 Kanta 王座暗处的一些东西，在阴影中有一些圆形的东西，闪着象牙色光芒。

entries.en:
A murmur in the pirates of the court. Doctor Cydonia looks quickly to Kanta to gauge how he should react. She is motionless, making only the sound of her life support machinery.

He scurries up her throne to whisper and, presumably, listen. Satisfied after a short conference, the doctor stands forward to address you.

"The great warlord is intrigued, $playerName," Cydonia says, relishing the drama "She has heard your name before; her family is many and her subjugants watch from the shadows all across the sector. What do you bring to the feet of her warlordship?"

The mask-face of Kanta watches dispassionately.
entries.zh:
殿堂中的海盗们发出低语声。Cydonia 医生快速地看向 Kanta 来判断他应该作何反应。她面无表情，只有她的维生装置发出声音。

他快步走上她的王座低声耳语，或是倾听。短暂的讨论后，医生满意地退回来向你宣布。

"伟大的军阀很感兴趣，$playerName "，Cydonia 说道，十分享受着这样的表演，"她过去听说过你的名字，她的家族广大且她的追随者们从阴影处观察着整个星域。你为军阀足下带来了什么？"

戴面具的 Kanta 静静地看着。

entries.en:
Cydonia hunches forward, and speaks quietly, "Simply access? Or no- your demand is the whole of the person? Kanta went through much trouble to acquire that asset and is loath to give it up.
