But," his eyes twitch, accessing cybernetic implants, "We understand that your abilities are exceptional and you have access to, ahhh, high places. Special technologies. I may be able to convince Kanta to let you have the asset if you serve well, just-"

Kanta's voice booms out again, "Bring me back my pet Loke; then Zal is yours. Blood for blood. The Pather called Cotton will be taught Kanta's justice!"
entries.zh:
Cydonia 弯着腰走上前，平静地说，"就只是见个面？或者说，不 —— 你想要这个人？Kanta经历了很多困难才得到这个人才，并且她也不愿舍弃。但是，" 他的眼睛抽搐了一下，访问了其中的电子植入物，"我们了解你非凡的能力，并且你已经身处，呃...高位。特别是科技方面。我可能能够说服 Kanta 来让你得到这个人才，如果你干得好的话，只是 ——"

Kanta 的声音又突然响起，"把咱的宠物 Loke 带回来；然后 Zal 就是你的了。以血还血。名叫 Cotton 的左径会领教 Kanta 的制裁！"

entries.en:
Cydonia cringes at her demand and smiles apologetically as he steps back to address the court.

"The great warlord will have her pet returned! This $playerName, this will be her champion where all others have failed!"

He leans close to you, smelling of vinegar.
entries.zh:
Cydonia 因她的要求而感到难堪，他歉意地笑着并退后一步向王庭内通告。

"伟大的军阀会让她的宠物回来的！由于所有其他人都失败了，$playerName 将作为她的冠军去完成别人所无法完成的这项任务！"

他靠近你，散发着一股尖酸刻薄的味道。

entries.en:
Cydonia speaks quickly and quietly to you, eyes flickering with words and images only he can see. "Brother Livewell Cotton, a rising star of the Luddic Path. Based out of the planet Epiphany in the Al Gebbar system, generally. He could be many places however. One of his cells kidnapped Kanta's pet, a clone of the former warlord Onesimos Loke and my creation. She wants her pet back. No one else has managed to track Cotton down."

"She's," he frowns, hesitant to reveal something, then gives in. "She's obsessed. It's made things... difficult. Do this and you may relieve me of Zal as well, that, that meddling tinker."
entries.zh:
Cydonia 轻快地与你说着话，眼睛里闪烁着只有他自己能看到的单词和图像。"Livewell Cotton 修士，卢德左径 的新星，通常待在位于 Al Gebbar 星系，Epiphany 行星的基地中。但他也可能在其他地方。他的一个爪牙绑架了 Kanta 的宠物 —— 前军阀 Onesimos Loke 的克隆人，也是我的作品。她想找回她的宠物，但没有其他人能够追踪到 Cotton。"

"她，" 他皱着眉，犹豫要不要继续透露些什么，然后让步了。"她心神不宁，这也让事情变得... 更加困难。去完成这件事，也许你能从我这里得到 Zal，就是那个，那个多管闲事的修理匠。"

o.en: I'm going to need some kind of guarantee.
I'd like to discuss additional terms.
o.zh: 我想进一步讨论额外的条款。

o.en: I don't agree to these terms.

entries.en:
Ignoring your words, Cydonia turns abruptly to the court and gives a shrill cry, "It is agreed! This captain will return the great warlord's pet-Loke! Watch now and be educated- this, this is how you serve the great warlord!"

Kanta claps once with her gauntlets, like an airlock slamming shut, and stands. Noise erupts from the court; Cydonia retreats to her side and guards step forward to lead you away.

Your hearing before the warlord's court is over.
entries.zh:
无视了你的话语，Cydonia 突然向御座前的人们嘶吼到，"同意了！这个舰长会找回伟大军阀的宠物 —— Loke！看好了，学着点 —— 这，这就是你服务伟大军阀的方式！"

Kanta 用她的手套拍了一下，发出像是气闸门突然关闭的声音，然后站了起来。王庭上爆发出喧闹声；Cydonia 退回她的身边，护卫们走上前来领你离开。

军阀的御前会见就在你听到这一切之后结束了。

entries.en:
You meet a tired-looking Zal in an assault shuttle bay.

"I suppose I should thank you, captain," she says, wiping a thin dusting of carbon ash from her face.

"What a glorious wreck your invasion has made of everything. At least we saved the-" she looks sharply at a pair of marines hauling a sealed case behind her, "Careful with that! It's going to save us all."

Your adjutant interrupts, "Captain, we have a problem."
entries.zh:
在一个突击穿梭机的舱室里，你见到了看起来很疲惫的 Zal。

"我想我应该感谢你，舰长，" 她说着，从脸上擦去了一层薄薄的碳灰。

"你的进攻让一切毁得多么彻底。至少我们救出了 —— " 她尖锐地看向了两个陆战队员，他们在她后面拖着一个密封的箱子，"注意那个东西！它会拯救我们所有人。"

你的副官打断了谈话，"舰长，我们有麻烦了。"

entries.en:
You're filled in via comms as you rush back to the bridge.

Kanta's comms are still offline, but she seems to have independent control of the stealth mine system. Tactical reports an envelope of mines closing around your $shipOrFleet. Some are simple rocks with hidden warheads and neutral gas thrusters, others have been loitering in phase-space for Ludd-knows how long. There are more than PD can possibly handle.
entries.zh:
当你赶回舰桥的时候，你的通讯终端便立刻被大量的信息所塞满。

Kanta 的通讯器依然处于离线状态，但她似乎能独立控制隐形空雷系统。战术军官向你报告道，一波空雷正在接近你的$shipOrFleet。其中一些只是装有惰性气体推进器藏有弹头的普通石块，但另一些则是只有圣卢德老爷子才知道它们在相位空间游荡了多久的空雷。这些空雷已经远远超出点防御系统的处理极限。

o.zh: 战术军官，我们有哪些选项？

entries.en:
Tactical sweats at your inquiry, "Sir-"

Zal appears behind you, held back by a couple guards. "Captain! Please listen- the stealth mines are on their own network. You have to get her to deactivate them."

She pauses for just a moment, then says "You have something Kanta values more than taking revenge on you. Or me."
entries.zh:
在你的询问的时候，战术军官正汗出如浆不知所措，"长官 ——"

Zal 出现在你身后，被两个护卫拦住。"舰长！请听我说 —— 隐形空雷在它们独立的网络上。你必须让她来解除它们。"

她停顿了一会儿，说："你有一些 Kanta 比起向你或是我报仇更看重的东西。"

o.en: Security- toss the Loke clone out an airlock. With a helmet.
o.zh: 警卫，把克隆人 Loke 扔出气闸。给他戴着头盔。

o.en: Security- toss the Loke clone out an airlock.
o.zh: 警卫，把克隆人 Loke 扔出气闸。

entries.en:
"Sir," your officer says, "Ah-"

Zal appears behind you, held back by a couple guards. "Captain! Please listen- Kanta had me working on a new generation of the stealth mines. I've got the codes to blow them, which might give us a chance."

"Just let me access a wide-array comms station and I'll do it."
entries.zh:
"长官..." 你的军官说到，"呃..."

Zal 出现在你身后，被两个护卫拦住。"舰长！请听我说 —— Kanta 过去让我开发新一代隐形空雷，因此我拿到了它们的破解代码，这可能可以给我们机会。"

"只要让我操控一个宽阵列通讯站，我就能做到。"

entries.en:
Zal shoves aside your comms officer, who looks only somewhat offended, and starts furiously tapping at the controls. Within moments, a careless handful of novas blink across the tactical display.

"I hate how the interface whites out when that happens," your tactical officer grumbles, then reports "Captain, the stealth mines are cleared enough for us to disengage."
entries.zh:
Zal 推开你的通讯军官，这让后者看起来有点愠愤。然后 Zal 开始急切地操作控制面板。片刻之后，数道杂乱的爆炸火光出现在了战术面板的屏幕中。

"我讨厌那个爆炸白屏效果。" 战术军官抱怨着报告，"舰长，隐形空雷已经被清理得足够我们撤离了。"

entries.en:
You oversee the raid from your bridge, your $shipOrFleet providing EW cover and sporadic fire support for the breaching drones and marine shuttles.

The raid hinges on mere minutes of chaos, all comms crackling with static and only tightbeam relays able to pierce the rain of EM scatter amidst clouds of chaff. Casualty reports roll in, displays in your bridge bleeding more and more red to fill the space with a bloody glow. In the confusion, more than one team reports success. This can be sorted out later- as quickly as they arrived, your forces perform an orderly withdrawal, though battered and depleted.
entries.zh:
你在舰桥上监视着这场袭击，你的$shipOrFleet为那些突击无人机和陆战队穿梭机提供电子战掩护以及零星的火力支援。

劫掠的成败将在几分钟的混乱中决定，所有通信频道都充斥着静电杂音；在杂波与干扰信号形成的云层中，唯有定向中继器能穿透这股电磁风暴。伤亡报告不断传来，舰桥显示屏上的数据泛红，将整个舱室都笼罩在一片血色光晕之中。在混乱之中，多个行动小组报告了成功的消息。这些消息可以之后再分辨 —— 他们刚返回，你的部队就开始有秩序地撤退，尽管都精疲力竭，伤痕累累。

entries.en: Sporadic gunfire rattles through the corridors of Kanta's Den for a long time after your marines pull out.
entries.zh: 你的陆战队员撤出后，零星的枪声响彻 Kanta 之巢的走廊，持续了很长时间。

o.zh: 考虑可以采取的军事行动

entries.en:
You convene your senior officers to discuss an extraction scenario for Elissa Zal. Kanta's Den is swarming with heavily armed gangs and is enveloped by a stealth mine network. You also lack any real intel pertaining to Zal's position within the station. The potential cost and difficulty of the raid is therefore projected to be extreme. High attrition of assault shuttles must be assumed, and a dozen separate infiltration squads would have to simultaneously breach volumes where Zal could be held.

There's no way the operation will be anything but a meat grinder. It would also be a blatant attack upon Kanta which would provoke pirates across the Sector, if that even matters anymore.
entries.zh:
你召集你的上级军官们商议营救 Elissa Zal 的方案，被隐形空雷网络环绕的 Kanta 之巢 内充斥着全副武装的帮派暴徒，同时你也缺少关于 Zal 所在位置的可靠情报，因此预计劫掠行动的成本和难度都极高。突击穿梭机的高损耗也需要纳入考量当中，因为需要十几队相互孤立的渗透小组同时闯入所有 Zal 可能被关押的舱室。

这次行动不可避免会成为绞肉机，这也会是一次对 Kanta 的公然袭击，甚至可能会激怒整个星域的海盗。

entries.en:
Doctor Cydonia pulls back, shocked at your directness, glancing to Kanta to gauge how he should react.

He scurries up her throne to whisper in her ear and listen. Satisfied after a short conference, the doctor stands forward to address you.

"The great warlord is intrigued by your knowledge of her queendom," Cydonia intones, relishing the drama. "When the outer family and the great Kanta's watchful subjugants from all across the sector whispered about the cleverness of the Captain $playerName, their words were no mere neutrino ghosts."
entries.zh:
Cydonia 医生退后一步，震惊于你的直白，瞥向 Kanta 来判断他该作何反应。他快步走上她的王座低声耳语并倾听。短暂的讨论后，医生满意地退回来向你宣布。

"伟大军阀对于你关于她的女王统治的了解程度很感兴趣。" Cydonia 说道，十分享受着这样的表演，"家族外围人员以及伟大 Kanta 遍布全星域的警惕追随者们都传言过 $playerName 舰长的聪明才智，看来这并不仅仅是中微子幽灵那样毫无来由。"

entries.en: His voice darkens, "But here your journey comes to an end, captain. Such insolence!" He motions to guards, who raise weapons, "The warlord will-"
entries.zh: 他的声音变得不快，"但在这里你的路途就到尽头了，舰长，你太无礼了！" 他示意卫兵们举起武器，"军阀大人会 ——"

entries.en:
With a clank, Kanta herself stands, and her amplified voice drowns out Doctor Cydonia. "We see a predator, a hunter, a trickster, a warrior. We see a weapon. We would wield you."

The cowering Doctor Cydonia licks his lips and turns back to you, "Her ruthlessness would wield you," he admits, then addresses the court, "Glory and riches flow to those who the warlord so honors!"
entries.zh:
在一声金属声中，Kanta 自己站了起来，她用更大的声音淹没了 Cydonia 医生。"咱家看到了一个捕食者，一个猎人，一个骗徒，一个勇士。咱家看到了一件武器，咱家会挥舞你。"

畏缩的 Cydonia 医生舔了舔嘴唇转向你，"她会无情地挥舞你，" 他承认道，然后在王庭上宣布，"愿荣耀和财富流向军阀如此尊敬的人！"

o.zh: 我要带走 Zal 作为报酬。

entries.en:
As you are led away, a trembling, bruised man held by two power-armored goons makes pleading eye contact with you. His audience is next.

You are led back through the supplicants and courtiers. Shuffling figures gleaming crimson, chrome, and gold, many eyes fall upon you. You feel their hate as Kanta - or is it Cydonia? - wields you like a bludgeon to shame them.
entries.zh:
当你被带走的时候，一个浑身颤抖，充满伤痕的人被两个重装打手押运着。他用充满恳求的目光看着你。接下来是他的觐见。

你被带领穿过恳求者与侍从之间。各种身影闪烁着深红，铬色以及金色的光芒。许多双眼睛落在了你的身上。你能感受到他们对于 Kanta，或是 Cydonia 的恨意 —— 他挥舞着你这个大棒来羞辱他们。

entries.en:
You have an angle, at least, dubious though it may be: Brother Livewell Cotton. Epiphany. The clone of Onesimos Loke.

A pirate captain, tattooed with skulls and festooned with bandoleers shoves past you mumbling about boot-lickers. Your guards tense, but relax as the pirate and their entourage proceed. They're posturing, not looking for a fight. Despite Kanta - or Cydonia - poisoning your reputation with the pirates at-large, they won't dare stand in your way while you carry out the will of Warlord Kanta.
entries.zh:
你至少有了切入点，尽管不太有把握：Livewell Cotton 修士，Epiphany 行星，Onesimos Loke 的克隆人。

一名纹着骷髅与弹链的海盗舰长推搡着穿过你，口里嘟哝着你是个马屁精什么的。你的保镖们紧张起来，但随着海盗和他们的保镖们不断经过，也都放松下来。他们只是做做样子，并不想惹事。尽管 Kanta —— 或是 Cydonia —— 让你在海盗中有了个走狗一样的名声，但也让他们丝毫不敢阻碍挂着军阀 Kanta 名号做事的你。

entries.en:
Gargoyle's face appears, projected over the expansive desk. "Where are they," Baird demands, "By Ludd's seven hells I will sell you piece by piece to Tri-Tach if you lie to me."

The hacker goes very still. Staring at the hissing crack in a bulkhead threatening to collapse into vacuum. "I do not know," Gargoyle says deliberately. "I did not assist them in... in some scheme. Though perhaps I did, though they never said it was their intention. I simply... provided tools they requested. Codes, programs. Advice."

"So you helped them!" Baird shouts. "For the protection I provided, asking the High Hegemon himself to overlook your crimes, you repay me with this treachery?"
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 的脸从桌上的全息影像中浮现出来。"他们在哪？" Baird 威胁道，"卢德的七重地狱在上，如果你对我撒谎，我会把你大卸八块之后一块块地卖给 速子科技！"

这名黑客不为所动，只是看着他对面那张几乎要扭曲开裂的脸。"我不知道，" Gargoyle 从容地说道，"在某种程度上，我并没有协助他们... 尽管我可能真的做过，但是他们从来没说那是他们的目的。我只是...提供了他们要的工具。编码、程序、建议。"

"所以你确实帮了他们！" Baird 咆哮道，"枉我如此保护你，请求至高霸主忽略你的罪行。你就用这种背叛来回报我？"

entries.en:
With Baird's attention thoroughly, and increasingly furiously, focused elsewhere, you pour yourself a glass, sample the fumes, and sip. Some kind of brandy. Eventide, judging by the label - a stylized arc of solar mirrors over a celestial orb.

A fine vintage; subtle, powerful, unexpected. You're beginning to suspect that this might be the highlight of the rest of this day.
entries.zh:
Baird 的注意力完全集中在其他地方，并开始越来越激动。你趁机给自己来上了一杯，品味着香气，浅抿了一口，是白兰地。你看了一眼瓶标，一轮代表恒星反射镜的弧线悬在天球之上，看来产地应该是 Eventide。

这还真是一杯佳酿，纤柔而有力，伴着一丝琢磨不透的回味。你开始觉得这杯酒会是你今天最精彩的部分了。

entries.en:
Gargoyle holds up a hand, "No, you- look, I admit I suspected something, but I didn't ask. You gave me explicit instructions to fulfill any request, anything, made by Scylla."

You can tell the hacker is repressing an impish smile, "I have the recording. 'Do anything Coureuse says,' you said, 'And I don't want you to ask any more inane questions.' I believe those were your exact words."
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 举起一只手，"不，你...这么说吧，我承认我曾经怀疑过，但是我没问。毕竟你下达了明确的指示，让我满足 Scylla 提出的任何要求，任何物品。"

你能看出黑客有点止不住想要坏笑。"我有录音。你之前说的：'Coureuse 说什么就做什么。我不想听到任何无聊的问题。' 我相信那是你的真话。"

entries.en:
Coureuse joins the call, alert and expectant.

"Captain!" she says, "And uh, provost. We've all been watching the feeds and- I've been in contact with Elissa. Thank you, thank you captain."

The provost raises an eyebrow. Prompted, Coureuse explains "Elissa built a working Janus device and gave it to the captain. She's brought us the full schematics."

"I should like to meet this Elissa Zal," the provost says evenly.
entries.zh:
Coureuse 这时加入了通话，既警觉又期待。

"舰长！" 她说，"呃...还有院长。我们都在看反馈信息，另外 —— 我已经联系到了 Elissa。谢谢你，谢谢你舰长。"

院长挑了挑眉毛。Coureuse 注意到了，就向她解释道："Elissa 制造了正常运行的 '双面神' 装置并把它交给了舰长，她给我们提供了完整的设计图。"

"我想见见这个 Elissa Zal，" 院长平静地说。

entries.en:
"Elissa Zal," Baird says. You can almost feel her judging through the comm-link. "This is all very... surprising," she says, off balance. "Academician Coureuse. Zal. We have much to discuss, but first get those schematics to the hyperspace labs."

"And captain," the provost addresses you now, "If you would come directly to my office. We ought not discuss details of the next stage on comms."
entries.zh:
"Elissa Zal。" Baird 说，你甚至能隔着通讯链接感受到她批评的态度，"这些都非常...令人惊讶。" 她突然说道。"Coureuse 院士，Zal，我们还有很多东西要讨论。但首先，把那些设计图送到超空间实验室。"

"还有你，舰长。" 院长对你说道，"可以的话，你直接来我的办公室。下一阶段的详情不适合在通讯中讨论。"

entries.en:
"Hello provost," Zal says, "Finally we speak. I've heard so, so much about you."

It is a small thing, but you watch as Baird suppresses first shock, then a flash of anger at her comms being joined without invitation.
entries.zh:
"你好，院长，" Zal 说，"我们终于有机会好好谈谈了。我听说过许多关于你的事，很多很多。"

虽然并不明显，但你注意到 Baird 先是压抑住了自己的震惊，然后闪过了一丝对不请自来加入通讯的愤怒。

entries.en: You take your shuttle to the Galatia Academy. Elissa Zal sits across from you, smiling to herself.
entries.zh: 你驾驶穿梭机前往 Galatia 学院。Elissa Zal 坐在你对面，自顾自地微笑着。

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName," Baird says. "We observed your $shipOrFleet come through the Gate."

"It was magnificent." She takes a deep breath, looking up and away for a moment, then back to you. "History has leapt forward for the first time in two hundred cycles."

"Scylla," the provost says suddenly, "She should hear this so she knows why I had to do all that I did. I'll link her in."
entries.zh:
"舰长 $playerName，" Baird 说。"我们观测到你的$shipOrFleet穿过星门而来。"

"太壮观了。" 她深呼吸了一次，抬头向远方望了一会儿，然后转向你。"两百年了，历史终于再次跨步向前。"

"Scylla，" 院长突然说，"她需要知道这件事，这样她就能理解我为什么坚持去做那些事了。我要连线她。"

entries.en: "Captain," Baird greets you, in her way. "We've been hearing the strangest rumors over hypercomms," she says expectantly.
entries.zh: "舰长，" Baird 用她特有的方式向你问候，"我们已经不断地从超空间通讯器收听到最奇怪的传闻。" 她的语气满怀期待。

entries.en: Zal meets your eyes. "Always," she says.
entries.zh: Zal 看向你的眼睛。"一直都是这样，" 她说。

entries.en: Zal rolls her eyes at you and fails to suppress a smile.
entries.zh: Zal 忍不住笑着对你翻了个白眼。

entries.en:
You enter Provost Baird's office and she greets you with uncharacteristic warmth.

"Come in, come in. Make yourself comfortable," she says. You note a bottle of something rare and four crystal glasses on her desk.

She taps at her console interface, "I wanted to show you this before the announcement went public. With," she adds with sarcastic reverence, "approval from the High Hegemon."

With a flicker, the holoprojector beams an image into the large central volume of the office: your flagship triumphantly exiting a Gate, drive aglow, hyperspace bubble rendered in visible EM as a victorious golden aura.
entries.zh:
你进入 Baird 院长的办公室，她以非同寻常的热情向你问好。

"进来，进来。随便坐，" 她说。你注意到她的桌子上放着一瓶稀有货和四个水晶杯。

她按了几下控制面板，"在公告发出去之前，我想让你先看看这个。" 她加上了嘲讽的敬语，"在至高霸主的许可下。"

随着一阵闪烁，全息投影将一个图像投射在硕大的办公室中央：你的旗舰越过星门，凯旋而归，引擎闪耀。超空间泡用可见光谱重新渲染绘制，映照出代表胜利的金色氛围。

entries.en:
"And this little show is only the first step, captain. A link between two Gates is momentous, but it means that so much more is possible: if we can open one Gate, then we can scale the technology to open more. It will take nearly unimaginable energy - and the resources of a Sector-spanning empire."

Baird brings her hands together, staring at the holo, and taps her fingers as if to let off excess energy. "Though the factions of this Sector are weak, the bones of the Domain are scattered all around us. Academician Simisola has located a derelict coronal tap which could provide the energy required to - theoretically, mind - open permanent links in the Gate network. And if what Coureuse's theories imply are true..."

The provost's attention returns to the world around her. "Where is Scylla? She was to report here after securing the schematics."
entries.zh:
"这个小小的展示只是第一步，舰长。两扇星门之间的连接确实意义重大，但这也意味着有更多的可能性是可以实现的：如果我们能够开启一扇星门，那么我们就能扩展这项技术开启更多星门。那会消耗难以想象的能量...以及跨越星域的大帝国量级的资源。"

Baird 双手合拢，盯着影像，敲击着手指，似乎在释放着她的激动。"尽管这一星域的势力都很弱小，但 人之领 的残骸散落在我们周围。院士 Simisola 找到了一个遗弃的星冕分流器，理论上它可以提供永久开启星门链接网络所需的能量。如果 Coureuse 的理论所预言是正确的..."

院长的注意力终于回到了她周围的现实世界。"Scylla 在哪？她应该在妥善保管好设计图之后就马上到这里来报到的。"

entries.en:
She taps a key on her desk-console, a touch of annoyance in her voice "Sebestyen. Have Coureuse and- yes, and Zal. Have them sent in." She shakes her head and gives you a see-what-we-must-deal-with look.

As she turns away, the comms unit chimes. She turns back, "What is it, Alviss? ... Is she on the station or not? Stop stammering, it's a simple yes or no question. ... I see."

She taps at the comms, the triumph draining from her expression.
entries.zh:
她在桌面控制台上轻触了一个按键，声音中透出了一丝不悦。"Sebestyen。去找 Coureuse 和...对，和 Zal。送她们进来。" 她摇了摇头，给你摆了个 '看看我们处理的都是些什么鬼事' 的表情。

在她刚要转身离开时，通讯器发出了响声。她转了回去，"怎么了，Alviss？... 她在不在空间站？别结结巴巴的了，说是或是不是...我知道了。"

她轻敲着通讯器，脸上胜利的表情消失了。

entries.en:
"Security, find me Academician Scylla Coureuse. And her- and Elissa Zal. ... Yes, immediately. Top priority."

Another tap, "And get me that insipid hacker. Yes, I mean Gargoyle. No, just on comms."
entries.zh:
"警卫，给我找到 Scylla Coureuse 院士。以及那个...以及那个 Elissa Zal... 是的，马上。最高优先级。"

她又按了一下屏幕，"还有让那个无聊的黑客见我。对，就是 Gargoyle。不，不用当面，通讯就行。"

o.en: Sneak a glass of the victory spirit while you still can
o.zh: 趁着现在还有机会，偷偷喝一杯庆祝胜利

entries.en:
"You haven't heard? I am blessed to deliver you the good word!"

"We await the return of Ludd! Blessed Sister Fear-not, our spiritual leader, was given a vision by the grace of cosmic pneuma that Ludd would return here from unearthly exile, to this very spot, after many cycles spent in spiritual battle for the soul of humanity."

"We await with joyous hearts and hymns upon our lips. Won't you join us?"
entries.zh:
"你从没听说过？我一定是蒙了福，才有幸把这美好的预言传达给你！"

"我们在等待卢德的归来！我们的精神领袖，无畏圣修女，宇宙灵气赐予了她一次未卜先知的机会。她看见卢德为全人类的灵魂进行着属灵的斗争，而在无数年后，卢德将结束那尘世外的流放，重归此处。"

"我们心中满怀喜乐地等候着，我们口中的赞美诗呼之欲出。你不想加入我们吗？"

o.en: Thank you, but I have, uh, worldly obligations.
o.zh: 谢谢你，但是我，呃，还有些世俗的事务要处理。

o.en: This sounds like a complete waste of time.
o.zh: 这听起来完全是浪费时间。

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods with understanding. "Nonetheless, captain, the path of Ludd's blessing is always before us. You may surprise yourself to find that you have been walking with Ludd all along."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe理解地点了点头。"即便如此，舰长，卢德赐福的道途永远都在我们面前。也许你会惊奇地发现，你始终在与卢德并肩而行。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods with acceptance, and says "Perhaps in time."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe点头以示接受，然后说："或许以后你就会理解了。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods with understanding, and says "Look inward, my child. One day you may understand."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe理解地点了点头，说道："看看你的内心，我的孩子。总有一天你会明白的。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head, smiles beatifically, and explains, "We are maintaining a holy vigil. We cannot simply... move. Our devotion was foreseen, that Holy Ludd may return to us and guide us."

"We would not," even the thought seems a little upsetting to the Luddic $rank, "Abandon the Prophet Returned!"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe摇了摇头，虔诚地笑了笑，并解释道，"我们在举行神圣守夜。我们无法就这么... 离开。我们的虔诚已被预见，只为圣卢德能回到我们身边，为我们指引前路。"

"所以，我们绝不会，" 只是抱有这种想法似乎都让这位卢德 $rank 感到一些不安，"背弃归来的先知！"

entries.en:
"Devotion is not a thing to be turned off and back on again like a datapad," $heOrShe says, with priestly concern but infinite patience for your withered spiritual understanding.

"That's not how it works. What you ask is impossible."
entries.zh:
"虔诚不是像数据平板一样可以随意开关的事物。" 对于你灵性认知上的匮乏，$heOrShe语气中带着教士的急切以及无限的耐心说道。

"事情并非你想的那样。你的要求是不可能实现的。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head sadly. "Devotion cannot be bought and sold. Besides, we have no need of credits. The Prophet Returned will provide us with spiritual riches beyond all imagination. There will be no poor and no rich where we shall be led on the blessed Path of Ludd."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe伤心地摇了摇头。"虔诚是不能被买卖的。另外，我们没有星币的欲求。归来的先知会赐予我们超乎想象的精神富足。待我们被引至那蒙福的卢德之径，彼时将再无贫富之别。"

entries.en:
The Luddic $rank turns $hisOrHer head and says "You misunderstand, enjoyment is irrelevant to-"

You terminate the comms before the deluded Luddic can condescend further.
entries.zh:
这位卢德 $rank 转过头说道："你误会了，这无关于享受 ——"

你赶在这位痴迷的卢德信徒要继续屈尊教导你之前就关闭了通讯。

entries.en:
You explain that you have done much for the Faithful, and many works for the Church. You invite the Luddic $rank to ask among $hisOrHer flock, they will testify to this fact, you are certain.

The vigil cannot be held at all times, you explain, because surely the faithful must sleep and otherwise attend to material concerns. Ludd was no stranger to the suffering and the poor, Ludd walked among the worlds and felt their suffering. Ludd did not tell the downtrodden to ignore their wants, despite the wretchedness of the world.
entries.zh:
你表示自己曾为卢德教会以及它的信众做过不少事。你主动请求这位卢德 $rank 问问$hisOrHer身边的人，相信他们都会认同你所言不虚。

守夜本来就不可能毫不间断地一直进行下去，你继续说道。就算是再虔诚的信众，也必须不时安眠片刻，抑或是处理其他物质上的需求。卢德饱经灾难与困苦，卢德游历众星，切身经历过它们各自的煎熬与苦难，感受过它们的痛苦。但尽管世界如此不幸，卢德也从未要求这些可怜的人们彻底忽略他们自己卑微的欲求。

o.en: Hold vigil from my flagship while your flock makes repairs nearby.
o.zh: 你可以在我的旗舰上继续守夜，与此同时其他人可以在附近进行维修。

entries.en:
The Luddic $rank nods as you speak, and says "I admit, our ships are old and of poor repair. It would alleviate much suffering if you... provided 50 units of supplies in the spirit of charity. And if, as you say, a vigil could be maintained for the short period required for your, ah, scan?"

You nod piously. This is not for your own self-glory; not at all. Supplies for the weary, and a scan to ensure the safety at all. It is not unreasonable, it is not unfaithful.

"I would accept this proposal, captain," $heOrShe says finally.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe听着你的话频频点头，有些犹豫地说道，"我承认我们的舰船都已经年久失修了。假若你能捐献 50 单位的补给，就能极大地缓解这种煎熬...当然，还请你务必抱着慈悲为怀的精神这么做。此外，就像你说的那样，我们可以在你的船上为了继续守夜而稍作休养，以便你可以前去进行...啊，扫描？"

你虔诚地点了点头。这不是什么值得自夸自傲的事情，完全不是。为疲劳之人提供给养，为所有人的安全进行一次扫描。这绝非无理取闹，也绝非信仰不忠。

"我接受这个提案，舰长。" $heOrShe终于说道。

o.en: Provide 50 supplies and go forward with the scan
o.zh: 提供 50 补给，并开始扫描

entries.en:
You dispatch a shuttle to retrieve the Luddic $rank and a small circle of advisors. As they board, you invite them to a viewing lounge where they can maintain their vigil during your operation. Your ops chief coordinates the transfer of supplies, and even begrudgingly allows a few cargo drones to be borrowed to help maneuver some desperately malfunctioning ships from the Luddic fleet.

One by one, their engines ignite, drive manifolds sending ripples throughout the local hyperspace medium. The ships of the faithful crawl slowly from the vicinity of the gate.
entries.zh:
你派出一架穿梭机，带回了这位卢德 $rank 和几位顾问。他们登舰后，你邀请他们来到一处观景休息室，以便他们在你行动时为了继续守夜而稍作休养。行动长官协调着补给的交接，甚至还不情愿地允许对方暂借几个货运无人机，以帮助修理几艘状况极其糟糕的舰船。

他们的引擎一个接一个地点亮，驱动流形在附近的超空间介质中泛起涟漪。信徒们的船缓慢从星门附近移开了。

entries.en:
Perhaps, you explain, that in the spirit of charity you - with assistance from the Luddic $rank of course - could perform a safety scan upon this Gate using a device you have on your flagship. You propose that it could be considered a ritual of cleansing.

This would also provide $hisOrHer followers an opportunity to make repairs to their faltering ships. The Prophet Returned would not want this flock to be lost to hull breaches and life support failure, surely.
entries.zh:
你提议，或许你可以本着慈悲为怀的精神，同时自然还要仰赖这位卢德 $rank 的协助，使用你的旗舰上搭载的设备对这座星门进行一次安全扫描。这可以被视为一种净化仪式，你如此解释道。

在扫描的同时，$hisOrHer的追随者们能趁着这个机会修理一下他们快要散架了的舰船。毕竟归来的先知一定不会想看到这些子民们因船体破损或维生系统失效而殒命。

o.en: Hold vigil from my flagship while your flock makes repairs nearby.
o.zh: 你可以在我的旗舰上继续守夜，其他人可以同时在附近进行维修。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe nods as you speak, and speaks hesitantly, "I admit, our ships are old and of poor repair. It would alleviate much suffering if you provided 50 supplies... in the spirit of charity, of course. And if, as you say, a vigil could be maintained for the short period required for this, ah, cleansing?"

You nod piously. This is not for your own self-glory; not at all. Supplies for the weary, and a scan to ensure the safety of all. It is not unreasonable, it is not unfaithful. You just need to ensure everything appears absolutely above-board for the Luddic $rank.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe听着你的话频频点头，有些犹豫地说道，"我承认我们的舰船都已经年久失修了。假若你能捐赠 50 单位的补给，就能极大地缓解这种煎熬...当然，还请你务必抱着慈悲为怀的精神这么做。此外，就像你说的那样，我们可以在你的船上为了继续守夜而稍作休养，以便你可以前去进行，啊，净化仪式？"

你虔诚地点了点头。这不是什么值得自夸自傲的事情，完全不是。为疲劳之人提供给养，为所有人的安全进行一次扫描。这绝非无理取闹，也绝非信仰不忠。你只需要确保，在这位卢德 $rank 的见证之下，一切所作所为都必须光明磊落。

o.en: Provide 50 supplies and go forward with the scan
o.zh: 提供 50 补给，并开始扫描

entries.en:
$HeOrShe nods as you speak, and says hesitantly "I admit, our ships are old and of poor repair. It would alleviate much suffering if you provided 50 supplies... in the spirit of charity, of course. And if, as you say, a vigil could be maintained for the short period required for your, ah, cleansing?"

You nod piously. As a commissioned militant of the Church of Galactic Redemption, these heretics (for that is what they are) are wary of your authority, but more trusting than they would be with an outsider when it comes to handling delicate matters of religion.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe听着你的话频频点头，有些犹豫地说道，"我承认我们的舰船都已经年久失修了。假若你能捐赠 50 单位的补给，就能极大地缓解这种煎熬... 当然，还请你务必抱着慈悲为怀的精神这么做。此外，就像你说的那样，我们可以在你的船上为了继续守夜而稍作休养，以便你可以前去进行... 净化仪式？"

你虔诚地点了点头。身为一名效力于银河救赎教会的武装斗士，这些异端 (至少对教会而言他们是) 对你所代表的威权有所警惕。但在牵扯到这些微妙的宗教问题时，你的身份会比教外人士更容易取得他们的信任。

o.en: Provide 50 supplies and go forward with the scan
o.zh: 提供 50 补给，并开始扫描

entries.en:
$HeOrShe nods as you speak, and says hesitantly "I admit, our ships are old and of poor repair. It would alleviate much suffering if you provided 50 supplies... in the spirit of charity, of course. And if, as you say, a vigil could be maintained for the short period required for your, ah, cleansing?"

You nod piously. These walkers of a, perhaps, slightly heretical path nonetheless view you as close to one of their own. After all, you have made pilgrimage to the shrines, just as many of them have. They trust you far more than the average spacer when it comes to a delicate matter of religion.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe听着你的话频频点头，有些犹豫地说道，"我承认我们的舰船都已经年久失修了。假若你能捐赠 50 单位的补给，就能极大地缓解这种煎熬... 当然，还请你务必抱着慈悲为怀的精神这么做。此外，就像你说的那样，我们可以在你的船上为了继续守夜而稍作休养，以便你可以前去进行... 净化仪式？"

你虔诚地点了点头。这些走在一条或许有点异端道路上的行者仍然将你视为接近他们自己的人。毕竟你和他们一样都去圣地朝圣过。当涉及到宗教的微妙问题时，和普通的航行者相比他们远更信任你。

o.en: Provide 50 supplies and go forward with the scan
o.zh: 提供 50 补给，并开始扫描

entries.en: Shock plays across $hisOrHer face, "Truly, you would do this terrible thing?" $heOrShe asks. "It would be slaughter. We are civilians, with few weapons."
entries.zh: $hisOrHer脸上充满了惊惧，"你真的打算做出如此可怕的事情？" $heOrShe感叹道，"那将是一场屠杀。我们只是平民，几乎都没有武器。"

entries.en:
After a moment's hesitation your tactical officer complies. Furious energies are channeled into capacitors, navigation armor retracted from ports and tubes, and a network of targeting radar, lidar, and more esoteric systems flicker to life.

The Luddic $rank looks faint, and mutters something to an underling.
entries.zh:
战术军官犹豫了一下才执行命令，爆裂的能量涌进寄存器，掩藏着炮塔和导弹架的航行用装甲开始收回，定位雷达、激光雷达以及各种稀奇古怪的系统闪烁着上线。

这位卢德 $rank 脸都白了，对一位下属说了些什么。

entries.en: The ships of the faithful start to crawl away, leaving a few stragglers. Tension builds as you wait - will these be martyrs to the vigil, those willing to stare down your beams and guns and missiles and give their lives?
entries.zh: 信徒们的船缓慢移走，只剩下几艘掉队的。空气逐渐变得紧张起来 —— 这些船会成为守夜的殉道者吗？难道他们甘愿直面你的光束，大炮和导弹，不惜以生命为代价？

entries.en:
One by one, old engines sputter and alight, and finally the last of the stragglers trail the mass of the vigil ships.

Stone-faced, your bridge crew awaits your next order.
entries.zh:
破旧的引擎一个接一个地呼啸着亮起来，终于，最后的掉队者也跟上了守夜者大部队的脚步。

你的舰桥成员们面无表情地等待着下一步命令。

entries.en:
Someone from the Luddic fleet has noticed you and is hailing.

Before you can respond, your sensors officer calls your attention. "The Luddic fleet is in poor repair. Some of their hyperdrives are causing a lot of interference, even in low-power mode. They're why we can't scan the nearby Gate."
entries.zh:
卢德舰队的人注意到了你，并发来了通讯请求。

在你做出回答前，传感器技官提醒你注意。"这支卢德舰队的船体状况大都很糟糕。一些超空间引擎甚至在低功率模式下也造成了不小的干扰。就是他们在妨碍我们扫描星门。"

entries.en:
A silent ring of adamantine material, derelict of a former age.

You use your command interface to query the status of the Gate scanning instrument package. The target-finder hangs as it tries to lock on to the anomaly at the center of the Gate's ring. ABORT, RETRY, FAIL? it asks in bold amber letters.

"Captain, there's a fleet of civilian ships right on top of the Gate," your sensors officer says, shaking their head. "There's just too much interference."
entries.zh:
一座沉寂已久的环状结构，由坚固的材料制成，是来自上个时代的遗迹。

你在命令面板上查询星门扫描仪器套件的状态，目标搜寻程序在试图锁定星门中心的异常点时突然崩溃，屏幕上显示出加粗的橙色字体：[中断，重试，失败？]。

"舰长，星门边上有一支民船舰队，" 传感器技官摇着头说。"干扰太强了。"

o.zh: 你说的 '神圣守夜' 是什么意思？

o.en: I need you to move your fleet away from the Gate.
o.zh: 我需要你的舰队远离星门。

o.en: Look, you can come right back after I'm done the scan.
o.zh: 听着，等我扫描完星门，你就可以回来这里。

o.en: Perhaps some kind of charitable donation could help?
o.zh: 或许一些慈善捐赠能帮到你们？
这不可能。好好享受你们的 '守夜' 吧。

o.en: As a, um, servant of the faith, I have a proposal.
o.zh: 作为，呃，信仰的仆人，我有一个提议。

o.en: As a servant of the Church, I have a proposal.
o.zh: 作为卢德教会的忠仆，我有一个提议。

o.en: As a servant of the faith, I have a proposal.
o.zh: 作为卢德信仰的忠仆，我有一个提议。

o.en: Move from the Gate or I shall open fire.
o.zh: 离星门远点，不然我就开火了。

entries.en: "Blessings upon you, space traveler," the Luddic $rank says. "Have you come to join our holy vigil? There is room here for all. And provided you share, we shall share alike."
entries.zh: "祝福你，太空旅者，" 这位卢德 $rank 说道。"你是来参加我们的神圣守夜的吗？我们这里还有空位呢。如果你愿意分享，我们也将同舟共济。"

entries.en: "Oh," the Luddic $rank says, "It is you again. Please, respect the blessed peace we have built here. There is room here for all, and we have little worth taking."
entries.zh: "哦，" 这位卢德 $rank 说道，"又是你。请你尊重我们在此建立的神圣的和平。我们接纳所有人，而我们没有什么值得掠夺的东西。"

entries.en:
"Blessed $playerName! May the light of Ludd guide you always. Thanks to your assistance, we are continuing our holy vigil."

"I'm sure the Prophet Returned will come soon," $heOrShe says and smiles radiantly.
entries.zh:
"祝福你，$playerName！愿卢德之光永远指引你。多亏了你的帮助，我们得以继续进行神圣守夜。"

"我相信先知归来的那一天很快就会到来，" $heOrShe喜开颜笑。

entries.en: Before you hangs the Gate, the vast and potent derelict of a former age.
entries.zh: 星门屹立在你面前，这是来自上个时代的，宏伟而强大的遗迹。

entries.en: "Then," Zal says, "I give you my working Janus Device. I can hook it up to your flagship's hyperdrive. Then we can travel through the Gates to the Galatia system."
entries.zh: "然后，" Zal 说，"我就把我那个正常运行的 '双面神' 装置交给你，我可以将它装到你旗舰的超空间引擎上，之后我们可以穿过星门航行到 Galatia 星系。"

o.en: You know Provost Baird will never let you go, right?
o.zh: 你知道 Baird 院长不会让你走，不是吗？

o.en: Scylla will be glad to see you.

entries.en: "We'll see," Zal says.
entries.zh: "拭目以待，"Zal 说。

entries.en:
Your command display shows the hyperspace manifold. It is calm and cool.

The scan begins, a line of disruption flaring between your flagship and the Gate. Spirals and ripples spill and surge in non-Newtonian bursts from a point at the center of the Gate. No, not a point - a circle, a sphere, a torus and inverted funnel; then some geometry that does not parse. You hear the faint music.

"Captain," your sensors officer reports, "The scan is complete."
entries.zh:
你的指挥界面上叠加显示了星门周围的超空间流形图像。它平稳而寂静。

扫描开始，你看到你的旗舰和星门之间摇曳着一条扭曲的连线。漩涡和涟漪随后如非牛顿流体一般，从星门中央处的一个点喷涌而出。不，那不是一个点 —— 而是一个圆、一个球体、一个圆环、一个倒置的环形漏斗；直到最后产生了一些无法用几何描述的东西。你听到了微弱的乐音。

"舰长，" 你的传感器技官汇报道，"扫描完成了。"

entries.en:
"Captain," Zal says, "I'll try to be brief. First: Scylla was sending me the Galatia Academy's schematics and experimental data all along. Including the results of the failed prototype test."

"Second: The Academy didn't have access to my, I'll admit, considerable and unique skills. And Kanta- those pirates can buy, cheat, and steal some fine gear on short notice."

"Third, and I'm not going to apologize, but Scylla and I held back the working device. It was my idea for leverage over Baird."
entries.zh:
"舰长，" Zal 说，"我会尽量简短说明。首先：Scylla 一直在给我发送 Galatia 学院的设计图和实验数据。包括失败的原型机测试结果。"

"第二：我承认学院并没能获得我的独特的重要技能，这一点之后我会承认的。Kanta 以及那些海盗可以在短时间内买到，骗取，或是偷到一些关键部件。"

"第三，我不会道歉，但 Scylla 和我私藏了这个正常工作的装置。利用 Baird 也是我的想法。"

o.en: Great plan. You almost blew me up before.
o.zh: 真是不错的计划。上次你差点就这样炸死我了。

o.en: We have a lot to talk about.
o.zh: 我们还得仔细谈谈这些。

entries.en:
"If this doesn't work, captain, then I've been wrong about everything and... Scylla has been wrong about everything. I trust her."

She hesitates, then says "With my life."
entries.zh:
"如果它无法运行，舰长，那就是我和... Scylla 搞错了一切。我相信她。"

她犹豫了一下，说道："用我的生命起誓。"

entries.en: "You didn't though," she says impatiently, "Let's focus on the present crisis. You've got the Gate there in front of you. Use it."
entries.zh: "但你没有。" 她不耐烦地说，"让我们专注于眼前的危机。星门就在你面前。使用它。"

entries.en:
"There will be time for that later," she says impatiently. "If this doesn't work, captain, then Scylla and I have been wrong about everything. I trust her."

She hesitates, then says "With my life."
entries.zh:
"以后会有时间的。" 她不耐烦地说，"如果它不能运行，舰长，那就是 Scylla 和我搞错了一切。我相信她。"

她犹豫了一下，"用我的生命起誓。"

entries.en: You have scanned this Gate and discovered the rhythm of the secret heart of the thing, hidden in a slip of space.
entries.zh: 你已经扫描了这个星门，发现在空间裂隙中隐藏的秘密核心的规律。

entries.en:
"On it," she says.

It takes mere minutes before your chief engineer reports that integration of the Janus Device into your hyperdrive system is complete.
entries.zh:
"在做了。" 她说。

几分钟后，你的总工程师报告说 '双面神' 装置整合进超空间引擎系统的工作已经完成了。

entries.en: "With your permission, captain," Zal says over internal comms, "I'll jury-rig the Janus Device into your flagship's hyperdrive."
entries.zh: "如果你允许的话，舰长，" Zal 在内部通讯中说，"我会临时把 '双面神' 装置安装到你旗舰的超空间引擎上。"

o.en: We're not done in the Magec system.
o.zh: 我们在 Magec 星系还有事要做。

entries.en: Your command interface lights up. 'EXECUTE SCAN' blinks expectantly. The Gate awaits, as cold as a tomb.
entries.zh: 你的命令面板亮了起来。'执行扫描' 如预期般闪烁着。星门等待着，冷得像一座坟墓。

entries.en: "The Janus Device is ready," your navigation officer reports. "We can traverse the Gate, $playerSirOrMadam. At your order."
entries.zh: "'双面神' 装置准备好了，" 你的领航军官报告道，"我们可以穿过星门了，$playerSirOrMadam。听你的命令。"

o.en: Nav, activate the Janus Device and take us in.
o.zh: 领航官，激活 '双面神' 装置，把我们带进去。

o.en: Zal, how do I know it isn't going to explode on me again?
o.zh: Zal，我怎么能知道它不会再向我爆炸呢？

entries.en: "You'll need to scan the Gate," Zal says softly on your comm-feed. "And then..."
entries.zh: "你需要扫描这个星门，" Zal 在你的通讯反馈中轻声说道，"然后..."

entries.en: "Yeah," Zal says, "It's- let's just focus on getting through this alive."
entries.zh: "当然，"Zal 说，"嗯...我们先集中精力度过难关。"

entries.en:
The hyperspace manifold pulses coolly, then again, warmer. It is working. Your officers operate with collective cool, but you can feel their tension. You are about to do what no one has done for over two hundred cycles.

A distant keening touches your mind. You instantly review your command status displays: no hyperspace alarm, no system alerts; no one else reacts as if anything is wrong. It's just in your head. An animal in pain; you try to concentrate on the sound and it slips away.

You hear the thrum of life support, the rumble of engines, the soft chorus of the bridge consoles' feedback and your officers' humanity. Everyone is watching the pulsing of the Gate.
entries.zh:
超空间流形开始脉动起来，不断反复，由沉稳转向激昂。它起作用了。虽然你的军官们仍在协调而冷静地行动着，但你能感受到他们的紧张。你正在完成一件过去两百多年没人能达成的壮举。

这时，一阵来自远方的恸哭轻触了你的心灵。你立即检查了命令面板状态：没有超空间警报，没有星系警报；没有其他人做出感受到了任何异常的反应。那仅在你的头脑中。像是动物在遭受痛苦；在你试图专心分辨这声音时，它却消失了。

你听到了维生系统的轻响，引擎的轰鸣，舰桥控制台各种反馈的嘈杂，和你副官们的交谈。每个人都在看着星门的脉动。

o.en: We're not done in the Magec system.
o.zh: 我们在 Magec 星系还有事要做。

entries.en:
"What now sits on Kanta's throne of blood and gold is abject to the teachings of blessed Ludd," he taps his fingers on his teacup. "Though a warrior cannot be ignorant of his enemies, I confess that I am not inclined to gaze too deeply into that monstrous abyss. Shall I debate an AI core, shall I ponder its heart? No, because it has no heart, no soul. It is a thing."

"Kanta wants her abomination. This is all I need to know." Cotton meets your eyes, "And you will be the one to give the abomination back to her."
entries.zh:
"如今端坐于 Kanta 那鲜血与黄金王座上的存在，已彻底背离了圣卢德的教诲。" 他用手指轻敲着茶杯。"虽然一个战士不能不了解他的敌人，但我承认我并不想深入凝视那丑恶的深渊。我需要和一个 AI 核心争论吗，我需要思考它的想法吗？不，因为它没有心，没有灵魂。两者是一样的。"

"Kanta 想要这个丑恶的东西；我只要知道这一点就够了。" Cotton 看着你的眼睛，"你将是把这个丑恶的东西还给她的人。"

entries.en: "Yes," he says, his eyes unblinking. "It has no path here. Its presence is raising questions which ought not be asked. So you will take it from my people and go."
entries.zh: "是的，" 他目不转睛地说，"它在这里无路可走。它的存在引发了不该被问起的问题。所以你会把它从我的人民中带走。"

entries.en:
"Yes, yes. Cydonia. Some mercy. You have met him, I know. Is he not strange? I cannot imagine a more wretched creature - excepting his creation, the Loke-thing. Cydonia is a liar to the end of space, and even the sacred becomes sin when it has left his hands."

"If you find occasion to bring his life to an end, I do believe it would be a good and righteous deed."

Cotton sips tea.
entries.zh:
"是的，是的。Cydonia。上天怜悯。我知道你见过他了。他难道不奇怪吗？除了他的作品，Loke 这样的东西，我想象不出更可悲的造物了。Cydonia 是个彻头彻尾的骗子，即使是圣物到了他的手里也会变成罪恶。"

"如果你有机会结束他的性命，我相信那会是一桩善举，正义之举。"

Cotton 抿着茶。

entries.en:
"If the Loke-thing started less than human, Kanta has lowered herself to that sorry state by her debauched pursuit of wrath and immortality."

Brother Cotton takes another slow sip of tea, "She is a malfunction of the machinery of the Hegemony; an obsolete hazard to be cleared away like the stealth-mines she's wrapped around her fortress."
entries.zh:
"如果说 Loke 这样的东西一开始就贱于人类，那么 Kanta 则是在她放荡追求怒火与不朽的过程中，将自己贬低到了同样可悲的境地。"

Cotton 修士又抿了一口茶，"她是 霸主 体系的故障部分，是应当被扫除的废弃危害品，就如同她堡垒周围的隐形空雷一样。"

entries.en:
"The music did not return. So that was my one moment, I thought. It had confirmed my righteous calling, and that was enough. For years I 'heard' nothing. I expected nothing."

"Then, one day not too long ago," he speaks haltingly, looking troubled. "It, it did visit upon me again."

His voice is soft now, "That was the day I was told you were to come here. What am I to make of that?"
entries.zh:
"旋律并没有再次响起。所以那便是我的神启一刻，我觉得。它验证了正义对我的召唤，那便足够了。这些年来我没有再 '听' 到什么。我也并没有再期待。"

"然后，不久前的一天，" 他犹豫地说道，看起来有些不安。"它，它又找上了我。"

他的声音现在变得柔和了，"那正是我得知你将来到此地的日子。这我该怎么理解呢？"

entries.en:
Brother Cotton stands, "I cannot say whether it is a choir of angels or a host of demons," he says. "I fear not pain, death, or judgment. But I do fear to stray from the Path."

He adjusts his coat; one of his minions opens the door, and the clink and murmur of the teahouse returns.

"My people have already brought the abomination to your shuttle," and as if on cue you feel an urgent buzz from your comms.

"Go there now, with Ludd's peace," he says.
entries.zh:
Cotton 修士站起来，"我不知道那是天使的吟唱还是恶魔的主持，" 他说道，"我并不害怕痛苦，死亡，或是审判。但我害怕偏离了卢德之道。"

他理了一下外套，一个仆人打开了门，茶馆的叮当声和谈话声又回来了。

"我的人已经把那个丑恶的东西送到你的穿梭机去了，" 与此同时，急促的嗡鸣声从你的通讯器中传来。

"现在就去，带着卢德的和平。" 他说。

entries.en:
Once outside the teahouse, you duck into a dark corner where the local vice squad is unlikely to spot you engaging in flagrant use of technology. You confirm via comms that the clone Loke has indeed been handed over to your waiting shuttle crew.

You return to your shuttle, and get the full but short story from your nervous guards: a squad of Pathers appeared, shoved a strange man into their hands, then left.
entries.zh:
一出茶馆，你就躲进一个黑暗的角落，在这里当地惩戒团难以发现你在公然使用科技产品。你通过通讯器验证了克隆人 Loke 确实已经被交给了你正在等待的穿梭机船员。

你回到穿梭机，从你紧张的护卫那里听取了完整但简短的过程报告：一队左径靠近过来，将一个陌生人推到他们的手中，然后离开了。

entries.en:
Inside, a couple confused-looking marines are watching clone Loke eat a simple meal of space rations wrapped in foil.

As you approach, Loke looks at you curiously, dropping the foil packet. With a bland smile he says "Ludd blesses you. Together we will walk on the Path."

You tell the marines to let him finish his lunch before escorting him to the brig for safekeeping.
entries.zh:
在里边，两个看起来很疑惑的陆战队员正看着克隆人 Loke 吃便饭，是箔纸包的太空配给餐。

你靠近后，Loke 丢下了箔纸包装，好奇地看着你。他面带灿烂的笑容对你说 "卢德保佑你。我们会一起走上卢德之道的。"

你告诉陆战队员让他吃完午饭，然后押他去禁闭室安全看管。

o.en: Loke, do you want to go back to Kanta?
Loke, do you want to stay here?
Loke, do you want to be free?

entries.en:
Loke smiles, some green thing from the ration still stuck in his teeth.

"Yes. I will go to Jorien," he says excitedly. "I will tell her about the Path! She will like it."
entries.zh:
Loke 微笑了起来，牙齿还卡着干粮里的什么绿东西。

"好啊。我去找 Jorien。" 他激动地说道，"我去跟她说说卢德之道！她会喜欢的。"

entries.en: Loke looks around, pausing a moment to take in the dusty blast-shields of the landing bay through a window. "No," he says. "It's cold."
entries.zh: Loke 四处张望了一下，花了点时间透过窗户观察登陆台上满是灰尘的防爆盾。"不想。" 他说道，"这儿冷。"

entries.en:
"I..." Loke's brow wrinkles around the grotesque scar on his forehead. "I... want...."

He bites his own lip, and cries out in pain. Anger rises on his face and he stomps the foil wrapper he dropped, as if to punish the thing.

The moment passes, and slowly his breathing returns to normal. His eyes wander over the ground, then back to you. "We will go to space now?" he asks.
entries.zh:
"我..." Loke 的眉毛在他额头上怪诞的伤疤旁皱了起来，"我...想..."

他咬着下唇，痛苦地喊出了声。他脸上露出忿怒的神色，一脚跺向他扔下的箔纸，仿佛是在责罚它。

时间慢慢流逝，他的呼吸也逐渐恢复正常。他的眼神在地上扫过，最后回到了你身上。"我们现在去太空吗？" 他问道。

entries.en:
"By both of us, I tell you true."

"I have prayed long on this matter," he says, bringing his hands together as if in demonstration. "Once, long ago, I was in a prison cell. I heard a music like... like the holy pneuma, from afar. A choir of angels."

"My heart leapt, to be touched so. Eagerly, I listened closer and in not a blink it was gone. For just a moment I was touched by grace. Do you understand? My life turned on that point; I found the Path."
entries.zh:
"只有我们两个，我告诉你事实。"

"我已经在这件事上祈祷很久了，" 他说道，一边双手合十，似乎在向你展示当时的情景。"起先，很久以前，我被囚禁在一个牢房里。我听到了旋律，像是...像是远处的圣灵。是天使的合唱。"

"我的心剧烈地跳动，我被深深地感染了。我渴望靠近去听，但不到一眨眼的工夫它就消失了。仅一刹那我就被这光辉所感动。你能理解吗？我的生活从那时起发生了变化，我寻得了卢德之道。"

entries.en: "You may not find satisfaction from that query, captain," Cotton says. "But I shall answer."
entries.zh: "你可能无法从这一询问中获得满意，舰长，" Cotton 说道，"但我会回答的。"

entries.en: "Do pardon me for contradicting my guest," says Cotton, "But I do not hold lightly my decision then or now."
entries.zh: "还请你原谅我反驳来客的无礼，" Cotton 说道，"但我从来都是三思而后行。"

entries.en: "Indeed," Cotton says, drawing out the word, his tone carefully controlled. "I will pray upon the meaning of your words, captain. This I promise."
entries.zh: "当然，" Cotton 说，拉长着语调，仔细控制着自己的声调。"我会为你话语中的意思祈祷的，舰长，我保证。"

entries.en: "Indeed," Cotton says, drawing out the word, his tone carefully controlled. "Mind you, it is not mine to give as-such; absolution is for all humanity who do so chose."
entries.zh: "当然，" Cotton 说，拉长着语调，仔细控制着自己的声调，"请你注意，这并不是以我个人身份给予的建议，救赎属于所有如此选择的人类。"

entries.en: "Captain $playerName. I am Brother Livewell Cotton and I'm pleased to greet you. With the blessings of Ludd's peace and all that, naturally." He winks and offers a hand.
entries.zh: "舰长 $playerName。我是 Livewell Cotton 修士，很高兴见到你。自然是带着卢德和平的祝愿。"他眨了眨眼，伸出一只手。

entries.en:
Brother Livewell Cotton stands and smiles as you enter. "Captain $playerName," he says, "It was my pleasure to hear that our paths would cross again."

He gives you a knowing look, "I pray you have meditated upon our previous discussion."
entries.zh:
你进来的时候，Livewell Cotton 修士站起来微笑着。" $playerName 舰长，"他说，"听说我们的道途再次相交，这是我的荣幸。"

他给你一个会意的眼神，"我祈祷你思考过我们之前的讨论。"

entries.en:
He maintains his smile. "As you'll do. Whatever blood's between us, it never hurt anyone to be kind in a small way." He points with his untaken hand "Ludd said that last bit once, you know, blessings be."

Then he brings his hands together, an unconscious return to prayer.
entries.zh:
他保持微笑。"就像你要做的那样。即便我们之间有过什么血海深仇，和善待人永不为过。" 他用落空了的手指了指，"后面那句是卢德说的，你知道吗，愿他保佑我们。"

然后他两手合十，不经意地做起了祷告。

entries.en: His smile widens slightly as you shake his hand, "A pleasure. Call me Livewell if you like, and I'll thank you for the sentiment."
entries.zh: 和你握手时，他的嘴角稍微上扬了一点点，"幸会。方便的话你就称呼我为 Livewell 吧，还请别太过于拘谨。"

o.en: Don't go to the back room

entries.en: The private room is austere, dim but for the spot of a paper lantern cast on the figure sitting facing you. He raises his face as you enter and holds a hand out to welcome you to sit. The sparse decor and furniture have the solid hand-made quality of true Luddic crafts and you know the set could be sold for a good price on any number of the core worlds.
entries.zh: 这个私人房间很简陋，昏暗，但有一个纸灯笼照在坐在你对面的人身上。当你进来时，他抬起脸，伸出手欢迎你坐下。稀疏的装饰品和家具是真正的卢德手制工艺品，你知道在很多核心世界星球这些可以卖个好价钱。

entries.en: Brother Cotton nods in agreement, and to your surprise says "You are indeed."
entries.zh: Cotton 赞同地点点头，出乎你的意料地说道："你确实该这么做。"

entries.en:
"Won't you join me for tea? I offer it to you, my guest, with the safety and hospitality that I've been blessed to provide."

He notes your hesitation and sits first. "Come along in your own time. I'm no scorpion, I do assure you."
entries.zh:
"你不和我喝一杯茶吗？我的客人，我会尽可能给你提供我有幸可以给予的安全与款待。"

他注意到你的犹豫，首先坐了下来。"随你便吧。我向你保证，茶里面没毒。"

o.en: I know to never turn my back on a Pather.
o.zh: 我知道从来不要把后背对着左径分子。

entries.en:
"Yes." Cotton sets his tea down, eyes hard.

"Yes I do. I did not don the blood-stained mantle of leadership lightly. It was to be my Path. And I shall walk without averting my eyes from the truth of my deeds. Ludd's revelation is pain!" He slams a hand on the table, rattling the dishware. "Ludd chose the Path not because it was easy, or kind, or without suffering!"

He speaks in almost a whisper, "The prophet chose because it was Good."
entries.zh:
"是的。" Cotton 把茶杯放下，眼神坚定。

"是的。我未轻易领受这染血的领袖之责。这本应是我的道途。并且我行在这道途上时，当不遮掩我之所为。受难乃是卢德的启示！" 他一只手锤在桌子上，震得茶具作响。"卢德选择这条道途，并不因其易行，或是因其平缓，也不是因可免遭了苦难！"

他像是耳语般说道："先知选择它，只因它是正的。"

entries.en:
Cotton raises an eyebrow at this challenge and sets his tea down with a sad smile.

"A younger man than I once was thought he might nourish his soul if only he could kill every heretic that stood before him."

"What he found was not strength, but pride. And he- he would have killed you before you had spoken those words. On the landing pad, perhaps; a bomb in a cargo container. Or on the street, with his hands, had it come to it. That man was as blind as his enemies."
entries.zh:
Cotton 对这一挑衅挑起了眉毛，伤感地笑着放下茶杯。

"一个如同曾经的我一样的年轻人，觉得只有杀掉他面前的所有异端，才能滋养自己的灵魂。"

"但这个人获得的不是力量，而是傲慢。并且他...他会在你说这些话之前就杀掉你。也许是用着陆台上的货物集装箱中的炸弹，或是铤而走险在大街上亲自动手。这人曾和他的敌人一样盲目。"

o.en: Despite hired killers coming for you, you meet me with tea. Why?
o.zh: 尽管派了杀手，但你还是请我喝茶，为什么？

o.en: What do you even want with the Loke clone, if he's so ungodly?
o.zh: 如果克隆人 Loke 是那么亵渎神灵的存在，你还要他做什么？

o.en: So what are you going to do with the clone?
o.zh: 所以你想用这个克隆人做什么？

o.en: Kanta didn't explicitly ask me to kill you. Nor did Cydonia.
o.zh: Kanta 并没有明确让我杀你，Cydonia 也没有。

o.en: Why is this clone so important to Kanta?
o.zh: 为什么这个克隆人对 Kanta 这么重要？

o.en: You're just going to give me Loke?
I wish to take the Loke clone back to Kanta. As I agreed.
o.zh: 我希望把 Loke 带回给 Kanta，就像我答应的那样。

entries.en:
Cotton arranges two plain cups, and tests the temperature of the teapot.

"Now I do know why you are here. It's no great coup of the secret-whisperers-and-listeners why the warlord Jorien Kanta has been sending a most diverse company of ne'er-do-wells to bring myself to an untimely end and, be it convenient, claim back her ungodly creation."

He pauses, then adds, "Though I must offer my apologies; I most assuredly except yourself from the company of those ne'er-do-wells."
entries.zh:
Cotton 排出两个塑料杯，试了试茶壶的温度。

"现在我知道你为什么到这里来了。Jorien Kanta 军阀送来鱼龙混杂的一群饭桶想要早早地结束我的性命，窃听到其原因并不是什么很困难的事。如果方便说的话，他们声称要回收她那邪恶的造物。"

他暂停了一下，补充道，"尽管如此，我必须表示我的歉意，我肯定把你排除在了那群饭桶之外。"

o.en: Did you not send a rogue Luddic Knight to kill me?
o.zh: 你没有派一伙无赖卢德骑士来杀我吗？

entries.en:
He leans back, meeting your eyes, as if he believes it important to face someone whose death he ordered.

"You did appear then to be an enemy of our righteous cause. In war, we battle our enemies. That is all. I did not then fully understand your significance, which... was revealed to me only recently."
entries.zh:
他向后仰着，看着你的眼睛，似乎他相信面向他要判处死刑的对象时这是很重要的。

"你确实一开始就是我们正义事业的敌人。在战争中，我们与敌人战斗。仅此而已。当时我没有完全理解你的重要性，只有最近这才显露出来。"

entries.en: He pauses, looking almost shy for a moment, then says "That... we will speak of that before we are done here."
entries.zh: 他顿了顿，一时看起来有些害羞，随后说道："那...在我们结束之前，我们会谈到那一点。"

entries.en: "I did. And you told that knight that you would repent and to prove it you paid them many credits." He looks at you, and asks in an unassuming tone, "Is that why you're really here? To repent?"
entries.zh: "我这么做了。你告诉了那个骑士你会忏悔，且为了证明这一点，你给了他们很多星币。" 他看着你，用谦逊的口吻问道，"这就是你来这里的真正原因吗？来忏悔？"

o.en: Yes. I seek to follow the teachings of the Prophet Ludd.
o.zh: 不错，我正是在追寻先知卢德的教导。

o.en: Credits or not, you sent the knight to kill me.
o.zh: 别扯什么星币了。那些骑士明摆着是你派去杀我的。

entries.en: "Indeed I did so," he nods, as this is a mere philosophical point. "And now here you are, your path brought together with mine. The means of Blessed Providence seem so mercurial to the eyes of us mortals, do they not?"
entries.zh: "我确实这样做了，" 他轻轻点头，仿佛这件事根本无足轻重，"可你还是来到了这里，我们的道途于此汇合。看来上天赐福于我们的方式并不唯一，你说呢？"

o.en: Yes, funny how these things work out.
o.zh: 没错，事情还是蛮有趣的。

o.en: Mercurial or not, you sent someone to kill me.
o.zh: 不管你是反复无常还是怎样，你派人来杀我了。

entries.en: He grins, "Then I shall content myself with the cheer of your face."
entries.zh: 他咧嘴一笑，"这样我就能满足于你脸上的笑容了。"

entries.en:
Cotton sets his tea down, smile gone.

"I confess to you that I did not always seek victory over killing. Given battle, I chose to destroy my enemy over defeating them. In time, Ludd's spirit showed me the true Path. I humbly submit and step away from that younger man's rage when it serves our holy war."
entries.zh:
Cotton 放下他的茶，笑容消失了。

"我承认我不总是只寻求胜利而非寻求杀戮。在战斗中，我会选择摧毁我的敌人而不只是击败他们。但最终，卢德精神向我展示了真正的道路。当年轻人的愤怒为我们的圣战服务时，我只对他们敬而远之。"

entries.en: You sit with Brother Cotton, notorious Pather terrorist.
entries.zh: 你和 Cotton 修士，这位臭名昭著的左径恐怖分子面对面坐了下来。

entries.en: "Welcome to it." He slaps one of his legs, "This one'll raise complaint if I stand, so I'll beg your pardon for taking leisure where I can."
entries.zh: "欢迎欢迎。" 他拍了拍自己的一条腿，"如果我站起来的话，这腿就该抱怨了。所以希望你能原谅我待在舒适的地方。"

entries.en:
"Tell true, if I met you with hammer and fiery sword, would you prevail?" Cotton nods generously, "Might be you do. Then what would my brothers and sisters have died for? The clone?"

He takes a moment to sip his tea, and finding it hot, blows on the cup.

"It serves our holy war that Kanta not forget that the Path is all around her, ephemeral and indomitable. Killing is not victory." He smiles wryly, "Not always."
entries.zh:
"说实话，如果我用铁锤和焰剑招待你的话，你还会获胜吗？" Cotton 慷慨地点了点头，"也许你会赢。然后我的修士和修女们是为什么而死的？那个克隆人吗？"

他停了一下抿了一口茶，发现它还很烫，就吹了吹杯子。

"提醒 Kanta 她一直身处左径包围之中，虽可能转瞬即逝却不可完全战胜，这会有利于我们的圣战。杀戮并不是胜利。" 他苦笑着，"并不总是。"

o.zh: 这似乎是难以言说的非暴力。

o.en: Did you realize that you cannot best me in combat?
o.zh: 你发现你不能在战斗中打败我了吗？

o.en: I suppose you have better things for them to die for?
o.zh: 我想，你总该有些更好的东西让他们为之而死吧？

entries.en:
"Hegemony tacticians and the thinking machines alike make the same mistake: they think that we who walk the Path can be defeated if we are measured, tracked, and numbered. Our beautiful holy war is not a mathematical calculation, but the soul of humanity. What we fight for cannot be held in databanks and logbooks."

He looks at you carefully. "I am certain that now is not our time to do battle," he says. "We walk a path, you and I, and here it crosses but does not end. I know not but that I must have faith."

He sips his tea. "It's good now. You should have some."
entries.zh:
"霸主 的战术家们和会思考的机器都犯了同样的错误：他们认为，只要可以被测量、被追踪、被计数，我们这些走上了卢德之道的人就可以被打败。然而我们美丽的圣战不是数学计算，而是人类的灵魂。我们奋斗的目标不能被数据库和日志里的东西衡量。"

他谨慎地看着你。"我很确定现在不是我们战斗的时候。" 他说道，"我们两人走在自己的道途上，现在它们交汇了，但还没有抵达尽头。我不知道接下来事情会如何发展，可我的信念依然坚定。"

他抿着茶。"现在挺好了。你也喝点。"

entries.en:
"You know the histories, of the great and terrible Warlord Onesimos Loke, yes? Once a grand officer of the Domain..." Cotton looks distant, "The Knights of Ludd stood then with the Hegemony. Standing with Pride against Wrath. Was that the Path?"

"This abomination is a sad copy of Onesimos Loke concocted by so-called 'doctor' Cydonia. He is a sick man, and to please Kanta for reasons I do not understand, he made a sick joke of the miracle of life."
entries.zh:
"你了解关于伟大而恐怖的军阀 Onesimos Loke 的历史，不是吗？他曾经是 人之领 的高级军官..." Cotton 看起来有些恍惚，"卢德骑士当时与 霸主 站在一起。与荣耀一起对抗愤怒。那是卢德之道吗？"

"这个令人厌恶的东西是所谓的 '医生' Cydonia 制作的 Onesimos Loke 悲惨的复制体。Cydonia 是一个病态的人，因为我不知道的原因讨好 Kanta，他用生命的奇迹开了个恶心的玩笑。"

entries.en:
"I had thought its death would be a demonstration, just as a healer excises a cancer. But as I held a gun to its head, my hand was stayed. I felt this was not the Path. Did I pity the thing? It is rare indeed that I do not find moral clarity in the execution of a heretic or abomination."

Cotton shakes his head, disturbed that he did not want to execute a man.

"I gave it into the care of some siblings of the faith. They taught it prayer from the Book. It appears to think, and to feel. I wonder if this is a lesson in humility. Imagine, to look upon the Creator's work and then this bloodless thing..."
entries.zh:
"我原以为它的死会是一场示范，就像一个治疗师切除一个肿瘤一样。但是当我拿枪指着它的头时，我的手停了下来。我感到这并不是正确的道路。我可怜这个东西了吗？很稀奇，我在处决这个异端和怪物时并没有得到心灵的纯净。"

Cotton 摇着头，因他未能处决那个人而深感心烦意乱。

"我把它交给一些虔诚的姐妹们照顾。她们用典籍教给它祈祷。它似乎在思考，也在感受。我想知道这是否是一个关于谦逊的教训。想象一下，目睹了造物主的作品后，再看看这毫无生气的东西..."

entries.en: Brother Livewell Cotton nods, and to your surprise simply says, "Then you shall."
entries.zh: Livewell Cotton 修士点了点头，出乎你的意料地简单说道，"可以。"

entries.en: You have arranged a meeting with Brother Cotton in a spacer bar on the surface.
entries.zh: 你在地面上的一家太空佬酒吧安排了与 Cotton 修士的会面。

entries.en: You have arranged a meeting with Brother Cotton in a spacer bar on the surface, but you need to approach Epiphany with your transponder off to sneak a shuttle past what passes for the traffic authority.
entries.zh: 你在地面上的一家太空佬酒吧安排了与 Cotton 修士的会面，但你需要关闭应答器偷偷接近 Epiphany，才能让没有通行许可的穿梭机暗中前往目的地。

entries.en:
"Yer want the Gate, yeh?" the pirate $rank mumbles while chewing on something. "Well it's mine. So then yer'll have to pay me and mine some tasty nice credits."

The pirate smiles crookedly, showing off pieces of $hisOrHer last snack and some diamond incisors which you're sure were very impressive to some hive gang.

"Give me $gaATG_pirateScanCost credits, then yer can have at yon Gate and do yer businesses."
entries.zh:
"你也想要星门哈？" 这名海盗 $rank 一边咀嚼着什么东西一边喃喃地说。"但这是我的星门，你得付我点甜蜜蜜的星币。"

海盗咧嘴笑了笑，你能看到$hisOrHer上一口食物的残渣，还有两颗金刚石门牙，这在他们那个巢区黑帮里应该算是个很霸气的东西。

"给我付 $gaATG_pirateScanCost 星币，你就可以拿走这个大铁环，随便你拿去干什么。"

o.en: Does not knowledge provide value to all humanity and, by generous corollary, you?
o.zh: 难道知识不是对全人类都有价值吗？你既然是个海盗，那么四舍五入也算个人吧？仔细想想吧，我要做的事对你也有价值。

o.en: Why pay when I can blast your fleet into dust?
o.zh: 如果我能把你的舰队炸成灰，是不是就不用付款了？

o.en: I was just leaving. Enjoy your Gate.
o.zh: 我正要走呢。好好享受你的星门。

entries.en:
A silent ring of adamantine material, derelict of a former age.

You query the status of the Gate scanning package and your sensors officer gives you a quick head-shake. Their station interface is spotted with amber warning messages.

"Captain, that pirate fleet is... it looks like they're pulsing their drive bubble. The Gate scanner can't make a lock with all that interference."
entries.zh:
一座沉寂已久的环状结构，由坚固的材料制成，是来自上个时代的遗迹。

你询问星门扫描仪器的状态，传感器技官只是摇了摇头，他面前的操作面板上满是橙色的警告信息。

"舰长，那支海盗舰队... 他们的驱动泡好像正在蹦迪一样。星门扫描仪没法在这么多干扰的情况下锁定目标。"

entries.en:
You order the credits transferred and note their arrival by the big, crudely-modified smile the pirate produces.

"Have yer at it, good cap'n!" $heOrShe shouts, then mashes $hisOrHer control console. The comm-link fails to terminate on the first try, but the second jab gets it, and you are relieved of the pirate's virtual presence.
entries.zh:
你下令传输星币。海盗脸上露出了大而粗犷的笑。

"好好享受，好人舰长！" $heOrShe喊道，然后砸了一下$hisOrHer控制台。第一次拍打没能切断通讯，不过第二次成功了，你从海盗的虚拟影像中解脱出来。

entries.en:
The pirate looks confused and possibly a little upset.

"Wha?" $heOrShe says through another bite from an emergency combat ration bar.
entries.zh:
海盗看起来很困惑，可能还有点心烦。

"捏说啥么？" $heOrShe一边咬着应急作战干粮一边吐出几个字。

o.en: I come to do science and pursue applications for new discoveries.
o.zh: 我来这里是做科研的，为新发现的理论寻求应用的渠道。

o.en: Why pay when I can blast your fleet into dust?
o.zh: 如果我能把你的舰队炸成灰，为什么要付款？

o.en: I was just leaving. Enjoy your Gate.
o.zh: 我正要走呢。好好享受你的星门。

entries.en:
"Just don't yer be doing that without buying me a drink first, ha-ha-ha," the pirate turns to laugh at $hisOrHer crew, who obediently join in.

$HeOrShe turns back, "So will yer be paying me to burn out, or?"
entries.zh:
"先给我买杯酒再讲这些，哈哈哈 —— " 海盗大笑转向$hisOrHer的船员们，后者也顺从地跟着笑了起来。

$HeOrShe转身看向你，"那你到底是付钱还是怎样？"

o.en: Why pay when I can blast your fleet into dust?
o.zh: 如果我能把你的舰队炸成灰，为什么要付款？

o.en: I was just leaving. Enjoy your Gate.
o.zh: 我正要走呢。好好享受你的星门。

entries.en:
Painstakingly, you walk the pirate step by step through an argument for a universal ethics of collective betterment with the particular application of allowing you to perform your scan gratis. It is a gamble, you admit - and the pirate understands gambling, enthusiastically - but one in which we all bet for potential wins from the universe itself.

This analogy bears more fruit, and you manage to advance a narrative throughline of cheating the house, where the pot to be won is the corpus of hyperspace physics knowledge and the house is the natural world itself. A crude approach, you reflect, but you're willing to compromise holistic fidelity to hurry the conversation along.

You prompt the pirate: "So by allowing me access to this Gate..."
entries.zh:
你费尽心思，循序渐进地为海盗讲解，为什么集体改善的普世伦理要求他允许你不付钱就进行扫描。你承认说这是一场豪赌 —— 这名海盗也热情地回复道他懂得赌博 —— 但大家都是在为宇宙本身会变得更好而下注。

这个类比有了效果，你顺水推舟，把整件事比作赌博讲了下去：为了赢得头奖，我们要欺骗庄家，只不过这里的头奖是取之不尽的超空间物理知识，而庄家正是宇宙本身。你事后回想，这的确是个粗暴的办法，但只要能推进对话，你愿意牺牲一些准确性。

你引导着海盗说出那句话："所以，如果你允许我扫描星门的话..."

entries.en: "I, I-" the pirate speaks hesitatingly, "...make richer... both of us. More."
entries.zh: "我，我 ——" 海盗语无伦次地说，"...变得更富有... 我和你都是。更有钱。"

entries.en: "Okay." The pirate sits back, tired. "We will go now. So yer better come back and pay me lots more credits in, uh, a cycle? Or we'll make you eat laser."
entries.zh: "成吧。" 海盗疲倦地瘫坐下去。"我们会乖乖离开。然后你最好回来付我一大笔钱，懂吗？呃，一年为限，不然我们就喂你吃激光。"

entries.en:
As the comms-link is terminated, the pirate fleet powers down weapons and turns away from the Gate.

Your attempt to instill a new ethos seems to have failed, but you judge it unlikely that this particular pirate captain will last long enough to attempt to collect what they think you're offering in a cycle anyway. And, more important, the Gate is clear of their drive-field interference.
entries.zh:
通讯链接关闭了，海盗舰队关闭了武器，离开了星门。

你似乎没能成功给海盗灌输新的观念，但你认为这个海盗基本不太可能活到一年后领取他自以为的 "赏金"。更重要的是，星门附近的驱动场干扰已经消除了。

o.en: So Baird hasn't thrown you over to the Hegemony yet?
o.zh: 所以 Baird 还没有把你扔给 霸主 吗？

entries.en: "Naw. We've got too much to offer one another," Gargoyle says casually. "Me: peerless skill, wit, and resourcefulness. Her: boundless ambition exceeded only by her resentment."
entries.zh: "还没呢，毕竟我们还能相互利用的东西实在是太多了。" Gargoyle 漫不经心地开着玩笑。"我嘛，不但技艺超群，举世无双，还幽默风趣，足智多谋。她嘛，在那无尽的野心之上，还有着无穷的怨恨。"

entries.en:
The hacker ticks off an additional finger, "Me: the dirt, from both near and afar."

Another finger, "Her: credits, legitimacy, and if not forgiveness then a clear head about the value of an asset despite personal feelings about said asset."

"I'll be fine," Gargoyle says, waving a hand dismissively. "I must say though, I am touched that you're so concerned about my well-being."
entries.zh:
黑客再弯下了一根手指，"我嘛，远看近看都是屑。"

然后接着另一根手指，"她嘛，诚实守信，公平正当，还有不知道宽宏大量算不算？毕竟她对某件资产即便有些个人看法，她还总能在估价的时候保持清醒的头脑。"

"我会没事的，" Gargoyle 说道，无所谓地挥了挥手。"不过我不得不说，你这样关心我的幸福还真让我有点小感动了。"

entries.en:
"W-well, she's been under a lot of pressure. And," he doesn't meet your eye as he speaks. "She just, just doesn't have time to think about people's feelings so much when, when there are such big problems, and things."

"That's just how, um, great people are sometimes," he concludes quietly.
entries.zh:
"嗯...好吧。她压力挺大的。" 他眼神闪烁地说道，"并且，她只是... 只是没有时间去充分考虑人们的感受，当... 当出了这么大的问题时。"

"这就是... 呃... 大人物有大人物的问题。" 他轻声总结道。

entries.en:
Sebestyen looks up at you, unsure.

"M-maybe not," he says, unsure. Then seems to realize who he's talking to. "Captain."

"Um, is there anything else I can help you with?"
entries.zh:
Sebestyen 抬头看着你，将信将疑。

"也...也许，" 他不确定地说道。然后似乎意识到了他在跟谁说话，"舰长。"

"嗯，有什么别的事情能为你效劳吗？"

entries.en:
Sebestyen nods.

"So, um. Captain. Is there anything else I can help you with?"
entries.zh:
Sebestyen 点了点头。

"所以，呃... 舰长。有什么其他的我能帮你的吗？"

entries.en: Sebestyen nods, his relief plain on his face.
entries.zh: Sebestyen 点了点头，脸上显得很轻松。

o.en: I do believe that I was meant to be paid after this Janus business.
o.zh: 我坚信 '双面神' 这桩事后，我理应得到报酬。

entries.en:
"Oh! Captain, yes, of course," Sebestyen says, flustered.

"I just, I- you know, with everything going on at the end there. Security, the shouting, the uh. Yes, getting you paid, let's see," he taps nervously at his console.

"Finance... contracts... $playerLastName... Yes, there you are." He manages a smile, "And there you go."

"Um," he begins.
entries.zh:
"哦！舰长，是的，当然了。" Sebestyen 慌乱地说道。

"我只是，那个...你懂的，在忙着给这一切收个尾。警卫！让他们别这么吵！呃..哦对了，是的，要给你报酬，让我查查..." 他有些紧张地敲击着他的控制台。

"财务... 合约人... $playerLastName... 是的，你在上面。" 他勉强地笑了笑，"好了。"

"唉。" 他又要开始说什么了。

entries.en: "I- I just wanted to say thank you," he says. "For um, it's been an honor to be a part of- of making history. I guess."
entries.zh: "我，我刚才只是想对你说声谢谢，" 他说道。"我，呃...能成为，呃...开创历史的一员，是一种荣誉，我想。"

o.en: I couldn't have done it without you.

entries.en:
"T- thank you. I mean, yes," he's clearly blushing now. "Good bye."

He manages to hit the comm-link cutoff on his second try.
entries.zh:
"谢... 谢谢你。我是说，很荣幸。" 他显然脸红了，"再见。"

他尝试了两次才成功关闭了通讯链接。

entries.en:
"I, uh. Yeah. I won't." Sebestyen attempts his best devil-may care spacer nod.

It could use some work.

"C-catch you around. Captain," he says, and manages to hit the comm-link cutoff on his second try.
entries.zh:
"我，呃。当然，我不会。" Sebestyen 努力学着像个宇宙民一样漫不经心地点头回应。

这人还真得多下点功夫。

"有...有机会再见，舰长。" 他说着，并尝试了两次才切断了通讯链接。

entries.en:
"Um, nothing captain," he says quickly. "Don't mean to take any more of your time. Good day. Captain."

He manages to hit the comm-link cutoff on his second try.
entries.zh:
"嗯，没什么事，舰长，" 他马上说道。"就不占用你时间了。向你问好，舰长。"

他尝试了两次才切断通讯链接。

entries.en: He looks at you for a long moment, then simply says "Thank you."
entries.zh: 他盯着你看了好一会，说了声 "谢谢。"

o.en: The provost seemed a bit upset last we spoke.
o.zh: 上次我们谈话之后，院长似乎有点不愉快。

entries.en:
"Ah, um. Yes." Sebestyen looks incredibly uncomfortable.

"It's been... difficult," he says. "For us all, I'm sure."

He coughs, and his eyes roam like he's looking for an escape pod.
entries.zh:
"呃，嗯。是的。" Sebestyen 看起来很不自在。

"这... 很难，" 他说道。"对我们所有人来说，我确信。"

他咳嗽了几声，眼神四处游荡，就像在寻找逃生舱。

o.en: You've done a good job, Alviss. We did some great things together.
o.zh: 做的不错，Alviss。我们一起干了件大事。

o.en: I don't see how you're so loyal, the way Baird treats everyone.
o.zh: 我不明白，Baird 对这么多人干了这么多事，你怎么还能这么忠心耿耿。

o.en: Maybe we should talk about something else.

entries.en: "Yes, yes that'd be good," he says quickly.
entries.zh: "是，是，那太好了。" 他马上说道。

o.en: Prepare a raid to extract Clone Loke
o.zh: 准备一场劫掠以营救克隆人 Loke

o.en: Prepare a raid to extract Elissa Zal
o.zh: 准备一场劫掠以营救 Elissa Zal

entries.en:
The station comms connect to the office of the provost with no delay and your navigation officer forwards the link to your command interface. She was waiting.

"Tell me what happened." Baird's tone is cold as vacuum. Coureuse is already on the link, looking paler than usual.

You get the distinct feeling that the provost knows very well what happened.
entries.zh:
空间站通讯系统立马就连接到了院长办公室，领航军官把通讯转接给你的命令界面。她在等着你。

"告诉我发生什么了。" Baird 的语调和真空一样冷。Coureuse 也已经在通讯中了，她的脸看上去比平时苍白许多。

你有种感觉，院长肯定早就知道会发生什么了。

o.en: There was some kind of accident.
You tell me what happened! I could have been killed by that thing!
o.zh: 老子还想问你呢！我差点就被那玩意干死了！

o.en: I've seen worse. What's plan B?
o.zh: 我还经历过更糟糕的场面。还有备用计划吗？

entries.en: "Yes, an accident," Baird says with a derisive snort. "The prototype failed. Nearly catastrophically. A negative result, however dramatic, is still a useful data point... which can be used to correct our errors."
entries.zh: "是，一点事故。" Baird 轻蔑地哼了一声。"原型机失败了。可以说是灾难性的失败。不过无论怎样，一次失败的尝试也是有用的数据... 我们可以利用它纠正我们的错误。"

entries.en: "But you weren't. You're a survivor, captain, which is why you're ideal for this work. Besides," she says too-casually, "Making history is a dangerous career choice. The one you chose."
entries.zh: "但你还活着。你总是能死里逃生，舰长，这就是为什么你是这项工作的最佳人选。另外，" 她过于随便地说，"谱写历史本来就是个高危职业。而你选择了这个职业。"

entries.en:
Baird narrows her eyes at this. "Plan B is we recalibrate the device using the data you've gained from the experiment. Then we try again."

Coureuse begins to speak, then thinks better of it. She looks ill at the thought.
entries.zh:
Baird 眯起眼。"备用计划就是，我们用你获得的数据重新校准我们的设备。然后我们再试一次。"

Coureuse 想说什么，但又忍住了。她看起来很不自在。

entries.en: Baird turns to Coureuse, "Academician. When will the next iteration of the prototype be completed?"
entries.zh: Baird 转向 Coureuse，"院士，原型机的下一次迭代什么时候能完成？"

entries.en:
"I don't-" she starts, "We need more time."

"Academician-" Baird begins, a warning.

Coureuse interrupts, "I'm a theoretician, not an engineer! This isn't a matter of just fitting pipes or, or aligning agrav plates. What we're doing is completely new and, and our engineering process is primitive. We're scientists trying to assemble the equivalent of, of, of a new hyperdrive in a teaching workshop! Not only are the facilities insufficient, the project application falls outside my expertise!"

Baird visibly calms herself, but beneath her collected facade something seethes.
entries.zh:
"我没法 ——" 她开口，"我们需要更多时间。"

"院士 ——" Baird 用警告的语气说。

Coureuse 打断了她，"我是个理论家，不是工程师！我们要干的活可不单单是什么把两根管子接在一起，也不是，也不是把无重力板材对齐。我们的工作可以说是前所未见的，但我们的工程过程实在是太不成熟了。我们只是普通科学家，但我们的任务相当于是在教学工坊里徒手造出一台超空间驱动引擎！我们不仅设施不齐全，项目也完全超出了我们的专业范畴！"

Baird 显然在试图让自己平静下来，但在她镇定的外表之下，有些东西正在沸腾。

entries.en:
"You do realize," the provost says, "That I am holding several Hegemony ministries at bay? They're rearing to storm and purge the Galatia Academy. Again. All I have on my side are the good graces of 'the hive-scum hegemon' Baikal Daud. And that, THAT is only held up by the Sector-shattering promise of what the results of this project could mean. If I don't get results, the lucky ones will live out their days in some oubliette near the core of Coatl."

"I'm sorry you're having trouble," she says without a trace of apology, "But I am accommodating the conditions circumstances have provided."
entries.zh:
"我希望你明白，" 院长说道，"我现在正把多少个 霸主 部门挡在门外？他们现在已经等不及想给 Galatia 学院来一次大清洗了。我再说一遍，我现在仅有的支持就是 '巢区恶霸' Baikal Daud 的好意。但就连这个，也只是看在这个项目或许对整个星域影响深远的份上。但如果搞砸了，我们中运气最好的家伙也许能在 Coatl 地心深处的某座地牢里度过余生了。"

"我很抱歉你遇上了各种问题，" 她不带一丝歉意地说道，"但环境如此，我也无能为力。"

entries.en:
"You do realize," the provost says, "That I am holding several Hegemony ministries at bay? They're rearing to storm and purge the Galatia Academy. Again. All I have on my side are the good graces of 'the hive-scum hegemon' Baikal Daud. And that, THAT is only held up by the Sector-shattering promise of what the results of this project could mean. If I don't get results, the lucky ones will live out their days in some oubliette near the core of Coatl."

Her icy glare shifts to you for a moment, "At least the captain here had the good sense to perform the failed experiment in a remote system."

"I'm sorry you're having trouble," she says without a trace of apology, "But I am accommodating the conditions circumstances have provided."
entries.zh:
"我希望你明白，" 院长说道，"我现在正把多少个 霸主 部门挡在门外？他们现在已经等不及想给 Galatia 学院来一次大清洗了。我再说一遍，我现在仅有的支持就是 '巢区恶霸' Baikal Daud 的好意。但就连这个，也只是看在这个项目或许对整个星域影响深远的份上。但如果搞砸了，我们中运气最好的家伙也许能在 Coatl 地心深处的某座地牢里度过余生了。"

她冰冷的目光转向你片刻，"至少这位舰长还算明智，把失败的实验安排在了偏远星系。"

"我很抱歉你遇上了各种问题，" 她不带一丝歉意地说道，"但环境如此，我也无能为力。"

entries.en:
"So by all means Scylla, take your time," Baird finishes with icy sarcasm.

Coureuse starts, like she wants to speak.

"What," Baird says, "Is it."

"I need Elissa Zal," Coureuse says quietly.
entries.zh:
"所以，Scylla，请你务必慢慢来，" Baird 以冷冰冰的讽刺结束道。

Coureuse 抬起头，好像想说些什么。

"还，有，" Baird 一字一句，"什，么，事。"

"我需要Elissa Zal，" Coureuse 小声说。

entries.en:
"Who." says Baird, her patience for excuses at an end.

"A... friend. An engineer. The best hardware wizard I know- I've ever known. Except she's, um, in trouble. It's a long story, but when we knew each other back on Westernesse there was-"
entries.zh:
"谁。" Baird 已经没有了听借口的耐心。

"我的一个... 朋友。是个工程师。我认识的摆弄硬件最厉害的人。不过她，呃，遇上了点麻烦事。说来话长，我是在 Westernesse 上认识她的，然后 ——"

entries.en:
Baird interrupts the backstory, "Captain $playerName. Get Coureuse's 'friend' if she thinks that'll help."

"Do whatever it takes," she says. "Bribe, blackmail, kill. I do not care. Be smart and be quiet about it. If we get a new prototype before you find this 'Elissa Zal' character, we'll try that route. If not, carry on. I don't want to know the details because I do not care."
entries.zh:
Baird 打断了背景故事，"$playerName 舰长。如果 Coureuse 觉得她的 '朋友' 会有帮助，那就把她找来。"

"用尽一切手段。" 她说，"贿赂，敲诈，暗杀，随便你怎么样。但是机灵点，别闹出太大动静。如果我们在你找到这位 Elissa Zal 之前能造出一台新的原型设备，我们会找你来测试。否则就继续找她。不用跟我汇报任务细节了，我根本不想知道。"

entries.en:
"Academician Scylla Coureuse." The provost's withering attention shifts like a pulsar beam.

"I don't want to hear a single non-actionable complaint until you have a new Janus prototype ready to deploy. Captain $playerName will run any of your little errands."

"Now," the provost concludes, "I have a meeting with a very prickly Hegemony inspector and we're both going to pretend that we know nothing about what just happened out there. Both of you get off my comms."

The link terminates.
entries.zh:
"Scylla Coureuse 院士。" 院长的目光像脉冲星的光束一样烧灼着。

"在你做出一台新的 '双面神'装置 原型机前，我不想听到哪怕一句无意义的抱怨。$playerName 舰长会代你解决这堆破事。"

"现在，" 院长收尾道，"我得去和某位非常棘手的霸主审查员见一面，而我们还都得假装对刚才发生的小 '事故' 毫不知情。现在你俩给我滚出通讯频道。"

通讯链接被终止了。

entries.en: Security confirms your order.
entries.zh: 警卫确认了你的命令。

entries.en: Security confirms your order.
entries.zh: 警卫确认了你的命令。

entries.en:
Tactical whispers in your ear, "Captain, detected stealth mines arming. Sparse envelopment of $shipOrFleet. Damage outlook - checking - moderate. They want to show they can hit us."

Kanta's voice rolls from the comms, "Kanta wields, and it is Kanta who orders. If... we give you a gift, it will be only at our pleasure. You must learn."

"Yes, yes," Cydonia agrees, "You must learn. Kanta has for you another task: complete it without complaint then perhaps you may win back her favor... after, after such an outrageous-"
entries.zh:
战术军官在你耳边轻声说道，"舰长，探测到隐形空雷布设正在启动。$shipOrFleet已被零散的空雷包围着。损伤预测检测中...中等。显然，他们想要展示他们拥有击沉我们的能力。"

Kanta 的声音从通讯器中传来，"这是 Kanta 的地盘，所以只有 Kanta 说了才算。如果...要咱家送你这件礼物，那只有在咱家乐意的时候才可以。懂了么。"

"是的，是的。" Cydonia 赞同到，"你必须再上道一些。Kanta 为你安排了另一项任务：毫无怨言地接受它，这样也许你能得回她的好感...毕竟，在如此放肆的 ——"

entries.en: "$ShipOrFleet ready to burn," says navigation.
entries.zh: "$ShipOrFleet准备点火。" 领航官说。

entries.en:
Kanta breaks into a titanium smile.

"Good, good," says Cydonia, rushing to get a word in. "The warlord is much pleased with your work."
entries.zh:
Kanta 突然发出钛金般的笑容。

"很好，很好，" Cydonia 急忙插嘴说。"军阀对你的工作很满意。"

entries.en:
Zal speaks up, "Kanta will call her fleets. They usually loiter in nearby hyperspace. They'll come through the jump-points, then straight for us."

"We've got a way to get out of the Magec system without a fight," and you hear a smile in her voice. "In the equipment case I brought on board: a fully operational Janus Device."
entries.zh:
Zal 大声说到，"Kanta 会召集她的舰队。他们通常在超空间附近游荡。他们会通过跳跃点进来，然后直接向我们而来。"

"我们有能够不战斗离开 Magec 星系的方法，" 你从她的声音里听出了一丝笑意，"在这个我带上船的装备箱里，有一个能够完全运行的 '双面神' 装置。

o.en: Nav, set course for the Magec Gate.
o.zh: 领航官，航向 Magec 星门。

o.en: This isn't going to be another Galatia incident, is it.
o.zh: 这不会重蹈 Galatia 实验的覆辙吧。

entries.en: "Course locked in. Captain," navigation responds, a little nervous.
entries.zh: "航向已锁定。舰长。" 领航官有些紧张地回答道。

entries.en: "It won't be," says Zal. "I promise. And besides, if it was? Imagine the hammer that would fall on Kanta."
entries.zh: "不会这样的，" Zal 说道，"我保证。另外，如果是这样的话？可以想象铁锤会落在 Kanta 头上。"

o.en: Nav, set course for the Magec Gate.
o.zh: 领航官，航向 Magec 星门。

o.en: Nav, just take us away from here.
o.zh: 领航官，带我们离开这里就好。

entries.en: "Captain," your tactical officer reports, "The stealth mines have disarmed. We're clear to disengage."
entries.zh: "舰长，" 你的战术军官报告道，"隐形空雷已经解除武装，我们可以撤退了。"

entries.en:
Kanta laughs inhumanly.

"Ah," says the doctor, licking his lips. "I'm afraid it isn't quite so simple as that. You've not pleased the great warlord Kanta sufficiently for her to simply give you her prize tinker."
entries.zh:
Kanta 残忍地笑着。

"啊，" 医生舔着嘴唇说。"恐怕并没有那么简单。你并没有让伟大的军阀 Kanta 满意到足以让她轻易地将她宝贵的修理匠送给你。"

o.en: What is it you want, then?
That wasn't part of the deal, Kanta.
You call yourself warlord? You're a small-time cheat and liar.
o.zh: 你管自己叫军阀？你就是个不入流的骗子。

entries.en:
Your nav officer calls your attention to the bridge display of the local volume; what passes for traffic control around Kanta's Den appears to be non-operational. A comms request blinks suddenly.

Warlord Kanta appears, a masked face atop a throne draped with the trophies of raids and conquest.
entries.zh:
你的领航军官提醒你关注舰桥上展示的本地信号；Kanta 之巢附近的交通控制系统似乎没有运行。一条通讯请求突然闪烁起来。

军阀 Kanta 现身了，一张戴着面具的面孔高踞于王座之上，王座周围挂满了劫掠与征服的战利品。

entries.en:
Beside her, of course, is 'doctor' Cydonia, who begins to speak. "Ah, so captain, do-"

"Do you return our dear Loke?" Kanta booms over him.
entries.zh:
在她身旁的，当然便是 Cydonia '医生'，他开口道。"啊，所以舰长，你 —— "

"你带回咱家亲爱的 Loke 了吗？" Kanta 大声盖过了他。

o.en: Yes. A shuttle will take him stationside.
o.zh: 是的。一艘穿梭机会把他带到空间站边上。

o.en: I have Loke for you. But first, I want Zal.
o.zh: 我会把 Loke 交给你。但首先，我要 Zal。

entries.en:
Zal's image flickers, then holds steady.

"I took the liberty of injecting one of Gargoyle's tricks into their network." She smirks. "Would you mind letting me on board? It won't take them long to get a signal out. This volume is going to be swarming with pirates very soon, to say nothing of the stealth mine network."
entries.zh:
Zal 的图像闪烁着，然后稳定了下来。

"我擅自将 Gargoyle 的一个小把戏注入到他们的网络中。" 她得意地笑着，"你介意我登船吗？他们过不了多久就会发出信号。这附近很快就会被海盗包围，更不用说隐形空雷网络了。"

o.en: Open the pod bay doors, ops.

entries.en:
After a tense minute, security reports that they've brought Zal aboard - along with a large equipment case. At your orders, your security chief provides her with a ship's comm unit.

"I owe you one," Zal says, "And I think I can repay you shortly. But first you're going to want to get out of the stealth mine network."

"I think you have something Kanta values more than taking revenge on you. Or me."
entries.zh:
紧张的一分钟后，警卫报告说他们已经让 Zal 登舰 —— 还有一个大型装备箱。在你的命令下，你的安全主管给她了一个舰上通讯单元。

"我欠你一个人情，" Zal 说，"然而我认为我很快就能回报你了。但首先你会想要离开隐形空雷网络。"

"我认为你有一些 Kanta 比起向你，或是向我复仇更看重的东西。"

o.en: Security- toss the Loke clone out an airlock. With a helmet.
o.zh: 警卫，把克隆人 Loke 扔出气闸。给他戴着头盔。

o.en: Security- toss the Loke clone out an airlock.
o.zh: 警卫，把克隆人 Loke 扔出气闸。

entries.en:
Zal joins the line, interrupting Cydonia.

"-I've decided to take Captain $playerName up on that deal," Zal says. Her voice sounds close, as if she is speaking from inside a vacsuit. "Captain, I'm outside your flagship now if you would please open the bay doors."

Shock washes over Cydonia, "Impossible!" he says, and turns to some minion, "Check Zal's quarters! Now!"
entries.zh:
Zal 打断了 Cydonia，插进通讯线路。

"—— 我已经决定接受 $playerName 舰长的交易了，" Zal 说。她的声音听起来很近，像是就在太空服里说话。"舰长，我现在在你的旗舰外面，你介意打开舱门吗。"

Cydonia 惊呆了，"不可能！"他说，然后转向下属们，"检查 Zal 的住处！现在！"

entries.en:
Kanta's voice roars painfully across the comms, "Call my fleets! Destroy th-"

Her cybernetic visage crackles in a wash of static.
entries.zh:
Kanta 的声音在通讯器中痛苦地回荡，"召集咱家的舰队来！干掉这个 ——"

她那张遍布改造的脸在一阵静电中碎裂消失。

entries.en: She looks off grimly, somewhere beyond her terminal's pick-up. "I shouldn't talk about it. Like this. I'll raise my concerns in the meeting with Provost Baird. Hopefully she listens."
entries.zh: 她目光阴沉地移开视线，向终端机以外的地方看去。"我不该说这些事情的。至少不该在这里说。我会在之后的会议中向 Baird 院长提出我的要求。希望她能听进去。"

entries.en:
Coureuse looks up from her console, a cloud of holo data shifting to adjust to her gaze, "Oh, it's you! The research team, ah, we're processing the data you've collected from the Gates."

"We've- we can't really talk about it until Provost Baird gives the go-ahead," she says. "But between you and me, the results are... exciting, but there are risks."
entries.zh:
Coureuse 的目光越过面前的控制台看向你，她面前一团团的全息数据为她的视线让开道路，"哦，是你啊！研究小组，嗯，正在分析你从星门上扫描到的数据。"

"我们现在已 —— 哎，在征得 Baird 院长同意前，我只能保持沉默，" 她说道。"不过，私下里给你透露一点，目前得出的结果... 很是令人兴奋，但也伴随着风险。"

entries.en:
"The automated transmitter returns worked perfectly. It's-," a series of expressions crosses Coureuse's face, and she begins to speak in half-starts at least three times before giving up. Instead, she laughs. "It's amazing, captain," she says, her eyes tracking back to the holo display, focusing back on the data.

"I have... so much to do," she says, distracted.
entries.zh:
"自动发信器传回的结果堪称完美。这可以说是..." Coureuse 的表情五味杂陈，她好像想解说些什么，但还是放弃了。她转而笑起来。"这数据真是太美妙了，舰长，" 她一边说一边看向全息显示屏，兴致满满地盯着扫描数据。

"我还有...很多要做的，" 她心不在焉地说道。

entries.en:
"An active scan picked it up once the Gate scanner, uh, told us where to look. It's very small, but somehow it's causing interference in the hyperspace manifold. Here, I can-" your sensors office taps a few controls and the Gate takes over the bridge display. An icon blinks near the center of the Gate.

Your sensors officer zooms in a subdisplay of visual EM. It's a dark, small shape, slowly rotating. Like a piece of space junk- with a power source.
entries.zh:
"啊，星门扫描仪告诉我们扫描目标方位后，我们用主动扫描发现了这个。它虽然很小，但能在超空间流形中造成干扰，原因未知。你看..." 传感器技官输入了几串指令后，星门的图像出现在了舰桥显示屏上，星门中心有个图标在闪烁。

你的传感器技官在副显示器上调出了放大后可见光波段的影像，这个漆黑的小玩意儿正在低速自转，它看上去就像搭载了能量源的太空垃圾。

o.en: Send a team to recover the microsat
o.zh: 派一支小队修复微型卫星

entries.en:
Your order the microsat destroyed. Tactical maintains a professional face but you can almost hear the grin in their response, "Aye, captain."

All stations are set to yellow alert. Weapons lock on target.
entries.zh:
你下令摧毁那个微型卫星。战术军官摆出一副严肃的面孔，但却掩盖不住声音中的笑意，"遵命，舰长。"

舰队进入黄色警戒状态，武器系统也锁定了目标。

entries.en:
The microsat disappears into a rapidly expanding cloud of energetic particles. You could swear you felt an imperceptible tremble through the hull of your flagship, and then nothing.

Your bridge officers hold their breath in anticipation of some reaction; a signal, an attack, a response. As the seconds tick away, there is nothing, and the tension eases.

Your sensors officer signals for your attention, "Captain. We've got a lock from the Gate scanner. Can proceed at your order, $playerSirOrMadam."
entries.zh:
微型卫星变成了一团逐渐向外扩散的高能粒子。你几乎能感受到你的旗舰船体轻微地颤抖了一下，然后万物回归寂静。

你的舰桥成员纷纷屏住呼吸，像是等待着某种回应，一段信号、一次攻击、一个答复。时间一秒一秒的过去，但什么都没有发生，紧张的气氛也随之缓和。

你的传感器技官提醒道，"舰长，星门扫描仪成功锁定目标。请下达命令，$playerSirOrMadam。"

entries.en:
A silent ring of adamantine material, derelict of a former age.

You query the status of the Gate scanning package and your sensors officer gives you a quick head-shake. Their station interface is spotted with amber warning messages.

"Captain, there's interference coming from... some kind of microsat in the middle of the Gate. The scanner can't make a lock."
entries.zh:
