一座沉寂已久的环状结构，由坚固的材料制成，是来自上个时代的遗迹。

你询问星门扫描仪器的状态，传感器技官只是摇了摇头。他面前的操作面板上满是橙色的警告信息。

"舰长，星门中间有个类似... 微型卫星的东西释放着强烈的干扰。星门扫描器没法锁定目标。"

o.zh: 看上去太可疑了，取消扫描。

entries.en:
At your command, your ops chief starts grumbling orders to the on-duty salvage teams. You watch as a pair of drones launch, figures in hardsuits dangling from hand-rails on the trailing drone.

The occupied drone halts at one Gate diameter from the microsat, leaving the other to recover the microsat via a remote operation.

At final approach, a manipulator arm is extended, and the clamps squeeze together in perfect time with the microsat's own slow rotation.

A burst of light fuzzes the display feed.
entries.zh:
按照你的命令，行动长官嘟哝着向当值的打捞小组下命令。你看着一对无人机离舰，穿着太空服的人影抓着靠后的无人机上的把手晃来晃去。

载着打捞员的无人机停在距离微型卫星一个星门直径那么远的地方，以便他们可以远程操控另一台无人机进行回收作业。

在最后一次变轨靠近后，无人机自转和卫星同步了。无人机的机械臂伸展开来，夹具完美地抓住了卫星。

这时，一道刺眼的白光占据了整个摄像头画面。

entries.en:
The display stutters and reforms. Your ops chief never even flinched. "Self-destruct charge," they report.

It's a standard operation from there. The salvage team manages to collect most of the pieces of microsat, and you view the assembled collection laid out in a small workspace off the primary cargo bay.

"Generic parts, more or less. Could be anyone who built it," your ops chief explains. "Unusual design to do what it does though. Y'know, to jam the Gate scanning what's-it," their eyes flicker to your tech officer, daring them to try to explain Coureuse's latest iteration on unified hyperfield theory again.
entries.zh:
画面卡顿了几下，随后恢复了正常。你的行动长官完全不为所动，并汇报道："自毁炸弹。"

之后的行动就是常规流程了。打捞小组成功收集了微型卫星残骸的大部分碎片，并在主货舱内的一处小型车间里对其进行重新组装。你通过视频通讯观察着这一切。

"基本都是随处可见的零部件，任何人都能造出这玩意。" 行动长官解释道，"不过这种设计的用途可不常见。和你想的一样，是用来干扰那个扫描星门的鬼玩意儿的。" 人们的目光瞟向技术军官，显然是已经听够了后者对 Coureuse 最新的超场理论一遍又一遍的讲解。

entries.en:
You're left only to speculate. At least the device itself is no longer blocking your scan.

Your sensors officer signals for your attention, "Captain. We've got a lock from the Gate scanner. Can proceed at your order, $playerSirOrMadam."
entries.zh:
你能做的只有揣测了。不过至少这个干扰设备已经被解除了。

你的传感器技官向你示意，"舰长，星门扫描仪已成功锁定目标。等候您的命令，$playerSirOrMadam。"

entries.en:
A silent ring of adamantine material, derelict of a former age.

There's a chime. "Wait," your sensors officer says, "There's a hypercomm pulse, uh, source near the Gate, some kind of microsat."

Your bridge crew quickly identifies a bogey hidden on the opposite side of the Gate and center it in the primary display. Before you can give a follow-up order there's a small flash of light, leaving only a rapidly expanding cloud of debris.

Your comms officer reports, "That was a coded pulse, very short. Probably a tactical scan of this $shipOrFleet. Then it self-destructed. Whoever left that microsat knows exactly who we are."
entries.zh:
一座沉寂已久的环状结构，由坚固的材料制成，是来自上个时代的遗迹。

舰桥里响起一阵叮叮的警报声。"等等，" 传感器技官说，"我们收到了一束超通讯脉冲，呃，来源就在星门附近，大概是某种微型卫星。"

你的舰桥船员很快就辨认出了这个可疑物体，它藏在星门的另一侧。船员们将它在屏幕上居中。在你还没来得及下达下一步命令，这个物体突然迸发出一道闪光，随后就变成了一团残骸。

通讯军官汇报道，"那脉冲是早就设定好的，持续时间非常短。大概是对我们的$shipOrFleet的一次战术性扫描。扫描完它就自爆了。把那颗微型卫星放在那里的家伙对我们的身份了如指掌。"

entries.en:
The scavenger fleet's captain smiles unconvincingly as the comm image resolves.

"Greetings starfarer!" $heOrShe says, thick with bonhomie. "Seen any good pickings around here? It's been a bit sparse for us, ha-ha, maybe we could use a tip or two."
entries.zh:
随着通讯链接建立，拾荒舰队的舰长勉强堆出一张笑脸。

"你好啊，远行者！" $heOrShe和善地说道，"在这附近有捞到什么好东西吗？我们近来运气不怎么好，啊哈哈... 要是您能分我们点物资就再好不过了。"

entries.en: "Too bad, too bad," $heOrShe says. A moments awkward pause, $heOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, then says, "So, um. Is there anything I can do for you, captain?"
entries.zh: "哎呀，那可真是太糟糕了。" $heOrShe说道。在一阵尴尬的沉默过后，$heOrShe舔了舔嘴唇，"所以，呃。有什么我能帮上你的吗，舰长？"

entries.en:
A long pause. Reluctantly the 'scavenger' concedes.

"Of course, of course. Captain. Guess you found something my scanners didn't 'eh? Well, that's the luck of the draw, like they say, and maybe it just isn't my day."

"Burn bright, my friend," $heOrShe concludes, and reaches for $hisOrHer comm cut-off.
entries.zh:
一段很长的沉默之后，这位 "拾荒者" 勉强松了口。

"当然，当然可以。舰长。我猜你的扫描器发现了些我们没能发现的东西，对吗？好吧，这就是所谓的风水轮流转，或许我今天就是有些点背。"

"祝你航行无阻，朋友。" $heOrShe就这样结束了对话，然后伸手按下了切断通信的按钮。

entries.en: "Oh, how wonderful! We'll have to burn on over there just as soon as I'm done my sweep here." $heOrShe smiles nervously, "You're too kind, captain. I'm sorry that I can't offer any good finds in return."
entries.zh: "哦，那真是太棒了！等我把这片区域再翻找一遍就过去。" $heOrShe紧张地笑了笑，"你是个好人，舰长。很抱歉我无以为报。"

entries.en:
"Just, ah. Being sure, right? Might have missed something on the first sweep. And don't think I don't appreciate your help, captain. Just, um."

$HeOrShe takes a second to think of an excuse, then finds it. "Ah, among us scavengers, see, it's so much better to find your own score than someone elses' leavings, no offense meant captain. Isn't that right?"
entries.zh:
"啊，只是再确认一下，是吧？或许有上次扫描漏了的东西。我很感谢你的帮助，舰长。只是，嗯。"

$HeOrShe花了一秒钟找借口。"你看，在我们拾荒者圈子里，别人留下的东西远不如自己找到的，不是吗？没有冒犯你的意思，舰长。"

entries.en:
"Ha-ha," that fake laugh again. A drop of sweat wobbles on the scavenger's forehead.

"I suppose, um. If you insist, captain, I'll be on your way. I should count myself lucky that I have you looking out for my good fortune, eh?"

"Burn bright, my friend," $heOrShe concludes shakily, and reaches for $hisOrHer comm cut-off.
entries.zh:
"哈哈..." 又是那张假装出来的笑脸。这位拾荒者的额头上渗出了几滴汗珠。

"如果你坚持如此的话，舰长，呃，那我想我们是该离开了。你没有打攻击我们的主意，我应该对此感到庆幸哈？"

"祝你航行无阻，朋友。" $heOrShe颤巍巍地结束了对话，然后伸手按下了断开通信按钮。

entries.en:
"What, that old thing? Ha-ha." $HisOrHer strained fake laugh is somewhat grating upon repeat, you discover.

"Well you know it is. We're all old hands at scavenging here, aren't we, fellow spacer? Sometimes you find lots of little wrecks around these Gates back from, y'know." $HeOrShe trails off.

Then begins to speak again as you fail to fill $hisOrHer silence. "Need to double and triple check to be sure, isn't that right? Maybe someone missed something out here and that'll be my lucky day," $heOrShe says. "So um. Did you need anything?"
entries.zh:
"什么？这个史前文物？哈哈..." 你不禁注意到，$HisOrHer的假笑听的太多，就变得有些刺耳了。

"你应该也知道原因吧。我们也都是一帮老骨头拾荒者了，不是吗，我的船员朋友？这些星门附近经常能找到不少小型残骸，也都是很古老的东西了，你懂的。" $HeOrShe停下了话语。

察觉到你无意接话后，$heOrShe继续说了起来。"得重复搜索两次，有时要三次，才能确定没漏掉什么，不对吗？谁知道会不会有人漏看了什么，那今天可就要变成我的幸运日了。" $heOrShe接着说道，"所以，呃。你有什么需要吗？"

entries.en:
"The Gate? Ha-ha ha-ha, oh Captain $playerName, you're a treasure." $HisOrHer fake laughter settles down quite quickly, and you see a drop of sweat wobble on $hisOrHer brow.

"Well, you know us spacers. Always telling stories about the Gates, isn't that right. Watch your back around an empty Gate, they say. Maybe it's just my, my what'sit, unconscious mind."
entries.zh:
"星门？哈哈哈哈，哦 $playerName 舰长，你可真会开玩笑。" $HisOrHer那伪装的笑容很快就停止了，而你注意到$hisOrHer眉毛上渗出了几滴汗珠。

"嗯，你也了解我们这样的人。经常讲关于星门的故事，对吧。即使是在空旷的星门附近也要看好自己的背后，他们都这么说。可能只是因为我的，叫什么来着，潜意识吧。"

entries.en: "I uh- of course, captain. It's in the comm link metadata of course. No offense intended, just being polite. We're all friends here, isn't that right, looking out for one another. Spacers got to stick together, that's what I always say."
entries.zh: "我，啊...哦，的确，舰长。我是从通讯链接传过来的元数据里看到的。我无意冒犯，表现得礼貌一些。我们在座的各位都是朋友，要相互照应着些，不是吗？宇宙民就是要这样团结一心，我经常这么说。"

entries.en:
"Ha-ha. Oh, captain. Myself, naturally. Well and uh, I've got an investor or two back on..." $heOrShe is visibly reaching for an answer, "Back on..."

It comes to $himOrHer. "Nomios, of course. Partners, right. Equal shares and whatnot. All on the up-and-up. Um, how about you?"
entries.zh:
"哈哈。哦，舰长。当然是我自己派我自己来的了。呃，其实我也有那么一两位投资人，就在..." $heOrShe伸出手，好像想要抓住答案似的，"就在..."

$himOrHer好像确实在心里抓到了一个答案。"就在 Nomios，当然了。合作伙伴，对。我们平分收益。可以说是风生水起啊。嗯，你呢？"

entries.en: Your sensors officer speaks, "Captain, you should know that they've been hitting us with some esoteric scanner sweeps ever since we entered proximity of the Gate. They probably don't think we know about it, but," they say with a hint of pride, "I caught some funny-looking background radiation."
entries.zh: 传感器技官开口了，"舰长，我有件事要向你汇报。在我们接近星门后，他们就一直在用某种古怪难懂的装备扫描我们。他们估计认为我们完全没有察觉，但是..." 语气转而带上了一丝骄傲，"我成功捕获到了一些很有意思的背景辐射。"

o.en: I'm going to need you to move away from the Gate.
o.zh: 我需要你远离这个星门。

o.en: There's a big cache on the other side of the system. My hold's full, so it's all yours.
o.zh: 星系那头有一整箱补给。我的货仓满了，干脆让给你吧。
可是这附近什么都没有。为什么要在这里干等？

o.en: I think it's time for you to go. I insist.
o.zh: 我再说一次，你是时候离开了。

o.en: Why are you lingering near the Gate?
o.zh: 你的舰队在星门附近徘徊，这是为什么？

o.en: It sure looks like you're watching the Gate. Expect something to come out?
o.zh: 在我看来你们就是在观察星门。那里面还能钻出来什么东西不成？

o.en: I don't recall giving you my name.
o.zh: 嗯？我可不记得跟你提起过我的名字。

entries.en:
The comms display resolves, and the League officer speaks without bothering to greet you.

"I am $rank $personName of the Persean League Navy. My orders are to facilitate a conversation." $HeOrShe looks annoyed, "With you." $HeOrShe obviously considers this task to be beneath $hisOrHer rank.

"Hold while my comms officer reroutes the link."

The Persean League crest flashes for a second, then another officer appears.
entries.zh:
通讯解析完成，这位联盟军官甚至没有打声招呼就直切正题。

"我是来自 英仙座联盟 海军的 $personName $rank。我接到的命令是促成一次对话。" $HeOrShe看起来有些生气，"和你的对话。" $HeOrShe显然被这份不符合身份的任务给惹恼了。

"稍等，我的通讯军官现在将转接你的通讯。"

英仙座联盟 的徽标仅闪了一下，就有另一名军官出现在了屏幕之上。

o.en: I don't have to tell you anything.
o.zh: 我没有义务向你报告任何事情。

entries.en:
Siyavong's smile grows as you resist his inquiry.

"Of course not, Captain $playerName. That is why I am having a simple conversation with you, and - if you'll let me - I will ask nicely."
entries.zh:
你拒绝配合他的询问，但 Siyavong 脸上的笑容却变大了。

"的确没有，$playerName 舰长。所以我只是想和你进行一次简单得不能再简单的谈话，而且 —— 如果你不介意的话 —— 我会亲切地问问。"

entries.en:
He folds his hands politely.

"I understand that you had a conversation with Horus Yaribay recently. He's an important man. Or, more accurately, Gens Yaribay is an important family. It must have been an interesting chat. I was wondering if you might assist my understanding of why that is so."
entries.zh:
他礼貌性地双手交叠。

"我了解到你最近和 Horus Yaribay 有过一次谈话。他是个重要人物。准确地说，Yaribay 氏族是个重要的家族。你们一定相谈甚欢吧。我想知道你是否可以帮助我理解，为什么你们的谈话会很有趣。"

o.en: Just work. Horus Yaribay made me his envoy to the Hegemony.
o.zh: 只是工作罢了。Horus Yaribay 指定我作为他和霸主之间的特使。

o.en: That conversation was private. Good day, lieutenant.
o.zh: 只是一次私人谈话。希望你有美好的一天，上尉。

o.en: Oh, Baird is blackmailing Horus Yaribay so she can negotiate a deal with the High Hegemon.
o.zh: 哦，Baird 在敲诈 Horus Yaribay，为了和至高霸主达成个什么交易。

entries.en:
Siyavong's smile seems frozen in place. "A pity," he says, the smile fading. "My curiosity shall remain unsated; its only fare? Bitter disappointment."

He sighs, and looks down for a moment, then back up, his spirits seemingly renewed.
entries.zh:
Siyavong 的笑容僵住了。"那可真遗憾，" 他说道。他脸上的笑容已经褪去，"看来我的好奇心是得不到满足了。我能得到的只有苦涩的失落。"

他叹了口气，垂下头看着什么，过了一会，又抬起头来，好像已经恢复了之前的精神。

entries.en:
"It's funny," he says, "Because despite their cosmopolitan affect, the Yaribays tend to use their own close gen-family as envoys."

Siyavong appears to think it over, then says "It must be your unique abilities and," he extends a hand toward you, "I would be remiss to neglect accounting for your not insignificant personal charm."

"But there must be more to it. The fact of your recent and recurring employment by the Galatia Academy keeps coming to mind. I simply cannot understand why."
entries.zh:
"这很有趣，"他说，"因为 Yaribay 氏族虽然拥有极为广泛的影响力，但却倾向于使用他们自己的亲属作为使节。"

Siyavong 看上去想了一下，接着说："我想这一定是因为你独特的能力，再加上，"他向你伸出一只手，"我怎么可以忽略你的个人魅力。"

"但肯定还有其他原因，你最近经常受雇于 Galatia 学院的事一直在我脑海中浮现。我无法理解其中原因。"

o.en: Nothing to do with it. But I'd keep an eye on Horus Yaribay if I were you.
o.zh: 和那些没有关系。但如果我是你的话，我会更加注意 Horus Yaribay。

o.en: If what you're implying were the case, it would be private. Good day, lieutenant.
o.zh: 如果你说的是真的，那这次就只是私人谈话了。希望你有美好的一天，上尉。

o.en: Oh, Baird is blackmailing Horus Yaribay so she can negotiate a deal with the High Hegemon.
o.zh: 哦，Baird 在敲诈 Horus Yaribay，为了和至高霸主达成个什么交易。

entries.en: Siyavong's smile doesn't reach his eyes. "Then I'm sure you'll forgive me for indulging my overactive imagination, captain. I will make sure to double-check my sources before bothering you again with such a trifle."
entries.zh: Siyavong 的嘴角上扬。"那我希望你能够原谅我过于发散的想象力，舰长。我保证会在下次因为这类琐事打扰你之前，先仔细检查自己的消息来源是否可靠。"

entries.en:
Siyavong's smile doesn't reach his eyes this time.

"I will indeed. And closely, by your worthy advice. I daresay, I respect your consideration for the good of the Persean League."

"So!" He claps his hands together, "I've taken too much of your time already."
entries.zh:
这次，Siyavong 的笑容没有那么舒展了。

"我一定会照做的，像你建议的那样紧紧盯着。我敢说，我尊重你为 英仙座联盟 利益的考量。"

"那么！" 他拍了拍手，"抱歉占用你那么多时间。"

entries.en:
Siyavong freezes for just a moment at your admission.

Then he starts to nod, breaking back into a smile. "Ah captain, my captain. Truly," he says with overwrought magnanimity, "You are a patriot of the League, channeling valuable intel about this gross conspiracy. Treasonous politics among the Kazeron gens, forbidden science in the black of space, the High Hegemon himself?"

"It's all connected," he whispers with a wink, then leans back. "But how does the secret Tri-Tachyon AI-god fit into this? Is it opposed by a motley cadre of heroic but tragically doomed Luddic crusaders?"

"No need to answer all at once captain, though I know you are more than willing."
entries.zh:
你的直言不讳让 Siyavong 呆住了好一会儿。

然后他点点头，重新换上标志性的微笑。"啊，舰长，我的好舰长。你可真是，" 他的语气中带着过度的宽宏大量，"联盟的爱国者为这种令人作呕的阴谋论提供了宝贵情报。Kazeron 大氏族之一参与的叛国政治，隐藏在深空中的禁忌科学，甚至牵扯到至高霸主本人？"

"它们的确有联系，" 他眨了眨眼轻声说道，然后抽回身子。"但是这个机密的速子科技 AI 是怎么跟这一切扯上关系的？它是否被那帮徒有勇气但命运悲惨的卢德十字军所反对着？"

"不用一次回答完这些，舰长，但我知道你是愿意回答的。"

o.en: I'm genuinely trying to help the League, lieutenant.
o.zh: 我真的是在帮助联盟，上尉。

o.en: I feel like you're not taking this seriously.
o.zh: 我觉得你没有认真对待我说的话。

o.en: I haven't figured it all out yet, but I will soon.
o.zh: 我还没有理清楚，但我就要得到答案了。

o.en: If you don't want to listen, then we're done here.
o.zh: 你要是没兴趣听的话，我们就到此为止吧。

entries.en:
"I see. Of course." his eyes flick over and up. Not quite an eye-roll.

He raises his hands, "But I have used too much of your time already, I'm sure. You've been, ah, quite illuminating. So."
entries.zh:
"我明白了，就是那样。" 他的眼角抬了抬，但并不是一副翻白眼的样子。

他抬起双手，"但我已经占用了你太多宝贵的时间。而我觉得，你给了我...这么说吧...很大的启发。那么..."

entries.en:
"But of course I am," he says, intent. "I take everything you do very seriously, captain. I watch your actions to see what you do not do, and listen carefully to the words you speak that I might hear what you do not say."

"This has been a valuable conversation to me." He picks up his datapad and taps it on his console conclusively.
entries.zh:
"但我的确有兴趣，" 他坚定地说，"我严肃地对待你做的任何一件事，舰长。我观察你的举动，看到你有所为有所不为，我聆听你说的话，听到你有所说有所不说。"

"这对我来说是一次宝贵的谈话。" 他拿起数据平板，把它放到控制台上，以示结束。

entries.en:
"More the credit to us then," Siyavong says, looking at you skeptically.

"If this is truly how you feel, then I hope we may enjoy similarly fruitful conversations at a future meeting. Perhaps we can all be more forthright when the time is right. But- until then."
entries.zh:
"那我们十分感谢，" Siyavong 怀疑地看着你说。

"如果你真的这样觉得，那我希望我们以后的谈话也能如此富有成果。如果时机成熟，我们或许都可以对彼此敞开心扉。但是...到时再说吧。"

entries.en:
"To be perfectly forthright with you, captain, I did not see you as the type," Siyavong says.

"But life is full of little surprises, is it not? I'm sure, if that is how you really feel, we shall speak again before long. Until then."
entries.zh:
"老实告诉你吧，舰长，我没想到你会实话实说，" Siyavong 说。

"但生活总是充满了小惊喜，不是吗？我敢肯定，如果你真的这样觉得，那我们不久就会再见面的。我很期待。"

entries.en: He looks genuinely perplexed. "Um, how interesting. Not a life philosophy I myself adhere to, of course, but there are many ways in the world. I suppose." He looks down at his datapad awkwardly. "That, ah, is everything then. So."
entries.zh: 他看上去真的有些迷茫。"嗯，真是有趣。当然，我不会采取这种生活哲学，但我想，世界之大，无奇不有。" 他尴尬地低头看向数据平板。"啊，没有别的事情了。那么。"

entries.en:
"A good day to you captain," Siyavong says, "And what is it you people say? 'Burn bright', yes."

He terminates the commlink.
entries.zh:
"希望你有愉快的一天，舰长，" Siyavong 说，"你们那句话是怎么说的来着？'航行无阻'，就是这个。"

他切断了通讯。

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName. I am Lieutenant Finlay Siyavong of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service. It is so very interesting to finally meet you," he says with a chuckle.

"You have a peculiar way of placing yourself at the center of fascinating events."
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长。我是海军上尉 Finlay Siyavong，从属于 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部。能和你见面可真是有趣，" 他微笑着说道。

"你总有一种奇特的本领，能让自己置身于各种迷人事件的中心。"

entries.en:
Once more, it is Finlay Siyavong of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service.

"Captain $playername. A pleasure, as always. And let me say- I can't help but admire your ability to place yourself at the center of fascinating events."
entries.zh:
屏幕上出现了一张熟悉的面孔，是来自 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部的海军上尉 Finlay Siyavong。

"$playername 舰长。和往常一样，很荣幸见到你。我不得不说... 我非常佩服你那种总能出现在迷人事件中心的能力。"

entries.en:
Once again it is Finlay Siyavong of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service.

"Captain $playername," he says flatly, "Your ability to place yourself at the center of fascinating events is remarkable."
entries.zh:
屏幕上出现了一张熟悉的面孔，是 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部的海军上尉 Finlay Siyavong。

"$playername 舰长，" 他平淡地说，"你总能搅合进各种有趣的事里，这一能力真是惊人。"

entries.en:
Once more, it is Finlay Siyavong of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service.

"Captain $playername," he says, "Your ability to place yourself at the center of fascinating events is remarkable as always."
entries.zh:
屏幕上出现了一张熟悉的面孔，是来自 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部的海军上尉 Finlay Siyavong。

"$playername 舰长。" 他说道，"你那种总能出现在迷人事件中心的能力，和往常一样令人吃惊。"

entries.en:
Baird taps at her desk console. "With the Gate scans completed and Daud's assurance that the Hegemony will not interfere, we may proceed to the implementation phase."

The provost allows herself a small smile as she turns to you. "This is Scylla's moment, of course. Let me link her in."
entries.zh:
Baird 点了一下桌子上的控制台。"现在我们完成了对星门的扫描，Daud 也保证了 霸主 不会进行干涉，我们可以进入实行阶段了。"

院长露出微微一笑，转过身看向你。"到 Scylla 大显身手的时候了，我把她的通讯接进来。"

entries.en:
As the comms display resolves, Baird is glancing over some status report blinking in her holodisplay. After a fraction of a second, she dismisses it with a flick.

"It is absolutely essential that we secure High Hegemon Baikal Daud's approval," she says, "At least covertly, before we begin the experimentation phase. Everything is contingent on the ability to proceed without political interference."

"I trust you'll make good time, captain," she concludes, then terminates the commlink without letting you get a word in.
entries.zh:
通讯显示终于接通了。Baird 正在她的全息显示屏上浏览着一些状况报告之类的东西。没看几秒，她就用手一弹，把报告关掉了。

"我们无论如何都得征得至高霸主 Baikal Daud 的同意，" 她斩钉截铁地说道，"就算是非公开的也行，然后我们才能开始实验阶段。我们的计划能否成功，取决于我们是否在执行计划时能不受政治上的干扰。"

"你办事，我放心，舰长，" 她就这样结束了对话，你甚至没来得及在她结束通讯前吐出几个字。

entries.en:
"That is what this academy has always lacked - a willingness to move past observation to use our knowledge to act upon the world. Get me Daud's cooperation, captain. Then we'll write history."

The provost terminates the commlink without letting you get a word in.
entries.zh:
"我们学院一直以来最缺乏的就是这个 —— 不止步于被动观测，而是利用我们的知识去改变世界的决心。现在去博得 Daud 的合作吧，舰长。然后我们将谱写历史。"

你甚至没来得及在院长切断通讯链接插上一句话。

entries.en:
The comm display resolves.

"You're back. Good. I have already heard from an agent working on behalf of High Hegemon Daud. His revised terms are," the provost suppresses some emotion, "Small-minded."

Baird taps at her desk console, the light flickering in her spectacles.

"I see, however, that the hyperspace physics team has not reported completion of the six Gate scans."
entries.zh:
通讯显示接通了，Baird 开口道，"很好，你回来了。我已经从一名代表至高霸主 Daud 的特工那里听说了你的成果。他修改后的条款可真是有点..." 院长压制着自己的感情，"小心眼了。"

Baird 点了一下桌上的控制台，她的眼镜上泛起一道反光。"不过超空间物理学研究小组还没收到他们需要的六份星门扫描数据。"

entries.en:
She turns to you.

"Without this data, we cannot tune the Janus prototype. Coordinate your efforts with Coureuse. Get me those scans."

The provost terminates the commlink without letting you get a single word in.
entries.zh:
她转过身看向你，"没有这些数据，我们就无法对 '双面神' 装置 原型机进行调制。去跟 Coureuse 协调一下你的工作，然后给我带来那些扫描数据。"

院长就这样切断了通讯，你甚至没找到机会插上一句话。

entries.en:
The comm link request blinks its awaiting response message for over a minute before it returns REQUEST DENIED.

Either Coureuse isn't in the mood to talk, or someone isn't letting her talk.
entries.zh:
通讯请求只是显示等待回复。'等待回复' 了一分钟多后，才终于变成了 '请求被拒绝'。

要么 Coureuse 没心情和你讲话，要么就是有人不想让她讲话。

o.en: Tell Baird about the mission you are doing for Warlord Kanta
o.zh: 告诉 Baird 你在为军阀 Kanta 所做的任务

entries.en:
The provost looks perplexed. "Kanta made a clone of the Warlord Loke, the very man to whom she once swore fealty? How perverse."

Baird dismisses this with a wave. "As a rule, I don't find it productive to dwell upon the psychology of insane pirates. Do it, or don't. Above all be on guard. The so-called Warlord Kanta achieved her place in the world through treachery and brutality in equal measure. I doubt she's changed her habits."

Provost Baird stares out her office window, over the academy interior. "The future we're building will have little place for her kind."
entries.zh:
院长看起来很困惑。"Kanta 制作了一个军阀 Loke 的克隆人？就是那个她曾经宣誓效忠的人？这太不寻常了。"

Baird 挥手否认。"通常来说，我认为老是想着对那些疯狂的海盗进行心理分析是没什么作用的。不管怎样，最重要的是保持警惕。这个所谓的军阀 Kanta 通过同等程度的背叛和残忍达到了她的地位。我怀疑她已经改变了习性。"

Baird 院长透过办公室的窗子，向学院的上方看去。"我们正在建设的未来没有她这种人的立足之地。"

o.en: Tell Baird about your plan to meet Warlord Kanta
o.zh: 告诉 Baird 你与军阀 Kanta 会面的计划

entries.en:
As you speak, Baird doesn't look tremendously impressed by Coureuse and Gargoyle's plan.

"Stupid. But bold, I admit," the provost says finally. "Sometimes the direct route is the best. Like Alexander at Telmessos, yes? Just don't start too many fires on the way, please. You will soon be needed for important work; real work. I don't want you starting some kind of war when we're so close to the culmination of all I've been working toward."
entries.zh:
你说出 Coureuse 和 Gargoyle 的计划的时候，Baird 似乎并不为所动。

"有勇无谋，我只能这么说。" 院长在你说完之后总结道，"有时直截了当的方式是最好的。就像 Alexander 在 Telmessos 的时候一样 ，不是吗？只是还请不要在这个过程中挑起太多战斗。很快就会有一个重要的工作需要你，一个真正的工作。我们已经非常接近我全部努力的最终目标了，我可不希望你在这时候挑起一场什么战争。"

entries.en:
Before you open comms, your sensors officer calls your attention and links their display to yours. "Captain, look at how they're modulating their drive fields. They've got their own version of a Gate scanner. Slower than ours, maybe, but similar principles."

Clearly, Tri-Tachyon has a parallel Gate research initiative.
entries.zh:
在你接通通讯之前，传感器技官招呼了一下你，然后把他的显示器连接到你的显示器上。"舰长，注意他们调制驱动场的方式。他们一定也有自己的星门扫描仪。或许速度不如我们的快，但原理都差不多。"

看来，速子科技 也有一个差不多的星门研究计划。

entries.en:
$personLastName looks at you with politely restrained surprise. "I'm sorry," $heOrShe says unapologetically, "But we must turn down your request. We are attending to Tri-Tachyon business and I would ask that you, instead, move your fleet clear of the Gate."

$HeOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms and awaits your response.
entries.zh:
$personLastName 惊讶而不失礼貌地看向你。"很抱歉，" $heOrShe的语气里并不带一丝歉意，"但我们必须拒绝你的请求。我们正处理 速子科技 的事务，而我正想请你将舰队远离星门。"

$HeOrShe抱起双臂，等待你的回应。

entries.en:
"Tri-Tachyon business," $heOrShe says. "A standard survey. You are of course familiar with Tri-Tachyon's line of proprietary star charts, the TriStar Smart Navigation Suite? It is important to provide up-to-date data on potential navigational hazards to our customers."

"Now, we need you to remove your fleet from the vicinity because, ah, your drive fields will interfere with our proprietary sensor suite."
entries.zh:
"速子科技 正在这里办事。" $heOrShe说道，"例行检查。你应该对 速子科技 专有的星图业务，也就是 TriStar 智能导航套装有所了解吧？对我们来说，为客户提供最新的潜在的航行危害数据，是非常重要的。"

"现在，我们希望你能和星门保持距离，因为，嗯，你的驱动场对我们的传感器套件造成了干扰。"

o.en: Sounds like a precise survey. And this Gate has been inert for 200 cycles.
o.zh: 很严谨的调查。这座星门都已经沉睡了 200 多年了。

o.en: Safety first, that's what I always say. Good luck with the survey.
o.zh: 安全第一，我总是这样说。祝你们调查顺利。

entries.en: "Indeed," $heOrShe says evasively. "We ah, need to make absolutely sure of that. Our customers demand no less."
entries.zh: "那是自然。" $heOrShe躲闪着话题，"我们，啊，必须确保数据准确无误。我们的客户要求可不低。"

o.en: I can't help but wonder about the nature of this survey.
o.zh: 我很好奇这次调查的性质。

o.en: Safety first, that's what I always say. Good luck with the survey.
o.zh: 我总是强调安全第一。祝你们调查顺利。

entries.en:
The Tri-Tachyon $rank looks like $heOrShe is gritting $hisOrHer perfect teeth.

"I've told you what we're doing, and time is money. What is it you want, captain?"
entries.zh:
这位速子科技 $rank 看上去好像$heOrShe正在磨$hisOrHer那一口完美的牙齿。

"我已经告诉了你我们的目的，时间就是金钱。舰长，你到底想要什么？"

o.en: Perhaps I could purchase a copy of your 'very precise' survey results.
o.zh: 或许我可以掏钱买一份你们 '非常仔细' 的调查结果。

o.en: Sorry, I just like to be sure. Good luck with the survey.
o.zh: 抱歉，我只是想确认一下。祝你们调查顺利。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks at you for a moment, calculating, then taps something on $hisOrHer console. Turning the comms record off?

"We could arrange something. No need to go through the TriStar Smart Navigation Suite. Direct data from me to you, direct payment from you to me." $HeOrShe smiles with undisguised avarice. "$gaATG_ttScanCost credits, let's say. Deal?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe盯着你看了一会，好像脑海里在计算着什么，然后在$hisOrHer控制台上点了一下。也许是把通讯记录器关掉了？

"我们可以做笔交易。忘了那个什么 TriStar 智能导航套组吧。我直接把数据发给你，你直接把款付给我。" $HeOrShe的笑容里透露着毫不掩饰的贪婪。"就 $gaATG_ttScanCost 星币吧。成交？"

entries.en:
$personLastName performs the data transfer with admirable customer service.

"A pleasure doing business with you, captain," $heOrShe says before terminating the comm link.
entries.zh:
$personLastName 以令人钦佩的客户服务质量进行了数据传输。

"跟你做生意很愉快，舰长。" $heOrShe说完便切断了通讯。

entries.en: $personLastName shrugs, "That's the price. The offer stands if you change your mind."
entries.zh: $personLastName 耸了耸肩，"一口价。如果你稍后改变了想法，我们还是这个开价。"

entries.en: "Thanks," $heOrShe says flatly.
entries.zh: "谢谢。" $heOrShe平淡地说。

entries.en:
The Tri-Tachyon $post notes your fleet powering up weapons, and nods.

"This could have been easy, captain," $heOrShe says, "But we'll do it your way."

The comm like terminates with a snap.
entries.zh:
这位速子科技 $post 注意到你的舰队在给武器充能，点了点头。

"本来不用闹得这么麻烦的，舰长。" $heOrShe说，"但我们会用你的方式来解决。"

屏幕一闪，通讯链接被切断了。

entries.en:
"I thought so," the Tri-Tachyon $post says. "Go find your own Gate, captain."

The comm link terminates with a snap.
entries.zh:
"我想也是，" 这位速子科技 $post 说道。"去找你自己的星门吧，舰长。"

屏幕一闪，通讯链接被切断了。

entries.en:
The Tri-Tachyon $post watches you for a moment, calculating. You can feel the cold anger radiating from $hisOrHer seemingly impassive visage.

$HeOrShe turns and calmly says to $hisOrHer bridge. "Tactical, go to orange."

Back to you, $heOrShe says $hisOrHer challenge, "If you're making a move, do it now. We're ready."
entries.zh:
这位速子科技 $post 盯着你看了一会，好像脑海里在计算着什么。你能感觉到冰冷的愤怒正从$hisOrHer看似冷漠的面容下放射出来。

$HeOrShe转向了$hisOrHer舰桥成员，冷静地说道，"战术部，橙色戒备。"

然后$heOrShe重新看向你，抛出了$hisOrHer的战书，"如果你想采取什么行动，最好快点。我们这边已经准备好了。"

entries.en:
The Tri-Tachyon $post watches you for a moment, calculating. You can feel the cold anger radiating from $hisOrHer seemingly impassive visage.

"Nav, set course away from here," $heOrShe turns and speaks calmly to $hisOrHer bridge. "We need to preserve company assets from brigandage."

$HeOrShe turns back to you, "I won't forget this, captain. The company won't, either."

The link terminates with a snap.
entries.zh:
这位速子科技 $post 盯着你看了一会，好像脑海里在计算着什么。你能感觉到冰冷的愤怒正从$hisOrHer看似冷漠的面容下放射出来。

"领航员，设定航线，离开这里，" $heOrShe转向$hisOrHer的舰桥成员，冷静地说道，"我们需要保护公司资产免遭抢劫。"

$HeOrShe转过身来看着你，"我不会忘记今天的，舰长。公司也忘不了。"

屏幕一闪，通讯链接被切断了。

entries.en:
"Direct data from me to you, direct payment from you to me." $HeOrShe smiles with undisguised avarice. "$gaATG_ttScanCost
 credits, let's say. Deal?"
entries.zh:
"我直接把数据发给你，你直接把款付给我。" $HeOrShe的笑容里透露着毫不掩饰的贪婪。
"那就收你 $gaATG_ttScanCost 星币吧。成交？"

o.en: Please move your fleet clear of the Gate.
o.zh: 请将你的舰队远离星门。

o.en: What is a Tri-Tachyon fleet doing out here?
o.zh: 速子科技 的舰队在这里做什么？

o.en: Leave the vicinity of the Gate or I shall open fire.
o.zh: 离星门远一点，不然我就要开火了。
我想谈谈关于购买数据的事情 ...

entries.en: "A fine day, captain," says the Tri-Tachyon $post. "We're just going about our lawful business. If you don't mind, please keep your drive field set to a minimum, thank you."
entries.zh: "你好，舰长，" 这位 速子科技 $post 说道。"我们只是在进行合法作业。如果你不介意的话，请将你的驱动场调到最小，谢谢。"

entries.en:
A silent ring of adamantine material, derelict of a former age.

Your sensors officer calls for your attention. "Captain, there's some kind of hyperwave interference coming from the nearby Tri-Tachyon fleet. Our scanner can't make a lock while they're... doing whatever they're doing."
entries.zh:
一座沉寂已久的环状结构，由坚固的材料制成，是来自上个时代的遗迹。

你的传感器技官让你注意。"舰长，我们受到了来自附近的那支速子科技舰队的某种超波干扰。如果他们还在那里做... 不知道是什么的事情的话，我们的扫描器就无法锁定目标。"

o.en: Inform the pirate that you are working for the Warlord Kanta
o.zh: 告知海盗你正在为军阀 Kanta 效力

entries.en:
You hold up your hand, interrupting the pirate captain mid-threat. This seems to catch $himOrHer off guard.

You use the moment to calmly explain that you have personally been given a mission by Warlord Kanta to return her pet Loke-clone to her. It would be in their best interests if they did everything possible to facilitate the success of your mission. Imagine what Kanta would think if she heard you had been distracted from carrying out her will.
entries.zh:
你举起手，打断了狠话才说到一半的海盗船长。这似乎让$himOrHer有些措手不及。

你趁机冷静地解释自己被军阀 Kanta 授予了一项任务，去找回她的宠物克隆人 Loke。如果他们能尽可能保证你的任务成功，那也会最符合他们的利益。想象一下如果 Kanta 听说你在践行她的意志时被分心了，她会怎么想。

entries.en:
The pirate looks as though $heOrShe has been struck by a Tachyon Lance.

"Y-yes, captain. Of course." $HeOrShe struggles to regain $hisOrHer composure, "Please, accept my profound apologies, profoundly, for the delay. I welcome you to be on your way and g-give my best regards to the Warlord."

You snap the comms link off while the pirate is still attempting an awkward half-bow.
entries.zh:
那海盗看起来像是刚被速子长矛滋了一轮一样。

"是...是的，舰长。当然。" $HeOrShe正努力恢复镇定，"请接受我对于您的延误的极大的，深深的歉意。欢迎你继续上路并转...转达我对军阀最真诚的问候。"

当海盗还在试图笨手笨脚地向你鞠躬行礼时，你把通讯链接掐断了。

entries.en: "I've been keeping an ear out," says Gargoyle. "You know, keeping a finger on the pulse of the Sector. Basic responsibility as my role as a top-of-the-line security consultant. Standard stuff, really. Keeping the Hegemon out of the networks here only takes a few minutes a day. Clean the logs, update the firewalls, stir the ICE. I could do it in my sleep. A curious mind like mine needs stimulation, right?"
entries.zh: "我一直在留心着外面的情况，" Gargoyle 说。"你懂的，时不时给整片星域把把脉。毕竟这是我作为顶尖安全顾问的基本职责。很普通的了，真的没什么。每天只要花上几分钟，我就能把 霸主 从这边的网络上请出去。然后就清理一下日志，升级一下防火墙，点检一下入侵反制电元，这些我睡着了都能做到。毕竟一颗好奇的脑袋总要寻求点刺激，不是吗？"

o.zh: 的确。所以你到底想做什么？

entries.en:
"Kanta's really mad about something," Gargoyle explains. "Some gang of Pathers took something precious from her. She's putting out a call for the best mercs and captains."

"Maybe you'll answer it," the hacker says with a small smile.

Coureuse nods enthusiastically, "Yes, that could work. You'd be perfect!"
entries.zh:
"最近有件事搞得 Kanta 很生气，" Gargoyle 解释道。"某个左径帮派从她手上抢走了重要的东西，她正为此召集最好的佣兵和舰长。"

"或许你可以去毛遂自荐，" 黑客笑着说道。

Coureuse 激动的点了点头，"是，这一定能成的。你是绝佳人选！"

entries.en:
"I have savings of um, just under $gaATG_coureuseCredits credits," Coureuse says shyly.

You can see Gargoyle's head shake just slightly, saying that won't do it.
entries.zh:
"我的存款有，呃，也就 $gaATG_coureuseCredits 星币这么多，" Coureuse 腼腆地说。

你注意到 Gargoyle 轻轻地摇了摇头，好像在说这点不够。

o.en: Keep your credits. We'll come up with something else.
o.zh: 还是留着你的星币吧。我会试试其他办法。
每一枚星币都有用。给我转过来吧。

entries.en:
"Okay... okay good, transfer is complete," Coureuse says. "I'm just glad to be of help in some small way."

Gargoyle watches you, unmoving, with just a hint of a smile.
entries.zh:
"好... 可以了，转账完成，" Coureuse 说。"我只是对自己能帮上忙这点感到很高兴。"

Gargoyle 看着你，好像不为所动，只是轻微笑了一下。

entries.en:
"Best of luck," the hacker says, "Be sure to comms if you need anything."

The academician looks pensive in the face of this bonhomie. "Thank you, captain. You won't regret helping Elissa, I know it."
entries.zh:
"祝你好运，" 黑客说道，"需要什么的话就联系我们。"

与这和蔼可亲的态度相比，院士则显得若有所思。"谢谢你，舰长。你不会后悔帮助了 Elissa 的，我可以肯定。"

entries.en:
"Well. She's allowed some contact with the outside world. Privileges? Um, obviously I guess, due to our ... arrangements. But that's all been through Kanta's organization, and then through whatever pirates owe the Kantas a favor. When Elissa says 'drop this instrument package in this orbit', if Kanta is behind her, it gets done."

"Elissa can sneak some things past Kanta's people. Her work is beyond them by a long shot," Coureuse smiles with pride at this, "But it's risky. And getting riskier. Kanta is a bit, um," she flutters her hands trying to figure out how to express it. "Her reactor is a bit leaky?"
entries.zh:
"嗯，她被允许偶尔和外界进行交流。这算是优待？但我猜应该是我们在其中有某种... 约定吧。不过这些都要经过 Kanta 的手下，然后再通过欠她人情的某个海盗送出来。所以当 Elissa 说 '把这些设备丢到这个轨道上'的时候，只要 Kanta 在背后点头答应，这事情就算成了。"

"Elissa 可以背着 Kanta 的人偷运些东西出来。毕竟他们根本搞不清楚她的工作，" Coureuse 说到这有些自豪地笑了，"但这是有风险的。而且最近这风险越来越高。毕竟 Kanta 有些，呃，" 她摆动着双手，想找一个恰当的形容方式。"有些反应堆侧漏？"

entries.en: "Y-yes, that's the one. In the Magec system. This is, um, part of why I've been somewhat reluctant to bring it up. Elissa told me to keep it ... not secret exactly, but to be careful. Kanta has informers in many places. You know, blackmail, bribery, extortion. Anyone the Kantas can get their hands on, they'll use them. So you can never be sure who to trust."
entries.zh: "对 —— 是啊，就是你想的那位，老巢在 Magec 星系的。这也是我不想提到 Elissa 的事情的原因之一。Elissa 让我...倒不是当作秘密，但是要万分小心。Kanta 在很多地方都有眼线。你也知道的，敲诈、行贿、勒索。Kanta 家族的人会利用任何她们能接触到的人，所以你永远都不知道该相信谁。"

entries.en:
"Oh no no no," the hacker says, "But yes."

"A little, here and there. I mean, how could I not? Zal has a reputation. She's the Zal! It would be a delight to assist in another Zal scheme."

You can tell from the way Gargoyle says 'a reputation' that this is a sign of great respect from someone who does not respect easily.
entries.zh:
"哦，不，不不不，" 黑客说道，"不过我确实知道一点。"

"就一点，很分散的传言。倒不如说，怎么可能没听说过呢？Zal 可是个大名人。她可是 '那位 Zal' 啊！要是能在另一次 'Zal 方案' 里帮把手，那可真是鄙人的荣幸之至。"

从 Gargoyle 的语气中，你听出来他对 Zal 抱有很高的尊重，而他并不轻易尊重别人。

entries.en:
"Did I say that?" says Gargoyle, failing to look innocent.

"- Fine, yes. Another. Remember hacking the Aztlan relay?" The hacker puts on a wistful look, "Zal really pulled through for me on that job."
entries.zh:
"我真那么说了吗？" Gargoyle 装无辜的演技十分拙劣。

"—— 行吧，对。'另一次'。还记得黑掉 Aztlan 中继站那次吗？" 黑客的脸上挂着一丝思念，"那次 Zal 帮了我很大的忙。"

entries.en:
"I can get you in," Gargoyle says deliberately, "You know, to talk. Find an angle. I think that might be how to do it. I may have worked with someone who - oh, twist my arm, yes it was Kanta's some, um," Gargoyle counts off a few fingers, "fourth cousin's grandnephew or something. There sure are a lot of Kantas, aren't there? Very busy, the Kantas."

"Point being, I may have acquired a digital token that'll get you an audience without getting shot on sight. From there, well, you also have a reputation! Tell Kanta you'll do some work for her. You're a hot item in the dark hypernet, what with everything you've been up to lately."
entries.zh:
"我可以送你进去，" Gargoyle 装模作样地说，"你懂的，去跟他们谈谈。找个切入点，这样应该能成。我正巧和某个人合作过 —— 哦，不跟你卖关子了，那个人就是 Kanta 的，呃，" Gargoyle 掰起手指头算了一下，"四表哥的曾外甥，还是什么的。家族人还真多啊，是吧？他们个个都是大忙人。"

"重点是，我正巧有个数字令牌。只要拿着它，你就能获得一次谈话的机会，而不是被乱枪射死。你成功进去以后，嗯，知道吗，你也是个名人啊！告诉 Kanta 你会为她干活。你在暗网上可是热门货，毕竟你最近可是干了不少大事。"

o.zh: '热门' 是好事还是坏事啊？

entries.en:
Gargoyle taps at something and your datapad chimes.

"Up to a point. There's hot, and there's radioactive. Right now, you're definitely hot. But you'll want to be careful about reaching critical mass."

"Yes, uh, we certainly don't want that," Coureuse adds. "But this is wonderful! If Gargoyle can give you a way in, then you can ... somehow get Elissa out? Maybe make a deal? I'll do whatever it takes. I don't have a lot of credits, but um, if it would help..."
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 在什么东西上点了几下之后，你的数据平板发出些声响。

"得看你热到什么程度了。太热了的话，可就会留下些难解决的核辐射。现在你算得上是相当热门了。但你得小心别让自己突破临界质量整出个核爆来。"

"呃，对，我可不想我们变成那样，" Coureuse 说道。"但是这真是太棒了！如果 Gargoyle 能让你进去，那你就能... 想办法带 Elissa 出来？也许跟他们做个交易？我什么都愿意做。我手头并不富裕，不过，嗯，如果我这点星币能帮上忙的话..."

entries.en:
Both Gargoyle and Coureuse look confused for a moment.

The hacker recovers first, and shrugs. "Best of luck. Be sure to comms if you need anything."

The academician looks pensive in the face of this bonhomie. "I uh, thank you, captain. You won't regret helping Elissa, I know it."
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 和 Coureuse 都迟疑了一会。

黑客最先回过了神来，耸了耸肩。"祝你好运。需要什么的话就联系我们。"

面对你的善意，院士显得若有所思。"我，嗯，感谢你，舰长。你不会后悔帮助了 Elissa 的，我可以肯定。"

entries.en:
Gargoyle and Coureuse look skeptical.

"Isn't that, um." Coureuse looks pleadingly at Gargoyle, "Dangerous?"

The hacker raises an eyebrow, "A bold proposal, captain. A marine assault on the stronghold of a pirate warlord holed up in a former Hegemony military base notoriously surrounded by a stealth mine field and filled with the heavily armed scum and villainy of the Sector."

Gargoyle ponders the problem, implants flickering with blue-green light.
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 和 Coureuse 都露出了怀疑的表情。

"那不会，呃，" Coureuse 用恳求的目光看着 Gargoyle，"很危险么？"

黑客扬了扬眉毛，"真是大胆的提案，舰长。军阀 Kanta 的要塞是一座前 霸主 军事基地，那座基地周围布满了臭名昭著的隐形空雷，更不用说基地里头还挤满了装备精良的人渣和恶棍。而你想对这样的要塞发动陆战队员突袭。"

Gargoyle 仔细考虑着这一提案，他的植入体闪着蓝绿色的光。

o.en: Can you get me any kind of tactical advantage? Security codes?
o.zh: 你能帮我获取一些战术优势吗？安全码之类的？

entries.en:
"Mmm. Absolutely," the hacker says with glib confidence. "It's not like they have a functioning civic bureaucracy to hack, so I'd have to make some contacts, throw some credits around... after a week or two of work I'd give you thirty-three repeating percent odds of-"

Coureuse interrupts suddenly, "We don't have time for that. Elissa is.. you can't... if you just shoot up the place, she might be-" she blinks away sudden tears, "Captain, there has to be some other way!"
entries.zh:
"嗯。当然能了，" 黑客带着油腔滑调的自信说道。"不过他们并没有一个正常运作的民事官僚机构让我破解，所以我得联系几个人，花点星币，然后... 不出一两个星期，我就能给你一份成功概率为百分之 33.3 循环的 ——"

Coureuse 突然插话，"我们没有那么多时间。Elissa 她... 你不能... 如果你强攻进去的话，她可能会 ——" 她眨眨眼，把泪水挤出眼眶，"舰长，一定还有其他办法的！"

entries.en:
"Best of luck," the hacker says cheerfully, "Try not to kill anyone who's done me any favors."

The academician looks pensive in the face of this bonhomie. "Um. Be careful, captain, please. I'd never forgive myself if Elissa got hurt."
entries.zh:
"祝你好运，" 黑客笑着说道，"尽量别杀那些欠我人情的人。"

与这和蔼可亲的态度相比，院士则显得若有所思。"呃。请务必小心，舰长。如果 Elissa 受了伤，我是无法原谅我自己的。"

entries.en:
Coureuse appears on the comms display. "Um. Captain $playerName. Hello."

She takes a deep breath. "Thank you for contacting me. I'm sorry about... everything. Provost Baird. The failed experiment. I should never have gone ahead with it when I wasn't absolutely certain of your safety."
entries.zh:
Coureuse 的身影出现在了通讯屏幕上。"呃，$playerName 舰长，你好。"

她做了个深呼吸。"谢谢你来找我。我很抱歉... 对于发生的一切，Baird 院长，失败的实验，我还不确定这台设备是否绝对安全就把它交给了你，我真不该那么做的。"

o.en: I understand. Baird can be a bit assertive.
o.zh: 我能理解，Baird 确实有些武断。

o.en: I got out. I always do.
o.zh: 我成功逃脱了。我总能死里逃生。

o.en: Easy for you to say- I could have been killed!
o.zh: 你说得倒轻松 —— 我可是差点就没命了！

o.en: Yes, you definitely owe me for this.

entries.en: "Yeah, that's one word for it," she says, and sighs.
entries.zh: "是啊，也可以那么说。" 她说着叹了口气。

entries.en: "Yes. You did. But I should have been more careful."
entries.zh: "是，你确实逃出来了。但我不该这么大意的。"

entries.en: "It won't happen again," she says earnestly. "I promise."
entries.zh: "这事不会再有下一次了，" 她诚恳地说。"我向你保证。"

entries.en: "I- I suppose I do, captain. I can't put all the blame on the provost. I did choose to follow her orders."
entries.zh: "我 —— 我想算是吧，舰长。也不能只怪院长。是我自己选择听从她的命令的。"

entries.en: "Okay," she says awkwardly.
entries.zh: "好吧，" 她略显尴尬地说。

entries.en: "Um." Coureuse shakes her head, and takes a deep breath. "So about finding Elissa Zal. I think we need Gargoyle in on this conversation. Let me, uh." She taps at her datapad.
entries.zh: "嗯..." Coureuse 摇了摇头，又深呼吸了一次。"关于找到 Elissa Zal。我觉得我们需要和 Gargoyle 谈谈。让我看看。" 她点了点数据平板。

entries.en:
Gargoyle appears in a flash. "Scylla, girl! Where have you been? The goons won't let me into the lab anymore so I snuck in when they were changing shifts. Your bright but stylistically sedated friends told me you were in some kind of important meeting, so I thought, how important could it be if I wasn't invited? So I had to ask Alviss what was going on, can you believe it? You know how he is, all stammering and trying so so hard not to lie or say anything against the old witch, and-"

The hacker pauses, taking in Coureuse's demeanor - and yours. "Oh. This is about the experiment and the exploding, isn't it. Queen B wasn't happy about that, huh."
entries.zh:
屏幕一闪，Gargoyle 出现了。"Scylla，我的好姐妹！你刚才哪去了？这群书呆子现在不让我进实验室了，所以我趁着他们换班的时候溜进去了。你那些聪明绝顶但不懂时尚的朋友们告诉我，你在开一个什么很重要的会，所以我就想，连我都不邀请去参加的会议，算什么重要会议？所以我只好去问 Alviss 到底是怎么了，你能想到吗？你也知道他那个人，结结巴巴的，还得努力不撒谎，还得注意不说那个老巫婆的坏话，还得 ——"

这位黑客停了停，应该是注意到了 Coureuse 的神态 —— 当然还有你的神态。"噢！一定是跟实验和大爆炸有关，我猜对了吗？B 女王对这事一定很不高兴。"

entries.en:
"Yes," says Coureuse. "Um. I mean, no. She wasn't happy. But what's important now is that we find Elissa-"

"-Zal?" Gargoyle interrupts, looking pleased.

"I- yes. You know her?" Coureuse looks confused.
entries.zh:
"不。" Coureuse说，"呃。我是说，是的。她当然不开心。但现在我们的首要目标是找到 Elissa..."

"—— Zal？" Gargoyle 打断道，他看起来饶有兴趣。

"我 —— 是的。你认识她？" Coureuse 不解道。

entries.en:
"Oh yes, but please, please, I must apologize," Gargoyle says magnanimously, "I've interrupted your story. Go on, I don't want to spoil anything too soon."

"Um," Coureuse recovers her composure, "Okay, yes, so I've... actually been in contact with Elissa off and on. Maybe uh, the captain here knows about that. The problem with Elissa is, well. She's being held sorta-prisoner by Kanta."

Gargoyle nods enthusiastically at this revelation.
entries.zh:
"哦，那可不。你继续吧，不好意思打断了你的故事，" Gargoyle 大度地说，"接着说，我可不想剧透。"

"呃，" Coureuse 恢复了镇定，"好吧，嗯，我其实... 和 Elissa 断断续续地有些联系。也许，呃，舰长也知道一些。问题是 Elissa，嗯，现在有点类似 Kanta 的阶下囚。"

Gargoyle 听了这一事实，热切的点了点头。

o.zh: 你说的 '类似阶下囚' 是什么意思

o.en: Kanta, as in the pirate warlord Kanta?
o.zh: Kanta？你是指那个海盗军阀 Kanta？

o.en: We're going to need a better plan than 'ask nicely'.
o.zh: 我们需要一个比 '好言相问' 更靠谱的计划。

o.en: Credits could help. How much are we talking about?
o.zh: 星币当然管用。你能出多少？

o.en: I'll just make it up as I go along. Intuition hasn't failed me yet.
o.zh: 我会临场发挥的。直觉还没让我失望过。

o.en: Why not just shoot my way in and bust Zal out?
o.zh: 不如用枪炮轰进去，强行把 Zal 劫出来？

o.en: So Kanta wants something found and returned. I could do that.
o.zh: 所以 Kanta 想要寻回失物，这事我能办。

o.en: A quick strike and it'll be over before you know it.
o.zh: 一次快速打击而已，等他们回过神来我已经溜了。

o.en: Gargoyle, I feel like you know something about what's going on.
o.zh: Gargoyle，你是不是早就知道发生什么事了。

o.en: What do you mean by 'another' Zal scheme?
o.zh: 什么叫 '另一次' Zal 方案？

o.en: How do we get Zal out?
o.zh: 那我们怎么把 Zal 救出来？

entries.en: "A, um, individual possibly from the Luddic Path, um, spiritual movement on $gaBA_marketName is offering to sell an important technological object to the Academy. We need someone to make the purchase."
entries.zh: "一个，嗯，可能是 卢德左径 的人，目前正，呃，神游在 $gaBA_marketName，提出要向学院出售一个重要的技术物品。我们需要有个人来购买。"

entries.en: "A, um, collector of esoteric goods? on $gaBA_marketName is offering to sell an important technological object to the Academy. We need someone to make the purchase."
entries.zh: "在 $gaBA_marketName 上有个嗯，呃，一个小众商品收藏家？那个人要向学院出售一件重要的技术物品。我们需要派个人去完成购置。"

o.en: Take a shuttle to meet with Provost Baird
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机面见 Baird 院长

entries.en:
You find a junior academy agent pacing in the landing bay reception lounge. As soon as you enter, they spot you with a look of relief and walk quickly to meet you.

"Captain $playerLastName! Thank you for coming. The provost will see you immediately. If you would just follow me this way, thank you..."
entries.zh:
你发现一名初级学院事务代理在登陆台的接待休息室里来回踱步。看到你进门，对方明显松了一口气，随即迅速走来迎接你。

"$playerLastName 舰长！感谢您的光临。院长将立刻与您会面。还请您跟我移步这边，谢谢..."

entries.en: Sebestyen points excitedly at a datapad in his hand, "Captain! I've just got word from Logistics that your crew has delivered the $gaBA_item - intact! They're going to be so excited in $gaBA_department, they never expected to get it back."
entries.zh: Sebestyen 兴奋地指着手中的数据平板，"舰长！我刚刚从后勤部门得到消息，你的船员已经交付了 $gaBA_item —— 完好无损！$gaBA_department 部门的人会很兴奋的，他们从来没有想过能重新得到它。"

entries.en:
"Ah, uh, captain." Sebestyen stammers awkwardly at you for a moment.

"The, um, bursar's office contacted me. And um, they're taking back the credits allocated to you for the purchase payment for the $global.gaBA_failedItem. They tell me that the situation has been resolved by... alternative means?"
entries.zh:
"哈，呃，舰长。" Sebestyen 尴尬地对你结结巴巴地说了一会儿。

"那个，嗯，财政部门联系了我。而且，嗯，他们要收回分配给你用于购买 $global.gaBA_failedItem 的星币。他们告诉我，情况已经通过...其他手段解决了？"

entries.en:
"Wow. Huh," the academician studies his datapad as if not quite believing it.

"So an individual who is associated with t-the Luddic Path contacted the Academy. Their name is $gaBA_contactName, and they say they want to sell the Academy a piece of technology that they... um, found somewhere, I guess? If it really is $gaBA_aOrAnItem, then this would be an extraordinary find."

"But. You know..." Sebestyen looks to you expectantly.
entries.zh:
"哇哦。哈，" 院士研究着他的数据平板，似乎不太相信。

"所以一个与 卢德左径 有关的人物联系了学院。他们的名字是 $gaBA_contactName，对方声称想卖给学院一项技术，那个人...嗯，是在某个地方找到的，我猜？如果它真的是 $gaBA_aOrAnItem，那么这可是一个重大发现。

"但是，您知道..." Sebestyen 期待地看向你。

entries.en:
"It's the Path! This goes against everything they believe. If they caught one of their own selling technology to us, can you imagine what they'd do? I mean..."

You watch Sebestyen's imagination work across his face; fanatical torture-dungeons lie just beneath the surface.

He visibly shudders and composes himself. "Sorry, I, yes. The details." He takes a deep breath. "Okay. So the contact is $gaBA_contactName, they're $gaBA_onOrAt $gaBA_marketName in the $gaBA_systemName system. The Academy has allocated $gaBA_costNormal credits to you to make the purchase. Just talk to the contact, make arrangements, and return the $gaBA_item to the Galatia Academy!"
entries.zh:
"这可是左径！那个人违背了他们所信奉的。如果他们发现他们自己的人向我们出售技术，您能想象他们会干出什么事吗？我是说。"

你看着 Sebestyen 的想象力在他脸上描绘出一副受苦的画面；狂热的折磨 —— 大地之下的地牢。

他明显地颤抖了一下，然后整理了一下思绪。"对不起...我...是的，任务详情。" 他深吸一口气。"好的，所以联络人是 $gaBA_contactName，对方目前在 $gaBA_onOrAt $gaBA_marketName，位于 $gaBA_systemName 星系。学院已经给你分配了 $gaBA_costNormal 星币，将提供给您进行购买。只要与联络人交谈，做出安排，并将 $gaBA_item 送回 Galatia 学院！"

entries.en:
"And, and there's a mission reward of $gaBA_reward credits. Just," he leans in, looking concerned, "you'll want to be very careful. Pathers. I've... heard things."

"You'll be okay, right?"
entries.zh:
"然后，还有 $gaBA_reward 星币的任务完成奖励。只是，" 他靠了过来，看起来很担心，"您要非常小心...左径。我...听说过一些事情。"

"您会没事的，对吧？"

entries.en:
Sebestyen puts a finger on his chin, "'Pirate' is such a strong word, isn't it? There are all sorts of reasons, maybe, that a polity might find itself outside of um legitimate faction control. One imagines. What I mean is that, ah, we have to be diplomatic when an opportunity presents itself to acquire ah, um, a..."

Sebestyen looks carefully at a datapad, then back at you. "Ah I see- $gaBA_aOrAnItem! Just think what this could mean for research opportunities!"
entries.zh:
Sebestyen 将一根手指按在下巴上。"'海盗' 是个很强烈的词，不是吗？也许有各种各样的原因，一个政体可能会发现自己在势力合法的控制范围之外。人们可以想象。我的意思是，当需要抓住一个机会的时候，我们得更加得心应手啊，嗯，啊..."

Sebestyen 仔细看着一个数据平板，然后回头看着你。"啊，我明白了 —— $gaBA_aOrAnItem！想想这可能意味着什么样的研究机会！"

entries.en:
"... Because- well, never mind. Um, where was I- yes, so the contact is named $gaBA_contactName, they're $gaBA_onOrAt $gaBA_marketName in the $gaBA_systemName system. The Academy has allocated funds in the amount of $gaBA_costNormal credits which would be provided to you to make the purchase."

"Just talk to the contact, make arrangements, and return the $gaBA_item to the Galatia Academy. Simple!" The academician taps his datapad on his desk contentedly.

"Oh right, and there's a mission reward of $gaBA_reward credits. Just," he leans in, looking concerned, "you'll want to be careful. Space pirates. I've ... heard things." He shakes his head, as if dismissing these concerns "But you'd be fine, right?"
entries.zh:
"因为... 算了。我说到哪里了，啊对，联络人名叫 $gaBA_contactName，对方目前在 $gaBA_onOrAt $gaBA_marketName，位于 $gaBA_systemName 星系。学院已经分配了 $gaBA_costNormal 星币，将提供给您进行购买。"

"只需要与联络人谈妥，并将 $gaBA_item 送回 Galatia 学院，轻而易举！" 院士心满意足地敲打着他桌上的数据平板。

"噢，对了，还有 $gaBA_reward 星币的任务完成奖励，只是..." 他俯下身子，看起来很是担心，"您要小心那些太空海盗。我...听说过一些事情。" 他摇摇头，似乎在否定这些担忧。"您不会出什么事的，对吧？"

o.en: Ask about purchasing technology from a Pather
o.zh: 询问在左径分子处购买技术物品的相关情况

o.en: Ask about purchasing technology from pirates
o.zh: 询问在海盗处购买技术物品的相关情况

entries.en:
The Pather nods, relieved, and says, almost to $himOrHerself, "Doing it like this will do more good than destroying some evil trinket." $HeOrShe looks up through the display with a fanatic's eyes once more, "I won't thank you, captain, but I hope the stars lead you to Ludd's Path."

$HeOrShe considers, "Someday." The comms go black.

Your logistics officer reports a shipping pickup ping from a local craft guild's logistics concourse. A neatly packaged crate bearing a logo for the Galatia Academy and only a few scorch-marks is soon on board your flagship.
entries.zh:
左径分子点头，松了口气，几乎是对$himOrHerself 自己说到，"这样做会比毁掉一些邪恶的造物更有好处。" 透过显示器，你看到$HeOrShe的狂热眼神。"我不会感激你，舰长，但我希望群星会引领你到卢德之道。"

$HeOrShe思考了一下，"总有一天。" 通讯随即中断了。

你的后勤官报告说，从当地的手工行会的后勤部发送了一个运输提货的信号。一个包装整齐的条板箱，上面有 Galatia 学院的标志，只有一些烧焦的痕迹，很快就会装载到你的旗舰上。
