Elek looks you over, the spark of recognition failing to ignite.

"I'm afraid I don't recall," he says. "What, may I ask, is the purpose of your visit?"
entries.zh:
Elek 打量着你，看不出一点认识你的样子。

"恐怕我不记得了。" 他说道，"请问你为什么来这？"

o.en: I found your modified sensor array on the Fringe.
o.zh: 我在边缘星区找到了你那个改装过的传感器阵列。

entries.en:
"Oh yes, of course. You should have simply said so."

He rushes out of his holodisplay to pick up a datapad, then places himself behind a large desk, waving you toward a chair. Unfortunately it is occupied by a battered datacore, the sort used in long-range probes.

"Now then," he taps at his datapad, failing to notice your obstacle.

"The mystery concerns a very old dataset which has been in the Galatia Academy archives for somewhat more than two hundred cycles. I stumbled upon it in the course of my studies - well, in fact, I was discussing the old archives with... a friend, a wealthy patron of the sciences. A comment they made reminded me of its existence."
entries.zh:
"哦。对的，是那件事。你本可以直接说就是。"

他冲出那堆全息投影，捡起一个数据平板后坐在一张大桌子后面，一边对着你向一张椅子招手示意。不幸的是，那张椅子已被一个破旧的数据核心所占用，看上去是从一个远距离探测器里取出来的。

"现在，" 他点着他的数据平板，没注意到你的椅子上已经有客了。

"这个谜团涉及到 Galatia 学院档案中大概两百个星历年前的古老数据集。我是在一项研究 —— 实际上我是在和... 一个学术赞助人朋友讨论旧档案时偶然发现的，和他的讨论让我想起来这个数据集。"

entries.en:
"As it happens, this dataset is a recording of telemetry from a Domain-era sensor array out on what we now call the Fringe. It was somewhat more civilized back when this data was captured, though not perhaps by much."

Elek chuckles softly at his wit.

"As for the dataset, we only really have a complete sourcing header. Our copy is mostly corrupted due to anomalous  degradation during hyperwave transmission and then over 200 cycles of low-priority storage."

He shakes his head with deep disappointment at the mistakes made by someone else.
entries.zh:
"碰巧，这份数据包是 人之领 时代位于我们现在称为边缘星区的传感器阵列的一份遥测数据。在它采集数据时，那片星区或许文明程度稍高些，但可能也没好到哪儿去。"

Elek 为自己的才智得意一笑。

"至于数据包本身，我们保存完整的只有来源头文件。大多数副本已经损坏，原因在于超波传输过程中的异常衰减，以及随后长达 200 个星历年的低优先级存储。"

对于那些人为错误，他非常失望地摊了摊手。

o.en: This chair has a datacore in it.
o.zh: 这张椅子上有个数据核心。

o.en: Cough pointedly and look toward the chair

entries.en: He either doesn't notice or doesn't acknowledge your signal.
entries.zh: 他要么没注意，要么压根没搭理你的示意。

entries.en:
He snaps out of his reverie and looks at the chair.

"So it does," he says. "Please don't touch it."
entries.zh:
他从沉思中回过神，看向那把椅子。

"确实如此。" 他说道，"请不要碰它。"

entries.en:
"In any event," Elek cradles his hands, looking into an imagined middle-distance. "This patron and, ah, friend offered to fund a project to recover an intact copy of the data."

"From the source." He smiles, quite pleased with himself. "An expedition shall be made to the original sensor array! Your name came up, captain."
entries.zh:
"总之，" Elek 双手交叉，看向远处。"这位赞助者和，呃，他的朋友，愿意出钱来恢复一份完整的数据副本。"

"从源头开始。" 他自得地笑着，"组建一支科考队前往那个传感器阵列！舰长，你的名字也在名单上。"

o.en: Find the sensor array, extract the data. Sounds simple.
o.zh: 找到传感器阵列，提取数据。听上去挺简单。

entries.en:
"When put like that, yes." He stands, placing his hands together behind his back, and begins pacing.

"I shall provide you with a scientific hardware package my students have prepared. It is far from simple, I assure you of that! Have your technicians attach it to the sensor array and it will carry out the necessary operations."

"That's not all, however." He pauses to look at you with a sly smile.
entries.zh:
"这么说，确实。" 他站起身，双手背在身后踱步。

"我的学生之前准备的科学设备包，可以给你一份。我向你保证，这绝非易事！让你的技师把它装到传感器阵列上，它能自行完成必要的步骤。"

"不过，我还没说完呢。" 他露出狡黠的微笑。

o.en: I haven't agreed to anything yet, Elek.

entries.en:
"I propose that once you acquire the data and my algorithm extracts the targeting coordinates, you then travel to the indicated location which lies at the heart of all of this effort. Explore what is to be explored, find what is to be found. You will bring back no mere long-range scan, but a thorough investigation!"

"Think of the science, think of the glory! And," he winks, "You must be thinking of that 'vast fortune'. I do believe that Director Gla... that my 'friend' will be more than delighted by this fait accompli."
entries.zh:
"我建议一旦你获取数据，并且我的算法也解析出目标坐标，就前往这所有努力指向的核心地点。探索需要探索的，发现应该发现的。你带回的将不只是远程扫描结果，而是彻底的实地勘察！"

"想想科学价值，想想这份荣耀！而且，" 他眨眼示意，"你一定在惦记那 '大笔星币'。我相信总监 Gla...我的那位 '朋友'，会对这份既成事实感到欣喜若狂的。"

entries.en: "Mm? That's 'Academician Elek', if you please. And of course you haven't agreed, I haven't explained the task fully. Now where was I..."
entries.zh: "嗯？请叫我 'Elek 院士'。你当然还没同意，因为我尚未完整阐述任务内容，刚才说到哪了..."

o.en: I'm $playerName. I found your modified sensor array on the Fringe.
o.zh: 我是 $playerName。我在边疆找到了你那座改装过的传感器阵列。

o.en: I'm $playerName. We've spoken before. I returned your datacore.
o.zh: 我是$playerName。我们见过面：我找回了你的数据核心。

o.en: I'm $playerName. I tried to contact you via comms...
o.zh: 我是 $playerName。我试过用通讯联系你...

o.en: I'm $playerName. We've spoken before. I returned your datacore.
o.zh: 我是$playerName。我们见过面：我找回了你的数据核心。

o.en: I'm $playerName, remember? I've found your sensor array on the Fringe.
o.zh: 我是 $playerName，还记得吗？我在边疆找到了你的传感器阵列。

entries.en:
"Excellent, we'll start by..." He pauses, processing your words.

"What? Don't be ridiculous," Elek huffs irritably. "Take the time to think it through, captain. I'm sure reason will win out eventually."

"Or, at least, greed," he says more quietly as he turns back to his holodisplay in a huff and begins arranging moons, a clear indication that he believes the conversation is over.
entries.zh:
"好极了，我们首先要..." 他顿了顿，消化着你的话语。

"什么？别荒唐了，" Elek 烦躁地哼了一声，"花时间好好想想，舰长，我相信你的理性终将占据上风。"

"或者，至少是贪婪，" 他低声嘀咕着，气呼呼地转回全息显示屏那边开始排列卫星模型，显然认为谈话已结束。

o.en: Ask where you could find the office of Cornelius Elek
o.zh: 询问在哪里能找到 Cornelius Elek 的办公室

entries.en:
A strange expression crosses the junior agent's face at your question, but it is instantly replaced by a return to bland pleasantness.

"Of course, captain. I presume you have an appointment? Academician Elek can be... busy."
entries.zh:
接待员因你的问题闪过了一副奇怪的表情，但立刻回到原本平和又愉悦的样貌。

"当然了，舰长。您应该有过预约了？Elek 院士可能... 会很忙。"

o.en: He sent me a personal invitation.

entries.en:
A strange expression crosses the junior agent's face at your question, but it is instantly replaced by a return to bland pleasantness.

"Of course, captain. I presume you have an appointment? Academician Elek can be... busy."
entries.zh:
接待员因你的问题闪过了一副奇怪的表情，但立刻回到原本平和又愉悦的样貌。

"当然了，舰长。您应该有过预约了？Elek 院士可能... 会很忙。"

o.en: I found his... experiment in the Fringe. I'm returning it to him.
o.zh: 我在边缘星区发现了他的...某种实验品。我要把它还给他。

entries.en:
"Of course, $playerSirOrMadam," the agent says. "If you'll come right this way."

You are led through the station's primary transport hub and are soon deposited in an airy plaza halfway around the ring of the station. Your junior agent leads you through crowds of students and past a few tight-lipped academicians who scurry by, clutching datapads.

The junior agent fills the air with the sort of patter they must have saved for first-cycle students, pointing out landmarks and remarking upon departments and figures of interest to niche fields of study.
entries.zh:
"当然，$playerSirOrMadam，" 接待员说道，"请跟我来。"

你穿过学院空间站的主要交通枢纽，很快到了围绕着交通站的宽敞广场。初级代理引导你穿过成群的学生们，其中夹杂着几个紧握着数据平板，抿着嘴且匆匆走过的学者。

初级代理说着些准备给第一个星历年学期的学生听的闲聊，不断介绍着各种学院地标，并对各个学院部门和前沿研究领域侃侃而谈，填补着路程中的氛围。

entries.en:
You arrive in a quiet hall off the main concourse, only a couple decks above the station rim. An open volume ringed by railings provides a dizzying view of the clouds of Pontus 'below' you.

"Third door on the right, $playerSirOrMadam." The junior agent makes a tight smile then disappears.
entries.zh:
你来到了主广场外一个寂静的大厅，此处只比学院空间站的外缘高了几层。一片围绕着栏杆的开阔空间能让人低头望见 Pontus 的云层，这视角下的景色令人眩晕。

"左侧第三个门，$playerSirOrMadam。" 初级代理紧张地微笑了下，之后就离开了。

o.en: Ask where you could find the office of Cornelius Elek
o.zh: 询问在哪里能找到 Cornelius Elek 的办公室

entries.en:
$HeOrShe considers whether to answer your question.

"I suppose you're technically in the chain of command as an auxiliary. Right. We arrested the provost of the academy on a screenful of charges- endangering space infrastructure, negligence of habitability protocols, gross conspiracy to manipulate unauthorized technologies; it goes on."

"And by Old Earth," you note $hisOrHer jaw clenching unconsciously, "He's earned it."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe在考虑是否回答你的问题。

"技术层面上讲，我想你确实算是指挥系统中的辅助军。好吧。我们逮捕了学院的院长，罪名得有满满一屏幕 —— 危害太空基础设施、漠视宜居性规程、公然合谋操纵未经授权的技术；还有很多。"

"以旧地球之名，" 你注意到$hisOrHer不自觉地紧咬着下巴，"这是他应得的。"

entries.en:
"We were briefed about the experiment. It was only supposed to cause a minor increase in comms noise, maybe some odd readings near the jump-points. Nothing like this! Obviously something more was going on, something big enough that the provost had to know about it, and-"

The lieutenant's adjutant whispers in $hisOrHer ear again. If you're not mistaken, there is shouting in the background, barely picked up by the lieutenant's handheld comm unit.

"The mob grows restless," the lieutenant says with a joyless smile. $HeOrShe barks some orders to someone; the holo feed jostles and flickers with static as they begin to move. "We'll chat later, captain. I'll buy you a pint on Coatl Station someday if you can get us out of this mess."
entries.zh:
"我们听取了有关实验的简报。但它本应该只会略微增加通信噪音，顶多在跳跃点附近出现一些奇怪的读数之类的。绝不会是现在这样！显然这里面另有隐情，里面的内幕大到院长不可能不知情，而且 ——"

上尉的副官再次在$hisOrHer耳边低语。如果你没听错的话，背景中有一些喊叫声，勉强能被上尉的手持式通讯装置拾到。

"这帮人又不安分起来了，"上尉毫无笑意地笑着说。$HeOrShe向什么人厉声下了几道命令；他们开始行动，全息视频信号夹杂着杂讯，紊乱而闪烁。"我们之后再聊，舰长。如果你能帮我们摆脱这个烂摊子，我会在 Coatl 空间站请你喝上一杯。"

o.en: Thank the officer and sign off.

entries.en:
"And then just about all at once the League snitches all stopped asking about Coureuse. That tells me, $firstName, it looks like someone found who they were looking for. It also tells me they're not a real experienced operation. Leave it to the League, right? Appointing offices by influence more than ability. I'd never abide by that."

"Anyway, shortly after that a unit of top pay-grade League agents fresh from Kazeron set up shop on Laicaille Habitat."
entries.zh:
"然后，英仙座联盟里的眼线们突然就都不再问 'Coureuse' 的事了。那我可就知道了啊，$firstName，估计是有人找到了他们想找的人。这同时还让我知道那些人并不是经验老道的特工。有什么事都直接丢给英仙座联盟 —— 对吧？他们任命官员居然不考核能力而是考核影响力，真让我看不下去。"

"总之，在那之后不久，一群从 Kazeron 来的太子爷 英仙座联盟 特工就开始在 Laicaille 栖息地 '安居乐业' 了。"

entries.en:
"Now, being a curious individual and a friend of the friendless, I was on the lookout for a League crackdown on our legitimate business operations. But it didn't come. Just the same-old same-old. 'So what're those spies doing on Laicaille?', I asked myself."

"I paid a real professional surveillance contractor and they got me list of names, rented properties, and schedule of activities. Looks like they've got some fancy safehouse set-up." The Pirate boss taps a datapad and your comms ping to alert you to an incoming file. "You've bought yourself a copy of the data, my friend."
entries.zh:
"现在，作为一个好奇心旺盛的人和那些无业游民的朋友，我估计 英仙座联盟 就要开始打击我们那些明面上的企业了。但它没有这么做。而是让一切保持着原样，那么那些间谍到底来 Laicaille 做什么呢？我这么问我自己。"

"我雇了一个专业监控团队，之后他们给了我一份清单，上面有一堆名字，租借房屋信息以及一些活动的日程表。看起来特工们在这里弄好了一些精致的安全屋。" 海盗头子轻触了一下数据平板，你的通讯器则发出了接收到文件的提示音。"你给自己搞到了一份资料，我的朋友。"

o.en: I do like to keep informed.
o.zh: 我确实喜欢保持消息灵通。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe leans back, putting on a casual act. "Me, I just ask questions. Maybe you're looking for answers, maybe you'll find one. Maybe it'll teach those League goons a bit of humility." The pirate smiles broadly at this thought.

"Just don't forget who helped you along, right?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe靠回了椅背，摆出一副漫不经心的样子。"我只是个问问题的人，答案还得你自己去找，也许你还真能找到什么东西。希望你的努力能让那些英仙座联盟的呆子们变得谦逊一些。" 海盗头子讲到这里，自己都笑了出来。

"别忘了是谁帮的你，如何？"

entries.en:
A two-spacer team rides a work drone to the relay and makes a quick hull cut to access a hard data connection. Within a minute, the snoop algorithm is set loose, the hull re-sealed, and the ops team returns.

Now you wait for it to do its work.
entries.zh:
一支两人小队驾驶着一架工作无人机来到了中继站上，快速切割其外壳以便找到可与其内部硬件连接的接口。不到一分钟后，窥探算法安装完成，中继器的外壳也被重新密封，行动小组成功返回。

现在你开始等待算法完成自己的使命。

entries.en:
After a tense hour or so, your comms officer informs you that the snoop is complete. A team of officers and specialists proficient in techops, infosec, and comms has been analyzing the snoop's data as it has come in, and have already prepared a preliminary report.

"The team is still finishing the detailed analysis and decrypting what we can," your comms officer reports, "But we've got a pretty good idea of the big picture."
entries.zh:
紧张地等待了一个小时后，通讯军官告诉你，窥探算法的工作完成了。一组精通技术操作、信息安全和通讯的军官和专家一直在逐步分析陆续接收到的信息，并已经完成了一份初步报告。

"我们的团队仍在进行详细的分析，并尽可能地对我们得到的信息进行解密。" 通讯军官报告说，"但我们已经对总体情况有了一定程度的了解。"

entries.en:
"It looks like most major factions and a few freelancers and underworld agents have been showing an anomalous level of activity in the Isirah system. There are plausible explanations for this of course, but what tipped us off was some sloppy infosec by a Pather infiltrator."

Here, your comms officer pulls up a communication ID and a League ID summary.
entries.zh:
"看起来大多数主要势力，少数自由佣兵和地下特工在 Isirah 星系中的活动频率高的异常。这可以有不少合理的解释，但根据我们的分析，这种现象大概率是一个粗心大意地泄露了不少情报的左径分子造成的。"

说到这，通讯军官拿出了一份包含了通讯 ID 和 英仙座联盟 ID 的列表。

o.zh: 这上边值得注意的是哪个人？

entries.en:
"Jensen Gallegos. All the signs of a Pather infiltrator. The ID doesn't hold up to scrutiny as you can see... er, yes captain. The big picture," they flip through some irrelevant data logs then focus again on a series of messages sent as text, "They slipped up here, mentioning Coureuse by name, though misspelled. That led us to discover a simple code system used by what appears to be a cell of Pathers operating on Laicaille Habitat."

The League ID of not-Jensen Gallegos is joined by a handful more IDs with annotated discrepancies and errors.
entries.zh:
"Jensen Gallegos，各种意义上讲都像是一名左径渗透者。如你所见，舰长，这个身份经不起仔细审查...呃，总体来说，" 他们跳过了一些无关紧要的信息，并将展示的重点放在了一系列呈现为文本的秘密信息上，"看这里，他们疏忽大意地提到了 Coureuse 的名字，虽然拼错了。这让我们发现了一个正在 Laicaille 栖息地上活动的左径组织使用的暗号系统。"

更多除了 Jensen Gallegos 以外的，被注释了差异和错误之处的 英仙座联盟 ID 被加入了 ID 列表中。

entries.en:
"Lots of communication, both text and holo. They think Coureuse is on Laicaille Habitat, but they can't get close to her, and they don't think their identities will hold up to a security check. Which is correct," your comms officer says with a touch of pride. "It sounds like they're asking home base to call in some big guns, whatever that might be. Or whoever."

The full report will be completed within the shift, but you know what you need to know: Laicaille Habitat.
entries.zh:
"这里有大量的通讯信息，包括文本和全息两种形式。他们认为 Coureuse 就在 Laicaille 栖息地上，只是这些人没能力接近她。同时他们认为他们的身份信息无法通过安全检查 —— 这倒是千真万确。" 你的通讯军官带着一丝自豪说道，"他们似乎在要求总部送来一些不得了的东西，或是派来一些狠角色。"

完整的调查报告将在轮班前完成，但你已经知道你需要知道的信息了：Laicaille 栖息地上有问题。

entries.en: You could run a snoop algorithm through the message cache to find "Scylla Coureuse" and related keywords. Only recent messages and unencrypted stores will be accessible, but there may be useful intel, and the process is nondestructive.
entries.zh: 你可以通过在信息缓存区中运行窥探算法找到 "Scylla Coureuse" 和相关的关键词。虽然只有最近的信息和未加密的数据具备可访问性，但其中仍可能存在有用的信息，而且这个过程不会损坏信息缓存区。

o.en: Install and run the snoop algorithm

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet was recently detected - or is currently being tracked by - a nearby fleet, making a covert hack impossible.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet最近才被一支附近的舰队探测到 —— 亦或是仍然在被其跟踪着，这使得秘密入侵行动成为不可能。

entries.en: "I- I suppose. If you like." $HeOrShe sounds confused.
entries.zh: "我 —— 我想可以。如果你喜欢的话。" $heOrShe听起来很困惑。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe pauses for a long moment, looking at you.

"I heard about that. Hardly believed it. Someone taking Reynard Hannan down a notch? Couldn't happen. Man is invincible."

"So we all thought," $heOrShe says quietly.
entries.zh:
$heOrShe停顿良久，注视着你。

"我有所耳闻。这简直难以置信，居然有人能让 Reynard Hannan 吃瘪？不可能的事，那男人战无不胜。"

"我们曾经都这么认为，" $heOrShe低声道。

entries.en:
"And you're right!" $HeOrShe slams $hisOrHer console, almost shouting.

"He doesn't care about anything outside of his precious gens. We're only important for him to get what he wants!"
entries.zh:
"你说得对！" $heOrShe猛拍控制台，几乎喊出声来。

"他只在乎他那宝贝氏族！我们不过是他实现野心的工具！"

entries.en:
"Unbelievable," $heOrShe says, shaking $hisOrHer head.

$HeOrShe stops, and gives you a look. Somehow more determined than you've seen. "But that's Reynard, isn't it. That's Gens Hannan. Every gens. That's all of them. Blood-sucking parasites, all of them."
entries.zh:
"难以置信，" $heOrShe说道，一边摇了摇头。

$heOrShe停下来，用一种你从未见过的坚定眼神看着你。"但这就是 Reynard，不是吗。这就是 Hannan 氏族，每个氏族都是如此，吸血的寄生虫，全都是。"

entries.en:
"Oh?" The archon's eyes flick off to one side then back to you.

"I don't think I've heard of her," $heOrShe says, asserting a placid tone of bureaucratic impatience. "You know there's a public comm directory for this sort of thing, captain."
entries.zh:
"哦？" 执政官的眼睛瞟向一边，然后又看向了你。

"我想我没听说过这个人。" $heOrShe说，同时恢复了$heOrShe那官僚式的，不耐烦的平静语调。"舰长，你应该知道有一种叫做公共通讯目录的东西，它就是用来处理这些事情的。"

entries.en:
"This again." The archon's eyes flick off to one side then back to you.

"Like I told you before, there's a public comm directory. This is outside the purview of my office."
entries.zh:
"又是这事。" 执政官的眼睛瞟向一边，然后又看向了你。

"我告诉过你了，有个叫公共通讯目录的东西可以帮到你，这事超出我的职权范围了。"

entries.en:
"This again." The archon's eyes flick off to one side then back to you.

"Like I told you before, there's a public comm directory. This is outside the purview of my office."
entries.zh:
"又是这事。" 执政官的眼睛瞟向一边，然后又看向了你。

"我告诉过你了，有个叫公共通讯目录的东西可以帮到你，这事超出我的职权范围了。"

entries.en:
"Demarchon." $HisOrHer eyes are fixed on you now.

"Look. I respect your office, and the ideals of the League, the true ideals..." $HeOrShe trails off with a sigh. "I've heard that line before, is what I am saying."

$PersonName takes a deep breath.

"Laicaille Habitat is not a large polity, nor a powerful one. And we've got lots of problems. Pirates, Pathers... meddling gens sniffing around for weakness to exploit. From where I'm sitting, I don't know what makes you any different. Perhaps you're working for them."
entries.zh:
"统领。" $hisOrHer的目光此刻正锁定着你。

"听着。我尊重您的职位，也尊重联盟的理念，那些真正的理念..." $heOrShe顿了顿，一边发出一声叹息，"这类说辞我以前听过了，这就是我的意思。"

$personName 深吸一口气。

"Laicaille 栖息地不是一个大政体，也不是什么强权。我们有许多问题。海盗、左径分子...以及四处窥伺可乘之机的氏族势力。在我这个位置，看不出你有何不同，也许你正在为他们效力。"

entries.en:
"Demarchon," $heOrShe says. "This again."

"You may have fine words for me, but words don't keep Laicaille Habitat free."
entries.zh:
"统领，" $heOrShe说道，"又来了。"

"你或许能对我说些漂亮话，但漂亮话守护不了 Laicaille 栖息地的自由。"

entries.en:
"With all due respect to your office, demarchon, we discussed this," $heOrShe says.

"If you need help, I suggest you ask the great Reynard Hannan. I'm sure he'll drop everything to assist the demarchon of a 'minor polity'."

"I have... a meeting." $HeOrShe looks aside. "Burn bright."
entries.zh:
"恕我冒昧，统领，但我们已经讨论过此事，" $heOrShe说道。

"如果你需要帮助，那我建议你去求助伟大的 Reynard Hannan。他一定会为一位 '小政体' 的统领放下所有事务。"

"我...还有个会议。" $heOrShe看向一旁，"祝你航行无阻。"

o.en: He's extorting me for League membership. Payments directly to Gens Hannan.
o.zh: 他在要挟我加入联盟，而好处会直接归 Hannan 氏族。

o.en: I understand. The Persean League blockaded my colonies to force me to join.
o.zh: 我理解，英仙座联盟 封锁了我的殖民地并强迫加入。

o.en: I'm sorry you feel that way. Let's discuss something else.
o.zh: 很遗憾你有这种感觉，我们换个话题吧。

o.en: Have you ever met Reynard Hannan?
o.zh: 你见过 Reynard Hannan 吗？

o.en: I told Reynard I'd join the League to vote him out of office. Would you help?
o.zh: 我曾告诉 Reynard 我会加入联盟来投票罢免他。你愿意帮忙吗？

o.en: I told Reynard to his face that his disregard for human life is unbelievably cynical.
o.zh: 我曾当面告诉 Reynard，他对人命的漠视简直冷酷到难以置信。

o.en: I beat Reynard at his own game. I joined the League, but on my terms.
o.zh: 我在 Reynard 的游戏中击败了他。我加入了联盟，但是按照我开出的条件。

o.en: I guess that's our lot. Shall we discuss something else?
o.zh: 我想这就是我们的处境了，要不换个话题聊聊？

entries.en:
"I recall that, now." $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head. "To my shame, Laicaille voted approval of the measure. Gens Hannan... well, we could not refuse. Our vote might not have much weight, but it symbolized the 'support of the minor polities of the League'."

"Minor polities!" The archon clenches $hisOrHer jaw then goes silent, a look of consternation settled on $hisOrHer face.

"I would make it up to you," $heOrShe says. "And to ourselves. Anything to stick it in Reynard Hannan's eye just once."
entries.zh:
"我现在想起来了。" $heOrShe摇头道，"惭愧的是，Laicaille 当时投了赞成票。Hannan 氏族...唉，我们无法拒绝。我们的那一票或许分量不重，但它象征着 '联盟小政体的支持'。"

"小政体！" 执政官咬紧牙关陷入了沉默，面容凝固着懊恼。

"我愿意弥补，" $heOrShe说道，"为了你，也为了我们自己。只要能给 Reynard Hannan 一次教训，什么都行。"

entries.en: "Once, personally," $heOrShe says, guardedly. "I've attended the League Council, of course."
entries.zh: "曾经，私下有过，"$heOrShe谨慎地说道，"当然，我参加过联盟议会。"

o.en: And is he not the most proud, insufferable bully you've ever met?
o.zh: 他难道不是你见过的最傲慢、最令人无法忍受的恶霸吗？

o.en: Don't you want to be like him? His success, his power?
o.zh: 你难道不想成为他那样的人吗？拥有他的成功，他的权力？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe smiles.

"Maybe we're more alike than I thought, demarchon."
entries.zh:
$heOrShe笑了笑。

"也许我们二人比我想象中更加相似，统领。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe frowns.

"Maybe we're even less alike than I thought."

$HisOrHer eyes glide away, not wanting to confront something. You, perhaps. Maybe something else.

"I have... a meeting. Burn bright, captain."

A listless arm shifts, and the comms cut out.
entries.zh:
$heOrShe皱起眉头。

"也许我们二人没有我想象中那么相似。"

$hisOrHer目光游离，似乎不愿直面某些事物。或许是你，或许是别的什么。

"我...还有个会议。祝你航行无阻，舰长。"

随着一条无力的手臂动了动，通讯中断了。

entries.en: "Let's," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh: "行，" $heOrShe说道。

entries.en:
"Um. Yes, actually. Recent events in the Galatia system, right? Dangerous what the Academy got up to, and while they deserve reprimand, the Hegemony reacted with typical overreach." A note of indignation enters $hisOrHer speech.

"The Persean League filed a complaint in the Interfactional Dispute Council, did you hear? We don't expect much to come of it, but someone has to say something, right?"

The archon examines you for a moment then says "Why do you ask?"
entries.zh:
"嗯，我知道。那是 Galatia 星系最近发生的事，对吧？学院的所作所为很危险，虽然他们应该受到谴责，但 霸主 也管得太宽了。

英仙座联盟 已经就此向国际争端委员会提出了控诉，你听说了吗？我们并不期望能取得什么成效，可是总有人得说些什么。"

执政官打量了你一会儿："你问这个干什么？"

o.en: I'm looking for Scylla Coureuse. She was involved.
o.zh: 我在找 Scylla Coureuse，她与此事有关。

o.en: Do you think something like that could happen here?
o.zh: 你觉得那样的事情会在这里发生吗？

entries.en:
"Of course not," $heOrShe says curtly, "I'm kept informed of all major industrial and research projects in this system. And the pirates, " the last word spoken with a tone of some annoyance, "They aren't capable of anything truly catastrophic. Unless another warlord shows up, but that's why we pay our share to the Persean League Armamentarium."

The archon sits up straighter, "So I assure you captain, you have nothing to worry about while doing business on Laicaille Habitat."
entries.zh:
"当然不会。" $heOrShe给出了简短的答复，"我随时能获得这个星系中所有重要的工业和科研项目的消息。至于那些海盗..." 这句话中的最后一个词几乎是被对方咬牙切齿地说出的，"他们没能力掀起什么风浪。除非有另一个军阀级别的人物冒出来，但 英仙座联盟 军备库的摊费可不是白交的。"

执政官坐得更直了："所以我向你保证，你在 Laicaille 栖息地做生意时没什么可担心的，舰长。"

o.en: I have proof that Scylla Coureuse is on this station.
o.zh: 我有证据证明 Scylla Coureuse 就在这空间站里。

o.en: Good to know. I'll rest easy.
o.zh: 真高兴能知晓这点，现在我能放心了。

o.en: What if Coureuse is on this station - right now?
o.zh: 如果 Coureuse 此刻就在这空间站上呢？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe is looking nervous. "I don't know what you're talking about, captain. Without some kind of evidence of...  Um. Look, I have another appointment. Good day, captain."

The archon hits a button and dumps you back to a holding pattern bearing the spinning crest of Laicaille Habitat's executive council.

The archon is hiding something, but you won't get it out of $himOrHer without some kind of compelling evidence.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe看起来变得紧张了起来。"我不知道你在说什么，舰长。如果没有切实的证据...嗯，听着，我还要开个会。再见，舰长。"

执政官按了下一个按钮，把你扔回了只能对着 Laicaille 栖息地旋转徽标发呆的等候界面。

执政官在隐瞒一些事情，但如果没有令人信服的证据，你没法从$himOrHer口中套出什么信息。

entries.en: Now is the time to drive it home. What inconvenient truth will you reveal to the archon?
entries.zh: 是切入正题的时候了，你会向执政官揭露什么难以忽视的真相？

entries.en: With only one piece of evidence to support your claim, it would be premature to make your revelation. You need to make sure that the archon cannot deny your accusation by finding another piece of evidence.
entries.zh: 现在只有一个证据可以支持你的说法，揭露真相还为时尚早。你得找到另一个切实的证据来让执政官难以否认你的指控。

o.en: I'll be back when I can prove it.
o.zh: 当我找到证据后，我会回来找你的。

o.en: Tell the Archon about the Pather cell operating here
o.zh: 告诉执政官这里有左径分部存在

o.en: Tell the Archon about the secret hypercomms relay on Groombridge station
o.zh: 告诉执政官 Groombridge 空间站上发现的秘密超空间通讯中继站

o.en: Tell the Archon that you know about the League's intel operation here
o.zh: 告诉执政官 英仙座联盟 正在这里进行一些情报活动

o.en: Tell the Archon about the comm intercepts to here from a radical on Fikenhild
o.zh: 告诉执政官从 Fikenhild 的激进分子那里截获的通讯

o.en: Let me see Coureuse. You don't owe the Persean League anything.
o.zh: 你不欠 英仙座联盟 什么，现在让我见见 Coureuse。

entries.en: The archon freezes up, stammering "I'm uh, of course I- "
entries.zh: 执政官愣住了，结结巴巴地说："我，呃，当然，我 —— "

entries.en: Your connection request stalls on the archon's symbol of office, returning only generic out-of-office text.
entries.zh: 你的连接请求画面上始终是那个执政官办公室的符号，收到的反馈也始终只有 "无人接听"。

entries.en:
"I'm under strict orders to... I mean, to keep intelligence matters of the Persean League... policy secrets..."

Archon $personLastName sounds defeated.
entries.zh:
"我奉命...我的意思是，为了保存 英仙座联盟 情报...政策机密..."

$personLastName 执政官听起来几乎要放弃了。

o.en: Orders from Kazeron? I can see who really runs Laicaille.
o.zh: 来自 Kazeron 的命令？现在我终于知道究竟是谁在管理 Laicaille 了。

o.en: She is a free citizen of the League. Does that mean nothing?
o.zh: 她可是 英仙座联盟 的公民。这个身份一点意义都没有吗？
很好，抱歉刺探了你们的情报。

entries.en:
"Look, we value our freedom here as much as- no, we value it more than those tin-pot plutocrats from Kazeron," the archon sputters. "Laicaille is free and proud! And by the stars, that means something here, even if you don't see it, and-" $HisOrHer face starts turning red, "they say 'don't ask questions', they say 'League defense' and 'need to know' and 'we've got a handle on it'. Do they? With this whole mess set to explode?"

Archon $personLastName closes $hisOrHer eyes and takes several deep breaths, then meets your gaze and says, "You're right. I've been letting those Kazeronian spies push me around. Push Laicaille around. Lord it over us with their 'security clearance' dross. I've... let down what it means to be Laicaillian."
entries.zh:
"听着，我们视我们的自由如珍宝，就像 —— 不，远比那些来自 Kazeron 的劣等富豪更珍重它。" 执政官气冲冲地说，" Laicaille 一直都自由而骄傲！" $HisOrHer的脸因为激动而涨得通红，"他们说 '不要问那么多问题'，他们说 '联盟防卫'，'按需知密' 和 '我们已经处理好了'。他们做到了吗？这里的情况还是一团糟！"

$personLastName 执政官闭上了$hisOrHer的眼睛，做了几次深呼吸，然后对上了你的目光："你是对的。那些 Kazeron 间谍一直在随心摆弄我，摆弄 Laicaille。用他们的 '安全许可' 对我们颐指气使。我已经...放下了做 Laicaille 人的意义。"

entries.en: The archon's voice steadies with a cold rage that's been building for many cycles, "But we're better than that. We need to show them who Laicaille really belongs to - not a bunch of Kazeron gens babies tracking dirt onto our fine station."
entries.zh: 执政官的稳重的言语中带着经过多年发酵沉积下来的愤怒。"但我们远比那更优秀，必须让他们知道 Laicaille 是谁的了 —— 它绝不属于一群在我们的空间站上玩泥巴的 Kazeron 子弟。"

entries.en:
"Wait," says the archon, still upset, "You're just going to drop the matter? No, I don't believe it. What's your angle, $playerName? Who are you working for? Westernesse media, one of those stupid holovid programs? Or is this another Kazeron psy-op, playing with those back-water rubes from Laicaille?" $HeOrShe takes a couple deep breaths and steadies $himOrHerself.

"Alright Captain $playerName, if that's really who you are. It's not 'fair enough' that I'm willing to cover for some game those upstart Kazeron spies want to play. There's nothing fair about it, nothing fair about how we've been pushed around and manipulated. Laicaille Habitat is free and proud! We don't stand for secret police and secret prisoners and all the old rot from the Domain-era."
entries.zh:
"等等，" 执政官说，对方看起来仍然很不安，"你就这么不做追究了？不，我不相信。$playerName，你究竟想做什么？你为谁工作？Westernesse 的媒体，那些愚蠢的全息影像节目？又或者这是 Kazeron 的间谍行动，来糊弄我们这群 Laicaille 乡巴佬的？" $HeOrShe做了几次深呼吸，让自己的情绪平复下来。

"好吧，$playerName 舰长，如果你真的是这些人中的一员，我得和你说我 '自愿' 为 Kazeron 间谍打掩护可一点都不公平，Laicaille 人被他们摆布的事实也一样。Laicaille 栖息地一直以来自由而骄傲！我们不支持秘密警察，秘密囚犯，也不支持 人之领 时代的老一套。"

entries.en: The archon's voice steadies with a cold rage that's been building for many cycles, it seems. "I'm going to show you and whoever you represent who Laicaille really belongs to - and it's not a bunch of Kazeron gens-babies tracking dirt onto our fine station."
entries.zh: 执政官的稳重的言语中带着经过多年发酵沉积下来的愤怒。"我要告诉你以及你背后的人 —— 不管那些人有怎样的身份 —— Laicaille 究竟属于谁，它绝不属于一群在我们的空间站上玩泥巴的 Kazeron 子弟。"

entries.en:
"It's not like that at all," the archon sputters. "Laicaille is free and proud! Small, yes, but strategically important. And not tied up in the nepotistic gens politics of Kazeron." $HisOrHer face starts turning red, "They don't understand! Out here we have to work for a living. We face risks those fools can't imagine. What kind of deal is this 'league' if they won't wipe out that pack of pirates holed up in Kapteyn that've been hounding us for... for cycles! And the fleet taxes!"

Archon $personLastName closes $hisOrHer eyes and takes several deep breaths, then meets your gaze with a new determination.

"You know what. You're right."
entries.zh:
"根本不是那么回事。" 执政官结结巴巴地说，" Laicaille 一直以来都自由而骄傲！虽然规模很小，但具有重要的战略意义，也不受 Kazeron 氏族政治的束缚。" $HisOrHer的脸开始变红，"他们根本不明白！在这里我们得工作谋生。我们面临着那些蠢货无法想象的风险。如果这个 '联盟' 不消灭藏在 Kapteyn 的那群威胁了我们好几年的海盗，那这结盟条约还有什么用？舰队税也白交了！"

$personLastName 执政官闭上$hisOrHer的眼睛，做了几次深呼吸，然后看向了你，对方的眼神中似乎带有全新的决意。

"现在看来，你是对的。"

entries.en: The archon's voice steadies with a cold rage that's been building for many cycles, it seems. "It's time to show them who Laicaille belongs to- and it's not a bunch of Kazeron gens-babies tracking dirt onto our fine station."
entries.zh: 执政官的稳重的言语中带着经过多年发酵沉积下来的愤怒。"是时候让他们知道 Laicaille 是谁的了 —— 它绝不属于一群在我们的空间站上玩泥巴的 Kazeron 子弟。"

entries.en:
"Laicaille is free and proud! And by the stars, that means something to the so-called 'minor' polities of the Persean League," $heOrShe nods significantly to you. "-even if Gens Hannan doesn't respect it."

"They say 'don't ask questions', they say 'League defense' and 'need to know' and 'we've got a handle on it'. It's been a mess from start. And Laicaille is to shoulder all the risk?"

Archon $personLastName takes several deep breaths, then meets your gaze.

"I've been letting those Kazeronian spies push me around. Push Laicaille around. Lord it over us with their 'security clearance' dross."
entries.zh:
"Laicaille 一直都自由而骄傲！看在群星的份上，这对 英仙座联盟 那些所谓的 '小' 政体意义重大，" $heOrShe意味深长地向你点头，"—— 哪怕 Hannan 氏族并不尊重这一点。"

"他们说 '不要问那么多问题'，他们说 '联盟防卫'，'按需知密' 和 '我们已经处理好了'。从头到尾都是一团糟，而风险还全要 Laicaille 承担？"

$personLastName 执政官深吸几口气，随后迎上你的目光。

"那些 Kazeron 间谍一直在随心摆弄我，摆弄 Laicaille。用他们的 '安全许可' 对我们颐指气使。"

entries.en: The archon's voice steadies with a cold rage that's been building for many cycles. "We're better than that. We'll show them who Laicaille really belongs to - not a bunch of Kazeron gens babies tracking dirt onto our fine station."
entries.zh: 执政官的稳重的言语中带着经过多年发酵沉积下来的愤怒。"我们远比那更优秀，是时候让他们知道 Laicaille 是谁的了 —— 它绝不属于一群在我们的空间站上玩泥巴的 Kazeron 子弟。"

o.en: Tell the archon about the Pather cell operating on Laicaille
o.zh: 告诉执政官 Laicaille 上有左径分部存在

o.en: Tell the archon about the secret hypercomms relay on Groombridge station
o.zh: 告诉执政官 Groombridge 空间站上发现的秘密超空间通讯中继站

o.en: Tell the archon how easily you discovered information on the intel operation on Laicaille
o.zh: 告诉执政官你是多么轻易就发现了在 Laicaille 进行的情报活动信息

o.en: Tell the archon about the 'comm intercepts' to Laicaille from a 'radical agitator' on Fikenhild
o.zh: 告诉执政官关于 Fikenhild 上某 '激进煽动者' 发往 Laicaille 的 '通讯截获内容'

o.en: I'll come back when I have something for you.
o.zh: 等我有所发现时再回来找你。

entries.en:
You explain that you have a communication intercept sent by Cavin Pharoh - a dangerous radical agitator on Fikenhild - to Scylla Coureuse. On Laicaille.

If Fleet Intel knows about this, then what's their game? And if Fleet Intel doesn't know about this, then that's even worse, isn't it?

The archon looks grim at this prospect.

As you forward the fake intercept, the archon finally finds $hisOrHer words. "They told me everyone would be quiet, no trouble, no games..."
entries.zh:
你解释说你有一份由 Cavin Pharoh —— Fikenhild 上一个擅长煽动暴乱的，危险的激进分子 —— 发给 Scylla Coureuse 的通讯信息，还是在 Laicaille 栖息地上被拦截到的。

如果舰队情报部知道这事，那他们在搞什么鬼？如果他们对此一无所知，那就更糟了，不是吗？

执政官对此持悲观态度。

当你转发这段伪造的信息时，执政官终于吐出了$hisOrHer要说的话。"他们告诉过我所有人都会安分守己，没有麻烦，也没有勾心斗角..."

entries.en:
You explain to Archon $personLastName that you have full documentation of the org chart, budget, and watch schedule of a League Fleet intel operation on Laicaille. There's even a line-item for a safehouse, and it aligns suspiciously with the cessation of a Fleet Intel search for Scylla Coureuse.

You forward the documents you received to drive the point home that you got everything on this sloppy operation by throwing a few credits around in-system. You hint at what a Pather cell could do with this information; the Persean League doesn't seem to be taking Laicaille Habitat's security very seriously.

The archon clenches $hisOrHer jaw. "I was given assurances..."
entries.zh:
你向 $personLastName 执政官解释说，你有涵盖驻扎在 Laicaille 的联盟舰队的组织结构、预算信息和监视时间表在内的完整报告，甚至还有一串安全屋的列表。所有的这些都与联盟舰队情报机构停止对 Scylla Coureuse 进行搜索有关。

你转发了你手上的文件，以表明获取这份资料并不困难 —— 只是随便丢点小钱而已，同时暗示了左径分部可以用这些信息做什么；英仙座联盟 似乎并没有把 Laicaille 栖息地的安全当回事。

执政官咬紧牙关地说："他们向我保证过..."

entries.en:
You explain to Archon $personLastName that you intercepted comm logs which reveal that a cell of Pather terrorists has infiltrated Laicaille Habitat under false identities to track down Scylla Coureuse. They know about the League intelligence safehouse and they have requested reinforcements to finish the job.

As the archon reads your uploaded log analysis, $heOrShe pales. "Siyavong told me they'd run a tight operation- no screwups. And now there are Pathers crawling around my station?"
entries.zh:
你向 $personLastName 执政官解释说，你截获的通讯日志显示，左径分子的一支小队已经用假身份潜入了 Laicaille 栖息地来搜寻 Scylla Coureuse。他们知道联盟特工安全屋的存在并且已经向总部请求了增援。

当执政官看完你上传的通讯日志分析报告时，$heOrShe脸色白了起来。"Siyavong 向我保证过他们会严密执行 —— 绝不出岔子。可现在居然有左径分子在我的空间站里到处乱爬？"

entries.en:
As you upload salvage logs, you explain to Archon $personLastName that you discovered a secret hypercommunication relay in the derelict Groombridge Habitat that's been sending periodic transmissions to a repeater close to Laicaille Habitat. And it, in turn, has been receiving transmissions from an array of probes around a distant star. And this array was compromised by a scavenger on the far end, and...

The archon goes pale, "-so pirates, or even Pathers, could be..."

You nod.

The archon shakes $hisOrHer head, "They said there'd be no wild experiments! Everyone remembers Galatia."
entries.zh:
你上传了通讯中继站的打捞日志，并向 $personLastName 执政官解释道：你在废弃的 Groombridge 栖息地发现了一个秘密的超空间通信中继站，它一直在定期向 Laicaille 栖息地附近的中继站发送信号，同时它还一直在接收来自某颗离这很远的恒星周围的一系列探测器的信号。如今这组通讯阵列已经从远端被拾荒者破坏了，所以...

执政官脸色惨白：" —— 所以是海盗，甚至左径分子，都有可能..."

你点了点头。

执政官摇着$hisOrHer的头，说道："他们说过不会在这里进行危险的实验！所有人都记得 Galatia 的教训。"

entries.en:
As you upload sensor readings and the scans recorded by rad-hardened drones, you explain to Archon $personLastName that you discovered a secret hypercommunication relay in the derelict Groombridge Habitat and it's been sending periodic transmissions to a repeater close to Laicaille Habitat. Someone has been talking without using official channels...

The archon goes pale, "I was told that, that it'd all be above-board. If they're keeping secrets from me, there's no telling what they could be doing..."

You nod.

The archon looks grim. "They said there'd be no wild experiments! Everyone remembers Galatia."
entries.zh:
你上传了涂装辐射保护镀层的无人机记录下的传感器读数和扫描结果，并向 $personLastName 执政官解释道：你在废弃的 Groombridge 栖息地发现了一个秘密的超空间通讯中继站，它一直在向 Laicaille 栖息地附近的中继站周期性地传输数据，这意味着有人在使用非官方的渠道进行通讯。

执政官脸色苍白，"有人告诉我，英仙座联盟的一切都是光明磊落的。如果他们对我有所隐瞒，不难想象那会是怎样的事..."

你点了点头。

执政官神情严峻："他们说过不会在这里进行危险的实验！所有人都记得 Galatia 的教训。"

o.en: Do you know anything about the Galatia incident?
o.zh: 你有关于 Galatia 事件的消息吗？

o.en: I know Coureuse is on this station and I can prove it.
o.zh: 我知道 Coureuse 在这空间站里，并且我有证据。

o.en: Archon. Let's talk about Coureuse, and the evidence you require...
o.zh: 执政官。让我们来谈谈 Coureuse，以及你需要的证据...

o.zh: 我也是联盟的民选统领，我们需要携手合作。

entries.en: "Glad to be of service," $heOrShe says sharply.
entries.zh: "很乐意能帮上忙。" $heOrShe话里带刺地说道。

entries.en:
"Captain. Take a shuttle. Meet me at the executive docking ring. Let's go see this Scylla Coureuse."

The archon doesn't await your reply before $heOrShe pounds the comms disconnect. You're left staring at the spinning crest of Laicaille Habitat's executive council.

"舰长，搭个穿梭机过来，在港口的行政环区等我，我带你去见 Scylla Coureuse。"

在执政官切断通讯前，$heOrShe没给你回应的机会。你只能对着 Laicaille 栖息地那旋转的徽标干瞪眼。
