entries.en:
"Hm," $heOrShe rubs $hisOrHer chin. "About our Scylla Coureuse problem."

"I need an excuse. Some exceptional reason to intervene. Evidence of... some risk, some misstep involving Coureuse. A leak in their operation. Can you give me one?"
entries.zh:
"嗯，" $heOrShe摩挲着$hisOrHer的下巴，"关于我们 Scylla Coureuse 的问题。"

"我需要一个借口，一个非同寻常的干预理由。需要证据证明...存在某种风险，与 Coureuse 相关的失误，他们行动中的纰漏。你能给我一个吗？"

entries.en: "Yes," $heOrShe says. "I need a reason to intervene. Evidence of some misstep I can hold against the Kazeron operation on my station. Can you give me one?"
entries.zh: "是的，" $heOrShe说道，"我需要一个干预的理由，需要能证明 Kazeron 在本站运作存在过失的证据。你能给我一个吗？"

entries.en:
$HisOrHer smile fades into something more melancholic.

"You say the right words, demarchon. Like many a supposed friend of Laicaille, of the 'minor' polities of the League." $HeOrShe pauses. "But do our interests align? When the storm grows hot, will you abandon us?"

$HeOrShe shrugs gently.

"I don't think there's anything else to say."
entries.zh:
$hisOrHer的笑容逐渐淡去，化作更深的忧郁。

"你说着冠冕堂皇的话，统领。就像许多自诩为 Laicaille 的朋友，自诩为联盟那些 '小' 政体的朋友的人一样。" $heOrShe顿了顿，"但我们的利益真的一致吗？当风暴加剧时，你会抛弃我们吗？"

$heOrShe轻轻耸了耸肩。

"我想没什么可说的了。"

entries.en:
"Hah!"

$HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head, a grim smile on $hisOrHer face. It slowly fades.

After a quiet moment, $heOrShe says, "You know what? Yes. Yes I would. He'd make me pay, he'd make Laicaille pay. But it'd be worth it to see him lose for once."
entries.zh:
"哈！"

$heOrShe摇摇头，一抹苦笑浮现在$hisOrHer的脸上，又逐渐消散

沉默片刻后，$heOrShe说道，"你知道吗？是的。是的，我会这么做。他会让我付出代价，让 Laicaille 付出代价。但只要能看他输一次，就值得。"

entries.en:
You ask around about the missing academician, buying moderately priced drinks to lubricate the flow of information. This is a spacer bar, and though spacers try to look out for one another you're finding little in the way of leads, mostly just shrugs and apologies.

One graying space dog accepts your drink and says, "Academician eh? If you're digging into the trouble that went down in Galatia not-too-long ago, I suggest you make well clear. Heggie boots came down hard and fast. Noodling with the jump-points is one thing, but what I hear is there was some business with one of them AIs behind it. Masterminding, like."
entries.zh:
你四处打听那位失踪院士的事，不断为别人买着价格适中的饮料，试图从他们的嘴里套出一些情报。这酒吧的客人大都是些太空佬，但尽管太空佬们总是尽量互帮互助，你仍是一无所获。大多数人能提供的仅仅是他们的耸肩和致歉。

一位苍老的太空船员接过了你的饮料："院士？如果你是在挖 Galatia 不久前发生的那些麻烦事，你不妨把话直接挑明了讲。当时霸主佬下手又快又狠。且不说对跳跃点做手脚这回事，我听说这事的背后还有个什么 AI，在幕后操纵着一切。"

o.en: Make your excuses and return to the bar
A secret AI masterminding an invasion of the core worlds?
o.zh: 一个不为人知的 AI 正在策划入侵核心星区？

entries.en:
The spacer winks, takes a deep drink, and speaks more quietly. "Aye, you see if they can close down the jump-points, all they gotta do is open the Gates right up and pow!"

A fist slams down on the table, rattling a couple empties.

"The invasion fleet! The one they've been settin' fer last two hun'erd cycles. See, it all adds up - them Ludd figure disappears, the exact moment them Gates go shut-down? You see what it means?"
entries.zh:
那个太空佬眨了眨眼，深深地喝了一口，然后用更小的音量开口了。"是啊，你看，如果他们有能力关闭跳跃点，他们现在需要做的就只是打开星门，砰！"

对方一拳砸在桌子上，弄得几个空瓶子晃来晃去。

"入侵舰队！他们已经为此准备了两百年。看，这都说得通了 —— 卢德本人在星门关闭的那一刻消失了，你知道这意味着什么吗？"

o.en: Make your excuses and return to the bar
Ludd and the AIs were working together?
o.zh: 卢德和 AI 搞在了一起？

entries.en:
The spacer takes another deep drink, continuing, "In-deed. Timings too perfect, ya'see? What, what with Ludd starting up the whole lot with them-all, preaching that we should throw our technologies away. Don't you see?"

The spacer looks around a little unsteadily, then lowers their head to speak almost in a whisper.

"They was preparing us. For the invasion. We shut down them factories and ships and weapons and factories," a finger spins, showing you the whole terrible cycle of betrayal. "Ya'see? Because you- if you look close, they say Ludd was never caught on holovid, but I seen things. Ludd was one of 'em. A cyborg-AI-robot whats'it. And there're others. Left behind to be leading us astray. You know whaddit means?"
entries.zh:
那个太空佬又喝了一大口酒，接着说："正是如此，时机太完美了，明白吗？卢德和他们一起开始了这一切，鼓吹我们应该抛弃我们的科技。你明白了吗？"

这时太空佬有些不安地环顾四周，然后低下头，说话的声音已经几乎是耳语了。

"他们在为入侵我们做准备。我们关停了他们的工厂，舰船，武器，然后又到工厂。" 对方伸出根手指画着圈，向你展示着这个可怕的循环，"你明白了？因为你 —— 如果你仔细思考，那种 '卢德从未被全息影像捕捉到' 的说法，至少我是明白了一些东西。卢德就是一个人工智能，是那群人工智能之一。它们让我们误入歧途。你知道这意味着什么吗？"

o.en: Make your excuses and return to the bar

o.zh: 我们的领导其实都是机器人？

entries.en: The spacer takes another swig, emptying the glass, then looks to you expectantly.
entries.zh: 太空船员又喝了一大口，喝光了杯子里的酒，然后带着期待的目光看着你。

o.en: Make your excuses and return to the bar
Order another round for the spacer
o.zh: 给这个太空佬再买上一轮酒

entries.en:
The bartender notices you and rolls their eyes, "Oh you're getting a real story I bet," then turns to the spacer. "You! I told you, no credits, no drink. I won't have you bumming around disturbing paying customers with more of your crazy stories. Out!"

The graying spacer gives you an apologetic smile, salutes, and slips unsteadily away.
entries.zh:
酒保注意到了你，翻了个白眼："噢，你听到的故事绝对是真的，我敢打包票。" 对方随后转向了那个太空佬，"你！我跟你说过，没钱了就别想再喝酒。我不会再让你的疯狂事迹来打扰到我尊敬的顾客。滚出去！"

白发苍苍的太空船员微微一笑表达他的歉意，敬了个礼，然后摇摇晃晃地溜走了。

entries.en:
You ask around about the missing academician, buying moderately priced drinks to lubricate the flow of information. This is a pirate bar, and despite their well-known enthusiasm for free booze, pirates are loathe to speak openly to anyone asking too many questions.

A shady character at the bar wearing an expensive but worn-looking coat accepts your drink. "They think you're the Sector's dumbest undercover cop, you know."

"But I know you're not," $gaFC_KBAheOrShe takes a long sip. "A cop, that is. I saw your $shipOrFleet come in, ran some queries. It's my business, you know."
entries.zh:
你四处打听失踪院士的事，不断为别人买着价格适中的饮料，试图从他们的嘴里套出一些情报。这是一个海盗酒吧，尽管他们对免费酒水的热情是出了名的，但海盗们不愿向问太多问题的人敞开心扉。

一个穿着昂贵但看着很破旧的外套的可疑人物接受了你的请客。"他们认为你是星域里最蠢的卧底探员。"

"但我知道你不是什么 —— " $gaFC_KBAheOrShe长啜了一口饮料。" —— 探员。我看到你的$shipOrFleet进来之后，做了一些调查。你得知道，这是我的工作。"

entries.en: "Knowing things. Selling that knowledge."
entries.zh: "搞懂事情，然后出售情报。"

o.en: Then I've come to the right person.

entries.en:
$gaFC_KBAHeOrShe smiles slyly, "Indeed you have."

"Problem is, I've sold that knowledge and my customer might take issue if I were to distribute it without respect for our, ah, understanding of the exclusive utility of that knowledge. My customer is very important around here, if you catch my meaning. Now, if you were to approach that customer directly to work something out, you might come away with something useful."
entries.zh:
$gaFC_KBAHeOrShe狡猾地笑了笑："没错。"

"问题是，我已经出售了这些情报，如果我不尊重我和我的客户对这些情报的...嗯...'独家效用' 的理解，而再次传播它，我的客户可能会提出异议。我的顾客在这里可是个重要人物 —— 你大概能明白我是什么意思。现在，如果你直接去找那位客户谈谈，你可能会得到一些有用的消息。"

o.en: I already talked to the boss of Kapteyn and got the information.
o.zh: 我已经和 Kapteyn 的头子谈过了，还拿到了一些情报。

o.en: Doesn't that cut you out of the loop? What about your profit?
o.zh: 那不是把你排除在外了吗？你自身的利益呢？

o.en: Thanks for the tip. Enjoy your drink.
o.zh: 感谢你的提示，请慢用吧。

entries.en: $gaFC_KBAHeOrShe gives an ironic salute, and says "Look me up, captain. I'll be around if you want to do business." $gaFC_KBAHeOrShe turns away and sips $gaFC_KBAhisOrHer drink.
entries.zh: $gaFC_KBAHeOrShe行了个颇具讽刺意味的礼，说："随时可以再来拜访我，舰长。想要再做点生意的话，记得我随时恭候。" $gaFC_KBAHeOrShe转过身去，继续啜饮着$gaFC_KBAhisOrHer的饮料。

entries.en: "Well then captain! I am glad to have been of service."
entries.zh: "那么好吧，舰长！很高兴能帮到你。"

o.en: I still need more on Coureuse. Can you help?
o.zh: 我还是需要一些帮助来找到 Coureuse，你能帮忙吗？

entries.en:
$gaFC_KBAHeOrShe sighs. "Maybe. Look, this is a business. It's ... I'll need something more if I'm going to tell you this. $gaFC_kapteynBarBribeCost credits."

$gaFC_KBAHeOrShe taps at $gaFC_KBAhisOrHer datapad and holds it out for you to confirm the transaction with your own.
entries.zh:
$gaFC_KBAHeOrShe叹了一口气。"也许吧。听着，这是一笔交易，这是...如果你想从我这得到更多情报，那就给我更多报酬，$gaFC_kapteynBarBribeCost 星币。"

$gaFC_KBAHeOrShe点击了一下$gaFC_KBAhisOrHer的数据平板，并将它转向你，让你确认汇款细节。

o.en: I'll figure it out myself. Enjoy your drink.
o.zh: 我会自己搞定这事的，请慢用吧。

entries.en:
$gaFC_KBAHeOrShe shrugs. "It's long-term planning, y'see. If you show up asking questions, it confirms that my customer made a wise purchase. Comes up they need to find something out, they come back to me."

"Long-term planning, my friend. That's the difference between these deadbeat pirate lackeys and myself. I'm going to big places."
entries.zh:
$gaFC_KBAHeOrShe耸了耸肩。"听好了，这是个长期工作。现在你来问我问题了，这就说明我的客户当初的选择是正确的。等到他们还需要其他情报的时候，他们会很愿意做回头客的。"

"我规划得很长远，朋友。这就是这些游手好闲的海盗跟班和我的区别，我可是个要去更美好的地方生活的人。"

entries.en:
You ask around about the missing academician, buying moderately priced drinks to lubricate the flow of information. This is a spacer bar, and though spacers try to look out for one another, you're finding little in the way of leads, mostly shrugs and apologies.

"I'm sorry you're having trouble finding your friend," says an off-shift dockworker in a utilitarian vacsuit liner. "I shall pray for your reunion."
entries.zh:
你四处打听那位失踪院士的事，不断为别人买着价格适中的饮料，试图从他们的嘴里套出一些情报。这酒吧的客人大都是些太空佬，但尽管太空佬们总是尽量互帮互助，你仍是一无所获。大多数人能提供的仅仅是他们的耸肩和致歉。

"对你没能找到你朋友这事，我感到很抱歉。" 一个穿着工服的港口工人说，"我祈祷你们能够重逢。"

entries.en:
The station technicians, in grungy Laicaille Habitat jumpsuits, respond well to your offer to buy them a round and listen to their troubles. You mention having had comms disruption in an ion storm once and ask what sort of trouble they're having.

"It's strange," says the big one, "There's no real pattern to it. Every few shifts, it just goes zap. Lots of noise gumming up some of the orbital beacons. Bossman makes us go out and check the beacon, and it's nothing. Lotta fooling around for no reason, I say."

"Not no ion storm either, we'd know that," says the smaller partner. "Ain't no natural wossit."
entries.zh:
当你提出可以为他们买一杯饮料并愿意倾听他们的烦恼时，穿着破旧的 Laicaille 栖息地连身裤的太空站技术人员给出了不错的回应。你以自己有一次在离子风暴中遇到了通信困难为引子，问他们遇到了什么样的麻烦。

"倒是有件怪事，" 一个大个子说，"不过没什么规律。每过几次轮班，一些轨道信标就会失灵，发出大量噪音。上头让我们去检查信标，结果什么都没查出来。让我说，大概是有什么人发神经了，无缘无故地在那里整我们。"

"那绝对不是离子风暴导致的，我们敢肯定，" 身材比较矮小的那个人说。"这不是自然现象。"

o.en: What do you think it is?

entries.en:
"Ghosties," says the big one, eyes wide.

The smaller one sighs and mumbles under their breath "...Ludd's sake..."

The big one looks annoyed, "No, let me tell it. I told you I wouldn't run your ear about it anymore, but the captain here asked nicely."
entries.zh:
"鬼魂。" 大个子把眼睛瞪的老大。

小个子叹了口气，低声嘟囔起来："...卢德在上..."

大个子看起来恼火了："不，让我说出来吧。我的确说过我不会再提这事了，但现在这位舰长可是在很有礼貌地请求着。"

o.en: I don't need any ghost stories. Enjoy your drinks. (leave)
o.zh: 我不想听鬼故事，你们慢慢喝吧。 (离去)

entries.en:
"It's all them people that died in Groombridge when the reactor went critical," the big one says. "No, not went critical. Was made critical. 'Cause it was murder."

"They got no peace, see, 'cause it wasn't a clean death and there's no justice. So they're calling out for someone to help. That's what it is, a signal from Groombridge."

The small one speaks up quietly, "...can't know that."
entries.zh:
"当反应堆失控进入临界状态时，Groombridge 上的所有人都命丧黄泉了，" 大个子说，"不，不是失控进入临界状态的，那是人为导致的，一场谋杀。"

"他们不得安息，因为那不是意外，而充满了邪恶的阴谋，所以他们在呼救。那就是 Groombridge 上信号的本质。"

小的那个轻声说："...怎么可能知道。"

o.en: How do you know the interference is coming from Groombridge?
o.zh: 你怎么知道干扰来自 Groombridge？

entries.en:
"Directional receiver." The big one looks proud.

"Yeah, but," the small one interjects, "I gotta remind you to reset the alignment origin on that thing half the time when we're out checking beacons. The noise could be from anywhere, could be anything. Some pulsar or something."
entries.zh:
"定向接收器。" 大个子看起来很自豪。

"对，但是，" 小个子打断道，"我得提醒你，那东西老是会发生偏离，每当我们过去检查信标的时候，有一半的时间得花在重置那个东西的校准原点上。干扰可能来自任何地方，干扰源也可能是任何东西，脉冲星之类。"

o.en: I thought you said it wasn't a natural source.
o.zh: 我记得你们说过干扰源不会是天然的东西。

entries.en:
"Well, no," the small one sputters, "I'm just saying as an example. Anyway," they check their datapad, "We gotta get back on-shift. Bottoms-up!"

The techs finish their drinks, give you their regards, and head out. You don't find their mixture of work and intemperance particularly reassuring, but maybe there is something weird going on at Groombridge Habitat. If someone really is sending secret encrypted signals...
entries.zh:
"呃，确实，" 小个子结结巴巴地说，"我只是随便举个例子而已。" 说到这，他们看了一眼他们的数据平板，"不论如何，我们得回去上班了，干杯！"

技术人员喝完酒，向你道别后就出发了。他们在工作期间酗酒的行为固然让人放不下心，但 Groombridge 栖息地发生的怪事如今更值得在意一些。如果有人真的在发送加密讯息...

o.en: Wait, are you some kind of Pather?
o.zh: 等等，你是什么左径分子吗？

entries.en:
The dockworker's expression shuts down instantly. "I am not a 'Pather', $playerSirOrMadam. I do follow the teachings of the Church of Galactic Redemption and I'd thank you not to make bigoted assumptions. We are not all fanatics and terrorists."

They stand, leaving an untouched drink. "Blessings of Ludd be upon all souls, both large and small," they say, and stomp away.
entries.zh:
港口工人的表情僵住了。"我可不是 '左径分子'，$playerSirOrMadam。我确实聆听着 银河救赎教会 的教诲，我得请求你不要做出偏执的假设。我们并非都是狂热人士和恐怖分子。"

他站了起来，留下一杯没碰过的饮料。"卢德祝福着每一个灵魂，无论其伟大或渺小。" 留下这么一句话后，对方跺着重步离开了。

o.en: Tell Baird that Coureuse is in the Isirah system
o.zh: 告诉 Baird，Coureuse 现在在 Isirah 星系。

o.en: Tell Baird you want to change your approach to the Coureuse mission
o.zh: 告诉 Baird 你想改变寻找 Coureuse 的方法

o.en: Tell Baird you want to change your approach to the Coureuse mission
o.zh: 告诉 Baird 你想改变寻找 Coureuse 的方法

entries.en: "Oh?" Baird's tone is neutral, behind it you can only feel the weight of an unresolved quantum state of judgment. "If you're sure you want to change your approach, make sure that this is your final decision, captain."
entries.zh: "哦？" 你从 Baird 的语气中听不出她的态度，就好像她的决断正处于无法确定的量子叠加态一般，"如果你想改变处理这事的方法，请确定这是你的最终决定，舰长。"

o.en: I'd like to take the diplomatic path.
o.zh: 我想用外交对话的方法来处理这事。

entries.en:
"Very well," she says, "Diplomacy it is. I shall ensure that you have the data you need to carry out your revised mission."

Provost Baird turns back to her desk display, reading something. "May I assume that is all, captain?"
entries.zh:
"很好，" 她说，"那就外交对话吧。我会确保你能得到执行调整后的任务所需的资料。"

Baird 把目光投向了她桌上的显示屏，读着什么东西。"舰长，我猜你没别的事了吧？"

entries.en: "Oh?" Baird's tone is neutral, behind it you can only feel the weight of an unresolved quantum state of judgment. "If you want to change your approach, make sure that this is your final decision, captain."
entries.zh: "哦？" 你从 Baird 的语气中听不出她的态度，就好像她的决断正处于无法确定的量子叠加态一般，"如果你想改变你处理这事的方法，确保这是你的最终决定，舰长。"

o.en: I'd like to take the exploration path.
o.zh: 我想用探索的方法来处理这事。

entries.en:
"Very well," she says, "Exploration it is. I shall ensure that you have the data you need to carry out your revised mission."

Provost Baird turns back to her desk display, reading something. "May I assume that is all, captain?"
entries.zh:
"很好，" 她说，"那就探索吧。我会确保你能得到执行调整后的任务所需的资料。"

Baird 把目光投向了她桌上的显示屏，读着什么东西。"舰长，我猜你没别的事了吧？"

o.zh: 是 Finlay Siyavong 探员，对吧？

o.en: This is the voice of Special Agent Finlay Siyavong, is it not?
o.zh: 这声音，是 Finlay Siyavong 特别探员吧？

o.en: You don't sound like Cavin Pharoh.
o.zh: 你听起来不像是 Cavin Pharoh。

entries.en:
You stand for a moment taking in the bewildering signage of the Kay-arco transport matrix before you shrug and allow your TriPad to select the best route to the home of Adonya Coureuse.

Cyclopean arcology substructure flashes by as you ride the primary ring tube to a far segment of the metroplex; a small passenger lift fills with the smell of sweat and machine oil of a shift of undersea laborers returning home; glimpses of the towering arms of Kay-arco flash by, glittering with thousands of windows.
entries.zh:
你驻足了欣赏了一会儿 Kay 生态圈交通网络上那些眼花缭乱的标识。随后耸了耸肩，还是决定让 TriPad 规划好去 Adonya Coureuse 住所的最佳路线。

你搭乘环道快车前往大都会的远郊，巨大的生态建筑基座在你身旁闪过，海底作业的工人们这时正搭乘着小型载客电梯回家，电梯中充斥着他们身上的汗味和机油味。Kay 生态圈高塔的一部分从你眼前晃过，千百扇窗户在阳光的照耀下闪闪发光。

entries.en:
You find yourself guided through the heart of a residential stack, through a quiet plaza filled with retirees and well-tended foliage, then before you is the door of Adonya Coureuse.

You press the door chime, and barely get out your excuse for the visit before being invited in.

Adonya is more than pleased to have a visitor and, despite your protests, has a cup of tea cooling in your hand before you quite know what's happening.
entries.zh:
跟随着引导，你经过了住宅区的中心地带，又穿过一个精心修葺过、满是退休老人的僻静广场，最后抵达了 Adonya Coureuse 的家门前。

你按下了门铃，还没来得及说出来访的理由，就被邀请进去了。

Adonya 对于有客来访显得非常愉快。你还没搞清楚状况就在盛情难却之下被敬上了一杯热茶。

entries.en:
You have only to bring up her daughter to get Adonya talking. "The girl is too clever for her own good. Just like her father." Adonya shakes her head at an old memory, but speaks of Scylla with pride. "The man who visited last time said that was all the questions they had, didn't they find anything? ... But look at you!" She admires your uniform, "Are you also from Fleet?"

You manage to avoid answering that question; Adonya has a holo-feed of the King of Westernesse holding court set to half-volume and switches effortlessly between commenting on the proceedings and questioning you about personal matters: you hedge on your precise age, admit to operating a space $shipOrFleet, and leave your marital status vague. She doesn't seem to mind your non-answers.

Finally you get the chance to ask a question of your own.
entries.zh:
你刚提到她的女儿，Adonya 就开始滔滔不绝起来。"这女孩太聪明了，但聪明反被聪明误。就和她父亲一样。" Adonya 在回忆往事时摇了摇头，但谈起 Scylla 她还是一脸骄傲。"上次来的人说他们该问的都问完了，难道他们还什么都没搞明白吗？可是看看你！" 她赞赏地看着你的制服，"你也是舰队的人吧？"

你设法回避了这个问题；Adonya 将 Westernesse 国王主持御前会议的全息直播音量调低了些，游刃有余地一边对会议中事项评头论足，一边询问你的私人问题：你对你的实际年龄避而不谈，也隐瞒了自己的婚姻状况，只是承认自己确实在指挥着太空$shipOrFleet。她似乎并不介意这些模棱两可的回答。

你终于找到了一个合适的机会，提出了自己的问题。

o.en: Who was it that was asking about Scylla before me?
o.zh: 在我之前打听 Scylla 消息的是谁？

o.en: Do you know where I can find Scylla?
o.zh: 你知道 Scylla 在哪吗？

o.en: Just make sure you're seen by any observers
o.zh: 确保周围有目击者看到你

entries.en:
Adonya continues watching some scandal involving the King of Westernesse. "That man from League Fleet- or was it MuniSec? Oh, you people can never get your records straight. It's that new king- so impressive at first, but if you only play to locals, the bigwigs on Kazeron will take you by the so-and-so, that's what I say. Give this scandal another week and everyone will say 'Adonya, you were right about everything.'

"Anyway, what was his name, Finlay something? He left a comms chip in case I had more questions. And I called, but it was an automated response, can you believe that? So I threw it away. Let him apologize in person." She smiles, "I like you much better."

You nod agreeably. An agent named Finlay. Probably working for the Persean League's intelligence service. Interesting.
entries.zh:
Adonya 继续看着与 Westernesse 国王相关丑闻的报道。"那是个联盟舰队...还是地方安全部来的人？你们这些人就没把自己的档案搞得有条理过。那就是新国王吗...一开始让人印象深刻，但如果你只取悦当地人的话，Kazeron 的大人物总能找到点把柄把你弄走，这就是我的看法。再让这丑闻发酵一个星期，大家都会说 'Adonya 您说得真对。'

"对了，他叫什么名字来着...Finlay 什么的？他留下了一个通讯芯片，以防我有其他问题。我有打过去，但居然只有自动留言回复，这你敢信？所以我把它扔了。让他亲自道歉吧。" 她微笑着说，"我更喜欢你一些。"

你愉快地点了点头。一个叫 Finlay 的探员，可能为 英仙座联盟 的情报机构工作，有意思。

entries.en:
You wait for a lull in the noise and ask your question a little louder than intended. Adonya gives you a corrective look before turning back to her holovid. The King of Westernesse is haranguing a panel of aquanomists.

"It's political, isn't it?" Adonya says after a moment. "Scylla finally found real trouble. I always told her that Cavin boy was bad news, but she'd say it was 'just art stuff'. I may be her mother, but I'm not stupid." She gestures intensely at the holovid, a splash of tea exiting her cup, "That's a capering twit if ever there was one, but at least no one is dying in some fool street fight."

She sighs, "If only Scylla had settled down with Elissa. You can be content making a ripple instead of a splash. I told her father that once, and he had the sense to listen."
entries.zh:
你趁着噪音稍微平息的片刻提出了你的问题，但没控制好音量。Adonya 用眼神示意你安静一些，把目光转回了全息影像。Westernesse 的国王正在对一众水生生物学家们高谈阔论。

"政治问题，不是吗？" 过了好一会儿，Adonya 才开口说到。"Scylla 终于惹上了大麻烦。我不止一次和她说过那个叫 Cavin 小伙儿是个灾星，但她说那 '只是在搞艺术'。我是有些婆婆妈妈，但我不笨。" 她对着全息影像比了个粗，还从杯里溅了些茶出来，"如果那小子还在的话，也只是个到处瞎胡闹的蠢货，但至少还没死于什么愚蠢的街头打斗。"

她叹了口气，"要是 Scylla 能和 Elissa 一起安顿下来就好了。一直这么小打小闹就好，别搞什么大风浪。之前我就和她爸说过一次，他也很明智地听了我的建议。"

entries.en:
"Ah," Adonya looks rather pleased now, "You fancy spies with your titles and gadgets didn't figure her out?" She laughs, "And now you've got to ask an old woman for help? Oh don't worry," she says, setting her tea down, "I'll tell you, captain."

"Elissa Zal. Such a nice girl. Could have been the best thing that ever happened to Scylla. But," she shakes her head, "an offer from the Galatia Academy came first. Full scholarship from the office of the Provost. Sikar was thrilled; his little scientist got the chance he never had."

She trails off, with a sad look.
entries.zh:
"啊，你们这些有一堆酷炫称号和厉害玩意儿的大间谍们，居然还没搞清那是谁？" Adonya 乐了，她揶揄着放下了茶，"现在你还得找个老太太帮忙？放心吧舰长，我都会告诉你的。"

"Elissa Zal，真是个好姑娘。她本来会是 Scylla 一辈子的朋友。但，" 她摇了摇头，" Galatia 学院先发来了录取通知。由院长提供全额奖学金。Sikar 当时激动得要命，他家的小科学家得到了他从未有过的机会。"

她的话音渐低，点点悲伤溢于言表。

o.en: Do you have a comms ID for Elissa Zal?
o.zh: 你有 Elissa Zal 的通讯 ID 吗？

entries.en:
"Oh, let me think," Adonya says. "No... no, it's been so many years." She gives you a sly smile, "But we could ask."

"TriHome," she says loudly. An expectant chime sounds from the holo-vid entertainment system as the King of Westernesse is muted. "Comms id for Elissa Zal, please.

"Searching," says TriHome, then a pause. "No Elissa Zal found in local system."

Adonya looks disappointed, and mutters "Stupid thing." She looks at you again, "Do you need more tea, dear?"

It feels about like the time you should leave, though you surreptitiously add the name "Elissa Zal" to your list of persons-of-interest.
entries.zh:
"哦，得让我想想，" Adonya 说。"不...我记不起来了，已经过去多少年了都。"她对着你狡黠地笑了笑，"但我们可以问问。"

"速子管家！" 随着她的大声呼唤，全息视频娱乐系统就把 Westernesse 国王给静音了，发出了等待输入的提示声。"请给我 Elissa Zal 的通讯 ID。"

"正在搜索..." 速子管家说，然后停顿了片刻，"本星系中未找到 Elissa Zal。"

Adonya 看起来很失望，喃喃着 "蠢东西"。她又看了看你，"亲爱的，你还要喝茶吗？"

看起来是时候该走了，你悄悄地把 "Elissa Zal" 这个名字加到了值得留意的人的名单上。

entries.en:
You interrupt Adonya's critique of one of the King's 'water-brained' advisors to compliment the view from the balcony. Adonya takes the bait and invites you to have your tea outdoors. The holovid's volume is reduced to a muttered cacophony as you step into the high sea air.

Banks of windows and balconies flow across the facing towers. Drones buzz in ordered lines, diverting to deliver packages or attend to cleaning. Adonya explains the generous terms of her lease compared to those offered by other towers and asks if you've considered retiring to Fikenhild. You smile and nod, turning this way and that for the thousands of cameras that are probably capturing your image. If anyone is watching, they will know you were here.
entries.zh:
在 Adonya 批评国王的一个 "脑袋进水" 的顾问时，你插嘴称赞了一句阳台外的景色 。Adonya 心领神会，邀你一起到外面喝茶。阳台上你们两人与海风对饮，全息视频的声音也变得模糊不清。

面前是屹立的高塔，成排的窗户和阳台错落其间。无人机井然有序地四下纷飞，忙着递送包裹或保持清洁。Adonya 谈到比起其它塔楼的租约，她这一栋楼的租约条款要慷慨的多，还问你是否考虑过退休后来 Fikenhild。你微笑着点头，接着转头向四处眺望，以便在成百上千个摄像头中尽可能地留下自己的影像。如果真有人在监视，他们肯定会知道你来过这里。

entries.en:
Having completed what you came here for, you make your apologies to Adonya Coureuse as you move to leave, assuring her that you will find Scylla and see that she is safe. And yes, you will absolutely comms if any new information comes up.

The door softly closes behind you, leaving your ears free of the holovid's incessant murmur - and the endless probing questions from Adonya. Reaching for your datapad, you discover that you're still holding a cup of cold tea. You carefully set it in front of the door before leaving.
entries.zh:
完成了你来这里的目的后，你在起身离开的时候向 Adonya Coureuse 赔了个不是，向她保证你会找到 Scylla 并确保她的安全。并且如果有任何新的线索，你绝对会告诉她。

门在你身后缓缓地关上了，耳朵里也没了全息影像没完没了的杂音和 Adonya 喋喋不休的追问。当伸手去拿数据平板时，你发现手里还拿着一杯放凉了的茶。离开之前，你小心翼翼地把它放到了门前。

entries.en:
You take a transport line outbound to the Kay-arco exurbs, a sprawling network of floating municipalities jostling in the sea at the base of the mighty half-submerged arcology. The monorail track gleams in the sun, a straight line toward the horizon like a hardpoint-mounted particle lance shot through a nebula.

The train breaks through a cloudbank, and you feel the subtle pull of deceleration fighting with the agrav field effect as you approach your target: a modular suburban conglomeration. You glance at your TriPad to recall the name of the place, 'Seabank Oasis'.
entries.zh:
你搭上了开往 Kay 生态圈远郊的交通线路。这生态圈是一座巨大的海上半潜生态设施，绵延不绝的浮动都市组成了庞大市郊网络，在它脚下的海中颠簸着。电车的单轨在阳光下闪耀着向地平线延伸出去，如同挂载点上的粒子长矛笔直地射穿了星云。

在冲破一片云堤之后，电车的减速度战胜了人工引力场的效果，让你感受到了一丝微妙拉扯感，提示你到达了目的地：一个模块化的市郊小区。你瞥了一眼 TriPad，想起了这个地方的名字，'海滨绿洲'。

entries.en:
You buzz at the doorway to one of the outer compounds, the green hint of lawn showing through the translucent vitreous strip at the top of the wall. After a short delay, a commsplate activates and a tired-looking woman appears in holo. You ask if you are speaking with Bione Lata, and would she mind answering some questions about Scylla Coureuse.

She looks behind her, then lowers her voice to reply. "Yes. Didn't someone already come by to ask about her? I haven't seen Scylla in years, like I said. Look, I don't have much time for this."
entries.zh:
在靠外围的一户院子的门口，你按响了门铃。透过墙顶半透明的玻璃带，院子里草坪上的绿意显露了出来。在短暂的等待之后，通讯板启动，在全息图像中显示出了一个看起来有些疲惫的女人。你询问她是否是 Bione Lata，以及她是否介意回答一些关于 Scylla Coureuse 的问题。

她看了看身后，然后压低声音回答。"是的，不是已经有人来问过她了吗？就像我说过的那样，我已经很多年没有见过 Scylla 了。听着，我不想再花很多时间回答这种问题。"

entries.en:
"Okay. Like I said, I don't know what she got mixed up with. When I knew Sy, she... worked hard. Good grades. No, great grades. Unless she thought the teacher was wrong, and then," Bione smiles now, "She wouldn't stand down."

"And I don't know, she was pretty serious with Elissa - um, Elissa Zal, like I told the other agent. Something happened, I don't know what. She hung out in the lower city more, with that Cavin guy. Got into all kinds of trouble. Then-" You hear the thin wail of an infant from both the commsplate and over the compound wall. "I really have to go now- goodbye agent... whatever your name is."
entries.zh:
"好吧。就像我说的，我不知道她现在到底掺和了什么事。我认识 Scylla 的时候，她...工作很努力，成绩很好，准确说，在她认为老师没错的情况下，她的成绩都很好。还有..." Bione 现在笑了，"她绝不会让步。"

"而且我不知道，她对 Elissa —— 嗯，Elissa Zal 相当认真。就像我告诉另一位调查员的那样，她发生了一些事情，但我不知道具体情况。她更多地在下城区闲逛，和那个叫 Cavin 的家伙在一起，卷进各种麻烦，然后..." 你听到从通讯板和院墙那边传来的婴儿的细微哭声，"我真的得走了 —— 再见，调查员...不管你叫什么名字。"

entries.en:
"Oh, um, that was a couple weeks ago. Finlay?" She thinks for a moment.

"Oh, you mean Agent Siyavong with Fleet intelligence. Finlay was his first name. You must be from Munisec, right?"
entries.zh:
"哦，嗯，那是几个星期前。Finlay？" 她思索了片刻。

哦，你是说舰队情报部的 Siyavong 探员吧，Finlay 是他的名。你一定是来自地方安全部吧？"

o.en: Make a noncommittal motion, possibly a nod

entries.en:
"That makes sense, League departments never coordinate with domestic services, do they. Well, it's not my fault you people never talk to each other. Agent Siyavong left a commskey."

"Here," she taps at something, and an id glyph appears. As you use your TriPad to pull the contact info, you hear the thin wail of an infant from both the commsplate and over the compound wall. "I really have to go now- goodbye agent, um, didn't catch your name- sorry!"

The commsplate clicks off, replacing Bione's face with the dancing Seabank Oasis mascot. You glance at the new comms contact on your TriPad, one Finlay Siyavong.
entries.zh:
"这很合理，联盟部门从不与星球当地部门协调，这你也知道。你们这些人从不互相交流可不是我的错。Siyavong 探员留下了一张通讯卡。"

"给，" 她按了几个键，出现了一个 ID 字样。当你用 TriPad 调出联系信息时，你听到从通讯面板和院墙那边传来的婴儿的细微哭声。"我真的要走了 —— 再见，调查员，嗯，没听清你的名字 —— 抱歉！"

通讯面板跳转，跳舞的海口绿洲吉祥物取代了 Bione 的脸。你瞥了一眼你 TriPad 上的新通讯联络人，这个叫 Finlay Siyavong 的人。

entries.en:
"Oh, um, that was a couple weeks ago. He was very nice, well dressed." She smiles, then tries to hide it. "Agent Finlay... Finlay Siyavong. He was with Fleet Intelligence. You're from Fleet too, right?"

You make a noncommittal motion that could be interpreted quite broadly.

"He asked a lot of questions. Can't you just ask him? I really am right in the middle of- " You hear the thin wail of an infant from both the commsplate and over the compound wall. "I have to go now. Sorry agent. Goodbye."

The commsplate shuts off, replacing Bione's face with the dancing Seabank Oasis mascot. An agent Finlay Siyavong. Probably working for the Persean League's intelligence service. Interesting.
entries.zh:
"哦，嗯，那是几个星期前。他人很好，穿得很好。Finlay 探员... Finlay Siyavong，他是舰队情报部的人。你也是吧？"

你做了一个不置可否的动作，点了一下头。

"嗯，他问了很多问题。你就不能和他直接谈谈吗？我真的有急事..." 你从通讯板和院墙那边都听到了婴儿的细微哭声，"我现在得走了。抱歉，探员，再见。"

通讯板跳转，跳舞的海银绿洲吉祥物取代了 Bione 的脸。探员 Finlay Siyavong，应该是在 英仙座联盟 的情报部门工作。有意思。

entries.en:
You take a step back and speak with your loud, carrying 'commander voice': first you assure Bione that you're simply following up on 'the agency's' previous visit, and that she is speaking to $playerName, by the way. You carefully enunciate your name so that there's no confusion about how to input it into a search query, whether by voice or text.

Pacing in front of the commsplate, you mention Scylla Coureuse again, but speak mostly about yourself and the patriotic importance of being forthright with officials. A neighbor pokes their head out a window from the next unit over with an upset look at the noise, but retreats as soon as you make eye contact.

You have such a show going that it takes a moment for you to realize that Bione's voice coming through the tinny commsplate is trying to get your attention.
entries.zh:
你退后一步，用你响亮而富有感染力的 '负责人腔调' 开了口：首先你向 Bione 表明你只是在跟进上一次特工的访问，然后强调她是在跟 $playerName 说话。你仔细地念出你的名字，保证在查询时不会打错字，无论是通过语音还是文字。

在通讯板前踱步，你再次提到 Scylla Coureuse，但主要是谈论的是你自己，以及配合官员的工作有多么重要。一位隔壁邻居从窗户里探出头来，对你的噪音感到不快，但在你的目光接触下就缩了回去。

你太入戏了，以至于你花了点时间才意识到，Bione 的声音通过小小的通讯板传来，想引起你的注意。

entries.en:
"Hello! Um, $playerFirstName was it? Can you keep it down? My-" You hear the thin wail of an infant from both the commsplate and over the compound wall.

Bione's look hardens; you've done it this time. "...I really have to go. Good bye."

The commsplate shuts off, replacing Bione's face with the dancing Seabank Oasis mascot. It reminds you to keep your voice down while visiting the exurb community, and won't you have a nice day.

You nod, and turn around just in time to catch a different neighbor watching you with a look of consternation, datapad ready to call in a complaint.
entries.zh:
"你好！嗯，$playerFirstName 是吗？你能小点声吗？我的..." 你听到从通讯板和院墙那边传来的婴儿的细微哭声。

Bione 的神情变得强硬，你这次真搞砸了点什么。"...我真的得走了。再见。"

通讯面板跳转了，跳着舞的 '海滨绿洲' 吉祥物取代了 Bione 的脸。它提醒你在访问郊区社区时不要太过吵闹，否则今天过的会不那么愉快。

你点头，转过身去，正好看到另一个邻居用惊愕的眼神看着你，手中拿着数据平板准备打电话投诉。

entries.en: You turn back toward the monorail line, subvocalizing an update to your mission notes. A fog bank rolls in, dimming the bright sun.
entries.zh: 你转身向单轨线走去，对你的任务笔记进行了更新。一片雾气滚滚而来，使明亮的阳光变得暗淡。

o.en: Go back to the transport hub

entries.en:
"I don't have any associates by that name." $HeOrShe sounds irritated.

"I'm answering your call because facilitating interstellar trade with independent operators is within my purview. If you're simply looking for a comms ID, I suggest you query a public search terminal."

"Now. Do you have any real business to discuss?"
entries.zh:
"我没有任何同事叫这个名字。" $HeOrShe听起来很恼火。

"我接听你的电话是因为与个体商户进行星际贸易属于我的职权范围。如果你只是想找通讯 ID，我建议你去查询公共搜索终端。"

"现在，你有什么真正的业务要谈吗？"

entries.en:
"Coureuse?" $HeOrShe gives you a skeptical look. "I believe you discussed this individual with our station commander already."

"The prime navarch's resolution has my full support, captain. We'll have to leave the matter at that."
entries.zh:
"Coureuse？" $HeOrShe向你投来怀疑的目光，"我想你已经和我们站长讨论过这个人了。"

"我对海军大都统的决议表示完全支持，舰长。这件事就到此为止吧。"

o.en: I'm looking for someone by the name of Scylla Coureuse.
o.zh: 我在找一位名叫 Scylla Coureuse 的人。

o.en: I'm looking for someone by the name of Scylla Coureuse.
o.zh: 我在找一个名叫 Scylla Coureuse 的人。

entries.en:
"Is that a ship?" $HeOrShe looks aside and taps at a control surface. "I don't see an registration for a 'Scylla Coureuse', though sometimes the interfactional databases take some time to update..."

More tapping.
entries.zh:
"那是艘船吗？" $heOrShe侧目望去，一边敲击着控制台，"我没有查到 'Scylla Coureuse' 的注册记录，不过跨势力数据库的更新有时会滞后..."

接着是更多的敲击声。

o.en: Coureuse is a person. An academician of the Galatia Academy. Or she was.
o.zh: Coureuse 是个人，是 Galatia 学院的一位院士。或者说，曾经是。

entries.en:
"Oh." $HeOrShe turns back to face you.

"$SirOrMadam, I'm a portmaster. That's a bit out of my purview unless you bear a warrant from munisec. Or maybe the King. But it doesn't matter because I've never heard of... what'd you say the name was? Core something?"
entries.zh:
"噢。" $heOrShe转回身面对着你。

"$SirOrMadam ，我只是个港务长。这有点超出我的职权范围，除非你持有地方安全部的授权令，或者国王手谕。不过这不重要，反正我从没听说过...你刚才说叫什么名字？Core 什么来着？"

o.en: Coureuse. But never mind, thank you.

entries.en: "Glad I could help," $heOrShe says without a trace of sarcasm.
entries.zh: "很高兴能帮上忙，" $heOrShe说道，语气中并没有任何讽刺意味。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe shrugs.

"Anything else?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe耸了耸肩。

"还有别的事吗？"

o.en: I'm looking for someone by the name of Scylla Coureuse.
o.zh: 我在找一位名叫 Scylla Coureuse 的人。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe blinks, then turns back to reading something.

After a moment $heOrShe glances at you.

"Did you have a question?"
entries.zh:
$heOrShe眨了眨眼，而后继续阅读资料。

片刻过后，$heOrShe瞥向你。

"你有什么问题吗？"

o.en: ... Have you seen the name Coureuse? Or heard of her?
o.zh: ...你见过 Coureuse 这个名字吗？或者听说过她？

entries.en:
"Much better." $HeOrShe puts down a TriPad and gives you $hisOrHer full attention. "If you want to ask a question, ask the question. Don't make me feel like I'm doing you a favor, stars above."

A pause.

"No. And No."
entries.zh:
"这样好多了。" $heOrShe放下了 TriPad，将注意力完全转到你身上，"要问问题就直接问。别让我觉得是在施舍你，群星在上。"

$heOrShe顿了顿。

"没见过。也没听说过。"

o.zh: 多谢，您真是帮大忙了。 (讽刺)

entries.en: $HeOrShe shrugs and picks the TriPad back up.
entries.zh: $heOrShe耸耸肩，重新拿起了 TriPad。

entries.en: $HeOrShe shrugs and picks the TriPad back up without acknowledging your tone.
entries.zh: $heOrShe耸耸肩，无视你的语气并重新拿起了 TriPad。

entries.en:
"Right. I don't know who that is." $HeOrShe sounds annoyed. "I'm not a comm directory."

"I am here to coordinate Persean League civil and military assets to ensure the safety and security of Fikenhild and the local system. If you have business to discuss relating to these matters, I would be delighted to assist you."

$HeOrShe doesn't sound particularly delighted, but your diplomatic intuition suggests it would be best not to point this out.
entries.zh:
"对，我不认识这个人。" $heOrShe听起来很不耐烦，"我不是通讯目录。"

"我的职责是协调 英仙座联盟 的民事与军事资源，确保 Fikenhild 及本地星系的安全稳定。如果你有相关事务需要讨论，我将很乐意协助你。"

$heOrShe听起来并不是特别乐意，但你的外交直觉告诉你最好别点破这点。

entries.en:
"Coureuse?" $HeOrShe gives you a skeptical look. "I believe you discussed this individual with the administration already."

"Their resolution has my full support, captain. We'll have to leave the matter at that."
entries.zh:
"Coureuse？" $HeOrShe向你投来怀疑的目光，"我想你已经和行政部门讨论过这个人了。"

"我对他们的决议表示完全支持，舰长。这件事就到此为止吧。"

o.en: I am a demarchon of the Persean League, $post, not some random 'operator'.
o.zh: 我可是 英仙座联盟 的统领之一，$post，而不是什么随随便便的 '商户'。

o.en: I am a demarchon of the Persean League and would appreciate some cooperation.
o.zh: 我是 英仙座联盟 的统领之一，希望你能配合一下。

entries.en:
"Fleet Intelligence has more leeway in these matters. Post-Mairaath reforms and all that. I'm not saying it should be done lightly, but..."

$HeOrShe looks at you. "Is it important?"
entries.zh:
"舰队情报部在这些事务上有更多的回旋余地，毕竟经历了后 Mairaath 改革。我并非主张草率行事，但..."

$heOrShe看向你，"这件事很重要吗？"

o.en: Not quite so important as that. Thank you.
o.zh: 倒也没那么重要，谢谢你。

entries.en:
"Alright." $personName nods, meeting your gaze.

"I appreciate your candor and judgement. Good luck with... whatever you're trying to sort out."
entries.zh:
"好吧。"  $personName点点头，一边迎上你的目光。

"感谢您的坦诚与判断力。祝您好运...无论您试图解决什么问题。"

entries.en:
"Alright." $personName nods slowly, meeting your gaze.

"I'll have a word with... a contact. Then it'll be in his hands. That's the best I can do, demarchon."
entries.zh:
"好吧。" $personName缓缓点头，一边迎上你的目光。

"我会和...一位联络人进行沟通。之后就由他处理了。这是我所能做到的极限了，统领大人。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe blinks, taken aback. "$PlayerSirOrMadam."

You hear the tap of keys and a quick glance aside.

"My apologies. I was... your admittance to the League is quite recent. My congratulations."

$HisOrHer voice doesn't quite have the warmth of enthusiasm $hisOrHer words would require to stand on their own.
entries.zh:
$heOrShe眨了眨眼，略显诧异。"$playerSirOrMadam。"

你听见键盘的敲击声，以及$heOrShe迅速瞥向一侧的眼神。

"我很抱歉。我刚刚...您加入联盟的时间还很短。恭喜您。"

$hisOrHer的声音缺乏应有的热情，难以支撑话语中的祝贺之意。

entries.en:
"As I'm sure you know, demarchon, there are certain procedures we have to follow. This is a League citizen on a League world? No outstanding warrant, no Fleet orders, no Council authorization?"

"If the King had given an order, I'd know about it. So." $HeOrShe spreads $hisOrHer hands. "I want to help you, but my office cannot do so unless we follow correct procedure. I'm sorry."

The $post looks aside. "Unless..."
entries.zh:
"统领，想必你也知道，我们必须遵循特定程序。这是一位身处联盟星球的联盟公民？没有未决逮捕令，没有舰队指令，也没有议会授权？"

"如果是国王下达了命令，那我才理应知晓。所以，" $heOrShe摊开双手，"我很希望能协助你，但我的部门必须按正确程序行事。抱歉。"

$post看向一旁。"除非..."

o.en: I bear a commission of the Persean League, $post. I'm not some random 'operator'.
o.zh: 我持有 英仙座联盟 的雇佣协议，$post ，而不是什么随随便便的 '商户'。

o.en: I bear a commission of the Persean League. I believe that falls under 'military'.
o.zh: 我持有 英仙座联盟 的雇佣协议，我认为这属于 '军事' 的范畴。

o.en: I understand your position and won't trouble you further.
o.zh: 我理解你的立场，我就不再打扰了。

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods, and $hisOrHer expression settles into familiar bureaucratic impatience.
entries.zh: $heOrShe点点头，表情也恢复为熟悉的官僚式不耐烦。

entries.en:
"A joker, huh." $HeOrShe narrows $hisOrHer eyes. "You know that interfering with my duties is a civil offense? Lucky for you, you're not worth the bother of prosecution."

"In the meantime, here's a punchline."

The comms cut rather abruptly.
entries.zh:
"跳梁小丑，哈。" $heOrShe眯起$hisOrHer的眼睛，"你知道干扰我执行公务是民事罪行吗？这次算你走运，还不值得我费劲去起诉你。"

"眼下先给你个教训。"

通讯链接相当突兀地中断了。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe blinks. "Captain."

You hear the tap of keys and a quick glance aside.

"Yes, I confirm that." $HeOrShe produces a brief, unenthusiastic smile.

"However I am forbidden to provide you with information on a League citizen on a League world without proper authorization, due cause, or an order from the King or the Prime Demarchon." $HeOrShe spreads $hisOrHer hands. "I want to help you, but procedure must be followed."
entries.zh:
$heOrShe眨了眨眼。"舰长。"

你听见键盘的敲击声，以及$heOrShe迅速瞥向一侧的眼神。

"是的，我已确认这一点。" $heOrShe露出短暂而平淡的微笑。

"但未经适当授权、正当理由，或国王及大统领的指令，我无权向你提供关于联盟星球公民的信息。" $heOrShe摊开双手，"我很希望能协助你，但我必须遵循程序。"

entries.en:
Cavin considers you for a moment. "So you're not working with him huh?" He slaps the commsplate, "Hear that, vat-pig? Not Fleet. You lose."

He turns back to you. "Uh... let'see, it was Finlay. Agent Finlay something. He tried to appeal to my 'patriotism as a citizen of the League' and flashed his FleetInt ID at me. Ha! What a soulless minion of orthodoxy."

FleetInt- he means the Persean League intelligence apparatus. Interesting.
entries.zh:
Cavin 打量了你一会儿。"这么说你不是和他一伙的？" 他拍了拍通讯板，"听到了吗，大桶猪？不是舰队的人，你输了。"

他回头看你。"呃...让我想想，是 Finlay，Finlay 探员什么的。他试图唤起我 '作为联盟公民的爱国主义'，并向我亮出了他的舰队情报部的身份。哈！真是一个没有灵魂的正统奴才。"

舰队情报部 —— 他指的是 英仙座联盟 的内部情报机构。有意思。

entries.en:
"I don't know what you're playing at, uh, captain whatever your name is. You shouldn't be talking to me. It's dangerous." He puffs out his chest a bit at this, eager to bear the label 'dangerous'.

"Look, a free bit of advice. If you know what's good for you - and Scylla - you'd get off this planet. So don't come back looking for me, okay?"

Cavin slaps the commsplate, unlatching the door bolts. He turns back to you for a moment, but thinks better of it and disappears into the structure.
entries.zh:
"我不知道你想干嘛，舰长大人，我也对你是谁不感兴趣。别和我说话，这很危险。" 他的胸更挺了一点，想让自己带着 '危险人物' 这个标签。

"听好，免费给你提个建议。如果现在有件事情对你和 Scylla 都好，那就是滚出这个星球。所以不要再来找我了，好吗？"

Cavin 拍了拍通讯面板，解开了门栓。他回头看了你一会儿，但思索一会后还是消失在建筑中了。

entries.en:
Cavin raises his chin, defiant. "I'd like to believe that. I told Scylla she couldn't sell out to the Galatia Academy without... making compromises." He says the word like it's a curse. "They'd either get in her head, or, or... " his jaw clenches.

He takes a breath, looks down, then continues quietly, "She thought she was onto something bigger than all this, you know. Change the world. Get us out of a closing trap. The Persean Sector, I mean, and all the wars and ruin. I don't know if I believe it. But if anyone could come up with, with something, I don't know what, it'd be Scylla."
entries.zh:
Cavin 扬起下巴，挑衅地说。"我宁愿相信你说的话。我告诉 Scylla 她在转去 Galatia 学院时不可能不...做出妥协。" 他说这个词时，好像是在骂人。"他们要么会进入她的大脑，要么，要么..." 他的下巴咬紧了。

他吸了一口气，低下头，然后静静地继续说："她认为她在做一件比这一切更伟大的事情，你知道。改变世界。把我们从一个封闭的笼子中解救出来。整个英仙座星域，我的意思是，现在发生的这些战争和毁灭。我不知道我是否相信这件事真能发生。但如果有人能想出，想出办法，我不知道那是什么办法，但那人一定是 Scylla。"

entries.en:
"I gotta go. You shouldn't be talking to me. If anyone knows where she is, maybe it's Elissa."

He looks around, then puts his body between you and the commsplate, and holds out a knockoff datapad displaying a comms ID glyph. He stays silent, but his look is almost pleading. You quickly scan the glyph with your TriPad, which makes a satisfied chime.
entries.zh:
"我得走了。你向我询问没有意义。如果有人知道她在哪里，也许是 Elissa。"

他环顾四周，然后用身体挡在你和通讯面板之间，并拿出一个山寨的数据平板，上面显示着一个通讯 ID。他保持沉默，但表情几乎是在恳求你。你迅速用 TriPad 扫描这个字符，它发出了成功的提示音。

entries.en:
"It's not my place to say, but Elissa might know something. Ask her. Just ... don't come back here." Cavin slaps the commsplate, unlatching the door bolts.

He turns back to you for a moment, but thinks better of it and disappears into the structure.
entries.zh:
"这不是我该说的，但 Elissa 可能知道些什么。问问她吧。然后...别再来了。" Cavin 拍了拍通讯面板，解开了门栓。

他回头看了你一会儿，但想了想，还是消失在了建筑中。

entries.en:
At your words, Cavin turns to look at the commsplate in horror. It crackles- Cavin pulls back with a start as it speaks in the second voice you heard, not the officious Fleet agent.

"I told you they're watching us! I told you!"

"Shut up!" Cavin pounds the commsplate with a fist, "And stop listening in, creep!" He turns back to you. "Who are you anyway? Why would you tell me this?"
entries.zh:
听了你的话，Cavin 惊恐地转头看向通讯面板。它发出噼里啪啦的声音并开始说话 —— Cavin 吓了一跳，但是面板传出是你之前听过的那个声音，而不是那个带有官腔的舰队特工。

"我告诉过你，他们在监视我们！我告诉过你！"

"闭嘴！" Cavin 一拳捶向通讯板，"别再偷听了，你这混蛋！" 他回头看你。"你到底是谁？你为什么要告诉我这些？"

entries.en:
Cavin looks at you, confused. "Hey, I don't know what you're playing at. I don't know any agent or whatever-" The commsplate crackles an interruption, "I told you they were a spy, Cavin! I win!"

He pounds the commsplate behind him, "They're not fleet, idiot!" And back to you, "I don't want any part of this. Tell your friend Finlay to go lick boots on Kazeron."
entries.zh:
Cavin 看着你，感到困惑。"嘿，我不知道你跟谁做事。我不认识什么特工或什么 ——" 通讯牌噼里啪啦地打断了他的话。"我就和你说过他们是间谍，Cavin ！我说对了吧！"

他用拳头捶向身后的通讯板，"他们不是舰队情报部的，白痴！" 然后重新转向你。"我不想掺和这事。告诉你的朋友滚去舔 Kazeron 的靴子。"

entries.en:
The commsplate crackles, "Yeah, tell 'em Cavin! Go suck vacuum fashy-worm!"

Cavin slaps the commsplate and the bolts withdraw. Cavin backs into the doorway. "Don't come looking for me again. I won't be here."

The door slams shut, sending a ripple through the polymer agit-prints surrounding the door. A flurry of plastic flakes flit to the ground.
entries.zh:
通讯板发出噼里啪啦的声音，"说得好，Cavin，告诉他们！让这些法西斯蛀虫滚去吸真空吧！"

Cavin 拍了拍通讯面板，门闩随即收了回去。Cavin 退到了门口。"不要再来找我了。我不会再待在这里。"

门被重重地关上了，在门周围的塑料制煽动性海报上吹出一阵涟漪。一片片碎屑飞落到了地上。

o.en: I just want to help Scylla.
Just making our friend Finlay's work more interesting.
o.zh: 只是想让我们的 Finlay 朋友的工作更有意思一点。

o.en: I'm looking for Elissa Zal. I think she can help Scylla.
o.zh: 我在找 Elissa Zal，我认为她可以帮助 Scylla。

entries.en:
Cavin looks at you, puzzled. "You know about Elissa? Who- " he looks down the street behind you almost unconsciously. "No, don't tell me."

"I gotta go. You shouldn't be talking to me. I- If anyone knows where Scylla is, maybe it's Elissa." He looks around, puts his body between you and the commsplate, and holds out a knockoff datapad with a comms ID glyph displayed. He nods to you in earnest. You quickly scan the glyph and your TriPad makes a satisfied chime to itself.
entries.zh:
Cavin 看着你，神色显得困惑不解。"你知道 Elissa 的事？是谁..." 他下意识地向你身后的街道张望了一会，并低声说道，"不，别告诉我。"

"我得走了。你不应该和我说话。我... 如果有人知道 Scylla 的下落，那可能就是 Elissa 了。" 他再次环顾四周，悄悄用身体挡在你和通讯面板之间，并迅速拿出一个山寨的数据平板，而上面正显示着一个通讯 ID。他快速向你点头。而你则麻利的扫描了这段代码。直至你的 TriPad 发出了悦耳的提示音。

entries.en:
"Seriously," Cavin says, "Don't come back here."

He slaps the commsplate, unlatching the door bolts. He turns back to you for a moment, but thinks better of it and disappears into the structure.
entries.zh:
"说真的，" Cavin说，"不要再来这里了。"

Cavin 拍了拍通讯面板，解开了门栓。他回头看了你一会儿，但想了想，还是消失在了建筑中。

entries.en:
You clear your throat and then speak rather too loudly, "Cavin Pharoh. I know that you are an associate of Scylla Coureuse. I would like you to answer some questions for my investigation, please"

The commsplate behind Cavin crackles and speaks, "Cavin! I told you they were a FleetSec agent, I told you! Don't tell them anything!"
entries.zh:
你清了清嗓子，然后大声说道："Cavin Pharoh。我知道你是 Scylla Coureuse 的一个伙伴。我想让你回答一些问题，以便我进行调查，请你配合。"

Cavin 身后的通讯器突然发出噼里啪啦的声音："Cavin！我就说他们是舰队安全局的特工，我告诉过你！不要告诉他们任何事情！"

entries.en:
Cavin goes pale, looking like a trapped animal. He smacks the commsplate behind him and hisses "Shut up!" then turns back to you, "And you- shut up too! I don't... I don't know you, I don't know anything. Don't talk to me!" Back to the commsplate, "Open up, this is some kind of crazy person."

The bolts withdraw and Cavin backs into the doorway. "Stay away from me!" he shouts one last time before the door slams shut sending a ripple through the polymer agit-prints surrounding the door. A flurry of plastic flakes flit to the ground.
entries.zh:
Cavin 的脸色逐渐苍白，看起来像一只被捉到的动物。他拍了拍身后的通讯面板，嘶吼道："闭嘴！" 然后回头看你，"还有你 —— 也闭嘴！我不... 我不认识你，我什么都不知道。不要和我说话！" 他又转向了通讯面板，"打开，这人就是个疯子。"

随着门闩缩回，Cavin 退到了门后。在门被关上之前，他最后一次喊道，"离我远点！" 门被重重地关上了，在门周围的塑料制煽动性海报上吹出一阵涟漪。一片片碎屑飞落到了地上。

o.en: Who else was asking questions about Coureuse?
o.zh: 还有谁在打听 Coureuse 的事？

o.en: I want to help Scylla. Do you know where she is?
o.zh: 我希望帮助 Scylla，你知道她在哪里吗

o.en: You know that the Fleet intel spies have your commsplate hacked, right?
o.zh: 你应该知道舰队情报部的间谍已经黑进了你的通讯系统？

o.en: I was told Elissa could help me find Scylla. Know where she is? (lie)
o.zh: 有人说 Elissa 能帮我找到 Scylla，你知道她在哪吗？ (说谎)

o.en: Just act extremely conspicuous for anyone watching

entries.en:
"Yeah. Obviously." He looks you over. "You're not MuniSec or Fleet. You a merc? Or some kinda spy? Your friend was already sniffing around here. We told him to go lick boots on Kazeron."

Cavin crosses his arms impatiently and looks off down the arco-tube, making every effort to show that he doesn't want to talk. "Well?"
entries.zh:
"是的。很明显。" 他看了看你，"你不是地方安全部或舰队情报部的人，雇佣兵？还是某种间谍？你的朋友已经在这里到处打探消息了，我们告诉他滚去舔 Kazeron 的靴子。"

Cavin 不耐烦地交叉着双臂，看着远处的维生管道，竭力表现出他根本不想交谈的态度。"所以你呢？"

entries.en:
The damaged commsplate by the door speaks with a crackle, "-re you MuniSec? We do not consent to a search! Not without-", then some muffled words, and a second voice interrupts, "Shut up. I'll handle it."

Hidden bolts withdraw and a man steps out. He's put on a sour scowl for you and is dressed in a mix of dirtsider approximation of spacer gear mixed with the accoutrement of some local counterculture fashion. He pulls the door closed and with a lowered voice says "Ignore that. Is she in more trouble? This is about the whole Galatia thing isn't it?"
entries.zh:
门边损坏的通讯面板发出噼里啪啦的全损人声，"...你是地方安全部？我们不同意搜查！除非你有... " 然后是一些低沉的话语，第二个声音打断道，"闭嘴。我来处理。"

随着隐藏的门闩被收回，一个男人走了出来。他对你摆出一副酸溜溜的表情，身上混搭着看起来像那么回事的宇宙民服饰和一些当地象征反主流文化的装饰品。出来后他把门拉上，用很低的声音说："别管这里面的事了。她是不是又卷进更多的麻烦里了？那件关于 Galatia 的事，是吗？"

entries.en: You turn from the dismal portico. It seems like it is time to make a call to one Finlay Siyavong.
entries.zh: 你从这个破烂的门廊转过身来。看来是时候给那个叫 Finlay Siyavong 的人打个电话了。

entries.en: You turn from the dismal portico, considering your last option. Elissa Zal was the closest to Scylla, it seems, and has made herself very difficult to find. It's time to make a call.
entries.zh: 你从这个破烂的门廊转过身来，考虑你最后的选择。似乎 Elissa Zal 是离 Scylla 最近的人，而且她把自己藏得很深。是时候再打一个电话了。

entries.en: You turn away from the dismal portico, considering your options. Elissa Zal was the closest to Scylla, it seems, and has made herself very difficult to find. Finlay Siyavong was asking a lot of questions about Scylla, so he may know something. It's time to make a call.
entries.zh: 你从这个破烂的门廊转过身来，考虑着你下一步。似乎 Elissa Zal 是最接近 Scylla 的人，而且她把自己藏得很深。Finlay Siyavong 问了很多关于 Scylla 的问题，所以他可能知道些什么。是时候做出决定了。

entries.en:
As you start to turn away from the dismal portico, the commsplate crackles one more time. It speaks. "You've made your point, $playerName."

An officious voice, though distorted by the damaged commsplate. It signals an elite education and a relaxed authority that comes naturally to its speaker.

"You want us to know you're looking for Scylla Coureuse and you're going to shout it from every street corner on Fikenhild until we acknowledge it."
entries.zh:
当你开始转身离开这个破烂的门廊时，通讯面板再次发出噼啪声。它说话了。"你已经表达了你的来意，$playerName "。

一个有官腔的声音，虽然被损坏的通讯器略有扭曲。这是一种受过精英教育的象征，说话者自然而然带有一种浅浅的权威感。

"你想让我们知道你在找 Scylla Coureuse，并且打算在 Fikenhild 的每个街角大声宣扬此事，直到我们做出回应。"

entries.en:
"We should speak more in a discreet setting. I'll transmit my comms ID for you to contact. Leave this nest of anarchists be. Come back topside, and let us talk about our mutual interest."

The commsplate sputters and dies with a lingering crackle as your datapad pings. It looks like you finally attracted the attention you were looking for.
entries.zh:
"我们应该在更隐蔽的环境下谈谈，舰长，" 那个声音继续说道。"我会把我的通讯 ID 发给你。别管这个无政府主义者的巢穴了。回到上面来，让我们面对面地谈谈我们的共同利益。"

当通讯面板发出噼里啪啦的响声时，你的数据平板发出了响声。看起来你终于引起了你正在寻找的人的关注。

o.en: You don't sound like Cavin Pharoh. Or his friend.
o.zh: 你不像是 Cavin Pharoh，也不像是他的朋友

entries.en: Your bodyguards silently take flanking positions four meters behind you, one to each side, as you walk back through the moldering undercity toward the civic lift.
entries.zh: 你的保镖们在你身后四米处悄然占据了侧翼位置，一左一右，护送你穿过腐朽的地下城区走向市政电梯。

entries.en: "You presume correctly, captain." The voice sounds almost impressed.
entries.zh: "你的推测是正确的，舰长。" 那个声音听起来几乎带着赞许。

entries.en: "You presume correctly, Demarchon $PlayerName." The voice sounds almost impressed.
entries.zh: "您的推测是正确的，统领大人。" 那个声音听起来几乎带着赞许。

entries.en: "You have a way of insisting, captain." The voice sounds a touch annoyed.
entries.zh: "你还真是顽固，舰长。" 那个声音听起来有一丝恼怒。

entries.en: "You have a way of insisting, demarchon." The voice sounds a touch annoyed.
entries.zh: "您还真是顽固，统领先生。" 那个声音听起来有一丝恼怒。

entries.en: "For good reason," the voice says patiently.
entries.zh: "我有充分的理由。" 那个声音耐心地说道。

entries.en:
The transit lift descends into the subsurface districts of Kay-arco. The air thickens with mildew and century-old machine lubricant. You pass through structural tunnels filled with cheap tenements, gray market retailers, and fringe ideologies.

Your TriPad's directions lead you to an address where Cavin Pharoh held what the event notice called a 'militant consciousness happening'. Along an anonymous stretch of shuttered depot-fronts you discover a secure door flanked by decaying polymer agitation prints. Chemmed out sleepers lie in entryways. It feels like the right place.
entries.zh:
转运电梯降到了 Kay 生态圈的下层区域。空气中弥漫着霉菌和百年老机油的味道。曾经的结构隧道已经被廉价公寓、黑市商贩和宣传小众意识形态的广告所充斥，你从中穿行而过。

TriPad 指引你来到 Cavin Pharoh 曾举办 "激进意识进行时" 活动的地点。沿着一条满是紧锁库房的不知名小道，你发现了一扇安全门。两侧用聚合物印制的煽动性传单已经褪色，磕昏了头的瘾君子栽倒在过道里。你默默想着，找对地方了。

entries.en:
As you raise your hand to knock, the commsplate by the door sputters to life and speaks.

"You've made your point, $TitlePL $playerName."

An officious voice, though distorted by the damaged commsplate. It signals an elite education and the relaxed authority which comes naturally to its speaker.

"You want us to know you're looking for Scylla Coureuse and you're going to shout it from every street corner on Fikenhild until we acknowledge it."
entries.zh:
当你举起手准备敲门时，门边的通讯器喷出了火花，并发出了声音。

"你已经表达了你的来意，$playerName。"

一个有官腔的声音，虽然被损坏的通讯器略有扭曲。这是一种受过精英教育的象征，说话者自然而然带有一种浅浅的权威感。

"你想让我们知道你在找 Scylla Coureuse，并且打算在 Fikenhild 的每个街角大声宣扬此事，直到我们做出回应。"

entries.en:
As you raise your hand to knock, the commsplate by the door sputters to life and speaks.

"$TitlePL $playerName. I apologize for delaying my response the inquiry you made through official channels."

An officious voice, though distorted by the damaged commsplate. It signals an elite education and the relaxed authority which comes naturally to its speaker.

"You're looking for someone quite specific, and I should like to assist you."
entries.zh:
当你举起手准备敲门时，门边的通讯器喷出了火花，并发出了声音。

"您已经表达了你的来意，$playerName 统领。"

一个有官腔的声音，虽然被损坏的通讯器略有扭曲。这是一种受过精英教育的象征，说话者自然而然带有一种浅浅的权威感。

"您想让我们知道您在找 Scylla Coureuse，并且打算在 Fikenhild 的每个街角大声宣扬此事，直到我们做出回应。"

entries.en: You stand for a moment at the transport hub, considering your options.
entries.zh: 你在交通枢纽驻足了一会，考虑着下一步该怎么走。

o.en: Visit Adonya Coureuse in the overcity
o.zh: 拜访住在上城区的 Adonya Coureuse。

o.en: Visit Bione Lata in the exurbs
Visit Cavin Pharoh in the undercity
o.zh: 拜访位于下城区的 Cavin Pharoh。

entries.en:
You return to your shuttle, considering what you've learned. The answer you seek feels very close now.

You stop yourself from tapping at your datapad impatiently; the comm directory will always be there.
entries.zh:
你返回了你的穿梭机，思考着你找到的线索。你感觉到你想要的答案已经近在咫尺。

你停下了不耐烦地轻敲数据平板的动作，通讯目录依然显示在屏幕上。

entries.en:
On your way back to the shuttle you review the information given to you by Baird as well as your own notes. Interrogating civilians is not your usual method - perhaps investigating the probes that Scylla, or someone close to her, may still be using in the $gaFC_starName system will reveal more concrete results.

You recall that Provost Baird asked you to inform her if you decided to change your approach to the matter of Scylla Coureuse.
entries.zh:
在返回穿梭机的路上，你复习了 Baird 给你提供的信息以及你自己的笔记。在质询平民这方面你并不太熟练 —— 也许调查一下 Scylla 或她身边的人仍在 $gaFC_starName 星系中使用的探测器，会发现更多详细的线索。

你想起 Baird 院长告诉过你，如果你想要改变寻找 Scylla Coureuse 的方式的话，需要先向她通报。

o.en: Shuttle to the surface to pursue the list of Coureuse associates
o.zh: 搭乘穿梭机到地面上并寻找和 Coureuse 有关联的人。

entries.en: "You presume correctly, $titlePL." The voice sounds almost impressed.
entries.zh: "你的推测是正确的，舰长。" 那个声音听起来几乎带着赞许。

entries.en: "You have a way of insisting, $titlePL." The voice sounds a touch annoyed.
entries.zh: "你还真是顽固，舰长。" 那个声音听起来有一丝恼怒。

entries.en: "For good reason," the voice says patiently.
entries.zh: "我有充分的理由。" 那个声音耐心地说道。

entries.en:
"We should bring this conversation to a more discreet setting," the voice continues. "I'll transmit my comms ID for you to contact. Leave this nest of anarchists be. Come back topside and let us speak face to face about our mutual interest."

The commsplate sputters and dies with a lingering crackle as your datapad pings. It looks like you finally attracted the official attention you were looking for.
entries.zh:
"我们应该在更隐蔽的环境下谈谈，舰长，" 那个声音继续说道，"我会把我的通讯 ID 发给你。别管这个无政府主义者的巢穴了。回到上面来，让我们面对面地谈谈我们的共同利益。"

通讯面板发出毫无规律的噪音，最后在一阵噼啪声中消停下来，你的数据平板这时也发出了响声。看来你终于引起了官方的注意，这正是你求之不得的。

o.en: Leave - you got what you need
o.zh: 离开 —— 你已经得到了你要的东西

entries.en:
"Don't worry about it. You have a rogue scientist to track down, and on behalf of the Fleet Intelligence Service, I have nothing to say to you on the subject. Nor have we ever met; I don't know you, you don't know me."

Agent Siyavong claps his hands together, "I believe we are finished. What is it you people say- 'burn bright', captain?"
entries.zh:
"别担心。你在追踪一个逃跑的科学家，而我代表舰队情报部，在这个问题上我没法告诉你任何事情。那么，我们从未见过面，我不认识你，你也不认识我。"

Siyavong 特工拍了拍手，"我相信我们已经谈完了。你们这些人怎么说来着 —— '航行无阻'，舰长？"

entries.en: Finlay shakes his head, still smiling. The comms line disconnects abruptly.
entries.zh: Finlay 摇了摇头，仍然微笑着。通讯线路突然中断了。

entries.en:
"Don't worry about it. You have a rogue scientist to track down, and on behalf of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service, I've said nothing to you on the subject."

He taps his nose. "Our meeting was purely a matter of routine internal affairs. Nothing out of the ordinary with the FIS coordinating on perfectly standard information-sharing with the executive representative of a member polity, don't you agree?"

Agent Siyavong claps his hands together, "I believe we are finished. What is it you people say- 'burn bright', captain-demarchon?"
entries.zh:
"别在意这些了。你还有个出走的科学家要追查呢，而我以 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部的名义发誓，我可没跟你说过这事。"

他轻点鼻尖，"我们的会面纯粹是常规内部事务。情报局与成员政体的行政代表进行完全标准的信息协调交流，这没什么不寻常的，你同意吧？"

Siyavong 探员双手一拍，"我想我们就此结束吧，你们常怎么说来着 —— '航行无阻'，舰长兼统领大人？"

entries.en: You review Baird's list of Coureuse's associates. It looks like you've cleared the best hits. And besides, you've got a strong new lead to follow up on.
entries.zh: 你开始回顾 Baird 给出的与 Coureuse 有关联的人的名单。看来你已经将最有可能的线索调查完毕了。不过，你又有了有力的新线索可以追查。

entries.en:
Descending through pillars of stormcloud over sparkling seas, your shuttle glides toward 'Kay-arco', the cosmopolitan megapolis-arcology of Fikenhild. Dampers dull the shock of atmospheric entry to a whisper as you review Baird's list of Coureuse's associates, starting with the first entry.

Adonya Coureuse is noted as a surviving parent, and lives in a pensioners' quarter.

It seems reasonable to start with her.
entries.zh:
在波光粼粼的海面上，你的穿梭机穿过风暴云柱后开始下降，航向了 "Kay 生态圈" —— Fikenhild 的巨型生态理想城。你开始回顾 Baird 给出的与 Coureuse 有关联的人的名单，穿梭机上的阻尼力场将进入大气层的噪音减小到了耳语一般的程度。

Adonya Coureuse被标记为调查目标依然在世的家人，对方住在一个退休人员区。

从她开始调查似乎不错。

entries.en:
You review Baird's list of Coureuse's associates on Fikenhild.

Bione Lata is tagged as 'childhood friend', and lives in an exurb community.

Perhaps she knows something more of Scylla Coureuse's personal connections from her early life. At the very least any other agent following similar leads would have had to have contacted Bione.
entries.zh:
你开始回顾 Baird 给出的与 Coureuse 有关联并住在 Fikenhild 上的人的名单。

Bione Lata是目标的一位 "儿时玩伴"，住在一个远郊社区。

也许她对 Scylla Coureuse 早期的个人交际网络了解得更多。至少任何其他顺着类似线索进行追查的特工都应该联系过 Bione。

entries.en:
You review Baird's list of Coureuse's associates on Fikenhild.

Cavin Pharoh's file has an attached file about an event at some kind of art co-op operated by undercity radicals.

He seems like the sort that is used to hiding from the authorities. Maybe he, or someone he knows, is helping Coureuse. You scroll through some holos of what passes for artwork in Cavin's association, and judging by the content, you feel that local MuniSec probably has Cavin on a list.
entries.zh:
你开始回顾 Baird 给出的与 Coureuse 有关联并住在 Fikenhild 上的人的名单。

Cavin Pharoh 的档案里有一部分是关于下城区激进分子在某个艺术合作社举办的活动的。

他似乎是那种惯于躲避当局的人。也许他，或者他认识的什么人在帮 Coureuse。你在 Cavin 的协会中浏览一些被认为是艺术品的全息图，你通过其中的内容判断，地方安全部可能已经将 Cavin 列为追捕对象了。

entries.en:
You assemble your senior officers to discuss the matter of the Coureuse-related hypercomms directed at the Isirah System. A preliminary scan of the Groombridge Habitat rotates slowly in the holoprojector's display.

"Theoretically," your nav officer says, "A hyperspace-interacting field could be pulsed only periodically. It'd be impossible to detect unless we caught it at the right moment. And we don't know the schedule."
entries.zh:
你召集你的上级军官讨论与 Coureuse 有关的，Isirah 星系中的超空间通讯信息。Groombridge 栖息地的初步扫描图在全息投影仪的显示屏上缓慢旋转。

"理论上，" 你的领航军官说，"超空间相互作用场只能周期性地产生脉冲。除非我们在恰当的时刻恰好捕捉到它，否则根本无法探测。现在我们也不知道具体时刻。"

entries.en:
Comms speaks up, "The same principle could be applied to the intra-system relay. Data could be cached, then pulsed to a habitat, ship, another relay..."

Your ops chief speaks, "-And that reactor shootin' rads like it is, no one would look too close. Or hang around long. Only way to search is," a thoughtful pause, "Rad-armored drones. One-way trip. If a relay is in there, it'll have a damn strong rad-shield."
entries.zh:
通讯军官说："同样的原理也可以应用到星系内的中继站上。数据可以被缓存，然后脉冲到栖息地，飞船，或是另一个中继站..."

行动长官则开口道，" —— 反应堆会不断地放出辐射，没人能凑近观察或长时间逗留。唯一的搜索方法是..." 说到这，现场的人都陷入沉思，"配备辐射保护层的无人机，只去不回。中继站里通常会有非常强大的辐射屏障。"

o.en: Then you know what to look for. Make it happen.
o.zh: 看起来你们知道该找什么了，不管你们有什么点子，让它变成现实吧。

entries.en: Your bridge crew exchanges looks - their captain is giving another one of those orders - while your ops chief leans back, deep in thought.
entries.zh: 舰桥上的船员交换了一下眼神 —— 他们的舰长又下达了这种命令 —— 而你的行动长官则向后靠了靠，陷入了沉思。

entries.en:
At the turn of the next shift the armored drones are prepared, and your ops chief oversees their deployment. You follow their progress through the projection of Groombridge Habitat, filling in fuzzy volumes - shielded from your scans or too radioactive to get a good read - with sharp details. An anomalous shielded mass is found soon enough in a damaged work bay in close proximity to the deadly core of the station.

Tech and comms begin discussing how to breach and hack the relay; your ops chief growls an interruption, "If I were them, I'd rig it to blow if it got looked at funny." The other officers go quiet.

Sensors speaks up, "We just have to intercept an in-system signal, right? Assuming it's tightcast, we could deploy a, um, cloud of detectors." Your ops chief looks at your sensors officer and sighs.
entries.zh:
在下一次交班的时候，带有屏蔽装甲保护的无人机准备就绪，并在行动长官的监督下进行了部署。随着它们的挺进，全息投影上之前覆盖了 Groombridge 栖息地的大片模糊区域 —— 代表辐射过强或受扫描屏蔽而无法得到可靠读数 —— 逐渐被清晰的细节所取代。很快，一团受异常屏蔽的什么东西在距离死寂的空间站核心很近的一个损坏工作舱室里被发现了。

技术军官和通讯军官开始讨论如何攻破和骇入中继站，而行动长官的一句怒吼就让两人都安静了下来，"如果我是那些家伙，就肯定会做些手脚把想来看热闹的家伙都给炸个稀巴烂！"

传感器技官也提高了嗓门，"那我们只能去拦截某个星系内的信号了，对吗？如果那只是个瞬时发送的东西，我们只需要部署大概一...呃...一团探测器？" 行动长官瞪了传感器技官一眼，叹了口气。

entries.en:
Within hours of establishing a makeshift detection cloud, the relay sends a comms squirt. The whiff of an outbound signal is projected by your navigator on your flagship bridge main holodisplay, the line points toward Laicaille Habitat. Not quite, but close enough. Maybe a relay in a close orbit.

"We just have to follow the path of the beam," your comms officer comments.
entries.zh:
在建立一个临时的探测器集群后数小时内，中继站发射了一个通讯信号。向外射出的一丝信号被你的领航员投射到了你的旗舰舰桥主全息显示器上，这条线指向 Laicaille 栖息地。不完全是，但已经很接近了，也许是轨道上的另一个中继站。

"我们跟着这条线走就可以了。" 通讯军官说。

entries.en:
You assemble your senior officers to discuss the matter of secret comms bursts directed at the Isirah System. A preliminary scan of the Groombridge Habitat rotates slowly in the holoprojector's display.

"Why here? I mean, rhetorically speaking," your nav officer says, "Because the only reason to relay signals from here to Laicaille is if your signals were coming from a hidden hypercomm relay."

Your comms officer raises a hand, and at your nod speaks, "It's unconventional. But Groombridge is uninhabited, so no one would complain about hyperwave wash."

Your ops chief speaks next, "The reactor shootin' rads like it is, no one would look too close. No scavengers."
entries.zh:
你召集你的上级军官来讨论 Isirah 星系中的秘密通讯爆发事件。Groombridge 栖息地的初步扫描图在全息投影仪的显示屏上缓缓旋转着。

"为什么在这呢？这只是个设问，" 你的领航军官说，"从这里向 Laicaille 传递信号的理由只有一种，那就是你的信号来自一个隐蔽的超空间通讯中继站。"

通讯军官举起手，在你点头的时候说，"这的确不同寻常，但 Groombridge 上没有居民，所以也不会有人去抱怨自己被沐浴在超波里。"

行动长官接着说，"而且反应堆还一直向现在这样爆辐射，不会有人凑过去看的。所以也不会有拾荒者。"

o.en: If there was a hypercomm relay here, how would we find it?
o.zh: 如果这有个超空间通讯中继站，我们该怎样找到它？

entries.en: "Rad-armored drones," your ops chief says. "One-way trip. If a relay is in there, it'd have a damn strong rad-shield, so we'll know what to look for."
entries.zh: "中继站里通常会有非常强大的辐射屏障。" 你的行动长官开口道，"所以我们可以选择配备辐射保护层的无人机，只去不回。那样就可以知道我们到底在找什么了。"

entries.en:
At the turn of the next shift, the armored drones are prepared and your ops chief oversees their deployment. You follow their progress through the projection of Groombridge Habitat, filling in fuzzy volumes - shielded from your scans or too radioactive to get a good read - with sharp details. An anomalous shielded mass is found soon enough in a damaged work bay in close proximity to the deadly core of the station.

Tech and comms begin discussing how to breach and hack the relay; your ops chief growls an interruption, "If I were them, I'd rig it to blow if it got looked at funny." The other officers go quiet.

Sensors speaks up, "We just have to intercept an in-system signal, right? Assuming it's tightcast, we could deploy a, um, cloud of detectors." Your ops chief looks at your sensors officer and sighs.

在下一次交班的时候，带有屏蔽装甲保护的无人机准备就绪，并在行动长官的监督下进行了部署。随着它们的挺进，全息投影上之前覆盖了 Groombridge 栖息地的大片模糊区域 —— 代表辐射过强或受扫描屏蔽而无法得到可靠读数 —— 逐渐被清晰的细节所取代。很快，一团受异常屏蔽的什么东西在距离死寂的空间站核心很近的一个损坏工作舱室里被发现了。

技术军官和通讯军官开始讨论如何攻破和骇入中继站，而行动长官的一句怒吼就让两人都安静了下来，"如果我是那些家伙，就肯定会做些手脚把想来看热闹的家伙都给炸个稀巴烂！"

传感器技官也提高了嗓门，"那我们只能去拦截某个星系内的信号了，对吗？如果那只是个瞬时发送的东西，我们只需要部署大概一...呃...一团探测器？" 行动长官瞪了传感器技官一眼，叹了口气。

entries.en:
Within hours of establishing a makeshift detection cloud, the relay sends a comms squirt. The whiff of an outbound signal is projected by your navigator on your flagship bridge main holodisplay, the line points toward Laicaille Habitat. Not quite, but close enough. Maybe a relay in a close orbit.

This is the sort of tech Coureuse is familiar with, and even if it is arguably circumstantial, it's a weird enough setup that you can probably scare the authorities at Laicaille with the revelation.

Ghosties indeed.
entries.zh:
在建立一个临时的探测器集群后数小时内，中继器发射了一个通讯信号。向外射出的一丝信号被你的领航员投射到了你的旗舰舰桥主全息显示器上，这条线指向 Laicaille 栖息地。不完全是，但已经很接近了。也许是轨道上的另一个中继站。

这是 Coureuse 熟悉的一种技术，即使它可以说是间接的，也巧合得太诡异了，你也许能用这个发现吓到 Laicaille 的当局。

还真藏有鬼啊。

o.en: Search the station for the source of the mysterious signals
o.zh: 在空间站里搜索神秘信号的来源

o.en: Search the station for a makeshift hypercomm receiver
o.zh: 在空间站里搜索一个临时超空间通讯接收器

entries.en:
You accede to the terms and oversee transfer of the records of your investigation into the current location of Scylla Coureuse - the Isirah System. The mercenary is terse but comprehensive in $hisOrHer oversight of the proceeding, which is soon concluded.

"I shall authorize the credits transfer immediately. My employer will find this acceptable. Our business is complete, captain."

The comms signal is terminated by the mercenary.
entries.zh:
你同意了对方的条件，并监督将你所调查的 Scylla Coureuse 的当前位置 —— 也就是 Isirah 星系 —— 的情报转交给了对方。雇佣兵在监管信息转交的简短过程中表现得精明干练。

"我将立即进行星币转账。我的雇主会觉得这是可以接受的。我们的任务完成了，舰长。"

通信被雇佣兵关闭了。

entries.en:
After your reply, the mercenary sits unmoving for a full ten seconds.

Then $heOrShe closes $hisOrHer eyes and nods $hisOrHer head. "I see."

The merc opens $hisOrHer eyes again, and looks at you again, unblinking. "How disappointing. Good shift, captain."
entries.zh:
在你回答之后，雇佣兵一动不动地坐了足足十秒钟。

然后$heOrShe闭上了眼睛，点了点头。"我明白了。"

说罢，雇佣兵又一次睁开了$hisOrHer的眼睛，又一次直直地看着你，眼皮也不动一下。"真令人失望。祝你今天顺利，舰长。"

o.en: That's it? You're just going to leave?
o.zh: 就这样？你就直接走了吗？

entries.en:
"That's it," $heOrShe says, then pauses, unblinking.

"Until next time, captain," the mercenary says finally. $HeOrShe shuts the comms link on you; static devolves to black.
entries.zh:
"就这样。" $heOrShe说，然后停顿了一会，眼睛一眨不眨。

"下次见，舰长。" 雇佣兵最后留下了这么一句话。$HeOrShe关闭了和你的通讯链接，屏幕渐渐变得漆黑一片。

entries.en:
The comms open.

"Captain $playerName," the mercenary captain speaks flatly, hands steepled before $himOrHer. "You have information which my employer would like you to share with them. Exclusively."

Then $heOrShe waits, perfectly content to let the silence grow.
entries.zh:
通讯被接通了。

"$playerName 舰长，" 雇佣舰长把两手高高地交叠在$himOrHer的面前，语气毫无起伏地开口说道，"你有一些情报，我的雇主想让你和他们分享 —— 只和他们分享。"

然后$heOrShe开始等待你的回复，十分享受地让沉默酝酿开来。

o.en: Let's talk about making a deal.
I don't respond well to threats.

o.zh: 你不可能从我这里得到任何情报。

entries.en: "Yes, let's. My employer has authorized me to pay you $gaFC_sellOutPrice credits for the transfer of the information you possess which is relevant to the current location of Scylla Coureuse."
entries.zh: "好，没问题。我的雇主已经授权我支付你 $gaFC_sellOutPrice 星币，以转移你所拥有的，与 Scylla Coureuse 的当前位置相关的信息。"

o.en: No, I mean how much will it cost for you to forget that I exist?
o.zh: 不，我是说，如果我想让你忘记我的存在，要花多少钱？

entries.en: The merc stares at you, then says "I see. That's quite impossible."
entries.zh: 雇佣兵盯着你，随后说道："这样啊...那是不可能的。"

o.zh: 我们还是谈谈别的事吧...

o.en: Let's talk about you bribing me, then.
o.zh: 那就来谈谈你贿赂我的事吧。

entries.en: "No," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh: "不行。" $heOrShe说。

o.zh: 我们还是谈谈别的事吧...

o.en: Let's talk about you bribing me, then.
o.zh: 那就来谈谈你贿赂我的事吧。

entries.en:
"Captain, there are things money simply can't buy."

Is that a hint of some expression on the merc's face? It is difficult to tell.

"Let me put it like this," $heOrShe says. "If you were in a position to purchase my services, you would not be in the position you are in. Therefore, your proposal is quite impossible."
entries.zh:
"舰长，有些东西可不是简简单单用钱就能买到的。"

雇佣兵的表情在暗示着什么吗？很难说。

"让我这么说吧。" $heOrShe说，"如果你的地位高到能购买我的服务，那你就不会非要亲自到处跑，进而陷入这种处境了。因此，你的建议是完全不可能被接受的。"

o.zh: 我们还是谈谈别的事吧...

o.en: Let's talk about you bribing me, then.
o.zh: 那就来谈谈你贿赂我的事吧。

o.en: Then you'll get nothing from me.
o.zh: 那你就别想从我这得到什么东西了。

entries.en: "Oh," the merc tilts $hisOrHer head a few degrees to one side. "Did I make a threat?"
entries.zh: "喔，" 雇佣兵歪了歪$hisOrHer的头，"我威胁你了吗？"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe raises $hisOrHer eyebrows. "I think you know perfectly well. You came here to find something," a small smile, "Or someone."

"You appear to be traveling with purposeful intent after investigative activity at your last stop. My employer believes that you found what you were looking for and would like you to share that information under exclusive terms."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe扬了扬$hisOrHer的眉毛。"我想你很清楚是什么情报。你来这里是为了寻找某个东西，"对方露出了一个小小的微笑，"或者某个人。"

"自上一站的调查活动结束后，你似乎一直在有目的地四处奔波。我的雇主认为你找到了你想要找的东西，希望你能仅为我们提供这一情报。"

entries.en:
"My employer." The merc crosses $hisOrHer arms.

"-Who is interested in exclusive access to your information. Who also... has a passion for discretion, so you need not worry about your reputation if you sold out your own employer." $HeOrShe considers. "Much."
entries.zh:
"我的雇主..." 叉着双臂的雇佣兵开了口。

"——是个有兴趣想从你这里要一些独家情报的人。那个人也... 非常懂得守口如瓶，所以即便你出卖了你的雇主，你也不必担心自己的声誉受影响，" $HeOrShe斟酌着用词，"...受太大影响。"

entries.en: The pirate boss looks annoyed as soon as $heOrShe turns to the comm feed. "You again."
entries.zh: 当海盗头子接受通讯链接时，$heOrShe看上去有些烦躁。"又是你。"

entries.en:
"Now you didn't hear this from me - because I don't mess with Pathers. They're all crazy. Don't care about credits one bit. Or they do, demanding tithes for this or that infraction against their Ludd-bedamned rules, but I just can't get a read on 'em."

"There's a cell of them infiltrating Laicaille Habitat. Going after Coureuse, I gathered. Nothing else there worth the trouble."
entries.zh:
"记住，接下来的情报你不是从我这里得到的 —— 因为我可不想招惹左径分子，他们都是神经病，一点也不在乎钱...或许他们在乎，只是不愿违背那该死的卢德规矩，无论如何我都看不懂他们的行为举止。"

"有一群左径分子渗透到了 Laicaille 栖息地。我猜他们是在找 Coureuse，毕竟没有东西值得他们干到这种地步了。"

o.zh: 你有证据吗？一些资料啥的？

entries.en:
"Um. Look." $gaFC_KBAHeOrShe goes into damage control mode, "Like I said, I don't mess with Pathers. I found their operation, but I didn't dig. I didn't charge you that much, see? You've got the bodyguards and heavily armed $shipOrFleet, I'm just some thawed-out space-meat trying to make a living."

$gaFC_KBAHeOrShe takes a deep breath, then says "Look, I'm sorry it's not better info. But I'm not going there. Maybe if you ask around you can get their attention - they have a goal, they won't just pop you in a corridor and attract unnecessary attention. Find out how they're communicating with home base, maybe. These Pathers, they're all recent. They've got to be coordinating with leadership somehow."

"Now please." $gaFC_KBAHeOrShe finishes the drink in one big gulp, "Good-bye and good luck." $gaFC_KBAHeOrShe stands, and makes for an exit.
entries.zh:
"呃，你看，我发现了他们的行动，但并没有去做深入调查。" $gaFC_KBAHeOrShe似乎不太想谈这个，"我说过了，我不会招惹左径分子。我没收你那么多钱，何况你有保镖和全副武装的舰队，而我只是块刚解冻然后想要谋生的太空冻肉。"

$gaFC_KBAHeOrShe深吸了一口气，然后说："听着，我很抱歉这不是什么更有用的情报，但我不会去冒险的，得你自己上了。也许你四处问问就可以引起他们的注意 —— 他们有要务在身，不会冒险对你动手，以免引起不必要的关注。你还可能查到他们是怎么和总部联系的。这些左径分子都是最近才来的，在这里应该没有成熟的指挥体系，他们得和外边的领导层进行一些协调工作。"

"现在，" $gaFC_KBAHeOrShe一口喝完了酒，开口道，"再见，祝你好运。" $gaFC_KBAHeOrShe站起来，向出口走去。

entries.en: "You've got a way with words, you know that?" $personName says with a conspiratorial smile, flashing gold teeth, "Very persuasive."
entries.zh: "你这张嘴可真会说话，知道吗？" $personName 露出一副阴森的笑容，你能看到对方那闪烁着的金牙，"非常有说服力。"

entries.en:
The pirate boss frowns, then reaches for $hisOrHer console. "One moment, captain."

The comm feed blanks to an ancient holding pattern for the Eridani-Utopia Corporation.
entries.zh:
海盗头子皱了皱眉头，然后将手伸向了$hisOrHer的控制台。"稍等，舰长。"

通讯信号突然失效了，呈现在你面前的东西变成了古老的 波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 的等候界面。

entries.en:
The feed flips back on. $personName is examining a datapad in $hisOrHer hands.

"Very funny, captain... $playerName. Because it looks to me more like if you'd got yourself the chance, you'd turn me in to the closest League fleet for a handful of credits and a pat on the head." $HeOrShe drops the datapad with a clatter.

"If that's how it is, that's how it is. I don't expect anything more, and I'll shoot you down myself if you step out of line on my station. But don't pretend to be my friend when you're nothing but a fawning bootlicker when an official patrol comes sniffing around."
entries.zh:
信号又恢复了。$personName 正在查看$HeOrShe手中的数据平板。

"非常有趣，$playerName... 舰长。因为在我看来，你一有机会就会把我交给最近的 英仙座联盟舰队 来换取一些荣誉和奖励。" $HeOrShe在一声重响之中将数据平板砸到了地上。

"就这样了，我可没期望从你那里得到什么，如果你在我的空间站上有越线的行为，我就亲自毙了你。你什么也不是，只是一个会阿谀奉承的马屁精，所以别假装我们很熟，特别是当有巡逻队在这附近嗅来嗅去的时候。"

entries.en: The pirate boss slaps at the comms console and the line disconnects, leaving you staring at static.
entries.zh: 海盗头子拍打着控制台挂掉了通讯，你只能对着一堆噪点干瞪眼。

entries.en:
The feed flips back on. $personName is examining a datapad in $hisOrHer hands and looking much more relaxed.

"Ah, $playername. I knew I'd heard that name somewhere. Yeah, alright. You've done some things for us. So I could do a thing for you. Just you don't forget it when the goings get tough, and be sure to tell good like-minded folks that $personName is a friend to all freedom-loving individuals who've been put on the wrong side of the law."
entries.zh:
信号又恢复了。$personName 正在查看$HeOrShe手中的数据平板，对方看起来比之前放松了一些。

"啊，$playername。我就知道我在哪儿听过这个名字。对，不错，你为我们做过一些事情，所以现在我也可以帮你个忙。当事情变得棘手起来时不要忘了这一点，还有，一定要告诉志同道合的人，$personName 是所有热爱自由但被法律抛弃的人的好朋友。"

o.en: You can count on it, friend.

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks you over, licks $hisOrHer lips, and thinks the question over for a moment.

"Might know someone by the name, might not. Why should I tell you?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe打量着你，舔了舔$hisOrHer的嘴唇，并稍微思考了一会。

"我也许知道这个人，也许并不。我为什么要告诉你呢？"

o.zh: 让我们来谈谈钱的事吧。

o.en: I'm one of you, you can work with me. I've got a reputation.
o.zh: 我是你们中的一员，我们可以合作一下。要知道我可是很有名气的。

o.en: Because uh, Warlord Kanta said so?
o.zh: 因为，呃，军阀 Kanta 这么说了？

entries.en:
The pirate boss leans forward. "You have my attention, good captain."

"If you could come up with... let's say $gaFC_kapteynBribeCost reasons why I should help you out, it might be that I'd be so inclined."
entries.zh:
海盗头子稍微往前倾了倾身子。"你成功地吸引了我的注意力，明事理的舰长。"

"如果你能支付...嗯，$gaFC_kapteynBribeCost 星币，我就可以帮你 —— 并且十分愿意这么做。"

o.en: Let's talk about Scylla Coureuse again, instead.
o.zh: 我们还是再来谈谈这个 Scylla Coureuse 吧。

entries.en:
"I may have heard something from someone. It's my business, right, knowing who's making the moves in the Isirah system, and to who."

$HeOrShe leans close to the comms pick-up, and speaks quietly "Word is the Persean League started asking a lot of questions about someone named 'Coureuse', and that was because the Hegemony started asking around first."
entries.zh:
"我从某些人那里得到了一些信息。对，这就是我的工作 —— 去调查谁在 Isirah 星系里搞小动作，以及他们是为谁而行动。"

$HeOrShe凑得离通讯设备更近了一些，轻声说道："听说 英仙座联盟 最近到处打听一个叫 'Coureuse' 的人，因为 霸主 率先对此展开了调查。"

entries.en:
"No she didn't. Get lost."

The pirate boss slaps at the comms console and the line disconnects, leaving you staring at static over nothing.
entries.zh:
"不，她没有，滚。"

海盗头子轻拍了一下通讯控制台，通讯就被断开了，你眼前的屏幕除了噪点以外只剩一片漆黑。

o.en: I'm looking for someone called Scylla Coureuse.
o.zh: 我在找一个叫 Scylla Coureuse 的人。

o.en: Meet the Archon and visit the safehouse of Scylla Coureuse
o.zh: 与执政官碰面并去安全屋拜访 Scylla Coureuse。

entries.en: The archon's eyes find the package of krill paste tucked under one of your arms (Sub-Kay brand, blue-bar special). $HeOrShe raises an eyebrow but makes no comment.
entries.zh: 执政官注意到你腋下夹着一包磷虾酱 ('Sub-Kay 牌，蓝调酒吧特供)。$HeOrShe挑了挑眉毛，但没有作任何评论。

entries.en: You step off your shuttle to meet the grim-faced Archon $personLastName and $hisOrHer entourage. You are introduced to the other six members of the Laicaille Executive Council; the archon assures you of their full support, though a surreptitious eye roll by one of the council members in the back suggests that the archon's enthusiasm is not shared by all.
entries.zh: 你走下穿梭机，并见到了一脸严肃的 $personLastName 执政官以及$hisOrHer的随行人员。接着你被介绍给了 Laicaille 执行委员会的其他六名成员，执政官向你保证他们会全力支持你，但你注意到其中一人偷偷翻了个白眼，看起来并不是所有人都和执政官一样对此无比热情。

entries.en: "I don't know anyone by the name. If this query does not concern station business, I'm going to become very disappointed, captain," $heOrShe glances at a readout, "Whoever you are."
entries.zh: "我不认识她。如果你的问题与空间站的事务无关，我会非常失望的。" $heOrShe瞥了一眼一旁的某种读数，"不论你是谁。"

entries.en:
"I don't know anyone by the name. If this query does not concern station business then..." $HeOrShe glances at a readout. "Demarchon."

$HisOrHer tone becomes somewhat more respectful. "$PlayerSirOrMadam. This is Laicaille. We try to handle our own business and not get involved in yours."
entries.zh:
"我不认识叫这个名字的人。如果这项查询不涉及空间站事务，那么..." $heOrShe瞥了眼读数，"统领大人。"

$hisOrHer的语气变得稍显恭敬。"$playerSirOrMadam，这里是 Laicaille。我们会尽力处理自己的事务，不介入您的纠纷。"

entries.en:
The $post holds up $hisOrHer hand to stop you before you can even lay the groundwork.

"A wonderful story, I'm sure. Unfortunately I am very busy looking after the safety of this station and the surrounding volume. Between Pathers, pirates, and imaginative independent operators, the few resources given to me by the League are stretched very thin indeed. If you want to help, pay your tariffs, keep your transponder on, and stay out of trouble, thank-you captain."

There is barely a moment between the end of $hisOrHer speech and termination of the comms link.
entries.zh:
你甚至还没来得及解释来此的原因，$post 就抬手打断了你。

"我敢肯定你有个十分精彩的故事要讲。但很遗憾，我正忙于保持这空间站和周围星区的安全，毕竟有太多的左径分子、海盗和怀揣大胆想法的自由人士正对我的辖区虎视眈眈，而 英仙座联盟 给我的资源实在是太有限了。如果你想帮忙，记得好好支付关税、保持应答器开启、别随便惹麻烦，感谢你的合作。"

在$hisOrHer的演说结束和通讯链接终止之间几乎没有任何空档。

entries.en:
The $post holds up $hisOrHer hand, stopping you before you begin. "Please, demarchon."

"Unfortunately I am very busy looking after the safety of this station and the surrounding volume. Between Pathers, pirates, and imaginative independent operators, the few resources given to me by the League are stretched thin."

A pause. Then, giving you a apologetic look $heOrShe says, "If you want to make an official inquiry... talk to the archon. You'll find them in the comm directory."
entries.zh:
$post举起$hisOrHer的手，在你开口前制止道，"请理解，统领大人。"

"但很遗憾，我正忙于保持这空间站和周围星区的安全，毕竟有太多的左径分子、海盗和怀揣大胆想法的自由人士正对我的辖区虎视眈眈，而 英仙座联盟 给我的资源实在是太有限了。"

场面陷入了片刻沉默，接着，$heOrShe向你投来歉意的目光，"如果您想进行正式的质询...请联系执政官，您可以在通讯目录里找到他们。"

entries.en:
"Okay. But I need-" Coureuse looks over her workbenches, computing array, and projects in various states of completion, "My, um, things."

You inform her that you have a special team that's well practiced in moving delicate scientific equipment. In fact, you'll introduce her to your ops chief to make arrangements right now...
entries.zh:
"好吧。但我得带走 ——" Coureuse 看了看她的工作台、计算机阵列和进展到不同程度的项目，"我的，嗯，东西。"

你通知她，你有一个在搬运精密科学设备方面经验丰富的团队。事实上，你正准备将她介绍给你的行动长官以便进行此项工作。

entries.en:
Within the hour, with the full cooperation of the Laicaille Executive Council and the station quartermaster, you have Scylla Coureuse and her equipment packed and transported to your $shipOrFleet.

Next stop, Galatia Academy Station. Baird always gets her way.
entries.zh:
一小时之内，在 Laicaille 执行委员会和空间站军需官的全力配合下，你成功把 Scylla Coureuse 和她打包好的设备带到了你的$shipOrFleet中。

下一站，回到 Galatia 学院空间站，去见那个总是能随心所欲的 Baird。

entries.en:
"Hmm, no ship by that name has come through recently," $heOrShe taps at a console.

"No, I'm afraid not. I don't believe I can help you find your lost ship, captain."
entries.zh:
"唔，最近还没有这个名字的船出现在这附近过。" $heOrShe轻敲着桌上的控制台。

"确实没有，恐怕我不能帮你找到你丢失的船了，舰长。"

o.en: No, I'm not looking for a ship. She's a person.
o.zh: 不，我可没在找一艘船。那是个人的名字。

o.en: Um. Thank you for your time.

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks up at you. "Ah, of course. You'll want to query the station's public comm directory. Good day, citizen. Stay vigilant!"

Before you can respond, the comm link terminates and you find yourself staring at the crest of the Persean League Fleet.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe抬头看着你。"啊，当然。如果是想找人的话，我想查询空间站的公共通讯目录会是个不错的主意。再见，公民。保持警惕！"

在你还来得及回应之前通讯线路就中断了，你面前只剩一个旋转的 英仙座联盟 舰队徽标。

o.en: I'm looking for a Scylla Coureuse.

entries.en:
"Oh, is that right? What is it, more black boxes to deliver to a 'need-to-know' location, and you need me to override station protocol?"
