"Written orders." $HeOrShe swipes with $hisOrHer hand to underline the point. "No exceptions. I told you people this before. If anything goes wrong during intra-station transport of Ludd-knows-what you people are stowing away in your secret warehouse, it'll be my head in the airlock."
entries.zh:
"哦，是吗？那又是什么？需要运送更多的秘密物品到一个 '你不用知道' 的位置，而现在你需要我覆写空间站安全协议吗？"

"给我书面命令。" $HeOrShe在空中划着$hisOrHer的手来强调重点，"不能有例外。我之前和你们说过了，在空间站内运输你们藏在秘密仓库里的...卢德才知道是什么鬼的东西的过程中，一旦出了什么问题，我就得人头落地。"

o.en: Right, of course. I'll be back with those.
o.zh: 好吧，当然，我会带着书面命令回来的。

o.en: Wait, what's this about a secret warehouse?
I'm going to have to insist! (bluff)
o.zh: 我有非得这么做的理由！ (虚张声势)

entries.en:
The $post looks at you almost apologetically. Almost.

"Not with that crew, huh? Good. You should have received customs and tariff forms automatically. Did you have some other business with my office?"
entries.zh:
$post 看向你的眼神几乎带上了几分歉意...几乎。

"你不是和那帮人一起的，对吧？行，你应该会自动收到报关单和关税表。现在你还有什么业务需要我帮忙的？"

entries.en: "No exceptions," $HeOrShe says pointedly, then shuts off $hisOrHer end of the link, leaving you staring at the crest of Laicaille Habitat.
entries.zh: "不能有例外，" $HeOrShe直截了当地这么说着，从$hisOrHer的那端关闭了通讯链接，你只能对着 Laicaille 栖息地的徽标干瞪眼。

entries.en:
Archon $personLastName speaks a quiet word into $hisOrHer commband and a small squad of diversely equipped Laicaille militia appears.

"Captain, let's go see that safehouse," $heOrShe says, and turns to lead your party toward a station transport shaft.
entries.zh:
执政官对着$hisOrHer的通讯环轻声说了一句话。不一会，一小队装备各异的 Laicaille 民兵抵达了你们的所在地。

"舰长，一起去看看那个安全屋吧。" $heOrShe说道，然后转身带路前往空间站的交通井。

entries.en: Coureuse looks at you with eyes hardened, and gives an ironic half-smile. "Baird always gets her way, didn't you know?"
entries.zh: Coureuse 直直地瞪着你，脸上挂着讽刺的微笑。"你应该知道的，Baird 总是能随心所欲。"

entries.en:
The safehouse is a low-rent commercial warehouse in a medium-security volume of this station ring. The thin bulkheads leave you just within earshot of the thudding bass of the twilit entertainment concourse a couple sections over.

As a score of officials and station militia approach the entrance of the safehouse - a standard cargo lock - a trio of lounging League agents leap to their feet.
entries.zh:
安全屋是一个租金很低的商业仓库，位于这个空间站环带中安全级别只是中等的扇区。过薄的舱壁甚至不能很好地阻隔娱乐广场上那低音贝斯发出的噪音 —— 哪怕那远在几个区段之外。

当你们接近安全屋那看起来就像个普通货仓门的入口时，三个懒散的 联盟 特工跳了起来。

entries.en:
The station archon strides forward, and channeling the resentment you stoked, harangues the League agents for endangering the station, stomping on the rights of League citizenry, and above all gross incompetence.

The young Kazeronian agent in command wipes a drop of sweat from their forehead, "Archon, we've got this. League security demands-"

"No, you don't got this. This operation is riddled with leaks," the archon glances briefly at you, "And your meltdown of an operation is a direct threat to our security. Laicaille Habitat is exerting its sovereign rights in this matter as of now, with the full support of the executive council."
entries.zh:
空间站执政官大步向前，任由你所激起的愤恨支配，厉声痛斥联盟特工们危害空间站安全并践踏 英仙座联盟 公民权利的行为，以及最恶劣的 —— 彻头彻尾的无能。

领队的年轻 Kazeron 特工擦了擦额头上渗出的汗水："执政官，事件仍在我们掌控下。为了确保 英仙座联盟 的内部安全 ——"

"看看你们 '掌控' 了什么东西！这次的行动根本是漏洞百出。" 执政官简短地瞥了你一眼，"你们在这次行动中的所作所为已经对我们的安全构成了严重的威胁。在执行委员会的全力支持下，Laicaille 栖息地将接管此事。"

entries.en:
The League agent lowers their wavering pistol, and at that, the flanking agents lose the strength of their composure.

The archon takes the agent's pistol, checks the safety, then shoves the agent away, leading you to the airlock. The control panel gives way to executive override codes, and the archon motions for you to pass through the armored doorway.
entries.zh:
联盟特工放下了颤抖的手枪。站在侧边的特工看到这场面，也失去了那股冷静的威压。

执政官夺过特工的手枪并检查了保险。他大手一挥推开前面的特工，带着你走向气闸门。随着控制面板被执行官的授权代码解锁，他示意你通过装甲门。

entries.en:
A woman stands before you, holding a datapad, looking quizzically at the newcomers.

You look around the dark space, taking in the shadowy equipment racks, humming machines, and cargo crates. A small zero-G style hab pod in the corner must be her domestic space.
entries.zh:
一个拿着数据平板的女人站在你面前，疑惑地看着没见过的到访者。

你环顾着这黑暗的空间，看到了阴暗的设备架，货箱以及嗡嗡作响的机器。角落里一个零重力风格的小生活舱看起来便是她的私人空间了。

o.zh: 我猜你就是 Scylla Coureuse 了。

entries.en:
"Yes. That's me," she says cautiously. "And... Archon $personLastName. This is unexpected. To what do I owe the honor?"

The archon nods toward you, "Captain $playerName. Who has a way of poking around in other people's business. Now it's your turn."
entries.zh:
"是的，就是我。" 她小心翼翼地说。"还有...$personLastName 执政官。这可有些突然，是什么风把您吹来了？"

"这位到处打听别人的事的 $playerName 舰长。" 执政官向你点点头，"该你说话了。"

entries.en: Coureuse spots the package of krill paste under your arm. "Is that... Sub-Kay blue-bar? Where- how did you-"
entries.zh: Coureuse 注意到了你腋下的磷虾酱包，"那是...蓝调酒吧的 Sub-Kay？你从哪 —— 怎么 —— "

o.zh: 一份来自 Elissa 的礼物。

entries.en:
Coureuse breaks into a smile of genuine joy.

"Of course! We always talked about how bad it smelled, but nothing is as good." She takes it, almost caressing the plastic while lost in some memory. She returns to herself with a start, "Oh, I'm sorry, just. Old times." She puts the package on a workbench, "Please, explain. Why are you here?"
entries.zh:
Coureuse 露出了由衷的喜悦微笑。

"当然！我们总是说它有多难闻，实际上对我们来说没有比它更好吃的东西了。" 她接过了磷虾酱包，抚摸着它的塑料包装，沉浸在一些记忆中。接着她回过神来："哦，对不起，只是...昔日时光罢了。" 她把那东西放到了工作台上，"请解释一下吧，你为什么来这里？"

o.en: I have a message for you.
I have a message for you.

entries.en:
Archon $personLastName eyes you, a nonverbal inquiry about whether $heOrShe is intruding, and concludes that $heOrShe is.

"I'll let you two speak privately. Citizen Coureuse, I am informing you that you are now under the direct protection of the Laicaille Executive Council. We shall ensure your safety on this station, and," $heOrShe casts a glance back at the League agents, "And ensure your right to freedom of movement as per the Persean League Charter."

As if just remembering its existence, the archon slips the League agent's pistol into $hisOrHer belt, nods, and steps toward the ongoing shouting match back in the airlock.

"Baird wants me back, doesn't she." Coureuse crosses her arms.
entries.zh:
$personLastName 执政官向你递了个眼神，似乎是在询问$heOrShe还呆在这是不是有些不太合适 —— 答案显然是肯定的。

"我还是让你们两位单独谈谈吧。公民 Coureuse，我现在正式告知你，你目前受到 Laicaille 执行委员会的直接保护。我们将确保你在这个空间站的安全，并且..." $heOrShe回头看了一眼联盟特工，"遵照 英仙座联盟 宪章，确保你享有行动自由。"

执政官把特工的手枪塞回到$hisOrHer的腰带里，好像刚注意到这把枪的存在似的。$heOrShe点了点头，转身走向气闸里正在吵架的两拨人。

"Baird 想把我弄回去，是吧？" Coureuse 双手抱在胸前，没好气地问道。

o.en: Give her Baird's message on your datapad
o.zh: 将你那显示着 Baird 的信息的数据平板交给她。

entries.en: You pass the datapad to Coureuse, and she takes it to a chair set at a workstation a few meters away, activating a privacy field that dulls the sound and blurs her image.
entries.zh: 你把数据平板递给 Coureuse，她拿着数据平板坐到了几米外的工作站椅子上，并激活了一个能消音和阻碍视线的隐私场。

entries.en: You hear muffled speech, Baird's tone is unmistakable. The indistinct outline of Coureuse is still, listening. Then, when Baird's speech ends, it slumps in the chair as if all will had been drained away.
entries.zh: 你听到了含混不清的说话声，不过毫无疑问是 Baird 的语调。Coureuse 模糊的轮廓就这样一动不动地默默听着。当 Baird 的说话声停下来时，那个轮廓猛然瘫倒在椅子上，仿佛里面所有的意志全都被抽走了。

entries.en: You turn to examine the workshop: racks of sub-AI processing cores sleep in coolant cradles, festooned with wires. An agrav-equipped overhead winch holds a machine casing in safety locks above a macroassembler with its modular components exposed. The workbench nearby holds several multipurpose engineering arms hovering over some device, its innards arranged like an exploded engineering diagram.
entries.zh: 你转过头来开始仔细打量起这个工坊：一排排的亚 AI 处理核心被安放在冷却槽里，上面缀满了线路。天花板上配备有反重力装置的绞车用几个安全栓挂着一套机器外壳，下面则是模块化组件全暴露在外的物质组装器。旁边的工作台上有几只多用途工程臂悬在一些设备上方，内部被摆放得像一张工程分解图一样。

entries.en:
A couple minutes later, the privacy field collapses and Coureuse emerges. She looks tired.

She hands the datapad back to you, and says "I'll come with you."
entries.zh:
几分钟后，隐私场解除，Coureuse 的轮廓变得清晰起来，她看上去很累。

她把数据平板还给了你："我会和你一起走的。"

entries.en:
"And you see before you the completion of his greatest work!" You shout and posture like an operatic villain, "A weapon more beautiful in its blasphemy than any before seen!"

You grow quiet and menacing, leaning in to the comms pickup and nearly growling, "We call it the 'Soul Eater', and it does just what you think- splits the purity of our material body from the soul given to you by your Creator. It transforms your Creator's so-called gift of human life - human servitude! - into a life of faithless meat-machines."
entries.zh:
"而你们面对的是那最伟大的杰作！" 你故作姿态，宛如歌剧中的反派头目登场一样大吼到，"一件完美的武器！它亵渎神明的方式简直是前所未见，美轮美奂！"

你让危险的气氛安静地酝酿了一小会儿，然后跨步上前，对着通讯拾音器近乎咆哮的喊道："'噬魂者'！我们这样称呼它。和你们想的一样，这东西会将造物主给你们的灵魂粉碎干净，只留下你们纯洁的肉体！它彻底结束造物主赋予你们的所谓人生，彻底摆脱那些人间的磨难！让你们转生成信仰尽失的血肉机器！"

entries.en:
You allow a slow smile to cross your face, "You see, with no soul, there is no good, no evil, no faith, no sin. We have found true freedom."

"And soon you will join us. Then, you will see too with eyes unclouded by 'faith'."

"Prepare the weapon!", you stand and shout to your tactical officer, who simply gapes at you. "Set power to maximum," you wink, hoping they pick up on it "- so we can tear the souls from all human beings within three light-minutes of our position!"
entries.zh:
随后你让一丝微笑缓缓地掠过了自己的脸。"你们看，没有灵魂，就没有善，没有恶，没有信仰，没有罪孽。我们已经找到了真正的自由。"

"而很快你们就会加入我们。用你不再被 '信仰' 蒙蔽的双眼见证这一切。"

"准备好武器！"，你站起来对战术军官喊道，但对方还没反应过来，只是瞪着眼睛看着你。"把功率调到最大，" 你使了个眼色，希望对方配合你的演出，"让我们把周围三光分内所有人的灵魂全数粉碎！"

entries.en:
You continue to rant as your bridge officers finally arrive at the idea of charging shields and drive fields in a resonance that looks impressive to standard sensors but will amount to nothing.

The Pather captain gives panicked orders to retreat then makes a sign of prayer as sweat quivers on $hisOrHer brow. Finally someone on the Pather bridge thinks to turn the comms off, ending the sad display.
entries.zh:
你继续在舰桥里咆哮，舰桥军官也终于领会了你的意图。他们立即想出了个主意，开始对护盾和驱动场进行共振充能。这样做虽然没什么实际意义，但会在标准传感器上产生非常引人注目的能量读数。

左径舰长惊慌失措地下令撤退，然后做了一个祈祷的手势，汗水在$hisOrHer的额头上颤抖。最后，左径舰桥上的某个人想到要关闭通讯，结束了这场可悲的闹剧。

entries.en:
"Um. Captain, $playerSirOrMadam," your tactical officer reports, "They've reversed course."

You nod, and smooth out your uniform.
entries.zh:
"呃，舰长$playerSirOrMadam，" 战术军官报告说，"对方调转航向了。"

你点点头，伸手抚平了制服。

entries.en:
The comms crackle to life, and the Pather captain stands defiant before you.

"The desecrators return! You are a slave to Moloch, an addict to the knowledge denied you. You return here to tend your evil workings. And you dare," the Pather shouts in a frenzy now, "You dare to knock at the door of the Creator! Who are you, Galatian?"

$HeOrShe does not wait for a reply, "In the light of the dying fires of your starships- only there will we seek peace."
entries.zh:
通讯器噼里啪啦地响了起来，左径的舰长挑衅地站在你面前。

"亵渎者回来了！你这恶魔摩洛克的奴隶，沉迷在那些你不配拥有的知识里。你回到这里只会继续作恶。你胆敢，" 左径教徒狂热地喊道，"你竟然敢敲响造物主的门扉！你是谁，是 Galatia 学院的人？"

$HeOrShe并没有打算听你回话。"只有在你们星舰沉没的火光中 —— 我们才能得到安宁。"

o.en: You're right, I do serve Moloch... (bluff)
o.zh: 你说对了，我确实是摩洛克的仆人... (虚张声势)

entries.en:
"The time for talk ended with Ludd's life! Show now your hollow faith, Molochian!

The comms shut off in a flurry of electronic warfare alerts.
entries.zh:
"谈话就像卢德的生命一样结束了！现在看看你空洞的信仰能做什么，摩洛克的信徒！"

通讯在一片电子战的警报声中关闭了。

entries.en:
You meet your tech officer in a briefing room. They've already unfolded a portable workstation and connected a holoprojector to present findings.

The probe contains a cluster of redundant cores grouped into a small network; a holo-cloud of connected glyphs rotates slowly: navigation and stationholding thrusters; power supply and thermostability; rad sensors and civ-grade field emitters.

Tech finishes the overview, then with a sly smile sets half the icons aside and upscales the remaining, revealing sub-icons identifying particular research project packages. "Now here's the good stuff," they say.

Yellow warning glyphs denote packages that do not follow the Galatia Academy specs you have on-file.
entries.zh:
你在简报室里见到了技术军官，他们已经展开了便携式工作站，并连接了一个全息投影仪来介绍调查结果。

该探测器由一组冗余计算核心组成的小型网络构成；一团相连的字符在空间中央缓缓旋转：导航系统和轨控发动机；电池和恒温系统；雷达传感器和民用级的立场发生器。

技术军官将一半的图标挪去一边，把剩余的图标放大，找到特定研究项目的子图标。"现在可找到点好东西，" 他说。

黄色的警告字样表示这是一个不符合你们备案中 Galatia 学院规范的项目。

entries.en:
"What's most interesting is... this one," Tech says, bringing an unknown package into focus. "There's a modified hyperdrive core in there, the kind a very small starship might use."

With a few key presses and a wave, the component icon explodes out into something like a glowing circuit diagram embedded in the shadow of the probe's schematics.

"It's like a hyperwave comms relay on combat stims." A tone of admiration emerges, "Beautiful work. No idea how they stabilize pulse strength on such cheap hardware."
entries.zh:
"有趣的是...这个。" 你的技术军官说着，把一个未知的套件挪到屏幕中间，"这里面有一个改造过的超空间引擎核心，是小型星舰会用的那种。"

随着几个键的按下，一挥手，组件图标骤然展开，化作一幅嵌入探测器结构图阴影中的发光电路示意图。

"这就像打了战斗兴奋剂的超波通讯中继器。" 对方的语气中流露出赞叹，"精妙绝伦。不知道他们是如何在如此廉价的硬件上稳定脉冲强度的。"

o.en: So who's it talking to? Where are they?
o.zh: 那它在和谁通话？他们人在哪？

entries.en:
Tech blinks, as if this was hardly a consideration in the light of such interesting engineering. "Um. It's not precisely a question of 'where' when we're speaking of hyperspace... "

You give the withering look which prompts what your underlings refer to behind your back as an 'executive summary'.

"What I mean to say is, we'll need to interface with a couple more probes like this to be able to pinpoint the transmission target within hyperspectral... we need to find two more probes. Then we'll know. $PlayerSirOrMadam."

One down, two to go.
entries.zh:
你明确表示，尽管这技术很吸引人，但你对它的信号到底指向哪里更感兴趣。

技术人员眨了眨眼，看起来像是听到了个基本不会考虑的问题。"呃，当我们说到超空间的时候，这并不是一个确切的关于 '哪里' 的问题..." 你用眼神止住了他的话头，提示他们赶紧做一种被你下属背地里称为 "执行总结" 的报告。

"...啊，我的意思是，我们需要与更多像这样的探测器对接，以便能够用超光谱确定传输目标...简单来说，我们还需要再找到两个探测器，就可得到结果，$PlayerSirOrMadam。"

已找到一个，还差两个。

entries.en:
A salvage crew is dispatched under your operations chief's watchful eye. Using codes provided by Provost Baird, the team opens the probe to install a short-range relay which allows your technicians full reign of the probe's data environment.

Tech reports feed active; the probe's hull is sealed with a few quick bursts of a plasma torch. Your ops chief recalls the salvage crew.
entries.zh:
在行动长官的监督下，一支打捞小组被派了出去。该小组用 Baird 院长提供的各种代码打开了探测器，并安装了一个短程中继器，使技术人员能够完全监测探测器的数据环境。

技术人员反馈启动成功。随着一阵离子焊枪的闪光，探测器的外壳被密封。行动长官召回了打捞人员。

o.en: Get a sitrep from the tech team
o.zh: 从技术小队那里获取情况说明

entries.en:
All crews perform their job with exemplary efficiency; your salvage team reports that an interface was successfully installed, and they've handed off control to your tech team who are already investigating the probe remotely.

"Hyperwave analysis is not a merely linear process," your tech officer explains. "We will need one more data set to complete the... hmm, well it isn't triangulation, but you can think of it like that if it helps. Um."

They clear their throat. "Captain. $PlayerSirOrMadam."

You dismiss them to return to their work. Two down, one to go.
entries.zh:
所有船员都以模范般的效率完成了他们的工作，打捞小组报告已经成功安装了接口，并将控制权移交给技术团队，他们正在远程调查这个探测器。

"超波分析不是一个简单的线性过程。" 你的技术军官解释说，"现在还差一个数据集才能完成...嗯，它不是三角测量，但可能有点类似，对。"

他们清了清嗓子。"舰长。$PlayerSirOrMadam。"

你让他们继续作业。两个数据集的输入已经完成，还需要最后一个。

entries.en:
This is the third time undertaking this operation so your crews know exactly what to do, and do it quickly.

The schematics of the third probe float before you in the briefing room.

"Our tinkerer has been at work," your tech officer explains, highlighting the ghostly specs of a highly modified miniature hyperdrive core, "Here we see much the same setup as previous examples, but they've made a few improvements."
entries.zh:
这是他们第三次干这种事，所以你的船员完全知道该怎么做，而且做得很好。

简报室中，第三个探测器的结构图漂浮在你面前。

"我们的工程师一直在工作，" 技术军官解释说，同时一个高度改良的微型超空间驱动核心的诡异形制被突出显示，"在这里，我们看到与之前的基本相同的配置，但又做了一些改进。"

entries.en:
Tangles of inscrutably annotated component icons are highlighted.

"You can see here, and here. A collection of parts from a... a variety of sources." Tech skims through the holo-model, rapt.

"Some of this is officially restricted Hegemony miltech. And see here? This might be a piece of Tri-Tachyon black hardware..."
entries.zh:
错综复杂、标注晦涩的组件图标被高亮显示。

"您看这里，还有这里。这是来自...多种渠道的零件集合。" 技官专注地翻阅着全息模型。

"其中部分属于 霸主 官方管制的军用科技。再看这里？这可能是 速子科技 黑色硬件的部件..."

entries.en:
The salvors operate a maintenance drone to make cuts in the hull at a standard access point. After the flash of plasma goes dark, the drone swivels its spotlights to reveal... nothing.

The probe hull is empty aside from dangling rough-cut ends of conduits. Someone has completely cleaned out the internal hardware chassis.

"It wasn't long ago," your sensors officer reports. "Radar sweep for debris spread from intrusion incident shows minimal spread. Whoever did this, they're probably still in-system."

In system. With the probe hardware you need.
entries.zh:
打捞员们操作着一架维修无人机，对船体上的一个标准对接口进行切割。在等离子体的闪光消失后，无人机转动其聚光灯，发现里面...什么也没有。

除了被粗暴切断的导管末端还悬在里面之外，探测器是空的。已经有人清空了内部的硬件。

"应该没过多久，" 你的传感器技官报告道，"雷达对上一个入侵者造成的碎片的扩散轨迹进行了扫描，显示出扩散幅度较小。不管是谁干的，他们很可能还在星系内。"

这个星系内有人带着你需要的硬件。

entries.en:
The salvors operate a maintenance drone to make cuts in the hull at a standard access point. After the flash of plasma goes dark, the drone swivels its spotlights to reveal... nothing.

The probe hull is empty aside from dangling rough-cut ends of conduits. Someone has completely cleaned out the internal hardware chassis.

"Radar sweep for debris spread from intrusion incident shows minimal spread," your sensors officer reports. "Very recent. Must be the casing of the probe those scavengers looted."

Then there's nothing more to do here.
entries.zh:
打捞员们操作着一架维修无人机，对船体上的一个标准对接口进行切割。在等离子体的闪光消失后，无人机转动其聚光灯，发现里面...什么也没有。

除了悬空的粗略切割的导管末端，探测器里面是空的。已经有人清空了内部的全部硬件。

"就在不久之前，" 你的传感器技官报告道，"雷达对上一个入侵者造成的碎片的扩散轨迹进行了扫描，显示出扩散幅度较小。非常新，一定是在附近搜刮的那些拾荒者干的。"

看来在这里没什么能干的了。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches the probe. It is not transmitting an active transponder ID, and when your comms officer performs a direct transponder ping there is no return.

A scan reveals unusually low mass according to the probe's specs. You order a salvage crew to deploy and investigate - carefully.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了探测器。它并没有主动广播应答器 ID，也没有在你的通讯军官请求应答器直接回应时返回任何信号。

扫描发现，相比起探测器的尺寸，它的质量异常的低。你派出了一个打捞小组仔细调查。

entries.en:
"Um," the tech notices a certain time-sensitive implication in your voice. "This is good. Very good. We got a much more accurate read for the meta-array, which, um." Frantic tapping at a TriPad.

"It looks like... an orbit somewhere in the Isirah system. Whoever is running these things, that's where their receiver is."
entries.zh:
"嗯..." 技术人员注意到你的举止，"这很好。非常好。我们得到了一个更准确的元阵列的读数，这，嗯..." 他疯狂地敲击着 TriPad。

"它看起来像是...在 Isirah 星系的某处的一个轨道上。不管是谁在操作这些东西，他的接收器就在那里。"

o.en: What would this receiver look like?
o.zh: 这个接收器是什么样子的？

entries.en:
Your tech officer thinks for a moment.

"It wouldn't be as large as a normal comm array. There's very clever miniaturization here - fragile, yes, if stealth is the goal... Whoever built this used scavenged parts. Wild variety of sources. Maybe pirate? But more sophisticated than any pirate work I've seen."
entries.zh:
你的技术军官思考了一会。

"它不会像普通的通信阵列那样大。想必有非常聪明的小型化改造 —— 虽然会很精密而脆弱，但保持隐秘才是它的设计目的。我们的工程师认为它似乎使用了搜刮来的零件。各种各样的来源，也许是海盗的？至少比我们见过的海盗搞的更复杂。"

entries.en:
"The receiver would show up as a neutrino source, just like any starship drive or civilian reactor. The hyperwave effects would be - well, it couldn't be placed somewhere populated, that's for sure. So this hyperwave comm relay would then tightbeam to the final receiver, whoever was listening, presumably. If we found the relay, we would know whoever is at the other end of this thing is nearby."

Stable orbit, neutrino source, uninhabited. The Isirah system.
entries.zh:
"接收器会像任何恒星引擎或民用反应堆那样显示为中微子源。超波效应则会 —— 嗯，总之肯定不能设在人口密集区。所以这个超波通讯中继站会窄波束传输给最终接收方，无论监听者是谁。如果我们找到了中继站，就能确定这玩意的另一端必然在附近。"

稳定轨道、中微子源、无人居住。答案是 Isirah 星系。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches the probe. Your comms officer performs an active transponder request and identifies the probe as property of the Galatia Academy with a serial number matching equipment assigned to Coureuse's hyperspace physics group.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了探测器。通讯军官发出了一道主动应答器请求，确认该探测器是 Galatia 学院的财产，其序列号与分配给 Coureuse 的超空间物理组的设备相匹配。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches the probe. It is not transmitting an active transponder ID, but when your comms officer performs a direct ping, the return identifies the probe as property of the Galatia Academy. This is followed by a block of legal language threatening fines and alluding to unspecified dangers inherent in tampering with said property.

You suspect that these mere words, a ghost of an EM pulse sent across cold vacuum, would dissuade few of the outer systems scavengers you've crossed paths with.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了探测器。它并没有传回有效的应答器 ID，但当通讯军官主动呼叫应答器时，返回的结果表明该探测器是 Galatia 学院的财产。随后是一段法律宣言，警告对破坏行为的罚款，并指出对设备进行修改有潜在的不明危险。

你怀疑这些仅仅只是文字，只是一个穿过寒冷真空而来的电磁脉冲幽灵而无实际约束，大概劝阻不了你所接触过的边缘星区拾荒者。

entries.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, preventing you from sending an EVA team to examine the probe.
entries.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法派出舱外活动小组去检查探测器。

entries.en:
A common class of probe used for research, surveying, and surveillance. There is no active transponder, but your comms officer's active ping returns an ID-packet bearing codes for the Galatia Academy.

EM leakage suggests functioning subsystems, perhaps collecting telemetry for some esoteric research project.
entries.zh:
一种常用于科研、勘探与监视的通用型探测器。虽然没有激活的应答器，但你的通讯军官发出的主动扫描收到了载有 Galatia 学院识别代码的数据包。

电磁泄漏的状况表明其子系统仍在运作，可能正在为某个深奥的研究项目收集遥测数据。

entries.en: The commsplate clicks off, replacing Bione's face with the dancing Seabank Oasis mascot, which reminds you that unregistered guests will be asked to leave the exurb at the end of the workshift.
entries.zh: 通讯面板跳转，跳舞的海堤绿洲吉祥物取代了 Bione 的脸，它提醒你，未登记的客人将在工作结束时被要求离开郊区。

o.en: Can you tell me about Scylla herself?
o.zh: 你能告诉我关于 Scylla 本人的情况吗

o.en: Who exactly came by before and questioned you?
o.zh: 是谁在之前拜访你问这些问题的

o.en: Tell me about this 'Agent Finlay' who spoke with you.
o.zh: 告诉我这个与你谈话的 'Finlay 特工' 的信息。

o.en: Just make sure you're seen by any observers

entries.en: Elissa Zal. This name is a new connection. You make a quick note on your TriPad.
entries.zh: Elissa Zal，这个名字是新的线索，你在 TriPad 上迅速记下了这些信息。

entries.en:
"Some among their ranks, yes," a hint of smile forms on Baird's face, "But others see that this is the way forward. The League can't pull the best and brightest from the entire Sector. The Galatia Academy can. They don't have the theoretical research and experimentation infrastructure we do. It's all practical matters with their Fleet Armamentarium; weapons, warships, heavy industry, and doling out contracts to gens-allies."

"Furthermore, subfactions within the League could not call an open vote on a matter so delicate as this. We merely resolved their political questions by other means," the provost tips her head toward you, acknowledging your role.
entries.zh:
"是的，他们中的一些人会。" Baird 的脸上流露出一丝笑意，"但其他人知道这其实能让星域更快地向前发展 —— 英仙座联盟 无法从整个星域中找出最优秀最聪明的人，但 Galatia 学院可以，再者他们也没有我们的理论研究基础和专业实验设备 —— 这可是与他们的舰队武器库有关的实际问题，武器、战舰、重工业，以及与盟国签订的各种合同。"

"此外，联盟内部的各派不能就这样一个微妙的问题要求公开投票，我们只是用其他方式解决了他们的政治问题。" 院长歪过头来看了你一眼，承认了你在事情发展中扮演的角色。

entries.en:
Through the silence, you can almost hear Baird thinking.

The transport pod hisses to a halt, and you feel the subtle shift of agrav fields. You step off and note that this seems to be a back entrance which allows Baird to avoid the waiting room full of important people unused to being told to wait.
entries.zh:
在一片寂静中，你几乎可以听到 Baird 脑子转动的声音。

运输舱在刹车的杂音中停下了，你能感觉到重力场发生的微妙变化。走下运输舱后，你注意到这似乎是后门，可以让 Baird 避开那间满是重要人物的等候室，毕竟那些人可不习惯被要求等候。

entries.en:
Baird looks at you for a long moment. You think you see something new. Something almost like emotional pain.

"Scylla never appreciated the gifts I... the academy offered her. It's how she was raised, perhaps. Her insubordination was indulged. Became habitual. But with time, when she sees what we accomplish, maybe her higher sense of rationality will win out. I know she is capable of it."

Baird turns, staring forward, and sets her jaw.
entries.zh:
Baird 注视了你很长时间。你感觉你在她脸上看到了前所未有的表情，似乎是某种感情上的痛苦。

"Scylla 从来没有对我... 对学院向她提供的机会表达过感激。也许，她就是这样长大的。她的不服从被纵容着。久而久之成为了习惯。但随着时间的推移，当她看到我们所取得的成就时，也许她思维中的理性会占上风。我知道她会回心转意的。"

Baird 转过身，凝视着前方，下巴绷得紧紧的。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet is interrupted in the middle of a standard approach sequence; instead of the usual traffic control chatter, your flagship receives a comm request directly from the office of the Provost.

"Captain," reports your comms officer, "She wants to speak with you."
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet在排队进入空间站时被打断了，在这种情况下通常会有交通管制通讯，可这一次，取而代之地，你收到了院长办公室的直接通讯。

"舰长，" 通讯军官报告说，"她想和你说话。"

entries.en:
The image of Provost Anahita Baird appears.

"Captain, it is good to see you return, finally. Bring her by shuttle," she says, "Directly to this docking port," a chime signals the receipt of navigation instructions and docking codes. "I'll meet you there."

The comm line shuts off.
entries.zh:
Anahita Baird 的形象出现了。

"舰长，很高兴终于看到你回来了。用穿梭机把她带上，" 她说，"直接带到这个码头，" 与此同时收到导航指示和对接代码的提示音响了起来，"我在那儿等你。"

通讯链接被切断了。

entries.en:
"And," Gargoyle interrupts, "I cracked those Hegemony snooper sats. All reports will be green across the board, no suspicious hyperspace folding going on here, officer!"

Baird nods in acknowledgement again, "Indeed. Gargoyle has been very useful." She turns to you, "And you as well. I anticipate that you will be instrumental in carrying out these experiments to their full effect, as I expect that some will entail... dramatic results."
entries.zh:
"还有，" Gargoyle 插话道，"我已经破解了霸主的监测卫星。它们向霸主提供的所有报告都会是一切正常，这里没有发现任何可疑的超空间折叠，长官！"

Baird 再次点头表示认可，"没错。Gargoyle 非常有用，" 接着她转向了你，"你也一样。我想你会在这些实验的实践阶段中发挥作用，因为我预计一些实验将会有... 戏剧性的结果。"

entries.en: Provost Baird pauses and turns to you, examining your reaction. "You must be wondering what this is all for, captain."
entries.zh: Baird 院长停顿了一下并看向了你，观察起你的反应来，"舰长，你一定很想知道这一切是为了什么。"

o.en: Not really. The pay is good.
You're obviously trying to re-open the Gates.
o.zh: 你显然是想要重启星门。

o.en: Say nothing. You won't fall for this again.
o.zh: 保持沉默。你不会再吃这个亏了。

entries.en:
Gargoyle makes a tiny applause at this revelation, somewhat undermining the gravity of Baird's speech.

Baird ignores this, taps a datapad, and the holoprojector flickers a 3D hyphae map into existence. You recognize the image: a map of the Domain-era gate network within the Persean Sector. A dense spot in one prominent lobe contains what you know as the Core Worlds.

"Or, more precisely, what the Gates can do," Baird says.
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 听了这番话后鼓了鼓掌，这多少削弱了 Baird 话语的压迫感。

Baird 没有理他，她点了点一个数据平板，全息投影仪投射出了一个三维的网状结构地图。你认出了这张图片：这是人之领星门网络在英仙座星域的结构图。在一片很显眼的区域中交织出的密集点就是被人称为核心世界的地方。

"更准确地说，是为了星门能做到的事。" Baird 说。

entries.en: She proceeds without regard for your response, "This is about opening up the galaxy again, captain. Yes, you see it now: the Gates. It was always about the Gates."
entries.zh: 她没有理会你的回答，"舰长，这是为了再次连通整个银河。听到这里你应该知道了：星门。这一切都是为了星门。"

entries.en: She proceeds without regard for your response, "This is about opening up the galaxy again, captain. Yes, you see it now: the Gates. It was always about the Gates."
entries.zh: 她没有理会你的回答，"舰长，这是为了再次连通整个银河。听到这里你应该知道了：星门。这一切都是为了星门。"

entries.en: Almost unconsciously she shoots a look at you, a flash of anger for ruining her moment, before she catches herself. "Yes, captain. And more- this is about opening up the galaxy again. Everything I have done, everything I have worked for has always been about the Gates."
entries.zh: 她几乎是下意识地瞪了你一眼，对你毁了她的美好时光感到愤怒，过了好一会她才回过神来，"对，舰长。更深远的意义是—— 再次连通整个银河。我完成的每件事，我正在为之努力的每件事都是为了星门。"

entries.en: She proceeds without regard for your response, "This is about opening up the galaxy again, captain. Yes, you see it now: the Gates. It was always about the Gates."
entries.zh: 她没有理会你的回答，"舰长，这是为了再次连通整个银河。听到这里你应该知道了：星门。这一切都是为了星门。"

entries.en:
Gargoyle speaks up again, more earnest somehow than usual "Freedom! Imagine that, $playerFirstName. The technology the Domain used to enslave humanity - liberated! The small minds that rule us, they're all still shackled by Domain-mindset. All alike in their own way, Tri-Tach, Ludders, the Hegemony; soulless minions of orthodoxy, all of them!"

"Imagine if we took that all away from them, imagine if anyone could go anywhere and do anything!" Gargoyle cackles, rocking back and forth.
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 又开口了，以不知怎么地比平时更认真的口气说道："自由！想象一下，$playerFirstName。人之领用来奴役人类的技术 —— 获得了解放！那些统治我们的狭隘之辈，他们也依然被人之领时代的思维束缚着。速子、卢德佬、霸主，全都是没有灵魂的奴才！"

"想象一下我们把他们的美梦打碎的情境，想象一下，任何人都可以去任何地方做任何事的时代！" Gargoyle 咯咯地笑了起来，身体前后摇晃着。

entries.en:
You notice that Baird has watched Gargoyle without emotion through this speech. As Gargoyle settles down, becoming distracted by a datapad, the provost speaks to you in a tone of commanding finality, "Return in a week or so, captain. My people need time to work. And you've earned a break."

"But keep your head down. The factions are restless after what you pulled in Isirah."

Baird turns to her desk console, expressions moving across her face as she appears to skim messages. "That is all, captain."

"And Gargoyle," she says after a moment.
entries.zh:
你注意到 Baird 在对方演讲时面无表情地看着 Gargoyle。当 Gargoyle 被数据平板分散了注意力安静下来时，院长用一种命令般的语气对你开口，"一周左右后回来，舰长。我的人需要时间工作，你则应该休息一下。"

"但要保持低调，自从你在 Isirah 搞出一些动静后，各方势力都焦躁不安。"

Baird 看向了桌面控制台，在浏览信息时她脸上阴晴不定，"就这样，舰长。"

"以及，Gargoyle。" 过了一会后她开口道。

o.en: I want to talk about your intentions with this technology.
o.zh: 我想谈谈你对这项科技的意图。

entries.en:
Baird turns from her desk display and looks through you, "There is no 'technology', captain. Merely possibilities. And vast though those possibilities may appear, they are yet mere possibilities."

She turns away again, dismissing you. "We shall speak of this later."

You feel the doors open soundlessly behind you, and the mirror-masked guards presence like a slight rise in static electricity. Time to go. Gargoyle joins you on the way out, giving you a sympathetic look while muttering something.
entries.zh:
Baird 又看向了你，"这可不是什么 '科技'，舰长，只是可能性。可能性再大也只是可能性而已。"

她转过身去开始打发你，"这事我们以后再详谈。"

你感觉到身后的门被悄无声息地打开了，那些戴着镜面面罩的守卫就在附近，像是静电般突兀，是时候动身了。Gargoyle 和你一起离开了办公室，一边同情地看了你一眼一边咕哝着什么。

entries.en:
* * *

You step off the shuttle, thrusters clicking as they cool, followed by Scylla Coureuse. The scientist was quiet on the brief shuttle ride which has returned her to Galatia Academy Station after her time in hiding.

As promised, Provost Baird is waiting with a small group of masked guards and senior advisors. Academician Sebestyen waves as your gaze drifts over him.

"It is so good to have you back with us, Scylla," says Baird.
entries.zh:
伴着推进器冷却时发出的脆响，你走下了穿梭机，Scylla Coureuse 紧随其后。在避开一些耳目后，你终于将她带回到了 Galatia 学院。

正如承诺的那样，Baird 院长早已带着一小队头戴面罩的警卫和高级顾问等候多时。你扫视众人，恰好发现 Sebestyen 院士正冲你招手。

"很高兴你能回到我们的身边，Scylla。" Baird 说道。

o.zh: 装作没看到 Sebestyen 的举动

entries.en:
Coureuse nods to Baird's words, though occupies herself with examining the reception lounge. "It hasn't changed much," she says.

Something in this doesn't please the provost, you think.

"Well," says Baird, "I believe you'll find that quite a lot has changed. Academician Alviss Sebestyen, please come forward- thank you. I understand that you knew Scylla back- " at his vigorous nod, she says "Yes, of course."
entries.zh:
Coureuse 点头赞同了 Baird 的说法，不过她的注意力其实都放在了观察周围的环境上。"看起来没变多少。" 她说道。

你想，这句话大概不会让院长高兴。

"是吗，" Baird 说，"我相信你之后会发现这里其实变了很多。Alviss Sebestyen 院士，到前面来—— 谢谢。我知道你认识 Scylla，就在从前——" 在 Sebestyen 有力地点了点头后，Baird 说，"对，当然。"

entries.en: Sebestyen smiles widely as you wave back. Baird is intent on Coureuse, and makes no acknowledgement.
entries.zh: 当你挥手回意时，Sebestyen 露出了灿烂的笑容。Baird 则将注意力都放在了 Coureuse 上，对此没有察觉。

entries.en:
Sebestyen begins to welcome Coureuse, shaking her hand, and asking about her trip. Coureuse raises an eyebrow at the question, and Baird interrupts, "There will be time for that later, Alviss. Please show the newly reinstated Academician Coureuse to her quarters - then show her the new laboratory."

Baird pauses, seeming to examine Coureuse for a response, but Scylla simply bows her head slightly in acknowledgement without meeting Baird's eyes.

"Scylla, I hope you can thrive here. Again. Please go with Alviss. And... keep an open mind," Baird says.
entries.zh:
Sebestyen 开始热烈欢迎 Coureuse，和她握手，然后询问她的旅途情况。听着听着 Coureuse 就皱起了眉头，随后 Baird 打断他说，"Alviss，以后会有时间让你问的。请带刚复职的 Coureuse 院士到她的住处去 —— 然后带她去看看新的实验室。"

Baird 停顿了一下，似乎在盯着 Coureuse 并等待她回应，但 Scylla 只是轻轻点头表示感谢，没有与 Baird 对视。

"Scylla，我希望你能在这里有所作为。再一次发光发热。现在请跟上 Alviss，并且... 保持开放的心态。" Baird 说。

entries.en:
With a sigh, Baird turns from them to you.

"Captain. Thank you for finding her and bringing her home," the provost watches the two leave the receiving lounge, starting to chat, Coureuse finally starting to smile. "With Scylla, we can begin it all again."

Baird holds up a hand to indicate an adjoining transport pod, "Let us remove to a more suitable setting for the continuation of our discussion."
entries.zh:
Baird 叹了口气，然后看向你。

"舰长。感谢你能找到她并把她带回家，" 院长看着离开接待室后开始聊天的两人，似乎 Coureuse 的脸上终于开始出现了微笑，"有了 Scylla，我们就可以重新开始了。"

Baird 指了指旁边的运输舱，"让我们去一个更适合继续讨论的地方吧。"

entries.en: Baird seems to study the passing conduits and vistas visible through the pod's bay windows, lost in thought. The silence grows, and you find that this may be an opportunity to ask something of the provost without interrupting one of her lectures.
entries.zh: Baird 通过运输舱舷窗看着外边的各种管道和远方的风景，陷入了沉思。安静的氛围开始支配这个空间，你发现这可能是个不必打断院长的长篇大论，就能向她提问的机会。

entries.en:
You follow Provost Baird into her office, and the doors close with a notable absence of sound. She motions you to a seat in front of her desk.

"First," she says, "you ought to be compensated for your fine work recovering a valuable asset."

Baird unlocks her desk interface and enters some commands; your personal datapad pings in response.
entries.zh:
你跟着 Baird 院长走进她的办公室，门在身后悄无声息地合上了。她示意你在她的办公桌前坐下。

"首先，" 她开口说道，"你回收了一位宝贵的人才，你出色的工作理应得到相应的报酬。"

Baird 解锁了她的桌面菜单，输入了一些指令。作为回应，你的个人数据平板轻响了几下。

entries.en:
Baird taps at her interface, her face illuminated by a moving image. "She seems to be settling in," she says, watching.

A holo projects into the space above her desk: a surveillance feed of a gleaming new physics laboratory. Scylla Coureuse is being introduced by Sebestyen to various academicians, judging by their formal dress, and technicians in various states of protective garb. They look young and eager to begin work.
entries.zh:
Baird 点了点屏幕，一张动态图像照亮了她的脸，"她看起来好像安顿下来了。" 她一边说一边看着。

一张全息图像从Baird 院长的桌子上投射出来：那是一个闪闪发光的新物理实验室的监控录像。Scylla Coureuse 被 Sebestyen 介绍给了在场各位，从他们的正装上来看，应该是院士们，此外还有穿着各种防护装束的技术员。他们看上去很年轻，并且急于投身到工作中。

entries.en:
As you enter Baird's office, you notice that Gargoyle is in the sitting area, heels resting on the common table. The hacker casually closes a holodisplay, "Oh, so good of everyone to join me. I was getting awfully bored, I thought I might read some files, but you got here just as I was getting started..."

Although she shows no outward change in expression, you get the familiar feeling of potent apprehension and clarity which fills your gut when a high-powered starship weapon is armed to fire. Provost Baird speaks with firm authority, "An amusing prank, I'm sure. Now remove your feet from there before I have you removed from my office again."

"Yes'm," Gargoyle mutters sullenly, dropping boots to the floor.
entries.zh:
走进 Baird 的办公室后，你注意到 Gargoyle 就呆在休息区，还把脚后跟搭到了桌子上。这位黑客漫不经心地关闭了一个全息显示器，"哦，终于有人能陪我聊聊了。我快无聊坏了，正想要看点文件呢，你就来了..."

虽然 Baird 不动声色，但你心中充满了危机感，熟悉得就像一门强劲的舰载武器已经瞄准了你并即将开火一样。院长带着不容置疑的权威开口了，"我猜这是个有趣的恶作剧。现在，趁我还没把你再次轰出我的办公室，把你的脚从桌子上拿开。"

"好好好，女士。" Gargoyle 闷闷不乐地咕哝着，把脚放到了地上。

entries.en:
Provost Baird moves behind her desk, brushes the surface with a scowl, then taps a few keys.

"First, captain," she says, "you ought to be compensated for your fine work recovering a valuable asset."

Your personal datapad pings in response to a command she entered into her desk interface.

Gargoyle perks up and withdraws a highly modified datapad, trailing loose cables. After a moment it also pings, to which Gargoyle says "Mm, Anahita. Don't spoil the good captain."
entries.zh:
Baird 院长走到了她的书桌后，瞪着眼扫了一遍桌面，然后敲了几个键。

"首先，舰长，" 她说道，"你回收了一位宝贵的人才，你出色的工作理应得到相应的报酬。"

你的私人数据平板响应了她在自己桌面交互面板上输入的指令。

Gargoyle 坐直了起来，掏出了一个荡着电缆、高度改造的数据平板。一小会后它也响了一下，而 Gargoyle 对此的回复是："哎呀，Anahita。你可别把我们亲爱的舰长惯坏了。"

o.zh: 你是不是... 在偷看我的账户？

entries.en:
She motions at the image, "We'll rebuild what we can from Coureuse's independent work and what she can recall, but without the Kallichore Archive, it would be... inconvenient to recapture certain data sets."

Baird looks up, at the proverbial sky, "I expect that the Hegemony Ministry of Technology Standards has installed very particular forms of surveillance in place around the Galatia system to avoid being caught flat-footed by another 'little accident'. We dare not interfere directly, lest we give them another excuse to meddle."
entries.zh:
她指着图像说："我们将根据 Coureuse 独自进行的项目和她所能回忆起的东西还原我们所能还原的一切，但如果没有 Kallichore 的档案，获取明确的数据集将会是十分... 不方便的。"

Baird 抬头看了看天空，"我估计霸主科技标准部已经在 Galatia 星系中安装了非常特殊的监控设备，以避免被另一个 '小事故' 搞得手忙脚乱。我们不敢对那些东西下手，免得又给他们什么介入的借口。"

entries.en:
A holoprojected image blooms into the space above Baird's desk: a surveillance feed of a gleaming new physics laboratory. Coureuse is being introduced by Sebestyen to various academicians, judging by their formal dress, and technicians in various states of protective garb. They look young and eager to begin work.

"She seems to be settling in," Baird says, motioning at the display, "Sebestyen is more capable than he appears. He has been both persistent and meticulous in facilitating the rebirth of this research team."

Gargoyle speaks up, "And just look what happens when he's not keeping an eye on me. All sorts of trouble!"
entries.zh:
一张全息图像在Baird 院长的桌子上骤然亮起：那是一个闪闪发光的新物理实验室的监控录像。Coureuse 被 Sebestyen 介绍给了在场各位，从他们的正装上来看，应该是院士们，此外还有穿着各种防护装束的技术员。他们看上去很年轻，并且急于投身到工作中。

"她看起来好像安顿下来了，" Baird 看着画面点了点头，"Sebestyen 比看上去更能干。他坚持不懈，一丝不苟地促成了这个研究团队的重生。"

Gargoyle 大声嚷嚷起来，"再看看他没盯住我时发生了什么。一大堆麻烦事接踵而至！"

entries.en:
Gargoyle gives you a guilty look, slowly stowing the datapad.

"Don't even start," Baird snaps. "Fight about it after this meeting." She gives her head a shake and returns her attention to the desk interface.
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 心虚地瞅了你一眼，缓缓地把数据平板藏了回去。

"别挑头，" Baird 厉声道，"开完会再吵。" 她晃了下脑袋，然后把注意力重新放在了桌面屏幕上。

entries.en:
"Acquire the Kallichore Archive, captain," Baird says, "And quickly." She turns away, dismissing you. "It would be premature to speak too much about what I am building toward, but a magnificent breakthrough is growing closer."

You feel the doors open soundlessly behind you, and the mirror-masked guards presence like a slight rise in ambient static electricity. Time to go.
entries.zh:
"舰长，去弄到 Kallichore 的档案，" Baird 说，"而且要快，" 她转过身去开始打发你，"现在谈论我的目标还为时过早，但一个伟大的突破已经近在咫尺了。"

你感觉到身后的门被悄无声息地打开了，那些戴着镜面面罩的守卫就在附近，像是静电般突兀，是时候动身了。

entries.en:
Bairds nods in acknowledgement, then says "My team has been working on the Kallichore data, decrypted thanks to Gargoyle's hard work, I must admit." You see Gargoyle take a small bow, as if having completed a masterful performance.

"Though we've started reopening previous avenues of research," she says, "having Coureuse here to form the heart of the advanced theory team will result in tremendous progress after Kallichore's bungling. This is her life's work, after all."
entries.zh:
Baird 点点头表示认同，然后说："我的团队一直在研究 Kallichore 档案中的数据，我必须得承认，多亏了 Gargoyle 的辛勤工作，这些数据才得以解密。" 你注意到了 Gargoyle 微微躬身的动作，仿佛他刚刚完成了一场大师级的表演。

"我们已经开始重启之前的研究方向，" 她说道，"在 Kallichore 的失误之后，让 Coureuse 在这里形成先进理论团队的核心将会带来巨大的进步。毕竟，这是她毕生的心血。"

o.en: I don't think the Persean League will be happy to lose Coureuse.
o.zh: 放跑了 Coureuse，英仙座联盟 会很不高兴的。

o.en: She doesn't like you, does she.
o.zh: 看起来她不怎么喜欢你，对吧。

entries.en:
"Ah..." The scavenger looks aside to avoid your gaze. "One finds all sorts of things out here and I, I couldn't really say if we did or not. I'd uh, have to have my assessor check the logs."

$HeOrShe shrugs with one shoulder, "Might take a while."
entries.zh:
"我明白了。" 拾荒者看向一旁，避开了你的目光。"人们在这里可以找到各种各样的东西，我也不能确定我到底找到了没有。我得让我的评估员检查一下日志。"

$HeOrShe耸了耸肩，"可能需要一段时间。"

o.en: I have all the time in the world.
o.zh: 我可以在这等到世界终结。

o.en: Perhaps a 'donation' could help speed things along.
o.zh: 也许一点点 '捐助' 能加速这个过程。

o.en: I'm authorized to recover Academy property- by force, if necessary.
o.zh: 学院允许我在必要时动用武力回收这个东西。

entries.en: "Oh, well now." The scavenger smiles, "Time is money, isn't it? And at faster than light speeds, my account books start doing funny things, ha-ha. I'm sure we could get some more of the crew checking cargo pods if there was some incentive... let's say $gaFC_bribeCost credits."
entries.zh: "哦，当然了。" 拾荒者微笑着说，"时间就是金钱，不是吗？我的账本开始以超越光速的效率做一些有趣的事情，哈哈。我相信，如果得到一些激励的话，我可以让更多的船员检查货舱...比方说 $gaFC_bribeCost 星币。"

o.en: I'll transfer those credits to speed things along. (bribe)
o.zh: 我会给你一些星币来加速这个过程。 (贿赂)

o.en: Actually, I have all the time in the world. (wait)
o.zh: 事实上，我可以等到世界终结。 (等着)

o.en: Don't test me. I will use force to recover Galatia Academy property if necessary.
o.zh: 不要考验我的耐心，Galatia 学院允许我在必要时用武力回收。

entries.en:
You authorize the credits transfer and can pin-point the moment it arrives because a wide smile breaks over the scavenger captain's face.

"Glad we could do business, captain. I've ordered my quartermaster to eject the cargo pod in question, so it's all yours," the scavenger says magnanimously.

"Burn bright captain, I'm sure we'll meet again!" $HeOrShe closes the comms before you can comment on the uncannily speedy 'discovery' of the Galatia Academy probe.
entries.zh:
你授权支付了星币。拾荒者舰长的脸上绽放出灿烂的笑容，你确定星币成功到账了。

"很高兴我们能做生意，舰长。我已经命令我的军需官弹出你想要的货舱，它就交由你处置了。" 拾荒者真诚地说道。

"航行无阻，舰长，相信我们会再见面的！" $HeOrShe关闭了通讯器，快到你都没来得及质疑这颗 Galatia 学院的探测器怎么这么容易就能找到。

entries.en: Your sensors officer reports that an ejected cargo pod floating in a spray of post-battle debris contains something that matches the mission target specifications.
entries.zh: 你的传感器技官报告道，一个弹射出来的货舱漂浮在战后碎片的包围中，其中包含符合任务目标规格的东西。

entries.en:
The scavenger captain flickers into your comm display.

"Greetings. Pardon my presumption, but I hope all is well? It's a long way back to the core worlds my friend, and we must look after one another."
entries.zh:
拾荒者的舰长在你的通讯显示器上闪烁着。

"你好。请原谅我的打扰，希望你那里一切都好？回到核心世界的路还很长，我的朋友，我们必须互相照顾。"

o.en: Did you happen to find a probe belonging to the Galatia Academy?
o.zh: 你有没有找到过一个属于 Galatia 学院的探测器？

entries.en: The scavenger captain is ignoring your comm request.
entries.zh: 拾荒者的舰长无视了你的通讯请求。

entries.en:
"I- ah, I see." The scavenger taps at a console and appears to think for about a second.

"Oh, would you look at that, we did find something with Galatia Academy markings. Must have slipped my mind."

$HeOrShe looks at you accusingly, "Would've returned it once it was identified properly. You could have asked nicely. We gotta look out for each other out here, remember? Otherwise we're no better than pirates or the boot-licking Heggies."
entries.zh:
"我 —— 呃，我懂了。" 拾荒者敲击着一个控制台，思考了大约一秒钟。

"哦，你看看这个，我们确实找到了带有 Galatia 学院标记的东西。一定是我忘了。"

$HeOrShe指责地看着你，"只要我们找到了，就会归还它。你可以礼貌的问我们。我们必须在这里互相照顾，懂吗？否则就和海盗或 霸主 的那些狗官一样。"

entries.en:
"I've ordered my quartermaster to eject the cargo pod, so it's all yours," the scavenger says testily. "Burn bright captain... into an asteroid, for all I care."

The comms are abruptly disconnected.
entries.zh:
"我已经命令军需官弹出货舱，它现在归你了。" 拾荒者试探性地说道，"航行无阻...撞上小行星也无所谓，我才不在乎。"

通讯突然中断了。

entries.en:
"Very well, captain. We have to do some minor repairs anyway. I'll be sure to forward your concern to my assessor who, I assure you, is doing their utmost to find your, ah, missing property."

The scavenger switches the feed to a generic holding signal.

You order your navigator to maintain position relative to the scavenger fleet, and to keep an eye out for any funny business.
entries.zh:
"很好，舰长。反正现在我们要做一些小修理。我一定会把你的关切转达给我的评估员，我向你保证，他们正在尽最大努力寻找你的，呃，失踪的财产。"

拾荒者将通讯频道切到通用待机信号。

你命令你的领航员保持与拾荒者舰队的相对位置，并注意任何异常情况。

entries.en:
It doesn't take long.

Your comms officer interrupts your reverie. "Captain! Something in the scavenger flagship cargo hold just emitted a short range comms pulse. Seen this before, profile fits a Pather op. Maybe pirates."

A breath later, the comms hold signal switches to the distraught face of the scavenger captain.
entries.zh:
没过多久。

通讯军官的一声大喊打断了你的沉思。"舰长！拾荒者旗舰货舱里的某个东西刚刚发出了一道短程通讯脉冲。我们以前见过这个，符合卢德左径的特征，也有可能是海盗。"

通讯频道的信号几乎马上就切换到拾荒者舰长那慌张的脸上。

entries.en:
"You didn't tell us it was trapped!" $heOrShe shouts in panic, "You should have said something, you should have- no, we need to get out of here. I'm ejecting the damn thing. Tell them I don't have it!"

The comms snap off.

Your tactical officer reports that the scavenger fleet is powering up engines.
entries.zh:
"你没告诉我们它是陷阱！" $heOrShe惊恐地喊道，"你应该告诉我的，你应该 —— 不，我们得离开这里。我要丢了那该死的东西。告诉他们那玩意儿不在我这！"

通讯中断了。

战术军官报告说，拾荒者舰队正在开动引擎。

entries.en:
With only one piece of evidence that Coureuse is at Laicaille Habitat you're not absolutely certain it would not be dismissed as merely circumstantial if you attempted to leverage it against the authorities.

You need to find one more piece of corroborating evidence.
entries.zh:
现在只有一项证据表明 Coureuse 在 Laicaille 栖息地，如果你试图以某种方式利用它对当局提出质疑，对方可能会以这只是间接证据为由不予考虑。

你得再找一个确凿的证据。

entries.en:
With multiple pieces of evidence, you feel confident that you have sufficient leverage to confront authorities at Laicaille Habitat about Scylla Coureuse.

It is time to talk to the archon of Laicaille Habitat.
entries.zh:
现在你有了两份不同的证据，你觉得自己已经有足够的筹码去和 Laicaille 栖息地的当局就 Scylla Coureuse 的事进行对质。

是时候和 Laicaille 栖息地的执政官谈谈了。

entries.en:
With only one piece of evidence that Coureuse is at Laicaille Habitat you're not absolutely certain it would not be dismissed as merely circumstantial if you attempted to leverage it against the authorities.

You need to find one more piece of corroborating evidence.
entries.zh:
现在只有一项证据表明 Coureuse 在 Laicaille 栖息地，如果你试图以某种方式利用它对当局提出质疑，对方可能会以这只是间接证据为由不予考虑。

你得再找一个确凿的证据。

entries.en:
With multiple pieces of evidence, you feel confident that you have sufficient leverage to confront authorities at Laicaille Habitat about Scylla Coureuse.

It is time to talk to the archon of Laicaille Habitat.
entries.zh:
现在你有了两份不同的证据，你觉得自己已经有足够的筹码去和 Laicaille 栖息地的当局就 Scylla Coureuse 的事进行对质。

是时候和 Laicaille 栖息地的执政官谈谈了。

entries.en:
Agent Siyavong blinks, and frowns as if he didn't expect you to simply come out and say it.

"I must admit that your forthrightness is somewhat disturbing."

"I advise you to be mindful of who you share your words with," he says sternly, "Particularly in consideration of what you're about to learn."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 特工眼睛一眨，换上了眉头紧皱的表情，似乎没料到你会这么直截了当地说出来。

"我不得不说，你直率得令人有些不安。"

"我建议你在分享信息时注意一下对方的身份。" 他严肃地说道，"特别是在分享你即将得知的这份重要情报之前。"

entries.en:
Siyavong pauses, showing no emotion or movement at all. You almost wonder if the comms feed has frozen, then he speaks. "I am interested, captain. Shall we make it a trade? Zal's comms ID for the location of Scylla Coureuse?

He smiles now.
entries.zh:
Siyavong 停顿了一下，没有表现出任何情绪或动作。你几乎要怀疑通讯信号是否卡住了，然后他开口了。"我很感兴趣，舰长。我们可以做个交易吗？用 Zal 的通讯 ID 换取 Scylla Coureuse 的位置？"

他现在笑了。

o.en: Transmit the comms ID of Elissa Zal
o.zh: 把 Elissa Zal 的通讯 ID 给他

entries.en:
"Coureuse is in the Isirah system. I will provide you-" he pauses dramatically as he taps something into his control interface; your TriPad pings, "with a plausible-looking data intercept of a communication between her and Mr. Cavin Pharoh."

"It'll show Provost Baird that you worked hard for it," he says with a wink.
entries.zh:
"Coureuse 在 Isirah 星系里。当然。我可以告诉你 —— " 他故意停顿了一下，好让你瞧见他往他的桌面控制台敲入了些什么。接着你的 TriPad 响了，"—— 有个看起来可信的数据，我们截获了她和 Cavin Pharoh 先生之间的通信。"

"这能告诉 Baird 院长，你真的在很努力工作，" 他眨着眼睛说。

entries.en:
"$TitlePL $playerName." His tone is respectful, perhaps with a note of amusement.

"Finally, we may speak directly," he says. "Finlay Siyavong, at your service."
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长。" 他语气恭敬，或许还带着一丝玩味。

"我们终于能直接交谈了。Finlay Siyavong，为你效劳。"

entries.en:
"$playerName. I am Finlay Siyavong; finally we may speak directly. And discreetly." He lowers his head, his expression hardening, "A skill, alongside tact, which you would do well to practice."

He looks aside, "You have a way of complicating matters, such as a certain surveillance operation in the Kay-arco undercity. Let me emphasize- " he stops himself. "No, let us speak to the matter at hand."
entries.zh:
"$playerName 统领，我是 Finlay Siyavong；我们终于能直接 —— 且隐秘地 —— 交谈了。" 他低下头，表情变得严肃起来。"这是一种技能，与战术一样，你最好能加以练习。"

他目光游移，"有些事可能让情况复杂化，比如在 Kay 生态圈下层都市的某项监视行动。让我来强调 ——" 他忽地止住。"不，抱歉，我就只谈眼前的事情吧。"

entries.en:
"Demarchon $playerName. I am Finlay Siyavong; finally we may speak directly. And discreetly." He lowers his head, his expression hardening somewhat, "A skill, alongside tact, which I would expect a demarchon of the League would better appreciate."

He looks aside. "There's a risk of complicating matters. Such as a certain surveillance operation in the Kay-arco undercity. Let me emphasize- " he stops himself.

"No, I apologize. I shall speak only to the matter at hand."
entries.zh:
"$playerName 统领，我是 Finlay Siyavong；我们终于能直接 —— 且隐秘地 —— 交谈了。" 他微微低头，神色略显冷峻，"这是一种技巧，连同处世之道，我本以为这是联盟统领更应体察的素养。"

他目光游移，"有些事可能让情况复杂化，比如在 Kay 生态圈下层都市的某项监视行动。让我来强调 ——" 他忽地止住。

"不，抱歉，我就只谈眼前的事情吧。"

entries.en:
"I am Finlay Siyavong, though you have made it quite clear that you know this already and are eager to display that knowledge in front of persons of interest to the Service."

"Let me be clear. The League guarantees certain rights to intersystem merchants, though it is a stretch to ascribe you even that status considering your 'colorful' record. Even if you display no respect for this institution and my explicit requests from you, I cannot simply lock you up." He folds his arms, and leans back. "As much as I would like to."

"But we have a more important matter to discuss, don't we $playerName."
entries.zh:
"我是 Finlay Siyavong，不过你已经很明确地表明自己早知此事，并急于向情报部门的关注人士炫耀这份认知。"

"容我直言，联盟保证了星系内商人的某些权利，尽管考虑到你 '丰富多彩' 的记录，赋予你这样的地位是一种牵强。所以即使你表现出对这个机构和我提出要求的不尊重，我也不能简单地把你关起来。" 他双臂交叠，向后靠去，"尽管我很想这么做。"

"但眼下我们有更重要的事情要讨论，不是吗？"

entries.en:
"I am Finlay Siyavong, though you have made it quite clear that you know this already and are eager to display that knowledge to persons of interest to the Service."

"Let me be clear. As demarchon you are given a certain leeway. And even if you display zero respect for our shared institutions and my explicit requests not to divulge confidential information, I cannot simply lock you up." He folds his arms, and leans back. "As much as I would like to."

"But we have a more important matter to discuss, don't we Demarchon $playerName."
entries.zh:
"我是 Finlay Siyavong，不过您已经很明确地表明自己早知此事，并急于向情报部门的关注人士炫耀这份认知。"

"容我直言。作为统领，您享有特定的自由度。即便您对我们的共同机构，以及我对您发出的务必不要泄露机密信息的明确要求都毫无敬意，我也无法直接将您关押。" 他双臂交叠，向后靠去，"尽管我很想这么做。"

"但眼下我们有更重要的事情要讨论，不是吗？统领 $playerName。"

entries.en:
Agent Siyavong gives a short, strange bark of laughter. "Oh, indeed," he says.

He pauses for a moment, examining you. "You're not serious."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 特工唐突地大笑了几声。"哦，确实如此，" 他说。

他停顿了一会儿，审视着你。"你没在说实话。"

o.en: I am... from a certain point of view.
o.zh: 这是真的...从某种角度上来说。

o.en: No, but it seems like what people like to hear.
o.zh: 确实，但是大多数人都愿意听到这个理由。

entries.en: Siyavong's smile widens, "If I didn't, did you just confirm it?"
entries.zh: Siyavong 笑得更灿烂了一些，"就算我之前不知道，你刚刚不是不打自招了吗？"

o.en: What is it exactly that you do?
o.zh: 你到底是做什么工作的？

o.en: It took you long enough to contact me.
o.zh: 你真是过了好一会才联系我。

entries.en:
He drops the smile and shifts the tilt of his head.

The pause lengthens, but he isn't saying anything.
entries.zh:
他收起笑容，一边调整着头部的倾斜角度。

沉默持续着，但他始终没有开口。

o.en: I can't disclose the reason. I intend to find her with or without your help.
o.zh: 我不能透露原因，而且我一定会找到她。有没有你的帮助都一样。

o.en: Other people seem to think she's important.
I'm helping Provost Anahita Baird with some kind of secret project.
o.zh: 我在为 Anahita Baird 院长做一件非常重要的事。

o.en: I can put you in contact with Elissa Zal.
o.zh: 我能让你联系到 Elissa Zal。

o.en: As a demarchon of the League, you work for me. Remember?
o.zh: 以我联盟统领的身份，你算是我的下级，记得吗？

entries.en:
"I didn't tell you anything."

He makes a gesture toward you. "You intercepted a communication, remember? Besides, Isirah- well, it's not a big place. I'm sure you'll put the pieces together."
entries.zh:
"我没告诉你任何东西。"

他朝你做了个手势，"是你自己截获了一个通讯，记得吗？再说，Isirah —— 呃，地方又不大，我相信你很快就会把必要的碎片拼凑起来的。"

entries.en:
"Yes, we've been watching you for some time."

Siyavong lifts a datapad and makes a show of glancing at it. "You've enjoyed a fascinating career lately, demarchon. You seem to have a knack for finding trouble, and for trouble finding you."

He puts down the datapad. "It's provided much fodder for the analysts."

"To be perfectly honest," he says, and smiles just a little, "I had hoped I would not find it necessary to speak with you so directly. But you've forced my hand, so here we are."
entries.zh:
"是的，我们已经观察你有一段时间了，$playerName。" Siyavong 举起一块数据平板，做出阅读的姿势。"您最近的生涯履历相当吸引人，统领大人。您似乎有寻找麻烦的诀窍，麻烦也确实找到了您。"

他放下了数据平板。"这为分析学者们提供了很多素材。"

"说实话，" 他说道，并微微一笑，"我曾希望我们不会发展到需要面对面交谈的地步。但您让我不得不这么做，所以我们现在坐在这里。"

entries.en:
"Ah. It took some time for the message to get through the... not quite the proper channels, of course..." Siyavong puts on a sly look for a moment. "I wouldn't say I expected you to reach out so directly, but perhaps I should have."

He lifts a datapad and taps its face. "You've enjoyed a fascinating career lately, demarchon. You have a knack for finding trouble, and for trouble finding you. It's provided much fodder for the analysts."

He sets the datapad down.

"To be perfectly honest," he begins, with an ironic hint of smile, "I had hoped we wouldn't have to speak at all. It'd be cleaner. But my hand was forced and here we are."
entries.zh:
"啊。消息是通过...不太正规的渠道传达，自然花了些时间..." Siyavong 脸上掠过一丝狡黠，"倒不是说我预料到您会如此直接地联系我，但或许我本该料到的。"

他拿起数据平板，一边轻触屏幕，"您最近的生涯履历相当吸引人，统领大人。您似乎有寻找麻烦的诀窍，麻烦也确实找到了你。这为分析学者们提供了很多素材。"

他放下数据平板。

"说实话，" 他带着一丝讽刺的笑意开口道，"我曾希望我们不会发展到需要交谈的地步。但您让我不得不这么做，所以我们现在坐在这里。"

entries.en:
"Yes, we've been watching you for some time."

Siyavong lifts a datapad and makes a show of glancing at it. "You've enjoyed a fascinating career lately, captain. You seem to have a knack for finding trouble, and for trouble finding you."

He puts down the datapad. "It's provided much fodder for the analysts."

"To be perfectly honest," he says, and smiles just a little, "I had hoped I would not find it necessary to speak with you so directly. But you've forced my hand, so here we are."
entries.zh:
"是的，我们已经观察你有一段时间了，$playerName。" Siyavong 举起一块数据平板，做出阅读的姿势。"你最近的生涯履历相当吸引人，舰长。你似乎有寻找麻烦的诀窍，麻烦也确实找到了你。"

他放下了数据平板。"这为分析学者们提供了很多素材。"

"说实话，" 他说道，并微微一笑，"我曾希望我们不会发展到需要面对面交谈的地步。但你让我不得不这么做，所以我们现在坐在这里。"

entries.en: "Quite," he folds his hands in a businesslike manner, "So?"
entries.zh: "很诚实，" 他以一种公事公办的方式折叠双手，"那么？"

entries.en:
Agent Siyavong looks like he's having fun; now you're playing his game.

"Well, $playerName, I happen to be one of these other people. She is important- or, more precisely, she could be important if she is given the correct opportunity."

He leans in, and says softly, "There are those who would like her to remain insignificant. Possibly forever. I think... we should not let it be that way. I suspect your 'other person' agrees with me on this point, if little else."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 探员看起来很开心，现在你着了他的道。

"好吧，$playerName，我正好也是 '某些人' 中的一个。她很重要 —— 或者，更确切地说，如果当她的机会来临，她会变得很重要。"

他靠过来，轻轻地说："有一些人希望她就这么保持无足轻重的状况，或许永远这样。我认为...我们不应该让事情变成那样。我怀疑你的 '某些人' 在这一点上同意我的观点，如果没有其他问题的话。"

entries.en:
"Coureuse is in the Isirah system, of course. I will provide you-" he pauses dramatically as he taps something out on his desk console. Your TriPad pings, "-with a plausible-looking data intercept of a communication between her and Mr. Cavin Pharoh to 'prove' the success of your search here."

He puts his hands together, not quite hiding his grin. "Provost Baird will be pleased, I'm sure."
entries.zh:
"Coureuse 在 Isirah 星系里。当然。我可以告诉你 ——" 他故意停顿了一下，好让你瞧见他往他的桌面控制台敲入了些什么。接着你的 TriPad 响了，"—— 有个看起来可信的数据，我们截获了她和 Cavin Pharoh 先生之间的通信，以 '证实' 你在此处的搜寻成果。"

他双手交握，几乎掩不住笑意，"我相信，Baird 院长会非常满意的。"

o.en: How do you know about Baird?
You're just telling me where she is?
o.zh: 你直接告诉我她现在在哪，好吧？

o.en: What is your endgame here? Why help me?
o.zh: 你的目的是什么，为什么要帮我？

entries.en:
He looks at you, curiously, his brow creased. "Interesting," he says to himself, "Direct."

"Is that really what you believe?" he muses, then waves the question away, "No need to respond to that. You've given me much to think about. Meanwhile - there's important business to get to: saving Scylla Coureuse." He grins like this is a shared joke.

"Coureuse is in the Isirah system, of course. I will provide you-" he pauses dramatically as he taps something out on his desk console; your TriPad pings, "-with a plausible-looking data intercept of a communication between her and Mr. Cavin Pharoh."
entries.zh:
他好奇地看着你，眉头紧皱。"有趣，" 他自语道，"直接。"

"你真的是这么想吗？" 他喃喃自语，然后挥挥手把问题抛开，"没必要回应这个。你已经甩给我很多问题了。现在 —— 有更重要的事情要做：救出 Scylla Coureuse。" 他就像我们在某个笑话上达成了默契一样笑了起来。

"Coureuse 在 Isirah 星系里。当然。我可以告诉你 —— " 他故意停顿了一下，好让你瞧见他往他的桌面控制台敲入了些什么。接着你的 TriPad 响了，" —— 有一个看起来可信的数据，我们截获了她和 Cavin Pharoh 先生之间的通信。"

entries.en:
Agent Siyavong looks like he's having fun; now you're playing his game.

"Of course, captain. Coureuse is in the Isirah system. I will provide you-" he pauses dramatically as he taps something out on his desk console; your TriPad pings, "-with a plausible-looking data intercept of a communication between her and Mr. Cavin Pharoh."

"It'll show Provost Baird that you worked hard for it," he says with a wink.
entries.zh:
Siyavong 特工看起来很开心；现在你着了他的道。

"Coureuse 在 Isirah 星系里。当然。另外我还可以给你提供 ——" 他故意停顿了一下，好让你瞧见他往他的桌面控制台敲入了些什么。接着你的 TriPad 响了，"—— 一份看起来十分可信的数据，我们截获了她和 Cavin Pharoh 先生之间的通信。"

"想必这能让 Baird 院长明白，你真的在很努力地工作。" 他眨着眼睛说。

o.en: You're just telling me where she is?
o.zh: 就这样？你打算直接告诉我她现在在哪？

o.en: How do you know about Baird?

entries.en:
"I am as you see, a representative of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service." Siyavong spreads his hands, as if showing he means no harm. "I work on behalf of the defense and security of the freedoms enjoyed by the constituents of the Persean League."

"But we are speaking today because of you, captain. You've been somewhat indiscreet in your search for an asset who is of interest to the Service."
entries.zh:
"如你所见，我是 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部的代表。" Siyavong 摊开双手，似乎在表明他没有恶意。"我的工作是防止并确保联盟成员所享受的自由不被侵犯。"

"但我们今天的谈话是因为你，舰长。你在寻找我们关注的某位人物时有些过于不谨慎。"

entries.en:
"I am as you see, a representative of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service."

Siyavong spreads his hands, as if showing he means no harm. "I work on behalf of the defense and security of the freedoms enjoyed by the constituents of the Persean League, which includes yourself and your organization."

"But we are speaking today because of you, captain, demarchon. You've been somewhat indiscreet in your search for an asset who is of interest to the Service and the League."
entries.zh:
"如您所见，我是 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部的代表。"

Siyavong 摊开双手，似乎在表明他没有恶意。"我的工作是防止并确保联盟 —— 也就是你目前所在的组织 —— 的成员所享受的自由不被侵犯。"

"但我们今天的谈话是因为您，舰长，统领。你在寻找我们关注的某位人物时有些过于不谨慎。"

entries.en:
"A rather direct question to ask an agent of the service, don't you think?" Siyavong seems genuinely amused. "But that is the heart of the matter, and your profile suggests a certain propensity for, shall we say, direct thinking."

"Let me answer you with a question," he says, leaning in.

"Why should you know where Scylla Coureuse is?"
entries.zh:
"你不觉得这个问题对于一名现役特工来说有些太直接了吗？" Siyavong 特工看起来被你逗乐了，"不过这确实是问题的关键，而你的档案表明你的确有一种...怎么说呢，直言不讳的倾向。"

"既然如此，我也用一个问题来回答你吧，" 他靠过来说道。

"你为什么想要知道 Scylla Coureuse 在哪里？"

entries.en: Siyavong studies his TriPad. "Fascinating," he says, then looks up, setting it aside.
entries.zh: Siyavong 研究了一会手中的 TriPad。"有意思。" 他说完便抬起头，并把它放在了一边。

entries.en:
The comms link holds for a few moments on the understated crest of Persean League Fleet Intelligence before connecting.

"Greetings, I am Lieutenant Finlay Siyavong with the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service," Siyavong says. "How may I be of assistance?"
entries.zh:
通讯链接在英仙座联盟舰队情报部那枚低调的徽记上停了片刻，随后接通。

"您好，我是英仙座联盟舰队情报部的 Finlay Siyavong 中尉，\" Siyavong 说道。\"有什么可以效劳？"

entries.en:
Agent Siyavong blinks, frowning at your directness

"You are forthright, captain. I'm afraid, with apologies, that the report heirarchy doesn't quite work like that. You may, of course, submit an official request to the FIS through proper channels. Though I hear there's something of a backlog."

His smirk is almost deniable. He lets you wait for just a moment before this would register as insolence, then continues.

"Nonetheless, as I'm sure you're aware, we in the League pride ourselves on a certain spirit of dynamism and cooperation which sets us apart from, say, the Hegemony."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 探员眨眨眼，对你直截了当的方式皱了皱眉。

"你很直接，舰长。但恐怕恕我直言，报告层级可并非是这样运作的。你当然可以通过正规渠道向情报局提交正式申请，不过我听说那边的积压可不少。"

他的讥笑几乎难以察觉。在即将构成无礼的临界点前，他停顿片刻，便继续说道。

"尽管如此，我相信你也清楚，我们联盟以某种活力与合作精神为傲，这也使我们区别于 —— 比方说 —— 霸主。"

o.en: And that's what makes the League great. Do go on.
o.zh: 而这正是联盟的伟大之处。继续吧。

o.en: That's the right attitude. So where's Coureuse?
o.zh: 态度正确。那么 Coureuse 人在哪里？

entries.en: Siyavong puts on a dutifully, if not quite friendly, expression at your sudden display of patriotism.
entries.zh: Siyavong 对你突然迸发的爱国热情露出了一副尽责却谈不上友善的表情。

entries.en: "Direct to the last," Siyavong says to himself, patience not quite frayed. Not quite.
entries.zh: "一如既往地直截了当，" Siyavong 自语道，他的耐心尚未耗尽。只是尚未。

entries.en:
"I'm afraid I don't know what you're talking about."

Siyavong watches you with an impeccable simulation of polite, bureaucratic confusion.

"If you would like to report a crime in interfactional space, or a crime in the local polity involving non-citizens of this League member-state, I can forward you to the appropriate contact."

No matter what you try, he's stonewalling. And he's good at it.
entries.zh:
"恐怕我不知道你在说什么。"

Siyavong 看着你，打着官腔装糊涂，那故作殷勤的做派简直无懈可击。

"如果你想报告跨势力的犯罪，或在当地政体中涉及非 英仙座联盟 成员国公民的犯罪，我可以把你转给适当的联系人。"

无论你怎么试探，他都在搪塞。而且他还很擅长这个。

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam, I have only the utmost respect for your office as executive leader of $player.theFactionName, a member polity of the Persean League in good standing. If you wish to officially coordinate on matters relating to intelligence concerning an individual of interest with the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service, I must direct you toward the official channels."

Siyavong's simulation of polite, bureaucratic non-helpfulness is immaculate. He's stonewalling.

He pauses for a significant moment, then adds "It would be highly irregular if I were to discuss potentially classified matters outside of official channels."
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam ，我对您作为 $player.theFactionName 行政领袖的职务抱有最高的敬意，该成员政体在 英仙座联盟 中享有良好的声誉。若您希望就涉及特定关注对象的情报事务与 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部进行正式协调，那么我必须指引您通过官方渠道进行办理。"

Siyavong 模仿出的礼貌而官僚化的 "不予协助" 姿态可谓完美。他正在搪塞推诿。

他刻意停顿片刻，补充道："若我通过非正式渠道讨论可能涉及机密的事务，将严重违反规程。"

o.en: I have questions about Scylla Coureuse.
o.zh: 我想问些关于 Scylla Coureuse 的事。

o.en: "Why are you pretending you don't know me?
o.zh: 你为什么要装作不认识我的样子？

o.en: Okay. I see how it is.
Scylla. Coureuse. Remember? You told me where to find her.
o.zh: Scylla Coureuse，记得吗，你说过知道去哪找她。

o.en: Academician Coureuse. You questioned people who know her.
o.zh: Coureuse 院士。你向认识她的人打听过她的事情。

o.en: As a demarchon of the Persean League, I demand you answer me.
o.zh: 作为联盟的一位统领，我要求你回答我。

entries.en: "I'm sorry $playerSirOrMadam, but no one by that name works in this office. I recommend that you inquire at a public directory."
entries.zh: "对不起，$playerSirOrMadam，但我们的工作人员中没有用这个名字的。我建议你在公共目录中查询。"

entries.en: A salvage team quickly secures the target in your hold for your technology team to investigate.
entries.zh: 一支打捞小组迅速将目标物安全送入你的货舱，供你的技术团队展开研究。

entries.en: Tech works quickly, and reports that they've established a connection with the probe instrument chassis.
entries.zh: 技术人员工作迅速，并报告说，他们已经与探测器的机箱建立了连接。

entries.en:
"Hyperwave analysis is not a merely linear process," your tech officer explains. "We will need one more data set to complete the... hmm, well it isn't triangulation, but you can think of it like that if it helps. Um."

They clear their throat. "Captain. $PlayerSirOrMadam."

You dismiss them to return to their work. Two probes down, one to go.
entries.zh:
"超波分析不是单纯的线性过程，" 你的技术军官解释道。"现在还差一个数据集才能完成... 嗯，好吧，它虽然不是三角定位，但如果那样更好理解的话，你可以当成是那样，嗯。"

对方清了清嗓子。"舰长 $PlayerSirOrMadam。"

你示意对方回到岗位继续作业。两个数据集的输入已经完成，就差最后一个了。

entries.en:
The schematics of the third probe float before you in the briefing room.

"Our tinkerer has been at work," your tech officer explains, highlighting the ghostly specs of a highly modified miniature hyperdrive core, "Here we see much the same setup as previous examples, but they've made a few improvements," tangles of inscrutably annotated component icons are highlighted, "Here, and here. A bizarre collection of parts from a variety of sources. Some are even officially restricted miltech."
entries.zh:
在简报室里，第三个探测器的原理图漂浮在你面前。

"我们的工程师一直在工作，" 你的技术军官解释说，强调了这个高度改良的微型超空间核心的规格有多么诡异，"在这里，我们看到与之前的基本相同的设置，但又做了一些改进，"他指向被一大堆难以理解的注释包围的组件图标，"这里和这里，一个怪异的，不同来源的零件集合，甚至包括受官方限制的军事技术。"

entries.en:
Provost Baird looks over her spectacles at you, "But you have not made contact yet. Because if you had, that is what you would be telling me."

She sighs, and raises her eyes briefly to the firmament, such as it is. "Very well..."

"If your information can be trusted, it may be effective to simply confront the local authorities with that knowledge and see what you might ascertain." She's gone into full lecture mode. "Bluff, perhaps. Competing authorities in-system might have knowledge of the activities of their counterparts; intel and counter-intel. Those less scrupulous might be bribed - and before you ask, I believe we've paid you quite enough already to carry out this mission one way or another without another creative entry for the bursar's office."
entries.zh:
Baird 院长的目光越过那往下滑了些许的眼镜投向你，"但是你还没有与她取得联系。因为如果你那么做了，那才是你该告诉我的事。"

她叹了口气，短暂地抬起眼睛望向天空 —— 大概是天空的方向。"很好..."

"如果信息是可靠的，那么你可以直接向当地政府了解情况来看看你能查明些什么，这或许会是有效的办法。" 她已经进入了演讲的状态。"虚张声势，大概吧。星系内相互竞争的当局可能知道对方的活动；情报工作与反情报工作。那些不那么谨慎的人可能会被贿赂 —— 在你开口之前，我得说我们已经给了你足够的钱，让你不管怎样都能完成这项任务，所以不要再为财务处添乱了。"

entries.en:
Pacing, she turns from the bay windows illuminating her office, "On the other hand, you might adopt an even less direct approach. Certain low-lifes and radicals, even Luddic Pathists, may follow in the wake of Coureuse. Or be looking for her themselves. I'm confident that you can handle such scum."

She stops, and faces you, "Not every problem can be solved with direct application of force," a slight smile appears, "All knowledge, perhaps, is the result of this human frustration. Now, go. You will be rewarded once I am in contact with Scylla Coureuse."
entries.zh:
她在照亮她办公室的凸窗前转过了身子，踱步起来，"另一方面，你也可以采取一种不那么直接的方式。某些底层居民和激进人士，甚至是卢德的左径分子，都可能在追踪着 Coureuse。或者是自己也在找她。我相信你有能力从这些人渣入手。"

她停了下来，面对着你，"并不是所有的问题都能通过简单粗暴的方式解决，" 一个微笑出现在了她脸上，"也许，所有的知识都是人类遭受挫折后总结出来的。现在，去吧。等我能联系上 Scylla Coureuse，你就可以得到报酬。"

entries.en: "Oh, one more thing- when you find her, be sure to bring her a block of Sub-Kay brand alamang. Make sure it's blue-bar, the good stuff. You can only really get it on Fikenhild. She says everything else belongs in a recycling tank."
entries.zh: "哦，还有一件事 —— 当你找到 Scylla 的时候，一定要给她带一块 Sub-Kay 牌的调味酱。这是嗯，一种磷虾酱。要确保是蓝色包装的。这可是好东西，你只有在 Fikenhild 上才能买到它。她说其他牌子的都该扔进回收槽里。"

o.en: 'Isirah system' and a block of krill paste, that's all I get?
o.zh: Isirah 星系和磷虾酱，对吧

entries.en:
"Yup." Her image smiles, delighted to give you such a poor answer.

"Look, she doesn't tell me her exact location. And besides, it changes. I just make sure she can get a signal out of the system for... well, that's for Sy to tell you. If she wants."

"Good luck sowing chaos, Captain."

The image of Elissa Zal flickers and degenerates into a mosaic of corrupted compression algorithm artifacts.
entries.zh:
"是啊。" 她虽然笑着，但给出的答案却让人深感无力。

"你看看，她既不愿意告诉我她的确切位置，也不愿意安分地待在原地别动。我只能保证她能够从系统中获得信号...嗯，如果 Scylla 愿意，她会告诉你。"

"希望你能把事儿闹大，舰长。"

Elissa Zal 的影像闪烁一阵后成了马赛克，就像是损坏了的压缩算法所输出的图像一样。

entries.en:
"Speaking of bad infosec: Cavin Pharoh. He trusted you for some reason."

Her desynced image appears to study you. "I don't see why."
entries.zh:
"说到糟糕的信息安全：Cavin Pharoh... 他似乎出于某种原因信任了你。"

面前她那模糊的影像似乎在琢磨着你。"但我不明白为什么。"

o.en: I think I made a convincing argument.
Because I'm not working for MuniSec or Fleet.
o.zh: 因为我的确不为地方安全部或是舰队情报部工作。

o.en: It must have been my raw charisma.
o.zh: 这一定是我的魅力导致的。

o.en: Neither do I. But he did.
o.zh: 我也不知道，但反正他信了。

entries.en:
"I think it's because of what I see in you as well." Zal rubs her chin, as if contemplating. "I think Cavin saw... disruption. Not chaos, exactly, but change. Yeah."

The image of Zal flickers slightly.

"Captain, I've decided that I will help you. Now I did make a promise to Scylla, so... let's just say that if I were you, I'd follow in the path of Leonis."
entries.zh:
"我想这也是因为我在你身上看到了什么。" Zal 揉着下巴，似乎在沉思。"我认为 Cavin 看到了...改变。确切地说，不是混乱，而是变革。是的。"

Zal 的形象微微闪动。

"舰长，我决定要帮助你。但目前我对 Scylla 做了承诺，所以...这么说吧，如果我是你，我会沿着 Leonis 的道路走下去。"

o.en: Warlord Leonis - you mean the Isirah system.
o.zh: 军阀 Leonis —— 你在指 Isirah 星系

entries.en:
The line opens only begrudgingly, after several frame-resets as several automated forwarding services connect and encryption protocol settles.

"$playerName," Zal says when the feed finally stabilizes, "Cavin told me to expect you."

Her speech and video are out of sync, and patchy. You wonder if she's even in the local volume of Fikenhild, or if she's got some kind of jerry-rigged hyperwave comms set up. Or if this is some kind of generated persona.
entries.zh:
在使用几个自动转发服务连接和加密协议后，又经过几次重构建框架，线路才断断续续地勉强接通。

"$playerName，" Zal 在信号最终稳定后说，"Cavin 说你可能会联系我。"

她的讲话和影像不同步，而且断断续续的。你无法确定她是否在 Fikenhild 当地，也许她在用某种临时拼凑的超波通讯装置。或者，这只是某种生成的伪装影像。

o.en: Cavin seemed to think that you know where Scylla is.
o.zh: Cavin 认为你知道 Scylla 在哪里。

o.en: You have a very interesting comms system.
o.zh: 你的通讯系统真有意思。

entries.en:
The line opens only begrudgingly, after several frame-resets as several automated forwarding services connect and encryption protocols settle.

"$playerName," Zal says when the feed finally stabilizes, "I thought you might contact me."

Her speech and video are out of sync, and patchy. You wonder if she's even in the local volume of Fikenhild, or if she's got some kind of jerry-rigged hyperwave comms set up. Or if this is some kind of generated persona.
entries.zh:
在使用几个自动转发服务连接和加密协议后，经过几次重构建框架后，线路才断断续续地勉强接通。

"$playerName，" Zal 在信号最终稳定后说，"我想你可能会联系我。"

她的讲话和影像不同步，而且断断续续的。你无法确定她是否在 Fikenhild 当地，也许她在用某种临时拼凑的超波通讯装置。或者，这只是某种生成的伪装影像。

o.en: A League Agent named Siyavong told me where Scylla is.
o.zh: 一个叫 Siyavong 的联盟特工告诉了我 Scylla 的位置。

o.en: Cavin seemed to think that you know where Scylla is.
o.zh: Cavin 认为你知道 Scylla 在哪里。

o.en: You have a very interesting comms system.
o.zh: 你的通讯系统真有意思。

entries.en: "Do you like it?" Zal smiles, and begins speaking before the image catches up, "It's one of my little projects."
entries.zh: "你喜欢它吗？" Zal 笑了笑，在图像跟上之前开始说话。"这是我的小项目之一。"

o.en: Is this how you communicate with Scylla?
o.zh: 这就是你与 Scylla 通讯的办法？

o.en: Does Scylla use this to carry on with her research?
o.zh: Scylla 用这东西继续她的研究？

o.en: Am I talking to a human or a simulated persona?
o.zh: 我是在和真人，还是模拟人格对话？

entries.en: The image of Zal sighs, "If it wasn't, how else would I?" She holds up a finger- "That's all you get. No details. It's important to practice good infosec, you know?"
entries.zh: Zal 的影像叹息道："如果不这样，我还能怎样？" 她竖起一根手指 —— "就透露这么多，没有更多细节。实行严格的信息安全处理是很重要的，你懂的吧？"

entries.en: "Not this particular system." The image of Zal makes a half-smile, then holds up a finger- "That's all you get. No details. It's important to practice good infosec, you know?"
entries.zh: "并不是这一个系统" Zal 的影像露出一抹似笑非笑的表情，随即竖起一根手指 ——"就透露这么多，没有更多细节。实行严格的信息安全处理是很重要的，你懂的吧？"

entries.en: "What are you, a philosopher?" The image of Zal rolls her eyes at you, "You're talking to me, aren't you? Is that not enough?" She holds up a finger- "You'll get no details from me. It's important to practice good infosec, you know?"
entries.zh: "你是什么人，哲学家吗？" Zal 的形象对你翻了个白眼，"你是在跟我说话，对吧？这还不够吗？" 她竖起一根手指 —— "你从我这里得不到任何详细情报，实行严格的信息安全处理是很重要的，你懂的吧？"

entries.en:
You disconnect the comms, wondering at what exactly is going on with what seems to be an unofficial hyperwave comm relay. Any answers, it seems, are to be found in the Isirah system.

And before you forget, you ping your quartermaster with instructions to pick up a block of this special krill paste.
entries.zh:
你断开了通讯，想知道这个非官方的超波通讯中继站上到底发生了什么。任何答案，似乎都可以在 Isirah 星系中找到。

在你忘记之前，你呼唤军需官，指示他采购一箱这种特殊的磷虾酱。

entries.en: Her image smiles mysteriously, "I didn't say it."
entries.zh: 她的影像神秘地笑着说："我可没说过。"

entries.en:
"The Warlord Leonis, cycle 47? Invaded the Isirah system? Blood and conquest?"

Her image rolls its eyes at you, "Look, if Scylla asks, tell her I tried my best to make it out like I was giving you a mysterious riddle and not just tell you right out loud where to find her."
entries.zh:
"军阀 Leonis，星历 47 年？入侵了 Isirah 星系？血腥和征服？"

她的形象对你翻了个白眼，"听着，如果 Scylla 问起，告诉她我已经尽力尝试用神秘谜语的形式提醒你，而不是直接大声告诉你去哪里找她。"

entries.en: Zal smirks, and before she appears to speak, her voice says "Yes, a lot of people are looking for Scylla. But you found me instead. Cavin Pharoh trusted you for some reason."
entries.zh: Zal 笑了笑，在她影像开口以前，声音已经传了出来："是的，有很多人都在找 Scylla ，而你却来找我，看起来 Cavin Pharoh 出于某种原因信任了你"

o.en: I think I made a convincing argument.
Because I'm not working for MuniSec or Fleet.
o.zh: 因为我的确不为地方安全部或是舰队情报部工作。

o.en: It must have been my raw charisma.
o.zh: 这一定是我的魅力导致的。

o.en: Neither do I. But he did.
o.zh: 我也不知道，但反正他信了。

entries.en:
Zal smirks, and before she appears to speak, her voice says "By the way, this is a recording. I have certain... commitments."

"It is my understanding that League intel has you on your way to meet Sylla for their own reasons. I would advise you not to trust their intentions. If you must go through with it, leave poor Cavin out. He's," the image pauses thoughtfully somewhat before the audio catches up, "He's a good kid."
entries.zh:
Zal 笑了笑，在她动嘴说话前，她的声音就已传出："顺便说一句，这是个录音。我有某些... 承诺。"

"据我所知，联盟的情报部门出于他们自己的原因，想让你找到 Scylla。我建议你不要相信他们的意图。如果你一定要去的话，不要把可怜的 Cavin 卷进来。他..." 在音频跟上之前，图像里的人若有所思地停顿了一下。"他是个好孩子。"

entries.en:
"Oh," the halting image of Zal smiles widely, "If I could ask one favor from you? When you find Sy, be sure to bring her a block of Sub-Kay brand alamang. It's um, krill paste. Make sure it's blue-bar, the good stuff. You can only really get it on Fikenhild. She says everything else belongs in a recycling tank."

"That's it." The voice goes quiet before the image, which looks at you for a moment, then down, then the image of Elissa Zal flickers and degenerates into a mosaic of corrupted compression algorithm artifacts.
entries.zh:
"哦，" Zal 停顿的形象笑得很灿烂，"我可以请你帮个忙吗？当你找到 Scylla 的时候，一定要给她带一块 Sub-Kay 牌的调味酱。这是嗯，一种磷虾酱。要确保是蓝色包装的。这可是好东西，你只有在 Fikenhild 上才能买到它。她说其他牌子的都该扔进回收槽里。"

"就这样吧。" 声音在图像前安静下来，图像看了你一会儿，然后往下看，最后 Elissa Zal 的图像闪烁起来，退化成由损坏的压缩算法造成的马赛克。

o.en: Have your quartermaster buy some krill paste
o.zh: 让你的副官买一些磷虾酱

entries.en: You disconnect the comms, wondering at what exactly is going on with Elissa Zal and what seems to be an unofficial hyperwave comm relay. Any answers, it seems, are to be found in the Isirah system.
entries.zh: 你断开了通讯，想知道 Elissa Zal 到底发生了什么，还有非官方的超波通讯中继站到底是什么。似乎所有答案都可以在 Isirah 星系中找到。

entries.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam?" your quartermaster asks through a comm link. You tell them what to do and, used to strange orders, they assure you that it will be done before you deorbit.
entries.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam？" 你的军需官通过通讯链接询问道。你告诉他们该怎么做，他们也习惯了这些奇怪的命令，向你保证会在你启航前完成。

entries.en:
The agent launches into a polished spiel, "The Academy was founded pre-collapse, a humble institution of research and higher education on the grand frontier of the Domain. The dual foci were practical matters in fields from applied terraforming to engineering sciences and more theoretical pursuits, including study of local astrophysics and xenobiology. The Collapse of course, changed everything, and in the following cycles... "

Your eyes wander over the people coming and going. Groups of energetic youth display earnest association with various subcultures by modifying their standard Academy uniforms- knockoff hivescum holo tags, ironic Luddic weave, Hegemony officer coats done up in off-code colors and patterns, ill-fitted spacer rigging. A few proper academicians in pale coats study their datapads or walk swiftly in small groups to meetings and lectures.
entries.zh:
这位事务代理开始了一段烂熟于心的套话，"学院成立于大崩塌之前，当时还只是人之领广阔边境上的一所不起眼的机构，潜心于研究与高等教育。那时学院的研究焦点讲求双轨并重，一方面解决从应用化地貌改造到工程科学领域的实际问题，另一方面又努力推动包括本地天体物理学和外星生物学在内的理论探究。当然，大崩塌改变了一切，在接下来的几个星历年里..."

你的目光在来来往往的人群中游移。一群朝气蓬勃的年轻人借着修改他们标准学院制服的机会，展示着他们和各种亚文化的热忱联系 —— 山寨版的巢区帮派全息标签、充斥戏谑意味的卢德织物、颜色图案都不合规范的霸主军官外套，还有松松垮垮的太空佬装束。一些穿着淡色外套的正经院士们或是在他们的数据平板上做研究，或是三五成群地走去参加会议和讲座。

entries.en:
Cursory inspection by your technology officer - to make sure this isn't some kind of bomb or rogue AI core - reveals a data core packed to its limit with compressed telemetry streams.

"It's a... a lot of data," they say, scrolling through vast columns of numbers.
entries.zh:
经你的技术军官粗略检查 —— 以确保这不是某种炸弹或失控 AI 核心 —— 之后，你们发现这是一个将压缩后的遥测数据填充到存储极限的数据核心。

"这...数据可真够多的。" 技官说道，一边翻阅着海量的数据条目。

o.en: Good. Then the Academy will pay me for its recovery.
o.zh: 真不错，接下来学院要付我回收费了。

entries.en: It doesn't matter what's on this data core, corrupted or not, so long as the Galatia Academy pays the credits promised for its return. You order the crate secured in the cargo hold until your $shipOrFleet next finds itself in the Galatia system.
entries.zh: 不管这个数据核心里有什么，是否损坏，只要 Galatia 学院为它的归还支付星币就好。你下令将箱子妥善安置在货舱中，直到你的$shipOrFleet下次抵达 Galatia 星系。

entries.en: Your ops chief oversees a retrieval mission by-the-book, staging approach-and-scan to maximize safety in the event of environmental or technological hazards. The salvor team is used to your chief's attention to detail and within the hour place the instrument package data core in an EM-sealed crate.
entries.zh: 在行动长官监督下，回收任务教科书式一般地进行着，长官严格地遵照停步扫描原则，以最大限度地保证在发生环境或技术风险时的安全。打捞小组习惯了行动长官对细节的关注，他们在一小时内把仪器的数据核心放到了带有电磁屏蔽的箱子里。

entries.en:
"Academician Elek, at your service. Captain... ?"

The academician draws out your presumed title like you've forgotten to serve him biscuits with his tea. You're certain your comms officer would have mentioned your name.
entries.zh:
"这里是 Elek 院士，有什么能帮到你的吗。舰... 长？"

院士以一个假定的头衔用作对你的称呼，那语气就好像他在喝茶时你没给他送饼干一样。你确定你的通讯军官在联络他时提到了你的名字。

o.en: I've recovered a data core. The provost authorized a reward.
o.zh: 我回收了数据核心，院长承诺过提供报酬。

o.en: My name is $playerName. I'm returning a data core for the provost's reward.
o.zh: 我的名字是 $playerName，我为院长承诺的归还数据核心所能得到的报酬而来。

entries.en:
"Oh, one of those. Of course. Your secretary should have just said so." The academician pauses, "But then this would have been Provost Kallichore, would it not? He's not the provost anymore, no no."

Elek's voice deepens with practiced gravitas, "Not after what happened..."
entries.zh:
"哦，那些玩意中的一个。当然可以，你的助理直接这么说就好。" 这位院士停顿了一下，"但如果是这样的话，给你提供报酬的该是 Kallichore 院长，不是吗？可他不再是院长了。"

Elek 的声音变得低沉起来，带着习惯性的稳重语调，"在发生了那样的事之后，不再是了..."

o.en: So is there still a reward?
Is there a reward or should I dump this data core into this gas giant we're orbiting?
o.zh: 你是打算给我报酬呢，还是打算看着我把这玩意儿扔到下边的气态巨行星里呢？

entries.en:
The edge in your voice seems to shake the academician.

"Oh." Elek looks at you blankly for a moment. "Please! Don't do that, the data is very valuable. Which, um, I suppose there is a reward. That account wasn't frozen, after all. Have your secretary or whatever send the datacore to the Planetology Department, if you would be so kind."
entries.zh:
你语气中的锋芒似乎把院士吓了一跳。

"哦。" Elek 茫然地看了你一会儿。"请不要这样做！这些数据很有价值。呃，我想报酬还是有的。毕竟那个账户并没有被冻结。如果你愿意的话，让你的助理或者其他什么人把数据核心送到行星学部门去。"

entries.en:
You would, and you do.

Academician Elek authorizes release of the reward credits to you, via the bursar's office, with surprising alacrity.
entries.zh:
你当然愿意，而且你也这么做了。

Elek 院士通过了财务处的批准，将作为报酬的星币发送给了你，速度快得惊人。

entries.en:
"Oh." Elek looks at you blankly for a moment.
