"I suppose there is that. Hmm, I don't recall that particular account being frozen. Have your secretary or whomever send the data core to the Planetology Department, if you would be so kind."
entries.zh:
"哦。" Elek 茫然地看了看你。

"就这样吧。嗯，那个账户应该没被冻结。如果你愿意的话，让你的助理或者其他什么人把数据核心送到行星学部门去。"

entries.en:
Elek leans back, slipping into his professorial role. "The provost - Kallichore that is - quite overstepped the bounds of his office, in my opinion. The Hegemony agreed and cracked down rather dramatically. Oppression and tyranny ran rampant in the halls of enlightenment! Troopers stomping down the corridors of our fine academy, can you believe!"

"Now, I'm a mere specialist in the planetary sciences - some would say preeminent in my field - so of course I had nothing to do with Kallichore's jump-point experiments. But." He pauses, taking a moment to look up to the heavens.

"I had my suspicions. Particularly of those amongst my colleagues who wouldn't hesitate to breach the ethos we uphold as members of this academy. And that's exactly what I told the Hegemony officer who interrogated me! The thick-headed brute said he'd review my list of names, but per my observations I speculate that he quite ignored my insight. It is as stars tossed in the mud, I tell you! I present the gift of knowledge and-"
entries.zh:
Elek 向后一靠，仿佛回归了教授的角色。"院长 —— 也就是 Kallichore —— 在我看来完全越界了。霸主 看起来完全同意这点，并展开了激烈的镇压。压迫和暴政在启迪心智的教学楼里肆意横行，士兵的铁蹄在这所优秀学院的走廊里随处践踏，你相信能有这种事吗？！"

"虽然我在自己的领域里也算得上是个出类拔萃的人，但我只是个行星学方面的专家，因此我自然和 Kallichore 的跳跃点实验毫无关系。但是。" 他停顿了一下，抬头望了望天。

"我当时是知道哪些人有嫌疑的。特别是某些和我共事的同僚，那些能毫不犹豫地打破我们学院一直秉承的道德伦理的家伙。我就是这么跟审问我的 霸主 军官说的！这个头上有包的畜生说他会再看一遍我的名单，但在就我看来，他完全没把我的看法当回事。我告诉你，这就像把繁星葬于泥土之中！我献上知识和 ——"

entries.en:
Elek rambles away, giving you no clear answers about what happened.

Instead, Academician Elek seems to have a list of complaints against his colleagues, the Hegemony officers who didn't cooperate in Elek's efforts to sell out his colleagues, and against both the previous and current provost, neither of whom holds - or held - a correct appreciation for 'The Academy'.

You sigh, and use your captain-voice to pry a few words into a pause as Elek is finally forced to take a breath.
entries.zh:
Elek 沉浸在自己的艺术中，对你的问题没有给出任何明确的答案。

相反，Elek 院士似乎有一大堆抱怨，对他的同事们，对那些不配合 Elek 出卖他同事的 霸主 军官，以及对前任和现任院长 —— 他们两人对 "学院" 都没有正确的认知。

你叹了口气，在对方话语的间隙以舰长哄下属的口吻插了几句话，Elek 终于被迫喘了口气。

o.en: "Is there a reward or do I dump this data core into the gas giant we're orbiting?
o.zh: 你是打算给我报酬呢，还是打算看着我把这玩意儿扔到下边的气态巨行星里呢？

entries.en:
"Captain!" Sebestyen looks pleased to see you. Come to think of it, he always seems pleased to see you. "I'm told you recovered, um," he taps at something on his desk.

"This um, oh, the data core. That project belongs to... here it is, Academician Elek in planetology."

Far be it from Sebestyen to criticize anyone directly, you detect an unusual drop in positivity in Sebestyen's tone when referring to this 'Elek'. It's not that he's being unkind, just... less kind.
entries.zh:
"舰长！" Sebestyen 似乎很高兴看到你。仔细想想，他看到你时总是一副高兴的样子。"我听说您回收了，嗯。" 他敲了敲桌子上的什么东西。

"这个，哦，数据核心。那个项目属于...行星学的 Elek 院士。"

Sebestyen 绝对不会直接批评任何人，但当提到这个 'Elek' 时，你发现 Sebestyen 的语气中夹杂着不寻常的情绪下降。不是说他不友善，只是...没那么友善了。

o.zh: Elek 院士有什么问题吗？

entries.en:
"Oh yes, of course," Sebestyen says. "There was a separate account allotment for data recovery rewards budgeted into the project's, um, budget. So regardless of who is, um, the current provost or not, you are set to be paid. I just need to send this form, and-" he taps his desk interface decisively.

"Done. The funds should be released to your account now. Good find, captain!"
entries.zh:
"哦，是的，当然，" Sebestyen 说道，"在这个项目的预算中，有一个单独的 '数据回收奖励账户' 用以提供款项。所以不管现任院长是谁，都是有报酬的。我只需要发送这个表格，然后 —— " 他敲击了一下他桌面上的面板。

"好了。奖金现在应该已经打到您的账户里了。不错，舰长！"

entries.en: "I, uh." Sebestyen is caught by your directness. "...Academician Elek?"
entries.zh: "我，呃。" Sebestyen 被你的直截了当弄得措手不及，"...Elek 院士？"

o.en: I get the impression that this person isn't universally liked.
o.zh: 你给我一种并不是谁都喜欢这个人的印象。

o.en: Never mind. The reward is still good?
o.zh: 没什么。我还能拿到报酬吗？

entries.en:
"I, uh," Sebestyen begins, then speaks more quietly, "Of... it, it isn't appropriate for me to speak poorly of any of the faculty of this institution. Being of course that I'm the liaison for Provost Baird's special, um."

He trails off, then tries a new tack.

"It's important that I be aware of the sensitivities of individuals within the academy, of course. And without. And how they might feel about... well, Academician Elek. He might be described by some - not me, of course - as having an, um."

Sebestyn reaches for a dark place within his psyche to find the words, then says "An off-putting manner."
entries.zh:
"我，呃，" Sebestyen 开口了，同时放低了声音，"...考虑到我是 Baird 院长指定的特别联络人，我不应该说这里任何一个教员的坏话，嗯。"

他的声音渐渐低了下去，然后开始尝试一种新的说法。

"当然，重要的是我需要关注到学院内外人员的感受，以及他们对...Elek 院士的感想。有些人 —— 当然不是我 —— 可能会说他，嗯。"

Sebestyn 开始从他内心的阴暗角落寻找词语以进行描述，然后继续道，"他的行为举止令人不快。"

entries.en:
"I mean." Sebestyen looks troubled. "Yes?"

"Of course the individuals who feel, um, off-put don't see it as a small issue at all, which complicates the liaising between the uh, departments in question."
entries.zh: "我的意思是。" Sebestyen 面露难色，"是吗？当然，那些，呃...有这种想法的人不会把这看作小事，这使相关，呃...院系之间的协调工作变得更复杂了。"

o.en: I'm sorry that Elek makes your job more difficult.
o.zh: 对 Elek 让你的工作变得麻烦这一点我深表歉意。

o.en: How much do you hate Elek?

entries.en:
"Please, captain," he says. "You don't need to apologize. My job is to liaison, and Provost Baird picked me because I, I exceed expectations!"

Sebestyen seems to surprise himself a bit with this self-assessment and, steeling himself, proceeds. "I can deal with Elek, don't worry. It is after all," he looks into the middle distance, jaw tight, "My job."
entries.zh:
"舰长，请别这样。" 他说道，"你无需道歉。我的工作是进行联络并协调人事关系，Baird 院长选我的原因是我...我很擅长这个！"

Sebestyen 似乎对自己的这番自我评价感到有点惊讶，接着他定了定神，继续说道，"我能应付 Elek，别担心。这毕竟，" 他目光投向远处，下巴紧绷，"是我的工作。"

entries.en:
"Um." Sebestyen turns a new shade of red. "Of course I don't, uh, I wouldn't use such a strong word with regard to... how about that reward for recovering the data core? $gaIntro2_credits credits, wasn't it?"

He starts tapping desperately at his interface.
entries.zh:
"呃。" Sebestyen 尴尬得脸红起来。"我当然不会，呃，我不会用这么强烈的词来形容...让我们谈谈恢复数据核心的奖励怎么样？$gaIntro2_credits 星币，对吧？"

他开始拼命敲击自己的操作界面。

entries.en:
"Captain!" Sebestyen looks pleased to see you. Come to think of it, he always seems pleased to see you.

"I'm told you recovered, um," he taps at something on his desk. "This um, oh, the data core. That project belongs to... here it is, Academician Elek in planetology."

Far be it from Sebestyen to criticize anyone directly, you detect an unusual drop in positivity in Sebestyen's tone when referring to this 'Elek'. It's not that he's being unkind, just... less kind.
entries.zh:
"舰长！" Sebestyen 似乎很高兴看到你。仔细想想，他看到你时总是一副高兴的样子。

"我听说您回收了，嗯。" 他敲了敲桌子上的什么东西。"这个，哦，数据核心。那个项目属于...行星学的 Elek 院士。"

Sebestyen 绝对不会直接批评任何人，但当提到这个 'Elek' 时，你发现 Sebestyen 的语气中夹杂着不寻常的情绪下降。不是说他不友善，只是...没那么友善了。

o.zh: Elek 院士有什么不对劲的吗？

o.en: Ask about returning a datacore to Provost Kallichore
o.zh: 询问关于将数据核心归还给 Kallichore 院长的事。

entries.en:
At the mention of "Kallichore" the junior agent goes suddenly pale and touches their ear, stammering something about an urgent request as they turn and leave.

With a sigh, you check the public comms terminal nearby. No entry under the name "Kallichore". After your query, the display locks into a Hegemony COMSEC warning.
entries.zh:
当你提到 "Kallichore" 时，那个初级代理的脸色突然变得煞白，他不自然地摸了摸耳朵，嘴上念叨着什么 "紧急请求"，转过身离开了。

你叹了口气，查看附近的公共通讯终端。然而你并没有发现以 Kallichore 这个名字登记的联络方式。在查询之后，终端被锁定了，弹出霸主 COMSEC 的警告标识。

entries.en:
You open comms to your flagship and delegate the task of finding out what's going on to your comms officer.

In short order they manage to navigate the lower echelons of graduate students to finally speak with someone in a position of authority.

The active comms link is routed to your personal interface.
entries.zh:
你接通了与旗舰的通讯，让通讯军官搞明白这里发生了什么事。

在很短的时间内，他们设法联络到了一些学生，然后是老师，接着层层推进，最终找到了一个管事的人。

通讯链接被转移至了你的个人端口。

entries.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam. Yes, of course." Is that the hint of a blush? The reprimand is made, so you push no further.
entries.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。是的，当然。" 技官是不是脸红了？批评已经做出，接下来还是不要过分责难了。

entries.en:
Your sensors officer activates the audio output: a garbled loop, wailing in and out of coherence. A recorded voice?

"The transmitter must be damaged. But with a little work," a hint of pride enters their voice, "There."

"-ment of the Galatia Academy. If found, I implore you to return the data core to the academy for a reward of 18,000 credits authorized by Provost Tomas Kallichore. Message will repeat."
entries.zh:
传感器技官开启音频输出：一段无法辨识的杂音在循环播放，其中夹杂着断断续续的啸叫声。似乎是一段录音？

"发射器肯定损坏了，但只要这样稍微操作一下..." 技官解释的语调带着一丝自豪，"走你。"

"—— Galatia 学院。若有人发现此物，恳请将数据核心归还学院，可获得由院长 Tomas Kallichore 授权的 18,000 星币酬金。信息将重复播放。"

entries.en:
Your sensors officer frowns at a blinking indicator. "Captain, there appears to be a faint signal coming from low orbit."

They pull a detailed scan of the transmission source to the primary bridge display, an orbital nav grid overlaid with icons and telemetry.

"The transmission is very weak. We only picked it up as the survey array ran through its calibration cycle. It looks like an automated instrument package deployed in low orbit. Power source is degraded. It's got to have been here for a while."
entries.zh:
传感器技官对着一盏闪烁的指示灯皱起眉头。"舰长，低轨道上出现了一个微弱的信号。"

传感器技官把对信号源的详细扫描信息上传到了主舰桥的显示器，这是一张布满图标和遥测数据的轨道导航网格图。

"信号源非常微弱，我们只能在勘测阵列运行完一整个校准周期时才接收到。它看起来像一个部署在低轨道的自动仪器套件。动力源已经废弃，看上去留在这里已经有一段时间了。"

entries.en:
"Well," your technology officer's brow furrows, "Recordings. Sensor logs. Detecting, um." They pause the data-feed, examining some of the numbers. "Some kind of... field strength?"

You are beginning to get the impression that your tech officer doesn't know what this device was measuring.
entries.zh:
"嗯，" 你的技术军官皱着眉头说，"录音、传感器记录、检测数据，嗯。" 对方暂停了数据的滚动，关注点放在了其中一些数字上。"某种... 场的强度？"

你心中生出一种感觉，那便是你的技术军官也不知道这玩意在测的到底是什么。

o.en: If you don't know, just say so.
o.zh: 如果你摸不着头脑，那就直说。

o.en: Good. Then the Academy will pay me for its recovery.
o.zh: 真不错，接下来学院要付我回收费了。

entries.en:
You are led to a dark place behind the bar.

In the neon twilight of blinking atmo duct monitor status lights you make out at least two large armed guards by the door.

Your guide has disappeared. One of the guards taps at the door, and after a moment, opens it and holds out a hand indicating that you should enter.
entries.zh:
你被带到了酒吧后一处阴暗的角落。

大气管线监视器的状态灯轻柔地闪烁着，用昏暗的霓虹照亮了一扇门旁两名魁梧的武装守卫。

给你带路的那人消失了。其中一名守卫在门上轻敲了一下。片刻之后，他把门打开，并伸手示意你进去。

o.en: Am I under arrest, or can I go?
o.zh: 我被逮捕了吗？没有的话我可以走了吗？

entries.en:
"You are not under arrest, citizen," $heOrShe admits. But the officer's face freezes in slow anger, "I tried to make this easy for you, you know. The security of the Hegemony ensures the security of the entire sector- to trade freely, to live, to survive. These are easy times compared to what the Hegemony has faced in the past. Do not make yourself an enemy here, captain."

The Hegemony officer stands abruptly, bumping the table and spilling some of the undrunk drinks. "If my department finds you anywhere near another 'mysterious incident', I assure you that we will not be so lenient. Consider this an official warning."

$HeOrShe marches out the front door. The bartender's eyes flick back to you, expressionless.
entries.zh:
"你没有被捕，公民。" 官员如此承认道，但$heOrShe的脸随着逐渐涌上的怒火变得僵硬起来，"你知道，我只是想让谈话轻松一点。霸主 的安全确保了整个星域的安全 —— 人们能自由地贸易、生活以及生存。与 霸主 过去所面临的情况相比，现在是个好时代。舰长，别在这里树敌。"

霸主 官员突然站了起来，撞到桌子并让一些没喝的饮料洒了出来。"如果我们发现你与另一起 '神秘事件' 有关，我向你保证，我们不会再这么仁慈了，把这当作官方警告吧。"

$HeOrShe大步走出了前门，酒保则面无表情地看了你一眼。

entries.en:
In the main entrance you see a flick of targeting lasers shift through near-IR from the silhouette of a light combat exoskeleton. Conversation in the room dies as patrons realize what is happening, leaving only the holos churning out noise. Time seems to slow as you take in the situation with instincts honed in space combat.

Patrons clear out of the bar in a remarkably casual manner, heads lowered, as if they had simply forgotten an appointment and can't be bothered to finish their drinks.
entries.zh:
轻型战术外骨骼的剪影出现在了正门方向，你望过去，正好看到了近红外瞄准激光束正在扫视目标的闪动。顾客们都意识到了事态不对，房间里的谈话声被一片死寂所取代，唯有全息影像还在发出噪声。在你看清当下的形势的同时，常年太空战斗磨练出来的直觉就不自觉地帮你把时间放缓了。

顾客们都努力地强装出一幅随意的样子，低着头离开了酒吧。这些人全都像是突然想起自己还有约，已经没时间喝完饮料了。

entries.en:
"I apologize for this crude posturing, Captain $playerName," the Hegemony officer says as $heOrShe approaches. $HeOrShe has a smooth Eventide academy accent; cream of the crop.

"Protocol," $heOrShe says with feigned resignation. You feel the silent mass of c-con thugs hovering closer behind you. The Hegemony officer gives a little stand-down wave, then says "Let us sit and have an informal chat. Let the Hegemony buy you a drink. That would be nice, yes?"

It seems you have little choice in the matter. Best play along until you get a read on the situation.
entries.zh:
"我为这失礼的状况表示抱歉，$playerName 舰长。" 那位 霸主 军官一边走过来一边说道。$HeOrShe有一口悦耳的 Eventide 学院口音，应该是位军中翘楚。

"这是规矩。" $heOrShe摆出一副身不由己的样子说到。你感觉到一群沉默的公控警员在你身后靠了过来。霸主 军官挥手示意让他们退下，然后对你说，"我们坐下来谈谈吧。就当是 霸主 请你喝一杯。你应该很乐意，对吧？"

在这件事上你似乎别无选择。在了解情况之前，你最好配合一下。

entries.en:
The bartender, sweating, places two drinks on the table between you and scurries off.

"Now I'm sure you've heard of the recent unpleasantness in the Aztlan system, yes? A terrible thing, this data-breach. Are you a student of history, captain? It's the sort of thing that starts wars, so we very much want to ensure that our investigation is ... conclusive."

"We know your $shipOrFleet was in the vicinity- no," $heOrShe smiles pleasantly, "You're not being accused of anything. I simply want to draw upon your patriotism and report if you... saw anything. As any good citizen would."
entries.zh:
酒保冷汗直冒，把两杯酒放在你们之间的桌子上之后就快步走开了。

"我相信你已经听说 Aztlan 星系最近发生了不愉快的事，对吧？数据泄露，那还真是件可怕的事情。你知道以史为鉴吗，舰长？在历史上这种事件就是所谓的战争的导火索，因此我们非常想确保我们的调查结果是...确凿无误的。"

"我们知道当时你的$shipOrFleet就在附近 —— 不过..." $heOrShe笑了，看上去还挺愉快的，"我并不是在指控你。我只是想唤起你的爱国精神，报告一下你是否有...看到任何东西。就如一名遵纪守法的好公民一样。"

o.en: I'm sure I didn't see anything, officer.
o.zh: 我确定当时没看到任何东西，长官。

entries.en:
"Indeed," $heOrShe frowns, eyes fixed on you. "Perhaps if we examined your sensor logs we would find something that slipped your mind."

But that would require a warrant, which requires very clear evidence of wrongdoing. The Hegemony could override the requirement, or manufacture it, but you know their bureaucracy moves slowly.

"Have you met or heard of an individual by the name of 'Gargoyle'? There is a significant reward for information, you know."
entries.zh:
"的确。" $heOrShe皱起眉头盯着你，"如果我们检查一下你的传感器日志，也许会发现一些你没注意到的东西。"

但这需要搜查令，而搜查令需要非常明确的不法行为证据。霸主 当然可以凌驾于任何条件之上，他们也可以制造条件，但你知道他们的官僚机构行动缓慢。

"你见过或者听说过任何叫 'Gargoyle' 的人吗？你知道，提供信息可是有大量报酬的。"

o.en: Patriotism, huh. What's with the goon squad?
o.zh: 爱国精神，是吧？那这群打手是怎么回事？
那这群打手是怎么回事？

entries.en:
The Hegemony officer produces a fake smile, then speaks an order into $hisOrHer cuff. You note the c-com covering the room fall away. "You must excuse my department. Some of my... associates suggested a different approach to our meeting. We compromised."

$HeOrShe gives you an open look, "I argued for an informal chat, captain. Make me right. Help me help you help the Hegemony."
entries.zh:
霸主 官员假笑了一下，然后对着$hisOrHer的袖口说了一句什么。你注意到满屋子公控警员都消失了。"还请您原谅我的手下。我的一些...同事们对我们的会议形式曾提出过一些不同的建议。现在我们已经谈妥了。"

$HeOrShe自然地看了看你："我主张的是非正式的聊天，舰长。那样对你我和 霸主 都有好处。"

o.en: You got me. I hacked the Aztlan Relay.
o.zh: 你逮到我了，正是我黑入了 Aztlan 中继站。

entries.en: The Hegemony officer frowns. "I am not here to make light of a serious security breach, captain. I understand you have a reputation, and that makes you very interesting. You might be wise to make yourself a great deal less interesting, captain, before the Hegemony starts to take you seriously."
entries.zh: 霸主军官皱了皱眉头，"我可不是来对一场严重的安全破坏开玩笑的，舰长。我知道你名声在外，那让你显得格外引人注目。在霸主开始认真对待你之前，你最好低调一些。"

entries.en: The bartender slowly shakes their head. Business is ruined for this shift, there's nothing more to say.
entries.zh: 酒保缓缓摇了摇头。今天的生意算是毁了，没什么好说的。

entries.en:
You begin taking stock of the patrons, looking for leads. As you scan the room, suddenly you lock eyes with a $manOrWoman in Hegemony uniform. $HeOrShe raises a hand, and holding it close to $hisOrHer chest points at you while saying something to the uniformed civil control officer at $hisOrHer side.

Turning to find a path for an inconspicuous exit, you see that more c-cons have appeared - by their posture, you surmise that they are holding small hand weapons on your bodyguards, who have responded in kind.
entries.zh:
你开始扫视人群，寻找线索。当环视房间时，你的目光突然锁定在了一个穿着 霸主 制服的$manOrWoman身上。只见$HeOrShe把手贴在胸前指了指你，同时对身边身着制服的公众管控警官说了些什么。

你立即转身想去找一个不那么显眼的出口，却看到了更多的公控警员。从他们的姿势来看，你推测他们已经用轻武器瞄准了你的保镖，你的保镖也以同样的方式做出回应。

o.en: Sounds like Tri-Tachyon beat you again.
o.zh: 看起来 速子科技 又一次打败了你们。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe mutters into $hisOrHer cuff. You catch the phrase "waste of time".

The Hegemony officer stands abruptly, bumping the table and spilling some of the undrunk drinks. "Get out of this bar. If my department finds you anywhere near another 'mysterious incident', I assure you that we will not be so lenient."

$HeOrShe storms out the front door. The bartender's eyes flick back to you, expressionless.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe对着$hisOrHer的袖口说了句什么。你听到了 "浪费时间" 这样的话。

霸主 官员突然站了起来，撞到桌子并让一些没喝过的饮料洒了出来。"滚出这个酒吧。如果我们发现你与其他什么 '神秘事件' 有关，我向你保证，我们不会再这么仁慈了。"

$HeOrShe怒气冲冲地走出了前门，酒保则面无表情地看了你一眼。

entries.en:
You give the go-order to your ops chief, who starts speaking in a low voice to the hand-picked squad of veteran salvage techs that are already crossing to the relay on a cargo drone.

The entire operation is carried out swiftly and according to the drills. A few quick cuts with low-EM tools, bulkhead section removed, Gargoyle's device secured in place. Parasite microdrones in the chassis will finish attaching key connections; taps into fiber lines, mostly. The bulkhead is sealed and the team withdraws with a few puffs of cold gas thrusters as silently as they approached.
entries.zh:
你向行动长官下达了命令，其低声叮嘱了几位精心挑选的资深打捞技师一些注意事项，接着后者搭乘着货运无人机到达了中继站。

整个行动都按照事先规划好的迅速进行完毕。技师用有着低电磁信号的工具进行了几次快速切割，移除了部分舱壁，将 Gargoyle 的装置固定到位。安装在底盘上寄生微型无人机则完成了联接的关键部分 —— 主要是接入光纤线路。最后，舱壁被密封完成，队员们随着货运无人机的冷气体推进器启动开始了撤退，就如他们来时一样安静。

entries.en:
Shortly, your comms officer confirms a short burst indicating that Gargoyle's device is operational.

Despite Gargoyle's cavalier attitude toward the entire enterprise, your comms and tech officers speculate that a hack this intrusive will be discovered very quickly indeed. It would be best to make a hasty escape while you remain undetected.
entries.zh:
很快，通讯军官收到了一个短脉冲信号，这证明 Gargoyle 的装置已经开始正常运作。

哪怕是不将 Gargoyle 那漫不经心的态度纳入考量范围，通讯军官和技术军官依然推测这样的入侵很快会被发现。趁你还没被抓个现行，马上逃走会是个正确的选择。

entries.en:
You wonder, too, if the Hegemony will trace the hack back to Gargoyle's hideout. A Tri-Tachyon controlled polity is unlikely to cooperate quickly with any Hegemony investigation.

But then the investigation might not be 'official', and less an investigation than a black ops snatch squad.

You should retrieve the archive from Gargoyle quickly.
entries.zh:
你也在想，霸主是否会用黑客装置反向追踪到 Gargoyle 的藏身处，但一个由 速子科技 控制的政体不太可能迅速配合 霸主 的任何调查。

但话说回来，那次调查可能并非 "官方" 性质，与其说是调查，不如说是一支秘密行动的抓捕小队。

你应该尽快从 Gargoyle 那里取回档案。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $name.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $name。

o.en: Install Gargoyle's hack device on the Aztlan Relay
o.zh: 在 Aztlan 的中继站上安装 Gargoyle 的黑客装置

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet was recently detected - or is currently being tracked by - a nearby fleet, making a covert installation of the hack impossible.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet刚刚被一支附近的舰队探测到 —— 亦或是正在被其追逐，这使得秘密安装黑客装置不可能实现。

entries.en:
The agent unleashes $hisOrHer perfect smile once more.

"By entering this establishment you have agreed to certain terms and conditions. By entering Tri-Tachyon space- you understand. Besides," $heOrShe drops the perfect smile. "I think you are well beyond that, considering the company you have been keeping."
entries.zh:
特工又一次露出了$heOrShe那完美的微笑。

"进入本场所的行为表明您已经同意了某些条款和条件，您明白我在说什么。此外..." $heOrShe维持着微笑，"考虑到一直以来的伙伴关系，我认为您了解的远不止于此。"

o.en: Is this about Baird and the Galatia Academy? Or Gargoyle? Arroyo maybe?
o.zh: 这是关于 Baird 和 Galatia 学院的事？还是 Gargoyle？又或者 Arroyo？

o.en: Point taken. Thanks for the drink. (leave)
o.zh: 知道了。谢谢你的饮料。 (离开)

entries.en:
Somehow the Tri-Tachyon agent's smile grows brighter and more perfect. "We just want to clear up a little confusion, you're not in trouble in the least."

"Please," $heOrShe indicates a spot where a curtain has been withdrawn to reveal a private booth that you did not previously notice was even there, "Let us provide you with a complimentary refreshment."
entries.zh:
不知怎么的，速子特工的笑容变得更加灿烂而完美。"我们只想搞清一些事情，您并没有陷入麻烦中。"

"请。" $heOrShe拉开了窗帘，窗帘下是一个你之前根本没有注意到的私人客座，"我们可以为您提供免费茶点。"

o.en: No, thank you. I was just leaving.
o.zh: 谢谢，但是不用。我这就要走了。

entries.en:
The agent looks nervous, breaking $hisOrHer facade and looking around as if for eavesdroppers.

"That's quite enough, captain," $heOrShe says somewhat more loudly, cutting you off, "I think we've all said our part." $HeOrShe stands, leveling $hisOrHer eyes down at you "The Tri-Tachyon Corporation thanks you for your business and we wish you safe travels.

The Tri-Tachyon agent disappears into some shadow. You look at your untouched drink. A bubble breaks onto the surface.
entries.zh:
特工看上去很紧张，$hisOrHer的淡定消失无踪，东张西望起来，让你感觉隔墙之耳无处不在。

"够了，舰长。" $heOrShe把声音提高了一些，打断了你的话，"我想我们都说完了。" $HeOrShe站了起来，用$hisOrHer的眼睛俯视着你："三一速子科技公司 感谢您的合作，并祝您一路平安。"

速子特工消失在阴影中。你看着你那杯没碰过的饮料，一个气泡缓缓地上升，并在触及液面时破裂了。

entries.en:
"There was an incident recently. The Aztlan Relay was compromised. Very embarrassing for HEGCOM, what with a, ah, history of such incidents. With embarrassment comes a propensity for overreaction, of conclusion leapt at based on long-held biases against the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. Now, we consider the unpleasantness of the AI Wars water under the bridge. After all, there's business to be done."

The agent's smile disappears, and $hisOrHer tone goes cold, "Our shareholders have much to lose. We cannot allow tensions to be inflamed by... adventurism." $HisOrHer eyes narrow, "Nor do I expect the current provost of Galatia to last long in her post. Give some thought to who you choose to do business with."
entries.zh:
"最近发生了一起事故，Aztlan 中继站被瘫痪了。这对 HEGCOM 来说非常尴尬，他们已经有过类似遭遇了。而随着这种尴尬而来的会是过激反应的倾向 —— 考虑到他们对 三一速子科技公司 的偏见，那对象会是我们。我们认为不愉快的 AI 战争都是过去时了，现在还有生意要做呢。"

特工的笑容消失了，语气变得冰冷起来："我们的股东可能会损失惨重，因此我们不能允许紧张局势被...冒险行动所激化。" $HisOrHer的眼睛眯了起来，"我也没指望 Galatia 的现任院长能在她的岗位上呆多久，考虑一下你应该和谁合作。"

o.en: Are you making me an offer?
I don't appreciate being spied on.
Point taken. Thanks for the drink. (leave)
o.zh: 知道了。谢谢你的饮料。 (离开)

entries.en:
You idly tap a pricey drink from the menu and it appears before you within seconds.

Noticing your surprise, the agent explains "Each customer builds a Tri-Taste profile as they enjoy our products. Correlating purchase history with time of day and certain other physiological signifiers allows- " $heOrShe raises $hisOrHer hands apologetically, "I get carried away sometimes. It's my passion for customer satisfaction."

You understand what is being said: We're watching you.

"But we're here to talk about your business," the agent's hand gently points at you without otherwise moving, "Not mine."
entries.zh:
你漫不经心地从菜单上点了昂贵的饮料，几秒钟内它就出现在了你面前。

特工注意到了你的惊讶，解释说："每个顾客在享受我们的产品时，我们都会建立速子口味档案。将购买饮料的时间和其他特定的生理信号联系起来，并以此 —— " $heOrShe举了举$hisOrHer的手以示歉意，"我可能有点太投入了，毕竟让客户满意是我的追求。"

你明白对方想表达什么：我们正在监视你。

"不过我们在这里要谈的是你的事情。" 特工用手轻轻地指了指你，"而不是我的。"

o.en: I don't appreciate being spied on.

entries.en:
The perfect smile twitches, then reaffirms itself, stronger than before.

"I'm sure we'll speak again, Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says with plastic cheer. "And on behalf of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation I would like to thank you for your visit."
entries.zh:
那完美的微笑抽搐了一下，在稍作调整后变得更灿烂了。

"我相信我们还会再见面的，$playerName 舰长。" $heOrShe带着虚假的兴致说道，"我谨代表 三一速子科技公司 感谢您的来访。"

entries.en:
You stand from the table, drink untouched. The Tri-Tachyon agent's eyes track you, no smile now.

You get that tingle on the back of your neck as you leave.
entries.zh:
你从桌边站起来，连饮料都没碰一下。速子特工的视线跟着你，脸上看不到一丝笑意。

当转身想要离开时，你感觉到脖子后面传来了刺痛感。

entries.en:
You stand from the table, drink untouched.

You almost feel like there's a tingle on the back of your neck as you leave, but the Tri-Tachyon agent is nowhere to be seen.
entries.zh:
你从桌边站起来，连饮料都没碰一下。

当你离开时，你似乎感觉到脖子后面一阵刺痛，但那位 速子科技 特工已不见踪影。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe stands, leveling $hisOrHer eyes down at you "The Tri-Tachyon Corporation thanks you for your business and wishes you safe travels. I'm sure you will continue to respect the business-friendly environment we cultivate in Tri-Tachyon space and beyond."

The Tri-Tachyon agent disappears into some shadow. You look at your untouched drink. A bubble breaks onto the surface.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe站了起来，用$hisOrHer的眼睛俯视着你："三一速子科技公司 感谢您的合作，并祝您一路平安。我相信您会继续尊重我们在 速子科技 疆域内外培育的商业友好环境。"

速子特工消失在阴影中。你看着你那杯没碰过的饮料，一个气泡缓缓地上升，并在触及液面时破裂了。

entries.en:
For a long few seconds, no response. Then the agent's smile appears again.

"I am pleased to hear that you are receptive to the suggestion," $heOrShe says, then stands. "The Company will be in contact, I'm sure. Thank you for your time, $playerName. I'm certain you will continue to respect the business-friendly environment we cultivate in Tri-Tachyon space and beyond."

The Tri-Tachyon agent disappears into some shadow. You look back at your untouched drink. A bubble breaks onto the surface.
entries.zh:
在接下来的数秒钟内，对方都没有做出任何回应。随后特工脸上的微笑再度浮现。

"我很高兴您能接受这个建议。" $heOrShe说道，然后站了起来，"我敢肯定公司会和您保持联络的。感谢您抽空交流，$playerName。我相信您会继续尊重我们在 速子科技 疆域内以及其他地方培育的商业友好环境。"

速子特工消失在阴影中。你看着你那杯没碰过的饮料，一个气泡缓缓地上升，并在触及液面时破裂了。

entries.en:
As your gaze begins to skim the crowd for potential jobs, a $manOrWoman in spotless Tri-Tachyon executive attire insinuates themself in front of you.

"Captain $playerName, we are so pleased that you have chosen to visit this franchise. The Tri-Tachyon Corporation values your contribution to the local economy," $heOrShe smiles perfectly as you realize that your hand is being shaken.

"If we may sit over here, I would like to discuss a special matter... Company business."
entries.zh:
当你扫视人群寻找潜在的工作机会时，穿着一尘不染的速子高管服装的$manOrWoman神不知鬼不觉地出现在了你面前。

"$playerName，我们很高兴看到您的到来。三一速子科技公司 十分重视您对当地经济的贡献。" $heOrShe边握着你的手边露出了完美的微笑。

"我们能换个地方吗？我想讨论一件特殊的事...公司业务。"

o.zh: 跟随 速子科技 特工

entries.en:
Arroyo looks even less pleased to see you after this statement.

"I see," he says.

He raises a gold-ringed finger, "Don't tell me a single word. It's Gargoyle. I know very well that I don't want to know what that absurd vandal is planning. I'll pay the bills that show up, that's the deal." He grimaces, "And I'll forward my invoice to Provost Baird so that ivory-torus puppetmaster can appreciate how much she's wringing me for."

"Now get off my comms."

He terminates the connection.
entries.zh:
这话一出，Arroyo 脸上的不悦更重了几分。

"原来如此，" 他说道。

他竖起一根戴金戒指的手指，"一个字也别跟我讲。是 Gargoyle 干的。我清楚得很，那个荒唐的捣蛋鬼在盘算什么，我一点都不想知道。账单来了我照付，说好的就是这样。" 他做了个苦脸，"回头我把发票转给 Baird 院长，好让那位象牙塔里牵线的主儿掂量掂量，她从我这儿榨走了多少。"

"现在，从我的通讯上滚开。"

他掐断了链接。

o.en: I found Gargoyle. There may be some expenses.
o.zh: 我找到 Gargoyle 了。兴许要花点钱。

entries.en:
Your comms officer connects your personal terminal to the local network. You activate the audio suppression field around your command station and enter the comms ID provided to you by Provost Baird. The animated logo of some Tri-Tachyon sub-department makes a half rotation before the call is answered.

"Arroyo here. Who's talking to me?" Rayan Arroyo looks you over as if examining a starship hull for scratches. He seems to find something he doesn't quite approve of in you.

"Who gave you my comms ID?" he demands.
entries.zh:
通讯军官将你的个人终端连接到本地网络。你先启动了指挥台周围的音频抑制场，接着输入 Baird 院长提供给你的通信 ID。某个 速子科技 子部门的全息标识转了半圈，然后通讯接通了。

"这里是 Arroyo。你哪位？" Rayan Arroyo 打量着你，就像在检查遍布划痕的星舰一样。他似乎对你有些意见。

"谁给了你我的通讯 ID？" 他质问道。

o.en: I'm told you can help me solve a problem.
o.zh: 我听说你可以帮我解决一个问题。

entries.en:
Your call connects to an automated receiver. The animated logo of a Tri-Tachyon subsidiary spins endlessly on your display. After half a minute and the second time a voice tells you that your patience is appreciated, you conclude that your call is being ignored.

Arroyo wants to discuss business in-person.
entries.zh:
你的通讯链接被转到了自动应答器上。速子科技 子公司的全息标识在你的显示画面上转个没完。在等了半分钟，听过两遍 "非常感谢您的耐心" 的声音之后，你知道自己的通讯请求被忽略了。

看来 Arroyo 想当面讨论业务。

o.en: I found Gargoyle. There may be some expenses.
o.zh: 我找到 Gargoyle 了。兴许要花点钱。

entries.en:
"Solve a problem." He says this as if it's a matter far beneath the worth of his attention.

"I don't solve problems, buddy. I pay people to solve problems for me. You got problems? Go talk to the shipyard and get your oxygen leak fixed. I don't care about your problem unless your problem is seven or eight figs of cash in an account that you need put to work."

He's starting to shout. You get the impression that he enjoys this sort of upbraiding.

"Done wasting my time? Now tell me who gave you my number because I'm going to fire them right after I cut this link."
entries.zh:
"解决问题。" 他的语气很不耐烦。

"我不解决问题，伙计。我付钱让别人为我解决问题。你有问题？去找船厂把你那氧气泄漏修一修吧。除非你账户后面有七八个零没地方用，否则我对你的问题不感兴趣。"

他的嗓门逐渐大了起来。在你看来，他很享受这种责骂他人的时间。

"浪费够我的时间了么？现在告诉我是谁让你来烦我的，我等下就要去解雇他。"

entries.en:
For just a moment, you think you see a wave of panic cross Arroyo's face. It's replaced by a cocky grin, "Oh, of course, of course- the Galatia Academy endowment fund. How could I forget?"

"Here," he taps at something and your comms displays an incoming set of coordinates with the code of a landing beacon.

"Take a shuttle down. We can touch base about the fund. I'm sure the Provost has exciting plans and I want to hear all about them-" He lifts his eyes upward for a moment and lowers them again to look directly at you. "In person."
entries.zh:
有那么一瞬间，你似乎看到 Arroyo 的脸上掠过一丝惊慌。取而代之的是傲慢的笑容。"哦，当然，当然 —— Galatia 学院的捐赠基金，我哪敢忘啊。"

"这里。" 他敲了敲什么东西，你的通讯器显示了一组刚传入的坐标和一个着陆信标的编码。

"乘坐穿梭机下来。我们可以就基金的问题进行接洽。我相信院长有着一些令人振奋的计划，我想好好了解一下 —— " 他抬起眼睛看了看，又低下头来直视着你，"当面谈。"

entries.en:
He carries on as if this was all perfectly expected.

"Ever been planetside? Doesn't count if it's just the arcologies. I'll give you a tour of my chalet. Spectacular views, you'll love it. See you soon."

He closes the connection before you can respond.
entries.zh:
他继续说着，好像这一切都在意料之中。"来过地表么？只去过生态都市群不算。我带你参观一下我的山间别墅。景色很壮观，你肯定会爱上的。待会儿见。"

他在你回应之前关闭了连接。

entries.en:
Leaving behind the Tri-Tach arcologies, diamonds growing atop the detritus of tiered slums. Over pipelines, a steel-blue bay, jagged fjords interrupted by ice-jams and landslides. Up and over a great crumbling escarpment like a black wave that fills the horizon; you cross a landscape of oddly-hued tundra spotted with thousands of milky-green lakes.

A new range of mountains rises on the horizon, torn in half by catastrophic workings of the terraformers, and beyond is a chaos of steep valleys populated by dwarf pine and thin white waterfalls. The nav system sounds a tone indicating imminent arrival, and you see Arroyo's private chalet: a small compound of radical geometric architecture surrounded by low outbuildings.

Your shuttle approaches an ellipsoid landing pad that appears to hang in the thin air over a gorge.
entries.zh:
越过速子的生态都市群 —— 那是一颗颗在层层贫民窟的碎石堆中耸立的钻石。飞越管道密布的区域，一片钢蓝色的海湾映入眼帘，锯齿状的峡湾被冰塞与山体滑坡截断。继续攀升，越过一道如黑色巨浪般横穿地平线的崩塌崖壁；又穿越了一片色调奇异的苔原，其上点缀着数千个乳绿色的湖泊。

一组新的山脉在地平线上升起，被地貌改造工程的灾难性运作撕成了两半，而更后面是一片混乱的陡峭山谷，被矮松树和细白的瀑布所点缀。导航系统响起，提示你即将到达，你看到了 Arroyo 的私人别墅：一座由激进几何建筑构成的小型复合体，周围环绕着低矮的附属建筑。

你的穿梭机接近了一个椭圆形的降落台，一眼看去它就像是悬浮在峡谷上空。

entries.en:
A human and a robotic servant greet you placidly as you arrive and lead you inside to a grand parlor done in dark geometric style. Gold inlay gleams in onyx tabletops, and the polished granite floor is set with tastefully patterned jewel-tone carpets placed slightly askew.

The view from the flawless sweep of diamond-matrix bay window is, as Arroyo promised, spectacular.
entries.zh:
当你到达时，一名人类仆人和一个机器人仆人平和地迎接你的到来，接着他们带你步入宏大的深色几何风格客厅。黄金镶嵌在黑玛瑙的桌面上闪耀，抛光的花岗岩地板上铺着的宝石色调地毯些许偏斜，其上的花纹设计感十足。

从金刚石方窗往外望去，映入眼帘的景色确实如 Arroyo 承诺的一样壮观。

entries.en:
Rayan Arroyo is sitting at one of the bars. He acknowledges your entrance with a nod as the servants disappear. He taps his datapad with two fingers. You hear the soft signal loss ping from your datapad and your sidearm-hand twitches instinctively.

Arroyo acknowledges this with the rise of one perfectly groomed eyebrow. "Calm down. Just making sure no one's listening." He flips through a series of null readouts on a datapad and, satisfied, sets it aside.

"So Baird is calling in another installment. What will that be, Captain $playerName?"
entries.zh:
Rayan Arroyo 正坐在屋中一个吧台里。他点头回应你的到来，而那两名仆人则默默退下。Arroyo 用两根手指敲了敲他的数据平板。随着你听到自己的数据平板发出柔和的信号丢失的声音，你平时握枪用的那只手本能地抽动了一下。

Arroyo 把他修剪得十分完美的眉毛挑了一下。"冷静，我只是在确保没有人监听。" 他在数据平板上检查了一系列读数为空，然后满意地将其放在一边。

"所以，Baird 又来催收下一笔款项了，你们需要什么呢？$playerName 舰长？"

o.en: I need to break into the datavault of the Ministry of Technology Standards.
o.zh: 我需要进入科技标准部的数据库

o.en: No small-talk? What about the tour?
o.zh: 不先聊些别的么？之前说好的参观呢？

entries.en:
He slams down an empty glass.

"I know someone who can do it. They're a pain in the ass but, this is key, they're crazy enough to do a job as stupid as the one you're proposing. A hacker called Gargoyle - the real one, not one of the wannabes. We've done business before. Here's a comms ID." Rayan pulls a datakey from a pocket, waves it over his datapad, and after a couple taps pushes it toward you.

"If you get any pushback, if Gargoyle throws a little tantrum, just give it back. It's all about the drama, but in the end you're already in with a job as stupid as this." He holds a hand up, "And by the way, you really did not need to go and tell me your true objective. The last thing I want is Hegemony counterint crawling all over my operation. Or, worse, some vampire from the Company board smelling blood."
entries.zh:
他猛地放下空杯子。"我知道一个人能办到。那家伙是个麻烦精，但关键是那家伙也疯到足以接下你提出的这种蠢差事。一个叫 Gargoyle 的黑客 —— 真正的黑客，不是那些模仿者。我们以前打过交道。这是他的通信 ID。" Rayan 从口袋里掏出一个数据密钥，在他的数据平板上挥了一挥，点了几下后把它推向了你。

"如果 Gargoyle 耍脾气不乐意，就照样子跟他对着干。他就喜欢小题大作，但反正你已经接手这么蠢的差事了。" 他举起一只手，"顺便说一下，你真的没必要告诉我那些细节。我最不想看到的就是 霸主 情报人员在我的地盘上转来转去。或者更糟，让董事会的一些吸血鬼摸到端倪。"

entries.en: He slaps the onyx bar-top one last time and puts his head in his hands.
entries.zh: 最后，他狠狠拍向黑玉制的吧台，然后把脸埋进了双手。

entries.en:
He sighs and pours something from a crystal decanter into a glass, empties it. "To a deal that gets worse all the time!"

Then pours another. He considers a moment, notices you, and tilts the decanter to offer you a drink.
entries.zh:
他叹了口气，从水晶酒瓶中倒出些什么到杯子里，接着把酒杯一口喝干。"向这个越来越糟的交易致敬！"

他又倒了一杯，思考了一会，发现你还在，就偏了偏酒瓶想为你斟酒。

entries.en:
"What Baird's got is a good investment, and the longer she waits-" he waves at the luxurious surroundings; the career of Rayan Arroyo "-the more interest she'll collect."

A shrug. "It's done well enough for me. We all make deals to get ahead, and I've seen worse. Done worse to others. Plus, I'm an asset now. You can't simply snuff an asset owned by a bigger player."

He turns and stares directly at you, "And you're an asset now, too. Hypothetical question- what's she got on you?" He gives a cold smile. "I hope you know."
entries.zh:
"Baird 做了一笔很划算的投资，而她等的时间越长 —— " 他向周围奢华的环境挥了挥手，这些都是 Rayan Arroyo 的事业，" —— 收到的利息就更多。"

他耸了耸肩。"对我来说，这已经够好了。我们做出交易终归是为了出人头地，而且我还见过更坏的事，当然也做过还要更糟的。外加，我现在可是一份资产。你不能就这么扼杀由更大的把手所拥有的资产。"

他转过身来，死死盯着你。"而你现在也是一份资产了。想想这个问题 —— 她有你什么把柄？" 他露出了冷笑，"我希望你能想通。"

o.en: What's Baird got on you anyway?
o.zh: 所以 Baird 到底有你什么把柄？

entries.en:
As soon as you say it, a smile grows on Arroyo's face.

He starts laughing, and takes his time as it builds and falls. He laughs like he's strapped to a madman's rocket, with no escape. Why not enjoy the ride?
entries.zh: 你话音刚落，Arroyo 就笑了起来。他放声大笑着，任凭笑意在胸中酝酿又平息，仿佛自己被绑了在疯子的火箭上：既然无处可逃，何不享受这趟旅程呢？

entries.en: He shrugs, and sips his second drink. "Stick to Baird. You'll find your vice to cope," he says.
entries.zh: 他耸耸肩，抿了一口他的第二杯酒。"继续跟着 Baird。你也会找到能麻醉自己的恶习，" 他说。

entries.en: Arroyo pours another, passes you the tumbler, and clinks his glass into yours, hard. "And Anahita Baird!" he shouts.
entries.zh: Arroyo 又倒了一杯，把平底杯递给你，狠狠碰了一下。"也敬 Anahita Baird！" 他喊道。

entries.en:
He gives you a look. "No. Who cares. Doesn't matter. Most of anything you'll hear about Gargoyle is made up, and half of that is true. So don't bother trying."

He leans back, looking elsewhere, content to talk to himself some more. "What's important is that Gargoyle always gets the job done. My theory is it's some kind of obsessive brain thing," he twirls a hand at his head to demonstrate. "Probably implanted a cybermod the wrong way around and got an AI instead of a frontal lobe."

"Have fun with that one," he says with a smirk.
entries.zh:
他给你了个眼色。"不可以，谁在乎呢。这不重要，你所听到的关于 Gargoyle 的事情真假参半，所以别白费时间了。"

他向后靠了靠，目光看向别处，自顾自地继续说了下去。"重要的是，Gargoyle 总是能完成工作，我觉得他真是个强迫症。" 他用手在脑袋旁边转了转示意，"搞不好还插错了什么赛博植入体的那种，脑子里多了个 AI，少了块额叶。"

"祝你们相处愉快，" 他嬉皮笑脸地说。

o.en: Can you tell me more about this 'Gargoyle'?
o.zh: 能不能跟我多聊一聊这位 'Gargoyle'？

entries.en:
As you start laughing, it seems to sap something from Arroyo's mania. You trail it off, leaving an awkward silence.

He puts his head in his hands.
entries.zh:
你突然迸发的笑声让 Arroyo 冷静了一点。随后你也收了声，两人之间只剩一片尴尬的寂静。

他把脸埋进了双手。

entries.en:
You've got what you needed from Rayan Arroyo, and with no signal on his part that you can discern, his human and robot servants appear once more.

"I won't say it's been a pleasure, but if you ever have more credits than you know what to do with or, hmm, a truly exceptional business opportunity, let's trade cryptokeys now so you don't have to track space-dust on my carpet again."

He taps his datapad and offers it, and you perform the mundane ritual which will ensure that anyone who wants to crack your mutual comms will, at least, have to put some effort into the task.
entries.zh:
你已经从 Rayan Arroyo 那里得到了你需要的东西，你没看到他有发出什么信号，但他的人类与机器人仆人再次出现了。

"我不会说这次的见面很愉快，但如果你哪天有太多钱不知道怎么花，或者说，一个十分卓越的商业契机，让我们交换一下通讯密钥，省得你下次还得把太空尘埃踩进我的地毯里。"

他在他的数据平板上敲了敲后递给了你，而你也走了一下无聊的流程，至少这会让想要骇入你们共同通讯的人多费些功夫。

entries.en:
Your shuttle reverses the previous route, down from the highlands, across the plateau of lakes. You spot factory-crawlers disgorging pipe and monorail pylons across the landscape, leaving long tracked trails of torn red dirt.

Across the rocky chaos, and the small cold sea, and over the mountainous slums crowned by glittering spires. Navigation pings and comms noise grows to a small roar over the heart of Tri-Tachyon, and your shuttle returns you to orbit.
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机原路返回，飞下高地，穿过湖泊高原。你看到几个爬行式移动工厂把管道和单轨铁路的塔架倾泻在地面上，留下一条条新翻开的红土痕迹。

穿过乱岩和一小片寒冷的海域，越过点缀在山地贫民窟之上的闪耀高塔。在 速子科技 腹地的上空，导航通讯协议和通讯噪音逐渐成为一阵轰鸣，穿梭机把你送回了轨道上。

o.en: Take a shuttle to Rayan Arroyo's chalet on the surface
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前往 Rayan Arroyo 的山间别墅

entries.en:
He slaps the onyx bar-top one last time and puts his head in his hands.

"Of course." He looks out on the vista of saw-tooth mountains for a moment, then speaks with unusual passivity: "I'd just hate to start a third AI war."
entries.zh:
最后，他狠狠拍向黑玉制的吧台，然后把脸埋进了双手。

"当然了。" 他眺望了一会儿远处的锯齿形山脉，然后用罕见的消极语气说道，"我只是不想引发第三次 AI 战争。"

entries.en:
Your shuttle descends into the young atmosphere of Eochu Bres, through towering battlements of clouds. A spray of rain is cast over your viewport, and it is wiped clean in a blink by the heat and speed of your descent.

The flight path soon deviates from the general approach corridor which has been ticking off minor use-fees from the Tri-Tachyon owned flight control: general volume access fee, priority flight lane fee, service fee, customer satisfaction insurance charge, advertisement bypass fee - you swipe the notifications off and focus on the landscape.
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机降入了 Eochu Bres 刚形成不久的大气层，在犹如城垛般的高耸云层间穿行。一阵雨雾喷洒在你的视窗上，又在眨眼间被下降时的热量和速度擦拭干净。

飞行路线很快就偏离了一般的进场通道，引发了一堆来自 速子科技 航空管制的小额扣费：基本空域通行费、优先航路附加费、服务费、客户满意度保险费、广告屏蔽费 —— 你刷掉了通知，专注于风景上。

entries.en:
"No," he says. He makes a show of looking around, "But it's nice isn't it?"

"Now I could be doing anything other than talking to you right now, so let's make it quick. You know you're getting something thanks to our mutual 'friend'. What is it?"
entries.zh:
"不聊，" 他说道。他环顾了一下四周，"但这确实很不错，不是吗？"

"眼下我本可以做任何事，而不是在这里和你交谈，所以让我们抓紧。你清楚你现在的待遇是因为我们共同的那位 '朋友'，对吧？"

o.en: I need to break into the datavault of the Ministry of Technology Standards.
o.zh: 我需要进入科技标准部的数据库。

o.en: Tell Baird about Gargoyle's plan to hack a Hegemony relay
o.zh: 告诉 Baird 关于 Gargoyle 黑掉 霸主 通讯中继站的计划

entries.en:
Provost Baird listens patiently as you explain. When you are finished, she waits a moment, then says crisply "I do not need to know your every move, captain, provided that you carry out your ultimate objective. If this 'Gargoyle' is the one I've heard so much about, then we have a good chance of acquiring the Kallichore Archive."

"Your course of action is obvious: help the hacker do it by whatever means are necessary, at whatever cost is required." She adopts the tone of a disappointed teacher, "Surely you don't need me to tell you this."
entries.zh:
Baird 院长耐心地听着你的解释。当你说完时，她等了一会儿，然后干脆地说："舰长，我只需要你完成任务，不关心你的每一步行动，如果这个 'Gargoyle' 是我久仰大名的那个，那么我们得到 Kallichore 的档案的可能性就很大了。"

"你的行动方针很明显：帮助黑客，用任何必要的手段，不惜任何代价。" 她的语气就像失望的老师，"你肯定不需要我来告诉你这些。"

o.en: Tell Baird about Gargoyle's plan to hack a Hegemony relay
o.zh: 告诉 Baird 关于 Gargoyle 黑掉 霸主 通讯中继站的计划

entries.en:
Provost Baird listens patiently as you explain. When you are finished, she waits a moment, then says crisply "I do not need to know your every move, captain, provided you carry out your ultimate objective."

"Your course of action is obvious: help this 'Gargoyle' by whatever means are necessary, at whatever cost is required." Baird turns to her desk display, scanning for her next appointment. A dismissal.

You reach to disconnect the comms when she adds, "Do have a copy of the specifications of this hack device sent to my office. I am intrigued."
entries.zh:
Baird 院长耐心地听着你的解释。当你说完时，她等了一会儿，然后干脆地说："舰长，我只需要你完成任务，不需要知道你的每一步行动。"

"你的行动方针很明确：帮助黑客，用任何必要的手段，不惜任何代价。" Baird 看向了她桌上的显示屏，确认着她的日程表。看起来你该走了。

你伸手想切断通讯，这时她补充道，"务必把这个黑客设备的规格参数发到我的办公室，我很感兴趣。"

o.en: Tell Baird about the installation of the hack device
o.zh: 告诉 Baird 黑客装置已经安装完成了

entries.en:
"You installed this hack device, and did not get the decrypted Kallichore Archive from Gargoyle before returning here?"

Baird pulls off her spectacles and stands, her usual cool quite broken, and shouts, "Go now! Get the archive before someone else does! Why are you waiting, go!"
entries.zh:
“你安装了黑客装置，回来之前却没有从 Gargoyle 那里拿到解密的 Kallichore 的档案？”

Baird 摘下眼镜站起身来，她平时的冷静消失得无影无踪，“现在快去！抢在别人之前拿到档案！你还等什么，快！”

o.en: What will you do if the Hegemony suspects you're behind the hack?
o.zh: 如果 霸主 发现你收留了这个黑客，你该怎么办？

entries.en:
Baird looks at you. "They suspect me already, of course."

"The Galatia Academy will appeal the original data seizure and demand the return of basic scientific research materials- which is not illegal under even old Domain law. 'This data breach only proves the danger of restricting basic research as this situation enables unsavory parties to exploit discoveries without oversight from the ecumenica'."

"I appreciate the irony of my objection, of course. But this is war by public relations: there is no room for scruples. I'll be exactly as cynical as they already believe me to be, and they'll believe the act because it is true." As Baird speaks, you find a note of satisfaction in her description of plot and counter-plot. "Behind that truth of course," she continues, "Is what really happened. Which shall be a fait accompli once they discover it, and one too embarrassing to publicize."
entries.zh:
Baird 看了看你，"当然，他们已经开始怀疑我了。"

"Galatia 学院将对原始数据的查封提出上诉，并要求归还基本的科学研究材料 —— 即使在旧时代 人之领 的法律下，这也是合规的。'这种数据泄露只能证明限制基础研究的危险，因为这样会使一些让人讨厌的家伙们在缺乏舆论监督的情况下私自探索它们'。"

"我会欣然地带着讽刺的意味去提出上诉，这是一场公关战争，没有顾忌的余地。我会表现得愤世嫉俗，如同他们对我的想象的那般，他们则会对此深信不疑，因为我的表现不是表演。" 当 Baird 做出解释时，你从她对这种阴谋和反阴谋的描述中感受到了她的满足感，"然而，隐藏于那之下的，" 她继续说道，"是我们的真实目的。一旦他们对此有所察觉，那将成为切实的证据和难以公开的尴尬事实。"

o.en: So what do you think of Gargoyle?
o.zh: 你觉得 Gargoyle 是个怎样的人？

entries.en:
Baird looks at you, raises an eyebrow, then looks back at nothing.

"Singularly charming," she says deadpan. "I taught for twenty cycles, captain. I've had worse."
entries.zh:
Baird 看了看你，扬了扬眉毛，然后又别过了头。

"独特而迷人，" 她面无表情地说。"我已经任教二十年了，舰长。我见过更差劲的人。"

entries.en:
"Cavin." She just pauses for a moment, looking up and elsewhere. Then she smiles a little, and shakes her head.

"No, he wouldn't. He'd get on with Baird like a hull breach, that's for sure. Um. Why do you ask?"
entries.zh:
"Cavin。" 她停了一会，抬起头看向了别处。然后她露出了一个微笑，摇了摇头。

"他是不会。他肯定会像攻船槌一样和 Baird 对着干。呃，你为什么问这个？"

o.en: I was wondering if you shared his... views.
o.zh: 我就是在想你是不是也和他的...看法，差不多。

o.en: He seems... unreliable. You were close, once.
o.zh: 他有点...不靠谱。你们以前挺亲密的。

o.en: I apologize, it is not my business.
o.zh: 抱歉，这不是我该多嘴的事。

entries.en:
"Ah," she lets out an awkward laugh. "I see. He has a way of making an impression, doesn't he. That's why he was so... um."

She shakes her head once, then looks at you brightly; a facade pulled over whatever her true feelings are. "Well, captain," she says, "I'm not still there in that art collective, am I?"
entries.zh:
"啊。" 她尴尬地笑了一声，"原来是这样。他确实容易给人留下深刻印象是吧？所以他才这么的...呃。"

她摇了摇头，然后笑容满面地看着你；伪装出的表情掩盖了她心中所想。"好了，舰长。" 她说道，"我总不能还在那个艺术展会里吧？"

o.en: That's a question, not an answer.
o.zh: 你怎么没给我答案还问起我来了。

entries.en:
The moment draws out. "Um," she looks away, then rapidly taps on her lab-interface, flooding the view with holographic data-tables. "I really must be getting back to work. Good-bye."

The feed flickers and a generic Galatia Academy holding signal appears.
entries.zh:
这一刻仿佛被拉长了。"呃。" 她偏过了视线，然后快速地在她的实验室界面上按了几下，一大堆全息数据表涌了出来。"我真得回去工作了。再见。"

影像闪烁了几下后，出现了 Galatia 学院的通用待机画面。

entries.en:
"Unreliable... I mean, yes, he was that," she admits. "He just has different priorities than most people. He doesn't really align with, well, institutions. It's what made him so... well, he was exciting, that's for sure." She looks down for a moment, "But at some point... if you're not his priority, when it's really important, well, that's the end of that."

"Um," she blinks several times, like waking up from a dream. "I really should get back to work." Coureuse rapidly taps on several interfaces, flooding the view with holographic data-tables. "Good-bye captain."

The feed flickers and a generic Galatia Academy holding signal appears.
entries.zh:
"不靠谱...我就是说，是的，他确实是那样。" 她承认道，"他就是首要目标和大多数人不同。他准确来说不算是和，呃，学院，目标一致。这也是为什么他...嗯，他让人觉得很刺激，这一点是肯定的。" 她低下了头，"但到了某些情况下...如果你不再是他的重点了，当有重要的事情时，嗯，那就是尾声了。"

"呃。" 她眨了眨眼，好像这才从梦中醒来。"我真得回去工作了。" Coureuse 快速地在她的实验室界面上按了几下，一大堆全息数据表涌了出来。"再见，舰长。"

影像闪烁了几下后，出现了 Galatia 学院的通用待机信号。

entries.en:
"I don't mind. That was all a few cycles ago, anyway."

A pause, then she says, "It is actually kind of nice to hear that he's still, well, being Cavin."
entries.zh:
"我不在意的。那都已经是好几个星历年以前了。"

停顿一下后她继续说道："实际上还不错，能听到他还是，还是 Cavin。"

entries.en:
"No, I..." She blinks rapidly. "Of course not. The, the equipment was all back in the Isirah system..."

She taps at some command interfaces and a flood of data tables fills the screen. "I really must get back to work, captain. Sorry. Good-bye."

The feed flickers and a generic Galatia Academy holding signal appears.
entries.zh:
"没有，我..." 她快速地眨着眼，"当然没。装备那些，那些都是在 Isirah 星系的事情了..."

她快速地在什么控制界面上按了几下，一大堆全息数据表涌了出来。"我真得回去工作了，舰长。抱歉。再见。"

影像闪烁了几下后，出现了 Galatia 学院的通用待机画面。

o.en: Do you think Baird can be trusted?
o.zh: 你觉得 Baird 可信吗？

entries.en:
She looks at you for a moment then sighs.

"You know she'll probably listen to this, right? Well, she knows how I feel, and I'm not going to pretend I believe otherwise. I don't like a lot about what she does and how she does it."

"Say what you will about the provost, she's... effective. It's better than any alternative I've seen so far."
entries.zh:
她盯着你看了一会，然后叹了口气。

"你知道她肯定会听到我们的谈话的吧？行吧，她也知道我怎么想，我也不打算假装自己有别的看法。她做的事，还有做事的方式，我很不喜欢。"

"你想怎么说院长都行，她很... 有效率。这办法比迄今为止我见过的所有其他的选择都要好。"

entries.en:
"I don't know," she says, "Making weapons for the Hegemony? Sector collapse to pre-hyperdrive levels? Torturing AI shards for Tri-Tach? I couldn't do that. I don't even know what the Luddics would make of me."

Coureuse gives a laugh, "Put me in a nunnery, probably. Might not be so bad."
entries.zh:
"我咋知道，" 她说道，"或许去给 霸主 制造武器？让我们的星域崩溃回前超空间引擎时代？帮 速子科技 折磨 AI 碎片？这些我都不干。要真这么办了，我都不知道卢德教徒们会把我怎么样。"

Coureuse 轻笑了一下，"估计，会把我关修女院里吧。好像也不是那么糟。"

o.en: Your friend Cavin doesn't seem like the type that would ever work for Baird.
o.zh: 你的朋友 Cavin 看起来怎么也不是会为 Baird 工作的人。

entries.en:
"Oh, very helpful," she says with a smile, "You get a, just a really different perspective from Gargoyle. There are so many assumptions, invisible little things we do, um, as an institutional organization without realizing, and - well, and also the technical stuff, like code. It's been - hmm, a bit strange. And teamwork in the traditional sense is mostly out of the question. But if we find a little self-contained project for Gargoyle, it can work out great."

"Thank you for all you've done for us. It could have gone very poorly."
entries.zh:
"哦，帮上大忙了。" 她微笑道，"我们可以看到，就是，能从 Gargoyle 身上看到非常不同的角度。我们作为一个学院组织，呃，对好多理所当然、凤毛麟角的事都没太在意，还有 —— 对了，还有技术方面的事，比如代码。一起合作是有点儿，嗯，怪，而且寻常的那种合作模式基本上也是行不通。但如果我们能给 Gargoyle 找一个独立项目的话成果会很棒。"

"谢谢你为我们做的一切。本来有可能会变得很糟的。"

o.en: Have you been in contact with Elissa Zal lately?
o.zh: 你最近和 Elissa Zal 有联系吗？

o.en: What will you do if the Hegemony suspects you're behind the hack?
o.zh: 要是霸主怀疑这次入侵是您在背后主使，您打算怎么办？

entries.en:
Baird looks over. "They suspect me already, of course."

"The Galatia Academy will appeal the original data seizure and demand the return of basic scientific research materials- which is not illegal under even old Domain law. 'This data breach only proves the danger of restricting basic research as this situation enables unsavory parties to exploit discoveries without oversight from the ecumenica'."

"I appreciate the irony of my objection, of course. But this is war by public relations: there is no room for scruples. I'll be exactly as cynical as they already believe me to be, and they'll believe the act because it is true." As Baird speaks, you find a note of satisfaction in her description of plot and counter-plot. "Behind that truth of course," she continues, "Is what really happened. Which shall be a fait accompli once they discover it, and one too embarrassing to publicize."
entries.zh:
Baird 转过目光。"他们早就疑上我了，自然。"

"Galatia 学院会对当初那次数据查抄提出申诉，要求归还基础科研资料 —— 即便按人之领旧律，这也不算违法。'这次数据外泄恰恰证明，限制基础研究有多危险：正是这种局面让心术不正之徒得以绕开教会当局的监督，肆意利用科研成果'。"

"我自然明白自己这套说辞有多讽刺。可这是一场舆论战，容不得半点顾忌。他们认定我有多犬儒，我便演得多犬儒；而这出戏他们必信，因为它本就是真的。" Baird 说到这里，你从她对这一来一去的算计里听出了几分得意。"当然，这层真相背后，" 她接着道，"才是真正发生的事。等他们察觉，生米早已煮成熟饭，而且尴尬得没法对外声张。"

o.en: She doesn't like you, does she.

entries.en:
Baird looks at you for a long moment. You think you see something new. Something almost like emotional pain.

"Scylla never appreciated the gifts I... the academy offered her. It's how she was raised, perhaps. Her insubordination was indulged. Became habitual. But with time, when she sees what we accomplish, maybe her higher sense of rationality will win out. I know she is capable of it."

Baird turns, staring forward, and sets her jaw.
entries.zh:
Baird 久久地看着你。你仿佛在她脸上看见了某种从未有过的东西 —— 几乎像是心底作痛。

"Scylla 从来不懂珍惜我... 学院给她的那些馈赠。许是她自小被养成了那样。她那些以下犯上的举动被一味纵容，久了就成了习惯。可日子一长，等她看见我们做成的事，或许她骨子里那份更高的理性会占上风。我知道她做得到。"

Baird 转过身，直视前方，咬紧了牙关。

o.en: So what do you think of Gargoyle?
o.zh: 那您觉得 Gargoyle 这人怎么样？

entries.en:
Baird looks at you, raises an eyebrow, then looks back at nothing.

"Singularly charming," she says deadpan. "I taught for twenty cycles, captain. I've had worse."
entries.zh:
Baird 看了你一眼，挑起一边眉毛，又重新望向虚无。

"真是别有风味，\" 她面无表情地说。\"我教了二十个周期的课，舰长。比这难缠的见得多了。"

entries.en:
The image of Provost Anahita Baird appears.

"Captain, it is good to see you return, finally. Bring her by shuttle," she says, "Directly to this docking port," a chime signals the receipt of navigation instructions and docking codes. "I'll meet you there."

The comm line shuts off.
entries.zh:
教务长 Anahita Baird 的影像出现在屏幕上。

"舰长，总算把您盼回来了。用穿梭机把她送过来，" 她说，"直接停到这个泊位，" 一声提示音表示导航指引与停靠码已收到。"我在那儿等您。"

通讯随即切断。

entries.en:
Baird taps at her interface, and the office holo-projector begins to glow. Her face illuminated by the image floating before you.

"She seems to be settling in," Baird says, watching what appears to be the feed from a gleaming new physics laboratory. Coureuse is being introduced by Sebestyen to various academicians, judging by their formal dress, and technicians in various states of protective garb. They look young and eager to begin work.

Sebestyen looks up, seeming to make eye contact with you - a subjective effect from the projector. He taps something on the datapad he's holding.
entries.zh:
Baird 在终端上点了几下，办公室里的全息投影仪亮了起来，浮在两人之间的影像把她的脸映得发亮。

"看样子她安顿下来了，" Baird 盯着画面说道。那像是一间簇新的物理实验室的实时影像：Sebestyen 正把 Coureuse 引见给几位院士 —— 从礼服看是院士 —— 还有穿着各色防护装束的技术员。一个个都年轻，急着开工。"

Sebestyen 抬起头，像是在与你对视 —— 其实只是投影给人的错觉。他在手上的数据板里点了些什么。

entries.en:
Baird's interface pings, and she taps a response.

A small cluster of documents join the surveillance feed, detailed reports on Gargoyle's activities hanging in the air, including a time-table for decrypting the Kallichore Archive.

"Sebestyen is more capable than he appears. He is both persistent and meticulous, as you can see."
entries.zh:
Baird 的终端响了一声，她点了个回复。

监控画面旁又浮出一小叠文件，是有关 Gargoyle 动向的详细报告，悬在半空，其中还夹着一份解密 Kallichore Archive 的时间表。

"Sebestyen 比看上去能干得多。既有耐性，又一丝不苟，您都看见了。"

entries.en:
You step off the shuttle, thrusters clicking as they cool, followed by Scylla Coureuse - with Gargoyle in tow.

The hacker's barrage of questions and suggestions has you at the limit of your patience after only a brief trip. Thankfully, Scylla Coureuse has served as an admirable buffer for their mercurial attention; she is able to speak endlessly, if haltingly, about arcane physics processes and tangents thereof.
entries.zh:
你走下穿梭机，推进器冷却时发出细碎的响声，身后跟着 Scylla Coureuse —— 还捎着 Gargoyle。

短短一路，这名黑客连珠炮似的问题和提议就把你的耐心磨到了尽头。好在 Scylla Coureuse 替你挡下了这份阴晴不定的关注，堪称称职；说起那些幽深的物理过程及其枝枝蔓蔓，她能滔滔不绝地讲下去，尽管时常结巴。

entries.en:
As promised, Provost Baird is waiting with a small group of masked guards and senior advisors. Academician Sebestyen waves as your gaze drifts over him.

"It is so good to have you back with us, Scylla," says Baird. She turns aside, expression cool. "And this is Gargoyle."
entries.zh:
教务长 Baird 果然如约等在那里，身边是一小队蒙面警卫和几名高级顾问。你的目光扫过院士 Sebestyen 时，他朝你挥了挥手。

"Scylla，你能回来，真是太好了，\" Baird 说道。她侧过脸去，神色冷淡。\"这位就是 Gargoyle。"

entries.en:
Coureuse nods to Baird's words, and looks around the reception lounge. "It hasn't changed much," she says quietly.

Something in this doesn't please the provost, you think.

Gargoyle takes this opportunity to step into the lull, and bows grandly. "Anahita, we meet at last!"

Baird smiles mirthlessly, then turns back to Coureuse. "I believe you'll find that quite a lot has changed. Academician Alviss Sebestyen, please come forward- thank you. I understand that you knew Scylla back- " at his vigorous nod, she says "Yes, of course."
entries.zh:
Coureuse 冲 Baird 的话点了点头，四下打量接待厅。"没怎么变，" 她轻声说。

这话里像有什么让教务长不大受用，你想。

Gargoyle 趁这点空当插了进来，夸张地鞠了一躬。"Anahita，总算见着了！"

Baird 笑得没有一丝笑意，又转向 Coureuse。"您会发现变的地方多着呢。院士 Alviss Sebestyen，请上前来 —— 多谢。我听说您当年就认识 Scylla，那时 —— " 见他使劲点头，她接口道，"是了，自然。"

entries.en: Sebestyen smiles widely as you wave back. Baird is intent on Coureuse, and makes no acknowledgement.
entries.zh: 你一挥手，Sebestyen 立刻笑开了花。Baird 心思全在 Coureuse 身上，全当没瞧见。

entries.en:
"Gargoyle, meet Academician Alviss Sebestyen," Baird says in a tone that would not be out of place on the bridge of a Hegemony warship.

"Alviss, kindly show Gargoyle to the guest suite we've prepared, and the newly reinstated Academician Coureuse to her quarters - then to her the new laboratory. Now, please."

She pauses, uncharacteristically, then speaks.

"Scylla, I hope you can thrive here. Again. Please... keep an open mind."
entries.zh:
"Gargoyle，来见见院士 Alviss Sebestyen，" Baird 的口气就算搁在霸主战舰的舰桥上也毫不突兀。

"Alviss，劳烦带 Gargoyle 去我们备好的客房，再送刚复职的 Coureuse 院士回她的住处 —— 之后领她去新实验室。这就去吧。"

她反常地顿了一顿，才又开口。

"Scylla，我希望你能在这里重新扎下根来。再一回。请你... 把心放开些。"

entries.en:
With a sigh, Baird turns from them to you.

"Captain. Thank you for bringing her home," the provost watches the three leave the receiving lounge. Gargoyle appears to have chosen to cooperate with Sebestyen's stammering appeals; the hacker seems wholly occupied by discovering how to fluster the academician. And Coureuse is finally beginning to smile at these antics.

"With Scylla, we can begin it all again."

Baird holds up a hand to indicate an adjoining transport pod, "Let us remove to a more suitable setting for the continuation of our discussion."
entries.zh:
Baird 轻轻叹了口气，从他们身上转头看向你。

"舰长。多谢你把她带回家，" 教务长目送三人离开接待厅。Gargoyle 似乎打定主意配合 Sebestyen 结结巴巴的恳请；这名黑客一门心思都在琢磨怎么让院士下不来台。而 Coureuse 看着这些胡闹，终于也慢慢有了笑意。

"有了 Scylla，一切都能重新来过。"

Baird 抬手指了指旁边一具交通舱，"换个更合适的地方，接着谈吧。"

entries.en: Baird seems to study the passing conduits and vistas visible through the pod's bay windows, lost in thought. The silence grows, and you find that this may be an opportunity to ask something of the provost without interrupting one of her lectures.
entries.zh: Baird 像是在端详舱窗外掠过的管线与景致，出了神。沉默渐长，你觉着这或许是个机会，能趁她没在长篇说教的当口问上几句。

entries.en:
Through the silence, you can almost hear Baird thinking.

The transport pod hisses to a halt, and you feel the subtle shift of agrav fields. You step off and note that this seems to be a back entrance which allows Baird to avoid the waiting room full of important people unused to being asked to wait.
entries.zh:
一片寂静里，你几乎能听见 Baird 在动脑筋。

交通舱伴着一声轻响停稳，反重力场微微一换。你走下来，看出这里像是个后门 —— 好让 Baird 绕开那间候见室，里面坐满了向来不习惯等人的要人。

entries.en:
You follow Provost Baird into her office, and the doors close with a notable absence of sound. She motions you to a seat in front of her desk.

"Captain, allow me to properly compensate you for your good work. You've brought me two valuable assets today." She taps a command and your personal datapad pings in response. "I trust this will help cover certain of your expenses."

Baird unlocks her desk interface and enters some commands; your personal datapad pings twice in response.
entries.zh:
你随教务长 Baird 进了办公室，门悄无声息地合上，安静得有些刻意。她示意你在办公桌前坐下。

"舰长，这趟差事办得漂亮，该好好酬谢您。今天您给我带回来两份难得的资产。\" 她点下一条指令，你的私人数据板应声一响。\"想来够抵您某些开销了。"

Baird 解开桌面终端的锁，敲进几道指令；你的私人数据板跟着响了两声。

o.en: Do you have the Kallichore Archive?
o.zh: 你拿到 Kallichore 的档案了？

entries.en:
"There's no time for that! But-" Gargoyle smirks. "-I see what you're trying. Don't worry, I've got it locked up nice and secure, encrypted with my own special juice, and backed up off-site. It'd take an Alpha Core to break it out, and that'd take time. If you knew where to look. And you don't."

"Professor Anahita won't have that kind of time if I spill everything you've done together to the big bad Hegemony. So where's my shuttle?"
entries.zh:
"没时间了！但是 —— " Gargoyle 得意地笑着说，"我知道你想干什么。别担心，我把它锁得很好，用我的小技巧加密还备份了。如果你能找到它，哪怕是用 Alpha 级核心来破解它也要花费不少时间，更何况你还不知道它在哪。"

"如果我们把你们正在密谋的一切都透露给大坏蛋 霸主，Anahita 教授就不会有什么时间了。所以，来接我的穿梭机呢？"

entries.en:
You enter the comms ID for Gargoyle and nod to your comms officer who stands ready for whatever surprises Gargoyle thinks would be amusing to send through comms.

No tricks this time. The display instantly resolves into a familiar face with an unfamiliar expression: fear.
entries.zh:
你输入 Gargoyle 的通讯 ID，并向通讯军官点头示意准备好应对 Gargoyle 可能会为找乐子而从通讯器传过来的什么小惊喜。

但这次没遇到什么鬼把戏。显示器上立马解析出了一张熟悉的脸，但挂着一种陌生的表情：恐惧。

entries.en:
"Captain, you need to take me on your ship and get me out of here. They know where I am. I've really done it this time, it's incredible." Gargoyle lets out a nervous laugh, "The greatest data heist since the Second AI War!"

The hacker seems to realize the gravity of this statement, "I think- they are pretty, very, extremely, entirely unhappy this time. It's not safe. Take me to ... to the Galatia Academy? Anahita can hide me, right? After all I've done, she has to."
entries.zh:
"舰长，你得用你的船带上我离开这里。他们知道我在哪儿了。这次我居然真的干成了，太不可思议了。" Gargoyle 紧张地笑了，"这可是第二次 AI 战争以来最伟大的数据大劫案！"

黑客似乎已经意识到了情况的严重性："我想 —— 他们这次有些，非常，超级，彻底的不高兴了。这可不安全。带我去... Galatia 学院？Anahita 有能耐把我藏起来，对吧？看在我做了这么多的份上，她肯定会的。"

o.en: Order a shuttle to pick up Gargoyle
o.zh: 派出一艘穿梭机去接 Gargoyle

entries.en:
Gargoyle nods, "That's the way, captain. I'll collect my toys."

Your shuttle gets in and out without any suspicious inquiries from traffic control; they're not wise to what's going on yet. Probably.

You order Gargoyle confined to quarters well away from the bridge, and for your comms officer to keep an eye out for anything suspicious.

"Captain," your tactical officer calls for your attention, "Hegemony fleet incoming."

Time to go.
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 点了点头，"那样就好，舰长。我来收收我的小东西。"

你的穿梭机并没有收到交通管制员的质询；看起来他们还不知道发生了什么，大概吧。

你下令将 Gargoyle 关到离舰桥很远的地方，并嘱咐你的通讯军官留意别放过任何可疑的动静。

"舰长，" 你的战术军官提醒你留意，"霸主 舰队来了。"

该溜了。

o.en: What if I just leave you here?
o.zh: 如果我就这么把你扔下呢？

entries.en:
Gargoyle's voice goes cold. "Then you don't get your precious data archive, Captain $playerName. Because I've got it locked up nice and secure, and backups off-site. By the way, you wouldn't believe what I have on Rayan Arroyo, on your boss Anahita Baird, on all sorts of people! Even you, my dear captain. The High Hegemon will have a fit when he watches you asking me to hack their precious ministry of technology suppression on Sector-wide news channels."

The hacker smiles without warmth, "It's me or nothing, cap."
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 的声音变冷了："那样你就得不到你想要的档案了，$playerName 舰长。因为我把它锁得很好，还做了备份。顺便说一句，我掌握了包括 Rayan Arroyo 以及你老板 Anahita Baird 在内各种人的情报！你当然也有份，舰长。当至高霸主在全星域新闻频道上看到你让我黑掉他们宝贵的技术部门时，他会大发雷霆的。"

黑客的笑容中没有一丝温度，"要么带上我，要么你会失去一切，舰长。"

o.zh: 等等，你说的都是些什么人？

entries.en:
"Just- I- Everyone!"

"Let me count my new friends," Gargoyle starts ticking off fingers, "The Hegemony for starters, whoever COMSEC thinks to send. I expect an official expedition will cause a diplomatic incident, so probably shadowy gun-fun goons will sneak in to try to murder me. Next, Tri-Tachyon, at least once they're tipped off by the Hegemony's blundering response. And the Pathers, can't forget them. The Hegemony leaks like a hull breach to all the little Ludders and they're going to simply love everything about this."

"Let me summarize for you, my good captain: within, oh, two or three shifts, this place will be in the crossfire of an interfactional criticality event and every second spacer buying noodles on the concourse is going to be an assassin or spy."
entries.zh:
"就只有 —— 我 —— 和所有人！"

"让我数一下自己都交了哪些新朋友，" Gargoyle 开始扳起手指数了起来，"先从 霸主 开始，COMSEC 想着能派来所有人都算进去。我估摸着要是来一次正式的抓捕行动的话，肯定会闹成一场外交纠纷，所以可能会偷偷派些喜欢在暗地里拿枪崩人的喽啰试着来弄死我。接着是 速子科技，至少 霸主 整出什么大动静之后，他们也会派人来看看。别忘了还有那群左径分子。霸主 情报网对于小卢德佬们来说简直漏得像个筛子似的，他们又肯定爱死这种破事了。"

"让我给你总结一下吧，我的好好舰长：不出...嗯...两三天这样，某件让各大势力紧张到临界点的大事就会把这个地方变成交火前线。到时候在港区里随便两个买拉面的太空佬，都可能有个是刺客或间谍什么的。"

entries.en:
"I love it!" Gargoyle shouts, sitting up.

"A glorious scheme, practically neon-black! Which one? All of them at once? Hmm," visor and cybermods start flickering with activity.
entries.zh: "我爱了！" Gargoyle 大叫着坐了起来，"这策划是喝高了多少？要整个五彩斑斓的黑是吧？是要黑哪个部门？所有部门一起？" 他的显示面罩和赛博植入体开始活力四射地闪烁起来。

o.en: Hold on- just one, actually. (explain the mission)
o.zh: 别激动 —— 事实上，就一个。 (解释任务)

entries.en: As you talk, the comms display with Gargoyle becomes crowded with virtualized half-written lists, reference panels, and code snippets. The hacker leaps from idea to idea, rejecting and accepting contingencies several steps ahead - or adjacent, perhaps - from whatever you are actually saying. The visual chaos is somewhat distracting.
entries.zh: 在你说话的时候，显示着 Gargoyle 的通讯界面充满了写了一半的什么清单，参考面板和代码片段。黑客在一个又一个的鬼主意间跳跃着，权衡着各种各样的可能事件，他总是能领先你的话几步 —— 但也会走偏。视觉上的混乱有点让人分心。

o.zh: 你需要点时间来理清思路？
这任务有完成的可能性吗？

entries.en:
"It might be tough. I'm going to need to pass some credits along to a couple friends for some special tricks. Hmm. Do we go all out? Rayan is buying snacks... I think we do. Yes."

"Here's how it's gonna happen- I've got a friend who will make you a little package. It should be ready by the time you get to Nova Maxios. In the Magec system, know it? You pick that up, then do fancy flying and whatever else it takes to install it in the Hegemony comms relay in the Aztlan system."
entries.zh:
"这可能很难。我得给几个朋友寄些钱来让他们帮忙搞点事情。嗯...这需要我们全力以赴吗？Rayan 去囤零食了...看来我们是得全力以赴了，没错。"

"好，之后的情况会是这样的 —— 我的朋友会给你做一个小玩意儿，在你到 Nova Maxios 时那东西应该就准备好了。你知道那儿吧？在 Magec 星系。拿上它之后，随便用你什么花里胡哨的航行技巧或者其他别的什么手段，把它装到 Aztlan 星系里 霸主 的通信中继站上。"

entries.en:
A thoughtful pause, then, "For the relay? Go in quiet to do the relay. Park your fleet. Maybe run a lone phase ship for the job, if your ego is capable of surviving away from your big boy toys for a few shifts. Or - this is fun - hack the sensor array and give the Heggies some ghosts to chase."

"Anyway, the installation itself is easy," the hacker continues nonchalantly. "Any work-drone you've got on staff should be able to figure out which end goes where."
entries.zh:
一段若有所思的停顿过后，"至于中继站？你必须悄悄解决中继站。停好你的舰队。可能的话单独开条相位舰来干这活儿，不过前提是你的自尊心受得了你把那些男孩大宝贝们放上那么几天。或者找点乐子去黑进传感器阵列，给 '霸猪' 们弄点鬼影去追。"

"反正，安装本身简单得很，" 黑客轻描淡写地继续说，"你船上随便弄个维护无人机应该都能搞清楚哪根线应该接哪儿。"

entries.en:
"The real trick comes after: gotta break the Hegemony crypto. That'll be yours truly who's got a little trick I've been saving from a couple cycles ago for just the right moment." Gargoyle holds cable-trailing arms up in a premature display of triumph. "It will be glorious!" Then sits back down.

"Right, so. After you install the hack device on the comm relay, come back here and you can thank me personally when I hand you a copy of the decrypted data. And friend-Rayan has my list of demands," a button tap, "Now."
entries.zh:
"然后就进入重点啦：破解 霸主 的加密系统。我打算把几年前就掌握的一个小漏洞拿出来用，真是便宜你了。" Gargoyle 早早地展示了胜利的气势，然后坐了回去，"多么辉煌！"

"啊，继续。所以，在通讯中继上安装了黑客装置后回来这里，之后等我给你一份解密数据的副本时，你就可以亲自感谢我了。Rayan 老伙计有我的愿望单。" 黑客按了一下按钮，"现在 —— "

entries.en:
Another button tap, and there's a ping on your datapad as Gargoyle sends you the address of a small holding facility near the main port-ring of Nova Maxios, as well as the number of a particular storage unit. "It'll be there," Gargoyle says with a smile that seems to imply you're not in on a joke.

"Now I have a lot to do before this is ready, so go along! COMSEC is going to completely blow its top when we pull this off, ha-ha!"

Gargoyle turns to another display, attention focused, cyber augments flickering at an increasing rate as the comm line disconnects on you almost as an afterthought.
entries.zh:
黑客又按下了一个按钮，Nova Maxios 主轨道环附近一个小型存储设施的地址和一个特定存储单元的号码被发到了你的数据平板上。"它来咯。" Gargoyle 笑着说，似乎在暗示这不是在开玩笑。

"在这一切准备好之前，我还有很多事情要做，所以去吧！当我们完成任务时，COMSEC 会大发雷霆的，哈哈！"

Gargoyle 看向了另一个显示器，接着通讯线路断开了，网络增强器开始以越来越快的速度闪烁起来。

entries.en:
You explain to Gargoyle the scope of the mission, and the target - the Kallichore Archive, the personal data store of former Provost Tomas Kallichore which the Hegemony Ministry of Technology Standards seized from the Galatia Academy in the wake of some kind of botched hyperspace experiment.

You also explain, in terms which avoid any implication of an employer-employee hierarchy, that Rayan Arroyo will be providing funding for the operation.
entries.zh:
你向 Gargoyle 说明了任务范围，以及任务目标 Kallichore 的档案 的情况。那是前院长 Tomas Kallichore 的个人数据存档，霸主 的科技标准部在超空间实验出了问题之后从 Galatia 学院查封了它。

你说明了 Rayan Arroyo 将提供行动资金，遣词造句中避免透露出你们之间的雇佣关系。

entries.en:
After connecting to the local network, you enter the comms ID for Gargoyle then pause at the prompt to initiate the call. You look over to your comms officer and they nod, ready to act.

As soon as you execute the command, the electronic warfare console lights up like fleet action in a nebula. Comms wrangles the infosec systems with cool efficiency, coordinating active response with nav, sensors, and engineering stations.

After perhaps half a minute the storm breaks, the alarms quiet, and your primary display resolves from a mesmerizing fractal battleground to a heavily augmented face grinning impishly.
entries.zh:
连接本地网络后，你输入 Gargoyle 的通讯 ID 并发起了通讯请求。你看了看通讯军官，而此人也点头回应，表示做好了行动的准备。

你执行命令的瞬间，电子战控制台像在星云中穿梭的舰队那样闪亮发光。通讯军官冷静地施展技巧，在导航，传感器和工程站点的协调下与信息安全网络博弈起来。

大概半分钟后，风暴终于平息，警报也停止了，你的主屏幕从迷人而支离破碎的电子战场变成了一张嵌满了强化植入物脸，正顽皮地咧嘴笑着。

entries.en:
"You were ready for me!" Gargoyle says too sweetly to be true before turning to an imagined audience, "The rocket jockey put together enough brains to deal with my little 'hello'!" Gargoyle bounces back and applauds, "Well done!"

"So you know who I am. Tell me, why did Rayan give you my comms ID? More presents, bribes, begging? Did he finally get in trouble with that junta of puppeteering vampires he desperately wishes were his friends? ...On the run from the law and needs a rep wipe?"

A thoughtful pause. "Do you always make that face when you meet new people?"
entries.zh:
"看来你是有备而来啊！" Gargoyle 以过于肉麻的语气非常不正经地说，接着他转向了想象中的观众，"这个火箭骑手集齐了足够的智慧来对付我小小的 '欢迎仪式'！" Gargoyle 从镜头里跳了回来，为你鼓掌，"干得好！"

"看起来你已经知道我是谁了。告诉我，为什么 Rayan 会把我的号码给你？礼物？贿赂？乞求？他终于和那群他拼命想交好的操偶师吸血鬼军阀闹翻了？...在逃避法律的制裁，需要销声匿迹？"

他若有所思地顿了顿。"你认识新朋友的时候总是那样垮着个脸吗？"

o.en: I have a job for you. I was told you're the best.
o.zh: 有份工作给你，我听说你是最棒的。

entries.en:
"A job? Uh, no," Gargoyle gags theatrically. "If I ever do a day of 'work' I want you to throw me out the airlock, then throw that airlock into a black hole."

The hacker lounges back carelessly, "But... still listening. Because you told me I'm the best, and I am. That was nice. But I'm not sure you really understand what it is I do."

A hand studded with interface nodules waves and your display fills with news clips - industrial shutdowns, suspected sabotage, databases hacked, political comms leaked, credits missing, ghost fleets.
entries.zh:
"工作？呃，不。" Gargoyle 夸张地说，"如果我有 '工作' 过一天，你就可以把我关进气闸舱然后把它扔到黑洞里了。"

黑客漫不经心地往后一仰："不过...我还听着呢。因为你说我是最棒的，我也确实是。真不错。但我不确定你到底知不知道我是做什么的。"

一只嵌满了数据接口的手在你眼前挥了挥，接着你的屏幕被各种新闻片段填满了 —— 工业设施关闭、可疑的破坏行动、数据库被黑入、政治通讯泄露、星币丢失、幽灵舰队。

entries.en:
"What I do," Gargoyle sits up, looking serious at last. "Is magic."

"An institution, a polity, a warship, a fleet, the Hegemony! The Luddic Church! The Tri-Tachyon Mega-credits-sucking Corporation! These are machines made of people, and these people don't understand their own machines. Or," a mock-pondering tone, "other people, come to think of it. The oneness of these holy constructs is mass delusion!"

"But I," Gargoyle taps a head-mounted dataport, "I understand. Simply," a finger pokes at you from the display, "Press there. There, then there, and the bubble pops. Push on the right place at the wrong time and the mighty become a sad joke. A gust of wind, a fart of fancy, a flimsy shell that's cracked. Understand?"
entries.zh:
"我施展的，" Gargoyle 又一次坐直了，并且终于严肃了起来，"是魔法。"

"机构、政体、战舰、舰队、霸主！卢德教会！还有那超他妈有钱的 速子科技！这些都是由人组成的机器，而这些人不了解他们自己组成的机器。" 他换上了一种嘲弄的语气，"其他人也一样，细想一下。这些神圣的大集合体只不过是场巨大的骗局！"

"但我，" Gargoyle 敲了敲头戴式的数据端口，"我能理解。简单地说，" 屏幕上伸出了一根戳向你的手指，"戳戳这里，然后是这，最后是那里，这一切就会化为泡影。让事情在错误的时间朝正确的方向发展，强者就会变成一个悲哀的笑话。化作一阵风、一个花哨的屁，或者一个破碎的薄壳。明白了吗？"

o.en: Can you hack into the datavault of a Hegemony Ministry?
o.zh: 你能黑进 霸主 部门的数据库吗？

entries.en:
You enter the comms ID, hand hovering over a glowing 'confirm' sigil. Your comms officer nods, ready to respond to whatever surprises Gargoyle thinks would be amusing to send through the link this time.

The display resolves from a mesmerizing fractal battleground to a familiar face grinning impishly at you. "Oh $playerFirstName, are you having trouble finding Nova Maxios? Let me help, I'll send you a copy of Baby's First Star Chart."

Your TriPad chimes softly.

"Go on, read it. Find 'M is for Magec'. You can figure it out! I believe in you." Gargoyle turns away and waves you off as your comms seem to disconnect of its own accord.
entries.zh:
你输入通讯 ID，手悬停在发光的 "确认" 标志上。通讯军官点了点头，对方已经准备好应对任何 Gargoyle 可能为了找乐子而发过来的惊喜内容了。

你的主屏幕从迷人而支离破碎的电子战场变成了一张神态夸张，顽皮地向你咧嘴笑着的脸。"喔，$playerFirstName，你找不到 Nova Maxios 了？让我帮帮你吧，我会给你一张婴儿都能看懂的星际地图。"

你的 TriPad 响起了轻柔的铃声。

"读下去，读下去。找到 'M 开头的 Magec'。你能搞明白的！我相信你。" Gargoyle 转过身去并挥手示意你离开，接着你的通讯链接自动断开了。

entries.en:
You enter the comms ID, hand hovering over a glowing 'confirm' sigil. Your comms officer nods, ready to respond to whatever surprises Gargoyle thinks would be amusing to send through the link this time.

The display resolves without incident to a familiar face grinning impishly. "Ah, Captain $playerFirstName! You must have forgotten my simple instructions."

Gargoyle counts off fingers, "Step one, collect the device. You did that, hurray! Step two, install it on the Aztlan Relay in - pay attention now, maybe get your scowly comms officer to take a memo - in the Aztlan system. Step three, come back to me for your precious data archive."

The hacker waves the remaining two fingers at you in a rude gesture. "And that's how it's done. Bye bye, busy now."

Your comms disconnect seemingly of their own accord.
entries.zh:
你输入通讯 ID，手悬停在发光的 "确认" 标志上。你的通讯军官点了点头，他已经准备好应对任何 Gargoyle 认为有趣的通讯内容了。

你的主屏幕上显示出了一张神态夸张，顽皮地向你咧嘴笑着的脸，没有发生任何意外。"啊，$playerFirstName 舰长！你一定是忘了我简单的提示。"

Gargoyle 数着手指，"第一步，收集设备。你做到了，万岁！第二步，把它安装在位于 Aztlan 星系的 —— 现在注意了，也许你该让你愁眉紧锁的通讯军官做个备忘录 —— Aztlan 中继站里。第三步，回到我这里来拿你宝贵的数据档案。"

黑客用剩下的两根手指粗鲁地朝你挥了挥。"事情就是这样。再见，我现在很忙。"

你的通讯链接自动断开了。

entries.en:
Gargoyle stares forlornly, resting chin on hands.

"I am wasted on you, $playerFirstName. I'm trying, I really am. Give me something to work with. Please? Otherwise I may just freeze myself for a thousand cycles. Maybe something interesting will have happened by then."
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 双手托着下巴，绝望地凝视着你。

“我浪费了好多时间在你身上，$playerFirstName。我在努力，真的。给我点事做。好吗？否则我可能会把自己冻上那么一千年。也许那之后会发生点趣事。”

o.en: Can you hack into the datavault of a Hegemony Ministry?
o.zh: 你能黑进 霸主 部门的数据库吗？

entries.en:
Gargoyle stares at you, slack-jawed. "Nuh you don't. You're just pretending because you think you need to look tough and smart in front of your minions. It's so obvious."

Gargoyle turns away, "Why do I even bother. Stick to driving your rocketship, Captain $playerFirstName. Pew pow blam! Take that, space pirates! Simple. Direct. Unsophisticated. Artless."

A dramatic sigh, "What a waste of time. Why are we even talking. Why do anything."
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 目瞪口呆地盯着你。"不你根本没听明白，你只是在装个样子，因为你想在手下面前表现得像是个足智多谋的狠角色一样，这太明显了。"

Gargoyle 转过身去："我为什么要自找麻烦？还是抱紧你的火箭飞船去吧，$playerFirstName 舰长。噼啪嘣！接招吧，太空海盗！简单，直接，朴实，毫无艺术感。"

他夸张地叹了口气，"真是浪费时间。我们为什么要聊这个，还聊了这么久？"

o.en: Can you hack into the datavault of a Hegemony Ministry?
o.zh: 你能黑进 霸主 部门的数据库吗？

o.en: Take a shuttle to visit Gargoyle's storage unit
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前往 Gargoyle 的存储单元

entries.en:
You take a shuttle to the main spaceport concourse, leading a landing party of bodyguards and techs.

The reception lounge ceilings are low, the old tube lights flickering. But the New Maxioans are proud of their makeshift polity; some locals catch your crew eyeing a dripping life support conduit and smile, nudging one another.
entries.zh:
你乘坐穿梭机进入了太空港的主港区，领着一堆保镖和技术人员踏上了空间站。

接待室的天花板很低，老式的荧光灯管在不停地闪烁。新 Maxios 人对他们拼凑起来的政体颇为自豪，一些本地人在注意到你的船员忍不住地把目光往一个漏得滴滴答答的维生管道上瞟的时候，微笑着互相推搡起来。

entries.en:
The address given to you by Gargoyle leads you to a run-down logistics ring that looks to be used mostly by failing tramp freighters and smugglers. You ask a young desk clerk where to find the unit number Gargoyle provided.

"Um, oh yes, you must be Captain... R. Boring?" the clerk squints at the desk terminal nervously - you log away this little joke from Gargoyle as you maintain impeccable composure - "I was told you'd be arriving for your cargo just a few minutes ago. Please, come right this way."
entries.zh:
Gargoyle 给你的地址将你带到了一个破旧的物流轨道环区，看起来这里的常客是不定期货船和各种走私者。你向年轻的接待员询问 Gargoyle 给你的储存单元号具体位置在哪里。

"呃，喔对了，想必您就是...R.Boring 舰长？"店员紧张地斜视着柜台终端 —— 你保持着无可挑剔的镇定，没有因为 Gargoyle 的这个小玩笑动摇，"几分钟前我刚被告知你会来这里取货。请走这边。"

entries.en:
The clerk starts to lead you through a back door, a light bulkhead lock, then freezes: a pallid man in a featureless gray uniform stands on the other side, a spot of gray on the darkness beyond.

"Mister Loke, sir," the clerk stutters, "I wasn't expecting, um, if I'd been told-"

The man - Mister Loke you presume - smiles blandly and says "I will show the captain the way."

Loke simply stops paying attention to the clerk, shifting his attention to you, still smiling. He nods encouragingly and turns to walk into the darkness beyond the portal.
entries.zh:
接待员领着你穿过后门 —— 一扇浅色的隔板门 —— 然后他僵住了：一个穿着单调的灰色制服的苍白男人就站在门后，如同黑暗中的一个灰点。

" Loke 先生，" 接待员结结巴巴地说，"我没想到，呃，如果有人告诉我 —— "

那个人 —— 你猜他就是 Loke 先生 —— 温和地微笑着："我来给舰长带路。"

Loke 没有再理会接待员，而把注意力转移到了你身上，依旧面带微笑。他冲你点了点头，转身走进了门后的黑暗中。

entries.en:
Mister Loke leads you past rows of sealed storage units, into a loading bay. Your footsteps produce a dull metallic echo. Something that smells of organic compounds is leaking.

Still smiling blandly, Loke stops and with the wave of his hand unlocks a storage unit. He speaks softly to you, "When she heard of this, Jorien told me she thought it was very funny. She wanted me to come and make sure you got what the Gargoyle asked Elissa to make for you."

His watery eyes stare at the storage unit, "It must be a nice thing."
entries.zh:
Loke 先生带你经过一排排密封的存储单元，进入了一个巨大的装货港。你的脚步发出沉闷的金属回声，有什么有机化合物味道的东西在泄漏着。

Loke 仍然温和地微笑着，他停下了脚步并挥手打开了一个储物柜。他轻声对你说："当听到这个消息时，Jorien 告诉我她觉得很有趣。她要我来确保你拿到 Gargoyle 让 Elissa 给你做的东西。"

他用湿润的眼睛看着存储单元，"这肯定是个好东西。"

o.zh: 多谢了...我想我该这么说。

entries.en:
Instead of answering, he gives you a respectful nod, and says "Goodbye," then walks away into the shadows of the warehouse.

You shake your head and turn your attention to the storage unit. Inside you find a single standard shipping crate. You motion the techs forward, and they approach with various handheld scanners; you are in no hurry to be the butt of another of Gargoyle's 'jokes'.
entries.zh:
他没有回答，而是恭敬地点头，说了声 "再见"，然后走进了仓库的阴影里。

你摇了摇头，把注意力转向存储单元，里面只有一个标准货箱。你示意技术人员上前，于是他们提着各种扫描仪凑了过去；你可不想成为 Gargoyle 的又一个 "笑话"。

entries.en:
The lead tech starts reporting. "Power source. Anomalous neutrinos. And um, minor hyperwave phase distortion?"

The entire crew of technicians take an unconscious step back. Hyperwave phasing technology has a poor reputation. And it's never been known to fit in so small a package and remain stable.

An hour later, as you are finishing your second hot drink at a nearby cafe, the techs give the all-clear through your datapad, concluding that as strange as this device is - seemingly a hand-built one-off hyperwave transmitter of some kind - it should pose no immediate danger.

You order it removed to your flagship.
entries.zh:
技术军官开始汇报："能量源，异常的中微子。还有，嗯，轻微的超波相位失真？"

技术专组的成员们不约而同地后退了一步，毕竟超波相位技术声名狼藉，而且从没人知道它能在这么小的空间里保持稳定。

一个小时后，当你在附近的一家咖啡馆喝完第二杯热饮时，数据平板上传来了技术军官告知安全的消息，上边还附着结论，尽管这个设备很奇怪 —— 似乎是某种手工制作的一次性超波发射器 —— 它应该不会立即构成危险。

你下令把它搬到你的旗舰上。

entries.en:
On the shuttle ride back to your $shipOrFleet you ponder tactics for inserting this device into the Aztlan Hyperwave Relay without being spotted by a Hegemony patrol. A small, fast detachment could do it. Or phase ships, using their fields to lower sensor profile. Or with a little luck you could find a quiet moment between patrol rotations...

The intercom crackles, "Captain, we've arrived."
entries.zh:
搭乘返回$shipOrFleet的穿梭机时，你思考着将这个设备安装到 Aztlan 超波中继站上而不被霸主巡逻队发现的方法。一支小而快速的特遣队应该能搞定。或者利用相位船的相位场降低传感器截面。或者运气好的话，也可以找到巡逻队轮班的时刻...

对讲器噼里啪啦地响了起来，"舰长，我们到了。"

entries.en:
You blink at these outrageous orders, tantamount to interstellar piracy. Even the law of the Hegemony, by the old Domain Naval Code, grants you certain rights. You'd guess that this is an overzealous $rank going a bit rogue in interpreting $hisOrHer orders.

As you think this over, you watch the Hegemony $rank's face turning a deeper shade of red, perhaps interpreting your pause as 'resistance'. It may be hard to get out of this one without a fight.
entries.zh:
听到这些无异于星际海盗的蛮横命令后，你眨了眨眼。即使是 霸主 根据旧时代的人之领海军法典制定的法律，也会在这种情况下为你保留一些权力。你猜这个 $rank 过分鲁莽了，以至于在解释$hisOrHer的命令时没按规矩来。

当作出思考时，你注意到霸主 $rank 的脸变成了更深的红色，对方也许把你的沉默理解成了 "抵抗"。事已至此，不战而退可能很难。

o.en: These are exceptional inspection terms. Do you have a warrant?
o.zh: 这些可是例外的搜查条款，你有搜查令吗？

o.en: I do not accept those terms, $rank.
Weasel your way out of this with an extravagant lie
o.zh: 用弥天大谎来蒙混过关

o.en: You don't have time for this, cut the comms
o.zh: 你可没时间和对面耗，切断通讯

entries.en:
