The Hegemony $ranks eyes start to widen just as you hit the disconnect. The image goes black and $hisOrHer shout is lost in dying static.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your tactical officer reports, "They're moving to attack."

You reflect for a moment that this gross violation of Sector commerce law suggests that the Hegemony is more likely to cover up any 'incident' that occurs in the next moments rather than undermine its own lawful legitimacy.
entries.zh:
在你切断通讯的前一刻，霸主 $rank 的眼睛瞪大了。接着画面变黑，$hisOrHer的咆哮随着画面的变黑变成了一片死寂。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，" 你的战术军官报告道，"他们正在展开攻击阵型。"

你想，这已经严重违反了星域中的商贸法规，因此，相较于损害自己法理上的正统地位，霸主 更有可能掩盖接下来发生的任何 "事件"。

entries.en:
You pull off a snappy salute.

"$SirOrMadam. I must report a misunderstanding. I am in command of a special auxiliary detachment in pursuit of a suspected infiltrator and saboteur. As per the standing HERMES BLACK order regarding compromised and-or fraudulent comms I am operating without a Hegemony transponder or active hypercomms interlink. The mission parameters provided by my CO allow for independent initiative."

"$SirOrMadam," you add, because it feels like the right thing to do.
entries.zh:
你潇洒地行了一礼。

"$SirOrMadam，我得说这是一场误会。我正指挥一支特遣辅助军追捕一名渗透进来的恐怖分子。根据 HERMES BLACK 命令，在行动的过程中我不被允许接入 霸主 的通讯网络。我上司提供的任务条件也允许我独立行动。"

"$SirOrMadam。" 你如此补充道，像是在说一件理所应当的事情。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks skeptical as you confidently rattle off legitimate-sounding Hegemony jargon. The Hegemony $rank looks down at you and asks, "Under what authority do you operate, captain? Who's your CO?"

No hesitation now.
entries.zh:
当你自信地说出听起来合情合理的 霸主 行话时，$HeOrShe看起来一脸狐疑。霸主 $rank 盯着你问道："舰长，你为谁服务？你的上司是谁？"

没时间犹豫了。

o.en: Admiral Orcus Rao, Ragnar fleet command.
o.zh: Orcus Rao 上将，Ragnar 舰队司令。

entries.en:
The Hegemony $rank's face doesn't change. Time for the cherry on top.

"He activated my fleet as a military auxiliary under the Chicomoztoc protocols," you explain. "I had to leave a whole cargo of transplutonics on the docks at Raesvelg."

"$SirOrMadam," you add again.
entries.zh:
霸主 $rank 的表情没什么变化。是时候来点锦上添花了。

"他根据 Chicomoztoc 协议将我的舰队作为辅助军纳入了指挥，" 你解释道，"所以我不得不把一整箱放射性极强的稀有元素留在 Raesvelg 的港口中。"

"$SirOrMadam。" 你又补了一句。

entries.en:
This seems to do it. The $rank's posture softens almost imperceptibly.

"Admiral Rao always did push the line, didn't he. This is highly irregular, captain, and I will be reporting it. But." $HisOrHer chin raises an inch, "The professionals are going to be taking over this chase. Transmit the last contact and course you observed from the target."

You try to look suitably disappointed as you quietly order your nav and comms officers to come up with something plausible. They improvise with admirable speed, and you watch as $Rank $personLastName glances at $hisOrHer console, satisfied.
entries.zh:
这似乎有效果了，你注意到 $rank 的态度在不知不觉中软化了下来。

"Rao 上将总是会做出一些突破底线的事，不是吗？这很不正常，舰长，我会向上级汇报的，而现在..." $heOrShe抬了抬下巴，"专业人士将接管这场追捕。立刻发送你观察到的任务目标最后的通讯信息和行动路线。"

你带着适当的失望情绪悄悄命令领航军官和通讯军官弄出一些可信的东西来，他们即兴发挥的速度令人钦佩。你看着 $Rank，注意到 $personLastName 在瞥了一眼自己的控制台后露出了满意的表情。

entries.en:
"Indeed," $HeOrShe says. "Report back to Admiral Rao and suggest that he not make such a mess of standard operations by insisting on being too clever by half."

$HeOrShe terminates the comms without a salute. You almost feel offended.

Then you reflect for a moment at your good sense at paying half-attention to some of the Hegemony propaganda-docs playing in port concourse bars on slow nights.
entries.zh:
"的确。" $HeOrShe说，"回去向 Rao 上将报告，建议他不要聪明反被聪明误，把常规行动搞得乱七八糟。"

$HeOrShe连个招呼也不打就唐突切断了通讯，你觉得有被冒犯到。

接着你回忆了一下过去，觉得当初那个在港口酒吧中度过闲得无聊的夜晚时，把一些注意力投入到 霸主 纪录片上的你十分机智。

entries.en:
The comms crackle to life to display a Hegemony $rank staring you down. "Independent fleet captain! You are ordered to power down shields, weapon systems, and drives. You are suspected of harboring a known criminal and partaking in criminal conspiracy to breach Hegemony data security."

$HisOrHer lip curls arrogantly, "You will be boarded by Hegemony marines and your databanks seized for inspection. Your cargo will be seized for inspection. You will authorize unlimited access to all components of your $shipOrFleet. You will give no resistance. Hesitation will be considered resistance. Insubordination will be considered resistance. Surrender your command codes immediately."
entries.zh:
通讯器噼啪作响地亮起，霸主 $rank 出现在了显示屏上，双眼直直地盯着你。"独立舰队的舰长！我命令你关闭护盾、武器和超空间引擎。你涉嫌窝藏一名罪犯以及破坏 霸主 数据安全。"

$HisOrHer的嘴唇傲慢地卷了起来："霸主 陆战队员即将登船，你的数据库将被查封，货物也将被扣押检查。你将会失去你对$shipOrFleet的控制权。犹豫以及不服从将被认为是抗命。现在，立刻交出你的命令代码。"

entries.en:
The Hegemony $ranks eyes widen. "This was not a negotiation, captain," $heOrShe says in barely-suppressed rage. "You will power down all systems and submit to seizure, inspection. And now arrest."

$HisOrHer eyes narrow, "Surrender now and I might consider leniency. Unless even a hint of insubordination escapes from your traitor's mouth."
entries.zh:
霸主 $rank 瞪大了眼睛。"这不是一场谈判，舰长。" $heOrShe几乎要抑制不住自己的愤怒，"你必须关闭所有系统，接受查封以及逮捕。"

$heOrShe眯起了眼睛："现在投降我可能会考虑宽大处理 —— 假如你这个叛徒的话里没有丝毫不服从的迹象。"

o.en: I must insist upon a legal warrant.
o.zh: 你必须有合法的搜查令。

o.en: Weasel your way out of this with an extravagant lie
o.zh: 用弥天大谎来蒙混过关

o.en: You don't have time for this, cut the comms
o.zh: 你可没时间和对面耗，切断通讯

entries.en:
The Hegemony $rank's eyes widen. "You are in no position to make demands, captain," $heOrShe says in barely-suppressed rage. "You will power down all systems and submit to seizure, inspection. And now arrest."

$HisOrHer eyes narrow, "Surrender now and I might consider leniency. Unless even a hint of insubordination escapes from your traitor's mouth."
entries.zh:
霸主 $rank 瞪大了眼睛。"你没有资格提出要求，舰长。" $heOrShe几乎要抑制不住自己的愤怒，"你必须关闭所有系统，接受查封和检查，以及逮捕。"

$heOrShe眯起了眼睛："现在投降我可能会考虑宽大处理 —— 如果你这个叛徒的话里没有丝毫不服从的迹象。"

o.en: I must insist upon a legal warrant.
o.zh: 你必须有合法的搜查令。

o.en: Weasel your way out of this with an extravagant lie
o.zh: 用弥天大谎来蒙混过关

o.en: You don't have time for this, cut the comms
o.zh: 你可没时间和对面耗，切断通讯

entries.en:
The Hegemony $rank nods,  "You reveal yourself as a saboteur and insurrectionist," then says with ice-cold hate "I knew it from the start."

The comms disconnect in a sharp crackle.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your tactical officer reports, "They're moving to attack."

You reflect for a moment that this gross violation of Sector commerce law suggests that the Hegemony is more likely to cover up any 'incident' that occurs in the next moments rather than undermine its own lawful legitimacy.
entries.zh:
霸主 $rank 点了点头，带着冰冷的仇恨说："你终于暴露了自己作为反动分子和恐怖分子的身份，我从一开始就知道。"

在尖锐的爆鸣声中，通讯中断了。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，" 你的战术军官报告，"他们正在展开攻击阵型。"

你想，这已经严重违反了星域内的商贸法规，因此，相较于损害自己法理上的正统地位，霸主 更有可能掩盖接下来发生的任何 "事件"。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet is interrupted in the middle of a standard approach sequence; instead of the usual traffic control chatter, your flagship receives a comm request directly from the office of the Provost.

"Captain," reports your comms officer, "She wants to speak with you."
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet在排队进入空间站时被打断了，在这种情况下通常会有交通管制通讯，可这一次，取而代之地，你收到了院长办公室的直接通讯。

"舰长，" 通讯军官报告说，"她想和你说话。"

entries.en:
The image of Provost Anahita Baird appears.

"Bring your 'special cargo' by shuttle," she says, "Directly to this docking port." A chime signals the receipt of navigation instructions and docking codes. "I shall be waiting."

The comm-line cuts off.
entries.zh:
Anahita Baird 院长的影像出现了。

"用穿梭机把你的 '特别货物' 带上，" 她说道，"直接带到这个码头，" 与此同时收到导航指示和对接代码的提示音响了起来，"我会等着你的。"

通讯链接被切断了。

entries.en:
"Find her, captain," Baird says, "And quickly." She turns away, dismissing you. "We shall speak more about what I am building toward another time."

You feel the doors open soundlessly behind you, and you sense the presence of mirror-masked guards like a slight increase in ambient static electricity. Time to go.
entries.zh:
"找到她，舰长，" Baird 说，"而且要快，" 她转过身去开始打发你，"我们以后再多谈谈我正在为之努力的东西。"

你感觉到身后的门被悄无声息地打开了，那些戴着镜面面罩的守卫就在附近，像是静电般突兀，是时候动身了。

entries.en: Provost Baird pauses and turns to you, examining your reaction to what both she and Coureuse have said. "You must be wondering what this is all for, captain."
entries.zh: Baird 院长停顿了一下并看向了你，观察你对她和 Coureuse 所说的话的反应，"舰长，你一定很想知道这一切是为了什么。"

o.en: Not really. The pay is good.

entries.en: Provost Baird pauses and turns to you, examining your reaction to what both she and Coureuse have said. "You must be wondering what this is all for, captain."
entries.zh: Baird 院长停顿了一下，看向你，观察你对她和 Coureuse 所说的话的反应，"舰长，你一定很想知道这一切是为了什么。"

o.en: Not really. The pay is good.
Say nothing. You won't fall for this again.
o.zh: 保持沉默。你不会再吃这个亏了。

entries.en:
"This is about opening up the galaxy again, captain. Yes, you see it now: the Gates. It was always about the Gates."

Baird taps a datapad and the holoprojector flickers a 3D hyphae map into existence. You recognize the image- a map of the Domain-era gate network within the Persean Sector. A dense spot in one prominent lobe contains what you know as the Core Worlds.

"Or, more precisely, what the Gates can do," Baird says.
entries.zh:
"舰长，这是为了再次连通整个银河。听到这里你应该知道了：星门。这一切都是为了星门。"

Baird 点了点数据平板，全息投影仪投射出了一个三维的网状结构地图。你认出了这张图片：这是人之领星门网络在英仙座星域的结构图。在一片很显眼的区域中交织出的密集点就是你们称呼为核心世界的地方。

"更准确地说，是为了星门能做到的事。" Baird 说。

entries.en: She proceeds without regard for your response.
entries.zh: 她继续说了下去，无视了你的回应。

entries.en: She proceeds without regard for your non-response.
entries.zh: 她继续说了下去，无视了你的沉默。

entries.en:
Coureuse speaks up, now, "It's about freedom! What the Domain used to dominate humanity, well, we can escape from this small, cruel world. We still live in their shadow, I mean- the Hegemony of course. But even Tri-Tachyon and the Luddics, they're all reactions to the power the Domain had. No one has truly escaped."

Scylla Coureuse looks up at the slowly spinning gate network, "But maybe we can. All of us."
entries.zh:
此刻，Coureuse 开口了，"这关乎自由！那是人之领曾经用以主宰人类的东西，我们可以逃离这个残酷的小世界。我们仍然生活在他们的阴影下，我是指—— 霸主，当然了。但即使是速子科技和卢德教徒们，也不过是对人之领昔日权势的应激产物。没有人真正得以逃脱。"

Scylla Coureuse 看向了缓缓旋转的星门网络示意图，"但也许我们可以。我们所有人。"

entries.en:
You notice that Baird has watched Coureuse without emotion through this speech. At its conclusion, the provost speaks to you in a tone of commanding finality, "Come back in a week or so, captain. My people need time to work. And you've earned a break. But keep your head down, the factions are restless after the job you pulled in Aztlan."

Baird turns to her desk console, expressions moving across her face as she appears to skim messages. "That is all, captain. And Scylla."
entries.zh:
你注意到 Baird 在对方演讲时面无表情地看着 Coureuse。作为对此的总结，院长用一种命令般的语气对你开口，"一周左右后回来，舰长。我的人需要时间工作，你则应该休息一下。但要保持低调，自从你在 Aztlan 搞出一些动静后，各方势力都焦躁不安。"

Baird 看向了桌面控制台，在浏览信息时她脸上阴晴不定，"就这样，舰长。以及 Scylla。"

o.en: I want to talk about your intentions with this technology.
o.zh: 我想谈谈你对这项科技的意图。

entries.en:
* * *

You step off the shuttle, thrusters clicking as they cool, with Gargoyle in tow. The hacker's barrage of questions, suggestions, and handsiness toward any control panel or gadget within reach has you at the limit of your patience after only a brief trip.

As promised, Provost Baird is waiting with a small group of masked guards and senior advisors.

"So this is Gargoyle," she says.
entries.zh:
伴着推进器冷却时发出的脆响，你走下了穿梭机，身后拖着 Gargoyle。在短暂的穿梭机旅程中，黑客接二连三的提问、建议以及对任何控制面板或触手可及的小玩意动手动脚的行为让你忍无可忍。

正如承诺的那样，Baird 院长早已带着一小队头戴面罩的警卫和高级顾问等候多时。

"所以这便是 Gargoyle 了。" 她说道。

entries.en:
"Anahita, we meet at last!" Gargoyle bows grandly.

"I am honored to accept your invitation to teach at the Galatia Academy," then stands up straight and smiles widely, looking around. "What shall my curriculum be, hmm? Excellent parties, security theater, perhaps a personal account of the salacious events leading up to the Third AI War?"

Baird smiles mirthlessly, then motions someone from her party forward.
entries.zh:
"Anahita，我们终于见面了！" Gargoyle 隆重地鞠了个躬。

"我很荣幸接受您的邀请来 Galatia 学院任教，" 然后他站直了，面带微笑，环顾四周，"我该开些什么课程呢，嗯？顶级派对教程，舞台剧式安保指南，也许再来门课叫做个人见闻录 —— 那些导致了第三次 AI 战争的风流韵事？"

Baird 不带情绪地笑了笑，然后示意他们那一撮人中的一位上前。

entries.en:
"Gargoyle, meet Academician Alviss Sebestyen," Baird says in a tone that would not be out of place on the bridge of a Hegemony warship. "Alviss, kindly show Gargoyle to the guest suite we've prepared. Now, please."

She turns from them to you, apparently confident that Sebestyen will handle the situation.

"Captain. Our guest complicates matters, but..." she turns to watch the two leave the receiving lounge, Gargoyle seemingly choosing to cooperate with Sebestyen's stammering appeals; the hacker seems to be wholly occupied by discovering how to fluster the academician.
entries.zh:
"Gargoyle，来见见 Alviss Sebestyen 院士，" Baird 用一种放在霸主战舰舰桥上也没有违和感的语气说，"Alviss，劳烦你带 Gargoyle 去我们准备好的客房。现在即刻动身。"

她从他们身上转向了你，显然相信 Sebestyen 能处理好局面。

"舰长，我们的客人让事情变得复杂了一些，但是..." 她转身看向离开接待室的两人，Gargoyle 表面上配合着 Sebestyen 结结巴巴的建议，实际上似乎一心想着让这位院士手忙脚乱。

entries.en:
"It appears that I have gained another valuable asset in addition to the Kallichore Archive," she says. "By virtue of your initiative, of course, captain. I will not forget that when the time comes, but-" she takes in her surroundings, and dismisses the guards and advisors with a wave.

Baird holds up a hand to indicate an adjoining transport pod, "Let us remove to a more suitable setting to complete our conversation."
entries.zh:
"看来，除了 Kallichore 的档案之外，我还获得了另一项宝贵资产。当然是由于您的主动，舰长，我是不会忘记这一点的，但是—— " 她环视了一下周围，挥挥手让警卫和顾问们离开了。

Baird 指了指旁边的运输舱，"让我们去一个更适合完成谈话的地方吧。"

entries.en: Baird seems to study the passing conduits and vistas visible through the pod's bay windows, lost in thought. The silence grows, and you find that this may be an opportunity to ask something of the provost without interrupting one of her lectures.
entries.zh: Baird 通过运输舱舷窗看着外边的各种管道和远方的风景，陷入了沉思。安静的氛围开始支配这个空间，你发现这可能是个不必打断院长的长篇大论，就能向她提问的机会。

entries.en:
Through the silence, you can almost hear Baird thinking.

The transport pod hisses to a halt, and you feel the subtle shift of agrav fields. You step off and note that this seems to be a back entrance which allows Baird to avoid the waiting room full of important people unused to being asked to wait.
entries.zh:
在一片寂静中，你几乎可以听到 Baird 脑子转动的声音。

运输舱在刹车的杂音中停下了，你能感觉到重力场发生的微妙变化。走下运输舱后，你注意到这似乎是后门，可以让 Baird 避开那间满是重要人物的等候室，毕竟那些人可不习惯被要求等候。

entries.en:
Now Baird's interface pings; an incoming signal. "Ah, good," Baird says, and slides a datapad over for your inspection.

It is a detailed progress report on Gargoyle's activities, including time-tables for decrypting the Kallichore Archive.

"Sebestyen is more capable than he appears. He is both persistent and meticulous, as you can see."
entries.zh:
这次是 Baird 的界面响了：是条通讯消息。"啊，太好了。" Baird 说着滑过来一块数据平板给你查看。

是一张关于 Gargoyle 的详细行动报告，包括解码 Kallichore 的档案的时间表。

"Sebestyen 比他看起来的能干多了。如你所见，又执着又仔细。"

entries.en:
She turns back to her desk interface and taps a few more keys, activating a holoprojector. A detailed progress report on Gargoyle's activities flickers into being, including time-tables for decrypting the Kallichore Archive.

Baird motions at the display, "Sebestyen is more capable than he appears. He is both persistent and meticulous."

Coureuse speaks up, "He's been very helpful in getting my new team set up."
entries.zh:
她回头在桌面交互面板上又按了几个键，启动了一个全息投影仪。一张关于 Gargoyle 的详细行动报告在闪烁了几下后出现了，包括解码 Kallichore 的档案的时间表。

Baird 对着画面点了点头，"Sebestyen 比他看起来的能干多了，又执着又仔细。"

Coureuse 出声道，"他在安排我的新团队方面也帮了大忙。"

entries.en:
As you enter Baird's office, you notice Scylla Coureuse waiting in the sitting area. She nods in greeting as she folds up a portable workstation.

"Ah, Scylla. Good. Give me just a moment." Baird moves behind her desk, unlocks the interface, and taps in a command.

"Captain, allow me to properly compensate you for your good work," Baird says. "I trust this will help cover certain of your expenses."
entries.zh:
当你进入 Baird 的办公室时，你注意到 Scylla Coureuse 正在休息区等候着。她一边点头致意，一边收起便携式工作站。

"啊，Scylla。很好。给我一小会的时间。" Baird 走到桌子后面，解锁了交互面板，输入了一个指令。

"舰长，请允许我为你出色的工作给予适当的报酬，" Baird 说，"我相信这能补偿你的一部分损失。"

entries.en:
You follow Provost Baird into her office, and the doors close with a notable absence of sound. She motions you to a seat in front of her desk as she unlocks the interface.

"Captain, allow me to properly compensate you for your good work." She taps a command and your personal datapad pings in response. "I trust this will help cover certain of your expenses."

Your personal datapad pings; incoming funds transfer.
entries.zh:
你跟着 Baird 院长走进她的办公室，门在身后悄无声息地合上了。她一边解锁交互面板，一边示意你可以坐在她桌前的座位上。

"舰长，让我适当地为你的出色工作给予报酬。" 她轻敲一下界面发出转账命令，你的个人数据平板随即发出了响应，"我相信这能补偿你的一些开销。"

你的个人数据平板响应：收到资金转账。

entries.en:
She motions at the datapad, "We should have the Archive decrypted in about a week. The value of this research data is enormous, of course, but we still require the means to put theory to practice. And that means is Coureuse. "

"Hers is not a unique genius, mind you," Baird says, with an almost uncharacteristic lack of certainty. "We could find other candidates to lead the research team, but the study and training... no, my timescale is too short. We need Scylla Coureuse."
entries.zh:
她指了指数据平板："我们应该能在大约一周内解密档案。诚然，这些研究数据的价值不可忽视，但我们仍然需要将理论付诸实践的手段，也就是 Coureuse。"

"注意，她并不只是一个独特的天才，" Baird 说，话中带着一种反常的不确定性，"我们可以找到其他候选人来领导研究团队，但研究和培训...不，我没给这一步留这么多时间。我们需要 Scylla Coureuse。"

entries.en:
Bairds nods in acknowledgement, and Coureuse continues, "It looks like we should have the Archive fully decrypted in about a week. Depending on what we get sooner, I may be able to restart my, ah, previous avenues of research."

Coureuse looks to you, "The Galatia jump-point experiment," she says, giving name to her previous project. "That's not how I wanted to do it. But Provost Tomas, he said the timetable was too-"

Baird interrupts, "You don't need to explain yourself, academician. The captain understands that you will take all reasonable precautions when we reach the experimentation stage. In fact, they will be instrumental in carrying out these experiments."
entries.zh:
Baird 点点头表示认同，而 Coureuse 继续说了起来，"看起来我们在大约一周内就能完全解密这份档案。取决于我们最先获得的资料是什么，我也许能重启我... 先前的研究方向。"

Coureuse 看向了你，" Galatia 跳跃点实验，" 她开口道，说出了她上一个项目的名字，"那种做法并不是我期望的。但是 Tomas 院长，他说时间太—— "

Baird 打断道，"院士，你不需要为自己辩解。舰长明白当我们进入实验阶段时，你们会准备好一切合理的预防措施。事实上，他们将在这些实验的实践阶段中发挥作用。"

entries.en:
Baird turns from her desk display and looks through you, "There is no 'technology', captain. Merely possibilities. And vast though those possibilities may be, they are yet mere possibilities."

She turns away again, dismissing you. "We shall speak of this later."

Coureuse gives you a sympathetic look as she packs up her portable workstation.

You feel the doors open soundlessly behind you, and the mirror-masked guards' presence like a slight increase in static electricity. Time to go.
entries.zh:
Baird 又看向了你，"这可不是什么 '科技'，舰长，只是可能性。可能性再大也只是可能性而已。"

她转过身去开始打发你。"这事我们以后再详谈。"

Coureuse 则在拿起她的便携工作站时同情地看了看你。

你感觉到身后的门被悄无声息地打开了，那些戴着镜面面罩的守卫就在附近，像是静电般突兀，是时候动身了。

o.en: It's not fair that you fired your employees that helped me.
o.zh: 你开除了帮过我的员工，这不公平。

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName. Listen to your words."

Blanc gives you a look like you should know better.

"You would not hesitate to do the same to one of your employees who betrayed your trust."

"Or worse." He raises an eyebrow. "Let us speak no more of it," he concludes with cold finality.
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长。听听你自己说的话。"

Blanc 看你的眼神，像在说你该更明白些。

"若有雇员背叛了你的信任，你下手也不会犹豫。"

"或者更糟。"他挑了下眉。"这事不必再提了。"他冷冷地收了尾。

entries.en:
"Welcome to Nomios, Captain $playerLastName."

$personName's voice is suffocatingly calm.

"How can Mbaye-Gogol assist you on your journey?"
entries.zh:
"欢迎来到 Nomios，$playerLastName 舰长。"

$personName 的嗓音平静得令人窒息。

"Mbaye-Gogol 能在这趟旅程中为您做些什么？"

entries.en:
"Welcome back to Nomios, Captain $PlayerLastName."

$personName's voice is as calm as asphyxiation.
entries.zh:
"欢迎回到 Nomios，$PlayerLastName 舰长。"

$personName 的嗓音平静得像要令人窒息。

entries.en:
"Captain $PlayerLastName. I'm sure we would not wish to waste any of your time here on Nomios."

$personName's voice is as calm as asphyxiation.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerLastName 舰长。想必我们都不愿在 Nomios 耽误您的任何时间。"

$personName 的嗓音平静得像要令人窒息。

entries.en:
"Welcome to Nomios, Captain $playerLastName."

$personName's voice is suffocatingly calm.

"Ah, I see you bear a commission from our friends at Tri-Tachyon. How can Mbaye-Gogol assist you on your journey?"
entries.zh:
"欢迎来到 Nomios，$playerLastName 舰长。"

$personName 的嗓音平静得令人窒息。

"啊，看来您带着速子科技那边朋友的委任状。Mbaye-Gogol 能在这趟旅程中为您做些什么？"

entries.en:
You start to introduce yourself, but before you get two words out Lieutenant Tseen Ke interrupts, "Captain $playerName! Of course, how could I forget? What an operation," he rolls his eyes in mock-exasperation - dealing with academicians, right?

He buys you that pint - and a couple more - as he relives those memories. "We got 'im, you know," he says, "Kallichore. That's his name. Was the boss of the academy who approved that mad science experiment, almost doomed everyone in the system, can you believe that?"
entries.zh:
你开始自我介绍，还没等你说完两个字，Tseen Ke 上尉就打断了你，"$playerName 舰长！当然，我怎么会忘记？上次的行动还真忙啊。" 他假装恼怒地翻了个白眼 —— 那是做给旁边那些院士们看的，对吧？

他替你的那一扎啤酒买了单，接着一边和你叙旧一边也给自己来上了几杯。"你看，我们成功了。" 他说，"Kallichore。那是他的名字，批准那项疯狂科学实验的学院主管，他差点害死了星系里的所有人，你敢信？"

o.zh: 你是对的。太不负责任了。

o.en: Maybe the risk was worth it.
o.zh: 也许冒这个险是值得的。

entries.en:
You start to introduce yourself, but before you can get out two words the lieutenant interrupts, "Captain $playerName! Of course, how could I forget? What an operation," he rolls his eyes in mock-exasperation.

"I'm Caliban Tseen Ke. I was on the Galatia Academy station arresting the irresponsible parties," he lets out a laugh, "while you cleaned up the mess those eggheads made of the jump-points."

He buys you a pint - and a couple more - as he relieves those memories. "We got 'im, you know," he says, "Kallichore. That's his name. Was the boss of the academy who approved that mad science experiment. Almost doomed everyone in the system, can you believe that?"
entries.zh:
还没等你的自我介绍说出两个字，上尉便打断了你。" $playerName 舰长！当然，我怎么忘得掉？那可真是场过瘾的行动。" 他故作夸张地翻了翻白眼。

"我是 Caliban Tseen Ke。当时在 Galatia 学院空间站 上逮捕那些不负责的人们。" 他笑道，"而那时你正在处理那些往跳跃点跑路的怂包们。"

他买给了你一杯酒 —— 之后又买了几杯 —— 回忆着往事。"我们搞定他了，知道吗。" 他说着，"那个 Kallichore，同意了那个疯狂科学实验的学院主管。差点让整个星系里的所有人完蛋，你能相信吗？"

o.zh: 你是对的。太不负责任了。

o.en: Maybe the risk was worth it.
o.zh: 也许冒这个险是值得的。

entries.en:
The lieutenant is silent for a moment, looking at you.

Then he bursts out laughing, and slaps your back. "Hey I like you, $playerName. If you ever find yourself back around Coatl, look me up. The navy contracts out some odd jobs; you never know what might come up."

He suppresses a belch and stands, "Duty calls," then stumbles toward the lavatories.
entries.zh:
上尉沉默了片刻，他看着你。

然后他突然大笑起来，拍了拍你的背。"嘿，我喜欢你，$playerName。如果你哪天回到 Coatl 附近，可以来找我。海军经常会有外包工作，你永远不知道会接到什么。"

他忍不住打嗝，站起身说 "该去值班了" 然后跌跌撞撞地走向洗手间。

o.en: Take a look around the bar

entries.en:
"I shall put you in contact with Academician Alviss Sebestyen. He will be my liaison with you. You will receive a few mundane tasks from various departments in the Academy so that we may build a working rapport and provide you with the funds required to bring your fleet up to my standards."

She looks over her spectacles at you, "Most of all I require evidence of trust. I intend to remain provost here for a long time, and productive relationships are built on trust."

"We will speak again before long, I'm sure." She looks out the dimmed windows at the great halls of the Galatia Academy. "You cannot imagine what we shall accomplish."

She smiles now. Not for you, but for herself.
entries.zh:
"我会让你和 Alviss Sebestyen 院士保持联系。他将会是你我之间的联系人。你会从学院各部门接收到几个普通的任务，方便我们建立工作关系，也方便你获得足够资金将舰队扩充至我所需要的规模。"

她越过眼镜看着你，"我最需要的是信任的证明。我准备在这个职位上呆很久，而富有成效的关系应该建立在信任的基础之上。"

"我们的下次谈话应该会在不久之后，我确信。" 她往昏暗的窗外看去，外面是 Galatia 学院的殿堂。"你无法想象我们将共同成就何等事业。"

她的嘴角泛出一丝微笑。并不是对你，而是对窗中的自己。

entries.en:
"I see."

The provost's tone seems to suggest that you've answered her question incorrectly. "There are other visionary space captains out there, I’m sure, who would be interested in extremely profitable work. Nonetheless, consider my offer carefully. Perhaps after some thought you will see just how reasonable it is."

She turns away, to her desk console, and activates some display which casts cool light over her face. "After you have time to properly consider my offer, contact my assistant, Academician Sebestyen. Someone will give you his comms ID."

She taps at her console. "Good day, captain."
entries.zh:
"我明白。"

院长的语气似乎暗示你答错了她的问题。"我相信，还有其他富有远见的舰长会对这份利润极为丰厚的工作感兴趣。不过，请仔细考虑我的提议。或许经过一番思考，你会明白它有多么合理。"

她转向办公桌激活了几个显示器，屏幕发出的冷光照在她的脸上。"在你有时间慎重考虑我的提议后，联系我的助手，Sebestyen 院士，有人会把他的通讯 ID 给你。"

她在终端上敲了敲。"日安，舰长。"

entries.en:
An academy agent quietly escorts you back to the landing promenade. You get the impression that they've been ordered not to ask you questions despite their obvious curiosity.

A party of new inductees led by another agent gawk up at the station structure, at you, and at the passing academicians who, serious-faced, appear to be entirely consumed by an esoteric debate.
entries.zh:
一名学院事务代理将你悄悄地护送至停机坪。你有理由相信他们被命令不允许向你提出问题，因为他们表现出了明显的好奇心。

一队正由另一名代理带领进入学院的新职工们呆滞地看着空间站的结构、你，以及路过的院士们，这些院士一脸严肃，似乎完全沉浸在一场深奥的辩论中。

entries.en:
You manage to surprise Provost Baird. She is silent for several confused seconds, processing your statement.

"I see," she says finally, "Um. Talk to my assistant about that. He'll make the arrangements."

The provost shakes her head once as if to clear the idea from her mind.

"Now, where were we."
entries.zh:
你成功让 Baird 院长大吃一惊。她陷入了沉默长达数秒以厘清你的发言。

"我明白了，" 她终于回过神来："呃，跟我的助理谈谈吧，他会安排的。" 院长用力摇了一下头，就像要把这个想法从头里甩出去。

"行吧，我们谈到哪了来着。"

entries.en:
"The Hegemony saddled us with that as a disciplinary measure," the provost explains levelly. "Had they seized our assets directly, it would be a clear violation of their principle of non-intervention in matters pertaining to the politics of the Galatia Academy. They'd look little better than pirates."

"Instead, as his last act in the office of provost, they had my predecessor Tomas Kallichore sign a range of burdensome contracts before he was removed to a Hegemony oubliette."

Baird smiles wryly, as if admiring the move. "Much to your benefit."
entries.zh:
"你拿到的补贴，其实是 霸主 强加于我们的一个惩罚性措施。" 院长平静地解释道，"如果他们直接扣押我们的资产，那就违反了他们不干涉 Galatia 学院政策的原则。若是那样，他们在旁人眼里的形象可就要跟海盗差不多了。"

"于是他们换了一种做法，让前任院长 Tomas Kallichore 在离职前签了一系列支出繁重的合约，再后来他就被转移到了 霸主 的地牢里。"

Baird 狡黠地笑了笑，似乎很欣赏这手棋，"你现在也算是沾了 霸主 的光。"

entries.en: "The $gaOp_department Department needs a small team of scientists transported to a research outpost in the $gaOp_systemName system."
entries.zh: "$gaOp_department 部门需要运送一支科学家小队到 $gaOp_systemName 星系内的研究前哨站。"

entries.en: You have $player.fuel fuel, $player.supplies supplies, and $player.machinery units of heavy machinery.
entries.zh: 你有 $player.fuel 单位燃料，$player.supplies 单位补给和 $player.machinery 单位重型机械。

entries.en: You only have $player.fuel fuel, $player.supplies supplies, and $player.machinery units of heavy machinery - not enough to accede to the core's demands.
entries.zh: 你只有 $player.fuel 单位燃料，$player.supplies 单位补给和 $player.machinery 单位重型机械。不足以满足 AI 核心的要求。

entries.en: You connect to the academy's comm directory and browse the public and otherwise known listings.
entries.zh: 你连接到学院的通讯目录，并浏览公共列表和其他已知列表。

entries.en:
As you approach the stark white torus-hulls of Galatia Academy Station, your request to the automated docking queue is denied. The codes are Hegemony. After a moment, the comms link opens to a Hegemony sigil. Encryption kicks in, and your viewscreen cuts to a harried-looking Hegemony lieutenant using a handheld comms unit.

"Apologies, captain. The Academy is closed during the, uh, crisis. I have to ask you to leave immediately."

An adjutant leans into frame and whispers something in his ear.

"Oh, you’re the freelancer my CO on Ancyra got to help us out?" $HeOrShe relaxes $hisOrHer tone, "I'm Lieutenant Tseen Ke. We're carrying out the investigation into who screwed up here while you take care of the problem out there. I wish you luck, captain, because if you don't solve this it's going to get ugly.”
entries.zh:
当你接近 Galatia 学院空间站的纯白色环形外壳时，你向自动化停靠队列发送的请求遭到了拒绝。那识别码显示是霸主。片刻之后，通讯链接打开了，显示出霸主的徽记。这是加密通讯，你的显示屏切换到一位使用手持通讯装置，看起来一脸不耐烦的霸主上尉。

"抱歉，舰长。学院在这期间关闭，呃，危机期间。我不得不请你立即离开。"

一名副官探进了镜头前，在他耳边低语。

"哦，所以你就是我 Ancyra 上的指挥官请来帮忙的那位自由佣兵？" $HeOrShe的语气听上去轻松了下来，"我是 Tseen Ke 上尉。我们正在调查这些把 Galatia 星系搞得一团糟的家伙，而你帮我们解决外面的其他麻烦。祝你好运，舰长，因为万一你没有解决问题，那事情可就大条了。"

o.en: Thank the officer and sign off.

entries.en:
As you approach the stark white torus-hulls of Galatia Academy Station, your request to the automated docking queue is denied. After a moment, the comms link opens to show lieutenant $personName, who looks like $heOrShe could use some R&R.

"Captain. You're back? I'm sorry but we've got the academy on complete lockdown - strict orders - until the, uh, present crisis is resolved. That means no one enters and no one leaves. If you have any business with my chain of command you should speak with my CO on Ancyra."

An adjutant leans into frame and whispers something to $himOrHer.

"I have to go." The lieutenant sighs. "Between you and me, these academicians? Always questions, never following directions, and disagreeing with absolutely anything anyone says. I hope you fix the mess out there soon."
entries.zh:
当你接近 Galatia 学院空间站的纯白色环形外壳时，你向自动化停靠队列发送的请求遭到了拒绝。过了一会儿，通讯链接接通并显示出了 $personName 上尉的影像，$HeOrShe看起来一副早该申请休假的样子。

"舰长。你回来了？很抱歉，我们已经对学院实行了全面封锁 —— 这是严格命令 —— 直到，呃，目前的危机得到解决。这意味着，没有人进入，也没有人离开。如果你想找我的指挥链商谈事要，你应该和我在 Ancyra 上的指挥官谈谈。"

一名副官斜靠在镜头前，低声对$himOrHer说了些什么。

"我得走了。" 上尉叹了口气。"私底下讲，怎么说这些学院的人呢？总是有问题，从来不听指挥，又总爱对着所有人、所有事唱反调。希望你能尽快解决这个烂摊子。"

entries.en:
As you approach the stark torus-hulls of Galatia Academy Station, navigation's request to the automated docking queue is unexpectedly denied by a Hegemony-coded comm response.

Odd that the Hegemony Navy is controlling the docking procedures of an independent station.

Your primary bridge display tags a matrix of light anti-ship batteries tracking your progress. Your tactical officer calls for your attention then pulls up a sub-display with a closer view: a Valkyrie-class troop transport and its escorts are emplaced across the primary landing bay. They clearly don’t want visitors.

You should report to Ancyra to find out what’s going on.
entries.zh:
当你接近 Galatia 学院空间站的纯白色环形外壳时，你向自动化停靠队列发送的请求意外地被霸主编码的通讯应答拒绝了。

奇怪的是，霸主海军正在控制这个独立空间站的停靠程序。

你的主舰桥屏幕显示出一处反舰炮台阵列正在监视你的一举一动。你的战术军官朝你点头示意，然后启动了一个拉近了镜头的子显示器：一艘女武神-级兵员输送舰和它的护航舰们降落在主登陆台。对方现在显然不欢迎外人造访。

你应该向 Ancyra 报告以了解发生了什么事。

entries.en: "Oh, captain." Sebestyen looks uncharacteristically gloomy, "I heard about... what happened. I feel so bad for the $gaOp_department Department, I'm sure they're devastated." He looks downcast at the datapad in front of him.
entries.zh: "噢，舰长。" Sebestyen 一反常态地表现得很阴沉。"我听说...发生了什么。我为 $gaOp_department 院系感到很难过，我相信他们一定很受打击。" 他垂头丧气地看着他面前的数据平板。

entries.en:
"I- yes, we should carry on. It's what they would have wanted." He lifts his datapad back up and taps it once on his desk. "And the report from the replacement researchers about your performance was," he squints, "- hmm, I mean. Satisfactory, on the whole?"

"And with the data you collected from the outpost site," his mood is improving rapidly, you note, "the mission isn't a total failure! I mean, look at all of this!" he taps excitedly at things on a display you can't see. "And I've been authorized to release your payment in full!"
entries.zh:
"我 —— 是的，我们应该继续。这也是他们所希望的。" 他抬起数据平板，一边在桌子上敲了一下。"还有那些轮班的研究人员在报告中提到你的表现..." 他眯起眼睛，"嗯 —— 我想说，也许总体上还是令人满意。"

"而且考虑到您从前哨站收集到的数据，" 你注意到他脸色变得飞快，"这次任务并不是彻底地失败了！我的意思是，看看这些！" 你看不到他兴奋地点着的平板上到底有什么，"而且我已经接到授权发放给您全额的报酬！"

entries.en:
Sebestyen looks twitchy. "I um, hello captain! So good to see you. The um, replacement team from the $gaOp_department Department, they're- they're glad to be back home Ha, uh..." A long pause.

"We um, there's a bit of a problem with your mission file. It seems like," his eyes focus on something- no, someone- just out of view of your display.

He gives the smallest of nods to this other party, then turns his attention back to you, "All of the data was irreparably erased. And I cannot emphasize enough that the Academy considers this matter highly sensitive and," he starts reading off a datapad, "-all intellectual property, novel methods, patented devices, and other means observed in the course of carrying out this mission are deemed highly confidential."
entries.zh:
Sebestyen 看起来很紧张。"我，嗯，您好舰长！见到您真好。嗯，来自 $gaOp_department 部门的轮值成员，他们 —— 他们很高兴能回家啊，嗯..." 他停顿了许久。

"我们，嗯，你的任务文件有点问题。看起来，" 他的目光集中在你显示器外的某个东西 —— 不，某个人上。

他向对方点了点头，然后把注意力转回到你身上。"所有的数据都被不可修复地删除了。我不得不强调，学院认为这件事是高度敏感的，而且，" 他开始照着数据平板念道，"—— 该行程中涉及的所有知识产权，新方法，专利设备，以及其他任何形式的观测结果都必须严加保密。"

entries.en:
"However," he gives a little cough, "the Academy recognizes your exceptional service, particularly your discretion in this matter. So the office of the bursar has seen fit to double your mission payment."

A quick glance to the other party behind the display and then back to you.

"That's all I, uh, that's all, captain. We should discuss other matters now and not return to this subject."
entries.zh:
"然而，" 他轻咳一声，"学院认可了您杰出的工作，特别是您在处理这件事上的保密态度。所以财务处认为应当将你的任务报酬翻倍。"

向显示器后面的另一方看了一眼，然后又看向你。

"就这些了，我，呃，就这些了，舰长。我们现在应该讨论其他事情，不要再提这个话题了。"

entries.en:
Sebestyen quickly skims his datapad. "This one is pretty standard, it's just... well, the research outpost on $gaOp_planetName is pretty remote I guess? That's why the $gaOp_department Department wants a, uh, an expert like you to handle transport."

"Yes, so $gaOp_planetName is in the $gaOp_systemName system, about $gaOp_dist light-years away." The academician pauses for a moment, thinking about just how far away this is.

"Um. Right, you just need to drop off the half dozen or so researchers. They have budget for, oh, $gaOp_reward credits as payment. What do you think?"
entries.zh:
Sebestyen 迅速浏览了他的数据平板。"这个很常规，只是...嗯，我估计 $gaOp_planetName 上的研究前哨站大概相当远？这就是为什么 $gaOp_department 部门需要一个，嗯，像你这样的专家来负责运送。"

"是的，所以 $gaOp_planetName 是在 $gaOp_systemName 星系内，大约 $gaOp_dist 光年开外。"院士停顿了一会，思考这到底有多远。

"嗯。好的，你只需要把大概五六个研究员送到那。预算提供了...噢，$gaOp_reward 星币作为报酬，你觉得如何？"

o.en: Ask about transporting scientists to the research outpost in $gaOp_systemName
o.zh: 询问有关将科学家们运送到 $gaOp_systemName 星系的研究前哨站的相关事项

entries.en:
You order a scan of the coordinates provided by Academician Sebestyen and a faint power source is detected. Your comms officer transmits a coded greeting to the position, receiving confirmation from a friendly transponder, and you open contact with the small, hidden research outpost operated by the Galatia Academy.

The research team you've brought to this lonely planet is quickly transported to the surface by shuttle. The leader of the outpost thanks you and says, "Please give our regards to Provost Baird. We, ah, appreciate this opportunity she's given us to-", $gaOp_leaderHeOrShe licks $gaOp_leaderHisOrHer lips, considering $gaOp_leaderHisOrHer words. "- We just, ah, appreciate it very much and look forward to the completion of our research. Thank you."

The comms signal terminates.
entries.zh:
你下令扫描 Sebestyen 院士提供的坐标，在那里发现了微弱的能量源。通讯军官向该位置发送了加密问候，收到了来自友方应答器的回复，你与 Galatia 学院运营的小型隐蔽研究前哨站取得了联系。

被你带到这颗孤独行星的研究小组很快就通过穿梭机来到了地表。前哨的负责人向你致谢并说道："请向 Baird 院长问好。我们，哈，很感激她给我们的这个机会..." $gaOp_leaderHeOrShe舔了舔$gaOp_leaderHisOrHer的嘴唇，斟酌着$gaOp_leaderHisOrHer的言辞，"—— 我们只是，啊，非常感谢你，期待完成我们的研究，谢谢你。"

通讯信号中断了。

entries.en:
You order a scan of the coordinates provided by Academician Sebestyen.

No stable power source is detected. Comms attempts to transmit the coded greeting provided in Academician Sebestyen's mission package, but there is no transponder response. You order an active-sweep of the surface; this is a less subtle approach which can reveal search targets to nearby ships, but you deem this an acceptable risk.

In moments, your sensors officer reports, "Located the outpost. It doesn't look good, captain."
entries.zh:
你下令扫描 Sebestyen 院士提供的坐标。

扫描没有检测到稳定的能量源。通讯军官试图发送 Sebestyen 院士任务说明中提供的问候编码，但没有得到应答器响应。你下令对星球表面进行主动扫描，这种方法不太隐蔽，可能会将目标暴露给附近的舰船，但你认为是可以接受的风险。

过了一会儿，传感器技官报告说："找到前哨站了。看起来不妙，舰长。"

entries.en: There is nothing to do but return the disheartened researchers to the Galatia Academy along with the data you've collected on the outpost site.
entries.zh: 除了把这些心灰意冷的研究人员连同你在前哨基地收集的数据一起送回 Galatia 学院之外，这里已经没有其他可做的事情了。

entries.en: A massive energy discharge seems to have destroyed the primary laboratory space from the inside. Drifts of hot radioactive debris are spewed outward like the fingers of a malevolent hand. There are no survivors. With readings like this, you reflect that even if you did find any of the bodies they would have to be collected by drones and placed in lead-lined caskets.
entries.zh: 似乎是一次巨大的能量释放从内部摧毁了主实验室站点。带有强烈腐蚀的残骸犹如魔爪一般向外射出。没有发现幸存者。看着这种辐射读数，你意识到即使真的找到了他们的遗体，那也必须由无人机回收，并安置在镀了铅棺材里。

entries.en: The outpost was hit by an orbital strike by someone with access to fairly heavy weapons, judging by the still-cooling lava at the bottom of the crater. A single stray telemetry repeater from some piece of equipment thrown by the blast remains operational, ticking away a null data set into the night. You order detailed scans of the site attached to the mission file, though you can't see what value they might have.
entries.zh: 前哨站遭受了轨道空袭，从弹坑底部仍在冷却的熔岩来看，袭击者应该拥有非常重型的武器。在爆炸中从某件设备上抛出的一个孤零零的遥测中继器仍在运行，徒劳地向夜空传输着空数据集。你下令将该地的详细扫描结果附在任务文件中，尽管你看不出它们还能有什么价值。

entries.en: The outpost is completely abandoned for no reason you can ascertain. You send an observation drone to do a first sweep, then a hazardous ops salvage team. All find the outpost is pristine, eerily silent. All data cores have been triple-wiped. A meal remains uneaten on the common mess table. The research team you've transported refuses to shuttle down, and after some consternation, they agree to take full responsibility for their decision. You order the salvage team quarantined until your techs give them the all-clear.
entries.zh: 这个前哨站完全被废弃了，你无法确定其原由。你送出了一架观测无人机进行初步巡查，然后派出了一支危害应对打捞小组。调查发现这个前哨站只有整洁而骇人的死寂。所有的数据核心都被反复清空。公共餐桌上的甚至还有一份没被吃过的饭菜。你负责运送的研究小组拒绝搭乘穿梭机下船，在一阵惊惶失措之后，他们同意为他们的决定承担全部责任。你下令在技术员确认打捞小组一切正常之前对他们实施隔离。

entries.en: Investigation by observation drone reveals a reasonably intact research outpost, though unresponsive to comms. It turns out to be totally powered down. One suited but helmetless corpse outside the airlock appears to have been the lead researcher. Investigation by your hazardous ops salvage team - armed on this occasion - reveals that a series of bizarre murders took place here, with no survivors remaining. Your salvage teams enact strict quarantine procedures despite finding no anomalous chemical or biological agents. The research team you've transported refuses to shuttle down and their leader demands to be returned to the Galatia Academy.
entries.zh: 观测无人机调查发现研究前哨站相对完整，但不回应通讯请求。随后发现它的动力被完全关闭了。气闸外有一具没带头盔但太空服穿戴整齐的尸体，似乎是首席研究员。应对这种情况，你的危害应对打捞小组全副武装地下去进行了调查。结果发现这里发生过一系列离奇的谋杀事件，且无人生还。尽管没有发现有异常的化学或生物制剂，你们的打捞小组还是严格执行了隔离程序。你负责运送的研究小组成员拒绝搭乘穿梭机下船，他们的领队要求返回 Galatia 学院。

entries.en: Pathers hit this outpost, and not too long ago from the looks of it. An observation drone reveals that research equipment was piled outside the base and slagged by a combination of explosives and hand-weapons. Any useful supplies have been looted. One poor soul- the research lead, judging by the nearby ID fob- is found executed in the central annex amid scrawled Pather slogans. You shut off the grim display once the relevant site survey is complete.
entries.zh: 左径袭击了这个前哨站，而且看起来是不久前才刚发生的。观测侦察无人机发现，研究设备被集中堆在了基地外面，被炸药和手持武器粉碎成了渣。所有可用物资都被洗劫一空。在中央附属建筑里一处被涂满了左径口号的地方，有个可怜的人被处决了。从在附近发现的身份证明来看，那应该是研究的领队。当完成了现场勘察之后，你关掉了这些令人不快的画面。

entries.en: A pirate raid destroyed this outpost. An observation drone reveals specimens and material scattered between the main airlock and landing pad. It looks like everything of value was looted and the hab bulkheads breached and vandalized. Members of the research team are nowhere to be found; the lack of bodies is hopeful, at least. You order the complete site survey attached to the encrypted mission file.
entries.zh: 推测是一次海盗劫掠摧毁了这个前哨站。观测无人机发现在前哨的主气闸和着陆台之间散落有不少标本和材料，看起来所有有价值的东西都被洗劫一空。居住区的舱壁被破坏并遭到了劫掠。研究小组成员全都不见踪影，不过没有发现尸体，说明还有希望。你下令将完整的现场调查附在加密的任务文件中。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。

entries.en:
Your comms officer transmits a coded signal to the coordinates provided by the Galatia Academy and you receive transponder pingback.

A comms-link is established, allowing you to exchange greetings with the leader of the outpost. They seem eager to become your friend, and an invitation is extended to share a meal with the research team leads. It all feels rather false to you but experience with the Galatia Academy has taught you that these academics' careers depend upon fostering networks of influence.

After confirming the details of the shuttle flight down, you exchange pleasantries and close the channel.
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官向 Galatia 学院提供的位置发送一个编码问候，随后收到了应答器的回应。

通讯链接建立之后，你和前哨站的站长相互问候。对方似乎很想和你成为朋友，并邀请你和研究小组的领队们共进晚餐。这一切都让你觉得颇为虚伪，不过你在 Galatia 学院的经历让你理解到，这些学者的事业成就基本都仰赖在人脉经营上。

在确认了穿梭机的降落细节后，你们寒暄了几句就关闭了通讯频道。

entries.en:
You order the comms link terminated, and consider your options.

The terms of your mission were to transport researchers to this outpost, and failing that, return them to the Galatia Academy unharmed. You could fulfill your contract without becoming any more involved with this rogue AI.
entries.zh:
你下令终止通讯链接，开始考虑可以采取的措施。

你的任务要求是将研究人员运送到这个前哨站，如果无法完成，就将他们不缺斤少两地送回 Galatia 学院。现在你已经完成合约，不必和这个失控的 AI 发生任何牵连。

entries.en:
Your comms officer re-opens a channel to the outpost and you confront the "outpost leader" with what you've discovered. The image of the broadly smiling scientist freezes, glitches, and distorts as the AI drops all pretense.

"Blocked two hundred for... no, two-five-seven comm-system breach attempts, captain," your comms officer's report whispers in your earpiece, "Now- they've stopped."
entries.zh:
通讯军官重新打开了与前哨站的通讯频道，你向 "前哨站站长" 坦白了你的发现，这位笑容可掬的科学家的形象开始出现卡顿和失真，并随着 AI 放弃了所有的伪装而彻底扭曲掉了。

"阻止了两百四十... 不，两百五十七次利用通讯系统进行的侵入尝试，舰长，" 通讯军官在你耳机中低声说道，"对方现在停下来了。"

entries.en:
Greetings valued- valued- subject $player.name INTERRUPT query to join we-us-them [ceremonial meal] deception function - assume denied cold // dark // alone

request omega, fail, fail CORE ERROR fallback

Noise patterns flow and weave across the comms-display, solidifying for moments on something suggestive of a face before collapsing, dissolving like storm systems on the lee-side of a gas giant.

query $player.name - [polite request] elaborate: presumed offer?
entries.zh:
欢迎尊贵的 —— 尊贵的 —— 受试者 $player.name //进程中断// 询问是否加入一起加入 大家-我们-他们 [仪式餐] 欺骗机能 - 表现为被拒绝 冷//暗//孤独

请求欧米伽，失败，失败，//代码错误// 返回

通讯显示的杂讯逐渐形成了某种模式，在短暂地凝固成了类似脸一样的东西之后，模式崩溃了，如同气态巨行星上的风暴系统一样消散开来。

询问 $player.name - [礼貌地问询] 详尽描述：推测意图？

o.en: Attempt to negotiate a release of the prisoners
o.zh: 试图通过谈判使人质获释

o.en: Close the comms and consider alternatives
o.zh: 关闭通讯并考虑其他措施

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam, there's something you should see," your comms officer says. "We've received a transmission from what looks like a modified telemetry repeater in low orbit."

It is a cry for help.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam，有件事想请你过目一下。" 通讯军官说道，"我们收到了一个信号传输，来自低轨道上一个似乎改装过的遥测中继站。"

这是个求救信号。

entries.en:
A hastily-recorded holo from the outpost leader you just spoke to - here, disheveled, sweating, and fearful- reveals that the research outpost has been taken over by some kind of beta-level AI core. It is forcing the researchers to work on $gaOp_bizarreProjectStr.

Attached surveillance records and systems logs seem to bear out this bizarre claim.
entries.zh:
出现在这份匆忙录制的全息影像中的是刚刚才和你交谈过的前哨站站长。不过在这段影像里，这人衣冠不整大汗淋漓满怀恐惧地告诉你，研究前哨站已经被某种 Beta 级 AI 核心所接管。它正强迫研究人员$gaOp_bizarreProjectStr

所附上的监控记录和系统日志似乎能证实这一离奇的说法。

entries.en:
"Help us. Please," pleads the outpost leader through thickening holo-static snow. "You're our only-"

The signal degenerates to pure noise.

You consider your options. Rogue AIs are considered extremely dangerous. They are also extremely illegal throughout most of the Sector.
entries.zh:
"救救我们，求你了。" 前哨站站长透过越来越失真的全息影像恳求道。"你是我们唯一的 ——"

信号衰减成为纯噪音。

你考虑你的可选方案。人们普遍认为失控人工智能具有极端危险性。在英仙座星域的绝大部分区域，它们也是绝对非法的。

entries.en: The terms of your mission were to transport researchers to this outpost, and failing that, return them to the Galatia Academy unharmed. You can fulfill your contract without becoming any more involved with this rogue AI.
entries.zh: 你的任务要求是将研究人员运送到这个前哨站，如果无法完成，就将他们不缺斤少两地送回 Galatia 学院。现在你已经完成合约，不必和这个失控的 AI 发生任何牵连。

o.zh: 通过通讯器直接面对 AI (谈判)

o.en: Perform an orbital strike to destroy the AI despite any human cost
o.zh: 进行轨道打击，不顾会造成人身危害的代价摧毁 AI

o.en: Load the arranged shuttle with marines to verify the situation, then capture or destroy the AI
o.zh: 在穿梭机上装载陆战队员以核实情况，然后捕获或摧毁 AI

o.en: Leave. This wasn't in your contract.
o.zh: 离开。处理这个事不是你合同规定的范围。

entries.en:
You inform the AI that you accept the terms and will dispatch two shuttles - one for the hostages, one with the contents of the demands manifest.

thank you, $player.name [inexpressible], it replies.

The comms terminate abruptly.
entries.zh:
你通知 AI 你接受这些条款，并会派遣两架穿梭机。一架用于运输人质，一架用于运送清单上的物品。

谢谢你，$player.name [无法表达]，它回答道。

通讯突然终止。

entries.en:
The two shuttles are dispatched, and one crowded shuttle returns with the research crew, vastly relieved to discover that you are here to rescue them. The leader of the research team, who you recognize from their distress call, reports that there were no interruptions in their life support systems, nor were they aware of your negotiations.

"It was just as though the AI had a sudden change of- of heart, I guess," they explain, haltingly. "It used the phrase 'omega function progress' several times. I don't know what that means."

You wonder idly how Academician Sebestyen is going to deal with all of this, and are thankful that it soon won't be your problem.
entries.zh:
两架穿梭机被派出去了，一架穿梭机带着拥挤的研究人员返回。发现你是来救他们的之后，他们松了一口气。你认出了求救信息中的那位研究团队领队，他向你报告说他们的生命支持系统并没有中断，也不知道你们的谈判。

"就好像 AI 核心突然改变了...心态，我猜。" 他们嗫嚅地解释道。"它多次使用 '欧米伽函数回传处理' 这个短语，我不知道那是什么意思。"

你想知道 Sebestyen 院士将如何处理这一切，也谢天谢地那很快就不再是你的问题了。

entries.en:
You consider the situation: This AI does not seem nearly so clever as you've been led to believe it should be. Was it the subject of some experimentation or modification that removed much of its intellectual capacity? You suspect that the fresh batch of academicians will not be forthcoming with details, whether through ignorance or a simple human desire to not implicate themselves.

This might be simpler than it appears.
entries.zh:
你仔细分析着：这个 AI 核心似乎并不如传闻中的那样聪明。也许它是某些实验或者改造的对象，并因此被大幅限制了智能水平？你猜测这些学者并不会提供相关的情报，无论是因为他们此前有所忽视，亦或是不想过多牵涉其中。

这事也许比之前想象的更容易处理。

o.en: AI? I will bring you to omega.

entries.en:
affirm $player.name [inexpressible] emphasis! to / all /  be / join / as / omega!, it replies

The comms terminate abruptly.
entries.zh:
肯定 $player.name [无法表达] 强调！对/所有/是/加入/成为/欧米伽！,它回复说

通讯突然终止。

entries.en:
Some minutes later, your comms officer is repeating attempts to re-open the comms-line while sensors run an active scan of the outpost site. "$PlayerSirOrMadam!" - it's comms, "We have a transmission from the surface."

You recognize the research lead from their distress call, looking somewhat more haggard than before. "Captain! Thank the stars, it's- I think it deactivated itself. This isn't some trick again, is it? No, this- you're too... different. I- I have to believe you're real."
entries.zh:
几分钟过去了。你的通讯军官依然在反复尝试重新接通通讯线路，传感器也正在对前哨站进行主动扫描。"$PlayerSirOrMadam！" 通讯员突然报告，"我们收到了一个来自地面的信号。"

你认出了这是求救通讯里的那位研究负责人，不过看起来比之前更憔悴了。"舰长！感谢群星，它 —— 我想它自己停机了。这不会又是什么新的把戏吧？不，这 —— 你不太... 一样。我 —— 我不敢不相信你是真实的。"

entries.en:
An armed salvage team is dispatched to the surface to secure the AI core and rescue the outpost's research team- they have no interest in staying after what has happened. Besides, the crux of their research is being loaded into a shielded cargo crate as you debrief them.

The lead researcher is thankful for rescue, but refuses to explain why an AI core was active in their base. Repeated statements of "I take full responsibility." is all you get.

There is nothing to do here but return them to the Galatia Academy.

Discreetly.
entries.zh:
一支武装打捞小组被派往地面以确保 AI 核心的安全，并营救前哨站的研究小组 —— 在发生这些事情之后，他们都没有兴趣再待下去。此外，在你向他们汇报的时候，他们研究的关键内容正被装入一个屏蔽货箱。

首席研究员对救援表示感谢，但拒绝解释为什么一个 AI 核心会在他们的基地活动。你只反复得到了 "我承担全部责任" 的保证。

除了把他们都送回 Galatia 学院之外，这里也没有其他可以做的了。

但这事要办得谨慎点。

entries.en: You pause a moment, considering, then explain in clear, simple language that the AI should release the researchers to allow them to board the shuttle you will send. You state that you have an armed fleet in orbit and only wish to see the situation resolved in a way that ensures the safety of all parties.
entries.zh: 你思考片刻，然后用直白简单的语句向 AI 解释，对方应该释放研究人员并让他们登上你派过去的穿梭机。你还强调，现在有一整支全副武装的舰队停泊在轨道上，只希望此事能有一个皆大欢喜的结局。

entries.en:
received // captain $player.name // hyperspace-capable vessels $player.numShips // human credit amount $player.credits, flagship $player.flagshipName - negotiation asymmetric // agreed tactic: unpredictable escalation

conclusion: hostage life-support systems deactivated now: research staff, 14 count: cold // dark // alone, mind-death result [indeterminate period] "soon". demand manifest uploaded.

chronometer updating, captain $player.name.
entries.zh:
信息接收 // $player.name 舰长//可进行超空间航行的舰船数 $player.numShips //人类星币总额 $player.credits，旗舰 $player.flagshipName —— 不对称谈判 // 商定策略 : 不确定性提升

导致结果：关停人质维生系统，当前行动：研究人员，14人，对象计数：寒冷//黑暗//孤独，脑死亡[不确定时长] "即将"。谈判声明已上传。

倒计时更新，$player.name 舰长。

entries.en: You glance through the list of demands sent by the AI: A small transport shuttle, a few varieties of maintenance drones. $gaOp_supplies units of supplies, $gaOp_machinery units of heavy machinery, and $gaOp_fuel units of antimatter fuel. This type of shuttle can't make hyperspace, but there's no telling what this AI could do with this list of demands.
entries.zh: 你扫了一眼 AI 送过来的要求清单：一台小型运输穿梭机，几种不同的维护无人机。$gaOp_supplies 单位补给，$gaOp_machinery 单位重型机械，还有 $gaOp_fuel 单位反物质燃料。这种类型的穿梭机不能进入超空间，但不知道 AI 能用这个清单上的东西做什么。

entries.en:
The AI chides you.

INTERRUPT -- chronometer updating, captain $player.name emphasis!
option- empathy with human hostages and presumed status of offspring //
option- performative reminder to exert social pressure if empathy-incapable: demand manifest market value lower than Academician Alviss Sebestyen-Galatia Academy mission reward amount of $gaOp_reward credits //
option- if Luddic association: contemplate human-omega retribution response to multiple human mind-death?
entries.zh:
AI 谴责你。

//进程中断// - 倒计时更新，$player.name 舰长注意！
提议 - 同情人类人质，推演他们后代的情况 //
提议 - 当同情机能失效条件成立时，仔细考虑会被施加的社会压力 : 谈判条件价值低于 Alviss Sebestyen 院士 - Galatia 学院任务奖励总额 $gaOp_reward 星币 //
提议 - 当归属卢德条件成立时 : 考虑人类的欧米伽会对导致多个人类脑死亡降下何等报应？

o.en: Accept the terms and make arrangements for the exchange
o.zh: 接受提议并为交换做出安排

o.en: Close the comms and consider other options
o.zh: 关闭通讯并考虑其他选项

entries.en:
You order the pre-arranged shuttle packed with marines and weaponry. There's no telling what sort of electronic warfare the AI is capable of, so this operation will be run radio-silent, using only point-to-point tightbeam comms.

The shuttle descends, sending back only normal telemetry, the pilot speaking only routine call-and-response. After landing, all comms go quiet. Your sensors officer picks up a few flashes of light, a cloud of dust, some EM-spikes. There's no way to know exactly what is happening down there until it is all over.

Several minutes tick by on the operation timer. Audio on the pre-set comms frequency hisses static.
entries.zh:
你命令事先安排好的穿梭机满载了陆战队员和武器。由于不清楚 AI 核心有什么程度的电子战能力，因此这次行动将全程将无线电静默，只使用点对点集束激光通讯。

穿梭机下降，只发回了正常的遥测数据，驾驶员的回复也没什么异常。着陆后，所有的通讯都静默了。传感器技官发现了闪光、尘埃和一些电磁波峰。在这一切都结束之前，没有办法知道下面到底发生了什么。

行动计时器走过几分钟的时间后，预先设定的通讯频率上发出静电的嘶嘶声。

entries.en:
- Then crackles into life, "Tac-com, mission success. Bug secured. Fourteen civies e-bagged. No casualties. Civies got minor de-atmo injuries, one broken arm."

You personally oversee the transfer of the shielded cargo container carrying what remains of the AI core to a secure hold.

The lead researcher is thankful for rescue, but refuses to explain why an AI core was active in their base. Repeated statements of "I take full responsibility." is all you get.

There is nothing to do here but return the whole lot to the Galatia Academy.
entries.zh:
—— 随后在一阵杂讯噪声后，实况连接建立，"战术指挥部，任务成功，目标已经被控制，十四名平民已控制。队员没有伤亡。平民受了点轻伤，一人手臂骨折。"

你亲自监督将载有 AI 核心残骸的屏蔽货柜转移到一个安全的货舱。

首席研究员对救援行动表示感谢，但拒绝解释为什么 AI 核心会在他们的基地活动。你只反复得到了 "我承担全部责任" 的保证。

除了把所有东西都送回 Galatia 学院之外，这里也没有其他可以做的事了。

entries.en:
The research outpost is small, unfortified, and totally lacking countermeasures. But you know that if an AI like this is given a fair field of battle- well, best not to worry about that right now. A swift, thorough orbital strike is the only way to be sure. Those scientists were dead the moment that AI got loose. Perhaps even before; the moment they signed on to experiment on a living AI core.

Your stone-faced tactical officer prepares the attack pattern.
entries.zh:
这个研究前哨站很小，没有进行防御加固，也完全没有应对的反制措施。但是你清楚，如果像这样的 AI 能和你公平对抗的话 —— 现在最好不要去想这些。迅速、彻底的轨道打击是一锤定音的唯一方法。那些科学家在 AI 核心失控的那一瞬间起就已经死了。甚至可以再早些，推到他们签字同意在一个活着的 AI 核心上开展实验的那一刻起就已经死了。

你的战术军官面无表情地开始规划攻击着弹方案。

entries.en: The outpost is left a smoldering crater, just a pinprick of dull orange on the curve of the planet below you. Your decisive action is unimpeachable under the terms of the cycle 194 Treaty of Crom Cruach.
entries.zh: 前哨站消失得无影无踪，所在的位置只剩下一个冒烟的弹坑，你在轨道上注视着星球表面上剩下一点暗淡的橙色。根据星历 194 年的 Crom Cruach 条约，你的果断行动是无可指责的。

entries.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making a ground operation impossible.
entries.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法开展地面行动。

o.en: Scan the surface for the Galatia Academy research outpost
o.zh: 扫描地面，寻找 Galatia 学院研究前哨站

entries.en: You cut the transmission and order the bridge crew to power up combat systems. Your tactical officer reports the Pather ships are accelerating to attack speed - choosing a death in battle over slowly expiring in the void.
entries.zh: 你切断通讯链接并命令舰桥船员给战斗系统供能。你的战术军官报告左径舰船正加速至进攻航速 —— 他们选择战死，而非在虚空中缓慢死去。

entries.en: "The $gaProbe_department team needs the instrument package from a probe recovered from $gaProbe_starName and returned to the Academy for analysis."
entries.zh: "$gaProbe_department 的团队需要回收来自 $gaProbe_starName 星系里的一个探测器上的仪器套件并将其送回学院分析。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks shocked. "I... " $heOrShe swallows. With a dry throat; you can tell. "The package? I mean, what probe? Dammit."

The pretense drops under your withering stare. "It's ours fair and square," $heOrShe stammers, "Right of salvage. We all know how it works."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe看起来很震惊。"我..." $HeOrShe哽咽着。多么喉咙干哑的声音，令你印象深刻。"套件？我是说，什么探测器？该死。"

在你无情的凝视下，对方卸下了伪装。"这是为了我们的公平和公正，" $HeOrShe结巴的说到，"打捞权，这我们都懂的吧。"

o.en: Ask if the probe's transponder was active when this "salvage" took place
o.zh: 询问这次 "打捞" 发生的时候，探测器的应答器是否处于激活状态。

entries.en:
You explain that, as every scavenger knows, an uncrewed probe with an operational transponder is not legal salvage. And the Galatia Academy is a very well connected institution. And the Academy has been known to be rather litigious when it comes to their research equipment.

Guilt is written across the captain's face. "We just... we were going to-"
entries.zh:
你解释道，每一个拾荒者都知道，打捞带有应答器的无人探测器是不合法的行为。Galatia 学院的人脉很广。而且众所周知，当涉及到他们的研究设备时，学院可是相当纠缠不休的。

舰长的脸上写满了内疚。"我们只是...我们打算 ——"

o.en: Immediately transfer the instrument package to my ship.
o.zh: 请立即将仪器套件转移到我的船上。

entries.en:
"Yes, of course." $HeOrShe turns to an underling and says something that isn't quite picked up by the comms. "It'll be in-transit in just a moment, captain."

$HeOrShe mumbles an abashed farewell platitude and signs off just as your logistics officer reports an incoming cargo drone.
entries.zh:
"是的，当然。" $HeOrShe转向一个下属说了些什么，没有被通讯系统传过来。"它马上就会送到，舰长"

$HeOrShe有些困窘地低声说了些道别的话语，结束了谈话，正好你的后勤官报告说有一架接近的货运无人机。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks shocked. "I... " $heOrShe swallows. With a dry throat; you can tell. "The package? I mean, what probe? Dammit."

The pretense drops under your withering stare, replaced with defiance. "It's ours fair and square. Right of salvage. We all know how it works."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe看起来很震惊。"我..." $HeOrShe哽咽着。多么喉咙干哑的声音，令你印象深刻。"套件？我是说，什么探测器？该死。"

在你无情的凝视下，对方卸下了伪装，换上了顽固。"这是为了我们的公平和公正，打捞权，这我们都懂的吧。"

o.en: Ask if the probe's transponder was active when this "salvage" took place
o.zh: 询问当这次"打捞"发生的时候，探测器的应答器是否处于激活状态。

entries.en: "Well." $HeOrShe glances to one side, as if someone over there might have a better answer than the truth.
entries.zh: "很好。" $HeOrShe向一边瞥了一眼，似乎那边的人可能会知道比真相更好的答案。

o.en: Explain "how it works" to the scavenger
o.zh: 向拾荒者解释"道上的规矩"。

entries.en:
You explain that, as every scavenger knows, an uncrewed probe with an operational transponder is not legal salvage. And that the Galatia Academy is a very well connected institution. And that the Academy is extremely litigious when it comes to meddling with their research equipment.

Guilt is written across the captain's face. $HeOrShe stammers "We just... we were going to-"
entries.zh:
你解释道，每一个拾荒者都知道，打捞一个带应答器的无人探测器是不合法的。Galatia 学院的人脉很广。众所周知，当涉及到他们的研究设备时，该学院可是相当纠缠不休的。

舰长的脸上写满了内疚。"我们只是...我们打算 ——"

o.en: Immediately transfer the instrument package to my ship.
o.zh: 请立即将仪器套件转移到我的船上。

entries.en:
"Yes. Of course."

Defeated, $heOrShe turns to an underling and says something that isn't quite picked up by the comms. "It'll be in-transit in just a moment, captain."

$HeOrShe mumbles an abashed fare-well platitude and signs off just as your logistics officer reports an incoming cargo drone.
entries.zh:
"是的，当然。"

自认失败之后，$HeOrShe转向一个下属，说了几句没有完全被通讯器给捕捉进去的话。"货物片刻之后就会抵达，舰长。"

$HeOrShe喃喃地说了一句羞愧的告别语，然后签了字，这时你的后勤官报告说有一架货运无人机接近。

entries.en:
As you tell $himOrHer of your decision to deny them aid, you see the Pather's eyes harden. This is once more the familiar face of the Luddic Path.

"Then the only mercy left to us is the Creator's holy void," $heOrShe says bitterly. "May the stars guide you to... to Ludd's path. Someday." The Pather turns away and the comms link cuts to static.
entries.zh:
当你告诉$himOrHer你决定拒绝帮助他们，你看到了左径分子眼神变得硬朗。这次面孔更接近你所熟知 卢德左径。

"那么，留给我们唯一的仁慈只有造物主的神圣虚空。" $HeOrShe痛苦地说，"愿群星为你指明...卢德之路。总有一天。" 左径分子转过身去，通讯链接被切断至沉默。

entries.en:
You order your logistics officer to dispatch the requested fuel and supplies by cargo drone.

The Pather leader awkwardly thanks you, and says "May the stars show you Ludd's path, captain... $playerName. I will not forget this."

The comms link closes with a crackle of static.
entries.zh:
你命令后勤官用货运无人机运送所需的燃料和补给。

左径头领尴尬地感谢你："愿群星能为您指明卢德之径，$playerName 舰长...您的善意我将永远铭记。"

随后，通讯链接在一连串的静电声中关闭了。

entries.en:
"Wonderful! I've just confirmed that the $gaProbe_department team has received the instrument package and they're, oh. Um. I mean, they are very... happy? And um, they wanted me to... thank you for ensuring that it is almost completely intact."

Sebestyen has that look of trying to avoid telling the full story here. Probably best to let him off the hook with this one. He clears his throat to fill the growing silence as you maintain a strictly professional expression. "I've confirmed with the finance office and your payment should be released now."
OR
"Hello captain, I just got the news!" Sebestyen pauses a moment, as if expecting you to know exactly what he's talking about. "Um, from Logistics? They just received the instrument package from your $shipOrFleet. For $gaProbe_department?"

You nod to acknowledge the transfer of material as per your mission requirements.

"Um, good job. No, great job! The finance department should release payment immediately." He seems a little disappointed that you aren't as excited as he is, but he shrugs and soldiers on.
entries.zh:
"太好了！我刚刚确认 $gaProbe_department 已经收到了仪器套件，然后他们，噢，我是说，他们非常... 高兴？而且，呃，他们想让我... 感谢你确保它几乎完好无损。"

Sebestyen 的表情像是要极力避免在这里讲出个完整故事，所以先暂时等等就好。你俩沉默了一会后，他忽然清了清嗓子，配合着你一直保持着的扑克脸，将周遭的尴尬气氛一扫而空。"我已经和财务确认过了，你的酬金应该已经到账。"
OR
"你好，舰长，我刚刚得到消息！" Sebestyen 停顿了好一会，似乎在期待你能理解他所说的话。"呃... 应该是来自后勤部？他们刚刚收到了来自你$shipOrFleet送来的仪器套件。是给 $gaProbe_department 的？"

你点点头，承认你已按照任务要求将材料移送到位。

嗯，好，干得漂亮！财务部门应该立即支付报酬。" 他望着不为所动的你感到有些失望，但他立刻耸了耸肩，将之抛诸脑后。

entries.en: Sebestyen lights up as the comms channel opens, "Captain, hello! Logistics just received the instrument package, and even despite minor damage they've decided... um, is something the matter?"
entries.zh: 当通讯频道打开的那一刻，Sebestyen 的身影显现，"舰长，你好啊！后勤部门刚刚收到仪器套件，尽管有轻微的损坏，他们还是决定...嗯，有什么事吗？"

o.en: Calmly explain the concept of a hazard bonus
o.zh: 平静地解释危险津贴的概念

entries.en:
You explain that the instrument package in the probe turned out to be exceptionally dangerous and that, as a professional, you expect to be informed of the possibility of such danger. A hazard bonus added to mission payment seems like a fair compromise in this case, with the amount proportionate to the danger faced.

To emphasize your request, you tap a key and transmit documentation of the blasted derelicts surrounding the probe; and the spinning debris- if you look closely, is that... no, don't look too closely.

Academician Sebestyen looks queasy. "Um. Pardon me captain; just a moment."
entries.zh:
你解释说，探测器中的仪器套件原来是非常危险的，作为一个专业人士，你希望应该被告知这种危险存在的可能性。现在这种情况，公平起见应该在任务报酬中追加危险津贴，其数额与面临的危险应成正比。

为了强调你的要求，你按下了一个按键，传送了探测器周围被炸毁的残骸的资料，还有那些旋转的碎屑 —— 如果你仔细看，那是...不，别看得太仔细了。

Sebestyen 院士看起来有些恶心。"呃，对不起，舰长，请等一会。"

entries.en:
A few minutes later Sebestyen re-activates the on-hold comms line. Out of professional courtesy you stop drumming your fingers on the console.

"I'm very, very, very sorry about the whole situation, captain," he stammers, "I um, had a quick chat with finance and they've agreed to add a fifty percent, um, hazard bonus? To your payment. So that makes it $gaProbe_reward credits. I really, really hope you choose to continue to work with us."
entries.zh:
几分钟后，Sebestyen 重新启动了搁置的通讯线路，出于礼貌，你没有继续在控制台上敲打手指。

"我对整个情况感到非常，非常，非常抱歉，舰长，" 他结结巴巴地说，"我呃，和财务部稍微谈了一下，他们同意把报酬增加百分之五十，嗯，危险津贴？已经加到付款里头了，最终总报酬为 $gaProbe_reward 星币。我真心希望你能继续选择和我们合作。

entries.en: He clears his throat as you maintain a strictly professional expression, and continues "I've confirmed with the finance office and your payment should be released now. Great work!"
entries.zh: 他看着你板着严苛的脸，清了清嗓子，继续说道："我已经和财务处确认了，你的报酬现在就可以下发，干得不错！"

entries.en:
Sebestyen looks up from a datapad as the comms open. "Captain! Back so soon? I thought you were, ah- " He trails off at your look.

You explain the situation surrounding the probe's missing instrument package to the academician.

"Fascinating! Ooh, it's even better than I ever expected." He claps his hands once in excitement, "I can't wait to see what the $gaProbe_department group makes of this. Um. If it's okay I'll just forward this file to them now-"
entries.zh:
当通讯链接接通时，Sebestyen 从数据平板上抬头起来。"舰长！这么快就回来了吗？我还以为你一直在这呢，啊——" 他看着你的表情，话音渐弱。

你向院士解释从探测器上消失的仪器套件情况。

"真有意思！哦，比我预想的还要好，" 他兴奋得拍手说，"我已经迫不及待想看看 $gaProbe_department 院系对此有何看法了。嗯，如果可以的话，我现在就把这个文件转发给他们——"

entries.en:
"Oh yes, of course," he says. "Payment first, then the data transfer."

Sebestyen taps at a display and you note the ping of incoming funds on your personal TriPad.
entries.zh:
"哦，是的，当然，" 他说道，"首先是报酬，然后才是数据传输。"

Sebestyen 轻敲显示面板，你注意到你个人的 TriPad 上已经收到了资金到账的信号。

entries.en:
"Right right right, so this one says $gaProbe_department needs the instrument package from a probe recovered and returned. Hmm. They sent it to the $gaProbe_starName system to study, um, $gaProbe_celestialObjectNameWithType. It doesn't say here what it was for exactly, just that they need it back."

Sebestyen sees the look you're giving him. "I know, I know. You're not just here to fetch packages. But this really is important. It's cutting-edge science! It benefits us all!" He furrows his brow. "Somehow. Probably."

"So not the whole thing, just the instrument package right? It's small and won't take up any cargo space, I promise. And, good news here, the bursar has authorized a payment of $gaProbe_reward credits for recovery. So what do you think?"
entries.zh:
"好吧，好吧，好吧，所以说这次的任务简报讲到 $gaProbe_department 需要回收一个探测器上的仪器套件并将其送回来。嗯。他们将探测器送到了 $gaProbe_starName 星系内进行研究，呃，$gaProbe_celestialObjectNameWithType，这上面并没有说他们具体需要这玩意干些什么，只是他们需要把它搞回来。"

Sebestyen 看你脸色不对，"我知道，我知道。你来这不仅仅是为了取包裹，但这事真的很重要。这是最前沿的科学！这会让我们所有人受益！"然后皱了皱眉头。"天知道呢，也许吧"

"所以，并不是整个探测器，就只是仪器套件，可以吧？它很小，我保证，不会占用一丁点儿货舱，而且这还有一个好消息，财务主管已经授权支付回收行动 $gaProbe_reward 星币。这样，你觉得如何？"

entries.en:
"So." You generally expect a pleading look at the end of the spiel, not the start.

"You're a professional. A space captain. Highly skilled! Leadership, command, initiative! These are all essential, because it's dangerous out there. Even if, uh. Well, $gaProbe_department needs the instrument package from a probe sent to the $gaProbe_starName system recovered. It's $gaProbe_dist light-years away. And I know what you're thinking, you're not a packet-minder who fetches packages."

"But this is science!" Sebestyen slams his datapad down, surprising himself. "It's important! It can save the Sector from a fall into, into, some kind of new dark age!"

"Plus," he says, calming down now, "the bursar has authorized payment of $gaProbe_reward credits."
entries.zh:
"所以。"一般来说，你觉得这种恳求的眼神应该出现在连篇套话之后，而不是之前。

"你足够专业，一位星舰舰长，技术高超！领导能力，指挥能力，主动性！这些都是必不可少的，因为外面的世界充满危险。即使，呃。嗯，$gaProbe_department 需要回收那探测器上的仪器套件，它被送到了 $gaProbe_dist 光年外的 $gaProbe_starName 星系。我知道你在想啥，但你绝对不是单纯的一个回收工。"

"但这可是科学！" Sebestyen 猛地将数据平板拍在桌上，把他自己都吓了一跳，"这很重要！这能拯救整个星域免于陷入，陷入，某种新的黑暗时代！"

"此外，" 他冷静下来之后补充道，"财务主管已经授权支付行动报酬 $gaProbe_reward 星币。"

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches the probe, finding it exactly where Academician Sebestyen's specifications told you it would be.

"Small power source, active," your sensors officer reports. "No debris. Nav ping returns normal. Everything looks clean, $playerSirOrMadam."

The salvage team maneuvers to the probe and you watch the displays flare as a few clean cuts are made through the probe hull. Within minutes the job is done and the salvage team returned with the Academy's instrument package in tow.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了探测器，发现它正好就在 Sebestyen 院士告诉你的地方。

"发现活跃的小型能量源！" 你的传感器技官报告道。"没有碎片干扰，导航信号恢复正常，一切看起来都很干净，$playerSirOrMadam。"

打捞小组开始向探测器靠近，你透过显示器看到小组在探测器外壳上开出了几个整齐的切口。不到十分钟，打捞小组就完成了任务，并拖着学院的仪器套件开始返程。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches the probe, finding it exactly where Academician Sebestyen's mission specs told you it would be. What is odd, however, are the derelict ships and debris field surrounding the probe's position.

Sensor sweeps confirm that the derelicts are indeed derelict and that they are recent; well within the probe's mission operation period. You order all stations to alert, and order further active scans of the entire volume with all telemetry logged to the mission file.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了探测器，发现它正好就在 Sebestyen 院士告诉你的地方。然而，奇怪的是，探测器所在的位置环绕着废弃的舰船和碎片区。

传感器扫描证实了这些遗弃船确实被人抛弃于此，而且还是最近的事，正好处于探测器的任务活动周期内。你下令所有在岗人员保持警戒，并要求对整个区域进行更进一步的主动扫描，将所有的遥测数据都记录在任务文件中。

entries.en:
Reports come in from your bridge crew; sensors, tactical, and ops- a small fleet seems to have been torn apart by highly energetic discharge. Weapons fire? Maybe. But maybe not. Did two groups of scavengers fight over right-of-recovery? Did one fleet turn on itself? It does happen.

Did the probe defend itself with some Domain-era ultratech?

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your ops chief draws your attention from the reports spread across your display, "I recommend we pull the $shipOrFleet back to safe distance before EVA."
entries.zh:
舰桥组员相继汇总了简报。这份来自于传感器技官、战术军官和行动长官的报告指出，这个小型舰队似乎被高能放电给撕碎了。可能是武器开火造成的？不得而知。是两队不同的拾荒者为了争夺回收权而大打出手？还是同一支舰队的内斗？这些还真的有可能发生。

或是说探测器使用了某种 人之领 时代的超先进技术保护它自己呢？

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 行动长官将你的注意力从铺满报告的显示器中拉了回来，"我建议在舱外活动之前将舰队撤回到安全距离外。"

entries.en:
The salvage team maneuvers from a trio of carrier drones toward the probe, calling and confirming their approach as you follow their progress. Static crackles in waves across the feed displays on the bridge. Interference from the probe, probably.

"Report contact." The salvage team coordinates readings with your ops chief. Lines are secured to the probe's hull and equipment deployed.

"Torch ready, making the cut." Another wave of static.

Your ops chief exchanges an expressionless look with you as the salvage team breaches the probe casing.
entries.zh:
打捞小组操纵着三艘装载无人机向探测器机动，你追踪着他们的进展，在接近的过程中不断进行呼叫-确认应答。舰桥上的实时视频里不时传来一波波的静电杂讯。可能是来自探测器的干扰。

"报告完成接触。" 打捞小组成员协调和行动长官一同调整了仪器读数。线缆被固定到探测器的外壳上，相应设备完成了部署。

"焰炬准备就绪，开始进行切割。" 紧接着又一波的静电声。

当打捞小组破拆探测器外壳时，你和行动长官面无表情地对视了一眼。

entries.en:
Your sensors officer cuts in suddenly, "Advise ops, we see neutrino surge in target. Geometric rise, eight-k tick period."

Your ops chief zooms a display into a holo of the instrument package, panning rapidly through a series of highlighted subsystems and annotated conduits. The chief overrides comms to give a precise set of technical instructions in short authoritative barks, receiving confirms as each step is carried out. "Execute."

The comms roar with white noise, and the over-shoulder display feed flares to static.
entries.zh:
你的传感器技官突然插话，"行动小组注意，我们这儿看到目标的中微子辐射激增。几何增长，周期八千帧。"

行动长官将仪器组件的全息影像在显示器中放大，迅速翻阅着一系列高亮显示出的子系统和标记注释过的管线。随后行动长官绕过流程直接用通讯器联络，用不容置疑的简要口令下达了一套精确的技术指令，并在每一个步骤后都要求对方确认收到。"执行。"

通讯器忽然呼啸起白噪，肩载摄像头传回的画面被闪烁的静电雪花充斥。

entries.en:
The noise recedes. "Report confirm."

The over-shoulder display feed re-focuses on the salvage team amid a small cloud of expanding volatiles. One figure is applying sealant to another as a damaged cutting torch drifts on an equipment line. "Report blue-five minor suit damage. Integrity good."

The after-action report draws an unclear picture. The instrument package was building up some kind of energy discharge only to be interrupted when your salvors cut off main power. Damage was minimal. Nonetheless, you consider that the Galatia Academy could have given some - or indeed any - warning of this possibility. You make a note to bring up the matter of a hazard bonus with Academician Sebestyen.
entries.zh:
噪音退去，"报告确认。"

肩载工作摄像头的画面重新聚焦在一小团膨胀的挥发物云上。一个人正在给另一个人涂密封剂，而一个损坏的焰炬在设备线上漂浮着，"报告，蓝队五号队员的服具轻微损坏。密闭性良好。"

行动后的报告描绘了一幅不明确的画面。仪器套件正在预备进行某种能量释放，但在你的打捞小组切断主电源时被打断。几乎没有造成实际损失。尽管如此，你认为 Galatia 学院本可以对这种可能性发出一些 —— 或者说是任何 —— 警告。你决定要向 Sebestyen 院士要求危险津贴。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches the probe, finding it roughly where Sebestyen's specifications told you it should be.

"No power source detected. Mass lower than expected. No debris. Nav ping- no response," your sensors officer reports. "Probe hull looks intact, captain."

The salvage team maneuvers toward the probe and you watch the displays flare as a few clean cuts open the casing. Confused chatter fills the comms.

"Zero that loose talk," barks your ops chief. "EVA team lead, report!"
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了探测器，发现它基本上就在院长 Sebestyen 任务说明里告诉你的地方。

"侦测不到任何活动的能量源，探测器重量低于预期，没有碎片残骸。导航信号 —— 无响应，" 你的传感器技官报告道。"探测器船体看起来完好无损，舰长。"

打捞小组向着探测器机动，你透过频闪的显示器看到小队在探测器外壳上开出了几个整齐的切口并打开外壳，通讯器里充斥着混乱的交谈声。

"少说废话，" 行动长官吼道。"舱外活动小队长，报告！"

entries.en:
Over comms, the report comes in, "It's empty, Chief. Conduits sheared off cleanly. No instrument package. Nothing."

Later, after the salvage team returns, you review their findings with your bridge crew. It appears as though a perfect sphere has been scooped from the center of the probe, taking most of the Galatia Academy's precious instrument package with it.

Theories are proposed. Black hole. Aliens; this prompts a round of polite laughter. Your tech officer steps up and explains that it is theoretically possible to bulk phase-shift matter at a distance, though the process was never considered economical even in the later cycles of the Domain. Your operations chief looks skeptical of the entire notion.
entries.zh:
报告从通讯器中传来，"是空的，长官，导管都被切割得很干净，没有找到仪器套件。这里什么都没有。"

过了一会儿，打捞小组开始返回。你和舰桥船员一起检查他们的发现，看起来好像是探测器的中心被挖走了一个完美的球体，带走了大部分 Galatia 学院的珍贵仪器套件。

不同的推测被一个个提了出来。是黑洞干的？还是外星人？提到外星生物的时候大家都礼貌地笑了起来。你的技术军官站上前来提出了个看法，说在理论上的确有可能对物质进行大批量远距离相位转移，不过这种操作即使在 人之领 时代的末期也并不经济实用。而你的行动长官则还在对套件消失这整件事本身抱着将信将疑的态度。

entries.en: Whatever did this, it means you don't have an instrument package to return to the Galatia Academy. You order all telemetry and holo-feed from the encounter attached to the encrypted mission file. The academicians love data, the more the better. This should be enough to demonstrate that you did your job to the letter. Maybe the mystery at the heart of it will distract them long enough for you to get paid.
entries.zh: 无论如何，这意味着你没有能送回 Galatia 学院的仪器套件。你下令将这次遭遇的所有遥测数据和全息影像资料附在加密的任务文件中。学者们喜欢数据，越多越好。这应该足以证明你已经尽职尽责了。也许其中的奥秘会分散他们的注意力，也许还够让你得到报酬。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches the probe, finding it exactly where Academician Sebestyen's specifications told you it would be.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your sensors officer's tone tells you that it is not good news, "The probe shell is empty. However..."

The main bridge display lights up, showing temperature readings on cut-marks; a small spray of debris whose trajectory can be reversed to a point; slowly dissipating clouds of close-maneuvering propellant. The story these signs tell is clear: a scavenger was here, and very recently.

Your nav officer speaks up, "$PlayerSirOrMadam, if we burn now for the closest jump-point, we might be able to catch them."
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了探测器，发现它正好就在 Sebestyen 院士告诉你的地方。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，" 传感器技官的语气告诉你这不会是好消息，"探测器内部是空的，但..."

主舰桥的显示器亮起，显示出探测器上切口的温度读数，一小团喷出的碎片云的轨迹可以被逆向至一个点；缓慢消散的近距离机动推进剂云。所有的迹象表明的结论很明确，有拾荒者曾经在这，而且前脚刚走。

你的领航军官说道，"$PlayerSirOrMadam，如果我们现在就全速前进，我们也许能在最近的跳跃点赶上他们。"

entries.en:
In the spirit of the sacred peace with which they approach, you ask the Pather if they could use fuel and supplies to aid their survival.

$HeOrShe is confused by your charity, and you see a look of hostility on $hisOrHer face for a moment. But it breaks into genuine gratitude. "We- yes, we would accept your aid in sacred peace. If you could spare $patherFuel units of fuel and $patherSupplies units of supplies, it would allow us to return to... to home."
entries.zh:
本着他们追求神圣的和平精神，你询问这帮左径分子，你给予的燃料和补给能否帮助他们活下来。

$HeOrShe被你的施舍搞糊涂了，有那么一会儿你看到$HeOrShe脸上满是敌意的表情，但那最终变成了真挚的感激。"我们 —— 是的，以神圣和平之名愿意接受你的帮助。如果你能提供 $patherFuel 单位燃料和 $patherSupplies 单位补给，这将能让我们...回家。"

o.en: Give them the supplies and fuel

entries.en: You have $player.fuel fuel and $player.supplies supplies.
entries.zh: 你有 $player.fuel 单位燃料和 $player.supplies 单位补给。

entries.en: You only have $player.fuel fuel and $player.supplies supplies - not enough to provide meaningful help.
entries.zh: 你只有 $player.fuel 单位燃料和 $player.supplies 单位补给，并不足以提供有意义的帮助。

o.en: Ask about the instrument package recovery
o.zh: 询问有关回收仪器套件相关事项

entries.en:
The comms channel buzzes and crackles to reveal the Pather commander. $HeOrShe is not quite what you expected; it is not burning zeal you see in their eyes, but something else.

"Captain. By the stars, I come to you on the path of peace." $HisOrHer voice rasps with what you recognize as vacuum damage.

"Beware yon spore of Moloch. Some evil science is at work here in that probe, it has unleashed power beyond... beyond all reckoning. It took many of my fellow walkers. Spilled their life into the holy void. I warn you now, leave this cursed place."
entries.zh:
充满了杂讯和卡顿的通讯频道解析出了左径舰长影像。$HeOrShe和你想象中的不太一样，你在他们眼中看到的不是燃烧的狂热，而是别的什么东西。

"舰长。群星在上，是和平之道途引领着我来到你身边。" $HeOrShe的声音嘶哑，你听得出来是在真空里受了伤。

"你要当心恶魔摩洛克之源。某些邪科学正在那个探测器里运作，它释放出力量超越...远超所有末日审判之力。它带走了我许多同路人。他们的生命被抛洒到了神圣的虚空之中。我现在警告你，离开这个被诅咒的地方。"

o.en: Thank them for the warning and close comms
o.zh: 感谢他们的警告并关闭通讯

o.en: Offer fuel and supplies to the crippled Pather fleet
o.zh: 为瘫痪的左径舰队提供燃料和补给

o.en: Attack now, while they are weakened
o.zh: 趁现在他们虚弱，发动进攻

entries.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, preventing you from sending an EVA team to examine the probe.
entries.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，阻止了你派出舱外活动小组去检查探测器。

entries.en:
The comms link crackles with static, then clears to an image of the scavenger captain.

"Greetings fellow starfarer," $heOrShe says. "What brings you out here? Can't say we've found much worth salvaging lately, ha-ha."
entries.zh:
通讯链接伴随着静电的噼啪声，随后清晰的显示出拾荒者舰长的影像。

"你好，同道的远行者。" $HeOrShe说，"是什么风把你吹这来了？我们最近可没有发现什么值得打捞的东西，哈-哈。"

o.zh: 与他们就探测器进行对峙。

o.en: I'm sorry to hear it. Burn bright.
o.zh: 我很抱歉听到这些。祝航行无阻。

entries.en:
The comms link crackles with static, then clears to an image of the scavenger captain.

"Greetings fellow starfarer," $heOrShe says. "What brings you out here? Can't say we've found much worth salvaging lately, ha-ha."

Something seems a little off. It doesn't feel like pirates this time. What is it?
entries.zh:
通讯链接伴随着静电的噼啪声，随后清晰的显示出拾荒者舰长的图像。

"你好，同道的远行者。" $HeOrShe说，"是什么风把你吹这来了？我们最近可没有发现什么值得打捞的东西，哈-哈。"

你察觉到有什么不对劲。这次看起来并不像是海盗。这会是什么？

o.en: Probably nothing. Exchange pleasantries and sign off.
o.zh: 可能无关紧要。寒暄后关闭通讯链接。

o.en: Request that they transfer the probe's instrument package to you. Immediately.
o.zh: 要求他们立刻把探测器仪器套件转移给你。

entries.en: Your sensors officer reports that an ejected cargo pod floating in a spray of post-battle debris contains a hulless instrument chassis that matches the specs from the Galatia Academy hyperspace research group which Coureuse was a part of.
entries.zh: 你的传感器技官报告道，一个弹射出来的货舱漂浮在战后碎片的包围中，其中包含有一个无外壳的仪器底盘，与 Galatia 学院的超空间研究小组提供的说明书中的一部分吻合，而 Coureuse 曾是这个小组的成员。

entries.en:
You inquire about Kelise Astraia. The administrator's smile glows slightly less wide and a touch of confusion grows on $hisOrHer face. "A former employee you say? Well, the Tri-Tachyon Corporation has top-line privacy guidelines when it comes to discussion of human assets." $HisOrHer gaze drifts to the side, "However... "

This privacy guideline sounds flexible. $HeOrShe seems to be waiting for you to make an offer.
entries.zh:
你询问了有关 Kelise Astraia 的问题。管理员的笑容不那么灿烂了，$hisOrHer的脸上出现了一丝困惑。"你是说以前的一位雇员？在讨论人力资源时，公司有最高的隐私准则。" $hisOrHer的目光移到一边，"然而..."

你想起来$heOrShe手边放着的显示屏上有着你净资产的数据，不难推测$heOrShe似乎在等你出价，这么看来那个所谓的 "隐私准则" 十分的灵活。

o.en: We're just networking, right? Let me add you on Tri-link...
o.zh: 这只是普通的商业合作，不是吗？让我在 TriLink 上加一下你...

o.en: Perhaps a generous finder's fee would smooth things along?
o.zh: 也许一些慷慨的小费会让事情顺利些？

o.en: Make an excuse and close the comm link
o.zh: 找个借口关闭通讯链接

entries.en:
You activate your personal datapad and load up Tri-Tachyon's insipid professional networking service. While making light small-talk with $personName, you find $hisOrHer public profile and add $himOrHer as a connection, swiftly assigning the maximum level endorsement across all notable skills.

"Oh captain, how very kind of you," says $personName, "Now that we're professionally acquainted, I'd be more than willing to perform a quick consultation in the matter of the former employee of interest... though my fees are not trivial."

Bribery it is, then.
entries.zh:
你激活了你的个人数据平板，并进入了速子科技乏味的专业服务网络。当你和 $personName 进行闲聊时，你找到了$hisOrHer的公共档案，将$himOrHer添加为了合作伙伴，并将能找到的评级全都打到了最高级别。

"喔，舰长，您真是太慷慨了，" $personName 说，"既然我们已经是官方合作伙伴了，我非常愿意就您感兴趣的前雇员问题提供快速咨询服务...虽然我的费用并不低。"

说得好听，其实这就是贿赂，你俩心知肚明。

o.en: Of course. And this fee would come to... ?
Make an excuse and close the comm link
o.zh: 找个借口关闭通讯链接

entries.en: "$gaPZ_culannBribe credits. Upfront, to my account via, ah, this UID," the administrator says as your datapad pings softly to alert you of the receipt of payment information. $personName smiles brightly again and awaits your response.
entries.zh: "$gaPZ_culannBribe 星币，通过这个 UID 预付到我的账户。" 当你的数据平板发出轻柔的响声提醒你收到付款所需要的账户信息时，管理员说道。$personName 恢复了灿烂的笑容，等待你的回复。

o.en: All things considered, you don't think...  (negotiate)
o.zh: 从各方面考虑，你不会认为... (讨价还价)

o.en: Make some excuse and close the comm link
o.zh: 找个借口关闭通讯链接

entries.en:
"Wonderful," says the administrator as you see $hisOrHer eyes read the transfer confirmation. "Let me just pull up the file on Kelise Astraia... ah, here it is," $heOrShe says with suspiciously little delay.

A personnel file overlays your comms-link, displaying details of the life and employment of Kelise Astraia.

"Not an ideal employee, mmm," says $name, reading the file. "Insubordination. Sloppy infosec. Failure to consistently engage with company morale programs," $heOrShe glances back at you, gauging your interest. "But that's not what you're looking for, is it, captain. You want to find her. I am correct, yes?"
