The file scrolls by quickly, manipulated by a combination of the administrator's hands flying over a virtual interface and subtle use of cyberaugs.
entries.zh:
"太棒了。" 当你看到$hisOrHer的眼睛读着转账确认时，这位管理员说，"让我调出 Kelise Astraia 的档案...啊，在这儿。" $heOrShe的话语带着一瞬的迟疑。

一份人事档案盖在了你的通讯画面上，显示着 Kelise Astraia 的生活和工作细节。

"这可不是一个理想的员工，嗯。" $name 读着文件说，"不服从指令，信息安全工作草率。未能持续参与公司的激励计划。" $heOrShe回头看了你一眼，猜测着你的兴趣点，"但这份文件不是您要找的东西，舰长，你想找到她本人，对吧？"

文件滚动得很快，管理员的手在虚拟界面上飞舞，并巧妙地掩盖了浏览的踪迹。

entries.en: $personName cuts you off before you can finish even an attempt to negotiate, "My fee structure is quite generous, captain, and offered with our special professional connection in mind." The smile remains, but $hisOrHer eyes tell you that you're skirting close to an event horizon.
entries.zh: $personName 在你还没来得及完整地说出谈判开场白之前就打断了你："舰长，我的收费已经相当低廉了，这是考虑到我们特殊的商业合作关系而做出的折扣。" 笑容依旧，但$hisOrHer的眼睛告诉你，应该要避开这个话题黑洞。

o.en: Make some excuse and close the comm link
o.zh: 找个借口关闭通讯链接

entries.en:
"Judging by the credits transfers from 'unknown source', I would suppose that employee 379490509 was contracting on the side for a black project from elsewhere in the Company. Not one of mine. Hm." This seems to annoy the administrator. "If I had to guess, that's why she resigned so suddenly and- oh, look at this."

A noisy holo from a navigation sat pops up showing a weathered Venture-class hull. "It's called the 'Hamatsu'. Surveys, scavenging, ... other jobs. Astraia booked the entire ship and requested some kind of modification installed." The administrator is frowning now, an unusual expression for $himOrHer. "No details. I'll have to have a word with the portmaster for allowing this to proceed without filing a copy with the Company."
entries.zh:
"从 '未知来源' 的星币转移来看，我认为这位 379490509 号员工加入了公司在其它地方的机密项目。不在我的辖区内，啧。" 这似乎惹恼了管理员，"如果要我猜的话，这就是她突然辞职的原因 —— 哦，来看看这个。"

一幅似乎是在导航信标的基座上摄制的布满噪点的全息图像弹了出来，图像上是一艘饱经风霜的 历险-级 星舰。"它叫做 'Hamatsu' 号。负责过探索，拾荒...以及许多其它工作。Astraia 预订了这艘船，并要求进行一些改装。" 管理员现在皱着眉头，这对$himOrHer来说是很不寻常的表情，"没有更多细节了。我得和港务长谈一谈，不知道谁允许在不向公司提交一份材料的情况下就为此船放行的。"

entries.en:
"The Hamatsu finished modifications then made to leave the Hybrasil system but turned its transponder off before jumping out." $HeOrShe considers this for a moment, then pages the file ahead.

"Ah. Owned by Callisto Ibrahim." $heOrShe looks up at you, "Heard of her? No? Bit of a reputation. A few junior partners in the Company hired her for a job a while back. She falsified credentials but delivered admirably in the end. She's now operating a few," a derisive sniff, "small fleets out of Agreus in the Arcadia system."

The administrator looks at you now, unsmiling. "If I were you and I wanted to find Kelise Astraia, I would talk to Ibrahim. She'll do business." A pause, "Like we are."
entries.zh:
"Hamatsu 号完成改装后，就启程离开 Hybrasil 星系，但在跳跃前就关闭了应答器。" $heOrShe思考了一会儿，然后继续翻动文件。

"啊。这是 Callisto Ibrahim 的船。" $heOrShe抬头看着你，"你听说过她吗？没有？她以前其实还挺有名的。毕竟公司的几个下级合伙人曾雇过她，虽然她是通过伪造证书才拿到那份工作，但令人钦佩的是，她最后还是出色的完成了任务。现在她在 Arcadia 星系里的 Agreus 运营着..." $heOrShe突然露出了一副嗤之以鼻的表情，"几支小舰队。"

管理员抬头看着你，不苟言笑的说道："如果我是你，想找到 Kelise Astraia 的话，我会先和 Ibrahim 谈谈。我想她不会拒绝生意的，就像我们一样。"

entries.en:
"And now you have your lead, so I believe I have earned my fee. I thank you for bringing this little loose end to my attention. Now I have some calls to make." $HeOrShe smiles again at you, entirely falsely. "You never know who you can trust."

"Pleasure doing business, captain. Profitable ventures to you." And with that, $heOrShe closes the comms.
entries.zh:
"现在你有了线索，所以我相信我的报酬是应得的。我很感谢你把这件小事告诉我，现在我得打几个电话。" $heOrShe又对你笑了，那笑容很虚伪，"你永远不知道自己可以相信谁。"

"很高兴做成这笔生意，舰长。我想这是一次对你有利的风险投资。" 说完，$heOrShe关闭了通讯。

entries.en: "Exactly!" Arroyo grins, and says "It'll be fun."
entries.zh: "完全正确！" Arroyo 笑道，"这会很有趣的。"

entries.en: "Yes, obviously," Arroyo rolls his eyes.
entries.zh: "对啊，很显然。" Arroyo 翻了翻白眼。

entries.en: "Vindication." Arroyo holds his hands palms up, eyebrows raised, waiting for you to understand his scheme. After a moment, he shakes his head and sighs.
entries.zh: "当然是为自己辩护。" Arroyo 抬了抬手，眉毛扬起，等着看你什么时候才能认识到这是他的阴谋。过了一会儿，他摇摇头并叹了口气。

entries.en: "Look- they're bad fakes. I spoofed a contract ID and bid low on this junk. Didn't even send the final payment. Hegemony spies and Tri-Tachyon Partner Relations are already sniffing after me so if it looks like a junior-exec smelled blood and was coming after my operation by manufacturing dirt, well, it raises some questions about the veracity of the entire accusation. Doesn't matter how flimsy; my PR team gets an angle to work. You see?"
entries.zh: "听着 —— 这些都是假消息。我伪造了合同 ID，然后低价买回这个垃圾，甚至连尾款都没有付。现在 霸主 间谍和 速子科技 公关已经盯上我了。但是，如果这整件事看起来就只是...某个下级主管像闻到血的秃鹫一般，为了升职加薪，试图弄虚作假来将我抓捕归案，那么整件事就变得有些可疑了。然后，哪怕这事只有一丁点令人生疑，我的公关团队也总能找到一个突破口...你明白没？"

o.en: No. But I'll do it if you want.
o.zh: 完全不懂，但如果你需要，我会帮你这个忙的。
这看起来不太像能成功的样子。

entries.en: "Wonderful. Can't wait to see who you choose."
entries.zh: "太棒了，我等不及想看看你会把它丢给谁了。"

entries.en: "Perfect. Doesn't matter what you think, as long as it's messy."
entries.zh: "也好。你怎么想不重要，只要你能把这件事搞乱就行。"

entries.en: "Doesn't matter. I'm creating an information environment my people can work with, so the messier, the better."
entries.zh: "没事的，我正在把这事弄成一个我的员工可以处理的局面，所以它越乱越好。"

entries.en:
"$playername. Why are you still here? Follow Kelise Astraia, follow the Hamatsu. Find out what Tri-Tachyon was up to at this 'Alpha Site' then return here," Baird removes her spectacles in an uncharacteristic display.

"Understand, captain, that you are not a subtle implement. You are gaining something of a reputation. I concede that your abilities and accomplishments are impressive."
entries.zh:
"$playername，你怎么还在这里？去追查 Kelise Astraia，追查 Hamatsu 号。去弄明白速子科技到底在 '阿尔法研究站' 做了什么，然后再回来。" 有些一反常态地，Baird 摘下了她的眼镜。

"舰长，你要明白，你不再是一个没什么存在感的工具人了。你要继续做些有出息的事才能出人头地。就你的能力和成就而言，我觉得你有这个能力。"

entries.en:
She leans forward, her eyes falling into shadow, "And you've impressed many of the powerful factions of the Sector. In your wake there follows a small army of spies, informants, and opportunists. They will catch up to you."

Provost Baird leans back again, and replaces her spectacles, "Grand designs are coming together, captain. We will change the world."
entries.zh:
她向前倾着身子，眼眶被阴影覆盖："你给星域中许多强大的势力留下了深刻的印象。在你身后，有一小群间谍、线人和机会主义者，随时准备着抓住你。"

Baird 院长又向后靠了靠，把眼镜放回原处："伟大的计划正在酝酿，舰长，我们将会改变世界。"

entries.en:
"Here, here, and here. Fusion scorch. Says heavy lifters, a big operation. But why? There's no settlement, no facilities, no mining. Except-" they pull up the visualization of a graduated radar scan of the vast slope of scree adjacent to the lifter-scorch, "Surface is sharp fragments, even distribution gradient. Suggests intentional demolition debris, and recent. And," with a smile, "-then it gets good."

The view is overlaid with a deep radar scan. The shapes are blurry, but there are distinct rectilinear forms beneath the debris.

Your sensors officer sits back, and not without a little pride says "I'd say someone's hiding something, captain."
entries.zh:
"这里，这里，还有这里，熔融和烧焦的痕迹。说明这里曾有大型的运输机起降，一场规模庞大的行动。但这是为了什么？这里没有定居点，没有工业基地，也没有采矿设施。除了 —— " 一张雷达扫描图随之被调出，图上显示了靠近烧焦地点的巨大碎石斜坡，"表面是锋利的碎片，甚至分布梯度也很均匀，这些都意味着这玩意儿是被有意设置的拆迁废墟，而且是最近才设置的。再有这个" 对方带着一丝微笑，"—— 接下来才精彩。"

眼前的视图被深层雷达扫描图覆盖。形状模糊，但你能看出废墟下面有明显的直线形状 —— 似乎是什么通道。

你的传感器技官坐在后面，略带得意地说，"我觉得有人在隐瞒什么，舰长。"

entries.en:
You order the hidden structures investigated. Deep scans are run, and salvor teams along with heavy equipment are shuttled to the surface, overseen by your ops chief.

The digging is easy; deep scans from orbit direct the work toward the most promising sites. Salvage crews burrow through the loose material, shoring up the working face with temporary structural foam.
entries.zh:
你下令调查隐藏的设施。进行了精确的深度扫描后，打捞小组在行动长官的监督下携带重型设备前往地面。

挖掘工作进行的很顺利，因为来自舰队的深度扫描已经将工作引向了最有希望的地点。打捞员在松散的废墟中挖洞，用临时结构泡沫支撑工作面以防止出现坍塌。

entries.en: After significant progress is made, your ops chief gives you an overview of the situation: whoever covered this place up, they were thorough. Most of what's left are concrete foundations and paving made from local material, a few embedded foametal slabs with sheared-off anchor-points, and a smattering of garbage in small cracks and rifts.
entries.zh: 在取得重大进展后，行动长官向你概述了一下情况：不管是谁掩埋了这个地方，他们都做得很彻底。余下的大部分东西都是由当地材料制成的混凝土地基和铺砌材料，一些嵌有被剪断锚点的泡沫金属板，以及在堆砌在裂缝里的零星垃圾。

entries.en:
"We can tell it's mostly of recent make- talking decades, not centuries. Probably younger," your ops chief explains, waving a four-fingered hand through the display holo. "You can see we excavated the structure with the density anomalies here," they give a bright spot in the display a solid jab, "-looks like a few cheap crawler-drones were left to collect and dump rubbish in a slag-pit. Then they drove themselves in before setting off the demo-charges on the cliff face."

Your ops chief steps back and nods respectfully, "Pro cleanup. No stray datacores, no shiny baubles. Rarely see anyone bother putting in this much effort. S'all I've got, captain."

Your ops chief gives a gruff salute and leaves you to ponder the diagram of the hidden base wormed now with several barren salvage tunnels.

Tri-Tachyon. They can afford to be thorough when they want to be, and they are when it matters.
entries.zh:
"我们可以看出来，这主要是最近一段时间被弄出来的 —— 差不多几十年，没几百年那么久。也可能还更接近现在些。" 你的行动长官隔着全息显示向你一边挥舞着只剩四个指头的手一边说明，"你可以看到我们在这里挖掘出了密度异常的结构..." 对方用力戳了戳显示界面上的一个亮点，"那看起来应该是留了几只便宜的爬行机器人把垃圾都收集起来倒进了熔渣坑里，然后它们把自己也倒了进去并引爆了炸弹。"

行动长官一边回顾细节，一边点头佩服对手："清理得很专业，没有散落的数据核心，没有闪闪发光的小玩意，很少有人会下功夫干得这么彻底。我搞清楚的事情就这么多了，舰长。"

说完这些，行动长官显得有些不甘地向你敬了个礼，然后只留你一个人盯着隐藏基地的示意图沉思。现在虽然已经钻穿了好几个打捞通道进去了，但全都一无所获。

速子科技。只要他们想做事的话，他们完全有能力把事情做彻底。而且如果事关重要的话，他们绝对会出手去做。

entries.en: "Captain, there's something you should see." Your sensors officer calls attention to their display, zoomed to a portion of the planet's surface.
entries.zh: "舰长，这里有些东西你或许想要看看。" 你的传感器技官将你的注意力引到了他的面前的显示屏上，画面已经聚焦到了行星表面上的一个地点。

o.en: See what your sensors officer has found
o.zh: 看看你的传感器技官找到了什么

entries.en:
She narrows her eyes.

"Is this about Kelise Astraia? It is, isn't it."
entries.zh:
她眯起眼睛。

"你是来找 Kelise Astraia 的，对吧？"

entries.en:
"Don't even get me started." Ibrahim seethes, "She chartered my ship for some hush-hush salvage operation. Supposedly," she stresses that word with disbelief, "And she comes in demanding highly unusual modifications with potentially dangerous hyperdrive field interactions!"

"Well, I got her to throw in a fair chunk of hazard pay, a rush fee, and a bit more to keep quiet about it like she wanted."
entries.zh:
"提到这事我就来气。" Ibrahim 生气地说，"她包下我的船去搞什么秘密打捞行动。据说是这样，" 她把这个词拉得老长，摆明了信不过她，"结果呢？她要求对舰船进行可能导致超空间驱动场冲突的古怪改装！"

"所以我让她付了一大笔危险津贴，一笔加急费用，还有一笔封口费 —— 按她的要求。"

entries.en:
"Yeah," she scowls, "Because disappearing with my favorite starship is a pretty big breach of contract. I'll tell whoever I damn well please. For all I know she ran my Hamatsu into a black hole in some Tri-Tachyon boondoggle search for a more efficient drive field to license back to us poor spacers just trying to get by."

Ibrahim takes a couple deep breaths, then turns to you, a little calmer. "What's your interest in all this?"
entries.zh:
"是啊，" 她皱着眉头，"因为我觉得带着我最喜欢的星舰玩失踪是相当严重的违约行为，所以我想跟谁说就跟谁说。据我所知，她把我的 Hamatsu 号开进了一个黑洞，就为了某种 速子科技 的无聊探索任务。据说那是为了寻找一个更有效的驱动场，以便让我们这些只是想谋生的可怜太空船员去申请使用他们的专利，然后狠狠地赚上一笔。"

Ibrahim 做了几次深呼吸，然后看向你，稍微冷静了下来："你呢？你为什么会对这些事感兴趣？"

o.en: I need to find out where Kelise Astraia went.
o.zh: 我得知道 Kelise Astraia 去哪了。

entries.en:
"I'll tell you what; I want to find her too. There'll be something in it for you if you can get me anything to go on. I'd go looking myself, but," Ibrahim waves a hand through the air; business, bureaucracy, other commitments.

"Better yet, find the Hamatsu and bring it back to me," she closes her eyes, looking pained, "in one piece, I hope. I've got a lot of memories in that old piece of space-junk."

"Let me get you started. My captain on the Hamatsu sent an encrypted flight plan before they left spacedock, after finishing the modifications." She taps at a desk console.
entries.zh:
"我会告诉你详细情况的，毕竟我也想找到她。我可以给你提供线索，但你得帮我个忙。我原本想亲自前往，但是，" Ibrahim 在空中挥挥手，生意，政治，或是其他什么承诺束缚了她。

"现在情况好多了，至少有人可以帮我了。找到 Hamatsu 号，然后把它带回来给我。"她闭上了眼睛，看起来很痛苦，"希望它完好无损，毕竟我在那艘老旧的太空垃圾里留下了很多回忆。"

"让我们开始吧。Hamatsu 号的舰长在完成舰船改装离开太空船坞之前，向我发送了一份加密的航行计划。" 她敲了敲桌上的控制台。

entries.en:
A hyperspace nav overlay appears, "Hybrasil is here. The Hamatsu fueled up and planned to travel to $gaPZ_relaySystem. Whether they made it, I don't know. Outer Fringe, no hypercomm coverage. They could have changed course. That rad-addled Tri-Tach engineer was tight-lipped about her intentions and ensured that the contract had my captain bound to follow changes in flight plan by her order."

Ibrahim swipes the display away, and it is replaced by a schematic of the Hamatsu, with certain additions to the drive field inductors highlighted. "These are the modifications she had done. If we're agreed that you'll find the Hamatsu for me, captain... "

She looks to you, waiting for an answer.
entries.zh:
一份超空间导航数据出现了："Hybrasil 星系在这里，Hamatsu 号已经加满了燃料，计划前往 $gaPZ_relaySystem。我不知道他们是否去了那里，因为那是边缘星区，没有通讯网络覆盖。他们可能中途改变了路线。那个脑袋像被辐射烤坏了的速子工程师对她的意图守口如瓶，但我们的合同确保了舰长必须按照她的命令，随时进行航行计划的变更。"

Ibrahim 将显示出的地图移走，取而代之的是 Hamatsu 号的示意图，驱动场感应器上做出的改动已经被高亮标记了出来。"这些就是她所做的改装。帮我找回 Hamatsu 号，舰长，拜托了..."

她看着你，等着你的回答。

entries.en: Ibrahim nods, frowning. "It would mean a lot."
entries.zh: Ibrahim 点点头，皱着眉头："这对我而言意义重大。"

entries.en: Ibrahim nods. "I would not expect it. I only ask that you try."
entries.zh: Ibrahim 点点头："我没抱什么期待，只是希望你能试一试。"

entries.en: Ibrahim looks at you, frowning. After what feels like a half minute of thought, she finally sighs and says "I'll take a chance with you, captain. It's not like any faction authorities are going to help me with this one."
entries.zh: Ibrahim 皱着眉头看着你，大概想了半分钟后，她终于叹了口气，说："我愿意在你身上赌一把，舰长，毕竟没有谁愿意帮我了。"

entries.en:
Ibrahim shakes her head, "I figured, Tri-Tachyon engineer? Maybe she knows what she's doing and I could get a cut in on it. What a fool I was. Anyway, I've sent you the schematics in case it helps with the search."

"That's all I have, captain," she says, not hopeful, but not resigned. "All I can say is burn hard, burn bright."
entries.zh:
Ibrahim 摇摇头："我曾以为，这可是个 速子科技 的工程师，也许她知道自己在做什么，我也可以分一杯羹，真是太傻了。不管怎么说，我已经把结构图发给你了，这说不定会对我们的搜寻有点帮助。"

"这就是我所有的资料了，舰长。" 她说，听起来并非满怀希望，但也没有放弃，"我只能说，愿你航行无阻。"

entries.en: His eyes open, "Faith simplifies such doubts. Your 'complexities' are the whispering demon of... of all of this," his arm reaches out, to take in the Sector in a sweep, "The world Moloch and Mammon have built! It sits on your shoulder, in your TriPad, your cyberlink, and whispers uncertainty in your soul."
entries.zh: 他睁开双眼，"信仰会消解这些疑惧。你所谓的 '复杂性'，不过是那正在向你低语的恶魔，它在... 它无处不在，" 他伸出臂膀，仿佛要横扫整片星域，"在这个由双子恶魔玛门和摩洛克所建造的世界里！它就坐在你的肩头，在你的 TriPad 里，在你的植入体链接里，在你的灵魂中低语着疑虑。"

entries.en:
Brother Cotton stands, and pulls out the other folding chair for you. "I've brought some fine tea, grown by a good friend. Won't you sit and share a cup with me?"

He pauses, noting your hesitation. "Do sit. You're my guest here in this humble place. And it would be rude to poison a guest," he gives a faux-serious look, "And a sin, besides."
entries.zh:
Cotton 修士站起身，为你拉出了另一把折叠椅。"我带来了些不错的茶，一位好友自家种的。不如我们先喝杯茶再聊吧？"

他停了停，注意到了你的犹豫不决。"快请坐吧。你是我在这不起眼的地方的客人。我是不会干对客人下毒这种事的，这太野蛮了，" 他做出了个假正经的表情，"而且，还是一宗罪孽。"

entries.en:
"I am concerned for your soul, captain. The end-times are upon us, and it is up to each of us where we look for guidance. Is it into the pit of Mammon, a promise of gold and hollow power? You carry the fruit of Moloch's tree in your $shipOrFleet, captain. What will grow from its seed, I wonder. And I fear."

"This is, as foretold by Ludd, another sign of the Apocalypse. I see what you think upon your face- was not the collapse of the Domain's Gates the Apocalypse?"

Cotton seems to balance rhetorical points with himself, "Yes, and no. It was merely the beginning."
entries.zh:
"我为你的灵魂感到担忧，舰长。时间的尽头终将来临，我们将各寻指引。我们是否要跳进玛门的深渊，换取他许诺的财富与虚无的权力？摩洛克之树的果实就在你的$shipOrFleet之中，舰长。它的种子将收获什么？我十分好奇，也十分畏惧。"

"正如卢德曾经预言过的那样，这是世界末日到来的又一信号。我能看出你在想些什么 —— 世界末日不是 人之领 星门崩溃的那天吗？"

Cotton 好像在斟酌字句，"是，但又不全是。那只是世界末日的开始。"

entries.en: "A warning. Yes, it is a warning.
entries.zh: "警告。对，这的确是一种告诫。

entries.en: "I am asking you to open not only your eyes, but your heart." He lifts a fist to his own chest, "I know, it is a sugary turn of words, but Ludd taught us to be true in our speech in the hope that our soul might shine through the clouds."
entries.zh: "我还请你不光要打开你的双眼，还要打开你的内心。" 他一只手握拳放在胸口，"我知道这听起来有些花言巧语，但卢德教导我们不得妄语，以期我们的灵魂能熠熠生辉，穿透世间阴霾。"

entries.en: "A threat? No, no captain. It is a warning."
entries.zh: "威胁？不，不，舰长，这只是在告诫。"

entries.en:
He sets his teacup down, and his voice rises. He once was a street-preacher, you realize, and likely did well at it.

"The ocean shall shatter and hang in the sky, mixed with blood. The locusts will hatch from the temple of the Adversary. The doom-bringer shall step through the empty door. And," he halts the sermon, smiles, almost abashed, "It goes on like that. I do say, the poetry of the Word takes me, but I shan't bore you if it isn't your interest."

He picks his teacup up again, and says "All was foretold by Ludd. It's written, here." He lifts a hand to his heart once again, and you notice now that there's a small book in a pocket there. The holy book of Ludd. "The question for us, poor and flawed children of creation, do we look to the light for guidance?"
entries.zh:
他放下茶杯，提高嗓门。你才重新意识到，他曾是位街头传教士，说不定还深谙其道。

"海洋波涛汹涌，逆流向天，卷走鲜血。吞噬一切的飞蝗将从大敌的神庙中孵化出来。带来毁灭的末日使者马上就要踏出虚无之门。然后，" 他停止了祷告词，似乎是有些害臊地笑了一下，"后面当然还有了。我对这些祷告文非常着迷，但若你对此并无兴趣，那我也不必继续叨扰你。"

他又拿起茶杯，说着 "卢德都预见到了。都白纸黑字地写在这里面。" 他再一次将一只手握拳放在胸口，这次你注意到，他的手中有个口袋，里面是一本书。卢德圣书。"一个我们都要面临的问题，作为造物主的子民，我们微不足道且满身瑕疵，但我们是否应该追寻光明的引导？"

o.en: Are you trying to convert me into a Pather?
o.zh: 你是想把我也变成一名左径分子吗？

o.en: I think there may be something to what you are saying.
o.zh: 我觉得你说的或许有些道理。

entries.en:
The energy seems to leave Brother Cotton now, and he looks almost sad as he performs a half-bow, "I should probably go now, Captain $playerName, before the local security forces wake up."

"I thank you for your time, until our paths cross once more. Choose the light."

And with that, he slips out the door, leaving you with two cups, a pot of tea, and a set of cheap autofab furniture.
entries.zh:
Cotton 修士身上的能量似乎开始消退了。他半鞠了一躬，神态看起来似乎有几分沮丧，"我得赶快离开了，$playerName 舰长，赶在这里的安保部队有所反应之前。"

"感谢你愿意在我身上花些时间，愿我们的道途再次交会。愿你选择光明。"

说完，他侧身走出了门，留给你的只有两个茶杯，一壶茶和一套自动工厂生产的廉价家具。

o.en: Take his teacup to check the DNA match with local security forces
o.zh: 带走他的茶杯，并交给当地安保部队做 DNA 匹配检测

entries.en: Brother Cotton grimaces, "I am perhaps not doing so good a job at this as I had prayed. Let me speak with absolute candor, Captain $playerName."
entries.zh: Cotton 修士苦笑了一下，"恐怕我未能如我祷告所愿，把此事处理妥当。还请容我坦诚相告吧，$playerName 舰长。"

entries.en:
Cotton looks troubled for a moment, holds a finger up, and says "Now that, it is just what I'm saying. 'Many eyes and ears'. I did speak with this knight-errant about you, and we spoke of... concerns. But I did not tell him to kill you and that is the truth."

He looks over at the table as if he just remembered something.
entries.zh:
Cotton 面露难色，他手指着天说道，"这个嘛，这就是我刚提到过的。'不乏耳目'。我的确跟这位骑士谈到过你的事情，我们对你的事情感到... 担忧。但我从未让他去追杀你，这就是事实。"

他看向桌子，好像想到什么似的。

entries.en:
His eyes open, "You must learn, my friend."

He takes his small Book of Ludd and places it deliberately in your hands, and pats it. "The word is the Path, and the Path is the light. Once you see it, you will have no need of questions."
entries.zh:
他睁开眼睛，"你必须自己领悟，我的朋友。"

他把他自己的那一小本卢德之书郑重其事地放到了你的手里，轻抚着它。"圣言即为道途，道途即为光明。待你寻见，你将不再疑惑。"

entries.en: He maintains his smile as he shrugs, "Have it your way. Whatever blood's between us, never hurt anyone to be kind." He points with his untaken hand, "Ludd said that last bit once, you know, blessings be."
entries.zh: 他耸了耸肩，但还保持着微笑，"那就随你吧。即便我们之间有过什么血海深仇，和善待人永不为过。" 他用落空了的手指了指，"后面那句是卢德说的，你知道吗，愿他保佑我们。"

entries.en: Brother Cotton grimaces, "I am perhaps not doing so good a job at this as I had prayed. Let me speak with absolute candor, Captain $playerName."
entries.zh: Cotton 修士苦笑了一下，"恐怕我未能如我祷告所愿，把此事处理妥当。还请容我坦诚相告吧，$playerName 舰长。"

entries.en: You return to the bar.
entries.zh: 你回到了酒吧。

entries.en: His smile widens slightly as you shake his hand, "A pleasure. Call me Livewell if you like, and I'll thank you for the sentiment."
entries.zh: 和你握手时，他的嘴角稍微上扬了一点点，"幸会。方便的话你就称呼我为 Livewell 吧，还请别太过于拘谨。"

entries.en:
As you raise the cup, Cotton says "Do be careful, it is hot."

He sips tea as well and, looking pleased with himself, asks "Now where was I?"
entries.zh:
你举起手中的茶杯，Cotton 提醒道："小心点，茶还很烫。"

他也品了品茶，看上去很满足，"我们刚刚说到哪来着？"

entries.en: Brother Cotton looks almost relieved, "Then you are beginning to understand. By Ludd's light..." he looks up, and whispers something to himself. Then looks back at you. "Listen now, please."
entries.zh: Cotton 修士看上去似乎感到了一丝宽慰，"那么你终于开始明白了。卢德之光保佑啊..." 他仰起头，低声自言自语了些什么。然后他重新看向你，"那么，请你听好了。"

entries.en:
"You know what, let us stand. It's a damned poor chair anyway - ah, Creator forgive," he makes a sign of penance for his curse.

He stands behind his chair, and pours himself a steaming cup of tea, which he holds in both hands. "Now where was I?"
entries.zh:
"也好，不如我们就站着吧。这椅子质量也真是差得见鬼。啊，原谅我，造物主。" 他为自己的口无遮拦做了个忏悔的手势。

他站在椅子后，为自己倒了一杯冒着热气的茶，双手捧起茶杯。"我们刚刚说到哪来着？"

entries.en:
The domestic security officer - station chief, you read on the placard on the desk in front of you - looks nauseous.

"-the most wanted Pather terrorist mastermind in the entire Persean Sector... in my jurisdiction... drinking a cup of tea?"
entries.zh:
这位内部安全部的官员 —— 空间站主管，你面前桌子上的立牌是这么写着的 —— 对方看起来紧张得想吐。

"—— 整片英仙座星域悬赏最高的左径恐怖分子头目... 在我的辖区里... 喝了杯茶？"

entries.en:
Brother Cotton's teacup sits placidly in a transparent aluminum evidence container on the station chief's desk. The DNA analysis glows accusingly on the TriPad next to it.

"I-", the station chief swallows, holds a moment, then begins to speak again, "Please keep this to yourself. Our... investigation will notify you if we need any clarifications to your statement. Please, um, see yourself out."

The chief focuses on breathing slowly, staring dumbly at the TriPad, then the cup, then back.
entries.zh:
在你面前的桌子上，Cotton 修士的茶杯正安详地躺在一个透明的铝制证物储存箱里。旁边的 TriPad 上，DNA 检测结果如同指控一般地闪着亮光。

"我 ——"，这名空间站主管咽了咽口水，沉默了好一会，才再次开口道，"请不要向旁人透露这次事件。如果我们的... 调查行动需要你澄清任何关于你的证词的细节，我们会通知你的。呃，你可以走了，请便吧。"

主管慢慢地平复着呼吸，呆呆地盯着 TriPad，又看向茶杯，然后又看了回去。

entries.en: His eyes open, and his gaze locks on yours. "The word is the Path, and the Path is the light. Once you see the Path, you will have no need to think or question. Just ... take the next step."
entries.zh: 他睁开双眼，目光牢牢地凝在你身上。"圣言即为道途，道途即为光明。待你得见此道之时，便不再会有所思虑，有所质疑。只管... 踏上此道。"

entries.en: His eyes open, and his gaze locks on yours. "The word is the Path, and the Path is the light. Take the next step. If you have faith, you will know."
entries.zh: 他睁开双眼，目光牢牢地凝在你身上。"圣言即为道途，道途即为光明。踏上道途吧。只要你胸怀信仰，自会领悟。"

entries.en:
"This is entirely necessary," the $rank says. "You have sworn loyalty to Supreme Executor Andrada. Prove that loyalty now by submitting to his will."

The Diktat officer's tone softens just a touch, "I understand, captain, that it feels like you will be setting aside a great achievement - capture of a secret weapon beyond imagination. But you know as well as I that all greatness can only come through following the Lion's vision of the future. You must execute the betrayer in your heart and surrender to him. It's the only way."
entries.zh:
"这完全有必要。"这位 $rank 说道。"你已发誓忠于最高元首 Andrada。现在遵从他的命令来证明你的忠心。"

这位辛达强权军官的语气忽然稍稍缓和。"我理解，舰长，你觉得自己将和一项伟大的成就失之交臂 —— 取得一件超乎想象的秘密武器。但你我都明白，一切伟大成就都源自于听从雄狮对未来的愿景。你必须抹除内心的叛徒，从而能全身心地听从雄狮的话语。这才是唯一的方法。"

o.zh: 那能给我一些小小的补偿吗？

entries.en:
"A wise choice," $heOrShe says, smiling. "This will bring strength to our great work. Perhaps we may end the stalemate with the degenerate Hegemony!"

You order your crew and marines to stand down, point defense envelope deactivated, and the transfer of executive command functions to the Sindrian Diktat XO.

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat. Glory to Admiral Andrada!" $Rank $personName salutes, then says "I will see that the Lion hears of your loyalty, captain," then signs off, leaving you with only the crest of the Sindrian Diktat navy.
entries.zh:
"明智之举。" $heOrShe微笑着说道，"这将为我们的伟大事业增添力量。也许我们终于能打破和腐朽的霸主之间的僵局！"

你命令船员与陆战队员退下，将点防御系统关闭，并把指挥协议转交给这位 辛达强权 军官。

"为了辛达强权的荣耀。为了 Andrada 上将的荣耀！"$personName $Rank 向你致敬，说道，"我保证雄狮会知道你的忠诚事迹，舰长。" 随后就离开了，屏幕上只剩下 辛达强权 海军 的徽标。

entries.en:
Once you signal agreement, the Diktat officer's anger cools into loathing. $HeOrShe accepts the command codes of the Ziggurat-class hull with curt acknowledgement.

"That was the first smart move you've made today." The Diktat $rank turns their back to you and exclaims, "Let this be an example to you all! Never let your faith in our great leader waver. We pledge our blood to the Lion and his great movement, forever!"

The comm link closes on their cheers, leaving you with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat.
entries.zh:
你示意同意以后，这位辛达军官的怒气减轻了，只剩下厌恶。$HeOrShe以简短的确认步骤接受了 通灵塔-级 船体的指挥代码。

"这是你今天做出的第一次聪明的决断。" 这位辛达强权 $rank 背过身去，喊道，"就让这次事件给你们做个示范！永远不要动摇你们对伟大领袖的信心。我们的鲜血将永远献给雄狮和他的伟大事业！"

通讯链接在对方的欢呼中被切断了，屏幕上只剩下 辛达强权 的徽标。

entries.en:
The Diktat $rank's tone goes ice-cold. "You are demanding credits in return for doing your duty? Pathetic."

"I hereby rescind your commission, effective immediately. Yours is the blood of a traitor, not worthy to be spilled in the name of the Lion."

"You have one last chance to live. Accept once and for all that all you possess may be forfeit to the great cause if Supreme Executor Admiral Andrada declares it. Surrender the Ziggurat-class hull immediately or I shall give the order to open fire on your $shipOrFleet."
entries.zh:
这位辛达强权 $rank 的态度降到了冰点。"你所做的不过是你的职责所在，而你竟想为此获取星币补偿？真是可悲之人。"

"我在此收回你的雇佣协议，立即生效。你身体里流淌着的是叛徒的血，不值得以雄狮之名喷洒疆场。"

"这是你最后得以生还的机会。你必须接受这条规则，如果最高元首 Andrada 上将有所需求，你就必须为伟大事业献出你所拥有的一切。立即交出 通灵塔-级 船体，否则我将下令向你的$shipOrFleet开火。"

entries.en:
The Diktat $rank's tone goes cold. "You are demanding credits for following orders? Pathetic. And entirely expected of the degenerate so-called civilization that has fallen outside the light of the Lion of Sindria."

"There will be no compensation. You have one last chance to survive: accept once and for all that all you possess may be forfeit to the great cause if Supreme Executor Admiral Andrada declares it. Surrender the Ziggurat-class hull immediately or I shall give the order to open fire on your $shipOrFleet."
entries.zh:
这位辛达强权 $rank 的态度降到了冰点。"你只不过是在服从命令，竟然还想为此赚点星币？真是可悲之人。你作为一个来自辛达瑞亚之狮的光芒辐射不到的，腐朽的外界 '文明' 的人，还真是典型。"

"别妄想什么补偿了。这是你最后得以生还的机会。你必须接受这条规则，如果最高元首 Andrada 上将有所需求，你就必须为伟大事业献出你所拥有的一切。立即交出 通灵塔-级 船体，否则我将下令向你的$shipOrFleet开火。"

entries.en:
The Diktat $rank's tone goes ice-cold. "To refuse is betrayal. I hereby rescind your commission, effective immediately. Yours is the blood of a traitor, not worthy to be spilled in the name of the Lion."

"You have one last chance to live. Accept once and for all that all you possess may be forfeit to the great cause if Supreme Executor Admiral Andrada declares it. Surrender the Ziggurat-class hull immediately or I shall give the order to open fire on your $shipOrFleet."
entries.zh:
这位辛达强权 $rank 的态度降到了冰点。"拒绝是一种背叛行为。我在此收回你的雇佣协议，立即生效。你身体里流淌着的是叛徒的血，不值得以雄狮之名喷洒疆场。"

"这是你最后得以生还的机会。你必须接受这条规则，如果最高元首 Andrada 将军有所需求，你就必须为伟大事业献出你所拥有的一切。立即交出 通灵塔-级 船体，否则我将下令向你的$shipOrFleet开火。"

entries.en:
"So be it." The Diktat $rank turns their back to you and exclaims, "Let this traitor's death be an example to you all!"

The comm are cut, leaving you with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Your tactical officer's console has lit up with red alerts.
entries.zh:
"那就这样吧。" 这位辛达强权 $rank 背过身去，喊道，"就用这名叛徒的死给你们做个示范！"

通讯链接被切断了，屏幕上只剩下 辛达强权 的徽标。战术军官面前的控制台上堆满了红色的警告信息。

entries.en:
"Are you refusing an order given by the Lion of Sindria?" The Diktat $rank looks at you coldly. "Disobedience is death."

"Transfer command protocols to my flagship," $HeOrShe demands again.
entries.zh:
"你想要拒绝辛达瑞亚之狮的命令？" 辛达强权 $rank 用冰冷的目光盯着你，"违抗只会带来死亡。"

"把指挥权移交给我的旗舰，" $HeOrShe再次要求道。

entries.en:
"You are an agitator and a terrorist," declares the $rank. "For disobeying Supreme Executor Admiral Andrada, I sentence you to death! You have no chance to survive. Treasure your last moments alive."

The comm are cut, leaving you with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Your tactical officer's console has lit up with red alerts.
entries.zh:
"你是一名反动派，一名恐怖分子。" $rank 如此宣布道，"因你违抗了最高元首 Andrada 上将的命令，我宣判你死刑！你没有生还的机会。好好珍惜你最后的几分钟吧。"

通讯链接被切断了，屏幕上只剩下 辛达强权 的徽标。战术军官面前的控制台上堆满了红色的警告信息。

entries.en:
"You may not refuse an order given by the Lion of Sindria," the Diktat $rank sneers. "We will take your ship one way or another. It belongs to the Supreme Executor, Admiral Andrada, now."

This demand is somewhat extraordinary and would certainly not hold atmo under the laws of interfactional commerce. If you defended yourself from the unwarranted seizure of a starship, the Sindrian Diktat would be on shaky grounds declaring you a pirate.

"Transfer command protocols to my flagship," $HeOrShe demands again.
entries.zh:
"你不能拒绝辛达瑞亚之狮的命令，" 这位辛达强权 $rank 冷笑道，"不论使用什么手段，我们都会带走你的船。现在，它属于最高元首 Andrada 上将了。"

这个要求有些不同寻常，而且在跨势力贸易方面的法规面前也经不起推敲。面对如此的无端星舰扣押，如果你选择自卫，辛达强权宣布你为海盗的做法也站不住脚。

"把指挥权移交给我的旗舰。" $HeOrShe再次要求道。

entries.en:
The Diktat $rank looks back up at you.

"Rest assured captain, the conspirators of this officer have been found, tried, and executed by our fine intelligence services. Order is restored to the Sindrian Diktat. Glory to Andrada, Lion of Sindria!"

$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat after the speech, then says, "You and your $shipOrFleet are free to go now, captain. The Sindrian Diktat will ensure order and stability so that no other such incidents disrupt the flow of trade in this volume."

"Good day, captain. Your discretion in this matter is acknowledged." The comms cut out to the crest of the Sindrian Diktat.
entries.zh:
这位辛达强权 $rank 重新看向你。

"请您放心，舰长，那名军官的同谋已被我们出色的情报机构找到，审判，并处决。辛达强权恢复了秩序。为了辛达瑞亚之狮 Andrada 的荣耀！"

$HeOrShe清了清嗓子，然后说道，"你和你的$shipOrFleet可以走了，舰长。辛达强权会重点注意秩序和稳定，并且确保不会再有类似事件打扰如此大规模的交易活动。"

"祝你有愉快的一天，舰长。希望您不要过度声张这次意外。" 通讯链接被切断了，屏幕上只剩下辛达强权的徽标。

entries.en:
You order command codes surrendered to the Diktat $rank. Your personnel and cargo are evacuated in short order as a Diktat skeleton crew - and Lion's Guard marines, and technicians, and intelligence officers - shuttle in to take control of the Ziggurat-class ship.

The Diktat $rank nods, not quite a salute. "Your loyalty to the Sindrian Diktat will not go unnoticed. After I personally deliver this unique hull to the Lion Andrada, I will be sure to mention your cooperation in the affair. May this achievement bring final victory to our great struggle!"

The comms cut, leaving you with only a Diktat holding signal.
entries.zh:
你下令将指挥代码交给这位辛达强权 $rank。船员和货物在尽可能短的时间内被撤出，然后一群辛达强权的船员 —— 以及一些狮心卫队的陆战队员，还有技师和情报官员 —— 乘坐穿梭机进入并控制了 通灵塔-级 船体。

这位辛达强权 $rank 点了点头，不太像是在行军礼，"你对 辛达强权 的忠诚不会被忽视。待我亲自将这独一无二的舰船交付给辛达瑞亚之狮 Andrada 时，我一定会特别提到你在这一事件中的合作态度。愿这一成就为我们伟大的斗争带来最后的胜利！"

通讯链接被切断了，屏幕上只剩下 辛达强权 的忙线标志。

entries.en:
You order your Ziggurat-class ship to shift into phase-space, dumping passive flux into extra dimensions via whatever strange principle the Mote inducers influence.

Such a maneuver is only possible outside of combat as it requires most systems, including life support, to be operated at only the barely survivable minimum.
entries.zh:
你命令 通灵塔-级 战舰进入相位空间，并凭借光尘的诡异影响将被动幅能全部移入其他维度。

这种行为只能在战斗爆发之外做出，因为它会导致包括维生系统在内的大量设备仅能以最低功率运行。

o.en: Ask for clarification on which ship you are to surrender
o.zh: 再次询问对方想要你交出的是哪艘船

entries.en:
A look of irritation and distress crosses the Diktat $rank's face.

$HeOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms, "Our MILINT is well aware of phase capabilities, captain. Order that ship out of phase and surrender its command codes. Immediately!"

$HeOrShe takes a deep breath, and says in a lower voice, "We can wait you out. A ship can't stay phased for more than a few minutes."
entries.zh:
一丝愤怒和忧虑闪过这位辛达强权 $rank 的脸上。

$HeOrShe抱起双臂，"我们的军事情报部可是很了解相位舰船，舰长。请你立刻命令那艘船离开相位，并交出指挥代码。"

$HeOrShe做了个深呼吸，压低声音说道，"我们等得起。你的船就算进入了相位，也保持不了几分钟。"

entries.en:
The Diktat $rank is both right and wrong. The Ziggurat-class cannot remain in phase space like this forever. But it can last a while, far longer than most phase-hulls. And you know that the Diktat $rank has little idea of the extent of its capabilities.

After nearly an hour, the Diktat $rank re-opens the comm channel.
entries.zh:
这位辛达强权 $rank 只说对了一半。通灵塔-级 的确不能永久停留在相位空间。但它能停留的时长远远超过大部分相位舰船。你心里清楚，这位辛达强权 $rank 对这艘船的能力一无所知。

时间过去了将近一个小时，这位辛达强权 $rank 重新打开了通讯频道。

o.zh: 我们还要在这浪费时间吗？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks agitated, "You, you cannot simply disappear and expect the orders of the Lion of Sindria to go away, Captain $playerName. I know the ship is still out there," a worried twitch of $hisOrHer eyes upward tells you $heOrShe is unsure of this. "We will be watching you. Very closely."

The comm link closes with a brief flash of the crest of the Lion's Guard.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe看起来更气愤了，"你，你觉得让你的舰船消失了，辛达瑞亚之狮就会放弃吗，$playerName 舰长？" $hisOrHer的眼睛紧张地轻抬了一下，估计$heOrShe并不知道那艘船是否还在原地。"我们会盯着你的。紧紧地盯着你。"

随着一闪而过的狮心卫队徽标，通讯链接被关闭了。

entries.en:
"Fancy new ship you've got there. Very mysterious," Gargoyle wiggles the fingers of both hands at the comm-feed. "Spooky Tri-Tach ultratech from beyond the veil, oooooh!"

The hacker drops the act, then says deadpan "Sure was nice of Baird to let you keep it."
entries.zh:
"你的新船真够漂亮的，神秘感十足啊。" Gargoyle 在通讯器前抬起两只手，让手指如波浪般律动，还发出了令人毛骨悚然的声音，"幽灵一样的 速子科技 超级工艺，远超所有人的认知，呜喔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔！"

黑客搞了一会怪后就不演了，面无表情地说：" Baird 竟然让你留着它，真是感天动地。"

o.zh: 感天动地...那是什么意思？
也许她突然想通了什么。

entries.en:
"You're a shiny distraction. The shiniest!"

"Every MILINT officer's eyes are popping out of their head, staring at your wake, drooling. Meanwhile the real show can proceed right here. Sure, they'll come sniffing around the Galatia Academy just about instantly, but that'll be their B-teams."

Gargoyle's arms cross with a satisfied look, "Neat, huh?"
entries.zh:
"你真是个绝妙的幌子，最绝妙的！"

"每一个 MILINT 军官都会把眼球瞪出他们的脑袋，盯着你流口水，跟着你到处转，而真正的演出就可以在这里开始了。当然，他们也会派人来 Galatia 学院刺探情报，但只要你还在外边活动，他们的目光就不可能集中到这里来。"

Gargoyle 交叉着胳膊，一副满意的表情："那也不错，是吧？"

entries.en: "Good, good! You're finally getting it. With some time, maybe you'll be even a sixteenth as good as me. The point was - ugh, you're so vexing, what was it... " Gargoyle taps a cyberjack cable, thinking. Then stops. "- Right."
entries.zh: "太棒了太棒了！你终于明白了。再努力一段时间，也许你就能有我十六分之一灵光了。重点是 —— 啊，你好烦啊，有什么事..." Gargoyle 接听了一个什么人的通讯，思索了一阵，然后停下了动作，"—— 对。"

entries.en:
The lifeless Hamatsu drifts before your $shipOrFleet, its broken body sectioned into your bridge display by a variety of sensors.

Your tactical officer brings your attention to an unusual distribution of burned patches, as if the Hamatsu was struck by exotic energy weapons from many angles, all at once.
entries.zh:
死气沉沉的 Hamatsu 号漂浮在你的$shipOrFleet前，它破碎的舰体出现在了你舰桥中各种传感器的画面上。

你的战术军官让你将注意力集中在舰体那不寻常的灼伤分布上，那看起来就好像 Hamatsu 号被另一个世界来的能量武器从多个角度同时击中了一般。

entries.en:
The initial salvage team sweep finds what's left of Kelise Astraia, identified through the biometric data in her Tri-Tachyon personnel record. She is quite deceased. A large cache of credits is found in her quarters in a shielded case.

The holds of the Hamatsu are packed with supplies and fuel, much of it recoverable. The law of salvage rules, even here.

You recall that Callisto Ibrahim mentioned an affinity for the Hamatsu. If you returned this leaky tomb of a hull to her, you could expect a reward. Ship captains sometimes get funny ideas about their first real command, but if Ibrahim is willing to pay...
entries.zh:
先头打捞小组发现了 Kelise Astraia 的遗骸，这是通过 速子科技 记录的生物特征数据确定的，她已经死去多时。打捞小组从她所在的舱室中一个被保护得很好的箱子里发现了大量的星币储存卡。

Hamatsu 号的货舱里装满了补给和燃料，其中大部分是可回收的。即使在这种荒无人烟的地区也要遵守打捞法。

你还记得 Callisto Ibrahim 提到过她对 Hamatsu 号的感情。如果你把这个满是破洞的墓碑归还给她，可以指望得到一些报酬，这不难理解，毕竟舰长们多少会觉得他们的第一次真正指挥十分难以忘怀，如果 Ibrahim 愿意付钱...

entries.en:
The initial salvage team sweep finds the quarters of someone that must have been a VIP, judging by the large cache of credits found in a shielded case.

The holds of the Venture are packed with supplies and fuel, much of it recoverable. Many essential systems are undamaged and the salvage chief reports that the ship could be restored to basic functionality.
entries.zh:
最初的打捞小组在一个被保护得很好的箱子里发现了大量的星币，因此他们断定这个箱子及其所在的舱室一定曾经属于一个有一定分量的人物。

历险-级 的货舱里装满了供应品和燃料，其中大部分是可回收的。许多重要的系统都没有损坏，打捞小组的组长报告说，这艘船可以恢复基本的功能。

entries.en:
Salvage crews boarding the wreck discover that many essential systems are undamaged and the ship could be restored to basic functionality.

You recall that Callisto Ibrahim mentioned an affinity for the Hamatsu. If you returned this leaky tomb of a hull to her, you could expect a reward. Ship captains sometimes get funny ideas about their first real command, but if Ibrahim is willing to pay...
entries.zh:
登船的打捞员发现许多重要的系统都没有损坏，此舰船可以恢复基本功能。

你还记得 Callisto Ibrahim 提到过她对 Hamatsu 号的感情。如果你把这个满是破洞的墓碑归还给她，可以指望得到报酬，这不难理解，毕竟舰长们多少会觉得他们的第一次真正指挥十分难以忘怀，如果 Ibrahim 愿意付钱...

entries.en: Salvage crews boarding the wreck discover that many essential systems are undamaged and the ship could be restored to basic functionality.
entries.zh: 登船的打捞员发现许多重要的系统都没有损坏，此舰船可以恢复基本功能。

entries.en: A lifeless Venture-class cruiser drifts before your $shipOrFleet, its broken body sectioned into your bridge display by a variety of sensors. Your tactical officer brings your attention to an unusual distribution of burned patches, as if the ship was struck by exotic energy weapons from many angles, all at once.
entries.zh: 一艘死气沉沉的 历险-级 漂浮在你的$shipOrFleet前，它破碎的舰体出现在了你舰桥中各种传感器的画面上。战术军官让你将注意力集中在舰体那不寻常的灼伤分布上，那看起来就好像这艘船被另一个世界来的能量武器从多个角度同时击中了一般。

entries.en:
Using some excuse, you stall the Hegemony $personRank for a couple minutes to consult with your bridge crew.

"This is not... quite standard, but technically they can demand a scan without a tariff violation warrant," your sensors officer explains."I'd heard of this clause used before, but mostly to set off transports suspected of moving Pather infiltrators and the like. They don't get full run of the ship, just the, um, primary features: main airlock, cargo bay, reactor, hyperdrive. To ensure hull integrity and make sure your reactor isn't going to blow. Theoretically."
entries.zh:
你找了些借口来拖延这位 霸主 $personRank 几分钟的时间，以便和你的舰桥组员商讨对策。

"这... 很难说得上是标准流程，但是从技术层面上说，他们的确可以在不持有关税违反令的情况下要求进行扫描，" 你的传感器技官解释道。"我听说这项条款以前确实被使用过，但大都是为了对付可能载有左径渗透者的运载舰。他们不会检查整艘船，只能，呃，检查那些主要部件：主气闸、货仓、反应堆、超空间引擎。检查一下船体完整性，确保你的反应堆不会突然炸掉。理论上是这样。"

entries.en:
"I don't think that argument would stand up in court. Um, in a civilian court anyway. But if you deny them, they'll take it out some other way. Probably."

So the Hegemony wants to do a sweep of the Ziggurat-class hull's major systems. You can have internal security keep their scan team away from anything related to the Mote systems. Possibly the goal is simple harassment. Possibly they'll use non-standard scanners to try to get a read on the Ziggurat-class's capabilities.

"What do we do, captain?" your sensors officer asks.
entries.zh:
"我觉得这种说法在法庭上站不住脚。呃，至少在民事法庭里。但如果你拒绝的话，他们会想别的办法的。大概吧。"

你意识到，霸主 是想全面扫描一遍 通灵塔-级 船体的主要系统。你可以命令舰内警卫严禁他们的扫描小组靠近与 光尘系统 有关的任何东西。或许他们的目的只是烦一烦你。但说不定他们打算使用特制的扫描仪器来尝试获知 通灵塔-级 的真实能力。

"我们该怎么办，舰长？" 你的传感器技官问道。

entries.en:
You take the comm-link with the Hegemony $personRank off hold, and explain that you bear a commission from the Hegemony. You fight for the same cause, you hold the same loyalties. If the Hegemony wishes to access your technology, let them ask properly.

Let them act as officers and speak to your face, not bureaucrats hiding their motives behind old regulations.

By the end of your speech, you find $personRank $personName nodding along with you.
entries.zh:
你打开之前静默的通讯链接，对这位 霸主 $personRank 解释道，你签署了一份来自霸主的雇佣协议。你们为了同一个理想而奋斗，对同一个势力宣誓忠诚。如果 霸主 想要访问你手中的技术，那就让他们以正常的方式提出要求。

让他们作为以军人的身份示人，和你面对面交谈，而不是让他们以官僚的身份，把真实意图隐藏在繁杂的规定之后。

你说完这番话后，$personName $personRank 赞同地点了点头。

entries.en:
"I agree with you captain. Fully," $heOrShe says, "This underhanded skulduggery is beneath the dignity of our long tradition of service. Nonetheless, captain, I have orders I need to technically fulfill. Let the scan team on board then I shall immediately recall them. They won't even bring their equipment."

"Just give me what I need to uphold the letter of my orders, and I will make it clear that the spirit behind them is unbecoming of a Hegemony officer."
entries.zh:
"我同意你的说法。完全地同意。" $heOrShe说道，"这种卑鄙的行径和我们的长期以来的服役传统完全不相称。话是这么说，舰长，我也有必须严格服从的命令。这样吧，让我的扫描小组上船，然后我会立刻把他们召回。他们甚至不会携带任何装备。"

"只要让我按照字面意思执行了命令就好，我会告诉他们这种下三滥的手段绝不是一名 霸主 军官应该采取的。"

o.en: Accept, allow the fake scan to proceed
o.zh: 接受提议，允许假装扫描

o.en: Deny, it's the principle of the thing
o.zh: 拒绝提议，这是原则问题

entries.en:
Your tactical officer deactivates your PD envelope to allow the scan team's shuttle to dock, and you watch on a display feed as the Hegemony technicians step into the airlock, swipe something on a datapad, then step back into their shuttle.

"Thank you for your cooperation in this investigation, captain. You're all clear to go." $PersonRank $personName manages a small, ironic smile, and says "For the Domain," before signing off the comm link.
entries.zh:
你的战术军官解除了点防御系统，并允许扫描小组的穿梭机着舰。你通过摄像头看到 霸主 的技术人员走进气闸，在数据平板上划了一下，接着便回到了穿梭机上。

"谢谢你在这次调查中的合作，舰长。没有发现任何问题，你可以走了。" $personName $PersonRank 挤出一个细微而讽刺的笑容，说了一句 "为了 人之领，" 并切断了通讯。

entries.en: The Hegemony $personRank sighs, and rubs $hisOrHer forehead as if this is giving $himOrHer a tremendous headache. "I'm trying to work with you, captain. But I won't risk my career for you."
entries.zh: 这位 霸主 $personRank 叹了口气，揉了揉$hisOrHer额头，好像这件事让$himOrHer头很痛一样。"我是想与你合作，舰长。但我不能为了你拿我的职业生涯冒险。"

entries.en:
The Hegemony $personRank gruffly accepts your delayed reply, and the scan proceeds with all the tedium you've come to expect from a process carried out by the Hegemony when the bureaucracy wants you to know that they will take all the time in the world, just waiting for you to make a wrong move.

You don't make a wrong move. Your internal security is firm in denying access beyond the remit of the inspections purview, and the scan team - obviously ordered to test your boundaries - stands down and sticks to the plan.
entries.zh:
这位 霸主 $personRank 生硬地同意了你花了很长时间才作出的回复。扫描和你预想中的差不多枯燥且冗长，你知道这是 霸主 官僚们常用的手段，他们几乎能跟你耗上无限的时间，就等着你的行动出现失误。

但你并没有作出失误的决定。你的内部警卫坚决地阻止扫描小组进入正常视察范围之外的地方，扫描小组 —— 他们接到的命令明显是来测试你的极限 —— 也不得不放弃他们的计划。

entries.en:
After several agonizing hours, the scan team returns to their shuttle.

"You're free to go, captain," says the Hegemony $personRank. The comm link closes with a brief flash of the crest of the Hegemony Navy and not so much as a thank-you.
entries.zh:
经过令人烦闷不堪的几个小时后，扫描小组终于返回了他们的穿梭机。

"你可以走了，舰长。" 这位 霸主 $personRank 说道。随着一闪而过的 霸主 海军徽标，通讯链接被关闭了，连一句谢谢都没有。

entries.en:
It takes a full three seconds for your denial to register a response on the Hegemony $personRank's face. This comes in the form of a slight turn of the head, and a slight furrow of the brow.

"Note in the official log," $heOrShe says, "that Captain $playerName has refused our order to undergo a standard safety scan as per the Interstellar Transit Accords of cycle 81."

$PersonRank $personName then says "You are free to go," and the comm link closes with a brief flash of the crest of the Hegemony Navy.
entries.zh:
这位 霸主 $personRank 足足花了三秒钟才对你的拒绝产生反应，具体表现为轻微的转头和皱眉。

"记录在官方日志里。" $heOrShe说，"$playerName 舰长拒绝了根据一次星历 81 年颁布的 [星际过境协定] 规定的例行安全检查。

$personName $PersonRank 说了句 "你可以走了。" 通讯链接也随着一闪而过的 霸主 海军徽标被关闭。

entries.en: You give the order for the $zigguratShipName to shift into phase-space, dumping passive flux into extra dimensions via whatever strange principle the Mote Inducers influence. Such a maneuver is only possible outside of combat as it requires most systems, including life support, to be operated at only the barely survivable minimum.
entries.zh: 你命令 $zigguratShipName 躲进相位空间，利用光尘产生系统所使用的古怪原理，将被动幅能排散至更高维度的空间中。如此的行动只能在战场外达成，因为这样做需要让包括维生系统在内的大部分系统保持在最低功率下运转。

o.en: Ask which ship they wanted scanned again
o.zh: 再次询问对方想要扫描的是哪艘船

entries.en:
A look of irritation and distress crosses the Hegemony $personRank's face.

"This is not a game, Captain $playerName. I want you to order that ship out of phase so that we may proceed with the scan. Immediately!"

$HeOrShe takes a deep breath, and says in a lower voice, "We can wait you out. A ship can't stay phased for more than a few minutes."
entries.zh:
这位霸主 $personRank 面露愠色。

"这可不是在闹着玩，$playerName 舰长。请你命令那艘船脱离相位状态，以便我们进行扫描。立刻，马上！"

$HeOrShe做了个深呼吸，压低声音说道，"我们等得起。你的船就算进入了相位，也保持不了几分钟。"

entries.en:
The Hegemony $personRank is both right and wrong. The Ziggurat-class cannot remain in phase space like this forever. But it can last a while, far longer than most phase-hulls. And you know that the Hegemony $personRank has no idea of the extent of its capabilities.

After nearly an hour, the Hegemony $personRank re-opens the comm channel.
entries.zh:
这位 $personRank 只说对了一半，通灵塔-级 的确不能永久停留在相位空间。但它能停留的时长远远超过大部分相位舰船。你心里清楚，这位霸主 $personRank 对这艘船的能力一无所知。

时间过去了将近一个小时，他重新打开了通讯频道。

o.zh: 我们还要在这浪费时间吗？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks agitated, "You, you cannot simply disappear and expect the Hegemony to go away, Captain $playerName. I know the ship is still out there," a worried twitch of $hisOrHer eyes upward tells you $heOrShe probably has no idea where the ship is. "We will be watching you. Very closely."

The comm link closes with a brief flash of the crest of the Hegemony Navy.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe看起来更气愤了，"你，你觉得让你的舰船消失了，霸主 就会乖乖离开吗，$playerName 舰长？我知道那艘船一定还在那里。" $hisOrHer眼睛紧张地轻抬了一下，估计$heOrShe其实并不知道那艘船是否还在原地，"我们会盯着你的，紧紧地盯着你。"

随着一闪而过的 霸主 海军徽标，通讯链接被关闭了。

entries.en:
Your bridge display focuses on figures in hardsuits deploying from a work-drone to swarm the probe, equipment cases and feed-lines trailing. Your operations chief grumbles over the comms, enforcing strict call-and-response procedure in accordance with safety protocols.

The salvage team soon discovers a nonstandard miniaturized hypercommunications relay core at the center of the probe's structure. Your ops chief turns from the console to give you that look which says this salvage job just got a lot more interesting.
entries.zh:
你的舰桥显示器集中展示着调查工作相关的图像，从如同蜂群一般围绕探测器运行的工作无人机，到设备箱和各式数据传输管线。行动长官在通讯频道中嚷嚷着，确保呼应环节严格按照安全协议进行。

打捞小组很快在探测器结构的中心发现了一个非标准的微型超通信中继核心。行动长官望向你并给了一个眼神，示意你打捞到了有意思的东西。

o.zh: 行动长，你们有什么发现？

entries.en:
Your ops chief leads you through a live compilation of the salvors' investigation: The hypercomm core is formed from once-carefully arranged loops of dense superconducting material, now bent and punctured by small impacts, its delicate conduits seared by radiation.

The sophisticated post-Collapse engineering is junked but its presence indicates the involvement of a major power-player in Sector politics.
entries.zh:
行动长官带你浏览了一遍已经整理好的现场调查数据：超通讯核心是由密集的超导材料形成的，曾经精心安排的回路已经被其所遭受的冲击弯曲，刺穿，它脆弱的管道则已经被辐射灼伤。

这个复杂的大崩塌后工程产物已经成了废铁，但超通讯核心的存在表明这片星域中最大的势力之一有参与平台的搭建。

entries.en:
On a hunch, you summon schematics of the Galatia Academy probe relays you recovered while searching for Scylla Coureuse. Understanding the implication of your request, your bridge officers pull copies to their personal workstations and begin looking for analogous structures.

Within minutes they come to the conclusion that the architecture is wildly different, though the underlying principles are similar. "If I were to guess, espionage got early-stage specs, then this gadget was developed in parallel," your sensors officer says. Interesting.

You nod, then return the bridge display to an external view of the instrument platform. Salvors have re-attached shielded equipment cases to cargo drones, their work complete.
entries.zh:
鬼使神差下，你找出了在寻找 Scylla Coureuse 时得到的 Galatia 学院探测中继站的结构图。猜到你这么做的意义后，舰桥军官们把这结构图复制了一份到自己的工作站上，开始和你一起在那上面寻找起类似的结构来。

几分钟后，他们得出了结论：尽管基本原理是相似的，但二者的结构完全不同。"如果让我猜的话，搭建这个的人得到了早期的型号，在那之后，我们手头有结构图的这个装置的开发似乎是完全独立进行的 —— 没有早期型号的资料作为辅助。" 你的传感器技官如此说道，那听起来很有趣。

你点了点头，然后把舰桥显示屏的画面切换回了仪器搭载平台的外部视图。打捞员们已经将保护好的设备箱重新安装到了货运无人机上，他们的工作完成了。

entries.en:
After the salvage team returns, their attendant cargo drone packed with recovered data cores, your technicians get to work pulling data from damaged memory.

The results are scrambled. Mostly.

Your techs manage to find a few archives frozen in unencrypted temporary memory: logistics requests for basic supplies, fuel, construction material typical of remote outposts. Your comms officer proudly presents you with two mentions of the surname "Astraia" - presumably Kelise Astraia - in the comm logs and, even better, the last target of this comm-link: a seemingly insignificant point in hyperspace.
entries.zh:
打捞小组回来了，他们的货运无人机装载着被回收的数据核心。技术人员开始从损坏的存储器中提取数据。

调查结果基本上一片混乱。

技术人员设法找到了一些冻结在未加密的临时内存中的档案：基本补给，燃料，典型的边远哨所所需建筑材料等物资的物流请求。通讯军官自豪地告知你，他发现通讯日志中有两次提到了 "Astraia" 这个姓氏 —— 估计就是 Kelise Astraia。更妙的是，那其中还记录下了这个通讯链接的最后一个通讯地点：超空间中一个看似毫不显眼的地点。

entries.en:
"It looks like she was in the core worlds, at the other end of these requests," your comm officer reports. This confirms that the black project was operating in this system, and Kelise Astraia was involved. And what of the destination of the Hamatsu and Astraia's current location?

The hyperspace coordinates beckon.
entries.zh:
"看起来她就在核心世界，在这些通讯请求的另一端，" 通讯军官报告说。这证实了这个秘密计划曾在这个星系中进行，Kelise Astraia 也的确有参与其中。那么，Hamatsu 号的目的地和 Astraia 现在的位置在哪呢？

超空间坐标在呼唤着你。

entries.en:
You buy drinks freely, targeting those patrons wearing the expensive professional clothing that serves as an unofficial uniform for junior Tri-Tachyon executives. Most attempt to 'network' with you, pitching unlikely business schemes as you nod and try to steer the conversation back toward a certain ordnance engineer.

Eventually you get a hit, of sorts.
entries.zh:
你开始免费请酒，把目标锁定在那些穿着昂贵职业套装的顾客身上 —— 那种职业套装基本上就是 速子科技 下级管理人员的制服。他们中的大多数人都在试图与你 "建立关系"，向你兜售一些不太靠谱的商业计划，因此你不得不一边点头应付一边努力把谈话引向那个军械工程师。

经过一番努力之后你成功了，至少在某种程度上。

entries.en:
"You're trying to poach talent aren't you," a smile and a wink from the smarmy suit, "You with one of the big Kazeron gens? Don't have to tell me. Anyway, it's easy - you just need credits. Talk to the administrator at Culann Starforge, show them you're serious. Everyone has an angle."

"Now, like I was saying, my product will completely redefine the paradigm, max-sizing next generation innovation..."

You pretend to receive an urgent notice on your datapad, finish your drink, and escape.
entries.zh:
"你是想挖人吧？" 身着油滑西装的人笑着眨眨眼睛，"你是 Kazeron 氏族那边的人吗？不用回答。不管怎样，这不难做到，有星币就成。跟 Culann 星际锻炉的管理员谈谈，让他们知道你当真想要那个人。毕竟每个人都有点自己的小算盘。"

"让我们回归正题，我说到哪了...喔对，我的产品将完全重塑规范，将革新的概念最大化..."

你假装自己刚在数据平板上收到了紧急通知，把酒喝完之后就溜之大吉。

entries.en: "I will pray for you, captain," the Knight says with some concern in $hisOrHer voice. "Fare you well on your path, and stray not into evil, and..."
entries.zh: "我会为你祷告的，舰长。" 这位骑士的语气略带担忧。"愿你在自己的道途上一路顺遂，莫要误入恶途，还有..."

entries.en:
"Good," the Luddic $rank nods. "It reassures me that you seem not a soul totally lost to the machine. Though I fear no good will come of that... thing."

"I will pray for you, captain. Fare you well on your path."
entries.zh:
"很好，" 这位卢德 $rank 点了点头。"你看起来不像是完全被机器夺去了灵魂，这让我略感安心。即便如此，我仍然担心，那个...东西，它恐怕不会带来任何好处。"

"我会为你祷告的，舰长。祝你一路顺风。"

entries.en:
"That is it," the Luddic $rank looks down at you suspiciously. "It concerns me - and my order - that you are so little troubled by this machine. When I look upon its face, I confess that I see nought but some spawn of the twin evils of Mammon and Moloch; a hollow child of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. But," $heOrShe raises a power-armor gauntleted hand, "It is not my place to pass that judgment. Yet."

"The Bishop-Admiral will be receiving my report. I will pray for you, captain. Fare you well on your path."
entries.zh:
"就是这样。" 这位卢德 $rank 怀疑地低头看着你，"你似乎并未被这台机器所困扰，这让我 —— 和我的骑士团 —— 感到担心。我必须承认，当我看向这机器时，我只看到双子恶魔玛门和摩洛克的造物，三一速子科技公司 的空虚产物。然而..." $heOrShe抬起一只戴着动力盔甲的手，"我不能在此作出审判。至少现在还不行。"

"我会向大主教-上将汇报此事。我会为你祷告的，舰长。祝你一路顺风。"

entries.en:
"You could pay me $playerName, all the credits in the Sector," $heOrShe says in near-monotone, "But you do not understand: I am a weapon. I have been bought, aimed, and fired toward you. Nothing can change that."

The merc reaches for the comms-disconnect switch again. "Good-bye, captain."
entries.zh:
"$playerName，你可以付给我星域中所有的星币，但那改变不了什么。" $heOrShe用机械一般的嗓音说道，"你得明白，我是一件武器，已经被购买并瞄准了你，现在就要开火，什么也改变不了这一点。"

雇佣舰长再一次抬起了要切断通讯的手："永别了，舰长。"

o.en: Cut comm link and prepare for combat
o.zh: 切断通讯链接，准备战斗

entries.en:
The merc pauses at your words, and you see a wave of consternation pass over $hisOrHer face at your lack of understanding. $HeOrShe reproaches you, "The Company of course. The only one that matters."

Tri-Tachyon, naturally.
entries.zh:
雇佣兵听了你的话后停下了动作，你看到$hisOrHer的脸上掠过一阵惊愕 —— 为你的迟钝。$heOrShe笑骂："当然是公司，那唯一一个心系此事的公司。"

速子科技，当然是他们。

o.en: Stop! I can pay you off.
Cut comm link and prepare for combat

entries.en:
"Captain, I am very pleased that you have returned with this valuable data, and," she pulls up a schematic of the Ziggurat-class prototype, "This fascinating prototype."

The manta-ray design spins slowly between you and the provost; she seems to be rubbing two fingers together, contemplating the thing before her.

"The starship itself is irrelevant. You may keep it."
entries.zh:
"舰长，你能带回这些有价值的数据真是太棒了，以及，" 她调出一份 通灵塔-级 原型舰的示意图，"这艘迷人的原型舰。"

这形如蝠鲼的船体的全息投影在你和院长之间缓缓旋转，她搓着两根手指，凝视着眼前的东西。

"星舰本身对我们来说无关紧要，你可以把它留在你的舰队中。"

o.en: I never intended to give it up.
o.zh: 我可从来没想过要把它交出去。

entries.en:
"Captain, I am pleased that you have returned with this valuable data," she pulls up a schematic of the Ziggurat-class prototype.

The manta-ray design spins slowly between you and the provost; she seems to be rubbing two fingers together, contemplating the thing before her.

"The starship itself is irrelevant because we got to it first, though I do hope that you consider where this information ends up- and the fate of the ship itself. Factions might get notions."
entries.zh:
"舰长，你能带回这些有价值的数据真是太棒了。" 她调出一份 通灵塔-级 原型舰的示意图。

这形同蝠鲼的船体的全息投影在你和院长之间缓缓旋转，她搓着两根手指，凝视着眼前的东西。

"那艘星舰本身无关紧要，因为我们已经快人一步了，不过我还是希望你能考虑一下这些信息最终会流向哪里 —— 以及舰船本身的归宿。星域中的各大势力可能会对此有些打算。"

entries.en:
Baird continues, "It is the anomalous device within that interests me, not the hull - and, of course, these 'motes' that it appears to create. We've taken thorough scans and will be able to create experimental variations before long."

"Academician Coureuse has been reviewing sensor data, I shall have her explain."
entries.zh:
Baird 继续道："让我感兴趣的不是这艘船本身，而是它内部那些奇怪的装置 —— 当然，还有它产生的这些 '光尘'。我们已经进行了全面的扫描，不久后就能创造出可以用于实验的样品。"

"Coureuse 院士一直在检查传感器数据，我会让她来解释。"

entries.en:
The provost taps at her desk console, and the comm display splits to display Scylla Coureuse.

"Provost, yes? ... Oh! Captain $playerName." Coureuse sounds flustered. "Of course, you must have just arrived."

"I was discussing the scientific value of the find with the captain here," says Provost Baird. "We had just arrived at the topic of these anomalous motes."

A certain subsystem of the Ziggurat display is highlighted, and an approximation of the strange dancing lights appears surrounding the display.
entries.zh:
院长在她的桌面控制台上进行了一些操作，通讯显示器分出了一个显示着 Scylla Coureuse 的画面。

"院长，有什么事吗？...喔！$playerName 舰长怎么在这？好吧，你也许刚到。" Coureuse 看上去很慌张。

"我刚刚正在和舰长讨论这一发现的科学价值，" Baird 院长说，"我们刚刚谈到了那些奇怪的光尘。"

通灵塔上的某个子系统在图像中被高光标记了出来，似乎还有一些光点正围绕着图像飞舞。

entries.en:
"Oh yes, from our preliminary analysis it does not appear to be a weapon system, exactly - I mean," Coureuse looks down, manipulating the display via datapad. She focuses on the two-stage anomalous device, which scales up to fill the shared display.

"It has been weaponized. But I don't think this is a weapon. It's too, hm." She considers her words. "Unfocused? General-purpose? You can see elements of hyperdrive core technology here," a section flashes at Coureuse's touch.

"As well as something resembling an Atherton Coil. That stabilizes P-space induction, right?" Another portion flashes.

If you squint, maybe...
entries.zh:
"哦是的，唔。从我们的初步分析来看，它似乎不是一种武器系统 —— 不，让我想想怎么说要准确一些，" Coureuse 向下看了看，通过数据平板操纵着图像。从她将其放大至填满整个显示器的举动来看，她关注的似乎是那个分为二阶段运作的特殊装置。

"它被当成了武器来使用，但我认为这原本并非武器。这非常...嗯..." 她思考着该如何进行表述，"设计方向模糊？通用性很强？不管怎么说，你可以从中看到超空间驱动核心技术的影子。" 显示器上的一个部分在 Coureuse 的触摸下闪烁了起来。

"以及类似 Atherton 线圈的东西 —— 嗯，那个稳定的相位空间感应器，不是吗？" 接着另一个部分发出了亮光。

你眯起了眼睛，觉得这玩意儿看上去有点眼熟，它好像是...

entries.en:
Coureuse looks impressed. "Yes! But also no. Um, let me back up," she says, rubbing her eyes. "It's as though the Tri-Tachyon team stumbled upon a breakthrough in - well, we don't know exactly what yet - and someone told them to turn it into a weapon system."

"Analysis... the implications of what we're detecting - I mean, with the instruments we have - we'll need to construct new ones. What we're seeing is unprecedented in terms of even state-of-the-art Domain-era technology." Coureuse looks away, thinking for just a moment, "Uh. Publicly acknowledged technology, anyway."

She turns back to the display, summoning a recording of the mote-swarm, "And the apparent 'flocking' behavior... though that word implies volition, which we're not even sure is-"
entries.zh:
Coureuse 看起来印象颇深，"是，但也不完全是。嗯，让我再说明一下，" 她揉着眼睛说，"这就好像 速子科技 团队灵光乍现，实现了一处突破 —— 我们还没搞明白他们突破了什么 —— 然后有什么人告诉他们这可以改造成武器系统。"

"分析...我想说的是，我们需要造新的仪器来对它们进行分析。因为展现在我们面前的是前所未有的，甚至已经超越了人之领时代的技术。" Coureuse 看向别处，思考了一会儿，"呃。至少超越了所有已经公开的技术。"

她转身看向显示屏，调出了一段光尘群的录像："它们拥有明显的 '聚集' 行为 —— 我知道这个词是用来形容有意识的个体的，我们还没能证明这一点。"

entries.en:
Baird raises a hand to stop the words tumbling from Coureuse. "That's enough. I understand, Scylla. Your team has a lot of work to do, and we shall ask Gargoyle to trace what information-exchange Tomas Kallichore made with Tri-Tachyon specific to applications within this Project Ziggurat."

Coureuse nods. "I'll, we'll get back to it."

She closes down the display of the Ziggurat device and looks to you, "This is incredible, captain. Thank you for this, this opportunity."

She signs off.
entries.zh:
Baird 扬起一只手打断了 Coureuse 的滔滔不绝："你说的够明白了。我知道你的团队还有很多的工作要做，Scylla，去忙你的吧。现在我们要让 Gargoyle 查一查 Tomas Kallichore 到底和 速子科技 做了什么信息交换，尤其是那些对这个通灵塔计划有用的信息。"

Coureuse 点点头："我会的，我这就回去工作。"

院长关闭了显示着 通灵塔-级 的装置，看着你说道："这非常不可思议，舰长。感谢你为我们提供了这个...这个机会。"

她停顿了一阵。

entries.en:
"Despite her inexperience, she's performing well under the pressure," Baird observes with a note of pride, "Our hardware team is struggling to follow her pace."

"Before we conclude," she says, "I must of course see to your compensation." She taps out a command sequence.
entries.zh:
"尽管经验不足，她依然表现得很好，尤其是在重压之下，" Baird 自豪地说，"我们的硬件团队付出了很大的努力才勉强跟上她的脚步。"

"在我们结束谈话之前，我应当先处理一下你的报酬问题。" 她一边说着，一边输入了一串指令。

entries.en:
"There will be more for you to do here before long, captain," she says. "Unbelievable things."

Baird smiles, looking uncharacteristically satisfied, and closes the comm-link.
entries.zh:
"不久之后还会有更多事情要劳烦你的，舰长。" 她说到。"更多不可思议的事情。"

在关闭通讯链接之前，Baird 心满意足地笑了，很是一反常态。

entries.en:
Arroyo takes on the distant look of a cyberaug interfacing with the hypernet. With a nod, Arroyo summons a personnel file to overlay your comms-link, summarizing the life and career of Kelise Astraia.

"A bit of an eccentric, our Kelise," Arroyo says, "But you can get the details later. Relevant bit is here: looks here like she was contracting on the side for a Tri-Tach black project - one of them anyway - and was asked to go on-site full-time. Left a convincing resignation and booked a starship, the 'Hamatsu'. Venture-class. That one's made more than a few trips out of the core worlds; scavenging, special ops. A few jobs for the Company here and there."
entries.zh:
Arroyo 用程序远程访问了资料库，接着他点了点头，将一份个人档案覆盖在了通讯链接上，那上面显示着 Kelise Astraia 生活的细节。

"我们的 Kelise 女士有点古怪，" Arroyo 说，"总之你可以稍后再了解这些细节。相关的部分在这里：看起来她好像加入了 速子科技 的机密项目 —— 反正就是那些机密的其中之一 —— 并被要求去现场全职工作。她留下了令人信服的辞职信，订了一艘星舰，历险-级 Hamatsu 号。这艘船已经离开过核心世界好几次了，拾荒或是什么特殊行动，总之就是为公司跑腿。"

o.en: Can you tell me more about the Hamatsu?
o.zh: 你能告诉我更多 Hamatsu 号的细节吗？

entries.en:
"Let's see. It looks like Astraia requested special modifications." Arroyo raises an eyebrow, "Expensive ones. I'm guessing some of this is a little extra to keep things quiet. No specs on these modifications, however. Lazy work by whoever was doing this data-gathering."

"Looks like the ship left the Hybrasil system and turned its transponder off sometime before jumping out. Doesn't necessarily mean anything, but... " Arroyo considers for a moment, then pages the file ahead.
entries.zh:
"让我们看看。看起来 Astraia 要求对船体做过一些特别的改装。" Arroyo 扬起眉毛，"价格不菲，我猜这是为了保密而额外准备的。然而，这些改装的细节没有被记录，看起来当时负责盯着的间谍很懒。

这艘船在跃进超空间离开了 Hybrasil 星系前关掉了应答器，这透露不出什么很有价值的情报，但是..." Arroyo 思考了一会儿，然后把文件翻到了前面。

entries.en:
"They didn't want to be followed," says Arroyo, looking somewhere off-comms, "I would assume the flight plan logged with the port authority is worthless. Someone has to know something though. Hmm." Data scrolls on his desk display.

"The Hamatsu is owned by one Callisto Ibrahim." he looks up at you, "Heard of her? No? Bit of a reputation. My former partner hired her once a while back. She lied up and down on her credentials," he shrugs. "But it worked out. Respect the con. Anyway, she's operating a few small fleets out of Agreus in the Arcadia system these days."

Arroyo's eye twitches in a certain way and the display records disappear.
entries.zh:
"但是这至少意味着他们不想被人跟踪，" Arroyo 看了看通讯画面以外的某处，数据在他桌面的投影仪上滚动着，"我猜港务局记录的航行计划在这方面给不了我们帮助。总得有人知道些什么，嗯..."

"Hamatsu 号的主人叫 Callisto Ibrahim。" 他抬头看着你，"听说过她吗？没有？其实她还有点名气，我以前的合伙人雇过她。她的证书从头到尾都是谎言..." 他耸耸肩，"但你得承认这很有用。不管怎么说，她最近在 Arcadia 星系的 Agreus 运营着几支小舰队。"

Arroyo 的眼角抽了抽，他面前的资料记录消失了。

entries.en:
"Well, $playername, that was fun. I've forwarded the files. If I were you, I'd try to get some information out of Ibrahim. She seems like someone who knows how to do business if the pay is right."

Arroyo sits back, "Now I have a reputation to obscure, if you don't mind. Good luck finding your engineer. Remember: I don't want to hear any more about this. The last thing I need is to get some Company director on my case because you're stepping on their pet black project."

With that, he terminates the link, leaving you with a spinning Tri-Tachyon logo.
entries.zh:
"好吧，$playername，这很有趣。我已经把文件发给你了，如果我是你，我会试着从 Ibrahim 那里打听点消息。只要价格合适，她应该知道如何做生意。"

Arroyo 坐了下来："如果你不介意的话，现在我得低调一些了。祝你能找到你的工程师。记住：我不想再听和这事有关的消息了，我最不需要的就是让某个公司主管来处理我的案子，只因你挖到了他们宝贝的机密项目。"

说完后，他切断了通讯，你面前只剩下旋转着的 速子科技 公司商标。

entries.en:
"Your worship of the twin evils Moloch and Mammon is not unseen by the Path, $playername. A wheeled eye spins, and it is fiery, and it is filled with judgment."

"Know that servants of Moloch can be bought. You consort with betrayers; those with no faith in their heart will sell their erstwhile comrades. Do you think Tri-Tachyon only provides information to your ilk? They know no loyalty but that of blooded silver."
entries.zh:
"你对恶魔摩洛克和玛门之愚忠，卢德已经知晓，$playername。卢德之眼！炙热而能洞悉一切！"

"摩洛克的仆人可被收买，你与背信弃义的人同行，却不知没有心的人终有一日会出卖同伴。你认为 速子科技 只会向你提供信息？他们一无所忠 —— 除了浸血的金银！"

o.en: I wish to repent and follow the Path of Ludd.
o.zh: 我当悔过，并追随卢德之道。

entries.en:
A console chimes, and the rogue knight looks almost surprised, and definitely a little disappointed. "You have... chosen," $heOrShe says haltingly, "But I am still not sure if the path in your heart truly leads toward the Path, or if this is the deceit of a coward who will give anything to save their own miserable life from judgment."

The Knight looks stoic once more, "It is not for me to decide now if your soul can be redeemed- it is not for any of us. But the worldly concern of your Path? That is a burden chosen by Brother Cotton. Find him. If the light of Ludd truly illuminates the Path before you, you will know how." $HeOrShe looks away, annoyed, "Then you can be his problem."

With that, the rogue knight snaps the comms-line dark. $HisOrHer face hangs in the air for just a moment as a bluish afterimage before fading to nothing.
entries.zh:
听到转账的声音后，骑士看起来十分惊讶，当然还有点失望。"你...已经做出了选择。" $heOrShe犹豫着说，"但我依然不知你心中的道路是否已与卢德的圣途交汇，或许我面前的人只是懦弱，宁愿付出其它一切也要保全性命。"

这位骑士又变得庄严了。"你的灵魂是否可以被救赎，我不可决定 —— 我们任何人都不拥有这种权力。但指引你前进的道路？这是 Cotton 修士的责任。当卢德的光照亮你的路，你就会知道应该去哪里找他。" $heOrShe把脸转开，看上去十分烦躁，"到了那时，操心你的就该是他了。"

说着，骑士突然切断了通讯。$hisOrHer的脸像一幅蓝色的余像悬在空中片刻，然后消失得无影无踪。

entries.en: Your comms officer snaps the holofeed off, the knight's face hanging like a specter in the air for just a moment of bluish afterimage. Your bridge crew coordinates your $shipOrFleet's muster to combat-ready status.
entries.zh: 你的通讯军官将全息影像断开，卢德骑士的脸像幽灵一样悬在空中，只留下片刻的蓝色余像。你的旗舰舰桥指挥员协调你的$shipOrFleet进入战斗状态。

entries.en:
The knight's face is stony. "Prove your devotion now. Unburden your soul of Mammon's shackles. Transfer $gaPZ_rkTithe credits in tithe to the Path of Ludd. Immediately."

$HeOrShe pauses, then says smugly "Remember that it is a sin to swear false oaths, $playername." The Knight brow furrows just a little, like $heOrShe knows your answer already, savoring that $heOrShe has caught you in a lie.
entries.zh:
骑士的脸一如既往的僵硬："证明你的忠诚，卸下恶魔玛门给你的枷锁。为卢德的圣途贡献 $gaPZ_rkTithe 的财富，立刻！"

$HeOrShe停顿了一下，然后沾沾自喜地说："切记，许下错误的誓言是罪过，$playername。" 说完后骑士的眉头微微皱了一下，好似$heOrShe已经得到了你的回应，接着开始津津有味地品味起刚刚$heOrShe用花言巧语在你面前取得的胜利来。

o.en: Perhaps half that amount would be sufficient?
o.zh: 也许那个数额的一半就足够了？
想都别想，升起护盾！ (结束对话)

entries.en:
At last the knight smiles, and it is a smile of cold fury. "Evil will always betray itself, you see? Your heart is polluted with greed, and pride, and deceit. In Ludd's name I shall strike you down, hammer and sword."

The comm-line goes dark. The knight's face hangs in the air like a specter for just a moment of bluish afterimage.
entries.zh:
最后，骑士笑了，那是一个冷酷和愤怒交织而成的笑容："邪恶的反噬正如当下，你的心已被贪婪，骄傲，诡诈所污秽。以卢德之名，我将引你走向灭亡，以我的利剑和铁锤！"

通讯被切断了，骑士的脸像幽灵一样悬在空中，只留下了片刻的蓝色余像。

entries.en:
You pitch the material to the pirate- a series of recorded comm calls between Rayan Arroyo and various parties setting up and carrying out a job to hack the Aztlan Relay. The Hegemony would pay well for this, or someone well-positioned in Tri-Tachyon. Why not dream big, why not sell it to both?

As the pirate considers your offer and you can see the logic of the situation working across $hisOrHer face.

"I'm going to make you an offer," $heOrShe says, a menacing smile growing on $hisOrHer face. "Transmit everything you've got now or I have my gang blow you out of the sky."
entries.zh:
你试着把这些材料推销给海盗，里面都是一些 Rayan Arroyo 和各种组织之间的通讯记录，能表明他们当时正策划和执行一项侵入 Aztlan 通讯中继站的任务。霸主 肯定会为此慷慨解囊，速子科技 里身居要职的家伙估计也会开出很高的价码。或者干脆更有想法一些，为何不把它同时卖给这两家？

在海盗审视你给出去的东西时，材料里那些能解释当前形势的逻辑关系明显起作用了，你从$hisOrHer的脸上看得出来。

"那我就给你开个价吧。" $heOrShe开了口，同时脸上浮现出了威胁人的阴险微笑，"把你手里现有的所有信息都传过来，否则我就叫我的人把你从天上给打下来。"

entries.en: Siyavong shrugs, perfectly innocuous.
entries.zh: Siyavong 耸了耸肩，看起来完全没有恶意。

o.en: What game are you playing this time?
o.zh: 你这次葫芦里卖的是什么药啊？

o.en: I'm simply operating my fleet. Nothing illegal in the Persean League.
o.zh: 我只是在运营我的舰队。这在 英仙座联盟 可不算违法。

o.en: It's nice to meet you, lieutenant. I'll just be on my way.
o.zh: 见到你很高兴，上尉。我该走了。

entries.en:
Siyavong smiles as innocuously as he is able. "It looks to Fleet Intelligence like a capital-sized phase-capable ship. Theoretically impossible. And yet," he extends the palm of his hand, indicating your $shipOrFleet. "And that's its least interesting quality, if my sources are to be believed."

Siyavong folds his hands together. "If you would indulge me, captain, I'm most curious about where you found such a thing. In your own words, if you would."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 尽可能挤出一个无害的微笑。"在舰队情报部看来，这东西是一艘大小达到主力舰规模，而且还能使用相位隐形的舰船，但这理论上显然是行不通的。然而..." 他伸手指了指你的$shipOrFleet。"如果我的情报来源准确的话，我们所熟知的尖端技术可能只是那东西最常见的特性罢了。

Siyavong 双手交握。"如果可以的话，舰长，我很好奇你是从哪找到这艘船的。当然，如果你能亲自讲述，那就更好了。"

o.en: I would prefer not to discuss business.
I found it in orbit of a Tri-Tachyon black site.
o.zh: 我是在一处 速子科技 的秘密研究站的轨道上找到它的。

o.en: It's nice to meet you, lieutenant. I'll just be on my way.
o.zh: 见到你很高兴，上尉。我该走了。

entries.en: Siyavong becomes intent, leaning forward, his attention focused on you now like a targeting laser. He keeps his tone casual, "Fascinating. And what did the Tri-Tachyon Corporation think about this?"
entries.zh: Siyavong 来了兴致，他的上半身微微前倾，目光像定位激光一样盯在你身上。他保持轻松的语气说道，"这可真是非常有意思。三一速子科技公司 对此又怎么想呢？"

o.zh: 解释什么是阿尔法研究站

o.en: It was nice chatting with you, lieutenant. I'll just be on my way.
o.zh: 和你聊天很愉快，上尉。我该走了。

entries.en:
"Oh, captain. I am disappointed to end our little discussion so soon," he says, looking legitimately let down. "But I understand," he continues, magnanimously, "You have business to attend to and I'm certain it cannot wait. We all have our demands. Such is the way of the world, is it not?"

"Good day, captain. I'm sure we will meet each other again very soon, and I would love to continue our little chat."

With that he closes the comms somewhat abruptly. You get the distinct feeling that Fleet Intelligence is going to be keeping a close eye on you.
entries.zh:
"哦，舰长。我们的谈话就这样结束真是令我很失望，" 他样子看起来真的很失落。"但是我理解，" 他宽容地继续道，"你也有耽搁不得的生意要做。我们都有各自的需要。这就是世界运行的方式，不是吗？"

"希望你有美好的一天，舰长。我们一定会很快再次见面的，到那时我们再接着聊吧。"

通讯就这么略带突兀的结束了。你感觉舰队情报部一定是盯上你了。

entries.en: "Of course, captain." Siyavong's smile takes on a subtle aspect of strain now. "If you do not want to cooperate with Fleet Intelligence, that is your personal choice and we have no, ah, legal objection."
entries.zh: "没有问题，舰长。" Siyavong 的笑容中夹着一丝僵硬。"无论你希不希望与舰队情报部合作，那都是你个人的选择，我们没有任何合理的反对意见。"

o.en: It was nice chatting with you, lieutenant. I'll just be on my way.
o.zh: 和你聊天很愉快，上尉。我该走了。

entries.en:
Siyavong acts as a perfect listener, responding with appropriate awe at the compounded mysteries of the Motes and what little you know of the Mote induction devices.

As you wind down, Siyavong pretends to look at his datapad, "Oh! I do believe I have interrupted your journey and taken much of your time with my carrying on. I'm sure we will meet each other again very soon, and I would love to continue our little chat."

"Good day, captain," and with that he closes the comms somewhat abruptly. You get the distinct feeling that Fleet Intelligence is going to be keeping a close eye on you.
entries.zh:
Siyavong 是个完美的倾听者，对光尘本身错综复杂的谜团和你知之甚少的光尘发生器表现了恰到好处的惊讶和畏惧。

在你讲完故事后，Siyavong 假装看了看数据平板，"哦！我一定是打扰了你的旅程，还浪费了你不少时间。我们一定会很快再次见面的，到那时我们再接着聊吧。"

"希望你有美好的一天，舰长，" 通讯就这么略带突兀的结束了。你感觉舰队情报部一定是盯上你了。

entries.en:
"Oh, how funny," Siyavong gives a little chuckle. "It just felt like the right word to describe the phenomena. Just one of those little coincidences, I suppose."

"But captain," he says apologetically, "I interrupted your story. I apologize. You were saying about the motes?"
entries.zh:
"哎呀哎呀，" Siyavong 轻轻笑了笑。"我只是觉得这个词描述这种现象还挺合适的。不过是个巧合罢了。"

"不过，舰长，" 他略带歉意地说道，"抱歉我打断了你的故事。你刚说到光尘什么的？"

o.en: Have you been spying on me?
It was nice chatting with you, lieutenant. I'll just be on my way.
o.zh: 和你聊天很愉快，上尉。我该走了。

entries.en:
Siyavong looks suitably impressed as you tell him about the secret Tri-Tachyon black site hidden beyond a nascent gravity well jump-point, and your discovery that everyone was dead, and there was a strange ship in orbit.

"This magnificent ship of yours, a Ziggurat-class hull I believe? Wonderful. You said it was strange- I am so very interested by these things, $playerName, won't you tell me more about these strange ah, 'motes' was it?"
entries.zh:
你向 Siyavong 讲述了你发现 速子科技 秘密研究站的经过。听到你说这个研究站被藏在一处亚临界重力井下，在场所有人全部遇难，只剩一艘船停在轨道上的事情后，Siyavong 表现出了恰到好处的吃惊。

"你那艘很气派的舰船，是叫做 通灵塔-级 吧？太美妙了。你提到它的奇怪之处 —— 我对这种事情一向很感兴趣，$playerName，不如你给我讲讲这些奇怪的，呃，'光尘' 的事情？"

o.en: I don't recall using the word 'mote' with you.
o.zh: 我可不记得和你提到过什么 '光尘' 啊。

o.en: Explain what little you know about the motes
o.zh: 解释你对光尘知之甚少

o.en: It was nice chatting with you, lieutenant. I'll just be on my way.
o.zh: 和你聊天很愉快，上尉。我该走了。

entries.en:
Siyavong's smile doesn't quite reach his eyes. "Why captain, that's such a strong word. Loaded with negative implications, that - no, I understand why you would feel the way you do, and it is a valid response."

"I am a citizen of the League. I would not be so proud if I did not value my freedom, my independence, would I? And we share this admirable quality, you and I."

"Oh," Siyavong pretends to look at his datapad, "I do believe I have interrupted your journey and taken much of your time with my carrying on. I'm sure we will meet each other again very soon, and I would love to continue our little chat."

"Good day, captain," and with that he closes the comms somewhat abruptly. You get the distinct feeling that Fleet Intelligence is going to be keeping a close eye on you.
entries.zh:
Siyavong 的嘴角上扬。"哎，舰长，你这话说的太重了。带着负面的暗示，这让我 —— 嗯，不过，我能理解你为什么这样觉得，这也是一种合理的反应。"

"我是一名 英仙座联盟 公民。如果我不尊重独立和自由的价值观，是不能像这样自豪的，不是吗？而且我们都有着这种可敬的品质，你和我都是。"

"哦，" Siyavong 假装看了看数据平板，"我一定是打扰了你的旅程，还浪费了你不少时间。相信我们会很快再次见面的，到那时我们再接着聊吧。"

"希望你有美好的一天，舰长，" 通讯就这么略带突兀的结束了。你感到舰队情报部一定是盯上你了。

entries.en:
A shocked expression crosses Siyavong's face, "Captain! I hope that you would think better of me. I simply want to ensure that you are well aware of your legal rights in Persean League controlled volume; the League charter guarantees your right to operate starships and engage freely in commerce so long as you respect the laws of navigation and so on."

"So, please. I believe I have interrupted your journey - do carry on. I'm sure we will meet each other again very soon, and I would love to continue our little chat."

"Good day, captain," and with that he closes the comms somewhat abruptly. You get the distinct feeling that Fleet Intelligence is going to be keeping a close eye on you.
entries.zh:
Siyavong 露出震惊的表情，"舰长！我希望你不要这么看待我。我不过是想确保你真的了解你在 英仙座联盟 控制区的法定权利，联盟的章程赋予你自由驾驶任何舰船和进行任何贸易的权利，当然前提是你遵守航行方面的法规等。"

"所以，请便。我一定是打扰了你的旅程，请继续吧。我们一定会很快再次见面的，到那时我们再接着聊吧。"

"希望你有美好的一天，舰长。" 通讯就这么略带突兀的结束了。你感觉舰队情报部一定是盯上你了。

entries.en:
"No game. I'm having a friendly conversation with you, pursuing a matter of special interest to Fleet Intelligence. Don't believe the holovids, captain - a friendly conversation is often the most powerful tool in an intelligence officer's arsenal."

"It looks to Fleet Intelligence like a capital-sized phase-capable ship. Theoretically impossible. And yet," he extends the palm of his hand, indicating your $shipOrFleet. "And that's its least interesting quality, if my sources are to be believed."

Siyavong folds his hands together. "If you would indulge me, captain, I'm most curious about where you found such a thing. In your own words, if you would be so kind."
entries.zh:
"我什么药也不卖。我只是为了某样舰队情报部特别感兴趣的东西，才特地来和你进行友好的交谈。别信那些全息广告上说的，舰长 —— 友好的交谈经常是情报人员最有效的武器。"

"情报部觉得这样东西是一艘大小达到主力舰规模，而且还能使用相位的舰船。理论上这是不可能的。然而，" 他伸手指了指你的$shipOrFleet。"然而如果我的情报来源准确的话，那只不过是它最平庸的特性。"

Siyavong 双手合十。"如果可以的话，舰长，我很想知道你是在哪里找到这么一艘船的。能用你自己的话描述描述的话就再好不过了。"

o.en: I would prefer not to discuss business.
I found it in orbit of a Tri-Tachyon black site.
o.zh: 我是在一处 速子科技 的秘密研究站的轨道上找到它的。

o.en: It's nice to meet you, lieutenant. I'll just be on my way.
o.zh: 见到你很高兴，上尉。我该走了。

o.en: Tell Baird about the Hamatsu hyperdrive modifications
o.zh: 告诉 Baird 关于 Hamatsu 号超空间引擎改装的事

entries.en:
Baird listens without reaction to your explanation of your findings: following the lead on Kelise Astraia to speaking with Callisto Ibrahim, acquiring specifications to the modifications done to the Hamatsu hyperdrive.

After only a moment's pause, the provost says "Take these specifications to Coureuse. She'll have my authorization to devote all necessary resources to the matter. We must move quickly if Tri-Tachyon has produced a reliable device to exploit Transverse Jump capability." She frowns, then turns quickly to start tapping at her desk console.
entries.zh:
Baird 面无表情地听完了你关于调查结果的汇报：跟随 Kelise Astraia 的线索，与 Callisto Ibrahim 谈话，最终获取了 Hamatsu 号超空间引擎改动的细节。

短暂的停顿之后，院长开口了："把这些细节说明拿给 Coureuse。我会授权她动用一切必要资源来处理此事。如果 速子科技 已经制造出一种可靠的横轴跳跃设备，我们就必须加快脚步了。" 她皱了皱眉头，然后迅速转过身去，开始轻敲她的桌面控制台。

entries.en:
Baird speaks, her attention divided "If this... Captain, I suspect that you will have to search for a non-standard hyperspace access point to find the Tri-Tachyon black site. Retrace the route of the Hamatsu from Hybrasil to $gaPZ_relaySystem."

Face illuminated by a newly-summoned display, Baird says "Go now, captain," and disconnects the comms.
entries.zh:
Baird 继续说道，这时她的注意力已经有些分散了："如果这...舰长，我猜你得先找到一个特殊的超空间跳跃点，那样你才能找到 速子科技 的秘密研究站。沿着 Hamatsu 号从 Hybrasil 到 $gaPZ_relaySystem 的路线走一趟试试。"

板着一张被刚刚调出的图像照亮的脸，Baird 说："舰长，现在就出发。" 她随即切断了通讯。

o.en: Tell Baird about finding the cleared Tri-Tach base site
o.zh: 告诉 Baird 你找到了被搬空的速子基地据点

entries.en:
You upload your salvage team's report and tell Baird about finding the Tri-Tachyon base site which was cleared and intentionally hidden.

The provost nods, glancing through your data. "This fits with what we know of Tri-Tachyon operations. My predecessor, Tomas Kallichore, assisted the Company with-," she looks at you carefully, "-at least one instance of such a black site. The Galatia Academy put its name on resupply missions, presenting them as deep space survey expeditions. The Hegemony never acknowledged this in their persecution of the Galatia Academy, though they obviously knew of it. Or know, now, with the records from Kallichore's Archive."
entries.zh:
你把打捞小组的报告传给了 Baird，并告诉她你发现了一座被速子科技清扫过并试图隐藏起来的基地据点。

院长点了点头，浏览了一下你的数据。"这符合我们对速子科技操作流程的了解，我前一任院长，Tomas Kallichore，协助过那家公司 ——" 她谨慎地看了看你，"—— 在这样一个秘密据点上，至少一次。Galatia 学院的名号就写在那次补给任务的协助机构一栏上，明面上是为深空调查探险进行补给。霸主在向 Galatia 学院施压时从未利用过这一点，尽管他们之前显然知道这件事。即使没有，现在有了 Kallichore 档案的记录后，他们也该知道了。"

entries.en:
Baird squeezes her eyes shut and adjusts her spectacles, looking vexed. By the missteps of the former provost, perhaps.

She turns back to you and says, "And, clearly, someone in Tri-Tachyon is up to the same old trick. Perhaps they moved their base after the Hegemony investigation of this institution. Perhaps they anticipated a Hegemony response."

"Enough speculation," Baird says after a moment's thought.
entries.zh:
Baird 闭上眼睛，扶了扶自己的眼镜，看上去有些恼火。也许是因为前任院长的失误。

她转过身对你说："现在很明显，速子科技 里有人在耍同样的把戏。也许 霸主 调查了相关机构之后，他们就转移了基地，他们已经预料到了 霸主 会有动作。"

"猜测的环节已经够长了。" Baird 想了一会儿后说。

o.en: Tell Coureuse about the Hamatsu hyperdrive modifications
o.zh: 告诉 Coureuse 关于 Hamatsu 号超空间引擎改装的事

entries.en:
Coureuse listens carefully to your recounting of the search for Kelise Astraia, of speaking with Callisto Ibrahim, and the strange Hamatsu hyperdrive modifications.

"Interesting," says Coureuse as the upload is completed.

The engineering diagrams of the Hamatsu flicker back and forth across her face as she scrolls through the specs. "This confirms a few theories we've been working on. And my thesis advisor- um, well if I'm not mistaken-" she freezes the display on a page of equations, "Ah! See right here? They used our work. I wonder how Tri-Tachyon got this. Provost Kallichore, I expect."
entries.zh:
Coureuse 仔细听你讲述了搜寻 Kelise Astraia 的过程，与 Callisto Ibrahim 的交谈，以及 Hamatsu 号超空间引擎的异常改动。

"很有意思，" 数据上传完毕后，Coureuse 说道。

她滚动浏览着详细设计参数，各种 Hamatsu 的工程图纸在她的脸上一闪而过。"这证实了我们正在研究的一些理论。还有我的博士论文导师的，呃，如果我没搞错的话 ——" 她把一整页的方程式停在了显示屏上，"啊！看到这个了吗？他们利用了我们的研究成果。我倒想知道速子科技是怎么得到这个的。是前任院长 Kallichore，我猜。"

o.en: It's a Transverse Jump device, right?
o.zh: 这是个横轴跳跃装置，对吗？

entries.en: "Yes!" Coureuse looks surprised and pleased, "It's all rather over-engineered when a simple software patch will do. It's fascinating to see how they've applied these principles to, ah, the hardware application. Experimentation and instrumental aspects of research were never my strong point," Coureuse admits. "I was into theory. Now that I'm back at the Academy, with the resources Baird is giving me..."
entries.zh: "没错！" Coureuse 看起来又惊又喜，"当一个简单的软件补丁就能解决问题时，所有的设计都是多余的。看他们把这些原则应用到，呃，硬件应用上，这很有意思。实验和操作从来都不是我的强项，" Coureuse 承认道。"我钻研的是理论。现在我回到了学院，有了 Baird 给我的资源..."

o.zh: 那，关于 Hamatsu 号的事。

entries.en: "Right. This ship, the Hamatsu. They went through all the trouble to modify the hyperdrive. That tells me that it went somewhere specific," Coureuse looks at you intensely, "If you found out where they used this, some special jump-point associated with a nascent gravity well that's... special, somehow. Unique? Hyperspatially-speaking?" Coureuse looks off somewhere, thinking again. "Perhaps not unique, but special."
entries.zh: "对。这艘船，Hamatsu 号，他们费了很大的劲来修改超空间引擎，我能从这一点看出它是被用来航向某个特别的地方的，" Coureuse 用热切的目光看着你，"你有在哪里发现他们用了这个装置吗，与亚临界重力井相关的特殊跳跃点？那从某种角度来说应该很... 特别。或者说独一无二的？用多维空间的话来说这对吗？" Coureuse 望向别处，再次思考了起来。"也许并不是独一无二的，但至少它很特别。"

entries.en: She puts down her datapad and stares into the distance, "How would such a phenomenon occur naturally?
