Gravitational slingshot of a planet that formed near a hyperspace-accessible primary launched away from its primary? I'd have to check with Astrometrics if..." Coureuse realizes you're still on the comms-call, "Oh, captain! My apologies. I think we're all done? I have a lot of- I need to talk to the rest of the team," she waves a hand, trying to express something inexpressible, "... Ideas. Bye."
entries.zh: 她放下数据平板，凝视着远方，"这种现象怎么能自然生成呢？是一颗可由超空间抵达的恒星附近形成的一颗行星，被引力弹弓甩离了那颗恒星吗？我得去问一下懂天体测量学的人，如果..." Coureuse 突然意识到她还在和你通话，"哦，舰长！非常抱歉。我想我们谈完了？我有很多 —— 我需要和团队的其他成员谈谈，" 她挥挥手，试图表达一些似乎根本表达不出来的东西，"... 一些想法。再见。"

entries.en:
The Tri-Tachyon $rank seems caught off guard by your ready agreement.

"I, I mean of course. The Tri-Tachyon Corporation thanks you for your cooperation in this matter. We shall of course arrange for a token payment for the recovery of company property - ah, of $entity.ttZigLowBuyPrice credits." $HeOrShe looks at you over the top of a TriPad, "Your discretion in this matter is assumed, of course."

The transfer of executive command functions proceeds smoothly.
entries.zh:
这位速子科技 $rank 看起来吃了一惊，似乎没有料到你会这么爽快地答应。

"我，嗯，这也是理所当然的。三一速子科技公司感谢您对此事的合作。当然，我们会为回收公司财产安排一笔象征性的费用...啊，数额是 $entity.ttZigLowBuyPrice 星币。" $HeOrShe的目光越过 TriPad 看向你，"当然，我们相信您会对此事谨慎保密。"

指挥权交接过程进行得很顺利。

entries.en: The Tri-Tachyon $rank smiles, "Now we're talking business, captain." $HeOrShe quickly consults a TriPad, then says "I'm prepared to offer $entity.ttZigBuyPrice credits as a 'consulting fee' in assisting in the recovery of the TTS Xenomorphica."
entries.zh: 这位速子科技 $rank 笑了起来，"总算谈到生意了，舰长。" $HeOrShe迅速查看了一下 TriPad，说道，"我很乐意提供 $entity.ttZigBuyPrice 星币，作为协助回收 TTS Xenorphica 过程的 '咨询费'。"

entries.en:
Once you signal agreement, the Tri-Tachyon officer is all cheer. $HeOrShe transfers the lordly sum of credits to you in exchange for the command codes of the Ziggurat-class hull.

$Rank $PersonName looks at you over the top of $hisOrHer TriPad, "Your discretion in this matter is assumed, of course," and gives another flinty smile. "It's been a pleasure doing business with you, captain."
entries.zh:
你示意同意以后，这位速子科技军官看起来欣喜若狂。$HeOrShe把这笔巨款转到了你的账户里。作为交换，你交出了通灵塔-级船体的指挥代码。

$Rank $PersonName 目光越过$hisOrHer的 TriPad 看向你，"当然，我们相信您会对此事谨慎保密，" 然后露出了一个冷硬的微笑，"和您做生意真是愉快，舰长。"

entries.en: "Gladly," says the Tri-Tachyon $rank with vicious satisfaction. The comms go dark.
entries.zh: "求之不得。" 这位速子科技 $rank 怀着邪恶的满足感说道。通讯被切断了。

entries.en:
The Tri-Tachyon $rank swallows uncomfortably, then says "That won't be necessary. We are running a business, not a slaughterhouse."

$HeOrShe pauses for a moment, unsure of how to proceed, then speaks. "You're making a terrible mistake, captain," $heOrShe says. "If that's what it comes to- a word of advice: the Tri-Tachyon Corporation is bigger than you, it's bigger than any person. It's bigger than all people, because it forms something greater than the sum of its components, human and otherwise."

"You'll never win." And with that, the Tri-Tachyon $rank cuts the comms as $hisOrHer fleet moves to disengage.
entries.zh:
这位速子科技 $rank 不自在地咽了口唾沫，然后说，"没有那个必要。我们经营的是生意，而不是屠宰场。"

$HeOrShe顿了顿，似乎是在再次开口前思考措辞。"你犯了个可怕的错误，舰长。" $heOrShe继续说道，"如果真的有那么一天的话 —— 给你提个醒：三一速子科技公司 比你庞大，比任何个体都庞大。它压倒一切，因为它超越了每个内在组成部分的总和，无论这些部分是人类或是非人类。"

"你赢不了的。" 这位 速子科技 $rank 就这样切断了通讯并命令$hisOrHer的舰队脱离接触。

entries.en: "We are well aware of the rights of salvage, captain," $heOrShe says, jaw tightening "But the Company views these as exceptional circumstances. A great deal of proprietary research has gone into that hull, and the Company expects to make good on its investment."
entries.zh: "我们当然知道打捞权，舰长。" $heOrShe咬牙切齿地说道，"但是我司认为这次是例外情况。我们在那艘船上倾注了太多的心血，也希望实现此次投资的价值。"

entries.en:
The Tri-Tachyon $rank seems caught cold, and pauses to swallow uncomfortably.

"I don't, um. The Tri-Tachyon Corporation makes no admission of responsibility or guilt in any matter covered by the cycle 194 Treaty of Crom Cruach," $heOrShe say automatically. "This conversation does not confirm or deny any speculation on your part as to the nature of the Tri-Tachyon property in question."

A cough. "I must reiterate my demand: return the TTS Xenorphica."
entries.zh:
这位 速子科技 $rank 似乎有些措不及防，停下来不自在地咽了口唾沫。

"我不...呃。三一速子科技公司 不承认星历 194 年签署的 Crom Cruach 条约中列出的任何责任与罪行。" $heOrShe机械地说，"本次对话既不证实、亦不否认你对于 速子科技 资产性质的任何推测。"

一声轻咳。"我必须重申我的要求：归还 TTS Xenorphica。"

o.en: Threaten to give the Hegemony access to the Ziggurat hull
o.zh: 威胁说让 霸主 拿到 通灵塔-级 的船体

entries.en:
The Tri-Tachyon $rank's face seems to freeze in place as you explain that, in your opinion, the technology on this ship definitely appears to break the Treaty of Crom Cruach, which ended the 2nd AI War. That is, it would if it were developed by Tri-Tachyon.

And if the Hegemony Ministry of Technology Standards hypothetically received your survey of a Tri-Tachyon black site, the so-called "Alpha Site", where such technology was developed.

Hypothetically.

"We'll be in touch," the $rank hisses. The comm cuts to a Tri-Tachyon logo.
entries.zh:
这位 速子科技 $rank 的表情似乎僵在了脸上。你指出，你认为这艘船上使用的科技明显违反了 Crom Cruach 条约，那份终结了第二次 AI 战争的条约。当然，前提是这艘船确实是 速子科技 所制造的。

假如 霸主 的科技标准部从你那收到了 速子科技 的秘密实验场，也就是所谓的 "阿尔法研究站" 的调查数据。

现在还只是假如。

"我们会再见的，" 这位 $rank 嘟哝道。通讯被切断了，只剩下一个 速子科技 标志。

entries.en: "So," he says, tapping a few keys on his desk console "You have the files. Go find a pirate who'll try to exploit me for all I'm worth." Arroyo grins.
entries.zh: "所以，" 他敲了敲桌面的控制台上的几个键，"你已经拿到文件了，现在去找个会试着把我敲诈到一无所有的海盗来。" Arroyo 咧嘴一笑。

o.en: How about some credits to help this job along?
o.zh: 来点星币，让这活儿更顺当如何？

o.en: Ask for help getting info on Kelise Astraia
o.zh: 请求帮助获取关于 Kelise Astraia 的信息

entries.en:
"It's a gift, is what it is," he says, "Dead easy. I just need someone else to do it. Here," Arroyo taps a key and a data transfer interface overlays your comm-view. He's sending an archive containing a series of comms recordings.

"This is a series of fake comms messages in which some leaky subcontractor proves that I was part of the conspiracy to hack the Hegemony relay in Aztlan. Take this to someone, I don't care who, someone semi-important in some pirate organization or other. Try Donn, or go to Qaras in the Yma system. Doesn't matter. Have them blackmail me with these messages."
entries.zh:
"这活就是白送钱。" 他说，"简单得要命，我只是需要有人来做这件事。喏，" Arroyo 轻触了某个按键，接着一个数据传输界面覆盖了你的通信视图，看起来他正在发送一份包含一系列通讯录音的档案。

"这是些虚假的通信信息，内容是某个嘴碎的联络人提到了我是入侵 Aztlan 星系中的那处 霸主 通讯中继站的密谋者之一。把它随便交给某人，我不在乎是谁，哪个海盗或什么组织的二把手都行。你可去 Donn 碰碰运气，或者去 Yma 星系的 Qaras。总之让他们用这些信息勒索我。"

o.en: You want my help to run a convoluted disinformation campaign.
o.zh: 看起来你是想让我帮你弄出一次复杂的造谣活动。

o.en: But you did take part in the conspiracy.
o.zh: 但你确实参与了那次密谋。

o.en: Why are you leaking evidence against yourself?
o.zh: 你为什么要泄露会对自己不利的证据？

entries.en:
"Is it you asking or Provost Baird?" he says in a tone that says he thinks it's Baird. "Doesn't matter," he slaps a hand on his desk and looks away, chewing on the problem.

"So. Tri-Tachyon employee huh? It's not terribly hard to pry data out of HR, to say nothing of franchise polity muni services. If you know who to ask, and how." He manages a half-smile, "And you're me," then turns back to face you.

"After taking some real heat from that last misbegotten crashdown of an operation you pulled, I'm going to need a little favor before I help you help Baird."
entries.zh:
"这问题是你自己问的还是 Baird 院长让你问的？" 虽然嘴上这么说着，你却听得出来他已经认定这是 Baird 院长让你问的问题了，接着他把一只手拍在桌子上，挪开目光沉思起来，"算了，无需回答。"

"你要找一个 速子科技 的员工对吗？只要你知道该问谁和该怎么问，从人力资源部门获取数据并不难，更不用说拥有市政特权的情况 —— 有我帮助的情况下了。" 他勉强挤出一丝微笑，然后转过身来面对着你。

"上次你的行动搞砸了一些东西，这让我备受打击，所以在我帮你以便让你能帮 Baird 之前，我需要你帮个小忙。"

o.en: Can you help me find Kelise Astraia?
o.zh: 你能帮我找找 Kelise Astraia 吗？

entries.en:
"You asked! Oh, joy of joys." Gargoyle rocks back and forth, as if in the throes of ecstasy. "That's all it takes: asking nicely. You know, it's not everyone that can bring themselves to do that."

Gargoyle smiles spitefully, then pauses, visibly calms down, and puts on a facade of professionalism. "It is an honor to assist you with this mission, captain. I will do my duty to my utmost."
entries.zh:
"你问了！噢，太美妙了。" Gargoyle 来回晃动，似乎沉浸在狂喜之中，"友好地请求 —— 这就是想得到答案时最需要做的，但你知道并不是每个人都能做到这点。"

Gargoyle 邪笑了一阵子，然后强迫自己冷静了下来，并装出一副官方的口吻："很荣幸在这项任务中协助你，舰长。我会尽我最大的努力。"

entries.en:
The officer act is dropped as the hacker picks up a datapad, "This doesn't have to be difficult. It's Tri-Tach, they'll sell anything. Just ask my buddy Arroyo! He's a Tri-Tach goon top to bottom, he'll know who to bribe."

Gargoyle tosses the datapad onto the desk, looking satisfied. "Glad I could help, captain. I'm sure I'll prove essential to your success".
entries.zh:
当黑客拿起数据平板时，他刚刚装出来的客套模样消失得无影无踪。"这并不难，要知道这可是 速子科技，只要价码合适，他们什么都会卖的。问问我的朋友 Arroyo 吧！他是一个彻头彻尾的 速子科技 大佬，他肯定知道该贿赂谁。"

Gargoyle 把数据平板扔到了桌上，看起来他对自己的表现很满意："能帮上忙我很高兴，舰长。我相信我能证明我对你的成功是必不可少的。"

o.en: I'll be honest, that was a little underwhelming.
o.zh: 说实话，这有点令人失望。

entries.en:
"Well I'll be honest too," says Gargoyle, "You're very welcome for the gift of my spare time."

With that, the hackers' comms disconnect leaving you with a blank feed.
entries.zh:
"好吧，我也实话实说，" Gargoyle 阴阳怪气地说，"你随便浪费我的空闲时间，还真是感谢啊。"

说完后，黑客的通讯就断开了，留在你面前的只有空无一物的显示屏。

o.en: What was that you were saying about 'Project Ziggurat'?
o.zh: 你刚才说的 '通灵塔计划' 到底是什么？

entries.en:
"Hello, this is Callisto Ibrahim of Ibrahim Interstellar Transport and Salvage."

She frowns and looks you over, assessing, "If you're looking for work I've got all the pilots I need right now, but I can take your comms ID in case something comes up."
entries.zh:
"你好，我是 Ibrahim 星际运输与打捞公司的 Callisto Ibrahim。"

她皱着眉头打量了你一会，评估道："如果你在找工作，现在不太合适，我目前手下的飞行员已经足够了，但我可以先记下你的通讯 ID，以后有需求再联系。"

entries.en:
She returns her focus to the schematics, zooming in.

"I've had my techs have a look. It seems to be an addition, an enhancement, to the drive field. Press a button and it pumps in a lot of energy all at once, pushes the envelope into a strange harmonic. Theoretically it won't do anything hazardous to the ship, but messing with the default settings of the hyperdrive is never a good way to stay in this business."

"Or alive."
entries.zh:
她把注意力放回了图纸上，并将屏幕聚焦在了高亮的修改部分

"我已经让技术人员看了一遍。这里似乎对驱动场进行了补充，更准确地说，加装了一个增强装置。按下激活按钮，它就会立刻注入大量能量，把覆盖舰船的驱动场变成一种奇怪的谐波。理论上它不会对舰船造成任何危险，但擅自改动超空间引擎的默认设置，可不是在这行长久干下去的好方法。"

"或者说，活命的方法。"

entries.en:
It is a storage room. A couple folding chairs are set at a drooping table. Bright patterns crawl across an old lighting tube. A pot of tea steams between two simple cups.

You recognize the Pather terrorist sitting in one of the chairs.
entries.zh:
这是一间储藏室，一张矮桌旁摆放着两把折叠椅，老旧的灯管布满了明暗不均的光斑，有两个朴素的茶杯围着一壶还冒着热气的茶放着。

你认识坐在其中一把椅子上的左径恐怖分子。

entries.en:
It is a storage room. A couple folding chairs are set at a drooping table. Bright patterns crawl across an old lighting tube. A pot of tea steams between two simple cups.

A Pather terrorist sits in one of the chairs.
entries.zh:
这是一间储藏室，一张矮桌旁摆放着两把折叠椅，老旧的灯管布满了明暗不均的光斑，有两个朴素的茶杯围着一壶还冒着热气的茶放着。

一名左径分子坐在其中一把椅子上。

entries.en:
"Well if it isn't Captain $playername." Brother Livewell Cotton beams a smile at you, "I am so glad to see you again in good health by the grace of sweet Ludd."

With a small motion he offers you his hand to shake in greeting.
entries.zh:
"这不是 $playername 舰长吗。" Livewell Cotton 修士向你投来一个微笑，"卢德保佑，很高兴见到你身心强健。"

他向你微微致意，并伸出手和你握手。

entries.en:
"Brother Livewell Cotton, at your service and pleased to meet you, Captain $playername. With blessings of Ludd and all that naturally."

He winks at this, then offers a hand for you to shake.
entries.zh:
"我是 Livewell Cotton 修士，能和你见面很荣幸，$playername 舰长。愿卢德与一切自然的祝福常伴你左右。"

他眨了眨眼，随后伸手和你握手。

entries.en:
"This Ziggurat, what it will bring... it is my greatest fear and, I confess, my greatest hope. It is clear to me that you hold the tool of the Adversary that will end the world."

He pauses now, and stares intently at you, then nods. "I am not asking you to set it down, exactly," he pauses, trying to find the words, "It is the tool of evil, yes, but imagine a smallarm set within reach of a child. I am asking-" he closes his eyes now, "-that when it comes time for you to decide what you will need to do, you follow the Path of light."
entries.zh:
"'通灵塔'，它所预示的...既是我最深的恐惧，也是我最大的希望，坦白来说。但有件事我非常明白，你已经手握着大敌的工具，足以毁灭世界。"

他顿了顿，看向你，目光如炬。然后他点了点头，"我并不是说要你把它丢掉。" 他斟酌着字句，"它是邪恶的工具，勿容置疑。然后你再想象一下把随身枪械放在孩童触手能及的地方会是什么情况。所以我恳请你..." 他闭上了双眼，"...当你不得不为自己的将来做出抉择的时刻到来时，我希望你能选择光之道途。"

o.en: I'll... think about what you've said.
o.zh: 我会... 好好想想你所说的。

o.en: What does 'the Path of light' even mean?
o.zh: 你说的 '光之道途' 又是指什么？

o.en: I'm not sure you're taking into consideration the complexity of the situation.
o.zh: 你或许还没意识到这整件事的复杂性。

entries.en: He speaks quietly, feverishly, wide-eyed, "They call me a murderer, a terrorist. But no doubt dwells in my soul, captain. None at all."
entries.zh: 他眼神纯洁，平静而不失狂热地说道，"别人叫我杀人凶手，恐怖分子。但我的灵魂里没有半点疑惑，舰长。一点都没有。"

entries.en:
A pause, then a dark look crosses Cotton's face.

"Captain, I must declare that it is grim tidings indeed that bring me to begging audience with you. We do see there that you operate a truly unholy creation, this 'Ziggurat'-class starship. For it is born of the womb of Tri-Tachyon greed, the product of meddling in places that human hand ought not reach."
entries.zh:
Cotton 顿了顿，脸沉了下来。

"舰长，我就跟你挑明了说吧，我是因为最近收到的严峻的消息才不得不以这种方式与你见一面。我们见识到了你麾下那不洁的造物，就是这艘 '通灵塔'-级。速子科技 的贪婪孕育了它，它是人类不应涉足之领域的产物。"

entries.en:
A pause, then a dark look crosses Cotton's face.

"Captain, I must declare that it is grim tidings indeed that bring me to begging audience with you. We have seen you operating a truly unholy creation, a 'Ziggurat'-class starship. For it is born of the womb of Tri-Tachyon greed, the product of meddling in places that human hand ought not reach."

He meets your look, "Now don't look surprised captain, there are many eyes and ears upon the daisy that stands so tall as you do. And you stand tall indeed."
entries.zh:
Cotton 顿了顿，脸沉了下来，

"舰长，我就跟你挑明了说吧，我是因为最近收到的严峻的消息才不得不以这种方式与你见一面。我们见识到了你麾下那不洁的造物，就是这艘 '通灵塔'-级。速子科技 的贪婪孕育了它，它是人类不应涉足之领域的产物。"

他对上了你的目光，"别显得如此意外，舰长，和你一样身居高位的贵人身边不乏我们的耳目。而且你的确身居高位。"

o.en: Didn't you send some rogue Luddic Knight to attack me?
o.zh: 你不是已经派了些无赖卢德骑士来攻击我了吗？
DEV 测试 cotton gaPZ 对话

entries.en:
The Diktat $rank appears in your comm display, outwardly calm.

"Captain $playerName. I hope I find you well? I understand you've been involved in a, ah, misunderstanding recently." The $rank straightens $hisOrHer uniform, clearly uncomfortable. "I have been ordered to make a statement."

$HeOrShe lifts a datapad from out of view and begins reading.

"From the office of the Chief High Inspector, the Sindrian Diktat would like to acknowledge that your previous encounter with our special self-defense forces over the matter of a, hmm, starship expropriation order was, ah..."

$HeOrShe looks away, speaking, "The officer in question acted rashly, without clarifying their orders with High Command. The Sindrian Diktat considers the incident to be the rogue action of a deep-cover terrorist sympathizer whose goal was to undermine the authority and glory of our leader, Supreme Executor Admiral Andrada."
entries.zh:
这位辛达强权 $rank 的身影出现了，你隔着屏幕都能感受到对方的镇静。

"$playerName 舰长。近来可好？我了解到您最近被卷入了一场，啊，误会。" 这位 $rank 抻了抻身上的制服，那制服显然穿起来并不舒服。"我受命向您通报一件事情。"

$HeOrShe从屏幕外拿出一块数据平板，照着上面的字念起来。

"来自 辛达强权 最高检察长办公室的消息，辛达强权希望您了解，您之前与我方特别自卫部队关于一道星舰征收命令的遭遇，是一次，啊..."

$HeOrShe往别处看了看，继续说道，"涉事官员行动鲁莽，并且未向最高指挥部确认命令细节。辛达强权 现宣布，该事件为潜伏的恐怖分子同情者的擅自行动，其目标是污蔑我们的领袖，最高元首 Andrada 上将的威名和荣光。"

entries.en: You order the main display turned on. The Diktat officer appears, already barking orders. "You have entered Sindrian Diktat space as a known operator of an, an unregistered class of starship, the so-called Ziggurat-class hull. By order of Supreme Executor Andrada, victory-be-his-alone, we claim the right to perform a thorough scan of all anomalous ship systems to ascertain their propriety in the interest of the security of the Sindrian Diktat."
entries.zh: 你下令打开主显示器，画面中出现了一位辛达军官的身影，厉声命令道，"你在 辛达强权 疆域内持有一艘未登记的舰船，呃，你所谓的 通灵塔-级 舰船。根据最高元首 Andrada 的命令 —— 愿胜利独属于他 —— 我们有权对任何异常的舰船系统进行扫描，以确保它们不会危害到 辛达强权 的安全。"

o.en: I don't appear to have an example of this ship class in my fleet.
o.zh: 我的舰队里似乎没有这么一艘船。

entries.en:
The Diktat $rank's jaw tightens.

"Of course. I know that," $heOrShe spits. "But if you did, we would have the right to perform a thorough stop-and-scan, and even board, and- " $heOrShe trails off, realizing the impotence of these statements.

"We're watching you. Closely. Be on your way now, captain. Long live the Lion of Sindria!"

The comms-link snaps off, leaving you with a holding signal.
entries.zh:
这位辛达强权 $rank 紧绷着下巴。

"我当然知道了。" $heOrShe不屑道，"但如果你真的带着这艘船出现了，那么我们有权进行一次彻底的截停扫描，若有必要还可以登舰，而且 ——" $heOrShe停了下来，意识到这些话语有多么无力。

"我们在盯着你。仔细地盯着。你现在可以走了，舰长。辛达瑞亚之狮万岁！"

通讯链接被关闭了，留给你的只有忙线标志。

entries.en:
You order the main display turned on. The Diktat officer appears, already barking orders. "You have entered Sindrian Diktat space while operating an unregistered class of starship! We claim right to perform a thorough scan of all ship systems, and said scan shall begin- now," $heOrShe waves a command to an underling.

Your sensors officer whispers a report to you, "Captain, they're performing an active scan. Trying to see everything. But this ship?" They give the hint of a smile, "Doesn't give up secrets easily."
entries.zh:
你下令打开主显示器，画面中出现了一位辛达军官的身影，其厉声命令道，"你在 辛达强权 疆域内持有一艘未登记的舰船！我们有权对该舰船系统进行一次彻底的扫描，扫描将 —— 立即开始。" $heOrShe挥挥手，对一位下属下令。

你的传感器技官轻声汇报道，"舰长，他们正在进行一次主动扫描，想获得所有信息。不过这艘船？" 他不动声色地笑了笑，"它对于保守秘密可是很在行。"

entries.en:
A bead of sweat finds its way down the Diktat $post's face as $hisOrHer eyes are clearly taking in the results on another screen. "... Yes, good, good. We have everything we need to... ah, ascertain that your starship is approved for interstellar commerce. You may proceed, captain. Victory to Sindria!"

The Diktat $rank signs off in a rush to report back, you assume, to Diktat INTSEC. You rest assured that your bridge crew is confident that the peculiar technologies of the Ziggurat-class are safe from a mere scan-at-distance patrol stop.
entries.zh:
一滴汗珠从这位辛达强权 $post 的脸上滑落，$hisOrHer的眼睛显然在看另一块屏幕上的扫描结果。"... 是的，很好，很好。我们收集了足够的信息来... 啊，确定你的舰船可以参与星际贸易。你可以走了，舰长。胜利属于辛达！"

这位辛达强权 $rank 急匆匆地离开了，你猜是赶着去和辛达强权的情报机构汇报扫描结果。你和你的舰桥成员都很有自信，通灵塔-级 所使用的奇异科技并非区区一次远程扫描就能破译的。

entries.en:
You order the main display turned on, and the Diktat officer appears, already barking orders. "You have entered Sindrian Diktat space while operating an illegal class of starship. Power down your engines!"

"By the power vested in me by the authority of Philip Andrada, the Diktat Supreme Executor, I-" a drop of sweat finds its way down $hisOrHer face,"-I declare that this ship is now property of the Sindrian Diktat. You shall stand down all weapon systems and shields then transfer command protocols to my flagship."
entries.zh:
你下令打开主显示器，画面中出现的这位辛达军官厉声命令道，"你在 辛达强权 疆域内持有一艘非法舰船。立即熄灭引擎！"

"由辛达强权最高元首 Philip Andrada 授予我的权力，我在此宣布 ——" 一滴汗珠从$hisOrHer脸上滑落，"—— 这艘船现在是 辛达强权 所有财产。请你关闭所有武器和护盾，然后将指挥权移交给我的旗舰。"

o.en: This is unnecessary. I am commissioned by the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 这没有必要。我和 辛达强权 签有一份雇佣协议。

o.en: My fleet will defend itself if you attempt to seize my ship.
o.zh: 如果你强行夺取我的船，我的舰队将只能选择自卫。
把 通灵塔-级 藏起来

o.en: How about some kind of compensation?
o.zh: 那能给我一些小小的补偿吗？

o.en: As you wish. (surrender the Ziggurat-class hull)
o.zh: 如你所愿。 (交出 通灵塔-级 船体)

entries.en:
"Although advancement of industry and innovation is within the interests of the Hegemony and restoration of the Domain," $heOrShe speaks almost automatically, as if from a bureaucrat's script "Certain oversight and limitations are necessary for the safety of all. Let this be notice that the Ministry of Technology Standards declares its intent to reassure the Domain-successor commonwealth of the Hegemony by ensuring compliance of your so-called Ziggurat-class hull with the terms of the cycle 194 Treaty of Crom Cruach," $hisOrHer eyes look up at yours, "which concluded the Second AI War"

The Hegemony $personRank concludes without emotion, "Consider this a warning." $HeOrShe then cuts the comms without saying so much as 'burn bright'.
entries.zh:
"尽管工业上的进步和革新与 霸主 的利益，乃至 人之领 的复兴相符合..." $heOrShe像在背诵演讲稿的官僚那样机械般地说出这段话，"但为了保护所有人的安全，我们有必要对此适当监管和限制。请你知会，科技标准部在此宣布，我们将全力辅佐 人之领 的继承者，即 霸主 联合体，为此我们会确保你那所谓的 通灵塔-级 船体完全遵守星历 194 年签署的 Crom Cruach 条约，" $hisOrHer的目光和你对上，"就是那份标志着第二次 AI 战争结束的条约。"

这位霸主 $personRank 毫无感情地结束道，"请你将这次谈话视作警告。" 接着，$HeOrShe切断了通讯，连一句惯例的 '航行无阻' 都没有说。

entries.en: "Good day, captain," the Hegemony $personRank says crisply. "A hull class of extraordinarily non-standard provenance was recently detected in your fleet by long-range sensors."
entries.zh: "你好，舰长，" 这位 霸主 $personRank 用清脆的声音说道。" 我们的远程传感器最近探测到你的舰队中有一艘来源非常神秘的舰船。"

entries.en: "Good day, captain," the Hegemony $personRank says crisply. "Our sensors detect a ship hull class of non-standard provenance."
entries.zh: "你好，舰长，" 这位 霸主 $personRank 用清脆的声音说道。" 我们的传感器探测到一艘来源未知的舰船。"

entries.en:
"You are ordered to undergo a standard safety scan of the," the Hegemony $personRank's eyes flick down to read something, "-the $zigguratShipName, as authorized under the Interstellar Transit Accords of cycle 81."

$PersonRank $personLastName looks directly at you again, and without expression says "We wish to avoid any accidents due to allowing transit of an unproven class of ship hull through Hegemony space."

Impressive composure for such a bald-faced lie.
entries.zh:
"根据星历81年颁布的 [星际过境协定]，请接受我们对 ——" 这位 霸主 $personRank 垂下眼睛看了看什么东西，"—— 对 $zigguratShipName 进行例行安全检查。"

$personLastName $PersonRank 直直地看着你，面无表情地说道，"我们不希望看到因这艘未经认证的舰船自由过境而在 霸主 疆域内引发任何意外事故。"

居然能面不改色地胡说八道。

o.en: Appeal on the basis of your Hegemony commission
o.zh: 利用你的 霸主 雇佣协议提出申诉

o.en: Let the Hegemony go through with their scan
o.zh: 允许 霸主 官员进行扫描

o.en: Deny the Hegemony access to your Ziggurat-class ship
o.zh: 拒绝 霸主 官员登上 通灵塔-级
让 通灵塔-级 消失

entries.en:
As your $shipOrFleet follows the automated instructions of local traffic control into a parking orbit, your comms officer calls for your attention.

"Captain," your comms officer says, "It's an Academician Sebestyen. He'd like to speak with you."
entries.zh:
当你的$shipOrFleet按照当地交通管制系统自动下达的指令进入停泊轨道时，通讯军官向你请求指示。

"舰长，" 通讯军官说，"是 Sebestyen 院士，他想和你谈谈。"

entries.en:
Academician Sebestyen appears, fidgeting, in your display.

"Captain! Hello, how are you?" he says, then stammers "I mean, I'm sorry, I'm supposed to tell you- ask you. Provost Baird would like to meet with you concerning a very important development. If you would please come meet her as soon as, um, at your convenience, that'd be wonderful." He pauses for a breath. "That's it. I'm sure we'll see you soon. Thank you. Bye?"

You manage to close the comms link with unusually little small-talk from Sebestyen.
entries.zh:
Sebestyen 院士出现在了通讯画面中，他看上去坐立不安。

"舰长！近况如何？" 他先打了个招呼，然后结结巴巴地继续开口道，"不，抱歉，我是来向您告知 —— 向您请求一件事的。Baird 院长想见你一面，商量一件很重要的事。如果您能马上 —— 不，在您方便时来见她一面，那就太好了。" 他停下来喘了口气，"就是这样。我相信我们很快就会再度碰面的。谢谢你，再见！"

你设法切断了通讯链接，Sebestyen 一反常态，几乎没怎么寒暄。

entries.en:
"Oh?" The junior academy agent raises their eyebrows at you, making a show of believing your statement while checking their datapad.

"Oh." You see the truth register on their face, "Oh! Yes. Immediately. Please $playerSirOrMadam, if you would be so kind as to come with me right away, we'll get you to your meeting with Provost Baird."
entries.zh:
"哦？" 初级学院事务代理对你扬起眉毛，作出相信你的陈述的样子并开始检查数据平板。

"喔。" 你从对方脸上看到了预期的结果，"喔！的确如此。$playerSirOrMadam，我们随时可以带您去与 Baird 院长会面，如果您能立马跟我来的话那真是太棒了。"

entries.en:
You enter the provost's office once again. Baird's desk is messier than usual, covered in memory cores, interfacing devices, and an anonymous matte-gray case.

"Good. Now that you're here, I believe Gargoyle should be joining us via comms-" Baird's eyes flick, annoyed, to a portable holocomms unit on her desk where an image of the hacker's head is intently paying attention to something else.
entries.zh:
你又一次走进了院长的办公室。Baird 的桌子看上去比平时更乱，上面放着数据存储核心、转接设备和一个奇怪的哑光灰色盒子。

"很好，你来了，我相信 Gargoyle 应该会通过通讯器来加入会谈。" Baird 恼火地瞟了一眼桌上的便携式全息通讯器，从显示上的全像来看，通讯另一头的黑客显然心不在焉地盯着别的东西。

entries.en:
Baird turns fully toward you and begins her speech. "Having examined the decrypted Kallichore Archive-" this catches Gargoyle's attention "-we now have hard leads on a certain collaboration my predecessor carried out with senior executives of the Tri-Tachyon corporation."

"Tri-Tachyon pursued research forbidden by the Hegemony at a location outside the core worlds referred to only by the code-name 'Alpha Site'. The archived communications have been algorithmically stripped of contextual descriptions. However." Baird pauses, seeming to relish the moment of knowing something that you do not.
entries.zh:
Baird 把身子转向了你，开始了她的发言。"在解密并检查 Kallichore 的档案之后 ——" 这引起了 Gargoyle 的注意，"我们现在有了前任院长与 速子科技 高层勾结的确凿证据。"

"速子科技 在核心世界之外一个代号为 '阿尔法研究站' 的地方进行被 霸主 禁止的研究。这些已经记录下来的通讯文件被算法剥离后或许能推测出其含义的上下文描述。然而，" Baird 停顿了一下，似乎在享受自己知晓你所不了解的一些事情的时刻。

entries.en:
"There are many signs that an individual with the surname 'Astraia' is involved. Who we are almost certain is-"

Gargoyle interrupts, "-Kelise Astraia, former weapons engineer employed at the Culann Starforge in the Hybrasil system by Tri-Tach. And rather underpaid in light of how essential the suits seem to have thought she was to the project."

Baird sets her jaw, "Thank you, Gargoyle," she says. "Kindly elaborate for the captain here."

The hacker grins, "Love to! So TT 'fired' Kelise over some incident, but if you look at her credit records... " A couple taps and the display fills with tables and numbers, "There are recurring payments, we're talking massive credits, something to do with 'Project Ziggurat', whatever that is. It sure makes up for her low salary at Culann, and... "
entries.zh:
"有很多迹象表明，这其中有一名参与者的姓氏是 'Astraia'。我们几乎可以断定，这个人就是 ——"

Gargoyle 打断道："Kelise Astraia，前武器工程师，受雇于 速子科技，在 Hybrasil 星系的 Culann 星际锻炉工作。考虑到高层似乎认为此人对这个项目至关重要，她的薪水未免低得令人生疑。"

Baird 抬起下巴："谢谢你，Gargoyle，现在请你给这位舰长详细说明一下 '低得令人生疑' 具体是指什么。"

黑客笑了："很乐意！回归正题，速子科技因为一些事件 '解雇' 了 Kelise，但如果你看看她的账户流水..." 黑客轻触了某些按钮，接着屏幕上出现了表格和数字，"你看这几笔有规律的入账记录，每笔都是数额高得惊人的星币，看上去与一个不知道具体是什么的 '通灵塔项目' 有关。这弥补了她在 Culann 的低工资，而且..."

entries.en:
Using one hand to slide the volume control of the holocomm unit down low, Baird keeps her gaze on you.

"We think Kelise Astraia was promoted to this 'Alpha Site'," she says. "Obviously there are others involved, but she's a senior ordnance engineer that's clearly connected to the project. And her infosec practices were sloppy."

"I want to know what Tri-Tachyon was doing at this Alpha Site. Our best lead so far is Kelise Astraia. Go to Hybrasil and find out where she disappeared to. Someone must know where she's gone, or has some evidence of her intentions. Tri-Tachyon watches everyone; someone will be willing to sell you that information."
entries.zh:
Baird 盯着你，伸出一只手把全息通信装置的音量调低。

"我们认为 Kelise Astraia 其实是升职了，并且被派到了这个 '阿尔法研究站'。"她说道，"显然还有其他人参与其中，不过她是一名高级军械工程师，她的学识显然和这个项目有关，只是她在信息保密方面的工作太草率了点。"

"我想知道 速子科技 在 阿尔法研究站 到底做了什么。我们目前最好的线索就是 Kelise Astraia。去 Hybrasil，找找她去了哪。肯定有人知道她去了哪里或者有她正打算做什么。速子科技 到处都有眼线；一定有人会愿意把这些信息卖给你。"

entries.en:
Baird turns and stares through the shaded diamond-matrix windows overlooking the annexes and concourses of the Galatia Academy.

"I'm sure that you can find her for me, captain. Just like you found Coureuse."
entries.zh:
Baird 转过身，目光穿过不甚透明的金刚石方窗，俯瞰着 Galatia 学院的附属建筑和港区。

"我相信你能帮我找到她，舰长。就像你之前找到 Coureuse 一样。"

o.en: Inform the agent that the Provost is expecting you for a meeting
o.zh: 通知工作人员院长正准备见你一面

entries.en:
The comms flicker and stabilize, the serious face of a Luddic Knight appears before you, dotted by holo-snow.

"You are here, just as Brother Cotton foretold," $heOrShe says, "I meet you $playername, and in my right hand I hold the hammer of Ludd, and in my left hand I wield the sword. Will you repent and turn from the path of evil to follow the blessed Path of Ludd?"

There seems to be some barely-restrained expectation behind $hisOrHer words, a slow anger distilled over years into a force more pure by far.
entries.zh:
通讯闪烁了一会才稳定下来，布满噪点的屏幕上出现了一位表情严肃的卢德骑士。

"正如 Cotton 修士所料，你果然在这。" $heOrShe说，"$playername，我与你兵戈相见，举在我右手的是卢德之锤，握在我左手的则是卢德之剑。你是否愿意悔改，从邪恶之路上回头，就此踏上至善的卢德之道吗？"

$hisOrHer的话语背后似乎有一些难以抑制的期待，就像多年来累积的愤怒凝聚成的一股更加纯净的力量。

o.en: I wish to repent and follow the Path of Ludd.
o.zh: 我当悔过，并追随卢德之道。

entries.en: "Captain," the Luddic $rank glances down, reading something "Captain $playerName. I greet you in the spirit of Ludd's peace, and may blessings be upon you."
entries.zh: "舰长。" 这位 卢德教会 $rank 低下头，读着什么东西，"$playerName 舰长。我本着卢德的和平精神向你致意，愿卢德保佑你。"

entries.en: "Our order's signal intercept conclave has detected a ship of, ah, unusual provenance in operation under your command. The Bishop-Admiral meditated upon this matter, and has concluded that the appearance of this... form... is a matter of great spiritual unease. 'The locusts will hatch from the temple of the Adversary', to quote from the revelations of Ludd, blessings be.
entries.zh: "我们骑士团下属的信号拦截密会最近探测到了，呃，你的舰队中有一艘来源不明的舰船。我们的大主教-上将对此事进行了冥想，得出的结论是，这一...形式...的出现，会带来精神层面上的极度不安。就像卢德的启示所说的那样，'蝗虫从大敌的神庙中孵化出来'。愿卢德保佑。

entries.en: "Our order's long-range signal intercept conclave has recently detected a ship of, ah, unusual provenance in operation under your command. The Bishop-Admiral meditated upon this matter, and has concluded that the appearance of this... form... is a matter of great spiritual unease. 'The locusts will hatch from the temple of the Adversary', to quote from the revelations of Ludd, blessings be.
entries.zh: "我们骑士团下属的远程信号拦截密会最近探测到了，呃，你的舰队中曾有一艘来源不明的舰船。我们的大主教-上将对此事进行了冥想，得出的结论是，这一...形式...的出现，会带来精神层面上的极度不安。就像卢德的启示所说的那样，'蝗虫从大敌的神庙中孵化出来'。愿卢德保佑。

entries.en: The Knight of Ludd looks at you in earnest, and says "We will watch you closely, with hammer in one hand and sword in the other." The words lack overt aggression; more a statement of duty than a threat.
entries.zh: 这位卢德骑士团的成员严肃地看着你，说道 "我们将密切地观察你，一手持锤，一手执剑。" 这些话语并没有明显的攻击性，比起威胁更像是声明自己的职责。

o.en: Is that it? Why did you stop me?
o.zh: 就这点事？为什么你要把我拦下来？

o.en: I will take your warning seriously.
o.zh: 我会认真考虑你的警告。

o.en: Message received. I'll be on my way now.

entries.en:
The comms open and you are faced with a dead-eyed mercenary captain.

"$PlayerName," $heOrShe says, "You have been looking in places that you should not be looking. Talking to people you should not be talking to. Asking questions that you should not be asking. Your death will be a lesson for others."

$HeOrShe moves with unconcerned deliberation to switch off the comms.
entries.zh:
通讯接通了，你面对的是一个顶着死鱼眼的雇佣舰长。

"$playername。" $heOrShe说，"你一直在关注你不应该关注的事，和你不应该交谈的人交谈，问一些不该问的问题。相信你的死会给其他人一个教训。"

$HeOrShe傲慢地将手伸向切断通讯的按钮。

o.en: Wait! Who are you working for?
Stop! I can pay you off.
o.zh: 别急！我可以开出合适的价码。

o.en: Cut comm link and prepare for combat

entries.en:
At first scan, this appears to be a utilitarian probe or instrument platform of the sort used for commercial navigation signaling, staking mining claims, and intra-system comm relays.

Closer approach reveals a crumbled mass of stealth cladding torn from the hull and drifting in near orbit. Whoever put this platform here did not want it to be found - but a small meteor swarm or, perhaps, light weapons fire thwarted their efforts. Radiation sensors indicate a damaged nuclear battery within. No significant artificial EM activity is apparent.
entries.zh:
初步扫描结果显示，这似乎是一种实用的探测器或仪器搭载平台，用于发射商业导航信号，宣称矿脉所有权和协助内环星系的通讯。

靠得更近之后，你发现有什么在附近的轨道上漂浮着，那似乎是一大块被从平台上割裂下来的隐形覆层。由此不难推测，把这个平台放在这里的人并不想让它被发现，可一群小流星亦或是轻武器的射弹让他们的努力付之一炬。辐射传感器显示里面有损坏的核电池，但并未在其中发现明显的人工电磁活动。

entries.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, preventing you from sending an EVA team to examine the probe.
entries.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，阻止了你派出舱外活动小组去检查探测器。

entries.en:
Arroyo seems genuinely amused when he answers the comms, "Ah, $playername! My ruthless blackmailer returns," he pauses for a moment and chuckles to himself while scrolling through a datapad.

"You should see the things they're saying about me, you'd think they caught me on holo in the High Hegemon's private quarters having a-" he looks up, "... Business, yes, of course." He tosses the datapad to the side.

"You wanted the file on Kelise Astraia." He grins, "I didn't even have to bribe the admin at Culann Starforge for this. Would you believe that we worked together a few cycles ago? There's a story there, but let me tell you about your weapons engineer."
entries.zh:
在接入通讯链接时，Arroyo 似乎真的被逗乐了："啊，$playername！我无情的勒索者回来了。" 他停顿了一下，一边检查数据平板一边暗自发笑。

"你应该听听他们是怎么说我的，你会以为他们手上有一套全息投影记录，还是关于我在至高霸主的私人房间里 —— " 他抬起头来，"...好吧，我们商量的事情。" 说着他把数据平板扔到了一边。

"你想要 Kelise Astraia 的档案。" 他笑着说，"我甚至不需要贿赂 Culann 星际锻炉的管理人员。你敢相信我们四年前在一起工作过吗？那时候发生了一些有趣的事 —— 算了，让我们来说说你的武器工程师吧。"

o.en: Offer to sell Arroyo's fake blackmail material
o.zh: 提出你想出售 Arroyo 伪造的勒索证据

o.en: Offer to sell Arroyo's fake blackmail material
o.zh: 提出你想出售 Arroyo 伪造的勒索证据

o.en: Offer to sell Arroyo's fake blackmail material
o.zh: 提出你想出售 Arroyo 伪造的勒索证据

entries.en:
The pirate leans back and tries to give you a knowing smile, "I see this isn't your first time negotiating with an intelligent operator like myself. My um, threat was simply a ruse to see if you were serious."

"And um, you passed the test," $heOrShe says, leaning forward again. "I'm going to make you an offer and you're going to take it, because-"
entries.zh:
海盗靠了回去，努力地装出一副情况不出所料的样子笑了一下："看起来这不是你第一次和像我一样聪明的人谈判了。我刚才的那个...呃...恐吓，只是个简单的试探而已，想看看你是不是认真的。"

"所以...呃...你够格了。" $heOrShe说着，又把身子靠了过来，"我等下会开个价，而你会接受，因为..."

o.en: You're going to pay me $gaPZ_paymentForCommFakes credits.

entries.en: "I accept," $heOrShe says without hesitation, and wipes sweat from $hisOrHer brow, "Transferring credits now."
entries.zh: "我接受。" $heOrShe立马回应道，还擦了擦$heOrShe额头上的冷汗，"这就转星币过去。"

entries.en:
With the data transfer complete, you watch as the pirate browses the blackmail material on $hisOrHer datapad with a hungry look on $hisOrHer face, "This is ... oh yes, very good. Wait 'til they see, it'll be-" $heOrShe seems to notice you again. "I believe we've made a fine deal, captain. Let's never speak of this again, yes?"

$personName shuts the commlink off, mercifully.
entries.zh:
数据传输完成后，海盗直接当着你的面就开始垂涎三尺地在$hisOrHer的数据平板上浏览起了那些黑料，"这是...哦，太棒了，等他们看到的时候，肯定会..." $heOrShe似乎才注意到你还在看着，"我想我们刚才真是做了笔好买卖，舰长。咱们就当这事从没发生过，咋样？"

$personName 切断了通讯，在你绷不住之前。

entries.en:
You transmit the data without bothering to put too much effort into acting scared; you have your dignity, after all.

As the transfer completes, the pirate leans back, a predatory smile on $hisOrHer face, "Very, very interesting. It's a good thing you came to someone smart, like me."

"Now scram before I change my mind."
entries.zh:
你就没再费功夫去装出一副被吓破胆了的样子，直接把数据传输了过去：毕竟你还是要给自己留点面子的。

数据传输完成后，海盗靠坐回椅背，脸上露出了能吃人的微笑，"非常，非常有趣。幸好你找到了像我这样的聪明人。"

"好了，在我改变主意之前，快滚。"

entries.en:
You pull out a personal datapad and explain that you can simply activate the EMP device attached to the memory core housing the blackmail data and they'll have no opportunity to blackmail anyone- in fact, you can spread word of their treachery in this matter. And then how many opportunities for mutual profit will show up in their orbit?

The pirate leans back and tries to give you a knowing smile, "Say no more. I can see that you are, like me, an intelligent operator. My um, threat was simply a ruse to see if you were serious about this business," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh:
你拿出了一个数据平板，向对方表明储存有勒索数据的内存核心上连有 EMP 装置，而你能轻易激活它，这样一来这份数据就毫无用处。此外，你还表示可以稍微宣传一下对方在这件勒索买卖上的诈骗行径，如此一来在这轨道上还会有多少利益往来的机会？

海盗靠了回去，努力地装出一副情况不出所料的样子笑了一下，"不用再说了。我看出你是干什么的了，和我一样，是个情报贩子。我刚才的那个...呃...恐吓，只是个简单的试探而已，想看看你是不是认真要做生意。" $heOrShe这么说到。

entries.en:
"And uh, congrats. You passed," $heOrShe says, recovering $hisOrHer composure. "You see before you someone who also knows all about business. And I'm going to make you an offer and you're going to take it, because- "

The pirate rambles, explaining why you won't find anyone else willing or indeed able to put your offering to best use. It's not a very good pitch.
entries.zh:
"所以...呃...恭喜，你够格了。" $heOrShe说，并恢复了镇静，"在你面前的是一个同样懂行的人。我等下会开个价，而你会接受，因为..."

海盗开始瞎扯，讲着些什么就你给出的那些材料，你没办法找到其他有意愿或有能力运用的人了之类的事情。这商谈的口才还真说不上好。

entries.en:
You wait for the right moment then cut through the posturing like a sabot core through a fluxed shield envelope, arguing the pirate into a price of $gaPZ_paymentForCommFakesHigh credits for the fake blackmail material.

"By Ludd's commode, yes, I get it" $heOrShe says finally, wiping sweat from $hisOrHer brow, "I accept your price. Transferring credits."
entries.zh:
犹如用赛博弹芯打穿幅能满载的护盾一般，你找准合适的时机，直接撕破了海盗装腔作势的嘴脸。争论直到对方愿意为假勒索线索支付 $gaPZ_paymentForCommFakesHigh 星币才算告一段落。

"看在卢德的份上，好吧，我接受。" $heOrShe最终同意了，擦着$heOrShe额头上的冷汗，"我接受你的开价。现在开始转账星币。"

entries.en:
With the data transfer complete, you watch as the pirate browses the blackmail material on $hisOrHer datapad with a hungry look on $hisOrHer face, "This is ... oh yes, very good. Wait 'til they see, it'll be-" $heOrShe seems to notice you again. "I believe we've made a fine deal, captain. Let's never speak of this again, yes?"

$personName shuts the commlink off, mercifully.
entries.zh:
数据传输完成后，海盗直接当着你的面就开始垂涎三尺地在$hisOrHer的数据平板上浏览起了那些黑料，"这是...哦，太棒了，等他们看到的时候，肯定会..." $heOrShe似乎才注意到你还在看着，"我想我们刚才真是做了笔好买卖，舰长。咱们就当这事从没发生过，咋样？"

$personName 切断了通讯，在你绷不住之前。

o.en: Brave words for someone without a warfleet behind them.
o.zh: 某人身后连支能打的舰队都没有，还真敢说这话。

o.en: Oh no. Anything but that. Transmitting now.
o.zh: 喔，别，千万别那样。我这就把资料传给你。

entries.en: "Captain $playerName. I am Lieutenant Finlay Siyavong of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service. It is so very interesting to finally meet you."
entries.zh: "$playerName 舰长，我是海军上尉 Finlay Siyavong，从属于 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部。能和你见上一面，真是令我感到非常有趣。"

entries.en: "Captain $playername." You are greeted once again by Finlay Siyavong of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service. "It is so interesting to meet you again," he says with a small smile.
entries.zh: "$playername 舰长。" 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部的 Finlay Siyavong 再次向你致意，"真高兴能再次见到你，" 他微笑着说。

entries.en: He nods politely toward you, "What an unusual ship you are operating."
entries.zh: 他礼貌地向你点了点头，"你这艘船还真是有点不同寻常。"

entries.en: He nods politely toward you, "I heard that you've been operating a very unusual ship. Quite unique, in fact."
entries.zh: 他礼貌地向你点了点头，"我听说你最近在使用一艘很不寻常的船。实际上，甚至可以说是独一无二。"

o.en: Oh, so now you know who I am again?
o.zh: 哦，现在你又知道我是谁了？

o.en: I'm not sure I follow, lieutenant. I operate many ships.
o.zh: 我有点没听明白，上尉。我指挥的船可不少。

o.en: Isn't it? I found it in orbit of a Tri-Tachyon black site.
o.zh: 可不是嘛？我是在一处 速子科技 的秘密研究站的轨道上找到它的。

o.en: It's nice to meet you, lieutenant. I'll just be on my way.
o.zh: 见到你很高兴，上尉。我该走了。

entries.en:
The Tri-Tachyon comms logo resolves rapidly to the smiling administrator of Culann Starforge.

"Greetings Captain $playerName!" $HeOrShe glances at a secondary display, "Your net worth is admirable. On behalf of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation, I would like to welcome you to Culann Starforge."

$HisOrHer perfect smile grows slightly larger. "We supply a variety of alloys to both private firms and major polities. Or perhaps you're a supplier in the ore trade?"
entries.zh:
速子科技 的商标很快被 Culann 星际锻炉管理员的微笑取代了。

"您好，$playername 舰长！" $heOrShe偷瞄了一眼那边的副显示屏，"您的净资产真是多得令人钦佩。我代表 三一速子科技公司，欢迎您来到 Culann 星际锻炉。"

$heOrShe完美的笑容绽放得更加灿烂了一些："我们面向各种客户供应各种合金，小到私人厂商，大至国家政党。又或许您是一位来自矿石贸易行业的供应商？"

o.zh: 打听有关 Kelise Astraia 的消息

entries.en:
The Tri-Tachyon $rank looks back at you directly, without emotion. "Consider this ample warning."
The comms cut. The Tri-Tachyon logo spins while a synthesized voice asks you to submit feedback on your customer experience.
entries.zh:
这位 速子科技 $rank 毫无感情地盯着你。"请将此视作一次警告。"
通讯链接被切断了。屏幕上出现了旋转的 速子科技 标志，同时一个合成的声音鼓励你提交关于用户体验的反馈。

entries.en:
"Good shift, captain," the Tri-Tachyon $rank says crisply. "Long-range sensors recently detected a certain Ziggurat-class TTS Xenorphica in your fleet; this is property of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation."

$HisOrHer eyes flick down, reading from a screen "Let this statement be notice that the Tri-Tachyon Corporation considers legitimate all appropriate and necessary means to recover property belonging to said company, including use of militarized force, employment of mercenaries or privateers, et cetera."
entries.zh:
"日安，舰长，" 这位 速子科技 $rank 清脆地说道。"远程传感器最近探测到你的舰队中有一艘名为 TTS Xenorphica 的 通灵塔-级 舰船，该舰是 三一速子科技公司 名下的财产。"

$HeOrShe低下头去，看着屏幕读道 "三一速子科技公司 在此声明，我公司认定，为追回归属本公司之财产，一切适当且必要的手段均属合法，包括但不限于动用军事力量、雇佣佣兵或私掠船等。"

entries.en:
"Good shift, captain," the Tri-Tachyon $rank says crisply. "You possess property belonging to the Tri-Tachyon Corporation."

$HisOrHer eyes flick down, reading from a screen "Let this statement be notice that the Tri-Tachyon Corporation considers legitimate all appropriate and necessary means to recover property belonging to said company, including use of militarized force, employment of mercenaries or privateers, et cetera."
entries.zh:
"日安，舰长，" 这位 速子科技 $rank 清脆地说道。"你当前持有 三一速子科技公司 名下的财产。"

$HisOrHer低下头去，看着屏幕读道 "三一速子科技公司 在此声明，我公司认定，为追回归属本公司之财产，一切适当且必要的手段均属合法，包括但不限于动用军事力量、雇佣佣兵或私掠船等。"

entries.en:
"Good shift, captain," the Tri-Tachyon $rank says crisply. "You possess property belonging to the Tri-Tachyon Corporation and I have come to recover it. Surrender the Ziggurat-class TTS Xenorphica to me at once."

$HeOrShe locks you with an unblinking gaze, awaiting your response.
entries.zh:
"日安，舰长，" 这位 速子科技 $rank 清脆地说道。"你当前持有 三一速子科技公司 名下的财产，我受命前来将其取回。请立刻将名为 TTS Xenorphica 的 通灵塔-级 舰船转交给我。"

$HeOrShe目不转睛地瞪着你，等待你的回复。

o.en: Haven't you heard of salvage rights?
You're going to have to pry it from my cold, dead hands.
o.zh: 那你恐怕得从我的尸体上跨过去。

o.en: What does the Hegemony think of this flying treaty violation?
o.zh: 霸主 要是看到这个违反条约的东西到处乱飞会怎么想？

o.en: How about payment? Perhaps a finder's fee?
o.zh: 报酬呢？没有发现者补贴吗？

o.en: I'll transfer command protocols at once. (accept)
o.zh: 我会立即移交指挥权。 (接受)

entries.en:
The academy agent makes a quiet request through their personal comms then gives you a patient look.

"The new provost is very, very busy. New administration after the, um, recent unpleasantness, you know? This could take some time. Days, weeks sometimes. You might want to leave your comms ID with me and come back in-"

The comms unit chimes softly.

"Yes? ... Really? I mean, yes, we’ll come up immediately." The agent turns to you, "Provost Baird will see you. Right now. Please follow me, captain."
entries.zh:
这位学院事务代理通过个人通讯默默地提交了申请，然后耐心地看着你。

"新上任的院长工作非常，非常繁忙。毕竟新的管理层是经过，呃，上次的那些不愉快之后才刚换届的，您明白吧？您可能需要再等一段时间。通常要等上几天，不过最长也不会超过几周。您不介意的话，可以将通讯 ID 留给我，到时我会 ——"

通讯设备发出了几声轻响。

"是的？... 您确定吗？我是说，明白了，我们现在就过去。" 这位事务代理向你转过身，"Baird 院长将和您会面。就现在。请跟我来，舰长。"

o.zh: 跟随这位初级学院事务代理

entries.en:
You are led through a discreet secure-access door to a series of passages that bypass the public concourses. A travel-lift activates at the academy agent’s presence and you step inside at the agent's encouraging nod.

The lift pod is wrapped by diamond-matrix through which you can see the canyon-like sweep of plazas pass by, filled with crowds of students, academics, and technicians. Raising your gaze, you see that the pod is approaching a tiered substructure which seems to hang over the curve of the station interior. The pod slows and you shuffle to adjust to the local grav-effect field gradient.

You must be near the core of Galatia Station.
entries.zh:
你被引导着穿过一扇不显眼的安全门，进入了一系列避开公共港区的通道。学院事务代理激活了一部移动升降梯，并点头示意你从这边进去。

你走进吊舱，透过舱体四周的金刚石方窗向外望去。你看到了之前经过的山谷般的广场，那里学生、学者和技工络绎不绝。目光上移，吊舱距离悬在空间站内部弧线上方的分层结构越来越近了。随着吊舱逐渐减速，你活动了一下身体，来适应此处的重力梯度场。

这里一定是 Galatia 空间站的核心附近了。

entries.en:
A guard wearing a mirrored faceplate dismisses the junior agent and ushers you to an antechamber filled with small groups waiting to meet with the provost. They have perfect hair and perfect skin unmarred by the radiation and burns that mark a spacer. Those cybernetics you can spot are consciously stylish adornments rather than crude augments. Many have brought their young progeny with them. The stench of wealth and influence is palpable.

Heads turn as you are led past all of them toward a set of large doors inlaid with wood from what looks like real trees. You feel their glares on you like point defense fire on heavy armor.
entries.zh:
一位面罩锃光瓦亮的卫兵示意初级代理离开，随后带着你来到前厅。这里的人们三五成群，等待着与院长会面。从他们的头发与皮肤上，你看不到宇宙民都会有的辐射与晒伤痕迹。这些人身上的植入体都是造型时尚的饰品，比普通的强化部件奢华得多。不少人还带着他们年轻的后辈。钱财与权势的气息扑面而来。

卫兵领着你穿过人群，走向一扇大门，门上镶嵌的似乎是真正的原木。这一举动引得不少人侧目。人们的视线聚焦于你，就像点防火力打在重甲上，让你暗觉如芒在背。

o.en: Smile and wink at them. You're special and know it.
o.zh: 向他们微笑并眨眼，你很清楚自己是特殊嘉宾。

entries.en:
You enter the office and the doors close silently behind you. Provost Anahita Baird turns to acknowledge your entrance while concluding a call via her desk tablet.

Ancient wooden shelves for real, paper books gleam darkly in subdued light emanating tastefully from nowhere. The shelves are only half-stocked from crates scattered around the office. A brass orrery of the Galatia system adorns a plinth in the midst of a seating cluster. Parchments mounted behind the provost’s desk display intimidating intellectual rankings, their seals of authenticity glowing softly.

"I apologize for the mess," she says, having noted your examination. "I've only just moved office."
entries.zh:
你进入房间，身后的门随即悄无声息地关上了。Anahita Baird 院长正在通过摆在桌上的平板与他人通话，只是转头示意你先进来稍等。

古老的木制书架上摆放着货真价实的纸质书籍，在不知何处散发出的暖光下镀出暗芒。书架只摆满了一半，地上还散落着几个板条箱。一座 Galatia 星系的铜制轨道模型点缀在座椅群的正中。院长桌后墙上的羊皮纸展示着令人生畏的学者排名，纸上证明其真实性的印章散发着柔和的光。

"请原谅这里的杂乱，" 她注意到你在四处张望，便开口说道，"我才刚刚搬到这个办公室。"

entries.en:
Before you speak she raises a hand.

"You're not here to set up a donation. Why then? Because it is very much in my interest to know about the up-and-coming mercenary captain who corrected the unfortunate situation created by my ambitious but incautious predecessor."

A pause.

"This institution is not devoted to purely theoretical work," she forms a cradle with her hands, as if to hold an idea as she explains it, "For what use is knowledge if it does not give us the power, and wisdom, to change the world for the better?"

She leaves the question hanging in the air for a moment.
entries.zh:
在你开口之前她便举手打断了你。

"你当然不是来捐款的。你为何而来？因为对我而言，结识某位冉冉升起的雇佣兵舰长很有意义，毕竟他收拾了我那眼高手低的前任留下的烂摊子。

她顿了一下。

"这座学府并非致力于纯粹的理论研究。" 她双手虚抱，思考着如何向你解释，"如果知识不能给予我们改进世界的力量和智慧，那它有什么意义？"

她抛出问题，但没有回答，空气中只余沉默。

entries.en: Provost Baird cuts you off as you begin to speak, "The question was rhetorical, captain."
entries.zh: Baird 院长在你刚要说话时打断了你，"那只是个反问句，舰长。"

entries.en:
Before you speak she raises a hand.

"You're not here to set up a donation. Why then? Because it is very much in my interest to know about the up-and-coming mercenary captain who is capable of reversing the unfortunate situation created by my ambitious but incautious predecessor."

A pause.

"This institution is not devoted to purely theoretical work," she forms a cradle with her hands, as if to hold an idea as she explains it, "For what use is knowledge if it does not give us the power, and wisdom, to change the world for the better?"

She leaves the question hanging in the air for a moment.
entries.zh:
在你开口之前她便举手打断了你。

"你当然不是来捐款的。你为何而来？因为对我而言，结识某位冉冉升起的雇佣兵舰长很有意义，毕竟他有能力逆转我那眼高手低的前任留下的烂摊子。

她顿了一下。

"这座学府并非致力于纯粹的理论研究。" 她双手虚抱，思考着如何向你解释，"如果知识不能给予我们改进世界的力量和智慧，那它有什么意义？"

她抛出问题，但没有回答，空气中只余沉默。

o.en: Knowledge is good for its own sake.
Knowledge can also be very profitable.
Knowledge brings us closer to the Creator.
o.zh: 知识引我们更近造物主。

entries.en:
She brings her hands apart. "The Galatia Academy could make use of someone like you. Someone capable, discreet," and here she pauses, a tactic for emphasis she appears to employ often,  "And very well paid. I do not wish to make the same mistake as my predecessor. If one wants work done properly, appropriate incentive must be provided."

She leans back and looks to you, done speaking. For real, this time. Probably.
entries.zh:
她摊开手。" Galatia 学院可以用到你这样的人。一个精明能干低调谨慎的家伙。" 说到这，她停顿了一下，看来她常用这招来强调重点，"而且报酬会非常丰厚。我不希望重蹈前任的覆辙。一个人如果想要把事情办妥，就要给出相应的激励。"

她靠在椅背上看着你，这次应该是讲完了。大概，也许。

o.en: I'm interested. What do you need done? (accept)
o.zh: 我很感兴趣。你需要我做什么？ (接受)

o.en: Thanks, but I have other priorities right now. (decline)
o.zh: 谢谢，但我有些需要优先处理的事项。 (拒绝)

o.en: Actually, I really did want to create a scholarship.
o.zh: 实际上，我确实想要个学位。

o.en: Ask about the stipend you're receiving

entries.en: She freezes, staring at you. "You can't be serious. I'm offering far more than the hull is worth, and I'm the only one who is going to pay you this kind of cash for the Hamatsu." Her hand balls into a fist, and she says "Reconsider."
entries.zh: 她愣住了，然后盯着你开口道："你不会是认真的吧？我出的价钱已经远远超过这艘破损成这样的船本身的价值了，也只有我一个人会愿意开这么高的价买下 Hamatsu 号。"说着她的手握成了拳头，看起来很紧张，"再考虑一下吧。"

o.en: Transfer the Hamatsu to Ibrahim's control
o.zh: 把 Hamatsu 号交给 Ibrahim

o.en: My mind is made up. Good bye.
o.zh: 我已经下定决心了，再见。

entries.en: Ibrahim is just starting to raise her voice as you shut off the comms.
entries.zh: Ibrahim 刚想说什么时，你已经切断了通讯。

entries.en:
You tell Ibrahim about the wreck of the Hamatsu - and the deceased Kelise Astraia.

"It's a shame, a damn shame, that she ended up like that," Ibrahim wipes away a tear, "That's no kind of fitting end to such a glorious career. Oh, there were some ups and some downs, but there's none to match her."
entries.zh:
你告诉 Ibrahim 你找到了 Hamatsu 号的残骸，还有 Kelise Astraia 的遗体。

"天啊，我...我不知道该说什么好，太可惜了，没想到她的一生结束的如此凄惨，" Ibrahim 擦了擦眼泪，"如此光辉的生涯不该就这么结束的...尽管有一些波澜，但对我来说没有任何一艘船能比得上她。"

o.en: ... Are you talking about your starship?

entries.en:
"Of course! The Hamatsu was my life for many cycles."

"Kelise Astraia? Got what was coming. She knew the risks, and was fool enough not to play it safe when compounding those risks." Ibrahim curls her lip, "People like her get good spacers killed." She pauses, "I'm already trying to forget about her."

"So. Captain. Want a job? I'd like the Hamatsu back. Fix it up, give it a new life. Stars beyond, there's a ship that deserves a second chance. I have no idea how I'm supposed to get a salvage vessel into this half-baked jump-point you described, so it's gonna be up to you."

She looks you over again, with that assessors sweep, "I'll make it worthwhile. Call it 100,000 credits for the hull, in any state."
entries.zh:
"当然了！Hamatsu 号陪伴了我许多年。"

"至于 Kelise Astraia？她活该。她知道风险有多大，但在考虑这些风险时，她太笨了，没有谨慎行事。" Ibrahim 噘着嘴，似乎很不满。"像她这样的人会害死很多优秀的太空船员。"她停顿了一下，"我已经在尝试忘掉她了。"

"所以，舰长，想要再来一份工作吗？我想取回 Hamatsu 号，修好它，给它一次新生 —— 繁星在上，这艘船值得 —— 但是我不知道该怎么让救援船进入你说的这个未成型的跳跃点，所以这得靠你了。"

她又看向了你，带着评估一般的目光："这次任务的酬劳不会让你失望的，100,000 星币应该足够把这艘船带回来了。"

o.en: Tell Ibrahim about finding the Hamatsu
o.zh: 告诉 Ibrahim 你找到 Hamatsu 号和 Kelise Astraia 遗体的事

entries.en: Ibrahim looks you over. "I'm still interested in recovering the Hamatsu. It's an easy 100,000 credits, captain."
entries.zh: Ibrahim 看着你："我依然希望能找回 Hamatsu 号，这 100,000 星币是笔很轻松就能赚到的钱，舰长。"

entries.en:
Ibrahim looks excited as her image solidifies, immediately launching into her speech without bothering with a greeting.

"-If my sensors and the orbital navigation registry do not deceive me, you have my starship, the Hamatsu! Captain, thank you!"

"I'll give you the $gaRH_reward credits right now and call it a done deal. You don't even have to bring it into a repair yard, I'll handle everything myself. I've already got the replacement hyperdrive in my warehouse, and some excellent engineers on call."
entries.zh:
Ibrahim 看起来很兴奋，甚至连招呼都没打就滔滔不绝起来：

"如果传感器和轨道导航注册系统没有骗我，你带回了我的飞船 Hamatsu 号！舰长，十分感谢！"

"我现在就给你 $gaRH_reward 星币，这样一来我们的约定就履行完毕了。你甚至不用把它送到修理厂，剩下的都由我处理。我的仓库里已经放着新的超空间引擎了，还有几位优秀的工程师正随时待命。"

o.en: Transfer the Hamatsu to Ibrahim's control
o.zh: 把 Hamatsu 号交给 Ibrahim

o.en: Sorry, I intend to keep the ship.

entries.en:
Ibrahim beams. "Thank you again, captain. Now if you don't mind, I have a lot to do."

She reaches for the disconnect button, then pauses. "If you ever need some work, give me a call. New jobs come up all the time and a capable captain is worth their weight in credits."
entries.zh:
Ibrahim 的脸上笑容灿烂："谢谢你，舰长。如果你不介意的话我就先挂断了，毕竟我还有很多事要做。"

她将手伸向断开通讯链接的按钮，在挂断前顿了一下："如果你需要工作，告诉我一声就好。新工作总是层出不穷，一个有能耐的舰长值得赚到更多的星币。"

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName I presume," the mercenary commander says coolly. "My employer is disappointed that you did not... reconsider." $HeOrShe says the last word with an odd emphasis, and after a second you recall a heated conversation with Callisto Ibrahim - you refused to hand over her old ship - in which she used that same word.

$HeOrShe watches you realize this, then closes the connection.
entries.zh:
"我猜您就是 $playerName 舰长了。" 雇佣兵指挥官沉稳的声音传来，"我的雇主很失望，因为你没有好好地...重新考虑一下。" $heOrShe说出最后几个词时语气很怪，过了一会，你想起了自己和 Callisto Ibrahim 进行过的一次激烈谈话 —— 那时你拒绝交出她的旧船 —— 当时她在谈话中就用了 "重新考虑" 这个词。

$HeOrShe就这么看着你，并在你摆出意识到了什么的表情时切断了通讯链接。

entries.en: "A key academician from $gaRR_department was, um, imprisoned by the Luddic Church on $gaRR_marketName for performing... research. We need someone to pay the, uh, tithe so they can be released."
entries.zh: "一位来自 $gaRR_department 院系的重要研究员，在进行...研究时被来自 $gaRR_marketName 的 卢德教会 的人给...那个...给囚禁了。我们需要派个人去交个...什一税，他们才肯放人。"

entries.en: "A key academician from $gaRR_department was, um, kidnapped while performing research by pirates based out of $gaRR_marketName and, well, we need someone to retrieve them now that a ransom has been negotiated."
entries.zh: "一位来自 $gaRR_department 院系的重要研究员，在进行研究时被来自 $gaRR_marketName 的海盗给...嗯...给绑架了。我们已经谈妥了赎金的金额，现在需要有个人去接他们回来。"

entries.en:
The $post nods. "You may transfer the credits to the port exchanger. Just tell them the sum is to be delivered to the Knights of Ludd."

You nod, and motion for your logistics officer to take care of the transaction.

"Which leaves us with your wayward academician," $heOrShe sighs. "We shall have them escorted to the outsiders' concourse immediately for your pick-up."
entries.zh:
$post 点点头。"你可以把星币打给港口的交易商。只需要告诉他们这笔钱是要交给卢德骑士团的就行。"

你点点头，示意你的后勤人员去处理这笔交易。

"现在就剩下你们这不听话的学者了。" $heOrShe叹息道，"我们将立即把他们护送到外来者使用的港区那里，以便你来接收。"

entries.en:
The Knight claps $hisOrHer notebook shut. "-Which concludes our business," $heOrShe says, and pauses as if considering $hisOrHer words.

"I will pray for you, captain. And please, prevail upon the Academy to be more... considerate. Providence guide you."
entries.zh:
骑士长合上了$hisOrHer的笔记本。"那我们的事情就算是办完了。" 说完后，$heOrShe顿了顿，似乎在考虑接下来的发言。

"我会为你祈祷，舰长。另外，也希望你向学院的人强调，让他们以后更加...小心一些。愿上天指引你的道途。"

entries.en:
You dispatch a shuttle to pick up the freed academician.

On-board, they appear in good health and - now away from the brooding Knights of Ludd - complains bitterly about lost data.

"Those fanatics smashed my new TriPad. Simply barbaric! And it can't be my imagination, but I suspect that they hardly bathe down there."

You nod politely and motion for your security chief to escort the academician to their quarters so you can avoid them on the long trip back to the Galatia Academy.
entries.zh:
你派了一艘穿梭机去接被释放的学者。一上船，在远离了烦人的卢德骑士后，对方的气色就开始飞速好转，然后刻薄地抱怨科研数据的丢失 ——"那些狂热分子砸了我的新 TriPad。简直野蛮至极！而且不是我瞎编，下边的这些卢德骑士估计都不洗澡的。"

你礼貌性地点点头，示意你的安全主管护送学者到自己的宿舍，这样就可以在回 Galatia 学院的漫长旅途中避开这个家伙。

entries.en:
"$BrotherOrSister," you begin, a touch of the cadence of a concourse-preacher you once heard coming to you as if from nowhere, "I feel like you don't fully approve of what is happening here."

Before the Knight can object to you prying into business not your own, you raise a hand to gently stop $himOrHer. You explain that you understand that it is not your place to ask why they are in this position, but as a fellow member of the faith, you empathize with the moral struggle of having to answer to both the institution and one's own God-given conscience.

You speak softly, building rapport with Knight $personLastName, who is nodding now. Truly, you explain, it is tragic that tawdry worldly affairs tarnish the beautiful spiritual journey mapped out by the prophet Ludd - but such is the fallen world.
entries.zh:
"$BrotherOrSister。" 你开口道，带着不知哪儿来的抑扬顿挫，像极了之前听过的港区传教士语调，"我可以感到刚才经手的这些事务并不能让你心悦诚服。"

在骑士长打算对你的多管闲事做出指责之前，你轻轻抬起手，温和地阻止了$himOrHer。你表示清楚自己没有立场去质问为何教会将此职责交由他们经手，但同为信仰的追随者，你能感同身受地体会到他们道义上的迷茫，难以面对天赋良心和机构职责之间的两难。

你娓娓道来，柔和的话语仿佛逐渐浸透着 $personLastName 骑士长的灵魂，而对方则已经频频点头赞同。真的，你解释道，肮脏的世俗事务已经玷污了先知卢德所描绘的那绝美的精神旅途，这无疑是一种悲哀，但这也是腐化堕落世界的现状。

entries.en:
"That's just the thing, $playerFirstName. I- that is, we- anyone, really, is caught between higher ideals, the transcendent glory that drives us to rise above all of-" a violent hand motion "-this! ... And the spiritual compromise required to exercise even a measure of power in this world. With the office comes power to do some good, I realize, but." $HeOrShe sighs deeply, looking off to the side.

"But with that good also comes evil, and each time this... I feel it eat away at my soul, just a bite. But after years and years, who have I become? When it is my day to join the stars, will I be the $manOrWoman who once was filled with the light of Creation, who was so inspired to swear to serve as a Knight of Ludd?"

"Or will I hold an accounting-book filled with my own cowardly compromises at the end? Heavy enough to weigh down my soul." $HisOrHer face hardens as $heOrShe comes to some decision.
entries.zh:
"正是，$playerFirstName，正是如此。我...我是说我们...对于所有的卢德信徒来说都是这样，我们都受困于此。我们都抱有崇高的理想，那超然的荣耀驱使着我们，终将使我们得以超越这世间的..." $HeOrShe比出一个激烈的手势，"...这一切！可惜，要在这凡世行使哪怕一点点的权力，就不得不在这精神上有所妥协。我曾以为，得到这个职位，便拥有了行善所需的权力。但事与愿违。" $HeOrShe深深叹了口气，目光转向一边。

"善与恶总是如影相随。每次在做现在这种事的时候，我都能感到我所作的恶在侵蚀着我的灵魂。虽然每次都微不足道，但随着日积月累，我如今都变成了个什么东西？当我最终返回群星的怀抱时，我还能是当初那个心怀神赐光辉的人吗？还能是那个感召神启，发誓成为卢德骑士的$manOrWoman吗？"

"抑或是我将永远攥着一本账簿，里面写满了我因懦弱而做出的各种妥协，终世都无法撒手离去？这账簿实在是过于沉重，几乎要压垮我的灵魂。" $heOrShe终于下定了决心，脸色也变得坚毅起来。

entries.en:
With a sweep of the arm, the knight throws the paper notebooks from $hisOrHer desk. You wince at this treatment of a genuinely hand-crafted object. "Hear this, captain: I won't allow myself to sink into slow spiritual death by these whispering wormwood corruptions. Was not Ludd a martyr!?"

Knight $personLastName looks directly at you, with fire in $hisOrHer eyes.

"Take this researcher. Tell them of when Ludd freed the prisoners, tell them of mercy, and of how the sacred can be found even in those who seem most lost." $HeOrShe stands, and jabs a key on a battered console that was spared $hisOrHer burst of wrath.

"Blessings of Ludd be upon you, $playerName. Now I have work to do." The comms shut off.
entries.zh:
骑士大手一挥，将那纸质笔记本从$hisOrHer的桌子上扫了下去。对珍贵手工制品的暴殄天物的态度让你不禁一颤。"听好了，舰长：我绝不会放任这窃窃私语般的靡靡之音侵蚀我的灵魂，使我渐渐陷入精神上的死亡。卢德难道不就是为此而献身的吗？"

这位名为 $personLastName 的骑士直视着你，$hisOrHer的眼神好似熊熊烈火。

"带走这个学者吧。告诉他们，是 卢德教会 释放了他们，告诉他们我们的仁慈，以及，即使在看起来最为迷惘的人身上，也能找到一缕神圣。" $HeOrShe站了起来，按下了一个破旧的控制台上的按键。这个控制台在$hisOrHer之前的怒火中幸免于难。

"愿卢德祝福你，$playerName。现在我得去忙点别的了。" 通讯链接随即关闭了。

entries.en:
You are left unsure of how you feel about inspiring this newfound conviction by way of your admittedly modest deception. Your logistics officer clears their throat and motions to the main display- a passenger request pickup has been received from a small shuttle bay. Your wayward researcher.

A shuttle is dispatched, returning with the flustered academician. All that remains is to return them to the Galatia Academy.
entries.zh:
对于这种通过温和的谎言来劝人改邪归正这事，你的感受难以言表。后勤官清了清嗓子，并向主显示屏示意 —— 刚刚收到来自穿梭机港口的乘客接应请求：正是那个迷途的学者。

一架穿梭机被派去，把惊魂未定的学者接了回来。接下来就是将那人送回 Galatia 学院了。

entries.en:
The comms open on a Knight of Ludd bearing the handweave and wooden sigil of a knight-captain. "Blessings of Ludd be upon you," $heOrShe says, looking you over with obvious suspicion. $HeOrShe nonetheless maintains a civil tone.

"How may I serve, $playerBrotherOrSister?"
entries.zh:
通讯接通后，一位身披手工织物，佩戴着木制骑士指挥官标志的卢德骑士出现了。"愿卢德保佑你。" $heOrShe说到。虽然目光中带着明显的怀疑，但$HeOrShe还是保持了尊重的语气。

"我可以为你效劳吗，$playerBrotherOrSister？"

o.en: Ask about a certain prisoner associated with the Galatia Academy
o.zh: 询问一位与 Galatia 学院有关的囚犯的事

entries.en:
"Ah, you're from the Academy. Or not quite- they hired you, is that right?" $HeOrShe gives you just a glance, "It is."

"First, I would like to assure you that the individual on whose behalf you are petitioning the Knights has been treated well, though considering their crimes, has been confined to a guest dormitory and had technological privileges... limited."

The Knight flips a page in some kind of real-paper notebook, reading. "I see here that this academician was caught with a number of... devices, 'research equipment', they say. These devices have been destroyed." $HeOrShe looks up to see how you react, then nods to $himOrHerself.
entries.zh:
"啊，你是学院来的人。或者说，是他们雇你来的，是这样吗？" $HeOrShe瞥了你一眼，"看来我说对了。"

"首先，我向你保证，你所指的这个人在骑士团受到了很好的对待；但考虑到他的罪行，他的行动范围被限制在一间来宾宿舍内，并且对其在使用科技方面的特权...进行了限制。"

团长把手中那本由真正的纸张制成的笔记本翻了一页，继续阅读道。"记录上写着，这位学者在被捕时携带了许多的...装置，即他们所谓的 '科研设备'。这些设备已经被销毁了。" $HeOrShe抬头观察了下你的反应，然后自己点了点头。

entries.en:
"You're here on behalf of the Academy. You, who appear to wish to count yourself among the Faithful." $HeOrShe does not look impressed. "You walk a treacherous Path, $playerBrotherOrSister."

$HisOrHer eyes turn down toward some kind of real-paper notebook, "Accept now my assurance that the individual on whose behalf you are petitioning the Knights has been treated well. Though considering their crimes, has been confined to a guest dormitory and had technological privileges... limited."

The Knight flips a page, eyes scanning the text. "I see here that this academician was caught with a number of devices, 'research equipment', they claim. These devices have been destroyed." $HeOrShe looks up to see how you react, then nods to $himOrHerself.
entries.zh:
"你代表学院而来。你似乎希望自己表现的很虔诚。" $HeOrShe看起来并不满意，"你走的路充满危险，$playerBrotherOrSister。"

$HeOrShe的目光转向一本纸质笔记本，"我向你保证，对那个你为之请愿的人，骑士团对他保护得很好。虽然考虑到他的罪行，他的行动范围被限制在一间来宾宿舍内，并且对其在使用科技方面的特权...进行了限制。"

骑士翻了一页，眼睛扫过文字。"这位院士被当场查获了若干设备，他们声称是所谓 '研究设备'。它们已经被销毁了。" $HeOrShe抬头看你有什么反应，然后自顾自的点了点头。

entries.en:
"We understand the need for stable relations between our respective institutions," $heOrShe says, "and the mother Church has emphasized this point very precisely to our order. Excubitor Orbis Oak has agreed to waive the usual procedures in place of a generous donation to the Church."

"I trust you have brought the Academy's silver?" $HeOrShe gives just the hint of a wry smile.
entries.zh:
"我能理解保持我们所属势力之间关系稳定的必要性。" $heOrShe说道，"教会母亲在给我们下命令的时候非常确切地强调过这一点。因此，行星教卫 Oak 已经同意，如果你能提供一笔慷慨的捐赠，教会则将会跳过一些常规程序。"

"想必你已经带来了学院的银子？" $HeOrShe的笑容中止不住地透出了少许的不屑。

o.en: Pay $gaRR_costNormal credits for the academician's release
o.zh: 支付 $gaRR_costNormal 星币以使他们释放学者

entries.en:
"Oh, captain! The $gaRR_department Department wanted me to give you their thanks for returning academician- uh, well, you won't remember the name, but they're all very pleased to get back to work on the- uh, well, I shouldn't really say."

Sebestyen looks nervously around, then clears his throat. "Trust me, they're very pleased. And it's due to you. Good job!"
entries.zh:
"哦，舰长！学院的 $gaRR_department 院系想让我代他们向您致谢，感谢您带回了...呃，那位院士，反正你也不记得名字了吧，但总之他们都很高兴能回去继续研究...呃，好吧，这我就真不该多说了。"

Sebestyen 尴尬地环顾四周，然后清了清嗓子道："相信我，他们非常高兴。而这都是您的功劳。干得不错！"

entries.en: "Ah, uh, captain." Sebestyen stammers awkwardly at you for a moment. "T-The, um, bursar's office contacted me, and um, they're taking back the credits allocated to you for the ransom payment. They tell me that the situation has been resolved?"
entries.zh: "啊，呃，舰长。" Sebestyen 尴尬地对你结吧了几下子。"这个，呃，财务办公室联系了我，要收回用于支付赎金的资金。他们说事情已经解决了？"

entries.en:
"Well uh, what happened is Academician $gaRR_researcherName from $gaRR_department was on a research mission, possibly near volumes patrolled by the Luddic- I mean, the Church of Galactic Redemption and was kidna- er, interred by the Knights of Ludd."

"They're, um." Sebestyen ponders for a moment, "Enthusiastic about enforcing certain prescripts. Between you and me, their understanding of theory is a bit loose at best, so there can be... misunderstandings. We- that is, the $gaRR_department department - was assured that the project was cleared by the exarch liaison who runs a shrine here on the Academy Station."
entries.zh:
"呃，现在的情况是 $gaRR_department 院系的 $gaRR_researcherName 院士在执行科研任务时，大概是在卢德...我是说，银河救赎教会 的巡逻区域附近，被卢德骑士团给绑...呃，给拦截了。

"这些骑士团的人，呃，" Sebestyen 组织了下语言，"在执行某些法规方面相当地热情。也就咱俩这样说说，他们对于法规的理解，顶多就是半瓶子醋的水平，所以可能会有这种...误会。我们，也就是学院的 $gaRR_department 院系，确定这个研究项目已经获得了在学院空间站充当联络人并管理教堂的主教的首肯。"

entries.en:
"So um. We're not sure what went wrong. This might be an inter- um, inter-departmental conflict within the Church?" Sebestyen stops himself and looks again at his datapad.

"Right! We need a representative - that'll be you - to travel to $gaRR_marketName and make arrangements with the representative from the Knights of Ludd. It was, um, hinted that a tithe of $gaRR_costNormal credits would smooth things over, so the finance department will give you that cash up-front. Your payment for performing the mission itself would be $gaRR_reward credits."
entries.zh:
"所以...呃...我们也不确定哪个环节出了问题。这可能是教会内部的...呃，部门间的冲突？" Sebestyen 说完后，再次看向他的平板。

"哦对！我们需要派一名代表 —— 也就是您 —— 去到 $gaRR_marketName 那里，与卢德骑士团的代表进行交涉。"呃，他们暗示说只要给出 $gaRR_costNormal 星币的什一税就足以让交涉变得顺利。财务部会预支给您这笔资金，而执行任务本身的酬劳则是 $gaRR_reward 星币。

o.en: If I free the researcher without paying, do I keep the ransom credits?
o.zh: 如果我能不花钱就把研究员救出来，那这钱我能自己留着吗？

entries.en:
"Um." This concept flusters the Academician somewhat, "Oh, stars. I, uh, let me check."

Judging by the illumination on his face, Sebestyen has pulled up a thick block of legal text, which he proceeds to scroll rapidly for a minute, speed-reading legal clauses.

"Technically," he smiles brightly, "the funds are released to you as 'working capital appropriated to hiree' - that's you - 'pursuant to recovering deliverables listed in addendum A'. So it looks like, yes, you would be able to keep the extra funds if you can complete the job without using them. Hopefully not by, um. Um." he looks queasy, and closes his eyes, and takes a deep breath.
entries.zh:
"呃这个..." 你的主意让 Sebestyen 显得有些慌乱，"呃，老天啊，我得查一下。"

从突然出现在他脸上的反光来看，Sebestyen 已经在平板上划拉出了一大坨法律条文，就算是滚动着快速阅读也花了他一分多钟的时间。

"好吧，理论上来说"，他笑得很灿烂，"这些资金是 '根据回收附录A中所列项目之所需，向受雇者'—— 也就是您 ——'所发放的行动资金'。所以，如果您能在不使用这些资金的情况下完成任务，您就可以留下这笔额外的钱。呃，希望您不是通过，呃...那种方法来...呃..." Sebestyen 显得很不舒服，他闭上了眼睛并深吸了一口气。

o.en: Don't worry, I can be very persuasive.
o.zh: 不用担心，我挺擅长通过谈判来解决问题的

entries.en:
Academician Sebestyen looks up, reassured.

"So you'll do it?"
entries.zh: Sebestyen 院士抬起头来，显然对此感到欣慰。"那么，您同意接下这项任务？"

entries.en:
"Um, what happened is Academician $gaRR_researcherName from $gaRR_department was on a research mission outside the core worlds and was... kidnapped by pirates."

"It's so dangerous out there", Sebestyen looks upset at the thought, "pirates, space battles, cannibals, meteorites..." he shudders. "Just awful, awful."
entries.zh:
"呃，现在的情况是 $gaRR_department 院系的研究员 $gaRR_researcherName 在核心星区外执行科研任务时被...被海盗给绑架了。"

"核心世界外简直太危险了，"说到这里，Sebestyen 显得十分不安，"海盗，太空战斗，食人者，还有陨石什么的..." 他颤抖着说道，"简直太吓人了，太恐怖了。"

entries.en:
"Right, yes. Pirates." He clears his throat, and looks down to read his datapad.

"Academician $gaRR_researcherName was taken by them. They know that the Galatia Academy looks after its own," he looks only slightly relieved by this, "and will pay a reasonable ransom. In this case they're demanding $gaRR_costNormal credits, which we'll release to you so you can pay the pirates' contact. Um, and their name is $gaRR_contactName, and they can be found $gaRR_onOrAt $gaRR_marketName."

"We'll give you their comm code so all you have to do is sneak into the port somehow, contact $gaRR_contactName, pay the ransom, then return Academician $gaRR_researcherName here to the Galatia Academy for an honorarium of $gaRR_reward credits."
entries.zh:
"哦对，海盗。" 他清了清嗓子，低头看向了他的数据平板。

"$gaRR_researcherName 院士被他们绑走了。他们知道 Galatia 学院肯定不会对自己人坐视不管..." 说到这，他稍微松了口气，"并且会支付合理数额的赎金。这次，他们想要 $gaRR_costNormal 星币作为赎金。我们会把这笔钱交给您，并由您付给海盗方面的联络人，呃，那人叫 $gaRR_contactName 的。您可以在 $gaRR_marketName 找到对方。"

"我们会提供给您他们的通讯代码，而您要做的就是设法潜入该港口，联系 $gaRR_contactName，并支付赎金。在把 $gaRR_researcherName 院士送回到 Galatia 学院后，会支付给您 $gaRR_reward 星币作为报酬。

o.en: If I find some other way to free the researcher, can I keep the ransom credits?
o.zh: 如果我能不付赎金就把研究员救出来，那这赎金我能自己留着吗？

entries.en:
"Um." This flusters Sebestyen, "Oh, stars. I, let me check."

Judging by the sudden illumination of his face, Sebestyen has pulled up a thick block of legal text, which he proceeds to scroll rapidly for a minute or so, speed-reading legal clauses.

"Well, technically," he smiles brightly, "the funds are released to you as 'working capital appropriated to hiree' - that's you - 'pursuant to recovering deliverables listed in addendum A'. So it looks like you would keep the extra funds if you complete the job without using them. Hopefully not by, um. Um." he looks queasy, and closes his eyes, and takes a deep breath.
entries.zh:
"呃这个..." 你的主意让 Sebestyen 显得有些慌乱，"呃，老天啊，我得查一下。"

从突然出现在他脸上的反光来看，Sebestyen 已经在平板上划拉出了一大坨法律条文，就算是滚动着快速阅读也花了他一分多钟的时间。

"好吧，理论上来说"，他笑得很灿烂，"这些资金是 '根据回收附录 A 中所列项目之所需，向受雇者'—— 也就是您 ——'所发放的行动资金'。所以，如果您能在不使用这些资金的情况下完成任务，您就可以留下这笔额外的钱。呃，希望您不是通过，呃...那种方法来...呃..." Sebestyen 显得很不舒服，他闭上了眼睛并深吸了一口气。

o.en: Don't worry, I can be very persuasive.
o.zh: 不用担心，我挺擅长通过谈判来解决问题的

entries.en:
Academician Sebestyen looks up, reassured.

"So you'll do it?"
entries.zh: Sebestyen 院士抬起头来，显然对此感到欣慰。"那么，您同意接下这项任务？"

entries.en:
"Oh. I read about it. There was a, a desperate situation, outside the core. Nothing was ever really proven, depending on which report you're going by, but it's more likely the records were destroyed. The way it goes is the crew ran out of supplies, and the captain..."

The Academician realizes with a start that he's become rather sidetracked. He picks up his datapad and squints, "Uh, where was I?"
entries.zh:
"噢。我有读过相关的资料。那是在远离核心世界的地方发生的绝境。虽然未经证实，各种来源说法不一，但真实情况的记录很可能已经被销毁了。事情是这样的，在船员们用完了最后的补给后，舰长就..."

院士猛然意识到他所说的已经有些跑题了。他重新拿起他的数据平板，眯起眼睛说道："嗯，我们刚才谈到哪了？"

o.zh: 询问关于被囚禁研究员的更多信息
询问关于被绑架研究员的更多信息

entries.en:
The pirates' fingers slither over a datapad as $heOrShe confirms the credits transfer.

"Very, very good," $heOrShe says without looking up, "You'll find your friend in the box."

The comms snap off.

Your logistics officer reports a pickup ping from a seemingly abandoned loading bay. You fear the worst as you dispatch a small shuttle to make the pickup, but you do indeed find a very unhappy academician of the Galatia Academy sealed in a crate with a small life-support unit. Given food, rest, and a shower, they'll be fine.
entries.zh:
海盗的手指在那数据平板上滑动着，确认了钱款到账。

"不错，很不错。" $heOrShe头也不抬地说，"你的朋友我就给您装到箱子里发过来了。"

通讯随即被切断了。

你的后勤官报告说，收到了来自疑似废弃装卸港口的提货请求。在穿梭机前去取回板条箱的路上，你一直担心会发生最坏的情况。万幸的是，你从箱子里找到的是一位很不爽的 Galatia 学院学者和一个小型维生装置。只要给点吃的，洗个澡，休息一下，这位学者就会没事的。

entries.en:
The pirates' fingers slither over a datapad as $heOrShe confirms the credits transfer.

"You'll find your friend in the box," $heOrShe says without looking up again.

The comms snap off.

Your logistics officer reports a pickup ping from a seemingly abandoned loading bay. You fear the worst as you dispatch a small shuttle to make the pickup, but you do indeed find a very unhappy academician of the Galatia Academy sealed in a crate with a small life-support unit. Given food, rest, and a shower, they'll be fine.
entries.zh:
海盗的手指在那数据平板上滑动着，确认了钱款到账。

"你的朋友我就给您装到箱子里发过来了。" $heOrShe头也不抬地说。

通讯被切断了。

你的后勤官报告说，收到了来自疑似废弃装卸港口的提货请求。在穿梭机前去取回板条箱的路上，你一直担心会发生最坏的情况。万幸的是，你从箱子里找到的是一位很不爽的 Galatia 学院学者和一个小型维生装置。只要给点吃的，洗个澡，休息一下，这位学者就会没事的。

entries.en:
You laugh, as though the pirate has told a hilarious joke. $HeOrShe looks confused at first, then with growing anger and disgust at being left out of some joke.

Wiping away a tear, you compliment the audacity of raising the price so blatantly, and observe that you would expect no less from ruthless space-scum of $hisOrHer caliber. Particularly when dealing with shiny-clean academics, who would get lost on the way to the head if they didn't have their datapad to lead them.
entries.zh:
你笑了，仿佛海盗刚讲了一个非常有趣的笑话。$HeOrShe起初看起来很困惑，之后便因为理解不了你的笑点而开始变得愤怒而厌烦。

擦掉笑出来的眼泪，你对$HeOrShe的厚颜无耻表示佩服，居然能如此嚣张地抬价，还说自己真不该低估$HeOrShe这种太空渣滓不要脸的程度。特别是在和这些天真纯洁的学者打交道的时候，毕竟这些人要是手上没了数据平板的话，连走路都找不着北。

entries.en:
"We, of course, are different animals," you explain as you smile ruthlessly back at the pirate.

$HeOrShe quickly comes around to the idea that you're an up-and-coming force, someone willing to do what it takes. And if they want to stay relevant, they're going to have to foster a good working relationship with you. Wouldn't want to end up spaced out of several different airlocks, right?

The first step toward this brighter future is, naturally, reducing the proposed ransom to something more reasonable, like $gaRR_costVeryLow. It's important that money exchanges hands to signal mutual respect, but to ask too much would be a poor investment "In our future as business partners," you explain.
entries.zh:
"当然，我和你，属于完全不同的两种生物。" 你朝那海盗回以冷酷的微笑，一边解释道。

$HeOrShe很快意识到，你作为一股新兴力量的领袖，应该是个做事不惜代价的家伙。因此，如果还想继续打交道的话，还是和你建立良好的合作关系为妙。毕竟谁都不想最后落下个被大卸八块之后从几个气闸里丢太空去的结局，不是吗？

作为共建美好明天的第一步，降低赎金到合理的数字，比如 $gaRR_costVeryLow 星币，就是很自然的选择了。虽然金钱的交换象征着彼此的互信，但漫天要价在 "我们作为未来的商业伙伴的情况下" 显然不是明智之举，你解释道。

entries.en:
You order the much smaller payment of $gaRR_costVeryLow to the cowed pirate who can barely tear $hisOrHer eyes from $hisOrHer cracked datapad until the incoming credits can be confirmed.

Your logistics officer reports a pickup ping from a seemingly abandoned loading bay. You fear the worst as you dispatch a small shuttle to make the pickup, but you do indeed find a very unhappy academician of the Galatia Academy sealed in a crate with a small life-support unit. Given food, rest, and a shower, they'll be fine.

The pirate speaks, relieved to see you've confirmed that the kidnapped academician is alive, "Captain, I'm-"
entries.zh:
你下令向这个受惊的小海盗支付 $gaRR_costVeryLow 星币，而$hisOrHer的眼睛则死死盯着手中的破解版数据平板，直到确认汇入的星币到账。

你的后勤官报告说，收到了来自疑似废弃装卸港口的提货请求。在穿梭机前去取回板条箱的路上，你一直担心会发生最坏的情况。万幸的是，你从箱子里找到的是一位很不爽的 Galatia 学院学者和一个小型维生装置。只要给点吃的，洗个澡，休息一下，这位学者就会没事的。

看到被绑架的学者还活着，海盗松了一口气，说道："舰长，我 ——"

entries.en: You turn your back and snap the comms off with a flick.
entries.zh: 你背过身去，打了个响指把通讯链接切断了。

entries.en:
The pirate $personLastName reels back a half-step, looking hurt. "That wasn't- captain, captain. Are you new to this? That must be it." The pirate produces a long, wheezing sigh.

"I can see you're just going to make trouble over this. It isn't my job to educate you in how the world works out here, and if this is how you act, you're going to have a," $heOrShe looks you over, and sneers, "-a long, painful education."

"So. I give up. Let it be $gaRR_costNormal credits then, I don't care. Take this screeching egg-head away, I beg you."
entries.zh:
海盗 $personLastName 向后退了半步，一副很受伤的样子。"唉不是...舰长，舰长啊，您是头一回干这事吗？我猜肯定是这样。" 海盗故意长长地叹了口气。

"看得出来，你迟早得因此惹上麻烦。我没空教你这里的行事准则，并且要是你以后还是这种作风的话..." $heOrShe望着你，冷笑道，"那你估计还得被痛苦地教育个挺长时间的。"

"算了，我认了。$gaRR_costNormal 星币就行，我无所谓了。赶紧把这个叽喳怪叫的秃头领走吧，我可谢谢您了。"

o.en: Accept and pay the original ransom of $gaRR_costNormal credits
o.zh: 接受并支付 $gaRR_costNormal 星币的原始赎金

o.en: Decline and cut the comm link
Decline, but trace the comms for a target for a marine raid
o.zh: 拒绝，但是追踪通讯信号并发动陆战队劫掠

o.en: Or I trace your comms and reduce your compound to slag. (threaten)
o.zh: 否则我就追踪你的通讯信号，让你的老巢从人间蒸发。 (威胁)

entries.en:
The comms signal struggles to establish through the ill-maintained local network. It takes seconds for the patchy decryption artifacts to spasmodically resolve into the face of the pirate you were instructed to contact.

You perform a perfunctory greeting, and the pirate smiles without warmth. "Ah, you're here for the Academy's lost child. We shall both be pleased to see the last of one another," $heOrShe rolls $hisOrHer eyes, "-it's the questions! So many questions."
entries.zh:
通讯信号在维护不善的本地网络中艰难地建立起来。花了几秒钟的时间，破旧的解密元件才断断续续地显示出一张面孔，正是你被指示联系的那位海盗。

你敷衍了事地打了个招呼，而海盗也是一副皮笑肉不笑的样子。"啊，你是来找学院那个迷路的孩子的。把事情一次结清对咱们都好，" $heOrShe翻了个白眼，"—— 这事很烦人！超烦人的。"

entries.en: The pirate claps $hisOrHer hands and looks back to you with all the eagerness of a lamprey. "You have my money, yes? $gaRR_costHigh credits, to my comms ID, and you can have your big wet scientist back."
entries.zh: 海盗拍了拍手，对你露出七鳃鳗般渴望的笑容。"你把我的钱带来了，对吧？$gaRR_costHigh 星币，打我通讯 ID 上，然后你就可以把您的大科学家接走了。"

o.en: Accept the higher amount and pay $gaRR_costHigh credits
o.zh: 接受坐地起价，支付 $gaRR_costHigh 星币
这可不是当初说好的价格。 (对峙)

o.en: Keep $himOrHer talking while you send a marine raid
o.zh: 拖着$himOrHer继续交谈，一边发动陆战队劫掠

entries.en:
You haggle, argue, and stall by quibbling over payment and delivery details. While speaking, you give the ready-signal via your datapad to your tactical officer. They have already been briefed for an extraction operation.

Regardless of the particular crimes of your contact, there are likely to be serious reputation consequences with the local authorities for starting a firefight within this polity.
entries.zh:
你和海盗讨价还价，斤斤计较，在付款和交货细节上争论不休，以此来拖延时间。在说话的同时，你通过手上的数据平板给战术军官发出了准备出击的信号。对方已经被告知要参与一次人质解救任务。

不管对面的海盗犯下了什么罪行，在当地政府的地盘上掀起一场火拼，无疑会大大影响你在这里的声誉。

entries.en:
A thud and a bang carry through the pirate's commline as the image goes fuzzy for a moment. $HeOrShe looks back at you, eyes wide with panic and anger, "You conniving clone of-"

The comms go dark. You switch the display to the tactical feed from your marines just as they report success.
entries.zh:
一声闷响之后，剧烈的爆炸声从海盗那边传来，通讯的图像也模糊了片刻。$HeOrShe回过头来看向你，睁大的双眼中充满了愤怒与恐慌，"你这贱逼克隆婊子养的 ——"

通讯器暗了下来。当你在平板上切换到来自陆战队员的战术信息时，行动成功的讯息也正好传来。

entries.en:
The pirate's eyes go wide. $HeOrShe quickly glances to someone off-screen and gives a little shake of the head, then returns $hisOrHer attention back to you.

"Rude. Just rude. You would threaten me with this? Here?" the pirate stomps back and forth, "You don't know who I know. I know pirate-bosses that will chew you up into little pieces. You have no idea who I work for."

"$gaRR_costVeryLow credits. If you can't pay that much, then I might as well throw myself out the airlock now. At least I'll go in one piece. My bosses wouldn't be so kind."
entries.zh:
海盗的眼睛瞪大了。$HeOrShe迅速瞥了一眼屏幕外的人，轻轻摇了摇头，然后把$HeOrShe的注意力重新集中到你身上。

"粗鄙。真是粗鄙。你敢拿这个威胁我？在我的地盘上？" 海盗来回跳着脚，"你不知道我认识谁，我认识的海盗大佬能把你嚼成碎末。你想象不到我在给谁干活。"

"$gaRR_costVeryLow 星币，如果这个价你也出不起的话，那我还不如直接把自己扔出气闸算了，至少还能死有全尸。我的老板可没这么仁慈。"

o.en: Accept and pay the smaller ransom of $gaRR_costVeryLow credits
o.zh: 同意并支付更低的 $gaRR_costVeryLow 星币赎金

o.en: Decline and cut the comm link
Decline, but trace the comms for a target for a marine raid
o.zh: 拒绝，但追踪通讯信号并发动陆战队劫掠

entries.en: "Greetings, captain. Perhaps you are an alumni? Have you considered donating to a scholarship trust with the Academy?"
entries.zh: "您好，舰长。也许您是本校校友？您考虑过向学院的奖学金信托捐款吗？"

entries.en: The agent smiles brightly. "Have you given some thought to setting up that scholarship fund with the Academy?"
entries.zh: 代理人笑得很灿烂。"你有没有考虑过与学院一起设立奖学金？"

entries.en:
You order your $shipOrFleet to traverse the dead gateway. Your bridge crew is especially quiet during the passage.

Nothing happens.
entries.zh:
你命令你的$shipOrFleet穿越废弃的星门。在穿越星门的过程中，舰桥上的船员们显得格外地安静。

什么事情都没有发生。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches the $entityName.

It is a Leviathan from out of time, at once familiar from its many and varied depictions in the secondary culture of the post-Collapse Persean Sector.

But to see it here in the proverbial flesh, it is the alien force of the Domain's power reified before you, looming like a blackened emperor slumped dead - but dreaming still - on a throne of stars.

You feel the weight of history pressing upon your chest, a tone like a distant ringing. You are frozen for an unconscious moment as if your mind was held in the gaze of a god; and in the next instant it is nothing but the buzz of power conduits and low thrum of agrav within the drive bubble, usually relegated to a filter of unperception by your subconscious.

You adjust your uniform and turn to your bridge officers.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet接近了 $entityName。

它是一位从过去踏入当下的巨兽，在 大崩塌 后 英仙座星域 的次生文化中，对其浩如烟海的描述使你一眼便将其认出。

但真正看到它传说中的躯干时，印象中 人之领 那神秘诡异的力量在你眼前凝聚成了实体。赫然是一位尸身虽然焦黑，却仍沉浸于悠悠长梦之中，倚睡于繁繁星宿之上的帝王。

你能感到历史的沉重音调压抑在你心头，耳中仿佛听到了亘古流传的回响。你的灵魂仿佛被一位神明凝视，上一个不经意的瞬间，世间万物都被凝固；而下一瞬间，一切又归于虚无，耳边只剩下了能量管道的嗡鸣声和驱动泡内重力场的底噪 —— 那是那些通常在你潜意识中被忽略掉的声音。

你整理了下你的制服，转头面向你的舰桥军官们。

o.en: Order salvage teams to perform an assessment
o.zh: 命令你的打捞小组进行分析

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches the $entityName.

Before you is a Leviathan from out of time, at once familiar from its many and varied depictions in the secondary culture of the post-Domain Persean Sector.
