You can feel the magisterial force upon you; your officers and crew are hushed, humbled and reverent, as if they have found themselves before the corpse of a thunderous and cruel god who once ruled the skies. To awaken it, to touch the divine, must fall somewhere between sacrilege and sanctification.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。

在你面前的是一位从过去踏入当下的巨兽，在后 人之领 时代 英仙座星域 的次生文化中，对其浩如烟海的描述使你一眼便将其认出。你可以感受到它身上不容侵犯的威严；你的军官和船员们顷刻间变得肃穆，谦卑，虔诚，仿佛他们站在一位曾经统治天空的雷厉神明的残像之前。想要去唤醒它，一窥那种神性，就必须投身于那亵渎与神圣的模糊界限。

o.en: Have your chief engineer review a plan to reactivate the Hauler
o.zh: 让你的总工程师制定一个 重启星门运输舰 的计划

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.

Energy surges throughout the vast hull as ancient conduits and machines self-test - some failing. Long-dormant self-repair drones seethe like vermin.

Your sensors officer's console lights up with incoming reports. Magnetic fields shudder and stabilize through test patterns, a growing stream - a river, a torrent - of neutrinos spill from reactions deep in the mass of the beast. Your $shipOrFleet's drive bubble compensates for gravitic fluctuations as space-time is tested.

The Gate Hauler is still awakening.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet接近了 $entityName。

随着古老的导管和机械开始自我调试，能量流传遍了巨大的船体 —— 而有些显示出了故障。休眠了许久的维修无人机开始如蝇群般游走于船体之中。

你传感器技官面前的屏幕闪烁着各类报告。重力场随着调试流程一次次震荡，平复，面前巨兽深处反应所喷出的中微子流从微弱的溪流变为河流，最终成为激流。你$shipOrFleet的驱动泡中和着时空压力所引起的引力震荡。

星门运输舰还在苏醒之中。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.

The titanic ship lays potent before you, ancient but powerful drive fields thrumming through the membrane of spacetime. You can almost feel it through the agrav's self-correction, the drone of a god-machine. Almost.

Once provided with a destination, the Gate Hauler will travel through normal-space - a Gate cannot be moved through hyperspace. The Hauler will travel faster than lightspeed, thankfully, due to its venerable Alcubierre drive. Indeed, the Hauler will quickly accelerate to an apparent normal-space speed which your $shipOrFleet cannot match with its relatively tiny in-system drives. The journey will still take quite some time, due to travelling significantly slower than standard hyperspace permits.

After it has arrived at the target destination, you may give the order to deploy the Gate to an unoccupied stable location.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet接近了 $entityName。

巨舰巍然耸立于你面前，古老但依旧强大的驱动场震动着时空膜。你几乎可以通过重力场的自我调试感受到机械巨神的低鸣。几乎如此。

输入坐标后，星门运输舰会通过常规空间驶向目的地 —— 星门自身无法通过超空间移动。得益于其古老的阿库别瑞引擎，运输舰能以超光速行驶。运输舰很快便会加速到一个你的$shipOrFleet相对薄弱的常规引擎无法跟上的常规空间速度。尽管如此，这段旅途还是要花上相当一段时间，因为运输舰的驱动方式还是远慢于常规超空间航行的速度。

当运输舰到达其目的地后，你可以下令让其在一个空置的 稳定点 部署星门。

o.en: Select a destination for the Gate Hauler
o.zh: 为星门运输舰选择一个目的地

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.

While in transit, what's left of the electronic brain - distributed, multiply redundant, well-shielded - is utterly focused on its goal. There is no realistic prospect of altering the course of the gargantuan ship and, indeed, when it is in its acceleration phase, of keeping up with it as it picks up speed in normal-space.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet接近了 $entityName。

在航行途中，运输舰那分布配置，多层备份，防护良好的电子大脑完完全全地专注于其目标。没有什么办法能让这艘庞然大物停下，而随着其开始加速，继续跟上它的速度也是痴人说梦。

entries.en:
A silent ring of adamantine material, derelict of a former age.

The Gate is inert.
entries.zh:
一座沉寂已久的环状结构，由坚固的材料制成，是来自上个时代的遗迹。

星门一片死寂。

entries.en:
Before you vast and potent hangs an adamantine ring, derelict of a former age.

You have scanned this Gate and discovered the rhythm of the secret heart of the thing, hidden in a slip of space. Using the Janus Device to create a bridge to another Gate requires a massive quantity of fuel. The more distant the target, the more fuel is required.

The Janus Device operates by transferring enormous amounts of peculiarly phased energy via a lead ship's hyperdrive field to stabilize a direct gate-to-gate connection.
entries.zh:
一座巨大而坚不可摧的环状结构屹立在你面前，这是来自上个时代的遗迹。

你已经扫描了这座星门，且知晓它隐藏在空间断层中关键的核心运行节律。使用 "双面神" 装置建立通往另一星门的桥路需要大量的燃料。目标星门越远，需要的燃料就越多。

"双面神" 装置的运作方式是通过领航舰的超空间驱动场输送大量的独特相位能量，以稳定两个星门之间的直接连接。

entries.en:
Before you vast and potent hangs an adamantine ring, derelict of a former age.

You have scanned this Gate and discovered the rhythm of the secret heart of the thing, hidden in a slip of space. Using the Janus Device to create a bridge to another Gate requires a massive quantity of fuel. The more distant the target, the more fuel is required.

You must integrate the Janus Device into your fleet to use the Gate.
entries.zh:
一座巨大而坚不可摧的环状结构屹立在你面前，这是来自上个时代的遗迹。

你已经扫描了这座星门，且知晓它隐藏在空间断层中关键的核心运行节律。使用 "双面神" 装置建立通往另一星门的桥路需要大量的燃料。目标星门越远，需要的燃料就越多。

你必须将 "双面神" 装置整合到你的舰队中才能使用星门。

entries.en:
A silent ring of adamantine material, derelict of a former age.

Your sensors officer nods to your cue. Your command interface lights up. 'EXECUTE SCAN' blinks expectantly. The Gate awaits, as cold as a tomb.
entries.zh:
一座沉寂已久的环状结构，由坚固的材料制成，是来自上个时代的遗迹。

你的传感器技官向你点头示意。你的指令界面亮了起来。"启动扫描" 的按键仿佛满怀期待一般闪烁着。星门依然如墓穴般冰冷，一如既往地静候着。

entries.en:
A silent ring of adamantine material, derelict of a former age.

You have scanned this Gate and discovered the rhythm of the secret heart of the thing, hidden in a slip of space.
entries.zh:
一座沉寂已久的环状结构，由坚固的材料制成，是来自上个时代的遗迹。

你已经扫描了这座星门，且知晓它隐藏在空间断层中关键的核心运行节律。

entries.en:
A silent ring of adamantine material, derelict of a former age.

Your sensors officer nods to you; the hyperwave scanner is ready. The words 'EXECUTE SCAN' blink expectantly in your command interface.

You will need a scan of this Gate to be able to use it, with the Janus Device, as an access or egress point from the Gate network.
entries.zh:
一座沉寂已久的环状结构，由坚固的材料制成，是来自上个时代的遗迹。

你的传感器技官向你点头示意；而超波扫描仪已经就绪。"启动扫描" 的按键在你的指令面板上令人满怀期待地闪烁着。

你需要先对该星门进行扫描才能将它作为星门网络的出入口，然后才可通过 "双面神" 装置使用它。

entries.en:
Your command display shows the hyperspace manifold. It is calm and cool.

The scanning beam flares in the hyperdimensional display. Spirals and ripples spill in bursts from the Gate, surging into inconceivable geometry. You hear a wisp of faint music.

"Captain," your sensors officer reports, "The scan is complete."
entries.zh:
你的指挥界面上显示出了星门周围的超空间流形。它平稳而寂静。

扫描光束在超维度显示画面中闪烁着。漩涡和涟漪从星门中喷涌而出，汇聚成无法描述的几何结构。你听到了一丝微弱的乐音。

"舰长，" 你的传感器技官汇报道，"扫描完成了。"

entries.en:
Your command display shows a representation of the hyperspace manifold. It is calm and cool.

The scan begins, a line of disruption flaring between your flagship and the Gate. Spirals and ripples spill and surge in non-Newtonian bursts from a point at the center of the Gate. No, not a point - a circle, a sphere, a torus and inverted funnel; then some geometry that does not parse.

You hear the faint music.

"Captain," your sensors officer reports, "The scan is complete."
entries.zh:
你的指挥界面上显示着星门周围的超空间流形图像。它平稳而寂静。

扫描开始，你看到你的旗舰和星门之间摇曳着一条扭曲的连线。漩涡和涟漪随后如非牛顿流体一般，从星门中央处的一个点喷涌而出。不，那不是一个点 —— 而是一个圆、一个球体、一个圆环、一个倒置的环形漏斗；直到最后产生了一些无法用几何描述的东西。

你听到了微弱的乐音。

"舰长，" 你的传感器技官汇报道，"扫描完成了。"

entries.en:
Your command display is overlaid with a representation of the hyperspace manifold surrounding the Gate. It is calm and cool, devoid of drive-wakes.

As the scan begins you watch a line of disruption flare between the icon representing your flagship and the icon representing the Gate. Spirals and ripples spill out in non-Newtonian waves, surging from a point at the center of the Gate. No, it's not a point - a circle, a sphere, a torus and inverted funnel; then some other form that makes you squeeze your eyes shut. You hear faint music from far away.

"Captain?" Your sensors officer is looking at you, "The scan is complete." You realize it's the second time they said this, and you gesture as if you were simply lost in thought.
entries.zh:
你的指挥界面上叠加显示着星门周围的超空间流形图像。它平稳而寂静，和超空间驱动器留下的航迹截然不同。

扫描开始，你看到在代表你旗舰和星门的图标之间摇曳着一条扭曲的连线。漩涡和涟漪随后如非牛顿流体的波动一般溢泄着，从星门中央处的一个点涌出。不，那不是一个点 —— 而是一个圆、一个球体、一个圆环、一个倒置的环形漏斗；接着又变换成其他形态，逼得你紧紧闭上双眼。你听到远处传来了微弱的乐音。

"舰长？" 你的传感器技官正看着你，"扫描完成了。" 你才意识到这是对方第二次说这句话了。你打了个手势，用沉思作为借口掩饰了自己的失态。

entries.en: "Provost Baird put in a request for the extraction of a, um, researcher? From er ... a heavily guarded Tri-Tachyon black site in the outer Sector. Also I'm not supposed to tell you where it is before you accept the mission." Sebestyen looks up at you awkwardly, "For reasons."
entries.zh: "Baird 院长提出了一个请求，请求前往一处...呃...戒备森严的 速子科技 秘密据点，并接回一名...嗯...科研人员。老样子，在您接受任务以前，我不能告诉您该据点的具体位置，" Sebestyen 尴尬地抬起头来看着你，"出于某些原因。"

entries.en:
As your $shipOrFleet prepares to de-orbit, you plug the datachip into a secure terminal to see what Provost Baird decided to risk your life for. It is encrypted, of course, and the routine ICE-breaker doesn't crack it. Rarely does, but one must be thorough.

You think for only a moment before inputting the secure comm frequency given to you by Sebestyen to contact this 'researcher'. The crypto unfolds, leaving you with a tiny code package that seems to want to interface with a standard Domain hyperdrive kernel. You call your navigation officer over to consult.
entries.zh:
在你的$shipOrFleet准备脱离轨道时，你把那张数据芯片插入了一个安全的终端机，想看看上面到底有什么东西，使 Baird 院长不惜让你冒生命危险也要拿到。当然，芯片上的内容经过了加密，而常规的反入侵机制破解工具拿它毫无办法。虽然这种通用的破解方法很少能起作用，但仍然值得尝试一下。

你稍作思考，便输入了之前 Sebestyen 给你的，用于联系这位 '研究员' 的通讯安全频率。加密的数据包被解开了，里面是一段简短的程序代码。这段代码似乎需要与一套标准的 人之领 超空间驱动场控制核心进行交互才能发挥作用。你把你的领航员叫了过来，以提供参考意见。

entries.en:
"It appears to 'tune' the hyperdrive field," they explain. "And if this does what it says it does, it would be able to create the effect of a sort of pseudo jump-point around the ship itself." The excitement in their voice is palpable, "Theoretically an entire fleet could launch itself into hyperspace from ... anywhere!"

You react without surprise to this development, thanking the officer for the input.

"Um, yes, $PlayerSirOrMadam," they say uncertainly. "I'll return to my station and await your orders."

You upload a copy of the datachip's contents to your personal TriPad. Just in case.
entries.zh:
"这个程序似乎会对超空间驱动场进行一些 '微调'。" 领航员解释道，"如果这个程序的功能真的如那位研究员所说，那就可以在舰船周围创造一种类似于跳跃点的模拟效果。" 领航员的声音中透出难掩的兴奋，"从理论上来说，整个舰队都可以从任何地方...直接跃入超空间！"

你对这一结论并不感到惊讶，只是对领航员提供的见解表示了感谢。

"嗯，好的，$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 领航员有点猜不透你的想法，"那我就先回我的岗位了，随时听候您的命令。"

保险起见，你把数据芯片里的信息也上传了一份到你自己的 TriPad 上。

entries.en: "Captain! Thank you for returning- " Sebestyen freezes, then lowers his voice, "-for returning the ah, researcher. Provost Baird will be very pleased. She's restarting the hyperspace- um, well, I shouldn't ruin it. I'm sure there'll be a proper announcement when they're all ready."
entries.zh: "舰长！感谢您把那个 —— " Sebestyen 突然顿住，然后压低声音说道，"把那个...那个研究员送回来，Baird 院长一定会很高兴的，她现在正忙着重启那个超空间 —— 呃，好吧，我不该多嘴。估计等他们准备好了以后，才会发一个适当的声明来公开这件事。"

entries.en:
"Yes! Okay." Sebestyen clears his throat nervously.

"The provost said I shouldn't... um, I can't tell you the location of the target system until after you accept. So." He trails off, and re-aligns the datapad on his desk, as if that might help. Everything set to order, he has no choice but to continue speaking.

"This mission requires... discretion. As I'm sure you know, there are many - technically - unclaimed systems outside the core worlds. If some polity were to make an official claim, they'd have to establish a charter and, well, this would - technically - give the Domain jurisdiction. Of course without the Domain around, the Hegemony has claimed successor status and has therefore stepped into the role of..."
entries.zh:
"好的，没问题！" Sebestyen 紧张地清了清嗓子。

"院长说在您接受任务前，我不应该...呃，我不能告诉您目标所在的星系位置。所以..."，他的声音渐渐低了下去，一边开始整理桌上的数据平板，似乎觉得这样做可能会有点用。所有东西都摆好之后，他别无选择，只能继续说。

"这项任务需要...谨慎行事。想必您也知道，在核心星区外，有很多理论上无人占有的星系。如果某个政体希望占领某处，他们必须获得来自 人之领 的特许，这相当于 人之领 拥有了此地的管辖权。当然，在 人之领 消失后，霸主 已经自诩为其继承者，并据此开始行使 人之领 的权力..."

entries.en:
Sebestyen notices you drifting.

"I'm sorry captain, what I mean to say is that the Tri-Tachyon corporation considers the site in question to be outside the jurisdiction of, er... anyone. And it is therefore within their rights to establish ah, a secret research base. And defend them however they see fit. The Hegemony disagrees."

"And so um," Sebestyen pinches his eyes shut for a moment, "They hire these mercenaries and, and they shoot anything that comes near. It's terrible!"
entries.zh:
Sebestyen 注意到你有点走神。

"不好意思，舰长。我其实是想说，速子科技 认为这个地方不属于，呃... 任何人的管辖范围，因此他们有权建立，嗯，那种秘密研究基地，并会以他们认为合适的方式进行自卫。而 霸主 则对此颇有微词。"

"因此，" Sebestyen 把眼睛紧闭了片刻，"他们聘请了这些雇佣兵，然后，然后他们会朝着一切靠近的物体开火。太恐怖了！"

o.en: Watch out for mercs, got it. The mission?
o.zh: 懂了，需要小心那些雇佣兵。那么任务的具体内容呢？

entries.en:
"Oh! I was just getting to that. Well, the previous provost, Tomas Kallichore, he worked closely with Tri-Tachyon. There was some pretty exciting research, actually, and... sorry, the mission: an academician from the Galatia Academy is still stationed at one of these secret research bases and... Provost Baird wants them back."

"But this academician was never there in the first place, technically. Legally speaking. Because it was all a big secret."

Sebestyen looks pained at the logic of these politics, "So Tri-Tachyon isn't, um, cooperating. Do you see?"
entries.zh:
"哦，我正要说这个呢。前任院长 Tomas Kallichore 与 速子科技 之间有紧密的合作关系。实际上，他们共同参与了许多激动人心的研究，而且...抱歉，说回到这次的任务上：一位 Galatia 学院的学者目前仍然驻扎在其中一处秘密科研基地中，而现在... Baird 院长希望把这个人带回来。

"但严格来说，这位学者在法律层面上一开始就不存在，整件事都是在严格保密的状态下进行的。"

Sebestyen 看上去对这错综复杂的政治逻辑感到有些头疼，"因此 速子科技 不太愿意...配合此事，您可以理解吗？"

o.en: You want me to kidnap a researcher from a secret Tri-Tachyon base?
o.zh: 所以你想让我从 速子科技 的秘密基地绑走一名研究员？

o.en: You want me to 'rescue' a researcher from a secret Tri-Tachyon base?
o.zh: 所以你想让我从 速子科技 的秘密基地 '解救' 一名研究员？

entries.en: He looks around, "Please, don't tell anyone I told you that part. Um. So if you can help, Provost Baird has insisted that you receive $gaTJ_reward credits. I'm authorized to provide more information if you accept."
entries.zh: 他环顾四周，说道，"拜托，可别跟别人说是我向您透露了这些事。呃，所以如果您愿意帮忙的话，Baird 院长坚持要给您 $gaTJ_reward 星币作为报酬。如果您同意，我可以给您提供更多的有关信息。"

entries.en: "No no no, it's not kidnapping!" Sebestyen seems sick at the thought, "The researcher wants to come home, $gaTJ_heOrShe managed to get some communications out and we've set up a whole system... er."
entries.zh: "不不不，不是绑架！" Sebestyen 看起来不太喜欢这个说法，"是那个研究员想回来，$gaTJ_heOrShe设法和外界联络上了，然后我们就安排了一套完整的方案...呃。"

entries.en: "Yes, exactly!" Sebestyen seems relieved at your understanding. "The researcher wants to come home, $gaTJ_heOrShe managed to get some communications out and we've set up a whole system... er."
entries.zh: "对，就是这样！" Sebestyen 看起来因你的理解而松了口气，"是那个研究员想回来，$gaTJ_heOrShe设法和外界联络上了，然后我们就安排了一套完整的方案...呃。"

entries.en:
"Wonderful," Academician Sebestyen looks relieved.

"The research base is on the planet $gaTJ_planetName in the $gaTJ_systemName system, which is $gaTJ_dist light-years from here."

"You'll want to avoid the, er, mercenary patrols. We believe they'll be guarding all of the jump-points, so if you can find a large gravity well to jump to, that could get you safely in-system. Then go to where the research base is hidden and contact Academician $gaTJ_researcherName through the coded frequency that I'll provide. $gaTJ_HeOrShe should be able to shut down the base's security for long enough to get aboard your ship."
entries.zh:
"太好了。" Sebestyen 院士看起来松了口气。

"那个研究基地位于 $gaTJ_systemName 星系中的 $gaTJ_planetName 上，且距此 $gaTJ_dist 光年。"

"您得避开那些，呃... 佣兵巡逻队。我相信他们一定会守住所有跳跃点的出入口。所以如果您想安全进入星系，可以找个大点的重力井跳进去。之后便可直接前往秘密研究基地，并用我提供的加密频率来联系 $gaTJ_researcherName 院士。$gaTJ_HeOrShe应该能暂时关闭基地的安全系统，而这足以为$gaTJ_HeOrShe登上你的舰队争取到足够多的时间。

entries.en:
Sebestyen re-reads his datapad with a concerned look, then adds "There's... a way to get back to hyperspace without using a jump-point. It might be useful."

He looks up at you, perhaps wondering if you'll think him insane, "It's not a joke. Before the Hegemony arrested so many of our top hyperspace researchers after the, ah, big incident, one of them - Academician Scylla Coureuse - was working on this theory, and we were very close to finding an application for a sort of Transverse Jump which could move a ship directly to hyperspace from normal-space."

He puts down the datapad, looking worried, "Theoretically."
entries.zh:
Sebestyen 焦虑地又重新看了看他的数据平板，然后补充道，"其实还有一种方法，可以不通过跳跃点就能返回超空间，可能会有用。"

他抬头看着你，猜测着这个点子会不会让你觉得他很疯狂。"我真没开玩笑。在之前的那场... 呃... 大事故中，霸主 逮捕了我们许多的顶尖超空间研究员。Scylla Coureuse 院士就在其中，她当时正在研究一种理论，并差点能把一种类似于{横轴跳跃}的理论付诸于应用了。这种方法可以让舰船从正常空间直接进入到超空间。"

他放下数据平板，忧心忡忡地说道："理论上是可行的。"

o.en: Oh, I know how to do that.
o.zh: 哦，其实我已经掌握你说的这个方法了。

entries.en:
Academician Sebestyen sits up a little straighter, "Yes! I'll transmit all the necessary information, captain. Good luck."

He puts down, then picks up his datapad. "And please be careful," he adds.
entries.zh:
Sebestyen 院士直了直身子，"哦对！我将会把完成任务所需的信息悉数传给您，舰长。祝您好运。"

他把手上的数据平板放下，又拿了起来，"也请您一定注意安全。" 他补充道。

entries.en:
"You- what?" Sebestyen looks stunned, processing your statement.

"I suppose, of course... There were rumors, anecdotes... um, do you mind providing some of your navigational logs? The data would be quite fascinating and, and..."
entries.zh:
"您已经 —— 啥？" Sebestyen 的脸上写满了震惊，一边消化着你的回答。

"我想...当然...确实有类似的传言和轶闻...呃如果不介意的话，您能提供些您舰队的导航日志以供参考吗？其中的数据想必会很有价值，而且，呃..."

o.en: I'll have my nav officer provide everything you need.
o.zh: 我的领航军官会提供你所需要的数据。

o.en: I don't think we have time for that.
o.zh: 我觉得我们现在没空干这事。

entries.en: "Um," he looks abashed. "Of course. Where were we..."
entries.zh: "呃，" 他看起来有些尴尬。"好吧。我们刚才在说什么来着..."

entries.en: "Wonderful," he smiles, "This could confirm the uh- right, you have things to do. Where were we..."
entries.zh: "太好了，" 他微笑着说，"这下子我们就可以证实这个 —— 呃对了，您还有正事要做。我们刚才在说什么来着..."

o.en: Ask about the Tri-Tachyon black site extraction mission
o.zh: 询问关于前往 速子科技 秘密据点的撤离任务

entries.en:
Almost immediately a worried face appears, dripping sweat. "Stars beyond," $gaTJ_heOrShe exclaims, "You actually came! I am Academician $gaTJ_researcherName and I'm ready to leave. Right now."

$gaTJ_HeOrShe laughs, sounding just a little unhinged, "It's been - rads and ruin, a long long time. I've pulled a copy of all the base archives, and," $gaTJ_heOrShe grins and holds up a small datachip, "The little secret Baird wants so badly. The EMP is about to go off, so don't panic when you detect it. I've hidden a shuttle in a shielded bay and I'll meet you in orbit soon. Just remember- "

A frantic alarm sounds behind $gaTJ_himOrHer. The researcher looks over $gaTJ_hisOrHer shoulder, "Ludd's hells-"

The signal cuts out.
entries.zh:
几乎在瞬间，屏幕上出现了一张紧张的面孔，满脸是汗。"繁星在上啊，" $gaTJ_heOrShe感叹道，"没想到你真的来了！我是 $gaTJ_researcherName 院士，我已经准备好跑路了，立马就走。"

$gaTJ_HeOrShe神经兮兮地笑了起来，"从很久以前开始，这破地方就已经啥也不剩了。我已经把基地里所有的档案拷了一份，而且..." $gaTJ_heOrShe咧开嘴，举起一张小小的数据芯片，"也拿到了 Baird 所渴望的小秘密。我弄的 EMP 马上就要爆炸了，所以一会看到的时候别慌。我在一座有电磁屏蔽的港口里藏了一架穿梭机，一会轨道上见。别忘了 —— "

$gaTJ_himOrHer身后响起一阵疯狂的警报声。院士回头望去，骂道，"我去它卢德的 —— "

信号中断了。

entries.en:
The EMP goes off like a flashbulb on your bridge holodisplay of the planet below. All stations set to high alert, you wait tense minutes for any sign of Baird's informant.

"There!" shouts your tactical officer.

The bridge display zooms in to a small energy source that just made low orbit - a tiny cargo shuttle without even a closed cockpit. Visual scans can just make out a suited figure riding on its light chassis, weak thrusters pushing a course toward intercept.
entries.zh:
舰桥的全息行星投影上，EMP 像闪光弹般瞬间爆炸，所有基地都进入了高度警戒状态。你紧张地等待着 Baird 的这位合作者的消息。

"在那！" 你的战术军官喊道。

舰桥显示在不断地放大，最终聚焦在一个刚刚突入低轨道的微弱能量源上 —— 是一架连封闭驾驶舱都没有的微型货运穿梭机。影像里勉强能看到一个穿着宇航服的人影骑在穿梭机轻飘飘的骨架上，由几个羸弱的推进器推着前往预定的会合点。

entries.en:
A space ops team ushers the freed academician into a debriefing chamber. "Captain," $gaTJ_heOrShe says with panic in $gaTJ_hisOrHer eyes, "There's no time. They got a signal out before the comms went down. I've got this," $gaTJ_heOrShe fumbles with a pouch on $gaTJ_hisOrHer vacuum rig, pulling out the datachip from earlier.

"It's a software patch. Roots and modifies hyperdrive field software. Then, on command, you can engage Transverse Jump. Jump from normal to hyperspace," a manic gleam comes into $gaTJ_researcherName's eyes, "Anywhere."
entries.zh:
一支太空行动小组将逃出生天的院士领进了一间简报室。"舰长。" $gaTJ_heOrShe说道，眼里充满了惊慌，"我们的时间不多了，他们在通讯被瘫痪之前就发出了一道警报。不过我拿到了这个。" $gaTJ_heOrShe从太空服上的一个小兜里摸出一张数据芯片，正是$gaTJ_heOrShe之前提到的那张。

"这里面是一个软件补丁，可以破解并修改超空间驱动场的控制程序。之后，你就可以随时下令，使用{横轴跳跃}从普通空间跳入超空间。" $gaTJ_researcherName 的眼中闪过一丝按耐不住的兴奋，"在任何地方都可以。"

o.en: No need. I already know how to do that.
o.zh: 用不着，我已经知道该怎么办了。

entries.en:
"You... what?" $gaTJ_researcherName looks at you, confused. "I've heard rumors. Just spacers' stories, I thought. There's no way you could tune the hyperdrive field that accurately on manual control. And if you made one mistake..."

$gaTJ_HeOrShe shakes $gaTJ_hisOrHer head, forlorn in the conclusion that $gaTJ_heOrShe has been rescued by a captain whose primary reactor is missing some shielding.

You take the datachip from $gaTJ_researcherName's trembling hand. Provost Baird wants this thing, so she'll get it. You order the academician to be seen to quarters - and watched - as you return to the bridge to decide whether to Transverse Jump directly to hyperspace or deal with the incoming mercs the old-fashioned way.
entries.zh:
"你已经...啥？" $gaTJ_researcherName 一头雾水地看着你。"我倒是听说过一些类似的传言，但我以为只是些太空佬编的故事罢了。在使用手动控制的情况下，你不可能把超空间驱动场调节得那么精确。但凡有一点误差，你就会..."

$gaTJ_HeOrShe大摇其头，绝望地认为自己的救命恩人，竟是一位脑子被船上主反应堆的辐射照坏了的疯子。

你从 $gaTJ_researcherName 颤抖的手中接过了数据芯片，既然 Baird 院长想要这东西，那就给她吧。你下令将院士送至宿舍 —— 并对其保持监视 —— 而你回到舰桥，考虑着是应该直接{横轴跳跃}进超空间，还是用老办法来对付那些雇佣兵。

entries.en:
You take the datachip from the escapee's trembling hand.

"Yes, yes," $gaTJ_researcherName says, "Use this and we can escape. Those mercs, captain, they're the expensive ones. No mere pirates, they're... " $gaTJ_heOrShe shudders, "They're cruel. And they have the best ships money can buy. You have to get us out of here."

You order the academician to be seen to quarters - and watched - as you return to the bridge.
entries.zh:
你从这逃出生天之人颤抖的手中接过了数据芯片。

"好，好。" $gaTJ_researcherName 说道，"用这个我们就可以跑路了。舰长，这些个速子佣兵可不是普通的海盗，他们很有钱..." $gaTJ_heOrShe打了个哆嗦，"也很残忍。他们开着能用钱买到的最好的船。您一定得带咱们逃出这里。"

你命令将学者送至宿舍 —— 并对其保持监视 —— 而你自己回到了舰桥上。

entries.en:
A look of fear crosses the escapee's face, "Captain! But you must. Please, just take it," $gaTJ_heOrShe moves forward, trying to push the datachip into your hands. And freezes as your bodyguards' sidearms appear.

"The merc fleets- they'll be coming for you now," $gaTJ_researcherName pleads. "They won't negotiate, captain. You have to get us out of here,"

You wave your bodyguards down and take the chip. Provost Baird wants this thing, so it must be worth something. You order the academician to be seen to quarters - and watched - as you return to the bridge.
entries.zh:
逃生者的脸上掠过一丝恐惧的神色，"舰长！但你必须这样做。求您了，收下吧。" $gaTJ_heOrShe凑了过来，想要把数据芯片硬塞给你。你的保镖掏出了随身携带的武器，$gaTJ_heOrShe立马站住了。

"这些速子佣兵 —— 他们马上就回来找你了。" $gaTJ_researcherName 恳求道，"他们可不会跟你谈判的，舰长，您得带我们立马跑路。"

你挥挥手叫保镖退下，接过了数据芯片。Baird 院长想要这个东西，所以里面肯定有什么好东西。你命令将院士送至宿舍 —— 并对其保持监视 —— 而你自己回到了舰桥上。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName. There is no outward sign of a Tri-Tachyon research base.

"Captain," your sensors officer brings your attention to a cluster of weak neutrino sources in the southern hemisphere. "Wouldn't have caught it if we didn't know what to look for."
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。从外表完全看不出 速子科技 研究基地的任何痕迹。

"舰长。" 传感器技官示意你注意下南半球的一簇中微子源。"还好我们知道此行的目的，否则我肯定会忽视这些玩意。"

entries.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making a rescue operation inadvisable.
entries.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，不应在此时进行救援行动。

o.en: Send a coded burst on the frequency provided by Sebestyen
o.zh: 使用 Sebestyen 提供的频率发送一道编码

entries.en:
They've been expecting you. Upon entering the traffic controlled volume of $gaVIP_marketName, you receive an incoming comms transmission from the offices of $gaVIP_VIPName. You arrange a dropoff point for $gaVIP_VIPhisOrHer $gaVIP_subjectRelation.

Before stepping off the transport, the young student turns back toward you and speaks.
entries.zh:
他们一直在等着你。在进入 $gaVIP_marketName 的交通控制区，你收到了来自 $gaVIP_VIPName 办公室的通讯信号。你为$gaVIP_VIPhisOrHer的 $gaVIP_subjectRelation 安排了一个下船点。

在走下运输艇之前，这位年轻的学生回头对你说话。

entries.en:
They've been expecting you. What passes for traffic control provides you a course past a field of stealth mines to enter the volume of $gaVIP_marketName. Soon you receive an incoming comms transmission from a grim boss of the Kanta dynasty, instructing you to make a drop-off for their $gaVIP_subjectRelation.

Before stepping off the transport, the young student turns back toward you and speaks.
entries.zh:
他们一直在等着你。交通管制部门为你提供了一条穿过隐形雷场的路线，以进入 $gaVIP_marketName 站内。很快，你就接收到了来自 Kanta 家族的一位冷酷头目的通讯信号，为你指示了一个给 $gaVIP_subjectRelation 引渡的位置。

在走下运输艇之前，这位年轻的学生回头对你说话。

entries.en: You're unable to complete the VIP delivery right now.
entries.zh: 你现在还不能完成 VIP 的移送。

entries.en: "A student from an influential family requires priority transport to $gaVIP_marketName in the $gaVIP_starName system within a short timeframe."
entries.zh: "一位背景雄厚的学生需要在短时间内优先将其送到 $gaVIP_starName 星系中的 $gaVIP_marketName。"

entries.en:
"The Academy provides secure and, and discreet transport to the very, very important students who attend. These are often rich or famous families you know, and there have been..." Sebestyen looks like he's trying not to look concerned. "Threats? Maybe. You never know. So."

He taps a datapad on his desk a couple times before deciding he should just plow ahead.

"This student is the $gaVIP_subjectRelation of $gaVIP_VIPName - that's the $gaVIP_VIPPost of $gaVIP_marketName, did you know? How exciting! Ah, and they require priority transport to $gaVIP_marketName in the $gaVIP_starName system for $gaVIP_event within $gaVIP_timeLimit days. We've been authorized an honorarium of... ", Sebestyen checks another datapad, "$gaVIP_reward credits. That's pretty good for an easy trip through the Core Worlds, right?"
entries.zh:
"学院为那些非常、非常重要的学生提供安全和，唔...谨慎的交通途径。你知道的，他们大都来自那些非常出名且富有的家族，况且过去我们也遇到过一些..." Sebestyen 好像在努力掩饰自己的担心，"遇到过些风险？也许吧，谁知道呢。"

他敲了几下桌上的数据平板，才终于下定决心继续说下去。

"这位学生是 $gaVIP_VIPName 的 $gaVIP_subjectRelation —— 这可是 $gaVIP_marketName 的 $gaVIP_VIPPost 啊，你知道吗？多么令人兴奋啊！哈，他们要求在 $gaVIP_timeLimit 天内，将其优先运送到 $gaVIP_starName 星系的 $gaVIP_marketName 以备 $gaVIP_event。我们已经获得了对方的授权，酬金为..." Sebestyen 检查了另一个数据平板，"$gaVIP_reward 星币，对于一次穿越核心世界的轻松旅途来说，这算是笔相当不错的报酬了，对吧？"

entries.en:
He goes a shade paler. "Oh um. You know. Threats."

You wait for him to elaborate. He gives in almost instantly.

"There are a lot of very bad people out there that say all kinds of things about important people and their, er, relations. And possibly, specifically, targeting a $gaVIP_subjectRelation of said family. They're usually not serious. Usually."

"...So are you still interested?"
entries.zh:
他的脸色变得白了几分。"噢，呃，你懂的。就是...那些风险。"

你一言不发，等着他的进一步说明。好在他没有让你等太久。

"眼下有许多坏家伙在谈论关于重要人物的各种事情，以及他们的，呃，人际关系。而且很可能，特别针对了其中的一个$gaVIP_subjectRelation。不过一般来说他们不是认真的... 一般不是。"

"那么你还有兴趣么？"

entries.en:
"Oh." Sebestyen looks again at the datapad in his hands. "Oh! My."

The academician seems to realize what this mission entails, suddenly. "That's ... that Kanta, isn't it? Oh. Wow, well yes. The Academy guarantees discretion and security to every family that entrusts us with their young students, no matter who. Whom, I mean."

Sebestyen puts on a serious look into the middle distance, "I am proud that we stand for the principles of education and knowledge, no matter where you, or anyone, comes from!"
entries.zh:
"噢，" Sebestyen 再次看向他手中的数据平板，"嗷！我的天。"

院士似乎意识到了这个任务的内容，突然，"那是... 那个 Kanta，是吗？噢，哇，好吧，学院对每一个托付子弟前来就学的家族都严守秘密、保障安全，无论是谁。我是说，无论何人。"

Sebestyen 隔着一些距离摆出了一副严肃的表情，"我很自豪我们依然坚守着有教无类与知识无界的原则，不论你，还是任何人，来自什么地方！"

entries.en:
He shakes his head and turns back to the datapad, "Where was- right, so the $gaVIP_subjectRelation of $gaVIP_kantaRelationFirstName Kanta - I wonder how closely they're related to the... Uh, never mind- they're a somebody at Kanta's Den. That will be priority transport to Kanta's Den in the Magec system within $gaVIP_timeLimit days. We've authorized an honorarium of, oh that's more than usual fee! $gaVIP_reward. Good, right?"

"Just-" he looks over his shoulder, then says quietly, "-be careful around those people, okay?"
entries.zh:
他摇了摇头，转回数据平板上，"那呢...对了，所以这个 $gaVIP_kantaRelationFirstName Kanta 的 $gaVIP_subjectRelation —— 我看看他们和那位到底有多亲近...呃，当我没说 —— 可是 Kanta 之巢里的大人物。所以这将是一份在 $gaVIP_timeLimit 天内直达 Magec 星系的高优先运输任务。我们已经获授权了一笔酬金，喔，这可比平常的费用要多！足足 $gaVIP_reward 星币。好极了，对吧？"

"只是..." 他头扭向自己的肩膀看过去，然后轻声说道，"和那些人打交道的时候还是要小心为妙，明白？"

o.zh: 询问有关 VIP 护送的事项。

entries.en:
Thinking quickly, you inform the mercenary captain that the passenger - a dangerous criminal, just as $heOrShe said - is being transported in a secured cargo container holding a single cryosleep unit. Therefore it will take some time to make the transfer due to the extra security arrangements you've made, but you emphatically agree that the proper authorities are best situated to bring the Kanta gang to justice.

The merc nods solemnly as you speak more of meting out justice and respecting authority. $HeOrShe gives a small salute as you sign off the comms to "personally oversee the transfer".
entries.zh:
迅速思考后，你告诉雇佣兵舰长，那名乘客，也就是$HeOrShe说的那个危险的罪犯，正锁在一个安全货物集装箱里的低温休眠装置中。由于你先前布置了额外的安保措施，因此进行转移需要额外花费一些时间。但你强调自己也认同让当局将 Kanta 团伙绳之于法是最好的做法。

你说到伸张正义和尊重权威时，雇佣兵郑重地点点头。当你在通讯器准备登出去 "亲自监督转移" 的时候，$HeOrShe甚至还给你行了个小礼。

entries.en:
Taking your hint during the comms call, your logistics officer and operations chief have already begun rigging a standard cargo container with an extra cryo pod.

As you enter the cargo bay your ops chief speaks, "Don't we need a body?"

Everyone looks at each other. No one says anything.

"Fine," the chief grumbles, "I guess this'll just have to do."
entries.zh:
因为听懂了你在通话中的暗示，你的后勤官和行动长官已经开始动手把一个多余的冷冻舱塞进标准货柜里了。

当你进入货舱时，行动长官问到："我们不搞个尸体进去吗？"

所有人面面相觑。没有人吐出一个字来。

"好吧，" 行动长官抱怨道，"我想就只能这么凑合着整了。"

entries.en:
Pod secured, your team scrambles the crypto on multiple locks: the cryopod itself, an interior crate packed into the cargo container with hastily-sprayed damage control foam, and on the heavy latches of the cargo container itself. The ruse won't hold up to sustained effort for long, but it should be enough to distract the merc long enough for you to put some light-years between you and them.

You return to the bridge having worked up a bit of a sweat, and comms the mercenary captain to inform $himOrHer that the secured prisoner will be on their way via cargo drone in just a moment. Now to the matter of the shared reward...
entries.zh:
冷冻舱固定好了之后，你的团队把好几个电子锁的密码都打乱了：冷冻舱本身的锁，草草用损控泡沫封装在货柜里的内箱上的锁，以及货柜重型活门上的锁。这个小伎俩拖不了太久，但它应该能让雇佣兵耽误好些时间，足以让你和他们拉开几光年的距离。

你回到舰桥时已经忙得出了点汗。之后重新和雇佣兵舰长进行了通话，通知$himOrHer被关好的囚犯马上就会通过货运无人机上路。现在应该到了讨论赏金分配的时候了...

entries.en:
Through an impressive display of flattery and feigned esprit de corps, you talk the merc into an up-front payment of $gaVIP_mercPayment credits.

After all, as you explain, "We are knights errant to this chaotic age. It is captains like you that uphold a code of honor higher than that of mere freebooters and through armed struggle demonstrate practical virtues that might again grow in the dry heart of the outcast Persean Sector."

The merc captain nods emphatically to your words. Your TriPad pings behind your back as incoming funds are automatically accepted.
entries.zh:
通过一番令人印象深刻的奉承和巴结，你说服雇佣兵预先支付 $gaVIP_mercPayment 星币。

毕竟，就和你所说的那样，"我们是这个混乱时代的骑士。正是像你这样的舰长坚持的比单纯的自由意志海盗更为高尚的荣誉准则，通过武装斗争印证了实际的美德，这些美德可能会在被抛弃的英仙座星域那些枯萎的心灵中再度绽放。"

雇佣兵舰长对你的话强调地点点头。你的 TriPad 在身后响起，转账到达的资金被自动接受了。

entries.en:
Your dealings completed, the merc offers not even a smile, and says "Burn bright, captain. I shall see you again soon, I hope."

Your nav officer begins to disengage your $shipOrFleet from the mercenaries at a leisurely burn, following previous orders.
entries.zh:
你们的交易完成后，这位雇佣兵笑都没笑一下，只是说："航行无阻，舰长，我希望很快会再见到你。"

你的领航军官开始按照之前的命令，让$shipOrFleet从雇佣兵那悠闲地脱离出来。

o.en: I am sure it will be an unforgettable meeting. Comms out.
o.zh: 我相信这将是一次令人难忘的会面，通讯完毕。

entries.en: The merc lifts $hisOrHer chin up a few degrees. "Very good, captain. I shall expect immediate transfer of the pris- passenger to my flagship."
entries.zh: 雇佣兵把$HeOrShe下巴抬高了几个度。"很好，舰长，我希望立即将这名乘客转移到我的旗舰上。"

o.en: Transfer the VIP to the merc's ship
o.zh: 把 VIP 移送至雇佣兵的船上

o.en: Hold on, we haven't discussed my payment.
o.zh: 等一下，我们还没有讨论报酬问题。

entries.en:
The mercenary captain stands unmoving before you as the comms link opens.

"Captain $playerName I presume," $heOrShe says. "I have reason to believe that you are transporting an individual associated with the notorious Kanta pirate gang. I have been authorized by $gaVIP_theMercFaction to apprehend this individual for questioning. Please surrender the passenger to my custody immediately."
entries.zh:
当通讯链接打开时，雇佣兵舰长一动不动地站在你面前。

"我猜你就是 $playerName 舰长。" $HeOrShe说道，"我有理由相信，你正在运送一个与臭名昭著的 Kanta 海盗团伙有关的人。我已被 $gaVIP_theMercFaction 授权逮捕此人进行审问，请立即将该乘客交给我监管。"

entries.en:
The mercenary's eyes flick off to one side and $hisOrHer jaw clenches. $HeOrShe obviously doesn't like being questioned.

"It's irrelevant. They are an associate of the Kanta pirate gang and are required for questioning. The Kantas are behind countless murders and terroristic acts, as you well know."
entries.zh:
雇佣兵的眼神瞥向一边，$HeOrShe下巴紧紧咬住，显然不喜欢被质疑。

"这无关紧要。他们是 Kanta 海盗团伙的同伙，需要接受审问。Kanta 帮是无数谋杀和恐怖行动的幕后黑手，这一点你很清楚。"

o.en: So they've committed no crime. Got it.
o.zh: 所以他们没有犯罪，明白了。

entries.en:
The mercenary crosses $hisOrHer arms and you see the muscles under $hisOrHer uniform flinch unconsciously.

"By the authority invested in me by $gaVIP_theMercFaction as per the terms of the letter of marque issued to me, I am authorized to act in their interest. Why would you protect the associate of known criminals, captain?"
entries.zh:
雇佣兵交叉$HeOrShe的手臂，你注意到$HeOrShe制服下的肌肉在不自觉退缩。

"根据签发给我逮捕许可令的条款，$gaVIP_theMercFaction 赋予我权力，我被授权为他们的利益行事，你为什么要保护已知罪犯的同伙，舰长！"

o.en: So you have no warrant. Got it.
o.zh: 所以你没有授权。明白了。

entries.en:
The mercenary glares at you, face unmoving, with timeless hatred. It's like staring down the barrel of a Tachyon Lance.

"You are protecting an individual with intimate knowledge of the workings of the greatest criminal empire the Persean Sector has known, captain. I suggest you do the right thing."
entries.zh:
雇佣兵瞪着你，不动声色，似乎有着不解的仇恨。这感觉就像直视着一门速子长矛的炮口。

"你在保护一个对英仙座星域已知最大犯罪帝国有深入了解的人，舰长，我劝你最好做正确的事。"

o.zh: 就算不做也没什么后果。明白了。

o.en: Send a fake and con the merc for credits
o.zh: 给他送一个冒牌货，骗取雇佣兵的信任

entries.en:
The merc's lip curls into a sneer as you state your refusal to cooperate.

"Worthless ingrate. Amateur. Mudworm up-start trash." $HeOrShe spits invectives, enraged. "I'll watch you gas out in vacuum soon, I swear it." The comms snap off in a burst of static.

You turn to the officer at the communications console and confirm that the entire conversation has been recorded. As you well know, if the mercenary attacks, you are within the rights generally recognized across the Sector to defend yourself with deadly force.

"Captain," your tactical officer says, "They're withdrawing."
entries.zh:
当你表示将拒绝合作时，雇佣兵露出冷笑。

"去你妈逼的外行蠢货，我给你点面子就蹭鼻子上脸了？不知好歹的家伙。" $HeOrShe恼羞成怒，口吐芬芳。"我发誓，我绝逼会亲眼看着你在真空中被憋死的。" 通讯在一阵静电声后中断了。

你看向通讯控制台的通讯军官，确认整个对话已经被记录下来，你很清楚，一旦雇佣兵发动攻击，你是基于整个星域普遍承认的许可范围内，使用致命性武力保护自己。

"舰长，" 战术军官说，"他们正在撤退。"

entries.en:
As the shuttle leaves your $shipOrFleet bearing some obscure relative of the Warlord Kanta, you consider how you're going to break the news to the Galatia Academy.

You also try not to consider how Kanta is going to feel about the whole situation. Rumor has it she's rather protective of family, no matter how distant the relation.
entries.zh:
当穿梭机载着某个军阀 Kanta 的某个不知名亲属离开你的$shipOrFleet时，你考虑如何去向 Galatia 学院透露这个消息。

你也试着不去考虑 Kanta 对整个情况是如何着想，有传言说她相当护短，不论血缘远近。

entries.en:
$HisOrHer head immediately levels with the display, giving a look as though you had spit in $hisOrHer face. An eyebrow raises.

"Excuse me?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe的头立即与显示屏持平，露出一个好像你往$HeOrShe的脸上啐了一口的表情。$hisOrHer挑起一侧眉毛。

"你说什么？"

o.en: I must have misspoke. Passenger transfer incoming. (back down)
o.zh: 我一定是说错话了。乘客马上就移送。 (退步)

o.en: I require a portion of the reward for my trouble. (negotiate)
o.zh: 我需要一部分报酬来补偿我今后的麻烦。 (谈判)

o.en: I must have misspoke. Go suck vacuum. (refuse)
o.zh: 我一定是说错话了，滚去吸真空吧。 (拒绝)

entries.en: Negotiating with the mercenary captain is as enjoyable as pulling teeth; $hisOrHer arrogance is simply mind-numbing. But you manage to get the merc to agree to pay you $gaVIP_mercPayment credits upfront for your release of the VIP.
entries.zh: 与雇佣兵舰长的谈判就像拔牙一样令人畅快；$HeOrShe的傲慢简直让人头疼。但你设法让雇佣兵同意为你引渡 VIP 预先支付 $gaVIP_mercPayment 星币。

entries.en:
The pirate grins with merciless glee. "Excellent, wonderful! You couldn't have made a better decision, my good captain. I am so pleased we could come to an agreement."

As arrangements are made to surrender the VIP passenger to the pirate fleet, you consider how best to break the bad news to the Galatia Academy. The Persean Sector is a dangerous place, you reflect, so perhaps they will be understanding.
entries.zh:
海盗笑得咧开了嘴。"非常好，棒极了！你简直做了最棒的决定，我的好舰长，我很高兴我们能达成协议。"

由于已经决定向海盗交出 VIP 乘客，你不得不考虑以最合适的方式向 Galatia 告知这个坏消息。英仙座星域危机四伏，也许他们会理解的。

entries.en:
The pirate reels at this notion as if struck by a Hellbore shell.

You use the moment to calmly explain how you are transporting one of the Warlord Kanta's own precious kin-folk, and it'd really be for the best if everything possible was done to facilitate the success of your mission.
entries.zh:
海盗听到这个消息，如同一发炼狱炮弹在耳边炸响

你趁着这个机会，冷静地向他解释你是怎样运送 Kanta 军阀的一位极其在乎的亲族，若对方能尽一切可能确保你任务的成功，那将再好不过。

entries.en:
The bravado and theater evaporate like sunward frost.

"Y-yes, of course. Captain." $HeOrShe struggles to regain some of $hisOrHer previous composure, "I do apologize. Profoundly. For the delay I've caused. Please," $heOrShe sweeps $hisOrHer arm in a broad gesture, "Do be on your way, and give my closest and warmest regards to t-the Warlord."

You snap the comms link off while the pirate is still attempting an awkward half-bow.
entries.zh:
虚张声势的闹剧就像向阳的冰霜一样消散了。

"是...是的，就是这样的。舰长。" $HeOrShe强撑着恢复了先前的一些冷静，"我确实错了。对于我所造成的延误，我真诚地道歉，请见谅。" $HeOrShe摆了摆$HeOrShe的手臂，稍显卑躬地做了请的手势，"请上路吧，替我向军阀大人表达最诚挚的问候。"

当海盗还在试图笨手笨脚地向你鞠躬行礼时，你把通讯链接掐断了。

entries.en:
The pirate gives you a scandalized look, then lets out a hearty laugh.

"Captain! I had no idea," $heOrShe says, "Your heart is so black; I am smitten, truly. Of course I agree to your terms. The sheer audacity! You would truly sell out your little sop to me?"
entries.zh:
海盗看起来愣了一下，然后会心一笑。

"舰长！太让我意外了。" $HeOrShe说，"你的心太黑了，黑到我都对你佩服至极了。行，我同意你开的条件。胆子真肥啊！你真要把你的小甜心卖给我么？"

entries.en:
The pirate laughs again, shaking $hisOrHer head. $HeOrShe waves an arm at an underling, "The credits; see to it that my good friend here is paid their silver."

The credits come in, and you arrange for a very confused VIP passenger to be transferred via escape pod to the pirate fleet. As you refresh your credit account balance on your personal TriPad you consider the lie you'll have to use to cover for this little incident. The Academy won't be happy no matter what, so it's all down to damage control.
entries.zh:
海盗再次笑了起来，$HeOrShe摇了摇头。$HeOrShe向一个小弟招了招手，"星币！看看，我从来不让我的好朋友空手而归。"

星币到账，你便让人护送着那位一脸懵的 VIP 客户通过逃生舱转移到海盗舰队。当你在 TriPad 上刷新你的星币账户余额时，你还在想不得不找个谎言来掩盖这个小 "意外"。无论怎样，学院都不会高兴的，所以这已经是最好的结果了。

entries.en:
The pirate looks betrayed and inhales, presumably to say something overwrought in response to your bold-faced turnaround, but you cut the comms before they can speak.

You order tactical to high alert. From here, it's fight or flight.
entries.zh:
海盗看起来一脸不爽，吸了口气，估计是想破口大骂来回应你的闭门羹，但你在他们开口之前就切断了通讯。

你下令战备进入高度警戒。该下决定了，要么战斗，要么逃跑。

entries.en:
The pirate captain saunters into view as the comms line flickers to clarity.

"Captain! Are you in such a hurry?" $heOrShe says theatrically. "Let us talk a moment about a small matter." $HeOrShe leans in, and you can almost smell the acrid sweat and vacuum-burn. "We are here to take your very special little passenger."

$HeOrShe smiles carnivorously.

"No one will be hurt, it's a simple kidnap and ransom job. We are civilized folk, after all. It's not worth dyin' and killin' over some aristo's fancy spawn eh?"
entries.zh:
通讯线路闪烁着，只见一位海盗舰长大步走进屏幕。

"舰长！你急着赶路吗？" $HeOrShe假正经地说道，"让我们来谈一件小事。" $HeOrShe往镜头上靠过来，你仿佛可以闻到刺鼻的汗水和炮火烧焦的味道。"我们是来这接你那位非常特别的小乘客的。"

$HeOrShe笑得像一只掠食者。

"我可以保证大家的安全，这只是一次简单的绑票加勒索，毕竟我们都是文明人。为某个贵族的纨绔子弟送掉小命很不值得，是吧？"

o.en: Agree to give up the VIP passenger
o.zh: 同意放弃 VIP 客户

o.en: Only if you pay $gaVIP_piratePayment credits. Up-front.
o.zh: 你得先给我 $gaVIP_piratePayment 星币我才会放人。要现在支付。

o.en: Bluff the pirate by saying you're working for Warlord Kanta
o.zh: 恐吓海盗说你在为军阀 Kanta 效力

entries.en:
The pirate captain gives you a philosophical frown when you refuse $hisOrHer terms.

"It is to be expected," $heOrShe says, "We each have a role to play in this great drama." $HeOrShe turns away from you, "Charge the guns and set the engines to full burn!" $HeOrShe turns back to you with a wild grin on $hisOrHer face, "My good captain, I shall meet you in Ludd's blackest hell!"

The comms are cut as the pirate fleet moves to engage.
entries.zh:
在你拒绝$HeOrShe开出的条件时，海盗舰长带着些许哲学家的气质对你皱了个眉头。

"意料之中。" $HeOrShe说，"毕竟我们都人在江湖，身不由己。" $HeOrShe背过身去，"准备火炮，引擎全速！" 当$HeOrShe重新回头看向你时，脸上换上了一副狰狞的狂笑，"我会去卢德最黑暗的地狱里见你的，我善良的好人舰长！"

随着海盗舰队转入接敌姿态，通讯也被切断了。

entries.en: The mercenary captain looks even more annoyed than before, but manages to restrain $hisOrHer anger. "Captain. I say again, transfer the suspect into my custody immediately or face the consequences."
entries.zh: 雇佣兵舰长看起来更恼火了，但设法止住了$HeOrShe的怒火，"舰长，我再说一遍，立即将嫌疑人移交给我监管，否则后果自负。"

entries.en:
Finally, the dam breaks. The last you see of the merc, $heOrShe roars with anger and fist raised - then the comms link goes to static.

You turn to your officer at the communications console and confirm that the entire conversation has been recorded. As you well know, if the mercenary attacks, you are within the rights generally recognized across the Sector to defend yourself with deadly force.

The combat alert sounds. "Captain," your tactical officer says, "They're moving to attack."
entries.zh:
终于，他崩溃了。你看了雇佣兵最后一眼，$HeOrShe正举拳怒吼 —— 然后通讯链接回到了一片死寂。

你看向通讯控制台的军官，确认整个对话已经被记录下来。毫无疑问，如果雇佣兵发动攻击，你是基于整个星域普遍承认的许可范围，使用致命性武力保护自己。

战斗警报响起。"舰长，" 战术军官说，"他们正在进行战术机动。"

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName I presume," the mercenary commander says coolly. $HeOrShe knows who you are, of course.

"The Warlord Kanta sends her regards."

$HeOrShe nods an order to some underling, then moves with unhurried contempt to close the connection.
entries.zh:
"我猜你是 $playerName 舰长。" 雇佣兵指挥官冷冷地说到。$HeOrShe当然知道你是谁。

"军阀 Kanta 向你问好。"

$HeOrShe向某个下属点了点头，然后带着从容不迫的轻蔑准备关闭通讯连接。

o.en: I'll see you in hell. Save a place for me when you get there.
o.zh: 我会送你下地狱。等你下去了记得给我占个位置。

entries.en:
Thrown off-guard by your reaction, $heOrShe struggles to regain the initiative, "No, you're to be made an example- "

You interrupt and explain that you're working for Kanta- deep undercover. Who would be foolish enough to sell the Warlord's kin without her express instructions? You don't even want to speculate how they angered the Warlord, but what would the Kanta clan be without a firm hand at its head?

In fact, you're on your way to carry out the second part of this task- the less said the better. And, you glance idly at a datapad, it is $hisOrHer fleet, right on time, which is to provide resupply at this stage of the operation.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe对你的反应始料未及，还在挣扎着想要重新掌握主动，"不，是你要被杀鸡儆..."

你打断了他的话，并告诉对方你在为 Kanta 效力 —— 深度卧底。没有她的明确指示，谁会愚蠢到去出卖军阀的亲属？你想都不敢去想他们到底是做错了什么才会惹恼了军阀。但如果那位大人的手腕不够强硬，Kanta 家族会是什么样子？

事实上，你正在去执行这项任务的第二阶段的路上 —— 那些细节还是少说为妙。然后你悠闲地瞥了一眼数据平板，没错，是$HeOrShe的舰队，如约而至，会在这个行动阶段提供补给。

entries.en: $HeOrShe sputters, and finally regains composure enough to speak. "My instructions were very clear. Intercept a kin-seller at these coordinates, eliminate." You detect the merest hint of uncertainty in $hisOrHer voice.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe哑口无言了好一阵子，之后才好不容易恢复了镇定，重新开口说道："我得到的指示非常清楚，在这些坐标上拦截一个出卖 Kanta 亲属的家伙，消灭掉。" 你从$HeOrShe声音中听出了一丝的不确定。

o.en: What else would she say, given that the fact of this "betrayal" is public knowledge?
o.zh: 那她还能怎么说？毕竟这次 "背叛" 已经是众所周知的事情了。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe pauses, eyes flickering back and forth as if trying to read your face for a bluff. Thinking. "I think... I see now. If we fought, the winner would receive updated instructions. Conditional messages hidden in comm systems." It's working. "I've heard stories about the Warlord arranging these kinds of... tests."

You keep quiet, letting $himOrHer talk $himOrHerself into it.

"-And whoever prevailed would be well supplied, whether the supplies are handed over or picked from the wreckage. They would be the better captain. More aggressive; more ruthless. A stronger fleet."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe停顿了一下，眼神来回闪烁，似乎是想从你的脸上看破你是不是在撒谎。$HeOrShe边思考边说，"我想想...我现在懂了。如果我们打起来了，那么赢家才会收到下一步的指示。通讯系统里面应该藏有需要满足一定条件才会发出的讯息。" 看来这奏效了。"我听说过军阀安排这种...试炼的故事。"

你保持沉默，让$himOrHer把$himOrHerself自己脑补进去。

"—— 而且无论是哪边赢了，都会得充足的补给，不管补给是直接交到赢家手上的还是从残骸里拣出来。他们才是更优秀的舰长：更加凶悍，更加冷血，舰队也更加强大。"

entries.en:
"But that's me, isn't it?" $HeOrShe grins, and it's not a pleasant thing to see as this ruse takes an unexpected turn. "I am curious about what this mission is, but I suppose that'll have to wait until after you're dead."

You find yourself staring at static as the comm link is abruptly terminated. Your comms officer gives you a sympathetic shrug.
entries.zh:
"但那应该是我，不是吗？" $HeOrShe冷笑道，这让你的诡计出乎意料地朝着不愉快的方向转了过去，"我很好奇这个任务是什么，但我想这得等你死了之后我才能弄明白了。"

通讯链接突然终止，好一会儿之后你才发现自己正盯着静电杂讯，说不出话来。你的通讯军官耸了耸肩，对你表示同情。

entries.en:
"And between us, it's just in doubt enough that neither of us wants to chance it, eh?" $HeOrShe grins with unexpected camaraderie.

"Scum like us gotta stick together, right? I'll transfer the supplies and lay low for a while if you can keep quiet. You go on, and next time we meet you can buy me and mine a few rounds to make up for today."
entries.zh:
"但就你和我来说，恐怕我们两个都不想冒这个险，对吧？" $HeOrShe苦笑着，用出乎你意料的友善语气说道。

"我们这种人渣应该抱团起来，不是吗？如果你能保持沉默，我可以把补给转移给你，并低调一阵子。你继续干你的活，下次我们在碰到的时候你就请我和我的人喝几杯，今天的事情就算一笔勾销了。"

o.en: Kanta won't hear a word. Burn bright.
o.zh: Kanta 一个字都不会听到的。航行无阻。

entries.en:
The mercenary commander actually looks indignant, raising a hand to halt what you presume is the attack order.

"You sold out one of Kanta's kin. But"- $heOrShe grinds out, with apparent difficulty- "you forgot about it? There must be no greater fool than you in the entire Sector."

The comm link snaps closed before you have a chance to respond.
entries.zh:
雇佣兵指挥官看起来怒不可竭。$HeOrShe举起手暂时制止了攻击指令的实行。

"你出卖了 Kanta 的一个亲戚。而且..."—— $HeOrShe艰难地从恨得咬牙切齿的嘴里挤出了这段话 ——"你还把这忘了？星域里没有比你更蠢的家伙了。"

在你有机会回应之前，通讯链接就已经被关闭了。

entries.en: "The trip home was interminable. I don't understand at all why I should be confined to quarters during a hyperspace storm alert. Still, I believe I've learned something. Like, you know, about myself? Thank you, captain."
entries.zh: "回家路真的没完没了，我完全不能理解为什么在超空间风暴预警期间我要被关在宿舍里。不过，我相信我已经学到了一些东西。比如，怎么说呢，更了解自己了？谢谢你，舰长。"

entries.en: "Travelling with you was the most terrifying experience of my life and I hope to never return to space again." A loud sigh. "But I suppose I'll have to. If I do, I hope you're the captain on my next trip."
entries.zh: "搭你的船旅行绝对是我这一生中最可怕的经历，我真希望永远不要再回到太空了。" 对方发出一声重重的叹息，"但估计这不太可能。如果真有下次太空旅行，到时候我希望舰长还是你。"

entries.en: "That was amazing! Wow, I mean, that was really living, you know? I'm going to drop out of the Academy and become the captain of my own fleet..." their eyes fill with an alarming gleam of admiration, "Just like you."
entries.zh: "这趟旅途真是太爽了！哇哦，要我说，在茫茫星海中自由翱翔，那才叫真正的生活！你懂我的意思吧？我恨不得现在就从学院退学，做一名舰长，统领属于我自己的舰队..." 这位 Galatia 学生的眼神里闪烁着无比的钦佩。"像你一样潇洒。"

entries.en: "Space is awful, how can you stand it? And the crew," they glance at some off-boarding spacers with disgust. "It's a good thing that lot has you to lead them and set a good example. Imagine if they were in charge! Ha- haha."
entries.zh: "太空太可怕了，你是怎么坚持下来的？还有那些船员。" 对方厌恶地瞥了一眼那些出舱的太空船员。"幸好有你这样的能人来领导那帮乌合之众。想象下如果没有你舰队会怎样！哈-哈哈。"

o.en: Inform the pirate that you are working for the Warlord Kanta
o.zh: 告知海盗你正在为军阀 Kanta 效力

entries.en:
You hold up your hand, interrupting the pirate captain mid-threat. This seems to catch $himOrHer off guard.

You use the moment to calmly explain that you are transporting one of the Warlord Kanta's own kin-folk, the $gaVIP_subjectRelation of $gaVIP_kantaRelationFirstName, and it'd really be for the best if they did everything possible to facilitate the success of your mission.
entries.zh:
你举起手，打断了狠话才说到一半的海盗舰长。这似乎让$himOrHer有些措手不及。

你利用这个时机冷静地解释说，你正载着军阀 Kanta 的一个亲戚，$gaVIP_kantaRelationFirstName 的 $gaVIP_subjectRelation。因此对方最好能尽其所能，确保你的任务能顺利达成。

entries.en:
The pirate looks as though $heOrShe has been struck by a Hellbore shell.

"Y-yes, of course. Captain." $HeOrShe struggles to regain $hisOrHer composure, "I... apologize, profoundly, for the delay I've caused. Please be on your way and g-give my best regards to the Warlord."

You snap the comms link off while the pirate is still attempting an awkward half-bow.
entries.zh:
那海盗看起来像是刚被炼狱炮来了一发一样。

"是...是的，当然。舰长。" $HeOrShe正努力恢复镇定，"我...我为我造成的延误抱歉...深表歉意。请您继续上路，请代我向军阀大人问...问个好。"

当海盗还在试图笨手笨脚地向你鞠躬行礼时，你把通讯链接掐断了。

entries.en:
After a short wait, your connection request is accepted. $personName looks at you for a while before speaking.

"And why would someone on the wrong side of $marketName's authorities want to get in touch with me?"

You consider that perhaps coming back with your transponder off and without attracting any undue attention might be a better approach.
entries.zh:
短暂的等待过后，你的连接请求被接受了。$personName 看了你好一会儿才开口说话。

"为什么会有个和 $marketName 当局作对的人想要和我联系？"

你考虑到，也许{关闭应答器}，在避免受到任何不必要的注意的情况下回来可能是一个更好的方法。

o.en: Take a look around the bar

entries.en: After a short wait, your connection request is accepted.
entries.zh: 短暂地等待之后，你的连接请求被接受了。

entries.en:
After a short wait, your connection request is accepted.

"You'll need to sort out your issues with the port authority and get docking clearance before we can do any sort of business."
entries.zh:
短暂的等待过后，你的连接请求被接受了。

"在我们开展任何业务之前，你得提前和港务局打个招呼，取得停靠许可。"

entries.en:
After a short wait, your connection request is accepted. The $manOrWoman starts to speak, then glances off-screen and closes the connection, leaving you looking at static.

You realize that you'll need to come back without attracting the attention of patrols before you're able to do business with this person.
entries.zh:
短暂的等待过后，你的连接请求被接受了。一个$manOrWoman接通了通讯，瞄了一眼屏幕后就切断了连接，丢下你在屏幕前盯着满屏杂讯。

你意识到，要想和这人交易，就得避免引起巡逻队的注意。

entries.en:
After a short wait, your connection request is accepted. The $manOrWoman starts to speak, then glances off-screen and closes the connection, leaving you looking at static.

You realize that you'll need to come back without attracting the attention of patrols before you're able to do business with this person.
entries.zh:
短暂的等待过后，你的连接请求被接受了。一个$manOrWoman接通了通讯，瞄了一眼屏幕后就切断了连接，丢下你在屏幕前盯着满屏杂讯。

你意识到，要想和这人交易，就得避免引起巡逻队的注意。

entries.en:
After a short wait, your connection request is accepted. The $manOrWoman starts to speak, then glances off-screen and closes the connection, leaving you looking at static.

You realize that you'll need to come back with your transponder turned off before you're able to do business with this person.
entries.zh:
短暂的等待过后，你的连接请求被接受了。一个$manOrWoman接通了通讯，瞄了一眼屏幕后就切断了连接，丢下你在屏幕前盯着满屏杂讯。

你意识到，要想和这人交易，就得{关闭应答器}再来找$HeOrShe。

entries.en:
The connection flashes valid, and the merc captain appears before you, hands steepled.

"$playerName." $HeOrShe has an open, neutral expression. "When you become a client of the gens, you make an agreement.  If you fail to uphold your end of that agreement, I am paid to make you into an example of what happens to people who do not respect Gens Hannan."

$HeOrShe waits a moment, then adds apologetically, "The terms of my contract require that I tell you this. I will be attacking you now, I suggest you order combat stations." $HeOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
通讯连接建立，佣兵舰长出现在你面前，双手交叠成尖塔状。

"$playerName。" $HeOrShe的表情坦率而中立。"当你成为氏族的客户时，你就会签订一份协议。如果你未能履行那份协议中的义务，那么我的职责就是将你塑造成一个范例 —— 用以警示那些不尊重 Hannan 氏族的人。"

$HeOrShe稍等了片刻，然后抱歉地补充道："我的合同条款要求我必须告诉你这些。我现在将对你发起攻击，我建议你下令进入战斗阵型。" $HeOrShe伸手准备切断通讯。

entries.en:
Your chief engineer starts nodding and tapping at their TriPad, mumbling over technical figures.

An interactive display appears in your executive interface, and with a few manipulations, the chief has a materials schedule prepared for your review.
entries.zh:
总工程师点了下头，手里开始敲打 TriPad，嘴里还嘟哝着技术相关的数字。

你的专用界面上弹出一个交互窗口，稍稍点了几下，你就看到了总工程师的待审阅材料统计表。

entries.en:
"The Gate Haulers were built for reliability," your chief engineer explains. "Every fail state reverts to a lower-energy safe mode; the backups of backups have backups. Even intentionally sabotaging a Hauler would involve extreme effort."

Your tech officer taps at a datapad with a vexed look, but raises no objection.

A silence descends. There is no need to put it into words: the arrival of a Gate Hauler in the Persean Sector would be momentous.
entries.zh:
"星门运输舰很看重可靠性。" 总工程师解释道，"一旦出现失败状态就会自动返回低能耗安全模式，就连后备手段的后备手段都要再加上个后备手段。哪怕有意破坏运输舰都相当费力。"

你的技术军官听着，手指敲打着数据平板，满脸困扰，却也没多反驳什么。

接下来是一片寂静，一切都不言自明：一座星门运输舰抵达英仙座星域，无疑是件意义重大的事。

entries.en:
Your operations chief oversees the transfer of transplutonics. Streams of cargo drones feed the unimaginably huge bulk of the Hauler; it seems strange that so little can move so much so far.

With only a little coaxing, the Gate Hauler's automation churns into something like machine-awareness; sensors report power surges throughout the hull as ancient conduits and machines self-test - some failing. Long-dormant self-repair drones begin to seethe like vermin.

And, slowly, your $shipOrFleet's various sensors feel the growing power of the machine. Magnetic fields shudder, neutrinos begin to spill forth in earnest from reactions deep in the mass of the beast; gravitic fluctuations from the warp-pylons flutter, and your own drive bubble compensates.

It will take about a day, engineering reports, and then the Gate Hauler will be ready to receive navigational input.
entries.zh:
行动长官监督着稀有元素的传送工作。一波又一波的货运无人机补给着星门运输舰那庞大的船体；如此小的东西，却可以运载那么多，那么远，让人难以置信。

只需你轻轻推上一把，星门运输舰的自动化系统便开始启动某种智能化运转；传感器上可以看到能量流传遍了船体，古老的导管和机械随之开始自我调试 —— 而有些显示出了故障。休眠了许久的维修无人机开始如蝇群般游走于船体之中。

然后，你$shipOrFleet的各类传感器开始感受到面前机械缓缓增长的能量。重力场震动，面前巨兽深处反应炉中激发出的中子喷涌而出；折跃标塔开始散播浮动的引力波，而你这边的驱动泡则中和着这一效应。

工程师报告星门运输舰大概还需要一天就能够开始接收导航信息。

entries.en:
You give the command.

The Leviathan awakens from its slumber one last time to perform the purpose for which it was built an aeon ago. Astride history, you feel its flow shift inexorably beneath you.
entries.zh:
你下达了指令。

巨兽从它的沉眠中最后一次苏醒，以履行那在万古之前为其设定的使命。你身处历史的脊背之上，感受着它的洪流在你脚下不可阻挡地转向。

entries.en:
The Gate Hauler rests in space, a potent mass jealously cradling its legendary cargo. It awaits final confirmation to deploy the Gate.

As it happens, the go-code requests telemetry from the Gate Hauler's launch as a pass-key. After several tense seconds, the re-launch telemetry appears to be accepted as valid input, and executive access is granted to your command console.

Functionality is limited: Gate deployment can only be targeted broadly at a star system or roughly equivalent celestial structure. The Hauler's programming allows for no fine control and will select its own stable location. The process is irreversible and the order can not be countermanded once given. After deployment, the Gate Hauler will automatically dismantle itself, presumably to become feedstock for the next glorious expansion of the Domain's frontier.

A single word blinks on your command interface. DEPLOY?
entries.zh:
星门运输舰停驻于深空之中，其庞大的身躯充满妒意地环绕着其传说中的货物。它等待着部署 星门 的最终指示。

在部署过程中，启动程序会需要星门运输舰发射时的遥测数据作为密码。在紧张的几秒过去之后，重新发射时的遥测数据作为可用数据被接收，全权控制权转移到了你的控制台上。

可供你操控的功能有限：星门部署只能大概选定一个星系或类似的天体结构。运输舰的程序不接受微操，会自行选择一个稳定点。这个流程不可逆，指示给出便不能再撤回。部署之后，星门运输舰会自行拆解，大概是为了 人之领 伟大边境的新一波扩张提供原材料。

你的控制台上闪烁着一个词语。部署？

entries.en:
It is no simple task to appraise a Gate Hauler, for the ship is truly massive.

Your officers, however, have the tools, ancient datafiles, and a trained and ready crew. Known variants of Gate Hauler design are pulled up on a shared display to match to the example which looms over your $shipOrFleet. Your operations chief oversees the deployment of salvors to key points in coordination with targeted sensor sweeps.

Meanwhile, your tech officer and chief engineer review the deep archive containing flight statistics on thousands of recorded Gate Hauler deployments in order to anticipate the results of in-transit damage and subsequent self-repair protocols.
entries.zh:
评估一座星门运输舰并非易事，因为这艘舰船实在庞大非常。

不过，你的军官们拥有合适的工具，古代数据文件以及一组训练有素的船员。星门运输设计的已知变体都被传输到公屏上，以便与横亘在你$shipOrFleet面前的这一座相匹配。你的行动长官配合目标传感器扫描结果，监督着打捞员们向关键点进行部署。

与此同时，你的技术军官和总工程师正在审查一个深度档案库，其中包含了数千次有记录的星门运输舰部署的航行数据，以预估运输途中产生的损坏以及后续的自我修复方案。

entries.en:
Ops orders the salvors to prioritize a data connection, and it's soon online via ancient protocols. Walls of amber error codes glow in your tech officer's interface.

You have part of an answer soon enough: The functioning of the Gate Hauler's enormous but primitive Alcubierre drive system was massively disrupted mid-transit. The ship's automation could not ascertain the cause of the discontinuity and so, to protect the literally astronomical value of its cargo, forced the ship into an automatic failsafe mode.

Most of the remaining fuel was dumped and the rest used to slow into an orbit of the most accessible nearby mass concentration: this lonely ice giant. The maneuver took the better part of a century.

Standard procedure would have the Domain send a well-supplied expedition of Gate engineers to reset the primary systems and send the Hauler back on its journey, albeit many hundreds of cycles behind schedule.
entries.zh:
行动长官命令打捞员们优先建立数据连接，他们通过古老的协议很快连接上了网络。技术军官的显示屏上闪烁着大量琥珀色的错误代码。

很快，你就找到了部分答案：星门运输舰庞大而原始的阿库别瑞引擎系统在运输途中严重失灵。因为舰船的自动化系统无法确定故障原因，为了保护其价值连城的货物，舰船因此被迫进入自动故障保护模式。

大部分多余燃料被抛弃，仅剩的则用来减速以进入附近最容易到达的质量集中区域：这个孤独冰巨星的轨道。这一操作花费了将近一个世纪的时间。

按照标准程序，人之领 会派遣一支装备精良的星门工程师探险队，重新设置主系统，让星门运输舰重新启航，尽管这会比原计划晚了数百个星历年。

entries.en:
The ancient records note that Gate Haulers would carry a standard complement of automated survey, extraction, and refining drones in the case of lost-contact. The documents seem to imply the ability to procure new sources of fuel and materials effectively at vast distances from the fail-safe point, though at the scale implied, this process would be inefficient at superluminal speeds even via hyperspace - assuming use of baseline Domain frontier technology.

Your officers conclude that, typical to the Domain, the publically available descriptions seem to elide certain key technologies and capabilities.

In any event, your survey turned up none of this - aside from the undeployed Gate itself, of course, held tight by the many-limbed face of the great starship.
entries.zh:
古老的记录显示，为了应对失联的情况，星门运输舰 会携带一套能够自动勘测，采集和提炼的标准无人机附件。这些文件似乎暗示了其在远离故障保护位置的地方获取新的燃料和材料来源的能力。但按照其显示的规模，在假设使用 人之领 标准开拓技术的情况下，即使用上超光速，甚至超空间，这一过程也是十分低效的。

你的军官们得出结论，这是典型的 人之领 风格，公开可知的描述似乎省略了某些关键技术和能力。

无论如何，你的调查基本上是一无所获 —— 当然，除了那个未部署的星门本身，它现在被雄伟星舰所伸出的许多触手牢牢抓住。

entries.en:
The ancient records note that Gate Haulers would carry a standard complement of automated survey, extraction, and refining drones in the case of lost-contact. The documents seem to imply the ability to procure new sources of fuel and materials effectively at vast distances from the fail-safe point, though at the scale implied, this process would be inefficient at superluminal speeds even via hyperspace - assuming use of baseline Domain frontier technology.

You can only conclude that this particular self-recovery effort ended with the drone expedition sent to the Limbo system, and it was to use obscure Explorarium wormhole technology to resupply the Gate Hauler so that it could continue its mission.

In any event, your search has turned up no additional technological treasures - aside from the undeployed Gate itself, of course, held tight in the many-limbed face of the great starship.
entries.zh:
古老的记录显示，为了应对失联的情况，星门运输舰 会携带一套能够自动勘测，采集和提炼的标准无人机附件。这些文件似乎暗示了其在远离故障保护位置的地方获取新的燃料和材料来源的能力。但按照其显示的规模，在假设使用 人之领 标准开拓技术的情况下，即使用上超光速，甚至超空间，这一过程也是十分低效的。

你得出这样的结论：这次特定的自我修复行动，以向 Limbo 星系派遣无人探测器而告终，目的是利用鲜为人知的开拓者虫洞技术为那座星门运输舰进行再补给，使其能够继续执行任务。

无论如何，你的调查基本上是一无所获 —— 当然，除了那个未部署的星门本身，它现在被雄伟星舰所伸出的许多触手牢牢抓住。

entries.en:
The details accumulate, each senior officer manipulating the shared display as reports are given. Finally, your chief engineer clears the holo back to a slowly rotating false-lit overview of the entire vast starship. They suppress a brief smile as they clear their throat.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." A pause for anticipation, a rare indulgence by your habitually practical chief engineer. "I have the pleasure to report that it is possible to re-activate the Gate Hauler. It could be targeted to a known system within the Persean Sector at your command."

It just needs transplutonics. A lot of transplutonics. Unlike familiar starship engines, the Gate Hauler doesn't use the standard Domain AM fuel package. Once a critical mass of transplutonics is achieved, the Gate Hauler will be able to operate for at least a thousand cycles with functionally unlimited range within the bounds of the Persean Sector.
entries.zh:
细节数据不断汇集到舰桥，每接到一条报告，你的上级军官们就要对着公屏敲敲打打。终于，总工程师清空全息投影，只留下人造光照下慢慢旋转的巨舰影像。工程师清了清嗓子，难掩笑意，说道：

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 虽然总工程师生性务实，此刻也突然停顿，想要吊起你的胃口。"很荣幸宣布我们能够重启星门运输舰。只要你一声令下，我们就能让它飞向英仙座内任何一个已知星系。"

重启只需要稀有元素 —— 但需要很多稀有元素。星门运输舰不同于常规星舰，并不使用 人之领 标准反物质燃料。只要为星门运输舰提供临界质量的稀有元素，它就能至少运行一千个星历年，在英仙座星域内，它的航程可以算作无限。

o.en: Tell me how to turn this thing back on. I want numbers, chief.
o.zh: 总工程师，告诉我怎样才能把它重新启动，尤其是具体开销。

o.en: What are the risks of reactivation?

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.

The ice giant spins below your $shipOrFleet, lit only by the barest light of the galaxy, warmed only by the internal pressure of gravity and the barest flicker of atomic decay. Unlikely to form naturally in interstellar space, this planet must have been thrown from its home system by some cataclysmic interaction in aeons past. Adrift, it is doomed to shrink and cool toward the interstellar medium over billions of cycles.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet接近了 $entityName。

冰巨星在你的$shipOrFleet下转动着，其表面被银河中微弱的星光所照耀，唯一的温度来自于其内核的重力压以及最为薄弱的放射性衰变。这个星球不大可能是在星际空间自行形成的，而更有可能是数亿万年前因某种巨大灾变而被从其母星系中抛出。现在它被迫承受在数亿年的星际游荡中缓缓冷缩的命运。

entries.en:
As you approach, he looks over and says "Captain $playerName! Don't look so surprised, you've got a fascinating reputation to, shall we say, movers and shakers the Sector over."

He dismisses the other officers with a promise to join them in a moment, then catches your eye, "Dilettantes. Compared to yourself, I mean. I trust you've heard of the academy's new provost?"
entries.zh:
当你走近时，$heOrShe回头看了看并说道："$playerName 舰长！不用那么惊讶，你的名声非常富有吸引力，可以说，你是整个星域的风云人物。"

$HeOrShe打发了其他军官，并承诺稍后加入他们，然后朝你示意，"真是外行。我的意思，和你相比起来。我相信你听说过学院的新院长？"

o.en: Oh, the Galatia Academy has a new chief executive?
o.zh: 哦，Galatia 学院有新领导了？

entries.en:
"My apologies," he grins apologetically, "We ivory-tower academics get so lost in our own world. Everything revolves around the next paper, the next conference."

The senior academician waves an arm to dismiss all of that.

"The new provost. After that embarrassing incident with Provost Kallichore, the Academy has come under new leadership - bold leadership. To the new provost, Anahita Baird!" He raises his glass in a toast.

You discover that you're holding a glass of something as well.
entries.zh:
"我很抱歉。" $heOrShe带着歉意尴尬地笑着说，"我们这些象牙塔中的学者在自己的世界里迷失了方向。一切都围绕着下一篇论文，下一次会议。"

这位资深院士挥了挥手，仿佛要驱散这些琐事。

"新院长。在 Kallichore 院长的那次尴尬事件之后，学院迎来了新的领导 —— 一位大胆的领导。致新院长，Anahita Baird！" $HeOrShe举杯致意。

这时你才意识到自己和他们一样，手里也拿着一杯什么东西。

o.en: Set it down on the bar

entries.en:
"Ah, I knew you were as intelligent as you look." He winks.

"Yes, the academy is renewing itself! After that embarrassing incident with Provost Kallichore, the Academy has come under new leadership- bold leadership. To the new provost, Anahita Baird!" He raises his glass in a toast. You discover that you're holding a glass of something as well.
entries.zh:
"啊，我就知道你和看起来一样聪明。" $heOrShe朝你眨了眨眼

"是的，学院正在经历变革！在 Kallichore 院长的那次尴尬事件之后，学院迎来了新的领导 —— 一位大胆的领导。致新院长，Anahita Baird！" $HeOrShe举杯致意。这时你才意识到自己和他们一样，手里也拿着一杯什么东西。

o.en: Set it down on the bar

entries.en: You raise your glass, and the senior academician enthusiastically hits it with their own, then downs the drink.
entries.zh: 你举起酒杯，这位资深院士热情地与你碰杯，然后一饮而尽。

entries.en: You set the glass down, giving the academician a skeptical look. He shrugs, and downs his own drink without your accompaniment.
entries.zh: 你放下酒杯，向院士投以怀疑的目光。$HeOrShe耸了耸肩，不等你举杯便将自己那份一饮而尽。

entries.en:
"To fresh blood, my enemies slaughtered and their lands conquered. Isn't that right? I mean this in purely metaphorical terms, of course, but I daresay the Hegemony purge has cleared out the old guard and opened up some opportunities. Which brings me to you."

A hand lands on your shoulder, somewhat intrusively.

"The new provost asked me to find someone like you, and now I've found you. Come to the Galatia Academy- in the Galatia system of course, but you don't need me to tell you that, ha-ha. Meet with Provost Baird."
entries.zh:
"敬新血液，敌人们被屠杀，土地被征服，你说是不是？当然完全是比喻性的，不过要我说 霸主 的清洗清除了守旧派并创造了一些机会，这就要说到你了。"

一只手有点无礼地搭在了你的肩膀上。

"新上任的院长委托过我寻找像你一样的人，而现在我找到了。来 Galatia 星系的 Galatia 学院，但你明显不需要我告诉你，哈哈，来和 Baird 院长见一面。"

entries.en:
His face turns serious for a moment, "She has a vision for the future, captain. And in times as extraordinary as these, she might just realize it. Hear what she has to say. Keep an open mind."

His tone lightens again, and $heOrShe glances at the officers he was previously carousing with. "Now if you would pardon me, I do believe that I owe a round for my new friends. I shall see you around the Galatia Academy soon, I'm sure."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe的表情严肃了一刻，"她有一个对未来的愿景，舰长。在现在这样的特殊时刻，她可能真的能实现这个愿景。听听她有什么说的。别抱有成见。

$HisOrHer的语气轻松了些，一边瞥了眼刚刚之前一起狂欢的舰船军官们，"现在请容我先行告退，我相信我还欠我的新朋友们一轮酒。我会很快在 Galatia 学院见到你的，不是么？"

entries.en:
As you enter, an impeccably dressed young-appearing man lounging at the bar stands and approaches with an easy, open expression. His eyes literally twinkle - subtle cybernetics - as he greets you.

"Captain $playerName, I cannot express how happy I am to connect." His handshake lingers a moment too long.
entries.zh:
当你进入时，一位衣着考究、容貌年轻的男子从吧台起身，带着随和坦率的神情走近。他在问候时双眼闪烁着微光 —— 那是精密的赛博改造体。

"$playerName 舰长，能与您会面我实在欣喜难言。" 他的握手的时间似乎更长了一些。

o.en: Always pleased to meet a fan. Did you want a holo with me?
o.zh: 见到粉丝总是令人愉快，想和我合张全息照吗？

o.en: Excuse me, I have important business to attend to.
Excuse me, I have important drinking to attend to.
o.zh: 失陪了，我有重要的酒局要赴。

entries.en:
The subtle, off-white material has a luxurious heft. An embossed Tri-Tachyon crest is just visible through the barely translucent polyply stock.

This is an affectation of the business class dating all the way back to Terran prehistory called a 'business-card', a sort of analog commlink ID data-packet. It reads:
entries.zh:
这张淡米色的精致材质带着奢华的分量。在微微透光的复合纸材上，隐约可见 速子科技 徽标的浮雕。

这是可追溯至地球史前时代的商业阶层习俗，称作 '名片'，一种模拟通讯链接的身份数据包。上面印着：

o.en: I take it you're not Director Glamor-Rotanev?
o.zh: 我猜你不是 Glamor-Rotanev 总监？

entries.en:
He laughs beautifully.

"Most welcome. You're holding the opportunity of a lifetime," he says with a wink. "I recommend you have a chat with Director Glamor-Rotanev. At your earliest convenience, of course."
entries.zh:
他优雅地笑了笑。

"荣幸之至。您手中握着千载难逢的机遇，" 他眨眼示意道，"我建议您与 Glamor-Rotanev 总监面谈。当然，在您最方便的时候。"

entries.en:
He laughs beautifully, again.

"Most welcome. You're holding the opportunity of a lifetime," he says with a wink. "I recommend you have a chat with Director Glamor-Rotanev. At your earliest convenience, of course."
entries.zh:
他又一次优雅地笑了笑。

"荣幸之至。您手中握着千载难逢的机遇，" 他眨眼示意道，"我建议您与 Glamor-Rotanev 总监面谈。当然，在您最方便的时候。"

entries.en:
He laughs beautifully.

"Oh, oh no," he says, almost bashful. "You're holding the opportunity of a lifetime. I recommend you have a chat with Director Glamor-Rotanev. At your earliest convenience, of course."
entries.zh:
他优雅地笑了笑。

"哦，不，" 他近乎腼腆地说道，"您手中握着千载难逢的机遇，我建议您与 Glamor-Rotanev 总监面谈。当然，在您最方便的时候。"
