他又一次优雅地笑了笑。

"您手中握着千载难逢的机遇，" 他眨眼示意道，"我建议您与 Glamor-Rotanev 总监面谈。当然，在您最方便的时候。"

entries.en:
He puts his hands together with a soft clap, and does something not quite like a bow.

"My task here is concluded. Enjoy yourself. Tonight's tab shall be on Mz. Glamor-Rotanev."

He turns, and exits the bar, leaving you with the 'business-card'.
entries.zh:
他双手合十轻轻一拍，做了个近似鞠躬的动作。

"我的任务至此完成。请尽情享受吧，今晚的消费将由 Glamor-Rotanev 女士买单。"

他转身离开酒吧，将那张 '名片' 留给了你。

o.en: Pocket the card and look back to the bar
o.zh: 将名片收进口袋，目光转回吧台

entries.en: It takes a moment for you to realize that you are holding a card. Placed through some sleight-of-hand, no doubt.
entries.zh: 你花了片刻才意识到自己正握着一张卡片，这无疑是通过某种手法悄然放进你手里的。

entries.en: His perfect eyebrows lift. "Just this," he says.
entries.zh: 他精致的眉毛微微扬起。"就这些了，" 他说道。

entries.en: He laughs beautifully, perfect teeth flashing.
entries.zh: 他优雅地笑了笑，精致的牙齿闪闪发光。

entries.en: "Naturally," he says, perfect teeth flashing. "I won't delay you a millisec- here."
entries.zh: "当然，" 他说道，那精致的牙齿闪烁着，"我不会耽误您哪怕毫秒 —— 给您。"

entries.en: "Naturally," he says, perfect teeth flashing. "I won't delay you a millisec- here."
entries.zh: "当然，" 他说道，那精致的牙齿闪烁着，"我不会耽误您哪怕毫秒 —— 给您。"

entries.en: "Acknowledging receipt of AIS code. Good to see you, $playerName."
entries.zh: "确认收到 AIS 代码。很高兴见到你，$playerName。"

entries.en: It appears the enemy $personRank doesn't seem to feel the need to talk to you, as your comm requests go unanswered.
entries.zh: 可能是敌方的 $personRank 觉得没有与你通话的必要，你的通讯请求没被应答。

entries.en: "Hostile $shipOrFleet, be advised: we've already dispatched a distress call to a nearby patrol, and it should arrive shortly."
entries.zh: "警告敌方$shipOrFleet：我已向附近巡逻队发出求救呼号，它们很快就到。"

entries.en:
The enemy $personRank looks grim but defiant. "We will fight you to the last," $heOrShe says.
OR
"Damn, we're in a tight spot." $PersonRank $personName suddenly notices the line is open and shuts it off.
entries.zh:
敌方的 $personRank 神情严峻，但面无惧色。"我们将死战到底。" $heOrShe说道。
OR
"该死，我们的情况不妙。" $PersonRank $personName 突然发现自己还在和你通话，于是迅速切断了通信。

entries.en:
"You have been scanned and," $heOrShe blinks at $hisOrHer screen, then says almost - but not quite - under $hisOrHer breath, "$playerName. The butcher."

$HeOrShe straightens $hisOrHer back, "It'd be best if you kept your distance. We, we are armed."
OR
As the comms resolve, $rank $personLastName looks at you with recognition and alarm.

"It's... you. The things you've done, I can't believe-" $heOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat uncomfortably, "What is it you want?"
entries.zh:
"你们已经被扫描并..." $heOrShe突然对着$hisOrHer的屏幕眨了好几次眼，然后用你几乎听不到的音量喃喃自语道，"$playerName。那个屠夫。"

$HeOrShe挺直了背，说道："你们最好保持距离。我...我们是有武装的！"
OR
当通信建立之后，$rank $personLastName 用显然认识你的表情警惕地盯着你。

"是...是你。你竟然做出过那种事情，我不敢相信 —— " $heOrShe不舒服地清了清嗓子，"你到底想要做什么？"

entries.en: "Ah, Captain $playerName." $HeOrShe looks uncomfortable. "Your reputation... precedes you. Let us conclude our business quickly then go our own ways."
entries.zh: "啊，$playerName 舰长。" $HeOrShe看起来有些不自在，"你的名声...久有耳闻。让我们快点把事情谈妥，然后就各行其道吧。"

entries.en: "You have been scanned and identified. It's probably best for both our peace of mind if you keep your distance."
entries.zh: "你们已经被扫描并确认了身份。为了我们双方都能安心，你们最好保持距离。"

entries.en: $PersonRank $personName looks aggravated. "If you want to talk, identify yourself first."
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personName 看起来有些不悦："如果有话要说，就先表明自己的身份！"

entries.en: $PersonRank $personName looks concerned. "If you want to talk, identify yourself first."
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personName 看起来有些紧张："如果有话要说，请先表明自己的身份！"

entries.en: You issue an order to activate the transponder and re-open the comm link.
entries.zh: 你下令启动了应答器，并重新打开通讯链接。

entries.en: "Domain MINEX clearance accepted, anti-tampering systems have been set to stand-by and will accept target approach for servicing."
entries.zh: "人之领 MINEX 许可已接受，防篡改系统已被设为待命状态，将允许目标接近进行检修。"

entries.en: "WARNING: This vessel is property of the Domain Explorarium and is responding with deadly force to tampering by any means and/or damaging or intrusive signals. Vandalism or destruction of Domain Explorarium property is punishable under the MINEX Establishment Act in addition to colonial polity charters applicable within this volume of Domain territory. This infraction is being recorded."
entries.zh: "警告：这艘船是 人之领开拓者 的财产，任何方式的篡改和/或破坏或侵入信号传送，都将回以致命武力。根据 [MINEX 创立法案] 及适用于 人之领 当地的殖民政体宪章，任何破坏或损毁 人之领开拓者 的财产的行为都将受到相应的惩处。本次违规行为已记录在案。"

entries.en: "Citizen of the Domain, this automated drone ship has identified and logged your vessel or habitat in the course of executing its mission parameters. Autonomous vessels of the Domain Explorarium are programmed to respond with deadly force to tampering by any means including damaging or intrusive signals. Vandalism or destruction of Domain Explorarium property is punishable under the MINEX Establishment Act in addition to colonial polity charters applicable within this volume of Domain territory."
entries.zh: "人之领 的公民，依照任务参数设定，这艘自动无人舰在航行中已经识别并记录了你的船只或居住地。同时，依照程序设定，人之领开拓者自主舰船会以致命武力回应任何方式的篡改企图，包括破坏或侵入信号传送。破坏或损毁人之领开拓者的财产，除了应接受人之领当地的殖民政体宪章裁决外，还将根据 [MINEX 创立法案] 受到相应的惩处。"

entries.en:
"Greetings friend, all is well? Good to hear it. Glory to the Lion of Sindria!"
OR
"Comms open, friendly. Course acknowledged; safe jumps. Victory to the Diktat!"
OR
"Line established, ID-confirmed. Hail and hoy, doing Saturn-Delta standard. If you run into any extremists out here, just send us their position and the Diktat will take care of it."
entries.zh:
"朋友，你好，一切顺利？很高兴听到这个消息，愿荣光照耀辛达瑞亚之狮！"
OR
"通信建立，友方单位。航线确认，跳跃安全。胜利属于强权！"
OR
"连线建立，身份无误。放声问好，通信标准转 Saturn-Delta。如遇任何顽敌，请告知其方位，把他们交由强权处理。"

entries.en:
"By authority of the Sindrian Diktat, you are ordered to take drives offline, disable weapons, and surrender. Failure to execute will be considered an act of aggression. Out."

The Diktat $personRank's gloating face is replaced by a Diktat crest before the image fades.
OR
"There is no place for degenerate scum in our glorious future." $PersonRank $personName turns aside and says "Lieutenant, do try to avoid taking prisoners this time."

The comm-line goes black.
OR
The comms flicker into being.

"We'll cleanse the Persean Sector of your kind," the $post sneers. "You will be lost to history."
OR
The Diktat $personRank sneers, "So are you a terrorist, a pirate, or a degenerate? No matter. If you're lucky, you'll die choking vacuum. If not, there's Cruor."
entries.zh:
"以 辛达强权 当局之名，你已被勒令熄灭引擎，关闭武器，束手就擒。如有违背，则视为挑衅侵略。以上。"

说完这些之后，屏幕上辛达强权 $personRank 那张幸灾乐祸的脸很快被辛达的徽标所取代，随后图像就消失了。
OR
"我们的光辉未来里没有废物人渣的容身之地。" $PersonRank $personName 转过头说道，"上尉，这一次务必要格杀勿论。"

通讯线路随即被切断了。
OR
"我们会把你们这种败类从星域中彻底根除，甚至从历史上完全抹掉。"
OR
这位辛达强权 $personRank 冷笑着说道："你是恐怖分子，或是海盗，还是堕落者？无所谓，运气好的话，你会窒息在真空中。要是运气不好，还有 Cruor 在等着你。"

entries.en:
"We've linecast to system patrol craft and they've already been dispatched; reinforcements are en route. You are advised to disengage, hostile."
OR
"You won't get away with this. You'll rot on Cruor with the rest of the degenerates."
OR
The Diktat $personRank stares toward some unfocused point. "Duty is sacrifice. I give my life for the Lion of Sindria."
entries.zh:
"我们已连线星系卫队，而它们也已经出击。援军正在途中，奉劝你们这帮敌人立刻撤离。"
OR
"你们无处可逃。你将同 Cruor 上的堕落之辈一同腐朽殆尽。"
OR
这位辛达强权 $personRank 凝视着虚空。"牺牲成就使命，我将为辛达瑞亚之狮献上生命。"

entries.en:
The Diktat $personRank looks grim but defiant. "We will fight you to the last," $heOrShe says, and cuts the transmission.
OR
"The great work will go on, with or without me." $HisOrHer expression hardens. "For the Lion!"

The comm blinks off.
entries.zh:
敌方的 $personRank 神情严峻，但面无惧色。"我们会战斗到底。" $heOrShe说道，并切断了通讯。
OR
"伟业势不可挡，无论我存亡与否。" $hisOrHer的神情坚毅，"为了伟大雄狮！"

通讯链接突然断开了。

entries.en:
The Reformer $personRank looks grim but defiant. "We will fight you to the last," $heOrShe says, and cuts the transmission.
OR
"The true heir will go on to victory, with or without me." $HisOrHer expression hardens. "For Achilles!"

The comm blinks off.
entries.zh:
改革者 $personRank 神情严峻，却毫不退让。"我们会和你打到最后一兵一卒，"$heOrShe说完，切断了通讯。
OR
"真正的继承者终将走向胜利，有没有我都一样。"$HisOrHer神情一凛。"为了 Achilles！"

通讯闪了一下，灭了。

entries.en:
"You've been scanned, maintain distance. Interference in military affairs will be considered an act of insurrection."

The Diktat $personRank gives a perfunctory salute. "Victory to the Diktat!" $heOrShe says before motioning to cut the transmission.
OR
The Diktat $personRank looks impatient. "Is there a problem? No? Then move along, citizen."
OR
"Comms on protocol Saturn-Delta established. If you have information leading to ARCists or ANTIs, submit to your local information officer for possible reward."
entries.zh:
"身份确认，保持距离。干扰军务将被视为叛乱行为。"

这位辛达强权 $personRank 按惯例敬了个礼，来了一句 "胜利属于强权！" 之后便关闭了通讯。
OR
这位辛达强权 $personRank 很不耐烦，"有问题吗？没有？那就继续上路，公民。"
OR
"通讯已按 Saturn-Delta 协议建立。如果你有关于 Askonia 革命者委员会的情报，将其提交给当地情报官员便有机会获得报酬。"

entries.en:
"Greetings friend, all is well? Good to hear it. Glory to the Reformer!"
OR
"Comms open, friendly. Course acknowledged; safe jumps. Victory to Achilles!"
OR
"Line established, ID-confirmed. Hail and hoy, doing Saturn-Delta standard."

"If you run into any of Hector's traitors out here, just send us their position and we'll take care of it."
entries.zh:
"你好，朋友，一切安好？那就好。荣耀归于改革者！"
OR
"通讯开启，友方。航向已确认；跳跃平安。胜利属于 Achilles！"
OR
"线路已建立，身份已确认。向你致意，按 Saturn-Delta 标准程序执行。"

"要是在外面碰上 Hector 那边的叛徒，把位置发给我们，我们来处理。"

entries.en:
"You've been scanned, maintain distance. Interference in military affairs will be considered an act of insurrection."

The Reformer $personRank gives a perfunctory salute. "Victory to Achilles, the true heir of Sindria!"

$HeOrShe motions to cut the transmission.
OR
The Reformer $personRank looks impatient. "Is there a problem? No? Then move along, citizen. I have a civil war to win."
OR
"Comms on protocol Saturn-Delta established. If you have information leading to Hectorites or ANTIs, submit a report to your local information officer for possible reward."
entries.zh:
"你已被扫描，保持距离。干预军事事务将被视为叛乱行为。"

改革者 $personRank 敷衍地敬了个礼。"胜利属于 Achilles，Sindria 的真正继承者！"

$HeOrShe做了个手势，要切断通讯。
OR
改革者 $personRank 显得不耐烦。"有问题吗？没有？那就走吧，公民。我还有一场内战要打赢。"
OR
"通讯已按 Saturn-Delta 标准程序建立。如果你掌握有关 Hector 党羽或 ANTI 的线索，请向当地情报官提交报告，或可得赏。"

entries.en:
"By authority of the Reformed Sindrian Diktat, you are ordered to take drives offline, disable weapons, and surrender. Failure to execute will be considered an act of aggression. Out."

The Reformer $personRank's gloating face is replaced by the new crest before the image fades.
OR
"Achilles is going to clear Askonia of traitors and criminals like you!"
OR
The Reformer $personRank sneers, "So are you a traitor, a terrorist, or a pirate? No matter, you all die the same."
entries.zh:
"奉改革后的辛达强权之命，命令你关闭驱动、解除武装并投降。拒不执行将被视为侵略行为。完毕。"

影像淡出之前，改革者 $personRank 那副得意的脸被新的徽记取代。
OR
"Achilles 会把 Askonia 上你这种叛徒和罪犯清理干净！"
OR
改革者 $personRank 嗤笑道："那么，你是叛徒、恐怖分子，还是海盗？无所谓，反正都是一个死法。"

entries.en:
"We've linecast to system patrol craft and they've already been dispatched; reinforcements are en route. You are advised to disengage, hostile."
OR
"You won't get away with this! Achilles will see to you."
OR
The Reformer $personRank stares toward some unfocused point. "I fight for Achilles. Freedom and order!"
entries.zh:
"我们已向星系巡逻艇发出通报，他们已经在路上了；增援正在赶来。建议你脱离接触，敌对目标。"
OR
"你逃不掉的！Achilles 会收拾你。"
OR
改革者 $personRank 茫然地望向某处。"我为 Achilles 而战。自由与秩序！"

entries.en: You try to establish a comm link, but get only static.
entries.zh: 你试图建立通讯链接，却只收到一片杂讯。

entries.en:
"Acknowledging receipt of your codes, moving to a secure channel." A flicker of a phoenix icon and static, then: "Yes? All is well I trust? Glad to hear it, citizen. Over and out."
OR
"Your $shipOrFleet has been scanned and identified, everything is in order. Burn bright, citizen."
OR
"Scanned and identified. You're flying pretty, citizen. Clean jumps and high burn." $PersonRank $personName signs off with a flash of the gold phoenix.
entries.zh:
"确认收到你们的身份代码，将转移至安全通讯频道。" 在出现一闪而过的不死鸟徽记和短暂的信号杂讯之后，对方继续说到，"怎样？近来一切安好？很高兴听到这个消息，公民。通话完毕。"
OR
"你们的$shipOrFleet已经被扫描识别，一切正常。祝航行无阻，公民。"
OR
"扫描识别已完成，你们飞得没问题，公民。祝跳跃平稳，航行顺畅。" $PersonRank $personName 随着一闪而过的金色不死鸟徽标而下线了。

entries.en:
"By authority of the High Hegemon Administrator, you are ordered to take hyperspace drives offline, disable weapons and surrender. Over."
OR
"Resistance to Hegemony authority is an act of insurrection and shall be punished accordingly. Surrender now or be met with force."
entries.zh:
"以 霸主 高级统帅部的名义，命令你们立即关闭超空间驱动器与武器系统，束手就擒，通话完毕。"
OR
"违背 霸主 当局的命令将被视为叛乱行为，必须受到相应惩罚。现在立即投降，否则我们就会动用武力。"

entries.en:
"Hostile vessel, be advised, linecast to system patrol craft has already been dispatched, reinforcements are en route. You are advised to power down weapon systems and disengage. Over."
OR
"Belligerent contact! Be advised that firing upon a Hegemony vessel is considered an act of insurrection and you'll be hunted down!" The Hegemony $personRank is sweating. "When they're done with you, you'll be sold in black markets on worlds across the Sector, I swear it."
OR
"We give our lives for the restoration of the Domain and all humanity." $HeOrShe pauses for a moment as if to say something more, then cuts the comm.
entries.zh:
"警告敌舰，我们已经联系了星系巡逻舰船，增援很快就到。建议你们关闭武器系统，放弃抵抗。完毕。"
OR
"敌对信号！警告你们，向 霸主 舰船开火将被视为现行暴乱！你们将被立即追捕！" 霸主 $personRank 看起来冷汗直冒，"等你们被解决掉之后，你们会被卖到星域各地的黑市里去！我发誓！"
OR
"我们将为 人之领 和全人类的复兴而献身。" $HeOrShe停顿了一下，似乎欲言又止，最后切断了通讯。

entries.en:
The Hegemony $personRank looks grim but defiant. "We will fight you to the last," $heOrShe says.
OR
"We fight and we die for the Domain; for humanity." The comm-line cuts out.
entries.zh:
霸主的 $personRank 神情严峻，但面无惧色。"我们会跟你们血战到底。" $heOrShe说道。
OR
"我们会奋战至死！为了人之领！为了全人类！" 通讯链接就这样被切断了。

entries.en:
"You have been scanned and identified, citizen. If nothing is amiss, we shall be on our way."
OR
The Hegemony $personRank looks impatient. "Is there an emergency to report? No? Then carry on, citizen."
entries.zh:
"公民们，你们的身份已被扫描识别。没有疑问的话，我们恕不奉陪。"
OR
这位霸主 $personRank 看起来有些不耐烦。"有什么紧急情况需要汇报的吗？没有？那就继续上路吧。通话完毕。"

entries.en:
"The blessing of Ludd be upon you."
OR
"Blessings of the stars and pneuma, friend."
OR
"Safe travels, friend, and blessing of Ludd be upon you."
entries.zh:
"愿卢德的祝福与你常在。"
OR
"这是来自繁星和圣灵的祝福，我的朋友。"
OR
"旅途平安，朋友。愿卢德的祝福与你常在。"

entries.en:
"Submit, repent, and your sinful technologies will be smashed; Resist, and only God's holy vacuum will show you mercy."
OR
"Servant of the machine! Submit now, repent, and perhaps even you will find redemption. Otherwise the only mercy you shall find will be in God's holy vacuum."
entries.zh:
"服从并忏悔，才能摆脱你们的罪恶科技。倘若负隅顽抗，那只有造物主神圣的虚空能给你们带来解脱。"
OR
"机械的奴仆！立即臣服并忏悔，或许还有机会获得救赎。否则，你唯一能获得的解脱将是造物主神圣的虚空。"

entries.en:
"We follow the way of Ludd. Though the righteous suffer the lash, our reward will be everlasting grace."
OR
"Do your unholy work then, servant of Mammon. When it is our time, Ludd will guide our souls to peace."
entries.zh:
"我们遵循卢德之教义。圣人虽需历经磨难，但永恒的恩惠终将降临吾身。"
OR
"那就继续作恶吧，贪婪者玛门的仆从。我们大限将至时，卢德将引领我们的灵魂迈向安息。"

entries.en:
"We follow the path of Ludd amidst persecution. Yea, the righteous will suffer the lash and our reward will be everlasting grace." The Luddic $personRank seems to be talking not to you anymore, but perhaps to $hisOrHer god.
OR
"Are you so corrupted by the false machine gods? Choose wisely your course; there is still time for redemption."
entries.zh:
"我们遵循着卢德的教义，饱经迫害。是的，圣人必须历经磨难，才能争得永恒的恩惠降临吾身。" 这位卢德 $personRank 看起来并非在与你，而是在与$hisOrHer的造物主交谈。
OR
"你被机械伪神腐蚀得如此之深？明智地选择你的道途吧，救赎仍为时不晚。"

entries.en:
"Contact; Do not interfere in our righteous mission."
OR
"Contact - please maintain distance. Blessing of Ludd, traveler."
entries.zh:
"通告，请勿干涉我们的神圣使命。"
OR
"通告，请保持距离。愿卢德保佑你，旅人。"

entries.en: "Greetings fellow walker. Blessings of Ludd be upon you."
entries.zh: "循道同袍，别来无恙。愿卢德的祝福与你常在。"

entries.en: "Submit, repent, and your sinful technologies will be smashed; Resist, and only God's holy vacuum will show you mercy."
entries.zh: "服从并忏悔，才能摆脱你们的罪恶科技。倘若负隅顽抗，那只有造物主神圣的虚空能给你们带来解脱。"

entries.en: "We follow the way of Ludd amidst persecution. Yea, the righteous will suffer the lash and our reward will be everlasting grace."
entries.zh: "我们遵循卢德之道，饱经迫害。是的，圣人必须历经磨难，才能争得永恒的恩惠降临吾身。"

entries.en:
"We follow the Path of Ludd amidst persecution. Yea, the righteous will suffer the lash and our reward will be everlasting grace."
OR
"Slave of Mammon! You cannot stand in the Path of Ludd; we follow unwavering toward redemption in fated death."
entries.zh:
"我们遵循卢德之道，饱经迫害。是的，圣人必须历经磨难，才能争得永恒的恩惠降临吾身。"
OR
"贪婪者玛门的奴隶！你们无法和卢德之道抗衡！命中注定我们终将离世，但我们迈向救赎的脚步毫不动摇。"

entries.en: "Do not interfere in our righteous mission, for we walk the Path of Ludd."
entries.zh: "不要干涉我们的神圣使命，我们正在修行卢德之道。"

entries.en: You try to establish a comm link, but get only static.
entries.zh: 你试图建立通讯链接，却只收到一片杂讯。

entries.en:
"Don't be a fool, casting at every blip you find out here. You want to get picked up by half the listening stations this side of the Sector?"
OR
"Keep it jolly, hunter. We'll be on our way."
OR
"Good hunting out here 'eh? Yeah, well I wouldn't tell if it was either. Burn bright."
entries.zh:
"别像个傻瓜一样见到个信号就追！你是打算把自己亮相给这半边星域的所有监听站看吗？"
OR
"杀得愉快，猎手们！我们也准备上路了。"
OR
"这儿活好整不？哈，也对，我是你的话也不会把好猎场随便说给别人听。祝航行无阻！"

entries.en:
"Attention, prey. You, and all your possessions are now my personal property. Any resisting ship will be disabled, boarded, and your officers massacred!"
OR
"Surrender yourself and your goods or you'll be taking a very long walk out the airlock once I've claimed your ship."
OR
The pirate $personRank makes a rude gesture and laughs before cutting the transmission.
OR
"When you get to the next life, tell 'em it was $personName that sent you."
OR
The open comms-line crackles; after a moment $personName speaks.

"Wait, someone actually answered this thing? Um. I'm not really sure what to say. Usually they just fight or run. So which is it?"
OR
"Just die already, you're boring me."
entries.zh:
"通告，猎物们。你们和你们所有的财产从现在起都归我个人所有。任何抵抗的舰船都将被瘫痪并登船，船上的军官将被处刑！"
OR
"交出你和你的货物。否则我一旦上了你的船，你就得到气闸外出趟远门了。"
OR
这位海盗 $personRank 笑着对你比了个粗鲁的手势，然后切断了通讯。
OR
"下辈子记得告诉别人是 $personName 弄死你的。"
OR
接通的通讯频道一开始只传来了什么东西咔哒作响的声音，过了一会儿之后 $personName 才开口说话。

"欸等等，居然有人接了这玩意儿？呃，我其实没想好要说些什么。别人不都是直接开打或立马逃跑的吗？你打算怎么选？"
OR
"烦人的家伙，你直接去死得了！"

entries.en:
"Greetings, honorable commander! We are a humble League merchant trading fleet headed for resupply. We would be honored to assist you in any way."
OR
"I must have left my transponder off; silly me. Here, I'll just be on my way..."
entries.zh:
"尊敬的指挥官，您好！我们只是一支不起眼的 联盟 商队，正在返航补给。如有需要，我们将荣幸地尽一切努力协助您。"
OR
"我一定是不小心把自己的应答器给关掉了，我的错。不介意的话，我马上就走..."

entries.en:
The pirate $personRank glares at you briefly before shutting down the comm link.
OR
$personName glares defiantly. "You'll never take me alive!"
OR
"You fight like an algae-farmer! Less talk, more shoot."
entries.zh:
那海盗 $personRank 在关闭通讯链接之前瞪了你一眼。
OR
$personName 挑衅地瞪着你说，"你别想活捉我！"
OR
"你打得像个藻农一样菜！少废话，多开炮！"

entries.en:
"Unless I am reading my scopes wrong, you have no reason to be talkin' right now. Get it?"
OR
"Go away, I'm trying to be inconspicuous."
OR
"What, you scrubbing cryotanks? Get lost."
entries.zh:
"如果我没看错扫描结果的话，我现在没事情找你。懂？"
OR
"滚！老子在避风头！"
OR
"啥？你个冷冻舱里出来的废物，滚一边去！"

entries.en:
"CID-IFF received [TARGET FRIENDLY] respond true // "

INTERRUPT

are you the maker? scanning. you are not. where is the omega?

INTERRUPT

"... Tachyon-licensed service technician]. Weapon systems have been powered down for Your Safety. Unit is prepared for approach of [valued customer/licensed service technician]."
OR
"CID-IFF received [TARGET FRIENDLY] respond true // ''Greetings [valued Tri-Tachyon Integrated Space Defense System Contract Holder/TriTachyon-licensed "

INTERRUPT

waiting. omega signal query? scanning. no. waiting.

INTERRUPT

" customer/licensed service technician]."
entries.zh:
"判断敌我识别代码回应是 [友方]...判定通过 //

/ 进程中断 /

你是造物主？扫描中... 你不是。欧米伽在哪？

/ 进程中断 /

"[...速子授权的维修技术员]。为了确保您的安全，武器系统已经关闭。本机已为 [尊敬的客户 / 特许维修技术人员] 的接近做好准备。"
OR
"判断敌我识别代码回应是 [友方]...判定通过 // "您好 [尊敬的速子科技综合空间防御系统合约持有者 / 速子科技特许...]"

/ 进程中断 /

等待。检索欧米伽？扫描中... 否。等待。

/ 进程中断 /

"[...顾客 / 特许维修技术人员]。"

entries.en:
"CID-IFF not received [TARGET HOSTILE] respond null // 'Greetings from Tri-Tachyon Integrated Space Defense System unit [MY_SERIAL]. This unit has not cleared- "

INTERRUPT

query. you are not the maker. scanning. you are not. where is omega? entity hostile.

The comm-link dies. Your comms officer panics for a moment before the console reboots itself. You exchange a look, then proceed.
OR
The comms crackle and whine as a frantic pattern of interweaving lines takes shape.

query. query. query target. is omega? omega? no. revert function.

INTERRUPT

" -SERIAL]. This unit has not cleared your vessel for approach and will employ the latest Tri-Tachyon Defense Products to ensure its integrity. Tri-Tachyon Corporation is pleased to wish you a 'Very Safe Day.'"
entries.zh:
"判断敌我识别代码回应非 [敌方]...判定失败 // 速子科技综合空间防御系统机体 [本机序列号] 向您问好。本机并未准许 ——"

/ 进程中断 /

检索。你不是造物主。扫描... 你不是。欧米伽在哪？实例敌对。

通讯链接突然死机了。你的通讯军官在控制台自行重启之前慌张了一小会儿。你跟通讯军官交换了一下眼神，示意对方继续手上的工作。
OR
通讯器发出刺耳的异响和啸叫，视讯上的线条以狂乱的样式交织出了某种形状。

检索。检索。检索目标。是欧米伽？欧米伽？否。恢复运作。

/ 进程中断 /

"[...序列号]。本机并未准许您的船只接近，将在必要时动用 速子科技 最新的防御产品以确保本机的完好。三一速子科技公司由衷地祝您能度过 '非常安全的一天'。"

entries.en:
"CID-IFF not received [TARGET UNKNOWN] respond null // 'Greetings valued customer of Tri-Tachyon Corporation products. Your vessel is not logged as a valid contract holder with the Tri-Tachyon Integrated Space Defense line of- "
INTERRUPT
scanning. omega? no, you are not. do not interfere.

The comm-link is cut.
OR
The comms crackle, and a mesmerizing pattern of interweaving lines takes shape.

waiting. query omega. scanning. false. return to

INTERRUPT

" -contract holder with the Tri-Tachyon Integrated Space Defense line of products and services. Have you considered a Tri-Tachyon Orbital Defense Plan? Please contact a customer service representative for more information.'"
entries.zh:
"判断敌我识别代码回应非 [未知]...判定失败 // 尊敬的三一速子科技公司产品的客户，您好。您的船只尚未签署合约以享受速子综合空间防御系列的..."
/ 进程中断 /
扫描... 欧米伽？不，你不是。请勿干涉。

通讯链接被切断了。
OR
通讯器响起了杂音，视讯上的线条以类似催眠图案的样式交织出了某种形状。

等待。检索欧米伽。扫描... 否。返回。

/ 进程中断 /

"...签署合约以享受速子综合空间防御系列的产品与服务。您是否考虑过采用速子科技轨道防御计划？详情请咨询客户服务代表。"

entries.en:
"Ah, a fellow spacer! You're a sight for a poor spacer down on their luck, let me tell you - first the Hegemony declares us outlaws, and that's just the start of it."

$personName proceeds to tell you about a handful of awful things, each more unlikely than the last, that have happened to $himOrHer over the last cycle before you manage to disconnect the comm-link.
OR
"Just us down-on-our luck miners out here. Seen any prime derelicts around? Or is it just the one you're flying in? Ha-ha."
entries.zh:
"哈，居然是个太空佬同行！你眼前的我也是个太空佬同胞，但倒霉透顶。我和你说，霸主 首先是宣布我们不再受法律保护，而那还只是那些倒霉事的开头而已。"

$personName 随后滔滔不绝地和你讲起了近年来发生在$himOrHer身上的一连串糟糕事，一个比一个离谱。直到你有机会关掉了通讯链接。
OR
"这里只有我们这些不走运的矿工。有在附近见到什么有价值的残骸吗？还是只有你正开着的那破烂玩意儿？哈哈。"

entries.en:
"Did the Hegemony send you to do this errand for 'em? Come to collect a bill?"
OR
"They should have sent the real navy, not some grounder leakin' in their vac-suit."
OR
"Don't you get any of your dirt on me when I blast your ship up."
entries.zh:
"霸主派你来给他们办这个差事吗？来收账？"
OR
"他们该派些真正的海军来，而不是一群在真空服里就吓尿了的混球。"
OR
"等我把你船轰成渣，可别把你的脏东西弄我身上。"

entries.en:
"You just a bruiser come to do the Hegemony's dirty work? Get it over with."
OR
"If a spacer steals food to feed $hisOrHer family, $hisOrHer comrades, they call it piracy. If that makes me a pirate, then I'd rather be a pirate than some poor tool salutin' the phoenix."
entries.zh:
"你就是那个来帮霸主干脏活的打手？赶紧了结吧。"
OR
"如果一个宇宙民要靠偷吃的来养活$hisOrHer的家人，$hisOrHer的同伴，他们就管这叫海盗行径。如果这就算海盗，那我宁愿当海盗，也不愿当个只会对着不死鸟徽标在那敬礼的可悲走狗。"

entries.en:
The rogue miner $personRank makes a rude gesture over the vid-screen before killing the comm link.
OR
$personName glares defiantly and spits. "Just another fool come to kill for your masters in their fancy uniforms."
entries.zh:
闹事矿工$personRank隔着视频画面对你比了个粗鲁的手势，然后切断了通讯链接。
OR
$personName 挑衅地瞪着眼，然后唾骂道。"不过是又来了个蠢货，来为他衣冠楚楚的主子杀人罢了。"

entries.en:
"Go away, I'm counting rocks."
OR
"Did the Hegemony send you? I don't know anything about anything."
OR
"Burn along, cap. This is my claim."
entries.zh:
"滚开，我在数石头。"
OR
"是 霸主 派你来的吗？我什么鬼东西都不知道。"
OR
"别来打扰我，舰长，这是我唯一的请求。"

entries.en: "Contact. Comms open," says $Rank $name. "We are ever-watchful in defense of holy Gilead."
entries.zh: "链接。通讯接通。" $Rank $name 说道，"我们为了保护神圣的 Gilead 而时刻警惕着。"

o.zh: 是什么让 Gilead 如此神圣？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe blinks. "Why, the Prophet Ludd was called to Gilead, in the Persean Sector, in a divine vision. Ludd came and touched the earth of Gilead and declared it a gift of providence, and thereupon called all the faithful to turn it into a garden world, a living example of the sacred balance of life, a place of pilgrimage."

"Believer or no," $heOrShe says earnestly, "you would be welcomed to visit the shrine on Gilead and see for yourself."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe眨了眨眼。"为什么？先知卢德是被神谕呼唤到了英仙座星域的 Gilead 星球。Ludd 降临并触摸了 Gilead 的大地，宣布其乃神之馈赠，并号召信徒将其变成一个花园世界。作为生命中神圣平衡的鲜活典范，一个朝圣之地。"

"不论是否为信徒。" $heOrShe真诚地说道，"我们都欢迎你去 Gilead 的圣地亲自看一看。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks at you for a long moment, a touch of amusement hiding sadness.

"I suppose if you're not from around here, you'd have to have it told."

"Used to be, Mairaath was a wonder of the Persean Sector. Three great cities in orbit, the Astropoli, and below a wonder of terraforming biotechnology." Bitterness enters $hisOrHer voice now, "Some Pathers took offense to people living long and well and without fear of the dark, so... "
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe看了你很久，目光中的惊奇掩盖了悲伤。

"我想，如果你不是这里的人，得有人给你讲讲这些事。"

"当年，Mairaath 是英仙座星域的奇迹。轨道上有三座宏伟的城市，又叫星际城，地面上则是地貌改造生物科技的奇迹。" $hisOrHer的语气现在带上了苦涩，"有些左径分子看不得别人能够不畏黑暗地好好生活，所以... "

entries.en:
"They blew it up," $heOrShe says, stone-faced. "The mad fanatics, they blew it up. Most terrible act of terrorism the Sector has ever had inflicted, if you ask me. Tens of millions dead, all the dreams and world turned to ash. The real miracle is anyone survived." $HeOrShe indicates $himOrHerself, "My ancestors did, somehow."

"Mayasuran until the end. And beyond the end, because not even the end of our world could kill us all off. Might be living off the scraps, but we're still living."

$HeOrShe is proud, still, despite Mairaath's lost glory.
entries.zh:
"他们把它炸了。" $heOrShe说道，面色僵硬，"那些狂信徒把它给炸了。如果你要问问我的看法，我只能说这是这片星域所经历过的最为可怖的恐怖袭击。千万人身亡，整个星球与其梦想一同化为灰烬。真正的奇迹是居然有人幸存。" $HeOrShe指向自己，"我的祖先活了下来，不知是如何做到的。"

"我们生来就是 Mayasura 人。哪怕死亡也无法改变这一点，只因我们世界的灭亡也没能把我们杀尽。就算我们只能靠拾荒过活，我们也还活着。"

$HeOrShe的自豪依旧，纵使 Mairaath 已经荣光不再。

entries.en:
The comms connection crackles into focus.

"Attention prey! Our weapons are- oh. Captain $PlayerName isn't it."

The pirate sighs and gives a stand-down motion to someone you can't see.
OR
The comms snap into focus, fuzz out, then resolve into near-focus.

"Surrender now or-" The pirate squints. "Is that $PlayerName? Oh, rads."
entries.zh:
通讯线路噼啪作响，画面渐渐清晰。

"注意了，猎物！我们的武器已经—— 哦。是$PlayerName舰长，对吧。"

海盗叹了口气，朝画面外你看不见的什么人做了个收手的手势。
OR
通讯画面猛地清晰，又糊成一团，最后勉强稳住。

"立刻投降，不然——\" 海盗眯起眼睛，\"那是$PlayerName？噢，见鬼。"

entries.en:
"We're not supposed to attack you. ARC business, right?"

$HeOrShe doesn't bother to hide $hisOrHer disappointment.

"Go on then. We'll just have to find another target."
OR
$HeOrShe turns and shouts over one shoulder. "Stand down! ARC has this one tagged as a 'comrade' so we're not supposed to loot 'em."

"Sorry about that, cappy," the pirate says. "We'll be on gettin' gone."
entries.zh:
"上头交代过别动你。是 ARC 的买卖，对吧？"

$HeOrShe毫不掩饰$hisOrHer的失望。

"那走吧。我们只好另找目标了。"
OR
$HeOrShe转过身，回头喊了一嗓子："都收手！ARC 把这家伙标成了'同志'，不许抢。"

"对不住了，船长，\" 海盗说道，\"我们这就走人。"

entries.en: "Reading you clear, super-green all 'round," says $Post $name. "Don't worry, we're just doing honest business. Not touching a thing on Gilead, no $playerSirOrMadam!"
entries.zh: "清晰收到，周围一切正常。" $Post $name 说道，"别担心，$playerSirOrMadam，我们只是来做正经生意的，不会碰 Gilead 上的任何东西！"

o.en: Wait, why can't you touch Gilead?
o.zh: 等下，为什么不能碰 Gilead？

entries.en:
"Oh now, you don't start too," $heOrShe says. "I didn't mean anything by it."

A long pause, then $heOrShe says, "Ah, you were asking for real. Well, it's the Luddic holy world, isn't it? They're very strict about who goes there and what they get up to. You don't want to mess around with the Knights of Ludd, they couldn't tell a joke from a declaration of war."

"Keep your nose clean around them and their world, that's all I'm saying." $HeOrShe nods, "Free bit of advice."
entries.zh:
"哦，你别也给我来这一套了。" $heOrShe说道，"我没啥特别的意思。"

经过漫长的沉默后，$heOrShe说道，"啊，你是真的要问啊。嗯，那不是个卢德圣地嘛？教会对谁能去那里，去了能做些什么都管得可严了。你可不会想招惹到卢德骑士团的，他们可是连玩笑和宣战布告都分不清的。"

"我意思就是在他们和他们的世界上，手脚干净些。" $HeOrShe点了点头，"就当是免费给你的建议。"

entries.en:
"Comms open and receiving," says $Post $name. "We're just out here looking for a lost bit o' Mairaath's glory days."
OR
"Scanned and identified. Maintaining distance and heading."

The $post looks you over, and decides to make smalltalk. "It gets me down, seeing Mairaath like this."
entries.zh:
"通讯接通，收到。" $Post $name 说道，"我们就是来这见识下当年 Mairaath 的风光样子的缩影。"
OR
"扫描完毕，身份确认。保持距离和航向。"

$post 望向你，打算聊聊天。"看到 Mairaath 这个样子，我心里挺不是滋味。"

entries.en:
The comms take some time to connect, and the transmission is patchy, as if sent through damaged or overloaded relays.

Nonetheless, Curate Sacraria Standfast appears.

"Look who's washed up on troubled shores," she says. "How may a servant of Providence help you this day?"
entries.zh:
通讯花了点时间才连上，而且传输有些不稳定，就好像是通过了什么受损或者过载的中继设备一样。不论如何，神龛祭司 Standfast 出现了。

"看看风把谁给吹来了。" 她说道，"今日一位上天之仆从能帮你些什么？"

entries.en:
The comms take some time to connect, and the transmission is patchy, as if sent through damaged or overloaded relays.

Nonetheless, Curate Sacraria Standfast appears.

"The true believer returns," she says coolly. "Come to explain a new compromise?"
entries.zh:
通讯费了些工夫才接通，信号断断续续，像是经由受损或过载的中继站转过来的。

即便如此，神龛祭司 Sacraria Standfast 还是出现在了画面里。

"真信徒回来了，\" 她语气冷淡。\"又来替哪一桩新的妥协说项？"

entries.en:
"Comms open and receiving," says $Post $name. "We're running trade here, the Mairaath route. And yes, there's still something worth buying and selling."
OR
"Hail received," says the $post. "Maintaining course. It's still worth running the Mairaath route, and I'd do it even if it weren't."
entries.zh:
"通讯接通，收到。" $Post $name 说道，"我们是跑商的，Mairaath 商路。是的，那里还有值得买卖的东西。"
OR
"呼叫已接收。" $post 说道，"维持航线，Mairaath 商路还值得一跑的，就算不值得，我还是会跑。"

o.en: Why wouldn't it be worth doing the Mairaath route?
o.zh: Mairaath 的商路为什么变成这样了？

entries.en:
"Identity confirmed. Please accept my greetings on behalf of the Company."
OR
"Sorry friend, this Tri-Tachyon vessel is on a classified mission. Burn bright."
OR
"Greetings on behalf of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation! Please state your business so that we may assist in meeting your needs -- for a reasonable fee, of course."
OR
"Comm open. Oh, do you have the latest Tri-Tachyon catalogue of executive spaceflight accessories? I'll have a customer service representative upload a copy immediately."

Your comms officer's console pings.
OR
"Hi, I'd like to add you to my professional network on TriLink."
entries.zh:
"您的身份已经确认。请接受我代表公司的问候。"
OR
"抱歉朋友，这艘 速子科技 舰船正在执行机密任务。祝您航行无阻。"
OR
"我代表 三一速子科技公司 向您致意。请说明您的业务需求，以便我们能够协助满足您的所需 —— 当然是在合理收费下。"
OR
"通讯建立。哦，你们要 速子科技 最新的宇航员用品目录吗？我会马上让客服代表上传一份给你们。"

通讯军官的控制台响起了提示音。
OR
"嗨，您好！我想在 TriLink 上邀请您加入我的业务群。"

entries.en:
"Attention. Your vessel has been scanned and identified as hostile to the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. Prepare for annihilation."
OR
"On behalf of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation I would like to thank you for providing this opportunity to prove the superiority of our branded line of space defense products."
OR
"On behalf of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation it is my duty to inform you that this engagement will be recorded. As a presumed belligerent engaged in destruction of wholly owned Company property, you automatically refuse all rights to distribution and profit-sharing." The Tri-Tachyon $personRank grins and cuts the comm-link.
entries.zh:
"请注意。您的船只已被扫描并且被确认与 速子科技 存在敌对关系。请做好被歼灭的准备。"
OR
"我谨代表 三一速子科技公司 感谢您，让我们有机会向您证明公司旗下的太空防御产品系列的卓越性能。"
OR
"我有责任代表 三一速子科技公司 通知您，这次的交战将被记录在案。作为破坏公司全额所有财产的交战方，您将自动放弃所有股权分配和利润分红的权利。" $personRank 咧嘴笑了笑并切断了通讯链接。

entries.en:
"Attention. Your vessel has been scanned and identified as hostile to the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. Further attempts at aggression will be recorded."
OR
"Any attempt to hinder or damage this Tri-Tachyon owned and operated vessel will result in legal consequences." The Tri-Tachyon $personRank looks nervous. "Trust me, these people don't mess around, you really ought to leave me alone."
entries.zh:
"请注意。您的船只已被扫描并且被确认与 三一速子科技公司 存在敌对关系。后续的利益侵害行为都将被记录在案。"
OR
"做出任何试图阻碍或破坏这艘 速子科技 公司所有并运营的船只的行为都将承担法律后果。" 这位 速子科技 的 $personRank 看起来很紧张，"相信我，这些法务部的家伙都不是吃素的。您真不该来招惹我的。"

entries.en: The Tri-Tachyon $personRank looks grim but defiant. "Corporate regulation 313.33, section A, states that combat-capable vessels must defend themselves in a vigorous manner at all times," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh: 速子科技 $personRank 神情严峻，但面无惧色。"公司条例 313.33 A 节规定，具有战斗能力的舰船必须在一切情况下积极地保护自己。" $heOrShe说道。

entries.en:
"On behalf of the Tri-Tachyon corporation, it is my pleasure to inform you that your $shipOrFleet has been scanned and its tactical loadout evaluated."

The $post drones in a pleasant corporate monotone. "Have you considered purchasing a Tri-Tachyon upgrade package? Visit the nearest Tri-Tachyon shipyard to find out more."

"Please maintain your distance... and have a nice day."
OR
"Greetings on behalf of the Tri-Tachyon corporation!" The $post produces a cheerful, if hollow, smile.

"Feel free to admire our ships which are equipped with the latest in Tri-Tachyon space defense products and software, but please maintain a safe distance. The Company takes property damage very seriously."
entries.zh:
"我很高兴代表速子科技公司通知您，我们已经扫描了您的$shipOrFleet，并对你们的战术装备进行了评估。"

$post 用令人愉悦的公司式单调语气陈述道。"您是否考虑过购买 速子科技 升级套餐？请前往最近的 速子科技 船厂了解更多信息。

"请保持安全距离...并祝您有愉快的一天。"
OR
"代表 速子科技 公司向您致以问候！" $post 露出了一个欢快却空洞的笑容。

"欢迎随意欣赏我们配备了 速子科技 旗下最新的太空防御产品的公司改装舰船。但请保持安全距离，本公司非常重视避免财产损失。"

entries.en: After a short wait, your connection request is denied.
entries.zh: 短暂的等待过后，你的连接请求被拒绝了。

entries.en:
This hull is damaged, but through the scars of impacts and stripped armor your sensors officer recognizes the crest of the Galatia Academy. This expedition was lightly and inconspicuously armed, enough to discourage casual piracy while not offending the official neutrality of the Academy.

Perhaps this was not enough.

Salvage repeaters - a common feature of high-risk Academy probes and expeditions which promise a reward for return of data - are all dead. Manually disabled, overloaded and fused or even smashed with hand-tools, from the looks of it. Clearly someone did not want them transmitting their message, or any message, in this place.
entries.zh:
这艘舰船已经受损，但从撞击的伤痕与剥落的装甲间，你的传感器技官辨认出了 Galatia 学院的徽标。此次科考队只配备了轻量且不起眼的武装，能在足以威慑普通海盗的同时不触犯学院的官方中立原则。

但或许这些武装还是有所不足。

所有打捞信号中继器 —— 高风险学院探测任务与科考队的常见配置，学院承诺对归还此物的数据者提供报酬 —— 均已失效。从痕迹判断，它们是被人为破坏的：手动关闭、过载熔毁，甚至被手用工具砸碎。显然有人不愿让它们在此地发送信息 —— 哪怕任何信息。

entries.en:
The expedition's equipment is not the best money can buy, but the sensor suites and detector arrays were obviously lovingly modified and maintained - what's left of them, anyway. They're torn apart, twisted and burnt into jagged black filaments.

Shielded datacores are recovered by salvor teams and returned for analysis in a signal-quarantined vault kept for this purpose. It does not take long for your tech officer to report results.
entries.zh:
科考队的设备虽然并非是顶级配置，但传感器组与探测阵列显然经过精心改装与维护 —— 至少残存部分如此。它们被撕扯得支离破碎，扭曲烧熔成参差的黑色线体。

打捞小组回收了屏蔽型数据核心，送入专为此类任务设置的信号隔离库进行分析。你的技术军官很快回报了结果。

entries.en:
"Judging from logs and fabrication tags, the expedition dates to circa cycle 176," your tech officer says. "This was the flagship of a small flotilla. The rest were... lost."

"Someone... tried to erase all records. Forge-reset."
entries.zh:
"根据日志与制造标签判断，此次科考队活动时间约为星历 176 年，" 你的技术军官汇报道，"这是小型编队的旗舰。其余舰船均已... 失踪。"

"有人...试图抹除所有记录，用锻炉级的重置。"

entries.en:
"Not quite," your tech officer suppresses a sly grin.

There's simple deletion and there's systemic erasure done to ensure that data recovery is effectively impossible. Whoever did this was not proficient enough to do the latter.
entries.zh:
"不尽然，" 你的技术军官克制住一丝狡黠的笑意。

简单的删除与系统性的擦除有本质区别 —— 后者的目的是杜绝数据恢复的可能性，而始作俑者并未精通到能执行后者的程度。

o.en: Find out what happened to the expedition
o.zh: 查明科考队遭遇了什么

entries.en:
Datastreams are painstakingly recovered, the high-interest combat logs prioritized by your techs. The data is lossy, and the gaps must be filled by algorithms which, used improperly, have a reputation for confidently asserting false results.

Nonetheless.

You see the black of the abyss, and the cluster of lights and icons signifying the Galatia Expedition's flotilla. The view is highly abstract, a reconstruction of a visualization necessary in not only hyperspace but the uncertain depths of the Abyss.

You speed the stream forward to the point where everything goes wrong.
entries.zh:
数据流被艰难地复原，你的技术军官优先恢复了高价值的战斗日志。数据存在损毁，空缺部分必须由算法填补，但若使用不当，这类算法常会言之凿凿地输出错误结论。

尽管如此。

你看到深渊的黑暗，以及标示 Galatia 科考队编队的光点与图标群。视图高度抽象，这是在超空间乃至深渊不确定深处都必需的视觉重构。

你将时间流快进至一切开始崩坏的节点。

entries.en:
The fleet approaches an Abyssal Light. A glow in the simulated display, a foggy illumination which somehow captures the cold and solipsistic loneliness of the veil beyond deep space.

The flagship comms hum with excited academicians eager to finally perform their experiments after long weeks of boredom.
entries.zh:
舰队接近了一个深渊光点。模拟界面上浮现朦胧的光晕，某种冰冷的、唯我论式的孤寂感透过这层深空之外的帷幕隐约传来。

旗舰的通讯频道中充斥着兴奋的学者们那嘈杂的交谈声，在数周乏味旅程后，他们终于能开展期待已久的实验。

entries.en:
The flotilla's hyperspace bubble ripples, then strains under an impossible force. Anomalous sensor readings are tagged, then...

An error pops up from your own software.
EXTREME UNRELIABILITY. Output may not reflect accurate reconstruction of data. Continue?
entries.zh:
编队的超空间泡泛起涟漪，随即在某种不可思议的力量下剧烈扭曲。异常传感器读数被标记了下来，而后...

你的软件弹出一条错误提示。
极 度 不 可 靠。输出结果可能无法准确反映数据重建实况。是否继续？

entries.en:
The display is full of red icons, jagged warnings vectoring toward elements of the flotilla.

The chief Academician orders a full sensor burst, max power, using the integrated suite of the entire flotilla. There is a flash as EM surges; and gravimetrics pulse, hyperwave doppler, Atherton resonators...

Another error.
INTERRUPT: INSUFFICIENT DATA. Continue to next viable reconstruction?
entries.zh:
界面布满了红色图标，锯齿状的警报矢量线直指编队各单元。

首席学者下令全功率启动传感器，进行爆发式扫描，调动整个编队的集成套件。电磁激增引发闪光；引力计量脉冲、超波多普勒、阿瑟顿谐振器...

又一条错误提示。
中 断：数 据 不 足。是否继续至下一段有效重建？

entries.en:
The feed is degraded, patchy. The flotilla is gone; only the flagship remains, panicked voices on ship comms, in retreat from its previous course. The timeline shows a halting record of desperate damage repairs and the crews' slow realization that they cannot make it back to civilized space.

It is a death-spiral known and feared by all spacer crews.

Systems break down, fuel and supplies dwindle. Morale breaks down. Then discipline. It unravels faster than usual with so many civilians.

You shut it off.
entries.zh:
画面时断时续且模糊不清。舰队已然溃散；仅剩旗舰，通讯频道里充斥着恐慌的语音，舰船也偏离了原定航线。时间线显示着绝望地进行紧急损伤维修的断续记录，以及船员们逐渐意识到无法返回文明星域的缓慢过程。

这是所有太空船员都熟知且恐惧的死亡螺旋。

系统逐一崩溃，燃料与补给日渐枯竭。士气瓦解，随后纪律也荡然无存。在搭载如此多平民的情况下，崩坏的速度比通常更快。

你关闭了记录。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $aOrAn $nameInText.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $aOrAn $nameInText。

entries.en: Your salvors perform an orderly breach under the supervision of your ops chief, identifying and disabling several custom-rigged defensive measures.
entries.zh: 在行动长官的监督下，你的打捞员们井然有序地实施了破舱作业，确认并关闭了好几种特制安全措施。

entries.en:
One salvor is overly hasty and skips a step in the measured protocols that made the reputation of your ops chief.

This earns the consequences of a custom-rigged defensive measure hidden in the access panel for the cargo bay override.
entries.zh:
一名打捞员过于急躁，跳过了你那以严谨著称的行动长官所制定的规程中的某个步骤。

这自然招致了后果：一个隐藏在货舱手动控制面板检修口里的、特制的防御装置被触发了。

entries.en:
This is a ship of mercenary-adventurers crewed by a colorful mix of distinct personalities from worlds representative of a broad swath of the Persean Sector.

The captain was a former officer who found himself on the losing side of a minor rebellion out of the Persean League. The pilot, a racer-turned-smuggler recovered from stim addiction. Former Diktat gone renegade, present at the massacre of... scion of an Eventide officer family, overbearing mother, disowned after... the engineer, the armorer, the navigator... all irrelevant details. You skim the report faster.

You can't imagine how they managed to work together. It doesn't matter; they're all dead now.
entries.zh:
这是一艘雇佣探险船，船员们个性迥异且出身遍布英仙座星域各个角落，而这也体现出了星域的辽阔。

舰长曾是一名军官，直到他在一场叛离英仙座联盟的小规模动乱中发现自己站在了注定会失败的一边。而驾驶员则是一名改行跑走私的竞速赛手，刚戒掉了兴奋剂药瘾。前强权叛党者，亲历过... 大屠杀的现场。来自 Eventide 军官家族的名门之后，有着强势的母亲，因为... 的原因断绝了关系。还有工程师、军械员、领航员... 全都充满了无关紧要的细节。你快速地略过了这些报告。

你无法想象他们在一起工作时的光景。但没关系；因为他们现在都死了。

entries.en: Your ops chief growls, bullying the remaining salvors into paranoid compliance. Several more explosives and panel overloads are disarmed before hull access is cleared.
entries.zh: 你的行动长官咆哮了起来，逼迫着剩下的打捞员们近乎偏执地履行各项指示。在又拆除了好几个爆炸物和仪表过载器之后，通向船体内部的通路终于被打通了。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $aOrAn $nameInText.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $aOrAn $nameInText。

entries.en:
The outside hull is oddly pristine, as if sent on a long journey fresh from the forge without personalized outfitting and customization.

Your salvors breach the exterior and find a different story: crudely anchored power conduits and coolant tubes have been rigged haphazardly through the shafts and corridors of the ship. Safety doors are stuck open and hatches cut through to provide access to serpentine bundles of cable. It's not high-quality work; the occasional powered-down maintenance drone, stupid automatic things meant to assist human technicians, suggests the obvious culprits.

Your salvors must make numerous cuts to clear access to core ship systems. It is not dangerous, merely inconvenient. It is near the true centerpoint of the hull volume that they find a trio of AI cores, two gammas and a beta from the looks of the casings. They are unpowered, the coolant congealed in its pipes.
entries.zh:
外部船体看上去崭新的出奇，好似该舰从工厂出炉即开始了一次远行，完全没有任何个人化配装和改造的痕迹。

你的打捞员们破开了外壳后所见的场景则大有不同：粗糙地固定住的导管和冷凝液管道危险地穿插在舰船的通道之中。安全门被卡开，舱门被切割以让如长蛇般的缆线穿过。这不是什么精工细活；偶尔能发现一些现已关机的维护机器人，这些为了辅助人类技师而制作的愚笨自动机械暗示了这一切的始作俑者。

你的打捞员必须做出一系列切割方能接触到舰船的核心系统。这并不危险，但很不方便。最终在舰船船体的真正中心点，他们发现了三个 AI 核心。从外壳来看，是两个 Gamma 核心和一个 Beta 核心。它们都没有链接能源，且它们的导管充满了凝结的冷凝液。

entries.en:
What looked to be a valuable if legally problematic find is a bust, however: the AI cores are hollowed out, as if perfect spheres of nothingness appeared where once cybernetic superintelligence dwelled.

The computer memory of the ship proper has no answers; it was overridden from the start and appears to be convinced that it's still in its forge-cradle.
entries.zh:
这看上去价值连城、哪怕有些法律隐患的发现，其实已经是竹篮打水：这些 AI 核心都已经被凿空。曾经的超级人工智能所居之处，现在只剩一块虚无的球形空间。

舰船的计算机记录也没有任何答案；它从一开始就被操控，甚至至今依旧认为自己还在工厂中的支撑架之上。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $aOrAn $nameInText.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $aOrAn $nameInText。

entries.en:
You watch the salvage teams via vid-feed as their rig and attendant drone swarm approach the derelict.

Details from long-range optical scans are confirmed: beneath a patina of space-weathering, the hull still bears a corporate registration and the crest of the Chartery of Opis, a polity annihilated during the Askonia Crisis of cycle 181.
entries.zh:
你通过视频观察着打捞小组的机械臂和辅助无人机蜂群接近残骸。

远距离光学扫描确认了细节：在被太空环境旧化的表层之下，船体上仍然勉强可见公司的注册登记和 Opis 宪章联合体 的徽标，那是一个在星历 181 年的 Askonia 危机中被消灭的政治实体。

entries.en:
The only body found aboard is the former captain, sitting at his command console, desiccated eyes fixed ahead at the suffocating nothingness of deep space.

Behind the CIC, in the armored computer center, there is a Tri-Tachyon manufactured AI core interface. Just sitting there unassuming out in the open, a perfectly casual commercial hardware installation. This dates the ship back further, to before the AI Wars.

No core lies in the cradle, however. Perhaps it was taken when the ship was abandoned.
entries.zh:
船舱内唯一找到的尸体是坐在控制台上的前舰长，他干涸的眼睛凝视着前方令人窒息的，一片虚无的深空。

在作战信息中心后面，武装计算机中心中，有一个速子科技制造的 AI 核心接口。它就那么静静地裸露着，像一个随处可见的商用硬件装置。这表明这艘船的历史可以追溯很早以前，乃至 AI 战争之前。

然而，接口中没有核心。也许是在舰船被遗弃时被人拿走了。

entries.en:
Your tech officer oversees an attempt to read the logs, to find some hint of what happened and why - but the memory banks have all been cleared by a repeating wipe program that continued until backup power faded.

A full forensic-archeological investigation might reveal answers, but you have neither the time nor equipment for such indulgence.
entries.zh:
在你的技术军官的监督下，船员们尝试读取日志，试图寻找能够说明发生了什么问题及其原因的蛛丝马迹 —— 但舰上有个擦除程序一直在循环擦除，一直工作到备用电源都耗尽了，这也彻底清空了舰上所有存储记忆库。

或许进行考古式的全面调查能够查出真相，但你的时间和装备都顶不住这么浪费。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $aOrAn $nameInText.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $aOrAn $nameInText。

entries.en:
As your salvor teams breach the hull, they discover tell-tale signs of a pirate crew: prominently-displayed hand weapons, decor as bold and brutal as it is unsophisticated - skulls and blood-red predominate, and signs of lackadaisical maintenance performed on the less interesting ship systems.

It is not a tomb-ship, however.

By numbers, most of the crew appears to have escaped before leaving the hull derelict. A few unfortunate victims of personal violence - or parts of them - appear to have been left behind from some kind of internal conflict. The cycles since were not kind to what remained as the life support systems slowly failed.
entries.zh:
当你的打捞小队破开船体时，他们发现了大量明显属于海盗船员的痕迹：显眼的手持武器，以骷髅头和血红色色调为主，粗犷而野蛮的装饰风格，还有舰船次要系统维护不善的痕迹。

然而，这艘舰船并非是一艘 "坟墓船"。

从数字上看，大多数船员似乎在船只被遗弃之前就已逃离。过程中一些不幸的受害者似乎因内部冲突而被抛弃，而随着生命支持系统逐渐失效，他们彻底陷入了水深火热之中。

entries.en:
A cursory trawl of what logs the senior officers bothered to keep suggests that this ship was part of a small pirate flotilla tracking a well-supplied independent expedition working its way through the outer fringe. That expedition spotted the pirates, then burned rapidly toward the Abyss. The pirates followed and soon lost their prey in the stultifying darkness.

With supplies and fuel dwindling and no certainty of a 'hostile resupply', the pirate leadership began to argue, and then to scrap hulls while consolidating crew onto the remaining ships - at the barrel of a gun, as necessary.

There wasn't quite enough room for everyone, it appears.
entries.zh:
粗略浏览了上级军官们记录的日志之后，可以发现这艘舰船属于一个小型海盗舰队，当时他们正在追踪一支在边缘星区航行的，补给充足的独立探险队。当探险队发现了海盗后，他们迅速驶向深渊超空间。海盗尾随而至，但很快就在无穷无尽的黑暗中失去了目标。

随着补给和燃料的减少，猎物却迟迟不见踪影，海盗头子们之间开始了内讧。直到不得不开始拆船，将船员集中到剩余的船上 —— 必要时使用暴力的方式。

不过似乎，他们没有足够的空间容纳所有人。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $aOrAn $nameInText.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $aOrAn $nameInText。

entries.en:
Your salvors detect a very weak energy shield still active, despite main power loss. It is oddly fluctuating, as if tuned to a frequency which would be of no use in combat.

It is a simple matter to disrupt and breach the shield with standard civilian EM probe-and-shield kit, and the salvors do so handily.
entries.zh:
你的打捞员发现一个很弱的能量护盾依然在工作，即便主要能源系统已经失效。它的波动频率很奇特，似乎是专门调制过的，使其在战斗中毫无作用。

使用民用的电磁探测与屏蔽工具包就能简单地干扰和突破这个护盾，打捞员做起来得心应手。

entries.en:
A search reveals that this is, or rather was, a Tri-Tachyon flagged vessel.

The crew is dead. What's left of the young executive with lead authority over the operation is still in his luxuriously outfitted personal cabin; such incidents involving the untimely discharge of an engineering-grade plasma cutter are not unknown in poorly managed repair docks, but when they occur in a ship's executive suite, pointed questions are raised.

The last survivor, suited against the apparent life support failure, is found near the jury-rigged power generator that was spliced into the ship's shield-grid. The suit's safeties were overridden and its atmo mix of oxygen reduced to zero.

It would have been a painless slide into unconsciousness and, soon enough, death.
entries.zh:
经一番搜寻后得知，这艘船是，或者说曾经是，一艘隶属于 速子科技 的船只。

所有船员都已死去。业务主管级的年轻执行官的残躯仍然留在他装修奢华的私人舱室里。这类涉及工程级等离子切割器意外发射的事故在管理不善的修理码头上并不少见，但这些事故发生在一艘舰船的执行官套房里，那就是个大问题了。

活到最后的那个人被发现于那台接入了舰船护盾电网的应急发电机附近，显然是为了抵抗失效的维生系统而穿着太空服。太空服的安全装置遭到了强行控制，呼吸空气中的氧气含量被降低到了零。

那应该会在不知不觉中就毫无痛苦地失去意识，继而很快走向死亡。

entries.en:
"THEY FOLLOW" was scraped onto the decking with a multitool. Low oxygen psychosis is not unheard of under such catastrophic conditions.

What exactly it was this shield was supposed to keep out - or in - is unclear.
entries.zh:
"他们追过来了" 几个大字被多用工具刻在了面板上。在这种灾难性的情况下，缺氧精神病的发作也并非闻所未闻。

已经无从而知，这护盾到底是要把什么东西挡在外面 —— 或封在里面。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $aOrAn $nameInText.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $aOrAn $nameInText。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $aOrAn $nameInText.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $aOrAn $nameInText。

entries.en:
As your salvors approach, some kind of proximity sensor is triggered - a faint comms transmission begins. The power system is clearly degraded and running down, causing the transmission to sputter and warble.

It's a repeating recording, not an active feed. Your comms officer does their best to clean it up, and forwards it to your command console.

A face appears, presumably the unfortunate ship's captain, his expression twisted by an appalling mixture of privation and hatred.
entries.zh:
当打捞员们靠近时，某种近程传感器被触发 —— 微弱的通讯传输也随之开始。供电系统显然已经劣化损毁，导致信号断断续续并伴有颤音。

这是一段循环播放的录音，而非实时通讯。你的通讯军官尽力修复信号后，便将其转至你的指挥台。

一张面容随之浮现，想必是这艘不幸舰船的舰长，他的表情因难以言喻的饥馑与憎恨而扭曲。

entries.en: "...Zunya, if you ever see this, know that my last wish and curse is that you burn, and burn slowly in the radiation of a leaking reactor. I hope your eyes boil, and your blood sublimes into the vacuum as your dying body is thrown into space by the others you've betrayed. You're as heartless as-"
entries.zh: "...Zunya，如果你见到这段影像，须知我最后的祈愿与诅咒便是让你燃烧，在泄漏反应堆的辐射中缓慢燃烧。我希望你的眼球沸腾，血液在真空中升华，而你那垂死的躯体被你背叛的同伴抛入太空。你冷酷如 ——"

entries.en: He goes on to describe various torments deserved due to the poor character of someone called Zunya Glamor-Rotanev. By context clues you presume her to be some kind of high ranking Tri-Tachyon executive who commissioned him to carry out a failed expedition.
entries.zh: 他继续描述着那个人 —— 那个名为 Zunya Glamor-Rotanev 的人 —— 因自己的卑劣品性而应得的种种折磨。根据上下文的线索，你推测此人是 速子科技 的高层管理者，并曾经委托他执行一项最终失败的探索任务。

o.en: Try to find out what Tri-Tachyon was looking for out here
o.zh: 尝试查出 速子科技 正在这里寻找什么

entries.en: He goes on to describe various torments deserved due to the poor character of Director of Special Acquisitions Zunya Glamor-Rotanev. It seems unlikely that she would be interested in a recording of the transmission.
entries.zh: 他继续描述着特殊采购部总监 Zunya Glamor-Rotanev 因自己的卑劣品性而应得的种种折磨，而她想必不会对这段通讯录音感兴趣。

o.en: Try to find records of what the mercenaries may have found
o.zh: 尝试寻找有关这些雇佣兵可能发现了什么的记录

entries.en:
Your ops chief gives the order, and salvage teams move to prioritize the recovery of datacores and sensor buffers.

They are efficient in their work, and soon their relays hum with recovered data. Tiny packet drones shuttle recovered hardware between the wreck and your $shipOrFleet.
entries.zh:
你的行动长官下达指令，打捞小组开始优先回收数据核心与传感器缓存。

他们的工作十分高效，转眼间中继器便开始嗡嗡作响，传输着恢复的数据。微型包裹无人机在舰船残骸与你的$shipOrFleet间穿梭运送回收的硬件。

entries.en:
Your tech officer is only frustrated by the results, however. The datacores have been wiped, memory overwritten thousands of times with hateful messages directed at Glamor-Rotanev. If these mercs found anything, if their logs had any clues, it's all been erased. If there was anything esoteric in their cargo holds, it's been dumped.

"It's all just scrap, $playerSirOrMadam," your tech officer reports, disappointed. Your ops chief grunts neutral acknowledgement; it's always scrap to them.
entries.zh:
然而，你的技术军官对结果只感到挫败。数据核心已被擦除，存储空间被数千条针对 Glamor-Rotanev 的仇恨信息反复覆写。即使这些佣兵曾发现了什么，即使他们的日志曾藏有线索，如今也已全部湮灭。如果他们货舱里曾载有玄秘之物，也早被倾弃。

"这全是废料了，$playerSirOrMadam，" 你的技术军官汇报道，语气中难掩失望。行动长官闷哼一声表示了解；在他眼中，这些向来都只是废料。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $aOrAn $nameInText.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $aOrAn $nameInText。

o.en: Send salvors in for a closer look
o.zh: 派遣打捞员们进行近距离勘察

o.en: Take samples for Oya Tanaica, the nanoforge engineer on Asher
o.zh: 采集样本以移交给 Asher 的纳米锻炉工程师 Oya Tanaica

entries.en:
A starship-sized metal structure spins slowly before your $shipOrFleet. It is no ship, but a regular form of asymmetric proportions with a trough-like interior. It appears to have sustained tremendous battle-damage on its convex face, which is riven with gaping holes.

A cloud of debris, presumably from the structure, hangs in the blackness like flies around a corpse.
entries.zh:
一座星舰尺寸的金属结构在你的$shipOrFleet面前缓缓旋转。它不是舰船，而是个比例不对称的规则体，内部呈槽状。其凸面似乎承受过剧烈的战斗损伤，布满了狰狞的裂口。

一片碎屑云 —— 想必是来自这座结构体 —— 正悬浮于黑暗中，如同尸体周围盘踞的蝇群。

entries.en:
A starship-sized metal structure spins slowly before your $shipOrFleet. It is no ship, but a modular armor section from the Onslaught Mk.I which your sensors officer readily matches to your records despite the tremendous battle-damage.

Smaller pieces of debris, presumably from the structure, hang in the blackness like flies around a corpse.
entries.zh:
一座星舰尺寸的金属结构在你的$shipOrFleet面前缓缓旋转。那不是舰船，而是 攻势 Mk.I 的一块模块化装甲残段，尽管承受过剧烈的战斗损伤，你的传感器技官仍能轻易将其与你的记录相匹配。

更细小的碎片，想必正来自这座结构，悬浮于黑暗中，如同尸体周围盘踞的蝇群。

entries.en:
A starship-sized metal structure spins slowly before your $shipOrFleet. It is no ship, but a modular armor section which, despite tremendous battle-damage, matches the armored vambrace of the Onslaught Mk.I.

Your sensors officer builds a scan of the structure from your $shipOrFleet's sensor suite then overlays it onto the 'arm' of your own Onslaught Mk.I. The visual match is obvious despite the violence which has torn and warped the structure.

Smaller pieces of debris, presumably from the vambrace, hang in the blackness like flies around a corpse.
entries.zh:
一座星舰尺寸的金属结构在你的$shipOrFleet面前缓缓旋转。那不是舰船，而是一块模块化装甲的残段，尽管承受过剧烈的战斗损伤，但仍能匹配 攻势 Mk.I 的护臂装甲结构。

你的传感器技官利用$shipOrFleet的传感器套件对该结构进行了扫描，并将其叠加至你那艘 攻势 Mk.I 的 '手臂' 上。尽管暴力撕扯与扭曲已使其结构变形，但视觉上的匹配依然显而易见。

更细小的碎片，想必正来自这座护臂，悬浮于黑暗中，如同尸体周围盘踞的蝇群。

entries.en:
"Spectra and mass returns are consistent, mostly, with ship armor," your sensors officer reports. "No active power systems, no atmo, no habitable volumes. Temperature approaching background."

They look over their shoulder at you. "It's dead. And it's been dead for a very long time."

Sensors gives you an apologetic look. "Conditions are strange out here, $playerSirOrMadam. We'll need a closer look to find out more."
entries.zh:
"光谱与质量反馈基本符合舰船装甲特征，" 你的传感器技官汇报道，"没有活跃的能源系统，没有大气，没有宜居舱段，温度趋近于背景值。"

他们回头看向你。"它被遗弃了，而且已经被遗弃了很长时间。"

传感器技官向你投来歉意的目光。"这里的环境很异常，$playerSirOrMadam。我们需要进行近距离勘察以获取更多信息。"

entries.en:
"Spectra and mass returns are consistent with original armor composition from our, ah, matching specimen," your sensors officer reports. "No active power systems, no atmo, no habitable volumes. Temperature approaching background."

They look over their shoulder at you. "It's dead, and it's been dead for a very long time."

Sensors gives you an apologetic look. "Conditions are strange out here, $playerSirOrMadam. We'll need a closer look to find out more."
entries.zh:
"光谱与质量反馈与我们的，呃，匹配样本的原始装甲成分一致，" 你的传感器技官汇报道，"没有活跃的能源系统，没有大气层，没有宜居舱段，温度趋近于背景值。"

他们回头看向你。"它被遗弃了，而且已经被遗弃了很长时间。"

传感器技官向你投来歉意的目光。"这里的环境很异常，$playerSirOrMadam。我们需要进行近距离勘察以获取更多信息。"

entries.en:
You give the word.

Your operations chief nods, then barks out deployment orders to the waiting salvor teams.

The investigation proceeds smoothly. The derelict structure and its attendant debris are truly cold and dead. Such battle-damage is familiar to your salvors, and this survey even easier due to the apparent lack of live munitions and none of the usual frozen or fried vacuum-desiccated remains.

Sensing a laxity in the crews, your ops chief growls admonitions over the general comms then orders a more detailed adherence to procedure.
entries.zh:
你下达了指令。

你的行动长官点了点头，随即向待命的打捞小组发出了部署命令。

调查顺利地进行着。废弃结构体及其附属残骸确实冰冷且毫无生机，这种战损形态对你的打捞员们来说并不陌生，而此次勘察甚至更为轻松，因为显然结构上既没有未引爆的弹药，也没有常见的冻僵或碳化的真空脱水遗骸。

察觉到队员们的松懈，你的行动长官在公共频道发出警告，命令队伍更严格地遵循操作流程。

entries.en:
As reports and scans come in, a picture emerges - both a detailed holographic mapping and an understanding of what this structure is.

It is a piece of modular armor with structural attachment points, flux vent ports, and even an auxiliary sensor network, though no internal power sources.

The engineering is all recognizable as related to Domain standards, but as if from a crude half-foreign culture. Power connectors, for instance, are robustly built but oddly shaped and accompanied by an odd drift in signage iconography. It's nothing your salvors can't understand or adapt, but it is technology unlike even the oldest nanofabricated hulls and hardware designs used in the Persean Sector.
entries.zh:
随着报告与扫描数据不断传回，事件的全貌逐渐清晰 —— 既包括详细的全息测绘，也包括对该结构本质的理解。

这是一块具备结构接合点、幅能排放口，甚至附带辅助传感器网络的模块化装甲残段，尽管内部已经没有能源供应。

该结构的所有工程构造都能辨识出与 人之领 标准的关联性，但仿佛又是出自某种粗犷的半异域文明。例如其电源接口虽然结构坚固却造型奇特，伴随的标识图标体系也存在诡异的偏移。你的打捞员并非无法理解或适应这一点，但即便与英仙座星域使用的最古老纳米锻造船体与硬件设计相比，这些技术也显得迥然不同。

o.en: Tech, what are we looking at here?
o.zh: 技术官，我们眼前的究竟是什么？

entries.en:
Reports and scans come in, a detailed holographic mapping forms in your primary display, and all data confirms with certainty that this is an Onslaught Mk.I vambrace.

The modular armor features structural attachment points, flux vent ports, and even an auxiliary sensor network, though no internal power sources.

The engineering is all recognizable as related to Domain standards, but as if from a crude half-foreign culture. Power connectors, for instance, are robustly built but oddly shaped and accompanied by an odd drift in signage iconography. Your salvors have understood and adapted to these oddities before. Nonetheless, it is technology unlike even the oldest nanofabricated hulls and hardware designs used in the Persean Sector.
entries.zh:
随着报告与扫描数据不断传回，详细的全息测绘在主显示屏上逐渐成型，所有数据都确凿无疑地证实：这是 攻势 Mk.I 的护臂结构。

这块模块化装甲具备结构接合点、幅能排放口，甚至附带辅助传感器网络，尽管内部已经没有能源供应。

该装甲的所有工程构造都能辨识出与 人之领 标准的关联性，但仿佛又是出自某种粗犷的半异域文明。例如其电源接口虽然结构坚固却造型奇特，伴随的标识图标体系也存在诡异的偏移。你的打捞员此前已理解并适应了这类异常。但尽管如此，即便与英仙座星域使用的最古老纳米锻造船体与硬件设计相比，这些技术也显得迥然不同。

o.en: Tech, what are we looking at here?
o.zh: 技术官，我们眼前的究竟是什么？

entries.en:
Your technology officer jumps at your words; they were apparently quite lost in thought.

"Um, $playerSirOrMadam. If I had to... in short, it's..."

Your ops chief maintains an even expression, pointedly unreactive to this stuttering.

"It's ancient," Tech finally settles on a word. "It can only be a product of the Early Domain."
entries.zh:
你的技术军官被你突然的发问惊得一颤；对方显然正沉浸于思索之中。

"呃，$playerSirOrMadam 。如果必须概括... 简而言之，这是..."

你的行动长官保持着平静的表情，对这番结结巴巴的陈述刻意不予回应。

"这是上古遗物，" 技术官终于确定了用词，"只能是早期人之领的产物。"

entries.en:
"Judging by the battle damage..." Your technology officer looks back at the specs, struggling. "There was a battle."

A look of concern grows. "It has been here for a long time, but from the debris cloud... and just one vambrace, abandoned here? The conditions are strange enough, but I would speculate that this is not an untouched site. It doesn't look like salvagers or scrappers, they've got distinctive patterns. I couldn't say who, or what, but I suspect the site has been disturbed. Or moved."

"If only it had datacores, buffers, something to analyze!" Tech looks at your ops chief, who gives a single shake of their head.
entries.zh:
"从战斗损伤判断..." 你的技术军官回顾着参数，面露难色，"这里发生过战斗。"

对方愈发担忧，"它已经在这里存在了很久，但根据碎片云的分布... 仅仅一块护臂，被遗弃于此？这里的环境已经足够异常，但我推测这并非是未被接触过的区域。这不像打捞员或拆解者的手法，他们有明确的作业特征。我无法断言是谁，又或是什么，但我怀疑该地点曾被扰动过，或曾被移动过。"

"要是它有数据核心、缓冲存储之类的可供分析的东西就好了！" 技术官看向了你的行动长官，后者只摇了摇头。

It's nothing like salvagers or scrappers, they've got distinctive patterns. I couldn't say who, or what, but I suspect the site has been disturbed, or moved."

"If only it had datacores, buffers, something to analyze!" Tech looks at your ops chief, who gives a single shake of their head.
