"I'm so glad to meet someone who understands the difficulties involved.

Having proper funding - say, an extra $igr_bribeAmountDGS credits - would ensure that this investigation could reach a speedy and satisfactory conclusion."
entries.zh:
"我很高兴能遇到一个能理解其中难处的人。

如果有良好的资助，比如说再有一笔 $igr_bribeAmountDGS 星币的款项，就能确保这项调查能够迅速获得一个令人满意的结论。"

o.zh: 提供一笔 $igr_bribeAmountDGS 星币的"捐助"

entries.en:
"Your interest in the matter is duly noted, but it doesn't sound like you're really ready to help me resolve this misunderstanding. Something more like, oh, $ise_bribeAmountDGS credits? That could facilitate a proper investigation."

"Now I have some fascinating reports about you to review, so come back when you're serious."
entries.zh:
"我非常理解你对事态的关切，但听上去你似乎还没做好协助我解决这个误会的准备。这还需要大概，嗯，$ise_bribeAmountDGS 星币左右？才能促成一次合理的调查。"

"然后现在我还有一堆关于你的精彩报告要读，所以下次你认真决定要做这件事的时候再来找我。"

entries.en:
"Oh," he says, looking disappointed. "How unusually passive of you. I was looking forward to your attempt to persuade me toward a wildly counter-logical business opportunity."

"Are you sure?"
entries.zh:
"哦，\"他说，看上去有点失望。\"你可真是少见地消极。我还挺期待你试着说服我去做一桩荒唐到违背逻辑的生意呢。"

"你确定？"

entries.en: "We'll see, then," Inesis says with a shrug. "I'm going to pay close attention to my notification algorithms. I suggest you do the same because this looks like a second Askonia Crisis to me."
entries.zh: "那就走着瞧吧，\"Inesis 耸耸肩说。\"我会密切关注我的通知算法。建议你也一样，因为在我看来，这像是第二次 Askonia 危机。"

entries.en: "Oh captain," he says cheerfully. "It is quite a vision, quite a dream. But do you know what they say about the best-laid plans?"
entries.zh: "哦，舰长，\"他快活地说。\"那确实是一幅了不起的图景，一个了不起的梦。可你知道人们怎么评价那些最周密的计划吗？"

entries.en: "Oh captain," he says cheerfully. "You know what they say about the best-laid plans?"
entries.zh: "哦，舰长，\"他快活地说。\"你知道人们怎么评价那些最周密的计划吗？"

entries.en:
"Anyhow," he says, looking up and away. "In a lonely Sector one must see how far one can go with the help of a powerful friend, you understand? Not all who share my, ah, passion for freedom see this on quite the same level, of course, but," he smile turns colder. "They've not once turned down a shipment of arms."

He seems satisfied with that, and takes a substantial drink from his glass.

"Let us deal with the problem of victory after it's been achieved, that's what I say."
entries.zh:
"总之，\"他说着，抬眼望向远处。\"在这孤零零的星域里，人总得看看，靠着一位有权势的朋友能走多远，你明白吧？并非所有跟我一样，呃，热爱自由的人都能站在同一个高度看这事，当然，不过——\"他笑意转冷。\"他们可一次都没拒绝过我们送去的军火。"

他似乎对此很满意，端起杯子灌了一大口。

"胜利之后的问题，等胜利到手再说，我就是这个主张。"

entries.en: "I don't quite recall," he says, rubbing his chin. "Something terribly poetic, no doubt."
entries.zh: "我记不太清了，\"他搓着下巴说。\"反正多半是句特别诗意的话。"

entries.en:
"Really?" He seems taken aback.

"I wasn't actually sure how it went, so I'll have to take your word for it. Perhaps I should have chosen a less ominous turn of phrase... nonetheless, it's fitting enough."
entries.zh:
"真的？"他像是被将了一军。

"我其实也不确定原话是怎么说的，那就只好信你了。也许我该换个不那么不祥的说法...不过，倒也挺贴切。"

entries.en: "The fuel you've given is already bringing in more weapons and recruits. And we're running hit-and-run operations on Diktat convoys further out than ever!"
entries.zh: "你给的燃料已经换回更多武器和人手了。我们对辛达强权的运输队打起了游击，比以往伸得还远！"

entries.en: "I got the supplies out - most of them - to comrades across the system." She looks quite earnest, as she speaks. "Thanks to you, they'll be ready for the uprising."
entries.zh: "补给我发出去了 —— 大部分吧 —— 送到了星系各处的同志手里。\" 她说得十分恳切。\"多亏了你，起事那天他们才备得齐。"

entries.en: "I've managed to smuggle most of the weapons to cells on Volturn and Sindria," she grins. "When we rise, their bunkers and mechs will fall."
entries.zh: "大部分武器我都设法偷运给了 Volturn 和 Sindria 上的地下小组，" 她咧嘴一笑。"等我们起事，他们的地堡和机甲都得塌。"

entries.en: "I've managed to smuggle most of the weapons to cells on Volturn and Sindria," she grins. "The bootlickers in their bunkers and mechs are already discovering that they're not so invincible as they thought."
entries.zh: "大部分武器我都设法偷运给了 Volturn 和 Sindria 上的地下小组，" 她咧嘴一笑。"那些躲在地堡和机甲里的走狗，已经开始明白自己没那么不可战胜了。"

o.zh: 交付 40 单位重型军械

entries.en:
After a short wait and a burst of static the makeshift comms network of Umbra finally relays you through.

"Death to Andrada," she says as a greeting. "What do you want?"
entries.zh:
稍等片刻，一阵静电杂音过后，Umbra 那套东拼西凑的通讯网络总算把你的信号接了进去。

"打倒 Andrada，\" 她拿这话当招呼。\"有什么事？"

entries.en:
"Back again." She gives you a look. "Did you forget something?"
OR
"Didn't you just comms?" She looks annoyed. "Out with it."
entries.zh:
"又来了。\" 她瞥了你一眼。\"落下什么东西了？"
OR
"不是刚通过话吗？\" 她一脸不耐。\"有话快说。"

entries.en:
"Back again." She gives you a look. "Can I help you with something?"
OR
"Didn't you just comms?" She raises an eyebrow.

"Well, out with it."
entries.zh:
"又来了。\" 她瞥了你一眼。\"有什么要我帮忙的？"
OR
"不是刚通过话吗？" 她挑了挑眉。

"那就说吧。"

entries.en:
"$playerName the liar." She scowls. "Didn't I tell you to go suck vacuum?"
OR
"The liar returns." She sniffs, and somehow looks down at you through the comms.

"Back to waste my time?"
entries.zh:
"$playerName，那个骗子。\" 她沉下脸。\"我不是叫你去吸真空吗？"
OR
"骗子又回来了。" 她哼了一声，隔着通讯竟也能摆出俯视你的样子。

"又来浪费我的时间？"

entries.en:
After a short wait and a burst of static the makeshift comms network of Umbra finally relays you through.

"Death to Andrada," she says as a greeting. "Captain $playerName, it's good to see you."
entries.zh:
稍等片刻，一阵静电杂音过后，Umbra 那套东拼西凑的通讯网络总算把你的信号接了进去。

"打倒 Andrada，\" 她拿这话当招呼。\"$playerName 舰长，见到你真好。"

entries.en:
After a short wait and a burst of static the makeshift comms network of Umbra finally relays you through.

"Death to all Andradas," she says as a greeting. "What do you want?"
entries.zh:
稍等片刻，一阵静电杂音过后，Umbra 那套东拼西凑的通讯网络总算把你的信号接了进去。

"打倒所有 Andrada 家的人，\" 她拿这话当招呼。\"有什么事？"

entries.en: "Yeah, what is it?
entries.zh: "是啊，什么事？"

entries.en: "$PlayerName," she says, defiant as ever.
entries.zh: "$PlayerName，" 她说道，还是那副不服输的劲头。

entries.en: "Captain," she says in greeting, defiant as ever. "Welcome to Askonia."
entries.zh: "舰长，\" 她照例招呼一声，还是那副不服输的劲头。\"欢迎来到 Askonia。"

entries.en: "Oh. $PlayerName." She looks tired. "What are you here for?"
entries.zh: "哦。是$PlayerName。\" 她一脸倦意。\"你来做什么？"

entries.en:
"I see now." Her eyes narrow.

"Tell me, how much did my grandmother pay you to come admonish me? You can tell her she's wasted her credits. Again."
entries.zh:
"我明白了。" 她皱起眉头。

"说吧，这次我奶奶花了多少雇你来说教我？你可以去告诉她老人家别浪费星币了。"

o.en: Your grandmother hired a freelancer to talk you out of... this?
o.zh: 你奶奶雇佣过自由佣兵来劝你离开...这儿？

o.en: Are you telling me I could have been paid for this?
o.zh: 你说我本来还能拿钱的？

entries.en:
Her eyes narrow.

"'A doomed cause'? And you claim to be a deep-cover agent who is part of the ARC."

"I think you're a liar," she says.

"A hired killer for execs and admirals, a profiteer selling drugs to the masses with one hand and harvesting black market organs with the other."
entries.zh:
她眯起了眼睛。

"'注定失败的事业'？而你自称是 Askonia 革命者委员会的深度卧底特工。"

"我认为你是个骗子，" 她说道。

"为高管和将军卖命的雇佣杀手，一边向大众兜售毒品牟利，一边收割黑市器官。"

entries.en: "Die in vacuum." She slams the cut-off.
entries.zh: "死在真空里吧。" 她猛力切断了通讯。

entries.en:
She considers your reply. "Huh."

"So you're not working for her." Imoinu looks away for a moment.

"Yeah, she wants me back to be a good gens-heir. Says I'm shaming the family. And if I am? Good. They deserve it for what's been done in the name of Gens Kato."
entries.zh:
她思忖着你的回答。"哼。"

"所以你不是为她办事的。" Imoinu 移开视线片刻。

"对，她想让我回去当个合格的氏族继承人，又说我让氏族蒙羞。就算真是这样？好啊。就凭他们以 Kato 氏族之名做的那些事，这是应得的报应。"

entries.en:
She considers your reply.

"Huh. For once, I don't think you're lying." Imoinu looks away for a moment. Her resolve hardens again. "Whatever."

"And what are you really? A hired killer for execs and admirals? Profiteer from the organs harvested from the desperate masses? Go suck vacuum."

She slams the cut-off.
entries.zh:
她思忖着你的回答。"哼。"

"这是唯一一次，我觉得你没撒谎。" Imoinu 移开视线片刻，随即再度坚定起来。"随便吧。"

"那你究竟是什么人？为高管和将军卖命的雇佣杀手？从绝望大众身上收割器官牟利的奸商？还是滚去真空里哈气吧。"

她猛力切断了通讯。

entries.en:
Her eyes narrow.

"A distinctly backhanded compliment. Tell me, are you another freelancer hired by my grandmother to come admonish me? Tell her she's wasted her credits."
entries.zh:
她眯起了眼睛。

"这可真是别有用心的恭维。告诉我，你也是我祖母雇来训诫我的自由佣兵吗？转告她，她的星币白花了。"

o.en: I truly have no idea what you're talking about.
o.zh: 我真的不明白你在说什么。

o.en: Are you telling me I could have been paid for this?
o.zh: 你是说我本可以为此拿到报酬？

entries.en:
"Whatever." She scowls. "At least I chose to make some good from my position!"

"What have you ever done? Acted the hired killer for execs and admirals? Profited from the organs harvested from the desperate masses?"

"I don't need your lectures." She slams the cut-off.
entries.zh:
"随便吧。" 她怒目而视，"至少我选择用我的身份做些好事！"

"你又做过什么？充当高管和将军的雇佣杀手？靠收割绝望大众的器官牟利？"

"我可不需要你的说教。" 她猛力切断了通讯。

entries.en:
"A pathetic attempt to ingratiate yourself after your previous blunder. Your ruse wouldn't work on a child." Her eyes narrow.

"Tell me, are you another freelancer hired by my grandmother to come admonish me? Tell her she's wasted her credits."
entries.zh:
"在搞砸了之后，现在又想讨好我，真是可悲的尝试。你这套把戏连小孩子都骗不了。" 她眯起了眼睛。

"告诉我，你也是我祖母雇来训诫我的自由佣兵吗？转告她，她的星币白花了。"

o.en: I truly have no idea what you're talking about.
o.zh: 我真的不明白你在说什么。

o.en: Are you telling me I could have been paid for this?
o.zh: 你是说我本可以为此拿到报酬？

entries.en:
"A pathetic attempt to ingratiate yourself after your previous blunder. Your ruse wouldn't work on a child." Her eyes narrow.

"Tell me, are you another freelancer hired by my grandmother to come admonish me? Tell her she's wasted her credits."
entries.zh:
"上回出了丑，这会儿又来讨好，可真够可怜的。这点把戏连小孩都骗不过。" 她眯起了眼睛。

"说吧，你又是我祖母花钱雇来教训我的自由从业者？回去告诉她，星币算是白花了。"

o.en: I truly have no idea what you're talking about.
o.zh: 我是真不知道你在说什么。

o.en: Are you telling me I could have been paid for this?
o.zh: 你是说，这事儿我本来还能拿钱？

entries.en:
"You're a bloody-booted minion of the Diktat and I'll have you spaced for your crimes the moment I get the chance."

Her dismissal is backed by the arrogance of a gens-heir.

And is made complete as she slams the comms shut-off.
entries.zh:
"你不过是辛达强权血靴下的走狗，等我找到机会，我一定会把你扔进太空，让你为自己的罪行付出代价。"

她那句轻蔑的斥责带着贵族后裔特有的傲慢。

随着通讯器被狠狠摔上，这番谈话彻底落幕。

o.en: We've had differences, but I wish to provision the ARC.
o.zh: 我们是有过分歧，但我想给 ARC 补些给养。

o.en: Aren't you Gens Kato? What are you doing on Umbra?
o.zh: 你不是 Kato 氏族的吗？你在 Umbra 上做什么？

entries.en:
"Yeah, what of it?"

She sticks her chin up, striking what is intended to be a defiant expression.

"I'm here to fight the brutal oppressions and liberate the Askonian System!"
entries.zh:
"是又怎样？"

她扬起下巴，摆出挑衅的姿态。

"我来此是为反抗暴虐的压迫，解放 Askonian 星系！"

entries.en:
"Yeah, what of it? Got another blatant lie to sell?"

She sticks her chin up, striking what is intended to be a defiant expression.

"I'm here to fight the brutal oppressions and liberate the Askonian System!"
entries.zh:
"是啊，那又怎样？又编好了什么瞎话来兜售？"

她扬起下巴，努力摆出一副不肯服软的表情。

"我来这儿，就是要反抗残暴的压迫，解放 Askonia 星系！"

entries.en:
"He is." She looks taken aback, but quickly recovers her composure.

"You met him? He's still on Mazalot suppressing the Luddics for the gens, I suppose."
entries.zh:
"确实如此。" 她略显错愕，但迅速恢复镇定。

"你见过他？我猜他还在 Mazalot 为氏族镇压卢德分子吧。"

o.en: He is. He became... rather angry at me.
o.zh: 是的。他变得...对我相当愤怒。

entries.en:
"You don't say!"

She laughs. You can hear the echo of long-running sibling conflict.

"Of course he's angry. He's there on behalf of the gens to hammer the Luddic faithful into compliant citizens of the League! The only tools he can imagine are force and fear because he thinks the Luddics are irrational sub-humans. Like stupid, simple animals."

She shakes her head, "He can't help but fail."
entries.zh:
"可不是嘛！"

她大笑起来，你能听出其中绵延多年的兄妹矛盾。

"他当然愤怒。他代表氏族在那里用铁腕将虔诚的卢德信徒 '锤炼' 成联盟的顺民！他所能想到的工具唯有暴力与恐惧，因为他视卢德分子为非理性的次等人，就像愚昧低等的动物。"

她摇头叹道，"他注定失败。"

entries.en:
"Dardan, helpful?" She scoffs. "Doesn't sound like him."

"He's there on behalf of the gens to hammer the Luddic faithful into compliant citizens of the League! The only tools he can imagine are force and fear because he thinks the Luddics are irrational sub-humans. Like stupid, simple animals."

She shakes her head, "He can't help but fail."
entries.zh:
"Dardan，乐于助人？" 她嗤之以鼻，"这可不像他。"

"他代表氏族在那里用铁腕将虔诚的卢德信徒 '锤炼' 成联盟的顺民！他所能想到的工具唯有暴力与恐惧，因为他视卢德分子为非理性的次等人，就像愚昧低等的动物。"

她摇头叹道，"他注定失败。"

o.en: He is. He seems unhappy in his current post.
o.zh: 是的。他似乎对当前的职位并不满意。

entries.en:
"You don't say!"

She laughs. You can hear the echo of long-running sibling conflict.

"Of course he's unhappy. He's there on behalf of the gens to hammer the Luddic faithful into compliant citizens of the League! The only tools he can imagine are force and fear because he thinks the Luddics are irrational sub-humans. Like stupid, simple animals."

She shakes her head, "He can't help but fail."
entries.zh:
"可不是嘛！"

她大笑起来，你能听出其中绵延多年的兄妹矛盾。

"他当然不满意。他代表氏族在那里用铁腕将虔诚的卢德信徒 '锤炼' 成联盟的顺民！他所能想到的工具唯有暴力与恐惧，因为他视卢德分子为非理性的次等人，就像愚昧低等的动物。"

她摇头叹道，"他注定失败。"

entries.en:
"Of course they object," she says. "They're part of an aristocratic elite whose position is predicated on the extractive exploitation of the masses."

 A hint of a smile appears. "And I've chosen to fight everything they stand for."
entries.zh:
"他们当然反对，" 她说道，"这群贵族精英的地位本就建立在剥削大众的基础上。"

她的脸上浮现出一丝笑意，"而我选择反抗他们代表的一切。"

o.en: I mean to say you're in a difficult position, but I do support your cause.
o.zh: 我是说虽然你的处境艰难，但我确实支持你的事业。

entries.en:
She looks at you suspiciously for a long moment.

"For a 'supporter', your words reek of defeatism. We need material support, not misplaced admonition."
entries.zh:
她满腹狐疑地注视你良久。

"作为一位 '支持者'，你的言辞却充满失败主义的气息。我们需要的是物质支援，而非不合时宜的说教。"

entries.en:
"A pathetic attempt to ingratiate yourself after your previous blunder. Your ruse wouldn't work on a child." Her eyes narrow.

"Tell me, are you another freelancer hired by my grandmother to come admonish me? Tell her she's wasted her credits."
entries.zh:
"在搞砸了之后，现在又想讨好我，真是可悲的尝试。你这套把戏连小孩子都骗不了。" 她眯起了眼睛。

"告诉我，你也是我祖母雇来训诫我的自由佣兵吗？转告她，她的星币白花了。"

o.en: I truly have no idea what you're talking about.
o.zh: 我真的不明白你在说什么。

o.en: Are you telling me I could have been paid for this?
o.zh: 你是说我本可以为此拿到报酬？

o.en: I met Dardan. Is he your brother?
o.zh: 我见过 Dardan 了，他是你的兄弟吗？

o.en: It seems a doomed cause. Don't you want to go home?
o.zh: 这似乎是注定失败的事业，你难道不想回家吗？

o.en: That's very... uh, noble of you.
You do what you like. Forget I brought it up, it's not my business.
o.zh: 你爱怎样便怎样。就当我没提过，这不关我事。

entries.en: "That's right," she says. "Now did you have anything useful to say, or are we done?"
entries.zh: "没错，" 她说道，"现在你还有什么有用的话要说吗，还是我们可以结束了？"

o.en: Doesn't your family, your gens, object?
o.zh: 你的家族，你的氏族，难道不反对吗？

o.en: That's rich talk coming from a Gens baby.
o.zh: 这都是纨绔子弟才会发出的天真言论。

o.en: I salute your dedication. It is a just cause.
o.zh: 我向你的奉献精神致敬，这是正义的事业。

o.en: Look, you're gens Kato. You're throwing yourself away on Umbra.
o.zh: 听着，你是 Kato 氏族的人。你呆在 Umbra 上简直是自暴自弃。

entries.en: "We have nothing to talk about," she snaps, then hits the comms cut-off.
entries.zh: "我们没什么可谈的了，" 她厉声回道，随即切断了通讯。

entries.en: "It is," she nods. "And I'm glad you can see that, despite the... difficulties."
entries.zh: "正是如此，" 她点头道，"我很高兴你能理解这一点，尽管存在...困难。"

o.en: You mean, being stuck on a pirate-infested icecube with no fleet.
o.zh: 你是指，困在这个海盗横行的冰疙瘩上，手上一支舰队也没有。

entries.en:
"The ARC navy is... it's mostly opportunistic pirates. A few have good ideology, but most..." She sighs. "It's not easy."

"The United Front is united more by bickering and infighting than solidarity. The Charterists are eternally fundraising, keeping all the credits for running their tours and parties instead of fighting. The Volturnian Self Defense Covenant puts up a real fight, but they're held back from true revolutionary consciousness by the reactionary elements of Luddic ideology. So all they can do is bleed out into that ocean of theirs..."
entries.zh:
"Askonia 革命者委员会的海军...大多是投机海盗。虽然少数人有好的理念，但多数..." 她叹道，"这并不容易。"

"联合阵线的团结更多体现在争吵和内斗上，而非真正的团结。宪章派永远在筹款，把所有星币都花在巡演和派对上，而非战斗。Volturn 自卫盟约确实在奋战，但他们被卢德思想中的反动元素所束缚，无法形成真正的革命觉悟。所以他们只能在自己那片海洋里慢慢失血..."

o.en: Why not go back to Kazeron and find a way to support the fight from inside the League?
o.zh: 为什么不回到 Kazeron，在联盟内部寻找支持斗争的方法？

o.en: What if you go to Volturn. Help the, um, Volturn Covenant?
o.zh: 如果你前往 Volturn 呢？去帮助那个，呃，Volturn 盟约？

entries.en:
She opens her mouth, then pauses, and closes it.

"Yes. That's... fair."
entries.zh:
她张口欲言，却又停顿，最终合上双唇。

"是的。这...说得在理。"

o.en: Speaking of Andrada... I've got some good news for you.
o.zh: 说到 Andrada...我有个好消息要告诉你。

entries.en: "What about him?" She watches you carefully.
entries.zh: "他怎么了？" 她仔细端详着你。

o.en: I'm pretty sure he's braindead. Dolos Macario as much as admitted it to me.
o.zh: 我敢肯定他已经脑死亡了。Dolos Macario 几乎对我承认了这一点。

entries.en:
She frowns, considering your claim.

"Could be. We don't think there's been a legitimate holo-cast from him for at least a cycle."

She shifts the tilt of her head. "But this raises two questions. One, why should we believe anything that comes from that ghoul Macario's mouth? Two, and this is the more pressing question to me, why in the name of Old Earth are you having personal conversations with Dolos Macario, Andrada's chief torturer and spymaster?"
entries.zh:
她皱起眉头，一边思忖你的说法。

"有可能。我们认为他的合法全息影像不会暂停一个星历年那么久。"

她偏了偏头："但这引出两个问题。第一，我们凭什么相信从 Macario 那只食尸鬼嘴里说出的任何话？第二，这也是我更迫切的问题 —— 看在旧地球的份上，你究竟为何会与 Dolos Macario，那个 Andrada 的首席刑讯官兼间谍头子，进行私人对话？"

entries.en:
You barely get half the words out before Imoinu speaks forcefully over you.

"I don't care about Macario's lies! Answer my question. How are you talking to him?"
entries.zh:
你还没说出半个字就又 Imoinu 厉声打断了。

"我不在乎 Macario 的谎言！回答我的问题，你怎么会和他搭上话的？"

entries.en:
"If what you say is true about Andrada, then it's probably good news. Probably. But practically speaking it doesn't change the situation. Holos can be faked. It's the entire basis of the Diktat propaganda machine."

She shrugs. "Besides, the Sindrian Diktat lives on, run by Andrada's underlings. The worlds of Askonia are still held under the boot of the oppressor. The fight must go on."
entries.zh:
"如果你关于 Andrada 的消息属实，那大概是好消息，大概吧。但实际上这并未改变局势，全息影像也可以伪造，这是独裁者宣传机器的根本运作方式。"

她耸了耸肩，"况且，辛达强权 的独裁政权仍在延续，由 Andrada 的爪牙们掌控。Askonia 的星球仍在被压迫者的铁蹄所践踏，斗争必须继续。"

entries.en:
"And even if you weren't lying about Andrada, practically speaking it doesn't change the situation. Holos can be faked. It's the entire basis of the Diktat propaganda machine."

She shrugs. "The Sindrian Diktat lives on, run by Andrada's underlings in his name. The worlds of Askonia are still held under the boot of the oppressor. The fight must go on."
entries.zh:
"即便你没在 Andrada 的事上撒谎，实际情况也毫无改变。全息影像也可以伪造，这正是独裁政权宣传机器的立身之本。"

她耸了耸肩，"辛达强权 的独裁政权仍在延续，由 Andrada 的爪牙们以他的名义所掌控着。Askonia 的星球仍在被压迫者的铁蹄所践踏，斗争必须继续。"

o.en: I'd like to help your cause.
o.zh: 我想谈谈如何支援你们的事业。

entries.en:
"You're an invaluable help to the resistance," she says, "but there's not much more you can do for us on Umbra."

"If you can use any of your influence, your abilities, to fight for the uprising through other contacts, organizations..."

"As for me, I've got work to do. She looks grimly determined, despite her youth. "This war for liberation from the tyrrany of Andradas isn't going to fight itself."
entries.zh:
"你帮了抵抗组织天大的忙，\" 她说道，\"不过在 Umbra，你能替我们做的已经不多了。"

"要是你能拿自己的人脉、自己的本事，通过别的门路、别的组织，替起义再出一把力..."

"至于我，还有活要干。\" 她年纪虽轻，神情却决绝。\"这场挣脱 Andrada 家族暴政的解放战争，可不会自己打起来。"

entries.en:
"Yes!" She perks up. "We need all the help we can get! Fuel, supplies and no, not credits exactly..."

Imoinu looks at you, eyes hard.

"We're fighting against those tyrants in every polity they've stamped their boots over. We need weapons, heavy weapons. And fuel, and supplies."
entries.zh:
"太好了！\" 她一下来了精神。\"什么支援我们都缺！燃料、补给，还有，不，倒也不全是星币..."

Imoinu 盯着你，眼神硬了起来。

"那些暴君把一个个政体都踩在脚下，我们就是在跟他们打。我们要武器，重武器。还要燃料，要补给。"

entries.en: She doesn't look terribly impressed.
entries.zh: 她看起来并不太感兴趣。

entries.en: She nods.
entries.zh: 她点了点头。

entries.en:
"I haven't heard the name."

She leans forward, "Is he an organizer? An arms dealer? A mercenary, a terrorist?"
entries.zh:
"我没听过这个名字。"

她身体前倾，"他是组织者？军火商？佣兵，还是恐怖分子？"

o.en: I think he's maybe some kind of artist?
o.zh: 我觉得他可能是某种艺术家？

o.en: I'm not sure. I just visited a slum where he was probably squatting.
o.zh: 我不确定，我刚去过一个他可能曾暂居过的贫民区。

entries.en:
"Um."

Imoinu gives you a look of re-assessment, the sort that seems to ask if the subject has all of their reactor plating installed correctly, so to speak.

"Thanks," she manages. "I uh, I'll... look him up. If I need an artist."
entries.zh:
"呃。"

Imoinu 向你投来重新审视的目光，那是一种仿佛在确认对方的反应堆护板是否安装妥当的眼神，可以这么说。

"谢了，" 她勉强说道，"我，呃，会...查查他的资料。如果哪天需要艺术家的话。"

entries.en:
"Um." Imoinu gives you a look of re-assessment, the sort that asks, 'Is this person crazy?'

"Uh. Thanks. I'll... look him up if I need somewhere to stay on Westernesse."
entries.zh:
"呃。" Imoinu 向你投来重新审视的目光，那是一种仿佛在问 '这人是不是疯了？' 的眼神。

"呃。谢了。如果我哪天需要在 Westernesse 落脚的话...我会查查他的信息。"

entries.en:
"Is that the same Gargoyle who did the hack of the Prime Demarchon's All-League Holo Address in '02?"

She looks at you skeptically.

"There are a lot of so-called hackers out there claiming to be 'the' Gargoyle."
entries.zh:
"就是那个在 '02 黑了大统领的全联盟全息演说的 Gargoyle 吗？"

她怀疑地看着你。

"现在有太多自称是 '那个' Gargoyle 的半吊子黑客了。"

o.en: This one hacked a Hegemony Ministry for... it's a long story, actually.
o.zh: 这家伙黑进过 霸主 的部门，就为了...说来话长了，真的。

entries.en:
"Huh. Let's call it a 'maybe', then. Good enough for a try- if what you say is true."

She reaches over and taps at an interface.

"If you get this cryptokey to your Gargoyle, we can see if they're the real deal. And if they're willing to help."
entries.zh:
"嗯。那就先算是 '可能' 吧。值得一试 —— 如果你说的是真的。"

她伸手点击操作界面。

"如果你把这枚加密密钥交给你的 Gargoyle，就能验证他是否货真价实，以及是否愿意帮忙。"

o.en: Gargoyle can be difficult, but I think they'll be a valuable asset to your cause.
o.zh: Gargoyle 可能不好相处，但我觉得他会成为你们事业的宝贵资产。

o.en: You have no idea what you're in for.
o.zh: 你根本不知道自己会面临什么。

o.en: I can't wait to hear how you get along.
o.zh: 我已经迫不及待想听听你们的相处经历了。

entries.en:
"We'll see." She nods, then pauses.

"Thank you," she says awkwardly.
entries.zh:
"我们走着瞧吧。" 她点点头，随后顿了顿。

"谢了，" 她不自然地说道。

entries.en: She gives you a funny look.
entries.zh: 她向你投来一个古怪的眼神。

entries.en:
She gives you a funny look.

"Thanks?"
entries.zh:
她向你投来一个古怪的眼神。

"谢了？"

entries.en:
"No..." She shakes her head.

"On Kazeron, the gens are too dominant. The moment I stepped off the shuttle they'd have some doctor declare me insane and lock me up in an estate dome on the dark side of Draugr so I stop 'embarrassing our gens'."
entries.zh:
"不..." 她摇头道。

"在 Kazeron，氏族势力太过强大了。我一下穿梭机，他们就会让某个医生宣布我精神失常，把我关进 Draugr 暗面的庄园穹顶里，好让我停止 '给氏族蒙羞'。"

entries.en:
A long pause, then she speaks.

"I'll keep that in mind."
entries.zh:
沉默许久后，她说道。

"我会记在心里的。"

o.en: I know someone on Westernesse who might help you. Cavin Pharoh.
o.zh: 我认识 Westernesse 上的一个人，他或许能帮你。Cavin Pharoh。

o.en: If you need safe transport to an independent world, I can arrange it.
o.zh: 如果你需要前往独立世界的安保运输，我可以安排。

o.en: I did transport an old man and a kid to Volturn. I think they're part of your resistance...
o.zh: 我确实运送过一位老人和一个孩子去 Volturn。我觉得他们是你的抵抗组织的一员...

o.en: I did transport a kid and his robot to Volturn, I think they wanted to join your resistance...
o.zh: 我确实运送过一个孩子和他的机器人去 Volturn，我觉得他们是想加入你的抵抗组织...

o.en: Do you need armaments? Supplies? Credits?
o.zh: 你们需要军火吗？补给？还是星币？

o.en: That's all I can think of for now.
o.zh: 目前我只能想到这些了。

o.en: Then stay here and freeze! I can't solve all your problems for you.
o.zh: 那就留在这里喝西北风去吧！我没法替你解决所有问题。

entries.en:
"Whatever." She scowls. "I didn't even ask for your help!"

"And what have you ever done? Acted the hired killer for execs and admirals? Profited from the organs harvested from the desperate masses?"

"I don't need your lecture." She slams the cut-off.
entries.zh:
"随你便。" 她怒目而视，"我根本没求你帮忙！"

"你又做过什么？充当高管和将军的雇佣杀手？靠收割绝望大众的器官牟利？"

"我可不需要你的说教。" 她猛力切断了通讯。

entries.en:
"Yeah, maybe." She sounds entirely unenthusiastic.

"The Luddics get upset and preachy when you explain revolutionary consciousness to them. Don't get me wrong, they've got good people, but..."

She shakes her head. "I'd go crazy. Or they would."

"Don't get me wrong though, the ARC has a cell network on Volturn, of course. We're not as strong as the VSDC, but we're fighting too! The problem is supplies, funding..."
entries.zh:
"也许吧。" 她的语气毫无热情。

"你要是试图向卢德派解释真正的革命觉悟，他们要么会恼火，要么就开始说教。别误会，他们中有好人，但是..."

她摇摇头，"我会疯掉的。或者他们会疯掉。"

"不过别误会，Askonia 革命者委员会在 Volturn 也有网络。我们虽不如 Volturn 自卫盟约强大，但也在战斗！问题在于补给、资金..."

entries.en:
"An old man and a kid?" She looks confused, mostly at your implied expectation that she would know what you're talking about.

"I haven't heard anything about that. I couldn't say if they were important, or..."
entries.zh:
"一个老人和一个孩子？" 她看上去很困惑，主要是对你暗示她应该明白你在说什么的期待而感到不解。

"我没听说这事，也无法判断他们是否重要，或者..."

entries.en: "Look. I'm sure the local ARC cells will take them in if they have a contact."
entries.zh: "听着。如果他们有联络人，本地的 Askonia 革命者委员会分部肯定会收留他们的。"

entries.en: "A kid and a robot?" She makes a face. "I don't see how that's helpful."
entries.zh: "一个孩子和机器人？" 她做了个怪表情，"我看不出这有什么用。"

entries.en: "I mean." Realizing her dismissiveness, she attempts a more conciliatory tone. "I'm sure if this kid is dedicated to the cause, they'll figure out how to join the ARC."
entries.zh: "我是说。" 意识到自己的轻慢态度后，她试图转用更缓和的语气，"我相信如果这孩子真心投身于事业，那他总会找到加入 Askonia 革命者委员会的方法。"

entries.en:
After a short wait and a burst of static the makeshift comms network of Umbra finally relays you through.

"Death to Andrada," she says as a greeting. Her eyes narrow as she takes you in.

"Aren't you... you're $playerName!"

She doesn't sound pleased to see you.
entries.zh:
经过短暂的等待后，随着一阵静电杂音，Umbra 上临时的通讯网络终于接通。

"Andrada 必死，" 她以此作为问候语。看清你后，她眯起了眼睛。

"你不是...你是 $playerName！"

她的语气听起来并不乐意见到你。

o.en: Ah, so you've heard of me. Very good.
o.zh: 啊，看来你听说过我。很好。

o.en: Perhaps you've mistaken me for someone else. (lie)

entries.en: "No," she says deadpan. "Not good."
entries.zh: "不，" 她面无表情地说道，"一点都不好。"

entries.en: "No," she says deadpan. "I have not."
entries.zh: "不，" 她面无表情地说道，"我没认错。"

o.en: I'm just a merc. He was extremely assertive about giving me a job.
o.zh: 我只是个佣兵。他极其强硬地给了我一份差事

o.en: I'm on a personal mission to undermine the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 我在执行一项瓦解 辛达强权 的个人任务。

o.en: I'm on a personal mission to undermine the Sindrian Diktat. (lie)
o.zh: 我在执行一项瓦解 辛达强权 的个人任务。 (说谎)

o.en: I'm a secret Hegemony agent working to undermine the Diktat. (lie)
o.zh: 我是暗中瓦解辛达强权的 霸主 特工。 (说谎)

o.en: I'm in a deep-cover ARC cell you've never heard of working as a double agent. (lie)
o.zh: 我在一个你从未听闻的 Askonia 革命者委员会深度潜伏小组里担任双面特工。 (说谎)

o.en: I am of the Luddic faith and I'm taking them down from the inside. (lie)
o.zh: 我信仰卢德之道，并且正从内部瓦解他们。 (说谎)

o.en: I am of the Luddic faith and I'm taking them down from the inside.
o.zh: 我信仰卢德之道，并且正从内部瓦解他们。

o.en: I'm Persean League fleet intelligence. My real name is 'Siyavong'. (lie)
o.zh: 我是 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部探员，真名叫 'Siyavong'。 (说谎)

o.en: I think, given the circumstances, he was being relatively honest.
o.zh: 我认为在这种情况下，他已经算相对诚实了。

entries.en:
"A merc." Imoinu crosses her arms. "So you only believe in credits. Good for you."

"Did Macario hire you to spread his lies for him? Don't bother answering."
entries.zh:
"佣兵。" Imoinu 抱起双臂，"所以你只相信星币吧。祝你顺利。"

"是 Macario 雇你来替他散布谎言的吧？不用回答了。"

entries.en:
"And I suppose you're acting as a double agent to take them down from the inside, somehow."

She considers you, though from her face it is clear that her opinion of your methods and their chance of success is not high.

"Okay." She crosses her arms. "I don't think that changes anything."
entries.zh:
"所以你是以双面特工的身份从内部瓦解他们，是吧。"

她审视着你，但表情明显透露出对你的方法及其成功几率评价不高。

"好吧。" 她抱起双臂，"我认为这改变不了什么。"

entries.en:
"And I suppose you're acting as a double agent to take them down from the inside, somehow."

She considers you, though from her face it is clear that her opinion of your methods and their chance of success is not high.

"Okay." She crosses her arms. "I appreciate... the ARC and the United Front appreciate your contribution to the cause."
entries.zh:
"所以你是以双面特工的身份从内部瓦解他们，是吧。"

她审视着你，但表情明显透露出对你的方法及其成功几率评价不高。

"好吧。" 她抱起双臂，"我很感谢...Askonia 革命者委员会与联合阵线很感谢你为事业作出的贡献。"

entries.en: "Sure. Okay." She crosses her arms and gives you an incredulous look.
entries.zh: "行吧。好吧。" 她抱起双臂，向你投来难以置信的目光。

entries.en: "No you're not." Imoinu crosses her arms. "You're as much a liar as Macario."
entries.zh: "不，你可不是。" Imoinu 抱起双臂，"你和 Macario 一样都是骗子罢了。"

entries.en:
"No you're not." Imoinu crosses her arms. "You already used that line on us and it was a lie the first time."

"Did Macario hire you to spread his lies for him? Don't bother answering."
entries.zh:
"不，你可不是。" Imoinu 抱起双臂，"你之前已经对我们用过这套说辞了，而自第一次起就是谎言。"

"是 Macario 雇你来替他散布谎言的吧？不用回答了。"

entries.en:
"A Luddic, huh." She has an odd expression, a crease in her brow. Like there's some deep-seated disgust that she's trying to hide.

"Well. Blessings to you, I guess," she says awkwardly. "I don't know whether to believe you or not. You should probably connect with Standfast and the VSDC. Anyway..."
entries.zh:
"卢德信徒，呵。" 她神情古怪，眉头紧蹙，仿佛在压抑某种深藏的嫌恶。

"好吧。愿主赐福于你，大概吧，" 她不自然地应道，"我不知道该不该信你，或许你该联系 Standfast 和 Volturn 自卫盟约。总之..."

entries.en:
"Finlay Siyavong? Ha!"

You can hear the aristocrat in her laugh. It is bitter, and a potential for sharp cruelty hides there.

"I've met him, you fool. You're not Finlay Siyavong. You're a liar."
entries.zh:
"Finlay Siyavong？哈！"

她的笑声里透着贵族式的刻薄。那是一种苦涩的、可能隐含着尖锐与残忍的笑声。

"我见过他，你这蠢货。你不是 Finlay Siyavong，你就是个骗子。"

entries.en:
Imoinu holds up a hand.

"I understand that you're trying to help, but building a revolutionary movement is more than just collecting completely random people."

"Well," she reconsiders, "It's a part of it, I guess. But I don't need you for that. Well-"

She lets out an exasperated breath.
entries.zh:
Imoinu 抬起一只手。

"我明白你想帮忙，但建设革命运动不是随便收容各种来历不明的人就能成事的。"

"好吧，" 她重新斟酌道，"这部分也算必要吧。但我不需要你来处理这些。唉 ——"

她泄气地长叹一声。

entries.en:
"If you want to bring volunteers to the ARC and the United Front, that is helpful and I appreciate your contribution to the struggle. But you don't need to tell me about every stray you picked up on your way to Askonia."

"If you have credits, supplies, heavy weapons, or recruits... yes, we'll accept them gladly and with thanks. That's how you can help."
entries.zh:
"如果你想向 Askonia 革命者委员会和联合阵线输送志愿者，这确实有帮助，我感谢你为斗争事业作出的贡献。但不必事无巨细地汇报你前往 Askonia 途中收容的每个流浪者。"

"如果你有星币、补给、重武器或兵员...是的，我们将欣然接受并表示感谢。这才是你能够提供帮助的方式。"

entries.en:
She perks up. "Yes. Absolutely."
OR
"It would be much appreciated," she says.
entries.zh:
她眼睛一亮。"当然。绝对的。"
OR
"这真是帮了大忙了，" 她说道。

entries.en: "Agreed." She nods, allowing a smile to slip through her well-practiced expression of revolutionary stoicism. "I'll take your weapons."
entries.zh: "成交。\" 她点点头，那副练得炉火纯青的革命者坚毅神情里，漏出了一丝笑意。\"你的武器，我收下了。"

entries.en:
"When the time is right," she grins, "You'll be able to see the fireworks from Kazeron."

Imoinu clears her throat.

"I'd... be proud to call you my comrade, captain," she says. "Thank you."
entries.zh:
"等时机一到，\" 她咧嘴一笑，\"你在 Kazeron 都能望见那场烟火。"

Imoinu 清了清嗓子。

"我会... 很自豪能叫你一声同志，舰长，\" 她说道。\"谢谢你。"

o.en: You're welcome. I'll be watching for those fireworks.
o.zh: 不必客气。那场烟火，我会等着看的。

entries.en:
"You're going to be able to see the fireworks from Kazeron," she says with a grin.

Imoinu clears her throat.

"I'd... be proud to call you my comrade, captain," she says. "Thank you."
entries.zh:
"到那时你在 Kazeron 都能望见那场烟火，" 她咧嘴笑道。

Imoinu 清了清嗓子。

"我会... 很自豪能叫你一声同志，舰长，\" 她说道。\"谢谢你。"

o.en: You're welcome. I'll be watching for those fireworks.
o.zh: 不必客气。那场烟火，我会等着看的。
打倒 Andrada 一家，同志。

entries.en:
She nods.

"Until then."
entries.zh:
她点了点头。

"那就到时候见。"

entries.en:
She smiles.

"Death to Andradas!"
entries.zh:
她笑了。

"Andradas 一家都该死！"

entries.en:
She looks at you suspiciously.

"Why? Aren't you just another bloody-handed mercenary for a choose-your-flavor imperialist?"
entries.zh:
她满腹疑心地打量着你。

"为什么？你不又是个双手沾血、随便给哪路帝国主义者都能卖命的雇佣兵？"

o.en: The truth is Reynard Hannan wants to annoy your grandmother. So here I am.
o.zh: 实话说吧，是 Reynard Hannan 想恶心你祖母，所以我就来了。

entries.en:
She looks appalled. And amused.

"Incredible. Our 'betters' are so petty. The lengths they'll go to sabotage within their own class!"

Imoinu shrugs while rolling her eyes.

"Well if it means you're willing to arm the uprising, I'll take it."
entries.zh:
她一脸震惊，又忍不住觉得好笑。

"真是开了眼。我们那些'上等人'竟这么小气，为了在同阶级里互相拆台，什么手段都使得出来！"

Imoinu 翻着白眼耸了耸肩。

"行吧，只要这意味着你肯给起义送军火，我就收下。"

o.en: Maybe I am. But I want to destroy the Sindrian Diktat, too
o.zh: 也许是吧。不过我也想亲手毁了辛达强权。

entries.en:
"Well," she's still reserved. "I suppose it doesn't matter if the ideological basis for your motivation is unsound... weapons are weapons. And if you're willing to arm the uprising, I'll accept them."

"Just don't," an accusing finger appears, "think I'll sell out the revolution for lucre."
entries.zh:
"好吧，\" 她仍旧有所保留。\"你那些动机的思想根基站不站得住脚，我看也不打紧... 武器就是武器。只要你肯给起义送军火，我就收。"

"只是别，\" 一根手指头指了过来，\"以为我会为了几个钱把革命卖了。"

o.en: Perhaps, but I want to destroy Dolos Macario. Personally. For vengeance.
o.zh: 也许吧，可我想毁掉的是 Dolos Macario。亲手，为了报仇。

entries.en:
"Well," she's still reserved. "I suppose it doesn't matter if your motivations are a perverse sublimination of ownerist grievance psychology... weapons are weapons. And if you're willing to arm the uprising, I'll accept them."

"Just don't," an accusing finger appears, "think I'll sell out the revolution for lucre."
entries.zh:
"好吧，\" 她仍旧有所保留。\"就算你那点动机，不过是有产者怨愤心理的一番扭曲升华... 武器就是武器。只要你肯给起义送军火，我就收。"

"只是别，\" 一根手指头指了过来，\"以为我会为了几个钱把革命卖了。"

o.en: Yes. And Orcus Rao ordered this bloody-handed merc to help you.
o.zh: 没错。而且正是 Orcus Rao 吩咐我这个双手沾血的雇佣兵来帮你的。

entries.en:
She looks shocked by your words at first, but shock is quickly overcome by cynical amusement.

"I see. One of the aristocratic military caste employed by one faction of ownerist warmongers is seeking advantage over another."

"If it means you're going to arm the uprising," Imoinu says with a shrug, "I'll take it."
entries.zh:
她乍一听像是吃了一惊，可那点惊愕转眼就化成了带着嘲弄的玩味。

"我明白了。说到底，是一伙有产者好战势力雇来的军事贵族，想压过另一伙罢了。"

"只要这意味着你会给起义送军火，\" Imoinu 耸了耸肩，\"我就收下。"

entries.en:
"You've been an invaluable help to the resistance," she says, "but there's not much more you can do for us on Umbra."

"If you can use any of your influence, your abilities, to advance the cause through other contacts, organizations..."

"As for me, I've got work to do. She looks grimly determined, despite her youth. "The general uprising of the United Front isn't going to launch itself!"
entries.zh:
"你帮了抵抗组织天大的忙，\" 她说道，\"不过在 Umbra，你能替我们做的已经不多了。"

"要是你能拿自己的人脉、自己的本事，通过别的门路、别的组织，把事业往前推一推..."

"至于我，还有活要干。\" 她年纪虽轻，神情却决绝。\"联合阵线的总起义，可不会自己发动起来！"

entries.en: She nods.
entries.zh: 她点了点头。

entries.en: She pauses for a moment, self-conscious.
entries.zh: 她顿了顿，像是有些不自在。

entries.en: She nods.
entries.zh: 她点了点头。

entries.en: She pauses for a moment, self-conscious.
entries.zh: 她顿了顿，像是有些不自在。

entries.en:
She perks up. "Yes!"

"We need all the help we can get! Fuel, supplies and no, not credits exactly..."

Imoinu looks at you, her eyes hard.

"If we're going to launch an uprising against the tyrant from every polity he's put under his boot, we're going to need weapons. Heavy weapons."
entries.zh:
她一下来了精神。"太好了！"

"我们缺人手缺得紧，什么支援都要！燃料、补给，还有，不，倒也不全是星币..."

Imoinu 盯着你，眼神硬了起来。

"要把那个把一个个政体都踩在脚下的暴君掀翻，我们就得有武器。重武器。"

entries.en:
"Thank you $playerName," she says.

"Fuel will allow the ARC to bring in comrades from the rest of the Core Worlds, as well as smuggle weapons and supplies."

A feral smile grows, "And raid the fleets of the tyrant Andrada!"
entries.zh:
"谢谢你，$playerName，" 她说道。

"有了燃料，ARC 就能把核心世界其他地方的同志接过来，也能偷运武器和补给。"

她脸上泛起一股野性的笑意，"还能去劫暴君 Andrada 的舰队！"

entries.en:
"Thank you $playerName," she says.

"Fuel will allow the ARC to bring in comrades from the rest of the Core Worlds, as well as smuggle weapons and supplies."

A feral smile grows, "And raid the fleets of the Andrada tyrants!"
entries.zh:
"谢谢你，$playerName，" 她说道。

"有了燃料，ARC 就能把核心世界其他地方的同志接过来，也能偷运武器和补给。"

她脸上泛起一股野性的笑意，"还能去劫 Andrada 家那些暴君的舰队！"

entries.en:
"Thank you, $playerName," she says.

"I'll ensure these supplies get to ships carrying out ARC missions, and to the underground resistance fighters."
entries.zh: "感谢你，$playerName，" 她说道，"我会确保这些补给能送达执行 Askonia 革命者委员会任务的舰船。"

entries.en:
"I thank you for your offer, captain, but I'm still arranging distribution of your previous contribution. It takes about a month to get everything where it needs to go."

She pauses, hesitant. Then explains, the frustration clear in her expression.

"The problem is if we stockpile too much materiel... it starts to 'get lost'. We work with a large number of individuals who are not... as ideologically committed to the ARC, and to the uprising, as I'd prefer."
entries.zh:
"感谢你的提议，舰长，但我仍在分发你之前的支援物资。将所有物资送达所需地点需要大约一个月的时间。"

她顿了顿，略显犹豫。随后解释道，神情明显带着沮丧。

"问题在于如果我们囤积过多物资、星币、补给...它们就会开始 '丢失'。我们合作的大量人员并非...像我们期望那样，对 Askonia 革命者委员会、对起义事业抱有坚定的意识形态认同。"

entries.en:
"I thank you for your offer, captain, but I'm still arranging distribution of your previous contribution. It'll take about two days to get everything where it needs to go."

She pauses, hesitant. Then explains, the frustration clear in her expression.

"The problem is if we stockpile too much materiel... it starts to 'get lost'. We work with a large number of individuals who are not... as ideologically committed to the ARC, and to the uprising, as I'd prefer."
entries.zh:
"多谢你的好意，舰长，可你上回捐的那批东西我还没分发完。要把一切都送到该去的地方，还得两天左右。"

她迟疑着顿了顿，这才解释起来，一脸的懊恼明明白白写在脸上。

"麻烦在于，物资一旦囤得太多... 就开始'不翼而飞'了。跟我们打交道的那么些人，对 ARC、对起义的信念，可没我希望的那么... 坚定。"

entries.en:
"Thank you, $playerName. We've been desperate for heavy weapons from the start - these'll allow us to hit back.

A vicious smile grows, "And hard."
entries.zh: "感谢你，$playerName。我们的重武器一直短缺，这些足够我们搞些动静。" 她露出一股阴险的笑容，"大动静。"

entries.en:
His expression is indignant for a moment. Then he laughs.

"Fair enough, captain, fair enough."

He taps his chin twice, as if thinking.

"I'll give you 50,000 credits for Leonidas. Take it or leave it."
entries.zh:
他脸上有一瞬显出愤慨。随即笑了出来。

"有理，舰长，有理。"

他在下巴上敲了两下，像是在盘算。

"Leonidas 我给你 50,000 星币。成不成，一句话。"

o.en: I think a covert AI-powered brainwashing program is worth more. 100k.
o.zh: 我觉得一套由 AI 驱动的秘密洗脑程序值更多。十万。

entries.en:
"A terrible thought," he says, looking grave - for only a moment.

Then he laughs.

"I'll give you 50,000 credits for Leonidas. Take it or leave it."
entries.zh:
"真是个可怕的想法，" 他一脸严肃地说——只严肃了那么一瞬。

然后他笑了。

"Leonidas 我给你 50,000 星币。成不成，一句话。"

o.en: I think a covert AI-powered brainwashing program is worth more. 100k.
o.zh: 我觉得一套由 AI 驱动的秘密洗脑程序值更多。十万。

entries.en:
"Nonetheless, I consistently demonstrate a value-add to Director Glamor-Rotanev's section. So long as she is satisfied, I am satisfied to continue my work."

"And I'm damned good at it," he says, a bit of humanity slipping through his salesman's persona.
entries.zh:
"不过，我始终能为 Glamor-Rotanev 总监的部门创造增值。只要她满意，我就乐意继续干下去。"

"而且我干得真他妈漂亮，" 他说，推销员外壳底下漏出一点人味。

entries.en:
"Nonetheless, I consistently demonstrate a value-add to the Special Acquisitions section. So long as my direct superior is satisfied, I am satisfied to continue my work."

"And I'm damned good at it," he says, a bit of humanity slipping through his salesman's persona.
entries.zh:
“不过，我一直证明自己对特别征调部有附加值。只要我的直属上级满意，我就满意于继续干我的活。”

“而且我他妈干得还不赖，”他说，一点人情味从他推销员的面具下漏了出来。

entries.en:
He rubs his chin, making a show of thinking this over.

"I'll tell you this." He raises a confident finger. "I consistently demonstrate value-add to Director Glamor-Rotanev's section. So long as she is satisfied, I am satisfied to continue my work."

"And I'm damned good at it," he says, a bit of humanity slipping through.
entries.zh:
他搓了搓下巴，摆出一副认真盘算的样子。

"我跟你交个底。\" 他竖起一根自信的手指。\"我始终能为 Glamor-Rotanev 总监的部门创造增值。只要她满意，我就乐意继续干下去。"

"而且我干得真他妈漂亮，" 他说，那副推销员皮囊里透出几分人味。

entries.en:
He rubs his chin, making a show of thinking this over.

"I'll tell you this." He raises a confident finger. "I consistently demonstrate value-add to the Special Acquisitions section. So long as my direct superior is satisfied, I am satisfied to continue my work."

"And I'm damned good at it," he says, a bit of humanity slipping through.
entries.zh:
他摩挲着下巴，装模作样地想了想。

“我这么跟你说吧。”他自信地竖起一根手指。“我一直证明自己对特别征调部有附加值。只要我的直属上级满意，我就满意于继续干我的活。”

“而且我他妈干得还不赖，”他说，一点人情味漏了出来。

o.en: What exactly is it you do? For Tri-Tachyon, I mean.
o.zh: 你到底是做什么的？我是说，在速子科技里。

entries.en:
"What is it I do? First, let me state that I welcome your engagement with the skillset I bring to our collaboration," he says. "Such understanding is key to profitable utilization of human resources."

"I solve problems by developing solutions." A quick smile; he knows this means nothing.

"I anticipate operational inefficiencies and facilitate their aversion before negative contingencies harm the financial aims of the Tri-Tachyon corporation. My position requires the mindful application of creativity, initiative, and partnership-building."
entries.zh:
"我是做什么的？首先，我很欣慰你愿意了解我为这次合作带来的专业技能，\" 他说，\"这份理解，是高效利用人力资源的关键。"

"我用开发方案来解决问题。" 他飞快一笑，自己也知道这话等于没说。

"我预判运营中的低效环节，并在负面意外损及速子科技的财务目标之前促成规避。本职要求我有意识地运用创造力、主观能动性与伙伴关系建设。"

o.en: I still have no idea what you do.
o.zh: 我还是没听明白你到底干什么。

o.en: Are you... some kind of spy?

entries.en:
The comms snap into focus.

"Let's deal," Inesis says without hesitation. You get the unnerving impression that he was expecting you.
entries.zh:
通讯画面猛地清晰起来。

"谈生意吧，" Inesis 半点不含糊。你隐隐觉得他早就在等你，这感觉叫人发毛。

entries.en:
The comms snap open.

"Back so soon," Inesis says with a hint of a smile.
entries.zh:
通讯应声接通。

"这么快就回来了，" Inesis 嘴角带点笑。

entries.en:
"Yes..." His eyes twitch once, twice. "Leonidas."

"I'm not sure what I can tell you about that which you do not already know." He smiles, disarmingly. "Perhaps it is I who should be asked you about him."
entries.zh:
"看过...\"他的眼睛抽动了一下，又是一下。\"Leonidas。"

"我不确定关于这件事，我还能告诉你什么你不知道的。\"他笑了笑，那笑意很能卸人防备。\"也许该反过来说 —— 是我该向你打听他。"

o.en: Why didn't it work? The AI dream project. His body couldn't function.
o.zh: 为什么没成？那个 AI 梦境计划。他的身体撑不住。

entries.en:
"Why didn't it work?"

He smiles, putting a slightly puzzled look on his face.

"I'm not a neurocyberneticist, captain. And besides, I wasn't involved in any way."
entries.zh:
"为什么没成？"

他笑了笑，脸上摆出些许困惑的神情。

"我不是神经控制论专家，舰长。再说，这事我一点也没参与。"

o.en: But you knew about the arrangements. And you're highly modded yourself.
o.zh: 可那些安排你都知道。而且你自己身上装了那么多改造。

entries.en:
"Captain," his mechanical smile doesn't reach his eyes.

"That's very forward of you to say."
entries.zh:
"舰长，"他那副机械的笑没有到眼睛里。

"这话说得可真够冒失的。"

o.en: Don't be coy. I know you don't care.
o.zh: 别装。我知道你根本不在乎。

o.en: I apologize. Let us speak of other things...

entries.en:
"You can be quite insistent, can't you, when you really want to."

The smile is frozen on his face.

"Nonetheless, the Tri-Tachyon Corporation has no comment to your inquiry. Let's not waste any more time on it."
entries.zh:
"真想要什么的时候，你还真是死缠不放，是不是。"

那笑容僵在他脸上。

"尽管如此，速子科技公司对你的询问无可奉告。别再在这事上耗时间了。"

entries.en:
Something seems to give in his expression.

Maybe it's your Tri-Tachyon commission. He can trust you. Or perhaps it's that you're both implicitly implicated by your involvement in what, depending on one's perspective, could be called a crime.
entries.zh:
他脸上的什么东西似乎松了下来。

也许是因为你挂着速子科技的委任状。他可以信你。又或者，是因为你们两人都牵涉其中 —— 那件事换个角度看，完全可以叫犯罪。

entries.en:
The smile adjusts, rings true. It's not a smile of friendliness, but the joy of the hunt.

"You can be quite insistent, can't you, when you want to be, $PlayerName."

He leans back, looking ever so slightly more natural than usual, dropping the artificially pleasant demeanor.
entries.zh:
笑意微微收敛，变得真切起来。那不是友善的笑，而是猎物入手的快意。

"$PlayerName，你一旦较真起来，还真是寸步不让。"

他向后靠去，卸下那副刻意堆出来的和善神情，看起来比平时自然了许多。

entries.en:
Something seems to give in his expression.

Maybe he likes you. Just a little.
entries.zh:
他脸上的什么东西似乎松了下来。

也许他有点喜欢你。就那么一点。

entries.en:
"From what I know - which is far from comprehensive - it should have worked."

He speaks plainly, without the saccharine customer-facing affability.

"We've had great success with behavioral influence by means of simulated memories as well as cybernetic integration of induced cortex-motor function integration. There are centuries of studies; it's quite a mature field - and one in which Tri-Tachyon has always led, even before the Collapse."

"So, what could have possibly gone wrong?"
entries.zh:
"据我所知——当然远远谈不上全面——这套东西本该是成功的。"

他说话的口气很平实，没了面对客户时那种甜腻的殷勤。

"用模拟记忆施加行为影响，以及通过义体植入整合诱导性皮层-运动功能，我们都取得过极大成功。相关研究积累了几个世纪，是个相当成熟的领域——而在这一领域，速子科技一直遥遥领先，甚至在大崩塌之前就是如此。"

"那么，到底是哪里出了差错？"

entries.en:
He shrugs.

"I don't know. NCSG is a top of the line aug studio. What element was different here?"
entries.zh:
他耸了耸肩。

"我不知道。NCSG 是顶尖的强化改造工坊。这次有什么环节不一样？"

o.en: The AIs. Could they have sabotaged Leonidas?
o.zh: 那些 AI。会不会是它们对 Leonidas 动了手脚？

o.en: Dolos Macario. Could he have sabotaged Leonidas?
o.zh: Dolos Macario。会不会是他对 Leonidas 动了手脚？

entries.en:
His eyes twitch.

"It's possible. If they did, they would have rewritten the evidence - telemetry, logs, anything they could get their... minds on."
entries.zh:
他的眼角抽动了一下。

"有可能。真是它们干的，它们就会把证据改写干净——遥测数据、日志，凡是它们的... 心智碰得到的东西。"

entries.en:
He smiles.

"It's possible. If he did, you do not appear to have found any evidence."
entries.zh:
他笑了笑。

"有可能。若真是他干的，看来你并没有找到任何证据。"

entries.en:
"Many things are possible. I would be remiss if I did not observe that Philip Andrada made a great number of enemies during the colorful events of his career."

His look becomes distant.

"Among those enemies are the most powerful factions in the Persean Sector - and their wealthiest, oldest, most senior members. With access to technologies that, as a rule, they forbid to others. He also made enemies of both the least and the greatest of what was once a great center of finance and innovation: Opis. To say nothing of the rest of Askonia. The Askonian has nothing to lose because Andrada already took everything from them, didn't he. And the Luddics, or anyone who knew someone sent to Cruor... you see my point."

He refreshes his smile.
entries.zh:
"可能的事很多。要是不提一句 Philip Andrada 在其生涯那些精彩事件里结下的众多敌人，那就是我的失职了。"

他的目光飘远了些。

"这些敌人当中，有英仙座星域最强大的几方势力——以及它们最富有、最古老、最资深的人物，这些人掌握着通常绝不许旁人染指的技术。他也同时得罪过 Opis 这座昔日金融与创新重镇里最卑微与最显赫的两端。更不必说 Askonia 的其余部分。Askonia 人早已一无所有，因为 Andrada 早把他们的东西全拿走了，不是吗。还有卢德信徒，或是任何有熟人被送去 Cruor 的人... 你该明白我的意思。"

他又把笑容重新挂回脸上。

o.en: This has not narrowed down the possibilities. Much.
o.zh: 这并没有把可能性缩小多少。真没多少。

entries.en: "No," he agrees, re-asserting his customer-pleasing countenance.
entries.zh: "没有，" 他赞同道，重新摆出那副讨客户欢心的面孔。

o.en: Let's talk about Leonidas Andrada. You reviewed the files, right?
o.zh: 我们谈谈 Leonidas Andrada。那些文件你看过了，对吧？

entries.en:
"Do I 'need' anything? No one is sabotaging AIs, of course."

He looks at you meaningfully.
entries.zh:
"我有什么'需要的'吗？当然没有人会去破坏 AI。"

他意味深长地看了你一眼。

o.en: I've brought you Leonidas Andrada. He's in cryosleep.
o.zh: 我把 Leonidas Andrada 带来了。他在低温休眠舱里。

o.en: I want to talk about Leonidas Andrada.

entries.en:
He closes his eyes. "The situation is not..."

He opens his eyes, and reforms his expression.

"I'm afraid I can't help you in this matter. The Company has no comment upon this individual or their alleged identity."
entries.zh:
他闭上眼。"情况并不是..."

他睁开眼，重新收拾好了表情。

"这件事恐怕我帮不了你。公司对此人，以及他所谓的身份，都没有任何评论。"

o.en: But it's your mess - and I'm helping you clean it up to avoid a scandal.
o.zh: 可这是你们的烂摊子——我是在帮你收拾，免得闹出丑闻。
那么，你是拒绝我这份礼物了。

o.en: What if I sell Leonidas to Orcus Rao? Would that be preferable?
o.zh: 如果我把 Leonidas 卖给 Orcus Rao 呢？那样是不是更合你意？

entries.en:
* * *

The arrangements are made.

An anonymous shuttle carries an unmarked cryosleep-unit to Achaman Station. The telemetry from the subtle tracking device you had installed on the unit cuts off not long after the agents of Faro Inesis take possession. They're used to covertly moving unmarked goods without asking questions.

Leonidas has a chance, at least. If Inesis' word is as good as his greed.
entries.zh:
* * *

安排妥当。

一艘匿名穿梭机把一具没有标识的低温休眠舱运往 Achaman Station。Faro Inesis 的手下接手这具休眠舱后不久，你安装在舱上的那枚隐蔽追踪器便断了遥测。这些人惯于悄悄地搬运无标识货物，从不问一句多余的话。

至少 Leonidas 还有一线机会——只要 Inesis 守信的成色比得上他贪财的成色。

entries.en:
He raises an eyebrow.

"I'm interested in your credits, but I'm not sure what you're asking for. You'll have to explain- what is it you mean by doing 'the right thing'?"
entries.zh:
他挑起一侧眉毛。

"你的星币我很感兴趣，可我不太确定你在要求什么。你得解释一下——所谓'做该做的事'，具体指什么？"

o.en: Provide Leonidas the treatment he needs to sucessfully live in the real world.
o.zh: 给 Leonidas 提供他需要的治疗，让他能真正在现实世界里生活下去。

o.en: Never mind, I'm not sure this is a good idea.
o.zh: 算了，我不确定这是个好主意。

entries.en:
Inesis sighs, closes his eyes, and you can almost see the calculations flash across his eyelids.

His eyes snap open.

"I could, personally, make certain arrangements with a top-line cybernetics-medical consultant for 100,000 credits, no less. Including discretion. And although I see no purpose for such a sentimental waste, if this is how you desire to spend your hard-earned wealth, I would be a poorer man not to take the opportunity."

He smiles, helpfully.
entries.zh:
Inesis 叹了口气，闭上眼睛，你几乎能看见一串数字在他眼皮底下飞闪而过。

他猛地睁开眼。

"我本人可以出面，找一位顶尖的义体医疗顾问做些安排，价钱不少于 100,000 星币，含保密费。虽说我看不出这种多愁善感的挥霍有什么意义，但既然你就想这么花掉辛苦挣来的钱，我不趁机做这笔生意，那才是亏了。"

他露出一个乐于助人的笑容。

o.en: The price is a bit much. Perhaps another time.
o.zh: 这价钱有点高了。改天再说吧。

o.en: Never mind, I'm not sure this is a good idea.
o.zh: 算了，我不确定这是个好主意。

entries.en: "Perhaps," he says, smile unwavering.
entries.zh: "也许吧，" 他说，笑容纹丝不动。

entries.en:
"I am not in the business of 'gifts', captain," he says. "I am in the business of deals. When you want to make a deal, come to me."

An automatic smile.

"Until then? Both Tri-Tachyon and I hope you have a very profitable day."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"我做的是生意，不收'礼物'，舰长，\" 他说，\"我做的是交易。你想谈交易的时候，再来找我。"

一个自动浮现的笑容。

"在那之前？速子科技和我都祝你这一天财源广进。"

通讯中断。

entries.en: "I'm not sure I understand."
entries.zh: "我不太明白你的意思。"

entries.en:
"Our mess?" Inesis looks aside. "What scandal?"

"I've seen nothing on TriNews besmirching the good name of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. Nor, I think, will you find any direct connection of your cryo-sleeper to the Tri-Tachyon brand."

A hint of his smile returns.

"-Aside from standard hardware and software products available to anyone with credits, of course."
entries.zh:
"我们的烂摊子？\" Inesis 把目光移向一旁，\"什么丑闻？"

"我在 TriNews 上没见过任何抹黑速子科技公司名声的东西。而且我想，你也找不出你那具低温休眠舱与速子科技这块招牌之间有任何直接关联。"

他的笑意又隐约回来了。

"——当然，只要出得起星币，谁都能买到的标准硬件与软件产品除外。"

entries.en:
A strange expression crosses his face.

"You brought me... why?"
entries.zh:
一丝古怪的神情掠过他脸上。

"你把他带来给我... 为什么？"

o.en: For credits. Wouldn't he be a useful political pawn?
o.zh: 为了星币。他难道不是一枚好用的政治棋子吗？

o.en: For our partnership. The clone is a gift, a token you can use for advantage.
o.zh: 为了我们的合作。这个克隆体是份礼物，一件你能拿来换取利益的信物。

o.en: Tri-Tachyon is behind his condition somehow, right? You must know how to help him.
o.zh: 他的状况多少跟速子科技有关，对吧？你一定知道该怎么救他。

entries.en:
"Again." His pleasant, customer-facing smile drops.

"Captain, please. Why?"
entries.zh:
"又来了。" 他那副讨客户欢心的和善笑容垮了下来。

"舰长，拜托。为什么？"

o.en: For credits. Wouldn't he be a useful political pawn?
o.zh: 为了星币。他难道不是一枚好用的政治棋子吗？

o.en: For our partnership. The clone is a gift, a token you can use for advantage.
o.zh: 为了我们的合作。这个克隆体是份礼物，一件你能拿来换取利益的信物。

o.en: Tri-Tachyon is behind his condition somehow, right? You must know how to help him.
o.zh: 他的状况多少跟速子科技有关，对吧？你一定知道该怎么救他。

entries.en:
His pleasant smile fades somewhat. "I hope we won't be throwing around any more inconsiderate words, captain.

"I simply don't see why you persist in this line of dealing."
entries.zh:
他脸上的和善笑容淡了几分。"我希望我们不必再甩出些不知轻重的话了，舰长。"

"我只是不明白，你为何非要在这件事上纠缠下去。"

o.en: For credits. Wouldn't he be a useful political pawn?
o.zh: 为了星币。他难道不是一枚好用的政治棋子吗？

o.en: For our partnership. The clone is a gift, a token you can use for advantage.
o.zh: 为了我们的合作。这个克隆体是份礼物，一件你能拿来换取利益的信物。

o.en: Tri-Tachyon is behind his condition somehow, right? You must know how to help him.
o.zh: 他的状况多少跟速子科技有关，对吧？你一定知道该怎么救他。

entries.en: This is odd. Inesis is usually so cheerful when discussing business.
entries.zh: 这不太对劲。Inesis 谈起生意来，向来都是眉飞色舞的。

entries.en: "Help..." Inesis looks at you, confused. "Why would we do that?"
entries.zh: "帮...\" Inesis 困惑地看着你，\"我们为什么要那么做？"

o.en: It's the right thing to do?
It's your mess and I'm helping clean it up.
o.zh: 这是你们的烂摊子，我是在帮忙收拾。

o.en: I'll pay you 50,000 credits if that's what it takes to do the right thing.
o.zh: 如果做该做的事就得花钱，那我付你 50,000 星币。

o.en: You know what? Never mind. You don't understand.
o.zh: 算了。就当我没说。你不明白。

o.en: What if I brought Leonidas to Orcus Rao? Would that be preferable?
o.zh: 如果我把 Leonidas 交给 Orcus Rao 呢？那样是不是更合你意？

entries.en: Inesis gives you a consternated look. It's odd on his face.
entries.zh: Inesis 一脸窘迫地看着你。这表情出现在他脸上格外别扭。

entries.en:
"I," he emphasizes the word, "am making no investigation of any kind, captain."

He closes his eyes.

"I'm afraid I can't help you in this matter. The Company has no comment upon this individual or their alleged identity."
entries.zh:
"我，\" 他把这个字咬得很重，\"没有在进行任何形式的调查，舰长。"

他闭上了眼睛。

"这件事恐怕我帮不了你。公司对此人，以及他所谓的身份，都没有任何评论。"

o.en: I'm trying to help Tri-Tachyon fix its mess to avoid a scandal. That's worth something.
o.zh: 我是在帮速子科技收拾烂摊子，免得闹出丑闻。这总该值点东西。

o.en: I'm helping you. You can use Leonidas against whoever screwed up.
o.zh: 我是在帮你。你可以拿 Leonidas 去对付把事情搞砸的人。

o.en: I'm trying to help stop whoever is sabotaging AI cores! You need this.
o.zh: 我是想帮你揪出那个破坏 AI 核心的家伙！你需要这个。

entries.en:
"I'm sure they'd enjoy that. Very self-sacrificing and pious, the sort of thing Luddics claim to relish."

He waves dismissively.

"You'd be doing them a favor. Please! Go on."
entries.zh:
"我相信他们会很乐意。多么自我牺牲、多么虔诚，正是卢德信徒声称最钟爱的那一套。"

他不以为然地摆了摆手。

"你这是在帮他们的忙。请吧！尽管去。"

entries.en:
"That's good, captain! Very good," he says, smile growing. "Now we're negotiating."

He taps his chin twice, as if thinking.

"I'll give you 50,000 credits for Leonidas. Take it or leave it."
entries.zh:
"这就对了，舰长！非常好，\" 他说，笑容越来越大，\"现在这才叫谈判。"

他在下巴上敲了两下，像是在盘算。

"Leonidas 我给你 50,000 星币。成不成，一句话。"

entries.en:
* * *

The arrangements are made.

An anonymous shuttle carries an unmarked cryosleep-unit to Achaman Station. The telemetry from the subtle tracking device you had installed on the unit cuts off not long after the agents of Faro Inesis take possession. They're used to covertly moving unmarked goods without asking questions.

It's no longer your problem and you're 50,000 credits richer. As for Leonidas? You don't have to think about him at all ever again.
entries.zh:
* * *

安排妥当。

一艘匿名穿梭机把一具没有标识的低温休眠舱运往 Achaman Station。Faro Inesis 的手下接手这具休眠舱后不久，你安装在舱上的那枚隐蔽追踪器便断了遥测。这些人惯于悄悄地搬运无标识货物，从不问一句多余的话。

这不再是你的事了，你还多了 50,000 星币。至于 Leonidas？你再也不必想起他了。

entries.en:
"Maybe," he says. Then looks directly at you.

"But maybe the question he's an answer to has far more viable contenders, with far more influential backers."

"But I merely speculate. Who could say? It's a risk, which is why I lower my bid accordingly. 50,000 credits, then?"

He puts on his smile for you.
entries.zh:
"也许吧，" 他说，然后直视着你。

"但他所对应的那个问题，也许还有远比他更合适的候选人，背后的靠山也远比他有势力。"

"不过我也只是猜测。谁说得准呢？这是个风险，我自然要把价码压低。那就 50,000 星币？"

他为你挂上了笑容。

o.en: I think one of the few remaining heirs to the Supreme Executor is worth more than 50k.
o.zh: 我觉得最高元首为数不多的继承人之一，可不止值五万。

o.en: And will you help Leonidas? Or will you keep him on ice or dump him in space?
o.zh: 那你会帮 Leonidas 吗？还是把他冻在舱里，或者干脆丢进太空？

entries.en:
"Dump him in... captain!" Inesis is taken aback. "I'm no monster."

"I'd keep him on ice, of course. The expense is not so great, and if nothing else comes of it, I'm sure a collector would be interested... I seem to recall one of the Yaribays was putting out feelers."

"Ah," he holds up a finger and smiles, as if at your cleverness. "But I should say no more about my potential buyers."
entries.zh:
"丢进太空... 舰长！\" Inesis 被噎了一下，\"我可不是什么怪物。"

"当然是把他冻在舱里。这笔开销也不大，而且就算别无所获，我相信总有收藏家会感兴趣... 我好像记得 Yaribay 家的某一位正在四处试探风声。"

"啊，\" 他竖起一根手指笑了笑，像是在赞许你的机敏，\"不过关于我潜在的买家，我还是少说为妙。"

o.en: You'd sell him to a collector? You ARE a monster!
o.zh: 你要把他卖给收藏家？你就是个怪物！

entries.en:
"That's a very unkind thing to say, captain. I'm sorry this conversation has become such an emotional tax for you- I suggest we leave it here, and perhaps you'll be more considerate when next we meet."

He puts on a saintly look. "I'll hold no hard feelings over some ill-considered words. Good day, captain."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"这话说得可真不留情面，舰长。很抱歉这场谈话让你付出了这么重的情绪代价——我建议就到这里，下次见面时，希望你能多些体谅。"

他摆出一副圣徒般的表情。"几句没过脑子的话，我不会记在心上。再会，舰长。"

通讯中断。

entries.en:
"Maybe," he says. Then looks directly at you.

"But it is, as you say, covert. Reputation is a funny thing in the shadows, and what do we have but your speculation and mine?"

"There are many, many unknowns. So it's a risk, which is why I lower my bid accordingly. 50,000 credits, then?"

He puts on his smile for you.
entries.zh:
"也许吧，" 他说，然后直视着你。

"但正如你所说，这事是秘密进行的。名声在暗处是个很微妙的东西，而我们手上除了你我的猜测，还有什么呢？"

"未知数太多太多。所以这是个风险，我自然要把价码压低。那就 50,000 星币？"

他为你挂上了笑容。

entries.en: "Captain." He gives you a look. "What makes you think I want to use anything against anyone?"
entries.zh: "舰长。\" 他瞥了你一眼，\"你凭什么觉得，我想拿什么东西去对付什么人？"

o.en: You work for Zunya Glamor-Rotanev, of course you'll use anything against anyone.
o.zh: 你替 Zunya Glamor-Rotanev 办事，当然会拿任何东西去对付任何人。

o.en: Then help someone out. There are cynical people out there who would exploit any weakness or mistake.
o.zh: 那就帮人一把。外面多的是刻薄之徒，任何弱点或差错都会被他们拿来利用。

entries.en:
He closes his eyes. "No, I don't think it is."

Now he looks at you patiently. "Where there's demand, there's a market. Tri-Tachyon cannot take responsibility for what buyers freely choose to do with our products."
entries.zh:
他闭上眼。"不，我不认为这是我们的错。"

然后他耐心地看着你。"有需求，就有市场。买家拿我们的产品去做什么，那是他们自由的选择，速子科技负不起这个责任。"

entries.en: "The Tri-Tachyon corporation doesn't see it that way, captain," he says blandly.
entries.zh: "速子科技公司不这么看，舰长，" 他语气平淡地说。

entries.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

Inesis watches you with a customer-pleasing half smile. Waiting for you to respond, apparently.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerName 舰长。"

Inesis 挂着那种讨客户欢心的半笑看着你，看样子是在等你接话。

entries.en:
"We could work together, you and I. I could provide you with opportunities appropriate to your core competencies. I would pay well."

His smile creaks upward a step.

"I believe you will find that I will be able to open certain doors for you, in the future. If certain investments... mature."

He blinks, once. "Consider it. That is all."
entries.zh:
"你我可以合作。我能提供与你核心竞争力相匹配的机会，报酬优厚。"

他的笑又往上提了一格。

"我相信你终会发现，我有能力替你打开某些门——只要某些投资...到了期。"

他眨了一下眼。"考虑一下吧。就这些。"

entries.en: "I've been thinking," he says.
entries.zh: "我近来一直在想，" 他说。

entries.en: "I've been thinking," he says.
entries.zh: "我近来一直在想，" 他说。

entries.en:
The smile strains the exact same percent as the prime rate of the Investment Bank of Eochu Bres (IBEB). If you had to guess.

"I've been thinking," he says. "And you should consider my thought before you say 'no'."
entries.zh:
他笑得有些吃力，吃力的百分比恰好跟 Eochu Bres 投资银行(IBEB)的基准利率分毫不差——若非要猜个准数的话。

"我近来一直在想，\" 他说，\"你不妨先听听我想了什么，再说'不'也不迟。"

entries.en:
"A fascinating argument, captain. It has been said that Hector is a bit young. Sheltered. Inexperienced. Reckless. Unstable. Sociopathic."

"Reports are reports. It is possible that they underestimate his potential." He shrugs, smiling pleasantly. "I can only imagine what would be said of you."

"In any event, tacit support of the legitimate successor aligns with Tri-Tachyon policy, so it appears we are in alignment."
entries.zh:
"很有说服力的论证，舰长。据说 Hector 有点年轻。养在温室里。缺乏经验。鲁莽。不稳定。反社会。"

"报告终归是报告。也许他们低估了他的潜力。\"他耸耸肩，笑得和善。\"我倒很想知道，别人会怎么议论你。"

"无论如何，默许支持合法继承人都符合速子科技的方针，看来我们是一致的。"

o.en: Good. I'm glad to hear we are agreed.
o.zh: 很好。很高兴我们达成了一致。

o.en: Let's discuss some other possibilities first...
o.zh: 我们先谈谈别的可能性...

entries.en:
"With your cooperation, I can make certain extraordinary arrangements. Sharing intel, weapons technology... I hope your good opinion of Hector proves correct."

"For your sake," he continues brightly, "I hope his reputation - yes, already - is much exaggerated. At the risk of being presumptuous, I would suggest bringing news of our arrangement to Hector yourself."

"Making a good impression is paramount, in business and... other fields of human endeavor."
entries.zh:
"有你的配合，我可以做出一些非同寻常的安排。共享情报、武器技术...我希望你对 Hector 的好评最终被证实。"

"为了你自己好，\"他语气轻快地继续说，\"我希望他的名声——对，现在就已经有了——被大大夸大了。恕我冒昧，我建议由你亲自把这个安排的消息带给 Hector。"

"留下好印象至关重要，在生意场上如此...在人类努力的其他领域也是如此。"

entries.en:
"There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble fleet with a clever commander," he nods generously toward you, "could sneak in, hack the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindrian Diktat military network. It all runs on our software, there's nothing to worry about."

He winks. Your TriPad pings.
entries.zh:
"Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支机动灵活的舰队，配上一位聪明的指挥官，\"他大方地朝你点了点头，\"可以悄悄潜入，黑进中继站，与辛达强权军方的网络直接建立通讯链路。那套系统全跑在我们的软件上，不必担心。"

他眨了眨眼。你的 TriPad 响了一声。

o.en: But how do I contact Hector if I am shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat navy?
o.zh: 可我是辛达强权海军格杀勿论的对象，怎么联系 Hector？

entries.en:
"A bold proposal," he says. "It has been argued that Macario - despite a propensity for creating public relations incidents bordering on habitual - is a stabilizing force. In relative terms, of course."

"Hector, meanwhile, is thought to be a bit young. Reckless. Unstable. Sociopathic."

He raises his eyebrows. "What do you think?"
entries.zh:
"大胆的提议，\"他说。\"有人认为，Macario——尽管他制造公关事件的癖好几乎已成习惯——是一股稳定力量。当然，是相对而言。"

"至于 Hector，人们觉得他太年轻。鲁莽。不稳定。反社会。"

他挑了挑眉。"你怎么看？"

o.zh: 除了'年轻'，你说的就是 Macario。
他会渐渐担得起这份权柄。

entries.en: Inesis laughs obligingly.
entries.zh: Inesis 配合地笑了几声。

entries.en: Inesis nods.
entries.zh: Inesis 点了点头。

entries.en: Inesis nods obligingly.
entries.zh: Inesis 配合地点点头。

entries.en:
"I must admit that I share something of your sentiment concerning Mr. Macario. While his ministry is an excellent customer of certain Tri-Tachyon data gathering and processing services, our strategic predictors estimate that his leadership shows a negative impact on market confidence... even outside of Askonia."

With these last words, Inesis shakes his head with mild disappointment.
entries.zh:
"我得承认，在 Macario 先生这件事上，我与你有几分同感。他的部门是速子科技某些数据采集与处理服务的优质客户，但我们的战略预测器估计，他的领导对市场信心有负面影响...甚至在 Askonia 之外也是如此。"

说到最后，Inesis 带着几分失望摇了摇头。

o.en: Then we agree that he should be removed.
o.zh: 那么我们都同意，他该被除掉。

o.en: Let's discuss some other possibilities first...
o.zh: 我们先谈谈别的可能性...

entries.en:
"It cannot be denied that there is an opportunity to introduce a new, more profitable, dynamism to the Askonian market."

He carefully places his hands together.

"But we must focus limited capacities, captain. Which is more important- removing Macario or supporting Hector?"
entries.zh:
"不可否认，确实存在一个机会，能为 Askonia 市场注入一股新的、更有利可图的活力。"

他小心地把双手合在一起。

"但我们必须集中有限的力量，舰长。哪一件更重要——除掉 Macario，还是支持 Hector？"

o.en: Let's discuss some other possibilities first...
o.zh: 我们先谈谈别的可能性...

entries.en:
"A bold proposal," he says. "It has been argued that Macario - despite a habitual propensity for creating public relations incidents - is a stabilizing force. In relative terms, of course."

"Hector, meanwhile, is thought to be a bit young. Reckless. Unstable. Sociopathic"

He raises his eyebrows. "What do you think?"
entries.zh:
"大胆的提议，\"他说。\"有人认为，Macario——尽管他制造公关事件的癖好已成习惯——是一股稳定力量。当然，是相对而言。"

"至于 Hector，人们觉得他太年轻。鲁莽。不稳定。反社会。"

他挑了挑眉。"你怎么看？"

o.en: Hector is the blood of Andrada. His fitness is without question.
o.zh: Hector 身上流着 Andrada 的血。他的资格无可置疑。
除了'年轻'，你说的就是 Macario。
他会渐渐担得起这份权柄。

entries.en:
Inesis raises an eyebrow. "It has been said that Hector is a bit young. Sheltered. Inexperienced. Reckless. Unstable. Sociopathic."

"Reports are reports. It is possible they underestimate his potential." He shrugs, smiling pleasantly. "I can only imagine what would be said of you."

"In any event, tacit support of the legitimate successor aligns with Tri-Tachyon policy, so it appears we are in alignment."
entries.zh:
Inesis 挑起一边眉毛。"据说 Hector 有点年轻。养在温室里。缺乏经验。鲁莽。不稳定。反社会。"

"报告终归是报告。也许他们低估了他的潜力。\"他耸耸肩，笑得和善。\"我倒很想知道，别人会怎么议论你。"

"无论如何，默许支持合法继承人都符合速子科技的方针，看来我们是一致的。"

o.en: Good. I'm glad to hear we are agreed.
o.zh: 很好。很高兴我们达成了一致。

o.en: Let's discuss some other possibilities first...
o.zh: 我们先谈谈别的可能性...

entries.en:
"Interesting," he says, half-smile undisturbed.

"I admit that I share something of your sentiment. While his ministry is an excellent customer of Tri-Tachyon data products, our strategic predictors estimate that his leadership produces a negative effect on consumer confidence - even outside of the Askonian market volume!"

Inesis shakes his head with mild disappointment.
entries.zh:
"有意思，"他说，半笑不减。

"我承认，我与你有几分同感。他的部门是速子科技数据产品的优质客户，但我们的战略预测器估计，他的领导对消费者信心有负面影响——甚至在 Askonia 市场容量之外也是如此！"

Inesis 带着几分失望摇了摇头。

entries.en:
"Certain divisions of Tri-Tachyon are enthusiastic about marketizing the iterative improvements derived from Macario's... applications. But I think you and I share alignment on this matter."

He smiles for you.

"If we proceed, it would be prudent to form a parallel initiative, a low-visibility shell operation so I could arrange certain matters personally. I'd require a pool of working capital separated from the usual accounts, of course..."
entries.zh:
"速子科技的某些部门热衷于把 Macario 那些...应用所带来的迭代改进推向市场。但我想，在这件事上你我立场一致。"

他朝你笑了一下。

"若要推进，稳妥的做法是另立一项并行计划，以低可见度的空壳形式运作，这样我就能亲自安排某些事务。当然，我需要一笔与常规账户分开的周转资金..."

o.en: You're asking for a bribe to covertly remove Macario?
o.zh: 你是在索贿，好暗中除掉 Macario？

o.en: Sounds complex. Maybe there's another approach...
o.zh: 听着太复杂了。也许还有别的路子...

entries.en:
"When the conflict begins openly - projections say it will, soon - the situation will become far more dynamic. Macario will commit his resources to removing internal and external opposition."

His half-smile is unchanged.

"We can begin with is making that job more difficult for him - and more expensive, more frustrating."

He closes his eyes for a moment, then opens them. Is that an entrepreneurial gleam? It could be. Or it could be a retina-cast vision overlay aug.
entries.zh:
"等冲突公开爆发——预测说很快了——局面会变得流动得多。Macario 会把资源投去清除内外的反对者。"

他的半笑没有变化。

"我们可以先让他这活儿更难办——更费钱、更叫他窝火。"

他闭眼片刻，又睁开。那是企业家式的精光吗？也许是。也可能只是视网膜投射式的视觉叠加植入体。

entries.en:
"A software attack. Through the hypercomms system."

Without lifting a finger, Inesis conjures an image in your shared comms-volume: a diagram of the Askonia system. It zooms into a highlighted entity - the comms relay.
Askonia's primary hub of interstellar communication and data transfer.

This would be a classic Tri-Tachyon tactic - it was employed to great effect in the AI Wars.

"You'll receive a software package," he says. "Don't worry, it'll be quite harmless... until you upload it into the relay."
entries.zh:
"一次软件攻击。通过超波通讯系统。"

Inesis 连手指都没抬，就在你们共享的通讯空间里变出一幅图像：Askonia 星系的示意图。画面推近，锁定一个高亮的实体——通讯中继站。
Askonia 星际通讯与数据传输的主要枢纽。

这会是典型的速子科技战术——在 AI 战争中曾大获成功。

"你会收到一个软件包，\"他说。\"别担心，它相当无害...直到你把它上传进中继站。"

entries.en:
"While you're at it, is it possible you have any important contacts within the Sindrian Diktat who might be persuaded to oppose Macario?"

His tone is innocent on its surface. But of course Inesis knows about what Macario had you doing in Askonia, running around like a servant between various victims and enemies. But how much does he know?

"This would be the time to contact them," he says.
entries.zh:
"趁这工夫——你在辛达强权内部，有没有什么重要的人脉，也许能被说服去反对 Macario？"

他的语气表面上天真无邪。可 Inesis 当然知道 Macario 在 Askonia 让你干了些什么，像个听差一样在形形色色的受害者和敌人之间奔波。但他究竟知道多少？

"现在正是联系他们的时候，"他说。

entries.en:
"Good. I am familiar with Deputy Star Marshal Hyder's inflexibility."

He sounds amused.

"Nonetheless, opening a line of contact with an insider will be useful... so long as she believes her sense of honor will survive untarnished."
entries.zh:
"很好。副星际元帅 Hyder 的不知变通，我是知道的。"

他听起来颇为玩味。

"不过，与内部人士建立联系总会有用...只要她相信自己那份荣誉感不会受损。"

entries.en:
"Good. "I am familiar with Guard High Deputy Executor Caden's ambition, which is sure to be... frustrated by Hector's claim - and Macario's backing."

"Opening a line of contact with an insider will be useful, provided he believes he is giving the orders."
entries.zh:
"很好。卫队高级副执政官 Caden 的野心，我是知道的，那野心注定会被...Hector 的继承主张——以及 Macario 的支持——所挫。"

"与内部人士建立联系总会有用，只要他相信自己才是下命令的人。"

entries.en: "Oh, well," he says, not in the least disappointed. "The software attack will have to be our opening move, then. We'll track his moves, find his safehouses..."
entries.zh: "哦，好吧，\"他说，一点也不失望。\"那就只能拿软件攻击当开场棋了。我们会追踪他的动作，找出他的安全屋..."

entries.en:
He smiles, and this time it seems like he might truly be enjoying himself. Just a little.

"I have just two more items to review with you."
entries.zh:
他笑了，这一次他似乎真的有点乐在其中。只有一点点。

"我还有两件事要与你过一遍。"

o.en: Caden. I told him Macario wanted to control him, which angered him.
o.zh: Caden。我告诉他 Macario 想控制他，这让他很恼火。

o.en: I wasn't exactly focused on 'networking' with the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 我可没心思跟辛达强权'搞人脉'。

o.en: Caden. He is a fervent Andradaist.
o.zh: Caden。他是狂热的 Andrada 主义者。

o.en: Hyder. She hates Macario. She hates 'dishonorable' acts, but maybe she can help.
o.zh: Hyder。她恨 Macario。她痛恨'不光彩'的勾当，不过也许她能帮上忙。

o.en: Hyder is known to be... in conflict with Macario.
o.zh: 据说 Hyder 与 Macario...有冲突。

o.en: Caden. He is a loyal Andradaist.
o.zh: Caden。他是忠诚的 Andrada 主义者。

o.en: I shall worry about such matters as I see fit.
Simple - support Achilles' bid to become Supreme Executor.
o.zh: 很简单——支持 Achilles 角逐最高元首之位。

entries.en:
Inesis blinks in perfect sync with the confirmation of your credits transfer.

"I'll make the arrangements... partner."

He smiles, again.
entries.zh:
星币划转确认的那一刻，Inesis 正好眨了一下眼。

"我这就去安排...合伙人。"

他又笑了。

o.en: And I'll tell Achilles he has outside support.
o.zh: 而我会告诉 Achilles，他有外援。

entries.en: He nods, not quite a bow.
entries.zh: 他点了点头，还称不上鞠躬。

entries.en:
He activates a thoughtful look.

"You understand that your proposal would contravene Tri-Tachyon strategic policy?"

"While Achilles' leadership may bring prosperity to the Persean League, especially Gens Kato, we project that Tri-Tachyon's share of profits would be reduced."
entries.zh:
他摆出一副若有所思的神情。

"你明白，你的提议会违背速子科技的战略方针吧？"

"Achilles 掌权或许能给英仙座联盟带来繁荣，尤其是 Kato 氏族，但据我们预测，速子科技分到的利润会因此缩水。"

o.en: If Gens Kato benefitted, it could break Kazeron as the center of the League...
o.zh: 如果 Kato 氏族得利，Kazeron 作为联盟中心的地位就可能被打破...

o.en: Consider this - with enough backing, Achilles won't need Gens Kato.
o.zh: 不妨这样想——只要有足够的支持，Achilles 就不必依赖 Kato 氏族。

o.en: Maybe there's something else we can do...
o.zh: 也许我们还有别的办法...

entries.en:
"It is possible," he admits.

"However there are numerous contingent factors misaligned with present Company priorities. Our strategic predictors project an outcome not likely to favor Tri-Tachyon if that scenario were to culminate."

"To this I'm afraid my answer must be 'no', with apologies."
entries.zh:
"并非没有可能，"他承认。

"不过，有许多相关因素与公司当前的优先事项并不一致。我们的战略预测器推算，若那种局面最终成形，结果恐怕不会有利于速子科技。"

"对此，我的答复恐怕只能是'不行'，还请见谅。"

o.en: Maybe there's something else we can do...
o.zh: 也许我们还有别的办法...

o.en: What if we make it so Achilles doesn't need Gens Kato?
o.zh: 如果我们让 Achilles 不再需要 Kato 氏族呢？

entries.en:
"A compelling angle," he concedes.

"If Fortuna didn't control a post-conflict Askonia under Achilles' rule... well, this scenario has been simulated. Certain stakeholders vetoed further consideration."

He performs a small shrug.

"If we were to proceed it would be prudent to form a parallel initiative run as a low-visibility shell operation. I could arrange matters myself using funds separated from the usual accounts..."
entries.zh:
"有说服力的角度，"他让步道。

"如果战后处于 Achilles 治下的 Askonia 不由 Fortuna 掌控...唔，这种局面已经做过推演了。某些利益相关方否决了进一步考虑。"

他轻轻耸了耸肩。

"若真要推进，稳妥的做法是另立一项并行的计划，以低可见度的空壳形式运作。我可以动用与常规账户分开的资金亲自安排..."

o.en: You're asking for a bribe to covertly support Achilles?
o.zh: 你是在索贿，好暗中支持 Achilles？

o.en: Sounds complex. Maybe there's another approach...
o.zh: 听着太复杂了。也许还有别的路子...

entries.en:
"That word has certain moralistic implications inapplicable to an arrangement between free agents," he says cheerfully.

"But whatever the word, 120,000 credits would let me launch an 'independent initiative' nearly immediately."

He smiles.
entries.zh:
"那个词带有某种道德说教意味，并不适用于独立行为方之间的安排，"他愉快地说。

"不过随便你怎么称呼，120,000 星币就能让我几乎立刻启动一项'独立计划'。"

他笑了。

o.en: That's a bit much. Maybe there's another approach...
o.zh: 这价码有点高。也许还有别的路子...

o.en: Support Hector's claim. He's an Andrada - he will handle Macario.
o.zh: 支持 Hector 的继承权。他是 Andrada 家的人——Macario 由他来对付。

o.en: Help me put Hector in charge - without Macario. Then he can truly reign.
o.zh: 帮我扶 Hector 上位——把 Macario 排除在外。这样他才能真正掌权。

o.en: It looks like we can't come to an agreement.
I just want to see that Macario is destroyed.
o.zh: 我只想看到 Macario 被彻底除掉。

entries.en:
"That word has certain moralistic implications inapplicable to an arrangement between two free agents," he says cheerfully.

"But whatever word you use, 100,000 credits would let me launch an 'independent initiative' nearly immediately."

He smiles.
entries.zh:
"那个词带有某种道德说教意味，并不适用于两个独立行为方之间的安排，"他愉快地说。

"不过随你怎么称呼，100,000 星币就能让我几乎立刻启动一项'独立计划'。"

他笑了。

o.en: That's a bit much. Maybe there's another approach...
o.zh: 这价码有点高。也许还有别的路子...

entries.en:
Inesis blinks in perfect sync with the confirmation of your credits transfer.

"I'll start making arrangements... partner."

He smiles, again.
entries.zh:
星币划转确认的那一刻，Inesis 正好眨了一下眼。

"我这就开始安排...合伙人。"

他又笑了。

o.en: Help me destroy the Sindrian Diktat by supporting the rebel United Front.
o.zh: 帮我摧毁辛达强权——支持叛军的联合阵线。

entries.en: He raises his eyebrows, ever optimistic.
entries.zh: 他挑起眉毛，一如既往地乐观。

entries.en:
"You?"

Inesis' face ripples strangely.

The silence extends uncomfortably.
entries.zh:
"你？"

Inesis 的面容诡异地泛起波纹。

沉默拖得让人难受。

o.en: Yes, me. If Philip Andrada could conquer Askonia, so can I.
o.zh: 对，我。Philip Andrada 能征服 Askonia，我也能。

entries.en:
He blinks, once.

"Fascinating."
entries.zh:
他眨了一下眼。

"有意思。"

o.en: I'm asking how you will assist me. I will reward my supporters.
o.zh: 我问的是你打算怎么帮我。我会奖赏支持我的人。

entries.en:
"No doubt," he says.

"Well. What a... bold proposal, captain. Quite exceptional. Thank you for sharing your intentions with me."

He refolds his hand neatly, and politely.

"Well," he says, putting a smile on his face. "Two items do come to mind, if I may review them with you. It'll take but a moment."
entries.zh:
"那是自然，"他说。

"唔。这可是个...大胆的提议，舰长。相当出格。感谢你把意图告诉我。"

他把双手重新交叠好，动作整齐而客气。

"那么，\"他脸上挂起笑容，\"我倒是想到了两件事，可否与你过一遍。花不了多少时间。"

o.en: I've changed my mind. I'm just going to wait and see what happens.
o.zh: 我改主意了。我打算先等着，看事情怎么发展。

entries.en:
"These rebels, unfortunately, are unlikely to nurture a business-friendly environment on terms we could accept."

He holds up a hand. "Allow me to offer a brief explanation."

"The Umbra pirates are anti-enterprise, anti-prosperity ideologues." He drops a finger.

"The militant Luddics on Volturn veer dangerously toward Patherism, and deny the central role of cutting-edge technology in profit-creation and human excellence." He ticks off another finger.
entries.zh:
"很遗憾，这些叛军不太可能培育出我们能接受的、对商业友好的环境。"

他抬起一只手。"容我简短说明一下。"

"Umbra 的海盗是反企业、反繁荣的意识形态分子。"他扳下一根手指。

"Volturn 上那些好战的卢德信徒正危险地滑向左径信仰，他们否认尖端技术在创造利润与成就人类卓越中的核心作用。"他又扳下一根手指。

entries.en:
"And the Charterists of Nortia?" He frowns with a sort of half-approval. "I concede that they appear to have the most potential from afar, but, unfortunately, their organization is quite beholden to the Hegemony's covert warfare per the efforts of one Orcus Rao. And all that entails."

"Various other insurrectionists known to us are too insignificant to play a leading role in a potential post-Andrada Askonia." He drops his hand.

"So you see? There is no way toward acceptable profitability in this scenario."
entries.zh:
"那 Nortia 的宪章派呢？\"他皱起眉，那神情里有几分半心半意的赞许。\"我承认，从远处看他们似乎最有潜力，但不幸的是，他们的组织相当受制于霸主的地下战争——这要归功于某个 Orcus Rao 的努力。还有随之而来的一切。"

"我们所知的其他各路叛党都太不成气候，无法在可能的后 Andrada 时代 Askonia 扮演主导角色。"他放下手。

"所以你看？这种局面下，没有任何一条路能通向可接受的利润。"

o.en: What if I paid you, personally, to make this happen for me?
o.zh: 如果我私下付钱给你，让你替我把这事办成呢？

o.en: I see. Perhaps there's another way.
o.zh: 我明白了。也许还有别的办法。

entries.en:
He smiles. "I fully respect and appreciate your offer. It is a point of pride to bend directives from above toward profitable ends, but this would be too far."

"With my apologies and regrets, I must decline."
entries.zh:
他笑了。"我完全尊重并感激你的提议。把上面的指令扭向有利可图的方向，是我引以为傲的本事，但这一次太过头了。"

"恕我致歉并抱憾，我只能拒绝。"

entries.en: "Perhaps there is," he says.
entries.zh: "也许确实有，"他说。

entries.en:
"Excellent! I'm sure we can spin up several new initiatives based on this material," he says.
OR
"Another excellent find, captain," he says with a smile. "I can't wait to tell R&D."
OR
"Wonderful! I'm sure the analysis projections will be even more exciting than the last set."
OR
"Excellent! R&D is eager for more samples. More than eager- desperate!"

He produces a laugh.
OR
"Fantastic! You wouldn't believe how the project-leaders in R&D fight over sample access scheduling." He shakes his head, smiling.

"Well, this should calm them down a bit. For a little while, anyway."
OR
"You'll be pleased to know that we've come up with new containment procedures for delivering the samples to R&D after the little accident last time."

Seeing your expression, he adds, "Don't worry, despite the breach in the hab-volume, all the samples were recovered. Eventually."

His confident smile re-asserts itself.
OR
"With more samples like this," he says, "we can expect that the next quarterly status report is going to show some very exciting projections."

He looks up and away for a moment, smiling to himself.
entries.zh:
"太好了！有这批材料打底，我确信能立起好几个新项目来，" 他说。
OR
"又是一件好货，舰长，\" 他笑道，\"我等不及要告诉 R&D 了。"
OR
"妙极了！我敢说这回的分析预测会比上一批更带劲。"
OR
"太好了！R&D 盼着更多样本，何止是盼——简直是急疯了！"

他干笑了一声。
OR
"漂亮！你是没瞧见 R&D 那帮项目主管为了抢样本排期怎么争抢。" 他笑着摇头。

"喏，这下总能让他们消停一阵。哪怕就一阵子。"
OR
"你听了大概会高兴：上回出了点小事故之后，我们给送样到 R&D 定了一套新的封存规程。"

见你这表情，他又补一句，"别担心，居住舱段是漏了，样本可都找回来了。终归是找回来了。"

那副自信的笑又重新挂回脸上。
OR
"再多来些这样的样本，\" 他说，\"下一份季度进度报告上的预测数字，想必会相当好看。"

他抬眼望向别处，独自笑了片刻。

entries.en:
"Excellent, excellent," his eyes flick rapidly.

"Director Glamor-Rotanev will be pleased, I'm sure of it."
entries.zh:
"好，好，" 他眼珠飞快地转着。

"Glamor-Rotanev 总监一准满意，我敢肯定。"

entries.en:
"Oh, these samples are quite unique, aren't they," he says, quite pleased. "The containment requirements are unusual! I can't wait to see what R&D makes of it all."

His habitual smile is untroubled.
entries.zh:
"哦，这批样本可真够特别的，\" 他颇为得意，\"封存条件都不一般！我等不及想看 R&D 拿它们折腾出什么来。"

那副惯常的笑纹丝不乱。

entries.en:
"A marvelous find, captain," he says. "This is exactly what the Director has been searching for! She'll be so pleased, I'm sure of it."

His eyes beam with unnatural warmth.
entries.zh:
"了不起的发现，舰长，\" 他说，\"这正是总监一直在找的东西！她一准高兴坏了，我敢打包票。"

他眼里放出一种不自然的热切。

o.en: I'd like to discuss items of interest to Director Glamor-Rotanev.
o.zh: 我想谈谈 Glamor-Rotanev 总监感兴趣的几样东西。

entries.en: "But if you have nothing for me... perhaps another time?"
entries.zh: "不过你要是没东西给我...那就下次再说？"

entries.en: "I'm always eager to discuss high-return initiatives," he says with a smile.
entries.zh: "我一向乐意谈谈高回报的项目，" 他笑道。

o.en: Zunya Glamor-Rotanev told me to speak with you...
o.zh: 是 Zunya Glamor-Rotanev 让我来找你谈的...

entries.en:
"Indeed she has," he says with a smile.

"I am authorized to engage in limited discussion of certain key initiatives and I may offer payment in exchange for samples and artifacts of interest to Director Glamor-Rotanev."

"Do you have any samples or artifacts you wish to transfer to my care?"
entries.zh:
"她确实交代过，" 他笑道。

"我获准就若干重点项目作有限度的讨论，也可就 Glamor-Rotanev 总监感兴趣的样本与文物提供报酬。"

"你手上可有意移交给我保管的样本或文物？"

entries.en:
The hulls are pitted and, in some places, appear to be subtly warped. Despite the visible damage, sensors detect dormant power sources which start to come online even as your bridge crew finishes an initial tactical assessment.

After a moment of surprise, your comms officer speaks. "$PlayerSirOrMadam, we've got transponder pings. The codes are standard Tri-Tachyon, but according to our last registry update they're over a hundred cycles out of date."
entries.zh:
船体表面存在凹陷，某些地方似乎有微妙的扭曲。尽管有明显的损坏，但传感器检测到存在休眠的动力源，甚至在你的舰桥人员完成初步的战术评估时，这些动力源就开始上线了。

在一阵惊讶之后，通讯军官开口了。"$PlayerSirOrMadam，我们收到了应答器信号。识别码是 速子科技 标准，但根据最后一次更新的注册表显示，它们已经过期至少 100 个星历年了。"

entries.en: Your most recent occupation was as...
entries.zh: 你近期的职业是...

o.en: >>(dev) quick start custom no time pass
o.zh: >>(dev) 快速开始自定义游戏 (无时间流逝)

entries.en:
