He laughs a bit too heartily.

"Not at all, my friend," he says, then leans in. "This isn't about the provost."
entries.zh:
他笑得有点过于热络。

"完全没有，我的朋友，\"他说，然后凑近。\"这事跟院长无关。"

entries.en:
He laughs a bit too heartily.

"Of course, of course," he says, then leans in. "This isn't about the provost."
entries.zh:
他笑得有点过于热络。

"当然，当然，\"他说，然后凑近。\"这事跟院长无关。"

entries.en:
He laughs a bit too heartily.

"I would never! I'm an academician, after all - a man of knowledge and only the highest ideals, I should hope," he says loudly. Then he leans in to speak more quietly.
entries.zh:
他笑得有点过于热络。

"我绝不会！毕竟我是个院士——一个求知识、只抱最高理想的人，但愿如此，"他大声说道。然后他凑近，压低了声音。

entries.en:
He laughs a bit too heartily, glancing around. It's unclear if he's embarrassed at your tactlessness or nervous of being overheard.

"I've not a clue what you mean, good captain! I'm merely a humble academician - a man of knowledge and only the highest ideals," he says loudly. Then he leans in to speak more quietly.
entries.zh:
他笑得有点过于热络，还四下张望。说不清他是被你的不识趣弄得尴尬，还是怕被人听见。

"我完全不明白你的意思，好舰长！我不过是个谦卑的院士——一个求知识、只抱最高理想的人，"他大声说道。然后他凑近，压低了声音。

entries.en:
He laughs a bit too heartily, glancing around. It's unclear if he's embarrassed at your tactlessness or nervous of being overheard.

"I've not a clue what you mean, good captain! I'm merely a humble academician - a man of knowledge and only the highest ideals," he says loudly. Then he leans in to speak more quietly.
entries.zh:
他笑得有点过于热络，还四下张望。说不清他是被你的不识趣弄得尴尬，还是怕被人听见。

"我完全不明白你的意思，好舰长！我不过是个谦卑的院士——一个求知识、只抱最高理想的人，"他大声说道。然后他凑近，压低了声音。

entries.en:
"This is about freedom, my friend. This is about the Askonia Charterist Alliance, the first resistance movement opposed to the tyranny of the Sindrian Diktat, that cruel regime created by Andrada when he murdered Opis."

"Which was once my home," he says, almost a whisper.

A shadow has fallen across his cheerful facade; in his eyes, you see genuine pain, still fresh after many cycles.
entries.zh:
"这是关于自由，我的朋友。这是关于 Askonia 宪章派同盟——第一支反抗辛达强权暴政的抵抗运动，那个由 Andrada 在谋杀 Opis 之后建立的残酷政权。"

"那里曾是我的家，"他说，几乎是耳语。

一层阴影落在他快活的面具上；在他眼里，你看见真切的痛楚，隔了这么多个星历年，仍旧新鲜。

entries.en: "The credits you've given have already been put to work - I've seen to it personally."
entries.zh: "你给的星币已经派上了用场——是我亲自盯的。"

entries.en: "The fuel you provided is already supporting increased covert fleet operations. Smuggling and... well, it wouldn't be covert if I told you, would it?" He laughs at himself.
entries.zh: "你提供的燃料已经在支撑更多秘密舰队行动。走私，还有...嗯，要是我告诉你了，那还叫秘密吗？"他自嘲地笑了。

entries.en: "Your contribution of supplies has already been distributed to our gathering of marines and warships among several independent polities. Thanks to you, they'll be well-equipped for the uprising."
entries.zh: "你捐赠的补给已经分发给我们散布在几个独立政权中的陆战队与战舰。多亏了你，起义时他们会装备齐整。"

entries.en:
"It's quite a list," he picks up his TriPad, but does not consult it. Perhaps just holding it helps him remember.

"We need fuel for covert fleet operations. And credits would do much to support our recruitment, fundraising, and expenses. Supplies, of course. We could train our fighters and operatives while building stockpiles of equipment for the uprising."

"The Charterists can operate openly in most of the Persean Sector so there will be no problems storing and shipping any contributions you choose to make."
entries.zh:
"这张单子可不短。"他拿起 TriPad，却没有去看。也许只是握着它就能帮他记住。

"我们需要燃料来维持秘密舰队行动。星币则大有用处，可以支撑招募、筹款和各项开支。当然还有补给。我们可以一边训练战士与特工，一边为起义囤积装备。"

"宪章派在英仙座星域大部分地方都能公开活动，所以你无论捐什么，储存和运输都不会有问题。"

entries.en: "Of course," he says. "Caution is the word."
entries.zh: "当然，\"他说，\"谨慎为上。"

entries.en:
"I cannot thank you enough," he says graciously.

"On the day that we liberate Sindria, Volturn, and the rest of the Askonia system the Charterists will not forget-"

He pauses, unable to speak for a moment. He rubs his eyes, then clears his throat.

"I apologize. We will never forget what you've done for us, captain."
entries.zh:
"我实在感激不尽，"他恳切地说。

"等到我们解放 Sindria、Volturn 以及 Askonia 星系其余各地的那一天，宪章派不会忘记——"

他顿住了，一时说不出话。他揉了揉眼睛，清了清嗓子。

"抱歉。我们永远不会忘记你为我们做的一切，舰长。"

entries.en:
"I cannot thank you enough," he says graciously.

"On the day that we liberate Sindria, Volturn, and the rest of the Askonia system the Charterists will not forget-" He pauses, unable to speak for a moment, then clears his throat.

"I apologize. We will never forget what you've done for us, captain."

"Now I... I have a lot of work to do. Look me up on Nortia if you pass through. I'm around... sometimes." An apologetic look. "Duty keeps me afar too often."
entries.zh:
"我实在感激不尽，"他恳切地说。

"等到我们解放 Sindria、Volturn 以及 Askonia 星系其余各地的那一天，宪章派不会忘记——"他顿住了，一时说不出话，随后清了清嗓子。

"抱歉。我们永远不会忘记你为我们做的一切，舰长。"

"现在我...我还有很多事要做。你要是路过 Nortia，就来找我。我...有时候在。\"一个歉然的眼神。\"职责太常把我拉到远处去了。"

entries.en: He gives you a friendly pat on the shoulder, then leaves with uncharacteristic determination - a few officers scattered around the bar wave to him, but he walks by, TriPad clutched tightly.
entries.zh: 他友善地拍了拍你的肩膀，随后以一种少见的决然转身离开——散在酒吧各处的几个军官朝他挥手，他却径直走过，TriPad 攥得死紧。

entries.en: "I'd like nothing more," he says.
entries.zh: "这正是我求之不得的，"他说。

entries.en:
"Fantastic," he says, eyes wide at his TriPad. "You have my thanks, now and forever, captain."

"I'll turn each credit you give me into three - that's the multiplicative power of recruitment and fundraising! And then to say nothing of bribing the right officials..."

He smiles, then winks.

"But I should actually say nothing about that. Let me simply thank you once more."
entries.zh:
"太好了，\"他盯着 TriPad，眼睛睁得老大，\"舰长，我的谢意从此刻直到永远。"

"你每给我一枚星币，我就能把它变成三枚——这就是招募与筹款的乘数效应！更不用说打点该打点的官员了..."

他笑了笑，眨了眨眼。

"不过这事我其实一个字都不该说。还是让我再谢你一次吧。"

entries.en:
"Excellent! With fuel reserves we can run additional covert fleet ops - and I can add a few additional stops to my rounds of the Core worlds drumming up support and recruits!"

"And once the uprising begins, we'll bring troops and combat ships in from where we've gathered them among a few friendly independent polities." He grins. "We seem to have friends everywhere."
entries.zh:
"太好了！有了燃料储备，我们就能多跑几趟秘密舰队行动——我也能在核心世界的巡回中多加几个站点，去鼓动支持、招募人手！"

"等起义一开始，我们就把部队和战斗舰艇从几个友好独立政权那里调来——人手舰船都攒在那儿。\"他咧嘴一笑，\"我们好像到处都有朋友。"

entries.en:
"Excellent! With these fuel reserves we can run additional covert fleet ops - and I can add a few additional stops to my rounds of the Core worlds drumming up support and recruits."

"We're bringing troops and combat ships in from a few friendly independent polities." He grins. "We seem to have friends everywhere."
entries.zh:
"太好了！有了这些燃料储备，我们就能多跑几趟秘密舰队行动——我也能在核心世界的巡回中多加几个站点，去鼓动支持、招募人手。"

"我们正从几个友好的独立政权那里调集部队和战斗舰艇。\"他咧嘴一笑，\"我们好像到处都有朋友。"

entries.en:
"These supplies are a welcome gift," he says.

"We're training fighters on Nortia and in several friendly independent polities in nearby systems - both ground combatants and the core of what will become the Navy of the Reformed Chartery of Askonia."

"Soon, my friend, they will fight for our freedom."
entries.zh:
"这批补给是份及时礼，"他说。

"我们正在 Nortia 以及邻近星系的几个友好独立政权那里训练战士——既有地面战斗人员，也有将成为改革后的 Askonia 宪章政体海军之核心的舰员。"

"很快，朋友，他们就会为我们的自由而战。"

entries.en:
"I'm sorry you feel that way, captain," he says. "Truly I am."

"But if you change your mind... us Charterists aren't going anywhere."

He taps his TriPad then he gives your shoulder a friendly pat and returns to the cluster of spacer captains he was speaking to previously.
entries.zh:
"很遗憾你这样想，舰长，"他说，"我是真心的。"

"但要是你改了主意...我们宪章派哪儿也不会去。"

他点了一下 TriPad，然后友善地拍了拍你的肩膀，回到刚才那几位船长聚着的圈子里。

entries.en:
"So you've met Curate Standfast?" He smiles warmly. "She's a tough biddy, isn't she?"

"The Volturnian Self-Defense Covenant is an invaluable ally in the United Front. Their fighters are dedicated... zealous even," he puts on a distant, impressed look.

"That's my answer. Fanatical, though under-equipped. I salute their contribution to the cause."
entries.zh:
"这么说你见过助理牧师 Standfast 了？\"他笑得很暖，\"那老太太可不好对付，对吧？"

"Volturn 自卫盟约是联合阵线里不可或缺的盟友。他们的战士忠诚...甚至称得上狂热，"他露出一种遥想而钦佩的神情。

"这就是我的回答。狂热，但装备不足。我向他们为事业所做的贡献致敬。"

entries.en:
He grins. "Yes, alright. You've got me."

His expression turns more serious. "I worry about what they might become. If we win - when we win - will they lay down arms? Will they allow Volturn to restore the Charter we lived under before this nightmare began?"

Iscare gives you an open look.

"Or will they establish a theocracy? Will they enforce their religion with militant zeal, like the Knights of Ludd? Or worse, like the Path? I don't think Moyra Standfast wants any of that, but it's bigger than her, isn't it."

"I don't have the answers. And that worries me."
entries.zh:
他咧嘴一笑。"好吧，算你说中了。"

他的神情严肃起来。"我担心他们会变成什么样子。如果我们赢了——不，当我们赢了——他们会放下武器吗？他们会允许 Volturn 恢复那场噩梦开始前我们生活其下的宪章吗？"

Iscare 坦然地看了你一眼。

"还是说，他们会建起一个神权政体？会像卢德骑士团那样，以好战的狂热推行他们的信仰？或者更糟，像卢德左径那样？我不认为 Moyra Standfast 想要这些，但这事的分量早已超过她一个人，不是吗。"

"我没有答案。而这让我不安。"

entries.en:
He settles his face into a neutral expression.

"The Galatia Academy is founded on a policy of strict neutrality, and I follow Baird's leadership in upholding that policy."

He winks.
entries.zh:
他把表情收成一副中立的模样。

"Galatia 学院建立在严格中立的原则之上，我追随 Baird 的领导，恪守这一原则。"

他眨了眨眼。

o.en: Look, I'm just trying to get by. I'm not interested in a lost cause.
o.zh: 听着，我只想混口饭吃。对注定失败的事业没兴趣。

o.en: What about the ARC, on Umbra?
o.zh: 那 Umbra 上的 ARC 呢？

o.en: What about the Luddics on Volturn?
o.zh: 那 Volturn 上的卢德信徒呢？

o.en: If you need a merc, I need to know what you're paying.
o.zh: 你要是缺雇佣兵，那得先让我知道你能出多少。

o.en: Does Provost Baird know about... this?
o.zh: 院长 Baird 知道...这件事吗？

o.en: Are you trying to recruit me to a terrorist organization?
o.zh: 你是在招募我加入一个恐怖组织吗？

o.en: Your cause sounds just. How can I help?
o.zh: 你的事业听起来是正义的。我能帮上什么？

o.en: I'd like to give additional support to the Charterists.
o.zh: 我想给宪章派追加一些支援。

o.en: Do you approve of Yaribay's vision? Reconciliation of the League and Hegemony?
o.zh: 你认可 Yaribay 的构想吗？让联盟与霸主和解？

o.en: So you approve of Rao's plan for Askonia?
o.zh: 那么，你认可 Rao 对 Askonia 的打算？

o.en: Tell me about the Charterist Alliance.

entries.en:
"Ah, them." He drums his fingers on the bar.

"We've agreed to form a united front against the Andrada regime, so I can't speak too poorly of our present allies."

"But," he looks away, "They're unrealistic. Opportunistic, even, considering their role in destabilizing our polity during the Askonia Crisis - that's what created the opening for the Hegemony's invasion in the first place! And then Andrada's mutiny and conquest."

"They should have followed the Chartery's processes. Yes, the system was slow and imperfect - but look at us now!"
entries.zh:
"啊，他们啊。"他手指在吧台上敲着。

"我们已经同意结成统一战线，对抗 Andrada 政权，所以我不好把眼下的盟友说得太糟。"

"可是，\"他移开目光，\"他们不切实际。甚至可以说是在投机——想想他们在 Askonia 危机期间把我们的政体搅乱成什么样，正是那场乱子给霸主的入侵开了口子！接着就是 Andrada 的叛乱与征服。"

"他们本该遵循宪章派的程序。是的，那套制度缓慢、不完美——可看看我们现在落到了什么地步！"

entries.en:
"They insist they're building some starry-eyed utopia and don't care who or what they tear down to get there. Just look at how they live - as destitute pirates. That's their utopia!"

"Nonetheless," he takes a breath, "I respect their dedication. Imoinu Kato - she's got the spirit, everyone can see that. Brings much-needed attention to the cause shared by the United Front."

"But if you ask me?" He speaks quietly, "I think she's just going to get herself killed."
entries.zh:
"他们一口咬定自己在建什么痴心妄想的乌托邦，却不管为了走到那儿要拆掉谁、拆掉什么。就看看他们过的是什么日子——一群穷光蛋海盗。这就是他们的乌托邦！"

"尽管如此，\"他吸了口气，\"我敬重他们的执着。Imoinu Kato——她有那股劲头，谁都看得出来。她让联合阵线共同的事业得到了亟需的关注。"

"可要我说？"他压低声音，"她不过是把自己往死路上送。"

entries.en:
"That's what I want to hear," he says with a laugh.

"As for help - well, you know how these sorts of things work, don't you?" He taps his TriPad. "We need supplies, fuel, and above all credits."
entries.zh:
"这才是我爱听的话，"他笑着说了句。

"至于帮忙——你也知道这种事是怎么运转的，对吧？"他点了一下 TriPad。"我们需要补给、燃料，最要紧的是星币。"

entries.en: He shakes his head, smiling. "I cannot express how pleased I am to hear that."
entries.zh: 他摇着头笑了。"我实在没法形容听到这句话有多高兴。"

entries.en:
"You've got a lot to think about," he says, "I can tell. The Charterists aren't going anywhere, and we can use all the help we can get."

He gives your shoulder a friendly pat as he leaves, heading toward one of the spacer captains he was speaking with before.
entries.zh:
"你要想的事不少，"他说，"我看得出来。宪章派哪儿也不会去，而我们需要一切能得到的助力。"

他友善地拍了拍你的肩膀离开，走向刚才与他交谈的其中一位船长。

entries.en:
Without introducing them he quickly, but charmingly, dismisses the other officers with a promise to join them in a moment.

"You've done well, very well for yourself. We could use a talented leader like you."
entries.zh:
他没作介绍，只是迅速又不失风度地打发了其他军官，答应稍后就过去。

"你干得不错，为自己挣下了很好的局面。我们正缺一位像你这样有本事的领袖。"

o.en: Use me? I've already done work for Provost Baird.
o.zh: 利用我？我已经替院长 Baird 干过活了。

o.en: Use me? I've already contacted Provost Baird.
o.zh: 利用我？我已经联系过院长 Baird 了。

o.en: Why do I feel like you're trying to sell me something.
o.zh: 我怎么觉得你是想向我推销点什么。

o.en: You know Horus Yaribay sent me to you?
o.zh: Horus Yaribay 派我来找你——这事你知道吗？

o.en: So you're Rao's contact with the ACA?

entries.en:
"Perhaps there's been a misunderstanding," he says smoothly. "My present interest is more in the area of fundraising - credits, fuel, supplies. For when the time comes."

"Now with that said," he says with a smile as he taps at his TriPad, "we may have a role for mercenaries when the time comes."
entries.zh:
"也许这里有点误会，"他圆滑地说，"我眼下更关心的是筹款——星币、燃料、补给。为了那一天到来的时候。"

"不过话虽如此，"他笑着说，"等到那一天，我们或许真有用得着雇佣兵的地方。"

entries.en:
"Count on it."

He gives your shoulder a friendly pat as he leaves, heading toward one of the spacer captains he was speaking with before.
entries.zh:
"一定。"

他友善地拍了拍你的肩膀离开，走向刚才与他交谈的其中一位船长。

entries.en:
As you approach, he looks over and says "Captain! It's a pleasure to meet you again. I trust Baird was not... too much?"

He grins brightly, his smile not unlike a pulsar beam.

"Friends! This is Captain $playerName. I'm sure you've heard of $playerHimOrHer. Captain $playerLastName, these are my new friends."
entries.zh:
你走近时，他看过来，说道："舰长！真高兴又见到你。我相信 Baird 没有...太过分吧？"

他笑得很灿烂，那笑容不亚于一道脉冲星的光束。

"朋友们！这位就是 $playerName 舰长。你们肯定听说过 $playerHimOrHer。$playerLastName 舰长，这些都是我的新朋友。"

o.zh: 很高兴认识你们。啊...请问？

entries.en:
As you approach, he looks over and says "Captain! It's a pleasure to meet you again. I trust Baird was not... too much?"

He grins brightly, his smile not unlike a pulsar beam.

"Friends! This is Captain $playerName. I'm sure you've heard of $playerHimOrHer. Commissioned by the Sindrian Diktat! Can you believe it?" He laughs. "None of my friends are so honored! I can only wonder what is wrong with them." He laughs again, a little too loud. Everyone else simply looks uncomfortable - perhaps Iscare has had a bit much to drink.
entries.zh:
你走近时，他看过来，说道："舰长！真高兴又见到你。我相信 Baird 没有...太过分吧？"

他笑得很灿烂，那笑容不亚于一道脉冲星的光束。

"朋友们！这位就是 $playerName 舰长。你们肯定听说过 $playerHimOrHer。辛达强权任命的！你们信吗？"他大笑。"我的朋友里没一个有这份荣幸！我只能琢磨他们到底哪儿出了问题。"他又笑了，笑得有点太响。其余人只是一脸不自在——也许 Iscare 喝得有点多了。

entries.en:
"Well," he says, still grinning, but perhaps with a splash of self-consciousness. "I couldn't possibly keep you from your duties, captain, so I must bid you a good day."

He performs a gracious half-bow, then retreats. His 'friends' all mumble excuses and disappear as well, leaving you alone with a couple half-finished drinks.
entries.zh:
"好了，\"他说，仍带着笑，不过或许掺了点不自在。\"我总不能耽误你的公务，舰长，只好祝你今天愉快了。"

他优雅地半鞠一躬，然后退开。他那帮"朋友"也都嘟囔着找借口散了，只留下你和几杯喝了一半的酒。

entries.en:
As you approach, he looks over and says "Captain $playerName! Don't be so surprised, you've a fascinating reputation to the, shall we say, movers and shakers of the Sector."

His smile is like a pulsar beam.

With a casual wave, he dismisses the other officers with the promise to join them in a moment, then catches your eye. "Dilettantes. Compared to yourself, I mean, of course. We could use a talented captain like you."
entries.zh:
你走近时，他看过来，说道："$playerName 舰长！别这么惊讶，在星域那些，姑且这么说吧，风云人物眼里，你可是个相当有意思的名号。"

他的笑容像一道脉冲星的光束。

他随意一挥手，打发了其他军官，答应稍后就过去，然后迎上你的目光。"一帮附庸风雅的家伙。当然，是跟你比。我们正缺一位像你这样有本事的舰长。"

entries.en:
As you approach, he looks over and says "Captain $playerName! Don't be so surprised, you've a fascinating reputation to the movers and shakers of the Sector, from grand Kazeron even to a minor orbit of... say, Ragnar."

His smile is like a pulsar beam.

With a casual wave, he dismisses the other officers with the promise to join them in a moment, then catches your eye. "Dilettantes. Compared to yourself, I mean, of course. I'm told we could use a talented captain like you."

他的笑容像一道脉冲星的光束。

He performs a gracious half-bow, then retreats back to his group.
entries.zh:
你走近时，他看过来，说道："$playerName 舰长！别这么惊讶，在星域那些，姑且这么说吧，风云人物眼里，你可是个相当有意思的名号。"

他的笑容像一道脉冲星的光束。

他随意一挥手，打发了其他军官，答应稍后就过去，然后迎上你的目光。"一帮附庸风雅的家伙。瞧瞧，你身上挂着辛达强权亮闪闪的委任状，而我这些朋友一个都没有！"他笑得有点太响，摇了摇头。"我总不能耽误你的公务，舰长，只好祝你今天愉快了。"

他优雅地半鞠一躬，然后退回他那群人里。

entries.en:
"We are going to restore Askonia to what it was before Andrada enslaved Sindria, and conquered Volturn and the rest. We're going to make Askonia independent, free, and prosperous!"

"Of course, Opis can never be restored," he says bitterly. "Nor the lives of millions dead. But it's for them, for the memory of Opis, that we must fight!"

He remembers in the moment to maintain appearances, putting on a smile and giving a wave to some contact across the bar before returning his attention to you.

There is a darkness - a killing darkness - in his eyes quite at odds with the breezy attitude he's put on display.
entries.zh:
"我们要把 Askonia 恢复到 Andrada 奴役 Sindria、征服 Volturn 与其余各地之前的样子。我们要让 Askonia 独立、自由、繁荣！"

"当然，Opis 再也回不来了，\"他苦涩地说，\"几百万条人命也回不来了。但正是为了他们，为了 Opis 的记忆，我们必须战斗！"

他忽然想起要维持体面，挂上笑容，朝酒吧另一头某个熟人挥了挥手，才把注意力转回你身上。

他的眼里有一片暗影——杀意森然的暗影——与他摆出的那副轻松做派全然不符。

entries.en:
"If you contribute to our cause, your dedication would not be forgotten. I won't insult you by promising you'll be repaid in full - after all, we may all die tomorrow, who knows?" A bitter laugh. "But if - no, when we make it through, when we topple the Andrada regime and freedom reigns once more in Askonia... the ACA won't forget your help."

He produces a grim, tentative smile.

"What do you say?"
entries.zh:
"如果你为我们的事业出力，你的付出不会被忘记。我不会用'全额奉还'这种话来侮辱你——毕竟，谁知道呢，也许我们明天就都死了？\"一声苦笑。\"但如果我们——不，当我们挺过去，当我们推翻 Andrada 政权、自由重临 Askonia...ACA 不会忘记你的帮助。"

他挤出一个阴郁而试探的笑。

"你说呢？"

entries.en:
He blinks, then laughs.

"You've been watching too much regime propaganda, my friend! We're the continuation of the legitimate government that was ousted by Andrada's genocidal invasion - he's the terrorist, not us! The ACA is, in effect, fighting for the re-establishment of the Chartery of Askonia."

He jabs two fingers at the bar with each word, "Freedom, prosperity, and independence."
entries.zh:
他愣了一下，随即笑了。

"你是政权宣传看多了，朋友！我们是被 Andrada 那场种族灭绝式入侵推翻的合法政府的延续——他才是恐怖分子，不是我们！实际上，ACA 战斗的目的，就是重建 Askonia 宪章政体。"

他每说一个词就用两根手指戳一下吧台："自由、繁荣、独立。"

entries.en:
"Now does that make us terrorists? To a ruthless dictator like Philip Andrada, I suppose it does. And if we strike terror into his black heart, all the better!"

He gives the bar a pound for emphasis, settling glasses rattling. Then gives an apologetic smile and a small salute to the bartender before turning his attention back to you.
entries.zh:
"这就算恐怖分子了？在 Philip Andrada 那样的冷酷独裁者眼里，大概算。可要是能让他那颗黑心生出恐惧，那更好！"

他重重捶了一下吧台以示强调，酒杯跟着一阵乱响。随后他歉然一笑，朝酒保草草行了个礼，再把注意力转回你身上。

entries.en:
The comms connect and show the charming smile of Arnaud Iscare. A message begins, though the image does not move.

"I'm sorry, friend, but duty calls. I'm currently travelling the Persean Sector looking for the best and brightest for the Galatia Academy and will return in-" His voice takes on the buzz of an algorithmically generated insert, "two days."

"If you'd like to leave a message..."
entries.zh:
通讯接通，画面里是 Arnaud Iscare 迷人的微笑。一段留言开始播放，画面却纹丝不动。

"抱歉，朋友，职责在身。我眼下正在英仙座星域各处游历，为 Galatia 学院寻访最出色、最聪敏的人才，我将在——"他的声音转为一段算法生成的插入音，"两天。"

"如果你想留言..."

After a short wait, your connection request is accepted.

$personName looks at you suspiciously.

"As I'm sure you're aware, I'm currently conducting a highly sensitive investigation, and have no time for idle chatter."

You get the feeling that you might get further if you came into port without broadcasting your identity by turning off your transponder.
entries.zh:
短暂的等待过后，你的连接请求被接受了。

$personName 用怀疑的目光看着你。

"我相信你应该清楚，我目前正在负责进行一项非常敏感的调查行动，没有时间和你闲聊。"

你有种感觉，如果{关闭你的应答器}隐瞒身份进入港口，事情可能会有更多的进展。

o.en: I understand running a thorough investigation can be expensive...
o.zh: 我知道进行这种彻底的调查会很花钱...

entries.en:
"I'm so glad to meet someone who understands the issues.

Having proper funding - say, an extra $ise_bribeAmountDGS credits - would ensure that this investigation could reach a speedy and satisfactory conclusion."
entries.zh:
"我很高兴能遇到一个能理解这些问题的人。

如果有良好的资助，比如说再有一笔 $ise_bribeAmountDGS 星币的款项，就能确保这项调查能够迅速获得一个令人满意的结论。"

o.zh: 提供一笔 $ise_bribeAmountDGS 星币的 "捐助"

entries.en:
"Your interest in the matter is duly noted, but it doesn't sound like you're really ready to help me resolve this misunderstanding. Something more like, oh, $ise_bribeAmountDGS credits? That could facilitate a proper investigation."

"Now I have fascinating reports about you to read over, so come back when you're serious."
entries.zh:
"我非常理解你对事态的关切，但听上去你似乎还没做好协助我解决这个误会的准备。这还需要大概，嗯，$ise_bribeAmountDGS 星币左右？才能促成一次合理的调查。"

"然后现在我还有一堆关于你的精彩报告要读，所以下次你认真决定要做这件事的时候再来找我。"

entries.en:
You hail the bartender, point, and order 'one of those'.

The patron's smile returns. "How embarrassing for our friends up there." A nod to the holodisplay.

You exchange cryptokeys to facilitate secure comms, and coordinate a pick-up point. The timeline is short, delivery is promised before the next workshift begins, and you are almost as surprised as the prisoner looks as they are shoved out of a shadowy maintenance hatch toward you, hands still tied. The patron leans through and gives you a nod before resealing the hatch.

You move quickly to leave before the civic observation net flags your identities.
entries.zh:
你叫来酒保，点了杯 '多选一'。

顾客的脸上又出现了微笑。向全息显示屏点了点头，"上面这位朋友可真尴尬。"

你在安全通讯频道中与设施安保人员对上了暗号，并协商接头地点。对方承诺在下一次轮班开始之前交付目标。没等多久，当双手仍然被绑着的囚犯被从阴暗的维修通道中推到你面前时，你几乎和他一样惊讶。那位顾客在舱门重新密封之前倾身向你点了点头。

你们在公民识别网络标记出身份之前迅速离开了。

entries.en:
You approach the smiling patron, who turns and keeps their eyes firmly locked at a menu display on the wall while a somewhat fanciful concoction appears on the bar.

"There are so many options, $playerName," they say deliberately. "Not everyone wants the same thing. Some disagree quite strongly, but are too polite to say so out loud." Eyes flicker to the door, then to a holodisplay of some news item about the leading political cadre of $jabr_marketName.

"Perhaps you'd like what I'm having?" They take a long sip, "It comes at quite a price because there are others who want it very, very much as well. $jabr_storyCost credits."
entries.zh:
你走近那位面带微笑的顾客，对方转过身来，但眼睛依旧紧紧地盯着墙上展示的菜单，这时吧台上出现了一种有些奇特的饮品。

"可供选择的手段很多，$playerName，" 对方唐突而刻意地这么说道。"并非每个人的所求都完全一致的。有些人心中十分不满，但出于礼貌而没有大声说出来。" 对方的目光闪过了门口，然后投向了全息显示屏上有关 $jabr_marketName 上领导干部的新闻。

"也许你会喜欢我手上的东西？" 对方长长地啜饮了一口，"这东西挺贵的，因为还有其他人也非常想得到它。价格是 $jabr_storyCost 星币。"

o.en: Bribe the smiling patron to acquire the prisoner
o.zh: 贿赂微笑的顾客以获得囚犯

entries.en: "I would like to discuss the unnecessary incarceration of a certain individual and what might be done to resolve the situation."
entries.zh: "我想讨论对某个人的非必要监禁，以及可能采取什么措施来解决这个问题。"

entries.en: From a shadowy corner, a $jabr_manOrWoman smoking a burning narcotic stick catches your eye.
entries.zh: 在一个阴暗的角落里，一个抽着大烟的$jabr_manOrWoman引起了你的注意。

entries.en: Your TriPad chimes, notifying you that your chief security officer has handed off the prisoner, now free. Perhaps.
entries.zh: 你 TriPad 的铃声响起，表明你的安全主管已经交出了囚犯，对方现在自由了，也许吧。

o.zh: 询问具体要怎么解决 "监禁" 问题

o.en: Approach the $jabr_manOrWoman smoking in the dark corner

entries.en:
The $jabr_manOrWoman looks you over as you approach. After a moment, $jabr_heOrShe seems satisfied and slides a cheap datapad across the table. It displays a personnel file and the schematics of a secure facility.

In a quiet voice $jabr_heOrShe explains, "I need an extract of the subject from, ah, unjust confinement $jabr_marketOnOrAt $jabr_marketName, $jabr_dist light-years away. My benefactor offers a payment of $jabr_reward credits to secure the subject's liberation." The $jabr_manOrWoman awaits your reply, eyes visible only as two constellations of reflected light.

You skim the schematics; they're thorough. You estimate that around $jabr_marines marines would be required to carry off this operation. Assaulting $jabr_marketFactionArticle $jabr_marketFaction prison could also have an impact on your reputation; measures can be taken to reduce identifiability, but they can't completely avert official suspicion.
entries.zh:
当你走近时，这个$jabr_manOrWoman一言不发地打量着你。片刻之后，$jabr_heOrShe似乎觉得你够格了，便把一个廉价的数据平板从桌子那边滑了过来。上面显示着一份个人资料和一个安全设施的结构图。

$jabr_heOrShe轻声解释道："我需要一次解救行动，任务对象正被...呃...非法监禁在 $jabr_dist 光年之外的 $jabr_marketName。我的赞助人可以为此提供 $jabr_reward 星币。" $jabr_manOrWoman等待你的答复，双眼反射出依稀可见的光芒，犹如星宿。

你扫视了资料，他们调查得很彻底。你估计大约需要 $jabr_marines 名陆战队员才能完成这次任务。袭击 $jabr_marketFactionArticle $jabr_marketFaction 的监狱设施可能会对你的声望造成影响。你可以采取一些措施来避免暴露身份，但这些手段无法完全摆脱官方的怀疑。

entries.en:
"I would simply like you to extract the subject from confinement on $jabr_marketOnOrAt $jabr_marketName, located $jabr_dist light-years away. Doing it quietly would be preferable, but sometimes these matters escape our control. Try not to offend the $jabr_marketFaction too much; it would draw unwanted attention. Once you liberate the subject, you will receive $jabr_reward credits to your accounts."

"I suspect that they're expecting a break attempt, so I acquired this." $HeOrShe taps at a TriPad and your corresponding system receives detailed reports on the troop deployments and infiltration defenses of $jabr_marketName. A quick review suggests that you'd need around $jabr_marines marines to carry off the operation.
entries.zh:
"任务是从 $jabr_dist 光年外的 $jabr_marketName 上解救目标。最好能不留痕迹，但这种情况有时我们也没法掌控。尽量不要太得罪了 $jabr_marketFaction}，否则就可能引起不必要的关注。任务目标获释后，{$jabr_reward 星币会被打进你的账户。"

"我怀疑他们正在为应对突袭做准备，所以我想办法搞到了这个。" $HeOrShe按了按 TriPad，你的数据平板上收到了驻军部署以及反渗透措施的详细报告。快速浏览之后你觉得需要 $jabr_marines 名陆战队员才能完成这次任务。

entries.en:
The target is disheveled, and looks to have gone some time without sleep. They have one of those perfectly ordinary faces; just another tech, clerk, or laborer that passes by on the transport tube. All that trouble, for this?

"Thank you captain," they give a wan smile as your guards lead them to a secure compartment, "I'm expected home now, I'm sure."
entries.zh:
目标蓬头垢面，看起来已经有一段时间没有睡过觉了。对方相当的相貌平平；就像你平时不会多加留意的，从货运通道中经过的技术人员、职员或工人。弄得如此麻烦，就为了这么个人？

"谢谢你，舰长，" 当你的警卫把那人领到一个安全的舱室时，对方脸色苍白地笑了笑，"我敢笃定我现在想家想死了。"

o.en: Try to negotiate to have the dues waived
Accept League membership on the given terms
o.zh: 接受给定的联盟成员条件

entries.en:
The comm-link flickers as it establishes the connection. Error codes flash by - outdated protocols and unauthorized modifications.

The pirate $rank appears, arms crossed. "Captain $playerName. I bring you greetings from the Warlord Kanta, mighty and ruthless. She has been watching your career and is pleased that you are prospering under her protection agreement."

This must be about the agreement you made, to do Kanta a 'favor' in exchange for her protection.
entries.zh:
通讯频道闪烁着建立了链接。面前各类报错信号闪烁不停，似乎是因为过期的程式协定以及未经许可的改装。

海盗 $rank 出现在频道里，双臂抱胸。" $playerName 舰长。强大以及残酷的 Kanta 军阀吩咐我向你带来问候。她一直关注着你的生涯，也很欣慰你能在她的保护下繁荣昌盛。"

这必然是关于之前你做的约定，卖 Kanta 一个 '人情' 以获得她的保护。

entries.en: "The Warlord Kanta wishes for you to perform a tactical bombardment," $heOrShe glances at a battered datapad, "on the military base of $affk_marketName. This shall demonstrate that none who cross Kanta may escape her reach!"
entries.zh: "军阀 Kanta 想要你执行一次战术轰炸。" $heOrShe看向一个残破不堪的数据平板。"目标是 $affk_marketName 的军事基地。这将向所有人证明，任何与 Kanta 为敌的人都无法逃脱她的制裁！"

o.en: It is my pleasure to fulfill the Warlord's wishes. (accept)
o.zh: 能为军阀效劳是我的荣幸。 (接受)

o.en: No, there has to be some alternative. (decline)
o.zh: 不，肯定还有其他办法。 (拒绝)

o.en: Are you mad? Bombard $affk_marketName? It's suicide. (decline)
o.zh: 你疯了？轰炸 $affk_marketName？这是自杀。 (拒绝)

entries.en: The pirate produces a thin, mocking smile which displays $hisOrHer sharpened teeth, and says "No, that's not 'it', captain."
entries.zh: 海盗讥笑一声，露出$hisOrHer的尖牙，说到。"不，不是 '就这样'，舰长。"

entries.en: The pirate produces a thin, mocking smile which displays $hisOrHer sharpened teeth.
entries.zh: 海盗讥笑一声，露出$hisOrHer的尖牙。

entries.en:
The comm-link flickers, freezes, and restarts as your comms protocols align with whatever the pirate is using.

The pirate $rank appears, a smug look already emplaced. "Captain $playerName. I am here on behalf of her mercilessness, Warlord Kanta. It is her wish that you know her many eyes are watching over you."

$HeOrShe smiles, displaying teeth filed to points. "That is all."
entries.zh:
在通讯链接闪断定格并重启了好几次之后，你的通讯器才匹配上了海盗用的不知啥鬼玩意通信协议。

海盗 $rank 出现在了画面上，洋洋得意的神情溢于言表。" $playerName 舰长，我代表无情的军阀 Kanta 来这。那位大人希望你明白她有许多双眼睛在注视着你。"

$HeOrShe微笑着，露出被锉尖的牙齿。"就是这些。"

The pirate $rank appears, a smug look already emplaced. "Captain $playerName. I am here on behalf of her mercilessness, Warlord Kanta. It is her wish that you know that her many eyes are watching you."

$HeOrShe smiles, displaying teeth filed to points. "That is all."

$HeOrShe微笑着，露出被锉尖的牙齿。"就是这些。"

The comm-link flickers as it establishes the connection. Some error codes flash by, something about outdated protocols and unauthorized modifications.

The pirate $rank appears, arms crossed. "Captain $playerName. I bring you greetings from the Warlord Kanta. She has been watching your career and is pleased that you are prospering under her protection agreement."
entries.zh:
通讯频道闪烁着建立了链接。面前各类报错信号闪烁不停，似乎是因为过期的程式协定以及未经许可的改装。

海盗 $rank 出现在频道里，双臂抱胸。" $playerName 舰长。强大以及残酷的 Kanta 军阀吩咐我向你带来问候。她一直关注着你的生涯，也很欣慰你能在她的保护下繁荣昌盛。"

entries.en:
"Nothing," $heOrShe says. "Yet."

The pirate flashes a sharp-toothed smile, diamond canines flashing, then hits the comms cutoff.
entries.zh:
"没什么。" $heOrShe说到，"现在还没。"

海盗咧着钻石尖牙笑了下，随后按下了通讯中断按钮。

entries.en:
"Yes," $heOrShe says, unamused at your flippant remark, "You should be thankful. You have been spared the Warlord Kanta's thirst for blood and ruin. For now."

$HeOrShe leans in, "When that thirst awakens, you will provide her with what she demands." The pirate flashes a sharp-toothed smile, diamond canines flashing, "One way, or another."

$HeOrShe hits the comms cutoff.
entries.zh:
"是的。" $heOrShe说到，明显对你轻率的回复不以为然。"你该感到庆幸。军阀 Kanta 目前还没打算从你这里满足她对流血和毁灭的饥渴。"

$HeOrShe倾向屏幕。"等那饥渴来临，你会给与她她所求之物的。" 海盗咧着闪光的钻石尖牙笑了下。"不论怎样都会。"

$HeOrShe敲下了通讯中断按钮。

o.en: Send the digital token given to you by Gargoyle
o.zh: 将 Gargoyle 给你的数字令牌发给他

o.en: I want to arrange an audience with Warlord Kanta. It concerns my colonies.
o.zh: 我希望能安排一次觐见军阀 Kanta 的机会，这关系到我的殖民地。

o.en: Would it help if I said 'please'?
o.zh: 如果我说 '请' 的话会有用吗？

o.en: I'm not a desk pilot trying to look big on comms, I'll tell you that much.
o.zh: 我可不是个只会在通讯里装逼的文职飞行员，你给我听好了。

entries.en:
"Here's some truth to chew on: you're not talkin' to Kanta. Only family gets in. Or maybe if you're lord-and-master of your own corner of this dead Domain doing real high-credits business. Maybe."

"Understand?"
entries.zh:
"和你说点真话，好好想想：你和 Kanta 说不上话的。只有亲戚才行。或者你是这死去的 人之领 中哪个小角落里做着超大星币生意的领主。那也只是有可能而已。"

"懂？"

entries.en: "Uhhh, confirm that, shuttle. Negative to request," traffic control says, "Incoming shuttle cleared for, uh, landing at bay 12. Proceed."
entries.zh: "呃嗯，知道了，开穿梭机的。不用找老大问了。" 负责交通管制的人说道，"前来的穿梭机可以，呃，降落在 12 号港。继续。"

entries.en:
You transfer a fractional credit over to the thug running traffic control, enough to cover a generous meal or a round of cheap drinks.

"Eh, here's one to brighten today," control says enthusiastically, "Me, I like going halfsies with the fry, bit-a each. Shuttle, you're cleared to land at munitions bay 12."
entries.zh:
你将小数点后几位的微量星币转给负责交通管控的恶棍，那足够买一顿丰盛的大餐或是喝一轮便宜的酒。

"嘿，这倒是能让今天亮堂点儿。" 管控人员热情地说到，"我晚点会弄份炸货双拼，每样都来点。开穿梭机的，你可以在第 12 号军用补给港口着陆。"

o.en: Let someone important know that I'm here to see Warlord Kanta.
o.zh: 告诉随便哪个管事儿的，说我是来见军阀 Kanta 的。

entries.en: "Uhh," says control, "You mean the portboss? Or, er, station king? Or you mean t-the..."
entries.zh: "呃..." 交管说道，"你是说港口老大？还是，呃，空间站之王？又或是你指的是那...那个..."

entries.en: "Um, copy that shuttle," the comms crackle, "Uh, hold. Um, please."
entries.zh: "呃，收到了，开穿梭机的。" 通讯中传来了不小的杂音，"呃，稍等。嗯，请稍等一下。"

o.en: Take a shuttle down to meet Kanta
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机下去见 Kanta

o.en: Take a shuttle to meet Kanta
Take a shuttle down to meet Kanta
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机下去见 Kanta

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName!" He turns, projecting a piercing voice to all corners. "It has been heard by the many ears of our Queen that you believe your every act, from one end of the Sector to the other, is done in Kanta's name already!"

"Did you not claim to be 'working for' our dear warlord?" The small man strains and sweats as he accuses you. "Did not her fear-inspiring name cross your lips... without her permission? Do you presume, captain, to know the will of our mighty-"

With the sound of grating metal, Cydonia's tirade is cut off. The Warlord Kanta stands up on armored mechanical legs. There's a thrashing, banging sound.
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长！\" 他转身，把尖利的嗓音送向殿堂每个角落，\"我们女王耳目众多，早已听说你自认从星域这头到那头的每一桩举动，都是打着 Kanta 的名号办下的！"

"你不是自称在'为我们亲爱的军阀效力'吗？\" 这矮子指摘你时涨红了脸、直冒汗，\"她那令人闻风丧胆的名号，不是没经她准许就从你嘴里溜出来了？舰长，你竟敢揣度我们伟大的——"

一阵金属摩擦的刺耳声响，Cydonia 的连声指摘戛然而止。军阀 Kanta 撑着覆甲的机械腿站了起来。跟着是一通翻撞、砸打的动静。

entries.en:
Laughter. That's what it is. Kanta's laughter like autocannon shell-cases dropping from an ejection port. Metal on metal, industrialized murder.

"Your presumption amuses us," Kanta's amplified voice booms out over the court, drowning out all else. "So eager to serve us, are you? Then tell us, how shall you serve?"

Cydonia's mouth is a flat, twitching line.
entries.zh:
是笑。原来是笑。Kanta 的笑声像自动炮的弹壳从抛壳口纷纷落下，金属碰着金属，是流水线造出来的杀戮。

"你这份放肆逗乐了我们，" Kanta 经放大的嗓音压过全场一切声响，轰然滚过殿堂，"这么急着为我们效劳，是么？那你说说，你打算怎么效劳？"

Cydonia 的嘴抿成一条微微抽动的直线。

o.en: I seek the Warlord Kanta's protection.
o.zh: 我求军阀 Kanta 的庇护。

entries.en: There is murmuring from the crowd of pirates as they jostle, metallic clinks and scrapes coming from their brazenly displayed weapons and combat armor.
entries.zh: 海盗人群相互推挤，低声议论着，那些毫不遮掩亮出来的武器与战斗护甲叮当、刮擦作响。

entries.en:
There is dark murmuring from the crowd of pirates as they jostle, metallic clinks and scrapes coming from their brazenly displayed weapons and combat armor.

Kanta's metal body hisses on her throne, patient as a landmine. Cydonia glares at you then leans over to whisper something to some pirate sergeant. The pirate makes a face as he catches himself pulling away from Cydonia.
entries.zh:
海盗人群相互推挤，压着嗓子的窃窃私语里透出不祥，那些毫不遮掩亮出来的武器与战斗护甲叮当、刮擦作响。

Kanta 的金属身躯在王座上嘶嘶作响，耐心得像一枚地雷。Cydonia 瞪了你一眼，随即侧身对某个海盗军士耳语了几句。那海盗察觉自己下意识往旁边躲了躲，脸上不由得做了个怪相。

o.en: Say something impressive yet meaningless, then leave
o.zh: 说一通听着气派却空洞无物的场面话，然后离开

o.en: I am no thief. I come openly, having taken this prize from your kin.
o.zh: 我不是贼。我堂堂正正地来，这件战利品是从你的亲族手里夺的。

o.en: My services. In exchange for Elissa Zal.
o.zh: 我出手效力。换 Elissa Zal。

o.en: I'll waste no time. I'm here for Elissa Zal.
o.zh: 我就不绕弯子了。我为 Elissa Zal 而来。
我为 Elissa Zal 而来。

entries.en:
Cydonia nods stiff-necked, the tiniest hint of a bow, then addresses you before the entire court.

"You've come crawling to her worshipfulness," he turns, projecting a piercing voice to all corners. "The mighty Warlord Kanta; the predator of the Persean Sector; the font of violence from which we quench our thirst for glory," then spins back toward you with surprising agility.

"Why are YOU here? Too feeble to protect your own $shipOrFleet? Perhaps," his voice drops to almost a whisper, "it is something else?"
entries.zh:
Cydonia 脖子僵硬地点了点头，微微欠身几乎看不出来，随即当着满朝众人开口。

"你匍匐着来见至尊女王陛下了，" 他转身，把尖利的嗓音送向殿堂每个角落，"威名赫赫的军阀 Kanta；英仙座星域的掠食者；那供我们解荣耀之渴的暴力之泉，" 说罢又敏捷得出奇地旋回身来对着你。

"你为何在此？是护不住自己的 $shipOrFleet 么？又或者，\" 他声音压得近乎耳语，\"是另有缘故？"

entries.en:
Cydonia nods stiff-necked, the tiniest hint of a bow, then addresses you before the entire court.

"You've come crawling to her worshipfulness," he turns, projecting a piercing voice to all corners. "The mighty Warlord Kanta; the predator of the Persean Sector; the font of violence from which we quench our thirst for glory," then spins back toward you with surprising agility.

"Why are YOU here? Could you not protect your own outposts? Perhaps," his voice drops to almost a whisper, "it is something else?"
entries.zh:
Cydonia 脖子僵硬地点了点头，微微欠身几乎看不出来，随即当着满朝众人开口。

"你匍匐着来见至尊女王陛下了，" 他转身，把尖利的嗓音送向殿堂每个角落，"威名赫赫的军阀 Kanta；英仙座星域的掠食者；那供我们解荣耀之渴的暴力之泉，" 说罢又敏捷得出奇地旋回身来对着你。

"你究竟为何在此？连自己的据点都护不住么？又或者，\" 他声音压得近乎耳语，\"是另有缘故？"

entries.en:
Cydonia nods stiff-necked, the tiniest hint of a bow, then addresses you before the entire court: "You bear a token of Kanta's kin, Nashyan, who is of the outer family! But Nashyan never gave you this token- I checked."

Now the guards react, leveling their weapons. Not training them on you yet.
entries.zh:
Cydonia 脖子僵硬地点了点头，微微欠身几乎看不出来，随即当着满朝众人对你说道："你带着 Kanta 亲族 Nashyan 的信物，而 Nashyan 是外家的人！可这信物从来不是 Nashyan 给你的——我查过了。"

卫兵这才有了反应，纷纷端平武器，只是还没对准你。

entries.en:
Cydonia nods stiff-necked, the tiniest insinuation of a bow, then addresses you.

"See now how Captain $playerName crawls before her worshipfulness!" He turns slowly, projecting his piercing voice to all corners. "Safe under the protection of the merciless Warlord Kanta; safe like a little fetus in a birthing tank. See how those prosper who appease her desires!"

He spins back toward you. "Besides supplicating yourself before our queen of blood," he hisses, "Why have you come?"
entries.zh:
Cydonia 脖子僵硬地点了点头，欠身的意思淡得几乎只是个暗示，随后对你开口。

"都来瞧瞧，$playerName 舰长是怎样匍匐在至尊女王陛下脚下的！\" 他缓缓转身，把尖利的嗓音送向殿堂每个角落，\"托无情军阀 Kanta 的庇护而安稳；安稳得像育婴舱里一个小小的胎儿。看看顺了她心意的人何等兴旺！"

他旋回身来对着你。"除了向血之女王苦苦哀告，" 他压着嗓子嘶声道，"你还有何贵干？"

entries.en:
Cydonia shakes his head slowly, arms crossed, looking down at you with showy disapproval.

He gives a shrill shout, "See this wretched worm before you!" Turning slowly to address all the court, he berates you. "This blind simpleton, this ungrateful fool. What madness compelled $playerName to throw off Kanta's gift of protection, given so dearly?"

The crowd boos and jeers, calling for your blood to spill on the agrav plates, or to boil away in the vacuum as merciless as their queen. Cydonia looks pleased with himself. Kanta sits, impassive, respirators hissing like serpents coiled to strike.
entries.zh:
Cydonia 抱着双臂，缓缓摇头，刻意摆出一副不以为然的神色俯视着你。

他尖声喊道："都看看眼前这条可怜虫！" 慢慢转过身面向满朝，数落起你来，"这个睁眼瞎的蠢货，这个忘恩负义的东西。是哪门子疯劲，叫 $playerName 把 Kanta 那般厚赐的庇护亲手扔了？"

满场嘘声与讥骂四起，嚷着要你的血洒在反重力甲板上，或是像他们那位女王一般无情地沸散在真空里。Cydonia 一副自得的模样。Kanta 端坐着不动声色，呼吸器嘶嘶作响，活像蓄势待发的盘蛇。

entries.en:
You can almost pick out a pattern of relations in their faces - this is a family business - and in their anarchic uniforms.

They're bedecked in prizes, modified combat armor plated with gold and gems, stolen high-end vacsuits redone in off-brand colors, Tri-Tachyon neck-scarves crudely knotted; ostentatious luxury wear.

The pirates wear their wealth on the outside, the more garish the better.
entries.zh: 你几乎能从他们的脸上看出亲缘关系 —— 这是个家族买卖 —— 他们身上都是毫无章法的制服也说明了这一点。他们佩戴着奖章，穿着饰有黄金和宝石的战斗装甲，还有偷来的高端真空服 —— 重新漆上了杂牌颜色，还戴着粗鲁打结的速子科技领巾，都是些炫耀的奢侈穿着。他们将自己的财富穿在外表上，越花哨越好。

entries.en:
Past pitted blast doors hung with crimson skull-banners, a large bay opens. The lingering acrid scent of energy weapon discharge hangs in the air, almost but not quite concealing the odor of rotting meat.

You're brought before what can only be described as a throne, tastelessly backlit in blood-red for maximum effect. The caps, badges, and insignia of various naval officers are impaled on fused blossoms of trophy weapons. You recognize kit from all of the polities of the Persean Sector.
entries.zh:
穿过挂着深红色骷髅横幅的斑驳防爆舱门，一个大隔间打开了。能量武器开火后留下的刺鼻气味弥漫在空气中，但还是盖不住这里的腐肉臭味。

你被带到一个只能被称为王座的地方前，不雅的血红色背光灯以最大功率从其后方投射出来。很多海军军官的军帽、奖章和徽章被穿刺在由战利品武器熔成的花簇上。你认出英仙座星域每个势力的装备都在其中。

entries.en:
Above all is the hissing, thrumming figure of Warlord Jorien Kanta, more machine now than human. Her face is a mask. What skin you can see is leathery like the rad scarring of old spacers.

A synthesized voice booms from the throne, "Submit before Kanta!"
entries.zh:
在其上是发出嘶嘶声和嗡嗡声的军阀 Jorien Kanta，她现在比起人类更像一台机器。她的脸就是个面具。你能看到的皮肤就像是老宇宙民的红色疤痕一样坚硬。

合成的嗓音从王座中发出，"在 Kanta 面前屈服！"

entries.en:
Before her a strange, small man hunches. He wears some parody of a doctor's surgical garb.

"You had best kneel," the doctor hisses.
entries.zh:
在她前面是一个奇怪的小个子男人，弓着身子。他穿着一种医生外科手术服的滑稽的仿制品。

"你最好跪下。" 医生低声说道。

entries.en:
If a broken atmo scrubber could laugh, it might sound like the noise that comes from Kanta.

"A kneeler!" she shouts. Her guards remain relaxed. "We see you know who is strong here. Know your place. Kanta will watch over you."

The doctor grimaces bloodlessly.
entries.zh:
如果坏掉的空气净化器能发出笑声的话，那估计和 Kanta 现在发出的声音差不多。

"一个下跪者！" 她喊道。她的卫兵神情自若。"咱家能让你明白谁是这里的强者。认清自己是个什么角色，Kanta 监视着你。"

医生做出了面无血色的扭曲表情。

entries.en:
If a broken atmo scrubber could laugh, it might sound like the noise that comes from Kanta.

"A stander!" she shouts.

You note that her guards remain relaxed. "We like you. A heggie would kneel in the mud because all they know is following and groveling. You stand like a spacer."

Her head tracks you. "Kanta will hear you."
entries.zh:
如果损坏的大气清洁器能够发笑，那么 Kanta 发出的噪音大概与它很相近。

"一个站立者！" 她喊道。你注意到她的守卫神情自若。"咱家喜欢你。一个霸主佬只会跪在污泥之中，因为他们只知道顺从和卑躬屈膝。而你像一个宇宙民一样站着。"

她将脑袋对着你。"Kanta 会聆听你的话语。"

entries.en: The small doctor steps forward and clears his throat, and says "I am Doctor Cydonia, personal assistant to the warlord."
entries.zh: 小个子医生走上前清了清嗓子说，"我是 Cydonia 医生，军阀的私人助理。"

entries.en: Your request cycles for a minute, then routes to a different link.
entries.zh: 你的请求转圈圈转了一分钟，然后转到一个不同的链接。

entries.en: Your request cycles for a minute, then routes to a different link.
entries.zh: 你的请求转圈圈转了一分钟，然后转到一个不同的链接。

entries.en: "Yeah, who're you?" $personName snarls. "And what makes you think you can show your rotten vis on this line asking for big K? She's ent gonna talk to any mudboot that crawls aboard unless it's to tell 'em about their one-way trip to join the disk, ha-ha."
entries.zh: "嗯？你丫谁啊？" $personName 不耐烦地说，"是什么让你觉得自己可以在这条线路上展示你的烂脸，求见 K 老大？她可不会随便和哪个爬上空间站的泥腿子说话，除非是要让那家伙去外面的吸积盘来趟单程旅行，哈哈。"

entries.en: "Yeah, who're you?" $personName snarls before bothering to glance at a grimy datapad. "Ah," $hisOrHer demeanor shifts hostility down several levels. "You again. Right, right."
entries.zh: "对，你谁？" $personName 吼罢，才不耐烦地扫了一眼脏兮兮的数据平板。"啊..." $hisOrHer的举止像是将敌意降低了好几个等级，"又是你。对，对。"

entries.en:
The portking of Kanta's Den appears before you with all of $hisOrHer singular charm. "You blasted, bloody rad-addled fool! You think you can vac-drop the Warlord's pet then just dance yourself back into her home? Them is some brassies you've got $playerName, but you got 'em instead of brains. I almost respect it."

$HeOrShe spits, the projectile presumably landing on $hisOrHer own control interface, "But only almost. Meantime, I'll be sittin' and smilin' watching all Kanta's underbosses fight for the chance to slag your flagship."
entries.zh:
Kanta 之巢的港口之王带着$hisOrHer那独特的魅力出现在你面前。"你这个该死的，叫辐射烧坏脑子的傻逼！你觉得你可以把军阀的宠物扔进真空里，然后再跳着舞回她家来？你胆可真大，$playerName，不过你也只是胆大无脑了。我几乎都要佩服你了。"

$HeOrShe啐了一口，口水大概溅在了$hisOrHer自己的控制界面上，"但也只是几乎而已。现在老子就要坐这儿，笑着看 Kanta 手下的所有小头目为争夺把你旗舰轰他妈稀烂的机会大打出手。"

entries.en: After an exceptionally rude gesture, the comms cut out.
entries.zh: 在一个极其粗鄙的手势过后，通讯就被切断了。

entries.en:
Kanta's Station King grins as the transfer comes through.

"Anyone gives you trouble? Tell 'em I said you're seeing the Warlord 'cause I said so."

$HeOrShe gives you a nod that's probably meant to be equal parts intimidating and reassuring.
entries.zh:
Kanta 的空间站之王见钱转来了便咧嘴笑了起来。

"谁要是敢惹你麻烦？你就讲是我叫你去见了军阀。"

$HeOrShe朝你点了点头，大概一半是威胁一半是鼓励的意思。

entries.en:
"Um," the pirate chews on something while appearing to examine you.

"You already paid up. It's all arranged. Though uh, if you don't remember... you wanna pay again?
entries.zh:
"呃，" 海盗一边嚼着些什么一边打量着你。

"你已经给过钱了。已经妥了。不过呃，如果你记不清了...你还想再给一次么？

entries.en:
You leave four guards and the pilot with your shuttle. Two more guards follow you. A pirate enforcer gives you an unpleasant look and steps directly into your path.

Surprisingly, they begin with what sounds like an attempt at a conciliatory tone, "Look friend, Kanta won't be seeing you this time. The warlord only speaks when there's real big business to talk. If you're not family or lord an' master of your own planet, might as well give up."

They smile crookedly, "Give the bars a visit, get destroyed, have some fun. Market's open, or the docks."
entries.zh:
你把四名警卫和驾驶员留在穿梭机上。又另外带上两名警卫跟着你，一名海盗执法者用不愉快的眼神盯着你，挡在你前面。

那人用一种令人吃惊的、听起来像在缓和紧张气氛的语气开口道："听着伙计，Kanta 这次不会接见你。军阀只会在有大桩生意的时候才会出面。除非你是她的哪位亲戚、或者哪个星球的所有者，不然就不用白费劲儿了。"

对方摇头晃脑地笑起来："去酒吧逛逛吧，要么被胖揍一顿、要么搞点乐子。市场和港口都开张呢。"

o.en: I really must speak with Kanta.
o.zh: 我真的必须跟 Kanta 谈谈

o.en: Are you going to stop me?
See what else can be bought on Kanta's Den
o.zh: 看看在 Kanta 之巢有什么值得买的

entries.en:
You get a regretful look.

"Like I said, it's only happening if you're family or overlord of your own little corner of the corpse of the Sector. Them's the rules."
entries.zh: 那人露出了一个遗憾的神色。"就和我说的那样，只有亲戚或者你是这片星域的尸体中哪个小角落里的领主才行。这就是规矩。"

entries.en: You step away and take in the concourse as if you never meant to talk to Kanta anyway. The pirate makes no comment.
entries.zh: 你走开了几步并参观起了港区，好像本来就没想和 Kanta 谈话一样。那个海盗也没说什么。

entries.en:
"Naw, friend."

They glance over a shoulder at a squad of heavily armed ruffians lounging around an enormous armored door inscribed with a skull motif.

"But they will."
entries.zh:
"不，朋友。" 那人回头看了眼在雕刻着骷髅图案的巨大装甲门旁边晃悠的一队重装暴徒。

"但他们会。"

entries.en:
You leave four guards and the pilot with your shuttle. Two more guards follow you. A pirate enforcer gives you an unpleasant look and steps directly into your path.

They begin in a surprisingly conciliatory tone, "Look friend, Kanta won't be seeing you this time. The warlord only speaks when there's real big business to talk. If you're not family or lord an' master of your own planet, might as well give up."

"Give the bars a visit, get destroyed, have some fun. Market's open, or the docks. I won't even make trouble about your transponder being on."

They smile crookedly.
entries.zh:
你把四名警卫和驾驶员留在穿梭机上。又另外带上两名警卫跟着你，一名海盗执法者用不愉快的眼神盯着你，挡在你前面。

那人用一种令人吃惊的、听起来像在缓和紧张气氛的语气开口道："听着伙计，Kanta 这次不会接见你。军阀只会在有大桩生意的时候才会出面。除非你是她的哪位亲戚、或者哪个星球的所有者，不然就不用白费劲儿了。"

"去酒吧逛逛吧，要么被胖揍一顿、要么搞点乐子。市场和港口都开张呢。我甚至不会因为你的应答器还开着就找你麻烦，" 对方摇头晃脑地笑了起来。

o.en: I really must speak with Kanta.
o.zh: 我非得跟 Kanta 谈谈不可。

o.en: Are you going to stop me?
See what else can be bought on Kanta's Den
o.zh: 看看 Kanta's Den 上还能买到些什么

entries.en:
You leave four guards and the pilot at your shuttle. Two more guards follow you, and the pirate lieutenant sent to meet you nods that this is correct.

You're led through a primary access corridor toward the center of the station. You adjust quickly to disjointed agrav fields, an effect you suspect is intentional as ranks of pirates of all shapes and ages eye you for weakness, murmuring crude comments and jostling for prestige.
entries.zh:
你把四名警卫和驾驶员留在穿梭机上。又有两名警卫跟着你，派来引见的海盗上尉点头表示没错。

你被带领穿过通向空间站中心的主通道。你很快就适应了这里杂乱无章的人工重力场，你怀疑这是故意所为。与此同时，各种各样、各个年龄的海盗都在盯着你寻找弱点，或是低声说着粗话，或是推搡着争抢风头。

entries.en:
Two guards accompany you onto the station while the rest wait with the shuttle. This is how it is done here.

You're led by one of Kanta's lieutenants toward the center of the station, adjusting to the disjointed agrav fields. Pirates of all shapes and ages eye you for weakness; they're bedecked in prizes, modified combat armor plated with gold and gems, stolen high-end vacsuits, knotted neck-scarves, ostentatious luxury wear.

They wear their spoils, the more garish the better.
entries.zh:
两名警卫跟着你前往空间站，其余的留在了穿梭机上等待。这儿的规矩就是这样。

你被 Kanta 的一个中尉领着前往空间站中心，适应了这里杂乱无章的人工重力场。各种各样、不同年龄的海盗都在打量着你，寻找每一丝破绽；他们佩戴着奖章，穿着饰有黄金和宝石的战斗装甲，还有偷来的高端真空服 —— 重新漆上了杂牌颜色，还戴着粗鲁打结的速子科技领巾，都是些炫耀的奢侈穿着。

他们将自己的财富穿在外表上，越花哨越好。

entries.en:
Past pitted blast doors hung with crimson skull-banners, a large bay opens. The lingering acrid scent of energy weapon discharge hangs in the air, almost but not quite concealing the odor of rotting meat.

You're brought before Kanta's throne, tastelessly backlit in blood-red. The caps, badges, and insignia of various naval officers are impaled on fused blossoms of trophy weapons. Above all is the hissing, thrumming figure of Warlord Jorien Kanta, more machine now than human. Her face is a mask. What skin you can see is space-cured leather.

The maybe-doctor, Cydonia, lurks near the base of her throne. He steps forward, "Behold!" he shrieks, "The court of Warlord Kanta, queen by blood-conquest, is in session!"
entries.zh:
穿过挂着深红色骷髅横幅的斑驳防爆舱门，一个大隔间打开了。能量武器开火后留下的刺鼻气味弥漫在空气中，但还是盖不住这里的腐肉臭味。

你被带到了 Kanta 的王座前，不雅的血红色背光灯从其后方投射出来。很多海军军官的军帽、奖章和徽章被刺穿在由战利品武器熔成的花簇上。在其上是发出嘶嘶声和嗡嗡声的军阀 Jorien Kanta，她现在比起人类更像一台机器。她的脸就是个面具。你能看到的皮肤就像是老航行家的红色疤痕一样坚硬。

那个大概是医生的家伙，Cydonia，就在她的王座下伏着。他上前一步，"觐见！" 他尖声叫道，"鲜血征讨的女皇，军阀 Kanta 的王室，开庭了！"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe blinks at you.

"Why're you talking to me, then? Call her yourself," $heOrShe says with a snort.
OR
"Kanta? Ha-ha, I'll just ask if she's free."

$HeOrShe lets that hang for a moment.

"You get hit on the head? You don't just - talk - to the Warlord. Need's you a real good reason. Anyway, not up to me," $heOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms. "Ask the station king."
OR
"Yeah? That'll have to be too bad 'cause I just do my bit, and if she wants something, someone tells me. Only goes one way."

$HeOrShe leans back, satisfied with that explanation.
OR
"Talk to the station king," $heOrShe says brusquely. "Not for me to say who gets to see the pirate queen."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe冲你眨了眨眼。

"那你为什么要和我说话？你自己打给她吧。" $heOrShe冷笑道。
OR
"Kanta？哈哈，如果她有空我会向她问问的。"

$HeOrShe将链接挂起了一会儿。

"你脑子被驴踢了？你不能这么随便就和军阀大人通话，你总得找个说得过去的由头吧。总之，不是由我说了算。" $heOrShe双手抱胸。"找空间站之王去。"
OR
"是吗？那就太糟糕了，因为我只是做我的工作，如果她想要什么，有人会告诉我。只有这一条路可走。"

$HeOrShe向后靠了靠，对这个解释很满意。
OR
"跟空间站之王谈谈吧，" $HeOrShe很不耐烦。"我不能说谁能见到海盗女王。"

o.en: I want to talk to Kanta.
I want to talk to Kanta.
I'd like to meet the Warlord Kanta.

entries.en:
$PersonName gives you an imperious look.

"And just what makes you think you can show your rotten vis on my comms and ask for Queen K?"
entries.zh:
$PersonName 摆出一副居高临下的神色。

"你凭什么觉得，能把你那张烂脸凑到我的通讯上，开口就要见 Queen K？"

entries.en: The vid feed flickers to life, a wash of static and audio distortion receding as your datapad adjusts for outdated comm protocols.
entries.zh: 视频画面闪烁着接通了，你的数据平板调整着过时的通讯链接，静电雪花和音频失真逐渐减弱了。

entries.en:
You hit the send command and the token is transmitted. Instantly you see the pirate's face change expression.

"Oh. Family, huh? Didn't recognize your face, cap. You don't got the family look; but ha-ha, the Kantas' they are everywhere 'eh? Ludd's hells, you should have said something before I go off broadsiding you."

"You know the drill. The warlord doesn't like comms, so we'll have to make you an appointment with the court. Get your boots on-station and I'll have someone meet you."
entries.zh:
你按下了发送键送出了电子令牌，当场就看到这个海盗脸色大变。

"哦。家族，嗯？没有认出你来，你看上去也和什么家族无关。但，哈哈，Kanta 的人无处不在是吧？见了卢德个鬼了，你早该在我开火前说一声的。"

"你知道规矩，军阀不喜欢用通讯器，所以我必须给你约一次御前会议。你人到空间站上来，我会找人来接你。"

entries.en: "Yeah, who're you?" $personName snarls before glancing at a grimy datapad. "Guess you're nobody, huh."
entries.zh: "喂，你谁啊？\" $personName 先恶声恶气地吼了一句，才扫了眼那块脏兮兮的数据板，\"看来是个无名小卒，哈。"

entries.en:
"Yeah, who're you?" $personName snarls before bothering to glance at a grimy datapad.

"Ah," $hisOrHer demeanor shifts hostility down several levels. "You again. Right, right."
entries.zh:
"喂，你谁啊？" $personName 恶声恶气地吼道，这才懒得抬眼扫一下那块脏兮兮的数据板。

"啊，\" $hisOrHer 的敌意登时降了好几档，\"是你啊。对，对。"

entries.en: The vid feed flickers to life, a wash of static and audio distortion receding as your datapad adjusts for outdated comm protocols.
entries.zh: 影像信号闪了几下亮起来，一片雪花与杂音随着数据板适配老旧通讯协议渐渐退去。

entries.en:
The vid feed flickers to life, a wash of static and audio distortion receding as your datapad adjusts for outdated comm protocols. The portking of Kanta's Den appears before you with all of $hisOrHer singular charm.

"You blasted, bloody rad-addled fool! You think you can vac-drop the Warlord's pet then just dance yourself back into her home? Them is some brassies you've got $playerName, but you got 'em instead of brains. I almost respect it."

$HeOrShe spits, the projectile appearing to land on $hisOrHer own control interface. "But only almost. Meantime, I'll be sittin' and smilin' watching all Kanta's underbosses fight for the chance to slag your flagship."
entries.zh:
影像信号闪了几下亮起来，一片雪花与杂音随着数据板适配老旧通讯协议渐渐退去。Kanta's Den 的港主出现在你面前，带着 $hisOrHer 那份独一份的魅力。

"你这该死的、脑子被辐射烤糊的蠢货！把军阀的宠儿丢进真空，转头还想大摇大摆回她家里来？$playerName，你这份胆子倒是够硬，可惜长的是胆子不是脑子。我差点都要敬你几分。"

$HeOrShe 啐了一口，那口东西看着落回了 $hisOrHer 自己的操作台上。"也就差点。眼下我且坐着看戏，笑看 Kanta 麾下那群头目争着抢着，要把你的旗舰熔成一堆废渣。"

entries.en: After an exceptionally rude gesture, the comms are cut.
entries.zh: 对方比了个极其无礼的手势，通讯随即被切断。

"Yeah, who're you?" $personName snarls before bothering to glance at a grimy datapad.

"Ah," $heOrShe grunts, dropping the datapad with a clatter. "I see now. You ent nothing, are you. Got a fleet, have you. Got business to talk?"

"对，你谁？"$personName 吼罢，才不耐烦地扫了一眼脏兮兮的数据平板。

"啊。" $heOrShe咕哝了一声，哗啦一声扔掉了数据平板。"我现在明白了。你也不是什么阿猫阿狗。有一两个殖民地是吧。有生意要谈吗？"

entries.en: "Yeah, who're you?" $personName snarls before bothering to glance at a grimy datapad. $heOrShe grunts, dropping the datapad with a clatter. "You're nothing. Why are you here, wasting my time?"
entries.zh: "对，你谁？" $personName 吼罢，才不耐烦地扫了一眼脏兮兮的数据平板。然后$heOrShe满口抱怨地把数据平板响亮地摔到了一旁。"你算老几？来这干啥？浪费我的时间？"

o.en: Take a shuttle to Kanta's Den
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前往 Kanta 之巢

entries.en: "Yeah, yeah. That'll be $kpBribeAmount credits," $heOrShe says. "For, ah, administrative expenses."
entries.zh: "是啊，是啊。总共是 $kpBribeAmount 星币的..." $heOrShe说道，"嗯，行政费用。"

o.en: This is... piracy. I'll make the transfer now.
o.zh: 这简直是...海盗行为。我现在就转账。

entries.en: "Yeah, uh. I am once again asking for $kpBribeAmount credits for..." $heOrShe thinks for a moment. "Administrative expenses. Yeah, that was it."
entries.zh: "对了，呃。我又打算要收 $kpBribeAmount 的星币当..." $heOrShe想了想，"管理费。对，就是这个。"

o.en: This is... piracy, again. I'll make the transfer now.
o.zh: 又来，这...这是海盗行径。我现在就转账。

"Yeah, who're you?" $personName snarls before bothering to glance at a grimy datapad.

"Ah," $hisOrHer demeanor shifts hostility down several levels. "You again. Right, right."
entries.zh:
"对，你谁？" $personName 吼罢，才不耐烦地扫了一眼脏兮兮的数据平板。

"啊..." $hisOrHer的举止像是将敌意降低了好几个等级，"又是你。对，对。"

entries.en: "No," $heOrShe spits, presumably on $hisOrHer own control console, "Last thing I need is some heggie bootlicking narc dropping ground-dirt in my fine station."
entries.zh: "不。" $HeOrShe吐了口唾沫，口水大概溅在了$hisOrHer自己的控制界面上，"我最不需要的就是那些给霸主佬舔靴子的缉毒犬把我干净的空间站弄得尘土飞扬。"

entries.en:
"Oh, got some lip on you have ya?" $HeOrShe spits, presumably on $hisOrHer own control console.

"Watch yourself, bootlicker. I could have you stripped down for parts before the shift is out."
entries.zh:
"哦，油嘴滑舌的啊你？" $HeOrShe吐了口唾沫，口水大概溅在了$hisOrHer自己的控制界面上。

"马屁精，你最好注意一点。我可以在换班之前把你拆成碎片。"

entries.en:
The pilot goes through routine chatter with what passes for traffic control. At the point that control asks for the standard bribe for a good landing slot, you have comms control forwarded to your datapad.

"Yeh, who's this then, shuttle?" control crackles, "Gonna buy me lunch, or do you like waiting?"
entries.zh:
驾驶员与负责颁发入场许可的航管进行了些惯例的交谈。正当航管表示可以按惯例付一些好处费来换取更好的着陆点时，你把通讯的控制权转到了自己的数据平板上。

"喂，这又是谁啊，开穿梭机的？" 航管在干扰的杂音中说道，"是打算请我一顿午饭，还是说你喜欢干等着？"

o.en: Your boss already gave me the go-ahead. Shall we comms them about the delay?
o.zh: 你的老大已经放我通行了。要不我们向上问问这耽搁是怎么回事？

o.en: Let's make it easy, friend. Do you like your fry red or green?
o.zh: 不用客气，朋友。你的炸串是想要荤的还是素的？

o.en: I'm here to see your boss.
Cut the shakedown. I'm here for Kanta.
o.zh: 别敲竹杠了，我是来见 Kanta 的。

entries.en: The pilot goes through routine chatter with what passes for traffic control. A previous bribe means you're recognized and get you a direct comms request to the station king, no waiting.
entries.zh: 驾驶员与负责颁发入场许可的航管进行了些惯例的交谈。先前的一次贿赂让你被认了出来，因此对方立刻给你安排了给空间站之王的直接通讯请求，没让你等着。

entries.en: The pilot goes through routine chatter with what passes for traffic control. A previous bribe means you're recognized and given no more trouble than usual.
entries.zh: 驾驶员与负责颁发入场许可的航管进行了些惯例的交谈。先前的一次贿赂让你被认了出来，因此这次也如同往常一样没节外生枝。

entries.en:
The pilot goes through routine chatter with what passes for traffic control, then suddenly pulls away in an evasive maneuver.

"Sorry captain," the pilot's voice crackles through to you. "We, uh, have a problem. And um, incoming comms."
entries.zh:
驾驶员与负责颁发入场许可的航管进行了些惯例的交谈，然后忽然作出了一个规避机动拉开了距离。

"抱歉舰长。" 驾驶员的声音在干扰的杂音中传来。"我们，呃，有麻烦了。还有嗯，有通讯来电。"

entries.en:
The vid feed flickers to life, a wash of static and audio distortion receding as your datapad adjusts for outdated comm protocols.

The portking of Kanta's Den appears before you with all of $hisOrHer singular charm. "You blasted, bloody rad-addled fool! You think you can vac-drop the Warlord's pet then just dance yourself back into her home? Them is some brassies you've got $playerName, but you got 'em instead of brains. I almost respect it."

$HeOrShe spits, the projectile presumably landing on $hisOrHer own control interface, "But only almost. Meantime, I'll be sittin' and smilin' watching all Kanta's underbosses fight for the chance to slag your flagship."
entries.zh:
视频画面闪烁着接通了，你的数据平板调整着过时的通讯链接，静电雪花和音频失真逐渐减弱了。

Kanta 之巢的港口之王带着$hisOrHer那独特的魅力出现在你面前。"你这个该死的，叫辐射烧坏脑子的傻逼！你觉得你可以把军阀的宠物扔进真空里，然后再跳着舞回她家来？你胆可真大，$playerName，不过你也只是胆大无脑了。我几乎都要佩服你了。"

$HeOrShe啐了一口，口水大概溅在了$hisOrHer自己的控制界面上，"但也只是几乎而已。现在老子就要坐这儿，笑着看 Kanta 手下的所有小头目为争夺把你旗舰轰他妈稀烂的机会大打出手。"

entries.en:
The comms cut. As your shuttle makes a hasty return to your $shipOrFleet, your tactical officer sends an urgent signal.

"Captain. Looks like Kanta's Den sent out a broadcast alert; calling in all nearby pirate fleets to our $shipOrFleet drive signature. Advise prep for hostiles."
entries.zh:
通讯切断了。在穿梭机匆忙地驶回你的$shipOrFleet时，你的战术军官发来了一条紧急信号。

"舰长。看起来 Kanta 之巢播送了一条警报，把周围的海盗舰队都朝着我们的$shipOrFleet驱动信号叫来了。建议预备敌袭。"

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。

entries.en:
His amusement, if anything, grows.

"Help." Jove puts a finger to his lips. "Perhaps."

"A direct assassination would be unlikely, if that was your meaning. Perhaps something more subtle?"
entries.zh:
他的笑意反倒更浓了。

"帮忙。\"Jove 把一根手指按在唇上。\"也许吧。"

"如果你指的是直接暗杀，那恐怕不太可能。要不要来点更隐蔽的手段？"

o.en: Even if I defeat the Sindrian Diktat myself, he's sure to run and hide.
o.zh: 就算我亲手打败辛达强权，他也一定会跑、会藏。

entries.en:
"Yes, I expect he would."

Jove allows a more serious expression to grow.

"You suggest that if Macario's present arrangement - the Sindrian Diktat - is broken by superior force, you would like me to then ascertain his subsequent whereabouts? Hm."

He's rubbing his hands together thoughtfully. You suspect that's a good sign.
entries.zh:
"没错，我想他会。"

Jove 的神情渐渐严肃起来。

"你的意思是，如果 Macario 眼下赖以存身的依仗——辛达强权——被更强的武力打碎，你希望我再去查明他之后的去向？嗯。"

他若有所思地搓着双手。你觉得这是个好兆头。

entries.en:
The comms flicker and hold. K-O Jove watches you with a wisp of smile, as if amused; as if assessing you like a prize.

"Captain," he says.
entries.zh:
通讯闪了闪，稳定下来。K-O Jove 嘴角挂着一丝笑打量你，仿佛觉得有趣，又仿佛在像掂量战利品一样评估你。

"舰长，" 他说道。

entries.en:
The comms flicker and hold. K-O Jove watches you with a wisp of smile, as if amused; as if assessing you like a prize.

"Captain," he says. "Have you brought me my 100,000 credits?"
entries.zh:
通讯闪了闪，稳定下来。K-O Jove 嘴角挂着一丝笑打量你，仿佛觉得有趣，又仿佛在像掂量战利品一样评估你。

"舰长，\" 他说道，\"给我那 100,000 星币，带来了吗？"

o.en: No, I'm still working on it.
No, I don't have the credits yet. (lie)
o.zh: 不，我还没拿到那些星币。 (撒谎)

o.en: I don't intend to pay you, Jove. I got what I wanted.
o.zh: 我不打算付你钱了，Jove。我要的东西已经到手了。

entries.en: "You've a poor sense of wit," Jove says coldly. "I suggest you refrain from attempting its use."
entries.zh: "你的风趣实在拙劣，\" Jove 冷冷道，\"我劝你还是别拿出来用了。"

entries.en:
"I see," he says quietly, bowing his head as if in pain.

"Good-bye." Almost a whisper.

The feed cuts abruptly to black.
entries.zh:
"我明白了，" 他轻声说，低下头，仿佛忍着痛楚。

"再见。" 几乎是一声耳语。

画面骤然一黑，切断了。

entries.en:
He pulls his feet off from where he had them propped up, then sits up straight.

Jove looks through the feed.

"Let me make quite sure of this because it would be beneath me to take your declaration lightly. Tell me, captain, is it true you intend to break our sacred trust?"

His tone is peculiar. Like some yawning depth lies beneath his pretty words.
entries.zh:
他把原本跷起的脚放下来，坐直了身子。

Jove 透过画面凝视着你。

"我得把这事问清楚——轻慢你的宣言，有失我的身份。告诉我，舰长，你当真打算背弃我们之间这份神圣的信任？"

他的语气很古怪。那些漂亮话底下，仿佛潜伏着一道深不见底的裂口。

o.en: I spoke too soon. You'll get your credits, Jove.
o.zh: 我说早了。你会拿到你的星币的，Jove。

o.en: You heard me the first time, Jove.

entries.en:
Jove sighs, disappointed.

"Lie, captain, but not to me. You know better."
entries.zh:
Jove 失望地叹了口气。

"撒谎可以，舰长，但别对我撒。你该懂分寸。"

entries.en:
He blinks, slowly, and releases a breath.

"Pity," he says. Then waves you away. "Get to it, yes?"

The comms cut, leaving you with a blank feed.
entries.zh:
他缓慢地眨了下眼，吐出一口气。

"可惜，\" 他说，随即挥手打发你走。\"去办吧，好吗？"

通讯切断，只留给你一片空白的画面。

entries.en:
Your TriPad pings confirmation as Jove nods, a slow smile growing on his face.

"Thank you. There's so little trust in these worlds, I am grateful to count upon you to pay your due."
entries.zh:
你的 TriPad 叮地一声确认，Jove 点了点头，脸上慢慢浮起笑意。

"谢谢你。这世道里信任太稀缺了，能指望你如约付账，我很感激。"

entries.en: "No. I inferred it." His tone is crisp.
entries.zh: "不。我是推断出来的。"他的语气干脆。

entries.en:
"I don't want or need 'friends'," he almost hisses the word.

"I want competent associates. Collaborators, clients, partners; whatever. I want them clear-eyed, because I tire of simpleminded brutes and self-deluded fanatics. They're sloppy. They're fools."

He takes a deep breath. "Still making up my mind about you, captain."
entries.zh:
"我不想要，也不需要【朋友】。"这个词几乎是从他齿间嘶出来的。

"我要的是能办事的同伙。合作者、客户、伙伴，随便叫什么。我要他们眼睛清楚，因为我受够了头脑简单的莽夫和自欺欺人的狂信徒。他们做事毛糙。他们都是蠢货。"

他深吸一口气。"至于你，船长，我还在下判断。"

entries.en: "You don't need to," he waves airily. "That gormless Diktat agent was confirmation enough."
entries.zh: "不必了。\"他漫不经心地一挥手。\"强权那个蠢头蠢脑的探子已经足够作证。"

entries.en:
"Then I graciously accept your appreciation, captain," he smiles broadly and insincerely. "I revealed nothing of you or of any agreement made between us to anyone else."

"What you, yes, must understand is that this information - the ripples made by the life and death of Jason Andrada - was already loose in the world when you stepped into that bar on Qaras. You can't stop it, and couldn't."

He rests his chin on both his hands.

"The question is, and this I eagerly await to witness, is what you do next."
entries.zh:
"那我就恭敬地领受你的谢意了，船长。\"他笑得开朗，却毫无诚意。\"关于你，关于我们之间的任何约定，我一个字都没向旁人透露。"

"你必须明白的是——没错，你必须明白——这些消息，Jason Andrada 的生死所激起的涟漪，在你踏进 Qaras 那间酒吧时就已经在这世上散开了。你阻止不了，也从来阻止不了。"

他把下巴搁在双手上。

"问题在于——这一点我正热切地等着看——你接下来会做什么。"

entries.en:
"I would not be so confident that what I did was assistance," Jove says, stroking his chin.

"It was, however, profitable to me."
entries.zh:
"我做过的事算不算帮忙，你最好别那么有把握。"Jove 摩挲着下巴说。

"不过，那对我很有赚头。"

entries.en:
"To whom?" He looks less amused now. "To an agent of the one-and-same Sindrian Diktat? A patrol commander of the Sindrian Diktat with a fake uniform?"

"If that is the house to which you pledge your loyalty, captain, then I am afraid the betrayal is not on my part."
entries.zh:
"背叛了谁？\"他此刻不那么觉得好笑了。\"背叛了同一个辛达强权的探子？还是辛达强权某个穿着假制服、冒充巡逻指挥官的家伙？"

"如果你效忠的是那样一个门庭，船长，那我恐怕要说，背叛的人不是我。"

entries.en: Jove nods, eyes closed, looking quite calm.
entries.zh: Jove 闭着眼点了点头，神情相当平静。

o.en: You sold Jason's info to a Diktat agent.
o.zh: 你把 Jason 的情报卖给了辛达强权的一个特工。

entries.en:
"So you caught up with the tiger cub?" He looks as pleased with himself as ever. "Well done, captain."

"If I may?" Jove holds up a finger. "I anticipate a certain indignation based on your phrasing and tone."

"It's true, more detailed data was discovered upon further inquiry made by myself and my organization following our own conversation. Jason Korin is, after all, a much more interesting person than I could ever have imagined."

He blinks innocently.

"I meant 'was', of course."
entries.zh:
"这么说，你追上那只小老虎了？\"他看上去一如既往地自得。\"干得好，船长。"

"容我插一句？\" Jove 竖起一根手指。\"从你的措辞和语气里，我预感到一阵怒气。"

"确实如此。我们那番谈话之后，我与我的人又做了一番追查，发现了更详细的数据。毕竟，Jason Korin 这个人比我所能想象的要有趣得多。"

他无辜地眨了眨眼。

"当然，我的意思是——【曾经是】。"

entries.en:
"You, in fact, held back certain essential facts from me. Well, one particularly crucial fact about Jason... Andrada's heritage."

He leans back, looking satisfied.
entries.zh:
"事实上，你对我瞒下了一些关键事实。嗯，一个格外要紧的事实：Jason...Andrada 的血脉。"

他向后一靠，一脸满意。

entries.en:
"Pardon me. Jason Andrada, I mean."

"There's profit to be found in the wake of important people, you see. Besides, we had no exclusive arrangement," he gives a little wave. "You have no basis for complaint."
entries.zh:
"恕我失言。我是说，Jason Andrada。"

"要紧人物走过之后，留下的尾流里是有钱可赚的，你瞧。再说，我们之间并没有排他约定。\"他轻轻一摆手。\"你没有理由抱怨。"

o.en: Pedantry won't make you any friends.
I would appreciate a little discretion.
o.zh: 希望你能稍稍谨慎一些。

o.en: You assisted the Sindrian Diktat. That's my complaint.
o.zh: 你帮了辛达强权。这就是我的不满。

o.en: You betrayed secrets of the Sindrian Diktat. That's my complaint.
o.zh: 你泄露了辛达强权的机密。这就是我的不满。

o.en: You sold Jason's info to a Sindrian Diktat double-agent.
o.zh: 你把 Jason 的情报卖给了辛达强权的一个双面间谍。

entries.en:
"Responding to such foolishness is beneath a Knight," the $post says, chin upturned. "May you discover a dignity in eternity that you know not now."

$HeOrShe reaches for the comms-cutoff.
entries.zh:
"回应这种蠢话远非骑士之义务。" $post 说着说着，扬起了下巴，"愿你在死后的永恒世界里能找到你现在仍不知晓的尊严。"

$HeOrShe切断了通讯。

entries.en:
The Knights bows $hisOrHer head, hands together. "Thank Providence for this miracle, thank Ludd for carrying the word of God, thank the holy Pneuma that our quest is attained."

No thanks for you, of course.

Seconds are called in and arrangements made to between your chief administrative officers and clerks of the Church to handle the takeover. As you each give confirmations, you see a strange sight: genuine giddiness just hidden beneath the Knight's armor of self-serious martial piety.

And the deed is done - or, at least, initiated. The Church has much work to do to integrate $KOLT_target into its loose theocracy.
entries.zh:
骑士们双手合十，低头祷告："感谢天意，佑我达成奇迹；感谢卢德，遵循主之教诲；感谢圣灵，助我完成任务。"

当然，他们没有在感谢你。

你呼叫副官们开会，安排了你方首席行政官们与教会职员的接管事宜。在双方互相确认的同时，你也有了奇妙的发现：在骑士团自认为严肃的武装修行外表之下，实际上也藏着天真的一面。

于是，合约达成 —— 至少是开始达成，教会要想把 $KOLT_target 吸收进他们松散的神权政体里，还得花不少工夫。

entries.en:
Your words catch the $post quite off guard, and $hisOrHer sense of pious superiority falters for a moment.

"You... really?" $HeOrShe says, then recovers. "I mean, if your heart is turned, then we would rejoice and claim $KOLT_target in Ludd's name for the Church of Galactic Redemption. Is this truly your desire?"
entries.zh:
你的话让 $post 感到十分意外，$hisOrHer那种自命不凡的虔诚感瞬间动摇了一下。

"你...真的吗？" $HeOrShe说道，然后恢复了常态。"我是说，如果你的心意已决，那么我们会很高兴以卢德的名义，为 银河救赎教会 占有 $KOLT_target。这真的是你渴望的吗？"

o.en: Yes, I wash my hands of $KOLT_target.
o.zh: 是的，我放弃对 $KOLT_target 的控制。

o.en: No, of course not. I'm not insane.

entries.en:
"Blessed day, captain... $playerName. Of course." The $post, acting like $heOrShe has done you a favor by remembering your name, puts $hisOrHer hands together and gives a little nod.

"We work here on a holy mission to protect the Faithful, to bring the lost flock of $KOLT_target back under the wing of the Church of Galactic Redemption, that their bodies and souls might be given the care and love of the Mother Church."

"It is their will, you will find. And it is the will of Providence that the Church see to their protectors. We are but a conduit for this sacred task."
entries.zh:
"蒙福的一天，舰长... $playerName。当然。" 这位 $post 将$hisOrHer的双手合十，微微点头，仿佛$heOrShe记住您的名字是一种恩惠。

"我们在这里执行神圣的使命，保护信徒，将迷失的 $KOLT_target 羊群重新带回银河救赎教会的羽翼之下，让他们的身体和灵魂都能得到教会母亲的关怀和爱护。"

"您会发现，这是他们的意愿。而上天也要求教会看顾他们的保护者。我们不过是执行这项神圣任务的媒介罢了。"

entries.en: "We hear your request," $hisOrHer face is impassive. "And by sacred oath, we must deny it."
entries.zh: "我们听到了你的请求，" $hisOrHer的脸上毫无表情。"根据神圣的誓言，我们必须拒绝它。"

o.en: I'm sure we can reach some kind of arrangement.
o.zh: 我相信我们可以达成某种协议。

o.en: Then I shall attack and destroy your fleet.
o.zh: 那我就攻击并摧毁你的舰队。

o.en: This smug obstinacy is why no one likes you.
o.zh: 你这种傲慢固执的性格就是没人喜欢你的原因。

entries.en: "We hear your demand," $hisOrHer face is impassive. "We reject your accusations of piracy and insurrection. We are sworn by sacred oath to bring the Faithful into the protection of the Church of Galactic Redemption. Only death may release a Knight of Ludd from their sacred duty."
entries.zh: "我们听到了你们的要求，" $hisOrHer的脸上毫无表情。"我们拒绝你关于海盗行为和煽动叛乱的指控。我们曾立下神圣的誓言，要将信徒置于 银河救赎教会 的保护之下。只有死亡才能让卢德骑士们解脱他们的神圣职责。"

o.en: Let's not be hasty. I'm sure we can reach some kind of arrangement.
o.zh: 别急着下结论。我相信我们可以达成某种协议。
那就只有死亡一条路可走了。

o.en: This smug obstinacy is why no one likes you.
o.zh: 你这种自以为是的固执就是没人喜欢你的原因。

entries.en:
"So be it," the $post says. "We shall meet in battle. May you discover mercy in eternity that you knew not in life."

$HeOrShe reaches for the comms-cutoff.
entries.zh:
"那就这样吧，" 这位 $post 说道，"我们将在战场上相见。愿你在死后的永恒世界里能找到你在生时未曾知晓的慈悲。"

$HeOrShe切断了通讯

entries.en:
"Mayhap with an official of the Church," $heOrShe says, making a show of thinking it over. "My remit, however, allows only your submission or defeat."

$HeOrShe lifts $hisOrHer chin slightly.

"Choose."
entries.zh:
"也许对于教会的官员来说可以，" $heOrShe说，假装在思考这个问题。"但我的职责只允许你们投降或被击败。"

$HeOrShe微微抬起$hisOrHer的下巴。

"选吧。"

entries.en: "If you are of the Faith, $playerBrotherOrSister, then place your faith in the will of the Church of Galactic Redemption and surrender this world unto the authority which shepherds Ludd's word upon the galaxy."
entries.zh: "如果你也是信徒，$playerBrotherOrSister，那么就请相信 银河救赎教会 的意志，并将这个世界交给这个在银河系中传播卢德之言的权威方。"

entries.en: "If you truly serve the Church, my $playerBrotherOrSister, then place your faith in the will of the Church of Galactic Redemption and surrender this world unto the authority which shepherds Ludd's word upon the galaxy."
entries.zh: "如果你真的为教会效力，我的 $playerBrotherOrSister，那么就请相信 银河救赎教会 的意志，并将这个世界交给这个在银河系中传播卢德之言的权威方。"

entries.en: "It is you who is the heretic, $playerBrotherOrSister, and I shall pray for you," $heOrShe says stonily.
entries.zh: "你才是异教徒，$playerBrotherOrSister，我会为你祈祷的，" $heOrShe冷漠地说。

o.en: You want $KOLT_target? You can have it.
If you want $KOLT_target, you're going to have to pry it from my cold, dead hands.
o.zh: 如果你们想要 $KOLT_target，那就得从我的尸体上跨过去

entries.en:
"Blessed day, captain $playerName," the $post says with all the self-assurance of someone who knows $heOrShe is backed by God.

"We are on a holy mission to ensure the protection of all the Faithful of $KOLT_target. It is the sacred duty of the Knights of Ludd to bring $KOLT_target under the protection of the Church of Galactic Redemption, and we shall gladly die to see it done."

$HeOrShe looks at you with a combination of pity and scorn.
entries.zh:
"蒙福的一天，$playerName 舰长，"这位 $post 语气中充满了自信，仿佛$heOrShe知道自己背后有神的支持。

"我们肩负着神圣的使命，确保 $KOLT_target 所有信徒的安全。将 $KOLT_target 置于银河救赎教会的保护之下是卢德骑士团的神圣职责，我们甘愿为此献身。"

$HeOrShe看着你，眼神中既有怜悯也有蔑视。

o.en: Your efforts, however noble, are undermining my authority. I would ask you to leave.
o.zh: 无论多么高尚，你们的行为都在削弱我的权威。我要求你们离开。

o.en: You are engaging in outright piracy and spreading insurrection. I demand you cease!
o.zh: 你们正在进行赤裸裸的海盗行为，并煽动叛乱。我要求你们立即停止！

o.en: I am of the Faith! How can the Faithful here be in danger, spiritual or otherwise?
o.zh: 我就是信徒！这里的信徒怎么可能会有精神上或者其他方面的危险？

o.en: I serve the Church! How can the Faithful here be in danger, spiritual or otherwise?
o.zh: 我正效力于教会！这里的信徒怎么可能会有精神上或者其他方面的危险？

o.en: I am of the Path of Ludd. With hammer and sword, I will smash your meddling fleet of heretics.
o.zh: 我遵循卢德之径。我将以锤与剑，粉碎你们这支多管闲事的异端舰队。

entries.en:
"Paltry, plebeian, pathetic," Cydonia hisses at you, "A beggar's sum, unworthy of the mighty Kanta!" he shouts, spittle flying.

The court shouts and jeers at your pitiable offer.
entries.zh:
"微不足道，庸俗，可悲。" Cydonia 嘶声道，"这是打发乞丐的金额，配不上伟大的 Kanta！" 他吐沫星子横飞地吼道。

整座王庭开始吼叫着嘲笑你可悲的提议。

entries.en:
"Hm," the doctor ponders, then looks to Kanta, whose obsidian gaze acknowledges him.

"One million credits," says Cydonia with an unusual affect, then adds "Dull, very dull. But a queenly sum nonetheless."
entries.zh:
"嗯。" 医生思考了一下，然后看向 Kanta，后者以黑曜石般深邃的凝视回应了他。

"一百万星币。" Cydonia 口气中难得有些被打动，但随即补充道。"乏味，非常乏味。但好歹是对得起一位女王的金额。"

entries.en:
"You dare return here $playerName!" shouts the Doctor Cydonia, spittle flying. "You stole Zal from us! Her clever little tinkerer, her asset, her prize."

He seethes, nearly hyperventilating, "H-how dare you!"
entries.zh:
"你还有胆子回到这里，$playerName！" 奇怪的医生吼道。"你夺走了 Zal！她机灵的小技工，她的资产，她的宝物。"

他气得几乎上气不接下气。"你 —— 你怎么敢！"

entries.en:
The court murmurs, heavy boots shuffle; you hear the distinct click-clank of a heavy kinetic round being chambered; it is inadvisable weapons handling practice within a sealed environment at the best of times.

There is hatred among the pirates, you see, and Cydonia is stirring it against you.
entries.zh: 王庭内响起一片低声细语，沉重的靴子在地面上拖曳；你听到了重动力子弹上膛时标志性的当啷声；在密封环境里，这可不是什么好的武器使用习惯。你看得出来海盗有些积怨颇深，而 Cydonia 正在煽动他们针对你。

entries.en:
"You dare return here $playerName!" shouts Doctor Cydonia. "After daring to attack the citadel of our dear warlord! Her home, her family! You stole Zal from us! Her clever little tinkerer, her asset, her prize."

He seethes, nearly hyperventilating, "H-how dare you!"
entries.zh:
"你攻击了我们军阀的要塞后还有胆子回到这里，$playerName！" 奇怪的医生吼道。"你攻击了她的家，她的家人！你夺走了 Zal！她机灵的小技工，她的资产，她的宝物。"

他气得几乎上气不接下气。"你 —— 你怎敢！"

entries.en:
Kanta's gauntlet slams against the side of her throne, crashing through the murmur of the court like thunder. Again she slams the throne, then once more, leaving a painful echo.

Warlord Kanta speaks, like the voice of a heavy combat walker if it could speak, harmonics buzzing through your bones.

"What tribute have you brought us? What gift will sate us?"

Cydonia leans in close, acidic breath wafting over you. "The warlord's protection is not easily gained. Do not offend her with unworthy dross," he hisses.
entries.zh:
Kanta 的铁拳重重砸在王座侧面，如一道惊雷劈开了王庭的窃窃私语。她又砸了一下，再砸一下，只留下令人耳膜生疼的回响。

军阀 Kanta 开口了，那声音就像一台重型战斗机甲真能说话——合成音震得你骨头里嗡嗡作响。

"你给咱家带来了什么贡品？什么礼物能够让咱家满意？"

Cydonia 凑得更近，一股酸腐的气息扑面而来。"军阀的庇护可不易求得。别拿不入流的渣滓来冒犯她，" 他嘶声说道。

o.en: Compromising information on $foundContactName, $foundContactFaction $foundContactPost and trusted contact
o.zh: 关于 $foundContactName 的敏感信息。其人乃是一位 $foundContactFaction 的 $foundContactPost 以及信任你的联络人。

entries.en:
Cydonia rolls his eyes theatrically as you declare your willingness to betray a contact at Kanta's will. "A worthless-" he begins.

A rhythmic thudding overpowers him, like the sound of a malfunctioning shield capacitor locked into a destructive charge cycle. You suppress your instinctual reaction to that danger as you realize that Kanta is laughing. Cydonia cringes, holding pallid hands over his ears.

With a dying echo, her laughter stops.
entries.zh:
听到你打算为了 Kanta 背叛一位联络人，Cydonia 装模做样地翻了个白眼道。"毫无价值的 ——"

一阵规律的砰砰声淹没了他的声音，这声音好像护盾发生器被锁进了自毁性的充能循环。你几乎本能地要做出对那种故障的应急反应时方才发现这其实是 Kanta 的笑声。Cydonia 战栗着以苍白的手指捂住他的耳朵。

随着最后一段回响，她的笑声停止了。

entries.en:
She speaks with the voice of a mechanical demon, "A willing betrayer; most delectable. You understand that the softest weapon may cause the most pain."

Her cyberauged body draws a deep, ragged breath, and she continues, "The anticipation shall bring us such pleasure."
entries.zh:
她以那机械恶魔般的声音开口道："一位心甘情愿的背叛者；最好的美味。你明白最柔软的兵器往往能造成最大的痛苦。"

她机械强化的身体深深地吸了一口气，继续道。"这份期待将会给咱家带来无上的欢愉。"

o.zh: 一部受损的 人之领 时代纳米锻炉

entries.en:
"That?" Cydonia's face contorts into a seemingly impossible sneer. "You can find junk like that in half the ruins in the fringe systems alone! It's a lump of technological excrement passed by the dying idiot-corpse of the Domain!"

He's either ignorant or lying about the rarity and value of even a damaged nanoforge. Many in the crowd of pirates know it, too, by their dark expressions and grumbling - but there is only one who may question Cydonia's judgment.

Kanta looks on, impassive. Bored, almost, if her moods could be divined by the subtle shift and hum of her augments.
entries.zh:
"这个？" Cydonia 的脸不自然地扭曲成了一个鄙视的表情，"你在边缘星区里一半的废墟里都能挖出这种垃圾玩意！这不过是 人之领 政权那愚蠢的尸体后留下来的一坨狗屎技术罢了。"

Kanta 毫无波澜地看着这一切。如果能从她的机械义体中微弱的嗡嗡声和动作中看出些什么，那大概就是无聊吧。

o.en: A Domain-era Dealmaker Holosuite, adaptable for medical experiments
o.zh: 一部 人之领 时代的全息交易撮合套件，也适用于医疗实验用途。

entries.en:
Kanta blasts her synthetic approval, "YES. A delightful toy for my Cydonia, for his little experiments, his playthings. Won't they amuse us?" With a creak of metal and clatter of beads and trophies, Kanta turns to look upon Cydonia.

He seems to shrink, "Y- yes, my queen. I'm sure- I suppose it could be... repurposed for my needs. There will be less need for live... subjects, I suppose."

The 'doctor' looks crestfallen at this development. It would seem that Kanta doesn't notice, or care.
entries.zh:
Kanta 的合成音充满了赞许。"好，给咱家 Cydonia 的小实验找了个好玩具。想来它会给咱家找些乐子？" 伴随着金属的吱嘎声以及串珠与战利品的碰撞声，Kanta 转向了 Cydonia。

他似乎快要缩进地里。"是 —— 是的，我的女王，我肯定 —— 我估计它可以按...我的需求进行改装。这样我们需要的活...实验品估计会少一些，我估计。"

'医生' 看上去对这项安排垂头丧气。而 Kanta 要么没有看出来，要么根本不在意。

o.zh: 一部 人之领 时代的战斗无人机复制器。

entries.en:
The core of the drone replicator is dragged into the court on an agrav sled and the specs read aloud at Cydonia's instructions by some kind of lead technician.

Certain phrases stand out: "autonomous hunter-killer", "exploding-tip fragmentation", "semi-lethal crowd-control escalation",  "adjustable potency chemical irritant", "30,000 rounds-per-minute", "excruciating burning sensation".

Kanta nods along, seemingly enthralled. Cydonia glances between you and her, ensuring that he is following the lead of his queen.
entries.zh:
无人机复制器的核心被一架反重力拖橇拖入王庭。一个 Cydonia 指挥下的技师头子正在大声读出其数据明细。

其中有些词语颇为让人在意："自动猎杀系统"，"高爆破片弹头"，"可选半致命镇暴"，"每分钟三万发"，"痛苦的灼烧感"。

Kanta 看上去听入神了，边听边点头。Cydonia 的视线在你和 Kanta 之间游移，确保自己紧跟女王的步调。

entries.en: As the reading is finished, Cydonia exchanges one last look with Kanta then turns approvingly to the technician. "Take it to The Arena!" he shouts, and Kanta's court erupts with thunderous shouts and stomps.
entries.zh: 技师报告完毕后，Cydonia 和 Kanta 交换了最后一个眼神，然后赞许地转向技师。"把它送到斗技场去！" 他大声说道，Kanta 的王庭随即爆发出热烈的欢呼和顿足声。

o.en: A favor of her choosing, at any time in the future
o.zh: 欠她一个人情，她将来可以随时要求偿还。

entries.en:
Cydonia frowns petulantly through your declaration.

"A favor?" he calls out shrilly, "My mighty queen's protection for the feeble promise of a-"

A metallic boom and the electric hum of overcharged amplification drown out Cydonia's mockery. Kanta's voice is like thunder, echoing off the armored wall-panels of the court chamber.

"WE ACCEPT."

With those simple words, she sits. Her face, a dark mask, has no expression you can discern. But she might be smiling to herself, somewhere inside her shell.
entries.zh:
Cydonia 在你宣告时不满地皱起了眉头。

"一个人情？" 他尖声叫道，"让我强大的女王提供保护，你却只愿给一个 ——"

金属音的巨响和过载扩音器的电子音淹没了 Cydonia 的嘲笑。Kanta 如雷般的声音在王庭的装甲墙之间回响。

"咱 家 接 受。"

仅仅说出这几个字后，她再次坐下。她的脸如同一副深色的面具，让你无法辨别出其下潜藏的表情。但军阀可能在暗自微笑着，就在她金属外壳下的某处。

entries.en:
"What," Cydonia's lip curls into a sneer, "would the mighty warlord do with-"

There's a heavy clank, all turn to find that Kanta is standing, trailing trophies and tubes. "WE ACCEPT," her vocoder blasts, the voice inhuman. "Vacuum AND fire shall greet those prisoners I wish to dispose."

The pirates of the court cheer to this, stomping their feet and slamming weapon-stocks into the deck plates.
entries.zh:
"我们伟大的军阀，" Cydonia 的嘴角勾起一抹冷笑，"要这个东西做 ——"

随着咣啷一声传来，众人转头望去，发现 Kanta 已经站了起来，拉扯着身后一堆管线以及战利品。"咱家接受。" 她的语音器爆发出非人的声音。"真空 与 烈火，将迎接那些咱家想处置的囚犯。"

听到这里，整座王庭的海盗欢呼起来，跺着脚，将武器枪托重重砸在甲板上。

o.en: I shall take my leave to consider what sort of gift befits the pirate queen.
o.zh: 我先退下了，我会考虑何种礼物配得上海盗女王。

entries.en:
As you leave, the court rumbles, and calls, jeers and admonitions directed at you, and each other.

Pirates in the corridors of Kanta's Den glower and grumble at your passing, their eyes promising secret blood spilled at some future opportunity.
entries.zh:
你离开时，整座王庭处于骚动之中，你身后皆是各类针对你和针对海盗彼此的呼声，嘲笑以及指责。

Kanta 之巢通道里的其他海盗在你路过时无一不对你虎视眈眈、念念有词，他们的眼神预示着未来某个时机必将在暗地里给你放血。
