"If I am understanding your intention, that might not be so easy. The Path is joined with the heart, the immortal spirit, not some number or identification file."
OR
"Someone?" $HeOrShe smiles in not wholly sincere apology.

"There are many people who come to Chalcedon, some who stay, some who go. Some who find that for which they search, and many who do not."
entries.zh:
"啊。" $HeOrShe目不转睛地盯着你。

"如果我会对了你的用意，这事恐怕没那么简单。我们间的道途与心相连，与不朽的灵相通，而不是一些数字和身份文件。"
OR
"你说某个人？" $HeOrShe不太真诚地笑着道歉道。

"来到 Chalcedon 的人很多，有人留下，有人离去。有人找到了他们所寻求的，更多的人一无所获。"

entries.en: The comms flicker and stabilize, displaying the $personPost before you.
entries.zh: 通讯画面稍微闪烁，然后稳定了下来，在你面前显示出 $personPost 的影像。

entries.en: The comm-link flickers, but fails to connect. It seems like you're being ignored, for now.
entries.zh: 通讯链接闪烁了一下，但是没能接通。看来，你暂时被忽视了。

entries.en: The comms fuzz and flickers before finally stabilizing into the $personPost before you.
entries.zh: 通讯画面经历了好一番模糊和闪烁，最终在你面前稳定为 $personPost 的影像。

entries.en: The comm-link flickers, but fails to connect. It seems like you're being ignored, for now.
entries.zh: 通讯链接闪烁了一下，但是没能接通。看来，你暂时被忽视了。

entries.en: "No." He smiles again. "You are welcome here, with blessed peace and the hospitality of my people."
entries.zh: "不。" 他再次笑了。"我们欢迎你，以神圣的和平和我们人民的热情。"

entries.en: "Yes." He smiles again. "But, $playerBrotherOrSister, you would not find what you're looking for."
entries.zh: "是的。" 他又笑了。"但是，$playerBrotherOrSister，你不会找到你想找的东西的。"

entries.en: "Yes." He smiles again. "But, $playerBrotherOrSister, you would not find what you're looking for."
entries.zh: "是的。" 他又笑了。"但是，$playerBrotherOrSister，你不会找到你想找的东西的。"

entries.en: He smiles again. "You are welcome here, with blessed peace and the hospitality of my people."
entries.zh: 他再次笑了。"我们欢迎你，以神圣的和平和我们人民的热情。"

entries.en: He smiles again. "You are welcome here, with blessed peace and the hospitality of my people."
entries.zh: 他再次笑了。"我们欢迎你，以神圣的和平和我们人民的热情。"

o.en: That led me to you. Will you shoot me as well?
o.zh: 他带我来的。你也要向我开枪么？

o.en: Yes, you did him a mercy.
o.zh: 是的，你对他算是仁慈了。

o.en: You murder because you feel like its right? That's insane.
o.zh: 因为你觉得这是对的就进行谋杀？这太疯狂了。

o.en: What you say about faith alone, not deeds, it... makes sense.
o.zh: 你说的只存信仰，无关行为，这...有道理。

o.en: You do what you want and think faith makes it good? That's insane.
o.zh: 你想做什么就做什么，然后觉得有信仰一切就会好起来？这是疯了。

o.en: What you say about following faith alone, it... makes sense.
o.zh: 你说的只需追随信仰，这...有道理。

o.en: How can you murder a man in cold blood and think yourself righteous?
o.zh: 你怎能冷酷无情地谋杀一个人并自诩正义？

entries.en:
"That?" Sedge looks down, as if at a stone on the ground.

"That got careless. That forgot that one does not speak easily of the Path. The Path is sacred. It does not belong in the mouth of a decadent heathen."

His eyes flick downward again, "Like that."
entries.zh:
"他？" Sedge 垂下眼睛，像在看地上的石块。

"他没有谨言慎行。他忘了他不可妄言圣道。卢德之道如此圣洁，怎可出于堕落异端之口。"

他的眼睛又向下撇了一下，"就像他。"

entries.en:
"Truly, you are a devil of the Domain returned from hell to torment us anew," $heOrShe says, spitting.

$HeOrShe looks down, letting out a shuddering sigh, then looks back to you. Shame is on $hisOrHer face.
entries.zh:
"啊，你可真是个 人之领 的魔王，再一次从地狱里出来折磨我们了。" $heOrShe咒骂着说道。

$HeOrShe的视线向下移去，发出一声带着颤抖的叹息。再次看向了你时，$hisOrHer的脸上却已然满是后悔与屈辱。

entries.en:
"I speak truth when I tell you that I know no man by the name Jethro Bornanew. I can... it is not simple. We have some computer records, but only for what is truly necessary. Those who walk the Path do not wish their names to be written in the book of Moloch."

"But, but. I can ask. Make inquiries for you. Just... you can stay on the comms, yes? I will find your man."
entries.zh:
"我没在撒谎，我真的不认识任何名叫 Jethro Bornanew 的人。我能... 哎，这不简单呐。虽然我们不会在非必要的情况下用电脑记录信息，但我们这里确实有一些条目。行于卢德之道之上的人们，并不希望自己的名字被写入恶魔摩洛克的书卷中。"

"但是，但是，我还是可以帮你问问，或者帮你提交查询请求。只要... 请你保持通讯畅通，好吗？我会帮你找到他的。"

entries.en: "You want a recruiter? I don't understand. Any recruiter? Tell me true what you want that you may take your hellfire far away from my home."
entries.zh: "你想找一个教徒招募人？我不明白，随便哪位招募人都行的意思？告诉我你到底想要什么，好教你身上那地狱之火离我家远些。"

entries.en:
The Pather stays on the comms, trying to appease your ruthlessness. $HeOrShe makes calls to various contacts in the loose collection of fragmentary sects, religious militias, and warlords that makes up the planetary administration.

It's all quite tedious, but within an hour or so $personName gets a hit - someone has indeed heard the name Jethro Bornanew and knows that he spoke to a recruiter by the unlikely name of Wrestling Sedge.
entries.zh:
这名左径信徒保持着和你的通讯，并不断尝试着平息你的不满。$HeOrShe呼叫着那些分散在不同教派、护教民兵和行星管理机构的军阀中的联络人。

你在这种极度乏味中度过了大约一个小时，$personName 终于有了进展：确实有人听说过 Jethro Bornanew 这个名字，且知道他曾和一个名字不怎么常见的教徒招募人 Wrestling Sedge 说上过话。

entries.en:
$PersonName looks stricken as they explain the hitch in this discovery.

"Sedge. He won't talk to you. He... doesn't use comms."
entries.zh:
$PersonName 神情沮丧地向你解释道，此次发现中的一个难以解决的问题：

"Sedge 他... 没法和你通话。他，他是拒绝使用通信设备的。"

o.en: Make him use comms. An exception. For me.
o.zh: 那么他得为我破这个例了。

o.en: Gee, that's too bad... (reach for controls)
o.zh: 呃... 这可就不好办了啊... (伸手去触碰控制台)

entries.en:
"Sedge agreed to meet you. I don't know why, but he suggested it. At a spacer bar, even. Neutral ground, yes? He said he wanted to speak with you. I don't understand it, but he's... he's taken with the pneuma. He does not fear death."

"It's all I can do. Please. I'll transmit the location to you now."
entries.zh:
"Sedge 同意和你会面了。我不理解他这么做是何用意，但他将见面地点约在了一间太空酒吧，那地方甚至该算是个中立的地区了，不是吗？他说他想和您谈谈。我是真的想不通，但他... 他与灵同在，悍不畏死。"

"我能为你做的事可真是做尽了。我马上就会把见面地点给您发过来。"

entries.en: "I... look, I can't," $heOrShe says, sweating. "Sedge's flock is armed and, and he's... taken with the pneuma. He doesn't fear death. He kills those who anger him. But wait, wait."
entries.zh: "我... 我做不到。" $heOrShe满头大汗地说道，"Sedge 的那伙人都武装到牙齿了，而且他... 他已与灵同在、悍不畏死。他会杀了任何触怒他的人。啊，等，等等。"

entries.en: "Wait, wait!" $heOrShe shouts, sweating.
entries.zh: "停，等一下！" $heOrShe满头大汗地喊道。

entries.en: "Yes," $heOrShe breaks into a desperate grin, "A meeting. Exactly."
entries.zh: "是啊，" $heOrShe勉强挤出一丝礼貌性的微笑，"线下会面才行。"

o.en: I'm looking for someone who may have joined the Path.
o.zh: 我在找一个可能已经加入了左径的人。

o.en: I'm looking for someone who recruits for the Path.
o.zh: 我在找为左径招募教徒的人。

o.en: Look, he had to talk to someone, right? A recruiter?
o.zh: 你看，他总得和什么人说过话，对吧？比如一个教徒招募人？

o.en: He came here to join the Luddic Path. His name is Jethro Bornanew.
o.zh: 他为了加入卢德左径来过这里。他的名字是 Jethro Bornanew。

entries.en:
You explain that while you were indeed at the protest on Jangala Station on that fated day, it is not all as it appears.

The holos that leaked out were manipulated by secret Hegemony AI cores which substituted your face for that of a Hegemony officer on the scene. The cowards are trying to deflect blame away from themselves! It is obvious that the long-term goal of the Hegemony is to stamp out all spiritual belief, the better to assert AI-led control over the population and turn all humans into mere machines, cogs in a new Domain; a mechanistic galaxy-straddling Moloch built in defiance of God's creation!
entries.zh:
你想方设法辩解道，虽然你在 Jangala 空间站命定遇袭的那一日正好出现在空间站，事实却根本不是他们所想的那样。

泄出的全息影像，其实被霸主用私藏的 AI 核心修改过了，你的脸被 AI 核心拿去，换掉了在场某位霸主军官的脸。那帮子懦夫如此做，全是为了给自己脱罪！至于霸主的长期目标，那当然就是摧垮一切精神信仰，由此，就能让民众接受 AI 核心的控制，将众人全部化作可悲的机械，变作那新人之领里的一个个齿轮；而那所谓的新人之领，正如一个蔑视着神之造物，横跨整个银河的摩洛克机械！

entries.en:
You explain that while marines under your command were indeed deployed on that fateful day on Epiphany, you were in fact trying to stop an Hegemony black-ops raid being run through the pirate Warlord Kanta. It was the subsequent black propaganda/cover-up that placed you at the center of the action.

Kanta is, of course, a hollowed-out shell controlled by an AI core; an abomination in the eyes of all followers of Ludd but indeed the very image of the Hegemony's ultimate goal for all humanity in the Persean Sector: machine-slaves to false AI-gods tasked with building a new Domain; a mechanistic galaxy-straddling Moloch to defy the very nature of God's creation!
entries.zh:
你想方设法辩解道，虽然你指挥的陆战队员确实在 Epiphany 遇袭这一天被部署过，但你实际上是在试图阻止霸主通过海盗军阀 Kanta 进行的隐秘劫掠行动。反倒是他们随后用以掩盖自身行径的宣传，将你拖入了这次袭击的中心。

当然，所谓 Kanta 也不过是一个由 AI 核心控制的空壳；在任何卢德的追随者眼中，这具空壳都只能说是令人生厌，但此等孽物，也正是霸主终极目标下英仙座星域所有人类的形象：为建立一个所谓的新人之领，而被 AI 伪神操弄着的机械奴隶；而那所谓的新人之领，正如一个横跨整个银河的摩洛克机械，蔑视着神之造物的一切天性！

entries.en:
Your voice breaks with emotion as you explain the depths of conspiracy set by the AIs to pit human against human, and of your victimhood has turned you toward, for the first time, reconsidering the goals and ideals of the Luddic Path.

You can tell from the horror on $personPost's face, and subsequent affirmation - they're right, about everything - that the arc of your story is too enticing not to take root. Though absurd, it feels right, and plays to a deep-rooted sense of persecution.
entries.zh:
你声情并茂，深入阐释着，那 AI 核心们是如何使出重重阴谋诡计，想方设法挑动人类内斗的；而你本人受到这 AI 核心们坑害的经历又如何驱使着你，让你有生以来第一次，开始重新考虑 卢德左径 那崇高的理想与远大的目标是否才是正道。

你观察着：那 $personPost 先是满脸恐慌，而后又是一脸的认同 —— 他的教派才是正道，所有方面都预测对了。由此看来，你讲出的那一番故事足够引人入胜，那人若是对此还提不起兴致才是怪事。虽然你讲出的故事听来略有些荒谬，但它足够贴合 卢德左径 成员的直觉，更是能够调动起他内心深处那份对异端邪说的愤恨之情。

entries.en:
"Please, fellow $playerBrotherOrSister, let us begin anew," $heOrShe says. "My name is $personName, and we walk with Blessed Ludd."

$HeOrShe brings $hisOrHer hands together and says a short prayer, then looks back up to you.

"You have come here to Chalcedon looking for something. Tell me now, how many I assist?"
entries.zh:
"来吧，亲爱的 $playerBrotherOrSister，愿我们都能改过自新。" $heOrShe说道，"我叫 $personName，而我们将与蒙福的卢德并肩同行。"

$HeOrShe双手合十，并念诵了一段简短的祷告，然后抬头看向你。

"你此次前来 Chalcedon 是为了寻找某物。告诉我，我能如何为你提供协助？"

o.en: I'm looking for a man named Jethro Bornanew.
o.zh: 我要找一个叫 Jethro Bornanew 的人

o.en: I'm looking for a Path recruiter.
o.zh: 我要找一个 卢德左径 的教徒招募人。

o.en: And I shall send my marines to kill and burn if you don't give me what I want.
o.zh: 你们要是胆敢不把我要的人交给我，我可就要派陆战队员下去烧杀抢掠了。

o.en: And I will bomb your pathetic cult from orbit if I don't get what I want.
o.zh: 你们要是胆敢不把我要的人交给我，我可要开始轨道轰炸，送你那小小教团上路了。

o.en: This is a terrible misunderstanding! It's not what it looks like.
o.zh: 这误会可太大了！事情才不是表面看起来那样。

entries.en: "You joined the faithful in resisting, albeit symbolically, the Hegemony oppressors who desecrate the holy world of Jangala. It is a small thing, and surely inadequate, but," $heOrShe smiles, "Your first step on the Path won't stomp our enemies out all at once."
entries.zh: "尽管只是象征性地，你还是成为了抵抗着亵渎圣地 Jangala 的 霸主 压迫者的忠诚者一员。这虽然微小而不足，" $heOrShe微笑着说道，"你在卢德之道上踏出的第一步并不能一步登天般摧毁我们的敌人。"

entries.en: "And a young Knight Initiate - former Initiate, I should say - spoke well of your simple words on Hesperus which set him on a new Path."
entries.zh: "还有一位年轻的新晋骑士 —— 或者说，前骑士 —— 对你在 Hesperus 所说的简单话语赞不绝口，这让他踏上了一条新的道途。"

entries.en: "I am told that Brother Cotton would like you to be told of his kind regards." $HeOrShe lifts an eyebrow, "I shan't ask why, though it does make one curious."
entries.zh: "Cotton 修士希望我替他传达亲切的问候。" $HeOrShe挑起一侧眉毛，"虽然我不会问为什么，但确实让人好奇。"

entries.en: "It is said that you walk with us. Perhaps not quite on the same Path, but close enough that we might pray together with truth in our hearts."
entries.zh: "据说你与我们同行。也许那不完全是同一条道途，但它们之间足够近，这让我们可以真诚地一同祈祷。"

entries.en: "Blessed peace upon you," $heOrShe begins with a tone of skepticism. "I cannot but wonder what brings one who walks with the Church among us who are so far from Gilead." $HeOrShe makes a quick reassuring smile, "I seek no fight, mind; you are spoken well of... by some."
entries.zh: "愿和平赐福于你。" $heOrShe以怀疑的口吻开始说道，"我不禁想知道，一个与教会同行的人是如何来到我们这些远离 Gilead 的地方的。" $HeOrShe迅速露出一个安抚的微笑，"我并不寻求争斗，你被某些人称赞...至少是一部分人。"

entries.en:
"Blessed is the day," $personName says, looking at you skeptically. "What brings you to our humble world?"
OR
"Peace of Ludd upon you," $personName says, somewhat hastily. "Why has Providence set our humble world on your Path?"
OR
"Blessings of Ludd," $personName says, examining you. "Pray tell what brings you and your $shipOrFleet to Chalcedon?"
OR
"May Providence favor this day and peace see its end," $personName says, looking you over. "What path brings you to our stormy home, captain?"
OR
"We thank Providence for this day and its peace," says $personName, holding $hisOrHer hands together piously. "How may I be of help, captain?"
entries.zh:
"今天真是福运临门。" $personName 一边说着，一边怀疑地看着你，"敢问是何事带你来到我们这贫寒的世界？"
OR
"愿卢德为你带来安宁。" $personName 有些匆忙地说道，"敢问天意为何让我们这贫寒的世界成为你道途中的一站？"
OR
"愿卢德祝福你。" $personName 一边说着，一边审视着你，"请告诉我，是什么带你和你的$shipOrFleet来到 Chalcedon？"
OR
"愿上苍保佑这一天，使它得以画上和平的句点。" $personName 一边说着，一边打量着你，"是什么带你来到我们这风暴缠身的家园，舰长？"
OR
"感谢上天赐予我等今日的和平。" $personName 说着，虔诚地双手合十，"我可以帮上什么吗，舰长？"

entries.en:
"Blessed is our way," $heOrShe says, "on this Path together, $playerBrotherOrSister."

The $personPost smiles, "Yes, we have heard of you. Good things; godly things."
entries.zh:
"同行于道途，循己身之径的，" $heOrShe说道，"这人便为有福！"

$personPost 微笑着说："没错，我的 $playerBrotherOrSister，关于你的佳话，我们早有耳闻；你行神圣之事，教众无不传颂。"

entries.en: There is no recognition on $hisOrHer face; nonetheless, $personName spits a retort: "For what, to murder? You'll get no man from us."
entries.zh: $hisOrHer脸上对你没有丝毫认同之情，尽管如此，$personName 还是呛声道："怎么，好让你们大开杀戒？你别想从我们这儿带走任何人。"

entries.en: "For what," $heOrShe spits, "To murder? We'll not hand one of our own to you."
entries.zh: "为了什么？" $heOrShe啐道，"为了杀戮吗？我们不会把我们的人交给你。"

o.zh: >> (dev) 骑士迷途 测试菜单

entries.en: DEV jump to Jaspis convo
entries.zh: DEV 跳到和 Jaspis 的对话

o.zh: DEV 开始 骑士迷途 任务

entries.en:
As you enter Jaspis' office, Knight Ailanthus inhales to announce you - and the Archcurate interrupts.

"Jethro, here you are!" she says, "Providence provides!" Knight Ailanthus lets out a cough, and Jaspis responds by waving them away.

"As well, I must attest, by way of the efforts of the good captain whose footsteps I hear also," she says, smiling, "For lest we forget, the Path of the righteous will not walk upon itself, is that not so?"
entries.zh:
正当你们走进 Jaspis 的办公室，骑士 Ailanthus 吸了一口气准备宣布你们的到来时 —— 大祭司打断了他。

"Jethro，你来了！" 她说道，"上天恩赐！" 骑士 Ailanthus 咳了一声，Jaspis 的回应只是挥挥手让他下去。

"而我也不得不说，你能无恙也是拜现在踏步来此的舰长所赐。" 她微笑着说道，"休让我们忘记，正义之道终需有人开拓，不是吗？"

entries.en:
Bornanew takes Jaspis' small, frail hand in his own.

"Yes, of course. Please, Mother Sophronia, you must not get too excited. It is just me, and I have caused you much distress."

"Yes and truly, " she says, shaking Bornanew off. "And for it you've already decided to undergo some senseless display of penance, I doubt not. An unseemly habit learnt from the Knights."

"Captain," she turns toward you. "You must grow tired of this, so I shall be succinct: you have my deepest gratitude. My secretary shall see that you receive your payment."

She aims herself at the doorway, "Degory, attend!"
entries.zh:
Bornanew 握住了 Jaspis 脆弱纤小的手。

"是的，是的。教母 Sophronia，请你毋须这么激动。只是我而已，我给你造成了这么多的苦恼。"

"正是如此。" 她说着甩开了 Bornanew。"而且我毫不怀疑你还准备做一些无意义的表面忏悔工作。真是个从骑士团那儿学来的不体面的习惯。"

"舰长。" 她转向了你，"你一定听烦了，所以我就简洁些：我向你致以最深切的谢意。我的秘书会确保你拿到报酬的。"

她朝着门口道："Degory，过来！"

entries.en:
You are met on the landing pad by a solemn Luddic Knight and attending Knight Initiate. The Knight's frown deepens noticeably as they take in Bornanew.

Knight Ailanthus leads you to Archcurate Jaspis' office in otherwise judgmental silence. Bornanew takes this treatment in stride, enjoying the gardens and fresh air.
entries.zh:
在停机坪上等着你们的是一位严肃的卢德骑士，还有随同的新晋骑士。在领走 Bornanew 时，那位骑士的眉头明显皱得更深了。

骑士 Ailanthus 带着你们走向 Jaspis 大祭司的办公室。在评判性的沉默中，Bornanew 只是大步流星地走着，享受着花园和新鲜空气。

entries.en:
Your shuttle is given an unusually expedient flight path to the complex housing Jaspis' office.

Bornanew watches the green world of Gilead grow below you.
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机被允许使用一条比以往通畅许多的航空通道，直达 Jaspis 办公室所在的建筑。

Bornanew 看着苍绿色的 Gilead 在你们脚下展开。

o.zh: 和 Mazalot 不一样，是吧？

entries.en:
He smiles, acknowledging the absurdity of your statement.

"Mazalot wasn't all bad. There was a sort of freedom there that can't be found on Gilead, though much danger as well."

He turns back to the view, "I did miss the green."
entries.zh:
他微笑着，承认你陈述中的荒谬之处。

"Mazalot 也没那么坏。那里有一种在 Gilead 找不到的自由，尽管同样伴随着许多危险。"

他转回去看向窗外，"我确实怀念这里的绿意。"

entries.en:
He smiles politely.

"Apprehensive, I confess. I believe I shall be punished by the Knights, though the Reverend Archurate may try to shield me. I shall ask her not to. An oath is an oath."

"I suspect there will be much silent contemplation and scrubbing of floors." He looks thoughtful, "They do like that sort of thing. I don't mind it."

He turns back to the face of Gilead.
entries.zh:
他礼貌的微笑道：

"老实说还是有点怕的。我相信骑士团会惩罚我，而宗师大人会试着帮我说话。我会让她别那么做的。誓言就是誓言。"

"我猜会有不少静坐，还要擦地板。" 他思索道，"他们挺喜欢用这类事情惩罚人的。我倒不是很在意。"

他重新回头看向了 Gilead。

entries.en:
As you leave with Degory, you hear Jaspis address Bornanew.

"The balance of power is changed; both I and the Faith's future have need of you. But..."

"Why 'Jeff'?" she asks.

You don't hear his reply.
entries.zh:
你和 Degory 一起离开时，你听到 Jaspis 对 Bornanew 说。

"力量的平衡改变了；我和信仰的未来都会需要你。只是..."

"怎么叫你 'Jeff'？" 她问道。

你没听到他的回复。

entries.en:
Bornanew puts his hands together and nods his head.

Blind to his response, Jaspis begins to address him, "The balance of power is changed; both I and the Faith's future have need of you..."
entries.zh:
Bornanew 收起了他的双手，然后点了点头。

Jaspis 并不能看见他的回应，她开始对他说道："力量的平衡改变了；我和信仰的未来都会需要你..."

entries.en:
The soft-spoken secretary, Degory, produces an incongruous datapad from her robes and conducts the transfer of the Archcurate's payment to your accounts. She then summons the grim-faced Knight Ailanthus to escort you to your waiting shuttle.

Your return to orbit is uneventful.
entries.zh:
说话轻声细语的秘书 Degory 从她的袍子里拿出了一个和她的形象完全不搭调的数据平板，把 大祭司 给你的报酬转入了你的账户。然后她叫来了冷着脸的骑士 Ailanthus，由他送你去正在等你的穿梭机。

返回轨道的过程一切顺利。

entries.en:
You speak first with some kind of secretary who politely persuades you to wait patiently.

After a short time, the image of the Archcurate Jaspis appears. She makes little effort to look toward comms feed as she putters around her office.

"It is good to hear from you, captain," she says. "Have you found Novice Bornanew?"
entries.zh:
先和你通话的是一个秘书样的人，她礼貌地劝你稍等一会。

一小段时间后，大祭司 Jaspis 的影像出现了。她在办公室里踱来踱去，基本没怎么看通讯画面。

"真高兴能收到你的消息，舰长。" 她说道，"你找到新晋骑士 Bornanew 了吗？"

entries.en: "Then I shall pray that Providence sees fit to give you a path both short and safe."
entries.zh: "那我便向上天祈祷，愿你一路简短平安。"

o.en: You mentioned payment for the job.
o.zh: 你之前提过工作报酬的事。

entries.en: "I did," she says. "25,000 credits upon your pledge, 50,000 credits upon the novice's return to me."
entries.zh: "我确实说过。" 她说到，"你承诺接下任务时我就付了 25,000 星币，等那个新晋骑士回到我身边时，我会再付 50,000 星币。"

o.en: What if I can't find him? What if he is dead?
o.zh: 如果我找不到他怎么办？要是他已经死了呢？

entries.en:
This gives the Archcurate pause.

"I pray that you will find him, and I have faith that Providence will provide your path. If you are thwarted, then I shall accept the records of your investigation in exchange for just compensation."

"And... if the worst came to pass, I would have his body receive a proper burial among the Knights." The old woman deflates a little, you can see, at the thought.
entries.zh:
这叫大祭司不由得停顿了一下。

"我祈祷你能找到他，而且我相信天意会为你指明前路。如果你的行动受挫，那么我会接受你的调查记录，以此换取合理的补偿。"

"而...如果发生了最糟糕的事，我会将他的遗体妥善地与骑士们埋葬在一起。" 你可以看出，这位老妇人一想到此事就有些低落。

o.en: This could be dangerous. I need more details.
o.zh: 这可能会很危险，我需要更多细节。

entries.en:
She considers her words as she sips something - tea, you suppose.

"He went amongst the wrathful and ill-led heretics of the so-called Luddic Path. If my understanding of your accomplishments is correct, then you have a full and fair idea of what you may face."

"Battle. In the void and upon the earth, entered through iniquitous trickery." She nods to herself, "That is how they fight. I would not ask you to walk amongst them if I did not think you were capable of matching their wickedness."
entries.zh:
她一边斟酌话语，一边小口抿着什么 —— 你推测，那应该是茶。

"他加入了一群充斥着狂怒和病态的异端，追随着所谓的卢德左径。如果我对你过往成就的了解没错的话，你应该完全清楚自己可能会面对什么。"

"战斗。既在虚空中，也在大地上，以邪恶的诡计潜入。" 她自己点了点头，"这就是他们战斗的方式。要是我认为你不能与他们的邪恶技俩相匹敌，我就不会要求你去找那个孩子。"

entries.en:
The Archcurate stops what she's doing, holds her hands together, and looks roughly toward the comm-feed.

"Yes?"
entries.zh:
大祭司停下了手头的事，双手合拢，目光大致朝向通信来源。

"嗯？"

o.en: I want to talk about your proposal, about the missing agent.
o.zh: 我想谈谈你的提议，关于那个失踪特工的。

o.en: I've given your proposal some thought. I will find your missing agent.
o.zh: 我考虑过你的提议了。我会替你找到失踪的特工。

entries.en:
She closes her eyes and bows her head, hands held together. You would swear she is saying a quiet prayer.

Her blind eyes open, and she looks at you across the comm-link.

"His name is Jethro Bornanew," she says.
entries.zh:
她闭上眼睛，垂下头颅，双手合十。你发誓，她一定是在无声地默念祈祷。

她睁开自己那失明的双眼，隔着通讯链接看向你。

"他的名字是 Jethro Bornanew。" 她开口道。

entries.en:
"He is a late-initiated Novice of the Luddic Knights. My assistant will provide you with an identity file."

"Novice Bornanew has infiltrated a cell of heretical militants affiliated with the so-called Luddic Path. I have not heard from him in some time."

"It's been far too long," she adds quietly.
entries.zh:
"他是一名见习修士，最近才加入卢德骑士团。我的助手会给你提供身份档案。"

"见习修士 Bornanew  潜入了一个异端武装分子小组，隶属于被称作 卢德左径 的组织。我已经有段时间没收到他的消息了。"

"时间过去的已经太久了。" 她平静地补充到。

o.en: What was his last known position?
o.zh: 他最后已知的位置在哪里？

entries.en:
"Chalcedon, in the Kumari Kandam system. He was to join some inner circle of the Path; he was to meet with a leader, or some manner of recruiter. Nothing have I heard since."

For a moment the Archcurate looks upward, and her lips move soundlessly, before she returns to face you.
entries.zh:
"Chalcedon，在 Kumari Kandam 星系。他当时要加入某个左径分子的核心圈子，打算面见某个领导，或者某种招募人员。自那时起，我就没再收到他的消息。"

大祭司的目光抬起了片刻，嘴唇无声地翕动，接着又转回来面对着你。

entries.en: "If heretics must die to secure his release," she says, "then do what must be done. Their blood will be washed away by that of the innocent, the seas and rivers that these 'Pathers' have spilled in the course of their heretical crusade. God will be your judge."
entries.zh: "如果必须铲除异端才能确保他安全获释，" 她说道，"那就做你该做的事吧。这些 '卢德左径' 所掀起的异端圣战让无辜者们血流成河，因而他们自己流的血，也会被这血海冲刷殆尽。神会明辨你的作为。"

entries.en: "You will be paid, of course. My office shall provide you an advance of 25,000 credits, with an additional 50,000 credits upon... resolution."
entries.zh: "当然，你会得到报酬。我的办公室会预付你 25,000 星币，事成之后...再追加 50,000 星币。"

entries.en:
Her expression tightens, multiplying the wrinkles on her face. "This I cannot deny."

"These heretics have vexed me for more years than you've lived; they have read Ludd's words through a glass, darkly, and they have seen a fearful vision. A dear and now departed fellow-walker said that it is a vision I have too-long contemplated."

She raises her hands, palms upward, "God shall weigh my soul," one hand drops. "I shall accept that judgment."
entries.zh:
她的表情紧绷起来，脸上的皱纹倍增。"这一点我不能否认。"

"这些异端们困扰了我已久，比你活过的年岁还要长过多年；他们仿佛对着模糊不清的镜子阅读了卢德的圣言，因而看到了一个可怕的幻象。一位亲爱的，已经离世的循道同袍曾对我说，这是一个我凝视了太久的幻象。"

她举起双手，掌心朝上，"神将会衡量我的灵魂，" 一只手落下。"我将接受那个审判。"

entries.en:
"His is a gentle soul, though rough-treated. He was in the House of Penitents when his case was brought before me, some years ago." The Archcurate turns slightly, as if taking in a vision from memory. "Prison, you would call it."

"It is my duty, more than simply charity, to review petitions of absolution as my schedule permits. I found in Jethro a bright mind, contrite and eager to learn anew. His crimes were not so great, and his part due more to his desire to please his associates than some inborn malice. I made his repentance my cause for a time, and by its end, he took on a new name, and he asked... how could he serve."
entries.zh:
"尽管曾受到了粗暴的对待，他还是有一个温柔的灵魂。几年前，当我处理他的案子时，他在忏悔者之家。" 大祭司稍微转过身去，仿佛回忆起了一幅画面，"用你们的话来说就是监狱。"

"在日程有空闲时，我有职责 —— 而不仅是出于慈悲 —— 审查赦免请求。我发现 Jethro 心灵明澈，愿意痛改前非。他的罪行并不那么严重，与其说是天性邪恶，倒不如说是为了取悦同伴。我花了一段时间主持他的忏悔，结束之后，他取了一个新名字，并且问...他该如何为神做贡献。"

entries.en:
"There was need for someone of his... experience. I sent him to train with the Knights, whereupon he became an initiate, and upon achieving the rank of novice he was assigned back to my Office of Archcuratorship to earn his knighthood through the service I required of him."

"I confess," she says quietly, "I fear that I have again spent the life of a good man. It is my pride-," Jaspis gives a bitter little laugh. "Perhaps it truly blinds me."
entries.zh:
"我们需要有他这样...经验的人。我送他去和卢德骑士们一同训练，于是他成为了一名学徒，然后在拿到了见习修士的职称后他被派回到我的主管办公室，为我服务来换取骑士职称。"

"我承认。" 她小声地说道，"我害怕我又一次浪费了一个好人的生命。我所秉持的骄傲 ——" Jaspis 轻轻地苦笑了一声。"也许真的蒙蔽了我自己。"

o.en: You don't know that he's dead.

entries.en:
"No. But the specter of his death weighs upon me as if it were already so."

She sighs. "I am old, captain, and perhaps I have borne this office too long. Let us speak of finding Bornanew, not of my guilt."
entries.zh:
"不。但是他的死亡如同鬼魅一般缠绕着我，一如既往。"

她叹了一口气。"我老了，舰长，而且我可能在这个办公室里熬的太久了。让我们讨论一下寻找 Bornanew，而不是我的罪孽吧。"

entries.en: "Yes." She sighs, "I am old, captain, and perhaps I have borne this office too long. Let us speak of Bornanew now, not of my guilt."
entries.zh: "是的。" 她叹了一口气，"我老了，舰长，而且我可能在这个办公室里熬的太久了。让我们讨论一下寻找Bornanew，而不是我的罪孽吧。"

entries.en:
You would swear that she gives you a hard look with her blind eyes.

"I cannot answer wholly yes or no," she says. "At one point, it might have been. Now I am not so sure."
entries.zh:
你确信她用盲眼给了你一个严厉的目光。

"我不能完全回答是或否。" 她说，"在某个时刻，也许还是可以的。但现在我不那么确定了。"

entries.en:
You would swear that she gives you a hard look with her blind eyes.

"I cannot answer wholly yes or no," she says. "At one point, it might have been. Now I am not so sure."
entries.zh:
你确信她用盲眼给了你一个严厉的目光。

"我不能完全回答是或否。" 她说，"在某个时刻，也许还是可以的。但现在我不那么确定了。"

o.en: And you still want me to deliver your 'message' to Cotton.
o.zh: 而你仍希望我将你的 '信息' 传递给 Cotton。

entries.en: "If that devil appears," she says, "then give him his due."
entries.zh: "如果那个恶魔出现了，" 她说道，"那就让他付出代价。"

entries.en:
"I pray that you do. May a friendly star light your Path."

Archcurate Jaspis signs off, and a shy novice opens the line to transfer your advance payment. They say a quiet "Blessed be your day," before closing the link.
entries.zh:
"我祈祷你能这样做。愿友好的星辰照亮你的道途。"

大祭司 Jaspis 结束了通话，一个害羞的见习修士打开线路，转移你的预付款。他们轻声说了一句 "愿你今日蒙福"，然后关闭了链接。

entries.en:
"Mm," she thinks for a moment before proceeding. "He was to pose as a man broken and lost, looking for a cause to illuminate his path. This would require little play-acting on Jethro's part."

"He would join a particular branch of the Luddic Path and prove himself by his aptitude and charm to make association with centermost leaders. He would send information to us, receive orders in return, and perform certain acts to influence the heretics' decisions."
entries.zh:
"嗯，" 她想了一会，然后继续道，"按照计划，他会扮作一个心碎欲绝，茫然若失的人，找寻着为自己指明前路的事业。对 Jethro 来说，这几乎不需要演技就能做到。"

"他会加入 卢德左径 的一个特定分部，通过他的天资和魅力证明自己，以便和最核心的领导人建立关系。他会给我们发送消息，接受我们回复的指令，并采取某些行动来影响异端们的决策。"

o.en: He is acting as your spy.
Is it possible he turned on you?
o.zh: 他有没有可能背叛了你？

entries.en: "Yes," the Archcurate says. "He is a good man, and so driven, who would take on this heavy burden to ease suffering and combat wrathful heresy."
entries.zh: "是的。" 大祭司说道，"他是个好人，如此努力，愿意承担这个沉重的负担，以减轻苦难并对抗暴怒的异端。"

entries.en: "No," the Archcurate says without hesitation. "He is a good man, and so driven."
entries.zh: "不。" 大祭司毫不犹豫地说道，"他是个好人，而且很努力。"

o.en: I accept your view of him, but you must consider the possibility.
o.zh: 我接受你对他的看法，但你必须考虑到这种可能性。

o.en: Then he may be... in trouble.

entries.en: "I mustn't and I shan't," she says fiercely. "And that will be the end of it."
entries.zh: "我不能，也不会这么做，" 她斩钉截铁地说道，"到此为止了。"

entries.en: "That he may," she says softly.
entries.zh: "也许他会，" 她轻声说道。

o.en: I can promise only to try.
You sound... a little bloodthirsty when it comes to the Path.
o.zh: 谈到左径的时候，你听起来...有点嗜血。

o.en: Can you tell me more about his mission?
o.zh: 你能再多跟我说说他的任务吗？
这是否和 Cotton 修士有关？

o.en: Can you tell me more about Bornanew?
o.zh: 你能告诉我更多关于 Bornanew 的信息吗？

entries.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you. "Yes. I am Jethro Bornanew."
entries.zh: 他分开双手转向了你。"是，我就是 Jethro Bornanew。"

entries.en:
"Oh, um." He looks at you to see if you're really asking this, now. You are.

"There are... writings around Ludd. From the early disciplines, recorded later. They tend to be heavily, ah, corrected toward the Church's rulings in accordance with Ludd's wishes. Or what is known of them. Others, unofficial copies, have been created by con-artists and heretics to prove their own schemes and cults. These, the Knights purge. Some are kept as examples. For teaching; heretic-finding."

He shakes his head, "Anyway. The song of angels."
entries.zh:
"哦，呃。" 他观察着你，似乎想确认你是否真的要问这个问题。你坚持要问。

"这些是...有关于卢德的著作，都来自于早期的学派，被后人整理而成。按照教会的裁决和卢德的意愿，这些书都被大量，嗯，'纠错'。或者按照什么他们所知的东西。其他非正式的抄本都是由骗子与异端创建的，为了佐证他们的阴谋与派系。这些都会被骑士团净化，少部分保留下来作为案例，用于警示或是辨别异端。"

他摇了摇头，"无论如何，那是天使的歌谣。"

entries.en: "To put it crudely, in some accounts it is said that God spoke to the Prophet Ludd through... through singing only Ludd could hear."
entries.zh: "简单而言，有的记载说神与先知卢德的交流是通过...通过只有卢德本人才能听到的歌。"

entries.en: "I apologize," he says. "After you came all this way, I have only the words of a novice to offer you. No great secrets or wisdom."
entries.zh: "抱歉。" 他说道，"在你不远万里来到这里之后，我只能说一些见习修士也能复述的话语，没有什么大奥妙或是大智慧。"

entries.en: "I pray for your strength," he says.
entries.zh: "我会为你的坚毅祈祷。" 他回应道。

entries.en: "Truly?" Bornanew shakes his head, "Now it is I who is tested by a fearful omen."
entries.zh: "真的吗？" Bornanew 摇了摇头，"现在是我被这可怕的预兆考验。"

o.zh: 这是卢德受神眷顾的证明。

entries.en: "To be so blessed must be a burden beyond all knowing," Bornanew says grimly.
entries.zh: "如此受神眷顾必是无人能知的重担。" Bornanew 阴沉地说道。

o.en: It sounds like a neurological issue.
o.zh: 听起来像是种神经系统的毛病。

entries.en:
"It could," Bornanew says, and looks to you. "Where between madness and the divine stands a prophet?"

"-On uneasy ground," he finishes; quoting something with a hint of a smile.
entries.zh:
"说不准呢。" Bornanew 说着，一边看向了你。"在疯狂与神性之间，先知将自立于何处？"

"—— 迎难而上。" 他自问自答，引述的同时不由得露出了一丝微笑。

entries.en: "It is not the time for theology," Bornanew says agreeably.
entries.zh: "现在确实不是谈神学的时候。" Bornanew 同意道。

o.en: There was a time I heard... distant music. Like a choir.
o.zh: 以前我也会听到...遥远的旋律。像是唱诗班。

entries.en: He raises an eyebrow at you.
entries.zh: 他朝你挑了挑眉。

o.en: I have heard... distant music. Like a choir. Wasn't in telemetry.
o.zh: 我也听到过...遥远的旋律。像是唱诗班。不是遥测信息。

o.en: I heard the music when we encountered a strange ship. It used exotic technologies unknown to even the Domain.
o.zh: 我听过那种旋律，那时我们遇到了某艘怪异的舰船。它使用了甚至对 人之领 来说都未知的奇异技术。

o.en: I heard the music when we scanned the Gates, the Domain Gates, using a new method.
o.zh: 当我用一种新的方法扫描 人之领 的星门时，我听到了旋律。

o.en: Never mind. It's not important now.
It's been said that Brother Livewell Cotton hears music. 'A choir of angels', those were the words.
o.zh: 据说 Livewell Cotton 修士也能听到旋律。'天使的合唱'，原话是这么说的。

o.en: Brother Livewell Cotton told me he has heard music. A 'choir of angels', he said.
o.zh: Livewell Cotton 修士也和我说他曾听到过旋律。他说那是 '天使的合唱'。

entries.en: "He would not be the first to make that claim," Bornanew says. "Nor the last, I am sure. God save us if Cotton were a prophet."
entries.zh: "敢这么说的，他绝不是第一个，" Bornanew 说道。"我敢肯定，也绝不会是最后一个。要是 Cotton 真能是个先知的话，愿神保佑我们。"

entries.en:
He lets out a sigh.

"Reason as well as life are gifts of the Creator. We are tested by confrontation with divine mystery. We must decide if we follow the highest path, or merely the most convenient."

He speaks more quietly, "It is a test. When the time comes, will you walk the path of light?"
entries.zh:
他叹了口气。

"理性与生命都是造物主的礼物。直面神性之谜乃是神给与我们的考验。我们必须决定是追随最高尚的道途，还是最轻松的道途。"

他用更低的声音继续道。"这是一场试炼。到时候，你是否会行光之道途？"

entries.en: "Of course. It is not now the time for theology," Bornanew says, watching you carefully.
entries.zh: "确实，现在不是谈神学的时候。" Bornanew 谨慎地看着你道。

o.en: Let us speak of other things.

entries.en: "The doctrine of the Church tells us the Gates are a product of technological sin. I'm sure you know this," Bornanew says, watching you carefully. "Ludd's words, as far as we know them, do not put it quite so simply."
entries.zh: "教会的教条声称星门是科技原罪的产物，你肯定也知道的。" Bornanew 谨慎地看着你道。"而据我们所知，卢德的原话却并没有如此简单。"

o.en: I have traversed the Gates. A lesser crossing, but I have the technology.
o.zh: 我曾穿过星门。可达范围不怎么广，但我有那个技术。

o.en: The Gates are a gift, Bornanew. We should use them.
o.zh: 星门是一种馈赠，Bornanew。我们应该利用它们。

o.en: The Gates are dangerous. They must be studied carefully.
o.zh: 星门很危险，研究它们时要慎之又慎。

o.en: Just as well, because I intend to avoid them.
o.zh: 也无所谓了，因为我打算离它们远点。

o.en: Just as well, because I intend to avoid them. (lie)
o.zh: 也无所谓了，因为我打算离它们远点。 (说谎)

entries.en: "Then I beg Providence save us," Bornanew almost whispers. "I know not what door you have opened."
entries.zh: "愿上天保佑我们，" Bornanew 的话语声微不可闻。"我不敢想象你打开了怎样的一扇门。"

o.en: The Gates are a gift, Bornanew. We should use them.
o.zh: 星门是一种馈赠，Bornanew。我们应该利用它们。

o.en: The Gates are dangerous. They must be studied carefully.
o.zh: 星门很危险，研究它们时要慎之又慎。

o.en: Just as well, because I intend to avoid them.
o.zh: 也无所谓了，因为我打算离它们远点。

o.en: Just as well, because I intend to avoid them. (lie)
o.zh: 也无所谓了，因为我打算离它们远点。 (说谎)

entries.en: "I admit, captain, that I cannot but look upon this gift with suspicion when the bones of the Domain lie moldering around us."
entries.zh: "人之领 的枯骨依旧洒遍这片星空，舰长，所以我不得不对这一馈赠保留怀疑的态度。"

entries.en: "One must be careful around great and terrible works such as the Gates. Even your science suggests that observation may change both subject and observer."
entries.zh: "对待星门这伟大又恐怖的杰作必须要小心。即使是你们的科学也提出了对事物的观察有可能同时改变观测者和被观测者。"

entries.en: "Just as well, then. But I suspect few of the great factions share your intent."
entries.zh: "那就无所谓吧。但我怀疑没有几个主要势力和你想法相同。"

entries.en: "Just as well, then," Bornanew says, as if you've both just agreed to not discuss something. "I suspect the great factions will do little to avoid them."
entries.zh: "那就无所谓吧。" Bornanew 说道，你们似乎达成了不再谈一些事的共识，"我怀疑那些主要势力并不会那么做。"

entries.en: "That sounds like a fearful omen," Bornanew says earnestly.
entries.zh: "听起来像是个可怕的预兆。" Bornanew 认真地说道。

o.en: What am I supposed to do with a 'fearful omen'?
o.zh: 我该如何应对这 '可怕的预兆'？

o.en: That ship, the Ziggurat, is in orbit. In my fleet.
o.zh: 那艘船，'通灵塔'，就在轨道上。在我的舰队之中。

entries.en: Almost unconsciously he looks up to the sky, and says "Ludd's grace preserve us."
entries.zh: 他下意识地抬头仰望天空，并说着 "愿卢德保佑我们。"

o.en: Walk the Path of Light? That doesn't help.
o.zh: 遵从光之道途？那无济于事。

o.en: I will try to walk the path of light. When the time comes.
o.zh: 当时机成熟的时候，我将尽力遵从光明之道。

o.en: 'Path of light'? Brother Cotton told me the same thing.
o.zh: '光之道途'？Cotton 修士也跟我说过同样的东西。

entries.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you. "No," he says. He glances back at the graves. "This farm - what's left of it - they built it. So I was told."
entries.zh: 他分开双手转向了你。"不是。" 他说着看了那些坟墓一眼，"这个所剩无几的农场，是他们搭的。至少我知道的是这样。"

entries.en:
"No," he says, looking at the graves. "I never met them. Not when they were alive, I mean."

"This farm - what's left of it - they built it. So I was told."
entries.zh:
"不是。" 他说着看了那些坟墓一眼，"我从没见过他们，至少没在他们在世时见过。"

"这个所剩无几的农场，就是他们搭的。至少我知道的是这样。"

entries.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you, a hint of concern on his face. "I see. The Reverend Archcurate. Of course."
entries.zh: 他分开双手转向了你，脸上带着一丝忧虑。"我知道了，那位受人尊敬的宗师大人。当然了。"

entries.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you, a hint of concern on his face. "I see. Jaspis, of course."
entries.zh: 他分开双手转向了你，脸上带着一丝忧虑。"我知道了，Jaspis。当然了。"

entries.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you. "Of course."
entries.zh: 他分开双手转向了你。"行吧。"

entries.en: He quickly turns to stare at you with a strange intensity. "I-," he begins, and his words catch in his throat. He breathes heavily for a moment, almost unsteady on his feet.
entries.zh: 他飞快地转过身，并带着一种奇怪的热切死死地盯着你。"我 ——" 他开口道，但是声音卡在了喉咙里。他用力喘了几口气，几乎站不稳脚跟。

o.en: Don't die for real on me, now.
o.zh: 你可别真死在我面前了。

entries.en:
After a moment, he lets a breath out, and then almost - but not quite - casually wipes a sleeve across his face. His eyes are red, you see.

"Yes. Yes, I am well. Is your offer serious? You would do this thing for me?"
entries.zh:
过了一会儿，他呼了口气，然后看似随便地用袖口抹了把脸。你发现他双眼通红。

"对。是的，我很好。" 他清了清嗓子，"但你说的是真的？你愿意对我那么做？"

entries.en:
He lets a breath out, and then almost casually wipes a sleeve across his face. His eyes are red, you see.

"Forgive me," he clears his throat. "Is your offer serious? You would do this thing for me?"
entries.zh:
他呼了口气，然后看似随意地用袖口抹了把脸。你发现他双眼通红。

"原谅我。" 他清了清嗓子，"但你说的是真的？你愿意对我那么做？"

entries.en:
After a moment, he lets a breath out, and then almost - but not quite - casually wipes a sleeve across his face. His eyes are red, you see.

"Yes. Yes, I am well. Is your offer serious? You would do this thing for me?"
entries.zh:
过了一会儿，他呼了口气，然后看似随便地用袖口抹了把脸。你发现他双眼通红。

"对。是的，我很好。" 他清了清嗓子，"但你说的是真的？你愿意对我那么做？"

o.en: Of course. I just need a body to substitute. (look pointedly at the graves)
o.zh: 当然了，我只要找具尸体代替你就成。 (意有所指地看一眼坟墓)

o.en: I'm afraid I cannot. The Archcurate gave me a mission and I intend to complete it.
o.zh: 恐怕不行。我打算认真完成大祭司给我交代的任务。

entries.en:
"No," he says with a sudden ferocity.

He catches himself, then begins again, more calmly,
"And no, forget about all of that. I'm coming with you to Gilead. I have to."
entries.zh:
"不行。" 他忽然恶狠狠地喊了一句。

他止住了自己的失态，然后重新用更冷静的语气说道。
"不，啊，忘记刚才那些事吧。我会和你去 Gilead，我必须去。"

entries.en: "Of course," he says quietly. "I have a duty; I made a promise."
entries.zh: "当然了。" 他轻声道，"是我的职责；我发过誓的。"

entries.en:
He quickly turns to stare at you with a strange intensity. "I-," he begins, and his words catch in his throat. He breathes heavily for a moment, almost unsteady on his feet.

"No," he says. "I'm coming with you to Gilead. It's what I have to do."
entries.zh:
他飞快地转过身，并带着一种奇怪的热切死死地盯着你。"我 ——" 他开口道，但是声音卡在了喉咙里。他用力喘了几口气，几乎站不稳脚跟。

"不用了。" 他说道，"我和你去 Gilead，这是我该做的。"

o.en: Don't die for real on me, now.
o.zh: 你可别真死在我面前了。

entries.en: "No," he says, then "Yes, I mean. I'm fine. Just, the answer is no. I'm coming with you to Gilead. It's what I have to do."
entries.zh: "不，" 他说，然后又说，"是的，我是说。我很好。只是，我不想变成尸体。我会和你去 Gilead。这是我必须做的事。"

entries.en: "No," he says. "The answer is no. I'm coming with you to Gilead. It's what I have to do."
entries.zh: "不。" 他说道，"我不想变成尸体。我会和你去 Gilead，这是我该做的。"

entries.en:
He looks, struck silent, at the light coming through the trees.

"Let someone else walk my path."

He turns to you. "I accept. Tell Jaspis... tell her... I should write something, maybe..."
entries.zh:
他抬起头，呆呆地看向树间洒落的阳光。

"就让其他人代我行我的道途吧。"

他回头看向你。"就这么办吧。告诉 Jaspis...告诉她...我或许该写点什么..."

o.en: No. You must live for yourself now.
o.zh: 不用。你应该为自己而活。

o.en: You should. It will help. She was... emotional.
o.zh: 写吧。可以起到一些作用。她... 很情绪化。

entries.en:
He sighs, covering his face with his hands. "I can't do this. I'm sorry."

"I have a duty. I made a promise. It's what I have to do."
entries.zh:
他叹了口气，用手捂住了脸。"我做不到。对不起。"

"我有我的职责。我发过誓的。我必须这么做。"

entries.en:
"But..." he falls silent.

In a long minute, he appears to accept your words.
entries.zh:
"但..." 他的声音低了下去。

过了许久，他似乎是同意了你的话。

entries.en: "This is it then," he turns and looks at you once more.
entries.zh: "那就到此为止了。" 他转过身，重新看向你。

o.en: It is. Burn bright, burn long. (leave)
o.zh: 是的。愿你的火光长明。 (离开)

o.en: It is. Blessed be your path. (leave)
o.zh: 是的。愿你的道途蒙福。 (离开)

o.en: It is. Keep your head down. (leave)
o.zh: 是的。愿你谦卑俯首。 (离开)

entries.en:
You walk from the graves, from the dry grove, and return to your shuttle, and it returns you to your $shipOrFleet.

Jethro Bornanew - the man who was once called Jethro Bornanew - is a free man now. Free of his oath, free of schemes; free to live his next life, whatever it may be.
entries.zh:
你离开了墓地，走出了干燥的树林，回到了你的穿梭机，而后者带你回了你的$shipOrFleet。

Jethro Bornanew —— 或者说那个曾经叫 Jethro Bornanew 的人 —— 现在是自由之身了。从他的誓言中解脱，从阴谋诡计中解脱；他将自由地选择他接下来的人生，无论是什么在等着他。

entries.en:
You walk from the graves, from the dry grove. Your marine squad falls in like spirits of the desert summoned to material form.

Jethro Bornanew - the man who was once called Jethro Bornanew - is a free man now. Free of his oath, free of schemes; free to live his next life, whatever it may be.
entries.zh:
你离开了墓地，走出了干燥的树林。陆战小队也集合了，就像受到召唤显出真身的沙漠之灵一般。

Jethro Bornanew —— 或者说那个曾经叫 Jethro Bornanew 的人 —— 现在自由了。自由于他的誓言，自由于阴谋诡计；自由地选择他的下一世怎么活，无论是什么在等着他。

entries.en:
Finding a body to substitute for Bornanew is not difficult. One that appears to have died a violent death, but at least a quick death?

Shot in the back by a Pather seems likely, but too dramatic. An accident, then; even easier. A thruster malfunction at the docks. Over in a split second, and no one really to blame except slipshod safety/control measures. One of those unhappy little events that Providence provides to bring an unexpected end to the path of life... and which burns away obvious identifying features.

The Reverend Archcurate will accept a closed-casket burial, you think.
entries.zh:
找具尸体来代替 Bornanew 倒也不难。比如一具看起来痛快地死于非命的尸体？

一具被左径分子从背后射杀的尸体倒是挺可信，但太张扬了。伪装成意外会更加简单，比如船坞或者是喷气机故障。这样的事故只需要一瞬间，完全可以把这口黑锅扣在马虎的安保措施头上。这正是上天意想终结一条生命时会用到的小事故...也刚好能烧尽所有能够清晰辨明受害人身份的特征。

你觉得宗师大人也不会太在意棺材里躺的究竟是谁。

entries.en:
"It is." He looks down at the graves. "It was."

"I've discovered that I'm a poor farmer, captain. It seems like everything withers at my touch."
entries.zh:
"是我的。" 他低头看向了坟墓。"以前是。"

"我发现我当农夫当得一塌糊涂，舰长。简直是种什么死什么。"

entries.en: He looks over your uniform, then past you toward the ridgeline. "You came a long way. Captain, I assume?"
entries.zh: 他的视线扫过你的制服，然后穿过你望向了山脊线。"我猜你是大老远过来的吧，舰长？"

entries.en:
He looks over your uniform, then past you toward the ridgeline.

"You came a long way. And you brought warriors." He turns back to the graves, "I've counted two, so far."
entries.zh:
他的视线扫过你的制服，然后穿过你望向了山脊线。

"我猜你是大老远过来的吧，而且你还带了士兵。" 他回过头重新看向坟墓，"至此为止，我数到了两个人。"

entries.en: He gives you a strange look. "If you really want to, I suppose."
entries.zh: 他莫名其妙地看了你一眼。"如果你真的想这么叫的话，也行。"

o.en: Jeff it is. It's less... you know.
o.zh: 那就 Jeff。这样不怎么...啊，你懂的。

o.en: I'm not being serious. Your name is Jethro.
o.zh: 我开玩笑的，你就叫 Jethro。

entries.en: "Less Luddic, you mean," he says with a smirk. "I understand."
entries.zh: "你是想说更不卢德化。" 他咧嘴一笑道，"我懂。"

entries.en: "Less Luddic," he says with a smirk. "I understand."
entries.zh: "这样不怎么卢德化。" 他咧嘴一笑道，"我懂。"

entries.en:
"Ah," he smiles awkwardly.

"I apologize. This is all... not a shock, exactly. A rather large turn on the path that I have found to be my life, I suppose. It is a lot to reflect upon, now that it is happening."
entries.zh:
"啊，" 他尴尬地笑了笑。

"抱歉。这一切...确切地说，不怎么震惊。我想，这是我人生道路上的相当大的转折。有很多值得反思的地方。"

entries.en:
You and Bornanew walk from the graves, from the dry grove.

"There's nothing here I need," Bornanew says as you pause before the dying farmstead. "I am prepared to leave."

The shuttle returns you to your $shipOrFleet.
entries.zh:
你和 Bornanew 离开了墓地，走出了干燥的树林。

"我也没什么要拿的。" Bornanew 见你在垂死的农庄前停了一下，如此说道，"我准备好出发了。"

穿梭机把你带回了你的$shipOrFleet。

entries.en:
You walk with Bornanew from the graves, from the grove. The marine squad falls in like spirits of the desert summoned to material form.

"There's nothing here I need," Bornanew says as you pause before the dying farmstead. "I am prepared to leave."

The shuttle returns to your $shipOrFleet.
entries.zh:
你和 Bornanew 离开了墓地，走出了干燥的树林。陆战小队也集合了，就像受到召唤显出真身的沙漠之灵一般。

"我也没什么要拿的。" Bornanew 见你在垂死的农庄前停了一下，如此说道，"我准备好出发了。"

穿梭机把你带回了你的$shipOrFleet。

o.en: Wait- what was that about the 'song of angels'?
o.zh: 等等 —— 什么是 '天使之歌'？

o.en: I'm taking you back to Gilead.
o.zh: 我是来带你回 Gilead 的。

o.en: If you like, I can have found you dead here.
o.zh: 如果你乐意，我也可以是只找到了你的尸体。

o.en: "Why does Jaspis want you back so badly?
o.zh: Jaspis 为什么这么着急叫你回去？

o.en: What happened with infiltrating the Path? You had a mission.
o.zh: 你潜入左径的时候出了什么事？你可是有任务在身。

entries.en:
"I failed," he says.

After a moment, he speaks again, "And I confess, I wanted to fail. After meeting the recruiter on Chalcedon..." Bornanew shakes his head.
entries.zh:
"我失败了。" 他说道。

过了一会，他又补充道："而且老实说，我是故意失败的。在见到 Chalcedon 的那个招募人后..." Bornanew 摇了摇头。

o.en: Sedge? Don't worry, I killed him.
o.zh: Sedge？别担心，他已经被我杀了。

entries.en:
"Yes," he looks surprised, "That was his name. I did not like the man. I did not like the things I would have to do to make him like me."

Bornanew looks away, "He seemed to be someone I might have been if I had lived a different life. Walked a different path."
entries.zh:
"对。" 他看起来有些惊讶，"他就是叫这个。我不喜欢那个人。也不喜欢为了让他喜欢我而不得不做的事。"

Bornanew 移开了目光。"他就像是另一个我，一个拥有不同人生，走上不同道路的我。"

o.zh: 别担心，Sedge 已经被我杀了。

o.en: The deed is done. Or not done, in your case. Let it go.
o.zh: 已经过去了。可能也不算吧，考虑到你的话。走吧。

o.en: But you're not him. That's why Jaspis wants you back.
o.zh: 但你不是他，所以 Jaspis 才想叫你回去。

o.en: You'll have to learn to be a lot less squeamish if you're to be a Knight.
o.zh: 若想成为骑士，你可不能这么软弱。

entries.en:
"You- what?" He looks you in the eyes, to confirm that you are telling the truth. He quickly discovers that you are.

"I have no words," he says, shaking his head.
entries.zh:
"你 —— 什么？" 他看向你的双眼，确认着你是不是在说真话。他很快发现，你确实是认真的。

"我不知道说什么好。" 他摇了摇头道。

o.en: Aren't you a Knight Initiate? How can you be so squeamish?
o.zh: 你不是个新晋骑士吗？怎么会这么软弱？

entries.en: He nods hesitantly, and says "Then I will speak no further on this matter."
entries.zh: 他犹豫地点点头，说道："那我就不说这个了。"

entries.en: He gives you a skeptical look, "That worries me all the more."
entries.zh: 他怀疑地看了你一眼，道："这让我更担心了。"

entries.en: "Your words are a cold comfort, captain."
entries.zh: "你的安慰于事无补，舰长。"

entries.en:
"I might not be when I get back," he admits.

"But you're right. It is probable that a Knight will be called upon to kill to defend the Faith. It is what I agreed to, what I swore I would learn."
entries.zh:
"等我回去时大概就不算了。" 他承认道。

"但你说得没错。骑士很可能被召唤去为了捍卫信仰而进行杀戮，这是我同意的事，也是我发誓要学会的事。"

o.en: Look, this one was on me. Don't worry about it.
o.zh: 听着，这件事算在我头上。别担心了。

o.en: See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to.
o.zh: 看到了吗？这就是为什么你是 Jaspis 所需要的人选。

entries.en:
"I feel that I must," he says. "In one sense, his death is due to my choices, though I had no way of knowing it."

"It is true also that he was, by all accounts - and indeed in my judgment - an evil man. His faith twisted in upon itself. It shielded him from remorse for his... actions."
entries.zh:
"我觉得我做不到。" 他说，"从某方面来看，他的死也是因为我的选择造成的，就算我不可能提前得知会那样。"

"不过他也确实是个恶人，不管从哪个方面来看这都是事实 —— 我个人也是这么觉得的。他的信仰扭曲而自私。他也因此不会后悔自己的...'行为'。"

o.en: You're worrying about it. I told you not to.
o.zh: 我和你说了纠结这事了，你还这样。

o.en: See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to.
o.zh: 看到了吗？这就是为什么你是 Jaspis 所需要的人选。

entries.en:
"I cannot do that," he says.

"I do concede that he was, by all accounts and indeed my judgment, an evil man. His faith, it was twisted in upon itself. It shielded him from remorse for his... actions."
entries.zh:
"我做不到。" 他说道。

"我也承认他确实是个恶人，不管从哪个方面来看都是这样 —— 我主观上也是这么觉得的。他扭曲自私的信仰导致他从不后悔自己的...'行为'。"

o.en: See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to.
o.zh: 看到了吗？这就是为什么你是 Jaspis 所需要的人选。

entries.en: "I cannot do that," he says.
entries.zh: "我做不到。" 他说道。

o.en: See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to.
o.zh: 看到了吗？这就是为什么你是 Jaspis 所需要的人选。

entries.en:
"I failed," he says.

After a moment, he speaks again, "And I confess, I wanted to fail. After meeting the recruiter on Chalcedon..."

Bornanew shakes his head.
entries.zh:
"我失败了。" 他说道。

过了一会，他又补充道："而且老实说，我是故意失败的。在见到 Chalcedon 的那个招募人后..."

Bornanew 摇了摇头。

entries.en:
"The Reverend Archcurate," he says automatically.

"Sorry," he adds quickly. "Habit. They really drill it into you in the Church. Archcurate Jaspis... told me I could call her Sophronia, as if I was family."

"She wants to change the path of the Faith, I believe. She believes I can help her do it."
entries.zh:
"宗师大人。" 他条件反射地说道。

"抱歉。" 他很快补充道，"习惯了，教会里真的会把这个烙进你的脑子。大祭司 Jaspis 说...我可以叫她 Sophronia，就像一家人一样。"

"我认为她想改变信仰之道。而她认为我可以帮她实现。"

entries.en:
"So was Ludd," he says, and laughs.

"Ah," he catches himself, and wipes his eyes. "Forgive me my blasphemy. I do not believe I am Ludd; I do not hear God's word in the songs of angels."
entries.zh:
"卢德也是。" 他说着大笑了起来。

"啊。" 他止住了自己的失态，擦了擦眼睛，"原谅我的不敬。我不觉得我会是卢德；我没在天使之歌中听到神言。"

o.en: People died for me to find you.
o.zh: 为了找到你，我让人丢了性命。

entries.en: He sighs deeply. "Was it necessary?"
entries.zh: 他深深地叹了口气。"那是必要的吗？"

o.en: That's not important now. I have a mission to complete.
o.zh: 现在无所谓了。我还有任务要完成。

o.en: Yes. In conflicts between the powerful, that's how it works.
o.zh: 是的。权势之争向来如此。

entries.en: "I see," he looks at you uneasily.
entries.zh: "我知道了。" 他不安地看着你。

entries.en: "Gilead," he says, staring at the graves.
entries.zh: "Gilead。" 他盯着坟墓说道。

entries.en: He looks at you uneasily, but says nothing.
entries.zh: 他有些不安地看着你，但并没有开口。

o.en: I shot a man to find you.
o.zh: 为了找到你，我射杀了一个人。

o.en: No one else seems to think much of you.
o.zh: 似乎其他人都没把你当回事。

entries.en:
He shrugs. "The Reverend Archcurate does. And that was enough to bring you here, for me."

He glances over at you, "I don't care to speculate about how many credits she's wasting on me."
entries.zh:
他耸了耸肩。"但宗师大人确实这么觉得，你都因此被派来找我了。"

他瞥了你一眼。"我都不愿去想她在我身上浪费了多少星币。"

entries.en:
"Yes," he says and glances at you. Expecting some news of Jaspis' health, maybe. He turns away again.

"Time comes for us all. I expect she sees that. She wants to leave behind a world... that's better, I think."
entries.zh:
"是啊。" 他说着瞥了你一眼。似乎是想听听你有没有关于 Jaspis 身体状况的消息。他又转过了头。

"岁月无情，我猜她自己也知道。所以她想留下一个更...好的世界，我想。"

entries.en: He grunts acknowledgement, looking down at the brightly painted graves.
entries.zh: 他赞同地哼了一声，一边低头看着色彩鲜艳的坟墓。

entries.en: He doesn't respond. Just looks down at the brightly painted graves.
entries.zh: 他没说什么，只是低头看着色彩鲜艳的坟墓。

entries.en:
"Bornanew, huh," $personName says, growing bored. "Sounds like a Luddie. I'd say check the public directory, but I guess he'd be one of those that thinks it's 'the book of Moloch', right?"

"Look... Captain $playerLastName was it? I have enough problems with keeping the Luddics under control as it is. If you want to find one, ask one."

$HeOrShe turns away to look at another screen, clearly finished with the conversation.
entries.zh:
"Bornanew，哼，" $personName 说，"听起来像个卢德佬。我建议你去查查公共目录，但我猜他会是那种把这当做 '恶魔摩洛克之书' 的人，对吧？"

"这么说吧... $playerLastName 舰长是吗？我在控制卢德人方面遇到的问题已经够多了。如果你想找一个卢德人，那就去问另一个。"

$HeOrShe转过身去看另一个屏幕，干脆地结束了对话。

entries.en:
"Bornanew, huh," $personName says. "Sounds like a Luddie. I'd say check the public directory, but I guess he'd be one of those that thinks it's 'the book of Moloch', right?"

"Look... Captain $playerLastName? I can see you're signed up with the League, so I want to help you. But I have enough problems keeping the Luddics under control as it is."
entries.zh:
"Bornanew，哼，" $personName 说，"听起来像个卢德佬。我建议你去查查公共目录，但我猜他会是那种把这当做 '恶魔摩洛克之书' 的人，对吧？"

"你瞧... $playerLastName 舰长？我看到你已经加入了联盟，所以我想帮帮你。但我在控制卢德信徒上遇到的麻烦已经够多了。"

o.en: So help me. Who runs the Path around here?
o.zh: 所以帮我一把。谁在指挥附近的左径分子？

o.en: I have credentials from Gens Yaribay. Horus Yaribay personally asked me to investigate this matter. (lie)
o.zh: 我有来自 Yaribay 氏族的证件。Horus Yaribay 亲自命令我调查此事。 (说谎)

entries.en:
"And," $heOrShe spares a glance back at the comms, "Don't stir up any trouble. $personLastName out."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"还有，" $heOrShe回头看了一眼通讯器，"别搞出任何麻烦。$personLastName 完毕。"

通讯中断了。

entries.en:
"Good, ... good," he says, uncertainly.

It looks like he's considering telling you more dire warnings, but he says nothing as he cuts the comms.
entries.zh:
"好，... 好。" 他不确定地说。

看起来他正在考虑向你发出更可怕的警告，但他在切断通讯时什么也没说。

entries.en:
What looks like an expression of terrible regret, poorly hidden, crosses Dardan Kato's face.

But he says nothing as he cuts the comms.
entries.zh:
Dardan Kato 的脸上露出一种难以掩饰的、可怕的悔恨表情。

但他在切断通讯时什么也没说。

entries.en:
"You really want to go there?" $HeOrShe looks at you for a moment, then shakes $hisOrHer head when you fail to desist.

"Well. Fine. There's a man, Nile Virens. He's some kind of strong-man in the Path. I swear he's behind half the bombings in the systems, but I can't peg anything on him. You know, legally. So if I touch him, it'll set off the Luddies and we all know what happened last time."

You note, now, that $personName looks seriously stressed out. $HeOrShe could probably use more sleep. And fewer stimulants.
entries.zh:
"你真的想去那里吗？" $HeOrShe看了你一会儿，见你没有罢休的意思，便摇了摇$hisOrHer的头。

"行。好吧。有一个人，Nile Virens。他是左径里的某个高层。并且我发誓他是星系中一半爆炸事件的幕后黑手，但我无法往他身上挂任何罪名。你知道，合法的那种。所以如果我碰他，就会激怒卢德佬，我们都知道上次发生了什么。"

你注意到，现在 $personName 看起来压力很大。$HeOrShe可能需要多一些睡眠，少一点刺激。

o.en: Where can I find Nile Virens?
o.zh: 在哪儿能找到 Nile Virens？

entries.en:
"He's got... a stronghold, I guess I'd call it. Fortified bunker on the surface. Well, a network of them hidden in the Luddic communities and quarters. I'll send you what I've got on him."

"There's also a comms ID, though," $heOrShe makes a little snort, "He doesn't pick up when 'Servants of Moloch' come calling."

"Captain." $HeOrShe fixes you with $hisOrHer bloodshot eyes. "Please. Don't do anything stupid. Like I said, the Luddies are touchy, and there are more of them than there are us."
entries.zh:
"他有... 一个要塞，我猜我可以这么称呼。地表上的坚固掩体。好吧，他们的网络隐藏在卢德信徒社群和居住区中。我会把我掌握的资料发给你。"

"这儿还有一个通讯 ID，" $heOrShe哼了一声，"不过 '摩洛克之仆' 呼叫时他不会接听的。"

"舰长。" $HeOrShe用$hisOrHer充满血丝的眼睛凝视着你，"拜托。别做什么傻事。就像我说的，卢德佬很敏感，而且人数比我们要多。"

o.en: ...We'll see. Thank you for you cooperation.
o.zh: ...让我们拭目以待。感谢你的合作。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe sighs heavily, and drops $hisOrHer TriPad onto $hisOrHer desk.

"No. And if you insist on poking around for your lost Luddie, just don't cause any trouble. That's an order, a command." $HeOrShe picks the TriPad back up, "Whatever it is I'm supposed to be doing around here for the glory of the Mazalot Unificiation Authority."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe重重地叹了口气，然后将$hisOrHer的 TriPad 放在$hisOrHer的桌子上。

"不行。如果你一定要四处探寻那个失踪的卢德佬，就别惹任何麻烦。这是个命令，死命令。" $HeOrShe又拿起那个 TriPad，"不论我为此做了什么，都是为了 Mazalot 统一政权的荣耀。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe rolls $hisOrHer eyes. "No? It's what they are."

"Anyway, I don't know where your Luddie is, so don't bother asking. Those people give me enough trouble as it is, and the last thing I need is another 'incident' to stir up the mob"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe翻了翻眼睛。"不是吗？这就是他们的本质。"

"不论如何，我不知道你要找的那个卢德佬在哪，所以别浪费时间了。那帮人已经给我弄出足够大的乱子了，而我最不希望看见的就是另一个 '事故' 激起民众的情绪。"

entries.en:
"Speaking of- I'm very busy. Have a bright burn away from here, spacer."

The comms snap off.
entries.zh:
"谈到这里 —— 我很忙。还请祝你离开时航行无阻，太空佬。"

通讯中断了

entries.en: $HeOrShe rolls $hisOrHer eyes. "Wonderful. I will definitely make an effort to remember your preferred form of address."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe翻了个白眼。"太好了，我一定会努力记住你喜欢的称呼方式。"

entries.en:
$PersonName looks at you incredulously, then lets out a bitter laugh.

"Are you, now. Great," $heOrShe rolls $hisOrHer eyes, "just what I need: a vigilante. Or a merc?"

"Look, either way about it, I am telling you - ordering you - to not go stirring up trouble with the Luddies. The last thing I need on my watch is another 'incident' to give them an excuse to cause more trouble."

$HeOrShe gives you a look of immense skepticism. "We done?"
entries.zh:
$PersonName 难以置信地看着你，然后发出一声苦笑。

"是吗？非常好，" $heOrShe翻了翻眼睛，"我需要的是个自以为是的私警，还是个雇佣兵？"

"听着，不论如何，我告诉，不，命令你 —— 不要再惹那帮卢德佬的麻烦了。我最不希望看到的就是另一个 '事故'，让他们借此引来更多麻烦。"

$HeOrShe对你投以极度怀疑的目光。"听明白了吗？"

entries.en:
You watch Dardan Kato's face stiffen; emotions - anger, annoyance, fear - erupt and crystalize.

"The Church." The words escape from his mouth like an inconvenient prisoner he'd rather everyone forgot. "Here."
entries.zh:
你看到 Dardan Kato 的脸变得僵硬，愤懑、恼怒、恐惧五味杂陈地凸显在他的脸上。

"教会。" 他像不愿意让别人听到一样吐出这句话，"到这里来了。"

o.en: Yes, I am searching for an agent of the Church. He came here.
o.zh: 是的，我正在搜寻一个隶属于教会的特工，他来过这里。

entries.en:
"No, you're not," he snaps. "You're not here. You're not welcome here. And we're not having this conversation."

The comms-link abruptly terminates.
entries.zh:
"不，你没有，" 他咆哮道，"别来这里。这里不欢迎你。我们也没有说过话。"

通信突然中断了。

entries.en:
His eyebrows go up. "Horus Yaribay sent you? Here?"

"Gens Kato is looking after Mazalot. Trying to build something here in spite of interfactional meddling. The Yaribays should know that, and you should know better than to interfere."

He snorts, "At least, you should have been quiet about it."
entries.zh:
他的眉毛扬起，"Horus Yaribay 让你来的？来这儿？"

"Kato 氏族管理着 Mazalot。哪怕各个派系横加干预，我们也要尽力在这做出些成就。Yaribay 氏族应当了解这点，而你也是个聪明人，肯定不会干涉这种事。"

他哼了声，"至少，要干涉也得是偷偷干涉。"

entries.en: The line blinks a standby message for several minutes. There is no acknowledgement of your comms request.
entries.zh: 几分钟过去，通讯界面一直保持着待机状态。你的通讯请求没有回应。

entries.en: The line blinks a standby message for several minutes. There is no acknowledgement of your comms request.
entries.zh: 几分钟过去，通讯界面一直保持着待机状态。你的通讯请求没有回应。

entries.en:
"I'm very busy. Have a bright burn away from here."

The comms snap off.
entries.zh:
"我很忙。还请祝你离开时航行无阻。"

通讯中断了。

entries.en: $HeOrShe glances down at a datapad, then back at you. "Oh. You're the one who's been asking around about the Luddie, aren't you."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe低头瞥了一眼数据平板，然后又看向你。"啊，你就是那个到处打听卢德佬的人，对吧？"

o.en: That's right. Know anything about Jethro Bornanew?
o.zh: 没错，你知道关于 Jethro Bornanew 的消息吗？
叫别人 '卢德佬' 是不是有点不尊重人了？

o.en: We prefer the word 'Faithful' or 'Walker'. 'Follower of Ludd' can work, if you like.
o.zh: 我们更喜欢 '忠诚者' 或者是 '求道者' 这样的称呼。如果你喜欢，'卢德的追随者' 也可以。

o.en: I'm on a mission on behalf of an archcurate of the Church of Galactic Redemption.
o.zh: 我作为 银河救赎教会 一位大祭司的代表执行一项任务。

entries.en: $HeOrShe is paying more attention to a datapad than the comms. "Perhaps we can resolve this quickly?"
entries.zh: $HeOrShe把注意力从通讯器移到数据平板上。"也许我们能早点解决这个问题？"

o.en: I'm looking for a man called Jethro Bornanew.
o.zh: 我在找一个叫 Jethro Bornanew 的人。

o.en: I'm looking for whoever is in charge of the Luddic Path around here.
o.zh: 我在寻找这里 卢德左径 活动的领导者。

o.en: I'm working for Horus Yaribay. Of Gens Yaribay. You know them?
o.zh: 我为 Horus Yaribay 工作。Yaribay 氏族的。你知道他们么？

entries.en:
"Oh, blessed void," $heOrShe looks upset.

"The Church should not... it is not my place to say what the Church should or should not do, particularly if a Reverend Archcurate ordered it, but... you haven't told anyone in the MUA about Church involvement, right?"

$HisOrHer eyes shift away from the feed, seeing some unfortunate vision, "I can only imagine what Administrator Kato would say if he found out."
entries.zh:
"哦，天哪，" $heOrShe看起来很沮丧。

"教会不应该... 我无权说教会应该做什么或不应该做什么，特别是如果宗师大人下令这样做，但是... 你没有告诉 MUA 有教会的人参与其中，对吧？"

$HisOrHer眼神从通讯器上移开，看到了一些不幸的景象。"我能想象到 Kato 管理员发觉此事时会说些什么。"

o.en: I share your desire to both respect the Faith... and handle this matter quietly. With your help.
o.zh: 我和你一样希望尊重信仰... 并在你的帮助下悄悄地处理这件事。

o.en: Jethro Bornanew must be found. If not by me, another will come.
o.zh: Jethro Bornanew 必须被找到。如果我找不到，那别人也会来接着找。

o.en: I understand. I won't tell the administrator. (lie)
o.zh: 明白，我不会告诉管理员的。 (说谎)

o.en: I understand. I won't tell the administrator.
o.zh: 明白，我不会告诉管理员的。

entries.en:
You see $personName wince at the mention of 'Luddies'. $HeOrShe takes a moment. Composing diplomatic words, perhaps.

"It cannot be denied. I pray that he would not be so casual with his scorn. It is... unseemly. If the Mazalot Unification Authority is to be seen as serious about its purpose..."

"Um," $heOrShe is momentarily self-conscious, "But this is no time to talk politics. So. Are you having any trouble with commercial logistics on Mazalot?"
entries.zh:
你发现 $personName 在听到 '卢德佬' 一词时皱起了眉头。$HeOrShe停顿了一会，也许是在构思外交辞令。

"这是不可否认的，我祈祷他不要如此随意地表达自己的蔑视。这是...不体面的。如果 Mazalot 统一政权被视为对其目的很认真的话..."

"嗯，" $heOrShe有些不安，"但现在不是谈论政治的时候。所以，你在 Mazalot 的商业物流方面有什么问题吗？"

o.en: This is very important. His name is Jethro Bornanew.
o.zh: 这很重要，他的名字是 Jethro Bornanew。

entries.en:
"I am sorry," $heOrShe says, something shifting in $hisOrHer demeanor, "But I cannot help you."

$HeOrShe looks like $heOrShe might say more, but instead says "I pray your visit to Mazalot is peaceful, captain," before cutting the comm-link.
entries.zh:
"对不起。" $heOrShe说道，态度有些许改变，"但我帮不了你。"

$HeOrShe看起来还想再说点什么，但最终只是在切断通讯链接之前道："我祈祷你在 Mazalot 一切平安，舰长。"

o.en: I share your desire to both respect the Faith... and handle this matter quietly. With your help.
o.zh: 我和你一样希望尊重信仰... 并在你的帮助下悄悄地处理这件事。

o.en: I have credentials from Gens Yaribay. Horus Yaribay personally asked me to investigate this matter. (lie)
o.zh: 我有 Yaribay 氏族的证件。Horus Yaribay 亲自要求我调查此事。 (说谎)

o.en: I am pursuing this matter for an archcurate of the Church.
o.zh: 我正在为教会的大祭司调查此事。

o.en: I understand. Let us speak of other things.
o.zh: 我明白了，来说点别的吧。

entries.en: "Yes," $heOrShe looks relieved. "My office is happy to assist in facilitating commerce within the sphere of the Mazalot Unification Authority and associated League-regulated space lanes."
entries.zh: "是的。" $heOrShe看起来松了一口气，"我的办公室很乐意协助促进 Mazalot 统一政权和联盟监管的贸易路线范围内的商业繁荣。"

entries.en:
"Gens Yaribay?" $HeOrShe sits up straight, "I, er, yes of course."

After a pause, as if $heOrShe was expecting more from you, $heOrShe adds quietly, "It was my understanding that Gens Kato was ah, most involved with the situation here on Mazalot?"
entries.zh:
"Yaribay 氏族？" $HeOrShe坐直了身子，"我，呃，是的当然。"

过了一会，$heOrShe似乎对你有更高的期待。$heOrShe平静地补充道，"据我所知，Kato 氏族才是，呃，最关心 Mazalot 情况的？"

o.en: Kato, Yaribay, what difference does it make?
Yaribay wants to find Jethro Bornanew. He may be involved with Pathers.
o.zh: Yaribay 想找到 Jethro Bornanew。他可能与左径分子的活动有关。

entries.en:
"Well, er," $heOrShe seems to be gauging whether your question was figurative or literal, then goes with the safe answer.

"It depends a lot on who you ask, er, $playerSirOrMadam. If I was asking the administrator here, Dardan Kato, I would... not emphasize my connection with gens Yaribay."
entries.zh:
"嗯，呃，" $heOrShe似乎在判断你是在隐喻什么还是仅仅字面意义上的询问，随后决定给出一个谨慎的回答。

"这在很大程度上取决于你在问谁，呃，$playerSirOrMadam。如果我问这里的管理员，Dardan Kato，我就不会... 强调自己与 Yaribay 氏族的联系。"

o.en: I'm looking for Jethro Bornanew. He may be involved with the Path.
o.zh: 我在找 Jethro Bornanew。他可能参与了左径分子的活动。

o.en: Is there some kind of problem?

entries.en: "I understand completely, $playerSirOrMadam," $heOrShe gets that blank-faced look of someone who intends to obey your inquiries to the letter - and no further. "You'll be the first to know if I hear anything about a Jeffery Bornanew."
entries.zh: "我明白了，$playerSirOrMadam。" $heOrShe面无表情，好像除了回应你的提问与要求以外没有任何其他的想法，"如果我听到关于 Jeffery Bornanew 的任何消息，你将是第一个知道的人。"

o.en: Is there some kind of problem?

entries.en:
"Jethro. Of course," $heOrShe says smoothly. "I'll write it down so I remember."

You hear tapping at a datapad.

"Will you be needing anything else from the port authority today, captain?"
entries.zh:
"Jethro。当然，" $heOrShe平静地说。"我会把它记下来。"

你听到敲击数据平板的声音。

"你今天还需要港务局的其他服务吗，舰长？"

entries.en:
"I'm not sure I understand," $heOrShe says smoothly. "My office will do everything it can to facilitate your commercial activities within the Mazalot Unification Authority's sphere of interest, as well as the nearby League trade-lanes."

You hear tapping at a datapad.

"Will you be needing anything else from the port authority today, captain?"
entries.zh:
"我不确定。" $heOrShe平静地说，"我的办公室将尽一切努力为你们在 Mazalot 统一政权的利益范围内，以及附近的联盟贸易通道内的商业活动提供便利。"

你听到敲击数据平板的声音。

"你今天还需要港务局的其他服务吗，舰长？"

o.en: Your administrator, Dardan Kato, seems to have a low opinion of 'Luddies'.
o.zh: 你们的管理员，Dardan Kato，好像对 '卢德佬' 们的评价很低。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe gives you a hard look.

"The Luddic Path, you say. 'May be involved'? Look, I can see where you're going and I don't believe it is a good idea."

$personLastName sighs. "The security forces are occupied with hunting the most extreme militants already and, say what you will, but they have a... sense of professionalism about it. They know to respect most of us Faithful. Usually."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe狠狠地看了你一眼。

"卢德左径，你说 '疑似参与' ？看吧，我就知道你接下来要说什么，并且我不觉得那是个好主意。"

$personLastName 叹了口气。"安保部队已经在忙于追捕最极端的武装分子，你想说什么就说什么，但他们对此有一种... 专业感。他们知道要尊重我们之中大多数有信仰的人。通常如此。"

entries.en: "Ah," $heOrShe reads something off a datapad. "Captain $playerName? May your time on Mazalot be one of blessed peace."
entries.zh: "啊。" $heOrShe在数据平板上读到了什么。" $playerName 舰长？愿你在 Mazalot 得享神圣的和平。"

o.en: I'm looking for a man who may be involved in the Luddic Path.
o.zh: 我在找一个疑似参与 卢德左径 活动的人。

entries.en: "Is there anything else I can help you with?"
entries.zh: "还有什么我能帮到你的吗？"

o.en: I'm looking for a man who may be involved in the Luddic Path.
o.zh: 我在找一个疑似参与 卢德左径 活动的人。

entries.en:
"Jethro?" $HeOrShe thinks for a moment. "Don't know 'em, sorry. I'm more in logistics and requisition, so if you have a question about that..."

$HeOrShe looks hopeful that you'll stop asking questions.
entries.zh:
"Jethro？" $HeOrShe想了一会儿，"不认识，抱歉。我这里是物流和申请业务，如果你对这方面有疑问..."

$HeOrShe一幅希望你别问了的样子。

entries.en:
"The Luddic... Ah." $HeOrShe glances around self-consciously.

"Look, I don't mess with those types. The Unification Authority put 'em on the terrorist list. You know what the punishment is for 'aiding and abetting'? Ain't worth it."
entries.zh:
"卢德...啊。" $HeOrShe不自在地环顾了四周。

"听着，我与那些人没有交集。统一政权把他们列入了恐怖分子名单。你明白 '协助和教唆' 的惩罚是什么吗？这对我来说不值得。"

o.en: Sounds serious. I'll keep my nose clean.
o.zh: 听起来挺严重，我不会惹麻烦的。

o.en: 'Worth it'? So you know what the Path will pay for collaboration?
o.zh: '值得'？所以你知道 卢德左径 会给协作者什么报酬？

entries.en:
"You so do, so do," $heOrShe says.

"Look, word of advice. If a mudboot comes all sneaky to you, and they make an offer - big number credits - just say, no way, not interested. Probably an Authority agent or could be FleetSec. Testing loyalty, is what that is. I mean sure, there's Pathers sneaking through all the time, but how do you know?"

$HeOrShe shrugs, "If the MUA questioned every Luddic who spoke against the polity, they'd have to arrest half the planet. It'd be another uprising! No one wants that."
entries.zh:
"你也该这样有样学样。" $heOrShe说。

"听着，给你点建议。如果有泥腿子鬼鬼祟祟的来找你，和你说有个活 —— 能赚大笔星币 —— 你就说，没门，没兴趣。很有可能这人是当局特工，或者舰队安全官。忠诚测试，就这样。我讲真的，当然有 卢德左径 在周边潜藏活动，但你怎么分辨呢？"

$HeOrShe耸耸肩，"如果 MUA 质询每个反政府的卢德信徒，他们就得拘留半个星球的人。这会是另一次暴动！没人希望这样。"

entries.en:
"Oh, come on." $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head in consternation.

"I'm just talking. It's just words. Ask anyone. Some mudboot will come all sneaking-like and say they're making an offer. Big-number credits. I tell them no way, not interested, I don't need that trouble. Even odds it's an Authority agent. Or FleetSec, could be. Testing loyalty, is what it is."

"And if the MUA questioned every Luddic who spoke up against the polity, they'd have to arrest half the planet. It'd be another uprising! No one wants that."
entries.zh:
"哦，得了。" $HeOrShe惊愕的摇摇头。

"我只是聊天。说说而已。随便问问谁。有些泥腿子鬼鬼祟祟的说有个赚钱的机会。一大笔星币。我告诉他们没门，没兴趣，我不需要这样的麻烦。很有可能这人是当局特工，或者舰队安全官。忠诚测试，就这样。"

"如果 MUA 质询每个反政府的卢德信徒，他们就得拘留半个星球的人。这会是另一次暴动！没人希望这样。"

o.en: I'm looking for a man called Jethro Bornanew.
o.zh: 我在找一个叫 Jethro Bornanew 的人。

o.en: I'm looking for whoever is in charge of the Luddic Path around here.
o.zh: 我在寻找这里 卢德左径 活动的领导者。

o.en: I have credentials from Gens Yaribay. Horus Yaribay personally asked me to investigate this matter. (lie)
o.zh: 我有 Yaribay 氏族的证件。Horus Yaribay 亲自要求我调查此事。 (说谎)

entries.en:
Your comms officer pings you unexpectedly.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I received an unusual communication which- I thought it should be brought to your attention."
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官突然向你发出通知。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，我收到了一份特别的通讯，我认为您应当关注它。"

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Someone who claims to work for a man named 'Virens' commed to invite you to a meeting. I did not... at first think to bring it to your attention until the details could be verified."

"Well, ah," they twitch nervously. "We verified the details."
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam。有个自称是 'Virens' 手底下的人发来了通讯，邀请您参加一个会议。我没有...立即向您汇报此事，我本想等到我们能够确认那些细节之后再讲。"

"呃，对，" 对方紧张地说。"我们核实了相关细节。"

entries.en:
And indeed, as your comms officer explains, it turns out that one Nile Virens figures prominently in Mazalot as the leader (alleged) of the local branch of the Luddic Path, though none of the mainstream media or data outlets state this apparently unspoken-by-agreement fact. Virens legally runs a number of charities; Pather fronts (allegedly), and owns properties in most of the significant Luddic-majority settlements on Mazalot.

It's not difficult to read between the lines. Just dangerous.

Unless you are someone who employs top-credit bodyguards and operates a private battlefleet.
entries.zh:
确实，正如你的通讯军官所说，Nile Virens 在 Mazalot 上扮演的一个重要角色其实是 卢德左径 当地分支的领导者 (据传)，尽管没有任何主流媒体或小道消息点明过这一不言而喻的事实。Virens 合法经营着数个慈善机构，其实都是掩护左径组织的前台 (据传)，且在 Mazalot 大多数重要的卢德聚集地中持有地产。

这很危险。听懂这个弦外之意应该不难。

除非能有个雇佣了顶级保镖，并坐拥一支私人作战舰队的家伙。

entries.en:
It's almost shocking that Virens hasn't been arrested already, but his status is a political minefield for the Mazalot Unification Authority. To crack down might instigate another uprising. To not crack down allows Pather influence to simmer just under the boiling point.

And now, Nile Virens has invited you for tea.

Your officers, of course, have rapidly assembled a tactical report on Virens' holdings for your review.
entries.zh:
Virens 至今未被捕，这令人感到难以置信。毕竟他的地位对 Mazalot 统一政权而言，犹如一颗政治地雷。对他采取强硬措施可能激起新的暴动，而不采取行动则会使左径分子的影响力在沸点之下持续酝酿。

而现在，Nile Virens 正邀请你共享下午茶。

自然，你的幕僚们已迅速编制了一份关于 Virens 势力范围的战术报告供你审查。

entries.en:
$PersonName looks at you for a long time before $heOrShe relents. "You would have my thanks for not mentioning who gave you this information."

"It is common knowledge that Luddic Path activity on Mazalot goes through a man named Nile Virens. The MUA has never got enough evidence to convict him of anything. And if they did, there would be another uprising, anyway. Virens... takes care of people. Charity, of a sort."

"Virens owns a series of compounds located in a few of the larger Luddic-majority settlements, and several in the former-frontiers. He does have a public comms ID, though I can't say whether he'll speak with you."
entries.zh:
$PersonName 注视着你，过了许久，$heOrShe的态度缓和了下来。"你没提起这份消息的来源，感激不尽。"

"众所周知，Mazalot 上的左径活动是通过一个名叫 Nile Virens 的人展开的。MUA 尚未掌握足以为其定罪的证据。不论如何，他们要是真有证据，那肯定又会发生一次暴动。毕竟 Virens 这个人...关心民众，宽厚仁爱 —— 勉强算是。"

"Virens 在一些较大的卢德聚居地有一连串的场院，另外还有几个位于前边境地带。他确实有公开的通讯 ID，但我说不准他会不会跟你谈。"

entries.en:
"Thank Providence," $heOrShe lets out a breath. "And thank you. The last thing Mazalot needs - the Faithful and the rest, both - is another crackdown. Or an uprising."

"Little difference," $heOrShe muses idly, "One always leads to the other."

"But um, where were we? My office is happy to assist in facilitating commerce within the sphere of the MUA and associated League-regulated space lanes."
entries.zh:
"感谢上天。" $heOrShe松了一口气，"也谢谢你。无论是对信徒还是其他人而言，Mazalot 最不需要的事就是另一次镇压，或者暴动。"

"没啥区别，" $heOrShe随口说，"一个总是跟着另一个。"

"但是嗯，我们说到哪儿了？我的部门很乐意协助 MUA 和相关联盟监管航线内的商贸活动。"

entries.en:
You touch the datapad and its screen flashes to a badge of the Mazalot Unification Authority Municipal Security. The agent gives you a little smile.

"Captain $playerName, by the power of the Mazalot Unification Authority, you are charged with criminal conspiracy under the Interstellar Terrorism Statute of-"

He drones on in legalese, relishing the act.

You consider your options: you suspect reprisals for dodging out of this entrapment scheme will be token at best - it feels like a credit-rustling op to scam naive spacers more than any kind of serious investigation.
entries.zh:
你接过数据平板，屏幕上随即闪现出 Mazalot 统一政权安全部门 (MUA) 的徽章。伪装的特工向你微微一笑。

"$playerName 舰长，根据 Mazalot 统一政权授予的权力，你被指控违反星际恐怖主义法 ——"

他得意地拖着长腔，一边念着法律术语，似乎很享受这个过程。

你在考虑自己的选择：你怀疑，就算摆脱了这场钓鱼执法，当局的报复行动充其量也只会是象征性的 —— 这感觉更像是一场欺骗天真宇宙民的星币诈骗，而不是什么严肃的调查。

o.en: I'm not sure this aligns with Administrator Kato's policies. Perhaps we should comms him and ask?
o.zh: 我不确定这是否符合 Kato 管理员的政策。也许我们应该联系他？

o.en: (raise your voice) "I would think that the MUA would cooperate with a Church investigation into Pather activity."
o.zh: (提高声音) "我认为 MUA 会配合教会对左径分子活动的调查。"

o.en: Punch the MUA agent in the face and make a break for it
o.zh: 给 MUA 特工的脸来上一拳，然后迅速逃跑

entries.en:
Before long, you've got the dossier on one Nile Virens, local Pather strongman, transferred to your datapad. Contact info, addresses, and a patchy bio. Operates compounds in all the major Luddic population centers. Effectively runs the Path on Mazalot.

"You need to watch out for that one," the agent stows his datapad and stands. "Slippery customer, he is. Can't nail him on one thing or another, always some young Luddie will come to confess in his place." The agent looks at you with comradely bonhomie, "Glad they finally called in the big guns. You gonna..." he makes a finger pistol motion, and winks.

"Not that you could tell me, I suppose."
entries.zh:
不久之后，对方就将当地左径头目 Nile Virens 的档案转移到了你的数据平板上。联系方式、地址和不完整的生物信息。在所有的主要卢德教徒聚居地都有驻地。在 Mazalot 上有效地指挥左径活动。

"你需要提防那个人，" 特工收起数据平板并站了起来。"他确实是个狡猾的人。在哪一点上都没法定他的罪，总有些年轻的卢德佬会替他顶罪。" 特工用一种同志般和蔼的眼神看着你，"很高兴他们终于呼叫了大炮。你要..." 他比了一个枪的手势，眨了眨眼睛。

"我猜你也不会告诉我。"

o.en: Your assistance will be noted in the after action report.
o.zh: 你的帮助会记录在行动后的报告内。

entries.en: The agent freezes, hunched over the datapad with the spurious 'fine' transaction request blinking. His eyes stare unblinking at you, expression grim. Deciding if you're serious.
entries.zh: 特工僵住了，弯腰盯着数据平板，上面闪烁着伪造的 '罚款' 交易请求。他的眼睛一眨不眨地看着你，表情严峻，判断你是否是认真的。

entries.en:
Heads turn. The party at a neighboring table does a double-take and decides now is a good time to pay the tab.

The agent fixes you with his eyes, and smirks coldly. "I see what you're trying. The Church doesn't run this polity, the League does."

He stares unblinking at you. Assessing.
entries.zh:
你瞬间化为目光焦点。邻桌聚会的人又仔细打量了一下，决定趁现在这个好时机赶紧付账走人。

特工的目光锁定了你，脸上挂着冰冷的假笑。"我知道你在试探些什么。教会不是这个国家的主事者，联盟才是。"

他目不转睛地凝视着你，揣摩不定。

o.en: Agent, I am acting on behalf of an archcurate of the Church of Galactic Redemption.
o.zh: 特工，我是 银河救赎教会 一名大祭司的代表。

o.en: Agent, you should know that I am a commissioned privateer of the Persean League Fleet.
o.zh: 特工，你应该知道我是 英仙座联盟 舰队的一名授权私掠者。

o.en: Punch the MUA agent in the face and make a break for it
o.zh: 给 MUA 特工的脸来上一拳，然后迅速逃跑

o.en: My name is Finlay Siyavong of Fleet Intelligence and I have questions for you.
o.zh: 我是舰队情报部的 Finlay Siyavong，我有问题要问你。

o.en: Before we continue, allow me to show you my diplomatic credentials from Gens Yaribay.
o.zh: 在我们继续之前，请允许我向你展示我从 Yaribay 氏族那里得到的外交证书。

entries.en:
"Yeah? Well good for Ludd." The agent holds up his datapad, which blinks a flash at you for a quick holo to register your 'crime'.

"Maybe you can pay your fine with all those tithes you Luddies collect from little old grannies. And it is," another couple taps, "5,000 credits."
entries.zh:
"哦？那卢德可真好。" 特工举起数据平板，随着一阵闪烁，他迅速地给你拍了一张全息影像，好用来登记你的 '罪行'。

"或许你可以掏出你们这些卢德佬从可怜的老奶奶们那里收来的什一税，来支付你的罚金。而这个数额是，" 他又在平板上敲了几下，"5,000 星币。"

entries.en:
The official datapad disappears and a different, somewhat more battered one appears in its place. A credits transfer request awaits your confirmation.

"You may pay your, ah, fine right here. I understand that you've expressed remorse for the breach of law, so I'll make sure this incident doesn't appear on your record."

He winks.
entries.zh:
官方的数据平板消失了，取而代之的是另一个更破旧的数据平板。一笔星币转账等待着你的确认。

"你可以在这缴纳你的，啊，罚款。我知道你已经对违法行为表示悔恨，所以我会确保这件事不会出现在官方记录中。"

他眨了眨眼。

o.en: Punch the MUA agent in the face and make a break for it
o.zh: 在 MUA 特工的脸上来一拳，然后逃跑

entries.en:
As the transfer chimes complete, the officer makes a perfectly insincere smile.

"Stay safe, citizen," he says.
entries.zh:
转账提示响了之后，特工露出了一个一点不真诚的微笑。

"注意安全，公民。" 他说。

o.en: Hold on. I paid for information - I expect to get it.
o.zh: 等下。我为这情报付了钱的 —— 我可期望得到它。

entries.en:
Confusion, then a sneer grows on his face.

"Don't get smart with me, spacer - you don't want to catch me in a bad mood."
entries.zh:
他脸上浮现出一阵困惑，随后转为冷笑。

"别跟我耍小聪明，太空佬 —— 你不会想让我心情不好的。"

o.en: Shall we call up Dardan Kato and explain the bribe I just paid?
o.zh: 我们要和 Dardan Kato 联络并解释下我刚刚的贿赂吗？

o.en: Shall we call up the administrator and explain the bribe I just paid?
o.zh: 我们要和管理员联络并解释我刚刚的贿赂吗？

entries.en:
His sneer fades. You wouldn't be so stupid, his look says, would you? You give a little nod; yes, you would. You've done far stupider and walked away intact.

Before long, you've got the dossier on one Nile Virens, local Pather strongman, transferred to your datapad. Contact info, addresses, and a patchy bio. Operates compounds in all the major Luddic population centers. Runs the Path, such as it is, on Mazalot.

"You deserve each other," the officer grumbles as he makes his exit.
entries.zh:
他的冷笑消失了。你有那么蠢吗？不会吧？他仿佛在用表情这么问。你轻轻点头。没错，你就那么蠢。你还做过蠢得更离谱的事，而且能全身而退。

不久之后，你让一份关于本地左径铁腕人物 Nile Virens 的档案转到了你的数据平板上。包括相关人士信息、地址和一份零散不堪的简介。在所有主要的卢德聚居区都运营有定居点。那基本上就是在暗地里领导整个 Mazalot 的左径了。

"你们俩都是自找的。" 特工在离开时抱怨道。

entries.en:
The agent freezes mid-speech, looks at you - yes, you mean it - then quickly taps at a datapad, looking between it and you.

"Captain." The datapad is tucked away, the agent standing up straight, the smile wiped off his face. "I'm afraid there's been a misunderstanding. The MUA, naturally, fully supports the League Fleet," his eyes meet yours, and he makes a comradely nod, "-and the commissioned privateers who bolster our forces."

"On behalf of Mazalot MuniSec, allow me to render any required assistance with, ah, Fleet operations..."
entries.zh:
这个特工话说到一半戛然而止，看向了你 —— 是的，你没在开玩笑 —— 然后在数据平板上飞快地敲了几下，目光在你和平板之间来回对照。

"这位舰长，" 数据平板被收到了一边，这个特工站的笔直，脸上抹去了笑容，"之前恐怕有一些误解。MUA 组织，理所当然地，全力以赴地，支持着联盟舰队，" 他与你目光交接，亲切地点头，"—— 以及让我们的部队如虎添翼的签约私掠者们。"

"请允许我代表 Mazalot 地方安全部，为，呃，舰队行动，提供一切必要的协助..."

o.en: Who runs the Path around here? I need information.
o.zh: 谁在指挥附近的左径分子？我需要他的信息。

entries.en:
A solid blow sends the security officer toppling back into a table which obediently flips, spilling glassware and tipsy spacers across the bar.

The MuniSec undercovers that were watching you the whole time from the bar leap to their feet, drawing stun prods.

You manage to avoid them thanks to the shouting, chaos, and your bodyguards' admirable job of running interference without appearing to be associated with you.
entries.zh:
重重的一击使安保人员摔倒在桌子上，桌子乖乖地翻了过来，让玻璃器皿和醉鬼洒落在酒吧里。

一直监视着你的地方安全部便衣站了起来，抽出电击器。

你成功地避开了他们，这要归功于喊叫、混乱，以及你的保镖在没有暴露和你关系的前提下进行的令人钦佩的干扰。

entries.en:
As you slip out of the bar, leaving the sound of breaking glass and shouting behind, you reflect that the MuniSec goons were definitely running holo-rec, so it's not a clean getaway.

But it's also probably not worth the real authorities making too much a fuss about, either. You wouldn't be the first spacer to run from a brawl, not on Mazalot, not anywhere, and allowances must be made for the commerce your type brings to these worlds.

Someone will remember, however.
entries.zh:
你溜出酒吧，玻璃破碎和呐喊起哄的声音抛在身后。这时你忽然回想到那些地方安全部的蠢货们肯定都开着全息记录仪，因此这并不是一次完美的逃亡。

但这或许也不是什么值得当局大惊小怪的事。毕竟你又不是第一个干架之后跑路的太空佬，这种事无论在 Mazalot 还是在其他的什么地方都不可能没发生过。而考虑到你们这种人能带来的商业价值，一些忍让肯定还是会被做出的。

不过嘛，某个人肯定会记得的。

entries.en:
This cop is local munisec, and a corrupt bottom-feeder at that. You know that such a bully is easily bullied if they believe you're higher-ranking. And the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service is an elite among the League, filled with Gens-heirs.

"Officer." You affect the aristocratic accent of Kazeron and its self-assured authority, "Think very carefully before you respond."
entries.zh:
这条子隶属地方安全部，一个腐败的底层混混。你知道如果这样的恶霸相信你的地位更高，他们很容易屈服。而英仙座联盟舰队情报部是联盟中的精英，里面都是氏族子弟。

"警官。" 你带着 Kazeron 的贵族口音，还有自信和优越感，"回答前好好想想。"

entries.en:
"I didn't want to come to this Luddie-infested backwater of a failed terraforming experiment to hunt Pathers, but Intel smelled rot. Do you know what that means? - Don't answer. We have heard reports - disturbing reports - about the accounts of the Mazalot Unification Authority Municipal Security branch."

The officer is on his back heel, sweating. Nearby tables are carefully pretending not to listen to your tirade.

"'Riddled with Pather credits' is what I've heard. And as you well know per the League's Interstellar Terrorism Statute - which you so helpfully quoted for me - that means that central oversight is empowered to intervene in local affairs."
entries.zh:
"我本来也不想到这个地貌改造失败的穷乡僻壤，在到处滋生的卢德佬里面追猎左径分子，但情报中透露出一股不妙的气息。你知道那意味着什么吗？—— 不用回答。我收到一些令人不安的报告，与 Mazalot 统一政权安全部门 (MUA) 的账目有关。"

这个军官立正站直，汗水涔涔而下。附近几桌人小心翼翼地装作没听到你的长篇大论。

"关于左径分子资金来源的流言，已经充斥了我的耳朵。而正如你所熟知的那样，根据联盟的星际恐怖主义法 —— 就是你之前帮我引用的那个 —— 这意味着中央监督机构将有权干预地方事务。"

entries.en:
"Do you know what that means? Do not respond, officer, I am not finished."
