You continue the dress-down, describing the various powers that the central League executive can hammer down upon members found to be involved in abetting terrorism - Mairaath's millions dead were fresh in the minds of the composers of the League's constitution, and the powers enumerated to stop a repeat of the event are far-reaching indeed.

It is, you reflect, a good thing you paid attention to League history.
entries.zh:
"你知道这意味着什么吗？别急着回答，长官，我还没说完。"

你继续斥责着，描述了联盟中央行政部门可以对被发现参与教唆恐怖主义的成员施加的各种处罚 —— Mairaath 的数百万死者在联盟的规则制定者们心中记忆犹新，而为阻止事件重演而被赋予的权力确实意义深远。

你庆幸到，还好你之前研究过联盟的历史。

entries.en:
Before long, you have the munisec officer silent and near-tears across from you in a booth while you browse local security reports on their datapad using their own login.

You find exactly what you need - Nile Virens, local Pather strongman. Operates compounds in all the major Luddic population centers.

After transferring the information to your own TriPad you toss the officer's datapad across the table. He is too slow to catch it, and it clatters to the ground.
entries.zh:
没过多久，你们坐进了一个小隔间。你对面的地方安全部的官员正在努力憋住眼泪，而你，拿着这位官员的平板，用着这位官员的账号，浏览着本地安全报告。

你准确无误地找到了你要的东西 —— Nile Virens，本地左径分子中的铁腕人物。在所有重要的卢德人口中心，都有他经营的院落。

把信息传输到自己的 TriPad 之后，你隔着桌子把这个官员的数据平板丢了过去。他慢了一拍，没能接住，平板摔到地上咔哒作响。

entries.en:
The agent freezes mid-speech, and looks at you. You've already got your TriPad out, credentials displayed. He quickly taps at a datapad, looking between it and yours. Hoping, perhaps, that these aren't what you claim they are.

"Captain." The datapad is tucked away, the agent standing up straight, the insincere smile off his face. "I'm afraid there's been a misunderstanding. Gens Yaribay is a respected operator which the MUA, naturally, welcomes within the local commercial volume. If MuniSec can be of any assistance in your, ah, business..."
entries.zh:
特工在讲话的过程中突然停住，直勾勾地看着你。你已经拿出了 TriPad 并展示出身份验证信息。他迅速地敲了几下数据平板，拿它和你的 TriPad 反复对比。也许他希望那些信息并不如你所说的那样一致。

"舰长。" 特工挺了挺身子，把数据平板塞回去，撤掉了脸上那虚伪的笑容。"恐怕我们之间有些误会。Yaribay 氏族备受尊敬，MUA 自然也欢迎他们在当地进行商业活动。如果地方安全部能够，呃，在商业方面提供帮助..."

o.en: Who runs the Path around here? I need information.
o.zh: 谁在指挥附近的左径分子？我需要他的信息。

entries.en:
You pay the fine.

"Stay safe, citizen." The MUA agent produces a perfunctory forge-duplicated smile, "This place is crawling with terrorist sympathizers."

He leaves.
entries.zh:
你交了罚款。

"注意安全，公民。" MUA 特工露出敷衍、虚伪的微笑，"这个地方挤满了恐怖分子的同情者。"

他离开了。

entries.en:
His eyes stare with the dumb authority of a machine set to an aggression routine. There is no human connection, no empathy. You can only imagine this as the look given by a gamma AI stripped of its theory of mind in some dim Tri-Tachyon blacksite.

"The fine," he says, "Is 5,000 credits."
entries.zh:
他的眼神死板而权威，就像一台设定了攻击程序的机器。没有人与人之间的联系，没有同理心。在你的想像中，只有一个身处速子科技秘密空间站，被剥夺了情感模块的 Gamma 级 AI 才能有此等表情。

"罚款，" 他说，"5,000 星币。"

o.en: Punch the MUA agent in the face and make a break for it
o.zh: 在 MUA 特工的脸上来一拳，然后逃跑

entries.en: You stared down the Excubitor Orbis of Hesperus. A munisec officer from Mazalot? He's nothing. A bilge-roach before the Dragon of Orion.
entries.zh: 你傲视着 Hesperus 的行星教卫。区区 Mazalot 来的地方安全部官员？不值一提。在伟大的猎户座之龙面前，他不过是一只舱底的蟑螂罢了。

entries.en: Your gaze sears like plasma, it tears the munisec bully apart like a graviton beam cannon flashing across the blood-and-ash flecked volume of space battle; you've seen things he wouldn't believe. Unimaginable vastnesses, vacuum most terrible and cruel.
entries.zh: 你的目光像等离子体一样灼热，它撕裂了这个地方安全部的恶霸，就像引力子束在遍布血与灰的太空战场中闪耀；你看到了他不会相信的事情。难以想象的浩瀚，最可怕和残酷的真空。

entries.en:
He drops his eyes to his silly parking-warden's datapad. Bashfully, he tucks it into a pocket while mumbling something about a misunderstanding, and shuffles away.

You stand alone.
entries.zh:
他的目光落在了他愚蠢的泊位管理员数据平板上。他害羞地把平板塞进口袋，嘴里嘟囔着误会，拖着脚步走开了。

你独自站着。

entries.en: You cut the comm link.
entries.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

entries.en: You cut the comm link after exchanging a few pleasantries.
entries.zh: 你在寒暄了几句后切断了通讯链接。

entries.en:
Suddenly, you have his full attention. "Yes, obviously."

His entire tone has changed into a cloud of blackest suspicion tinged with playful competition.

A pause as he considers you, then says, "Gens Yaribay isn't stupid enough to just... ask... for my cooperation. I am not sure yet about you."
entries.zh:
突然，他的注意力集中在你身上，"对，显然。"

他的语气包含了最阴暗的怀疑，夹杂着戏谑的竞争色彩。

他顿了一下，看了看你，然后说，"Yaribay 氏族还没有愚蠢到只是...请求...我的合作。我还不确定你的情况。"

o.en: You help me, then Yaribay owes you one. Deal?
o.zh: 你来帮我一把，之后 Yaribay 欠你一个人情。成交吗？

o.en: For the good of the League, I am asking for your help.
o.zh: 为了联盟的利益，我需要你的帮助。

o.en: I'm sure Gens Yaribay will make some kind of concession.
o.zh: 我相信 Yaribay 氏族一定会为此做出某种让步。

entries.en:
Dardan Kato bursts out laughing. It's a desperate, on-edge sort of break; too many stimulants, you suspect.

He takes a minute to settle down.

"Oh, thank you," he wipes away a tear, "I needed that. What a shift it's been- and then, ah, such patriotism! - Yaribay you said?" He shakes his head, "What a gift. I shall thank them for this excellent jape."
entries.zh:
Dardan Kato 突然大笑起来。这是一种绝望的、失控边缘的冲动。你怀疑，是兴奋剂过量。

他花了一分钟才平静下来。

"哦，谢谢你，" 他擦去眼泪，"我需要这个。多么美好的一天 —— 啊，还有，爱国主义！—— 你说 Yaribay？" 他摇摇头，"真是好礼物。我要感谢他们给我带来了如此精彩的笑话。"

entries.en: "Somehow," Dardan Kato says, "I am not prepared to have some Yaribay slug ooze around my volume on a vague suggestion of concessions. I have enough problems without the meddling of some debutante."
entries.zh: "怎样都好，" Dardan Kato 说，"我不准备让那些只会提出含糊让步提议的 Yaribay 鼻涕虫在这边爬来爬去。我的麻烦够多了，不需要天真大小姐们在这指手画脚。"

entries.en:
His demeanor freezes into an icy mask, and a hand reaches for his comms-cutoff.

"Don't talk to me."

The link terminates.
entries.zh:
他脸上的表情犹如冰面具一样冻住了，一只手伸向通讯开关。

"别和我说话。"

链接被切断了。

entries.en: "Ha!" Dardan Kato's laugh is mirthless. "By Gens Kato accounts, Yaribay owes us a lot more than 'one', and I'm not going to provide one of their minions with an opening based solely on... on what? The good name of gens Yaribay?"
entries.zh: "哈！" Dardan Kato 的笑声毫无笑意。"在 Kato 氏族的账上，Yaribay 欠我们的不止 '一个'，我也不会仅仅为了...为了什么？Yaribay 氏族的好名声而放过他们的任何一个爪牙。"

entries.en:
"Gens Yaribay?" $HeOrShe immediately sits up straighter. "Yes, $playerSirOrMadam, how can I help?"

$HeOrShe glances around, then leans a little closer to the comms, "If the administrator finds out you're working for Yaribay, well. He'll make your life difficult. Just so you know. I got nothing against them personally. Even think they're the way to go, right? Peace with the Hegemony? I'll take that over war any shift of the week."
entries.zh:
"Yaribay 氏族？" $HeOrShe立即坐得更直了些，"是的，$playerSirOrMadam，我能帮你做些什么？"

$HeOrShe瞥了眼周围，然后稍稍靠近通讯器，"如果管理员发现你在为 Yaribay 工作，好吧。他不会让你的日子好过的。你要知道。我个人对他们没什么意见。甚至认为他们...是对的？与 霸主 的和平？这周每一天，我都会觉得这比战争更重要。"

o.en: I need to make contact with the Luddic Path on Mazalot.
o.zh: 我需要与 Mazalot 上的 卢德左径 取得联系。

o.en: You know what, forget I said anything about Yaribay.
o.zh: 不如这样，忘了我说的关于 Yaribay 的任何事。

entries.en: "Okay. Look though- I don't want to start any trouble, and you gotta remember I didn't tell you any of this. I'm only sticking my neck out because... I'm just doing my part. You'll mention that to the Yaribays?"
entries.zh: "好吧。你看 —— 我不想惹上什么麻烦，你得记着我可什么都没说。我冒险仅仅是因为...我在做我该做的事。你会向 Yaribay 的人提这事么？"

o.en: I'm afraid not. I have to protect your identity.
o.zh: 我恐怕不能。我必须保护你的身份。

entries.en: $PersonName smiles obediently.
entries.zh: $PersonName 顺从地笑了。

entries.en: $PersonName looks disappointed, but says "I understand, $playerSirOrMadam."
entries.zh: $PersonName 看起来很失望，但仍然说 "我理解，$playerSirOrMadam。"

entries.en: "Everyone knows the Path comes through here. They say, don't touch that crate? You don't touch that crate. Gotta be careful or they make sure you remember who runs things. And who's that? Nile Virens."
entries.zh: "所有人都知道这儿 卢德左径 说了算。他们说，别碰那箱子？那你就别碰。小心点，要不他们就会让你知道谁才是老大。谁是老大呢？{Nile Virens}。"

entries.en:
"Virens is the Path on Mazalot. It all goes through him. He's got compounds on the surface. Sometimes we make shipments. I'll give you the locations." $HeOrShe taps at a datapad. "The Authority can't nail him down on any of this. Or won't. Too scared."

"But you're not," $heOrShe looks at you, eyes gleaming. "Not too scared I mean, right? Hope you find your man. And if Virens goes down a peg or two? Wouldn't mind a bit."
entries.zh:
"Virens 是 Mazalot 上的 卢德左径 成员。他是老大。在地表他有个基地。有时候会有些物流运输往来，我给你详细地址。" $HeOrShe点了点数据平板，"当局没办法给他定罪。或者是不想定罪。太忌惮他了。"

"但你不一样。" $heOrShe看着你，眼神闪亮，"我的意思是，不怎么忌惮，对么？希望你找到你想找的人。而如果 Virens 跌了个跟头？没人在意。"

entries.en: "Don't mention it, $playerSirOrMadam," $personName says almost bashfully.
entries.zh: "别提了，$playerSirOrMadam。" $personName 羞怯地说。

entries.en: "Er," $heOrShe says, looking confused for a moment before deciding to play along. "Of course, $playerSirOrMadam. I heard nothing."
entries.zh: "呃..." $heOrShe一瞬间看起来有些困惑，但随即决定配合演戏，"当然，$playerSirOrMadam。我什么也没听到。"

o.zh: 测试 Bornanew 那端的通讯状况

entries.en: "I... it is not my place." $HeOrShe rubs $hisOrHer forehead nervously. "I will... report your words to my superior. I can promise nothing."
entries.zh: "我... 我不负责这个。" $HeOrShe紧张的点了点$hisOrHer的脑袋。"我会... 向我的上级转达你的要求。我也不能给出任何保证。"

entries.en:
"I did not speak with Brother Cotton directly. A message was relayed," $heOrShe looks at you with curiosity and concern as $heOrShe speaks.

"My Path is to obey, so I obey."
entries.zh:
"我并没有直接同 Cotton 修士谈过。信息是被转达的。" $heOrShe说道，一边用着好奇而关切的目光看着你。

"我的道途是遵从，所以我便遵从。"

entries.en:
"Well decided, $playerBrotherOrSister. We share Faith, if not our Path, but that is enough. We must do all in our worldly and spiritual power to halt that so-called church's perversion of Ludd's teachings."

$HeOrShe holds $hisOrHer hands together, "Blessed be this day; may your Path lead you to righteous glory."
entries.zh:
"好决定，$playerBrotherOrSister。我们拥有同样的信仰，也许不是同行于圣道，但也够了。我们需竭尽世俗和灵性之力，去阻止那所谓的教会扭曲卢德的教导。"

$HeOrShe紧握$hisOrHer的双手，"愿今日蒙福；愿你的道途引领你得公义的荣耀。"

entries.en:
"Well decided, $playerBrotherOrSister. We share Faith and a Path, and that must be enough. We must do all in our worldly and spiritual power to halt that so-called church's perversion of Ludd's teachings."

$HeOrShe holds $hisOrHer hands together, "Blessed be this day; may your Path lead you to righteous glory."
entries.zh:
"好决定，$playerBrotherOrSister。我们拥有同样的信仰，同行于道途，这就够了。我们需竭尽世俗和灵性之力，去阻止那所谓的教会扭曲卢德的教导。"

$HeOrShe紧握$hisOrHer的双手，"愿今日蒙福；愿你的道途引领你得公义的荣耀。"

entries.en:
"I pray that I could believe you," $HeOrShe holds $hisOrHer hands together for a moment, "But you are not of the Faith, nor of the Path. What value is the word of one who so denies the light of Ludd?"

$HeOrShe lets $hisOrHer hands drop. "Nothing. It is worth nothing. Even the truth, if indeed it is truth, is a lie in your heretic's mouth."
entries.zh:
"我祈愿我可以相信你，" $HeOrShe握住$hisOrHer的双手，"但你既无信仰，又不奉行卢德之道。一个否认卢德之光的人，他的言语又有何价值？"

$HeOrShe让$hisOrHer的手垂下。"没有。毫无价值。即使是真的，假使的确是真的，也是从你这异端之口中说出的谎言。"

entries.en: "I will cut you from the sky, burn your fleet and scatter your ashes to the blessed vacuum." $HeOrShe smiles grimly, "This is where your path ends, for you have asked forbidden questions and searched for forbidden things."
entries.zh: "我会将你从天空斩落，燃尽你的舰队然后将你的骨灰撒入这神圣的虚空。" $HeOrShe狞笑着，"你既然问寻禁忌，那这便是你的终结。"

entries.en: "You tread a dangerous path, $playerBrotherOrSister. I was sent here to cut you from the sky and scatter your ashes to the blessed vacuum. I pray that this shall not be necessary."
entries.zh: "你踏上了一条危险的道路，$playerBrotherOrSister。我被派来将你从天空斩落，将你的骨灰撒入这神圣的虚空。我希望我没有必要这么做。"

entries.en: "But you must," $heOrShe says, almost perplexed. "I shall attack if you do not desist."
entries.zh: "但你必须如此，" $heOrShe几乎是困惑不解地说出这些话，"你再不停下，我就要动武了。"

entries.en: "But you must," $heOrShe says unhappily.
entries.zh: "但你必须那样，" $heOrShe不高兴地说。

entries.en:
The commlink opens with a shudder, error codes flashing from ancient protocols begrudgingly converted to current standards.

The Pather captain stares you down. "$playername," $heOrShe begins.
entries.zh:
伴着抖动和卡顿，通讯链接联通了。古老的通讯协议被强行转换符合现行规范，产生了一堆在不断闪烁的错误代码。

左径舰长盯着你。"$playername，" $heOrShe说道。

o.en: I'm not going to stop my search.
If that is what the Path demands, I will cease. (lie)
o.zh: 若是卢德之道所需，那我会就此停手。 (说谎)

o.en: I serve the Faith, and I search for a servant of the Faith. What would battle serve?
o.zh: 我为信仰服务，我在寻找信仰的仆从。战斗又有什么用呢？

o.en: I wish to serve the Path; finding Bornanew will serve the cause we share.
o.zh: 我愿奉卢德之道； 找到 Bornanew 对我们共同的事业是有益处的。

o.en: Finding Bornanew will serve the Path. Have faith.
o.zh: 找到 Bornanew 既是侍奉卢德之道。坚定你的信仰。

o.en: What else did Brother Cotton say? Is that all?
o.zh: Cotton 修士还说了什么？就这些么？

o.en: I need to contact Brother Cotton. I have something for him.
o.zh: 我需要联系 Cotton 修士。我有些东西给他。

o.en: You demand what your puny fleet cannot impose. Flee now.
o.zh: 你那弱小的舰队可给不了你底气。现在快逃吧。

o.en: You talk a lot. Sure you're up for this?
o.zh: 废话还挺多。你确定你准备好了么？

o.en: Stand down, $brotherOrSister. I am following the orders of Livewell Cotton.
o.zh: 停下，$brotherOrSister。我正在听从 Livewell Cotton 的命令。

entries.en:
"You too must pray on this, $playerBrotherOrSister," $heOrShe says with genuine concern. "It is a narrow Path we tread, and easily lost by those who pervert the teachings of Ludd and name their heresy Truth."

"Let me speak truth to you; I wish not to battle you. The strength of the Faithful is wasted when we fight amongst ourselves; and the devil-spawn of the Domain laugh as they watch. They think we're misguided fools, you know."
entries.zh:
"你需为此祈祷，$playerBrotherOrSister。" $heOrShe真诚的关心着你。"我们所行的圣道如此狭窄，极易为那些信奉异端邪说，扭曲卢德教导之人所迷惑。"

"让我来告诉你真相：我不想与你战斗。当我们自相残杀时，信徒的力量就被虚耗；而那些 人之领 的恶魔之子会看着我们大笑。你知道的，他们觉得我们是被误导的蠢货。"

o.en: We are no fools. Save your strength, $brotherOrSister.
o.zh: 我们不是蠢货。省省力气吧，$brotherOrSister。

o.en: You would be a fool, and a heretic besides, to stand in my way.
o.zh: 如果你挡了我的路，那你就是个蠢货，而且还是个异端。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe stares hard into your eyes, at least the holo-image of them, then brings $hisOrHer hands together. "May Providence show me the way; by the stars and the pneuma and the revelation."

After a moment, $personName opens $hisOrHer eyes.

"Let me speak plainly now: I shall trust your Path. Wherever it leads you, remember what we fight for."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe直视着你的眼睛，至少是全息影像上的眼睛，然后将$hisOrHer的手合起。"愿上天示我前路；以星辰、圣灵和启示。"

过了一会，$personName 张开$hisOrHer的眼睛。

"让我直说吧：我愿相信你的道途。无论此道引你去何方，别忘了我们为何而战。"

entries.en:
$HisOrHer eyes go hard. "It is as I fear. The false Church has corrupted you. It was said that the Adversary would cloak their lies in the sacrament, and here it is before me."

"May God's holy vacuum purify you," $heOrShe hisses.
entries.zh:
$HisOrHer双眼紧盯着你。"这就是我害怕的。你已经被那虚假的教会腐化。据说大敌会用圣礼掩盖谎言，正如我现在所见。"

"愿神圣的虚空将你净化。" $heOrShe嘶哑地说。

entries.en:
"You must pray on this, $playerBrotherOrSister," $heOrShe says with genuine concern. "It is a narrow and perilous Path we tread, beset by the false teachings of the Church on one side, and by the devil-spawn of the Domain on the other."

$HeOrShe sighs, and brings $hisOrHer hands together. "May Providence show me the way; by the stars and the pneuma and the revelation."
entries.zh:
"你需为此祈祷，$playerBrotherOrSister。" $heOrShe真诚地关心着你，"我们所行的圣道狭窄而崎岖，被虚伪谎言的异端教会所困，又被 人之领 的恶魔之子所围。"

$HeOrShe叹了口气，然后将$hisOrHer的手合起。"愿上天示我前路；以星辰、圣灵和启示。"

entries.en:
After a moment, $personName opens $hisOrHer eyes.

"Let me speak plainly now: I shall trust your Path. Wherever it leads you, remember what we fight for."
entries.zh:
过了一会，$personName 张开了$hisOrHer的眼睛。

"让我直说吧：我愿相信你的道途。无论此道引你去何方，别忘了我们为何而战。"

entries.en: "Brother Cotton spoke to you?" $HisOrHer eyes narrow.
entries.zh: "Cotton 修士和你说话了？" $HisOrHer的眼睛眯起。

o.en: Yes, over tea. Would that we all could serve the Path with such grace and charm.
o.zh: 是的，边喝茶边谈。愿我们都能以如此的优雅和魅力侍奉于卢德之道。

entries.en:
"Would that we could indeed," $heOrShe says, perhaps thinking to some slight or misstep $heOrShe observed in the fellow Faithful.

"It is said that Brother Cotton hears the song of the angels, the whisper of pneuma itself. It is not for human ears, they say." $HeOrShe looks away wistfully, "He is like a prophet of old; touched by the divine."

Aware of how this sounds, $heOrShe quickly adds, "Not like Ludd, of course. The Word, that is another matter. What I mean to say is that, truly, it must be blessedly glorious."
entries.zh:
"要是我们能这样就好了，" $heOrShe说道，或许是想起了$heOrShe在一众信徒中曾经观察到的一些怠慢或是错误的行为。

"据说 Cotton 修士能听到天使的歌声，也就是圣灵的低语。他们说，这不是人类能听到的。" $HeOrShe深情地望着远方。"他就像古代的先知，被神灵所点化。"

意识到这听起来有些不妥当，$heOrShe连忙补充到，"当然了，不是像卢德那样。圣言中所述的，那是另一回事了。我实际上想说的是，那一定是无上光荣的。"

o.en: It must; truly we are blessed to walk aside him.
o.zh: 必须如此。我们能与他同行真是蒙了神的祝福。

entries.en:
"Truly! Oh, I am overcome- forgive me, I must pray."

Putting $hisOrHer hands together, the Pather goes on for some time about how wonderful Brother Cotton is, and how we should all follow his example and be so blessed.

And so on; you put your hands together and mumble something to keep up the act. Soon enough, the show is over, and persuade the Pather that $heOrShe may close the comms without yet another blessing.
entries.zh:
"真的！哦，我太激动了 —— 原谅我，我必须祈祷。"

将$hisOrHer的手合拢之后，左径分子滔滔不绝地赞颂 Cotton 修士是多么耀目，以及我等应当如何效仿他，才能以此蒙受赐福。

如此这般；你将双手合拢，含糊地念叨几句以跟上这出好戏。很快，表演拉下了帷幕，你也说服左径分子关闭了通讯，免得$heOrShe再来一轮祝颂。

entries.en:
"I was told to cut you from the sky, to burn your fleet and scatter your ashes to the blessed vacuum." $HeOrShe smiles grimly, "But then I received a message. Brother Cotton believes that Providence has sung of your role in the final battle."

$HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head, dropping the smile. "I know not what to make of this. Nonetheless, I... ask... that you cease your search for this 'missing' recruit." $HeOrShe sighs, recognizing how pathetic this sounds.

"Ask yourself," $heOrShe pleads, "Who do you serve by this action? What lies at the end of this Path?"
entries.zh:
"有人叫我将你从天空斩落，燃尽你的舰队然后将你的骨灰撒入这神圣的虚空。" $HeOrShe狞笑着，"但我之后收到一条消息。Cotton 修士相信上天认可你在最终之战里的贡献。"

$HeOrShe摇着头，收起笑容。"我不知道该怎么做。不管怎样，我...请求...你不要再寻找这个 '失踪' 的新成员了。" $HeOrShe叹道，意识到这听起来多么可悲。

"问问你自己，" $heOrShe恳求道，"在这个行动中你为谁服务？在这条道途的尽头有什么？"

entries.en:
"You are known to us. You shed blood for the Faith on Jangala by the Hegemony's cruel hand." $HeOrShe smiles grimly, "Yes, we know of you."

$HeOrShe drops the smile, and continues. "Serve the Path again: cease your search. Do not pry into our operations, do not ask after one or another 'missing' recruit."
entries.zh:
"我们知道你。在 Jangala，你在 霸主 残酷的手上为信仰流过血。" $HeOrShe狞笑着，"对，我们知道你的事。"

$HeOrShe收起笑容，继续说道，"再次侍奉左径吧：停止你的追寻。不要窥探我们的行动，不要探问无论哪个 '失踪' 的新成员。"

entries.en:
"You are known to us. You have spoken in support of the Path that is necessary and righteous to faithful walkers," $heOrShe smiles grimly for a moment, then drops it.

"So if you truly wish to serve the Path, cease your search. Do not pry into our operations, do not ask after one or another 'missing' recruit."
entries.zh:
"我们知道你。你曾发言支持左径，支持那条对忠实的求道者而言必要且正义的卢德之道。" $heOrShe狞笑了一会，然后收起表情。

"那么如果你真的希望侍奉于左径，就停止你的追寻。不要窥探我们的行动，不要探问无论哪个 '失踪' 的新成员。"

entries.en:
The Pather shakes $hisOrHer head; grim, determined.

"In that, you are mistaken. I prayed that our Paths would align, and a fellow $playerBrotherOrSister could walk with me. But here it ends for you- in God's holy vacuum."

The comms are cut.
entries.zh:
左径摇了摇$hisOrHer的头；冷酷，坚定。

"在这一点上，你错了。我祈祷你我的道途将要并行，一位 $playerBrotherOrSister 可以与我同行。但你的道途将在这里走向尽头 —— 在这神圣虚空之中。"

通讯被切断了。

entries.en:
The Pather shakes $hisOrHer head; grim, determined.

"I obey, and I obey unto a righteous death in God's holy vacuum."

That said, $heOrShe cuts the comms.
entries.zh:
左径摇了摇$hisOrHer的头；冷酷，坚定。

"我遵从，我遵从直到在神圣虚空之中为公义而献身。"

这么说着，$heOrShe切断了通讯。

entries.en:
"I but asked," $heOrShe says, distressed. "And I shall not disobey Brother Cotton's orders. If you will not listen to my words, then I beg you pray. Pray! And listen for the song of the angels, because you will hear no more from me."

$HeOrShe cuts the comms.
entries.zh:
"我只是问问。" $heOrShe苦恼的说，"我也不会违背 Cotton 修士的命令。如果你不想听我的话，那我请求你祈祷吧。祈祷吧！以听天使之颂歌，因你将不会听见我的言语。"

$HeOrShe切断了通讯。

o.en: Prepare a raid on Virens' compounds to extract Jethro Bornanew
o.zh: 准备劫掠 Virens 的藏身处以营救 Jethro Bornanew

entries.en: "And." Her tone is flinty; she is not unperceptive.
entries.zh: "接着说。" 她的语气冷冷的，看来并非没有察觉。

o.en: I have his body for you. (lie)
o.zh: 我为你带回了他的尸体。 (说谎)

o.en: I told him I would tell you he is dead.
o.zh: 我告诉过他，我会跟你说他已经死了。

entries.en:
"I understand," she says. A wall of ice, betrayed only by a glint in her eyes.

"Have him sent down. I shall compel the Knights to make the correct arrangements."

She pauses, taking a deep breath.
entries.zh:
"我知道了。" 她说道。她面若坚冰，唯有眼神中的一丝闪光出卖了她。

"送他下来吧。我会命骑士处理的。"

她停了下来，深吸了一口气。

entries.en:
"Captain. You have provided me... closure. You shall receive your compensation. May Providence guide us, may God forgive us."

She closes the link somewhat abruptly, sending you to a CGR standby mode which is quickly picked up by an aide who arranges the credits transfer, and a flight path for the shuttle to deliver the body.
entries.zh:
"舰长。你给了我... 解脱。你将收到你的报酬。愿上天指引我们，愿神宽恕我们。"

她有些突然地关闭了通讯链接，把你送回了银河救赎教会的待机界面，很快，一名助手接入了通讯，安排了星币转账，并为运送遗体的穿梭机规划了航线。

entries.en:
After a long, long moment she speaks.

"I understand," she says, a wall of ice.

"Was the notion his, or yours?"
entries.zh:
沉默了很久，很久后，她才开口说话。

"我知道了。" 她面若坚冰地说道。

"那是他的想法，还是你的？"

entries.en: She nods, slowly, with the weight of her years.
entries.zh: 带着属于她年龄的沧桑，她缓慢地点了点头。

entries.en: She nods, slowly, with the weight of her years.
entries.zh: 她缓慢地点了点头，似乎瞬间老了许多。

entries.en: "Perhaps it does not," she says in bitter agreement.
entries.zh: "也许没吧。" 她悲伤地同意道。

entries.en: "You have failed to fulfill the terms of our agreement."
entries.zh: "你没能完成我们的合约。"

o.en: I gave you the truth. Is that not enough?
o.zh: 我告诉了你真相。这还不够吗？

o.en: I accept that failure because I have freed a man.
o.zh: 我很乐意接受这个结果，因为我让一个人挣脱了束缚。

o.en: Do you want me to go kidnap him?
o.zh: 你想让我把他绑回来吗？

o.en: Would it make you happy if I shot Bornanew and brought back his body?
o.zh: 要是我对 Bornanew 开一枪再把他的尸体拉回来，你会高兴吗？

entries.en:
"It is not," she says sharply. "But it is all I have, so upon it I shall subsist."

A long pause, and then, "You shall receive your credits."
entries.zh:
"不够。" 她尖刻地说道。"但既然这是我能有的一切，我也只得以此为继。"

她停了很久没开口，然后说道。"你会拿到你的星币的。"

entries.en: She closes the link abruptly, sending you to a CGR standby mode. An instant later, a secretary activates the comms to arrange for the credits transfer in a terse transaction.
entries.zh: 她突然关闭了链接，把你送回了 银河救赎教会 的待机界面。一瞬间后，一名秘书激活了通讯，简洁地安排了星币的转账。

entries.en:
"What a joyous world is yours," Jaspis says, "where all may be free as they like with little concern of the evil permitted reign by their dereliction of God-given necessity."

A pause, then, "You shall receive your credits."
entries.zh:
"那你的世界还真是欢乐。" Jaspis 说道，"每个人都能无拘无束，毫不担心对神予之责的玩忽职守而造成的邪恶横行。"

她停了一会，然后说道。"你会拿到你的星币的。"

entries.en: She closes the link abruptly, sending you to a CGR standby mode. An instant later, a secretary activates the comms to arrange for the credits transfer in a terse transaction.
entries.zh: 她突然关闭了链接，把你送回了 银河救赎教会 的待机界面。一瞬间后，一名秘书激活了通讯，简洁地安排了星币的转账。

entries.en:
"No. Leave him. Free will was given to us by God that we would use it, and err."

A pause, then, "You shall receive the credits."
entries.zh:
"不，随他去吧。神给予我们自由意志就是让我们使用，并犯错的。"

她停了一会，然后说道。"你会拿到你的星币的。"

entries.en: She closes the link abruptly, sending you to a CGR standby mode. An instant later, a secretary activates the comms to arrange for the credits transfer in a terse transaction.
entries.zh: 她突然关闭了链接，把你送回了 银河救赎教会 的待机界面。一瞬间后，一名秘书激活了通讯，简洁地安排了星币的转账。

entries.en:
She gives you a surprisingly fierce look through old, blind eyes.

"No. Leave the matter closed. We shall not speak again."

She closes the link.
entries.zh:
她那对苍老、失明的双眼用一个狰狞的不可置信的方式瞪了你一眼。

"不。不要再管这件事了。我们不会再谈了。"

她切断了通讯。

entries.en:
"Heavens rejoice!" A ray of unselfconscious joy breaks through the Archcurate's well-tended walls.

"You must bring him here, I must see him," she pauses, then laughs at herself. "You know what I mean. Come now, I shall have the Knights forgo their accustomed rigidity."
entries.zh:
"天堂也会为此喜悦！" 一阵毫不掩饰的喜悦穿透了大祭司精心维持的庄严外表。

"你必须把他带到这里，我必须见到他。" 她顿了顿，然后自嘲地笑了，"你知道我的意思。现在就来，我会让骑士们放弃他们惯有的死板。"

entries.en:
She cuts her end of the comm-link with unusual speed, leaving you with a static holding image provided by the Church: a human silhouette descending to Gilead on a beam of light.

An implausible image at best.
entries.zh:
她以不寻常的速度切断了她那端的通讯链接，留下教会提供的待机图像：一个人影顺着一束光降落到 Gilead。

不管怎么说都是个不太现实的影像。

o.en: I found Bornanew. He's here, with my $shipOrFleet.
o.zh: 我找到 Bornanew 了。他就在我的$shipOrFleet里。

o.en: Take a shuttle with Bornanew to the surface
o.zh: 和 Bornanew 一起坐穿梭机前往地表

entries.en:
You would swear that Sedge is upset.

"No more questions," he spits. "We are done."

He walks away.
entries.zh:
你发誓，Sedge 分明是生气了。

"别再问了，" 他啐道，"我们到此为止。"

他转身走开了。

entries.en:
The proprietor, who was pretending to polish a samovar, releases an audible sigh of relief before giving you an accusing look. You suspect service will not be enthusiastic for you in this establishment in the future.

You have a lead: Mazalot.
entries.zh:
之前一直在假装擦洗茶具的店主这时发出了一声如释重负的叹息，并用责备的眼神瞪了你一眼。你估计以后再也没法在这享受到什么热情的服务了。

不过你有了条线索：Mazalot

entries.en:
Sedge disappears down a side-alley, and his thugs with him. You are left in the dripping alley with a corpse.

And a lead: Mazalot.
entries.zh:
Sedge 消失在小巷另一头，他的手下和他一起走了，留下你和一具尸体。

还有一条线索：Mazalot

entries.en:
You draw and fire. The shot reverberates in the small space, a sharp crack that rattles ceramicware.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

There are shouts and screams from patrons. Chaos, and flight. The room empties out, the proprietor ducks behind the bar.
entries.zh:
你拔枪射击。枪声在狭小的空间中回荡，尖锐的声音震得瓷器嗡嗡作响。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

顾客们发出尖叫声。一片混乱，人们纷纷逃离。房间里空荡荡的，老板躲在吧台后面。

o.en: Check to make sure he is dead
o.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

entries.en:
You draw and fire. The shot reverberates in the small space, a sharp crack that rattles ceramicware.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

The proprietor ducks behind the bar and scrabbles out some back door.
entries.zh:
你拔枪射击。枪声在狭小的空间中回荡，尖锐的声音震得瓷器嗡嗡作响。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

老板翻身躲进吧台，从后门爬了出去。

o.en: Check to make sure he is dead
o.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

entries.en:
You speak a sharp word into your comms and within seconds an echoing crack shoots down the alley.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

His thugs disappear. Tactical chatter from your guards - equipped with the best - tracks their flight from the spot.
entries.zh:
你对着通讯器说了个词，数秒后，一声巨响在小巷中回荡。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

他的手下消失了。你装备精良的保镖们说着战术术语，追踪着他们的逃跑路线。

o.en: Check to make sure he is dead
o.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

entries.en:
You draw and fire. The shot reverberates in the alley, a sharp crack.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

Silence follows the echoing shot, broken only by retreating footsteps as his thugs flee the scene.
entries.zh:
你拔枪射击。尖锐的枪声在小巷中回荡。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

回响之后，唯有他手下逃离的脚步声打破了沉默。

o.en: Check to make sure he is dead
o.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

entries.en:
His sightless eyes stare up at a paper lantern slowly spinning in the rafters, casting a warm and murky light.

He is smiling. And dead.
entries.zh:
他无神的双眼盯着一个在屋檐上慢慢旋转的纸灯笼，倒映着温暖而朦胧的光。

他在笑。他死了。

entries.en:
His sightless eyes stare up at a translucent awning, rain spatter distorting a murky light.

He is smiling. And dead.
entries.zh:
他无神的双眼凝视着半透明的雨篷，雨点扭曲了模糊的光线。

他在笑。他死了。

entries.en: You spot your sidearm on the ground, next to the Mammonite's cooling body.
entries.zh: 你瞟到你的随身武器落在地上，旁边就是玛门之仆冰凉的尸体。

o.en: Grab your sidearm and shoot Sedge in the back
o.zh: 拿起你的随身武器并在 Sedge 背后射击他
从背后向 Sedge 射击

o.en: Have one of your guards shoot him in the back
o.zh: 让你的一名警卫在他背后射击他

entries.en:
You leave his body to return to your $shipOrFleet. The Path will know what to do with it.

They are sure to come after you, if they weren't before.
entries.zh:
你丢下了他的尸体，径直返回了你的$shipOrFleet。左径自然知道该怎么处理。

他们肯定会来追寻你的下落了，即便他们此前还没动手的话。

entries.en: "It is a good thing you are not God," Sedge cracks a new smile, "Because then I would be in big trouble."
entries.zh: "幸好你不是神。" Sedge 又露出一个微笑，"因为那样我就有大麻烦了。"

entries.en:
"Sense is not faith," Sedge says, correcting you. "But maybe you are still finding the Path."

He pauses, then adds, "Maybe we talk more someday, $playerBrotherOrSister, after your business with me."
entries.zh:
"理性不是信仰。" Sedge 纠正道，"但也许你仍在探寻圣道。"

他停顿了一下，然后补充道，"也许我们下次再聊，$playerBrotherOrSister，在这单生意之后。"

entries.en:
Sedge leans over to examine it.

"Ah." He speaks without hesitation, "Yes, I remember now. He went to Mazalot."
entries.zh:
Sedge 探身过来查看。

"啊。" 他毫不犹疑地说道，"对，我现在想起来了，他去了 Mazalot。"

entries.en:
Sedge considers his words for a moment. Sucking spittle through his tooth-gap.

"That man, his faith is true." Sedge swishes again. "But he... did not know his Path."
entries.zh:
Sedge 斟酌了一会，从牙缝里吸着气。

"那个男人，他的信仰坚定虔诚。" Sedge 低声说道，"但是他...没有领悟到他的道途。"

entries.en:
Sedge stands back suddenly, looking away down the alley.

"That a man could believe, truly, and not know his Path? I did not like to see that. I told him he had no place with us."

He speaks without meeting your eyes, "I was told he worked for a time, then bought passage to Mazalot."

"I hope they see what I saw, too. That... he is unfit."
entries.zh:
Sedge 突然后退一步，看向小巷另一边。

"是那个信仰坚定虔诚，但却没领悟到自己道途的男人？那时我不太待见这种人。我和他说过，他和我们不是同路人。"

他说话时没有看你的眼睛，"我听说他工作了一段时间，然后凑够钱去了 Mazalot。"

"我相信那边的人的看法应该和我的一样。就是...他不合适。"

entries.en:
Sedge stands, suddenly, a look of concern on his face.

"That a man could believe, truly, and not know his Path? I did not like to see that. I told him, he had no place with us."

"I was told he worked for a time, then bought passage to Mazalot," he says. "I hope they see what I saw, too. That he is unfit."
entries.zh:
Sedge 突然站了起来，脸上多了一丝关切的神色。

"是那个信仰坚定虔诚，但却没领悟到自己道途的男人？那时我不太待见这种人。我和他说过，他和我们不是同路人。"

"我听说他工作了一段时间，然后凑够钱去了 Mazalot。" 他说，"我相信那边的人的看法应该和我的一样。他不合适。"

entries.en: You draw out your TriPad and activate the Jethro Bornanew file. There is a holo from before he left.
entries.zh: 你掏出 TriPad，打开了 Jethro Bornanew 的档案。里面有一张他离开前的全息影像。

entries.en: You slowly draw your TriPad and activate the Jethro Bornanew file. There is a holo from before he left.
entries.zh: 你谨慎地掏出 TriPad，打开了 Jethro Bornanew 的档案。里面有一张他离开前的全息影像。

o.en: Take a shuttle down to meet with Nile Virens
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机下去与 Nile Virens 会面

entries.en:
From the shuttle you admire the atmospheric display resulting from Mazalot's strong magnetic field; spectra flare and break like ocean waves.

Your shuttle is unaffected aside from extra cleanup processing required by the comms and nav systems.

You land on the outskirts of some Luddic-majority town in what passes for a spaceport: a field of baked gray dust. A long row of sheds might be traffic control, warehouses, or a barn for all you know.
entries.zh:
在穿梭机内，你欣赏着 Mazalot 强大磁场所造就的壮观大气景象；光谱波动犹如海浪般绚烂分裂。

你的穿梭机除了通讯和导航系统需要额外清理外，未受任何影响。

你降落在一个以卢德信众为人口主题的小镇外围，这里的太空港仅仅是一片灰色的尘土地带。一排排棚屋或许是交通管制中心、仓库，或者在你看来，它们甚至可能是个谷仓。

entries.en:
A pair of militants wearing dust masks meet you. They're armed, but not conspicuously so.

They lead you through a town of sun-baked brick and slowly corroding salvage. Bright paint and lush gardens manage, just, to stave off a sense of apocalyptic decay.

Soon, you find yourself before a large compound with doors of etched metal. The militants are met by another pair, similarly armed. The most senior among them lowers his mask.
entries.zh:
两名戴着防尘面具的武装人员迎接了你。他们配备着武器，但不太引人注目。

他们引导你穿越一个由日晒砖瓦和逐渐锈蚀的废料建成的小镇。明亮的彩绘和繁盛的花园勉强抵御着末世般的衰败感。

很快，你来到了一个拥有精致金属门的大型院落前。这两名武装人员被另外两名同样配备武器的人接应。其中位列最高的一人缓缓地摘下了他的面具。

entries.en:
"$PlayerName. Blessed peace," he says, and hesitates.

"Please. Your weapon." He indicates your sidearm.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerName。愿和平赐福，" 他说着，稍作停顿。

"另外，您的武器。" 他示意你拿出你的随身武器。

o.en: Don't worry, I'm not here to shoot anyone.
o.zh: 放心，我没准备射爆谁的脑袋。

o.en: I will not surrender my sidearm.
o.zh: 我不会交出我的随身武器的。

o.en: You'll have to take it from my cold, dead hands.
o.zh: 那得等我死透之后，你才能从我手上拿走它。

entries.en: "$PlayerName. Blessed peace this day. Please, $playerSirOrMadam, follow me."
entries.zh: "$PlayerName。愿和平赐福今日。这边请，$playerSirOrMadam，跟我来吧。"

entries.en:
The lead guard does a quick one-two knock on the doors and they swing open.

The air is cool, the walls hung with cloth woven in bright patterns; wooden furniture prevails. A clean, earthy scent hangs in the air. You are overcome by a sense of ancient wealth - entirely underwhelming compared to the palaces of Eventide or a Tri-Tachyon executive's chateau, but here, you can tell that every object, every surface, has been transformed by the hand and muscle of human beings alone.

You are led up stairs - wooden, creaking unsettlingly - to a room overlooking an interior courtyard garden. The silhouette of a man stirs at your presence.
entries.zh:
领头的守卫快速敲了两下门，门开了。

空气凉爽，墙壁上挂着织有鲜艳图案的布；满眼都是木制家具。空气中弥漫着清新的泥土香味。一种古老的财富感震慑了你 —— 虽然与 Eventide 的宫殿或速子科技高管的庄园相比起来平淡无奇，但你可以看出，这里的每个物体和每个平面，都仅由人类用的双手和肌肉所造就。

你被引上楼梯 —— 木制，噶吱作响 —— 来到一间能俯瞰内部庭院的房间。一个男人的轮廓因你的出现动了起来。

entries.en:
"You use this word 'ally'. It is, I think, too strong a word for what was between he and I."

Virens switches his teacup to his other hand, "Nor shall I deny the association, not once or thrice. The Path can be a twisted thing, captain, and ever am I surprised by the company with whom I walk."

"I apologize for nothing but for providing you with an unsatisfactory answer." He pours more tea, "My wife always said I was a middling host."
entries.zh:
"我和他的关系用 '盟友' 来形容的话，未免有点太过了。"

Virens 换了一只手端茶杯。"但我也没有否认我们之间的联系，从来没有。圣道可能会充满曲折，舰长，就连我会也不时感叹，伴我同行的到底都是些什么人。"

"很抱歉，我没法给你一个满意的答复。" 他再倒了点茶，"我确实不擅长于待客之道，我的妻子也经常这么说。"

entries.en:
He gives you a funny look.

"Sedge. On Chalcedon." He raises his eyebrows, "In the back? Surely you will not begrudge my caution."
entries.zh:
他给你的表情像是听到了什么搞笑的事情一样。

"Sedge。在 Chalcedon 上。" 他扬起眉毛，"从身后下的手？想必你不会怪罪我行事谨慎吧。"

o.en: He would have killed me without hesitation, given the chance. (lie)
o.zh: 如果有机会，他一定会毫不犹豫地杀了我。 (说谎)

o.en: I didn't like him. That's why. (lie)
o.zh: 我不喜欢他，就这样。 (说谎)

o.en: His anti-technological terrorism is a threat to the future of the Persean Sector. (lie)
o.zh: 他的反科技恐怖主义对英仙座星域的未来是个威胁。 (说谎)

o.en: He was a brute who ruled through terror. (lie)
o.zh: 他就是个实行恐怖统治的野蛮人。 (说谎)

o.en: Because he's a Pather. It's what all Pathers deserve. (lie)
o.zh: 因为他是个左径分子，这就是所有左径分子的下场。 (说谎)

o.en: His manner and actions pollute the purity of the Path. (lie)
o.zh: 他的态度与行为玷污了卢德之道的纯粹。 (说谎)

o.en: He would have killed me without hesitation, given the chance.
o.zh: 如果有机会，他一定会毫不犹豫地杀了我。

o.en: I didn't like him. That's why.
He drank my tea. It was my. Tea.
o.zh: 他喝了我的茶。那可是 '我 的' 茶。

o.en: His anti-technological terrorism is a threat to the future of the Persean Sector.
o.zh: 他的反科技恐怖主义对英仙座星域的未来是个威胁。

o.en: He was a brute who ruled through terror.
o.zh: 他就是个实行恐怖统治的野蛮人。

o.en: Because he's a Pather. It's what all Pathers deserve.
o.zh: 因为他是个左径分子，这就是所有左径分子的下场。

o.en: His manner and actions pollute the purity of the Path.
o.zh: 他的态度与行为玷污了卢德之道的纯粹。

o.en: Consider a lie to answer with...

entries.en:
You execute the command to open comms for Nile Virens. Your interface links to the MUA network, its motto blinking for a moment - something about "diversity of belief and good order" - then forwards through a series of ancient off-the-forge low-power relays displaying embedded logos of the long-dead megacorp that once claimed ownership of the hardware.

Your request hangs in the limbo, request bouncing between nodes on the Mazalot network.

Nile Virens isn't answering.
entries.zh:
你下达了指令，接通了与 Nile Virens 的通讯链接。你的界面接入了 MUA 网络，在那里，一句关于 "信仰多样性与良好秩序" 的标语短暂闪现，随后通过一系列古老的、刚出厂的低功耗中继器进行了转发，这些中继器上刻有早已消失的巨头企业的标志，它们曾宣称这些硬件为己有。

你的通讯请求在 Mazalot 网络的节点间徘徊，如同石沉大海。

Nile Virens 没有给出任何回应。

o.en: Have your comms officer babysit the link request
o.zh: 让你的通讯军官负责链接请求

entries.en:
Mere minutes later, your comms officer pings you with an update.

Nile Virens never activated the comms; it seems that he "doesn't use comms". But someone who claimed to be an associate did respond, finally, and has relayed an invitation...
entries.zh:
几分钟后，你的通讯军官给你发来了最新消息。

Nile Virens 一直没有激活通讯器；看来他 "不使用通讯器"。但终于有一个自称是他同事的人回复了，并转达了一个邀请...

o.en: He's invited me for tea, hasn't he.
o.zh: 他已经邀请过我去喝杯茶了，不是吗。

entries.en:
"Um," your comms officer is caught off guard. "Yes, $playerSirOrMadam, he has. For tea."

You consider your options.
entries.zh:
"呃，" 你的通讯军官显得稍显意外。"是的，$playerSirOrMadam，他确实邀请了您，去喝茶。"

你思索着自己的各种选择。

entries.en: Your comms officer replies with an appropriately professional level of enthusiasm to the tedious task. In the meantime, you turn to certain routine obligations of running a $shipOrFleet.
entries.zh: 你的通讯军官带着些许职业水平的热忱接下了这项乏味的任务。在此期间，你将转而处理管理$shipOrFleet的一些日常事务。

entries.en: It is possible that word of your killing of Sedge has made its way to Virens, whether he uses comms or not. You imagine that he may take a dim view of your action on Chalcedon.
entries.zh: 您杀死 Sedge 的消息很可能已经传到了 Virens 那里，无论他是否使用通讯设备。你猜想，他可能对你在 Chalcedon 上的行动持有负面看法。

o.en: I'm looking for a man called Jethro Bornanew.
o.zh: 我在找一个名叫 Jethro Bornanew 的男人。

o.en: Why did you invite me here?
Why did you take my sidearm?
o.zh: 你为什么收走了我的随身武器？

o.en: You're a lot more polite than Sedge.
o.zh: 你比 Sedge 要有礼貌多了。

o.en: How does a man like you ally yourself with a man like Sedge?
o.zh: 你这样的人怎么会和 Sedge 那样的人走到一起去？

o.en: Sit and take a cup of tea

entries.en:
You return to your $shipOrFleet without having met Virens.

It seems that he will only meet you if you are totally defanged. Perhaps he does not believe that your marines could 'invite' him to meet you.
entries.zh:
你没有去见 Virens，而是回到你的$shipOrFleet。

看起来只有在你彻底 '无害' 的情况下他才会见你。也许他也不相信你的陆战队员能够 '邀请' 他见面。

entries.en:
"I see," Virens says, looking out into the courtyard. Thinking, for a long minute. He turns back and deliberately sips some tea.

"I think you should speak with Bornanew yourself," he says. "I shall have my man give you the coordinates."
entries.zh:
"我明白了。" Virens 这么说着，目光落在了庭院里。他思考了很长一段时间，然后转回了头，十分僵硬地抿了一口茶。

"我觉得你确实该和 Bornanew 亲自谈谈。" 他说道，"我这就让我的人给你坐标。"

o.en: Why help the Church? Are you not of a... wayward sect?
o.zh: 为什么你要帮助教会？你所属的教派通常不是更...另辟蹊径吗？

entries.en:
"Wayward?" He gives a soft laugh. "You can be diplomatic when you wish it."

"The Church is not all one thing. And do you think this man, this Jethro Bornanew, will help that part of the Church which seeks a dominion of orthodoxy to overcome all the Faithful, and the Sector besides?"

"Of that, I am not sure." His mouth moves toward an amused smile, but doesn't quite get there. "Burn bright, captain."
entries.zh:
"另辟蹊径？" 他轻笑一声，"你圆滑起来倒还挺像样的。"

"教会内部并不是铁板一块。而你觉得这个家伙，这个 Jethro Bornanew，能帮教会里那些坚持所谓正统的势力压制所有其他信徒，乃至整个星域吗？"

"我可不确定。" 他扯出了一个被逗乐了的笑容，但最终没咧得那么开。"祝你航行无阻，舰长。"

o.en: How does this serve the Path, for me to find Bornanew for the Church?
o.zh: 我帮教会找到 Bornanew 对左径有什么好处？

entries.en:
"I speak true, $playerBrotherOrSister, when I say that I do not know what Path has been set for us by Providence."

"But I do know that the Church is not all of one thing. And do you think this man, this Jethro Bornanew, will help that part of the Church which seeks a dominion of orthodoxy to overcome all the Faithful, and the Sector besides?"

"Of that I am especially unsure." His mouth moves toward a smile of amusement, but doesn't quite get there. "Burn bright, captain."
entries.zh:
"我说实话，$playerBrotherOrSister，我不知道上天为我们铺设了怎样的道途。"

"但我知道教会并不是铁板一块。而你觉得这个家伙，这个 Jethro Bornanew，能帮教会里那些正统派克服所有信徒和其他星域的阻碍吗？"

"我可一点也不确定。" 他的嘴角扯出了一个被逗乐了的笑容，但最终没咧得那么开。"愿你航行无阻，舰长。"

o.zh: 这就完了？没什么关于 '卢德之道' 的高谈阔论？

entries.en:
"I felt you would not wish to hear of 'the Path'. But if you wish, I will tell you briefly of the Path."

He looks down, frowning. "The Path is not all alike. In some places, the Path provides something that nothing else will. Not Kazeron, not the Hegemony, certainly not the Mazalot Unification Authority."

He looks up, changed; there is a sad fervor in his eyes that you did not see before. "We were lost. And then the Word found us. Ludd's message shines bright in the dark of space, in the shadow of the powerful. Not even the Church can contain it."

"THAT is the Path." He nearly shouts, standing. Then takes a deep breath, and a moment to smooth his fine clothing.
entries.zh:
"我不觉得你真的想了解 '卢德之道'。但是如果你想的话，我可以简单地向你介绍介绍。"

他皱起眉头，垂下脑袋。"每个人的卢德之道都并非一致，卢德之道展现了常人所不能及之物。这些东西 Kazeron 给不了你，霸主 给不了你，Mazalot 统一政权自然也给不了你。"

他抬起头，表情快速变化，那是一种你从未见过的，既狂热又哀伤的眼神。"我们曾经迷失。然后，'卢德之道' 找到了我们。在漆黑的太空中，在强权的阴影下，卢德的教诲振聋发聩，就连教会也不足以容纳其万一。"

"那，就是卢德之道。" 他几乎是站着喊出来的，随即深深地吸了一口气，顺了顺身上精致的衣服。

o.en: Why would you, a Pather, help me with this?
o.zh: 为什么你，作为一个左径分子，会在这件事上帮我？

entries.en:
His lip curls in an ironic smile while his eyes narrow just slightly; some repressed anger, even rage.

"You know little of the Path, spacer. The Path provides something that nothing else will. Not Kazeron, not the Hegemony, certainly not the Mazalot Unification Authority."

He sets his teacup down firmly. There is a sad fervor in his eyes that you did not see before. "Ludd's message shines bright in the dark of space, in the shadow beneath the boot of power. Not even the Church can contain it."

He takes a deep breath, and smooths his fine clothing.
entries.zh:
他嘴唇卷起来，露出讽刺的微笑；微眯起的眼睛中透露着压抑着的愤懑与怒火。

"你对卢德之道知之甚少，太空佬。卢德之道展现了常人所不能及之物。这些东西 Kazeron 给不了你，霸主 给不了你，Mazalot 统一政权自然也给不了你。"

他坚定地放下茶杯，眼中展现出一种你从未见过的狂热与哀伤。"在漆黑的太空中，在强权的阴影下，卢德的教诲振聋发聩，就连教会也不足以容纳其万一。"

他深深地吸了一口气，顺了顺身上精致的衣服。

o.en: You have my thanks; may a path of peace lay before you.
o.zh: 非常感谢；愿你的道途通向和平。

entries.en:
He stands to see you off.

"The Path is not all one thing, spacer, nor is the Church. Remember that."
entries.zh:
他站起来把你送走了。

"左径并非铁板一块，宇宙民，教会也不是。谨记。"

o.en: Just like that? Is this some kind of trap?
o.zh: 这就结束了？这是个陷阱吗？

entries.en:
He shakes his head at the implied accusation. "It is not."

"You know little of the Path, spacer. The Path provides something that nothing else will. Not Kazeron, not the Hegemony, certainly not the Mazalot Unification Authority."

He sets his teacup down firmly, rattling the ceramic. There is a sad fervor in his eyes you did not see before. "Ludd's message shines bright in the dark of space, and in the shadow beneath the boot of power. Not even the Church can contain it."

He stands, and takes a deep breath. Then smooths his fine clothing. "Go in peace," he says.
entries.zh:
他对于你隐含的中伤摇了摇头。"绝非如此。"

"你对卢德之道知之甚少，太空佬。卢德之道展现了常人所不能及之物。这些东西 Kazeron 给不了你，霸主 给不了你，Mazalot 统一政权自然也给不了你。"

他坚定地放下茶杯，手捏的茶杯咯咯作响。他的眼中展现出一种你从未见过的狂热与哀伤。"在漆黑的太空中，在强权的阴影下，卢德的教诲振聋发聩，就连教会也不足以容纳其万一。"

他站起来，深深地吸了一口气，理了理身上精致的衣服。"和平地回去吧。" 他说道。

o.en: One more thing- I need to find Brother Cotton.
o.zh: 还有一件事 —— 我还在找 Cotton 修士。

entries.en:
Virens' expression cools noticeably.

"Do you," he says; not a question. "With that, I cannot help you."
entries.zh:
Virens 的面色明显阴沉下来。

"是吗。" 他说道；这不是个疑问句，"我没法帮你。"

o.en: Do you have a problem with Cotton?

o.zh: 你的意思是，'不会' 帮我。

o.en: Well, thank you anyway. And for the tea.
o.zh: 好吧，无论如何还是谢谢你了。还有你的茶。

entries.en:
He stands, and smooths his fine clothing, letting out a deep breath.

"I will not speak of Cotton. Not here, not now."
entries.zh:
他站了起来，理了理身上精致的衣服，深深吸了口气。

"我不想谈起 Cotton。至少不是此时此刻。"

entries.en:
He stands, and smooths his fine clothing, letting out a deep breath.

"If you would drink a bitter tea, then I 'will not'," he emphasizes your words, "stop you."
entries.zh:
他站了起来，理了理身上精致的衣服，深深吸了口气。

"如果你想尝点苦茶，那我也 '不会'。" 他故意强调了你先前的用词，"阻止你。"

o.en: Thank you. And for the tea.

entries.en: He stands to see you off, "The Path is not all one thing, spacer, nor is the Church. Remember that."
entries.zh: 他起身目送了你。"左径并非铁板一块，宇宙民，教会也不是。谨记。"

o.en: That wasn't so hard, was it.
o.zh: 是吧，告诉我也没那么难。

entries.en:
Virens' lead guard brings you back to the entry hall, where a secretary meets you and uses a scratched datapad to provide you with coordinates to a location on the surface of Mazalot.

Then you are accompanied back to your shuttle; the population keeps a wary distance. They know who you met, and know better than to interfere.
entries.zh:
Virens 的警卫队长带着你回到了大厅。一位秘书凑了上来，用一块全是划痕的数据平板为你提供了 Mazalot 地表上的一个坐标。

他们把你送回了你的穿梭机；人群都不安地保持着距离。他们知道你去见了谁，也知道最好不要被卷进来。

entries.en:
Virens' lead guard brings you back to the entry hall, where a secretary meets you and uses a scratched datapad to provide you with coordinates to a location on the surface of Mazalot.

Your side arm is returned, and you are accompanied back to your shuttle; the population keeps a wary distance. They know who you met, and know better than to interfere.
entries.zh:
Virens 的警卫队长带着你回到了大厅。一位秘书凑了上来，用一块全是划痕的数据平板为你提供了 Mazalot 地表上的一个坐标。

他们交还了你的随身武器，然后把你送回了你的穿梭机；人群都不安地保持着距离。他们知道你去见了谁，也知道最好不要被卷进来。

entries.en:
The lead guard accepts it with both hands, giving a little bow, then tucks it into a holster on the front of his webbing.

A place of honor? Or at least a visible demonstration that he's going to keep a close eye on your gun.
entries.zh:
领头的守卫用双手将其接过，并礼貌地微微鞠躬，然后把它收进他胸前的挂网枪套中。

这是将其置于荣耀之地吗？或至少是一个明显的信号，表明他将会密切关注你的枪。

entries.en:
The guards glance nervously at one another. Someone mutters something at the edge of your hearing.

The leader gives a hiss and they shut up.

"Please, if you would," he says. "You are a guest of Brother Virens. He guarantees your safety on this world."
entries.zh:
守卫们紧张地相互交换着眼神。你隐约听到有人在窃窃私语。

领头的人发出一声低吼，守卫们立即安静下来。

"请，如果您同意，" 他说。"您是 Virens 修士的贵宾。在这颗星球上，他保证您的安全。"

entries.en:
The guards glance nervously at one another, muttering. The leader gives a hiss and they shut up.

"Please, if you would," he says. "You are a guest of Brother Virens. You will not be touched on this world."
entries.zh:
守卫们紧张地相互交换着眼神，一边窃窃私语着。领头的人发出一声低吼，守卫们立即安静下来。

"请，如果您同意，" 他说。"您是 Virens 修士的贵宾。在这颗星球上，他保证您的安全。"

entries.en:
The leader almost looks sad for a moment, then something shifts in his eyes and his expression is left dull but alert.

"Then you will not meet with Brother Virens," he says. "We shall return to your shuttle."

The other guards are tense.
entries.zh:
头领有一瞬间几乎是露出了悲伤的神情，然后他眼中有什么东西变了，他的表情也变得木然，但仍保持警觉。

"那么你就不会见到 Virens 修士了，" 他说。"我们会送你回穿梭机。"

其他守卫都紧张起来。

entries.en: Virens' militants escort you back through town. You see clearly now how the population avoids your route, and how you haven't, in fact, seen any MUA personnel. Anywhere.
entries.zh: Virens 的守卫护送着你穿过城镇。你可以清楚地看到人们是如何对你避之不及，并且你没有，确实没有，看到任何 MUA 人员。哪里都没有。

entries.en:
Virens pulls back, frowning.

"Am I to understand that as a threat, or merely a jest made in very poor taste?"
entries.zh:
Virens 皱着眉头躺上了椅背。

"你是在威胁我？还是说我可以认为这只是个糟糕透顶的玩笑？"

o.en: My apologies. It's just spacer humor.
o.zh: 抱歉，只是太空佬的黑色幽默而已。

o.en: It's a job. I'm simply being realistic.
o.zh: 就是个赏金任务。我比较实事求是而已。

entries.en: He gives you a look. He seems more distant from you, somehow.
entries.zh: 他看了你一眼。不知怎地，你能感觉出你们之间更有距离感了。

entries.en: He gives you a look that contains not a hint of amusement.
entries.zh: 他看了你一眼，显然他一点也不觉得这有趣。

entries.en:
"I see," Virens says coldly. "It would be consistent to level the same charge against myself, yes?"

He looks at you with expectant challenge.
entries.zh:
"原来如此。" Virens 的语气冷了下来，"照你的说法，我也会受到相同的指控，是吗？"

他挑衅地看着你。

entries.en: "Then I shall await your judgment in good spirit," he says. "Though you must understand, it is only God whose judgment for which I truly fear and hope."
entries.zh: "那我可真得定心等待你的裁决了。" 他说道，"但你得明白，只有来自神的裁决，才是我真正敬畏并期待的。"

entries.en: "Then I shall await your wrath in good spirit," he says calmly. "Though you must understand, it is only God whose judgment for which I truly fear and hope."
entries.zh: "那我可真得定心等待你的怒火了。" 他说道，"但你得明白，只有来自神的裁决，才是我真正敬畏并期待的。"

entries.en:
"Do I?" He looks away, brow wrinkling. "Then I feel perhaps I am failing at something."

He turns back to you, "Nonetheless, it is only God whose judgment for which I truly fear and hope."
entries.zh:
"我真的会吗？" 他皱着眉看向了别处，"看来我在某些方面做得还不够好。"

他重新面对你道："然而，我真正敬畏和期盼的只有神的裁决。"

entries.en:
"I see," Virens says coldly. "It would be consistent to level the same charge against myself, yes?"

He looks at you with expectant challenge.
entries.zh:
"原来如此。" Virens 的语气冷了下来，"照你的说法，我也会受到相同的指控，是吗？"

他挑衅地看着你。

entries.en:
"You are not wrong in that," Virens says.

"And he died as he lived: through a seemingly random act of wanton violence."

You detect more than a hint of criticism in these words.
entries.zh:
"这你倒说得没错。" Virens 说道。

"他死于一场看似随机的肆意暴力之中，颇有种以其人之道还治其人之身的感觉。"

你察觉到了他话语里有明显的指责意味。

o.en: He was a murderer. The world is better off without him.
o.zh: 他是个杀人犯。这个世界没了他才好。

o.en: How can you criticize me while Pathers raid and kill?
o.zh: 左径分子烧杀抢掠，凭什么轮到你来指责我？

o.en: That's rich coming from a Pather. Remember Mairaath?
o.zh: 这句话从左径分子的嘴里吐出来可真是讽刺。还记得 Mairaath 吗？

entries.en:
"Yes. But think of what you've created, back on Chalcedon."

Virens leans forward, "A hero, blessed martyr," he whispers. "Shot in the back by a spacer coward. Sedge now walks beside Ludd, and the children of Chalcedon will walk in his footsteps."

He leans back again. "You've made what was once an inconvenience an immortal, captain."
entries.zh:
"你说得没错。但想想你在 Chalcedon 上铸就了什么。"

Virens 凑到你耳边，"一个大英雄，光荣的烈士。" 他低语道，"被一个两面三刀的懦夫背叛。Sedge 现在与卢德并肩前进，而 Chalcedon 的子民也会追随他的步伐。"

他重新坐直了身体。"你把曾经的小麻烦变成了永垂不朽的传说，舰长。"

entries.en:
"Think of what you've created, back on Chalcedon."

Virens leans forward, "A hero, blessed martyr," he whispers. "Shot in the back by a spacer coward. Sedge now walks beside Ludd, and the children of Chalcedon will walk in his footsteps."

He leans back again. "It may be that you've made a whole new generation of raiders and killers, captain."
entries.zh:
"想想你在 Chalcedon 上铸就了什么。"

Virens 凑到你耳边，"一个大英雄，光荣的烈士。" 他低语道，"被一个两面三刀的懦夫背叛。Sedge 现在与卢德并肩前进，而 Chalcedon 的子民也会追随他的步伐。"

他重新站直了身体。"也许你只手打造了一代全新的掠夺者和杀手，舰长。"

entries.en: "No. But they choose," Virens says.
entries.zh: "当然不是。但他们依旧会这么做。" Virens 说道。

entries.en: "So they shall," Virens agrees.
entries.zh: "确实如此。" Virens 赞同道。

entries.en:
He sighs. "Mairaath, yes. We're told many things of Mairaath. But think of what you've created, back on Chalcedon."

Virens leans forward, "A hero, blessed martyr," he whispers. "Shot in the back by a spacer coward. Sedge now walks beside Ludd, and the children of Chalcedon will walk in his footsteps."

He leans back again. "It may be that you've made a whole new generation of raiders and killers, captain."
entries.zh:
他叹道："Mairaath，对。我们听闻了不少 Mairaath 上发生的故事。但想想你在 Chalcedon 上铸就了什么。"

Virens 凑到你耳边，"一个大英雄，光荣的烈士。" 他低语道，"被一个两面三刀的懦夫背叛。Sedge 现在与卢德并肩前进，而 Chalcedon 的子民也会追随他的步伐。"

他重新站直了身体。"也许你只手打造了一代全新的掠夺者和杀手，舰长。"

o.en: You can't simply dismiss Mairaath, and what the Path did there.
o.zh: 你不应该这么简单就把 Mairaath 和左径在那做过的事一笔带过。

entries.en:
"No," he says, "I cannot."

"But I will not rehash this old argument now. Remember, it is you who came to me, in my home, to ask me for a favor."
entries.zh:
他说道："我确实不应该。"

"但我现在不想翻这些旧账。别忘了，现在是你主动来我的地盘找我，让我帮个忙的。"

entries.en:
"You are not wrong in that," Virens says. "He died as he lived, through a seemingly random act of wanton violence."

You detect more than a hint of criticism in these words.
entries.zh:
"这你倒是说得没错。" Virens 说道，"他死于一场看似随机的肆意暴力之中，颇有种以其人之道还治其人之身的感觉。"

你察觉到了他话语里有明显的指责意味。

o.en: He was a murderer. The world is better off without him.
o.zh: 他是个杀人犯。这个世界没了他才好。

o.en: How can you criticize me while Pathers raid and kill?
o.zh: 左径分子烧杀抢掠，凭什么轮到你来指责我？

o.en: That's rich coming from a Pather. Remember Mairaath?
o.zh: 这句话从左径分子嘴里吐出真是滑稽。还记得 Mairaath 吗？

entries.en:
"It is easy to dislike a great many people in a great many circumstances," Virens says. "Sedge, perhaps, easier to dislike than most, I must admit."

"Still. Death is not a thing to administer lightly."

You are certain he has made such administrations himself.
entries.zh:
"许多时候人们轻易地因为各种原因互相敌视。" Virens 说道，"我得说，或许 Sedge 是更容易被人厌恶的那类。"

"但，你也不应该轻描淡写地判他死刑。"

然而无须质疑的是，他自己就是个做过这种事的人。

o.en: So are you thinking about killing me?

entries.en:
"It is easy to dislike a great many people in a great many circumstances," Virens says. "Sedge, perhaps, easier to dislike than most, I must admit."

"Still. Death is not a thing to administer lightly."

With these words, you would be certain he has made such administrations, did not his position imply already such was the case.
entries.zh:
"许多时候人们轻易地因为各种原因互相敌视。" Virens 说道，"我得说，或许 Sedge 是更容易被人厌恶的那类。"

"但，你也不应该轻描淡写地判他死刑。"

然而无须质疑的是，能坐在如今的位置上，他自己就是个做过这种事的人。

o.en: So are you thinking about killing me?

entries.en:
"I concede that he has, to my knowledge, killed many," Virens says. "And with little hesitation. By the other hand, he did speak with you; he seemed to me not a man to waste his time with talk when intent upon killing."

"To that point," he picks up his teacup. "The deed is done. Sedge is not mine to avenge, so put any worry of that from your mind."

"You see, I am a man who does hesitate. Thoughtless action," he shakes his head. "But there are times for killing. And, after hesitation - and thought - I see that it be done."

Virens smiles unreassuringly.
entries.zh:
"我承认，在我的印象里他确实杀了很多人。" Virens 说道，"且从不犹豫。但话又说回来，他和你有过一些面谈；而在我看来如果真的想杀你，他可不是那种会浪费时间动嘴皮子的人。"

"总之。" 他端起了他的茶杯，"事已至此，给 Sedge 报仇也不是我该干的事，你就别为此担心了。"

"要知道，我就是容易犹豫。这事真是欠考虑。" 他摇了摇头，"但当杀戮的时机到来之际，在犹豫和思考之后，我将势在必得。"

Virens 的微笑让你毛骨悚然。

o.en: So are you thinking about killing me?

entries.en: "The thought had crossed my mind," he admits. "But I think it would bring much trouble. And... I want to see what happens."
entries.zh: "我还真这么想过。" 他承认道，"但我觉得那样只会更麻烦。况且...我想看看接下来事情会怎么发展。"

o.en: I'm glad we cleared that up.
o.zh: 很高兴我们把这事说清楚了。

entries.en:
He stares straight at you. "You did not steal my tea."

"So," he trails off, giving a one-shoulder shrug, tea steady in his other hand. "No."

Just the hint of an unexpected smile lingers.
entries.zh:
他直勾勾地盯着你道："你又没偷我的茶。"

"所以。" 他顿了顿，用没端茶杯的那只手耸了耸肩，"不会。"

他的嘴角只挂着一丝出人意料的微笑。

o.en: I'm glad we cleared that up.
o.zh: 很高兴我们把这事说清楚了。

entries.en: "I as well," he says.
entries.zh: "我也这么觉得。" 他回应道。

Virens smiles unreassuringly.

entries.en: "Ah." Virens leans back, examining you coolly. "Am I next?"
entries.zh: "啊。" Virens 向后靠了靠，一边冷冷地打量着你。"那我就是下一个？"

entries.en: "Ah." Virens leans back, examining you coolly. "Am I next?"
entries.zh: "啊。" Virens 向后靠了靠，一边冷冷地打量着你。"那我就是下一个？"

entries.en:
"Ah," Virens leans back, examining you coolly.

"It will take a great deal of blood indeed to wash all that is impure from the Path, and indeed from the Sector entirely."
entries.zh:
"啊。" Virens 向后靠了靠，一边冷冷地打量着你。

"想把 卢德左径 中，乃至整个星域中所有的不洁全部洗净，可是要花不少血水啊。"

o.en: Not so much once a few are made example of.
o.zh: 杀鸡儆猴，就不会死那么多人了。

entries.en:
"Your faith burns bright. Perhaps too bright for me, a simple man, to face unblinking." Virens adjusts his posture, uncomfortable perhaps.

"Let us speak of other things."
entries.zh:
"你的信仰如此坚定耀眼，耀眼到让我这个凡夫俗子无法直视。" Virens 调整了一下他的坐姿，或许是因为不适。

"我们谈点别的吧。"

entries.en:
"Your faith burns bright. Perhaps too bright for me, a simple man, to face unblinking." Virens adjusts his posture, uncomfortable perhaps.

"Let us speak of other things."
entries.zh:
"你的信仰如此坚定耀眼，耀眼到让我这个凡夫俗子无法直视。" Virens 调整了一下他的坐姿，或许是因为不适。

"我们谈点别的吧。"

entries.en:
"Ah," Virens leans back, examining you coolly.

"It will take a great deal of blood indeed to wash all that is impure from the Path, and indeed from the Sector entirely."
entries.zh:
"啊。" Virens 向后靠了靠，一边冷冷地打量着你。

"然而想把 卢德左径 乃至整个星域中所有的污秽全部洗净，毫无疑问是要不少血水啊。"

o.en: Not so much once a few are made example of.
o.zh: 杀鸡儆猴，就不会死那么多人了。

entries.en: "You killed a man over a cup of tea?" Virens' composure cracks for a moment in sheer disbelief.
entries.zh: "你杀了个人就因为一杯茶？" 因为太过难以置信，Virens 那镇定自若的神色从他脸上消失了那么一小会儿。

entries.en:
"I understand that Sedge could be rude, yes, and even offensive. But," he shakes his head. "Death is not a thing to administer lightly."

You are certain he has made such administrations himself.
entries.zh:
"我知道 Sedge 是个没礼貌的家伙，甚至可以说相当粗鲁。不过，" 他摇了摇头，"你也不应该随便让人去死。"

然而毋庸置疑，他自己就是个做过这种事的人。

o.en: So are you thinking about killing me?

entries.en:
"Yes," Virens pauses, studying you. "I know."

"I have met this man, Bornanew, and I know where he is." He leaves the statement hanging.
entries.zh:
"嗯。" Virens 顿了顿，上下扫了你几眼，"我认识他。"

"我见过这个人，Bornanew，我还知道他在哪里。" 他的话到这里就戛然而止了。

o.en: Will you tell me where he is?
o.zh: 你能不能告诉我他的具体位置？

o.en: Let it hang; he knows what you want
o.zh: 那就停在这儿；他知道你想问什么的

entries.en:
"He did, however, tell me why he was sent here. And by who." Virens looks for your reaction.

"I would not wish to direct you to him if your intentions were... unkind."
entries.zh:
"然而他确实和我说过来这里的缘由。包括谁让他来的。" Virens 看了你一眼。

"如果你是抱着...恶意的话，我不打算透露他的行踪。"

o.en: Archcurate Jaspis wants him back. To serve her. To serve the Church.
o.zh: 大祭司 Jaspis 想让他回去为她服务。为教会服务。

o.en: Whatever his mission was, it's over. The archcurate is... worried about him.
o.zh: 无论他的任务是什么，都不该继续了。大祭司很...担心他。

o.en: Well, I don't get paid if I don't return with him. Or his body.
o.zh: 我带不回他就拿不到钱。他的尸首也能凑合。

entries.en:
With a small, amused nod Virens acknowledges that you've left the gap in conversation for him, not you, to fill.

"I feel that I have some responsibility to Bornanew, you see." Virens flicks a nonexistent speck from his teacup. "Not for him in particular, but for courtesy, shall we say. My meeting with him was brief, and we have had no business or acquaintance since."
entries.zh:
对于你把刚才话题的停顿交给他来衔接这个举动，Virens 显然被逗乐了，他朝你轻轻点了点头表示认可。

"我觉得我对 Bornanew 负有一定的责任，你明白吧。" Virens 弹掉了他杯子上不存在的茶渣，"当然不是对他特殊照顾，不如说是，职业操守。我和他只有一面之缘，之后就再也没有事业或感情上的交集了。"

entries.en:
"I may," says Virens.

"I feel that I have some responsibility to Bornanew." He flicks a nonexistent speck from his teacup. "Not for any particular loyalty. For the general principle. My meeting with Bornanew was brief, and we have had no business or acquaintance since."
entries.zh:
"我是可以告诉你。" Virens 说道，

"但我觉得我对 Bornanew 负有一定的责任。" Virens 弹掉了他杯子上不存在的茶渣，"当然不是出于忠诚，而是职业操守。我和他只有一面之缘，之后就再也没有事业或感情上的交集了。"

entries.en:
Virens' mouth draws a thin line. "He is... was... not a polite man, nor pleasant. Driven, however. Quite driven."

Virens looks thoughtfully at his tea like something is wrong with it, something ineffable.
entries.zh:
Virens 的嘴勾勒出一道曲线。"他不...曾...不是一个有礼貌，或是令人愉快的人。但他很执着，非常的执着。"

Virens 若有所思的看着他的茶，似乎有什么难以言喻的问题。

entries.en: He nods, and says "He is not a polite man, nor pleasant. Driven, however. Quite driven."
entries.zh: 他点头并说道："他不是一个有礼貌，或是令人愉快的人。但他很执着，非常的执着。"

entries.en: "Sedge shot the man who set up the meeting in front of you."
entries.zh: "Sedge 在你面前射杀了那个安排会面的人。"

entries.en: "I am told that Sedge became... agitated. He was quick to anger, and quick to demonstrate that anger."
entries.zh: "我被告知 Sedge 变得...非常焦躁不安。他变得非常易怒，并急切地想要发泄这股怒火。"

entries.en: "I knew Sedge to be crude, and to be cruel."
entries.zh: "我知道 Sedge 为人粗鲁，同时也很残忍。"

entries.en: Virens looks thoughtfully at his tea like something is wrong with it, something ineffable.
entries.zh: Virens 若有所思的看着他的茶，似乎有什么难以言喻的问题。

entries.en:
This he didn't expect. He looks at you, searching, now.

"I know of him," he says. "I would not say I know him. If you are looking for him, I will not be of much use. We... follow different Paths."
entries.zh:
这是他始料未及的。他现在正看着你，寻找着什么。

"我知道他。" 他说道，"但我不敢说我认识他。如果你在找他，我帮不上什么忙。我们...遵循着不同的道途。"

entries.en:
Virens shrugs awkwardly, the cuffs restraining his movement.

"As I said, Livewell Cotton is no associate of mine, nor am I a packet-carrier. I have ways of sending him messages, and I can do so if that is what you demand."
entries.zh:
Virens 尴尬地耸耸肩，手铐限制了他的行动。

"我说过，Livewell Cotton 不是我的同伙，我也不是什么信使。我有办法向他传递消息，如果你有需要，我可以这么做。"

entries.en:
Virens shrugs.

"As I said, Livewell Cotton is no associate of mine. Nor am I a packet-carrier. I do have ways of sending him messages, and I can do so if that is what you demand."
entries.zh:
Virens 耸耸肩。

"我说过，Livewell Cotton 不是我的同伙，我也不是什么信使。我确实有办法向他传递消息，如果你有需要，我可以这么做。"

entries.en: "It shall bring me great pleasure to do so," Virens says, the bilious undercurrent impossible to miss, "upon my return to what is left of my home."
entries.zh: "我很乐意这么做。" Virens 说道，那尖刻的潜台词根本无法忽视，"等我回到我那残破的家园之后。"

entries.en:
More than anything, Nile Virens looks tired. Not surprised; he seems to have been expecting you. But tired.

His fine suit, hand sewn from the looks of it, is ripped and dirty. A medic has applied some derm patches; you've already been briefed on his status. Minor lacerations, contusions; nothing serious.
entries.zh:
无论如何，Nile Virens 看起来很累。他的表情除了疲惫丝毫不显得意外，显然他已经猜到你要来见他了。

他手工定制的精致制服已经破破烂烂，满是污渍。医疗兵给他上了几个皮肤贴片；在你进来之前就被告知了他的状况：一些小的切口和瘀伤而已，没什么大碍。

entries.en: You leave the brig and return to your command center.
entries.zh: 你离开了禁闭室，回到指挥中心

entries.en:
You oversee the raid from your bridge, your $shipOrFleet providing EW cover and sporadic fire support for the breaching drones and marine shuttles.

The raid hinges on mere minutes of chaos, comms throughout the hemisphere crackling with static and only tightbeam relays able to pierce the rain of EM scatter amid clouds of chaff and disruption. Casualty reports roll in, displays on your bridge bleeding to fill the space with a bloody glow.

In the confusion, more than one team reports success. This can be sorted out later. As quickly as they landed, your forces perform an orderly withdrawal, laying covering fire while hauling casualties and prisoners.
entries.zh:
你在舰桥上监督本次劫掠行动，你的$shipOrFleet正在为入侵的无人机和陆战队穿梭机提供电子战掩护和零星的火力支援。

劫掠的成败将在几分钟的混乱中决定，整个半球的通信频道都充斥着静电杂音；在杂波与干扰信号形成的云层中，唯有定向中继器能穿透这股电磁风暴。伤亡报告不断传来，舰桥显示屏上的数据泛红，将整个舱室都笼罩在一片血色光晕之中。

在混乱中，不止一个小组报告他们成功了。这些信息可以稍后再处理。你们在陆战队着陆后迅速有序撤离，一边掩护射击，一边运送伤员和俘虏。

entries.en:
Multiple prisoners have been taken and returned to your $shipOrFleet. None matches the admittedly crude biometric data you have on Jethro Bornanew.

Nile Virens himself, however, awaits you in a cell.
entries.zh:
数个俘虏被带到了你的$shipOrFleet上，他们中没有哪个和你手上的 Jethro Bornanew 的简陋生物信息吻合。

而 Nile Virens 本人正在囚禁室中等你。

entries.en:
A quiet minute passes while some tea is retrieved. Virens stares at you, and you at him.

The guard sets a pot, and two cups down. Virens lifts his hands - bound in a restraint cuff - to the table.
entries.zh:
Virens 和你相视无言，在取茶的这段时间里安静地等着。

卫兵摆好了一个茶壶和两个杯子。Virens 把他的手 —— 还有上面的手铐 —— 放上了桌子。

entries.en:
He smirks wearily.

"Yes," he says, "I can see that all too well, Captain $playerName. You appear to believe that I have him stashed away somewhere."
entries.zh:
他露出了一个疲惫的假笑。

"没错。" 他说道，"简直是一目了然，$playerName 舰长。你似乎是觉得我把他藏哪了。"

entries.en:
"I believe I can answer your questions," Virens says, "If you would allow me to explain the situation."

He clears his throat, ending in an uncomfortable cough, then begins. "Bornanew came to this world asking about the Luddic Path. He had asked similar questions on Chalcedon."
entries.zh:
"我相信我能回答你的问题。" Virens 说，"如果你允许我解释一下情况的话。"

他清了清嗓子，不舒服地咳嗽了一声，然后开始说道：" Bornanew 来到这个世界，询问有关 卢德左径 的事情。他在 Chalcedon 也问过类似的问题。"

entries.en: He raises an eyebrow. "Yes. He met with Sedge. I did not know this when he came here, but it was soon confirmed by my people."
entries.zh: 他挑了挑眉。"是的，他见过 Sedge。他来的时候我还不知道，但很快就被我的人证实了。"

entries.en:
He raises an eyebrow. "Yes. He met with Sedge. The man you shot in the back, in a teahouse catering to spacers."

Virens doesn't seem to infuse his last words with any particular judgment.
entries.zh:
他挑了挑眉道："是的，他和 Sedge 见了面。就是在那家为宇宙民开的茶馆里，被你开枪打中后背的那个人。"

Virens 似乎并没有在最后一句话中掺杂特别的意见。

entries.en:
He raises an eyebrow. "Yes. He met with Sedge. The man you... saw dead in the alley behind a teahouse catering to spacers."

Virens doesn't seem to infuse his last words with any particular judgment.
entries.zh:
他挑了挑眉道："是的，他和 Sedge 见了面。你见过的，就是那个...死在为宇宙民开的茶馆后面巷子里的那个人。"

Virens 似乎并没有在最后一句话中掺杂特别的意见。

entries.en: "I invited Bornanew for tea." He pauses, "You could learn much from the hospitality of the Luddic Faithful."
entries.zh: "我邀请 Bornanew 来喝过茶。" 他顿了顿，"你可以多学学卢德信徒的好客。"

entries.en: "I invited Bornanew for tea." He pauses, "My hospitality was not quite like yours. We do things differently among the Faithful."
entries.zh: "我邀请 Bornanew 来喝过茶。" 他顿了顿，"我这里的招待与你的不同，信徒之间的规矩是不一样的。"

entries.en: "I invited Bornanew for tea." He pauses, "Much like you have invited me, though I must confess that my 'invitation' was gentler by far."
entries.zh: "我邀请 Bornanew 来喝过茶。" 他顿了顿，"就像你邀请我一样，但是我得承认我的 '邀请' 要温柔得多。"

entries.en: "Anyway; we spoke. He told me why he came to Mazalot - the real reason - and who sent him." He gives you a moment to take that in. "I did not offer him employment in any respect. Nor, as it happens, did he want it."
entries.zh: "不管怎样，我们谈过了。他告诉了我他为什么来到了 Mazalot —— 他真正的目的 —— 还有谁派他来的。" 他给了你一点时间来理解。"我并没有给他任何活计。碰巧的是，他也没有开口要。"

entries.en: "We come now to the crux of our dealing, captain. I know where Bornanew went next. I am willing to tell you, provided you give me my freedom."
entries.zh: "舰长，这就是我们之间交易的关键。我知道 Bornanew 下一步要去哪。只要你放我走，我会非常乐意告诉你的。"

o.zh: 很好，用 Bornanew 换取你的自由。 (说实话)
很好，用 Bornanew 换取你的自由。 (说谎)

entries.en: He simply stares at you as if this isn't worth a response.
entries.zh: 他只是看着你，仿佛这不值得他开口。

entries.en: He crosses his arms. "I am no use to my people dead."
entries.zh: 他双手抱胸，说道："我死了对我的人民没好处。"

entries.en:
He takes the datapad and manipulates the digital map with skill born of familiarity.

After but a moment, he pushes the datapad back across the table to you. A marker has been set on a blur outside of a minor settlement in the southern hemisphere; some homestead. The Luddic settlers did not see fit to submit their names to the Mazalot Unification Authority's survey, so it is named only by a code assigned by a software interpreter.

"That is where he went after we spoke. My watchers in the transport hub have not seen him leave the municipality," he shrugs at this; there are other modes of transport, of course.

"You should speak with Bornanew."
entries.zh:
他接过了数据平板，随后熟练地操作起了数字地图。

片刻之后，他把数据平板推给了桌对面的你。标记落在了南半球一个小聚落旁的模糊地区上；是一座家宅。当地的卢德住民没把名字写进 Mazalot 统一政权的调查里，所以这一块只用了一串软件助手生成的代码表示。

"我们谈过后，他就去了这里。我安排在交通枢纽的监视员从没见到他离开过这个市区。" 对此他嗤之以鼻；显然还有很多其他的移动方式。

"你去和 Bornanew 聊聊吧。"

o.en: Guard, take Virens to a shuttle.
o.zh: 卫兵，送 Virens 去穿梭机。

o.en: For a Pather, you turn remarkably easily.
o.zh: 对于一个左径分子来说，你反水的也太快了。

entries.en: In response, Virens drops his cuffed hands on the table with a clunk. He looks to you expectantly.
entries.zh: 听到你这么说后，Virens 哒的一声把铐着的手放在了桌子上，满怀期待地看着你。

entries.en:
He nods slowly, watching your face.

He rubs his bruised wrists. "I don't know the coordinates by heart. I shall need a datapad and a standard map of Mazalot."
entries.zh:
他看着你的脸慢慢地点了点头。

他揉着瘀伤的手腕，说道："我没法精准地把坐标报出来，给我一个数据平板，还有一张 Mazalot 的标准地图。"

o.zh: 拿出你的私人数据平板

entries.en:
Virens is escorted to a shuttle with orders that he be released on the landing pad of wherever they happen to end up. He can figure it out from there; you're certain of it.

You return to your command center.
entries.zh:
Virens 被押送至一架穿梭机，你下令到达停机坪后就将他释放。你确信他会有办法离开的。

你回到了你的指挥中心。

entries.en: You tell him he'll go free, and he is a fool to trust you.
entries.zh: 你告诉他他能获得自由，而蠢到信你就是他的问题了。

entries.en: "Wait!" Virens tries to stand, "We had a deal."
entries.zh: "等等！" Virens 挣扎着企图站起来，"我们的交易...！"

o.en: You're going free... into the custody of the MUA. Guard, take Virens to a shuttle.
o.zh: 你可以走...但首先得去一趟 MUA。卫兵，带 Virens 上穿梭机。

entries.en:
He sees your weapon and relaxes. Like he understands what you're doing, and accepts it.

It's over in a moment.
entries.zh:
他见你举起了武器，反而放松了下来。看来他知道你打算做什么，也坦然接受了。

这没花多久。

entries.en: He looks confused for a moment, and then suppresses a smile.
entries.zh: 他一时看起来有些困惑，接着忍住了上翘的嘴角。

entries.en:
"I apologize, captain. I should not make light of your mercy."

He pauses, then "But as your guest... the MUA cannot charge me, and cannot hold me. It would cause such chaos. They will release me."

"But it doesn't end there."
entries.zh:
"真抱歉，舰长。我不该怠慢您的仁慈。"

他顿了一下，然后说道："但作为您的客人...MUA 关不住我，也没法给我定罪。那会引起大乱子的。他们会放了我。"

"不但如此。"

entries.en:
"I apologize, captain. I should not make light of your mercy."

He clears his throat, "It is a strange Path that I have been given. That is all."
entries.zh:
"真抱歉，舰长。我不该轻视您的仁慈。"

他清了清嗓子道："只是，我真是被给予了一条怪异的道途。"

entries.en:
"I will thank them for their mercy; they will extend the hand of compromise. You'll be the great enemy, they the peacemakers."

He looks apologetic, "It won't happen for sure, but when Providence provides, those who truly love God leap to seize it. By the end of this, it is I who might be thanking you."
entries.zh:
"我会感谢他们的善意；然后他们就会提出妥协的方案。你会成为当头大敌，他们会成为和平使者。"

他看起来满脸歉意，"虽然这并不万无一失，但在上天施恩之时，真正敬神之人会迫不及待地抓住这个机会。最终，该谢谢你的就是我了。"

entries.en: It might be useful to have a Pather that understands both your power and your mercy.
entries.zh: 一个同时了解你的能力与仁慈的左径分子也许很有价值。

o.en: Guard, take Virens to a shuttle.
o.zh: 卫兵，送 Virens 去穿梭机。

o.en: For a Pather, you turn remarkably easily.
o.zh: 对于一个左径分子来说，你反水的也太快了。

o.en: You're going free... into the custody of the MUA. Guard, take Virens to a shuttle.
o.zh: 你可以走...但首先得去一趟 MUA。卫兵，带 Virens 上穿梭机。

o.en: No. Draw your sidearm and shoot him.
o.zh: 算了。拔出随身武器射杀他。

entries.en:
Virens is escorted to a shuttle with orders that he handed over to the highest ranking officer of the MUA that can be found. He'll be their problem now.

You return to your command center.
entries.zh:
Virens 被押送到穿梭机上，你下令将他移送给 MUA 中能找到的最高级别长官。怎么处理他现在是 MUA 的事情了。

你返回了指挥中心。

entries.en: He sighs impatiently. "Your vision is narrow, I'm afraid. And I shall not be the man to correct it."
entries.zh: 他烦躁地叹了口气。"恐怕是你的眼界太窄了。不过我也不想纠正你。"

entries.en:
"I see no need to perform for you, captain."

He sighs, "You want Jethro Bornanew, I want to return to my home. Let us speak of business."
entries.zh:
"我觉得没必要在你面前演戏，舰长。"

他叹息道："你想要 Jethro Bornanew，而我想回家。让我们谈谈正事吧。"

o.en: Who told you I'm looking for Jethro Bornanew.
o.zh: 是谁告诉你我在找 Jethro Bornanew 的。

o.en: Guard, get this man some tea.
It looks like I just walked all over your 'path', huh.
o.zh: 看来我刚刚把你的 '道途' 给踏了个平，嗯？

o.en: So you're not going to call me a servant of Moloch? Spawn of Mammon?
o.zh: 不打算叫我恶魔摩洛克的仆人？玛门的宠儿？

o.en: You don't sound like much of a Pather.
o.zh: 你的谈吐倒不像个左径分子。

o.en: I need to speak with Brother Cotton. To give him a message.
o.zh: 我得和 Cotton 修士聊聊。有条消息要告诉他。

o.en: Send him a message. Tell him I need to meet with him.
o.zh: 给他带个话，就说我要见他。

entries.en:
You convene your senior officers to discuss an extraction scenario for Jethro Bornanew, presumably employed or taken hostage by Nile Virens.

It is impossible to completely avoid the MUA's defense network, although even cursory scans show that it is deployed to counter internal uprisings rather than external raids. Persean League casualties can be minimized, but certain sensor stations and defensive batteries will have to be disabled to open the way for a clean assault on Virens' bases.

The Pathers are another problem entirely: separate infiltration squads must simultaneously breach secure compounds located in densely populated settlements. Casual use of heavy weaponry among civilians would attract unwanted interference both in the immediate operation and your future activities. You must strike everywhere swiftly, unerringly, and with a light touch.
entries.zh:
你召集上级军官商议营救 Jethro Bornanew 的方案，目标此时应该是被 Nile Virens 雇佣或囚禁了。

想要完全避开 MUA 的防御系统是毫无可能的，尽管他们是为了应对内部暴动而非外部劫掠而建成。突袭过程中对英仙座联盟造成的损失可以降至最小，但是为了能直击 Virens 的据点，一些侦察站和防御炮台依旧需要处理掉。

左径分子则完全是另一个问题：潜入小队们必须同时进攻人口密集的聚落中戒备森严的几座建筑。在人群中随意使用重型武器不但会立刻引来阻碍，还会对你未来的活动造成影响。你必须迅捷，精准，还要谨慎地打击每一个地区。

entries.en:
You pour tea in the two cups.

"Blessed peace upon us," Virens says, his voice thick with irony. "I accept your hospitality, and the welcome of your home."
entries.zh:
你在两个杯子里倒上了茶。

"愿和平赐福我们。" Virens 说道，声音里满满的都是讽刺，"我接受您的款待，以及您家园的欢迎。"

entries.en:
He lifts his cuffed hands to awkwardly pour tea in the two cups, one after the other.

"Blessed peace upon us," Virens says, his voice thick with irony. "I offer my hospitality, and the welcome of my home: Mazalot, world of dust."
entries.zh:
他用被禁锢的双手狼狈地把茶杯一盏一盏地倒满。

"愿和平赐福我们。" Virens 说道，声音里满满的都是讽刺，"我为您呈上我的热情，还有来自废墟之世 Mazalot 的欢迎。"

entries.en:
He lifts his injured hands to pour tea in the two cups, one after the other. He spills only a little.

"Blessed peace upon us," Virens says, his voice thick with irony. "I offer my hospitality, and the welcome of my home: Mazalot, world of dust."
entries.zh:
他用受伤的双手狼狈地把茶杯一盏一盏地倒满，过程中只洒出了少许。

"愿和平赐福我们。" Virens 说道，声音里满满的都是讽刺，"我为您呈上我的热情，还有来自废墟之世 Mazalot 的欢迎。"

entries.en:
The guard moves to Virens, holds the cuffs, and gives a nod to the guard watching through the surveillance feed. A remote command unlocks the cuffs. The guard pulls the cuffs away. Virens wrists are deeply bruised.

He rubs them, eyes still fixed on you.
entries.zh:
警卫走到 Virens 的身边，握住手铐，并通过监控画面向正在另一侧观察的警卫点头示意。一个遥控指令打开了手铐。警卫把手铐拉开。Virens 的手腕伤痕累累。

他揉着手腕，眼睛仍然盯着你。

entries.en: He uses the cuffs to shove one teacup toward you, and takes the other in his hands and lifts it, a splash escaping onto the table.
entries.zh: 他用手铐把一只茶杯推向你，然后用手捧起另一只茶杯，溅起的茶水落到了桌子上。

entries.en: He blows on the tea and takes a sip.
entries.zh: 他吹了吹茶，然后抿了一口。

entries.en:
The tea is very hot, and not very good. Some concoction of genmod yeasts grown in a vat spinning around some Persean world or other.

Virens matches your action and shows no sign of noticing the quality of the tea.
entries.zh:
茶很烫，而且味道很一般。它是用一种产自绕着某个英仙座星域世界还是哪转的工业大桶里的基因改造酵母调制的。

Virens 和你一样端起了杯子，对茶的质量没任何表态。

entries.en: Virens picks up his teacup. His grip is unsteady, and he splashes some tea onto his hand and the table.
entries.zh: Virens 拿起茶杯。他的手握不稳，茶水溅到了手上和桌子上。

entries.en: "No."

He smirks, though his eyes remain fixed on yours with... yes, that looks like rage long-suppressed, held in a little ball; a spark to light fires for years and years.

"Captain $playerName. I can see that you are not unaccustomed to the use of force. I am not so young a man as I was and have found I have little patience for theater when it comes to matters of... business."

"You want Jethro Bornanew. You believe that I have him working for me, or I've kidnapped him for some purpose."
entries.zh:
他笑了，尽管他的眼睛仍然紧紧盯着你的眼睛...是的，那看起来像是压抑已久的愤怒，被压缩在一个小球里；一个常年以来等待燎原的火种。

"$PlayerName舰长。我看得出，你并非不习惯使用武力。我已经不再像以前那么年轻了，我发现在...公事上，我已经没有什么耐心去演戏了。"

"你想要 Jethro Bornanew 。你认为他为我工作，或者我出于某种目的绑架了他。"

entries.en:
Virens closes his eyes for a long moment, like this is making him even more tired.

"You. You did. You asked everyone on Mazalot where to find Jethro Bornanew."

He opens his eyes again. "When the captain of an independent $shipOrFleet comes to Mazalot and asks for someone, I hear of it. Especially after they've done the same thing on Chalcedon."
entries.zh:
Virens 闭上了他的眼睛，好一会都没说话，仿佛这个问题让他觉得更累了。

"是你。你自己告诉了我。你在 Mazalot 上问遍了 Jethro Bornanew 在哪。"

他再次睁开了双眼。"如果有一个 非势力团体 的$shipOrFleet舰长跑到 Mazalot 来找人，我肯定会知道的。尤其是你之前还在 Chalcedon 上做过相同的事。"

entries.en: Virens acknowledges your act with a nod, and raises his cup to you before sipping some tea.
entries.zh: Virens 点头认可了你的举动，向你举杯致意后喝了些茶。

entries.en:
"Blessed peace upon you," the man says, turning toward you. "I am Nile Virens. I invite you to sit with me."

A finely-carved table is set with a tea set, simple in form and painted with delicate natural motifs.
entries.zh:
"愿和平赐福于你。" 男人转向你说道，"我是 Nile Virens。请与我同坐。"

精雕细琢的桌子上摆放着茶具，造型简洁，绘有精致的自然风景。

entries.en:
You are gaining a sense for the quality of tea by the scent hanging in the air after boiling water is freshly poured.

This is a fine blend.
entries.zh:
沸水倾入后，空气中弥漫的香气在不经意间就向你透露出了茶的品质。

这可是上好的拼配茶。

entries.en:
With all this dealing with Luddics, you realize that you're starting to develop a sense for the quality of tea by the scent hanging in the air after boiling water is freshly poured.

This is the good stuff.
entries.zh:
与卢德信徒打交道之后，你意识到，自己似乎开始能通过开水刚冲下时空气中弥漫的香气来判断茶叶的品质了。

这可是好东西。

entries.en:
You sit, and Virens pours two cups, then motions for you to choose your pick of the two.

After you do, he holds the cup up for a moment and inhales the steam.
entries.zh:
你坐了下来，Virens 倒了两杯茶，示意你从中拿一杯。

你拿了，他举起另一杯茶，缓缓吸入蒸汽。

entries.en:
A frown begins in his brow but fails to materialize on his mouth.

"I respect that you shall do as you wish, $playerSirOrMadam," he says, and pours a cup for himself. "My invitation stands, and you have my hospitality regardless."
entries.zh:
他眉头微皱，但这丝不悦最终没有表现在嘴角。

"我尊重你行自己所愿之事的权利，$playerSirOrMadam，" 他说道，一边为自己倒了杯茶，"我的邀请仍然有效，无论如何，你都将受到我的款待。"

o.en: I don't negotiate with terrorists. My fleet is in orbit.
o.zh: 我懒得和恐怖分子讨价还价。我的舰队就在轨道上。

o.en: I have a battalion of marines in orbit. Make this easy on yourself.
o.zh: 我有一整个营的陆战队大军在轨道上。劝你别自找麻烦。

entries.en:
Virens leans back, rubbing his chin.

"Captain," he begins, "Whatever you make of my home, this settlement... Mazalot is a polity of the Persean League. Their fleets will hound you to the ends of the Persean Sector."

"I say this to make sure, very very sure, you know what you are threatening to do. So you will see why it is not necessary."
entries.zh:
Virens 向后靠了靠，揉着他的下巴。

"舰长啊。" 他出声道，"不管你觉得我的家园是个什么样的地方，这个聚落... Mazalot 依旧是 英仙座联盟 的政体之一。他们的舰队会追杀你到 英仙座星域 的每个角落。"

"我说这些只是想彻底，彻彻底底地确认，你真的知道你威胁要做的是什么事情。因为这样你便会明白这根本是没有必要的事情。"

entries.en: "Because I think you should speak with Bornanew yourself," he says. "I shall have my man give you the coordinates."
entries.zh: "因为我觉得你确实该和 Bornanew 亲自谈谈。" 他说道，"我这就让我的人给你坐标。"

entries.en:
"If I didn't bring you in now, it seems you'd ask everyone in the system about Jethro Bornanew, about the Luddic Path, and ultimately, about me."

"You are blessedly persistent," he smiles indulgently. "Dangerously persistent, if left to your devices, I suspect. Others would ask why you're asking. The MUA would ask why you're asking. Too much of this asking, asking, asking. It upsets delicate things."

As he speaks, he reaches out and almost, but not quite, touches the fine teapot. He seems to realize what he is doing and pulls back.
entries.zh:
"如果现在我没带你进来，你好像就会问星系中的每个人关于 Jethro Bornanew 的事，还有卢德左径，最后，再问到我。"

"神赐予你毅力。" 他宽容地笑道，"我猜如果让你自行行动的话，这毅力会变得危险起来。其他人会问你为什么要问，MUA 也会问你为什么要问。太多的问题、问题、问题。这会增添许多琐事。"

他一边说话一边伸出手。在马上触碰到那只精致茶壶的时候，他似乎意识到自己的行为，随即把手收了回来。

entries.en:
Virens meets your eyes, "Though you are my guest here, and perhaps because you are my guest, I feel that I must demand an answer from you."

"So I ask you this, $playerName. Why did you kill him?"
entries.zh:
Virens 注视着你的双眼，"即使你是我的客人，也许也正因为这样，我必须要求你给我一个说法。"

"所以我问你，$playerName，你为什么杀了他？"

entries.en: You need Virens to cooperate. Perhaps a lie will help...
entries.zh: 你需要 Virens 的合作，也许谎言会起效...

entries.en: Virens is a perceptive and cultured man. The truth will serve.
entries.zh: Virens 是个敏锐而有修养的人，实话实说才是上策。

entries.en: "There are 198 of us remaining, captain."
entries.zh: "舰长，我们还剩 198 个人。"

entries.en:
"There are 198 of us remaining, captain."

The $manOrWoman looks up, hopefully. "Some of us have spacefaring experience and, and other useful trades. We could work as crew during the journey back to the core worlds. If it helps."
entries.zh:
"舰长，我们还剩 198 个人。"

这个$manOrWoman充满希望地抬起头。"我们中有些人有太空航行和其他有用技艺的经验。如果能帮得上您，我们可以在返回 核心世界 的路程上作为船员替您工作。"

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet has $player.crewRoomStr spare crew berths. This would be sufficient to transport this lost sect.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet有 $player.crewRoomStr 额外船员宿舍空间。这足以运送这一迷途的教派。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet has $player.crewRoomStr spare crew berths. There is not enough room to transport the lost sect.

Seeing your hesitation, $heOrShe adds, "The ship that brought us to this place, it's... we stripped it for supplies, but we've seen the hull in orbit. Or so we believe."
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet有 $player.crewRoomStr 额外船员宿舍空间。这不足以运送这一迷途的教派。

看到你的犹豫，$heOrShe补充道。"送我们来此地的那艘舰船...虽然我们为了寻求补给把它清空了，但是我们相信船体应该还在轨道上。"

entries.en:
"We, um. Our former... the false prophet, he said we must be rid of the sin of Mammon before our exodus." $HeOrShe looks down, abashed, "Perhaps we acted with unreasonable haste when we gave up all of our credits."

The $manOrWoman looks up, hopefully. "Some of us have spacefaring experience and useful trades. We could work as crew during the journey back to the core worlds. If it helps."
entries.zh:
"我们，呃，我们以前的...假先知，他说我们必须在离开前摆脱恶魔玛门的罪孽。" $HeOrShe羞愧地低头说，"也许我们放弃所有星币的举动过于草率了。"

这个$manOrWoman充满希望地抬起头来。"我们中的有人具有航天和其他派得上用场的行业经验。我们可以在返回核心世界的旅程中担任船员。如果您用得上的话。"
