entries.en:
"We were followers of, a, a..."

Realizing that $heOrShe is falling over $hisOrHer words, $heOrShe takes a moment to collect $himOrHerself, and begins again.

"We believed a new revelation had been given, like that revealed unto Ludd. Our false prophet claimed to hear a choir of angels, and the song told him that a great cleansing would fall upon the Sector. A war between angels and demons to end the world. Any who did not follow our exodus would be destroyed by the wrath of God."
entries.zh:
"我们在追随着他，他..."

意识到自己语无伦次，$heOrShe稍作停顿，整理思绪后继续说道。

"我们相信神已经向我们给予了新的启示，就像卢德那次一样。我们的伪先知声称听到了天使的合唱，歌声告诉他，一场大灭绝将降临这个星域。天使与恶魔之间的战争将摧毁这个世界。任何不追随我们迁移的人都将因神的愤怒而被毁灭。"

entries.en:
"So we followed him, a handful of hundreds, to this place."

"Though this world is rich, it was not... it is no paradise. And the demands of our false prophet became... bizarre. Unreasonable. Impious. He grew wroth at any questioning, claiming the angels commanded him, and then. Um."

"There was an accident." $PersonRank $PersonName looks aside, avoiding the gaze of the comms, "He is... I pray that his restless spirit might find a peace now which it did not know in life."
entries.zh:
"于是我们跟随他，统共几百人来到这个地方。"

"虽然这个新世界很富裕。但它不是...它不是天堂。我们伪先知的要求变得愈来愈...古怪。不合理。不虔诚。他不容许任何质疑，声称是天使给予了他启示，然后...嗯。"

"发生了一起事故。" $PersonRank $PersonName 看向一边，避开通讯设备的摄像头，"他...我祈祷他不安的灵魂现在能找到生前从未有过的安宁。"

o.en: What are you doing out on the fringe?
o.zh: 你们到边缘星区干什么？

entries.en:
"-llo? Oh, oh blessings of Ludd! Thank Providence you're receiving! We are a community of, of faithful settlers who were... led astray from the true Church of Galactic Redemption."

$HeOrShe clasps $hisOrHer hands together. "We wish now to repent, and to return, and beg the holy Church for forgiveness."
entries.zh:
"...你好？哦，哦，卢德赐福啊！感谢上天，你收到了信号！我们团体都是由... 偏离了银河救赎教会正途的虔诚定居者组成的。"

$HeOrShe双手合十。"现在我们只希望能够忏悔，还有回归，以及请求圣教会的宽恕。"

entries.en:
With a crackle, the comms sync into a working connection.

"Blessing of Ludd, you have returned!" $PersonRank $personLastName clasps $hisOrHer hands together in thanks.

"This penance we suffer is harsh and hungry, $playerSirOrMadam. We beg of you, will you do us the charity of transporting to a world of the Church so that we may repent our heresy?"
entries.zh:
随着一阵噼啪声，通信同步到了工作链接。

"卢德保佑，你回来了！" $PersonRank $personLastName 将$hisOrHer的双手合十以示感谢。

"我们遭受了如此残酷而饥饿的苦修，$playerSirOrMadam。我们恳求您，能大发善心，把我们带到一个教会的世界上去吗？这样我们就可以为我们的离经叛道而忏悔了。"

entries.en: "An archcurate of the Church approached me. It seems that they require the services of a space captain with experience travelling outside the core worlds..."
entries.zh: "教会的一个大祭司找到我。看上去他需要一个有在核心世界之外探险经验的太空舰长来帮他的忙..."

entries.en: A $locrlf_manOrWoman seems to be examining incoming spacer captains and taking notes on a TriPad poorly hidden in a handweave scarf.
entries.zh: 一个$locrlf_manOrWoman似乎正在评估前来的太空舰长，并用在手织围巾里那个藏得不是很好的 TriPad 记笔记。

entries.en:
"For that, ah, we would be most blessed and thankful to you. We shall pray for forgiveness," $heOrShe says solemnly, "And await the judgment of the Church."

$PersonName looks like $heOrShe badly wants to ask you something, and is considering if $heOrShe should.
entries.zh:
"那件事的话，呃，我们感谢并祝福您。我们会祈祷宽恕，" $heOrShe郑重地说道。"并等待教会的审判。"

$PersonName 看上去正在欲言又止地想要问你什么，但是却又在三思$heOrShe是否该问。

o.en: Know that I follow the Path. It may well lead not where the Church preaches.
o.zh: 我虽行卢德之径，而这条路径所及之处却并不一定如教会所教那般。

o.en: The Church will tend to its flock.
I don't know what the Church intends, if that is what you wanted to ask.
o.zh: 如果你想问的是教会有什么打算，那我也不知道。

entries.en:
"The Church! Yes for that, ah, we would be most blessed and thankful to you. We shall pray for forgiveness," $heOrShe says solemnly, "And await the mercy of the Church."

$PersonName looks like $heOrShe badly wants to ask you something, and is considering if $heOrShe should.
entries.zh:
"教会！那件事的话，呃，我们感谢并祝福您。我们会祈祷宽恕，" $heOrShe郑重地说道。"并等待教会的宽恕。"

$PersonName 看上去正在欲言又止地想要问你什么，但是却又在三思$heOrShe是否该问。

o.zh: 我虽行卢德之径，而这条路径所及之处却并不一定如教会所教那般。

o.en: The Church will tend to its flock.
I don't know what the Church intends, if that is what you wish to ask.
o.zh: 如果你想问的是教会有什么打算，那我也不知道。

entries.en: "Do you know what is intended for us?" $HeOrShe looks at you fearfully, "Will the Knight Inquisitors be sent?"
entries.zh: "您知道我们将会被如何处置吗？" $HeOrShe面露恐惧地看向你。"会有骑士审判官来吗？"

o.en: Know that I follow the Path. It may well lead not where the Church preaches.
o.zh: 我虽行卢德之径，而这条路径所及之处却并不一定如教会所教那般。

o.en: Truly, I don't know what the Church intends.
o.zh: 我真的不知道教会的安排。

o.en: The Church will tend to its flock.
I could only assume so. Heresy is a serious crime.
o.zh: 我也只能如此推测了，异端可确实是重罪。

entries.en: $HeOrShe bows with uneasy acceptance, hands held together.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe双手合十，不安又认命般地鞠了个躬。

entries.en: $HeOrShe bows with fearful acceptance, hands held together. Not quite shaking.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe双手合十，恐惧又认命般地鞠了个躬。但至少还没吓得浑身哆嗦。

entries.en: $HeOrShe bows in acceptance, hands held together.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe双手合十，鞠了个躬接受了这一切。

entries.en: $HeOrShe bows in acceptance, embarrassed that you saw $hisOrHer intent so easily.
entries.zh: 被你轻易看出想法，$HeOrShe羞愧难当，认命般地鞠了个躬。

entries.en: "I... I see, $playerSirOrMadam."
entries.zh: "我... 我明白了，$playerSirOrMadam."

o.en: Leave them for the Church to deal with.
o.zh: 让教会来处理他们的问题吧。

o.en: I shall bring word of you to my contact, to the Church.
o.zh: 我会把你们的消息传达给我的联络人，再带给教会。

o.en: I could bring word of you to my contact, to the Church...
o.zh: 我可以把你们的消息传达给我的联络人，再带给教会...

o.en: An agent of the Church hired me to find you.
o.zh: 一位教会的特工雇佣我来搜寻你们。

entries.en: $HeOrShe gives you the nav coordinates of $locrlf_systemName and hull ID for the heretics' transport, the 'CGR Light of Exultation'.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe给了你 $locrlf_systemName 的导航坐标，以及异端们所乘运输船的舰船 ID，'CGR Light of Exultation'。

entries.en: $HeOrShe gives you the nav coordinates of $locrlf_systemName and hull ID for the heretics' transport, the 'CGR Light of Exultation'.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe给了你 $locrlf_systemName 的导航坐标，以及异端们所乘运输船的舰船 ID，'CGR Light of Exultation'。

entries.en: $locrlf_personName gives you nav coordinates to $locrlf_systemName, $locrlf_hisOrHer comms ID, and the hull ID of the heretics' transport, the 'CGR Light of Exultation'.
entries.zh: $locrlf_personName 给了你 $locrlf_systemName 的导航坐标，$locrlf_hisOrHer的通信 ID，还有异端们所乘运输船的舰船 ID，'CGR Light of Exultation'。

entries.en:
A wave of guilt, quickly suppressed, crosses $hisOrHer face.

"Y-yes, well. It is my place to take a perfectly reasonable broker's fee. Currying talent is honest work, despite what the Ruralist hardliners preach."

$locrlf_HeOrShe taps $locrlf_hisOrHer hand on the bartop impatiently.

"It's just as well, then. You've made your point. Let's make the payment $locrlf_rewardAmountHigher credits, if that's what it takes."
entries.zh:
一股负罪感突然涌上$hisOrHer的脸，然后又被$hisOrHer快速压了下去。

"对...对，没错，我当然有权收笔中介费了，又不是啥没理由的事。不管那帮子农村强硬派怎么念经，讨好人才终究还是个正当工作。"

$locrlf_HeOrShe不耐心的敲击着吧台。

"不过也没差，我也懂你什么意思。你非得多要钱的话，就提到 $locrlf_rewardAmountHigher 星币吧。"

entries.en:
A wave of guilt, quickly suppressed, crosses $hisOrHer face.

"Y-yes, well. It is my place to take a perfectly reasonable broker's fee. Currying talent is honest work, despite what the Ruralist hardliners preach."

$HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer fingers on $hisOrHer comms unit impatiently. "But yes, it's just as well. You've made your point, captain. Let's make the payment $locrlf_rewardAmountHigher credits, if that's what it takes."

$locrlf_HeOrShe不耐心的敲击着通讯器。"不过也没差，我也懂你什么意思，舰长。你非得多要钱的话，就提到 $locrlf_rewardAmountHigher 星币吧。"

o.en: What does the Church need done outside the core worlds?
o.zh: 教会要在核心世界之外干什么？

o.en: Ask if the $locrlf_manOrWoman trying to take secret notes could use some help
o.zh: 询问那个在偷偷做秘密笔记的$locrlf_manOrWoman是否需要帮助

entries.en:
"Oh!" $locrlf_HeOrShe jumps a bit as you speak, then looks you up and down. "Yes, you seem like you would be quite fitting."

"I have," $locrlf_heOrShe drops $locrlf_hisOrHer voice, "a delicate matter to discuss. An archcurate - who I shall not name - made it known to me that a flock of believers was led astray by a heretical self-proclaimed prophet."

$locrlf_HisOrHer eyes are wide with alarm.

"Of course I would imagine this the business of the Knights, and I should be pleased to let their inquisitors deal with heretics as is their wont. But... well, it is not my place to speculate."
entries.zh:
"哦！" $locrlf_HeOrShe听到你的话先是吓了一跳，然后上下打量了你一番。"嗯，你看上去会很适合。"

"我有，"$locrlf_HeOrShe压低声音，"一件微妙的事情想要讨论。一位我不方便透露姓名的大祭司告诉我，有一群信徒被一个妄称先知的异端带上了歧途。"

$locrlf_HisOrHer警觉的瞪大眼睛，"我当然会认为这是骑士团的事，我很乐意让他们的审判官按照惯例处异端。但...好吧，不是我该猜测的事。"

entries.en:
"These heretics pooled money and bought an old transport, then they left for some fringe system to 'begin anew'. Possibly they're all dead. Forgive me; with Ludd, for all that I know. Nonetheless, a non-believing scavenger was the last to spot them, apparently burning toward... a particular system."

$locrlf_HeOrShe reveals $locrlf_hisOrHer cheap datapad.

"Will you find them? For the Church? Find out what came of them. Bring news back to me, and then I will report to, to the archcurate. I've been provided with funds for the operation, $locrlf_rewardAmount credits. They are yours after you bring back conclusive data on the fate of the heretics."
entries.zh:
"这帮异端花了笔钱买了艘旧运输船，启程去某个边缘星系 '重新开始' 。他们多半都死了。噢对不起，卢德在上，我就只知道这些。不管如何，最后目击他们的是一位不信教的拾荒者，他们似乎正向着个特定星系一头扎过去。"

$locrlf_HeOrShe掏出$locrlf_hisOrHer的廉价数据平板。

"你能帮我找到他们不？就当是为了教会？弄明白他们最后怎么样了，把消息带给我，然后我会转告给大祭司 。我手头有批给这次行动的资金，$locrlf_rewardAmount 星币。只要你给我带来这帮异端下场的确凿证据，这笔钱就是你的。"

o.en: The Church is paying more than $locrlf_rewardAmount credits for the job, aren't they.
o.zh: “教会批给你的钱不止 $locrlf_rewardAmount 星币，对吧？”

entries.en:
"Oh!" $locrlf_HeOrShe jumps a bit as you speak. "You again. Have you reconsidered?"

$locrlf_HeOrShe lowers $locrlf_hisOrHer voice, "It is a delicate matter, of course. This archcurate wants this stray flock of heretics found, and for some reason is not relying upon the Knight Inquisitors." $locrlf_HeOrShe sighs, "It is not my business to speculate on the doings of the Church, of course."

"Regardless, the heretics bought a transport and burned out into the fringe. They were last seen by a scavenger who reported the sighting to... well, one of the Faithful, anyway. Now if you find them and return to me with conclusive data on what happened to them, I shall give you the Church's reward of $locrlf_rewardAmount credits."
entries.zh:
"哦！" 听到你的话，$locrlf_HeOrShe吓了一跳，"又是你。你重新考虑过了吗？"

$locrlf_HeOrShe压低声音，"当然，这是个棘手的问题。大祭司希望找到这群迷失的异端，而且，出于某种原因，大祭司不希望骑士审判官出手。" $locrlf_HeOrShe叹了口气，"当然，教会的行动也轮不到我去猜。"

"不管怎样，异端们买了一艘运输船，一头扎进了边缘星区。最后看到他们的是某个拾荒者，拾荒者向...好吧，反正是一个信徒报告了此事。现在，如果你找到他们，并带给我关于他们遭遇的确凿证据，我会给你教会提供的 $locrlf_rewardAmount 星币。"

"哦！" 听到你的话，$locrlf_HeOrShe吓了一跳，"又是你。你重新考虑过了吗？"

$locrlf_HeOrShe压低声音，"当然，这是个棘手的问题。大祭司希望找到这群迷失的异端，而且，出于某种原因，大祭司不希望骑士审判官出手。" $locrlf_HeOrShe叹了口气，"当然，教会 的行动也轮不到我去猜。"

"不管怎样，异端们买了一艘运输船，一头扎进了边缘星区。最后看到他们的是某个拾荒者，拾荒者向...好吧，反正是一个信徒报告了此事。现在，如果你找到他们，并带给我关于他们遭遇的确凿证据，我会给你教会提供的 $locrlf_rewardAmountHigher 星币。"

entries.en:
"As I said, I was approached by an archcurate. I shall not name them, by their request, but it was made known to me that a flock of believers has been led astray by a false and heretical self-proclaimed prophet."

"I know," $heOrShe sighs. "I too would imagine this the business of the Knights of Ludd, and I would be pleased to let their inquisitors deal with heretics as is their wont. But for some reason the Church wants to handle this on their own and it is not my place to speculate why that may be."
entries.zh:
"我说过，有个大祭司找到了我 —— 应大祭司本人要求，姓名不便透露。但我从大祭司那里得知，有位异端妄称先知，将一群信徒带上了歧途。"

"我知道。" $heOrShe叹了口气，"我也想过，这件事本该卢德骑士团出手，我也愿意让他们的审判官按照惯例处置异端。但不知为啥教会想自己处理这件事，具体什么原因就轮不到我来猜了。"

entries.en:
"These false-believers, heretics, pooled money and bought an old transport, then left for some fringe system to 'begin anew', whatever that means. Possibly they're all dead - forgive me, or with Ludd for all that I know. Nonetheless, a non-believing scavenger was the last to spot them burning toward a particular system."

"Will you find them? For the Church?"

"Discover what came of them. Bring news back to me, and then I will report to the archcurate. I've been provided with funds for the operation, $locrlf_rewardAmount credits. It's yours after you bring back news of the heretics."
entries.zh:
"这帮伪信徒，异端，花了笔钱买了艘旧运输船，启程去某个边缘星系 '重新开始'，也不知他们这么说到底是什么意思。他们多半都死了。噢对不起，卢德在上，我就只知道这些。不管如何，他们最后的目击者是一位不信教的拾荒者，他们似乎正向着个特定星系一头扎过去。"

"你能找到他们吗？就当是为了教会？"

 "弄明白他们最后怎么样了，把消息带给我，然后我会转告给大祭司。我手头有批给这次行动的资金，$locrlf_rewardAmount 星币 。只要你带来这帮异端的消息，这笔钱就是你的了。"

o.en: The Church is giving you more than $locrlf_rewardAmount credits for the job, aren't they.
o.zh: “教会批给你的钱不止 $locrlf_rewardAmount 星币，对吧？”

o.en: I found the missing heretics. They're all dead. (lie)
o.zh: 我找到迷失的异端了，他们都死了。 (说谎)

entries.en: Now, of course, there's the matter of the heretics.
entries.zh: 当然，现在就轮到异端的问题了。

o.en: Also, the heretics are on board my $shipOrFleet. I intend to return them to the Church.
o.zh: 还有就是，我的$shipOrFleet也把异端载回来了，我准备把他们送回教会。

entries.en: Now, of course, there's the matter of the heretics.
entries.zh: 当然，现在就轮到异端的问题了。

o.en: Also, the heretics are on board my $shipOrFleet. I intend to take them to a world of the Luddic Path.
o.zh: 还有就是，我的$shipOrFleet也把异端载回来了，我准备把他们送去 卢德左径 治下的世界。

entries.en: Now, of course, there's the matter of the former heretics.
entries.zh: 当然，现在就轮到前异端的问题了。

o.en: The repentant heretics are on board my $shipOrFleet. I intend to return them to the Church.
o.zh: 我的$shipOrFleet把忏悔过的异端载回来了，我准备把他们送回教会。

entries.en: $PersonName nods along as you explain how you found the heretics, not looking particularly interested.
entries.zh: 你向 $PersonName 解释着你找到这帮异端的过程，$HeOrShe一边听着一边点着头，看来也没有多感兴趣。

entries.en: "Thank you, $playerSirOrMadam," $heOrShe says. "I shall bring the archcurate your report posthaste. Please accept your reward, as promised."
entries.zh: "谢谢你，$playerSirOrMadam。" $heOrShe感谢道："我会尽快把你的报告传达给大祭司，请收下先前承诺的奖励。"

entries.en:
"Thank you, $playerSirOrMadam," $heOrShe says. "I shall bring the archcurate your report posthaste. Please accept your generous reward."

"I shall tell the archcurate that your fee was higher than expected," $personName mumbles to $himOrHerself.
entries.zh:
"谢谢你，$playerSirOrMadam。" $heOrShe感谢道："我会尽快把你的报告传达给大祭司，请收下这一大笔奖励。"

"还得跟大祭司说说，你收的钱比预想的多。" $personName 小声自言自语。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe nods along as you explain how you found the heretics dead in their 'promised land', led astray and to their doom, if not damnation. $PersonName doesn't look particularly upset.

"Such is the fate of those who would spit on the Church of Galactic Redemption," $heOrShe says, then goes quiet. Perhaps pondering the fate of heretics who managed to avoid the Knight Inquisitors.
entries.zh:
你向 $PersonName 解释着你发现这群异端死在自己 '应许之地' 上的过程，这帮异端踏上歧途，最后也就自我毁灭了，或许算得上天谴。$HeOrShe一边听着一边点着头，看来也没有多伤心。

"对 银河救赎教会 不敬的人，就该有这种下场。" $heOrShe冷不丁说出这么一句，然后又一言不发，或许是在仔细思考这群避开了骑士审判官的异端的命运。

o.en: That's all there is to it.

entries.en:
"Oh, I... I see." $HisOrHer contenance shifts between relief and worry. "The Church, they- we are repentant! I swear it, even before you arrived."

"The false prophet who, who seduced us - his proclamations became bizarre. Unreasonable. Impious. He grew wroth at any questioning, claiming the angels commanded him, and then. Um."

"There was an accident." $PersonRank $PersonName looks aside, avoiding the gaze of the comms, "He is... I pray that his restless spirit might find a peace now which it did not know in life."
entries.zh:
"哦，我...我明白了。" $HisOrHer的表情在宽慰和担忧之间转换。"教会，他们...我们很后悔！我发誓，甚至在你们到来之前就已经在忏悔了。"

"那个伪先知，那个蛊惑了我们的家伙 —— 他的要求变得愈来愈...古怪。不合理。不虔诚。他不容许任何质疑，声称是天使给予了他启示，然后...嗯。"

"发生了一起事故。" $PersonRank $PersonName 看向一边，避开通讯设备的摄像头，"他被...我祈祷他不安的灵魂现在能找到生前从未有过的安宁。"

entries.en:
$personName's eyes go wide.

"What!? You brought them here?" $HeOrShe covers $hisOrHer face with $hisOrHer hands and makes a noise too pained to be a sigh.

"By Ludd's hammer, that wasn't the job! I... I didn't know anything about this. I'll specifically say I told you to report back with just confirmation of their position and status."
entries.zh:
$personName突然瞪圆了双眼。

"啥？你把他们带回来了？" $HeOrShe双手捂脸，似乎要叹气，但痛苦到声音都不对了。

"看在卢德之锤的份上，那可不是工作的内容！我...我也不知道怎么办了，我得跟大祭司说清楚了，我只要你确认一下他们的位置和情况的。"

entries.en:
"As for you- take those heretics somewhere else! Or at least wait until I've made my report to offload them. I want nothing to do with them, this isn't my fault!"

The signal cuts, leaving you with an ancient comms software fallback-pattern.
entries.zh:
"至于你 —— 把这帮异端带到别处去吧！再或者等到我做完报告了，再把他们放下船。我可没让你去安置他们，不是我的错！"

信号断开，你眼前只剩下一款古老通讯软件的退出界面。

entries.en:
$personName sighs, deeply, as if you've brought $hisOrHer rather more trouble than the signed up for. Because you have.

"I cannot imagine what, by Ludd's hammer, compelled you to bring the heretics here. So here's what we're going to do."

"I," $heOrShe pauses, giving you a stern look, "I know nothing about them. You delivered your news to me, now I shall tell the archcurate that's all you told me. You will dispose of those faithless ingrates however you see fit, and I'll have had nothing to do with it, good-day."

The comms cut out.
entries.zh:
$personName 长叹一口气，仿佛你帮$hisOrHer干活反倒是添乱了 —— 确实是添乱了。

"看在卢德之锤的份上，我都不敢想你是中了什么邪，才把异端带到我这里了。那我就这么办..."

"我..." $heOrShe突然停下，严厉的看着你："我不知道你带来了异端，你只带来了异端的消息，至少我只能跟大祭司这么讲。这帮信仰不坚定的白眼狼就随你处置了，不管怎么干都不关我事，再见。"

通讯断开了。

entries.en:
$personName's eyes go wide.

"What? The... Path? And you brought them here!? What by Ludd's hammer possessed you to do such a thing?"
entries.zh:
$personName突然瞪圆了双眼。

"啥？左... 左径？你还把他们带来这里了！？卢德的铁锤在上，你是中了什么邪，才能整出这种事！"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe waves $hisOrHer hands as if this might make the situation go away. "No. No, you didn't tell me this. I know nothing; I'll report to the archcurate that you found the heretics, and what happens from there is your - their - business. Good-day!"

The signal cuts, leaving you with an ancient comms software fallback-pattern.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe自欺欺人的挥挥手，仿佛这么做就能让情况好起来。"不。不，这话不是你跟我说的，我什么都不知道。我只会跟大祭司汇报，说你找到异端了，再往后出什么事就看你 —— 看他们怎么折腾了。再！见！"

信号断开，你眼前只剩下一款古老通讯软件的退出界面。

o.en: How many of you need transport?
o.zh: 你们有多少人需要运输？

o.en: Make an excuse and cut the comms
Transport them to a Luddic Church world, for forgiveness
o.zh: 将他们运送到 卢德教会 的星球，以求宽恕

o.en: Offer to transport them to a Luddic Church world
o.zh: 提议将他们运送到 卢德教会 的星球

o.en: Transport them to the Luddic Path, to start anew
o.zh: 将他们运送到 卢德左径 的星球，开启新生

o.en: I see. That is an unfortunate course of events.
o.zh: 我明白了。事态发展的结果真是不幸。

o.en: I'm afraid that this all sounds like brazen heresy.
o.zh: 这一切听起来都像是一套厚颜无耻的异端邪说。

o.en: So you rubes got tricked until someone did the sensible thing and murdered the conman.
o.zh: 所以你们这些乡巴佬一直被骗着，直到有人终于做件明智的事，把那个骗子给宰了。

o.en: You're far from the true Path. Thank Ludd what had to be done was done.
o.zh: 你们偏离了正确的道途。感谢卢德，应行之事终于尘埃落定。

o.en: I take no pleasure in observing that your faith blinded you.
o.zh: 你的信仰蒙蔽了你的双眼，对此我可是高兴不起来。

o.en: It's a good thing someone finally stood up and murdered the scum, eh?
o.zh: 终于有人站出来杀了这个人渣，这是件好事，是吧？

entries.en: $PersonRank $personLastName bows slightly, hands clasped. "Yes. Our poor fortune is punishment for our foolishness, and faithlessness."
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personLastName 微微鞠躬，双手合十。"是的，我们的不幸是对我们的愚蠢和不虔诚的惩罚。"

entries.en:
$PersonRank $personLastName looks only more defeated by your words.

"It is true," $heOrShe chokes out, not quite a sob. "We have been punished for our faithlessness."
entries.zh:
你的话让 $PersonRank $personLastName 显得更加沮丧。

"你说得对，" $heOrShe哽咽着，几乎要哭了出来。"我们为自己的不虔诚受到了惩罚。"

entries.en:
$PersonRank $personLastName bristles at your words, but represses $hisOrHer instinct to react with anger.

"We were fools, yes," $heOrShe says, eyes downcast. "But it was... it was an accident. A terrible accident, nothing more."

$HisOrHer voice cracks with desperation, clinging to an agreed-upon truth.
entries.zh:
在听到你的话后，$PersonRank $personLastName 感到非常不快，但还是压制住了本能的愤怒。

"我们确实很愚蠢，" $heOrShe垂下眼睛。"但那...那是个意外。一个可怕的意外，仅此而已。"

$HisOrHer的声音带着绝望，坚持着那个认定的事实。

entries.en:
$PersonRank $personLastName shifts uncomfortably at your words.

"It was an accident. A terrible accident, nothing more." $HisOrHer voice cracks with desperation, clinging to an agreed-upon truth. "We're not murderers! We seek only the peace of Ludd. And, and to atone."
entries.zh:
$PersonRank $personLastName 听到你的话后，身体很不自然地动了一下。

"那是一场意外。一场可怕的意外，仅此而已。" $HisOrHer的声音带着绝望，坚持着那个认定的事实。"我们不是凶手！我们只想寻求卢德的和平。还有，还有赎罪。"

entries.en:
"Pride!" The word bursts from $PersonRank $personLastName.

"It was pride that blinded us. A false revelation made us feel above all others, blessed with special knowledge. Had we but kept the true faith..."

$HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head. "We have been punished for straying from the Church and seek now to repent."
entries.zh:
"骄傲！" 这个词从 $PersonRank $personLastName 口中迸发出来。

"正是骄傲蒙蔽了我们的双眼。错误的启示让我们觉得受到独特知识的恩惠，比其他人优越。而如果我们能保持真正的信仰的话..."

$HeOrShe摇摇头。"我们因背离教会而受到惩罚，现在只想寻求忏悔。"

entries.en:
$PersonRank $personLastName looks horrified. "We're not... no... it was an accident! A terrible accident, nothing more."

$HisOrHer voice cracks with desperation, clinging to an agreed-upon truth.

"We seek only the peace of Ludd. And, and to atone."
entries.zh:
$PersonRank $personLastName 看起来非常惊恐。"我们不是...不是...那是个意外！一个可怕的意外，仅此而已。"

$HisOrHer 的声音带着绝望，坚持着那个认定的事实。

"我们只想寻求卢德的安宁。还有，还有赎罪。"

entries.en:
"Blessings of Ludd upon you, $playerSirOrMadam!" the Luddic $personRank says, effusing about redemption and the like. You manage to offload $himOrHer to an adjutant 'to make arrangements'.

Ops gruffly coordinates shuttles with the planetside heretics. They are a thin and subdued group, nearly starving despite the lush landscape of $entity.name due to their former prophet's lack of preparation.

If nothing else, perhaps the Church will appreciate the return of a lost flock.
entries.zh:
"愿卢德降福于您，$playerSirOrMadam！"卢德 $personRank 滔滔不绝地谈论着救赎之类的东西。你设法把$himOrHer交给副官 "安排"。

行动长官粗暴地用穿梭机与地面上的卢德异端们对接。他们虚弱不堪、毫无活力，尽管 $entity.name 的植被郁郁葱葱，但由于他们的前先知缺乏准备，他们快要饿死了。

如果不出意外的话，也许教会为迷失羔羊们的回归而感激。

entries.en:
"Blessings of Ludd upon you, $playerSirOrMadam!" the Luddic $personRank cries out, and wipes away tears of relief.

You have your officers make the arrangements, coordinating with the planetside heretics. They are a thin and subdued group, nearly starving despite the lush landscape of $entity.name due to their former prophet's lack of preparation.

The Church will surely take in these refugees, with mercy and love, provided they repent.
entries.zh:
"愿卢德降福于您，$playerSirOrMadam！" 卢德 $personRank 失声高呼，拭去如释重负的泪水。

你让你的副官做好了和星球上卢德异端对接的相关安排。他们虚弱不堪、毫无活力，尽管 $entity.name 的植被郁郁葱葱，但由于他们的前先知缺乏准备，他们快要饿死了。

教会必将以仁慈与爱心接纳这些难民，只要他们迷途知返。

entries.en:
"Blessings of Ludd upon you, $playerSirOrMadam," the Luddic $personRank says grimly, perhaps anticipating the new path upon which $heOrShe has set $hisOrHer very first step.

You have your officers make the arrangements, coordinating with the planetside heretics. They are a thin and subdued group, nearly starving despite the lush landscape of $entity.name due to their former prophet's lack of preparation.

The Path will take them. The Path knows well of faith betrayed.
entries.zh:
"愿卢德降福于您，$playerSirOrMadam，" 卢德 $personRank 阴沉地说道，也许$heOrShe正在期待$hisOrHer那踏上全新道途的第一步。

你让你的副官做好了和星球上卢德异端对接的相关安排。他们虚弱不堪、毫无活力，尽管 $entity.name 的植被郁郁葱葱，但由于他们的前先知缺乏准备，他们快要饿死了。

左径会接纳他们。左径深知被背弃的信仰。

entries.en: You've arrived at a colony controlled by the Church of Galactic Redemption suitable for offloading the Luddic heretics you rescued from the fringe.
entries.zh: 你们来到了一个由 银河救赎教会 控制的殖民地，这里{适合卸下你从边缘星系救出的卢德异端}。

o.zh: 用穿梭机把救出的异端送到 $name

entries.en:
As promised, you allow the heretics to disembark. Their shuttles are met by a serene curate backed by a pair of frowning Knights of Ludd.

The curate welcomes the refugees with prayer and blessings as they bow, hands clasped, and fall to their knees in repentance.

What was lost is now found, as if returned from death and born again to be embraced by the merciful Faith.
entries.zh:
按照约定，你让那些异端登岸。迎接他们穿梭机的是一位安详的祭司，身后跟着一对皱着眉头的卢德骑士。

祭司用祈祷和祝福欢迎这些难民，难民们先是鞠躬，再双手合十，最后跪地忏悔。

他们感到失而复得，仿佛在仁慈信仰的拥抱下死而复生。

entries.en: You've arrived at a colony controlled by the Church of Galactic Redemption suitable for offloading the Luddic heretics you rescued from the fringe.
entries.zh: 你们来到了一个由 银河救赎教会 控制的殖民地，这里{适合卸下你从边缘星系救出的卢德异端}。

o.zh: 用穿梭机把救出的异端送到 $name

entries.en:
As promised, you allow the lost heretics to disembark. Their shuttles are met by a serene curate backed by a pair of frowning Knights of Ludd. The curate welcomes the refugees as they bow, hands clasped, or fall to their knees in repentance.

Though the Church now shows a face of reconciliation, the Knight-Inquisitors will surely come later for a full accounting of their sins.
entries.zh:
按照约定，你让那些异端登岸。迎接他们穿梭机的是一位安详的祭司，身后跟着一对皱着眉头的卢德骑士。祭司用祈祷和祝福欢迎这些难民，难民们先是鞠躬，再双手合十，最后跪地忏悔。

虽然教会现在表现出了和善的一面，但骑士审判官们日后一定会来彻底清算他们的罪孽。

o.en: Inquire about turning over a community of heretics
o.zh: 询问关于卸下一整个卢德异端组织的问题

entries.en:
"Heretics you say?" The Knight sits up even more rigidly, somehow, to meet this challenge to $hisOrHer militant faith. "Yes, they are a problem which falls under our purview."

"I shall have a novice collect a full witnessing on the situation from your subordinates so that the inquisitors may make a full, and just, accounting of their heresy." $HeOrShe raises an eyebrow, "Presuming your cooperation, of course. For which you would have the thanks of both myself and of the Knights of Ludd."
entries.zh:
"你说异教徒？" 骑士把腰板打得笔直，似乎在准备迎接这个对$hisOrHer狂热信仰的挑战。"是的，他们的问题属于我们的责任范围。"

"我会让一个见习修士从你的下属那里收集关于这件事的完整证词，以便审判官能够全面、公正地评估他们的异端行为。" $HeOrShe挑了挑眉毛，"当然，前提是你的合作。对此，我和卢德骑士团都会对你表示感谢。"

o.en: I'll have them loaded on shuttles immediately.
o.zh: 我会马上把他们装上穿梭机。

o.en: Show mercy, Knight. They are good-intentioned but misled.
o.zh: 发发慈悲吧，骑士。他们初心向善，但却误入歧途。

entries.en: The Knight gives a stiff, small bow. "Providence guide us."
entries.zh: 骑士僵硬地微微鞠了一躬。"上天指引着我们。"

entries.en:
The Knight doesn't quite sigh, and says, "You've familiar with the Road to Hell, $playerSirOrMadam?"

"Ancient aphorisms aside, I promise to you that we shall provide justice and Ludd's teaching shall provide mercy. Anything less would breach the oath I've sworn."
entries.zh:
骑士轻叹了口气，"你知道通往地狱之路是由什么铺就的吗，$playerSirOrMadam？"

"好吧，先忘掉那古老的谚语，我向你保证，我们将伸张正义，而卢德的教诲将带来仁慈。如若缺失了分毫，就是违背了我的誓言。"

entries.en: The matter resolves to a simple business of logistics, which both your subordinates and the Knights' gang of shockingly young and clean-cut novices handle with aplomb.
entries.zh: 这件事变成了一个简单的后勤问题，你的下属和骑士团中那些年轻、干净利落的见习修士们都能轻松应对。

o.en: Inquire about offloading a community of Luddic heretics
o.zh: 询问关于卸下一整个卢德异端组织的问题

entries.en:
"Heretics?" $Post $personLastName sits up as you explain, intent upon the challenge of bringing more of the Faithful to the true Path of Ludd.

"They have been so very lost," $heOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head as $heOrShe speaks, "First by the corruption and weakness of the Church, then by the demonic rantings of a madman."

"You have done the right thing, $playerBrotherOrSister, to bring them to us. Their first few steps on the Path will be painful, but we shall be at their side to guide them and provide spiritual strength."
entries.zh:
"异端？" 当你解释时，$Post $personLastName 坐了起来，急切地想要把更多的信徒带向正确的卢德之径。

"他们已经如此迷失，" $heOrShe边说边摇头，"这首先归咎于教会的腐败和软弱，当然还有那个疯子的妖言惑众。"

"你做得对，$playerBrotherOrSister，把他们带到我们这里来。他们踏上卢德之径的最初几步，必然痛苦万分，但我们会在他们身边指引他们，给予他们心灵的支柱。"

o.en: I'll have them loaded on shuttles immediately.
o.zh: 我会马上把他们装上穿梭机。

o.en: Show mercy, $brotherOrSister. They were good-intentioned but misled.
o.zh: 发发慈悲吧，$brotherOrSister。他们初心向善，但却误入歧途。

entries.en: The Pather nods. "This step is best done quickly."
entries.zh: 左径分子点了点头。"最好快点完成。"

entries.en:
The Pather doesn't quite sigh. "Let the compassion you feel now fuel your dedication to an ultimate Good, greater than the small pains they - and we - must carry."

$HisOrHer voice fills with conviction. "In the end, Ludd's promise awaits us all."
entries.zh:
左径分子轻叹了口气。"把你现在所持的同情，化作对至善的献身吧，这会比他们 —— 还有我们 —— 所必须承受的那微不足道的痛苦更伟大。"

$HisOrHer的声音充满信念。"最终，卢德的应许，等候着我们所有人。"

entries.en:
The matter resolves to a simple business of logistics.

Some of your subordinates are awkward in dealing with Pathers but soon discover that when it comes to practical need the Path knows there are times to set high-minded spiritual demands aside in the interest of expedience.
entries.zh:
这件事最终变成了一个简单的后勤问题。

你的部分下属在与左径分子打交道时感到有些别扭。但他们很快发现，在涉及到实际问题时，这些左径分子也知道为了权益之计，有时需要将崇高的精神需求放在一边。

entries.en: You've arrived at a colony controlled by the Luddic Path suitable for offloading the heretics you rescued from the fringe.
entries.zh: 你们来到了一个由 卢德左径 控制的殖民地，这里{适合卸下你从边缘星系救出的卢德异端}。

o.zh: 用穿梭机把救出的异端送到 $name

entries.en:
The somewhat unconventional body that passes for the port authority has some pointed questions as you arrange for the offloading of nearly two hundred heretics from the fringe.

You iterate rapidly up the chain of authority and find yourself speaking to the equivalent of the top civilian administrator.
entries.zh:
你安排卸下近两百名来自边缘星系的异端的时候，那个行事颇为另类、勉强算得上港口管理局的机构，对你的行为有些尖锐的问题。

你迅速逐级向上交涉，最后你发现正坐在自己对面的是最高民事管理员。

entries.en: Amid the low-priority updates you receive upon entering the colonial datasphere, a minor report is flagged for your attention.
entries.zh: 在进入殖民地数据领域后，你收到一些低优先级的更新，其中有一份次要报告被{标记着等待你的处理}。

entries.en:
A small community of heretical Luddics was rescued from a remote village on the surface of $name.

Rescuers describe the Luddics as repentant and half-starved, their agricultural efforts having failed due to poor preparation. They now seem intent upon rejoining the Church of Galactic Redemption. Given basic necessities by your administration, they have been released to haunt the landing facilities, seeking work as crew or charity transport back to the core worlds.

Colonial MuniSec will monitor the group for radical Pather activity.
entries.zh:
一小群异端卢德信徒在 $name 地表的一个边远村庄获救。

救援人员描述说，由于准备不充分，这些卢德信徒在农业上的尝试全都以失败告终，他们饿的饥肠辘辘，后悔不已。现在他们似乎打算重新加入银河救赎教会。你的行政机关为他们提供基本必需品后，已经将其释放。现在信众们徘徊在登陆设施附近，寻找顺路船只上的工作或慈善运输的方式，以返回核心世界。

殖民地地方安全部将重点关注该团体，以防他们从事激进的左径活动。

entries.en: Amid the low-priority updates you receive upon entering the colonial datasphere, a minor report is flagged for your attention.
entries.zh: 在进入殖民地数据领域后，你收到一些低优先级的更新，其中有一份次要报告被{标记着等待你的处理}。

entries.en:
The community of heretical Luddics living in a remote village on the surface of $name has been rescued by a local emergency response team.

The Luddics are described as repentant and half-starved due to their failing agricultural efforts and now seem intent upon rejoining the Church of Galactic Redemption. Given basic necessities by your administration, they have been released to haunt the landing facilities, seeking work as crew or charitable transport back to the core worlds.

Colonial MuniSec will monitor the group for radical Pather activity.
entries.zh:
一小群异端卢德信徒在 $name 地表的一个边远村庄被当地的应急小组救出。

救援人员描述说，这些卢德信徒因为在农业上的尝试全都失败而饥肠辘辘，后悔不已，现在似乎打算重新加入银河救赎教会。你的行政机关为他们提供基本必需品后，已经将其释放。现在信众们徘徊在登陆设施附近，寻找顺路船只上的工作或慈善运输的方式，以返回核心世界。

殖民地地方安全部将重点关注该团体，以防他们从事激进的左径活动。

entries.en:
You explain that although you have no spiritual or secular power within the Church of Galactic Redemption, you could perhaps provide transport to a place where they could atone for their heresy.

"Yes," $heOrShe looks hopefully at you. "We seek to repent, and keep to the true faith."
entries.zh:
你解释道，虽然你在 银河救赎教会 中并没有特别的宗教或世俗权力，但你或许可以安排将信徒们送到一个可以为他们的叛教行为赎罪的地方。

"是，" $heOrShe满是希望地看着你。"我们寻求宽恕，以维持真正的信仰。"

entries.en:
You explain that you are commissioned by the Church of Galactic Redemption, and although the powers you are granted are worldly in nature, perhaps - provided the former heretics act in good faith - you could ensure a righteous outcome.

Yes," $heOrShe looks hopefully at you. "We seek to repent, and keep to the true faith."
entries.zh:
你解释到你已被 银河救赎教会 雇佣，虽然你所被授予的还是世俗方面的权力，但是 —— 假如这些前异端能够端正行事 —— 你也能保证公正的结果。

"是，" $heOrShe满是希望地看着你。"我们寻求宽恕，维持真正的信仰。"

o.en: You have strayed far, $brotherOrSister, but the Church is rich in mercy
o.zh: 你偏离了正途，$brotherOrSister，但教会充满仁慈

o.en: How can you crawl back to the Church when there is a Path more righteous?
o.zh: 既然有一条更正确的道途，你为什么要屈身爬回教会？

entries.en:
"The..." $heOrShe hesitates before saying the words. "The Path."

"You represent the Luddic Path?" $heOrShe blinks, rubbing $hisOrHer eyes. "They have a... strong reputation. Despite what the Church says, it seems like the Path is everywhere."

"Um," $PersonRank $personLastName looks to you nervously. "Do I understand correctly your... offer?"
entries.zh:
"左..." $heOrShe犹豫再三，还是说出了那个词。"左径。"

"你代表卢德左径？" $heOrShe揉了揉他的眼角。"他们的名声... 比较极端。看来不管教会怎么说，左径确实已无处不在。"

"唔，" $PersonRank $personLastName紧张地看着你。"所以我没理解错您的... 提议吧？"

o.en: Yes, I will take you to the Path. There you will discover true faith.
o.zh: 是的，我会带你去见左径。你会在那里发现真正的信仰。

o.en: No, we're just discussing faith. Just words.
o.zh: 不，我们只是在讨论信仰。说说而已。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe sputters, "Of course. Just words. I didn't mean to imply..."

$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat nervously, letting $hisOrHer words trail off.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe语无伦次道。"当然。只是说辞。我不是指..."

$HeOrShe紧张地清了清嗓子，$hisOrHer的声音渐渐缩小。

entries.en:
Grim-faced, $heOrShe clasps $hisOrHer hands and bows in submission.

"Anything to free us of this false paradise."
entries.zh:
$heOrShe面色凝重地双手合十，鞠躬臣服。

"只要能把我们从这个虚假的乐园中带走，怎么都可以。"

entries.en:
Your comms officer calls for your attention, "$PlayerSirOrMadam, we're getting a comms request from the surface. It's a weak signal."

Sensors takes over the report, "Picking up a small power source, large central structure. Earthworks. Not military; some kind of... art? Ceremonial? Underground habitation, and... fields. An attempt at farming."

"There's no colony here on the charts, $playerSirOrMadam. Not pre or post-Collapse."
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官叫住了你："$PlayerSirOrMadam，我们收到来自地面的通讯请求。信号很弱。"

传感器接管了报告，"探测到一个小型电源，大型中心结构。土方工程。非军事目的；而是某种...艺术？仪式？此外还有地下居住区，以及...田地。有人在尝试耕种。"

"数据显示，这里从来没有过殖民地，$playerSirOrMadam。无论是大崩塌前还是大崩塌后。"

entries.en:
Your comms officer reports that the comms signal from the surface is still active.

Your sensors officer confirms that there is still some kind of unregistered colony site, complete with decorative earthworks, underground habitation, and a feeble attempt at agriculture.
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官报告说，地表的通讯信号仍然保持活跃。

而你的传感器技官确认，那里仍然存在某种未经注册的殖民地，包含装饰性的土方工程、地下居住区和低限度的农业尝试。

entries.en: Your comms officer reports the comms signal from the rogue Luddic sect on the surface is still active.
entries.zh: 你的通讯军官报告说，来自地表上的游散卢德分支的通讯信号仍然保持活跃。

o.en: Connect comms to the signal from the surface
o.zh: 与来自地表的信号连接通讯

entries.en:
$HeOrShe suppressing some emotion and, after a moment of hesitation, hastily speaks, "We've got skilled techs, and operators. Lots of spacefaring experience. We'd be... happy to work as crew for the passage home."

The miners' leader uploads a passenger manifest displaying relevant skill-sets. It will require 136 crew berths to transport these miners.

"And, um." $HeOrShe looks around the temporary shelter $heOrShe is occupying. "There's equipment. Heavy Machinery, at least 12 units that could be salvaged. The Company just left it behind, so why not take it?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe抑制住了某种情绪，在犹豫片刻后，急促地说道："我们有熟练的技术人员和操作员。有丰富的太空飞行经验。而且我们很...乐意在回家的旅程中作为船员工作"。

矿工们的头领上传了一份显示相关技能的人员名单。运送这些矿工需要 136 间船员宿舍。

"还有，呃..." $HeOrShe环顾$hisOrHer的临时庇护所，"这里还有些设备。至少有 12 单位的重型机械可以回收。既然公司把它们留下了，为什么不拿走呢？"

entries.en:
The question makes $personName uncomfortable.

"I know I spoke in anger, captain. But in these times... lots of miners are looking for work, and the hiring agents, they talk to each other."

$HeOrShe frowns, "I don't want a reputation as... difficult."
entries.zh:
这个问题让 $personName 感到有些别扭。

"我知道我说的只是气话，舰长。但在现在这个时代...很多矿工都在找工作，而那些招聘中介，他们会互相交换信息。"

$HeOrShe皱了皱眉头，"我不想背上...所谓 '难搞' 的名头。"

o.en: You do what you need to do to make a living, I understand.
o.zh: 为了生活，你必须做你该做的事，我理解。

o.en: That's a good attitude, you have to accept your place in the world.
o.zh: 这种想法很好，你必须接受自己在世界上的位置。

o.en: That's outrageous! They left you to die out here!
o.zh: 这太离谱了！他们可是让你在这里等死！

entries.en: "Gotta get by," $heOrShe shrugs. "But first, we need to get back to the core worlds. If... you could help us."
entries.zh: "总得过日子，" $heOrShe耸耸肩。"但首先，我们得回到核心世界。前提是...您能帮助我们的话。"

entries.en: After a couple of false starts, the comms protocols settle down to establish a fitful connection.
entries.zh: 经过几次错误的尝试后，通信协议终于稳定下来，勉强建立起了连接。

entries.en:
"Calling $shipOrFleet in orbit- a connection! Glorious stars!" Relief washes over the $manOrWoman's face.

"Signal clear. Are you the commander of the $shipOrFleet in orbit? We're miners, or we were. There was an accident, our main rig blew. Then the company pulled out, they left us here to die!"

$HeOrShe grimaces in anger and frustration, "The bloodsuckers said a return trip 'wasn't in the contract' if we couldn't produce. Will you help us return to the core?"
entries.zh:
"赶紧继续呼叫轨道上的$shipOrFleet... 连接成功！哦我的银河在上！" 这个$manOrWoman如释重负。

"信号清晰。您是轨道上$shipOrFleet的指挥官吗？我们是矿工，呃，至少曾经是。这里发生了些意外，我们的主钻机爆炸了。然后那帮公司就撤走了，把我们丢在这里等死！"

$HeOrShe因为愤怒和沮丧而面目狰狞，"这些吸血鬼说如果我们不能够生产，回程就 '不包含在合同' 里。您能帮助我们回到核心星区吗？"

entries.en: "Captain!" The miner $post looks hopeful, but concerned. "I ask you once again, will you help us return to the core? Although our life support is rated for multiple cycles, it's extremely boring out here." $HeOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms. "And we're not getting paid."
entries.zh: "舰长！" 矿工 $post 面带希望，但又十分忧虑。"我想再恳求您一次，您能否帮助我们回到核心星区？虽然我们的生命维持系统可以维持几个星历年，但这里实在是非常无聊。" $HeOrShe双手交叉。"而且在这待着也没有工钱可拿。"

entries.en: "Captain," the miner $post looks hesitant. "You've returned. I trust the... ion storm... was not too disruptive? I ask you once more, will you help us? Although our life support is rated for multiple cycles, it's extremely boring out here." $HeOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms. "And we're not getting paid."
entries.zh: "舰长！" 矿工 $post 看上去犹豫不决。"您回来了。我相信...离子风暴...没有造成太大破坏吧？我想再恳求您一次，您能帮助我们吗？虽然我们的生命维持系统可以维持几个星历年，但这里实在是非常无聊。" $HeOrShe双手交叉。"而且在这待着也没有工钱可拿。"

entries.en: "Captain!" The miner $post looks hopeful. "You came back! Are you ready to help us return to the core worlds? Although our life support is rated for multiple cycles, it's extremely boring out here." $HeOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms. "And we're not getting paid."
entries.zh: "舰长！" 矿工 $post 面带希望。"您回来了！您准备好帮助我们回到核心世界了？虽然我们的生命维持系统可以维持几个星历年，但这里实在是非常无聊。" $HeOrShe双手交叉。"而且在这待着也没有工钱可拿。"

entries.en:
After a moment of hesitation, $personName quickly adds "We've got skilled techs, and operators. Lots of spacefaring experience. We'd be happy to crew for the passage home."

$HeOrShe uploads a workcrew manifest displaying relevant skills. It would require 136 crew berths to transport the miners.

"And, um." $HeOrShe looks around $hisOrHer temporary shelter. "There's equipment. At least 12 units of heavy machinery could be recovered. The company just left it behind, so why not take it?"
entries.zh:
犹豫片刻后，$personName迅速补充道："我们有熟练的技术人员和操作员。有丰富的太空飞行经验。我们很乐意在回家的旅程中作为船员工作"。

$HeOrShe上传了一份显示相关技能的人员名单。运送这些矿工需要 136 间船员宿舍。

"还有，呃..." $HeOrShe环顾$hisOrHer的临时庇护所，"这里还有些设备。至少有 12 单位的重型机械可以回收。既然公司把它们留下了，为什么不拿走呢？"

entries.en: Per the records already transmitted to you, it will require 136 crew berths to transport these miners. They also offered to recover 12 units of heavy machinery from the worksite.
entries.zh: 根据已经转交给你的记录，运送这些矿工需要 136 间船员宿舍。他们还提出能帮你从工地回收 12 单位的重型机械。

o.en: Um. Ion storm! Comms uh, breaking up...
o.zh: 嗯... 离子风暴！通讯，呃，中断...

o.en: Um. It's another ion storm! Comms uh, breaking up...
o.zh: 嗯... 另一场离子风暴！通讯，呃，中断...

o.en: I can't transport you now, but I promise I'll be back.
o.zh: 我现在没法运送你们，但我承诺我会回来的。

o.en: I can take you to my own colony. I could use honest workers.
o.zh: 我可以把你们带回到我的殖民地。我需要诚实的工人。

o.en: Sorry, I have urgent business to attend to.
Offer to transport the miners back to civilization
o.zh: 提议将矿工运送回文明世界

o.en: What were you mining? Was there a survey?
o.zh: "你们在开采什么？有先调查过吗？

o.en: Who left you here? What company?
o.zh: 谁把你们扔在这了？哪个公司？

entries.en:
"That's strange," $heOrShe says. "We don't detect-"

You snap the comms off.
entries.zh:
"真奇怪。" $heOrShe说道，"我们没有检测到 ——"

你切断了通讯。

entries.en: "We've got plenty of supplies, so if we don't die of boredom, we'll be waiting." $HeOrShe sighs and closes the comm-link.
entries.zh: "我们有足够的补给品，只要不无聊死，我们就继续在这等着。" $HeOrShe叹了口气，关闭了通讯链接。

entries.en:
"Truly?" The miner $post grins. "If you've got paying jobs we'd be fools not to take them."

"I'll get everyone organized down here, and have the heavy machinery packed up for you within a shift! Ah, it'll be good to get back to work."
entries.zh:
"真的吗？"矿工 $post 咧嘴一笑。"如果您有付薪的工作，我们可没理由傻得去拒绝。"

"我会安排好这里的所有人，在一个星历日内把重型机械打包好给您！啊，能回去工作真是太好了。"

entries.en:
"Splendid." The miner $post grins.

"I'll get everyone organized down here, and have the heavy machinery packed up for you within a shift! Ah, it'll be good to get back to work."
entries.zh:
"太棒了。"矿工 $post 咧嘴一笑。

"我会安排好这里的所有人，在一个星历日内把重型机械打包好给您！啊，能回去工作真是太好了。"

entries.en: You have your officers make arrangements. The miners, eager to escape from the monotony of their temporary worksite, board your $shipOrFleet along with all the general-purpose heavy equipment that could be recovered.
entries.zh: 你让你的军官们安排好一切。矿工们急切渴望逃离生活单调的临时工地，他们带着所有可回收的通用重型设备登上你的$shipOrFleet。

entries.en: You've arrived at a colony suitable for offloading the miners you rescued from the fringe survey site.
entries.zh: 你到达了一个适合{卸下从边缘勘测点救出的矿工}的殖民地。

o.zh: 用穿梭机把救出的矿工送到 $name

entries.en:
As promised, you offload the abandoned mining crew you rescued from the fringe. They smile and give thanks to you and your officers as they leave.

Nearly a third of the crew choose to stay on, forgoing the usual signing bonus. It seems that they are finding spacefaring - and regular wages - to their taste.
entries.zh:
正如承诺的那样，你卸下了你从边缘地带救出的被遗弃的采矿队成员。他们在离开时微笑着向你和你的军官表达着感谢。

其中近三分之一的船员选择留下，放弃了通常的签约奖金。看来他们觉得航天事业和固定的工资更符合他们的口味。

entries.en: You've arrived at a colony under your administration suitable for resettlement of the rescued miners.
entries.zh: 你已经到达了你管辖下的殖民地其中一个{适合安置获救矿工}的星球。

o.zh: 用穿梭机把救出的矿工送到 $name

entries.en:
As promised, you offload the mining crew you rescued from the fringe survey site. They smile and give thanks to you and your officers as they leave to find gainful employment in your colony. With recommendations based on work ethic and good behavior, it is likely they will do well here.

Nearly a third of the crew choose to stay on your rolls, forgoing the usual signing bonus. It appears that they find the adventure of spacefaring to their taste.
entries.zh:
正如承诺的那样，你卸下了从边远勘探地救出的采矿队成员。他们微笑着向你和你的军官表达着感谢，然后动身在你的殖民地寻找有赚头的工作。凭着根据职业道德和良好行为给出的推荐，他们估计能在这里有所成就。

其中近三分之一的船员选择留下，放弃了通常的签约奖金。看起来他们觉得远航星际的探险更合他们的口味。

entries.en: Amid the low-priority updates you receive upon entering the colonial datasphere, a minor report is flagged for your attention.
entries.zh: 在进入殖民地数据领域后，你收到一些低优先级的更新，其中有一份次要报告被{标记着等待你的处理}。

entries.en:
A small crew of miners, abandoned by their exploration company, was been rescued from the surface of $name.

Left without pay, they've sold the remains of their survey and survival equipment for basic necessities, and now haunt the landing facilities to seek work in local industry, or as crew on newly arriving ships.

Colonial MuniSec is monitoring the situation.
entries.zh:
有一个小队的矿工被勘探公司抛弃，在 $name 的表面被救出。

他们被拖欠工资，只能变卖剩余的调查和生存设备来换取生存必需品，现在他们徘徊在登陆设施附近，尝试寻找新到达舰船上的船员工作。

殖民地地方安全部正在密切关注事态发展。

entries.en:
Upon entering orbit, your comms officer reports "$PlayerSirOrMadam, we're getting a signal. Point of origin from structure on the surface."

Sensors takes over the report, "Scan shows a small power source, several light planetary craft, and robotic drill rigs. Temporary structures. Mining survey?"
entries.zh:
进入轨道后，你的通讯军官报告说："$PlayerSirOrMadam，我们收到信号。信号来自地表上的建筑。"

传感器接收到报告："扫描显示有一个小型电源，几艘轻型行星飞行器和机器人钻机。应该是临时建筑。可能是为了矿业调查？"

entries.en: Your comms officer reports that the signal from the surface is still active. Sensors indicate that the mining survey site is largely intact, a cluster of temporary structures with a significant power source, light planetary craft, and robotic drill rigs.
entries.zh: 你的通讯军官报告说，那个来自地表的信号仍然保持活跃。传感器显示，采矿勘测站基本完好无损，存在一个临时建筑群，其中有重要的动力源，轻型行星飞行器和机器人钻机。

o.en: Hail the signal coming from the surface
o.zh: 呼叫星球表面的信号源

entries.en:
"Aye, this place is a real find!" $HeOrShe speaks with obvious pride.

"By the Domain standard rating these are classified as ultra-rich ore deposits."

"With a proper mine site, and equipment, and... well, you could feed refineries across half the core. Unfortunately the bloodsuckers took off with the full survey data, but if you ran your own, you'd see for yourself what a bounty we've got here. All yours, as far as I'm concerned."
entries.zh:
"啊，这里可是个好地方！" $HeOrShe在说着这话时脸上带着明显的自豪。

"根据 人之领 的标准评级，这里可是被分类为具有{富饶的矿床}。"

"如果有了合适的矿场和设备...这么说，您可以喂饱大半个核心世界的精炼厂。不幸的是，那些吸血鬼带走了完整的勘测数据，但如果您自己勘测一遍，您就会亲眼看到我们这里有多少宝藏。就我而言，这些都该是您的。"

entries.en:
"Aye, this place is a real find!" $HeOrShe speaks with obvious pride.

"By the Domain standard rating these are classified as plentiful organics deposits."

"Set down a drill-rig almost anywhere and you'll hit high-purity take! Unfortunately the bloodsuckers took off with the full survey data, but if you ran your own, you'd see for yourself what a bounty you've got here. And it's all yours, as far as I'm concerned."
entries.zh:
"啊，这里可是个好地方！" $HeOrShe在说着这话时脸上带着明显的自豪。

"根据 人之领 的标准评级，这里可是被分类为具有{富足的有机物}。"

"随便找个地方架起钻井平台，都几乎能获得高纯度的矿藏！不幸的是，那些吸血鬼带走了完整的勘测数据，但如果您自己勘测一遍，您就会亲眼看到我们这里有多少宝藏。就我而言，这些都该是您的。"

entries.en:
"Aye, this place is a real find!" $HeOrShe speaks with obvious pride.

"By the Domain standard rating these are classified as ultra-rich rare ore deposits."

"With a proper operation, you could feed half the refineries of the core worlds. Unfortunately the bloodsuckers took off with the full survey data, but if you ran your own, you'd see for yourself what a bounty you've got here. All yours, as far as I'm concerned."
entries.zh:
"啊，这里可是个好地方！" $HeOrShe在说着这话时脸上带着明显的自豪。

"根据 人之领 的标准评级，这里可是被分类为具有{富饶的稀有元素}。"

"如果有了合适的矿场和设备...这么说，您可以喂饱大半个核心世界的精炼厂。不幸的是，那些吸血鬼带走了完整的勘测数据，但如果您自己勘测一遍，您就会亲眼看到我们这里有多少宝藏。就我而言，这些都该是您的。"

entries.en:
"Aye, this place is a real find!" $HeOrShe speaks with obvious pride.

"By the Domain standard rating these are classified as plentiful volatiles deposits."

"With a proper extraction operation you could feed half the fuel production of the core! Imagine. Unfortunately the bloodsuckers took off with the full survey data, but if you ran your own, you'd see for yourself what a bounty you've got here. And it's all yours, as far as I'm concerned."
entries.zh:
"啊，这里可是个好地方！" $HeOrShe在说着这话时脸上带着明显的自豪。

"根据 人之领 的标准评级，这里可是被分类为具有{富足的挥发物}。"

"如果有了合适的矿场和设备...这么说，您可以喂饱大半个核心世界的燃料生产业。不幸的是，那些吸血鬼带走了完整的勘测数据，但如果您自己勘测一遍，您就会亲眼看到我们这里有多少宝藏。就我而言，这些都该是您的。"

entries.en:
"No!" $HeOrShe shouts defensively. "No no, never... " $heOrShe appears to be trying to gauge your reaction through the fits of the poor comm link.

"...Yes. Maybe? A little, from time to time, perhaps. Desperate times, these are, aren't they? We think of ourselves more as rogues of the fringe. Corsairs, if you will. Good, honest folk driven to low means to make ends meet. Sounds better when you say it like that, don't it?"

"And even if we are pirates, know that I'm being honest with ya. Counts for something, don't it?"
entries.zh:
"不！" $HeOrShe几乎是反射性地喊道。"不不，绝对不是..." $heOrShe似乎想通过那糟糕的通讯链接传过去的声音，来判断你的反应。

"...是的。呃，也许？偶尔有些时候，我们是。现在是非常时期，不是吗？我们更愿意把自己视为行走在边缘的混混。我们是那些为了讨口饭吃，不得不采取卑劣手段的善良且正直的人。这样说听起来好多了，不是吗？"

"即使我们是海盗，但请相信我说的都是实话。至少有些很可信，不是吗？"

o.zh: 所以你们...是正直的海盗。

entries.en:
"Well," $heOrShe draws this out, leaning back.

"If you're demanding only the strictest sort of definition, why then I suppose we couldn't rightly object to that choice nomenclature on the, what's it, empirical grounds, now could we."
entries.zh:
"呃..." $heOrShe向后靠了靠，拖长了声音说道。

"如果你用最严格的定义，那么我想我们无法反驳这种基于刻板印象的命名法则，现在我们可以出发了吗？"

entries.en: "Surely we are, captain!" $HeOrShe grins.
entries.zh: "我们当然正直，舰长！" $HeOrShe讥笑着说。

entries.en:
"I didn't say we weren't, but..." $heOrShe pauses a moment, in furious thought, before deciding that you're constructing a fiction for $himOrHer to play along with. For whose benefit? Your own crew, perhaps.

"Aye. Aye, that's right. Not pirates, as you will." The pirate nods emphatically, and gives a wink.
entries.zh:
"我没说我们不是，但是..." $heOrShe停顿了片刻，大脑飞速运转过后，才意识到你在帮$himOrHer一起编造谎言。但为什么要这样做？也许是为了让你的船员不感到那么膈应。

"对，对，没错。不是海盗，和你说的一样。" 海盗重重地点点头，并使了个眼色。

entries.en:
"Treasure? Oh, Old Marlowe's stash?" The pirate snorts dismissively. "Weren't no thing. Not here, anyway."

"We come out all this way, the rad-addled betrayer claiming all the while he knows where Marlowe left his riches, this very planet. We go down to the spot with our diggers ready and have a look and then, and then!" $HeOrShe claps $hisOrHer hands together with a smack.

"Gunned in the back, we are! Hit from orbit with our shields down." The pirate waves an arm around, "Reactor breach on the one ship, blew half away the other. Real mess, had to scrub bits of my mates off my vac suit, I did."
entries.zh:
"宝藏？哦，老 Marlowe 的宝藏？" 那个海盗不屑地哼了一声。"什么都没有。至少这鸟地方肯定没有。"

"我们大老远跑来，这个脑子有问题的叛徒却一直叫嚣他知道 Marlowe 把财宝藏在这个星球上。我们带着挖掘设备跑过来，仔细找了一遍，然后，然后！" $HeOrShe猛地拍手，发出啪的一声。

"背后被来了发大的，我们！在护盾关闭的时候被从轨道上来的什么东西打中了。" 海盗挥了挥手，"一艘船上的反应堆破裂，另一艘船直接被炸掉了一半。真是一团糟，我还得自己擦掉真空服上队友的碎屑。"

entries.en:
"-ta sky if you don't answer, and burn Fenius to the bone! Rads and..." The $manOrWoman's face resolves mid-curse, and freezes in shock.

"It worked! I told ya," $heOrShe shouts to someone behind $himOrHer, "It's a $shipOrFleet burnin' above, a real one!"

$HeOrShe turns back, "You gotta get us off this rock! We're running low on supplies, and before long we'll have to be growing our own food in the dirt like.. like mud-loving Luddies!"
entries.zh:
"—— 老天啊，要是你再没回应，再不把 Fenius 烧成灰！辐..." 那个$manOrWoman的脸在咒骂中清晰起来，随即因震惊而僵住。

"成了！我就说能行。" $heOrShe向身后的人喊道，"天上真有个$shipOrFleet在烧推子！"

$HeOrShe转过身来，"你得让我们离开这块石头！我们的补给快用完了，要不了多久我们就得在土里种自己的食物，就像...就像那些热爱烂泥的卢德佬一样！"

entries.en: "Captain $playerName, my good friend!" The pirate puts on $hisOrHer best smile. "We're so glad you've come back. Perhaps you've considered ah, transporting us off this rock?"
entries.zh: "$playerName 舰长，我的好朋友！" 海盗露出了$hisOrHer最好的笑容。"我们很高兴你回来了。也许你考虑过，呃，把我们从这块石头上运走？"

entries.en: "Captain $playerName, my good friend!" The pirate puts on $hisOrHer best smile. "We're so glad you've come back. Perhaps you've had time to reconsider ah, transporting us off this rock?"
entries.zh: "$playerName 舰长，我的好朋友！" 海盗露出了$hisOrHer最好的笑容。"我们很高兴你回来了。也许你已经有时间重新考虑，呃，要不要把我们从这块石头上运走？"

o.en: Tell me about Old Marlowe's treasure.
o.zh: 和我介绍一下老 Marlowe 的宝藏吧。

o.en: What are you doing on this... rock?
o.zh: 你们在这...块石头上干什么？
是 '卢德信徒'，不是 '卢德佬'。

o.en: Offer them a place in your own fleet
o.zh: 提出让他们加入你的舰队

o.en: Offer to transport them to a pirate world
o.zh: 提出送他们去一个海盗世界

o.en: Offer to transport them to a pirate world (lie)
o.zh: 提出送他们去一个海盗世界 (说谎)

o.en: Offer to transport them... to prison
About going to prison? I'm telling you, not asking.
o.zh: 关于进监狱的事？我并没有在询问你，而是在通知你。

entries.en:
"Just what I need, more pirates to dispose of," $Post $personLastName says with a frown. "I trust you have some kind of evidence for their crimes? No, don't answer that. I'll have a subordinate handle the whole mess."

$HeOrShe has you wait as your comms are transferred to a security officer.
entries.zh:
"更多要我清理的海盗，好像我手上的还不够似的，" $Post $personLastName 皱眉说道。"我相信你有他们罪行的证据？不，不必回答。我会让属下来收拾这烂摊子。"

$HeOrShe让你待机等待通讯转给安保人员。

entries.en:
You assign your own subordinate in turn to coordinate the transfer of the pirates, their spirits much diminished by the time spent in your brig, to the local authorities.

The local bureaucracy alternates between impatient and bored with the entire proceeding.

Nonetheless, you manage to rid yourself of the entire crew in exchange for a modest reward. A not insignificant number of these individuals have criminal records, and a subset of those crimes fall under the jurisdiction of interfactional anti-piracy agreements which include a protocol to automatically pay out standing bounties.
entries.zh:
你安排了你的属下对接和当地官方交接海盗的事宜。长期关在你的紧闭室之中也明显打击了海盗们的精神。

当地官僚在整个过程中保持着要么无聊，要么不耐烦的态度。

不管怎样，你得以处理掉了这一伙人，并拿到了些许赏金。海盗中不少人有犯罪记录，而其中一些罪行在势力之间反海盗协议的规定下有自动发放赏金的程序。

entries.en:
"Oh, delightful: another disgusting herd of space trash come to smear grime on everything they don't steal." $Post $personLastName frowns dramatically. "Well, we know how to treat the criminal element here, trust me on that. I'll have my subordinate handle the mess."

$HeOrShe has you wait as your comms are transferred to a security officer.
entries.zh:
"哦，太好了；又一群恶心的太空垃圾来把他们还没偷走的东西也搞得一层灰。" $Post $personLastName 做作地皱了下眉头。"好了，我们知道怎么处理犯罪分子，这一点你可以相信我。我会让我的属下来收拾这个烂摊子。"

$HeOrShe让你待机等待通讯转给安保人员。

entries.en:
"Pirates, you say?" $Post $personLastName considers the matter with a frown. "It is a small thing, but removing this lot from the spaceways should increase profitability by a fraction of a percent, and every percent counts. I'll transfer you to someone who can make the correct arrangements."

$HeOrShe has you wait as your comms are forwarded to a security officer.
entries.zh:
"你说海盗？" $Post $personLastName 皱眉思索道。"这是件小事，但是把这帮人从航道上清理掉应能将收益略微提升不到一个百分点。而每一点都很重要。我会把你转接给能处理此事的人。"

$HeOrShe让你待机等待通讯转给安保人员。

entries.en:
"Ah, yet another pack of spacer criminals, sinners one and all." $Post $personLastName says with a frown. "Ludd forgive me, but I am thankful that I am not required to display saintly mercy in such matters. I'll have a subordinate handle the mess."

$HeOrShe has you wait as your comms are transferred to a security officer.
entries.zh:
"啊，又一批宇宙民罪犯，无一不是罪人。" $Post $personLastName 皱眉道。"卢德宽恕，但我确实庆幸在处理这些事上不需要体现圣人的慈悲。我会让属下来收拾这烂摊子"

$HeOrShe让你待机等待通讯转给安保人员。

entries.en:
"You bring me a pack of desperate sinners, captain. Just what am I to do with them?" $Post $personLastName's frown slowly evaporates. "With hammer and sword, I'm sure we'll think of something appropriate. I'll have a subordinate handle the whole mess."

$HeOrShe has you wait as your comms are transferred to a security officer.
entries.zh:
"你给我带来了一帮无路可走的罪人，舰长。你想让我把他们怎么样？" $Post $personLastName 紧皱的眉头渐渐舒缓。"以锤与剑之名，我相信我们总能想到合适的。我会让属下来收拾这个烂摊子。"

$HeOrShe让你待机等待通讯转给安保人员。

entries.en:
"Pirates? How... inefficient," $Post $personLastName says, distracted. "I'm sure I have someone who can handle them for you."

$HeOrShe has you wait as your comms are transferred to a security officer.
entries.zh:
"海盗？真是...浪费，" $Post $personLastName 心不在焉地说道。"我相信我手下有人能帮你处理他们。"

$HeOrShe让你待机等待通讯转给安保人员。

entries.en:
"Pirates," $Post $personLastName says with a vicious frown. "Chaos and insubordination follow piracy. Always, captain. Always." $HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer comms interface, "I'll have a subordinate handle the matter."

Your  comms are swiftly transferred to a security officer who makes the arrangements.
entries.zh:
"海盗，" $Post $personLastName 面色凶狠地皱着眉头。"混乱和逆反总是和海盗行为息息相关。向来如此。" $HeOrShe按了下$hisOrHer通讯台。"我会让属下来处理此事。"

通讯链接很快转给了能做相关安排的安保人员。

entries.en:
"Eh, it's a shame to see a good crew gone bad," $Post $personLastName says with a frown. "Well, send 'em over and I'll have someone process the lot."

$HeOrShe has your comms transferred to a security officer who makes the arrangements.
entries.zh:
"呃，看到好好一伙儿人走上歧路总是可惜。" $Post $personLastName 皱眉道，"好吧，把他们送过来，我会找人处理他们。"

$HeOrShe将通讯链接转给了能做相关安排的安保人员。

entries.en:
"You're just handing me a crew of pirates?" $Post $personLastName smiles wickedly. "Don't you worry, captain, I know how to take care of these sorts of things. Don't you worry one little bit. I'll have a subordinate, ah, handle the matter." $HeOrShe winks, suggesting some secretive means that you don't quite follow.

Before you can inquire, $heOrShe has your comms transferred to a security officer bearing a blank face and a dramatic scar.
entries.zh:
"你就直接把一帮海盗这么交给我了？" $Post $personLastName 邪恶地笑道。"别担心，舰长，我知道怎么处理这类问题。您一点都别担心。我会让个属下来，呃，处理此事。" $HeOrShe眨了眨眼，似乎在影射什么你不太明白的秘密。

在你能问个清楚之前，$heOrShe便将通讯链接转给了一位面无表情，但有一道夸张的伤疤的安保人员。

entries.en:
"Aye, surely," the pirate leader backtracks nervously. "I read you green and clear, 'Luddic faithful'."

The $manOrWoman nods enthusiastically, "Can't say I haven't prayed a bit meself from time to time," then over $hisOrHer shoulder "Isn't that right? You saw me prayin' that time."

The pirate turns back to you, "We all agree, um, my fellow $playerBrotherOrSister. Now, can you take us aboard? We're good spacers, can work our way."
entries.zh:
"是的，当然，" 海盗首领紧张地回道。"我听得一清二楚，他说的是 '卢德信徒'。"

这个$manOrWoman热情地点点头，"我有的时候也会祈祷一下，" 然后$hisOrHer又侧过身，"不是吗？那次你看到我祈祷了吧。"

海盗又把头转了回来："我们都同意，呃，我的$playerBrotherOrSister。现在，你能带我们上船吗？我们都是优秀的宇宙民，会努力工作的。"

entries.en:
The pirate looks at you for a long moment.

"Can't promise I can find him, can't promise he really knows where Marlowe's loot is. Fenius is a slippery worm, he is."

"But if you get me and my crew off this rock and into a nice safe pirate port, then I'll help you. I'll help you 'cause I could use some revenging on Fenius," $heOrShe curls $hisOrHer hands into fists and knocks them together. "We'll find him, then you can wring him for information and wring him hard."
entries.zh:
海盗凝视了你很久。

"我不能保证一定能找到他，也不能保证他真的知道 Marlowe 的宝藏在哪里。因为 Fenius 这家伙就是条狡猾的臭虫。"

"但如果你能把我和我的人从这块石头上弄到个安全的海盗港口，我就帮你。我早就想给 Fenius 这家伙狠狠上一课，" $heOrShe双手握拳，然后敲在一起。"等我们找到他之后，你就可以为所欲为地榨取他的信息了。"

o.en: I'll deal with Fenius as I see fit.
o.zh: 我会以我觉得合适的方式处理 Fenius。

o.en: How do I know I can trust you?
o.zh: 我怎么知道我能否信任你？

entries.en: "'Course you will, captain, 'course you will." The pirate nods obediently. "But I know Fenius, and he ain't spilling the truth unless you make it hurt. Just helping you with my knowledge, I am. I know my place."
entries.zh: "舰长，您当然可以按您的想法来。您怎么样都行。" 海盗顺从地点点头，"但我很了解 Fenius，除非你让他痛苦，否则他嘴里是冒不出一句实话的。我只是想用我的知识来帮助你。我很清楚自己的位置。"

entries.en: "Can't," $heOrShe shrugs. "But you've got me, an honest pirate, at the bottom of a big ol' gravwell, so I've not got much to negotiate with."
entries.zh: "不能，" $heOrShe耸耸肩，"但现在我就是个栽在这重力大坑里一老实巴交的海盗，就让你给逮着了，我也没啥能谈判的筹码。"

entries.en: "As you will, captain, as you will. "
entries.zh: "您说了算，舰长，您说了算。"

entries.en:
The pirate barks a laugh, then stops suddenly.

"You serious?" $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head, "No, no. We're free spirits, you see. In prison, our uh human essence wouldn't have a chance to, uh, flourish."

"Better to be stuck on a rock then stuck IN a rock with a Heggie watching you at all your personal businesses, right? That's what I think."
entries.zh:
海盗大笑，然后突然停了下来。

"你认真的吗？" $HeOrShe摇摇头，"不，不。你看，我们是自由的灵魂。在监狱里，我们的人性就没有机会，呃，充分发展。"

"被困在岩石上总比被困在岩石里的同时又被霸主那些狗官监视着你所有私事要好对吧？至少我是这么想的。"

entries.en:
Understanding crosses the pirates face, and $hisOrHer expression closes, hostile.

"Yeah? You and what army."
entries.zh:
理解的神色从海盗的脸上转瞬即逝，$hisOrHer摆出了一副臭脸。

"咋了？你手里还有什么臭鱼烂虾？"

o.zh: 那可不是什么臭鱼烂虾。 (准备陆战队劫掠)

o.en: Mind your tone. I'm the one with warships in orbit.
o.zh: 注意你的语气。轨道上停着的可是我的战舰。

entries.en: $HeOrShe raises $hisOrHer hands, "Not me making threats, captain. We're just honest folk looking for a way home."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe举起$hisOrHer双手，"我们可没有发出威胁，舰长。我们只是一帮想回家的乡亲们。"

entries.en:
"If you're offering transport, you are... we'd need 54 crew berths to take what's left of the gang. Though if we're just countin' real flesh-and-blood arms and legs, they'd only count for forty or so," the pirate laughs grimly.

"We're experienced crew, spacers one and all that can work our way home. You'll not have a more loyal pack of rogues!"
entries.zh:
"如果你愿意提供交通工具，那你... 我们需要 54 间船员宿舍来容纳帮派里剩下的人。虽然如果按照真肉做的手臂和腿脚来算的话，大概只能数出四十多个。" 这位海盗冷酷地笑着说。

"我们都是有经验的船员，纯纯正正的太空佬，精明能干。你找不到比这更忠诚的一帮流氓了！"

entries.en: "Eh," $HeOrShe rubs $hisOrHer chin. "Beats sitting on this rock 'til we turn blue."
entries.zh: "呃，" $HeOrShe揉了揉$hisOrHer的下巴。"我们在实在受不住之前会一直坐在这块石头上。"

entries.en: "Seeing as how you're all, ah, a Luddic Faithful. And with respect, $playerBrotherOrSister - and I ask only on behalf of a handful of my less spiritually illuminated comrades - would we have to be doing praying all official like? And living piously or whatnot?"
entries.zh: "既然你们都是卢德信徒，啊。恕我直言，$playerBrotherOrSister —— 我只代表我少数精神上不那么光明的同志们提问 —— 我们必须正式地祈祷吗？并且必须虔诚地生活吗？"

o.en: Yes, I will require that you live in accordance with Luddic principles.
o.zh: 是的，我会要求你按照卢德的信条生活。

o.en: No, my crew is free to practice their own beliefs. Or lack thereof.
o.zh: 不，我的船员可以自由地实践自己的信仰。也可以不信仰这些。

entries.en: "Glad to hear it!" $HeOrShe lets out a sigh of relief, "Very forward-thinking you are, and uh, blessing of good ol' Ludd on you and what-like."
entries.zh: "太棒了！" $HeOrShe松了一口气，"您真是有远见，呃，愿卢德保佑你什么的。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe lets out a long sigh. "Well, then we'll be on blessed good behavior like a pack of curates then, we will."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe长叹一声。"好吧，那么我们会表现得像一群祭司一样，我们会遵守教义。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe lets out a long sigh. "Well, then we'll be on blessed good behavior like a pack of curates then, we will."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe长叹一声。"好吧，那么我们会表现得像一群祭司一样，我们会遵守教义。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe lets out a long sigh. "Well, then we'll be on blessed good behavior like a pack of curates then, we will."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe长叹一声。"好吧，那么我们会表现得像一群祭司一样，我们会遵守教义。"

"If you're offering work, you are... we'd need 54 crew berths to take what's left of the gang. Though if we're just countin' real flesh-and-blood arms and legs, they'd only count for forty or so," the pirate laughs grimly.

"We're experienced crew, spacers one and all. You'll not have a more loyal pack of rogues!"
