"如果你愿意提供工作，那你... 我们需要 54 间船员宿舍来容纳帮派里剩下的人。虽然如果按照真肉做的手臂和腿脚来算的话，大概只能数出四十多个。" 这位海盗冷酷地笑着说。

"我们都是有经验的船员，纯纯正正的太空佬。你找不到比这更忠诚的一帮流氓了！"

entries.en: You've arrived at a suitably lawless starport to offload the formerly marooned pirates you rescued.
entries.zh: 你来到了一个足够无法无天的太空港，正合适{卸下你救下来的受困海盗们}。

o.zh: 用穿梭机把受困的海盗送到 $name

o.en: No, tell them it'll be the next stop at a suitable port.
o.zh: 不，告诉他们下一站会停在一个更好的港口。

entries.en:
The pirate crew cheers as they are off-boarded, shouting boasts and singing an off-color song about the variety of substances they plan to abuse. Others, grim-faced, mutter grisly plans to revenge themselves upon Fenius and his crew.

A handful of pirates wish to remain in your employment, offering to forgo the usual signing bonus due to your generosity. Those who have approval from both your security chief and their section leaders are allowed to remain.
entries.zh:
海盗们欢呼着下了船，彼此之间哼着吹嘘他们接下来要嗑什么乱七八糟东西的粗俗小曲儿。另一些面色沉重的家伙则低声琢磨着报复 Fenius 一伙人的计划。

少数海盗则自愿留下来替你工作，并且因为你的慷慨同意不要标准的签约奖金。同时得到你的安全主管和其手下小组长们认可的那些人得以留了下来。

entries.en: You've arrived at a suitably lawless starport to offload the formerly marooned pirates you rescued. They are eager to go, as they've found that Luddic discipline is a poor fit for their swashbuckling lifestyle.
entries.zh: 你来到了另一个足够无法无天的太空港，正合适{卸下你救下来的受困海盗们}。海盗们普遍认为卢德教义的严谨纪律实在和他们刀尖上舔血的生活方式不太适合，因此都迫不及待地想要离开。

o.zh: 用穿梭机把海盗们送到 $name

entries.en:
Once they're a safe distance from the ramps of the shuttles, the pirates cheer in relief from the discipline you imposed, shouting and singing about the various substances they plan to abuse. Others mutter grisly plans to revenge themselves upon Fenius and his crew.

A single member of the pirates, having become quite taken with Luddism, wishes to remain in your employment. They forgo the usual signing bonus due to your charity and, with approval from both your security chief and their section leader, are allowed to remain.
entries.zh:
当他们离开穿梭机的闸道一段安全距离后，海盗们瞬间欢呼雀跃，为你们强加的纪律感到如释重负，他们大喊大叫，唱着他们准备滥用的各种药物。其他人则喃喃自语，计划向 Fenius 和他的船员复仇。

海盗们中有一个人对卢德教颇有好感，希望继续受雇于你。因为对你的感激，而放弃了常规的签约奖金。经你的安全主管和其手下小组长们的批准，此人被允许留下。

entries.en: You've arrived at the next suitably lawless starport to offload the formerly marooned pirates you rescued.
entries.zh: 你来到了另一个足够无法无天的太空港，正合适{卸下你救下来的受困海盗们}。

o.zh: 用穿梭机把受困的海盗送到 $name

entries.en: There's grumbling from the pirates, but they accept your promise that the next port will be their last stop.
entries.zh: 海盗们颇有微词，但是他们接受了你保证下一个太空港就是最后一站的承诺。

o.en: Inquire about turning a crew of pirates over to official custody
o.zh: 询问将这一帮海盗交给官方关押的安排

o.en: Inquire about turning a crew of pirates over to official custody
o.zh: 询问将这一帮海盗交给官方关押的安排

o.en: Inquire about turning a crew of pirates over to official custody
o.zh: 询问将这一帮海盗交给官方关押的安排

o.en: Inquire about turning a crew of pirates over to official custody
o.zh: 询问将这一帮海盗交给官方关押的安排

entries.en:
You call for a halt to the raid and consider your options.

If nothing else, the pirate leader must be sweating in the e-shelter down on the surface. Wondering what you're planning, waiting for the flash and bang of a hostile breach.
entries.zh:
你喊停了劫掠，考虑你手上的选项。

别的不说，海盗头子现在肯定在地面上某个紧急避难所里满头是汗地猜测着你的计划，并等待着武力突破的爆炸和火光。

entries.en:
Your officers were conservative in planning, crafting an imaginative tactical scenario which assumed the pirates possess all sorts of armaments and preparation which, in the end, they did not: anti-armor capability, a drone recon network, sentry turrets, field fortifications, and finally an EW-proof ghost gun ambush.

In the end, the operation is a simple matter of cutting the lights then punching through flimsy shelter walls to stun-round those few pirates with live firearms detected and flagged by the marines' personal combat radar.

They missed the hand-made bomb, however.
entries.zh:
你的军官们做了慎密的筹划，精心考虑了一整套天马行空的战术情景，假设海盗持有各类武装且防备周密。然而到头来，他们什么都没有，没有反装甲能力，无人机侦察网络，哨戒炮台，阵地工事，更没有什么免疫电子战的土制枪械伏击。

到头来，这次行动只是简单地掐断灯火之后从藏身处薄弱的外墙开洞进去，接着给陆战队员个人战斗雷达探出来的少数几个持有火器的海盗喂点震撼弹。

但是他们还真没料到那个土炸弹。

entries.en:
The pirate leader is justifiably defeated-looking, ashamed at being taken so easily despite the circumstances.

The pirates are removed to the $shipOrFleet brigs, packed closer than even the minimal comforts of the lowest crewmember's berth.
entries.zh:
海盗头目理所当然地一脸沮丧，即便是在这样窘迫的情况下，如此被轻易俘虏还是会感到羞愧。

海盗们被转移到$shipOrFleet上，他们挤在一起，享受着比最底层船员还要差的舒适待遇。

entries.en:
You convene your officers to plan a raid to capture the pirates so that they might be brought to justice and, it is safe to assume, result in an appropriate bounty payout.

The pirates are few in number and woefully undersupplied.
entries.zh:
你召集了你的军官来策划一次抓捕海盗们的劫掠行动，以便将他们绳之以法，而且，不难推测，这可以提供不少的悬赏报酬。

海盗们数量稀少且很不幸地缺乏补给。

entries.en: Amid the low-priority updates you receive upon entering the colonial datasphere, a minor report is flagged for your attention.
entries.zh: 在进入殖民地数据领域后，你收到一些低优先级的更新，其中有一份次要报告被{标记着等待你的处理}。

entries.en:
A small crew of stranded pirates was rescued from emergency shelters near a wrecked spacecraft in a remote province on the surface of $name.

Standing bounties on those pirates with sufficiently concerning criminal records have been distributed to the rescuers. The rest have been released to haunt the landing facilities, seeking menial jobs between opportunities to sign with newly arrived ships.

Colonial MuniSec is monitoring the situation.
entries.zh:
一小队海盗在 $name 表面的紧急避难所被救出，他们被困在偏远地区的废弃太空船附近。

那些有重大犯罪记录的海盗已被逮捕，赏金已分发给救援者。其余的海盗被释放，现在他们徘徊在登陆设施附近，尝试寻找新到达舰船上的船员工作。

殖民地地方安全部正在密切关注事态发展。

entries.en:
Upon entering orbit, your comms officer reports "$PlayerSirOrMadam, we're getting a signal. Point of origin from a wreck on the surface."

Sensors takes over the report, "Scan indicates debris spread and... a crater. Looks hot; radioactive. Disabled ship hull nearby. Looks like they got hit from orbit. And... survivors. Nearby, in emergency shelters."
entries.zh:
进入轨道后，你的通讯军官报告说："$PlayerSirOrMadam，我们收到信号。信号来自地表上的坠毁的舰船。"

传感器接收到报告："扫描显示有一地飞散的碎片和...一个弹坑。看起来很热，有放射性。附近的舰船船体有破损。看起来他们在轨道上被击中了。还有... 幸存者。很近，在一座紧急避难所里。"

entries.en:
Your comms officer reports that the communication signal from the surface is still active.

Sensors indicate the radioactive crater as well as a disabled ship remain. Emergency shelters with an active power source are set up nearby.
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官报告说，那个来自地表的联络信号仍然保持活跃。

传感器显示，放射性弹坑和坠毁的舰船仍然在原本的位置。附近设有带有电源的紧急避难所。

o.en: Connect comms to the signal from the surface
o.zh: 将通讯连接到来自地表的信号

o.en: Unfortunately, I don't have enough room.
o.zh: 很不幸，我没有足够的空间来安置你们。
我需要重新考虑我的选择。

o.en: Good. I'll have shuttles sent down.
o.zh: 很好。我会派穿梭机下去的。

o.en: Yes, yes... I'll send shuttles down to pick you up. (prepare the brig)
o.zh: 是啊，是啊... 我会派穿梭机来接你们上来的。 (准备禁闭室)

entries.en:
You send shuttles down - and have marines ready to escort the pirates to the brig for safekeeping.

Through a security feed, you watch as the shocked pirates step aboard your $shipOrFleet only to be restrained and escorted, shouting and cursing, to overcrowded cells.

Their trip back to the core worlds won't be pleasant or comfortable, but they won't take up any valuable crew berths.

Next step: find a figure of sufficient authority to reward you with a collective bounty for this mass arrest.
entries.zh:
你派穿梭机降落下去，让陆战队员准备押送海盗到禁闭室妥善看管。

通过安全信息，你看到震惊的海盗被束缚押送着登上你的$shipOrFleet，一边大喊大叫，一边咒骂着，来到拥挤的牢房。

他们返回核心世界的旅程注定不会舒适愉快，但他们不会占用任何宝贵的船员宿舍。

下一步：找一个有足够权威的人物来领取你这次大规模逮捕的大量赏金。

entries.en:
"Oh. Um." The pirate smiles nervously, "Perhaps you'll salvage something, maybe let someone know, or... make some room?" $heOrShe asks hopefully.

"That last one- just a joke! Nothing like a joke to pass the long days. Long... long, days," $heOrShe trails off.
entries.zh:
"哦，呃..." 这名海盗紧张地笑着，"也许你将会打捞什么东西，或者让谁留意一下，或者...想办法空出点位置？" $heOrShe满怀希望地问道。

"最后那个 —— 只是个玩笑！没什么能比一个笑话更能打发这漫长的日子了。这日子太漫长... 太漫长了。" $heOrShe的声音渐渐地低了下来。

entries.en: "Oh. Um." The pirate smiles nervously, "Don't let me get in the way of a good think, captain. You've got us at the bottom of a gravwell, we're at your mercy."
entries.zh: "哦。呃..." 海盗紧张地笑了笑。"别让我们影响您深思熟虑，舰长。我们现在可是栽在这重力大坑里了，任您宰割。"

entries.en:
You order shuttles sent to retrieve the pirates.

The former pirates are distributed widely among work crews and their communications tagged by your security chief. A close watch will be kept to ensure there's no mutinous scheme afoot, and that the pirates do indeed work their fare back to an appropriate spaceport.
entries.zh:
你派遣穿梭机将海盗们接了回来。

这些原海盗们被打散配属到了各类船员职位上。他们的通讯都由你的安全主管严密监视以确保他们不在暗中谋划造反，并且老老实实地干活挣出他们回港的船票。

entries.en:
You order shuttles sent to retrieve the pirates.

The former pirates are distributed widely among work crews and their communications tagged by your security officer. A close watch will be kept to ensure they are integrated into your $shipOrFleet and aren't planning to run any mutinous schemes.

After the first shift, your security officer reports that although the pirates are not adapting to their circumstances without incident, they seem genuinely enthusiastic about the prospect of food, pay, and interesting work.
entries.zh:
你派遣穿梭机将海盗们接了回来。

这些原海盗们被打散配属到了各类船员职位上。他们的通讯都由你的安保人员严密监视，以确保他们能够融入你的$shipOrFleet而非暗中谋划造反。

一个星历日之后，你的安保人员报告虽然这些海盗融入新环境的过程并非没有波折，但是他们看上去真的对有饭吃、有钱挣、有好活整的生活颇为上心。

entries.en:
"Ah, Ormon Fenius. Fenius the Outcast, he's called. The slimiest piece of trash that ever oozed from the mud of..."

$HeOrShe pauses, thoughtfully. "Come to think of it, I dunno where he's from. Somewhere awful where everyone lies, cheats, and steals from one another, probably."

At this, $heOrShe looks around, "'Course there's properly done lying, cheating, and stealing. Quite acceptable, using one's own wits to win a prize through clever work," $heOrShe thumps $hisOrHer chest, "That's my trade, it is! Cleverness and craft. Not like Fenius."
entries.zh:
"啊，那货叫 Ormon Fenius，也有的叫他浪子 Fenius 什么的。他这种最最下贱的垃圾崽种肯定是从..."

$HeOrShe说着说着突然停下了，好像在想着什么："这么一想，我还真不知道这崽种从哪片烂泥塘子爬出来的，多半也不是啥好地方，得是那种所有人都互相撒谎、行骗、盗窃的地方。"

说完这一句，$heOrShe又向四周张望了一下："自然，撒谎行骗盗窃啥的也不是坏事，这种事也有正当的，毕竟也是用聪明才智获得收入的一种手段嘛。" $heOrShe顺势拍了下$hisOrHer自己的胸口，"对咯！我也是干这行的，不过我用的是自己的聪明才智，和 Fenius 那个崽种可不一样。"

entries.en:
"Fenius, why he'll lie, cheat, and steal for anything, from anyone. The man has no honor! And, and," the pirate is getting worked up, standing to shout, "He's no fun!"

No fun. The worst of crimes.

The pirate sits, calming down. "He let us land so we could get Marlowe's stash, then blasted our ships from orbit and took off. One reactor went critical, the other... well, just failed. But the previous, ah, owner of my ship thought to have survival equipment. So here we are."
entries.zh:
"Fenius 这货，为啥不管见了谁都是撒谎、行骗、盗窃？就因为他没有荣耀可言！他还，他还..." 海盗说着说着渐渐兴奋起来，大喊着直接站了起来，"他还没意思！"

没意思，那可还真是个大罪。

海盗终于坐了下来，冷静了一些："那崽种让我们在这降落，说这里就能找到 Marlowe 的财宝，然后他自己从轨道上对我们的船一通猛射，之后脚底一抹油，溜了。我们一个反应堆临界了，另一个...就，直接报废了。但我这艘船的，啊，上一任主人考虑周全，给我们留了生存装备，这才让我们挨到了现在。"

entries.en:
"Ah, Old Marlowe!" The pirate gets almost misty eyed, "Now there was a pirate. He could drink! Oh, how he drank. And fight! Bloodthirsty, he was, would shoot you in the front, back, side - any direction he could get. Whatever it took to win."

"Well, he weren't exactly a nice man. And when he gambled, he cheated. Oh, how he cheated! A sight to see, I tell you. Anyway, eventually he cheated the wrong mark and," $heOrShe makes a gun-shape with $hisOrHer hand and motions firing it, making a wet noise. $HeOrShe uses the other hand to indicate a generous volume of splatter from the exit wound, if you're interpreting the body language correctly.
entries.zh:
"啊，老 Marlowe 诶！" 对面的海盗眼里瞬间泛起泪光，"那才叫真正的海盗。他那酒量简直绝了！哦，你是不知道他多能喝。他还很能打！那个嗜血狂魔，管你过来是正面、背面还是侧面，只要抓住机会他就往死里开枪。为了能赢，他什么招都使得出来。"

"其实吧，他确实不算什么好人。只要一下注赌钱，他就耍赖出千。哦，真不知道他哪来的那么多赖招！我就跟你讲，他出千，绝了。可怎么说呢，他最后到底是坑错了人，然后嘛..." $heOrShe一只手比成枪做了个开火的动作，嘴里配合着发出吧唧一声，用另一只手比划出那人被射了个对穿，血肉飞溅的场面，如果你没理解错这一通肢体语言的话。

entries.en:
"Marlowe was rich, see. Big rich, real rich. But no one's found his stash. Thought we might 'cause I was stupid enough to trust Fenius, despite his reputation..."

$HeOrShe slumps down, now that the excitement of Marlowe's story is over. "So here we are."
entries.zh:
"Marlowe 他就是富，巨富，超富。但没人找到过他的财宝。我还以为我们能找到呢，要么也不至于着了 Fenius 这货的道，忘了他以前就..."

Marlowe 故事的兴奋劲一过，$HeOrShe立马瘫坐下去："所以我们就到这里了。"

entries.en: The pirate grins, glad for an appreciative audience.
entries.zh: 海盗咧嘴一笑，为自己找到了个懂欣赏的听众而欣喜着。

entries.en:
"The rad-blasted betrayer Fenius left us here! Told us he knew where Old Marlowe buried a stash. Stash o' lies, more like," $heOrShe spits voluminously, and hatefully.

"Took all the ships and what little loot... er, cargo, that is. Legitimate salvage and digging equipment! That's us, legitimate salvors done in by a bad lot and left here to die in the dirt. Like, like Luddie worms!"

The $manOrWoman looks pained, "It's no way for a spacer to die, down here. Take us up, captain. We'll be good to ya."
entries.zh:
"那个活该该被辐射轰死的叛徒崽种 Fenius 把我们撂这了，切，他还跟我说他知道老 Marlowe 在哪藏了财宝呢，藏了狗屁财宝！" $heOrShe直接就是一顿臭骂，恨意溢于言表。

"那崽种把我们所有船都报废了，还毁了我们仅剩的赃...啊，货物，对是货物。那可全都是合法的打捞挖掘设备呢！结果我们就沦落到这了，明明是一帮遵纪守法的打捞工人，却被这么欺负，最后还被撂在这泥巴球上等死，就，就和那帮子卢德佬一样。"

那$manOrWoman看起来确实很痛苦："咱太空佬可不能死在地上，死在这地方。舰长，捎我们一程，我们可不会亏待了你。"

entries.en:
The clink of teacups is suddenly overcome by a shout and a crash.

"Demon! Servant of Moloch, follower of Mammon!" A disheveled figure with a scraggly beard leaps on a table, leveling a pistol toward you, "I walk the Path! I strike at you with the Hammer of-"
entries.zh:
茶杯的叮当声突然被一阵碰撞和一声大喊所覆盖。

"恶魔！摩洛克的仆人，玛门的追随者！" 一个头发凌乱、胡子拉碴的人跳到桌子上举起手枪对着你，"我行走于卢德之径！我将以卢德之锤将你 ——"

entries.en:
A series of dull cracks signals your guards' suppressed low-penetration fire and the assassin falls like a ragdoll.

The samovar behind him, indented by a through-shot, leaks a steady patter of hot water into a growing pool of blood on the table.
entries.zh:
一串沉闷的枪响表明你的警卫们进行了消声低穿透力射击，刺客就像一个破布娃娃一样应声倒下。

他身后的茶炊被流弹打凹了下去，茶水潺潺而出，漏到了桌子上逐渐绽开的血泊里。

entries.en:
Local MuniSec holds you, your guards, and a few witnesses until a mid-rank Knight of Ludd can make a ruling on the situation. The case for self-defense is clear-cut - witnesses swear holy oaths to this - and the licensing of your protective weapons is accepted.

"A child, led astray," the Knight says gruffly as the would-be assassin is wrapped in a simple shroud and taken away. Their eyes turn to you, "Your pride sows wrath, and it bears this bloody fruit."

After a pointed silence, they say, "You and yours; go now. What's here is done."

"...So I pray," the Knight mutters as you turn away.
entries.zh:
地方安全部控制住了你和你的警卫，以及几位目击者，直到一位中阶卢德骑士终于对情况做出裁定。正当防卫的事实显而易见，目击者对其所见所闻宣以圣誓，并且你的自卫武器许可也都真实有效。

"一位被引入歧途的孩子。" 当这名刺杀未遂的刺客被朴实无华的裹尸布裹起带走之后，骑士哀叹道。人们的目光随之转向了你，"你的傲慢播下了愤怒，最终收获了这血腥的结果。"

在一段突兀的沉默后他们说："你和你的人；现在走吧。这里发生的事已经了结了。"

"...我祈祷如此，" 在你转身离开时，骑士低声说道。

entries.en: Player Luddic attitude set to Atheist
entries.zh: 玩家的卢德信仰设定为 无神论者

entries.en: Player Luddic attitude set to Cynical
entries.zh: 玩家的卢德信仰设定为 轻蔑者

o.en: Player met Cotton and sat to have tea
o.zh: Player met Cotton and sat to have tea

entries.en: Player set to have met Brother Cotton, and to have sat down with him (indicating that they will talk to Pathers)
entries.zh: 玩家已被设定为已见过科顿修士，并与之坐下交谈（表明他们将与左径狂信徒交谈）

entries.en: Player set to have radicalized Ned Boot, the Initiate met at the Hesperus Shrine
entries.zh: 设定玩家已经将 Hesperus 圣地 遇到的 学徒修士，Ned Boot，转化为激进分子。

entries.en: Player Luddic attitude set to Pather
entries.zh: 玩家的卢德信仰设定为 卢德左径

entries.en: Player Luddic attitude set to Faithful
entries.zh: 玩家的卢德信仰设定为 虔信者

entries.en: Player set to have acquired Loke via a Raid on Epiphany
entries.zh: 设定玩家已经通过袭击 Epiphany 抓获了 Loke

entries.en:
You pour yourself some water and have a sip. It is cold, and it is good.

It is almost disturbingly unlike the water from your own ship, purified from cometary ice, generally, and infused with certain standard additives.
entries.zh:
你自己倒了点水，喝了一口，凉的，但是很好喝。

它和你的星舰上的水有本质上的不同，似乎是从彗星上的冰提纯而来，并且加入了某些标准添加剂。

entries.en: You exit the sanctum, still pondering what you saw and, perhaps, felt.
entries.zh: 你走出密室，思考着你所看到，或许还有感觉到的。

entries.en: You've made a contribution recently so providing another at this time might be viewed as an unseemly act of pride.
entries.zh: 你最近已经做过捐赠了，过多的捐赠会被视为傲慢的举动。

entries.en: You inquire with the subcurate about the possibility of contributing to the maintenance of this holy site. With a warm smile, the subcurate explains that an offering of 10 units of supplies would do much to assist the Church in its observance of sacred duties.
entries.zh: 你询问助理祭司是否可以为这片圣迹的维护提供捐助。助理祭司带着热情的微笑解释说，10 单位的补给便可大大助于教会履行其神圣的职责。

entries.en:
You inquire with the subcurate about the possibility of contributing to the maintenance of this holy site. An offering of 10 units of supplies would do much to assist the Church in its observance of sacred duties. Unfortunately you do not have enough supplies on hand.

The subcurate gives a sad smile. "I see that your intent is good. Perhaps you would like to partake of the charity meal we offer each shift?"
entries.zh:
你询问助理祭司是否可以为这片圣迹的维护提供捐助。10 单位的补给便可大大助于教会履行其神圣的职责。不幸的是，你手头没有足够的补给。

助理祭司向你回以一个黯然的微笑，"你的好意我心领了。也许你可能会需要一份我们每天提供的布施餐？"

entries.en:
The attendant receives your request with only the subtlest disapproval. To your surprise, a subcurate approaches to escort you to the shrine's viewing chamber.

A vast, dim gallery opens upon a hundred-meter diamond plate window allowing a full view of the glory of Kumari Aru. Here, pilgrims quietly contemplate the miracle of Creation, taking in the sublime and terrible beauty of the gas giant looming below. Storm systems the size of a standard terrestrial world churn with slow majesty, inner-lit with green-violet sheet lightning, teeming with xenolife.

Does something incomprehensible look up from the lee of a dark cloudbank at the bright point in that alien sky?
entries.zh:
圣务侍接受了你的请求，只是稍显不悦。出乎你意料的是，一名助理祭司走了过来，领你去了圣地的观礼室。

一个巨大而昏暗的回廊围绕着一扇百米宽的菱形窗口展开，让人得以一览 Kumari Aru 的壮丽美景。在这里，朝圣者们冥思创世者的神迹，体验下方赫然耸立的气态巨行星所展现出的庄严敬畏之美。规模相当于一个标准的类地星球风暴系统缓慢而威严地翻腾着，大片绿紫色的雷电不时闪烁其中，孕育着数不尽的异种生命。

不知在那阴暗的云层之下，是否有什么难以名状之物正抬头望着它们的天空中的亮点？

entries.en:
At the landing pad, you are met by a solemn Luddic Knight. A Knight Initiate stands a few paces behind, trying to match the ease and calm of their superior.

"Captain $PlayerName," the Knight says, "Let me speak welcome on behalf of the Church of Galactic Redemption. I extend to you an invitation from the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis to meet and share refreshment."

The Knight stands aside, motioning with gauntlet to invite you to walk toward the administrative structures.
entries.zh:
在停机坪上，一位庄严的卢德骑士正等着你的到来。一名新晋骑士站在他身后几步远的地方，试图模仿前辈的从容镇静。

"$PlayerName 舰长，" 骑士说，"请允许我代表 银河救赎教会 表示欢迎。同时，我谨代表 Jaspis 宗师大人向你发来会面和共进茶点的邀请。"

骑士站到一旁，用戴着臂铠的手邀请你向行政建筑群进发。

entries.en:
The Knight's eyebrows shoot up in surprise. With a blink the Knight recovers composure, and says "Y... es. Of course. This is a request, not a demand. Although. The Reverend Archcurate." A moment's pause. "She suggested that I insist, if necessary."

Beneath the solemnity, the Knight's look pleads for you to not put them in the awkward situation of denying the Archcurate.

You mentally review your model of the Church hierarchy: the Archcurate Conclave is the crown of the Church, meeting or sending representatives to perform the rulings that determine the highest matters; interpreting the canon of Ludd, sanctification, holy law, excommunication. If the Church has rulers, this Archcurate is among them.
entries.zh:
骑士惊讶的扬起眉毛，随即便恢复了镇静，说道，"是...是的，当然了。这是个请求而非命令。即便宗师大人她..." 他停顿了一下，"她建议我在必要时坚持一下。"

在这种庄重的氛围下，骑士恳求你不要让他们因你的抗命而陷入尴尬的境地。

你回想了一下教会的等级制度：教宗密会是教会的最高权力机关。他们有权举行会议或派出代表来裁决教会的事务，此外还能解读卢德的教义、提拔某人、制定圣典或是将某人逐出教会。如果说教会有统治者的话，那这位大祭司一定是其中之一。

o.en: I've changed my mind. Lead on.

entries.en: The Knight simply makes a small bow in acknowledgement of your description of the Archurate. You suppose they're being politic.
entries.zh: 骑士只是简单颔首，默认了你对大祭司的描述。你觉得他们对此很谨慎。

entries.en: "I know not. It is my duty to extend this hospitality on behalf of the Reverend Archcurate," the Knight says, then with a thought adds, "You are accused of no heresy, or secular crime. Your safety is my duty."
entries.zh: "我不知道。我仅仅是代表宗师大人向您问好。" 骑士说到，思考了一下又开始补充，"您并没有被指控为异端，或是犯下有违教规的罪行。确保您的安全是我的职责。"

entries.en:
At the landing pad, you are met by a solemn Luddic Knight. A Knight Initiate stands a few paces behind, trying to match the ease and calm of their superior.

"Captain $PlayerName," the Knight says, "Let me once again speak welcome on behalf of the Church of Galactic Redemption. I extend to you an invitation from the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis to meet and share refreshment."

The knight stands aside, motioning with gauntlet to invite you to walk toward the administrative structures.
entries.zh:
在停机坪上，一位庄严的卢德骑士正等着你的到来。一名新晋骑士站在他身后几步远的地方，试图模仿前辈的从容镇静。

"$PlayerName 舰长，" 骑士说，"请允许我再度代表银河救赎教会表示欢迎。同时，我谨代表 Jaspis 宗师大人向你发来会面和共进茶点的邀请。"

骑士站到一旁，用戴着臂铠的手邀请你向行政建筑群进发。

entries.en:
You are led by the Knight through gardens and the soaring arcades of Luddic Church architecture: half-remembered dreams of gothic cathedrals given flight by the material science of the Domain. It might be thought impertinent to mention this aspect of the construction, of course.

The Knight-Initiate follows behind, footsteps echoing between arched portals, over slate tiles flecked with glittering pyrite like stars in the night.
entries.zh:
骑士带着你穿过了花园与卢德教会建筑群中高耸的拱廊，这种几乎要被世人遗忘的哥特式教堂，竟然被人之领材料学的奇迹腾飞至如此的高度。当然，在这里提到这一点一定会被当做无礼之徒。

新晋骑士紧随其后，脚步声在拱形的大门之间回响。而你们脚下的地板则被发光的黄铁矿点缀着，如同夜空中的星星。

o.en: Does every successful pilgrim get to meet the Archcurate?
o.zh: 每一个成功的朝圣者都能见到大祭司吗？

o.en: Why am I receiving this treatment?
o.zh: 为什么你们这样对待我？

entries.en:
The Knight looks back at you, half-cape fluttering over carefully secured weaponry, with an expression that yours is a stupid question. The tone of the reply is firmly neutral, however.

"No, captain. The Reverend Archcurate requested a meeting with you specifically."
entries.zh:
骑士转身看向你，单肩披风随之扬起，露出了下面还稳妥地挂在身上的武器。那表情在说你的问题真蠢，但是回答的语气却带着一种强硬的中立。

"不，舰长。宗师大人特别指明要和你会面。"

entries.en: "I know not, captain, and could not say," the Knight says crisply, eyes forward.
entries.zh: "我不知道，也不能说，舰长。" 骑士目不斜视，干脆地说。

entries.en:
You pass through wooden doors and halls carpeted in designs of foliage and fauna, presumably of Old Earth: a fawn, a whale; hawks and dragons circling in a blue sky wreathed with leaves of ivy, oak, and palm.

The Archcurate's office appears relatively austere at first glance, but as your eyes adjust, hand-carved wooden paneling emerges, their faces packed with small plants and figures both human and animal. The room is situated to overlook a private atrium-garden. A shaft of sunlight illuminates flowers and catches the softly trickling drops of a fountain.
entries.zh:
你穿过了铺满树叶与动物图案的门和大厅。这些图案似乎来自于古地球：一只小鹿，一头鲸鱼；鹰和龙在布满常春藤、橡树和棕榈叶的蓝天上盘旋。

乍一看，大祭司的办公室显得相对朴素。但随着你仔细观察，却发现了手工雕刻的木质镶条，其上刻满了动植物还有人的图案。这房间的位置刚好能俯瞰私人空中花园；一缕阳光照亮了园中的花海，喷泉的水珠也在阳光中闪动。

entries.en:
"Your Excellency," the Knight calls out too loudly for the space, and bows to the figure within.

The Archcurate Jaspis turns toward you, closing a thick book.

"Come before me, captain," she says. "I would share with you a pot of tea, and my hospitality. Knight Ailanthus, you have my thanks and may leave us be."

A metal carafe with a long handle steams on a heating element, a pot and two simple cups beside.
entries.zh:
"阁下，" 骑士声如洪钟，向里面的人鞠躬致意。

Jaspis 大祭司转身朝向你，同时合上一本厚厚的书。

"坐到我身前来，舰长，" 她开口道，"我愿意与您分享一壶茶及我对客人的欢迎。骑士 Ailanthus ，感谢您的帮助，请让我俩独处吧。"

一个长柄金属水瓶正在加热元件上吐着蒸汽，旁边放着一个茶壶和两个朴实的茶杯。

entries.en: "Water then, if it please you." Her hand opens to indicate a pitcher in the corner, her gaze fixed somewhere past you.
entries.zh: "想喝点水的话，请自便。" 她张手示意角落里的一个陶罐，目光凝视着你身侧的某个地方。

o.en: You wanted to see me. I'm here. Let's get to the point.
o.zh: 你想要见我，所以我来了。让我们开门见山吧。

entries.en: "It is a ritual of welcome, captain," she says as if to a small child, then adds with unexpected acid, "You needn't drink the bedamned tea, or the water, but by Ludd's good grace, accept a gift given."
entries.zh: "这不过是为了表达欢迎之意。" 她的言语像是在安抚一个孩童，却又隐含几分尖刻，"不愿意喝茶或喝水是无妨，但还请接受他人的好意，就当是看在卢德的份上。"

o.en: I don't believe an Archcurate should speak like that.
o.zh: 我不觉得一位大祭司会这样子说话。

o.en: It is my policy not to owe anyone anything.
o.zh: 不欠任何人任何事是我的个人信条。

entries.en: She scoffs. "Oh, so after right and truly blundering the greeting I laid before you, now you are the master of Church affairs? Even I can see plain how you've made such an impression on the ecumene."
entries.zh: 她讥讽道："哦？我之前问候你的时候，你毫无疑问是犯蠢了，结果现在反倒是由你来主持教会事务？这下就连我都能一眼看出，你到底是怎么给世间留下这种印象的了。"

entries.en: "As charming of wit and tongue as hearsay suggested, you must enliven celebration and negotiation in equal part. Even now I find my own self contemplating the necessity of bothering to show hospitality at all."
entries.zh: "传闻你幽默风趣，巧舌如簧，那你也一定能把庆祝和谈判的氛围炒热吧。就算是现在我也在考虑，到底有没有必要展现出一丁点殷勤好客的意思。"

entries.en:
She grabs the long handle of the carafe. "Drink the tea or not. I shall now make it," she says, and gaze still unfocused, fills the teapot.

She is quite blind, you realize.
entries.zh:
她握住水壶的握把，"不论你愿不愿意喝，我都会把茶倒好，" 她边说边动手倒满了茶壶，双眼全程都未曾聚焦。

你意识到，她已目盲。

entries.en:
"Then I share with you water drawn from the well of my home, and my hospitality with it," she says, all part of the ritual. She gets up and retrieves the pitcher of water, placing it next to the tea pot.

Her gaze is still unfocused. She is quite blind, you realize, as she  takes the handle of the carafe of boiling water, and without looking, fills the teapot.
entries.zh:
"那么为了表现我的好客之心，我将与你分享从我家中水井里提的水。" 言下之意，这都是仪式的一部分。她起身端起陶制水灌，把它摆在茶壶旁边。

她的双眼依然未曾聚焦，你意识到她早已目盲。从握住煮沸的水壶握把，到装满茶壶，全程她都没用眼睛去看。

entries.en:
She takes the handle of the carafe of boiling water, and without looking, gaze still unfocused, fills the teapot.

She is quite blind, you realize.
entries.zh:
她握住装了开水的水壶的握把，不看一眼，目光涣散，却把茶壶沏满。

你意识到，她已目盲。

entries.en:
"That even I can see," she says without hesitation. "We both bear burdens with the grace the Creator saw fit to provide; for one, I give thanks that I was not made a boor."

She returns the carafe to the heating element, centering it perfectly.
entries.zh:
"即便如此我也能看明白。" 她没有丝毫迟疑地接了下去，"造物主赐予我们其认为合适的重担，并且我们都心怀感激地承载着；在一切之前，我得感激我没有作为俗人降生。"

她把水瓶放回了加热元件上，水瓶的落点完美居中。

o.en: Why did you invite me here?

entries.en: "Have water, if you will. My tea will be but a moment."
entries.zh: "如果你想就喝点水吧，茶要待会才好。"

entries.en: "Let us give the tea a moment, child."
entries.zh: "让我们等茶泡好吧，孩子。"

entries.en: She smiles thinly.
entries.zh: 她淡淡一笑。

entries.en:
"You made pilgrimage to the holy shrines of Ludd, you have made affinity with the Church and held compassion for the Faithful." She picks up a teacup and idly taps the side.

"'In my right hand I hold the hammer as my left is open for you to take.'" She says, quoting the Book of Ludd. "The hammer has place alongside the heart."
entries.zh:
"你曾朝拜了卢德的圣地，你与教会的关系亲和稳定，你对忠实的信徒充满怜悯。" 她拿起了一个茶杯，漫不经心地敲了敲。

"'我右手执锤，左手为你敞开。'" 她引用着卢德圣书，"锤与心，应同在。"

entries.en:
"You made pilgrimage to the holy shrines of Ludd, and yet you treat the Church with face dark and averted, speaking cutting words with false jocularity. You are bereft of affinity for the nicety of manners without suffering the years to earn that exalted state." She picks up a teacup and taps its side idly.

"A question sits restless in my mind: is your inclination a life of misjudgment led by directionless passion?"
entries.zh:
"你曾朝拜了卢德的圣地，却始终躲闪着我们、对教会冷面相待，带着虚伪的幽默抛出刻薄的言语。如果这般高贵的姿态不是遭受多年折磨所致，那或许你已经完全丧失了礼节感和亲和力。" 她拿起了一个茶杯，漫不经心地敲了敲。

"有个问题在我的脑海里挥之不去：被缺失方向的激情所误导的生活，这便是你的此生所向吗？"

entries.en:
"The militancy of your zeal has its admirers among the Faithful, but there is question that you are overquick to raise the hammer of wrath when the righteous path is oft led by the heart, and humbly so."

She picks up a teacup and taps its side idly.

"And yet, 'In my right hand I hold the hammer as my left is open for you to take.'" She says, quoting the Book of Ludd. "The hammer has a place."
entries.zh:
"信徒们都很欣赏你的战斗热情，问题在于，你常常过快地挥舞起暴怒的重锤了，要知道，正义之道通常是由内心谦卑地将你引上的。"

她拿起了一个茶杯，漫不经心地敲了敲。

"不过，'我右手执锤，左手为你敞开。'" 她引用着卢德圣书，"锤的确拥有一席之地。"

entries.en:
"You made pilgrimage to the holy shrines of Ludd. A taxing act to which the Faithful aspire. Yet you also take pain to keep distance from the Church, to hold nothing holy." She picks up a teacup and taps its side idly.

"I have not received you here to admonish or proselytize. If a struggle bedevils your soul, or if it is deaf to the songs of Creation, then that matter is for your own prayer and meditation."
entries.zh:
"你曾朝拜了卢德的圣地，这是信徒们都渴望做出的贡献。然而你隐忍着痛苦，与教会保持距离，将一切视为俗物。" 她拿起了一个茶杯，漫不经心地敲了敲。

"我来接待你并不是为了做出告诫或者劝你改宗。如果你的灵魂深陷于焦灼的斗争中，亦或是它无法听到创生的歌谣，那就由你自己去祈祷和冥想吧。"

entries.en:
"The office I am entrusted to has need for the service of an actor of means and ability."

More quietly, her voice gone low and rough, "A hammer."

The Archcurate places her teacup back on the desk, exactly where it was before, then pours tea into her cup, and then into yours.
entries.zh:
"我所受命的职位需要一个有能力、有手段的人。"

悄然间，她的声音变得低沉而强烈，"一柄重锤。"

大祭司把她的茶杯放回了桌上，茶杯精确落回了它原本所在的地方，那之后，她分别向她自己和你的茶杯中倒入茶水。

entries.en: She either ignored or forgot your desire for water instead of tea. You strongly suspect it is the former.
entries.zh: 她要么是无视，要么是忘记了你要的是水而不是茶。你强烈怀疑是前者。

entries.en:
You leave the Knight to ponder how to deliver your rejection to the Archcurate.

Your shuttle ascends from the green world. There is no objection from traffic control or any kind of follow-up comms request as you return to your $shipOrFleet.
entries.zh:
你让骑士自己想想怎么向大祭司传达你的拒绝。

你的穿梭机离开了这个绿色的世界。在返回你$shipOrFleet的途中，没有交通管制或别种形式的后续通信向你传达反对意见。

o.en: So you want me to be your 'hammer'?
o.zh: 所以你想让我成为你的那柄 '重锤'？

o.en: I mean what do you want? What is your goal?
o.zh: 你想要什么？你的目标是什么？

o.en: Don't you have the Knights of Ludd for this?
o.zh: 不是有 卢德骑士团 可以为你效劳吗？

o.en: You remind me of Provost Baird.
o.zh: 你让我想起了 Baird 院长。

o.en: I would be blessed to be of service to the Church.
o.zh: 能够为教会效力，我很荣幸。

o.en: I'm not sure you appreciate how hard the Hammer must fall.
o.zh: 我想你大概会对这柄重锤落下的力道感到不满。

o.en: A job offer. I should have known
o.zh: 一份工作邀请，我早就该知道了。

o.en: Your message for Brother Cotton is a leaf?
o.zh: 你给 Cotton 修士的信息是一片叶子吗？

entries.en:
A long pause.

"I shall order traffic control to give you permission to land, captain," the Excubitor Orbis says finally. "May your spirit find that for which it searches."
entries.zh:
通讯频道陷入了长久的沉默。

"我会让交通管制中心给予你降落许可，舰长。" 行星教卫终于开口，"愿你的灵魂能寻找到它所追寻之物。"

entries.en:
A long pause.

Excubitor Orbis Oak sighs. "I shall review your request in seven days," he says, "Starting from now."

He lifts a stylus and scratches something on a sheet of nondigital medium, his gaze now elsewhere. "Remember that Patience is the child of Humility."

"Blessings be, captain," he finishes.
entries.zh:
通讯频道陷入了长久的沉默。

行星教卫 Oak 叹了口气。"我会在七天之后考虑你的诉求。" 他说道，"从现在开始计时。"

他拿起一支笔，在一张非数字化媒介的纸张上写写画画，目光却投向了别处。"记住，耐心源自谦逊。"

"愿神灵护佑你，舰长。" 他最后说道。

o.en: What about the time I've already waited?
o.zh: 那我已经等了的时间算什么？

entries.en:
"Yes," he says, and the wrinkle of the smallest smile in the Persean Sector appears by his mouth.

A long pause.

"I shall order traffic control to give you permission to land, captain," the Excubitor Orbis says finally. "May your spirit find that for which it searches."
entries.zh:
"好的。" 他说道，嘴角浮现出英仙座星域中最微小的笑容形成的褶皱。

漫长的等待。

"我将会命令交通管制处给予你着陆许可，舰长。" 行星教卫终于开口，"愿尔之灵魂寻得其所寻之物。"

entries.en:
"Yes," he says, his frown deepening.

"And I see no indication that you have found it."
entries.zh:
"是的，" 他说着，眉头紧蹙。

"而且我看不出任何你已经找到它的迹象。"

entries.en:
"Yes," he says, and the wrinkle of the smallest smile in the Persean Sector appears by his mouth.

A long pause.

"I shall order traffic control to give you permission to land, captain," the Excubitor Orbis says finally. "May your spirit find that for which it searches."
entries.zh:
"好的。" 他说道，嘴角浮现出英仙座星域中最微小的笑容形成的褶皱。

通讯频道陷入了长久的沉默。

"我将会命令交通管制处给予你着陆许可，舰长。" 行星教卫终于开口，"愿尔之灵魂寻得其所寻之物。"

o.en: I have come to ask for permission to visit the shrine.
o.zh: 我来此是为了得到访问圣地的许可。

o.en: You told me to find redemption...
o.zh: 你曾告诉我要寻求救赎...

o.en: Why are you denying me access to the shrine?
o.zh: 你为什么不让我进入圣地？

o.en: Why are you denying me access to the shrine?
o.zh: 你为什么不让我进入圣地？

entries.en:
His dark eyes examine yours via the comm-link for a long moment before he speaks.

"Firstly, so that you may improve yourself," he says. "The virtue of patience is oft spake but little held."

"Secondly, for the general betterment. All who live and pass here benefit by orderly and virtuous conduct. Even I in my own self become bettered for upholding discipline in good faith."
entries.zh:
在开口说话前，他黑色的眼睛通过通讯链接审视了你很长一段时间。

"首先，你可以借此提升一下你自己，" 他说到。"耐心的美德，常常被人挂在嘴边，却鲜有人能真正拥有。"

"其次，也是为了让我们所有人变得更好。此地的所有居民与过客，都因有序且合乎美德的行为而受益。即便是我自己，也会因秉持信念与维护纪律而得以提升。"

entries.en:
"Thirdly and directly - because I shall not lie even by omission to your honest inquiry - it provides my staff with time to investigate your background and character. To determine as best we can your intentions."

There it is: a background check. Do the Knights actually use paper records? Is that why it takes so long? Incredible.
entries.zh:
"最后，直截了当地说 —— 因为我不应通过撒谎亦或是无视你真诚的询问来进行回避 —— 它为我的骑士们提供了调查你的背景和性格的时间，从而让我们尽可能确定你的意图。"

原来如此，这是为了背景调查。难道这些骑士真的使用纸质记录吗？所以这就是需要这么长时间的原因？真难以置信。

entries.en:
"Because you are an unacceptable risk; you choose sin after sin, and your bestrayed path will lead to sin sixfold once again."

"Ludd declared that none are beyond redemption," he says, "So I give thanks that it is the all-forgiving Creator who is to judge your soul, not I."
entries.zh:
"因为你的存在就是不可接受的风险，你接二连三地犯下罪行，你那叛逆之道将再度通往六重大罪。"

"卢德有言，世间无人不可得救，" 他说到，"感谢卢德，审判你灵魂的是大慈大悲的造物主，而不是我。"

entries.en: "Because I have judged it so," he says, his tone of long-held authority which suggests that this is all that is required to settle the matter.
entries.zh: "因为这是我的判断，"他说，语气中带着长期执政的权威，看来这就是解决问题所需要的一切。

entries.en: "Poorly," he says.
entries.zh: "并不乐观，" 他说道。

entries.en: "Well enough," he says begrudgingly. "Despite your impetuous disposition."
entries.zh: "还算过得去，" 他满不情愿地说道。"如果忽略你那暴躁的脾气的话。"

entries.en:
You return to your shuttle, taking a final breath of air rich with the exhalations of both the greenery and the mass of humanity.

As your pilot swaps take-off pings with traffic control, they pause at an unusual set of nav instructions which are forwarded to your (now retrieved) datapad: you are being directed to a landing which serves a huge monastic complex, some sort of Church administrative center.

The local datasphere is not forthcoming on details. It's difficult to say if this is a security measure or pious neglect.
entries.zh:
吸入最后一口充满了绿色植物和人类气息的空气后，你返回了穿梭机上。

当你的飞行员与交通管制交换起飞信号时，一组不寻常的导航指令打断了他们，随后这些指令被转发到了你的数据平板上：你的穿梭机需要沿着非标准航线前往一处庞大寺院建筑群中的着陆场，那似乎是教会的行政中心。

当地的数据库没能提供有关细节。很难说这是保密措施还是一种虔诚的忽视。

o.zh: 沿着对方发来的航线航行

entries.en:
It is a smaller path you are led down; not the highway of humanity for the main shrine, this is a smaller, secondary shrine in the lee of a crag dominated by the immense forest.

Pilgrims are offered tea, and water, and ritual washing. The air is filled with sweat, incense, and the scent of pine. A thrum of odd chanting distorted by the breeze lifts and wanes by the whims of the air currents.

You see shrine curates blessing pilgrims. Soon it is your turn.
entries.zh:
你被带到了一条更小的路上；不是通往主圣地的大道，而是位于峭壁背风处林海中的、一座更小的次级圣地。

这里有为朝圣者准备的茶、水和受洗仪式。空气中弥漫着汗水、熏香和松树的香味。一阵奇怪的吟诵声被微风扰乱，随着气流而起伏。

你看到圣地住持们在为朝圣者祈福。很快就轮到你了。

entries.en:
"The faithful must know to keep watch for what is coming," the attendant says with a strange look, then almost - but not quite - smiles.

"I mean not to sound so arcane; it is merely that our Church has endured hard times, and may yet again."
entries.zh:
"忠实的信徒必须时刻对将要发生的事务保持关注。" 圣务侍带着奇怪的表情说，然后几乎 —— 但不完全地 —— 微笑着。

"我知道不必说得如此神秘；这仅仅是因为教会经历过艰难的时光，也许还会再经历一次。"

o.en: You think hard times will come?
o.zh: 你认为艰难的时光会再次到来吗？

entries.en: "I pray that they do not," the attendant says. "We prepare for if they do."
entries.zh: "我祈祷着不会。" 圣务侍说，"但我们也做好了应对的准备。"

o.en: Shuttle down to complete the pilgrimage
o.zh: 搭乘穿梭机下到地面来为朝圣之旅画上句号

entries.en:
You return to your shuttle, taking a final breath of air rich with the exhalations of greenery.

The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful.
entries.zh:
吸入最后一口充满了绿色植物气息的空气后，你返回了穿梭机上。

搭乘穿梭机返航的过程一切顺利。

entries.en:
The attendant dutifully explains that the shrine commemorates the holy site where Ludd first stepped onto Gilead and was brought prostrate, to the shock of non-believers, to kiss the earth itself, so overcome was Ludd by the rapturous touch of Divinity.

Ludd's influence spread by its own evident virtue, the attendant explains, and the industrial terraforming machines were brought down and flowers bloomed in the rubble. There is no mention of strikes, global storms, sabotage, apocalyptic flooding and heatwaves, or corporate terror squads in this narrative. Nor does the attendant mention that, technically, an entire planet owned by the Eridani Utopia Terraforming megacorporation was illegally occupied by a radical cult. Rather, the unbelievers wept as Ludd revealed their sins and told them forgiveness was within reach on this garden-world.

It is an appealing morality tale delivered earnestly.
entries.zh:
圣务侍尽职地解释说，这个圣地是为了纪念卢德第一次踏上 Gilead 而建的，那时卢德被神伟大的才能所折服，在无信者们震惊的目光中，弯下腰亲吻了大地。

圣务侍继续解释说，卢德的精神通过其自身明显的优点传播开来，地貌改造工业机器被摧毁，鲜花在废墟中盛开。在叙述中，对方没有提到罢工、全球风暴、蓄意破坏、末日洪水和热浪，也没有提到企业的恐怖组织。圣务侍更没有提到，严格意义上来说，这件事就是 波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 拥有的整颗星球被激进的教团非法占领。取而代之地，对方说，当卢德揭示了他们的罪恶并告诉他们，在这花园世界里宽恕将触手可及的时候，无信者们感激涕零。

真是个引人入胜的道德故事。

entries.en:
Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is strictly overseen by the Knights of Ludd; your shuttle must queue behind a not insignificant flotilla of lumbering transports and haulers filled with approved industrial goods.

As your shuttle inserts into a holding orbit, an override comes in from traffic control. Your pilot forwards the nav instructions to you for approval: immediate permission to descend on a non-standard route to a site which is not the usual pilgrimage transport complex. Instead, you are being directed to a pad serving a sprawling monastic compound.

The local datasphere, such as it is, is not forthcoming on details.
entries.zh:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆笨重的运输船和拖船后面。

你的穿梭机进入悬停轨道时，交通管制发来了超驰指令。驾驶员将导航指示转发给你以供确认：通行许可来的很快，但目的地并非通常的朝圣者交通复合体。取而代之地，你的穿梭机需要沿着非标准航线下到一处庞大寺院建筑群中的停机坪上。

哪怕是当地的数据库，也没能提供有关目的地的细节。

As your shuttle inserts into a holding orbit, an override comes in from traffic control. Your pilot forwards the nav instructions to you for approval: immediate permission to descend on a non-standard route to a site which is not the usual pilgrimage transport complex. Instead, you are being directed to a pad serving a sprawling monastic compound.

The local datasphere, such as it is, is not forthcoming on details. You can only assume that Archcurate Jaspis is insisting on meeting with you.
entries.zh:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆笨重的运输船和拖船后面。

你的穿梭机进入悬停轨道时，交通管制发来了超驰指令。驾驶员将导航指示转发给你以供确认：通行许可来的很快，但目的地并非通常的朝圣者交通复合体。取而代之地，你的穿梭机需要沿着非标准航线下到一处庞大寺院建筑群中的停机坪上。

哪怕是当地的数据库，也没能提供有关目的地的细节。你只能猜这或许是 Jaspis 大祭司 要见你。
