entries.en: You return to the shaded halls of the transport complex.
entries.zh: 你回到了运输中心被阴影遮蔽的大厅里。

entries.en:
You enter the shaded halls of the transport complex and move toward your shuttle's landing pad.

One of the shrine attendants intercepts you and, with a quick glance at a discreet datapad (swiftly tucked back into voluminous robes), invites you to follow them.

"I am blessed, Captain $PlayerName," the attendant says, "to invite you to complete the Pilgrim's Path on this day."
entries.zh:
你进入了交通枢纽那昏暗的厅堂，接着走向自己的穿梭机所在的停机坪。

圣务侍们中的一位主动迎上了你，他迅速瞥了一眼手持数据平板，又飞快地把它塞回宽松的长袍里，然后邀请你跟上他们。

"我很荣幸，$PlayerName 舰长，" 圣务侍说到，"能够邀请您在今天为您的朝圣者之路画上句号。"

o.en: How do you know of this?

entries.en: The curate casts scented drops and says the words, though it is almost a blur. It is strange to have come so far, for this.
entries.zh: 祭司撒下带着香味的水滴，念着祷文，然而那声音模糊不清。奔波许久就为了这个，还真是奇怪。

entries.en:
Around you flows a river of pilgrims. They've invested such meaning into the journey they've made, supposedly in the path of their prophet Ludd. It is almost unbelievable how much has been built on the words of one obscure figure who managed to be blessed by circumstance with great charisma and a moment to bend the arc of history.

What would the - certainly - long-dead Ludd make of what's become of all of it?
entries.zh:
你的周围流淌着朝圣者的人流。他们为自己跟随先知卢德的脚步的旅程找到了意义。令人难以置信的是，那个设法利用了环境、以巨大的感召力在一瞬间弯曲了历史走向的人，他留下的话语究竟都形成了什么。

那么，那位 —— 当然 —— 早已死去的卢德又会怎么看待这一切呢？

entries.en:
Around you people put on the motions of pilgrimage and ritual, play-acting the forms of great meaning for their prophet Ludd. It is almost unbelievable what has been built on the intentionally obfuscated rantings of one rabble-rouser. It is impossible to know what Ludd would made of all this.

The Church, of course, makes a good show of pretending to, and it prospers for it.
entries.zh:
在你周围，人们进行着朝圣和仪式相关的各种活动，为他们的先知卢德表演着具有重大意义的仪式。很难相信这一切都是建立在被一个煽动者故意歪曲的话语之上，这让人很难想象卢德会怎么看待这一切。

至于教会，他们自然装作理解卢德，并借此而繁荣壮大。

entries.en: Around you flows a river of faith and ritual. Your fellow pilgrims have chosen their purpose to pursue, that of Ludd's message. In the collective hardship of life in the Persean Sector, as in the collective hardship of the pilgrimage, they find a kind of peace and meaning that is absent in the hollow left by the Collapse.
entries.zh: 你的周围流淌着信仰和仪式的河流。与你同行的朝圣者已经选好所追求的目标，那便是卢德的旨意。在英仙座星域的艰难生活中、在朝圣路上的同甘共苦中，他们寻找到了在 大崩塌 留下的空洞中所缺失的和平和真义。

entries.en:
All around you see despair and decadence in equal measure channelled into the elaborate rituals of the Luddic Church. Made safe, made convenient; an insulating layer that allows people to live without truly walking Ludd's Path.

It is easy to forget here in the proud edifice of the Church that Ludd held a hammer, too, and was unafraid to use it without hesitation in the face of evil.
entries.zh:
环顾四周，你意识到绝望和颓废同样程度上渗入了卢德教会精心设计的仪式中。安全而方便的仪式保护着人们，让他们在不必真正遵循卢德之道的情况下也能生活下去。

站在这座骄傲的大教堂里，人们很容易忘记卢德手中也曾执重锤，并有勇气在面对邪恶时毫不犹豫地将其挥出。

entries.en:
Around you a river of pilgrims flows. They've found meaning in the journey they've made between the shrines, following the path of their prophet Ludd. It is almost unbelievable how much has been built on the words of one person who, blessed or cursed by circumstance, bent the arc of history across the face of the Domain and the Collapse.

Looking upon the crowds, the pointed arches, the trees beyond- What would Ludd make of this?
entries.zh:
你的周围流淌着朝圣者的人流。他们为自己跟随先知卢德的脚步、在各个圣地间穿梭的旅程找到了意义。令人难以置信的是，那个被环境祝福，或者说被环境诅咒的、在 人之领 面前，在 大崩塌 的背景下弯曲了历史走向的人，他留下的话语究竟都形成了什么。

看看这人群，尖拱门和远方的树木 —— 卢德会怎么看待这一切？

entries.en: You order the pilot to abort your descent rather than follow the unusual nav plan. There is no objection from traffic control or any kind of follow-up comms request as you return to your $shipOrFleet.
entries.zh: 你下令飞行员取消着陆计划，而非跟着非常规航线走。在返回你$shipOrFleet的途中，没有交通管制或别种形式的后续通信向你传达反对意见。

entries.en:
You order the pilot to follow the original ascent rather than follow the unusual navigation instructions.

There is no objection from traffic control or any kind of follow-up comms request as you return to your $shipOrFleet.
entries.zh:
你下令飞行员继续返航，而非跟着非常规航线走。

在返回你$shipOrFleet的途中，没有交通管制或别种形式的后续通信向你传达反对意见。

entries.en: The landing bay, one of a score or so allocated to outsiders, is packed with parties of Luddic pilgrims dressed in traditional handweave led by robed attendants.
entries.zh: 这座登陆台是分配给外人的二十来个台位之一，它被长袍圣务侍带领着的、身着传统手织品的卢德朝圣者队伍挤满。

entries.en: One such stony-faced attendant meets your shuttle on the pad and, wasting no time, firmly but politely inquires about your business here.
entries.zh: 一个面无表情的圣务侍在着陆台等待着你的穿梭机降落，对方一上来就强硬却不失礼节地向你询问到访此地的目的。

entries.en:
One such stony-faced attendant meets your shuttle on the pad and with a double-glance at a discreet datapad, rapidly stowed in voluminous robes, invites you to follow them.

"I am blessed, captain $PlayerName," the attendant says, "to invite you to complete the Pilgrim's Path on this day."
entries.zh:
一位面无表情的圣务侍在停机坪上接待了你的穿梭机，迅速瞥了一眼手持数据平板，又飞快地把它塞回宽松的长袍里，然后邀请你跟上他们。

"我很荣幸，$PlayerName 舰长..." 圣务侍说道，"能够邀请您在今天为您的朝圣者之路画上句号。"

o.en: How do you know of this?

entries.en:
One such stony-faced attendant, flanked by Knights of Ludd in gleaming powered armor, meets your shuttle on the pad.

"We do not welcome those who have done what you have done, Captain $playerName," the attendant says. "Please leave now."

They appear unyielding and perhaps even consider standing up to you a righteous test of their devotion.
entries.zh:
一个面无表情的圣务侍在着陆台等待着你的穿梭机降落，身着闪闪发光的动力盔甲的卢德骑士伴随在对方身侧。

"我们并不待见你的所作所为，$playerName 舰长。" 圣务侍说，"请你离开。"

他们看起来不会退让，甚至觉得拦在你面前是对忠诚的正义考验。

entries.en:
One such stony-faced attendant, flanked by Knights of Ludd in gleaming powered armor, meets your shuttle on the pad.

"We do not welcome those who so willfully scorn the Faith, Captain $playerName," the attendant says. "Please leave now."

They appear unyielding and perhaps even consider standing up to you a righteous test of their devotion.
entries.zh:
一个面无表情的圣务侍在着陆台等待着你的穿梭机降落，身着闪闪发光的动力盔甲的卢德骑士伴随在对方身侧。

"我们并不待见你的所作所为，$playerName 舰长。" 圣务侍说，"请你离开。"

他们看起来不会退让，甚至觉得拦在你面前是对忠诚的正义考验。

entries.en:
The attendant nods, explaining that you must leave your guards behind because this is a place of peace, and all are equal on the Pilgrim's Path.

The request is an implied request for keeping up appearances: a couple of your guards, unarmed and trained for situations requiring this degree of subtlety, attend to your safety as per matter of course. You note other unusually small parties of "pilgrims", plainly but clearly wealthy by their cut and carriage, led by their own shrine-attendants and accompanied by unusually muscled 'distant cousins'.

Nonetheless, the crowds filing out of the transport complex, on a wide highway of beaten earth and cobble, are enormous. Those that cannot walk are carried; no powered transport is provided.
entries.zh:
圣务侍点了点头，解释说你必须让保镖留下，因为这是个和平的地方，朝圣者之路上人人平等。

这不过是个对外在形象的含蓄要求：几个没有携带武器的保镖接受过应对这种微妙情况的训练，他们理所当然地成为了和你一同拜访此地的朝圣者以照顾你的安全。同时你还注意到了其他一些异常的小规模 "朝圣者"，他们的举手投足毫不掩饰地流露出了明显的富有，由专属的圣务侍带领，还有些肌肉发达的 "远房表亲" 陪同。

从运输中心鱼贯而出的人群数量庞大，他们来到了由碎土和鹅卵石铺成的宽阔公路上。由于此地不提供助力交通工具，那些无法行走的人只能由其他人抬着。

entries.en:
The path of the pilgrims leads up a slope covered in trees more enormous than any you've seen before. Though small in scale compared to the celestial phenomena that is your daily bread, their living architecture forms a natural cathedral.

Dispassionate Knights of Ludd watch as attendants shuttle you through a cordoned path in an arc through a final grove of mighty sequoia-analogs atop the promontory at the terminus of the ridge - it is a temple, struts and spars intertwined with the trees. Golden sunlight filters through heavy branches, and as the breeze lifts a whispering chorus of foliage, you catch an earthy scent over the mass of humanity surrounding you.
entries.zh:
朝圣者之路通向了一个山坡，山坡被你前所未见的巨大树木覆盖着 —— 尽管与你见惯了的天体和太空建筑相比还是太小了 —— 他们的活建筑形成了一个天然的大教堂。

神情冰冷的卢德骑士看着圣务侍将你领过一条围栏小路，小路顺着山坡将你领入位于岬角顶端的巨大类红杉园林，这园林乃是一座支柱与树木交织在一起的寺庙。金色的阳光透过茂密的树枝，微风吹动树叶让它们低声合唱，你则透过周围人群捕捉到了泥土的芳香。

entries.en: You have only a brief moment before the high altar of living wood. Small tokens and offerings are piled high amongst low, cheap candles.
entries.zh: 在高高的活木祭坛前，你只能停留一小会儿。小小的纪念品和祭品在低矮廉价的蜡烛之间堆得很高。

o.en: Offer Brother Cotton's copy of the Book of Ludd
o.zh: 献上 Cotton 修士的卢德之书抄本

entries.en:
And in a moment, it passes.

It is hot, and you are in a large and sweaty crowd full of pilgrims all wrapped up away from you, lost in their own worship.

The attendants do their best to herd the masses along the main pathway. You must push through groups calling and crying and singing and praying.
entries.zh:
转眼间，圣地就不在你眼前了。

炎热的天气里，你被一大群汗流浃背的人群裹挟着前行，这些朝圣者迷失在他们自身的崇拜中。

圣务侍们尽力将群众汇集到主干道上。你必须得挤过那些呼喊、哭泣、唱诵和祈祷着的人们。

entries.en: Thinking quickly, you place Brother Cotton's small book on the pile of offerings. It settles into the scrimshaw, trinkets, and cheap photo-prints like it belongs there.
entries.zh: 你快速思索了一会，把 Cotton 修士的小本子放到了祭品堆上。它融入了那些雕刻物、装饰品和廉价的相片印花，好似它本就属于那里。

entries.en:
Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is overseen by the Knights of Ludd, and their traffic control is characteristically strict. Your shuttle queues behind a flotilla of lumbering transports and haulers.

The face of Gilead is filled with green continents, seeded with Earth-life by sporeship and climate-stabilized by Eridani Utopia's vast terraforming machines. Then Ludd came and the Faithful turned the world into a garden-wilderness of astounding richness; it is a gem of the Persean Sector.

Your shuttle receives a ping from traffic control: permission to descend.
entries.zh:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆笨重的运输船和拖船后面。

Gilead 的星球表面上遍布绿洲，孢子母舰在上面播种了类地生命，波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 的巨型机器则稳定了它的气候和生态。那之后卢德来到了这里，跟随着他的信徒们则把世界变成了花园般的未开发模样，至今它依然富饶得惊人。它是英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

你的穿梭机收到了交通管制中心的提示：这是允许降落的意思。

entries.en: Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is overseen by the Knights of Ludd, and their traffic control is typically strict. Your shuttle queues behind a flotilla of lumbering transports and hauler
entries.zh: 离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士监管，并且他们的交通管制非常严格。你的穿梭机排在一堆笨重的运输船和拖船后面。

entries.en: The face of Gilead is painted with fragile green continents and glittering blue oceans. Ludd came here and the original Faithful, undiluted by the Church hierarchy, liberated the world from Eridani Utopia's terraforming machines. In place of a sprawl of private fortress-plantations and crowded resort playgrounds for the rich, a garden-wilderness of astounding richness bloomed. It is a gem of the Persean Sector.
entries.zh: Gilead 的表面由纤巧美丽的绿色大陆和闪闪发光的蓝色海洋组成。卢德曾到过这里，那些追随他的、尚未被教会阶级制度侵蚀的最初信徒们，则将这个世界从 波江座-乌托邦 的地貌改造机器手中解放了出来。于是在这颗星球上，取代了杂乱无章的私人堡垒种植园和拥挤的富人度假乐园，一片富饶得惊人的自然花园盛放了，这让它成为了英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

entries.en: The face of Gilead is painted with fragile green continents and glittering blue oceans. Ludd came here, saw Eridani Utopia's vast terraforming machines and designs for profit, and led the first Faithful to liberate the world. In place of sprawling private fortress-plantations and crowded resort compounds, a garden-wilderness of astounding richness was cultivated. It is a gem of the Persean Sector.
entries.zh: Gilead 的表面由纤巧美丽的绿色大陆和闪闪发光的蓝色海洋组成。卢德曾到过这里，看到 波江座-乌托邦 的巨型地貌改造机器和为了盈利进行的规划后，让最初信徒们解放了这个世界。于是在这颗星球上，取代了杂乱无章的私人堡垒种植园和拥挤的度假区复合体，一片富饶得惊人的自然花园被耕耘而出，让它成为了英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

entries.en: The face of Gilead bears startlingly green continents and glittering blue oceans. First seeded by sporeships, the terraforming contract was granted by the Domain colonial authorities to the Eridani Utopia Terraforming megacorporation. Their vast machines tamed the world, and just as the project was on the cusp of fruition, Ludd came. From a certain perspective, the followers of Ludd stole the world to create their own vision of paradise: a rustic garden-wilderness. Despite the hypocrisy, or perhaps for it, Gilead is a gem of the Persean Sector.
entries.zh: Gilead 的表面承载着惊艳的绿色大陆和闪烁的蓝色海洋。在最初由孢子母舰播种生命后，一份人之领殖民部门和波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团之间的合同签订了，后者的巨型机器随后开始开垦这个世界。就在项目即将取得成果之际，卢德来到了这里。从某种角度来看，卢德的追随者窃取了这个世界，将它塑造成了他们心目中的天堂：一座质朴的自然花园。尽管虚伪，但或许正因如此，Gilead 成为了英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

entries.en: The face of Gilead is filled with green continents, seeded with Earth-life by sporeship and climate-stabilized by Eridani-Utopia's vast terraforming machines. Then Ludd came and the Faithful turned the world into a rustic garden-wilderness of astounding richness; it is a gem of the Persean Sector.
entries.zh: Gilead 的星球表面上遍布绿洲，孢子母舰在上面播种了类地生命，波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 的巨型机器则稳定了它的气候和生态。那之后卢德来到了这里，跟随着他的信徒们则把世界变成了一座质朴的自然花园，这使它成为了英仙座星域中的一颗明珠。

entries.en: The face of Gilead is filled with green continents, seeded with Earth-life by sporeship and climate-stabilized by Eridani Utopia's vast terraforming machines. Then Ludd came and turned the world into a rustic garden-wilderness of astounding richness; it is a gem of the Persean Sector.
entries.zh: Gilead 的表面被绿色的大地所覆盖。孢子母舰在这里播种了类地生命，波江座-乌托邦集团的巨型环境改造机器稳定了这里的气候和生态。随后卢德游历至此，将这个世界变成了富饶惊人的质朴园野，成就了这一英仙座星域瑰宝。

entries.en: Your shuttle receives a ping from traffic control: permission to descend.
entries.zh: 你的穿梭机收到了交通管制中心的提示：这是允许降落的意思。

entries.en: It is well known that pilgrims of the Luddic faith travel here from across the Persean Sector to visit the holy shrine of Gilead. The shrine is said to be built where Ludd kissed the ground after first stepping onto the surface of the planet.
entries.zh: 众所周知，心怀卢德信仰的朝圣者们从英仙座星域的各处来到这里，参观 Gilead 上神圣的圣地。据说，这座圣地就坐落于卢德第一次踏上这颗星球后亲吻大地之处。

o.en: Join the pilgrims visiting the Luddic shrine
o.zh: 加入拜访卢德圣地的朝圣者们

entries.en:
Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is strictly overseen by the Knights of Ludd; your shuttle must queue behind a flotilla of lumbering transports and haulers filled with approved industrial goods.

This provides you with time to contemplate the face of Gilead; its continents, once fringed only by alien algae-equivalents, were seeded with Earth-life by a far-roving sporeship of the second wave of human expansion. The Eridani-Utopia Terraforming megacorp followed and its vast machines stabilized the climate and ecological processes. Ludd came then, pulled down the machines, and the believers who followed maintained the world as a garden-wilderness of astounding richness. Truly, it is a gem of the Persean Sector.

Your shuttle receives a ping from traffic control: permission to descend.
entries.zh:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆装满经过批准的工业产品的笨重运输船和拖船后面。

这样一来你便有时间细想 Gilead 的面貌了。它的大陆曾经只被外星藻类覆盖，直到人类进行第二波殖民扩张时，被远道而来的孢子母舰播种了类地生命。波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 紧随其后，用巨型机器稳定了气候和生态。那之后卢德来到了这里，摧毁了机器，跟随着他的信徒们则把世界维持着花园般的未开发模样，至今它依然富饶得惊人。的确，它当得起英仙座星域明珠的名号。

这时你的穿梭机收到了交通管制中心的提示：这是允许降落的意思。

entries.en: Nav routes your comm-link to the local system network, and after what feels like a longer than necessary wait, the link finally establishes a connection.
entries.zh: 领航员将你的通讯链接路由到本地的系统网络中，在经过一段感觉上超出必要等待所需的时间后，连接终于被建立。

entries.en: You work your way through the spacers, buying drinks and talking shop. Dropping some good-natured but pointed complaints about the humorless Church-operated customs regime gets you on the right path, and soon enough you find yourself in a smoky escape shaft behind the bar talking to a tech in the local port bureaucracy.
entries.zh: 你开始从宇宙民中寻找门路，和他们一起谈天说地，买酒请客。在对古板的教会海关规程尖锐而中肯地吐槽了几句之后，你马上就摸到了门道。很快，在你反应过来之前，你就已经置身于酒吧后面一个烟雾缭绕的逃生井里，和一位当地港口机构的技术人员攀谈了起来。

o.en: Feel out the possibility of a bribe
o.zh: 试探是否存在行贿的可能

entries.en:
"People like us, just gotta keep our heads down. Pray in public, yeah, live your own life on the quiet, you know?"

They take a drag from a black market drug stick. "Say what you will about the Excubitor Orbis, at least he takes mercy and forgiveness as seriously as he takes all those other 'knightly virtues'."

Between complaints about Luddic society you get the understanding that for 2,000 credits an unauthorized shuttle flight to the shrine of Hesperus could be tagged by a helpful nonbeliever as a regular pilgrim transport.
entries.zh:
"像我们这样的人，就得低着脑袋过活。公开场合得虔诚一点，是啊，私下里自己的日子还是该咋过咋过，你懂吧？"

他们抽了一口黑市毒烟卷，继续道："不管你对行星教卫有几个意见，至少他对待怜悯和宽恕的态度也和他对其他那些 '骑士美德' 一样严肃。"

夹杂在各种对卢德教居民的抱怨和牢骚里，你打听到只要花 2,000 星币就能让一个有能耐的无信者把一趟未经授权前往 Hesperus 的穿梭机飞行计划标记为朝圣者定期运输航班。

entries.en: You try to speak but he's already terminated his end of the link.
entries.zh: 你正想说话，但他已经从他那一端终止了链接。

entries.en: He nods acknowledgement, nothing more, then terminates his end of the commlink.
entries.zh: 他仅仅是点头表示了解，然后便从他那一侧终止了链接。

entries.en:
That wrinkle again, the Sector's smallest smile.

"How debased is our devotion that you would think saying those words would open the path before you."

"And," he continues, "How debased is your spiritual being that you would think to indulge it."
entries.zh:
那个皱纹 —— 或者也可以说是全星域最微弱的笑容 —— 又一次浮现出来。

"我等的奉献是何其卑贱，以至于让你认为那番话语就可为你开通前路。"

"而至于你，" 他继续道，"你的精神又是何其堕落，才会想着沉溺于此。"

entries.en:
That wrinkle again, the Sector's smallest smile.

"Yes, I am quite certain that you have committed many crimes. Secular justice is only part of my purview however," he says gravely.

"Today I am more concerned with your spirit."
entries.zh:
那个皱纹 —— 或者也可以说是全星域最微弱的笑容 —— 又一次浮现出来。

他严肃地说道："的确，我十分肯定，你犯下了诸多罪行。然而，世俗正义不过是我职责的冰山一角。"

"今日，我更关注你心中的真意。"

entries.en:
"I ordered your landing request denied," he states plainly. "The protection of this world is my duty."

"I find that those with a history of exceptional acts oft test the charity of Providence by taking exceptional risks."
entries.zh:
"我下令拒绝了你的降落请求，"他开门见山地说道，"保护这个世界是我的职责。"

"我发现那些有着非凡过往的人经常冒着巨大风险来试探上天的慈悲。"

o.en: So I need to convince you that I am not a risk?
o.zh: 所以我需要让你相信我不是一个风险？

o.en: Are you accusing me of criminal intent?
o.zh: 你在指控我拥有犯罪倾向吗？

o.en: Just tell me how many credits I need to 'tithe'.
o.zh: 告诉我需要缴纳多少 '什一税' 就好。

entries.en:
"Your reputation is suspect, captain. I cannot in good conscience allow you access to our shrine," the Excubitor Orbis says. "Find yourself redemption. If you manage to find some degree of it, then we may discuss the matter again."

"Seek virtue, captain," he says by way of farewell.
entries.zh:
"你的恶名让人产生怀疑，舰长。我不能问心无愧地让你访问我们的圣地。" 行星教卫说到，"为你自己寻找救赎吧。如果你能多少找到一些，那我们可以再讨论一下这件事。"

"求善，舰长。" 他以告别的语气说到。

o.en: How about we talk about redemption now.
o.zh: 不如我们现在就谈谈救赎吧。

entries.en:
A long pause.

"I shall order traffic control to give you permission to land, captain," the Excubitor Orbis says finally. "May your spirit find that for which it searches."
entries.zh:
通讯频道陷入了长久的沉默。

"我会让交通管制中心给予你降落许可，舰长。" 行星教卫终于开口，"愿你的灵魂能寻找到它所追寻之物。"

entries.en:
"I shall review your request in seven days," the Excubitor Orbis says. "If that is enough for Creation, it will be enough for you to learn patience."

That wrinkle again.

"Blessings be, captain."
entries.zh:
"我将在七天之内审核你的请求，" 行星教卫说到。"如果这时间足够创造天地万物，那么也足够让你学习到耐心。"

他脸上再次浮现出充满褶皱的笑。

"愿你蒙福，舰长。"

entries.en: He drops a heavy hand like a gavel on his desk. "I am uninterested in more words. Listen well now, for I speak my judgment on this matter."
entries.zh: 他像落下拍卖锤一般重重地拍了一下桌子。"我不想再听下去了。现在，好好听我对这件事的判断吧。"

entries.en:
That wrinkle again, the Sector's smallest smile.

"Spend not your time in this life on folly; even our youngest initiate could see that you wear risk like a badge. The secular procedures at hand are only part of my purview," he says.

"At present I am more concerned with your spirit."
entries.zh:
那个皱纹 —— 或者也可以说是全星域最微弱的笑容 —— 又一次浮现出来。

"奉劝你，此生莫要行愚蠢之事。纵使我等最年轻的新教友也可看出，你危险常伴，有如勋章在身。手头的那些红尘琐事，毕竟只是我职责的冰山一角。" 他说道。

"此时此刻，我更关注你心中的真意。"

entries.en:
The silence extends, uncomfortably. He blinks, slowly.

He's really doing this. Some kind of test, or challenge. Are you going to let him win?

He isn't giving up. He continues to stare, absurdly, saying nothing. You notice the subtlest flicker in the image as the display corrects for signal fluctuation.
entries.zh:
令人不快的死寂延续着，他缓缓地眨了眨眼。

他居然真的在这么做，像是某种测试或者挑战。你要把胜利拱手相让吗？

他锲而不舍，他一言不发，继续荒唐地盯着。你注意到显示器校正信号波动时，图像产生了些许闪烁。

o.en: Why was my travel request denied?
o.zh: 为什么我的航行请求被拒绝了？

o.en: I demand to know why my request was denied!
o.zh: 我要求得知为什么我的请求被拒绝了！

entries.en:
The hum of your ship grows in your ears, the sense of inhabiting your own body in a can hurtling around a gravity well, the incomprehensible webs of influence keeping you both in this place and in the constant dynamism of crisis.

Lower and higher dimensions twist and vibrate, a web conspiring to hold you up - or back - falling and clinging just so. Your technologies tap these invisible quirks of physics to keep you warm, keep you cool; your feet on the deck, the air flowing follow a rhythm, a meter. It is like music, in fact. If you listen carefully...

It would be impossible to speak, now.
entries.zh:
飞船的轰鸣在你耳中不断回响放大，让你意识到自己正身处于一个围绕重力井飞驰的铁罐头中。引力犹如无数无边的大网，让你困入动力持续变动的危局之中，滞留于此。

高低维度互相交织震荡着，一同合谋将你网住，当你即将下坠时将你举起，在你意欲爬升时把你拖住。你身边的各种科技仿佛在有节奏地敲打着种种无形的物理异象，使你保持温暖，让你脚踏实地，令空气保持循环，一切都充满了韵律。其实这犹如乐曲，只要你仔细去聆听...

此刻，难以言述。

entries.en:
You almost jump as the Excubitor Orbis speaks, pulling you back to the moment.

"You possess patience," he says. A new wrinkle appears beside his mouth; what passes for a smile among the Knights of Ludd, you suppose.

"I did not expect it of you."

You've won. Is this victory? It is an uncomfortable feeling.
entries.zh:
行星教卫突然开口，差点吓了你一跳，也将你的思绪拉回现实。

"你很有耐心。" 他说。他的嘴角边又浮现出一抹皱纹；你猜测这在卢德骑士团里可能算是一种笑容吧。

"我没料到你会有如此耐心。"

你赢了。但这真的算得上是胜利吗？这种感觉让你一阵不舒服。

entries.en: You've played this game before, with Gargoyle. You know how to win. Stay strong.
entries.zh: 你以前就和 Gargoyle 玩过这个游戏，你知道该怎么赢 —— 坚持不懈。

entries.en: He nods brusquely, then returns his gaze to the lead coffins. "I'm supposed to contemplate their sacrifice. Horrible way to die, like that. You're a," he glances at your garb again, "spacer, right? Ever seen that happen to anyone?"
entries.zh: 他唐突地点了点头，然后把目光转回铅衬的棺木上。"我应该考虑接受像他们那样的牺牲，像那样可怖的死亡。说起来，你是..." 他又瞥了一眼你的装束，"宇宙民，对吧？以前有见过什么人遭遇这样的事吗？"

entries.en: He stares at you for a moment, then slowly returns his gaze to the radioactive martyrs.
entries.zh: 他盯着你看了一会，随后缓缓地将目光转向了那些辐射缠身的殉道者。

entries.en: He nods, satisfied with the belief that it is he who will shield people like you from such horrors, then returns his gaze to the radioactive martyrs.
entries.zh: 他点了点头，坚信自己将会保护像你这样的人免遭这般恐怖。他对此心满意足，接着将目光转向了那些辐射缠身的殉道者。

entries.en: The initiate's eyes are wide; he's clearly impressed. "Don't tell anyone, but... I mean, you have to admit what Cotton has done is cunning and brave. The... the Creator gave him gifts, and he uses them."
entries.zh: 这个新人睁大了双眼，显然他十分钦佩。"别告诉任何人，不过...我是说，你不得不承认 Cotton 的行动堪称智勇双全。而...造物主赐予他的天赋，他发挥得淋漓尽致。"

entries.en:
A troubled look passes over his face. "The Knights, sometimes it seems like they are more interested in making rules for the sake of rules instead of fighting evil."

With a sigh, the initiate returns his gaze toward the radioactive martyrs.
entries.zh:
他脸上闪过苦恼的神色，"那些骑士大人们，有些时候比起打击邪恶，他们看起来更喜欢为了规则而制定规则。"

随着一声叹息，新人将目光转向了那些辐射缠身的殉道者。

entries.en:
The initiate's eyes are wide; he's clearly impressed. And troubled.

"But... the things he does, I mean," the young man visibly struggles between what he feels and what he has been told. "Maybe he goes too far, but at least he tries, you know?"
entries.zh:
这个新人睁大了双眼，显然他十分钦佩，但也十分困扰。

"但是...他的所作所为，我是说，" 这个年轻人很明显在自己的感受和别人的说法之间挣扎着，"也许他做的太过分了，但至少他在努力，你也明白的吧？"

entries.en:
The initiate's eyes are wide; he's clearly impressed. "Don't tell anyone, but... I would like to meet him too. Maybe join him."

He glances guiltily toward the shrine-attendants. "Maybe."
entries.zh:
这个新人睁大了双眼，显然他十分钦佩。"别告诉任何人，不过...我也想见他一面。或许，还会加入他。"

他怀着愧疚瞥了一眼圣地的圣务侍，继续道："或许吧。"

entries.en:
The initiate nods in response, but is unsure now of your outlook.

"I mean, say what you will about Cotton," he glances guiltily toward the shrine attendants, "He fights for what he believes. At least."
entries.zh:
新人虽然点头回应，但他现在对你的观点有些犹豫。

"我的意思是，你大可以说出自己对 Cotton 的看法，" 他怀着愧疚瞥了一眼圣地的圣务侍，"但至少，他在为自己的信仰而战。"

entries.en: The initiate's eyes are wide; he's clearly impressed. "Don't tell anyone, but... I would like to meet him. Hear what he had to say. Maybe join up."
entries.zh: 这个新人睁大了双眼，显然他十分钦佩。"别告诉任何人，不过...我也想见他一面，听听他要说些什么，或许还会加入他的队伍。"

entries.en: Your introspection seems to throw the initiate off. You can see the thought work across his face- are you making fun of me? But it is quickly dismissed, and you are filed under 'not a threat'.
entries.zh: 你的内省似乎让这位新人不知所措。你可以看到他的想法浮现在了脸上 —— 你在消遣我吗？但这表情很快就收了起来，而你也被划进了 '没有威胁' 的行列里。

entries.en: He takes a moment to parse your response. You can see it work across his face- are you making fun of me? But the thought is dismissed, and you are filed under 'not a threat'.
entries.zh: 他花了些许时间来理解你的回复。你能够从他的脸上分明地看出他在思考 —— 你在消遣我吗？不过这个念头很快就被摒弃了，而你也被划进了 '没有威胁' 的行列里。

entries.en:
"I'm a knight, sworn and-" he catches himself raising his voice, looks nervously to check for shrine attendants, "-and a member of the order. I'll die in service of my sacred duty."

He nods brusquely at the trio of lead-lined coffins at the center of the shrine. "Like they did, if I have to. I'm not scared."
entries.zh:
"我是一名骑士，已经立誓并 ——" 他注意到自己不小心说大声了些，有点紧张地看了一下圣地圣务侍是否在附近，"—— 并成为一名骑士团成员。我愿为了我神圣的职责而献身。"

他对着圣地中央的三口铅制棺材坚定地点了点头。"若有必要，我也将像他们那样。我并不害怕。"

o.en: Nod and make an appropriately serious face
o.zh: 点点头，做出符合时宜的严肃表情

o.en: You should be. That death is hell I would not wish upon my worst enemy.
o.zh: 你最好还是怕一怕。毕竟，就算是我的死对头，我也不想让他经历那种地狱般的死亡。

entries.en:
He seems satisfied, just, with your apparent acceptance of his declaration. Out of the corner of your eye you see him turn back toward the center of the shrine, sigh, and resume what you assume to be an initiation-vigil.

Time will have to test him and tell if he will actually be any good as a Knight of Ludd.
entries.zh:
你仅仅是表面上认可了他的宣言，他看起来就已经满意了。从你眼角的余光可以看到，他转身朝向圣地的中央，叹了一口气，又回到了之前的状态 —— 你猜那可能是入团要做的守夜祈祷之类的。

时间将会考验他，并辨明他是否真的足以担任一名卢德骑士。

entries.en:
You see his jaw clench, and quick anger rise in his posture. You wonder briefly at how the shrine attendants would react to a Knight-initiate assaulting a visitor, but out of the corner of your eye you can see the young man steady himself, then turn and lock his gaze toward the center of the shrine, maintaining control and mumbling prayer.

He may actually have what it takes to become a good Knight of Ludd one day.
entries.zh:
你看到他的下巴绷紧了，愤怒迅速在他姿态中升腾。在这稍纵即逝的片刻，你不由得好奇，圣地的圣务侍们会怎么处置袭击访客的新晋骑士。不过，从你眼角的余光可以看到，这位青年稳住了自己，然后转身凝视着圣地的中央，保持着理智，喃喃自语地祈祷着。

有朝一日，他或许真的会拥有成为一名优秀的卢德骑士所需的品质。

entries.en:
Your grim delivery sinks the thought into the young man. You can see it in his eyes, and his pale scalp; yes, fear.

In that fear, he seems to forget trying to get a rise out of you and locks his gaze toward the center of the shrine, mumbling a prayer.

He might actually have what it takes to become a good Knight of Ludd one day.
entries.zh:
你那冷酷的话语将一缕思绪沉入这个年轻人的心底。你可以看到他眼中的动摇，还有那毫无血色的头皮。没错，是恐惧。

在这份恐惧之中，他看起来已经顾不上招惹你了。他牢牢地凝视着圣地的中央，喃喃自语地祈祷着。

有朝一日，他或许真的会拥有成为一名优秀的卢德骑士所需的品质。

entries.en: "Right," he sticks his chest out a little more, categorizing you safely within his teleology. "I'm sworn to protect your lot, you know."
entries.zh: "确实，" 他的胸膛稍稍挺起，将你稳妥地划入他那与生俱来的使命之中。"我将立誓守护你的命运，望你知晓。"

entries.en:
The thought disrupts his expectations, and you can see it in his sudden squint. He looks around, making sure no subcurate is watching, then leans closer.

"What like ...the Path?" he whispers in horrified fascination, "Do you know Brother Cotton?"
entries.zh:
从他那骤然斜视的目光中，你能看出，这个想法出乎他的预料。他环视四周，确保没有助理祭司在看着，然后靠得更近了些。

"像什么样的...卢德之道？" 他惶恐着，却又不失痴迷，悄声低语道，"你知道 Cotton 修士吗？"

o.en: I've met him. His views are... unique.
o.zh: 我见过他。他的观点...很独到。

o.en: I've met him. Brother Cotton is a true visionary.
o.zh: 我见过他。Cotton 修士是一位真正远见卓识的人。

o.en: Yes. He's a snake that puts on a polite mask to charm people.
o.zh: 我知道他。他是条毒蛇，戴着彬彬有礼的面具来诱人上当。

o.en: No. But I'd like to. Then do what must be done.
o.zh: 没有，但我想要见他，然后做该做的事。

o.en: No. I have my own Path to follow.
o.zh: 不，我将追随我自己心中的圣道。

o.en: I came here to perhaps find that out.
o.zh: 我此行或许是为了找到那个答案。

o.en: I am here only to see what is to be seen.
o.zh: 我此行只是为了见我应见之物。

o.en: So quick to start a fight? You've only just signed up.
o.zh: 这么着急挑事？你才刚报名入团吧。

o.en: Despite appearances, I am a pilgrim, young knight.
o.zh: 尽管外表如此，但我是一名朝圣者，年轻的骑士。

o.en: I seek a Path not so different from yours.
o.zh: 我所追寻的那条圣道与你们并无二异。

entries.en:
At your request, the attending subcurate leads you through a brief ceremonial hand-washing, then down a long gallery.

The flow of the curate's robe doesn't quite touch the floor, a welded field of armored plates weathered into intricate patterns by the varied atmospheres of a score of worlds on which the Knights have fought and died. Niches along the walls are occupied by empty helmets.
entries.zh:
在你的要求下，在场的助理祭司带领你进行了一次简短的净手礼，然后领你沿着长廊走了下去。

祭司长袍拂过地面，那是一片用装甲板焊接而成的战场。每个装甲板都带着不同星球大气侵蚀的痕迹，组成了精致复杂的图案，展示着骑士们奋战至死的印记。沿着而建的壁龛被无数空空如也的头盔填得满满当当。

entries.en: At your request, the attending subcurate leads you through a brief ceremonial hand-washing, then down the gallery floored by welded armored plates. Niches along the walls are occupied by empty helmets.
entries.zh: 在你的要求下，在场的助理祭司带领你进行了一次简短的净手礼，然后领你沿着一条地面由装甲板焊接而成的长廊走了下去。沿着而建的壁龛被无数空空如也的头盔填得满满当当。

entries.en:
The shrine is a grand tomb set in an enormous airshaft. The industrial viscera has been transformed into a baroque sculpture of thousands of edged weapons aligned like feathers of a wing, rays of gleaming serrated metal boldly thrust in killing arcs through the vast space.

In the middle, surrounded by a galaxy of flickering candles, lie the lead-lined caskets of a squad of martyred Knights. The manner of their deaths, the subcurate explains in reverent whispers, left their bodies unidentifiable and infused with radioactive material which would kill a direct observer even to this day.
entries.zh:
这座圣地是一座华丽的墓穴，坐落在一个庞大的通风竖井内。曾经脉动的工业肺腑已经被一座巴洛克式的雕塑取而代之。成千上万锋利的兵刃犹如羽翼上的翎毛般齐整排列，钢铁的锋芒闪耀着寒光，错落有致地排出了弧形的杀阵，直指那无边的宇宙。

在那中央，无数烛火犹如银河般闪耀，将一队殉道骑士们的铅衬棺木环绕其中。助理祭司虔诚地低语道，他们的死因导致其遗体无法辨认，渗入的放射性物质时至今日仍会让直接观察的人命丧黄泉。

entries.en:
Subdued chanting, warped by the strange geometry of this cultic industrial space, blends with the air-cyclers. The candles burn clean and bright, gleaming off the multitude of bladed facets adorning every surface of the shrine's interior, a monument to sacral bloodshed.

You are left in a prayer-niche to contemplate the horror.
entries.zh:
在这尊奉教礼的工业区里，低沉的颂唱声被奇异的几何形体所扭曲，融入了空气循环。蜡烛的光芒清澈明亮，在那遍布圣地内每一个角落的锋刃饰面上闪耀着，这座纪念堂祭奠着那以神之名所挥洒的鲜血。

你留在一座祈祷者壁龛之中，深思着这份恐怖。

entries.en:
You are just beginning to make your way toward the shuttle bay when you receive a ping from your nav officer: the request to land has been denied by traffic control.

Strange. This should be perfectly routine.
entries.zh:
你刚刚开始前往穿梭机停泊港便收到了你领航军官的消息：着陆请求被交通管制中心拒绝了。

奇怪。这请求再普通不过了。

o.en: Request to speak with someone in authority

entries.en:
"Affirmative," Nav says. A moments pause. "Captain, I have traffic control on comms."

Nav patches you into the comm-loop, and a young-looking Luddic Knight, probably an initiate, appears before you.
entries.zh:
"好的，" 领航员说到。片刻过后。"舰长，我已经接通了交通管制中心。"

领航员将你接入到通讯回路中，一个看起来很年轻的卢德骑士，可能是个新人，出现在了你的面前。

entries.en: Nav patches you into the link, and a young-looking Luddic Knight - or maybe an initiate - appears before you.
entries.zh: 领航员将你接入链接，然后一个看起来很年轻的卢德骑士 —— 或者是个新人 —— 出现在你的面前。

entries.en:
"Blessed for the day, Captain," they just manage to hide the quaver in their voice. "With apologies, your request to land has been denied."

As you draw breath to reply, the initiate's eyes flick to a notification and go wide.

"Apologies, Captain ... I mean, respectfully. I... the Excubitor Orbis wishes to speak with you," they say without stumbling on the title. Practice, you're sure.

"Transferring link."
entries.zh:
"愿卢德保佑你，舰长。" 他们成功地藏住了他们声音中的颤抖，"十分抱歉，你的着陆请求被拒绝了。"

你吸了一口气，正准备回复，这个新人瞧了一眼通知然后瞪大了他的眼睛。

"抱歉，舰长... 我的意思是，尊敬的。我想说... 行星教卫想要和你通话。" 他们在念头衔的时候倒是十分流利。练过，你很确信。

"正在转接。"

entries.en:
The Excubitor Orbis appears before you.

"Captain $playerName," he says by way of greeting, a stern gaze already fixed on you.

The moment draws longer. He is the image of poise, perfectly content to wait for you to speak. A wrinkle appears, then disappears, by a mouth which appears fixed permanently on the precipice of a frown.
entries.zh:
行星教卫出现在了你的面前。

"$playerName 舰长。" 他以问候的语气说道，同时严肃地盯着你。

时间的流逝仿佛变慢了。他就好像是沉着的化身，全然沉浸于对你的等待之中。嘴角的皱纹若隐若现，像是被永远困在了成型的边缘不断徘徊。

o.en: Why was my travel request denied?
o.zh: 为什么我的航行请求被拒绝了？

o.en: I demand to know why my request was denied!
o.zh: 我要求得知为什么我的请求被拒绝了！

o.en: Take a shuttle to visit the Luddic shrine
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前去拜访卢德圣地

o.en: Take a shuttle to visit the Luddic shrine
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前去拜访卢德圣地

entries.en:
The landing bay antechamber is a baroque gothic-militant display of post-industrial salvage. Dead suits of power armor stand at attention, weapons proudly displayed. Glowing between rivet-encrusted arches are scenes of battle and martyrdom done up in mosaic panes formed of fractured gems; structural diamond and colorful lenses recovered from mining lasers or reactor inspection ports.

The gallery is filled with parties of Luddic pilgrims dressed in traditional handweave meeting with shrine attendants.
entries.zh:
登陆台的前厅里堆砌着后工业时代的文物，展现出巴洛克式的艺术风格，以及哥特式的尚武。能源耗尽的动力装甲摆出立正的姿势，骄傲的展示着手中的武器。嵌着铆钉的拱门之间透出光芒，其内是由宝石碎片打造的马赛克窗格，展现着战斗和殉道的场景。那些结构完美的钻石和色彩斑斓的透镜，是从采矿激光和反应堆检查端口之中回收而来的。

展馆里挤满了身着传统手工服饰的卢德朝圣者，他们正在与圣地的圣务侍们会面。

entries.en:
You make the arrangements and transfer the credits.

True to their word, the nonbeliever tags your shuttle with the ID for a regular pilgrim transport service.

Your shuttle begins its descent to the cold and unforgiving surface of Hesperus.
entries.zh:
你安排妥当并付了星币。

按照承诺，这个不信奉卢德教派的交通管制处人员把你的穿梭机用朝圣者定期运输航班的 ID 进行了标记。

你的穿梭机开始向 Hesperus 冰冷无情的地表降落。

entries.en:
The shrine is a grand tomb set in an enormous airshaft. The industrial viscera has been transformed into a baroque sculpture of thousands of edged weapons aligned like feathers of a wing, rays of gleaming serrated metal boldly thrust in killing arcs through the vast space.

In the center, surrounded by a galaxy of flickering candles, lie the lead-lined caskets of a squad of martyred Knights. The manner of their deaths, the subcurate explains in reverent whispers, left their bodies unidentifiable and infused with radioactive material which would kill a direct observer even to this day.

You are left in a prayer-niche to contemplate the horror.
entries.zh:
这座圣地是一座华丽的墓穴，坐落在一个庞大的通风竖井内。曾经脉动的工业肺腑已经被一座巴洛克式的雕塑取而代之。成千上万锋利的兵刃犹如羽翼上的翎毛般齐整排列，钢铁的锋芒闪耀着寒光，错落有致地排出了弧形的杀阵，直指那无边的宇宙。

在那中央，无数烛火犹如银河般闪耀，将一队殉道骑士们的铅衬棺木环绕其中。助理祭司虔诚地低语道，他们的死因导致其遗体无法辨认，渗入的放射性物质时至今日仍会让直接观察的人命丧黄泉。

你留在一座祈祷者壁龛之中，深思着这份恐怖。

entries.en:
In the next niche over, a young knight-initiate gives you a challenging look. His head is freshly shaved; he must be very new to the order.

"You're not a Knight," he says quietly, making a show of looking over your uniform. "Nor one of us. Not really. Why are you here, spacer?"
entries.zh:
在对面的壁龛里，一名年轻入门骑士向你送来一个审视的眼神。他剃发的痕迹还很新鲜，想必才刚刚加入骑士团不久。

"你并非骑士，" 他轻声说道，一边装腔作势地上下打量着你的制服，"也不是我们中的一员，至少不像。你为何来到这里，宇宙民？"

entries.en:
Traffic control gives you its blessing and your shuttle descends toward the unforgiving surface of Hesperus.

The planet is riven by glaciers like a network of scars on the battered hide of some ancient beast. Your flight path takes you toward one great canyon filled with a chaos of ice and stone, then a child-branch over which walls of dark rock loom. Now and again you spot the crumbling remains of industry, and among them the occasional lights of Knight-chartered enterprises and monastic communities.
entries.zh:
交通管制处为你送上了例行的 "卢德保佑"。你的穿梭机开始降落到冰冷无情的 Hesperus 地表。

Hesperus 的地表被冰川切割得四分五裂，如同一头上古凶兽伤痕累累的毛皮，疤痕勾连成网。你的航线将你带往一个巨大的峡谷，里面凌乱地堆砌着冰块和岩石。接着映入眼帘的是峡谷的一条分支，其上是若隐若现，有如无边城墙的漆黑巨石。你时不时看见摇摇欲坠的工业遗迹，其中间或闪烁着属于骑士特批企业和隐修社区的灯火。

entries.en: Traffic control gives you its blessing, so to speak, and your shuttle begins its descent to the cold and unforgiving surface of Hesperus.
entries.zh: 说出来你自己都不信，交通管制居然祝福了你，随后，你的穿梭机开始向 Hesperus 冰冷无情的地表降落。

entries.en:
A well-timed plume of radiation from nearby Daedaleon gives your shuttle cover to sneak through the local traffic control's sensor net.

Your shuttle begins its descent to the cold and unforgiving surface of Hesperus.
entries.zh:
一股辐射羽流从附近的 Daedaleon 如期而至，掩护你的穿梭机躲过了当地交通管制的传感器网络。

你的穿梭机开始向 Hesperus 冰冷无情的地表降落。

entries.en:
The planet is riven by glaciers like a network of scars on the battered hide of a fossilized monster.

The flight path takes your shuttle into a great canyon of canyons filled with a chaos of ice and stone. The shuttle banks into an off-branch; the ridges of dark rock loom larger.

Now and again you spot the crumbling remains of industry, and among them the occasional lights of a Knight-chartered enterprise or monastic community.
entries.zh:
这颗星球被冰川切割得四分五裂，如同一头石制野兽，疤痕在它那伤痕累累的毛皮上勾连成网。

你的跟随着导航飞入了一个巨大的峡谷中，冰块和岩石凌乱地堆砌着。穿梭机倾斜着飞进峡谷的一条岔路，隐约间，你感觉黑色巨石构成的山脊愈加巨大。

你隐约间看见残破不堪的工业遗迹中，骑士特批企业和隐修社区的灯火正在闪烁。

entries.en:
Around one last turn of the canyon, the shrine complex appears, a bright spire of habitats, towers, and masts rising from the misty remains of a titanic atmospheric processing plant.

Your trained eye spots the likely positions of heavy weapon emplacements: too-clean cliff-faces at convenient angles, the suspiciously level floors of certain hanging valleys.
entries.zh:
在峡谷的最后一个拐角处，圣地的殿堂出现了。那是一座由栖息地，塔楼，旗杆簇拥而成的尖顶，灯火辉煌，从云山雾罩的巨型大气处理厂废墟中拔地而起。

你久经训练的眼光发现了一些可能布置有重武器的位置：角度适合射击且过于干净的峭壁，某些悬谷上平坦到可疑的地表。

entries.en:
You put in the order to have a shuttle prepared for a flight to the surface.

"Captain," your Nav officer reports, "Traffic control is denying your flight request."
entries.zh:
你下令让一艘穿梭机做好飞往地面的准备。

"舰长，" 你的领航军官汇报道，"交通管制处否决了你的飞行请求。"

o.en: Get me the Excubitor Orbis on comms.

entries.en:
You put in the order to have a shuttle prepared for a flight to the surface.

"Captain," your Nav officer reports, "Traffic control is denying your flight request."
entries.zh:
你下令让一艘穿梭机做好飞往地面的准备。

"舰长，" 你的领航军官汇报道，"交通管制处否决了你的飞行请求。"

o.en: Get me the Excubitor Orbis on comms.
Secretly take a shuttle to visit the Luddic shrine
o.zh: 秘密搭乘穿梭机去拜访卢德圣地

entries.en: Subdued chanting, warped by the strange geometry of this cultic industrial space, blends with the air-cyclers. The candles burn clean and bright, gleaming off the multitude of bladed facets adorning every surface of the shrine's interior, a monument to sacral bloodshed.
entries.zh: 在这尊奉教礼的工业区里，一系列奇形怪状的物体，使那压抑的颂唱声扭曲着，最终融化在空气循环器里。蜡烛的光芒清澈明亮，在那遍布圣地内每一个角落的锋刃饰面上闪耀着，这座纪念堂祭奠着那以神之名所挥洒的鲜血。

entries.en:
The novice seems to brighten up at this. "It's actually a misunderstanding that the teachings of Ludd are anti-technological, after all..." They see the look on your face at the threat of another scripture reading.

"Ahem. In other words, we believe the problem with advanced technology is not necessarily intrinsic. Well, some technologies are abhorrent- planet-killers, mind-interfacing, crass immortality. Anyway, the six industrial sins are committed when the human spirit is corrupted by technology used without virtue."
entries.zh:
见习修士听到你的话后似乎眼前一亮。"常人认为卢德教义反科技，这实际上是一种误解，毕竟..." 话说到一半，对方注意到了你面如死灰的表情，仿佛已经忍耐经文到了极限。

"嗯嗯。换句话说，我们认为先进技术的问题不一定是内在的。好吧，的确有些技术本身就令人憎恶 —— 行星杀手、心灵接口、愚蠢的永生。总之，工业的六宗罪是因为人们的精神被无道德底线的技术侵蚀所导致的。"

entries.en:
Point made, they nod emphatically. "You fly a space-ship, right? There are many good reasons to do this. To deliver charity, to unite families, to feed the hungry..."

The novice rattles off some extremely optimistic scenarios, and you're forced to concede - to yourself - that it's not unlikely that some of these causes have been inadvertently served in the course of your career.
entries.zh:
说到点子上后，对方笃定地点着头。"你是开飞船的，对吧？这样的职业很好，很值得从事。可以做慈善，让家庭和睦，还能帮助有需要的人..."

见习修士滔滔不绝地说出了一些理想的情景，而你则必须承认 —— 扪心自问 —— 在你的职业生涯中，对方提到的一些事的确可能在不经意间发生。

entries.en: "Forgive them their youth," the curate says with a sad smile. "We live it but once."
entries.zh: "请原谅他们的莽撞。" 祭司苦笑着说，"我们都是从那个时候过来的。"

entries.en: The curate nods. "Each person finds expression of spirit in their own way. That is the beauty of the gift of consciousness. Or," $heOrShe adds with a wink, "Its evolution, as you may prefer."
entries.zh: 祭司点点头。"每个人对心灵都有自己的解读，这便是意识的妙处，或者说..." $heOrShe眨了眨眼睛，"这是种进化，假如这么说你更好理解的话。"

entries.en: The curate smiles a little. "You speak already as if you walk among the Faithful. But as Ludd said, 'The truth of words is revealed by where stands the speaker.'"
entries.zh: 祭司微微一笑。"你的言辞让人感觉你已拥抱信仰。但正如卢德所说，'话语的真理是由说话者的立场所揭示的。'"

entries.en: The curate smiles a little. Is $heOrShe hiding something behind $hisOrHer display of piety?
entries.zh: 祭司微微一笑。$heOrShe是否在那虔诚下隐藏着别的东西呢？

entries.en: The curate smiles at your words. "Yes, to do so would be a praiseworthy service."
entries.zh: 祭司听了你的话后微笑起来。"没错，这样做是值得称赞的。"

entries.en:
The curate freezes, suddenly wary. "Ah."

$HeOrShe lets a breath out. "Now there's a name I have not heard in a very long time."

Before you can speak, the curate continues "It's nothing untoward. I do tend to this shrine and my transient flock, but I am not a hermit. Of course I have heard of Cotton. And met him on one occasion. I made my report to the Knights long ago and that was the end of it."

"I hesitate to ask, but must: why do you inquire so?"
entries.zh:
祭司僵住了，突然露出了戒备的模样。"啊。"

$HeOrShe吐出了一口气。"我很久没听过这个名字了。"

你还没来得及说什么，祭司就继续说了下去。"没什么大问题。我确实在照顾着这个圣地和在这暂住的信徒们，但我不是隐士。我当然听说过 Cotton，甚至见过他一次。那时我向骑士们做了相关报告，不过我与此人的交集仅此而已。"

"虽然有些犹豫，但我必须得问你：你为何向我打听他？"

o.en: I am going to kill him.

entries.en:
"I would counsel you against that path," the curate says flatly.

The curate brushes off $hisOrHer robes. "If it pleases you," $heOrShe does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
entries.zh:
"我奉劝你不要踏上那条道路。" 祭司断然地说。

祭司轻振$hisOrHer的长袍。"如果我的回答让你满意了的话，" $heOrShe避开了你的目光，"我得去照顾其他朝圣者了。"

entries.en:
The curate sighs, rubbing $hisOrHer eyes as if a sharp headache had just come upon $himOrHer, then speaks.

"I could not say if you would find the finality you seek on that particular path."
entries.zh:
祭司叹了口气，揉了揉$hisOrHer的眼睛，仿佛正在忍受剧烈的头痛，然后开口道：

"我并不知道这条道路是否通向你所追求的最终结局。"

o.en: By broadside or sidearm, I can ensure finality.
o.zh: 不管用舷炮还是佩枪，我都会确保那是我想要的结局。

entries.en:
"He's not the first of his kind, nor will he be the last, nor is he the only," $heOrShe says with a pained voice.

"If it pleases you," the curate does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
entries.zh:
"他不是第一个选择如此的人，也不会是最后一个，更不是唯一的一个。" $heOrShe痛苦地说道。

"如果这让你满意的话，" 祭司没有和你对视，"我现在要去见其他的朝圣者了。"

entries.en:
"As you say," the curate concedes without meeting your eyes.

"If it pleases you," the curate does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
entries.zh:
"就照你的意思来吧。" 祭司勉为其难地同意了，但没有对上你的目光。

"如果我的回答让你满意了的话，" 祭司避开了你的目光，"我得去照顾其他朝圣者了。"

entries.en: "And were you to find him?"
entries.zh: "那如果你找到他了呢？"

o.en: I am going to kill him.

entries.en:
The curate looks tired, but considers this response.

"Would he tell you anything you did not already believe?" $HeOrShe sits down on a bench with a sigh. "You need not answer that. And I would prefer you did not."

"People come to this shrine seeking answers. I have found that most who come here already have the answers they seek; truly what they seek is permission to accept that which they already know."
entries.zh:
祭司看起来很疲惫，但还是思考了一下你的回应。

"他会告诉你一些你还不相信的事吗？" $HeOrShe叹了口气并坐到了长凳上，"不必回答，我只希望你不要这样做。"

"人们来到这圣地寻求答案。但我发现，大多数来到这里的人，心中其实早已有了他们寻求的答案；他们真正寻求的，是获得许可，去接受那些他们已经知道的事情。"

entries.en: The curate stands, and brushes off $hisOrHer robe. "If it pleases you," the curate does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
entries.zh: 祭司站了起来，轻振$hisOrHer的长袍。"如果我的回答让你满意了的话，" 祭司避开了你的目光，"我得去照顾其他朝圣者了。"

entries.en:
"Well. Whatever your intentions, I would counsel you to walk a path far from 'Brother' Cotton," the curate says flatly.

The curate brushes off $hisOrHer robes. "If it pleases you," $heOrShe does not meet your eyes, "I shall attend to the other pilgrims now."
entries.zh:
"好吧，无论你意欲何方，我都劝你最好能踏上一条远离 Cotton '修士' 的道路。" 祭司断然地说。

祭司轻振$hisOrHer的长袍。"如果我的回答让你满意了的话，" $heOrShe说，"我得去照顾其他朝圣者了。"

entries.en:
"Ye... es," the curate says, eyeing you skeptically.

"I'm sure," $heOrShe continues charitably, "that charging a nominal fare for fuel, air, and foodstuff would not be wholly out of line. The faithful would not expect you to beggar yourself to provide safe transport."
entries.zh:
"是...的。" 祭司说，看向你的目光满是怀疑。

"可以肯定的是，" $heOrShe宽容地继续道，"对燃料、空气和食物收取象征性的费用是合理的。信徒们不会指望你无偿提供安全的交通服务。"

entries.en: "To those ends, if indeed this is your intended venture, I should provide you with coordinates of all the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Though... some shrines have been lost. Opis, of course, is no more. There was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is possessed of many dangers, I hear, even beyond that system's infestation of pirates. Nonetheless, ah-"
entries.zh: "如果你真的想要进行这样的冒险，我应该向你提供朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标以助你实现你的目标。尽管...一些神殿已经不复存在了，就比如 Opis。Killa 上曾经有个神殿，或许现在还在，我听说那里存在着许多比海盗侵袭还要严重的危险。尽管如此，啊 ——"

entries.en:
"Before you go, captain, I beg you indulge me. I would 'upload' to you the coordinates for all of the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. Perhaps you will follow this fascination?"

$HeOrShe fumbles with a battered off-brand datapad, clearly uncomfortable with its use.
entries.zh:
"舰长，请允许我在你离开之前向你 '上传' 朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标。也许你会深深着迷于此。"

$HeOrShe在一个破旧不堪的杂牌数据平板上摸索着，显然是不太擅长使用它。

o.zh: 指导 $himOrHer 使用数据平板

entries.en: The curate nods. "A fair rebuke. It is simply that you do not look like a pilgrim to me. I should not be so rigid of mind."
entries.zh: 祭司点点头。"很合适的指摘。在我看来你就不像个朝圣者。或许我不该这么固执的。"

entries.en:
"Gilead, Jangala, Hesperus... a handful," $heOrShe says with a pause, eyes searching. "Some have been lost over the years; Opis of course. And others sanctified anew. Here of course; Beholder Station orbiting Kumari Aru, though militant elements frequent the volume. And Volturn, though the present authorities are fickle about access."

"There... was, or possibly is, a shrine on Killa. It is a dangerous place however, to say nothing of the system's infestation of pirates."
entries.zh:
"Gilead、Jangala、Hesperus...有不少。" $heOrShe停顿了一下，目光仿佛在寻找着什么。"有些已经遗失在岁月中了，比如 Opis。还有一些地方被重新革凡登圣。譬如此地，Kumari Aru 轨道上的 Beholder 空间站就是一处，尽管武装分子频繁在附近出没。还有 Volturn 圣地，然而当局对是否允许拜访那里一事反复无常。"

"还有曾经的 Killa 圣地...可能现在还在。不过那里的环境本来就很危险，更别提该星系常受到海盗侵扰了。"

o.en: One could make a few credits transporting pilgrims between shrines...
o.zh: 看来在圣地之间为朝圣者提供交通服务可以赚些星币...

o.en: It could be charitable to transport pilgrims between shrines...
o.zh: 看来在圣地之间为朝圣者提供交通服务是不错的慈善事业...

o.en: I would like to visit the shrines.
I would make a pilgrimage to each of the shrines.
o.zh: 我打算去所有圣地朝圣。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat, then gives a practiced speech: "Taken together, these shrines form the Pilgrim's Path. It is not merely a linear path through space. Though of course," $heOrShe takes a patient tone, "In secular use the name has been given to the major shipping lanes between Church and Hegemony-controlled volumes."

The curate continues, "The Pilgrim's Path is a spiritual journey unique to each individual as they explore and discover their faith through our shared teachings, the holy Word gifted to us by the Creator who touched the prophet Ludd. The faithful are encouraged to make a pilgrimage at least once in their life, if they are able."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe清了清嗓子，开始进行一段熟练的说明。"如果在太空中画一条线，把这些圣地串在一起，就形成了{朝圣者之路}。对我们来说，它可不仅仅是一条穿过太空的路程。话虽如此..." $heOrShe慢条斯理地说道，"在世俗语境中，这个名字常被用来指代来往于教会和霸主控制的星际空间之间的重要航道。"

祭司继续说下去。"对每个人来说，{朝圣者之路}是他们独一无二的精神旅程，他们通过我们共同的教义，也就是曾感动先知卢德的造物主赐予我们的圣言，来探索和发现自己的信仰。我们鼓励信众，若有能力的情况下，在他们的一生中至少应当进行一次朝圣之旅。"

o.en: One could make a few credits transporting pilgrims between shrines...
o.zh: 看来在圣地之间为朝圣者提供交通服务可以赚些星币...

o.en: It could be charitable to transport pilgrims between shrines...
o.zh: 看来在圣地之间为朝圣者提供交通服务是不错的慈善事业...

o.en: I would like to visit the shrines.

entries.en: "You are welcome here," the curate calls to you as you go. "Always."
entries.zh: "我们欢迎你拜访此地。" 祭司在你离开的时候说到，"永远欢迎。"

entries.en:
The curate lets a broad smile appear. "Then let me be first to welcome you on your first step on the Pilgrim's Path. You will experience wonders both beautiful and terrible, great and small, of human and natural aspects of Creation."

"Some unbelievers, I am told, have inadvertently found their faith while walking the Pilgrim's Path." $HeOrShe shrugs, "Providence works in ways mysterious to us."
entries.zh:
祭司露出了灿烂的笑容。"那么就让我荣幸地成为庆祝你踏上朝圣者之径的第一人。你将体验到人类与自然造物的美丽与恐怖、宏大与渺小。"

"有人告诉过我，有些本来不信教的人，在朝圣者之路上无意中找到了信仰。" $HeOrShe耸了耸肩，"天意难测。"

o.en: I'm not a pilgrim, I just wanted to see the shrine.
o.zh: 我不是为了朝拜，我只是想参观圣地。
你说 '受召' 是什么意思？

o.en: I bet you use that line with everyone.
o.zh: 我敢打赌你跟谁都这么说。

o.en: It's good to finally talk to an adult.
o.zh: 很庆幸终于能和一位成年人交谈了。
和我介绍一下这地方吧。

o.en: I would like to consider myself a pilgrim.
o.zh: 我愿意把自己当成朝圣者。

o.en: How do you know I'm not a pilgrim?
o.zh: 你怎么知道我不是朝圣者的？

o.en: Thank you; my interest is purely secular.
o.zh: 谢谢，但我对这里只有些世俗的兴趣。

entries.en: $PersonPost $personName nods in acknowledgement as you take the first step on whatever path you might follow.
entries.zh: $PersonPost $personName 向你点头致意，而你也迈步走向了那条属于自己的道途。

entries.en: $PersonPost $personName gives you a strange look as you walk away, as if $heOrShe knows not what path you might take.
entries.zh: $PersonPost $personName 在你离开时投来了奇怪的目光，似乎是因为$heOrShe无法看出你将去往何方。

entries.en: $PersonPost $personName motions a sign of blessing as you take your first step on this Pilgrim's Path.
entries.zh: $PersonPost $personName 在你踏上朝圣者之路时为你祈福。

entries.en: $PersonPost $personName gives you a strange look as you walk away, as if $heOrShe has concern for the path you might take.
entries.zh: $PersonPost $personName 在你离开时投来了奇怪的目光，似乎是因为$heOrShe很关心你将要选择的方向。

entries.en:
"It is my calling to serve the pilgrims who come here."

A pause, then, "And also those who are not pilgrims." $HeOrShe looks expectantly at you, $hisOrHer silence asking which one you are - pilgrim or not?
entries.zh:
"为来到这里的朝圣者服务是我的使命。"

对方停顿了一下，随即继续道，"当然我也会为并非朝圣者的人服务。" $HeOrShe满面期待地看着你，$hisOrHer的沉默则是对你的询问 —— 你是不是朝圣者呢？

entries.en:
"It is my calling to serve the pilgrims who come here."

A pause, then, "And also those who are not pilgrims." $HeOrShe looks expectantly at you.
entries.zh:
我生来就是为了服侍来此的朝圣者。

稍顿，又说道，“还有那些并非朝圣者的人。” $HeOrShe 期待地看着你。

entries.en:
"Here, captain, let me 'upload' to you the coordinates for all of the known shrines of the Pilgrim's Path."

$HeOrShe fumbles with a battered off-brand datapad, clearly uncomfortable with its use.
entries.zh:
"舰长，来，让我向你 '上传' 朝圣者之路上所有已知神殿的坐标。"

$HeOrShe在一个破旧不堪的杂牌数据平板上摸索着，显然是不太擅长使用它。

o.zh: 指导 $himOrHer 使用数据平板

entries.en: As if on cue - or perhaps because they were hovering nearby the whole time - the curate of the shrine steps up to you and the novice.
entries.zh: 好像是碰巧 —— 又或者是因为对方根本就没离开过 —— 此时，圣地的祭司向你和见习修士走来。

entries.en:
"That's quite enough, my child," they say with iron concealed beneath soft words, "Perhaps you should undertake a prayer of contrition in the chapel while I speak with the captain."

Abashed, the novice bows and flees. The curate turns to you, face worn with lines of more than just patience.
entries.zh:
"够了，我的孩子。" 对方轻柔的话语里透露出铁一般的执着。"也许在我和舰长说话时，你应该在小教堂里做一个忏悔的祈祷。"

见习修士羞愧地鞠了一躬，逃也似地离开了。祭司看向你，在她脸上留下痕迹的不止有多年的耐心。

entries.en:
"Ah, the blessed faith of the young," the curate dismisses the novice with a nod. "Forthright and, I'm afraid, tactless."

"My name is $personName, and I am entrusted with the care of this shrine. I felt called to personally welcome you, captain."
entries.zh:
"啊，年轻人的神圣信仰..." 祭司点了点头，让见习修士离开了。"直率，但恐怕还有些莽撞。"

"我是 $personName，负责照看这处圣地的牧师。这位舰长，我受召来亲自招待您。"

entries.en: "Then you may rest certain that you have come to the right place," the curate says warmly.
entries.zh: "那么你可以放心，你来对地方了。" 祭司热情地说。

entries.en: "Perhaps your interest here is purely secular?" The curate smiles a little, then says "You have my welcome whether you come with faith or not."
entries.zh: "也许你对这里的兴趣无关信仰？" 祭司微微一笑，"无论是否拥有信仰，这儿都欢迎你。"

entries.en: The curate smiles. "You have my welcome whether you have come for faith or not."
entries.zh: 祭司笑了。"不管是不是为了信仰而来，圣地都欢迎你的参观。"

entries.en: After a moment, you point out the correct sequence of commands for transferring the nav data.
entries.zh: 过了一会儿，你指出了用于传输导航数据的正确命令集。

entries.en: "My thanks," $heOrShe says humbly.
entries.zh: "谢谢。" $heOrShe谦卑地说。

o.en: By the way, do you know one Brother Livewell Cotton?
o.zh: 对了，你知道 Livewell Cotton 修士吗？

o.en: I'm sure this will be interesting, curate.
o.zh: 我猜这会很有趣的，祭司。

o.en: No, thank you. Now I have a journey to begin.
o.zh: 不，我才该感谢你。现在我该开始一段旅程了。

o.en: Now I know where to avoid. Good-day.
o.zh: 现在我知道该避开哪些地方了，再会。

o.en: Not Moloch nor Mammon shall lead me astray.
o.zh: 双子恶魔们也无法令我误入歧途。

entries.en: "Yes." The curate smiles a little, "Yes, I do. You have caught me out from atop a world-weary wall built around your soul."
entries.zh: "是的。" 祭司微微一笑，"没错，我的确如此。你的灵魂筑起了一道厌世之墙与信仰隔离，却依然翻上墙顶接受我的引导。"

entries.en:
"Might you indeed," the curate says with a small smile. "Even to a secular visitor they represent wonders both beautiful and terrible of human and natural aspects of Creation."

"Some unbelievers, I am told, have inadvertently found their faith while walking the Pilgrim's Path." $HeOrShe shrugs coyly, "Providence works in ways most mysterious."
entries.zh:
"当然可以。" 祭司浅笑着说。"即使对世俗的游客来说，它们也能充分体现人类和自然造物的美丽与恐怖。"

"有人告诉过我，有些本来不信教的人，在朝圣者之路上无意中找到了信仰。" $HeOrShe耸肩的动作微小得你几乎没有察觉，"天意难测。"

entries.en:
You join the novice in prayer, repeating the words as best you can with hands clasped. At first it feels silly to partake in this naive ritual led by a cloistered child of the Church. It is like a lamb leading the lion.

And yet.

Perhaps there is value in the unblushing faith held by such an innocent.

When the prayer finishes, the novice beams a bright smile at you. Behind, you notice that the shrine's Curate Sacraria - the priest of highest authority here - has been watching your exchange from a candle-lit alcove.
entries.zh:
你加入了见习修士的祷告，双手合十，尽可能地重复着祷告词。起初，参加这个由一个与世隔绝的教会孩子主持的天真的仪式感觉很傻。就像狮子去接受小羊羔的指引一样。

然而那只是一开始的想法。

也许这样一个天真无邪的孩子毫不羞愧地秉持的信念，的确有其价值所在。

当祷告结束时，见习修士对你灿烂地微笑着。你注意到，在后面，圣地的神龛祭司 —— 这里的最高权威牧师 —— 一直在烛光照亮的壁龛边观察着你们的互动。

entries.en:
"Wonderful! Blessed already are those whose spirit of reason calls them to the Church."

This is everything they could have hoped for, everything they've been training for. You're given an earful and more about sin, forgiveness, redemption, and the spiritual salve of a simple life. Lots about walking a path and stories about how all sorts of people were impressed with things Ludd said and did.

The novice winds down, and, noticing your endurance flagging, says "May... may I pray with you for a safe journey through the holy vacuum?"
entries.zh:
"太棒了！受精神呼唤前往教会的人已是受福之人。"

这是对方期盼的回答，也是对方为之训练的目标。你听了一大堆话，是关于罪、宽恕、救赎和朴素生活等的种种精神慰藉。还有很多故事，指引人如何与道同行，以及各种各样的人是如何折服于卢德的言行的。

注意到你的不耐烦，见习修士不再滔滔不绝，反而说到，"我...我可以和你一同祈祷吗？祝愿我们在神圣的虚空中一路平安。"

o.en: Politely pretend to join the novice in prayer
o.zh: 礼貌地假装和见习修士一起祈祷

o.en: Pretend to join the novice in prayer
o.zh: 假装和见习修士一起祈祷

径直离开  #"It's a good story, but... it sounds like a story."  #"It's a good story, but... it sounds like a story."  #"It's a good story, but... it sounds like a story."  #"It's a good story, but... it sounds like a story."  #"It's a good story, but... it sounds like a story."

entries.en:
"Wait," says the novice, "I-"

And you're gone.
entries.zh:
"等等，"见习修士喊道，"我 ——"

但你已经走远了。

entries.en:
"Oh," says the novice, "I-"

And you're gone.
entries.zh:
"哦，"见习修士喊道，"我 ——"

但你已经走远了。

entries.en:
Their mouth shuts, attack-routine shunting to another approach pattern in response to your spoiling feint, then opens again.

"If-" they begin, but you've already turned away.
entries.zh:
修士立马闭嘴了，开始转化攻击模式以应对你的破坏性佯攻，然后再次开口。

"如果 ——" 对方开始说话，但你已经转身离开了。

entries.en:
Your polite rebuff only kindles their pious urge to engage.

"So you've already heard the Good News," the novice says eagerly. "Blessed are you in the eyes of Ludd, already and truly. Do you count yourself among the Faithful or has a sense of spiritual longing brought you to this shrine?"
entries.zh:
你礼貌性的拒绝只是让对方虔诚的热情烧得更旺了。

"这么说，你已经得知好消息了。" 见习修士满面热情，"你在卢德的眼中已存真福。你认为自己是虔诚的信徒吗？还是精神上的渴望把你带到了这圣地来？"

o.en: I was simply curious about the shrine.
o.zh: 我很好奇圣地长什么样。

o.en: I... may have some spiritual questions.
o.zh: 我...也许有些唯心方面的问题。

o.en: You misunderstand; I already walk the Path.
o.zh: 你误解了我的话语，我早已踏上了卢德之道。

o.en: No. What good is a religion that hates technology?
o.zh: 不。一个憎恨科技的宗教有什么好的？

o.en: Sorry, but I'm busy. Very busy. Good-bye.
o.zh: 抱歉，但我是个忙人，非常忙。再见。

entries.en:
You politely hold your hands together and mumble something prayer-like, taking a moment to appreciate the poetry of the quoted scripture despite the naive delivery.

When the prayer finishes, the novice beams a bright smile at you. Behind them, you notice that the shrine's Curate Sacraria - the priest of highest authority here - has been watching your exchange from a candle-lit alcove.
entries.zh:
你礼貌地双手合十，边随意地呢喃着一些类似祷文的东西，边欣赏着所引用的祷文中的诗意来，尽管它的表达方式很幼稚。

当祷告结束时，见习修士对你粲然一笑。你注意到，在那身后，圣地的神龛祭司 —— 这里的最高权威牧师 —— 一直在烛光照亮的壁龛边观察着你们的互动。

entries.en:
You keep quiet and let the youth rattle on while you get in a good eye-roll.

Letting out a sigh, you happen to spot the shrine's Curate Sacraria, the priest of highest authority here, watching your interaction from a candle-lit alcove. They make eye contact and raise an eyebrow.
entries.zh:
你不言一语，面前的年轻人喋喋不休，你只得翻了翻白眼。

你叹了口气，碰巧注意到圣地的神龛祭司，这里的最高权威牧师，一直在烛光照亮的壁龛边观察着你们的互动。对方对上了你的目光，并扬了扬眉毛。

entries.en:
This stops the novice short with a look just this side of panic. It is as if hearing you blaspheme so might sully their own faith. You notice their hands unconsciously motion a sign of contrition.

"Ah, that is not- pardon me, I mean to say, 'Blessed are the ignorant', so Ludd said, 'that they might be led on their first steps toward the path to righteousness.' And I believe that, t-truly," the novice stammers.

You see movement now, from the candle-lit alcove behind the novice.
entries.zh:
这话让见习修士猛地顿住，脸上几乎露出惊慌。仿佛听你如此亵渎，连他们自己的信仰都要被玷污了似的。你留意到他们的手不自觉地比了个忏悔的手势。

"啊，那不是—— 恕我失言，我是想说，'无知者有福'，卢德曾如是说，'好叫他们踏上通往义路的第一步。' 我信这个，真、真的，" 见习修士结结巴巴地说道。

这时你看见，见习修士身后烛光照亮的壁龛里，有东西动了动。

o.en: I'd like to learn more about your faith.
o.zh: 我很乐意再深入了解一下你们的信仰。

o.en: Thank you, but I'm already familiar with your religion.
o.zh: 谢谢，但我已经对你们的宗教很熟悉了。

o.en: Look. I'm a supporter of AI rights, so... (truth)
o.zh: 听着。我是支持 AI 权利的，所以... (实话)

o.en: I'm a strong supporter of AI rights. (provoke)
o.zh: 我是赋予 AI 人权提议的坚定支持者。

o.en: I have felt myself drawn to the Path.
o.zh: 我感到自己已经被卢德之道所吸引。

entries.en: The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful, yet you are keenly aware of the thin envelope of technology protecting you from the ravages of vacuum and radiation.
entries.zh: 搭乘穿梭机返航的过程平稳顺利，然而你敏锐地意识到，保护你免受真空和辐射摧残的是一层由科技造就的薄外衣。

entries.en: The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful, yet you are keenly aware of the thin envelope of technology protecting you from the ravages of vacuum and radiation.
entries.zh: 搭乘穿梭机返航的过程平稳顺利，然而你敏锐地意识到，保护你免受真空和辐射摧残的是一层由科技造就的薄外衣。

entries.en:
You notice a young novice watching you. As you accidentally meet their eyes, their smile widens; target acquired. They approach, keen on proselytization to a spacer captain.

These enthusiastic missionaries are a common enough affliction of spacedocks, so you are not unprepared. As they first draw breath to speak, you seize the initiative and say-
entries.zh:
你注意到一个年轻的见习修士在看着你。当你对上那人的目光时，对方的笑容变得灿烂起来，像是发现了目标一般。修士往这边走来，似乎是想改变一位太空舰长的信仰。

这些热情的传教士是太空船坞里常见的折磨怪，所以你其实早有准备。当对方深吸一口气就要说话时，你抓住主动权说道 ——

entries.en:
Without making eye contact, you notice one of those youthful proselytizing types attempting to engage with the occasional hard-case spacer. If you wanted to chat, you'd only have to give the subtlest sign and they'd be filling your ears with hymns of Ludd.

Behind, a humbly yet splendidly robed shadow lurks in a candle-lit alcove. The shrine's Curate, you must assume.
entries.zh:
在避开对方目光的前提下，你注意到了一个年轻的传教者试图与偶尔出现的顽固宇宙民交流。如果想和对方聊聊，你只需要给出一个最微妙的手势，对方就会用卢德的赞美诗填满你的耳朵。

在他后方，一个穿着华丽长袍但姿态谦卑的身影潜伏在烛光照亮的壁龛边。你猜那应该是圣地的住持祭司。

o.en: Why not. Look over to the young missionary.
o.zh: 为什么不呢？把目光投向那年轻的传教士。

entries.en:
As you meet their eyes, their smile widens; target acquired. They approach, keen to recite the unabridged Sacred Texts of Ludd to you.

They first draw breath to speak and you seize the initiative to say-
entries.zh:
当你对上那人的目光时，对方的笑容变得灿烂起来，像是发现了目标一般。对方往这边走来，带着为你背诵未删节版 [卢德圣典] 的渴望。

当对方深吸一口气就要说话时，你抓住主动权说道 ——

entries.en:
This stops the novice short with a look just this side of panic. It is as if hearing you blaspheme so might sully their own faith. You notice their hands unconsciously motion a sign of contrition.

"Ah, that is not- pardon me, I mean to say, 'Blessed are the ignorant', so Ludd said, 'that they might be led on their first steps toward the path to righteousness.' And I believe that, t-truly," the novice stammers.

You see movement now, from the candle-lit alcove behind the novice.
entries.zh:
这让见习修士呆滞了一会，眼光中透露着惊恐，仿佛在听到你亵渎的话语后自己的信仰也会受到玷污。你注意到对方的手无意识地在做出忏悔的手势。

"啊，那不 —— 请原谅我，我的意思是，'无知者也可享有福音'，卢德是这么说的，'他们也被允许引入正义之道。' 而我相信这一点，真...真的。" 见习修士结结巴巴地说。

这时你注意到那个见习修士后方烛光照亮的壁龛里骚动起来。

entries.en:
"Oh! Pardon my presumption, $playerBrotherOrSister. May... may I pray with you for a safe journey through the holy vacuum?"

The novice perhaps asked this rhetorically, for they're already clasping their hands, eyes closed, and calling for submission before divine providence that you may navigate holy Creation to better serve in carrying out Ludd's teachings, and so on.
entries.zh:
"哦！请原谅我的冒昧，$playerBrotherOrSister。我...我可以和你一同祈祷吗？祝愿我们在神圣的虚空中一路平安。"

见习修士只是礼貌性地这么问了一下，因为还没等你回应，对方已经双手合十、双目紧闭开始祷告，祷词无非是煽动你向神圣天意展现自己的顺从，以便神赐予你驾驭神圣的造物的能力，更坚定地执行卢德的教义等等。

o.zh: 假装和见习修士一起祈祷

o.zh: 礼貌地假装和见习修士一起祈祷

o.en: Take this opportunity to sneak away

entries.en: "Oh, praise Ludd!" the novice exclaims, "That you would be so drawn to spiritual salvation, $playerBrotherOrSister. May... may I pray with you for a safe journey through the holy vacuum?"
entries.zh: "喔，卢德在上！" 见习修士惊呼道，"你竟如此浸淫于精神救赎，$playerBrotherOrSister。我...我可以和你一同祈祷吗？祝愿我们在神圣的虚空中一路平安。"

o.zh: 礼貌地假装和见习修士一起祈祷

o.en: Pretend to join the novice in prayer
o.zh: 假装和见习修士一起祈祷

entries.en:
"Perhaps." The attendant cools a little, "As Ludd said, 'To hold faith in your heart, wholly and truly, invites small cruelties of the tongue's lash.'"

"And do you know what Ludd said next?," they ask, rhetorically, "'Let faith be your armor; let walls of devotion build you a citadel, and there we shall be always in spiritual union.'"

The attendant seems satisfied with the unassailability of this statement, and wishing to hurry you along before things get more awkward, adds "Is there anything else I may assist you with?"
entries.zh:
"也许吧。" 圣务侍冷静了一点，"正如卢德所言，'真心全意地坚守信仰，往往会招致流言蜚语的恶意中伤。'"

"你知道卢德接下来说了什么吗？" 他反问道，"'让信仰成为你的铠甲；让虔诚化作无数城墙，为你构成堡垒，如此一来，我们的灵魂就能永远合为一体。'"

圣务侍看起来对这句话的无懈可击感到满意。为了赶快结束话题以避免尴尬，他补充道："还有什么我可以帮助你的吗？"

o.en: I'd like to visit the shrine.
On second thought, show me the interior shrine.
o.zh: 仔细想想，还是带我看看内部的圣地吧。

o.en: Yes. I wish to go outside.
This seems like a... difficult place to maintain a shrine.
o.zh: 这个地方似乎...很难被维持为一座圣地。

o.en: This seems like a terrible place to put a shrine.
o.zh: 这里看起来不像是个建圣地的好地方。

entries.en: "Yes, that is true." The attendant cools a little, questioning your motives. "We try to discourage, ah, sightseers. It disturbs the worship, you see."
entries.zh: "是的，确有其事。" 圣务侍稍微冷静了一点，怀疑你来此的目的。"我们试图劝阻这些，呃，游客。你知道的，这干扰了朝拜。"

o.en: I am no sightseer, but I do want to undertake this experience.
o.zh: 我不是游客，但我确实想体验一下。

o.en: I am no sightseer. I wish to test my faith.
o.zh: 我不是游客。我想考验自己的信念。

o.en: Don't worry, I have no intention of going out there.
o.zh: 别担心，我没有要出去的意思。

entries.en:
"Yes, of course. I can show you to the washing station where we ask that all, pilgrim or no, partake of a simple cleansing before visiting the interior shrine."

The attendant starts to shuffle you along into a group of devotees.
entries.zh:
"是，当然可以。我可以带你去净化站，在那里我们要求所有人，无论朝圣者与否，在参观圣地内部之前进行简单的清洁。"

圣务侍把你带进虔信者的队伍中。

o.en: I mean the outside. The real shrine.
o.zh: 我的意思是去外面，去真正的圣地。

entries.en:
The attendant looks you over skeptically.

"You are sure of this? You desire this with full knowledge of what exposure to Jangala entails?"

The attendant brings your attention to a row of pamphlets in a tasteful wooden stand displaying what, at a glance, appear to be a selection of truly unholy skin conditions.
entries.zh:
圣务侍一脸疑惑地看着你。

"你认真的？你真的了解暴露在 Jangala 的地表会造成什么后果吗？"

圣务侍示意你留意一旁的雅致木架，上面展示了一排翻开了的宣传册。你瞥了一眼，看来里面应该是精选了各种非常不神圣的皮肤感染症状。

entries.en:
The attendant looks at you with new respect.

"You are sure of this, pilgrim? You desire this with full knowledge of what exposure to Jangala entails, and choose to take this holy suffering upon your body?"
entries.zh:
圣务侍以前所未有的敬意看着你。

"你确定吗，朝圣者？你渴望接触 Jangala ，同时充分了解这会带来什么，并选择将这份神圣的痛苦施于自身？"

entries.en:
"Would it not be 'foolish', captain, to expose yourself to the outside?" the attendant says, somehow keeping peevishness out of their tone if not words.

As if on cue - or perhaps because they were hovering nearby the whole time - a curate (you presume) of the shrine steps up to you and the attendant, robes not quite resplendent but conveying a sense of care and craft that belies a higher status in the Church.
entries.zh:
"把自己暴露在外面不是很 '愚蠢' 吗，舰长？" 圣务侍说。不知为何，他的语气并不焦躁。

就好像是在暗示，或者可能是因为他们一直在附近徘徊，一位圣地的祭司 (你推测) 走到你和圣务侍面前。他的长袍并不那么华丽，但传达了一种谨慎和诡秘的感觉，这掩盖了他们在教会中更高的地位。

entries.en:
"That's quite enough, my child," the curate says with iron concealed beneath soft words, "Perhaps you should undertake a prayer of contrition in the chapel while I speak with the captain."

Abashed, the attendant bows and flees. The curate turns to you and says, "Please accept my apologies. I shall personally show you the way to the inner shrine."
entries.zh:
"够了，我的孩子，" 祭司轻柔的话语里透露出铁一般的执着，"也许在我和舰长说话时，你应该在小教堂里做一个忏悔的祈祷。"

羞愧不堪的圣务侍急忙弯下腰，逃也似地离开了。祭司转向你说，"请接受我的道歉。我会亲自带你去内部圣地的。"

entries.en:
The verdant continents of Jangala sprawl beneath you, crowned by huge weather systems churning lethargic and magisterial.

Searing lines of orbital burn lasers flick out from Jangala station, invisible until they cut slashes of plasma through the thick atmosphere. Burn-glow competes with rampaging electrical storms to illuminate the mountainous cloud formations from below.
entries.zh:
Jangala 青翠的大陆在你脚下延伸，巨型的云层在你的头顶上慵懒地翻腾着。

炽热的轨道激光从 Jangala 空间站中喷涌而出，在大气层中划出一道道炫目的等离子体。燃烧的辉光和云层中的闪电交相辉映，照亮了下面那些如山峦般厚重的云层。

entries.en:
The hum of your shuttle changes pitch as it hits the edge of true atmosphere, passing quickly into cloud cover. Beyond the viewpanes human-eye visibility is reduced to nearly zero. As the shuttle fires retros for landing, dipping well below the speed of sound by the demand of both nav regs and good manners, your viewport begins to collect marching droplets of moisture.

The droplets have an odd ochre coloration, and the clouds above a sickly green tinge. You've heard of this effect; fine-grained spore-analogs in the atmosphere.
entries.zh:
伴随着时高时低的噪音，你的穿梭机抵达了真实大气的边缘，一瞬间消失在云层之中。在观察窗之外，人眼的能见度几乎为零。当穿梭机开始着陆时，由于导航规则和礼貌的要求，其下降速度远低于音速，你的观察窗逐渐布满移动着的水滴。

水滴呈现出一种奇怪的赭色，而云层上方又是病态的绿色。你对此有所耳闻：这是大气中细小的类孢子的东西。

o.en: Look up the long term effects of the spores
o.zh: 查阅这些孢子的长期影响

entries.en:
A quick datapad search reveals that, statistically, human activity within the Jangalan biosphere is relatively safe so long as proper air filtration and decontamination procedures are followed. Detox meds for accidental exposures are readily available, though may have unpleasant side effects.

There are reports of individuals whose poor luck and lack of contingency planning combined with vehicle malfunction during truly abysmal weather has resulted in cases of long term exposure to Jangala's biosphere for days, weeks, and in one case more than a standard month. The resulting growths and infections appear to result in a singularly torturous manner of death.
entries.zh:
数据平板的快速检索显示，从统计数据来看，只要遵循适当的空气过滤和净化程序，Jangala 生物圈内的人类活动相对安全。针对意外暴露的排毒药物很容易获取，尽管它们可能产生令人不快的副作用。

有报道称，一些人的运气不佳，缺乏应急计划，再加上在真正恶劣的天气下的载具故障，导致他们长期暴露在 Jangala 生物圈达数天、数周，有一例甚至超过一个标准月。由此产生的生长和感染似乎导致了异常折磨的死亡。

entries.en:
-At least, judging by the holos available on the public infonet, which are indeed gruesome.

A cynical part of you wonders if the authorities allow distribution of these graphic accounts to promote protocol compliance.
entries.zh:
—— 至少，从公共信息网上的全息图来看，这确实很可怕。

你心里突然泛起一丝愤世嫉俗的想法，在想当局是否在故意放任这些图片的传播，就是为了促使人们遵守安全规定。

entries.en:
Your shuttle descends to the landing pad, the Jangalan foliage encroaching through its own ashes to reclaim the space.

You pop a standard dose of antixenols and re-examine the quality of your breathing mask as the access tunnel takes a moment to perform a self-cleaning cycle on exposed surfaces. The air feels no different, yet.

Maybe a little warmer, a little heavier with moisture.
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机刚降落在停机坪，Jangala 上的植物就重新开始在自己的灰烬上生长，夺回了属于它们的领地。

人行通道需要一段时间对裸露的表面进行自清洁循环，你趁此时注射了标准剂量的抗异种药物，并重新检查呼吸面罩的质量。尽管这里的空气感觉也没什么不同。

也许也就是更暖和、更潮湿一点。

entries.en:
You reach up and loose your mask, drawing in breath from Jangala. Shallowly at first, then deeper. The smells of spice and rot and ammonia and fresh greens. Whatever may come, you know it won't instantly kill you, and anything that happens is reversible. Is that a tingle, a catch in your throat?

Have faith.

You follow the short trail you were told of. It seems nearly overgrown, feelers and tendrils brush against you.

There are others. Maskless pilgrims, tears streaming from their red eyes and mucus from their noses, skin blotchy, white robes rapidly discolored by alien emissions. They meet your eyes, smile and nod in camaraderie, making the signs of Ludd for you.
entries.zh:
你抬手揭下面罩，吞吐着 Jangala 的气息。从刚开始的轻浅试探，逐渐变得深吸长气。香辛味，腐败味，氨味，新鲜绿植味，百味杂陈。不论迎面扑来的是什么气体，你知道这都不会让你当场毙命，而且造成的损伤都是可逆的。然而你喉头依然感到一丝异样，是刺痛吗？

秉持信仰。

你照着自己得知的那条捷径走了下去。这条路看起来几乎全都是杂草，触角和卷须不断刮蹭着你。

这里还有其他的人。那是些摘掉面罩的朝圣者，他们双眼通红，涕泗横流，皮肤斑驳，一袭白袍在异星的废气里迅速褪色。他们与你目光相交，怀揣着同道的情谊对你微笑颔首，行卢德之礼。

entries.en:
There are overgrown human figures - a statue garden. The forms blister with growths, crawling with tendrils, sprouting the fruiting bodies of alien life.

One moves; not the wind, but another pilgrim, the growths taking hold. How long does this take, hours? Days?

It becomes distracting, hard to focus. You feel like you might die, but the feeling reaches a plateau, a sea of pain and irritation. You allow yourself to float in a buzzing atonal headache, itchiness, torment.

And something more.
entries.zh:
这里到处植物漫身的人形 —— 简直是一座雕像花园。这些造像身上缀满了液疱，缠满了卷须，萌发出了外星生命的子实体。

周围传来了一阵动静，不是风吹草动，而是另一个朝圣者被植物的疯长给牢牢抓住了。这要花多长时间？几个小时，还是几天？

这些景象让人精神溃散，难以保持专注。你感到自己可能会就这样死去，但这种感觉上升到了极限之后就不再积累，形成了一片充满了痛苦和焦虑的汪洋。你任由自己漂浮这一片杂乱无章且挥之不去的头痛，瘙痒和折磨之中。

以及一些别的东西...

entries.en:
The green churns imperceptibly, all-consuming, ferociously regenerative, a cycle of life that could be born of Earth or an alien world.

And you are within it, for all of its horror and comfort.
entries.zh:
绿色在难以察觉地翻腾着，无厌地吞噬，凶蛮地再生，生命的轮回既可以生于地球，也可以生于一个异星世界。

而你正置身其中，感受着它的震撼与慰藉。

entries.en:
You follow the short trail you were told of; it seems nearly overgrown. You follow it, feelers and tendrils brushing against you.

There are others. Maskless pilgrims, tears streaming from their red eyes and mucus from their noses, skin blotchy, white robes rapidly discolored by alien emissions.

You breathe shallowly. Is your skin hotter, dryer; wetter? Is that itch something taking hold? Whatever may come, you know it won't instantly kill you, and anything that happens is reversible. Have faith.
entries.zh:
你沿着被告知的短途小径前进；它看起来杂草丛生，藤蔓和卷须刮蹭着你的身体。

这里也有其他摘下了面罩的朝圣者，他们双眼通红，涕泗横流，皮肤斑驳，一袭白袍在异星的废气里迅速褪色。

你浅浅地呼吸，感受着环境的影响。皮肤变得燥热还是干裂又或是湿润？隐约还有不断变强的瘙痒？不过你知道，无论将要发生什么，都不会让你当场毙命，并且所有的损伤都是可逆的。秉持信仰。

entries.en:
Beyond, you see the statue garden. The forms blister with growths, crawling with tendrils, sprouting fruiting bodies of xenolife. Among them are pilgrims, exposed in their light robes. Easily overtaken by the overgrowth. How long does it take- hours, days?

At their feet, covered by a quilt of mosses and mycelium or alien equivalents, are bones. Or are they fallen branches, overgrown rocks? The final wish for terminally-devoted fanatics, or your imagination?
entries.zh:
远处，你看见一座雕像花园。这些造像身上缀满了液疱，缠满了卷须，萌发出了异种生命的子实体。穿着浅色长袍的朝圣者们夹杂在其中。过度生长的植物轻松的淹没了他们。形成这一切花费了多少时间？是几个小时，还是数天？

他们的脚下，那被苔藓和菌丝或类似外星生物组成的被子覆盖着的，是骨头，还是枯枝，乱石？是狂热信徒的遗愿，或者只是你自己的想象？

entries.en: The green churns not quite imperceptibly in the course of your stay, all-consuming, ferociously regenerative, a cycle of life that could be born of Earth or an alien world.
entries.zh: 在你逗留的这段时间里，这些绿植微不可查地翻搅着，无厌地吞噬，凶蛮地再生，生命的轮回既可以生于地球，也可以生于一个异星世界。

entries.en:
You calmly approach the Luddic protestors, asking to speak to an organizer. They are reluctant to identify a leader who would make an obvious target for MuniSec guards, but soon enough you are recognized by one of the better-dressed Luddics. It appears that your reputation precedes you.

They enthusiastically vouch for you, "a true friend of the Church", and manage to persuade the protestors to clear a path for you and your landing party.

As you step into the commercial promenade, past merchants and spacers annoyed at your special treatment, you begin to hear amplified orders to disperse from the Hegemony gendarmerie.
entries.zh:
你冷静地走向卢德抗议者们，请求与他们的组织者谈一谈。他们虽然冒着被地方安全部重点关注的风险请出了一位领导者，但看起来很不情愿。不过很快，你就被一名衣冠楚楚的卢德信众认出来了 —— 看起来你已经声名远扬。

他们热情地担保你为 "教会真正的朋友"，并且设法说服抗议者们，为你和你的登陆小队让出一条道路。

在你走过那些被你的特殊待遇惹恼的商人和宇宙民，去往商业街的时候，你开始听到 霸主 宪兵那音量放大的驱散命令。

entries.en:
"Not here," $heOrShe says, eyes not leaving the protestors. "On the surface. For appreciating the local plant-life. Don't understand why, you wouldn't believe how toxic the stuff is. Detox after exposure is like a week of hangover compressed down into a day or two."

$HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head. "At least that's what it felt like for me. Guess they like suffering. Luddics for you. Top brass says we gotta humor 'em. Politics, right?"

A burst of coded garble comes through the comms, and the $post gives a short response. "Gendarmerie will be here soon if you want to stay for the show," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh:
"有，不过不在这里，" $heOrShe说，视线并没有离开抗议者，"是在地表上，朝圣者们喜欢在那欣赏当地的植物。我不理解。你想象不到那些玩意的毒性有多强。人体暴露在那种环境中后，后续的排毒过程十分痛苦，好比是把整整一周的宿醉压缩到一至两天。"

$HeOrShe摇了摇头。"反正我的亲身体验就是这样的。可能这帮人就是喜欢受苦吧。这就是卢德信徒。上面的人说我们必须迁就他们。这就是政治，对吧？"

通讯器中传来一阵噪声，$post给出了一个简短的回答。"如果你想看看接下来会发生什么，宪兵马上就到了。" $heOrShe说。

entries.en: "Look, sorry about all of this," $heOrShe indicates the protest. "Tell you what- I can route you and your crew through secure access so you don't have to wait on the circus."
entries.zh: "听着，我对此感到十分抱歉。" $heOrShe表示抗议，"这么和你说吧，我可以把你和你的人送到安全通道，这样你就不必在这马戏场里等着了。"

o.zh: 谢了，但是我会在这等着。

entries.en: The $rank waves a cadet over, giving them instructions to lead you, your guards, and a few of your crew given shore leave - who are looking increasingly impatient - through an alternate route to the commercial promenade.
entries.zh: $rank 挥手招来一名学员，指示他带着你，你的警卫和一些获准上岸的船员 —— 他们看起来越来越不耐烦 —— 从另一条路线前往商业街。

entries.en: Suddenly the $rank does a double-take. "$playerName? That's you, isn't it? Commissioned Auxiliary, right? Had an alert come through when you entered orbit."
entries.zh: 突然，$rank 愣了一下，然后露出了吃惊的表情。"$playerName？那是你，对不对？现役辅助军，对吧？当你进入轨道的时候，触发了一个警报。"

entries.en: The $rank nods, and returns to the comms with more professional focus now; the gendarmerie can't be far off.
entries.zh: $rank 点了点头，带着更加专业和专注的状态回到了通讯中；宪兵应该不远了。

entries.en:
You step forward, proclaiming that you wish to join the protest. At first the Luddics are disbelieving, but as you turn to face the bewildered MuniSec guards and take up the Luddic chant-prayer, a small cheer erupts.

You see $PersonRank $personLastName shake $hisOrHer head in disbelief.
entries.zh:
你迈步向前，宣称你也希望加入抗议。起初，卢德信众并不相信，但随着你转身面对困惑的地方安全部守卫，并开始颂唱卢德祷文，人群中爆发出一阵小小的欢呼。

你看到 $PersonRank $personLastName 难以置信地摇着头。

entries.en: Later, you compare bruises and cuts with your fellow protestors. Your bodyguards, reacting admirably to the unusual situation, managed to shield you from the worst of the gendarmes' beatings, pacification gas, and restraint foam. But you took your hits and have proven yourself to these Luddic pilgrims. You take the opportunity to explain that-
entries.zh: 不久之后，你和你的抗议者同伴们相互打量着身上的淤青和切口。面对这样异乎寻常的情景，你的保镖做出了绝佳的反应，设法将你从宪兵们最毒辣的殴打，镇静气体，以及拘束泡沫中保了下来。不过你还是挨了几下，向这些卢德朝圣者证明了自己。趁此机会，你解释道 ——

o.en: Despite being a non-believer, you support their rights
o.zh: 尽管身为一名无信者，你还是支持他们的权利

o.en: This shared experience brings you all closer to Ludd
o.zh: 共患难的经历令你们离卢德更近了

o.en: In due time, the heretics will pay for these beatings ten-fold
o.zh: 终有一日，要十倍地将这顿毒打奉还给那些异端

o.en: You just wanted to feel what it was like to lose a fight
o.zh: 你只是想尝尝战败的滋味

entries.en:
The pilgrims welcome you as one of their own, pledging their hospitality if you visit their homesteads, and promising a seat for you at the front of their congregation's service to welcome returning pilgrims.

They tell you of the shrine of Jangala, and of being exposed to the toxic xenolife - far more painful, they claim, than anything MuniSec can do to them.

Your name is called from the commsplate.
entries.zh:
朝圣者们像欢迎同道那样欢迎你。他们承诺，如果你来拜访他们的家宅和会众，那你一定会得到殷勤接待，并且保证给你在他们会众服务站的前排留一个座位，以便欢迎那些归来的朝圣者。

他们告诉你 Jangala 圣地的事，并讲述着暴露在剧毒异种生命下的体验 —— 他们声称，这种痛苦甚至远胜于地方安全部最酷烈的暴行。

通信板呼叫了你的名字。

entries.en:
Most of the protestors are alarmed by your rhetoric, glancing nervously toward unseen observation devices and drawing away from your corner of the holding cell. Though a couple younger pilgrims and one much older, with scars to show his commitment, remain near you, eyes daring the others to speak their criticism aloud.

"We hear you, $playerBrotherOrSister. The end of the Path is near," he whispers, and tells you of the Jangala Shrine, of mortification of the flesh through exposure to the xenolife - worse than anything MuniSec could hope to inflict.

Your name is called from the commsplate.
entries.zh:
大多数抗议者被你的激进言论吓到，紧张的瞥了一眼不可视的监视装置，抽身离开了属于你的牢房角落。尽管几个年轻的朝圣者和一位老者 —— 他身上的伤痕记述着他的奉献 —— 留在你身旁，目光盯着其他人，大声批判着。

"我们听说过你，$playerBrotherOrSister，卢德之道的终点已经近在咫尺。" 他轻声耳语，对你讲述着 Jangala 圣地的事，讲述着暴露在异种生命中对肉身所造成的折辱 —— 远远超过地方安全部的任何打压手段。

通信板呼叫了你的名字。

entries.en:
The pilgrims welcome you as a respectable outsider, pledging hospitality if you visit their homesteads and congregations.

They tell you of the shrine of Jangala, and of being exposed to the toxic xenolife - far more painful, they claim, than anything MuniSec could do to them.

Your name is called from the commsplate.
entries.zh:
朝圣者们欢迎你的到来，认为你是一位可敬的外乡人。他们承诺，如果你来拜访他们的家宅和会众，那你一定会得到殷勤接待。

他们告诉你 Jangala 圣地的事，并讲述着暴露在剧毒异种生命下的体验 —— 他们声称，这种痛苦甚至远胜于地方安全部最酷烈的暴行。

通信板呼叫了你的名字。

entries.en: The Luddic protestors are confused and even a little alarmed by your explanation - it seems they've been locked in with a crazy person. They physically draw away from your corner of the holding cell until your name is called through the commsplate.
entries.zh: 这些卢德抗议者们对你的解释感到困惑，甚至有点害怕 —— 看起来他们和一个狂人关在一起了。他们挪动身体离开了属于你的牢房角落，直到通信板呼叫了你的名字。

entries.en:
You order a small squad of your own marines, armaments and munitions removed due to port regulations, on a fast shuttle from your $shipOrFleet.

The marines, in full power armor, form a vanguard before you and simply march into the protesting Luddics.
entries.zh:
你从自己的陆战队里要来一支小队，坐着穿梭机从你的$shipOrFleet高速赶来。鉴于港口规定，没有携带武器弹药。

这些陆战队员身着全套动力装甲，在你身前组成一支先锋，仅仅是简单地朝着抗议的卢德信众展开行军，没有其他多余的举动。

entries.en:
The protestors' line is easily broken by your armored marines, as are not a few limbs. The MuniSec guards manage to exploit the situation and corral the protesters - now crying, screaming, and shouting abuse at you in particular - into ineffective huddles.

The Hegemony officer overseeing the official response looks not simply annoyed, but livid.
entries.zh:
抗议者的队列被你全副武装的陆战队员轻而易举地尽数冲散。地方安全部的守卫们趁势出手，迫使这些抗议者们 —— 他们现在哭喊，尖叫着，甚至对你破口大骂 —— 无能为力地缩成一团。

负责监督官方回应的 霸主 官员看起来对你的意见不小，已经脸色发青了。

entries.en:
"I should have you arrested!" $heOrShe shouts, then, ignoring your armored marines - who dare not touch a Hegemony officer on their own station - gets close to your face, "Your little stunt just gave them a propaganda holo that'll recruit hundreds of Pather terrorists," $heOrShe seethes.
