"Get your goons out of my sight before I call in the real marines."
entries.zh:
"我真应该逮捕你！" $heOrShe怒吼着赶到你的面前，无视了你那些全副武装的陆战队员 —— 他们也不敢在 霸主 的地盘上对军官撒野，"你愚蠢的行为会被拍进全息图里，而这会带来几百名左径分子，" $heOrShe咬牙切齿地说。

"在我集结真正的军队之前，让你的暴徒滚出我的视线。"

entries.en: As you step onto the commercial promenade you see both crew and locals pointing and staring. Some hold datapad, recording holos...
entries.zh: 当你走进商业街时，你看到船员和当地居民对着什么东西指手画脚。一些人还拿着数据平板和有记录功能的全息影像设备。

entries.en: The $faction $rank shakes $hisOrHer head. "Appreciate the patriotic gesture, citizen, but we'll handle this. Got to be delicate," $heOrShe says with annoyance, "It's very... political."
entries.zh: $faction $rank摇了摇$hisOrHer的头。"感谢你的爱国情怀，公民，但我们会处理这件事，这事一定要谨慎，" $heOrShe恼怒地说，"这件事...非常有政治影响。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe seems to think it over for a second, then glances at a small datapad.

"Tell you what; get your marines here in three minutes and subsume to my command, here's the comm-code. I want min-force, zero fire and flash; weapons locked to my authorization."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe想了一小会，然后看向了一个小数据平板。

"给我听好了；让你的陆战队员在三分钟之内过来，一切听我的指挥，这是通讯代码。我要以最低限度的武力来镇压叛乱，任何会发光和喷火的玩意都不要；武器必须在我的授权下才准许使用。"

o.en: On second thought, I'll let you handle this.
o.zh: 仔细想想，我还是让你来处理吧。

entries.en:
You coordinate a joint response, a squad of your marines able to quickly deploy on the dock-side and coordinate with the Hegemony gendarmerie on the opposite end of the protest. A steady advance breaks the protest line apart with minimal use of force - the Luddics' fists, hammers, and signs useless against power-armored troops.

$Rank $personName is busy coordinating arrests in the aftermath but manages to catch your eye and give a quick half-salute as you leave toward the commercial promenade.
entries.zh:
你组织了一次联合行动，你的陆战队员迅速部署在码头侧面，和位于抗议者们另一头的 霸主 宪兵展开配合。你们的部队稳步推进，以最低限度的武力镇压了抗议队伍 —— 卢德信众的拳头，铁锤，以及标语牌，面对动力装甲部队显得苍白无力。

$Rank $personName 忙着组织事后的逮捕行动，但当你离开此地去往商业街的时候，他还是在百忙中对你示意，快速地向你敬了一个半礼。

entries.en: Suddenly the $rank does a double-take. "$playerName? That's you, isn't it? Commissioned Auxiliary, right? Had an alert come through when you entered orbit."
entries.zh: 突然，$rank 愣了一下，然后露出了吃惊的表情。"$playerName？那是你，对不对？现役辅助军，对吧？当你进入轨道的时候，触发了一个警报。"

entries.en: The $rank nods, distractedly. "As you will, captain."
entries.zh: $rank 心烦意乱地点了点头，"如你所愿，舰长。"

o.en: Use your standing with the Church to pass
o.zh: 利用你与教会的关系来通过这里

o.en: Use your commission with the Hegemony to pass
o.zh: 利用你与霸主的雇佣关系来通过这里

o.en: Pilgrims? Is there some kind of shrine here?
o.zh: 朝圣者？这附近有圣地吗？

o.en: Join the protestors, help them take a stand
o.zh: 加入抗议者，帮他们表明立场

o.en: Use your marines to muscle through right now
o.zh: 派遣你的陆战队员强行开路

o.en: Offer your marines to help clear the protest
o.zh: 派遣你的陆战队员辅助当局驱散抗议者

o.en: Wait for the authorities to clear the protest
o.zh: 等待当局驱散抗议人群

entries.en:
You wait. The crowd grows, and grows less patient - a minority jeers and shouts, a few spacers start throwing trash. The Luddics perform their chant-prayer, calling for an end to the orbital burns, arms locked. From fights breaking out, it is clear that there is much support for the Luddic cause outside of the overt protestors.

It feels near a boiling point when heads start to turn and you see a dark regiment of lightly armored troopers deploy from columns into a wedge. Security drones hum overhead, targeting lasers and ID-cams flickering.
entries.zh:
你冷眼旁观。聚集的人越来越多，也越来越没有耐心 —— 一小部分人发出嘲笑和叫喊，有些宇宙民开始朝人群丢垃圾。卢德教徒们手拉着手，吟唱祷文，呼吁停止使用轨道射线焚烧地表植被。从打斗中可以看出，除了公开的抗议者，还有许多人支持这项运动。

当局势接近失控时，人们突然转头看向一个方向，你发现一支装备轻武器的秘密部队正从方队改为楔形队列。治安无人机在人群头顶上嗡嗡作响，瞄准激光和 ID 扫描仪不停闪烁着。

entries.en:
A steady advance breaks the protest line apart, shock-prods rise and fall to silence shouts and screams. It is difficult to see through the pacification gas, but you can make out drones deploying restraint foam on struggling forms. The Luddics' fists, signs, and even hammers are useless against the power-armored gendarmerie.

"You may pass safely, citizen," a drone buzzes at you in a pleasant voice.

Stepping toward the main promenade, you turn to find that you've left a diminishing trail of blood-spots. A scuff or two of your heel on the deck plate takes care of the problem.
entries.zh:
军队的稳步推进冲散了抗议者的队列，他们挥舞着手中的电击棒，让所有尖叫和呼喊都归于虚无，透过镇暴气体，你可以模糊的辨认出无人机正在释放抑制泡沫来压制挣扎的人。卢德信徒的拳头，标语牌，甚至是铁锤，在装备动力装甲的宪兵面前显得苍白无力。

"你可以安全通过了，公民。" 一架无人机以悦耳的声音对你嗡嗡作响。

当你大步走向主港区时，你转过身来，发现脚上沾满了抗议者的鲜血，在身后留下一排逐渐模糊的血脚印。你用鞋跟在甲板上猛蹭了两下，摆脱了这点不适。

entries.en:
It's $rank $personName again, $hisOrHer demeanor cold and martial.

"The rules are simple, captain," $heOrShe says, ice-cold, "And we've been very, very lenient with you. But there seems to be a failure to communicate, so let me explain in very small words how it works around here."

A guard sets a plastic tray of your personal belongings on the battered table of the processing room. The Hegemony $rank continues, slowly; each word given emphasis. "Pay your tariffs. Don't disrupt business."

$HeOrShe turns and motions at some guards, "Now get out of my sight."
entries.zh:
来者又是 $personName $rank，举止冷峻，金戈铁马。

"规矩很简单，舰长。" $HeOrShe语气冰冷，"我们对你已经极其，极其的宽容了。然而，看起来交涉还是失败了，那我就用最简短的话来把这儿的规矩说清楚。"

一名警卫把装着你个人物品的塑料托盘放在审讯室那破旧的桌子上。与此同时，这名 霸主 $rank 逐字逐句地继续说道："付关税，别碍事。"

$HeOrShe转过身对警卫打了个手势，"现在，你可以滚了。"

entries.en:
You are shoved, squinting, into the bright light of the plaza outside of the municipal security processing center.

Dignity largely unbruised, you secure your sidearm (cellmag confiscated), run a quick check on your personal datapad, and give a nod to your second officer - who has been waiting patiently with two hot drinks.
entries.zh:
你被推到市政安全审核中心外面的广场上，明亮的光芒使你不由得眯起眼睛。

你的尊严被很大程度的保留了，你保护好自己的随身武器 (弹匣已没收)，快速检查了自己的私人数据平板，然后对你的二副点了点头 —— 他带着两杯热饮，一直耐心地等着你。

entries.en:
The reception lounge is filled with parties of Luddic pilgrims in traditional handweave led by subcurates in ritual hand-washing. A glance upward reveals the true cleansing: a battery of air-purification units caught in a tangle of murmuring ducts.

Foliage presses itself almost sensually against the outer viewports, letting in only dim light. The plant life seems to twitch, liquids oozing over the panes from cracks in bladders and tubules, leaving rivulets cutting across flaking encrustations. Between the zeal of the foliage and hand-crafted charm of Luddic engineering, the place feels distinctly worrisome compared to the environmental containment you are accustomed to.
entries.zh:
接待休息室里挤满了在此聚会的卢德朝圣者。他们身着传统的手工服装，由助理祭司带领进行仪式性的净手。向上看一眼，你就会发现这里真正的清洁设施：淹没在复杂管道中的一组空气净化装置。

舞动着的叶片几乎堵死了窗户，只有些许昏暗的光线照射进来。这些富有生机的植物似乎在抽搐着，液体从囊状器官和小管的裂缝中渗出，留下一条条涓涓细流划过剥落的外壳。在植物的躁动和卢德工艺的魅力之间，与你习惯的，那些被精心调控的环境相比，这个地方明显令人担忧。

entries.en:
One of the shrine's attendants scurries to meet you.

"The complex is kept overpressurized," they say, following your gaze, "so if there were a breach, there would be plenty of time to find and seal the leak."

The attendant creates what must be intended to be a reassuring smile. "How might we assist you?"
entries.zh:
圣地的圣务侍赶忙出来迎接你。

"这片建筑群一直处于超载状态，" 跟随着你的目光，他们说道，"所以，如果哪里有漏洞，我们应该能有足够的时间发现并将其密封。"

圣务侍做出一个令人安心的笑容。"我们能为您提供什么帮助？"

entries.en:
One of the shrine's attendants instantly recognizes that you're not one of the usual pilgrims and intercepts you, making remarkable speed despite wearing awkward-looking novice's robes.

The attendant smiles piously, hands held together. "How might we assist you?"
entries.zh:
圣地的一名圣务侍立即意识到你不是寻常的朝圣者。尽管穿着看起来很尴尬的新手长袍，他还是很快地拦住了你。

圣务侍双手合十，虔诚地微笑着。"我们能为您提供什么帮助？"

o.en: I'd like to visit the shrine.
I wish to visit the shrine. Outside.
o.zh: 我希望参拜圣地。在户外。

entries.en: "Bringing oneself before the sacred is not a matter of convenience," the attendant says serenely. "That we must travail so to worship here confers upon the act an extraordinary sense of self-reflection, I believe."
entries.zh: "虔诚的人会追寻信仰，哪怕千辛万苦。" 圣务侍平静地说，"我相信，我们必须经历苦难才有资格在这里朝拜，这会带来一种非凡的自我反思意识。"

o.en: I hear some pilgrims go outside unprotected.
o.zh: 我听说有些朝圣者在没有保护的情况下就出去了。

o.en: I would like to visit the shrine.

entries.en: You undergo a routine decontamination in a stained yet clean chamber built for that purpose. After an oddly-smelling shower, the flicker of lasers, and another round of antixenols, you are given back your clothing. Everything is abrasively dry and smells of disinfectant.
entries.zh: 你在一间整洁但略有污渍的洁净室里接受了例行去污。穿过气味奇怪的淋浴、照过几次激光、又服用了另一轮抗异种感染药物之后，你拿回了你的衣服。所有东西都被强力烘干过，还带着点消毒液的味道。

entries.en: Breathing feels strange, still. You have to think about each breath, filling your lungs, then emptying them.
entries.zh: 呼吸的感觉仍然很奇怪。你不得不仔细进行每一次呼吸，用空气填满你的肺，然后排空它们。

entries.en: You make your way toward the landing pads, past pilgrims queuing for the charity cafeteria, regrouping before or after visiting the shrine, and otherwise stowing their humble possessions.
entries.zh: 你朝着停机坪走去，路过在慈善食堂前排队的朝圣者。他们或在参拜圣地前后重新聚集，又或者在收起他们微不足道的财物。

entries.en: You make your way toward the landing pads, past pilgrims queuing for the charity cafeteria, regrouping before or after visiting the shrine, and otherwise stowing their humble possessions.
entries.zh: 你朝着停机坪走去，路过在慈善食堂前排队的朝圣者。他们或在参拜圣地前后重新聚集，又或者在收起他们微不足道的财物。

entries.en:
The concourse is in chaos. A crowd of protestors in Luddic greens has formed a human barrier across the main entrance. Surrounding them are angry spacers, officers and crew alike, waiting to enter the commercial promenade or return to their ships.

A small contingent of local MuniSec holds the shouting crowds apart - barely.
entries.zh:
港区陷入了一片混乱，一群身着卢德绿袍的抗议者在主要出入口形成了人墙。周遭堵满了想要进入商业街或返回舰船的宇宙民、军官与船员，他们现在怒气冲天。

一支地方安全部的小分队勉强把喧闹的人群隔开。

entries.en:
The concourse is in chaos. A crowd of protestors in Luddic greens has formed a human barrier across the main entrance. Surrounding them are angry spacers, officers and crew alike, waiting to enter the commercial promenade or return to their ships.

A small contingent of local MuniSec holds the shouting crowds apart - barely.
entries.zh:
港区陷入了一片混乱，一群身着卢德绿袍的抗议者在主要出入口形成了人墙。周遭堵满了想要进入商业街或返回舰船的宇宙民、军官与船员，他们现在怒气冲天。

一支地方安全部的小分队勉强把喧闹的人群隔开。

o.en: DEV check out the Luddic protest
o.zh: DEV 测试 卢德教徒 抗议

entries.en:
You recognize the Hegemony $post, $name speaking orders into a small comms unit. $HeOrShe notices you, and nods you over.

"Luddics protesting the planet-side burns," $heOrShe explains. "Get these every other week due to the pilgrims. They consider it a sort of rite of passage."

$HeOrShe one-arm shrugs to suggest that $heOrShe doesn't find the matter worth getting too upset over, then speaks another string of tactical jargon into $hisOrHer comms.
entries.zh:
你认出了那个霸主 $post，$name 正通过一个小型通讯器下达着命令。$HeOrShe注意到了你，并向你点头示意。

"卢德教徒正在抗议轨道焚化。" $HeOrShe解释说，"由于朝圣者的原因，这种事情每隔一周就会发生一次。他们都把这当成朝圣之路上的某种仪式了。"

$HeOrShe耸了耸半边肩膀，一副这事也不值得让$HeOrShe太上心的样子。随后$hisOrHer对着通讯器又说了一串战术术语。

entries.en:
You are led past heavy curtains which mute the murmur of pilgrims and shut out all artificial light. Pilgrims kneel in the shrine-chamber, silhouetted before the glowing panes to without lit by that sickly yellow-green cloud cover.

Beyond, you see the statue garden. The forms blister with growths, crawling with tendrils, sprouting fruiting bodies of xenolife. Among them are pilgrims, exposed in only light robes. Easily overtaken by the overgrowth. At their feet, covered by a quilt of mosses and mycelium or alien equivalents, are bones. Or are they fallen branches, overgrown rocks? The final wish for terminally-devoted fanatics, or your imagination?

The green churns not quite imperceptibly in the course of the minutes you watch, all-consuming, ferociously regenerative, a cycle of life that could be born of Earth or an alien world.
entries.zh:
你被带领着穿过厚重的幕布，这些布料阻隔了朝圣者的低语，挡住了所有的人造光源。朝圣者们跪倒在神殿内，他们在明亮的窗格前被勾勒出轮廓，不必被那病态的黄绿色云层照亮。

在远处，你看到了那座雕像花园。这些造像身上缀满了液疱，缠满了卷须，萌发出了异种生命的子实体。只穿着浅色长袍的朝圣者夹杂其中，疯长的植物轻易淹没了他们。在他们脚下，那被苔藓和菌丝或类似外星生物组成的被子覆盖着的是人骨，还是倒下的树枝和杂乱的岩石？是绝境中狂热信徒的最后愿望，又或者仅仅是你的想象？

在你停留的几分钟里，绿色在不知不觉中汹涌澎湃，无厌地吞噬，凶蛮地再生，生命的轮回既可以生于地球，也可以生于一个异星世界。

entries.en:
The air hits you, warm and wet, like high-G shock foam. You step out and follow the short trail; it seems nearly overgrown. You follow it, leaves and feelers brushing against you.

You find the statue gardens, the forms blistering with growth, crawling with tendrils, sprouting fruiting bodies of xenolife. Among them are pilgrims, exposed in their light robes. Easily overtaken by the overgrowth. How long does it take- hours, days?

At their feet, covered by a quilt of mosses and mycelium or alien equivalents, are bones. Or fallen branches, overgrown rocks. Or the final wish for terminally-devoted fanatics.

The green churns not quite imperceptibly in the course of your stay, all-consuming, ferociously regenerative, a cycle of life that could be born of Earth or an alien world.
entries.zh:
空气刺痛着你，带来温暖又潮湿的感觉，就像高重力缓冲泡沫一样。你沿着小路走了出去，这条路几乎被植物淹没了。你顺着路继续前行，树叶和触须拂过你的身体。

你发现了一座雕像花园，这些造像身上缀满了液疱，缠满了卷须，萌发出了异种生命的子实体。穿着浅色长袍的朝圣者夹杂其中，疯长的植物轻易淹没了他们。形成这一切花费了多少时间？是几个小时，还是数天？

他们的脚下，那被苔藓和菌丝或类似外星生物组成的被子覆盖着的，是骨头，还是枯枝，乱石？是狂热信徒的遗愿，或者只是你自己的想象？

在你停留的几分钟里，绿色在不知不觉中汹涌澎湃，无厌地吞噬，凶蛮地再生，生命的轮回既可以生于地球，也可以生于一个异星世界。

o.en: Return to the interior of the complex

entries.en:
Your shuttle descends toward verdant continents crowned by lethargically churning storm systems. The orbital burn lasers flicker from the spark of Jangala station, invisible until they cut lines of plasma through the atmosphere.

You pass through blinding cloud cover, the light taking on a sickly hue of green. Your viewport is streaked with marching droplets of spore-laden water as the shuttle slows to drop softly onto the landing pad nearly lost in the overgrowth of Jangalan foliage.
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机降落在苍翠的陆地上，翻腾的风暴在地表缓慢移动着。伴随着 Jangala 空间站上闪烁的光斑，轨道激光倾泻而下，在大气层中切出耀眼的等离子火焰。

你穿过炫目的云层，映入眼帘的是一片令人头晕的绿色。舷窗外，饱含孢子的雨滴如行军般奔流而下；穿梭机减速缓降，轻柔地停靠在几乎被 Jangala 疯长的植被彻底吞没的停机坪上。

o.en: Take a shuttle to visit the Luddic shrine
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前去拜访卢德圣地

o.en: Take a shuttle to visit the Luddic shrine
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前去拜访卢德圣地

o.en: Take a shuttle to visit the Luddic shrine
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前去拜访卢德圣地

entries.en:
The air hits you in the environmental lock, warm and wet, like high-G shock foam. You step out alone, for this is how it is done.

Oozing nets hang from the shrine complex; rhizomes sprouting luridly colored bulbs that glow in what passes for sunlight. Dust, or tiny bugs, or spores float about, moving in swirls against the heavy and languid air.
entries.zh:
湿热的空气从直通外界环境的气闸里喷涌而出，如同高 G 力缓冲泡沫那样猛烈冲击你的身体。你独自迈步而出，正如仪式要求的那般。

圣地的殿堂上挂满了蛛网，植物的根茎上长出五彩斑斓的球团，在勉强能算是阳光的事物之下闪闪发亮。那些尘埃，微虫，又或者是孢子的东西，四处漂浮着，顶着沉重而慵懒的空气打起旋来。

o.en: Take off your mask. Have faith.
Keep it on, you're not an idiot.
o.zh: 戴好面罩，你又不是傻子。

entries.en:
You are led past heavy curtains. The murmur of pilgrims is muted, and all artificial light shut out.

Your eyes adjust to the shrine-chamber, taking in rows of silhouetted pilgrims kneeling before polished panes of diamond-matrix, illuminated by the sickly yellow-green cloud cover from without.

Beyond the windows, you see overgrown human figures - a statue garden. The forms blister with growths, crawling with tendrils, sprouting the fruiting bodies of alien life. One moves; not the wind, but another pilgrim, exposed and outdoors. There are people out there, you realize with a start, wearing only light robes. Easily overtaken by the overgrowth.
entries.zh:
你被带领着穿过厚重的幕布。朝圣者的窃窃私语沉寂了下来，所有的人造光源都被熄灭了。

你刚适应神殿内的昏暗光线，就看到一排排的朝圣者跪倒在金刚石方窗前。它们的侧影被外面病态的黄绿色云层所照亮。

在窗外，你看到被植物寄生的人形 —— 那是一座雕像花园。这些造像身上缀满了液疱，缠满了卷须，萌发出了外星生命的子实体。其中一个人形移动着 —— 那不是风在吹动，而是另一个在户外的朝圣者。你猛然意识到，外面的人只穿着浅色长袍，这使得他们很容易隐蔽在植物群中。

entries.en:
At their feet, more forms come into focus; covered by a quilt of mosses and mycelium, or whatever alien equivalent, which obscures the feet of the statues. Bones. Or are they fallen branches and overgrown rocks? The final wish for some terminally-devoted fanatics, or your imagination set loose?

The green churns not quite imperceptibly in the course of the minutes you watch, all-consuming, ferociously regenerative, a cycle of life that could be born of Earth or an alien world.
entries.zh:
在他们脚下，更多种类的植物映入眼帘；苔藓和菌丝，或者其他类似的东西，覆盖着雕像的脚。那是人骨，还是倒下的树枝和杂草丛生的岩石？这是一些狂热者的终极渴望，又或者仅仅是你的想象？

在你观察的几分钟里，你并不难察觉到那些搅动着的绿色，无厌地吞噬，凶蛮地再生，生命的轮回既可以生于地球，也可以生于一个异星世界。

entries.en:
"Do you insult or laud me, I wonder," she says. "Anahita Baird is a powerful woman, intelligent and proud. She also makes herself habit of knocking upon the doors of demons."

She sits back, cradling her teacup.

"Or I should say, rather, she sends others to knock in her place." The Archcurate waves a hand dismissively, "I hold not your work for her against your character. If I may return your Janus-faced compliment: what you have done for Baird may even prove more your suitability for what is in my mind."
entries.zh:
"我很好奇，你到底是在侮辱我还是赞美我，" 她说到，"Anahita Baird 是个女强人，才华横溢，自命不凡。她早就养成了敲响魔鬼大门的坏习惯。" 她坐了回去，把茶杯抱进自己的怀里。

"或者，确切来讲，她是派别人替她去敲这扇门。" 大祭司轻蔑地挥了挥手，"我觉得你为她干的活并不符合你的性格。如果我回应了你这口是心非的恭维，那你为 Baird 所做的一切便能印证我的想法"

entries.en:
"The Church," she says, "might reward such zealousness."

A wry smile appears, "Would one place faith in the machinery of offices, of rules and letters and who-serves-whom? I pray that we do not grow our own demon in Ludd's good name."

"Worry not." She leans back, "My advanced age allows me to say such things that could have a novice excommunicated."
entries.zh:
"教会..." 她说到，"...有可能奖励这种狂热。"

苦笑浮现在她的脸上，"人难道会把信仰寄托在一个由职务，规则，信件和上下尊卑所构成的机器上吗？我真心祈祷，我等万万不可以卢德之名恣意妄为。"

"无需担忧。" 她往后靠了靠，"我年岁已高，即便口出妄言，也不会像新人那般遭受绝罚。"

entries.en: "It is," she says simply. "Let that be the end of it for now."
entries.zh: "是的，" 她简单说到，"眼下就到此为止吧。"

entries.en:
"I understand full well that you wish untempered wrath let loose in the cause of holy justice, captain."

Her blind eyes seem fixed on you.

"Let me provide you a channel for your river of tears and blood. Otherwise the products of all that suffering might be spilled directionless, wasted."
entries.zh:
"我完全理解，你为了神圣的正义而显露出的无法掩饰的愤怒，舰长。"

她空虚的双眼在冥冥之中注视着你。

"我会为你的血泪提供宣泄的途径，否则这些痛苦所带来的力量将会毫无意义地浪费掉。"

entries.en:
The Archcurate reaches under her desk then places a book on the pitted surface. It is the holy book of Ludd given to you by Brother Cotton; you had left it as an offering at the shrine, amongst a mountain of trinkets.

That she has it here, and knows you put it there, suggests much about the capabilities of the Church and the attention being paid to you.

"I understand full well that you wish untempered wrath let loose to wreak holy justice, captain." Her blind eyes seem fixed on you. "At least, you have communed with one who does."
entries.zh:
大祭司把手伸到桌子下，拿出一本书并将其放到了不甚平整的桌面上。那是 Cotton 修士送给你的卢德圣书；之前你把它当作祭品留在了圣地的那堆小饰品之中。

而现在她拿到了这本书，并且她知道这书是你放在那里的，这说明了教会的能耐以及教会对你的关注。

"舰长，我完全明白，你希望在无尽的怒火中施展神圣的审判。" 她那失明的双目似乎一直在盯着你。"至少，你和一个有这种想法的人交流过。"

entries.en:
She turns to a small side-shelf, opens a wooden box, and takes out a delicate, desiccated leaf.

"Do you know Ludd's Parable of the Kudzu?" She carefully opens Cotton's book, places the leaf within, closes it, and pushes it toward you.

She leans forward, then says in a harsh whisper, "Take it to him. We will speak of this later."
entries.zh:
她转向旁边的一个小架子，打开了一枚木盒子，取出了一片精致的枯叶。

"你知道卢德关于 Kudzu 的寓言吗？" 她小心翼翼地打开 Cotton 修士的书，把那叶子放进去，又轻轻合上，将书推到你面前。

她凑到你耳边，尖刻地低语道，"把这本书带给他，我们后面再谈。"

entries.en:
She takes a leisurely moment to sip her tea.

"You will of course be paid. The coffers of the Church are not so abundant as Tri-Tachyon's plunder, but if these credits may service a righteous path, let us not cast them aside."

"Such acts are for saints." She smiles a little, "Not for those such as you and I."
entries.zh:
她悠闲地喝了一会茶。

"你当然会得到报酬。教会的财力并不如 速子科技 的那帮掠夺者那样雄厚，但如果能将钱财用于正道之上，倒是不妨为此一掷千金。"

"如此行事则是为了卢德的圣者，" 她微微地笑了笑，"并不是为了你我。"

entries.en:
She smiles sardonically. "You have met the Knights. You know full well that in all matters they will break rather than bend and name such waste 'sacrifice'."

"I should not speak so broadly however. There is one who was sent to me to serve for his noviceship. He is the one I want you to find."
entries.zh:
她讽刺地笑了笑："你是见过骑士团的。你也很清楚，他们都是些撞破南墙不回头的家伙，还美其名曰 '牺牲'。"

"不过，话也不能说的太草率。有个新手被派到我手下见习，他就是我想让你找的人。"

entries.en:
"No. My hammer is," she nods in your direction, "a humbler being by far than you. But he requires aid in his quest, and for that you might well serve."

She sips some tea, "Do understand that I speak not entirely of war and wrath. A hammer may strike subtly, even quietly, if aimed with skill, wisdom, and piety."
entries.zh:
"不。我手下的 '重锤' 是..." 她朝你颔首致意，"一个比你谦逊得多的人。但他在任务中需要帮助，你或许要为此提供协助。"

她啜饮了几口茶，继续道："请你一定要理解，我所说的协助，并不完全是指掀起战火。只要辅以技巧，智慧与虔诚，即便是重锤出击也可以做到无声无息。"

entries.en:
"The Faith has many enemies, both within and without the Church," she says slowly. "Some know what evil they do; others do not. They must be set right."

"I would labor to do good as Ludd taught us, and by all means available, as Ludd also taught us. In doing good, I serve this office. And to greater purpose, I serve the vision Ludd handed down to us."
entries.zh:
"伟大的信仰举目皆敌，教会面临着内忧外患。" 她缓缓说道，"有些人知道自己作恶多端；还有些一无所觉。他们都将得到惩戒。"

"我必如卢德所教的那般，行善积德，尽心竭力。在这善举中，我得以履行这份职责。为了那崇高的旨意，我将献身于 卢德 为我们传下的神谕。"

entries.en:
The Archcurate carefully puts her hands together, not unlike a position of prayer.

"Captain. Allow me to put the matter to you directly."
entries.zh:
大祭司虔诚地双手合十，与祈祷的姿势并无不同。

"舰长，请允许我直接告诉你这件事。"

entries.en: "My hammer is," she nods in your direction, acknowledging something, "a humbler thing by far than yourself. But he requires aid in his quest, and for that you might well serve."
entries.zh: "我手下的 '重锤' 是..." 她朝你颔首致意，似乎正确认着什么，"一个比你谦逊得多的人。但他在任务中需要帮助，你或许要为此提供协助。"

entries.en:
"My agent is a novice of the Knights of Ludd. He was assigned to my office in order to achieve his Knighthood. He infiltrated a cell of heretical militants affiliated with the ill-named Luddic Path. I have not heard from him in some time."

Her voice, usually somewhere between confident and sardonic, almost breaks on these last few words.
entries.zh:
"我的特工是卢德骑士团的见习修士。他被派到这里来工作是为了取得骑士爵位。在他潜入臭名昭著的 卢德左径 的一个异端武装成员基地后，我已经有一段时间没有收到他的讯息了。"

她那通常介于自信和讥讽之间的音色，在话语的结尾几乎跑偏了。

entries.en:
"If you accept this task from my office, my assistant will provide you with identity files to aid you in finding my agent. You will also be given a modest retainer to fund your efforts, and more if... when you find him."

"You need not answer now. Pray on the matter. Or 'ponder' if that is how you would name it."

She turns back to the book she had open when you entered. "May Providence favor you with a blessed path; I pray it returns to me with an answer in the affirmative."
entries.zh:
"如果你愿意接受以我办公室的名义发布的这项任务，我的助手将为你提供身份文件，以帮助你找到我的代理人。此外你还会得到一笔数额不大的定金，而如果你能找到...不，当你找到他的时候，还会有额外的奖赏。"

"现在不必回答。请先为此事做出祷告，又或许你会把这称为 '琢磨一下'。"

她重新打开了你进来时她正在读的那本书。"愿上天赐予你受到祝福之路，我则希望它能让你给出肯定的答复。"

o.en: Do not expect me to run errands for the Church.

entries.en: She proceeds, pointedly ignoring your statement.
entries.zh: 她继续说了下去，并且显然无视了你的指摘。

entries.en: She hrums in acknowledgement, attention focused elsewhere now, opening her book with one hand and placing the other upon its open face.
entries.zh: 她轻哼一声表示了解，随即将注意力转到了别处，用一只手打开书，另一只手则放到了那书页上。

entries.en:
"With such haste?" she says, "You need not play-act enthusiasm to impress me. My opinion has always held that decisions of great import should be given ample time to steep."

"Gift me now with silence," she says as she opens her book with one hand and places the other upon its open face.
entries.zh:
"这么快？" 她说，"你不需要用装腔作势的热情来打动我。我认为，重大的决定应该用足够的时间去思考。"

"现在请让我清净一会。" 她边说边用一只手打开书，把另一只手放到了那书页上。

entries.en:
"Your posturing is best held within, captain."

She opens her book with one hand and places the other upon its open face, "Then diffused through meditation," she says.

After a moment she adds, "Unless self-flagellation is your preferred expression of zeal. I judge not."
entries.zh:
"舰长，你最好内敛一些。"

她用一只手打开书，另一只手则放到了那书页上，"然后让自己的态度通过冥想传达。" 她说道。

过了一会她又补充道："除非你热衷于通过自我鞭笞的方式表达热情，我对此不做评判。"

entries.en:
You leave Archcurate Jaspis to her book.

A soft-spoken attendant in robes makes an incongruous datapad appear and coordinates transfer of the Archcurate's comms ID - at least, for her office - then passes you off to the blank-faced Knight Ailanthus to escort you to your waiting shuttle.

Your return to orbit is uneventful.
entries.zh:
你起身离开，给 Jaspis 大祭司留下静心读书的空间。

穿着长袍、说话轻声细语的圣务侍摸出了个和她自己的形象很不搭调的数据平板，将大祭司的通讯 ID 调给了你 —— 至少是她办公室的 —— 然后让面无表情的 Ailanthus 骑士将你护送回穿梭机处。

返回轨道的过程一切顺利。

entries.en:
There is no interior atmosphere, at least none to speak of. Ghostly veils of dust flex and twist in the electrostatic fields of the shrine, strong enough to overcome the low gravity of this world to hang in the near-vacuum.

Instructions are given by some unnamed Luddic priest who recites his words into crude repeaters awoken by your activity:

"Come only in peace. Let rest the dead. We pray now in the words revealed to Ludd... "
entries.zh:
室内空气稀薄，可以说是没有。幽灵似的尘埃，如同面纱一般在圣地的静电场中飘摇，电场的强度足以克服这颗星球微弱的引力，使尘埃悬浮在近乎真空的环境中。

你激活了简陋的中继器，一位不知名的卢德神父所朗诵的导言开始广播：

"铸剑为犁，逝者安息。我等虔诚祷告，谨遵卢德神启..."

entries.en:
The ossuary is built from buried hulls, roughly welded in a chaotic but not artless architecture. No surface is quite level, and the original - faded, crumbling - icons and lettering belie forgotten functions. "Crew quarters", "attachment point", "purge before cycling".

In the gloom you begin to make out empty sockets, rib-cages, countless femurs and spines. They cluster in recesses, corners, in stowage spaces with hatches removed.

You realize that the dust in the air comes from the bodies, the bones, slowly crumbling around you.
entries.zh:
藏骨堂由深埋地下的船体改造而来，与错落有致的建筑粗略地焊成一体。这里找不到任何平整的表面，而那些面目全非，破碎不堪的符号和字迹，已然遮盖了被人遗忘的舱室功能 —— "船员宿舍"，"连接点"，"循环前清洁站" 等等。

在一片幽暗中，你渐渐辨认出空洞的眼窝，肋骨架，以及数之不尽的股骨和脊椎，它们一团团簇拥在壁龛里，在墙角里，在拆掉舱门的储物间里。

你悚然惊觉，空中飘散的尘埃，正是来自于身边这些日渐破碎的骸骨和遗体。

entries.en:
The unknown priest's words fill the radio-channels, made warbly and tinny by the low power of the repeaters.

"...fell from orbit like burning leaves / caught by wind and wailing / lifebreath stolen from mother and child..."

A dead suit's indicators blink from gray-black to green. It steps toward you.
entries.zh:
无线电频道里充斥着这位无名神父的话语，功率低下的中继器使之化作刺耳的呢喃。

"...于星轨坠入凡尘，似落叶燎作飞灰 / 狂风无尽之哭嚎，困我于囹圄之中 / 母子相依为命，生息俱为所夺..."

一套看起来已经关机的服具，身上的指示灯突然忽闪着由黑转绿。接着，它向你走了过来。

entries.en:
You instinctively pull back, hand on your sidearm.

The figure pauses, adjusts something on its battered suit, and the helmet switches on its self-illumination. Its hands sign a channel ID, which you flick to.

"We have few visitors," says the same voice as the broadcast prayers, rough with age and disuse.

So this is what passes for the local Curate Sacraria.
entries.zh:
你本能地后撤，手放到了防身武器上。

那个身影停下来了，在破旧不堪的服具上调整了一下，然后头盔就启动了自发光。它出示了一个通讯频道 ID，你跟着点了一下。

"这里几乎没有访客。" 这声音与广播里的祷告声相同，漫长岁月中的缄默，使这嗓音变得沙哑。

所以，这就是当地传闻中的神龛祭司了。

o.en: I've come to see the shrine.
There must be thousands of the dead here.
o.zh: 这里恐怕有成千上万的死者。
这诡异的展览是怎么回事？

entries.en: Moving deeper, between rooms and hulls, you witness galleries of the dead, bones and skulls carefully and artfully piled. You catch a glimpse now and then of pilgrims in ones and twos by their active vacsuit indicators. The curate leaves them to their contemplations.
entries.zh: 随着脚步逐渐深入，在那些房间和船体之中，你目睹了逝者的长廊，遗骸与头颅被精心而富有艺术感地堆积起来。通过真空服上那些激活的指示灯，你时不时可以瞥见三三两两的朝圣者。祭司没有打搅他们的深思。

entries.en: You are left among the dead. The webs of ash hanging in the air twitch and flow as movement elsewhere in the labyrinth triggers minor fluctuations in the standing electrostatic charge.
entries.zh: 你被留在了茫茫死者之中。这幽幽曲径间的静电荷经久不散，每当它们产生一丝微不可查的涨落，空中悬浮的灰烬便如水网般流转不息。

entries.en:
"Yes," the curate says, and brings a hand down to squeeze your shoulder, "Yes," he says again, and you can hear the smile in his voice.

Then, without a word, he disappears into some shadowy corridor.
entries.zh:
"是的，" 祭司说道，他伸出一只手拍了拍你的肩膀，"是的，" 他重复着，你能感受到他的声音中的笑意。

随后，他无声地隐入了某个昏暗的小道。

entries.en:
The curate thinks for a moment, then comes to a conclusion. "You will," he says, and brings a hand down to squeeze your shoulder, "Yes," he says again, and you can hear the start of a smile in his voice.

Then, without a word, he disappears into some shadowy corridor.
entries.zh:
祭司思索片刻便有了结论。"你会的，" 他说，并伸手拍了拍你的肩膀。"你会的，" 他重复道，你可以感受到他声音中的笑意。

随后，他无声地隐入了某个昏暗的小道。

entries.en:
The curate simply looks at you, then, you think, shakes his head. "Contemplate," he says finally.

With that said, and nothing else, he disappears into some shadowy corridor.
entries.zh:
祭司只是看着你，你好像看到他摇了摇头"请三思，" 他最终开口道。

说完，他便无声地隐入了某个昏暗的小道。

entries.en:
"You are within it, the sacred space," the curate sacraria spreads his arms, "Witness the get of wrath."

He turns and moves, as if expecting you to follow.
entries.zh:
"你正处于它之中，处于这片神圣之地上。" 神龛祭司展开双臂，"见证这战争怒火的恶报。"

他转身走去，似乎期待着你跟上他。

entries.en:
"They are forgotten," the curate says, his gaze passing across the bones. Taking stock, somehow. "But I will not forget them. And all who visit here, they will help me remember that those who died may live eternal."

He fixes you now with a suddenly-piercing gaze, "You will help?"
entries.zh:
"他们已被遗忘，" 祭司说到，他的目光掠过这些遗骨，像是以某种方式在盘点着，"但我不会忘记。每一位造访此地的人，都会助我铭记 —— 这些逝者永垂不朽。"

而现在，他突然以一种锐利的目光凝视着你，"你也会帮我吗？"

o.en: I will fight to avenge them.

entries.en:
For a long pause the hollow eyes in that dark suit-helmet examine you. The curate looks, if anything, tired, in his tired old suit.

He turns and moves, as if expecting you to follow.
entries.zh:
在那幽暗的服具头盔之下，空洞的双眼审视了你很长一段时间。而这位服具破旧的祭司，如果说真能从他身上看出些什么，那便只有疲惫。

他转身走去，似乎期待着你跟上他。

entries.en:
The curate sacraria stops before a pedestal, a bouquet of spines topped by fragments of skull. You see the glint of a cranial implant among the shards. The curate carefully lifts a fragment, trailing gold wire.

"Death comes for all. Every warlord, High Hegemon, CEO, spacer. Every prophet, every thief, every friend."

He looks at you with suddenly-piercing eyes, "Even you star-farer, fleet-captain. Death will come."
entries.zh:
神龛祭司在一个底座面前停下，底座上立着一束脊椎，顶端缀有颅骨的碎片，你甚至还能看见上面闪闪发亮的颅骨植入物。祭司小心翼翼地举起一块碎片，其后牵着一根金线。

"人终有一死。不论是军阀、至高霸主、CEO，还是宇宙民。所有先知，所有窃贼，所有友人。"

他的目光倏忽间刺向了你，"哪怕是你 ，身为远行者，身为舰队的舰长。死亡终将降临。"

o.en: Is that some kind of threat?

entries.en:
The hollow eyes of the curate squint, unmoving for a moment. "No," he says in a voice warmed only little over interstellar medium. "The dead are numberless," the suit sags.

Then. with a grunt, he turns and walks as if expecting you to follow.
entries.zh:
祭司那空洞的双眼微眯着，一时间纹丝不动。"不，" 他的声音化为电波，穿破了星际介质，染上一丝温暖的味道，"死者是数之不尽的。" 言罢，他的身形也随之颓落。

然后，随着一声低语，他转身走去，似乎期待着你跟上他。

entries.en:
He stops and fixes you with a suddenly piercing gaze. "The bodies, the bodies can be counted. Dust and bones."

"But not the dead. Their love, their life. No number remembers that." A pause. "You understand?"
entries.zh:
他停下来，你感受到如同锋刃一般的目光向你投来。"尸体，我们可以数清尸体。皆是尘埃与白骨。"

"但永远无法衡量死亡。他们的爱，他们的生命。没有数字能够记住那一切。" 他顿了顿，"你可明白？"

entries.en:
You stay a while in the ossuary of Killa.

The hollow eyes keep silent vigil. Stacks and wings and arches and forests of human bone adorn every surface.

The dust-flux pulses slowly, like the breath of a titanic creature.
entries.zh:
你在 Killa 的藏骨堂稍作停留。

这些空洞的眼孔，彻夜不眠地进行着他们那永不停歇的祷告。书库，侧厅，拱门，森森白骨如林，装点着每一片角落。

尘埃之流缓缓搏动，有如庞然大物吞吐的气息。

entries.en:
The curate makes a sound in his throat; acknowledgement. You catch a glimpse of sad, dark eyes. "Then you walk with me. Come. A dark path. Company is welcome."

He turns and walks without hesitation into the folds of ruin.
entries.zh:
祭司清了清嗓子，确认通讯畅通。你瞥见一双悲伤而黯淡的眼睛。"那么，你便和我走吧。请随我来，前途未明，自当携手并肩。"

他转身走去，似乎期待着你跟上他。

entries.en:
"They are forgotten," he says, "All forgotten, turned to dust by war. But I will remember that they once were. It is all I have to give."

The curate's suit helmet bobs at you, "And you will remember too, now."

"And then they shall live eternal. You understand?"
entries.zh:
"他们已被遗忘，" 他说到，"被世人尽数忘却，被战乱碾作飞灰。但我将铭记他们的存在，这正是我所必须付出的。"

祭司的服具头盔冲你低了低，"而现在，你也会铭记。"

"如此，他们将永垂不朽。你可明白？"

o.en: I will fight to avenge them.

entries.en:
You leave the dead in their tombs within the battered crust of the lifeless moon below.

The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful.
entries.zh:
你留逝者安息于陵墓中，深埋在这死寂卫星那破碎的地壳之下。

搭乘穿梭机返航的过程一切顺利。

entries.en:
You leave the dead in their tombs within the battered crust of the lifeless moon below.

The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful.
entries.zh:
你留逝者安息于陵墓中，深埋在这死寂卫星那破碎的地壳之下。

搭乘穿梭机返航的过程一切顺利。

entries.en:
Veils of dust slowly flex and twist in the electrostatic fields of the shrine, strong enough to overcome the low gravity of this world to hang in the near-vacuum.

Instructions are given by some unnamed Luddic priest who recites their words into crude repeaters awoken by your activity:

"Come only in peace. Let rest the dead. We pray now in the words revealed to Ludd... "
entries.zh:
尘埃如面纱一般在圣地的静电场中飘摇，电场的强度足以克服这颗星球微弱的引力，使尘埃悬浮在近乎真空的环境中。

你激活了简陋的中继器，一位不知名的卢德神父所朗诵的导言开始广播：

"铸剑为犁，逝者安息。我等虔诚祷告，谨遵卢德神启..."

entries.en:
In the gloom you begin to make out empty sockets, rib-cages, countless femurs and spines. They cluster in recesses, corners, in stowage spaces, their hatches removed.

Recorded verse haunt the comms channels.

"... cities fall from orbit like burning leaves / caught by the wind and wailing / life's breath pulled from mother and child..."
entries.zh:
在一片幽暗中，你渐渐辨认出空洞的眼窝，肋骨架，以及数之不尽的股骨和脊椎，它们一团团簇拥在壁龛里，在墙角里，在拆掉舱门的储物间里。

阴魂不散的诗篇，回荡在通信频道之中。

"...城塞，于星轨坠入凡尘，似落叶燎作飞灰 / 狂风无尽之哭嚎，困我于囹圄之中 / 母子相依为命，生息俱为所夺..."

entries.en:
Wandering the halls, you eventually encounter the curate sacraria of the ossuary. He is, as before, a man of few words, and greets you with only a nod and the ghost of a sad smile.

You are left among the dead. The webs of ash hanging in the air twitch and flow as movement elsewhere in the labyrinth trigger minor fluctuations in the standing electrostatic charge.
entries.zh:
在回廊中游荡着，你终于遇见了藏骨堂的神龛祭司。他一如往常，寡言少语，如幽灵般哀伤地微笑着，对你微微颔首致意。

你被留在了茫茫死者之中。这幽幽曲径间的静电荷经久不散，每当它们产生一丝微不可查的涨落，空中悬浮的灰烬便如水网般流转不息。

entries.en:
Your shuttle descends toward the surface of Killa, following the landing beacon to an ancient lava-sea peppered with craters.

Tactical systems log the brief ping of targeting radar but the signature suggests a handheld system too crude to pose a threat to your countermeasures.

The landing site is far from any obvious ruins or landmarks. There's just a smear of crumbling temporary habs and cold, broken transports.
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机向 Killa 的地表降下，跟随着陆信标的指引，来到了一片遍布着无数火山岛屿的古老熔岩海之上。

战术系统记录了微弱的瞄准雷达脉冲信号，识别特征表明其来自于简陋的手持式系统，不足以对你的反制措施造成威胁。

着陆点偏离了所有显眼的废墟和地标，这里的破败景象中只有摇摇欲坠的临时居所和冰冷残破的交通工具。

entries.en:
Your shuttle comes to a rest on the landing pad, easing softly into the microgravity.

The wreckage and debris is not so chaotic as it seemed from orbit. A swarm of dusty footprints lead toward an airlock buried in an escarpment some distance away.

It appears that others have been using this site in the cycles since the war's devastation.
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机靠在停机坪上，缓缓进入了微重力环境。

残骸和碎片并没有轨道上看起来的那么混乱。一片灰尘印下的足迹，通往一个埋在远方峭壁中的气闸。

看起来，惨遭战火蹂躏后的这些年里，某些人一直在使用这个站点。

o.en: Request an active scan of the area
o.zh: 请求对该区域进行主动扫描

entries.en: You follow the path laid by others to the airlock. The manual controls allow you to pull it open to reveal a yawning black hole.
entries.zh: 你沿着前人走过的路来到气闸前，拉开依然健在的手动操纵装置，露出一个十分宽阔的漆黑洞口。

entries.en: Your shuttle returns to your $shipOrFleet in orbit.
entries.zh: 你的穿梭机返回了你在轨道上的$shipOrFleet。

entries.en: Your sensors officer performs an active scan of the area from your $shipOrFleet as you wait on the landing pad. Your datapad barely flickers as one of the powerful beams sweeps your position.
entries.zh: 趁着你在停机坪上等待的时候，你的传感器技官从你的$shipOrFleet上发起了主动扫描。当高能波束群中的一道扫过你的位置时，你的数据平板微微闪烁了一下。

entries.en:
Your datapad pings as the results come in.

There are low-density voids beneath the surface; artificial density patterns. Caves or bunkers or tunnels. Ferric and non-ferric metals, some EM activity, some radioactivity. It reads about as standard as any report you've seen involving the smear and scatter of ruined human civilization across the Persean Sector.

The trail of footprints beckons you toward what looks like an airlock embedded in a nearby escarpment.
entries.zh:
扫描结果出来时，你的数据平板也随之响应。

结果显示，地表之下存在密度较低的空间，与人工建筑的密度模型高度吻合。洞穴，掩体，隧道，铁和非铁的金属，再加上一点电磁波活动和放射性特征。这份报告读起来中规中矩，和 英仙座星域 那些七零八落，一片狼藉的人类文明废墟大差不差。

足迹引导着你走向附近一个嵌入峭壁的，看起来像气闸的东西。

entries.en:
Your shuttle descends toward the surface of Killa, following the landing beacon to the site of the shrine. A careless scattering of wrecked hulls and cold transport rovers form the graveyard of a long-past slaughter..

You follow the dusty footsteps of previous pilgrims to a humble airlock set into an escarpment of crumbling regolith.
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机沿着着陆信标降落到 Killa 的地表，抵达了圣地。很久以前这似乎发生过一场屠杀，毁坏的船体、冰冷的运输车则被搭在一起，草草的当做了死者的坟墓。

你追随着前几位朝圣者在灰尘中的脚步，来到一个摇摇欲坠的风化峭壁上，进入了一个简陋的气闸室。

o.en: Take a shuttle to the Luddic Church beacon
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前去拜访卢德圣地

o.en: Take a shuttle to the Luddic shrine
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前去拜访卢德圣地

entries.en:
"The Pneuma lives in these words," he says quietly.

Then, almost embarassed, he signs a spacer's fare-well ("all-secure, acceleration imminent") and steps back toward the ruined antechamber of the shrine, leaving you to your contemplation.

You feel the muted thrum of the shifting platform through your feet, the barest roll as distant waves make their futile assault against the ruin.
entries.zh:
"圣灵寓于这些字句之中，" 他轻声说道。

接着，他几乎有些窘迫地比了个太空人的告别手势 ("一切安稳，即将加速")，退向圣地破败的前厅，留你独自沉思。

你隔着脚底感到平台移动时低沉的震颤，还有那一丝几不可察的摇晃 —— 远处的浪涛正徒劳地撞击着这片废墟。

entries.en:
He does not answer.

He stares sadly at the lonely, flickering flame.

Then, almost embarassed, he signs a spacer's fare-well ("all-secure, acceleration imminent") and steps back toward the ruined antechamber of the shrine, leaving you to your contemplation.
entries.zh:
他没有作答。

他怔怔地望着那簇孤寂摇曳的火苗，神色黯然。

接着，他几乎有些窘迫地比了个太空人的告别手势 ("一切安稳，即将加速")，退向圣地破败的前厅，留你独自沉思。

entries.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is empty, as lonely as a coffin that never embraced the corpse for which it was built.

The receiving hall is pocked and scorched by more weapons-fire. Lighter here; handheld arms. Rusty pools of dank water on the floor mingle with suspicious rusty stains. It smells of salt and rot and smoke.

An enormous, ragged hole opens to the dark sea below. Nearly half the underside of this platform must be missing. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads. Someone's left candles here, though they've burnt out and gathered small pools of water inside the divits burnt into the paraffin.
entries.zh:
圣地的前厅空空荡荡，孤寂得像一具棺材，从未迎来它本该盛殓的遗体。

接待大厅里又添了更多武器开火留下的弹痕与焦灼。这里要轻些，是手持武器。地上锈水洼混着可疑的锈色污渍。空气里是盐味、腐味，还有烟味。

一个巨大、边缘参差的窟窿朝着底下幽暗的海敞开。这平台近半的底层怕是都没了。你能听见浪头拍打外壁舱板。有人在这儿留了些蜡烛，只是早已燃尽，烛泪烧出的小凹里积了一汪汪水。

entries.en:
"Was a raid," a voice says.

A muted high pitched keen replies; sonic mapping, and just the barest flicker of barely-visible laser sweep to show that your bodyguards have quickly discovered the source of the voice. A murmur of tactical chatter confirms its owner is unarmed.

A rough-looking laborer, maybe a low-status tech, steps from the shadows. His eyes are cast toward the hole in the floor.

"The Sindies got word somehow. They say some informer told 'em there was a weapons cache in the shrine."

He indicates with his chin - the hole, the sea. A conspicuous and heavy absence.
entries.zh:
"是场突袭，" 一个声音说道。

一声压低了的尖细蜂鸣回响起来，是声呐测绘；还有一丝几乎看不见的激光扫掠微光，说明你的护卫已经迅速锁定了声源。一阵战术耳语确认来人没有携带武器。

一个形容粗粝的劳工，兴许是个身份低微的技术员，从阴影里走了出来。他的目光落在地上那个窟窿上。

"辛达佬不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲这圣地里面藏了批武器。"

他用下巴朝那边点了点 —— 那个窟窿，那片海。一块扎眼而沉重的空白。

o.en: Who are you? Is this the shrine?

entries.en:
"I'm called Simon. No one important," he says with a glance at you. "Came back after the committee said things were over."

"That," he kicks a foot forward, "was the shrine."

He's quiet for a moment. But he wants to tell the story.

"As I hear it, the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly just regular walkers."
entries.zh:
"我叫 Simon，无名小卒罢了，\" 他瞥了你一眼，\"委员会宣布事情了结之后，我回来了。"

"至于那个，\" 他抬脚往前点了点，\"就是圣地了。"

他沉默了片刻。可他想要讲出这段往事。

"我听说是这样，辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半只是普通行者。"

entries.en:
"Not any who was down there, no," he says. "But this whole district was full of VSDC at the height of the fighting."

"You looking for someone in particular?"
entries.zh:
"待在下面的，没有，\" 他说，\"不过打得最凶那阵子，整个街区到处都是 VSDC 的人。"

"你是在找什么特定的人吗？"

o.en: A curate sacraria. Who keeps the shrine.
o.zh: 是位司祭，掌管圣龛、看护这处圣地。

o.en: No. I came for the shrine.
o.zh: 不。我是为这处圣地而来。

entries.en:
"Not any who was down there, no," he says. "But this whole district was full of VSDC at the height of the fighting."

"You looking for someone in particular?"
entries.zh:
"待在下面的，没有，\" 他说，\"不过打得最凶那阵子，整个街区到处都是 VSDC 的人。"

"你是在找什么特定的人吗？"

o.zh: 是那位司祭，Moyra Standfast，掌管圣龛。

o.en: No. I came for the shrine.
o.zh: 不。我是为这处圣地而来。

entries.en: "This is it," he says.
entries.zh: "就这样了，" 他说道。

entries.en:
Simon takes a deep breath, then kneels by the candles. He selects one, flicking the water away, then replaces the stub to its original position.

An igniter clicks in his hand, and he sets a tiny, wavering flame on the wick. It grows, and he withdraws the igniter.

Two flames.

He snaps it shut with practiced hand, leaving just the candle. Then pauses a moment. And puts his hand out, offering you the igniter.
entries.zh:
Simon 深吸一口气，在蜡烛旁跪下。他挑出一支，弹去积水，又把那截烛头放回原处。

他手里咔哒一声打着了点火器，把一簇细小、摇曳的火苗送上烛芯。火苗长了起来，他便收回点火器。

两簇火光。

他手法熟练地把它啪地合上，只留下那支蜡烛。随后顿了片刻。又把手伸出来，把点火器递给你。

entries.en:
You follow Simon's lead, clearing the seawater out of a likely-looking candle, then clicking the igniter to give it flame; a tenuous flicker of life renewed.

Simon takes the igniter back.

He watches the flames for a moment. and his eyes are brighter than before. He rubs at his face with one scarred hand. Fingers missing.
entries.zh:
你照着 Simon 的样子，把一支看着还合用的蜡烛里的海水清掉，再咔哒一声打着点火器给它续上火；一线微弱摇曳、重又燃起的生机。

Simon 把点火器收了回去。

他望着火光看了片刻，眼神比先前亮了些。他用一只满是疤痕的手抹了抹脸。缺了几根指头。

o.en: It is not just a candle.

entries.en: "It is, though," he says. "For those of us who lived."
entries.zh: "可对我们这些活下来的人来说，它就是，\" 他说道。"

entries.en: Simon makes the igniter disappear and watches the flame for a moment. His eyes are brighter than before, and he rubs at his face with one scarred hand.
entries.zh: Simon 把点火器收得没了影，又望着火苗看了片刻。他的眼神比先前亮了些，用一只满是疤痕的手抹了抹脸。

o.en: It is not just a candle.

entries.en:
He gives you a look, then turns back to contemplating the missing shrine.

"Well, this is it."
entries.zh:
他看了你一眼，又转回去凝望那已不复存在的圣地。

"嗯，就这样了。"

entries.en:
He gives you a look, then turns back to his contemplation.

"Standfast was her name. Don't think people are quite agreed about whether she was down there or not. When it happened. Lots of folks went away, and lots came back after the... the resolution."

He shrugs.
entries.zh:
他看了你一眼，又转回自己的沉思里。

"她叫 Standfast。事发那会儿她到底在不在下面，大家至今也没个一致的说法。出事的时候。好些人逃走了，等...等事情了结，又回来了不少。"

他耸了耸肩。

entries.en: "It's just a pistol," she says. "It's not that heavy."
entries.zh: "也就一把手枪而已。" 她说，"这可不算什么 '严实' 的武装。"

entries.en:
She raises an eyebrow. "I could arrange a blessing if that's what you want."

She dips two fingers in a cup of tea and flings the droplets at you. "Blessed be this pilgrim before me, may they find grace on Ludd's path. May Providence be merciful in hardship, and if not, let them bow their head in humble prayer to their Creator, who made the stars all around, begging forgiveness for their sins, and for guidance on their path."

"There," she drops a hand on the table. "You're blessed."
entries.zh:
她眉头一挑。"如果你想要，我可以安排一场祝福。"

她把两根手指浸入茶水，然后将液滴泼洒向你。"愿我面前的这位朝圣者蒙福，愿他在卢德曾行的道途上寻得恩典。愿他在困苦中得见上天的慈悲，如若不然，愿他谦卑俯首，向那创造群星的造物主祈祷，祈求宽恕他的罪愆，指引他的前路。"

"好了，" 她把手往桌上一放。"你已得祝福。"

entries.en:
"I suppose I could arrange a blessing," she says slowly.

"But the shrine is closed, didn't you hear? It would feel," she pretends to search for the words, "Disloyal."

The woman shrugs, open handed.
entries.zh:
"我觉得我倒是可以给你安排一次祝福。" 她缓缓说到。

"但圣地关闭了，你没听说吗？这未免..." 她假装在斟酌用词，"不太虔诚。"

那妇人摊开双手，耸了耸肩。

entries.en:
She looks at you for a long moment.

"A long time ago, before... many things, the-one-who-would-be Ludd was hunted by the authorities of the Domain. They had electronic eyes everywhere, and hidden ears. But their multitude of small demons did not find the-one-who-would-be, who was hidden among friends and fellow travelers."

"And do you know why?"
entries.zh:
她目不转睛地盯了你许久。

"很久之前，在...许多事情之前，命定之人卢德曾被 人之领 官方追捕。他们的摄像头和监听器无处不在，但这些小恶魔却没能找到藏身于好友和同道之中的那位命定之人。

"你知道为什么吗？"

entries.en:
"OPSEC," she says, kicking a table-leg, setting the tea-set clattering. "Ludd got betrayed in the end, of course, but what can you do? All good things and so on."

Letting out a sigh, she continues in a voice of spirited obedience: "No, officer, I've never heard of this insurgency. Sounds awful."
entries.zh:
"OPSEC，" 她说着，一边踢了下桌脚，把茶具震得乱响，"的确，卢德最终遭到了背叛，但你又能怎么办呢？正如天下没有不散的宴席。"

长叹一声后，她换上一副充满俯首听命的语气继续道："不，长官，我从未听说过这次叛乱。这听起来糟透了。"

entries.en:
She looks at you for a long moment.

"No, officer. I am armed only to protect the shrine from looters and terrorists. You know how times are. The authority of the Supreme Executor is... stretched thin."

You detect more than a hint of disapproval in her eyes, but she knows when not to speak her mind.
entries.zh:
她目不转睛地盯了你许久。

"不，长官。我携带的武器仅用于保卫圣地不受劫匪和恐怖分子的侵害。您知道时局如何，最高元首 的权威...已经捉襟见肘了。"

你从她眼神中看到的远不止一丝腹诽，但她很清楚何时该缄口不言。

entries.en:
"Then," she says, "I am here to show you to it."

"Simon?" she says to someone behind you, "You may also stow your weapon."

You turn to look and Simon does as she asks, giving you an apologetic little half-salute. The curate smiles, and with open hands shows you the way to the inner shrine.
entries.zh:
"那么，" 她说道，"我就带你去吧。"

"Simon？" 她对你身后的某个人说到，"你也可以收起武器了。"

你转身看去，发现 Simon 照做了，还向你微微致以歉意的半礼。祭司微笑着，张开双手为你展示通往内部圣地的道路。

entries.en: "A pilgrim? You?" She looks perplexed.
entries.zh: "朝圣者？你？" 她看起来很迷惑。

entries.en:
"Then," she says, "I am here to show you to it."

"Simon?" she says to someone behind you, "You may also put your gun away."

You turn to look and Simon does as she asks, giving you an apologetic little half-salute. The curate smiles, and with open hands shows you the way to the inner shrine.
entries.zh:
"那么，" 她说道，"我就带你去吧。"

"Simon？" 她对你身后的某个人说到，"你也可以放下枪了。"

你转身看去，发现 Simon 照做了，还向你微微致以歉意的半礼。祭司微笑着，张开双手为你展示通往内部圣地的道路。

entries.en: "It is my understanding," she says, "That the musings of your Supreme Executor broadly contradict the precepts of the Church of Galactic Redemption - and the teachings of Ludd in particular."
entries.zh: "据我所知，" 她说道，"你那位最高元首的见解，和 银河救赎教会 的戒律 —— 尤其是卢德的教诲 —— 大相径庭。"

o.en: There is common ground. An emphasis on tradition and family.
o.zh: 也有共通之处，比如对家庭和传统的重视。

o.en: I'm not here for a lecture on theology.
o.zh: 我来这里不是为了听神学演说。

entries.en:
"The Church is not one mind, but the body of many brought together in council," she says. "Some support our work here with zeal, and some are content merely to pray."

A dark look comes over her, "I, however, pray that the united face of the Church might not turn from witnessing our suffering. Ludd wept unblinking, it is said; that the Fathers and Mothers of our Church would do the same."
entries.zh:
"教会并非铁板一块，而是众多个体在议会中凝聚而成的整体，" 她说道，"有些人热忱地支持我们在此地的事业，而有些人则仅仅满足于祈祷。"

黯淡的神色攀上她的面庞，"尽管如此，我仍然祈愿教会那团结的容颜，莫要对我们正在遭受的苦难视而不见。据说卢德落泪的双眼也不曾放弃见证；愿我们教会的神父与教母们亦能如此。"

entries.en: "I've made a believer of you," the curate smiles. "Good."
entries.zh: "看来我让你确信这一点了。" 祭司笑着说，"很好。"

entries.en:
The tea is rich with umami. Less vegetal, more briny.

"A humble local variety," the woman says. "Tartessian Brown is hard to come by, what with the occupation."
entries.zh:
这茶鲜甜可口，茶味不浓，海味更重。

"一种普通的本地品种罢了，" 那妇人说到，"自从这里被占领之后，就很难弄到 Tartessus 产的棕茶。"

entries.en:
For once, she does not answer.

She is staring sadly, you think, at the candles before you.
entries.zh:
这一次，她并没有做出回应。

她凝视着你面前的蜡烛，你感到她的眼神中充满了悲伤。

entries.en:
"So the torch is passed," the curate says. "Light of flame, light of faith."

She gives you a sly look, "Or it's just a candle."
entries.zh:
"就这样，火炬受到了传承。" 祭司说道，"火焰之光，信仰之光。"

她看向你，露出了狡黠的神色，"又或许只是一支小小的蜡烛。"

entries.en:
"No. Not at all." She gives you a look of some disgust. "I am a curate of the Church of Galactic Redemption. What I do and what they do are very different. I hope, I truly hope, you can see that."

Her gaze turns to the weapons, "I admit, there has been... contact. Each day is a test. I pray we do not stray too far from Ludd."
entries.zh:
"不，我才不是。" 她一边回答一边盯着你，眼神里满是厌恶。"我可是 银河救赎教会 的一名祭司，我的所作所为和他们那帮人可不一样。我希望，我真诚地希望，你能看出其中的差别。"

她眼神一转，又看向了军火，"我承认，我们也...接触过他们。与他们接触的每一天，都是对信仰的一次考验。但愿我们不会偏离卢德之道太远。"

entries.en:
"The Pneuma lives in these words."

She is staring sadly, you think, at the candles before you.
entries.zh:
"圣灵就活在这些文字之中。"

她凝视着你面前的蜡烛，你感到她的眼神中充满了悲伤。

o.en: You seem heavily armed for a curate.
o.zh: 作为一个祭司，你看起来似乎武装的太过严实了。

o.en: I mean, are you part of the Volturn insurgency?
o.zh: 我说，你也是 Volturn 叛乱的一份子吗？

o.en: Are you a member of the Volturn insurgency?
o.zh: 你是 Volturn 叛乱者的一员吗？

o.en: Shouldn't you be talking about blessings?
o.zh: 你不应该讨论一下祝福的事情吗？

o.en: I'm here to see the shrine.
I am a pilgrim come for the shrine.
o.zh: 我是一位朝圣者，前来拜谒圣地。

o.en: I could report you for threatening a commissioned officer of the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 对于你威胁 辛达强权 委任军官的行径，我可是能进行举报的。

o.en: This seems to confirm your part in the insurgency.
o.zh: 这些军火似乎证实了你和 Volturn 叛乱的关系。
这些军火可真是...令人不安

o.en: Are you part of the Luddic Path?
o.zh: 你是 卢德左径 的一份子吗？

o.en: What does the Church think of your part in this insurgency?
o.zh: 你参与 Volturn 的叛乱这件事，教会怎么看？

o.en: It is not just a candle.
Look out the window for a moment
I sense a note of criticism in your tone.
Why do you insist on being so stubborn and backward? I'm trying to help.
o.zh: 你为何如此顽固不化？我这是在帮你。

o.en: If you accepted the Supreme Executor, it wouldn't have to be like this.
o.zh: 如果你接纳了最高元首，事情就不至于此了。

o.en: If the Church has abandoned you, why stay?
o.zh: 如果教会已经抛弃了你，那又何苦再坚持下去？

o.en: A compromise, then. Private prayer, public support for the Executor.
o.zh: 那看来是一种妥协了。私下里举行祷告，但明面上还是支持首长的。

entries.en: "There's a suggestion," she says with false cheer. "We could put one of those holo portraits of Andrada right... here," she waves a hand at the center of the shrine. "Really focus our prayers, do some good."
entries.zh: "我这有个建议。" 她装出欢快的语气，"我们可以把 Andrada 的全息肖像放在...这里。" 她冲着圣地中央挥了挥手，"这么一摆，他那肖像可就有点用了，能让我们祈祷更专注了呢。"

entries.en:
"This," she indicates the decrepit shrine around her, "Is the compromise. As dictated by your Executor."

"Any further, then we shall have left the path of Ludd's teachings entirely. So here I remain."
entries.zh:
"这些。" 她指向她周围破败的圣地，"这就是妥协。都是你的首长的作品。"

"更进一步，我们就完全背离了卢德的教诲。所以我决意在此停留。"

entries.en:
"Oh?" She raises an eyebrow at you. "Oh, alright. Lying is a sin, and redemption must begin somewhere."

She raises her chin and looks at you. "The shrine has been all but stomped out by your Sindrian Diktat. Soldiers and MuniSec harass pilgrims and arrest the faithful, then steal our tithes."

"As long as they leave the shrine untouched, however, the Church is willing to turn the other cheek."
entries.zh:
"哦？" 她对你扬了扬眉毛。"对，是的，谎言是种罪恶，而救赎必须从某处开启。"

她抬起下巴看向了你。"圣地几乎被你们 辛达强权 亵渎了个遍。士兵和地方安全部的人在骚扰朝圣者，逮捕我们的信徒，然后偷走我们的什一税。"

"但是，只要他们不触碰我们的圣地，教会就愿意坐视不管。"

entries.en: "My faith is not the Church," she says fiercely. "And they can defrock and excommunicate me for that if they like, it would change nothing here."
entries.zh: "教会不是我的信仰。" 她言辞激烈，"如果他们愿意，他们可以因此取消我的教会资格，把我逐出教会，但这不会改变任何事情。"

entries.en:
She looks around, as if for the first time. "It is, isn't it."

"Appropriate, though. Reminds us of our place on this world."
entries.zh:
她环顾四周，一切宛如初见。"的确如此，不是吗。"

"但这样才是恰到好处，可以警醒我们，认清自己在这颗星球上的处境。"

entries.en:
"You could," she admits, holding your gaze. "Do it or don't, I'm too old to dance around implied threats."

For the first time, she sips her tea. "I could be having that nap."
entries.zh:
"那就请便，" 她附和道，一边迎上你的目光，"报不报随你，我都这把年纪了，可没精力跟你玩什么含沙射影的把戏。"

自你闯入以来，她首次啄了一口茶，一边继续道："刚才我就该接着打盹的。"

entries.en:
"I will consider your position once I can put that same question to those of my flock that were sent to Cruor," she says.

"Until you can give them back," her eyes are bright with tears, "I will do as I do."
entries.zh:
"只有当我能把同样的问题抛向我那些被送去 Cruor 的教众时，我才会考虑你的立场，" 她说道。

"但直到你把他们还给我之前，" 她的眼里闪着泪光，"我只会一如既往。"

entries.en:
"You... do that," the curate says haltingly, not looking at you.

"Now please go."
entries.zh:
"而你...那样做了，" 祭司看向别处，颤抖着说。

"现在请你离开吧。"

entries.en: The curate smiles superficially, then with open hands shows you the way to the inner shrine.
entries.zh: 祭司用微笑掩盖了心中的情绪，随即摊开双手，为你指出了通往内部圣地的道路。

entries.en: "Interesting," she lies. "You'll have to tell me more after appreciating the shrine."
entries.zh: "有意思，" 她敷衍道，"参观完圣地之后，你可得多跟我说说。"

entries.en: "Of course not," she says. "Not my job."
entries.zh: "当然不是了。" 她说，"而且那也不是我的职责。"

entries.en: The curate frowns. "What troubles you about it?"
entries.zh: 祭司皱起眉头，"这些军火有什么让你不安的？"

o.en: The violence. Is this not a religion of peace?
o.zh: 军火象征暴力，你们 卢德教会 不是崇尚和平吗？

o.en: This is a shrine. Is it not a sacred place?
o.zh: 这里可是圣地啊，这种神圣的地方难道可以拿来放军火吗？

o.en: Lack of heavy weapons. How will you fight armored targets?
o.zh: 都没几件重武器，你们要怎么对付防御精良的敌人呢？

entries.en: A smile doubles the wrinkles on her face. "I believe we understand one another."
entries.zh: 祭司微笑着，苍老的脸上登时又添了更多皱纹。"我们可真是心有灵犀。"

entries.en:
"The book does tell us 'Blessed are the peacemakers', yet," the curate looks at you with hard eyes, "Peace does not make itself."

"Ludd was no war-maker, but Ludd knew when to fight. By self-sacrifice, by martyrdom, did not Ludd deliver victory?"

She waves a hand dismissively. "This is rhetoric to you, perhaps. But to me, it is more simple: I will not let more of my flock be taken to the mines of Cruor as sacrifice to some tin-pot Lucifer."
entries.zh:
"卢德圣书中的确有这样的训诫 —— '缔造和平者当受蒙福'，可是，" 祭司看向你，眼神冷酷，"和平终究不会自己实现。"

"卢德并不好战，但卢德知晓何时该战。通过自我牺牲，通过壮烈殉道作战，难道说，卢德没有带来胜利吗？"

祭司挥了挥手，神情愈发轻蔑："在你看来，我刚刚那一番话，可能只是虚浮之辞；然而，我眼里，这番话的含义可就直白得多了 —— 我可不想再看到我的教众被丢进 Cruor 的矿坑里，沦为劣等魔鬼路西法的祭品。"

entries.en:
A shifty official meets your shuttle on the landing pad. Behind him, you spot temporary weapon emplacements and shield modules stamped with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Pale conscripts in battered armor eye you warily while they suck down narcotic smoke.

The official produces a trembling facsimile of a smile and looks you up and down.

"A, a pilgrim are you?" he asks unconvincingly. "I'm afraid the shrine is closed today. And tomorrow. Security concerns. The situation has been... unstable."
entries.zh:
一名狡诈的官员在停机坪上看见了你的穿梭机。在他身后，你看到贴着 辛达强权 徽标的临时武器阵地和护盾模块。面色苍白的征召兵穿着破烂不堪的护甲，一边吸着麻醉烟，一边警惕地盯着你。

这名官员挤出一个像传真画面那样缺乏真实感的笑容，上下打量着你。

"啊，你是个朝圣者？" 他的话听起来没有什么说服力，"恐怕圣地今天，以及明天，都不会开张。这是出于安全考虑，毕竟局势一直...不太稳定。"

entries.en:
A datapad appears in the official's hand and he looks, squinting to get a read on you. Are you a plant from internal security, a terrorist infiltrator? The options weigh on his face against his greed.

It's no contest.
entries.zh:
一个数据平板出现在这名官员手中，他看了看平板，眯眼打量着你。到底该认定你为内部安全部的坐探，还是打成恐怖主义渗透者？他心里经历着一番天人交战。

结果毫无疑问。

entries.en:
"Oh, oh oh, it is so difficult. The terrorists strike without warning, at women and children and... oh, I am thankful for the Lion. A lesser man would simply bombard this planet into submission, but the Supreme Executor? These are his children, and he is like a father. But even a father only has s-so many resources at his disposal... why, if we had the credits to purchase better armor for our brave young soldiers," he indicates the smoking conscripts, now having a spitting contest off the side of the landing platform.

"Imagine how their mothers would feel if they were hurt by a terrorist bomb..."
entries.zh:
"唉，唉，唉！世事艰难啊！针对妇女儿童的恐怖袭击突如其来，以及...噢，我真心感谢那位 雄狮。卑劣之徒只会肆无忌惮地轰炸这个行星来镇压我们，但若是 最高元首？他真是爱民如子，待我们如父亲一般。但即便是他也只有这么点物资可供调用...为何如此啊，若我们有更多的星币，来给我们勇武的年轻战士们采购更好的护甲..." 他指着那些吞云吐雾的征召兵们 —— 他们正在停机坪边上举行吐痰大赛。

"想象一下，要是这些战士被恐怖袭击所害，他们的母亲又会作何感想..."

o.en: Heartbroken, I'm sure. I'll be leaving now.
o.zh: 我敢肯定她们会心碎不已。那么，我先走了。

entries.en: His datapad disappears into his coat. "Responding to such c-comments is beneath my dignity," the official says with little enthusiasm.
entries.zh: 他把数据平板塞回外套，"回应这些...议...议论，简直是侮辱我的尊严。" 他冷冰冰地说道。

entries.en: "5,000 credits," the official shoots back.
entries.zh: "5,000 星币。" 这名官员开始坐地起价。

o.en: What are you feeding those kids, Volturnian lobster?
o.zh: 你给孩子们吃什么伙食啊，Volturn 蓝龙虾吗？

entries.en: "It's a deal," the official says, excreting a wet smile, offering his datapad for your payment confirmation.
entries.zh: "成交。" 官员一边说着一边挤出了满脸的淫笑，拿出他的数据平板来让你付款。

entries.en: "It's a deal," the official says, excreting a wet smile, offering his datapad for your payment confirmation.
entries.zh: "成交。" 官员一边说着一边挤出了满脸的淫笑，拿出他的数据平板来让你付款。

entries.en:
With the bribe transferred, the official nods and leads you through the security checkpoint while making obsequious smalltalk.

"At attention!" he screams, setting the conscripts into a flurry of activity, dropping narcotic-sticks and grabbing firearms.
entries.zh:
收到贿赂之后，官员点了点头，一边带你通过安检一边美言于你。

"立正！" 他大喊道，引发了一系列慌乱的举动 —— 征召兵们迅速丢下麻醉烟，然后抬起枪。

entries.en:
A datapad appears in the official's hand and he looks, squinting, between you and it several times.

"M-my humblest apologies, $playerSirOrMadam," the official stutters, "I should have been notified, made preparations," he looks around scattershot until his gaze catches on the conscripts.
entries.zh:
这位官员拿出一个数据平板，他反复抬头在你和数据平板之间来回比较。

"我，我衷心向您道歉，$playerSirOrMadam，" 军官结巴道，"我早该得知并且提前做好准备的，"他左顾右盼，最后盯在了征召兵的身上。

entries.en:
"At attention!" he screams, setting off a flurry of activity, dropping narco-sticks and firearms raised at salute.

"Please, please," the official says, leading you past the now at-attention conscripts and through the checkpoint. As you pass, the official speaks loudly about the respect due to an officer, whether merely in the municipal guard or fighting in the auxiliary fleets.
entries.zh:
"立正！"他大喊到，引发了一系列慌乱的举动 —— 丢下麻醉烟，然后抬起枪，再接着是敬礼。

"您请，您请！" 官员说着，带你走过这些立正的征召兵身旁，穿过了检查站。你走过去的时候，这名官员还在冲他们高谈阔论 —— 下至市政卫队，上至辅助军舰队，无论身处何处都必须尊敬长官云云。

entries.en:
"Hrm," the official rubs his hands together, "Your devotion to that quaint religion is not in doubt. It is simply that, ah, the Supreme Executor must be... reassured of the loyalty of the more, more... Luddic members of his empire before he allows them to return here."

The official's eyes are moist, but not from any compassion you can sense, "He yearns to allow free worship, but each time the Lion allows his compassion to guide his judgment it is, is abused." The official opens his hands apologetically.
entries.zh:
"嗯，" 这名军官搓了搓手，"你对这个古雅教派的虔诚毋庸置疑。只不过，呃，最高元首 必须...确认一下，他帝国中越来越多的...卢德成员的忠诚，然后才能允许他们回到这里。"

这名官员双眼湿润，但你感觉那不是因为同情，"他是渴望容许信仰自由的，但每当那位 雄狮 让恻隐之心影响了自己的判断，他的仁慈便会遭到滥用。" 官员抱歉地张开了自己的手。

o.en: If only these people would respect law and order.
o.zh: 要是这些人尊重法律和秩序就好了。

entries.en: "Yes, of course!" the official says, nodding.
entries.zh: "当然没错！" 官员说着点了点头。

entries.en: "A community must learn, learn together to respect the vision of the Supreme Executor. And once they do, they can rest assured that his glorious plan may proceed- to the benefit of all!"
entries.zh: "全社会必须学习，共同学习贯彻最高元首的伟大愿景。一旦他们做到了，就可高枕无忧，因为他光荣的计划将会推进下去 —— 直至造福万民！"

entries.en: "Precisely!" the official says, nodding agreement for you.
entries.zh: "正是如此！"官员一边说着，一边对你点头表示赞同。

entries.en: "Perhaps it may seem that way," the official says, appearing to examine you for subversive elements. "But it's for the best."
entries.zh: "也许事情看起来是那样，" 官员说到，像在考察你是否有破坏意图，"但这是最好的办法。"

entries.en: "Indeed," the official says, shaking his head with something unlike sadness.
entries.zh: "的确，" 官员一边说着，一边摇头，但不像是心怀悲伤的样子。

entries.en:
You return to your shuttle, taking a final breath of sea-air, the stink of rotten material that's encrusted itself on these platforms still in your nostrils.

The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful.
entries.zh:
你回到了你的穿梭机，最后一次呼吸这里的海风。在这些平台上，腐烂的污秽已经开始结垢，恶臭残留在你的鼻腔之中。

搭乘穿梭机返航的过程一切顺利。

entries.en:
You lean in closer, hardening your expression. The official, confused but intrigued, follows your cue and leans in.

You demand, on his life, to know if he is a true follower of Admiral Philip Andrada, Supreme Executor; The Lion of Sindria; the leader of a great movement to purge degeneration from the system while constructing a new, proud Persean people to populate the Sector.

"Y-yes, of course," he says, trembling.

Then he must let you, a secret agent of the Lion's Guard, perform your mission.

"I'll have to... to confirm..." He starts fumbling for his datapad.
entries.zh:
你靠上前去，神情越发坚毅。这名官员虽然有些困惑，但还是好奇地遵照你暗示靠了过来。

你要他以自己的性命发誓，告诉你他是否真正追随 Philip Andrada 上将，最高元首，辛达瑞亚之狮；那位肃清星域中的堕落，并以骄傲的新英仙人民取而代之的伟大领袖。

"是...是的，当然了。"他颤抖着说到。

那他就必须让你 —— 一名 狮心卫队 的秘密探员 —— 履行自己的使命。

"我必须...必须请示一下..." 他开始胡乱摸索他的数据平板。

o.en: That would be a terrible error.

entries.en:
You put a hand out and firmly lower his datapad while maintaining eye contact.

"That would inform the traitors who have infiltrated," you spit at his feet, "-what passes for local security. I should have you shot."
entries.zh:
维持着四目相接的状态，你伸出一只手稳稳地按住了他的数据平板。

"那只会让已经渗透进来的叛徒知道..." 你冲着他的脚啐了一口，"...你们这些所谓的本地安保都是什么货色。我早应该把你枪毙了。"

entries.en:
"I am loyal, I am loyal!" he shouts, sweat rolling down his face, "I swear it!"

He nearly sobs, suppresses the response, then asks in a small voice, "Is this... a test? Who sent..."
entries.zh:
"我是忠诚的，我是忠诚的！" 他大喊着，冷汗从脸上滑落，"我发誓！"

他几乎是呜咽着把自己的反应压了下去，然后用小声询问道："这是否...是一次考验？敢问是哪位派您来..."

o.en: From the top. The very top. Essential mission. Need-to-know.
o.zh: 是上级的意思，最上级。头等要务。你需要知道的就这么多。

entries.en:
The official pales, then whispers "The Supreme-"

You cut him off by raising a finger.

He nods vigorously, flinging sweat. Blind loyalty fills his eyes.

"Yes. Yes, of course. You need to access... but of course. Taking care of the Luddic problem, the terrorists and- I knew it, I knew there was a plan! I'll tell no one. You can count on me."
entries.zh:
官员脸色一变，悄声道："最高元..."

你竖起一根手指，打断了他的话。

他兴奋地点头，汗如雨下，盲目的忠诚充斥了他的双眼。

"是！明白！您需要通行权限...但当然了，要处理卢德信徒问题，那些恐怖分子和...我就知道，我就知道阁下必有计划！我绝不会泄露分毫，请您相信我！"

entries.en:
The official nods, smooths out his uniform, then turns to the conscripts. "At attention!" he screams, sending them into a flurry of activity, dropping narcotic-sticks and grabbing for firearms.

He then marches proudly toward the shrine entrance, halts with a clack of boot-heel, and pivots - all in passable parade form.
entries.zh:
官员点了点头，理顺他的制服，然后转身面朝征召兵们。"立正！" 他大喊道，引发了一系列慌乱的举动 —— 他们迅速丢下麻醉烟，然后抬起枪。

他之后得意地迈向圣地入口，脚跟咯吱一声停顿，而后旋转。所有这些动作都是按阅兵级别执行的。

o.en: Perhaps a donation to local security forces will help?
o.zh: 或许为本地安全机构进行一笔捐赠会有所帮助？

o.en: Explain that you are commissioned by the Sindrian Diktat
o.zh: 解释说你和 辛达强权 之间有雇佣协议

o.en: I must visit the shrine. I'm quite devout.
o.zh: 我一定要去圣地朝拜。我十分虔诚。

o.en: Explain that you are on a secret mission from the Supreme Executor (lie)
o.zh: 解释说你正在执行最高元首的秘密任务 (说谎)

o.en: I would like to visit the shrine.

entries.en:
"I see," the official says, arms crossed. "It pains me to inform you that a visit is... quite impossible."

You reflect that he doesn't sound particularly pained, and it appears to be quite possible if he just let you walk through the doors.
entries.zh:
"我明白了，" 这名官员抱着手臂说到，"我很苦恼地告知您，想要参观是...完全不可能的。"

你思索了一番 —— 他听起来并没有特别苦恼，看起来也完全可以让你直接通过。

entries.en:
"Was a raid," he says. "The Sindies got some word somehow. They say some informer told 'em there was a weapons cache."

He seems to gain confidence as he revisits a simmering anger.

"Never saw anything like that, but the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is, Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly just regular walkers."
entries.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲这儿藏了批武器。"

一回到这桩憋着火的事上，他胆子倒像是壮了些。

"那种东西我从没见过，可辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说当时有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半只是普通行者。"

o.zh: 出了什么事？有人逃出来吗？

entries.en:
"Was a raid," he says. "The Sindies got some word somehow. They say some informer told 'em there was a weapons cache."

He makes a nervous glance over his shoulder, though he seems gain confidence as he revisit what is clearly the source of simmering anger.

"Never saw anything like that, but the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is, Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly just regular walkers."
entries.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲这儿藏了批武器。"

他紧张地回头瞥了一眼，可一回到这桩显然还憋着火的事上，胆子倒像是壮了些。

"那种东西我从没见过，可辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说当时有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半只是普通行者。"

o.zh: 出了什么事？有人逃出来吗？

entries.en:
"All dead. Must have been quick."

The laborer clutches their hands together again, like some instinct to pray.

"I... I gotta go, boss." They turn away, and pause to look back. "Ludd's peace to you."

The laborer disappears, leaving you and your bodyguards on the charred platform. A cold drizzle begins to fall.
entries.zh:
"全死了。应该没受什么罪。"

劳工又把双手攥在一起，像是出于某种祷告的本能。

"我... 我得走了，老板。\" 他们转身，又回头望了一眼，\"愿卢德赐你平安。"

劳工没了踪影，留你和几名护卫站在焦黑的平台上。冷雨淅淅沥沥落了下来。

entries.en:
"All dead. Must have been quick."

The laborer clutches their hands together again, like some instinct to pray.

"I... I should go, boss. We never met," he turns away, then pauses. "Ludd's peace to you."

The laborer disappears, leaving you and your bodyguards on the charred platform. A cold drizzle begins to fall.
entries.zh:
"全死了。应该没受什么罪。"

劳工又把双手攥在一起，像是出于某种祷告的本能。

"我... 我得走了，老板。咱们没见过面，\" 他转身，又顿住，\"愿卢德赐你平安。"

劳工没了踪影，留你和几名护卫站在焦黑的平台上。冷雨淅淅沥沥落了下来。

entries.en:
The flight in your return shuttle is uneventful.

You are keenly aware of the thin envelope of technology protecting you from the ravages of vacuum and radiation.
entries.zh:
返程的穿梭机上一路无事。

你格外清楚地意识到，隔着真空与辐射的肆虐护住你的，不过是薄薄一层技术外壳。

entries.en:
You step forward over the plates, and see in the center of the platform's main deck an enormous hole which opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads, though muffled. There is a collection of candles set here, some lit, others are dark, with water collected in the divits burnt into the paraffin.

The subcurate notes your gaze.

"Blessed peace," he says in a rough voice, though softly. "Would you like to light a candle for someone?"

Despite the somewhat threadbare robes of a subcurate, you note that the man could be a laborer, maybe a low-status tech. Weathered face, scarred hands.
entries.zh:
你踩着补板走上前，看见平台主甲板中央有一个巨大的窟窿，朝底下幽暗的海敞开。浪头拍打外壁舱板的声响闷闷地传来。这儿摆着一堆蜡烛，有的亮着，有的熄了，烛泪凝出的小凹里积着水。

副助祭留意到了你的目光。

"愿平安与你同在，\" 他嗓音粗哑，却放得很轻，\"要为谁点一支蜡烛吗？"

副助祭的袍子虽有些寒酸，你却看出这人本可能是个劳工，或是身份低微的技术员。饱经风霜的脸，满是疤痕的手。

entries.en:
"It was a raid," he says. "The Sindies... the occupiers got word, somehow. It's said an informer told them there was a weapons cache in the shrine."

He indicates with his chin - the hole, the sea. A conspicuous and heavy absence.
entries.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬... 那些占领军，不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲圣地里面藏了批武器。"

他用下巴朝那边点了点 —— 那个窟窿，那片海。一块扎眼而沉重的空白。

o.en: Who are you? Is this the shrine?

entries.en:
"It was a raid," he says. "The Sindies... the occupiers got word, somehow. It's said an informer told them there was a weapons cache in the shrine."

He indicates with his chin - the hole, the sea. A conspicuous and heavy absence.
entries.zh:
"是场突袭，\" 他说，\"辛达佬... 那些占领军，不知从哪儿得了消息。听说是有人告密，讲圣地里面藏了批武器。"

他用下巴朝那边点了点 —— 那个窟窿，那片海。一块扎眼而沉重的空白。

o.en: Who are you? What happened to the shrine?

entries.en:
"I'm called Simon," he says with a glance at you. "Came back after the committee said things were over. Took care of the place. They gave me a title, robes. Guess I found the calling late in life."

"And that," he kicks a foot forward, "was the shrine."

He's quiet for a moment. But he wants to tell the story.

"As I hear it, the Sindies, they shot their way in. Set demolition charges, pulled back, and blew it. Word is Faithful were sheltering in the deeps, in the old access tubes. Some VSDC, but mostly regular walkers."
entries.zh:
"我叫 Simon，\" 他看了你一眼，\"委员会宣布事情了结之后，我回来了，照看这地方。他们给了个头衔，一身袍子。大概我这辈子悟道得晚吧。"

"至于那个，\" 他抬脚往前点了点，\"就是圣地了。"

他沉默了片刻。可他想要讲出这段往事。

"我听说是这样，辛达佬硬是打了进来。埋好炸药，撤出去，然后引爆。听说有信徒躲在深处、旧检修管道里。有几个 VSDC 的人，不过多半是普通行者。"

entries.en:
"Not any who was down there, no," he says. "But the whole district was full of VSDC at the height of the fighting."

"Are you looking for someone in particular?"
entries.zh:
"待在下面的，没有，\" 他说，\"不过打得最凶那阵子，整个街区到处都是 VSDC 的人。"

"你是在找什么特定的人吗？"

o.en: A curate sacraria. Who keeps the shrine.
o.zh: 是位司祭，掌管圣龛、看护这处圣地。

o.en: No. I came for the shrine.
o.zh: 不。我是为这处圣地而来。

entries.en:
"Not any who was down there, no," he says. "But the whole district was full of VSDC at the height of the fighting."

"Are you looking for someone in particular?"
entries.zh:
"待在下面的，没有，\" 他说，\"不过打得最凶那阵子，整个街区到处都是 VSDC 的人。"

"你是在找什么特定的人吗？"

o.zh: 是那位司祭，Moyra Standfast，掌管圣龛。

o.en: No. I came for the shrine.
o.zh: 不。我是为这处圣地而来。

entries.en: "This is it," he says.
entries.zh: "就这样了，" 他说道。

entries.en:
Simon gives you a look, then turns back to contemplating the missing shrine.

"Well, this is it."
entries.zh:
Simon 看了你一眼，又转回去凝望那已不复存在的圣地。

"嗯，就这样了。"

entries.en:
Simon gives you a look, then turns back to his contemplation.

"Standfast was her name. Don't think people are quite agreed about whether she was down there or not. When it happened, I mean. Lots of folks went away, and lots came back after the... the resolution. We've been rebuilding."

He shrugs, hands still held together.
entries.zh:
Simon 看了你一眼，又转回自己的沉思里。

"她叫 Standfast。事发那会儿她到底在不在下面，大家至今也没个一致的说法。我是说出事的时候。好些人逃走了，等...等事情了结，又回来了不少。我们一直在重建。"

他耸了耸肩，双手仍合握在一起。

entries.en:
Simon gives you a look, then turns back to his contemplation.

"Don't think people are quite agreed about whether she was down there or not. When it happened, I mean. Lots of folks went away, and lots came back after the... the resolution. We've been rebuilding."

He shrugs, almost sheepish, hands still held together.

"I pray for her."
entries.zh:
Simon 看了你一眼，又转回自己的沉思里。

"她到底在不在下面，大家至今也没个一致的说法。我是说出事的时候。好些人逃走了，等...等事情了结，又回来了不少。我们一直在重建。"

他耸了耸肩，几乎有些局促，双手仍合握在一起。

"我为她祷告。"

entries.en:
The shifty official meets your shuttle on the landing pad. Behind him, you spot temporary weapon emplacements and shield modules stamped with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Pale conscripts in battered armor eye you warily while they suck down narcotic smoke.

"At attention!" the official screams to the conscripts as he comes to greet you. "I haven't told," he whispers, drawing too close. "And if you need anything, anything, to root out these Luddie terrorists...." he leaves it unsaid, looking for approval in your eyes.

You endure obsequious smalltalk as he escorts you through the checkpoint and to the heavy doors leading toward the shrine.
entries.zh:
一名狡诈的官员在停机坪上看见了你的穿梭机。在他身后，你看到贴着 辛达强权 徽标的临时武器阵地和护盾模块。面色苍白的征召兵穿着破烂不堪的护甲，一边吸着麻醉烟，一边警惕地盯着你。

"立正！" 这名官员来接见你时，对着征召兵们大声喊道。接着他对你悄声耳语，距离近的有些过头："我刚刚还没说，如果您需要任何东西，任何！来铲除这些卢德恐怖分子..." 他没再继续说下去，只是期望从你眼中看到一丝认可。

你忍耐着他的阿谀奉承，随他通过了检查站，来到了通往圣地的沉重门扉。

entries.en: Satisfied, the official gives a wave and the thrum of heavy motors winding up preludes the doors of the shrine cracking open just enough to allow your entrance.
entries.zh: 军官满意地挥了挥手，身后立刻传来了重型马达的轰鸣声；圣地的大门随即开了一条小缝 —— 只够你一人入内。

entries.en:
The receiving hall is empty of pilgrims, and mostly dark. Hand-sewn banners hang limply, their bright colors muted in the gloom. Benches and tables lay empty.

You spot a light through a small doorway. The humble office of the curate sacraria, and within, an old woman asleep behind a pot of tea, still steaming, set out on the desk.
entries.zh:
接待大厅一片漆黑，一个朝圣者的影子都没有。抬头望去，手制的横幅无力地悬挂在上面，靓丽的颜色在昏暗中显得黯淡无光。环视内部，大厅中的桌椅全都空着。

你在一个门缝里看到一束光。在神龛祭司那简陋的办公室里面，一个老妇人正睡着，她身前的桌子上还放着一壶冒着热气的茶。

o.en: Cough, scuff your boot; wake her up unobtrusively
o.zh: 咳嗽出声，把靴子往地上蹭，不着痕迹地叫醒她

o.en: Hello! I'd like the see the shrine!
If the tea is that hot, you can't really be asleep.
o.zh: 茶这么热，你不可能是真的睡着了。

entries.en:
As you step in, she opens her eyes and after getting a good look, withdraws a pistol from where she held it under her mantle of hand-weave and places it in a holster.

"I could hardly shoot someone trying to be so polite about sneaking up on an old woman," she says, examining your uniform.
entries.zh:
当你走进房间正打算叫醒她的时候，她睁开了双眼，从手织的斗篷下抽出手枪，并把它收回了枪套。

"明明是在悄悄靠近我这老太婆，却又表现得这么礼貌，真让我一时不好开枪。" 她一边说着，一边打量着你的制服。

entries.en:
She sighs at your outburst and opens her eyes - she seems too composed to have been truly sleeping - then withdraws the pistol which was held under her hand-weave and places it in a holster.

"I can hardly shoot you for interrupting the nap I wasn't having, now can I," she says.
entries.zh:
察觉到你的突然来访，妇人叹了口气，一边睁开了眼睛 —— 她冷静异常，看来根本没睡。然后，她从手织的斗篷下抽出手枪，并把它插回了枪套。

"我会枪毙那些打扰我小憩的家伙，" 她说道，"只是这次我没在打盹，自然也不好朝你开枪，不是吗？"

entries.en:
As you step to the desk and pour a cup, she lets her eyes open and withdraws a pistol from her hand-weave.

This she places in a holster.

"I'll hardly shoot you for being presumptuous over a cup of tea. So yes, do help yourself."
entries.zh:
正当你走到桌前并倒了杯茶时，她睁开双眼，从手织的斗篷下面抽出手枪 ——

然后，她把枪插回了枪套。

"我可不至于因为你自作主张倒了杯茶就给你来上一枪。没事了，请自便吧。"

entries.en:
She smiles as she withdraws the pistol she was holding beneath her hand-weave, opens her eyes, then places the pistol in a holster.

"Observant. If you're a goon, then I must say you're a higher grade than the usual. How may I serve?"
entries.zh:
妇人微微一笑，一边从手织的斗篷下抽出手枪，她睁开眼，然后把枪插回了枪套。

"还挺敏锐。如果你也是辛达的打手，那你至少比起常见的那种级别高些。有何贵干？"

entries.en:
Not quite an hour later, you find yourself at the bottom of the sea, in the Luddic shrine of Volturn. It is a creaking and unnervingly humid inspection module at the end of a modified extraction stack; a metal proboscis thrust into the depths of Volturn.

It is also filled with guns, explosives, grenades, cellmags. Crates and racks are piled high, making the small space more cramped. A small shrine is set in an open space under a round diamond-matrix viewport which holds back a titanic mass of water. A few candles struggle to maintain even a decent flicker among the ranks of their dead comrades.

There are pilgrims here, of a sort. Their unwashed bodies smell of sweat and smoke, they speak and pray quietly. The curate sacraria re-lights a candle from one that is burning, and offers one for you to do the same.
entries.zh:
不到一小时，你已深入海底，抵达 Volturn 的卢德 圣地。那是一个潮湿的探测舱室，位于改良型钻井的末端，嘎吱作响，令人不安，如同刺入 Volturn 深处的长喙。

这里还填满了枪支，炸药，榴弹，弹匣。板条箱和架子高高堆起，让本就狭小的空间愈发拥挤。那圆形的金刚石观察窗，将亿万吨水体阻隔在外，其下的空地上布置着一个小小的圣地。一些蜡烛在它们那一排排熄灭的同道之中挣扎着，闪烁出恰到好处的微光。

这里有一些勉强算是朝圣者的人，他们安静地交谈和祈祷着，未经清洗的身躯散发着汗水和烟熏的气息。神龛祭司用已燃的烛火点亮了另一支，也给你一支让你跟上。

entries.en:
The curate leads you to the back of an entry hall and pulls back a heavy curtain. The metal rings attaching it to a rail above clatter, dropping flakes of rust.

Perhaps this is a shrine of humility?

It is a small thing set in the back of a back room, rows of candles are arrayed around the wooden centerpiece carved with images of Ludd's travails. The candles are all dead, but the place is illuminated by dim shafts of light let in by grimy portholes.

"We do not have many visitors, you see," the curate says.
entries.zh:
祭司带你来到门厅后面，拉开一片帷幕。幕布上方滑轨的铁环哗啦作响，锈斑寸寸剥落。

或许，这里是代表谦卑的圣地？

那是一个小物件，安置在里屋的后方。一排排蜡烛环绕着中心的木雕，其上镌刻着卢德的艰苦历程。烛火早已尽数熄灭，但透过那蒙尘的舷窗，一缕幽光依旧笼罩着这个地方。

"如你所见，这里算是无人问津了。" 祭司说到。

o.en: Take a shuttle to visit the Luddic shrine
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前去拜访卢德圣地

o.en: Take a shuttle to visit the Luddic shrine
o.zh: 乘坐穿梭机前去拜访卢德圣地

entries.en:
You are met outside by a jittery-looking local laborer. Not one of the two, from before.

He puts his hands together and nods at you, watery eyes nervously darting to your bodyguards.
entries.zh:
出来时，一名神色惶惶的本地劳工迎上你。不是先前那两人中的一个。

他双手合十，朝你点了点头，水汪汪的眼睛紧张地在你几名护卫身上打转。

entries.en: A shard from a familiar teapot crunches beneath your boot.
entries.zh: 一个熟悉的茶壶碎片在你脚下嘎吱作响。

entries.en:
Curate Sacraria Standfast greets you with tea inside the echoing receiving hall before escorting you down to the inner shrine.

You enter the creaking, humid inspection module at the end of a modified extraction stack where the shrine is housed, against all reason. Crates and racks of weapons and ammunition are piled high, crowding the pilgrims/insurgents. Their unwashed bodies smell of sweat and smoke. They speak and pray quietly.
entries.zh:
在回音袅袅的接待大厅之中，神龛祭司 Standfast 备好茶水接待了你，然后护送你前往内部的 圣地。

尽管这不合常理，你还是进入了圣地。它安置在一个潮湿的探测舱室，位于改良型钻井的末端，嘎吱作响。塞满武器弹药的板条箱和架子高高堆起，朝圣者和义军摩肩接踵。他们安静地交谈和祈祷着，未经清洗的身躯散发着汗水和烟熏的气息。

那圆形的金刚石观察窗，将海洋深处那粉碎性的重压阻隔在外，其下的空地上布置着圣地的核心。一些蜡烛在它们那一排排熄灭的同道之中挣扎着，闪烁出恰到好处的微光。一如既往，用已燃的烛火点亮了另一支，也给你一支让你跟上。

entries.en: You light the candle from one that still burns, bringing one of its companions back to life and carrying on its flame.
entries.zh: 你用已燃的烛火点亮了另一支，让它的一位同伴起死回生，薪火相传。

entries.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is empty, as lonely as a coffin that never embraced the corpse for which it was constructed.

The receiving hall is pocked and scorched by more weapons-fire. Lighter here. Handheld arms. Rusty pools of dank water on the floor mingle with suspicious rusty stains.

It smells of salt and rot and smoke.

An enormous hole opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads, though muffled. Someone's left candles here, though they're cold and dark and have gathered small pools of water inside the divits burnt into the paraffin.
entries.zh: 圣地里空无一人，接待大厅里布满了弹孔与烧蚀的痕迹，很明显这是由武器开火造成的。这里的空气混杂着盐味，烟味，还有一股腐败的味道，地板上阴湿的水坑里混杂着可疑的铁锈色痕迹。

entries.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is not quite empty, as a humbly-robed subcurate greets you with a half-bow, and a quiet word lost in the distorted susurration of waves and wind.

Your eyes roam over the interior of the receiving hall, noting the pocks and scorch of more weapons-fire. Lighter here. Handheld arms. Artfully arranged hull-patch plates form a walkway through the rusty pools of water mingling with suspicious rusty stains.

Under the incense, it smells of salt and smoke. A hint of rot.
entries.zh:
圣地的前厅并不算空，一位衣着朴素谦卑的副助祭欠身相迎，低声说了句什么，淹没在浪涛与风声扭曲的沙沙里。

你的目光扫过接待大厅内里，又留意到更多武器开火留下的弹痕与焦灼。这里要轻些，是手持武器。几块船壳补板被巧妙地铺成一条小径，穿过混着可疑锈色污渍的锈水洼。

熏香底下，是盐味、烟味，还有一丝腐坏的气息。

entries.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is warm and well-lit, and lined with patchwork repairs, the walls a hand-built mosaic of corroded metal, ceramic, and plastic.

After a moment you recognize that it is a mural executed in a palette of rust and ruin, a crudely rendered scene of nature - and there, Ludd, an ambigious figure suggested by a ragged silhouette.

It smells still of salt and smoke, but handweave carpeting softens the receiving hall.

Simon the subcurate greets you with a half-bow and an offering of the briny tea of Volturn.
entries.zh:
圣地的前厅暖意融融，灯火通明，四壁打满补丁，是用锈蚀的金属、陶瓷与塑料手工拼成的一幅镶嵌画。

片刻之后你才认出，那是一幅以锈色与残败为调子绘成的壁画，拙朴地描着一处自然景致 —— 而那儿，是卢德，一个由参差剪影勾出的、模棱两可的身影。

空气里依旧是盐味与烟味，但手工织就的地毯让接待大厅柔和了些。

副助祭 Simon 欠身向你行礼，奉上一杯 Volturn 的咸茶。

entries.en:
The antechamber of the shrine is not quite empty, as a humbly-robed subcurate greets you with a half-bow, and a quiet word lost in the distorted susurration of waves and wind.

Your eyes roam over the interior of the receiving hall, noting the pocks and scorch of more weapons-fire. Lighter here. Handheld arms. Artfully arranged hull-patch plates form a walkway through the rusty pools of water mingling with suspicious rusty stains.

Under the incense, it smells of salt and smoke. A hint of rot.
