$post 此言是对$hisOrHer的船员所说，而非对你。随后，通讯链接在噼啪作响中化作一片雪花，最后一幕是双手合十的短暂祈祷画面。

entries.en:
The link flickers open and the conversation begins poorly.

"Befouler, defiler, sinful spite-God! Demoniac!"

The look of rage and religious mania pulls the $post's face into a devilish mask as $heOrShe shouts.
entries.zh:
通讯链接在闪烁中开启，对话在开始便充满敌意。

"玷污者，亵渎者，罪孽的邪神！恶魔化身！"

$heOrShe咆哮着，狂怒与宗教狂热使这位 $post 面容扭曲，形成一副如同魔鬼般的面具。

entries.en:
"What work-of-Moloch $shipOrFleet appears in our skies? What unholy combination of human craft and... and abomination? You are to be destroyed on sight, accursed by God and all who are faithful!"

$HeOrShe desperately clasps $hisOrHer hands together and prays. "Blessed Ludd, give me strength when the evil one appears..."

Targeting alerts chime from your tactical officer's console.
entries.zh:
"何等莫洛克造物$shipOrFleet竟出现在我们的空域中？这渎神的人造工艺与... 与畸形之物的结合？你这被神与所有信众诅咒的存在，应当格杀勿论！"

$heOrShe绝望地合掌祈祷。"卢德护佑啊，当邪魔显现时请赐予我力量..."

目标锁定的警报声从你战术军官的控制台传来。

o.en: Cut the link and take evasive action

entries.en:
Your comms officer calls for your attention.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. There's an incoming comms request, marked urgent, from the portwatcher. They want to speak with you personally."
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官对你示意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。港区监视者发来一条紧急通讯请求，要求与您本人通话。"

entries.en:
Your comms officer calls for your attention.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. There's an incoming comms request, marked urgent, from the station commander. They want to speak with you personally."
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官对你示意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。空间站指挥官发来一条紧急通讯请求，要求与您本人通话。"

entries.en:
"Perhaps your soul is not yet lost to the machine," $heOrShe says cheerfully. "It is possible your sins may be forgiven without the purge of holy fire."
OR
"Truly, Ludd's hand has guided you," the Pather says, wiping a tear from $hisOrHer eye.
entries.zh:
"你的灵魂尚未完全迷失在机械之中。" $heOrShe欣喜地说到，"你的罪业未必经历圣焰焚身即可获得宽恕。"
OR
"诚然，卢德之手引导了你。" 这个左径分子边说着，边从$hisOrHer的眼角抹去了一滴眼泪。

entries.en:
"Well," the Pather says haltingly. "Despite our grand talk and how blessed and bountiful our path together could be... Providence only provides to those of us who know to accept the gift laid before them - and to those who humble themselves with a tithe appropriate to the magnitude of their sin."

$HisOrHer quickly glances down at a screen then back to you, "Which would be, ah, on the order of $entity.LP_titheDGS credits."
entries.zh:
"好吧。" 这个左径分子有些犹豫地说到，"尽管我们说得天花乱坠，称我们携手同行的道途会是多么蒙福而丰盛....但上天只眷顾那些懂得接受摆在面前的恩赐的人 —— 以及那些愿以与其罪孽相称的什一税来谦卑己身的人。"

$HisOrHer飞快地瞥了一眼屏幕，然后又望向你，"而这份罪业，啊，恰好等价于 $entity.LP_titheDGS 星币。"

entries.en:
"My thanks to Providence!" the $rank exclaims, then calls back to $hisOrHer bridge crew, "Persecution proves our devotion! The unbelievers now beg us to share our blessings." $HeOrShe turns back, troubled, "Um. However. My standing is... limited. It is not my place to welcome you to the fold under our hammer and sword, no matter the tithe you offer unto our holy war. You will have to speak with a shepherd of greater authority than I at one of our gathering-places in the fringe worlds."

"Of course," $heOrShe is abashed now, "I cannot tell you where a station of the Luddic Path is located. I am pledged before Providence to secrecy and it would be a sin to swear false oath. That path must be yours to discover."

"I suggest you pray for revelation," $heOrShe says earnestly.
entries.zh:
"赞美上天眷顾！" $rank 喊到，随后回过头去向$hisOrHer的舰桥船员说到，"迫害证明了我们的虔诚！不信者现在正恳求我们分享祝福。" $HeOrShe转了回来，似乎是有些困扰，"呃，但要怎么说呢，因为我的位置...有限，不管你要为我们的圣战事业贡献多少的什一税，我都无权以锤与剑的名义接纳你加入我们的教团。但你可以在我们位于边缘星区世界的某个集会所，找一位比我权威更高的牧师谈谈。"

"当然了，" $heOrShe现在显得有些惭愧，"我不能告诉你 卢德左径 的空间站具体在哪。我在上天面前立誓保密，而发假誓是罪过。那条路必须由你自己去发现。"

"我建议你为启示而祈祷。" $heOrShe真诚地说到。

entries.en:
The $rank's eyes light up at the suggestion of a larger 'tithe'. Struggling to maintain the fiction that this blackmail is a strictly religious matter, $heOrShe declares that $LP_megaTitheDGS credits could persuade Pather raiders to leave all of your colonies - but not fleets - alone for $LP_megaTitheDuration days.

"My brothers and sisters who have taken up arms are zealous, after all. Righteous passion drives them toward the field of battle, and credits are poor fare compared to the feast of divine justice," $heOrShe explains with the barest hint of apology.
entries.zh:
当听到你提出缴纳一笔更高的 "什一税" 时，这位 $rank 的眼睛亮了起来。$heOrShe竭力维持着这场勒索是纯粹的宗教事务的假象，并宣称如果支付 $LP_megaTitheDGS 星币，就能说服左径掠夺者们在 $LP_megaTitheDuration 天内不对你所有的殖民地 —— 但不包括舰队 —— 进行骚扰。

"毕竟，我那些拿起武器的兄弟姐妹们是充满热忱的。正义的激情驱使他们奔赴战场，与神圣正义的盛宴相比，星币不过是粗茶淡饭，" $heOrShe解释道，语气中带着一丝若有若无的歉意。

o.en: Perhaps we could share a more permanent - and bountiful - Path together?
o.zh: 或许我们可以一起相约走上一条更加长久 —— 并且更有前途的关系呢？
我需要考虑此事。 (暂时离开)

entries.en:
"Greetings $playerSirOrMadam," $Rank $personLastName says with a salute.

"If you require additional officers for your fleet operations I'm prepared to review some of our most promising candidates for your approval."
entries.zh:
"向您问好，$playerSirOrMadam，" $Rank $personLastName 敬了个礼。

"若您的舰队行动需要补充军官，我这就把几名最有前途的候选人都过一遍，供您定夺。"

entries.en:
"Greetings $playerSirOrMadam. I've located a few promising officer candidates and provided you with their comms IDs so you can find them in the local comm directory."

A pause, and then $heOrShe helpfully adds, "They're ready to be interviewed at your convenience."
entries.zh:
"向您问好，$playerSirOrMadam。我已物色到几名不错的军官候选人，并把他们的通讯识别码发给了您，在本地通讯名录里就能找到。"

顿了顿，$heOrShe 又殷勤地补上一句，"您什么时候方便，随时都能面试他们。"

o.en: I'm looking for officers with some... specific qualities.
o.zh: 我想找具备某些... 特质的军官。

entries.en:
"Naturally," $heOrShe says.

"What sort of disposition did you have in mind, $playerSirOrMadam?"
entries.zh:
"自然，" $heOrShe 说道。

"您想要哪种性子，$playerSirOrMadam？"

entries.en:
"Understood." $HeOrShe taps on a TriPad, then looks up.

"If you had particular skills in mind, I can further filter the candidate pool..."
entries.zh:
"明白。" $HeOrShe 在 TriPad 上点了几下，抬起头来。

"若您心里已有想挑的技能，我还能再筛一筛候选名单..."

entries.en:
"Excellent. I think I have a few candidates that may fulfill your requirements. I'll forward their comms IDs to your TriPad so you can find them in the local comm directory and perform interviews at your leisure."

"It's always a pleasure to place good talent, $playerSirOrMadam."
entries.zh:
"很好。我想有几位候选人应当合您的要求。我把他们的通讯识别码发到您的 TriPad 上，您到本地通讯名录里一查便知，什么时候面试都随您。"

"替好苗子谋个好位子，总是件快事，$playerSirOrMadam。"

entries.en:
The comm link buzzes and solidifies. $TheFactionLong $personRank looks upon you with loathing.

"I look now upon the face of a miserable villain who violates holy peace, who attacks defenseless pilgrims," $heOrShe seethes. "For what? To steal their crumbs?" $HeOrShe takes a deep breath, $hisOrHer anger threatening to disrupt $hisOrHer composure entirely.

"I consider your cruel opportunism a personal affront to my honor as a warrior. My orders are to hunt you down and destroy you, but know that I consider this a duel between an officer and an unscrupulous coward."

"Prepare your $shipOrFleet for combat, captain," $heOrShe spits. "Let us see how you do in a fair fight."
entries.zh:
通讯链接嗡鸣着稳定了下来。$TheFactionLong $personRank 厌恶地看向你。

"我面前是一亵渎神圣的和平，袭击手无寸铁朝圣者的恶徒。" $heOrShe愤怒地说道，"你有何所图？掠夺他们仅有的资产？" $HeOrShe深深吸了一口气，$hisOrHer的愤怒已经几乎完全耗尽了$hisOrHer的自制力。

"你残忍的投机行为是对我等战士之荣耀的亵渎。我的命令便是找到并摧毁你，但我个人将此看作一位军官和一个卑劣的懦夫之间的决斗。"

"让你的$shipOrFleet准备战斗，舰长。" $heOrShe唾骂道，"让咱们看看你怎么光明正大地战斗。"

entries.en:
"Well, well. Normally this is when I'd start shooting, but my sensors report some interesting cargo that I wouldn't want to endanger.

So, how about this: you give me the good stuff, and I let you live. And, since I'm in a generous mood, to also keep your $shipOrFleet. How about it?"
entries.zh:
"好了好了。换作平时我现在已经开炮了，但我的传感器发现了一些有趣的货物，我可不想弄坏了它们。

所以不如这样：你把你的好东西给我，我放你一条生路。而如果我心情不错的话，你还可以带着你的$shipOrFleet走。怎么样？"

entries.en: $PersonRank $personLastName looks pleased with your offer and cuts the comm link. After your crew pushes the required crates out the airlock, the pirate fleet allows you to disengage.
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personLastName 看起来对你的上贡很满意，并切断了通讯链接。当你的船员将所需的货物箱子推出气闸后，海盗舰队允许你离开了。

entries.en:
The comms flicker and spit, resolving into the frowning image of $post.

"The prey crawls before me," $heOrShe says, glaring. "Why should we believe what it has to say?"
entries.zh:
通讯画面闪烁不定，最终显出了眉头紧皱的 $post。

"猎物爬到了我跟前。" $heOrShe怒目说道，"我们凭什么要相信它说的话？"

entries.en:
The comms flicker and spit, resolving into the scowling image of $post.

"Look at you, prey. Writhing and lying and tricking to escape from our trap."

"We'll bleed you dry," $heOrShe hisses.
entries.zh:
通讯画面闪烁不定，最终显出了咬牙切齿的 $post。

"看看你这德行，猎物。想靠打滚撒谎糊弄我们把你从陷阱里放走。"

"我们将放干你的血。" $heOrShe嘶声说道。

entries.en:
"And an admirable fleet it is," $heOrShe admits, giving a moment of dainty applause. "But greater empires than yours have sent fleets to sweep away the rubbish, yes?"

$HeOrShe leans closer to the comm-interface, smile gone. "Believe me, captain, I have no desire for this to come to a fight. My crews... they have expectations. If I do not meet them, they will toss me out the airlock and find someone who will."

$HeOrShe sits back. "Heavy is the crown," $heOrShe mutters grimly.
entries.zh:
"是个值得敬佩的舰队。" $heOrShe承认到，轻轻地鼓了鼓掌。"但比你更加强大的帝国不也尝试过派舰队来扫清我们这些垃圾吗？"

$HeOrShe脸上的笑容消失了，他倾向通讯屏幕。" 相信我，舰长，我也不想变成一场战斗。我的伙计们... 他们对我是有要求的。要是我不能满足，他们自会把我扔出气阀另找他人。"

$HeOrShe再度坐下。"这王冠戴在头上可不轻啊。" $heOrShe冷冷地自言自语道。

entries.en:
"I'm afraid my compatriots will accept no less. In my position, I must... provide. A king who does not provide..."

A note of legitimate worry seems to have entered $hisOrHer voice. $HeOrShe tries to cover it by re-asserting a smug smile, but it is half-hearted at best.

"Come now; as the king of a gang yourself - whatever you want to call it - you understand. We are all shackled in a great chain from high to low and low to high. The weak must pledge what strength they have to the powerful so that they are not crushed."
entries.zh:
"可惜我的伙伴们没法接受更少了。在我这个位置的人得...养家。养不起部下的大王就会..."

$hisOrHer声音里似乎带上了一丝真心的担忧。虽然$HeOrShe试图透过狂妄的笑容来将其掩盖，其效果也只能说是事倍功半。

"好了；你自己也是个团伙还是什么鬼的大佬 —— 你懂得。我们都是上下受制于人，一条线上的蚂蚱。弱者必须尽力服侍强者，才能避免被其碾碎。"

o.en: You justify piracy with that nonsense?
o.zh: 你就用这种鬼话来为海盗行径开脱？
所以你觉得我软弱可欺。
所以你觉得我实力雄厚。

entries.en: $HeOrShe shrugs, smile wavering.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe耸了耸肩，笑容有些勉强。

entries.en:
"I, um." $HeOrShe realizes that $heOrShe has walked into a trap of $hisOrHer own making - and coughs, lamely.

"And possibly even among possible equals, each must contribute what they are best able, don't you agree? A few credits for protection, it's a fair trade."
entries.zh:
"我，呃。" $HeOrShe认识到自己的话把自己套进去了 —— $heOrShe无力地咳嗽了一声。

"就算在平等的两人之间，双方也得尽量做到彼此应做的，不是吗？用一点星币来换取保护，这是公平交易。"

entries.en:
The pirate pulls a bottle of something from behind $hisOrHer comms console, and lifts it up.

"To our mutual betterment!" $heOrShe declares, then takes a long glug. $HeOrShe slams the bottle on the console, and wipes $hisOrHer mouth with $hisOrHer sleeve, not quite suppressing a belch.

And with that it seems that your 'arrangement' is sealed.
entries.zh:
海盗从$hisOrHer的通讯台后面拿出来了一瓶什么东西，将其举了起来。

"庆祝咱们互利互助！" $heOrShe宣布道，随即喝了一大口那瓶子里的东西。$HeOrShe把瓶子拍在桌上，用$hisOrHer的袖口擦了擦嘴，但还是没能止住一个酒嗝。

这么一来，你们的 '协议' 就证实签订了。

o.en: 10 percent is too much. Be reasonable.
An outrageous demand! You can see the power of my $shipOrFleet from where you sit.
o.zh: 无理的要求！你就坐在那看看我$shipOrFleet的厉害吧。

entries.en:
"So we do, so we do. It is pleasing that you've decided to be civilized about it," the pirate puts on a self-satisfied smile.

"The fringe is dangerous!" $heOrShe explains, "And my people hungry. I propose that you provide me with 10% of the gross income of your colony. I shall see that my compatriots, ah, protect your trade lanes and rein in the desperate scavengers who might feel enticed to raid for much-needed supplies."
entries.zh:
"那就谈，那就谈啊。跟文明人打交道就是让人高兴。" 海盗挤出一个自满的笑容。

"边缘星区可危险啦！" $heOrShe解释道。"而且我的人可都得吃饭。我提议你分给我你殖民地{总收入的 10%}。我保证我的伙伴们会，呃，保护你的商路并看住那些想通过打劫过活的拾荒者们。

entries.en:
"Come now," $heOrShe says. "I respect that you... ended our previous, ah, agreement to my face. You aren't a coward, I'll give you that much."

$HeOrShe sighs, shaking $hisOrHer head. "Coward or not, you also aren't to be trusted." $HeOrShe spreads $hisOrHer hands, acting the thoughtful administrator. "I have people to care for. How can I do that if tomorrow you might come to me and tell me our deal is off? That's no way to deal."
entries.zh:
"现在来吧，" $heOrShe说，"我尊重你...当着我的面结束了我们之前的，啊，协议。你不是个懦夫，这点我得承认。"

$HeOrShe叹了口气，摇了摇$hisOrHer的脑袋。"不管你是不是懦夫，你都不可信的。" $HeOrShe摊开双手，扮演起深思熟虑的管理者角色。"我有人要照顾。如果明天你突然来找我，告诉我我们的交易取消了，那我该怎么办？这可不是做生意的方式。"

o.en: You'll have 10% of the gross income of my colonies and I'll tell you why you'll accept.
o.zh: 你会拿到我殖民地收入的 10% ，而我也会告诉你为什么你会接受。

entries.en:
"So we do, so we do." The pirate does not smile. "And yet. You say 'business', but I'm no fool - I've heard of your treachery. Call me a pirate, but I rob and kill honestly."

$HeOrShe continues without considering $himOrHerself to have made any kind of contradiction, "I am also known for my forgiving moods. So I shall offer you a chance to repair your reputation: give me 10% of the gross income from your colony. My compatriots will protect your trade lanes and rein in the desperate scavengers who might feel enticed to raid for much-needed supplies."

$HeOrShe puts on a conciliatory grin.
entries.zh:
"我们也想，我们也想啊。" 海盗脸上没有一丝笑容。"但话说回来。你嘴上说着 '生意'，可是我可不是傻子 —— 我听过你背信弃义的事情了。我是个海盗，但是我至少光明正大地杀人越货。"

$HeOrShe似乎没有意识到自己的话里的逻辑问题，自顾自地说了下去。"但我也是有名地宽宏大度，所以我给你个修复你名声的机会：分给我你殖民地{总收入的 10%}。我的伙伴们会保护你的商路并看住那些想通过打劫过活的拾荒者们。"

$HeOrShe挤出了个微笑来体现自己的愿意和解的诚意。

entries.en:
"Business? You're a liar, captain. I'd respect if you shot me in the back, but only if you did it honestly. This?" $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head in disgust, apparently, at your duplicity.

"I'll not be your next fool. The only business there is to do between us will be done through ships of war."
entries.zh:
"生意？你是个骗子，舰长。你要是有种堂堂正正给我背后来一枪，我还能敬你三分。就你现在这德性？" $HeOrShe摇了摇$hisOrHer的头，明显为你的背信弃义所不齿。

"我不会当你的下一个冤大头。咱们之间的生意只有通过战舰来谈。"

o.en: You'll have 10% of the gross income of my colonies and I'll tell you why you'll accept.
o.zh: 你会拿到我殖民地收入的 10% ，而我也会告诉你为什么你会接受。

entries.en: $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head as if sad, "I tried, didn't I. It'd be such a shame if something happened to your lovely little colony."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe看上去有些伤心地摇了摇头。"我尝试过了，不是吗。要是你那可爱的小殖民地出了什么事，那可就太遗憾了。"

entries.en:
The comms flicker and spit, resolving into the grinning image of $post.

"Well, well, well," $heOrShe drawls. "An independent proprietor has come to my humble outpost. Whatever for?" $HeOrShe puts on a perplexed look, "I've heard that it's dangerous out here."
entries.zh:
通讯画面闪烁不定，最终显出了 $post 的笑脸。

"哎呀呀。" $heOrShe慢里斯条地说道，"一位独立经营者光临我这寒酸的前哨站。有何贵干啊？" $HeOrShe摆出一副困惑的表情，"我听说外面可危险了。"

entries.en:
You receive a disturbing post-battle report from your tech officer: the command and control centers of the XIV Battlegroup ships you fought appear to have been modified to enable complete control of all systems by AI cores.

It doesn't look like Tri-Tachyon work, either. This was done by the Hegemony.
entries.zh:
你从技术军官那里收到了一份令人不安的战后简报：刚刚与你方交手的第十四战斗群战舰的指令控制中心似乎为了适配 AI 核心操控进行了全系统改造。

并且，这看上去也不像是 速子科技 的手笔，而是 霸主 自己所为。

entries.en:
You comply enthusiastically to the $rank's request, welcoming a technical team to board your $shipOrFleet to inspect and remove the planetkiller.

The Diktat $rank follows your lead to espouse enthusiastic admiration for the Supreme Executor. "The Lion is generous to those who serve his Great Movement and Eternal Vision! A weapon such as this... it will ensure the reign of the Sindrian Diktat for a thousand cycles! You and I are sure to be recognized and rewarded," here, $heOrShe gives a wink, "for our contributions to his Final Victory. Ah, let's add a little to that reward; the Movement serves those who serve it, don't you agree?"

$HeOrShe produces a satisfied smile, leaving this hanging as a rhetorical question as $heOrShe signs off to see the planetkiller turned over to some secret arsenal or other.
entries.zh:
你热情地履行了 $rank 的要求，欢迎一支技术小队登上你的$shipOrFleet来检查并带走行星杀手。

辛达强权 $rank 紧随其后，表达了自己对最高元首的热烈钦佩。"狮王对那些为他的伟大事业和永恒愿景服务的人很慷慨！你和我肯定会得到认可和奖励。" 这时，$heOrShe向你眨了眨眼，"为我们对他的最终胜利做出的贡献。啊，我们干脆把赏金加倍吧，辛达强权为那些服务于它的人服务，你认可吗？"

$HeOrShe露出满意的笑容，把这个问题留作一句反问，一边目送行星杀手被送进某个秘密武器库。

entries.en:
You comply with the $rank's request, allowing a technical team to board your $shipOrFleet to inspect and remove the planetkiller.

The Diktat $rank beams. "The Lion is generous to those that serve his Great Movement and I- you are sure to be recognized for your small contribution to his Final Victory. A weapon such as this... it will ensure the reign of the Sindrian Diktat for a thousand cycles!"

With a final satisfied grin, $heOrShe turns to shut off the comms, halts, then touches $hisOrHer forehead. "I almost forgot- your payment."

A tap at a datapad. "See? Both of us may be rewarded by service to the Supreme Executor."
entries.zh:
你遵照 $rank 的要求，允许一支技术小队登上你的$shipOrFleet来检查并带走行星杀手。

辛达强权 $rank 眉开眼笑。"狮王对那些为他的伟大事业服务的人很慷慨，并且我 —— 你，肯定会因为你为他的最终胜利做出的小小贡献而得到认可。"

最后，带着满意的笑容，$heOrShe正要关闭通讯链接，却又停顿了一下，然后拍了拍自己额头。"我差点忘了你的报酬。" $heOrShe在数据平板上轻轻一点，"看到了吗？咱们两个都会因服务于最高元首而得到奖励。"

entries.en:
"Outrageous!" $heOrShe shouts, "I should have you arraigned for subversion for even suggesting such a thing! You... you are personally betraying the Supreme Executor's vision!"

The Diktat $Rank takes a breath, then summons as much menace as they are capable of; "Surrender the planetkiller. Immediately."
entries.zh:
"岂有此理！" $heOrShe吼道，"光凭你竟敢提出这种要求这一点，我就应当以颠覆罪将你立马传唤！你... 你这是亲自背叛了最高元首描绘下的伟大愿景！"

辛达强权 $Rank 深吸了一口气，然后竭尽全力威胁道，"交出行星杀手，马上！"

o.en: Funny, I don't recall pledging loyalty to Andrada. The price is still 500,000 credits.
o.zh: 有趣，我可不记得我对 Andrada 宣誓效忠过。我的要价还是 500,000 星币。

entries.en: "Your selfishness and greed will not be forgotten, $playerName."
entries.zh: "你的自私和贪婪将不会被忘记，$playerName。"

entries.en:
"Outrageous!" $heOrShe shouts, "I should have you arraigned for subversion for even suggesting such a thing! You... you are personally betraying the Supreme Executor's vision!"

The Diktat $Rank takes a breath, then summons as much menace as they are capable of; "Surrender the planetkiller. Immediately."
entries.zh:
"岂有此理！" $heOrShe吼道，"光凭你竟敢提出这种要求这一点，我就应当以颠覆罪将你立马传唤！你... 你这是亲自背叛了最高元首描绘下的伟大愿景！"

辛达强权 $Rank 深吸了一口气，然后竭尽全力威胁道，"交出行星杀手，马上！"

o.en: My price stands. If you take a moment to use your brain I think you'll find it quite reasonable.
o.zh: 我的要价不变。如果你花点时间动动脑子，我想你会发现这很合理。

o.en: My price stands. Oh, and make sure not a trace of your Lion's 'special' modifications remains.
o.zh: 我的要价不变。哦，还请确保把你家狮心卫队的那些 '特殊' 改造给拆干净。

entries.en:
The Diktat $Rank's face turns an odd shade of red, and $heOrShe breathes heavily. But something in your words seems to take.

"I must consult my superior," $heOrShe says through gritted teeth, then slams the comms-hold.

You take a minute to watch the crest of the Sindrian Diktat spinning over implausible propaganda-holos of the Lion of Sindria's greatest victories.
entries.zh:
辛达强权 $Rank 的脸红得相当别扭，就连$heOrShe喘出来的气都粗重了不少，但你的提议在其看来似乎仍旧有些道理。

"我必须请示我的上级。" $heOrShe咬牙切齿地说，然后猛地挂掉了通讯链接。

你盯着旋转的 辛达强权 徽标看了一会，徽标后面一直播放着鼓吹辛达瑞亚之狮最伟大胜利的全息宣传影像，宣传内容却难说有多少说服力。

entries.en:
An image of soldiers in power armor marching to the cheers of the 'liberated' citizens of Volturn is interrupted by the cowed-looking Diktat $Rank.

"My superior approved your... request," $heOrShe says, looking like $heOrShe ate something rotten. "It'll take one week to make the arrangements. Return to me then to complete the trade."

"I will add that, against my personal wishes, nearby patrols have received the... suggestion... to tolerate your presence."

With that said, $heOrShe slams the comms shutoff.
entries.zh:
面前的图像中，Volturn 上身着动力装甲的士兵正在 '获得解放' 的人民的欢呼致意中列队前行。而很快那个辛达强权 $Rank 就带着一副刚被训斥过的神色接入了通讯。

"我的上级批准了你那些...请求。" $heOrShe说道，脸色就像吃了条虫子般难看，"我们需要{一个星期}的时间来安排，到时候再回来敲定这笔交易。"

"另外，尽管这并非我本意，但附近的巡逻队已经都接到了...容忍你存在的...建议。"

说完这句话，$heOrShe狠狠挂掉了通讯链接。

entries.en:
An image of soldiers marching to the cheers of the 'liberated' citizens of Volturn is interrupted by the cowed-looking Diktat $Rank.

"My superior approved your... your demeaning extortion," $heOrShe says with a face like $heOrShe has eaten something rotten. "It'll take one week to make the arrangements. Return then to complete the trade."

"I will add that, against my personal recommendation that you be arrested and executed as a terrorist, nearby patrols have received the... suggestion... to tolerate your presence."

With that said, $heOrShe slams the comms shutoff.
entries.zh:
面前的图像中，Volturn 上被 '解放' 的人民们正在向着列队行军的士兵欢呼致意。而很快那个辛达强权 $Rank 就带着一副刚被训斥过的神色接入了通讯。

"我的上级批准了你那些...有辱人格的勒索。" $heOrShe说道，脸色就像吃了条虫子般难看，"我们需要{一个星期}的时间来安排，到时候再回来敲定这笔交易。"

"另外，就我个人而言，我更愿意把你当作恐怖分子来逮捕并处决。但附近的巡逻队都收到了...容忍你存在的...建议。"

说完这句话，$heOrShe狠狠挂掉了通讯链接。

entries.en:
You coordinate with the Pather to have the planetkiller transferred to their keeping.

"This is a praiseworthy act, $playerSirOrMadam, in service of Ludd's vision - twisted and dark though the Path we walk together be."

"Word of your... cooperation shall be spread among the True Faithful." $HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer hands together once more. "Holy peace be upon you $playerName, until the End of Days when all shall be judged."
entries.zh:
你与左径分子协调配合，把行星杀手移交给他们保管。

"你的行为值得赞扬，$playerSirOrMadam，你为卢德的愿景服务 —— 尽管我等的卢德之径将会如此黑暗，如此扭曲。"

"你的... 合作将由那些真正忠诚的人口口相传。" $HeOrShe再次将双手合十，"愿神圣的和平降临于你，$playerName，直到末日，直到一切受到审判之时。"

entries.en:
"Your dedication and service are to be commended! I personally salute your dedication to the mission of the Hegemony to protect humanity and its habitable environs, as per the vision of the first High Hegemon Kali Molina who gave the Diktat of Hegemony on Eventide so many cycles ago."

You would swear that $personName is posing for the recording of the comms-feed.
entries.zh:
"你的奉献精神和服务值得赞扬！我以个人的名义向你致敬，因你献身于 霸主 保护人类及其宜居环境的使命，正如许多星历年之前，首任至高霸主 Kali Molina 在 Eventide 颁布 霸主敕令 时所展望的那样。"

你几乎可以肯定 $personName 正在为记录下这段通讯而调整着姿势。

entries.en: Regardless, the wheels of the Hegemony bureaucracy turn smoothly, oiled perhaps by a desire not to repeat any 'incidents' similar to the destruction of Opis. A technical team verifies the planetkiller and efficiently removes it to Hegemony custody, and a reward for the recovery of weapons of mass destruction is provided.
entries.zh: 无论如何，霸主 的官僚机构运作得很顺利，也许是因为不想再出现一次像摧毁 Opis 那样的 "意外"。一个技术团队鉴定了这台行星杀手，然后迅速将其移交给了 霸主 的监管机构，并为你回收大规模杀伤性武器的行为提供了报酬。

entries.en:
The reward is transferred to your accounts, and there is an implication that you may be placed in the running for some kind of service medal.

The planetkiller, one assumes, shall rest in a secret arsenal somewhere.
entries.zh:
报酬被打到了你的账户里，这意味着你可能会参选某个服务类奖项。

至于行星杀手，想必会被封存在某个秘密军械库里。

entries.en:
"You are to be commended for your dedication and service, $playerName!"

"As a commissioned auxiliary, you have pledged yourself to the cause of the Hegemony, but I would like to take this moment to personally salute your dedication to protecting humanity and its habitable environs according to the vision of the first High Hegemon, Kali Molina, who gave the Diktat of Hegemony on Eventide so many cycles ago."

$HeOrShe, in fact, salutes you.

You would swear that $personName is putting on a show for the recording of the comms-feed.
entries.zh:
"$playerName，你的奉献精神和服务值得赞扬！"

"作为一名现役辅助军，你已经宣誓效忠于 霸主 的事业，但我仍以个人的名义向你致敬，因你献身于 霸主 保护人类及其宜居环境的使命，正如许多星历年之前，首任至高霸主 Kali Molina 在 Eventide 颁布 霸主敕令 时所展望的那样。"

$HeOrShe本人直接向你敬了个礼。

你几乎可以肯定 $personName 正在为记录下这段通讯而调整着姿势。

entries.en:
The wheels of the Hegemony bureaucracy turn smoothly, oiled perhaps by a desire not to repeat any 'incidents' similar to the destruction of Opis.

A technical team verifies the planetkiller and efficiently removes it to Hegemony custody, and a reward for the recovery of weapons of mass destruction is provided.
entries.zh:
霸主 的官僚机构运作得很顺利，也许是因为不想再出现一次像摧毁 Opis 那样的 "意外"。

一个技术团队鉴定了这台行星杀手，然后迅速将其移交给了 霸主 的监管机构，并为你回收大规模杀伤性武器的行为提供了报酬。

entries.en:
A reward above and beyond your commission payment is transferred to your accounts, and there is an implication that you may be placed in the running for some kind of service medal.

The planetkiller shall rest in a secret arsenal somewhere. One assumes.

"For the Restoration!" $heOrShe  says triumphantly. "And burn bright, captain."
entries.zh:
除了佣金，还有一笔奖励被打进你的账户，这意味着你可能会参选某个服务类奖项。

至于行星杀手，想必会被封存在某个秘密军械库里。

"为了 人之领 的复兴！" $heOrShe昂首挺胸地说道，"祝你航行无阻，舰长。"

entries.en:
"Of course," the $rank grits $hisOrHer teeth. "It is... policy... to incentivize the safety of all citizens within Hegemony space."

"I shall have to confirm your exceptional," $heOrShe lets the word sink in, "request with a superior officer. Of course."
entries.zh:
"当然，" $rank 咬牙切齿地说道，"奖励有助于 霸主 疆域内全体公民安全生活的行为... 符合... 政策。"

"我必须确认您的 '特殊' 请求，" $heOrShe着重强调了 "特殊" 二字，"当然，还得有上级确认。"

o.en: Of course. I await that confirmation.
It was just an idea. Naturally I'll hand over the planetkiler for no reward.
o.zh: 这只是我一个想法。我当然会把行星杀手无偿交给你。

entries.en:
Although $PersonRank $personName seems personally displeased with your mercenary demand, $hisOrHer superior appears to have no objections.

The wheels of the Hegemony bureaucracy turn smoothly, oiled perhaps by a desire not to repeat any 'incidents' similar to the destruction of Opis.
entries.zh:
尽管 $PersonRank $personName 个人似乎对你在有一份佣金的情况下还提出这样的要求感到不满，但$hisOrHer的上级似乎没有反对意见。

霸主 的官僚机构运作得很顺利，也许是因为不想再出现一次像摧毁 Opis 那样的 "意外"。

entries.en:
Although $PersonRank $personName seems personally displeased with your mercenary demand, Central Command appears to have no objections.

The wheels of the Hegemony bureaucracy turn smoothly, oiled perhaps by a desire not to repeat any 'incidents' similar to the destruction of Opis.
entries.zh:
尽管 $PersonRank $personName 个人似乎对你在有一份佣金的情况下还提出这样的要求感到不满，但指挥部似乎没有意见。

霸主 的官僚机构运作得很顺利，也许是因为不想再出现一次像摧毁 Opis 那样的 "意外"。

entries.en:
The Hegemony tech-team verifies your claim of having possession of a planetkiller, and when the credits-transfer comes in, they remove the weapon from your $shipOrFleet.

"If all citizens were as dutiful as you, $playerSirOrMadam, I would soon be out my operating budget," $personName says coolly. "Good day."
entries.zh:
霸主 的技术团队证实了你持有行星杀手的说法，在星币到账时，他们就把这件武器运出了你的$shipOrFleet。

"如果所有公民都像你一样 '尽职尽责' ，$playerSirOrMadam，我很快就会花光我的部队预算。" $personName 冷淡地说。"祝好。"

entries.en:
"Of course," the $rank grits $hisOrHer teeth. "It is official policy to incentivize the safety of all citizens within Hegemony space."

"I shall have to confirm your exceptional," $heOrShe lets the word sink in, "request with Central Command. Of course."
entries.zh:
"当然，" $rank 咬牙切齿地说道，"奖励有助于 霸主 疆域内全体公民安全生活的行为符合官方政策。"

"我必须确认您的 '特殊' 请求，" $heOrShe着重强调了 "特殊" 二字，"当然，还得有上级确认。"

o.en: Of course. I await that confirmation.
It was just an idea. Naturally I'll hand over the planetkiler for no reward.
o.zh: 这只是我一个想法。我当然会把行星杀手无偿交给你。

entries.en: "Naturally, citizen." Your backing down seems to put $himOrHer into a better mood; $heOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat, putting a bit of unpleasantness behind $himOrHer.
entries.zh: "这是当然，公民。" 你的让步似乎让$himOrHer心情好了一些。$heOrShe清了清自己的嗓子，把一些不愉快抛之脑后。

entries.en:
Comms opens the link. Your sensors and tactical officers start flickering interfaces on their control consoles, and they exchange a look.

Tactical begins with a report, "SIGINT matches... almost... with previous encounters with autonomous Domain warships."

"I think," your comms officer jumps in, "I think I can convince their governing routines to stand-down from aggressive guard mode. We've got part of a very old Domain codeset in the Hegemony MILAUX package, meant to help auxiliaries avoid getting blasted by auto-defenses. We can't order a complete stand-down though; they didn't give us everything."
entries.zh:
通讯军官建立了链接。你的传感器技官与战术军官在他们的控制面板上频繁地切换着界面，两人交换了一个眼神。

战术军官向你报告道，"根据信号情报... 这几乎匹配... 匹配于我们之前遭遇过的 人之领 的自动化战舰。"

"我认为..." 你的通讯军官插话道，"我认为我可以命令它们的主控程序退出攻击性警戒模式。霸主辅助军组件中有一部分非常古老的 人之领 指令集，用于帮助辅助军避免被那些自动防御系统摧毁。不过我们不能命令它们完全解除警戒，霸主 没有把所有指令全交给我们。"

o.en: Try the codes. Maybe we can avoid a fight.
o.zh: 试试那条指令。我们或许可以避免与之一战。
战术军官，你说的 '几乎匹配' 是有多匹配？

o.en: Close the link and close in on the asteroid
o.zh: 关闭链接并接近小行星

entries.en:
Your comms officer gives a sanguine "Aye $playerSirOrMadam!" and starts transmitting. Your tactical officer turns to their station with a grim look.

You're not held long in suspense, for a fraction of a second after transmission an acknowledgment ping flashes on your comms officer's console. The asteroid blooms, casting undetected bogeys from itself in glowing icons on the tactical display. The bogeys form up into a standard patrol formation with inhuman synchronization.

It would have been a spectacular ambush to walk into.
entries.zh:
通讯军官骄傲地回复道："是，$playerSirOrMadam！" 并开始了传输。战术军官则一脸严肃地转向了自己的工作站。

这份悬念并未保持很久，在代码传输完成后不到一秒，对方的响应便已闪烁于通讯军官的控制面板上。小行星如花苞绽放般打开，原先未被探测到的敌机从中释放而出，在战术显示器上被投影为一个个发亮的图标。它们以一种人类所无法企及的协调性组建成了标准的巡逻阵型。

刚才若是贸然接近，一定会上演一场华丽的伏击战吧。

entries.en:
Hull-ids come in; combat-scarred XIV Battlegroup hulls, repaired without orbital dockyards. A veteran fleet, for sure. Between the fact that they've been hidden here for many cycles and your SIGINT, it is clear that humans do not command these ships.

But now the way is clear. Tactical mutters to sensors about keeping an eye on the automated swarm.
entries.zh:
舷号映入眼帘，第十四战斗群舰体上刻着被战火洗礼所留下的痕迹，那是不使用轨道船坞进行修复的证明。毫无疑问，这是一支久经沙场的舰队。从它们在数十个星历年间隐藏于此的事实，以及你收集的信号情报来看，这些舰船显然并非由人类指挥。

但至少，前路已然畅通无阻。战术军官低语着吩咐传感器技官，让其对自动化舰队时刻保持警惕。

o.en: Send a salvor team to access the cache
o.zh: 派遣打捞小组前往藏匿点

entries.en:
Your ops chief oversees the operation with familiar gruffness and wariness.

The salvors use a cloud of microdrones to cast a sensor net over the asteroid, coordinating with your $shipOrFleet's technicians to map density anomalies. There are faster methods, but this is the best way to find the surprises that tend to be left to protect far-flung caches.

The rock is spotted with hiding holes, empty, and fuel and supply stores, also empty. No surprise fusion mines or pinhead AM traps. Ops finally gives the order, and the salvors move in to uncover the camouflaged access point.
entries.zh:
你的行动长官一如以往，以粗中带细的风格指挥着打捞行动。

打捞员们使用一群微型无人机在小行星上组建了一个传感器网络，并与你$shipOrFleet的技术人员协同测绘了藏匿点的密度异常情况。虽然这不是最快捷的打捞技术，但要想完好地找到散落在藏匿点中的宝藏，这便是最好的办法了。

这块岩石上遍布着空的隐蔽洞穴，燃料和供给存储点中也空无一物。在确认没有聚变诡雷或者微型反物质陷阱后，行动长官终于下达了命令，打捞员们开始探测隐藏的对接口。

entries.en:
The shaky image from a salvor's helmetcam reveals the carapace of terrestrial death, glittering in the chaotic play of suitlamps.

One planetkiller.

Your ops chief cuts the excited chatter between salvors with a harsh word, and they return to procedural call-and-response. The planetkiller is soon secured in your flagship.
entries.zh:
头戴式摄像机传回的抖动画面之中，映出了崩灭大地之物的外壳，它在便携灯混乱的照射下闪闪发光。

那是一台行星杀手。

你的行动长官一声令下，打断了打捞员们兴奋的七嘴八舌，他们又开始一如既往地做出回复。行星杀手很快就被送到了你的旗舰上。

entries.en:
The expensive smiles appears once more, a part of a mask.

"I'm very sorry to say that such an arrangement will be impossible, $playerSirOrMadam. You must understand, of course, that we owe our shareholders - and I include myself among that esteemed group - we owe our shareholders quantifiable reports on investments and profits."

"An open-ended promise of that magnitude is, well..." $heOrShe searches for the word, and with a small look of disgust, finds it. "Unbusinesslike."
entries.zh:
那副高贵的笑容再一次像面具一样凝固在了$heOrShe的脸上。

"我很遗憾地说，这样的安排是不可能的，$playerSirOrMadam。当然了，您必须明白，我们 —— 指我和我的合作伙伴，都欠股东一份投资和利润的量化报告。"

"一个如此重大的开放式承诺是，嗯..." $heOrShe斟词着酌句，一边露出了恶心的表情，最终找到了$heOrShe想要的形容词，"非商业化的。"

entries.en:
$PersonName is eager to do business - presumably they will negotiate a finder's fee with the relevant VP for this find - and with Tri-Tachyon's deep pockets, it is not difficult to negotiate for a half million credits payment.

A small team of elite techs is shuttled to your $shipOrFleet to inspect the planetkiller. Your technical officer can barely refrain from asking questions about their advanced diagnostic tools, but the work is soon done and the deal confirmed.

You receive a small fortune, and the planetkiller disappears into the machinery of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation.
entries.zh:
$PersonName急切地想要促成这笔交易 —— 你推测对方将与相关副总裁就这一发现谈一笔中介费。并且，凭借 速子科技 的雄厚财力，支付 500,000 星币并不困难。

一支由精英技术人员组成的小组被派往你的$shipOrFleet，对行星杀手展开鉴定工作。你的技术军官几乎忍不住要就那些先进的鉴定仪器向他们发出疑问，但工作很快就完成了，交易也得到了确认。

你发了一笔小财，行星杀手则被喂进了 三一速子科技公司 这部巨大的企业机器之中，自此销声匿迹。

entries.en:
Arroyo is, naturally, taken aback at your claim.

"You serious?" He looks at you, assessing.
entries.zh:
不出所料，Arroyo 对你的话感到吃惊。

"你认真的？" 他仔细打量着你。

o.en: Deadly serious. Planetkillers are a rare commodity. I thought of you because you're rich.
o.zh: 非常认真。行星杀手非常罕见。我想到了你，因为你很有钱。

entries.en:
"This again." He gives you a cold look, "I hope you haven't been peddling this forbidden Domain-era weapon of mass destruction responsible for billions of deaths to anyone else before coming crawling back to me."

He's ice-cold.

"Right?"
entries.zh:
"又是这样。" 他冷冷地看了你一眼，"我希望你在爬回来找我之前，没有向任何人兜售过这种曾在 人之领 时代造成数十亿人死亡的大规模杀伤性武器。"

他的态度直降冰点。

"对吧？"

entries.en: "You already made that joke," he says. "It wasn't funny the first time."
entries.zh: "你已经开过了那个玩笑。" 他说道，"第一次就没多好笑。"

o.en: I'm serious this time. Planetkillers are a rare commodity. I thought of you; you're rich.
o.zh: 我这次是认真的，行星杀手可是个稀罕货。我想到了你，你相当有钱。

o.en: Just trying to brighten your day.
o.zh: 只是想让你度过愉快的一天。

entries.en: "No," he says. "And we're not having this conversation about you selling me a weapon of mass destruction."
entries.zh: "不，" 他说道，"并且我们从来没谈过关于你卖给我大规模杀伤性武器的事。"

entries.en:
"Hilarious."

He doesn't smile.
entries.zh:
"真搞笑。"

他并没有笑。

entries.en:
"Thanks."

He doesn't sound thankful.
entries.zh:
"谢谢。"

他听起来并没有多么感谢你。

entries.en: "There is little to say," $PersonName says, frowning. "They are an abomination to all that is holy and good. Their mere existence is a crime against humanity and God alike."
entries.zh: "这没什么好说的，" $PersonName 皱眉说到，"它们是对一切圣洁良善之物的亵渎。它们仅是存在，便是对人类与神犯下的罪过。"

o.en: I wish to give a planetkiller into the custody of the Church.
o.zh: 我希望把一个行星杀手置于教会的监管下。

o.en: Er, good to know. I'll try to avoid them.
o.zh: 啊，好吧，我会尽量避开它们的。

entries.en: $PersonRank $personLastName's face tightens. "I do not have the time or inclination to re-debate the history of the AI Wars, captain. If you have no other pressing business, then let us conclude this conversation."
entries.zh: $PersonRank $personLastName 的脸绷紧了。"我没有时间也没有兴趣重新争论 AI 战争的历史，舰长。如果您没有其他紧急事务，那就让我们到此为止吧。"

o.en: You misunderstand; I've found a planetkiller weapon.
o.zh: 你误会了，我找到了一台行星杀手。

entries.en:
The Hegemony $post's eyes go wide, and $heOrShe says "I... I see. We will need to send a technical team to confirm your claim. And bring the weapon in for safekeeping."

Skepticism remains in $hisOrHer tone, but it seems more of a fading hope that you are lying than actual disbelief.
entries.zh:
霸主 $post 瞪大了眼睛，而后说道："我... 我明白了。我们需要派遣一支技术小组来核实你的说法，并将那台武器送到安全的地方保管。"

$hisOrHer的语气里充满了怀疑，但比起真的不相信你，听起来更像是某种微弱的希望 —— 那人希望你只是在撒谎。

o.en: Of course. It is every citizen's duty to submit forbidden weapons to the proper authorities.
o.zh: 当然。向有关当局提交违禁武器是每个公民的责任。

o.en: Don't you think such honesty deserves a reward? 500,000 credits should do.
o.zh: 你不认为这样的诚实值得奖励吗？500,000 星币就可以了。

entries.en:
Rao raises an eyebrow, surprised; but not surprised, somehow. "I see."

"I suppose I should say 'Well done'," he says with a sigh. "We shall need to send a technical team to confirm your claim - and bring the weapon in for safekeeping, of course."

A note of skepticism remains in his tone, but you've certainly got his attention.
entries.zh:
海军上将 Rao 惊讶地扬起眉毛；但不知为何，他看上去也没有那么惊奇。"我明白了。"

"我想我应该说声 '做得好'，" 上将叹了口气，"我们需要派遣一支技术小组来核实你的说法，当然也要将那台武器送到安全的地方保管。"

他的语气中仍然带有怀疑的意味，但可以肯定的是，你已经引起了他的注意。

o.en: Of course. It is every citizen's duty to submit forbidden weapons to the proper authorities.
o.zh: 当然。向有关当局提交违禁武器是每个公民的责任。

o.en: Don't you think such honesty deserves a reward? 500,000 credits should do.
o.zh: 你不认为这样的诚实值得奖励吗？500,000 星币就可以了。

entries.en: Admiral Rao's face tightens. "I do not have the inclination to debate the history of the AI Wars, captain. Nor discuss certain mutinous former officers of the Hegemony and their crimes."
entries.zh: 海军上将 Rao 的脸绷紧了。"我不想争论 AI 战争的历史，舰长，也不讨论某些叛变的前 霸主 军官及其罪行。"

o.en: You misunderstand; I've found a planetkiller weapon.
o.zh: 你误会了，我找到了一台行星杀手。

entries.en:
$PersonName's hands go together and $heOrShe closes $hisOrHer eyes, mumbling what sounds like thanks to Providence.

"I confess, captain, I did not expect you to return," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh:
$PersonName双手合十，闭上了自己的双眼，一边喃喃自语着，听起来像是在感谢天意。

"我承认，舰长，我没想到你会回来，" $heOrShe说道。

o.en: Make arrangements to turn it over
Isn't it useless without the codes?
o.zh: 没有密码的话，它不就是一块废铁？

o.en: I want you to promise you're not going to use this on people.
o.zh: 我要你保证你们不会对人们使用这个东西。

entries.en:
"Ah," $heOrShe puts on an expensive-looking smile. "I'm very sorry to say that we don't have any available for sale right now, but if you'd like to submit your contact information for the waitlist..."

"We also have a dazzling range of lower-yield weapons, including AM-catalyzed fusion devices with a proven track record in both civilian and private military contractor applications. I'd be more than happy to provide you with a catalog, including our Tri-Tachyon holo experience featuring a hand-curated selection of some of our most popular items."
entries.zh:
"啊，" $heOrShe摆出一副高贵的微笑。"我很遗憾我们现在并没有任何可供出售的物品，但如果您想提交您的联系方式来浏览其他商品... "

"我们还有一系列令人眼花缭乱的低当量武器，比如反物质催化聚变装置，在民用和私人军事承包商方面都有着良好的效用记录。我非常乐意为您提供一份目录，即使用我们的 速子科技 全息体验影像，其中包括我们亲自挑选的一些最受欢迎的物品。"

o.zh: 我不是来买的，我是来卖东西的。

o.en: I'll just take the catalog and be on my way.

entries.en:
"Oh!" $heOrShe exclaims, "Please accept my apologies, $playerSirOrMadam. It is not often that we find a, a supplier of such items."

$HeOrShe taps at something on a TriPad, and the cheerful business-persona turns its glow down a notch or three.

"If what you say is true - and we shall have to have a technician, ah, inspect the item before any payment is made - then rest assured that we shall deal with utmost secrecy. It's nothing more than Tri-Tachyon's guarantee to respect the privacy of our valued partners."
entries.zh:
"哦！" $heOrShe惊叫道，"请接受我的道歉，$playerSirOrMadam。我们并不经常遇到，呃，这种东西的供应商。"

$HeOrShe快速地在 TriPad 上点击着什么东西，同时欢快的贸易人格瞬间降低了几个档次。

"如果您说的是真的 —— 在付款之前，我们必须让一名技术人员，嗯，检查一下那个东西。请放心，我们会尽最大努力保密。这只不过是 速子科技 尊重我们宝贵合作伙伴的隐私的保障。"

o.en: How about I give you the planetkiller for no charge, and Tri-Tachyon will owe me a favor. A big favor.
o.zh: 我把行星杀手免费送你怎么样，这样 速子科技 就会欠我一个人情，一个大大的人情。
协商要求 500,000 星币的报酬

entries.en: "Not so useless as you might think," $heOrShe says. "It is a God-cursed totem, a demonic thing feared and worshipped by heretics. There is power-" $heOrShe stops $himOrHerself, realizing that despite $hisOrHer excitement, it is best not to speak too openly of The Path's plans.
entries.zh: "并不像你想的那样无用，" $heOrShe说道，"这是一个被造物主诅咒的图腾，是异端害怕和崇拜的恶魔。它拥有力量 —— " $heOrShe克制住了自己。你意识到了尽管$heOrShe很兴奋，但还是不要太过公开地谈论左径的计划。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe stares at you for a long moment. "You know as well as I that I could easily lie to you, one way or the other; I am no saint. Let us not waste time play-acting."

"A weapon is a threat as much as it is a weapon. You know this as well as I. If, truly, I professed that it would never be used, and I was believed, then it is no longer a threat." $HeOrShe pauses, then continues. "-Only a weapon. Which is all the more dangerous, don't you think?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe凝视了你好一会儿才开口。"你和我都很清楚，我对你撒谎简直易如反掌。毕竟借口这么多，而我又非圣贤。所以我们就别浪费时间演戏了。"

"武器可以成为一种威慑，也能成为一件凶器。你对这方面的了解应该不比我差。假如我发自内心地宣称它永远不会被使用，而且大家都相信我，那么它就不再是一种威慑。" $HeOrShe顿了顿，继续说道，"—— 那它就只能成为一件凶器了。这种情况显然对我们大家来说都更加危险，你不觉得吗？"

entries.en:
"It's strange, $playerSirOrMadam," your tactical officer says, eyes flicking between displays. "They're using protocols newer than Domain-era, but certainly not recent Hegemony. It looks like something out of... the First AI War, I'd say."

Which could suggest something dangerous, and potentially more sophisticated than the current standard of Persean Sector military technology.
entries.zh:
"这很奇怪，$playerSirOrMadam，" 你战术军官向你说道，眼神来回扫过各个显示器，"它们的协议相较 人之领 时代的要更新些，但肯定又不是近期 霸主 所使用的那些协议。这似乎是出自于...要我说的话，第一次 AI 战争。"

这可能意味着这里埋藏着某些危险的东西，且其协议可能比当今英仙座星域军事标准的那些都更为复杂。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet maneuvers closer to the asteroid.

Your sensors officer gives a shout of alarm - bogeys are spilling out of the asteroid, clouds of loosely-piled regolith and stealth-sheath panels spinning away as they are caught by thruster-bursts. The angular forms of Domain XIV Battlegroup hulls appear, veteran ships judging by the obvious field repairs. The IDs are automatically tagged and collated into the tactical display.

You have no time to ask why a ghost fleet from the First AI War has ambushed you.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet开始机动，并向小行星靠近。

你的传感器技官拉响了警报 —— 敌机正从小行星中涌出，松散的小行星物质和隐形护板在喷吐烈焰的推进器前四散纷飞。人之领 第十四战斗群那棱角分明的船体已显露出来，无数现场抢修在船体上留下的痕迹诉说着这支舰队纵横沙场的过往。舰船识别信息被标记、整合，并投射在战术显示器上。

你没时间质问为何一支来自第一次 AI 战争的幽灵舰队会伏击你。

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam!"

Your comms officer calls for your attention with an excited look, "I'm picking up an anomalous signal, it's an open channel. Just a carrier signal, a low-grade military fallback standard. Very faint and lossy. We're really only picking this up because of the MILAUX package installed in our comms system to help integrate with Hegemony fleet actions."

"Shall I open a link?" Their hands don't quite tremble over the controls. Whatever is using this frequency is either Hegemony or has some of their less secure emergency codes.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam！"

你的通讯军官兴奋地叫住你，"我捕获到一个开放频道上的异常信号，虽然只是个低级军事备用标准、微弱且有损的载波。要不是为了与 霸主 舰队协同作战而在通信系统中安装了辅助军组件，我们绝对无法捕获这样的信号。"

"我该建立链接吗？" 对方的手紧贴控制面板，几近颤抖。使用这一载波频率的对象，若不是 霸主 官方，便是其他掌握 霸主 低安全等级的应急编码之人。

o.en: Try to open a comm link on this channel
o.zh: 尝试在此频道建立通讯链接

o.en: Ignore it and close in on the asteroid

entries.en:
Your comms officer tags the faint carrier wave which is using an obscure Hegemony signal standard. Someone - or perhaps no one - has been waiting for a response for quite some time.

"Shall I open a link?" your comms officer asks, mostly keeping their excitement over a mystery signal under control. Mostly.
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官标记了那个似乎遵循着 霸主 标准的微弱载波信号。那里或许已经有人久候多时，又或许早已人去船空。

"我该建立链接吗？" 你的通讯军官问道，面对着这样一个神秘信号，这位军官已经几乎按捺不住自己的兴奋了。

o.en: Try to open a comm link on this channel
o.zh: 尝试在此频道建立通讯链接

o.en: Ignore it and close in on the asteroid
Attempt to remotely hack into the Nexus to retrieve the location of the planetkiller
o.zh: 尝试远程黑入中枢，取回行星杀手的位置信息。

entries.en:
"You," $heOrShe says with a truly ugly sneer that tells you everything about $hisOrHer opinion.

"It's not ready."

The Sindrian Diktat $Rank slams the comms-cutoff.
entries.zh:
"喂，你。" $heOrShe用发自真心的厌恶和讥讽语气传递了$heOrShe对你的所有看法。

"我们还没准备好。"

辛达强权的 $Rank 猛然挂掉了通讯链接。

entries.en:
"It's ready," $heOrShe says, sneering. "The Executor-class battleship, a thing of beauty and vision that you will never understand."

$HeOrShe slams a comms-cutoff, leaving a confused but unquestioningly loyal junior officer to make the actual arrangements. A technical team takes possession of the planetkiller and remove it from your $shipOrFleet into the custody of the Sindrian Diktat.

Andrada only knows what will be done with it.
entries.zh:
"一切就绪了。" $heOrShe语气讥讽，"执行官-级 战列舰，此等尤物的精美绝伦就凭你可永远都品味不出来。"

$HeOrShe旋即切断了通讯链接，留下一名虽然困惑但忠诚无疑的下级军官来做出实际安排。一支技术小队接管了行星杀手，并把它从你的$shipOrFleet移送给 辛达强权 保管。

只有 Andrada 才知道它以后派得上怎样的用场。

entries.en:
A synthetic voice greets you without affect, "Standby. Awaiting command. Autonomous override in effect."

The crest of the Domain XIV Battlegroup flickers in the comms display, a text feed of the words in the audio channel displayed in overlay.

"Standby. Awaiting command. Autonomous override in effect."
entries.zh:
一个合成声音毫无感情地回应了你："准备就绪。正在待命。无人自主操控已强制生效。"

人之领 第十四战斗群的徽标在通讯器中闪烁，从文字传输通道传来的信息和音频通道信息，叠加显示在了上面。

"准备就绪。正在待命。无人自主控制已强制生效。"

o.en: Pssst, do you want a planetkiller?
o.zh: 嘘，你想要一台行星杀手吗？
我想谈谈行星杀手的事情。

entries.en: "Begone from here!" $HeOrShe shouts, then hits the comms shut-off.
entries.zh: "从这里滚出去！" $HeOrShe吼道，随后关闭了通讯。

o.en: I have something that will be of great interest to the Lion of Sindria.
o.zh: 我有件辛达瑞亚之狮会非常感兴趣的东西。

entries.en: $HeOrShe barely raises an eyebrow, "And what is that?"
entries.zh: $HeOrShe几乎没有抬眼看你，"那是什么？"

o.zh: 一台完好无损的行星杀手。
哦，其实什么都没有。我口误了。

entries.en:
The Diktat $Rank gives you a funny look.

"Spacers," $heOrShe says under $hisOrHer breath.
entries.zh:
辛达强权 $Rank 向你投来了一个古怪的眼神。

"死太空佬。" $heOrShe低声抱怨了一句，几乎没让你听见。

entries.en:
That seems to get $hisOrHer attention. "I see," $heOrShe says, eyes narrowed. "You shall surrender the alleged planetkiller device to my custody for... confirmation of your claims. It is, of course, illegal to possess such a weapon without the direct authorization of the Supreme Executor."

"This matter is quite delicate, you surely understand," $heOrShe says in a lower voice. "Imagine a repeat of the Opis Incident - the rebel terrorists blew up their own moon to vex Admiral Andrada's authority!"

In a conciliatory tone, $heOrShe adds, "I'll ensure you receive compensation, of course. 100,000 credits.
entries.zh:
这好像引起了$hisOrHer的注意。"我明白了。" $heOrShe眯起眼睛说，"你应该把你说的行星杀手交给我保管以... 证实你的说法。当然了，未经最高元首的直接授权，持有这种武器是非法的。"

"这件事很微妙，你肯定知道。" $heOrShe低声说道，"想象一下 Opis 事件重演 —— 反叛的恐怖分子炸毁了自己的卫星，以此来挑战 Andrada 上将的权威！"

$heOrShe安抚道，"当然，我保证你能得到补偿。10,000 星币。

o.en: Gladly, and at once, for the glory of Supreme Executor!
o.zh: 乐意之至，我立刻照办，为了最高元首的荣耀！

o.en: A planetkiller is worth at least 500,000 credits to your glorious Lion.
o.zh: 对你那荣耀的狮王来说，一台行星杀手至少值 500,000 星币。

o.en: A planetkiller is worth at least a pristine Executor-class battleship, don't you think?
o.zh: 一台行星杀手至少值一艘全新的 执行官-级 战列舰，你不这样认为吗？

o.en: I'd like to discuss planetkiller weapons.
o.zh: 我想谈谈行星杀手的事情。
我有你们要的行星杀手。
我想谈谈行星杀手的事情。

entries.en:
Although nothing appears to change in the holodisplay, you hear nothing more from the voice.

It feels, somehow, as if an animating presence has departed.

Your comms officer looks wide-eyed at you in amazement. The others' expressions range from world-weary incomprehension to barely-suppressed terror.
entries.zh:
虽然全息投影没有任何变化，你没再听到那个声音再说任何话语了。

看上去，似乎驱动这一切的存在已经离开了。

你的通讯军官惊讶地瞪眼看着你。其他人的表情多是掩饰不住的恐惧和疲惫的不解。

o.zh: 在下个星历日前给我报告！解散。

entries.en:
It is not unusual that the Remnant Nexus exchanges signals with the local comm relay. Wherever Tri-Tachyon's AI fleets linger, one finds clouds of tiny spy-sats, relays, and repeaters chirping squirts of data back and forth. Very quietly, almost enough to be lost in the background noise. But not quite.

It is not a simple thing to tap into this self-evolved network to request a very specific piece of information. You assemble your senior officers and consider your options for hacking into the Nexus
entries.zh:
余辉中枢和星系内的通讯中继站进行信号交互并不罕见。毕竟无论这些 速子科技 麾下的 AI 舰队在哪儿徘徊，都会留下如云雾般密布的间谍卫星和中继转发系统，不停地来回吞吐数据流。虽然这些都安静到几乎能被背景噪音所掩盖，但也不是完全悄然无息。

接入这样一个自我进化出来的网络里获取某个特定的信息绝非易事。你将你的上级军官召集到了一起，考虑能采取什么行动来黑入中枢。

o.en: Use Tri-Tachyon command codes to make the task possible
o.zh: 使用 速子科技 的命令编码让这项工作可行

o.en: Open a comm-link into the network
o.zh: 向网络开放通讯链接接入

entries.en:
As a commissioned privateer of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation, you have been given a standard set of access codes. These are old protocols, and while they've migrated away from company standards over time (due, probably, to the meddling of idle AIs), your technical officers have the skill to adapt to the unusual changes.

After hours of painstakingly crafting a request - it must be asked in precisely the correct way and have the properly mutated access codes attached - the question is asked and the answer received nearly instantly. Unnervingly so. Nonetheless, you now have navigation coordinates which should lead to the planetkiller.
entries.zh:
身为一名 三一速子科技公司 麾下的签约私掠者，你被给予了一套标准访问编码。这些协议很老旧，而且和公司标准规范渐行渐远 (也许是那些到处闲逛的 AI 们搞的鬼)，不过你的技术官们完全有能力适应此类异常变动。

由于必须附上准确转换后的访问编码，并使用非常精确无误方式进行询问，检索请求在煞费苦心地认真编写了几个小时之后才发出去，之后却几乎立即就收到了回答，让人不禁有些胆怯。但无论如何，你现在拿到了应该都能通往行星杀手所在位置的导航坐标了。

entries.en:
Your comms officer inputs the commands, a look of confusion remaining on their face.

"Their system isn't built for comms. Um, at all. But, theoretically the adaptive protocols should... could interface, if there's a proper link..."

Another tap at the controls, "The line should be open. If someone, something... is listening."

Your display shows nothing but holo-snow. Your officers fall silent, and the signal processing amplifies the buzz of cosmic background radiation to a near-audible level. There's nought but a yawning void awaiting your words.
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官输入了指令，一脸的困惑依然没有散去。

"它们的系统构造没考虑过接受通讯，呃，完全没有。但，理论上自适应协议应该...也许能进行交互，如果有合适的链接的话..."

通讯军官又在控制台上按了一下，"链接应该开启了，如果有人，有什么东西...在听着的话。"

你的显示台上除了全息雪花噪之外什么都没显示。你的军官都安静了下来，与此同时，信号处理器自顾自地把宇宙背景辐射的嗡响放大到了几乎能听见的音量水平。在这无有之处中，仿佛有片虚空正打着哈欠等着你发话。

o.en: This is Artemisia Sun, CEO of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation.
o.zh: 我是 Artemisia Sun，三一速子科技公司 的首席执行官。

o.en: This is Omega calling. I have a command for you.
o.zh: 这是欧米伽在呼叫。我有指令要传达给你。

entries.en:
Their reports don't tell you anything you couldn't already guess.

The techs who were ordered to run a more paranoid than usual sweep found nothing in your $shipOrFleet's computer systems that wasn't supposed to be there - any more than usual, at least. Nothing of the telemetry recorded during your 'chat' provides anything of use.

The navigational coordinates which appeared in the comms buffer appear valid, however.
entries.zh:
他们的报告没有告知任何你预料之外的内容。

技官们被要求对$shipOrFleet的电脑系统进行一个比平常更小心的扫描。扫描结果没发现多出任何本来不该在系统里的东西 —— 至少没有平时多出来的更多。你 '谈话' 中记录的遥测信息也没能提供有用的信息。

但是在你通讯缓存中出现的航行坐标看上去确实是有效的。

o.en: How do you know my name?
o.zh: 你怎么知道我的名字的？

o.en: I apologize for lying to you. Let's be honest with one another from now on.
o.zh: 我为向你撒谎一事表示抱歉。从此以后，让我们坦诚相待吧。

o.en: I want us to be completely honest with one another.
o.zh: 我希望我们彼此完全坦诚。

o.en: Are you the Remnant AI Nexus?
o.zh: 你是余辉的 AI 中枢吗？

o.en: Have you hacked my computer systems?
o.zh: 你入侵了我的电脑系统吗？

o.en: You're probably an Alpha Core having fun with me.
o.zh: 你是个正在拿我寻开心的 Alpha 核心吧。

entries.en: Your comms officer is taken aback, "But $playerSirOrMadam, what-"
entries.zh: 你的通讯军官看起来大吃了一惊，"但是，$playerSirOrMadam，这 ——"

o.en: Just do it. I've got an idea.
o.zh: 就这么办。我有一个主意。

entries.en: i am agreed

entries.en:
You couldn't quite say how you heard the words. It was as if they were spoken without a voice. Your senior officers all take a step back from the empty holo-display, eyes wide; shocked into silence.

Your comms officer exchanges a look with you - yes, they heard it too; no, they don't know what it is. They tear their eyes away from the nothing in the holo-display and start pulling telemetry into a buffer through their datapad interface.

你没法描述自己到底是怎么听见这些话的。它们仿佛并非由声音传递。你的上级军官们都不由得从空空如也的全息显示台后退了一步，瞪大了双眼，震惊得说不出话来。

你的通讯军官和你交换了一个眼色，对，也听到了；不，也不知道那是什么。通讯军官将视线从空白的全息显示屏上移开，并开始用数据平板遥测缓冲区数据。
