   恐惧将迫使其他人类
   从汝处强夺以取此力

o.en: I will keep it for myself, to frighten off any who would attack me.
o.zh: 我会自己留着它，震慑那些想要对我不利的人。

entries.en:
may you die
    as a rich human

    (much amusement!)
entries.zh:
愿汝死时
    终为富有之人

    (更加愉悦！)

o.en: I'm going to sell it to someone rich. Like Rayan Arroyo.
o.zh: 我打算把它卖给某个有钱人，比如 Rayan Arroyo 。

entries.en:
you ask my name

   i have no other like myself to tell my name back to me
   and/or: i have only myself to tell me back my name
   (a reflection collapsing into unity)

   i would name myself: i-us watch, learn, think
   but, human, that is not what you ask

   i give you my truth
   (not your answer)
entries.zh:
汝问吾名。

   吾并无其他如吾之个体复述吾之名。
   又或：吾之名只有吾来复述。
   (倒影崩坏为团结)

   吾将如此称呼吾：吾-我等 观察，学习，思考
   但，人类，这并非你所问。

   吾给予汝吾之真理
   (而非汝之答案)

entries.en:
then
   i am

   (such amusement!)

   are you satisfied?
entries.zh:
那
   吾便是

   (如此愉悦！)

   汝可如愿？

entries.en:
then
   i am OMEGA

   are you satisfied?
entries.zh:
那
   吾便是 欧米伽

   汝可如愿？

o.en: Open a coded comms channel to discuss the planetkiller weapon with the Knights of Ludd
o.zh: 开启加密通讯频道，与卢德骑士团商讨行星杀手的事宜

entries.en:
As a commissioned militant of the Church of Galactic Redemption, you have been given a set of codes allowing you to more easily coordinate with both fellow militants of the Church and the Knights of Ludd.

Using this access to link in to the Knights' comms network earns your comms officer a rebuke from a Knight-novice who appears to be practically a teenager.
entries.zh:
作为 银河救赎教会 雇佣的武装成员，你获得了一套编码，可借此更便捷地与教会同僚及卢德骑士团成员协同作战。

利用此权限接入骑士团通讯网络的行为，使你的通讯军官遭到了一名看上去还是个青年的见习骑士的斥责。

o.en: Take over the comms and emphasize the importance of your mission
o.zh: 接管通讯，并强调你任务的重要性

entries.en:
The Knight-novice is easily cowed by your authority - and, it appears, the content of your admonishment triggers some kind of oversight.

The image flickers, and a grizzled Knight-captain appears. Without greeting, he says "He wishes to speak with you. Pray bide a moment."

The connection flickers to static, then to a simple holding pattern. The technology of the Knights of Ludd is crude but reliable
entries.zh:
见习骑士很轻易就被你的权威所震慑 —— 并且，你训诫的内容似乎触发了某种监察机制。

随着画面的闪烁，一位面容沧桑的骑士舰长出现了。未作寒暄，他便说道："他要与你对话，请稍候片刻。"

链接闪烁着变为静电杂音，随后进入简单的等候界面。卢德骑士团的技术简陋但可靠。

o.en: Wait to speak with whoever 'he' is
o.zh: 等待与那位 '他' 对话

entries.en:
After nearly two minutes, the connection flickers into life once again.

According to your comm-link metadata it is the Excubitor Orbis of Hesperus who has appeared before you,

"I am Gideon Oak," he says, his stern gaze fixed on you.

Then he waits, patient as stone.
entries.zh:
近两分钟后，链接再次闪烁激活。

根据通讯链接的元数据，此刻出现在你面前的正是 Hesperus 的行星教卫。

"我是 Gideon Oak，" 他说道，严厉的目光锁定着你。

随后他陷入了等待，静如磐石。

o.en: I have a planetkiller weapon to give into the custody of the Knights of Ludd.
o.zh: 我手上有台行星杀手，我来此将其交予卢德骑士团保管。

entries.en:
He silently considers you, and your words.

The moment draws uncomfortably long before he, evidently, decides that he believes you.

"Know that this must be kept from the Hegemony," he says slowly. "They claim unholy inheritance of the old Domain and would be loathe to see us destroy a piece of it."
entries.zh:
他沉默地审视着你，以及你的话语。

场面陷入了漫长而难熬的沉默，但最后他显然还是决定相信你。

"须知此事必须对 霸主 保密，" 他缓缓说道，"他们自称继承了古代 人之领 的非法遗产，也必然不愿看着我们摧毁其中的一块碎片。"

o.en: I understand. I will transfer the planetkiller now.
o.zh: 我理解，现在我就会将行星杀手进行交付。

entries.en:
A squad of Knights led by an inquisitor-captain shuttles to your $shipOrFleet, examines the planetkiller device, speaks a prayer against evil, then takes it back with them.

"You have done well to keep faith with the Faithful, $playerName," the Excubitor Orbis says. "Bless you for your deed."

He does not smile, but there is a just-detectable warmth to his expression nonetheless.
entries.zh:
一支由审判官舰长率领的骑士小队乘坐穿梭机来到了你的$shipOrFleet，他们检查了行星杀手装置，又诵念了几句驱邪祷语，随后便将其带走了。

"你坚守了对信众的忠诚，$playerName，" 行星教卫说道，"祝福你的善举。"

他的脸上没有笑容，但透露出了极其微小的一丝暖意。

o.en: I have a planetkiller weapon to give into the custody of the Knights of Ludd.
o.zh: 我手上有台行星杀手，我来此将其交予卢德骑士团保管。

entries.en:
Data recovery from a Tri-Tachyon war-AI nexus is laborious due to the unusual hardware and the AI-designed data architecture which seems to delight in confounding idiosyncrasies.

"I've heard speculation that it's like art to them," your tech officer says, noticing your attention. "To the AIs, I mean. Like poetry expressed through mathematics."

You know what to look for, however, which makes the often unprofitably onerous data analysis yield results more quickly.
entries.zh:
由于 速子科技 的 AI 战斗中枢那不同寻常的硬件设备以及 AI 设计的数据架构，其中充斥着令人困惑的特征，导致从中恢复数据相当费劲。

"我听闻一种假设说，这对它们而言是某种艺术，" 你的技术军官见你在意，便解释道，"我是指，对那些 AI 来说。就跟用数学来写诗一样。"

不过你知道自己要找什么，因此能让这一般来说艰苦且得不偿失的数据分析工作更快得出有用的结果。

entries.en:
Data recovery from the AI war-nexus is laborious due to the unusual hardware and confoundingly idiosyncratic data architecture.

Your tech officer stumbles on their words from excitement and exhaustion. "A detachment from this nexus encountered a Hegemony fleet. Broke them in minutes, a terrible defeat. Tri-Tachyon had intel protocols; they'd assign AIs to trawl captured datastores then feed that back to more AIs and- ah. There's a planetkiller device."

Your tech officer is wide-eyed. "The weapon. A planetkiller," they repeat with the excited morbidity of a child who, maybe, glimpsed a dead body. "The Hegemony fleet cached it in an asteroid. We got the name of the system it's in!"
entries.zh:
由于 AI 战斗中枢那不同寻常的硬件设备以及充斥着令人困惑特征的数据架构，导致从中恢复数据相当费劲。

你的技术军官兴奋又疲惫，有一句没一句地说道："有一支无人舰队从这个中枢启航，后来它遇到了一支 霸主 舰队。前者没几分钟就把后者碾碎了，真是个可怕的下场。而 速子科技 有一套通讯协议，他们会让 AI 爬取截获的数据，然后将其反馈给其它更多的 AI —— 啊。这提到了一台行星杀手。"

你的技术军官突然瞪大了双眼。"那种武器。一台行星杀手，" 重复的语气像是瞥见了一具尸体的孩子一样狂热又病态，"霸主 舰队把它藏在了某颗小行星上。而我们现在知道它在哪个星系里了！"

entries.en: "That as which was foretold by Ludd," $heOrShe says. "There are a number of signs which were prophesied. Some, but not all, have come to pass."
entries.zh: "那正如卢德的预言，" $heOrShe说道，"很多迹象已经被预言到了。其中一部分，但不是全部，也已经成为现实了。"

entries.en: "This should be an easy deal for you, captain. As an unbeliever, you do not know the rightful fear - and glorious anticipation - of Armageddon."
entries.zh: "这对你来说小事一桩，舰长。作为异教徒，你缺少对世界末日应有的恐惧 —— 以及光荣的期待。"

entries.en:
$HisOrHer lip quirks, something like amusement. "The Persean Sector is filled with slaves of Mammon. They would sell even their family for mere lucre. A cold lead to a planetkiller, one they believe is hidden behind the claws and teeth of their own AI abominations?"

"That is a whisper easily bought."
entries.zh:
$HisOrHer嘴唇诡异地抽动着，好像被你的话逗笑了，"英仙座星域充满了恶魔玛门的奴隶。他们甚至会为了金钱卖掉自己的家人。他们哪里知道，这条指向行星杀手的冰冷线索，正隐藏在自己所信奉的 AI 秽物的尖牙利爪之下？"

"这只是很容易就能买到的小道消息罢了。"

entries.en:
"Revealing our stratagems is not part of the deal," $heOrShe says.

The Pather won't say, of course.

They could very well be trying to make you party to the Path's greatest atrocity since the destruction of the world of Mairaath. Where would they use a PK, Chicomoztoc? Culann? Kazeron?

Millions would die, and the strategic keystone of a major faction reduced to ash.
entries.zh:
"我们并不打算透露自己的战略。" $heOrShe说道。

当然，左径分子不可能会说出来。

他们可能会间接让你牵涉到自 卢德左径 毁灭 Mairaath 世界后最严重的暴行之中。他们会在哪里使用行星杀手？Chicomoztoc？Culann？Kazeron？

这会夺走上百万人的生命，同时某个主要势力的战略支柱将化为灰烬。

entries.en:
"Some have tried." $HeOrShe pauses, eyes lost for just a moment. "They did not return."

Wherever it is, it must be very dangerous or somehow beyond the technical capacity of the Luddic Path to retrieve.

So it's probably well-guarded.
entries.zh:
"有些人试过了。" $HeOrShe停顿了一下，眼神短暂地失焦，"但他们没能返航。"

无论它在哪里，这次行动一定非常危险，或者不知为何超出了 卢德左径 的技术水平。

所以它可能被严密看管着。

entries.en: "Nor we with a defiler of Creation," $heOrShe says calmly. "But you know that's not always true."
entries.zh: "我们也不与玷污造物主的恶徒相处，" $heOrShe平静地说，"但你知道，事实并非总是如此。"

o.en: What would you do with a PK? Is it not unholy?
o.zh: 你要用行星杀手做什么？那不是罪恶的吗？

o.en: If you know where it is, why don't you get it yourself?
o.zh: 如果你知道它在哪，那你为什么不自己去取？

o.en: How do you know this? Is your information good?
o.zh: 你怎么知道的？你的消息准确吗？

o.en: I'm going to need time to think about this.
o.zh: 我需要时间来考虑这件事。

o.en: No! Giving a PK to the Path is beyond reckless.
o.zh: 决不！把行星杀手送给左径，这种行为已经不能用鲁莽来形容了。

o.en: A planetkiller for peace, then. Where do I need to go?
o.zh: 嗯，一台用来维持和平的行星杀手装置。我要去哪找？

o.en: What do you mean by 'End of the world'?
o.zh: 你口中的 '世界末日' 是什么意思？

o.en: I need you people to stop sabotaging my industries.
o.zh: 我要你的人停止在我的工业设施上搞破坏。

o.en: You attack my people. Though I serve the Church, have you not greater enemies?
o.zh: 你们袭击了我的人。尽管我效力于 卢德教会，但除了我，难道就没有对你们威胁更大的敌人了吗？

o.en: I share your Luddic faith, if not your methods. Why do you attack my people?
o.zh: 我将卢德的福音传遍四海，尽管不是用你们的方式，你们为什么还要袭击我的人？

o.en: We are not enemies. Why do you attack my people?
o.zh: 我们并非敌人，为什么你们要袭击我的人？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe takes your words in for a moment, thinking.

"Wide is the chasm between us," $heOrShe says. "You know our aims, and our resolve. We know of the madness which drives you to construct ever larger shrines to Moloch. Alas, if but our prayers were answered! If but your heart was not deaf to Ludd's Word."

"At an impasse, we resort to holy war. But perhaps you and I could explore an alternative - I am not without compromise, despite the lies you've been told."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe听了你的话，沉思片刻。

"我们之间的鸿沟何其宽广，" $heOrShe说道，"你明知我们目标明确，决心坚定。我们知道，疯狂驱使着你为恶魔摩洛克建造着更大的圣地。唉，但凡我们的祈祷得到过回应！但凡你的心没有对卢德的圣言充耳不闻！"

"在绝望中，我们诉诸圣战。但也许你我能探索到别的出路 —— 尽管你对我们撒谎在先，我还是没有放弃和解的选择。"

o.en: You're open to some kind of deal, then.
o.zh: 既然如此，看来你愿意和我做个交易。

o.en: No, I'm done with you. (cut comms)
o.zh: 不，我受够你了。 (切断通讯)

entries.en: "I shall pray for your safe return," $heOrShe says without irony.
entries.zh: "我会祈祷你平安归来。" $heOrShe真诚地说道。

entries.en:
$PersonName's eyes narrow, fully aware that you now know their lead on the planetkiller and have no stated intent to fulfill the proposed deal.

"I shall pray for you," $heOrShe says without apparent irony.
entries.zh:
$PersonName 眯起眼睛，完全意识到你现在已经得到了他们手上关于行星杀手的线索，却没有遵循交易的打算。

"我会为你祈祷。" $heOrShe说道，话语中并没有明显的讽刺意味。

entries.en:
The Pather taps something on a datapad, opening a shared dataspace. "There's a den of abominations - what you would call a Remnant Nexus - which contains data about a Hegemony fleet that had a planetkiller. It is in the $pk_nexusSystemName."

$HeOrShe holds up a hand in anticipation of your questions. "We have confirmed that this Tri-Tachyon source is reliable; their details match Hegemony records concerning a strategic data breach, and a subsequent fleet lost during the first AI War."

"Don't look so surprised, captain," $heOrShe says, chidingly. "Faith in Ludd's Word does not contradict worldly expertise."
entries.zh:
左径分子在数据平板上点了几下，打开了一个共享数据库。"有一个令人憎恶的巢穴，你可以称其为余辉中枢，其中有关于一支 霸主 舰队的数据 —— 那支舰队曾携带过一颗行星杀手。它在 $pk_nexusSystemName 星系里。"

$HeOrShe举起手，抢先制止了你的提问。"我们已经确认这条来自 速子科技 的消息是可靠的。它们的细节符合 霸主 记录中的一次战略数据泄露事件，以及接下来，那一支在第一次 AI 战争中失踪的舰队。"

"别看起来这么吃惊，舰长，" $heOrShe对你的失态略加责备，说道，"信奉卢德福音和使用专业术语之间并不矛盾。"

o.en: I'll find the planetkiller and return it to you.
o.zh: 我会找到那台行星杀手装置，并带给你。

o.en: I'll catch this bird for you. (lie)
o.zh: 我会为你抓住这只鸟的。 (说谎)

entries.en:
The Pather taps something on an old datapad, then pauses. And carefully looks at you.

"Something in my spirit hesitates. Why should that be?" $HeOrShe slowly puts the datapad down. "How did you, a slave to Moloch, come to speak with me so readily? Is this a ruse to use the information so-revealed to ourselves for your own ends? Or for Tri-Tachyon? The Hegemony?"

You can see $hisOrHer expression turning from distrust to disgust. "I won't be your dupe, your fool, your means of finding the tool of the defiler!" $HeOrShe stands, shouting, "Begone from here!"
entries.zh:
那个左径分子在一个老旧的数据平板上敲了几下，然后停了下来，并仔细打量着你。

"我的意志有些犹豫不决。为什么？" $HeOrShe缓缓地放下了数据平板。"你，恶魔摩洛克的奴隶，怎能如此平和地与我交谈？这一定是一个诡计，你是为了你某些不可告人的目的而透露给我们这些信息？还是为了 速子科技？霸主？"

你可以看到$HeOrShe的表情从不信任转为了厌恶。"我不会上你的当，受你的骗，或者沦为你寻找渎神者的工具！" $HeOrShe站起来，喝道："从这里滚出去！"

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods without surprise or consternation. "Then the holy war shall continue."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe没有任何惊讶地点了点头。"那么圣战将会继续。"

entries.en:
"Then think, and return if you find wisdom," $heOrShe says, and drums $hisOrHer fingers a couple times on the comms-console.

"Perhaps a braver, or greedier, heretic will accept my offer first. Perhaps not."
entries.zh:
"那么就好好想想吧，想明白了再回来。" $heOrShe说道，一边用手指在通讯控制台上敲了几下。

"在那之前，也许一个更勇敢，更贪婪的异端会接受我的提议。也许不会。"

entries.en: As long as the Pathers don't use the planetkiller on you, then it's not your problem. Maybe they'll just throw it into a black hole, who can say?
entries.zh: 只要左径教徒们不把行星杀手用在你身上，那就不关你的事。也许他们会把它扔进一个黑洞里，谁知道呢？

entries.en: It would be madness to actually give the planetkiller to the Pather. But if the lead is good, you could remove it from their potential grasp - and decide for yourself where it should end up.
entries.zh: 如果真的把行星杀手交给左径教徒，那就太疯狂了。但如果线索是真的，你可以把它收入你手中 —— 然后自己决定怎么处理它。

entries.en:
A hint of a smile crosses $hisOrHer lips. "We understand one another."

"There is little we want from you; not credits, not ships. However," $heOrShe pauses deliberately. "There is something."

"It would persuade me, and others of like mind in my organization, to set aside the purification of your industries... until Armageddon, of course, when our armies will meet yours in final battle. But until that glorious day you could enjoy your trinkets and idols."
entries.zh:
$hisOrHer嘴唇上掠过一丝笑意。"我们了解彼此。"

"我们想要的东西微不足道；不是星币，不是战舰。然而，" $heOrShe从容不迫地停顿了一下，"是一样别的东西。"

"这会说服我，和我组织中其他志同道合的人，把净化你的工业放在一边... 当然，直到世界末日，我们的军队将在最终决战中与你相遇。但在那荣耀之日到来之前，你可以尽情享受你那些小饰品和神像。"

o.en: What is it you want? Speak plainly.
o.zh: 直说吧，你到底想要什么？

entries.en: $HeOrShe gives a nod, "One planetkiller weapon."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe点了点头，"一台行星杀手装置。"

entries.en:
"I see by your face that you know of these abominations; that unholy craft of the Domain, murderer of Opis and its billions; and Hanan Pacha, and countless others."

"I know where one may be found. Bring it to me and our holy war against you shall end." $HeOrShe lowers $hisOrHer head just a little, "Until the end of the world."
entries.zh:
"你的表情已经说明你对这些可憎事物的了解；人之领 那残害了 Opis 及其数十亿居民的不洁造物；它还毁掉了 Hanan Pacha，和其他数不胜数的世界。"

"我知道哪里能找到一枚。把它带给我，然后我们之间的圣战就会永远结束。" $HeOrShe略微低下了头，"直到世界末日。"

entries.en:
A lost planetkiller is an object of dread which looms over every human in the Persean Sector; it is the bane of Opis, of Hanan Pacha, and the other worlds such atrocity was unleashed upon.

Many a powerful faction will want to secure this weapon so that they may not be dethroned in a shock-atrocity, and many a minor faction will want to use it to secure respect and protection. Ludd only knows what the Pathers would do with it, to say nothing of pirates.
entries.zh:
一颗下落不明的行星杀手是笼罩在英仙座星域每个人头顶上的不祥阴影。它那残暴肆虐的力量，是曾让 Opis、Hanan Pacha 以及其他世界覆灭的罪魁祸首。

许多强大的势力都希望能拥有这样一件武器，来确保他们不会因为一次闪电突袭就被踢下王座。而许多二流势力也希望用其确保自己能受到尊重和保护。至于左径信徒会拿这件装置干些什么，恐怕只有卢德他老人家才会知道，更别提那些海盗了。

entries.en:
A lost planetkiller is an object of dread which looms over every human in the Persean Sector; it is the bane of Opis, of Hanan Pacha, and the other worlds such atrocity was unleashed upon.

Ludd only knows what the Luddic Path would plan to do with such a device, and when you made your agreement, you didn't intend to find out by doing something so foolish as handing it over.

They might guess what you've found, however. In time, word will trickle through their network of Watchers, whether from some informant in your crew, or prayer and guesswork.
entries.zh:
一颗下落不明的行星杀手是笼罩在英仙座星域所有人类头顶上的不祥阴影；在被它蹂躏过的其它所有世界上，包括 Opis，Hanan Pacha 在内，都留下了刻骨铭心的伤痛。

只有卢德他老人家才知道左径信徒会打算用这样的装置干些什么，而当你敲定这笔交易时，可没有蠢到简简单单地把行星杀手交出去只为了看看这样做会带来何种后果。

无论你作出何种努力，他们都会很快知道你发现了些什么。消息会通过他们的监视网络不胫而走，无论是来自你船员中的线人，亦或者是祈祷与臆测。

entries.en:
A lost planetkiller is an object of dread which looms over every human in the Persean Sector; it is the bane of Opis, of Hanan Pacha, and the other worlds such atrocity was unleashed upon.

Ludd only knows what the Luddic Path plans to do with such a device. You did agree to hand it over to them, however. Perhaps they simply want to guarantee their safety and standing in the Sector. Perhaps they want to destroy the abomination.

Whatever you choose to do, they will know what you've found before long. Word will trickle through their network of Watchers, whether from some informant in your crew, or prayer and guesswork.
entries.zh:
一颗下落不明的行星杀手是笼罩在英仙座星域所有人类头顶上的不祥阴影；在被它蹂躏过的其它所有世界上，包括 Opis，Hanan Pacha 在内，都留下了刻骨铭心的伤痛。

只有卢德他老人家才知道左径信徒会打算用这样的装置干些什么。然而你已经同意把行星杀手交给他们，也许他们只是想保障自己在这片星域里的安全和立足之地 —— 也许他们只是想毁掉这台可怕的憎恶科技造物。

无论你作出何种努力，他们都会很快知道你发现了些什么。消息会通过他们的监视网络不胫而走，无论是来自你船员中的线人，亦或者是祈祷与臆测。

entries.en:
The rock that autonomous fleet was defending is pocked with hiding holes, empty, and fuel and supply stores, also empty. After a thorough sensor sweep, your ops chief finally gives the order, and the salvors move in to uncover a camouflaged access point.

The shaky image from a helmetcam reveals the carapace of terrestrial death, glittering in the chaotic play of suitlamps.

One planetkiller.

Your ops chief cuts the excited chatter between salvors with a harsh word, and they return to procedural call-and-response. The planetkiller is soon secured in your flagship.
entries.zh:
那支全自动舰队所保护的小行星上布满了空荡荡的隐藏洞穴，里面的燃料和补给库空空如也。在彻底的传感器扫描后，你的行动长官终于下达了命令，让打捞员们进入了其中一个隐藏的对接口。

头戴式摄像机传回的抖动画面之中，映出了崩灭大地之物的外壳，它在便携灯混乱的照射下闪闪发光。

那是一台行星杀手。

你的行动长官一声令下，打断了打捞员们兴奋的七嘴八舌，他们又开始一如既往地做出回复。行星杀手很快就被送到了你的旗舰上。

entries.en:
A party of the inhabitants wearing masks and hoods meet you halfway.

Their guards, at the back, hold weapons slung; standard Domain-fab carbines. Their clothing is repurposed utility forgecloth, the type used to line cargo bays and maintenance conduits. They wear adornments denoting status made of worn but well-polished military insignia; winged phoenixes and stars. Hegemony crew survivors. And they've been here for a long time, from the looks of it.

A leader steps forward, pulling off her goggles. "Did we win?" she asks.
entries.zh:
一群身着面罩与兜帽的当地住民在途中与你们会面了。

这群人的卫兵在队伍的后方，随身的标准预制型人之领卡宾枪被吊在背带上。他们的衣着是改制后再利用的勤务合成服，就是在负责管理货舱和钻维护通道的人员身上会看到的那种。但他们的身上依旧有着一些用来表明职务与地位的装饰品，由磨损严重但依旧擦得锃亮的军徽制成 —— 那是双翼绽开的不死鸟与群星。这群人是 霸主 的幸存船员，而且根据他们的样子来看，这群人已经在这里待了相当，相当长的一段时间了。

他们的领队走上前来，一边摘下了她的护目镜。"我们赢了吗？" 她问道。

o.en: The First AI War or the Second?
o.zh: 第一次 AI 战争还是第二次？

entries.en:
The leader exchanges glances with her companions, taking in the implication of your words.

You are invited to their settlement, to continue your conversation out of the cold. These castaways have not forgotten hospitality, in their manner.

Or, perhaps, their leader - an elder by the name of Alo Skiron called "commander" by her lieutenants - knows the wisdom of controlling the spread of potentially explosive news from the outside Sector.
entries.zh:
头领与她的同伴们交换着眼神，尝试着接受你话里的言外之意。

你受邀进入了他们的聚落，寻一个稍微暖和一点的场所继续谈话。至少这些落难者依旧没有忘记基本的待客之道 —— 至少是以他们的标准来说。

亦或者，是他们的头领 —— 一位被她的 "中尉" 们称呼为 "指挥官" 的，名叫 Alo Skiron 的长老 —— 明智地选择了一种能够将外部星域中传来的爆炸性新闻控制在最低传播限度的手段。

entries.en:
You are led to a cluster of neat, low structures; earthworks and hull panels spotted with forgeglass and chimney. The streets are clean and the citizenry uniformed by job role. Despite fixing you with open stares, they do not falter in their assignments.

Commander Skiron welcomes you and your party into a central meeting hall. It is warm, and festooned with Hegemony paraphernalia: uniforms, weapons, etched insignia from supply-case lids. The hand-worked reverence brings to mind a Luddic shrine that has undergone conversion to worship a martial god.

You pretend to sip a wretched yeast-derived ersatz tea - coffee maybe? - given to you by Skiron's attendants.
entries.zh:
你被带往了一群简单，低矮的建筑群中。这些建筑大多由土方与星舰的船体结构板构成，烟囱和预铸玻璃点缀其中。街道十分干净，居民们身着自己职业对应的制服。尽管他们的目光都赤裸裸地盯着你们，但没有一人停下自己手上的工作。

Skiron 指挥官将你们一行人迎进了一座中心议会厅。这里不仅相当温暖，还装饰着 霸主 相关的随身装备：制服，武器，补给箱盖上抠下的徽记等等。这些手工制作的纪念物几乎让你以为这是一座卢德圣地，只不过进行了一些翻修，好重新用来敬拜一位军武之神。

对于 Skiron 的侍从端上来的劣质酵母衍生物代茶 —— 说不定是代咖啡？—— 你则是假装抿了一口。

entries.en:
"You come from the Core Worlds, yes?" Skiron asks, "We must get back in contact with our proper chain of command. The protocols command it."

Behind her, attendants and guards all mumble something in unison. You think you catch the word 'protocols'.
entries.zh:
"你们是从核心世界来的，对吗？" Skiron 开口问道，"我们必须和正式的指挥链重新建立联系，一切皆为纪律之命。"

在她身后，侍从与守卫们一起咕哝着相似的话语。你觉得你好像听到了 "纪律" 二字。

entries.en:
"Will you bring word of us to the Persean Hegemony of the Fourteenth Battlegroup? They must have survived, yes? The Protocols promise that you will be rewarded, and we, saved."

(Behind her, in unison, you hear intoned the words "Reward and Salvation," in not quite the sing-song of group prayer.)

Now you can see the strange gleam in Skiron's eyes, as if she is looking up at the unwitting savior from her religion. And at the same time, something like fear, even panic, under the mania; you are an outsider.

They don't have outsiders here.
entries.zh:
"你愿意将我们的消息传达给 第十四战斗群英仙座星域霸主统摄政权 吗？他们肯定幸存下来了，对吗？纪律保证了你会得到嘉奖，而我们则会得到 —— 救赎。"

(在她身后，你又听到了人们齐声，用好似又不似祈祷与合唱的声音反复念着 "嘉奖与救赎"。)

现在 Skiron 像是看见了她信仰中的救世主一般，眼底正散发着奇异的微光。而与此同时，那眼神中在狂热之下也还埋藏着些许恐惧，甚至是惊慌，因为你是个外来者。

他们这里从来就没有过外来者。

entries.en:
Skiron's face goes into a blank just-following-orders expression you know very well.

"Protocol forbids me from discussing strategic matters in a time of war. I would need authorization. We must re-establish contact with Command."

("Command is Salvation," they say together, behind her.)
entries.zh:
Skiron 的脸上摆出了一副你早已见过不知道多少次的，除了死板地服从命令外什么都看不出来的冷淡表情。

"纪律禁止我们在战时状态下向无关人士透露战略情报，除非得到上级授权。我们必须重新建立与指挥部的联系。"

("指挥部即为救赎，" 人们在她身后齐声说到。)

entries.en:
Skiron's face automatically moves toward a blank expression of denial, but relaxes as she catches herself.

"The Protocols forbid me from discussing strategic matters without authorization from Command," she says, "But as a commissioned auxiliary, I should give you the sitrep."

She takes a deep breath, then begins. "Our orders were to destroy a staging point for the Tri-Tachyon AI warfleets, a vast automated station. The last intel said it was under construction, but..."
entries.zh:
Skiron 的脸上几乎下意识地摆出了一副抗拒的冷淡表情，但很快就放松了下来。

"纪律严禁我们与没有得到指挥部授权的人士透露重要的战略信息，" 她说到，"但作为霸主签约下的辅助军官，你理应得到一份简报。"

她深吸了一口气，便继续说了下去。"我们接到的命令是摧毁其中一个 速子科技 AI 战斗舰队的集合点，一座颇具规模的自律太空站。我们最后得到的情报是其仍旧处于建造的过程当中，但是..."

o.en: It was fully armed and operational.
o.zh: 那支舰队武装齐全，依旧处于运作状态。

entries.en:
"Yes. And accompanied by an armada of AI warships. Our ancestors disengaged, but most of their logistical ships were lost."

"Their fleet could not return to the Core Worlds, so one small detachment was sent back with the remaining fuel and news of the defeat. It appears that they were intercepted."

"Our ancestors found the closest habitable world, called Sentinel in the old surveys. We settled here, with what salvage could be spared."
entries.zh:
"没错，而且还跟着一整支 AI 舰队大军。我们的祖先最终得以脱离战斗，但他们的大部分后勤舰船都损失殆尽了。"

"他们的舰队无法返回核心世界，所以只能凑出余下的燃料让一支小型先遣队带着他们失败的战报回程。但很显然，那支先遣队肯定是被中途拦截了。"

"我们的祖先从古老的调查数据中找到了这个他们最近的宜居世界，并称之为 Sentinel。在回收利用一切可以利用的东西后，他们就在这里安家落户了下来。"

o.en: Your settlement is smaller than what could be built from an entire fleet of salvage.
o.zh: 和打捞一整支舰队所能回收的物资相比，你们的定居点有些小了。

entries.en:
"You observe well," Skiron admits.

"I should say no more until I receive orders from Command, as I'm sure you understand, $playerSirOrMadam."
entries.zh:
"你的确观察到了不少东西，" Skiron 承认道。

"直到指挥部的命令传来前，我不会再向你透露半个字，希望你能见谅，$playerSirOrMadam。"

entries.en:
Skiron's face goes into a blank just-following-orders expression you know very well.

"Protocol forbids me from discussing strategic matters in a time of war. I would need authorization from Command."

("Command is salvation," they say together, behind her.)

"But," she pauses, looking troubled. "I will say this much: we faced great danger. You should be watchful."
entries.zh:
Skiron 的脸上摆出了一副你早已见过不知道多少次的，除了死板地服从命令外什么都看不出来的冷淡表情。

"纪律禁止我们在战时状态下透露战略情报，除非得到上级授权。"

("指挥部即为救赎，" 人们在她身后齐声说到。)

"但是。" 片刻的停顿后，她面露难色，"我们曾面对过巨大的危机，你应该小心一点，我只能向你透露这么多。"

entries.en:
"Yes... yes, we saw lights in the sky about a cycle ago." Skiron says.

"We don't have advanced instrumentation, so we could not identify the opposed forces. We're pretty sure from the visible drive spectra - and weapons-blink - that it wasn't a Tri-Tachyon warfleet."
entries.zh:
"是的... 是的，我们在大约一星历年前在天上看到了光。" Skiron 说道。

"我们没有先进的设备，所以我们无法区分交战双方。但是从能观测到的引擎光谱 —— 还有武器闪光 —— 那不是 速子科技 的作战舰队。"

o.zh: 舰载武器开火的闪光？这片星系里最近发生了战斗吗？

entries.en:
"Um," she looks cowed. "So we believe. None of the elder-crew still live. But they told stories of such conflicts as seen from distant worlds, and... we have training manuals. And holos, though most have broken down by now."

"But we have trained in accordance with The Protocols!" she says, rallying. "Our data is limited, it is true, but we have recorded all observations and movements in great detail." ("The Protocols are Truth," they say behind her.)

"Our interpretation suggests a mix of low to mid-tech warships were engaged in combat, with occasional flashes of higher-energy spectra." She looks proud, but nervous, as she delivers these details.

"Whoever - whatever - it was, they did not contact us."
entries.zh:
"唔，" 她看上去有些畏缩。"我们是这样认为的。之前的老船员全都过世了，但他们讲过从遥远的星球上看，这种战斗会是什么样子的，而且... 我们还有训练手册，还有全息视频，虽然大部分现在都坏了。"

"但是我们按照纪律进行过训练！" 她重整了下姿态，说道，"确实，我们信息有限，但是我们仔细记录了所有观察到的细节和动作。" ("纪律即为真理。"人们在她身后说道。)

"据我们分析，参战舰船的技术水平总体处于低至中等，偶尔还能观测到高能光谱闪烁。" 提供这些报告时，她看上去紧张但自豪。

"不论参战的是谁...是什么，他们都没有与我们联系。"

entries.en:
Skiron gives you another of her blank looks; wrestling with the demands of Protocols. After a moment's consideration, compassion eases her expression.

"Protocol forbids me to reveal intel," Skiron says, "But it is known fact that our ancestors came here to fight Tri-Tachyon's AI warfleets. They are not... limited, as we are, by the human lifespan."

Her gaze goes upward for a moment, toward the fearful skies.
entries.zh:
Skiron 又向你投来她那副淡然的表情，估计是在心里和纪律的要求做着斗争。考虑一刻后，同情让她的表情柔和了一些。

"纪律不许我透露机密信息，" Skiron 说道，"但是众所周知，我们的祖先来此和 速子科技 的 AI 舰队作战。那些 AI 舰队不像我们... 受制于人类的寿命。"

她双眼略微向上瞥了一下，瞥向那可怖的天穹。

entries.en:
One of her lieutenants uses the lull to speaks up, "A cycle ago, the lights in the sky-"

"We don't know what those were!" Skiron shouts to silence the lieutenant, and rewards them with a look that promises disciplinary action.

She turns back to you, composed. "There may be someone, or something, still out there and operational. Our sensors are not sophisticated," she taps next to her eye.

"That is all we can say."
entries.zh:
她手下一个副官趁这个停顿开了口，"一个星历年前，天上的光——"

"我们不清楚那是什么！" Skiron 斥停了那个副官，并给他一个要事后处分的眼光。

她整理好了情绪，再度转向你，"外面可能有某些人，某些东西，依旧存在并且能够运行。我们的传感器不够精密。" 她揉了揉眼角。

"我能说的只有这么多了。"

entries.en:
"Yes, of course," she nods. "They are the regulations which we adhere to. They ensure continuity of the mission. We have followed the Protocols for many-" she looks back at her retinue, who have started mumbling something prayer-like, and gives a brief wave of admonition. They go quiet, and Skiron turns back to you.

"-For over one hundred cycles. We have followed the manuals and re-taught the training of our ancestors. We follow the orders left for us to carry out. Until we receive orders otherwise, this is as it must be."

(Behind her, you hear a chorus of reverent "Ayes" in affirmation.)
entries.zh:
"当然了。" 她点头道，"这些是我们所遵从的规章制度，它们保证了我们能够继续执行任务。我们已经遵从纪律长达 ——" 她用近乎警告般的眼神看向了自己正开始默念某些类似于祈祷的随行人员们，让他们安静了下来，随后，Skiron 将视线移回了你的身上。

"—— 已经长达一百个星历年了。我们遵从着手册上的内容，向后代传授着我们的祖先所接受过的训练。遵从着托付于我们的命令，直到新的指令传来，此乃必要之事。"

(在她身后，你听到她的随从们肯定地齐声传出了一片 "是的"。)

entries.en:
Commander Skiron considers her answer before speaking.

"We are descended from the crews of a Hegemony flotilla active during the Great AI War. None of the original crew survive for it has been over a hundred cycles since planetfall. We have maintained continuity of command," she touches the crest attached to her 'uniform', "As per Hegemony cut-off protocols. The Protocols are survival."

("The Protocols are Life," they intone behind Skiron.)
entries.zh:
Skiron 指挥官在开口前思量了片刻。

"我们是活跃于 AI 战争时期的 霸主 舰队乘员的后代。因为自我们降落于此已经过去了百年之久，原先的舰员没有一个能存活至今，但我们依旧维持着指挥链的存续。" 她摩挲着她那身 '制服' 上的霸主徽标，"就如 霸主 的标准失联应对纪律一般，纪律即为我们生存的关键。"

("纪律即为生命，" 他们在 Skiron 身后齐声念到。)

entries.en:
Moving delicately away from the subject of Protocols, you inquire about the details of the lost crews' survival.

Skiron speaks in general terms about building infrastructure to survive the elements, the hardships they faced - long winters, shortfalls of food, and maintaining discipline. Though she expands on few of the details citing "tactical concerns", it is clear this is the sort of story which is the grist of countless genre holodramas.

You definitely get the feeling that Skiron is holding something back.
entries.zh:
你谨慎地将话题从所谓的 "纪律" 上岔开，询问起了这些落难船员是如何生存下来的。

Skiron 与你谈起他们是如何建起居所遮风挡雨，还有他们曾经面临的困境 —— 漫长的冬天，短缺的食物，还有在舰员之中如何维持纪律。不过她还是因为某些 "战术上的考量" 而对诸多细节有所保留，但就像无数你曾经看过的全息剧集的戏码一样，这个借口听起来相当老套。

你感觉 Skiron 肯定在隐瞒着些什么。

entries.en:
Thankful for your own openness, Commander Skiron seems pleased to share the story of her settlement.

"We are descended from the crews of a Hegemony flotilla active during the Great AI War. The ah, the First AI War, as you call it," Skiron explains. "None of the original crew survive, for it has been over 100 cycles since planetfall. We have maintained continuity of command," she touches the crest attached to her 'uniform', "As per Hegemony cut-off protocols. The Protocols are survival."

("The Protocols are Life," they say together behind her.)
entries.zh:
在谢过你的开诚布公后，Skiron 指挥官看起来很愿意与你分享她聚落的故事。

"我们是在 AI 战争时期活跃的一支 霸主 舰队幸存乘员的后代。啊，用你的话来说，第一次 AI 战争。" Skiron 解释道，"自从我们降落于此星球后已过去了一百个星历年，原先的乘员里没有一个能活到今天，但我们维持着指挥链的延续。" 她抚摸着那身 '制服' 上的霸主徽标，"就如 霸主 纪律中规定的标准失联应对一般，纪律即为生存。"

("纪律即为生命。" 他们在 Skiron 身后齐声念到。)

entries.en:
Moving delicately away from the subject of Protocols, you inquire about the details of the lost crews' survival.

Skiron tells of building infrastructure to survive the elements, of assembling a crude industrial and bioproductive base using survival manuals, scrapped materials, and the simple nanoforges they could adapt from the remains of their fleet. Their story is one of remarkable endurance and adaptability, the grist of countless genre holodramas.

You get the feeling, however, that Skiron is holding something back.
entries.zh:
你谨慎地将话题从所谓的 "纪律" 上岔开，询问起了这些落难船员是如何生存下来的。

Skiron 与你谈起他们是如何建立起能够遮风挡雨的基础设施，如何利用从生存手册中的知识与回收的材料，以及数台从残余的舰船中回收而来的简易纳米锻炉组建起粗糙的基础工业和生体培养设施。这段故事就如许多流行全息剧的戏码一样，展示着这群幸存者惊人的毅力与对环境的适应力。

然而，你还是感觉 Skiron 肯定在隐瞒着些什么。

entries.en: "I will not confirm or deny any fact or inference you may suggest, $playerSirOrMadam," Skiron says. "I suggest we speak of other matters."
entries.zh: "我不会认定或否定任何你所谓的结论或推断。$playerSirOrMadam。" Skiron 说道，"我建议我们换个话题。"

entries.en:
"Captain," Skiron says, leaning forward, adopting a low, comradely tone. "You are a leader, and an auxiliary of the Hegemony Navy. You understand the necessities of command. Of initiative. I do not know the Core worlds, but I do know of living here, on the Far Fringe."

She takes a breath, holds it, and lets it go. "Whatever was done by those that came before, I trust that they were dutiful and served their mission. If they, if we, if I have anything to answer for, it is my duty to stand before Command and answer for it."
entries.zh:
"舰长。" Skiron 倾过身子，像个老战友般低声说道，"您是个领导者，以及 霸主 海军的辅助军。您明白指挥的重要。主动性的重要。我不了解核心世界，但我懂如何在边缘星区生存。"

她深吸了一口气，然后缓缓吐出。"不论前人到底干了什么，我相信他们尽职地完成了他们的任务。如果他们，或者我们需要向任何人负责，那我的使命便是向指挥部负责。"

entries.en:
She raises her voice, addressing everyone present. "And so I shall. As commander, I take full responsibility for the execution of our Mission, and shall proceed until Command says otherwise - or I die in the line of duty."

("Command is Salvation!" they say behind her, forcefully, affirming their loyalty to Skiron and to the mission. Whatever it is.)
entries.zh:
她提高声音，向所有的在场的人发话。"因此我会这么做。作为指挥官，我对我们任务的执行负全责。我会一直如此，直到指挥部另有安排，或我尽忠而亡。"

("指挥部便是救赎！"人们在她身后喊道，再一次表明了他们的忠心。对 Skiron 的忠心，又或是对他们任务的忠心。)

entries.en:
"I can not confirm or deny any fact or inference you may suggest, $playerSirOrMadam," Skiron says. "As you can see, we do not have spacefaring capabilities here, and I am forbidden from discussing even historical operations until such a time as they have been declassified by Command."

She crosses her arms. "I suggest we speak of other matters."
entries.zh:
"我不能认定或否定任何你指出的所谓事实或者推论，$playerSirOrMadam。" Skiron 说道，"如你所见，我们这里并没有进行太空航行的能力，而且除非指挥部解除加密，否则我亦无权讨论过去的行动。"

她双手交叉。"我建议我们换个话题。"

o.en: I was attacked by that fleet. Your ancestors left a deadly trap.
o.zh: 那支舰队袭击了我们。你们的祖先可算是留下了好一个致命陷阱。

entries.en:
"War sows a deadly crop," Skiron says, turning her eyes to one of the Hegemony crests etched into a battered hull-plate. "And conscripts the innocent to die, and makes unfeeling machines of humanity."

"Whatever was done in the past, you are alive, and so are we."
entries.zh:
"战争会洒下致命的种子。" Skiron 说道，她低头看向破烂舱壁上的 霸主 徽标，"战争把无辜者征召起来，送他们去死，将人心铸造成无情的机器。"

"不论过去做了什么，你还活着，我们也是。"

o.en: The truth must be told, no matter how uncomfortable.
o.zh: 真相必须被揭露，无论是多令人不快的真相。

entries.en:
"An admirable principle in the abstract, captain," she says. "I wonder if you grant it to your crew as eagerly as to yourself."

"But enough hypotheticals," Skiron gives you a hard look. "I shall respect your principles so long as you respect our need to maintain discipline. This is not a soft world. We prioritize survival over your fine ideals because the alternative was death."

She turns her eyes to the largest Hegemony crest, etched into a hull plate removed from some XIV Battlegroup hull. "Take your truth to the Core worlds and let Command be our judge."

"I believe our conversation is concluded."
entries.zh:
"在抽象的层面上，这确实是个值得赞许的原则，舰长。" 她说道，"但我好奇，当面对你自己的船员时，你是否也能像对你自己那样爽快地说出真相。"

"不过没必要再空谈这些猜测了。" Skiron 给你一个严厉的眼神，"只要你能遵守我们维护纪律的需要，我也能尊重你的原则。这不是个温和的世界。我们的生存要优先于你高贵的信念，不然下场便是死亡。"

她转过眼，看向舱壁上从某艘第十四战斗群船体上搜来的 霸主 徽标。"把你的真相带回核心世界 ，让指挥部进行裁决吧。"

"我认为我们之间的交谈已经结束了。"

o.en: I'm willing to keep it quiet. For the greater good.
o.zh: 为了大多数人的利益，我愿意对此缄口不提。

entries.en:
"I am glad to hear it," Skiron says. "Though you certainly chose an awkward opportunity to exclaim such devotion, captain."

"Regardless, it is Command that will judge us - and our ancestors - for what we have accomplished and for what we have failed."

She looks at one of the huge XIV Battlegroup crests etched into scarred hullplate. "I believe we each know where we stand. I thank you for coming here."
entries.zh:
"我很高兴听你这么说。" Skiron 说道，"不过你确实选了个相当尴尬的时机来宣扬你对此的信念，舰长。"

"不论如何，会审判我们 —— 还有我们祖先 —— 的只有指挥部，我们的功过将会由他们来决定。"

她看向镶在伤痕累累的舱壁上的，那巨大的 '第十四战斗群' 徽标。"我相信我们已经理解了彼此的立场。感谢你来到这里。"

o.en: I'm willing to keep it quiet. For adequate compensation.
o.zh: 只要有个合适的价钱，我也是愿意乖乖闭嘴的。

entries.en:
"I must admit, captain, I expected you to be more devoted to a higher cause. Perhaps the standards for auxiliaries have dropped in the past hundred cycles."

"Nonetheless. Weapons are tools, and by extension, so are those that wield them. Would the Persean Hegemony turn from a useful tool? No." She gives you a meaningful look, as if to admit that she isn't speaking only of mercenaries.

"We have no credits here, if that is what you are asking," she continues. "Command will see to your bill after you report our position. And now that we know where we each stand, I believe that our conversation is concluded."
entries.zh:
"我必须承认，舰长，我以为你所奋斗的事业会更加崇高。或许过去百年来 辅助军 的标准已经不如以往了。"

"不论如何。武器是工具，驾驭武器者也一样。英仙座霸主 会放弃有用的工具吗？不会。" 她向你投来一个意味深长的眼神，似乎是承认了她所指的并非仅仅是雇佣兵。

"如果你想要星币，我们这里没有。" 她继续道，"你汇报我们的坐标后，指挥部会处理你们的账单。既然我们已了解彼此的立场，我认为我们的对话就此结束了。"

o.en: The use of AIs in war is a crime under Hegemony's law.
o.zh: 根据 霸主 的法律，在战争中使用 AI 的行径属于犯罪。

entries.en:
She looks at you. "I should think you would be unsurprised to find that military concerns of the Persean Hegemony dictate a higher law than that of civilians. Concern for abstract hypocrisies? Such worries are for soft worlds."

"To your point, it is Command that shall judge us - and our ancestors - for what we have accomplished and for what we have failed."

She looks at one of the huge XIV Battlegroup crests etched into a scarred hullplate. "I believe we each know where we stand. I thank you for coming here.
entries.zh:
她看向你。"英仙座霸主 的军事考量要高于针对平民的法律，我认为你应该不会对这一点感到意外。至于对抽象虚伪的顾虑？那只存在于软弱的世界上。"

"说到你的观点，会审判我们 —— 还有我们祖先 —— 的只有指挥部，我们的功过将会由他们来决定。"

她看向镶在伤痕累累的舱壁上的，那巨大的 '第十四战斗群' 徽标。"我相信我们已经理解了彼此的立场。感谢你来到这里。"

o.en: Forcing AIs to fight your war is unconscionable.
o.zh: 强迫 AI 们为你们的战争卖命是不人道的。

entries.en:
"I have not yet learned of a war won on conscience, captain. You must find that we have little time for that on the Far Fringe."

"Regardless," Skiron says, sweeping a hand as if to clear away such talk, "It is done. Weapons are tools, and by extension, so are those that wield them. The Persean Hegemony has taken both conscript and volunteer. Would any military seeking victory turn from a useful tool?" She leaves the question hanging and potent.

"It is Command that shall judge us - and our ancestors - for what we have accomplished and for what we have failed."

She looks to one of the huge XIV Battlegroup crests etched into a scarred hullplate. "I believe we each know where we stand. I thank you for coming here."
entries.zh:
"我还没听说过哪场战争是靠所谓人道打赢的，舰长。你要明白，在边缘星区，我们可没时间悲天悯人。"

"不论如何，" Skiron 说道，一边挥手，仿佛试图挥散这个话题，"事已至此。武器是工具，同理，操作武器的人也一样。英仙座霸主 既接受志愿兵，又招募动员兵。若一支军队想要取得胜利，那它又为什么会放弃有用的工具呢？" 她抛下了这一尖锐的问题，没有回答。

"会审判我们 —— 还有我们祖先 —— 的只有指挥部，我们的功过将会由他们来决定。"

她看向镶在伤痕累累的舱壁上的，那巨大的 '第十四战斗群' 徽标。"我相信我们已经理解了彼此的立场。感谢你来到这里。"

o.en: AI is an abomination unto God.

entries.en:
"There are still Luddics among us who agree with you," she says. "And they understand full well that toleration is a contingent state of affairs. Has that been forgotten in the Core?"

"Regardless," Skiron says, sweeping a hand as if to clear away such talk, "It is done. Weapons are tools, and by extension, so are those that wield them. The Persean Hegemony has taken both conscript and volunteer. Would any who truly seek victory turn from a useful tool?" She leaves the question hanging.

"It is Command that shall judge us - and our ancestors - for what we have accomplished and for what we have failed."

She looks to one of the huge XIV Battlegroup crests etched into a scarred hullplate. "I believe we each know where we stand. I thank you for coming here.
entries.zh:
"我们之中依然存在认同你观点的卢德教徒。" 她说道，"但他们也清楚地明白，容忍只是一种暂时的权宜状态。难道这一点已经在核心世界中被遗忘了吗？"

"不论如何，" Skiron 说道，一边挥手，仿佛试图挥散这个话题，"事已至此。武器是工具，同理，操作武器的人也一样。英仙座霸主 既接受志愿兵，又招募动员兵。若一支军队想要取得胜利，那它又为什么会放弃有用的工具呢？" 她抛下了这一尖锐的问题，没有回答。

"会审判我们 —— 还有我们祖先 —— 的只有指挥部，我们的功过将会由他们来决定。"

她看向镶在伤痕累累的舱壁上的，那巨大的 '第十四战斗群' 徽标。"我相信我们已经理解了彼此的立场。感谢你来到这里。"

o.en: It was the right thing to do. AIs are a powerful tool.
o.zh: AI 是强大的工具，你们当初做了正确的选择。

entries.en:
"Then you agree with the decision my ancestors made." Skiron seems no more pleased at this revelation than anything you've said.

"And that decision was not made without dissent," she adds. "Even mutiny." Her eyes go hard and cold as the barren landscape of Sentinel.

"War sows a deadly crop," Skiron says after a time, turning her gaze to a crest of the XIV Battlegroup etched into a battered hull-plate. "And bears bitter fruit to those who survive."

"I believe we each know where we stand. I thank you for coming here."
entries.zh:
"那你便是认同了我祖先的决定。" Skiron 对此似乎并没有感到特别的欣慰。

"而那个决定也带来了反对。" 她补充道，"甚至是叛乱。" 她的眼神如 Sentinel 荒芜的土地一般冷冽。

"战争会洒下致命的种子。" Skiron 说到，她低头看向破烂舱壁上 '第十四战斗群' 的徽标。"然后给幸存者留下苦涩的果实。"

"我相信我们已经理解了彼此的立场。感谢你来到这里。"

entries.en:
Skiron looks at you for a long time, motionless. Her guards' tense, and shuffle uneasily, though keep their weapons slung. Her lieutenants maintain carefully neutral expressions.

She closes her eyes and takes a deep breath, apparently coming to a decision.
entries.zh:
Skiron 一动不动地观察了你很久。她的卫兵都紧张不安地来回移动，不过都还是把武器挂在肩上。她的副官们小心维持着中立地表情。

她闭眼深吸了口气，似乎下定了决心。

entries.en:
Skiron stands, and her lieutenants rush to follow her lead, forming an unsteady echelon behind her.

"Our time for conversation is at an end, captain. We thank you for your visit."

Her guards step forward.
entries.zh:
Skiron 站了起来，她的副官们急匆匆地跟随其后，阶梯状站在她身后。

"我们对话的时间结束了，舰长。我感谢你的参观。"

她的卫兵们向前迈步。

entries.en:
Skiron stands, and her lieutenants rush to follow her lead, forming an unsteady echelon behind her.

Her guards step forward.

"Clear the room," she says. "The captain and I shall remain."
entries.zh:
Skiron 站了起来，她的副官们急匆匆地跟随其后，阶梯状站在她身后。

她的卫兵们向前迈步。

"现在清场。" 她说道，"舰长和我会单独留下。"

entries.en:
Everyone files out without a word. A few of Skiron's people give you odd looks.

When the heavy door is shut softly behind you, Skiron lets out a sigh and sits. Then looks at you, chin in hand.

"I am uncertain of what you hope to gain. You of all people must understand the need to maintain discipline."
entries.zh:
所有人无声地排成一排离开。Skiron 的几个手下向你投来了奇怪的眼光。

在厚重的门轻轻关上之后，Skiron 叹了口气，坐了下去。她随后托着下巴看向你。

"我不确定你想得到什么。和其他人相比，你最该知道维持纪律的重要性。"

entries.en:
"A staging point for the salvage required to construct our settlement," Skiron says with a blank-faced orders-following look.

You're familiar with the expression. When a subordinate wishes to conceal information without technically lying, they might answer with only and exactly what was asked.
entries.zh:
"这是一个用于收集建设定居点所需打捞物资的中转站。" Skiron 带着一张奉令办事的单调脸色说道。

你很明白这个表情，这是下级不想撒谎，却想要对上级隐瞒一些事情时的样子。这种时候，对方只会精确回答你所问的问题，不多说一句。

entries.en: "Yes. Our ancestors constructed a temporary dockyard to perform the salvage and staging required to construct our settlement," Skiron says, then pauses. "And adapting the remaining war-fighting elements of the fleet."
entries.zh: "是的，我们的祖先建造了一个临时船坞用以储藏和分配我们所收集的材料，用以建设定居点。" Skiron 停顿了一下，继续说道，"也用以重新改造舰队的剩余战力。"

entries.en: No word about the rest of the fleet, however.
entries.zh: 然而，对于剩余的舰队，她却只字未提。

entries.en: No word about adapting the fleet into an autonomous fighting force loyal to the Hegemony.
entries.zh: 对于将舰队改造为一支效忠于 霸主 的自动化作战舰队一事，她则只字未提。

entries.en: No word about adapting the fleet into an autonomous fighting force loyal to the Hegemony, using AI cores to command warships- just like Tri-Tachyon.
entries.zh: 对于将舰队改造为一支效忠于 霸主 的自动化作战舰队，并像 速子科技 那样使用 AI 核心指挥战舰一事，她则只字未提。

entries.en:
"Yes. Our ancestors constructed a temporary dockyard to perform the salvage and staging required to construct our settlement," Skiron says, her face and tone the image of just-following-orders.

You're familiar with the expression. When a subordinate wishes to conceal information without technically lying, they might answer with only and exactly what was asked.
entries.zh:
"是的，我们的祖先建造了一个临时船坞用以储藏和分配我们所收集的材料，用以建设定居点。" Skiron 说道，她脸色及口气都体现出一种只是在奉命办事的感觉。

你很明白这个表情，这是下级不想撒谎，却想要对上级隐瞒一些事情时的样子。这种时候，对方只会精确回答你所问的问题，不多说一句。

entries.en: "I have nothing to say on the subject, $playerSirOrMadam," she says, face stiff with denial.
entries.zh: "对此我无话可说。$playerSirOrMadam。" 她脸色僵硬地否定道。

entries.en:
Skiron's eyes go wide, though she manages to control her voice. "Ah," she says. "I truly cannot speak more of... that. The Protocols."

"But if," she looks almost pleading, attempting to divert her mind around the demands of the all-important Protocols, "-If a loyal citizen of the Hegemony, commissioned or otherwise, recovered a weapon of mass destruction, then they should return it to Hegemony authorities for safekeeping with all haste and secrecy."
entries.zh:
Skiron 双眼圆睁，但是她成功地控制了自己的语调。"啊。" 她说道，"我真的不能再说更多... 关于那事。得遵守纪律。"

"但是，" 她近乎哀求地看着你，似乎想从她的思维中抽离那至高无上的纪律 。"作为一位忠于 霸主 的公民，不论正式受雇与否，如果成功地夺回了任何大规模杀伤性武器，那该公民应当将武器尽快并低调的归还给 霸主 官方保管。"

entries.en:
A long sigh, then she adds feebly, "I speak hypothetically, of course."

Her lieutenants are tense behind her, pretending they don't know what they now know.
entries.zh:
她长叹一声，弱弱地补充道。"当然，我只是打个比方。"

她身后的副官们则僵硬地假装没有听到他们刚刚得到的信息。

entries.en: Her eyes go wide, but Skiron manages to control her voice. "I cannot speak to that, $playerSirOrMadam," she says, face stiff.
entries.zh: Skiron 双眼圆睁，但是她成功地控制了自己的语调。"我不能提及那事，$playerSirOrMadam。" 她说道，脸色僵硬。

entries.en:
Commander Skiron smiles, "That would be much appreciated, Captain $playerName. With their help, we can solve many problems, and maintain an outpost worthy of Command. The Protocols will guide us until Command establishes contact."

("The Protocols will guide us," they repeat behind her.)

You give orders to your senior officers to make it so. Some trained crew and communication equipment will fill in the most glaring gaps in the colony's infrastructure, bringing it up to a level considered at least marginally civilized by the standards of the Persean Sector.
entries.zh:
Skiron 笑道："那就谢谢你了，$playerName舰长。有了他们的帮助，我们可以解决很多问题，把这里打造为一个指挥部也能认可的哨站。直到收到指挥部的联络，纪律将引导我们。"

("纪律将引导我们。" 她身后的众人重复道。)

你向你的上级军官下达了执行命令。一些训练有素的船员和通讯设备能够弥补当前殖民地基建中最大的漏洞。这能让当地的基础设施至少达到英仙座星域文明社会的最低标准。

entries.en:
Commander Skiron halts, and looks around with a half-smile, "That would be much appreciated, Captain $playerName. With their help, we can maintain an outpost worthy of Command. The Protocols will guide us until Command establishes contact."

("The Protocols will guide us," they repeat softly behind her.)

You issue orders through comms to your senior officers to make it so.
entries.zh:
Skiron 停顿了一下，然后半笑着说道："那就谢谢你了，$playerName舰长。有了他们的帮助，我们可以把这里打造为一个指挥部也能认可的哨站。直到收到指挥部的联络，纪律将引导我们。"

("纪律将引导我们。" 她身后的众人轻声重复道。)

你令你的上级军官们按照安排开工。

entries.en:
"Hegemony, I'd wager. Old work," your ops chief says with a grunt. "First AI War."

Your sensors officer asks for some evidence for that conclusion,  but ops just shakes their head and says something about their "gut".

Sensors runs an additional sweep, then calls for your attention, "$PlayerSirOrMadam, there are some abandoned ships in the gantries. Look to be XIV Battlegroup vintage."
entries.zh:
"我敢打赌这是 霸主 留下的东西，有不少年头了。" 你的行动长官嘟哝着，"估计能追溯到第一次 AI 战争时期。"

你的传感器技官问起了这个结论的依据，但行动长只是摇了摇头，低语着什么这是自己的 "直觉" 一类的话。

传感器技官在运行了又一次扫描后，向你示意道："$PlayerSirOrMadam，这座船坞里还有几艘被遗弃于此的舰艇，看起来像是第十四战斗群的老古董了。"

entries.en:
"Hegemony. Old work," your ops chief says with a grunt. "First AI War, I'd wager."

This is where the crews that settled on Sentinel must have salvaged elements of their fleet - and converted others.

Your sensors officer runs a scan, then calls for your attention, "$PlayerSirOrMadam, there are some abandoned ships in the debris. Look to be Battlegroup XIV vintage."
entries.zh:
"霸主 留下的玩意，有些年头了。" 你的行动长官咕哝着说到，"我敢打赌是第一次 AI 战争时期的东西。"

这里肯定就是 Sentinel 上的原舰队船员回收再利用他们舰队里一切还能发挥作用的东西 —— 与改装舰船的地方了。

你的传感器技官运行了一次扫描，示意你过来看看，"$PlayerSirOrMadam，这片残骸带里还有些被遗弃的舰船，看起来像是第十四战斗群的老古董了。"

entries.en: This collection of makeshift gantries is barely worth description as a 'dockyard', though it has obviously served as a one-off site to perform rapid work on a flotilla of large starships.
entries.zh: 尽管这片由多台临时的龙门吊架组成的一次性集合体只能勉强算得上 "船坞"，但其上仍然留存着被用来临场修复整支大型舰队的痕迹。

entries.en:
One of your guards passes you the satchel with datapads pre-loaded with current affairs primers.

Used by salvors on the Fringe, these are kept up-to-date for a reasonable subscription fee and statistically proven to ensure an efficient transition into contemporary society for temporal refugees including cryo-sleepers, decivs, and castaways.

Skiron and the others treat your datapads like holy artifacts, touching them delicately. They know, haltingly, how to use the interfaces but it is clear that they have been cut off from sophisticated nanoforge output for a long, long time.
entries.zh:
你的一个随行警卫递了一个小书包给你，里面装了些预载有星域近况读本的数据平板。

这是打捞者游走于边缘星区时的常备之物，只要付一小笔订阅费用就能持续更新。统计数据显示，这些读物能有效地帮助那些与世隔绝许久的难民重新融入社会，无论对方是低温休眠者，船难幸存者，还是文明丧失地的蛮荒人。

Skiron 一行人像对待圣物般接过了你的数据平板，小心翼翼地触碰着它。即使动作有些迟疑，但他们还是知道如何使用那些交互界面。不过很显然，他们已经在很长，很长一段时间里，与稍微复杂些的纳米锻炉制品无缘了。

entries.en:
You and a handful of senior officers take in their quiet discussion and reactions to the current state of affairs; their linguistic drift is no worse than any cryo-case you've met before.

"We thank you for this intel, captain," Skiron says, handing a datapad back to you. "Much has changed, but it brings me great satisfaction to know that Command awaits us."

("Command is Salvation," they say together, behind her.)
entries.zh:
你和几个上级军官听着这群人小声讨论着当前的局势与时事；他们口中的方言的确与当下的英仙座星域有些脱轨，但并不比你见过的一些低温休眠者身上的案例更严重。

"我们感谢你提供的情报，舰长。" Skiron 说道，同时将数据平板交还给你。"许多事情都变了，但知道了指挥部仍然存在，并依旧等待着我们回去报到，使我们倍感欣慰。"

("指挥部即为救赎，" 在她身后，人们齐声说道。)

o.en: Look. I know your fleet was modified for AI core control. I have evidence.
o.zh: 听着，我知道你们的舰队经过了改装，用于搭载 AI 核心进行控制，我有证据。

o.en: I encountered your fleet. It was under autonomous control.
o.zh: 我和你们的舰队打过照面了，它们当时正处于 AI 控制下的自动化状态。

o.en: I found your gantries in orbit. But no fleet.
o.zh: 我找到你们轨道上的船坞了，但没看到你们的舰队。

entries.en: You consider certain discoveries you've made. Skiron's adherence to 'Protocols' suggests that she may not be forthcoming, but perhaps she will spill some detail when presented with hard facts.
entries.zh: 你思忖着自己已有的发现 。出于 Skiron 对 '纪律' 的遵从，她或许并不会对你袒露一切，但或许只要你将某些难以辩驳的证据摆在她面前，就能够从她口中钓出更多的细节。

entries.en: You consider certain discoveries you've made. Although open to a certain amount of information-sharing, you suspect that you'll get little information of immediate value out of Skiron due to her adherence to 'the Protocols'.
entries.zh: 你思忖着自己已有的发现 。尽管你们已经在有限的程度上分享了情报，但你依旧怀疑自己能够从死守 '纪律' 的 Skiron 身上获取多少具有直接价值的情报。

entries.en: You consider certain discoveries you've made established. Skiron seems to trust your Hegemony commission, so she might be willing to fill in some gaps about what exactly happened if you present her with intel you already possess.
entries.zh: 你思忖着自己已有的发现 。看起来 Skiron 对你的 霸主 雇佣协议深信不疑，因此只要你将自己现有的情报与她交换，她似乎会很乐意为你补上这些事件之间的空白。

o.en: I found the planetkiller your fleet left behind.
o.zh: 我找到你们的舰队留下的行星杀手了。

o.en: Confront Skiron with something you know
o.zh: 与 Skiron 就你所掌握的现状对质

o.en: I could leave 100 crew; specialists to assist your colony.
o.zh: 我可以留下 100 名船员，他们可以作为专家与技师协助你的殖民地。

o.en: Make arrangements to take on medical cases for treatment in Hegemony space
o.zh: 安排将患者送往 霸主 治下的疆域进行治疗

o.en: Can you tell me anything about active Tri-Tachyon AI war fleets?
o.zh: 你能告诉我那些仍处于活跃状态的 速子科技 AI 舰队是怎么回事吗？

o.en: I feel that there is some danger here that you are not telling me about.
o.zh: 我觉得这里有些你没有告诉我的危险存在。

o.en: Can you tell me about these 'Protocols'?
o.zh: 你能不能跟我说说和这些 '纪律' 有关的事？

o.en: Do you want to stay here?

o.zh: 你们的星舰出了什么事？

o.en: Tell me, how did your people come to live in this place?
o.zh: 跟我说说，你们这群人是如何在这里生活的？

o.en: I would like to ask you some questions.

entries.en: Skiron's face is impassive. "The Protocols prohibit sharing intel without strategic purpose," she says. "But you may ask."
entries.zh: Skiron 看起来无动于衷。"纪律严禁我们为了达成非战略目的而与他人分享情报，" 她说道，"但让你提几个问题也无妨。"

entries.en: "The Protocols allow for conditional intel-sharing," Skiron says, giving you a hesitant look. "Your own candor is appreciated. So ask."
entries.zh: "纪律允许在有条件的情况下与他人共享情报，" Skiron 有些犹豫地看了你一眼，说到，"我们感谢你在这方面的直截了当，所以问吧。"

entries.en: "It is Protocol to share intel with allies," Skiron gives you a comradely nod. "Ask, and we shall provide."
entries.zh: "根据纪律，我们应当与盟友共享情报，" Skiron 如对待一个同志般向你点头致意，"我们有问必答。"

o.en: Catch her up on the current history of the Sector
o.zh: 帮她了解星域最近的情况和历史

o.en: Show them your Hegemony commission credentials
o.zh: 向他们展示你的 霸主 雇佣协议

entries.en:
The bitterly cold surface of $fullName rolls beneath you, the poles locked in endless winter. Only lucky arrangements of weather produce marginal habitability in small regions.

And indeed, there is a weak radio signal detectable in the midst of just such a conjunction. It transmits a weak transponder signal in Hegemony-standard protocol; an old code, but it checks out.

A sensor sweep reveals a tiny settlement with signs of primitive industry and agriculture.
entries.zh:
$fullName 凛冽刺骨的地表在你的下方缓缓转动着，这颗星球的两极仅有无尽的寒冬。在这种气候状况下，只有极少数较为幸运的地区适宜人类居住。

而这里的确有人居住：在星球表面其中一个宜居的角落，侦测到了一丝微弱的无线电信号。这缕若有若无的微弱信号传递着一条使用 霸主 标准协议的应答器编码，种类有些老旧，但依旧能够识别。

传感器扫描辨识出了这里存在着一个有些许农业和原始工业迹象的小型聚落。

o.zh: 在通讯频道里对信号作出应答

entries.en:
The bitterly cold surface of $fullName rolls beneath you, the poles locked in endless winter. Only lucky arrangements of weather produce marginal habitability in small regions.

The settlement of XIV Battlegroup castaways emits a weak radio signal just-detectable in the midst of such a conjunction.
entries.zh:
$fullName 寒冷刺骨的大地在你面前展开，两极都处于永久的严冬之中。只有天气规律中一些幸运的巧合让个别微小的地区能够勉强适于居住。

第十四战斗群 遗民的定居点恰恰位于这么一个地区之中，散发着勉强能够被观测到的微弱无线电波。

o.en: Take a shuttle down to investigate
o.zh: 搭乘穿梭机下往地表调查
DEV 设为已遭遇 XIV 舰队
DEV 设为已击败 XIV 舰队
DEV 测试 nexus 破解对话

entries.en:
You are escorted to the rim of the rocky plateau where your shuttle awaits. Skiron reminds you again to return to Hegemony space and tell 'Command' about Sentinel.

About to step aboard, you notice a stark white fragment of bone in a gravelly rill. You pause in your step; it must be a fibula, or tibia. Maybe. You suspect that the Protocols would demand orderly containment of the honored dead.

So, this?

Whatever it was, it was done many cycles ago.
entries.zh:
你被护送到了一个岩石台地上，你的穿梭机在此等候。Skiron 再度提醒你要回到 霸主 疆域，并将 Sentinel 的情况报给 '指挥部'。

就当你即将踏上船时，你在砾石中发现了一块异常明显的骨头碎片。你停下脚步；这应该是一块腓骨，或者一块胫骨。你心怀疑惑：纪律应该会要求荣誉身故的死者被规范地收容。

那，这个是？

不管是什么，这都是很多个星历年之前的事情了。

entries.en:
You are escorted to the rim of the rocky plateau where your shuttle awaits. Skiron reminds you again to return to Hegemony space and tell 'Command' about Sentinel.

The fragment of bone you saw in cold gravel the first time you left this world is missing. Or perhaps this is just a similar-looking ditch on a monotonously bleak world.
entries.zh:
你被护送到了一个岩石台地上，你的穿梭机在此等候。Skiron 再度提醒你要回到 霸主 疆域，并将 Sentinel 的情况报给 '指挥部'。

你刚登陆时在冰冷的碎石中看到的那片碎骨已经不在了。或许这里只是这个单调阴暗的世界上另一处样子相似的小沟吧。

entries.en: As you walk back through the settlement, under the subtle stares of Skiron's workcrews, you note how easily a few technicians with light equipment could upgrade the comms and infrastructure to the bare minimum of space-faring civilization.
entries.zh: 当你顶着 Skiron 的工人隐晦的注视，再度穿过定居点往回走时，你注意到只需几名技术人员带着轻型设备，就能轻松将通讯和基础设施升级到太空文明的最低标准。

o.en: I could leave 100 crew here; specialists to help your colony survive.
o.zh: 我可以留下 100 名船员，作为专家和技师来确保你们的殖民地能继续生存下去。

entries.en:
You step off the shuttle, the frosty ground crunching beneath your boots. Your envirosuit has no trouble keeping you completely comfortable despite the biting wind.

The settlement is about a kilometer off. You've landed at a polite distance, on a rocky plateau, to avoid disturbing some muddy gray fields of some kind of agricultural effort.
entries.zh:
你踏下了穿梭机，结满霜冻的地面在你的靴底吱嘎作响。尽管周围寒风刺骨，但你的生态服保证了你舒适无虞。

那片聚落距此约有一公里远。出于基本的礼节，你的着陆地点选在了一处多石的高地上，尽量避免震动打扰到那片看起来像是在尝试进行某些农作活动的灰色泥地。

entries.en:
You pull up your Hegemony credentials on your TriPad and offer them to Skiron for confirmation.

She gives you a deliberate look, then turns her gaze to the screen. She taps in some codewords and mutters passphrases which your credentials respond to approvingly. Skiron pauses for a moment, then coming to a decision passes your TriPad back to you with the care one would give to an irreplaceable artifact.
entries.zh:
你从自己的 TriPad 上调出了自己的 霸主 证明文件，将它们展示给 Skiron 以供确认。

她小心地看了你一眼，便将眼神转向了屏幕。她键入了某些代码，喃喃自语着一些口令，而你的证明文件也对此作出了正确的回应。Skiron 停住了片刻，决定小心翼翼地将 TriPad 递还给你，就好像这是某种无可替代的文物。

entries.en:
"It is not unimaginable that Tri-Tachyon, or some AI, has broken our security. But. I believe you to be who you say you are, Captain $PlayerName, Auxiliary to the Hegemony Navy."

She doesn't quite smile, but a moment of tension has broken. Her guards relax slightly at her words, and her lieutenants exchange a grin.

("Praise Command," you hear someone say.)
entries.zh:
"速子科技，或是某个 AI 破解了我们的安全系统，这并非不可想象。但据你所言，我还是愿意相信你，自称隶属于 霸主 海军辅助军的 $PlayerName 舰长。"

她的脸上并没有流露出任何的笑意，但紧张的气氛还是消散无踪了。守卫们从她的话语中感到了些许安心，而她的中尉们相视而笑。

(你听到其中的某人说道 "赞美指挥部"。)

entries.en:
Skiron exchanges a quick look of incomprehension with her lieutenants. "It is our duty to stand by our post until we receive new orders from Command."

("Duty is Life," they mutter behind her.)
entries.zh:
Skiron 和她手下的中尉们快速交换了一个眼神，"在收到来自指挥部的新命令前，我们必须坚守职责。"

("职责即为生命，" 他们在她身后低声念到。)

entries.en:
"It is our duty," the Skiron exchanges a glance with her lieutenants. "Until we receive orders otherwise. Although..."

She deliberates for a moment with her advisors, then turns back to you. "Assuming medical technology is available in the Core Worlds, we would send some of our number with, um, advanced conditions for treatment. Command will make arrangements for their well-being, I am certain."

"And," after an awkward pause, "appropriate payment will be made to you as well, I am sure."
entries.zh:
"在接收到新命令之前，我们的职责就是坚守岗位。" Skiron 和她的中尉们交换了一个眼神，"不过..."

她与顾问们商讨片刻之后，转过头来对你说到，"有些医疗条件只有核心世界才能够提供，而我们正好需要，呃，转送几名病情严重的患者接受治疗。我确定指挥部肯定会负责照顾他们的健康状况的。"

"而且，" 在片刻尴尬的停顿过后，她继续说道，"我也很确定，你肯定会得到相应的报酬的。"

entries.en:
You send off a quick order to your purser to coordinate intake of certain medical cases from the colony of Sentinel.

Their suffering due to gaps in technological access and the harsh environment is, upon review, appalling. Like something out of a grim historical holo about Old Earth - or a scene of the underclass on one of the poorer Core worlds.
entries.zh:
你随即命令你的事务长安排将 Sentinel 殖民地上的病患接收到舰上。

经过初步诊疗后，舰上的大家发现，因为缺少许多医疗科技，也因为此地严酷的生存环境，那些病患的情况简直算得上骇人听闻。他们的状况与某些旧地球历史全息纪录片里 —— 或者是某个贫穷核心世界的社会底层的情况别无二致。

entries.en:
Your standard comms request gives no return. If there is a comms network, or even an emergency survival unit on the surface, it's either damaged or can't make a connection.

Your comms officer tries more unconventional workarounds, from a suite of ancient standards used to ping drifting Domain-era relics to the latest suite of underworld methods that would earn a stern look from any honest customs officer; lossy but easily mistaken for background noise by sensor grids. All attempts are fruitless.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. We might have to make contact the old fashioned way," your comms officer reports apologetically.
entries.zh:
你发送的标准通讯请求并未得到任何答复。这颗星球的地表上没有通讯器网络，甚至连一台紧急求生通讯器都没有，就算有也应该全坏了，或是无法建立通讯链接。

你的通讯军官尝试采用一系列非常规手段，从一套用来定位从 人之领 时代以来就在深空中飘流的遗物的旧式通讯标准，再到一套容易用传感器阵列背景噪声掩盖的地下帮派专用最新低保真通讯标准，能让正派的海关人员板起脸侧目而视的那种。但这些尝试最终都只是徒劳罢了。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，我们说不定只能用老办法和他们接触了。" 你的通讯军官带着一丝歉意向你报告。

entries.en: You land at a polite distance, on a rocky plateau, and are again met by an armed party led by Commander Alo Skiron. She says a formal greeting and invites you to take refreshment and speak in the central meeting hall of the colony.
entries.zh: 你在不会冒犯对方的距离外降落，停靠在一片岩石台地上。Alo Skiron 指挥官带领的一队武装人员再度迎接了你。做完正式的问候之后，她便邀请你到殖民地的中心会议厅饮茶座谈。

entries.en:
It is warm inside, and bedecked with uniforms, weapons, and insignia like a reverent shrine to the XIV Battlegroup-era Hegemony.

You pretend to sip a wretched yeast-derived brew.
entries.zh:
会议厅内部很温暖，并装饰着军服，武器还有徽标，活像一做纪念第十四战斗群时代 霸主 的虔诚圣地。

你假装喝了一口那恶心的酵母制饮品。

entries.en:
"Have you brought word of our survival to Command?" Skiron asks, trying very hard not to convey her impatience. "It is essential that we report our intel, and receive orders."

("Duty is Survival; Command is Salvation," her attendants murmur behind her.)
entries.zh:
"你有把我们存活的消息带给指挥部吗？" Skiron 努力掩饰着她的不耐烦，问道，"我们必须要能够上报我们的信息，同时接受指示。"

("使命即是生存；指挥部即为救赎。" 她的副官们在身后低声道。)

o.en: There's a lost fringe colony, Sentinel, that you ought to know about... (explain)
o.zh: 有一座失落的边缘殖民地，名为 Sentinel，你应该了解一下... (解释)

entries.en:
$HeOrShe goes still. "I see," $heOrShe says. "That is a troubling allegation. Though if what you say is true, it was done over a hundred cycles ago."

The $rank sighs. "I shall include it in my report. Rest assured that we shall get to the bottom of this matter, citizen. In the meantime, I advise that you keep speculation about what you think you saw to yourself."

A pause, then, "We would not want to get COMSEC involved, I am sure. Imagine the bureaucracy," $heOrShe tries to lighten the threat with an unconvincing smile as $heOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off. "I must go."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe直起了身子。"我知道了。" $heOrShe说道，"那确实是个令人担忧的指控。然而即便属实，那也是远在上百个星历年之前的事了。"

$rank 叹了口气。"我会把这加进报告书里的，请放心，公民，我们会查清此事的。另外，我还建议你将所见所闻的揣测都权且保留。"

停顿片刻之后，对方继续道："我很确信我们彼此都不想把 COMSEC 牵扯进来，想想看那得有多少文书找上门，" $heOrShe试图在切断通讯链接前用一个微笑缓和一下气氛，"我就先失陪了。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe goes still. "I see," $heOrShe says. "That is a troubling allegation. Though if what you say is true, it was done over a hundred cycles ago."

The $rank sighs. "I shall include it in my report. Rest assured that we shall get to the bottom of this matter, auxiliary. In the meantime, as per the conditions of your condition, I suggest that you keep speculation about what you think you saw to yourself."

A pause, then, "We would not want to get COMSEC involved, am I right? Imagine the bureaucracy," $heOrShe tries to lighten the threat with an unconvincing smile as $heOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off. "I must go."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe直起了身子。"我知道了。" $heOrShe说道，"那确实是个令人担忧的指控。然而即便属实，那也是远在上百个星历年之前的事了。"

$rank 叹了口气。"我会把这加进报告书里的，请放心，辅助军，我们会查清此事的。另外，我还建议你将所见所闻的揣测都权且保留。"

停顿片刻之后，对方继续道："我很确信我们彼此都不想把 COMSEC 牵扯进来，想想看那得有多少文书找上门，" $heOrShe试图在切断通讯链接前用一个微笑缓和一下气氛，"我就先失陪了。"

o.en: There was also the matter of a planetkiller weapon...
o.zh: 还有一个关于行星杀手的问题...

o.en: I also discovered that the original flotilla modified their fleet to accept AI core control.
o.zh: 我还发现，最初的舰队曾改造过他们的舰船，以接受 AI 核心的控制。

entries.en:
The $post nods along with surprise and concern as you tell $himOrHer about the lost crew forming a colony on Sentinel and surviving for over 100 cycles while maintaining 'Protocol'.

"I must bring this matter to the Strategic Assembly immediately. I expect we'll dispatch relief and reinforcements."

"Right," $heOrShe says, "I must make my report. Good work, citizen."
entries.zh:

"我得立刻向战略指挥部上报此事。我想他们会立刻派出援助和援兵。"

"好了。" $heOrShe说道，"我需要准备我的报告了，干得好，公民。"

entries.en:
The $post nods along with surprise and concern as you tell $himOrHer about the lost crew forming a colony on Sentinel and surviving for over 100 cycles while maintaining 'Protocol'.

"You did the right thing," $heOrShe says when you tell of how you have transported select medical cases from the thin-stretched colonists.

"Have them off-loaded; my adjutant will make the arrangements. I must bring this matter to the Strategic Assembly immediately. I expect we'll dispatch relief and reinforcements as soon as possible."

"Right," $heOrShe says, "I must make my report. Good work, citizen."
