entries.zh:
$post 面带惊讶和担忧地听完了你关于在 Sentinel 生存了超过 100 星历年 并依旧维持着 '纪律' 的船员殖民地的报告。

"你做了正确的事。" 听到你留下了一些船员来协助生存艰难的殖民者们，还把病弱者带来 核心世界 接受治疗，$heOrShe如此说道。

"把他们卸下来吧，我的副官会做安排。我会立刻向战略指挥部上报此事。我想他们会立刻派出援助和援兵。" $HeOrShe向你投来一个战友般的微笑，"看来边缘星区还有不少速子佬的阴谋要解决，是吧？舰队有机会好好狩猎一番了。真希望我也能去一趟。"

"好了。" $heOrShe说道，"我需要准备我的报告了，干得漂亮，公民。"

entries.en: "Too bad," he says. "You'll just have to find someone else to buy your forbidden Domain-era weapon of mass destruction responsible for billions of deaths."
entries.zh: "太糟糕了，" 他说道，"至于那台害死过数十亿人的 人之领 时代大规模杀伤性武器了，你只能找其他人来购买了。"

o.en: I've changed my mind. 300,000 is a good price.
o.zh: 我改主意了。300,000 星币是个好价钱。

o.en: That's just what I'm going to do.

entries.en: "Good luck selling your forbidden Domain-era weapon of mass destruction responsible for billions of deaths," he says. His tone feels insincere to you, somehow.
entries.zh: "祝你好运，希望你能卖掉你那台害死过数十亿人的 人之领 时代大规模杀伤性武器。" 他说道。不知怎的，他的语气让你觉得不怎么真诚。

entries.en: "Good luck," he says without much sincerity you can detect.
entries.zh: "祝你好运，" 他说道，但你听不出他有多真诚。

entries.en:
You make the arrangements, delivering an anonymous package - without a customs scan, easily avoided with a token bribe - to a robotic warehouse run by a shell-company owned by a shell-company of a shell-company owned by Rayan Arroyo.

The credits are good.

"Never talk to me about this ever again," he says as a good-bye.
entries.zh:
你做出安排，将匿名包裹送到一个自动化仓库 —— 该仓库由 Rayan Arroyo 旗下空壳公司的空壳公司下属的空壳公司运营，只需象征性贿赂即可轻松避免海关扫描。

报酬丰厚。

"以后别再和我提起这件事了。" 他以这句话作为告别。

entries.en:
"Good thinking, $playerName."

He lifts his eyes, staring at nothing; considering his options. If anything, he seems stressed out by your offer.

"I can do 300,000 credits," he finally says. "And, though this should not need saying, I need you to keep your mouth absolutely shut about this. It's a good thing you came to me first."

He blinks.

"You did come to me first, right?"
entries.zh:
"好主意，$playerName。"

他抬起眼睛，什么也没有看，考虑着他的选择。如果有什么不同的话，他似乎对你的提议颇感压力。

"我可以支付 300,000 星币，" 他最终说道，"尽管无需多言，但我需要你对此保密。你先来找我是件好事。"

他眨了眨眼。

"你第一个找的人是我，对吧？"

entries.en:
"Good."

He sighs. "300,000 credits. Deal?"
entries.zh:
"很好。"

他叹了口气。"300,000 星币。成交？"

o.en: I'm going to need more credits.

entries.en:
He puts his face into his palm, taking a deep breath.

"You idiot," he says with a sigh.

"I can do 150,000. That's my best offer for a hot item."
entries.zh:
他把脸埋在手掌里，深深地吸了一口气。

"你这个白痴，" 他叹了口气说。

"我可以再加 150,000 星币。这是我能对一件热门商品开出的最高价。"

entries.en:
You make the arrangements, delivering an anonymous package - without a customs scan, easily avoided with a token bribe - to a robotic warehouse run by a shell-company owned by a shell-company of a shell-company owned by Rayan Arroyo.

The credits are good.

"Never talk to me about this ever again," he says as a good-bye.
entries.zh:
你做出安排，将匿名包裹送到一个自动化仓库 —— 该仓库由 Rayan Arroyo 旗下空壳公司的空壳公司下属的空壳公司运营，只需象征性贿赂即可轻松避免海关扫描。

报酬丰厚。

"以后别再和我提起这件事了。" 他以这句话作为告别。

entries.en: "Yes. Good." $HeOrShe examines you suspiciously. "Was there something you wished to discuss?"
entries.zh: "嗯，不错。" $HeOrShe满腹狐疑地打量着你，"你还有什么想讨论的吗？"

entries.en:
"What?!" $HeOrShe draws back in shock, "I pray that you are merely a liar making a joke in poor taste. If indeed you did possess such a demonic artifact, I would implore you to take it far from this place and destroy it, immediately! Or, or, the Knights will deal with you!"

"Speak not to me," $heOrShe says, face red, then slams the comms shut-off.
entries.zh:
"什么？！" $HeOrShe震惊地向后退去，"我祈祷你只是个编造蹩脚笑话的骗子。假如你真的持有此等魔物，我恳求你立刻将其远远带离此地，或者将其毁灭！否，否则骑士团会来处置你的！"

"不要再和我说话了。" $heOrShe红着脸说道，随后重重地关闭了通讯链接。

entries.en: "Here you are," $heOrShe says brightly, tapping at a TriPad. "I hope you'll choose to do business with us soon."
entries.zh: "发给您了，" $heOrShe高兴地说着，一边在 TriPad 上点来点去，"希望不久后您会选择与我们做生意。"

entries.en:
The comms hang for a moment on the crest of the League then snaps to a stately-looking League $Post.

"Independent colonial leader, Captain $PlayerName. Greetings from the Persean League." The hint of a smile forms on $hisOrHer face.

"You may be wondering why we are here. And in such force."
entries.zh:
通讯画面在联盟的徽标上停留了片刻，然后突然切换到了一个看起来十分庄重的 $Post .

"独立殖民领袖，$PlayerName舰长。英仙座联盟 向你致意。" $hisOrHer的脸上浮现出一丝微笑。

"你可能在想我们为什么会在这里，以及为什么会动用如此强大的力量。"

o.en: I am wondering exactly that. Perhaps you can explain?
o.zh: 我正好也想知道这一点。或许你能解释一下？

o.en: I demand to know why you're trying to blockade my independent colony!
o.zh: 我要求你们解释为什么试图封锁我的独立殖民地！

o.en: You're here to strong-arm me into joining the League, aren't you.
o.zh: 你们是来这里用武力威胁我加入联盟，对吧？

entries.en:
"Be realistic, captain. Sooner or later, you're going to have to make a deal with someone more powerful than yourself," $heOrShe sighs.

"You could do far worse than Reynard Hannan."
entries.zh:
"认清现实吧，舰长。早晚有一天，你得和比你更强大的人达成协议，" $heOrShe叹了口气。

"你不如就直接和 Reynard Hannan 签协议。"

entries.en:
"A cynical outlook," $heOrShe says, giving you a curious look through the link. "But we can work with it."

$HeOrShe breaks into a fleeting, but genuine smile. "Soon, I'm sure, I'll be calling you by 'Archon'. Give my regards to Reynard."

"Now. Have the good grace to withdraw your fleet; I still have my orders, you understand."
entries.zh:
"这看法可够自私自利的。" $heOrShe一边说着，一边在通讯界面上向你投来了一个奇怪的眼神，"不过倒是也行。"

$HeOrShe脸上快速闪过一缕真诚的微笑。"要不了多久，我就得称呼你 '执政官' 了，到时候记得代我向 Reynard 问好。"

"现在，还请你行行好，撤回你的舰队。我有令在身，你也能理解吧。"

o.en: This is piracy! You can't just blockade any system you want!
o.zh: 这是海盗行为！你们不能想封锁哪个星系就封锁哪个！

o.en: Explain where Reynard Hannan can stick the League Armada
o.zh: 解释一下 Reynard Hannan 可以把联盟无敌舰队布置在哪里

o.en: True, strength is necessary to protect freedom... from thugs like you and your bosses on Kazeron.
o.zh: 没错，力量是保护自由的必需品...尤其是在面对像你这种恶棍，以及你在 Kazeron 的那些主子时。

o.en: True, strength is necessary to protect freedom... and we're stronger together.
o.zh: 没错，力量是保护自由的必需品...而当我们团结在一起时，我们的力量会更加强大.

o.en: You've described a protection racket... and I'll have no part in your banditry.
o.zh: 你所描述的就是保护费...而我绝不会参与你们的强盗行为。

o.en: You've described a protection racket... and I want to be on the winning team.
o.zh: 你所描述的就是保护费...而我想站在赢家这边。

entries.en:
"Be realistic, captain. Sooner or later, you're going to have to make a deal with someone more powerful than yourself," $heOrShe sighs.

"You could do far worse than Reynard Hannan."
entries.zh:
"认清现实吧，舰长。早晚有一天，你得和比你更强大的人达成协议，" $heOrShe叹了口气。

"你不如就直接和 Reynard Hannan 签协议。"

entries.en:
"I'm glad you see it that way, captain- or shall it be Demarchon $playerLastName?"

$HeOrShe breaks into a genuine, albeit fleeting smile. "Soon, I'm sure, when you've joined the League. Give my regards to Reynard."
entries.zh:
"很高兴你能这么看问题，舰长 —— 或者说，我该叫你 $playerLastName 统领？"

$HeOrShe脸上快速闪过一缕真诚的微笑。"我很肯定，你马上就能加入联盟了，到那时候，记得替我向 Reynard 问好。"

entries.en:
A thin, perfunctory smile appears. "A blockade can't be switched on and off like a light," $heOrShe says.

"It is my belief, and that of the League Council, that it would be most productive if you were to make the first gesture of goodwill."
entries.zh:
一个淡淡而敷衍的微笑出现在脸上。"封锁可不是像开关灯那样可以随意解除的，" $heOrShe说道。

"我相信，并且联盟理事会也相信，如果你能够首先表现出善意的话，将会是一个良好的开端。"

entries.en:
$Post $personLastName sits patiently as you speak.

"Very imaginative, captain," $heOrShe says once you finish. "You've made your position quite clear."
entries.zh:
$Post $personLastName 耐心地等着你说完。

"真是富有想象力，舰长。" $heOrShe在你讲完后说道，"你已经把你的立场表达得很清楚了。"

entries.en:
"This," the $post paces, hands behind $hisOrHer back, "is a standard commerce protection operation performed by an interstellar confederation of peace-seeking polities which are, collectively, recognized by interfactional treaty."

$HeOrShe turns to face the comms. "Are you such an entity? Or are you an upstart whose treasures are simply floating in space, waiting to be plucked?"
entries.zh:
"这，" $post 踱着步，$hisOrHer的双手背在身后，"是由一个被各势力间的条约所认可的、寻求和平的政治势力组成的星际联邦所执行的标准商业保护行动。"

$HeOrShe面对通讯设备，"你是这样一个势力吗？还是只是一个放任财宝在太空中漂浮、等着被掠夺的新兴势力？"

o.en: I assume the question is hypothetical.
o.zh: 我猜这个问题是个假设。

o.en: What of freedom, rights, and prosperity? Do those ideals mean nothing?
o.zh: 那么自由、权利和繁荣呢？这些理想难道毫无意义吗？

o.en: No- I'm building a new sector free of your tyranny.
o.zh: 不 —— 我正在建立一个摆脱你们暴政的新星域。

o.en: You'll have to pluck that treasure from my cold, dead hands.
o.zh: 你们得从我冰冷僵死的手中夺取那些财宝。

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe点了点头。

entries.en:
"Freedom and rights exist within civilization," $hisOrHer tone grows impatient; this is a lecture.

"It is a social construction. We've come to a point where you may choose to be part of our society, or you may embrace the consequences of barbarism."
entries.zh:
"自由和权利存在于文明之中，" $hisOrHer的语气变得不耐烦起来，更像是在说教。

"这就是社会建构的道理。我们已经到了这样一个十字路口：你可以选择成为我们社会的一部分，或者你也可以承担野蛮行为的后果。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe rolls $hisOrHer eyes. "How nice for you," $heOrShe spits.

"Let me explain the sector, captain -- and it's a mere captain you'll remain if you don't understand this -- freedom and rights exist within civilization; a social construct. You may choose to be part of our society, or you may embrace the consequences of barbarism."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe翻了个白眼。"那你很伟大了。" $heOrShe不屑地说道。

"让我来给你解释一下这片星域，舰长 —— 如果你不明白这一点，你将永远只是一个舰长 —— 自由和权利存在于文明之中，这就是社会建构的道理。你可以选择成为我们社会的一部分，或者你也可以承担野蛮行为的后果。"

entries.en:
"Very well," $heOrShe says with a nod.

"You have our... request. Now open fire or negotiate with Kazeron."

The $post waves a dismissing hand at some adjutant, and the comms blink to the crest of the Persean League.
entries.zh:
"很好，" $heOrShe点了点头说。

"你收到了我们的...要求。现在，要么开火，要么与 Kazeron 进行谈判。"

这位 $post 向某位副官挥了挥手，示意其退下，通讯设备上的画面闪烁，显示出了 英仙座联盟 的徽标。

entries.en:
"If it weren't us here, it'd be another faction. And they would not possess our... restraint."

$HeOrShe leans in. "Come to Kazeron. Tell Gens Hannan I sent you, and I think Reynard Hannan himself will talk to you. Join us, and this goes away. You have everything to gain. Prosperity, protection, and freedom."
entries.zh:
"如果不是我们在这里，那就会是另一个势力。而他们可不会像我们这样...克制。"

$HeOrShe向前倾身。"去 Kazeron。告诉 Hannan 氏族是我让你去的，我想 Reynard Hannan 本人会和你谈谈。加入我们，这一切就会结束。你将得到一切。繁荣、保护和自由。"

entries.en:
"Gladly. It is the aim of the Persean League to form a confederation which upholds the rights and freedoms of each member polity."

$HeOrShe raises $hisOrHer eyes up toward some ideal form which exists in an imagined space. "Together, united in strength, we stand against tin-pot tyrants, fanatics, and mega-corps alike."

$Post $personLastName drops $hisOrHer gaze back to your image. "Otherwise, independent polities get peeled away and... eaten. Devoured directly less often in recent cycles, but eaten away from the inside nonetheless by infiltration and corruption."
entries.zh:
"很乐意告诉你。英仙座联盟 的目标是建立一个维护每个成员政治权利和自由的联邦。"

$HeOrShe将自己的目光投向了一个存在于想象空间中的理想形态。"我们团结一致，共同对抗那些独裁者、狂热分子以及巨型企业。"

$Post $personLastName将$hisOrHer的目光重新投回到你的影像上。"否则，独立的政体就会被剥离...吞并。虽然在最近的几个星历年里，直接吞并的情况不那么常见了，但内部依然会因为渗透和腐败而被不断侵蚀。"

entries.en:
The hint of a smile fades.

"I'm here to do you a favor, $playerName. And your people. Remember Mairaath. Remember Opis. It's only together, united, that we have a chance to stand against tin-pot tyrants, fanatics, and mega-corps."

"Independents who raise their heads too high? They get burned. Our strength is what stops them. The League is the best of all futures, one worth fighting for."
entries.zh:
$heOrShe脸上的笑意逐渐消失。

"我是来帮你的，$playerName。也是来帮你的人民的。想想 Mairaath 和 Opis。只有我们团结一致，才有机会对抗那些卑劣的独裁者、狂热分子以及巨型企业。"

"那些骄傲过头的独立政体？他们会被毁灭，是我们的力量保护了他们。联盟是最好的未来，值得我们为之奋斗。"

entries.en:
The hint of smile disappears like a wisp of vapor in a star's low orbit.

"I'm here to do you a favor, captain," $heOrShe uses the minor fleet-officer title like a slur. "Mairaath. Opis," $heOrShe spits the words with anger.

"Independents who raise their heads too high? They get burned by the tyrant remains of dead empires or their pet fanatics. And the only thing stopping that from happening again is our combined strength."
entries.zh:
$heOrShe微笑的痕迹就像恒星低轨道上的一缕水汽般消失了。

"我是来帮你的，舰长。" $heOrShe轻蔑地使用着舰队下级军官的称呼，"Mairaath，Opis..." $heOrShe愤怒地吐出这几个词。

"那些骄傲过头的独立政体？他们会被死去帝国的暴君余孽或他们豢养的狂热分子烧掉。而唯一能够阻止这种事情再次发生的，只有联盟的力量。"

entries.en: As you get near $entityName, you get an incoming comm request.
entries.zh: 当你靠近 $entityName 时，你收到了一则通讯请求。

entries.en:
The comms hang for a moment on the crest of the League then snap to a slightly unready looking $post.

"Independent $shipOrFleet cap- er, colonial leader. Please accept greetings on behalf of the Persean League - and my personal assurance that we seek only to secure our shared rights and freedoms."

An uncomfortable pause, then "I've not been authorized to negotiate on behalf of this League operation. You will have to speak with the Prime Navarch of the Grand Armada."

$HeOrShe moves to hit the comms shut-off.
entries.zh:
通讯画面在联盟的徽标上停留了片刻，然后突然切换到了一个看起来稍显紧张的 $post。

"独立$shipOrFleet的指挥官，或者说是殖民领袖。请代我接受 英仙座联盟 的问候 —— 以及我个人保证，我们只求保障我们共同的权利和自由"

一阵令人尴尬的沉默后，"我并未获得代表此次联盟行动进行谈判的授权。你必须与联盟无敌舰队的首席海军都统交谈。"

$HeOrShe准备按下通讯关闭按钮。

entries.en: Reynard is outwardly amenable, but not convinced. You feel that it will take one more strong argument to win this negotiation.
entries.zh: Reynard 表面上看起来乐于接受，但实际上并未被说服。你感觉到还需要一个强有力的论点才能赢得这场谈判。

o.en: I defeated your blockade. You've tried to use force against me, and failed.
o.zh: 我已经打破了你们的封锁。你们试图诉诸武力，但失败了。

o.en: I defeated your punitive expedition. You've tried to use direct force against me and failed.
o.zh: 我击败了你们的惩戒远征队。你们试图诉诸武力，但失败了。

o.en: Your system defense fleet, the pride of Kazeron, broke upon me.
o.zh: 你们的星系防卫舰队，Kazeron 的骄傲，已在我面前溃败。

o.en: Perhaps a $hannanBribePercent fee directly to Gens Hannan accounts, for facilitating this agreement?
o.zh: 也许可以直接向 Hannan 氏族支付 $hannanBribePercent 的费用，以促成这项协议？

o.en: DEV just add the the argument counter vs Reynard
o.zh: DEV 直接给对 Reynard 的论据计数加一

o.en: Rumor is Kazeron's pristine nanoforge is... missing. I would donate a spare I happen to have.
o.zh: 据说 Kazeron 上的那个 完好的纳米锻炉...不见了。我正好有一个备用的，可以捐赠给联盟。

o.en: I was just subject to an 'inspection', don't you people talk to each other?
o.zh: 你们刚才已经 '调查' 过我了，你们互相都不谈谈的吗？

entries.en:
"Perhaps they haven't yet filed the report with command," $heOrShe says, airily. "With so many bandits and smugglers, there's little time to catch up with the bureaucracy."

"So I'm sure you'll understand that I must proceed with the inspection." A chilly hint of a smile, a challenge, grows on $hisOrHer face. "Standard procedure."
entries.zh:
"说不定它们只是忘记向指挥部上报了。" $heOrShe轻松说道，"这么多海盗和走私犯，哪有时间处理文书工作。"

"我这么说，是要你理解我还得继续检查。" $hisOrHer的脸上慢慢显现出冷笑与怀疑，"这可是标准流程。"

entries.en:
The link snaps to life.

"Hailing suspicious fleet operating in non-chartered volume," the League $Post looks down at you like they've caught a small-time ore-smuggler. "This task force acts in the legitimate interest of the Persean League to regulate safe travel and freedom of commerce per interfactional law."

$HeOrShe raises $hisOrHer chin another couple degrees, "As the apparent representative of a non-League entity and non-signatory to the Persean Sector commercial standards accord, you are hereby ordered to stand down your weapons. Prepare to be boarded."

Dictum concluded, $heOrShe sneers. "We're here to make sure you're civilized, spacer. Open up."
entries.zh:
通讯链接突然接通。

"呼叫在未定星区行动的嫌疑舰队。" 英仙座联盟 $Post 轻蔑的看着你，仿佛自己只是又逮到一伙走私矿石的小毛贼，"本特遣队为维护 英仙座联盟 合法利益，根据势力间规约，于此进行安全航行与商业自由保障行动。"

$HeOrShe把$hisOrHer的下巴再上扬了几度："鉴于你本人为某非联盟实体与 '英仙座星域商业标准协定' 非缔约成员的当然代表，现命令你方关闭武器，准备接受登舰。"

讲完套话之后，$heOrShe当即讥讽道："我们是来确保你们足够文明的，太空佬。开门。"

entries.en:
The link snaps to life.

"Hailing suspicious fleet operating in non-chartered volume," the League $Post stares officiously at you. "This task force acts in the legitimate interest of the Persean League to regulate safe travel and freedom of commerce per interfactional law."

$HeOrShe raises $hisOrHer chin a couple degrees, "As the apparent representative of a non-League entity and non-signatory to the Persean Sector commercial standards accord, you are hereby ordered to stand down your weapons. Prepare to be boarded for standard inspection."
entries.zh:
通讯链接突然接通。

"呼叫在未定星域行动的嫌疑舰队。" 英仙座联盟 $Post 正经的看着你，"本特遣队为维护 英仙座联盟 合法利益，根据势力间规约，于此进行安全航行与商业自由保障行动。"

$HeOrShe把$hisOrHer的下巴再上扬了几度："鉴于你本人为某非联盟实体与 '英仙座星域商业标准协定' 非缔约成员的当然代表，现命令你方关闭武器，准备接受登舰调查。"

entries.en:
The inspection teams are not gentle, tearing open hatches, rummaging through carefully organized stocks, and running active scans directly through sensitive equipment clusters.

Complaints from your $shipOrFleet's officers are met by stony bureaucratic obfuscation. "Claim forms may be submitted to seek recompense for 'regrettably unavoidable' damage incurred during inspection", but "one shouldn't expect a response from the investigatory body for at least a cycle".
entries.zh:
检查小组毫不留情，他们撕开舱门，翻箱倒柜地搜查精心整理的库存，还直接在成堆的敏感设备中进行主动扫描。

你$shipOrFleet的军官们的抱怨全都被以官僚式的含糊其辞冷漠回应。军官们被告知，虽然可以提交索赔表，对检查过程中造成的 "令人遗憾但不可避免的" 损失寻求赔偿，但这 "至少在一个星历年内很难得到调查机构的答复"。

entries.en: "You're free to go, spacer," the League $Post sniffs dismissively. "Don't let me catch you out here again."
entries.zh: "太空佬，你可以走了，" 联盟 $Post 不屑地哼了一声，"别让我再在这里逮到你。"

o.en: Cut the comm link and power up weapons
o.zh: 切断通讯链接并将武器充能

o.en: Am I to understand that if I were part of the Persean League this could be avoided?
o.zh: 我是不是该这么想，如果我加入 英仙座联盟，就可以避免发生这种事？

entries.en:
What was almost an accommodating expression on $Post $personLastName's face turns instantly to a frown.

$HeOrShe addresses someone off-image while fixing you with a cool glare, "Lieutenant, have the boarding parties prepared. Be thorough; we've got a troublemaker."
entries.zh:
$Post $personLastName 原本还有点通融的意思，听你说完话立刻就皱起眉头。

$HeOrShe怒目圆瞪，死盯着你，同时向镜头外的某人发号施令："上尉，准备登船小组，查的仔细点，这帮人是来找事的。"

entries.en:
A smile actually breaks across the League $Post's face. "I had a good feeling about you, captain. I must apologize for my... assertive words. As an independent authority yourself, I am sure you understand fully the need to stand up to those factions which would trample our rights in the name of some dead empire or backward religion."

$HeOrShe gives some hand-signal to someone off-image. "You're free to go, of course. You'll find the shipyards of Kazeron an excellent place to refit and replenish. There's no finer works in the Sector, if you ask me."

"Burn bright! I'll welcome you to the League on our next meeting."
entries.zh:
联盟 $Post 的代表脸上露出了微笑。"我对你感觉很好，舰长。我必须为我那些...强硬的话语道歉。作为一支独立力量，我相信你完全理解，对于那些以某个死去的帝国或落后的宗教之名践踏我们权利的势力，我们有必要进行抵制。"

$HeOrShe向画面外的人做了个手势。"当然，你可以自由离开了。你会发现 Kazeron 的港口是修整舰队补充给养的好地方。要我说，这里是整个星域相关服务最出色的地方了。"

"航行无阻！下次见面时我会欢迎你加入联盟 。"

entries.en:
$Post $personLastName's expression cools to just a touch off cryosleep.

"You must think me a fool, $playerName. Do you tell the same story to every League patrol in the hope of getting let off easy?"

$HeOrShe fixes you with a glare as $heOrShe addresses someone off-image, "Lieutenant, have the boarding parties prepared. We're going to be extra thorough with this one."
entries.zh:
$Post $personLastName 的脸色瞬间变得铁青，冷峻的像是进了冬眠舱。

"$playerName，你是不是当我傻。你是不是跟所有联盟巡查队都这么说，就是想让他们早点放人？"

$HeOrShe怒目圆瞪，死盯着你，同时向镜头外的某人发号施令："上尉，准备登船小组，把这伙人得彻彻底底查一遍。"

entries.en:
$HisOrHer eyebrows raise. "You would need to speak with a prominent representative of the League Council on Kazeron about membership. As a member, of course, you would not be subject to random commerce safety inspections unless exceptional conditions were met."

"We have real rights, you know," $heOrShe says. A believer, it appears. "Unlike some factions."
entries.zh:
$HisOrHer 扬起眉毛。"你需要和 Kazeron 上联盟理事会的一位重要代表谈谈入会事宜。当然，作为会员，除非遇到特殊情况，否则你不会受到随机的商业安全检查。"

"我们有真正的权利，你知道的..." $heOrShe说道，看来$heOrShe确实很相信联盟对权利的保护，"不像某些势力。"

o.en: I'll do that. Orderly confederation with the League makes sense.
o.zh: 我会的。与联盟结成秩序邦联是有意义的。

o.en: And submit to your bullying? Not likely.
o.zh: 然后任由你们欺负吗？没门儿。

entries.en:
$Post $personLastName's expression cools.

"Indeed. While you consider the benefits of confederation, I still have a job to do." $HeOrShe addresses someone off-image, "Lieutenant, have the boarding parties prepared."
entries.zh:
$Post $personLastName 脸色冷峻。

"是这样的。加入联盟的好处你先慢慢考虑，我还得干活呢。" $HeOrShe对着镜头外的某人下令："上尉，准备登船小组。"

o.en: That's nonsense, you have no such authority in this volume.
o.zh: 胡说八道，你们在这里无权这么干。

o.en: With that fleet? You're in no position to make demands.
o.zh: 就凭你那支舰队？你还没资格提要求。

entries.en:
The League $Post's face freezes for a moment. Then $heOrShe speaks.

"You seem like an upstanding independent operator." $HeOrShe nods, the very image of reasonable authority. "I'm going to let you go with a warning. There are some bad folks out here, captain. Someone has to keep them in line."

$HeOrShe produces a strained smile. "You're free to go."
entries.zh:
联盟 $Post 官员的脸色瞬间凝固，随后$heOrShe开口说道。

"你看起来是个正直的独立个体。" $HeOrShe点了点头，一副有理有据的权威模样。"这次我只是给你一个警告，放你一马。外面有不少恶棍，舰长。总得有人治治他们。"

$HeOrShe挤出一个勉强的笑容。"你可以走了。"

entries.en:
"Do you have something to hide?" $HisOrHer tone grows dismissive, "Captain."

"Attempting to avoid a legitimate commerce regulation inspection per interfactional law is highly suspicious. Is it drugs? Illegally harvested organs? We'll find out."

The League $Post speaks aside, "Prepare the boarding parties. Give orders to be especially... thorough. We're dealing with some prime space-scum."
entries.zh:
"你是不是有什么秘密？" $HisOrHer的语气中带着不屑，"舰长。"

"试图逃避合法的商业监管检查是违法行为。是毒品吗？还是非法采集的器官？我们会搞清楚的。"

联盟的 $Post 向一旁说道："准备登船检查。务必特别...彻底。我们面对的是一群最顶尖的太空罪犯。"

entries.en:
The League $post's eyes go wide.

"$playerName. That is... this is a shock. You must understand that withdrawal from the League is permanent and irreversible. Though of course, technically any member polity may leave, as they wish. We all have that freedom. That's why we're the League."

$HeOrShe shifts uncomfortably. "I urge you to reconsider. Think of your people! I won't... your words won't leave my office."
entries.zh:
联盟 $post 瞪大了双眼。

"$playerName。真是...真是惊人。你必须理解，退出联盟的决定是永久的，无法逆转的。虽说我们的成员在技术上确实享有随意退出的自由，正因为我们都享有这种自由，我们才会成为 联盟。"

$HeOrShe不适地挪动着身体。"请你再慎重考虑一下，想想你治下的人民！我不会...你这句话不会传出我的办公室的。"

entries.en:
"These words come as a surprise, $playerName," Reynard Hannan says calmly. "Would you throw away what we have built together so needlessly and so thoughtlessly?"

You detect the anger boiling, deeply. "You had such potential."

He pulls back suddenly, turning away with a dismissive flick. "Tell me now that you misspoke. I will allow myself to forget your slip of the tongue."
entries.zh:
"$playerName，你这话说得很惊人。" Reynard Hannan 冷静陈述道，"你真的要如此随意，如此欠考虑地背弃我们一同建立的一切吗？"

你感觉他冷静的外表下，内心深处早已是怒火中烧。"你明明那么有潜力。"

他突然抽身后退，带着轻蔑的甩手动作转过身去。"就跟我承认你说错话了吧，我会允许我自己忘记你方才的失言。"

entries.en:
The League $post's eyes go wide.

"$playerName. That is... this is a shock. You must understand that withdrawal from the League is permanent and irreversible. Though of course, technically, any member polity may leave as they wish. We all have that freedom."

$HeOrShe shifts uncomfortably, then speaks more quietly. "...Technically. But one hears things. You have an arrangement with Gens Hannan, is that correct? You cannot break a client agreement with a gens of Kazeron! It simply isn't done; why, you'll end up... an outcast, a bandit, a pariah. I urge you to reconsider. Think of your people!"
entries.zh:
联盟 $post 瞪大了双眼。

"$playerName。真是...真是惊人。你必须理解，退出联盟的决定是永久的，无法逆转的。虽说我们的成员在技术上确实享有随意退出的自由，我们都享有这种自由。"

$HeOrShe不适地挪动着身体，之后更小声地说了起来："...我们在技术上有这种自由，但我还听说了，你和 Hannan 氏族还有协议呢，对吧？你可不能违反与 Kazeron 的氏族订立的客户协议啊！这种协议可不是说断就断的，就是说，你会变成...流浪汉，流氓，贱民。请你再慎重考虑一下，想想你治下的人民！"

entries.en:
"These words come as a surprise, $playerName," Reynard Hannan says calmly. "Would you violate the promise you made to me, and to Gens Hannan, so thoughtlessly? I imagined we would prosper together; build a new Persean Sector... together."

You detect the anger boiling, deeply. "I never took you for an oathbreaker," he says soft, and deadly.

He pulls back suddenly, turning away with a dismissive flick. "Tell me now that you misspoke. I will allow myself to forget your slip of the tongue."
entries.zh:
"$playerName，你这话说得很惊人。" Reynard Hannan 冷静陈述道，"你真的要如此随意地毁弃你与我，与 Hannan 氏族许下的承诺吗？我还想象着我们能共同繁荣，建设新 英仙座星域...在你我合力下。"

你感觉他冷静的外表下，内心深处早已是怒火中烧。"我从没有认为你会背弃承诺。" 他说道，语调轻柔，却暗藏着致命的杀意。

他突然抽身后退，带着轻蔑的甩手动作转过身去。"就跟我承认你说错话了吧，我会允许我自己忘记你方才的失言。"

o.en: My colony is leaving the Persean League. Consider this official notice.
o.zh: 我的殖民地将退出 英仙座联盟。特此正式通告。

o.en: I'm pulling my colonies out of the Persean League. Consider this official notice.
o.zh: 我的殖民地将退出 英仙座联盟。特此正式通告。

o.en: I'm pulling my colonies out of the Persean League. Consider this official notice.
o.zh: 我的殖民地将退出 英仙座联盟。特此正式通告。

o.en: My colony is leaving the Persean League. Consider this official notice.
o.zh: 我的殖民地将退出 英仙座联盟。特此正式通告。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe eyes you for a long moment.

"Don't throw such words around so thoughtlessly in the future, $playerName. In the League, your word means something."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe瞪你瞪了有一会儿。

"$playerName，将来可别再不过脑子地说这种话了。在联盟，你的承诺是有分量的。"

entries.en: "Ah. That's what I thought," Reynard says with false grace. "It sounds just like the sort of boorish faux pas you would make."
entries.zh: "啊，和我想的一样。" Reynard 装出一副通情达理的样子，如释重负道，"如此粗鲁的失言，听起来确实是你的风格。"

entries.en:
The League $post's eyes narrow. "Think of what you're saying, $playerName."

"Yes, while you technically have the right to withdraw from the League at any time - we all do - it simply isn't done. The council will take this poorly, to say nothing of the Prime Demarchon."

$HeOrShe sighs, exasperated. "Let me speak plainly so that you may understand: your industries will be razed, your fleets reduced to scrap. One does not simply walk away from the Persean League."
entries.zh:
联盟 $post 眯起了眼睛。" $playerName，你说话的时候多考虑考虑。"

"对，技术上你确实有随时退出联盟的自由，这个我们都有，但这种事可不是退出了就完了的。议会不会接受，更别说大统领本人了。"

$HeOrShe恼怒地叹了口气。"换个你能听懂的说法吧：联盟会烧光你的产业，毁灭你的舰队，没有人能轻易从 英仙座联盟 中抽身而退。"

entries.en:
"Ingrate," Reynard Hannan spits the word. "I would see my League punish your barbarism, your bloody-minded fickleness, your oathbreaking."

"I would see your fleets smashed; your legacy burned to ash," he hisses, eyes afire. "Picture it, captain. You would be nothing but a dreary footnote in the history of the League, and minor embarrassment to Gens Hannan."

"If... you said such words, that would be your fate." He speaks very softly now, "Total annihilation."
entries.zh:
"背信弃义。" Reynard Hannan 唾骂道，"我将亲眼见证我的联盟惩戒你的野蛮，你不安好心的故意作梗，你的言而无信。"

"我将见证你的舰队被粉碎，你的遗产被焚毁。" 他继续咒骂着，眼里怒火迸射，"想想那幅场景吧，舰长，你只会成为联盟历史中无趣的注脚，只会给 Hannan 氏族带来些微不快。"

"如果你真敢...如此妄言的话，那你的命运就会如此。" 现在他的语气又变得相当柔和，"被完全毁灭。"

entries.en:
The League $post's eyes narrow. "Think of what you're saying, $playerName."

"Yes, while you technically have the right to withdraw from the League at any time - we all do - it simply isn't done. The council will take this poorly, to say nothing of the Prime Demarchon."

$HeOrShe sighs, exasperated. "Let me speak plainly so that you may understand: you will harried, captain. And yes, a captain is all you'll be in the end. It may take cycles, but if you do this, you will make... such enemies."
entries.zh:
联盟 $post 眯起了眼睛。" $playerName，你说话的时候多考虑考虑。"

"对，技术上你确实有随时退出联盟的自由，这个我们都有，但这种事可不是退出了就完了的。议会不会接受，更别说大统领本人了。"

$HeOrShe恼怒地叹了口气。"换个你能听懂的说法吧：联盟会折磨你，直至你不堪其扰，舰长 —— 对，直到最后你只能当个舰长为止。可能我们要花上几年才能让你重新变为孤家寡人，但如果你真敢退出的话，你就会结下这么可怕...的仇敌。"

entries.en:
"Ingrate," Reynard Hannan spits the word. "My League remembers barbarism, bloody-minded fickleness, oathbreaking and lies. We remember Mairaath."

"One day," his eyes go cold as the space between the stars, "You might be only dust. Annihilated, forgotten. You could be nothing but a dreary footnote in the glorious history of the League, a minor embarrassment to Gens Hannan."

"Picture it," he says softly. "After such words, that would be your fate."
entries.zh:
"背信弃义。" Reynard Hannan 唾骂道，"我的联盟将铭记你的野蛮，你不安好心的故意作梗，你的言而无信与满口谎言。我们还记得 Mariaath。"

"终有一天，" 他眼神冷漠的如同恒星间的茫茫虚空，"你会化作尘埃，被毁灭，被遗忘。你只会成为联盟历史中无趣的注脚，只会给 Hannan 氏族带来些微不快。"

"想想那幅场景吧。" 现在他的语气又柔和了下来，"如此妄言之后，你的命运也只能这样了。"

entries.en:
"Don't be an ingrate," the Persean League $post flushes with anger. "You had a second chance! No one gets a second chance!"

"Let me spell out for you the consequence of your barbarous words: your industries? They'll be razed to slag. Your people? Killed, and scattered to the stars to die in vacuum, or in the mines of some backwater gravity well."

"You'll never be allowed back into the League. You'll be scorned as an oathbreaker, a barbarian; an enemy of the free people of the League. Think on that."
entries.zh:
"你可别忘恩负义！" 英仙座联盟 $post 涨红了脸，愤怒异常："我们可是又给了你一次机会！没什么人能得到这种机会的！"

"我就用你这种蛮子听得懂的话，一个字一个字的给你讲讲你的结局如何吧：你的工业？全都毁了，烧成铁渣。你的人？全都杀了，要么扔进外太空，等着憋死，要么就扔进哪个与世隔绝的重力井里的矿场，当一辈子奴工。"

"而你将 再也不能回到联盟 了。大家都会鄙视你，说你背信弃义，蛮横无理，是全联盟自由人民的敌人。好好想想吧。"

entries.en:
Reynard closes his eyes for a moment, "You've made a series of terrible errors, $playerName," he says, voice filled with mock-sorrow. "You had such potential. To be part of something greater; to build something lasting, something beautiful."

The calm breaks, "Churl!" he shouts, eyes afire. "You're nothing but a barbarian, good for nothing but chaos! I'll grind your fleets to dust! I'll raze your industry to the ground! Your treasures will become as so much slag; your people scattered to the vacuum to pollute some other world, or die in the vacuum."

"When we come for you," his eyes are filled with hate, "We will come with fire."
entries.zh:
Reynard 闭上双眼片刻，" $playerName，你犯下了几个糟糕的错误。" 他的声音充满着虚伪的哀伤，"你原本很有潜力，能够成为伟业的一部分，能够建立永恒的丰功伟绩。"

那宁静的氛围猛然破开。"你这莽夫！" 他突然大喊起来，双眼里燃着火焰，"你不过是个野蛮人，除了制造混乱外一无是处！我要把你的舰队碾作尘埃！我要把你的工业烧成白地！你的财宝将被融成渣滓，你的人民将被丢进真空，让他们要么去祸害其他哪个世界，要么就这么死在真空里！"

"我们再找你的时候..." 他眼中充满着仇恨，"我们会全副武装的。"

entries.en:
"Don't be an ingrate," the Persean League $post flushes with anger. "You had a second chance! No one gets a second chance!"

"The League remembers such betrayal. We never forgot Mairaath, and never will," with its present capacity reduced, $heOrShe must fall back to the old scars and grudges of the League. "Even if it takes a hundred cycles, there will be a reckoning."

"And you'll never be allowed back into the League. You'll be scorned as an oathbreaker, a barbarian; an enemy of the free people of the League. Think on that."
entries.zh:
"你可别忘恩负义！" 英仙座联盟 $post 涨红了脸，愤怒异常："我们可是又给了你一次机会！没什么人能得到这种机会的！"

"联盟会记得这种背叛的，我们还没有忘记 Mariaath，我们永远不会忘记它。" $heOrShe不得不去挖掘联盟过去的深仇旧恨，因为现在的联盟能力远不如当初了，"我们会复仇的，哪怕花上一百个星历年。"

"而你将 再也不能回到联盟 了。大家都会鄙视你，说你背信弃义，蛮横无理，是全联盟自由人民的敌人。好好想想吧。"

entries.en:
Reynard closes his eyes for a moment, "You've made a series of terrible errors, $playerName," he says, voice filled with mock-sorrow. "You had such potential. To be part of something greater; to build something lasting, something beautiful."

"Again and again you chose chaos. A barbarian-led rogue polity like yours... will never be allowed to rejoin the League."

"Don't worry about another blockade, captain," he spits the low title, his eyes shining like the frost of a cryopod. "Someday, we will come for you. And when we come, we will come with fire."
entries.zh:
Reynard 闭上双眼片刻，" $playerName，你犯下了几个糟糕的错误。" 他的声音充满着虚伪的哀伤，"你原本很有潜力，能够成为伟业的一部分，能够建立永恒的丰功伟绩。"

 "一次又一次，你还是在选择混乱。你这种野蛮人治下的流氓政治实体...将{再也不能加入联盟}。"

"不必担心下一次封锁了，舰长。" 他轻蔑地吐出了这个低微的头衔，双眼闪烁寒光，如同冷冻舱上的结霜一般冰冷，"总有一天，我们会来找你的，等我们到来的时候，我们会全副武装。"

o.en: I'd like to talk to you about joining the Persean League.
o.zh: 我希望与你谈谈关于加入 英仙座联盟 的事宜。

entries.en:
The comms crackle, forming an image.

"Captain $playerName," the Persean League $post stares at you with undisguised hostility. "You were once one of us. You believed in building a new sector together." $HisOrHer voice drops, "I wonder, though, did you ever believe or was it always a trick. What could you have gained that is worth such a betrayal of our ideals?"

$HeOrShe pauses for half a breath, then instead of admonishing you further taps the comms cutoff.
OR
The comms form an image, and crackling into focus.

"To think you were once part of the League," $heOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head in disgust. "You've chosen barbarism, so we shall deal with you in the only language you know: brute force."

$HeOrShe makes an abrupt sign to cut the comms.
entries.zh:
通讯发出嘈杂声，形成了一个图像。

"$playerName舰长，" 英仙座联盟 的 $post 毫不掩饰敌意地盯着你。"你曾经是我们中的一员。你曾相信我们可以共同建设一个新的星域。" $HisOrHer的声音低沉下来，"不过，我想知道，你是否曾经真正相信过我们的理想，还是这只是你的一个诡计。背叛我们的理想，你究竟能得到什么好处？"

$HeOrShe停顿了一下，没有进一步责备你，而是切断了通讯。
OR
通讯发出嘈杂声，形成了一个图像。

"真没想到你曾经成为过联盟的一员，" $heOrShe厌恶地摇了摇头，"你选择了野蛮，那么我们就用你唯一能理解的语言来对付你：暴力。"

$HeOrShe突然做了个手势，切断了通讯。

entries.en:
The comms snap into clarity.

"There's really no reason for me to speak to you, of course," the Persean League $post says. "I suppose I wanted to be able to say that I looked upon your face before I was forced to use violence in the service of the League." $HeOrShe leans closer, "Because unlike you, I believe in honor and dignity."

$HeOrShe jabs the cutoff before you can respond.
OR
The comms snap into clarity.

"You've proven yourself an oathbreaker twice over," the Persean League $post says, derision plain in $hisOrHer voice. $HeOrShe turns to address $hisOrHer own crew and officers, "Witness the fate of an upstart bandit who assaults the principles of the League!"

$HisOrHer hand drops, signaling the comms cutoff before you can reply.
entries.zh:
通讯瞬间变得清晰。

"当然，我其实并不想和你交谈，" 英仙座联盟 $Post 说道，"我只是想在自己被迫为联盟的利益使用暴力之前，能亲眼看看你的脸。" $HeOrShe靠近了一些，"因为和你不同，我相信荣誉和尊严。"

$HeOrShe在你回答之前切断了通讯。
OR
通讯瞬间变得清晰。

"你已经两次证明自己是个背誓者了，" 英仙座联盟 $Post 说，声音中充满了嘲讽。$HeOrShe转身对自己的船员和军官说道，"看看这个背叛联盟的暴发户强盗的下场吧！"

随着$HisOrHer手落下，通讯在你来得及回答之前就切断了。

entries.en: "You hold no major faction's commission," he says, eyes focused on a subtle interface implant. "Considering your... activities, you will need to commit to a Persean League commission as a part of the membership agreement; a standard arrangement."
entries.zh: "你目前没有和任何主要势力签订雇佣协议，" 他说道，眼睛紧盯着某个微妙的植入物界面，"考虑到你的...活动，你需要与联盟签订雇佣协议，作为你加入 英仙座联盟 的条件之一；这是标准流程。"

entries.en:
"You presently hold a $otherCommissionFaction commission," he says, frowning. "A problem, but not insurmountable. Resign that commission and commit to the Persean League as part of the membership agreement."

"Certain members of the council may object, perhaps loudly. But they'll merely be seeking concessions." Reynard gives a small smile, "Routine matters, easily managed."
entries.zh:
"你目前和 $otherCommissionFaction 签订了雇佣协议，" 他皱着眉头说，"这是一个问题，但并非无法解决。撕毁那份协议，再与联盟签订新的，并承诺效忠于 英仙座联盟。"

"理事会的一些成员可能会反对，甚至可能闹得很大。但他们只是在寻求让步。" Reynard 微微一笑，"这只是例行公事，很容易处理。"

entries.en: "You are already commissioned with the League," he says approvingly. "This would do much to ease the membership process."
entries.zh: "你已经接受了联盟的雇佣协议，" 他赞许地说。"这将极大地简化加入联盟的流程。"

o.en: I'd like to talk to you about joining the Persean League.
o.zh: 我希望与你谈谈关于加入 英仙座联盟 的事宜。

entries.en:
He laughs as if at some private joke then moves to close the comm link.

And pauses.

"Oh, you were serious?" He starts to shake his head, suppressing a smile. But not quite succeeding, because he wants you to see it. "That's even better."
entries.zh:
他大笑起来，仿佛听到了某个只有当事人才懂的笑话，然后准备关闭通讯链接，却又停了下来。

"哦，你是认真的？" 他开始摇头，试图忍住笑意，但并未完全成功；而他之所以没有完全忍住，只是因为他想让你看到这一点。"那就更好了。"

他关闭了通讯，留下你一个人，面对着 Hannan 氏族的徽标和大统领的标志，思考着将你带到这一刻的种种选择。

entries.en:
"Do you remember what we had, $playerName?" Reynard looks dreamily away, "A shared vision, my patronage, a future. Together."

He turns an icy gaze back on you, like the target-lock of a directed energy submunition. "Do you remember throwing that away, like so much effluent?"

"I remember." His expression is very still.
entries.zh:
"你还记得我们曾经拥有的一切吗，$playerName？" Reynard 梦幻般地望向远方，"共同的愿景，我的支持，一个共同的未来。我们一起。"

他转过头来，用冰冷的目光盯着你，就像定向能量武器锁定了目标一样。"你是否记得你把这一切都抛弃了吗，就像扔掉一堆垃圾？"

"我记得。" 他的表情非常平静。

entries.en: He completes the motion, leaving you to contemplate the choices which led you to this moment with the crest of Gens Hannan wrapped in the sigil of the office of Prime Demarchon.
entries.zh: 他做完了那个动作，只留下你去回味：是哪些抉择把你带到了这一刻——Hannan 氏族的纹章，被裹进了大统领的徽记之中。

entries.en: He completes the motion, leaving you to contemplate the choices which led you to this moment with the crest of Gens Hannan wrapped in the sigil of the office of Prime Demarchon.
entries.zh: 他做完了那个动作，只留下你去回味：是哪些抉择把你带到了这一刻——Hannan 氏族的纹章，被裹进了大统领的徽记之中。

o.en: DEV Use mind powers to make him let you into the League
o.zh: DEV 用念力让他放你进联盟

entries.en:
"My hands are tied, $playerName. The League Council, the representative body of all the free peoples of the League, demanded a show of force."

"I hope," he drops his voice, "You'll learn an important lesson from this."

"Speak to me when the operation is concluded," he says, all business now. "Good day."
entries.zh:
"我也无能为力，$playerName。联盟理事会，即联盟所有自由人民的代表机构，要求我们宣示力量。"

"我希望，" 他压低声音，"你能从这件事中吸取一个重要的教训。"

"等行动结束后，我们再谈谈，" 他现在的语气完全是一副公事公办的样子。"祝你好运。"

entries.en:
A single perfect eyebrow raises a centimeter.

"You had not heard?" He shakes his head ever so slightly, a concession to the notion that he ought to express regret.

"You will," he says, reaching for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
他的一条完美的眉毛微微上扬。

"你还没听说吗？" 他轻轻摇了摇头，仿佛是在承认他应该表示遗憾。

"你很快就会知道了，" 他说着，随即切断了通讯。

entries.en:
Reynard lips move into a small, cold smile, as if indulging a joke made in very poor taste.

"Your word is nothing, $playerName; a wisp of a forgotten memory, lost between the stars. And you come to me and bark like a lap-hound, begging but not understanding."

If his look didn't contain such contempt, you'd think he was pitying you.
entries.zh:
Reynard 的嘴唇勾起一抹小而冰冷的微笑，仿佛是在纵容一个非常低俗的笑话。

"你的言语毫无价值，$playerName；就一缕被遗落在群星之间的记忆。而你跑到我面前，像野狗一样狂吠、乞求，却什么都不明白。"

要不是他的眼神中充满了蔑视，你或许还会以为他在可怜你。

entries.en:
Reynard Hannan looks upon you approvingly.

"The details are endless, but you need only be concerned with the highest level of the arrangement. It is not complex."
entries.zh: Reynard Hannan 赞许地看着你。"琐事无穷无尽，但你只需要关注最重要的事项。这并不复杂。"

entries.en:
He explains that you must hold a League commission, and pay $plDuesPercent of gross colony income in dues. In turn, the Persean League will provide you with political protection from the sort of meddling major factions use to bully minor polities; Hegemony AI inspections, for instance. You will benefit from various League development programs for new member-polities which should increase colony accessibility by around 10%.

"Provide the League with dues and commercial access and you will be free to run your affairs as you wish," he concludes. "Barring certain extremes which would embarrass the League, naturally." He gives you a look of self-aware pedantry, "But any leader with sense knows how to keep their internal affairs... internal."
entries.zh:
他解释说，你必须持有联盟的雇佣协议，再支付殖民地总收入的 $plDuesPercent 作为会费。作为回报，英仙座联盟 将为你提供政治保护，免受强大势力通过干涉来欺凌弱小势力的行为；例如，免受 霸主 AI 审查活动的骚扰。作为新加入联盟的成员，你的殖民地将从各种联盟发展计划中受益，从而提高约 10% 殖民地流通性。

"向联盟支付会费并提供商业通道，你就可以自由地按照自己的意愿处理你的事务，" 他总结道，"当然，除了那些会让联盟感到难堪的极端行为。" 他给了你一个要你自知谨小慎微的眼神，"但任何明智的领导者都知道如何让自己的内部事务...在内部解决。"

entries.en: Reynard Hannan looks at you blankly, drool starting to drip from the side of his mouth. He speaks in a robotic monotone, "Of course, $playerName. I would be so... pleased... to help you."
entries.zh: Reynard Hannan 呆呆地看着你，口水开始从嘴角滴落。他用一种机械般单调的声音说道："当然，$playerName。我会非常...乐意...帮助你的。"

entries.en:
"The details are endless, but you need only be concerned with the highest level of the arrangement. It is not complex."

Reynard Hannan smiles coldly. "And I believe you wished to 'vote me out'? Maybe you'll get your chance."
entries.zh:
"琐事无穷无尽，但你只需要关注最重要的事项。这并不复杂。"

Reynard Hannan 冷笑道："而且我相信你曾经想 '把我赶出去'？也许你会有机会的。"

o.en: My decision to stop payments to Gens Hannan may have been ill-considered.
o.zh: 我先前停止向 Hannan 氏族付款的决定有些草率了。

o.en: I'm stopping the payments to Gens Hannan, effective immediately.
o.zh: 我要终止对 Hannan 氏族的付款，立即生效。

entries.en: Unfortunately, the pods were wired to explode unless the correct authorization code was given, and the cargo is destroyed in its entirety.
entries.zh: 不幸的是，只有给出正确的授权码才能避免货物仓的自爆装置启动，因此仓内的货物被全部炸毁了。

o.en: Put the pods into a stable orbit
o.zh: 把货物舱送入稳定轨道

o.en: Transmit the keycode and examine the contents
o.zh: 传送密钥代码并检查其内容物

o.en: You're new. What happened to the old archon?
o.zh: 你似乎是新来的，之前的执政官怎么了？

entries.en:
"They were replaced," $heOrShe says imperiously. "I, of course, have only recently been burdened with this office."

"You see, the local rabble couldn't maintain order and my family, Gens Hannan, has invested tremendously into the industries this backwater mining camp feeds. It was decided that someone responsible ought to look after things directly." $HeOrShe sighs, crossing $hisOrHer arms, "Lucky me."
entries.zh:
"那人被换掉了。" $heOrShe一副无所谓的样子，"当然，我是最近才担任起这个职务的。"

"你看，当地的暴民无法维持秩序，而我的氏族 —— Hannan 氏族 —— 已经在这个停滞不前的采矿营地所供养的工业上投入了大量资金，这意味着需要由专人来负责管理这些事物。" $HeOrShe叹息着，交叉着$hisOrHer的双臂，"我真幸运。"

o.en: If you don't like it here, why don't you resign?
o.zh: 如果你不喜欢这里，为什么不辞职呢？

entries.en:
$PersonName looks down at you, "I'm sure someone of your station wouldn't understand, captain. I'm Hannan. I bear obligations," $heOrShe says this word with a particular emphasis, a particular noblesse oblige.

"I shall do my time, as the gens demands, and then it is agreed that I shall take up a more fitting office. Perhaps as vice-minister of something or other. A navarchship perhaps?" $HeOrShe smiles, "That would only be the beginning, of course. Unlike many of my dear cousins, I have greater ambitions; and to fulfill ambitions we must sacrifice- thus." $PersonName spreads $hisOrHer hands, indicating Laicaille Habitat.
entries.zh:
$PersonName 看着你："舰长，我敢说身处你这样的地位的人是不会明白的。我是 Hannan 氏族的一员，我承担着责任。" $heOrShe特别强调了 "责任" 这词，似乎想说这是一种特殊的贵族义务。

"我将按照氏族的要求完成我的工作，那之后我将会担任一个更合适的职务。或许是做什么的副部长，又或许是一名海军将领。" $HeOrShe微笑着说，"当然，那只会是个开始。我有理想，不像我亲爱的任何一位兄弟姐妹，我有更大的理想，而为了实现理想，我必须做出奉献 —— 就这样。" $PersonName 摊开$hisOrHer的手，暗示着 Laicaille 栖息地就是所谓的 "奉献"。

o.en: This post must be a terrible burden. Thank you for your service. (sarcastic)
o.zh: 这个岗位肯定是个苦差事。感谢你的奉献。 (讽刺)

o.en: This post must be a terrible burden. Thank you for your service.
o.zh: 这个岗位肯定是个苦差事。感谢你的奉献。

o.en: Interesting. Well, keep up the good work. (leave)
o.zh: 有意思。好吧，继续好好干。 (离开)

o.en: Demarchon. Not captain. I lead a member-polity in the League.
o.zh: 是统领，而不是舰长。我领导着联盟的一个成员政体。

o.en: This must be terrible for you. Thank you for your service. (sarcastic)
o.zh: 这对你来说肯定很难熬吧。感谢你的奉献。 (讽刺)

o.en: This must be terrible for you. Thank you for your service.
o.zh: 这对你来说肯定很难熬吧。感谢你的奉献。

o.en: Interesting. Well, keep up the good work. (leave)
o.zh: 有意思。好吧，继续好好干。 (离开)

entries.en:
"Indeed." $heOrShe looks toward the proverbial horizon wistfully, "I am counting the days 'til I might return to a center of culture and wealth."

"Anyway, there's supposed to be some kind of work for me to do around here. Appearances must be maintained, am I not right? Your visit was very diverting, thank you captain."
entries.zh:
"确实。" $heOrShe惆怅地看向远方，如同望着一条遥远的地平线，"我正在数着日子，到了重返文化和财富的中心那一天，我就能清楚自己在这里熬了多久。"

"不论如何，这里应该有值得我做的事。起码也得做个样子，不是么？和你聊天很有意思，谢谢你，舰长。"

entries.en:
He smiles, turning his head slightly into a practiced angle to better emphasize his jawline.

"That would be Gens Hannan you recognize, $playerSirOrMadam"
entries.zh:
他微笑着，略微侧首熟练地摆出角度以更好地凸显下颌线。

"你认出的想必是 Hannan 氏族，$playerSirOrMadam。"

entries.en:
"Not at all," he says, quite seriously.

"I bring the dynamism and culture of Kazeron to this staid backwater, and it will be much improved by my example and leadership."
entries.zh:
"完全没有，" 他十分严肃地说道。

"我将 Kazeron 的活力与文化带到了这个沉闷的边陲之地，我的表率与领导将使此地焕然一新。"

o.en: Aren't you a little young for an archon?
o.zh: 作为执政官你是否有些太年轻了？

entries.en:
"Is that so?" $HeOrShe raises an eyebrow.

"How charming. I'm sure your contribution to our League will be acknowledged sooner or later."
entries.zh:
"是吗？" $heOrShe挑了挑眉。

"真是感人，我相信你对联盟的贡献迟早会获得认可。"

o.en: This post must be a terrible burden. Thank you for your service. (sarcastic)
o.zh: 这个岗位肯定是个苦差事。感谢你的奉献。 (讽刺)

o.en: This post must be a terrible burden. Thank you for your service.
o.zh: 这个岗位肯定是个苦差事。感谢你的奉献。

o.en: Interesting. Well, keep up the good work. (leave)
o.zh: 有意思。好吧，继续好好干。 (离开)

entries.en:
$HeOrShe recognizes you with a start and $hisOrHer attempt to put on a neutral face to greet the comm request collapses.

"Captain $playerName. We meet again."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe立马就认出了你，并且$HeOrShe在回应通讯请求后装作什么也没发生的努力失败了。

"$playerName 舰长，我们又见面了。"

o.en: What happened? Weren't you the archon of Laicaille?
o.zh: 发生了什么？你不是 Laicaille 的执政官吗？

entries.en:
"I was, yes." $HeOrShe lets this stand for a moment. "I didn't play along and I - we - embarrassed some important people in the League. Made some powerful enemies. They turned the executive council against me, and that was it."

"I don't hold anything against you, captain. They won," $heOrShe says, then shakes $hisOrHer head. "Laicaille Habitat is small and poor in the grand scheme of the Persean League. Despite what the charter says, that's all there is to it."
entries.zh:
"我是，至少曾经是。" $HeOrShe沉默了一阵子，"我没有安分守己，因此我 —— 或者说我们 —— 让联盟里的一些重要人物感到尴尬。让一些惹不起的人成为了敌人，他们让执行委员会站在了我的对立面，就是这样。"

"我并未因此对你怀恨在心，舰长。他们赢了。" $heOrShe说，然后摇了摇$hisOrHer的头，" Laicaille 栖息地不过是 英仙座联盟 宏伟计划中无关紧要的一部分，不管联盟的宪章里写了什么，这就是事实。"

o.en: This seems unjust. Is there anything I can do?
o.zh: 这不公平，我能做些什么呢？

o.en: Are they going to come after me next?
My condolences. I must be on my way. (cut comm link)
o.zh: 我很抱歉，但我得先走了。 (切断通讯链接)

entries.en:
"No," $heOrShe smiles bitterly. "I don't think so. Consider yourself lucky that you've been largely overlooked by Kazeron and Gens Hannans for your role in all of this."

"I think you would do well not to contact me about this subject again, captain."
entries.zh:
"不会。" $HeOrShe苦笑着说，"我不这么认为，你很幸运，Kazeron 当局和 Hannan 氏族都没有注意到你在这一切中扮演的角色。"

"你最好不要再为此事联系我了，舰长。"

entries.en:
"No." $HeOrShe smiles bitterly, "Break Kazeron's grip on the League? Convince Gens Hannan to give the people of Laicaille back ownership of their mining fleets and processing facilities?"

"I lost. I don't like it, but my career is over. Consider yourself lucky that you've been largely overlooked for your role in all of this. You would do well not to contact me about the subject again."
entries.zh:
"不。" $HeOrShe苦笑着说，"你能做到什么呢？打破 Kazeron 对联盟的控制？说服 Hannan 氏族把采矿舰队和加工设施的所有权还给 Laicaille 的人民吗？"

"我输了，舰长。我不喜欢这个结局，但事实就是如此，我的事业已经走到了尽头。你应该庆幸自己在这一切中发挥的作用很大程度上被忽视了 —— 这就是我给你的忠告，你最好不要再为这事联系我了。"

o.en: My condolences. I must be on my way. (cut comm link)
o.zh: 我很抱歉，但我得先走了。 (切断通讯链接)

entries.en:
$HeOrShe recognizes you with a start and $hisOrHer attempt to put on a neutral face to greet the comm request collapses.

"Demarchon $playerName. We meet again."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe立马就认出了你，并且$HeOrShe在回应通讯请求后装作什么也没发生的努力失败了。

"$playerName 统领，我们又见面了。"

o.en: What happened? Weren't you the archon of Laicaille?
o.zh: 发生了什么？你不是 Laicaille 的执政官吗？

entries.en:
"I was, yes." $HeOrShe lets this stand for a moment. "I, we, embarrassed some important people. Gens out of Kazeron."

$HeOrShe pauses, then shrugs. "Reynard Hannan. He didn't like the way things went. Made him look bad. He turned our executive council against me. Wasn't hard for him. Gens Hannan is behind most of the out-of-system investment, to say nothing of control over Fleet patrols. And that was it."

"I don't hold anything against you, demarchon. They won," $heOrShe says, then shakes $hisOrHer head. "Laicaille Habitat is small and poor in the grand scheme of the Persean League. Despite what the charter says, that's all there is to it."
entries.zh:
"我是，至少曾经是。" $HeOrShe沉默了一阵子，"我，我们，让一些大人物难堪了。那些 Kazeron 的氏族势力。"

$heOrShe顿了顿，随后耸耸肩。"Reynard Hannan，他不喜欢事态的发展，因为这让他颜面扫地。他操纵执行委员会与我作对，这对他不难。Hannan 氏族掌控着大部分跨星系投资，更不用说舰队巡逻权，就是这样。"

"我并未因此对你怀恨在心，统领。他们赢了。" $heOrShe说，然后摇了摇$hisOrHer的头，"Laicaille 栖息地不过是 英仙座联盟 宏伟计划中无关紧要的一部分，不管联盟的宪章里写了什么，这就是事实。"

o.en: This is unjust. Is there anything I can do?
o.zh: 这也太不公平了，我能做些什么呢？

o.en: Are they going to come after me next?
My condolences. I must be on my way. (cut comm link)
o.zh: 我很抱歉，但我得先走了。 (切断通讯链接)

o.en: I told Horus Yaribay I'm backing you and Achilles. And so should he.
o.zh: 我告诉过 Horus Yaribay，我站在你和 Achilles 这一边。他也该如此。

entries.en:
She looks mildly amused.

"Rather direct of you, but nonetheless appreciated. I am in the midst of negotiations with Gens Yaribay and hope that he will see the wisdom of my plan."

"Perhaps your good word will tip his opinion," Fortuna says charitably. "But these things take time. Especially with Horus."
entries.zh:
她看上去被逗乐了一点。

"你倒是直截了当，不过我还是领情。我正在与 Yaribay 氏族谈判，希望他能看出我这套计划的明智之处。"

"也许你的一句好话能让他的看法偏过来。\"Fortuna 说得宽厚，\"不过这种事急不得。尤其是对 Horus。"

entries.en:
"Patience, my dear, patience," she says indulgently. "You'll have an opportunity to earn more credits soon enough."

"In the meantime, ready yourself for the coming war."
entries.zh:
"耐心，亲爱的，耐心。\"她纵容地说，\"机会很快就会来，让你挣到更多星币。"

"在那之前，为即将到来的战争做好准备。"

o.en: Is there anything I can do to help with Achilles?
o.zh: 关于 Achilles 的事，我能帮上什么忙吗？

o.en: Is there anything I can do to help with Achilles?
o.zh: 关于 Achilles 的事，我能帮上什么忙吗？

entries.en:
"Patience, my dear, patience," she says indulgently. "You'll have an opportunity soon enough."

"In the meantime, ready yourself for the coming war."
entries.zh:
"耐心，亲爱的，耐心。\"她纵容地说，\"机会很快就会来的。"

"在那之前，为即将到来的战争做好准备。"

entries.en:
The comms request idles, repeating.

Finally, some young flunky in a perfectly pressed black uniform appears.

"Glory to Andrada, the Lion of Sindria. This is the Ministry of Internal Security, office of the Chief High Inspector-General."

The officer eyes you suspiciously.

"If you have subversion to report, please terminate this link and connect to the Patriotic Citizen-Security Reports section."
entries.zh:
通讯请求一遍遍重复，悬着没人接。

总算来了个年轻跟班，一身黑制服笔挺。

"荣耀归于辛达瑞亚之狮 Andrada。这里是内部安全部，最高检察长办公室。"

那军官疑心重重地打量着你。

"若要举报颠覆行为，请断开本链接，改接爱国公民安全举报处。"

o.en: I need to talk to you about Fortuna Kato's plans with Achilles.
o.zh: 我得跟你谈谈 Fortuna Kato 围绕 Achilles 的打算。

entries.en:
"With respect for my position and duty, $titlePL, I would prefer not to discuss the situation from a perspective which could be misconstrued as favoring one or another of the Gens."

Siyavong doesn't change his expression.

"Perhaps we might speak again when the situation becomes... more clearly applicable to the security of the Persean League." He pauses. "And, perhaps, to one of its citizens, commission-bearers, or even a demarchon."
entries.zh:
"出于对我职位与职责的尊重，$titlePL，我不愿从某个可能被误解为偏袒某一氏族的立场来谈这件事。"

Siyavong 面色不改。

"也许等局势...更明确地涉及英仙座联盟的安全时，我们可以再谈。\"他顿了顿。\"或者，涉及它的某位公民、某位持委任状者，甚至某位统领时。"

entries.en: He nods again, expression controlled.
entries.zh: 他又点了点头，神情克制。

entries.en:
He frowns, looking down for a moment. Then back to you.

"I was never given favor for my secret name. Reynard Hannan saw to that. And I will not slacken now like a Gens-heir because of my name."

Achilles wears a hard expression, then continues.

"It is no small thing to be the son of Philip Andrada, but my potential is what I made of it. As for me, as for Askonia."

He takes a deep breath.

"I have much to do, $titlePL."
entries.zh:
他皱起眉，低头看了片刻，然后重新看向你。

"我这个隐秘的姓氏，从来没给我带来过什么优待。Reynard Hannan 把这条路堵死了。我也绝不会因为一个姓氏，就像个氏族继承人那样松懈下来。"

Achilles 面色严峻，接着说道。

"做 Philip Andrada 的儿子不是小事，可我这份潜力，是我自己挣出来的。于我如此，于 Askonia 亦如此。"

他深吸了一口气。

"我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"

entries.en: He nods again, expression controlled.
entries.zh: 他又点了点头，神情克制。

entries.en:
"Were that it was so simple. If I was a Persean League Fleet lieutenant, winning would have been enough- job done, now get some R&R."

Achilles looks wistful for just a moment.

"But Askonia calls. I must transform a win into a victory; no small task, even for the 'blood of Andrada'."

By his smirk, you are led to understand that he is making a joke.

"Now I have much to do, $titlePL," he says conclusively.
entries.zh:
"要是事情真有那么简单就好了。我要是英仙座联盟舰队的一名上尉，打赢就够了——事情完了，回去休整。"

Achilles 有一瞬间神情怅然。

"可 Askonia 在召唤。我得把一场胜仗变成一场胜利；就算对'Andrada 的血脉'来说，这也不是小事。"

看他那副得意的笑，你明白他是在开玩笑。

"现在我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"他以这句话作结。

entries.en:
"Were that it was so simple. If I was a lieutenant back in Fleet, winning would have been enough. Job done, now get some R&R."

He looks wistful for just a moment.

"But," he says, "I must transform... this... into victory. No small task, even for the 'blood of Andrada'." By his ironic smirk, you are led to understand that he is making a joke.

"Now I have much to do, $titlePL," he says conclusively.
entries.zh:
"要是事情真有那么简单就好了。我要是还在舰队里当上尉，打赢就够了。事情完了，去休整一番。"

Achilles 有一瞬间神情怅然。

"可是，"他说，"我得把...这个...变成胜利。就算对'Andrada 的血脉'来说，这也不是小事。"看他那带着自嘲的笑，你明白他是在开玩笑。

"现在我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"他以这句话作结。

entries.en:
"Were that 'better' was so simple as your good intentions. If I was a lieutenant back in Fleet, winning would have been enough. Job done, get some R&R."

He looks wistful for just a moment.

"But Askonia calls. I must transform a win into a resounding victory; no small task, even for the 'blood of Andrada'."

By his smirk, you are led to understand that he is making a joke.

"Now I have much to do, $titlePL," he says conclusively.
entries.zh:
"要是'更好'能像你的好意一样简单就好了。我要是还在舰队里当上尉，打赢就够了。事情完了，回去休整。"

Achilles 有一瞬间神情怅然。

"可 Askonia 在召唤。我得把一场胜仗变成一场响当当的胜利；就算对'Andrada 的血脉'来说，这也不是小事。"

看他那副得意的笑，你明白他是在开玩笑。

"现在我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"他以这句话作结。

entries.en: He gives you an odd look, then nods again, expression controlled.
entries.zh: 他古怪地看了你一眼，随后又点了点头，神情克制。

entries.en:
"Were that 'better' was so simple as good intentions. Were I still a lieutenant in Fleet, winning would have been enough. Job done, get some R&R."

He looks wistful for just a moment.

"But," he says, "I must transform the dead, the ruins and wrecks... into victory. No small task, even for the 'blood of Andrada'." By his ironic smirk, you are led to understand that he is making a joke.

"Now I have much to do, $titlePL," he says conclusively.
entries.zh:
"要是'更好'能像好意一样简单就好了。我要还是舰队里的上尉，打赢就够了。事情完了，去休整一番。"

Achilles 有一瞬间神情怅然。

"可是，"他说，"我得把死者、废墟和残骸...变成胜利。就算对'Andrada 的血脉'来说，这也不是小事。"看他那带着自嘲的笑，你明白他是在开玩笑。

"现在我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"他以这句话作结。

entries.en:
Is that a look of amusement?

If so, it is ironic, and quickly concealed.

"Matters such as this are never so simple as they appear," he says. "And we shall not be speaking further on the subject at this time."

"Askonia calls, $titlePL. And I have much to do," he says conclusively.
entries.zh:
那眼神里是觉得有趣吗？

若真是如此，那也是带着讽刺的，而且立刻就被藏了起来。

"这种事从来不像看上去那么简单，\"他说，\"眼下我们也不会再谈这个话题了。"

"Askonia 在召唤，$titlePL。而我还有许多事要做。"他以这句话作结。

entries.en: Before long, Supreme Executor Achilles Andrada himself appears in the link.
entries.zh: 没过多久，最高元首 Achilles Andrada 本人出现在通讯里。

entries.en:
Before long, Achilles Andrada himself appears in the link.
He looks more like Demarchon than Supreme Executor to your eyes.
entries.zh:
没过多久，Achilles Andrada 本人出现在通讯里。
在你眼里，他更像一位统领，而不是最高元首。

entries.en: The comms stall for several minutes on the new crest of Achilles' Sindrian Diktat.
entries.zh: 通讯画面停在辛达强权的新徽记上——那枚 Achilles 的徽记——好几分钟没有动静。

entries.en: The comms stall for several minutes on the crest of the Persean League.
entries.zh: 通讯画面在英仙座联盟的徽记上停滞了好几分钟。

entries.en: "And more than service, you pledged the support of your colonial organization to my cause." He nods, almost but not quite a bow.
entries.zh: "而且你不只效了力，还把殖民组织的力量押在了我的事业上。"他点了点头，姿态近乎躬身，却又算不上躬身。

entries.en: "$TitlePL $PlayerLastName." He looks you over. "I must take this opportunity to give you my thanks for your service."
entries.zh: "$TitlePL $PlayerLastName。\"他打量了你一番。\"我必须借此机会，为你的效劳向你致谢。"

entries.en: "$TitlePL $PlayerLastName." He looks you over. "I must take this opportunity to give you my thanks for your service."
entries.zh: "$TitlePL $PlayerLastName。\"他打量了你一番。\"我必须借此机会，为你的效劳向你致谢。"

entries.en: "$TitlePL $PlayerLastName." He looks you over. "My fellow demarchon. I must give you my thanks for your service."
entries.zh: "$TitlePL $PlayerLastName。\"他打量着你。\"我的统领同僚。我必须为你的效劳向你致谢。"

entries.en:
You'd swear his eyes glint coldly as he takes a deep, calming breath.

"Matters such as this are never so simple as they appear," he says. "And we shall not be speaking further on the subject at this time."

"Askonia calls. I have much to do, $titlePL," he says conclusively.
entries.zh:
他深深吸了一口气，让自己平静下来；你几乎敢发誓，那一瞬他的眼里闪过一丝冷光。

"这种事从来不像看上去那么简单，\"他说，\"眼下我们也不会再谈这个话题了。"

"Askonia 在召唤。我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"他以这句话作结。

o.en: You fought well and deserve your victory.
o.zh: 你打得漂亮，这场胜利是你应得的。

o.en: You fought well and deserve your victory. (lie)
o.zh: 你打得漂亮，这场胜利是你应得的。 (说谎)

o.en: I am proud to have done my part to make a better Askonia.
o.zh: 能为让 Askonia 变得更好尽一份力，我很自豪。

o.en: I'm only sorry to see that Fortuna Kato continues to trouble you...
o.zh: 我只是遗憾，Fortuna Kato 还在给你添麻烦...

o.en: I'm relieved that you've escaped from Gens Kato's influence.
o.zh: 你能摆脱 Kato 氏族的影响，我就放心了。

o.en: I didn't support you for credits. I did it for the blood of Andrada.
o.zh: 我支持你不是为了星币，是为了 Andrada 的血脉。

entries.en:
His expression, however restrained, makes it clear that this is an unwelcome reply.

"I have much to do," he says conclusively.

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
他的神情再怎么克制，也分明告诉你：这不是他想听到的回答。

"我还有许多事要做。"他以这句话作结。

通讯中断。

entries.en:
"We shall not be speaking of that."

You'd swear his eyes glint coldly as he takes a deep, calming breath.

"I have much to do, $titlePL," he says conclusively.
entries.zh:
"这件事我们不会谈。"

他深吸了一口气，让自己平静下来；你几乎敢发誓，那一瞬他的眼里闪过一丝冷光。

"我还有许多事要做，$titlePL。"他以这句话作结。

entries.en:
"Fine words cost little," he says with an uncommon hint of humor in his voice. "And do little to repay the sacrifice and expenses of my supporters."

He looks aside and makes a gesture to what you assume is an aide or secretary.
entries.zh:
"漂亮话不值几个钱，\"他说，语气里带着少见的几分幽默，\"也还不清我支持者们的牺牲与花销。"

他侧过头去，朝一个你猜是助手或秘书的人做了个手势。

entries.en:
"Fine words cost little," he says. "And they do little to repay the sacrifice - and expenses - of my supporters. We have great debts to pay due to the devastation, but it is a poor leader who does not see to his followers."

He looks aside and makes a gesture to what you assume is an aide or secretary.
entries.zh:
"漂亮话不值几个钱，\"他说，\"也还不清我支持者们的牺牲——还有花销。这场浩劫让我们欠下巨额债务，可一个不照应追随者的领袖，算不上好领袖。"

他侧过头去，朝一个你猜是助手或秘书的人做了个手势。

entries.en:
"It was hard fought," he says. "Askonia... will have debts to pay for a long, long time. But it is a poor leader who does not pay the expenses incurred by his followers while supporting his cause."

He looks aside and makes a gesture to what you assume is an aide or secretary.
entries.zh:
"这一仗打得很苦，\"他说，\"Askonia...要还很久很久的债。可追随者为了支持我的事业而欠下的开销，一个不替他们付账的领袖，算不上好领袖。"

他侧过头去，朝一个你猜是助手或秘书的人做了个手势。

entries.en:
"And I will not use fine words to hide the fact that I cannot reward you with credits."

Achilles takes a breath. He clearly does not enjoy this.

"My Sindrian Diktat is reduced, and deeply in debt. Recovery from the devastation of war is..."

He trails off, looking distant. And very tired.
entries.zh:
"我也不会用漂亮话来掩饰：我没法用星币酬谢你。"

Achilles 吸了口气。他显然并不享受这番话。

"我的辛达强权被削弱了，还背上了一身深债。从战争浩劫中恢复，是..."

他的话音低了下去，目光望向远处。他看上去疲惫至极。

entries.en:
"Good intentions will not transform the ruins and the dead into victory," he says distantly. Then comes back to you, if anything, suddenly self-conscious. "I will not use fine words to hide the fact that I cannot reward you with credits."

Achilles takes a breath. He clearly does not enjoy this.

"My Sindrian Diktat is reduced, and deeply in debt. Recovery from the devastation of war is..."

He trails off, looking distant. And very tired.
entries.zh:
"好意没法把废墟和死者变成胜利，\"他神色遥远地说。随后他回过神来，反倒突然有些局促。\"我也不会用漂亮话来掩饰：我没法用星币酬谢你。"

Achilles 吸了口气。他显然并不享受这番话。

"我的辛达强权被削弱了，还背上了一身深债。从战争浩劫中恢复，是..."

他的话音低了下去，目光望向远处。他看上去疲惫至极。

o.en: I understand. I supported you for the cause, not the credits.
o.zh: 我明白。我支持你，是为了这番事业，不是为了星币。

o.en: You managed to escape from under Fortuna Kato's thumb, didn't you?
o.zh: 你总算从 Fortuna Kato 的掌心里挣脱出来了，不是吗？

o.en: That's more than a little disappointing.
I understand. I supported you for the cause, not the credits.
o.zh: 我明白。我支持你，是为了这番事业，不是为了星币。

o.en: It sounds like Fortuna Kato's patronage comes at a steep price.
o.zh: 听起来，Fortuna Kato 的庇护代价不低。

o.en: That's more than a little disappointing.
