"My Sindrian Diktat is reduced, and deeply in debt. Recovery from the devastation of war is..."

He trails off, looking distant. And very tired.
entries.zh:
"我也不会用漂亮话来掩饰：我没法用星币酬谢你。"

Achilles 吸了口气。他显然并不享受这番话。

"我的辛达强权被削弱了，还背上了一身深债。从战争浩劫中恢复，是..."

他的话音低了下去，目光望向远处。他看上去疲惫至极。

entries.en:
He lowers his head again, in acknowledgement.

"I... haven't the words."

He takes another deep breath.

"There is much to do, $titlePL. I must go."
entries.zh:
他又低下头，以示认可。

"我...不知道该怎么开口。"

他又深吸了一口气。

"有许多事要做，$titlePL。我得走了。"

entries.en:
He sighs, giving you a look just short of accusing.

"Here's the thing - it's politics. You back to wrong guy, make a gamble and the new Grand Lion isn't the one you put your credits on..."

He shakes his head, looking aside. Perhaps at the spectacular mountain-top view from his private chalet.

"Still. Lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. And plenty of planetary infrastructure to bring back online too, but those won't have quite the same margins."
entries.zh:
他叹了口气，看你的眼神里差一点就是责备。

"关键是——这是政治。你押错了人，赌了一把，可新任大狮不是你下了星币的那位..."

他摇了摇头，把目光移开。也许是在看他那座私人山庄外的壮丽山景。

"不过呢。要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。还有成堆的行星基础设施等着重新上线，只是那些的利润差得远。"

entries.en:
"Anyway I've got a good 'in' to land some plush reconstruction contracts. They've got a navy to rebuild - I hear the new guy, Achilles? He's a navy man. But you know what they say about clones..."

Arroyo goes quiet for a second, seeing no need to finish the aphorism.

"There's planetary infrastructure to rebuild too, and I'm hearing good things about some economic reforms that should loosen things up in Askonia. Lot of old firms were a bit close with the old regime - with the new guy?"

Arroyo draws a line across his throat.

"It's an open orbit! That's the chatter among investors, anyway." He rubs his hands together. "Busy times ahead!"
entries.zh:
"总之我已经打通了一条不错的路子，能拿下几份肥厚的重建合同。他们要重建舰队——听说那位新人，Achilles？他是行伍出身。不过克隆体那些事，你也知道人们怎么说..."

Arroyo 静了一秒，觉得不必把这句谚语说完。

"行星基础设施也有得重建，而且我听说有些经济改革会让 Askonia 松快起来。不少老牌企业跟旧政权走得太近——可现在这位新人呢？"

Arroyo 用手在脖子上一划。

"眼下是一片开阔轨道！至少投资圈里是这么传的。\"他搓了搓手。\"接下来有的忙了！"

entries.en:
"It's a glorious mess, isn't it." He frowns.

"Lot of old firms were a bit close with the old regime, and not a few senior execs in the Company. And you know what happens when their cozy arrangement with the old guard collapses!"

Arroyo draws a line across his throat.

"Got lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. And planetary infrastructure all over the place. Won't have quite the same margins, but neither will they have quite such close oversight."

He rubs his hands together. "I can still turn this whole operation into the black. Busy times ahead!"
entries.zh:
"这真是场光辉灿烂的烂摊子。"他皱起眉。

"不少老牌企业跟旧政权走得太近，公司里也有好些高管。你也知道，他们跟旧势力那套舒坦的勾当一垮，会是什么下场！"

Arroyo 用手在脖子上一划。

"要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。行星基础设施也到处都是。利润是差些，可他们的监管也松得多。"

他搓了搓手。"我照样能把整桩买卖做成盈利。接下来有的忙了！"

entries.en:
"A glorious mess, isn't it?" He grins.

"Lot of old firms were a bit close with the old regime, and not a few senior execs in the Company. And you know what happens when their cozy arrangement with the old guard collapses!"

Arroyo draws a line across his throat.

"Got lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. And planetary infrastructure all over the place! Won't have quite the same margins, but neither will they have quite such close oversight." He rubs his hands together. "Busy times ahead!"
entries.zh:
"一场光辉灿烂的烂摊子，不是吗？"他咧嘴一笑。

"不少老牌企业跟旧政权走得太近，公司里也有好些高管。你也知道，他们跟旧势力那套舒坦的勾当一垮，会是什么下场！"

Arroyo 用手在脖子上一划。

"要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。行星基础设施也到处都是！利润是差些，可他们的监管也松得多。\"他搓了搓手。\"接下来有的忙了！"

entries.en:
He shrugs, then leans back, fingertips together.

"For me, it was a bit of an exploratory venture. You pushed me," he admits, "But don't get any ideas."
entries.zh:
他耸了耸肩，向后靠去，指尖抵在一起。

"对我来说，这趟多少算是一次探路之行。是你推了我一把，\"他承认道，\"不过你别多想。"

entries.en: "Arroyo," he corrects you. "And a lot of bad people died too. Think it balances out? You keeping up your moral accounting?"
entries.zh: "是 Arroyo，\"他纠正你。\"而且死的坏人也很多。你觉得这能抵平吗？你还在记你那份道德账？"

entries.en:
He slaps his hands on his desk.

"What'd we learn?"

Arroyo draws his fingers back together and dips them toward you, indicating that you should provide an insightful response.
entries.zh:
他双手拍在桌上。

"我们学到了什么？"

Arroyo 把手指并拢收回，朝你微微一倾，示意你给个有见地的回答。

entries.en:
"Wrong!" He slams a hand back on his desk.

"It's 'don't listen to hot tips from $playerName'. I can't believe I ever let you talk me into getting involved."

He turns away.

"Now stop bothering me, I have work to do."
entries.zh:
"错！"他一只手又拍回桌面。

"正确答案是'别听 $playerName 的内幕消息'。我真不敢相信，我居然让你说动我掺和进来。"

他转过身去。

"行了，别再来烦我，我还有活要干。"

o.en: A loose coalition of mercenaries and opportunists cannot stop a polity based on military tradition.
o.zh: 雇佣兵与投机者凑成的松散同盟，挡不住一个以军事传统立国的政体。

o.en: Even a polity based on strong military tradition can be destroyed by betrayal and decadence?
o.zh: 即便以强大军事传统立国的政体，也会毁于背叛与腐化？

o.en: A cosmopolitan polity is more resilient than any absolutist dictatorship.
o.zh: 开放包容的政体，比任何专制独裁都更有韧性。

o.en: Even a resilient, cosmopolitan coalition can be defeated if reactionary forces are backed by a megacorporation?
o.zh: 即便是坚韧而开放的同盟，只要反动势力背后有巨型企业撑腰，也会落败？

o.en: Personalist dictatorships are particularly prone to failure?
o.zh: 个人独裁的政体尤其容易崩盘？

o.en: Starship fuel is the most important substance in the Persean Sector.
o.zh: 星舰燃料才是英仙座星域最重要的东西。

o.en: Avoid a succession crisis by building strong institutions?
o.zh: 靠建立强有力的制度来避免继承危机？

entries.en:
Your comms connect.

"Arroyo here."

Rayan Arroyo looks you over, not quite disapproving.

"Askonia. Exciting place."
entries.zh:
通讯接通了。

"Arroyo 在此。"

Rayan Arroyo 把你打量了一遍，说不上是不赞同。

"Askonia。是个热闹地方。"

o.en: Yes, that's one way to put it.
A lot of good people died, Rayan.

entries.en:
"Your guy didn't work out," he says. "Too bad. And too bad for me, I can't turn those connections into contracts."

"Still. Lots of folks out there now have navies to rebuild. And plenty of planetary infrastructure to bring back online too, but those won't have quite the same margins."

He rubs his hands together. "Lower margins, but also less oversight. There may be some opportunities to turn this whole operation back into the black."
entries.zh:
"你那位没成事，\"他说。\"可惜。对我更可惜——那些人脉我换不成合同了。"

"不过呢。现在外面多少家都得重建舰队。还有成堆的行星基础设施等着重新上线，只是那些的利润差得远。"

他搓了搓手。"利润是低些，但监管也松些。这整桩买卖，说不定还有机会做回盈利。"

entries.en:
He sighs, giving you a look just short of accusing.

"Here's the thing - it's politics. You back to wrong guy, make a gamble and the new Grand Lion isn't the one you put your credits on..."

He shakes his head, looking aside. Perhaps at the spectacular mountain-top view from his private chalet.

"Still. Lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. Plenty of planetary infrastructure to bring back online too, but those won't have quite the same margins."
entries.zh:
他叹了口气，看你的眼神里差一点就是责备。

"关键是——这是政治。你押错了人，赌了一把，可新任大狮不是你下了星币的那位..."

他摇了摇头，把目光移开。也许是在看他那座私人山庄外的壮丽山景。

"不过呢。要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。还有成堆的行星基础设施等着重新上线，只是那些的利润差得远。"

entries.en:
"Anyway I've got a good 'in' to land some plush reconstruction contracts. They've got a navy to rebuild - I hear the new guy, Hector? He likes warships. But you know what they say about clones..."

Arroyo goes quiet for a second, seeing no need to finish the aphorism.

"There's a lot of planetary infrastructure to rebuild as well, but those won't have quite the same margins." He rubs his hands together. "But also - less oversight. There are opportunities. It'll be busy times!"
entries.zh:
"总之我已经打通了一条不错的路子，能拿下几份肥厚的重建合同。他们要重建舰队——听说那位新人，Hector？他喜欢战舰。不过克隆体那些事，你也知道人们怎么说..."

Arroyo 静了一秒，觉得不必把这句谚语说完。

"要重建的行星基础设施也不少，只是那些的利润差得远。\"他搓了搓手。\"不过——监管也松。机会是有的。接下来有的忙了！"

entries.en:
"I'll tell you what I think - I think it's a big, Ludd-damned mess. First Opis, and now Sindria? What an unbelievable waste of capital."

He shakes his head, clearly upset. Though not quite, you suspect, at the loss of life for its own sake.

"What idiot gave that blowhard Diktat general, or admiral, or... whatever; some idiot gave him a planet-killer. Unbelievable."
entries.zh:
"我跟你说我怎么想——我觉得这就是一大摊卢德诅咒的烂事。先是 Opis，现在又是 Sindria？难以置信的资本浪费。"

他摇了摇头，看样子很恼火。不过你猜，这不全是为那些人命。

"是哪个白痴，把一件行星杀手塞给了辛达强权那个爱吹牛的将军、或者上将、或者...随便什么军衔来着；反正是个白痴把行星杀手给了他。简直难以置信。"

o.en: I gave him the planet-killer, Rayan.

entries.en:
Arroyo looks aside, at the excellent view from his chalet.

"Still. There are lots of navies to rebuild, mercs included. And planetary infrastructure all over the place! Won't have quite the same margins, but neither will they have quite such close oversight."

He rubs his hands together. "Busy times ahead."
entries.zh:
Arroyo 把目光移开，望向他山庄外那片极好的景致。

"不过呢。要重建的舰队多的是，雇佣兵也算在内。行星基础设施也到处都是！利润是差些，可他们的监管也松得多。"

他搓了搓手。"接下来有的忙了。"

entries.en: "Arroyo," he corrects you. "And a word of advice, you're not going to impress anyone with your sense of humor so stick to fleet actions."
entries.zh: "是 Arroyo，\"他纠正你。\"给你一句忠告：靠幽默感是赢不了任何人好感的，还是专心打你的舰队战吧。"

entries.en: "In any event, I have found that we work well together. I would elect to continue our partnership. There is ever more challenge and opportunity; the Gens never rest."
entries.zh: "无论如何，我觉得我们合作得很好。我愿意继续这段伙伴关系。挑战与机会只会越来越多；氏族从不停歇。"

entries.en: "You'll want your credits, of course, mercenary," she adds with a smirk.
entries.zh: "当然，你想要你的星币，雇佣兵，"她嘴角一挑，补了一句。

o.en: I'd like to think I helped make the Sector a better place, too.
o.zh: 我倒愿意相信，我也帮着让星域变好了一点。

entries.en: "Indeed," she says airily.
entries.zh: "确实，"她轻飘飘地说。

entries.en: She raises an eyebrow but does not otherwise comment on your sudden burst of idealism.
entries.zh: 她挑起一边眉毛，除此之外没对你这份突如其来的理想主义作任何评论。

entries.en: "All is as I planned," she says, tapping her TriPad. "You have earned this."
entries.zh: "一切都在我计划之中，\"她轻敲 TriPad，\"这是你应得的。"

entries.en: "You fulfilled your end of the deal," she says, tapping her TriPad.
entries.zh: "你履行了你那一半约定，"她轻敲 TriPad。

entries.en:
"Indeed, your payment was not contingent upon Achilles winning," she says, not hiding her disappointment. "But we had a deal."

She taps her TriPad.
entries.zh:
"确实，你的报酬并不以 Achilles 取胜为条件，\"她说，并不掩饰失望。\"但我们有约在先。"

她轻敲 TriPad。

entries.en:
"Indeed, your payment was not contingent upon a productive victory," she says, not hiding her disappointment. "But we had a deal."

She taps her TriPad.
entries.zh:
"确实，你的报酬并不以一场有成果的胜利为条件，\"她说，并不掩饰失望。\"但我们有约在先。"

她轻敲 TriPad。

entries.en:
"Your payment was not contingent upon a productive victory, I admit," she says, not hiding her disappointment. "But we had a deal."

She taps her TriPad.
entries.zh:
"我承认，你的报酬并不以一场有成果的胜利为条件，\"她说，并不掩饰失望。\"但我们有约在先。"

她轻敲 TriPad。

entries.en:
"Achilles, Achilles." Fortuna frowns.

"His support, and success, has exceeded all expectations. I fear the boy has grown somewhat... independent."
entries.zh:
"Achilles，Achilles。"Fortuna 皱起眉。

"他的支持度，还有他的成功，都超出了所有预期。我怕这孩子已经长出了几分...独立。"

entries.en:
"Achilles has won our victory on terms quite acceptable to Gens Kato."

Fortuna looks as pleased as a felid.

"The shape of the Persean League, and indeed the Sector, is shifting much as I intended. Gens Hannan's investments into the Sindrian Diktat old guard were greater than we imagined - Reynard has lost a great deal of capital, to say nothing of his political credibility."

"Gens Hannan is a fortress, still, but," she smiles slowly. "But there is a crack, a growing defect, a progressive failure state..."
entries.zh:
"Achilles 为我们赢下了胜利，条件对 Kato 氏族而言相当可以接受。"

Fortuna 一脸猫似的得意。

"英仙座联盟的格局——其实还有整个星域——正按我的意图挪动。Hannan 氏族投进辛达强权旧卫队里的本钱比我们想的多得多——Reynard 损失了大笔资本，更别提他的政治信誉。"

"Hannan 氏族眼下仍是座堡垒，可是，\"她缓缓一笑，\"可是那里已有了一道裂缝、一处不断扩大的缺陷、一种逐步失效的状态..."

entries.en:
"Achilles has won our victory on terms quite acceptable to Gens Kato."

Fortuna flashes a look as pleased as a felid, but quickly tempers herself.

"Despite the tragedy of Sindria, the shape of the remaining Persean League, and indeed the Sector, is shifting much as I intended. Gens Hannan's investments into the Sindrian Diktat old guard were greater than we imagined - Reynard has lost a great deal of capital, to say nothing of his political credibility."

"Gens Hannan is a fortress, still, but," she allows herself a slow smile. "But there is a crack, a growing defect, a progressive failure state..."
entries.zh:
"Achilles 为我们赢下了胜利，条件对 Kato 氏族而言相当可以接受。"

Fortuna 脸上掠过猫一般的得意，但很快收敛住了。

"尽管 Sindria 出了那样的惨剧，余下的英仙座联盟——其实还有整个星域——的格局仍按我的意图挪动。Hannan 氏族投进辛达强权旧卫队里的本钱比我们想的多得多——Reynard 损失了大笔资本，更别提他的政治信誉。"

"Hannan 氏族眼下仍是座堡垒，可是，\"她容许自己缓缓一笑，\"可是那里已有了一道裂缝、一处不断扩大的缺陷、一种逐步失效的状态..."

entries.en:
"The civil war was too much for the Sindrian Diktat."

She looks distant.

"I cannot say I am surprised. I could see even in his youth that Philip Andrada was fundamentally a selfish brute despite his charm and obvious talent. Then he sought to create his own 'Gens Andrada' through perverse technologies without understanding that family is something more, and greater, than one man."

She sniffs dismissively.

"Even Reynard understands that much."
entries.zh:
"内战对辛达强权来说太重了。"

她的目光飘远。

"我不能说我觉得意外。早在年轻时我就看得出，Philip Andrada 骨子里是个自私的暴徒，尽管他有魅力、有显而易见的才干。后来他竟想借那些悖逆的技术造一个自己的'Andrada 氏族'，却不懂家族是比一个人更多、也更重的东西。"

她轻蔑地哼了一声。

"这一点，连 Reynard 都明白。"

entries.en:
"I cannot but find myself displeased with Achilles' performance," she says, looking aside - and looking very displeased.

"I gave him everything, everything he needed. Then as he was called upon to deliver victory... he faltered."
entries.zh:
"我没法不觉得 Achilles 的表现令人不满，"她说着把目光移开——那神情确实很不满。

"我给了他一切，他需要的一切。可等该他交出胜利的时候...他退缩了。"

entries.en:
"To see Gens Kato and Gens Yaribay finally uniting against Gens Hannan, why, Reynard's arrogance has long earned its due!"

Fortuna holds back her pleased expression.

"Perhaps upon the turn of the next All-League Council election we might finally make another bid for the seat of the Prime Demarchon..."
entries.zh:
"看着 Kato 氏族和 Yaribay 氏族终于联手对付 Hannan 氏族，哼，Reynard 的傲慢早就该有这一天了！"

Fortuna 忍住那副得意的神情。

"也许等下一轮全联盟议会选举来临，我们终于能再争一次大统领的位子..."

entries.en:
"Despite the... situation, I am pleased to see Gens Kato and Gens Yaribay finally uniting against Gens Hannan. Reynard's arrogance has earned its due."

Fortuna cannot quite summon a pleased expression.

"Perhaps upon the turn of the next All-League Council election we might finally make another bid for the seat of the Prime Demarchon..."
entries.zh:
"尽管有那个...状况，我还是很高兴看到 Kato 氏族和 Yaribay 氏族终于联手对付 Hannan 氏族。Reynard 的傲慢得到了应有的报应。"

Fortuna 没能完全摆出高兴的神情。

"也许等下一轮全联盟议会选举来临，我们终于能再争一次大统领的位子..."

entries.en:
"Sindria. Stars above, no one expected it could happen again," she says softly.

"What fool gave a planet-killer to an even greater fool?"
entries.zh:
"Sindria。群星在上，谁也没想到这事还能再发生一次，"她轻声说。

"是哪个蠢货把行星杀手交给了一个更蠢的蠢货？"

entries.en:
"In the meantime," she picks up and glances at her TriPad, "We have not been lax in our activities. A special All-League committee has begun an investigation into certain practices of the Prime Demarchon." She lowers the TriPad to look at you.

"This means you will no longer have to pay some 'bribe' to Gens Hannan to retain your organization's position, in good standing, within the Persean League."
entries.zh:
"与此同时，"她接回话头，瞥了一眼 TriPad，"我们的动作也没松懈。一个全联盟特别委员会已经开始调查大统领的某些做法。"她放下 TriPad，看向你。

"这意味着，你不必再向 Hannan 氏族交那笔所谓的'贿赂'，来保住你组织在英仙座联盟内的席位与声誉了。"

entries.en: "But you must be here because of Askonia," she says. "Much has changed in a short time."
entries.zh: "不过你到这儿来，肯定是为了 Askonia，\"她说。\"短短时间里，变了很多。"

entries.en:
There's a long pause. Fortuna's expression is very still.

"We shall not be speaking of that," she says, finally.
entries.zh:
长久的沉默。Fortuna 的神情一动不动。

"这件事我们不必谈，"她终于开口。

entries.en:
There's a long pause. Fortuna's expression is very still. Then something softens, ever so slightly.

"I have not, no."
entries.zh:
长久的沉默。Fortuna 的神情一动不动。随后，有什么东西极轻微地软了下来。

"没有，没有消息。"

entries.en:
"Her... 'organization' seems to have fallen apart, and Umbra controlled directly by several loosely associated pirate gangs. I fear the worst, for if she were captured I would soon expect a ransom demand."

She looks down, then up.

"If you..."
entries.zh:
"她那个...'组织'似乎已经散了，Umbra 现在直接由几伙关系松散的海盗帮派把持。我怕的是最坏的结果——若她只是被俘，我早该收到索要赎金的消息了。"

她低下头，又抬起来。

"如果你..."

o.en: I will let you know if I hear anything.

entries.en:
"Her... 'organization' seems to have fallen apart, and Umbra controlled directly by several loosely associated pirate gangs. I fear the worst, for if she were captured I would soon expect a ransom demand."

She looks down, then up.

"If you..."
entries.zh:
"她那个...'组织'似乎已经散了，Umbra 现在直接由几伙关系松散的海盗帮派把持。我怕的是最坏的结果——若她只是被俘，我早该收到索要赎金的消息了。"

她低下头，又抬起来。

"如果你..."

o.en: I will let you know if I hear anything.

entries.en:
"Her... 'organization' seems to have fallen apart. With the new administration on Umbra, I would expect... either legal prosecution or a ransom demand. Either is acceptable to me. But to hear nothing at all?"

She looks down. Then back up.

"If you..."
entries.zh:
"她那个...'组织'似乎已经散了。Umbra 换了新政府，我本该等到...要么正式起诉，要么一封赎金要求。哪一样我都能接受。可什么消息都没有？"

她低下头。然后又抬起来。

"如果你..."

o.en: I will let you know if I hear anything.

entries.en:
"Her... 'organization' seems to have fallen apart, and with Umbra retaken by the Sindrian Diktat, I would expect official word of legal prosecution. It would be negotiated away, of course. And arrangements made. It is always so with members of the inner Gens."

She looks down, then up.

"If you..."
entries.zh:
"她那个...'组织'似乎已经散了。Umbra 既被辛达强权重新拿下，我该收到正式起诉的消息。当然，那最终会被谈掉，再作些安排。核心氏族的人向来如此。"

她低下头，又抬起来。

"如果你..."

o.en: I will let you know if I hear anything.

entries.en: She nods, composing herself.
entries.zh: 她点了点头，重新定了定神。

entries.en:
Supreme Executor Hector Andrada appears before you, uniform pristine, chest filled with medals. His tyrian cape hangs off one shoulder.

"Oh, hello $PlayerName."

One booted foot is on his desk. A sword, unsheathed, is laid across the surface.
entries.zh:
最高元首 Hector Andrada 出现在你面前，制服一尘不染，胸前挂满勋章。他那件提尔紫的披风搭在一侧肩上。

"哦，你好啊，$PlayerName。"

他一只穿着靴子的脚踩在办公桌上。一柄出了鞘的剑横在桌面。

o.en: Let us speak of the Sindrian Diktat...
o.zh: 我们来谈谈辛达强权吧...

o.en: Let us speak of the war - and your victory!
o.zh: 我们来谈谈这场战争——还有你的胜利！

o.en: How may I serve you, Supreme Executor?
o.zh: 我该如何为你效劳，最高元首？

entries.en:
He ignores your words, speaking instead at you.

"You have served me, $playerLastName," he says. "With more loyalty than most."

Hector turns his eyes upon you, expression withheld. He seems to savor the state of uncertainty.
entries.zh:
他无视你的话，径自对着你说下去。

"你曾为我效劳，$playerLastName，\"他说，\"比大多数人更忠诚。"

Hector 把目光投向你，脸上不露分毫。他似乎很享受这种让人捉摸不透的状态。

entries.en:
"But I am surrounded by lesser men. Weak, thin-blooded."

Hector's face twists with emotion; he pauses, speaking quietly, "They poisoned my father, you know. Cowards. He should never have waited so long. He should never have tried to, to-" Through gritted teeth, "Protect. Me."

He wipes his face with his sleeve, bedecked with gold braid.

With his off-hand, Hector pulls his sidearm from his belt, then is still - he holds it, aiming as if to execute a traitor kneeling before him.
entries.zh:
"可我身边尽是些庸碌之辈。软弱，血统稀薄。"

Hector 的脸因情绪而扭曲；他顿了顿，压低声音说："你知道吗，他们毒死了我父亲。那些懦夫。他本不该等那么久。他本不该试图去，去——"他咬紧牙关，"保护。我。"

他用缀着金色绶带的袖子抹了把脸。

Hector 用空着的那只手从腰间拔出配枪，然后一动不动——他端着枪，像是在瞄准一个跪在面前、等待处决的叛徒。

entries.en:
"And Hyder. That lying... that lying Heggie traitor."

Hector barks a desperate laugh, and begins pacing furiously.

"A Hegemony traitor from the start. A Heggie liar. Typical case, lacking strength of will and instead appearing weak... using trickery and manipulation. And fed, always fed by the Hegemony."

"I knew it! I always knew it." His eyes go wide. "I knew the hand of Orcus Rao."
entries.zh:
"还有 Hyder。那个谎言连篇的...那个谎言连篇的霸主佬叛徒。"

Hector 迸出一声绝望的干笑，开始狂躁地来回踱步。

"从一开始就是霸主的叛徒。一个霸主佬骗子。典型的货色，没有意志力，就装出一副软弱相...靠诡计和操纵行事。而且有人喂着他，一直是霸主在喂。"

"我就知道！我一直就知道。\"他双眼圆睁，\"我早就知道幕后是 Orcus Rao 的手。"

entries.en:
"And Hyder. That lying... that lying Heggie traitor."

Hector barks a desperate laugh, and begins pacing furiously.

"A Hegemony traitor from the start until the end. A plant. A Heggie liar. Typical case, lacking strength of will and instead appearing weak... using trickery and manipulation. And fed, always fed by the Hegemony."

"I knew it! I always knew it." His eyes go wide. "I knew the hand of Orcus Rao."
entries.zh:
"还有 Hyder。那个谎言连篇的...那个谎言连篇的霸主佬叛徒。"

Hector 迸出一声绝望的干笑，开始狂躁地来回踱步。

"从头到尾都是霸主的叛徒。一个安插进来的钉子。一个霸主佬骗子。典型的货色，没有意志力，就装出一副软弱相...靠诡计和操纵行事。而且有人喂着他，一直是霸主在喂。"

"我就知道！我一直就知道。\"他双眼圆睁，\"我早就知道幕后是 Orcus Rao 的手。"

entries.en:
"And Macario. That lying... that lying spider."

Hector barks a desperate laugh, and begins pacing furiously.

"A Luddie liar. That's how he wormed his way into my father's good favor. He had to be a good liar - better than good, the best - to deceive my father. And everyone else, for so long."
entries.zh:
"还有 Macario。那个谎言连篇的...那个谎言连篇的蜘蛛。"

Hector 迸出一声绝望的干笑，开始狂躁地来回踱步。

"一个卢德佬，一个骗子。他就是这么钻进我父亲的宠信里的。他必须是个高明的骗子——不止高明，得是最顶尖的——才能骗过我父亲。还有所有人，骗了那么久。"

entries.en:
"And Macario. That vermin, that spider."

He sweeps some debris from the top of the desk, circling like a frustrated carnivore.

"A Luddie liar. That's how he wormed his way into my father's good favor. He had to be a good liar - better than good, the best - to deceive my father. And everyone else, for so long. He told me 'to not act too soon'."

"TO. NOT. ACT."

He swings his arm wildly and fires a round. You hear a shrill alarm begin.
entries.zh:
"还有 Macario。那只鼠辈，那只蜘蛛。"

他一把扫掉桌上的碎屑，像一头受挫的食肉兽那样来回打转。

"一个卢德佬，一个骗子。他就是这么钻进我父亲的宠信里的。他必须是个高明的骗子——不止高明，得是最顶尖的——才能骗过我父亲。还有所有人，骗了那么久。他还对我说'别动手太早'。"

"别。动。手。"

他狂乱地挥臂开了一枪。你听见一阵尖利的警报声响起。

entries.en:
"Hyder!" He sweeps some debris from the top of the desk, circling like a frustrated carnivore.

"A Hegemony traitor from the start. I saw the signs, but I was advised to not act."

"TO. NOT. ACT."

He swings his arm and fires a round, aimless. You hear the start of a shrill alarm.
entries.zh:
"Hyder！"他一把扫掉桌上的碎屑，像一头受挫的食肉兽那样来回打转。

"从一开始就是霸主的叛徒。我看到了迹象，可有人劝我别动手。"

"别。动。手。"

他挥臂开了一枪，漫无目标。你听见一阵尖利的警报声开始响起。

entries.en:
"Hyder!" He sweeps some debris from the top of the desk, circling like a frustrated carnivore.

"A Hegemony traitor from the start and 'til the end. Sabotaging my conquest... I saw the signs, but I was advised to not act."

"TO. NOT. ACT."

He swings his arm and fires a round, aimless. You hear the start of a shrill alarm.
entries.zh:
"Hyder！"他一把扫掉桌上的碎屑，像一头受挫的食肉兽那样来回打转。

"从头到尾都是霸主的叛徒。破坏我的征服大业...我看到了迹象，可有人劝我别动手。"

"别。动。手。"

他挥臂开了一枪，漫无目标。你听见一阵尖利的警报声开始响起。

entries.en:
"And Caden! That fat fool."

Hector kicks something on the ground that dutifully flies off-link with a clatter. "How did my father ever tolerate his simpering incompetence?"
entries.zh:
"还有 Caden！那个肥胖的蠢货。"

Hector 踢飞了地上的什么东西，那东西很听话地哐当一声飞出了通讯画面。"我父亲究竟是怎么容忍他那副谄媚无能的样子？"

entries.en:
"And you."

He turns toward the link, meeting your eyes as if he stood before you.

"Macario's poisoned dagger... in my back."

He laughs, desperately, sweating off the combat stims he must have taken earlier.
entries.zh:
"还有你。"

他转向通讯画面，直直迎上你的目光，仿佛就站在你面前。

"Macario 的毒匕首...插在我的背上。"

他绝望地笑起来，浑身是汗，像是正把先前服下的战斗兴奋剂从体内逼出来。

entries.en: "Now die, die for me!" he shouts.
entries.zh: "现在去死，为我而死！"他吼道。

entries.en: "Lies, lies, lies! Always spacer lies!"
entries.zh: "谎言，谎言，全是谎言！太空佬的谎话永远没个完！"

entries.en: "Then die!" he shrieks, then breaks into a fit of coughing.
entries.zh: "那就去死！"他尖叫道，随即爆发出一阵剧烈的咳嗽。

entries.en:
"You are declared outlaw," he hisses, "terrorist and enemy of the Supreme Executor."

His voice raises to a shout. "Supreme traitor! It's all your fault! All of it! I strip you of your commission, of all honors. You will be hunted down and executed like the spacer vermin you are!"

As the link cuts, the last you see of Hector are his bloodshot eyes and the flash of some weapon.
entries.zh:
"你被宣布为不法之徒，\"他嘶声道，\"恐怖分子，最高元首的敌人。"

他的声音拔高成咆哮。"大叛徒！全是你的错！全都是！我剥夺你的军职，剥夺你的一切荣誉。你会被追捕、被处决，就像你这种太空佬渣滓该有的下场！"

通讯切断时，你最后看到的是他布满血丝的双眼，还有某件武器闪起的一道亮光。

entries.en:
He steadies his breathing, and looks back into the link, as if seeing you for the first time.

"Serve my Sindrian Diktat and you shall be rewarded. Betray me and you will stamped out with the rest of the vermin," he says, glowering.

"When the Supreme Executor has use for you, you'll be told."

Hector turns away, head hanging.

"Now leave me alone. I've... much to do." His voice is almost a whisper.
entries.zh:
他稳住呼吸，重新望向通讯链接，仿佛第一次看清了你。

"为我的辛达强权效命，自有封赏。若是背叛我，你就和其余虫子一起被碾碎，"他怒视着说。

"等最高元首用得着你，自会通知你。"

Hector 转过身去，垂着头。

"现在让我一个人待着。我还有...很多事要做。"他的声音轻得近乎耳语。

entries.en:
He steadies his breathing, then looks up, through the link. It is as if he was seeing you for the first time.

The sidearm returns to his holster. The sword, he holds reversed, blade down.

"All Askonia shall be mine," he says calmly. "First Askonia, then the Persean Sector."
entries.zh:
他稳住呼吸，然后抬眼望向通讯链接，仿佛第一次看清了你。

手枪收回枪套。那柄剑，他倒提着，剑尖朝下。

"整个 Askonia 都将归我，\"他平静地说，\"先是 Askonia，然后是英仙座星域。"

entries.en:
"Serve me honorably and you shall be rewarded. Betray me..." His hand wanders back to his sidearm.

Hector gives you a warning look, then turns away.

He raises one hand without looking back, a dismissal.
entries.zh:
"忠心侍奉我，自有封赏。若是背叛我..."他的手又摸回枪套边。

Hector 给了你一个警告的眼神，随后转过身去。

他头也不回地抬起一只手，示意你退下。

entries.en:
He steadies his breathing, then looks up, through the link. It is as if he was seeing you for the first time.

The sidearm returns to his holster. The sword, he holds reversed, blade down.

"The gates," he says calmly. "They are the key, you see. When I take the gates, the galaxy will become mine."
entries.zh:
他稳住呼吸，然后抬眼望向通讯链接，仿佛第一次看清了你。

手枪收回枪套。那柄剑，他倒提着，剑尖朝下。

"星门，\"他平静地说，\"你瞧，那就是钥匙。等我拿下星门，整个银河都将归我。"

entries.en:
He nods, and turns away.

"I will summon you when you may next serve me, captain."

He raises one hand without looking back, a dismissal.
entries.zh:
他点点头，转过身去。

"等我下次用得着你，自会召你前来，舰长。"

他头也不回地抬起一只手，示意你退下。

entries.en:
"Serve me honorably and you shall be rewarded. Betray me..." His hand wanders back to his sidearm.

Hector gives you a warning look, then turns away.

He raises one hand without looking back, a dismissal. "Now leave me. I've much to do."
entries.zh:
"忠诚地为我效劳，你就会得到奖赏。背叛我..."他的手又摸回了配枪。

Hector 警告地看了你一眼，然后转过身去。

他头也不回地抬起一只手，示意你退下。"现在离开我吧。我还有很多事要做。"

entries.en:
"You helped secure full material assistance for the ACA on Nortia, and for that I thank you - and my... trusted contacts would like to relay their appreciation for your efforts."

"This Second Askonia Crisis was a terrible situation, but I am proud to have done what little I could to steer the Sector toward a more hopeful future." He looks self-conscious, then clears his throat. "Allow me to provide you with credits to offset the risks you have taken and - well, we may consider it a reward, I suppose."
entries.zh:
"你在 Nortia 帮 ACA 落实了足额的物资援助，为此我感谢你——我...信得过的联系人也很想转达对你这些努力的赞赏。"

"这第二次 Askonia 危机是场可怕的局面，但我为自己尽了绵薄之力、把星域引向一个更有希望的未来而自豪。\"他显得有些不好意思，随即清了清嗓子。\"请允许我提供一笔星币，补偿你承担的风险，还有——嗯，我们不妨就把它算作报酬吧。"

entries.en:
"I am disappointed, very disappointed, to have heard that you provided nothing for the ACA uprising on Nortia," Horus says. "My... trusted contacts agree. It was a missed opportunity, and materially hindered our efforts."

"You failed me in this." He spreads his hands. "There's no other way to put it."
entries.zh:
"听说你对 Nortia 上 ACA 的起事什么也没提供，我很失望，非常失望，\"Horus 说。\"我...信得过的联系人也是这么看的。那是个错失的机会，而且在实际上拖累了我们的行动。"

"这件事上你辜负了我。\"他摊开双手。\"没有别的说法。"

entries.en:
"I had word from Arnaud Iscare that you helped secure some material assistance for the ACA on Nortia," Horus says. "But not enough."

"My... trusted contacts agree. This was a missed opportunity, and I am disappointed with the outcome." He spreads his hands. "There's nothing more to say."
entries.zh:
"Arnaud Iscare 传话来，说你在 Nortia 帮 ACA 弄到了一些物资援助，\"Horus 说。\"但不够。"

"我...信得过的联系人也是这么看的。那是个错失的机会，这个结果让我失望。\"他摊开手。\"没什么可多说的了。"

entries.en:
"And now the Hegemony has begun to rebuild something of its legitimacy in Umbra."

He nods. "This is good. An indicator of how things are to be. If the Hegemony can compromise, then so can we.""
entries.zh:
"而现在，霸主已开始在 Umbra 重建它的一部分合法性。"

他点点头。"这很好。这预示着未来的局面该是什么样。如果霸主能让步，那我们也能。"

entries.en:
"And now the Hegemony has begun to rebuild something of its legitimacy in Nortia."

He nods. "This is good. An indicator of how things are to be. If the Hegemony can compromise, then so can we.""
entries.zh:
"而现在，霸主已开始在 Nortia 重建它的一部分合法性。"

他点点头。"这很好。这预示着未来的局面该是什么样。如果霸主能让步，那我们也能。"

entries.en:
"And now the Hegemony has begun to rebuild something of its legitimacy in both Nortia and Umbra."

He nods. "This is good, very good. An indicator of how things are to be. If the Hegemony can compromise, then so can we."
entries.zh:
"而现在，霸主已开始在 Nortia 和 Umbra 两地重建它的一部分合法性。"

他点点头。"这很好，非常好。这预示着未来的局面该是什么样。如果霸主能让步，那我们也能。"

entries.en:
"The Hegemony - and the rebels, mostly through them - have taken more out of the Sindrian Diktat than anyone might have expected," Horus says, allowing a hint of cheer to enter his voice.

"This is good. An indicator of the future."
entries.zh:
"霸主——还有叛乱者，多半是借霸主之手——从辛达强权身上取得的战果，超出了所有人的预料，"Horus 说，语气里透出一丝欢快。

"这很好。这是未来的征兆。"

entries.en:
"The Hegemony - and the rebels - have taken less out of the Sindrian Diktat than I might have hoped, $titlePL," Horus admits. "I can only hope that this is not an indicator of... well, there is more to the Persean Sector than the Askonia System, right?"

He puts on an unconvincing smile. "We simply must do better next time."
entries.zh:
"霸主——还有那些叛乱者——从辛达强权身上啃下的东西，比我期望的要少，$titlePL，"Horus 承认道，"我只能希望这并不预示着...呃，英仙座星域可不止一个 Askonia 星系，对吧？"

他摆出一个毫无说服力的笑容。"下次我们非得做得更好不可。"

entries.en:
"Indeed, indeed." Horus nods automatically and unenthusiastically. "Time shall tell."

He sighs, thinking for a long moment.

At last, he says, "Perhaps you've a more pleasant topic in mind?"
entries.zh:
"确实，确实。\"Horus 机械地点着头，兴致缺缺，\"时间会给出答案。"

他叹了口气，思忖良久。

最后他开口道："你心里是不是有个更愉快的话题？"

entries.en:
"Then you are a cynic, $titlePL," Horus says with a desperate air of amusement.

"Now perhaps you've a more pleasant topic in mind?"
entries.zh:
"那么你是个愤世嫉俗的人，$titlePL，"Horus 说，带着一种近乎绝望的玩味。

"那么现在，你心里是不是有个更愉快的话题？"

entries.en: "I as well, $titlePL," he says nodding. "May we live to see that cycle when humanity is re-united."
entries.zh: "我也一样，$titlePL，\"他点头道，\"愿我们活着看到人类重归一统的那一天。"

entries.en:
"$TitlePL, you speak boldly," he says, taken aback. But not displeased.

"There is much still to be settled. But I hope I do not speak too soon when I declare that I feel the beginning of the winds of change..."

He allows himself a fleeting smile at this thought.
entries.zh:
"$TitlePL，你说话可真大胆，"他说，吃了一惊，但并不见怪。

"还有许多事悬而未决。但我宣布自己已感到变革之风初起时，希望这话没说得太早..."

念及此处，他放任自己露出一个转瞬即逝的微笑。

entries.en:
"Indeed," Horus says automatically, nodding.

"So. Perhaps you've a more pleasant topic in mind?"
entries.zh:
"确实，"Horus 机械地点着头说。

"那么。你心里是不是有个更愉快的话题？"

entries.en:
"Thank you," Horus says automatically, nodding.

"So. Perhaps you've a more pleasant topic in mind?"
entries.zh:
"谢谢你，"Horus 机械地点着头说。

"那么。你心里是不是有个更愉快的话题？"

entries.en:
"Indeed, indeed," Horus says automatically, nodding.

"Perhaps you've a more pleasant topic in mind?"
entries.zh:
"确实，确实，"Horus 机械地点着头说。

"你心里是不是有个更愉快的话题？"

o.en: It's going to get a lot worse before it gets better, Horus.
o.zh: Horus，事情在好转之前，还会糟糕得多。

o.en: Achilles is not his father. And whatever he is, he's not Hector.
o.zh: Achilles 不是他父亲。不管他是什么人，他都不是 Hector。

o.en: Achilles is a better man than Hector. And Philip. He's League.
o.zh: Achilles 比 Hector 更像个人，也比 Philip 强。他是联盟的人。

o.en: I hope this brings about your vision for the future - a unified Sector!
o.zh: 我希望这能实现你那份对未来的愿景——一个统一的星域！

o.en: With this victory - and it is - will you be able to dethrone Reynard?
o.zh: 凭着这场胜利——这确实是场胜利——你能把 Reynard 拉下台吗？

o.en: Keep your head down, I say. There'll be more chances.
o.zh: 要我说，先低头忍着。往后还有的是机会。

entries.en:
"Sindria, by the stars, how could it be? After Opis..."

Horus speaks haltingly, his usual aristocratic distance faltering.

"In no way was this caused by the Hegemony. None can argue that, not like... no, they would never."

He closes his eyes for a moment, centering himself.
entries.zh:
"Sindria，群星在上，怎么会这样？在 Opis 之后..."

Horus 说得断断续续，他惯有的贵族式疏离也撑不住了。

"这绝不是霸主造成的。没人能这么说，不像...不，他们绝不会。"

他闭了闭眼，定住心神。

entries.en:
"Peace in Askonia!"

He shakes his head, as if in disbelief. "Stars above, at last this is over and we can return to business."
entries.zh:
"Askonia 和平了！"

他摇了摇头，仿佛难以置信。"群星在上，这事总算结束了，我们可以回去做生意了。"

entries.en:
"Peace in Askonia!" Horus shakes his head, as if in disbelief.

"And Fortuna's gambit failed, I'm afraid. I am not of the opinion that Kazeron, much less the League entire, is a zero-sum struggle. But Gens Hannan is positioned to take much of what Gens Kato once had; influence, prestige, property... power, above all."

His expression is grim.

"If nothing else, Achilles seems amenable to outside investment, commerce, and some loosening of Philip's military discipline upon all Askonian society... this is better, isn't it? We can get back to business."
entries.zh:
"Askonia 和平了！"Horus 摇了摇头，仿佛难以置信。

"可惜 Fortuna 的赌局失败了。我并不认为 Kazeron——更不用说整个联盟——是一场零和博弈。但 Hannan 氏族如今占据有利位置，将攫取 Kato 氏族昔日拥有的大部分东西：影响力、声望、产业...最重要的是权力。"

他神情阴沉。

"至少 Achilles 似乎愿意接受外来投资、商业往来，也愿意稍微放松 Philip 强加于整个 Askonia 社会的军事纪律...这样更好，不是吗？我们可以回去做生意了。"

entries.en:
"Peace in Askonia!" Horus shakes his head, as if in disbelief. "Though it strains definition, under Hector's new rule, that it can be so called."

"Fortuna's gambit failed, I'm afraid. I am not of the opinion that Kazeron, much less the League entire, is a zero-sum struggle. But Gens Hannan is positioned to take much of what Gens Kato once had; influence, prestige, property... power, above all. And it is known that Reynard favors a polity in Askonia which draws the attention of the Hegemony away from his own ambitions."

His expression is grim. "At least the fighting is over and we can return to something like business as usual."

他神情阴沉。"至少仗打完了，我们可以回到某种类似照常做生意的状态。"

entries.en:
"Peace in Askonia!" Horus shakes his head, as if in disbelief.

"And Fortuna's gambit worked. Is that not incredible? You were right, $titlePL. Stars above, at last this is over and we can return to business."

His looks, above all, concerned. More even than usual.

"The mutiny in Askonia has collapsed," Horus says, as if in wonderment. "It worked."

He looks down. "But at what cost?"

"Askonia 的叛乱已经瓦解了，\"Horus 说，语气像是惊叹，\"它成了。"

他垂下目光。"可代价是什么？"

"Though I am not of the opinion that Kazeron, much less the League entire, is a zero-sum struggle, Gens Kato is positioned to take much from Gens Hannan; influence, prestige, property... power, above all."

His expression is grim. "At least the fighting is over. Achilles seems in favor of investment and commerce... perhaps we can return to a sort of business as usual."

"The mutiny in Askonia has collapsed," Horus says, as if in wonderment. "At least as an effective independent power."

"They're the League's problem now," he says with a sniff. "Fortuna, oh Fortuna. You've quite upset things."
entries.zh:
"Askonia 的叛乱已经瓦解了，\"Horus 说，语气像是惊叹，\"至少作为一个有效的独立势力是完了。"

"现在他们成了联盟的麻烦。\"他嗤了一声，\"Fortuna 啊 Fortuna。你可把局面搅得不轻。"

He looks down. "But at what cost?"

Reynard favors a combative polity in Askonia for it draws the Hegemony's attention from his own ambitions."

His expression is grim. "At least the fighting is over and we can return to business."

"Askonia 的叛乱在 Hector Andrada 的领导下延续了下来。这局面很难称之为'和平'，但我必须这么说。Fortuna 的赌局失败了。"

他神情阴沉。"至少仗打完了，我们可以回去做生意了。"

entries.en:
"And Reynard's gambit failed." He gives you a significant look, "And with my backing, I'm afraid."

"I am not of the opinion that Kazeron, much less the League entire, is a zero-sum struggle. But Gens Kato is positioned to take much from Gens Hannan... and Gens Yaribay. Influence, prestige, property... power, above all."

His expression is grim. "At least this is over and we can return to business."
entries.zh:
"而 Reynard 的赌局失败了。\"他意味深长地看了你一眼，\"可惜，是在我的支持下失败的。"

"我并不认为 Kazeron——更不用说整个联盟——是一场零和博弈。但 Kato 氏族如今占据有利位置，将从 Hannan 氏族...以及 Yaribay 氏族手中夺走许多东西。影响力、声望、产业...最重要的是权力。"

他神情阴沉。"至少这事结束了，我们可以回去做生意了。"

entries.en:
"Peace in Askonia!" Horus shakes his head, as if in disbelief.

"Reynard's gambit worked. It was a trap - and Fortuna is stuck in it. Is that not incredible? You were right, $titlePL. Stars above, at last this is over and we can return to business."

He sighs, seemingly relieved at the prospect.

"The Persean League is not a zero-sum struggle, you know. Though Gens Hannan grows more powerful, Gens Yaribay has not lost... there is the future of my gens to consider, after all."
entries.zh:
"Askonia 和平了！"Horus 摇了摇头，仿佛难以置信。

"Reynard 的赌局成了。那是个陷阱——Fortuna 陷在里面脱不了身。这不是不可思议吗？你说对了，$titlePL。群星在上，这事总算结束了，我们可以回去做生意了。"

他叹了口气，似乎为此感到宽慰。

"你知道，英仙座联盟不是一场零和博弈。尽管 Hannan 氏族愈发强大，Yaribay 氏族并没有输...毕竟，我得为我氏族的未来着想。"

entries.en:
"Peace in Askonia!" Horus shakes his head, as if in disbelief. "Though it is a difficult state of affairs to call 'peace', but I must."

"Reynard's gambit worked. It was a trap - and Fortuna's bid fell into it, and failed. Is that not incredible? You were right, $titlePL. Stars above, at last this is over and we can return to business."

He sighs, seemingly relieved at the prospect.

"The Persean League is not a zero-sum struggle, you know. Though Gens Hannan grows more powerful, I have given my gens security and stability."

他叹了口气，似乎为此感到宽慰。

"你知道，英仙座联盟不是一场零和博弈。尽管 Hannan 氏族愈发强大，我至少给我的氏族带来了安全与稳定。"

entries.en:
"This is the closing of an ugly chapter in the history of the Sector, I think," Horus says hopefully. "I am pleased to see the end of it and, I hope, the glimmer of a brighter future."

He smiles unconvincingly.
entries.zh:
"我想，这是星域历史上一个丑陋篇章的终结，\"Horus 满怀希望地说，\"我很高兴看到它落幕，也希望能看到更光明的未来透出一线微光。"

他挤出一个毫无说服力的笑容。

entries.en: "This has not turned out to be a profitable venture, captain," he says, smile fixed. It is difficult to read how much, if any, disappointment or reprimand, if any, he intends to express. "But such is the risk we undertake."
entries.zh: "事实证明，这并不是一笔有利可图的生意，舰长，\"他说，笑容不变。很难看出他究竟想表达几分失望或责备——如果有的话。\"但这就是我们承担的风险。"

entries.en:
"This has turned out to be a profitable venture, captain."

His usual smile is fixed, as usual. But is there a hint of pleasure, of human warmth in his tone? It is difficult to say.
entries.zh:
"事实证明，这是一笔有利可图的生意，舰长。"

他一贯的笑容照旧凝固着。但语气里是否藏着一丝愉悦、一丝人情味？很难说。

entries.en:
"Although, as they say, 'our' side has won, it is on terms that I had wished to avoid. And if the venture is not profitable, then it is, of course, a loss."

His usual smile is fixed, as usual. But it is difficult to read how much, if any, disappointment or reprimand, if any, he intends to express. "But such is the risk we undertake."
entries.zh:
"虽说，如他们所言，'我们'这一方赢了，可赢的条件却是我本希望避开的。而一笔生意若不赚钱，那自然就是亏损。"

他一贯的笑容照旧凝固着。很难看出他究竟想表达几分失望或责备——如果有的话。"但这就是我们承担的风险。"

entries.en:
"One wonders at the value of the anti-Macario initiative considering Hector's failure to maintain control of the Sindrian Diktat." He shrugs, turning his palms up.

"It was your investment to make." His habitual half-smile grows slightly. "I made my own, of course."
entries.zh:
"考虑到 Hector 未能稳住辛达强权的控制权，反 Macario 行动究竟有多少价值，不免让人掂量。"他耸耸肩，翻起掌心。

"那是你该做的投资。\"他惯常的半笑稍稍加深。\"当然，我也做了我自己的。"

entries.en:
"The anti-Macario initiative appears to have been successful in light of Hector's... disemployment of the man." He shrugs, turns his palms up. "I hope you've leveraged this outcome toward a profitable outcome."

His half-smile grows slightly. "I have."
entries.zh:
"从 Hector 把那个人...解职这件事看，反 Macario 行动似乎成功了。\"他耸耸肩，翻起掌心。\"我希望你已经把这个结果撬成了有利可图的回报。"

他的半笑稍稍加深。"我确实这么做了。"

o.en: I too am eager to discover new, profitable opportunities.
o.zh: 我也一样渴望发现新的、有利可图的机会。

entries.en: His smile glistens.
entries.zh: 他的笑容油亮地绽开。

o.en: I'll get what I want - for Macario to get what he deserves.
o.zh: 我会得到我想要的——让 Macario 得到他应得的下场。

o.en: I got what I wanted. Macario will get what he deserves.
o.zh: 我得到了我想要的。Macario 会得到他应得的下场。

o.en: I got what I wanted. Macario got what he deserved.
o.zh: 我得到了我想要的。Macario 也得到了他应得的下场。

entries.en:
His smile glistens.

"I am happy for you, captain."
entries.zh:
他的笑容油亮地绽开。

"我为你高兴，舰长。"

entries.en:
His smile glistens.

"I anticipate your success, captain."
entries.zh:
他的笑容油亮地绽开。

"我期待你的成功，舰长。"

o.en: All that matters is it's over.

entries.en: His smile glistens.
entries.zh: 他的笑容油亮地绽开。

o.en: And Leonidas. The body has proved useful?
o.zh: 还有 Leonidas。那具躯体证明有用了吗？

entries.en:
"His body lives," Inesis says. His expression grows vacant as he accesses some remote information. "Prospects for recovery remain... ambiguous."

His eyes, suddenly sharp, return to you.

"Captain. I consider our agreement inviolable under reasonable conditions, of course, but I would like to propose a modification to the terms."
entries.zh:
"他的身体还活着，\"Inesis 说。当他调取某处远程信息时，神情变得空茫。\"康复的前景仍然...不明确。"

他的目光骤然锐利，重新落回你身上。

"舰长。当然，在合理的条件下，我认为我们的协议不可侵犯，但我想提议对条款做一处修改。"

entries.en:
"You put Leonidas in my care with... charitable aims. But given that odds of successful rehabilitation are poor, perhaps your credits could be put to better use. I believe I could find an interested party to acquire the subject who - let us be clear - is unlikely to ever awaken into consciousness and coherence."

"You gave me 100,000 credits for our deal. Let me repay you that, and an additional 100,000 for a total of 200,000 credits, and you rescind the conditions of our deal."
entries.zh:
"你把 Leonidas 交给我照管，抱着...慈善的目的。但既然成功康复的希望渺茫，也许你的星币可以用在更划算的地方。我想我能找到一个有兴趣的买家来接手这个对象——我们说清楚——他几乎不可能再醒过来，恢复意识与神智。"

"你为我们的交易付了我 100,000 星币。让我把这笔钱还给你，再加 100,000，合计 200,000 星币，而你撤销我们交易中的那些条件。"

entries.en: "I'm afraid I'm contractually forbidden to elaborate any further on the subject," he says, making a good show of appearing regretfully helpful.
entries.zh: "恐怕按合同我不能就此事再多说了，"他说，颇为到位地摆出一副既遗憾又乐于相助的样子。

entries.en: "Yes," Inesis says.
entries.zh: "是的，"Inesis 说。

entries.en:
"A shame about Sindria," he says, half-smile in place, but his expression taking on a look of mild regret. "The capital losses alone..."

He shakes his head.
entries.zh:
"Sindria 的事真是可惜，\"他说着，嘴角那抹半笑依旧在，神情却添了几许淡淡的惋惜。\"单是资本损失就..."

他摇了摇头。

entries.en:
"The capital losses in Askonia following the collapse of the centralized Sindrian polity..." Inesis shakes his head, half-smile in place, but his expression taking on a look of mild regret.

"A fair number of senior executives in Tri-Tachyon have lost much," he says. "The upcoming quarter will be... stimulating."
entries.zh:
"辛达集权政体崩解之后，Askonia 的资本损失..."Inesis 摇了摇头，嘴角那抹半笑依旧在，神情却添了几许淡淡的惋惜。

"速子科技有相当一批高管损失惨重，\"他说，\"接下来的这个季度会...很刺激。"

entries.en:
"Nothing like a reasonably-sized war to stimulate the Sector's economy," he says, half-smile fixed. "What I most admire is how inefficiency is discarded by the fact of necessity."

"It is... beautiful to witness," he muses.
entries.zh:
"再没有比一场规模适中的战争更能刺激星域经济的了，\"他说，半笑凝固在脸上。\"我最欣赏的一点是，必要性会让低效无处容身。"

"看着这一幕...真是美妙，"他沉吟道。

entries.en:
"A pleasure dealing with you, captain," he says brightly.

You receive the ping of an incoming credits transfer almost instantly.
entries.zh:
"跟你做生意很愉快，舰长，"他轻快地说。

几乎立刻，你就收到了星币转账到账的提示音。

You receive the ping of an incoming credits transfer almost instantly.

entries.en:
Inesis' pleasant expression is solidly fixed.

"What I suggest is more human than you may wish to admit, captain, but let me assure you that I am a man who honors his contracts."

He nods, expression unchanged.
entries.zh:
Inesis 那副和悦的神情牢牢地凝在脸上。

"我的建议比你愿意承认的要更合乎人性，舰长。不过请放心，我是个守合同的人。"

他点了点头，神色不变。

o.en: You want to sell Leonidas to... someone? To do what?
o.zh: 你想把 Leonidas 卖给...某个人？要干什么？

entries.en: "I seek only profit and place no conditions upon purchases," he says mildly.
entries.zh: "我只求利润，对买主不设条件，"他温和地说。

o.en: I think his value has increased considerably, don't you?
o.zh: 我想他的价值已经涨了不少，你不觉得吗？

entries.en: "A tranchant insight, captain." His smile grows. "Let me instead propose a payment of 300,000 credits."
entries.zh: "好一句锋利的见解，舰长。\"他的笑容加深。\"那我改提一笔 300,000 星币的付款吧。"

entries.en:
Inesis shrugs.

"I merely presenting you with opportunity."
entries.zh:
Inesis 耸了耸肩。

"我不过是在给你一个机会。"

o.en: Your proposal is inhuman. I reject it unambiguously.
o.zh: 你的提议毫无人性。我明确拒绝。

entries.en:
"In any event, I believe my investment in the Nortia acquisition will pay off handsomely once the commercial situation is normalized."

He pauses, then raises his eyebrows in an open expression of congratulation.

"Whatever your intent, the company is pleased with this outcome."
entries.zh:
"无论如何，我相信等商业秩序恢复正常，我在 Nortia 收购案上的投资会带来丰厚的回报。"

他顿了顿，然后挑起眉毛，毫不掩饰地作出祝贺的神情。

"不管你的意图是什么，公司对这个结果很满意。"

entries.en:
"In any event, I believe my investment in the Umbra acquisition will pay off handsomely once the commercial situation is normalized."

He pauses, then raises his eyebrows in an open expression of congratulation.

"Whatever your intent, the company is pleased with this outcome."
entries.zh:
"无论如何，我相信等商业秩序恢复正常，我在 Umbra 收购案上的投资会带来丰厚的回报。"

他顿了顿，然后挑起眉毛，毫不掩饰地作出祝贺的神情。

"不管你的意图是什么，公司对这个结果很满意。"

entries.en:
"In any event, I believe my investment in the Nortia and Umbra acquisitions will pay off handsomely once the commercial situation is normalized."

He pauses, then raises his eyebrows in an open expression of congratulation.

"Whatever your intent, the company is pleased with this outcome."
entries.zh:
"无论如何，我相信等商业秩序恢复正常，我在 Nortia 与 Umbra 两桩收购案上的投资会带来丰厚的回报。"

他顿了顿，然后挑起眉毛，毫不掩饰地作出祝贺的神情。

"不管你的意图是什么，公司对这个结果很满意。"

entries.en: "In any event, new opportunities abound. I am eager to find the profits in this new Persean Sector."
entries.zh: "无论如何，新机会遍地都是。我已迫不及待要在这个新的英仙座星域里找出利润所在。"

entries.en: "Sindria," he says, staring outward for a moment. "Opis and now Sindria, by the stars, how history repeats itself- darkly."
entries.zh: "Sindria，\"他说着，目光向外望了片刻，\"先是 Opis，如今是 Sindria。群星在上，历史是多么执拗地重演——一次比一次更黑暗。"

entries.en: "But it is a joyful time, captain! The so-called Sindrian Diktat is dead and gone - and the last of the Andradas with it!
entries.zh: "但这是个值得欢庆的时刻，舰长！所谓的辛达强权已经死了、没了——Andrada 家最后的血脉也随它而去！"

entries.en:
"We still have Hector to deal with, don't we. Another Phillip. A dim shadow of his father, at least."

He smirks at his wordplay.
entries.zh:
"我们还得应付 Hector，不是吗。又是一个 Phillip。至少，只是他父亲投下的一道暗影。"

他为自己这句俏皮话得意地笑了笑。

entries.en:
"We still have Achilles to deal with, don't we." He taps a finger on his cheek.

"A pale shadow of his clone-father, but an Andrada nonetheless. The work is unfinished."
entries.zh:
"我们还得应付 Achilles，不是吗。"他用一根手指轻敲着脸颊。

"比起他的克隆父亲，那只是个苍白的影子，可终究是 Andrada 家的人。这活儿还没干完。"

entries.en:
"We still have Achilles to deal with, don't we." He taps a finger on his cheek.

"I can't help but hold two contradictory hopes: that the League will hold him close so that he may not repeat the crimes of his clone-father... and that the League will stay well aloof, so that the Sindrian Diktat can be finished off once and for all through uprising and intervention!"
entries.zh:
"我们还得应付 Achilles，不是吗。"他用一根手指轻敲着脸颊。

"我忍不住同时抱着两个互相矛盾的指望：指望联盟把他牢牢攥住，好让他没法重犯他克隆父亲的罪行...也指望联盟远远撒手不管，好让辛达强权在起义与干预之下被彻底了结！"

entries.en:
"But Nortia, sweet Nortia remains free. There is still much to be done, no?"

"One day, ALL of Askonia will again be strong and free," he says, then grins with a new weariness.
entries.zh:
"可 Nortia，可爱的 Nortia 仍然自由。还有许多事要做，不是吗？"

"总有一天，Askonia 的每一寸土地都会重新变得强大而自由，"他说，随后带着一种新的倦意咧嘴笑了。

entries.en:
"But Nortia, oh Nortia, the fight goes on. At least under the Hegemony it shall be fought with words and, and... process. A slow process, compromise, but at least not warships and bombs."

"One day, all Askonia will again be strong and free," he says, then grins with renewed weariness.

The Hegemony does not easily give up polities it has 'returned' to the fold.
entries.zh:
"可 Nortia，唉，Nortia，斗争还在继续。至少归入霸主之后，这场斗争要用言辞、用...程序来打。缓慢的程序，妥协，但至少不是战舰和炸弹。"

"总有一天，整个 Askonia 会重新变得强大而自由，"他说，随后带着新的倦意咧嘴笑了。

霸主不会轻易放手它已经'收归'治下的政权。

entries.en:
"But Nortia, oh Nortia, the fight goes on. One day, all Askonia will again be strong and free."

He grins, though with a new weariness.
entries.zh:
"可 Nortia，唉，Nortia，斗争还在继续。总有一天，整个 Askonia 会重新变得强大而自由。"

他咧嘴笑了，只是那笑里添了一层新的倦意。

entries.en: Despite his bright tone, his look is weary.
entries.zh: 尽管语气亮堂，他的神情却很疲惫。

entries.en:
The comms snap open and resolve to show Arnaud Iscare already with a charming look.

"Captain $PlayerLastName! So good to see you again."
entries.zh:
通讯应声而开，画面里 Arnaud Iscare 已经挂上了一副迷人的神情。

"$PlayerLastName 舰长！又见到你真是太好了。"

entries.en:
The link is accepted and Arnaud Iscare looks up with a charmingly affected look of surprise.

"Captain? Back so soon?" He smiles. "How many I be of assistance?"
entries.zh:
通讯接通，Arnaud Iscare 抬起头，做出一副可爱又刻意的惊讶神情。

"舰长？这么快就回来了？\"他笑了笑，\"有什么我能效劳的？"

entries.en:
He closes his eyes. You can see his jaw tighten a little.

"The Hegemony has determined that it's not my concern anymore." Orcus opens his eyes. They are cold, and clear. "We'll see."
entries.zh:
他闭上眼睛。你能看到他的下颌稍稍绷紧。

"霸主已经认定，这不再是我的事了。\"Orcus 睁开眼。那双眼睛又冷又清。\"我们走着瞧。"

entries.en:
He closes his eyes, and sighs.

"Not my problem anymore. It's over."
entries.zh:
他闭上眼睛，叹了口气。

"不再是我的问题了。都结束了。"

entries.en:
He closes his eyes, and sighs.

"He won."

A hand reflexively balls into a fist, loosely. Rao notices himself, and relaxes. Another sigh.
entries.zh:
他闭上眼睛，叹了口气。

"他赢了。"

一只手不自觉地松松握成拳。Rao 自己察觉到了，松开手。又是一声叹息。

entries.en:
He gives you a weary look.

"Sindria is toast. Macario with it." A long pause. "That's the line, anyway. The Hegemony has determined that it's not my concern anymore."

"So it's not."
entries.zh:
他疲惫地看了你一眼。

"Sindria 完了。Macario 也跟着完了。\"长久的沉默。\"至少官方是这么说的。霸主已经认定，这不再是我的事了。"

"那就不是吧。"

entries.en:
He closes his eyes, and sighs.

"Not my problem anymore. It's over."
entries.zh:
他闭上眼睛，叹了口气。

"不再是我的问题了。都结束了。"

entries.en:
"I did," he says. "Finally."

He takes a deep breath.

"The answer was no."
entries.zh:
"问到了，\"他说。\"总算问到了。"

他深吸一口气。

"答复是不。"

entries.en:
"He didn't, no," Rao answers, then looks away.

"But he made it pretty clear in how he said no. What he didn't say was that he can't look soft on traitors. Not in the current political environment."
entries.zh:
"没说，"Rao 答道，然后把目光移开。

"但他那句'不'是怎么说出口的，已经很清楚了。他没说出口的是：在眼下这种政治气候里，他不能对叛徒显得心软。"

entries.en:
"She's got her work cut out for her rebuilding Achilles' navy."

He doesn't sound too pleased about this, but not too upset either.
entries.zh:
"她要重建 Achilles 的舰队，够她忙的了。"

他说这话时听不出多高兴，但也不算太难过。

o.en: Is the Hegemony going to do anything?

entries.en:
"I'm surprised she didn't die in battle, what with the defeat of her fleet," he says. "Figured that's how she'd have wanted to go."

"Well, she's got her work cut out for her rebuilding Achilles' navy for the shiny new Sindrian Diktat."

He doesn't sound too pleased about this, but not too upset either.
entries.zh:
"她的舰队都败成那样，她居然没战死，我挺意外，\"他说。\"我以为那会是她想要的死法。"

"不过话说回来，她要为那个崭新的辛达强权重建 Achilles 的舰队，够她忙的了。"

他说这话时听不出多高兴，但也不算太难过。

o.en: Is the Hegemony going to do anything?

entries.en:
"Besides, we have it on reasonably good authority she died in battle," he says.

"Probably how she wanted to go."
entries.zh:
"再说，我们有相当可靠的消息来源，说她战死了，"他说。

"大概正是她想要的死法。"

entries.en:
He looks back at you, joyless.

"We did pick her up. On Nortia. She surrendered herself from a command shuttle holed through a half dozen times, by the report."
entries.zh:
他回望你，眼里没有笑意。

"我们确实把她接回来了。在 Nortia。报告说，她从一艘被打穿了六七个洞的指挥穿梭机里自己出来投降了。"

entries.en:
He looks back at you, joyless.

"We did pick her up. On the Askonia fringe. She surrendered herself from a command shuttle holed through a half dozen times, by the report."
entries.zh:
他回望你，眼里没有笑意。

"我们确实把她接回来了。在 Askonia 星系的边缘。报告说，她从一艘被打穿了六七个洞的指挥穿梭机里自己出来投降了。"

entries.en:
Orcus shrugs.

He is quiet, and his look distant for a moment. Perhaps wondering if that's how he'd want to go.
entries.zh:
Orcus 耸了耸肩。

他沉默着，有一瞬目光很远。也许是在想，那会不会也是他想要的死法。

entries.en:
"In custody. Still sentenced for execution but apparently the Strategic Council isn't in a hurry to have it carried out."

"What does that mean?" Orcus gives you an ironic look. "Ludd's hell if I know. It's up to the bureaucracy now."
entries.zh:
"在押。判决仍是死刑，但显然战略委员会并不急着执行。"

"这是什么意思？\"Orcus 带着讽刺看了你一眼。\"卢德在上，我哪知道。现在这归官僚管了。"

entries.en:
"Besides, we have it on reasonably good authority she died in battle," he says.

"Probably how she wanted to go."
entries.zh:
"再说，我们有相当可靠的消息来源，说她战死了，"他说。

"大概正是她想要的死法。"

entries.en:
"Do anything?" He snorts. "That's up to the bureaucracy and the committees. Maybe they'll ask Achilles nicely to transfer her to a liaison post so we can nab her."

He shrugs, then looks away. Quiet for a moment.

Nothing more to say.
entries.zh:
"有什么动作？\"他哼了一声。\"那得看官僚和委员会的意思。说不定他们会客客气气地请 Achilles 把她调去做联络官，好让我们把她抓到手里。"

他耸了耸肩，把目光移开。安静了片刻。

没什么可再说的了。

o.en: Did you ever get anything from Daud on the Hyder offer?
o.zh: 关于 Hyder 那个提议，你从 Daud 那儿问到什么了吗？

entries.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat is stronger than ever. A young leader, some damned clone of Andrada. Renewed sense of purpose. You understand what that means?"

"We lost," he says, staring into space. "Completely."
entries.zh:
"辛达强权比以往任何时候都强。一个年轻的领袖，Andrada 的什么该死的克隆体。目标感重燃。你明白那意味着什么吗？"

"我们输了，\"他盯着虚空说道。\"彻底输了。"

entries.en:
"There's no reward for this, $titleHeg. My funding is frozen. Under investigation. They'll be thorough."

He seems older, and listless. Like a ship that's lost too many maneuvering thrusters.

"I'll be facing a court-martial, of course. Quiet retirement and keeping my mouth shut is the best I can hope for."

Rao takes a deep breath, then his eyes turn to meet yours through the link. "I'm done. You... you keep your head down. They're going to be looking for people to blame. It's the Hegemony way."
entries.zh:
"这件事没有奖赏，$titleHeg。我的经费被冻结了。正在被调查。他们会查得很彻底。"

他看上去老了些，也提不起劲，像一艘丢掉了太多姿态推进器的船。

"我当然要上军事法庭。安静退休、把嘴闭上，已经是我能指望的最好结局。"

Rao 深吸一口气，然后目光穿过通讯链路，与你的目光相接。"我完了。你...你也把头低下去吧。他们会找人来背这个责任。这就是霸主的做派。"

entries.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat remains," he says. "Whatever damage was done, that is the important fact. And now they've got a young energetic leader, some damn clone of Andrada. Renewed sense of purpose. You understand what that means?"

"We lost."
entries.zh:
"辛达强权还在，\"他说。\"不管这次受了多大损伤，那才是要紧的事实。而现在他们有了一个年轻有为的领袖，Andrada 的什么该死的克隆体。目标感重燃。你明白那意味着什么吗？"

"我们输了。"

entries.en:
"There's no reward for this, $titleHeg. My funding has been frozen pending an investigation."

"I'll be facing a court-martial. Not my first," he adds with a joyless smile. "But I imagine my assignment at Ragnar is going to be renewed until they convince me to retire. It's... what this place is for."

"You keep your head down for a bit, $titleHeg. I take full responsibility for the operation, but they're still going to be looking for people to blame. It's the Hegemony way."
entries.zh:
"这件事没有奖赏，$titleHeg。我的经费已被冻结，等候调查。"

"我要上军事法庭了。这倒不是第一次，\"他补了一句，笑意里没有半分快活。\"不过我猜，我在 Ragnar 的任职会被无限续下去，直到他们说服我退休为止。这地方...就是干这个用的。"

"你也把头低一阵子，$titleHeg。这次行动由我负全责，可他们照样会找人来背锅。这就是霸主的做派。"

entries.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat has taken some hits, but they've held on," he says, almost a growl. "And now they've got a young, energetic leader. Some damn clone of Andrada. Renewed sense of purpose. You understand what that means?"

"If we didn't lose, we sure didn't win."
entries.zh:
"辛达强权挨了几下，可他们撑住了，\"他说，声音几乎像是低吼。\"而现在他们有了一个年轻、有干劲的领袖。Andrada 的什么该死的克隆体。目标感重燃。你明白那意味着什么吗？"

"我们要是没输，那也绝对没赢。"

entries.en: "My budget is being put under review, but I'm going to make sure you get something for your trouble." He taps something on his datapad.
entries.zh: "我的预算正在被重新审查，不过我会确保你为自己这些麻烦拿到点东西。"他在数据板上点了点什么。

entries.en:
"They're going to call me to stand before the Strategic Council," he says wearily. "An inquiry. Effectively a court-martial but they're not quite calling it that for," he snorts, "public morale."

"I can handle them. Have before, will again. Don't think I'll be leaving Ragnar any time soon though."
entries.zh:
"他们会叫我到战略委员会面前站着，\"他疲惫地说。\"一次调查。实质上就是军事法庭，只是他们不肯这么叫，为了，\"他哼了一声，\"为了士气。"

"我应付得了他们。以前应付过，以后也还得应付。不过我想，我短期内是离不开 Ragnar 了。"

entries.en:
"The Sindrian Mutiny is a shell of itself."

"I wouldn't call it a total win, but I'll take it. The Strategic Council has questions, but they'll be handing out medals soon enough."

"You'll get one too, I'm sure." He smirks. "Once the bureaucrats figure out which end to stick it on."
entries.zh:
"辛达叛乱如今只剩个空壳。"

"我不会说这是全胜，但这个结果我认了。战略委员会有些疑问，但勋章很快就要发下来了。"

"你也会拿到一枚，我肯定。\"他撇了撇嘴。\"等那帮官僚弄明白该把别针别在哪一头之后。"

entries.en:
"There's a bit of leftover budget. I'm sure the auditors won't be too put out if I ensure you're rewarded for your service."

"And who knows," he says, "Maybe when everything settles down I'll get promoted out of this back-orbit dumpster and given a seat on some committee. Plenty of those to go around."

He looks off and far away. "Hoping for somewhere warm... not Jangala though, ugh."
entries.zh:
"还剩一点预算。我确保你因这份效劳得到奖赏，审计官们想必不会太介意。"

"谁知道呢，\"他说，\"等一切平息下来，说不定我能从这个后轨道的垃圾堆里升出去，在某个委员会里弄个位子。那种位子多得是。"

他望向远处。"想找个暖和点的地方...不过别是 Jangala，唉。"

entries.en: "That's it," he says. "There'll still be work now and then, if you want it. When I get back."
entries.zh: "就这样了，\"他说。\"零星还有些活，你要是想接就接。等我回来。"

entries.en:
"Burn bright."

He reaches for the comms cut-off and the link goes dark.
entries.zh:
"愿你光芒不灭。"

他伸手去关通讯，链路暗了下去。

entries.en: He slowly reaches for the comms cut-off and the link goes dark.
entries.zh: 他缓缓伸手去关通讯，链路暗了下去。

entries.en:
"The Sindrian Mutiny is destroyed."

He grins, a bitter thing held back for many cycles.

"The Hegemony got a win here, $titleHeg. And so did Daud. Won't shut up my back-stabbing cousins at the Eventide ball, but they'll keep it to whispers."

"And you're a hero. Enjoy it. I bet Daud'll even give you a medal." He smirks. "Once the bureaucrats figure out which end to stick it on, that is. Could take a while!"

He laughs.
entries.zh:
"辛达叛乱被摧毁了。"

他咧嘴一笑，那笑意里带着苦，压了不知多少个星历年。

"霸主在这里赢了一局，$titleHeg。Daud 也赢了。这堵不住我在 Eventide 舞会上那些背后捅刀的表亲的嘴，但他们至少会压成耳语。"

"而你是个英雄。好好享受吧。我打赌 Daud 甚至会给你发一枚勋章。\"他撇了撇嘴。\"等那帮官僚弄明白该把别针别在哪一头——那可得等上一阵子！"

他笑了起来。

entries.en:
"There's a bit of leftover budget. I'm sure the auditors won't be too put out if I ensure you're rewarded for delivering what even they will be forced to admit is a victory."

"And you know what?," his grin only grows, "I have a pretty good feeling that I'm going to get promoted out of this back-orbit dumpster and given a seat on a decent committee. If I'm lucky, I'll even get a choice in the matter!"

"I'm hoping for..." He looks off and far away, basking in an imagined sun. "Somewhere warm. Not Jangala though, ugh."
entries.zh:
"还剩一点预算。我确保你因交付了一场连他们都不得不承认的胜利而得到奖赏，审计官们想必不会太介意。"

"你猜怎么着？\"他的笑越咧越开，\"我有种很好的预感：我能从这个后轨道的垃圾堆里升出去，在一个像样的委员会里弄个位子。运气好的话，我甚至还能自己挑一个！"

"我想去...\"他望向远处，像在享受一轮想象出来的太阳。\"暖和一点的地方。不过别是 Jangala，唉。"

entries.en:
Rao sighs. He looks deflated.

"It's all a huge mess, this planet-killer business. Good riddance to the mutineers, yes, blown up into forms of radiation that only excite academicians. But everyone knows the rot that birthed the Diktat started in the Hegemony and this makes the Hegemony look bad. Very bad. It makes Daud look bad. It makes me look bad."

He rubs his face, then pauses.

"You too. For your involvement."
entries.zh:
Rao 叹了口气。他看上去像被抽空了。

"这整摊子行星杀手的破事，全是一团乱麻。那些叛变分子算是清干净了，没错，被炸成只有院士们才会感兴趣的辐射形态。可谁都知道，生出辛达强权的那份腐坏，源头就在霸主；这事让霸主很难看。非常难看。让 Daud 难看。让我难看。"

他抹了把脸，然后停住。

"还有你。因为你也掺和在里面。"

entries.en:
"The auditors are going to be merciless, $titleHeg. My funding is frozen. Under investigation."

He seems older, somehow, and listless, like a ship that's lost most of its maneuvering thrusters.

"I'll be facing a court-martial, of course. Quiet retirement and keeping my mouth shut is about the best I can hope for. They'll be out for blood - someone to blame."

Rao takes a deep breath, then his eyes turn to meet yours through the link.

"I'm done. You... you keep your head down. Even if they find the idiot who provided the Diktat with a PK, the knives will be out."
entries.zh:
"审计官们不会手下留情，$titleHeg。我的经费被冻结了。正在被调查。"

他不知怎么的，看上去更老了，也提不起劲，像一艘丢掉了大半姿态推进器的船。

"我当然要上军事法庭。安静退休、把嘴闭上，差不多就是我能指望的最好结局。他们要来喝血的——总得有人背这个。"

Rao 深吸一口气，然后目光穿过通讯链路，与你的目光相接。

"我完了。你...你也把头低下去吧。就算他们找到那个给辛达强权送上行星杀手的白痴，刀也已经出鞘了。"

entries.en:
Rao appears. He looks tired.

"$TitleHeg." He takes a moment, a deep breath.

"It's over, then."
entries.zh:
Rao 出现在画面里。他看上去很疲惫。

"$TitleHeg。"他顿了顿，深吸一口气。

"那么，结束了。"

entries.en:
Rao appears. He looks tired. He doesn't even look at you.

"I still can't believe the crazy drunk did it," he says.

Now his eyes go to the feed, to you. "There's going to be an inquiry."
entries.zh:
Rao 出现在画面里。他看上去很疲惫。他甚至没有看你。

"我还是没法相信，那个疯酒鬼居然办成了，"他说。

这时他的目光才转到通讯画面，落到你身上。"接下来会有调查。"

entries.en:
"The Hegemony is the living remnant of the Domain. The only authorized possessor of planet-killers." He snorts. "That's the official line."

"Some stupid spacer hard-up for credits must have found a PK somewhere out in the Fringe and thought selling it to the Diktat would be..." he trails off, shaking his head. "Who knows."

He looks away for a long moment.
entries.zh:
"霸主是人之领活着的残片。是唯一被授权持有行星杀手的势力。\"他哼了一声。\"官方说法就是这样。"

"准是哪个缺钱缺疯了的蠢船员，在边缘星域某处翻出一件行星杀手，还以为把它卖给辛达强权能换来...\"他话没说完，摇了摇头。\"谁知道呢。"

他把目光移开，很久没有作声。

entries.en:
Rao appears. He looks tired. But by his eyes you can see he's smiling inside.

"It's good to see you, $titleHeg." He takes a moment, a deep breath.

"We did it."
entries.zh:
Rao 出现在画面里。他看上去很疲惫。但从他的眼神里能看出，他心里在笑。

"见到你真好，$titleHeg。"他顿了顿，深吸一口气。

"我们做到了。"

entries.en:
"You gave Fortuna Kato's wayward granddaughter her revolution on Umbra." He snaps his fingers.

"For your service."
entries.zh:
"你帮 Fortuna 那个走上歧途的孙女在 Umbra 搞成了她的革命。"他打了个响指。

"给你的酬劳。"

entries.en: "You appear to have had difficulty carrying out my complete instructions," he says, frowning. "If you only half-arm an already doomed insurrection, it doesn't have quite the same effect."
entries.zh: "看来你执行我的完整吩咐时遇到了点困难，\"他皱着眉说，\"一场本就注定失败的暴动，你只给它武装一半，效果可就差得远了。"

entries.en: "You appear to have had difficulty carrying out my complete instructions," he says, frowning. "If you only half-arm an already doomed insurrection, it doesn't have quite the same effect."
entries.zh: "看来你执行我的完整吩咐时遇到了点困难，\"他皱着眉说，\"一场本就注定失败的暴动，你只给它武装一半，效果可就差得远了。"

entries.en:
"You appear to have difficulty following instructions," he says coldly. "You failed to fully outfit even a single doomed uprising."

"What use are you?"
entries.zh:
"看来你不太会照吩咐办事，\"他冷冷地说，\"连一场注定失败的起事，你都没能给它配齐装备。"

"你还有什么用？"

entries.en: "You served me well and carried out my instructions," he says, quite satisfied - with himself, mostly, from his tone and expression.
entries.zh: "你为我办得不错，把我的吩咐都执行了，"他说，相当满意——从他的语气和神情看，多半是对他自己满意。

entries.en:
"You gave the Luddic fanatics of Volturn their weapons." He snaps his fingers.

"Your reward."
entries.zh:
"你把武器交给了 Volturn 的卢德狂信徒。"他打了个响指。

"你的奖赏。"

entries.en: "I've been meaning to speak to you about Askonia."
entries.zh: "我一直想跟你谈谈 Askonia 的事。"

entries.en: "We will do great things for Gens Hannan, $titlePL," his voice is warm, yet somehow possessive. "We will make history together."
entries.zh: "我们要为 Hannan 氏族成就一番大业，$titlePL，\"他的声音温和，却不知怎地带上了占有的意味，\"我们要一起创造历史。"

entries.en:
"We will do great things for Gens Hannan, $titlePL," his voice is warm, yet somehow possessive. "We will make history together."

"But I'm forgetting something."

Reynard pauses, quite self-aware.
entries.zh:
"我们要为 Hannan 氏族成就一番大业，$titlePL，\"他的声音温和，却不知怎地带上了占有的意味，\"我们要一起创造历史。"

"不过我忘了一件事。"

Reynard 顿了顿，显然心里有数。

entries.en:
He looks away. "My patience has been tried. Good day."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
他移开目光。"我的耐心已经耗尽了。告辞。"

通讯断了。

entries.en: "I ought to offer my congratulations to Achilles. He exceeded expectations," Reynard says. "And even managed to throw off Fortuna's fussy oversight. Good for him."
entries.zh: "我该向 Achilles 道个贺。他超出了预期，\"Reynard 说，\"甚至还甩掉了 Fortuna 那套处处插手的监管。他有本事。"

entries.en:
"It's a pity about the Achilles clone, of course. He never did manage to quite throw off Fortuna's overbearing manipulation."

Reynard speaks dismissively, but there's some bitter undercurrent he cannot, or will not, conceal.
entries.zh:
"当然，Achilles 那个克隆体的事很可惜。他到底没能彻底摆脱 Fortuna 那套专横的摆布。"

Reynard 说得漫不经心，可底下压着一股苦涩，他藏不住，或者说不愿藏。

entries.en:
"I must be honest, the results were somewhat more... explosive than ever I thought possible." He looks over his fingernails, which are flawless.

"...Sindria as well as Opis?" He tsk-tsks.
entries.zh:
"实话说，结果比我预想的...要火爆得多。"他端详着自己的指甲，那指甲完美无瑕。

"...Sindria，还有 Opis？"他啧啧了两声。

entries.en: "I ought to offer my congratulations to that clone, Hector. He exceeded anyone's expectations."
entries.zh: "我该向那个克隆体道个贺，Hector。他超出了所有人的预期。"

entries.en: "I'd offer my congratulations to that Hector clone, but," Reynard shrugs. "He made a bit of a mess of things, didn't he."
entries.zh: "我本想向那个 Hector 克隆体道个贺，不过，\"Reynard 耸了耸肩，\"他把事情弄得有点糟，不是吗。"

entries.en:
"You played your part well, $titlePL."

He gifts you with an approving smile, though it is just a little too bright, his teeth just a little sharper than they ought to be.

"Perhaps if you prove that wasn't a fluke... well, the generosity of Gens Hannan is not casually granted, but I assure you it is... substantial."
entries.zh:
"你这一角演得不错，$titlePL。"

他赏了你一个赞许的笑容，只是亮得有点过头，牙也尖得有点不该。

"也许，等你能证明那并非侥幸...嗯，Hannan 氏族的慷慨从不轻许，但我向你保证，它...相当丰厚。"

entries.en:
"You did a poor job given even the simple, straightforward tasks I tasked you to perform."

He sits up now, an expression of displeasure growing.

"I gave you such opportunity, showed such generosity. What did you provide in return?"

"Mediocrity."
entries.zh:
"我交给你的都是简单直白的差事，你办得却很糟。"

他坐直了身子，脸上的不悦一点点加深。

"我给了你那样的机会，待你那样慷慨。你回报了我什么？"

"平庸。"

entries.en: "And the Sindrian Diktat remains a useful buffer." He smirks. "For the security of the Persean League."
entries.zh: "而辛达强权仍然是一道有用的缓冲。\"他得意地一笑。\"为了英仙座联盟的安全。"

entries.en: "Pity about the Sindrian Diktat," he says. "It was useful, very useful, for a time."
entries.zh: "辛达强权的事很可惜，\"他说，\"它曾经很有用，非常有用，有那么一阵子。"

entries.en:
"Dolos Macario, yes," he says.

"Contact the man who calls himself K-O Jove, on Qaras. I know you've met him already. He's been given instructions as well as payment for the service he shall provide. He will arrange matters to suit your requirements."

"Enjoy yourself," he says, attention wandering elsewhere. "I'm sure Dolos won't."
entries.zh:
"Dolos Macario，对，"他说。

"去 Qaras 联系那个自称 K-O Jove 的人。我知道你已经见过他。他既拿到了指令，也拿到了他即将提供的服务的报酬。他会把事情安排得合乎你的要求。"

"好好享受，\"他说，注意力已经飘到别处，\"我确信 Dolos 不会。"

entries.en: You detect the barest flash of annoyance for ruining his timing but Reynard recovers his poise immediately.
entries.zh: 你捕捉到他脸上一闪而过的不快——你坏了他的节奏——但 Reynard 立刻恢复了那副从容。

entries.en:
"Dolos Macario, yes," he says.

"Contact the man who calls himself K-O Jove, on Qaras. I know you made some small deal with him, but that was half a bluff on his part. I've seen that he has the resources required to actually deliver upon his promise, and that he'll speak no more of payments to you."

"Enjoy yourself," he says, attention wandering elsewhere. "I'm sure Dolos won't."
entries.zh:
"Dolos Macario，对，"他说。

"去 Qaras 联系那个自称 K-O Jove 的人。我知道你跟他做过一笔小交易，但那有一半是他在虚张声势。我已经查明，他有真正兑现承诺所需的资源，也不会再向你提付款的事。"

"好好享受，\"他说，注意力已经飘到别处，\"我确信 Dolos 不会。"

entries.en:
He frowns. Not a subject he wished to revisit, apparently.

"He cannot become anything more than he was." Siyavong raises a finger at you. "I suggest that you not read too much into this absence of information. You recall his condition - which is almost certainly irreversible barring the provision of a miracle which, as a humble servant of the Fleet Intelligence Service, is not amongst the privileges I may draw upon to perform my duties."

"The matter is effectively closed."

He is still frowning.
entries.zh:
他皱起眉头。看来这不是他想再谈的话题。

"他不可能比从前更有起色。\"Siyavong 朝你竖起一根手指。\"我建议你别从这份信息缺失里读出太多东西。你记得他的状况——那几乎肯定是不可逆的，除非出现奇迹；而作为舰队情报部一名卑微的雇员，动用奇迹并不在我履行职责所能享有的特权之列。"

"这件事实际上已经了结了。"

他仍然皱着眉。

entries.en:
The comms link holds for a moment on the understated crest of Persean League Fleet Intelligence before connecting.

"Greetings, $TitlePL $playerLastName," Siyavong says.
entries.zh:
通讯链路在英仙座联盟舰队情报部那枚低调的徽记上停留了片刻，随后接通。

"你好，$TitlePL $playerLastName，"Siyavong 说。

entries.en:
The comms link holds for a moment on the understated crest of Persean League Fleet Intelligence before connecting.

"Greetings, $TitlePL $playerLastName," Siyavong says.
entries.zh:
通讯链路在英仙座联盟舰队情报部那枚低调的徽记上停留了片刻，随后接通。

"你好，$TitlePL $playerLastName，"Siyavong 说。

entries.en:
"Yes, well." A grimace. "Not quite like this."

He pauses. Watching you.

"What I want is what is best for the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL."
entries.zh:
"是啊，好吧。\"他嘴角一抽，\"可不是这样收场的。"

他顿了顿，目光打量着你。

"我所求的，是对英仙座联盟的安全与安稳最有利的结果，$titlePL。"

entries.en:
"Yes, well." A quick smirk. "But there is winning and there is winning, with... worlds of difference between the two."

He looks away. "As we have observed in Askonia so recently. Nonetheless."
entries.zh:
"是啊，好吧。\"他飞快地一笑，\"但赢也分很多种，两者之间...天差地别。"

他移开视线。"就像我们近来在 Askonia 亲眼所见。不过，话虽如此。"

entries.en:
"What I want," Siyavong says.

He makes as if to consider the question for a moment.

"What I want is the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL." A quick smile. "Contingency and circumstance willing, we may get it."
entries.zh:
"我所求的，"Siyavong 说。

他装模作样地思索了片刻。

"我所求的，是英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL。\"他飞快地一笑，\"若时势与机缘允许，我们或许能得到它。"

entries.en:
"What we want," Siyavong says.

He makes as if to consider the question for a moment.

"What I want is the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL." A quick smile. "Contingency and circumstance willing, we may get it."
entries.zh:
"我们所求的，"Siyavong 说。

他装模作样地思索了片刻。

"我所求的，是英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL。\"他飞快地一笑，\"若时势与机缘允许，我们或许能得到它。"

entries.en:
"Do something about Hector?" Siyavong says, as if taken aback. He makes as if to consider the question for a moment.

"What I want is to ensure the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL, and the benefits that happy situation would confer upon the Persean Sector entire."

"Contingency and circumstance willing, it will require... vigilance. The specifics of which need not concern you at this moment."
entries.zh:
"对 Hector 做点什么？"Siyavong 说，像是被问了个措手不及。他装模作样地思索了片刻。

"我所求的，是确保英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL，以及这一可喜局面将为整个英仙座星域带来的好处。"

"若时势与机缘允许，这需要...警惕。具体细节此刻不必劳你费心。"

o.en: Achilles won. Isn't that what you wanted?
o.zh: Achilles 赢了。这不正是你想要的吗？

o.en: I pledged my support and Achilles won. Is this not what you wanted?
o.zh: 我承诺了支持，Achilles 也赢了。这不正是你想要的吗？

o.en: Achilles won. Isn't that what you wanted?
o.zh: Achilles 赢了。这不正是你想要的吗？

o.en: I pledged my support and Achilles won. Is this not what you wanted?
o.zh: 我承诺了支持，Achilles 也赢了。这不正是你想要的吗？

o.en: You got what you wanted, then, didn't you.
o.zh: 那么，你得到了你想要的，不是吗。

o.en: We got what we wanted, then, didn't we.
o.zh: 那么，我们得到了我们想要的，不是吗。

o.en: We got what you wanted, then, didn't we.
o.zh: 那么，我们得到了你想要的，不是吗。

o.en: Are you going to do something about Hector?
o.zh: 你打算对 Hector 采取行动吗？

o.en: So what is to become of Leonidas?
o.zh: 那么 Leonidas 会怎么样？

o.en: The Sindrian Diktat is done for. Isn't that success?
o.zh: 辛达强权完了。这还不算成功吗？

o.en: The Sindrian Diktat is finished, Askonia liberated. This can only be a good thing.
o.zh: 辛达强权覆灭了，Askonia 解放了。这只能是件好事。

entries.en:
"Undeniably. But power abhors a vacuum."

Siyavong looks away with a sigh.

"What I want is to ensure the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL, and the benefits that happy situation would confer upon the Persean Sector entire."

"Contingency and circumstance willing, it will require... vigilance. The specifics of which need not concern you at this moment."
entries.zh:
"无可否认。但权力厌恶真空。"

Siyavong 叹了口气，移开目光。

"我所求的，是确保英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL，以及这一可喜局面将为整个英仙座星域带来的好处。"

"若时势与机缘允许，这需要...警惕。具体细节此刻不必劳你费心。"

entries.en:
He turns his head at you, almost coy.

"I thank you, $titlePL. For your help."
entries.zh:
他转过头看你，神情近乎羞怯。

"我谢谢你，$titlePL。谢谢你的帮助。"

entries.en:
He turns his head at you, almost coy.

"We must all contend with how events played out. You in your way, me in mine. It is, after all, my duty."

Siyavong folds his hands together and re-affirms his ironic half-smile like the lowering of a blast-shield.
entries.zh:
他转过头看你，神情近乎羞怯。

"我们都得面对事情最终的走向。你以你的方式，我以我的。毕竟，这是我的职责。"

Siyavong 十指交叠，重新挂上那抹带着讥诮的半笑，仿佛降下一道防爆闸门。

entries.en:
"Achilles Andrada reigns as Demarchon of the Sindrian Diktat."

Siyavong taps his desk. And you see his half-smile appear.

"Victories which are too great can turn into dangerous things, you know. Sometimes it is best if success is... moderate."
entries.zh:
"Achilles Andrada 以辛达强权统领的身份掌权。"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。你看到他那抹半笑浮了上来。

"你要知道，太大的胜利是会变成危险东西的。有时候，成功...适度一些反而最好。"

entries.en:
"Achilles Andrada reigns as Supreme Executor."

"And he's slipped from... Gens influence, shall we say. But at least it was not, as many are also now saying, a 'great' victory."

Siyavong taps his desk.

"Great victories can be a dangerous thing, you know. Sometimes it is best for most of us to avoid too many of them. Accounting for context, of course."
entries.zh:
"Achilles Andrada 以最高元首的身份掌权。"

"而且他已经摆脱了...氏族的操控，姑且这么说吧。但至少，那并不是如今许多人也在说的那种'伟大'胜利。"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。

"你要知道，伟大的胜利可能是危险的东西。有时候，对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利少一些反而最好。当然，这要视情况而定。"

entries.en:
"Achilles Andrada reigns as Supreme Executor after a great victory."

Siyavong taps his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for... for the rest of us if there are not too many of them."

His half-smile does not re-appear.
entries.zh:
"Achilles Andrada 在一场伟大胜利之后以最高元首的身份掌权。"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对...对我们其余人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好。"

他那抹半笑没有再出现。

entries.en:
"The end of the Sindrian Diktat," he says, and looks at you as if that's statement enough. "It was no great victory for anyone. Though perhaps the Hegemony is pleased to make example of 'their' mutiny?"

Siyavong taps his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for most of us if there are not too many of them," a flicker of a smile regrows, "with context accounted for, of course."
entries.zh:
"辛达强权的终结，\"他说，看着你，仿佛这名字就已经说明了一切。\"那对谁都不是什么伟大的胜利。不过也许霸主倒乐意拿'他们的'那场叛乱来做个榜样？"

Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好，\"一丝笑意重新泛起，\"当然，这要把具体情况算进去。"

entries.en:
"Hector Andrada," he says, and looks at you as if that's statement enough. He's tapping his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for... for most of us if there are not too many of them. The results, you see; well..."

His half-smile does not re-appear.
entries.zh:
"Hector Andrada，"他说，看着你，仿佛这名字就已经说明了一切。他敲着书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对...对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好。你看那些后果；唉..."

他那抹半笑没有再出现。

entries.en:
"Hector Andrada," he says, and looks at you as if that's statement enough.

"But it was not, as many are now saying, a great victory." He emphasizes that word, 'great'. Siyavong taps his desk. A nervous tic?

"Great victories can be dangerous. Sometimes it is best for most of us if there are not too many of them," a flicker of smile regrows, "with context accounted for, of course."
entries.zh:
"Hector Andrada，"他说，看着你，仿佛这名字就已经说明了一切。

"但那并不是——如今许多人正这么说——一场伟大的胜利。"他把'伟大'这个词咬得很重。Siyavong 敲了敲书桌。是紧张的怪癖吗？

"伟大的胜利可能很危险。有时候，对我们大多数人来说，这类胜利不要太多才好，\"一丝笑意重新泛起，\"当然，这要把具体情况算进去。"

entries.en:
He proceeds immediately into a rant.

"It was a fool who provided a planet-killer to the Sindrian Diktat," Siyavong says forcefully. "Not a monster, I think. Merely a credits-hungry fool. Or worse, a believer."

He looks away. There is more anger in his voice than you've ever heard before - something well beyond the uptight annoyance you might expect, what with his educated Kazeronian accent.

"I would hate to think it was a believer."

An awkward silence extends.
entries.zh:
他立刻发作起来。

"把行星杀手交给辛达强权的，是个蠢货，\"Siyavong 语气强硬地说。\"我想不是恶棍。只是个见钱眼开的蠢货。或者更糟——一个信徒。"

他移开视线。他声音里的怒气，比你以往听过的都要重——远不止他那口受过良好教育的 Kazeron 腔调本该带来的那种拘谨的烦躁。

"我真不愿去想那是个信徒。"

尴尬的沉默漫延开来。

entries.en:
Your shuttle drops to the primary landing pad of the Shrine of Volturn, a humble thing that cycled work crews and deliveries in cycles past.

The structure is not unscarred by the rough transition of this world from under the boot of the Sindrian Diktat. New repairs are few.

A squad of Knights of Ludd now guard this place, and their leader steps forward, examining you somberly. His expression is severe, yet ready - a battle-hardened warrior, clearly.

He is gruffly polite and you are allowed past.
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机降落在 Volturn 圣地的主停机坪上 —— 这处朴素的所在，往年轮转着接送工班与补给。

这颗星球从辛达强权的铁蹄下艰难易主，建筑上难免留了些伤痕。新修补的地方却不多。

如今一队卢德骑士团守卫着此地，领队上前，神色凝重地打量你。他神情严峻，却蓄势待发 —— 一望便知是久经沙场的战士。

他礼数粗简，却也客气，放你通行。

entries.en:
The antechamber is lined with patchwork repairs, the walls a hand-built mosaic of corroded metal, ceramic, and plastic.

After a moment you recognize that it is a mural executed in a palette of rust and ruin, a crudely rendered scene of nature - and there, Ludd, an ambigious figure suggested by a ragged silhouette.

It smells still of salt and smoke, but handweave carpeting softens the receiving hall.

A minor subcurate greets you with an offer of the briny tea of Volturn.
entries.zh:
前厅四壁打满补丁，是用锈蚀的金属、陶瓷与塑料手工拼成的一幅镶嵌画。

片刻之后你才认出，那是一幅以锈色与残败为调子绘成的壁画，拙朴地描着一处自然景致 —— 而那儿，是卢德，一个由参差剪影勾出的、模棱两可的身影。

空气里依旧是盐味与烟味，但手工织就的地毯让接待大厅柔和了些。

一名低位副助祭上前相迎，奉上一杯 Volturn 的咸茶。

entries.en:
You are led through the shrine, humbly rebuilt in much the same form - and there, the enormous, ragged hole still opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads.

Swarms and schools of small candles gather and flicker along the ragged portal. Prayers and memories of the lost.
entries.zh:
有人领你穿过圣地，它照着原样谦朴地重建过 —— 而那儿，那个巨大、边缘参差的窟窿依旧朝着底下幽暗的海敞开。你能听见浪头拍打外壁舱板的声响。

成群成簇的小蜡烛沿着破口聚拢、摇曳。是给逝者的祷词与追忆。

entries.en:
Simon leads you through the shrine, humbly rebuilt in much the same form - and there, the enormous, ragged hole still opens to the dark sea below. You can hear the waves slap against exterior bulkheads.

Swarms and schools of small candles gather and flicker along the ragged portal. Prayers and memories of the lost.

Their flames outnumber the visitors who pray or whisper quietly; a few may even be off-worlders, judging by their suits and robes bereft of salt-stain.
entries.zh:
Simon 领你穿过圣地，依旧照着原来的样子谦朴地重建过 —— 而那儿，那个巨大的、边缘参差的窟窿依旧朝着底下幽暗的海敞开。你能听见浪头拍打外壁舱板的声响。

成群成簇的小蜡烛沿着破口聚拢、摇曳。是给逝者的祷词与追忆。

烛火比前来祷告或低声絮语的访客还多；从那一尘不染、不见盐渍的衣袍来看，其中几位说不定还是外世界来的。

entries.en:
Dolos Macario, the Spider of Sindria, appears before you. He looks bored.

"Captain, o captain," he greets you, his tone bored. "Not yet." He winks and hits the shut-off.

The crest of the Sindrian Diktat internal security ministry slowly turns.
entries.zh:
Dolos Macario，辛达瑞亚之蛛，出现在你面前。他看起来很无聊。

"舰长啊，舰长。" 他和你打了个招呼，语调透露着无聊，"还不到时候。" 他眨了眨眼，然后按下了切断键。

辛达强权 内部安全部的徽标慢慢地旋转着。

entries.en:
At this you receive a searching look. Whether he is determining your meaning, or processing his own reaction...

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
这话换来一道探询的目光。他是在掂量你的意思，还是在消化自己的反应...

通讯中断。

entries.en:
Siyavong looks away with a sigh.

"What I want is to ensure the safety and security of the Persean League, $titlePL, and the benefits that happy situation would confer upon the Persean Sector entire."

"Contingency and circumstance willing, it will require... vigilance. The specifics of which need not concern you at this moment."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 叹了口气，移开目光。

"我所求的，是确保英仙座联盟的安全与安稳，$titlePL，以及这一可喜局面将为整个英仙座星域带来的好处。"

"若时势与机缘允许，这需要...警惕。具体细节此刻不必劳你费心。"

o.en: Arroyo is Tri-Tachyon - could he decrypt Macario's files?
o.zh: Arroyo 是速子科技的人 —— 他能破解 Macario 的文件吗？

o.en: Inesis is Tri-Tachyon - could he decrypt Macario's files?
o.zh: Inesis 是速子科技的人 —— 他能破解 Macario 的文件吗？
