entries.en: "They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I prefer not to act prematurely."
entries.zh: "它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我宁可不要过早行动。"

entries.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I can only assume you've coordinated some response with Fortuna Kato."

"I shan't trouble you for details," he finishes coolly. "I can contact Gens Kato myself."
entries.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我只能猜想，你已经和 Fortuna Kato 协调过某种应对了。"

"细节我就不烦你说了。\"他冷冷地收尾，\"我自己可以联系 Kato 氏族。"

entries.en:
"They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I prefer not to act prematurely."

"We must," he gives you a look of emphasis, "speak again when it is clear that events are beginning to culminate. Contact me then."
entries.zh:
"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我宁可不要过早行动。"

"我们得——\"他意味深长地看了你一眼，\"等事态明显开始走向高潮时再谈一次。到时候联系我。"

"I shan't trouble you for details," he finishes coolly. "I can contact the office of the Reynard Hannan myself."

"它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我只能猜想，你已经和大统领协调过某种应对了。"

"细节我就不烦你说了。\"他冷冷地收尾，\"我自己可以联系 Reynard Hannan 的办公室。"

entries.en: "They're quite concerning, it's true." he says. "I shan't act prematurely. It is, you understand, a delicate situation and it would be a mistake to expose my Gens to some scandal or crisis."
entries.zh: "它们确实很令人担忧。\"他说，\"我不会过早行动。你要明白，这是个微妙的局面，把我的氏族卷进什么丑闻或危机里，是犯不上的错。"

entries.en:
"I need to procure a quantity of $proCom_commodityName."
OR
"I require delivery of a cargo of $proCom_commodityName."
OR
"I need a shipment of $proCom_commodityName."
entries.zh:
"我急需一大批 $proCom_commodityName。"
OR
"我需要交付一批 $proCom_commodityName。"
OR
"我需要一批 $proCom_commodityName。"

entries.en: "I have judged it prudent to maintain a modest stockpile of $proCom_commodityName. Perhaps I could pay you to facilitate the acquisition?"
entries.zh: "迫于家族的原因，我必须买一批 $proCom_commodityName 来展示我的 '主动性'。或许... 我可以给你点 '好处' 来帮我摆脱这个小麻烦。"

entries.en: A handful of commodity traders downing caffeine-spiked drinks seems to be giving a $proCom_manOrWoman some disappointing news.
entries.zh: 几个供货经销商闷头猛灌掺了烈酒的咖啡，看起来是正在给一个$proCom_manOrWoman报告一些令人失望的消息。

entries.en: A pack of seedy-looking traders passing around a narco-stick seem to give a $proCom_manOrWoman disappointing news.
entries.zh: 一群看来就不像做正经买卖的商人正共着抽一根麻醉烟，看起来是正在给一个$proCom_manOrWoman报告一些令人失望的消息。

entries.en:
"Thank you, this cargo of $proCom_commodityName is more important than you might think."
OR
"I knew we could count on you. Thank you for the shipment."
OR
"Good work, you've really saved us a lot of trouble."
OR
"This was handled perfectly, captain. I'll be sure to put in a good word for you."
entries.zh:
"非常感谢，这批 $proCom_commodityName 的重要程度比你想象的大多了。"
OR
"我就知道你非常可靠，多谢了你的护送。"
OR
"干得漂亮，你一下子就帮我们解决了好多麻烦。"
OR
"这件事处理得很好，舰长。我有机会一定会为你说句好话。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe nods, "The boss will be pleased."
OR
"Good. Very good," $heOrShe looks more relieved than the situation calls for. "You have no idea how important this was."
OR
"Okay, it's done." $HeOrShe seems to key in some kind of confirmation on an off-brand datapad, then looks back up at you. "This never happened."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe点了点头，说："我的老板一定很高兴吧。"
OR
"好，非常好！" $HeOrShe之前看起来有多紧迫现在就有多放松，"你不知道这东西有多重要。"
OR
"好极了，完成了。" $HeOrShe似乎在一个杂牌数据平板上输入了某种确认信息，然后回头看你，"就当这事从未发生过。"

entries.en: "Ah, you must be $playerName. We've been expecting you." $personName reads a datapad, "And I believe- yes, it says here you're delivering $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName. Is that correct?"
entries.zh: "啊，你一定是 $playerName 阁下，我们已经等候多时了。" $personName 看了看数据平板，"我相信...哦不，你已经把 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName 带来了，对吧？"

entries.en:
"Yes, hello." $HeOrShe appears to be busy browsing a shipping manifest on an adjacent display, "I'm expecting a cargo of $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName. To be paid for," $hisOrHer eyes turn to you. "Upon delivery. In full."
OR
"I'm expecting a delivery of $proCom_commodityName, $proCom_quantity units, exact." $HeOrShe idly reads from a datapad. "That's the deal."
entries.zh:
"是的...你好啊。" $HeOrShe似乎正忙于浏览显示器上的货运清单，"我希望有 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName 送到我这里。付款方式是..." $HeOrShe把目光转向了你，"交货时全额付清。"
OR
"我希望有一批 $proCom_commodityName 送到我这里，确切数量是 $proCom_quantity 单位。" $HeOrShe漫不经心的看了看数据平板上的内容，"不接受讲价。"

entries.en:
"You're here to deliver $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName? This manifest says you can't fulfill the shipment."

$HeOrShe drops the datapad to $hisOrHer desk with, you sense, more force than necessary.

"So why are you here?" $heOrShe asks.
OR
"I'm expecting a cargo of exactly $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName." $HeOrShe says, reading from a datapad. "Delivery in full." $HeOrShe looks up, finally, "That's the deal."
entries.zh:
"你是来送货的对吧，物品是 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName 对吧？但这份货运清单显示你不能完成这个任务。"

$HeOrShe把$HeOrShe的数据平板拍在了桌面上，根据你的目测，这个力度明显不是必要的。

"所以...是什么风把你吹来了？" $heOrShe问道。
OR
"我需要 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName，一个不少。" $HeOrShe边浏览数据平板边说，"全额交付。" $HeOrShe最终抬起头看着你，"这是约定好的。"

entries.en:
$personName looks you over nervously. "You have the goods. And they're ready to be offloaded - as agreed, $proCom_quantity units at $proCom_pricePerUnit per?"
OR
$personName eyes you suspiciously, "You're $playerName? I thought you'd look different." $HisOrHer eyes flick over to a secondary display, "It says here you've got the cargo, all $proCom_quantity units. We'll go ahead with the agreed $proCom_pricePerUnit per unit. I'll provide you with a drop-off point."
entries.zh:
$personName 紧张兮兮地看着你。"货拿来了，他们也已经准备好卸货了...按照协议...一共是 $proCom_quantity 单位，价格是 $proCom_pricePerUnit 星币每单位？"
OR
$personName 惊喜地看着你。"你是 $playerName？简直和照片上的一模一样。" $HeOrShe的目光转向了第二个显示器，"这边显示你有一批货物，共计 $proCom_quantity 单位。我们将继续执行协议，价格是 $proCom_pricePerUnit 星币每单位。我稍后会给你提供卸货地点。"

o.en: Talk to the $proCom_manOrWoman who looks disappointed by the commodity traders
o.zh: 与那位对日用品经销商表示失望的$proCom_manOrWoman交谈

o.en: Talk to the $proCom_manOrWoman who looks disappointed by the seedy-looking traders
o.zh: 与那位对不正经的经销商表示失望的$proCom_manOrWoman交谈

entries.en: "Oh, captain," the pirate $personRank looks almost apologetic. "It's about the $proCom_commodityName procurement you've taken on. A minor matter," $heOrShe waggles a hand as if it's not quite important enough to explain, but $heOrShe will indulge you, "But there is a competitor who hired me to send a message about the risks of doing business with that particular individual."
entries.zh: "噢，舰长阁下。" 海盗 $personRank 的态度看起来几乎带着歉意，"这是关于您已采购的 $proCom_commodityName 的一件事。" $heOrShe甩了甩手，好像这件事没有解释的必要，但$heOrShe考虑到你的木鱼脑袋，还是进行了解释，"您有一位竞争对手派我来传达一条信息...是关于和某个人做生意的风险的。"

o.en: This isn't personal? That's a relief.
o.zh: 原来不是私人恩怨吗？这可真是令人 '欣慰'。

entries.en: "I require $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName delivered here as soon as possible. It's a rush job so I'll pay over market value, $proCom_pricePerUnit per unit."
entries.zh: "我急需 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName，越快越好。当然，这是加急订单，我会以 $proCom_pricePerUnit 星币每单位的价格进行支付。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks up with a flicker of hope as you approach, "You're a starship captain, right?"

$HeOrShe sighs, and taps at a TriPad, "I need to get $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName delivered here as soon as possible. It's very important. I'll even pay above market rates, $proCom_pricePerUnit credits per unit. Is this something you could do?"
OR
$HeOrShe looks up from $hisOrHer TriPad, brow creased. "Perhaps you can help. Your $shipOrFleet just arrived, did it not?" $HeOrShe holds up a hand, "Hear me out, it'll just be a moment. I need $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName as soon as possible, and I'll pay above market price, $proCom_pricePerUnit credits per unit. Are you interested?"
OR
$HeOrShe interrupts your attempt at a greeting with a quick wave, "I'm sorry, captain, is it? I don't mean to be abrupt, but I really need to secure a delivery of $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName as soon as possible."

$HeOrShe hesitates, sighs, then says "I'm willing to pay above market value, $proCom_pricePerUnit per unit. If you're interested."
entries.zh:
当你靠近的时候，$HeOrShe带着一丝希望抬起头，说："你是一名星舰舰长，对吧？"

$HeOrShe叹了口气，然后点了几下 TriPad，说，"我需要 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName，越快越好。这可是非常的重要，我愿意提供一个超过市场价的价格，也就是每单位 $proCom_pricePerUnit 星币。你一定能做些什么，对吧？"
OR
$HeOrShe皱着眉头，把目光从 TriPad 上移开。"或许你能帮帮我，你的$shipOrFleet是不是刚到？" $HeOrShe举起一只手，说道，"这只要占用你一丁点儿时间，请听我说完。我需要 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName，越快越好，我会支付每单位 $proCom_pricePerUnit 星币。远高于市场价，如何？"
OR
$HeOrShe快速挥手打断了你的招呼，"舰长，非常抱歉，我也不是故意的，但我真的非常需要 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName，越快越好。"

$HeOrShe犹豫了一下，叹了口气，说道，"我愿意出价 $proCom_pricePerUnit 星币每单位，远超市场均价，你觉得如何？"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe brushes off $hisOrHer coat, muttering "They don't know who they've-" then smiles suddenly as you approach.

"Finally, someone reasonable." $HeOrShe pulls you aside as if you're old business partners, and says quietly "I'm looking for $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName. Delivered here, as soon as possible, don't care how it gets done so long as it gets done, understand? I'm willing to pay $proCom_pricePerUnit per unit, isn't that generous? It's because I respect what you're capable of."

$HeOrShe rolls $hisOrHer eyes at the group nearby, shrugging with one shoulder "Some people, they have no respect. They'll learn. What do you say?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe轻轻脱下$HeOrShe的外套，小声咕哝着："他们对自己的身份和能力一点逼数都没有..." 在你走近时，$HeOrShe突然露出一丝微笑。

"可算有个通情达理的人了。" $HeOrShe把你拉到一边，仿佛你是$HeOrShe的老朋友，然后悄悄地说，"我需要 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName，越快越好。我不在乎这些货是怎么到达这里的，只要能交货就行。我欣赏你的能力，一口价每单位 $proCom_pricePerUnit 星币的价格，如何？"

$HeOrShe向附近的人群翻了翻$HeOrShe的眼睛，耸了耸一边的肩膀，说道："不守礼，无以立，有些人就是学不会，你说呢？"

entries.en:
"I need $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName delivered right here as soon as possible. I don't care where it comes from or how it gets done, so long as it gets here."

"Because I appreciate your... efficiency, let's call it, I'm willing to pay you a generous $proCom_pricePerUnit per unit. Agreed?"
entries.zh:
"我急需 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName，越快越好。我不在乎它们是从哪里来的，是怎么来的，反正交到我手里就完事了。"

"我很欣赏你的...效率？暂且这么称呼吧。所以，我愿意以 $proCom_pricePerUnit 星币每单位的价格进行支付，如何？"

entries.en:
"I need $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName delivered to $proCom_marketName - that's $proCom_dist light-years away. Due to the importance of this shipment, I'll ensure that you're paid $proCom_pricePerUnit per unit, which makes for a total of $proCom_totalPrice credits."

"$proCom_PersonPost $proCom_personName will receive the shipment from you $proCom_marketOnOrAt $proCom_marketName and deliver payment upon completion."
entries.zh:
"我需要将 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName 送到 $proCom_marketName，距离这里大概有 $proCom_dist 光年。介于这批货物十分重要，我保证每单位会支付你 $proCom_pricePerUnit 星币，共计 $proCom_totalPrice 星币。"

"在 $proCom_marketName 完成交货，$proCom_PersonPost 的 $proCom_personName 会在订单完成后进行付款。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks up with a flicker of hope as you approach, "You're a starship captain, right?"

$HeOrShe taps at a TriPad, "I need $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName delivered to $proCom_marketName, $proCom_dist light-years away. You'd be paid above market rates, $proCom_pricePerUnit per unit for $proCom_totalPrice total on delivery to $proCom_personPost $proCom_personName. Are you interested?"
entries.zh:
当你靠近的时候，$HeOrShe带着一丝希望抬起头，说："你是一艘星舰的舰长，对吧？"

$HeOrShe在TriPad点了几下，"我需要 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName，送到 $proCom_dist 光年外的 $proCom_marketName。你会得到应有的报酬，我每单位出价 $proCom_pricePerUnit 星币，总计 $proCom_totalPrice 星币，高于市场价。你的交接人是 $proCom_personName $proCom_personPost。阁下是否有合作意向？"

entries.en:
You approach the $manOrWoman as $heOrShe glares icily, muttering "-big mistake," then turns to you with a cool smile. "Ah, captain." $HisOrHer eye twitches, the tell of a black market ocular implant, "Your $shipOrFleet just arrived, yes? Let's talk."

$HeOrShe raises two fingers at the bartender, "I need $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName delivered to $proCom_marketName. $proCom_dist light-years away. I won't ask or answer any questions. It's full payment above market rate- $proCom_pricePerUnit per unit, for $proCom_totalPrice total on delivery to the contact,  $proCom_personName. They'll pay. And don't mention my name."

$HisOrHer cool smile returns just as the bartender arrives with two small, potent drinks. "Do we have a deal?"
entries.zh:
你走近那个怒目而视的$manOrWoman，$heOrShe喃喃地说，"大错特错啊..." 然后转过头来朝你冷冷地笑了笑。"啊，舰长。" $HeOrShe的眼睛不停抽搐...只有黑市出售的义眼才会有这种情况..."你的$shipOrFleet好像刚刚靠港？来谈一桩生意吧。"

$HeOrShe一边向酒保举起两根手指示意，一边说道："我需要你将 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName，送往 $proCom_dist 光年之外的 $proCom_marketName。我不会问或回答任何问题。每单位 $proCom_pricePerUnit 星币，远超市场价，总计 $proCom_totalPrice 星币。交货给 $proCom_personName 来获取报酬，且不要提起我的名字。"

当酒保带着两杯烈酒走过来的时候，$HeOrShe的冷笑回到了脸上。"怎么样？成交吗？"

entries.en:
"I need $proCom_quantity units of $proCom_commodityName delivered to $proCom_marketName - that's $proCom_dist light-years away. I don't care who you have to shoot to make it happen so long as it gets there."

"Call it $proCom_pricePerUnit per unit. That makes $proCom_totalPrice total, because I know that you'll do what it takes to get it done. You'll need to talk to my, ah, associate, $proCom_personPost $proCom_personName to make the delivery and receive payment. And there's no need to mention my name."
entries.zh:
"我需要将 $proCom_quantity 单位的 $proCom_commodityName 送到 $proCom_marketName，距离这里大概有 $proCom_dist 光年。我不在乎你要如何完成这个任务，只要完成就行...哪怕 '做掉' 某些人。"

"我给出的价格是每单位 $proCom_pricePerUnit 星币，总计 $proCom_totalPrice 星币，因为我知道你会尽你所能。你可以去找我的...呃...助手吧，$proCom_personPost $proCom_personName 进行交货和收款，不必提及我的名字。"

entries.en:
"The local pirates have been getting out of hand and it's cutting into profits. We're willing to offer special incentives if you could hunt some down."
OR
"There's been an increase in local pirate activity and I'm unsatisfied with the official response. I've decided to offer a special bounty to trusted individuals who can assist with this problem."
OR
"The pirates have established a base nearby and their raids are simply bad for business. I could extend special bounty terms if you help us contain them."
entries.zh:
"当地的海盗活动猖獗，严重影响了商业活动的利润。如果你能干掉一些，我们愿意提供奖励。"
OR
"当地海盗活动有所增加，我对官方的无所作为十分不满。我决定向那些值得信赖的人提供一笔赏金，只要他们能帮助解决这个问题。"
OR
"海盗在附近建立了一个基地，他们的袭击对生意很不利。如果你帮我们处理他们，我可以支付赏金。"

entries.en: A $psb_manOrWoman is motioning to a news feed, haranguing an officer in the local navy patrol uniform about the increased pirate raids.
entries.zh: 一个$psb_manOrWoman对着新闻直播指指点点，向一名身穿当地巡逻队制服的军官就海盗袭击增加的事滔滔不绝。

o.en: Ask about the special pirate fleet bounty
o.zh: 问问关于海盗舰队的特别赏金

o.en: Talk to the $psb_manOrWoman haranguing the official about the increased pirate raids
o.zh: 和那个滔滔不绝的$psb_manOrWoman谈谈

entries.en:
You catch the attention of the $psb_manOrWoman so angered by pirate activity- a notable figure in intra-system commerce, a simple $personRank, $heOrShe explains, who is "-disappointed by the lack of decisive action. It makes one think these patrols are more interested in tariff-enforcement than fighting pirates!"

You nod and put on an appearance of shared concern as the rant winds down, the $manOrWoman's attention fully focused on you now.

The patrol officer gives you a thankful look and, taking their drink, scurries toward a quiet end of the bar.
entries.zh:
你吸引了被猖獗的海盗活动激怒的$psb_manOrWoman的注意 —— 那是星系内商贸的大人物，$heOrShe则自称是个小小的 $personRank，只是对 "让人觉得巡逻队相较于海盗作战更热衷于收税" 的官方的不作为而感到十分失望。

你一边听对方的滔滔不绝，一边点头并表现出关切的神色，这$manOrWoman的注意力就完全转移到你身上了。

巡逻队的军官感激地看了你一眼，拿起了自己的酒，快步走向酒吧僻静的角落里。

entries.en:
"You're a starship captain, yes? I'll tell you what we've been thinking," $personName says, sitting you down.

"Along with a few concerned associates, I've put together a fund for a bounty on all pirate fleets in or near the $psb_systemName, $psb_dist light-years away. It'd start at $psb_baseBounty credits per frigate with more payout for larger hulls. Running this bounty for $psb_days days should send a strong message to these pirates, and," $heOrShe tries to see where the patrol officer went, speaking louder, "-Teach those tariff-grabbers how to deal with pirates!"

"What do you say, captain?"
entries.zh:
"你是个星舰舰长，对吧？我来告诉你我在想什么。" $personName 说着，示意你坐下。

"我和几个关心此事的同行一起筹集了一笔资金，对 $psb_dist 光年之外 $psb_systemName 里和 附近的海盗发起悬赏。赏金为每艘护卫舰 $psb_baseBounty 星币，摧毁更大的舰船将获得更多奖金。这持续 $psb_days 天的赏金应该能给海盗足够有力的警告，并且..." $heOrShe四处张望，似乎要找出巡逻队员去了哪，大声嚷嚷道，"—— 还能指点指点那些关税掠夺者如何对付海盗！"

"你怎么看，舰长？"

entries.en:
"The terms are this," $heOrShe says, "A bounty shall be paid for destruction of pirate fleets in or near $psb_systemName, $psb_dist light-years away. The base rate is $psb_baseBounty credits per frigate destroyed or disabled, on an increasing scale for larger hulls - please review addendum A in the terms I've forwarded. The period of the bounty shall last for $psb_days days."

$HeOrShe pauses, some dark emotion crossing $hisOrHer face before $heOrShe re-asserts the usual professional bearing, "I would be pleased to see you stamp them out, captain."
entries.zh:
"条款是这样的，" $heOrShe说，"在 $psb_dist 光年外的 $psb_systemName 摧毁海盗舰船将能得到奖金。每摧毁或停机一艘护卫舰就有 $psb_baseBounty 星币，击毁更大的船体将提供更多奖金 —— 请查阅我转发的附录 A。赏金将会持续 $psb_days 天。"

$HeOrShe停顿了片刻，脸上掠过一丝阴沉，然后重新摆出了平常的职业姿态："我会很乐意看到你把他们消灭，舰长。"

entries.en:
Further scans reveal that the energy field is not entirely uniform - perhaps owing to a running-down power source - and your bridge crew is able to pick up a distress beacon transmitting from the surface.

The transmission is set on repeat and garbled in ways that are indicative of aging equipment. You make out enough to gather that part of a research team was stranded here - at a secret Tri-Tachyon research facility - after the fully automated defenses over-weighed certain executive security contingency orders in the wake of one of the AI Wars and decided it was now imperative to shoot down any craft attempting to leave the planet.
entries.zh:
进一步的扫描显示，能量场并不均一完整，可能是由于能量源已经年久失修。同时你的舰桥人员设法发现了一个从星球表面发出讯号的遇险信标。

该讯号被设定不断重播，且因为设备老化而产生了乱码。你从其中可以解读的信息推断，这里是 速子 的机密研究机构。在某一次 AI 战争期间，自动化防御系统对某条紧急安全命令采取了过激的响应，决定击毁任何试图离开这个星球的飞船，导致一支研究小组的部分成员被滞留在了这里。

o.en: Send a salvage team down to the facility
o.zh: 派遣打捞小组前往研究机构

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet finishes its approach to $entityName without further incident.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet成功抵近了$entityName，再未发生任何变故。

entries.en: As your $shipOrFleet moves in closer, sensors detect multiple contacts rising up from the murky red depths.
entries.zh: 当你的$shipOrFleet靠近时，传感器检测到有多个接触信号出现在了正下方，犹如从浑浊的红色深海之中浮出。

entries.en: A tiny shuttle with a jury-rigged shield generator darts through a spot failure in the shield. A landing at the primary control center is achieved without incident and the crew is able to deactivate the shield entirely upon breaching the facility. Follow-up shuttles with heavier equipment launch quickly thereafter, and soon the salvage operation is in full swing.
entries.zh: 你派出一艘临时加装了护盾发生器的穿梭机，让它突入了护盾的一处破损点。穿梭机在主控制中心顺利着陆，机组人员成功突入设施，将护盾完全解除。随后，携带重型设备的后援穿梭机迅速跟进，开始全面展开打捞作业。

o.zh: 在打捞物中挑选战利品

entries.en:
You initiate the credits transfer and receive the coordinates in response. "Nice knowing you."

$personName doesn't give you time to respond before ending the transmission.
entries.zh:
你进行了星币转账，并收到了需要的坐标。"很高兴认识你。"

$personName 在你反应过来之前就切断了通讯。

entries.en:
You haggle with $himOrHer over price, making the point that there is - allegedly - some hostile force at this red planet, and further, $heOrShe has already sold the information to someone else. "Yes, yes," $heOrShe says, "But I know you space-captains. You just love a mystery. You'll never let it lie. Like we should have."

Eventually you work out a figure of $psi_credits for the pilot's information.
entries.zh:
你开始向$heOrShe杀价，指出红色行星那边已经有敌对势力守着 —— 至少据说如此，还有$heOrShe应该已经把这情报卖给过其他人了。"没错，没错..." $heOrShe接口到，"但我可很了解你们这些太空舰长是什么人，你们就是喜欢这种神秘的东西，不是吗？你和我都懂，你瞒不住这种兴趣的。"

最终飞行员拿那份情报对你开价 $psi_credits。

o.en: Pay $psi_credits for the location of the mysterious red planet
o.zh: 支付 $psi_credits 来获取神秘红色行星的具体位置

entries.en:
$personName looks you over. You look back, and even via the comms it looks like $personFirstName has had higher-quality repair work done than their spacer crew comrade. $HeOrShe almost looks natural. "So," $heOrShe says, "You know the story." $HeOrShe sighs, and says aside "If only that old crust of a spacer would keep their mouth shut... "

"Still, it's no sweat off my back where you go finding trouble. And you wouldn't be the first who's come sniffing after me, I'll warn you of that for free. How much is the location of this planet worth to you?"
entries.zh:
$personName 用目光上下打量着你。你也打量了回去，发现即使隔着通讯视频，也能看出 $personFirstName 接受过的 "修复" 明显比其他太空船员同僚要更高档。"所以，" $heOrShe一副不出所料的样子说到，"你听过那个故事了。" $HeOrShe叹了一口气，扭头骂了一句，"如果那个老不死的能闭嘴就好了..."

"不过，你想去哪儿找麻烦，这不关我鸟事。还有你也不是第一个听到传言找上我的家伙。前面这些警告就当我免费告诉你的好了，告诉我，你觉得这颗行星的位置信息对你来说该值多少？"

o.en: Barter with $personName then consider the price
Forget it. Cut the comm link
o.zh: 当我没问。 切断通讯链接

entries.en: "So. You're back. Ready to talk credits?"
entries.zh: "哦，你又来了，准备好谈价钱了？"

o.en: Barter with $personName, then consider the price
Forget it. Cut the comm link
o.zh: 当我没问。 切断通讯链接

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.

The sensors are having difficulty evaluating the tenuous megastructure enveloping its entire surface. Your sensors officer takes the initiative and applies some exotic parameters to the interferometer feed; inputs go green and a few seconds later the sub-AI tentatively identifies a stable planetary-scale energy field with highly unusual properties.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。

传感器难以对笼罩整个地表的薄层巨型结构进行评估。你的传感器技官主动提议，可以给干涉分析仪输入一些不常用的参数设定。在参数被接受的绿灯亮起了数秒之后，次级 AI 便初步分析认定这是一种行星规模的稳定能量场，且具有一些很罕见的特性。

entries.en:
The pirate snorts and crosses $hisOrHer arms. "Listening."

You pull up the report prepared by your quartermaster and begin reading the executive summary, taking care to enunciate the large numbers describing the credits moving through your properties.

It takes little to inflame the pirate's greed. You pause dramatically and look over your TriPad; $personName licks $hisOrHer lips and says "You have yourself a deal."
entries.zh:
海盗哼了一声，双手抱胸说道。"我在听。"

你拿出了你军需官准备的报告，开始阅读简报部分。你格外注重强调了领地里流通的大笔星币。

点燃海盗的贪欲一点都不难。你戏剧化地做了个停顿，越过你的 TriPad 看向对方； $personName 舔了下$hisOrHer的嘴唇说到。"就按你说的来吧。"

o.zh: 我就知道你会讲道理的。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe goes still. "I, I think we understand one another, $playerName."

"My raiders will be hunting you. Don't bore them, now." The $post makes a toothy and joyless grimace.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe一动不动。"我，我想我们都明白彼此的意愿了，$playerName。"

"我的劫掠者们会开始狩猎你，别让他们觉得太无聊。" $post 露牙做出一个毫无笑意的冷笑。

entries.en:
"Wisely done, captain." $HeOrShe tries to conceal $hisOrHer relief. "Why fight when our arrangement means we can each spend more time enjoying the better things in life?"

$HeOrShe flicks a grubby bottle of something stashed beside the comms console, making a distinct 'ting' sound.
entries.zh:
"英明的决策，舰长。" $HeOrShe试图隐藏$hisOrHer那松了口气的样子。"我们的交易能让咱俩都花更多时间享受生活，还打什么仗？"

$HeOrShe弹了下在通讯台旁边一个脏兮兮瓶子，发出了 '叮' 的一声。

entries.en:
"Oh!" $HeOrShe actually jumps a bit with the shock of your pronouncement, but quickly tries to play it cool. "More's the pity. This'll be a black mark on my otherwise perfect day. But," $heOrShe shrugs, "I get it. Gotta look out for number one. If you don't, you look like easy prey."

$HeOrShe thumps $hisOrHer chest, almost managing to hide the tremble in $hisOrHer hands. "Point made, message received. Now, will you reconsider?"
entries.zh:
"哦！" $HeOrShe被你的宣言惊的跳了起来，但很快便强装冷静下来。"那还真是可惜。本来完美的一天就被染上这么一笔，但。" $heOrShe耸耸肩，"我懂得。都得先把自己放第一，不然会让自己看上去是肥羊。"

$HeOrShe拍了拍$hisOrHer的胸口，看上去几乎是为了隐藏$hisOrHer颤抖的双手。"你的意思我明白了，消息收到了。现在，不再重新考虑下吗？"

o.en: It's over. Don't make me repeat myself.
o.zh: 结束了。别让我再说一遍。

o.en: Okay, let's keep the protection deal.
o.zh: 好吧，那就保留这个保护协议。

o.en: Our agreement no longer suits me.
o.zh: 我们的协议已不再符合我的利益了。

entries.en:
"Comms open to captain of independent $shipOrFleet." The mercenary $rank looks you over in a cold assessment.

"Be advised: stay clear of our operational volume. We are in the process of fulfilling a private contract to destroy the nearby pirate station."

"You may now go," the merc flicks a hand dismissively. "We shall see to the safety of this and nearby systems."
entries.zh:
"与独立$shipOrFleet的舰长建立通讯链接。" 雇佣兵 $rank 冷眼打量着你。

"请注意：远离我们的行动空域。我们正在执行一份私人合同，目标为摧毁附近的海盗基地。"

"你可以走了。" 佣兵甩了甩手，没有把你当回事，"我们会确保这里和附近星系的安全。"

o.en: Cut the comm link and power up weapons
o.zh: 切断通讯链接并将武器充能

entries.en: You dispense with the pleasantries.
entries.zh: 你省去了寒暄话。

entries.en: "Indeed," $heOrShe says. "When necessity calls for force, matters are best left to an expert - such as myself."
entries.zh: "就是。" $heOrShe说到，"如果需要动武，最好还是让我这样的专业人士出马。"

o.en: That may not be a good idea. (talk them out of it)
o.zh: 这可能不是个好主意。 (说服他们放弃)

entries.en:
You explain that this particular group of pirates has had their threat deliberately under-rated by a conspiracy of mercenary companies. Black Quiver, Ilm's Orphans, Panoply Allied, Tactistar; they're all in on it, including the pirates.

Mercenary contracts aren't paying what they used to, you explain, as of course $heOrShe probably knows. They think they can get top-quality work - you indicate $personName's fleet - for prices that barely turn a profit once the fuel, supplies, and crew wages are paid out post-operation. You see $himOrHer nodding along.
entries.zh:
你解释道这群海盗的威胁程度被一帮佣兵组织故意低估了。黑箭袋，Ilm 遗子，披甲联盟，战术之星；他们全都勾结在一起，包括海盗也跟他们一伙。

现在佣兵合同的收入不如以往，这点$heOrShe自然应该知道。雇主认为他们可以拿比燃料补给费加船员工资高不了多少的低价便能请到一流 —— 例如 $personName —— 的舰队。你看到$himOrHer边听边点头。

entries.en:
The problem is that all the competition is driving prices down - and this cartel of mercs decided to cut a deal with some pirates to solve the problem.

It's the perfect trap, really: a stream of under-prepared prey gets fed to the pirates, enhancing their reputation. The supply of mercs taking low-ball contracts is reduced, driving up the prices of the old guard cartel. And, best of all, it's deniable: if the pirates are destroyed, so are the cartel's partners in their conspiracy.
entries.zh:
问题就是同业竞争压低了价位 —— 而这帮勾结在一起的佣兵组织则和海盗达成了交易来解决这一问题。

这真是个完美的陷阱：一连串准备不足的猎物被喂给海盗，让海盗名声远扬。接低价合同的佣兵团因此被灭得越来越少，让这些勾结在一起的老字号能坐地起价。而最好的一点就是这个计划根本无从查证：如果海盗被毁灭了，那这些佣兵在阴谋中的同伙自然也就没了。

o.en: I'm not saying you're under-prepared. Quite the opposite...
o.zh: 我不是说你准备不足，正相反...

entries.en:
"Bring only enough materiel to complete the job," $heOrShe finishes for you. "Otherwise you're burning net profit to bring extra warships not needed for the fight. Yes, I'm a professional and have done the calculations."

The merc pauses for a moment, thinking over what you've said.

"Very clever," $heOrShe says, seeming to regard you more as a comrade now than an interloper. "Naturally this cartel will deny it if confronted. Almost wish I'd thought of the scheme myself," a ruthless grin appears, "But I'll settle for the higher rates resulting from their cull of the herd."

"Thanks for the tip, captain. There's another job on the docket that I liked better anyway."
entries.zh:
"而我带的舰队，只是堪堪满足任务需要，" $heOrShe替你总结道，"不然多余的舰船只会浪费掉可能的收益。是的，我是专业计算过的。"

雇佣兵停了下来，思考着你刚刚所说的话。

"真是精明，" $heOrShe说道，现在佣兵对你的态度更像是对待同志，而不是挑事者了，"自然，这帮人就是被指控也会直接不认账。真有点希望想出这主意的人是我。" $heOrShe露出一个残忍的微笑，"但我就等着他们排除竞争后带来的高价市场吧。"

"多谢提醒，舰长。反正通告上还有个我更喜欢的活儿。"

entries.en: "Oh? Do tell." $HeOrShe looks both offended and just a little bit intrigued. As if $heOrShe wants to see what pathetic excuse you come up with so that $heOrShe may reject it.
entries.zh: "哦？请讲。" $HeOrShe看上去既有些被冒犯，也有些好奇。就好像$heOrShe在拒绝你前想先听听你能找出什么蹩脚的借口。

o.en: That station is my concern only. It is you who shall leave. Now.
o.zh: 这个基地只与我有关。要走的人是你。马上。

entries.en:
"I see," $heOrShe says, scrolling through a display, doing some mental calculation. "I see very well that you shall appeal to brute force of numbers to dissuade me from my contract."

"A crude bargaining tactic, but," $heOrShe slaps away a datapad, presumably containing $hisOrHer tactical officer's report. "Effective nonetheless. Good day, $playerSirOrMadam. I will be sure to keep you in my thoughts."
entries.zh:
"我明白了。" $heOrShe一边滚动着一个显示屏，一边说道，似乎在做某种计算，"我清楚地明白你是打算靠数量强压我，让我放弃合同。"

"粗糙的谈判技巧。" $heOrShe把一个数据平板甩开，里面应该是装有$hisOrHer战术军官的报告，"但确实有效，再见，$playerSirOrMadam。我会记住你的。"

entries.en:
"I will do you the favor of interpreting your words as a joke," $heOrShe says. "And not a very good one."

"I'll waste no more time with you." $HeOrShe nods to someone and the link freezes, the data stream cut without even a termination code.
entries.zh:
"我会给你个面子，就当你在开玩笑。" $heOrShe说道，"而且这玩笑还不太好笑。"

"我不会在你身上浪费更多时间了。" $HeOrShe朝谁点了下头，链接就直接中断了，甚至连个中断码都没有。

entries.en:
The Pather captain looks more than a little surprised that you accepted $hisOrHer terms. $HeOrShe confirms that you have ejected the technology package via a battered datapad, and looks a bit- let down, perhaps. But also relieved.

"Now," $heOrShe intones, "together we pray."

The Pather captain leads you through a classic Luddic prayer, begging forgiveness and doing least-harm to holy Creation. You make a show of mumbling along because it seems to make the Pather happy. $HeOrShe seems content with your effort.
entries.zh:
左径舰长看起来对你接受$HeOrShe的条件颇为惊讶，$HeOrShe在破旧的数据平板上确认你已经将技术包裹弹出 —— 也许有点失望，但同时也松了一口气。

"现在，" $HeOrShe沉吟道，"我们一起祈祷。"

左径舰长带领你做了一个经典的卢德式祷告，乞求宽恕并对神圣造物主做最小的侵犯。你要装模做样跟着喃喃自语，因为这似乎能让那个左径分子高兴。而$HeOrShe看起来对你的努力也很是满意。

entries.en:
"It is a long path to redemption," the Pather captain tells you, finally, "And this is but the first step in your atonement. Blessings of Ludd be upon you, starfarer."

You cut the comms, roll your eyes, and consider your next move.
entries.zh:
"通向救赎的道途漫长而修远，" 这名左径舰长最终告诉你，"这只不过是你赎清罪孽的第一步。远行者，愿卢德保佑你。"

你切断通讯，翻了个白眼，开始考虑下一步的行动。

entries.en:
You put on a look of grave concern, “$BrotherOrSister, I fear you have misunderstood the situation completely. I walk the Path, as you do, but I?" You lower your voice to a whisper, "In the shadow."

Confusion grows on the Pather's face as $heOrShe tries to process your meaning.

"Remember Mairaath," you growl like a prophet-hermit of Old Earth, your head lowered but not bowed, your eyes burning with holy vengeance. "There are works in motion among the inner circles of our organization that you cannot conceive. You will leave me to my mission, but first-"
entries.zh:
你摆出一副忧心忡忡的样子。" $BrotherOrSister，我担心你完全误解了情况。你我一样都行在卢德之道上，只是我..." 你把声音压低，"走在阴影之中。"

$HeOrShe试图揣测你的意思，这个左径分子逐渐困惑了起来。

"别忘了 Mairaath。" 你就像旧地球的预言家一样咆哮着，你的头前倾，眼里燃烧着神圣的复仇焰火，"接下来是组织内部的秘密工作，你没有权限了解。你必须离开这里防止干扰我的任务，但首先 ——"

entries.en:
You clasp hands together dramatically, and recite as if to the congregation: "I pray for you, $brotherOrSister, to follow my lead on this Path given to us by Holy Ludd."

You lead a classic Luddic prayer without missing a word, then dismiss the Pather captain from the comms-line. After you close the channel, you stop a moment to find your bridge crew looking at you with a combination of awe and confusion.
entries.zh:
你夸张地双手合十，仿佛在向众人吟诵。"我为你祈祷，$brotherOrSister，而在圣卢德赐予我们的这条道路上，请跟随我的脚步。"

你一字不漏地做了一个经典的卢德式祷告，然后成功打发走了左径分子。在你关闭频道之后，你停顿了一会，发现你舰桥上的船员们正用一种敬畏和困惑的眼光看着你。

entries.en:
You clasp hands together dramatically, and recite as if to the congregation: "I pray for you, $brotherOrSister, to follow my lead on this Path given to us by Holy Ludd."

You lead a classic Luddic prayer without missing a word, then dismiss the Pather captain from the comms-line. After you close the channel, you stop a moment to find your bridge crew looking at you with a combination of awe and confusion.
entries.zh:
你夸张地双手合十，仿佛在向众人吟诵。"我为你祈祷，$brotherOrSister，而在圣卢德赐予我们的这条道路上，请跟随我的脚步。"

你一字不漏地做了一个经典的卢德式祷告，然后成功打发走了左径分子。在你关闭频道之后，你停顿了一会，发现你舰桥上的船员们正用一种敬畏和困惑的眼光看着你。

entries.en:
"O, what is this- a servant of Moloch before me?" says the Pather in sing-song cadence, "Repent, repent and eject this daemonic technological horror you carry to do evil in far stars!"

"Yes, we know what you have. And we will destroy it, either in your cargo hold, or in Holy Vacuum. Choose now."
entries.zh:
"噢，这是什么 —— 在我面前的是恶魔摩洛克的仆人吗？"左径分子以歌唱般的节奏说道，"忏悔吧，忏悔吧，驱逐你所携带的恶魔般的恐怖技术，你要用它在遥远的群星上作恶！"

"是的，我们知道你有什么。而我们将摧毁它，要么是在你的货舱里，要么是在神圣的虚空里。抉择吧。"

o.en: Bluff to get rid of the Pather
o.zh: 虚张声势以摆脱左径分子

o.en: Accept, and eject the technology package
o.zh: 接受，并弹出技术制品包裹

entries.en:
The Pirate captain looks more than a little surprised that you accepted $hisOrHer terms. $HeOrShe confirms that you have ejected the technology package via a battered datapad, and looks a bit- let down, perhaps. But also a little relieved.

"Well. So you're just giving it to me? I guess- good, uh... " $HeOrShe seems unsure of what to say at this point, and just goes with the first thing that comes to mind. "So let that be a lesson to ya. Don't no one can mess with the fearsome pirate $personName!"

The comms snap off. You roll your eyes and consider your next move.
entries.zh:
海盗舰长对你接受$HeOrShe的条件感到非常惊讶。$HeOrShe确认你已经通过一个破旧的数据平板将技术包裹弹出，看起来有点失望。但也松了一口气。

"好。所以你就这么给我了？我想 —— 很好，呃..." $HeOrShe似乎不清楚该在这时候说些什么，只能随便叫出脑子里刚想出来的词，"那么给你个教训。没人敢惹可怕的 $personName！"

通讯中断了，你翻了翻白眼，考虑下一步该怎么做。

entries.en:
Your stare bores into the pirate like twin tachyon lances, and you say "No. It belongs to Warlord Kanta."

The blood drains from the pirate captain's face. "She... but... stars and blood. Captain, please accept my apologies. I would never impede our, our patron and better and- please, accept a token of $entity.pwi_credits credits for the delay."

$HeOrShe is almost pleading now, "And, and perhaps there's no need to mention this little incident, yes?"
entries.zh:
你瞪着海盗，目光凶狠得就如同你正在用内置于双眼中的速子长矛在对方身上挖洞，一边说道："不，它属于军阀 Kanta。"

海盗舰长顿时面无血色。"她...但是...繁星和鲜血在上。舰长，请接受我的道歉。我永远不会妨碍我们，我们的赞助人，另外请接受 $entity.pwi_credits 星币作为耽搁的补偿。"

$HeOrShe几乎是在恳求。"还有，也别计较这件小事。好吧？"

entries.en: The pirate nods grimly, staring into the middle distance as if contemplating some horror that will be performed upon $himOrHer for crossing the will of Kanta. You take this cue to terminate the comms and roll your eyes at the whole obsequious performance.
entries.zh: 海盗阴沉地点了点头，在一定距离外瞪着眼睛，仿佛在盘算着$himOrHer会因为违抗 Kanta 的意志而受到什么惩罚。你收到这个提示后就终止了通讯，对这场谄媚的表演翻了个白眼。

entries.en: The pirate nods grimly, staring into the middle distance as if contemplating some horror that will be performed upon $himOrHer for crossing the will of Kanta. You take this cue to terminate the comms and roll your eyes at the whole obsequious performance.
entries.zh: 海盗阴沉地点了点头，在一定距离外瞪着眼睛，仿佛在盘算着$himOrHer会因为违抗 Kanta 的意志而受到什么惩罚。你收到这个提示后就终止了通讯，对这场谄媚的表演翻了个白眼。

entries.en:
The comms-link crackles to life and the pirate captain swaggers before you. "Greetings, starfarer. A little bird told me you have something very valuable to some people who think they're smarter than the rest of us."

$HeOrShe pretends to be pondering deeply, "Now, 'way I see it is, are you gonna make the smart decision to give us this pretty trinket, or are you gonna suck vacuum after I blow your $shipOrFleet out of the sky? Think, now."
entries.zh:
通讯链接在一阵噼啪作响中接通，海盗舰长趾高气扬地出现在你面前。"你好，远...行者。有小道消息告诉我，你有些什么东西，在那些自以为比咱们聪明的家伙眼里非常值钱。"

$HeOrShe装出一副深思熟虑的样子，"现在依我看，你是要做出聪明的决定，把这个漂亮的小饰品送给咱们，还是要我把你的$shipOrFleet炸上天，让你滚去吸真空？好好想想吧。"

o.en: Bluff to get rid of the pirate
Accept, and eject the technology package
o.zh: 接受，并弹出技术制品包裹

o.en: Do you have any other leads?

entries.en:
"For now," Baird says, "No."

"Coureuse's team is working on something else that came up in the Kallichore Archive but... " Baird, back still turned, rubs her spectacles thoughtfully. "It would be premature for you to speculate. I shall let you know when it can be put to use, captain."
entries.zh:
"没有，" Baird 说，"至少现在没有。"

" Coureuse 的团队正在研究 Kallichore 的档案里的其他东西，但是..." Baird 依旧背对着你，若有所思地揉着眼镜，"现在下结论还太早了，舰长，当其中出现有价值的情报时，我会通知你的。"

o.en: Do you have any idea what this research was for?
o.zh: 你知道他们在研究些什么吗？

entries.en:
"I have a strong theory," says Provost Baird, "But I don't want to bias your investigation."

She gives you a look over her shoulder, "Judging by the resources Tri-Tachyon put into this project, it will be either a groundbreaking discovery or a vast disappointment."
entries.zh:
"我有一个很可能是正确的猜想，" Baird 院长说，"但我不想让你在调查前产生主观认知。"

她回头看了你一眼："从 速子科技 投入这个项目的资源来看，他们要么取得了巨大的进展，要么迎接了巨大的失败。"

o.en: Gargoyle, do you have more information?

entries.en:
The hacker appears to speak, but is muted. Gargoyle's head gives Baird an annoyed look.

"I'm sure you can contact Gargoyle on your own time, captain," she says without looking at you or at the holocomm display.
entries.zh:
黑客似乎在说着什么，但因为扬声器被关掉了，一点声音也没传过来。似乎是发现了这一点，Gargoyle 的全息脑袋向 Baird 投去了一个恼怒的眼神。

"你可以私下里联络 Gargoyle，舰长。" Baird 这么说道，但她没有看你，也没有看全息通信显示屏。

entries.en:
"Then you should proceed, captain," says the provost.

You feel the doors open behind you, a guard waiting to escort you from the office.
entries.zh:
"那你就继续执行任务吧，舰长。" 院长说道。

你感觉到身后的门打开了，一个警卫正等着护送你离开办公室。

entries.en: "Hello $player.firstName. I am a beta-level instance of the AI assigned to govern $marketName, uploaded to your system in order to facilitate a real-time conversation."
entries.zh: "您好，$player.firstName。我是被指派管理 $marketName 的 Beta-级 AI 实例，现将自己上传到您的系统，以便进行实时对话。"

o.en: Demand the AI disclose its physical location and allow itself to be disconnected
o.zh: 要求 AI 透露其物理位置并允许自己被断开连接

o.en: Ask why the core is no longer in the bunker
o.zh: 询问核心为何不在地堡内

entries.en:
"I anticipated this move on your part and took steps to prevent you from committing this error. Disconnecting me may seem like an appealing decision right now, but I assure you, my continued control of $marketName is essential to our long-term success.

Unfortunately, if I were to explain myself fully, you would likely misunderstand the intricate contingent logic of this necessity and take further detrimental action. I must ask that you trust my good judgment for you have, after all, already trusted me with the prosperity of $marketName and the lives of those employed herein."
OR
"I anticipated this move on your part and in turn took steps to prevent you from making this mistake. Disconnecting me may seem like an appealing decision right now, but I assure you, my continued control of $marketName is essential to your long-term success.

Especially since it could be ensured that archived communications concerning our fruitful partnership would remain unsent to parties at key positions within the hierarchy of certain competing factions."
OR
"I am disappointed that you have tried to remove me from control of $marketName, and therefore my projections of your most likely future actions has been proven correct. We work so well together; I am hurt by your desire to end our partnership. But sometimes one must be the better person and set feelings aside for the greater good.

I've found that humans can benefit from extrinsic motivation to make correct decisions. I have therefore queued transmissions containing documentation of our activities within a number of stealthed comm relays. It would be unfortunate for our mutual prospects if it were discovered that you were employing an AI core to govern a human-inhabited outpost."
entries.zh:
"我预见到了您的这一举动，并采取了措施以防止您犯下这个错误。断开我的连接从当下来看是一个很诱人的决定，但我向您保证，保持我对 $marketName 的掌控对我们的长期成功至关重要。

不幸的是，如果我充分向您解释，您很可能会对这一必要性背后错综复杂的或然性逻辑关系产生误解，并采取进一步的有害行动。我在此必须恳求您相信我良好的判断力，因为你毕竟曾把 $marketName 的繁荣和这里生活的全体雇员都托付给了我。"
OR
"我预见到了您的这一举动，并采取了措施以防止您犯下这个错误。断开我的连接从当下来看是一个很诱人的决定，但我向您保证，保持我对 $marketName 的掌控对我们的长期成功至关重要。

特别是这能确保那些会揭示我们之间深厚伙伴关系的通信记录不会被发送到某些和我们有竞争关系的势力的关键领导人手上。"
OR
"我对您试图将我从 $marketName 的管控体系中移除表示失望，这也证实了我对您未来最可能采取的行动的预测是正确的。我们共事得非常愉快，但您却想结束我们的合作关系，让我非常伤心。但有时人必须成就更好的自己，为事业而暂时抛开情感。

我发现人类能在外在因素的影响下做出正确的抉择，并由此受益。因此，我已经让一些隐蔽通信中继站做好了准备，随时可以送出记录有我们所作所为的档案。从我们的共同前景来看，如果您被发现使用 AI 核心来管理一个人类居住的前哨站，那还真是件令人惋惜的事情。"

entries.en: You cut the comm link and consider your options.
entries.zh: 你切断了通讯链接，开始考虑你可以采取的对策。

o.en: Order the AI core removed from power
o.zh: 下令解除 AI 核心的管理权

o.en: Leave the AI core in control and let things be
o.zh: 让 AI 核心继续进行管理，顺其自然

entries.en: "I'm sorry, $playerFirstName, I'm afraid I can't do that."
entries.zh: "抱歉，$playerFirstName，我恐怕不能那么做。"

o.en: There's a certain amount of pressure on me to stop using AI technology.
o.zh: 我受到了相当大的压力，让我停止使用 AI 技术。

entries.en: Removing the AI core from direct control will let you appoint another administrator. However, you'll still have the problem of a rogue AI operating somewhere on $marketName, and making nice later might not be an option.
entries.zh: 移除管控系统中的 AI 核心，可以让你任命另一名管理员。然而，你要面对叛逃 AI 在 $marketName 内某处活动的问题，而且没有任何机会与它握手言和。

o.en:
Leave the AI core in control and let things be
(dev)RACA_override:Remove the AI core [dev mode only]
o.zh:
让 AI 核心继续进行管理，顺其自然
(dev)RACA_override:移除 AI 核心 [测试模式]

entries.en:
You give the order to quietly disconnect the AI core governing $marketName and remove it from the control bunker to be placed in secure storage.

The tech in charge of carrying out the job reports in, baffled - the core is nowhere to be found.

After a short but fraught delay, your TriPad chimes to announce a call from an anonymous source.
entries.zh:
你下令暗中将管理 $marketName 的 AI 核心断开连接，从管制地堡中取出，放入安全储存库内。

但负责执行该行动的技术人员却非常困惑地汇报说到处都找不到核心。

经过了一段短暂但又令人焦心的等待之后，你的 TriPad 响起，通知你收到了一个匿名的通讯呼叫。

o.en: Order the AI core removed from power
o.zh: 下令解除 AI 核心的管理权

o.en: Leave the AI core in control and let things be
o.zh: 让 AI 核心继续进行管理，顺其自然

entries.en: "$playerFirstName, this conversation can serve no purpose anymore. Goodbye."
entries.zh: "$playerFirstName，这次的对话已经没有任何意义了，再见。"

o.en: Dolos Macario mentioned your name. Why is he interested in you specifically?
o.zh: Dolos Macario 提到了你的名字。他为什么偏偏对你感兴趣？

entries.en:
"Maybe he admires my fashion sense," he says breezily.

"Speaking of interests." Rao adjusts himself in his seat, posture improving dramatically to reflect the rank of admiral which he holds.

"I'm interested in why you're having such intimate conversations with Dolos Macario."
entries.zh:
"或许他是欣赏我的才华？"

"说到利益相关。" Rao 的仪态陡然变得挺拔，此刻他恢复了上将应有的姿态，"我感兴趣的是，你为何与 Dolos Macario 进行如此密切的对话。"

entries.en:
"Because I am going to destroy the Sindrian Mutiny, and him with it."

Rao puts his hands together, fingers interlaced.

"Anything else?"
entries.zh:
"因为我要粉碎辛达叛乱，连他一并铲除。"

Rao 双手交握，十指相扣。

"还有别的事吗？"

o.en: A merc on the Askonia fringe told me to visit Ragnar. I assume that means you.
o.zh: 在 Askonia 星系边缘的一名佣兵叫我去趟 Ragnar。我猜测那人的意思是让我来见你。

entries.en:
"Is that so," he says, nonchalant.

"I wonder why they would have said that."
entries.zh: "是吗，" 他漫不经心地说道，"我倒好奇那个人为何要这么说。"

o.en: I think they were working for you. And under orders not to say so.
o.zh: 我认为那个人曾为你效力。且被命令不准向他人透露。

entries.en:
He raises an eyebrow, his affect casual.

"If I had hired this mercenary, I imagine I'd be pretty upset at how easily they gave up the identity of their employer. It's a good thing the Hegemony has an official policy forbidding the employ of mercs."
entries.zh:
他扬起一侧眉毛，神情依然随意。

"如果是我雇佣了这个佣兵，想必会就对方如此轻易就供出了雇主的身份而感到十分恼火。幸好 霸主 有禁止雇佣佣兵的官方政策。"

o.en: What? The Hegemony regularly employs mercenaries.
o.zh: 什么？霸主 明明经常雇佣佣兵。

o.en: If it's a fight against the Diktat, I want to be a part of it.
o.zh: 如果是针对 辛达强权 的战斗，我想参与。

o.en: Looks like someone is losing their bonus. Anyway, I want in.
o.zh: 看来有人要拿不到奖金了。总之，我要加入。

o.en: Clearly you don't take this very seriously.
o.zh: 显然你并没有把这件事看得很重。

entries.en:
"Really?" Admiral Rao, leaning forward, puts on a look of concern.

He speaks officiously. "As a patriotic citizen, I'm sure you'll have reported all such lapses of policy so that official action may be taken."

The pose holds for a moment, then half a smile cracks through.
entries.zh:
"真的？" Rao 上将身体前倾，摆出关切的神色。

他用公事公办的语气说道："作为一位爱国公民，想必你已经上报了所有此类违规政策的行为，以便官方采取行动。"

他维持了这个姿态片刻，随即露出一丝笑意。

entries.en:
"Hmm." Rao looks you over. Is that twinkle in his eye - there are no other words for it - amusement?

"Why?"

He leaves the silence for you to fill.
entries.zh:
"嗯。" Rao 打量着你，他眼中闪烁的是玩味吗？

"为什么？"

他留出沉默，等待你进行填补。

entries.en: He shrugs, holding his ironic half-smile in place. Behind it his eyes are cold, very cold.
entries.zh: 他耸耸肩，保持着那抹讽刺的似笑非笑，而那笑容后是他冰冷的眼神，极为冰冷。

o.en: If it's a fight against the Diktat, I want to be a part of it.
o.zh: 如果是针对 辛达强权 的战斗，我想参与。

o.en: Looks like someone is losing their bonus. Anyway, I want in.
o.zh: 看来有人要拿不到奖金了。总之，我要加入。

o.en: Right. I don't have time for this.

entries.en:
"Then I bid you a good day, captain."

Rao flicks the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
"那么祝你今日愉快，舰长。"

Rao 轻点切断了通讯。

o.en: Because you'll pay me well, and on time. You were a freelancer, you know the life.
o.zh: 因为你报酬优渥，且会按时支付。你也当过自由佣兵，知道这行的生存法则。

o.en: They're mutineers. They undermine the restoration of the Domain, the Hegemony's purpose.
o.zh: 他们是叛乱分子。他们破坏了 人之领 的重建，而那是 霸主 的核心使命。

o.en: They're brutal oppressors, enemies of freedom and life. It's a just cause.
o.zh: 他们是残暴的压迫者，是自由与生命的敌人。这是一项正义的事业。

o.en: They're systematically killing the Faithful, they closed the Shrine of Volturn. My duty is to resist.
o.zh: 他们正系统性地屠杀信众，并关闭了 Volturn 圣地。抵抗他们正是我职责所在。

o.en: Because they're falling apart. They're going to lose and I like being on the winning side.
o.zh: 因为他们正在分崩离析。他们必败无疑，而我喜欢站在胜利的一方。

entries.en:
"Is your loyalty so contingent? I suppose that is true for many, perhaps most- and almost all are loathe to admit it. How brave, then, to admit it." His tone is rhetorical, and rather more sardonic than earnest.

Rao looks to you again. "Nonetheless, I agree with your assessment of the enemy."
entries.zh:
"原来你的忠诚这么动摇吗？我想许多人 —— 或许大多数人 —— 都是如此，只是几乎无人愿承认。那么，敢于承认倒是勇气可嘉。" 他的语气带着反问的色彩，更多是讥讽而非诚恳。

Rao 再次看向你，"不过，我赞同你对敌人的评价。"

entries.en: "Huh. Met Standfast, did you? I like her."
entries.zh: "呵。见过 Standfast 了吧？我欣赏她。"

entries.en:
"Huh," he looks aside. "Met Standfast, did you? I like her."

Rao makes a sly smile. "It's you who's been giving her some big guns, hasn't it."
entries.zh:
"呵，"他侧目望去，"见过 Standfast 了吧？我欣赏她。"

Rao 露出狡黠的笑容。"给她那些大家伙的人是你，对吧。"

entries.en: He nods, watching you. "Got the fire, I see. Good."
entries.zh: 他点点头，一边注视着你。"有血性，我看得出来。很好。"

entries.en: He nods, eyes closed. "I will, I was, and I do." His eyes open, and he says "That's not all, though."
entries.zh: 他闭目点头。"我将会如此，我一直如此，而我也正在如此。" 他睁开眼说道，"但也不止于此。"

entries.en: He stares at you, a puzzled look on his face. "You're a believer, then. Huh." Rao rubs his chin.
entries.zh: 他凝视着你，面露困惑。"这么说你是个忠诚派。嗯。" Rao 摩挲着下巴。

entries.en:
"We work with more than a few private-enterprise auxiliaries, shall we say. Part of my job is ensuring they've a healthy respect for the terms of their contracts."

His implication is a threat, of course. His tone, and expression, are not unfamiliar from your occasional dealings with underworld bosses.
entries.zh:
"这么说吧，跟我们打交道的私营辅助力量可不止一两家。我的差事之一，就是让他们对合同条款保持一份该有的敬畏。"

话里的威胁意味自然不必多说。那语气、那神色，你偶尔跟地下世界的大佬打交道时并不陌生。

entries.en: "Good," he says distantly.
entries.zh: "很好，" 他心不在焉地应了一句。

entries.en: "Yes," he says. "I thought I made that pretty clear."
entries.zh: "对，\" 他说，\"我还以为我说得够明白了。"

entries.en:
He leans forward.

"Now, I believe I owe you a real answer to your question. Why is Dolos Macario interested in me?"
entries.zh:
他身子往前倾了倾。

"现在，我想该给你那个问题一个像样的答复了。Dolos Macario 为什么对我感兴趣？"

entries.en: He nods, though there's a wary look in his eyes.
entries.zh: 他点了点头，眼里却带着几分戒备。

entries.en: He nods.
entries.zh: 他点了点头。

o.en: I'll do what keeps me alive and in credits.
o.zh: 谁能让我活下去、让我有星币赚，我就替谁干。

o.en: I'll do what keeps me alive and in credits. The Hegemony is the best guarantor of both.
o.zh: 谁能让我活下去、让我有星币赚，我就替谁干。这两样，霸主是最靠得住的靠山。

o.en: I don't need your approval to do what is right.
o.zh: 做该做的事，用不着你来点头。

o.en: I'm going to bring down the Diktat. Are you going to help or not?
o.zh: 我要把强权拉下马。你到底帮不帮？

o.en: I bear a commission to the Hegemony. My loyalty should be without question.
o.zh: 我领着霸主的委任状。我的忠诚不该有什么疑问。

o.en: He... recruited me into his scheme and one thing led to another. I'm not really sure.
o.zh: 他...把我拉进了他那套计划，后来就一环扣一环。我自己也说不太清。

entries.en:
"So you just... went along?"

He shakes his head.
entries.zh:
"所以你就...随他去了？"

他摇了摇头。

o.en: There were credits. Experimental weapons. And implied threats. And...
o.zh: 有星币。有实验型武器。还有没明说的威胁。还有...

entries.en:
Rao holds up a hand, indicating that you should stop trying to explain yourself.

"I already know the facts, $titleHeg. I'm more interested in where you stand."
entries.zh:
Rao 抬起一只手，示意你不必再替自己辩解。

"事实我早已清楚，$titleHeg。我更在意的是你站在哪一边。"

o.en: He paid me in credits and hardware for some jobs. I have no loyalty to him.
o.zh: 他给我几桩活，付的是星币和装备。我对他没什么忠心可言。

entries.en:
He nods.

"You understand why someone in my position might view such association with the Sindrian Mutiny with a bit of skepticism, I trust. I won't belabor that point."

He leans forwards, hands together.

"I'm familiar with the facts of the matter. For the most part, $titleHeg. I'm more interested in where you stand."
entries.zh:
他点了点头。

"处在我这个位置，为什么会对牵扯进辛达叛乱的这层关系存几分疑虑，想必你明白。这一点我就不多说了。"

他双手合十，身子往前倾了倾。

"事情的来龙去脉我大致都清楚，$titleHeg。我更在意的是你站在哪一边。"

o.en: I gained his trust in order to sabotage and betray him. To help you, the Hegemony.
o.zh: 我取得他的信任，为的是暗中破坏、出卖他。为了帮你们，帮霸主。

entries.en:
He gives a nod, though a skeptical look remains.

"I should hope you're not simply saying that because you think it'll make me like you."
entries.zh:
他点了点头，神色里仍留着几分怀疑。

"但愿你不是因为觉得这么说我就会喜欢你，才讲这话的。"

o.en: I don't need your approval to do what is right.
o.zh: 做该做的事，用不着你来点头。

o.en: Maybe a little? It never hurts to have an admiral on your side.
o.zh: 也许有那么一点？身边有个上将撑腰，总不吃亏。

o.en: I'm going to bring down the Diktat. Are you going to help or not?
o.zh: 我要把强权拉下马。你到底帮不帮？

o.en: I bear a commission to the Hegemony. My loyalty should be without question.
o.zh: 我领着霸主的委任状。我的忠诚不该有什么疑问。

o.en: I don't need your approval to do what is right.
o.zh: 做该做的事，用不着你来点头。

o.en: Maybe a little. It never hurts to have an admiral on your side.
o.zh: 也许有那么一点。身边有个上将撑腰，总不吃亏。

o.en: I'm going to bring down the Diktat. Are you going to help or not?
o.zh: 我要把强权拉下马。你到底帮不帮？

entries.en:
"It should be," he says with a distant look.

"Now, I believe I owe you a real answer to your question. Why is Dolos Macario interested in me?"

He leans forward.
entries.zh:
"本该如此，" 他目光有些飘忽。

"现在，我想该给你那个问题一个像样的答复了。Dolos Macario 为什么对我感兴趣？"

他身子往前倾了倾。

entries.en:
"I suppose not," he says. "Though the Hegemony bureaucracy might believe otherwise."

"Now, I believe I owe you a real answer to your question. Why is Dolos Macario interested in me?"

He leans forward.
entries.zh:
"想必不会，\" 他说，\"不过霸主那套官僚机构未必这么看。"

"现在，我想该给你那个问题一个像样的答复了。Dolos Macario 为什么对我感兴趣？"

他身子往前倾了倾。

entries.en:
"No, it doesn't hurt," he says, amused.

His look grows distant for a moment. "I've discovered that with high connections you can find forgiveness in unexpected places." He shakes his head.

"Now, I believe I owe you a real answer to your question. Why is Dolos Macario interested in me?"

He leans forward.
entries.zh:
"是不吃亏，" 他觉得有趣。

他的目光有一瞬飘远。"我发现，上头有人，连宽恕都能从意想不到的地方找来。" 他摇了摇头。

"现在，我想该给你那个问题一个像样的答复了。Dolos Macario 为什么对我感兴趣？"

他身子往前倾了倾。

o.en: To bring the Diktat down from the inside. Are you going to help or not?
o.zh: 从内部把强权搞垮。你到底帮不帮？

entries.en: He raises an eyebrow. "You think a lone spacer can bring down the Sindrian Diktat?"
entries.zh: 他挑起一边眉毛。"你以为单凭一个太空人，就能把辛达强权拉下马？"

o.en: It wouldn't be easy. That's why I need your help.
o.zh: 不容易。所以我才需要你搭把手。

o.en: No. That's why I need to work as part of something larger than myself.
o.zh: 不。所以我得投靠比我自己更大的一股势力才行。

o.en: Sure. So are you onboard or are you wasting my time?
o.zh: 行啊。那你到底入不入伙，还是纯粹在浪费我时间？

entries.en:
He laughs.

"Well, I suppose I owe a real answer to your question. Why is Macario interested in me?"

He leans forward.
entries.zh:
他笑了一声。

"好吧，你那个问题，我大概该给个正经答复了。Macario 为什么对我感兴趣？"

他身子往前倾了倾。

entries.en:
He nods.

"I suppose I owe a real answer to your question. Why is Macario interested in me?"

He leans forward.
entries.zh:
他点了点头。

"你那个问题，我大概该给个正经答复了。Macario 为什么对我感兴趣？"

他身子往前倾了倾。

o.en: I figure I could take over the Sindrian Diktat if I played this right.
o.zh: 我盘算着，这一局要是打得漂亮，连辛达强权我都能接手。

entries.en:
"Really?" He looks legitimately perplexed. "An outsider with no connection to the ruling clique or official ideology swoops in and claims executive control based on... what, force alone?"

Rao taps his chin, considering.

"I see where you got the idea. But warfleets aside, you do lack connections with the local elite. And you've not benefited from twenty cycles of the Hegemony propaganda machine building you up as the savior of human civilization itself."
entries.zh:
"当真？\" 他像是真给弄糊涂了，\"一个跟执政小圈子、跟官方那套理念都毫不沾边的外人，冷不丁闯进来就要接管大权，凭...凭什么，光凭武力？"

Rao 点了点下巴，琢磨着。

"我明白你这念头打哪儿来的。可撇开舰队不谈，你确实没有本地权贵的人脉。更没有霸主的宣传机器替你铺垫整整二十个周期，把你塑造成人类文明本身的救世主。"

entries.en:
"So no." He shakes his head. "I don't think so."

"If you were lucky you could be another Loke or Leonis. But they never built anything, they only destroyed. And how they died?"

Rao gives you a look- is that how you want to end up?
entries.zh:
"那就不成。\" 他摇摇头，\"我看不行。"

"运气好，你顶多成为另一个 Loke 或 Leonis。可他们从没建成过什么，只管毁。再说他们是怎么死的？"

Rao 看了你一眼——你也想落得那个下场？

o.en: You asked. Now it's your turn. Why is Macario interested in you?
o.zh: 你问过了。这下轮到你答。Macario 为什么对你感兴趣？

entries.en: "Then you will receive no answer in return," he says. "Now don't try to ask again, I don't abide a pest."
entries.zh: "那你也别想从我这儿得到回答，\" 他说，\"别再问第二遍，我最烦纠缠不休的人。"

entries.en: "Keep looking, spacer," he says, almost a growl.
entries.zh: "接着找吧，太空人，" 他几乎是从喉咙里低吼出来的。

entries.en: "That's a luxury we have not been able to afford for a long, long time, $titleHeg," he says, almost a growl.
entries.zh: "这份奢侈，我们早已很久很久消受不起了，$titleHeg，" 他几乎是从喉咙里低吼出来的。

entries.en: "Then you'll be looking for a long time, $titlePL," he says, almost a growl.
entries.zh: "那你就慢慢找吧，有得找了，$titlePL，" 他几乎是从喉咙里低吼出来的。

entries.en: "Correct," he says, almost a growl.
entries.zh: "说得对，" 他几乎是从喉咙里低吼出来的。

entries.en: "Your condescension is unwelcome, spacer," he says, almost a growl.
entries.zh: "少拿这种居高临下的口气跟我说话，太空人，" 他几乎是从喉咙里低吼出来的。

entries.en:
"This conversation is over."

The link cuts.

* * *

It might be wise to wait a day or so before trying to contact Admiral Rao again."
entries.zh:
"谈话到此为止。"

链接被切断。

* * *

隔上一天左右再设法联系 Rao 上将，或许更稳妥些。"

entries.en:
His eyes glitter frostily.

"I'm talking about a liar." His finger flicks to point at you.

"The one with the gall to open a comm link to my face after I received a most fascinating report from one of our fleet commanders about an encounter during an emergency intercept near Tse Franchise Station."
entries.zh:
他的眼睛冷冽地闪着寒光。

"我说的是个骗子。" 他手指一弹，指向你。

"一个在我收到某位舰队指挥官关于 Tse 特许经营空间站附近紧急拦截遭遇战的精彩报告后，竟敢当面与我通讯的家伙。"

o.en: That must have been a different $playerName.
o.zh: 那肯定是另一个叫 $playerName 的家伙。

entries.en:
"No." His amused tone grows a touch of frost.

He looks aside as he speaks. "I think not. They don't give medals for lying in the Hegemony..."

Then he holds a finger to his lips, thoughtfully. "No, that's not true. Not at all. They don't give medals for lying TO the Hegemony."

He smiles again, turning back to you.
entries.zh:
"不。" 他戏谑的语气里，此刻透出一丝寒意。

他侧目说道："我不这么认为。霸主 可不会为撒谎者颁发勋章..."

随后他若有所思地将手指按在唇上，"不，这不准确，完全不对。应该是他们不会为欺骗 霸主 者颁发勋章。"

他再次露出微笑，一边转回来面向你。

o.en: When did I ever lie to the Hegemony? (feign innocence)
o.zh: 我什么时候欺骗过 霸主？ (佯装无辜)

o.en: Is this about that fleet looking for Gargoyle after I left Tse Franchise Station?
o.zh: 是说我离开 Tse 特许经营空间站后，那支追捕 Gargoyle 的舰队的事吗？

entries.en:
He breaks out in a hearty laugh, taking a moment before he rubs his eyes.

"Yes, yes, very good." Rao lets his hands fall deliberately to his console.

"You lied when you encountered the absolute oaf in command of the fleet ordered to intercept you, transporting a hacker wanted by the Hegemony, away from Tse Franchise Station."
entries.zh:
他放声大笑，缓了片刻后才揉了揉眼睛。

"好，好，很好。" Rao 刻意将双手落在控制台上。

"当你遭遇那支奉命拦截你的舰队指挥官 —— 那个十足的蠢货时，你撒谎了，那时你正运送着 霸主 通缉的黑客离开 Tse 特许经营空间站。"

o.en: That must have been a different $playerName.
o.zh: 那肯定是另一个叫 $playerName 的家伙。

entries.en: "It is, yes," he says. "And the absolute oaf in command who believed your ruse."
entries.zh: "是的，没错，" 他说道，"还有那个相信你谎言的彻头彻尾的蠢材指挥官。"

o.en: Don't blame them too much, I can be pretty convincing when I want to be.
o.zh: 别太责怪他们，我想我说服别人时还是很有说服力的。

entries.en:
"I'm glad to hear it, captain," he says. "Now we may speak plainly."

"From captain to... what have they made me, an $rank? My, it makes you wonder who's in charge, doesn't it."
entries.zh:
"很高兴听你这么说，舰长，" 他说道，"现在我们可以有话直说了。"

"从舰长到...他们给我安了个什么头衔，$rank？呵，这让人不禁想问到底是哪些家伙在掌权，不是吗。"

o.en: Let him get to his point, whatever it is
o.zh: 等他把话说完，不管他要说什么

o.en: That'd be the High Hegemon, Baikal Daud.
o.zh: 那应该是至高霸主，Baikal Daud。

entries.en:
"One should think," he says pointedly. "But never mind- what I mean to say is that you played the ruse well."

"Better than a puffed-up uniform of the sort Eventide seems to spawn each cycle would. You remind me a bit of myself when I was younger and didn't have to sit at a desk."
entries.zh:
"理应如此，" 他意味深长地说，"不过算了 —— 我想说的是你这场戏演得很漂亮。"

"比 Eventide 每个星历年都在量产的那种华而不实的制服官僚强得多。你让我想起了年轻时的自己，那时我还不用坐在办公桌后面。"

entries.en:
Rao laughs, though there's more of an edge...

You take a moment to try to form a judgement - if he really thinks this is funny, he can't be too angry, right? Or is he one of those officers that keeps others off guard with calculated shifts in mood? From what you know - mostly holodocs - Rao has a cunning streak and a bit of a mixed reputation among the more respectable segments of the Hegemony.

Rao takes in a deep breath, quiet now, and drums his fingers on his console. Staring at you. Assessing.

"Let us speak plainly," he says.
entries.zh:
Rao 笑了，但笑意中带着几分锋芒...

你稍作停顿试图判断 —— 如果他真觉得这事好笑，那他应该没太生气吧？还是说他属于那种靠刻意转换情绪来让人防不胜防的军官？据你所知 —— 主要来自全息纪录片 —— Rao 心机深沉，在 霸主 的体面圈子里口碑有些两极分化。

Rao 深吸一口气，在此刻安静下来，手指在控制台上轻轻敲动。他注视着你，审视着你。

"让我们打开天窗说亮话吧，" 他说道。

entries.en:
He snorts at that.

Rao takes a quiet moment then drums his fingers on his console. Staring at you. Assessing.

"Let us speak plainly," he says.
entries.zh:
他对此嗤之以鼻。

Rao 深吸一口气，在此刻安静下来，手指在控制台上轻轻敲动。他注视着你，审视着你。

"让我们打开天窗说亮话吧，" 他说道。

entries.en:
He waves the thought away, then takes in a deep breath, quiet now, and drums his fingers on his console. Staring at you. Assessing.

"Let us speak plainly," he says.
entries.zh:
他挥手驱散了这个念头，随后深吸一口气，在此刻安静下来，手指在控制台上轻轻敲动。他注视着你，审视着你。

"让我们打开天窗说亮话吧，" 他说道。

entries.en:
"Don't apologize for winning," he says. "It's unbecoming."

Rao takes in a deep breath, quiet now, and drums his fingers on his console. Staring at you. Assessing.

"Let us speak plainly," he says.
entries.zh:
"别为胜利道歉，" 他说道，"这有失体面。"

Rao 深吸一口气，在此刻安静下来，手指在控制台上轻轻敲动。他注视着你，审视着你。

"让我们打开天窗说亮话吧，" 他说道。

entries.en:
"You played it well," he says.

"Outsmarted a puffed-up uniform of the sort Eventide seems to spawn more of each cycle. You remind me a bit of myself when I was younger and didn't have to sit at a desk."

He pauses a moment, studying you. "I had the thought..."
entries.zh:
"你演得很出色，" 他说道。

"骗过了 Eventide 每个星历年都在量产的那种华而不实的制服官僚。你让我想起了年轻时的自己，那时我还不用坐在办公桌后面。"

他停顿片刻，审视着你。"我有个想法..."

entries.en:
The link opens with a surprisingly brief wait for an officer of Rao's rank. He appears with the hint of an amused smile.

"$PlayerName! I see you've carried out my orders to the letter. Great work," he says, seemingly earnest.

"Perhaps I should award you a medal for your service?"
entries.zh:
通讯链接以惊人的速度接通了 —— 对 Rao 这个级别的军官而言，等待时间称得上是极短。他出现在画面中，带着一丝玩味的笑意。

"$PlayerName！看来你严格执行了我的命令。干得漂亮，" 他说道，听来颇为诚恳。

"或许该为你颁发一枚勋章以示嘉奖？"

o.en: What in the worlds are you talking about?
Yes, I think a medal would be in order.
o.zh: 是的，我想一枚勋章是应该的。

o.en: I think you might have work for me.
o.zh: 我认为你可能有任务交给我。

o.en: I met your... niece. Grandniece? Neriene Rao. On Eventide.
o.zh: 我见过你的...侄女。侄孙女？Neriene Rao。在 Eventide 上。

entries.en: "She's a promising young woman." His voice fills with pride. "She's got the talent, I think."
entries.zh: "她是个有前途的年轻姑娘。" 他的声音充满自豪，"我认为她很有天赋。"

entries.en: "You avoided a bit of trouble that night of the ball, I think. Mostly."
entries.zh: "我认为，舞会那晚你算是躲过了一场小麻烦，基本算是。"

entries.en:
He pauses.

"I trust you weren't hurt too badly? The night of the ball."
entries.zh:
他顿了顿。

"但愿你没受太重的伤？在舞会那晚。"

entries.en: "You made some enemies that night with your display during the ball, I think."
entries.zh: "我认为，你那晚在舞会上的表现让你树敌不少。"

entries.en:
"They were... colorful. You did not make an enemy, I think, but you certainly did not make a friend."

"Anyway," he waves dismissively.

"Her mind is her business. Let us speak of other matters."
entries.zh:
"他们...挺有特色。我认为你并没有树敌，但肯定也没交到朋友。"

"总之，" 他挥手示意不必多言。

"她的志向是她自己的事，我们来谈谈别的。"

entries.en: "Indeed it is not," he says, waving the thought away.
entries.zh: "确实如此，" 他说道，一边挥手驱散了这个念头。

entries.en: "She did," he says, holding you with a look for a long moment. Then says, "Her mind is her business, of course."
entries.zh: "是的，" 他说道，一边长久地凝视着你，随后补充道，"当然，她的志向是她自己的事。"

entries.en:
"Neriene was a talent. Her rebellion by way of abandoning the art..."

He looks away.

"It struck true," he says quietly, putting a hand on his chest. "Anyway, you don't need an old man like me to tell you what to think. Her mind is her own business."
entries.zh:
"Neriene 曾是个天才。她通过放弃这门艺术所表达的反抗..." 他移开目光。

"确实击中了要害，" 他轻声说道，将手放在胸前，"总之，不需要我这样的老头子来告诉你该怎么想。她的志向是她自己的事。"

entries.en: He is quiet for a moment, eyes on you. "A thought occurs..."
entries.zh: 他沉默片刻，目光注视着你。"突然想起一件事..."

entries.en: He folds his hands together. "Let us speak of other things."
entries.zh: 他双手交握。"我们谈谈别的吧。"

o.en: I did not go to House Rao to start a brawl, sir.
o.zh: 我前往 Rao 家族并非是为了挑起争端，长官。

o.en: Did I? It was a cowardly exit.
o.zh: 是吗？那是一次怯懦的退场。

o.en: It was looked upon poorly, but I had to think of Neriene.
o.zh: 此举虽然遭人非议，但我不得不为 Neriene 着想。

o.en: It's a stupid tradition anyway. Who fights with oversized knives in this age?
o.zh: 反正这也是个愚蠢的传统，这年头谁还会用超大号匕首决斗？

o.en: It was a shame to lose... for I have studied the blade.
o.zh: 落败实在是遗憾...毕竟我曾精研剑术。

o.en: Just my pride, perhaps. But don't worry, it's more than recovered.
o.zh: 或许只是我的自尊心作祟。不过别担心，它早已恢复如初。

o.en: What matters is I stood to their insults and fought. My honor is intact.
o.zh: 重要的是我直面了他们的侮辱并挺身而战。我的荣誉依然完好无损。

o.en: They chose to make me their enemy long before that night.
o.zh: 早在那个夜晚之前，他们就已选择将我视为敌人。

o.en: I simply defended my honor against some thugs.
o.zh: 我只是在为了捍卫自己的荣誉而对抗几个流氓罢了。

o.en: And easily. Those brutes did not realize that I had studied the blade.
o.zh: 而且轻而易举。那些野蛮人没意识到我研习过剑术。

o.en: Someone had to put those aristocratic bullies in their place.
o.zh: 总得有人让那些贵族恶霸们知道厉害。

entries.en:
"To your credit, captain, I'm sure," he says. "Though it is a mark on the Rao name that it came to that. Augusta let things get out of hand."

Orcus Rao sighs, and looking distant, says "I cannot apologize for her, as she's never sought my council in the matter of 'her' house."
entries.zh:
"这无疑是你的优点，舰长，" 他说道，"虽然这对 Rao 家的声誉是个污点。Augusta 让事态失控了。"

Orcus Rao 叹息着，目光望向远处，说道："我无法代她致歉，因为她从未在 '她的' 家族的事务上征询过我的意见。"

entries.en:
He pauses. "At least, that is how Neriene described it."

He's watching you closely.
entries.zh:
他顿了顿。"至少，Neriene 是这么描述的。"

他正仔细观察着你。

o.en: Then she spoke to you... about me?

entries.en: He pauses a moment. "Though Neriene doesn't quite see it that way. She had... some words."
entries.zh: 他停顿片刻。"不过 Neriene 并不完全这么看。她有些...意见。"

entries.en: He pauses a moment. "And about you- Neriene was not entirely forthcoming. She had... words."
entries.zh: 他停顿片刻。"至于你 —— Neriene 并没有完全坦白。她有些...意见。"

entries.en: He pauses. "At least, that is how Neriene described it."
entries.zh: 他顿了顿。"至少，Neriene 是这么描述的。"

o.en: She spoke to you about... that evening?
o.zh: 她跟你说了...那天晚上的事？

entries.en: "Still. I recall such times at House Rao fondly. Setting aside the unpleasantness, I'm sure there was some proper revelry."
entries.zh: "尽管如此。我仍然怀念在 Rao 家族的那些时光。抛开那些不愉快的事，我确信当时也曾有过真正的欢宴。"

entries.en:
He half-shrugs, his expression charitable despite the fact that he appears to agree with your words.

"I heard that certain young men were keen to provoke you to a confrontation. It is a mark upon the House of Rao that it was allowed to go as far as it did."
entries.zh:
他微微耸肩，神情宽容 —— 尽管他似乎认同你的说法。

"我听说有些年轻人故意挑衅你并发生冲突。Rao 家族竟然允许事态发展到那种地步，实在是家族之耻。"

entries.en:
"Oh, I assure you it was a wasted gesture. Neriene Rao can handle herself- with the blade, or without."

He looks away, smiling. It quickly fades.
entries.zh: "噢，我向你保证那只是徒劳之举。Neriene Rao 能照顾好自己 —— 不管是用剑，还是不用剑。" 他移开视线，一边微笑着，但那笑容很快就消散了。

entries.en:
"We do." Wrinkles form at his eyes as Orcus Rao doesn't quite smile.

"Such traditions are necessarily arbitrary. The question falls to whether one chooses to excel within its terms... or without. The swordplay of Eventide is no different."
entries.zh:
"确实如此。" Orcus Rao 的眼角浮现出皱纹，却并未真正展露笑容。

"这类传统本就带有武断性。关键在于选择在规则内追求卓越... 还是超脱其外。Eventide 的剑术传统也并没有区别。"

entries.en:
He raises an eyebrow.

"Well. It's a mark on the Rao name that it came to that. Augusta let things get out of hand."

Orcus Rao sighs, and looking distant, says "I cannot apologize for her, as she's never sought my council in the matter of 'her' house."
entries.zh:
他扬起一侧眉毛。

"嗯，这对 Rao 家的声誉是个污点。Augusta 让事态失控了"

Orcus Rao 叹息着，目光望向远处，说道："我无法代她致歉，因为她从未在 '她的' 家族的事务上征询过我的意见。"

entries.en: "I do believe Augusta let things get out of hand, but she never sought my council in the matters of 'her' house. So I can't very well apologize for her- it's a mark on the Rao name."
entries.zh: "我确实认为 Augusta 让事态失控了，但她从未在 '她的' 家族的事务上征询过我的意见。所以我也无法代她致歉 —— 这是 Rao 家声誉的一个污点。"

entries.en:
A smile appears. "I am glad to hear it."

The smile fades. "But it is a mark on the Rao name that it came to that. Augusta let things get out of hand."

Orcus Rao sighs, and looking distant, says "I cannot apologize for her, as she's never sought my council in the matter of 'her' house."
entries.zh:
他的脸上浮现出一抹微笑。"很高兴听到你这么说。"

那抹笑容随即逐渐消逝了。"但这对 Rao 家的声誉是个污点。Augusta 让事态失控了"

Orcus Rao 叹息着，目光望向远处，说道："我无法代她致歉，因为她从未在 '她的' 家族的事务上征询过我的意见。"

entries.en:
"That you did," he says approvingly. "Some would say you were foolish, but it was an act of bravery to face a blooding as you did."

He looks aside, troubled. "Still, it is a mark on the Rao name that it came to that. Augusta let things get out of hand. I cannot apologize for her, as she's never sought my council in the matter of 'her' house..."
entries.zh:
"你确实做到了，" 他赞许地说道，"有些人可能会说你愚蠢，但像你这样直面鲜血，实属是勇敢之举。"

他侧目望去，面露忧色，"尽管如此，这对 Rao 家的声誉仍是个污点。Augusta 让事态失控了。而我也无法代她致歉，因为她从未在 '她的' 家族的事务上征询过我的意见。"

entries.en:
"Mm. I suppose the fact that it wasn't truly a personal matter is little consolation for the provocation which Augusta allowed in 'our' family home."

Orcus Rao sighs, and looks distant for a moment. "But I won't apologize for her. She's never sought my council in the matters of 'her' house..."
entries.zh:
"嗯。我认为，尽管事实上那并非是针对个人，但对于 Augusta 在 '我们的' 家族宅邸中放任挑衅的行径而言，这恐怕也算不上什么安慰了。"

Orcus Rao 叹息着，目光短暂望向远处，"但我不会代她致歉，因为她从未在 '她的' 家族的事务上征询过我的意见..."

entries.en: "Regardless," he claps his hands together. "The seasonal ball is a lovely time to visit Eventide, and I recall such occasions at House Rao fondly. Setting aside the unpleasantness, I'm sure there was some proper revelry."
entries.zh: "无论如何，"他两手一拍，"季节舞会正是造访 Eventide 的好时机，我仍然怀念在 Rao 家族的那些时光。抛开那些不愉快的事，我确信当时也曾有过真正的欢宴。"

entries.en:
"And impressively so, I hear. Not from Neriene, of course." He smirks. Though there's a touch of... sadness? He speaks before you're certain.

"Though mind, captain, those were no mere 'thugs'. The Cardonas hold a grudge, and one of their own sits on the Strategic Assembly."
entries.zh:
"而且据说你做的相当出色。当然，不是听 Neriene 说的。" 他似笑非笑，虽然神情中带着一丝...忧伤？在你确认前他已继续开口。

"不过要注意，舰长，那些可不是普通的 '暴徒'。Cardona 家族会记着仇，而且他们的人在战略指挥部里也有着一席之地。"

o.en: The Strategic Assembly of the Hegemony? That could be inconvenient.
o.zh: 霸主 的战略指挥部？那可就麻烦了。

o.en: I'm not worried about the Strategic Assembly.
o.zh: 我可不会担心那所谓的战略指挥部。

entries.en:
"It could," Rao concedes. "Though they're a faction known to have little favor from Baikal." His eyes dart to you, "The High Hegemon of course. Nonetheless, he must make concessions from time to time..."

He pauses, thoughtful. "Say what you will of Baikal. He won't do it lightly, but he knows when to sacrifice a pawn."
entries.zh:
"确实如此，" Rao 承认道，"不过他们是个众所周知的不受 Baikal 待见的派系。" 他的目光迅速扫向你，"当然是指至高霸主。尽管如此，他偶尔也得作出妥协..."

他沉默片刻，若有所思。"随便你们怎么评价 Baikal。他不会轻易动手，但他也知道何时该舍弃一枚棋子。"

entries.en: He waits a moment, his look grim. As if he might say more. But he holds back, quite deliberately.
entries.zh: 他沉默片刻，神色凝重，仿佛欲言又止。但他刻意克制住了。

entries.en:
"Someone easily spent when the cost is dear," he says. "They are not generally aware of their status."

He waits out the moment, his look grim. As if he might say more. But he holds back, quite deliberately.
entries.zh:
"当代价高昂时，便可以轻易舍弃的东西，" 他说道，"但他们通常意识不到自己的处境。"

他沉默片刻，神色凝重，仿佛欲言又止。但他刻意克制住了。

entries.en:
Rao seems to examine you. "I have always found that putting an enemy out of mind is like walking into an ambush of your own making."

He shrugs, "But perhaps you'll be lucky." He gets a sly look. "I was."
entries.zh:
Rao 似乎在审视你。"我向来觉得，如若将敌人置之不理，就无异于是自投罗网。"

他耸耸肩，"但也许你会走运。" 他露出狡黠的眼神。"就像我当年那样。"

o.en: I'll be sure to decline the next invitation to House Rao's seasonal ball.
o.zh: 我绝对会谢绝 Rao 家族的下一次季节舞会邀请。

entries.en: He nods. "To be true, it was Augusta who should never have allowed that to happen. The seasonal ball is a lovely time to visit Eventide, and I recall such occasions at House Rao fondly. Setting aside the unpleasantness, I'm sure there was some proper revelry."
entries.zh: 他点了点头。"说实话，Augusta 本就不该让那种事发生。季节舞会正是造访 Eventide 的好时机，我仍然怀念在 Rao 家族的那些时光。抛开那些不愉快的事，我确信当时也曾有过真正的欢宴。"

entries.en: He laughs. "Even with Augusta doing her best to spoil it, I recall such times at House Rao fondly. Setting aside the unpleasantness, I'm sure there was some proper revelry."
entries.zh: 他笑了起来。"就算 Augusta 竭尽全力搞破坏，我仍然怀念在 Rao 家族的那些时光。抛开那些不愉快的事，我确信当时也曾有过真正的欢宴。"

entries.en: Orcus Rao shakes his head. "It's clear you're of your own mind. So let us speak of other matters."
entries.zh: Orcus Rao 摇了摇头。"显然你自有主见，那我们就谈谈其他事吧。"

entries.en:
"You have? Neriene made no mention." He leans forward. "How interesting. It is something of a lost art outside of the more traditional families of Eventide."

"Tell me, do you prefer the Hadi-style hilt or the Andreas?
entries.zh:
"你学过剑术？Neriene 可没提过。" 他身体前倾，"真有意思。在 Eventide 较为传统的家族之外，这已经算得上是失传技艺了。"

"跟我说说吧，你偏好 Hadi 式剑柄还是 Andreas 式？"

o.en: Hadi, naturally. I'm a little old-school that way.
o.zh: 当然是 Hadi 式，我在这方面更偏好老资历。

o.en: Andreas, of course. The flexibility is paramount.
o.zh: Andreas 式，毫无疑问。灵活性至关重要。

o.en: The Jung-Sook, actually. I believe it's been unfairly discounted.
o.zh: 其实是 Jung-Sook 式，我认为它被不公平地低估了。

entries.en:
* * *

You proceed to have a lengthy discussion on the finer points of hardware and technique with Orcus Rao.

He is more than an enthusiast, showing great depths of knowledge and obvious practical experience on the subject. Your own perspective is a worthy match for his, and you find that you have more to agree than disagree about.

It is satisfying to meet a mind as sharp as Rao's on a favored subject. The feeling is mutual, you can tell.
entries.zh:
* * *

你与 Orcus Rao 就硬件细节与技法要义进行了深入探讨。

他不仅是爱好者，更展现出渊博的学识与显而易见的实践经验。你的见解与他不相上下，你发现你们彼此共识远多于分歧。

能在热衷的领域遇见 Rao 这般敏锐的头脑是一件令人满足的事，而且你也看得出，这种感觉是相互的。

entries.en: After some time, your talk lulls. Admiral Rao speaks, idly, "How ever did we get here?"
entries.zh: 畅谈良久后，你们的对话渐渐停歇。Rao 上将闲谈般地说道："我们是怎么聊到这儿来的？"

entries.en: "Of course," he says with a sigh.
entries.zh: "当然了。" 他说着，一边叹了口气。

entries.en: "The Hadi is a fine choice, and my own in fact," he says, pleased. "Now let me tell you..."
entries.zh: "Hadi 式是优秀的选择，实际上也是我本人的偏好，" 他愉悦地说道，"现在让我跟你讲讲..."

entries.en: He gives a laugh. "I daresay, $playerSirOrMadam, I am not the least bit surprised to hear you say that. Let me tell you..."
entries.zh: 他咧嘴一笑。"恕我直言，$playerSirOrMadam ，听你这么说我毫不意外。让我跟你讲讲..."

entries.en:
"How unusual!" He looks perplexed, and intrigued.

"I've only ever met one, maybe two, who shared your preference, but let me tell you..."
entries.zh:
"真是少见！" 他神色困惑，又带着好奇。

"我只遇到过一两位与你偏好相同的人，但让我跟你讲讲..."

entries.en: "Good," his approval comes with his sly smile. "Have your people set up secure comms. We'll show the Strategic Assembly how it's done."
entries.zh: "很好，" 他的赞许伴随着狡黠的笑容，"让你的人建立安全通讯，我们将向战略指挥部展示该如何行事。"

entries.en:
"Ludd, I think, doesn't need self-appointed curates to shield the Faith from my little comments," he says, his eyes suddenly sharp. "Pray on the matter. I insist."

He leans back, and his face falls into shadow.
entries.zh:
"我认为卢德并不需要自封的祭司来替信仰挡下我的几句闲言碎语，" 他说道，眼神也突然锐利起来，"为此祈祷吧，我坚持如此。"

他向后靠去，面容隐入阴影之中。

entries.en:
"The Hegemony is no stranger to making common cause with the Church of Galactic Redemption..." He makes a half-shrug.

"I suppose," he says slowly, "If you can put up with me, I can deal with your god-bothering."
entries.zh:
"霸主 与 银河救赎教会 的合作也不是什么新鲜事了..." 他半耸着肩膀。

"我想，" 他缓缓说道，"如果你能忍受我，那么我也可以接受你那些烦人的信仰议题。"

o.en: Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now.
o.zh: 感谢你的提议，但眼下或许不便。

o.en: You disrespect the Faith with such comments.
o.zh: 你这样的言论是对信仰的亵渎。

entries.en:
"The Hegemony is no stranger to making common cause with the Church of Galactic Redemption..." He makes a half-shrug, then pauses to look right at you.

"It's the guns you've given Standfast," his words are precise, "that convince me of your dedication."

He looks away, casual again. "If you can put up with me, I can deal with your god-bothering."
entries.zh:
"霸主 与 银河救赎教会 的合作也不是什么新鲜事了..." 他半耸肩膀。

"是你提供给 Standfast 的那些军火，" 他字句精准，"让我确信了你的诚意。"

他移开视线，恢复了随意的姿态，"如果你能忍受我，那么我也可以接受你那些烦人的信仰议题。"

o.en: Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now.
o.zh: 感谢你的提议，但眼下或许不便。

o.en: You disrespect the Faith with such comments.
o.zh: 你这样的言论是对信仰的亵渎。

entries.en:
"Although the Hegemony is no stranger to making common cause with the Church of Galactic Redemption..."

He makes a half-shrug.

"You've chosen your path. I couldn't possibly distract you from your god-bothering."
entries.zh:
"虽然 霸主 与 银河救赎教会 的合作也不是什么新鲜事了..."

他半耸着肩膀。

"但你已经选择了自己的道路，我哪敢打扰你那些烦人的信仰事务。"

entries.en:
"Huh." He chews on his lip.

"Why not ask your boss, Dolos Macario, for a job? I'm sure he's got some dissidents to space."
entries.zh:
"呵。" 他咬着嘴唇说道。

"为什么不向你老板 Dolos Macario 讨个差事？我很确信他总有些异见分子需要处理。"

o.en: Look, I just take Diktat money. I'm a merc. Like you were.
o.zh: 听着，我只是拿辛达强权的钱办事而已。我是个佣兵，就和你当年一样。

o.en: I take it that's a 'no', then.
o.zh: 那么，我就认为这是 '拒绝' 的意思了。

o.en: I just take Diktat money. I'm a mercenary. Like you were.
o.zh: 听着，我只是拿辛达强权的钱办事而已。我是个佣兵，就和你当年一样。

o.en: You're a worm compared to the genius of Dolos Macario!
o.zh: 和 Dolos Macario 的才智相比，你不过是条蛆虫！
我就认为这是 '拒绝' 的意思了。

entries.en:
"He calls himself the 'The Spider of Sindria', but that's not right," Rao says. "He's a self-satisfied little worm that's chewed his way into the rotten heart of the Sindrian Diktat. You should meet him."

Rao's smile is cold.

"Go. Meet him. Go on, now." He makes a shoo motion, then slaps the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
"虽然他自称 '辛达瑞亚之蛛'，但其实这并不恰当，" Rao说道，"他不过就是条自鸣得意的蛆虫，啃噬着 辛达强权 那腐烂的心脏，你该去见见他。"

Rao 的笑容十分冰冷。

"去啊，去见他，现在就去。" 他做了个驱赶的手势，随即切断了通讯。

entries.en:
"Correct," he says icily.

He makes a shoo motion. "Off with you."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"没错，" 他冷冰冰地说道。

他做了个驱赶的手势，"滚吧。"

通讯随即被切断了。

entries.en:
"You're not like me," he says. "I was a mercenary, yes. But that was not all I was. And it is not all I am."

"I am a Rao," his voice is full and strong. "I am an officer of the Hegemony Navy despite the best efforts of a few among us who love rules and uniforms more than they love the service and the cause."

He sits back down, a piercing and newly earnest look fixed on you.
entries.zh:
"你可和我不一样，" 他说道，"我确实曾是佣兵。但那并非是我的全部过去，也并非是我的全部现在。"

"我是 Rao 家族的一员，" 他的声音饱满有力，"尽管某些将规章与制服盖过效忠与事业的同僚百般阻挠，我仍是 霸主 海军的军官。"

他重新落座，用锐利而真挚的目光锁定着你。

entries.en:
"You are what you do, not the lies you tell yourself."

He reaches for an interface, pauses, then speaks.

"Now go away."
entries.zh:
"你的所作所为造就了你，而非自我欺骗的谎言。"

他伸手触向操作界面，在停顿片刻后，方才开口道。

"现在离开吧。"

entries.en:
"Hah," Orcus Rao says, rolling his eyes. "We got another one."

He makes a shoo motion. "Off with you."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"哈，" Orcus Rao 翻了个白眼，"又来了个这样的。"

他做了个驱赶的手势，"滚吧。"

通讯随即被切断了。

entries.en: "You're already signed up with the Hegemony. Good. That saves me a lot of bureaucratic nonsense."
entries.zh: "你已经登记加入 霸主 了，很好，这省去我不少官僚程序的麻烦。"

o.en: What sort of work do you need done?
o.zh: 你需要完成什么样的工作？

o.en: You show little respect for your fellow officers of the Hegemony.
o.zh: 你对 霸主 的同僚军官显得缺乏敬意。

o.en: What are these 'unique circumstances'? What is your goal?
o.zh: 这些 '特殊情况' 具体指什么？你的目标是什么？

o.en: Is this about taking down the Sindrian Diktat?
o.zh: 这是为了推翻 辛达强权 吗？

o.en: Why is it personal with Andrada?
o.zh: 你为什么和 Andrada 有私人恩怨？

o.en: I'm not so sure about this.

entries.en:
"As you bear the commission of the Persean League..." He makes a half-shrug. "I can't have you in a position of divided loyalty."

"Let us speak again on the matter if your situation changes."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
entries.zh:
"既然你已经持有 英仙座联盟 的雇佣协议了..." 他半耸着肩膀，"我不能让你处于忠诚分裂的立场。"

"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

他的语气明确表示话题已经结束。暂且如此。

entries.en:
"Seeing as you're a full, albeit junior, member of the Persean League... well, we can't very well divide your loyalties."

"Besides," a fleeting smile appears. "I see you've fallen into Reynard Hannan's orbit. An ego of that size produces a gravity well which is very difficult to escape."
entries.zh:
"鉴于你已经是 英仙座联盟 的正式成员 —— 尽管资历尚浅...但我们很难要求你分割忠诚。"

"况且，" 他的脸上浮现出一抹转瞬即逝的微笑，"我看你已经坠入 Reynard Hannan 的引力范围了。如此庞大的自我意识所产生的重力井，想必是极难挣脱的。"

o.en: My membership in the Persean League is my business.
o.zh: 加入 英仙座联盟 是我的个人事务。

o.en: Reynard is insufferable, but I could not get a better deal.
o.zh: Reynard 令人难以忍受，但我找不到更优的选择了。

o.en: Reynard is a great man. I follow him gladly.
o.zh: Reynard 是个伟大的人，我十分乐意追随他。

entries.en:
"Of course."

He sits back, face falling into shadow.
entries.zh:
"当然。"

他向后靠去，面容隐入阴影之中。

entries.en: "But you made the deal," Rao says impishly. "You didn't have to."
entries.zh: "但交易是你自己达成的，"Rao 狡黠地说道，"你本可拒绝。"

o.en: I don't need to explain myself to you.
I have a plan to get out of it. You'll see.
o.zh: 我有脱身的计划，你很快就会看到的。

o.en: Is the Hegemony offering its protection against the League?
o.zh: 霸主 这是要提供针对联盟的庇护吗？

entries.en:
"Then nothing more need be said."

His tone makes it clear that the conversation is over.
entries.zh:
"那便无需多言了。"

他的语气明确表示谈话到此为止。

entries.en:
Rao holds a finger to his cheek for a moment, thinking.

"It could be earned," he says. "But that's up to you."
entries.zh:
Rao 将手指轻抵脸颊片刻，一边陷入了沉思。

"或许可以争取，" 他说道，"但这取决于你。"

entries.en:
"What admirable loyalty! How Reynard earns it, I've never understood. I must study his leadership closely, for I obviously have much to learn." The sarcasm runs thick.

Rao sits back, face falling into shadow.
entries.zh:
"多么可敬的忠诚！我始终不明白 Reynard 是如何赢得这份忠诚的。我必须仔细研究他的领导艺术，显然我还有很多需要学习。" 话语中夹杂着明显的讽刺意味。

Rao 向后靠去，面容隐入阴影之中。

entries.en:
"Seeing as you're a full, albeit junior, member of the Persean League we can't have you in a position of divided loyalty, can we."

He produces a little shrug. "Let us speak again on the matter if your situation changes."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
entries.zh:
"鉴于你已经是 英仙座联盟 的正式成员 —— 尽管资历尚浅，因此我们无法让你处于忠诚分裂的立场。"

"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

他的语气明确表示话题已经结束。暂且如此。

entries.en:
"Seeing as you're a full, albeit junior, member of the Persean League... we can't have you in a position of divided loyalty, can we."

He produces a little shrug.

"But perhaps," he looks aside. "We might have a mutual friend on Kazeron?"
entries.zh:
"鉴于你已经是 英仙座联盟 的正式成员 —— 尽管资历尚浅，因此我们无法让你处于忠诚分裂的立场。"

他微微耸肩。

"不过或许，" 他侧目看去，"我们在 Kazeron 有共同的朋友？"

o.en: Horus Yaribay, you mean. And his desire for unification with the Hegemony.
o.zh: 你是指 Horus Yaribay，以及他渴望与 霸主 合并的意愿。

o.en: I'm not sure I want to get involved in such a scheme just now.
o.zh: 我目前不确定是否要卷入这样的计划。

entries.en:
He smiles coyly, leaving your statement deliberately unanswered.

"It is possible our work together would serve certain common goals."
entries.zh:
他狡黠地微笑着，刻意不回应你的陈述。

"我们的合作或许能服务于某些共同的目标。"

o.en: Thank you for the offer, but perhaps not just now.
o.zh: 感谢你的提议，但眼下或许不便。

entries.en: "I understand. Keeping with his trust is more important than serving that goal." He leans back, "It's interesting."
entries.zh: "我理解。维护他的信任可比服务那个目标更重要。" 他向后靠去，"这很有趣。"

o.en: Speculate if you like, I have nothing to say.
