o.zh: 你尽管猜测，而我就无可奉告了。

o.en: Hypothetically, I would require the consent of the third party before discussing anything.
o.zh: 在假设的情况下，我在讨论任何事情之前都需要获得第三方的同意。

o.en: I'm not sure I want to get involved in such a scheme just now.
o.zh: 我目前还不确定是否要卷入这样的计划。

entries.en: Rao raises an eyebrow, his expression amused.
entries.zh: Rao 扬起一侧眉毛，神色玩味。

entries.en:
"Nothing more need be said."

His tone makes it clear that the conversation is over.
entries.zh:
"无需多言了。"

他的语气明确表示谈话到此为止。

entries.en:
"Let us speak again on the matter if your situation changes."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
entries.zh:
"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

他的语气明确表示谈话到此为止。

entries.en:
"I'd like to offer you work. You don't have to salute me, and I'll make sure you're paid promptly."

He leans forward, his hands together. "What do you think? Could be fun. Play your cards right, and you'll be a legend."
entries.zh:
"我想给你提供工作。你不必向我敬礼，而我也会确保报酬能够及时支付。"

他倾身向前，双手交握，"你意下如何？这或许会很有趣。如果你打得一手好牌的话，就将会成为传奇。"

entries.en:
"There's rules to break when you need to win, and there's betrayal. These are very different things, fundamentally so, captain. He and I have done the former, but he threw away his honor with the latter."

"We are not. the. same." Rao's words come out slow, and cold.
entries.zh:
"为追求胜利而打破规则，与背信弃义可是两回事。它们本质上天差地别，舰长。他与我都曾践行前者，但他为后者而抛弃了荣誉。"

"我们并·非·同·类。" Rao 的话语缓慢而冰冷。

entries.en:
Rao lets out a slow breath. "That's talk for old comrades, over drink."

He leans back, not quite committing to a frown.

"Patience, captain."
entries.zh:
Rao 缓缓呼出一口气，"那是老战友间把酒言欢时的谈资。"

他向后靠去，眉间并未完全皱起。

"耐心些，舰长。"

entries.en:
"The truth makes few friends." Rao produces a wry smile.

"I never could stand a fool, especially when that fool is an honorable member of the Strategic Assembly. So," he holds his hand out to indicate his surroundings, Ragnar Complex.

"It's not so bad."
entries.zh:
"真相鲜少赢得朋友。" Rao 露出讥诮的微笑。

"我向来无法容忍蠢材，尤其当他们是战略指挥部的成员时。所以，" 他伸手示意周围的环境 —— Ragnar 综合设施。

"这里还不算太糟。"

entries.en:
"I'm offering you the chance to be the grit that throws history off its axis."

He lets his sly smile fade. "There are many bodies of power turning just now. Grinding away, warships and bombings and riots and resources."

"The Persean Sector needs change, or it will grind what's left of us to dust."
entries.zh:
"我正在给予你成为历史转折点的机会。"

他慢慢收起他那狡黠的微笑，"此刻正有许多权力机构正在运转。缓慢地碾磨着 —— 战舰、轰炸、暴动、资源。"

"英仙座星域需要变革，否则它将把我们仅存的一切碾作尘埃。"

entries.en:
A cold, quick expression passes over his face.

"Let us say that I'd be as satisfied as any Hegemony officer to cut down that pompous traitor. Setting aside even the matter of honor, I have a personal dislike of the man."
entries.zh:
一抹冰冷而迅疾的神色掠过他的脸庞。

"可以说，与任何 霸主 军官一样，能除掉那个自负的叛徒会令我深感快意。即便撇开荣誉问题不谈，我个人也极度厌恶此人。"

entries.en:
"A proper officer of the Hegemony is taught to leap toward the enemy, blazing guns. Once the noise quiets down, they'll wait, slack-jawed, for the medals to be pinned to their uniforms."

"Such is the way of the Domain, which we must uphold."

He half-raises a finger, a quirk on his lips. "Officially," he concludes.
entries.zh:
"正统的 霸主 军官被教导要随着枪口的火光冲向敌阵。待硝烟散去，他们便张着嘴等待勋章别上军装。"

"此乃 人之领 之道，我等必须恪守。"

他微抬手指，嘴角轻扬，"官方说法如此，" 他总结道。

entries.en:
"Baikal was kind enough to find me a place where I could get important work done. I deal with... let us call them 'unique circumstances'. And for this I find it necessary to associate with energetic freelancers."

"I'll ensure you're paid promptly for a roster of small merc jobs."

"Then, perhaps something big will come up. When it does, I want to know I can count on you."
entries.zh:
"Baikal 好意为我寻得一处能处理重要事务的地方。我要处理的是...不妨让我们称之为 '特殊情况'。为此，我需要有活力的自由职业者。"

"我会确保你接手的小型雇佣任务都能及时获得报酬。"

"届时，或许会有重大机遇降临。当那一刻来临时，我希望能与你建立信任。"

entries.en:
"You've got promise, captain. You know how to slip out of a trap. You know how to use any means available to win."

He pauses. "It speaks well for what I have in mind.""
entries.zh:
"你很有潜力，舰长。你懂得如何挣脱陷阱，懂得如何不择手段地取得胜利。"

他停顿片刻，"这正契合我心中的构想。"

o.en: And what do you have in mind?

entries.en: "You've got promise, captain." He pauses. "And I believe you have the experience to handle what I've got in mind."
entries.zh: "你很有潜力，舰长。" 他停顿片刻，"而且我相信，以你的经验足以胜任我心中的计划。"

o.en: And what do you have in mind?

entries.en:
"You have promise, captain. Especially if your captaining is anything like your swordplay. You spilled blood for honor in personal combat. That is more than most can say."

He pauses. "It speaks well for you, for what I have in mind."
entries.zh:
"你很有潜力，舰长，尤其是你那与自身剑术造诣相当益彰的指挥才能。你曾为荣誉在个人决斗中血溅三尺，这已胜过多数人所能言。"

他停顿片刻，"这为你增光添彩，也契合我心中的构想。"

o.en: And what do you have in mind?

entries.en:
"You have promise, captain. You were brave enough to take up the sword with full knowledge of the art, fight... and lose. Your blood was spilled for honor in personal combat. That is more than most can say."

He pauses. "It speaks well for you, for what I have in mind."
entries.zh:
"你很有潜力，舰长。你足够勇敢，在通晓剑艺的情况下执剑应战...并败北。你曾为荣誉在个人决斗中血溅三尺，这已胜过多数人所能言。"

他停顿片刻，"这为你增光添彩，也契合我心中的构想。"

o.en: And what do you have in mind?

entries.en:
"You have promise, captain, that's true. But," he takes on an avuncular tone, "I don't think you've got enough experience to handle what I've got in mind."

"Put yourself out there, take on some jobs. We may speak again on this later."

His tone makes it clear that the issue is settled. For now.
entries.zh:
"你确实很有潜力，舰长。但是，" 他的语气转为长辈式的教诲，"我认为你尚且缺乏足够经验，不足以处理我所构思的事情。"

"去历练吧，承接些任务。我们或许可以日后再议此事。"

他的语气明确表示话题已经结束。暂且如此。

entries.en:
"You've found lucrative employment of a sort with the Tri-Tachyon corporation, however."

He leans back. "We could discuss this matter again if that situation were to change."
entries.zh:
"然而，你已经在 速子科技 找到某种利润丰厚的差事了。"

他向后靠去，"如果你的状况发生变化了，我们可以再谈论此事。"

o.en: What's a war hero doing at this insignificant outpost?
o.zh: 一位战争英雄怎么会出现在这偏僻的前哨站？

entries.en:
He blows some air out through his nostrils, barely a laugh.

"Trading tired banter with you, it appears." He makes a show of checking a secondary display. For the time, perhaps.

"I am busy, if you can believe it. Perhaps you had something useful, or at least interesting to say?"
entries.zh:
他从鼻腔里呼出一丝气流，勉强算作笑声。

"看来又是这种老套的寒暄。" 他如同刻意展示般地瞥了眼副屏幕 —— 或许是在看时间。

"我很忙，信不信由你。或许你有什么有用，或至少有趣的话要说？"

entries.en:
"The Director of Special Acquisitions."

His eyes narrow.

"What'd you get into? You didn't agree to anything she offered, did you?"
entries.zh:
"特殊采购部总监。"

他眯起了眼睛。

"你这是卷入什么事了？你没答应她提出的什么条件吧？"

o.en: Have you had any dealing with Zunya Glamor-Rotanev?
o.zh: 你和 Zunya Glamor-Rotanev 有过任何往来吗？

o.en: Have you had any dealing with Zunya Glamor-Rotanev?
o.zh: 你和 Zunya Glamor-Rotanev 有过任何往来吗？

entries.en:
"Okay." $heOrShe says, giving you a skeptical look. "Perhaps there's a more profitable discussion we could have."
OR
$HeOrShe frowns. "My time isn't cheap, you know."
OR
"I should be charging by the minute," he says to himself.
OR
"Sure," he says, with a skeptical look. "What's your next pitch?"
OR
He simply sighs.
entries.zh:
"好吧。\" $heOrShe说着，怀疑地看了你一眼，\"也许我们能聊点更有赚头的事。"
OR
$HeOrShe几乎要皱起眉头。"我的时间可不便宜，你知道的。"
OR
"真该按分钟跟你收费，" 他自言自语地嘟囔了一句。
OR
"行吧，\" 他狐疑地看了你一眼，\"你下一套说辞又是什么？"
OR
他只是叹了口气。

entries.en:
Your comms connect.

"Arroyo here. Who's talking?"

Rayan Arroyo looks you over disapprovingly, as if examining a luxury starship hull for scratches.
OR
"This better be good."

Rayan Arroyo looks you over disapprovingly, then says "Remind me to take you shopping for a proper suit. I know a guy who can do wonders."
OR
The animated logo of some Tri-Tachyon sub-department makes half of a rotation before the call is answered.

"Arroyo. Make it quick."

He looks you over, with a frown. "Oh. You. What is it?
entries.zh:
你发出了通讯请求，某种 速子科技 分部的商标在通讯得到应答前缓缓地转了半圈。

"这里是 Arroyo，你是哪位？" Rayan Arroyo 不以为然地看着你，他的目光就像在一艘豪华的星舰上寻找着划痕。
OR
"你带来的最好是好消息。" Rayan Arroyo 不以为然地看着你，"记得提醒我带你去买一套合适的西装，我认识一个能把西装做得很好看的人。"
OR
"这里是 Arroyo，有话快说。" Rayan Arroyo 看到是你，皱了皱眉。"喔，是你。这次又有什么事？"

entries.en: "I need a datacore swapped with one from some ruins on a planet out on the Fringe, an easy job."
entries.zh: "我需要用数据核心掉包另一个在边缘星区遗迹里的其他数据核心。这活很简单。"

entries.en:
Your sensors officer reports that a high-powered scan of the coordinates provided shows the $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target is long abandoned, but appears relatively intact.

However, there is also a fresh burnt-out shuttle in a nearby landing complex. On the obvious approach path is the scar of a debris field, apparently created by the low-velocity impact of a second shuttle. Nearby ruins show signs of some light orbital bombardment, likely retaliatory.

It appears as though a lightly-equipped scavenger attempted this operation once before and was caught off guard by the local decivs. Your sensors officer coordinates targeted scans with Tactical to estimate hostile combat capabilities.
entries.zh:
在对提供的坐标进行高能扫描之后，传感器技官报告说 $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target 虽然废弃了很久，但还算是完整。

然而，在附近的降落设施上，也发现了一艘刚刚耗尽燃料没多久的穿梭机，在降落轨迹上还留下了一片明显的残骸区，看来是另一艘穿梭机遭到低速碰撞造成的。附近的建筑遗迹似乎也受到了小规模轨道轰炸，可能是出于报复。

看来在你之前，就有过一群装备不足的拾荒者来执行任务，并且在放松警惕的时候被当地蛮荒人偷袭了。传感器技官与战术军官互相协调进行精确扫描，确认敌方战斗力。

o.en: Consider a ground operation to retrieve the data
o.zh: 考虑地面作战来获取数据

o.en: Drop 10 units of supplies at a nearby location to distract the locals
o.zh: 在附近投下 10 单位补给，来分散当地人的注意力

entries.en: Your marines provide security while a small salvage team carefully accesses the $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target and swaps out the specified data core.
entries.zh: 在你陆战队员的保护下，一小支打捞小组小心地进入了 $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target，替换了指定的数据核心。

entries.en:
"I should think you'd know better than to ask," $heOrShe produces a thin smile. "Perhaps you fear some risk to your $shipOrFleet and reputation? I didn't take you for a coward, but I'll indulge you this once."

"I have intel which suggests that the datacore contains specifications for an obscure industrial process which is marginally more effective than common methods. Without specialized knowledge, its value is difficult to recognize. Equally difficult is finding a buyer who is in a position to make good use of this alternative process. The stars have aligned for me, however, and I am willing to share a portion of my anticipated profits for your service."

"Satisfied?"
entries.zh:
"我想你应该知道，这种事最好别问，" $heOrShe露出一丝浅笑，"或许你是担心你的$shipOrFleet和名声会受到什么风险？我还以为你没那么懦夫，但这次我就迁就一下你吧。"

"我收到的情报显示，那个数据核心中包含了一种鲜为人知的生产工艺的使用说明，它比常见的工艺稍微有效一些。没有专业知识的话，很难认识到它的价值。同样困难的是找到一个能够充分利用这种替代工艺的买家。不过，这次幸运女神站在我这边，我愿意分享一部分未来收益来换取你的服务。"

"满意了？"

o.en: Why do a swap, why not just take the datacore?
o.zh: 为什么还要再放个核心上去，直接拿走东西不就完事了？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe rolls $hisOrHer eyes. "So that the process contained therein appears to be a new invention," $heOrShe says slowly, as if to a simple child.

"The swapped core will soon be discovered by a scavenger who will find that it contains the common-knowledge process rather than the unique one actually developed by $rdsm_megacorpName. This will create substantial evidence to 'prove' that the process is a unique discovery, which will make it much more profitable to patent in the polities across the Sector that bother with that sort of thing."

"It comes down to credits, $playerName. From your perspective, $rdsm_reward credits. And that's all that should concern you. Understand?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe翻了个白眼。"因为，这种做法会让核心里的独特工艺显得像是一项新发明，" $heOrShe像哄小孩那样慢悠悠的说到。

"很快，拾荒者就会找到这枚掉包过的核心，但这枚核心里面只有常见的工艺，没有 $rdsm_megacorpName 开发的独特工艺。由此，便能实实在在的 '证明' 这项工艺如何独一无二，进而在星域中那些关心专利的公司里多捞出点油水。"

"归根结底是星币，$playerName。对你来说，就是 $rdsm_reward 星币。这才是你应该关心的。明白了吗？"

o.en: But what if someone finds another copy of $rdsm_megacorpName's process?
o.zh: 但是，如果有人再找到另一份 $rdsm_megacorpName 工艺的备份，又该怎么办？

entries.en:
"You don't quit, do you?"

$HeOrShe sighs. "My buyer will simply declare that they faked this hypothetical second discovery to undermine the patent."
entries.zh:
"还真是执着啊你，是不是？"

$HeOrShe叹了口气。"那我的买家就会宣布他们这次发现是伪造的，是对于买家专利权的蓄意破坏。"

o.en: And that hypothetical second copy of the process was recovered before the fake datacore was found...
o.zh: 万一，在有人找到我们掉包的数据核心之前，就有别人找到了另一份备份的话...

entries.en:
"I will arrange for the prompt discovery of the datacore you leave behind by an unknowing scavenger," $heOrShe snaps, patience nearly at an end. "Obviously."

"Enough chatter. Are you in or out?"
entries.zh:
"我会引导不知情的拾荒者去 '发现' 你掉包的数据核心的。" $heOrShe语气渐渐严厉，看来$heOrShe的耐心已经快要耗尽了，"很明显的事。"

"聊得够多了，你到底是干还是不干？"

o.en: Ask about the 'easy' datacore swap job
o.zh: 问问这个 '简单' 的数据核心掉包任务

entries.en:
"Our partnership has been productive," $heOrShe says, "I trust you can handle the simple requirements of this task."

$HeOrShe taps at a datapad, summoning a starmap. "There is an abandoned $rdsm_target on $rdsm_planetName in the $rdsm_systemName, $rdsm_dist light-years away. It was once property of the $rdsm_megacorpName megacorporation, not that it's mattered for 200 cycles."

"I will provide you with a datacore and a precise diagram of the $rdsm_target. Exchange my datacore for the one you will find per my specifications. Make it look natural, like it's been untouched since the Collapse."

"If there's anything else around to plunder in the colony, have at it. My only concern is that the datacore is in place and the one you find is returned here to me. You'll be paid $rdsm_reward credits when you return to me with the datacore."
entries.zh:
"我们的合作一直很高效，" $heOrShe说，"我相信你能完成这个简单的任务。"

$HeOrShe滑动数据平板，召唤出一张星图。"在距离这里 $rdsm_dist 光年处，$rdsm_systemName 中的 $rdsm_planetName 上，有一座废弃的 $rdsm_target。它曾属于 $rdsm_megacorpName 集团，但那已经是 200 星历年以前的事情了。"

"我会给你提供一个数据核心和一份关于 $rdsm_target 的准确示意图。找到我需要的数据核心，用我给你的数据核心替换原有那个。做的自然点，让它看起来就像大崩塌以来一直未被触碰过。"

"如果殖民地周围还有其它有价值的东西，尽管带走。我唯一关心的是，我的数据核心要放在原位，而你找到的那个要拿回来给我。等你带着数据核心回来时，我会付你 $rdsm_reward 星币。"

o.en: "What's on this datacore that's so important?
o.zh: 这个数据核心为什么如此重要？

entries.en:
"Our partnership has been productive," $heOrShe says, "I trust you can handle the simply requirements of this task."

$HeOrShe taps at a datapad, summoning a starmap. "There is an abandoned $rdsm_target on $rdsm_planetName in $rdsm_systemName, $rdsm_dist light-years away. It was once property of the $rdsm_megacorpName megacorporation, not that it's mattered for 200 cycles."

"I will provide you with a datacore and a precise diagram of the $rdsm_target. Exchange my datacore for the one you will find per my specifications. Make it look natural, like it's been untouched since the Collapse."

"If there's anything else around to plunder in the colony, have at it. My only concern is that the my datacore is in place and the one you find is returned here to me. And one more thing..."
entries.zh:
"我们的合作一直很高效，" $heOrShe说，"我相信你能完成这个简单的任务。"

$HeOrShe滑动数据平板，召唤出一张星图。"在距离这里 $rdsm_dist 光年处，$rdsm_systemName 中的 $rdsm_planetName 上，有一座废弃的 $rdsm_target。它曾属于 $rdsm_megacorpName 集团，但那已经是 200 星历年以前的事情了。"

"我会给你提供一个数据核心和一份关于 $rdsm_target 的准确示意图。找到我需要的数据核心，用我给你的数据核心替换原有那个。做的自然点，让它看起来就像大崩塌以来一直未被触碰过。"

"如果殖民地周围还有其它有价值的东西，尽管带走。我唯一关心的是，我的数据核心要放在原位，而你找到的那个要拿回来给我。另外，还有一件事..."

entries.en:
"You should be aware, however, that there have been reports of decivs on $rdsm_marketName. They may be... hostile." $HeOrShe smiles rather carnivorously, then says "I recommend bringing at least $rdsm_marinesReq to ensure the safety of your operation."

"You'll be paid $rdsm_reward credits when you return to me with the datacore."
entries.zh:
"不过，你应该知道，有报告称在 $rdsm_marketName 上有些蛮荒人，他们可能会... 具有敌意。" $HeOrShe露出肉食动物般的微笑，然后说道，"为了确保行动安全，我建议至少带上 $rdsm_marinesReq 名陆战队员。"

"你回来并交付数据核心后，将会获得 $rdsm_reward 星币。"

o.en: "What's on this datacore that's so important?
o.zh: 这个数据核心为什么如此重要？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe smiles carnivorously, "Yes, of course. You'll be paid $rdsm_reward credits when you return and deliver the datacore."

"You should be aware, however, that there have been reports of decivs on $rdsm_marketName. They may be... hostile. I recommend bringing at least $rdsm_marinesReq to ensure the safety of your operation."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe露出了肉食动物般的微笑，"好吧，当然。你回来并交付数据核心后，将会获得 $rdsm_reward 星币。"

"不过，你应该知道，有报告称在 $rdsm_marketName 上出现了蛮荒人，他们可能会... 具有敌意。为了确保行动安全，我建议至少带上 $rdsm_marinesReq 名陆战队员。"

o.en: Why do a swap, why not just take the datacore?
o.zh: 为什么还要再放个核心上去，直接拿走东西不就完事了？

entries.en:
You order a small salvage team deployed.

Under the close watch of your operations chief, they access the $rdsm_target and exchange the new datacore for the old.
entries.zh:
你命令投放一小支打捞小组。

行动长官仔细观察着打捞小组进入 $rdsm_target，用新的核心替换了原有的那个。

entries.en:
You order a few cargo crates loaded with supplies then rigged with visual-audio-radio emergency beacons and disposable landing rockets.

It's an old trick when dealing with decivs, but it usually works. Whether they accept the supplies as payment, bribery, or simply relatively high tech goods in an environment largely cut off from interstellar commerce, the value of these crates is literally astronomical.

You watch a cluster of crates shrink to spots, then disappear into the face of $name.
entries.zh:
你调来了几箱补给，给它们装上了声光无线电三合一紧急信标，还有一次性着陆火箭。

这算是处理蛮荒人的常用手段，但一般都能起效。不管他们是把这些补给当成你的报酬、贿赂，还是单纯知道在这种基本和星际经贸无缘的环境里，这些补给算是罕有相对高科技的产物，这几箱东西总之对他们能算得上价值非凡。

你看着几个补给箱渐渐变成小点，最后消失在 $name 的地表。

entries.en:
"Drop telemetry reads successful surface contact," your sensors officer reports, who taps at their console then mumbles something into another comms channel. "Confirmed by $shipOrFleet instruments."

Tactical signals acknowledgement, then says "Mission is go."

The landing shuttles glitter with a burst of propulsion then drop in silent formation toward the surface. The cargo drop was close enough to the target zone to distract any decivs present, but far enough - hopefully - to clear or persuade away any active resistance.

Within minutes, shuttles report unimpeded landing. Salvor crews deploy immediately through the settling dust cloud, only lightly armed to ensure maximum operational speed.
entries.zh:
"遥测数据显示已成功建立地表联系。" 你的传感器技官报告道，他轻敲控制台，然后在另一个通讯频道低声说了些什么，"$shipOrFleet的仪器已对此进行了确认。"

战术信号得到了确认，随后传来指令："任务继续。"

在推进器的一阵闪光中，登陆穿梭机以静默的队形向地表降落。登陆仓投放位置距离目标区域足够近，足以分散所有在场蛮荒人的注意力，但也足够远 —— 希望如此 —— 以清除或劝退任何可能的主动抵抗。

几分钟后，穿梭机报告已顺利着陆。打捞小组迅速穿过逐渐散去的烟尘进行部署，他们仅携带了轻武器，以确保最大的行动速度。

entries.en:
The small salvage team accesses the $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target, cutting through sealed locks and blasting weak points as needed. Their work is sloppy, even crude, compared to your ops chief's usual standards - intentionally so. The physical evidence of your crews' intrusion is meant to appear to be the work of local decivs' random plundering rather than a targeted job.

Objective found, your salvors swap out the specified data core and install the fake. They carefully create the appearance of random tampering, plundering a few obvious modular and interface components that would be of interest to cut-off decivs, then re-dust the scene.

From orbit, your sensors officer spots movement in nearby terrain; armed locals. The salvors perform a quick evac before they can bring heavy weapons to bear and, aside from a few light energy weapon burns on the shuttle plating, there's no harm done.
entries.zh:
打捞小组成功潜入了 $rdsm_megacorpName 的 $rdsm_target，他们破除了密码锁，并在必要时对薄弱点进行了爆破。与行动长官平日执行任务的严谨标准相比，这次行动显得颇为马虎，甚至有些粗鲁 —— 但这正是他们有意为之。这样做的目的是为了让船员们入侵的痕迹更像是当地蛮荒人随性掠夺的结果，而非有针对性的行动。

确认目标后，打捞人员迅速替换了指定的数据核心，并安装了伪造的数据核心。他们细心地制造出了随机破坏的假象，带走了一些会引起蛮荒人兴趣的模块和接口组件，然后重新布置了现场，覆盖灰尘以掩盖痕迹。

从轨道上，你的传感器技官报告附近地形中有移动痕迹；是本地武装力量。在他们架设重型武器之前，打捞小组迅速撤离。除了穿梭机外壳上留下几处轻型能量武器的灼烧痕迹外，并未受到任何伤害。

entries.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making a ground operation impossible.
entries.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法开展地面行动。

o.en: I have the $rdsm_megacorpName datacore for you.
o.zh: 我拿到了你要的 $rdsm_megacorpName 数据核心。

entries.en:
$PersonName's eyes light up. "Excellent work, captain!"

You give orders for delivery of the core while $heOrShe transfers you your reward.
entries.zh:
$PersonName 眼神一亮。"干得漂亮，舰长！"

在$heOrShe支付报酬的同时，你下令移交核心。

entries.en: Your sensors officer reports that a high-powered scan of the coordinates provided shows the $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target is long abandoned, but appears to be in relatively good shape.
entries.zh: 在对提供的坐标进行高能扫描之后，传感器技官报告说 $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target 虽然废弃了很久，但状况相对还算好。

o.en: Send a team down to retrieve the data

entries.en:
"Acknowledged," $heOrShe says, seemingly frozen.

At a loss for words, $heOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
"了解。" $heOrShe愣住了，怔怔地说道。

$heOrShe一言不发，伸手切断了通讯。

entries.en:
"Acknowledged," $heOrShe says, seemingly frozen.

At a loss for words, $heOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
"了解。" $heOrShe愣住了，怔怔地说道。

$heOrShe一言不发，伸手切断了通讯。

entries.en: You are trusted and valued by $theFaction, green-lit by patrols and port authorities alike, and have considerable access to high-level officials. You are given much leeway, and may receive trade concessions and access to high-quality ships and munitions.
entries.zh: 你深受 $theFaction 的信任与尊重，巡逻队和港务局对你大开绿灯，同高层官员会面接洽也不是难事。你能从诸多事物中获得回旋的余地，可以在交易中争得更大的让利空间，并有资格获取高质量的舰船与武器。

entries.en: You are considered an exemplar of the Andradan Ideal. Patrol officers know that their careers, and perhaps lives, depend on making your life as pleasant as possible. A rather grand holo-version of you is featured in propaganda segments extolling your embodiment of the values the Supreme Executor forges in the worthy.
entries.zh: 你被视做挺身维护 Andrada 伟大愿景的楷模。巡逻队指挥官知道他们的事业前程，甚至身家性命，都取决于他们能否尽心尽力确保你的日常生活能够顺风顺水。在辛达的全息宣传短片中，你作为最高元首思想所铸核心价值观的伟大践行者出场，形象被塑造得比平日里更加伟岸。

entries.en: You are considered an exemplar of the Achillean Ideal. Patrol officers know that their careers will be served by treating you with dutiful respect. A rather grand holo-version of you is featured in the occasional propaganda segments broadcast throughout the Askonia system.
entries.zh: 你被视作 Achillean Ideal 的典范。巡逻军官心里都清楚，恭恭敬敬地待你，于他们的前程大有好处。Askonia 星系里不时播放的宣传片段中，还会出现一个格外气派的你的全息形象。

entries.en: You are trusted and valued by $theFaction, green-lit by patrols and port authorities alike, and have considerable access to high-level officials. You are given much leeway, and may receive trade concessions and access to high-quality ships and munitions.
entries.zh: 你深受 $theFaction 的信任与尊重，巡逻队和港务局对你大开绿灯，同高层官员会面接洽也不是难事。你能从诸多事物中获得回旋的余地，可以在交易中争得更大的让利空间，并有资格获取高质量的舰船与武器。

entries.en: Independent fleet operators and leading officials of non-aligned polities consider you a friend and valuable asset. You are favored in business and contracts, given priority docking access, and invited to dine with VIPs. You are given great leeway due to the goodwill you have earned.
entries.zh: 独立舰队的运营者和中立政体的领导阶层将你视为宝贵的财富和亲密的友人。你在生意场上与合同中能够得到较为有利的条款，获得港口的优先停泊权，并受邀与 VIP 们一起进餐。因为这份你为自己挣来的好感，你在大部分事务中都能获得许多回旋的余地。

entries.en: You are upheld as a friend, ally, and patriot of the League (and the gens); an example held high for those building a new, free system of federated polities among the stars to counter those who would recast the chains of Domain hegemony.
entries.zh: 你被 英仙座联盟 (以及其内部各氏族) 视作朋友，盟友，爱国者；你为那些想要在星系中建立一个全新而自由的联邦政体的人树立了一个很好的榜样，用以对抗那些想重拾 人之领 霸权的人。

entries.en: Truly, you walk with Ludd. Even the most pious curates concede that your worldly actions have bolstered the Faith, and they pray for your wellbeing. The Knights of Ludd put great trust in your handling of technology for righteous cause. Even heretical sects admire your conduct, despite their departures from Church canon.
entries.zh: 无疑，你行在卢德之道上。即便最虔诚的祭司也承认你的世俗行为支持着信仰，他们愿为你的幸福祈祷。卢德骑士充分信任你为正义驱使着科技。即使是异端派系也钦佩你的行为，即使那悖离了教会的教义。

entries.en: Truly, you walk upon the Path. It is not a Path of peace, and it marches ceaselessly toward the end-time, which is soon. Your fellow Walkers will keep Faith with you, whether into the blessed martyrdom of battle or into the great unknown that is God's plan, revealed only to the prophets such as Ludd and, some say, Brother Cotton.
entries.zh: 诚然，你已踏上了卢德之道。这并非是一条平坦的道途，每一次的迈步前行都只会向并不遥远的末日更进一步。同行之人将和你一起共守誓约，无论是要迈向神圣的光荣殉道之战，还是将要接受神赐的伟大未知试炼。只有最伟大的先知，比如卢德本人或者某些人认为值此称号的 Cotton 修士，才有能力揭示你的命运。

entries.en: Your exploits are legendary and inspire scores of imitators. Your underworld connections and influence are enviable, giving access to black markets and hired guns; a river of hot goods, drugs, and armaments are available at your whim.
entries.zh: 你的事迹已经成为传说故事，激励了无数的模仿者。你在犯罪社会里的人脉与影响力惹人眼红，各地的黑市与地下佣兵都对你敞开怀抱。只要你想，就会有一条满溢着走私货物、违禁药物和军火的河流随你取用。

entries.en: The board of directors considers you an exemplar of the corporation's core values as well as a key strategic partner. VPs use management methods based on the growth-focused synergies you inspire. Vast investment capital and technical expertise are made available through your Tri-Tachyon connections.
entries.zh: 董事会已经认定您是一位重要的战略合作伙伴，需作为公司重要的核心盈利指标加以考量。根据您规模增长与优势集中两者协调并重的理念，多位副总裁都采取了全新的管理模式。凭借您和 速子科技 的关系，您可以调动大量的投资基金和技术支持。

entries.en: There are rumors that you're a double or triple-agent working for - or against? - Dolos Macario.
entries.zh: 有传言说你是 Dolos Macario 的双面特工，搞不好还是个要收拾他的三面特工。

entries.en: The $faction officials tend to view you favorably, though this has little in the way of implications. At best, you might be sold some low-grade surplus military equipment, or avoid being the target of an investigation if a more convenient scapegoat is available.
entries.zh: $faction 的官员普遍对你抱有好感，不过这影响并不大。充其量，你只是能被允许购买一些低档的过剩军用装备，或是在有其他更趁手的替罪羊时避免成为审查的首要目标。

entries.en: You have been flagged as a known quantity in the records kept by the Sindrian Diktat security apparatus. Officials tend to view you favorably, though don't go out of their way to make life easy. At best, you might be sold some low-grade surplus military equipment, or avoid being the target of an investigation if a more convenient scapegoat is available.
entries.zh: 在 辛达强权 政府安全机构保有的记录中，你已经被标注为了一个所谓的已知数。官员们普遍对你抱有好感，但他们也不至于为了让你过的更轻松太过尽心尽力。充其量，你只是能被允许购买一些低档的过剩军用装备，或是在有其他更趁手的替罪羊时避免成为审查的首要目标。

entries.en: You have been flagged as a known quantity in the records kept by the reformed Sindrian Diktat security apparatus. Officials tend to view you favorably, though don't go out of their way to make life easy. At best, you might be sold some low-grade surplus military equipment, or avoid being the target of an investigation if it involves more than the usual bother.
entries.zh: 改革后的辛达强权安全机构所存的档案里，你已被标注为一个"已知数"。官员们普遍对你抱有好感，却也不会特意替你行方便。往好里说，你或许能买到些低档的过剩军用装备，或是在某桩审查格外麻烦时免于被盯上。

entries.en: You have earned a begrudging respect from the Hegemony bureaucracy. Officers tend to be less strict with you, though this has few practical implications. At best you might be sold low-grade surplus equipment and avoid being the target of a quota-meeting investigation.
entries.zh: 你勉强得到了 霸主 官僚系统的尊重。官员们普遍会对你不那么严格，尽管这没有什么实际影响。充其量，你只是能被允许购买一些低档的过剩装备，并且能避免成为例行审查的目标。

entries.en: You are considered a reliable operator by the independent fleet operations and minor polities of the Persean Sector. You are welcome in matters of business.
entries.zh: 你被英仙座星域的独立舰队与地方小型政体们视为可靠的合作伙伴，因此他们也很欢迎你与其做交易。

entries.en: You are considered a reliable operator among the worlds of the Persean League and by their shared navy. The gens of Kazeron even welcome you in matters of business, though you are still considered an outsider.
entries.zh: 在 英仙座联盟 和他们的海军中，你被当做了个可靠的人，可以依赖于你。Kazeron 的几个氏族都愿意与你做生意，即使你还是被当做外来者。

entries.en: You are greeted by the Faithful with a warmth of neighborliness, nothing more. You know the words and the signs that offer respect to the Church of Galactic Redemption, and for that many, but not all, of them return that respect.
entries.zh: 信徒们待你温如睦邻，但也仅此而已。你知晓如何用言行和举止向银河救赎教会表示敬重，他们绝大部分也会对你以礼相待。

entries.en: Your name is spoken occasionally in the secret networks of the Luddic Path, and it is spoken of with tentative trust and praise. Still, the Path is a loose association and some fanatic might still get the wrong idea and try to extort a tithe from you, or worse.
entries.zh: 你的名字时常在左径的秘密网络当中被提起，也常伴随委婉的赞扬与信任。尽管如此，左径仍然是一个松散的联盟，一些狂热分子可能仍然会有错误的认识并试图从你那里勒索什一税，甚至更糟。

entries.en: You've been around pirates, smugglers, and other criminals often enough, and know how to act so they treat you as one of their own. The benefits of this comradeliness are dubious at best, of course, because they're known to gun one another down if enough credits are on the line.
entries.zh: 你经常混迹于海盗、走私者或其他罪犯之中，学会了如何行事才能让他们视你为同伙。当然，这种同僚关系是否有利可图只能说值得怀疑，毕竟众所周知，只要有星币能入账，火并一下算得了什么？

entries.en: Due to your status as a valued partner, the standard oxygen and agrav convenience fee has been waived for your visits to Tri-Tachyon or subsidiary owned facilities.
entries.zh: 鉴于你与 速子科技 重要合作伙伴的身份，你无需在访问 速子科技 及其子公司的设施时缴纳标准氧气及人造重力设施使用费。

entries.en: You're relatively well-known within $theFaction, whether in person or by reputation. Minor functionaries know to stay out of your way.
entries.zh: 你在 $theFaction 内部已经小有名气，不少人都对你有所耳闻，或是有所私交。官场里的小角色都知道别去碍着你的事。

entries.en: You've been flagged for official treatment as a trusted supporter of the Andradan Movement, a friend and ally of Sindrian Diktat authority. Minor functionaries know that their careers and possibly lives depend on easing your business with Diktat-controlled volumes.
entries.zh: 在 辛达强权 政府的官方的接待准则中，你被标注为一位 Andrada 伟大运动的坚定支持者，是一位老朋友，一个好伙伴。基层公务员都很清楚，你在辛达领空内的公务是否顺利，是一件事关他们事业前程乃至身家性命的头等大事。

entries.en: You've been flagged for official treatment as a trusted supporter of the Achillean Reform Movement, a friend and ally of Reformed Sindrian Diktat authority. Minor functionaries know not to risk their careers by troubling your business within Diktat-controlled volumes.
entries.zh: 你已被官方列为 Achillean Reform Movement 的可靠支持者，是改革后的辛达强权当局的朋友与盟友。基层小吏都明白，在辛达控制下的空域里找你麻烦，等于拿自己的前程冒险。

entries.en: You are well known to the Hegemony, and admired. Officers respect your steadfastness and civilian personnel appreciative of your honest dealing. Functionaries learn that not every rule applies to you, and that you are trusted with restricted military hardware.
entries.zh: 你的大名广闻于 霸主。你的正直受军官们的尊敬，你的坦诚受文官们的赞赏。公务员们清楚，有些规定可能并不适用于你，而他们对你的信任足以让你弄到管制的军用装备。

entries.en: You have a good reputation with more than a few high-level independent fleet commanders and non-aligned polity officials in the Persean Sector. You are considered a good operator, favored in matters of business and easily forgiven minor indiscretions.
entries.zh: 在英仙座星域你声名大噪，不少高级独立舰队的长官和中立政体的官员们都对你刮目相看。你被人们认为精明能干，在各种事务中备受青睐，就算犯了点小错，他们也会选择不予追究。

entries.en: You are given friendly welcome by agents of the Persean League, including fleet, customs, and intelligence services. The great gens of Kazeron favor you in matters of business and easily forgive minor indiscretions.
entries.zh: 英仙座联盟的政治代理，包括舰队、海关，以及情报部门都对你表示友好欢迎。Kazeron 的几个显赫氏族在各类事务上十分青睐你，就算犯了点小错，他们也会选择不予追究。

entries.en: The Luddic Faithful of the Church count you as a friend, made welcome in their lands and trusted in dealings. You are allowed to self-moderate unsubtle use of technologies without need for the heavy hand of the Knights of Ludd to guide you toward righteousness.
entries.zh: 卢德神圣教会将你视作朋友，欢迎你进入他们的领土并且在贸易中对你保持信任。你被允许自我约束地、不过分张扬地使用科技，而毋需卢德骑士团那严格的规范来指导你如何迈向正途。

entries.en: You are a fellow Walker on the Path. Your name is passed between secret Watchers who hold the Faith secretly in every port, every fleet, and maintain a network of information built on human trust and heart. These Watchers would aid you in unexpected ways at unexpected times.
entries.zh: 你现在是卢德之道上一名求道者了。你的名字在那些暗地里怀揣着信仰的秘密注视者当中广为流传，这些注视者密布于每一个港口、每一支舰队、乃至编织出一整个建立于人情之上的情报网络，会在出乎意料的时候以你意想不到的方式帮助到你。

entries.en: You've proven useful to some of the leaders of the various criminal enterprises in the Sector. Harassing you may be more trouble than it's worth to a pirate who wants to breathe something more substantial than vacuum.
entries.zh: 你已经赢得了星域中不少犯罪集团领导人的赏识，对于一般的小海盗来说，招惹你造成的麻烦可能比起获得的利益更大 —— 只要他还想呼吸点像样的空气，而不是被丢出舱门体验在真空中呼吸的话。

entries.en: A smiling holo of you appears in the Tri-Tachyon quarterly corporate report as an example of a key partner in various enterprises. You are given special perks and priority access to facilities owned or operated by Tri-Tachyon and its subsidiaries.
entries.zh: 作为公司多个部门重要的合作伙伴关系的返利，您的友善全息形象出现在 速子科技 公司季度报告上。您享受特别的优待，有权优先使用 速子科技 及其子公司所属的设施。

entries.en: Your meeting with the High Hegemon is a topic of speculation among the higher ranks.
entries.zh: 高层官员都在猜测你与至高霸主的会面都谈了什么。

entries.en: $Faction commanders have authorization to engage your fleet on sight, and all markets are prohibited from trading with you. You might still recover good standing with $theFaction, but it's going to take some serious work.
entries.zh: $Faction 的指挥官有权在发现你的舰队后不经询问立即交战，同时它们的所有市场都被禁止与你交易。你也许还有机会恢复与 $theFaction 的良好关系，但这已经不是能靠做几件小事就能解决的问题。

entries.en: You have joined the ranks of those declared enemies of the state. The Sindrian Diktat navy has authorization to engage your fleet, and traders are prohibited from dealing with you for fear of being declared supporters of terrorism.
entries.zh: 你已经跻身于国家公敌的行列。辛达强权 海军已被授权与你的舰队交火，同时商人都被禁止与你交易，违者恐怕会被认定为支持恐怖主义。

entries.en: You have been declared an enemy of the polity. The Reformed Sindrian Diktat navy has authorization to engage your fleet, and traders are prohibited from dealing with you for fear of being declared supporters of terrorism, piracy, or even worse: Hectorite treason.
entries.zh: 你已被宣布为公敌。改革后的辛达强权海军获授权向你的舰队开火，商贾也被禁止与你交易 —— 生怕被扣上支持恐怖主义、海盗行径，甚或更糟的罪名：Hectorite 叛国。

entries.en: $Faction commanders have authorization to engage your fleet on sight, and all markets are prohibited from trading with you. You might still recover good standing with $theFaction, but it's going to take some serious work.
entries.zh: $Faction 的指挥官有权在发现你的舰队后不经询问立即交战，同时它们的所有市场都被禁止与你交易。你也许还有机会恢复与 $theFaction 的良好关系，但这已经不是能靠做几件小事就能解决的问题。

entries.en: Opportunistic independent captains may engage your fleet on sight to collect the open bounty that has been pooled to ensure your downfall. Unaligned markets are closed to you, as you are considered worse even than most pirates. You might still recover your standing with the non-aligned polities of the Sector, but it's going to take some serious work.
entries.zh: 投机取巧的独立舰队舰长们只要一看到你就会立马开火，以争取你头上那笔为了让你伏法而筹集的公开悬赏。就连没什么政治倾向的独立市场也不愿意对你开放，因为人们觉得你比大多数海盗都还差劲。你也许还有机会恢复与星域里林立的中立政体之间的关系，但这已经不是能靠做几件小事就能解决的问题。

entries.en: Patrols of the Persean League have orders to 'engage at opportunity' if your fleet is spotted, considering you no better than a pirate. Markets of League Worlds are closed to you, and it is rumored that the gens of Kazeron are cooking up plans to be rid of your nuisance once and for all.
entries.zh: 在 英仙座联盟 的巡逻队眼里，你没比海盗好哪去。他们已经接到命令，只要发现你的舰队便可以伺机进攻。联盟所属市场拒绝与你交易，同时据说 Kazeron 的氏族们正计划一劳永逸地处理掉你这个麻烦。

entries.en: The Church considers you a minion of Moloch, a slave to demonic technology. You are a witless ally of Mammon, striving only for the hedonic lucre of miserable unbelievers blind to Ludd's Revelation. Yea, you are an agent of evil and must be treated with as such.
entries.zh: 教会视你为恶魔摩洛克的爪牙，恶魔技术的奴隶。你是恶魔玛门的愚蠢盟友，只为那些无视卢德启示的悲惨不信者们的享乐而奋斗。是的，你是邪恶的代理人，也理当受到应有的对待。

entries.en: To the Luddic Path you are considered a minion of Moloch and slave to demonic technology. You are a witless ally of Mammon, striving in this sin-filled world not for love of God but for only the hedonic lucre of miserable unbelievers blind to Ludd's Revelation.
entries.zh: 对于 卢德左径 而言你被认为是摩洛克的宠儿、科技恶魔的奴隶。你是恶魔玛门愚蠢的盟仆，在这个浸满罪恶的世界中奋斗不是出于对神的敬爱，而是仅仅为了从那些可悲的对卢德的启示视而不见，沉浸享乐的不信者身上榨取不义之财。

entries.en:
Although you are not utterly despised, pirates are more than willing to attack if they believe you have credits or cargo to plunder.
Or if they're bored.
entries.zh:
虽然还没到被记恨的地步，但如果海盗觉得你有星币或货物可抢，他们是绝对不介意动手的。
或者，只是因为他们闲得发慌。

entries.en: Many pirates fear you, but few respect anything but your powerful fleet. Pirate bases are not willing to trade openly with you to avoid being seen as 'collaborators'. Pirates will attack you if they catch you in a moment of weakness.
entries.zh: 大多数海盗都只是惧怕你强大的舰队，并没有对你有一丝尊敬之情。为了避免惹上成为你 "帮凶" 的名号，海盗基地不愿与你公开交易，不仅如此，海盗们还会乘人之危对你发动袭击。

entries.en: Employees of Tri-Tachyon have been given the opportunity to earn a substantial increase to their quarterly performance bonus if they manage to kill you or, failing that, destroy your ability to cause further harm to the interests of the Company. A truly astronomical bribe might get you back in their good books.
entries.zh: 如果 速子科技 的员工设法干掉了你，或，退而求其次，使你失去对公司利益造成进一步破坏的能力，那么他们的季度奖金便有机会大涨一笔。也许得花上一笔天文数字级的贿赂才能让你重获一个好印象。

entries.en: You are known to have performed work for Provost Baird of the Galatia Academy.
entries.zh: 众所周知，你曾为 Galatia 学院的 Baird 院长效力。

entries.en: Suspicions have risen to an actionable level. There's no shoot-on-sight authorization quite yet, but $faction ports will refuse to trade with you, and patrols seem on a mission to make your life miserable.
entries.zh: 对你的怀疑程度已经到了可以付诸行动的地步。虽然目前还没到要求对你格杀勿论的程度，但 $faction 的港口拒绝与你交易，而执勤中的巡逻队也乐得给你找点麻烦。

entries.en: The Sindrian Diktat security apparatus has flagged you as a suspected terrorist, though has not yet issued a shoot-on-sight order. Diktat-controlled ports will refuse to trade with you, and patrols seem to make it their mission to make your life miserable.
entries.zh: 辛达强权 政府的安全机构已经将你标记为恐怖分子嫌犯，但目前还没下达格杀勿论的指令。辛达控制下的港口会拒绝与你贸易，而巡逻队们仿佛是接到了指示一样处处让你苦不堪言。

entries.en: The Reformed Diktat security apparatus has flagged you as a suspected terrorist, though has not yet issued a shoot-on-sight order. Diktat-controlled ports will refuse to trade with you, and patrols seem to make it their mission to make your life miserable.
entries.zh: 改革后的辛达强权安全机构已将你标记为恐怖分子嫌犯，不过尚未下达格杀勿论的指令。辛达控制下的港口会拒绝与你贸易，巡逻队则像是把让你日子难过当成了使命。

entries.en: Suspicions have risen to an actionable level. There's no shoot-on-sight authorization quite yet, but $faction ports will refuse to trade with you, and patrols seem on a mission to make your life miserable.
entries.zh: 对你的怀疑程度已经到了可以付诸行动的地步。虽然目前还没到要求对你格杀勿论的程度，但 $faction 的港口拒绝与你交易，而执勤中的巡逻队也乐得给你找点麻烦。

entries.en: Suspicions have risen to an actionable level. There's no shoot-on-sight authorization quite yet, but $faction ports will refuse to trade with you, and patrols seem on a mission to make your life miserable.
entries.zh: 对你的怀疑程度已经到了可以付诸行动的地步。虽然目前还没到要求对你格杀勿论的程度，但 $faction 的港口拒绝与你交易，而执勤中的巡逻队也乐得给你找点麻烦。

entries.en: The PLFIS has flagged you as an involved party in suspicious and/or criminal activity. You are denied permission to trade in League world markets, and patrols will treat you as a potential threat, though they do not have shoot-on-sight orders from Fleet command. Yet.
entries.zh: 英仙座联盟 的舰队情报部已经认定你为可疑或犯罪活动的参与者。联盟所属的市场拒绝与你交易。巡逻队也同样视你为潜在的危险分子，尽管舰队司令并没有下达格杀勿论的指令 —— 只是暂时还没下达。

entries.en: Curates of the Church of Galactic Redemption offer you as example of one led far astray from Ludd's revelation; one lost in the machine; perhaps not yet lost to Moloch, but an unwitting servant to evil. The Knights look wary upon you, and subject you to unnecessary delays and investigation.
entries.zh: 银河救赎教会 的祭司将你看作被机器所惑、背离卢德启示之人的范例；也许还没有落入恶魔摩洛克的掌控，但已无意中沦为邪恶的帮凶。骑士们对你满怀警惕，常让你受到不必要的拖延和调查。

entries.en: The Watchers of the Path are everywhere, and they whisper that you might not be so lost a soul as once you appeared. Nonetheless, excitable Pather fleetmasters may still attempt to extract tithes from you using threat of destruction in the Holy Vacuum.
entries.zh: 左径的注视者无处不在，他们低语着，说你或许并不像表面上那样是个迷失的灵魂。尽管如此，激进的左径舰队舰长仍有可能试图以在神圣真空中毁灭你为威胁，向你勒索什一税。

entries.en: Pirates will keep their weapons warm around your $shipOrFleet, and view you with distrust. This is more than can be said for how they view their fellows much of the time, so it's not as if hostility is insurmountable if a large number of credits or sufficient intimidation is in play.
entries.zh: 海盗会一边用不信任的眼神看待你，一边在你的$shipOrFleet周围预热他们的武器。大多数时候他们看待自己同僚的眼光也好不到哪去，所以只要有够多的星币或足量的恐吓，这点敌意也不是不能放在一旁。

entries.en: A Tri-Tachyon sub-AI (alleged) tracks your movements through the Sector, and when docked at a wholly owned or subsidiary facility, you are followed by an indiscreet security drone. Employees of the corporation treat you with suspicion, performing additional checks to avoid risk to their quarterly bonus.
entries.zh: 一个 速子科技 的次 AI 核心 (据称) 在星域中追踪你的行动轨迹。当你在 速子科技 及其子公司所属的设施靠港停泊时，总会有一台安保无人机光明正大的跟着你。速子科技 的员工以不信任的眼光看待你，并对你进行再三检查以避免扣除他们的季度奖金。

entries.en: You are rumored to be an agent for Gens Yaribay of Kazeron.
entries.zh: 据传你是 Kazeron 上 Yaribay 氏族的特工。

entries.en: You are known to have pilgrimaged to, or at least visited, the shrines of the Pilgrim's Path.
entries.zh: 人们已知晓你曾朝圣过，至少是拜访过，朝圣者之路上的诸多圣地。

entries.en: You're not generally well known by $faction officials, for good or ill.
entries.zh: 你并未被 $faction 的要员们广泛熟知，名声不好不坏。

entries.en: You're not generally well known by the Sindrian Diktat security apparatus. If you keep your head down and your mouth shut, you'll probably be fine unless some Lion's Guard officer wants to make an example out of someone.
entries.zh: 你在 辛达强权 的安全机构看来还并不起眼。如果你行事低调，也许这里还算安全，除非一些狮心卫队高官想要拿你杀鸡儆猴。

entries.en: The reformed Sindrian Diktat security apparatus has been ordered to give a great deal of leeway to free agents of the Persean Sector - even spacers with a colorful reputation. If you keep your head down and stick to business no one is likely to take a professional interest in your comings and goings.
entries.zh: 改革后的辛达强权安全机构已奉命对英仙座星域的自由航行者大开方便之门 —— 哪怕名声不太干净的老太空人也不例外。只要你低调行事、只管做买卖，多半没人会特意来过问你的行踪。

entries.en: You're not generally well known by $faction officials, for good or ill.
entries.zh: 你并未被 $faction 的要员们广泛熟知，名声不好不坏。

entries.en: Your reputation is not considered notable by the independent fleet operations and minor polities of the Persean Sector. If you're willing to do business, then you will be welcomed.
entries.zh: 你尚未在英仙座星域中出名，独立舰队与小型政体们并不认识你。如果你想和他们做生意，他们就会照例欢迎你。

entries.en: Officials of the Persean League consider you to be an independent operator with a set of League-guaranteed commerce rights within their controlled volume. You can trade and travel freely so long as you use a transponder, respect tariffs, and adhere to commodity restrictions.
entries.zh: 英仙座联盟 的官员把你当做一个自由人，在他们控制的星区里，你受惠于一系列由联盟保证的贸易权利。只要你打开应答器，支付关税，并严格遵守商品限制，你便可以在这里自由贸易与通行。

entries.en: Officials of the Persean League consider you to be an independent operator with a set of League-guaranteed commerce rights within their controlled volume. Your noteworthy independent fleet makes some smaller members wary and others respectful.
entries.zh: 英仙座联盟 的官员把你当做一个自由人，在他们控制的星区里，你受惠于一系列由联盟保证的贸易权利。你那引人注目的独立舰队让一些势力较小的成员对你十分谨慎，其他人则对你毕恭毕敬。

entries.en: Officials of the Persean League consider you to be an independent operator with a set of League-guaranteed commerce rights within their controlled volume. Controlling your own colony has made you notable as a potential partner.
entries.zh: 英仙座联盟 的官员把你当做一个自由人，在他们控制的星区里，你受惠于一系列由联盟保证的贸易权利。你拥有的殖民地让你作为联盟潜在合作伙伴而备受瞩目。

entries.en: You know enough about the beliefs and practices of the Luddic Church to avoid obvious gaffes, and they know how to deal with outsiders well enough to politely conduct business with you.
entries.zh: 你对卢德教会的信仰与习俗已经有了足够的了解，学会了避免在无意中冒犯信徒。他们也会礼貌地与你这个外人打交道或做生意。

entries.en: You are not considered a great evil by the Luddic Path, though that won't stop them from demanding "tithes" or destroying your "sinful technology" if a fanatical group of militants becomes inspired to take worldly action.
entries.zh: 卢德左径 并不认为你罪大恶极，当然，这不妨碍一些渴望投身于世俗行动的狂热武装分子，前来向你索要 "什一税"，或者摧毁你拥有的 "罪恶科技"。

entries.en: You've been around pirates, smugglers, and criminals long enough to know how to conduct business with them. That doesn't mean they won't attack if the opportunity presents itself, of course.
entries.zh: 你花了不少时间混迹于海盗、走私者或其他罪犯之中，掌握了和他们做生意的法门。当然，这并不代表他们不会在看到 "商机" 的时候袭击你。

entries.en: The Tri-Tachyon Customer and Client Service Smart Database, a Domain certified equivalent sub-gamma AI system dedicated to tracking potential competition, has not tagged your profile for special treatment or caution.
entries.zh: 速子科技 智能客户服务数据库是一个等效于次伽马 AI 核心的系统，用以追踪可能的竞争。你在此数据库中的档案并没有优待或者警告的标记。

entries.en: It is known that you traded words with Brother Cotton - and lived.
entries.zh: 人尽皆知你与 Cotton 修士面见交谈 —— 还活了下来。

entries.en: Causing you harm has been declared proscribed by the Luddic Path due to an act of great service to their cause.
entries.zh: 由于你对他们事业作出的巨大贡献，卢德左径 已宣布禁止对你造成伤害。

entries.en: Causing you harm has been declared proscribed by the Luddic Path due to an act of great service to their cause. You are also known to have traded words with Brother Cotton.
entries.zh: 由于你对他们事业作出的巨大贡献，卢德左径 已宣布禁止对你造成伤害。你与 Cotton 修士的对谈也为人们所熟知。

entries.en: You have paid off Warlord Kanta to ensure that pirates - mostly - don't attack your colonies.
entries.zh: 你已经买通了军阀 Kanta 来确保海盗们避开你的殖民地，至少在大多数时候。

entries.en: You had, and lost, Warlord Kanta's protection over your holdings.
entries.zh: 你已经失去了军阀 Kanta 对你财产的保护。

entries.en: You are the one who spaced Kanta's clone of Loke.
entries.zh: 你就是那个把 Kanta 克隆的 Loke 送入太空的家伙。

entries.en: You were an early supporter of Achilles Andrada's bid to claim his father's position, and for that you are treated with respect - and given great leeway - in all official dealings.
entries.zh: 你曾早早支持 Achilles Andrada 夺取其父之位，因此在一切官方往来中备受礼遇 —— 也享有极大的通融。

entries.en: You were an early supporter of Achilles Andrada's bid to claim his father's position, even giving material aid from your own colonial organization. For this service you are treated with respect - and given great leeway - in all official dealings.
entries.zh: 你曾早早支持 Achilles Andrada 夺取其父之位，甚至动用自己的殖民机构给予实质援助。凭这份功劳，你在一切官方往来中备受礼遇 —— 也享有极大的通融。

entries.en: You were an early supporter of Hector Andrada's bid to claim his father's position, and for that you are treated with respect - and given great leeway - in all official dealings.
entries.zh: 你曾早早支持 Hector Andrada 夺取其父之位，因此在一切官方往来中备受礼遇 —— 也享有极大的通融。

entries.en: You were an early supporter of Hector Andrada's bid to claim his father's position, even giving material aid from your own colonial organization. For this service you are treated with respect - and given great leeway - in all official dealings.
entries.zh: 你曾早早支持 Hector Andrada 夺取其父之位，甚至动用自己的殖民机构给予实质援助。凭这份功劳，你在一切官方往来中备受礼遇 —— 也享有极大的通融。

entries.en: Though nothing has been proven (yet), $faction officials tend to view you with distrust. Link access to the port authority is granted only grudgingly, and you find yourself the subject of investigations and harassment frequently.
entries.zh: 虽然目前还没有任何确凿的犯罪证据，但 $faction 的官员已经开始对你有所怀疑。你必须再三要求接入港口当局，对方才会勉强同意，同时你发现自己经常遭到调查和骚扰。

entries.en: Though you have not been declared an enemy of the polity, it is clear that you have been flagged by the Sindrian Diktat security apparatus. Port officials view you with distrust, fulfilling procedural requests slowly and singling you out for unnecessary inspections and checks.
entries.zh: 虽然还没有宣布你为国家的敌人，但是很明显你已经在 辛达强权 政府的安全机构的记录里留下了注脚。港务局官员们都用怀疑的目光审视你，规章申报处理缓慢，并时常对你进行不必要的检查。

entries.en: Though you have not been declared an enemy of the polity, it is clear that you have been flagged by the reformed Sindrian Diktat security apparatus as a person of interest. Port officials view you with distrust, fulfilling procedural requests slowly and singling you out for unnecessary inspections and checks.
entries.zh: 虽未宣布你为公敌，但显然改革后的辛达强权安全机构已把你列为重点关注对象。港务官员对你满腹疑心，办事拖拖拉拉，还专挑些没必要的检查来为难你。

entries.en: Though nothing has been proven (yet), $faction officials tend to view you with distrust. Link access to the port authority is granted only grudgingly, and you find yourself the subject of investigations and harassment frequently.
entries.zh: 虽然目前还没有任何确凿的犯罪证据，但 $faction 的官员已经开始对你有所怀疑。你必须再三要求接入港口当局，对方才会勉强同意，同时你发现自己经常遭到调查和骚扰。

entries.en: Though nothing has been proven (yet), $faction officials tend to view you with distrust. Link access to the port authority is granted only grudgingly, and you find yourself the subject of investigations and harassment frequently.
entries.zh: 虽然目前还没有任何确凿的犯罪证据，但 $faction 的官员已经开始对你有所怀疑。你必须再三要求接入港口当局，对方才会勉强同意，同时你发现自己经常遭到调查和骚扰。

entries.en: You have been tagged as a person of interest by the Persean League federal apparatus, subject to additional inspection and verification upon port entry. The gens of Kazeron are hesitant to deal with you preferring to do necessary business through intermediaries.
entries.zh: 你已被 英仙座联盟 联邦安全局标记为重点关注对象，需要在靠港停泊时接受额外检查。Kazeron 的氏族们并不愿意与你打交道，他们宁愿通过代理人来与你进行必要的交易。

entries.en: You are seen as a typical spacer; dismissive of Ludd's revelation and scornful of the Church. Your use of high technology is considered reckless, filling a hollow in your soul with false comforts of the material world. Some among the Faithful pity you, others distrust you.
entries.zh: 你被视为一名典型的宇宙民；对卢德的启示不屑一顾、蔑视教会。你鲁莽地运用着高科技造物，用物质世界的虚假舒适填补你灵魂的空虚。信徒中一些人怜悯你，另一些则不信任你。

entries.en: You are known among some Luddic Path as one who may be open to the wisdom of Ludd's true teachings. Or you may not, for you are still of the Tribe of Moloch, and it is known that Ludd would not frown upon your destruction.
entries.zh: 你以一个或许已经拥抱卢德真正的教诲的形象被一些左径人士所知。也可能并不是，只因你仍然是恶魔摩洛克的徒众，并且众所周知卢德不会对毁灭你感到不满。

entries.en: Pirates are generally only suspicious towards you, which is a far sight better than the loathing they hold for most 'legitimate' space-captains. This doesn't mean they won't attack you if the credits are good, of course. Pirates are pirates, after all.
entries.zh: 一般来讲，海盗只是对你不信任，相比起他们对大多数 "官方" 太空舰长的厌恶，这种态度要好得多。当然，如果报酬丰厚，他们还是会攻击你。毕竟，本性难移。

entries.en: Your profile with the Tri-Tachyon Customer and Client Service Smart Database has been algorithmically tagged as "potential risk" resulting in additional small "security fees" and delays when docking at facilities owned or operated by Tri-Tachyon or its subsidiaries.
entries.zh: 在 速子科技 智能客户服务数据库中，你已经被算法标记为 "潜在的威胁"。你会被收取附加的小额 "安全费"，并在 速子科技 及其子公司的设施中延后靠港停泊。

entries.en: A special department has taken an interest in how you have found so many AI cores.
entries.zh: 一个特殊部门很想知道你是如何找到这么多 AI 核心的。

entries.en: A holo of your face and an IDENT-hash of your last known fleet are both regular parts of inter-system security bulletins. It's fairly certain there's a high-ranking $faction officer whose primary assignment is to hunt you down.
entries.zh: 你的面部全息图像和你舰队最后被发现时的识别信息快照已经成为了星系间安全通知公告的常规部分。可以肯定的是，有一名高级别的 $faction 官员的首要任务便是负责追捕你。

entries.en: You have been declared an enemy of the polity by the Sindrian Diktat and seen as a deranged terrorist against the Andradan Movement. Uncharitably modified holos of you performing crimes and sordid acts have appeared in official propaganda broadcasts.
entries.zh: 你已经被 辛达强权 宣示为国家公敌，被视为一名顽抗 Andrada 伟大运动的疯狂恐怖分子。你的全息影像被刻画得更加狰狞可恶，被用于宣传你犯下的各种见不得人的违法罪行，在官方宣传广播中频繁出现。

entries.en: You have been declared an enemy of the polity by the Reformed Sindrian Diktat and are seen as a deranged terrorist, perhaps even guilty of spreading Hectorite treason. Uncharitably modified holos of you performing crimes and sordid acts have appeared in propaganda broadcast throughout the Askonia system.
entries.zh: 改革后的辛达强权已宣布你为公敌，视你为丧心病狂的恐怖分子，甚至可能犯下散布 Hectorite 叛国思想之罪。Askonia 星系播放的宣传里，出现了经过恶意篡改的全息影像，把你描绘成干下种种罪行与龌龊勾当的模样。

entries.en: A holo of your face and an IDENT-hash of your last known fleet are both regular parts of inter-system security bulletins. It's fairly certain there's a high-ranking $faction officer whose primary assignment is to hunt you down.
entries.zh: 你的面部全息图像和你舰队最后被发现时的识别信息快照已经成为了星系间安全通知公告的常规部分。可以肯定的是，有一名高级别的 $faction 官员的首要任务便是负责追捕你。

entries.en: You are a scourge of the spaceways. A holo of your face and scan of your $shipOrFleet are traded between independent flotillas and administrators as part of an unofficial collective security arrangement. It is likely that a well-paid mercenary company is working to hunt you down.
entries.zh: 你就是空间航道上的大灾星。作为独立舰队和地方政体管理者之间非正式集体安全协定的一部分，你的全息头像和你麾下$shipOrFleet的情资时常被他们互相交换。很可能已经有某个服务价格不菲的佣兵公司把对你的追猎提上了他们的日程。

entries.en: You are a scourge of the spaceways, declared enemy of the Persean League and its free citizens. More concerning, however, is that the great gens of Kazeron are willing to put aside their differences to pool resources to hunt you down.
entries.zh: 你是航道上的灾星，是 英仙座联盟 及其自由子民的公敌。然而你更需要担心的是，Kazeron 的显赫氏族愿意放下彼此的成见，穷尽一切资源来追捕你。

entries.en: The Luddic Church portrays you as a wrathful corruptor, sinful and unrepentant, a desecrator of that which is holy and good. The Knights of Ludd have assigned an Inquisitor to your case; even some curates have suggested that it might not be a sin to kill you. It's only a matter of time before some fanatic makes an attempt.
entries.zh: 卢德教会 将你形容为一个狂躁的堕落者，罪孽深重且不知悔改，是对所有圣洁和美好事物的亵渎。卢德骑士团已经专门为处理你而指派了一位精干的异端审判官。甚至有些祭司隐晦地暗示，杀死你可能算不上是一种罪过，因此迟早会有狂热信徒开始这么做。

entries.en: Pather-aligned priests rail against you in their sermons; they call you a wrathful AI-conjured homunculus. Your destruction is a holy duty. It's only a matter of time before some fanatic takes a shot at you in a bar, or a Pather fleetmaster jumps at the opportunity for martyrdom.
entries.zh: 站在左径分子一侧的牧师在他们的布道中谴责你；他们称你是一个气急败坏的 AI 造出的侏儒。毁灭你是一项神圣的使命。距离你在酒吧里被狂热分子的冷枪命中或者被试图殉教的左径舰队拦截只是时间问题。

entries.en: You are scorned as mere prey and despised as a lackey serving the fat, rich factions of the Persean Sector.
entries.zh: 你不过是被海盗们嗤之以鼻的猎物，并且作为那些英仙座星域里臃肿流油的主要势力们的一条看门杂种为海盗舰长们所不齿。

entries.en: You are hated by Pirates; they use a holo of your face for target-practice. No doubt there is a brash young pirate assembling a kill-fleet to ambush you to secure the immortality of their name, if not person, in the lawless shadows of the Persean Sector.
entries.zh: 你现在就是海盗们的眼中钉；他们甚至用你的全息脸像来练习打靶。不难想象，英仙座星域无法地带的阴影中，初出茅庐的年轻海盗们有一个算一个，都准备集结舰队猎杀你，你的人头便是他们 "万古流芳" 之路的开始。

entries.en: Tri-Tachyon has assigned an AI core to theorycrafting your destruction and set aside a mercenary fund to see it done. Your name has its own byline, in red, in quarterly corporate reports and a rather uglier version of you features in procedurally-generated children's adutainment holos.
entries.zh: 速子科技 已经指派了一个 AI 核心来计算如何干掉你，并专门划拨了一笔佣兵基金来实现计划。在公司的季度报告中，你的名字被单独以红色标注。此外，在系统生成的幼儿教育全息影像中，你的形象被修饰得更加丑恶。

entries.en: Your name is known to some high-level officials in $theFaction. Harassing you is therefore a more risky endeavor for local patrol commanders.
entries.zh: 你的名号被一些 $theFaction 的高层官员所知晓。无故骚扰你对地方巡逻指挥来说已经是比较冒险的行为了。

entries.en: Your name is spoken well of among some of the high-level officials in the various ministries of the Sindrian Diktat, and it is clear that there is some kind of official note attached to your record. Local patrol commanders and port authority officers alike know what's good for their careers and make a point of treating you politely and efficiently.
entries.zh: 你的好名声已经在 辛达强权 各部门的高官之间流传，并且可以确定的是，你的记录上被附上了官方备注。当地的巡逻队长官和港务局官员都待你友善，并高效的处理你的请求。他们都知道这对他们的职业生涯百利而无一害。

entries.en: Your name is spoken well of among some of the high-level officials in the various ministries of the Reformed Sindrian Diktat, and it is clear that there is some kind of official note attached to your record. Local patrol commanders and port authority officers alike know what's good for their careers and make a point of treating you politely and efficiently.
entries.zh: 改革后的辛达强权各部门的高官之间，你的名声颇受称道，而且显然你的档案上附着某种官方备注。当地巡逻指挥官和港务局官员都懂得什么对自己的仕途有利，无不特意待你客气而利落。

entries.en: Your integrity is known in the Hegemony bureaucracy, earning you respect from officers and the welcome of civilian personnel. There is willingness to sell you certain restricted materiel and forgo some of the more tedious inspections.
entries.zh: 你的正直已经在 霸主 的官僚系统中广为人知，使你在官员和文职人员当中有着良好的声誉。他们愿意向你出售一些管制品，并且省略一些冗长的检查程序。

entries.en: Your name is known by many independent commanders and non-aligned polity officials. You are considered a safe operator, made welcome in matters of business and easily forgiven for minor indiscretions.
entries.zh: 你的名声已被众多独立舰队的运营者和中立政体的官员所知晓。你被人们认为百举百捷，在各类事务上广受接纳，就算犯了点小错，他们也会选择不予追究。

entries.en: Your name is known and welcomed among the worlds of the Persean League - and the gens of Kazeron - including the shared Fleet. You are considered a safe operator, made welcome in matters of business and easily forgiven for minor indiscretions.
entries.zh: 你在英仙座联盟治下世界和他们的海军中 —— 还有 Kazeron 的几个氏族之中，都颇具声望、备受欢迎。你被人们认为百举百捷，在各类事务上广受接纳，就算犯了点小错，他们也会选择不予追究。

entries.en: The Church welcomes you to the volumes they control, and their Knights of Ludd watch you with less suspicion than most spacers. You know to make the expected signs of respect, and modestly hide those technologies which cause offense to the most conservative Faithful.
entries.zh: 教会欢迎你进入他们掌控的区域，并且卢德骑士团对你的监视比对其他多数访客的更为疏松。你知道如何做出得体的礼仪手势以表达尊重，并且谦逊地把那些可能会冒犯到最为保守的信徒的科技制品隐藏起来。

entries.en: Your name is spoken of well among the secret cells and far-flung sects that make up the Luddic Path. Those few worlds controlled by Path-aligned polities welcome your trade, and will do their best to ensure that some excitable fanatic doesn't try to attack you.
entries.zh: 组成 卢德左径 的各个秘密团体与各支教派间流传着你的大名。左径控制下的少数几个殖民地欢迎与你贸易，也会尽其所能避免一些极端的狂热分子前去袭击你。

entries.en: Pirates respect your swagger, and are inclined to respect the notoriety you've gained in the underworld that allows you to throw your weight around a little to get what you want.
entries.zh: 你在犯罪团伙之间已经小有恶名，海盗们都对你肃然起敬，而你也知道如何活用这些在黑道的影响力来夺得你想要的东西。

entries.en: The Tri-Tachyon Customer and Client Service Smart Database assigns you priority docking and a complimentary fruit and flower arrangement at every port controlled by Tri-Tachyon or one of its subsidiaries. Even if this is automated by a technically non-sentient sub-AI system, it is a sign that the Tri-Tachyon corporation values your ongoing business relationship.
entries.zh: 在每一个 速子科技 及其子公司控制下的港口，智能客户服务数据库会优先让你进港停泊，并布置免费的水果与鲜花。即使这些欢迎只是由非感性子 AI 系统自动完成，这也是 速子科技 公司重视与你保持商业关系的象征。

entries.en:
The grim expanse of the Remnant battlestation fills your viewscreen. A bridge officer re-scales the tactical target display so that its entire mass can be seen at once.

A relic from the First AI War, the station's long arc gapes with empty sockets where weapons platforms and citadels were once present. Despite the obvious damage, the station is armed and operational.

The combat analysis system churns for a few seconds and then beeps angrily instead of producing the usual range of tactical recommendations.
entries.zh:
阴森而巨大的 余辉 作战基地填满了你的显示屏。一名舰桥军官重新调整了战术目标显示屏的比例，以便展示这个庞然巨物的全貌。

作为第一次 AI 战争的遗迹，在这座空间站漫长的弧面上，那些曾安装着武器平台和壁垒的地方如今只剩下空荡荡的接口。尽管受损明显，这座空间站却依然全副武装且运转如常。

作战分析系统在运转了几秒钟之后，并没有像往常那样给出一系列的战术建议，而是猛烈地哔哔作响。

entries.en:
The grim expanse of the remnant battlestation fills your viewscreen. A bridge officer re-scales the tactical target display so that its entire mass can be seen at once.

A relic from the First AI War, the station nonetheless appears to be fully armed and operational.

The combat analysis system churns for a few seconds and then beeps angrily instead of producing the usual range of tactical recommendations.
entries.zh:
阴森而巨大的 余辉 作战基地填满了你的显示屏。一名舰桥军官重新调整了战术目标显示屏的比例，以便展示这个庞然巨物的全貌。

虽然是第一次 AI 战争的遗迹，但这座空间站如今却依然全副武装且运转如常。

作战分析系统在运转了几秒钟之后，并没有像往常那样给出一系列的战术建议，而是猛烈地哔哔作响。

entries.en:
"Good to see you, $playerSirOrMadam," $PersonLastName says with a grin.

"We've got holds filled with everything your $shipOrFleet could possibly need. Just give the order and we'll begin cargo transfer."
entries.zh:
"见到你真好，$playerSirOrMadam，" $PersonLastName咧嘴笑道。

"我们的货舱里装满了你的$shipOrFleet可能需要的一切。只要你下令，我们就开始转运货物。"

entries.en:
"Bright stars, $playerSirOrMadam," $Rank $PersonLastName says.

"We've given you all we've got, captain. You'll see us burning back to base before you know it."
entries.zh:
"星光长明，$playerSirOrMadam，" $Rank $PersonLastName说道。

"能给的我们都给你了，舰长。用不了多久，你就会看到我们点火返航回基地。"

o.en: "Want to make a few credits on the side? (sell)

entries.en:
Your story can end here, starfarer. It's time to enjoy your retirement.

The question is, where and how?
entries.zh:
你的故事可以在此画上句号了，星际行者。是时候享受退休生活了。

问题是，在哪里，又该如何？

entries.en:
You still hear the whispers of the moons, the songs of the stars. You live at such a velocity that it feels impossible to stop now.

There is no part of you that cannot be replaced; there are chems and replacements to enhance failing senses, overlaid and embedded smart-systems to assist failing memory and reaction time. Modules and modifications integrated into your body and mind. There are even dealers in lost miracles of the Domain - irreplaceable nanoscale devices, artificial machine-proteins, components only found in forgotten orbits of ruined worlds.

But they will become more and more expensive.
entries.zh:
你仍听得见卫星的低语、群星的歌声。你活得这样疾速，如今要停下来，竟觉得已不可能。

你身上没有哪一处是换不掉的：有化学药剂与替代部件来强化衰退的感官，有层层叠加、植入体内的智能系统来补救日渐迟钝的记忆与反应。各类模块与改造，早已同你的身心融为一体。甚至还有人兜售人之领失落的奇迹 —— 无可替代的纳米级器件、人造机械蛋白、只在破败世界被遗忘的轨道上才寻得见的元件。

只是，它们会越来越贵。

o.en: Technology will make me better, stronger, faster
o.zh: 技术会让我更好、更强、更快

o.en: On second thought, retirement sounds nice
o.zh: 转念一想，退休听着倒也不错

o.en: A hermitage on Chalcedon, far from corrupting influences
o.zh: 在 Chalcedon 结庐隐居，远离一切腐化诱惑

o.en: The Galatia Academy could use a new professor- Contemporary Space Combat Studies?
o.zh: Galatia 学院也许正缺一位教授——当代太空作战研究？

o.en: Perhaps the Hegemony naval academy of Coatl could use a new instructor?
o.zh: 也许霸主在 Coatl 的海军学院正缺一位新教官？

o.en: The endless dunes of Asharu call...
o.zh: Asharu 那无尽的沙丘在召唤...

o.en: Fikenhild was nice. Perhaps a luxury suite atop an arcology...
o.zh: Fikenhild 是个好地方。也许该在巨型生态建筑的顶层弄一套豪华套房...

o.en: Kazeron is a center of culture, industry, and politics...
o.zh: Kazeron 是文化、工业与政治的中心...

o.en: Kazeron is a center of culture, industry, and politics...
o.zh: Kazeron 是文化、工业与政治的中心...

o.en: Kazeron is a center of culture, industry, and politics...
o.zh: Kazeron 是文化、工业与政治的中心...

o.en: Settle down as Demarchon of your colony
o.zh: 作为你殖民地的民选统领安顿下来

o.en: Settle down as Demarchon of your colonies
o.zh: 作为你诸殖民地的民选统领安顿下来

o.en: A nice farm on Gilead, perhaps
o.zh: 或许在 Gilead 弄一座不错的农场
在 Tartessus 开一片辽阔的牧场

o.en: Somewhere comfortable, neutral, and above all anonymous
o.zh: 找个舒适、中立、最重要的是无人知晓的地方

o.en: No! It does not have to end
On second thought, maybe I'll comms Cydonia
o.zh: 再想想，也许我该联络一下 Cydonia

o.en: Settle down as leader of your colony
o.zh: 作为你殖民地的领袖安顿下来

o.en: Settle down as leader of your colonies
o.zh: 作为你诸殖民地的领袖安顿下来
在 Qaras 住一间带防护的顶层公寓

o.en: You recall Arroyo's mountain-top chateau... why not buy your own?
o.zh: 你想起 Arroyo 那座山顶宅邸...何不自己也买一座？

entries.en:
Asharu, desert world.

Few would choose to make it their home, but you are someone quite unlike most.
entries.zh:
Asharu，荒漠世界。

没几个人愿意把这儿当家，可你偏偏和大多数人全然不同。

entries.en:
Chalcedon.

Your Path, you decide, leads into the eye of the storm. That is where peace may be found, if the divine so wills it.
entries.zh:
Chalcedon，就是这里了。

你认定，你的道途通向风暴之眼。若神明愿意，那里便是安宁所在。

entries.en:
Coatl Academy.

If humanity is to survive this long dark era, it needs to instill discipline, honor, and excellence in those fresh-faced cadets who will one day become officers in the Hegemony navy.

They stand against chaos and warlordism. They will defend the Persean Sector from inhuman threats both known and unknown. If the Domain is to be rebuilt, it will be by their blood.

You can do your part to help them do theirs.
entries.zh:
Coatl 学院。

人类若要熬过这漫长的黑暗时代，就得把纪律、荣誉与卓越，灌进那些稚气未脱的学员骨子里 —— 他们终有一日会成为霸主海军的军官。

他们挺身抵挡混乱与军阀割据，将守护英仙座星域，免于已知与未知的非人威胁。人之领若要重建，必得以他们的鲜血筑成。

你可以尽自己的一份力，帮他们担起他们的那份。

entries.en:
You are the executive officer of your colonial apparatus, majority-owner of most key infrastructure. But you aspire to be more than a bureaucrat: what if you were a leader?

Now you may dedicate yourself to this work, transforming the polity into something more than a legal entity enumerating a wage-roll of mercenaries, contractors, and desperate fortune-seekers.

Mass-fabricated shelters will become homes; the sprawl slumped along webs of maximum-efficiency grown outward from spaceports will become towns, communities.

Perhaps one day these shining cities and their inhabitants will share a sense of purpose and being: a true polity.
entries.zh:
你是自家殖民机构的主管，多数关键基建的大股东。可你志不止于做个官僚 —— 若真当一回领袖呢？

如今你大可倾力于此，让这个政体不再只是一具法律空壳 —— 名下不过列着一张薪册，写着雇佣兵、承包商，还有一群走投无路的淘金者。

成批预制的栖身舱会变成家；沿着一味讲究效率、自太空港向外铺开的管网胡乱摊伏的连片棚户，会变成城镇，变成聚落。

也许有朝一日，这些闪闪发亮的城池与住在里头的人，会生出共同的目标与归属 —— 那时，才称得上是一个真正的政体。

entries.en:
You are demarchon, leader of the people. More than a mere executive officer of a colonial apparatus, more than a distant majority-owner of key infrastructure and bureaucrat.

Now you may dedicate yourself to this work, transforming the polity into something more than a legal entity enumerating a wage-roll of mercenaries, contractors, and desperate fortune-seekers.

Mass-fabricated shelters will become homes; the sprawl slumped along webs of maximum-efficiency grown outward from spaceports will become towns, communities.

Perhaps one day these shining cities and their inhabitants will share a sense of purpose and being: a true polity.
entries.zh:
你是 demarchon，人民的领袖。不止是殖民机构里一名区区主管，也不止是远远握着关键基建大股、高高在上的官僚。

如今你大可倾力于此，让这个政体不再只是一具法律空壳 —— 名下不过列着一张薪册，写着雇佣兵、承包商，还有一群走投无路的淘金者。

成批预制的栖身舱会变成家；沿着一味讲究效率、自太空港向外铺开的管网胡乱摊伏的连片棚户，会变成城镇，变成聚落。

也许有朝一日，这些闪闪发亮的城池与住在里头的人，会生出共同的目标与归属 —— 那时，才称得上是一个真正的政体。

entries.en:
Eochu Bres.

You envision a palace set upon the mountains in a raw, new land whose life and living is wrought by the ingenuity of humanity... and its creations.

It will be the ultimate celebration of the tool-makers, the world-shapers who claim the raw clay of the universe and produce splendor and wealth; it is all that it means to be human and more.
entries.zh:
Eochu Bres，就是这里了。

你想象着一座宫殿，矗立在一片蛮荒新大陆的群山之上；那里的生命与生活，皆由人类的智慧...以及人类的造物所铸造。

这将是对工具制造者、对塑世者的终极礼赞——他们攫取宇宙的原始黏土，缔造出辉煌与财富；这便是身为人类的全部意义，而且不止于此。

entries.en:
Fikenhild.

An ocean of freedom and leisure - for those who, like you, can afford clear skies, endless seas, and a penthouse atop one of the five glittering arcologies.
entries.zh:
Fikenhild 星。

一片自由与闲适的海洋 —— 只属于像你这样，买得起万里晴空、无垠碧海，以及五座流光溢彩的巨型生态理想城中某一座顶层豪宅的人。

entries.en:
The Galatia Academy.

A ray of knowledge illuminating the shadows of war, a beacon of hope and education guiding those who are honest and true. Your influence may better the minds you nurture - one small part of lifting the Persean Sector out of this dark age.
entries.zh:
Galatia 学院。

一缕知识之光，照进战争的阴影；一座希望与教化的灯塔，为诚实正直之人引路。你的影响，或许能让你悉心培育的那些心智有所长进 —— 而要把英仙座星域从这黑暗时代里托举出来，靠的正是这样一点一滴的力气。

entries.en:
Gilead.

A garden world, a human world, the farthest thing from the death and cold of space. Surrounded by the blessing of life and living.
entries.zh:
Gilead，就是这里了。

一座花园世界，一座人类的世界，与太空的死亡和寒冷相隔最远。被生命与生机的祝福所环绕。

entries.en:
Kazeron.

Heart of the Persean League and the rising power of the Sector. If there is to be a future for humanity, it may very well be forged here.
entries.zh:
Kazeron 星。

英仙座联盟的心脏，也是星域里冉冉升起的新势力。人类若还有未来，多半就在此地锻成。

entries.zh:
Kazeron 星。

英仙座联盟的心脏，也是星域里冉冉升起的新势力。人类若还有未来，多半就在此地锻成。

entries.en: Finally, a time for rest.
entries.zh: 终于，到了歇下来的时候。

entries.en:
Nova Maxios.

Where fate is self-made, and you are your accomplishments, not the name someone else gave you.
entries.zh:
Nova Maxios 空间站。

在这里，命运由自己挣得；你就是你做成的事，而非旁人给你安的名字。

entries.en:
Qaras.

Where you may rest upon a throne atop the rabble and riot, a place you've earned by grit, blood, and lucre.
entries.zh:
Qaras，就是这里了。

在那里，你可以安坐于暴民与骚乱之上的王座；那是你凭胆识、鲜血和钱财挣来的位置。

entries.en:
Tartessus.

You may finally rest, letting each day present you with a tapestry of sun-lit clouds over endless plains.
entries.zh:
Tartessus，就是这里了。

你终于可以歇息了，任由每一天在你面前铺开一幅阳光照耀的云锦，笼罩着无垠的平原。

entries.en:
"But first, I ask a question of you, $titlePL," he says regally.

"It is the question of whether you are with me, with Gens Hannan, or if you are not. I would see that you given great rewards, power, and access as a client of my patronage."

"It is a choice," he says softly. "I want you to confirm it to me."

"Now."
entries.zh:
"但首先，我要问你一个问题，$titlePL，"他说，气度俨然。

"问题就是：你到底站在我这边、站在 Hannan 氏族这边，还是不。若你站过来，我会让你作为我的门客，得到丰厚的赏赐、权力与门路。"

"这是个选择，\"他轻声说，\"我要你亲口向我确认。"

"就现在。"

o.en: I cannot submit myself to you and your Gens.
o.zh: 我不能向你和你的氏族屈膝。

entries.en:
"Then you resign yourself to irrelevance," Reynard says with icy contempt.

"I have nothing more to say to you."
entries.zh:
"那你就是认了命，甘做一个无足轻重的人，"Reynard 语带冰冷的轻蔑。

"我跟你没什么好说的了。"

entries.en: "Good," he whispers.
entries.zh: "很好，"他低声道。

entries.en: The question now is, do you continue and contact Achilles Andrada, perhaps to pledge support for him?
entries.zh: 现在的问题是：你是否继续，去联系 Achilles Andrada，或许向他宣誓效忠？

o.en: Yes, I will speak to Achilles
o.zh: 是的，我会去找 Achilles 谈谈

entries.en:
"Then you resign yourself to irrelevance," Reynard says with icy contempt.

He reaches for the comms cut-off without another word.
entries.zh:
"那你就甘心沦为无足轻重之人吧，" Reynard 语带冰冷的轻蔑。

他一言不发，伸手去按通讯切断键。

entries.en:
"You resign yourself to irrelevance," Reynard spits.

The Prime Demarchon's face is frozen in a mask of contempt but for the barest twitch- and in it, somehow, the promise of revenge whether by nuclear fire or the cold of space.

He reaches for the comms cut-off without another word.
entries.zh:
"你就甘心沦为无足轻重之人吧，" Reynard 啐了一口。

大统领的脸凝成一副轻蔑的面具，只余一丝极细微的抽动——而就在那抽动里，不知怎的，藏着报复的许诺：不是核火，便是太空的严寒。

他一言不发，伸手去按通讯切断键。

entries.en:
"Of course; I assumed you had misspoken." He looks casually aside, taking in what is no doubt a spectacular view.

"It is the sort of thing you might do, and which I, of course, forgive."
entries.zh:
"当然；我以为你只是口误。" 他随意地看向一旁，欣赏着无疑非常壮观的景色。

"这是你可能会做的事情，而我，当然，会原谅你。"

entries.en: Reynard sighs, rolling his eyes.
entries.zh: Reynard 叹了口气，翻了个白眼。

entries.en:
You explain that your main objection is the cost of the membership dues; paying for League membership simply won't do.

As you speak, Reynard's face is a display of muted conflict between skepticism and impatience.

This is going to take some industrial-grade convincing.
entries.zh:
你解释说，你主要的反对意见是会员费的价格，花钱换取联盟会员资格就是不行。

你说话的时候，Reynard 的脸上露出了怀疑与不耐烦交织的微妙表情。

这恐怕需要极具说服力的理由才行。

entries.en:
Reynard's eyebrows raise by perhaps half a centimeter at your display.

"You could have been a client of greatness." He leans back, expression very cold. "It saddens me to find that you are either more a fool than I imagined, or that you do not fully comprehend the consequences of crossing Gens Hannan."

"Now I shall have to make a... demonstration of you."
entries.zh:
Reynard 因为你的表现而微微挑了挑眉。

"你本可以成为一位伟大的客户。" 他向后靠去，表情十分冷漠。"我发现你要么比我想象中的更愚蠢，要么就是你没有充分理解得罪 Hannan 氏族的后果，这让我感到很悲哀。"

"现在，我不得不拿你来做个...示范。"

entries.en:
"Treasure my forgiveness, captain. It is a rare and precious gift." He stares down, somehow, through the comms; imperious.

"Uphold your end of our arrangement, or your earlier problems will seem like a walk in the parks of Gilead."
entries.zh:
"珍惜我的宽恕吧，舰长。这是一份罕见且珍贵的礼物。" 他透过通讯设备，以一种高傲的姿态俯视着你。

"履行好我们约定中你的那部分职责，若非如此，那么和你接下来的经历相比，你之前遇到的那些麻烦就会像是去 Gilead 的公园里散步一样轻松了。"

entries.en:
"I must admit, you've surprised me, $playerName," he says, "and I surprise myself when I speak - as Prime Demarchon - that the League council will agree to waive the usual dues owed by member polities of the Persean League."

Reynard Hannan summons a glowing politician's smile, looking for all the worlds as if this was his plan all along.
entries.zh:
"我必须承认，你让我感到惊讶，$playerName，" 他说道，"而当我 —— 作为大统领 —— 说出这句话时，我自己也感到惊讶，英仙座联盟 议会将会同意{免除联盟成员政权通常应缴纳的会费}。"

Reynard Hannan 露出了政客们惯常的灿烂笑容，仿佛这本来就是他的计划。

o.en: I accept League membership on the amended terms.
o.zh: 我接受修改后的联盟成员条件。

entries.en:
"I must admit, you've surprised me, $playerName," he says, "and I surprise myself when I speak - as Prime Demarchon - that the League council will agree to waive the usual dues owed by member polities of the Persean League."

Reynard Hannan makes a strained attempt at an appeasing smile. It appears that his negotiations do not usually go so well for the other party.
entries.zh:
"我必须承认，你让我感到惊讶，$playerName，" 他说到，"而当我 —— 作为大统领 —— 说出这句话时，我自己也感到惊讶，英仙座联盟 议会将会同意{免除联盟成员政权通常应缴纳的会费}。"

Reynard Hannan 努力地挤出一个安抚的微笑，但这笑容显得有些勉强。看来，他在谈判中通常不会让对方如此轻易地占到便宜。

o.en: I accept League membership on the amended terms.
o.zh: 我接受修改后的联盟成员条件。

entries.en:
"An unfortunate business." He puts on an almost regretful look, "And a waste of key resources. Naturally, I had to appear to follow the voice of the League Council on that matter."

"You've founded a powerful polity." His hands open wide, generous. "I could see that from the start, of course. But what's important is that you proved it to the entire council. We can use this."

He smiles, conceding nothing.
entries.zh:
"一笔糟糕的交易，" 他摆出一副非常遗憾的表情，"浪费了那么多关键资源。当然，在那件事上我不得不表现得遵从联盟理事会的意见。"

"你建立了一个强大的政体。" 他摊开双手，显得非常慷慨大度，"我一开始就看出来了。但重要的是，你向整个议会证明了这一点。我们可以利用这一点。"

他微笑着，丝毫没有让步的意思。

entries.en:
"Oh, that was you?" Reynard's facade of carefree loftiness looks increasingly brittle.

"The forges will provide, no doubt. No doubt... " His expression slackens as he ponders something. Then he quirks his lip, a sneer like a cornered wolf. "The League Council will respect your demonstration, no doubt about it."

"I must admit you're not only clever, but lucky," he says, trying his best to concede very little. "You've proven that to my satisfaction. Admirable qualities in... an associate."
entries.zh:
"噢，那是你干的？" Reynard 那副轻松高傲的面具看上去正逐渐碎裂。

"锻炉自会有供应，毫无疑问。毫无疑问..." 他思索着，表情逐渐松弛。随后他嘴角扭曲，露出困兽般的狞笑。"联盟理事会必将尊重你的展示，这点毋庸置疑。"

"我必须承认你不仅聪明，还很走运，" 他竭力做出最小程度的让步，"你已向我充分证明了这点。这些都是可贵的品质...对于一个合作伙伴而言。"

entries.en: You give the order for your quartermaster to release the Pristine Nanoforge into Kazeronian custody. The receiving officer is, unsurprisingly, a mid-level Hannan gensfolk.
entries.zh: 你下令让你的军需官将完好的纳米锻炉移交给 Kazeron 的官员。接收的官员不出所料，是一位 Hannan 氏族的中层成员。

entries.en:
"Well," Reynard's tone contains just a hint of impatience. "The standard terms of Persean League membership stand, as I've explained."

You must hold a Persean League commission. You will be required to pay $plDuesPercent of gross colony income in dues. In turn, the Persean League will provide you with political protection from the meddling major factions use to bully minor polities such as the Hegemony AI inspections. League development programs for new member-polities should increase colony accessibility by around 10%.
entries.zh:
"好吧，" Reynard 的声音中透露出一丝不耐烦，"我已经解释过了，英仙座联盟 成员的标准条款是固定的。"

你必须持有联盟委任状，并支付殖民地总收入的 $plDuesPercent 作为会费。作为回报，英仙座联盟 将为你提供政治保护，免受强大势力通过干涉来欺凌弱小势力的行为；例如，免受 霸主 AI 审查活动骚扰。联盟发展计划会提高新成员国约 10% 的殖民地流通性。

o.en: Accept League membership on the given terms
o.zh: 接受给定的联盟成员条件

entries.en: Meanwhile, you skim and certify the executive summary of the Persean League commission credentials.
entries.zh: 与此同时，你快速浏览并确认了 英仙座联盟 雇佣协议的摘要。

entries.en: You have your comms officer fire off a resignation order for your previous commission - an impersonal act sure to annoy and offend.
entries.zh: 你让通讯军官发出了一份辞去之前职务的命令 —— 这是一个不带任何个人情感的举动，但肯定会让对方恼怒和不满。

entries.en: With a few taps of the comms interface, you exchange secure credit-transfer codes.
entries.zh: 随着在通讯界面上的几下轻触，你们交换了安全的星币转账代码。

entries.en:
"It is the relationships formed between the tiers of our civilization, the flow of loyalty and favor, that ties our interests together and benefits us all," Reynard muses.

He closes his eyes for a moment, holding his hands together against his chest, "I would be honored to offer patronage to you on such terms."

"We'll have to spin this arrangement to the public, somehow, of course. Some lesser polity inevitably cries 'bribery' - such a crude word - in order to leverage unearned influence."
entries.zh:
"正是我们文明中各个阶级之间的关系，忠诚与奖赏的交换，将我们的利益紧密联系在一起，使我们所有人受益，" Reynard 沉思道。

他闭上眼睛片刻，双手合十放在胸前，"我很荣幸能在这样的条件下为你提供庇护。"

"当然，我们得想办法把这个安排向公众宣传一番。总有一些小政体不可避免地会大喊 '贿赂' —— 这么粗鲁的词 —— 以此来撬动他们不应得的影响力。"

entries.en:
"It is the relationships formed between the tiers of our civilization, the flow of loyalty and favor, that ties our interests together and benefits us all," Reynard muses.

He closes his eyes for a moment as he holds and slowly releases a deep breath. They open suddenly. "Your reputation, however, precedes you, $playerName. You've made a habit of breaking your word, and I cannot offer my patronage to someone with no honor."

"I mean no insult, of course," he says, magnanimous in his own way. "People of your, ah, ruthless quality have their use. Just not like this."
entries.zh:
"正是我们文明中各个阶级之间的关系，忠诚与奖赏的交换，将我们的利益紧密联系在一起，使我们所有人受益，" Reynard 沉思道。

他闭上眼睛，深吸一口气，然后缓缓呼出，突然又睁开了眼睛。"然而，你的名声早已传开，$playerName。你惯常于背信弃义，我无法向一个毫无荣誉可言的人提供庇护。"

"我无意冒犯，" 他以自己独特的方式展现出宽宏大量，"像你这样，呃，冷酷无情的人也有用处。只是不是以这种方式。"

entries.en:
"As Prime Demarchon, I attest that $player.theFactionName meets the membership requirements set out by the constitution of the Persean League. As the lead executive, your personal authorization of petition for membership is provisionally recognized and passed." He makes a conciliatory gesture, "The council must officially vote approval, of course. But I shall see to that formality."

"Let me be the first, then, to welcome you to the Persean League, $playerName. Together we will build a worthy future for the Persean Sector and, one day, the galaxy itself."

Reynard Hannan smiles widely, flashing perfect teeth - nearly; his canines are slightly more prominent than ideal. An affectation of style, surely.
entries.zh:
"作为大统领，我证明 $player.theFactionName 符合 英仙座联盟 宪章所规定的成员要求。作为首席执行官，你个人提出的入会申请已被临时认可并通过。" 他做出了一个和解的手势，"当然，理事会必须正式投票批准。但我会处理好这个形式上的问题。"

"那么，就让我第一个欢迎你加入 英仙座联盟，$playerName。我们将共同为英仙座星域，乃至有一天为整个银河系，创造一个光明的未来。"

Reynard Hannan 咧开嘴，露出了几乎完美的牙齿 —— 只是他的犬齿比想象中稍微突出了一些。这一定是他刻意追求的风格。

o.en: You heard me the first time - I'm done with the League.
o.zh: 你刚刚也听到了吧 —— 我和联盟到此为止了。
别在意，我只是...说错话了而已。

o.en: I meant what I said. I'm done with the League.
o.zh: 我是认真的。我和联盟的关系到此为止了。

entries.en:
A strained grimace appears on Reynard Hannan's face, showing new wrinkles where they aren't meant to appear.

"The... rumors, unfortunately, are true. An ugly business, the details of which we need not revisit." His impressive jawline clenches tightly for a moment.

"For your part in quietly returning the forge of Kazeron to its former glory, I would personally ensure that the League Council fully appreciates your... patriotism."
entries.zh:
Reynard Hannan 的脸上露出了一丝勉强的苦笑，这让他本不该出现皱纹的地方也显现出了纹路.

"那个...传言，很不幸，是真的。这是一件丑陋的事情，我们无需再重提那些细节。" 他那线条分明的下巴紧绷了一会儿，

"对于你暗中帮助 Kazeron 恢复纳米锻炉往日荣耀的行为，我本人会确保联盟理事会充分认识到你的...爱国精神。"

entries.en:
"Recall my words, captain. You had one chance for forgiveness," he says grimly, "and you wasted it."

"Do not recall to me your betrayal."
entries.zh:
"记住我的话，舰长。你只有一次获得原谅的机会，" 他严厉地说道，"而你已经浪费了。"

"不要让我想起你的背叛。"

entries.en:
"There is a stain on you, captain," he says gravely. "It is the reek of one who does not keep their word. Lies I can forgive as mere intrigue... but to betray an oath?"

His head shakes, slowly. "Worse than dishonorable, it is uncivilized. You're a barbarian, captain. You cannot be a part of the world I've built."

"Don't misunderstand me," he stops, and fixing his gaze on you. "Barbarians have their use, nonetheless."
entries.zh:
"你身上有一个污点，舰长，" 他严肃地说道，"不守信用的人是令人厌恶的。谎言我可以原谅，那只是计谋...但背叛誓言？"

他缓缓地摇了摇头。"这比失去荣誉还要糟糕，这是不文明的行为。你是个野蛮人，舰长。你不能成为我构建的世界的一部分。"

"不要误会我，" 他停下来，目光固定在你身上。"不过，野蛮人也有他们的用处。"

entries.en:
"Your little scrap of a colony - what was it called? I forget - is not a member of the Persean League, captain. What need have I to be patron to barbarians?"

He sighs, looking away. "I grant that mercs like you have their uses. But it always feels like one must sanitize after such transactions."
entries.zh:
"你那块小小的殖民地 —— 它叫什么名字来着？我忘了 —— 并不是 英仙座联盟 的成员，舰长。我为什么要成为野蛮人的庇护者呢？"

他叹了口气，目光移开。"我承认像你这样的佣兵有他们的用处。但和你这种人打交道后，总感觉需要好好消毒一番。"

entries.en:
"No."

Reynard leans back, hands coming together in front of him. His lack of explanation is quite intentional, and it feels like acknowledging it would concede him a minor victory.
entries.zh:
"不。"

Reynard 向后靠去，双手在身前交叠。他故意不给出解释，而承认这一点似乎会让他获得一场小小的胜利。

entries.en:
"Poor thing." Reynard smiles sadly, the facade of forgiveness written across his face. "I hope you've learned your lesson."

He drops the expression for steely indifference. "Understand full and well that you're only going to get this one chance to cross me and return."
entries.zh:
"真可怜。" Reynard 脸上露出悲伤的笑容，宽恕的假象浮现在他的脸上。"我希望你已经吸取了教训。"

他收起笑容，变得冷酷无情。"你要清楚地知道，我只给你一次迷途知返的机会。"

o.en: Yes, I made a terrible mistake. Please accept my apologies.
o.zh: 是的，我犯了一个可怕的错误。请原谅我。

o.en: Never mind, I didn't come here to beg.
o.zh: 抱歉，我不是来乞求宽恕的。

entries.en:
"Oh? If you're facing bankruptcy, I could have a word with some investors. As a personal favor, of course." He oozes noblesse oblige, reflecting on your situation.
