He leverages himself off the bar and to a standing position. "Got a sleep shift to catch. Good luck with the, uh, I guess you didn't say. Good luck with it, anyway."
entries.zh:
那名独立舰长对你的冷淡不以为意，最后深深吸了一口酒。

他撑着吧台站起身。"我还有个睡眠班要赶。祝你那件，呃，你好像也没说是什么事。总之，祝顺利吧。"

entries.en:
"You know." He pats his chest. "Them bits what goes in here. And, well, lots of other pieces too a spacer might lose. Just about anything squishy, really. And spacer or no, sooner or later there's always someone that's got some bit going bad that could use a better one, am I right?"

"And here," he sweeps with his hand; Nomios. "They've got the best supply in the Sector - on ice."

He looks at you, the idea suddenly dawning on him. "That's not why you're here?"
entries.zh:
"你懂的。\"他拍了拍胸口。\"就是装进这里头的那些部件。还有，嗯，太空船员可能弄丢的许多别的零件。说真的，凡是软乎乎的玩意儿都算。不管是不是干这行的，早晚总有人身上某个部件坏了，想换个更好的，我说得对吧？"

"而这里，\"他挥手一划；Nomios。\"这儿的货源是星域里最好的——冰镇着的。"

他看着你，忽然像想通了什么。"你该不会就是为这个来的吧？"

o.en: No. I don't trade in... meat.
o.zh: 不是。我不做... '卖肉'的买卖。

o.en: Oh, I am. I simply hadn't heard the term.
o.zh: 哦，我是做这行的。我只是没听过这个说法。

o.en: You're telling me they sell parts from the cryosleepers?
o.zh: 你是说，他们拿冷冻沉睡者身上的部件去卖？

entries.en: He gives you a curious look, then shrugs.
entries.zh: 他好奇地看了你一眼，然后耸耸肩。

entries.en: He gives you a curious look for a moment, then shrugs.
entries.zh: 他好奇地看了你一会儿，然后耸耸肩。

entries.en: He gives you a curious look for a moment, then shrugs.
entries.zh: 他好奇地看了你一会儿，然后耸耸肩。

entries.en:
He clears is throat, loudly, as if the noise might go back two seconds in time and cover up your words.

"I didn't tell nothing," he takes a careful sip of his drink, still looking around warily.

"Anyway, it's all legitimate and agreed-to. Not lots of folks have all the credits it'd take to get a good sleep-package, so... put some of your useful bits into the deal and knock the price down. Buy what's like 'em back, or good-enough augments, when you're awoke. Maybe on credit, maybe some investment works out in ten, a hundred cycles."

He pulls a crunchy snack out of a microgravity-safe container and pops it in his mouth.

"Just business."
entries.zh:
他大声清了清嗓子，仿佛这声音能倒回两秒钟之前，把你的话盖掉。

"我什么都没说，"他小心地抿了一口酒，仍在警觉地四下张望。

"反正，全都是合法合规、双方讲定的。没多少人拿得出买一份好睡眠套餐要的那些星币，所以... 把自己身上几件有用的部件折进交易里，价钱就压下来了。等你醒过来，再买回差不多的，或者够用的强化件。也许赊账，也许某笔投资在十年、一百个星历年之后就有了回报。"

他从一个适用于微重力的密封罐里掏出一块脆零嘴，丢进嘴里。

"只是生意。"

o.en: Do you know anything about a Doctor Cydonia?
o.zh: 你听说过一个叫 Cydonia 的博士吗？

o.en: Do you know about Doctor Cydonia's involvement here?
o.zh: 你知道 Cydonia 博士在这里掺和了些什么吗？

o.en: I'm looking for someone who died here. Something went wrong.
o.zh: 我在找一个死在这里的人。事情出了岔子。

o.en: Thank him for the drink and look back around the bar
o.zh: 谢过他的酒，再看看酒吧里还有什么人

entries.en:
The independent captain takes one last, long draw from his drink.

"Welp." He leverages himself off the bar and to a standing position. "Got a sleep shift to catch. Good luck with the, uh, I guess you didn't say. Good luck with it, anyway."
entries.zh:
那名独立舰长最后深深吸了一口酒。

"得嘞。\"他撑着吧台站起身。\"我还有个睡眠班要赶。祝你那件，呃，你好像也没说是什么事。总之，祝顺利吧。"

o.en: Wipe the crumbs off your uniform and look around the bar
o.zh: 掸掉制服上的碎屑，环视酒吧

entries.en:
He raises his eyebrows.

"Careful with those words, $playerSirOrMadam. Mbaye-Gogol is ver' mindful of its reputation, you know. They want folks putting all their credits here, entrusting the cryosanctum with waking them up in a thousand cycles."

"And me? Speak not ill of the hand that pays, is what I say. Don't know nothing about anything going wrong, and ain't never happens so far as I know."

He eyes you. "Not meaning any disrespect to yourself, mind."
entries.zh:
他挑了挑眉毛。

"说话小心点，$playerSirOrMadam。Mbaye-Gogol 对自己的名声可看重得很。他们盼着大伙儿把星币都搁在这儿，把身家托给冷冻圣所，指望一千年后有人把自己叫醒。"

"我呢？我就一句话：别说给钱那只手的坏话。什么出了岔子的事，我一点不知道，据我所知也从来没出过。"

他打量着你。"当然，没有对你不敬的意思。"

entries.en:
You ask around about a mercenary you've heard of by the name of Pericles Aventine, focusing on drawing out the comfortable-looking regulars who know the local volume.

It doesn't take so long, nor the purchase of so many drinks.

"'Aventine' eh? You must mean Pericles Moroz."

An old spacer interjects herself into your present, fruitless inquiry. The trade agent lifts your gifted drink in salute and waves you toward your new source.
entries.zh:
你四处打听一个听说的雇佣兵，名叫 Pericles Aventine，专挑那些看上去过得舒坦、又熟悉本地星区的常客套话。

没有花太久，也没用上几杯酒。

"'Aventine'？你说的一定是 Pericles Moroz。"

一个老航行者插进了你眼下这场毫无收获的打听。那名贸易代理举起你请的那杯酒致意，又朝这位新消息源挥了挥手。

o.en: Sit and have the old spacer's drink refreshed
o.zh: 坐下，给这位老航行者再续一杯

entries.en:
You ask around about a mercenary you've heard of by the name of Pericles Moroz, focusing on drawing out the comfortable-looking regulars who know the local volume.

It doesn't take so long, nor the purchase of so many drinks.

"Pericles 'eh? I know of 'im. Even met 'im, in a manner of speaking."

An old spacer interjects herself into your present, fruitless inquiry. The trade agent lifts your gifted drink in salute and waves you toward your new source.
entries.zh:
你四处打听一个听说的雇佣兵，名叫 Pericles Moroz，专挑那些看上去过得舒坦、又熟悉本地星区的常客套话。

没有花太久，也没用上几杯酒。

"Pericles？这名儿我听过。还见过他本人——勉强算是见过吧。"

一个老航行者插进了你眼下这场毫无收获的打听。那名贸易代理举起你请的那杯酒致意，又朝这位新消息源挥了挥手。

o.en: Sit and have the old spacer's drink refreshed
o.zh: 坐下，给这位老航行者再续一杯

entries.en:
"-And the kid's got a talent for combat," she continues. "A natural leader, to boot. Presence, and voice like a plasma cutter. Ambitious though, and ruthless. He don't know to quit when he's won, y'see."

She lifts the fresh drink that's appeared and flashes a titanium smile.
entries.zh:
"——而且这小子天生就是打仗的料，\"她接着说，\"还是个天生的头儿。有气场，嗓子像等离子切割器。不过野心大，手也狠。他赢了也不晓得收手，你懂吧。"

她端起刚出现的那杯新酒，咧嘴一笑，露出一口亮得反光的牙。

o.en: But he gets the job done, right?
You're saying he overextends his fleet?
o.zh: 你是说，他把舰队拉得太长了？

o.en: I don't see how it's possible to win too much.
o.zh: 赢太多这种事，我可想不出怎么能办到。

entries.en:
"Listen close." She sets down the drinking-vessel.

"You're hired for a job, you do the job. Everyone's happy, 'cept maybe them who wanted to pull an ambush. Fair be fair."

She pauses, looking somewhere distant.
entries.zh:
"听仔细了。"她放下酒杯。

"你接了活，就好好干。大家都高兴，也许除了那些本来想打伏击的人。一码归一码。"

她顿住，目光飘向远处。

entries.en:
"Let me put it like this. If you go too far, beyond the job... then it's for blood and glory. For yourself."

"Risks the job, risks the credits. Scare off some pirates, that's fair. Give 'em a fight if they come looking for one, that's fair. Hunt 'em down after they run, tankers and all, across two systems? Poppin' escape pods to boot?"

"That ain't fair. That's making enemies." She finished her drink in one long swig, then stands. "S'all I'll say. Thanks for the drink."
entries.zh:
"这么说吧。要是你走得太远，超出了这单活...那就是为了血，为了荣耀。为了你自己。"

"那是在拿活计冒险，拿星币冒险。把几个海盗吓跑，这算公平。他们找上门来，就给他们一场打，也算公平。可他们跑了你还一路追杀，油船什么的都不放过，追过两个星系？连逃生舱都打爆？"

"那就不公平了。那是在结仇。\"她一口把酒喝干，然后站起身。\"我就说这些。谢谢你的酒。"

entries.en:
The bartender appears to retrieve the empty vessel, and looks casually toward the departing spacer.

"You've been asking about Pericles. He's here, sometimes. Drinks all 'round after a big score. Folks like him plenty when the night starts, but by the end..."

He turns to give you an appraising look.

"Not looking for trouble, right? Business?"
entries.zh:
酒保过来收走空杯，又若无其事地朝那离去的太空佬看了一眼。

"你一直在打听 Pericles。他有时候会来。干成一票大的，就请全场喝一轮。夜里刚开始的时候，大家都挺喜欢他，可到了后半夜..."

他转过头，打量着你。

"不是来找麻烦的吧？谈生意？"

entries.en:
"Spoke with Moroz yet? Maeus Moroz? Closest thing to a family Pericles has. Maeus doesn't go out on jobs so much anymore."

The bartender gives the table a wipe, then shrugs. "Takes a hard bastard to love another like a son. Almost heartwarming."

"Mind you, don't be saying I said it here, or anywhere else. Like I told, they're hard. They're killers. Do Heggies work sometimes, sometimes not. I'll give you his comms, for it's no secret."

With a nod, the bartender throws the towel over their shoulder and scuttles away with the drinkware.
entries.zh:
"跟 Moroz 谈过了吗？Maeus Moroz？算是 Pericles 最亲近的亲人了。Maeus 现在不太出去接活了。"

酒保擦了擦桌子，然后耸耸肩。"得是个硬茬子，才能把别人当儿子一样疼。听着还挺暖心。"

"不过你记着，别说是我在这儿说的，也别说是从别处听来的。我说过了，他们是硬角色。是杀人的行当。有时候接霸主的活，有时候不接。我把他的通讯号给你，反正也不是什么秘密。"

酒保点点头，把毛巾往肩上一搭，端着酒具匆匆走开。

entries.en:
"Spoke with Moroz yet? Maeus Moroz? Closest thing to a family Pericles has. Maeus doesn't go out on jobs so much anymore."

The bartender gives the table a wipe, then shrugs. "Takes a hard bastard to love another like a son. Almost heartwarming."

"Mind you, don't be saying I said it here, or anywhere else. Like I told, they're hard. They're killers. Do Heggies work sometimes, sometimes not. I'll give you his comms, for it's no secret."

With a nod, the bartender throws the towel over their shoulder and scuttles away with the drinkware.
entries.zh:
"跟 Moroz 谈过了吗？Maeus Moroz？算是 Pericles 最亲近的亲人了。Maeus 现在不太出去接活了。"

酒保擦了擦桌子，然后耸耸肩。"得是个硬茬子，才能把别人当儿子一样疼。听着还挺暖心。"

"不过你记着，别说是我在这儿说的，也别说是从别处听来的。我说过了，他们是硬角色。是杀人的行当。有时候接霸主的活，有时候不接。我把他的通讯号给你，反正也不是什么秘密。"

酒保点点头，把毛巾往肩上一搭，端着酒具匆匆走开。

entries.en:
"You heard true, then. Pericles is like a son to Moroz."

He pauses to see if you recognize the name.

"Maeus Moroz. He's a hard bastard, but maybe it takes one to be the father to another. Almost heartwarming. But they're killers. Do Heggie work sometimes, sometimes not. Maybe you know that already, maybe that's why you're asking. So, yeah, Pericles is here sometimes. Not seem him for a few shifts though."

With a nod, the bartender throws the towel over his shoulder and scuttles away with the drinkware.
entries.zh:
"那你听的是真的。Pericles 对 Moroz 来说就像儿子。"

他顿了顿，看你是不是认得这个名字。

"Maeus Moroz。他是个硬茬子，可也许就得是这种人，才当得了别人的父亲。听着还挺暖心。可他们是杀人的行当。有时候接霸主的活，有时候不接。也许你早就知道，也许你就是为这个才来问的。所以，对，Pericles 有时候会来。不过我已经好几班没见到他了。"

酒保点点头，把毛巾往肩上一搭，端着酒具匆匆走开。

entries.en:
The bartender squints at you as he gives the table a wipe.

"Pericles. Always throwing himself at danger. Did he finally cross Kanta or something?"

Then, quickly, "I'm not asking for an answer, and I'd welcome you not to start any trouble here. I got a bar to run and a long life I want to live. Will take your order at the bar if you're buying."

The bartender scuttles away.
entries.zh:
酒保一边擦桌子，一边眯起眼看你。

"Pericles。总是往危险里扑。他终于是惹上 Kanta 那帮人了，还是怎么？"

然后他很快补上一句："我不是要你回答，也请你别在我这儿惹事。我这酒吧要开下去，我还想活得长久。你要买酒，就到吧台来点。"

酒保匆匆走开。

entries.en:
"Stars above." The bartender exclaims, looking up. He recognizes you're not a drunk, and seems to be praying you're just a crank.

"If that's... if you think that, I don't need to hear about it. That's loose talk. Especially about Pericles. Mind what you're broadcasting, clear?"

The bartender scuttles away with the drinkware without wiping down the table.
entries.zh:
"群星在上。"酒保抬头喊道。他看出你不是醉汉，又像是盼着你不过是个胡说八道的怪人。

"要是那...要是你这么想，我可不用听。那是胡说八道。尤其是关于 Pericles 的。说话留神，明白吗？"

酒保端着酒具匆匆走开，连桌子都没擦。

entries.en:
You're in mid-conversation with a heavy freighter pilot when the words seem suddenly loud in your ears. Your hand goes to your sidearm - a subconscious response to the hush you now realize fell over the bar.

"You!" A shout from a broad figure silhouetted in the door. "Take my son's name from your dirt-eating mouth!"
entries.zh:
你正和一名重型货船驾驶员聊到一半，那些话忽然在耳中变得响亮。你的手摸向随身武器——那是对此刻酒吧里骤然安静下来的下意识反应，你这才意识到。

"你！\"门口一道宽大的身影逆着光，厉声喝道。\"别用你那张吃土的臭嘴提我儿子的名字！"

o.en: I need to talk to Pericles. It's a... family matter.
o.zh: 我得跟 Pericles 谈谈。是...家里的事。

o.en: Business. Got a job. I'm hearing he's good, maybe great. (lie)
o.zh: 生意。有单活。听说他干得不错，也许很出色。 (说谎)

o.en: He's in danger. I need to warn him.
He's a clone of Philip Andrada.
o.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。

entries.en:
You ask around about someone named 'Jason Korin', lubricating the conversation freely with purchased drinks. Most are pleased to accept your generosity - such token gifts in exchange for a bit of goodwill and a rumor are a fixture of spaceport bars

No one has heard of a 'Jason Korin', however, nor seen the young man whose image you extracted from the intel file.

Alternatives are suggested for whatever presumed service you are seeking or offering but, with clarification, you receive nothing more than an apologetic shrug or a raised glass and the expressed hope that you'll find yourself under a luckier star soon enough.
entries.zh:
你四处打听一个叫 Jason Korin 的人，用买来的酒水把话头润得顺滑。多数人乐意接受你的慷慨——用这点小恩小惠换几分好感和一则传闻，本是太空港酒吧的常态。

然而没人听过 Jason Korin 这个名字，也没人见过你从情报文件里截出的那个年轻人的模样。

人们纷纷替你猜你想找或想卖的是哪一门路，可等你解释清楚，换来的只有一句抱歉的耸肩，或者举起酒杯，说希望你早点走到一颗运气更好的星下去。

entries.en:
You turn to make a casual scan of the bar to find your view blocked by a heavily augmented woman in a dark coat. Her eyes are silver.

"'Pologies, $playerSirOrMadam." She clears her throat. "The boss... wishes for me to do the favor of extending to you an invitation to partake in the back room and share a word on your, uh, pressing query."

She hides a look of relief at making it through what are clearly someone else's words.
entries.zh:
你转身随意扫了一眼酒吧，视线却被一个身穿深色外套、改造痕迹极重的女人挡住。她的眼睛是银色的。

"抱歉，$playerSirOrMadam。\"她清了清嗓子。\"老板...想让我帮忙给您带个话，请您到后面那间屋里坐坐，聊聊您那桩，呃，要紧的事。"

话说完，她藏起一丝如释重负的神色——那显然不是她自己的措辞。

entries.en:
She nods, then turns to lead you into the shadows at the back of the bar.

Behind a clever echelon of black curtains is a door, and behind that door a small, luxurious lounge slouches moodily.
entries.zh:
她点点头，转身领你走进酒吧后方的阴影里。

层层巧妙错落的黑色帘幕之后是一扇门，门后是一间小巧而奢华的休息室，懒散地沉在暗处。

entries.en:
You move to step away, and she steps into your path. From the corner of your eye you see a couple of your bodyguards tense up, ready to act.

"Please," she says, expressionless. "That's my ask. Boss don't like to hear no. Gets in a mood."
entries.zh:
你想侧身走开，她却横跨一步挡在前面。你眼角瞥见两名保镖绷紧了身子，随时准备动手。

"拜托。\"她面无表情。\"这是我要办的事。老板不爱听不行。会闹脾气。"

o.en: Still no. Good luck with your boss.
o.zh: 还是不行。祝你老板那儿好运。

o.en: You got an answer. Now clear off.
o.zh: 你已经得到答复了。现在让开。

entries.en:
She half-bows apologetically and removes herself from your path.

Your bodyguards relax.
entries.zh:
她带着歉意半鞠一躬，让开了去路。

你的保镖们松了下来。

entries.en:
She half-bows apologetically and removes herself from your path.

Your bodyguards relax.
entries.zh:
她带着歉意半鞠一躬，让开了去路。

你的保镖们松了下来。

entries.en:
"Interesting," the $post says, watching you with a wisp of smile. As if assessing you like a prize. "Intriguing, even."

The goon, silver-eyes, disappears.

"I am called K-O Jove. Qaras is my interest. When interesting things happen here, they become my business."
entries.zh:
"有意思。\"$post 说，唇角挂着一丝笑，打量着你，像在估一件奖品。\"甚至可以说，耐人寻味。"

那个银眼睛的打手不见了。

"人们叫我 K-O Jove。Qaras 是我的地盘。这里一旦发生有意思的事，就成了我的事。"

o.en: I suppose you might know where I can find Jason Korin?
o.zh: 我想，你也许知道哪儿能找到 Jason Korin？

entries.en:
"Achilles Kalian? Of course we know him! He's the one who wiped the floor with some spacer trash last week, ha-ha!"

A couple other young officers start chanting "Kalian! Kalian!"

After this fails to inspire the rest of the bar to take up the chant, they conclude with a cheer nonetheless and down their drinks.
entries.zh:
"Achilles Kalian？我们当然认得他！上周把某个太空佬渣滓揍得满地找牙的就是他，哈哈！"

旁边几个年轻军官开始齐声喊："Kalian！Kalian！"

这喊声没能带动酒吧里其余的人，他们还是自己欢呼了一声作结，然后把杯中酒一饮而尽。

entries.en: The officers' pointman slams a drinking vessel down and wipes his mouth on his sleeve.
entries.zh: 军官们当中领头的那个把酒杯往桌上一顿，用袖子抹了抹嘴。

o.en: I feel like you good folks could use another round - on me.
o.zh: 我看诸位该再来一轮——我请。

o.en: Uh, I have a pressing appointment elsewhere. (leave)
o.zh: 呃，我还有个要紧的约会。在别处。 (离开)

entries.en:
"Hey," one of the junior officers is looking between you and their datapad, albeit somewhat unsteadily. "You're a... you have a commish... mission."

After a moment of confusion, the message gets across - you bear a League commission and therefore are one of the "good ones" - the exact words used.

This results in a cheer to your integrity and honorable bearing followed by enthusiastic back-slapping and drink-spilling.
entries.zh:
"嘿，\"一名下级军官的目光在你和他们的数据板之间来回，人有些站不稳，\"你是... 你有委任... 委任状。"

困惑了片刻，意思总算传达到了——你持有联盟的委任状，因此属于他们口中的"自己人"——用的正是这几个字。

于是有人为你的正直与体面欢呼起来，接着是一通热情的拍背和泼洒的酒水。

o.en: I feel like you good folks could use a round on me.
o.zh: 我看诸位该让我请一轮。

o.en: I have a pressing appointment elsewhere. (leave)
o.zh: 我还有个要紧的约会。在别处。 (离开)

entries.en:
"Hey," one of the junior officers is looking between you and their datapad, albeit somewhat unsteadily. "You're a, uh... a democh... demarchon!"

Everyone stands up a bit straighter, adopting a somewhat more respectable, though still wobbly, composure.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," their apparent leader declares. "It would be an honor to share a drink with you."

A chorus of "ayes" follow this proclamation.
entries.zh:
"嘿，\"一名下级军官的目光在你和他们的数据板之间来回，人有些站不稳，\"你是，呃... 统... 统领！"

所有人都坐直了些，摆出一副稍微像样些、多少也还算端正的仪态，尽管有几位仍在晃。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，\"他们当中显然是头儿的那位宣布道，\"能与您共饮一杯，是我们的荣幸。"

话音刚落，一片"是！"的应和声响起。

o.en: Well, it's not like you have much choice
o.zh: 反正你也没什么别的选择

entries.en: One round turns into two, and a good impression is solidified.
entries.zh: 一轮变成两轮，好印象也就此坐实。

entries.en:
"Hey," one of the junior officers is looking at their datapad, albeit somewhat unsteadily. "You're not with us."

Low muttering; the officers seem to withdraw their drinks as if you might snatch them away, or seed them with some spacer-poison.
entries.zh:
"嘿，\"一名下级军官看着自己的数据板，人有些站不稳，\"你不是我们的人。"

低低的嘀咕声；军官们似乎把酒杯往回收，像是怕你一把抢走，或者往里下了什么太空佬的毒药。

o.en: I feel like you good folks could use a round on me.
o.zh: 我看诸位该让我请一轮。

o.en: I have a pressing appointment elsewhere. (leave)
o.zh: 我还有个要紧的约会。在别处。 (离开)

entries.en: You hear the words "heggie" and "Mairaath" along with the broadside of dark looks.
entries.zh: 你听见"霸主佬"和"Mairaath"这两个词，还迎着迎面而来的一片阴沉目光。

entries.en: You hear the words "luddie" and "mazzie" alongside with some skeptical looks.
entries.zh: 你听见"卢德佬"和"Mazzie"这两个词，还伴着几道怀疑的目光。

entries.en:
"Hey," one of the junior officers is looking at their datapad, albeit somewhat unsteadily. "You're not with us."

Low muttering; the officers seem to withdraw their drinks as if you might snatch them away, or seed them with some spacer-poison.
entries.zh:
"嘿，\"一名下级军官看着自己的数据板，人有些站不稳，\"你不是我们的人。"

低低的嘀咕声；军官们似乎把酒杯往回收，像是怕你一把抢走，或者往里下了什么太空佬的毒药。

entries.en: Having run an ID, it appears they've discovered that while you bear a commission, it is not with the Persean League, which appears to put your character into question.
entries.zh: 他们查过身份之后似乎发现：你确实持有委任状，但并不属于英仙座联盟——这让你的品性成了问题。

entries.en: Having run an ID, it appears they've discovered that you don't bear a faction commission at all - you're just some random spacer out for their own self.
entries.zh: 他们查过身份之后似乎发现：你根本没有任何势力的委任状——不过是个为自己奔忙的太空佬。

entries.en: You hear the words "sindie" and "Cruor" alongside some skeptical looks.
entries.zh: 你听见"辛达佬"和"Cruor"这两个词，还伴着几道怀疑的目光。

entries.en: You hear the words "tachy" along with some skeptical looks.
entries.zh: 你听见"速子佬"这个词，还伴着几道怀疑的目光。

entries.en:
You share a round with the junior officers. Learning that they are drinking with a demarchon of the League has put them into a somewhat stunned state.

They do their best to maintain their composure - sitting up straight, albeit unsteadily in a few cases, and sipping their drinks rather than downing them all at once.

A few polite questions are managed - where is your planet, what are its notable qualities - before you can firmly turn the conversation to your own purposes.
entries.zh:
你和这些下级军官共饮了一轮。得知自己是在跟联盟的一位统领喝酒，他们有些发懵。

他们竭力维持仪态——坐得笔直，有几位却坐得不太稳，喝酒也改成小口啜，不再一口闷。

他们总算问出几个客套的问题——你的星球在哪儿，有什么出众之处——你这才得以把话头稳稳引到自己的目的上。

o.en: I hear Lieutenant Kalian is unassigned. I'd like to speak with him...
o.zh: 我听说 Kalian 中尉目前没有任职。我想跟他谈谈...

entries.en: More than one of the officers is forced to retreat from the field to 'vent flux', as they put it, before the ruckus quiets enough that you can find an opportunity to turn the conversation toward your inquiry.
entries.zh: 不止一名军官不得不离席，用他们的话说，去"排幅能"；等喧闹平息到你能找到机会把话头引向你的问题，已经过了一会儿。

o.en: I hear Kalian was unassigned. Shame. But I might have an opportunity...
o.zh: 我听说 Kalian 没有任职。可惜。不过我这儿也许有个机会...

entries.en:
You couldn't have delivered a more fitting line to a more receptive audience.

The cheers and stomping earn a worried look from the barkeeper, but they know where the credits come from and who it's profitable to keep happy.
entries.zh:
这句话说得再合适不过，听的人也再捧场不过。

欢呼与跺脚招来酒保担忧的一瞥，可他们清楚星币是从谁手里来的，也清楚哄谁开心才有赚头。

entries.en:
Their 'leader' seems unsure, and looks back at the gang to gauge their mood. By their state of inebriation, their mood seems to be a matter of pure chance.

A shaking head, a displeased noise. It spreads into frowns and glares and more muttering.

"I don't think so, cap," the 'leader' says dismissively. "We don't rec with your kind. Kalian knew what to do with your type."

The implied threat earns some hoots and encouragement.
entries.zh:
他们的'头儿'看着有些迟疑，回头望向那帮人，想摸清他们的情绪。不过就他们醉成那样，情绪如何恐怕全凭运气。

一个摇头，一声不满的哼声。随即蔓延成皱眉、瞪眼和更多的嘀咕。

"我看不必了，舰长，\"他们的'头儿'不以为然地摆了摆手，\"我们可不跟你们这种人喝酒。Kalian 知道该拿你们这种人怎么办。"

这暗含的威胁招来几声哄笑和叫好。

o.en: I have a pressing appointment elsewhere. (leave)
o.zh: 我还有个要紧的约会。在别处。 (离开)

o.en: Wipe the smirk off his face... with your fist.
o.zh: 用拳头抹掉他脸上那副得意的笑...

entries.en:
Their 'leader' seems unsure, and looks back at the gang to gauge their mood. By their state of inebriation, their mood seems to be a matter of pure chance.

A shrug, a sheepish grin. This spreads into approving sounds, then cheers. The 'leader' nods at you.

"A drinks a drink, isn't it? Come on, then."

You're pulled to their table and hailed as someone landing halfway between a worthy competitor and a fellow-warrior.
entries.zh:
他们的'头儿'看着有些迟疑，回头望向那帮人，想摸清他们的情绪。不过就他们醉成那样，情绪如何恐怕全凭运气。

一个耸肩，一个不好意思的笑。这笑传染开来，变成认可的嘀咕，接着是欢呼。'头儿'朝你点了点头。

"酒就是酒，还能有什么两样？那就来吧。"

你被拽到他们桌边，被当成一个既算得上像样的对手、又够得上同袍的人来欢迎。

o.en: Bartender, a round for my new friends!
o.zh: 酒保，给我的新朋友们来一轮！

entries.en:
"I don't think so, cap," their 'leader' says dismissively.

Some derisive hoots are emitted from the pack of officers. "We don't rec with your kind. Achilles knew what to do with you."

The implied threat earns some jeers and encouragement.
entries.zh:
"我看不必了，舰长，"他们的'头儿'不以为然地摆了摆手。

军官堆里爆出几声嘲弄的嘘声。"我们可不跟你们这种人打交道。Achilles 知道该拿你们怎么办。"

这暗含的威胁招来几声哄笑和叫好。

o.en: I have a pressing appointment elsewhere. (leave)
o.zh: 我还有个要紧的约会。在别处。 (离开)

o.en: Wipe the smirk off his face - with your fist
o.zh: 用拳头抹掉他脸上那副得意的笑

entries.en:
The junior officers sheepishly give in to your authority, shushing their drunker comrades and arranging themselves respectfully at the table. It isn't a passable parade formation, but it's a good sight more civilized than the state you found them in.

The bartender gives you a grateful look as they find this opportunity to finally clear some of the empties.
entries.zh:
那些下级军官讪讪地服了你的管束，嘘住醉得更厉害的同伴，规规矩矩地在桌边坐好。这队形算不上能上阅兵场的行列，但比起你刚进来时的样子，已经文明太多了。

酒保趁这机会终于能收走几个空杯，感激地看了你一眼。

entries.en:
Boos and jeers erupt. You're obviously no fun at all.

The officers do settle into a relatively sullen din after a minute, but they seem unlikely to engage in a conversation.
entries.zh:
嘘声和嘲笑炸开来。你显然是个扫兴的家伙。

过了一分钟，军官们到底还是压成了一片闷闷的低声嘈杂，但看样子是不打算跟你搭话了。

entries.en: Boos and jeers erupt. It's become clear that you're no fun at all, and the mood is taking a turn for the ugly.
entries.zh: 嘘声和嘲笑炸开来。你是个扫兴的家伙，这已经很明显了，而气氛正往难看的方向滑。

o.en: Step away and find a quiet corner of the bar to reassess your options
o.zh: 退开，到酒吧安静的角落重新盘算

o.en: I have a pressing appointment. Elsewhere. (leave)
o.zh: 我还有个要紧的约会。在别处。 (离开)

entries.en:
Boos and jeers erupt. You're no fun at all.

One larger, drunker junior officer steps to your face, flashes a grin to his comrades, then delivers his line.

"Achilles knew what to do with your kind."
entries.zh:
嘘声和嘲笑炸开来。你一点都不好玩。

一个块头更大、醉得更狠的下级军官凑到你脸前，朝同伴们咧嘴一笑，然后撂下他那句话。

"Achilles 知道该怎么收拾你们这种人。"

o.en: I have a pressing appointment elsewhere. (leave)
o.zh: 我还有个要紧的约会。在别处。 (离开)

o.en: Wipe the smirk off his face - with your fist
o.zh: 用拳头抹掉他脸上那副得意的笑

entries.en:
"It would be inappropriate to speculate on the alleged activities of hypothetical guests or employees, whether on-contract or... permanent staff."

Blanc speaks soothingly, like quiet death.

"Please accept my apologies, captain."
entries.zh:
"对假设中的客人或雇员的所谓活动加以揣测，是不合适的——无论他们是合同人员，还是... 长期员工。"

Blanc 的语气安抚人心，像安静的死亡。

"请接受我的歉意，舰长。"

entries.en:
"It is as I explained," Blanc says, his voice suffocatingly soothing.

"It would be inappropriate to discuss the hypothetical activities of guests or employees, whether permanent staff or... contracted."

His attempt at a sad, apologetic smile mostly fails.
entries.zh:
"正如我解释过的，"Blanc 说，声音安抚得令人窒息。

"讨论客人或雇员——无论长期员工还是... 合同人员——的假设性活动，是不合适的。"

他试图挤出一个悲伤而歉意的微笑，基本失败了。

o.en: I have questions about an operation performed here by a Doctor Cydonia.
o.zh: 关于一位 Cydonia 医生在这里做的一台手术，我有几个问题。

o.en: I'm looking for a young man called Perseus Saturnian.
o.zh: 我在找一个叫 Perseus Saturnian 的年轻人。

entries.en:
"Of course," he says blandly.

"We have many guests here, and the directors of Mbaye-Gogol consider their privacy a core principle of the Cryosanctum. It is perhaps our utmost principle; a pillar of the corporation. We have a reputation spanning... generations."

Blanc's face is barely animate. When his lips move, it is as if a corpse has been compelled to twitch by embedded electrodes.

"So I am sure you understand why I cannot confirm or deny the presence of any individual."
entries.zh:
"当然，"他语气平淡地说。

"我们这里有许多客人，而 Mbaye-Gogol 的董事们把他们的隐私视为冷冻圣所的核心原则。这或许是我们最高的原则，是公司的支柱。我们的声誉已经延续了... 好几代人。"

Blanc 的脸上几乎没有活气。他的嘴唇动起来时，就像一具尸体被埋入的电极逼着抽动。

"所以我相信你能理解，为什么我既不能确认、也不能否认任何人的存在。"

o.en: I'm looking for Perseus Andrada, heir to the Supreme Executor.
o.zh: 我在找 Perseus Andrada，最高元首的继承人。

entries.en: Blanc says nothing as he hits the comms cut-off.
entries.zh: Blanc 一言不发，按下了通讯切断。

entries.en: Blanc says nothing as he hits the comms cut-off. He gives you a distinctly unfriendly look.
entries.zh: Blanc 一言不发，按下了通讯切断。他看你的眼神明显不友善。

entries.en: Blanc says nothing as he hits the comms cut-off. The looks he gives you says quite enough.
entries.zh: Blanc 一言不发，按下了通讯切断。他看你的那一眼，已经把话说尽了。

o.en: I have a particular interest in the unique services offered by Doctor Cydonia.
o.zh: 我对 Cydonia 博士提供的那些独特服务特别感兴趣。

o.en: We spoke of Doctor Cydonia. I want what he provides.
o.zh: 我们谈过 Cydonia 博士。我想要他提供的东西。

entries.en:
"Ah." His face tightens almost imperceptibly. "I'm afraid that will be impossible. 'Doctor' Cydonia is no longer a partner of the Mbaye-Gogol Cryosanctum."

His tone warms slightly above the cosmic background medium as he continues.

"I would be more than pleased to introduce you to our current team handling such matters, which includes highly vetted cyberneticists."

He emphasizes the words 'highly vetted'.

"Among them are the very best applied cognitive restoration experts in the Persean Sector. They are all highly decorated alumni of the Galatia Academy, many of whom left tenured positions to join us."
entries.zh:
"啊。\"他的脸几乎看不出来地绷紧了。\"恐怕那不可能。'博士' Cydonia 已经不再是 Mbaye-Gogol 冷冻圣所的合作伙伴了。"

他接着说下去，语气比宇宙背景温度稍稍暖了那么一点。

"我非常乐意为你引荐我们目前负责这类事务的团队，其中包括经过严格审查的神经机械学家。"

他加重了'严格审查'这几个字。

"他们之中有英仙座星域最顶尖的应用认知修复专家。全都是 Galatia 学院荣誉等身的校友，不少人放弃了终身教职来投奔我们。"

o.en: The best cognitive restoration experts, you say?
o.zh: 你说最优秀的认知修复专家？

entries.en:
"Ah." His face tightens perceptibly. "I see. You should have said so directly. 'Doctor' Cydonia is no longer a partner of the Mbaye-Gogol Cryosanctum, of course."

His tone warms slightly above the cosmic background medium as he continues.

"I would, however, be more than pleased to introduce you to our current team handling such matters, which includes highly vetted cyberneticists."

He emphasizes the words 'highly vetted'.

"Among them are the very best applied cognitive restoration experts in the Persean Sector. They are all highly decorated alumni of the Galatia Academy, many of whom left tenured positions to join us."
entries.zh:
"啊。\"他的脸明显绷紧了。\"我明白了。你该直接说。'博士' Cydonia 当然已经不再是 Mbaye-Gogol 冷冻圣所的合作伙伴了。"

他接着说下去，语气比宇宙背景温度稍稍暖了那么一点。

"不过，我非常乐意为你引荐我们目前负责这类事务的团队，其中包括经过严格审查的神经机械学家。"

他加重了'严格审查'这几个字。

"他们之中有英仙座星域最优秀的应用认知修复专家。全都是 Galatia 学院出身、荣誉等身的校友，其中许多人放弃了终身教职来加入我们。"

o.en: The best cognitive restoration experts, you say?
o.zh: 你说最优秀的认知修复专家？

entries.en:
"The mind a precious thing, is it not?"

His eyes are darkly glassy, like empty portals.

"The Directors of Mbaye-Gogol appreciate the desire of exceptional individuals to ensure the continuity of consciousness beyond one's own... time. And, for an appropriate price - an investment, I would call it - we are prepared to share the gifts of this unique suite of technologies."
entries.zh:
"心智是珍贵的东西，不是吗？"

他的眼睛暗而发亮，像两扇空无一物的门。

"Mbaye-Gogol 的董事们理解，卓越之人渴望意识能延续到自己... 时限之外。而只要价格合适——我更愿意称之为一笔投资——我们愿意分享这一整套独特技术所带来的恩惠。"

o.en: Beyond one's time, yes. I have serious concerns, however.
o.zh: 延续到时限之外，没错。不过我有很严重的顾虑。

entries.en:
Blanc's face adjusts to an appropriately sympathetic expression.

"I fully respect your admission of concern. It is brave and sensible to express doubt in the face of such a magnificent promise."

He places his hands together. "How may I reassure you?"
entries.zh:
Blanc 的脸上调整出一副恰到好处的同情神色。

"你能坦承顾虑，我完全尊重。面对如此宏大的承诺仍能表达怀疑，既勇敢又明智。"

他双手交叠。"我怎样才能让你安心？"

o.en: I hear it can go wrong. The case of Perseus Saturnian, for instance.
o.zh: 我听说这事会出岔子。比如 Perseus Saturnian 那一例。

entries.en:
His expression freezes. You've crossed a threshold.

"You broach an uncomfortable subject, captain."

"I suppose I should not feel altogether ambushed by an implied accusation. You are, after all, expressing a valid concern. And it is one based on a rumor not leaked by this institution; to that I attest with the most supreme confidence."

There is threat in his voice; cool, slow, and patient.
entries.zh:
他的表情僵住了。你已经越过了一道界线。

"你提起了一个令人不快的话题，舰长。"

"我想我不该因为一句隐含的指控就觉得自己是被人打了埋伏。毕竟，你表达的是一个合理的顾虑。而且它依据的传闻并非从本机构泄露出去——这一点我可以凭最高的确信担保。"

他的声音里带着威胁：冷静、缓慢，而且很有耐心。

entries.en:
Blanc sighs, releasing the tension with an uncomfortable whistling sound.

"The involvement of 'Doctor' Wyatt Cydonia was a stipulation on behalf of... a particular client. They insisted, you see, and tripled the usual fee. I must admit it was a rare lapse in judgement within Mbaye-Gogol."

He looks off and away. "More than credits, there were... political considerations."

His head shakes sadly.
entries.zh:
Blanc 叹了口气，用一声令人不适的哨音把紧绷释放掉。

"'博士' Wyatt Cydonia 的参与，是应... 某位客户的要求。你看，他们坚持要这样，还付了三倍的常规费用。我得承认，这是 Mbaye-Gogol 内部一次罕见的判断失误。"

他把目光移开，望向别处。"比起星币，还有... 政治上的考量。"

他悲伤地摇了摇头。

o.en: So the accident was Cydonia's fault, not Mbaye-Gogol?
o.zh: 所以这次事故是 Cydonia 的错，不是 Mbaye-Gogol 的？

entries.en:
"Precisely," he says. "I am relieved by your perception of the situation."

"Our error was allowing him to operate in our facilities, using our equipment and support team. The subject-pair was not viable, the procedure was doomed from the outset."

"Cydonia." He speaks as if the name pains him. Finally some feeling from this ghoulish visage.
entries.zh:
"正是如此，\"他说，\"你能这样看待局势，我很欣慰。"

"我们的错误，是允许他在我们的设施里、用我们的设备和保障团队施行手术。那一对受术体本身不可行，手术从一开始就注定失败。"

"Cydonia。"他说这个名字时像在忍痛。这张食尸鬼般的脸上，总算有了点情绪。

entries.en:
"Cydonia promised the impossible." His eyes flit, scanning a tally of damages in what must pass for a rage. "No one can bring back the dead!"

"The transfer subject, effectively brain-dead... the chance of success was nil, however viable the target clone. Now this error, his egregious misrepresentation, reflects poorly upon the Cryosanctum. I hear he's fled to that barbarous hive of pirates called 'Kanta's Den'."

He shakes his head, stiffly.
entries.zh:
"Cydonia 承诺了不可能的事。"他的眼睛飞快地扫动，像是在清点一份损失清单，那大概就是他所能表现出的愤怒。"没人能让死者复生！"

"移植受体实际上已经脑死亡... 无论目标克隆体多么可行，成功的几率都是零。如今这个错误、他这番恶劣的虚假陈述，让冷冻圣所颜面尽失。我听说他已经逃到那个叫'Kanta's Den'的野蛮海盗窝里去了。"

他僵硬地摇了摇头。

entries.en:
"I understand perfectly," he says, with a clear undertone suggesting he does not, and that he's very annoyed at someone.

Possibly you, among others.
entries.zh:
"我完全明白，"他说，话里清楚地透着另一层意思：他并不明白，而且正对某个人极为恼火。

而在这些人当中，说不定就有你。

entries.en:
"Macario." His look is distant. Light-years distant.

"I understand." His eyes return to you, some patient grievance kindling a distant glow.
entries.zh:
"Macario。"他的目光变得遥远。远以光年计。

"我明白了。"他的目光回到你身上，某种积压已久的怨怼在其中点起一点幽微的光。

entries.en:
"The transcendent... what?" Blanc blinks, then re-focuses.

"Dolos Macario," he says firmly, after a moment. His look is distant. Light-years distant.

"I understand." His eyes return to you, some patient grievance kindling a distant glow.
entries.zh:
"超凡的... 什么？"Blanc 眨了眨眼，重新定下神来。

"Dolos Macario。"片刻之后，他肯定地说。他的目光变得遥远。远以光年计。

"我明白了。"他的目光回到你身上，某种积压已久的怨怼在其中点起一点幽微的光。

entries.en:
"His touch is a stain on our reputation," he says. "I fear it may take generations to erase. You... you must tell me how you found- tell me who is spreading this malicious rumor."

His eyes pin you, suddenly sharp.
entries.zh:
"他经手的东西，是我们声誉上的一块污渍，\"他说，\"我怕要几代人的时间才能擦掉。你... 你必须告诉我是怎么查到的——告诉我是谁在散布这种恶意的谣言。"

他的目光忽然变得锐利，把你钉在原地。

o.en: I must keep my sources confidential. You of all people understand discretion.
o.zh: 我必须为我的消息来源保密。别人不说，你最该懂什么叫谨慎。

o.en: Dolos Macario. His operation had sloppy infosec.
o.zh: Dolos Macario。他的行动在信息安全上太马虎了。

o.en: So. Cydonia failed to upload the brain-dead Philip Andrada into his own clone?
o.zh: 那么，Cydonia 是没能把脑死亡的 Philip Andrada 上传进他自己的克隆体？

o.en: I must keep my sources confidential. You of all people understand discretion.
o.zh: 我必须为我的消息来源保密。别人不说，你最该懂什么叫谨慎。

o.en: Dolos Macario. His operation had sloppy infosec.
o.zh: Dolos Macario。他的行动在信息安全上太马虎了。

o.en: Dolos Macario. His actions betray the transcendent vision of Supreme Executor Philip Andrada.
o.zh: Dolos Macario。他的所作所为，背弃了最高元首 Philip Andrada 那超凡的愿景。

o.en: So. Cydonia failed to upload the brain-dead Supreme Executor into a clone?
o.zh: 那么，Cydonia 是没能把脑死亡的最高元首上传进克隆体？

entries.en:
Blanc's eyes focus on you. An understanding.

"No," he lies dutifully.

"That unfortunate tale is a grotesque imagination. As executive representative of the Mbaye-Gogol corporation, I reiterate that client corpus integrity is among our core values. And we take matters of defamation deadly seriously."

"I expect that with your not insubtantial assets exposed to legal action you will avoid repeating... damaging speculation."

His face twitches itself into an automatic customer-facing approximation of a smile.
entries.zh:
Blanc 的目光聚在你身上。是一种了然。

"不。"他尽职尽责地撒了这个谎。

"那个不幸的故事纯属荒诞的想象。作为 Mbaye-Gogol 公司的执行代表，我再重申一次：客户遗体的完整性是我们的核心价值观之一。而我们对诽谤之事是极其严肃的。"

"考虑到你名下不容小觑的资产有可能面临法律诉讼，我期望你能避免再重复... 那些有害的揣测。"

他的脸抽搐了一下，自动摆出一副面向客户用的、近似微笑的表情。

o.en: I think we understand one another.
o.zh: 我想我们彼此都明白了。

o.en: Thanks, I got what I needed.
o.zh: 多谢，我要的已经拿到了。

o.en: Maybe an 'investment' into securing your reputation is in order...
o.zh: 也许该为保住你的声誉'投资'一笔了...

o.en: I'm forced to be direct. Perseus Andrada died here. Because of Doctor Cydonia.
o.zh: 我只能直说。Perseus Andrada 死在这里。因为 Cydonia 医生。

entries.en: Blanc sighs a long, drawn out sigh.
entries.zh: Blanc 长长地叹了一口气，拖得很慢。

entries.en: Blanc sighs a long, drawn out sigh. Centers himself, his face settling into a shape of deep disapproval, and draws a breath-
entries.zh: Blanc 长长地叹了一口气。他定了定神，脸上凝成一幅深切不以为然的神情，然后吸了一口气——

o.en: I've also had an interesting conversation with your portmaster...
o.zh: 我还跟你的港务长有过一次很有意思的谈话...

entries.en: Blanc sighs a long, drawn out sigh. Centers himself, his face settling into a shape of deep disapproval, and draws a breath-
entries.zh: Blanc 长长地叹了一口气。他定了定神，脸上凝成一幅深切不以为然的神情，然后吸了一口气——

o.en: I've also had an interesting conversation with your quartermaster...
o.zh: 我还跟你的军需官有过一次很有意思的谈话...

entries.en:
"What a grotesque imagination you have," he says blandly.

"As executive representative of the Mbaye-Gogol corporation, I cannot comment on our relationship with a particular client, real or hypothetical. However," his voice grows deeper. "We hold client corpus integrity among our core values. Mbaye-Gogol takes defamation very, very seriously due to the sacred relationship we hold with all of our clients."
entries.zh:
"你的想象力真是荒诞得可以，"他语气平淡地说。

"作为 Mbaye-Gogol 公司的执行代表，我无法就我们与某位客户之间的关系置评，无论这位客户是真实存在还是假设的。不过，\"他的声音沉了下去，\"客户遗体的完整性是我们的核心价值观之一。Mbaye-Gogol 与我们所有客户之间维系着神圣的关系，因此我们对诽谤一事极其、极其严肃。"

entries.en:
"I expect that with your not insubstantial assets exposed to legal action, you will avoid repeating this... speculation."

His face twitches itself into an automatic customer-facing approximation of a smile.

"That will be all for today, I think, Captain $PlayerName," he says, then cuts the link with a block-and-terminate command.
entries.zh:
"考虑到你名下相当可观的资产有可能面临法律诉讼，我期望你能避免再重复这种... 揣测。"

他的脸抽搐了一下，自动摆出一副面向客户用的、近似微笑的表情。

"今天就到这里吧，$PlayerName 舰长。"他说完，用一条阻断并终止的指令切断了链接。

entries.en:
You watch the ghostly afterimagine of Gallu Blanc fade into blackness.

If the man has nerves, you may have just struck one. He's scared, but not scared enough to crack.

Perhaps he'll speak with you again in a day or so. After he's cooled off.
entries.zh:
你看着 Gallu Blanc 那幽灵般的余像沉入黑暗。

这人要是有痛处，你刚才大概正好戳在上面。他确实怕了，但还没怕到垮掉。

也许过一两天他会再找你谈。等他冷静下来。

entries.en: "Oh?" He barely raises an eyebrow.
entries.zh: "哦？"他连眉毛都几乎没动一下。

o.en: I've confirmed that Doctor Cydonia attempted an operation on Perseus Saturnian.
o.zh: 我已确认，Cydonia 博士曾试图对 Perseus Saturnian 施行手术。

entries.en: He blinks, once.
entries.zh: 他眨了一下眼。

o.en: And it failed. Perseus was sent to 'bioprocessing'. His parts were sold off.
o.zh: 而且失败了。Perseus 被送去'生物处理'。他的器官被拆开卖掉了。

entries.en:
"Enough!"

It's not quite a shout, but Blanc's anger has almost drawn color to his cheeks. Almost.

You've crossed a threshold.

"I see, captain, that your persistence is not easily diverted. So let us 'clear the air', as they say, and lay rest to your alleged concerns."

There is threat in his voice; cool, slow, and patient.
entries.zh:
"够了！"

这还算不上喊叫，但 Blanc 的怒气几乎让血色涌上了脸颊。几乎。

你已经越过了一道界线。

"我看出来了，舰长，你的执着不容易被引开。那我们就照他们的说法'把话说开'，也好让你那些所谓的疑虑有个了结。"

他的声音里带着威胁：冷静、缓慢，而且很有耐心。

entries.en:
Blanc holds his gaze on you, then exhales; an uncomfortable whistling sound.

"The involvement of 'Doctor' Wyatt Cydonia was a stipulation on behalf of... a particular client. They insisted that he perform the procedure. And tripled the usual fee. I must admit that accepting these terms was a rare lapse in judgement within Mbaye-Gogol."

He looks off and away. "More than credits, there were... political considerations."
entries.zh:
Blanc 的目光在你身上停了一会儿，然后呼出一口气，发出一种令人不适的哨音。

"'博士' Wyatt Cydonia 的参与，是应... 某位客户的要求。他们坚持要由他来做这台手术。而且付了三倍的常规费用。我得承认，接受这些条件，是 Mbaye-Gogol 内部一次罕见的判断失误。"

他把目光移开，望向别处。"比起星币，还有... 政治上的考量。"

o.en: So the 'accident' was due to Cydonia alone, not Mbaye-Gogol policy?
o.zh: 那么这起'事故'只该归咎于 Cydonia，而不是 Mbaye-Gogol 的方针？

entries.en:
"Precisely," he says. "I am relieved by your understanding of the situation."

"Our only error was allowing him to operate in our facilities, using our equipment and support team. ...The subject-pair was not viable, the procedure was doomed from the outset."

"Cydonia." He speaks as if the name pains him, contorting his ghoulish visage.
entries.zh:
"正是如此，\"他说，\"你能这样理解局势，我很欣慰。"

"我们唯一的错误，是允许他在我们的设施里、用我们的设备和保障团队施行手术。...这一对受术体本身就不具备可行性，手术从一开始就注定失败。"

"Cydonia。"他说出这个名字时像在忍痛，那张食尸鬼般的脸扭曲起来。

o.en: I had an interesting conversation with your portmaster.
o.zh: 我跟你的港务长有过一次很有意思的谈话。

entries.en: "Our portmaster upholds Mbaye-Gogol safety standards to my satisfaction," he says with forced nonchalance. "I have no need to be involved in such matters."
entries.zh: "我们的港务长执行 Mbaye-Gogol 安全标准，我很满意，\"他强作淡然地说，\"这种事不必我插手。"

o.en: It was confirmed that Doctor Cydonia worked as a contractor for Mbaye-Gogol.
o.zh: 已确认 Cydonia 博士曾以承包人身份为 Mbaye-Gogol 工作。

entries.en:
"Oh?" His voice is calm.

"We employ many contractors, captain, and their work is - as you surely know - a private matter between Mbaye-Gogol and our guests."
entries.zh:
"哦？"他的声音很平静。

"我们雇了很多承包人，舰长。而你当然清楚，他们的工作属于 Mbaye-Gogol 与客人之间的私事。"

o.en: It corroborates a disturbing report in my possession concerning Perseus Saturnian.
o.zh: 这印证了我手上一份关于 Perseus Saturnian 的报告——内容令人不安。

o.en: I had an interesting conversation with your quartermaster.
o.zh: 我跟你的军需官有过一次很有意思的谈话。

entries.en: A pause, very short.
entries.zh: 一段停顿，极短。

o.en: You're simulating Philip Andrada's life for a cloned body?
o.zh: \"你们在给一具克隆体模拟 Philip Andrada 的人生？\

o.en: How could it possibly be flawed?

entries.en: The voices go quiet for a moment. Then, simultaneously:
entries.zh: 那些声音安静了片刻。随后，同时开口：

o.en: Is there anyone else alive on this asteroid?
o.zh: 这颗小行星上还有别的活人吗？

o.en: If you are the caretakers, where is Leonidas?
o.zh: \"既然你们是看护者，那 Leonidas 在哪？\

o.en: Let me guess - he's braindead, on life support?
o.zh: \"让我猜猜——他脑死亡了，靠生命维持系统吊着？\
你们是 AI 核心，对吧。

o.en: Crasis, were you programmed to be annoying?
Crasis, were you programmed to be... like this?
So what's this about a 'mutually beneficial arrangement'?
o.zh: 那么，所谓【互利安排】是怎么回事？

o.en: I want to see Leonidas. Open the door.

entries.en:
A soft chime. A different tone, this time, and directional.

Indicator sigils around one of the doors off the lobby begin to glow, a 'wait' signal.
entries.zh:
一声轻柔的鸣响。这次音色不同，而且有方向。

大厅一侧某扇门周围的指示符开始泛出微光——是个'稍候'的信号。

o.en: I acknowledge you were coerced. Let us proceed.
o.zh: \"我认可你是被胁迫的。我们继续吧。\

o.en: I'll be the judge of that. Show me.
I'm working for myself to discover the meaning of Macario's files.
o.zh: \"我在为自己做事——我要弄清 Macario 那些文件的意思。\

o.en: I wasn't sent by Tri-Tachyon, or Cyberzenith, if that's what you're asking.
o.zh: \"派我来的既不是速子科技，也不是 Cyberzenith——如果你问的是这个。\

o.en: I serve the Sindrian Diktat. I seek Andrada's heir.
o.zh: \"我为辛达强权效力。我在找 Andrada 的继承人。\

o.en: I acquired intelligence. That's all you need to know.
o.zh: \"我弄到了一份情报。你知道这些就够了。\

o.en: I acquired a set of intelligence files meant for Dolos Macario.
o.zh: \"我弄到了一批情报文件，本来是给 Dolos Macario 的。\

o.en: I won't be interrogated by a pair of glorified TriPads.
o.zh: \"轮不到两台自我感觉良好的 TriPad 来审问我。\

o.en: It means I work for the good of all humans.
o.zh: \"意思是，我为全体人类的福祉做事。\

o.en: It means I work for the good of all beings, human or AI.
o.zh: \"意思是，我为一切存在的福祉做事——不论是人类，还是 AI。\

o.en: I won't be interrogated by a pair of glorified TriPads.
o.zh: \"轮不到两台自我感觉良好的 TriPad 来审问我。\

o.en: Finlay Siyavong told me you could and would kill the Andrada heirs.
o.zh: Finlay Siyavong 告诉我，你既能、也愿意杀掉 Andrada 家的几个继承人。

entries.en: He takes a slow breath, eyes fixed on your through the link.
entries.zh: 他缓缓吸了口气，隔着通讯链路一眼不眨地盯着你。

o.en: I'm only looking for the truth.
I apologize. It was an innappropriate inquiry.
o.zh: 我道歉。这问题问得不合时宜。

o.en: So did you order the assassination of Andrada's clones?
o.zh: 这么说，是你下令刺杀 Andrada 的克隆体了？

o.en: I'm giving you a chance to deny the allegations.
o.zh: 我给你一个否认这些指控的机会。

entries.en:
You recognize Rao's expression - the stoic face of a commanding officer who is disappointed - but more than that, angry - with a subordinate who has risked the mission through not only ignorance but poor fundamental judgment and character.

"$TitleHeg. You mingled with a Persean League spy. And then come to me to pour his lies on my desk?"
entries.zh:
你认得 Rao 这副神情 —— 一名主官绷着的、不动声色的脸，失望是有的，可更深处是怒：恼的是手下办事不单因为无知，更因判断与品性都欠火候，险些把整桩任务搭进去。

"$TitleHeg。你跟一个英仙座联盟的探子搅在一处，回头还跑到我这儿，把他那套谎话倒在我桌上？"

entries.en:
You recognize Rao's expression - the stoic, blank face of a commanding officer who is truly angry with a subordinate who has risked the mission through more than ignorance but poor fundamental judgment and character.

"$TitlePL." His voice is controlled. "I extent great leeway by even accepting your comms request. Then you pour the lies of a League spy on my desk."
entries.zh:
你认得 Rao 这副神情——指挥官板起的一张不动声色的空面孔：下属把任务置于险地，靠的不只是无知，更是根本上的判断与品性出了岔子，他这才真动了怒。

"$TitlePL。\" 他把声音压得很稳。\"光是肯接下你的通讯请求，我已经是格外通融了。转头你却把一个联盟间谍的谎话倒到我桌上。"

entries.en:
You recognize Rao's expression - the stoic face of a commanding officer who is disappointed - but more than that, angry - with a civilian who has risked the mission through not only ignorance but poor fundamental judgment and character.

"Captain. You've mingled with a Persean League spy. Then come to me and you pour his lies onto my desk."
entries.zh:
你认得 Rao 这副神情——指挥官板着脸，失望，可更甚的是恼火：一个平民把任务置于险地，靠的不只是无知，更是根本上的判断与品性出了岔子。

"舰长。你跟一个英仙座联盟的间谍搅在了一起。转头还跑来我这儿，把他的谎话倒到我桌上。"

o.en: I have unique intel concerning the Sindrian Mutiny.
o.zh: 我有一份关于辛达叛乱的独家情报。

o.en: I have unique intel concerning the Sindrian Mutiny. (send files)
o.zh: 我有一份关于辛达叛乱的独家情报。 (发送文件)

entries.en: Cydonia makes a strange expression, then turns away to cough wetly before looking back at you.
entries.zh: Cydonia 露出一个古怪的表情，转过头去湿漉漉地咳了几声，才又看向你。

entries.en:
His eyes shift around like restless vermin. "I am fully... under Jorien Kanta's protection. It would not be easy to mur- to kill me."

Something starts beeping near him, and a skinny arm swats at a control interface, silencing the interruption.

"Is that why you're here?"
entries.zh:
他的眼珠像不安的鼠类一样四处乱转。"我完全... 在 Jorien Kanta 的庇护之下。想杀——想杀我，可没那么容易。"

他身边有什么东西开始哔哔作响，一条瘦削的手臂拍向控制界面，把那声音掐掉。

"你就是为了这个来的？"

o.en: I'm here to find out what you did to Perseus.
o.zh: 我来这里，是想弄清楚你对 Perseus 做了什么。

o.en: You deserve death, but I'm not here for that. Not yet.
o.zh: 你该死，但我不是为这个来的。至少现在还不是。

o.en: Macario sent me to kill you. I'm still making up my mind. (lie)
o.zh: Macario 派我来杀你。我还没拿定主意。 (说谎)

entries.en:
"I don't plan to die, captain," Cydonia says, quite confident. "You may discard with that notion and attempt to apply your mind to higher purposes."

He contemplates this for a moment, then turns a waxen face toward you, unable to restrain himself.

"It'd have worked," he says softly. "Perseus. The project. Everything. And it will. I shall father a new age of life eternal; the flesh of the mind forever renewed!"
entries.zh:
"我没打算死，舰长，\"Cydonia 说，语气相当笃定，\"你大可以把这个念头扔掉，把心思用在更高的目的上。"

他为此沉思了片刻，随后按捺不住，把一张惨白的脸转向你。

"它本来是能成的，\"他轻声说，\"Perseus。那项计划。一切。而且它会成的。我将开创一个永生的新纪元；心智的肉身，永远焕然一新！"

entries.en: "I- I wouldn't know anything about that... captain, is it?"
entries.zh: "我——我对那事一无所知... 舰长，是吧？"

entries.en: "I- I wouldn't know anything about that, captain."
entries.zh: "我——我对那事一无所知，舰长。"

entries.en: His wan smile reveals very small, evenly-spaced teeth. Possibly meant to be disarming, it yields a distinct lack of warmth.
entries.zh: 他勉强扯出的笑露出细小而排列整齐的牙齿。这本该是让人卸下防备的笑，却只透出一股明显的冷意。

o.en: Dispense with the denial, 'doctor'. I have Macario's files on Perseus.
o.zh: 别装了，'博士'。我手上有 Macario 关于 Perseus 的档案。

o.en: I know what Macario knows, doctor. I'm trying to help you.
o.zh: Macario 知道什么，我就知道什么，博士。我是在帮你。

entries.en:
He waves you away. "I must return to my, my work..."

The comms cut, leaving you with a blank link.

Perhaps you need something more to get Cydonia's attention.
entries.zh:
他挥手把你赶开。"我得回去做我的、我的工作了..."

通讯切断，只留下一条空白的链路。

也许你得拿出点更实在的东西，才能让 Cydonia 正眼看你。

entries.en:
"I must return to my, my work..."

He waves you away, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
"我得回去做我的、我的工作了..."

他挥手把你赶开，然后伸手去够通讯开关。

o.en: I learned about Perseus Saturnian on Nomios. They all said it was your fault.
o.zh: 我是在 Nomios 听说 Perseus Saturnian 的事的。他们都说那是你的错。

entries.en:
Mercifully, the smile disappears.

"Lies," he hisses. "Manufactured by small men who covet my genius."
entries.zh:
谢天谢地，那笑容消失了。

"谎话，\"他嘶声道。\"是那些觊觎我才华的小人造出来的。"

entries.en:
Mercifully, the smile disappears.

"Help me," he hisses. "Why would I need help from vermin?"
entries.zh:
谢天谢地，那笑容消失了。

"帮我？\"他嘶声道。\"我凭什么需要虫豸来帮？"

entries.en:
"'Not yet'," he mocks your words in a thin whine.

"I managed to relieve myself of any concern for the so-called 'judgment' of lesser minds for more cycles than you've lived. I have no fear of your threats."

"Your masters - whoever sent you - was it Gallu Blanc and those pickled brains at the Cryosanctum? Perhaps Macario and Caden, the clever fool and his fat puppet? What a pair."
entries.zh:
"'还不是时候'，"他用尖细的鼻音学你的腔调。

"我早已不再理会所谓'低等心智'的'评判'——这样的星历年头，比你活过的还长。你的威胁吓不到我。"

"你的主子——不管派你来的是谁——是 Gallu Blanc，和冷冻圣所里那帮罐子里的脑子？也许是 Macario 和 Caden，那个自作聪明的蠢货和他那个肥胖的傀儡？真是一对活宝。"

entries.en: The comms snap off quite abruptly.
entries.zh: 通讯啪地一声断了，十分突兀。

entries.en: You got Cydonia's side of the story. He is not, perhaps, entirely trustworthy. But his self-serving grievances may contain a shadow of truth.
entries.zh: 你听到了 Cydonia 那一面的说法。他这个人也许并不完全可信。但他那些自私的怨言里，或许藏着一丝真相的影子。

entries.en:
After a short wait, the comms-link is approved. An image shudders into being.

Doctor Cydonia barely looks up. He's rummaging around in some tray, his hands are spattered with... something. It's hard to tell in the cold cast of light.

"Are you that delivery, my specimens? How many times have I t-told you to go directly to the portboss!"
entries.zh:
等了没多久，通讯链路获得批准，一帧影像抖动着成形。

Cydonia 博士几乎没抬头。他正在一个托盘里翻找，手上溅着... 什么东西。在那冷调的光线下很难看清。

"你就是那个送货的？我的标本呢？我跟你们说过多少遍了，直接去找港务长！"

entries.en:
After a short wait, the comms-link is approved. An image shudders into being.

Doctor Cydonia looks at you, running his tongue over his lips. He wipes his hands with a cloth, which he tucks somewhere off the comms visual.

"What? Is this about my specimens?" His voice is almost a hiss. "I told you... you people never to speak to me directly."
entries.zh:
等了没多久，通讯链路获得批准，一帧影像抖动着成形。

Cydonia 博士看着你，舌头舔过嘴唇。他用一块布擦了擦手，然后把布塞进通讯画面之外的某处。

"什么事？是我的标本的事吗？\"他的声音近乎嘶嘶作响。\"我跟你们说过... 你们这些人，永远别直接找我说话。"

entries.en: "Well?" His face droops into a frown. "You're interrupting an important... experiment."
entries.zh: "说吧？\"他的脸垮下来，皱起眉头。\"你打断了我的一个重要的... 实验。"

entries.en:
"Wait- that cranial anatomy... yes, I remember you."

There's a bit of spittle hanging off the side of his mouth. You can't stop watching it.
entries.zh:
"等等——那个颅骨结构... 对，我认得你。"

他嘴角挂着一小点唾沫。你的目光没法从那里挪开。

entries.en:
After a short wait, the comms-link is approved. An image shudders into being.

Doctor Cydonia barely looks up. He's rummaging around in some tray, his hands are spattered with... something. It's hard to tell in the cold cast of light.

"Are you that delivery, my specimens? How many times have I t-told you to go directly to the portboss!"
entries.zh:
等了没多久，通讯链路获得批准，一帧影像抖动着成形。

Cydonia 博士几乎没抬头。他正在一个托盘里翻找，手上溅着... 什么东西。在那冷调的光线下很难看清。

"你就是那个送货的？我的标本呢？我跟你们说过多少遍了，直接去找港务长！"

entries.en:
Cydonia almost throbs, his hands clenched tightly.

"I gave so much, so much to Blanc and the half-frozen brains who give him his orders. Never should have trusted them - between those stifling 'procedures', endless 'checklists', and that farce of an 'ethics board'," his voice is a mocking whine.

"He ensured my failure! They saw what I was about to achieve - a breakthrough which would make their primitive icebox, their precious cryosanctum, obsolete. They never had the clarity of vision to reproduce my, my methods."

He takes a moment, wheezing, to catch his breath.
entries.zh:
Cydonia 浑身震动，双手死死握紧。

"我付出了那么多，那么多——给了 Blanc，和那些对他发号施令的半冻僵脑子。我当初就不该信他们——那些令人窒息的'程序'、没完没了的'清单'，还有那个闹剧似的'伦理委员会'，"他的声音是嘲弄的尖鸣。

"是他确保了我的失败！他们看见了我即将达成的东西——一项足以让他们那台原始的冰柜、他们宝贝的冷冻圣所变得一钱不值的突破。他们从来没有那份眼力，去复现我的、我的方法。"

他喘着粗气，停了一会儿才缓过来。

entries.en:
His voice creaks out, more quietly than before.

"The transfer of consciousness to a cloned body... it would be akin to immortality, would it not? Though I knew it wouldn't work on Nomios. With Perseus."

"That doesn't mean the experiment was a waste," he says, defensive. "I played along. It was a ruse, in part. Ha! There was... data to collect. Elements of the procedure to refine. All part of the great work. Much delayed, yes, but it proceeds..."

His hands wander around his console until one finds a datapad, which he strokes softly.
entries.zh:
他的声音从嗓子里挤出来，比先前轻了些。

"把意识转移进克隆的身体... 那几乎等同于永生，不是吗？虽然我早知道在 Nomios 成不了。用在 Perseus 身上成不了。"

"但这不代表那次实验是白费，\"他辩解道，\"我配合了他们。一部分是假意周旋。哈！总有... 数据要收集。程序里有些环节要改良。全都是伟业的一部分。是拖后了很多，没错，但它在推进..."

他的手在控制台上摸索，直到摸到一块数据板，便轻轻抚了起来。

entries.en: "You?" He snorts. "I think not."
entries.zh: "你？\"他哼了一声，\"我看不必。"

entries.en:
He cackles wetly, shooting spittle, doing nothing to repudiate your statement.

"Yesss, my genius is as madness to a lesser being. Witnessing your pathetic intellect attempt to understand is amusing... but. But not for so long." His face droops.

"It is lonely to possess a mind at this lofty apex... "
entries.zh:
他湿漉漉地怪笑起来，唾沫四溅，丝毫没有反驳你的话。

"对——了，对低等存在来说，我的天才就形同疯癫。看着你那点可怜的心智试图理解，倒是有趣... 不过。不过也持续不了多久了。"他的脸垮了下来。

"拥有一颗处在如此高处的心智... 是孤独的..."

entries.en:
"I don't owe you an explanation, worm," he says with a sneer. "But I'm cursed with a... generosity... a need to seed wisdom even upon barren ground."

He waves weakly, dismissing his own quibbling.

"Kanta," he almost whispers, "Is a glorious mind. She possesses a, a, a foreshadowing of the clarity of the new race - the Human Eternal. She is the spark that shall portend the flame, the fire; no, the nova!"

Cydonia nearly screeches this last word.
entries.zh:
"我没必要向你解释，虫子，\"他冷笑着说，\"可我偏偏被一种... 慷慨... 缠上了，非要把智慧的种子撒在贫瘠的土地上。"

他虚弱地摆了摆手，把自己那点计较挥散掉。

"Kanta，\"他几乎是耳语，\"她有一颗光辉的心智。她身上有、有、有着新种族——永生之人——那份澄明的先声。她是那点火星，预示着火苗、烈火；不，是那颗轰然爆开的恒星！"

最后那个词，Cydonia 几乎是尖啸出来的。

entries.en: It takes him a moment to recover, head hanging, breathing.
entries.zh: 他低着头喘气，过了一会儿才缓过来。

entries.en:
"Macario," Cydonia's eyes narrow. "Paranoid, back-stabbing Sindrians... blaming, scheming, accusing. Delay after delay!"

"He's a small mind. Clever, in a way, but small. Philip Andrada was always the greater man; he had a vision, a vision to transform mankind! I can't speak for his methods, but it was a vision nonetheless. Macario hated that. He hated it because he couldn't understand, you see? His mind could not perceive the essence of divinity which is just... within reach."

Cydonia's hand raises, not quite reaching. He doesn't seem conscious of its movement.
entries.zh:
"Macario，\"Cydonia 眯起眼睛，\"多疑、背后捅刀的辛达人... 推责、算计、指控。一次次的拖延！"

"他器量狭小。某种意义上的聪明，但终究狭小。Philip Andrada 才是更伟大的人；他有远见，那是一种改造人类的远见！他的手段我不做评判，但那毕竟是远见。Macario 恨的就是这一点。他恨它，因为他理解不了，你明白吗？他的心智看不见那份神性的本质——而它就在... 触手可及之处。"

Cydonia 抬起手，却没有真正伸出去。他似乎没意识到自己在动。

entries.en:
"Macario can only imagine terrorizing his tiny fiefdom, his squalid little star system. That's why he poisoned the Perseus operation."

His hand seems to mimic manipulating a small object. A motion like pinching, and a twist.

Cydonia looks away with a contemplative sneer.

"...Philip, too, I expect," he mutters.
entries.zh:
"Macario 只想象得出怎么恐吓他那块小小的封地、他那个肮脏的小星系。所以他才会毒害 Perseus 的行动。"

他的手像是在摆弄一件小东西。一个捏住、再一拧的动作。

Cydonia 把目光移开，脸上挂着沉思般的冷笑。

"...我猜，Philip 也一样，"他喃喃道。

entries.en:
His watery eyes snap back to you.

"You see... no, of course you don't. You're a gun-holder, a planet-razer. Another tedious gangster. I'm surrounded by your breed."

He examines you, intrusive somehow despite the comms.

"I can tell from your cranial aspect. You're a clever beast, much akin to Macario. I see it, now. Maybe not even that. Perhaps you're Caden? A chained hound."
entries.zh:
他那双水汪汪的眼睛猛地转回你身上。

"你明白... 不，你当然不明白。你不过是个拿枪的、烧星球的。又一个乏味的匪徒。我身边全是你这类货色。"

他打量着你，隔着通讯，那目光却莫名地有种侵门踏户的意味。

"从你的颅骨轮廓就看得出来。你是头聪明的畜生，跟 Macario 很像。我现在看出来了。也许还没那么聪明。说不定你是 Caden？一条拴着链子的猎犬。"

entries.en:
Cydonia almost throbs, his hands clenched tightly.

"I gave so much. To Mbaye-Gogol, to that cabal of half-frozen brains that gives Gallu Blanc his orders. The cryosanctum. Pah! With their stifling 'procedures' and endless 'checklists' and that farce of an 'ethics board'," his voice is a mocking whine.

"They ensured my failure. Their aim from the start was to ruin my reputation amongst the so-called 'official' cybernetics research community. They saw what I was about to achieve - and they wanted to destroy it. They never had the clarity of vision to reproduce my methods."

He takes a moment, wheezing, to catch his breath.
entries.zh:
Cydonia 浑身震动，双手死死握紧。

"我付出了那么多。给了 Mbaye-Gogol，给了那个对 Gallu Blanc 发号施令的半冻僵脑子的小集团。冷冻圣所。呸！他们那套令人窒息的'程序'、没完没了的'清单'，还有那个闹剧似的'伦理委员会'，"他的声音是嘲弄的尖鸣。

"他们确保了我的失败。他们从一开始就想毁掉我在所谓'正统'神经机械学研究界的名声。他们看见了我即将达成的东西——就想把它毁掉。他们从来没有那份眼力，去复现我的方法。"

他喘着粗气，停了一会儿才缓过来。

o.en: Gallu Blanc said you tried to transfer the consciousness of Philip Andrada into Perseus.
o.zh: Gallu Blanc 说，你曾试图把 Philip Andrada 的意识转移进 Perseus。

o.en: Yours is truly a great work. Can I help in any way?
o.zh: 你做的确实是一项伟业。我能帮上什么忙吗？

o.en: What was your goal with Perseus? Some form of immortality?
o.zh: 你对 Perseus 打的什么算盘？某种形式的永生？

o.en: You're insane. You know that, right?
If your... great work is eternal life, why are you hiding here with Kanta?
o.zh: 如果你的... 伟业就是永生，那你为什么躲在 Kanta 这里？

o.en: Why would Macario want to sabotage your work?
o.zh: Macario 为什么要破坏你的工作？

o.en: I heard Mbaye-Gogol blames you for... the incident. They set you up?
o.zh: 我听说 Mbaye-Gogol 把... 那次事故的责任推到你头上。是他们设的局？

entries.en: "I tire of this," he says, looking away.
entries.zh: "我厌倦了，"他说着，把目光移开。

entries.en:
He wipes his hands with the cloth he tucked away at the beginning of your conversation. Attention drifting.

"I must return to my... experiment."
entries.zh:
他取出你们谈话开始时收起来的那块布，擦了擦手。注意力正在飘远。

"我得回到我的... 实验上去了。"

entries.en: "You try my patience," he says with a sigh. "It is futile indulgence to gift wisdom to a beast like you."
entries.zh: "你在消磨我的耐心，\"他叹了口气，\"把智慧赐给像你这样的畜生，是徒劳的纵容。"

entries.en: "You try my patience," he says with a sigh. "It is futile indulgence to gift wisdom to a beast like you."
entries.zh: "你在消磨我的耐心，\"他叹了口气，\"把智慧赐给像你这样的畜生，是徒劳的纵容。"

entries.en:
"Yes!" Then he says more softly, "And no."

"The transfer of consciousness to a cloned body... it would be akin to immortality, wouldn't it? Though I knew it wouldn't work. On Nomios. Back in the Cryosantum."
entries.zh:
"对！\"随即他放轻了声音，\"也不对。"

"把意识转移进克隆的身体... 那几乎等同于永生，不是吗？虽然我早知道它成不了。在 Nomios。当年在冷冻圣所。"

entries.en:
He glares at you, eyes red. Lip trembling.

"Philistine, luddite, heretic. You hate genius," he's looking at you, very closely. "It's your jealousy- I see it in your brow. You can't help yourself, your urges compel you to destroy beauty."
entries.zh:
他瞪着你，眼睛发红，嘴唇发抖。

"庸人、卢德分子、异端。你恨天才，\"他凑得很近地看着你。\"是你的嫉妒——我在你的眉宇间看出来了。你控制不住自己，你的冲动逼着你去毁掉美。"

o.en: I'm not here about any of that. I'm here about Perseus Saturnian.
o.zh: 我不是为这些来的。我是为 Perseus Saturnian 来的。

o.en: Sure thing, doc. But I'm here about your failure called 'Perseus Saturnian'.
o.zh: 当然，博士。可我来是为那个叫'Perseus Saturnian'的失败品。

entries.en: "You lie."
entries.zh: "你撒谎。"

entries.en: "You lie."
entries.zh: "你撒谎。"

entries.en:
"Hah!" A thick blob of spittle shoots from Cydonia's mouth.

"It wasn't enough to kill my great project? To sabotage a work that would bring human civilization into a new golden age?"

His wet eyes scan you. "Not that you can even be- conceive of such things."
entries.zh:
"哈！"一团浓稠的唾沫从 Cydonia 嘴里喷出来。

"毁掉我的伟业还不够？破坏一件本该把人类文明带进新黄金时代的工作，还不够？"

他湿润的双眼扫过你。"反正这种事，你连想——想象都想象不来。"

o.zh: 我知道 Perseus Saturnian 的事。

o.en: I'm not leaving until you tell what happened to Perseus.
o.zh: 你不说出 Perseus 出了什么事，我就不走。

o.en: I asked about Perseus on Nomios. They all said it was your fault.
o.zh: 我在 Nomios 打听过 Perseus。他们都说那是你的错。

o.en: I learned about Perseus Saturnian on Nomios. They all said it was your fault.
o.zh: 我是在 Nomios 听说 Perseus Saturnian 的事的。他们都说那是你的错。

entries.en:
"This ag-"

He is interrupted by a fit of coughing. It looks painful and his voice is hoarse when he next speaks.

"No time... for this."

His hand, claw-like, hits the comms shut-off faster than you'd think was possible. The link goes blank.
OR
"Y-you with this again." He waves feebly at your image, as if you were a piece of zero-g litter.

"Go away!"

Finally he manages to swat the comms shut-off, and the link goes black.
OR
"What- what bothersome insect are you?" He coughs wetly. "I'm extremely busy with... things you cannot understand."

He smacks the comms shut-off and the link goes black.
entries.zh:
"又是这——"

一阵咳嗽打断了他。那样子看着就疼，他再开口时嗓音已经沙哑。

"没时间... 跟你耗。"

他那只爪子般的手敲向通讯开关，快得超出你的想象。链路断开，一片空白。
OR
"你——你又来这套。"他虚弱地朝你的影像挥了挥手，仿佛你是一块零重力下的垃圾。

"滚开！"

他终于一巴掌拍中通讯开关，链路黑了。
OR
"你——你是个什么讨人嫌的虫子？\"他湿漉漉地咳了一声。\"我忙得很，忙着... 你根本理解不了的事。"

他啪地拍下通讯开关，链路黑了。

entries.en:
"You're that upstart mercenary captain," his lip curls with disgust.

"I don't like what you bring out in Jorien. You make her difficult. She's in careful balance, very careful."
entries.zh:
"你就是那个暴发户雇佣兵舰长，"他厌恶地撇起嘴角。

"我不喜欢你勾出来的 Jorien 那一面。你让她变得难缠。她处在一个精心的平衡里，非常精心。"

o.en: Let's agree to disagree. I'm here to ask you about something else...
o.zh: 那咱们就各执一词吧。我来是想问你另一件事...

o.en: Kanta? Balanced? She's an insane murderous cyborg!
o.zh: Kanta？平衡？她是个杀人不眨眼的疯子赛博格！

o.en: Er... yes. Exquisite work. Masterful, even. (lie)
o.zh: 呃... 是的。精妙的作品。甚至可说是大师手笔。 (说谎)
是的。精妙的作品。甚至可说是大师手笔。

entries.en:
"You threw my Loke out an airlock! My beautiful creation, the first..." He pauses, then speaks. "The first that lived."

"It was so scared after. I had to d- to sedate it. My poor flower." His eyes are large, and wet. "It could have died," he says, holding back tears.
entries.zh:
"你把我的 Loke 扔出了气闸！我美丽的造物，第一个...\"他顿了顿，才接着说，\"第一个活下来的。"

"那之后它怕成那样。我只好给——给它打了镇静剂。我可怜的花儿。"他的眼睛很大，湿漉漉的。"它本来会死的，"他说着，忍住了眼泪。

o.en: It was my life or... his. Kanta activated her minefield.
o.zh: 不是我的命，就是... 他的。Kanta 启动了雷场。
那个 Loke 玩意儿，根本就不该存在。

o.en: I'm sorry about Loke. He was innocent.
o.zh: Loke 的事，我很抱歉。他是无辜的。
Loke 的事，我很抱歉。 (说谎)

entries.en:
"You killed my Loke, my beautiful clone; my first viable creation," he whines.

"Why did you take it from me, the first that lived? Why, why." His eyes are large, and wet.

Are those tears?
entries.zh:
"你杀了我的 Loke，我美丽的克隆体，我第一个成活的造物，"他哀声道。

"你为什么要把它从我身边夺走，那是第一个活下来的？为什么，为什么。"他的眼睛很大，湿漉漉的。

那是眼泪吗？

o.en: It was my life or... his. Kanta activated her minefield.
o.zh: 不是我的命，就是... 他的。Kanta 启动了雷场。
那个 Loke 玩意儿，根本就不该存在。

o.en: I'm sorry about Loke. He was innocent.
o.zh: Loke 的事，我很抱歉。他是无辜的。
Loke 的事，我很抱歉。 (说谎)

entries.en: Cydonia frowns, and makes a distracted muttering sound. Perhaps something about 'specimens'.
entries.zh: Cydonia 皱起眉，心不在焉地嘟囔了一声。也许是在说'标本'。

entries.en:
"Insane?" Cydonia perks up, combative. "Hardly, hardly at all."

"What you cannot admit is that she is more sane than you - or even I. Her mind has had centuries to develop a, a transcendent wisdom. Beyond good and evil... I tend her, like a garden of such complexity you cannot begin to comprehend. Such beautiful fruit it will bear..."
entries.zh:
"疯子？\"Cydonia 精神一振，摆出应战的架势。\"算不上，远远算不上。"

"你不肯承认的是，她比你更清醒——甚至比我更清醒。她的心智有了几百年时间去发育出一套、一套超凡的智慧。超越善恶... 我照料她，就像照料一座复杂到你根本无从理解的花园。它结出的果实会多么美丽..."

o.en: But it didn't work out so well with Perseus, did it.
o.zh: 可换成 Perseus，就没那么顺利了，对吧。

entries.en:
"Is it not?" Cydonia perks up, attentive to praise.

"Her body is one thing; meat and mechanics. The concerns of a dilletante," he makes a dismissive wave.

"It is her mind that fascinates me most... it is more sophisticated than you can imagine. Beyond good and evil. With centuries to develop, and the correct... supplements... I tend her like a garden of such complexity you cannot begin to comprehend. Such beautiful fruit is growing..."
entries.zh:
"不是吗？"Cydonia 精神一振，对赞誉格外上心。

"她的身体是一回事；血肉与机械。那是半吊子才操心的事，"他不屑地摆了摆手。

"最让我着迷的是她的心智... 它比你所能想象的更为精妙。超越善恶。有几百年时间去发育，再加上正确的... 补剂... 我照料她，就像照料一座复杂到你根本无从理解的花园。多么美丽的果实正在长成..."

o.en: But why didn't it work on Perseus Saturnian?
o.zh: 可为什么在 Perseus Saturnian 身上就不管用？

entries.en:
"What I did?" His voice rises.

"What I did would have been the preface to a miraculous breakthrough! Which they ALL conspired to sabotage, the small-minded fools. Whoever sent you - was it Gallu Blanc and that conclave of half-frozen brains at the Cryosanctum? Perhaps Macario and Caden, the self-satisfied fool and his fat puppet?"

Cydonia shudders, face twisted with anger.

"They cannot... be- conceive of the golden age my great work will bring."
entries.zh:
"我做了什么？"他的声音拔高了。

"我所做的事，本该是一场奇迹般突破的序章！可他们【全都】合谋破坏它——那群心胸狭隘的蠢货。派你来的到底是谁？是 Gallu Blanc，和冷冻圣所里那帮泡在罐里的脑子？也许是 Macario 和 Caden，那个自鸣得意的蠢货和他那个肥胖的傀儡？"

Cydonia 一阵战栗，脸因愤怒而扭曲。

"他们根本... 想——想象不出我的伟业将带来怎样的黄金时代。"

entries.en:
"My fault? MY fault?" His voice rises.

"What I did would have been the preface to a miraculous breakthrough! Which they ALL conspired to sabotage, the small-minded fools. Whoever sent you - was it Gallu Blanc and that conclave of half-frozen brains at the Cryosanctum? Perhaps Macario and Caden, the self-satisfied fool and his fat puppet?"

Cydonia almost throbs, his hands clenched tightly.

"They cannot... be- conceive of the golden age my great work will bring."
entries.zh:
"我的错？【我】的错？"他的声音拔高了。

"我所做的事，本该是一场奇迹般突破的序章！可他们【全都】合谋破坏它——那群心胸狭隘的蠢货。派你来的到底是谁？是 Gallu Blanc，和冷冻圣所里那帮泡在罐里的脑子？也许是 Macario 和 Caden，那个自鸣得意的蠢货和他那个肥胖的傀儡？"

Cydonia 浑身震动，双手死死握紧。

"他们根本... 想——想象不出我的伟业将带来怎样的黄金时代。"

entries.en:
He looks back to the feed.

"If this is 'critical intel', as you say, I can only hope for an opportunity to shake up the status quo established by Reynard Hannan. Considering the character of the Sindrian Diktat, any presumed intelligence data should prove... troublesome. Therefore it is important that it be presented objectively, and to do so we need it to get into the professional bureaucracy before it becomes 'handled' by a major gens."

"That includes Gens Yaribay," he says with a self-effacing look. "Your trust is appreciated, as a matter of course."
entries.zh:
他重新看向通讯画面。

"如果这真如你所说，是'关键情报'，那我倒希望能借此撼动 Reynard Hannan 立下的那套现状。以辛达强权的行事作风，任何被认定的情报恐怕都会相当...麻烦。所以关键在于让它以客观的面目呈上去；要做到这一点，就得赶在某个大氏族把它'处理'掉之前，送进职业官僚体系里。"

"这其中也包括 Yaribay 氏族，\"他带着几分自嘲说道，\"当然，你的信任我很领情。"

entries.en:
"Take the files to Fleet Intelligence," he says, a tone of aristocratic command entering his voice. "Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

He taps at a TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface.

"Gens Yaribay shall be watching the situation, captain."

He allows the hint of a smile, though there's worry in his eyes.
entries.zh:
"把文件送到舰队情报部去，\"他说，语调里带上了贵族式的命令口吻，\"特工 Finlay Siyavong。"

他在 TriPad 上点了几下，一个通讯识别码出现在你的界面上。

"Yaribay 氏族会盯着这件事的，舰长。"

他容许自己露出一丝笑意，眼里却藏着忧虑。

entries.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat," Horus says, repeating your words. He thinks for a moment.

"The League has maintained a distasteful partnership with the Diktat against the Hegemony for many cycles. I do wonder, however..."
entries.zh:
"辛达强权，"Horus 重复着你的话，沉吟片刻。

"许多个周期以来，联盟一直与强权维持着一种令人不快的合作，共同对付霸主。不过我在想..."

entries.en:
You explain the situation. Macario's bizarre requests, the sudden interruption and the recovery from the skull of a courier killed in space by a merc on the edge of Askonia.

Reynard pretends to stifle a yawn.

"Fine, fine, perhaps it is something," he says. "Take it to Fleet Intelligence. Special Agent Finlay Siyavong."

A tap at his TriPad and a comms ID appears in your interface. Reynard sets his face, not giving a look of approval - or, for once, condescension.

"Off you go. I'll receive a report if it's anything."
entries.zh:
你解释了来龙去脉：Macario 那些古怪的要求、通讯的骤然中断，以及从一名信使的颅骨里取出的东西 —— 那信使是在 Askonia 边缘被雇佣兵杀死在太空里的。

Reynard 装模作样地压下一个哈欠。

"行，行，也许真有点东西，\"他说，\"送去舰队情报部。找特工 Finlay Siyavong。"

他在 TriPad 上一点，一个通讯识别码出现在你的界面上。Reynard 板着脸，既没有赞许的神色 —— 这一次也没有居高临下。

"去吧。要真有价值，我会收到报告的。"

entries.en:
Reynard considers your words as a felid might consider a shiproach. A smug grin appears.

"If this intel is encrypted how do you know it is as 'critical' as you so claim?"
entries.zh:
Reynard 掂量着你的话，像一只猫在掂量船上的蟑螂。随即浮起一丝得意的笑。

"这情报既然是加密的，你又怎么知道它真像你说的那么'关键'？"

o.en: Because this was meant for Dolos Macario. (explain)
o.zh: 因为这东西原本是送给 Dolos Macario 的。 (解释)
