entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet completely overwhelms the asteroid's defenses in short order. Electronic warfare and counter-fire reduce the opposition to nothing more than a lightshow.
entries.zh: 你的 $shipOrFleet 在极短的时间里彻底压垮了小行星的防御。电子战与反火力压制把对面打成了一场纯粹的灯光秀。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet takes minor damage as it overwhelms the asteroid's defense matrix.
entries.zh: 你的 $shipOrFleet 在压垮小行星防御阵列时受了轻微损伤。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet takes significant damage during the fight to overwhelm the asteroid's defense matrix.
entries.zh: 为了压垮小行星的防御阵列，你的 $shipOrFleet 在这一战里损伤不轻。

entries.en:
A face appears. A familiar face. It smiles, cockily confident.

"Captain $playerLastName, at last," it says.

"So opportunistic, so unable to resist the prize. I've read the reports, the intel. I know all about you."
entries.zh:
一张脸浮现出来。一张熟悉的脸。它笑了，自信得近乎挑衅。

"总算见面了，$playerLastName 舰长。"它说。

"多么善于钻营，多么抵挡不住诱饵的诱惑。报告我看过了，情报也看过。我对你了解得很透。"

o.en: Hector Palatin. Or should I say Andrada.
Hector Andrada. Son of the Supreme Executor.

entries.en:
He shrugs, mockingly apologetic.

"But you'll have to do a lot better than," a handwave, "that, to steal my birthright. I could almost respect your ambition..."

He interrupts himself with a questioning look.

"You think you can take it from me, don't you."
entries.zh:
他耸了耸肩，一副假作歉意的样子。

"不过想抢走我的继承权，你得比，\"他一挥手，\"这个高明得多才行。你这点野心，我几乎要生出敬意了..."

他忽然停住，投来一个询问的眼神。

"你以为你能从我手里夺走，是吧。"

o.en: I came to find out what Macario is doing. Why are you firing on me?
o.zh: 我是来查 Macario 在做什么的。你为什么要向我开火？

o.en: I came to warn you. Cease fire, let us talk!
o.zh: 我是来警告你的。停火，我们谈谈！

o.en: Take what from you? What are you talking about?
o.zh: 从你手里夺走什么？你在说什么？

o.en: Your defenses are destroyed. Surrender now!
o.zh: 你的防御已经被打垮了。立刻投降！

o.en: Actually yes, I can. The Diktat will be mine!
o.zh: 没错，我确实能。辛达强权会归我！

entries.en:
Almost instantly you feel it through the decking - a shudder, the warble of agrav plates as they compensate for a sudden inertial disruption.

The shock of a rolling explosion hits a split second later.
entries.zh:
几乎是立刻，你透过甲板感觉到了：一阵颤抖，反重力板为补偿突如其来的惯性扰动而发出的颤鸣。

半秒之后，一阵翻滚的爆炸冲击到了。

entries.en:
The lights fade to black as the agrav releases you to Elysium's natural microgravity.

Independently powered emergency lights rise in a hellish glow pierced by your bodyguards' spots. Unsecured objects jostled by the shockwaves float away from surfaces - datapads, a stylus, a drinking vessel.

The corpse in its cloud of flakes of dried blood.

Disciplined tactical chatter from your marines and techs fills the comms as they enact emergency protocols.
entries.zh:
反重力场失效，把你交还给 Elysium 的天然微重力，灯光随之暗了下去。

独立供电的应急灯亮起一片地狱般的红光，被护卫们的聚光灯刺开。被震波晃离原位、没有固定的东西从各处表面飘走——数据板、一支笔、一只饮杯。

那具尸体，裹在一团干涸的血屑之中。

通讯频道里满是陆战队与技术员们执行应急程序时克制有序的联络声。

o.zh: 报告。刚才那是什么爆炸？

entries.en:
Your sensors officer replies from your flagship's bridge: several enormous mining charges, the sort usually encountered at the business end of a Hammer torpedo, buried in the crust of Elysium. Some signal, probably optical hardwire, set it off.

The enormous internal habitable volume has been breached and the structural integrity of the asteroid - previously reinforced in iterative stages of construction - is fatally compromised.

In short, the place is coming down around you, falling in upon itself.
entries.zh:
传感器技官从旗舰舰桥回报：是几枚巨型采矿炸药，通常出现在大锤鱼雷弹头那一端的东西，被埋进了 Elysium 的地壳里。某个信号——大概是光纤硬线——把它们引爆了。

内部巨大的宜居空间已被击穿，而这颗小行星的结构完整性——曾在一次次扩建中逐层加固——如今已遭致命破坏。

简而言之，这地方正在你四周塌下来，向内垮塌。

entries.en:
This is not as immediately dangerous as the planet-bound might expect. The asteroid's true gravity is, after all, miniscule.

While this cluster of mountain-sized boulders may eventually collapse and even crush these marbled halls into so much gravel, much of your crew - former asteroid miners - know to keep calm, for these titanic masses accelerate slowly indeed in their infinitesimal shared attraction.
entries.zh:
这并不像久居行星的人以为的那样立时致命。毕竟，小行星本身的引力微乎其微。

这一簇山一样大的巨石最终或许会塌合，甚至把这些大理石的厅堂碾成一堆碎石；但你手下不少船员本是当过小行星矿工的，他们懂得保持镇定——在如此微弱的相互引力下，这些庞然巨物加速得极慢。

entries.en:
Your marines and crew evacuate carefully, using many of the same tools which allowed them to access the secrets of this base to exfiltrate without casualties.

The investigation, however, must be cut short. Few datacores were obtained and little of the base could be fully explored.

By his word, as much as it can be trusted, Hector is not in or on Elysium. It was once his home, but he left it a death-trap.

A trap for you, in particular.

You consider this.
entries.zh:
你的陆战队与船员谨慎撤离，用的还是当初打开这座基地秘密的那些工具，一路无伤亡地退了出去。

但调查只能草草收场。到手的数据核心寥寥无几，基地里也没几处能真正探查完。

照他所说——能信几分另说——Hector 并不在 Elysium 之内或之上。这里曾是它的家，他离开时把它留成了一座死亡陷阱。

尤其是为你设的陷阱。

你思量着这一点。

entries.en:
As you ponder your next move, a fusion reactor deep in the core of the asteroid collapses catastrophically.

It flashes in the display, a small star smothered in dust.
entries.zh:
你正琢磨下一步，小行星核心深处的一座聚变反应堆灾难性地崩塌了。

显示屏上它一闪，像一颗被尘埃闷死的小恒星。

entries.en:
Your shuttle docks under the protective firing arcs of your $shipOrFleet and the hair-trigger watch of your marines.

It soon becomes clear that no expense was spared in outfitting this facility. Perhaps the inlaid marble - true pressed marble, or some nanoforge product? - was carved by the frantic arms of insectile work-drones to the whim of a previous owner.
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机在 $shipOrFleet 的掩护射界与陆战队随时扣扳机的警戒下完成对接。

很快就看得出来，这处设施的装潢没省过一分钱。那些镶嵌的大理石——真正压制的石材，还是纳米锻炉的产物？——或许就是虫形工作机的机械臂按前主人的兴致，疯了一般雕出来的。

entries.en:
A perfect approximation of natural sunlight is cast from airshafts and recessed portals, the implied sky always just out of line-of-sight. The warm patches of sun amidst the cool weight of the halls and columns produces the feeling of the palace of some emperor of Old Earth despite the damage from your marines' incursion.

Hidden autoturrets have been blown, or simply overloaded remotely. Doors cut or blasted where they did not give in to electronic persuasion. The smoking bodies of maintenance drones that might have formed a makeshift anti-intrusion swarm are strewn recklessly.

No humans.
entries.zh:
通风井与内嵌的采光口投下几可乱真的阳光，那片暗示出的天空永远恰好看不进视线。凉重的廊道与立柱之间，一方方暖阳，让人几乎以为身在旧地球某位帝王的宫殿里——尽管陆战队的突入已在这里留下损伤。

暗藏的自动炮塔被炸开，或者干脆被远程过载。凡是不吃电子手段的门，就被切开或炸开。那些本可临时拼成反入侵蜂群的维护无人机，烧着烟的残骸散落一地。

没有人。

entries.en:
Before a particularly tall set of doors, cast bronze of intricate geometry, your lead bodyguard holds up a hand. A small blast is felt more than it is heard, a rapidly damped shock through the agrav and the air.

"Defense bot cluster. Shielded vault," your bodyguard says, eyes outward, scanning for threat. "All clear."
entries.zh:
在一扇格外高大的门前——铸铜的门面，几何纹样繁复——你的护卫队长抬起一只手。一声不大的爆炸，与其说听见，不如说是感觉到：一阵被迅速衰减的震波穿过反重力场与空气。

"防御机器人集群。屏蔽库房。\"你的保镖说着，目光朝外扫视威胁。\"已清空。"

entries.en:
Before a particularly tall set of doors, cast bronze of intricate geometry, your lead bodyguard holds up a hand. A series of small blasts is felt more than it is heard, a rapidly damped shock through the agrav and the air.

"Defense bot cluster. Shielded vault," your bodyguard says, eyes outward, scanning for threat. "Blue squad ambushed while escorting a tech team. All clear now."
entries.zh:
在一扇格外高大的门前——铸铜的门面，几何纹样繁复——你的护卫队长抬起一只手。一连串不大的爆炸，与其说听见，不如说是感觉到：一阵被迅速衰减的震波穿过反重力场与空气。

"防御机器人集群。屏蔽库房。\"你的保镖说着，目光朝外扫视威胁。\"蓝队在护送技术组时遭了伏击。现在都清干净了。"

entries.en:
The doors open silently, revealing a shadowy gallery. The whiff of burning and blood-red emergency lights are all that remain of the danger.

A tech has forwarded a diagram to your personal datapad; you're coming up on the central control room.
entries.zh:
门无声地滑开，露出一条幽暗的长廊。焦糊的气味，还有血红的应急灯，是那场危险留下的全部痕迹。

一名技术员把一张平面图传到了你的私人数据板上；中央控制室就在前面。

entries.en:
The faux-historical cladding was laid with a lighter hand here. The space is still ruinously airy for asteroid construction, but the control consoles and display units remind you more of a modern starship bridge.

The effect is somewhat spoiled by the man in a white uniform who appears to have been cut down by a sword - some time ago, well before your arrival from the looks of the dried brown-black stain spilling across the floor. He lies face-down, dead. Without seeing his face you can tell he is older, his build heavier, his skin darker than the image of Hector.

Some maintenance bot's tracks have drawn flaking lines back and forth across the room then out through a surreptitious hatch.

As you take this in, the primary display chimes, and a test pattern blinks through the holo-projector. Your bodyguards raise weapons, one at the display, others to cover access points.
entries.zh:
这里的仿古装饰收得比外头轻了些。放在小行星建筑的标准里，这处空间依旧空旷得近乎奢侈，但那些控制台与显示单元，更像是一座现代星舰的舰桥。

这份效果多少被破坏了：一个穿白色制服的男人，似乎是被刀剑砍倒的——看那摊漫过地面的干涸褐黑血迹，时候不短，远在你到来之前。他面朝下趴着，已经死了。不必看脸，你也看得出他比影像里的 Hector 年长，体格更重，肤色更深。

某台维护机器人的履带在室内来回碾出剥落的痕线，一直延伸到一处隐蔽的舱门外面。

你正看着这些，主显示屏响了一声，一道测试图样在全息投影器里闪烁起来。你的护卫举起了武器，一支对着显示屏，其余人封住各个出入口。

entries.en:
A perfect approximation of natural sunlight is cast from airshafts and recessed portals, the implied sky always just out of view. The warm patches of sun amidst the cool weight of the halls and columns produces the feeling of the palace of some emperor of Old Earth, despite the damage from your marines' incursion. It is a far cry from the comparatively spartan facilities of 17054 Irkalla.

Hidden autoturrets have been blown, or simply overloaded remotely. Doors cut or blasted where they did not give in to electronic persuasion. The smoking bodies of maintenance drones that might have formed a makeshift anti-intrusion swarm are strewn recklessly.

No humans.
entries.zh:
通风井与内嵌的采光口投下几可乱真的阳光，那片暗示出的天空永远恰好看不进视线。凉重的廊道与立柱之间，一方方暖阳，让人几乎以为身在旧地球某位帝王的宫殿里——尽管陆战队的突入已在这里留下损伤。与 17054 Irkalla 那处相对简陋的设施相比，这里简直是另一个世界。

暗藏的自动炮塔被炸开，或者干脆被远程过载。凡是不吃电子手段的门，就被切开或炸开。那些本可临时拼成反入侵蜂群的维护无人机，烧着烟的残骸散落一地。

没有人。

o.en: Order a complete bombardment of the Elysium base facility
o.zh: 下令对 Elysium 基地设施进行全面轰炸

entries.en: 58966 Elysium spins slowly, sullen under your examinations.
entries.zh: 58966 Elysium 缓缓旋转，在你的审视下显得阴沉。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe spins once more to face you, half-cape fluttering in a practiced motion.

"Fly, fly now my hunters! My beautiful knights of the vacuum! Fight gloriously!"

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 再次旋身面对你，半披风随着这练熟的动作翻飞。

"去吧，去吧，我的猎手们！我美丽的真空骑士！光荣地战斗吧！"

通讯中断。

entries.en:
As the transfer pings, the hand waves a dismissal.

"I, $playerSirOrMadam, serve glorious battle. Credits merely pave a path toward the glory of war, whether they come from my patron or from my..." $HeOrShe considers $hisOrHer words for a moment, then looks over one shoulder, almost coy. "My supplicant."

$HeOrShe spins once more to face you, half-cape fluttering in a practiced motion.

"Until we meet again - in battle, no doubt."
entries.zh:
转账到账的提示音响过，那只手一挥，示意作罢。

"我，$playerSirOrMadam，只侍奉光荣的战斗。星币不过是铺就通往战争荣光之路的石子，无论它来自我的雇主，还是来自我的...\"$HeOrShe 略微斟酌了$hisOrHer措辞，随后侧过一边肩膀，几乎带着几分娇态，\"还是来自我的祈求者。"

$HeOrShe 再次旋身面对你，半披风随着这练熟的动作翻飞。

"后会有期——当然，是在战场上。"

entries.en: "A coward's ruse!" shouts $personName. "I smelled it from the start. This is no true warrior we face in battle, but a cashier, a mere credit-pinching accountant."
entries.zh: "懦夫的把戏！\"$personName吼道，\"我一开始就闻出来了。我们在战场上撞见的不是什么真正的战士，是个收银员，一个只会数着星币过日子的账房。"

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName!"

The mercenary $rank shouts your name like an invective.

"You... WILL... be destroyed."

$HeOrShe turns on $hisOrHer heel, a half-cape fluttering dramatically. One hand is raised, as if waiting to give a fire order.

There is a short pause in which you might insert a word into this drama.
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长！"

那名雇佣兵 $rank 把你的名字喊得像一句咒骂。

"你...必将...毁灭。"

$HeOrShe 原地转过身，$hisOrHer 半截披风戏剧性地扬起。一只手举着，像在等着下达开火命令。

短暂的停顿，你或许能在这出戏里插一句话。

entries.en: The hand wavers. The moment draws out.
entries.zh: 那只手迟疑着。这一刻被拉得很长。

o.zh: 也许 50,000 星币就够了？ (说谎)

entries.en: The hand wavers. The moment draws out.
entries.zh: 那只手迟疑着。这一刻被拉得很长。

o.en: You've rather misjudged your fleet's strength, $post.
o.zh: 你对自家舰队的实力估计得有点偏差，$post。

o.en: You've rather misjudged your fleet's strength, $post. (lie)
o.zh: 你对自家舰队的实力估计得有点偏差，$post。 (说谎)

entries.en: The hand wavers. $HisOrHer head turns to the side, looking perhaps to $hisOrHer tactical officer.
entries.zh: 那只手迟疑了。$HisOrHer 的头转向一侧，也许是在看 $hisOrHer 的战术官。

o.en: You've rather misjudged your fleet's strength, $post.
o.zh: 你对自家舰队的实力估计得有点偏差，$post。

entries.en:
The hand wavers. $HisOrHer head turns to the side, looking perhaps to $hisOrHer tactical officer.

Shouted words from the other bridge, distorted by comms privacy algorithms. $PersonLastName's head snaps to the side, $hisOrHer invulnerable look faltering for a moment. Then it turns to anger.

"Space your excuses, coward! Traitor!" $HisOrHer invectives are directed at an officer on $hisOrHer own bridge.
entries.zh:
那只手迟疑了。$HisOrHer 的头转向一侧，也许是在看 $hisOrHer 的战术官。

对面的舰桥上传来喊叫，被通讯隐私算法搅得失真。$PersonLastName 猛地扭头，$hisOrHer 那副不可撼动的神情有一瞬动摇。随即转为怒意。

"把你的借口扔进太空去，懦夫！叛徒！"$HisOrHer 的咒骂全冲着 $hisOrHer 自己舰桥上的某名军官。

entries.en:
The mercenary $post struggles with $hisOrHer belt for a moment then draws a pistol which snaps to a threatening position somewhere off-link. More shouting.

The link snaps off. It's unclear if the flash was a weapons discharge or just noise at the end of an interrupted comms buffer.

Regardless, chaos on the mercenary's bridge may provide you with an opportunity for easy disengagement.
entries.zh:
雇佣兵 $post 在 $hisOrHer 腰带上摸索了一下，随即拔出手枪，枪口一下抬向画面外某个威胁性的方位。喊声更响了。

通讯骤然中断。那一闪究竟是武器击发，还是通讯缓冲被截断时的杂讯，说不清楚。

无论如何，那名雇佣兵舰桥上的混乱，也许正好给了你轻松脱身的机会。

o.en: Do you understand the monster you're assisting?
o.zh: 你知道自己在帮一个什么样的怪物吗？

o.en: Do you understand the monster you're assisting?
o.zh: 你知道自己在帮一个什么样的怪物吗？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks back over a shoulder. The hand waves a dismissal.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I serve only the splendor of battle. The credits of my patron merely pave a path toward the glory of war.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 回头望了一眼。那只手一挥，示意不必再说。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。我只效忠于战斗的壮美。雇主的星币，不过是替我铺出一条通往战争荣光的路。

o.en: Do not attack! I bear a commission of the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 别动手！我持有辛达强权的委任状。

entries.en:
The have waves a dismissal.

"And I, captain, serve glorious battle. The credits of my patron merely pave the path toward the glory of the warrior."

$HeOrShe looks over one shoulder, almost coy.

"I have heard much spoken of those loyal to the Lion of Sindria. Perhaps your reputed fervor will enhance the honor of my victory."
entries.zh:
那只手一挥，示意不必再说。

"而我，舰长，效忠于光荣的战斗。雇主的星币，不过是替我铺出一条通往战士荣光的路。"

$HeOrShe 回头望过一侧肩膀，带着几分刻意的含情。

"关于忠于辛达瑞亚之狮的那些人，我听过不少说法。也许你传闻中的那股狂热，能让我的胜利更有光彩。"

entries.en: Objective icons flip from urgent ambers to cool greens. It is done, and done quickly. The way is open.
entries.zh: 目标图标从急促的琥珀色翻成沉静的绿色。结束了，而且结束得很快。路已经打开。

entries.en: Objective icons flip from urgent ambers to cool greens all across the facility embedded in the rock of 58966 Elysium. It is done, and done quickly. The way is open.
entries.zh: 嵌在 58966 Elysium 岩体里的整座设施上，目标图标从急促的琥珀色翻成沉静的绿色。结束了，而且结束得很快。路已经打开。

entries.en:
The marines deploy from a cloud of chaff and open-vacuum support shuttles. They're a cluster of glowing points in your tactical display that spreads in a coordinated pattern, almost floral.

Or perhaps it is a web, a net thrown through space, a constellation of chattering nodes allocating firepower, coordinating smart munitions and drone swarms, to envelop and infiltrate the docking bay and its surrounds.
entries.zh:
陆战队员从一片箔条云与真空支援穿梭机中投放出去。战术屏上，他们是一簇发光的点，按协同的队形铺展开来，几近花开。

又或者那是一张网，一张撒向太空的网：一群彼此呼应的节点，分配火力，调度智能弹药与无人机群，只为包围并突入船坞及其周边。

entries.en:
You watch the tactical display as the marines deploy into formation, like the glowing outspread fingers of some fire-god, emerging as squads from a cloud of chaff and open-vacuum support shuttles.

The points on the display spread in seeming chaos, their movements practiced to suggest patternlessness.

Perhaps they are webs, entangling nets thrown through space, a constellation of chattering nodes allocating firepower, coordinating smart munitions and drone swarms to envelop and infiltrate the asteroid base through the docking bay, access ports, and no small number of new breaches created by shaped charge and plasma cutter.
entries.zh:
你盯着战术屏，看陆战队员展开队形——像某位火之神明伸开的发光手指，一个个小队从箔条云与真空支援穿梭机中钻出来。

屏上的光点看似杂乱地散开，那份娴熟却恰恰是为了演出毫无章法。

又或者它们是网，是撒向太空的缠网：一群彼此呼应的节点，分配火力，调度智能弹药与无人机群，从船坞、各个通道口，以及成型装药与等离子切割器新开出的不少破口，包围并突入这座小行星基地。

entries.en: A few squads are briefed, suited up, and armed for a microgravity assault. If they go in quick, the element of surprise may foil prepared defenses.
entries.zh: 几个小队受领了任务，穿好装甲，武装齐全，准备进行一次微重力突袭。只要进得够快，出其不意也许就能让对面备好的防御落空。

entries.en: The marines are briefed, suited up, and armed for a microgravity assault to fully envelope and infiltrate the Elysium base.
entries.zh: 陆战队员受领了任务，穿好装甲，武装齐全，准备以一次微重力突袭全面包围并突入 Elysium 基地。

entries.en: Spawned merc. Have fun!
entries.zh: 雇佣兵已生成。祝你玩得愉快！

entries.en:
You $shipOrFleet matches orbit with the asteroid $name.

The primary display pings as your $shipOrFleet receives a nav-radar pulse from an asteroid-side telemetry relay. It's followed by a brush of low-power nav-tel lasers which establish your course and swap (brief) transponder tags. Nothing out of the ordinary.
entries.zh:
你的 $shipOrFleet 与小行星 $name 同步进入轨道。

主显示屏响了一声：你的 $shipOrFleet 收到了来自小行星一侧遥测中继的导航雷达脉冲。接着是一束低功率导航遥测激光扫过，确认了你的航向，并交换了 (短暂的) 应答器标识。一切如常。

entries.en:
You $shipOrFleet matches orbit with the asteroid $name.

There is no automated nav-telemetry ping from the base - external comms, sensors, and weapons emplacements have been reduced to slowly cooling craters and a far-flung cloud of debris.
entries.zh:
你的 $shipOrFleet 与小行星 $name 同步进入轨道。

基地没有发来任何自动导航遥测信号 —— 外部通讯、传感器与武器阵地都已化作缓缓冷却的坑洞，和一片飘散极远的残骸云。

entries.en:
You $shipOrFleet matches orbit with what's left of asteroid $name.

It is little more than a clump of rubble which is, post-bombardment, unusually warm in terms both thermal and radioactive.
entries.zh:
你的 $shipOrFleet 与 $name 小行星的残骸同步进入轨道。

那不过是一堆碎石，在遭到轨道轰炸之后，无论热辐射还是放射性，都异常地暖。

entries.en:
You $shipOrFleet matches orbit with what's left of asteroid $name.

It is little more than a clump of rubble which is, post-collapse, unusually warm in terms both thermal and radioactive.
entries.zh:
你的 $shipOrFleet 与 $name 小行星的残骸同步进入轨道。

那不过是一堆碎石，在崩毁之后，无论热辐射还是放射性，都异常地暖。

o.en: I want to talk to a human. Comms, get someone on the line.
o.zh: 我要跟活人说话。通讯，给我接个人上来。

o.en: Tactical. What's an opposed access scenario look like?
o.zh: 战术。强攻进入会是什么局面？

o.en: Order your $shipOrFleet to attack Elysium's space defense
o.zh: 命令你的 $shipOrFleet 攻击 Elysium 的太空防御

o.en: Ready a section of marines to secure just the docking bay
o.zh: 准备一个班的陆战队，只夺取船坞

o.en: Prepare a platoon of marines to secure the entire asteroid base
o.zh: 准备一个排的陆战队，夺取整座小行星基地

entries.en:
The local nav volume around Elysium has been cleared by your $shipOrFleet, leaving fresh craters, cooling slag, and a halo of debris.

The asteroid base could be destroyed by relatively modest bombardment, but if you wish to gain valuable intel or prisoners, the interior must be infiltrated by space marines.
entries.zh:
Elysium 周边的本地航行空域已被你的 $shipOrFleet 清扫干净，只留下新炸出的坑洞、正在冷却的熔渣，以及一圈残骸光环。

这座小行星基地用一次规模不大的轰击就能摧毁，但若想取得有价值的情报或俘虏，就必须派陆战队突入内部。

o.en: Shuttle to Elysium with a squad of techs
o.zh: 带一队技师乘穿梭机前往 Elysium

o.en: Tactical, is the $shipOrFleet able to take our their defenses without losses?
o.zh: 战术，$shipOrFleet 能无损打掉他们的防御吗？

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches the local volume of Elysium.

The tactical display lights up, the estimated targeting envelopes of emplaced weapons flashing as they are entered, and adjusted as telemetry comes in. Points of light, arcs of beams, flashes of ordinance.
entries.zh:
你的 $shipOrFleet 驶近 Elysium 的本地空域。

战术屏亮了起来：那些固定炮位的预判射击包线先是一闪而入，随后随遥测数据不断修正。光点、光束的弧线、弹药的爆闪。

entries.en:
Elysium slowly turns in the display, access points and instrument clusters entering and breaking direct LOS over the asteroid's irregular surface.

Your comms officer runs through every standard ship-to-station hail protocol. Then the backups to those protocols, everything from tightbeam to radio, from q-pulse to graviton carrier.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," comms says, their professional tone undeterred by failure. "Still only receiving the automated message loop. They're ignoring us or no one's home."
entries.zh:
Elysium 在显示屏上缓缓转动，各个接入点与仪器簇随不规则的小行星表面时隐时现，时而进入直视线，时而脱离。

你的通讯官把舰对站的每一种标准呼叫协议都试了一遍。接着又试了那些协议的备份 —— 从定向窄束到无线电，从量子脉冲到引力子载波，全都用上了。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，\"通讯官说道，职业化的语气并未因失败而动摇，\"仍然只收到那套自动消息循环。他们要么是在无视我们，要么是没人在。"

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your sensors officer takes control of the display.

An enhanced view of 58966 Elysium grows, a false color rendering more revealing than the dim smudge your human eyes would perceive. Bright overlays grow at your sensors officer's prompting - here, radiator grids, there off-gassing, a tracery of waste heat and the hard geometry of comms arrays, sensor rigs, maintenance hatches, and a docking bay.

Tactical adds a spread of icons - showy armaments meant to discourage casual looters alongside a standard array of impactor defense. A moment later, these are joined by an additional matrix of heavier armament set in camouflaged hideaways.

Sensors raises an eyebrow.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam，"你的传感器技官接过显示屏的控制权。

58966 Elysium 的增强视图在屏上放大，伪彩渲染比肉眼所见的黯淡一团要清晰得多。在传感器技官的指令下，明亮的叠加标记逐一浮现 —— 这里是散热阵列，那里是排气，还有废热的脉络，以及通讯阵列、传感器支架、检修舱口与一处船坞的硬朗轮廓。

战术官叠上一片图标 —— 那些摆出来给人看的武器，是用来吓退顺手牵羊的拾荒者的，旁边还有一套标准的动能武器防御阵列。片刻之后，又添上一组藏在伪装掩体里的重武器。

传感器技官挑了挑眉。

entries.en:
It appears to be an unusually well-equipped civilian habitat tucked inside an asteroid. It was probably first mined a couple hundred cycles ago then improved upon in stages by various owners.

Such arrangements are particularly common in the Hybrasil system, where eccentric executives enjoy the privilege of their own tiny legal regimes within the nav-volumes of wholly-owned sub-planetary bodies.

Comms speaks up, "Captain, we're receiving a signal. Automated response. Asserting private ownership rights... standard interfactional terms of emergency protocols, will respond with deadly force to threat to habitatal volumes or life support systems."
entries.zh:
这看上去是一座藏在小行星内部的民用居所，装备好得不太寻常。它大概是在两百来个星历年之前被首次开采，之后由历任主人分阶段改造过。

这种安排在 Hybrasil 星系格外常见 —— 那些行事古怪的高管们，乐于在自己全资拥有的次行星天体的航行空域里，享受一套属于自己的微小法域。

通讯官开口了："舰长，我们收到一个信号。自动应答。正在主张私有产权...按势力间标准的紧急协议条款，对威胁居住舱段或生命维持系统的行为将以致命武力回应。"

entries.en:
Your sensors officer acknowledges, and 58966 Elysium grows in the primary bridge display. Bright overlays showing radiator grids, off-gassing, waste heat, and the hard geometry of comms arrays, sensor rigs, maintenance hatches, and a docking bay.

Tactical adds a spread of icons suggesting armaments both light and heavy, both openly displayed and hidden.
entries.zh:
传感器技官应了一声，58966 Elysium 在主舰桥显示屏上放大。明亮的叠加标记标出散热阵列、排气、废热，以及通讯阵列、传感器支架、检修舱口与一处船坞的硬朗轮廓。

战术官叠上一片图标，标示出轻、重两等武器，明的暗的都有。

entries.en: Your sensors officer acknowledges, and 58966 Elysium grows in the primary bridge display.
entries.zh: 传感器技官应了一声，58966 Elysium 在主舰桥显示屏上放大。

entries.en:
The local nav volume around Elysium has been cleared by your $shipOrFleet, leaving fresh craters, cooling slag, and a halo of debris.

Your marines have secured the docking bay.

The asteroid base could be destroyed by relatively modest bombardment.
entries.zh:
Elysium 周边的本地航行空域已被你的 $shipOrFleet 清扫干净，只留下新炸出的坑洞、正在冷却的熔渣，以及一圈残骸光环。

你的陆战队已夺取船坞。

这座小行星基地用一次规模不大的轰击就能摧毁。

entries.en:
The local nav volume around Elysium has been cleared by your $shipOrFleet, leaving fresh craters, cooling slag, and a halo of debris.

Your marines have secured the docking bay and infiltrated the base, deactivating internal security and taking control of key systems.

The asteroid base could be destroyed by relatively modest bombardment.
entries.zh:
Elysium 周边的本地航行空域已被你的 $shipOrFleet 清扫干净，只留下新炸出的坑洞、正在冷却的熔渣，以及一圈残骸光环。

你的陆战队夺取了船坞，并突入基地，关掉了内部安防，控制了关键系统。

这座小行星基地用一次规模不大的轰击就能摧毁。

entries.en: Tactical nods, and the primary display erupts with the gold and red of an assault plan they had already prepared.
entries.zh: 战术官点了点头，主显示屏上随即迸开一片金红——那是一份早已备好的强攻方案。

entries.en:
Tactical stands up quite straight to report.

"A critical mass of fleet assets can overwhelm their hardened defenses and ensure total control of near-surface volume with zero losses."
entries.zh:
战术官挺身立正，开始报告。

"只要舰队兵力达到临界规模，就能压垮他们加固过的防御，零损失拿下近表面空域的完全控制权。"

entries.en:
"We'll need marines. At least 48 suits will allow us to secure the docking bay and simultaneously infiltrate surrounding volumes to cripple the oppo defenses." A pause. "A lightning raid with 12 marines would be riskier, but possible."

"Going in without marines is asking for an ambush. High casualties." Tactical is steady. "$PlayerSirOrMadam."
entries.zh:
"我们需要陆战队。至少 48 副装甲，才够拿下船坞，同时突入周边区域，瘫痪对方的防御。\"一顿。\"12 人打一场闪电突袭，风险更大，但也做得到。"

"不带陆战队进去，就是请人打埋伏。伤亡会很重。\"战术官语气平稳。\"$PlayerSirOrMadam。"

entries.en:
"More marines. At least 48 suits will allow us to secure the docking bay and simultaneously infiltrate surrounding volumes to cripple the oppo defenses."

A pause. "A lightning raid with 12 marines could secure the docking bay, though it would not be without risk."
entries.zh:
"需要更多陆战队。至少 48 副装甲，才够拿下船坞，同时突入周边区域，瘫痪对方的防御。"

一顿。"12 人的闪电突袭也能拿下船坞，只是风险难免。"

entries.en: "The available marine complement is sufficient to storm the asteroid with minimal risk."
entries.zh: "现有的陆战队编制足够强攻这座小行星，风险很小。"

entries.en: "Yes, $playerSirOrMadam." Tactical doesn't smile, but there's a sense of pride in the answer. "We can do it at your order."
entries.zh: "是，$playerSirOrMadam。\"战术官没有笑，但答话里透着一丝自豪。\"只要你下令，我们就能办到。"

entries.en:
Tactical considers this for a moment.

"An additional 25% fleet strength would ensure victory without losses. Another non-civilian destroyer or a couple frigates would do it."
entries.zh:
战术官想了想。

"再增补 25% 的舰队兵力，就能确保无损失取胜。再来一艘非民用的驱逐舰，或者两艘护卫舰，就够了。"

entries.en:
Tactical considers this for a moment.

"A destroyer-class hull or two, military of course, and a few frigates could do it. We'd need to double the current fleet strength, to be clear."
entries.zh:
战术官想了想。

"一两艘驱逐舰级的舰体——当然是军用的——再加上几艘护卫舰，就够了。说清楚些：我们得把现有舰队兵力翻一倍。"

entries.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam." Tactical remains expressionless. "A couple more destroyers, military, and a handful of frigates would give us something to work with. Or a cruiser with screening elements. We'd need to triple the current fleet strength."
entries.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。\"战术官面无表情。\"再来两艘军用驱逐舰、几艘护卫舰，我们就有些本钱可用了。或者一艘巡洋舰加护航兵力。说白了，现有舰队兵力得翻到三倍。"

entries.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam." Tactical almost makes a face. Almost. "This $shipOrFleet is not... an especially credible combat force. A cruiser and a couple destroyers, a few frigates to screen. That we could work with."
entries.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。\"战术官差点皱起眉。只差一点。\"这支 $shipOrFleet...算不上特别可靠的战力。一艘巡洋舰、两艘驱逐舰，再配几艘护卫舰作屏障。那样我们才有得打。"

entries.en:
"There are insufficient marines to secure the docking bay. Micro-g infiltration training and armor are absolutely required to avoid casuaulties. Even against a civie base. And this is... something more."

Tactical puts on a stoic expression. Working within limits is the job, and demanding more resources in deep-space is uncomfortably close to complaining; they wouldn't caution you without meaning it.
entries.zh:
"陆战队员不足以夺取船坞。要避免伤亡，微重力突入训练和装甲是绝对必需的。哪怕对面只是民用基地也一样。而这里...不止是民用基地。"

战术官摆出一副沉静的神色。在既有条件里想办法，本是分内之事；在深空里再开口要资源，就近乎抱怨了。若非当真，战术官不会这样提醒你。

entries.en: "Once close-nav volume is cleared, I recommend deploying marines. A section, a dozen or so, could secure the primary hangar and entry. More would be ideal, but." Tactical doesn't finish the thought. Working within limits is the job, and demanding more resources in deep-space is uncomfortably close to whinging.
entries.zh: "一旦近距航行空间清理干净，我建议投放陆战队。一个班，十来个人，足以拿下主船坞和入口。再多人自然更好，只是。"战术官没有把话说完。在既有条件里想办法，本是分内之事；在深空里再开口要资源，就近乎发牢骚了。

entries.en: "Once close-nav volume is cleared, I recommend deploying a platoon of marines, 48 suits. A section to secure the primary hangar and entry, others to secure and breach secondary access points, another in reserves. Shock infiltration and envelopment."
entries.zh: "一旦近距航行空间清理干净，我建议投放一个排的陆战队，48 副装甲。一个班夺取主船坞和入口，其余人拿下并炸开次级通道，再留一个班作预备。突击突入，两翼包抄。"

entries.en: "My projections estimate that the $shipOrFleet could rapidly overwhelm the rock's defenses. Negligible damage, no casualties."
entries.zh: "按我的推演，$shipOrFleet 可以迅速压垮这块石头的防御。损伤可以忽略，不会出现伤亡。"

entries.en: "Estimate minor damage to the $shipOrFleet before overwhelming defenses." Tactical meets your look. "An easy win at a small cost, $playerSirOrMadam."
entries.zh: "预计 $shipOrFleet 会在压垮对方防御前受轻微损伤。\"战术官迎上你的目光。\"小代价，轻松取胜，$playerSirOrMadam。"

entries.en: "The $shipOrFleet would have difficulty overcoming the rock's anti-space spread. Estimate moderate damage." Tactical meets your look. "A win, but it'll cost."
entries.zh: "$shipOrFleet 要突破这块石头的对空火力网会很吃力。预计中度损伤。\"战术官迎上你的目光。\"能赢，但得付代价。"

entries.en:
He's back.

"I've been proven right at every step, haven't I. Macario has been useful to me."

Hector puts on a slow smile.

"His insight is derived from long study of the degenerate itinerancy of spacers."

"Yes, I mean you." He points accusation, enjoying the drama. "See how you dance to my prediction at every step? A few baubles and insinuations is all it took."
entries.zh:
他又出现了。

"每一步都被我算准了，不是吗。Macario 对我很有用。"

Hector 缓缓露出一个笑容。

"他的洞见，来自对太空人那种堕落的漂泊习性长年的研究。"

"没错，我说的就是你。\"他抬手指控，享受这出戏。\"看看你是怎么一步步照我的预判起舞的？几个诱饵，几句暗示，就够了。"

o.en: Where are you hiding? Enough games.
o.zh: 你躲在哪儿？别再玩花样了。

o.en: You really drank up the Andradan ideology, haven't you.
o.zh: 你还真是把 Andrada 那套主义喝得一滴不剩。

o.en: I'm going to have to have a chat with Macario after I track you down.
o.zh: 等我找到你，得好好跟 Macario 谈一谈。

o.en: ...You're not even in this asteroid, are you.
o.zh: ...你根本不在这个小行星上，是吧。

o.en: You've studied Andradaism I see, but Macario has misled you.
o.zh: 看得出来你研究过 Andrada 主义，但 Macario 把你带错了路。

o.en: Please, enough! I am loyal to the blood of Andrada!
o.zh: 够了，求你！我忠于 Andrada 的血脉！

o.en: Where are you hiding? We must speak.
o.zh: 你藏在哪儿？我们必须谈谈。

o.en: I'm going to have to have a chat with Macario after I track you down.
o.zh: 等我找到你，得好好跟 Macario 谈一谈。

o.en: ...You're not even in this asteroid, are you.
o.zh: ...你根本不在这个小行星上，是吧。

entries.en:
Hector doesn't acknowledge your words. He proceeds without hesitation, unburdened by self-doubt. He's clearly inherited the Andradan oratory gift.

"You only destroy. You cannot build, not really. That's why you'll always fail. You see-"

You see that this is a recording.

The eyes appear to follow you, the body language almost plausibly reacting to your movement. The holo is, no doubt, assisted by the same Tri-Tachyon human interfacing software that's allowed Philip Andrada to continue giving his speeches these past cycles.
entries.zh:
Hector 并不理会你的话。他毫不停顿地继续讲下去，全无自我怀疑的负担。显然，他继承了 Andrada 家的辩才。

"你只会破坏。你建不起任何东西，根本不能。所以你永远都会失败。你瞧——"

你看出来了：这是一段录像。

那双眼睛像是跟着你转，肢体语言几乎能以假乱真地回应你的动作。毫无疑问，这段全息借的是速子科技那套人机接口软件——正是它让 Philip Andrada 这些年来还能继续发表演说。

entries.en:
If what Hector says is true, if Dolos Macario really is feeding him 'intel', then the Spider of Sindria has a lot to answer for.

At least Hector is wrapping up his speech.

"...only regret is that I am not here to personally witness your destruction. Think of it as returning to the embrace of your chosen home: nothing and nowhere!"
entries.zh:
如果 Hector 所言属实，如果 Dolos Macario 真的在给他喂【情报】，那么这位辛达瑞亚的蜘蛛，要交代的事情可就多了。

至少 Hector 的演说要收尾了。

"...唯一的遗憾，是我不能亲眼看着你毁灭。就把它当作回到你所选的家园怀抱吧：虚无，无处！"

entries.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's sons have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their clone-father's empire: Hector and Achilles.

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly.

Openly - and soon.
entries.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两个儿子已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们克隆父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面烧起来。

明面开战——而且很快。

entries.en:
You've discovered what so troubled Macario, and found his contingency plan for control of the Sindrian Diktat in the form of Hector Andrada. It is clear, too, that he does not fully control the situation and perhaps never did. He would have never allowed Achilles to live.

History waits in fine balance as each presumptive heir builds strength. Macario will soon gamble everything; he will be exposed.

And it will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly.

Openly - and soon.
entries.zh:
你查明了究竟是什么让 Macario 如此不安，也发现了他为掌控辛达强权所备的后手——Hector Andrada。同样清楚的是，他并未完全握得住局面，或许从来就没握住过。否则他绝不会让 Achilles 活着。

历史悬在一线之间，每位自认的继承者都在积蓄力量。Macario 很快就要押上全部；他会暴露。

而只消一点火星，冲突就会明面烧起来。

明面开战——而且很快。

History waits in fine balance as each presumptive heir builds strength.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly.

History waits in fine balance as each presumptive heir builds strength.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly.

Openly - and soon.
entries.zh:
你查清了七位 Andrada 其人，也发现了 Macario 为掌控辛达强权所备的后手——Hector Andrada。同样清楚的是，他并未完全握得住局面，或许从来就没握住过。否则他绝不会让 Achilles 活着。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面烧起来。

明面开战——而且很快。

entries.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's sons have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their clone-father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two of seven.

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength, as each prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

That will be the time to strike.
entries.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两个儿子已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们克隆父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。七人中的二人。

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量，各自准备押上全部。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面爆发。而且很快。届时他们都最是脆弱。他们眼中只会有彼此这一个对手。

那就是动手的时候。

entries.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's heirs have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their clone-father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two of seven. One made weak by Macario's corrupting influence, the other made weak by the League's.

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength and prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

That will be the time to strike.
entries.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两位继承人已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们克隆父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。七人中的二人。一个被 Macario 的腐蚀性影响弄弱了，另一个则被联盟的影响弄弱。

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量，各自准备押上全部。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面爆发。而且很快。届时他们都最是脆弱。他们眼中只会有彼此这一个对手。

那就是动手的时候。

entries.en:
Whatever the schemes of the Andrada's divided old guard, two of Philip's heirs - his true blood - have moved into the foremost positions to succeed as Supreme Executor of their father's empire: Hector and Achilles. Two viable heirs of the original seven. But are they made weak by corrupting influence - one by Macario's scheming, the other by the League's? Can Andrada's blood, can his transcendent philosophy, overcome such setback?

History waits in fine balance as each builds strength and prepares to gamble everything.

It will take very little for the conflict to ignite openly. And soon. They will be vulnerable. They will see rivals only in one another.

One thing is clear: you must choose.
entries.zh:
无论 Andrada 家那些各怀心思的旧部在打什么算盘，Philip 的两位继承人——他真正的血脉——已经站到了最前头，只等接掌他们父亲帝国的最高元首之位：Hector 与 Achilles。最初七人中仅存的两个可继之人。可他们是否已被腐蚀性的影响弄弱了——一个毁于 Macario 的算计，另一个毁于联盟的？Andrada 的血脉，他那套超凡的哲学，能跨过这样的挫折吗？

历史悬在一线之间，两人各自积蓄力量，各自准备押上全部。

只消一点火星，冲突就会明面爆发。而且很快。届时他们都最是脆弱。他们眼中只会有彼此这一个对手。

有一件事很清楚：你必须选边。

entries.en:
You've discovered the fate of each of the seven sons of Philip Andrada.

Scattered to the small worlds of the Persean Sector, some died by the hand of assassins, others never truly lived.

But enough survived. The blood of Andrada lives on.
entries.zh:
你已经查清了 Philip Andrada 七个儿子各自的结局。

他们被散落到英仙座星域的小世界，有的死于刺客之手，有的从未真正活过。

但活下来的已经够多。Andrada 的血脉仍在延续。

entries.en:
"Captain $PlayerName," she says.

"I should have met with you sooner."
entries.zh:
"$PlayerName 舰长，"她说。

"我该早点见你的。"

o.en: A pleasure to meet you, ma'am. Where's Achilles?
Yes, you should have. This bait-and-switch is beneath both of us.
o.zh: 是啊，你本该如此。这种引我上钩又掉包的把戏，配不上你，也配不上我。

entries.en: "Safe," she says.
entries.zh: "他很安全，"她说。

entries.en: "Safe," she says, with a nod acknowledging your polite words in a strained situation.
entries.zh: "安全，"她说着点了点头，算是对你在这种紧绷场合里说的客套话表示认可。

entries.en: Her look cools slightly.
entries.zh: 她的神色冷了几分。

entries.en:
She traces a hand on the table. "An attempt on Achilles' life was made on this very spot. It was blind luck that the first shot missed."

Her eyes rise.
entries.zh:
她一只手在桌面上划过。"就在这个位置，有人对 Achilles 下过手。第一枪打偏，纯属运气。"

她抬起眼。

entries.en: "Then you appear. A servant of the cult of Ludd?" She looks skeptical.
entries.zh: "然后你出现了。卢德教派的仆从？"她看上去颇为怀疑。

entries.en:
"Then you appear."

"An independent spacer. A warlord, some say."
entries.zh:
"然后你出现了。"

"一个独立的太空佬。也有人说，是个军阀。"

entries.en:
"Then you appear. Bearing a commission of the Hegemony."

"Meddling."
entries.zh:
"然后你出现了。手里还捧着霸主的委任状。"

"来插手的。"

entries.en: "Then you appear. Bearing a commission of the League. Loyal, ostensibly, to our noble project."
entries.zh: "然后你出现了。捧着联盟的委任状。表面上，是忠于我们这项高尚事业的。"

entries.en: "Then you appear. A member of the League in full, but moreover, a creature of Reynard Hannan."
entries.zh: "然后你出现了。一位十足的联盟成员，但更像是 Reynard Hannan 的走狗。"

entries.en: "Then you appear. A full member of the League due, in part, to the largesse of Reynard Hannan."
entries.zh: "然后你出现了。能成为正式的联盟成员，多少得归功于 Reynard Hannan 的慷慨。"

entries.en: "Then you appear. A special 'friend' of Horus Yaribay, are you? I haven't quite pinned down what you're receiving in return for your support."
entries.zh: "然后你出现了。Horus Yaribay 的'特殊朋友'，是吗？我还没弄清楚，你这份支持换回来的是什么。"

entries.en: "Then you appear. Are you another automaton sworn to Philip Andrada's little experiment in ideology?"
entries.zh: "你也是那种向 Philip Andrada 那场意识形态小实验宣誓效忠的人偶吗？"

entries.en: "Then you appear. A commissioned contractor for the Tri-Tachyon corporation."
entries.zh: "然后你出现了。拿着速子科技公司委任的合同承包者。"

entries.en:
"With Reynard," she begins, "The world is of two camps: those for and those against Gens Hannan."

"A Sindrian Diktat simmering at near-war against the Hegemony? This serves Gens Hannan."

"Askonia at peace, however, and a member of the League?" Her expression is open.
entries.zh:
"在 Reynard 看来，\"她开口道，\"这世上只分两派：支持 Hannan 氏族的，和反对 Hannan 氏族的。"

"一个跟霸主僵持在战争边缘的辛达强权？这正合 Hannan 氏族的意。"

"可要是 Askonia 太平无事，还成了联盟的一员呢？"她的神情坦荡。

o.en: It would dilute his influence. And yours.
o.zh: 那会稀释他的影响力。还有你的。

entries.en:
"Imagine what the population and industry of Askonia - not so great as once they were, admittedly - and a majority stake in Sector fuel production would mean. The barycenter of League power would no longer fall solely within the orbit of Kazeron."

"The Kazeron dominated by Reynard Hannan."
entries.zh:
"想象一下：Askonia 的人口与工业——得承认，已不复当年——再加上星域燃料生产的多数份额，那意味着什么。联盟权力的重心，将不再只落在 Kazeron 的轨道里。"

"那个由 Reynard Hannan 把持的 Kazeron。"

entries.en: "Yes," she admits. "But this gens of secondary influence has already adapted to such conditions."
entries.zh: "没错，\"她承认，\"可这个影响力居次的氏族，早就适应这种局面了。"

o.en: So is this a play against Gens Hannan?
o.zh: 所以这是一场针对 Hannan 氏族的棋局？

entries.en:
"Temper your rage, captain," she says.

"Whatever you think of Andrada, my way is easier. Achilles can soften the excesses of the Sindrian Diktat, promote openness and transparency, and foster the new trade relationships which peace is built upon."
entries.zh:
"收一收你的怒火，舰长，"她说。

"不管你怎么看 Andrada，我的路更省事。Achilles 能收敛辛达强权的过度之处，推动开放与透明，培育和平所依托的新贸易关系。"

entries.en: "I appreciate your respect for civil discussion," she says, "despite our differing perspectives."
entries.zh: "我欣赏你对文明讨论的尊重，\"她说，\"尽管我们看法不同。"

entries.en:
"I remember the horror of Opis, captain," she says. "I remember watching as that world was torn apart and millions died. You need never remind me."

She lets that be for a moment.

"But I cannot change the past. And with respect to your idealism, my ability to bend the present is limited, however great."
entries.zh:
"我记得 Opis 的惨状，舰长，\"她说，\"我记得看着那个世界被撕碎，几百万人死去。你用不着提醒我。"

她让这句话悬在那儿，过了一会儿。

"可我改不了过去。至于你的理想主义——不管它多宏大，我能扭转当下的力量都是有限的。"

entries.en:
"That fight was lost before it began!" Her voice raises.

"I will use what power I have to bend the present toward the best future I can see. I shall not hold my hand to await your judgment on that matter, or any other!"
entries.zh:
"那场仗在开打之前就已经输了！"她的声音扬了起来。

"我会用我手上的权力，把当下推向我看得见的最好的未来。我不会停手等着你来评判这件事，或者别的什么事！"

entries.en:
"I will make no time for your dim sermonizing," she spits. Then, suppressing her anger, takes a deep breath.

"I have Achilles' assurance that he will stop the persecution. Is that not enough?"
entries.zh:
"我没空听你那些昏话布道。"她咬着牙说，随后压住怒气，深吸一口气。

"Achilles 向我保证过，他会停止迫害。这还不够吗？"

o.en: I suppose it'll have to be.
It'll have to be. For now.
And let the crimes against humanity go unpunished? It is not enough.
o.zh: 就让反人类的罪行不受惩罚？这不够。

entries.en:
This response baffles her.

"You?" She makes a strange expression; it'd be unseemly to laugh in your face.

"I am at a loss, $playerSirOrMadam. What you propose is... unreasonable."
entries.zh:
这个回答让她一时不知所措。

"你？"她露出一个古怪的表情；当着你的面笑出声来，终究有失体面。

"我不知道该说什么了，$playerSirOrMadam。你的提议...不合情理。"

o.en: Keep up. I've made a habit of accomplishing the impossible.
o.zh: 跟上。把不可能的事办成，我已经习惯了。

entries.en: "I suppose we shall," she says doubtfully.
entries.zh: "那就走着瞧吧，"她将信将疑地说。

entries.en: "So you say," she says.
entries.zh: "随你怎么说，"她说。

o.en: I shall hold my tongue. For now.
You would call Andrada's conquest legitimate? What of Opis and its dead?
o.zh: 你会说 Andrada 的征服是合法的？那 Opis 和它死掉的人呢？

o.en: You would accept Diktat legitimacy! You'd deny what your own granddaughter fights for?
o.zh: 你要承认强权的合法性！你要否掉你亲孙女为之奋斗的东西？

o.en: You would find it less 'easy' if you valued the lives of the Faithful sent to Cruor.
o.zh: 要是你在乎那些被送去 Cruor 的卢德信徒的性命，就不会觉得这事有多'省事'。

o.en: You misunderstand. I intend to take the Sindrian Diktat for myself.
o.zh: 你误会了。我打算自己拿下辛达强权。

entries.en: "The Hegemony had its chance, captain. Auxiliary captain," she says the words quite deliberately. "For more than 20 cycles, you had your chance."
entries.zh: "霸主有过机会，舰长。辅助军的舰长，\"她把这几个字说得格外刻意，\"二十多个星历年，你们都有过机会。"

o.en: The Andrada mutiny must be brought to justice - by the Hegemony.
o.zh: Andrada 的叛变必须受到审判——由霸主来审。

entries.en:
She moves as if to wipe some imagined dirt from her extravagant costume, but catches herself, and folds her hands neatly.

"Perhaps there is a more salient point we might build upon."
entries.zh:
她像是要抹掉那身华服上并不存在的灰尘，手抬到一半又收住，端端正正地把双手交握在身前。

"或许我们可以从一个更切题的要点谈起。"

o.en: It appears that we disagree about what is to be done.
o.zh: 看来我们对于该做什么，意见不合。

entries.en: She nods, slowly.
entries.zh: 她缓缓点头。

entries.en: "I must," she says.
entries.zh: "我必须这么做，"她说。

entries.en: She nods, slowly.
entries.zh: 她缓缓点头。

entries.en: She lets out a breath, slowly. Eyes hard.
entries.zh: 她缓缓吐出一口气，眼神变硬。

o.en: Andrada must be destroyed. His hateful polity, his clones. All of it.
o.zh: Andrada 必须被摧毁。他那个可憎的政权，他的克隆体。全部。

o.en: So how will you ensure Achilles becomes Supreme Executor?
o.zh: 那你要怎么保证 Achilles 当上最高元首？

entries.en:
"So you're a believer," she says, gently.

A distance, a coolness enters her voice.

"Know that Achilles is a willing partner in my endeavour. I am extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
entries.zh:
"原来你是个信徒，"她温和地说。

她的声音里多了一层疏远和冷意。

"要知道，Achilles 是自愿与我同行的。我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

o.en: Andrada's genius is transcendent. As is his blood!
o.zh: Andrada 的天才是超凡的。他的血脉也是！

entries.en:
"Then perhaps, in that, we can find common orbit," she says. A coolness enters her voice, like armor.

"Achilles is a willing partner in my endeavour. I am extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
entries.zh:
"那么在这一点上，我们或许能进入同一条轨道，"她说。一层冷意像装甲一样覆上她的声音。

"Achilles 是自愿与我同行的。我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

o.en: I am no automaton. I seek only to bring order to the growing chaos.
o.zh: 我不是人偶。我只想给这愈演愈烈的混乱带来秩序。

entries.en:
She leans back.

"I won't deny that I serve my own interests," she says. "But I recognize the value in forming a coalition with a capable, dutiful, and... ambitious young man."

"There's much to gain: lasting peace as a united bloc stays Hegemony aggression. Trade agreements, knowledge-sharing, a shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan and toward the League itself."
entries.zh:
她向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益做事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟一个能干、尽责、而且...有野心的年轻人结成同盟，是有价值的。"

"能得到的很多：一个统一的集团就能挡住霸主的进犯，换来长久和平。贸易协定、知识共享，权力重心从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron，转向联盟本身。"

entries.en:
She leans back.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interest," she says. "But I recognize the value in forming a coalition with... a capable, dutiful, and ambitious young man."

"Trust me," she says, showing perfect teeth. "If he thought he was to be a mere tool, he would not have agreed to my terms. He's an Andrada."
entries.zh:
她向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟一个...能干、尽责、而且有野心的年轻人结成同盟，自有其价值。"

"相信我，\"她说着，露出一口完美的牙齿，\"如果他以为自己只是个工具，就不会答应我的条件。他可是 Andrada 家的人。"

entries.en: "As you would have it," she says. "I shall not whisper even a hint of your faithlessness to the Sindrian Diktat."
entries.zh: "随你，\"她说，\"你对辛达强权的二心，我一个字都不会往外递。"

entries.en: She nods.
entries.zh: 她点了点头。

entries.en: "I speak in jest, captain," she says evenly. "If I threaten you, you will know it."
entries.zh: "我在说笑，舰长，\"她语气平缓，\"我要是威胁你，你会知道的。"

o.en: I am no 'automaton'. My commission is held with my own self-interest in mind.
o.zh: 我不是什么'人偶'。我接这份委任，考虑的是我自己的利益。
为什么是 Achilles？为什么不是别人？

entries.en:
She shrugs. Then she looks up at you.

"You mean to align yourself with Horus Yaribay," she says, looking you over.

"$TitlePL. You know he is too hesitant, too cautious. You and I know why the Hegemony can't simply be invited to 'clean up' their errors and crimes in Askonia. The situation has evolved - this is an opportunity to unseat Reynard Hannan from what he believes is his personal throne in the office of Prime Demarchon by shifting the center of power of the Persean League and, indeed, the Sector."

"Horus will understand that it was necessary to do it my way, in the end."
entries.zh:
她耸了耸肩，然后抬头看向你。

"你想跟 Horus Yaribay 站到一边，"她打量着你，说。

"$TitlePL。你知道他太犹豫，太谨慎。你我都清楚，为什么不能干脆请霸主来'清理'他们在 Askonia 犯下的错误和罪行。局势已经变了——这是个机会：把英仙座联盟、乃至整个星域的权力中心挪一挪，让 Reynard Hannan 从他自以为属于他的那张大统领宝座上滚下来。"

"到头来，Horus 会明白，按我的方式做是必要的。"

o.en: How will supporting some renewed Diktat lead to the peace Horus desires?
o.zh: 扶持一个重生的强权，怎么可能带来 Horus 想要的那种和平？

entries.en:
"Would you propose allowing Dolos Macario to dictate the constitution of a renewed Sindrian Diktat?"

She pauses, then answers herself, "There's little that'd be worse."
entries.zh:
"你难道主张让 Dolos Macario 来定一个重生的辛达强权的宪法？"

她顿了顿，随即自答："没什么比那更糟了。"

o.en: Won't this set off the Hegemony? Don't you risk a greater conflict?
o.zh: 这不会激怒霸主吗？你就不怕引出一场更大的冲突？

entries.en:
"Every act entails risk," she says steadily. "The question is if you seize the opportunity to direct events or cede it to another."

"Anyway, the High Hegemon is no fool." Fortuna speaks confidently, "He will do everything to minimize the spread of conflict. To minimize further fallout which embarasses the project of the Hegemony."
entries.zh:
"任何行动都有风险，"她语气平稳。"问题在于，你是抓住机会去主导局势，还是把它让给别人。"

"再说，至高霸主不是蠢人。\"Fortuna 说得很笃定，\"他会尽一切努力把冲突压到最小，把进一步让霸主的事业蒙羞的余波压到最小。"

o.en: If you support Achilles, it means there will be civil war in Askonia.
o.zh: 你要是支持 Achilles，就意味着 Askonia 会打内战。

entries.en:
"Yes!" Her hand makes a small fist.

"And if I don't, who stands to stop a new consolidation of power within the Sindrian Diktat? For cycles now the polity has been as paralyzed as the drooling corpse of Philip Andrada."

"Imagine Dolos Macario behind Caden, or some clone he's managed to indoctrinate, with the full, unified power of the Sindrian Diktat! It would be disaster."
entries.zh:
"对！"她的手轻轻握成拳。

"如果我不做，还有谁能拦住辛达强权内部新一轮的权力整合？这么多星历年，这个政权就跟 Philip Andrada 那具流着口水的尸体一样瘫痪。"

"想想看，Dolos Macario 躲在 Caden 背后，或者躲在他成功洗脑的某个克隆体背后，握着辛达强权完整而统一的权力！那会是场灾难。"

o.en: Let us set aside Horus for the moment...

entries.en: "Let's," she agrees.
entries.zh: "那就先放一放。"她表示同意。

entries.en: You begin to scan the clientele, searching for the distinct face of Achilles Andrada. Failing that, Fleet uniforms with their backs turned - one looks over his shoulder and meets your eyes for a moment.
entries.zh: 你开始扫视店里的客人，找 Achilles Andrada 那张辨识度极高的脸。找不到的话，就找背对着你的舰队制服——其中一人回头瞥了一眼，与你目光相接了一瞬。

entries.en: It's a suspicious look. Not Achilles.
entries.zh: 那是个狐疑的眼神。不是 Achilles。

entries.en: A frown and a glare is all you get. It's not Achilles.
entries.zh: 你只换来一记皱眉和瞪视。不是 Achilles。

entries.en: You get a smile, a raised glass, and an open look - another round, captain? You acknowledge the gesture, but keep searching for Achilles.
entries.zh: 你换来一个微笑、一只举起的酒杯，还有一副坦荡的神情——再来一轮吗，舰长？你点头回礼，但继续找 Achilles。

o.en: Ping your bodyguards and keep looking
o.zh: 给你的保镖发个信号，继续找

entries.en:
A hush falls, and heads turn.

You follow them toward the figure who has appeared at the bar's entrance: a silhouette of glittering shadow. A squad of attendants calmly file around her like invading infantry.

Her costume is ostentatious, like a monarch of old Earth.
entries.zh:
一片静默落下，众人纷纷转头。

你随众人的目光看向酒吧门口出现的那个人影：一道闪着光的暗影。一队随从从容地绕着她散开，像入侵的步兵。

她的衣着张扬夺目，像旧地球的君主。

entries.en:
You have bodyguards both overt and incognito - dressed as spacers on shore-leave, a technician just off-shift. Their heads scan the room's firing lines, and an EW specialist taps at their datapad as if checking for messages.

You can imagine the subtle sensors tagging the various low-powered hand weapons carried by the clientele. They would appear in the optics, cybernetic or simple hardware, of your guards. A dense cluster of pistols would show in the pack of League Fleet junior officers in one corner.
entries.zh:
你的保镖有明有暗——有的扮成上岸休假的太空佬，有的像个刚下班的技工。他们扫视着屋里各条可能的射击线路，一名电子战专家敲着数据平板，像是在查消息。

你能想象那些精细的传感器，正把客人们随身带的各色低功率手武器一一标出来。它们会出现在你保镖的目镜里——义体也好，普通硬件也罢。角落里那堆联盟舰队下级军官身上，会亮起一团密集的手枪光点。

entries.en:
"I'll have the room." Her voice is raised with a resonant confidence quite comfortable delivering outrageous demands.

Those who understand the implications of her presence take quick last sips and leave. Those who don't are quietly, even forcefully, escorted out by aides - guards? Their uniforms are gilt with touches of Gens Kato fancy, but you can tell by their movement that there are panels of flex-armor and subtle weapons beneath.

The Matriarch of Gens Kato turns her gaze upon you as the bar empties. Two chairs are pulled up, a table given a wipe-down.

She sits, regal.
entries.zh:
"这间屋子我包了。"她提高了声音，那声音浑厚而自信，说这种荒唐的要求说得十分从容。

明白她出现意味着什么的人，赶紧喝完最后一口就走。不明白的，则由随从——还是护卫？——安静地、甚至强硬地请了出去。他们的制服上有 Kato 氏族那种讲究的金线装饰，但从走路的姿态看得出来，底下衬着柔性装甲板，还藏着不张扬的武器。

酒吧空下来时，Kato 氏族的女族长把目光转向你。两把椅子被拉了过来，一张桌子被擦了一遍。

她坐了下来，仪态威严。

entries.en:
"You?"

Her face twitches and settles into cool disappointment rather than bursting into laughter, but you suspect she might have.
entries.zh:
"你？"

她脸上抽动了一下，随后没有爆出笑声，而是沉成一片冷淡的失望——但你怀疑她差点就笑出来了。

entries.en:
"Oh, Dardan." She looks off and away. "Stubborn boy."

"Perhaps we were too strict in directing his upbringing - I left that to Hadwin, you know. It is as though he fears to have any imagination. It makes his... situation difficult."
entries.zh:
"唉，Dardan。"她的目光移向别处。"倔孩子。"

"也许我们在管教他时太严了——你知道，那摊事我交给了 Hadwin。他像是连一点想象力都怕有。这让他的...处境很难办。"

o.en: Maybe planetary administration isn't Dardan's calling.
o.zh: 也许行星行政本来就不是 Dardan 该走的路。

o.en: It appears he's learned a hatred for the Luddic Faithful.
o.zh: 看样子他学会了憎恨卢德信徒。

o.en: He lacks the conviction to take the steps necessary to quell the Pather uprisings.
o.zh: 他缺那份决心，下不了镇压左径暴动该下的手。

entries.en:
She gives you a look.

"He will learn. It is his duty to the gens. And I gave him it not because I thought it would be easy, but because the challenge would teach him what he needs to lead the gens."
entries.zh:
她看了你一眼。

"他会学会的。这是他对氏族的责任。我把这差事交给他，不是以为它轻松，而是因为这挑战能教会他领导氏族所需要的东西。"

entries.en:
"It is not 'hatred' if it is a rational fear. Look upon Mairaath, captain! See there the destruction wrought by blind faith, the millions dead. For what?"

"It is an irrational cult. No greater force holds us back from rebuilding human civilization - one of freedom and plenty rather than the tyranny and war of the Domain."

She takes a deep breath, centering regal calm upon herself once again.

"Freedom and plenty. To return to the point, Achilles offers us a chance for this and more, captain."
entries.zh:
"如果那是理性的恐惧，就不叫'憎恨'。看看 Mairaath，舰长！看看盲信造出的毁灭，看看那几百万条人命。图什么？"

"那是个不理性的教派。没有哪股力量比它更妨碍我们重建人类文明——一个自由而富足、而非人之领那种暴政与战争的文明。"

她深吸一口气，重新把那份君临般的镇定收拢回来。

"自由与富足。回到正题：Achilles 给了我们一个机会，能换来这些，甚至更多，舰长。"

entries.en:
She gives you a look of some consternation.

"I have no love for the Luddics and their irrational mythology. They hold the entire Sector back, in an age of darkness. But consider well such bold and bloodthirsty proclamations - see how such 'conviction' has served Philip Andrada on Volturn."

"Andrada was as blind the Luddics he slaughtered," she hisses. Then takes a deep breath, re-centering herself in a sense of regal calm.

"And for all purposes he is as good as dead. Which brings us back to Achilles."
entries.zh:
她看着你，神情有些不安。

"我对卢德派和他们那套不理性的神话毫无好感。在这黑暗的时代，是他们拖住了整个星域。可你好好掂量掂量这种大胆又嗜血的说辞——看看这种'决心'让 Philip Andrada 在 Volturn 落了个什么下场。"

"Andrada 跟他屠杀的那些卢德派一样瞎，"她嘶声道。随后深吸一口气，重新沉回那份君临般的镇定里。

"而说到底，他早跟死了没两样。这就又说回 Achilles 了。"

o.en: I met Dardan. Your grandson, if I am not mistaken?
o.zh: 我见过 Dardan。没弄错的话，他是你孙子？

entries.en: "So it does." She stands.
entries.zh: "确实如此。"她站起身。

entries.en: "I will ask simply that you do not place yourself in the way of progress, captain," she says, her tone distinctly stonier than before.
entries.zh: "我只请你别挡在进步的路上，舰长。"她说，语气比先前明显更硬。

entries.en:
"I don't expect you or your masters in the Hegemony Strategic Council to understand why my way is best."

"I will ask simply that you do not place yourself in the way of progress, captain," she says, her tone distinctly stonier than before.
entries.zh:
"我不指望你，也不指望你那些在霸主战略委员会里的主子，能明白我的路为何最好。"

"我只请你别挡在进步的路上，舰长。"她说，语气比先前明显更硬。

entries.en: "Remember that you are part of the Persean League, captain," she says. "Our strength is together. Do not place yourself in the way of progress."
entries.zh: "记住你是英仙座联盟的一分子，舰长。\"她说，\"我们的力量在于同心。别挡在进步的路上。"

entries.en: She interrupts, holding a hand aloft, a finger raised to summon the bartender, who appears almost instantly.
entries.zh: 她打断你，一只手抬起，竖起一根手指唤来酒保；那酒保几乎立刻就到了。

entries.en:
"I find myself in the mood for a glass of the Aguila-Samek '45."

She projects her voice to the room.

"I apologize, ma'am," the bartender says, scurrying up to the table, "but we don't h-"

"Of course you don't," she says over him. "I brought some that you may pour for me."
entries.zh:
"我忽然想喝一杯 Aguila-Samek '45。"

她把声音送向整个房间。

"抱歉，女士，\"酒保快步凑到桌边，\"可我们没——"

"你们当然没有，\"她打断他，\"我自己带了，你只管给我斟上。"

entries.en:
She snaps her fingers, and an attendant approaches.

A case appears and from it an amber bottle webbed in silver tracery, a stream of cool mist flowing down the sides. It opens with a crisp pop.

The bartender fills Fortuna's glass, then hesitates, the spout frozen above the glass set in front of you.

She gives a tiny nod, and the bartender pours for you.
entries.zh:
她打了个响指，一名随从走上前来。

一只箱子送上桌，从里面取出一只琥珀色酒瓶，瓶身覆着银丝般的纹路，冷雾顺着瓶壁流下。瓶盖弹开，发出清脆的一声。

酒保为 Fortuna 斟满一杯，随后迟疑起来，壶嘴悬在你面前那只杯子的上方不动了。

她轻轻一点头，酒保便为你斟上。

entries.en:
She raises her glass.

"I desire stability. It is a necessary precursor to general prosperity and good living. I offer Achilles all of this, and more - the opportunity to fulfill his duty and ambition as a 'great man' of history." She pauses. "Or, at least, the echo of one."

"I do not demand his humiliation for my own self-regard, nor his life or pain for the crimes of his clone-father."

"And to you I offer an honest accounting of my goals and motives." She looks to you with haughty expectation.
entries.zh:
她举起酒杯。

"我要的是稳定。那是普遍繁荣与优裕生活必要的前提。这些我全都给 Achilles，还有更多——一个成为历史上'伟人'、尽到责任并实现抱负的机会。\"她顿了顿。\"至少，做一个伟人的回声。"

"我并不为了自己的体面要求他受辱，也不为他克隆父亲的罪行索取他的性命或痛苦。"

"而对你，我愿意如实交代我的目标与动机。"她带着傲然的期待看向你。

o.zh: 为这话，我先干一杯——有条件地。

o.en: You forget MY ambitions. Which have been earned, not inherited.
o.zh: 你忘了我的野心。那是我挣来的，不是继承来的。

o.en: You forget that Achilles is a symbol. So long as he lives, so does Andrada.
o.zh: 你忘了 Achilles 是个象征。只要他活着，Andrada 就还活着。

o.en: You forget that Achilles is the blood of Andrada, from which all authority flows.
o.zh: 你忘了，Achilles 身上流着 Andrada 的血，而一切权威皆由此而来。

entries.en:
"I welcome the prospect of your partnership."

She clinks your glass and sips, looking pleased.
entries.zh:
"我很期待与你携手。"

她与你碰杯，抿了一口，看上去颇为满意。

entries.en:
"I welcome the prospect of your partnership."

She clinks your glass and sips, looking pleased.

"Provisionally."
entries.zh:
"我很期待与你携手。"

她与你碰杯，抿了一口，看上去颇为满意。

"有条件地。"

entries.en:
She raises an eyebrow, quite skeptical.

Then sips her drink, timing her action to allow herself to ignore your gaffe.
entries.zh:
她挑起一边眉毛，满是怀疑。

然后抿了一口酒，借着这个动作，正好不去理会你的失言。

entries.en:
She raises an eyebrow, quite skeptical.

Then sips her drink, looking for a moment pleased to ignore your impasse.
entries.zh:
她挑起一边眉毛，满是怀疑。

然后抿了一口酒，一时之间像是很乐意无视你们之间的僵局。

entries.en:
She raises an eyebrow, quite skeptical.

Then, with a sigh, she sips her drink, looking for a moment pleased to ignore your words.
entries.zh:
她挑起一边眉毛，满是怀疑。

随后叹了口气，抿了一口酒，一时之间像是很乐意无视你说的话。

entries.en: "My 'tool'?" She smirks. "I'm simply extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
entries.zh: "我的'工具'？\"她嘴角一挑。\"我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

entries.en:
She leans back.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interests, but I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners. Some junior, some senior; it as natural as fortunes rise and wane by the vagaries of time."
entries.zh:
她向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，但我看得出，跟自愿联手的伙伴结成同盟是有价值的。有晚辈，也有长辈；就像时运随光阴的无常而起落一样自然。"

entries.en:
"You've met Reynard Hannan. Would you rather Achilles fell into his orbit?"

She leans back.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interest, but I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners. Be they junior or senior; it as natural as fortunes wax and wane."
entries.zh:
"你见过 Reynard Hannan。你宁可让 Achilles 落进他的轨道？"

她向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，但我看得出，跟自愿联手的伙伴结成同盟是有价值的。不论辈分高低；就像时运有盛有衰一样自然。"

entries.en:
"Now I ask you - not accuse - what is your interest in Achilles? What is the Hegemony's interest in Achilles?"

She smiles, coyly. "Did Daud... no, it would have been Orcus Rao, wouldn't it. Did Orcus put you up to this?"
entries.zh:
"现在我问你——不是指控你——你对 Achilles 有什么图谋？霸主对 Achilles 又有什么图谋？"

她勾了勾嘴角，笑得有几分做作。"是 Daud 让你...不，应该是 Orcus Rao，对吧。是 Orcus 教你这么干的？"

o.en: I'll not confirm or deny Hegemony involvement.
o.zh: 霸主是否介入，我不承认，也不否认。

o.en: He knows nothing of this. As far as I know.
o.zh: 此事他一无所知。据我所知是如此。

o.en: I'm acting under my own initiative, ma'am.

entries.en: "Of course he is," she says, satisfied.
entries.zh: "他当然参与其中，"她心满意足地说。

entries.en: "How loyal," she says. "Maybe he'll give you a medal... when the dust settles."
entries.zh: "真忠诚，\"她说，\"也许他会给你发一枚勋章...等尘埃落定之后。"

entries.en:
"No," she says. "Either you're lying or you've been woefully uninformed."

"Which is worrying," she adds, with a look of concern.
entries.zh:
"不对，\"她说，\"要么你在撒谎，要么你被瞒得彻底。"

"这可叫人担心，"她补了一句，脸上现出忧色。

entries.en:
She examines you for a moment.

"Trust me, then," she says, "when I tell you that he knows quite a lot of this."
entries.zh:
她打量了你片刻。

"那么，就相信我吧，\"她说，\"我说他对这事知道得相当多。"

entries.en: "Perhaps you even believe that," she says.
entries.zh: "也许你自己都信了这话，"她说。

entries.en: "Please give Orcus my compliments when next you meet with him on that dismal station of his," she concludes.
entries.zh: "下次去他那座阴惨惨的空间站上见他，代我向他致意，"她最后说。

entries.en:
"Broadly speaking," she says, "He will claim legitimacy. He will have backing. Allies, credits, warships."

A pause. "Insiders."

"And he will take Sindria. And with Sindria, Askonia. And Askonia will join the Persean League."
entries.zh:
"大略说来，"她说，"他会宣称自己名正言顺。他会有靠山。盟友、星币、战舰。"

一顿。"还有内应。"

"然后他会拿下 Sindria。拿下 Sindria，也就拿下了 Askonia。而 Askonia 会加入英仙座联盟。"

entries.en:
She smiles coldly. "Your mercenary reputation prevails."

Fortuna takes a moment to whisper into her cuff. You, in turn, receive the ping of a credits transfer.

"For your consideration," she says. "You shall receive additional payments as you follow my instructions to ensure the ascension of Achilles to his birthright."
entries.zh:
她冷冷一笑。"你这雇佣兵的名声，果然名不虚传。"

Fortuna 低头对着袖口低语了几句。随即，你的通讯器响起一声星币转账的提示音。

"一点心意。\"她说，\"只要你按我的吩咐行事，确保 Achilles 登上他生来就该有的位置，后续还会另有酬劳。"

o.zh: 你说出'十万星币'的时候，我就已经答应了。

entries.en:
"When the time is right we must speak again," she says.

Fortuna stands.

"I thank you, $TitlePL $PlayerLastName. We will build a better Persean Sector. One with a future."
entries.zh:
"时机成熟时，我们得再谈一次。"她说。

Fortuna 站起身。

"我谢谢你，$TitlePL $PlayerLastName。我们会建起一个更好的英仙座星域。一个还有未来的星域。"

entries.en:
She smiles coldly.

"No. You can't be trusted to uphold a deal. Everyone knows that."
entries.zh:
她冷冷一笑。

"不必。你守不住协议，这谁都知道。"

entries.en:
She stands.

"Thank you, $TitlePL $PlayerLastName. Together we will build a better Persean Sector. One with a future."
entries.zh:
她站起身。

"谢谢你，$TitlePL $PlayerLastName。我们会一起建起一个更好的英仙座星域。一个还有未来的星域。"

o.en: If you've got the credits, then I'll back you. And Achilles, if you want.
o.zh: 只要星币到位，我就支持你。还有 Achilles，如果你要。

o.en: But Andrada's ideology is incompatible with the Persean League's... diversity.
o.zh: 可 Andrada 的意识形态，与英仙座联盟的...多元，水火不容。

o.en: But Andrada's transcendent ideology is incompatible with the League's 'diversity'.
o.zh: 可 Andrada 那套超凡的意识形态，与联盟的'多元'水火不容。

o.en: The Hegemony would never allow it.
Bold of you to tell me the plan. What stops me from revealing it?
o.zh: 把计划讲给我听，胆子不小。我凭什么不把它捅出去？

o.en: A bold plan, and I've heard no better. Can I help?
o.zh: 计划够大胆，我也没听过更好的。我能帮上忙吗？

o.en: You're going to have one big problem - me.
o.zh: 你会有个大麻烦——就是我。

o.en: Andrada still must be destroyed. Everything he built, torn down.
o.zh: Andrada 还是得被毁掉。他建起来的一切，都得推倒。

o.en: I am not comfortable with the power you may have over Achilles.
o.zh: 你可能对 Achilles 拥有的那种支配力，让我很不舒服。

o.en: I won't help or hinder you. I've got my own business to see to.
o.zh: 我不帮你，也不拦你。我自己还有事要办。

o.en: I will make no agreement without speaking to Horus Yaribay.
o.zh: 不先跟 Horus Yaribay 谈，我不会达成任何协议。

entries.en:
"Philip's ideology was the half-baked musing of an amateur historian," she whisks a hand, dismissive. "The appeal is all aesthetics."

"Achilles looks good in uniform. He'll co-opt the legacy of his clone-father with ease."
entries.zh:
"Philip 的意识形态，不过是个业余历史学者的半吊子玄想。\"她随手一挥，满不在乎。\"它的吸引力全在审美上。"

"Achilles 穿军装好看。他要接手他那克隆父亲的遗产，轻而易举。"

entries.en:
"Philip's ideology was the half-baked musing of an amateur historian," she whisks a hand, dismissive. "The popular appeal is all aesthetics."

Fortuna holds a moment, then gives you a look.

"No offense intended, of course," she says. "Achilles looks good in a uniform. It's all he needs."
entries.zh:
"Philip 的意识形态，不过是个业余历史学者的半吊子玄想。\"她随手一挥，满不在乎。\"它能收拢人心，靠的也全是审美。"

Fortuna 顿了顿，然后看了你一眼。

"当然，无意冒犯。\"她说，\"Achilles 穿军装好看。这就够了。"

entries.en: "That's why I didn't ask the Hegemony for permission."
entries.zh: "所以我才没去求霸主批准。"

entries.en:
"Nothing. And soon it won't matter, because it is already in motion."

"Understand that my telling you," she says, "Is a sign of respect. For your accomplishments, for your judgement."

"Accept my good regard," she says, positively dripping noblesse oblige.
entries.zh:
"什么也拦不住。而且很快就无所谓了，因为它已经在运转。"

"你要明白，我把这些告诉你，\"她说，\"是一种尊重。对你的功绩，对你的判断。"

"收下我的敬意。"她说，那口吻里满是居高临下的施恩意味。

entries.en:
She smiles.

"Yes. When the time is right. We'll speak again before long, I am sure."
entries.zh:
她微微一笑。

"好。等时机成熟。用不了多久我们还会再谈，我确信。"

entries.en:
She smiles. "Yes. When the time is right. We'll speak again before long."

"Perhaps we can get you out from under Reynard's thumb. Contingent on Achilles' success, of course."
entries.zh:
她微微一笑。"好。等时机成熟。用不了多久我们还会再谈。"

"也许我们能把你从 Reynard 的掌心里弄出来。当然，得看 Achilles 成不成事。"

entries.en:
"You deal in absolutes. Ideals with no regard for the world."

She sighs. "You speak like Imoinu."
entries.zh:
"你只讲绝对。只讲理想，不管这世界如何。"

她叹了口气。"你说话像 Imoinu。"

o.en: And you compromise away a legacy of treason, mass killings, and planet-murder.
o.zh: 而你，把叛国、屠杀和屠星换来的那份遗产，拿去做妥协交易。

entries.en: "It is clear we do not see eye to eye." She stands.
entries.zh: "显然我们谈不到一处。"她站起身。

entries.en:
"Your own business," she repeats your words, a touch of frost entering her tone.

She stands.

"Then I too shall mind to my own. See to it that you do not interfere."
entries.zh:
"我自己的事，"她重复着你的话，语气里渗进一丝霜意。

她站起身。

"那我也只管我自己的。你务必别来插手。"

entries.en:
"Your own business," she repeats your words, a touch of frost entering her tone.

She stands.

"Then I shall mind my own. See to it that you, and your spymaster Orcus, mind yours."
entries.zh:
"我自己的事，"她重复着你的话，语气里渗进一丝霜意。

她站起身。

"那我就只管我自己的。你，还有你那间谍头子 Orcus，管好你们的。"

entries.en:
"Your own business," she repeats your words, a touch of frost entering her tone.

She stands.

"Then I shall mind my own. See to it that you, and your bosses at Tri-Tachyon, mind yours."
entries.zh:
"我自己的事，"她重复着你的话，语气里渗进一丝霜意。

她站起身。

"那我就只管我自己的。你，还有你在速子科技的那些上头，管好你们的。"

entries.en:
She nods, keeping her eyes on you.

"I understand. My plans are already in motion and shall provide the best of any alternative. Horus will see that when you speak to him, as I assume you shall."

"Understand that my openness in speaking with you," she says, "Is a sign of respect. For your accomplishments, for your judgement. And for that of Gens Yaribay, even if we do not agree on... every detail."
entries.zh:
她点头，目光始终没有离开你。

"我明白。我的计划已在运转，它会胜过任何替代方案。你去跟 Horus 谈，他会看明白的——我想你总会去谈。"

"你要明白，我这样坦率地同你说话，\"她说，\"是一种尊重。对你的功绩，对你的判断。对 Yaribay 氏族 那一族也是如此，哪怕我们并非在...每个细节上都一致。"

entries.en:
"Accept my good regard," she says, her tone making it clear that her statement is equal to natural law to her mind.

She stands.

"Now I have much to see done. Give Horus my regards."
entries.zh:
"收下我的敬意。"她说，那语气分明表明，在她看来这话等同于自然律。

她站起身。

"眼下我还有太多事要办。替我向 Horus 问好。"

o.en: If I'm meddling, then what is this? You've taken Achilles for your tool.
o.zh: 如果我这叫插手，那你又算什么？你把 Achilles 当成了自己的工具。

o.en: I serve the Persean League. Who is served by making Achilles your tool?
o.zh: 我为英仙座联盟效力。把 Achilles 变成你的工具，又是为谁效力？
我可不是 Reynard 的'走狗'！

o.en: I told Reynard I would vote him out at the first opportunity. Will you help me?
o.zh: 我跟 Reynard 说过，一有机会就把他投下台。你愿意帮我吗？

o.en: Reynard Hannan blackmailed me. I'm not his 'creature'.
o.zh: Reynard Hannan 勒索过我。我不是他的'走狗'。

o.en: Are you working with Finlay Siyavong, from Fleet Intelligence?
o.zh: 你在跟舰队情报部的 Finlay Siyavong 合作吗？

o.en: Does Horus Yaribay know about what you're doing here?
o.zh: Horus Yaribay 知道你在这儿做的事吗？

entries.en:
Her expression closes slightly.

"I see. Of course." She sighs.

"Headstrong, is she not? I fear I was too liberal with Eunomia concerning her upbringing. Hadwin, my consort, always said so. Perhaps he was right."
entries.zh:
她的神情微微收紧。

"我明白了。当然。"她叹了口气。

"性子太拗，是不是？我怕是对 Eunomia 的管教太松了。Hadwin，我的伴侣，一直这么说。也许他是对的。"

o.en: She's going to get herself killed.
o.zh: 她这是要把自己送进死路。

o.en: She is fighting for what she believes.
o.zh: 她在为自己相信的东西而战。

o.en: She is fighting for a righteous cause.
o.zh: 她在为一项正义的事业而战。

entries.en: "Indeed. Imoinu seems to complicate matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
entries.zh: "确实。Imoinu 像是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

entries.en: "I sincerely hope not. Imoinu seems to complicate matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
entries.zh: "我真心希望不至于。Imoinu 像是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

entries.en:
"'What she believes'," Fortuna says scornfully. "As if that ever changed anything."

"Imoinu complicates matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
entries.zh:
"'她相信的东西'，\"Fortuna 轻蔑地说，\"好像那玩意儿什么时候改变过什么。"

"Imoinu 是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

entries.en:
"'A righteous cause'," Fortuna says scornfully. "As if that ever changed anything."

"Imoinu complicates matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
entries.zh:
"'一项正义的事业'，\"Fortuna 轻蔑地说，\"好像那玩意儿什么时候改变过什么。"

"Imoinu 是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

entries.en:
She shakes her head.

"The sooner the question of the Sindrian Diktat is resolved, the sooner she'll come home, where she belongs."
entries.zh:
她摇了摇头。

"辛达强权的问题了结得越早，她就能越早回家，回到她该在的地方。"

entries.en: "You should not encourage her with your 'contributions', captain." Her scolding tone is only half-serious. "You only delay the inevitable."
entries.zh: "你不该用你那些'捐赠'去鼓励她，舰长。\"她这责备的语气只有一半是认真的，\"你只是把不可避免的事往后推。"

o.en: I spoke to Imoinu. Your granddaughter, I believe?
o.zh: 我跟 Imoinu 谈过。我想她是你孙女？

entries.en:
She leaves, gilded silhouette followed by ranks of attendants.

The bartender lets out a sigh. Business this shift is ruined... but the next will be filled with gawkers and rumor-mongers.

You take your leave, followed by your bodyguards.
entries.zh:
她离开了，镀金般的身影后跟着一列随从。

酒保叹了口气。这一班的生意算是毁了...不过下一班会挤满看热闹的和传闲话的。

你带着保镖离开。

entries.en:
"As you wish," she says, conceding absolutely nothing.

"I shall speak as if he shall hear every word, of course."
entries.zh:
"如你所愿，"她说，却一步也没让。

"当然，我说话时会当作他每个字都听得见。"

entries.en: "Temper your enthusiasm, captain," she says calmly. "I have a plan for Reynard."
entries.zh: "收一收你的热情，舰长，\"她平静地说，\"我对 Reynard 有安排。"

entries.en:
"I know of what happened," she says. "And you are his until you're freed."

She holds up a hand, delicately. "We may yet speak of that. Patience."
entries.zh:
"我知道发生了什么，\"她说，\"在你脱身之前，你就是他的人。"

她优雅地抬起一只手。"这事我们以后或许会谈。耐心点。"

entries.en:
"Uncomfortable," she repeats your words, a touch of frost entering her tone.

She stands.

"Achilles is a man grown and can see to his own comfort and compromise, captain. See to it that you mind your own."
entries.zh:
"不舒服，"她重复着你的话，语气里渗进一丝霜意。

她站起身。

"Achilles 已经成年，他的安逸和他的妥协，他自己会照看，舰长。你管好你自己的事。"

entries.en:
Her eyes shift at his name.

"Fleet Intelligence serves the Persean League. And so do I, in my way. That is all that need be said."
entries.zh:
听到这个名字，她的眼神一动。

"舰队情报部效忠英仙座联盟。我也是，以我的方式。该说的就这些。"

o.en: He put me in contact with Achilles. I trust you knew?
o.zh: 他让我跟 Achilles 接上了线。我猜你早就知道？

o.en: I'm working with him on... the situation. I trust you knew?
o.zh: 我在跟他一起处理...这件事。我猜你早就知道？

entries.en: She gives you a level look. Not a topic for discussion, it says.
entries.zh: 她定定地看你一眼。那意思很清楚：这不是可以谈的话题。

entries.en: She nods.
entries.zh: 她点了点头。

"Fleet Intelligence serves the Persean League. And so do I, in my way. That is all that need be said."

"舰队情报部效忠英仙座联盟。我也是，以我的方式。该说的就这些。"

o.zh: 他让我跟 Achilles 接上了线。我猜你早就知道？

entries.en: "Good," she says, then gives you a level look. Not a topic for discussion, it says.
entries.zh: "很好，"她说，然后定定地看你一眼。那意思很清楚：这不是可以谈的话题。

entries.en:
"I see you understand me," she says with a smirk.

"It may be that I am simply extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
entries.zh:
"看来你懂我的意思，"她带着一丝冷笑说。

"也许我不过是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

o.en: I'm sure your goodwill comes with reasonable conditions.
o.zh: 我相信你的善意，附带着合理的条件。

o.en: A sound proposal; I applaud your initiative.
o.zh: 很好的提议，我欣赏你的主动性。

o.en: So he's to be a tool of your ambitions for Gens Kato?
o.zh: 所以他要成为你为 Kato 氏族铺路的工具？

o.en: There is nothing 'natural' about Achilles, or his position you would exploit.
o.zh: Achilles 身上没有一点'天然'可言，你想利用的那个位置也一样。

o.en: Tri-Tachyon's commission allows me to take initiative. As you have with Achilles.
o.zh: 速子科技的委任状允许我自行决断。就像你对 Achilles 做的那样。

entries.en:
"My 'scheme'?" She smirks.

"I'm simply extending my goodwill, my patronage - matronage - to the natural and fitting heir of a neighboring independent polity with an interest in joining the Persean League."
entries.zh:
"我的'算盘'？"她嘴角一挑。

"我只是在向一位邻邦独立政权的天然、合宜的继承人伸出善意、伸出提携——女族长的提携——毕竟那一方有意加入英仙座联盟。"

entries.en:
She leans back slightly.

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interest," she says. "But I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners who gain from my association."

"Favorable trade agreements, knowledge-sharing... and an implicit shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan."
entries.zh:
她稍稍向后靠去。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟自愿联手、又能从与我的合作中获益的伙伴结成同盟，自有其价值。"

"有利的贸易协定、知识共享...还有权力重心不言自明的转移：从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron 挪开。"

entries.en:
She leans back slightly.

"He is what he is believed to be. And I won't deny that I serve my self-interest, but I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners who gain from my association. Favorable trade agreements, knowledge-sharing... and the implicit shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan."
entries.zh:
她稍稍向后靠去。

"他就是人们所认定的那个人。我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，但我看得出，跟自愿联手、又能从与我的合作中获益的伙伴结成同盟，自有其价值。有利的贸易协定、知识共享...还有权力重心不言自明的转移：从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron 挪开。"

"I won't deny that I serve my self-interest," she says. "But I recognize the value in a coalition of willing partners who gain from my association. Favorable trade agreements, knowledge-sharing... and the implicit shift in the balance of power away from Kazeron, presently dominated by Gens Hannan."
entries.zh:
她稍稍向后靠去，神情分明是不认同你的语气。

"我不否认我在为自己的利益行事，\"她说，\"但我看得出，跟自愿联手、又能从与我的合作中获益的伙伴结成同盟，自有其价值。有利的贸易协定、知识共享...还有权力重心不言自明的转移：从目前由 Hannan 氏族把持的 Kazeron 挪开。"
