entries.en:
"So it appears. The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled, attack - sloppy work, shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your Jason Korin. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts; the foundation of civilization itself."

He puts on a look of shallow concern.

"You appear dissatisfied with my information, captain?"
entries.zh:
"看来就是这样。开枪的人接的是一桩正当却办砸了的袭击——手法粗糙，无能得丢人——目标跟你的 Jason Korin 毫无关系。不过是催人还债的老套路，文明本身的基石。"

他摆出一副浅淡的关切神色。

"看来你对我的情报不太满意，舰长？"

entries.en:
"It so appears. The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled hit - sloppy work, shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your baby Andrada. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts, the foundation of civilization itself."

He puts on a look of shallow concern.

"You appear dissatisfied with my information, captain?"
entries.zh:
"看来就是这样。开枪的人接的是一桩正当的活，只是办砸了——手法粗糙，无能得丢人——目标跟你那位 Andrada 宝贝毫无关系。不过是催人还债的老套路，文明本身的基石。"

他摆出一副浅淡的关切神色。

"看来你对我的情报不太满意，舰长？"

entries.en:
"Yes."

$HeOrShe flashes a genuine smile. An alien look.
entries.zh:
"是。"

$HeOrShe 绽出一个真诚的笑。那表情陌生得不像他。

entries.en:
"Is that so?" He looks genuinely intrigued.

"Prove yourself. What is it?"
entries.zh:
"是吗？"他看上去真被勾起了兴趣。

"那就拿出点东西来。是什么？"

o.en: In truth, it's several points which reinforce one another.
o.zh: 实话说，是几点理由，彼此互相支撑。

entries.en: He makes a rolling hand motion - get on with it.
entries.zh: 他抬起手做了个催促的手势——往下说。

o.en: You're an information broker. You must have integrity.
o.zh: 你是情报贩子。信誉总得有。

entries.en:
To sell information at a top price, you explain, his clients must believe that he is trustworthy. And not only that - they must believe that his judgement is solid. Jove himself must know who to trust in order to separate good information from bad. Or he must know precisely how little to trust the untrustworthy to turn bad information into good.

He nods, evidently enjoying your explanation.

You continue: a client attacked in public immediately after meeting with him does not project the image of a trustworthy enterprise. It raises uncomfortable, unprofitable questions. And if the attack was not carried out on his order, it's only worse, because that means a third party sees him as weak. An opportunity to exploit. This would mean that K-O Jove does not have the judgement necessary to handle his own affairs.
entries.zh:
你解释说，要把情报卖出最高价，他的客户就必须相信他可靠。而不止于此——他们还得相信他的判断是稳的。Jove 自己就得知道谁可信，才能从坏情报里挑出好的。又或者，他得非常清楚该少信那些不可信的人几分，才好把坏情报变成好情报。

他点头，显然颇享受你这一番解释。

你接着说：一个刚跟他见过面、就在公开场合被袭击的客户，传达不出任何可靠生意的形象。它会引出些令人不适、也赚不到钱的问题。而如果这场袭击不是他下的令，那就更糟——因为那意味着有第三方视他为软弱。是个可以下手的机会。而这也就意味着，K-O Jove 不具备处理自己事务所需的判断力。

o.en: You see, my problem is your problem.
o.zh: 你看，我的麻烦就是你的麻烦。

entries.en:
"I suppose." Jove watches you carefully.

"What you ask is not trivial. Favors must be called, bribes paid. Qaras is built on relationships and not all are so... trusting... as that between you and I."
entries.zh:
"也许吧。"Jove 仔细看着你。

"你求的不是小事。人情要动用，贿赂要打点。Qaras 是立在一层层关系上的，而这些关系并不都像你我之间这么...信得过..."

o.en: Exactly. When you are indebted to another, your problems become theirs...
o.zh: 正是如此。你欠了别人的时候，你的麻烦也就成了他们的...

entries.en:
You elaborate: if K-O Jove owes some other gang, syndicate, cell, boss, or clade, it ties their interests into alignment. None profits from annihilation of the other. Indeed, when Jove owes a debt of credits or favor, it will profit his creditor when he thrives.

Jove closes his eyes, not shaking his head, no; his subtle smile remains.

"Enough, captain. Enough. If I listen to more of this I'll be a poor man indeed, despite my many interested friends."
entries.zh:
你进一步说：若 K-O Jove 欠着别的帮派、辛迪加、小队、头目或宗族的债，那便把双方的利益捆到了一处。哪一方被彻底铲掉，另一方都无利可图。事实上，当 Jove 欠着一笔星币或人情的债时，他越兴旺，债主就越得利。

Jove 闭上眼睛，没有摇头，没有；那抹浅笑还挂着。

"够了，舰长。够了。再听下去，我就要变成一个穷光蛋了——尽管我有那么多愿意关照我的朋友。"

entries.en:
"I'll make sure no one interferes with your revenge plot. One supposes all of Qaras will be better for it, somehow - I'll hold you to that."

$HeOrShe gives an ironic little salute. "Have fun."
entries.zh:
"我会保证没人来搅你的复仇。想来这么一折腾，Qaras 上下多少会更好些——这话我可记在你账上。"

$HeOrShe 行了个带讥意的小礼。"玩得开心。"

entries.en:
"Right." His hands come together softly.

"I'll have my people have a little look for you. We keep an eye on everything exciting around here - it's as I said. This won't take terribly long."
entries.zh:
"好。"他双手轻轻一合。

"我让我的人替你打听打听。这地方但凡是有点意思的事，我们都盯着——就像我说的。不会花太久。"

o.en: Hold on, you don't even know who Jason Korin is?
o.zh: 等等，你连 Jason Korin 是谁都不知道？

entries.en:
"Why should I?" $heOrShe says with a laugh. "Do you have any idea how many people step off their transport into the dark heart of Qaras each day looking for something, running from something, hiding, using?"

"It's only your interest that's convinced me there's something interesting here, if not amusing. If your 'Jason' matters, my people will find him."
entries.zh:
"我凭什么？"$heOrShe 笑了一声。"你知道每天有多少人从运输船上下来，一头扎进 Qaras 这颗黑暗的心脏？找东西的、躲事的、藏身的、用药的？"

"只凭你这份兴趣，我就信了这里头有点意思——至少不无聊。要是你那位 Jason 真要紧，我的人会找到他。"

o.en: Well you're in for quite a surprise.
Well you're in for quite a surprise.
He is the blood of Philip Andrada, Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的血脉——辛达强权的最高元首。

entries.en: "Oh?" He looks attentive. "Do tell."
entries.zh: "哦？\"他来了兴致。\"说来听听。"

entries.en:
"Ha!" $HeOrShe claps. "I applaud a reversal! I shall wait."

With an ironic shake of his head, $heOrShe fingers fly over a TriPad interface.
entries.zh:
"哈！\"$HeOrShe 鼓起掌来。\"我最爱这种出人意料的转折！那我就等着。"

$heOrShe 带着几分自嘲地摇了摇头，手指在 TriPad 界面上飞快地划过。

entries.en:
"Ha!" $HeOrShe claps. "I applaud a reversal! I shall wait."

With an ironic shake of his head, $heOrShe whispers into a comms unit, eyes still watching you.
entries.zh:
"哈！\"$HeOrShe 鼓起掌来。\"我最爱这种出人意料的转折！那我就等着。"

$heOrShe 带着几分自嘲地摇了摇头，对着通讯器低语几句，眼睛始终没离开你。

entries.en:
For a moment, Jove appears to be at an uncharacteristic loss for words.

Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." He says the name carefully, like holding an armed grenade. "Fascinating. Gone a bit rogue, you say?"

An unsteady grin, then he whispers something into his wrist-comms.
entries.zh:
有那么一瞬，Jove 罕见地像是无话可说。

当然，只一瞬。

"Andrada。\"这名字他说得极小心，像捧着一枚拔了保险的手雷。\"有意思。你是说，有点脱了缰？"

他咧嘴一笑，笑意不太稳，随即对着腕上的通讯器低声说了几句。

entries.en:
For a moment, Jove appears to be at a loss for words, his look perplexed.

Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." He does a double-glance at you, seeing how you react to hear him say the name. And he says it carefully, like holding an armed grenade.

"Fascinating. Gone a bit rogue, it seems?"

An unsteady grin, then he whispers something into his wrist-comms.
entries.zh:
有那么一瞬，Jove 像是找不出话来，满脸困惑。

当然，只一瞬。

"Andrada。"他朝你连看了两眼，想看出你听到这名字时的反应。这名字他说得极小心，像捧着一枚拔了保险的手雷。

"有意思。看来是有点脱了缰？"

他咧嘴一笑，笑意不太稳，随即对着腕上的通讯器低声说了几句。

o.en: No. You seem like a man who appreciates anticipation.

"No credits. I will help you because of my admiration for your bold deed."

"You're $playerName." He speaks past your question.

A strange expression comes over $hisOrHer face. "You did a very naughty thing, a cruel thing, to Kanta's pet clone."

$HisOrHer eyes dart to meet yours. "It was a beautiful execution. She's not so invincible, is she, Queen Jorien."
entries.zh:
"你是 $playerName。"他没接你的问题。

一种古怪的神情掠过 $hisOrHer 的脸。"你对 Kanta 养的那只克隆体做了件很坏、很残忍的事。"

$HisOrHer 的目光一挑，对上你的眼睛。"那是一场漂亮的处决。她也没那么不可战胜，对吧，Jorien 女王。"

o.en: It was a mistake made in a moment of crisis.

o.en: It's nice to meet a fan of my work.

entries.zh: "别这么害臊。\" $heOrShe 责备道。\"那是一记神来之举。"

entries.en:
"Don't play-act weakness to me," his voice suddenly acid. "It was an inspired act. Possess it, and accept my highest praise."

He closes his eyes, taking a deep breath, then resettles his composure.
entries.zh:
"别在我面前装软弱。\"他的声音骤然转酸。\"那是一记神来之举。认下它，接受我最高的赞誉。"

他闭上眼，深吸一口气，重新整好仪态。

entries.en: He puts his hands together and appears to nod respectfully toward you. It's an uncomfortable but seemingly heartfelt concession.
entries.zh: 他双手合拢，像是郑重地朝你点头致意。这份让步叫人不太舒服，却看上去出自真心。

entries.en:
"Oh." He seems taken a little aback. "I see."

"I give praise to your inspired act." He puts his hands together in an impression of piety and appears to nod respectfully toward you.
entries.zh:
"哦。\"他似乎有些意外。\"我明白了。"

"我为你的神来之举献上赞誉。"他双手合拢，做出一副虔诚的样子，像是郑重地朝你点头。

o.en: We were speaking of Jason Korin. Do you know where I can find him?
o.zh: 我们刚才在说 Jason Korin。你知道哪儿能找到他吗？

entries.en:
The smile hardens.

"You need to learn to take pleasure in this business, captain. You'll find precious little happiness in the dead of space."

He pauses.

"Make it worth my time to give you the man you seek."
entries.zh:
笑意凝住了。

"你得学会从这门生意里尝出点滋味，舰长。在深空里，你能找到的快乐少得可怜。"

他顿了顿。

"想让我交出你要找的人，就拿出点东西来，让我觉得这时间花得值。"

entries.en:
He leans toward you.

"No."

The hint of a smile flares for a moment.

"15,000 credits, however, would demonstrate your commitment to my thorough and thoughtful response."
entries.zh:
他朝你俯身过来。

"不。"

一丝笑意一闪即灭。

"不过，15,000 星币足以表明你确实希望我认真、周到地作答。"

"He's dead."

He releases the TriPad so it drops with a clatter.
entries.zh:
Jove 手里拿着一块 TriPad，看了你一会儿，却始终没看它。

"他死了。"

他松开手，TriPad 啪嗒一声落在地上。

entries.en: "A common enough problem, isn't it?"

o.en: How, why? Was it a targeted killing?
o.zh: 怎么死的，为什么？是定点清除？

o.en: I'm going to need more information than that.
o.zh: 这点东西不够，我需要更多。

"And I'm forced to admit this comes as something of a relief. More Andradas causing trouble?"

$HeOrShe frowns. "You must understand, there is a scale of imagination - no, let us call it 'ambition' - which produces inconvenient outcomes for... innovators and free-thinkers."
entries.zh:
"而我不得不承认，这消息多少让我松了口气。又有一位 Andrada 出来惹麻烦了？"

$HeOrShe 皱起眉。"你得明白，想象力是有量级的——不，还是叫它【野心】吧——到了某个量级，就会给...创新者和自由思想者带来些不便的后果。"

entries.en:
"See, it's funny. Your Jason was a fractious specimen." $HeOrShe eyes the TriPad but does not yet retrieve it.

"In his time on Qaras he scuffled with low-level distributors, contacted aspiring revolutionaries, exploded - figuratively, mind - a prospective 'romantic' encounter, and had to be reminded of 'local custom' by a section enforcer..."

"And yet, I do not detect in any of these frictive events the seed of a killing grudge. Perhaps he encountered the wrong place, the wrong time, the wrong gang. And that's why he caught a stray shot. An accident of circumstance, a quirk of fate."

$HeOrShe shrugs mildly. "He's attrition, in the end. A statistic."
entries.zh:
"你看，有意思的地方就在这儿。你那个 Jason 是个不安分的样本。"$HeOrShe 瞥了眼地上的 TriPad，却没有去捡。

"他在 Qaras 这段时间，跟底层分销商动过手，接触过几个想闹革命的年轻人，还——比喻意义上——炸掉了一场本该成的姻缘，最后得靠片区执法员提醒他什么叫本地规矩..."

"可这些磕磕碰碰里，我看不出哪一件埋着杀机的种子。也许他只是撞上了错的地方、错的时间、错的帮派。于是一发流弹找上了他。时势的意外，命运的捉弄。"

$HeOrShe 无所谓地耸了耸肩。"说到底，他只是损耗。一个数字。"

o.zh: 你是说他是被枪打死的？

o.en: Are you incapable of giving a straight answer?"
o.zh: 你就不能给个痛快的回答？

entries.en:

Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." $HeOrShe seems unsettled, despite his affect. "Fascinating."

"I daresay, for an Andrada such a quick death was a mercy. I don't say this out of personal hatred, mind. Just a realist."

$PersonName leans back, as if bored.

"Now I believe we're finished here." That smile again. "For now."

$HeOrShe 终于哑口无言。

当然，不会太久。

"要我说，对一位 Andrada 而言，死得这么快反倒是种仁慈。这话不是出于私怨，我不过是个现实主义者。"

$PersonName 向后一靠，像是在犯困。

"现在，我想我们这边谈完了。\"又是那个笑。\"暂时。"

"One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate. All else is madness."

His tone darkens. "And for an Andrada? That death was a mercy." Jove leans back, as if bored.

"If you're unsatisfied with what I could provide with what I was given, then the loss is on you. Now I believe we're finished here." The smile again. "For now."

"人会慢慢学会接受命运那只反复无常的手。除此之外都是疯念。"

他的语气沉了下来。"而放在一位 Andrada 身上？那样的死是种仁慈。"Jove 向后一靠，像是在犯困。

"如果凭我手上这些还满足不了你，那损失算你的。现在，我想我们这边谈完了。\"又是那个笑。\"暂时。"

"That's another funny thing. Your Jason doesn't seem important at all."

$HeOrShe narrows $hisOrHer eyes. "I believe you're holding back, captain."

"If you're unsatisfied with what I could provide with what I was given, then that disappointment is on you."

Jove leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
entries.zh:
"还有件有意思的事。你那个 Jason，看着一点也不重要。"

$HeOrShe 眯起 $hisOrHer 的双眼。"我觉得你有所保留，舰长。"

"如果凭我手上这些还满足不了你，那这份失望得你自己兜着。"

Then leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 皱起眉，一副通情达理的样子。"人会慢慢学会接受命运那只反复无常的手。除此之外都是疯念。"

然后向后一靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe nods, frowning reasonably. "Tragic," $heOrShe says. Then $hisOrHer tone darkens, "But for an Andrada, that death was a mercy."

Then leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 点点头，眉头皱着，显得很讲道理。"真惨。"$heOrShe 说。随后 $hisOrHer 的语气沉了下来，"但对一位 Andrada 来说，那样的死是种仁慈。"

然后向后一靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

entries.en: Silver-eyes appears, apparently unbidden.
entries.zh: 银眼女人现身了，仿佛不请自来。

o.en: Jason Korin is a clone of Philip Andrada. His death can't be an accident.
o.zh: Jason Korin 是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。他的死不可能是意外。

o.en: Someone that important to so many doesn't just die.
o.zh: 对这么多人来说这么要紧的一个人，不会就这么死了。

o.en: I believe you. Accidents happen all the time.
I believe you. Accidents happen all the time. (lie)
o.zh: 我信你。意外天天都有。 (说谎)

entries.en: Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. It was a senseless death on a violent world, if the criminal is to be believed.
entries.zh: Jason Korin，Andrada 的继承人，死了。如果那个罪犯的话可信，这不过是这座暴戾星球上一场毫无意义的死亡。

entries.en:
You step from the hidden lounge into the echelon of dark curtains, a velvety black like deep space. The air is close and warm, like a vacsuit with a bad atmo regulator.

Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. It was a senseless death on a violent world, if the criminal is to be believed.
entries.zh:
你从隐秘的休息室走出来，穿过层层叠叠的黑色帘幕——那黑如天鹅绒，像深空本身。空气闷热，像一件大气调节器坏掉的太空服。

Jason Korin，Andrada 的继承人，死了。如果那个罪犯的话可信，这不过是这座暴戾星球上一场毫无意义的死亡。

entries.en:
The pirate drops $hisOrHer attention from you as if you were a piece of furniture and returns $hisOrHer attention to a quiet holo of what looks to be some sort of bloodsport.

The augmented goon emerges from the shadows to escort you back to the bar.
entries.zh:
那海盗把 $hisOrHer 的注意力从你身上挪开，仿佛你只是件家具，转而回到 $hisOrHer 面前那幅安静的全息影像上——看上去像某种血腥格斗。

那个改造过的打手从阴影里走出来，送你回酒吧。

entries.en: "Pity I find in you a sad morsel." He turns his head away, as if in disgust. "A 'fellow corsair'. Don't bore me. Above all, not that."
entries.zh: "可惜我在你身上只找到一块可怜的碎屑。\"他别过头去，像是嫌恶。\"'同道的私掠船长'。别让我厌烦。尤其是这一句。"

entries.en:
"I suppose. For a," he raises a skeptical eyebrow, "fellow corsair."

A finger is held up. "I'll allow your use of this esteemed badge of dishonor only provisionally, mind."
entries.zh:
"我想想。作为一个，\"他怀疑地挑起一边眉毛，\"【同行海盗】。"

他竖起一根手指。"事先说清楚，这枚光荣的耻辱徽章，我只是暂时准许你借用。"

entries.en:
"I should say no... I mean," $heOrShe gives a delicate wave. "Look at you. But."

A sigh, then, "What Kanta wants, Kanta gets. And you," $heOrShe looks at you significantly, "get special treatment."
entries.zh:
"我本该说不...我是说，\"$heOrShe优雅地摆了摆手。\"看看你这副样子。可是。"

一声叹息，然后："Kanta 想要什么，Kanta 就得到什么。而你，"$heOrShe意味深长地看着你，"得到特别优待。"

o.en: And how are we going to do that?

entries.en:
A pause.

"The fool with the gun wasn't mine, I'll have you know. That was..." the pirate rubs $hisOrHer fingers together in one hand, "artless."
entries.zh:
一段停顿。

"拿枪那个蠢货不是我的人，这你可得听清楚。那手法...\"这个海盗把$hisOrHer的手指并在一起搓了搓，\"毫无章法。"

o.en: So what is this? What are you selling?
o.zh: 那这算什么？你在卖什么？

o.en: We've got off to a poor start. Let call this a new orbit.
o.zh: 我们开头开得不好。就当这是换了一条新轨道吧。

o.en: My guards handled it. Why are you calling?
o.zh: 我的保镖已经处理了。你打来干什么？

o.en: And the goon? Was he your doing?

entries.en:
"Burn bright, as they say."

Jove turns away. "But not too bright," he adds quietly.
entries.zh:
"照他们说的，烧得亮些。"

Jove 转过身去。"但也别太亮。"他轻声补了一句。

entries.en:
He nods slowly, eyes on you. Not quite a bow.

"I appreciate your candor, captain. Those are not cheap words from me."

Thoughts appear to race across Jove's face. "Such a portentous death - Andrada's heir! - here on Qaras. Such a person is not made without many knowing of it. And such a person is not killed without many searching for his killer."

He looks back at you.

"A quick death - a merciful fate for a clone of Andrada. I speak not out of hatred, I'm simply a realist. Few will accept this, of course. Things are going to get interesting around here."
entries.zh:
他缓缓点头，目光没有离开你。算不上鞠躬。

"舰长，我欣赏你的坦率。这话从我嘴里说出来，可不便宜。"

种种念头似乎在 Jove 脸上飞快掠过。"这样一桩预兆重重的死——Andrada 的继承人啊！——就发生在 Qaras。造出这样一个人，不可能瞒过多少人的耳目。而这样一个人被杀，也不可能没有许多人去找凶手。"

他重新看向你。

"死得快——对 Andrada 的克隆体来说，这算是慈悲的结局。我说这话不是出于憎恨，我只是个现实主义者。当然，肯接受这说法的人不会多。这一带要变得有意思了。"

o.en: Good luck. Now I've got a pressing matter to attend to.
o.zh: 祝你好运。现在我还有件急事要办。

o.en: The death of Philip Andrada's heir can't be an accident.
o.zh: Philip Andrada 的继承人，不可能死于意外。

o.en: Don't get comfortable. There are more clones. Or were.
o.zh: 别以为可以松口气。克隆体不止一个。或者曾经不止一个。

entries.en:
"More..."

His expression freezes in a half-amused mask, a shield of detachment not quite fully raised.

Jove looks away, eyes moving rapidly. "Stars and blood, but of course - Andrada would be a fool not to. What does a clone cost to the Supreme Executor? This-"

He looks back at you, evidently deciding not to share his further thoughts on the subject.

"Your generosity is much appreciated," he says after a moment.
entries.zh:
"不止一个..."

他的表情僵在一副半带笑意的面具上，那层疏离的盾牌还没能完全举起来。

Jove 移开视线，眼睛飞快地转动。"星与血啊，可这当然了——换成 Andrada，不这么做才是蠢货。对最高元首来说，一个克隆体值几个钱？这——"

他重新看向你，显然决定不再把这个话题往下说。

"你的慷慨，我很领情。"他顿了顿才说。

entries.en: "One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate." $HeOrShe watches you very carefully. "You accept this very easily."
entries.zh: "人总会学着接受命运那只反复无常的手。\"$HeOrShe极仔细地打量着你。\"而你接受得太轻巧了。"

entries.en:
"One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate." $HeOrShe frowns, looking off somewhere. "Although sometimes it is... assisted."

He sits up, "I have no evidence of this, however. But this is the most interesting thing that's happened on Qaras for some time. There's... work to do."
entries.zh:
"人总会学着接受命运那只反复无常的手。\"$HeOrShe皱起眉，目光投向别处。\"只不过，有时候那只手...是有人在推。"

他坐直了身子。"不过我没有证据。但这是 Qaras 这段时间里最有意思的事。有些...活要干。"

entries.en: He claps his hands together softly. Then speaks, either from memory or reading off a subtle implant.
entries.zh: 他轻轻合掌一拍，然后开口——不知是在凭记忆背诵，还是在读某个植入体的显示。

entries.en: "That botch-job?," he answers with a look of mild disgust. "No. Not my style."
entries.zh: "那桩烂活？\"他答道，脸上带着几分嫌恶。\"不是我。那不合我的风格。"

entries.en:
"It was. And you disappointed me," an edge enters $hisOrHer voice. "And found a rougher example of local hospitality, I'm afraid."

He leans back, casual as a predator.

"You need to learn to accept a friendly offer, captain. You need someone to watch your back. Or just as well," a wave, "Your front."
entries.zh:
"是我。而你让我失望了。\"$hisOrHer声音里添了几分锋利。\"恐怕你也领教了本地待客之道里更粗野的那一面。"

他向后靠去，随意得像一头掠食者。

"舰长，你得学学接受一份好意的提议。你需要有人替你看住背后。或者，也一样，\"他一挥手，\"看住正面。"

entries.en:
"I admire a constructive attitude, captain."

The quirk of his lip, loitering like a dumbfire munition drone, grows into something toothy and smile-like for a moment.

"Perhaps we can make the best of an awkward situation."
entries.zh:
"我欣赏有建设性的态度，舰长。"

他嘴角那一撇，先前像一架盘桓不去的无制导战机，此刻咧开，有一瞬成了带牙的笑。

"也许我们能把这尴尬局面变成点好事。"

entries.en: "You must make time for pleasantries, captain. There's precious little pleasure in the cold of space; we must make our own where it is to be found."
entries.zh: "舰长，寒暄这种事也得腾出时间。太空的寒冷里，可享受的东西少得可怜；哪儿能找到乐趣，我们就得自己在哪儿造出来。"

entries.en: "Hardly," $heOrShe answers with a look of the mildest disgust. "I'm hurt that you would suggest my methods were so unsophisticated."
entries.zh: "差得远。\"$heOrShe答道，脸上一丝极轻的嫌恶。\"你竟说我的手法这么不上台面，这话挺伤我。"

entries.en:
The hint of a smile haunts his lips.

"You certainly have."
entries.zh:
一丝笑意在他唇边徘徊。

"你确实过得挺有意思。"

o.en: In the bar. It was you who sent silver-eyes.
o.zh: 酒吧里。银眼女人是你派来的。

entries.en: $HeOrShe looks aside. "He wasn't mine, by the way. The one who showed you the gun."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe移开目光。"顺带说一句，拿枪给你看的那个不是我的人。"

entries.en: He closes his eyes for a moment. "But that's not why you're here."
entries.zh: 他闭了闭眼。"但你来这儿不是为了这个。"

entries.en:
He places his hands together.

"You came to Qaras looking for Jason Korin." $HisOrHer tone suggests a shift in the conversation.

"And it looks like you're not the only one. I have a proposal: tell me why he's important to you and I'll tell you where he is."

$HeOrShe holds up a finger. "No fibbing." A wink. "I'll know."
entries.zh:
他把双手交叠在一起。

"你来 Qaras，是为找 Jason Korin。"$HisOrHer的语气一变，话题显然转了个方向。

"而且看来盯着他的不止你一个。我提个条件：告诉我他为什么对你重要，我就告诉你他在哪儿。"

$HeOrShe竖起一根手指。"不许编。"他眨了下眼。"我听得出来。"

entries.en:
"Our Jason was a fractious specimen. In his time on Qaras he scuffled with low-level distributors, contacted aspiring revolutionaries, exploded - figuratively, mind - a prospective 'romantic' encounter, and had to be reminded of 'local custom' by a section enforcer."

"And yet, I do not detect in any of these frictive events the seed of a killing grudge. He was in the wrong place at the wrong time with the wrong gang. And that's why he caught a stray shot. An accident of circumstance, a quirk of fate."
entries.zh:
"我们这位 Jason 是个难缠的样本。在 Qaras 这段时间，他跟底层分销商起过冲突，接触过跃跃欲试的革命分子，还搞砸过一次——请注意，是比喻意义上的——一段可能的'风月'，最后还得让一个片区执法员提醒他什么叫做'本地习俗'。"

"然而，从这些摩擦里，我看不出哪一件埋下了杀意的种子。他只是在错误的时间、错误的地点，跟错了帮派。所以他挨了一发流弹。环境造成的意外，命运的怪癖。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe shrugs. "He's attrition, in the end. A statistic."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe耸耸肩。"说到底，他不过是损耗。一个数字。"

o.en: You're telling me he was the victim of a random shooting?
o.zh: 你是说，他死于一场随机的枪击？

entries.en:
"So it appears." $HeOrShe shrugs. "The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled hit - sloppy work; shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your Jason Korin. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts, the foundation of civilization itself."

"Are you dissatisfied with my information? I assure you, my people were thorough." Jove examines you through the link. "You know something I do not, of course. I can only help you as much as you let me."
entries.zh:
"看来如此。\"$HeOrShe耸耸肩。\"枪手当时在办一桩合法但办砸了的清除——活干得马虎，无能得丢人——目标跟你的 Jason Korin 毫无关系。不过是催人老实还债的例行差事，而还债正是文明的根基。"

"你对我的情报不满意？我向你保证，我的人查得很彻底。\"Jove 隔着通讯打量你。\"当然，你知道一些我不知道的事。你能让我帮到多少，全看你自己。"

o.en: I'm satisfied. Accidents happen all the time.
I'm satisfied. And I have pressing business to deal with.
o.zh: 我满意。而且我还有急事要办。

o.en: He was a clone of Philip Andrada. He was on the run.
o.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。他当时在逃亡。

entries.en:
"So it appears." $HeOrShe shrugs. "The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled hit - sloppy work; shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your baby Andrada. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts, the foundation of civilization itself."

"Are you dissatisfied?" Jove puts on a look of concern. "I assure you, my people were thorough. I must concede, however, the feeling that such a portentous death - Andrada's heir! - ought to have meant more to the world."
entries.zh:
"看来如此。\"$HeOrShe耸耸肩。\"枪手当时在办一桩合法但办砸了的清除——活干得马虎，无能得丢人——目标跟你那位宝贝 Andrada 毫无关系。不过是催人老实还债的例行差事，而还债正是文明的根基。"

"你不满意？\"Jove 摆出一副关切的样子。\"我向你保证，我的人查得很彻底。不过我得承认，我总觉得这么一桩预兆重重的死——Andrada 的继承人啊！——本该在世上留下更大的回响。"

o.en: The death of Philip Andrada's heir can't be an accident.
o.zh: Philip Andrada 的继承人，不可能死于意外。

o.en: Don't get too comfortable. There are more of them.
o.zh: 别太放心。他们还有更多。

entries.en:
"One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate." $HeOrShe frowns, looking off somewhere. "Although sometimes it is... assisted."

He sits up, "I have no evidence of this, however. But this is the most interesting thing that's happened on Qaras for some time. There's... work to do."
entries.zh:
"人总会学着接受命运那只反复无常的手。\"$HeOrShe皱起眉，目光投向别处。\"只不过，有时候那只手...是有人在推。"

他坐直了身子。"不过我没有证据。但这是 Qaras 这段时间里最有意思的事。有些...活要干。"

entries.en:
"Now," he smirks. "I suppose you've got that hired gun's boss to track down and beat some information out of."

"Don't worry a bit about deploying a few marines down here," $heOrShe gives a little wave, a mockery of Luddic sacrament. "I give you my blessing in light of the attack on your person. The 'authorities' will turn a blind eye."
entries.zh:
"那么，\"他勾起嘴角。\"我猜你还有个雇佣枪手的老大要去追，揍出点情报来。"

"往这儿派几个陆战队，你完全不必顾虑，\"$heOrShe 摆了摆手，那动作是对卢德圣礼的戏仿。\"既然有人在你身上动了手，我就赐你一份祝福。'当局'会睁一只眼闭一只眼。"

entries.en:
He smirks. "I suppose you've got that hired gun's boss to track down and beat some information out of."

"Don't worry a bit about deploying a few marines down here," he gives a little wave, a mockery of Luddic sacrament. "I give you my blessing in light of the attack on your person. The 'authorities' will turn a blind eye."
entries.zh:
他勾起嘴角。"我猜你还有个雇佣枪手的老大要去追，揍出点情报来。"

"往这儿派几个陆战队，你完全不必顾虑，\"他摆了摆手，那动作是对卢德圣礼的戏仿。\"既然有人在你身上动了手，我就赐你一份祝福。'当局'会睁一只眼闭一只眼。"

o.en: He's a clone of Philip Andrada. He fled from... his minders.
o.zh: 他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。他从...他的看护者手里逃了出来。

o.en: I don't wish to reveal that information.

entries.en:
Jove is at a loss for words. Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." $HeOrShe looks unsettled, despite $hisOrHer affect. "I see it now. Fascinating."

"For an Andrada, that death was a mercy. I don't say this out of personal hatred, mind; I'm a realist." He raises $hisOrHer eyebrows. "You heard correctly: Jason is dead. Allow me to elaborate."
entries.zh:
Jove 一时说不出话。当然，也就那么一瞬。

"Andrada。\"$HeOrShe神色有些不安，尽管$hisOrHer仍端着那副姿态。\"现在我看清了。真有意思。"

"对一位 Andrada 来说，那样的死算是慈悲了。别误会，我说这话不是出于私怨；我是个现实主义者。\"$hisOrHer挑起眉毛。\"你没听错：Jason 死了。让我细说。"

o.en: I've already got a lead. You're negotiating from weakness.
o.zh: 我已经有线索了。你这是在弱势谈条件。

entries.en:
"You think that corridor-gang knew what they were asking?" $HeOrShe leans close, a feral look growing. "They're rubes. Muscle for bullying civilians. Meat for the slaughter."

"I offer you a glittering gift. Don't reject me again."
entries.zh:
"你觉得那帮混走廊的知道自己在问什么吗？\"$HeOrShe凑近了些，眼里的野性一点点涨起来。\"他们是些乡巴佬。给人当打手、欺负平民。就是待宰的肉。"

"我给你的是一份闪光的礼物。别再拒绝我。"

o.en: I'll pay you 10,000 credits to just tell me.
o.zh: 我付你 10,000 星币，你直接告诉我。

o.en: Fine. 15,000 credits for information on Jason Korin.
o.zh: 行。15,000 星币，买 Jason Korin 的情报。

o.en: Fine. 15,000 credits for information on Jason Korin.
o.zh: 行。15,000 星币，买 Jason Korin 的情报。

entries.en: "Boring. But I do have my duty to turn a profit." $HeOrShe sighs. "Let's make it 15,000."
entries.zh: "无趣。不过赚钱是我的本分。\"$HeOrShe叹了口气。\"那就 15,000。"

entries.en: Jove nods with a tiny smile that seems a little more satisfied than proper based on his apparent disdain for your credits.
entries.zh: Jove 点了点头，微微笑了笑。他那副看不上你这些星币的样子，跟这个笑里的满足感颇不相称。

entries.en: "No." He crosses his arms.
entries.zh: "不行。"他抱起双臂。

entries.en: His eyes go up as he gives a little shrug.
entries.zh: 他眼睛一抬，轻轻耸了耸肩。

o.en: I don't make deals with criminals.
I don't deal with criminals. Nor can I trust them.
o.zh: 我不跟罪犯打交道，也没法信他们。

entries.en:
He tilts his head. "How can I be a criminal if there is no law?"

"Come now, captain. Don't hide behind abstractions."
entries.zh:
他偏了偏头。"没有法律，我又怎么会是罪犯？"

"得了，舰长。别躲在抽象概念后头。"

o.en: As a fellow corsair, haven't I earned a bit of goodwill?
o.zh: 同为私掠船长，我总该挣得几分情面吧？

entries.en:
He places his hands together.

"You came to Qaras looking for Jason Korin." $HisOrHer tone suggests a shift in the conversation.

"And it looks like you're not the only one. I want to help you, and I will. And I have a request: I'd like to know why he's important to you."

$HeOrShe holds up a finger. "I'll respect your wishes if you don't want to tell. It will leave me ever so curious, so hungry, but," he winks. "I'm sure I'll discover the truth soon enough."
entries.zh:
他把双手交叠在一起。

"你来 Qaras，是为找 Jason Korin。"$HisOrHer的语气一变，话题显然转了个方向。

"而且看来盯着他的不止你一个。我想帮你，也会帮。我只有一个请求：我想知道他为什么对你重要。"

$HeOrShe竖起一根手指。"你若不愿说，我尊重你的意思。那会让我好奇得要命、馋得发慌，不过，"他眨了眨眼。"我确信，用不了多久我自己就能查出真相。"

entries.en: Jove gives you a sad look, and lets out a breath. "I respect your decision."
entries.zh: Jove 带着惋惜看了你一眼，吐出一口气。"我尊重你的决定。"

entries.en:
The image stabilizes.

"Intriguing," he says quietly, examining you like he is contemplating a purchase.

"I am called K-O Jove. Qaras is my interest. When interesting things happen here, they become my business."
entries.zh:
影像稳定下来。

"有意思。"他轻声说，打量你的样子像在盘算一桩买卖。

"人们叫我 K-O Jove。Qaras 是我的地盘。这里一旦发生有意思的事，就成了我的事。"

o.en: Was that your goon who pulled a weapon on me?
o.zh: 刚才拿枪顶着我那个，是你的人？

o.en: Was it you in the bar who sent silver-eyes?
o.zh: 酒吧里那个银眼女人，是你派来的？

o.en: Well I've certainly had an interesting time on Qaras.
o.zh: 我在 Qaras 确实过得挺有意思。

entries.en:
The image stabilizes.

"Perhaps in light of recent events," K-O Jove says quietly, "You'll reconsider my offer."
entries.zh:
影像稳定下来。

"也许鉴于最近这些事，\"K-O Jove 轻声说，\"你会重新考虑我的提议。"

o.en: Was that your goon who pulled a weapon on me?
o.zh: 刚才拿枪顶着我那个，是你的人？

o.en: Well I've certainly had an interesting time on Qaras.
o.zh: 我在 Qaras 确实过得挺有意思。

entries.en:
Jove looks, if anything, both surprised and offended. His mouth hangs slightly open as you cut the comms.

He's clearly working some self-interested angle.

And you've got a lead to follow: the goon's boss, the gang leader who was paid by an Askonian to rough you up.
entries.zh:
真要说的话，Jove 看上去既吃惊又觉得受了冒犯。你切断通讯时，他的嘴还微微张着。

他显然在打自己的算盘。

而你手上还有条线索要追：那个打手的老大，那个被某个 Askonia 人出钱雇来教训你的帮派头目。

entries.en: You stare at the blackness of the blank comms interface. Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. It was a senseless death on a violent world, if the pirate is to be believed.
entries.zh: 你盯着通讯界面熄灭后的一片漆黑。Jason Korin，Andrada 的继承人，死了。若那海盗的话可信，这不过是暴力世界上一场毫无意义的死。

entries.en:
The raid hinges on maintaining chaos in the opposition. Feints are initiated along multiple axes, from infiltration squads to seeming external attacks against the Qaras metroplex. All bear different IFF codes or the signs and sigils of local organization's crews in order to maximize confusion.

The EM comms explode with panic and rumor. Your own $shipOrFleet's electronic warfare efforts only add to the operational turmoil.

No one knows if this is an internal coup gone hot, a black-ops strike from an external power, or simply a new pirate warlord attempting to sign their name alongside Leonis and Loke in one bold, swift conquest of the largest 'free' pirate-aligned world.
entries.zh:
这次突袭全看能否让对手一直处在混乱里。佯动沿多条轴线同时展开，从渗透小队到看似针对 Qaras 主城区的外部突袭。所有单位都打着不同的 IFF 识别码，或者本地组织自己船员的标记与徽记，让混乱尽量大。

电磁通讯里炸开一片恐慌与传言。你自己那支 $shipOrFleet 的电子战搅扰，又把局势推得更乱。

没人分得清这到底是一场走火的内部政变、某个外部势力的黑箱打击，还是某个新起的海盗军阀想凭一次大胆而迅疾的征服，把自己的名字与 Leonis、Loke 并列刻在这颗最大的'自由'海盗世界之上。

entries.en:
You watch as the point-squad approaches its ingress through ancient terraforming infrastructure, a trench of roughly fused rock melted from orbit to channel what was once a vast river. The channel was built over and largely forgotten.

The target gang has fortified their compound and deployed unusually heavy anti-armor weapons due to the general alarm. To no avail, however - breaching-charges crumble the floor beneath their weapon-positions and darkly carapaced marines rise from the smoke and darkness below like demons of the underworld.
entries.zh:
你看着尖兵小队向入口靠近——那是穿过古老地球化改造设施的一处缺口，一条从轨道上熔出来的、粗糙熔结的岩沟，当年用来给一条大得惊人的河流改道。后来沟上盖了东西，也就大半被忘了。

目标帮派已经把据点加固，又因全城警戒而搬出了异常沉重的反装甲武器。然而毫无用处——破门炸药炸塌了他们火力点下方的地面，一队身着深色甲壳的陆战队员从下方的烟与暗里升起，像地底的恶魔。

entries.en:
You convene your officers to discuss how to breach the defenses of Qaras in order to obtain intel from a minor gang leader.

The target gang is lightly armed and you have reasonable intel about their defenses and capabilities. The problem is the loose alliance of heavily armed groups pledged to defend Qaras from unauthorized incursions by outsiders - like yourself. Even the civilian population is notoriously well-armed, with more than its fair share of pirates, criminals, and deserters.

The decentralized nature of the opposition is a weakness and a strength. While they will have difficulty coordinating their efforts, there is no central command to target, no one tactical mode to anticipate and counter. The key will be not to defeat the enemy - that would require nightmarish protracted subsurface urban combat - but to sow confusion between various armed bodies so that the objective may be achieved by rapid, targeted infiltration.
entries.zh:
你召集军官们，商议如何破开 Qaras 的防线，好从一个小帮派头目嘴里挖出情报。

目标帮派装备轻，你对他们的防御与战力也有相当可靠的了解。问题在于那批重武装团伙结成的松散同盟，他们发誓要把任何未经许可的外来入侵挡在 Qaras 外面——而你正是那种外来者。连平民的武装程度都出了名的扎实，其中海盗、罪犯、逃兵的比例远高于常理。

对手分散，这既是弱点也是长处。他们各干各的，难以协同；可也没有中枢可以一击，没有一套统一的战术模式可供预判和反制。关键在于不要以击溃敌军为目标——那意味着要在深层城区里打一场噩梦般的持久巷战——而是在各支武装之间散播混乱，好让目标靠一次快速、精准的渗透达成。

entries.en: "Never heard of 'em," $heOrShe says without hesitation.
entries.zh: "没听过这号人。" $heOrShe 毫不迟疑地说。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe makes a thinking-face.

"Nope, don't know 'em," $heOrShe says after a moment.
OR
$HeOrShe considers for a moment. "I don't recognize the name, $playerSirOrMadam."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 摆出一副思索的表情。

"不认识这号人。" $heOrShe 过了片刻才说。
OR
$HeOrShe 斟酌片刻。"这个名字我没听过，$playerSirOrMadam。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe doesn't even blink. "Do I look like a comm directory?"

"Got work to do, cappy. That all?"
OR
$HeOrShe thinks for a moment. "Don't know one of those."
OR
"Never heard of 'em," $heOrShe says without hesitation.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 连眼都不眨。"我看起来像通讯名录吗？"

"我还有活要干，船长。就这些？"
OR
$HeOrShe 想了一会儿。"没听说过这号人。"
OR
"没听过这号人。" $heOrShe 毫不迟疑地说。

entries.en:
"Below my paygrade." $HeOrShe doesn't even blink.

"Unless you've got some business to chew, kindly burn off."
entries.zh:
"这不在我的档次里。" $HeOrShe 连眼都不眨。

"除非你有买卖要谈，不然就劳驾滚远点。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe pauses deliberately before answering.

"Might know one by that name. might not. Why?"
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 刻意停顿了一下，才开口。

"也许认识一个叫这名字的。也许不认识。问这个做什么？"

o.en: Can he be trusted? Is his information good?
o.zh: 他靠得住吗？他的消息准吗？

o.en: Why's he called 'K-O?' It's a strange name.
o.zh: 为什么叫他 K-O？这名字挺怪。

entries.en: $HeOrShe gives an unenthusiastic nod of acknowledgement.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe 提不起兴致地点了下头，算是知道了。

entries.en:
"K-O." $HeOrShe repeats the name. "I always assumed it meant 'knockout'. From a bar fight, you know?"
OR
"Is it?" $HeOrShe looks genuinely confused. "People go by initials from time to time."

"It's a strange question, don't you think?" $HeOrShe looks satisfied to have turned this around on you.
OR
"Never asked." $HeOrShe shrugs. "Seemed like it'd be rude. People call themselves all sorts of things."
OR
"This is Qaras," $heOrShe says, matter-of-fact. "People come here all the time and find a new name, new face. New all sorts of things. I don't make it my business to find out if they're not volunteering why. We all got a past."

"Some more than others," $heOrShe says, giving you a significant look.
entries.zh:
"K-O。\" $HeOrShe 把这个名字重复了一遍。\"我一直以为那是【击倒】的意思。酒吧斗殴里那种，你懂吧？"
OR
"是吗？\" $HeOrShe 看上去真的糊涂了。\"用缩写当名字的人时不时也有。"

"这问题挺怪，你不觉得吗？" $HeOrShe 把话头反推回你身上，显得颇为得意。
OR
"没问过。\" $HeOrShe 耸肩。\"问了显得没礼貌。人给自己起的名字五花八门。"
OR
"这里是 Qaras。\" $heOrShe 说得平平淡淡。\"总有人来这儿，换一个新名字、一张新面孔。新的什么都有。人家不主动说，我就不去打听。谁都有过去。"

"有些人的过去比别人的多。" $heOrShe 意味深长地看了你一眼。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks at you for a long moment.

"Those are very different questions when it comes to Jove." $HeOrShe looks down. "That's all I'll say about that."
OR
"I suppose as much as anyone around here," $heOrShe says with a grin. "Do you trust me?"

"Don't answer that. Don't care to know."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 久久地看着你。

"问到 Jove 头上，这两个问题可就差得太远了。\" $HeOrShe 垂下目光。\"这件事我只说这么多。"
OR
"大概跟这一带任何人一样靠得住。\" $heOrShe 咧嘴一笑。\"你信我吗？"

"别回答。我也不想知道。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe sighs. "I'd love to take your money, captain, but I'd have to give you the same answer - I don't know any whatever-his-name-is."

"Then you'd be angry that I took your money. And I make it a policy not to make enemies who have their own $shipOrFleet."

$HeOrShe leans forward, "Don't take that the wrong way - this is Qaras, we don't bow to outsiders here, ships or no. But I've got ongoing concerns that aren't you and I'm content to keep it that way."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 叹了口气。"我很想收下你的钱，船长，可我还是那句话——我并不认识什么这个那个名字的人。"

"那样你会为我白收了你的钱而恼火。而我的原则是不跟名下有 $shipOrFleet 的人结仇。"

$HeOrShe 俯身向前。"别往歪处想——这里是 Qaras，我们不对着外人低头，有没有舰船都一样。不过我眼下的麻烦不是你，我也乐意让它保持这样。"

entries.en:
"I don't have that intel," $heOrShe says. "Credits won't change that."

$HeOrShe pauses, then says, "You might recon the spacer bars off the portside concourse."
OR
"Negative," $heOrShe says. "Might be I could lie, but I don't need more enemies."

The pirate almost smiles. "Got a full deck of 'em already, thank you and over."
entries.zh:
"我没有那份情报。\" $heOrShe 说。\"星币也改不了这一点。"

$HeOrShe 顿了顿，然后说："你可以去左舷走廊外那几家太空人酒吧探探。"
OR
"不行。\" $heOrShe 说。\"我大可以骗你，可我不需要再多几个敌人。"

那海盗几乎笑了一下。"我手里敌人的牌早就满手了，谢了，通话结束。"

entries.en:
"Look now, you won't like if I took your credits for nothing. I've a policy to don't make blood with anyone who owns their own $shipOrFleet unless there's real good reason."
OR
$HeOrShe shrugs. "Would love to take the credits, cap, but you'd still get nothing."
entries.zh:
"你听好，我要是白拿了你的星币，你也不会高兴。我的规矩是：除非真有十足的理由，不跟任何名下有 $shipOrFleet 的人结血仇。"
OR
$HeOrShe 耸了耸肩。"我巴不得收下这笔星币，船长，可你还是什么都问不出来。"

entries.en:
"Don't take it wrong," $heOrShe says almost apologetically.

"We're Qaras. Qaras don't bow in the dirt to outsiders, warships or no, and that ain't changing. But I've got concerns that ain't you and I'm content to keep 'em that way."
OR
"That being said, there's those around that make their business snooping. Might ask one of 'em. They'd be good to ping a runner."

$HeOrShe looks you over. "That's what this is about, right?"
entries.zh:
"别往歪处想。" $heOrShe 说，几乎带着歉意。

"我们是 Qaras 人。Qaras 人不对外人低头伏地，管你有没有战舰，这一点不会变。不过我手头的麻烦不是你，我也乐得让它一直不是你。"
OR
"话虽这么说，这附近有些人专做打探的买卖。你可以去问问他们中的一个。要找人跑腿传话，他们很在行。"

$HeOrShe 上下打量你。"你要的就是这个，对吧？"

o.en: I'm looking for a man named Jason Korin.
o.zh: 我在找一个叫 Jason Korin 的人。

o.en: Maybe 10,000 credits would change your mind?
o.zh: 也许 10,000 星币能让你改主意？
你知道 K-O Jove 吗？

entries.en:
The squad engineer's suit mounts a particularly clever electronic warfare module, a sort of up-gunned remote interfacer that trawls every datacache its whisperers can locate within a limited range. Unshielded civilian tech is particularly vulnerable to automated interrogation.

Your technology officer had a team assembled for the operation on your $shipOrFleet and, eager to show their abilities after the slim pickings of the gang compound, they dive into the task of sorting useful intel from the domestic chaff of an entire Qaras apartment agglomeration.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your tech officer says, suppressing a triumphant look. "We got a comms record of interest."
entries.zh:
小队工程师的动力装甲上装着一具相当精巧的电子战模块，算是一种火力强化的远程接口器，能在有限范围内把它那些窃听程序所及之处的一切数据缓存都翻个遍。没有防护的民用设备尤其经不起这种自动化审讯。

你的技术官在你的 $shipOrFleet 上为这次行动组建了一支小队；他们在帮派据点里收获寥寥，正急着显显本事，于是一头扎进这活儿，要从整个 Qaras 公寓群的家庭杂讯里筛出有用的情报。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，\"你的技术官说道，压着一脸得意，\"我们拿到了一段有意思的通讯记录。"

entries.en:
* * *

The Askonian is obvious by their demeanor, a face which threatens to break into a look of disgust at any moment. The other is K-O Jove, looking as pleased with himself as ever.
entries.zh:
* * *

那个 Askonia 人一看神态就认得出来，那张脸上随时都像要露出厌恶。另一个是 K-O Jove，还是那副志得意满的老样子。

entries.en:
The timestamp indicates that this conversation was recent - after your own conversation with Jove.

It appears he went digging for further information. And-
entries.zh:
时间戳显示，这段对话就发生在最近 —— 在你和 Jove 谈过之后。

看来他是去挖更深的料了。而且 ——

entries.en:
The timestamp indicates that this conversation was recent. Very recent.

The agent has fled. Or is fleeing, right now.
entries.zh:
时间戳显示，这段对话发生在最近。非常近。

那个代理人已经跑了。又或者，此刻正在跑。

o.en: Navigation. Any recent departures from the surface, or orbit?
o.zh: 导航组。地面或轨道上，最近有谁离开吗？

entries.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam. An unauthorized ship, transponder off, just cut through the parking orbits. Traffic control - well, that's what they claim to be - they've very unhappy, demanding a 'fine'-"
entries.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。一艘没有授权的船，应答器关闭，刚穿过停泊轨道。交管那边 —— 好吧，他们自称是交管 —— 非常不满，嚷着要开【罚单】——"

entries.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam. An unauthorized ship, transponder off, just cut through the parking orbits. Traffic control - well, er, that's what they claim to be - they think it's part of the raid and are calling for it to be shot down. Looking like they're leaving in a hurry."
entries.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。一艘没有授权的船，应答器关闭，刚穿过停泊轨道。交管那边 —— 呃，好吧，他们自称是交管 —— 他们以为这是突袭的一部分，正要求把它打下来。看样子是急着走。"

entries.en:
Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. Shot and killed, if the criminal is to be believed. And not by a Diktat agent. Not this Diktat agent, anyway.

You have no doubt that Macario is capable of arranging countless layers of betrayal and deception.

If you leave now, you might catch the fleeing ship.
entries.zh:
Andrada 的继承人 Jason Korin 死了。照那罪犯的说法，是被人开枪打死的。而且不是辛达强权的代理人干的。至少，不是这个代理人干的。

你毫不怀疑 Macario 有本事布下数不清的背叛与欺骗。

如果你现在就走，也许还能追上那艘正在逃离的船。

entries.en:
This Diktat agent is fleeing with proof - thanks to new discoveries by K-O Jove - that the heir to Andrada is dead.

Was it truly an accident? An agent of the Diktat didn't do it. At least, this agent of the Diktat didn't do it.

If you leave now, you might catch the fleeing ship.
entries.zh:
这名辛达强权代理人正带着证据出逃 —— 那证据来自 K-O Jove 的新发现 —— 表明 Andrada 的继承人已经死了。

真的是意外吗？不是辛达强权的人干的。至少，不是这个辛达强权代理人干的。

如果你现在就走，也许还能追上那艘正在逃离的船。

entries.en:
* * *

With a gentle 'thump' the breaching charge creates an unexpected ingress through what was once a wall.

Your marines stream through the new gap, the remains of a door, and the (now) empty windowframe of the prefab module. Dust and smoke occlude normal vision, but milliradar and sonics build a more than adequate tactical visualization.

Through the view assembled by helmet-cams and battle-drones - the dust slowly clears as atmo systems detect the unhealthy excess particulate - it looks like this place has been evacuated recently, and quickly. Clothing and food containers are strewn about. A half-empty luggage case idles by the sleep-pod.
entries.zh:
* * *

一声轻轻的'砰'，破门炸药从原本是墙的地方炸开了一个意料之外的入口。

陆战队从新开的缺口、残破的门框和预制舱那扇 (如今已空的) 窗框里涌了进去。尘土与浓烟遮蔽了正常视线，但毫米波雷达和声呐足以拼出一幅相当清晰的战术视图。

从头盔摄像机与战斗无人机拼出的画面里 —— 随着大气系统检测到空气中超标的颗粒物，尘雾正慢慢散去 —— 这里看起来刚被撤离过，而且撤得很急。衣物和食品容器散落一地。一只半空的行李箱静静躺在睡眠舱旁。

entries.en:
It is not a real fight.

After a few overwhelming acts of force which lead to minor to moderate injury (and one messy death) on the part of the opposition, the conflict is definitively resolved.

This gang's surviving enforcers have either fled or been subdued by nominally less-than-lethal means.

Their leader is brought before you, a blood-spattered chair set back upright, and he is placed in it by the huge black gauntlets of a power-armored marine.

He's had better days.
entries.zh:
这算不上真正的战斗。

几轮压倒性的武力镇下，对方受了轻度到中度的伤 (还有一人死得很难看)，冲突就此彻底了结。

这个帮派活下来的执法者，要么跑了，要么被一系列名义上算作非致命的手段制服了。

他们的头目被带到你面前。一把溅满血的椅子被扶正，一名身着动力装甲的陆战队员用巨大的黑色护手把他按了进去。

他显然见过好得多的日子。

o.en: I was attacked and threatened by your associate.
o.zh: 我遭到了你同伙的袭击和威胁。

o.en: You were so eager to ask me questions I figured I'd drop by.
o.zh: 你这么急着问我问题，我想着不如亲自上门一趟。

entries.en:
Inside the compound, the fight is already over.

After a few overwhelming acts of force which lead to minor to moderate injuries (and one messy death), the conflict is definitively resolved.

This minor gang's surviving enforcers have either fled or been subdued by various means generally considered to be less-than-lethal.

Their leader is brought to a blood-spattered chair set back upright, and he is placed in it by the huge black gauntlets of a power-armored marine. A portable comms projector is activated.

He looks like he's not had a worse day.
entries.zh:
院子里面，战斗已经结束。

几轮压倒性的武力镇下，对方受了轻度到中度的伤 (还有一人死得很难看)，冲突就此彻底了结。

这个小帮派活下来的执法者，要么跑了，要么被种种通常算作非致命的手段制服了。

他们的头目被带到一把溅满血的椅子前，椅子被扶正，一名身着动力装甲的陆战队员用巨大的黑色护手把他按了进去。一台便携通讯投影仪随即启动。

瞧他那样，怕是没比今天更倒霉的日子了。

o.en: I was assaulted by your associate. Threatened with a deadly weapon.
o.zh: 你的同伙袭击了我。还用致命武器威胁我。

o.en: Why so quiet? You were so eager to ask me questions before.
o.zh: 怎么不吭声了？先前你问问题可问得挺起劲。

entries.en:
He grins desperately.

"You didn't have to go through all the trouble, I- I'm quite satisfied with- And actually I regret- I apologize profusely. I had no idea who you were. Truth!"

He takes a deep breath, assessing if this line of rhetoric is finding traction.

"I was given to think you were a, some kind of... let me make it up to you! The credits I accepted for the job deposit are yours, of course, to cover damages, and to apologize, and..."
entries.zh:
他拼命挤出一个笑。

"你何必闹得这么大，我 —— 我其实很满意 —— 而且我确实后悔 —— 我万分抱歉。我不知道你是谁。真的！"

他深吸一口气，掂量着这套说辞有没有说动你。

"有人让我以为你是、是某种...让我补偿你！我收的那笔活儿定金，当然归你，算作赔偿，也算赔罪，还有..."

entries.en:
* * *

Like his underling before him, he spills everything.

He describes his contact, the agent who paid him to try to rough you up, and every detail he can remember.

Askonian by the accent. Military or intelligence by bearing.
Maybe. A professional, anyway.

He volunteers the location of the apartment-safehouse his people tracked this agent to - in case of the need for 'debt collection', of course.

Debts are taken very seriously on Qaras.
entries.zh:
* * *

和他先前那名手下一样，他什么都招了。

他说出了自己的联络人 —— 那个出钱雇他来找你麻烦的代理人，以及他能想起的每一个细节。

口音是 Askonia 人。举止像军人，或者情报人员。
也许吧。不过总归是个行家。

他主动交代了手下摸到的那个代理人落脚公寓安全屋的位置 —— 当然，是备着日后【收债】之需。

在 Qaras，欠债是件极严肃的事。

o.zh: 去见那名 Askonia 代理人

entries.en:
* * *

Like his goon before him, he spills everything.

He describes his contact, the agent who paid him to try to rough you up, and every detail he can remember.

Askonian by the accent. Military or intelligence by bearing.
Maybe.

He volunteers the location of the apartment-safehouse his people tracked this agent to - just in case of the need for 'debt collection'. They take credits-owing very seriously on Qaras.
entries.zh:
* * *

和他先前那名打手一样，他什么都招了。

他说出了自己的联络人 —— 那个出钱雇他来找你麻烦的代理人，以及他能想起的每一个细节。

口音是 Askonia 人。举止像军人，或者情报人员。
也许吧。

他主动交代了手下摸到的那个代理人落脚公寓安全屋的位置 —— 只当是备着日后【收债】之需。在 Qaras，欠星币是件极严肃的事。

o.zh: 去见那名 Askonia 代理人

o.en: Prepare a 'visit' to the gang leader who ordered a goon to attack you
o.zh: 筹备一次对那个下令让打手袭击你的帮派头目的'拜访'

o.en: Prepare a full raid against the gang that attacked you
o.zh: 筹备一次对袭击你的帮派的全面突袭

entries.en:
Your armorer meets you along with a dozen marines equipped for urban infiltration.

They're more lightly armed and armored than they would be for a full assault, but they have more than enough firepower to take on any minor gang of Qaras.
entries.zh:
你的军械官带着十来个为城区渗透装备好的陆战队员来见你。

他们的武装与装甲都比全面强攻时轻，但火力拿来对付 Qaras 上任何一个小帮派都绰绰有余。

entries.en:
Although your bodyguards are capable, they're not trained or equipped to assault semi-fortified urban strongholds.

You need at least 12 marines to ensure your 'visit' is both safe (for you) and sufficiently persuasive.
entries.zh:
你的卫队虽个个能干，却没有攻打半设防城区据点的训练与装备。

你至少需要 12 名陆战队员，才能保证这次'拜访'既 (对你来说) 安全，也足够有说服力。

entries.en:
You have not received permission from any figure of local influence on Qaras to perform an operation. As an outsider imposing on their home turf, however chaotic, you are likely to set off the defensive alliance of the various gangs, crews, corps, and mercs that protect Qaras from outsiders.

Only a full military raid can overcome them.
entries.zh:
你没有从 Qaras 任何有影响力的角色那里取得行动许可。作为一个闯进他们地盘的外人，无论这地方多乱，你都很可能触发那套防御同盟——各个帮派、船员、公司和雇佣兵组成的、把 Qaras 挡在外人之外的网。

只有一次全面的军事突袭才能压过他们。

entries.en: With the blessing of a local leader of influence, the 'official' enforcers of what passes for order around here should not give you any trouble.
entries.zh: 有了本地一位有影响力的头面人物点头，这地方勉强算作秩序的那批'官方'执法者，应该不会给你添麻烦。

entries.en:
Each party of local enforcers, variously affiliated, stationed at strategic points of the main metroplex of Qaras makes no acknowledgement that a squad of power-armored space marines is marching through their territory.

Some bystanders stare. The wiser flee.

Shopkeepers shut their storefronts with practiced efficiency. They know what to do when a turf war breaks out, and this looks like a serious one.
entries.zh:
驻扎在 Qaras 主城区各个要点上的本地执法者分属各不相同的势力，对一队身着动力装甲的太空陆战队正从自己地盘上走过这件事，全都装作没看见。

有几个旁观者直盯着看。聪明些的已经跑了。

店主们以熟练的效率关上店门。地盘火并起来该怎么办，他们心里清楚；而这一场看着不像闹着玩的。

entries.en:
Groups of local enforcers, variously affiliated, are stationed at strategic points throughout the main metroplex of Qaras. Those you can avoid, you avoid. Those who force a confrontation in the name of this-or-that local gang boss are forced to stand aside by the threat of military-grade firepower.

As a rule, bystanders flee on sight.

Shopkeepers shut their storefronts with practiced speed; they know what to do when a turf war breaks out, and this looks like a serious one.

It doesn't take long for word to spread. The corridors are cleared of civilians well before you arrive at your target.
entries.zh:
本地执法者分属各不相同的势力，成群驻扎在 Qaras 主城区各处要点。能绕开的，你就绕开。那些打着这个或那个本地帮派头目的名号非要拦你的，在军用级火力的威胁下也只能让到一边。

照例，旁观者一看见你们就跑。

店主们以熟练的速度关上店门；地盘火并起来该怎么办，他们清楚，而这一场看着不像闹着玩的。

消息传开得很快。你还没到目标，走廊里的平民早就清空了。

entries.en:
No serious firefights broke out during your intrusion through the territory of a dozen minor gangs - you're an unknown bearing heavy firepower, so they satisfy themselves with threats, taunts, and displays of bravado. It would be expensive to force a conflict with uncertain goals and definite losses; evolutionary pressure has compelled a reasonably practical level of strategic thought among the gangs of Qaras.

You've made no friends here, of course.
entries.zh:
在你穿过十几个小帮派地盘的整个过程中，没有爆发一场像样的枪战 —— 你是个来历不明、火力凶猛的访客，所以他们只要威胁、嘲讽、摆摆架子就满足了。为了一场目标不明、损失却必然惨重的冲突硬碰一次，代价太高；生存的压力，早已在 Qaras 的帮派之间逼出一种相当务实的战略思维。

当然，你在这儿一个朋友都没交到。

entries.en:
"Yes." A slow smile appears.

"I would like you to confirm these reports. Personally."

"The Hegemony is a blunt instrument, intelligence services included. If we started an official investigation, everyone will soon know why."
entries.zh:
"没错。"一个缓慢的笑容浮了上来。

"我希望由你去核实这些报告。亲自去。"

"霸主是件钝器，情报部门也一样。我们要是正式立案调查，所有人很快就会明白是为了什么。"

entries.en: "It'd be convenient if you held a Hegemony commission, and may soon become necessary. Makes it easier to pay you, too. Consider it. I'll even help with the paperwork."
entries.zh: "你手上要是有份霸主委任状，事情会方便得多，而且恐怕很快非有不可。付你钱也名正言顺些。考虑一下。文书我可以帮你办。"

entries.en:
"Before I get ahead of myself," he says, "you should review the reports."

He taps an interface and your comms pings a file transfer.
entries.zh:
"我别把话扯太远，\"他说。\"你该先看看这些报告。"

他在界面上点了一下，你的通讯器响起文件传输的提示音。

o.en: Close the comms then open the files

entries.en: You transfer the files to a secure workspace accessible via your TriPad.
entries.zh: 你把文件转进一个能通过 TriPad 访问的安全工作区。

entries.en:
Orcus Rao sets down his datapad and puts his hands together.

"What about them?"
entries.zh:
Orcus Rao 放下数据平板，双手交叠。

"他们怎么了？"

entries.en:
Orcus gives you a baleful look. "I need not remind you of our position."

"We - the Hegemony - don't want any Andrada on any throne. No Supreme Executor, no Sindrian Diktat. We are going to wipe the mutineer from history."
entries.zh:
Orcus 阴冷地看了你一眼。"用不着我提醒你我们的处境。"

"我们 —— 霸主 —— 不要任何 Andrada 坐上任何王座。不要最高元首，也不要辛达强权。我们要把这个叛徒从历史里抹掉。"

o.en: You may have to compromise at some point, admiral.
o.zh: 到某个时候，你也许不得不妥协，上将。

entries.en: He gives you a quick look, then nods, satisfied.
entries.zh: 他飞快地看了你一眼，然后点头，颇为满意。

entries.en: He gives you a long look, then nods, unsatisfied somehow.
entries.zh: 他久久地看着你，然后点头，却总像有些不满意。

entries.en:
"I'll leave this business of 'compromise' to the diplomats, $titleHeg." He says, emphasizing your presumed rank.

"This is not a matter open to discussion," he growls.
entries.zh:
"'妥协'这种事，我留给外交官去办，$titleHeg。"他说着，特意强调了你那个想当然的军衔。

"这件事没有商量的余地，"他低吼道。

o.en: Achilles could be a problem. He's smart; navy-trained. And he keeps a cool head.
o.zh: Achilles 可能会是个麻烦。他聪明，受过海军训练，而且沉得住气。

o.en: Achilles could be a reformer. He'd be better for the Sector than Philip ever was.
o.zh: Achilles 说不定是个改革者。对这个星域来说，他会比 Philip 强得多。

entries.en:
Rao grunts acknowledgement.

"From the sounds of it they've had that one in their pocket for a great many cycles. Fortuna Kato might have had Fleet Intel help at the start, might have not... It's not the worst case we anticipated, but it's close."

He idly squeezes one hand into a fist.

"Remember, $titleHeg, we don't want any Andrada on any throne. No Supreme Executor, no Sindrian Diktat. We are going to wipe the mutineer from history."
entries.zh:
Rao 哼了一声，表示知道了。

"听这情形，他们把那东西攥在手里已经很多个星历年了。Fortuna Kato 一开始也许得到过舰队情报部的协助，也许没有...这还不是我们预料中最糟的情况，但也差不远了。"

他随手攥紧一只拳头。

"记住，$titleHeg，我们不要任何 Andrada 坐上任何王座。不要最高元首，也不要辛达强权。我们要把这个叛徒从历史里抹掉。"

o.en: You may have to compromise at some point, admiral...
o.zh: 到某个时候，你也许不得不妥协，上将...

entries.en:
"Ragnar Complex," he corrects you. "I'm not posted here to enjoy myself, captain."

"This place," he gestures toward his surroundings, "has certain advantages. Foremost being that none of my former contingent from the Eventide class are particularly interested in taking this dishonorable post, nor are they asking to be invited for an official inspection of a fleet of mildly radioactive hulks."

He stares off into what you assume is a bulkhead, for a moment. Considering his alternatives, perhaps.

"Enough about me," he says finally.
entries.zh:
"是 Ragnar 综合设施，\"他纠正你，\"我被派到这儿可不是来享乐的，舰长。"

"这地方，\"他朝四周示意，\"有它的好处。最主要的是，我原先带的、从 Eventide 那个阶层出身的那批人，没谁特别想接这个不光彩的差事，也没谁主动要求被请来对一支轻度放射性的废船舰队做正式视察。"

他朝某个方向望了一会儿 —— 你猜那是一道舱壁。也许是在掂量自己还有别的什么出路。

"不说我了，"他最后说。

entries.en:
Orcus Rao sets down his datapad and puts his hands together.

"What about them?"
entries.zh:
Orcus Rao 放下数据平板，双手交叠。

"他们怎么了？"

o.en: I've done some investigating. They're real.
o.zh: 我查过一些。他们是真的。

o.en: I've already confirmed all entries. They're real.
o.zh: 每一条我都核实过了。他们是真的。

entries.en:
"Find them," he says.

"I don't think this is the usual pack of lies from Dolos Macario. Not this time. But we need confirmation, and I'd prefer it be done with more subtlety than the Hegemony's usual 'finest' poking around in," he picks up the datapad and gives it a distasteful look, "this list of backwaters."

He looks you over with a lingering look of disapproval.

"We should make sure you're prepared."
entries.zh:
"找到他们。"他说。

"我不认为这又是 Dolos Macario 那套惯常的谎话。这次不像。但我们需要确证，而且我希望办得比霸主那些惯常的【精锐】更讲究些，\"他拿起数据平板，厌恶地看了一眼，\"别让他们在这串穷乡僻壤里到处乱戳。"

他上下打量你，目光里留着久久不散的不满。

"我们得确保你准备妥当。"

entries.en:
He nods.

"Then we should make sure you're outfitted."
entries.zh:
他点了点头。

"那我们就得确保你的装备齐备。"

entries.en:
"Good initiative, $titleHeg," he says, allowing himself to produce a surprised look. "Maybe I've grown to used to the Hegemony speed of doing things."

"Which, speaking of, brings me to the matter of some outfitting I had intended you receive to assist you in your investigation of the clones"
entries.zh:
"有主动精神，$titleHeg，\"他说，允许自己露出一点意外的神情。\"也许是我太习惯霸主办事的那个速度了。"

"说到这个，正好，我原本就打算给你一批装备补给，好协助你调查那些克隆体。"

entries.en: "Did she," he says, not particularly pleased.
entries.zh: "是吗。"他说，语气并不怎么愉快。

o.en: I can only assume she knows your role here.
o.zh: 我只能认为，她清楚你在这里的角色。

entries.en: "No. She's telling me she's watching me," he says. "Which she should be, of course."
entries.zh: "不。她是在告诉我，她在盯着我，\"他说。\"当然，她本来就该盯着。"

entries.en: "We've met." He pauses, making it clear he does not intend to elaborate on this point.
entries.zh: "见过。"他顿了顿，摆明了不打算就这一点多说。

entries.en: "Of course," he says, "because she's not a fool, and Gens Kato has a relatively effective spy network."
entries.zh: "当然，\"他说，\"因为她不是傻子，而 Kato 氏族 的间谍网相当管用。"

entries.en:
He grunts, dismissive.

"I'm sure she enjoys getting you to do her bidding. This changes nothing."
entries.zh:
他嗤了一声，不以为然。

"我肯定她很享受让你替她跑腿。这改变不了什么。"

entries.en: "Did she," he says, not particularly pleased. "How nice. Be sure to return them if you can be bothered."
entries.zh: "是吗。\"他说，语气并不怎么愉快。\"那可真好。要是你乐意，记得把致意还回去。"

o.en: Fortuna Kato told me to give you her compliments.
o.zh: Fortuna Kato 让我代她向你致意。

entries.en:
You explain about the automated defenses and the personalized, pre-recorded messages. Your name could have been subbed into his speeches by an algorithm, but you suspect this was meant for you.

Rao nods, listening.

"Think he's Macario's pick?"
entries.zh:
你讲了那些自动防御系统，以及那些针对个人预先录好的讯息。你的名字也许只是被算法替换进了他的演讲，但你怀疑那本是说给你听的。

Rao 点着头，听你说完。

"你觉得他是 Macario 选中的人？"

o.en: Probably. Hector seems to believe everything Macario told him.
o.zh: 多半是。Macario 说的每一句，Hector 似乎都信。

o.en: I'm not sure. Hector talks like a true believer in Andradism.
o.zh: 我不确定。Hector 说话的样子，像是个真心信仰 Andrada 主义的信徒。

o.en: I don't think so. Hector seems sheltered. How could he lead an empire?
o.zh: 我不这么认为。Hector 像是被养在温室里的人。他怎么可能领导一个帝国？

entries.en: "Just imagine," he says, then shakes his head.
entries.zh: "想想那会成什么样。"他说着，摇了摇头。

entries.en: "Would that not serve?" His tone is rhetorical.
entries.zh: "那样岂不更好？"他的语气是反问。

entries.en: "With the help of Dolos Macario, I expect," he says.
entries.zh: "我猜，是在 Dolos Macario 的扶助之下。"他说。

entries.en:
"If Macario had direct control over every aspect of his upbringing, and ensured that everything he knows is what Macario wishes for him to know... and never more than Macario himself."

Rao returns his speculative look to meet yours.

"This is good. We'll work with it."
entries.zh:
"如果 Macario 直接控制了他成长的每一个方面，确保他所知的一切都是 Macario 希望他知道的...而且绝不超过 Macario 本人所知的范围。"

Rao 收回审视的目光，与你对上视线。

"这很好。我们就按这个来做。"

entries.en:
"Put some kid raised in an asteroid eating nothing but Andradaism in charge of an empire?"

He smiles. Like someone who's seen their opponent's force disposition - and has a plan.

"Good work, $titleHeg."
entries.zh:
"让一个在小行星上长大、从小只吃 Andrada 主义那一套的孩子去掌管一个帝国？"

他笑了。像是已经看清了对手的兵力部署 —— 而且心里有了主意。

"干得好，$titleHeg。"

o.en: I found Hector. Irkalla was a trap. (explain)
o.zh: 我找到了 Hector。Irkalla 是个陷阱。 (解释)

entries.en: "Dead." Rao's expression doesn't change. "How?"
entries.zh: "死了。\"Rao 神色不变，\"怎么死的？"

entries.en: "Looks like?"
entries.zh: "看起来像？"

o.en: It does. But there were... others trying to track down Jason. (explain)
o.zh: 确实像。但还有...别的人也在追查 Jason。 (解释)

entries.en: You explain how someone paid to have you questioned, and perhaps killed, by a local goon. It did not go well for said goon.
entries.zh: 你说明有人出钱，让当地一个混混来审问你，或许还要你的命。那个混混的下场不太好。

entries.en: A Diktat agent, or what appears to be one, paid for the job. You found their apartment, and a comms log of them paying for documents that confirm Jason's death. The agent then fled the planet.
entries.zh: 一名辛达强权的特工 —— 至少看起来是 —— 付了这笔钱。你找到了他的住处，还有一份通讯记录，显示他出钱买了确认 Jason 死亡的文件。之后那名特工逃出了这颗行星。

entries.en: You managed to catch their shuttle, you explain. And you explain about the hidden poison capsule, and their Sindrian Diktat uniform.
entries.zh: 你说明自己截住了他们的穿梭机，又说到那枚暗藏的毒囊，还有他们身上辛达强权的制服。

entries.en: "So who hired the hitman?"
entries.zh: "那杀手是谁雇的？"

entries.en:
"Could be the right hand doesn't know what the left is hiding."

Rao rubs his chin.

"At least he's off the board. Probably wasn't leadership material anyway."
entries.zh:
"也可能是右手不知道左手在瞒什么。"

Rao 摩挲着下巴。

"至少他出局了。他大概本来也不是当领袖的料。"

entries.en:
"An inside job, huh." Rao smirks, rubbing his chin. "Or maybe an attempt at one. Could be the right hand doesn't know what the left was hiding."

"At least he's off the board."
entries.zh:
"内部人干的，嗯。\"Rao 咧嘴一笑，摩挲着下巴，\"或者只是有人想这么干。也可能是右手不知道左手在瞒什么。"

"至少他出局了。"

entries.en:
He blinks, giving you a questioning look.

"I'd think you would want to know who was trying to kill you, $titleHeg." Rao shrugs. "And I'd be interested in why."

"At least the kid is off the board. Probably wasn't leadership material anyway."
entries.zh:
他眨了眨眼，疑惑地看着你。

"我以为你会想知道是谁想杀你，$titleHeg。\"Rao 耸耸肩，\"而我也想知道为什么。"

"至少那小子出局了。他大概本来也不是当领袖的料。"

o.en: Jason Andrada was on Qaras. He was dead when I arrived.
o.zh: Jason Andrada 在 Qaras 上。我赶到的时候他已经死了。

entries.en:
"I don't have a reputation for being stickler for regulations, but I need you to hold a Hegemony commission before we have operational discussions concerning these matters."

He lets a hand drop on his desk.

"No exceptions."
entries.zh:
"我向来不以严守条令出名，但在我们就这些事展开作战层面的讨论之前，我需要你持有霸主委任状。"

他把一只手拍到桌上。

"没有例外。"

entries.en:
"Then," Rao says, unsurprised, "for some reason, you tried to shoot Maeus Moroz."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He is," his look shifts to you for a moment, "or was, useful."
entries.zh:
"那么，\"Rao 说，毫无意外之色，\"出于某种原因，你试图对 Maeus Moroz 开枪。"

他瞥了一眼数据板。

"我倒希望你没那么做。他是个，\"他的目光在你身上停了一瞬，\"或者说，曾是个有用的人。"

entries.en:
"Then," Rao says, unsurprised, "you shot Maeus."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He was useful."
entries.zh:
"那么，\"Rao 说，毫无意外之色，\"你对 Maeus 开了枪。"

他瞥了一眼数据板。

"我倒希望你没那么做。他曾是个有用的人。"

entries.en:
"Then," Rao says, unsurprised, "you destroyed the fleet of Maeus Moroz in space."

He glances at his datapad.

"I'd prefer that you hadn't. He was useful."
entries.zh:
"那么，\"Rao 说，毫无意外之色，\"你在太空里摧毁了 Maeus Moroz 的舰队。"

他瞥了一眼数据板。

"我倒希望你没那么做。他曾是个有用的人。"

entries.en: "Someone," Rao says, not quite asking a question. "Did you find out who?"
entries.zh: "有人干的，\"Rao 说，语气不太像在提问，\"查出是谁了吗？"

o.en: No. His... adoptive father, Maeus Moroz, didn't either.
o.zh: 没有。他的...养父 Maeus Moroz 也没查出来。

entries.en: Rao nods, and glances at his datapad. Unconcerned.
entries.zh: Rao 点点头，瞥了一眼数据板。并不在意。

entries.en:
"Yes," Rao says, unsurprised.

"Then you sat at the bar and had a drink with Maeus Moroz."

His eyes lock on to you. The question is all in his look.
entries.zh:
"是的，"Rao 说，并不意外。

"然后你坐在吧台边，跟 Maeus Moroz 喝了一杯。"

他盯住你。疑问全写在他的眼神里。

o.en: He blames Dolos Macario for the death of... his son.
o.zh: 他把...他儿子的死归咎于 Dolos Macario。

entries.en: "Good," says Rao.
entries.zh: "很好，"Rao 说。

entries.en: "Because Dolos Macario is the enemy," he says. "And Maeus is not the forgiving type."
entries.zh: "因为 Dolos Macario 是敌人，\"他说，\"而 Maeus 可不是会原谅人的那种人。"

entries.en:
His look hardens into a warning.

"You're asking a dangerous question, $titleHeg. In this business I should think you would know better than that."
entries.zh:
他的眼神沉下来，成了警告。

"你在问一个危险的问题，$titleHeg。干我们这行，我以为你该比这更懂分寸。"

o.en: I just need to know what you're doing so I can do my job.
o.zh: 我只是需要知道你在做什么，好让我能办我的事。

o.en: I'm not here to act as your assassin, Orcus.
o.zh: 我不是来给你当刺客的，Orcus。

entries.en: "Good. We'll speak no more of it."
entries.zh: "很好。这件事到此为止。"

entries.en:
"You 'need to know' enough to do your part, $titleHeg," he says. "And no more. This is the Hegemony and that is how this works here."

"Take a shift to cool off," he says, dismissing you as he reaches for the comms cut-off. "The discussion is over. We will not speak of it again."

The link snaps to a Hegemony crest.
entries.zh:
"你知道的'足够'让你做好你那份事就够了，$titleHeg，\"他说，\"不能更多。这里是霸主，这里的规矩就是这样。"

"去轮一班岗，冷静一下，\"他说着伸手去切通讯，把你打发了，\"谈话结束了。这件事我们不会再提。"

通讯一断，画面定格在霸主的徽记上。

entries.en:
"Admiral Rao," he says, correcting you. "And no, I never asked that particular service of you."

"Take a shift to cool off," he says, dismissing you as he reaches for the comms cut-off. "The discussion is over. We will not speak of it again."

The link snaps to a Hegemony crest.
entries.zh:
"是 Rao 上将，\"他纠正你，\"另外，没有。我从来没让你干过那件事。"

"去轮一班岗，冷静一下，\"他说着伸手去切通讯，把你打发了，\"谈话结束了。这件事我们不会再提。"

通讯一断，画面定格在霸主的徽记上。

o.en: I found Pericles. Someone shot him.
o.zh: 我找到了 Pericles。有人开枪打死了他。

entries.en:
"Find them," he says. "Didn't I say that already?"

"I don't think this is a pack of lies from Dolos Macario, not this time. But confirmation doesn't hurt. And I'd prefer it if someone with a little more subtlety than the Hegemony's usual 'finest' poking around in," he picks up the datapad and gives it a distasteful look, "this list of backwaters."
entries.zh:
"找出他们，\"他说，\"我不是已经说过了？"

"我不觉得这是 Dolos Macario 编的一整套谎话，这次不像。不过确认一下也没有坏处。而且我更希望派个比霸主一贯的'精锐'稍微懂点分寸的人去查，\"他拿起数据板，嫌恶地看了一眼，\"去查这一串穷乡僻壤。"

o.en: Isn't... Ragnar Station a bit of a backwater?
o.zh: Ragnar 空间站...不算是有点偏僻吗？

entries.en: He considers for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
entries.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

entries.en:
"You've done good work for the Hegemony," he says, and taps at his datapad. "For your trouble."

"And you're going to see a lot more trouble before this is over, $TitleHeg $PlayerLastName. Watch your back."
entries.zh:
"你为霸主干得不错，\"他说着，在数据平板上敲了几下。\"这是给你的酬劳。"

"而在这件事了结之前，你还会碰上更多麻烦，$TitleHeg $PlayerLastName。多留个心眼。"

entries.en:
"You've served the Hegemony," he says, and taps the datapad. "For your trouble."

"You're going to see a lot more trouble before this is over, $TitleHeg $PlayerLastName. Watch your back."
entries.zh:
"你为霸主效过力，\"他说着，敲了敲数据平板。\"这是给你的酬劳。"

"在这件事了结之前，你还会碰上更多麻烦，$TitleHeg $PlayerLastName。多留个心眼。"

entries.en: He consider for a moment, then says "I believe we've discussed everything. For now."
entries.zh: 他沉吟片刻，然后说："我想该谈的都谈过了。就目前而言。"

o.en: I'd like to discuss the ANDRADA files.
o.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 文件。

entries.en:
Rao glances at his datapad, taps out some commands.

"My quartermaster will provide you with fuel and supplies. They're in a bay on Ragnar Complex I've assigned to you."

He puts the datapad down. "That's it. Find all those clones, sons, whatever they are."
entries.zh:
Rao 瞥了一眼数据平板，敲下几条指令。

"我的军需官会给你补给燃料和物资。东西放在 Ragnar 综合设施的一个泊位里，我划给你了。"

他放下数据平板。"就这样。把那些克隆体、儿子，随他们是什么，全都找出来。"

entries.en:
Rao glances at his datapad, taps out some commands.

"My quartermaster will provide you with fuel and supplies. They're in a bay on Ragnar Complex I've assigned to you."

He puts the datapad down. "Now about the clones."
entries.zh:
Rao 瞥了一眼数据平板，敲下几条指令。

"我的军需官会给你补给燃料和物资。东西放在 Ragnar 综合设施的一个泊位里，我划给你了。"

他放下数据平板。"那么，说说那些克隆体。"

o.en: I'd like to discuss the ANDRADA files.
o.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 文件。

entries.en:
Achilles "Kalian".

Early body of data is tagged planet Madeira. Creche committee bribed, exowomb records altered. Parents: naval logistics/senior AM tech.

Exceptional creche scores despite conflict with peers. Medical reports green. Fleet Cadets program, commendation. Bribe to naval committee (action codename PORPHYRA). Application to Kazeron Academy. Graduation with full honors.

Offered piracy patrol, unexpectedly rescinded. Re-assigned to Yesod, Zagan system, awaiting assignment. Observation program disrupted by PL Fleet Intelligence; intel insufficient, request additional detail. Yesod MuniSec reports involvement in altercation, spacer bar; news suppressed by Fleet Intelligence.
entries.zh:
Achilles，代号 "Kalian"。

早期数据一律标在 Madeira 行星名下。育幼委员会被买通，体外子宫记录经过涂改。父母：一方在海军后勤，一方是资深反物质技师。

育幼院考评极优，尽管与同龄人屡有冲突。医学报告全部正常。舰队候补军官计划，获嘉奖。向海军委员会行贿 (行动代号 PORPHYRA)。申请 Kazeron 学院。以最高荣誉毕业。

已获派剿盗巡逻任务，却意外被撤销。改派至 Zagan 星系的 Yesod，等待分配。观察计划被英仙座联盟舰队情报部打乱；情报不足，请求补充细节。Yesod 的 MuniSec 报告其卷入一场斗殴，地点是太空船员酒吧；消息已被舰队情报部压下。

entries.en: You now have a list of places of interest, mostly small planets, a couple minor asteroids, and the Galatia Academy station. All within the core worlds.
entries.zh: 你手上现在有了一份地点清单：多数是小型行星，另有一两处小行星，还有 Galatia 学院空间站 —— 全都在核心世界之内。

entries.en:
You pull up the ANDRADA files. There are seven archives filled with timestamped data: Names, locations, status reports, receipts, medical analysis, surveillance.

The data has been processed and analyzed by an intelligence team, possibly over many cycles. You are able to rapidly glean essential details from the prepared summaries.

This archive is stored in your TriPad in a secure workspace and remains accessible through your mission intel entry.
entries.zh:
你调出 ANDRADA 文件。七个档案，塞满了带时间戳的数据：姓名、地点、状态报告、收据、医学分析、监视记录。

这些数据已经过一个情报小组的处理与分析，也许花了许多个星历年。你得以从整理好的摘要里迅速拣出要点。

这份档案存放在你 TriPad 上的加密工作区里，仍可从任务情报条目中访问。

o.en: Just have an algorithm extract the essential details

entries.en:
Hector "Palatin"

Record of property purchase from numbered holding incorporate, Hybrasil system. Orbital coordinates attached, missing schematics; registry name 58966 Elysium.

Supply, staff procurement through TT subsidiaries. Medical report green. List of private tutors, CVs attached, assigned to ELYSIUM. Receipts of payment; shortest term one shift, longest one and a half cycles.

Accounting for period contains fees for medical evac (cryo-stabilized), multiple instances. Details redacted. Psych assessment missing from file.
entries.zh:
Hector，代号 "Palatin"。

有资产购入记录，卖方为 Hybrasil 星系一家以编号注册的控股公司。附有轨道坐标，图纸缺失；登记名为 58966 Elysium。

补给与人员招募均经速子科技下属公司办理。医学报告全部正常。附私人教师名单与简历，皆派驻 ELYSIUM。付款收据齐备；聘期最短的只有一个轮班，最长的一个半星历年。

该期间的账目中含有医疗后送费用 (低温稳定处理)，且不止一次。细目已删节。心理评估报告不在卷内。

o.zh: 显示 ELYSIUM 轨道数据

entries.en:
Hercules "Cyrino"

Anonymous donation to Nova Maxios orphanage, records altered. Excellent creche scores. Conflict with peers. Multiple MuniSec reports as adolescent.

Accepted to Galatia Academy with full scholarship under Gens Kato-sponsored charity program. Excellent induction-cycle scores.

Conflicting reports regarding necessity of bribery action due to subject's academic achievement. Observation team key agent failed check-in. Concerns about credits allocated to action NARRA-AULD missing. Case forwarded to Ministry of Internal Security, EXCISION-RED, new personnel requested.

Applied and accepted to Post-Collapse History department. Department committee approval of assistant academician status.
entries.zh:
Hercules，代号 "Cyrino"。

向 Nova Maxios 孤儿院的匿名捐款，记录经过涂改。育幼院考评优异。与同龄人屡有冲突。少年时期有多份 MuniSec 报告。

经 Kato 氏族赞助的慈善项目，以全额奖学金被 Galatia 学院录取。入学阶段考评优异。

因其学业成绩出众，是否仍需执行贿赂行动，各方报告相互矛盾。观察组关键特工未按时报到。行动 NARRA-AULD 名下的拨款下落不明，引起关注。案子转交内部安全部，EXCISION-RED，已申请新人手。

申请并获准进入大崩塌后历史系。系委员会已批准其助理院士身份。

Accepted to Galatia Academy with full scholarship under Gens Kato-sponsored charity program. Excellent induction-cycle scores.

向 Nova Maxios 孤儿院的匿名捐款，记录经过涂改。育幼院考评优异。与同龄人屡有冲突。少年时期有多份 MuniSec 报告。

entries.en:
Jason "Korin"

Culann. Fees paid to Tri-Tachyon "Cybescence Betterment" charity school; focus on early-age cybernetic interfacing (non-intrusive). Peer altercations, fines charged sponsoring front corporation. Budget allocation under action DALGAN-SIG. Fees paid for social-stability counselling.

Psych report update, subject: anti-company outbursts. Unauthorized absence from Cybescence Betterment. MuniSec records of vandalism, theft. Front corporation allocated additional credits under DALGAN-SIG to suppress records. Tri-Tachyon Customer Awareness (access via DALGAN-SIG) reports subject purchased unlicensed transport to Qaras, Yma system.

Observation team re-assigned. Subject associated with ANTI-associated agents, Kanta gang connections. Permission to extract subject awaiting confirmation.
entries.zh:
Jason，代号 "Korin"。

Culann。学费付给速子科技旗下的 "Cybescence Betterment" 慈善学校；主攻幼龄期义体接驳 (非侵入式)。与同龄人发生冲突，罚款记在出面赞助的空壳公司账上。预算列在行动 DALGAN-SIG 项下。另有社会稳定性辅导的费用支出。

心理报告更新，事由：屡次发表反公司言论。未经许可离开 Cybescence Betterment。MuniSec 有故意毁坏与盗窃的记录。空壳公司在 DALGAN-SIG 项下追加拨款，用以压下记录。速子科技客户关注部门 (经 DALGAN-SIG 取得权限) 报告：对象购得一趟无照运输，前往 Yma 星系的 Qaras。

观察组已改派。对象与反公司势力的代理人往来，并与 Kanta 的帮派有联系。提取对象的许可仍在等待批准。

entries.en:
Leonidas "Esculus"

Cethlan commerce court: purchase of cometary body in Duzakh system, price reduced due to dispute over recognition of exploitation rights.

Project codename IRKALLA, refurbishment contract: NDAs, list of tech specs, unusual bio-support equipment, re-orbit to L4-point of Duzahk fringe jump-point.

Contract with Neurozenith Cybernetic Solutions Group (NCSG) for an extended program, anonymous package. Additional contracts with numbered fronts registered in various polities. Manifests imply regular site resupply. Accounting suggests unusually high cost.

Procurement of two contractors, specialized services, referred to by codenames CRASIS, AUREOLIN for 10-cycle period. Two term extensions paid upfront.
entries.zh:
Leonidas，代号 "Esculus"。

Cethlan 商事法庭：购入 Duzakh 星系内一具彗星体，因开采权认定存在争议，成交价被压低。

项目代号 IRKALLA，改造合同：保密协议、技术规格清单、非常规生命维持设备、重新入轨至 Duzahk 边缘跳跃点的 L4 点。

与 Neurozenith Cybernetic Solutions Group (NCSG) 签订长期项目合同，以匿名形式打包。另有若干合同，对方是注册在各政体下的编号空壳。货运清单显示该处有定期补给。账目也显示费用高得不寻常。

采购两名承包商提供专门服务，以代号 CRASIS、AUREOLIN 指称，合约十个星历年。两次续约费用已预先付清。

o.zh: 显示 IRKALLA 轨道数据

entries.en: And a flashing indicator. Attached message, timestamp: now.
entries.zh: 还有一处闪动的标记。附带一条消息，时间戳：此刻。

o.zh: 显示 IRKALLA 轨道数据

entries.en:
It opens.

Nothing. It's blank.

Then text appears, one character after another. As if they carried a sense of their own volition.
entries.zh:
它打开了。

什么也没有。一片空白。

然后文字浮现出来，一个字符接一个字符。仿佛它们各有自己的意志。

entries.en:
One by one, the characters disappear. The note closes itself and disappears from your TriPad.

You take a deep breath waiting for what happens next.

Nothing.
entries.zh:
字符又一个一个地消失。那条便笺自行关闭，从你的 TriPad 上不见了。

你深吸一口气，等着看接下来会发生什么。

什么也没有。

entries.en:
Pericles "Aventine"

Records of ongoing payment to mercenary captain Maues Moroz based out of Orthrus, in the Samarra System. Medical reports green. Creche reports exceptional.

Eventide section, private academy: flight training, navigation, tactics, mathematics. Subject expelled for altercation with heir of REDACTED, a leading family of Eventide. Combat sim records good-to-exceptional.

Record of fleet operations, merc jobs in core worlds and near-fringe. Associated with incorporated body owned by 'Moroz' who holds lease on several warehouses, two private docks on Orthrus.
entries.zh:
Pericles，代号 "Aventine"。

有持续付款记录，收款人为盘踞在 Samarra 星系 Orthrus 的雇佣兵头目 Maeus Moroz。医学报告全部正常。育幼院考评极优。

Eventide 城区，私立学院：飞行训练、导航、战术、数学。对象因与【已删节】家族的继承人发生冲突而被开除 —— 那是 Eventide 的望族之一。战斗模拟记录从良好到极优。

有舰队作战记录，在核心世界与近边缘地带接过雇佣任务。与一家法人实体有关联，其所有者【Moroz】租用着 Orthrus 上的几处仓库和两个私人船坞。

entries.en:
Perseus "Saturnian".

Nomios, Arcadia system. Medical reports green. Biochemistry reports. Electrostim muscular and neurological development regimen, equipment and technician fees.

Cheerful progress reports; costly procurement receipt - inventory referred to by codewords. Doctor Cydonia "proceeding with operation". Updates suddenly cease at $sd7s_cydoniaDate.

Alarmed finger-pointing reports. Cydonia gone dark, then reported present at Kanta's Den. Case referred to the Ministry of Internal Security, something called EXCISION-RED.
entries.zh:
Perseus，代号 "Saturnian"。

Nomios，Arcadia 星系。医学报告全部正常。生化检测报告。电刺激肌肉与神经发育方案，设备与技术员费用。

进度报告笔调轻快；昂贵的采购收据 —— 清单上的物件只用代号指称。Cydonia 医生【手术进行中】。所有更新在 $sd7s_cydoniaDate 骤然中断。

随后是惊慌的相互推责报告。Cydonia 失联，之后有报告称其出现在 Kanta's Den。案子转交内部安全部，落到一个叫 EXCISION-RED 的名目下。

entries.en:
As you step out of the bar, you find yourself shoved roughly against the corridor wall. The augmented brute holds an ugly little palm-cannon in your face.

"What's yer interest in Jason Korin, spacey?"

His breath is foul.

"Start spillin' or your head'll return to orbit minus yer hull."
entries.zh:
你刚走出酒吧，就被人粗暴地按在走廊墙上。那个改造过的壮汉把一具丑陋的小手炮顶在你脸上。

"你打听 Jason Korin 干什么，太空佬？"

他的口气臭得刺鼻。

"开始吐实话，不然你的脑袋就得脱离舰体、独自回轨道去。"

o.en: Let your bodyguards do their work
You cannot begin to comprehend the depths of your error, friend.
o.zh: 朋友，你根本想象不到自己错得有多深。

o.en: I'd like to talk to him. Do you know where I can find him?
o.zh: 我想跟他谈谈。你知道上哪儿能找到他？

entries.en:
"So?"

His hands are upturned, empty - to show what you've given.

"IF Fleet Intelligence determines your 'critical intel' is of any use, then I'll be impressed. Don't waste my time groveling."
entries.zh:
"所以？"

他摊开双手，掌心空空——这就是你交上来的东西。

"如果舰队情报部认定你这份'关键情报'有点用处，我才会对你刮目相看。别浪费时间在我面前摇尾乞怜。"

entries.en:
"In fact, I was just speaking with my Fleet Intelligence liaison. What you brought us - what you brought me - has turned out to be of some interest."

He gives you an appraising look.

"Don't think you've impressed me, captain. Not yet."
entries.zh:
"事实上，我刚和我的舰队情报部联络官谈过。你带给我们的东西——你带给我的东西——确实有些意思。"

他用估量的目光打量你。

"别以为你已经让我刮目相看了，舰长。还没有。"

o.en: I wish to discuss the ANDRADA files.
o.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 档案。

o.en: I wish to discuss the ANDRADA files.
o.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 档案。

o.en: I wish to discuss the ANDRADA files.
o.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 档案。

entries.en: "No. The topic has been discussed to my satisfaction," he says authoritatively. "Don't mention it again."
entries.zh: "不必了。这个话题已经谈得让我满意了，\"他以不容置疑的口吻说，\"别再提了。"

entries.en:
"The files you brought to me, yes."

He smiles broadly, leaning back.

"Well?"
entries.zh:
"你带给我的那些档案，对。"

他咧嘴一笑，向后靠去。

"然后呢？"

entries.en:
"The files you brought to Horus Yaribay before me, yes."

He leans back, smiling broadly without making any effort to look like he means it.

"Well?"
entries.zh:
"那些你先交给了 Horus Yaribay、才轮到我看到的档案，对。"

他向后一靠，咧嘴笑着，却半点没打算装出真诚。

"然后呢？"

o.en: Horus is too weak to respond. It's clear why you are Prime Demarchon.
o.zh: Horus 太软弱，根本无力回应。你为什么会是大统领，一目了然。

o.en: I wish to discuss the ANDRADA files.
o.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 档案。

entries.en:
"Dolos Macario's secret files, yes."

He smiles broadly, teeth flashing perfectly.

"You can only imagine my surprise when they turned out to be of substance. Quite the conspiracy you've revealed. Or is it Macario I should thank?"

He raises his eyebrows. "You may yet be doing him service."
entries.zh:
"Dolos Macario 的秘密档案，对。"

他咧嘴一笑，牙齿白得发亮。

"你可以想象我有多意外——那些东西居然真有分量。你揭出来的阴谋可不小。或者，我该谢的是 Macario？"

他挑起眉毛。"说不定你这是在帮他。"
