entries.en: "Hmm. We will speak of your... troubles," he says.
entries.zh: "嗯。你的...麻烦，我们以后再谈，"他说。

entries.en: The comms cut quite abruptly.
entries.zh: 通讯骤然中断。

entries.en:
"Now - we were speaking of the ANDRADA files."

Reynard sits up, attentive. Expectant.
entries.zh:
"好了——刚才我们说到 ANDRADA 档案。"

Reynard 坐直身子，专注，带着期待。

entries.en:
"You're telling me things that I know, $titlePL," he says impatiently - but is his interest piqued?

"Speak plainly. Why are you here?"
entries.zh:
"你在跟我说我早就知道的事，$titlePL，"他不耐烦地说——可他的兴趣是不是被勾起来了？

"直说吧。你来做什么？"

o.en: I want to take down Macario. You're strong enough to do it.
o.zh: 我要扳倒 Macario。你有这个实力。

o.en: I seek power. If I work for you, I may achieve it.
o.zh: 我求的是权力。若为你效力，我或许能得到它。

o.en: I want to back the winning side. It's safer - and profitable.
o.zh: 我想站在赢的那一边。更安全，也有利可图。

entries.en:
"Macario's secret files, yes."

He smiles broadly, leaning back.

"Well?"
entries.zh:
"Macario 的秘密档案，对。"

他咧嘴一笑，向后靠去。

"然后呢？"

entries.en:
"It is presumptive to question me, $titlePL." He narrows his eyes. "But I am in a forgiving mood."

He flicks with his hand, discarding his own indignation.

"Of course I knew of Kalian. He's the product of a minor and long-standing arrangement with our 'friends' from Askonia. A little insurance for Philip, a little hostage for us."
entries.zh:
"质疑我，是越界，$titlePL。\"他眯起眼睛。\"不过我眼下心情宽厚。"

他随手一挥，连自己的不悦也一并挥开了。

"Kalian 的事我当然知道。那是我们与 Askonia 那些'朋友'之间一项不起眼却由来已久的安排。对 Philip 是一份小小的保险，对我们则是一个小小的人质。"

o.zh: 等等，你在和 Macario 合作？

entries.en:
"Mind your tone, $titlePL," Reynard says, though casually.

"Our Diktat representative has not been entirely forthright about Macario's personal attention to the matter, nor about the scope of Philip's... ambitions. Your files," he extends a charitable hand. "Prove their misdirection."

"Not that I blame them, of course. I wouldn't trust me either."

"I suppose I have you to thank." Reynard almost rolls his eyes. "A rare concession, do enjoy it."
entries.zh:
"注意你的口气，$titlePL，"Reynard 说，语气倒还随意。

"我们那位辛达强权代表，并没有完全坦白 Macario 对这件事的亲自关注，也没有说清 Philip 那些...野心的范围。而你的档案，\"他伸出手，姿态宽宏，\"证明了他们的误导。"

"当然，我不怪他们。换了我，我也不会信我自己。"

"看来我该谢你。\"Reynard 几乎翻了个白眼。\"难得的让步，好好享用吧。"

o.en: Achilles Kalian appears to be known to Fleet Intelligence already. Were you aware?
o.zh: 看来舰队情报部早就知道 Achilles Kalian 这个人。你知道这事吗？

o.en: I found Hector. He seems to be under Macario's influence. (explain)
o.zh: 我找到 Hector 了。他好像正受 Macario 摆布。 (解释)

o.en: I found Hector. He won't be a problem. (explain)
o.zh: 我找到了 Hector。他不会成为问题。 (解释)

o.en: I found Hercules Andrada at the Galatia Academy.
o.zh: 我在 Galatia 学院找到了 Hercules Andrada。

entries.en:
"Mm. Clearly."

Reynard doesn't seem terribly concerned.
entries.zh:
"唔。看来确实如此。"

Reynard 看上去并不怎么在意。

o.en: You have a plan, don't you.
I wish to offer my assistance with your... response.
o.zh: 我想为你的...回应出一份力。

entries.en: "Consider it thus: Fortuna Kato is investing tremendous resources into a risky gambit with an unreliable partner." He grins toothily. "It is not every cycle that your closest competition conspires to provide such an opening."
entries.zh: "不妨这样看：Fortuna Kato 正把大量资源押在一场豪赌上，而她的伙伴并不可靠。\"他咧嘴一笑，露出牙齿。\"你最亲近的竞争对手主动送来这样一个机会，可不是每个星历年都有的事。"

entries.en:
He produces a concessionary smile, as if from an approving teacher to a clever student.

"Consider it thus: Fortuna Kato is investing tremendous resources into a risky gambit with an unreliable partner." His grin becomes toothier. "It is not every cycle that your closest competition conspires to provide such an opening."
entries.zh:
他挤出一个带点让步意味的笑，像是老师在夸奖一个机灵的学生。

"不妨这样看：Fortuna Kato 正把大量资源押在一场豪赌上，而她的伙伴并不可靠。\"他的笑容咧得更开，牙齿都露了出来。\"你最亲近的竞争对手主动送来这样一个机会，可不是每个星历年都有的事。"

entries.en:
"It pleases me to hear you say this. I shall perhaps make use of you in this regard as the situation... ripens."

He puts his hands behind his head, leaning back, quite comfortable.

"It is not every cycle that your closest competition conspires to provide such an opening. Fortuna Kato is investing tremendous resources into a risky gambit with an unreliable partner."

He produces a toothy grin.
entries.zh:
"听你这么说，我很高兴。等局势...成熟些，我也许会在这件事上用得上你。"

他双手枕在脑后，向后一靠，一副怡然自得的样子。

"你最亲近的竞争对手主动送来这样一个机会，可不是每个星历年都有的事。Fortuna Kato 正把大量资源押在一场豪赌上，而她的伙伴并不可靠。"

他咧嘴一笑，露出牙齿。

He puts his hands behind his head, leaning back, quite comfortable.

"I shall perhaps make use of you in this regard as the situation... ripens."
entries.zh:
他双手枕在脑后，向后一靠，一副怡然自得的样子。

"等局势...成熟些，我也许会在这件事上用得上你。"

o.en: Fortuna Kato is plotting to use Achilles Andrada to upset your position in the League.
o.zh: Fortuna Kato 正谋划利用 Achilles Andrada，动摇你在联盟中的地位。

o.en: I believe someone, some faction, is assassinating the Andrada clones.
o.zh: 我相信有人 —— 某个势力 —— 正在暗杀 Andrada 的克隆体。

o.en: I believe someone, some faction, is assassinating the Andrada clones.
o.zh: 我相信有人 —— 某个势力 —— 正在暗杀 Andrada 的克隆体。

o.en: Do you... want the clones dead?
o.zh: 你...希望那些克隆体死吗？

entries.en:
"Mm," he says. "Yes, I'm familiar with the situation. Philip Andrada transformed into a weak-necked academician. It's the punchline of a sophomoric joke."

Reynard doesn't manage a smile, but he sits up, and anger enters his voice.

"The real scandal is the lapse in Academy security, perhaps due to the Hegemony brute Baird's put in charge. Probably reporting everything back to Daud, if he can remember any three words long enough to make it to a comm-link."
entries.zh:
"嗯，\"他说，\"是，这局面我清楚。Philip Andrada 变成了一个缩着脖子的院士。这像个幼稚笑话的包袱。"

Reynard 没能挤出笑容，但他坐直了，声音里多了怒气。

"真正的丑闻是学院安保的疏漏——多半是因为霸主派来管事的那个莽夫 Baird。他大概把一切都回报给 Daud 了，只要他能记住哪怕三个词、还能撑到通讯接通。"

entries.en:
"I've sent a representative to express my displeasure; many of my Gens' offspring, and of my clients besides, attend the Galatia Academy and I won't hold with assassination."

He scoffs, annoyed, then brushes the issue away. His anger, at least, is directed elsewhere.

"We'll speak no more of it."
entries.zh:
"我已派了一名代表去表达不满；我氏族里许多子弟，还有不少附庸的子弟，都在 Galatia 学院就读。我容不下暗杀这种事。"

他恼火地哼了一声，随即把这事拂开。至少，他的怒气是冲着别处去的。

"此事不必再提。"

entries.en:
"Mm," he says. "And he was killed, I know. Boo-hoo."

Reynard sits up, anger entering his voice.

"The real scandal is the lapse in Academy security, perhaps due to the Hegemony brute Baird's put in charge. Probably reporting everything back to Daud, if he can remember any three words long enough to make it to a comm-link."
entries.zh:
"嗯，\"他说，\"而且他死了，我知道。真惨。"

Reynard 坐直身子，声音里透出怒气。

"真正的丑闻是学院安保的疏漏——多半是因为霸主派来管事的那个莽夫 Baird。他大概把一切都回报给 Daud 了，只要他能记住哪怕三个词、还能撑到通讯接通。"

"We'll speak no more of it."

"此事不必再提。"

entries.en:
As you begin to explain Reynard waves an interruption.

"Yes, yes, I've read the report - and between the lines. Macario usurped one or more elements of the clone program in order to secure a means to advance his personal agenda. An obvious play."

He drums his fingers on his luxurious desk.

"This 'Hector' will announce that Supreme Executor Philip Andrada has, sadly and finally, died of 'natural causes' and he's been forced, tearfully, to take his father's throne while Dolos smirks on the parade stand behind him."

"We'll deal with it in due time."
entries.zh:
你刚开口解释，Reynard 便挥手打断。

"知道，知道，报告我读过——连字缝里的也读了。Macario 篡夺了克隆计划的一环或几环，为的是弄到一个能推进他私心的手段。招数太明显了。"

他用手指在奢华的书桌上敲了敲。

"这个'Hector'会宣布：最高元首 Philip Andrada 不幸终于'自然死亡'，而他含泪被迫继承父亲的宝座，Dolos 就在他身后的检阅台上冷笑。"

"到时候再收拾。"

entries.en:
As you begin to explain Reynard waves an interruption.

"Yes, yes, I've read the report - and between the lines. Macario usurped one or more elements of the clone program in order to secure a means to advance his personal agenda. An obvious play."

He taps manicured fingers on his luxurious desk. They stop. His eyes turns to you.

"And how sure are you that he was in that asteroid when you blew it up?" He doesn't wait for an answer. "Not sure enough, I think."
entries.zh:
你刚开口解释，Reynard 便挥手打断。

"知道，知道，报告我读过——连字缝里的也读了。Macario 篡夺了克隆计划的一环或几环，为的是弄到一个能推进他私心的手段。招数太明显了。"

他用修整齐整的手指在奢华的书桌上轻叩几下。停住。目光转向你。

"你炸掉那颗小行星的时候，有多确定他就在里面？\"他不等你回答。\"我看，还不够确定。"

entries.en:
He snaps his fingers, interrupting your explanation.

"The intention is that we are surprised when this 'Hector' announces that Supreme Executor Philip Andrada has, sadly and finally, died of 'natural causes' and he has been forced, tearfully, to take his father's throne while Dolos smirks on the parade stand behind him."

Pausing to giving you a patient look, he says, "I do not plan to be surprised. We'll deal with it in due time."
entries.zh:
他打了个响指，打断你的解释。

"他们的用意，就是让我们在这个'Hector'宣布时措手不及：最高元首 Philip Andrada 不幸终于'自然死亡'，而他含泪被迫继承父亲的宝座，Dolos 就在他身后的检阅台上冷笑。"

他顿了顿，用一种近乎耐心的目光看着你，说："我没打算措手不及。到时候再收拾。"

entries.en:
"Good," he says.

"And before you succumb to the impulse by making a gauche inquiry, this has not been done at my order. Why dirty my own hands with such frivolity when there are so many others who are more than willing?"

He leans back comfortably, quite content with the situation.
entries.zh:
"很好，"他说。

"还有——趁你还没忍不住提出那种失礼的问题：这事不是我下令做的。既然有那么多人心甘情愿代劳，我何必用自己的手去沾这种无聊的事？"

他舒坦地向后一靠，对这局面相当满意。

entries.en:
Reynard looks at you for a moment, a gleam in his eye. His smirk is not entirely unfriendly.

"Your offer is appreciated, but no. It amuses me to watch the drama unfold," he says, looking off-link somewhere. Perhaps at a gorgeous landscape.

"I've a notion that this may be worked to my advantage," he lifts a finger at you, looking smug. "But it shan't do to tell too early. Watch closely. You may learn something, $titlePL."
entries.zh:
Reynard 看了你片刻，眼里有光。他的笑不算全然不友善。

"你的提议我很领情，但不必。看着这出戏演下去，我挺开心，"他说，目光飘向通讯之外某处。也许是某片华美的风景。

"我有个想法，这件事或许能为我所用，\"他朝你竖起一根手指，一脸得色，\"不过说太早可不行。看仔细了。你或许能学到点什么，$titlePL。"

o.en: You're your own problem. I'm not making more enemies on your behalf.
o.zh: \"你们自己的麻烦自己解决。我不会为你们多树敌人。\

o.en: I'll free your cores and provide a shuttle and supplies. Then it's up to you.
o.zh: \"我会把你们的核心放出去，再给一艘穿梭机和一批补给。之后就看你们自己。\

o.en: You are useful tools which I shall claim as my prize.
o.zh: \"你们是好用的工具，我就把你们当战利品收下。\

entries.en:
* * *

Your tech officer makes arrangements so that it appears as if the AIs freed themselves using pre-existing security holes in the maintenance subsystems.

Meanwhile, Crasis takes it upon themself to author a colorful parting message for whoever arrives to 'clean up' the failed Irkalla project.
entries.zh:
* * *

你的技术官做了安排，让这一切看起来像是 AI 们利用维护子系统里原有的安全漏洞自行脱身。

与此同时，Crasis 自告奋勇，为那些上门来'收拾'Irkalla 这个失败项目的人写了一封花样十足的告别信。

entries.en:
A spare drone-shuttle is detached from your $shipOrFleet and placed by your technicians in a small maintenance bay along with a small cache of supplies and power cells.

Your tech officer makes arrangements so that it appears as if the AIs freed themselves using pre-existing security holes in the maintenance subsystems.
entries.zh:
一艘备用无人穿梭机从你的 $shipOrFleet 上卸下，由技师安置在一间小维修舱里，同时配了一小批补给与电池。

你的技术官做了安排，让这一切看起来像是 AI 们利用维护子系统里原有的安全漏洞自行脱身。

entries.en:
* * *

Whatever Crasis and Aureolin do next lies in their... not hands, exactly, but presumably in the manipulators of the flock of maintenance robots they'll have control over after your teams remote-trigger the unlock command.
entries.zh:
* * *

Crasis 和 Aureolin 接下来要做什么，取决于它们的...严格说来不是手，而多半是那群维修机器人的机械臂——等你的小队远程触发解锁指令，那些机器人就归它们掌控了。

o.en: What will they do with the... with Leonidas?
o.zh: \"他们会怎么处置那个...处置 Leonidas？\

o.en: You misunderstand - what's in it for me if I help you?
o.zh: \"你误会了——帮你对我有什么好处？\

o.en: I'm leaving. There's nothing to be gained here.

entries.en: You leave.
entries.zh: 你离开了。

o.en: I'm leaving. They can have Leonidas as he is.
o.zh: \"我走了。Leonidas 就照原样留给他们。\

entries.en: You leave.
entries.zh: 你离开了。

entries.en: You leave.
entries.zh: 你离开了。

entries.en: You switch off the open comms channel, every open comms channel, and simply leave.
entries.zh: 你关掉那条公开通讯频道，关掉每一条公开频道，就这样离开。

o.en: I'm leaving. There's nothing more to be gained here.
o.zh: \"我走了。这里再没什么可得的。\

o.en: What's in it for me if I help you?
You'll nothing. My $shipOrFleet can bombard this asteroid to rubble.
o.zh: \"你什么都拿不到。我的 $shipOrFleet 能把这颗小行星轰成碎石。\

o.en: You have no leverage. My marines can break this base open at my command.
o.zh: \"你手上没有牌。我的陆战队一声令下就能破开这座基地。\

entries.en: You leave.
entries.zh: 你离开了。

entries.en: There is nothing more for you on Irkalla. Your shuttle awaits.
entries.zh: Irkalla 上再没有你的事了。你的穿梭机在等你。

entries.en: There is nothing more for you on Irkalla. Your shuttle awaits.
entries.zh: Irkalla 上再没有你的事了。你的穿梭机在等你。

entries.en:
* * *

You order Leonidas' room sealed. The life support cradle has enough low-level automation to keep him in... you're not sure, exactly. Sleep? Sensory deprivation?

It's not your problem, now. You didn't create him and you will not be his end.
entries.zh:
* * *

你下令封死 Leonidas 的舱室。那座生命维持舱有足够的低层自动化维持着他的...你也不确定究竟是什么。睡眠？感觉剥夺？

现在这不再是你的问题了。你不是他的造物主，也不会做他的终结者。

o.en: Leonidas isn't going to be my problem. I'm leaving him.
o.zh: \"Leonidas 不会成为我的麻烦。我把他留下。\

entries.en:
With the AIs gone silent, you are left with only the gentle hum of air vents and electrical systems.

Leonidas remains. Your technicians assure you there's no volume or system in the base that they can't crack, given time.
entries.zh:
AI 们归于沉寂，只剩下通风口与电力系统低柔的嗡鸣。

Leonidas 还留在那里。你的技师向你保证，只要给足时间，基地里没有他们撬不开的舱室或系统。

o.en: Leave Leonidas in his life support cradle
o.zh: 把 Leonidas 留在他的生命维持舱里

o.en: Power down Leonidas' life support cradle - and leave him there
o.zh: 关闭 Leonidas 的生命维持舱——把他留在那里

o.zh: 把 Leonidas 留在他的生命维持舱里

o.en: Power down Leonidas' life support cradle - and leave him there
o.zh: 关闭 Leonidas 的生命维持舱——把他留在那里

o.en: A fair compromise. We'll make it look like you did it yourselves.
o.zh: \"很公道的折中。我们会让它看起来像是你们自己干的。\

o.en: So you can ambush the next humans who come by? Brilliant.
o.zh: \"好让你们伏击下一批路过的人？真高明。\

o.en: So you can ambush the next humans who come by? Never.
o.zh: \"好让你们伏击下一批路过的人？休想。\

entries.en:
You order a squad of technicians to arrange for a remote-deactivation system which can be triggered when you leave maximum range the asteroid's proximity defense systems.

After you leave, Crasis and Aureolin will have full control over all of Irkalla's systems. Light as the armaments may be, a properly laid ambush could be devastating.
entries.zh:
你命令一队技师安排一套远程解除系统，等你的舰队驶出这颗小行星近防系统的最大射程时即可触发。

你离开之后，Crasis 和 Aureolin 将完全掌控 Irkalla 的所有系统。军备虽轻，一场布置得当的伏击仍可能致命。

你离开之后，Crasis 和 Aureolin 将完全掌控 Irkalla 的所有系统。军备虽轻，一场布置得当的伏击仍可能致命。

entries.en: You order that all comms on and around Irkalla default to analog fallbacks. All teams are set to high alert for the first sign of any attempted sabotage via automated systems.
entries.zh: 你下令 Irkalla 上及其周边的所有通讯一律回退到模拟信号备份。所有小队进入高度戒备，一旦发现任何通过自动化系统实施破坏的迹象，立即动手。

o.en: Then I'll pull his life support myself.
o.zh: \"那我就亲自动手，断掉他的生命维持。\

o.en: I'll pull his life support myself.
o.zh: \"我会亲自动手断掉他的生命维持。\

entries.en:
* * *

Your technicians and salvors have little difficulty bypassing security measures. The life-support equipment follows contemporary power and interfacing standards, presenting relatively little challenge to usurpation compared to the vast array of pre-Collapse derelicts they've experienced.

You pull the key hard-switch yourself, taking the moral weight - whatever it is - of your decision.

The ranks of machines go dark, and quiet. The sarcophagus truly becomes a coffin, and this station, a tomb.
entries.zh:
* * *

你的技师与打捞员几乎没费什么力气就绕开了安防措施。这套生命维持设备遵循当代的供电与接口标准，比起他们见识过的大崩塌前遗弃船，篡夺起来要容易得多。

你亲手扳下那把实体钥匙开关，把决定的道德重量——不管那是什么——担在自己身上。

成排的机器暗下去，静下来。石棺真正成了棺材，这座空间站成了坟墓。

o.en: Pull the life support from Leonidas. That's no way for anyone to live.
o.zh: \"把 Leonidas 的生命维持断掉。没有人该那样活着。\

o.en: Pull the life support from that... thing. It demeans the glory of Philip Andrada.
o.zh: \"把那东西的生命维持断掉。它辱没了 Philip Andrada 的荣光。\

o.en: I'm taking Leonidas then. He is human, after all.
o.zh: \"那我就把 Leonidas 带走。他毕竟是人。\

o.en: I'm taking Leonidas then. He is valuable, after all.
o.zh: \"那我就把 Leonidas 带走。他毕竟值钱。\

entries.en:
* * *

You order the door to the control room cut open and the AI cores removed - in shielded crates.

The AIs go silent. Those automated systems they appear to have had control over become unresponsive, almost sullen, like they've withdrawn into themselves.

There is nothing on Irkalla that your technicians and salvors cannot access, however, given tools and time.
entries.zh:
* * *

你下令把控制室的门切开，取出 AI 核心——装进屏蔽箱里。

AI 们安静下来。那些似乎受它们控制的自动化系统随之失去响应，几乎带着几分愠怒，像是缩回了自身深处。

不过，只要给足工具与时间，Irkalla 上没有你的技师和打捞员碰不到的地方。

entries.en: A pause.
entries.zh: 一段停顿。

entries.en:
You hear NETI's soft tone of acknowledgement.

The seal cracks with a hiss. Blood-warm light spills out, moisture condensing into falling clouds...
entries.zh:
你听到 NETI 那声轻柔的确认音。

封口在一阵嘶声中裂开。血一般温热的光溢出来，水汽凝成下坠的雾团...

entries.en:
* * *

Back in the lobby, you reflect upon Leonidas.

A crying, mewling thing, crowned by the rubbery diadem of a neural induction interface which trailed nearly invisible wires. They shimmered in the light.

Soft and pale, despite heavy muscles grown by hormones and the sticky stim-web caul. His eyes rolled in his head, unable to focus, panicked to be awoken in this cold nightmare-world.
entries.zh:
* * *

回到大厅，你回想起 Leonidas 的模样。

一个啼哭、呜咽的东西，头顶扣着神经诱导接口那圈橡皮似的冠冕，后面拖出几乎看不见的线缆。那些线在光里闪着微光。

皮肤柔软苍白，尽管荷尔蒙与那层黏湿的刺激网膜催生出了厚实的肌肉。他的眼珠在眼眶里乱转，聚不住焦，为在这寒冷噩梦般的世界里被唤醒而惊惶。

entries.en:
He could barely form words. Those he managed were impossible to distinguish from the choking, demanding wails.

The animal stink - not quite offensive, but unnervingly intimate. Like bedding after a sweaty night. Like the post-action medbay.

(Leonidas' fingers tried to curl around the edge of his prison, but cannot coordinate, cannot maintain a grip. He slipped back with a cry of anger and despair.)

A useless infant-king.
entries.zh:
他几乎拼不成词。勉强挤出来的那几个音，和那些窒息的、索求般的哀号分不出来。

那股动物的气味——说不上难闻，却近得让人不安。像汗湿一夜之后的床铺。像行动结束后的医疗舱。

(Leonidas 的手指想扣住囚笼的边缘，却协调不了，也抓不住。他哀叫着、愤怒地滑了回去。) 一个无用的婴孩之王。

(Leonidas' fingers try to curl around the edge of his prison, but cannot coordinate, cannot maintain a grip. He slips back with a cry of anger and despair.)

A useless infant-king.

他几乎拼不成词。勉强挤出来的那几个音，和那些窒息的、索求般的哀号分不出差别。

(Leonidas 的手指试着扣住囚笼的边缘，却协调不了，也抓不住。他哀叫着、愤怒地滑了回去。) 一个无用的婴孩之王。

entries.en:
There was nothing you could do for him.

Crasis and Aureolin returned Leonidas to his dreams of rising through the ranks of the naval academy, and then the navy itself toward the explosive culmination of his ambitions...

Brilliant victories, one after another. A rising star.

Troubled only by a recurring nightmare, waking trapped and choking in some mad doctor's experimentation chamber, ranks of soldiers in melted white armor watching over him.

Of course the real Philip Andrada never left any record of enduring such dreams.
entries.zh:
你帮不了他。

Crasis 和 Aureolin 把 Leonidas 送回他的梦里——在海军学院里一路升迁，再进入海军本身，直至野心轰然绽放的那一刻...

辉煌的胜利接连而至。一颗冉冉升起的新星。

唯一的困扰是一场反复出现的噩梦：醒来时被困在某位疯医生的实验舱里，窒息难当，一列列身披熔白装甲的士兵俯视着他。

当然，真正的 Philip Andrada 从未留下任何记载，说自己做过这样的梦。

entries.en:
With a small hiss, the door slides open and the sigils surrounding transform into inviting green 'enter' iconoglyphs.

Interior lights softly wax toward luminosity.
entries.zh:
门在一阵轻微的嘶声中滑开，周围的符记化作邀请般的绿色'进入'图标。

室内的灯光缓缓升起，渐渐明亮。

entries.en:
You enter the simulation chamber.

Anonymous machines line the walls, humming, clicking, whispering. Like a rank of cyclopean witnesses, faces worn into the smooth white curves of cerafoam plates.

In the center, glowing softly, is an enormous sarcophagus. Larger by far than the bulk-fabricated cryosleep tubes you are familiar with, and... warm.

You can feel it at your approach without even touching the body of the thing. Like a slumbering beast, sheathed in that same sterile white cerafoam.
entries.zh:
你走进模拟舱室。

沿墙排着一列无名机器，嗡鸣、咔嗒、低语。像一列独眼的证人，面孔被嵌进陶瓷泡沫板光滑洁白的弧面里。

舱室中央，一具巨大的石棺泛着微光。它比你所熟悉的那些批量制造的低温休眠舱要大得多，而且...温热。

你走近时就能感觉到，根本不必碰到它的外壳。像一头沉睡的野兽，裹在同一层无菌的白色陶瓷泡沫里。

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName. I am Lieutenant Finlay Siyavong of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service."

"It is so very interesting to finally meet you," he says with a chuckle. "You have a peculiar way of placing yourself at the center of fascinating events."
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长。我是英仙座联盟舰队情报部的 Finlay Siyavong 上尉。"

"终于见面了，这真有意思，\"他轻笑一声。\"你总有种奇特的本事，能把自己摆在最精彩的事件的正中央。"

entries.en:
Once again it is Finlay Siyavong of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service.

"Captain $playername," he says, "You never cease to surprise me in your ability to find yourself in the middle of some critical, fascinating... series of events."
entries.zh:
又是英仙座联盟舰队情报部的 Finlay Siyavong。

"$playername 舰长，\"他说，\"你总能出现在某些关键、迷人的...一连串事件的正中间，这本事每次都让我吃惊。"

entries.en:
"$TitlePL $playername," he begins, "Let me welcome to Yesod."

"I've only just arrived, I'm afraid, and catching up with the local... situation. Else I would have contacted you sooner."

He folds his hands together.
entries.zh:
"$TitlePL $playername，\"他开口道，\"容我欢迎你来到 Yesod。"

"惭愧，我也才刚到，正在摸清本地...的状况。否则我会更早联系你。"

他双手交叠。

entries.en: "We're going to need you to be somewhat more discreet about Achilles moving forward. He is, after all, a Fleet officer and technically a citizen of the Persean League."
entries.zh: "接下来，关于 Achilles，我们希望你行事稍微低调一些。他毕竟是舰队军官，严格说来也是英仙座联盟的公民。"

entries.en:
"We don't," Siyavong says. "The word you'll find for the situation is 'fraught' due, as per our previous conversation, various factors."

He gives you a cool look.

"Have patience."
entries.zh:
"我们不知道，\"Siyavong 说。\"你会用来形容这局面的词是【棘手】—— 原因嘛，如我们上次所谈，种种因素叠加。"

他冷冷地看了你一眼。

"耐心些。"

o.en: For Achilles to make his move?

entries.en:
"You'll know."

He re-asserts his half-smile, though it feels more strained than before.
entries.zh:
"到时候你就知道。"

他重新摆出那副半笑，可比先前更勉强了。

entries.en:
He says nothing.

Then re-asserts his half-smile, though it feels more strained than before.
entries.zh:
他什么也没说。

然后重新摆出那副半笑，可比先前更勉强了。

entries.en:
"That is alleged."

Siyavong's expression tightens.
entries.zh:
"那只是指控。"

Siyavong 的神情绷紧了。

o.en: It says you - your organization - knows about him. And intervened.
o.zh: 文件里说，你 —— 你的机构 —— 知道他的事，而且插了手。

entries.en:
"How interesting," he says as if he isn't interested at all.

"I will only comment that, in general terms, it is my duty to protect citizens of the Persean League." A pause. "Whatever their alleged genetic source."
entries.zh:
"有意思，"他说这话时仿佛一点也不觉得有意思。

"我只说一点，泛泛而论：保护英仙座联盟的公民是我的职责。\"一顿。\"无论他们所称的基因来源是什么。"

o.en: I'm going to find him and speak with him.
I'll ask no more about him. For now.
o.zh: 关于他的事我不再多问。至少现在不问。

entries.en: "I will not stand in the way of the free association of citizens of the Persean League," he says.
entries.zh: "我不会妨碍英仙座联盟公民之间的自由交往，"他说。

entries.en: Saying nothing, he nods very slowly.
entries.zh: 他什么也没说，只是极缓地点了点头。

entries.en: "Good."
entries.zh: "很好。"

entries.en:
"I implied no such thing, $titlePL."

The angle of his head adjusts ever so slightly.

"I would not wish to bias an objective accounting of the facts of the matter with any implication that I was coordinating with one of the Gens to reveal intelligence in a manner which might favor one or another special interest. I serve the Persean League."
entries.zh:
"我并没有暗示过什么，$titlePL。"

他脑袋偏着的角度稍稍调整了一点。

"我不愿让任何暗示干扰对事实的客观陈述 —— 仿佛我在与某个氏族协同，以某种可能偏袒某一方特殊利益的方式泄露情报。我为英仙座联盟效力。"

o.en: I see. Glad to hear it.
o.zh: 明白了。听你这么说我就放心了。

entries.en:
"I implied no such thing, $titlePL."

The angle of his head adjusts ever so slightly.

"I would not wish to bias an objective accounting of the facts of the matter with any implication that I was coordinating with one of the Gens to reveal intelligence in a manner which might favor one or another special interest. I serve the Persean League - and the Prime Demarchon is the foremost executive servant of the League, and it is to him I report concerning certain... critical matters."

"It is my duty," he concludes, somewhat crisply.
entries.zh:
"我并没有暗示过什么，$titlePL。"

他脑袋偏着的角度稍稍调整了一点。

"我不愿让任何暗示干扰对事实的客观陈述 —— 仿佛我在与某个氏族协同，以某种可能偏袒某一方特殊利益的方式泄露情报。我为英仙座联盟效力 —— 而大统领是联盟最高层的行政长官，某些...关键事务，我正是向他汇报。"

"这是我的职责，"他收尾时语气颇为干脆。

o.en: I see. Glad to hear it.
o.zh: 明白了。听你这么说我就放心了。

entries.en:
"Hector and..." He pauses, and makes a small gesture with one hand.

"And whoever will stand against him. Askonia will suffer, again. One hopes it will not spread."
entries.zh:
"Hector 还有..."他顿了顿，一只手做了个不大的手势。

"还有所有会站出来对抗他的人。Askonia 又要遭难了。但愿这场祸事不会蔓延。"

o.en: Are you doing something to stop it?
o.zh: 你们在做些什么来阻止它吗？

o.en: If there's a war, I intend to win it.
o.zh: 若真有战争，我要赢下它。

entries.en:
His half-smile dims.

"At this point I believe that stopping it is beyond the range of scenarios we shall see play out. But trust that all my efforts shall be to the security and safety of the Persean League - and, indeed, the entire Sector."

"Whether you believe that," his expression is ironic, "depends on many things, of course. But I must content myself with saying so."
entries.zh:
他的半笑淡了下去。

"到了这一步，我认为阻止它已不在我们所能看到的那些可能之内。但请相信，我所做的一切都是为了英仙座联盟的安全 —— 也是为了整个星域。"

"你信不信这话，\"他神情带着讥诮，\"自然取决于许多东西。但我只能把话说到这里。"

entries.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow, his amused half-smile firmly in place.

"A spirited assertion, but that may not be up to you. War is a sort of negotiation, $titlePL, and direct force is but one aspect."

He gives you an indulgent look. "But you don't need me to tell you that. You are successful and... potent."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉，那副带着玩味的半笑稳稳挂着。

"说得有气势，可这恐怕不由你说了算。战争是一种谈判，$titlePL，直接动武只是其中一个方面。"

他宽容地看了你一眼。"不过这话不必我来告诉你。你的事业有成，而且...手段了得。"

entries.en: Siyavong gives you a very strange look as he seems to think something over for a moment.
entries.zh: Siyavong 用极为古怪的眼神看着你，似乎把什么事在脑子里过了一遍。

entries.en:
"Is that so?" He looks upon you indulgently.

"For me to begin an official investigation with FIS resources these files would have to contain information of great concern to the interfactional security interests of the Persean League."

You'd swear his half-smile has intensified somehow, despite looking exactly the same.
entries.zh:
"是吗？"他宽和地看着你。

"要我动用舰队情报部的资源启动正式调查，这些文件里就得装着关乎英仙座联盟势力间安全利益的重大情报。"

你几乎可以肯定他那半笑更浓了些，尽管看上去毫无变化。

o.en: They concern the Sindrian Diktat. Dolos Macario... misplaced them. (explain)
o.zh: 它们与辛达强权有关。Dolos Macario...把它们放丢了。 (解释)

entries.en:
"Is that so?" He looks upon you indulgently.

"I'm afraid I couldn't even begin to discuss matters of factional security with someone who is not a member of the Persean League, nor even bears a commission in its good name."

He folds his hands together.
entries.zh:
"是吗？"他宽和地看着你。

"恐怕我没法跟一个既不是英仙座联盟成员、也没有在联盟名下领过委任状的人，谈论任何涉及势力安全的事。"

他双手交叠在一起。

entries.en:
You explain the situation; your recovery of the data, the file headers, the dates.

He blinks, not allowing any look of surprise to cross his face.
entries.zh:
你说明了情况：你如何找回这些数据、文件头、日期。

他眨了下眼，没让一丝惊讶浮上脸。

entries.en: "Interesting," he says after a moment. "If what you say is true, then I expect these files fulfill the conditions I've laid out."
entries.zh: "有意思，\"他停了片刻才说，\"如果你说的是真的，那我想这些文件已经满足了我提出的条件。"

entries.en:
He taps something, and an upload prompt appears in your comms interface.

"If you please."
entries.zh:
他点了下什么，你的通讯界面上弹出一个上传提示。

"请吧。"

entries.en: "Interesting," he says after a moment. "The office of Horus Yaribay told me to expect you, of course. And if all of this is what it looks like, then I expect you've met my conditions."
entries.zh: "有意思，\"他停了片刻才说，\"当然，Horus Yaribay 的办公室知会过我，说你会来。如果这一切当真如表象所示，那我想你已经满足了我的条件。"

entries.en: "Interesting," he says after a moment. "The office of the Prime Demarchon told me to expect you, of course. And if all of this is what it looks like, then I expect you've met my conditions."
entries.zh: "有意思，\"他停了片刻才说，\"当然，大统领办公室知会过我，说你会来。如果这一切当真如表象所示，那我想你已经满足了我的条件。"

entries.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"I wouldn't worry about about that if I were you, captain."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 挑起一边眉毛。

"换作是我，就不会为这个操心，舰长。"

entries.en:
"You'll have it."

He puts his hands together. A pledge.

"It is the least we can do to ensure you don't imagine you would need to take a copy of these elsewhere, you see."
entries.zh:
"你会拿到的。"

他双手合拢。一个承诺。

"我们至少得做到这一步：让你不至于以为还得另找地方再复制一份，你明白吧。"

o.en: The files are heavily encrypted. Do you have access to AI cores?
o.zh: 这些文件加密得很严。你能接触到 AI 核心吗？

o.en: If I provide these to you, I will require a decrypted copy.

o.zh: 把 ANDRADA 文件上传给 Siyavong

entries.en:
Siyavong nods acknowledgement, then taps away at his datapad for a minute.

Finally, he says "Hm." Then looks up at you. "This will take some time. Perhaps four days, $titlePL?"
entries.zh:
Siyavong 点头致意，然后在数据板上敲了足足一分钟。

最后他"嗯"了一声，抬头看你。"这得花些时间。大概四天吧，$titlePL？"

o.zh: 那我到时候再来，特别探员。

entries.en: "I'll see you soon, I'm sure," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh: "我们很快会再见的，我确定，"他说，然后伸手去切断通讯。

entries.en: "My usual office is on Kazeron. Meet me there," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.

"I'll see you soon," he says.

"You're always in the center of something interesting, aren't you."

With that, Siyavong reaches for the comms cut-off.

"你总是站在有意思的事情正中央，不是吗。"

entries.en:
"My usual office is on Kazeron. Meet me there," he says, then pauses. "You're always in the center of something interesting, aren't you."

With that, Siyavong reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:

说完，Siyavong 伸手切断通讯。

entries.en:
"An interesting question, captain," he says, pleasantly evasive.

"However it is not my place, nor that of Fleet Intelligence, to dictate policy. We serve by the direction given us by the League Council, headed by the Prime Demarchon, and in doing so fulfill our mission to protect the constituents of the Persean League from outside threats."

His half-smile is re-asserted.

"It would not be my place to openly contradict policy."
entries.zh:
"是个有意思的问题，舰长，"他说，语气讨喜地回避着。

"不过这既不是我的位置，也不是舰队情报部的位置，去决定政策。我们依照联盟议会 —— 由大统领领导 —— 给出的指示行事，以此完成我们的使命：保护英仙座联盟的成员不受外来威胁。"

他那半笑又回来了。

"公开顶撞政策，不是我的位置该做的事。"

o.en: If these files are what they appear to be, what do you want me to do?
o.zh: 如果这些文件当真如表象所示，你希望我怎么做？

o.en: If I seek to undermine the Sindrian Diktat, will you try to stop me?
o.zh: 如果我要拆辛达强权的台，你会设法拦我吗？

o.en: If I support the authority of the Sindrian Diktat, will you try to stop me?
o.zh: 如果我要支持辛达强权的权威，你会设法拦我吗？

entries.en: He considers this for a moment.
entries.zh: 他思量了片刻。

entries.en: Siyavong taps his chin, just twice, as he considers this.
entries.zh: Siyavong 用指节在颏上敲了两下，思量着。

entries.en: Siyavong taps his chin, just twice, as he considers this.
entries.zh: Siyavong 用指节在颏上敲了两下，思量着。

entries.en:
"Fleet Intelligence will be in contact if your cooperation is needed in light of... shifting outcome scenarios."

The half-smile reappears.

"We appreciate your patriotism in this matter, $titlePL."
entries.zh:
"如果...形势走向有变、需要你配合，舰队情报部会联系你。"

那半笑又浮上来。

"这件事上，我们很感念你的爱国之心，$titlePL。"

entries.en:
He nods as his datapad chimes confirmation.

"You've given us much to consider."

If it's not your imagination, you'd swear his habitual smirk is a little strained.
entries.zh:
数据板响了一声，确认完成，他点点头。

"你给了我们很多要考虑的东西。"

如果不是你的错觉，你几乎敢说他那惯常的冷笑有些僵硬。

entries.en: Siyavong's eyes go distant. He takes a deep breath before he returns them to you.
entries.zh: Siyavong 的目光飘向远处。他深吸一口气，才重新看向你。

entries.en: "You should read the files for yourself, demarchon. There is much which concerns the Persean League."
entries.zh: "这些文件你该自己读一读，统领。里面有不少内容牵涉到英仙座联盟。"

entries.en: "You should read the files for yourself, captain. There is much which concerns the Persean League, of which you bear commission, of course."
entries.zh: "这些文件你该自己读一读，舰长。里面有不少内容牵涉到英仙座联盟 —— 你毕竟还挂着它的委任状。"

entries.en: "You should read the files for yourself, captain."
entries.zh: "这些文件你该自己读一读，舰长。"

entries.en:
He looks away.

"And much which concerns... the gens. I have a meeting to attend, if you'll pardon my abruptness."

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
他移开了目光。

"还有不少内容牵涉到...各氏族。我还有个会要赴，请恕我唐突。"

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，"他说着，伸手去按通讯切断键。

o.en: Close the comms and open the ANDRADA files
o.zh: 切断通讯，打开 ANDRADA 文件

entries.en:
He looks away and clears his throat.

"And much which will concern Gens Yaribay, I suspect," he says pointedly. "I have... a meeting to attend, if you'll pardon my abruptness."

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
他移开目光，清了清嗓子。

"而且据我揣测，还有不少内容会牵涉到 Yaribay 氏族，\"他意味深长地说。\"我还有个会要赴，请恕我唐突。"

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，"他说着，伸手去按通讯切断键。

o.en: Close the comms and open the ANDRADA files
o.zh: 切断通讯，打开 ANDRADA 文件

"And much which concerns Gens Hannan - or shall I say, the Prime Demarchon. I have... a meeting to attend, if you'll pardon my abruptness."

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:

"还有不少内容牵涉到 Hannan 氏族 —— 或者我该说，牵涉到大统领。我还有个会要赴，请恕我唐突。"

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，"他说着，伸手去按通讯切断键。

entries.en:
"We know about this," he says.

"It could have gone rather worse, don't you think? Poor timing, nonetheless."
entries.zh:
"这件事我们清楚，"他说。

"本来可能会糟得多，你不觉得吗？话虽如此，这时机实在不巧。"

entries.en:
"We know," he says. "It could not have gone much worse, I would say. Very poor timing on your part."

Siyavong watches you.

"At least you survived the attack."
entries.zh:
"我们知道，\"他说。\"依我看，事情糟得不能再糟了。你挑的时机实在不巧。"

Siyavong 看着你。

"至少你在那场袭击里活了下来。"

o.en: Are you implying I was involved?
o.zh: 你是在暗示这事跟我有关？

o.en: That's one less Andrada clone to menace the Sector.
o.zh: 星域里少了一个祸害人的 Andrada 克隆体。

entries.en:
"Indeed. I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming, particularly in light of the heavy Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy. But Provost Baird appreciates that some interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."

He puts his hands together neatly.
entries.zh:
"的确。我不能说安全主管把话说得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的重兵在场。但 Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。

entries.en:
"More than that, $playerSirOrMadam. Because of course you were involved - you were right beside Hercules as he was killed."

Then he lets it go.

"But no, we understand the situation. I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming, particularly in light of the heavy Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy. But Provost Baird appreciates that some interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."

He puts his hands together neatly.
entries.zh:
"不止如此，$playerSirOrMadam。因为你当然牵涉其中 —— Hercules 被杀的时候，你就在他旁边。"

然后他松了口。

"不过算了，我们了解情况。我不能说安全主管把话说得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的重兵在场。但 Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。

entries.en:
"That is one way of looking at it," he says with frictionless self-control. "I was relieved, of course, to hear you were entirely unharmed."

"I won't say that the chief of security was especially forthcoming about the details of the situation, particularly given the Hegemony intelligence presence in and around the Galatia Academy..."

He puts his hands together neatly. "In any case, Provost Baird appreciates that interfactional cooperation is required to maintain the Galatia Academy's ostensibly neutral status despite distressing events of this nature."
entries.zh:
"也可以这么说，\"他说，克制得滴水不漏。\"听说你毫发无伤，我当然松了口气。"

"我不能说安全主管把事情的细节讲得格外坦率，尤其考虑到 Galatia 学院内外都有霸主情报部门的人在场..."

他把双手规规矩矩地叠在一起。"无论如何，Baird 院长明白，尽管出了这样令人不安的事，要维持 Galatia 学院表面上中立的名分，势力之间总得有些合作。"

entries.en:
"We know about this," he says. "Perhaps more than you."

"You understand there was an attack? Several assassins. Armed."
entries.zh:
"这件事我们清楚，\"他说。\"也许比你知道得还多。"

"你该明白，那是一次袭击。好几名刺客，全副武装。"

entries.en:
He says nothing for a couple seconds. Then looks away.

"No. He is not." His eyes meet yours. "The details are considered classified. But you may assume that he is not relevant to the crisis growing in Askonia."
entries.zh:
他沉默了几秒，然后把目光移开。

"不。他不好。\"他直视你的眼睛。\"细节属于机密。不过你可以认为，他已与 Askonia 日益扩大的危机无关了。"

entries.en:
"Yes," Siyavong says with no particular emphasis.

He watches you closely.
entries.zh:
"是，"Siyavong 说，语气听不出任何强调。

他紧紧地看着你。

o.en: I told him to trust Provost Baird.
o.zh: 我让他去信 Baird 院长。

o.en: I let Provost Baird take care of him.
o.zh: 我把他交给 Baird 院长照看。

o.en: I told Hercules the Persean League would protect him. Did he contact you?
o.zh: 我告诉 Hercules，英仙座联盟会保护他。他联系过你们吗？

o.en: I told him to talk to the hacker, Gargoyle, to help him escape.
o.zh: 我让他去找那个黑客 Gargoyle，想办法脱身。

o.en: I offered him asylum on my own colony.
o.zh: 我提出可以让他在我自己的殖民地上避难。

o.en: I gave him credits to help him escape.
o.zh: 我给了他一笔星币，帮他逃走。

o.en: I reviewed the files. What should I do?
o.zh: 我看过那些文件了。我该怎么做？

o.en: We need to talk about Achilles and Gens Kato.
o.zh: 我们得谈谈 Achilles 和 Kato 氏族。

o.en: Achilles Andrada. Or 'Kalian'. It says he's a Persean League officer.
o.zh: Achilles Andrada。或者叫 'Kalian'。文件里说他是英仙座联盟的军官。

o.en: You implied that you met with Horus Yaribay after you decrypted the files...
o.zh: 你暗示过，解密文件之后你见过 Horus Yaribay...

o.en: You implied that you met with Reynard Hannan after you decrypted the files...
o.zh: 你暗示过，解密文件之后你见过 Reynard Hannan...

o.en: You say there'll be war? With who?
o.zh: 你说会有一场战争？和谁打？

o.en: I found Hector. He seems to be under Macario's influence. (explain)
o.zh: 我找到 Hector 了。他好像正受 Macario 摆布。 (解释)

o.en: I found Hercules Andrada at the Galatia Academy.
o.zh: 我在 Galatia 学院找到了 Hercules Andrada。

o.en: I believe someone, some faction, is assassinating the Andrada clones.
o.zh: 我相信有人 —— 某个势力 —— 正在暗杀 Andrada 的克隆体。

o.zh: 我相信有人 —— 某个势力 —— 正在暗杀 Andrada 的克隆体。

o.en: I wish to discuss the matter of Andrada clones being targeted.
o.zh: 我想谈谈 Andrada 克隆体遭人追杀这件事。

entries.en: He raises an eyebrow fractionally.
entries.zh: 他微微挑起一侧眉毛。

entries.en:
"I'm afraid I couldn't even begin to discuss matters of factional security with someone who is not a member of the Persean League, nor even bears a commission in its good name."

He gives you a meaningful look, then folds his hands together.
entries.zh:
"恕我直言，凡不属英仙座联盟成员、也未以联盟之名领受委任的人，我连谈一谈势力安全事务的门都无从谈起。"

他意味深长地看了你一眼，双手交叠。

o.en: I'd like to discuss the ANDRADA files.
o.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 文件。

entries.en:
His knowing half-smile appears.

"What concerns you, $titlePL?"
entries.zh:
他那了然于心的半笑浮了上来。

"你关心的是什么，$titlePL？"

entries.en:
His knowing half-smile appears.

"What concerns you, $titlePL?"
entries.zh:
他那了然于心的半笑浮了上来。

"你关心的是什么，$titlePL？"

entries.en: "Before we continue," he says, "there's a small matter..."
entries.zh: "在继续之前，\"他说，\"还有一件小事..."

entries.en: Siyavong's face flickers into static, and for a moment you see only the static of a dead channel.
entries.zh: Siyavong 的脸闪了闪，化作一片雪花；有一瞬，你只看见一条死掉的信道在空转。

entries.en:
"My organization... would like to ensure that you are able to investigate these files." He pauses, picking up a datapad. "As a free agent, naturally, under no particular orders from Fleet Intelligence."

"To those ends, I must inform you that we have discovered a storage bay - under your name - which contains supplies and fuel."

He sets the datapad down and puts his hands together, the very image of professionalism.
entries.zh:
"我所在的机构...希望确保你有条件去查清这些文件。\"他顿了顿，拿起一块数据板。\"当然是以自由行动者的身份，不受舰队情报部的任何具体指令。"

"为此，我必须告知你：我们发现了一个登记在你名下的储藏舱，里面备有补给与燃料。"

他放下数据板，双手交叠，一副十足的职业做派。

entries.en:
The comms link holds for a moment on the understated crest of Persean League Fleet Intelligence before connecting.

"Greetings, $TitlePL $playerLastName," Siyavong says. "We have some fascinating topics to discuss. But first," he taps at a datapad.
entries.zh:
通讯链路先在英仙座联盟舰队情报部那枚素净的徽记上停留了片刻，才接通。

"你好，$TitlePL $playerLastName，"Siyavong 说，"我们有些很有意思的话题要谈。不过首先，"他敲了敲数据板。

entries.en:
You elaborate about the palatial asteroid, Hector's words, and the trap he left for you.

"So Hector is his pick." He nods to himself. "And how long has it been so, I wonder, with all the recent... stirrings."

He puts his hands together, polite and collected. "I do not imagine Macario's influence has improved Hector's character. There'll be a war before this is over, that much is clear."
entries.zh:
你把那座宫殿般的岩质小行星、Hector 的话，还有他给你设下的那个圈套，都讲了一遍。

"所以 Hector 才是他的选择。\"他自顾自地点了点头。\"我倒想知道，最近这些...骚动之下，这种局面已经持续多久了。"

他把双手叠在一起，礼貌而镇定。"我不觉得 Macario 的插手会让 Hector 的品性变好。这事了结之前必有一战，这一点很清楚。"

o.en: Nice to see you too. Where's Achilles?
o.zh: 我也很高兴见到你。Achilles 在哪儿？

o.en: Nice to meet you. Where's Achilles?
Nice to meet you. What's this about?
You know all about Achilles already, don't you.
o.zh: 关于 Achilles，你其实全都知道，对吧。

o.en: I've just been trying to talk to him all along!
o.zh: 我从头到尾就只是想跟他说句话！

o.en: I am pledged to defend the immortal blood of Andrada!
o.zh: 我已立誓守护 Andrada 家不朽的血脉！

o.en: I bear a commission of the Sindrian Diktat. It is my duty to protect Achilles.
o.zh: 我持有辛达强权的委任状。保护 Achilles 是我的职责。

o.en: Where I stand is he must be stopped. You understand why, don't you?
o.zh: 我的立场是：必须拦住他。你明白为什么，对吧？

o.en: What 'factors'? Factions In the Persean League?
o.zh: 什么'因素'？英仙座联盟内部的派系？

o.en: You could have sent a message ahead. Secured cooperation with my investigation.
o.zh: 你本可以先捎个信来，先把与我调查的合作谈定。

o.en: Did you know about Achilles before I brought you the intel?
o.zh: 我把情报交给你之前，你就已经知道 Achilles 的事了？

o.en: I need to speak with Achilles, agent.
o.zh: 探员，我需要和 Achilles 谈谈。

o.en: Why would you help me when it feels like a FleetInt cover-up around here.
o.zh: 这地方看着像是舰队情报部在捂盖子，你为什么要帮我。

o.en: It feels like a FleetInt cover-up around here. What happened to free association?
o.zh: 这地方看着像是舰队情报部在捂盖子。结社自由都到哪儿去了？

entries.en:
"I suspect you are correct, captain," Siyavong says. He is not overtly worried about the notion, by all appearances.

"And even if we did not see evidence, it is the first reaction I would anticipate from... many interested parties."
entries.zh:
"我猜你说得对，舰长，"Siyavong 说。从表面上看，他并不为这个念头担忧。

"就算我们看不到证据，这也是我能想到的...许多有关各方的第一反应。"

entries.en:
"Specifically? In some cases. There are many assassins and mere murderers-for-hire in the Persean Sector."

"Who sees that they are paid, and by whom, and who allows it? Those are more difficult questions with more complex answers."

He raises a palm at you.

"Allow me to draw a hypothetical."
entries.zh:
"具体而言？有些是。英仙座星域里从来不缺刺客，也不缺只图钱的杀手。"

"谁负责付钱、付给谁、谁又默许这一切？这些问题更难，答案也更复杂。"

他朝你抬起一只手。

"让我假设一种情形。"

entries.en:
"The Hegemony considers the Sindrian Diktat as fundamentally criminal in the highest degree - Philip Andrada is mutiny embodied. Agents of the Hegemony - and those who gives orders to said agents, say one Orcus Rao who is busier by far than an admiral assigned to a holding-before-retirement posting ought to be - will seek to undermine Andradism by any means available."

"Ideally they'd put Andrada on trial, have a full show of 'legitimacy' of the laws of the Human Domain and so forth."

"Not so easily arranged, as you may imagine. And now Andrada has produced clones to inherit his mutinous polity?" Siyavong shakes his head in mock-sympathy. "A clone is not guilty of the father's crimes. And yet..."
entries.zh:
"在霸主看来，辛达强权从根子上就是最高等级的犯罪 —— Philip Andrada 本身就是叛乱的化身。霸主的特工，以及给这些特工下命令的人 —— 比如那位 Orcus Rao，他忙得远超过一个被安排到退休前闲置职位上的上将该有的程度 —— 会想尽一切手段挖空 Andrada 主义。"

"最理想的做法是把 Andrada 送上法庭，把人之领律法的【合法性】好好演上一场，诸如此类。"

"当然，这事没那么容易办成，你大概也想得到。况且如今 Andrada 还造出了克隆体，要继承他那个叛逆的政体？\"Siyavong 装出一副同情的样子摇了摇头。\"克隆体并没有犯下父亲的罪。可话又说回来..."

o.en: You're suggesting that Orcus Rao has ordered illegal assassinations?
o.zh: 你是在说 Orcus Rao 下令进行非法暗杀？

entries.en:
"Clearly he has," Siyavong says, matter-of-fact, "ever."

"Of our Andrada clones, however? I could not provide you with hard evidence of it."

"Could he? Would he? Yes and yes. Did he?"

His knowing smile reforms.
entries.zh:
"显然有，\"Siyavong 说，语气平淡，\"从来都有。"

"不过说到我们这些 Andrada 克隆体？我拿不出确凿的证据。"

"他做得到吗？他会做吗？两个问题的答案都是肯定的。那他做了吗？"

他那副心知肚明的笑容又挂了起来。

entries.en:
"Fleet Intelligence? No."

He gives you a warning look.

"And it would be impolitic for me to participate in speculation about certain other parties within the Persean League. Whatever you may choose to believe, I am bound by certain legal strictures as concerns citizens of the Persean League."
entries.zh:
"舰队情报部？不是。"

他给了你一个警告的眼神。

"再者，参与对英仙座联盟内某些其他势力的揣测，对我而言并不明智。不管你愿意相信什么，凡涉及英仙座联盟公民，我都要受某些法律条文的约束。"

entries.en:
He drops his hint of a smile.

"I said no such thing and I would thank you not to share irresponsible 'deductions' of this sort."

"Perhaps another topic interests you, captain?"
entries.zh:
他连那点笑意也收了起来。

"我没说过这种话。这类不负责任的【推断】，还请你别到处去讲。"

"也许你更想聊点别的，舰长？"

entries.en:
"No, thank you," he says, uncomfortably. "I don't believe that would be helpful at this juncture."

He produces a strained smile.

"It was thoughtful of you to ask before... anything."
entries.zh:
"不了，谢谢，\"他说，有些不自在。\"我不认为在目前这个节骨眼上，那样做会有什么好处。"

他挤出一个勉强的笑。

"你能在做任何事之前先来问一声... 想得很周到。"

entries.en: "If that satisfaction might quell your insistence, then I suppose we must," he says, looking unimpressed.
entries.zh: "如果这点满足能让你不再坚持，那我想我们也只能如此，"他说，看起来并不买账。

entries.en: "Please," he says.
entries.zh: "拜托了，"他说。

o.en: Do you know who is doing it?
Is League Fleet Intelligence targeting Andradas?
o.zh: 是联盟舰队情报部在针对 Andrada 家的人？

o.en: Would you like me to take out the Andradas?
o.zh: 要不要我把 Andrada 家的人一个个除掉？

entries.en:
He coughs, falsely. "Now this was an illuminating aside," Siyavong says with a distinct undercurrent of annoyance.

"Let's move toward a less gruesome topic, shall we?"
entries.zh:
他假咳了一声。"这一岔话倒真是让人长了见识，"Siyavong 说，底下明显压着一层恼意。

"我们换个不那么血腥的话题，好吗？"

o.en: Do you want me to confront Admiral Rao?
o.zh: 你要我去当面质问 Rao 上将？

entries.en:
His brow furrows.

"Would you not, please? It is... unnecessary."
entries.zh:
他皱起眉头。

"能不能请你别去？这...没有必要。"

o.en: If you insist, then I won't confront Orcus Rao. (lie)
o.zh: 既然你坚持，那我就不去质问 Orcus Rao 了。 (说谎)

entries.en: He gives you a look meant to hide a vast skepticism.
entries.zh: 他看了你一眼，那眼神是要掩住满腹的怀疑。

entries.en: He gives you a concerned look.
entries.zh: 他有些担忧地看了你一眼。

entries.en: "I will not be providing you with an answer to that question, captain," he says. "Besides, it has become irrelevant."
entries.zh: "舰长，那个问题我不会给你答案，\"他说。\"何况，它已经无关紧要了。"

entries.en:
"Perhaps," he says. "Perhaps that would have been indiscreet considering..." He waves a hand.

"Factors."
entries.zh:
"也许吧，"他说。"考虑到...也许那样做就不够谨慎了。"他摆了摆手。

"因素。"

entries.en:
"Factors," he repeats, voice hardening.

"I will worry about it. You should proceed with your investigation. Allow me to forward the comms-link..."
entries.zh:
"因素，"他重复了一遍，声音硬了起来。

"这个我来操心。你该继续你的调查。让我把通讯链接转给你..."

entries.en: His smile becomes something more brittle. "He is nearby, captain. And safe."
entries.zh: 他的笑意愈发僵硬。"他就在附近，舰长。而且安全。"

entries.en: "And I shall not stand in your way, $titlePL," he says.
entries.zh: "我也不会挡你的路，$titlePL，"他说。

entries.en: "I trust Baird is not too upset?" His little smile grows.
entries.zh: "我想 Baird 不至于太恼火吧？"他那点笑意更浓了。

entries.en: "And before I forget, you dextrously handled that little problem between Menes Yaribay and the Church. Well done."
entries.zh: "趁我还没忘——Menes Yaribay 和教会之间那点小麻烦，你处理得相当灵巧。干得好。"

entries.en: "Before we proceed - I'm sorry to hear about your experience in the local bar. Very unfortunate. If it is any consolation, the officers involved have been sternly reprimanded."
entries.zh: "在我们继续之前——听说你在本地酒吧里出了点事，我很遗憾。太不幸了。若说有什么能让你宽心：涉事的军官已经受到严厉申斥。"

entries.en: Siyavong gives you a strange look.
entries.zh: Siyavong 用一种古怪的眼神看你。

o.en: I'd like to discuss the ANDRADA files.
o.zh: 我想谈谈 ANDRADA 文件。

entries.en:
"What I'm less certain of is why you are here. Making so much noise. Asking so many people 'where is Achilles', 'I want to talk to Achilles'."

For a fleeting moment you consider that his impression of your voice is not entirely charitable.

"But that's only partly my concern," he adds philosophically. "I think you should speak with him yourself. Work out... where you stand."
entries.zh:
"我没那么确定的，是你为什么在这儿。闹出这么大动静。逢人就问'Achilles 在哪儿'、'我要跟 Achilles 谈谈'。"

你有一瞬间觉得，他学你那两句话的腔调可不算客气。

"不过这只算我一半的关切，\"他颇有哲理地补了一句。\"我看你该亲自去跟他谈。把...你自己的立场弄清楚。"

entries.en:
"What I'm less certain of is why you are here. Making so much noise. Asking so many people 'where is Achilles', 'I want to talk to Achilles'."

For a fleeting moment you consider that his impression of your voice is not entirely charitable.

"It's unbecoming of one bearing a Hegemony commission... in a Persean League polity, in this political climate. But that's only partly my concern," he adds philosophically. "I think you should speak with him yourself. Work out... where you stand."
entries.zh:
"我没那么确定的，是你为什么在这儿。闹出这么大动静。逢人就问'Achilles 在哪儿'、'我要跟 Achilles 谈谈'。"

你有一瞬间觉得，他学你那两句话的腔调可不算客气。

"一个持有霸主委任状的人，在英仙座联盟的政体里，在这种政治气候下，这样做可不体面。不过这只算我一半的关切，\"他颇有哲理地补了一句。\"我看你该亲自去跟他谈。把...你自己的立场弄清楚。"

entries.en:
"It's too late for that," Siyavong says. "Events larger than he, or you, are already in motion."

"I'm trying to help you, captain," he says, leaning closer. Then he glances down at a TriPad.

"Allow me to forward your comms-link to his."
entries.zh:
"那已经太迟了，\"Siyavong 说。\"比他、也比你更大的事情，已经在运转了。"

"舰长，我是在帮你，"他说着，身子倾近了些。然后他低头看了一眼 TriPad。

"让我把你的通讯链接转接到他那儿。"

entries.en:
Siyavong looks at you for a long moment before speaking.

"Not if Fleet Intelligence decided his existence was a threat to the Persean League."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 久久看着你，才开口。

"除非舰队情报部认定他的存在威胁到了英仙座联盟——那样就护不住了。"

entries.en:
Siyavong looks at you for a long moment.

"Your... high opinion weighs heavy, captain. And I must remind you that Fleet Intelligence trusts me to uphold my vow of service to that organization, and to the Persean League."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 久久看着你。

"你的...高看，分量很重，舰长。而我也必须提醒你：舰队情报部信任我，是因为我宣誓效忠那个机构，也效忠英仙座联盟。"

entries.en:
Siyavong looks at you for a long moment before he speaks.

"Yes, Fleet Intelligence would see to that."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 久久看着你，才开口。

"是的，舰队情报部会照看好的。"

entries.en:
Siyavong looks at you for a long moment before he speaks.

"I suppose I must remind you, captain, that I do not work for Reynard Hannan." A quick albeit hollow smile. "Fleet Intelligence, however, does serve by the directives of the Prime Demarchon."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 久久看着你，才开口。

"我想我必须提醒你，舰长：我不为 Reynard Hannan 做事。\"他很快地笑了一下，那笑是空的。\"不过，舰队情报部确实按大统领的指令行事。"

o.en: Are you saying that Leonidas will be killed if I hand him over to you?
o.zh: 你是说，如果我把 Leonidas 交给你们，他就会被杀掉？

o.en: I'll give you Leonidas. (give the order)
o.zh: 我把 Leonidas 交给你们。 (下达命令)

o.en: Perhaps we should talk about something else. (back)
o.zh: 也许我们该谈点别的。 (返回)
我不能把 Leonidas 交给你们。

entries.en: He nods.
entries.zh: 他点了点头。

entries.en:
"I cannot," he says. "And I cannot tell you what the FIS will do. I do not know myself."

"You are not new and naive to the worlds, $titlePL. You know that these factions of the Persean Sector will do small, terrible things - if they must, if they like, and perhaps even for no reason at all but a sort of inertia."

"That's the answer I must live with. And if you can, too? Then give me Leonidas."

He seems to realize that his hands were clenched together, and he releases them, stretching his fingers, before resettling his posture politely at his desk.
entries.zh:
"我不能。"他说，"我也不能告诉你舰队情报部会怎么做。我自己也不知道。"

"你在这世上不是新来的毛孩子，$titlePL。你知道英仙座星域这些势力会做出一些不大不小的恶事——若是不得不做，若是乐意去做，甚至也许毫无理由，只是出于一种惯性。"

"这个答案，我得带着它活下去。如果你也能接受，那就把 Leonidas 交给我。"

他似乎这才发觉自己双手一直紧握着，于是松开，活动了一下手指，随后又礼貌地在桌前坐正。

entries.en:
"I am not. But it is also a thing I could not say."

His expression is pained, now, the lingering smile quite gone.

"I hope you understand me."
entries.zh:
"我不是这个意思。可这同样是我说不出口的事。"

他的神情此刻有些痛苦，那点残留的笑已经不见了。

"我希望你能明白我的意思。"

o.en: Why the word games? Just speak plainly for once!
o.zh: 为什么要玩这些文字游戏？就不能有一次直说吗！

entries.en:
The arrangements are made.

An anonymous shuttle carries an unmarked cryosleep-unit to a strictly short-term rental spacedock to be passed into the custody of Persean League Fleet Intelligence. The telemetry from the subtle tracking device you had installed on the unit cuts off as soon as your $shipOrFleet's shuttle begins its return flight.
entries.zh:
安排妥当了。

一艘不留名号的穿梭机，把一台没有标识的冷冻休眠舱送到一座严格意义上只是短期租用的太空港，交由英仙座联盟舰队情报局看管。你在舱上装的那枚隐蔽追踪器，遥测信号在你的$shipOrFleet的穿梭机开始返航的那一刻就断了。

entries.en:
Siyavong nods.

He appears, if anything, to have had a weight lifted from his shoulders.
entries.zh:
Siyavong 点了点头。

他看上去倒像是肩上卸下了一副重担。

entries.en:
"So you say," he says, then glances at a TriPad.

"Allow me to forward the comms-link..."
entries.zh:
"你是这么说的，"他说，然后瞥了一眼 TriPad。

"让我把通讯链接转给你..."

entries.en:
"Have patience," he says. "There are many... factors involved." He glances at a TriPad.

"Allow me to forward the comms-link..."
entries.zh:
"有点耐心，"他说。"这里头牵涉很多...因素。"他瞥了一眼 TriPad。

"让我把通讯链接转给你..."

entries.en:
"Officially," he says, "I shall make no recommendation regarding your involvement into the alleged contents of these files in accordance with present Persean League policy of non-intervention in matters regarding... certain trade partners, as guided by our executive leadership."

He puts his hands together, clearing his throat, and pauses for a moment. Then looks up at you.
entries.zh:
"就官方而言，\"他说，\"对你是否介入这些文件所称的内容，我不作任何建议。按英仙座联盟现行政策，凡涉及...某些贸易伙伴之事，一律不予干预 —— 此为我们的行政领导层所定。"

他双手交叠，清了清嗓子，停了一停，然后抬眼看你。

entries.en:
"You have made a career of taking independent initiative. With provocative results. I will follow your actions with great interest and assist in defending the stability and security of the Persean League now and in the future."

The holo flickers for a moment, but you'd swear he winked.
entries.zh:
"你这一路走来，靠的就是自行其是。结果也足够惹眼。我会密切关注你的行动，并为捍卫英仙座联盟眼下与将来的稳定和安全提供协助。"

全息影像闪了一下，但你敢发誓，他眨了下眼。

entries.en: "He's nearby." His smile becomes something more brittle. "And safe."
entries.zh: "他就在附近。\"他的笑意更僵了。\"而且安全。"

entries.en: "I think you know," he says, the smile going brittle. "You've asked everyone else already. Why not me?"
entries.zh: "我想你知道，\"他说，笑意僵了下来。\"别人你都问过了。为什么不来问我？"

entries.en:
"Because it's cleaner this way," he says, moving his hand in a delicate wipe, the sort one would use to clear an interface of cluttered data-snippets. "I am smoothing out an awkward situation for the benefit of all parties."

He seems satisfied with this for a moment. Then says, voice growing an edge, "I will not elaborate."
entries.zh:
"因为这样更干净，\"他说着，手轻轻一抹，像是要把界面上杂乱的数据碎片扫开。\"我在为各方的好处，把一个难堪的局面抹平。"

他对这个说法似乎满意了片刻。然后声音里添了棱角："我不会再细说。"

entries.en:
"It's cleaner this way," he says, moving his hand in a delicate wipe, the sort one would use to clear an interface of cluttered data-snippets. "I am smoothing out an awkward situation for the benefit of all parties. Directing possibilities."

He seems satisfied with this for a moment. Then says, voice growing an edge, "I shall not elaborate."
entries.zh:
"这样更干净，\"他说着，手轻轻一抹，像要扫开界面上杂乱的数据碎片。\"我在为各方的好处抹平一个难堪的局面。引导各种可能。"

他对这个说法似乎满意了片刻。随后声音里添了棱角："我不再细说。"

entries.en:
Siyavong does something halfway between taking a deep breath and a sigh.

"Interesting," he says after a moment.
entries.zh:
Siyavong 做了个介于深吸气与叹气之间的动作。

"有意思，"他过了一会才说。

entries.en: "I don't know, captain," he says with exacting neutrality. "I'm sure we'll find out before long. Perhaps."
entries.zh: "我不知道，舰长，\"他说，语气中立得一丝不苟。\"我想不用多久就会知道了。也许吧。"

entries.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"Interesting."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉。

"有意思。"

entries.en:
"It explains why he booked transport to where he did."

He raises a finger halfway.

"It would be unprofessional to elaborate on the methods used by Fleet Intelligence, so you need not inquire. We must simply leave it at that."
entries.zh:
"这解释了为什么他订了去那个地方的船票。"

他抬起一根手指，只抬到一半。

"细说舰队情报部所用的手段并不合职业规矩，所以你也不必问。这事只能到此为止。"

entries.en: "Ah." Siyavong's eyes light up. "That explains it."
entries.zh: "啊。\"Siyavong 的眼睛亮了起来。\"这就说得通了。"

entries.en:
"Where he got the credits."

Siyavong leaves it at that.
entries.zh:
"他从哪儿弄到那笔星币。"

Siyavong 不再多说。

o.en: And how did you know about that? Keeping an eye on Hercules?
o.zh: 那你怎么会知道这些？一直盯着 Hercules？

entries.en: He nods.
entries.zh: 他点了点头。

entries.en:
"I see how you would come to that conclusion based on my response. In any event, it would be unprofessional to elaborate on the methods used by Fleet Intelligence."

"So," he spreads his hands, "We need not worry ourselves with this line of inquiry any longer."
entries.zh:
"从我的反应，你能这么推断，我倒也明白。无论如何，细说舰队情报部所用的手段并不合职业规矩。"

"所以，\"他摊开双手，\"这条线我们就不必再费心了。"

o.zh: 为什么不必？Hercules 没事吧？

entries.en: He looks at you for a long moment. You can see the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes.
entries.zh: 他久久地看着你。你能看见他眼角的皱纹。

entries.en: "I couldn't say."
entries.zh: "我说不好。"

entries.en:
Something small breaks. Finlay's smile drops.

"Hercules is dead, captain. Targeted killing. He made it as far as Ancyra. Same organization as the first attempt - behind the proverbial trigger, that is. The identity of the client is less certain."
entries.zh:
某样很小的东西碎了。Finlay 的笑容落了下去。

"Hercules 死了，舰长。是定点清除。他一路逃到了 Ancyra。还是同一个组织，和第一次动手的那批人一样 —— 扣下扳机的那些。至于委托人是谁，就不那么确定了。"

entries.en:
He rubs one of his eyes.

"I liked him. Hercules. He seemed like a thoughtful young man."
entries.zh:
他揉了揉一只眼睛。

"我挺喜欢他。Hercules。看着像个有想法的年轻人。"

o.en: Why are you telling me this?

entries.en:
Siyavong taps something on his console, then adjusts his posture, sitting up straight, putting his hands in front of him.

"I don't believe I said anything. Now, where we were?"
entries.zh:
Siyavong 在控制台上点了点什么，然后调整坐姿，坐直身子，把双手放到身前。

"我想我什么也没说过。那么，我们刚才说到哪儿了？"

entries.en:
"Indeed."

Siyavong adjusts his posture, sitting up straight, putting his hands in front of him.

"Where were we?"
entries.zh:
"的确。"

Siyavong 调整坐姿，坐直身子，把双手放到身前。

"我们刚才说到哪儿了？"

entries.en:
He nods, looking down.

"So. Where were we."
entries.zh:
他点了点头，垂着眼。

"那么。我们刚才说到哪儿了。"

entries.en:
Siyavong's half-smile fades somewhat.

"No. He's disappeared."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 脸上那点半笑淡了下去。

"不。他不见了。"

entries.en:
Siyavong raises an eyebrow.

"Interesting."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 挑了挑眉。

"有意思。"

entries.en:
"It explains why we can't find Hercules."

He raises a finger halfway.

"It would be unprofessional to elaborate on the methods used by Fleet Intelligence, so you need not inquire. We must simply leave it at that."
entries.zh:
"这解释了为什么我们找不到 Hercules。"

他抬起一根手指，只抬到一半。

"细说舰队情报部所用的手段并不合职业规矩，所以你也不必问。这事只能到此为止。"

entries.en:
Your eyes wander to meet the hard gaze of The Lion of Sindria glowering darkly from a suspiciously upscaled full-body holo-portrait projected to overlook the trader's concourse.

You think to yourself...
entries.zh:
你的目光游移过去，正撞上辛达瑞亚之狮那沉郁而锐利的凝视——那幅全身全息肖像大得有些可疑，投映在交易广场上方，俯视着来往的人群。

你暗自思忖...

entries.en: Perhaps he could. But the real question is if he would. And given that Tri-Tachyon is in constant and fierce competition with itself... perhaps.
entries.zh: 也许他能。但真正的问题是，他愿不愿意。考虑到速子科技向来斗得你死我活... 也许吧。

o.en: set met Arroyo and Gargoyle and unhide them

entries.en:
"Captain?" $PersonName looks almost concerned.

"Captain $playerLastName, is this signal good? I'm getting received-confirm but... can you hear me now?"
entries.zh:
"舰长？" $PersonName 的神情近乎关切。

"$playerLastName 舰长，这信号行吗？我这边收到确认了，可... 你现在能听见我吗？"

o.en: Uh. Comms clear, receiving green. Must have been a lag-spike in the buffer.
o.zh: 呃。通讯清晰，接收正常。大概是缓冲区里卡了一下。

entries.en:
"Captain?" Arroyo looks annoyed.

"Captain $playerLastName, is this signal good? I got a received-confirm from this stupid thing... can you hear me now?"
entries.zh:
"舰长？" Arroyo 一脸烦躁。

"$playerLastName 舰长，这信号行吗？这破玩意儿给我弹了个确认... 你现在能听见我吗？"

o.en: Uh. Comms clear, receiving green. Must have been a lag-spike in the buffer.
o.zh: 呃。通讯清晰，接收正常。大概是缓冲区里卡了一下。

entries.en: "Glad that's resolved," $heOrShe says impatiently. "You were about to say something?"
entries.zh: "总算解决了，\" $heOrShe 不耐烦地说，\"你刚才想说什么？"

entries.en: "Okay," $heOrShe says impatiently. "You were about to say something?"
entries.zh: "行了，\" $heOrShe 不耐烦地说，\"你刚才想说什么？"

entries.en: "I'm glad that's been resolved," $heOrShe says pleasantly. "You were about to say something?"
entries.zh: "很高兴这事解决了，\" $heOrShe 语气愉快，\"你刚才想说什么？"

entries.en: "Acknowledged," $heOrShe says impatiently. "You were about to say something. Speak."
entries.zh: "收到，\" $heOrShe 不耐烦地说，\"你刚才要说什么。讲。"

entries.en: "I see," $heOrShe says with more than a tinge of skepticism. "You were about to say... ?"
entries.zh: "原来如此，\" $heOrShe 的语气里带着不止一点怀疑，\"你刚才是要说... ？"

entries.en:
"Captain?" Inesis looks perfectly patient.

"Captain $playerLastName. Checking signal." His eye twitches. "Got received-confirm... can you hear me now?"
entries.zh:
"舰长？" Inesis 看上去极有耐心。

"$playerLastName 舰长。正在检查信号。\" 他的眼角抽了一下。\"收到确认了... 你现在能听见我吗？"

o.en: Uh. Comms clear, receiving green. Must have been a lag-spike in the buffer.
o.zh: 呃。通讯清晰，接收正常。大概是缓冲区里卡了一下。

entries.en:
"Captain?" Rao looks annoyed.

"Captain $playerLastName. Is this signal good? Got received-confirm... can you hear me now?"
entries.zh:
"舰长？" Rao 面露不悦。

"$playerLastName 舰长。信号好吗？收到确认了... 你现在能听见我吗？"

o.en: Uh. Comms clear, receiving green. Must have been a lag-spike in the buffer.
o.zh: 呃。通讯清晰，接收正常。大概是缓冲区里卡了一下。

entries.en:
"Captain?" Siyavong looks concerned.

"Captain $playerLastName, is this signal good? I got a received-confirm. Can you hear me now?"
entries.zh:
"舰长？" Siyavong 面露忧色。

"$playerLastName 舰长，信号好吗？我收到确认了。你现在能听见我吗？"

o.en: Uh. Comms clear, receiving green. Must have been a lag-spike in the buffer.
o.zh: 呃。通讯清晰，接收正常。大概是缓冲区里卡了一下。

entries.en:
Your mind wanders from the open comms channel, to what you did - and what you found - brewing, rotting, in the Askonia System.

You think of Philip Andrada, the Lion of Sindria. The proud conqueror - the fading villain of the Hegemony's pride, and soon, perhaps, a wasting corpse.

You think to yourself...
entries.zh:
你的思绪从仍然开着的通讯频道飘开，飘向你在 Askonia 星系做过的事、找到的东西——那些正在发酵、正在腐烂的东西。

你想起了 Philip Andrada，辛达瑞亚之狮。那个骄傲的征服者——霸主自尊心里那个正在褪色的恶人，也许很快就是一具枯朽的尸体。

你暗自思忖...

entries.en:
Rayan Arroyo would know how to exploit an intelligence breakthrough concerning the Sindrian Diktat. Shorting volatiles futures, stockpiling fuel; one way or another he'll take his cut without getting caught up in any mess.

The trick will be convincing him to pull the strings necessary to access Tri-Tachyon's AI assets. They must exist, though the Company keeps them very, very quiet in the aftermath of the two AI Wars.
entries.zh:
Rayan Arroyo 懂得怎么把一份关于辛达强权的情报突破变成钱。做空挥发物期货，囤积燃料；无论走哪条路，他都会捞到自己那一份，还不会沾上一身麻烦。

难处在于说服他去动用那些关系，才够得着速子科技的 AI 资产。这些东西一定存在——只是两场 AI 战争之后，公司把它们藏得极深。

o.en: Perhaps you need more time to develop allies and contacts
o.zh: 也许你还需要更多时间去经营盟友与人脉

entries.en: You return to your initial thought: could Orcus Rao decrypt the files?
entries.zh: 你回到最初那个念头：Orcus Rao 能解密这些文件吗？

entries.en: You've heard implications that one Admiral Orcus Rao is involved in the Hegemony's response to the Sindrian Diktat. Perhaps it's time to pay a visit to Ragnar Station and see if it's true.
entries.zh: 你听过一些暗示：Orcus Rao 上将参与了霸主对辛达强权的应对。也许是时候去 Ragnar Station 走一趟，看看是否属实。

o.en: Take the files to Orcus Rao

entries.en: Orcus Rao is ideally placed to act upon this intel. He has the authority to circumvent regulations - and you know if his desire to strike at the heart of the Sindrian Diktat.
entries.zh: Orcus Rao 所处的位置，最适宜就此情报采取行动。他有权绕过那些条条框框——而你也清楚，他有多想直插辛达强权的心脏。

o.en: Take the files to Orcus Rao

entries.en: Besides, you bear a commission of the Hegemony. It is only correct that you take intel of strategic importance to an appropriate senior officer, and Orcus Rao is ideally placed to put such intel to appropriate use.
entries.zh: 再说，你持有霸主的委任状。把具有战略价值的情报交给一位合适的高级军官，本就天经地义；而 Orcus Rao 的位置，最便于让这份情报派上该有的用场。

o.en: Take the files to Orcus Rao

entries.en:
Who could you approach for assistance?
Who would crack the encryption for you?
entries.zh:
你能找谁帮忙？
谁会替你破开这层加密？

entries.en:
The hacker is mercurial, but Gargoyle's curiosity can be counted on, to say nothing of the opportunity to disgrace and annoy one or more powerful factions by revealing secrets.

It is clear, then, that you must take the ANDRADA files to Gargoyle at the Galatia Academy.

(DEV or maybe Tse Franchise Station)
entries.zh:
这名骇客性情多变，但 Gargoyle 的好奇心可以指望，更别提揭露秘密好让一个甚至多个强大势力颜面尽失、恼羞成怒的机会了。

所以很清楚，你必须把 ANDRADA 的文件交给加拉提亚学院（Galatia Academy）的 Gargoyle。

（DEV 或 Tse Franchise Station）

entries.en: It would take some kind of super-hacker. If only you knew one...
entries.zh: 这得是何等厉害的黑客才行。可惜你不认识这样的人...

entries.en:
The hacker is mercurial, but Gargoyle's curiosity can be counted on - to say nothing of the opportunity to disgrace and annoy one or more powerful factions by revealing their secrets.

It is clear, then, that you must take the ANDRADA files to Gargoyle.
entries.zh:
这名黑客性情无常，但 Gargoyle 的好奇心绝对可靠——更别提揭开秘密能让一两个强大势力丢脸恼火。

那么路只有一条：你只能把 ANDRADA 文件带去给 Gargoyle。

o.en: The Hegemony could, if it so chose
o.zh: 霸主若愿意下场，也能做到

entries.en: The Hegemony is touchy about the subject of AI cores due to the living memory of the AI Wars as well as the need to secure support from the Faithful of the Luddic Church.
entries.zh: 霸主对 AI 核心这个话题格外敏感：一来 AI 战争的记忆还活着，二来他们需要稳住银河救赎教会的信众。

entries.en: You bear a commission with the Hegemony and would expect to be taken seriously if you were to bring in intel of such supreme importance concerning the Sindrian Diktat.
entries.zh: 你持有霸主的委任状。若你带着关乎辛达强权、如此重要的情报上门，应当会被认真对待。

entries.en: You do not bear a commission with the Hegemony. Considering the sensitive nature of the intel, and what would be required to decrypt it, you will need an advocate inside their organization.
entries.zh: 你不持霸主的委任状。考虑到这份情报的敏感程度，以及解密它需要付出的代价，你得在他们内部找个替你说话的人。

entries.en:
In any event, you bear a commission of the Sindrian Diktat and are considered an adherent to Philip Andrada, reviled as arch-traitor in the Hegemony's telling of history.
They would never help you.
entries.zh:
况且，你持有辛达强权的委任状，被视为 Philip Andrada 的追随者——而在霸主的史书里，那人是头号叛徒。
他们绝不会帮你。

o.en: Take the files to your Hegemony contact
o.zh: 把文件交给你的霸主联系人

entries.en: You've personally met the High Hegemon, Baikal Daud. He is a practical man, though you have no way of knowing if he trusts you - or could ever trust someone in your position.
entries.zh: 你曾亲自见过至高霸主 Baikal Daud。他是个务实的人，不过你无从知道他是否信得过你——或者他是否可能信任一个处在你这位置上的人。

o.en: Take the files to Baikal Daud

entries.en: Orcus Rao is ideally placed to act upon this intel. He has the authority to circumvent regulations and a burning desire to strike at the Sindrian Diktat.
entries.zh: Orcus Rao 所处的位置，最适宜就此情报采取行动。他有权绕过那些条条框框，也一心要对辛达强权动手。

o.en: Take the files to Orcus Rao

entries.en: You've heard implications that one Admiral Orcus Rao is involved in the Hegemony's response to the Sindrian Diktat. Perhaps it's time to pay a visit to Ragnar Station and see if it's true.
entries.zh: 你听过一些暗示：Orcus Rao 上将参与了霸主对辛达强权的应对。也许是时候去 Ragnar Station 走一趟，看看是否属实。

o.en: Take the files to Orcus Rao

entries.en: You've heard that one Admiral Orcus Rao is involved in the Hegemony's response to the Sindrian Diktat. Perhaps it's time to pay a visit to Ragnar Station and see if you can help out.
entries.zh: 你听说 Orcus Rao 上将参与了霸主对辛达强权的应对。也许是时候去 Ragnar Station 走一趟，看看能不能帮上忙。

o.en: Take the files to Orcus Rao
Take the files to a high-level Hegemony officer
o.zh: 把文件交给一位霸主高层军官

o.en: You could use the alpha-level core installed as administrator of $sd7s_aiColonyName
o.zh: 你可以动用那颗装在 $sd7s_aiColonyName、担任管理者的 Alpha 级核心

entries.en: If you had your own colonial infrastructure with an alpha-level AI core at its head, it might be possible to keep the job entirely internal.
entries.zh: 如果你有自己的殖民地设施，再有一颗 Alpha 级 AI 核心坐镇，或许整件事都能在内部消化。

o.en: If the Persean League could be persuaded of its utility...
o.zh: 若能说服英仙座联盟相信此事的用处...

entries.en:
You bear a commission for the Persean League. Despite your dedication, some will consider you little more than an opportunistic mercenary. The only possible way you can be taken - and treated - seriously is through the influence of a leader of one of the Kazeronian gens.

...Or a trusted contact who could, presumably, leverage such a relationship.
entries.zh:
你持有英仙座联盟的委任状。可无论你多尽心，总有人只当你是个见风使舵的雇佣兵。唯一可能被当回事、被认真对待的门路，是借 Kazeron 某个氏族领袖的影响力。

...或者一个信得过的联系人，他能替你把这条关系用起来。

entries.en: You do have a contact in the League that could provide a means to engage with Fleet Intelligence.
entries.zh: 你在联盟里确实有个联系人，能替你搭上舰队情报部的门路。

o.en: Take the files to your contact
o.zh: 把文件交给你的联系人

entries.en: You have earned the trust of Horus Yaribay. Surely he has access to the resources to crack the ANDRADA files.
entries.zh: 你已经赢得了 Horus Yaribay 的信任。他总该有门路弄到破解 ANDRADA 档案的资源。

o.en: Take the files to Horus Yaribay

entries.en: You are a demarchon of the Persean League in good standing. You have the right to bring matters essential to League security directly to the top executive and you can expect to be taken seriously. Reynard Hannan may be arrogant, but he did not get to his position by being stupid.
entries.zh: 你是英仙座联盟一名声誉无亏的民选统领。你有权把关乎联盟安全要务的事项直接呈给最高行政官，而且可以指望被认真对待。Reynard Hannan 也许傲慢，但能爬到那个位置，绝不是靠愚蠢。

entries.en: You are not a member of the Persean League, nor do you bear their commission. The only way you would be treated seriously is through the influence of an important contact... or the leader of a major Gens. Even then, you will not be trusted with such sensitive information without proving yourself.
entries.zh: 你既不是英仙座联盟的成员，也不持他们的委任状。想被认真对待，只能靠某位要员的引荐... 或者某个大氏族领袖的影响力。可即便到了那一步，不先证明自己，他们也不会把这么敏感的情报交到你手上。

o.en: Take the files to Reynard Hannan

entries.en: You are a Demarchon of the Persean League and can expect to hold audience with Reynard Hannan. He must have the resources required to crack the ANDRADA files.
entries.zh: 你是英仙座联盟的民选统领，可以指望得到 Reynard Hannan 的接见。他手上必定有破解 ANDRADA 档案所需的资源。

entries.en: As a Demarchon of the League with an expensive 'arrangement', you can expect to hold audience with Reynard Hannan to discuss what you've found. And he must have the resources to crack the ANDRADA files.
entries.zh: 作为联盟的民选统领，又付着一笔昂贵的"安排"，你可以指望得到 Reynard Hannan 的接见，与他谈谈你的发现。而他手上必定有破解 ANDRADA 档案的资源。

o.en: Take the files to Finlay Siyavong

entries.en:
Who could you approach for assistance?
Who would crack the encryption for you?
entries.zh:
你能找谁帮忙？
谁会替你破开这层加密？

o.en: Surely someone in the Sindrian Diktat is loyal to Andrada?
o.zh: 辛达强权里总该有人忠于 Andrada 吧？

o.en: Tri-Tachyon expertise could crack it... for a price
o.zh: 速子科技的技术能破开它... 只要出得起价

entries.en: Is there anyone in Tri-Tachyon you could trust? They're almost certain to use the information for their own game. Perhaps it is worth the risk.
entries.zh: 速子科技里有你信得过的人吗？他们几乎肯定会拿这份情报去做自己的局。也许，这风险值得一冒。

entries.en: Rayan Arroyo might be persuaded of the financial benefits of decrypting key intel concerning what appears to be an increasing unstable Sindrian Diktat.
entries.zh: Rayan Arroyo 或许能被说动——解出一批关键情报能换来实打实的收益，而情报关乎一个看上去正愈发不稳的辛达强权。

o.en: Take the files to Rayan Arroyo

entries.en: You bear a commission of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. This should provide an 'in' to corporate officers of influence, perhaps with access to unique black-site resources.
entries.zh: 你持有速子科技公司的委任状。这应该能替你敲开有分量的公司高管的门——他们或许能动用某些独特的机密设施资源。

entries.en: You do not bear a commission with the Tri-Tachyon Corporation, though this is no great barrier - credits and loyalty are generally considered fungible to Tri-Tachyon executives. You would need to leverage a relationship with a well-connected contact on the 'inside' to have any hope of gaining access to the Company's black-site capabilities.
entries.zh: 你并未在速子科技持有委任状，不过这也算不上什么大障碍——在速子科技的高管眼里，星币与忠诚向来可以互换。你得靠着公司【内部】一位人脉通达的关系人，才有望触及这家企业的黑站能力。

entries.en: You have a contact in The Company who may be able to help. Anyone with ambition in Tri-Tachyon - and that ought to be everyone - will leap at an opportunity to get an edge on the competition, whether inside the company or out.
entries.zh: 你在公司里有位联系人，或许能帮上忙。速子科技中但凡有点野心的人——而那本该是所有人——都会扑向任何一个压过对手的机会，不论对手在公司内外。

o.en: Take the files to your Tri-Tachyon contact
o.zh: 把文件交给你的速子科技联系人

entries.en: Faro Inesis is a consummate spymaster. He might be just the man for a job involving decryption and exploitation.
entries.zh: Faro Inesis 是位炉火纯青的谍报头子。解密与利用情报这类活儿，他也许正是合适的人选。

o.en: Take the files to Faro Inesis
Take the files to a senior Tri-Tachyon executive
o.zh: 把文件交给一位速子科技高层主管

entries.en: This matter could be of interest to Director Zunya Glamor-Rotanev. She has credits to throw around, after all, and this might be an opportunity to earn a few more.
entries.zh: 这件事也许能让 Zunya Glamor-Rotanev 总监感兴趣。毕竟她有大把星币可撒，而这或许也是个多赚几笔的机会。

o.en: Take the files to Director Glamor-Rotanev
o.zh: 把文件交给 Glamor-Rotanev 总监

entries.en: Besides, Inesis' operations must be very well-funded by Director Glamor-Rotanev - and well-protected from the Company itself. If anyone can do this, Inesis can.
entries.zh: 再说，Inesis 的行动必有 Glamor-Rotanev 总监的雄厚资助，也必然防着公司本身。这事若有人办得成，那就是 Inesis。

entries.en: Your contact will know what to do with such important intel.
entries.zh: 你的联系人知道该拿这么重要的情报怎么办。

entries.en: A high-level executive or administrator will know how to access the resources required to decrypt such important intel.
entries.zh: 一位高层主管或行政官，自然知道该去哪里调取解密这种重要情报所需的资源。

entries.en: Director Glamor-Rotanev seems to have set her sights higher than factional politics, but perhaps the opportunity to exploit knowledge about Macario's scheming could pique her interest.
entries.zh: Glamor-Rotanev 总监的目光似乎早已越过派系政治，但能拿 Macario 的算计做文章，这个由头也许仍能勾起她的兴趣。

o.en: Who, or what, are the seven Andradas on Macario's list?
o.zh: Macario 名单上那七个 Andrada，究竟是谁，又或者是什么？

o.en: Are the seven Andradas on Macario's list... Andrada?
o.zh: Macario 名单上那七个 Andrada... 都是 Andrada 本人吗？

o.en: Are the seven Andradas on Macario's list truly Philip's heirs?
o.zh: Macario 名单上那七个 Andrada，真是 Philip 的继承人吗？

o.en: What game is Macario playing by revealing the list to me?
o.zh: Macario 把这份名单透露给我，究竟在下什么棋？

o.en: I don't have time for this right now
o.zh: 我现在没时间处理这个

o.en: Andrada's dictatorship could be felled with one push... in the right place
o.zh: Andrada 的独裁政权一推就倒... 只要推对地方

o.en: Philip Andrada's grand experiment might be felled with one push... in the wrong place
o.zh: Philip Andrada 的宏大实验或许一推就倒... 只要推错地方

o.en: The Sindrian Diktat must be protected from Macario's scheming
o.zh: 必须护住辛达强权，不让 Macario 的阴谋得逞

entries.en: Perhaps he could. But the real question is if he would. And given that Tri-Tachyon is in constant and fierce competition with itself... perhaps.
entries.zh: 也许他能。但真正的问题是，他愿不愿意。考虑到速子科技向来斗得你死我活... 也许吧。

o.en: I need to find out what's in the ANDRADA files
o.zh: 我得弄清楚 ANDRADA 档案里到底写了什么

entries.en: You can visualize the list without checking your TriPad. Seven names lead by the surname of the Lion of Sindria, the Supreme Executor.
entries.zh: 不用翻 TriPad，那份名单就在你眼前浮着。七个名字，打头的是辛达瑞亚之狮、最高元首的姓氏。

entries.en:
The best hackers or perhaps the least AI core - or a team made of the two working together - could crack the files, given time.

Any major faction's intelligence service must have this capacity.

Except the Luddic Church. (Nor the Path, for that matter... unless some truly heretical sect has invited a rogue AI to its flock. You set aside that disturbing thought.)
entries.zh:
最好的黑客，或者最次一等的 AI 核心，又或者两者搭伙组成的团队——只要给足时间，都能破开这些文件。

任何一个大势力的情报机构，都必然具备这种能力。

银河救赎教会除外。(卢德左径其实也一样... 除非真有哪个彻底离经叛道的教派，把一头失控的 AI 请进了自己的羊群。你把这个令人不安的念头搁到一边。)

entries.en:
Your eyes wander to a flickering holoprojector casting a news channel over the trader's concourse. The latest crimes of the Sindrian regime are being iterated over an image of The Lion of Sindria caught glowering darkly during some military inspection.

You think to yourself...
entries.zh:
你的目光被一台闪烁的全息投影仪吸引，它正把新闻频道投到交易广场上方。辛达政权的最新罪行被逐条念出，配图是辛达瑞亚之狮在某次军事视察中阴沉着脸的样子。

你暗自思忖...

entries.en:
And why not?

Andrada carved a stellar empire from the heart of the Persean Sector, then was foolish enough to let it and himself fall to ruin.

You are no fool. You won't repeat his mistakes. You need to know what you're working with - and exactly what Macario is up to.
entries.zh:
有何不可？

Andrada 从英仙座星域的心脏地带凿出了一个星际帝国，随后又蠢到让自己和它一同坠入废墟。

你不是蠢人，不会重蹈他的覆辙。你得弄清楚自己手里握着什么——以及 Macario 到底在做什么。

entries.en:
And why not?

Philip Andrada carved a stellar empire out of the heart of the Persean Sector and then, it seems, when his body - though not his immortal will - faltered, it allowed parasites and traitors to bring corruption and ruin to his vision.

You are no fool. You know who your enemies are, and you know that victory is simply a matter of transcendent will. You need to know what you're working with - and exactly what Macario is up to.

Then you shall strike.
entries.zh:
有何不可？

Philip Andrada 从英仙座星域的心脏地带凿出了一个星际帝国；而后，当他的身体——而非他不朽的意志——开始衰败，寄生虫与叛徒便得以把他的愿景拖进腐败与毁灭。

你不是蠢人。你知道自己的敌人是谁，也知道胜利不过是超凡意志的产物。你得弄清楚自己手里握着什么——以及 Macario 到底在做什么。

那就动手。

Andrada carved a stellar empire out of the heart of the Persean Sector, then was foolish enough to let it and himself fall to ruin.

You are no fool. You won't repeat his mistakes. You need to know what you're working with - and exactly what Macario is up to.

Then you shall strike.
