entries.en:
Macario is playing a complicated game, and he will be at his weakest during the moment of crisis he so clearly wishes to engineer. It will be his opportunity to push Caden into the office of Supreme Executor - bound by a puppet-master's strings. That will be your chance.

You need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next move.
entries.zh:
Macario 在下很大的一盘棋，而在他一心要制造的那场危机爆发之时，他也最虚弱。那是他把 Caden 推上最高元首之位的机会——用提线拴住的傀儡。那也是你的机会。

你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一步。

entries.en:
Macario is playing a complicated game, and he will be at his weakest during the moment of crisis he so clearly wishes to engineer. Does he mean to push Caden into the office of Supreme Executor while bound by a puppet-master's strings?

Is this the bold future that Philip Andrada decreed? It is difficult to imagine it is so.

You need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next move.
entries.zh:
Macario 在下很大的一盘棋，而在他一心要制造的那场危机爆发之时，他也最虚弱。他是打算把 Caden 推上最高元首之位，再用提线拴住他吗？

这就是 Philip Andrada 所钦定的那幅壮阔未来吗？很难想象会是如此。

你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一步。

entries.en:
It appears to be too important a piece of intel to simply allow into your hands - and more dangerously, your databanks. Macario of all people should know that post-Collapse encryption is not a sure science.

The best hackers, perhaps the least AI core, or a team made up of the two working together for any given major intelligence service might be able to crack it, given time. Any are capable of it but the Luddic Church (and Path, for that matter, unless some truly heretical sect has invited a rogue AI to its flock.)

You set aside that disturbing thought.

What is clear is you need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next manipulation.
entries.zh:
这份情报太重要了，不可能就这么落进你手里——更危险的是，落进你的数据库。别人或许不懂，Macario 总该知道，大崩塌之后的加密术从来不是什么稳妥的科学。

顶尖黑客，或者最次一等的 AI 核心，又或者两者搭伙组成的团队——任何一家大情报机构，只要给足时间，或许都能把它破开。除了银河救赎教会，谁都有这个能力 (卢德左径其实也一样，除非真有哪个彻底离经叛道的教派，把一头失控的 AI 请进了自己的羊群)。

你把这个令人不安的念头搁到一边。

清楚的是：你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一次操纵。

entries.en:
Seven names, seven Andradas. One file's updates halted.

Deceased perhaps? Escaped from Macario's machinations, anyway. And Andrada's, perhaps.

There are too many unknowns. Too many "perhaps". You need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next manipulation.
entries.zh:
七个名字，七个 Andrada。其中一份档案的更新停在某处。

也许人已经死了？总之，是逃出了 Macario 的算计。或许，也逃出了 Andrada 的。

未知太多，"也许"也太多。你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一次操纵。

entries.en:
Seven names, seven Andradas. One file's updates halted.

Deceased, perhaps. Escaped from Macario's machinations, anyway. What was Supreme Executor Philip Andrada's plan for these files, these names?

There are too many unknowns. Too many "perhaps". You need to learn more to know how to react to Macario's next move.
entries.zh:
七个名字，七个 Andrada。其中一份档案的更新停在某处。

也许人已经死了。总之，是逃出了 Macario 的算计。最高元首 Philip Andrada 对这些文件、这些名字，原本是打的什么算盘？

未知太多，"也许"也太多。你得摸清更多，才知道该如何应对 Macario 的下一步。

entries.en: Perhaps he could. Certainly Orcus Rao seems dedicated to the destruction of Philip Andrada, and if Macario's files are the opening he needs...
entries.zh: 也许他能。Orcus Rao 显然一心要毁掉 Philip Andrada，如果 Macario 的这些文件正是他等的那个缺口...

entries.en:
Philip Andrada carved a stellar empire from the heart of the Persean Sector and then, it seems, his body - though not his immortal will - faltered, allowing parasites and traitors to bring corruption and ruin to his vision.

Foremost among them: Dolos Macario.

You don't know exactly what these files represent but they can't be the product of Macario. He builds nothing of his own, only manipulating what others created. He is nothing like Philip Andrada, who conceived a perfect polity from force and will alone.

It may be that only you can save the Sindrian Diktat.
entries.zh:
Philip Andrada 从英仙座星域的心脏地带凿出了一个星际帝国；而后，垮下去的似乎是他的身体——而非他不朽的意志，寄生虫与叛徒这才得以把他的愿景拖进腐败与毁灭。

其中最要紧的一个：Dolos Macario。

你说不准这些文件究竟意味着什么，但它们不可能是 Macario 的产物。他从不自己建造什么，只会摆弄别人造出来的东西。他与 Philip Andrada 全然不同——那个人仅凭武力与意志，就构想出一个完美的政体。

也许只有你，才救得下辛达强权。

entries.en: Perhaps he could. But the real question is if he would. And given that Tri-Tachyon is in constant and fierce competition with itself... perhaps.
entries.zh: 也许他能。但真正的问题是，他愿不愿意。考虑到速子科技向来斗得你死我活... 也许吧。

entries.en:
Your eyes wander over a crudely disfigured image of the Lion of Sindria glowering darkly from a peeling agit-print, mass-fabricated and postered to keep the ARC's hate pure.

His portrait is inverted, his face X'd out with jagged red lightning bolts, the skulls of his victims piled around his head.

You think to yourself...
entries.zh:
你的目光扫过一幅粗糙毁损的画像：辛达瑞亚之狮从那剥落的宣传画里阴沉地瞪视着。画是批量印制的，贴满街巷，只为让 Askonia 革命者委员会心里的仇恨保持纯粹。

画像被倒挂着，脸上打了个红叉，四周钉着锯齿状的红色闪电；他那些"受害者"的骷髅堆在他脑袋周围。

你暗自思忖...

entries.en: "16,000 credits," $heOrShe shoots back.
entries.zh: "16,000 星币，"$heOrShe回敬道。

entries.en: $PersonName glances at a TriPad. "Payment received. Thank you, captain."
entries.zh: $PersonName瞥了眼 TriPad。"款已收到。谢谢你，舰长。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe gives you a 20,000 credit smile.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe朝你露出一个值 20,000 星币的笑容。

entries.en: $HeOrShe gives you a 16,000 credit smile.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe朝你露出一个值 16,000 星币的笑容。

entries.en: $HeOrShe gives you a 12,000 credit smile.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe朝你露出一个值 12,000 星币的笑容。

entries.en: "Faro Inesis is your man. I'll forward you his contact information..."
entries.zh: "Faro Inesis 就是你要找的人。我把他的联系方式转给你..."

o.en: I've already met Faro Inesis! What'd I pay you for?
o.zh: 我已经见过 Faro Inesis 了！我这钱花在哪儿了？

entries.en:
"Thank me after you see some profits from this venture of yours," $heOrShe says.

"Now I ought to open a comms to my investment agent to talk about volatiles futures..."
entries.zh:
"等你在这桩买卖里见到收益，再来谢我，"$heOrShe说道。

"现在我得联络我的投资代理人，谈谈挥发物期货..."

entries.en:
"I'd call it a successful consultation to enhance efficiency in underutilized partner connections."

This line is delivered in complete earnestness.

"Thank me after you see some profits from this venture of yours," $heOrShe says with a wink. "Now I've got some volatiles futures to look into..."
entries.zh:
"我会称之为一次成功的咨询，提升了利用不足的伙伴关系的效率。"

这句话说得一本正经。

"等你在这桩买卖里见到收益，再来谢我，\"$heOrShe眨了眨眼，\"现在我得去看看几笔挥发物期货了..."

entries.en:
You watch $personLastName's eyes as $heOrShe skims the file header.

"This won't be cheap," $heOrShe says. "If this is what it looks like."
entries.zh:
你看着$personLastName的眼睛 —— $heOrShe正扫过文件的头部信息。

"这可不便宜，\"$heOrShe说道，\"如果它真是看上去的那样。"

o.en: What would you say this looks like?

entries.en: "It might be sensitive information of interest to... a commercial partner of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation," $heOrShe says with a slightly more strained smile.
entries.zh: "它可能是些敏感信息，或许会让...速子科技的一家商业伙伴感兴趣，"$heOrShe说道，笑容略微发僵。

o.en: The Sindrian Diktat is a partner of Tri-Tachyon?
o.zh: 辛达强权是速子科技的伙伴？

o.en: Then we'll be careful. Let's discuss credits.
o.zh: 那我们就谨慎些。谈谈星币吧。

entries.en:
"Ah," $heOrShe spreads his hands, thinks better of it, and puts $hisOrHer hands together again. "Every major faction in the Persean Sector is a commercial partner of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation! Even the Luddic Church. Isn't that something?"

"It is true that there are occasional conflicts - 'kinetic negotiations', if you will - which put profitable ventures on hold. But in the end everyone recognizes that the market is the ultimate driver of prosperity, whatever political rhetoric they claim to embrace."

"After the dust settles, Tri-Tachyon is always open for business." $HeOrShe produces a business-friendly smile.
entries.zh:
"啊，\"$heOrShe摊开双手，又觉得不妥，重新把$hisOrHer双手合拢，\"英仙座星域的每一个主要势力，都是速子科技的商业伙伴！连银河救赎教会也不例外。有意思吧？"

"偶尔确实会有冲突 —— 不妨称之为'动能谈判' —— 让赚钱的生意暂时搁置。但说到底，人人都明白市场才是繁荣的根本动力，无论他们嘴上信奉的是什么政治辞令。"

"尘埃落定之后，速子科技永远乐意做生意。"$HeOrShe露出一个对生意人最友善的笑容。

o.zh: 真叫人振奋。我们来谈谈星币吧。

entries.en: "As we discussed, for a 20,000 credit finders-fee I can forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
entries.zh: "如我们所谈，20,000 星币的介绍费，我就把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

entries.en: "As we discussed," $heOrShe sighs, "I'll accept a 16,000 credit finders-fee then forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
entries.zh: "如我们所谈，\"$heOrShe叹了口气，\"16,000 星币的介绍费我收下，然后把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

entries.en: "As we discussed," $heOrShe sighs, "I'll accept a 12,000 credit finders-fee then forward you to someone who will take care of everything."
entries.zh: "如我们所谈，\"$heOrShe叹了口气，\"12,000 星币的介绍费我收下，然后把你转荐给一位能打理一切的人。"

entries.en:
"Decryption?" $HeOrShe smiles.

"That won't be a problem. No one beats Tri-Tachyon at data technology, and I'm sure we can come to a discreet arrangement... if you've got the credits."

$HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer hands together, eager to do business. "If you upload a sample of the files, I can give you a better idea of what level of... investment you're going to need.
entries.zh:
"解密？"$HeOrShe笑了。

"这不成问题。论数据技术，没人比得过速子科技，而且我相信我们能谈成一桩稳妥的安排...只要你的星币够。"

$HeOrShe把$hisOrHer双手一合，一副急于做生意的样子。"你先上传一份文件样本，我就能更准确地告诉你，这笔...投入大概要多大。"

o.en: Upload a sample of the ANDRADA files
o.zh: 上传 ANDRADA 文件的样本

entries.en: "You'll be back," $heOrShe says, projecting confidence.
entries.zh: "你会回来的，"$heOrShe说道，刻意显出十足的信心。

o.en: I could just take this to Gargoyle. You know, the hacker?
o.zh: 我大可以拿去找 Gargoyle。你知道的，那个黑客？

o.en: I could probably just sell these files to another faction and make quite a profit.
o.zh: 我大概也能把这些文件卖给别的势力，赚上一笔。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"12,000 credits," $heOrShe says. "Take it or leave it."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"12,000 星币，\"$heOrShe说道，\"要就要，不要拉倒。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"16,000 credits," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"16,000 星币，"$heOrShe说道。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, consternated.

"Then see what you can get out of that anarchist," $heOrShe says. "You'll probably end up with a virus in your flagship for the trouble."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe舔了舔$hisOrHer嘴唇，一脸为难。

"那就去看看能从那个无政府主义者身上榨出什么，\"$heOrShe说道，\"到头来你的旗舰多半会中个病毒，算是这趟的报酬。"

entries.en: "You think you're the first spacer," $heOrShe says, "with a datacore full of noise claiming to have essential intel for sale?"
entries.zh: "你以为你是头一个，\"$heOrShe说道，\"抱着个塞满杂音的数据核心，声称手里有关键情报待售的太空人？"

entries.en: "Only because I admire your assertive negotiation, I'll do it for 12,000 credits," $heOrShe says. "Are you in or out?"
entries.zh: "纯粹是欣赏你这股强硬的谈法，12,000 星币，\"$heOrShe说道，\"做还是不做？"

entries.en: "But because I admire your spirit, I'll do 16,000 credits," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh: "不过看在你这份胆气的份上，16,000 星币，"$heOrShe说道。

entries.en: $HeOrShe crosses $hisOrHer arms. "Go on, try it. It'll be a waste of time, and time is credits."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe抱起$hisOrHer双臂。"去啊，试试看。白费时间，而时间就是星币。"

o.en: I need to access some very sensitive, heavily encrypted files.
o.zh: 我需要读取一些高度敏感、层层加密的文件。

o.en: I need to access some very sensitive, heavily encrypted files.
o.zh: 我需要读取一些高度敏感、层层加密的文件。

entries.en: "I trust you are coordinating with Special Agent Siyavong?"
entries.zh: "想来您已经在同特别特工 Siyavong 接洽着了吧？"

o.en: I have no intention of doing so.

entries.en:
He nods.

"You are most patriotic, $titlePL, I am sure. I hope your service renders the Persean League more just and... disentangled from certain embarassments."

"Now I ought let you return to your work. We shall have much to discuss upon its completion, no doubt."
entries.zh:
他点了点头。

"$titlePL 这番爱国心，我信。盼您这趟差事能让英仙座联盟更公道些，也... 少沾上些叫人难堪的牵连。"

"我该放您回去办正事了。等事情办妥，咱们少不了一大堆要谈的。"

entries.en:
He nods.

"You are most patriotic, $titlePL, I am sure. I hope your service renders the Persean League more just and... disentangled from certain embarassments."

"Now I ought let you return to your work. We shall have much to discuss upon its completion, no doubt."
entries.zh:
他点了点头。

"$titlePL 这番爱国心，我信。盼您这趟差事能让英仙座联盟更公道些，也... 少沾上些叫人难堪的牵连。"

"我该放您回去办正事了。等事情办妥，咱们少不了一大堆要谈的。"

entries.en:
Horus produces a strained look.

"It is disappointing to hear you say that. If I could, I would persuade you otherwise - as a matter of patriotism toward the League, of course."
entries.zh:
Horus 脸上掠过一丝不自在。

"听您这么说，叫人失望。能劝的话我总要把您劝回来——自然是出于对联盟的一片忠心。"

entries.en:
He nods.

"I won't trouble you further upon the matter, then, $titlePL."

A pause.

"I believe that will be all?"
entries.zh:
他点了点头。

"那这桩事我就不多打扰了，$titlePL。"

顿了一顿。

"想来没别的事了吧？"

entries.en:
He nods.

"You are most gracious, $titlePL. I hope your service renders the Persean League more just and... disentangled from certain embarassments."

"Now I ought let you return to your work."
entries.zh:
他点了点头。

"$titlePL 真是通情达理。盼您这趟差事能让英仙座联盟更公道些，也... 少沾上些叫人难堪的牵连。"

"我该放您回去办正事了。"

entries.en:
"As a gentleman," he speaks deliberately. "I would not besmirch the good name of the Coucil of Demarchons by implying the files were leaked by one of their esteemed class."

"Having said that, my understanding is that certain of the files were redacted per the privilege of the Prime Demarchon's office."

He glances away.

"Reynard moved more quickly than I expected. I had thought the files could be introduced without objection to the council during a quiet moment..."
entries.zh:
"身为绅士，\" 他字斟句酌，\"我可不愿玷污统领议会的清名，去暗示文件是他们里头某位体面人物漏出来的。"

"话虽如此，据我所知，其中有些文件是依着大统领办公厅的权责给删节过的。"

他把目光移开。

"Reynard 出手比我预想的快。我原打算趁个风平浪静的空当，把文件不声不响地递到议会上..."

o.en: I will send you my full copy. (send the files)
o.zh: 我把完整的副本发给您。 (发送文件)

o.en: I'm sure the Prime Demarchon has a good reason for restricting certain information.
o.zh: 大统领扣下某些消息，想来总有他的道理。

entries.en: "Of course," he says. "I would never suggest you do otherwise."
entries.zh: "自然，\" 他说道，\"我哪会劝您反着来。"

o.en: Good. Let us discuss other matters, then.
I'm just kidding. I'll send you my full copy. (send the files)
o.zh: 玩笑话。我把完整副本发给您。 (发送文件)

entries.en:
"You have my thanks, $titlePL."

He nods, not quite a bow.

"As a gentleman," he speaks deliberately. "I would not besmirch the good name of the Coucil of Demarchons by implying the files were leaked by one of their esteemed class."

"Having said that, my understanding is that certain of the files were redacted per the privilege of the Prime Demarchon's office."

He glances away.

"Reynard moved more quickly than I expected. I had thought the files could be introduced without objection to the council during a quiet moment..."
entries.zh:
"多谢了，$titlePL。"

他点了点头，算不上鞠躬。

"身为绅士，\" 他字斟句酌，\"我可不愿玷污统领议会的清名，去暗示文件是他们里头某位体面人物漏出来的。"

"话虽如此，据我所知，其中有些文件是依着大统领办公厅的权责给删节过的。"

他把目光移开。

"Reynard 出手比我预想的快。我原打算趁个风平浪静的空当，把文件不声不响地递到议会上..."

entries.en:
"It is essential the Council know the full truth, unbiased by the interests of... certain gens."

He coughs politely, then re-settles his posture.
entries.zh:
"议会必须知道全部真相，不能让... 某些氏族的私利搅浑了。"

他客气地咳了一声，重新端正了坐姿。

entries.en:
"You have my thanks, $titlePL."

He nods, not quite a bow.
entries.zh:
"多谢了，$titlePL。"

他点了点头，算不上鞠躬。

o.en: I'd like the discuss the encrypted files I brought to you.
o.zh: 我想谈谈我交给你的那批加密文件。

entries.en:
"Yes... yes, of course." He turns aside, makes a shoo motion, then returns his focus to you.

"As I understand it, a version of these so-called ANDRADA files was released to the Council of Demarchons. I am not, strictly speaking, supposed to have access to them..."
entries.zh:
"是... 是，当然。" 他侧过身，做了个赶人的手势，转回头来重新对着你。

"据我所知，这批所谓 ANDRADA 文件有个版本已发到统领议会。严格说起来，我本不该看得到它们..."

o.en: I will send you my full copy. (send the files)
o.zh: 我把完整的副本发给您。 (发送文件)

entries.en:
"It is possible that Gens Yaribay's interests align with Kato's on this matter, but I shall need consult with my advisors and begin negotiations."

"Nonetheless, I appreciate that you have contacted me about this matter." He looks away, picking up a TriPad and beginning to tap at it. "Let us speak again when the situation develops further."

Horus looks up over his TriPad at you.

"For now, $titlePL, I shall bid you fare-well."
entries.zh:
"在这件事上，Yaribay 氏族的利益也许和 Kato 家一致，但我需要和顾问们商议，还要开始谈判。"

"尽管如此，我很感谢你就这件事联系我。\"他移开视线，拿起一台 TriPad，开始在上面点划。\"等局势再有发展，我们再谈。"

Horus 从 TriPad 上方抬头看你。

"眼下就先这样，$titlePL，祝你安好。"

o.en: Is there some way I can help you?
Is it possible you are overthinking this?
o.zh: 有没有可能，是你想得太多了？

o.en: The intricacy of Gens politics may be somewhat beyond a simple spacer like myself.
o.zh: 氏族政治这般千头万绪，像我这样单纯的太空船员，怕是有点跟不上。

o.en: I found Fortuna persuasive. I intend to support her and Achilles.
o.zh: 我觉得 Fortuna 说得有道理。我打算支持她和 Achilles。

o.en: I don't trust Fortuna, but I do intend to support Achilles.
o.zh: 我不信任 Fortuna，但我确实打算支持 Achilles。

o.en: I think I should just report this all to Reynard Hannan.
o.zh: 我想我该把这一切都报告给 Reynard Hannan。

o.en: I'll leave you to your thoughts, then. (don't involve yourself further)
o.zh: 那我就让你自己慢慢想。 (不再牵扯进去)

entries.en: He looks up, almost grateful. "Perhaps, $titlePL. Perhaps."
entries.zh: 他抬起头，几乎是带着感激。"也许吧，$titlePL。也许。"

entries.en:
This earns you a fleeting smile.

"Without a doubt," he admits. "But one such as myself was born into Gens politics, and it I must drink and breathe if my Gens is to survive."
entries.zh:
这话换来他一个转瞬即逝的微笑。

"毫无疑问，\"他承认道。\"但像我这样的人，生来就泡在氏族政治里；要让我的氏族存续下去，我就得把它当成水和空气。"

entries.en:
This earns you a fleeting smile.

"It is no failing or deficiency on your part, $titlePL," he concedes. "Possibly quite the opposite. But one such as myself was born into Gens politics, and it I must drink and breathe if my Gens is to survive."
entries.zh:
这话换来他一个转瞬即逝的微笑。

"这不是你的过失或欠缺，$titlePL，\"他让步道。\"也许恰恰相反。但像我这样的人，生来就泡在氏族政治里；要让我的氏族存续下去，我就得把它当成水和空气。"

entries.en:
"Fortuna." Horus looks up at you, expression strained.

"Well, you must do as you feel you must, $titlePL. I would not ask otherwise, though I advise caution."

"Gens politics are never quite what they seem."
entries.zh:
"Fortuna。"Horus 抬头看向你，神情紧绷。

"那就随你觉得该怎么做就怎么做吧，$titlePL。我不会强求，只是劝你谨慎。"

"氏族政治从来都不是表面看上去那样。"

entries.en:
"Achilles, then." Horus looks up at you, expression strained.

"Well, you must do as you feel you must, $titlePL. I would not ask otherwise, though I advise caution. Gens politics are never quite what they seem. And when you become entangled with the League, the Gens are unavoidable."
entries.zh:
"那就 Achilles。"Horus 抬头看向你，神情紧绷。

"那就随你觉得该怎么做就怎么做吧，$titlePL。我不会强求，只是劝你谨慎。氏族政治从来都不是表面看上去那样。而一旦你跟联盟牵扯上关系，氏族就避不开了。"

entries.en:
"Reynard." That got his attention.

Horus looks at you, expression dim.

"Do as you feel you must, $titlePL. I would not ask otherwise. And it is possible that Reynard offers stability against Fortuna's... adventurism. On the other hand, Gens politics are never quite what they seem. I advise caution."

"Nonetheless, you have my thanks for what you have done for me 'til now."
entries.zh:
"Reynard。"这话让他抬起了头。

Horus 看着你，神情黯淡。

"你觉得该怎么做就怎么做吧，$titlePL。我不会强求。也许 Reynard 能带来稳定，制衡 Fortuna 的...冒险主义。可另一方面，氏族政治从来都不是表面看上去那样。我劝你谨慎。"

"不管怎样，我感谢你至今为我做的一切。"

entries.en:
"I shall need consult with my advisors and begin certain negotiations, much as Fortuna has done already."

He looks away, picking up a TriPad and beginning to tap at it. "Perhaps we shall soon speak again upon this; for now, I bid you fare-well."
entries.zh:
"我需要和我的顾问们商议，并着手一些谈判——Fortuna 已经先走了一步。"

他移开视线，拿起一台 TriPad，开始在上面点划。"或许我们很快会再谈这件事；眼下，我祝你安好。"

entries.en: "Mm," he says, still lost in thought.
entries.zh: "嗯，"他说，仍陷在思绪里。

entries.en: "Mm," he says, still lost in thought.
entries.zh: "嗯，"他说，仍陷在思绪里。

entries.en: "Mm," he says, picking up a TriPad and beginning to tap at it. "You have my thanks for the service you have done Gens Yaribay, $titlePL. I bid you fare-well."
entries.zh: "嗯，\"他说着，拿起一台 TriPad，开始在上面点划。\"你为 Yaribay 氏族做的事，我记下了，$titlePL。祝你安好。"

o.en: I'm asking about Lieutenant Kallian as a Demarchon of the Persean League.
o.zh: 我是以英仙座联盟统领的身份，在打听 Kalian 中尉。

o.en: I bear a commission of the Persean League. I ask again, do you know of a Lieutenant Kallian?
o.zh: 我持有英仙座联盟的委任状。我再问一次，你认得一位 Kalian 中尉吗？

entries.en:
$personName sits up straight. "My apologies, Demarchon. I didn't recognize you in this context - my comms suite should have..."

$HeOrShe gives an annoyed glance to the side, perhaps directed at the comms technician.

"Nonetheless, I'm not familiar with... Kalian, you said? An officer in Fleet? Hm." $HeOrShe taps at $hisOrHer datapad.
entries.zh:
$personName 坐直了身子。"恕我失礼，统领。这种场合我没认出你来——我的通讯系统本该..."

$HeOrShe 不快地朝旁边瞥了一眼，大概是在看通讯技师。

"不过，我对... 你说的是 Kalian？舰队里的一名军官？嗯。"$HeOrShe 在$hisOrHer的数据板上敲了几下。

entries.en:
"Yes, it looks like we did have a transfer recently. Lieutenant... Kalian. Yes."

$HisOrHer eyes scan the datapad. "Wow."
entries.zh:
"对，看来我们最近确实接收过一名调动人员。中尉... Kalian。对。"

$HisOrHer 的目光扫过数据板。"哇哦。"

entries.en:
"They usually send us... well, between you and me, demarchon, Yesod isn't exactly Fleet's top priority."

"We get the dregs. Drunks, fools, and the most disgraced of the gens-babies to lead them. Your Kalian? His record says he was flagged for an early command. Someone thought he'd have a serious career. Then it looks like that got squashed by..." $HeOrShe taps for a moment the interface. "Some major gens or other. Shame."

"Not that Kalian is totally clean... Looks like he got into a fight in a spacer bar not long after transfer. Public record suppressed. Someone up high felt bad for him, I'd guess."
entries.zh:
"他们派给我们的通常都是... 这么说吧，统领，你我之间的话，Yesod 可不算舰队的头等要地。"

"分到这儿来的都是些剩货。醉鬼、蠢货，还有最丢人的那批氏族子弟来带队。你那位 Kalian？档案上说他曾被标为可提前授衔指挥。有人觉得他会有番正经前程。可后来似乎被... 压下去了。\"$HeOrShe 在界面上敲了一阵。\"某个大氏族之类。可惜。"

"倒不是说 Kalian 一点污点都没有... 看来他调来没多久，就在一家太空佬酒吧里打了架。公开记录被压了下去。我猜是上头有人替他难过。"

o.en: An officer should know to control himself regardless of the circumstances.
o.zh: 不管什么处境，军官都该懂得克制自己。

o.en: He lost a prime opportunity to corruption. It's natural to take out that anger.
o.zh: 他丢掉的那个绝好机会，毁在了腐败上。把火气撒出来，也是人之常情。

o.en: Do you have a comms ID? I'd like to speak with him.
o.zh: 你有他的通讯识别码吗？我想跟他谈谈。

entries.en: "I suppose." A look of concern crosses $hisOrHer face. "But he should have the sense to direct it where it belongs."
entries.zh: "也许吧。\"$hisOrHer 脸上掠过一丝担忧。\"可他该有分寸，把火气发在该发的地方。"

entries.en: "I suppose. The young..." $HeOrShe looks up. "They have much to learn. I hope Fleet knows what it's doing here."
entries.zh: "也许吧。年轻人...\"$HeOrShe 抬起头。\"他们要学的还多。但愿舰队知道自己在做什么。"

entries.en:
"I do, in fact." $HeOrShe taps the datapad. "You should have it now."

"Good luck with... with whatever you're up to, demarchon. Maybe give Lieutenant Kallian a bit of advice on how to deal with the gens?"

$name smirks, then shakes $hisOrHer head.

"Anything else today?"
entries.zh:
"我确实有。\"$HeOrShe 在数据板上敲了一下。\"你现在应该收到了。"

"祝你好运... 不管你打算做什么，统领。也许可以给 Kalian 中尉提点建议，教他怎么应付那些氏族？"

$name 咧嘴一笑，随即摇起 $hisOrHer 的头。

"今天还有别的事吗？"

entries.en:
"I see. However, $playerSirOrMadam, I remain a civilian administrator."

$HeOrShe picks up a datapad. "Out of respect for your dedication to the defense of the League, I'll do what I can. Which isn't much. I assume this is somehow pursuant to factional defense interests?"

$HeOrShe looks up at you, but doesn't wait for a reply, then executes a series of taps on datapad.

"I've sent a request with your comms ID to my Fleet liaison. Maybe they'll help, maybe not. You'll know if you get a comms request."

$HeOrShe leans back. "That help?"
entries.zh:
"我明白。不过，$playerSirOrMadam，我终究只是个民政行政官。"

$HeOrShe 拿起一块数据板。"念在你为联盟防务尽心尽力的份上，我尽力而为。不过也做不了多少。我猜这事多少与联盟的防务利益有关？"

$HeOrShe 抬眼看向你，却没等你回答，随即在数据板上敲了一连串指令。

"我已经把你的通讯识别码附在一份请求里，发给了我的舰队联络官。他们帮不帮，不好说。要是收到通讯请求，那就是有回音了。"

$HeOrShe 靠回椅背。"这样有帮助吗？"

o.en: It's the least you could do.
o.zh: 这不过是你最起码该做的。

entries.en: "You're welcome," $heOrShe says. "Is there anything else I can help with?"
entries.zh: "不客气，\"$heOrShe 说道，\"还有别的我能帮上的吗？"

entries.en:
An annoyed look.

"You're so very welcome, captain. Now I have an important meeting."

$HeOrShe hits the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
一脸不快。

"不必客气，舰长。现在我有个重要的会。"

$HeOrShe 按下了通讯切断键。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe smiles and shakes $hisOrHer head.

"No, I'll not be taking a bribe. Quartermaster's privilege is one thing, but there's some matters you don't stick fingers in if you want to keep all ten or so."

"And Lieutenant Kalian? I want the best for him, I suppose. He was polite. No gens-baby, that one."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 笑了笑，摇了摇 $hisOrHer 的头。

"不行，我不受贿。军需官有军需官的门路，这是一回事；可有些事，想保住十根手指就别往里伸。"

"至于 Kalian 中尉？我倒是希望他好。他懂礼貌。不是那种氏族少爷，那一个不是。"

o.en: I understand. I apologize if I overstepped propriety.
o.zh: 我明白。若是我失了分寸，还望见谅。

o.en: I do too. I'm looking for him because his life may be in danger.
o.zh: 我也希望他好。我找他，是因为他可能有性命之忧。

entries.en: "I've already forgotten," $heOrShe says with a wink.
entries.zh: "我已经忘了，"$heOrShe 眨了眨眼说道。

entries.en:
Now $heOrShe looks concerned.

"Don't know what that might be about, captain, and I don't want to know. Sounds like it's above my pay grade. I think you should talk to the station commander."
entries.zh:
$heOrShe 此刻露出了关切的神色。

"不知道那会是什么事，舰长，我也不想知道。听起来不是我这点薪水该操心的。我看你该去找空间站指挥官谈谈。"

o.en: You couldn't tell me why he transferred? Is it classified?
o.zh: 他调来的原因你不能说？是机密吗？

entries.en:
"Oh, I don't know," $heOrShe says.

"Like I said, I'm the quartermaster. It's always 'we need this list of materiel and we need it yesterday'. Now if they'd bothered to plan ahead and comms me for a chat to let me know what's been planned, maybe drop off an extra crate of this or that, it'd make everyone's life easier."

$PersonLastName shakes $hisOrHer head.
entries.zh:
"哦，我可说不清，"$heOrShe 说道。

"像我说的，我是军需官。永远是'这份物资清单我们昨天就要'。要是他们肯提前规划，跟我通个话聊聊打算怎么办，也许再顺手多送一箱这个那个过来，大家日子都好过。"

$PersonLastName 摇了摇 $hisOrHer 的头。

o.en: Can you give me Kalian's comms ID?
o.zh: 能把 Kalian 的通讯识别码给我吗？

entries.en:
"I don't know about that, $playerSirOrMadam." $HeOrShe drums a few fingers on $hisOrHer console with a renewed look of concern for regulations.

"If it's not a request from Fleet, I can't just give out the comms IDs of an officer unless it's been approved."

$HeOrShe shrugs. "Sorry."
entries.zh:
"这个我可不敢说，$playerSirOrMadam。"$HeOrShe 用几根手指在 $hisOrHer 控制台上敲了敲，脸上又浮出那种对规章的顾虑。

"要不是舰队发来的请求，我不能随便把一名军官的通讯识别码交出去，除非已经批了。"

$HeOrShe 耸了耸肩。"抱歉。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks down, pokes at an interface, and frowns.

"So you are."

More tapping at the interface. The frown deepens.

"Looks like his comms ID really has been classified by FleetInt. So no luck, captain. Maybe Kalian got into a fight with the wrong spacer, eh?"

"I'm sorry, but I'm not going to step on FleetInt's toes for you, $playerSirOrMadam. Best of luck finding Lieutenant Kalian."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 低下头，戳了戳界面，皱起眉。

"所以确实是。"

又在界面上敲了几下。眉头皱得更紧。

"看来他的通讯识别码真被舰队情报部列为机密了。那就没办法了，舰长。也许 Kalian 是跟不该惹的太空佬打了一架，嗯？"

"抱歉，我可不会为了你去踩舰队情报部的脚，$playerSirOrMadam。祝你顺利找到 Kalian 中尉。"

o.en: Perhaps someone in your position could put a 'donation' to good use...
o.zh: 也许像你这样位置的人，能让一笔'捐款'发挥点用处...

o.en: I am commissioned by the Persean League, $rank.
o.zh: 我持有英仙座联盟的委任状，$rank。

o.en: I am a Demarchon of the Persean League, $rank.
o.zh: 我是英仙座联盟的统领，$rank。

entries.en: "M'pleasure," $personLastName says and gives a casual salute before signing off the link.
entries.zh: "好说，"$personLastName 说着，随意敬了个礼，随后切断了通讯链路。

entries.en: $PersonLastName shrugs and hits the comms cut-off.
entries.zh: $PersonLastName 耸了耸肩，按下了通讯切断键。

o.en: What do you mean by potential?
o.zh: 你说的'潜质'是什么意思？

entries.en:
"You get a feel for it in my position," $heOrShe says, lifting $hisOrHer chin. "Some new officers, they expect you to come to them and beg for a requisition list. As if I need to make more work for myself!"

"Kalian, he showed before his first duty shift. Polite, to-the-point, organized. Practically did my job for me - with a fine salute, on top."

$HeOrShe leans back, smiling, "And he did all of that looking bruised and battered like he'd fell down from orbit! Made an impression, I tell you. And, ha-ha, he must have made an impression on some spacer scu- some, er, unruly individuals at the bar."
entries.zh:
"在我这个位置上，你自然会有感觉，\"$heOrShe 扬起 $hisOrHer 下巴说道，\"有些新来的军官，还指望你上门去求一份申领单。好像我嫌自己活儿不够多似的！"

"Kalian 呢，头一班岗之前就来找我了。有礼貌，说话干脆，办事有条理。简直把我的活儿替我干了——末了还敬了个漂亮的礼。"

$HeOrShe 靠回椅背，笑吟吟的，"而且他做这些的时候，一身青一块紫一块，活像从轨道上摔下来过！跟你说，印象深得很。还有，哈哈，他大概也给酒吧里那几个太空佬渣... 那个，不太守规矩的家伙，留下了点印象。"

o.en: Do you know a Lieutenant Achilles Kalian?
o.zh: 你知道一位叫 Achilles Kalian 的上尉吗？

entries.en:
$Post $personLastName considers the name for a moment.

"Nope, don't know him."
entries.zh:
$Post $personLastName 琢磨了一下这个名字。

"没有，不认识。"

o.zh: 刚调来不久，还在等分配？

entries.en: "No problem," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh: "没事。"$heOrShe说。

entries.en: "Oh, of course," $heOrShe says, nodding. "Got into a bar fight. I heard about that."
entries.zh: "哦，当然。\"$heOrShe点着头说。\"酒吧斗殴。那事我听说了。"

o.zh: 这么说你认识 Kalian 上尉？

entries.en:
$Post $personLastName considers the name for a moment.

"Nope, don't know him."
entries.zh:
$Post $personLastName 琢磨了一下这个名字。

"没有，不认识。"

o.en: Recent transfer. Awaiting assignment. Got in a bar fight?"
o.zh: 刚调来不久，还在等分配，还打过一场酒吧斗殴？

entries.en:
"Oh, of course," $heOrShe says, nodding. "I heard about that."

$HeOrShe looks you over. "And you... you got into one too, didn't you?" $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head.
entries.zh:
"哦，当然。\"$heOrShe点着头说。\"那事我听说了。"

$HeOrShe打量你一番。"还有你...你也打了一场，是吧？"说着，$HeOrShe晃了晃$hisOrHer脑袋。

o.en: Let's focus on Kalian. What'd you hear about the fight?
o.zh: 先说 Kalian。那场斗殴你听说了什么？
这么说你认识 Kalian 上尉？

entries.en:
"Oh, of course," $heOrShe says, nodding.

"I heard about that."
entries.zh:
"哦，当然。"$heOrShe点着头说。

"那事我听说了。"

o.zh: 这么说你认识 Kalian 上尉？

entries.en: "That he was in a bar fight, yes," $heOrShe says. "That's it."
entries.zh: "听说他卷进了一场酒吧斗殴，对。\"$heOrShe说。\"就这些。"

entries.en: "That it happened," $heOrShe says. "Kalian and some spacer, I think? The station commander was not happy, sent out a memo about military-civil relations."
entries.zh: "听说确实打了。\"$heOrShe说。\"Kalian 和某个太空佬，好像是？空间站指挥官很不高兴，发了一份关于军民关系的通告。"

o.en: So you do know Lieutenant Kalian!
o.zh: 所以你的确认识 Kalian 上尉！

entries.en:
"That it happened," $heOrShe says. "Kalian and some spacer, I think? The station commander was not happy, sent out a memo about military-civil relations."

"You sure didn't help, did you," $heOrShe adds. "I'd stay out of the station commander's way if I were you."
entries.zh:
"听说确实打了。\"$heOrShe说。\"Kalian 和某个太空佬，好像是？空间站指挥官很不高兴，发了一份关于军民关系的通告。"

"你肯定没帮上忙，是吧。\"$heOrShe补了一句。\"换作我，就离空间站指挥官远点。"

o.en: So you do know Lieutenant Kalian!
o.zh: 所以你的确认识 Kalian 上尉！

entries.en:
$HeOrShe thinks for a moment.

"The station commander was not happy. Sent out a memo about military-civil relations. I'm Fleet, captain. Need to keep everyone happy, military and commercial alike."

"If one of mine got in a fight," $heOrShe says, "they'd be cleaning the heads for a month. That's all I'll say about that."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe想了一会儿。

"空间站指挥官很不高兴，发了一份关于军民关系的通告。我是舰队的人，舰长。军方也好，商界也好，两头都得哄好。"

"要是我手下有人打了这么一架，\"$heOrShe说，\"就得刷一个月厕所。这话我就说到这儿。"

entries.en:
"No. Just that he got in a fight." $HeOrShe shrugs.

"Sorry, that's all I've got."
entries.zh:
"没有。只听说他打了一架。"$HeOrShe耸了耸肩。

"抱歉，我就知道这么多。"

entries.en:
"No. Just that he got in a fight. I suppose it wasn't with you?"

$HeOrShe pauses a moment, looking to see if you'll volunteer anything, then shrugs.

"Anyway, have you got some business to discuss?"
entries.zh:
"没有。只听说他打了一架。我猜不是跟你打？"

$HeOrShe顿了顿，看着你会不会主动说点什么，然后耸了耸肩。

"总之，你有没有什么事要谈？"

entries.en:
$Post $personLastName gets an annoyed look.

"Yes? A lieutenant you say? I'm an administrator of the civilian polity, captain. Ask someone from Fleet about your lieutenant, like our local station commander."

$HeOrShe sighs.

"Did you have anything relevant to my duties to discuss?"
entries.zh:
$Post $personLastName 露出一脸的不耐烦。

"有事？你说一位中尉？舰长，我是民政管理机构的行政官。你那位中尉的事，去问舰队里的人，比如我们本地的空间站指挥官。"

$HeOrShe 叹了口气。

"你还有什么事，是跟我的职责有关的吗？"

entries.en:
$Post $personLastName gives you a look, then glances down at a datapad and taps something.

"It would be inappropriate to discuss internal Fleet affairs, captain. Unless you have a complaint to make?"
entries.zh:
$Post $personLastName 看了你一眼，低头扫了眼数据板，点了几下。

"讨论舰队内部事务不太合适，舰长。除非你有投诉要提？"

o.en: No complaint. I'm looking to contact Lieutenant Kalian.
o.zh: 没有投诉。我想联系 Kalian 上尉。

entries.en:
$Post $personLastName gives you a look, then glances down at a datapad and taps something.

"It would be inappropriate to discuss internal Fleet affairs, captain. Unless you have a complaint to make?"
entries.zh:
$Post $personLastName 看了你一眼，低头扫了眼数据板，点了几下。

"讨论舰队内部事务不太合适，舰长。除非你有投诉要提？"

o.en: No complaint. I'm looking to contact Lieutenant Kalian.
o.zh: 没有投诉。我想联系 Kalian 上尉。

o.en: Yes, uh. There was an altercation in a spacer bar...
o.zh: 有，呃。太空佬酒吧里出过一次冲突...

entries.en:
$Post $personLastName gives you a look, then glances down at a datapad and taps something. Then looks back up at you, wearily.

"I don't make it a habit of discussing internal Fleet affairs, $titlePL. Even with those who bear our commission. I have orders to be highly discrete in matters involving Lieutenant Kalian after the... incident."
entries.zh:
$Post $personLastName 看了你一眼，随后低头看了看数据板，敲了几下，又疲惫地抬眼看向你。

"我不习惯谈论舰队内部事务，$titlePL。哪怕对方持有我们的委任状也一样。在那件... 事之后，凡涉及 Kalian 中尉，我都奉命必须极度谨慎。"

entries.en:
$Post $personLastName gives you a look, then glances down at a datapad and taps something.

"It would be inappropriate to discuss internal Fleet affairs. Especially with a commissioned auxiliary of the Hegemony."

$HeOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off.

"Good day, captain."
entries.zh:
$Post $personLastName 看了你一眼，随后低头看了看数据板，敲了几下。

"谈论舰队内部事务是不合适的。尤其是对一个持有霸主委任状的辅助人员。"

$HeOrShe 伸手去按通讯切断键。

"日安，舰长。"

entries.en:
"Kalian, Kalian..." $HeOrShe looks up, rubbing $hisOrHer ear.

After a moment, $hisOrHer eyes light up. "Lieutenant Kalian, of course."

"Recent transfer. Fine young man. Such potential! Couldn't tell you why he got assigned to Yesod, but they don't tell the quartermaster anything, ha-ha."
entries.zh:
"Kalian，Kalian..."$HeOrShe 抬起头，揉着$hisOrHer的耳朵。

过了一会儿，$hisOrHer 的眼睛亮了起来。"Kalian 中尉，当然。"

"最近刚调来的。好小伙子。多有潜质！他为什么被派到 Yesod，我可说不出来——不过他们什么都不会告诉军需官，哈哈。"

entries.en: You make a quick exit before things get out of control.
entries.zh: 在场面失控之前，你迅速离场。

entries.en: It doesn't take a tactician to read the room. You make a quick exit before things get ugly.
entries.zh: 读懂这屋里的气氛用不着战术家。在事情变难看之前，你迅速抽身。

entries.en:
* * *

You got a good first hit in.

But there were a lot of them, and they're Fleet officers in a Persean League polity. This doesn't make them tougher than the usual crowd, but they enjoy certain exceptional legal protections.

Your bodyguards could only do so much to pull you from the chaos - your honor, perhaps, intact. Bodily you are battered and bruised, uniform torn, and your local reputation besmirched.

The MuniSec officer who 'interviews' you makes it clear that someone higher up gave an order to sweep this incident away. They just want you gone, and quietly.
entries.zh:
* * *

你第一拳打得漂亮。

可他们人太多，而且这里是英仙座联盟的政体，他们是舰队军官。这并不让他们比寻常的混混更抗揍，但他们享有某些格外好用的法律保护。

你的保镖能把你从乱局里拖出来，能做的也就那么多——名誉也许还算完好。身上青一块紫一块，制服扯破了，你在此地的名声也毁了。

"约谈"你的那名 MuniSec 军官把话说得很明白：上头有人下令，把这事抹平。他们只想让你走，而且是悄无声息地走。

entries.en:
You're treated to an enthusiastic retelling of the injustice faced by Kalian - a brilliant officer, the academy's finest - who received a choice assignment then had it withdrawn at the last moment. And then, again, about his confrontation with a barbaric spacer who dared malign the good name of the League (generally) and (in particular) Fleet.

Sour talk about Gens-babies taking the choice missions is much quieter. You steer the conversation back toward what could be done for Kalian - perhaps a private request for increased fleet patrols to quell piracy, even mercenary work...

The drunk League officers are more than happy to help their comrade make a useful contact.
entries.zh:
你被热情地灌了一通 Kalian 所受的不公：一个出色的军官，学院里最拔尖的人，本已拿到一份好差事，却在最后一刻被撤了。接着又是一遍，讲他怎么跟一个野蛮的太空佬对上——那人竟敢玷污联盟 (泛泛而言) 和舰队 (尤其) 的好名声。

至于说氏族崽子抢走好任务的酸话，就压得低多了。你把话头引回能为 Kalian 做点什么——也许私下请求增派舰队巡逻、清剿海盗，甚至雇佣兵的活儿...

这些醉醺醺的联盟军官乐得帮自家兄弟搭上一条有用的线。

o.en: Say your polite good-byes and leave

entries.en: You deftly extract yourself before the officers can ply you with ill-advised quantities of drink.
entries.zh: 趁军官们还没灌你喝下那些不明智的酒量，你利落地脱了身。

BTW an assassin tried to take him out already and failed - thats what really happened in the bar, the random fight story is a coverup

找到了 Achilles，选项：

- 留在英仙座联盟，移交给舰队情报局的 Finlay Siyavong

顺带一提，已经有个刺客想取他性命却没得逞 - 酒吧里真正发生的就是这回事，那场"偶遇斗殴"的说法是遮掩。

o.en: The incident - the bar fight with a spacer?
o.zh: 那件事——跟一个太空佬在酒吧打架？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe pauses for a moment, then speaks.

"That's the story, yes. But it wasn't a bar fight - it was a targeted attack. An assassination attempt."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 顿了顿，才开口。

"对外是这么说，没错。可那不是酒吧斗殴——那是针对性的袭击。一次暗杀企图。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe pauses for a moment, then speaks.

"Cover story was he got in a bar fight. But it wasn't - it was a targeted attack. An assassination attempt."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 顿了顿，才开口。

"对外说他在酒吧打了架。其实不是——那是针对性的袭击。一次暗杀企图。"

entries.en: "Strange, though. Wasn't Pathers that did it, or ANTIs or anything like that. And why a lieutenant? Kalian was impressive in the academy, but he's nobody. No history, no gens."
entries.zh: "可这事透着古怪。动手的不是左径分子，也不是 ANTI 或者那一类人。而且为什么是一名中尉？Kalian 在军官学院里很出色，可他没什么分量。没有履历，没有家世。"

o.en: Huh. Weird. I'd like to speak with him - do you have his comms ID?
o.zh: 嗯。怪事。我想跟他谈谈——你有他的通讯识别码吗？

o.en: It's probably because he's a clone of Philip Andrada
o.zh: 大概因为他是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体

entries.en:
$HeOrShe sighs.

"Sorry, $playerLastName. Direct orders."

"We should wrap. Weird business going around, like some Fleet Intelligence op. I don't like it, but no one asked me or told me anything."

"That'll be you too, if you know what's good for you. Give me a stand-up fight, stick to your guns - those you can count on."

$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat and reaches for the comms cut-off. "Good day, then."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 叹了口气。

"抱歉，$playerLastName。这是直接命令。"

"我们就到这儿吧。最近在办些古怪的事，像是舰队情报部的行动。我不喜欢，可没人问过我，也没人告诉我什么。"

"你要是识相，也会落得同样的处境。给我一场堂堂正正的仗，守住你的炮位——那些才靠得住。"

$HeOrShe 清了清 $hisOrHer 嗓子，伸手去按通讯切断键。"那么，日安。"

entries.en:
$Post $PersonLastName stares at you for a long, long moment. Processing.

"$TitlePL," $heOrShe says finally. "Your comms signal must have had a glitch, it seems like your last statement got garbled."

"I believe we must now conclude our discussion. I have... a meeting. To attend."

$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat and reaches for the comms cut-off.

"Good day, then."
entries.zh:
$Post $PersonLastName 久久地盯着你。像是在消化什么。

"$TitlePL，\"$heOrShe 终于开口，\"你的通讯信号恐怕出了故障——你最后那句话似乎串了音。"

"我想我们的谈话该到此为止了。我还有个... 会要赴。"

$HeOrShe 清了清 $hisOrHer 嗓子，伸手去按通讯切断键。

"那么，日安。"

entries.en: "He is unavailable," $heOrShe says. "On assignment."
entries.zh: "他现在不在，\"$heOrShe 说道，\"有任务在身。"

o.en: I see. Thank you for your time.
o.zh: 我明白了。多谢你抽时间。

o.en: I was under the impression that he was unassigned at present.
o.zh: 我原以为他目前没有任职。

entries.en:
"And you were not involved, captain," $heOrShe says icily. "I repeat, it would be inappropriate to discuss internal Fleet affairs."

$HeOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off.

"Good day, captain."
entries.zh:
"而你与这事无关，舰长，\"$heOrShe 冷冰冰地说，\"我再重复一次，谈论舰队内部事务是不合适的。"

$HeOrShe 伸手去按通讯切断键。

"日安，舰长。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks at you from overtop a datapad.

"Yes, I see now. And you were involved. Threw the first punch, as the surveillance proved. Struck a cadet of the Persean League Navy. Then you were told to leave."

The $post takes a deep breath.

"We're being very lenient with you, captain." $HeOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off.

"Good day and good-bye."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe 从数据板上方看着你。

"对，我现在看明白了。而且你也有份。监控记录证实，是你先动的手。你打的是英仙座联盟海军的一名学员。然后你被要求离开。"

$post 深吸了一口气。

"我们对你是非常宽容了，舰长。"$HeOrShe 伸手去按通讯切断键。

"日安，再见。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods with only mild displeasure.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe 点了点头，只是略有些不满。

entries.en:
"Your 'impression' has no connection to Fleet," $heOrShe says icily. "And I repeat, it is inappropriate for me to discuss internal Fleet affairs with an outsider."

$HeOrShe reaches for the comms cut-off.

"Good day, captain."
entries.zh:
"你的'印象'跟舰队毫无关系，\"$heOrShe 冷冰冰地说，\"我再重复一次，我无权跟一个外人谈论舰队内部事务。"

$HeOrShe 伸手去按通讯切断键。

"日安，舰长。"

entries.en:
Comms signals for your attention.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam, there's an incoming comms. Persean League Fleet Intelligence, it says."
entries.zh:
通讯器发出提示，要你注意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，有通讯接进来。对方自称是英仙座联盟舰队情报部。"

o.en: I acquired potentially critical encrypted intel about the Sindrian Diktat. It may be valuable...
o.zh: 我拿到了一份加密情报，关于辛达强权，可能很要紧。说不定值不少钱...

entries.en:
"Take it to Faro Inesis. Achaman. Magec system."

She doesn't bother to infuse her voice with even a pretense of interest.

"Next item."
entries.zh:
"把它交给 Faro Inesis。Achaman，Magec 星系。"

她连装都懒得装出一点兴趣。

"下一项。"

entries.en:
"Take it to my strategic analyst, name is Faro Inesis. Achaman Franchise Station, Magec system."

She doesn't bother to infuse her voice with even a pretense of interest.

"Next item."
entries.zh:
"交给我的战略分析师，叫 Faro Inesis。Achaman Franchise Station，Magec 星系。"

她连装都懒得装出一点兴趣。

"下一项。"

entries.en:
The stylus stops spinning, the $post's eyes turn to you. $HeOrShe looks almost confused.

"There is no negotiation with the will of the Supreme Executor."

$HeOrShe puts the stylus down. "The Lion has shown such restraint with upstarts like you. Of course, in my heart, I know his long-term vision will produce the best possible world for all of us - those who have a part in his vision, that is - but... there's nothing I desire more than to turn degenerate scum like you into ash." $HeOrShe stares at you for a long moment, unblinking.
entries.zh:
笔杆停止了旋转，这位 $post 的眼睛转向了你。$HeOrShe看起来好像有些困惑。

"最高元首的意志没有谈判的余地。"

$HeOrShe把笔杆放下。"雄狮对像你这样的后起之秀表现出了极大的克制。当然，在我内心深处，我知道他的长远眼光将为我们所有人 —— 那些参与他愿景的人 —— 创造出一个尽可能好的世界。但是...我最大的愿景就是把像你这样堕落的渣滓化为灰烬。" $HeOrShe目不转睛地盯着你，久久没有眨眼。

entries.en: As you start to take in the clientele, the lights flicker. The sundry holos and screens fuzz and go blank as EM interference scrambles their inputs.
entries.zh: 你刚作为顾客落座的一刻，灯光突然闪烁起来。各个全息投影和电子屏幕变得模糊不清，然后直接白屏 —— 明显是电磁干扰影响了输入信号。

entries.en:
With a series of bangs, troopers in light combat frames burst through every entrance, shouting amplified orders, waving vicious little guns.

Random INTSEC raid; you know enough to appear calm and keep your hands away from your sidearm.

Each patron is scanned and, in-turn, their fate is revealed by a subtle movement of the lead INTSEC officer signaling whether they are to be left alone or arrested. Most are spared.
entries.zh:
身穿轻型战斗动力甲的士兵随着一连串的爆音从每个出入口鱼贯而入，口中命令凶狠咆哮、手中武器闪烁凶光。

这是 INTSEC 随机搜查；你很清楚此刻就得表现冷静，同时双手远离随身武器。

所有顾客都要逐一接受扫描，INTSEC 现场总指挥的一个小动作便会决定他们的命运：单独留下，或是当场逮捕。当然，大多数人都幸免于难。

entries.en:
One group of spacers appears to believe they have something to hide. As the officer approaches, they break into action. One manages to half-draw a concealed weapon but is hit with the crack of an electrostun/restraint-foam round. The convulsing body crashes through a table, sending pieces of broken glass up in glittering parabolae.

The rest of the party are restrained and beaten, the drumming of clubs on flesh eventually overtaking the cries of pain and outrage. Outsiders look on in horror; the staff and locals have a glazed, unfocused expression; it is safest to see nothing.
entries.zh:
一群宇宙民似乎是在隐藏些什么。当官员走近时，他们突然开始行动。其中一人刚刚将一把隐藏的武器掏出一半，就被电击/束缚泡沫弹击中。仍在抽搐着的身体撞翻了桌子，使得玻璃碎片在空中划出一条弧线。

剩下的人被制服和殴打，棍棒敲击在肉体上的声音最终盖过了痛苦愤怒的呼喊声。外来者们惊恐地看着这一幕；员工和本地人则表现得呆滞和失神；什么也不看应该是最安全的做法了。

entries.en: He says nothing, just stares at you for a moment. His off-hand twitches significantly and your world explodes with light and pain.
entries.zh: 他一言不发，只是盯着你看了一会儿。他的手猛地一抽，接着你的世界就在一片光亮和痛苦中炸开了。

o.en: Close your eyes and cover your vitals
o.zh: 闭上眼睛，保护要害部位

entries.en: His eyes narrow and flick down to his scanner.
entries.zh: 他眯起眼睛扫视着扫描仪。

entries.en: He says nothing, just stares at you for a moment. His off-hand twitches significantly and your world explodes with light and pain.
entries.zh: 他一言不发，只是盯着你看了一会儿。他的手猛地一抽，接着你的世界就在一片光亮和痛苦中炸开了。

o.en: Close your eyes and cover your vitals
o.zh: 闭上眼睛，保护要害部位

entries.en: He says nothing, just stares at you for a moment as if a chair tried to start a conversation.
entries.zh: 他一言不发，只是盯着你看了一会儿，仿佛你是一把试图开口交谈的椅子。

entries.en:
He responds with the automatic phrase, "The Movement is its own reward."

If his tone does not contain warmth, at least it holds the comfort that his internal IFF has slotted you into a non-hostile category.
entries.zh: 他用机械般生硬的语调说道："伟大运动本身就是回报。" 就算语气并不温暖，至少他脑子里的敌我识别程序把你归类到了非敌对类里。

entries.en: The Diktat Internal Security officer walks slowly on a tangent to you, examining each of your bodyguards from their feet to their weapons before shifting his gaze to you. You stare for a moment into dark eyes.
entries.zh: 辛达强权 内安部的军官突然停下手中工作，慢慢走向你，从头到脚再到武器地打量着你的每一个保镖，然后把目光转向了你。你盯着对方漆黑的双眼看了一会。

o.en: Thank you for your service, sir.
Thank you for your service, sir. (sarcastic)
o.zh: 感谢您的工作，长官。 (讽刺)

entries.en:
You find yourself slumped against a rattling air vent in a minor offshoot of the commercial concourse. One of your guards, bleeding and appallingly bruised, applies a dermal patch to your neck and your consciousness acknowledges the ocean of pain receding like a tide, leaving a loose hollowness in your chest and numbing cold in your limbs.

INTSEC simply wanted to send a message, it appears. Nothing more, nothing less.
entries.zh:
你发现你在商业港区的一个小弄堂里，现在正靠着一个作响的通风口。你的一个保镖 —— 此刻鼻青脸肿，留着鲜血 —— 在你的脖子上贴了个皮肤贴片。潮水一般的疼痛在你的潜意识里退去，只剩下胸口中的空洞感和四肢里发麻的冷意。

看来 INTSEC 只是想给个警告，仅此而已。

o.en: Just get back to your ship
Swear that you will have revenge
Admit that you had it coming

entries.en: You reflect that this is simply how power works. When challenged, it must prove itself or the illusion evaporates.
entries.zh: 你意识到，这就是权力的运作方式。当受到挑战时，它必须证明自己，否则那层幻影就会蒸发。

entries.en:
You focus on the INTSEC officer's face, using your physical pain to sear it into your memory.

One day, you swear, he will receive justice.
entries.zh:
你紧盯着 INTSEC 军官的脸，用躯体上的疼痛把他烙在你的记忆中。

总有一天，你发誓，他会被正义制裁。

entries.en:
It would almost be more reassuring to feel the pain. Without it, you feel empty. And tired.

With the help of your guards, you slowly make your way back to your ship.
entries.zh:
能感受到疼痛甚至还更让人安心些。没了只会让你觉得空虚。还有疲惫。

在你的保镖的帮助下，你慢慢地回到了舰船上。

entries.en:
The INTSEC officer gives a small nod to the guards, then moves on with arbitrary authority to the next spacer captain, who is given a similar treatment.

Apparently this means you're free to go. There will be no more business to be done at this bar for the rest of the shift. Even the corridors outside are strangely quiet, the populace recognizing the tell of a crackdown.
entries.zh:
这位 INTSEC 军官对着卫兵们轻轻点了下头，然后独断专行地向下一个太空舰长实施了差不多的处置。

显然这意思是你可以走了。整个星历日内这个酒吧里都不会有别的事了。即使是外面的走廊里也格外安静，人们知道什么是杀鸡儆猴。

entries.en:
"You're mad!" $HeOrShe says, nearly shouting. "Our mighty fleets, the, the Sindrian Diktat will stomp out your colonies and burn your memory from history! We'll-"

You watch as a drop of spittle flies through the air, a testament to the good quality of the holo's resolution. The $post is working up quite a lather and appears to have nothing else useful to say.
entries.zh:
"你疯了！" $HeOrShe喊道，"我们强大的舰队，我 —— 辛达强权 将会摧毁你的殖民地，把你的痕迹从历史中抹去！我们会 ——"

你注视着一滴唾沫在空中飞过，这是全息影像高分辨率的有力证明。这位 $post 滔滔不绝，但看起来已经没有什么有用的话要说了。

o.en: I'm here to inform you that I will be ending the fuel accord.
o.zh: 我来通知你，我将终止燃料条约。

entries.en:
"You- you can't do that!" The Diktat $Post looks quickly around for a moment, as if there might be some information that would make sense of your statement.

Finding none, $heOrShe settles back to look at you with a look of shock, edging toward anger. "Don't be a fool, you'll be made to regret this. You cannot cross the will of the Supreme Executor, not without grave punishment. You'll never be forgiven. He'll make an example of you. If you don't die in space, he'll send you to Cruor. If you try to hide, the Spider will find you. That's how it works."

"There's still time," $heOrShe says in a low voice. "I'll pretend you never said anything."
entries.zh:
"你-你不能这么做！" 这位辛达强权的 $Post 迅速环顾四周，好像在寻找能解释你言论的信息。

一无所获后，$heOrShe重新坐定，用震惊的眼神看着你，眼神中逐渐透露出愤怒。"别犯傻，你会为此后悔的。你不能违抗最高元首的意愿，否则将受到严厉惩罚。你永远不会被原谅。他会拿你当典型。如果你没在太空中丧生，他就会把你送到 Cruor。如果你试图躲藏，蜘蛛会找到你。这就是规矩。"

"还有时间，" $heOrShe低声说道，"我会装作你什么都没说。"

o.en: You heard me. The deal is off.

o.zh: 抱歉，我一定是口误了。 (返回)
开始 篡位者们 任务

o.en: set The Usurpers mission as completed
o.zh: 设定任务 篡位者们 已完成
设定已告诉 Caden 玩家会支持他
开始 Ram 的酒吧劫掠事件 (辛达强权 篡权者事件链)

o.en: set Macario gave PC an Executor as reward
o.zh: set Macario gave PC an Executor as reward

entries.en: Done.
entries.zh: 完成。

entries.en: Done.
entries.zh: 完成。

entries.en: Done.
entries.zh: 完成。

entries.en:
You take a deep breath.

And open your eyes.
entries.zh:
你深吸一口气。

然后睁开了眼睛。

entries.en:
There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindrian Diktat military network.

Then you could talk to Caden. Give his fanaticism a push in the right (or wrong) direction.
entries.zh:
Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与辛达强权的军用网络建立通讯链路。

然后你就能和 Caden 通话了。给他那份狂热推一把，推向正确 (或者错误) 的方向。

entries.en:
There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindrian Diktat military network.

Then you could talk to Hyder and explain the situation.
entries.zh:
Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与辛达强权的军用网络建立通讯链路。

然后你就能和 Hyder 通话，向她说明情况。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe holds up a hand, looking alarmed now.

"No. You cannot reject the deal. Do you understand your words? Do you understand the significance of this? To contradict the will of the Supreme Executor is the definition of treason."

The $post takes a deep breath.

"Captain. I was trying to be kind. But you appear not to understand, so I shall speak plainly: You WILL accept the deal as ordered. You will make no more outbursts. You will utter no more degradations against the authority of the Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat."

"You will signal your acceptance of the deal, as ordered. Now."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe举起一只手，现在看起来有些惊慌。

"不。你不能拒绝这个交易。你明白你的话吗？你明白这其中的意义吗？违抗最高元首的命令就是叛国。"

这位 $post 深吸了一口气。

"舰长。我本想友善一些。但你好像不明白，那我就直说了吧：你必须按照命令接受这个交易。你不准再爆发情绪。你不准再违抗 辛达强权 最高元首的意志。"

"你必须按照命令表示接受这个交易。现在。"

o.en: It is you who doesn't understand. I have my fleet, I have the power!
o.zh: 是你不明白。我有我的舰队，我有力量！

entries.en:
The $post's voice goes ice-cold. "Your words are treason. I hereby rescind your commission, effective immediately."

"Flee from this place now, traitor. Flee before your precious $shipOrFleet is shot from the sky. The iron will of the Lion of Sindria, his immortal supremacy, will never be cowed by meddlesome spacer trash like you!"

The comms are cut without further ceremony.
entries.zh:
这位 $post 的声音冷若冰霜。"你的发言是叛国言论。我特此即刻撤销你的雇佣协议。"

"叛徒，现在就从这里离开。在你宝贵的$shipOrFleet被击落之前离开。辛达瑞亚之狮的坚如钢铁的意志，以及他那不朽的至高权威，绝不会被你这种多管闲事的太空垃圾所吓倒！"

通讯链接中断了，没有进一步的寒暄。

entries.en:
"You're an open enemy of the Sindrian Diktat, and an itinerant spacer degenerate besides." $HeOrShe leans back, looking disgusted. "Plead as you might, there will be no merciful outcome for... elements... carrying out open, terroristic war against the Andradan movement."

"I trust that system patrols have already reported your position to High Command and, as we speak, the mighty warfleets of the Supreme Executor are making their approach," $heOrShe says, examining a fingernail. "I have time to wait. Do you?"
entries.zh:
"你不仅是个无家可归的下贱太空佬，还与 辛达强权 公然为敌。" $HeOrShe满脸嫌弃，不禁往后靠了靠，"随你怎么求也没用，对于针对 Andrada 伟大运动公然进行恐怖主义战争的...人员...毫无慈悲可言。"

"我相信，星系巡逻舰队已经将你的位置情况报告给了最高指挥部，就在我们谈话的时候，最高元首 的巨大舰队可能就在来的路上了。" $heOrShe低头细细端详着手指甲，"我可以等，你可以吗？"

o.en: The Diktat is sending attack fleets against me. Perhaps we could work out a deal?
o.zh: 辛达强权 一直在派出袭击舰队攻击我方，或许我们可以达成协议？

o.en: The Diktat sends attack fleets against me despite my commission. This oversight must be corrected!
o.zh: 尽管我持有相应的雇佣协议，但 辛达强权 还是一直在派出袭击舰队攻击我方，这种疏忽必须纠正！

o.en: The Sindrian Diktat keeps sending attack fleets. Perhaps we could work out a deal? DEV
o.zh: 辛达强权 一直在派出袭击舰队，或许我们可以达成协议？ DEV

entries.en:
"Ah," the $post puts on a cruel smile. "So you begin to understand the power of the Andradan Movement."

"It is my opinion that the greater Sector would be provided with a point of instruction were you to be squashed like an insect. However the Supreme Executor has ordered that you be shown mercy - his wisdom and vision far surpass my own, of course, and I bow to his authority: You will submit half of the profit from your fuel sales to the Sindrian Diktat in exchange for the right to exist."

"You won't get a better deal than that, captain," $heOrShe says indifferently. $HeOrShe picks up a stylus and begins to twirl it around as you consider the extortionate terms of the agreement.
entries.zh:
"啊。" $post 露出了残忍的微笑，"你终于开始理解 Andrada 伟大运动的力量了。"

"虽说我觉得，如果就这样把你像虫子一样碾死的话，能向整个星域说明更多，但最高元首下令对你网开一面 —— 自然，他的智慧与视野都远非我能相比，而且我也要服从于他的权威。你要将出售燃料所获利润的一半交给 辛达强权，以此换取你自身苟活的权利。"

"你不会有更好的买卖了，舰长。" $heOrShe一边冷酷地说着，一边趁你自己考虑协议中几乎和抢劫没甚区别的条文的时候，捡起一根触控笔玩起了转笔。

o.en: Perhaps we can adjust the details of the agreement, just a little.
o.zh: 也许我们可以稍微调整一下协议的细节。

entries.en:
"Of course, of course," the $post forms the pretense of a smile while tapping some input. "I'm familiar with your situation, let's see... yes, a most inconvenient situation."

$HisOrHer eyes dart up from $hisOrHer console. As $heOrShe speaks, $heOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head. "You really messed up, captain. You should know better than to put yourself in the path of the Supreme Executor's vision."

More tapping.

"I'm surprised you weren't already brought in by the Chief High Inspector-General over this matter. Though I hear he's been busy with... well, anyway, let's get you sorted out."
entries.zh:
"当然，当然。" 这位 $post 故作微笑，同时敲打着输入设备，"我很了解你的情况，让我看看...是的，一个非常棘手的处境。"

$HisOrHer的眼睛从$hisOrHer的控制台上离开，一边说话一边摇头。"你真的搞砸了，舰长。你应该更清楚，不要让自己成为最高元首眼中的绊脚石。"

对方继续敲打着设备。

"我很惊讶最高检察长还没有因为这件事把你抓起来。不过我听说他一直很忙...算了，不说这个了，让我们来解决问题吧。"

o.en: Yes, I have an... understanding, of sorts, with the Spider of Sindria.
o.zh: 好吧，我和辛达瑞亚之蛛...有某种程度的默契。

entries.en:
"Good news, captain. It appears as though the Supreme Executor - or one of his appointed Executor-Justices, I'm sure - was in a generous mood when your case came up." $HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer interface.

"You haven't been personally flagged for execution," $heOrShe looks up. "That's good!" $HeOrShe looks back down.

"You will submit half of the profit from your fuel sales to the Sindrian Diktat in exchange for the right to exist."

$HeOrShe sits back, satisfied. "If you'll just send over your cryptokey, I'll go ahead and signal your agreement immediately."
entries.zh:
"好消息，舰长。当你的案子呈上时，最高元首 —— 或者我确信是他亲自任命的一位执行法官 —— 心情似乎很好。" $HeOrShe敲打着自己的界面。

"你没有被亲自标记为处决目标，" $heOrShe抬起头，"这是好事！" $HeOrShe然后又低下头。

"你可以把燃料销售利润的一半上缴给 辛达强权 ，以换取生存的权利。"

$HeOrShe满意地靠回椅背上。"只要你把密码密钥发过来，我马上就通知对方你已经签署协议。"

entries.en:
The $post looses a single strange bark of a laugh. Then pauses.

"Why, rooting out traitors, I imagine. And terrorists like Pathers and Antis... all sorts of degenerate scum who oppose the glorious vision of Supreme Executor Philip Andrada." $HeOrShe blinks rapidly, then dabs $hisOrHer eye with a white kerchief.

"Pardon me. Something in the atmo. I'll have to have a word with Life Support."
entries.zh:
这位 $post 发出了一声奇怪而短促的笑声，然后停顿了一下。

"为什么？我想是为了铲除叛徒吧。还有像 卢德左径 和 Askonia 革命者委员会这样的恐怖分子...以及所有反对最高元首 Philip Andrada 光辉愿景的堕落渣滓。" $HeOrShe快速地眨了眨眼，然后用一块白手帕擦了擦眼睛。

"抱歉。空气里好像有什么东西。我得跟维生系统的人说一声。"

entries.en:
The $post freezes, eyes fixed on you. For a long moment.

"Of course," $heOrShe says, finally, then gives an awkward little cough. "Where were we? Oh yes, your little problem."
entries.zh:
这位 $post 愣住了，眼睛紧紧盯着你。过了好一会儿。

"当然，" $heOrShe终于说道，然后尴尬地轻咳了一声。"我们说到哪儿了？哦对，你的小问题。"

entries.en:
$Rank $personLastName looses a single strange bark of a laugh. Then pauses.

"You're serious? Oh my, oh captain." $HeOrShe retrieves a perfect white kerchief from a pocket and wipes at $hisOrHer right eye.

"I refer of course to Chief High Inspector-General Dolos Macario. He roots out traitors, terrorists... all sorts of degenerate scum who oppose the glorious vision of Supreme Executor Philip Andrada. No one escapes his web, captain." $HeOrShe blinks rapidly, then dabs $hisOrHer eye again.

"No one."

Back to tapping on the interface.
entries.zh:
$Rank $personLastName 发出了一声奇特而短促的笑声，然后停顿了一下。

"你是认真的？哦天哪，舰长。" $HeOrShe从口袋里掏出一条洁白无瑕的手帕，擦了擦右眼。

"我当然是指最高检察长 Dolos Macario。他揪出叛徒、恐怖分子...所有反对最高元首 Philip Andrada 光辉愿景的堕落渣滓。没有人能从他的罗网中逃脱，舰长。" $HeOrShe快速地眨了眨眼，然后又擦了擦眼睛。

"一个都没有。"

接着又开始在界面上敲打起来。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks confused.

"I'm not sure I understand, captain. You bear a commission of the Sindrian Diktat. You MUST submit to the authority of the Supreme Executor. There's no question here."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe看起来有些困惑。

"我不太明白，舰长。你接受了 辛达强权 的雇佣。你必须服从最高元首的权威。毫无疑问。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe gives a charitable little laugh, as if you made an embarrassing joke. Then pauses.

"You're serious? Oh, captain." $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head. "You... understand that this order is stamped with the ID of the office of the Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat?"

$HeOrShe begins to look a little concerned.

"You must comply."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe发出了一声宽容的轻笑，就好像你讲了一个令人尴尬的笑话。然后停顿了一下。

"你是认真的？得了吧，舰长。" $HeOrShe摇了摇$hisOrHer的头。"你...明白这个命令上 辛达强权 最高元首办公室的 ID 意味着什么吗？"

$HeOrShe开始显得有点担忧。

"你必须遵守。"

o.en: Perhaps we can adjust the details of the agreement, just a little.
o.zh: 或许我们可以稍微调整一下协议的细节。

o.en: I'm not so sure about this.
I reject that deal. I will offer my own terms...
o.zh: 我拒绝这个交易。我会提出我自己的条件...

entries.en:
The $post sighs, disappointed.

"Very well. If you insist, I will submit your agreement to High Command. Your people will be provided with account IDs for the payments and so forth." $HeOrShe gives a dismissive wave, "Good day, captain."

This may cut deeply into your profit margins, but the full saturation bombing the Diktat fleets promise to unleash would be even less profitable.
entries.zh:
这位 $post 叹了口气，显得很失望。

"好吧。如果你坚持的话，我会把你的协议提交给最高指挥部 。你的人将会获得用于支付的账户 ID 等等。" $HeOrShe不耐烦地挥了挥手，"再见，舰长。"

这可能会极大地压缩你的利润空间，但辛达强权舰队承诺发动的全面饱和轰炸将让你的收益更加惨淡。

entries.en:
"I see truly what you are: spacer trash. You'll lie to me, you'll lie to anyone and say anything to save your own skin. You'll sell anyone for your ill-gained profiteering off Andradan greatness. I despise your kind, $playerName."

"However." $HeOrShe smiles cruelly. "There is a place for you in the glorious future forged by the Sindrian Diktat."

"You will become a justly vanquished enemy; a bit of vermin, stomped out. You will be extinguished by the might of Supreme Executor Philip Andrada's perfect vision for our future."

"Make the most of your remaining time, spacer. Inevitability approaches."
entries.zh:
"我看出你的真面目了，你这垃圾太空佬。为了保全你自己，你能对我说谎，也可以对别人说谎，为了保全自己，你什么都能说，为了保全你从 Andrada 伟大事业中捞到的不义之财，你要出卖谁就出卖谁。$playerName，我看不起你这种人。"

"然而，" $HeOrShe说着说着，露出了残忍的微笑，"在 辛达强权 铸造的光辉未来中，你这种人也能够存在。"

"你将作为我们堂堂正正击败的敌人，我们随意碾过的小小恶人而存在。你将被最高元首 Philip Andrada 对我们未来的完美愿景摧垮。"

"剩下的日子就好好过吧，太空佬。正义避无可避，正义终将抵达。"

o.zh: DEV 开启 辛达强权 选项

entries.en:
After a crackle of static the comms come to shuddering stability. The Sindrian Diktat $post looks upon you imperiously.

"Hailing independent fleet! We are-" $HeOrShe is interrupted by a subordinate officer leaning into view and whispering something.

$HeOrShe puts on a knowing look, simmering with hostility. "Of course, Captain $PlayerName. We know full well of you and your methods."
entries.zh:
一阵静电噪声之后，通讯链接勉强建立，信号自然是不甚稳定。$post 带着居高临下的气场看着你。

"呼叫独立舰队！我方 —— " 话音未落，一名副官突然进入影像，跟$HeOrShe轻声说了些什么，打断了$HeOrShe。

$HeOrShe似乎明白了什么，带着明显的敌意嘲讽道："当然了，这不是 $PlayerName 舰长吗。我们不仅了解你这个人，还了解你玩的把戏。"

o.en: Perhaps you shouldn't let others' opinions color our first meeting.
o.zh: 我们才初次见面，或许还是不要让别人的想法左右你的看法为好。

o.en: Good, that saves me from having to introduce myself.
o.zh: 真棒，这下我连自我介绍都省了。

entries.en:
"You employ cowardly, indirect tactics in a feeble attempt to undermine the power of the Sindrian Diktat! You're waging a secret economic war on the beating heart of the Sindrian economy by undercutting the fuel market. Don't think we can't see your aims."

"Now." $HeOrShe stands up more stiffly, "I have been tasked by the authority of the Supreme Executor to put your meddling to an end."
entries.zh:
"你居心不良，妄图间接破坏 辛达强权 的伟力！你正在秘密的打着一场经济战，通过燃料市场低价竞争，攻击辛达经济的关键所在，别以为我们看不透你的真实目的。"

"既然如此。" $HeOrShe站了起来，动作更显僵硬，命令道，"遵循最高元首的权威命令，我将终结你的侵略行径。"

o.en: Wait, so this is just about fuel profits?
o.zh: 等等，所以说搞这么一出就是为了燃料收入的事？

o.en: How do you propose to stop me?
I think you'll find my methods quite direct. Tactical, arm weapons.
o.zh: I think you'll find my methods quite direct. Tactical, arm weapons.

o.en: Let's talk about this, maybe work out some kind of deal.
o.zh: 我们再谈谈吧，或许我们能达成某种协议呢。

entries.en: "Yes, your methods," $heOrShe says. "The natural respite of the degenerate spacer: underhanded deception; poisoning; lies."
entries.zh: "对，就是你玩的把戏。" $heOrShe唾骂道，"堕落太空佬天生就会拿来拖时间的那一套：暗中欺瞒，蓄意谋害，随意扯谎。"

entries.en: "Even now you squirm and lie, like all you worldless spacers. I, however, am armed and armored by the unconquerable ideology of the Andradan Movement, the wisdom of the Supreme Executor himself! I see through you; I see my enemy and I know where to direct my righteous hatred." $HeOrShe tips $hisOrHer slowly toward you as $heOrShe speaks.
entries.zh: "现在你就在狡辩，就在扯谎，和所有无根无源的太空佬一个德行！我可不一样，有 Andrada 伟大运动战无不胜的思想武装着我，这可是最高元首的智慧！我能看穿你，我能认清敌人是谁，我知晓自己的正义之怒该向谁投射。" $HeOrShe讲着讲着，整个人向你这边慢慢靠了过来。

entries.en: "Then you deny nothing. Look at you, spacer; you have no people, you have no homeland; your blood thins and weakens in the vacuum. You subsist on lies and deception. Your ideology is poison."
entries.zh: "那么你就没有否认了。再看看你自己吧，太空佬，你没有人民，没有故乡，连血脉都在真空中日渐稀薄。你这种人，只靠谎言欺骗苟且偷生，你仅有的思想就是坑蒙拐骗。"

entries.en:
After a crackle of static the comms come to shuddering stability. The Sindrian Diktat $Post looks upon you imperiously.

"Hailing the fleet of $PlayerName. I come with the authority of the Supreme Executor to put an end to your cowardly economic warfare upon the Sindrian Diktat!"
entries.zh:
一阵静电噪声之后，通讯链接勉强建立，信号自然是不甚稳定。辛达强权 $post 带着居高临下的气场看着你。

"呼叫 $PlayerName 的舰队，本舰队代表最高元首前来，意在终结你方对 辛达强权 的龌龊经济战行径！"

o.zh: 等等，'经济战' 又是什么意思？

o.en: Let's talk about this, maybe work out some kind of deal.
o.zh: 我们再谈谈吧，或许我们能达成某种协议呢。

entries.en:
After a crackle, the comms stabilize. The Sindrian Diktat $Post looks upon you imperiously.

"Hailing independent fleet! We-" $HeOrShe is interrupted by a subordinate leaning into view and whispering.

$HeOrShe puts on a knowing look. "Of course. Captain $PlayerName. Your loyalty to the vision of the Supreme Executor shall now be tested - stand aside as we carry out our orders."
entries.zh:
一阵静电噪声之后，通讯链接勉强建立，信号自然是不甚稳定。$post 带着居高临下的气场看着你。

"呼叫独立舰队！我方 —— " 话音未落，一名副官突然进入影像，跟$HeOrShe轻声说了些什么，打断了$HeOrShe。

$HeOrShe似乎明白了什么。"当然了，你是 $PlayerName 舰长。现在，我们将考验你对最高元首愿景的忠诚 —— 我们执行命令的时候，你不要来碍事。"

o.en: My loyalty is unquestionable! I demand an apology for the implication.
o.zh: 我的忠诚毫无疑问！我要求你就暗指我不忠诚一事道歉！

entries.en:
"I shall be more than glad to provide an apology once my orders have been executed," $heOrShe says, unperturbed. "Why you've been allowed to retain your commission after carrying out meddlesome economic warfare - consciously or not - against the heart of Sindrian industry is not for me to question."

"This situation offers you a glorious opportunity - consign your 'colony' and its slipshod fuel operation to the flames I shall deliver. Burn away your degenerate spacer profiteering! Leave in its place nothing but austere commitment to the Lion of Sindria and his transcendent  Movement!"
entries.zh:
"行动结束之后，我将很乐意对你道歉。" $heOrShe坦然陈述道，"至于为什么你有意无意对 辛达强权 关键产业发起这场多余的经济战之后，官方还允许你保留雇佣协议，就轮不到我多问了。"

"这种情形倒也是你的荣幸 —— 让我的火焰将你的 '殖民地' 与其中粗制滥造的燃料生产设施付之一炬，烧尽你作为太空佬的下贱与牟利之心！只留下你对于辛达瑞亚之狮与他伟大运动的绝对热忱！"

entries.en:
$HisOrHer eyes narrow. "You understand nothing, spacer. If it were up to me, you would be stripped of your commission and sent to Cruor."

"Lucky for you," says the $post, "It is not. In the meantime, I shall proceed with the cleansing operation."

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" $heOrShe cries, making a salute.
entries.zh:
$HisOrHer眯起双眼。"果然你还是什么都不懂啊，太空佬。如果由我来管理你的话，只怕你已经被取消雇佣，扔到 Cruor 去了。"

"也算你走运。" $post 说着，"管理你的不是我。就现在，我还要继续执行扫荡行动。"

"荣耀归于 辛达强权！" $heOrShe一边大喊，一边敬了个礼。

o.en: You're going to bomb my colony to quash competition with Sindria's fuel industry?
o.zh: 你轰炸我的殖民地，就是为了 辛达强权 的燃料产业少些对手？

o.en: If the Supreme Executor demands it, I shall submit to his will.
o.zh: 如果是最高元首的命令，那我自当遵从。

o.en: If the Supreme Executor demands it, I shall submit to his will. (lie)
o.zh: 如果是最高元首的命令，那我自当遵从。 (说谎)

entries.en:
"Good," says the $post. "I shall proceed with the cleansing operation."

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" $heOrShe cries, making a salute.
entries.zh:
"很好。" $post 说道，"我还要继续执行扫荡行动。"

"荣耀归于 辛达强权！" $heOrShe一边大喊，一边敬了个礼。

entries.en:
"Good," says the $post. "I shall proceed with the cleansing operation."

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" $heOrShe calls, making a salute.
entries.zh:
"很好。" $post 说道，"我还要继续执行扫荡行动。"

"荣耀归于 辛达强权！" $heOrShe一边大喊，一边敬了个礼。

entries.en:
"I am to remove your pitiable fuel production operation. I am to remove the population of vagabonds, criminals, and degenerates you've gathered," $heOrShe says, voice flat. "Why you've been allowed to retain your commission after carrying out meddlesome economic warfare - consciously or not - against the heart of Sindrian industry is not for me to question."

"This situation offers you a glorious opportunity - consign your 'colony' and its slipshod fuel operation to the flames I shall deliver. Burn away your degenerate spacer profiteering! Leave in its place nothing but austere commitment to the Lion of Sindria and his transcendent  Movement!"
entries.zh:
"我将移除你小小的燃料生产设施，我也将移除你治下的这帮子流浪汉、犯罪者、下流坯。" $heOrShe陈述道，语调不带一点起伏，"至于为什么你有意无意对 辛达强权 关键产业发起这场多余的经济战之后，官方还允许你保留雇佣协议，就轮不到我多问了。"

"这种情形倒也是你的荣幸 —— 让我的火焰将你的 '殖民地' 与其中粗制滥造的燃料生产设施付之一炬，烧尽你作为太空佬的下贱与牟利之心！只留下你对于辛达瑞亚之狮与他伟大运动的绝对热忱！"

entries.en:
The Diktat $Post looks appalled, and spits $hisOrHer words. "There will be no... deal."

"I shall follow my orders or find glorious death in the service of Supreme Executor Philip Andrada." $HeOrShe raises $hisOrHer chin, "And my orders are to bomb your pitiful fuel production operation into dust. Only the authority of the Supreme Executor can countermand these orders. Your destruction is as good as inevitable."

$HeOrShe gives some signal to $hisOrHer bridge crew, and the comms cut out.
entries.zh:
辛达强权 $Post 看起来很生气，骂道："绝不可能有...协议。"

"我为 Philip Andrada 最高元首而服役，我将听从他的命令，直至我壮烈牺牲。" $HeOrShe抬了抬下巴，"而我收到的命令，就是让我把你可怜的燃料生产设施炸成灰，只有 最高元首 本人能够收回这条命令，你殖民地的毁灭几近无可避免。"

$HeOrShe对着$HeOrShe的舰桥成员打了打手势，通讯随即被切断了。

entries.en:
"Of course you feign ignorance of your acts - spacers like you have no notion of honor and glory, or of the Andradan Movement which propels the living spirit of history." A look of disgust grows on $hisOrHer face. "Your scheming attempt to undermine the true expression of Philip Andrada's transcendent vision will be met by the military might of the Sindrian Diktat."

"I shall bomb your pitiable fuel production operation to dust. I shall bomb your population of vagabonds and criminals to dust. I shall destroy everything that stands against the authority of the Supreme Executor!"
entries.zh:
"自然，这时候你又开始装作不知道你都干了什么了 —— 你这种太空佬毫无荣誉感可言，更无法理解我们推动历史生灵继续前进的 Andrada 伟大运动。" $hisOrHer的表情越来越厌恶，"你破坏 Philip Andrada 超然愿景真实含义的阴谋诡计，就交由 辛达强权 的军力来碾碎。"

"我要把你那可怜的燃料生产设施炸成灰，我要把你治下的那帮子流浪汉、犯罪者炸成灰，我要摧毁一切阻挡 最高元首 荣光的事物！"

entries.en:
"Of course not," $heOrShe says with a look of disgust. "And of course that is what you'd think - spacers like you have no notion of the honor and glory of the Andradan Movement that gives meaning to history itself!"

"Your scheming attempt to undermine the true expression of Philip Andrada's transcendent vision will be met by the military might of the Sindrian Diktat."
entries.zh:
"自然不是因为这种事。" $heOrShe满脸嫌弃，"自然，你这种人也只能想到这一层 —— 你这种太空佬，自然无法理解能够赋予历史以意义的 Andrada 伟大运动，其本身又是何种光荣与何种伟岸！"

"你破坏 Philip Andrada 超然愿景真实含义的阴谋诡计，就交由 辛达强权 的军力来碾碎。"

entries.en: "I shall bomb your pitiable fuel production operation to dust. I shall bomb your population of vagabonds and criminals to dust. I shall destroy everything that stands against the glory of the Sindrian Diktat!"
entries.zh: "我要把你那可怜的燃料生产设施炸成灰，我要把你治下的那帮子流浪汉、犯罪者炸成灰，我要摧毁一切阻挡 辛达强权 荣光的事物！"

entries.en: "I suppose Rayan Arroyo is seeing a fine profit in undercutting Tri-Tachyon's embargo against me." He smirks without amusement. "Oh, they'll regulate commerce toward political goals, like any polity. They just do it with words like 'treaty compliant self-modifying pricing algorithm'."
entries.zh: "我猜 Rayan Arroyo 是从压低速子科技对我的禁运里赚了不少。\"他毫无笑意地一撇嘴。\"哦，他们当然会为了政治目的管制贸易，哪个政权不这样。只是他们管这叫'符合条约的自主调整定价算法'。"

entries.en:
"Your assistance will not be forgotten."

He nods to you, with respect, though nowhere so deep as to be interpreted as a bow of submission.
entries.zh:
"你的援助不会被忘记。"

他向你点头，带着敬意——但绝没有深到会被理解为臣服之礼的地步。

entries.en: "That Tri-Tachyon spy - Inesis - is providing intel and... certain pieces of esoteric technology." He makes a face as if he's tasted something just slightly off. "I don't trust him. But everything has checked out. So far."
entries.zh: "那个速子科技的间谍——Inesis——在提供情报，还有... 某些偏门的科技。\"他做了个表情，像是尝到了什么略微变味的东西。\"我不信他。但所有东西都核对通过了。到目前为止。"

entries.en: "I've found that you've arranged material support for my cause," he says.
entries.zh: "我得知你为我的事业筹措了物资支援，"他说。

o.en: I've come to ask you to make a compromise with the Volturnian Self Defense Covenant.
o.zh: 我来是想请你与 Volturnian 自卫盟约达成妥协。

entries.en:
"Unthinkable," he snaps.

"Those Pather terrorists have been carrying out a campaign of sabotage and assassination to directly undermine my cause. And for what? One would hope that they recognize that I am not my father - or my brother - and am not to fault for the excesses of either."

Achilles takes a deep breath. "I've already shown considerable restraint, captain. Considerable."

His tone makes his feelings about further discussion of the topic quite clear.
entries.zh:
"想都别想，"他厉声道。

"那些左径恐怖分子一直在搞破坏、搞暗杀，就是要直接毁掉我的事业。可这又是图什么？我倒希望他们能明白：我不是我父亲——也不是我兄长——他们两人做过的那些过头事，怪不到我头上。"

Achilles 深吸了一口气。"我已经克制得够多了，舰长。相当多。"

他的语气已经把他的态度说得很清楚：这个话题不必再谈。

o.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colonies, as well.
o.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的各殖民地的支持。

o.en: You will have the support of my organization, my colony, as well.
o.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的殖民地的支持。

entries.en:
"The VSDC? Unthinkable!"

"They're Pather-aligned terrorists carrying out a campaign of sabotage and assassination to directly undermine my cause. And for what? Do they have any idea what Hector will do to them if he won?"

He takes a deep breath. "I've shown considerable restraint, captain. Considerable."
entries.zh:
"VSDC？简直不可想象！"

"他们是与卢德左径结盟的恐怖分子，正在搞一场破坏与暗杀的战役，目的就是直接拆我的台。可图什么呢？他们知不知道，要是 Hector 赢了，会怎么收拾他们？"

他深吸一口气。"我已经相当克制了，舰长。相当克制。"

entries.en: "I expect you'll want something," he says, flashing a cynical look. "But first we're going to have a war to win."
entries.zh: "我猜你总归是想要点什么，\"他说，眼里闪过一丝讥讽。\"但首先，我们得先打赢一场战争。"

entries.en: "I expect you'll want something," he says, flashing a cynical look. "But first we're going to have a war to win."
entries.zh: "我猜你总归是想要点什么，\"他说，眼里闪过一丝讥讽。\"但首先，我们得先打赢一场战争。"

entries.en:
"$TitlePL." Achilles begins to speak, then falters.

It's the first time you've seen him like this. He seems uncomfortable owing anyone such gratitude as would be appropriate.

"I'll assign a liaison officer, and," he pauses again. "I should say... thank you, $titlePL."
entries.zh:
"$TitlePL。"Achilles 开口，又顿住了。

你还是头一次见他这样。看来欠下别人这样一份感激，让他浑身不自在。

"我会派一名联络官，还有——\"他又顿住。\"我该说... 谢谢你，$titlePL。"

entries.en:
Achilles almost smiles, then acknowledges your words with a nod, not a bow.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome and you shall find that I am not ungrateful."
entries.zh:
Achilles 几乎露出笑意，随后以一个点头而非鞠躬，算是领了你的话。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，你也会发现我并非不知感恩。"

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome and you shall find that I am not ungrateful."

Achilles 仔细打量着你，以一个点头而非鞠躬，领了你的话。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，你也会发现我并非不知感恩。"
