>>(开发) 殖民地数量 +1 (可重复)

o.en: The Persean League has made you weak. Hector is going to crush you.
o.zh: 英仙座联盟把你养软了。Hector 会碾碎你。

entries.en:
"I think not," Achilles says, a distinct chill entering his voice. "On both counts."

Achilles reaches for the comms cut off.

"This conversation serves no purpose. Consider it terminated."
entries.zh:
"我看未必，\"Achilles 说，声音里明显添了几分寒意，\"两条都不成立。"

Achilles 伸手去切断通讯。

"这场谈话毫无意义。就当它已经结束了。"

o.en: The blood of Andrada runs thin in you. Perhaps your cloning was botched?
o.zh: 你身上 Andrada 的血太稀了。也许当初克隆你的时候出了岔子？

entries.en:
"That's not how it works, captain," he says.

"Perhaps you've been reading too much into the more esoteric sections of my father's 'transcendent philosophy'. He trained as an admiral, not a cloning technician; to be great at one field does not give mastery of all others."

"He forgot that, in time."

Achilles reaches for the comms cut off.

"I shall not."
entries.zh:
"事情不是这么运作的，舰长，"他说。

"也许你把我父亲那套【超凡意识形态】里过于玄虚的章节读得太多了。他受的是海军上将的训练，不是克隆技师；精通一行，并不等于通晓其余各行。"

"到后来，他把这一点忘了。"

Achilles 伸手去切断通讯。

"我不会忘。"

entries.en: The link terminates rather abruptly.
entries.zh: 通讯链接断得相当突兀。

entries.en:
The comms flicker to display the Sindrian Diktat $Post. $HeOrShe greets you with a sneer.

"We shall not allow itinerant space trash to continue meddling in the affairs of the Sindrian Diktat. Your like has no place in the great Andradan future of the Persean Sector! Prepare to be destroyed!"
entries.zh:
通讯频道闪烁，显示出 辛达强权 $Post 的身影。$HeOrShe带着讥讽向你致意。

"我们 辛达强权 不会再容许你这种东躲西藏的太空废物干涉我们的事务了！在 Andrada 为英仙座星域绘制的未来愿景中，不会有你这种货色的位置！准备被摧毁吧！"

o.en: What is the meaning of this? I am commissioned by the Sindrian Diktat!
o.zh: 这是什么意思？我正受雇于 辛达强权 呢！

o.en: How am I possibly meddling with the Sindrian Diktat?
o.zh: 我怎么可能干涉 辛达强权 的事务？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks conflicted, and leans in. "Perhaps you are not without hope, captain. This demonstration of Diktat power is made because you have dared - however ignorantly, however inadvertently - to interfere with Sindrian exports. Fuel is the heart of Sindria's economy, and your attempts to compete in fuel production are a threat, a hostile act, however feeble." $HeOrShe pauses to let you consider the depths of your betrayal. "Now you see, captain."

$HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head, almost regretful. Then speaks loudly, "I have my orders. And I have the clarity of vision to see my orders carried out to their end, no matter what the cost! If I die, the Sindrian Diktat will live on! Glory to the Supreme Executor!"

The $post is standing and saluting the abstract gaze of Philip Andrada, putting on quite a show for $hisOrHer bridge officers.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe向前一步，表情复杂，解释道。"或许你还算得上不无希望，舰长。辛达强权 之所以如此宣称，是因为你竟敢与我们进行市场竞争，无论你是否知晓后果，无论你是否有意为之 —— 燃料是辛达的经济命脉，而你尝试与我们进行市场竞争就是蓄意威胁，就是敌对行为，不管行为轻重。" $HeOrShe顿了顿，给你留些时间思考自己的背叛行为到底多严重，"这下你懂了吧，舰长。"

$HeOrShe摇了摇头，算是有些后悔的意思，然后大声喊道："我有令在身，我视野清晰，能看清我的命令如何完成，无论付出多少代价！即便我死去，辛达强权 必将继续存在！荣耀归于最高元首！"

$post 直直地站在原地，向抽象的 Philip Andrada 的目光敬礼，给$hisOrHer的舰桥军官演了出好戏。

entries.en:
Your question short-circuits $hisOrHer building tirade. $HeOrShe sputters, then recovers.

"The fuel, you fool! You are using indirect coward's tactics in a feeble attempt to undermine the beating heart of the Sindrian war-machine by undercutting the fuel market. Don't think we can't see your every move."

"Now." $HeOrShe stands stiffly, "By the authority of the Supreme Executor, I will bomb your pitiable fuel production operation and I will bomb the population of vagabonds, criminals, and degenerates you've gathered to run it; I will leave only ash. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!"
entries.zh:
你的问题直接打断了$hisOrHer的控诉。$HeOrShe啐了几口，之后才继续说了下去。

"燃料啊，蠢货！你居心不良，妄图通过燃料市场低价竞争间接破坏 辛达强权 战争机器的关键所在，别觉得我们看不出你这点伎俩。"

"现在。" $HeOrShe呆呆地站着，"以最高元首之名，我要轰炸你那可怜的燃料生产设备，我还要轰炸你拉拢来生产燃料的这帮子流浪汉、犯罪者、下流坯，我要轰炸到你的星球上只剩灰烬！荣耀归于 辛达强权！"

o.en: I want your help with the Sindrian Diktat situation.
o.zh: 辛达强权那边的事，我想请你帮忙。

entries.en: "What about it?" He lifts his TriPad and gives it a casual once-over. "It's going well."
entries.zh: "怎么了？\"他举起 TriPad，漫不经心地扫了一眼。\"进展顺利。"

o.en: I need you to switch who you're supporting.
o.zh: 我要你换掉你支持的对象。

o.en: I want you to stop. Cease operations, pull your support.
o.zh: 我要你停手。收掉生意，撤走支援。

entries.en: "What about it?" He lifts his TriPad and gives it a casual once-over. "It's going well."
entries.zh: "怎么了？\"他举起 TriPad，漫不经心地扫了一眼。\"进展顺利。"

o.en: I want you to stop. Cease operations, pull your support.
o.zh: 我要你停手。收掉生意，撤走支援。

o.en: I'd like to discuss your intervention in the Askonia situation.
o.zh: 我想谈谈你对 Askonia 局势的介入。

entries.en:
There is no factional crest, simply a utilitarian label projected into the display.

INTERFACTIONAL RESOLUTION COMMISSION

* * *
entries.zh:
没有势力徽记，显示屏上只投出一行实用主义的标签。

跨势力调解委员会

* * *

entries.en:
A spokesperson appears in front of a meeting chamber, a repurposed freight bay fitted with modular lighting and sound-dampening panels.

The murmur of voices. Shadowy delegates in the uniform of many factions; civilians, military and political representatives.

"Please- please be seated and we'll-" The bland voice of an anonymous bureaucrat does little to settle the room. "-to announce, announce the formation of the Interfactional Resolution Commission in full accordance with guidelines established by the cycle 194 Treaty of Crom Cruach, with a quorum of major involved Persean Sector political entities..."
entries.zh:
一名发言人出现在一间会议厅前——一处改作他用的货运舱，装上了模块化照明与隔音板。

人声低语。众多阴影中的代表，穿着各势力的制服；文职、军方与政治代表混杂其间。

"请——请各位就座，我们这就——\" 某位无名官僚平淡的声音并没能让场内安静下来。\"——宣布，宣布跨势力调解委员会成立，完全依照 194 星历年 Crom Cruach 条约所确立的准则，英仙座星域各主要相关政治实体均已达到法定数量..."

entries.en:
The major players are making a show of taking notice.

Setting up arguments for who is to blame for the mess before the death of thousands, perhaps hundreds of thousands, requires someone to blame.

They have to, now that the situation has officially become 'out of hand'.

The bureaucrat wraps up with a singularly uninspiring request for "calming tensions" and "sensible solutions".

The feed freezes before the unenthusiastic applause becomes too noticeable.
entries.zh:
各方主要角色都在做出一副注意到了的姿态。

在成千上万——也许是几十万——人死去之前，就得先摆好'谁来为这烂摊子负责'的论据：总得有人来背这个责。

他们不得不如此，既然局势已经正式变成了'失控'。

那位官僚以一句格外提不起劲的呼吁收尾，只要求"缓和紧张局势"、"拿出明智的解决方案"。

在全息流里，那阵敷衍的掌声还没变得太扎眼，画面就冻结了。

entries.en:
The bureaucrat fades to a ghostly afterimage in your display, then to nothingness.

Notifications appear, demanding. $ShipOrFleet status, supply levels, crew, senior officer reports...
entries.zh:
那位官僚在你的显示屏上淡成一道幽灵般的残影，然后归于虚无。

提示接连弹出，全在催办。$ShipOrFleet 状态、补给水平、船员、高级军官报告...

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam." It's your comms officer.

"The automatic content sweep flagged a high importance item on local network... an announcement concerning Askonia, tagged interfactional diplomatic interest."

Comms forwards a link to your command station.

High-rate holofeed. Cached in local comms common.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 是你的通讯军官。

"自动内容扫描在本地网络上标出了一条高优先级条目...一则关于 Askonia 的公告，标记为势力间外交关注事项。"

通讯军官把链接转发到你的指挥台。

高速全息流。缓存在本地通讯公共池中。

entries.en:
"Impossible," $heOrShe says. "You understand that your commission was stripped by order of the Supreme Executor? Whatever the present circumstance, to contravene the will of the Supreme Executor carries a sentence of death."

The $rank takes a breath and calms $himOrHerself.

"Only the Supreme Executor can restore your commission, $playerName."
entries.zh:
"不可能。\"$heOrShe说，\"你该明白，你的委任状是最高元首下令剥夺的？不论眼下是什么情形，违逆最高元首的意志，都是死罪。"

这位$rank深吸一口气，$himOrHerself定了定神。

"只有最高元首才能恢复你的委任状，$playerName。"

entries.en:
"Impossible," $heOrShe says. "We are in a state of existential war... the situation is quite extraordinary. One can't be too careful of treachery, turn-coats, and mutineers!"

The $rank takes a breath and calms $himOrHerself.

"Besides, there has been an official decree - only the Supreme Executor can approve a new commission, $playerName."
entries.zh:
"不可能。\"$heOrShe说，\"我们正处在生死存亡的战争状态...局面非常特殊。对背叛、变节者和哗变者，再怎么小心都不为过！"

这位$rank深吸一口气，$himOrHerself定了定神。

"再说，已有正式法令——新委任状只能由最高元首批准，$playerName。"

entries.en:
"Excellent work, $titlePL," she says. "Additional supply lines shall make it less difficult for the Prime Demarchon to interfere in my- our project."

"Please accept this payment for your trouble." She taps at her TriPad.
entries.zh:
"干得漂亮，$titlePL，\"她说，\"多几条补给线，大统领要插手我的——我们的计划，就没那么容易了。"

"这份报酬，请收下，算你辛苦一场。"她在 TriPad 上点了几下。

o.en: I've secured support from a Tri-Tachyon executive, Rayan Arroyo. (explain)
o.zh: 我已争取到速子科技一位高管 Rayan Arroyo 的支持。 (解释)

o.en: I've heard Imoinu Kato is part of a rebel group on Umbra...
o.zh: 我听说 Imoinu Kato 参与了 Umbra 上的一支叛军...

entries.en:
Her expression closes somewhat.

"I see. Of course." She sighs.

"Headstrong, is she not? I fear I was too liberal with Eunomia concerning her upbringing. Hadwin, my consort, always said so. Perhaps he was right."
entries.zh:
她的神情微微收紧。

"我明白了。当然。"她叹了口气。

"性子太拗，是不是？我怕是对 Eunomia 的管教太松了。Hadwin，我的伴侣，一直这么说。也许他是对的。"

o.en: She's going to get herself killed.
o.zh: 她这是要把自己送进死路。

o.en: She is fighting for what she believes.
o.zh: 她在为自己相信的东西而战。

o.en: She is fighting for a righteous cause.
o.zh: 她在为一项正义的事业而战。

o.en: Making concessions to the Luddics on Volturn might help Achilles' cause.
o.zh: 在 Volturn 对卢德派做些让步，或许对 Achilles 的事业有利。

entries.en:
Her eyes narrow.

"The so-called Volturnian Self Defense Covenant cannot be negotiated with, $titlePL. They possess an irrational fanaticism they hold higher than any 'worldly' agreement they might temporarily make, particularly with someone they view as an arch-'Mammonite'." Her tone is venomous. "These are not people fundamentally driven by rationality, merely whatever fearful emotions might be invoked by whichever demogogue the mob decides to call 'prophet' or 'curate'."

She composes herself. A deep breath. Control and calm.

"They are a problem to be dealt with after the civil war is concluded. Giving them even a slip of legitimation now would only make the problem worse long-term."
entries.zh:
她眯起眼睛。

"没法跟所谓的 VSDC 谈判，$titlePL。他们抱着一种不理性的狂热，把它看得比任何'世俗'的临时协定都高——尤其当对方在他们眼里是头号'玛门信徒'。"她语调里带着毒意。"这种人根本不由理性驱动，只是被恐惧情绪牵着走——而那些恐惧，是随便哪个被暴民奉为'先知'或'教区长'的煽动家都能挑起来的。"

她定了定神。深吸一口气。重拾掌控，恢复平静。

"他们是内战结束之后才需要处理的问题。现在哪怕给他们一丝名分，长期看也只会让问题更糟。"

o.en: I've secured support from a Tri-Tachyon agent, Faro Inesis. (explain)
o.zh: 我已争取到速子科技一名特工的支持：Faro Inesis。 (解释)

entries.en:
"Well done, $titlePL," she says. "Diversified logistics are particularly useful in light of Reynard's attempts to meddle in Gens Kato affairs."

"Your service must be compensated, of course." Fortuna taps at her TriPad.
entries.zh:
"干得好，$titlePL，\"她说，\"Reynard 一心想插手 Kato 氏族的事务，这种时候，多元的后勤渠道尤其有用。"

"你的付出当然该有酬劳。"Fortuna 在 TriPad 上点了几下。

o.en: I've secured a Tri-Tachyon agent, Faro Inesis, to help counter Macario. (explain)
o.zh: 我已争取到速子科技特工 Faro Inesis，由他协助对付 Macario。 (解释)

entries.en:
She can't hide her pleasure as you explain how Faro Inesis will counter Dolos Macario using the technological superiority he can draw upon from Tri-Tachyon's corpus of information warfare applications and experience.

(You do, of course, withhold the inconvenient detail that Inesis intends to help Achilles free himself from the influence of Gens Kato by doing so.)

"Well done, $titlePL," she says. "Macario is infamous for his cruelty and cleverness. It provides comfort to hear you've gained cooperation from such an elite operative to foil his schemes."

"I judge you are due compensation." She taps her TriPad.
entries.zh:
你解释 Faro Inesis 将如何凭他可以从速子科技那一整套信息战应用与实战经验中调取的技术优势，来反制 Dolos Macario；她听着，掩不住喜色。

(当然，你略去了一个不便提及的细节：Inesis 这么做，是要帮 Achilles 摆脱 Kato 氏族的掌控。)

"干得好，$titlePL，\"她说，\"Macario 的残忍与狡诈是出了名的。听说你争取到这样一位精锐特工来挫败他的算计，这让人安心。"

"我看你该得一份酬劳。"她在 TriPad 上点了点。

o.en: I could use more fuel and supplies.
o.zh: 我需要更多燃料和补给。

entries.en:
Fortuna looks toward someone off-link and gives a nod. Then back to you.

Your TriPad pings softly.

"See that they are not misused," she says.
entries.zh:
Fortuna 朝通讯之外某人看了一眼，点了点头，然后转回你这边。

你的 TriPad 轻轻响了一声。

"记着，别把它们用错了地方。"

entries.en:
"Achilles' fleets are moving on Volturn. We expect to take the planet rapidly, and from there, gather strength for a final confrontation with Hector's forces."

"He shall require your own fleet when that moment arrives."
entries.zh:
"Achilles 的舰队正在向 Volturn 推进。我们预计能迅速拿下那颗行星，然后在那里积蓄力量，与 Hector 的部队做最后决战。"

"到那一刻，他会需要你的舰队。"

entries.en:
"Achilles' fleets are in orbit of Volturn. That shall be his base to prepare for the final confrontation with Hector's forces."

"He shall require your own fleet when that moment arrives."
entries.zh:
"Achilles 的舰队已在 Volturn 轨道上。那里将成为他的基地，用来准备与 Hector 部队的最后决战。"

"到那一刻，他会需要你的舰队。"

entries.en: "A matter comes to mind," she says suddenly.
entries.zh: "我想起一件事，"她忽然说。

entries.en:
"Horus Yaribay," she says, watching you. "It is known that you've worked closely with him on matters essential to his interests. There is trust."

A pause.

"I would like you to ask him to back Gens Kato in the All-League Council."

"The obstruction of Prime Demarchon can be overridden with a majority vote, and if Horus delivered me, us, that majority... we would not have to resort to bureaucratic trickery and outright smuggling to support Achilles' fleets."
entries.zh:
"Horus Yaribay，\"她说着，目光落在你身上，\"众所周知，你曾与他密切合作，办过几件关系到他切身利益的大事。你们之间有信任。"

她停了停。

"我希望你去请他在全联盟议会上支持 Kato 氏族。"

"大统领的阻挠可以用多数票压下去，而如果 Horus 能为我、为我们带来那个多数...我们就不必再靠官僚把戏和明摆着的走私去支援 Achilles 的舰队了。"

o.en: I will ask Horus to back you, on your behalf.
o.zh: 我会替你去找 Horus，请他支持你。

o.en: I could ask Horus. The trust I've earned from him is not cheap, however...
o.zh: 我可以去找 Horus。不过，我在他那里挣来的信任可不便宜...

o.en: I apologize, but I cannot instrumentalize the trust Horus has placed in me.
o.zh: 抱歉，但我不能把 Horus 对我的信任当作工具。

o.en: I apologize, but I cannot instrumentalize the trust Horus has placed in me. (lie)
o.zh: 抱歉，但我不能把 Horus 对我的信任当作工具。 (说谎)

entries.en: "You have my thanks, $titlePL," she says graciously.
entries.zh: "多谢你，$titlePL，"她仪态从容地说道。

entries.en:
She sniffs, suppressing an expression.

"A rather directly mercenary request, but I ought to have anticipated it."

Fortuna taps her TriPad.

"Speak to Horus."
entries.zh:
她轻哼一声，把某种神色压了下去。

"这要求直白得像雇佣兵，不过我早该料到的。"

Fortuna 在 TriPad 上点了点。

"去跟 Horus 谈吧。"

entries.en:
A cynical smile appears for a moment.

"Of course. That is our arrangement."

Fortuna taps her TriPad.

"Speak to Horus."
entries.zh:
一丝讥讽的笑在她脸上一闪而过。

"当然。我们就是这么约定的。"

Fortuna 在 TriPad 上点了点。

"去跟 Horus 谈吧。"

entries.en:
She sniffs, suppressing an expression.

"Of course, $titlePL. I could not demand you infringe upon personal trust. It is sacred, and I accept your answer with the utmost respect."
entries.zh:
她轻哼一声，把某种神色压了下去。

"当然，$titlePL。我无权要求你背弃私人的信任。那是神圣的，我以最大的敬意接受你的答复。"

entries.en:
She sniffs, suppressing an expression.

"Of course, $titlePL. I could not demand you infringe upon personal trust. It is sacred, and I accept your answer with the utmost respect."
entries.zh:
她轻哼一声，把某种神色压了下去。

"当然，$titlePL。我无权要求你背弃私人的信任。那是神圣的，我以最大的敬意接受你的答复。"

entries.en:
Fortuna cannot quite contain her delight.

"Thank you, $titlePL," she says breathlessly.
entries.zh:
Fortuna 几乎掩不住欣喜。

"谢谢你，$titlePL，"她气息难平地说道。

o.en: Horus Yaribay has agreed to back you against Reynard.
o.zh: Horus Yaribay 已经答应支持你对抗 Reynard。

entries.en: She taps something on her TriPad, then nods graciously.
entries.zh: 她在 TriPad 上点了几下，随后矜持地点了点头。

entries.en: "Indeed. Imoinu seems to complicate matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
entries.zh: "确实。Imoinu 像是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

entries.en: "I sincerely hope not. Imoinu seems to complicate matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
entries.zh: "我真心希望不至于。Imoinu 像是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

entries.en:
"'What she believes'," Fortuna says scornfully. "As if that ever changed anything."

"Imoinu complicates matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
entries.zh:
"'她相信的东西'，\"Fortuna 轻蔑地说，\"好像那玩意儿什么时候改变过什么。"

"Imoinu 是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

entries.en:
"'A righteous cause'," Fortuna says scornfully. "As if that ever changed anything."

"Imoinu complicates matters out of personal spite, and her commitment to that doomed crusade only increases when I attempt to have someone reason with her."
entries.zh:
"'一项正义的事业'，\"Fortuna 轻蔑地说，\"好像那玩意儿什么时候改变过什么。"

"Imoinu 是出于私怨把局面搅得更乱；我每派人去劝她，她对那场注定失败的圣战反倒更来劲。"

entries.en:
She shakes her head.

"The sooner the question of the Sindrian Diktat is resolved, the sooner she'll come home, where she belongs."
entries.zh:
她摇了摇头。

"辛达强权的问题了结得越早，她就能越早回家，回到她该在的地方。"

entries.en: "You should not encourage her with your 'contributions', captain." Her scolding tone is only half-serious. "You only delay the inevitable."
entries.zh: "你不该用你那些'捐赠'去鼓励她，舰长。\"她这责备的语气只有一半是认真的，\"你只是把不可避免的事往后推。"

entries.en: As your $shipOrFleet trades pings with local traffic control, your comms officer calls for your attention. "$PlayerSirOrMadam, there's a message for you. It was stored in the comm network until our transponder code was registered to the local authorities."
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet与当地交通管制交换着应答信号，通讯官忽然叫住了你。"$PlayerSirOrMadam，有你的一条消息。它一直存在通讯网络里，直到我们的应答器代码在地方当局登记之后才放出来。"

o.en: Patch it through to my TriPad.

entries.en:
Fortuna Kato appears. A good holo; it appears that she's willing to pay the premium transmission and caching fees.

"We must speak on matters of great import," she says. "Come to Kazeron."

She lets the holo run for a moment, regal and perfectly relaxed as she runs up the bill. Then her eyes shift to focus off-feed. That's the signal, and the recording cuts out.
entries.zh:
Fortuna Kato 的影像浮现。全息画质很好；看来她愿意付那份高额的传输与缓存费用。

"我们必须谈谈极要紧的事，\"她说，\"到 Kazeron 来。"

她让全息影像多跑了一会儿，雍容而全然放松，账单也一路往上跳。随后她的目光移向镜头之外。那就是信号，录制随即中断。

entries.zh: 没有附带任何数据。你关掉了播放。

She lets the holo run for a moment, regal and perfectly relaxed as she runs up the bill. Then her eyes shift to focus off-feed. That's the signal, and the recording cuts out.

Fortuna Kato 的影像浮现。全息画质很好；看来她愿意付那份高额的传输与缓存费用。

"我们必须谈谈，\"她说，\"到 Kazeron 来。有一桩回报丰厚的机会在等你。"

她让全息影像多跑了一会儿，雍容而全然放松，账单也一路往上跳。随后她的目光移向镜头之外。那就是信号，录制随即中断。

entries.en:
"Yes, much is afoot," she says with a nod.

"The Prime Demarchon is using his position to sabotage my efforts through official sanctions. It is most vexing. Would that Horus Yaribay had the spine to stand against Reynard Hannan."
entries.zh:
"是啊，暗流不少，"她点头说道。

"大统领正利用他的职位，以官方制裁来破坏我的努力。这实在恼人。要是 Horus Yaribay 有那份脊梁，敢站出来对抗 Reynard Hannan 就好了。"

entries.en:
"Yes, much is afoot," she says with a nod.

"Gens Yaribay's backing is proving essential to thwarting the Prime Demarchon's sabotage of our support for Achilles. You have my thanks for securing his cooperation."
entries.zh:
"是啊，暗流不少，"她点头说道。

"要挫败大统领对我们支援 Achilles 一事的破坏，Yaribay 氏族的支持已证明不可或缺。你促成了他的合作，我多谢你。"

entries.en: "Yes, much is afoot." She nods slowly.
entries.zh: "是啊，眼下暗流不少。"她缓缓点头。

entries.en: "What is your concern?"
entries.zh: "你在顾虑什么？"

entries.en:
"I would suggest engaging Hector's forces directly, if given an opportunity with good odds," she says. "Otherwise you might attack patrols, raid merchant convoys... this will sap the strength of his dying 'Diktat'."

"But then, of course," Fortuna smiles coldly, "you know full well how to conduct space warfare, captain. That's why I met with you on Yesod."
entries.zh:
"若有胜算在握的机会，我建议直接与 Hector 的部队交战，\"她说，\"否则，你可以袭击巡逻队、劫掠商船队...这会一点点抽干他那具行将就木的'强权'。"

"不过话说回来，\"Fortuna 冷冷一笑，\"太空战该怎么打，你比谁都清楚，舰长。我在 Yesod 见你，正是为此。"

o.en: We need to discuss the situation in Askonia...
o.zh: 我们得谈谈 Askonia 的局势...

entries.en: Her eyes go distant. "Someone has supplied Imoinu and her rebels. When I discover who... Rao probably. He always was a scoundrel."
entries.zh: 她的目光飘远。"有人在给 Imoinu 和她的叛军供补给。等我查出是谁...多半是 Rao。他一向就是个无赖。"

entries.en: "Achilles' fleets could use diversified logistical support. It could prove efficacious to bribe a certain Tri-Tachyon executive," she says coyly.
entries.zh: "Achilles 的舰队需要更多元的后勤支持。买通某位速子科技的高管，或许会颇有成效，"她意味深长地说。

entries.en:
The comms take some time to connect, and the transmission is patchy, as if sent through damaged or overloaded relays.

Nonetheless, Curate Sacraria Standfast appears.

"Blessed be the day," she says. Then squints.

"Who, may I ask, are you? I confess I did expect some urgent business of the Mother Church on this channel, not so much... some kind of star-farer?"
entries.zh:
通讯费了些工夫才接通，信号断断续续，像是经由受损或过载的中继站转过来的。

即便如此，神龛祭司 Sacraria Standfast 还是出现在了画面里。

"愿这一日蒙福，" 她说道，随即眯起眼睛。

"敢问你是哪位？实不相瞒，我原以为这条线路上来的会是母教会的什么急务，怎想到...来了个跑船的？"

entries.en:
You order Leonidas' cryopod prepared. A drone-carrier is prepped for the transfer, its cargo cradled gently by an octet of clamp-arms.

Hector is intrigued, waving off what can only be objections on the receiving end from his attendants and bridge officers. Warnings not to accept indeterminate packages from dubious spacers.

"Tell me, captain, what is this gift?"
entries.zh:
你下令准备好 Leonidas 的冷冻舱。一架无人运输机为转运做好了准备，八条钳臂轻轻托住舱体。

Hector 来了兴致，挥手挡开了通讯那头侍从与舰桥军官的反对——无非是在警告他别收下来历不明的太空佬递上的不明包裹。

"告诉我，舰长，这是什么礼物？"

o.en: Your clone-brother, Leonidas Andrada. In cryosleep.
o.zh: 你的克隆兄弟，Leonidas Andrada。在冷冻休眠中。

entries.en:
An alarmed look. "But Dolos-"

Hector shuts his mouth, giving you a wary look.

"My clone-brother." He nods, slowly. Remembering to appear ruthless and in control at all times.

"A most unique and fitting gift, spacer. You shall have to tell me... your version of events. Someday. Perhaps my brother will... become useful one day."

By Hector's look, you don't think he has rehabilitation in mind; they are one flesh, after all.
entries.zh:
他神色一惊。"可 Dolos——"

Hector 把话咽了回去，警惕地看着你。

"我的克隆兄弟。"他缓缓点头，没忘记要时刻显得冷酷、尽在掌握。

"一份绝无仅有、恰到好处的礼物，太空佬。你总得跟我讲讲...你那个版本的说法。改天吧。也许我这位兄弟有朝一日...会变得有用。"

看 Hector 的神情，你不觉得他打的是让人康复的主意；毕竟，他们本是一体。

o.en: I bring a gift. (give him Leonidas Andrada)
o.zh: 我带来了一件礼物。 （把 Leonidas Andrada 交给他）

o.en: It is you who will be destroyed, Hector.

entries.en:
He laughs.

"You're weak. Polluted and bound by sentiment. You do not yet realize that my will alone produces right and wrong."

"And when the time comes to claim final victory I shall not hesitate to execute my enemy, whether it is you, or my own blood corrupted by the weak-willed merchant-warriors of the League."

He looks down, his voice rich with cruelty like wine. "Your existence is... an impurity."

"Goodbye, captain. You'll die well at my pleasure."
entries.zh:
他大笑。

"你软弱。被情感污染，被情感束缚。你还没明白：是非对错，只由我的意志而定。"

"等到夺取最终胜利的时候，我会毫不犹豫地处决我的敌人——不管是你，还是我自己那被联盟那些意志薄弱的商贾武士腐蚀了的血亲。"

他垂下目光，嗓音醇厚如酒，却浸满残酷。"你的存在...是一种杂质。"

"再见了，舰长。你会死得漂亮，全凭我高兴。"

o.en: I came to offer you the chance to surrender, Hector. End the chaos.
o.zh: 我是来给你投降的机会的，Hector。结束这场混乱吧。

o.en: I wish to pledge my loyalty... but I must end my commission. I shall return.
o.zh: 我愿宣誓效忠于你...但我必须先了结另一份委任。我会回来的。

o.en: I wish to pledge my loyalty... and retain my other commission.
o.zh: 我愿宣誓效忠于你...同时保留我另一份委任。

entries.en:
"Dolos is so confident, so sure, that he's smarter than everyone around him. But he has never fooled me."

Hector laughs.

Then his eyes fix on you. "Don't bore me with what I already know. Why do you dare speak to me?"
entries.zh:
"Dolos 太自信，太笃定自己比身边所有人都聪明。可他从来没有骗过我。"

Hector 大笑。

然后他的目光钉住你。"别拿我早就知道的事来烦我。你凭什么敢跟我说话？"

o.en: Achilles is the better man. It's so obvious when you speak.
o.zh: Achilles 才是更好的人。你一开口，这就再明显不过。

entries.en:
He laughs.

"You're weak. You're weak like he is weak - bound up in sentimental rules and traditions. You do not yet realize that my will alone produces right and wrong."

"And when the time comes to claim final victory? I shall not hesitate to execute my enemy, whether it is you, or my own clone-brother, my own blood corrupted by the soft cosmopolitanism of the Persean League."

He looks down, his voice rich with cruelty like wine. "He is a... a profanity, a sacrilege, an impurity." Hector fixes you with his gaze once more.

"Goodbye, captain. You'll die well at my pleasure."
entries.zh:
他大笑。

"你软弱。你和他一样软弱——被感伤、规矩和传统捆住了手脚。你还没明白：是非对错，只由我的意志而定。"

"等到夺取最终胜利的时候呢？我会毫不犹豫地处决我的敌人——不管是你，还是我的克隆兄弟，我自己的血亲，被英仙座联盟那套软绵绵的世界主义腐蚀了。"

他垂下目光，嗓音醇厚如酒，却浸满残酷。"他就是个...一个渎神之物，一桩大不敬，一种杂质。"Hector 的目光再次锁住你。

"再见了，舰长。你会死得漂亮，全凭我高兴。"

o.en: I am not your enemy! Dolos Macario has been telling you lies for his own purposes.
o.zh: 我不是你的敌人！Dolos Macario 一直在为自己的目的对你说谎。

o.en: I am not your enemy! I have come to pledge my loyalty to you.
o.zh: 我不是你的敌人！我是来向你宣誓效忠的。

o.en: I am not your enemy! I have come to pledge my loyalty to you.
o.zh: 我不是你的敌人！我是来向你宣誓效忠的。

entries.en:
He tilts his head back and laughs.

"So eager you are, so bold despite Macario's kill-order."

Hector examines you now, closely, with a sort of predatory interest that the holos of 58966 Elysium could not capture.

"I like this," he says, relishing the moment. "It's interesting."

"So you're loyal? Prove it."
entries.zh:
他仰头大笑。

"你可真急切，顶着 Macario 的格杀令还敢这么大胆。"

Hector 现在细细打量着你，那是一种捕食者般的兴趣——58966 Elysium 的全息影像可捕捉不到这种东西。

"我喜欢这样，\"他说，品味着这一刻，\"有意思。"

"那么，你忠诚？证明给我看。"

entries.en:
"What great fool comes to pledge themselves while bearing the commission of a rival?" he asks, mocking you for the unseen advisors and hangers-on that surround him on the bridge of his flagship.

"What is loyalty that does not place myself at its head? You'll have one last chance to correct yourself."

He seems to contemplate drawing his sword, but relents.

"Get out of my sight."
entries.zh:
"什么样的蠢货会带着对头的委任状跑来宣誓效忠？"他问道，这话是问给他旗舰舰桥上那些你看不见的谋臣与随从听的，拿你来取笑。

"不把我放在首位的忠诚，算什么忠诚？你还有最后一次机会改口。"

他似乎考虑过拔剑，但终究作罢。

"滚出我的视线。"

entries.en:
"Ingrate," he spits. "What rotten offering is this? What is loyalty that does not place myself at its head?"

He seems to contemplate drawing his sword, but relents.

"Get out of my sight."
entries.zh:
"不知感恩的东西，\"他啐道，\"这算什么烂供品？不把我放在首位的忠诚，算什么忠诚？"

他似乎考虑过拔剑，但终究作罢。

"滚出我的视线。"

entries.en: The comm-link flickers then locks into focus. Before you stands Supreme Executor Hector Andrada.
entries.zh: 通讯链接闪了几下，随后锁定成像。站在你面前的是最高元首 Hector Andrada。

entries.en: "$playerLastName, you've returned." Hector's lip twists. "What have you brought me?"
entries.zh: "$playerLastName，你回来了。\"Hector 嘴角一拧。\"你给我带了什么来？"

entries.en:
"Back so soon?" Hector rolls his shoulders, setting the medals on his uniform tingling.

"What have you brought for me?"
entries.zh:
"这么快就回来了？"Hector 转了转肩膀，制服上的勋章叮当作响。

"你给我带了什么？"

entries.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," Hector says with a delighted sneer.

"My failed usurper, as I recall. Come to surrender to inevitability?"
entries.zh:
"舰长 $playerLastName，"Hector 说着，露出一丝得意而轻蔑的笑。

"我没记错的话，你就是那个没成事的篡位者。来向必然之势投降了？"

entries.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," Hector says with a hungry grin. "My devoted servant."

"Can you prove your loyalty to my..." His tongue flickers. "Satisfaction?"
entries.zh:
"舰长 $playerLastName，\"Hector 说着，咧开一个饥渴的笑。\"我忠诚的仆人。"

"你能证明你的忠诚，让我...\"他舔了舔舌头。\"满意吗？"

entries.en:
He crosses his arms.

"Try, then."
entries.zh:
他双臂抱胸。

"那就试试。"

entries.en:
"Captain $playerLastName," Hector says with a hungry grin. "My devoted servant."

"Can you prove your loyalty to my..." His tongue flickers. "Satisfaction?"
entries.zh:
"舰长 $playerLastName，\"Hector 说着，咧开一个饥渴的笑。\"我忠诚的仆人。"

"你能证明你的忠诚，让我...\"他舔了舔舌头。\"满意吗？"

o.en: I wish to pledge my loyalty... but I must end my commission. I shall return.
o.zh: 我愿宣誓效忠于你...但我必须先了结另一份委任。我会回来的。

o.en: I wish to pledge my loyalty... and retain my other commission.
o.zh: 我愿宣誓效忠于你...同时保留我另一份委任。

entries.en:
"$playerLastName, you've returned." Hector's lip twists. "I've been told you humbled Orcus Rao's pitiful base of operations."

He raises his chin, letting the moment draw out.

"This pleases me," he allows.
entries.zh:
"$playerLastName，你回来了。\"Hector 嘴角一拧。\"我听说你把 Orcus Rao 那可怜的老巢给端了。"

他扬起下巴，故意让这一刻拖长。

"这让我很满意。"他总算松了口。

entries.en:
"Now I'm told we have too much fuel because half the usual buyers are too cowardly to enter the system."

He waves idly, dismissing the fearful merchant-convoys that are key to the Askonian economy.

"You might as well bombard more of my enemies into submission with it. You!" He points to someone off-link. "See that $playerLastName receives the fuel. Immediately!"

Hector returns to you, looking satisfied. His off-hand taps the hilt of his sword.

"So. What else?"
entries.zh:
"现在又有人告诉我，我们手上的燃料太多，因为平时一半的买家都太胆小，不敢进这个星系。"

他漫不经心地摆了摆手，仿佛那些胆怯的商队——Askonia 经济的命脉——不值一提。

"那你还不如拿它去多轰几个敌人，把他们轰到投降为止。你！\"他指向通讯画面外的某人。\"让 $playerLastName 把燃料领走。立刻！"

Hector 转回来看着你，一脸满足。他空着的那只手拍了拍剑柄。

"那么。还有别的吗？"

entries.en:
"Bring me Achilles' head on a spike!"

He barks a laugh at his own wit, eyes roaming.

You can't see the attendants and advisors in the room with him, but no doubt- with a brusque gesture he's on to a new thought.
entries.zh:
"把 Achilles 的脑袋插在矛尖上给我送来！"

他被自己的机灵逗得笑了一声，目光四处游移。

你看不见与他同处一室的侍从和顾问，但无疑——他一个粗率的动作，心思已经转到了别处。

entries.en:
"Your commission is restored," Hector declares. "See that you bring honor to the Sindrian Diktat - preferably in battle with my cowardly enemies."

He raises a finger.

"I do want Achilles' head, captain. The thought that my own blood could be corrupted by the so-called Persean League... it is sacrilege."

His look of disgust is definitive.

"Now go away! Make it happen." He turns his back, cape fluttering.

"Glory to my Sindrian Diktat!"
entries.zh:
"你的委任状恢复了，\"Hector 宣布，\"记住为辛达强权带来荣耀——最好是在与我那些懦弱的敌人交战时。"

他竖起一根手指。

"Achilles 的脑袋我确实要，舰长。一想到我自己的血亲竟会被所谓的英仙座联盟腐蚀...这是大不敬。"

他脸上的厌恶毫不含糊。

"现在滚吧！去把它办成。"他转过身去，披风飘动。

"荣耀归于我的辛达强权！"

entries.en:
"I am hearing most upsetting rumors about the Hegemony meddling in my rightful domain. My father settled this matter once already when he took their fleets and burned those who would not see his wisdom."

Hector's fist clenches and releases.

"I believe Orcus Rao has chosen to oppose me, the old fool. Teach him the error of conspiring against me - go to Ragnar Complex and destroy his base of operations. The station, the military base, the spaceport. Everything he's used to send arms to the terrorists, traitors, rebels, and the rest of the vermin I must waste time stamping out."
entries.zh:
"我听到一些极令人不安的传言，说霸主在插手我名正言顺的领地。我父亲当年就了结过这件事：他夺了他们的舰队，把那些不肯领会他智慧的人烧了个干净。"

Hector 的拳头攥紧，又松开。

"我相信 Orcus Rao 已经选择与我为敌，这个老糊涂。让他明白密谋反我是什么下场——去 Ragnar Complex，毁掉他的行动基地。空间站、军事基地、太空港。凡是他用来给恐怖分子、叛徒、叛乱者，以及其余那些还得劳我费时清剿的渣滓运送武器的地方，全都毁掉。"

entries.en:
"Destroy my enemies!" he shouts, standing.

"They swarm, the cowards, in a mindless circle around Volturn. Followers of my so-called 'brother' Achilles."

Hector makes a dreadful expression, stroking the hilt of his sword. It appears to be a new addition to the uniform of the Supreme Executor.

"Mercenaries, fools; the rubbish-sweepings of the League worlds," he mutters.
entries.zh:
"毁掉我的敌人！"他站起身来大喊。

"那些懦夫成群结队，毫无头脑地绕着 Volturn 打转。都是我那个所谓的'兄弟' Achilles 的追随者。"

Hector 抚着剑柄，脸上的表情难看至极。那把剑似乎是最高元首制服上新添的一件。

"雇佣兵、蠢货；从联盟各个世界扫出来的垃圾，"他喃喃道。

entries.en:
"He should have accepted my challenge like a man! His cowardice is proof that he is no blood of Andrada."

Hector draws his sword with a flash and holds it in a ready stance against an invisible opponent.

"Probably," he muses, "he's some half-breed thing cooked up by that mad doctor... what's his name."

Hector snaps the fingers of his off-hand at someone and listens for a moment.

"Cydonia," he repeats.

He slashes the air with his sword, a body-cut.
entries.zh:
"他本该像个男人一样接受我的挑战！他的怯懦就是证据：他身上没有一滴 Andrada 的血。"

Hector 拔剑出鞘，剑光一闪，摆出架势对着一个看不见的对手。

"八成，\"他沉吟道，\"他是那个疯医生弄出来的某种杂种东西...叫什么来着。"

Hector 用空着的那只手朝某人打了个响指，听了一会儿。

"Cydonia。"他重复了一遍。

他挥剑斩向空气，一记横断躯干的劈砍。

o.en: How may I serve you, Supreme Executor?
o.zh: 我该如何为你效劳，最高元首？

entries.en:
Hector's eyes gleam as you elaborate the logistics, facilities, and most especially the additional fleet capacity your colonial organization will bring to his cause.

"Yes, yes," he says, nodding. "THIS is how you demonstrate loyalty. Fleets and territory!"

He catches himself in his enthusiasm, and tempers it.
entries.zh:
当你细数后勤、设施，尤其是你的殖民组织将为他的事业带来的额外舰队产能时，Hector 的眼睛亮了起来。

"对，对，\"他连连点头，\"这才叫表忠心。舰队和地盘！"

他察觉自己失了态，随即收敛了几分。

entries.en:
"-However undeveloped these colonies might be and, doubtless, filled with spacer mongrels. Nonetheless, I must begin somewhere."

He flashes a grin again.
entries.zh:
"——尽管这些殖民地可能很落后，而且无疑塞满了太空杂种。不过，我总得有个起点。"

他又咧嘴一笑。

o.en: I pledge the support of my organization, my colony, to your cause.
o.zh: 我愿以我的组织、我的殖民地之力，支持你的事业。

o.en: I pledge the support of my organization, my colony, to your cause.
o.zh: 我愿以我的组织、我的殖民地之力，支持你的事业。

o.en: I pledge the support of my organization, my colonies, to your cause.
o.zh: 我愿以我的组织、我的各块殖民地之力，支持你的事业。

entries.en: Hector nods, though there is a troubled look on his face.
entries.zh: Hector 点了点头，可脸上却带着几分不安。

entries.en:
"I was assured by Dolos that he had everything under control."

There's a low, uneasy anger growing in Hector's voice. "He spoke of... grumbling in the leadership. Disloyalty."

He takes a deep breath.

"If what you say is true and not degenerate spacer lies, then you'll have done me a service." Hector nods, examining you through the link. A provisional acknowledgement.

"If. And I shall soon discover the truth."
entries.zh:
"Dolos 向我保证过，一切都在他掌控之中。"

Hector 的声音里，一股压抑而不安的火气正在积聚。"他提过...领导层里有人怨声载道。不忠。"

他深吸了一口气。

"如果你说的都是真的，而不是堕落的太空佬编的瞎话，那你就替我办成了一件事。"Hector 点了点头，透过链路打量着你。一次带保留的认可。

"如果。而且我很快就会查清真相。"

entries.en:
You explain that Macario's scheming had driven Hyder to smuggle supplies and even question her command, for the sake of duty to the Sindrian Diktat navy - but you confronted her with the reality of the situation and reminded her of her oath.

Not to Macario and his plotting, but to the blood of Andrada. To Hector.
entries.zh:
你解释说，Macario 的算计逼得 Hyder 私自偷运物资，甚至质疑自己接到的命令，只因她认为自己该对辛达强权海军尽责——但你当面把局势的实情摆给她看，并提醒她记起自己的誓言。

不是向 Macario 和他的阴谋效忠，而是向 Andrada 的血脉。向 Hector。

entries.en:
You explain how Macario's scheming had driven Caden into a state of wild resentment - he was led to believe he would be the next Supreme Executor while Macario hid Hector's existence. All of this was a ploy to use Caden's righteous fervor for the transcendent philosophy of Philip Andrada against the Sindrian Diktat, so that Dolos Macario could channel Caden's rage... and the resources of the Lion's Guard.

But you confronted Caden with the truth, and with his oath to serve the blood of Andrada. By submitting to Hector's authority, he will best serve the Sindrian Diktat.
entries.zh:
你解释说，Macario 的算计让 Caden 陷入了狂热的怨恨——他被引导相信，只要 Macario 继续藏着 Hector 的存在，下一任最高元首就该是他。这一切都是个圈套：把 Caden 对 Philip Andrada 超凡哲学的正义热忱用来对付辛达强权，好让 Dolos Macario 能利用 Caden 的怒火...以及狮心卫队的资源。

但你当面把真相告诉他，也提醒了他效忠 Andrada 血脉的誓言。臣服于 Hector 的权威，才是他报效辛达强权的最好方式。

entries.en:
You explain how Macario's scheming had driven a wedge between Hyder and Caden, splitting the combat effectiveness of the Sindrian Diktat Navy and the Lion's Guard so that each questioned their own loyalty to the legacy of Philip Andrada, Lion of Sindria. It was all a ploy to destabilize the Sindrian Diktat and make it vulnerable to Dolos Macario's sway.

But you've reminded each of their oath of service to the blood of Andrada - to Hector, the Supreme Executor and source of all true authority.
entries.zh:
你解释说，Macario 的算计在 Hyder 与 Caden 之间打进了一根楔子，让辛达强权海军与狮心卫队的战斗力一分为二，各自都开始怀疑自己对 Philip Andrada——辛达瑞亚之狮——所留遗产的忠诚。这一切都是为了让辛达强权失去稳定，好任由 Dolos Macario 摆布。

但你让他们各自想起了效忠 Andrada 血脉的誓言——效忠 Hector，最高元首，一切真正权威的源头。

entries.en:
"He took it from you? Do I recall ordering your commission stripped?" Hector raises an eyebrow. "Hmm."

"I sign a great number of executive orders," he says, peevish. "Endless bureaucracy. You'd think we were the Hegemony! Dolos has been very helpful, but I suspect at times he's pursuing his little side-projects..."

Hector rubs his chin, putting on a thoughtful look.
entries.zh:
"他从你手里夺走的？我记得我下过命令，撤销你的委任状？\"Hector 挑起一边眉毛。\"嗯。"

"我签的行政命令多得数不清，\"他烦躁地说，\"没完没了的官僚程序。简直像我们成了霸主似的！Dolos 帮了大忙，可有时候我怀疑他在搞自己那些小项目..."

Hector 摸了摸下巴，摆出一副沉思的模样。

entries.en:
"I know- I'll just declare that you never lost your commission. I can do that, you know." He grins at the thought. Perhaps because it would annoy Macario.

"That is, if..." Hector turns his eyes on you. "If I am satisfied with your... loyalty."

He places his chin on his hands and looks through the link eagerly, as if anticipating a game.
entries.zh:
"我知道——我干脆宣布你从未失去委任状。你知道，这事我办得到。"想到这儿他咧嘴一笑。也许是因为这会让 Macario 恼火。

"也就是说，前提是...\"Hector 把目光转向你。\"前提是我对你的...忠诚感到满意。"

他双手托住下巴，兴味盎然地从链路那头望着你，像是在等一场游戏开场。

entries.en:
Then he crosses his arms, having come to a decision.

"I shall choose to believe in you, $playerName. If Dolos objects, let him bring me more fleets and weapons than you have provided."
entries.zh:
然后他双臂抱胸，显然已作出决定。

"我选择相信你，$playerName。要是 Dolos 有意见，就让他给我送来比你更多的舰队和武器。"

o.en: How may I serve you, Supreme Executor?
o.zh: 我该如何为你效劳，最高元首？

entries.en:
As you speak of Andradaism he stands taller, chin raised and regal, resplendent in his uniform of the Supreme Executor.

"Enough," he says at last, indulgent.

"I know all of this, of course, but it does please me to hear that even an outsider is capable of understanding my father's teachings."

"I am... his immortal blood, his legacy, the personification of his empire." Hector's gaze lifts; taking in his domain, the excitement obvious in his eyes.
entries.zh:
你谈起 Andrada 主义时，他的身姿愈发挺拔，下巴扬起，气度威严，一身最高元首的制服光彩照人。

"够了，"他最后说道，语气宽纵。

"这些我自然全都知道，可听到连一个外人都能理解我父亲的教诲，我还是很高兴。"

"我就是...他不朽的血脉，他的遗产，他那帝国的化身。"Hector 抬眼望去，将他的疆域尽收眼底，眼中的兴奋毫不掩饰。

entries.en:
His eyes returns at last to you.

"See that you don't forget it, spacer."
entries.zh:
他的目光最终落回你身上。

"记住，别把这事忘了，太空佬。"

o.en: I will... return when I can prove my loyalty, Supreme Executor.
o.zh: 我...会在能证明忠诚的时候回来，最高元首。

entries.en:
You order Leonidas' cryopod prepared. A drone-carrier is prepped for the transfer, its cargo cradled gently by an octet of clamp-arms.

Hector is intrigued, waving off what can only be objections on the receiving end from his attendants and bridge officers. Warnings not to accept indeterminate packages from dubious spacers.

"Tell me, captain, what is this gift?"
entries.zh:
你下令准备好 Leonidas 的冷冻舱。一架无人运输机为转运做好了准备，八条钳臂轻轻托住舱体。

Hector 来了兴致，挥手挡开了通讯那头侍从与舰桥军官的反对——无非是在警告他别收下来历不明的太空佬递上的不明包裹。

"告诉我，舰长，这是什么礼物？"

o.en: Your clone-brother, Leonidas Andrada. In cryosleep.
o.zh: 你的克隆兄弟，Leonidas Andrada。在冷冻睡眠中。

entries.en:
An alarmed look. "But Dolos said-"

Hector shuts himself up, and gives you a wary look.

"My clone-brother." He nods, slowly. Remembering to appear ruthless and in control at all times.

"A most unique and fitting gift, spacer. You shall have to tell me... your version of events. Someday. Perhaps my brother will... become useful one day."

By Hector's look, you don't think he has rehabilitation in mind; they are one flesh, after all.
entries.zh:
他神色一惊。"可 Dolos 说过——"

Hector 把话咽了回去，警惕地看着你。

"我的克隆兄弟。"他缓缓点头，没忘记要时刻显得冷酷、尽在掌握。

"一份绝无仅有、恰到好处的礼物，太空佬。你总得跟我讲讲...你那个版本的说法。改天吧。也许我这位兄弟有朝一日...会变得有用。"

看 Hector 的神情，你不觉得他打的是让人康复的主意；毕竟，他们本是一体。

o.en: I've ensured the commitment of powerful allies... (explain)
o.zh: 我已确保了几位强援的承诺... (解释)

o.en: I have secured you logistical support from outside of Askonia... (explain)
o.zh: 我已从 Askonia 之外为你弄到了后勤支援... (解释)

o.en: I held a commission of the Sindrian Diktat... until Macario took it from me.
o.zh: 我曾持有辛达强权的委任...直到 Macario 把它夺走。

o.en: I pledge the support of my organization, my colony, to your cause.
o.zh: 我愿以我的组织、我的殖民地之力，支持你的事业。

o.en: I pledge the support of my organization, my colony, to your cause.
o.zh: 我愿以我的组织、我的殖民地之力，支持你的事业。

o.en: I follow Andrada's Transcendent Ideology and swear to serve his immortal blood!
o.zh: 我信奉 Andrada 的超凡意识形态，誓死效忠他不朽的血脉！

o.en: I bring a gift. (give him Leonidas Andrada)
o.zh: 我带来了件礼物。 (把 Leonidas Andrada 交给他)

entries.en:
"See that you do - and be quick about it. My time is more valuable than you can possibly imagine. In the meantime..."

He looks aside and flutters his hand to get someone's attention.

"See that this spacer scum isn't accidentally killed. Revoke the kill-order, whatever. I want to see what happens next."

Hector turns back to you and raises his chin - a wordless dismissal.
entries.zh:
"务必做到——而且要快。我的时间比你能想象的还要金贵。在此期间..."

他侧过头去，摆了摆手，唤人注意。

"别让这个太空垃圾意外送了命。把格杀令撤了，随便怎么处理。我想看看接下来会怎样。"

Hector 转回头看着你，扬起下巴——无声的逐客令。

entries.en:
"See that you do - and be quick about it. My time is more valuable than you can possibly imagine, spacer."

Hector turns back to you and raises his chin - a wordless dismissal.
entries.zh:
"务必做到——而且要快。我的时间比你能想象的还要金贵，太空佬。"

Hector 转回头看着你，扬起下巴——无声的逐客令。

entries.en:
"Yes, I'm sure-" Hector stifles a yawn. "You spacers are useful at this sort of thing, aren't you. I'd be interested if this involves any rare and powerful weapons..."

His expression grows more pleased as he imagines what might be gained from the armories of Culann, Kazeron, and Coatl.
entries.zh:
"是啊，我确信——\"Hector 把哈欠憋了回去。\"你们这些太空佬干这种事倒是挺在行，不是吗。要是这事牵扯到什么稀有又强力的武器，我倒会有兴趣..."

他一想到能从 Culann、Kazeron 和 Coatl 的军械库里弄到些什么，神色便越发满意起来。

entries.en: You describe the spy networks and software intrusions of Faro Inesis. Seeing Hector grow bored, you move on to summarizing the dizzying arrangement of shell entities Faro Inesis can use to purchase materiel from any major polity to deliver directly to Sindrian Diktat arsenals.
entries.zh: 你讲述了 Faro Inesis 的间谍网络与软件入侵。见 Hector 听得有些乏味，你便转而概述他布下的那套令人眼花缭乱的空壳公司：凭这些公司，他可以从任何一个大势力手中购得军需物资，直接送进辛达强权的军械库。

entries.en: You describe the dizzying arrangement of shell entities Rayan Arroyo has organized which can facilitate the purchase materiel from any major polity to deliver directly to Sindrian Diktat arsenals.
entries.zh: 你讲述了 Rayan Arroyo 布下的那套令人眼花缭乱的空壳公司网络：靠它可以从任何一个大势力手中购得军需物资，直接送进辛达强权的军械库。

entries.en: You describe the spy networks and software intrusions of Faro Inesis. Seeing Hector grow bored, you move to summarizing the dizzying arrangement of shell entities both Faro Inesis and Rayan Arroyo control which they can use to purchase material - weapons - from any major polity to deliver directly to Sindrian Diktat arsenals.
entries.zh: 你讲述了 Faro Inesis 的间谍网络与软件入侵。见 Hector 听得有些乏味，你便转而概述两人共同掌控的那套令人眼花缭乱的空壳公司：凭这些公司，他们可以从任何一个大势力手中购得物资——武器——直接送进辛达强权的军械库。

o.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的各殖民地的支持。

o.zh: 你也会得到我的组织、我的殖民地的支持。
