entries.en:
The $post's face goes pale.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I apologize for the misunderstanding - time of war and all, we have to be very... very... sorry, I shall not take any more of your time."

$HeOrShe snaps a salute.

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!"
entries.zh:
$post 的脸刷地白了。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。误会之处，我深表歉意——战时嘛，我们不得不非常...非常...抱歉，我不再占用你的时间了。"

$HeOrShe 啪地行了个军礼。

"荣耀归于辛达强权！"

o.en: Glory to the Sindrian Diktat. You may go.
o.zh: 荣耀归于辛达强权。你可以走了。

entries.en:
Nothing, then, from Hercules. Wherever he is.

If he's even still alive.
entries.zh:
那么，Hercules 那边什么也没有。不管他身在何处。

如果他还活着的话。

entries.en:
"There has been no further contact with the subject. We've received nothing, we've found nothing."

Hesitation.
entries.zh:
"与目标再没有任何联系。我们什么都没收到，也什么都没查到。"

一阵迟疑。

entries.en:
"It's... almost speculation, almost. But our agents have found... patterns which suggest that other operatives have been looking for Hercules."

"Surveillance anomalies, reactive software inquiries set off by our own search - very discreet, we were never tracked," they add rapidly. "Suspect the others are private agents, but some very likely backed by major factions. Very sophisticated, very subtle. High access."
entries.zh:
"这...几乎只能算推测，几乎。但我们的人手发现了一些...迹象，表明还有别的特工在找 Hercules。"

"监视上的异常、由我们自己的搜索引发的反制性软件探询——做得极隐蔽，我们从未被追踪到，\"对方说得很快。\"怀疑其他几路是私人特工，但也有些很可能有大型势力撑腰。手段极老练，极隐蔽。权限很高。"

o.zh: 可还是没有 Hercules 的踪迹。

entries.en:
"Correct, $playerSirOrMadam. It's possible someone else got to him first."

Their expression is closed.

"We'll send a priority message to you, directly, if the situation changes."
entries.zh:
"正是，$playerSirOrMadam。有可能别人先一步找到了他。"

对方神色一收。

"情况若有变化，我们会直接给你发最优先级的消息。"

entries.en: "Yes, of course - the matter of supplying their resistance movement."
entries.zh: "对，当然——就是给他们抵抗运动提供补给的事。"

entries.en:
"Arnaud Iscare informed me that you've given the Nortia ACA everything they need," Horus says, allowing himself a hopeful smile. "My... trusted contacts would like to relay their thanks and appreciation."

"Allow me to provide you with credits to offset the risks you have taken and - well, we may consider it a reward, I suppose."
entries.zh:
"Arnaud Iscare 告诉我，你已经把 Nortia 的 ACA 需要的一切都给了他们，\"Horus 说，难得露出一个带着希望的笑容。\"我那些...可信的联系人想转达他们的感谢与赞赏。"

"请允许我给你一些星币，补偿你承担的风险，还有——嗯，我们不妨就把它当成一笔报酬吧。"

entries.en:
"I am disappointed to have had no word from Arnaud Iscare on Nortia," Horus says with a concerned look.

"My, ah, trusted contacts quite insist that it would assist in securing a beneficial outcome in Askonia. So please, captain, see that it is done promptly."
entries.zh:
"Nortia 的 Arnaud Iscare 一直没有消息，我很失望，"Horus 面带忧虑地说。

"我那些，呃，可信的联系人坚持认为，这会有助于在 Askonia 争取一个有利的结果。所以，舰长，请务必尽快办妥。"

entries.en:
"I have had word from Arnaud Iscare that you've helped secure some material assistance for the ACA on Nortia," Horus says.

"Please see that he received everything he needs so that we may see, ah, a most beneficial settlement once this terrible crisis is over."
entries.zh:
"Arnaud Iscare 来信了，说你在 Nortia 帮 ACA 弄到了一批物资援助，"Horus 说。

"请确保他拿到了所需的一切，好让这场可怕的危机结束后，我们能看到一个，呃，极为有利的结局。"

entries.en:
"You mean to ask Gens Yaribay to join the Gens Kato voting block against the Prime Demarchon, of course," he says.

"Fortuna has made her position, and her offer, clear during ongoing unofficial negotiations."

He pauses, looking aside. Somewhere far away.

"I do find it... interesting, and notably intentional, that she asked you to be the messenger for this implied final proposal."

Horus seems amused, if resigned.
entries.zh:
"说到底，您是要拉 Yaribay 氏族进 Kato 氏族那个表决阵营，一起制衡大统领，对吧，" 他说道。

"这几轮私下商谈里，Fortuna 把立场和开出的条件都摆得很明白了。"

他顿了顿，目光挪向别处，落在很远的地方。

"她偏挑您来传这个没明说出口的最后提议，我倒觉得... 有意思，而且用意明显得很。"

Horus 像是觉得好笑，却又带着几分认命。

entries.en:
"With respect for your position, $titlePL," he says, bowing his head ever so slightly, "I shall be content to respond to Fortuna directly."

"You need not trouble yourself to repeat the inquiry in the future," he adds after a moment of reflection.

He didn't say it, but this sounds a lot like 'no'.
entries.zh:
"顾及您的身份，$titlePL，\" 他微微欠了欠身，\"这事我更愿意直接回 Fortuna 本人。"

"往后就不劳您再跑一趟传话了，" 他想了想又补了一句。

"这话他没明说，可听着跟一个'不'字没什么两样。"

entries.en:
"Yes," he says, returning to look at you through the link.

"You may tell Fortuna Kato that I accept her terms and proposal on behalf of Gens Yaribay," he says, bowing is head ever so slightly.

"I am sure you'll want to bring her the news yourself."
entries.zh:
"好，" 他说着，重新透过通讯看向您。

"请转告 Fortuna Kato，我代表 Yaribay 氏族接受她的条件与提议，" 他说着，微微欠了欠身。

"这消息，想来您要亲自带回去给她。"

o.zh: 你向 Achilles 宣誓效忠了。

o.en: Wait - I bring word from a... mutual acquaintance.
o.zh: 等等——我带来了一个...故交的口信。

o.en: Wait - I bring word about a... mutual acquaintance.
o.zh: 等等——我来传个话，关于一位...故交。

o.en: You do not. But I ask humbly and accept if you refuse me an answer.
o.zh: 你没有。但我谦卑地请求；你若拒绝回答，我也接受。

o.en: Will you give me one anyway?
o.zh: 可你还是愿意给我一个解释吗？

o.en: I went through a lot of trouble on your behalf. What of Rao's offer?
o.zh: 我为你费了不少周折。Rao 的提议呢？

entries.en: She crosses her arms.
entries.zh: 她抱起双臂。

entries.en:
"Acknowledged."

She crosses her arms, saying nothing more.
entries.zh:
"知道了。"

她抱起双臂，不再多言。

entries.en:
She says nothing for a moment.

Then, deliberately, "It was my duty. A leader cannot abrogate their responsibility to assess the vision and judgment of their superior. To follow blindly and in willful ignorance? That seems... a lesser form of a treason, but treason nonetheless."

Her voice becomes softer.

"I am not perfect, captain. Nor is my judgment. I cannot sacrifice my crew, my officers, and my fleet on the alter of Oxana Hyder's ego."

"Much less that of a Hector, Dolos, or... or Philip Andrada."
entries.zh:
她沉默了片刻。

随后，她一字一顿地开口："那是我的职责。一个领导者无法推卸这样的责任：去审视上级的远见与判断。盲目追随、刻意不问？那似乎是...一种较轻的叛国，但终究是叛国。"

她的声音柔和下来。

"我并不完美，舰长。我的判断也不完美。我不能把我的船员、我的军官、我的舰队，献祭在 Oxana Hyder 的自负之上。"

"更不必说献祭在一个 Hector、Dolos，或者...或者 Philip Andrada 的自负之上了。"

entries.en: She raises her chin. "That is all I have to say. We shall not speak of it again."
entries.zh: 她抬起下巴。"我要说的就这些。此事不必再提。"

entries.en: She crosses her arms, saying nothing.
entries.zh: 她抱起双臂，一言不发。

entries.en:
"Rao offered nothing."

She crosses her arms.
entries.zh:
"Rao 什么也没提。"

她抱起双臂。

entries.en:
"Yes." Her look is imperious. "I do not owe you an explanation."

She does not activate the privacy field.
entries.zh:
"是。\"她的目光傲慢。\"我没有义务向你解释。"

她没有开启隐私场。

entries.en: He nods, not quite a bow.
entries.zh: 他点了点头，还称不上鞠躬。

entries.en:
"I'll be making certain arrangements. Sharing intel, weapons technology... I hope your opinion of Hector proves correct."

"For your sake," he continues brightly, "I hope his reputation - yes, already - is much exaggerated. At the risk of being presumptuous, I would suggest bringing news of our arrangement to Hector yourself."

"Making a good impression is paramount, in business and... other fields of human endeavor."
entries.zh:
"我会做一番安排。共享情报、武器技术...我希望你对 Hector 的看法是对的。"

"为你着想，\"他语气明亮地接着说，\"我希望他的名声——是的，已经有的名声——是被大大夸大了。恕我冒昧，我建议由你亲自把我们的安排告诉 Hector。"

"留下好印象是最要紧的，做生意如此...人类其他的行当也一样。"

o.en: But how do I contact Hector if I am shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat navy?
o.zh: 可我是辛达强权海军格杀勿论的对象，怎么联系 Hector？

entries.en:
"There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble fleet with a clever commander," he nods generously toward you, "could sneak in, hack the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindrian Diktat military network. It all runs on our software, there's nothing to worry about."

He winks. Your TriPad pings.
entries.zh:
"Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支机动灵活的舰队，配上一位聪明的指挥官，\"他大方地朝你点了点头，\"可以悄悄潜入，黑进中继站，与辛达强权军方的网络直接建立通讯链路。那套系统全跑在我们的软件上，不必担心。"

他眨了眨眼。你的 TriPad 响了一声。

o.en: This will help me prove my loyalty to Hector.
o.zh: 这能帮我向 Hector 证明我的忠诚。

entries.en: Inesis smiles helpfully.
entries.zh: Inesis 热心地笑了笑。

entries.en: Inesis smiles helpfully, suspiciously bereft of judgment.
entries.zh: Inesis 热心地笑了笑，那笑容干净得可疑，全无评判之意。

entries.en:
"Macario has committed his resources to removing internal and external opposition."

His half-smile is unchanged.

"We can begin with making that job more difficult - more expensive, more frustrating. He'll be... made incompetent."

Inesis closes his eyes for a moment, then opens them. Is that an entrepreneurial gleam? It could be. Or it could be a retina-cast vision overlay aug.
entries.zh:
"Macario 已经把资源都押在了清除内外的反对者上。"

他那种半笑的神情没有变。

"我们可以先让这桩活儿变得更难——更费钱、更让人窝火。他会...被弄得无能。"

Inesis 闭了一下眼睛，又睁开。那是一丝企业家的锐光吗？也许吧。也可能只是视网膜投影的叠加植入体。

o.en: How do you propose to do that?

entries.en:
"A software attack. Through the hypercomms system."

Without lifting a finger, Inesis conjures an image in your shared comms-volume: a diagram of the Askonia system. It zooms into a highlighted entity - the comms relay.
Askonia's primary hub of interstellar communication and data transfer.

This would be a classic Tri-Tachyon tactic - it was employed to great effect in the AI Wars.

"You'll receive a software package," he says. "Don't worry, it'll be quite harmless... until you upload it into the relay."
entries.zh:
"一次软件攻击。通过超波通讯系统。"

Inesis 连手指都没抬，就在你们共享的通讯空间里变出一幅图像：Askonia 星系的示意图。画面推近，锁定一个高亮的实体——通讯中继站。
Askonia 星际通讯与数据传输的主要枢纽。

这会是典型的速子科技战术——在 AI 战争中曾大获成功。

"你会收到一个软件包，\"他说。\"别担心，它相当无害...直到你把它上传进中继站。"

o.en: The relay surrounded by hostile fleets on a war footing?
o.zh: 那座中继站的四周，全是处于战备状态的敌对舰队？

o.en: I know the place. The kill-order was put on hold, so it shouldn't be hard.
o.zh: 那地方我知道。格杀令已经暂缓，所以应该不难。

o.en: I know the place. I have a commission, it'll be easy.
o.zh: 那地方我知道。我手上有委任在身，会很轻松。

entries.en:
"Indeed! This falls neatly within your solution skill-set," he says brightly.

"My projections for your odds of success are remarkably high."
entries.zh:
"正是！这恰好落在你解决问题的技能范围内，"他语气明亮地说。

"我的模型算下来，你成功的概率高得惊人。"

o.en: You have no idea how reassuring that sounds.
o.zh: 你根本不知道这话听着有多让人安心。

o.en: They're one hundred percent, I assume.

entries.en: His pleasant smile is re-asserted.
entries.zh: 他那和悦的笑容又端了回来。

entries.en:
He laughs dutifully.

And does not elaborate.
entries.zh:
他尽责地笑了笑。

没有再多说。

entries.en: His pleasant smile is re-asserted.
entries.zh: 他那和悦的笑容又端了回来。

entries.en:
"You?"

Inesis' face ripples strangely.

The silence extends uncomfortably.
entries.zh:
"你？"

Inesis 的面容诡异地泛起波纹。

沉默拖得让人难受。

o.en: Yes, me. If Philip Andrada could conquer Askonia, so can I.
o.zh: 对，我。Philip Andrada 能征服 Askonia，我也能。

entries.en:
He blinks, once.

"Fascinating."
entries.zh:
他眨了一下眼。

"有意思。"

o.en: I'm asking how you will assist me. I will reward my supporters.
o.zh: 我问的是你打算怎么帮我。我会奖赏支持我的人。

entries.en:
"No doubt," he says. "It is a... bold proposal, captain. Quite exceptional. Thank you for sharing your intentions with me."

He refolds his hand neatly, and politely.
entries.zh:
"毫无疑问，\"他说，\"这是个...大胆的提议，舰长。相当不凡。谢谢你把自己的打算告诉我。"

他把双手重新交叠，动作整齐而客气。

o.en: So will you help? What will it cost?
o.zh: 那你帮不帮？要多少代价？

entries.en:
Inesis produces a soft, pleasant chuckle.

"I fear I must decline your generous offer, captain. I have sufficient employment at present which provides me with stimulation and opportunity for advancement."

He adjusts his hands. "Your's is an exciting notion, there is no doubt. I shall watch in admiration of your ambition."

His smile is refreshed.
entries.zh:
Inesis 发出一声轻软、悦耳的低笑。

"恐怕我得谢绝你这番慷慨的提议，舰长。我眼下的差事足够多，能给我刺激，也给我晋升的机会。"

他调整了一下双手的姿势。"你这个想法很令人兴奋，这一点毫无疑问。我会怀着钦佩，看着你的野心如何施展。"

他的笑容焕然一新。

entries.en: Inesis looks at you attentively, his expression inviting you to speak.
entries.zh: Inesis 专注地看着你，神情像是邀你开口。

entries.en:
He smiles. "I fully respect and appreciate your offer. It is a point of pride to bend directives from above toward profitable ends, but this would be too far."

"With my apologies and regrets, I must decline."
entries.zh:
他笑了。"我完全尊重并感激你的提议。把上面的指令扭向有利可图的方向，是我引以为傲的本事，但这一次太过头了。"

"恕我致歉并抱憾，我只能拒绝。"

entries.en: "Perhaps there is," he says.
entries.zh: "也许确实有，"他说。

entries.en:
"Askonia!" His artificial smile brightens.

"A dynamic situation indeed, ripe with opportunity. New market segments are seeing extraordinary demand spikes."
entries.zh:
"Askonia！"他脸上那副人造的笑容亮了起来。

"确实是个动荡的局面，机会遍地。新的市场板块正出现异常的需求峰值。"

o.en: I want your help taking down Dolos Macario.
o.zh: 我要你帮我扳倒 Dolos Macario。

o.en: I want you to help support Achilles Andrada.
o.zh: 我要你帮忙支援 Achilles Andrada。

o.en: I want you to help support Hector Andrada.
o.zh: 我要你帮忙支援 Hector Andrada。

o.en: I want your help supporting the Askonian rebels.
o.zh: 我要你帮我支援 Askonia 的叛军。

entries.en:
The comms snap open and resolve to show Arnaud Iscare already with a charming look.

"Captain $PlayerLastName! So good to see you again."
entries.zh:
通讯应声而开，画面里 Arnaud Iscare 已经挂上了一副迷人的神情。

"$PlayerLastName 舰长！又见到你真是太好了。"

entries.en:
The link is accepted and Arnaud Iscare looks up with a charmingly affected look of surprise.

"Captain? Back so soon?" He smiles. "How many I be of assistance?"
entries.zh:
通讯接通，Arnaud Iscare 抬起头，做出一副可爱又刻意的惊讶神情。

"舰长？这么快就回来了？\"他笑了笑，\"有什么我能效劳的？"

entries.en:
There is no response to your comms request.

Iscare is either not on Nortia or is not responding to comms at this time.
entries.zh:
你的通讯请求没有得到回应。

Iscare 要么不在 Nortia，要么此刻不接通讯。

entries.en:
The comms connect and show the charming smile of Arnaud Iscare. You hear his voice, though the image does not move.

"I'm sorry, friend, but duty calls. I'm currently travelling the Persean Sector looking for the best and brightest for the Galatia Academy and will return in-" His voice takes on the buzz of an algorithmically generated insert, but there seems to be some kind of error because the word is indecipherable.

"If you'd like to leave a message..."
entries.zh:
通讯接通，画面里是 Arnaud Iscare 迷人的微笑。你能听见他的声音，画面却纹丝不动。

"抱歉，朋友，职责在身。我眼下正在英仙座星域各处游历，为 Galatia 学院寻访最出色、最聪敏的人才，我将在——"他的声音转为一段算法生成的插入音，但似乎出了某种差错，那个词模糊得无法辨清。

"如果你想留言..."

entries.en: The $post mumbles something and cuts the comms.
entries.zh: 那位$post嘟囔了几句，切断了通讯。

entries.en:
The image flickers and holds.

"After each sleep, I tell myself 'you live to see Dolos Macario dead'."

He does not look well. Too little sleep, too much drink.

"Vengeance sustains a man. But no more," he mutters.
entries.zh:
影像闪了闪，稳住了。

"每次睡醒，我都对自己说：'你活着，是为了亲眼看见 Dolos Macario 死'。"

他气色很糟。睡得少，喝得多。

"复仇撑着一个男人活下去。可也撑不了多久了，"他喃喃道。

entries.en:
The image flickers and holds.

"After each sleep, I tell myself 'you live to see Dolos Macario dead'. Vengeance sustains a man. But no more," he mutters.

He does not look well. Too little sleep, too much drink. His eyes manage to find yours through the comms.

"What do you want?"
entries.zh:
影像闪了闪，稳住了。

"每次睡醒，我都对自己说：'你活着，是为了亲眼看见 Dolos Macario 死'。复仇撑着一个男人活下去。可也撑不了多久了，"他喃喃道。

他气色很糟。睡得少，喝得多。他的目光穿过通讯，勉强找到你的眼睛。

"你想要什么？"

entries.en: The comm-link flickers, then stabilizes to show Maeus Moroz, a grim but eager look in his eyes.
entries.zh: 通讯链接闪了几下，随即稳定下来，映出 Maeus Moroz 的身影；他眼神阴沉，却透着股急切。

entries.en:
"It is a glorious thing to bring the hunt to the den of the beast."

He inhales deeply. "I smell blood in the vacuum, captain. Blood and fear, ha-ha!"
entries.zh:
"把猎物追到野兽的老巢里来，这可是件光荣的事。"

他深深吸了口气。"我在真空里都闻得到血腥味，舰长。血，还有恐惧，哈哈！"

entries.en:
"It is a glorious thing to bring the hunt to the den of the beast."

He inhales deeply, eyes wild. "I smell blood in the vacuum, captain. Blood and fear, ha-ha!"
entries.zh:
"把猎物追到野兽的老巢里来，这可是件光荣的事。"

他深深吸了口气，双眼发狂。"我在真空里都闻得到血腥味，舰长。血，还有恐惧，哈哈！"

entries.en:
"I am preparing for the hunt, captain. Every compartment of my fleet will be filled with fuel, supplies, and killers. Many killers, all that I know."

"And I know many," he almost growls, clearly enjoying himself.
entries.zh:
"我正在为这场狩猎做准备，舰长。我舰队的每一个舱室都会塞满燃料、补给，还有杀手。很多杀手，全是我认得的人。"

"而且我认得很多人，"他几乎是在低吼，显然乐在其中。

entries.en:
"I am preparing for a hunt, captain. Every compartment of my fleet will be filled with munitions... and killers. Many killers. All that I know."

"And I know many," he almost growls, clearly enjoying himself.
entries.zh:
"我正在为一场狩猎做准备，舰长。我舰队的每一个舱室都会塞满弹药...还有杀手。很多杀手。全是我认得的人。"

"而且我认得很多人，"他几乎是在低吼，显然乐在其中。

entries.en: "Comms open, comrade!" His greeting is almost a shout. "I fast approach the den of my enemy with vengeance in my heart. Come with me - there will be glorious battle!"
entries.zh: "通讯接通了，同志！\"他这一声几乎是喊出来的。\"我正全速逼近敌人的老巢，心里揣着复仇的念头。跟我来 —— 会有一场光荣的战斗！"

entries.en:
"Comms open!" His greeting is almost a shout.

"I fast approach the den of my enemy with vengeance in my heart. Come with me - witness the clarity of glorious battle!"
entries.zh:
"通讯接通了！"他这一声几乎是喊出来的。

"我正全速逼近敌人的老巢，心里揣着复仇的念头。跟我来 —— 来亲眼看看光荣之战有多么纯粹！"

entries.en:
He sighs, shaking his head.

"It... it does not matter. Now I wait here in orbit until a final battle. Either Macario's puppy comes to us, or we to him . And then, then that is my chance!"

"This... Achilles, he promised me Dolos. Maybe he gives him to me, maybe I take him after this battle." He shrugs. "Either way."
entries.zh:
他叹了口气，摇了摇头。

"这...这不重要。现在我就在这颗行星的轨道上等着，等最后一场决战。要么 Macario 的小狗来找我们，要么我们去找他。然后，然后那就是我的机会！"

"这个...Achilles，他答应把 Dolos 交给我。也许他真会给我，也许我在这场仗之后自己动手抓他。\"他耸耸肩。\"反正都一样。"

entries.en:
Maeus is quiet for a moment.

"Thank you captain, for this. My fleet, my people - they are strong, but not so strong as the Diktat navy. This way I have a chance - vengeance for my son. Blood for blood."

He grins, fiercely.

"I hope I shall greet you again captain, in the volume of battle!" Maeus' eyes flash with manic energy. "Good hunting, comrade. And burn, burn bright!"

He laughs as he reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
Maeus 沉默了片刻。

"谢谢你，舰长，为了这个。我的舰队、我的人——他们很强，可没强到能跟强权的海军比。这样一来我就有机会了——为我儿子复仇。血债血偿。"

他咧嘴一笑，笑得凶悍。

"但愿我还能在战场的喧嚣里再见到你，舰长！\"Maeus 眼中闪过狂热的光。\"好好打，同志。烧起来，烧得亮些！"

他笑着伸手去切断通讯。

entries.en:
"Got a report." His eyes flick down to his datapad, then back up. "Our friends on Nortia, the ACA, have received everything they asked for."

"Good work." Rao doesn't smile.
entries.zh:
"收到报告了。\"他低头瞥了一眼数据板，又抬眼看你，\"我们在 Nortia 的朋友，ACA，已经拿到了他们要的一切。"

"干得不错。"Rao 没有笑。

entries.en:
"An informant on Umbra had an interesting story, by the way," Rao says. "Some spacer came through making big donations to the Gens girl, Imoinu, for her 'revolution'."

"Good." Rao nods at you. "But that's the end of it, captain. We don't want some band of pirates with big ideas ruining the post-crisis settlement."
entries.zh:
"顺带一提，Umbra 上有个线人讲了个有意思的故事，\"Rao 说，\"有个船长跑来给氏族那丫头 Imoinu 的'革命'捐了一大笔。"

"很好。\"Rao 朝你点了点头，\"但到此为止，舰长。我们不想让一伙满脑子大志的海盗毁了危机之后的安排。"

entries.en:
"I received a report from an informant on Umbra," Rao says coldly. "Sounds like some spacer captain with space-dust for brains got excited for the revolution run by that Kazeronian princess and armed a bunch of ANTIs to the teeth."

"That was stupid," Rao says with a sighs, rubbing his eyes. "But it's done. Remember that I'm the one who is going to have to explain this to the Strategic Council if it burns us."
entries.zh:
"我在 Umbra 的线人给我送了一份报告，\"Rao 冷冷地说，\"听起来是某个脑子里塞满太空尘的船长，被那位 Kazeron 公主搞的革命冲昏了头，把一帮 ANTI 武装到了牙齿。"

"这蠢透了，\"Rao 叹了口气，揉着眼睛，\"但事情已经做了。记住：要是这事烧到我们头上，得去战略委员会解释的人是我。"

entries.en:
"I'm hearing things from Volturn, captain," Rao says. "Luddics are acting up. Say a spacer made a 'charitable donation' that's helped them out of a rough spot."

"That's enough for the VSDC, I think," he says with a nod, not smiling. "We just want them causing trouble - not taking over."
entries.zh:
"Volturn 那边有些风声，舰长，\"Rao 说，\"卢德派在折腾。据说有个船长做了笔'慈善捐赠'，帮他们熬过了一道难关。"

"对 VSDC 来说，这就够了，我想，\"他点了点头，脸上没有笑意，\"我们只要他们去惹麻烦——不是让他们接管局面。"

entries.en:
"I'm hearing things from Volturn, captain," Rao says, an edge to his voice. "It's a miracle, apparently. Some spacer decided to personally arm the entire Volturnian Self Defense Covenant with enough materiel for a proper, blessed-bedamned uprising."

"That," he says coldly, "was a mistake. And against my explicit ord-" He pauses, conceding the slip. "Against my instructions."

"I'm not happy, captain. But there's no undoing it now. We'll see if it bites us."
entries.zh:
"Volturn 那边有些风声，舰长，\"Rao 说，语气锐利起来，\"据说是个奇迹。有个船长决定亲自把整个 Volturn 自卫盟约武装起来，军械多到足够他们打一场像模像样的、活见鬼的起义。"

"那，\"他冷冷地说，\"是个错误。而且违背了我明确的命——\"他停住，默认了这次失口，\"违背了我的指示。"

"我不高兴，舰长。但现在已经收不回来了。就看它会不会反咬我们一口。"

o.en: Do you want me to attack the heirs' fleets directly?
o.zh: 你要我直接去打继承人们的舰队？

entries.en:
"If you can," he says.

"Raid their outposts and infrastructure. Put the spaceports and industries out of commission. If you can pick off patrols, merchant fleets - anything - that's what I want to see."

Rao smirks.

"I'm not allowed to order Hegemony-flagged fleets to directly do what has to be done, so it's up to you."
entries.zh:
"能打就打，"他说。

"袭扰他们的前哨和基础设施。让那些太空港和工业设施停摆。要是能顺手干掉巡逻队、商船队——什么都行——那就是我要看到的。"

Rao 勾了勾嘴角。

"我不能下令挂霸主旗的舰队去直接干这些必须干的事，所以只能靠你了。"

entries.en:
"What about it?" He crosses his arms.

"Should be simple. I want to see uprisings across the system and anything those Andrada-clones think they're building going down in flames."
entries.zh:
"谈它什么？"他抱起手臂。

"应该很简单。我要看到整个星系起义四起，还有那些 Andrada 克隆体自以为在建的东西全都烧成灰。"

entries.en:
He pauses a moment.

"I'm not hearing anything from Nortia," he says, voice containing a note of disapproval. "I expected the ACA would be receiving fuel and supplies from a mysterious spacer who developed a sudden enthusiasm for the cause of a Free Askonia."

"So." Rao looks you over. "Get on it."
entries.zh:
他停顿了片刻。

"Nortia 那边我什么消息都没听到，\"他说，语气里带着不满，\"我本以为 ACA 会收到一位神秘船长送去的燃料和补给——那位船长忽然对自由 Askonia 的事业热情高涨。"

"所以。\"Rao 上下打量你，\"去办。"

entries.en:
"The Charterists are up and running, fully supplied."

His eyes meet yours through the link. "Good work."
entries.zh:
"宪章派已经运转起来，补给充足。"

他的目光透过通讯链路与你的相接。"干得好。"

entries.en:
"You haven't made any deliveries to the Charterist contact on Nortia."

His eyes flick up to meet yours through the link.

"That's disappointing. That pack of play-terrorists is what guarantees a post-crisis Askonia that isn't dominated by the Sindrian Mutiny. And that's only because I'm not allowed to go in there myself and solve this problem the old fashioned way with the pride of the Fourteenth."

"Get on it, and don't screw it up."
entries.zh:
"你还没给 Nortia 上的宪章派联络人送过任何东西。"

他的目光透过通讯链路抬起来，与你相接。

"这很让人失望。那帮玩票的恐怖分子，是危机之后 Askonia 不被'辛达叛乱'把持的唯一保障。而这仅仅是因为，上头不许我亲自带着第十四战斗群的骄傲开进去，用老办法把问题解决掉。"

"去办，别搞砸了。"

entries.en:
"The Strategic Assembly doesn't want to send in the navy. It'd look bad. No risk of mutiny - things are different now - but because that's how we got this problem in the first place. Appearances."

He snorts dismissively.

"So instead we're arming and supplying rebels, with priority given to the Charterists out of Nortia. They're ostensibly for full independence but the diplomats say the ACA leadership is 'open-minded'. Whatever that means."
entries.zh:
"战略议会不想派海军进去。那样不好看。不是怕哗变——现在情况不一样了——而是因为这问题最初就是那么来的。面子。"

他不以为然地哼了一声。

"所以我们就改成武装叛军、给他们供补给，优先照顾 Nortia 出来的宪章派。他们名义上是要完全独立，但外交官们说 ACA 的领导层'思想开明'。管他什么意思。"

entries.en:
"I want you to run supplies, fuel, and credits to our Charterist contact on Nortia. Despite your commission, they say it looks better if it's done indirectly. Gives the Charterists credibility with the so-called 'United Front' that's planning a system-wide uprising."

"I'll let our people know to set up a meeting."
entries.zh:
"我要你把补给、燃料和星币送到我们在 Nortia 的宪章派联络人手上。虽说你带着委任状，他们说这事办得间接些更好看。这也能给宪章派在所谓'联合阵线'那里挣点信誉——那帮人正筹划一场全星系起义。"

"我会通知我们的人安排一次会面。"

entries.en:
"Remember, you need to contact our Charterist contact on Nortia as soon as possible and get the supplies flowing," he says.

"The rebels are key to our strategy in Askonia."
entries.zh:
"记住，你得尽快联系上我们在 Nortia 的宪章派联络人，让补给流动起来，"他说。

"叛军是我们在 Askonia 战略的关键。"

entries.en:
"You made contact with the Charterists and started supplying them with material."

His eyes flick up to meet yours through the link.

"Good. Keep it going."
entries.zh:
"你已经和宪章派接上了头，开始给他们供物资。"

他的目光透过通讯链路抬起来，与你相接。

"很好。接着干。"

entries.en:
"Captain." He lets out a breath. "I'm spying on the Sindrian Diktat. When you go and hack their high-level comms relay and call the seniormost naval commander of any ability, I hear about it."

"Now let's return to the important question: Hyder."
entries.zh:
"舰长。\"他吐出一口气。\"我在监视辛达强权。你跑去黑进他们的高层通讯中继站，又去联络他们最有本事的海军指挥官——这种事会传到我耳朵里。"

"现在回到关键问题：Hyder。"

entries.en:
"I'm jealous, $titleHeg, because you get an opportunity to see some action."

"Get out there and hit as many patrols and convoys as you can. Don't care if they claim to follow the traitor Philip or any one of his clones - they're all targets. And if you can get in and raid key facilities, even better. Anything bearing those purple wings is fair game."
entries.zh:
"我羡慕你，$titleHeg，因为你有机会真刀真枪干一场。"

"出去，能打多少巡逻队和运输队就打多少。别管他们声称效忠叛徒 Philip 还是他哪一个克隆体——全是目标。要是还能钻进去突袭关键设施，那就更好。凡带着那对紫色翼徽的，都可以打。"

entries.en:
The comm-link connects immediately. Admiral Orcus Rao sits before you.

He doesn't waste words on greetings.
entries.zh:
通讯链路立刻接通。Orcus Rao 上将坐在你面前。

他不在寒暄上浪费口舌。

entries.en: "Askonia is getting hot," he says.
entries.zh: "Askonia 要热起来了。"他说。

entries.en: "Askonia is getting hot," he says. "What's the read on Hyder?"
entries.zh: "Askonia 要热起来了。\"他说，\"Hyder 那边什么情况？"

entries.en:
The comm-link connects immediately. Admiral Orcus Rao sits before you.

He doesn't waste words on greetings.
entries.zh:
通讯链路立刻接通。Orcus Rao 上将坐在你面前。

他不在寒暄上浪费口舌。

entries.en:
The comm-link connects immediately. Admiral Orcus Rao sits before you.

He doesn't waste words on greetings.
entries.zh:
通讯链路立刻接通。Orcus Rao 上将坐在你面前。

他不在寒暄上浪费口舌。

entries.en:
The comm-link connects immediately. Admiral Orcus Rao sits before you.

He doesn't waste words on greetings.
entries.zh:
通讯链路立刻接通。Orcus Rao 上将坐在你面前。

他不在寒暄上浪费口舌。

entries.en:
The comm-link connects immediately. Admiral Orcus Rao sits before you.

He doesn't waste words on greetings.
entries.zh:
通讯链路立刻接通。Orcus Rao 上将坐在你面前。

他不在寒暄上浪费口舌。

entries.en:
"Achilles?" You almost miss his flash of anger.

"Explain."
entries.zh:
"Achilles？"你差点没捕捉到他眼中一闪而过的怒意。

"解释。"

o.en: Dividing the navy and Lion's Guard between the heirs means there's no clear victor.
o.zh: 把海军和狮心卫队分给不同的继承人，就没有明确的赢家。

o.en: I figure we need to get as much of the Diktat navy out from under Macario's influence as possible.
o.zh: 我觉得，得尽量把强权海军从 Macario 的影响下拉出来。

o.en: Honestly? Achilles is the better man. If someone has to win, it should be him.
o.zh: 说实话？Achilles 是更合适的人。如果非得有人赢，那该是他。

entries.en:
He grunts an acknowledgement.

"Not bad for an auxiliary," he concedes. "That is, if Hyder cares to listen to the advice of some spacer merc."
entries.zh:
他咕哝一声，算是认可。

"对一个编外人员来说，不算差，\"他让步道。\"前提是 Hyder 愿意听一个太空雇佣兵的建议。"

entries.en:
"Fair enough. Split their forces and reduce Macario's hard-power. Just don't let your personal feelings about Macario get in the way of the mission."

"We're here to take down the Sindrian Diktat." He forms a wry smile. "But once it's over, I'll open the airlock if you want to give him a push."

"But let's not get ahead of ourselves. This all depends on if Hyder takes the advice of some spacer merc."
entries.zh:
"说得过去。拆散他们的兵力，削弱 Macario 的硬实力。只是别让你对 Macario 的私人感情妨碍任务。"

"我们是来扳倒辛达强权的。\"他挤出一个苦笑。\"不过等事情了结，你要是想推他一把，气闸我来开。"

"但别想得太远。这一切都取决于 Hyder 肯不肯听一个太空雇佣兵的建议。"

entries.en:
"The 'better man'? Listen to yourself. And if he actually is, it'll only make things worse if he's in charge."

"The mission is to take down the Sindrian Diktat, not choose which fancy-lad clone sits in front of the flag."

He closes his eyes, then takes a deep breath and slowly unclenches his fists.

"Stay on target, $titleHeg. And let's not get ahead of ourselves. This all depends on if Hyder takes the advice of some spacer merc."
entries.zh:
"'更合适的人'？听听你自己在说什么。他要真是，那让他掌权只会更糟。"

"任务是扳倒辛达强权，不是挑哪个公子哥克隆体坐到帅旗前面。"

他闭上眼，深吸一口气，慢慢松开拳头。

"盯住目标，$titleHeg。也别想得太远。这一切都取决于 Hyder 肯不肯听一个太空雇佣兵的建议。"

o.en: She's conflicted. I told her I'd ask if you could cut her a deal.
o.zh: 她很矛盾。我跟她说，我会来问你能否给她一条出路。

o.en: We spoke. She seems unsure of what to do.
o.zh: 我们谈过了。她似乎拿不准该怎么办。

o.en: We spoke. I suggested that she back Achilles.
o.zh: 我们谈过了。我建议她支持 Achilles。

entries.en:
He rubs his face, idly, with one hand.

"A deal, huh. You know she had a trial? Mutiny on the battlefield, premeditated, in active combat? By an officer?"

"The sentence is death."

He considers this for a moment, then half-raises a single finger. "Almost."

He sits back, considering.
entries.zh:
他一只手随意地搓了搓脸。

"交易，是吗。你知道她受过审判吧？战阵哗变，有预谋，发生在实战之中，而且是一名军官？"

"判决是死刑。"

他斟酌了片刻，竖起半根手指。"差一点。"

他向后靠去，陷入思索。

o.en: You're telling me you can cut her a deal?
o.zh: 你是说，你能给她谈成一笔交易？

entries.en:
"No." He crosses his arms. "And Hyder knows it. She knows the trial was held 25 cycles ago and she was sentenced to death in absentia. Execution of the sentence pending, obviously."

"That's all I can offer."
entries.zh:
"不能。\"他抱起双臂。\"Hyder 也知道。她知道那场审判是 25 个星历年之前的事，她被缺席判处死刑。判决待执行，这不用说。"

"我能给的只有这些。"

o.en: You don't have authority. But someone else does.
o.zh: 你没有这个权限。但别人有。

entries.en:
He gives you a weary look.

"The High Hegemon could make an exception."
entries.zh:
他疲惫地看你一眼。

"至高霸主可以破例。"

entries.en:
He makes a sly smile.

"You're starting to understand how the Hegemony works, captain." A weary look replaces the smile. "Only the High Hegemon can make an exception."
entries.zh:
他狡黠地笑了笑。

"你开始明白霸主是怎么运转的了，舰长。\"笑容褪成一脸倦意。\"只有至高霸主才能破例。"

entries.en: "Question is, will he. And is there time."
entries.zh: "问题是他肯不肯。还有来不来得及。"

o.en: So you just need to contact the High Hegemon? Sounds easy enough.
o.zh: 所以你只需要联系上至高霸主？听起来够简单。

o.en: I'm guessing it isn't as easy as sending the High Hegemon a request.
o.zh: 我猜，不会像给至高霸主递份申请那么容易。

entries.en: "Sounds easy," he says in a tone that makes it clear it isn't.
entries.zh: "听着是简单，"他说，那语气分明表示一点都不简单。

entries.en: "No."
entries.zh: "不必了。"

entries.en:
"Political considerations. Daud needs to run a tight ship because he's already, well." Rao stops himself. "Well, I'll worry about that. Above your pay grade."

He takes a deep breath. "It should suffice to say I'd be more than pleased to shoot Hyder myself and the entire Hegemony navy would buy my drinks afterward."

"With a word Daud might take one capable commander from the enemy but he'd have told every faithless turncoat with mutiny rotting in their heart that they might be forgiven. That is unacceptable both as a matter utility and of honor."
entries.zh:
"政治上的考量。Daud 必须把船管得滴水不漏，因为他本来就，呃。\"Rao 打住了。\"算了，这我来操心。超出你的级别。"

他深吸一口气。"说得够清楚就是：我巴不得亲手毙了 Hyder，完事之后整支霸主海军都会请我喝酒。"

"Daud 一句话，或许能从敌人那边拉走一位能干的指挥官，但他同时也等于告诉每一个心怀叛念、哗变之毒烂在心里的不忠之徒：他们可以被赦免。无论从实利还是荣誉上讲，这都不能接受。"

o.en: After all that bother you put me through, you're not going to try?
o.zh: 你让我费了这么多周折，现在连试都不肯试？

o.en: What of Askonia? If the Lion's Guard and navy are united under Hector, the Diktat is stronger.
o.zh: 那 Askonia 呢？狮心卫队和海军要是都归到 Hector 麾下，强权就更强了。

entries.en: "Eh, fairs got nothing to do with it. Never did," he says, and sighs. "I'll put in the request. But damn the stars, it hurts me to be the one to do it."
entries.zh: "唉，公不公平跟这事没关系。从来就没关系，\"他说着叹了口气。\"我会去提这个请求。可该死的星海啊，偏偏要由我来提，真叫我难受。"

entries.en:
He sighs.

"I am going to try. I need to ensure that all parties lose the civil war and that's not going to happen if their forces are united."
entries.zh:
他叹了口气。

"我会去试。我得确保内战里哪一方都赢不了，可他们的兵力要是合到一处，这就办不到了。"

entries.en: "My thinking exactly," he says. "So I'll put in the request. But damn the stars, it hurts me to be the one to do it."
entries.zh: "我正是这么想的，\"他说。\"所以我会去提这个请求。可该死的星海啊，偏偏要由我来提，真叫我难受。"

entries.en:
"Time is going to be tight. I can't say what the turnaround will be, it all depends on how the weather is in the Strategic Council. And with Askonia going critical..."

He shakes his head.

"We have agents on Nortia. She can surrender herself there."
entries.zh:
"时间会很紧。我说不准回复要多久，全看战略委员会里的风向。何况 Askonia 眼看就要到临界点..."

他摇了摇头。

"我们在 Nortia 有自己人。她可以在那里自首。"

o.en: Can I give Hyder your guarantee of clemency?
o.zh: 我可以把你的免罪保证转告 Hyder 吗？

entries.en:
He pauses, putting one fist in his other hand.

"No. Only that I'll try."
entries.zh:
他顿了顿，一只拳头抵进另一只手心里。

"不行。我只能保证我会去试。"

o.en: I suppose I'll have to say the same to you.
o.zh: 看来我也只能对你说同样的话了。

entries.en: "Ever?" He narrows his eyes. "What did you do?"
entries.zh: "永远？\"他眯起眼。\"你做了什么？"

o.en: I believe she didn't trust me already. Due to our previous interaction.
o.zh: 我想她本来就不信任我。因为我们之前那次接触。

entries.en:
"I see." He looks away with a sigh. Thinking for a moment.

"That is unfortunate," he says finally. "I had hoped that your earlier contact could be leveraged toward some kind of negotiation. Clearly this was misjudged."
entries.zh:
"我明白了。"他叹了口气，把目光移开。思索片刻。

"这很不幸，\"他终于开口。\"我原本希望，凭你先前的接触，能促成某种谈判。显然我判断错了。"

entries.en: "You didn't." He fixes his expression and takes a deep breath. Clearly angry, but not finding a use for expressing that anger... yet.
entries.zh: "你没有。"他收起表情，深吸一口气。分明是怒了，只是还找不到由头把这股火发出来... 暂时。

o.en: She, uh, does not wish to speak with me again. Ever.
o.zh: 她，呃，不想再跟我说话了。永远不想。

entries.en: He stares. "And?"
entries.zh: 他盯着你。"然后呢？"

o.en: I told her it wasn't up to me, it was up to her.
o.zh: 我告诉她，这事不由我决定，由她决定。

entries.en:
Rao snorts, looking away with obvious impatience.

"I suppose I could have been more explicit about 'using initiative'. But fine, the deed is done. Or not done." He looks back. "She's unsure."

"Which clone do you think she'll support? Or another option?"
entries.zh:
Rao 嗤了一声，把目光移开，明显不耐烦。

"我大概该把'发挥主动性'说得更明白些。不过算了，事已至此。或者说什么都没成。\"他看回来。\"她在犹豫。"

"你觉得她会支持哪个克隆体？还是另有选择？"

o.en: Achilles. He's a real naval officer, she'll respect that.
o.zh: Achilles。他是真正的海军军官，她会敬重这一点。

o.en: She's a follower. Hector declared first and foremost. He'll appear legitimate.
o.zh: 她是个随大流的人。Hector 最先也最张扬地表明了立场。他会显得名正言顺。

entries.en: "It's as good a theory as any," he says. "I'll just hope the betrayal is as messy as the first time she turned-coat."
entries.zh: "这说法倒也不比别的差，\"他说。\"我只希望她这回倒戈，闹得跟第一次一样难看。"

entries.en:
He grunts acknowledgement.

"Maybe we'll get lucky and Macario will be stupid enough to have her purged."
entries.zh:
他咕哝一声，算是认可。

"也许运气好，Macario 会蠢到把她清洗掉。"

entries.en:
"Not sure?" He gives you a deadpan look.

"Well I am sure. Sure that you've got through a lot of effort to arrive exactly where we started," he spits, clearly displeased. "And now I'm starting to question my own judgement," he says under his breath.
entries.zh:
"不确定？"他面无表情地看你一眼。

"那我就确定了。确定你费了一大圈力气，正好回到我们出发的地方，"他啐道，显然很不高兴。"而且我现在开始怀疑自己的判断了，"他低声说。

entries.en: Rao gives you a weary look, then glances at his datapad. "Next order of business."
entries.zh: Rao 疲惫地看了你一眼，随即瞄了瞄手里的数据板。"下一件事。"

entries.en:
Rao gives you a weary look, then glances at his datapad.

"Next order of business. We'll see what the folks down in MINCOM can do about your little reputation problem while we're at it."
entries.zh:
Rao 疲惫地看了你一眼，随即瞄了瞄手里的数据板。

"下一件事。顺便看看 MINCOM 那帮人能对你那点名声道上的小麻烦做点什么。"

o.en: I, uh, can't wait to see.
o.zh: 我，呃，真是等不及想看了。

entries.en: He gives you a weary look. "Let's get back to the plan."
entries.zh: 他疲惫地看了你一眼。"回到计划上来。"

entries.en: "Next." He doesn't glance at his datapad this time. "My favorite part: taking out hostiles."
entries.zh: "下一件。\"这次他没看数据板。\"我最喜欢的环节：清除敌对目标。"

entries.en:
"Sir! Admiral Rao, sir," the lieutenant says, just managing not to stammer.

"The conditions you specified are met precisely: high bandwidth hyperwave with Sindrian Diktat priority override code direct from the Zagan system. Sir. Like you said."

"Acknowledged, lieutenant," Rao says, voice gravelly with the threat of a senior officer's rebuke. No ironic smile. "Patch it to this feed. Dismissed."

"Sir!" The lieutenant disappears.

Rao winks at you then sets priority to the third input feed.
entries.zh:
"长官！Rao 上将，长官，"上尉说，勉强没有结巴。

"您指定的条件全部精确满足：高带宽超波通讯，带辛达强权优先覆盖码，直接从 Zagan 星系发来。长官。跟您说的一样。"

"收到，上尉，\"Rao 说，嗓音沙哑，透着资深军官训斥人的威胁。没有一丝带刺的笑意。\"接到这条信息流上。解散。"

"是，长官！"上尉消失了。

Rao 朝你眨眨眼，然后把优先级切到第三条输入信息流。

entries.en:
"So there it is." Rao's got a smile on his face. "The civil war just turned hot. Couldn't ask for better timing, because next comes my favorite part."

He doesn't glance at his datapad this time. "Taking out hostiles."
entries.zh:
"来了。\"Rao 脸上挂着笑。\"内战已经打成热战了。这时机再好不过，因为接下来是我最喜欢的环节。"

这次他没看数据板。"清除敌对目标。"

entries.en:
"Next-" He draws a breath and is interrupted by a comms ping.

Rao gives you a knowing look. "About time. I think you're going to want to see this too."

A new feed appears - a fresh-faced young Hegemony lieutenant. Rao's got his command face on.

"Lieutenant! I gave explicit orders not to interrupt this meeting unless extremely specific conditions were met."
entries.zh:
"下一件——"他吸了口气，被一声通讯提示音打断。

Rao 意味深长地看你一眼。"总算来了。我想你也会想看看这个。"

一条新的信息流接入——一名面容青涩的年轻霸主上尉。Rao 已经换上了那副指挥官的脸色。

"上尉！我下过明确的命令，除非满足极其具体的条件，不许打断这场会议。"

entries.en:
"Any more rebels, give 'em a little help, but not too much. And if you've got any more connections with unpleasant people, now's the time to call them in. We want to see the Sindrian Diktat fall, $titleHeg."

"Then the Phoenix will do what it does best and rise from the ashes, or whatever line the propaganda department is coming up for this one."

He tosses the datapad onto his desk. "That's it."

"Any questions? No?" He doesn't wait for you to interject. "Good. See you at the victory parade."
entries.zh:
"再碰上别的叛军，就给他们一点帮助，别太多。你要是还认识什么不三不四的人，现在正是把他们叫来的时候。我们要看到辛达强权倒下，$titleHeg。"

"然后凤凰会做它最擅长的事，从灰烬里重生——或者宣传部这回又想出什么说辞。"

他把数据板扔到桌上。"就这些。"

"还有问题吗？没有？\"他没等你插话。\"很好。胜利阅兵见。"

entries.en:
"My quartermaster will release more fuel and supplies to your tender care. I trust you'll put them to work killing mutineers."

A ping from your TriPad suggests that your own quartermaster has just received the news.
entries.zh:
"我的军需官会再拨一批燃料和补给，交给你照管。我相信你会让它们用在杀叛军上。"

你的 TriPad 响了一声提示，看来你自己的军需官刚收到消息。

entries.en:
"My quartermaster will release some fuel and supplies to a storage bay assigned to you, on Ragnar Complex. I trust you'll put what you can in the hands of our Charterist friends - remember, Nortia - and otherwise set to work killing mutineers."

A ping from your TriPad suggests that your own quartermaster has just received the news.
entries.zh:
"我的军需官会拨一批燃料和补给到 Ragnar Complex 上划给你的一间仓储舱。我相信你会把能匀出来的部分交到我们宪章派朋友手里——记住，Nortia——剩下的就用来杀叛军。"

你的 TriPad 响了一声提示，看来你自己的军需官刚收到消息。

entries.en:
"I'm not releasing more fuel and supplies," he says.

"You've already got the stocks meant for the Charterists and I want them put to work killing mutineers one way or another."

His expression goes hard. "Is that understood?"
entries.zh:
"我不会再拨燃料和补给了，"他说。

"本来要给宪章派的那批库存已经在你手上，我要它们不管走哪条路，都用在杀叛军上。"

他的神情硬了起来。"听明白了吗？"

o.en: Look - I have a fleet. I can put those supplies to better use than the Charterists.
o.zh: 听我说——我有一支舰队。那批补给交给我，比给宪章派用得更好。

entries.en:
"Does it look like we care?" he growls.

"If I wanted a deranged mercenary with authority issues to steal all the glory, I'd have put the reserve fleet directly under your command. But you might be surprised that opinions both popular and elite among the Core worlds view your type somewhat dimly compared to the 'freedom fighters' from a rich little moon that got blown to gravel by the psychotic arch-traitor."

He raises a single finger.

"And don't mistake this for a conversation. I'm telling you this out of the respect from one warrior to another."

The hand lowers. "Moving on."
entries.zh:
"你看我们像在乎吗？"他低吼道。

"我要真想找一个满脑子不服管、还疯疯癫癫的雇佣兵来抢光所有功劳，早就把预备舰队直接拨到你手下了。可你也许想不到，核心世界的民意和精英，看你们这号人都不怎么顺眼——特别比起那颗富庶小卫星上出来的'自由斗士'。那颗卫星可是被那个疯魔的超级叛徒炸成了一地碎石。"

他竖起一根手指。

"别把这当成商量。我告诉你这些，是出于一个战士对另一个战士的尊重。"

那只手放下了。"继续。"

entries.en:
"Nothing yet from my agents on Nortia, no."

His look is distant.
entries.zh:
"Nortia 上的手下还没有消息，没有。"

他的目光飘远了。

entries.en:
"No, not yet."

He lets out a deep breath.
entries.zh:
"没有，还没有。"

他长长吐出一口气。

entries.en:
"No, not yet."

He lets out a deep breath.
entries.zh:
"没有，还没有。"

他长长吐出一口气。

o.en: Well. Hyder switched sides. To Achilles.
o.zh: 嗯。Hyder 换了阵营。投到 Achilles 那边去了。

entries.en:
Rao looks at you for a long moment.

"Yes. I've had reports. Guess that means her answer was 'no'." He relaxes, not pleased, but not willing to take this as a defeat.

"So was Daud's, for what it's worth. He put it in official words, but what he didn't say was that he can't look soft on traitors. Not in the current political environment."

Orcus snorts. "Best not to get into all that."
entries.zh:
Rao 盯着你看了好一会儿。

"是。我收到报告了。看来这就是她的答复：'不'。"他松了松身子，不算满意，却也不肯把这事当成一次挫败。

"Daud 的答复也一样，算是吧。他用官话写的，但没说出来的是：他不能对叛徒显得心软。在眼下这种政治气候里不能。"

Orcus 哼了一声。"这些还是别深究了。"

o.en: Heard anything from Hyder about the offer?
o.zh: 关于那个提议，Hyder 那边有消息吗？

o.en: Have you heard back from Daud about the Hyder offer?
o.zh: 关于给 Hyder 的提议，Daud 回话了吗？

entries.en: "That means she's done. Gone. Out of the picture." He takes a deep breath. "Don't know what the Spider is going to have done to her, but it's not the justice she deserved."
entries.zh: "也就是说她完了。没了。出局了。\"他深吸一口气，\"不知道'蜘蛛'会对她做什么，但那不是她该得的正义。"

entries.en: "Execution," he says. "Clean and earned."
entries.zh: "处决，\"他说，\"干净，而且是她挣来的。"

entries.en:
"A soft and easy sentiment for one who wasn't involved." He gives you a hard look. "Who wasn't betrayed. Whose comrades weren't murdered by cold-blooded treachery."

"I'll let those fool's words pass," Rao says. "Because you weren't there."
entries.zh:
"对一个没被卷进去的人来说，这话说得又软又轻巧。\"他狠狠地看了你一眼，\"你没被背叛。你的同袍没被冷血的背信杀掉。"

"这些蠢话我就不计较了，\"Rao 说，\"因为你当时不在场。"

entries.en:
He looks away.

"The matter is concluded. Doesn't matter what either of us wants now."
entries.zh:
他把目光移开。

"这事已经了结。现在你我想要什么都不重要了。"

entries.en: "Not from Hyder," he says flatly. "She was arrested by Macario's goons."
entries.zh: "不是 Hyder 的消息，\"他平板地说，\"她被 Macario 的打手抓了。"

entries.en: "No," he says flatly. "And it doesn't matter anymore. Hyder was arrested by Macario's goons."
entries.zh: "没有，\"他平板地说，\"而且也不重要了。Hyder 被 Macario 的打手抓了。"

entries.en: As your $shipOrFleet trades pings with local traffic control, your comms officer calls for your attention. "$PlayerSirOrMadam, there's a message for you. It was stored in the comm network until our transponder code was registered to the local authorities."
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet与当地交通管制交换着应答信号，通讯官忽然叫住了你。"$PlayerSirOrMadam，有你的一条消息。它一直存在通讯网络里，直到我们的应答器代码在地方当局登记之后才放出来。"

o.en: Patch it through to my TriPad.

entries.en:
Orcus Rao appears. A good holo; it appears that the Hegemony budget will pay the premium-grade transmission and caching fees.

"$PlayerName," he says. "It has begun, or soon will. Get to Ragnar so we can talk."

His image reaches out to a control interface and the message terminates.
entries.zh:
Orcus Rao 现身。全息影像很清晰；看来霸主的预算肯为这种高级传输和缓存费用买单。

"$PlayerName，\"他说，\"已经开始了，或者很快就开始。到 Ragnar 来，我们当面谈。"

他的影像伸手去够控制界面，消息就此中断。

entries.en:
There is no attached data.

Rao either doesn't fully trust inter-system comms or isn't bothered by the need to hear his own voice. Probably both.
entries.zh:
没有附带任何数据。

Rao 要么是不完全信得过星系间的通讯，要么就是喜欢听自己说话、不嫌费事。多半两者都有。

entries.en: "Moving along," Rao says gruffly.
entries.zh: "说下一件，"Rao 生硬地说。

o.zh: 我在为 Rao 上将效力，$rank。

o.en: Turn the transponder on and comply
Talk your way out of it
Refuse and cut the comm link

entries.en:
An annoyed look crosses $post's face.

"Hold a moment for confirmation," $heOrShe says, tapping at an interface.

It appears to come through green because $heOrShe sighs, and says, "$PlayerSirOrMadam. You are clear to proceed, just... try to keep a low profile from now on, alright?"

Then, curtly, "$PersonRank $PersonLastName out."
entries.zh:
$post 脸上闪过一丝不快。

"稍等，我需要核实一下，"$heOrShe 说着，在界面上敲了几下。

看来核验通过了，因为$heOrShe 叹了口气，说道："$PlayerSirOrMadam。你可以通行了，只是...往后尽量低调些，行吗？"

随后简短地说："$PersonRank $PersonLastName 通话结束。"

entries.en:
"Oh, of course. I received report that you provided for the Gens Kato child's rebellion on Umbra. Good work."

He snaps his fingers at someone off-link.
entries.zh:
"哦，当然。我收到报告，说你在 Umbra 为 Kato 氏族那个孩子起事提供了支援。干得不错。"

他冲通讯链路外的什么人打了个响指。

entries.en:
"Mm? Oh, you must want your reward for helping out our Luddie friends on Volturn."

He snaps his fingers at someone off-link.

"Well done."
entries.zh:
"嗯？哦，你一定是来领赏的——为你在 Volturn 帮了我们那些卢德朋友一把。"

他冲通讯链路外的什么人打了个响指。

"干得好。"

entries.en:
"And I won't have been the first."

Reynard looks away, quite collected.

"Take the so-called Thulian raiders, in this very system. I could easily erase them. Quite easily." His hand motions a demonstration.

"But I do not. Why? They provide something useful to interested parties. The people of the League are reminded to be thankful for Kazeron's contributions to Fleet. Fleet is kept focused on patrols and skirmishes, away from politics. Interfactional traders are reminded of the safety their tariffs pay to provide."

"It's a beautiful tension," he says, speaking more for himself than for you. "As in Askonia, as across the Sector entire."
entries.zh:
"而且我也不会是第一个这么干的人。"

Reynard 移开目光，神色从容。

"就说这个星系里那伙所谓的 Thulian 劫掠者。我要抹掉他们，不费吹灰之力。真的，不费吹灰之力。"他的手比划了一下，权作演示。

"可我没有动手。为什么？因为他们对有心人有用。联盟的民众由此记得感激 Kazeron 对舰队的贡献。舰队则被牢牢拴在巡逻和小规模冲突上，离政治远远的。跨势力贸易商也由此记得，他们交的那些关税买来的是安全。"

"这是一种美妙的张力，\"他说，这话更像是说给他自己听的，\"Askonia 如此，整个星域也如此。"

entries.en:
"Oh yes, your sworn nemesis," he says, amused. "He has disrespected my office, my Gens, and my self."

"It is..."

Reynard drums his fingers on his desk. The muted thrum of rocket batteries unleashing their payload. "Unacceptable."

He turns his eyes to you. There's an odd gleam.

"I have an idea."
entries.zh:
"哦，是啊，你那位不共戴天的仇敌，\"他饶有兴味地说，\"他冒犯了我的职位、我的氏族，还有我本人。"

"这实在..."

Reynard 的手指在桌面上敲击，那声音闷闷的，像火箭炮组齐射时的低鸣。"不可接受。"

他把目光转向你。那眼神里有种古怪的光。

"我有个主意。"

entries.en: He barely nods acknowledgement.
entries.zh: 他勉强点了点头，算是应了。

entries.en: "No," he corrects you with a warning look. "It will be a gift. Do not presume otherwise."
entries.zh: "不，\"他带着警告的目光纠正你，\"那是一份礼物。别自作多情。"

entries.en:
"I need not explain myself." He almost looks annoyed. But more than anything, bored with your question.

"-Particularly when giving you a gift. We will not speak of it until it is time, and then you may thank me appropriately."
entries.zh:
"我不需要向你解释自己。"他看上去有点恼。但更多的是对你这个问题感到腻烦。

"——尤其是在我要送你一份礼物的时候。时候未到，我们不必谈它；到时候，你自可以好好地谢我。"

entries.en:
"I'll ensure that you are given Macario," he says. "When this is all over. He'll be a gift."

"All you must do is complete what I have asked, so that I am in an appropriately generous mood."
entries.zh:
"我会确保 Macario 落到你手里，\"他说，\"等这一切结束之后。他会是一份礼物。"

"你要做的，只是把我交代的事办完，好让我届时心情足够慷慨。"

o.zh: 为什么不干脆直接一点？

entries.en:
"I'll ensure that you are given Macario," he says. "When this is all over. He'll be a gift."

"All you must do is complete what I have asked, so that I am in an appropriately generous mood."
entries.zh:
"我会确保 Macario 落到你手里，\"他说，\"等这一切结束之后。他会是一份礼物。"

"你要做的，只是把我交代的事办完，好让我届时心情足够慷慨。"

o.en: I already have an... arrangement with one K-O Jove.
o.zh: 我已经和某个 K-O Jove 有了...一项安排。

entries.en:
There's a strange flash of an expression - surprise? And a hint of respect. Reynard quickly suppresses it.

"You demonstrate proper foresight, $titlePL, but you put perhaps too much trust into the resources of one ambitious young criminal. He has a part to play, but who will ensure that the final settlement of the Second Askonia Crisis will preclude any amnesty or employment for one Dolos Macario?"

He leans in. "Only my Persean League can provide such diplomatic leverage."
entries.zh:
他脸上飞快掠过一丝古怪的神情——是惊讶？还带着一点敬意。Reynard 立刻把它压了下去。

"你颇有远见，$titlePL，可你对一个野心勃勃的年轻罪犯手里的资源，信得或许太过了。他自有他的角色，但谁来保证第二次 Askonia 危机的最终解决方案会彻底堵死 Dolos Macario 获得特赦或受雇的门路？"

他凑近了些。"只有我的英仙座联盟能提供这样的外交筹码。"

o.zh: 为什么不干脆直接一点？

entries.en:
"Not particularly," he says.

"They hate Gens Kato more than they hate me, and that is useful. Fortuna doesn't have the wisdom to tolerate their little 'irrationalities', nor reign in the excesses of her somewhat dull grandson... What's his name, Dandan? On Mazalot, you'll recall."

He motions a dismissal. "Those fanatics will make themselves useful, one way or another."
entries.zh:
"不怎么担心，"他说。

"他们恨 Kato 氏族胜过恨我，这就很有用。Fortuna 没那份肚量去容忍他们那点'不讲道理'，也管不住她那个有点迟钝的孙子的过火做派...他叫什么来着，Dardan？在 Mazalot，你该记得。"

他摆了摆手，像是把人打发走。"那些狂信徒总会派上用场的，以某种方式。"

o.en: I wish to discuss the situation in Askonia.
o.zh: 我想谈谈 Askonia 的局势。

o.en: Aren't you concerned about the Luddic uprising taking power in Volturn?
o.zh: 你就不担心卢德派起事在 Volturn 夺了权吗？

o.en: You've effectively funded a piratical insurrection on Umbra...
o.zh: 你实质上资助了 Umbra 上一场海盗式的暴动...

o.en: Why not cut a deal with Fortuna?
o.zh: 为什么不跟 Fortuna 做笔交易？

o.en: I'd like to ask about something else. (back)

entries.en: "Askonia." He looks distant. "What of it?"
entries.zh: "Askonia。\"他目光飘远。\"你想说什么？"

entries.en:
"Cut a deal? For what?" Reynard raises an eyebrow. "I have credits, I have power, I have my Gens, and I have Kazeron."

He leans forward.

"My intent, you see, is to provide Fortuna with education."
entries.zh:
"做笔交易？为了什么？\"Reynard 挑起一边眉毛。\"我有星币，我有权力，我有我的氏族，我还有 Kazeron。"

他向前倾身。

"你看，我的打算，是给 Fortuna 一点教育。"

entries.en:
"She must learn to quell her ambitions, to accept her place in the order of things."

"But she chose... this." He shakes his head in mock-sadness. "She chose this, and now I must teach her why things are as they are."
entries.zh:
"她得学会压住自己的野心，接受自己在秩序中的位置。"

"可她偏偏选了...这个。\"他故作惋惜地摇了摇头。\"她选了这个，那现在就得由我来教她，事情为什么是这个样子。"

entries.en:
He smiles, smug and powerful.

"You did well to push him over the edge. Horus was always easily manipulated. He is more like his cousin Menes than he'd ever admit, but..."

Reynard smirks, then waves the thought away.
entries.zh:
他笑了，自得而强势。

"你把他推过了那道坎，干得不错。Horus 一向容易被人摆布。他比他自己肯承认的更像他表亲 Menes，不过..."

Reynard 扯了扯嘴角，把那点念头挥手拂开。

o.en: I spoke with Horus Yaribay. He will support you against Kato.
o.zh: 我和 Horus Yaribay 谈过了。他会支持你对付 Kato。

entries.en:
"I've heard good things about the Gens Kato child. You recall, on Umbra?" He examines a fingernail. "Seems like she's causing quite a lot of trouble."

He looks up, a smile growing. "You've done well."

He snaps his fingers at someone you can't see, and your TriPad pings in response.
entries.zh:
"我听到不少关于 Kato 氏族那小丫头的好话。你还记得 Umbra 上的事吧？\"他端详着指甲。\"看来她惹出的麻烦不小。"

他抬起头，笑意渐浓。"你干得不错。"

他朝你看不见的某个人打了个响指，你的 TriPad 随即响了一声。

entries.en:
"You haven't given any weapons to the Gens Kato child on Umbra. So I hear."

He examines a fingernail. "I'm disappointed." He looks up. "I don't want you to disappoint me, $titlePL."
entries.zh:
"你没给 Umbra 上 Kato 氏族那小丫头任何武器。我听说是这样。"

他端详着自己的指甲。"我很失望。"他抬起头。"我不希望你让我失望，$titlePL。"

entries.en:
Then his expression goes very cold, very cold.

"You're a fool and you have resigned yourself to irrelevance by throwing away my gift of membership in the beautiful Persean League."
entries.zh:
接着他的神情变得极冷，极冷。

"你是个蠢货。你把我赏你的、美丽的英仙座联盟成员资格丢掉了，就此认命，甘做一个无足轻重的人。"

entries.en:
"You are useless to me." Reynard speaks with icy contempt, "I'll have no more of my generosity spurned by an ingrate."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"你对我毫无用处。\"Reynard 语带冰冷的轻蔑，\"我不会再让一个不知感恩的东西糟蹋我的慷慨。"

通讯中断。

entries.en:
"I have word that you've supplied the Gens Kato child." He examines a fingernail. "Good."

"If I wasn't clear the first time, let me erase any doubt: you are to give her everything, everything she wants.
entries.zh:
"我听说你给 Kato 氏族那小丫头送了补给。\"他端详着指甲。\"很好。"

"如果我第一次没说清楚，那就让我把任何疑虑都抹掉：她想要什么，你就给她什么，全部都给。"

entries.en:
After a few minutes the secretary reappears.

"I'm sorry," they say, smiling. "But the Prime Demarchon is unavailable. Would you like to leave a message?"
entries.zh:
几分钟后，秘书又出现了。

"很抱歉，\"她微笑着说，\"大统领现在不便接见。你要留言吗？"

entries.en: As your $shipOrFleet trades pings with local traffic control, your comms officer calls for your attention. "$PlayerSirOrMadam, there's a message for you. It was stored in the comm network until our transponder code was registered to the local authorities."
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet与当地交通管制交换着应答信号，通讯官忽然叫住了你。"$PlayerSirOrMadam，有你的一条消息。它一直存在通讯网络里，直到我们的应答器代码在地方当局登记之后才放出来。"

o.en: Patch it through to my TriPad.

entries.en:
Reynard Hannan appears. A good holo, no credits spared to pay for premium-grade transmission and caching fees.

"$PlayerName," he says, not bothering to look into the feed. "Come to Kazeron, we must speak."

His image freezes on a gesture made toward some hapless secretary to stop recording.
entries.zh:
Reynard Hannan 的影像浮现。全息画质极好——为了顶级传输与缓存费用，他一个星币都没省。

"$PlayerName，\"他连看都不看镜头，\"到 Kazeron 来，我们得谈谈。"

他的影像定格在一个手势上——那是朝某个倒霉秘书做的，示意停止录制。

entries.en: There is no attached data.
entries.zh: 没有附带任何数据。

entries.en:
Surprisingly, the comms open not with some under-secretary, but Reynard Hannan himself.

"$TitlePL $playerLastName," he says. "Things are beginning to get exciting, aren't they."
entries.zh:
出乎意料，通讯接通的不是哪个副秘书，而是 Reynard Hannan 本人。

"$TitlePL $playerLastName，\"他说，\"事情开始有意思起来了，不是吗。"

entries.en:
Surprisingly, the comms open not with some under-secretary, but Reynard Hannan himself.

"$TitlePL $playerLastName," he says. "Things are beginning to get exciting, aren't they."
entries.zh:
出乎意料，通讯接通的不是哪个副秘书，而是 Reynard Hannan 本人。

"$TitlePL $playerLastName，\"他说，\"事情开始有意思起来了，不是吗。"

o.en: Just let him talk. It's what he wants.
o.zh: 让他说下去。他就想这样。

o.en: You mean it looks like a civil war has broken out?
o.zh: 你是说，看起来像是内战已经打起来了？

o.en: Yes! I can't wait to get involved in the shooting.
o.zh: 对！我都等不及要掺和进这场枪战了。

entries.en: He pauses, satisfied without a response for a moment.
entries.zh: 他顿了顿，一时无人应答，他倒很满意。

entries.en:
"You can be very literal, $titlePL," he says. "We'll have to work on that."

He places his hands together and sits up straight. "Now, then."
entries.zh:
"你还真是句句照字面理解，$titlePL，\"他说，\"这一点我们得改改。"

他双手交叠，坐直了身子。"那么，现在。"

entries.en: "Well." Reynard gives you an odd look. "Do save some enthusiasm for the art of subtlety, $titlePL, because it is that which I wish to speak of first."
entries.zh: "好吧。\"Reynard 古怪地看了你一眼。\"$titlePL，把你的热情分一点给含蓄这门艺术，因为我首先要谈的正是这个。"

entries.en:
He looks upward, idly, as if staring at the stars.

"You've an opportunity in Askonia, $titlePL. Raid, plunder, and loot. I'll ensure your reputation is respected in the post-war settlement so you can enjoy the spoils of war. You'll earn it, I'm sure."

He gives you a little wave.
entries.zh:
他百无聊赖地抬眼向上看，仿佛在凝望群星。

"你在 Askonia 有个机会，$titlePL。袭击、劫掠、搜刮。我会确保战后和谈时你的名声得到尊重，好让你享用到手的战利品。我确信，你会挣到这些的。"

他冲你轻轻挥了挥手。

entries.en: He barely nods acknowledgement.
entries.zh: 他勉强点了点头，算是应了。

entries.en: "No," he corrects you with a warning look. "It will be a gift. Do not presume otherwise."
entries.zh: "不，\"他带着警告的目光纠正你，\"那是一份礼物。别自作多情。"

entries.en:
"I need not explain myself."

He almost looks annoyed, but more than anything bored with your question.

"Particularly when giving you a gift. We will not speak of it until it is time, and then you may thank me appropriately."
entries.zh:
"我不需要向你解释自己。"

他看上去有点恼，但更多的是对你这个问题感到腻烦。

"尤其是当我要送你一份礼物的时候。时候未到，我们不必谈它；到时候，你自可以好好地谢我。"

o.en: Is that it? What about Achilles?

entries.en:
"Achilles, yes." He closes his eyes. "I intend to enjoy watching him spend Fortuna's reserves on a failing cause. Perhaps he'll even have a happy little accident. But not too soon..."

Reynard's eyes open with a fierce gleam. "Hector requires a humbling too, you see. The boy would do well to learn to appreciate the value of a 'friendly neighbor'."
entries.zh:
"Achilles，对。\"他闭上眼睛。\"我打算好好看着他把 Fortuna 的家底耗在一桩注定失败的事业上。说不定他还会碰上点愉快的'小意外'。不过，用不着太早..."

Reynard 睁开眼，目光锐利如刃。"你看，Hector 也欠一次挫败。这小子最好学会体会'友善的邻居'有多值钱。"

entries.en:
"On a related note, it would please me very much to rain gifts upon another Askonian malcontent..."

He flips a TriPad up into one hand and gives it a glance.
entries.zh:
"说到这个，我很想给 Askonia 另一位不安分的家伙下一场礼物雨..."

他把一只 TriPad 抛到手里，瞥了一眼。

entries.en:
"The Volturnian so-called 'Self Defense Covenant', led by one Curate Sacraria Moyra Standfast."

The TriPad drops.

"Give her everything she prays for. Weapons, credits, supplies. My quartermaster will assign you materiel."
entries.zh:
"Volturn 人所谓的'自卫盟约'，领头的是个叫 Curate Sacraria Moyra Standfast 的家伙。"

TriPad 落了下来。

"她祈祷什么，就给她什么。武器、星币、补给。我的军需官会给你调配物资。"

entries.en:
"The Volturnian so-called 'Self Defense Covenant'," he lowers the TriPad. "But you know of them already, don't you $titlePL. You've given them everything!"

He casually tosses the datapad. You don't hear it land.

"Fantastic. You've anticipated my desire - if only all my clients had such initiative. But then..." He squints. "You're not a praying type, are you? That would surprise me more than anything."

"Anyway," he snaps his fingers at someone and your own TriPad pings. "You've earned this."
entries.zh:
"Volturn 人所谓的'自卫盟约'，\"他放下 TriPad。\"可你早就知道他们了，对吧，$titlePL。你什么都给他们了！"

他漫不经心地把数据板一抛。你没听见它落地的声音。

"妙极了。你连我想要什么都已经提前办了——但愿我所有的门客都有这份主动。不过...\"他眯起眼。\"你不是会祈祷的那种人吧？那可就是最让我吃惊的事了。"

"总之，\"他朝某人打了个响指，你自己的 TriPad 也响了一声。\"这是你挣来的。"

entries.en:
"The Volturnian so-called 'Self Defense Covenant'," he lowers the TriPad. "But you know of them already, don't you $titlePL."

The TriPad drops.

"Give her everything she prays for. Weapons, credits, supplies. My quartermaster will assign you materiel."
entries.zh:
"Volturn 人所谓的'自卫盟约'，\"他放下 TriPad。\"可你早就知道他们了，对吧，$titlePL。"

TriPad 落了下来。

"她祈祷什么，就给她什么。武器、星币、补给。我的军需官会给你调配物资。"

entries.en: He leans back, luxuriating, arms set behind his head.
entries.zh: 他向后靠去，双臂枕在脑后，一副享受的模样。

entries.en:
"Oh, I suppose you'll need her comms as well."

He snaps his fingers without even glancing aside, and your TriPad pings.

"Volturn. You can remember 'Volturn', right?" He doesn't await a response. "Good."
entries.zh:
"哦，我想你还需要她的通讯编号。"

他连看都没往旁边看一眼，只打了个响指，你的 TriPad 便响了一声。

"Volturn。'Volturn' 这名字你记得住吧？\"他没等你回答。\"很好。"

o.en: Yes, everyone knows where Volturn is.
o.zh: 当然，谁都知道 Volturn 在哪儿。

entries.en: "Volturn. You can remember 'Volturn', right?" He doesn't await a response. "Good."
entries.zh: "Volturn。'Volturn' 这名字你记得住吧？\"他没等你回答。\"很好。"

o.en: Yes, everyone knows where Volturn is.
o.zh: 当然，谁都知道 Volturn 在哪儿。

entries.en:
She blinks once, twice.

"Well, bless me. I don't imagine the Rogue of Eventide suddenly grew a heart, so his aim would have to be undermining the presumptive heirs to Philip Andrada."

She places her hands together, and looks upward.

"What irony that I pray for sons to be less dutiful to their father's memory." Her eyes drop to you, through the link. "I will not turn from what Rao offers, provided it is without conditions."
entries.zh:
她眨了一下眼，又眨了一下。

"哎，真是折我的寿。那位 Eventide 的浪子总不会忽然长了颗善心，那么他打的算盘，必是去削 Philip Andrada 的那几个推定继承人。"

她双手合十，抬眼望向上方。

"偏要我祷告，求做儿子的少尽些孝、别那么念着亡父，你说讽不讽刺。" 她的目光穿过通讯落回你身上。"只要不附带条件，Rao 给的，我不会推。"

o.en: He wants you to undermine Achilles Andrada.
o.zh: 他要你去拆 Achilles Andrada 的台。

entries.en:
She blinks once, twice.

"Well, bless me. I don't imagine that white-haired devil suddenly grew a heart, so his aim has to be manipulating one or another presumptive heir to Philip Andrada."

She places her hands together, and looks upward.

"What irony that I pray for sons to be less dutiful to their father's memory." Her eyes drop to you, through the link. "I will not turn from what Reynard offers, provided it is without conditions."
entries.zh:
她眨了一下眼，又眨了一下。

"哎，真是折我的寿。那位白头发的老魔鬼总不会忽然长了颗善心，那么他打的算盘，必定是摆弄 Philip Andrada 哪一个推定继承人。"

她双手合十，抬眼望向上方。

"偏要我祷告，求做儿子的少尽些孝、别那么念着亡父，你说讽不讽刺。" 她的目光穿过通讯落回你身上。"只要不附带条件，Reynard 给的，我不会推。"

o.en: He wants you to undermine Achilles Andrada.
o.zh: 他要你去拆 Achilles Andrada 的台。

entries.en:
She blinks once, twice.

"Well, bless me. I don't imagine that white-haired devil suddenly grew a heart, so it'll have to be his aim to indirectly undermine Gens Kato who's sponsored Volturn's present overlord in the form of Achilles Andrada."

She places her hands together, and looks upward.

"What irony that I pray for the son to be less dutiful to his father's memory." Her eyes drop to you, through the link. "I will not turn from what Reynard offers, provided it is without conditions."
entries.zh:
她眨了一下眼，又眨了一下。

"哎，真是折我的寿。那位白头发的老魔鬼总不会忽然长了颗善心，那么他八成是想拐着弯地削 Kato 氏族 —— 眼下压着 Volturn 的那位主子 Achilles Andrada，正是他们扶上去的。"

她双手合十，抬眼望向上方。

"偏要我祷告，求做儿子的少尽些孝、别那么念着亡父，你说讽不讽刺。" 她的目光穿过通讯落回你身上。"只要不附带条件，Reynard 给的，我不会推。"

o.en: He wants you to undermine Achilles Andrada.
o.zh: 他要你去拆 Achilles Andrada 的台。

entries.en:
"Does he? Then, with your help, we shall do our very best, providence willing," she says sweetly.

"But promise me this- you'll one day visit my shrine here."
entries.zh:
"是吗？那么有你相助，天意若允，我们自当竭尽所能，" 她语声温软。

"不过你得应我一桩 —— 总有一天，要来我这座圣地看看。"

entries.en: She nods, perhaps even bows, hands held together.
entries.zh: 她双手合十，点了点头，倒像是欠身行了个礼。

entries.en:
She holds your look for a moment, with a small, sad smile.

"Try."
entries.zh:
她迎着你的目光停了片刻，唇边挂着一丝浅淡的、怅然的笑。

"且试试吧。"

entries.en:
She smiles, sadly.

"I will show you the way when you are ready to walk upon it," she says.
entries.zh:
她凄然一笑。

"等你愿意踏上那条路了，我自会指给你看，" 她说道。

o.en: Moyra Standfast? You lead the Luddic rebels of Volturn, right?
o.zh: Moyra Standfast？Volturn 的卢德叛军是你领着的，对吧？

entries.en:
"That's rather a bold assertion, captain whatever-your-name-is," she says, taken aback. "To accuse an old woman of terrorism! Whatever have these worlds come to."

An accusing finger appears. "I'll have you know that my congregation, such as it is - or was - is quite orthodox, thank-you very much. We don't abide heretical notions, much less Patherism here."
entries.zh:
"这话说得可真够冒失的，不知叫什么名字的舰长，\" 她被噎了一下。\"竟指摘一个老婆子搞恐怖主义！这世道都成什么样子了。"

一根指头责难地点了过来。"我可得说清楚，我这点会众 —— 如今还剩多少且不论 —— 向来是规规矩矩的正统，多谢关心。异端邪说我们这里容不下，更别提卢德左径那一套。"

o.en: Reynard Hannan wants to supply your armed uprising.
o.zh: Reynard Hannan 想给你们这场武装起事供货。

entries.en:
"That's rather a bold assertion, captain whatever-your-name-is," she says, taken aback. "To accuse an old woman of terrorism! Whatever have these worlds come to."

An accusing finger appears. "I'll have you know that my congregation, such as it is - or was - is quite orthodox, thank-you very much. We don't abide heretical notions, much less Patherism here."

"这话说得可真够冒失的，不知叫什么名字的舰长，\" 她被噎了一下。\"竟指摘一个老婆子搞恐怖主义！这世道都成什么样子了。"

一根指头责难地点了过来。"我可得说清楚，我这点会众 —— 如今还剩多少且不论 —— 向来是规规矩矩的正统，多谢关心。异端邪说我们这里容不下，更别提卢德左径那一套。"

o.en: Orcus Rao wants to supply your armed uprising.
o.zh: Orcus Rao 想给你们这场武装起事供货。

o.en: Reynard Hannan sent me. With... gifts.
o.zh: Reynard Hannan 派我来的。带了些... 薄礼。

o.en: Orcus Rao sent me. With... gifts.
o.zh: Orcus Rao 派我来的。带了些... 薄礼。

entries.en:
"Why by Ludd's blessed teeth would that man, of all men in the Persean Sector, send me gifts?"

She puts on a skeptical expression.

"I'm not quite the looker I was in cycles past, I'll admit, but it seems even more unlikely to me that the Prime Demarchon of the Persean League has had a sudden crisis of faith."
entries.zh:
"圣卢德在上，英仙座星域里那么多人，偏偏是他，给我送的哪门子礼？"

她摆出一副不信的神情。

"我承认，早年那点模样如今是没了，可要说英仙座联盟的大统领忽然动了信教的念头，我瞧着更不大可能。"

o.en: Reynard Hannan wants to supply your armed uprising.
o.zh: Reynard Hannan 想给你们这场武装起事供货。

entries.en:
"Orcus Rao. One used to hear that name more often. Why the sudden charity from the forgotten 'hero'?"

She puts on a skeptical expression.

"I'm not quite the looker I was in cycles past, I'll admit, but it seems even more unlikely to me that this unorthodox admiral of the Hegemony has had a sudden crisis of faith."
entries.zh:
"Orcus Rao。这名字早年倒是常听见。这位早被人忘干净的'英雄'，怎么忽然发起善心来了？"

她摆出一副不信的神情。

"我承认，早年那点模样如今是没了，可要说霸主这位不大守规矩的上将忽然动了信教的念头，我瞧着更不大可能。"

o.en: Orcus Rao wants to supply your armed uprising.
o.zh: Orcus Rao 想给你们这场武装起事供货。

o.en: I've come to assist your cause. With, ah, worldly offerings.
o.zh: 我是来助你们成事的。带了点，呃，俗世的东西。

entries.en:
"Me? Oh," her hands come together, "I truly am blessed by providence on this otherwise dark day of days."

She drops the pious expression somewhat abruptly.

"Come now. You'd have to be the worst Diktat spy in the system with that cover story. Who are you and what do you really want?"
entries.zh:
"给我？哎哟，\" 她双手合十，\"偏赶在这般晦暗的日子里，我可真是蒙了天意的福。"

那副虔诚的神色，她收得颇为干脆。

"得了吧。就凭这套说辞，你若真是密探，也是全星系最蹩脚的辛达强权探子。你到底是谁，又究竟想要什么？"

o.en: Reynard Hannan wants to supply your armed uprising.
o.zh: Reynard Hannan 想给你们这场武装起事供货。

She drops the pious expression somewhat abruptly.

"Come now. You'd have to be the worst Diktat spy in the system with that cover story. Who are you and what do you really want?"

o.en: Orcus Rao wants to supply your armed uprising.
o.zh: Orcus Rao 想给你们这场武装起事供货。

o.en: Inesis. I want to discuss Askonia...
o.zh: Inesis。我想谈谈 Askonia 的事...

entries.en:
The comm-link connects immediately. Admiral Orcus Rao sits before you.

He doesn't waste words on greetings.

"Askonia is going hot," he says.
entries.zh:
通讯链路立刻接通。Orcus Rao 上将坐在你面前。

他不多费口舌寒暄。

"Askonia 要打起来了，"他说。

entries.en:
"You may know my brother, Hector," a pause for some laughs, some jeers.

Achilles is hard-faced, raising a hand for silence. A dignified rebuke after the set-up for mockery.

"He is a victim." His hand movement quells all objection. "A puppet controlled by Dolos Macario, my father's disloyal spymaster. You know HIM as the 'Spider of Sindria', and many are the rumors of his degenerate crimes - of torture, kidnapping, and above all treason. Treason against the final will of my father, the Supreme Executor!"
entries.zh:
"你们或许认识我的兄弟，Hector，"他停顿了一下，等着几声笑、几声嘘。

Achilles 板着脸，抬手要众人安静。他先容人起哄，再以不失体面的方式驳回。

"他是个受害者。\"他的手势压下了所有异议。\"一个被 Dolos Macario 操控的傀儡——我父亲那个不忠的间谍头子。你们称他【辛达瑞亚之蛛】，关于他那些堕落的罪行，流言众多——酷刑、绑架，而最要紧的是叛国。背叛我父亲、最高元首最终的遗愿！"

entries.en:
Achilles looks down for a moment, apparently concerned, projecting vulnerability - for a moment.

"Help me free my brother from that beast," he says quietly.

Then he looks up, eyes piercing through the holo. Voice growing stronger, deeper.

"Help me free Askonia."
entries.zh:
Achilles 垂下眼，有那么一瞬显得忧虑，流露出一丝脆弱——只是一瞬。

"帮我把我兄弟从那头野兽手里救出来，"他轻声说。

随即他抬起头，目光穿透全息影像。声音渐强，渐沉。

"帮我解放 Askonia。"

entries.en:
"I am the heir to Andrada!"

Achilles uses the voice of command.

"I will be your Supreme Executor! I ask not for a blind pledge with a gun at your back; only that my loyal citizens of the Sindrian Diktat remember - remember the hope and vision of Philip Andrada when he gave up his life to bring order to chaos. I make that same pledge to you."

"I give my life to bring order from chaos. For you, for Askonia, for the Sindrian Diktat!"
entries.zh:
"我才是 Andrada 的继承人！"

Achilles 拿出了发号施令的嗓音。

"我将成为你们的最高元首！我不要你们在枪口抵着后背时盲目效忠；我只求我忠诚的辛达强权公民记住——记住 Philip Andrada 为从混沌中带来秩序而献出生命时的希望与远见。我向你们立下同样的誓言。"

"我献出我的生命，为从混沌中带来秩序。为了你们，为了 Askonia，为了辛达强权！"

entries.en:
The view pulls back - a warship hangar, lines of fighters and munitions ready to load. A crowd of officers and crew, marines and technicians, cheer.

An unfamiliar banner unfurls behind Achilles - he stands alone before it.

Gens Kato's PR was skillfully restrained, crafting the image of a man who looks ready to fight, surrounded by the weapons of war and the warriors who will die using them.
entries.zh:
镜头拉远——战舰机库，成排的战机与待装的弹药。一群军官与船员、陆战队员与技师在欢呼。

一面陌生的旗帜在 Achilles 身后展开——他独自立在旗前。

Kato 氏族的公关手腕克制而老练，精心塑造出这样一个形象：一个看上去随时准备开战的人，置身于战争的武器与将要持着这些武器赴死的战士之间。

entries.en:
"You may know my brother, Hector," a pause for some laughs, some jeers.

Achilles is hard-faced, raising a hand for silence. A dignified rebuke after the set-up for mockery.

"He is a victim." His hand movement quells all objection.

"A puppet controlled by Dolos Macario, my father's disloyal spymaster. You know HIM as the 'Spider of Sindria', and many are the rumors of his degenerate crimes - of torture, kidnapping, and above all treason. Treason against the final will of my father, the Supreme Executor!"
entries.zh:
"你们或许认识我的兄弟，Hector，"他停顿了一下，等着几声笑、几声嘘。

Achilles 板着脸，抬手要众人安静。他先容人起哄，再以不失体面的方式驳回。

"他是个受害者。"他的手势压下了所有异议。

"一个被 Dolos Macario 操控的傀儡——我父亲那个不忠的间谍头子。你们称他【辛达瑞亚之蛛】，关于他那些堕落的罪行，流言众多——酷刑、绑架，而最要紧的是叛国。背叛我父亲、最高元首最终的遗愿！"

Achilles looks down for a moment, apparently concerned, projecting vulnerability - for a moment.

"Help me free my brother from that beast," he says quietly.

Then he looks up, eyes piercing in the carefully arranged lighting. Voice growing stronger, deeper.

"Help me free Askonia."

Achilles 垂下眼，有那么一瞬显得忧虑，流露出一丝脆弱——只是一瞬。

"帮我把我兄弟从那头野兽手里救出来，"他轻声说。

随即他抬起头，目光在精心布置的灯光里锋利逼人。声音渐强，渐沉。

"帮我解放 Askonia。"

"I shall be your Supreme Executor! I ask not for a blind pledge with a gun at your back; I ask only that my loyal citizens of the Sindrian Diktat remember - remember the hope and vision of Philip Andrada when he gave up his life to bring order to chaos. I make that same pledge to you."

"I give my life to bring order from chaos. For you, for Askonia, for the Sindrian Diktat!"
