"Andrada 的继承人，理应是我！"

Achilles 拿出了发号施令的嗓音。

"我将成为你们的最高元首！我不要你们在枪口抵着后背时盲目效忠；我只求我忠诚的辛达强权公民记住——记住 Philip Andrada 为从混沌中带来秩序而献出生命时的希望与远见。我向你们立下同样的誓言。"

"我献出我的生命，为从混沌中带来秩序。为了你们，为了 Askonia，为了辛达强权！"

entries.en:
The lighting shifts subtly, illuminating the hangar. As if on cue, the crowd cheers.

An unfamiliar banner unfurls behind Achilles - he stands alone before it.

Gens Kato's PR was skillfully restrained, crafting the image of a man who looks ready to fight, surrounded by the weapons of war and the warriors who will die using them.
entries.zh:
灯光悄然变换，照亮机库。人群仿佛接到了信号，齐声欢呼。

一面陌生的旗帜在 Achilles 身后展开——他独自立在旗前。

Kato 氏族的公关手腕克制而老练，精心塑造出这样一个形象：一个看上去随时准备开战的人，置身于战争的武器与将要持着这些武器赴死的战士之间。

entries.en:
"I think you're going to want to see this," they say. "Another signal flagged high interest by the content sweep."

A pause, a concerned look.

"Sindrian Diktat priority override codes, but... loc-tag says it's from the Zagan system?"
entries.zh:
"我想你最好看看这个，\"对方说，\"内容筛查又标出一条高关注度信号。"

一阵沉默，一副担忧的神色。

"辛达强权的优先级覆盖码，可是...定位标签显示它来自 Zagan 星系？"

o.zh: DEV 不作声明直接离开

entries.en: It has begun. A war between clone-brothers over the Sindrian Diktat, over who will become the
entries.zh: 开始了。一场克隆兄弟之间争夺辛达强权的战争，争夺谁将成为...

entries.en:
Your bodyguards clear a path through the excited crowd - now given free license to pop the lids off pressurized drink capsules. You suspect the medics will be busy administering remedies come the end of next shift.

You step back onto your shuttle, already receiving updates from Tactical about massive fleet movements in close orbit.
entries.zh:
你的保镖在兴奋的人群中开出一条路——这些人如今获准随意拧开加压饮料罐的盖子。你估计，到下一班结束时，军医们要忙着分发解酒药了。

你回到穿梭机上，战术部门已经在不断发来近轨道大规模舰队调动的通报。

entries.en:
A lone figure emerges as a shadow into the bright spotlight. Judicious application of muffling fields ensures an awed hush.

Achilles Andrada stands, eyes cast downward, face in shadow for a long moment. You can feel the tension build.
entries.zh:
一个孤身的人影自暗处走入明亮的聚光。消音场开合得恰到好处，压出一片敬畏的静默。

Achilles Andrada 站定，垂着眼睛，面孔在阴影里停留了很久。你能感觉到紧张在积聚。

entries.en:
"My father," he begins. "Was a man who showed many faces. A war hero." The muffling field adjusts to let am uneasy murmur through, then asserts itself to allow the next words. "-And the Hegemony's greatest traitor."

"He was a ruthless man. A genius, and to some, a monster. As great and terrible as a force of nature; the iron hand of history set in motion."

"Above all, he was a visionary."
entries.zh:
"我的父亲，"他开口道，"是个有许多副面孔的人。一位战争英雄。"消音场稍稍放开，让一阵不安的低语透了出来，随即又重新压住，为接下来的话留出空隙。"——也是霸主最大的叛徒。"

"他是个无情的人。一个天才，在某些人眼里则是怪物。如自然之力般伟大而可怖；是历史被启动时的那只铁手。"

"而最重要的，他是个有远见的人。"

entries.en:
Achilles stares out at the crowd, his gaze directed at some elevated point. A practiced pose.

"But in time, surrounded by corrupt and immoral advisors, my father's vision grew dim - and the Sindrian Diktat rotted under those who conspired to deceive my aging father. They hid news of his death while plotting a treasonous coup."
entries.zh:
Achilles 望向人群，目光却落在某处高点上。一个练熟了的姿势。

"但时日一久，在腐败无德的顾问包围之下，我父亲的眼光渐渐暗淡——辛达强权在那些合谋欺瞒我年迈父亲的人手里烂掉了。他们隐瞒他的死讯，同时策划一场谋逆政变。"

entries.en: It has begun. A war between clone-brothers over the Sindrian Diktat, over who will become the
entries.zh: 开始了。一场克隆兄弟之间争夺辛达强权的战争，争夺谁将成为...

entries.en:
"-was a visionary."

Achilles Andrada stares out at you, his gaze appears directed at an elevated point behind you.

"But in time, surrounded by corrupt and immoral advisors, my father's vision grew dim - and the Sindrian Diktat fell under those who conspired to deceive my aging father. They hid news of his death while plotting a treasonous coup."
entries.zh:
"——是个有远见的人。"

Achilles Andrada 凝视着你，可那目光似乎落在你身后某处较高的点上。

"但时日一久，在腐败无德的顾问包围之下，我父亲的眼光渐渐暗淡——辛达强权落入了那些合谋欺瞒我年迈父亲的人手中。他们隐瞒他的死讯，同时策划一场谋逆政变。"

entries.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam." It's your comms officer.
entries.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。"是你的通讯官。

entries.en:
Now, now it is time for Hector to launch his own fleet into orbit of Sindria.

You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power to bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. He can restore your commission; he can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat!
entries.zh:
如今，该让 Hector 把自己的舰队送上 Sindria 轨道了。

你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。他能恢复你的委任；他能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献！

entries.en:
Now it is the time that Hector must launch his own fleet from Sindria to face the usurper, the pretender, Achilles.

You must bring your appeal to the Supreme Executor directly. You must thread the gauntlet of Sindrian naval power without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given Macario's kill-on-sight order. Will Caden hold his ships back? Would Hyder?

Only Hector can restore your commission. Only Hector can recognize your loyalty and devotion to the Sindrian Diktat and make things as they should be.
entries.zh:
现在，Hector 必须把自己的舰队从 Sindria 派出，去迎战那个篡位者、那个僭位者，Achilles。

你必须把你的申诉直接递到最高元首面前。你必须闯过辛达海军设下的层层关卡，又不能被奉了 Macario 格杀令的辛达强权舰队截住。Caden 会让他的舰队按兵不动吗？Hyder 呢？

只有 Hector 能恢复你的委任。只有 Hector 能认可你对辛达强权的忠诚与奉献，让一切回到本该有的样子。

entries.en:
You review a few reports from your senior officers, supply and fuel levels, a bizarre suggestion to switch to a four shift rotation...

"$PlayerSirOrMadam, I have Achilles... Achilles Andrada for you."

Your comms officer.
entries.zh:
你翻看了几份高级军官送来的报告：补给与燃料存量，还有一份建议改行四班轮换制的古怪提案...

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，Achilles... Achilles Andrada 要和你通话。"

是你的通讯官。

entries.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"I am entirely untroubled by your motivation, captain. After all it is likely, though not certain, that he was behind the assassination attempt that Fleet Intelligence is content to call 'a bar fight'."
entries.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"你的动机我毫不介意，舰长。毕竟那场暗杀——舰队情报部乐意称之为'一场酒吧斗殴'——多半是他主使的，虽然还不能确定。"

entries.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"I have no qualms with your motive, captain. After all it is likely, though not certain, that he tried to have me assassinated in what League intelligence is content to call 'a bar fight'. The other possibilities..."
entries.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"你的动机我毫无意见，舰长。毕竟他多半——虽然还不能确定——就是想让人暗杀我，而联盟情报部门乐意把这事称作'一场酒吧斗殴'。其余的可能性..."

entries.en:
"I cannot disagree."

He smiles, though it is a cold smile. "Leadership in Askonia has been rather scarce of late, has it not?"
entries.zh:
"我无法反驳。"

他笑了笑，只是那笑冷得很。"最近 Askonia 的领导人可是相当稀缺，不是吗？"

entries.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"Have no fear that I misconstrue your ultimate loyalty, captain. I've heard that very sentiment often, and clearly."
entries.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"不必担心我会误解你最终的忠诚，舰长。这种话我听得多了，而且听得清清楚楚。"

entries.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"Have no fear that I misconstrue your ultimate loyalty, captain. I've already heard that very sentiment often, and clearly."
entries.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"不必担心我会误解你最终的忠诚，舰长。这种话我已经听得多了，而且听得清清楚楚。"

entries.en:
As he draws breath to speak further some kind of alert sounds. With an annoyed look he presses his cuff and holds it to his ear.

"Understood." Achilles' expression hardens.

His eyes turn to you. "Setting this link to standby."
entries.zh:
他吸了口气，正要继续往下说，某种警报响了。他面露恼色，按下袖口，把它凑到耳边。

"明白。"Achilles 的神情沉了下去。

他的目光转向你。"这条链路转入待机。"

entries.en: "Now," he says. "There is much to see done."
entries.zh: "现在，\"他说。\"还有许多事等着办。"

entries.en:
Achilles closes his eyes for a moment, and after a deep breath, appears to compose himself. It's not unlike raising shields - a rapid change in demeanor, the invocation of a kind of invulnerability, however limited by human flesh.

"We're moving the timeline up," he says, voice in the familiar mode of a commanding officer. "My staff will contact you. An invitation. Will you do this? I ask no oath or pledge, simply your presence at... an important announcement."
entries.zh:
Achilles 闭了闭眼，深吸一口气后，似乎重新稳住了自己。这有点像升起护盾——神态骤变，唤起某种刀枪不入的姿态，尽管血肉之躯终究有限。

"我们把时间表提前了，\"他说，语气已换成指挥官那种熟悉的腔调。\"我的幕僚会联系你。一份邀请。你愿意来吗？我不要誓言，也不要承诺，只要你到场——出席... 一场重要的宣告。"

o.en: You're going to announce your claim, aren't you.
o.zh: 你要公布你的主张了，对吧。

entries.en:
He smiles, a cold smile.

"Trust that I have no intention of becoming that, captain."
entries.zh:
他露出一个冷笑。

"请相信，我没有变成那种人的打算，舰长。"

entries.en:
"Trust that I have no intention of becoming that, captain."

He smiles, a cold smile.

"Strange, though, this behaviour... from a client of Fortuna Kato. Or do you call it a partnership?"
entries.zh:
"请相信，我没有变成那种人的打算，舰长。"

他露出一个冷笑。

"不过真奇怪，这种做派... 竟出自 Fortuna Kato 的一个门客。还是说，你们管这叫合伙？"

entries.en:
"You made a wager, captain, and I presume you accept the risk that entails."

He smiles, a cold smile.

"I'll see that you win, however. Though not for the sake of your accounts."
entries.zh:
"你下了注，舰长，我猜你也接受随之而来的风险。"

他露出一个冷笑。

"不过，我会让你赢的。虽然不是为了你的账本。"

entries.en: "Then we have nothing more to talk about," he says conclusively, then reaches over and presses the comms cut-off.
entries.zh: "那我们就没有什么可谈的了，"他以定论的口吻说，随后伸手按下了通讯切断键。

entries.en:
"Too bad," he says. "As we have nothing more to discuss, I will consider the conversation concluded."

Without another word he reaches over and presses the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
"太遗憾了，\"他说。\"既然我们再没有什么可谈的，我就此认为谈话结束。"

他一言不发，伸手按下了通讯切断键。

entries.en:
"This was anticipated," he says, then gives you an inquisitive look.

"But why are you here, now, telling me this?"
entries.zh:
"这在我预料之中，"他说，随后探询地看了你一眼。

"可你为什么现在跑来，把这件事告诉我？"

o.en: To warn you. I want you to win despite Reynard.
o.zh: 来提醒你。我希望你赢，哪怕 Reynard 插手也一样。

o.en: Because it would be dishonorable to deceive you.
Because I don't like being manipulated.
o.zh: 因为我不喜欢被人摆布。

entries.en: "Good," he says like your position is both obvious and unquestionably correct.
entries.zh: "很好，"他说，那口气仿佛你的立场既显而易见，又无可置疑地正确。

entries.en: "I respect your candor," he says. "And I must ask the question: do I have your support?"
entries.zh: "我敬重你的坦率，\"他说。\"而且我必须问一句：我是否得到了你的支持？"

entries.en:
"It is strange, $playerName, to taunt me to my face after so much effort. It is a waste. And for what?"

He, for one, sounds unamused. His expression clears and is replaced by something stoic, hardened over many cycles.

"You are no use to me. Do not interfere."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"$playerName，费了这么多功夫之后当面嘲弄我，真是奇怪。这是浪费。究竟图什么？"

至少他听起来毫无笑意。他脸上的神情一扫而空，换成了某种坚忍的东西——历经许多星历年磨出来的硬。

"你对我没有用处。别来碍事。"

通讯中断。

entries.en:
"An understandable position," he says calmly. "Your choice must be your own."

"I must ask the question, $titlePL: do I have your support?"
entries.zh:
"可以理解，\"他平静地说。\"你的选择必须由你自己作。"

"我必须问一句，$titlePL：我是否得到了你的支持？"

entries.en:
"Fortuna. Of course."

Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome, and I am not ungrateful."
entries.zh:
"Fortuna。当然。"

Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎，我不是不知感恩的人。"

entries.en:
"Fortuna. Of course." Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome, whatever its motive, and I am not ungrateful."
entries.zh:
"Fortuna。当然。"Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。不论你出于什么动机，你的支持我都欢迎，我也并非不知感恩。"

entries.en:
He nods, as if this was expected.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition." Achilles almost smiles. "Your support is welcome; I am not ungrateful."
entries.zh:
他点了点头，仿佛一切都在意料之中。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。\"Achilles 几乎笑了。\"你的支持我欢迎；我不是不知感恩的人。"

entries.en:
"Agent Siyavong." Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. Your support is welcome; I am not ungrateful."
entries.zh:
"Siyavong 特工。"Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。你的支持我欢迎；我不是不知感恩的人。"

entries.en:
"The work of Agent Siyavong, no doubt." Achilles almost smiles, focusing his eyes elsewhere, then back to you.

"This is becoming quite the motley coalition. But your support is welcome, whatever the means by which it was obtained; I am not ungrateful."
entries.zh:
"这无疑是 Siyavong 特工的手笔。"Achilles 几乎笑了，目光先飘向别处，又回到你身上。

"这个联盟真是越来越杂了。不过，不论你用什么手段换来的，你的支持我都欢迎；我并非不知感恩。"

entries.en:
He nods, as if this was expected. He doesn't look pleased, however, and understandably.

"I can only assume this is more bedamned Gens politicking," he says. "It has the smell of Reynard Hannan about it."
entries.zh:
他点了点头，仿佛一切都在意料之中。不过他看上去并不高兴——这也难怪。

"我只能认为，这又是那些该死的氏族政治，\"他说。\"这味道一闻就是 Reynard Hannan 的手笔。"

o.en: I tell you this because it would be dishonorable to deceive you.
o.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为欺骗你有失荣誉。

o.en: I tell you this because I don't like being manipulated.
o.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为我不喜欢被人摆布。

entries.en: "A public demonstration of support, even if it is given no true substance, is nonetheless useful."
entries.zh: "公开表态支持，哪怕没有半点实质内容，也依然有用。"

entries.en: "I respect your candor, if not your choice of master," he says.
entries.zh: "我敬重你的坦率，虽然不敬重你选的主子，"他说。

entries.en: "Then I may say with confidence that we share that much," he says, though his voice is not warm.
entries.zh: "那么我可以有把握地说，至少在这一点上我们是一致的，"他说，只是语气并不热络。

entries.en:
He nods, as if this was expected. He doesn't look pleased, however, and understandably.

"I can only assume this is more bedamned Gens politicking," he says. "It has the smell of Reynard Hannan about it."
entries.zh:
他点了点头，仿佛一切都在意料之中。不过他看上去并不高兴——这也难怪。

"我只能认为，这又是那些该死的氏族政治，\"他说。\"这味道一闻就是 Reynard Hannan 的手笔。"

o.en: No, actually I am working with Horus Yaribay.
o.zh: 不，其实我是在和 Horus Yaribay 合作。

entries.en:
Achilles is taken aback.

"Unexpected. I always considered Horus Yaribay to be a tr-" He catches himself.

"An uncertain leader. With unconventional beliefs, given his position."
entries.zh:
Achilles 一怔。

"出乎意料。我一直以为 Horus Yaribay 是个叛——"他及时收住了。

"一个靠不住的领袖。以他的位置而言，信念未免太不合常规。"

o.en: I tell you this because it would be dishonorable to deceive you.
o.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为欺骗你有失荣誉。

o.en: I tell you this because I don't like being manipulated.
o.zh: 我告诉你这些，是因为我不喜欢被人摆布。

entries.en:
He appears before you, posture rigid, uniform perfectly ordered.

Achilles acknowledges you with a look, content to wait for you to speak first.
entries.zh:
他出现在你面前，身姿笔挺，制服一丝不苟。

Achilles 以目光示意，乐意等你先开口。

entries.en:
He appears before you, wearing his new uniform.

Achilles acknowledges you with a look, content to wait for you to speak first.
entries.zh:
他出现在你面前，穿着他那身新制服。

Achilles 以目光示意，乐意等你先开口。

entries.en:
"Of course." He doesn't quite smile.

"My logistics team noted that the black market prices were unusually generous. My new shadowy 'benefactor' might make enemies of the usual con-artists if they aren't careful."
entries.zh:
"当然。"他算不上笑了。

"我的后勤组注意到，黑市上的价格优惠得反常。我那位新来的、神出鬼没的'恩主'，要是不小心，恐怕会把那些惯常坑蒙拐骗的家伙都得罪光。"

entries.en:
He blinks, slowly. Expressionless.

Saying nothing for several moments more. As if to drive the point home that he does not owe you an explanation or even a reaction.

"Captain," he says finally.
entries.zh:
他缓缓眨了眨眼。面无表情。

又是好一会儿一言不发。仿佛要把这一点钉实：他不欠你任何解释，甚至连一个反应都不欠。

"舰长，"他终于开口。

o.en: I've secured a line of support for you from... an agent on Achaman Station.
o.zh: 我已经为你打通了一条支援渠道，来自... Achaman 空间站的一名特工。

entries.en: "Yes, we've had unusually sophisticated materiel coming in. Good Tri-Tachyon tech. Unlocked, it seems, by an insider. The kind of kit that usually comes from lucky convoy-raiding."
entries.zh: "是的，最近进来的物资精密得反常。上好的速子科技货。看来是有内鬼解锁的。这种装备，通常只有运气极好地劫下一支运输队才弄得到。"

o.en: The way I see it, if I can be rich, you can be Supreme Executor.
o.zh: 在我看来，只要我能发财，你就能当上最高元首。

o.en: Remember, I'm doing this for the Persean League.
o.zh: 记住，我做这些是为了英仙座联盟。

o.en: I do think you'll be the best for Askonia.
o.zh: 我确实认为，对 Askonia 来说，你才是最好的选择。

o.en: You must not become a client, a puppet, of Fortuna Kato.
o.zh: 你绝不能变成 Fortuna Kato 的门客、她的傀儡。

o.en: I want to ensure Macario is removed. I assume you're agreed?
o.zh: 我要确保 Macario 被除掉。我想你对此没有异议？

o.en: I'm only doing this so I can see Macario dead.
o.zh: 我这么做，只是为了亲眼看到 Macario 死。

entries.en:
He nods, satisfied and even amused.

"It is welcome," he says. "I admit, my staff - yes, I have a staff now - was a little surprised when your partner first made contact."
entries.zh:
他点了点头，颇为满意，甚至有些觉得好笑。

"这很受欢迎，\"他说。\"我承认，我的幕僚——没错，我现在也有幕僚了——在你那位伙伴初次接触时，还有点吃惊。"

entries.en:
"It is useful to diversify sources of material support. I expect you appreciate the implications, captain."

He nods toward you. "I do."
entries.zh:
"物资来源多样化，总是有用的。我想你明白这意味着什么，舰长。"

他朝你点了点头。"我明白。"

entries.en:
"You'll know shortly." His words are clipped. "Talk after."

The comms cut to a holding pattern.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." You hear the voice of your comms officer.

They do not, as a rule, use priority override to interrupt your comms.
entries.zh:
"你很快就知道了。\"他的话音短促。\"之后再谈。"

通讯转入保持状态。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。"你听见通讯官的声音。

按规矩，他们不会用优先权限打断你的通讯。

entries.en: "Holofeed rebroadcast from Sindria- priority signal. Content sweep flagged critical high interest."
entries.zh: "由 Sindria 转发的全息推送——优先信号。内容筛查标记为最高关注级别。"

entries.en:
He blinks, expressionless.

Saying nothing for several moments more. As if to drive the point home that he does not owe you an explanation or even a reaction.

"Captain," he says finally. "You did not come here to whine, I hope."
entries.zh:
他眨了眨眼，面无表情。

又是好一会儿一言不发。仿佛要把这一点钉实：他不欠你任何解释，甚至连一个反应都不欠。

"舰长，\"他终于开口。\"我希望你不是来这儿诉苦的。"

entries.en:
Horacio Caden appears on the holo.

Sweating, distraught. His eyebrows twitching.

Dolos Macario flanks him, face blank and still. To Caden's right there is space for another. Heavy banners bearing Sindrian Diktat crest and color fall behind them in velvet waves.

Caden is speaking.
entries.zh:
Horacio Caden 出现在全息影像中。

满头大汗，心神大乱。眉毛不住抽动。

Dolos Macario 立在他侧后，面无表情，静止不动。Caden 右手边空着一个位置。缀着辛达强权徽记与色彩的厚重旗帜在他们身后如天鹅绒的波纹般层层垂落。

Caden 正在讲话。

entries.en:
"-to announce that our beloved Supreme Executor," his voice catches for a moment. He proceeds. "Supreme Executor Philip Andrada, the Lion of Sindria, conqueror of Askonia, philosopher... teacher... died early this morning. He-"

You can almost picture it in your mind.
entries.zh:
"...宣布我们敬爱的最高元首，\"他的声音哽了一下，随即继续，\"最高元首 Philip Andrada，辛达瑞亚之狮，Askonia 的征服者，哲人...导师...已于今日凌晨逝世。他——"

你几乎能在脑中勾出那幅画面。

entries.en:
* * *

The man would have brought a squad of marines, a special unit attached to the Ministry of Internal Security for "wet work".

Loyal. Compromised. And two, perhaps three, senior officers of INTSEC in full uniform. To project authority.

There'd have been signs of violence. Perhaps a streak of blood where a body was pulled away. Inconvenient witnesses or principled objectors, purged.

If they had passed any bond-workers, those would have gaped shamelessly. Their guards would have known to salute.
entries.zh:
* * *

那人会带上一队陆战队——一支隶属于内部安全部、专门干"脏活"的特种小队。

忠诚。各有把柄。还有两三名 INTSEC 高级军官，全套制服在身，用以彰显权威。

现场本该留下暴力的痕迹。也许还有一道拖走尸体时蹭出的血迹。碍事的目击者，或是讲原则的反对者，都被清除了。

要是他们路上遇到什么契约工，那些人准会毫不掩饰地张大嘴看。看守他们的工头自然也懂得敬礼。

entries.en:
The lead officer would have halted at a biometric scanner, taking a moment to input unlock authorization. The armored doors would have opened, the movement of their enormous mass like the weight of a passing age.

That officer's white hair and long black coat gave him a priestly silhouette.

The party proceeded into a bunker deep, deep within Sindria.
entries.zh:
领头的军官会在生物识别扫描仪前停下，花片刻输入解锁授权。装甲大门随之开启，那巨大门扇的移动，沉重得仿佛一个正在逝去的时代从身边碾过。

那名军官白发、黑色长外套，勾勒出一副祭司般的剪影。

一行人向 Sindria 深处、极深处的掩体行去。

entries.en:
Beyond tiers of heavy blast doors lay a luxurious receiving room. A handful of offices and a suite - grand, yet hunkered somehow under the weight of armor and miles of rock.

The party entered an antiseptic inner chamber.

A giant coffin-like vessel lay flat. An off-white sarcophagus of ceramic and intricate technology, a golden winged crest. Within lay a corpse-like figure, its body invaded by bundles of tubing and wires leading to ranks of medical machines attending their master like boxy, robotic courtiers.

A wretched echo of Leonidas' cradle in far-off Irkalla.
entries.zh:
层层厚重的防爆门之后，是一间奢华的会客厅。几间办公室和一套居所——气派非凡，却又像是被装甲与数英里岩层的重量压得伏低了身子。

一行人走进一间洁净得近乎无菌的内室。

一具巨大的棺状容器平放着。那是陶瓷与精密技术打造的灰白色石棺，镶着一枚金色翼形纹章。棺内躺着一个形如尸体的身影，躯体被成束的管线侵入，管线连向一排排医疗机器——那些方头方脑的机器如同机械廷臣，侍奉着自己的主人。

遥远 Irkalla 那具 Leonidas 的摇篮，在此处落下一个凄凉的余响。

entries.en:
The neurological monitors would have shown 100% brain death, and must have for a long time.

Nanoscale filaments inserted into the brainstem compel a facsimile of life from the decaying nervous system.

A hand gloved in black reached toward the master switch. When it closed upon the power to end life, it did not hesitate.

The white noise died to half its former volume. Just ventilation and the creak of black armor as the INTSEC marines shifted their weight, unsure of protocol.
entries.zh:
神经监测仪上显示的该是百分之百的脑死亡，而且必定已持续很久。

插入脑干的纳米级细丝，强迫那具衰败的神经系统挤出一丝生命的假象。

一只戴着黑手套的手伸向总控开关。当它握住那终结生命的权力时，没有半分迟疑。

白噪音的音量降到原先的一半。只剩通风的声响，以及 INTSEC 陆战队员挪动重心时黑色装甲的吱嘎声——他们拿不准该按什么规矩行事。

entries.en:
The body of Philip Andrada, Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat, Lion of Sindria, must have finally died under remorseless eyes.

* * *

Caden's next words were forgettable. He's unsteady and red-faced. In his drink, no doubt.

"My father," Hector has taken the podium; young, powerful, and confident, "was a great man."

His expression is brash. As he speaks, he sends challenging looks to each side, staring down imagined rivals.
entries.zh:
辛达强权最高元首、辛达瑞亚之狮 Philip Andrada 的躯体，想必终于在那双毫无怜悯的眼睛下死去了。

* * *

Caden 接下来的话没什么值得记的。他站得不稳，满脸通红。多半是喝多了。

"我的父亲，\"Hector 已走上讲台；年轻、强壮、自信，\"是一位伟人。"

他神情张扬。说话时，他朝两侧各投去挑衅的目光，像是在逼视想象出来的对手。

entries.en:
Caden is staring at his feet. Nothing is as he hoped.

Macario is the very image of poise.

"As Supreme Executor, the last of Philip's blood, pledge yourself to me! Pledge yourself as I pledge to carry on His traditions; His people, His work, His philosophy, His grand project - the Sindrian Diktat!"

Cheers erupt, pounding of fists and feet.

The display switches to a long shot - rank upon rank of officers, soldiers, navy, citizens; new subjects of the new age hail their Supreme Executor.
entries.zh:
Caden 盯着自己的脚。一切都不如他所愿。

Macario 则是镇定的化身。

"身为最高元首、Philip 最后的血脉，向我宣誓效忠！向我宣誓，正如我宣誓继承他的传统、他的人民、他的事业、他的理念、他的宏图——辛达强权！"

欢呼声爆发，拳与脚砰砰地砸着。

画面切到远景——一列列军官、士兵、海军、市民；新时代的新子民在向他们的最高元首致敬。

entries.en:
They chant three syllables with the voice of one. AN-DRA-DA. Again and again and again.

Hector Andrada, Supreme Executor, raises his arms - illuminated in a pillar of light, he is as an avatar of the gods brought to Sindria.

You flick a control surface and the image dies away.
entries.zh:
他们齐声高呼三个音节。AN-DRA-DA。一遍，又一遍，再一遍。

最高元首 Hector Andrada 举起双臂——他沐浴在一道光柱之中，宛如被迎至 Sindria 的神明化身。

你拨了一下控制面板，影像熄灭了。

entries.en:
They chant three syllables with the voice of one. AN-DRA-DA. Again and again and again.

Hector Andrada, Supreme Executor, raises his arms - illuminated in a pillar of light, he is as an avatar of the gods brought to Sindria.

You catch your breath, returning to the moment, and press a control surface.

The image slowly fades away.
entries.zh:
他们齐声高呼三个音节。AN-DRA-DA。一遍，又一遍，再一遍。

最高元首 Hector Andrada 举起双臂——他沐浴在一道光柱之中，宛如被迎至 Sindria 的神明化身。

你缓过一口气，回到当下，按下一块控制面板。

影像缓缓淡去。

entries.en:
Achilles re-appears.

There's more color in his face than you've seen before, and he's breathing heavily - but steadily. Controlled.

This might be what passes for anger, even rage, in him.
entries.zh:
Achilles 再次出现在通讯画面中。

他脸上涨起的血色比你以往见过的都浓，呼吸粗重——但很平稳。克制住了。

在他身上，这大概就算是愤怒，甚至是暴怒了。

entries.en: He nods, barely acknowledging your words.
entries.zh: 他点了点头，几乎没对你的话作出回应。

entries.en: He nods, either too distracted or not caring to acknowledge any hint of falsehood.
entries.zh: 他点了点头——要么是太分心，要么是根本不屑于去察觉你话里的虚假。

entries.en:
Achilles closes his eyes for a moment, and after a deep breath, appears to compose himself. It's not unlike raising shields - a rapid change in demeanor, the invocation of a kind of invulnerability, however limited by human flesh.

"We're moving the timeline up," he says, voice in the familiar mode of a commanding officer giving rapid orders. "My staff shall contact you. An invitation."

A pause, and he adjusts his tone, remembering that he ought to be polite in a moment in which he does not exactly outrank you. Yet.

"I would... invite you to attend."
entries.zh:
Achilles 闭了闭眼，深吸一口气后，似乎重新稳住了自己。这有点像升起护盾——神态骤变，唤起某种刀枪不入的姿态，尽管血肉之躯终究有限。

"我们把时间表提前了，\"他说，语气是指挥官下达急令时那种熟悉的腔调。\"我的幕僚会联系你。一份邀请。"

一顿。他调整了语气，想起此刻自己其实并不比你高一级——暂时还不。

"我... 想邀请你出席。"

o.en: You're going to announce your claim, aren't you.
o.zh: 你要公布你的主张了，对吧。

entries.en:
Achilles closes his eyes for a moment, and after a deep breath, appears to compose himself. It's not unlike raising shields - a rapid change in demeanor, the invocation of a kind of invulnerability, however limited by human flesh.

"We're moving the timeline up," he says, voice in the familiar mode of a commanding officer. "My staff will contact you. An invitation. I would... invite you to attend."

"I ask no oath, no pledge. Only your presence."
entries.zh:
Achilles 闭了闭眼，深吸一口气后，似乎重新稳住了自己。这有点像升起护盾——神态骤变，唤起某种刀枪不入的姿态，尽管血肉之躯终究有限。

"我们把时间表提前了，\"他说，语气是指挥官那种熟悉的腔调。\"我的幕僚会联系你。一份邀请。我... 想邀请你出席。"

"我不要誓言，也不要承诺。只要你人到场。"

o.en: You're going to announce your claim, aren't you.
o.zh: 你要公布你的主张了，对吧。

entries.en:
He produces a brief and joyless smirk, then you can see his eyes and his attention shifting elsewhere.

"I have much to do," he says, and reaches for his interface.

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
他扯出一个短促、毫无喜色的笑，随后你眼看着他的目光与注意力转向了别处。

"我还有很多事要办，"他说着，伸手去按他的界面。

通讯中断。

entries.en:
You cut the comms.

True to his word, an invitation arrives shortly thereafter. A ceremony - unspecified - is to be held on a warship held in a Gens Kato-owned spacedock.

Quite soon.

They must have been waiting, and ready. The Gens Kato strategists allowed Hector to make the first move - and had contingencies prepared for whatever form it took.
entries.zh:
你切断了通讯。

他说到做到，邀请很快就到了。一场仪式——细节未明——将在一艘停泊于 Kato 氏族名下太空船坞的战舰上举行。

就在不久之后。

他们一定早有准备，一直在等。Kato 氏族的谋士们任由 Hector 先动手——并为他可能采取的任何形式都备好了后手。

entries.en:
Some hours later, you (and your bodyguards) step off your shuttle wearing your finest uniforms.

An attendant in Gens Kato livery meets you, reading instructions off a datapad.

"Um, $titlePL $PlayerName? $PlayerSirOrMadam. Yes, you and your, uh, party; if you could please come with me?"
entries.zh:
几个小时后，你 (带着你的保镖) 走下穿梭机，穿着你最体面的制服。

一名穿着 Kato 氏族服饰的侍从迎上来，一边从数据板上读着指示。

"呃，$titlePL $PlayerName？$PlayerSirOrMadam。对，就是你和你的，呃，随行人员；请跟我来好吗？"

entries.en:
You follow the attendant to the spacedock, then through a luxuriously spacious access bridge into a large hangar within a warship.

Lines of fighters and munitions ready to be loaded dominate a crowd of officers and crew, marines and technicians. More are streaming in by the minute, led to their positions by flustered attendants.

Most are wearing uniforms - an odd design to your eyes, as if the ghost army of some long-lost battlegroup appeared out of deep space. Looking closer, you see something of the utilitarian League Armada fit done up with tyrian trim on off-white field with gold touches.
entries.zh:
你跟着侍从走向太空港，穿过一条宽敞得近乎奢华的连接廊桥，进入一艘战舰内的大机库。

成排待装的战机与弹药横在眼前，抢尽了一群军官、船员、陆战队员与技师的风头。每一分钟都有更多人涌进来，被手忙脚乱的侍从领到各自的位置。

大多数人穿着制服——在你眼里式样古怪，仿佛某支早已湮没的战斗群的幽灵大军从深空里冒了出来。再细看，你辨认出几分联盟舰队那种实用主义的剪裁，只是配上了泰尔紫的镶边，米白的底子上缀着金色点缀。

entries.en:
You're led to a section of VIPs and their associates - dominated by Gens Kato, but with many notable client gens. Businessfolk of many worlds, glowering mercenaries, and a proud but more humbly dressed group set along the corridors with the best access from softly buzzing camera drones - refugees of Askonia, primarily Opis.

A bold association.

You are feted with drinks and snacks, the attention of VIPs, and the lingering look of more than a few media drones. The chatter grows to a respectable din. Speculation directed toward an empty stage at one end of the hangar.

The lights dim, and the chatter subsides.
entries.zh:
你被领到贵宾及其随从的区域——Kato 氏族的人占了多数，但也有不少显赫的附庸氏族。来自多个世界的商人、面色阴沉的雇佣兵，还有一群神情骄傲却衣着朴素的人，站在位置最好、能让嗡鸣的摄像无人机顺畅取景的廊道边——他们是 Askonia 的难民，多数来自 Opis。

这一手相当大胆。

酒水点心款待着你，贵宾们围着你说话，还有不止一架媒体无人机久久地打量你。交谈声渐渐汇成一片体面的喧响。种种猜测都指向机库尽头那座空着的舞台。

灯光暗下，喧响平息。

entries.en:
You close the invitation, preferring to keep your association just a little more covert.

It's a clever move, trying to have you attend the ceremony. Without saying a word it would create an image of your full support as a subordinate to Achilles Andrada. It would grant him your legitimacy - or, failing that, at least an appearance of commanding your potency.
entries.zh:
你关掉了邀请，宁可让你与他的关联再隐蔽一些。

这步棋很聪明：让你出席仪式，不必说一个字，就能造出你完全支持 Achilles Andrada、且甘居其下的形象。这会让他借到你的正统性——即便不成，至少也显得他能号令你这份力量。

entries.en:
The image of Hyder reforms.

She looks as if her bridge's agrav has been tuned too high.
entries.zh:
Hyder 的影像重新成形。

她看上去，像是舰桥的人工重力被调得太高了。

entries.en: "It's happening," she says distantly.
entries.zh: "开始了，"她声音飘忽地说。

entries.en: "He was just like-" Hyder shakes her head. "The files. The truth is undeniable."
entries.zh: "他简直就像——\"Hyder 摇摇头。\"那些文件。真相无可辩驳。"

entries.en: "So now a 'son' of Andrada appears. With Macario's enthusiastic backing." A sniff, then, "Caden's evidently less so."
entries.zh: "于是，Andrada 的一个'儿子'登场了。带着 Macario 满腔热情的支持。\"她哼了一声，\"Caden 显然就没那么热情了。"

o.en: I recovered files on the seven sons of Philip Andrada... (explain)
o.zh: 我找回了关于 Philip Andrada 七个儿子的文件... (解释)

o.en: Have you considered what you're going to do now? Time is short.
o.zh: 你想过接下来要怎么做吗？时间不多了。

entries.en:
"Captain, I've only just watched this... clone announces himself as Supreme Executor. This is..."

Hyder trails off. Eyes searching.
entries.zh:
"舰长，我刚看着这个...克隆体自称最高元首。这简直..."

Hyder 没有说下去。目光游移，像是在搜寻什么。

entries.en: He's consolidating power. You must be ready.
entries.zh: 他在收拢权力。你必须做好准备。

entries.en: A small icon slowly pulses. The link with Achilles Andrada.
entries.zh: 一个小图标缓缓跳动。是与 Achilles Andrada 的通讯。

o.zh: 重新接通与 Achilles 的通讯

entries.en: The link with Horus Yaribay re-opens. He looks pale.
entries.zh: 与 Horus Yaribay 的通讯重新接通。他脸色苍白。

entries.en: A small icon slowly pulses. The link with Hyder.
entries.zh: 一个小图标缓缓跳动。是与 Hyder 的通讯。

o.zh: 重新接通与 Hyder 的通讯

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam." It's your comms officer.

"The automatic content sweep flagged a critical high interest item on local network... an announcement from Sindria."

Comms forwards a link to your command station.

High-priority holofeed. The closest thing to a live broadcast possible, quite expensive.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam。"是你的通讯军官。

"自动内容筛选在本地网络上标出了一条极高关注项...是 Sindria 发来的宣告。"

通讯军官把一个链接转发到你的指挥台。

高优先级全息信号。这已是所能做到的最接近现场直播的形式，造价不菲。

o.en: I need your help with the situation brewing in the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 辛达强权那边的事正在发酵，我需要你帮忙。

entries.en: The next step: go to Yesod to tell Achilles about the logistics operation you've arranged via Arroyo.
entries.zh: 下一步：前往 Yesod，把你在 Arroyo 那里安排好的后勤行动告知 Achilles。

entries.en:
Now you need to get yourself to Yesod and inform Achilles about Arroyo's supply operation.

This should help him secure an independent power base from Gens Kato. Perhaps it is not sufficient alone, but every little bit helps.
entries.zh:
现在你得亲自去一趟 Yesod，把 Arroyo 的补给行动告知 Achilles。

这应当能帮他从 Kato 氏族手里挣出一块独立的权力根基。也许单凭这一点还不够，但积少成多。

entries.en:
Now you need to get word to Hector that you've secured an additional line of support to tip the scales in his favor.

Surely he'll recognize that you've proven your loyalty in spite of Macario's lies.
entries.zh:
现在你得把消息送到 Hector 那里：你又为他拉到了一路支援，足以让天平向他倾斜。

他总该认账：哪怕 Macario 满口谎话，你的忠诚已经得到了证明。

o.en: But how? You're shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 可怎么做？辛达强权一见你就开火。

entries.en:
Now you need to get word to the Sindrian Diktat that you've secured an additional line of support for the rightful heir, Hector Andrada, which should help tip the scales in his favor. Every little bit helps, after all.

Surely they'll recognize that you've proven your loyalty in spite of Macario's gross misstep.
entries.zh:
现在你得把消息递给辛达强权：你为合法继承人 Hector Andrada 又拉到一路支援，足以让天平向他倾斜。毕竟积少成多。

他们总该认账：哪怕 Macario 犯下大错，你的忠诚已经得到了证明。

entries.en: Hector Andrada is key. His will alone will determine the future of the Sindrian Diktat, whatever Macario thinks.
entries.zh: 关键在于 Hector Andrada。不管 Macario 怎么想，辛达强权的未来只系于他一个人的意志。

o.en: But how? You're shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 可怎么做？辛达强权一见你就开火。

entries.en: Dolos Macario is key. His manipulations will determine the future of the Sindrian Diktat, whatever Hector thinks.
entries.zh: 关键在于 Dolos Macario。不管 Hector 怎么想，辛达强权的未来都系于他的手腕。

o.en: But how? You're shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 可怎么做？辛达强权一见你就开火。

entries.en:
Next step: get word to Dolos Macario that you've secured an additional line of support for the 'rightful' heir, Hector Andrada, which should help tip the scales in his favor. Every little bit helps.

He'll be forced to recognize your value in spite of his gross misstep.
entries.zh:
下一步：把消息递给 Dolos Macario——你为那位'合法'继承人 Hector Andrada 又拉到一路支援，足以让天平向他倾斜。积少成多嘛。

哪怕他犯下大错，也由不得他不认你的价值。

o.en: But how? You're shoot-on-sight to the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 可怎么做？辛达强权一见你就开火。

entries.en:
One means comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network.

It's a long shot, but even with a common snoop hack you might be able to find a link for Hector's alias - or for someone who knows where he might be found.

Decisive action is exactly how Andrada won Askonia - you need but follow his example.
entries.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻捷隐蔽的舰队可以潜进去，黑进中继，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。

希望不大，但哪怕只用寻常的窥探手段，也许就能找到通往 Hector 化名的链路——或是找到一个知道他下落的人。

Andrada 当年正是靠果断的行动赢下了 Askonia——你只需照他的样子做。

entries.en:
One means comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system.

A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and give him one last chance to correct himself before you show him the true meaning of power.
entries.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。

一支轻捷隐蔽的舰队可以潜进去，黑进中继，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说清他犯下的错误，给他最后一次改正的机会——在那之后，就让他见识见识权力的真正含义。

o.en: It must be done. Macario must be shown the error of his ways
o.zh: 必须这么做。必须让 Macario 看清他错在哪里

entries.en:
One means comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system.

A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and set everything right.
entries.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。

一支轻捷隐蔽的舰队可以潜进去，黑进中继，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说清他犯下的错误，把一切拨回正轨。

entries.en:
There's some time now, while the inevitable conflict lays quiet. Time to move additional supplies to the rebels, make more contacts, and refit your own fleet...

You take a moment to have your comms officer set up wide-band content monitors so you will be alerted when events of interest occur in the Askonia system.
entries.zh:
眼下还有一段时间，那场迟早要来的冲突暂且沉寂。正好把更多补给送给叛军，多结几路人脉，再把自己的舰队整备一番...

你抽空让通讯军官架起全频段内容监听，Askonia 星系里一有值得注意的动静，你就能收到警报。

entries.en: The hum and clatter of the bar fades as the main holo-projector's image grows and transitions through a blurry leap in scale, then focuses back to sharpness, as the bartender fiddles with the controls.
entries.zh: 酒吧里的嗡鸣与杯盘碰撞声渐渐低下去。酒保拨弄着控制钮，主全息投影的画面随之放大，经过一次模糊的尺度跃变，重新聚焦、恢复清晰。

entries.en:
A narrator, voice insistently dull, has been speaking the whole time, "-accompanied by this statement from the Chief High Inspector-General..."

A quick cut to a face you know all too well.
entries.zh:
一个解说员的画外音始终没停，语调刻意平板："——并附上首席总监察长的这份声明..."

快切到一张你熟悉得不能再熟悉的脸。

entries.en:
A Hegemony MIS narrator, voice insistently dull, has been speaking the whole time, "-accompanied by this statement from the Sindrian Mutiny's chief spy..."

A quick cut to a face you know all too well.
entries.zh:
霸主 MIS 的解说员一直在说，语调刻意平板："——并附上辛达叛乱当局头号间谍的这份声明..."

快切到一张你熟悉得不能再熟悉的脸。

entries.en:
Dolos Macario displays sadness, concern, and just the right touch of righteous anger.

"My fellow, loyal, citizens of the Sindrian Diktat. I address not only you but all right-thinking people of the Persean Sector. All who uphold law and order in troubled times."
entries.zh:
Dolos Macario 脸上显出悲伤、忧虑，以及恰到好处的一丝义愤。

"辛达强权忠诚的同胞们。我不只是在向你们说话，也是在向英仙座星域所有明事理的人说话。向所有在乱世中维护法律与秩序的人说话。"

entries.en:
Dolos Macario displays sadness, deep concern, and a careful touch of righteous anger.

"My fellow, loyal, citizens of the Sindrian Diktat. I address not only you but all right-thinking people of the Persean Sector. All who uphold law and order in troubled times."

(Some off-duty Hegemony officers at the end of the bar boo and jeer. Several spacers join in.)
entries.zh:
Dolos Macario 脸上显出悲伤、深切的忧虑，以及一丝拿捏得当的义愤。

"辛达强权忠诚的同胞们。我不只是在向你们说话，也是在向英仙座星域所有明事理的人说话。向所有在乱世中维护法律与秩序的人说话。"

(酒吧尽头几名休班的霸主军官发出嘘声与嘲骂。几个太空人也跟着起哄。)

entries.en:
"I have provided evidence of a disturbing conspiracy which threatens everything we hold dear." He holds for a moment.

"Until now our dear leader, Supreme Executor Philip Andrada, has kept his progeny secret - entrusted to caretakers for protection and to provide a traditional upbringing far from the corrupting influence of celebrity and wealth. Given an honest start to life, as any father would wish for his sons, for these many past cycles."

"Until recently," his voice finally cracks, "they were safe."

He closes his eyes and takes a shuddering breath, appearing to suppress a sob.
entries.zh:
"我已提交证据，证明一场令人不安的阴谋正在威胁我们所珍视的一切。"他停顿了一瞬。

"直到今天，我们敬爱的领袖、最高元首 Philip Andrada 一直将自己的子嗣藏在暗处——托付给看护人抚养，既为保护他们，也为了让他们在远离名声与财富腐蚀的地方接受传统的教养。让他们有一个诚实的起点，正如任何一位父亲对自己儿子的期望，这么多星历年都是如此。"

"直到不久之前，\"他的声音终于裂了，\"他们都是安全的。"

他闭上眼，吸了一口气，肩膀发颤，像是在压住一声呜咽。

entries.en:
He appears to regain his composure.

"A mad spacer has made it $playerHisOrHer personal mission to... to murder the innocent children of Philip Andrada. The heirs to his project, his very bloodline!"

Macario looks up now, into the holosensor, eyes wide; reddened but not weeping - no, not now - now is the time to take hard action.

"Rest assured," his voice deepens, his hands, held together, raise up from his desk. "My organization has brought the sole remaining survivor of this murderous rampage into protection and we have taken all appropriate measures to ensure his security."
entries.zh:
他似乎重新稳住了情绪。

"一个疯狂的太空人，把杀害 Philip Andrada 那些无辜的孩子当成了 $playerHisOrHer 毕生的使命。那是他事业的继承人，是他真正的血脉！"

Macario 这时抬起头，望向全息传感器，双眼睁得很大；眼眶发红，却没有落泪——不，不是现在——现在是采取强硬行动的时候。

"请放心，\"他的声音沉了下去，交握的双手从桌面上抬起，\"我的机构已将这场屠杀中唯一的幸存者纳入保护，并已采取一切适当措施确保他的安全。"

entries.en:
He appears to regain his composure.

"A mad spacer somehow lied $playerHisOrHer way into a commission with the Sindrian Diktat. $PlayerHeOrShe made it a personal mission to... to murder the innocent children of Philip Andrada. The heirs to his project, his very bloodline!" His voice goes soft for a moment. "It is the foulest treachery one can imagine."

Macario looks up now, into the holosensor, eyes wide; reddened but not weeping - no, not now - now is the time to take hard action.

"Rest assured," his voice deepens, his hands, held together, raise up from his desk. "My organization has brought the sole remaining survivor into our protection and we have taken all appropriate measures to ensure his security."
entries.zh:
他似乎重新稳住了情绪。

"一个疯狂的太空人，靠着 $playerHisOrHer 的谎言，骗到了一份辛达强权的委任。$PlayerHeOrShe 把杀害 Philip Andrada 那些无辜的孩子当成了自己的使命。那是他事业的继承人，是他真正的血脉！\"他的声音软了一瞬，\"这是能想象到的最卑劣的背叛。"

Macario 这时抬起头，望向全息传感器，双眼睁得很大；眼眶发红，却没有落泪——不，不是现在——现在是采取强硬行动的时候。

"请放心，\"他的声音沉了下去，交握的双手从桌面上抬起，\"我的机构已将唯一的幸存者纳入我们的保护，并已采取一切适当措施确保他的安全。"

entries.en: "We shall not let one cowardly murderer, a radical terrorist employed by the Cult of Ludd, shatter the peace and destroy our way of life!"
entries.zh: "我们绝不容许一个卑怯的凶手——一个受卢德教派雇用的激进恐怖分子——打碎和平、毁掉我们的生活方式！"

entries.en: "We shall not let one cowardly murderer, a minion following the cruel and outrageous orders of the so-called 'Hegemony', shatter the peace and destroy our way of life!
entries.zh: "我们绝不容许一个卑怯的凶手，一个听命于所谓'霸主'的残暴无道指令的走狗，打碎和平、毁掉我们的生活方式！"

entries.en: "We shall not let one cowardly murderer, one senseless terrorist employed by decadent Kazeronian aristocrats, shatter the peace and destroy our way of life!"
entries.zh: "我们绝不容许一个卑怯的凶手——一个受堕落的 Kazeron 贵族雇用的、毫无理智的恐怖分子——打碎和平、毁掉我们的生活方式！"

entries.en: "We shall not let one cowardly murderer, one senseless terrorist, shatter the peace and destroy our way of life!"
entries.zh: "我们绝不容许一个卑怯的凶手、一个毫无理智的恐怖分子打碎和平、毁掉我们的生活方式！"

entries.en: "We shall not let one loathsome traitor, one senseless terrorist - who swore a false loyalty to our beautiful cause - shatter the peace and destroy our way of life!"
entries.zh: "我们绝不容许一个可憎的叛徒——一个曾对我们美好的事业宣誓效忠、却背信弃义的、毫无理智的恐怖分子——打碎和平、毁掉我们的生活方式！"

entries.en:
Now his voice fills with righteous anger.

"Look upon the coward! Hear me now, $playerName." He stares through the holo. "You will be hunted to the far fringe of the Persean Sector!"

He rises from his desk, gesticulating with a clenched fist, "We SHALL have justice!"

"Observe and report, loyal citizens! Any information you provide may prove useful as we track this murderous..."

You take a deep breath, processing the scope of Macario's scheme. He keeps talking.
entries.zh:
这时他的声音里涨满了义愤。

"看看这个懦夫！听好了，$playerName。\"他透过全息影像直盯着你，\"你将被追猎到英仙座星域最远的边陲！"

他从桌后站起身，攥紧拳头比划着，"我们必将讨回正义！"

"忠诚的公民们，注意观察、及时举报！你们提供的任何情报，在我们追踪这个嗜血的..."

你深吸一口气，掂量着 Macario 这盘棋的规模。他还在说。

entries.en:
Now his voice fills with righteous anger.

"Look upon the traitor! Hear me now, $playerName." He stares through the holo. "You are stripped of your commission. You will be hunted to the far fringe of the Persean Sector!"

He rises from his desk, gesticulating with a clenched fist, "We SHALL uphold justice!"

"Observe and report, loyal citizens! Any information you provide may prove useful as we track this murderous..."

You take a deep breath, processing the scope of Macario's scheme. He keeps talking.
entries.zh:
这时他的声音里涨满了义愤。

"看看这个叛徒！听好了，$playerName。\"他透过全息影像直盯着你，\"你的委任状已被剥夺。你将被追猎到英仙座星域最远的边陲！"

他从桌后站起身，攥紧拳头比划着，"我们必将维护正义！"

"忠诚的公民们，注意观察、及时举报！你们提供的任何情报，在我们追踪这个嗜血的..."

你深吸一口气，掂量着 Macario 这盘棋的规模。他还在说。

entries.en: You notice the spacer at the next table turn to re-examine your face.
entries.zh: 你注意到邻桌的太空人转过头来，重新打量你的脸。

entries.en: You notice the spacer at the next table turn to re-examine your face. And another, two down.
entries.zh: 你注意到邻桌的太空人转过头来，重新打量你的脸。再过去两桌，又有一个。

entries.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat. I shall not recklessly name her... or him until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then another, from a couple tables over.
entries.zh:
"...还有一名同谋，一个就藏在辛达强权政府内部的高层叛徒。在调查完成之前，我不会轻率地点出她...或者他的名字，但请放心，正义必将迅速而确凿。接下来还会有..."

接着，隔了两张桌子的又一个人转过头来。

o.en: It appears to be time to leave

entries.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat whose treachery sunk to supplying $playerName with one of the sacred Executors, a battleship designed by the Supreme Executor himself."

He looks down for a moment, as if steeling himself against the weight of the hurt and shame of this vile act.

"I shall not recklessly name her... or him, until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then, from a couple tables over, another spacer turns to look toward you.
entries.zh:
"...还有一名同谋，一个就藏在辛达强权政府内部的高层叛徒，此人的背叛已堕落到向 $playerName 提供一艘神圣的 Executor 级战舰——那是最高元首亲手设计的战列舰。"

他低下头片刻，仿佛在硬扛这桩恶行带来的伤痛与羞辱。

"在调查完成之前，我不会轻率地点出她...或者他的名字，但请放心，正义必将迅速而确凿。接下来还会有..."

随后，隔了两张桌子，又一名太空人转头望向你。

entries.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat whose treachery sunk to supplying $playerName with one of the sacred Executors, a battleship designed by the Supreme Executor himself."

He looks down for a moment, as if steeling himself against the weight of the hurt and shame of this vile act.

"I shall not recklessly name her... or him, until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then, from a couple tables over, another spacer turns to look toward you.
entries.zh:
...与一位同谋，辛达强权政府内部的一名高层叛徒——其背叛行径甚至到了向 $playerName 提供一台神圣 “执行者” 战舰的地步，那是一艘由最高执行者本人设计的战列舰。

他低头看着...

o.en: It appears to be time to leave

entries.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat. I shall not recklessly name her... or him until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then another, from a couple tables over.
entries.zh: ...与一位同谋，辛达强权政府内部的一名高层叛徒。在调查完成之前，我不会轻率地说出她...或他的名字，但请放心，报应会来得又快又准。还会有...

o.en: It appears to be time to leave

entries.en:
The audio is silent for a moment, a holo-caster's lips moving to no effect.

BREAKING NEWS, the holo-cast proclaims in bold letters.

"From the Askonia System-"

The caster's voice hits like a too-loud slap before pulling back to merely overwhelming.

You begin to turn away. Yet another declaration of a final crackdown on the next victim from a carousel of scapegoats.
entries.zh:
声音先空了一瞬，全息播报员的嘴唇动着，却没有半点声响。

突发新闻。全息播报以粗体大字宣告。

"来自 Askonia 星系——"

播报员的声音猛地砸下来，像一记过重的耳光，随后才收敛到仅仅是压人的音量。

你正要转身走开。又是一则宣告：要对下一个牺牲品动手，进行最终的清洗——替罪羊一个接一个，轮着来。

entries.en:
Then you glimpse your own face, bright and distorted.

SPACER MURDER RAMPAGE - POLITICALLY MOTIVATED?
entries.zh:
接着，你瞥见了自己的脸，明亮而扭曲。

太空船员连环凶杀案——出于政治动机？

entries.en: There's you, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy, flanked by bodyguards. There's an ominous tone.
entries.zh: 画面里是你，穿过 Galatia 学院的入口休息厅，两侧是护卫。配乐透着一股不祥的味道。

entries.en: There's you, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy, flanked by bodyguards. There's an ominous tone. This must be about Hercules. Who you never met, in fact. You recall a discussion with Provost Baird, and-
entries.zh: 画面里是你，穿过 Galatia 学院的入口休息厅，两侧是护卫。配乐透着一股不祥的味道。这一定和 Hercules 有关。可你其实从没见过他。你想起与 Baird 院长的那次谈话，还有——

entries.en:
ACADEMICIAN ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT?

Images of Hercules' destroyed office, small arms-fire gouged walls and shattered poster-screens.

A bland, out-of-context statement from Chief of Security Marcellus Lott.
entries.zh:
院士遇刺未遂？

Hercules 那间被毁的办公室：墙上留着轻武器射击的凿痕，招贴屏碎裂一地。

安全主管 Marcellus Lott 一段四平八稳、脱离上下文的声明。

entries.en:
ACADEMICIAN ASSASSINATION COVERUP?

An image of Hercules' destroyed office, small arms-fire gouged walls and shattered poster-screens. Erdene Benoit, in tears, led away by guards in mirrored masks.

A bland, out-of-context statement from Chief of Security Marcellus Lott.
entries.zh:
院士遇刺，遭人掩盖？

Hercules 那间被毁的办公室：墙上留着轻武器射击的凿痕，招贴屏碎裂一地。Erdene Benoit 泪流满面，被戴镜面面具的守卫带走。

安全主管 Marcellus Lott 一段四平八稳、脱离上下文的声明。

entries.en:
ACADEMICIAN ASSASSINATION COVERUP?

An image of a destroyed office, small arms-fire gouged walls and shattered poster-screens. A young woman, in tears, led away by guards in mirrored masks.

A bland, out-of-context statement from the Galatia Academy's chief of security.
entries.zh:
院士遇刺，遭人掩盖？

一间被毁的办公室：墙上留着轻武器射击的凿痕，招贴屏碎裂一地。一名年轻女子泪流满面，被戴镜面面具的守卫带走。

Galatia 学院安全主管一段四平八稳、脱离上下文的声明。

entries.en:
A view over the shoulder of a cowering civilian, grainy footage from a cheap buzz-drone.

DEATH SQUAD INVADES QARAS

Your boot crushes a discarded food container as you stride down the municipal corridor flanked by fearsome-looking marines. Your eye catches on the camera and it freezes, zooms. Your menacing face in stark chiaroscuro.

Grainy recording from a handheld sensor. Broken-down doors, a trashed meeting room.

Cut to Jason Korin's bloodless corpse on a slab, eyes staring blank accusations. Hard to tell he's a young Andrada with the tattoo-work.

A hangdog curate mumbles something of no consequence to an unseen interviewer.
entries.zh:
镜头越过一名瑟缩平民的肩头，影像是廉价蜂鸣无人机拍下的粗颗粒画面。

死亡小队入侵 QARAS

你踏着一只被丢弃的食品盒走过去，靴底把它碾扁，两侧面目凶悍的陆战队簇拥着你，你大步穿过市政走廊。你的目光扫到镜头，画面骤然定格、推近。你那张脸在强烈的明暗对比下显得狰狞。

手持传感器拍下的粗颗粒影像。被撞烂的门，一片狼藉的会议室。

镜头切到 Jason Korin 了无血色的尸体，躺在停尸台上，双眼空洞地瞪着，像无声的控诉。一身刺青让人几乎认不出这是个年轻的 Andrada。

一个垂头丧气的教士对着镜头外的采访者嘟囔了几句无关紧要的话。

o.zh: 事情根本不是那样发生的！

entries.en:
Your outcry is covered by another loud, jarring tone meant to contribute to the threatening image of you being constructed in holo-projectors across the Sector.

There's a quick aside about strange experiments being carried out in the Galatia system related to the recent jump-point disruption. A tenuous link is implied via reference to (mostly) redacted port logs which may - or may not - contain your fleet's ident-codes released by the Hegemony recovery and reconciliation committee.
entries.zh:
你的喊声被又一声刺耳的巨响盖过——那声响是刻意加进来的，好让全星域的全息投影共同塑造出的这个凶险的你，更显得可怖。

接着是一段简短的插叙：Galatia 星系正在进行的诡异实验，与最近的跳跃点中断有关。片中引用了一批 (大部分已涂黑的) 港口日志，借此暗示出一条脆弱的关联：那些日志里或许有、或许没有你舰队的识别码，而这些识别码正是霸主恢复与和解委员会放出的。

entries.en: Next: Maeus Moroz leaving the MuniSec facility, his face red with tears, looking lost and enraged. For someone to explain, someone to target...
entries.zh: 下一段：Maeus Moroz 走出 MuniSec 设施，满脸泪痕、涨得通红，神情茫然又暴怒。像是在等谁来解释，或者等一个可以迁怒的目标...

entries.en: "Shh." A spacer at the next table shushes you without looking away from the projection.
entries.zh: "嘘。"邻桌的一个太空人嘘了你一声，目光始终没离开投影。

entries.en:
ORTHRUS DOUBLE MURDER: FATHER AND SON

Then the moment you pulled a gun in the bar and fired. The clip ends with the flash, then repeats. Repeats again, slower. Maeus's body jerks and freezes.
entries.zh:
ORTHRUS 双命凶案：父与子

接着是你在酒吧里拔枪开火的那一刻。片段在枪口火光中结束，然后重播。又重播一遍，更慢。Maeus 的身体猛地一颤，随即定格。

entries.en:
ORTHRUS DOUBLE MURDER: FATHER AND SON

Then the moment you pulled a gun in the bar and failed to fire. The clip scales and zoom toward you holding the pistol, ready to fire, the bartender's face contorted in horror. It repeats the loop. Repeats again, slower, as if Maeus never saw the shot coming, the shot you never fired.
entries.zh:
ORTHRUS 双命凶案：父与子

接着是你在酒吧里拔枪、却没能开火的那一刻。画面推近、再推近，定格在举枪待发的你身上，酒保的脸因恐惧而扭曲。片段循环播放。又重播一遍，更慢，仿佛 Maeus 始终没看见那一枪袭来——那一枪你从未开出。

entries.en:
ORTHRUS MURDER: FATHER MOURNS SON

Then an older holo, one you never saw. The fuzzy edge of a security drone's pickup: a young man of familiar build walks, nearly colliding with a spacer just off-ship, a raised hand, a small flash, and the young man falls to the ground.

So quick, so subtle - it takes several seconds for the bystander coming to the young man's aid to notice the blood pooling on the ground. The small crowd recoils to an unheard cry.
entries.zh:
ORTHRUS 凶案：父亲哀悼儿子

接着是一段更早的全息影像，你从没见过。画面边缘是安保无人机模糊的取景：一个身形熟悉的年轻人走过，几乎与一名刚下船的太空人撞上，一只手抬起，一点微光，年轻人便倒在地上。

太快了，也太轻了——好几秒之后，那个上前搀扶年轻人的旁观者才注意到地上正漫开的血。小小的人群猛地一缩，应和着一声你听不见的惊叫。

entries.en:
58966 Elysium.

Marble walls and columns invaded by hostile shadows in black armor. Doors breached, atmo venting in clouds. A shot from low, looking up - their leader, you, marching through desecrated halls. Giving an order.

Quick cut: a body in a pool of fresh blood, slashed dead.

ROGUE SPACER TRANSFORMS PARADISE INTO SLAUGHTERHOUSE
entries.zh:
画面：58966 Elysium。

大理石的墙壁与立柱间，闯入一片片黑色装甲的敌意暗影。门被撞开，大气成团地往外泄。一个自下而上的仰拍镜头——他们的首领，也就是你，正穿过被亵渎的厅堂。你在下令。

快切：一具被砍死的尸体，躺在新鲜的血泊里。

狂徒太空人把乐园变成屠场

entries.en: "Shh." A spacer at the next table shushes you without looking away from the projection.
entries.zh: "嘘。"邻桌的一个太空人嘘了你一声，目光始终没离开投影。

entries.en:
The spacer at the next table turns, finally. "Hey, I'm trying to watch..."

They squint at you, then look back at the holo - it's cut away from your face. The spacer gives you one more skeptical look then return their attention to the holo-cast.
entries.zh:
邻桌的太空人终于转过头来。"喂，我正看着呢..."

他眯起眼打量你，随后回头看向全息影像——画面已经从你脸上切走了。那太空人又带着怀疑看了你一眼，便把注意力收回全息直播上。

entries.en: Your bodyguards throw a disposable poncho over you as they hustle you out a side-door; you could pass as any civilian girded against the drip of poorly-tuned life support conduits.
entries.zh: 护卫们把一件一次性斗篷披到你身上，簇拥着你从侧门匆匆离开；此刻你看起来就像任何一个寻常平民，裹着斗篷抵挡调校不良的生命维持导管滴下的冷凝水。

entries.en:
You leave the bar flanked by bodyguards. Most of the patrons know better than to gawk at the executive leader of their present polity.

The corridors are quiet. Nonetheless, a squad of MuniSec joins your party, less from fear of a mob than the desire of the local section enforcer to earn your esteem.
entries.zh:
你在保镖的簇拥下离开酒吧。大多数顾客都知道不该盯着他们当前政体的行政首脑看。

走廊里很安静。尽管如此，一队市政安全兵加入了你的队伍，与其说是怕暴民，不如说是想...

entries.en: It takes a moment for the bartender to realize who the shout came from - then they leap to obey, cowering apologetically.
entries.zh: 酒保花了一会儿才意识到喊声来自谁——然后他们连忙照办，畏缩着道歉。

entries.en:
Macario's attack on your reputation, even if rejected as Sindrian black propaganda, nonetheless makes you an inconvenient friend.

And a target for bounty hunters and assassins, no doubt.

It's unthinkable to simply sit back and allow this to be done to you. You carefully consider how you should react.
entries.zh:
Macario 对你名声的攻击，即便被当作辛达的黑宣传而不被采信，也足以让你成为一个令人为难的朋友。

而且毫无疑问，会让你成为赏金猎人与刺客的目标。

坐视这一切落到自己头上，是无法想象的。你仔细思量自己该如何应对。

entries.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Ah, Captain $playerName. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" he booms enthusiastically. "It stirs the heart to see a loyal follower of the Supreme Executor's vision, and," he leans in, "One who will stand with me when the time comes, when strength and loyalty will be required to secure the future of the Persean Sector."

He leans back, satisfied. "Terrible what Macario's been saying you've done. Avoid meeting any of our fleets; there's a kill-on-sight order, you know. And they don't have my authority... and patience."

Caden smirks, then bellows "Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!"
entries.zh:
卫队高级副执政官 Caden 出现在你面前。

"啊，舰长 $playerName。光荣属于辛达强权！\"他热情地吼道。\"看到有人忠心追随最高元首的愿景，真叫人热血沸腾，而且，\"他凑近了些，\"等那一刻来临，需要力量与忠诚来保住英仙座星域的未来时，这个人会站在我这边。"

他向后靠去，很是满意。"Macario 到处说你干了些什么，那些话真难听。别去碰我们的舰队；有一道见即格杀的命令，你知道的。何况他们也没有我的气度...和耐心。"

Caden 得意地一笑，随即吼道："光荣属于辛达强权！"

entries.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Ah, $PlayerName. The next target of Macario's little games, aren't you." His eyes gleam with mirth. "Yes, I'm sure you'll want to tell me it's all made up and he's manipulating me. But what of it? This is what you deserve"

Caden laughs cruelly.

"Ever word you speak is a degenerate spacer lie. I will have ears for you only as you plead for mercy - then I shall order your execution to proceed!"

He's pleased with this retort, and with a dramatic gesture orders his comms officer to cut the link.
entries.zh:
卫队高级副执政官 Caden 出现在你面前。

"啊，$PlayerName。你就是 Macario 那些小游戏的下一个目标，对吧。\"他眼里闪着快意。\"是啊，你肯定想告诉我，这一切都是编的，是他在操纵我。可那又怎样？这是你自找的。"

Caden 残忍地笑了起来。

"你说的每一个字，都是堕落的太空佬的谎言。我只在你求饶的时候才听得进你的话——然后，我就下令行刑！"

他对这番回击很满意，夸张地一挥手，命令通讯官切断链路。

entries.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Captain $playerName. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" he booms enthusiastically. "Dolos tells me such things, such terrible things about what he claims you've done."
entries.zh:
卫队高级副执政官 Caden 出现在你面前。

"舰长 $playerName。光荣属于辛达强权！\"他热情地吼道。\"Dolos 跟我说了些事，说了些很可怕的事，都是他声称你干下的。"

entries.en:
Guard High Deputy Executor Caden appears before you.

"Ah, Captain $playerName. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" he booms enthusiastically. "It stirs the heart to see a 'loyal' follower of the Supreme Executor's vision."

He smirks at his own cleverness.

"Terrible what Macario's saying you've done. I do suggest you avoid meeting any of our other fleets; there's a kill-on-sight order, you know. It was Macario's idea and he has no authority over me, so I've chosen to treat you with... patience."

Caden, satisfied with his grandiosity, bellows "Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!"
entries.zh:
卫队高级副执政官 Caden 出现在你面前。

"啊，舰长 $playerName。光荣属于辛达强权！\"他热情地吼道。\"看到有人'忠心'追随最高元首的愿景，真叫人热血沸腾。"

他为自己这份机灵得意地笑了。

"Macario 到处说你干了些什么，那些话真难听。我确实建议你避开我们其余的舰队；有一道见即格杀的命令，你知道的。那是 Macario 的主意，而他无权管我，所以我选择对你...保持耐心。"

Caden 对自己的派头颇为满意，吼道："光荣属于辛达强权！"
