o.en: Wait, $Rank, I have an intel report you must see!
o.zh: 等等，$Rank，我有一份情报，你必须看看！

entries.en:
You begin to explain: seven sons stashed in seven star systems, seven clones of-

"Clones?!" His shout interrupts your explanation. "Impossible! I'd have known."

He takes a breath. And another, composing himself.

"I'm afraid you've fallen for another one of Macario little tricks, spacer."
entries.zh:
你开始解释：七个儿子藏在七个星系，七个克隆体——

"克隆体？！\"他的吼声打断了你的话。\"不可能！我不可能不知道。"

他吸了一口气。又吸了一口，让自己镇定下来。

"太空佬，恐怕你是又中了 Macario 的一个小把戏。"

o.en: I have proof - the files, l will send them to you. (upload files)
o.zh: 我有证据——那些文件，我这就发给你。 (上传文件)

o.en: I... yes, it must be a trick.

entries.en:
"There's no need for that," he says. Caden begins a dismissive wave, then stops. "But your demonstration of loyalty is not... unappreciated. It is just - just - possible that you may be capable of understanding the transcendent ideology of Philip Andrada."

The file transfer is accepted.

"Now, then, you may set aside your worries," he says condescendingly. "I shall be keeping an eye on Dolos Macario. Everything is under control," he tells himself.

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!" He gestures at an underling to cut the link.
entries.zh:
"不必了，\"他说。Caden 抬手想做个不屑一顾的手势，又停住了。\"不过你这份忠诚的表示，也并非...不受赏识。只是——只是——有可能，你确实有能力领会 Philip Andrada 的超凡意识形态。"

文件传输被接受。

"好了，现在你可以把那些担忧放下了，"他居高临下地说。"Dolos Macario 我会盯着的。一切都在掌控之中，"他对自己说。

"光荣属于辛达强权！"他朝一名下属示意，切断链路。

entries.en:
He waves a hand as if brushing your worries away.

"Many have fallen for his lies. You don't know Dolos like I do - and I've got my eye on him," he says. Then looks away. "Everything is under control," he tells himself.

"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat!"

He gestures at an underling to cut the link.
entries.zh:
他摆了摆手，像是要把你的担忧从眼前拂开。

"很多人都栽在他的谎话上。你不像我这么了解 Dolos——我盯着他呢，"他说。随即移开目光。"一切都在掌控之中，"他对自己说。

"光荣属于辛达强权！"

他朝一名下属示意，切断链路。

o.en: I wish to discuss certain files with you, $Rank.
o.zh: 我想和你谈谈某些文件，$Rank。

entries.en: "As successor to that office," he looks up and away for a moment, as if pondering the title that shall soon be his, "I hope you've brought me something of... fitting significance."
entries.zh: "作为那个职位的继任者，\"他抬眼望向别处，仿佛在琢磨那顶即将属于他的头衔，\"我希望你带来的东西...够得上分量。"

o.en: I recovered files meant for Macario. Concerning clones of Andrada. (explain)
o.zh: 我找回了本该交给 Macario 的文件。关于 Andrada 的克隆体。 (解释)

entries.en:
He hesitates.

"Who are you, spacer, to tell me what I must do? Think carefully before you answer."

His expression is perched on a knife's edge - somewhere between amusement and the calm before a furious tirade.
entries.zh:
他迟疑了。

"你算什么东西，太空佬，也敢来告诉我该做什么？回答之前想清楚了。"

他的神情像悬在刀刃上——说不清是觉得有趣，还是暴怒发作前的那种平静。

o.en: I recovered files meant for Macario. Concerning clones of Andrada. (explain)
o.zh: 我找回了本该交给 Macario 的文件。关于 Andrada 的克隆体。 (解释)

entries.en:
He hesitates. Then, with little consideration, comes to a judgment.

"Who are you to tell me what I must do, spacer? You, a degenerate itinerant?"

He leans back, satisfied. "Glory to the Sindrian Diktat," he bellows.

The connection is terminated.
entries.zh:
他迟疑了一下。随后几乎没怎么考虑，就做出了判断。

"你算什么东西，也敢来告诉我该做什么，太空佬？一个堕落的流浪汉？"

他向后靠去，很是满意。"光荣属于辛达强权！"他吼道。

通讯被切断。

entries.en:
He hesitates, then summons a privacy field.

"You've pledged commission to the glorious Sindrian Diktat and the Supreme Executor, Philip Andrada."
entries.zh:
他迟疑了一下，随即召出一层隐私场。

"你已宣誓为光荣的辛达强权、为最高元首 Philip Andrada 效命。"

entries.en: You know of Caden's misgivings about Dolos Macario. If Caden read the ANDRADA files and understood their implications...
entries.zh: 你知道 Caden 对 Dolos Macario 心存疑虑。如果 Caden 读过那些 ANDRADA 文件，明白其中的含义...

entries.en:
He hesitates. Then touches his cuff, summoning a privacy field.

"You've pledged to support me, the right hand of Philip Andrada, Lion of Sindria, Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat."
entries.zh:
他迟疑了一下。随即碰了碰袖口，召出一层隐私场。

"你已宣誓支持我——Philip Andrada 的左右手，辛达瑞亚之狮，辛达强权的最高元首。"

entries.en:
He hesitates, then summons a privacy field.

"You've pledged to support me, the right hand of Philip Andrada, Lion of Sindria, Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat."

You recall, now, that you did lie to him about that.
entries.zh:
他迟疑了一下，随即召出一层隐私场。

"你已宣誓支持我——Philip Andrada 的左右手，辛达瑞亚之狮，辛达强权的最高元首。"

你这才想起来，在这件事上，你确实对他说了谎。

entries.en:
"It is well known that your people tend toward cowardice, forever smuggling drugs and acting as rather poor, self-serving mercenaries who overwhelm worthier opponents through surprise and number."

"Macario has seen fit to unburden himself of you. Now your loyalty is tested. What of it?"
entries.zh:
"众所周知，你们这种人天生怯懦，成天走私毒品，当那种低劣又自私的雇佣兵，靠偷袭和人多势众压过比你们更可敬的对手。"

"Macario 觉得该把你这个包袱甩掉了。现在你的忠诚要受考验了。怎么样？"

o.en: We must preserve Philip Andrada's glorious vision! It is what he'd want.
o.zh: 我们必须守住 Philip Andrada 光荣的愿景！这才是他想要的。

o.en: Macario will destroy the Sindrian Diktat if he isn't stopped!
o.zh: 再不拦住 Macario，他会毁了辛达强权！

o.en: Macario betrayed us both. Were not you to be Supreme Executor?
o.zh: Macario 背叛了我们两个。本来要坐上最高元首之位的，不就是你吗？

o.en: Hector needs you. I, too, swore to uphold the blood of Andrada...
o.zh: Hector 需要你。我也曾宣誓维护 Andrada 的血脉...

o.en: We need to work together. All of us, for Hector. For the Sindrian Diktat!
o.zh: 我们必须合作。所有人一起，为了 Hector。为了辛达强权！

o.en: I pledged myself to the Sindrian Diktat - and Macario has called me traitor.
o.zh: 我已宣誓效忠辛达强权——而 Macario 却把我叫作叛徒。

o.en: I pledged myself to the Sindrian Diktat. I serve the blood of Andrada...
o.zh: 我已宣誓效忠辛达强权。我侍奉的是 Andrada 的血脉...

o.en: I said I would give you support in the coming crisis. So here I stand.
o.zh: 我说过，我会在这场危机中支持你。所以我来了。

o.en: I bear good news- material support from a top Tri-Tachyon executive.
o.zh: 我带来了好消息——速子科技一位高层的实质支持。

o.en: I am here to prove my loyalty to the Sindrian Diktat no matter Macario's lies!
o.zh: 我来这里，是要证明我对辛达强权的忠诚，不管 Macario 编了什么谎！

o.en: I pledged myself to the Sindrian Diktat - and Macario has called me traitor... as a ruse.
o.zh: 我已宣誓效忠辛达强权——而 Macario 却把我叫作叛徒...这是做戏。

entries.en:
"It is well known that your people tend toward cowardice, forever smuggling drugs and acting as rather poor, self-serving mercenaries who overwhelm worthier opponents through surprise and number."

"Macario used you. Now your loyalty, so far as you are capable of loyalty, is tested. What of it?"
entries.zh:
"众所周知，你们这种人天生怯懦，成天走私毒品，当那种低劣又自私的雇佣兵，靠偷袭和人多势众压过比你们更可敬的对手。"

"Macario 利用了你。现在，你的忠诚——如果你也懂得什么叫忠诚的话——要受考验了。怎么样？"

entries.en:
"And why should I listen to you, spacer? I never lost faith in the glory of Philip's transcendent philosophy. Never. It is others who failed. All around me, they fall. Their will is weak. Cowards. Traitors!"

He paces, like a cloned animal of Old Earth caged too long.
entries.zh:
"我凭什么要听你的，太空佬？我从未动摇过对 Philip 超凡意识形态之荣光的信念。从来没有。是别人失败了。我身边的人一个个倒下。他们意志薄弱。懦夫。叛徒！"

他来回踱步，像一头被关得太久的古地球克隆兽。

entries.en:
"You speak far too familiarly of the Supreme Executor's mind, spacer," Caden says, expression is pitiless.

"None knew him as did I. Certainly some clone, some child brainwashed by Dolos knows nothing, nothing at all."
entries.zh:
"你对最高元首的心思说得也太随便了，太空佬，"Caden 说，神情毫无怜悯。

"没有人像我那样了解他。某个克隆体，某个被 Dolos 洗脑的孩子，当然什么都不知道，什么都不知道。"

entries.en:
He gives you a cold look at that. But it is not dismissive.

"I was to be Supreme Executor," he growls. "Not some clone, some child brainwashed by Dolos."
entries.zh:
听到这话，他冷冷瞥了你一眼。但那目光并非不屑。

"本该由我来当最高元首，\"他低吼道，\"而不是某个克隆体，某个被 Dolos 洗脑的孩子。"

entries.en: "Speak not of that!" he shouts, spittle flying. "You have no right! I was to be Supreme Executor! Not some clone, some child brainwashed by Dolos!"
entries.zh: "别提那件事！\"他吼道，唾沫横飞。\"你没有这个资格！本该由我来当最高元首！而不是某个克隆体，某个被 Dolos 洗脑的孩子！"

entries.en:
He scoffs, expression more cruel than pitying.

"A spacer's oath. What's that worth? More than the blood of a clone?"
entries.zh:
他嗤了一声，那神情与其说是怜悯，不如说是残忍。

"一个太空佬的誓言。值几个钱？比一个克隆体的血还值钱？"

o.en: We must unite under Hector Andrada's leadership! (explain)
o.zh: 我们必须团结在 Hector Andrada 的旗下！ (解释)

o.en: You should work with, rather than against, Oxana Hyder. (explain)
o.zh: 你该与 Oxana Hyder 合作，而不是与她为敌。 (解释)

o.en: Dolos Macario is your real enemy. Not Hyder, nor Hector. (explain)
o.zh: Dolos Macario 才是你真正的敌人。不是 Hyder，也不是 Hector。 (解释)
<dev> 增加 3 点 cadenPoints 并打印总数

entries.en: DEV added 3 points, total is $cadenPoints
entries.zh: DEV 已增加 3 点，总数为 $cadenPoints

o.en: I see that you are... very busy. (leave)

entries.en: Caden wipes his brow, giving you a skeptical look. He looks suddenly tired. You notice the sweat-stains on his uniform.
entries.zh: Caden 抹了把额头，怀疑地看着你。他忽然显得很疲倦。你注意到他制服上的汗渍。

entries.en: Caden sticks his jaw out, striking a defiant pose against all who question Andradaism.
entries.zh: Caden 扬起下巴，摆出桀骜的姿态，仿佛要与所有质疑 Andrada 主义的人对抗到底。

entries.en: Caden sticks his chest out, medals flashing. His pride in his position is obvious. He looks eager to act.
entries.zh: Caden 挺起胸膛，勋章闪亮。他对自身地位的得意毫不掩饰。他看上去急于动手。

entries.en: Caden looks red and fervid, eyes gleaming with fire for Andradaism. He can't stop pacing.
entries.zh: Caden 脸色涨红，神态狂热，眼里烧着为 Andrada 主义而燃的火。他停不下踱步。

entries.en: His eyes dart around, his hand brushing his uniform pocket, then dropping to his side. You get the distinct impression that Caden is not in a receptive mood.
entries.zh: 他的目光四处游移，手在制服口袋上蹭了一下，又垂回身侧。你分明感觉到，Caden 此刻不是个听得进话的人。

entries.en:
You ask, does Dolos Macario embody the transcendent philosophy of Philip Andrada?

He is deceptive, physically cowardly, and avoids the glory of battle and contest of will, favoring trickery instead.

Worse, he appears to believe he is better than the great work laid out by Philip Andrada! By seeking to manipulate, mold, and corrupt both the polity and heir of Andradaism reified, he mocks and sullies their perfection.

Macario is the rot in the heart of the Sindrian Diktat that must be purged. And everyone, everyone, from Gilead to Kazeron to Chicomoztoc, can see that it is Horacio Caden who holds the knife.
entries.zh:
你问：Dolos Macario 身上可体现了 Philip Andrada 的超凡意识形态？

他惯于欺瞒，身体上怯懦，回避战斗的荣光与意志的较量，只会取巧。

更糟的是，他似乎自认为比 Philip Andrada 所奠定的伟业更高明！他妄图操纵、塑造并腐蚀 Andrada 主义所实体化的政体与继承人，这是在嘲弄并玷污它们的完美。

Macario 是辛达强权心脏里的腐坏，必须清除。而从 Gilead 到 Kazeron 再到 Chicomoztoc，所有人，所有人都看得出，握刀的人是 Horacio Caden。

entries.en:
You ask, does Macario embody the transcendent philosophy of Philip Andrada? He is deceptive, physically cowardly, and avoids the glory of battle and contest of will, instead favoring trickery and lies.

Worse, he appears to believe he is better than-

Caden interrupts you with a snort.

"Why would you attempt to lecture, of all people, ME about the Transcendent Philosophy? You are vermin before the master."

He gestures dismissively. "Cease before I order the oxygen torn from your lungs."
entries.zh:
你问：Macario 可体现了 Philip Andrada 的超凡意识形态？他惯于欺瞒，身体上怯懦，回避战斗的荣光与意志的较量，只爱取巧与说谎。

更糟的是，他似乎自认为比——

Caden 哼了一声，打断你。

"你算什么东西，偏要来给我讲超凡意识形态？在宗师面前，你不过是虫豸。"

他轻蔑地一挥手。"趁我还没下令把你肺里的氧气抽干，闭嘴。"

entries.en:
Caden looks off and away at a particular angle, a practiced pose to emphasize what's left of his jawline.

"And I suppose it must fall to me, as usual, the last one who has the will and the power to save the Sindrian Diktat."

He takes a deep breath, then releases it.

"So must it be."
entries.zh:
Caden 侧过脸，朝某个特定角度望去——那是练熟了的姿势，为的是显出他仅剩的那点下颌轮廓。

"那么，照例又该落到我头上——最后一个还有意志、还有力量拯救辛达强权的人。"

他深吸一口气，再缓缓吐出。

"那就只能如此了。"

entries.en:
"Tri-Tachyon?" He scoffs. "Fools! Decadent fools, cowards who invent robots to play war. What do robots know of glory?"

He looks far and away, becoming somehow unsatisfied with this line of thought.

Caden turns back to you.

"This is an unexpected loyalty, but admirable... for a spacer. War is not won on an empty stomach eh?" He pats his stomach, setting medals jangling.
entries.zh:
"速子科技？\"他不屑地哼了一声。\"蠢货！堕落的蠢货，一群造机器人来打仗的懦夫。机器人懂什么荣耀？"

他望向远方，不知怎的，越想越不痛快。

Caden 转回来看你。

"这份忠诚出人意料，不过...对一个太空佬来说，值得钦佩。空着肚子可打不赢仗，对吧？"他拍拍自己的肚子，勋章叮当作响。

entries.en: "Yes, yes," he waves a hand impatiently. "Of course you did and do. An admirable declaration... for a spacer."
entries.zh: "是，是，\"他不耐烦地摆摆手。\"你当然效忠过，现在也还效忠着。一番值得钦佩的宣言...对一个太空佬来说。"

entries.en:
Caden laughs, as if acting out a part.

"I never trusted him. Too bony,"  he muses. "Spends his time in a perverse little room watching holo-feeds."

"So what do you have to say for yourself, spacer?"
entries.zh:
Caden 笑了起来，像是在演一出戏。

"我从没信过他。太瘦了，一身骨头，\"他若有所思地说。\"成天缩在一间变态的小屋子里看全息影像。"

"那么，你有什么要为自己辩解的，太空佬？"

entries.en:
Caden laughs cruelly.

"Ever word you speak is a degenerate spacer lie. I will have ears for such dross only when you plead for mercy - then I will order your execution to proceed!"

He's pleased with this retort, and with a dramatic gesture orders his comms officer to cut the link.
entries.zh:
Caden 残忍地笑了起来。

"你说的每一个字，都是堕落的太空佬的谎言。这种废话，我只在你求饶的时候才听——然后我就下令行刑！"

他对这番回击很满意，夸张地一挥手，命令通讯官切断链路。

entries.en:
Caden shrugs.

"Dolos is fickle, isn't he. Always over-complicating what ought to be simple. Waste of time, waste of resources. But he can be useful, so I indulge his whimsy from time to time."

He turns from his pacing and looks at you through the link.
entries.zh:
Caden 耸了耸肩。

"Dolos 这人反复无常，对吧。总把本该简单的事搞得无比复杂。浪费时间，浪费资源。不过他有时还有用，所以我也就时不时纵容一下他的怪念头。"

他停下踱步，转过身，透过链路看着你。

entries.en:
Caden shrugs.

"Dolos is fickle. And endlessly over-complicating what ought to be simple. Wasted effort, wasted resources. But he can be useful, so I indulge his whimsy from time to time."

He turns from his pacing and looks at you through the link.
entries.zh:
Caden 耸了耸肩。

"Dolos 反复无常。没完没了地把本该简单的事搞得无比复杂。白费力气，白费资源。不过他有时还有用，所以我也就时不时纵容一下他的怪念头。"

他停下踱步，转过身，透过链路看着你。

entries.en:
"Yes." He looks up, eyes bloodshot.

"Yes, there is much to be done. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat."
entries.zh:
"是。"他抬起头，双眼布满血丝。

"是，还有很多事要做。荣耀归于辛达强权。"

entries.en:
"To the death," he mutters, hair lank.

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"至死方休，"他低声说，头发黏成一绺绺。

通讯中断。

entries.en:
You explain that the blood of Andrada will prevail over Macario's trickery and deception. Hector is a young man and he needs the experience of an old warrior, an example to lead him; indeed, a hero of the Sindrian Diktat.

He needs Horacio Caden. The Sindrian Diktat needs Horacio Caden. Indeed, Askonia - no, the Persean Sector needs Caden. It is not a place of fame and glory he might have imagined, but with Hector's father cut down... who but Horacio Caden to take Philip's place?

It is what Philip would have wanted.

Caden sulks, but you can swear he nods as you describe his heroism and wisdom.
entries.zh:
你解释说，Andrada 的血脉终将胜过 Macario 的诡计与欺瞒。Hector 还年轻，他需要一位老将的经验，需要一个可供他效法的榜样；确切地说，需要一位辛达强权的英雄。

他需要 Horacio Caden。辛达强权需要 Horacio Caden。确切地说，Askonia——不，整个英仙座星域都需要 Caden。这或许不是他想象中的功名与荣耀之地，可既然 Hector 的父亲已经倒下...除了 Horacio Caden，还有谁能取代 Philip 的位置？

这正是 Philip 会希望看到的。

Caden 沉着脸不吭声，但当你讲到他的英勇与智慧时，你发誓他点了下头。

entries.en:
You begin to explain that the blood of Andrada will prevail over Macario's trickery and deception. Hector is a young man and he needs the experience of an old warrior, an example to lead him; indeed, a hero of the-

Caden sulks, then, frustrated, interrupts with a shout.

"Enough! I won't be pandered to by a degenerate spacer. Loyal you may claim to be, but I shall not tolerate presumption! Not from spacer trash."

He takes a few seconds to catch his breath, glaring.
entries.zh:
你开口解释，Andrada 的血脉终将胜过 Macario 的诡计与欺瞒。Hector 还年轻，他需要一位老将的经验，需要一个可供他效法的榜样；确切地说，需要一位辛达强权的英雄——

Caden 沉着脸，随即烦躁地一声喝断，不让你说下去。

"够了！我不需要你这种堕落的太空佬来哄。你可以自称忠诚，但别太僭越！你僭越得太过了，太空渣滓。"

他花了几秒钟才喘匀气，瞪着你。

entries.en:
You explain that you see Hyder and Caden both as fighters - though she more tentative, obsessed with rules and order of logistics without truly understanding the glory of battle as described by Andrada's transcendent philosophy.

But that's why Hyder needs Horacio Caden: to serve as heroic example. This entire ploy by Macario to divide the fleets only weakens the Sindrian Diktat while enemies around a pretender.

Caden should make an ally of Hyder - subservient, of course - to use his skill, experience, and knowledge of Andrada's transcendent philosophy to overcome Hyder's innate failings.

The Diktat must come first and all must serve its cause.
entries.zh:
你解释说，在你眼里 Hyder 与 Caden 都是战士——只是她更为犹疑，执迷于规则与后勤秩序，却并不真正懂得 Andrada 超凡意识形态所描述的战斗之荣光。

也正因如此，Hyder 才需要 Horacio Caden：作为英雄的榜样。Macario 分化舰队的整套把戏，只会削弱辛达强权，同时让敌人聚拢到一名僭位者周围。

Caden 应当把 Hyder 收为盟友——当然，是从属的盟友——以他的本领、经验和对 Andrada 超凡意识形态的通晓，去弥补 Hyder 天生的缺陷。

强权必须高于一切，人人都该为它的事业效力。

entries.en:
You begin to explain that you see Hyder and Caden both as fighters - though she more tentative, obsessed with rules and order of logistics without truly understanding the glory of battle as described by Andrada's transcendent philosophy.

But that's why Hyder needs Horacio Caden: to serve as heroic example. This entire ploy by Macario to divide the fleets only-

"Cease your talk!" Caden interrupts with a shout.

"You speak defeatism! A capital offense if so I deem it. And you dare compare Hyder with myself? She's fit only to run a commissary. By Andrada's immortal glory, you're testing my patience, spacer."
entries.zh:
你解释说，在你眼里 Hyder 与 Caden 都是战士——只是她更为犹疑，执迷于规则与后勤秩序，却并不真正懂得 Andrada 超凡意识形态所描述的战斗之荣光。

也正因如此，Hyder 才需要 Horacio Caden：作为英雄的榜样。Macario 分化舰队的整套把戏，无非——

"住口！"Caden 一声喝断。

"你这是失败主义言论！我若认定如此，就是死罪。你还敢拿 Hyder 跟我相比？她只配去管军需库。以 Andrada 不朽的荣光起誓，太空佬，你是在试探我的耐性。"

entries.en:
"Even spacers like yourself," he says, claiming the line of reasoning for himself.

"It must be obvious if even you can see it," he concludes proudly.
entries.zh:
"就连你这样的太空佬，"他说，把这套推论据为己有。

"连你都看得出来，那这道理必定显而易见，"他得意地下了结论。

entries.en: "Of course. This loyalty is unexpected, but admirable... from a spacer." Caden looks pleased with himself, puffing up his chest, setting medals jangling.
entries.zh: "当然。这份忠诚出人意料，不过...对一个太空佬来说，值得钦佩。"Caden 看上去颇为自得，挺起胸膛，勋章叮当作响。

entries.en: Macario's informants could be listening. It may be best to begin this conversation through a private channel via the Sindria Relay.
entries.zh: Macario 的线人也许正在监听。这次谈话，最好经由 Sindria Relay 走私人频道开始。

o.en: Wait! I must speak to you about Dolos Macario.
o.zh: 等等！我必须和你谈谈 Dolos Macario。

o.en: Wait! I must speak to you about Dolos Macario.
o.zh: 等等！我必须和你谈谈 Dolos Macario。

entries.en:
Nane shifts to explaining the logs of a private courier operation to an increasingly uncomfortable mini-Dolos, dates and names highlighted. Low-profile shuttles to an obscure asteroid in the Hybrasil system.

Altered medical reports - a series of deaths, covered up over a period of many cycles before you ever found Elysium.

"Oh, that's awkward isn't it?" Nane exchanges looks with mini-Dolos, who shrugs in faux-innocence.
entries.zh:
Nane 转而向越来越坐立不安的小 Dolos 解说一桩私人信使业务的记录，日期与姓名被逐一高亮。低调的穿梭机飞往 Hybrasil 星系一颗偏僻的小行星。

被篡改的医疗报告——一连串死亡，在你发现 Elysium 之前，已经被掩盖了许多个星历年。

"哦，这可有点尴尬，是吧？" Nane 与小 Dolos 交换了个眼神，后者故作无辜地耸了耸肩。

entries.en:
"If murder was the goal," says Nane, "why did Maeus Moroz get the last shot?"

From a high angle, a grimy feed. There's you and Maeus Moroz, sharing a drink. He looks gruff, but is nodding his head at your words. The bartender sets two small glasses down, and Moroz immediately empties his.
entries.zh:
"如果目标是谋杀，\" Nane 说，\"那最后一枪为什么是 Maeus Moroz 开的？"

高角度拍摄，一段脏兮兮的画面。你和 Maeus Moroz 在共饮。他脸色阴沉，却对你的话点着头。酒保放下两只小杯，Moroz 立刻一饮而尽。

entries.en:
Next is a clip from the other 'cast, the one from the real Macario. The words ORTHRUS MURDER: FATHER MOURNS SON in glowing blood-red.

The words shrink, as if the air was let out of them, and flop onto the ground under Nane's sardonic expression. Mini-Dolos attempts to lift the words back up, behind him the mockery-edit of real Macario's original propaganda holo, but the words prove too floppy and awkward, and finally he throws up his arms and sulks in frustration.
entries.zh:
接下来是另一档节目的片段，真正 Macario 那一档。血红色的发光大字：ORTHRUS 凶案：父亲哀悼儿子。

那些字缩小了，仿佛被抽干了气，软塌塌地掉到地上，Nane 脸上挂着嘲讽。小 Dolos 试图把字重新举起来，身后是真 Macario 原版宣传全息片的戏仿剪辑版，可那些字软得实在别扭，最后他只能扬起双臂，气恼地生闷气。

entries.en:
"Methinks," Nane's head and voice tilt in a signature mid-sentence re-pitch, "a little spider's web of lies is looking a lit...tle convenient when you consider recent events..."

A tiny Hector and Achilles join the mini-Dolos, though child-sized even to him.

Immediately, they begin to fight, and for a moment it looks like Dolos might play the adult before - being the blackguard he is - tries to smack Achilles. With comic irony, little bully Hector sweeps Achilles' legs, allowing Dolos' hand to connect with Hector instead, and...

Meanwhile, a fat little Horacio Caden appears, completely unaware of the conflict, stumbling with a bottle in hand...
entries.zh:
"依我看，\" Nane 的头与声音在句中标志性地一偏，语调随之一变，\"一张小小的谎言蛛网，放到近来这些事里去看，可就显得有那么...点儿太方便了..."

一个小小的 Hector 和 Achilles 加入进来，站在小 Dolos 旁边，个头却连对他都算孩童尺寸。

他们立刻打作一团，有一瞬间，倒像是 Dolos 要扮演一回大人——可紧接着，他这个恶棍就去扇 Achilles 了。讽刺的是，小恶霸 Hector 一记扫腿把 Achilles 绊倒，让 Dolos 的手正好落在 Hector 身上，于是...

与此同时，一个胖乎乎的小 Horacio Caden 出现，完全没察觉那边的冲突，手里拎着酒瓶摇摇晃晃地走过来...

entries.en:
Nane's arms lift, sweeping away the whole comic-bizarre scene. The image dims and desaturates.

"I'm just your lovely everyday holo-friend, fellow Syzygens, but even I didn't have to look too close before the official story started unraveling. But first-"

Nane pivots seamlessly into an ad-read for an esoteric insurance scheme. A few spacers close to the bar grow bored and, at their behest, the bartender adjusts the holo stream.
entries.zh:
Nane 抬起双臂，把整幅滑稽荒诞的场景一扫而空。影像转暗，褪去色彩。

"我不过是你们可爱的日常全息朋友，各位 Syzygen 同胞，可就连我也不用凑得太近，官方的说法就开始崩线了。不过首先——"

Nane 无缝转进一段玄乎保险方案的广告口播。吧台边几个太空人听腻了，应他们要求，酒保调了调全息流。

entries.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what you paid Arroyo to arrange.
entries.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定是你花钱请 Arroyo 安排的那一出。

entries.en: Whatever that was, it seems to have been designed to undermine Macario's efforts to destroy your reputation by making a farce of him and his narrative of somber outrage.
entries.zh: 不管那是什么，看来目的都是要拆 Macario 的台：他本想毁掉你的名声，如今他自己和他那套沉痛义愤的说辞反倒成了笑柄。

entries.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what Fortuna Kato arranged to help with your reputation. You shake your head to think that part of Gens Kato's budget went to pay for it.
entries.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定都是 Fortuna Kato 为帮你挽回名声安排的那一出。想到 Kato 氏族的预算有一部分花在了这上面，你不禁摇头。

entries.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what Orcus Rao arranged to help with your reputation. You shake your head to think that part of the Hegemony's black-ops budget went to pay for it.
entries.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定都是 Orcus Rao 为帮你挽回名声安排的那一出。想到霸主的黑色行动预算有一部分花在了这上面，你不禁摇头。

entries.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what you paid Faro Inesis to arrange.
entries.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定是你花钱请 Faro Inesis 安排的那一出。

entries.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what Finlay Siyavong arranged to help with your reputation. You shake your head to think that part of the Persean League's black-ops budget went to pay for it.
entries.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定都是 Finlay Siyavong 为帮你挽回名声安排的那一出。想到英仙座联盟的黑色行动预算有一部分花在了这上面，你不禁摇头。

entries.en:
Hopefully it works.

As if in answer, a couple of spacers walking by do a double-take in recognition and... it's not fear, or hatred, but awkward acknowledgement. Their look seems to say 'dirt-siders, right? Mistake to trust them'.

You look back to the bar.
entries.zh:
但愿这有用。

像是回应一般，几个路过的太空人认出你来，愣了一下，回头又看——那神情不是恐惧，也不是憎恨，而是尴尬的会意。他们的眼神仿佛在说：'地面人嘛，对吧？信他们就是个错'。

你转回头看向吧台。

entries.en:
The holo-stream at the center of the bar catches your eye as you spot a familiar face.

Your own.
entries.zh:
酒吧中央的全息流吸引了你的目光，你在上面看见一张熟面孔。

你自己的。

o.en: Lean back into the shadow a little more, and watch
o.zh: 再往阴影里靠一靠，静静看着

entries.en: The bartender dutifully acknowledges your shout with a gesture, and the volume increases noticeably.
entries.zh: 酒保尽职地抬手应了你的喊声，音量明显调高了。

entries.en:
Your face in the holo is replaced by that of one 'Syzygy Nane', a holo-star out of Westernesse - notable as a striking example of cosmetic modification achieving a mode of avant-garde which doesn't quite dip into outlandishness, but, at least, orbits it.

And they're talking about you.

"-from those official Sindrian holos, then I have a space elevator to sell you!"

Laughter. Audience reaction shot - assembled by software in what must have been real-time from viewers within reasonable lightspeed delay, the crowd demonstrates a peculiar mix of fashion and holo-avatars.
entries.zh:
你在全息影像里的脸被换成了"Syzygy Nane"——一位来自 Westernesse 的全息明星，堪称整容改造的醒目范例：那副前卫做派始终没真滑向怪诞，但至少绕着它打转。

而且他们正在谈论你。

"——这些话要是出自辛达的官方全息片，那我这儿还有台太空电梯要卖给你！"

笑声。观众反应镜头——想必是由软件从光速延迟范围内的观众那里实时汇编而成，人群呈现出时尚与全息化身混杂交错的怪相。

entries.en:
An ominous chord is struck, summoning banners of the Sindrian Diktat. A tiny, dancing Dolos Macario, his head over-large, like a child's puppet appears from between them.

Nane provides his voice, squeaking and whining about the 'degenerate spacer, mass-murderer $playerName!' overtop a small feed of the Sindrian Diktat propaganda - sped up, altered to look cheap and tawdry, somehow, its somber outrage undermined with effects trickery.

"Maybe," says Nane reasonably, setting aside the mini-Dolos voice, "there's something more to the story..."
entries.zh:
一段不祥的和弦响起，辛达强权的旗帜随之浮现。一个小小的、跳着舞的 Dolos Macario，脑袋大得不成比例，像个孩童玩偶，从旗帜之间钻了出来。

Nane 替他配音，尖声尖气地抱怨着那个'堕落太空人、杀人魔 $playerName！'，背景是一小段辛达强权的宣传片——被调了速度、改得廉价粗劣，那股庄重义愤不知怎么就败在了特效把戏之下。

"也许，\" Nane 收起小 Dolos 的嗓音，通情达理地说，\"这故事背后还有别的东西..."

entries.en:
Nane narrates, making you out to be not so much a mass-murderer as a luckless spacer. Well-intentioned on the whole, if a bit naive.

It plays a bit into the unfortunate stereotype of the dazed, undersocialized spacer who is taken advantage of by fast-talking, cosmopolitan dirt-siders.

Your reappearance in the holo breaks your stream of thought away from musing on your self-image.
entries.zh:
Nane 娓娓道来，把你塑造成一个不太像杀人魔、倒更像倒霉太空人的角色。总体上心地不坏，只是有点天真。

这多少迎合了那个不幸的刻板印象：一个懵懂、不善交际的太空人，被油嘴滑舌的都市地面人占了便宜。

你在全息影像里再次露面，打断了你对自我形象的沉思。

entries.en:
There you are again, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy. Cut to outside of Hercules' office. You knock, and are let in. Time compression; a moment later Benoit leaves.

Time returns to its normal flow as a figure, blurred by active camo, appears and suddenly fires through the door. They pause a moment to shift their weapon and toss a grenade through the shredded doorway.

More fighting.

It ends showing you stumbling, dazed, from the ruined office, held up by two emergency response technicians. A victim.
entries.zh:
又是你，正走过 Galatia 学院的门厅。镜头切到 Hercules 办公室门外。你敲门，被让了进去。时间被压缩；片刻之后，Benoit 走了出来。

时间恢复常速，一个被主动伪装模糊着的身影现身，突然朝门内开火。他们停顿片刻，调整武器，往支离破碎的门口扔进一枚手雷。

更多交火。

最后是你在两名应急响应技师的搀扶下，恍惚地从残破的办公室走出来。一个受害者。

entries.en:
There you are again, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy. Cut to outside of an academician's office. You recognize it - presumably the spot where an attack was carried out on Hercules Cyrino.

You reflect that you still have no idea if he survived or not.

Cut to port logs, a quick cross. your $shipOrFleet the date highlights. Other side: surveillance feed of the office, its door caught receiving fire from a frag burst - frozen in time. Timestamped. Nane appears between them, examining one, then the other.

"How odd," Nane says, with a quizzical look. "I may just be a humble drop-out, but it looks like they don't match?"
entries.zh:
又是你，正走过 Galatia 学院的门厅。镜头切到一位院士的办公室外。你认得这里——想必就是 Hercules Cyrino 遇袭的地点。

你回想起来，自己至今不知道他是否活了下来。

镜头切到港口记录，一个快速的对照。你的 $shipOrFleet，日期被高亮标出。另一侧：办公室的监控画面，房门正被一枚破片弹击中——时间凝固。带时间戳。Nane 出现在两者之间，先看一个，再看另一个。

"真奇怪，\" Nane 面露疑惑，\"我可能只是个不值一提的退学生，可这两边看着对不上啊？"

entries.en:
"-more excitement than I ever had in tertiary education, and believe me, we knew how to party!"

This, to mini-Dolos, who nods and begins to dance.

"But" Nane gives mini-Dolos a little shove, and he falls on his bottom. "It's pretty obvious $playerName was the target of-"

Did Provost Baird cooperate to provide this security feed?

A bribe, or a hack?
entries.zh:
"——比我在大学时代经历过的任何刺激都多，相信我，我们那会儿可会玩了！"

这话是对小 Dolos 说的，他点点头，跳起舞来。

"不过——\" Nane 轻轻推了小 Dolos 一把，他一屁股坐倒在地。\"明摆着，$playerName 才是目标——"

是院长 Baird 配合提供了这段监控画面吗？

是贿赂，还是入侵？

entries.en:
"-a good time on Qaras," Nane continues, "believe me, you DON'T want to-"

There you are again, a grainy security sensor feed outside the bar. A huge goon puts a gun in your face...

"-can you believe this?"

Laughter. Audience reaction shots. A gesture and some meaningless words referencing some youth trend that hasn't broken out of the Westernesse system quite yet.
entries.zh:
"——在 Qaras 玩得开心，\" Nane 接着说，\"相信我，你绝对不想——"

又是你，酒吧外一段满是噪点的保安传感器画面。一个彪形大汉把枪口顶到你脸上...

"——你敢信吗？"

笑声。观众反应镜头。一个手势，外加几句没什么意义的词，引用了某种还没传出 Westernesse 星系的青年潮流。

entries.en:
"Impossible," $heOrShe says. "You understand that your commission was stripped by order of the Supreme Executor? Whatever the present circumstance, to contravene the will of the Supreme Executor carries a sentence of death."

The $rank takes a breath and calms $himOrHerself.

"Only the Supreme Executor can restore your commission, $playerName."
entries.zh:
"不可能。\"$heOrShe说，\"你该明白，你的委任状是最高元首下令剥夺的？不论眼下是什么情形，违逆最高元首的意志，都是死罪。"

这位$rank深吸一口气，$himOrHerself定了定神。

"只有最高元首才能恢复你的委任状，$playerName。"

entries.en:
"Impossible," $heOrShe says. "We are in a state of existential war... the situation is quite extraordinary. One can't be too careful of treachery, turn-coats, and mutineers!"

The $rank takes a breath and calms $himOrHerself.

"Besides, there has been an official decree - only the Supreme Executor can approve a new commission, $playerName."
entries.zh:
"不可能。\"$heOrShe说，\"我们正处在生死存亡的战争状态...局面非常特殊。对背叛、变节者和哗变者，再怎么小心都不为过！"

这位$rank深吸一口气，$himOrHerself定了定神。

"再说，已有正式法令——新委任状只能由最高元首批准，$playerName。"

entries.en:
Fortuna appears.

"$TitlePL $PlayerName. I expect to see you soon at Yesod."

"Perhaps we will speak further after your conversation with Achilles," she says.
entries.zh:
Fortuna 出现在画面里。

"$TitlePL $PlayerName，盼着早日在 Yesod 见到你。"

"等你和 Achilles 谈完，或许我们再细聊，" 她说道。

entries.en:
Your inquiry is rapidly answered.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Successful contact was initiated by the subject and pick-up arrangements were made." A nervous look. "It was a short timescale, very recent... we had to act before we could confirm with you."

"But he didn't show. No further contact attempt was made. And no hard confirmation on who contacted us - they just... claimed to be Hercules. Text only. We have no additional information on the situation."
entries.zh:
你的询问很快得到了答复。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。目标主动发起了通讯，联系成功，接应安排也已定下。\"对方不安地瞥了一眼。\"时间非常紧，就在不久前...我们来不及先向你确认就动手了。"

"可他没有出现。之后也没再尝试联系。而且我们无法确认对方是谁——那人只是...自称 Hercules。只有文字。关于目前的情况，我们没有更多情报。"

o.en: You acted appropriately. Continue the operation, but be very careful.
o.zh: 你们的处置是对的。行动继续，但务必谨慎。

o.en: Disappointing. I want to be contacted as soon as anything changes!
o.zh: 让人失望。一有变化，立刻通知我！

entries.en: "Yes, $playerSirOrMadam. Acknowledged. Will do."
entries.zh: "是，$playerSirOrMadam。明白。照办。"

entries.en: "Yes, $playerSirOrMadam. Will do."
entries.zh: "是，$playerSirOrMadam。照办。"

entries.en:
Your inquiry is rapidly answered.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. No change in the situation. Operation is ongoing."
entries.zh:
你的询问很快得到了答复。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。情况没有变化。行动仍在进行。"

o.en: Good. Keep it up and tell me if you find anything.
o.zh: 很好。继续，有发现就报我。

o.en: I want you to go quiet, don't attract attention. But keep the line open if he comms.
o.zh: 我要你们静下来，别引人注意。但他要是来通讯，线得通着。

entries.en: "You speak with conviction and clarity. I shall seriously consider your counsel, $titlePL."
entries.zh: "您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我会认真想想您的劝，$titlePL。"

entries.en: He pauses. "I appreciated your... discretion. With the Menes situation. Now too."
entries.zh: 他顿了顿。"我很感激你的...谨慎。在 Menes 那件事上。这一次也一样。"

entries.en: He pauses. "Your assistance in opening contact with High Hegemon Daud was much appreciated. Now, too."
entries.zh: 他顿了顿。"你帮忙打通了与至高霸主 Daud 的联络，我很领情。这一次也一样。"

entries.en: He pauses. "Your assistance in opening contact with the High Hegemon was much appreciated," he says. "To say nothing of your... discretion with the Menes situation. Just so, now."
entries.zh: 他顿了顿。"你帮忙打通了与至高霸主的联络，我很领情，"他说，"更不必说你在 Menes 那件事上的...谨慎。这一次也一样。"

entries.en:
"You speak with conviction and clarity. I believe... I do believe I shall do as you suggest, $titlePL."

He still looks uneasy, but a sense of confidence in having made a hard decision settles in his expression.
entries.zh:
"您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我想... 我确是打算照您说的办了，$titlePL。"

他神色仍有些不安，可难下的决心既已拿定，眉宇间倒添了几分沉稳。

entries.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I have inquiries and envoys to send, if you do not mind."
entries.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我还有几处要探问，几个使节要派出去，希望你不介意。"

entries.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall have to arrange a meeting with Fortuna Kato. It's time we spoke vis-a-vis."
entries.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我就得安排一次与 Fortuna Kato 的会面了。该是我们当面谈一谈的时候了。"

entries.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall meet Fortuna Kato as soon as possible. It's time we spoke vis-a-vis."
entries.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我会尽快去见 Fortuna Kato。该是我们当面谈一谈的时候了。"

entries.en: "I must speak with my envoys, reach out to certain contacts. There is much to arrange. We must speak again when the conflict breaks into the open."
entries.zh: "我得和我的使节们谈谈，联络一些人。要安排的事很多。等冲突摆到明面上，我们必须再谈一次。"

entries.en:
"In truth, I've had my eyes on the Askonia situation for some time. The history of Opis, of... Andrada. It is at the center of the conflict between League and Hegemony."

He waves a hand, brushing the past away.

"There is a man, a contact, on Nortia. He is an organizer for the Askonia Charterist Alliance. The Hegemony favors his organization."

"So shall I. Give him supplies, fuel, credits - whatever he needs. My people will arrange a meeting."
entries.zh:
"说实话，Askonia 的局势我盯了有些时候了。Opis 的历史，还有...Andrada。这里正是联盟与霸主冲突的中心。"

他摆了摆手，把那些过往挥到一边。

"Nortia 上有个人，我的一个关系人。他是 Askonia 宪章派同盟的组织者。霸主那边是看好他这一伙的。"

"我也一样。给他补给、燃料、星币——他要什么就给什么。我的人会安排一次会面。"

o.en: Arnaud Iscare? I've spoken with him already, yes.
o.zh: Arnaud Iscare？我已经和他谈过了，是的。

o.en: Arnaud Iscare? I've already given him everything the ACA required.
o.zh: Arnaud Iscare？ACA 要的东西，我已经全给他了。

entries.en:
Horus sounds more confident somehow, a new sense of purpose driving him as he lays out plans.

"I'll have my Gens provide you with a warehouse on Kazeron containing everything you need. And credits."
entries.zh:
Horus 的声音不知不觉间多了几分底气；一种新的目标感驱使着他，把计划一条条铺开。

"我让氏族在 Kazeron 给你备一处仓库，你要的东西里头都有。还有星币。"

entries.en:
Horus furrows his brow as he taps at a datapad. Then looks up.

"That was you? Stars above... of course." He smiles, a new sense of purpose driving him. "Nonetheless, I'll have my Gens provide you with a warehouse on Kazeron with fuel and supplies. I expect that you may have other contacts, or means, that might assist... our cause."
entries.zh:
Horus 皱着眉，在数据板上点了几下，然后抬起头。

"那是你做的？群星在上...当然。\"他笑了，一种新的目标感驱使着他。\"不管怎样，我让氏族在 Kazeron 给你备一处仓库，里头有燃料和补给。我想你也许还有别的关系，或者别的门路，能帮上...我们这桩事业。"

entries.en:
"Oh, that is most fortuitous! A most driven man, is he not?"

He smiles, a new sense of purpose driving him. "I'll have my Gens provide you with a warehouse on Kazeron containing everything you need."
entries.zh:
"哦，那可太巧了！那人干劲十足，不是吗？"

他笑了，一种新的目标感驱使着他。"我让氏族在 Kazeron 给你备一处仓库，你要的东西里头都有。"

entries.en:
"I ask, also, that you assist the rebels however you might, even those who may be somewhat at cross-purpose with the ACA. Our cause is to correct where the Hegemony went so wrong - the Sindrian Diktat itself must be destroyed, no matter which clone of the arch-mutineer would lead it."

"Andrada made many enemies - most of all the Hegemony - and they will thank us for helping them."
entries.zh:
"另外，我还想请你不论用什么法子，都尽量帮一把那些叛军——哪怕其中有些人和 ACA 的宗旨不尽一致。我们要做的，是纠正霸主当年错得太离谱的地方——辛达强权本身必须被摧毁，不管坐上那位子的是那个老叛徒的哪一具克隆体。"

"Andrada 树敌无数——其中最恨他的就是霸主——我们帮他们一把，他们会感激我们的。"

entries.en:
"We must..."

He pauses.

"Do I have your support in what I aim to accomplish? I would be remiss not to ask you explicitly. You are not my employee, nor am I your patron."
entries.zh:
"我们必须..."

他顿住了。

"我要做的这件事，能得到你的支持吗？不把这话明明白白问出口，就是我的失礼。你不是我的下属，我也不是你的东家。"

o.en: Of course. I consider us partners in this endeavor.
o.zh: 当然。这件事上，我视我们为伙伴。

o.en: No, you chose your path. I must choose my own.
o.zh: 不。你选了你自己的路。我也得走我自己的。

entries.en: "I am glad to hear that." His smile is genuine.
entries.zh: "听你这么说，我很高兴。"他的笑容是真的。

entries.en: "You speak with conviction and clarity," he says. "I shall consider your counsel, $titlePL."
entries.zh: "您这话说得恳切，也说得明白，\" 他说道，\"您的劝，我会放在心上，$titlePL。"

entries.en: "You speak with conviction and clarity," he says. "I shall consider your counsel, $titlePL."
entries.zh: "您这话说得恳切，也说得明白，\" 他说道，\"您的劝，我会放在心上，$titlePL。"

entries.en:
"Don't forget, $titlePL - speak with Finlay Siyavong. But remember above all that he cannot give you orders, only advice. You need not do as he says."

Horus picks up his TriPad again, and hums approvingly as he flicks through notifications. He looks up.

"I believe that is all?"
entries.zh:
"别忘了，$titlePL——去和 Finlay Siyavong 谈谈。但最要紧的是记住：他只能给你建议，不能给你下命令。你不必照他说的做。"

Horus 又拿起他的 TriPad，一边翻着通知一边满意地哼了一声。他抬起头。

"我想，就这些了？"

entries.en:
Horus picks up his TriPad again, and hums approvingly as he flicks through notifications. He looks up.

"I believe that is all?"
entries.zh:
Horus 又拿起他的 TriPad，一边翻着通知一边满意地哼了一声。他抬起头。

"我想，就这些了？"

Horus picks up his TriPad again, and hums approvingly as he flicks through notifications. He looks up.

"I believe that is all?"
