"我想，就这些了？"

entries.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall make inquiries with the office of the Prime Demarchon to ascertain Reynard's policies concerning Gens Kato. Common orbit may yet be found."
entries.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我会向大统领办公室探问一番，弄清 Reynard 对 Kato 氏族是什么政策。说不定还能找到共同的轨道。"

entries.en: "Well then," he sits up. "I shall reach out to the office of the Prime Demarchon and offer my support against Fortuna's reckless plans."
entries.zh: "那好，\"他坐直身子，\"我会联络大统领办公室，表示我支持他们对付 Fortuna 这鲁莽的计划。"

entries.en:
At once, his jaw tightens in anger, and he almost speaks.

But after a moment he releases a breath, appearing to accept the validity of your criticism.

"You are correct," hey says, eyes closed, "$titlePL. It is my burden and duty to lead."
entries.zh:
他的牙关一下子咬紧，怒意上涌，几乎就要开口。

可过了片刻，他吐出一口气，似乎接受了你的批评确有它的道理。

"你说得对，\"他闭着眼说，\"$titlePL。领导是我的重负，也是我的职责。"

entries.en:
He takes a deep breath.

"This appears to be turning into a Second Askonia Crisis. And I fear it is an opportunity to work toward the goal I have elaborated previously - to take a step, perhaps, toward bringing the Persean Sector together."

"Reconciliation with the Hegemony," he says softly.

Horus looks through the link. "It is you that provided me with what I needed - a direct, secure line of communication with the High Hegemon. And now I am presented with the opportunity where concrete action can be taken. It feels like a cliff, but... to fly, you must believe."

"Thank you, $titlePL." He smiles, in a far-off way. "For clarity."
entries.zh:
他深吸一口气。

"这眼看着要变成第二次 Askonia 危机了。而我担心，这也正是个机会，让我能朝先前详细说过的那桩目标推进——也许，是朝着让英仙座星域重归一统，迈出一步。"

"与霸主和解，"他轻声说。

Horus 透过链路望着你。"是你给了我需要的东西——一条直通至高霸主的、安全可靠的联络线。而现在，一个能真正做点实事的机会就摆在面前。这感觉像是站在悬崖上，可...想要飞起来，你就得信。"

"谢谢你，$titlePL。\"他笑了笑，神思仿佛在别处。\"为这份清醒。"

entries.en:
"Sides, sides, hm," he rubs his chin. "There are many forces at work here, $titlePL. Many perspectives to consider."

"I'm, I'm-" Horus coughs and clears his throat, then is discouraged to find that the question has become no easier to answer.

"Perhaps I shall take a cautious approach," he concludes. "Wait and see in order to act at an appropriate time."
entries.zh:
"站边，站边，嗯，\"他搓着下巴，\"这里头有许多股力量在动，$titlePL。要考虑的立场太多了。"

"我，我——"Horus 咳了一声，清清嗓子，随即沮丧地发现这个问题并没有变得更好回答。

"也许我该走稳妥的路子，\"他最后说，\"先看着，等到合适的时机再动手。"

entries.en: "A wise move, I'm sure," Horus says uneasily.
entries.zh: "想必是明智之举，"Horus 不安地说。

entries.en: "A wise move, I'm sure," Horus says uneasily.
entries.zh: "想必是明智之举，"Horus 不安地说。

entries.en: "A wise move, I'm sure," Horus says uneasily.
entries.zh: "想必是明智之举，"Horus 不安地说。

entries.en: "You truly believe I ought? It would be undermining the Prime Demarchon... it may weaken the League. Fortuna and I agree on many things, and much to do with Reynard, but her vision is," he considers his words. "It is limited, and I think stubbornly small-minded in some respects. Take for instance her bigotry against the Luddics..."
entries.zh: "你真觉得我该这么做？那等于拆大统领的台...也许会削弱联盟。Fortuna 和我在许多事上看法一致，在关于 Reynard 的事上更是如此，可她的眼界，\"他斟酌着用词，\"是有限的，而且我认为在某些方面固执得有些小家子气。就拿她对卢德派的偏见来说..."

o.en: Nothing else will break Reynard's strangehold. You must support Fortuna.
o.zh: 除此之外，再也破不了 Reynard 的钳制。你必须支持 Fortuna。

o.en: On second thought, there's much to consider. (back)
o.zh: 再想想，这事还得再琢磨琢磨。 (返回)

entries.en:
"You truly believe so?"

He looks strained. "I suppose my Gens has much to gain if Fortuna's plans fail. And to be second is no shameful thing. I must look first to the safety of Gens Yaribay...our future is inexorably bound to Gens Hannan given the present state of affairs."

He pauses, then muses, "There will always be more opportunities, in time..."
entries.zh:
"你真这么认为？"

他面色绷紧。"我想，如果 Fortuna 的计划失败，我的氏族能得的好处不少。屈居第二也并非什么丢人的事。我得首先顾全 Yaribay 氏族的安危...以眼下的局面，我们的前途和 Hannan 氏族已经死死绑在一起了。"

他顿了顿，若有所思："假以时日，机会总是会有的..."

o.en: Do it. Gens Yaribay will be rewarded for your loyalty.
o.zh: 放手去做。您这份忠心，Yaribay 氏族会得到回报。

o.en: On second thought, there's much to consider. (back)
o.zh: 再想想，这事还得再琢磨琢磨。 (返回)

entries.en: "As you would have it," Horus says, frown growing.
entries.zh: "那就随你的意，"Horus 说着，眉头越皱越紧。

entries.en: "As you would have it," Horus says, frown growing.
entries.zh: "那就随你的意，"Horus 说着，眉头越皱越紧。

entries.en: "As you would have it," Horus says, frown growing.
entries.zh: "那就随你的意，"Horus 说着，眉头越皱越紧。

entries.en:
"The Hegemony," he says.

"It's risky, very risky. They must destroy the Sindrian Diktat as a polity. There is sure to be much chaos in the aftermath..."
entries.zh:
"霸主，"他说。

"这很冒险，非常冒险。他们必须把辛达强权作为一个政权彻底打掉。事后必定是一片大乱..."

o.en: You must, though. This is your chance!
o.zh: 可你必须这么做。这是你的机会！

o.en: On second thought, there's much to consider. (back)
o.zh: 再想想，这事还得再琢磨琢磨。 (返回)

entries.en:
"Firstly it implies a diminishment. She could have simply contacted me herself as a sign of respect. But it may also serve as an affordance which concedes to me a greater range of response. Were I to deny her in a direct negotiation, it might close the door of possibility upon certain concessions due to a perceived loss of face. So in another sense, she is requesting terms. A counter-proposal."

He appears to consider the possibilities in a signalling-game perhaps too subtle for an outsider to the Gens system to quite appreciate.

Or he's overthinking it.
entries.zh:
"首先，这等于把我看低了一层。她本可以亲自联络我，以示尊重。但这同时也可能是一种姿态，等于主动给了我更大的回旋余地。倘若我在直接谈判中拒绝她，那么由于她自觉失了颜面，某些让步的大门也许就此关死。所以换个角度看，她是在开条件。是一份反提案。"

他似乎正在推演一场信号博弈里的种种可能——那微妙之处，氏族体系之外的人恐怕难以体会。

又或者，是他想多了。

entries.en:
"Of course," he says after a long pause, "this means Achilles will make a counter-declaration."

He looks at you through the link. "Very soon."
entries.zh:
"当然，\"他沉默良久才开口，\"这意味着 Achilles 也会发表一份针锋相对的声明。"

他隔着链路看着你。"很快。"

o.en: Have you decided which side Gens Yaribay will support in Askonia?
o.zh: 你想好了吗，Yaribay 氏族在 Askonia 会站哪一边？

o.en: Listen to yourself, Horus! You lead a great Gens, you must be decisive!
o.zh: 听听你自己在说什么，Horus！你执掌着一个大氏族，就得拿出决断来！

o.en: I suggest you back Fortuna's plan for Achilles.
o.zh: 我建议你支持 Fortuna 对 Achilles 的那套计划。

o.en: I suggest you back Reynard against Fortuna's crazy scheme.
o.zh: 我建议你站在 Reynard 一边，反对 Fortuna 这个疯狂的计划。

o.en: You need to choose yourself. By backing the Hegemony.
o.zh: 你得自己拿主意。就选支持霸主。

o.en: Yes, we should wait before taking action. (delay)
o.zh: 对，我们该再等等，先别动手。 (拖延)

o.en: I should tell you about Fortuna Kato's plans for Achilles Andrada. (explain)
o.zh: 我该告诉你 Fortuna Kato 对 Achilles Andrada 的打算。 (解释)

entries.en: "How many capital ships does he have?"
entries.zh: "他手上有多少主力舰？"

entries.en:
Her expression doesn't visibly change, but somehow Hyder looks even less impressed now than she did before.

She closes her eyes and rubs the bridge of her nose, as if warding off an impending headache.
entries.zh:
她的表情看不出变化，可 Hyder 现在似乎比刚才更不以为然了。

她闭上眼，揉了揉鼻梁，像是在压住一场快要发作的头痛。

entries.en:
"A historian?"

Hyder doesn't look impressed.
entries.zh:
"历史学者？"

Hyder 一脸不以为然。

entries.en:
"An academician."

Hyder doesn't look impressed.
entries.zh:
"一位院士？"

Hyder 一脸不以为然。

entries.en:
"Rao."

There's a change in her voice.

"He hates me, you know," she says. "He hates us all. You cannot understand unless you were there."
entries.zh:
"Rao。"

她的声音变了。

"他恨我，你知道的，\"她说。\"他恨我们所有人。除非你当时在场，否则你不会明白。"

o.en: Maybe. But his loyalty to the Hegemony is greater than his hatred for you.
o.zh: 也许。但他对霸主的忠诚，胜过对你的恨意。

o.en: It doesn't matter what he thinks. It matters what you are going to do.
o.zh: 他怎么想无关紧要。重要的是你打算怎么做。

entries.en:
She looks into the feed.

"And what good does that do me?"
entries.zh:
她望向通讯画面。

"那对我有什么好处？"

entries.en:
"Yes." She looks directly into the feed.

Uncertain. And working hard not to show it.
entries.zh:
"是。"她直直望向通讯画面。

心里没底。而且正竭力不露出来。

entries.en:
Her eyebrows raise.

"Really. You can prove this? I would-" She pauses, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.

"Don't apologize, you've already interrupted. Report."

She listens, and as she does her eyes turn back to you.

It's not exactly fear you see; she's known battle and knows how to control fear. It's a look of threat-assessment, perhaps triage. Anticipation of casualties.
entries.zh:
她挑了挑眉。

"当真。你能证明？我倒——"她话没说完，抬手按住耳侧，转过身去。

"别道歉了，你都打断了。报告。"

她听着，目光也随之转回你身上。

你看到的算不上恐惧；她经历过战阵，懂得如何压住恐惧。那是一种评估威胁的目光，或许是在做分诊式的盘算——预先清点将有多少伤亡。

entries.en:
There's a small voice in your ear now, too.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam."

It's your comms officer. You're not sure they've ever interrupted one of your private conversations like this.
entries.zh:
这时，你耳中也响起一个细小的声音。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam."

是你的通讯军官。你记不清他们何时这样打断过你的私人通话。

entries.en:
She looks up.

"This means that-" She pauses, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.

"Don't apologize, you've already interrupted. Report."

She listens, and as she does her eyes turn back to you.

It's not exactly fear you see; she's known battle and knows how to control fear. It's a look of threat-assessment, perhaps triage. Anticipation of casualties.
entries.zh:
她抬起头。

"这意味着——"她话没说完，抬手按住耳侧，转过身去。

"别道歉了，你都打断了。报告。"

她听着，目光也随之转回你身上。

你看到的算不上恐惧；她经历过战阵，懂得如何压住恐惧。那是一种评估威胁的目光，或许是在做分诊式的盘算——预先清点将有多少伤亡。

entries.en:
"Last we spoke you were acting as Macario's minion. Now you're declared his arch-nemesis, a terrorist and murderer. To speak with you is treason."

"Was betrayal your reward? Not that I believe Dolos, of course."

Her expression doesn't soften.

"Not the way he tells it, anyway. Were the killings just a job? Or are you another convenient Spider's patsy whose worth is spent?"
entries.zh:
"上次我们说话时，你还是 Macario 的走狗。如今你被宣布为他的头号死敌、恐怖分子和杀人犯。跟你说话就是叛国。"

"背叛就是你的报酬？当然，我并不相信 Dolos 的说辞。"

她的神色没有缓和。

"至少不像他说的那样。那些谋杀只是一桩差事吗？还是说，你又是蜘蛛随手用完即弃的替罪羊，价值已经耗尽？"

o.en: It isn't like that at all. Let me explain, I have proof. (explain)
o.zh: 根本不是那么回事。让我解释，我有证据。 (解释)

o.en: What I have to say is more important than old disagreements.
o.zh: 我要说的事，比旧日的分歧重要得多。

o.en: We must join together against Macario - he threatens Philip Andrada's glorious legacy!
o.zh: 我们必须联手对抗 Macario——他威胁的是 Philip Andrada 光辉的遗业！

entries.en:
"Captain $PlayerName." She pauses, then takes a deep breath.

"I do not believe Macario. At least, I don't believe whatever has happened went the way he tells it. The entire announcement... secret heirs, after all this time?"

She looks at you, suspicious, but clearly wanting answers.
entries.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"她顿了顿，深吸一口气。

"我不信 Macario。至少，我不信发生的一切真像他说的那样。整场宣告...秘密继承人，过了这么久才冒出来？"

她看着你，满腹狐疑，可显然是在等一个答案。

o.en: The existence of Andrada's clone-sons is the true part, actually.
o.zh: 不过，Andrada 有几个克隆儿子，这部分倒是真的。

entries.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

She pauses, then takes a deep, deliberate breath.

"I do not believe the news, the lies, which Macario has spread concerning you. I can only imagine he is, once more, attempting to tarnish the reputation of an honorable leader."

"Besides," she says, shaking her head, "...secret heirs, hidden conspiracies suddenly revealed? After all this time?"
entries.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"

她顿了顿，刻意地深吸一口气。

"我不信 Macario 散布的关于你的那些消息、那些谎言。我只能认为，他又一次想抹黑一位可敬领袖的名声。"

"再说，"她摇着头说，"...秘密继承人、暗藏的阴谋突然被揭穿？过了这么多年？"

o.en: The existence of Andrada's clone-sons is true, actually.
o.zh: 其实，Andrada 的克隆儿子确实存在。

entries.en:
"You." She spits the word.

"I recall you all but declared yourself Supreme Executor the last time we spoke. You have no tact and less honor. You're nothing but Macario's pet imp, sent to tempt and corrupt."

"And now, what has happened? He's cut you loose? Declared you terrorist and murderer - for all I know it's true. Maybe it doesn't-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.
entries.zh:
"你。"她把这个字吐了出来。

"我记得上次谈话时，你几乎就要自封最高元首了。你毫无分寸，更无荣誉可言。你不过是 Macario 养的一只小恶魔，被派来引诱和腐蚀别人。"

"现在呢，出什么事了？他把你甩了？宣布你是恐怖分子和杀人犯——就我所知，这或许是真的。也许这并不——"

训斥到一半，她停了下来，伸手摸向耳边，转身避开。

entries.en:
"You." She spits the word.

"I recall you were Macario's lickspittle. Now he's cut you loose, it appears. Declared you his nemesis, a terrorist and murderer. For all I know it's true."

"I don't trust a word you-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.
entries.zh:
"你。"她把这个字吐了出来。

"我记得你是 Macario 的跟屁虫。现在看样子，他把你甩了。宣布你是他的死敌、恐怖分子和杀人犯。就我所知，这或许是真的。"

"你说的每一个字我都不信——"

训斥到一半，她停了下来，伸手摸向耳边，转身避开。

entries.en:
"You." She spits the word. "Macario's lickspittle."

"I see he's cut you loose, declared you his nemesis. A terrorist and murderer. For all I know it's true."

"Now you hack our comms? Not only do you have no honor, you waste your-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.
entries.zh:
"你。\"她把这个字吐了出来，\"Macario 的跟屁虫。"

"我看出来了，他把你甩了，宣布你是他的死敌。恐怖分子和杀人犯。就我所知，这或许是真的。"

"现在你还来黑我们的通讯？你不但毫无荣誉，还白白浪费你的——"

训斥到一半，她停了下来，伸手摸向耳边，转身避开。

entries.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

She pauses, then takes a deep, deliberate breath.

"I do not believe the news, the lies, which Macario has spread concerning you. I can only imagine he is, once more, attempting to tarnish the reputation of an honorable leader."

"Besides," she says, shaking her head, "if the files you gave me are all true..."
entries.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"

她顿了顿，刻意地深吸一口气。

"我不信 Macario 散布的关于你的那些消息、那些谎言。我只能认为，他又一次想抹黑一位可敬领袖的名声。"

"再说，"她摇着头说，"要是你给我的那些档案都是真的..."

o.en: They are. I've confirmed all of it.
o.zh: 都是真的。我全都核实过了。

entries.en:
"Captain $PlayerName."

She pauses, then takes a deep, deliberate breath.

"Much has happened. Philip, declared dead. Macario presenting this... clone of Philip as successor. Your files were real."
entries.zh:
"舰长 $PlayerName。"

她顿了顿，刻意地深吸一口气。

"发生了很多事。Philip，被宣布死亡。Macario 把 Philip 的...那个克隆体推出来当继承人。你的档案是真的。"

o.en: They are. I've confirmed all of it.
o.zh: 都是真的。我全都核实过了。

entries.en:
"Macario's... declaration about you. What he says you did. I must assume they are lies, for I don't believe you are a child-murderer. And Dolos will lie to cover the truth, habitually."

"How many of them live? The clones."
entries.zh:
"Macario 关于你的...那番宣告。他说你干过的那些事。我只能认定那是谎言，因为我不信你是会杀害孩童的人。而 Dolos 向来习惯用谎言掩盖真相。"

"他们还有几个活着？那些克隆体。"

o.en: It's complicated. But only one has serious backing- Achilles.
o.zh: 说来复杂。但只有一个有真正的靠山——Achilles。

entries.en: "The Persean League," she says. "Of course. Reynard Hannan is too proud of his own power to honor his word concerning the League's neutrality. And the League too decadent to stop him..."
entries.zh: "英仙座联盟，\"她说，\"果然。Reynard Hannan 对自己的权势太过自负，不会遵守他关于联盟中立的承诺。而联盟又太腐朽，拦不住他..."

o.en: In this case, Fortuna Kato appears to be the prime mover...
o.zh: 这一回，Fortuna Kato 似乎才是真正的推手...

entries.en:
"Is that so? That does align with recent intel concerning Gens Kato. It must be some deeper plot," she says, brow furrowed. "Kato would not be allowed to act unless Hannan approved, unless- who knows! It's all plot and counter-plot, receding forever."

She shakes her head, frustrated.
entries.zh:
"是吗？这倒和最近关于 Kato 氏族的情报对得上。背后必定还有更深的算计，\"她皱着眉说，\"没有 Hannan 点头，Kato 不可能擅自动手，除非——谁知道呢！全是阴谋与反阴谋，一环套一环，望不到头。"

她烦躁地摇了摇头。

entries.en:
"Your word is not enough. If you're lying, or wrong... that is treason."

Her expression only cools.

"Treason is death."
entries.zh:
"你的话不够。如果你在撒谎，或者搞错了...那就是叛国。"

她的神情只是更冷了。

"叛国，就是死。"

o.zh: 把 ANDRADA 文件发给 Hyder

o.en: It's the best I can do. Trust me.
o.zh: 我只能做到这一步。相信我。

o.en: This stubbornness is why you're going to find yourself in front of a firing squad.
o.zh: 就是这股倔劲，迟早会让你站到行刑队面前。

entries.en:
"I cannot," she says with cold finality.

"Do not contact me again. Hyder out."

The comms snap off.
entries.zh:
"我不能，"她说道，冷硬而决绝。

"不要再联系我。Hyder 完毕。"

通讯骤然中断。

entries.en:
Her eyes narrow.

"Threatening an officer is a capital crime, captain. I've been far too lenient in indulging your treasonous paranoia."

"No more chances. Vacate this orbit."

"Hyder out." The comms snap off.
entries.zh:
她眯起了眼睛。

"威胁一名军官是死罪，舰长。我对你那套叛国式的偏执，实在太过纵容了。"

"没有下一次了。离开这条轨道。"

"Hyder 完毕。"通讯骤然中断。

entries.en:
She nods, slowly. Pensive.

"Macario will be controlling the new Supreme Executor's comms. As he did, with time, Philip's."

Hyder considers for a moment, then her posture straightens. The tone of command enters her voice.

"Avoid the Sindrian Diktat fleets - we have our orders and will follow them to the death. If you've other allies, forces to marshal, some angle to play against Macario... seek them out. An opportunity will arise to make contact when open conflict becomes inevitable. Macario cannot personally control fleets comms in a time of war."
entries.zh:
她缓缓点头。若有所思。

"Macario 会控制新任最高元首的通讯。就像他当初随着时间推移，控制了 Philip 的一样。"

Hyder 思索片刻，随即挺直了身子。发号施令的语气回到她声音里。

"避开辛达强权的舰队——我们有自己的命令，会至死执行。如果你还有别的盟友、有能调动的兵力、有能用来对付 Macario 的门路...就去找他们。等公开冲突变得不可避免，接触的机会自然会出现。战时的舰队通讯，Macario 没法亲自控制。"

o.en: How will I know it is time?
o.zh: 我怎么知道什么时候是时机？

entries.en:
She closes her eyes, and takes a deep breath. Asserting calm.

"Macario will be controlling the new Supreme Executor's comms. As he did, in time, with Philip's."

Hyder considers for a moment, then her posture straightens. The tone of command re-enters her voice.

"Avoid the Sindrian Diktat fleets - it would not do well for the morale of the navy to be forced to report an escaped prisoner. If you've other allies, forces to marshal, some angle to play against Macario... seek them now. An opportunity shall arise to make contact with Hector when open conflict breaks out. Macario cannot personally control fleet comms in war."
entries.zh:
她闭上眼，深吸一口气。强自镇定。

"Macario 会控制新任最高元首的通讯。就像他当初一步步控制了 Philip 的一样。"

Hyder 思索片刻，随即挺直了身子。发号施令的语气又回到她声音里。

"避开辛达强权的舰队——要是海军被迫上报囚犯脱逃，对士气可不是好事。如果你还有别的盟友、有能调动的兵力、有能用来对付 Macario 的门路...现在就去找。等公开冲突爆发，与 Hector 接触的机会自然会出现。战时的舰队通讯，Macario 没法亲自控制。"

o.en: How will I know it is time?
o.zh: 我怎么知道什么时候是时机？

entries.en:
She is silent, but after a moment it comes to her.

"When the League-backed pretender makes his claim," she says. "As soon he must."
entries.zh:
她沉默着，但片刻之后，答案自己浮了上来。

"等那个有联盟撑腰的人出来争继承权的时候，\"她说。\"他迟早必须这么做。"

entries.en:
She is silent, but after a moment it comes to her.

"When the League-backed pretender makes his claim," she says. "As soon he must."
entries.zh:
她沉默着，但片刻之后，答案自己浮了上来。

"等那个有联盟撑腰的人出来争继承权的时候，\"她说。\"他迟早必须这么做。"

entries.en:
"That order was authorized by Philip Andrada, the-"

She stops herself, brow furrowed.

"Yes, I know that Philip did not himself sign the order. But Macario has such control of the executive bureaucracy... and an order authorized by the Supreme Executor cannot be revoked - except by the Supreme Executor."
entries.zh:
"那道命令是 Philip Andrada 批准的，那位——"

她收住话头，皱起眉。

"是的，我知道那道命令不是 Philip 亲笔签的。可 Macario 把行政官僚体系抓得那么紧...而最高元首授权的命令无法撤销——除非由最高元首本人来撤。"

o.en: What if the order was 'successfully' executed?
o.zh: 如果那道命令已经被'成功'执行了呢？

entries.en:
Hyder glares.

"I shall not lie. Especially not against the ultimate authority of the Supreme Executor's law."
entries.zh:
Hyder 瞪着你。

"我不会撒谎。尤其不会拿最高元首法律的至高权威来做假。"

o.en: Does the order require I be killed instantly?
o.zh: 那道命令要求立即处死我吗？

entries.en:
You receive another look of consternation.

Hyder lifts a TriPad and smashes through an unlock, then a query. She reads, rapidly, then her eyes return to the link.

"The order is built on a standard template employed against high-value terrorists." A tap and swipe. "Pre-amble is custom written for you. You know the details from Macario's speech. The list of crimes attributed to your name is... excessive."

She swipes a few times, scrolling rapidly through the document. "But the terms are boilerplate. It does not specify instant death, but 'delivery unto proper authorities such that' et cetera. And extended period of... interrogation is assumed."

Hyder looks back up at you, over the TriPad. Is that amusement?
entries.zh:
你又换来一记惊愕的目光。

Hyder 拿起一台 TriPad，飞快地解锁，随即调出一份检索。她迅速读着，目光随后回到通讯画面上。

"这道命令套的是对付高价值恐怖分子的标准模板。"她点了点，又划了一下。"开头部分是专门为你写的。细节你从 Macario 的演讲里已经知道了。挂在你名下的罪状清单...长得过分。"

她划了几下，快速翻过文件。"但条款都是套话。它没有写明要立即处死，只说'移交有关当局，以便'云云。而且还默认会有一段漫长的...审讯。"

Hyder 越过 TriPad 抬头看你。那算是在觉得有趣吗？

entries.en:
Hyder puts her hands behind her back, TriPad still held, and adopts a formal posture.

"I hereby accept the surrender of $playerName and place them into the sole authority of the Navy of the Sindrian Diktat pending prisoner debriefing, processing, and transfer made with safety arrangements appropriate to the present crisis."

"Thus order 044-25766 is fulfilled, and it shall be so communicated to the fleets and legions of the Sindrian Diktat."
entries.zh:
Hyder 把双手背到身后，TriPad 仍握在手里，摆出正式的姿态。

"本人特此接受 $playerName 的投降，并将其全权交由辛达强权海军处置，待完成战俘问询、处理，并按当前危机所需的安保安排进行移交。"

"至此，044-25766 号命令即告执行完毕，并将照此通报辛达强权的各舰队与军团。"

o.en: You're not bad at bending the rules when you put your mind to it.
o.zh: 你认真起来，钻规矩空子的本事倒不差。

entries.en: "This won't work for long," she says, voice tight. "You must contact Hector as soon as possible to... clean this up."
entries.zh: "这撑不了多久，\"她声音发紧。\"你必须尽快联系上 Hector，把这事...收拾干净。"

entries.en:
"Don't," she spits.

"This won't work for long," she says, voice tight. "You must contact Hector as soon as possible to... clean this up."
entries.zh:
"别说了，"她厉声道。

"这撑不了多久，\"她声音发紧。\"你必须尽快联系上 Hector，把这事...收拾干净。"

entries.en: She says nothing.
entries.zh: 她一言不发。

o.en: He said he can't guarantee a timeline.
o.zh: 他说，时间上他没法打包票。

entries.en: Her expression doesn't change.
entries.zh: 她的神情没有变化。

o.en: And he said you could surrender yourself to Hegemony agents on Nortia.
o.zh: 他还说，你可以在 Nortia 向霸主的代理人自首。

o.en: I need you to acknowledge that you understand what is offered.
o.zh: 我需要你明确表示，你明白对方开出了什么条件。

entries.en: Hyder nods, then looks down, silent.
entries.zh: Hyder 点点头，随即低下头，沉默不语。

o.en: Do you have any questions? Anything to tell Rao?
o.zh: 你有什么想问的吗？有什么话要带给 Rao？

entries.en:
Hyder nods, then looks down, silent for a moment.

"You offer the possibility of the good graces of Baikal Daud and the Hegemony bureaucracy. To, perhaps, set aside a death sentence for mutiny."
entries.zh:
Hyder 点点头，随即低下头，沉默了片刻。

"你给的是一个可能：Baikal Daud 与霸主官僚体系愿意施恩。也许，那道因叛乱罪判下的死刑也能就此作罢。"

o.en: Do you have any questions? Anything to tell Rao?
o.zh: 你有什么想问的吗？有什么话要带给 Rao？

entries.en: "Yes," she snaps. "I understand. The good grace of Baikal Daud and the Hegemony bureaucracy to set aside a death sentence for mutiny."
entries.zh: "对，\"她厉声道。\"我明白。Baikal Daud 与霸主官僚体系的恩典，能让那道因叛乱罪判下的死刑作罢。"

o.en: He said you could surrender yourself to Hegemony agents on Nortia.
o.zh: 他说，你可以在 Nortia 向霸主的代理人自首。

entries.en:
"No."

She looks up at you through the comms-link.

Her eyes are bright. You wonder how long it's been since she has shed a tear.
entries.zh:
"不。"

她透过通讯链路抬头看你。

她的眼睛亮着。你想，她上一次落泪，是多久以前的事了。

entries.en:
She stares at you for a moment.

Then cuts the comms.
entries.zh:
她盯着你看了片刻。

随即切断了通讯。

entries.en:
Her expression doesn't change.

"As I anticipated. Nothing is changed."
entries.zh:
她的神情没有变化。

"如我所料。什么都不会改变。"

o.en: He might still give you a way out.
o.zh: 他也许还是会给你留一条出路。

entries.en:
Hyder nods.

"Then this conversation is over. 'Burn bright', as I believe you say."

She cuts the comms.
entries.zh:
Hyder 点点头。

"那么，这次谈话就到此为止。'烧得亮些'——我记得你们是这么说的。"

她切断了通讯。

entries.en:
"No," she says. "He won't."

She stares at you for a moment.

Then cuts the comms."
entries.zh:
"不，\"她说。\"他不会。"

她盯着你看了片刻。

随即切断了通讯。

entries.en:
Hyder demonstrates impressive cool as she barks orders to her bridge crew and summons a privacy field with a touch to her uniform cuff.

"Rao," she says.
entries.zh:
Hyder 展现出过人的镇定：她一边向舰桥船员发号施令，一边抬手碰了碰制服袖口，召出一层隐私场。

"Rao，"她说。

o.en: I have no offer from Rao. But he said he would deal with you himself.
o.zh: Rao 没给我任何条件。但他说，他会亲自来对付你。

entries.en:
Hyder demonstrates impressive cool as she barks orders to her bridge crew and summons a privacy field with a touch to her uniform cuff.

"Rao," she says.
entries.zh:
Hyder 展现出过人的镇定：她一边向舰桥船员发号施令，一边抬手碰了碰制服袖口，召出一层隐私场。

"Rao，"她说。

o.en: He said he put in a request to the High Hegemon for clemency. For your sentence.
o.zh: 他说，他已经向至高霸主递了请求，为你那份判决求一份特赦。

entries.en:
Hyder demonstrates impressive cool as she barks orders to her bridge crew and summons a privacy field with a touch to her uniform cuff.

"Rao," she says, eyes downcast. They raise. You note, perhaps, a new sense of resolve. "I already made my decision."
entries.zh:
Hyder 展现出过人的镇定：她一边向舰桥船员发号施令，一边抬手碰了碰制服袖口，召出一层隐私场。

"Rao，\"她说着，垂下眼睛。随即抬起目光。你隐约觉得，那目光里多了一份新的决意。\"我已经做了决定。"

o.zh: 你向 Achilles 宣誓效忠了。

o.en: You should back Achilles Andrada. He is the better man.
o.zh: 你应该支持 Achilles Andrada。他才是更合适的人。

o.en: There is a rightful heir you could back - Achilles Andrada. (explain)
o.zh: 有一位名正言顺的继承人值得你支持——Achilles Andrada。 (解释)

o.en: Another clone, heir, then. One could be a man of character and ability.
o.zh: 那就换个克隆体，换个继承人。总该有一个是有品性、有本事的。

o.en: Maybe a schemer. A spymaster, a sneak, a rogue. Everything you're not.
o.zh: 也许要个阴谋家。一个间谍头子、一个暗探、一个无赖。所有你不是的东西。

o.en: Perhaps this wasn't such a good idea...
o.zh: 也许这主意本来就不怎么样...

entries.en:
You explain that Achilles Andrada is, by all appearances, an honorable officer trained by the Persean League Fleet. He is dutiful, able, and respected by his peers.

"He could be as you say," Hyder admits.

"However I have seen reports of Fortuna Kato's recent... investments. Mercenaries, warships, heavy weapons. Without Fortuna, Achilles has no fleet, no power. No chance."

"Tell me, is he the heir to Andrada or the figurehead of a League invasion?"
entries.zh:
你解释说，从各方面看，Achilles Andrada 都是个正直的军官，受过英仙座联盟舰队的训练。他尽责、能干，也受同僚敬重。

"他也许真如你所说，"Hyder 承认。

"可我看过报告，Fortuna Kato 最近在...投资。雇佣兵、战舰、重型武器。没有 Fortuna，Achilles 就没有舰队、没有实力。没有胜算。"

"告诉我，他是 Andrada 的继承人，还是联盟入侵的一块招牌？"

entries.en:
She can't hide her look of disgust.

"Betray all I've sworn to give everything to Fortuna Kato and her ilk. To be... 'free'? Speak no more of it."
entries.zh:
她脸上的厌恶藏不住。

"背弃我立过的一切誓言，把一切都交给 Fortuna Kato 和她那一类人。就为了...'自由'？别再提了。"

entries.en: "Who did you have in mind?" She looks skeptical.
entries.zh: "你心里想的是谁？"她神情怀疑。

entries.en:
"To back these... 'reformers'. It would be a betrayal."

Hyder's face is impassive. Brittle.

"I swore an oath."
entries.zh:
"支持这些...'改革派'。这是背叛。"

Hyder 面无表情。像随时会碎。

"我立过誓。"

o.en: Was that oath made to Hector?
o.zh: 那道誓是向 Hector 立的吗？

o.en: You once broke an oath to the Hegemony.
o.zh: 你曾经背弃过对霸主的誓言。

o.en: Is inertia to be the better part of valor?
o.zh: 难道坐视不动，反倒成了勇气的上策？

o.en: Then follow it! Go pledge yourself to Hector.
o.zh: 那就遵誓而行！去投效 Hector。

entries.en:
She says nothing for a long moment.

Then Hyder places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank-you, captain," she says, voice the perfect tone of dismissal from a commanding office. "Kindly ensure that you respect official comms protocol in the future."

"Hyder out."
entries.zh:
她久久没有说话。

随后 Hyder 双手背到身后，摆出正式的姿态。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长，\"她说，那语气完全是上级军官打发人的腔调。\"今后请务必遵守官方通讯规程。"

"Hyder 完毕。"

entries.en:
She says nothing for a long moment.

Then Hyder places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank-you, captain," she says, voice the perfect tone of dismissal from a commanding office. "There is much to see done. Kindly keep your $shipOrFleet clear of my course."

"Hyder out."
entries.zh:
她久久没有说话。

随后 Hyder 双手背到身后，摆出正式的姿态。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长，\"她说，那语气完全是上级军官打发人的腔调。\"要做的事还有很多。请让你的 $shipOrFleet 离我的航路远一点。"

"Hyder 完毕。"

o.en: With your support he could be his own man, not Fortuna's puppet. A true heir to Andrada.
o.zh: 有你的支持，他就能自立，不必做 Fortuna 的傀儡。做 Andrada 真正的继承人。

o.en: With your backing, the Sindrian Diktat could join the League. You'd be safe - and free.
o.zh: 有你的支持，辛达强权就能加入联盟。你会安全——而且自由。

entries.en:
You explain that Achilles Andrada is, by all appearances, an honorable officer trained by the Persean League Fleet. He is dutiful, able, and respected by his peers.

Hyder listens, nodding. When you finish, she asks,"And how many capital ships does he command?"
entries.zh:
你解释说，从各方面看，Achilles Andrada 都是个正直的军官，受过英仙座联盟舰队的训练。他尽责、能干，也受同僚敬重。

Hyder 听着，点了点头。等你说完，她问道："那他能指挥多少主力舰？"

o.en: As many as Gens Kato can afford, from the sounds of it. She's backing him.
o.zh: 听这意思，Kato 氏族出得起多少，他就有多少。她在给他撑腰。

entries.en:
"So this is what Fortuna Kato has been up to. Mercenaries, hulls, heavy weapons, freelance marines. Distorting half the Core Worlds' military markets." She flashes a look, "Unofficial sources of materiel has been extremely relevant to my situation for some time, captain."

"Tell me," she says coldly. "Is your Achilles to be heir to Andrada - or the spearhead of a League invasion?"
entries.zh:
"原来 Fortuna Kato 一直在忙这些。雇佣兵、舰体、重型武器、自由陆战队。把半个核心世界的军火市场都搅乱了。"她瞟了你一眼。"舰长，非官方的物资来源，对我眼下的处境来说，已经重要了很久。"

"告诉我，\"她冷冷地说。\"你那位 Achilles，是要做 Andrada 的继承人——还是联盟入侵的矛头？"

entries.en:
You explain that Achilles Andrada is, by all appearances, an honorable officer trained by the Persean League Fleet. He is dutiful, able, and respected by his peers.

Hyder listens, nodding. When you finish, she asks,"And how many capital ships does he command?"
entries.zh:
你解释说，从各方面看，Achilles Andrada 都是个正直的军官，受过英仙座联盟舰队的训练。他尽责、能干，也受同僚敬重。

Hyder 听着，点了点头。等你说完，她问道："那他能指挥多少主力舰？"

o.en: As many as Gens Kato can afford, from the sounds of it.
o.zh: 听这意思，Kato 氏族出得起多少，他就有多少。

entries.en:
She looks entirely skeptical of the notion.

"Elaborate."
entries.zh:
她对这个说法显然满心怀疑。

"说下去。"

entries.en:
You explain that while Hector has been misinformed by Macario concerning yourself, and likely others, he is confident and aggressive. He has Andrada's fire - his fire, steel, and determination to pursue and win victory!

Macario has surely underestimated Hector's willfulness - he will make a poor pawn for Macario's plans. But he needs help.

Your help.

And her's. Her honor, her duty, and the loyalty of the fleets of the Sindrian Diktat navy.
entries.zh:
你解释说，Hector 虽然被 Macario 灌输了关于你的错误说法，很可能还有关于别人的，但他自信，锐气逼人。他有 Andrada 的那股火——那股火、那股钢铁般的意志，以及追击并夺取胜利的决心！

Macario 显然低估了 Hector 的意志——他不会是 Macario 计划里好用的棋子。但他需要帮助。

你的帮助。

还有她的。她的荣誉、她的职责，以及辛达强权海军各舰队的忠诚。

entries.en:
Hyder nods, grimly.

"An heir to Andrada. The blood of Andrada. That was in my oath, after all. A bit of poetical flourish, I once thought."

She sighs, closing her eyes.

"I could see it. If... if he can be rid of Macario's festering influence."
entries.zh:
Hyder 神情凝重地点了点头。

"Andrada 的继承人。Andrada 的血脉。我的誓言里确实有这一条。我曾经以为，那不过是句诗意的漂亮话。"

她闭上眼，叹了口气。

"我能看到那个可能。如果...如果他能摆脱 Macario 那套溃烂的影响。"

o.en: Then we're agreed. You'll back Hector.
o.zh: 那就这么说定了。你支持 Hector。

entries.en:
Her eyes open. "I swore it, did I not?"

"You, however, are officially kill-on-sight as a traitor, terrorist, and murderer."

Hyder almost sounds darkly amused. Almost.

"The only one who can rescind that order is the Supreme Executor."
entries.zh:
她睁开眼。"我发过誓，不是吗？"

"不过你就不一样了。官方已经把你定为叛徒、恐怖分子、杀人犯，格杀勿论。"

Hyder 的语气里几乎带着一丝阴沉的玩味。几乎。

"唯一能撤销那道命令的，只有最高元首。"

o.en: Unless that order was no longer in effect...
o.zh: 除非那道命令已经不再有效了...

o.en: Then I must speak with Hector Andrada.
o.zh: 那我必须去和 Hector Andrada 谈。

o.en: Hercules. A historian. Young, but... he's smart, and stable.
o.zh: Hercules。一个历史学者。年轻，可是...他聪明，也稳重。

o.en: I'm, uh, not sure. It was just a thought.
o.zh: 我，呃，还没想好。只是随口一提。

entries.en:
Then Hyder places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank-you, captain," she says, voice the confident tone of dismissal from a commanding office. "There is much to see done."

"Hyder out."
entries.zh:
随后 Hyder 双手背到身后，摆出正式的站姿。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长，\"她说，语气笃定，带着指挥官办公室里惯有的那种送客口吻。\"还有许多事等着办。"

"Hyder 完毕。"

entries.en:
You explain that Hector possesses Andrada's fire - his fire, steel, and determination to pursue and claim victory.

And although Hector has been misinformed by Macario concerning yourself, and likely others, he bears Andrada's blood and in time will wield a correct understanding of Andrada's transcendent philosophy. Macario has surely underestimated Hector's capability - he will make a poor pawn. But he needs help.

Your help.

And her's. Her honor, her duty, and the loyalty of the fleets of the Sindrian Diktat navy.
entries.zh:
你解释说，Hector 身上有 Andrada 的那股火——那股火、那股钢铁般的意志，以及追击并夺取胜利的决心。

而且，虽然 Hector 被 Macario 灌输了关于你的错误说法，很可能还有关于别人的，但他身上流着 Andrada 的血，假以时日，他会真正理解 Andrada 那套超凡的哲学。Macario 显然低估了 Hector 的能力——他不会是枚好用的棋子。但他需要帮助。

你的帮助。

还有她的。她的荣誉、她的职责，以及辛达强权海军各舰队的忠诚。

o.en: You must stand by Hector Andrada. He is the rightful heir.
o.zh: 你必须站在 Hector Andrada 这边。他才是名正言顺的继承人。

o.en: There is a rightful heir you could back - Hector Andrada. (explain)
o.zh: 有一位名正言顺的继承人值得你支持——Hector Andrada。 (解释)

entries.en:
Hyder takes a deep breath, composing herself.

"I will hear your offer. But I agree to nothing."
entries.zh:
Hyder 深吸一口气，稳住心神。

"你的提议我可以听。但我什么都没答应。"

o.en: In the meantime, watch yourself. Macario...

entries.en:
She places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank you captain, your report will be given due consideration by the appropriate authorities. Glory to the Sindrian Diktat."

Her expression is grimly neutral.

"That will be all."
entries.zh:
她双手背到身后，摆出正式的姿态。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长。你的报告会由有关部门予以适当考虑。荣耀归于辛达强权。"

她的神情冷硬，毫无波澜。

"就到这里。"

o.en: Turn yourself over to the Hegemony. I'll get Orcus Rao's assurance of a fair trial. Maybe a deal.
o.zh: 向霸主自首。我会拿到 Orcus Rao 的保证，给你一场公正的审判。也许还能谈个交易。

o.en: Turn yourself in to the Hegemony. You'll get a fair trial, or a deal from... from Orcus Rao.
o.zh: 向霸主自首。你会得到公正的审判，或者...或者从 Orcus Rao 那里得到一个交易。

entries.en:
"Rao."

There's a change in her voice.

"He hates me, you know," she says. "He hates us all. You cannot understand unless you were there."
entries.zh:
"Rao。"

她的声音变了。

"他恨我，你知道的，\"她说。\"他恨我们所有人。除非你当时在场，否则你不会明白。"

o.en: Let me try. I'll speak to him, get a deal.
o.zh: 让我试试。我去跟他谈，谈成一笔交易。

entries.en: "The Hegemony already sentenced me for... mutiny," she speaks robotically. "They abhor mutiny, as well they should."
entries.zh: "霸主已经以...叛乱罪判过我，\"她机械地说。\"他们痛恨叛乱，这理所应当。"

o.en: I'll speak to him, get a deal. Anything is possible.
o.zh: 我去跟他谈，谈成一笔交易。什么事都有可能。

entries.en: She doesn't look impressed.
entries.zh: 她看上去并不以为然。

o.en: Faro Inesis. He's... an agent, of sorts, for an arm of Tri-Tachyon. He'll do it for credits.
o.zh: Faro Inesis。他算是...速子科技某个分支机构的代理人。给星币他就办事。

entries.en:
"For credits." She can't keep the tone of disgust from her voice. "He'll be one of Tri-Tachyon's degenerate, half-mad cyborg executives, I imagine. Willing to sell anything, everything, for credits."

She leans forward. "I loathe their ilk. I'll hear no more of Faro Inesis."
entries.zh:
"为了星币。\"她语气里的厌恶掩不住。\"我猜他就是速子科技那种堕落的、半疯的改造人高管。为了星币，什么都肯卖，什么都能卖。"

她向前倾身。"我厌恶他们那一类人。Faro Inesis 的事，我不想再听了。"

o.en: Arnaud Iscare. He's a reputable Charterist...
o.zh: Arnaud Iscare。他是个口碑不错的宪章派...

entries.en: "I know who Iscare is, captain. He's among the most wanted terrorists in the Askonia System."
entries.zh: "舰长，我知道 Iscare 是什么人。他是 Askonia 星系头号通缉的恐怖分子之一。"

entries.en:
"I know who Iscare is, captain. He's among the most wanted terrorists in the Askonia System - a list presently led by you, by the way."

"Did you know that he - his people - tried to assassinate me? It was a bomb," she says, tone acidic. "I'll hear no more of him."
entries.zh:
"舰长，我知道 Iscare 是什么人。他是 Askonia 星系头号通缉的恐怖分子之一——顺便说一句，那份名单现在排在第一位的是你。"

"你知道他——他的人——曾经试图暗杀我吗？用的是一枚炸弹，\"她说，语气尖刻。\"他的事我不想再听了。"

o.en: K-O Jove. He's a sort of information broker and spy on Qaras...
o.zh: K-O Jove。他算是 Qaras 上的情报贩子，也干间谍的活儿...

entries.en:
"A criminal and a pirate, you mean," she says, interrupting. "From Qaras, a notorious and lawless gathering of spacer trash of the worst kind."

"I'll hear no more of it."
entries.zh:
"你是说，一个罪犯、一个海盗，\"她打断你。\"从 Qaras 来的——那地方声名狼藉、无法无天，聚着最下等的太空渣滓。"

"这事我不想再听了。"

entries.en:
"After all of these... spy-games, that's what you have to say?"

She looks aside, distressed and annoyed.

"Honor, yes. I have upheld it through all, against schemers and traitors on all sides. Now a new-declared Supreme Executor, and soon another, no doubt. Which Sindrian Diktat shall I serve?"

Hyder turns to you.

"And why should I speak to you of such things? You've been nothing but a harbinger of chaos."
entries.zh:
"闹了这么多...间谍把戏，你就给我这一句？"

她移开目光，既烦躁又苦恼。

"荣誉，对。我自始至终都守着它，对抗四面八方的阴谋家和叛徒。如今又有人自立为最高元首，而且毫无疑问，很快还会有下一个。我该效忠哪一个辛达强权？"

Hyder 转向你。

"再说，我凭什么跟你谈这些？你从头到尾只会带来混乱。"

o.en: Duty and honor above all. Stand by your oath to the Sindrian Diktat!
o.zh: 责任与荣誉高于一切。守住你对辛达强权的誓言！

entries.en: Hyder folds her arms, giving you an impatient look.
entries.zh: Hyder 抱起双臂，不耐烦地看着你。

entries.en: You terminate the connection through the comms relay.
entries.zh: 你通过通讯中继结束了连接。

entries.en: You terminate the connection through the comms relay.
entries.zh: 你通过通讯中继结束了连接。

entries.en: You terminate the connection through the comms relay.
entries.zh: 你通过通讯中继结束了连接。

entries.en:
A strange look grows on Hyder's face. She appears to be at a loss for words.

Is she stunned into silence by the scope of your ambition, and your largesse? That you would offer her a place by your side, as Supreme Executor of Askonia - and beyond?
entries.zh:
Hyder 脸上浮起一种古怪的神情。她似乎一时说不出话来。

她是被你野心的规模与你的慷慨震得说不出话吗？你竟愿意让她站到你身边，做 Askonia——乃至更远之地的最高元首？

o.en: I can protect your loyal officers, your fleet. You'll have a place in my armada.
o.zh: 我可以保护你那些忠诚的军官，还有你的舰队。我的舰队里会有你的位置。

entries.en:
"You're insane," she whispers. "Just like Caden."

Hyder's hand twitches and the comms cut.
entries.zh:
"你疯了，\"她低声说道，\"和 Caden 一模一样。"

Hyder 的手一抽，通讯切断。

entries.en:
So that's it.

She is a small-minded woman to not understand what you propose, what you offer. She's stuck in her ways now, forever clutching at the memory of the young Philip Andrada she followed into mutiny.
entries.zh:
原来如此。

她心胸狭隘，根本不懂你提议的是什么、你给出的是什么。她已困在自己的老路里，永远抓着那个她曾追随发动叛乱的年轻 Philip Andrada 的影子不放。

o.en: Orcus Rao. I'm not saying it'll be easy, but he could get you out of this.
o.zh: Orcus Rao。我不敢说这事容易，但他能把你从这里捞出去。

o.en: Orcus Rao. I'm not saying it'll be easy, but he could get you out of this.
o.zh: Orcus Rao。我不敢说这事容易，但他能把你从这里捞出去。

o.en: Let me be candid - Orcus Rao sent me to discover your intentions.
o.zh: 我就直说了——Orcus Rao 派我来探你的意图。

entries.en:
Her eyes dart to meet yours..

"And how should I 'be ready'? He has informants and agents everywhere. Among my crew and on my staff, no doubt."
entries.zh:
她的目光骤然迎上你的。

"那我该怎么'做好准备'？他的线人和特工无处不在。我的船员里、我的幕僚里，肯定都有。"

o.en: You need allies who can do what Macario does.
o.zh: 你需要能替你做 Macario 那些事的盟友。

entries.en: "And who would that be?"
entries.zh: "那会是谁？"

entries.en:
"Is he?" She looks defensive.

"And if he is - how can I fight informants, agents, assassins. He's bribed or blackmailed someone in every senior staff and ministry."

"Fleet armaments can't fight that war."
entries.zh:
"是吗？"她神情戒备起来。

"就算真是这样——我又怎么去对付线人、特工、刺客。每个高级幕僚班子、每个部里，都有人被他收买或要挟。"

"舰队火力打不了这场仗。"

o.en: You need allies. Allies who can do what Macario does.
o.zh: 你需要盟友。能替你做 Macario 那些事的盟友。

o.en: I suspect Macario plans to eliminate you. You've got to be ready.
o.zh: 我怀疑 Macario 打算除掉你。你得做好准备。

entries.en:
Her eyes dart to meet yours..

"And how should I 'be ready'? He has informants and agents everywhere. Among my crew and on my staff, no doubt."
entries.zh:
她的目光骤然迎上你的。

"那我该怎么'做好准备'？他的线人和特工无处不在。我的船员里、我的幕僚里，肯定都有。"

o.en: You need allies who can protect you. And each other.
o.zh: 你需要能保护你的盟友。也能彼此保护的盟友。

entries.en:
Hyder is taken aback.

"I cannot," she says softly.

"I cannot!" Louder.

"Askonia is not a battleship, captain. Can't you see that? Victory cannot be won by fleet action alone. I'm no... no politician, but I know enough to know that I am not a Supreme Executor."

She looks away. "I've seen what it does to a man."
entries.zh:
Hyder 愣住了。

"我不能，"她轻声说道。

"我不能！"声音更大了。

"Askonia 不是一艘战列舰，舰长。你看不出来吗？胜利不可能只靠舰队作战取得。我不是...不是政客，但我至少明白，我当不了最高元首。"

她移开目光。"我见过那个位置会把人变成什么样。"

entries.en:
"Where is he now? Dead, or as good as!"

She doesn't shout, not quite.

"And where has he left us? Askonia is a trap, a prison, fought over by clones and cronies!"
entries.zh:
"他现在在哪儿？死了，还是跟死了没两样！"

她没有喊出来。差一点。

"他给我们留下的是什么？Askonia 是个陷阱、一座监狱，一群克隆体和亲信为了它打个不停！"

o.en: I'm surprised to hear you speak like that about Philip Andrada.
o.zh: 听你这样评价 Philip Andrada，我很意外。

o.en: They don't all belong to Macario. There is Achilles, trained as a Persean League officer...
o.zh: 他们并不都归 Macario 管。还有 Achilles——他是按英仙座联盟军官的路子培养出来的...

o.en: You knew then what you know now. Back the strong - Hector Andrada.
o.zh: 你现在知道的这些，你那时就知道。那就押强者——Hector Andrada。

o.en: There's got to be something you can do.
This is your chance! If you seize the initiative, you could become Supreme Executor.
o.zh: 这是你的机会！只要抓住先机，你就能成为最高元首。

o.en: That did not stop Philip Andrada. He made himself Supreme Executor!
o.zh: 这可没拦住 Philip Andrada。他自己当上了最高元首！

o.en: You must. Macario is going to eliminate you if you don't do something.
o.zh: 你必须这么做。你要是不动手，Macario 就会除掉你。

o.en: Then turn yourself into the Hegemony. I'll talk to Rao, a fair trial. Maybe even a deal.
o.zh: 那就向霸主自首吧。我去找 Rao 谈，争取一场公正的审判。说不定还能谈成条件。

o.en: Finlay Siyavong. He's a Persean League agent...
o.zh: Finlay Siyavong。他是英仙座联盟的特工...

entries.en:
"I know about Siyavong. He's a meddler."

She can't hide her look of disgust.

"You suggest I betray all I've sworn, to give everything to Fortuna Kato and her ilk. Degenerate, squabbling nobles."
entries.zh:
"Siyavong 我知道。他是个爱插手的家伙。"

她脸上的厌恶藏不住。

"你是要我背弃自己立过的所有誓言，把一切都交给 Fortuna Kato 和她那一类人。一群堕落、只会内斗的贵族。"

entries.en:
"The League."

She can't hide her look of disgust.

"You suggest I betray all I've sworn, to give everything to those degenerate, squabbling nobles?"
entries.zh:
"联盟。"

她脸上的厌恶藏不住。

"你是要我背弃自己立过的所有誓言，把一切都交给那些堕落、只会内斗的贵族？"

o.en: It's not all the gens. Some in the League believe in ideals, you know.
o.zh: 不是所有氏族都那样。联盟里也有人真心相信理想，你知道的。

o.en: No, not for the gens - do it for Achilles. Siyavong believes he serves the League.
o.zh: 不，不是为氏族——是为了 Achilles 去做。Siyavong 相信自己在为联盟效命。

entries.en:
"Yes." She nods, not looking into the feed. "Of course."

She says nothing for a long moment.

Then Hyder places her hands behind her back in formal posture. The privacy field drops.

"Thank-you, captain," she says, voice the confident tone of dismissal from a commanding office. "There is much to see done."

"Hyder out."
entries.zh:
"是。\"她点点头，目光没有看向通讯画面。\"当然。"

她久久没有说话。

随后 Hyder 双手背到身后，摆出正式的站姿。隐私场撤去。

"谢谢你，舰长，\"她说，语气笃定，带着指挥官办公室里惯有的那种送客口吻。\"还有许多事等着办。"

"Hyder 完毕。"

o.en: I'm not here to tell you what to do. Just a warning about what is to come.
o.zh: 我不是来教你怎么做的。只是提醒你，接下来要发生什么。

entries.en:
"Don't pretend you're surprised for my sake, captain."

It's like something's broken in her.

"It's been like this for a long time. It's a silence that's only grown more deafening with each cycle. It's unsaid by everyone except the most ignorant dullards."
entries.zh:
"舰长，别为了照顾我装出一副吃惊的样子。"

她像是有什么地方坏掉了。

"这样已经很久了。那是一种沉默，每过一星历年，就变得更震耳。除了最愚钝的蠢货，谁都不去说破。"

entries.en:
Her hand holds steady. Then reaches for her opposite cuff and the vague muffling of a privacy field descends on her command station.

"This had better be good," she says with a sigh.

She seems more drawn than at your first meeting.
entries.zh:
她的手稳稳停着。随后伸向另一侧的袖口，一层隐约的隔音嗡鸣笼罩了她的指挥台。

"这最好值得一听，"她叹了口气说道。

比起你们初次见面，她显得更加憔悴。

o.en: I recovered Macario's files about seven clones of Philip Andrada. (explain)
o.zh: 我找回了 Macario 关于 Philip Andrada 七个克隆体的文件。 (解释)

entries.en:
Hyder hits the privacy field.

She sighs, then says "This had better be good. Have you confirmed the veracity of every file?"
entries.zh:
Hyder 启动了隐私场。

她叹了口气，然后说道："这最好值得一听。每一份文件的真实性你都核实过了吗？"

entries.en:
Hyder hits the privacy field.

She sighs, then says "This had better be good."
entries.zh:
Hyder 启动了隐私场。

她叹了口气，说道："这最好值得一听。"

entries.en:
You tell of extracting the encrypted files meant for Dolos Macario from the head of a courier (deceased) floating in space after a mercenary destroyed their transport on the fringe of the Askonia system.

And the contents: seven sets of reports on seven clones of Andrada hidden in seven systems spread across the Persean Sector.

You describe the details. Hyder's expression is closed.
entries.zh:
你讲起事情的经过：一名信使的运输船在 Askonia 星系边缘被雇佣兵击毁，你从漂浮在太空中的那具遗体上取出了本该交给 Dolos Macario 的加密文件。

还有文件的内容：七组报告，关于七个 Andrada 的克隆体，被藏在英仙座星域各处七个星系里。

你详述了细节。Hyder 面无表情。

entries.en:
"Though I respect your word as an officer," she says, "I would be remiss not to confirm the alleged contents of these files myself."

She crosses her arms.
entries.zh:
"尽管我尊重你身为军官的保证，\"她说道，\"但若不亲自核实这些文件所称的内容，就是我的失职。"

她抱起了双臂。

o.zh: 把 ANDRADA 文件发给 Hyder

entries.en:
"I don't trust you," she says, voice level.

"And most of all I don't trust Macario. I have no reason to believe this isn't another of his games."

She crosses her arms.
entries.zh:
"我不信你，"她说道，声音平板。

"而我最不信的是 Macario。我没有理由相信这不是他又一场把戏。"

她抱起了双臂。

o.zh: 把 ANDRADA 文件发给 Hyder

o.en: You're going to have to take my word for it, $rank.
This stubbornness is why you're going to find yourself in front of a firing squad.
o.zh: 就是这股倔劲，迟早会让你站到行刑队面前。

entries.en:
"Hold a moment, captain."

She takes a few minutes, scrolling rapidly through files. Rapidly assessing new intel as a trained combat officer must. Her frown only deepens.

A sign, you think, that she might believe these are real.

She sets her TriPad down and looks back through the comms, distantly. As if staring across light-years.
entries.zh:
"等一下，舰长。"

她花了几分钟，飞快地翻动文件。以一名训练有素的战斗军官应有的方式，迅速评估着新情报。她的眉头越皱越紧。

你觉得，这是个迹象——她或许相信这些都是真的。

她放下 TriPad，隔着通讯望回来，目光遥远。像是在凝视数光年之外。

entries.en:
"It is... disturbing." She looks away.

"Heirs of Andrada. Plots and schemes. A battle for spies, assassins, and," a look of disgust, "politicians."

Her eyes snap to yours. "How much of this have you personally confirmed?"
entries.zh:
"这...令人不安。"她移开了目光。

"Andrada 的继承人。阴谋与算计。一场由间谍、刺客，还有，\"她露出厌恶的神色，\"政客来打的战争。"

她的目光猛地转向你。"这些，你亲自核实了多少？"

entries.en:
Hyder's hand twitches and the privacy field drops.

She watches you for a moment, then the comms cut.
entries.zh:
Hyder 的手一抽，隐私场消散了。

她看了你片刻，随后通讯切断。

entries.en:
Hyder's hand twitches and the privacy field drops.

She watches you for a moment, then the comms cut.
entries.zh:
Hyder 的手一抽，隐私场消散了。

她看了你片刻，随后通讯切断。

entries.en:
Her look says it all.

"Return when you do and not before. I risk much by even accepting your comms request."

"Hyder out."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
她的神情已经说明了一切。

"等你核实完了再回来，别提前。光是接下你的通讯请求，我就已经冒了很大风险。"

"Hyder 完毕。"

通讯切断。

entries.en: She nods, and puts her fist under her chin. Eyes closed, thinking. But only for a moment.
entries.zh: 她点了点头，一拳抵住下巴。闭上眼，思索。但只有片刻。

entries.en:
"I risk much to even speak of this subject. I need one hundred percent confirmation from you before this goes any further."

She sets her TriPad aside, then places her hands behind her back in formal posture.

"Thank you captain. That will be all."
entries.zh:
"光是谈论这件事，我就已经冒了极大风险。在事情继续推进之前，我需要你百分之百的确认。"

她把 TriPad 放到一旁，随后双手背到身后，摆出正式的仪态。

"谢谢你，舰长。就这样吧。"

o.en: Watch your back. Macario is going to make a move sooner or later.
o.zh: 小心背后。Macario 迟早会动手。

o.en: Remember that I gave you this. That it's me trying to protect you.
o.zh: 记住，这是我把机会给你的。是我在想办法保护你。

entries.en: A quick nod. She unfocuses from you, thinking. For a moment.
entries.zh: 她迅速点了点头，目光从你身上散开，思索着。只片刻。

entries.en:
"I can deploy a fleet to battle, balance my sabotaged logistics." It seems like she's speaking to herself. "This..."

Hyder trails off. Eyes searching. Like she can't bring herself to ask.

The next step.
entries.zh:
"我可以派一支舰队去作战，可以平衡被人动了手脚的后勤。\"听上去她像是在自言自语。\"可这个..."

Hyder 话音渐止。目光四下搜寻。像是怎么也开不了口问出来。

下一步。

entries.en: She doesn't react for a moment. As if an underling made an error and she's providing a chance for self-correction.
entries.zh: 她一时没有反应。像是在等一名下属自己纠正错误。

o.en: None of it, yet. I came to you first.
o.zh: 一个都还没核实。我先来找的你。

entries.en: She doesn't react for a moment.
entries.zh: 她一时没有反应。

entries.en: A slow nod. She takes a moment to assemble her thoughts.
entries.zh: 她缓缓点头，花了一会儿整理思绪。

o.en: Wait - I have an intel report you must see.
o.zh: 等等——我有一份情报报告，你必须看看。

o.en: We need to talk about a... certain intel report.
o.zh: 我们得谈谈...某份情报报告。

o.en: We must discuss the future of the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 我们必须谈谈辛达强权的未来。

o.en: We must discuss the future of the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 我们必须谈谈辛达强权的未来。

entries.en:
"No," she says. "I'll not play-act in another game for the amusement of Dolos Macario."

"Hyder out."

She drops her hand sharply and the connection blanks.
entries.zh:
"不，\"她说道。\"我不会再为博 Dolos Macario 一笑，去他另一场戏里演戏。"

"Hyder 完毕。"

她的手猛地落下，通讯画面归于空白。

entries.en:
"No," she says. "I'll not play-act in another game for the amusement of Dolos Macario."

"Hyder out."

She drops her hand sharply and the connection blanks.
entries.zh:
"不，\"她说道。\"我不会再为博 Dolos Macario 一笑，去他另一场戏里演戏。"

"Hyder 完毕。"

她的手猛地落下，通讯画面归于空白。

entries.en:
"I am disappointed," she says, voice going distant. A commander ordering a squad to certain death. "You approach me with critical information, and then - confusion. More underhanded schemes, half-truths."

"Is this yet another Macario scheme?" Her head tilts, just slightly. "I'm not even sure you would know it is, if it is. It would explain a lot. Everything, perhaps."
entries.zh:
"我很失望，\"她说道，声音渐渐疏远。像一位指挥官在下令让小队去送死。\"你带着关键情报来见我，结果却是——混乱。更多的暗地算计、半真半假的话。"

"这又是 Macario 的一场算计吗？\"她的头微微一偏。\"我甚至不确定，若真是如此，你自己会不会知道。这能解释很多事。也许能解释一切。"

o.en: Look, I'm just trying to help you. It isn't easy.
o.zh: 听着，我只是想帮你。这不容易。

o.en: Your paranoia is playing right into Macario's hands. This is what he wants!
o.zh: 你的偏执正合 Macario 的心意。这正是他想要的！

o.en: If that's what you think, I'll leave you to your own devices.
o.zh: 既然你这么想，那就随你自便吧。

entries.en:
She just watches you for a moment.

"Hyder out."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
她只是看了你片刻。

"Hyder 完毕。"

通讯切断。

entries.en:
She just watches you for a moment.

"Hyder out."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
她只是看了你片刻。

"Hyder 完毕。"

通讯切断。

entries.en: There's a growing skepticism, a reticence in her voice. You're losing her trust.
entries.zh: 她语气里的怀疑越来越重，还带着几分保留。你正在失去她的信任。

entries.en: There's a growing skepticism, a reticence in her voice. You're losing her trust.
entries.zh: 她语气里的怀疑越来越重，还带着几分保留。你正在失去她的信任。

entries.en:
"It is going well. And I'm making a fair little profit for my trouble, as well."

He nods, politely. "With you to thank, of course."
entries.zh:
"进展顺利。而且我为此费的心力，也换来了相当不错的一笔小利。"

他客气地点了点头。"当然，多亏了你。"

o.en: I'd like to discuss the Achilles support operation.
o.zh: 我想谈谈支援 Achilles 的行动。

entries.en: "Everything is proceeding as planned," he says with a smile.
entries.zh: "一切都在按计划推进，"他笑着说。

o.en: I'd like to discuss the anti-Macario operation.
o.zh: 我想谈谈针对 Macario 的行动。

entries.en: "Yes," he says with a smile. "I suppose so."
entries.zh: "是啊，\"他笑着说，\"我想也是。"

entries.en:
"Change? Now?"

His pleasant smile looks troubled, just a little.

"Quite impossible. I've got a good, clean operation running. It nearly runs itself - I've acquired some top talent, you see. And they're motivated, how they're motivated!"

He shakes his head. "It's not only irrational, it's unaesthetic. I'm sure you understand."

His smile returns to its usual glow.
entries.zh:
"改换？现在？"

他那和悦的笑容里，多了一丝为难。

"绝无可能。我手上这套行动运作得干净又漂亮，几乎能自己运转——你知道，我招到了一批顶尖人才。而且他们干劲十足，干劲十足啊！"

他摇了摇头。"这不只是不理性，更是不美。我相信你能明白。"

他的笑容恢复了惯常的光彩。

entries.en:
"Disturbing?" His face forms a look of concern. "I'm sorry to hear that, captain. I thought you would be pleased."

"But please- rest easy in the knowledge that you've done the right thing. I've found a particular satisfaction in pursuing your objective - and the opportunity for profits therein."

He smiles.
entries.zh:
"不安？\"他脸上摆出一副关切的神情。\"听你这么说我很遗憾，舰长。我以为你会高兴。"

"不过请放心——你只要知道，你做的是对的。追着你的目标走，我从中得到了某种特别的满足——还有其中的盈利机会。"

他笑了笑。

o.en: I'd like to discuss the Hector support operation.
o.zh: 我想谈谈支援 Hector 的行动。

o.en: I'd like to discuss the Hector support operation.
o.zh: 我想谈谈支援 Hector 的行动。

entries.en:
"Yes? I believe we are waiting for you to upload the software attack into the Askonia comms relay."

He nods, politely.

"Once that is completed, the operation may proceed."
entries.zh:
"嗯？我想我们还在等你把软件攻击上传进 Askonia 的通讯中继。"

他客气地点了点头。

"那一步完成之后，行动才能继续。"

o.en: Of course. I'll get right on that.
You could thank me by giving me a share of those profits.
o.zh: 你要谢我，就分我一份利润。

entries.en:
"Now I believe that's all we have to discuss on that subject," he adds.

"Was there something else you wished to discuss? Some more exotic samples of interest for Director Glamor-Rotanev's projects, perhaps?"
entries.zh:
"那么我想，这个话题我们已经谈完了，"他补了一句。

"你还有其他事想谈吗？也许还有些更稀奇的样品，能让 Glamor-Rotanev 总监的项目感兴趣？"

o.en: I want you to change the faction you're supporting.
o.zh: 我要你换个支持的势力。

o.en: I suppose that's all we have to say about that.
o.zh: 这件事，我想我们也只能谈到这里了。

o.en: I want you the end your support for Achilles.
I want you the end your support for Hector.
I want you the end your support for Hector.
I want you the end your operation against Macario.
o.zh: 我要你停止针对 Macario 的行动。

o.en: I find your sudden enthusiasm for this cause... a little disturbing.
o.zh: 你突然对这项事业生出的热情...让我有点不安。

entries.en:
"Oh? I suppose I could." He makes a show of considering the thought.

"But I'd rather not."

He smiles pleasantly.
entries.zh:
"哦？我想我可以。"他煞有介事地作出一副考虑的样子。

"但我宁愿不这么做。"

他愉快地笑了。

entries.en:
"Stop?"

His smile wavers.

"Oh, no, captain. This is going to continue. It's how I've got everything set up, you see. It's like a beautiful machine, not quite perfect, but close enough. Efficient, effective, profitable... and it won't stop until the work is done."
entries.zh:
"停手？"

他的笑容晃了一下。

"哦，不，舰长。这事会继续下去。你看，我一切都是照这个方向搭好的。它像一台漂亮的机器，算不上完美，但也差不离了。高效、管用、能赚钱...而且在活儿干完之前，它不会停。"

entries.en:
"Do not be so quick to discard your self-interest, captain," he says, smile fixed. "I know the 'transcendent philosophy' makes much of self-sacrifice, but in my reading Philip Andrada always considered it a quality best found in... others."

"I cannot help but recognize the genius of Philip Andrada."
entries.zh:
"别急着把自己的利益丢到一边，舰长，\"他说，笑容不变。\"我知道那套'超凡哲学'很看重自我牺牲，但据我解读，Philip Andrada 一向认为这种品质最好出现在...别人身上。"

"我不得不承认 Philip Andrada 的天才。"

o.en: We were speaking of Hector Andrada.
o.zh: 我们刚才在说 Hector Andrada。

entries.en:
"Given that violent conflict is projected with near-certainty - our strategic predictors are quite clear on this point - we are well-positioned to secure long-term profits from new growth opportunities."

"As such, it is in our interests - Tri-Tachyon, Director Glamor-Rotanev's division, and of course my own portfolio - to minimize devastation to Askonian economic infrastructure."

"So," he folds his hands neatly. "Tell me how we make your vendetta against Dolos Macario align with our interests."
entries.zh:
"鉴于暴力冲突几乎可以确定将会发生——我们的战略预测模型在这一点上相当明确——我们已占据有利位置，可以从新的增长机会中获取长期利润。"

"因此，把对 Askonia 经济基础设施的破坏降到最低，符合我们的利益——速子科技、Glamor-Rotanev 总监的部门，当然还有我本人的投资组合。"

"那么，\"他双手整齐地交叠起来。\"告诉我，怎么让你对 Dolos Macario 的私怨与我们的利益一致。"

entries.en: "Doubtless." His smile is automatic.
entries.zh: "毫无疑问。"他的微笑是自动的。

entries.en:
"I will accept that as a compliment, captain."

His smile is automatic.
entries.zh:
"我就把这当作恭维了，舰长。"

他的微笑是自动的。

entries.en: "Destruction?" He gives you a look.
entries.zh: "摧毁？"他看了你一眼。

entries.en:
"Quite understandable," he says reassuringly.

"Macario's ministry is an excellent customer for Tri-Tachyon data gathering and processing products but even our strategic predictors estimate that his leadership shows a negative impact on consumer confidence - in the Askonia market and beyond. His organization's culture promotes certain inefficiencies and creates unnecessary negative externalities - as well you know."

Inesis shakes his head with mild disappointment.
entries.zh:
"可以理解，"他宽慰地说。

"Macario 的官署是速子科技数据采集与处理产品的大客户，可就连我们的战略预测器都估计，他的领导对消费者信心有负面影响——在 Askonia 市场内如此，在外也是如此。他那个组织的文化助长某些低效，还制造出本不必要的负面外部效应——这一点你也很清楚。"

Inesis 略带失望地摇了摇头。

entries.en: "Certainly," he says, putting a smile on his face. "I have two items to review with you, it'll take but a moment."
entries.zh: "当然，\"他脸上堆起笑容，\"我有两件事要跟你过一遍，用不了多久。"

entries.en: "Certainly," he says, putting a smile on his face. "I have an item to review with you; it'll take but a moment."
entries.zh: "当然，\"他脸上堆起笑容，\"有件事要跟你过一遍，用不了多久。"

entries.en: "Oh well," he says with a smile.
entries.zh: "哦，好吧，"他笑着说。

entries.en: "I have an item to review, it'll take but a moment."
entries.zh: "有件事要过一遍，用不了多久。"

entries.en: "I have two items to review, it'll take but a moment."
entries.zh: "有两件事要过一遍，用不了多久。"

entries.en: Inesis nods.
entries.zh: Inesis 点了点头。

entries.en:
"A word of warning," he says cheerfully. "In Tri-Tachyon we have... how would you put it - 'zones of interest'?"

"Official job descriptions are, of course, a statement of minimum expectation. Tri-Tachyon expects all of its employees - and contractors - to exceed expectations by showing ambition and initiative above and beyond the strict definitions of their role whenever possible. This naturally results in a certain amount of conflict, a 'jostling for position', if you like."
entries.zh:
"提醒一句，\"他语气轻快，\"在速子科技，我们有...怎么说呢——'利益区'？"

"正式的职位说明，当然只写明最低的期望。速子科技要求所有雇员——以及承包商——只要有可能，就要拿出超越职责严格界定的野心与主动性，去超过期望。这自然会造成一定程度的摩擦，或者说'抢位置'，随你怎么说。"

entries.en:
"Your participation in the Sindrian Diktat situation has drawn attention from certain fellow executives who have profited greatly from the status quo - that is, the development, sale, and production of advanced technologies in the field of weapons, starship hulls, surveillance, and public relations."

"Willing or not, you've threatened their profits, which has led to a certain resentment." He pauses a moment, "Which I do not share, of course."

The smile re-appears.

He picks up his TriPad, as if concluding the conversation - though you know full well his implants can access any information he requires.
entries.zh:
"你在辛达强权那摊事里的作为，已经引来了几位同僚执行官的注意——那些人从现状里获利极丰，所谓现状，即武器、舰体、监控与公关领域先进技术的研发、销售与生产。"

"不管你有意无意，你威胁到了他们的利润，这就招来了一些怨气。\"他顿了顿，\"当然，我没有这种怨气。"

笑容又浮了上来。

他拿起 TriPad，像是要给这场谈话收尾——尽管你很清楚，他的植入体随时能调取他需要的任何信息。

entries.en:
"Your participation in the Sindrian Diktat situation has drawn attention from fellow executives who have profited greatly from the status quo - that is, the development, sale, and production of advanced technologies in the field of weapons, starship hulls, surveillance, and public relations."

"Willing or not, you appear to threaten their profits and position of favor, and this has led to a certain amount of resentment." He pauses a moment, "Which I do not share, of course."

The smile re-appears.

He picks up his TriPad, as if concluding the conversation - though you know full well his implants can access any information he requires.
entries.zh:
"你在辛达强权那摊事里的作为，已经引来了同僚执行官的注意——那些人从现状里获利极丰，所谓现状，即武器、舰体、监控与公关领域先进技术的研发、销售与生产。"

"不管你有意无意，你似乎威胁到了他们的利润与受宠的地位，这就招来了不少怨气。\"他顿了顿，\"当然，我没有这种怨气。"

笑容又浮了上来。

他拿起 TriPad，像是要给这场谈话收尾——尽管你很清楚，他的植入体随时能调取他需要的任何信息。

o.en: That's absurd. I support Hector, the rightful heir!
o.zh: 荒谬。我支持的是 Hector，合法继承人！

entries.en:
He glances at you one last time.

"You'll be attacked by a well-equipped war fleet. Could be mercenary, could be private. You didn't hear this from me, of course."

"Profit in all your ventures, captain," he says cheerfully.
entries.zh:
他最后看了你一眼。

"你会遭到一支装备精良的舰队袭击。可能是雇佣兵，也可能是私人武装。当然，这话你没从我这儿听过。"

"愿你每一桩生意都盈利，舰长，"他语气轻快地说。

entries.en: "Alas," Inesis says with an apologetic shrug. "They view Hector's cause as a secondary objective - one contingent upon their continued profits."
entries.zh: "唉，\"Inesis 歉意地耸了耸肩，\"他们只把 Hector 的事业当作次要目标——一个得看他们利润能否延续的目标。"

entries.en:
He glances at you one last time.

"You will be attacked by a very well-outfitted war fleet. Could be mercenary, could be private. You didn't hear this from me, of course."

"Profit in all your ventures, captain," he says cheerfully.
entries.zh:
他最后看了你一眼。

"你会遭到一支装备极精良的舰队袭击。可能是雇佣兵，也可能是私人武装。当然，这话你没从我这儿听过。"

"愿你每一桩生意都盈利，舰长，"他语气轻快地说。

entries.en:
"The first: you have a public-relations problem. Mr. Macario did some nasty work... and I'd be pleased to contract, on your behalf, a firm which specializes in reputation recovery of just this sort."

"60,000 credits and they'll undo the damage. Well, most of it, and we can only promise that outside of the Sindrian Diktat. I'll handle the details - my fee is built into the price. What do you say?"
entries.zh:
"第一件：你的公关出了问题。Macario 先生干的那些事可不干净...而我很乐意代你签下一家公司，专做这一类声誉修复。"

"60,000 星币，他们就能把损害抹平。嗯，大部分吧，而且我们只能保证在辛达强权境外有效。细节由我打理——我的抽成算在价里了。你说呢？"

o.en: I can handle my own reputation.
o.zh: 我自己的名声，我自己处理。

entries.en:
"A wise choice," he makes a small nod, as if you've taught him a subtle lesson. "I'll put in a request immediately."

"Just remember that these things take time. I think you'll be impressed by what my contact's firm can accomplish."
entries.zh:
"明智的选择，\"他微微颔首，仿佛你给他上了一堂不动声色的课，\"我这就去提申请。"

"只要记住，这种事需要时间。我想，我那位联系人手下公司的本事会让你满意的。"

entries.en: "Of course," he makes a small nod, as if you've taught him something.
entries.zh: "当然，"他微微颔首，仿佛你刚教会了他什么。

entries.en:
"Consider me pleased to have provided such comfort," Inesis says, installing a pleasant response on his face.

"Nonetheless, I can only expect you've come to me because you are interested in organizing a response to Macario's provocative act of defamation."
entries.zh:
"能给你这样的安慰，我很欣慰，"Inesis 说着，在脸上装配出一副愉快的表情。

"不过，我只能认为你来找我，是因为你有意组织一次对 Macario 那番挑衅性诽谤的回应。"

o.en: Yes, I believe your skillset could prove useful to those ends.
o.zh: 是的，我相信你的本事对这件事会有用。

o.en: You're smarter than you look, Faro.
No, I really am just trying to avoid getting entangled in this. Can you help?
o.zh: 不，我真的只是想避开这摊事。你能帮忙吗？

o.en: I'm more worried about what Macario is doing to the Sector.
o.zh: 我更在意的是 Macario 正在对星域做的事。

o.en: Honestly, I'm trying to avoid getting entangled in any of this. Can you help?
o.zh: 说实话，我只是想避开这摊事，不被卷进去。你能帮忙吗？

o.en: I'm more worried about taking out Dolos Macario.
o.zh: 我更在意的是除掉 Dolos Macario。

o.en: I intend to ensure Hector becomes Supreme Executor. All other considerations are secondary.
o.zh: 我要确保 Hector 成为最高元首。其他一切都在其次。

o.en: I want to remove Macario's corrupting influence from the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 我要把 Macario 的腐蚀性影响从辛达强权里清出去。

entries.en:
"'Taking out'," he says, giving you a look, smile fixed.

"An emotional response is logical, for among spacers you must maintain a certain aura of 'danger' to disincentivize hostile action against your property, particularly when operating in low-trust, high-violence interfactional volumes." He pauses. "The far fringe of civilized space."

"If I may be so bold as to infer your purpose: you wish to ask for MY help in 'taking out' Dolos Macario."

He watches you, a pleasant expression installed on his face.
entries.zh:
"'除掉'，"他说，看了你一眼，笑容不变。

"情绪化的反应是合乎逻辑的。在星海间讨生活的人当中，你必须维持某种'危险'的气场，才能让觊觎你产业的人不敢轻举妄动，尤其是在信任稀薄、暴力横行的势力交界空域。\"他顿了顿。\"也就是文明星域的远缘。"

"若我冒昧揣测一下你的目的：你是想请【我】帮忙'除掉' Dolos Macario。"

他注视着你，脸上装配着一副愉快的表情。

o.en: I suspect your skillset would be useful for accomplishing my objective.
o.zh: 我猜你的本事会有助于达成我的目标。

o.en: You're smarter than you look, Faro.

entries.en:
"'Remove'," he says, giving you a look, smile fixed.

"I admit that I share something of your sentiment concerning Mr. Macario; while his ministry is an excellent customer of certain Tri-Tachyon data gathering and processing services, our strategic predictors estimate that his leadership shows a negative impact on market confidence... even outside of Askonia."

With these last words, Inesis shakes his head with moderate disappointment.
entries.zh:
"'清除'，"他说，看了你一眼，笑容不变。

"我承认，对 Macario 先生，我多少与你同感；他的部门固然是速子科技某些数据采集与处理服务的优质客户，但我们的战略预测模型估计，他的领导对市场信心产生了负面影响...甚至在 Askonia 之外也是如此。"

说完最后一句，Inesis 带着几分失望摇了摇头。

o.en: We must remove Macario and support Hector.
o.zh: 我们必须清除 Macario，支持 Hector。

o.en: Perhaps we can just support Hector. He's an Andrada - he will handle Macario.
o.zh: 也许我们只要支持 Hector 就好。他是 Andrada 家的人——他会对付 Macario。

o.en: Let's discuss some other possibilities first...
o.zh: 我们先谈谈别的可能性...

entries.en:
So it's personal.

You will pledge yourself to one goal above all: the destruction of Dolos Macario.

Who are his enemies? Who will turn on him, who will aid you in sabotaging his machinations? Now is the time to call upon their resources.
entries.zh:
这么说，是私怨。

你将立誓只为一个目标：毁掉 Dolos Macario。

谁是他的敌人？谁会倒戈相向，谁会帮你破坏他的算计？现在正是动用他们资源的时候。

entries.en:
And what of the heirs?

Who will you back as a 'true' heir of Andrada?
entries.zh:
那些继承人呢？

你要拥立谁作 Andrada 的'真正'继承人？

o.en: Hector. Who I shall convince of my loyalty.
o.zh: Hector。我会让他相信我的忠诚。

o.en: Achilles. Who, conveniently, already opposes Macario.
o.zh: Achilles。正好，他本就与 Macario 为敌。

o.en: No one. Let them both burn, and their Sindrian Diktat with them.
o.zh: 谁都不。让他们两个一起烧，连同他们的辛达强权。

entries.en: So be it.
entries.zh: 那就这样吧。

o.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave

With the help of Arroyo - and it might take a little negotiation or, failing that, bribery - you'll be able to identify an opening. There may be other potential allies as well...

entries.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly. Hector must make his move, and soon - then Achilles will follow.

With Caden in command of the Lion's Guard fleet and paramilitary forces his backing may make all the difference to Hector's success - and, in turn, Macario's.

There may be other potential allies as well...
entries.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。Hector 必须出手，而且要快——然后 Achilles 才会跟上。

有 Caden 统率狮心卫队舰队与准军事部队，他的支持或许会决定 Hector 的成败——反过来，也会决定 Macario 的成败。

也许还有别的潜在盟友...

o.en: But how do I contact Caden if I am shoot-on-sight?
o.zh: 可我一露面就会遭到攻击，怎么联系 Caden？

entries.zh: 你答应过 Fortuna Kato，会帮她支持 Achilles 的继承主张——为了星币。你们两人都是 Macario 的敌人，利益自然一致。

o.en: I will speak with Fortuna Kato
o.zh: 我去和 Fortuna Kato 谈

o.en: This is personal. I'm going to make Macario regret ever speaking to me.
o.zh: 这是私人恩怨。我要让 Macario 后悔曾经对我说过话。

o.en: He's a monster. For the sake of the Sector, Macario's scheming must be stopped.
o.zh: 他是个怪物。为了星域，必须制止 Macario 的阴谋。

o.en: I don't want to get involved, it's not my fight.
o.zh: 我不想卷进去，这不是我的仗。

o.en: He's made a mistake. I must convince Macario that he needs me!
o.zh: 他走错了一步。我得让 Macario 相信他需要我！

o.en: Macario must be stopped before he tears the Sindrian Diktat apart.
o.zh: 必须在 Macario 把辛达强权撕碎之前制止他。

o.en: Macario must be stopped - for the sake of the Sindrian Diktat!
o.zh: 必须制止 Macario——为了辛达强权！

entries.en:
Smashing through Diktat fleets to capture Macario has an appealing directness. But he'll scurry away by one escape route or another as soon as you entered orbit.

You have to be more subtle. You consider options. And allies. Whoever you speak to first may send signals about your loyalties and priorities...
entries.zh:
击穿强权舰队、擒下 Macario，这种直截了当的做法颇有吸引力。可你一旦进入轨道，他就会从某条退路溜走。

你得做得更隐蔽。你权衡着选项，还有盟友。你先去找谁，或许就会透露出你的忠诚与轻重缓急...

entries.en: Although averse to your schemes as a rule, Rayan Arroyo might be persuaded to help by the promise of safe profits.
entries.zh: Rayan Arroyo 素来讨厌你那些算计，但若能许他一笔稳妥的利润，也许能说服他帮忙。

o.en: I will speak with Rayan Arroyo
o.zh: 我去和 Rayan Arroyo 谈

entries.en: Though you don't hold a Hegemony commission, Orcus Rao is a contact - and certainly interested in arranging the downfall of his counterpart in the 'Sindrian Mutiny'.
entries.zh: 你虽然不持有霸主的委任状，但 Orcus Rao 算得上是旧识——而且他必定有兴趣安排'辛达叛乱'中那位同侪的倒台。

o.en: I will speak with Orcus Rao

o.zh: 我先去和 Orcus Rao 谈

o.zh: 我去和 Oxana Hyder 谈

entries.en: If you could smash through those fleets and capture Macario, you'd leave the pride of the Sindrian Diktat scattered and demoralized. The polity would be vulnerable to intervention from the Hegemony, or perhaps even Achilles Andrada with Persean League backing.
entries.zh: 如果你能击穿那些舰队、擒住 Macario，辛达强权引以为傲的军力将四散溃败、士气尽失。这个政权就会脆弱到任人介入——霸主会来，甚至可能有英仙座联盟撑腰的 Achilles Andrada。

o.en: I can do it myself. I will be ready when an opportunity arises.
o.zh: 我自己来。时机一到，我会准备好的。

entries.en: Reynard Hannan is the most powerful man in the Persean League. He can help you, if you prove yourself to him by helping him respond to this Second Askonia Crisis.
