o.zh: 我去和 Reynard Hannan 谈。

entries.en: Reynard Hannan is the most powerful man in the Persean League. He can help you, if you prove yourself to him by helping him respond to this Second Askonia Crisis.
entries.zh: Reynard Hannan 是英仙座联盟最有势力的人。只要你能帮他应对这场第二次 Askonia 危机，向他证明自己的价值，他就会帮你。

o.en: I will speak with Reynard Hannan.
o.zh: 我去和 Reynard Hannan 谈。

entries.en:
Macario is a faithless manipulator who believes in nothing, who wants nothing but to play cruel games with the lives of those in his power.

He'll cause more chaos and death - unless someone takes charge of the Sindrian Diktat and frees it from his corrupting influence.
entries.zh:
Macario 是个没有信念的操纵者，什么都不信，只想拿那些落到他手里的人的性命，玩残酷的游戏。

他会造出更多的混乱与死亡——除非有人接管辛达强权，把它从他腐蚀性的影响中解救出来。

o.en: Macario must be removed; Achilles should lead the Sindrian Diktat
o.zh: 必须除掉 Macario；辛达强权该由 Achilles 来领导

o.en: Macario must be removed; Hector should lead the Sindrian Diktat
o.zh: 必须除掉 Macario；辛达强权该由 Hector 来领导

o.en: It doesn't matter right now - Macario must be removed
o.zh: 现在这些都无所谓——必须除掉 Macario

entries.en:
Macario is a faithless manipulator who believes in nothing but his own power to play games with the lives of those around him. He'll cause more chaos and death before the end, unless someone can truly take charge of the Sindrian Diktat.

Not a puppet - a leader.

The true heir to Philip Andrada must rise.
entries.zh:
Macario 是个毫无信义的操弄者，除了自己那点玩弄他人性命的本事，他什么都不信。除非有人能真正接手辛达强权，否则在一切结束之前，他还会制造更多的混乱与死亡。

不是傀儡——是领袖。

Philip Andrada 真正的继承人必须站出来。

o.en: Macario must be removed - Hector should lead the Sindrian Diktat
o.zh: 必须除掉 Macario——辛达强权该由 Hector 来领导

o.en: Macario must be removed - Achilles should lead the Sindrian Diktat
o.zh: 必须除掉 Macario——辛达强权该由 Achilles 来领导

entries.en:
You decide that Achilles must lead the Sindrian Diktat.

He is not a puppet of Macario, and and he's much more than a weak echo of the worst side of Philip Andrada.

There is, of course, the matter of Fortuna Kato.

She intends to manipulate Achilles through her support of his cause. She claims he's a willing partner in the arrangement, but her goals are to recenter of power in the Persean League, perhaps even making Askonia a full League member...
entries.zh:
你决定，辛达强权必须由 Achilles 来领导。

他不是 Macario 的傀儡，也远不只是 Philip Andrada 最坏那一面的软弱回声。

当然，还有 Fortuna Kato 这一桩。

她打算借着支持他的事业来操纵他。她声称他在这桩安排里是自愿的伙伴，可她的目标是把权力重心重新搬回英仙座联盟，甚至可能让 Askonia 成为联盟的正式成员...

o.en: And that's fine, Fortuna's plan for Achilles is the best outcome
o.zh: 那也无妨，Fortuna 为 Achilles 安排的路就是最好的结果

o.en: Fortuna Kato's plans must be thwarted as well
o.zh: Fortuna Kato 的算盘也必须打掉

o.en: Wait and see - first Achilles needs to beat Hector
o.zh: 静观其变——Achilles 得先打赢 Hector

entries.en:
Fortuna Kato must be stopped as well. But how?

Undermine her position within the League through the machinations of the other gens, Hannan and Yaribay? Or by ensuring that Achilles has an independent base of support - enough that he need not answer to Fortuna's beck and call?

A direct approach could undermine Achilles. You'll have to be clever.
entries.zh:
Fortuna Kato 也必须被拦住。可怎么拦？

借另外两个氏族——Hannan 与 Yaribay——的算计来动摇她在联盟里的地位？还是确保 Achilles 有一块独立的支持基础——大到他不必听凭 Fortuna 呼来喝去？

直接动手可能会害了 Achilles。你得聪明些。

o.en: The fact remains - Macario must be destroyed
o.zh: 事实不变——Macario 必须被摧毁

entries.en:
Hector must lead the Sindrian Diktat - and not as Macario's puppet.

It won't be easy, because Macario has already poisoned Hector's opinion of you, judging by the recordings you experienced at 58966 Elysium.

But, surely, the transcendent philosophy of Philip Andrada will prevail.

The Blood of Andrada MUST prevail.
entries.zh:
Hector 必须领导辛达强权——而且不能做 Macario 的傀儡。

这不会容易，因为从你在 58966 Elysium 经历过的那些录像来看，Macario 已经在 Hector 心里把对你的看法毒化了。

但是，Philip Andrada 那套超凡的哲学终将胜出。

Andrada 的血脉必须胜出。

entries.en: You decide that whatever happens, you need to remove Macario. Who will lead the Sindrian Diktat can be decided later.
entries.zh: 你决定，无论之后如何，Macario 都必须先除掉。至于谁来领导辛达强权，可以以后再说。

entries.en:
Internal conflicts can and should be set aside; they're a distraction from what's important. Achilles has a war to win.

And Macario must be destroyed.
entries.zh:
内部的纷争可以、也应该先搁到一边；那只会让人从要紧的事上分心。Achilles 还有一场战争要打赢。

而 Macario 必须被摧毁。

entries.en:
Fortuna Kato will do what is best for her - and for the Sector. She'll do her best to see that Achilles prevails.

The fact remains: Macario must be destroyed.
entries.zh:
Fortuna Kato 会做对她自己、也对星域最有利的事。她会尽力让 Achilles 胜出。

事实不变：Macario 必须被摧毁。

entries.en:
But how?

If you could smash through the fleets and capture Macario, you'd leave the pride of the Sindrian Diktat scattered and demoralized.

The one polity which embodies Andrada's Transcendent Ideology would be left vulnerable to invasion!

By the Hegemony. Or the Persean League. Or Luddic infiltrators...

Another war, another occupation. Industry razed, ships and stations blazing like short-lived stars; hundreds of thousands, possibly millions, left dead.
entries.zh:
可怎么做？

就算你能一路击穿那些舰队、抓住 Macario，你也会让辛达强权的骄傲四散溃逃、士气尽失。

那个唯一承载着 Andrada 超凡意识形态的政体，将被暴露在入侵之下！

来自霸主。或者英仙座联盟。或者卢德派的渗透者...

又一场战争，又一次占领。工业被夷平，舰船与空间站像短命的星辰一样燃烧；数十万人，也许数百万人，就此死去。

entries.en:
Besides, as soon as your fleet secured an orbit, he'd scurry away by one escape route or another to the safe houses he must have on half the worlds of the Persean Sector.

You have to be more subtle. You consider options and allies. Whoever you speak to first will send a signal about which faction you favor.
entries.zh:
再说，你的舰队一旦进入轨道，他就会从某条退路溜走，躲进他在英仙座星域半数星球上都备着的安全屋。

你得做得更隐蔽些。你权衡着手里的选项与潜在的盟友。你先去找谁，就等于向各方表明你偏向哪一边。

entries.en:
You'll tear apart the Spider's web and crush him like a bug.

He made it personal and you're going to show him the only way this can be allowed to end.

There's one big problem, to begin with.
entries.zh:
你要撕碎他这张蜘蛛网，像碾死一只虫子那样碾碎他。

他把这事变成了私人恩怨，而你要让他看清，这件事唯一被允许的结局是什么。

首先就有一个大问题。

o.en: He's sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 他安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

entries.en:
You'll tear apart the Spider's web and crush him like a bug.

He made it personal and you're going to show him the only way this can be allowed to end.

There is a big problem, to begin with.
entries.zh:
你要撕碎他这张蜘蛛网，像碾死一只虫子那样碾碎他。

他把这事变成了私人恩怨，而你要让他看清，这件事唯一被允许的结局是什么。

首先就有个大问题。

o.en: He took my Sindrian Diktat commission.
o.zh: 他夺走了我的辛达强权委任状。

entries.en:
Are you loyal to the Sindrian Diktat?

Without your commission, declared a terrorist and target of a kill-on-sight order, how can you demonstrate your support for the next Supreme Executor?
entries.zh:
你忠于辛达强权吗？

没了委任状，又被宣布为恐怖分子、成了格杀勿论令的目标，你还怎么向下一任最高元首表明你的支持？

o.en: I am loyal to the Sindrian Diktat! There must be a way.
o.zh: 我忠于辛达强权！总有办法的。

o.en: None of that matters to me.
o.zh: 那些对我来说都无所谓。

entries.en:
What loyalty you had to the Sindrian Diktat is as void and null as your former commission. It is the natural consequence of betrayal.

This brings you to the second problem.
entries.zh:
你对辛达强权曾有过的忠诚，已和你从前的委任状一样归于无效。这是背叛的必然结果。

这就引出了第二个问题。

o.en: Macario is sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: Macario 安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

entries.en:
You'll tear down his Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from his ruthless manipulation.

They will all thank you when he is gone.

There's one big problem, to begin with.
entries.zh:
你要拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从他冷酷的操纵中解放出来。

等他倒了，所有人都会感谢你。

首先就有一个大问题。

o.en: He's sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 他安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

entries.en:
You'll tear down his Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from his ruthless manipulation. You did deny Fortuna Kato's request to back Achilles' bid to become Supreme Executor, even if his victory would implicitly remove Macario from power.

You'll just have to ensure it happens by some other means.

And there's one big problem, to begin with.
entries.zh:
你要拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从他冷酷的操纵中解放出来。你确实拒绝了 Fortuna Kato 要你支持 Achilles 争夺最高元首之位的请求，尽管他的胜利会顺带让 Macario 失去权力。

你只能另想办法，确保这件事发生。

而首先，就有个大问题。

o.en: Macario is sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: Macario 安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

entries.en:
You've told Fortuna Kato you'll back Achilles Andrada's bid to become Supreme Executor. By doing so, he'll tear down the Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from Macario's ruthless manipulation.

They will thank you when he is gone.

There's one big problem, to begin with.
entries.zh:
你已经告诉 Fortuna Kato，你会支持 Achilles Andrada 争夺最高元首之位。这样一来，他就能拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从 Macario 冷酷的操纵中解放出来。

等他倒了，他们会感谢你的。

首先就有一个大问题。

o.en: Macario is sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: Macario 安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

entries.en:
You'll tear down his Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from his ruthless manipulation.

You've even told Fortuna Kato that you'll back Achilles Andrada's bid to become Supreme Executor so long as she makes it worth your time. Her first payment was but a taste.

If Achilles wins, you get paid. If Achilles wins, Macario loses. What's not to like?

There's one big problem, to begin with.
entries.zh:
你要拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从他冷酷的操纵中解放出来。

你甚至已经告诉 Fortuna Kato，只要她出的价对得起你的时间，你就会支持 Achilles Andrada 争夺最高元首之位。她付的第一笔，不过是个开头。

Achilles 赢了，你拿钱。Achilles 赢了，Macario 就输了。有什么不好？

首先就有一个大问题。

o.en: Macario is sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: Macario 安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

entries.en:
He's put you in a tough spot and made himself your problem. Perhaps you can avoid Macario and the fallout from his schemes.

But Macario did declare you a psychotic, murderous terrorist in front of the entire Persean Sector, and the number one enemy of the Sindrian Diktat.

It won't be easy to ignore.
entries.zh:
他把你逼进一个难堪的境地，也把自己变成了你的麻烦。也许你可以避开 Macario，避开他那些算计带来的余波。

可 Macario 毕竟当着整个英仙座星域宣布你是个嗜血的疯子恐怖分子，是辛达强权的头号敌人。

想置之不理，没那么容易。

o.en: I'll just have to do my best

entries.en:
Macario is a faithless manipulator who believes in nothing but his own power. He never cared for Andrada's vision, however faded it became in those final cycles. A true heir to Philip Andrada must stand and take up the mantle, throw off Macario's web of lies, and usher in a new age.

Not as a puppet. As a leader.
entries.zh:
Macario 是个没有信念的操纵者，除了自己的权力，他什么都不信。Andrada 的愿景在最后那些星历年里无论褪色到什么地步，他也从未真正在意过。Philip Andrada 真正的继承人必须站出来，接过这份衣钵，挣脱 Macario 的谎言之网，开启一个新的时代。

不是当傀儡。是当领袖。

o.en: Macario must be removed; Hector should lead the Sindrian Diktat
o.zh: 必须除掉 Macario；辛达强权该由 Hector 来领导

o.en: Macario must be removed; Achilles should lead the Sindrian Diktat
o.zh: 必须除掉 Macario；辛达强权该由 Achilles 来领导

entries.en:
One comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and set everything right.
entries.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说明他犯下的错误，把一切拨回正轨。

o.en: I must confront Macario and make him recognize his error
o.zh: 我必须当面质问 Macario，让他认清自己的错误

entries.en:
One comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and give him one last chance to correct himself before you show him the true meaning of power.
entries.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说明他犯下的错误，在他见识到权力的真正含义之前，给他最后一次改过的机会。

o.en: It must be done. Macario must be shown the error of his ways
o.zh: 必须这么做。必须让 Macario 看清他错在哪里

entries.en:
You are a believer in the power of the Sindrian Diktat, after all. Macario would wield that power, but he's a fool to try to discard his best ally in attaining power - perhaps even his better.

As satisfying as it would be to prove this to him by smashing down his office doors at the head of a squad of marines, this is a matter that requires opening with a round of negotiation.

Establishing a direct line of communication will be difficult. You cannot approach Sindria without being attacked, and if you prevailed against the defense fleets, wasting the power of the Diktat in senseless fighting does not serve your purpose.
entries.zh:
毕竟，你信仰辛达强权的力量。Macario 想驾驭这份力量，可若他在夺权的路上抛弃自己最好的盟友，那他就是个蠢货——那位盟友或许还比他更胜一筹。

带着一队陆战队砸开他办公室的大门、当面向他证明这一点，固然痛快，但这件事得先以一轮谈判开场。

建立一条直通线路会很困难。你一靠近 Sindria 就会遭到攻击；就算你压过了防御舰队，让强权的力量耗在无谓的厮杀里也达不到你的目的。

entries.en:
You are a believer in the Sindrian Diktat, after all. Your bear a commission - or did until Macario declared it away.

Macario must be reminded of the power of loyalty - your own, above all - and his own to Andrada's vision. The pomp and intellectualization of the transcendent ideology is superstructure upon the fundamental fact that power flows to those who possess the will to seize and master it.
entries.zh:
毕竟，你信仰辛达强权。你持有它的委任状——至少在 Macario 宣布作废之前还持有。

必须让 Macario 想起忠诚的分量——尤其是你的忠诚——以及他对 Andrada 构想的忠诚。那套超凡意识形态的排场与高谈阔论，不过是上层建筑；底下那个根本事实是：权力归于那些有意志去夺取并驾驭它的人。

entries.en: Establishing a direct line of communication will be difficult, however. You cannot approach Sindria without being attacked, and if you prevailed against the defense fleets, wasting the power of the Diktat in senseless fighting would undermine your cause.
entries.zh: 不过，建立一条直通线路会很困难。你一靠近 Sindria 就会遭到攻击；就算你压过了那些防御舰队，让强权的力量耗在这种无谓的厮杀里，也只会削弱你自己的事业。

entries.en: You've sown a seed of distrust between Horacio Caden and Macario. Perhaps it's time to see if it will bear bloody fruit.
entries.zh: 你已在 Horacio Caden 与 Macario 之间埋下了猜忌的种子。也许该看看它会不会结出见血的果实了。

o.en: I will speak with Horacio Caden
o.zh: 我去和 Horacio Caden 谈

entries.en: You've sown a seed of trust with Horacio Caden. With your shared loyalty to Philip Andrada's vision, surely you can find a way to save the Sindrian Diktat.
entries.zh: 你已在 Horacio Caden 心中埋下了信任的种子。既然你们都忠于 Philip Andrada 的构想，总能找到一条拯救辛达强权的路。

o.en: I will speak with Horacio Caden
o.zh: 我去和 Horacio Caden 谈

entries.en: You recall telling Macario that Hyder wanted to install herself as Supreme Executor. He may move against her sooner than later.
entries.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Macario 说，Hyder 想把自己推上最高元首之位。他也许很快就会对她动手。

entries.en: You recall telling Caden that Hyder wants to become Supreme Executor. He dismissed it at the time...
entries.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Caden 说，Hyder 想当最高元首。他当时没当回事...

entries.en: You recall telling Macario that Hyder wants to defect to the Hegemony. He might take action against her.
entries.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Macario 说，Hyder 想叛投霸主。他也许会因此对她采取行动。

entries.en: You recall telling Caden that Macario backs Hyder, surely leading to some resentment on Caden's part...
entries.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Caden 说，Macario 在背后支持 Hyder——这想必让 Caden 生出几分怨恨...

entries.en: You recall telling Macario contradictory 'facts' about Hyder's intentions, which did not endear you to him. but will he act against Hyder nonetheless based on any of it?
entries.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Macario 讲过关于 Hyder 意图的种种自相矛盾的'事实'，这并没让你在他那里讨到好。可他会不会仍然依据其中某一条，对 Hyder 下手？

entries.en:
The only way you are going to be able to contact Hector - or anyone else - is directly.

And without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given kill-on-sight orders. Will Hyder hold her ships back? Would Caden?

Will Hector take command of his own fleet, when war breaks out? He must, you think - for he bears the blood of Andrada. To do any less would be shameful.
entries.zh:
你能联系上 Hector——或任何其他人——的唯一办法，就是直接接触。

而且还不能撞上接到格杀令的辛达强权舰队。Hyder 会约束住她的舰船吗？Caden 会吗？

战火一起，Hector 会亲自统率自己的舰队吗？你认为他一定会——因为他身上流着 Andrada 的血。做不到，便是耻辱。

o.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave

entries.en: It is increasingly clear that he considers you a loose end that needs to be trimmed.
entries.zh: 越来越清楚的是，他把你当成了一个需要剪掉的尾巴。

o.en: Forget about Macario, then. I must support the Sindrian Diktat!
o.zh: 那就别再管 Macario 了。我必须支持辛达强权！

o.en: I'll make Macario regret his betrayal. Revenge will be mine!
o.zh: 我要让 Macario 为他的背叛后悔。这仇我一定报！

entries.en:
The question remains- Which Sindrian Diktat?

Who will you back as the true heir of Andrada?
entries.zh:
问题仍在——哪一个辛达强权？

你要拥立谁作 Andrada 真正的继承人？

o.en: Hector. Who I shall convince of my loyalty.
o.zh: Hector。我会让他相信我的忠诚。

o.en: Achilles. Who, conveniently, already opposes Macario.
o.zh: Achilles。正好，他本就与 Macario 为敌。

entries.en: Then you must pledge yourself to Achilles, a trained military leader who is not burdened by being the puppet of a spymaster quite so treacherous as Dolos Macario.
entries.zh: 那么你必须向 Achilles 宣誓效忠——一位受过训练的军事领袖，不必背负做 Dolos Macario 这种背信弃义的谍报头子傀儡的包袱。

o.en: Disconnect from the relay and leave

entries.en:
Then you must prove yourself despite the inconvenience of being declared the foremost enemy of the Sindrian Diktat by that treacherous spymaster.

Hector will recognize your loyalty because you will demonstrate it to him by providing material support, securing wavering allies, and pledging yourself directly to his cause - once you have the opportunity to do so...
entries.zh:
那么，尽管那个背信弃义的谍报头子已把你宣布为辛达强权的头号公敌，你仍得证明自己。

Hector 会认可你的忠诚，因为你要以实际支援、稳住摇摆的盟友、直接向他宣誓效忠来向他证明——只等你有机会这么做...

entries.en:
Macario is controlling the comms network. The only way to contact Hector - or anyone else - is directly.

And without being intercepted by a Sindrian Diktat fleet given kill-on-sight orders. Will Hyder hold her ships back? Would Caden?

Will Hector take command of his own fleet, when war breaks out? He must, you think - for he bears the blood of Andrada. To do any less would be shameful.
entries.zh:
Macario 控制着通讯网络。要联系 Hector——或任何其他人——唯一的办法是直接接触。

而且还不能撞上接到格杀令的辛达强权舰队。Hyder 会约束住她的舰船吗？Caden 会吗？

战火一起，Hector 会亲自统率自己的舰队吗？你认为他一定会——因为他身上流着 Andrada 的血。做不到，便是耻辱。

entries.zh: 你深吸一口气，然后睁开眼。

entries.en:
What is Macario's ploy?

Hector has declared himself Supreme Executor, the heir to Andrada. This moment is critical to the future of the Diktat.

But how? Macario is controlling the comms network and seems determined that you play the role of antagonist.
entries.zh:
Macario 在打什么算盘？

Hector 已自立为最高元首，Andrada 的继承人。此刻对强权的未来至关重要。

可该怎么做？Macario 控制着通讯网络，而且似乎打定主意要让你来扮那个反派。

entries.en:
Hector has declared himself Supreme Executor, the heir to Andrada. This moment is critical to the future of the Diktat!

Macario is controlling the comms network and is determined that you play the role of antagonist. No doubt he's seen fit to dispatch a fleet to catch you in the act of 'sabotaging' the system comms relay...
entries.zh:
Hector 已自立为最高元首，Andrada 的继承人。此刻对强权的未来至关重要！

Macario 控制着通讯网络，且打定主意要让你来扮那个反派。他多半还觉得派一支舰队来，正好能当场逮住你在'破坏'星系通讯中继站...

o.en: Was it a mistake to trust Macario?
o.zh: 信任 Macario 是不是一开始就错了？

entries.en:
It is highly likely that this is going to become a dangerous place to be found meddling with Diktat infrastructure, and soon.

The civil war must begin when Achilles declares his claim.

Which he must, and soon.
entries.zh:
此地十有八九很快就会变成一个危险的地方：一旦被人发现你在动强权的基础设施。

内战必定会随着 Achilles 宣布继承权而开始。

而他必定会，而且很快。

entries.zh: 按 Fortuna Kato 的请求，你需要前往 Yesod，与 Achilles 取得联系。

entries.en: $HeOrShe ignores your words.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe对你的话置之不理。

entries.en:
"I swore loyalty 'til death- and beyond, that my actions may live forever in glorious history."

"Degenerate spacers like yourself will never understand greatness! I have risen above traitors and weakness, through eternal war I shall demonstrate my eternal devotion to the Great Movement!"

You see now the mania and gleam of combat stim abuse; $heOrShe proceeds to rant about your forthcoming destruction, providing no sign that he will listen to reason.
entries.zh:
"我曾宣誓效忠，至死 —— 乃至死后，好让我的事迹永载光荣的史册。"

"像你这种堕落的太空佬，永远不懂何谓伟大！我已超越叛徒与软弱，我要通过永不停歇的战争，向伟大运动证明我永恒的忠诚！"

你这才看清他眼中那股狂躁，还有滥用战斗兴奋剂的异样光泽；$heOrShe接着喋喋不休地预言你的灭亡，全无半点听得进道理的样子。

entries.en: $HeOrShe ignores your words.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe对你的话置之不理。

entries.en: $HeOrShe ignores your words.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe对你的话置之不理。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe laughs a laugh found somewhere beside madness.

"Of course you don't understand! You could never understand, for you are a degenerate spacer - lost, lost from blood and greatness. I serve unto death, and beyond death. Sindria is become a glorious beacon of death to an unworthy Sector, an unworthy galaxy; an unworthy species - plagued by weakness, brought down by treachery! My actions, a shadow, an echo of Andrada's genius, will join the others of the Glorious Movement and burn through history like-"

You see now the mania and gleam of combat stim abuse; $heOrShe proceeds to rant about your forthcoming destruction, giving little sign of listening to reason.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe笑了，那笑声像是从疯狂边上某处捡来的。

"你当然不明白！你永远也不会明白，因为你是个堕落的太空佬 —— 失落了，从血脉与伟大中彻底失落了。我效忠至死，直至死后。Sindria 已经成了一座死亡的光辉灯塔，照向这个不配的星域、不配的银河、不配的物种 —— 被软弱所困，被背叛所毁！我的作为，是 Andrada 天才的一道影子、一声回响，它将汇入光荣运动其他人的行列，如..."

你这才看清他眼中那股狂躁，还有滥用战斗兴奋剂的异样光泽；$heOrShe接着喋喋不休地预言你的灭亡，几乎全无听得进道理的样子。

entries.en: "Get your $shipOrFleet to the Askonia relay and upload that hack." He puts on a skeptical look. "I'm curious to see if it'll actually do what the techs say it will."
entries.zh: "把你的$shipOrFleet开到 Askonia 的中继站，把那套黑客程序传上去。\"他露出一副怀疑的神情。\"我挺好奇它到底会不会真像技术员说的那样管用。"

entries.en:
"You understand that you bear a commission of the Hegemony, $titleHeg?"

Rao looks well beyond displeased.

"Do you understand that your conduct while bearing that commission reflects upon the Hegemony, $titleHeg? And that pledging support for the clone of a traitor is so far beyond any reasonable act that I would never have expected to have to explicitly forbid it?"

He holds up a finger. "Do not answer. I'm not interested in excuses."
entries.zh:
"你明白自己持有霸主的委任状吗，$titleHeg？"

Rao 的表情远不止是不悦。

"你明白带着这份委任状时，你的一举一动都关系到霸主的颜面吗，$titleHeg？你明白公开支持一个叛徒的克隆体，已经越出任何合理的界限，我压根没想到自己还得明令禁止这种事吗？"

他竖起一根手指。"别回答。我对借口没兴趣。"

entries.en:
"I'll not belabor it. You screwed up." He takes a deep breath, eyes closed. "I don't want to see your face right now."

His hand reaches for his comms interface and- the link cuts.
entries.zh:
"我不再多说。你搞砸了。\"他闭上眼，深吸一口气。\"我现在不想看到你的脸。"

他的手伸向通讯界面，然后——链路断了。

entries.en:
"I'll not belabor it. You screwed up." He takes a deep breath, eyes closed. "I don't want to see your face right now."

Eyes open.

"But the war won't wait for that."
entries.zh:
"我不再多说。你搞砸了。\"他闭上眼，深吸一口气。\"我现在不想看到你的脸。"

他睁开眼。

"可战争不会等我消了这口气。"

entries.en:
She pauses, then reaches toward her ear, turning aside.

"No apologies. If it's critical, report!" Her impatience burns.

Hyder listens to something; her eyes turn back to you. She looks worried.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." A small voice in your ear.

It's your comms officer. You're not sure they've ever interrupted one of your private conversations like this.
entries.zh:
她顿了顿，随即抬手按住耳侧，转过身去。

"不必道歉。要是紧急，就报告！"她的不耐烦几乎灼人。

Hyder 听着什么，目光转回你身上。她看上去有些担忧。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。"你耳边响起一个细小的声音。

是你的通讯军官。你记不清他们何时这样打断过你的私人通话。

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your comms officer continues, a whisper in your ear. "Holofeed from the relay, direct from Sindria- full broadcast, priority override. Content sweep flagged critical high interest."

"Captain," Hyder says with all the dignity she can recover from the interruption. "There is... news. Let us resume this conversation in a few minutes."
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam，\"通讯军官在你耳边低语着继续说，\"中继站转来的全息信号，直接从 Sindria 发来——全频道广播，最高优先级覆盖。内容筛选标记为极高关注。"

"舰长，\"Hyder 尽力从被打断的狼狈中拾回威严，\"有...消息。我们几分钟后再继续这场谈话。"

o.en: Agreed. I'm putting the link on hold.

o.zh: 什么事能要紧到这个地步？

entries.en:
"Hyder out," she says crisply, and the connection snaps to a holding pattern.

The crest of the Sindrian Diktat Navy.
entries.zh:
"Hyder 完毕，"她干脆地说，连接应声转入保持画面。

辛达强权海军的徽记。

o.en: Comms- what's going on? Forward the feed.
o.zh: 通讯——怎么回事？把信号接过来。

entries.en:
"I don't trust a word from-"

She pauses mid-chastisement, reaching toward her ear and turning aside.

"Cease the apologies, you've already interrupted. If it's critical, report!"

She listens, and as she does her eyes turn back to you. Accusing.
entries.zh:
"那边的话我一个字都不信——"

训斥到一半，她停住了，抬手按住耳侧，转过身去。

"别再道歉了，你已经打断了。要是紧急，就报告！"

她听着，目光随之转回你身上。带着责问。

o.en: What I have to say is more important than old disagreements.
o.zh: 我要说的事，比旧日的分歧重要得多。

o.en: I should thank your underling, that was getting upsetting.
o.zh: 我倒该谢谢你的下属，刚才那场面快让人受不了了。

entries.en: She doesn't appear to listen as you speak.
entries.zh: 你说话时，她似乎根本没在听。

entries.en: She doesn't appear to listen as you speak.
entries.zh: 你说话时，她似乎根本没在听。

entries.en:
"$PlayerLastName," Hyder says with all the dignity she can recover. "No more games. If we meet again, it will be in battle."

The fire died from her voice; she doesn't care about you anymore. Something else has her worried.

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerLastName，"Hyder 说话时已拾回了几分威严。"别再耍花样了。若我们再见面，那就是在战场上。"

她声音里的火气熄了；她已经不再在意你。有别的事让她忧心。

通讯切断。

entries.en:
"$PlayerLastName," Hyder spits your name like poison. "No more games. If we meet again, it will be in battle."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerLastName，"Hyder 吐出你的名字，像吐出一口毒。"别再耍花样了。若我们再见面，那就是在战场上。"

通讯切断。

entries.en:
"No," she says.

"I shall not be playing another of Macario's games. I refuse. If we meet again, it will be-"

She pauses, reaching toward her ear, turning aside.

"No apologies. If it's critical, report!"

As Hyder listens, her eyes turn back to you. Worried. Accusing. Like something is your fault.
entries.zh:
"不行，"她说。

"我不会再陪 Macario 玩这种把戏。我拒绝。若我们再见面，那便是——"

她停住话头，抬手按住耳侧，转过身去。

"不必道歉。要是紧急，就报告！"

Hyder 听着，目光转回你身上。忧虑。责问。仿佛一切都是你的过错。

o.en: Whatever it is, I didn't do it.
o.zh: 不管出了什么事，都不是我干的。

entries.en:
"Do not contact me again," she spits. "Hyder out."

True to her word, the feed cuts.
entries.zh:
"别再联系我，\"她啐道，\"Hyder 完毕。"

她说到做到，通讯画面随即切断。

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam." There's a small voice in your ear.

It's your comms officer. You're not sure they've ever interrupted one of your private conversations.

To be fair, though, this one was concluded.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam。"你耳边响起一个细小的声音。

是你的通讯军官。你记不清他们何时打断过你的私人通话。

不过平心而论，这一通已经谈完了。

entries.en:
"No," she says. "I'm not playing any more of Macario's games. I refuse. Do not contact me again," she spits. "Hyder out."

True to her word, the feed cuts.
entries.zh:
"不行，\"她说。\"我不会再陪 Macario 玩下去了。我拒绝。别再联系我，\"她啐道，\"Hyder 完毕。"

她说到做到，通讯画面随即切断。

entries.en:
The connection stutters through a series of hyperwave adjustment cycles, then proceeds to a holding signal- awaiting pickup.

After a moment, Hyder herself appears, at attention.

A look of shock flashes across her face as she registers it is indeed you she is looking at, not a lieutenant star marshal ensconced in the star fortress orbiting Sindria, as she expected.
entries.zh:
连接在一连串超波校准周期中卡顿地推进，随后转入等待接通的保持信号。

片刻之后，Hyder 本人出现在画面中，站得笔直。

当她看清屏幕对面确实是你，而不是她预想中那位驻守 Sindria 轨道恒星要塞的低阶星际元帅时，脸上闪过一丝震惊。

o.en: Deputy Star Marshal Hyder. We have much to discuss.

It takes more than a few minutes for the comms to bounce between what you assume are low-level functionaries who, luckily, read the request tags without summoning the courage to ask you your business directly.

But, finally, Dolos Macario appears before you.
entries.zh:
通讯在几个你猜是基层办事员的人之间来回转接了不止几分钟——好在他们只看了请求标签，没敢直接问你来意。

但最后，Dolos Macario 还是出现在你面前。

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam, you're going to want to see this. Picked it up from the relay. Full broadcast, priority override of commercial bands. Content sweep flagged high interest."

An announcement from Sindria, holofeed. Almost, but not quite, live.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam，这个你肯定想看看。从中继上截到的。全频道广播，优先级覆盖商业频段。内容扫描标记为高关注。"

一则来自 Sindria 的公告，全息讯号。几乎是实时的，但又算不上完全实时。

entries.en: Reynard's meaning is as clear as your answer to his arrogant demand. If you want help, you'll have to go elsewhere.
entries.zh: 你对他那傲慢要求的回答，已经让 Reynard 的意思再明白不过。想要帮忙，你得另寻他人。

entries.en:
"Fortuna Kato's puppet, Achilles, will soon launch his claim as Philip Andrada's heir."

He looks off-link as he speaks, at some view not shared with you. It's probably grand.

"She seeks to undermine the cohesion of the Persean League and primacy of Gens Hannan. A foolish plan, and doomed, but it nonetheless requires my personal response."

He smiles to himself, a feral gleam in his eyes. "She'll see that I am not lax in my attentions. And you can help me with a part of it."
entries.zh:
"Fortuna Kato 的傀儡，Achilles，很快就要公开宣称自己是 Philip Andrada 的继承人。"

他说话时目光飘向链路之外，看着一处不与你共享的景象。那景象想必很气派。

"她想瓦解英仙座联盟的团结，动摇 Hannan 氏族的首要地位。这计划很蠢，也注定失败，可终究需要我亲自应对。"

他自顾自地笑了笑，眼里闪着野性的光。"她会看到，我盯事情从不松懈。而其中一部分，你可以帮我。"

entries.en:
"A quiet and civilized war, as is proper. I have had a quantity of materiel assembled. It shall be transferred to your name before the end of our conversation."

"I want you to take this materiel to Umbra and give Imoinu Kato everything she possibly wants for her little play-revolution."

He seems very, very pleased with himself.

"Do this, and you will be rewarded."
entries.zh:
"一场安静而文明的战争，这才合规矩。我已经备好了一批军需物资，等我们谈完，就会转到你名下。"

"我要你把这批物资送到 Umbra，交给 Imoinu Kato；她那个过家家似的革命要什么，就给她什么。"

他看上去对自己满意极了。

"办成这件事，你会得到赏赐。"

o.en: You want me to... help Imoinu and the ARC?
o.zh: 你要我...去帮 Imoinu 和 ARC？

entries.en:
"I was going to ask you to take weapons and supplies to Umbra to fuel one Imoinu Kato's little revolution - imagine my surprise at the report that you had already done so!"

He examines you with an oddly penetrating gaze far from his usual show of nonchalance.

"If I was a more suspicious man, I might have concerns that you shared the anarchic delusions of Antis like the Gens Kato child. But I know you better than that, $titlePL. You appreciate what power provides."

"Keep up the good work. I want the Gens Kato child to have everything she wants."
entries.zh:
"我本打算让你带武器和补给去 Umbra，给 Imoinu Kato 那场小革命添把火——结果报告说，你已经这么干过了！你可以想见我有多意外。"

他打量着你，目光锐利得有些反常，全无平日那副漫不经心。

"我要是疑心再重些，或许会担心你跟 Kato 氏族那小丫头一样，抱着 Antis 那套无政府的妄想。可我了解你，$titlePL，不至于此。你懂得权力能给你什么。"

"继续这么干。Kato 氏族那小丫头要什么，我就要她得到什么。"

entries.en:
"I was going to ask you to take weapons and supplies to Umbra to fuel one Imoinu Kato's little revolution - imagine my surprise at the report that you had already done so."

He examines you with an oddly penetrating gaze far from his usual show of nonchalance.

"If I was a more suspicious man, I might have concerns that you shared the anarchic delusions of Antis like the Gens Kato child. But I know you better than that, $titlePL. You appreciate what power provides."

He snaps his fingers at someone off-link.
entries.zh:
"我本打算让你带武器和补给去 Umbra，给 Imoinu Kato 那场小革命添把火——结果报告说，你已经这么干过了。你可以想见我有多意外。"

他打量着你，目光锐利得有些反常，全无平日那副漫不经心。

"我要是疑心再重些，或许会担心你跟 Kato 氏族那小丫头一样，抱着 Antis 那套无政府的妄想。可我了解你，$titlePL，不至于此。你懂得权力能给你什么。"

他朝链路外的某个人打了个响指。

entries.en:
"Yes!"

He laughs.

"Nothing will vex Fortuna more. I want to see the flames from Kazeron!"

He closes his eyes to take in a slow, pleased breath.

"If there's anything left over, keep it. Use it or sell it, I don't care."
entries.zh:
"对！"

他大笑起来。

"没什么比这更让 Fortuna 恼火了。我要从 Kazeron 都能看见那火光！"

他闭上眼，缓缓吸了一口气，满心惬意。

"要是有剩下的，就留着。自己用还是卖掉，我不管。"

o.zh: 我不需要任何人的帮助

entries.en: Despite his distance from true power, despite his self-doubt, at least Horus does not seek to make himself your master.
entries.zh: 尽管他与真正的权力相隔甚远，尽管他心存自我怀疑，至少 Horus 没打算做你的主子。

entries.en: For all her pride, at least Fortuna Kato will make an agreement without demanding you submit as if to a king.
entries.zh: 尽管她骄横自负，至少 Fortuna Kato 愿意谈条件，不会要求你像对君王那样俯首称臣。

entries.en: He, at least, can be counted on to support the Persean League rather than the interests of one Gens over another.
entries.zh: 至少他指望得上——他会支持英仙座联盟，而不是让某一个氏族的利益压过别家。

entries.en: If Reynard Hannan cannot accept your independence, then you'll simply have to take it for yourself and act accordingly.
entries.zh: 既然 Reynard Hannan 容不下你的独立，那你就自己去挣，然后照自己的意思行事。

entries.en:
After a few minutes the secretary reappears.

"I'm sorry," they say, smiling. "But the Prime Demarchon is unavailable. Would you like to leave a message?"
entries.zh:
几分钟后，秘书又出现了。

"很抱歉，\"她微笑着说，\"大统领现在不便接见。你要留言吗？"

entries.en:
Shockingly, the comms open not with some under-secretary, but upon Reynard Hannan himself.

"$TitlePL $playerLastName! You've made quite an impression in the holos, haven't you - a terrorist and child-murderer, I hear."

He chuckles luxuriously, then quite deliberately catches himself, and pauses.

"I know, I know. It's just Dolos playing his game."
entries.zh:
出乎意料，通讯接通的不是哪个副秘书，而是 Reynard Hannan 本人。

"$TitlePL $playerLastName！你在全息新闻里可真是出尽风头——恐怖分子，还杀过孩子，我听说是这样。"

他惬意地低笑几声，随即刻意收住，顿了顿。

"我知道，我知道。不过是 Dolos 在玩他那套把戏。"

entries.en:
A slow smile grows.

"It seems you understand my position. It is refreshing, from time to time, to be relieved of the need to explain myself yet again to some underling."
entries.zh:
一个笑容缓缓绽开。

"看来你明白我的处境。偶尔不必再向哪个下属解释一遍自己，倒也让人神清气爽。"

entries.en:
"No doubt," he says, not quite rolling his eyes. "You need to learn to enjoy yourself from time to time, $titlePL," he says. "I do."

He lets out a breath and looks aside.

"Regardless. I cannot let this insult to my patronage go unanswered."
entries.zh:
"那是自然，\"他说，差点就要翻起白眼。\"$titlePL，你得学会偶尔让自己快活一点，\"他说，\"我就很会。"

他吐出一口气，目光移向别处。

"总之。对我这份庇护的侮辱，我不能不作回应。"

entries.en:
"Oh?" He raises his eyebrows, carnivorous smile in place.

"Perhaps I shouldn't place my hand upon the scale... just to see how you attempt it."

"But as amusing as that might be, I cannot let this insult to my patronage go unanswered."
entries.zh:
"哦？"他挑起眉毛，脸上挂着那副食肉动物般的笑。

"也许我不该伸手去动那架天平...就看看你打算怎么动手。"

"可尽管那会很有趣，对我这份庇护的侮辱，我不能不作回应。"

entries.en:
A slow smile grows. Then he can't hold it in any longer, and he bursts out laughing, canines flashing.

It takes him some time to settle down.

"You came to me- for help?"

He suppresses another burst of laughter. "Due to your own short-sighted decisions, you are no longer a member of the Persean League, captain! You expect... help? From ME?"
entries.zh:
一个笑容缓缓绽开。接着他再也憋不住，放声大笑起来，犬齿闪着光。

他好一会儿才收住笑。

"你来找我——就为了求助？"

他压下又一阵笑。"因为你自己那些短视的决定，你已经不再是英仙座联盟的一员了，舰长！你还指望...帮忙？从我这儿？"

entries.en: "I'll see to Dolos," he says. "But first there is a matter more important to me. Fortuna Kato."
entries.zh: "Dolos 的事我会处置，\"他说，\"但眼下有件对我更重要的事。Fortuna Kato。"

entries.en: "I'll see to Dolos," he says. "But first is a matter more important to me: Fortuna Kato."
entries.zh: "Dolos 的事我会处置，\"他说，\"但眼下有件对我更重要的事：Fortuna Kato。"

entries.en:
He drops whatever expression he was performing for you and turns away.

The link cuts to black.
entries.zh:
他收起了那副专门演给你看的神情，转过身去。

通讯切断，屏幕一片漆黑。

o.en: Macario is slandering your client. You'll allow that?
o.zh: Macario 在诽谤你的门客。这你也能由着他？

o.en: Yes, it's all terribly funny. Especially to me.
o.zh: 是啊，这一切真是好笑极了。尤其对我而言。

o.en: He's only sealing his own fate as far as I'm concerned.
o.zh: 在我看来，他只是在亲手了结自己的命运。

o.en: Macario is slandering your client. You'll allow that?
o.zh: Macario 在诽谤你的门客。这你也能由着他？

o.en: He's crafting a big lie to cover his attempt to seize control of the Diktat!
o.zh: 他编出一套弥天大谎，就为了掩盖他夺取强权控制权的图谋！

o.en: It doesn't matter - he must be destroyed for the good of the Sector.
o.zh: 那不重要——为了星域的大局，他必须被除掉。

o.en: Macario is slandering your client. You'll allow that?
o.zh: Macario 在诽谤你的门客。这你也能由着他？

o.en: Yes, it's very funny being declared a child-murdering terrorist.
o.zh: 是啊，被人宣布成杀害孩童的恐怖分子，真是太好笑了。

o.en: Macario is slandering your client. You'll allow that?
o.zh: Macario 在诽谤你的门客。这你也能由着他？

o.en: Yes, it's all terribly funny. Especially to me.
o.zh: 是啊，这一切真是好笑极了。尤其对我而言。

o.en: He's only sealing his own fate as far as I'm concerned.
o.zh: 在我看来，他只是在亲手了结自己的命运。

entries.en:
"You've resigned yourself to irrelevance," Reynard says with icy contempt. "I have nothing more to say to you."

The comms cut.

Reynard has made his position clear. If you want help, you'll have to go elsewhere.
entries.zh:
"你已经认了命，甘做一个无足轻重的人，\"Reynard 语带冰冷的轻蔑，\"我跟你没什么好说的了。"

通讯中断。

Reynard 的立场已经很清楚了。想要帮忙，你得另寻他人。

entries.en:
"As for Macario's propaganda... yes, in fact, I have just the thing. Speak to Finlay Siyavong; he's an agent with Fleet Intelligence. A bit unimaginative," Reynard flashes a look of minor embarassment on Siyavong's behalf, "but competent nonetheless."

"He has much potential if he can get over... well, you'll see. My secretary will arrange his comms-id for you, I'm sure."

Reynard looks away, something off-link catching his eye.
entries.zh:
"至于 Macario 的那套宣传...没错，我这儿正好有个办法。去找 Finlay Siyavong，他是舰队情报部的特工。人有点缺乏想象力，\"Reynard 脸上掠过一丝替 Siyavong 感到的尴尬，\"但办事还是靠得住的。"

"只要他能克服...算了，你见了就知道。他很有潜力。我的秘书会把他的通讯编号给你，我想没问题。"

Reynard 移开目光，链路外有什么东西吸引了他。

o.en: I've spoken with Agent Siyavong before.
o.zh: 我之前和 Siyavong 特工谈过。

entries.en:
"Wonderful," he says in a way that ensures you are not mistaken about the fact that he does not care.

"Fleet Intelligence will probably ask you to pledge yourself to support Achilles Andrada," he waves a hand, growing bored.

"Do it, or don't, I care not."
entries.zh:
"太好了，"他说道，那语气确保你不会误会——他其实一点也不在乎。

"舰队情报部大概会让你表态支持 Achilles Andrada，"他摆了摆手，已经开始觉得无聊。

"做不做，随你，我不在乎。"

o.en: Don't you want to undermine Achilles, and therefore Kato?
o.zh: 你不想搞垮 Achilles，从而搞垮 Kato 吗？

entries.en:
"Ultimately." He looks over his desk at you. "But I find it amusing to allow Fortuna to believe the millions of credits she's committed to this scheme, and continues to commit, will pay off."

He barks a laugh to himself.

"Let us speak of it again after the war is announced. Now I have much to do. Probably. Good day then, $titlePL."

The comms cut seemingly of their own accord, to a holding pattern, the crest of Gens Hannan.
entries.zh:
"终究会。\"他隔着桌子看向你。\"不过我倒觉得有趣：让 Fortuna 相信她投进这个计划的几百万星币——还有她继续投的那些——终会有回报。"

他自顾自地短笑了一声。

"等战争宣布之后，我们再谈这件事。眼下我有很多事要办。大概吧。那就这样，$titlePL，日安。"

通讯仿佛自己断了，转入了等待画面：Hannan 氏族的纹章。

entries.en:
"Ultimately." He looks over his desk at you. "But I find it amusing to allow Fortuna to believe the millions of credits she's committed to this scheme, and continues to commit, will pay off."

He barks a laugh to himself, then pauses.

"Although... yes, I think I would have you speak to Horus Yaribay."
entries.zh:
"终究会。\"他隔着桌子看向你。\"不过我倒觉得有趣：让 Fortuna 相信她投进这个计划的几百万星币——还有她继续投的那些——终会有回报。"

他自顾自地短笑了一声，随即顿住。

"不过...对，我想让你去和 Horus Yaribay 谈谈。"

o.en: What do you want me to say to Horus?
o.zh: 你要我对 Horus 说什么？

entries.en:
"Advise him, as a contact, as a friend, to work against Fortuna Kato," he says, a slow smile growing at the thought.

"He is soft and will respond to sentiment. Then let us speak of all of this again, once the war is announced, as soon it must be. I have much to do now, probably."

"Good day, $titlePL."

The comms cut seemingly of their own accord.
entries.zh:
"以联系人的身份、以朋友的身份劝他，去跟 Fortuna Kato 作对，"他说，想到这儿，笑容缓缓绽开。

"他心软，吃感情这一套。等战争宣布之后——那不会太久了——我们再把这一切谈一遍。眼下我有很多事要办，大概吧。"

"日安，$titlePL。"

通讯仿佛自己断了。

entries.en:
Reynard's secretary appears, for only a moment. "Hold please, I shall forward the link per the Prime Demarchon's request," they say, before disappearing.

The crest of Gens Hannan appears again for a moment. An upthrust, open hand. Golden rays.

You're pondering Reynard's petty revenge against Fortuna via her granddaughter Imoinu when your quartermaster pings you about an inquiry from a warehouse manager on $entity.name.

Before you can respond, the comms flash an incoming link.
entries.zh:
Reynard 的秘书只露了一瞬。"请稍候，我这就按大统领的吩咐把链路转过去，"说完便消失了。

Hannan 氏族的纹章又出现了一瞬：一只向上张开的手，金色的光芒。

你正琢磨着 Reynard 如何借 Fortuna 的孙女 Imoinu 来实施他那点小报复，军需官忽然发来提示：$entity.name 上有一位仓库管理员提出查询。

你还没来得及回应，通讯界面上闪起一条接入请求。

entries.en:
"We wish to ensure your ability to operate your $shipOrFleet through the critical events we anticipate will occur soon, quite soon. In the interests of the League, of course."

You hear a soft ping from your TriPad - a notification from your quartermaster expressing surprise at an inquiry from the logistics manager of a spaceport-adjacent warehouse concerning a bay leased under your name.

Siyavong smiles.
entries.zh:
"我们希望确保你有能力带着你的$shipOrFleet，熬过我们预计不久后——很快了——将要发生的关键事件。当然，是为了联盟的利益。"

你的 TriPad 轻轻响了一声——是军需官发来的通知，说港区附近一座仓库的后勤经理来问起一个登记在你名下的泊位，他对此颇为诧异。

Siyavong 笑了。

entries.en:
The comms connect.

"You." Arroyo doesn't look happy.

"Your first impulse after that disastrous propaganda cast - yes, I saw it - was to come here?"

He makes an exasperated sound. "Unbelievable."
entries.zh:
通讯接通了。

"你。" Arroyo 脸色不好看。

"那场灾难性的宣传直播之后——对，我看了——你的第一反应是跑到这儿来？"

他恼火地出了口气。"真是难以置信。"

o.en: Help me Arroyo. You're my only hope.
o.zh: 帮帮我，Arroyo。你是我唯一的希望了。

o.en: I need your help. You could profit from this.
o.zh: 我需要你的帮助。这事你能赚一笔。

o.en: I suppose I can just figure this out on my own.
o.zh: 那我还是自己想办法吧。

entries.en:
"I told you I didn't want to get involved," he says. "Remember when you came to me waving around some top-level secret files you stole from the... who was it - oh, right, the leader of the Sindrian Diktat's secret police with a reputation for torture and assassination? Remember that?"

He looks away, shaking his head.

"I make it a policy never to get involved with someone named after an animal. Never ends well."
entries.zh:
"我跟你说过，我不想掺和进来，\"他说，\"还记得你拿着几份绝密文件跑到我这儿来晃吗？你从那个...叫什么来着——哦对，辛达强权秘密警察的头子、那个以酷刑和暗杀出名的家伙——那儿偷来的。还记得吗？"

他别过脸去，摇了摇头。

"我的原则是，绝不跟名字取自动物的人打交道。从来没好下场。"

o.en: I need your help. You could profit from this.
o.zh: 我需要你的帮助。这事你能赚一笔。

o.en: Help me Arroyo. You're my only hope.
o.zh: 帮帮我，Arroyo。你是我唯一的希望了。

o.en: I suppose I can just figure this out on my own.
o.zh: 那我还是自己想办法吧。

entries.en:
He sighs deeply.

"Unlikely," he says, putting his elbows on his desk and his head in his hands. "But tell me why you think I should have anything to do with... you."
entries.zh:
他长叹一声。

"不太可能，\"他说着，双肘撑在桌上，两手抱住了头，\"不过你倒是说说，我凭什么要跟...你——扯上关系。"

entries.en:
"I guess not," he says. "You're unbelievable."

He turns away, one hand reaching for what you assume is the comms cut-off.

"By the way, a 'fellow' Company executive got it in their head that you were interfering with their profits. Watch your back, because I'm not going to do it anymore."

He turns to look over his shoulder. "This? It's over. Have a nice life."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"看来不会，\"他说。\"你真是不可理喻。"

他转过身去，一只手伸向你猜是通讯切断键的地方。

"顺便说一句，公司里有位'同事'认定你在妨碍他们的利润。自己盯着背后吧，这事我不会再替你看着了。"

他回头看了一眼。"这事？到此为止。祝你过得愉快。"

通讯中断。

entries.en:
Arroyo has made his position clear.

You'll just have to watch your back and react as other parties make their moves - or contact stronger, more willing allies.

Whether by some murderous Tri-Tachyon executive or some pretender Supreme Executor, you will be stopped by no one.
entries.zh:
Arroyo 已经把立场说得很清楚了。

你只能自己盯着背后，等别人先出手再作应对——或者去联系更强、更愿意出手的盟友。

不管是某个杀心已起的速子科技高管，还是某个僭称最高元首的人，谁都拦不住你。

entries.en:
"Unbelievable," he says again, disgusted.

He sighs, deeply, then puts his elbows on his desk and his head in his hands.

"But fine. Fine. Tell me why you think I should have anything to do with... you."
entries.zh:
"真是难以置信，"他又说了一遍，一脸嫌恶。

他长叹一声，然后把双肘撑在桌上，两手抱住了头。

"不过算了。算了。你倒是说说，我凭什么要跟...你——扯上关系。"

entries.en:
"No," he says, and sighs. "You can't."

"Look at what a mess you've already made of yourself! I mean- just-"

With a consternated expression, he moves his hands, but seems unable to express how to describe the depth of your blundering.

Then he sighs, deeply, then puts his elbows on his desk and his head in his hands. "Fine. Tell me why you think I should have anything to do with... you."
entries.zh:
"不行，\"他说，叹了口气，\"你办不到。"

"看看你把自己搞成了什么烂摊子！我是说——你就——"

他一脸苦恼地比划着双手，却似乎找不到话来形容你闯的祸有多深。

然后他长叹一声，把双肘撑在桌上，两手抱住了头。"算了。你倒是说说，我凭什么要跟...你——扯上关系。"

entries.en:
Arroyo raises his head and straightens his suit, looking at you directly once more. His expression is skeptical, bordering on dismissive.

"Is that it? Fine. That's not... not quite so unrealistic as I expected."
entries.zh:
Arroyo 抬起头，理了理西装，再次直视你。他的神情带着怀疑，近乎不屑。

"就这些？行。这倒...没有我想的那么不切实际。"

entries.en:
"Exactly!"

He's starting to look a bit more cheerful.

"We're going to fix your reputation. Some of it, anyway."
entries.zh:
"正是！"

他的脸色开始好看起来。

"我们要把你的名声修好。至少修好一部分。"

entries.en:
"Let's keep focused on the problem we're trying to solve here, captain." He points, "Your reputation."

He's starting to look a bit more cheerful.
entries.zh:
"我们还是集中在这个要解决的问题上，舰长。\"他指了指。\"你的名声。"

他的脸色开始好看起来。

entries.en:
Arroyo gapes for a moment, then says - perhaps not quite shouts - "No! Stop that, stop trying to tell me - anyone - about his transparent ideology!"

"Stars above," he says, palm to his face. "You sound like a malfunctioning sub-gamma assistant."
entries.zh:
Arroyo 张着嘴愣了片刻，然后说——也许算不上吼——"不！住口，别再跟我——跟任何人——讲他那套一眼就能看穿的意识形态了！"

"群星在上，\"他一手捂住脸。\"你听起来像台出了故障的次伽马级辅助程序。"

o.en: If you can't respect the transcendent ideology of Philip Andrada, then we have nothing to talk about.
o.zh: 如果你不尊重 Philip Andrada 那套超凡的意识形态，那我们就没什么好谈的。
我道歉。你刚才说到哪了？

entries.en:
"Focus on the problem we're trying to solve here." He points. "Your reputation!"

He's starting to look a bit more cheerful.
entries.zh:
"先集中在我们眼下要解决的问题上。\"他指了指。\"你的名声！"

他的脸色开始好看起来。

entries.en:
Arroyo sighs. Then, slowly, he raises his head.

He adjusts his suit, though it is tailored to effortless perfection, then looks at you directly, expression well past skeptical and nearly within the realm of dismissive.

"Is that what will make you happy? Fine. Hypothetically, then, let's talk about how you - yourself - get out of this."

"First, forget about 'destroying' Macario."
entries.zh:
Arroyo 叹了口气。然后缓缓抬起头。

他理了理西装——那身衣服本就剪裁得无可挑剔——然后直视着你，神情早已越过怀疑，几乎到了不屑一顾的地步。

"那样你就满意了？行。那我们就假设一下，谈谈你——你自己——怎么从这局里脱身。"

"第一，别想什么'除掉'Macario。"

entries.en:
Arroyo raises his head, looking at you directly. His expression is grotesque.

"Prove yourself."

He takes a deep breath, bordering on a sigh.

"To Dolos Macario."

He raises both hands - is that a tremor - to his temples and rubs them, as if to ritualistically fend off an expected headache.
entries.zh:
Arroyo 抬起头，直视着你。他的神情古怪得有些扭曲。

"证明你自己。"

他深吸一口气，几乎要变成一声叹息。

"向 Dolos Macario 证明。"

他抬起双手——那是在发抖吗——按上太阳穴揉了起来，像是在做某种仪式，好挡开一场预料之中的头痛。

entries.en:
"You understand that he just flushed your reputation into the recycling tank? And, besides, HE has a reputation for torture, kidnapping, assassination, and so on and on and on?"

He puts his hands together carefully, as if restraining himself.

"You don't think he's made his intentions for you clear? You want to... prove yourself."
entries.zh:
"你明白他刚把你的名声冲进回收槽里了吧？而且，他自己可是以酷刑、绑架、暗杀等等等等出名的？"

他小心地把双手合在一起，像是在克制自己。

"你难道不觉得他对你的意图已经够清楚了？你还想...向他证明自己。"

o.en: Yes. That's what I just said.
o.zh: 对。我刚才就是这么说的。

o.en: Perhaps you don't understand the full context here.
o.zh: 也许你根本没弄明白这里面的来龙去脉。

o.en: I don't feel like you have an appreciation for Transcendent Andradan Ideology.
o.zh: 我看你并不真正懂得 Andrada 超凡意识形态的分量。

o.en: He has power. I have power, and I want more. Isn't this obvious?
o.zh: 他手里有权。我手里也有权，而且我想要更多。这还不够明显吗？

entries.en: He just stares at you.
entries.zh: 他只是盯着你。

entries.en: "Yes!" He slams his hands down. "I do!"
entries.zh: "没错！"他双手往下一拍。"我懂！"

entries.en: "The," he speaks haltingly, bewildered, "transcendent... what? No! No one cares about any of that. Least of all me!"
entries.zh: "那、那个，\"他结结巴巴，一脸茫然，\"超凡...什么？不！没人关心那些东西。至少我不关心！"

entries.en: "I... guess," he says, his expression at trying to wrap his mind around your statements somehow grotesque.
entries.zh: "我...大概吧，"他说，那副拼命想弄懂你那番话的表情，不知怎的有些狰狞。

entries.en:
He lets the air out of his lungs, a sound of existential pain. After a moment, he seems to recover.

"No! Forget all of that. Clear your head. You want to live to enjoy riches and power? Smarten up!"
entries.zh:
他把肺里的气全吐了出来，那声音像是一种存在层面的痛苦。过了片刻，他像是缓过来了。

"不！那些全忘了。脑子放清楚。你想活着享受财富和权力？那就给我聪明点！"

o.en: I can handle my own reputation, thanks.
o.zh: 我自己的名声我自己能处理，多谢。

o.en: Is this going to be expensive?
I can handle my own reputation, thanks.
o.zh: 我自己的名声我自己能处理，多谢。

o.en: Is this going to be expensive?
I don't care about that. I want to take down Macario.
o.zh: 我不在乎那些。我要扳倒 Macario。

o.en: I don't care about that. I want to destroy the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 我不在乎那些。我要摧毁辛达强权。

entries.en: "No, you can't," he says. "That's why you're here."
entries.zh: "不，你处理不了，\"他说。\"这正是你来找我的原因。"

entries.en: "Not in the long run," he says.
entries.zh: "从长远看，你承受不起，"他说。

entries.en:
"With half the Sector's meat-head bounty hunters trying to kill the number one terrorist on Macario's list and the other half merely suspecting you're a baby-killer?"

"You need to get your act together. Fix your reputation, gather allies, then you can even begin to consider hitting back. I've got a contact in a PR firm that can clean things up for 50,000 credits."
entries.zh:
"半个星域的莽夫赏金猎人都在追杀 Macario 名单上的头号恐怖分子，另一半不过是在怀疑你是个杀婴犯？"

"你得先把自己收拾整齐。修好名声，拉拢盟友，然后才谈得上考虑反击。我认识一家公关公司，花 50,000 星币就能把事摆平。"

o.en: I'd like to, but I can't afford it.

entries.en:
"Good," he says, though clearly isn't allowing himself to sound pleased. "The first rational decision you've made since..."

He considers.

Then waves a hand. "Whenever. Anyway, they'll get it done. You'll see."
entries.zh:
"很好，\"他说，语气却明显不肯露出半分满意。\"这是你自...以来做出的第一个理性决定。"

他想了想。

然后摆了摆手。"随便什么时候吧。总之他们会办妥的。你等着看就是。"

entries.en: "You can't afford..." Arroyo rubs his eyes. "Okay. Too bad, I guess."
entries.zh: "你付不起...\"Arroyo 揉了揉眼睛。\"行吧。那挺可惜。"

entries.en: "You sure? That'd be letting Dolos Macario tell the story."
entries.zh: "你确定？那等于让 Dolos Macario 来讲这个故事。"

o.en: I'd like to, but I can't afford it.

entries.en: He shrugs.
entries.zh: 他耸了耸肩。

entries.en: "Now all you need to do," he leans back, hands behind his head. "Is lay low. Stay out of trouble. Let things calm down, let your investments mature. Collect the interest, re-invest."
entries.zh: "现在你只需要做一件事，\"他往后一靠，双手枕在脑后。\"低调。别惹麻烦。让事情冷下来，等你的投资慢慢成熟。收利息，再投出去。"

o.en: The situation in the Sindrian Diktat must be addressed.
o.zh: 辛达强权的局面必须处理。

o.en: I'm not sure that's a realistic outcome, Rayan.
o.zh: 我不认为那能成为现实，Rayan。

o.en: Sit it out? Not my style, Rayan.
o.zh: 袖手旁观？那不是我的作风，Rayan。

entries.en: Arroyo sighs, and closes his eyes. "Somehow I thought you'd say that."
entries.zh: Arroyo 叹了口气，闭上眼睛。"不知怎么，我就猜到你会这么说。"

entries.en: "Don't call me Rayan," he snaps.
entries.zh: "别叫我 Rayan，"他厉声道。

entries.en: "Don't call me Rayan," he snaps.
entries.zh: "别叫我 Rayan，"他厉声道。

entries.en: He sits up, giving you a suspicious look.
entries.zh: 他坐直身子，狐疑地看着你。

o.en: I was kidding. I still need to deal with the situation in Askonia.
o.zh: 我开玩笑的。Askonia 的局面我还是得处理。

o.en: I'm serious. I'm going to try to lay low.
o.zh: 我是认真的。我会尽量低调。

entries.en: He sits up, giving you a suspicious look.
entries.zh: 他坐直身子，狐疑地看着你。

o.en: I was kidding. I still need to deal with the situation in Askonia.
o.zh: 我开玩笑的。Askonia 的局面我还是得处理。

o.en: I'm serious. I'm going to try to lay low.
o.zh: 我是认真的。我会尽量低调。

entries.en:
"Good." He nods. "Smart."

"I also should tell you. I've heard... grumbling. About you meddling in Askonia." His hand comes up. "I don't care if you meant to or not, it's immaterial. Point is, a couple fellow Company executives got the idea that their profits would be better off if your operations were closed."

"Permanently."
entries.zh:
"很好。\"他点了点头。\"聪明。"

"还有件事我该告诉你。我听到了一些...怨言。说你在 Askonia 多管闲事。\"他抬起一只手。\"我不在乎你是不是有意的，那不重要。重点是，公司里有几位高管认定，你的产业要是被关掉，他们的利润会更好看。"

"永久关掉。"

entries.en:
"Yeah."

He leans back. "So be careful."
entries.zh:
"是啊。"

他往后一靠。"所以小心点。"

o.en: Who is it? How? I'd like some information.
o.zh: 是谁？怎么动手？我想知道些细节。

entries.en:
Arroyo's expression doesn't change.

"That's all I've got. Like I said, rumors. And I'm not about to go digging around in the dirt of these trigger-happy ladder-climbers. It's called 'self preservation' and you should consider learning about it. Don't get killed. I'd be..."

He trails off, considering his words. None seem to come to him.

"Got work to do," he says quickly. "Arroyo out."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
Arroyo 的表情没有变化。

"我知道的就这些。我说了，都是传言。我才不会去翻那些一点就炸、只顾往上爬的家伙的脏事。这叫'自保'，你该学着点。别被人弄死了。不然我会..."

他话说到一半停住了，斟酌着用词。似乎一个词也没斟酌出来。

"我还有活要干，\"他飞快地说。\"Arroyo 完毕。"

通讯中断。

entries.en:
You'll just have to watch your back and react as other parties make their moves.

Whether a murderous Tri-Tachyon executive or would-be Supreme Executor.
entries.zh:
你只能自己盯着背后，等别人先出手再作应对。

不管出手的是个杀心已起的速子科技高管，还是个想做最高元首的人。

o.en: I must destroy Macario so Hector Andrada can reign as Supreme Executor.
o.zh: 我必须除掉 Macario，好让 Hector Andrada 以最高元首的身份执政。

o.en: I want to take down Dolos Macario.
I want to take down Dolos Macario - and the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 我要扳倒 Dolos Macario——还有辛达强权。

o.en: I just want to make this whole situation go away.
o.zh: 我只想让这一团乱麻赶紧过去。

o.en: I need to prove myself to Dolos Macario. Show that he made a mistake.
o.zh: 我得向 Dolos Macario 证明我自己。让他知道他错了。

entries.en: "What you have, captain," he slaps one hand in the other. "Is a PR problem. A big one. But we've got tools for that. Does anyone still talk about Daedaleon? Nope!"
entries.zh: "你现在的处境，舰长，\"他一掌拍在另一只手上，\"是个公关问题。而且是个大问题。不过我们有工具对付这个。现在还有谁提 Daedaleon 吗？没有！"

entries.en:
Arroyo raises his head and straightens his suit, looking at you directly once more. His expression is skeptical, bordering on dismissive.

"Is that it? Fine. Hypothetically, then, let's talk about how you get out of this. First, forget about 'taking down' Macario."
entries.zh:
Arroyo 抬起头，理了理西装，再次直视你。他的神情带着怀疑，近乎不屑。

"就这些？行。那我们就假设一下，谈谈你怎么从这局里脱身。第一，别想什么'扳倒'Macario。"

entries.en:
Arroyo raises his head and straightens his suit, looking at you directly once more. His expression is skeptical, bordering on dismissive.

"Is that it? Fine. Hypothetically, let's talk about how you get out of this. First, forget about all of that."
entries.zh:
Arroyo 抬起头，理了理西装，再次直视你。他的神情带着怀疑，近乎不屑。

"就这些？行。那我们就假设一下，谈谈你怎么从这局里脱身。第一，这些念头全都放下。"

o.en: I fail to see what this has to do with Transcendent Andradan Ideology.
o.zh: 我看不出这跟 Andrada 超凡意识形态有什么关系。

o.en: What does this have to do with showing Macario his error?
o.zh: 这跟让 Macario 认清自己的错误有什么关系？

o.en: You mean that moon Tri-Tachyon turned into an exotic radiation-spewing death-trap?
o.zh: 你是说那颗卫星——速子科技把它改造成了一座喷射奇异辐射的死亡陷阱？

entries.en: You explain to Fortuna how you convinced Faro Inesis to back Achilles, leaving out the inconvenient detail that Inesis' intent is to help Achilles free himself from the influence of Gens Kato by doing so.
entries.zh: 你向 Fortuna 说明你是如何说服 Faro Inesis 支持 Achilles 的，却略过了一个不便提及的细节：Inesis 的用意，正是借此帮 Achilles 摆脱 Kato 氏族的影响。

entries.en:
You explain to Fortuna how you convinced Faro Inesis to undermine Dolos Macario - in effect, helping Achilles - by appealing to both his desire to secure long-term profits as well as an up-front bribe.

Or 'investment', depending on one's perspective.
entries.zh:
你向 Fortuna 说明你是如何说服 Faro Inesis 去拆 Dolos Macario 的台——实际上也就是帮 Achilles——既迎合了他想确保长期利润的心思，也递上了一笔预付的好处。

或者按各人的立场，叫'投资'。

entries.en: You explain to Fortuna how you convinced Rayan Arroyo to support Achilles by convincing him of the opportunity to secure profitable contracts after current industrials and suppliers are disrupted by the presumed civil war.
entries.zh: 你向 Fortuna 说明你是如何说服 Rayan Arroyo 支持 Achilles 的：你让他相信，一旦现有的工业与供应商被这场预料中的内战打乱，他就有机会拿到利润丰厚的合同。

entries.en:
"Well done, $titlePL," she says. "Macario is infamous for his cruelty and cleverness. It is some comfort to hear you've gained cooperation an elite operative to foil his schemes."

"You are due compensation, naturally." She taps her TriPad.
entries.zh:
"干得好，$titlePL，\"她说。\"Macario 以残忍和精明臭名昭著。听说你争取到一名精锐特工的合作去挫败他的图谋，这让人稍感安心。"

"你理应得到报酬，这是当然的。"她点了点 TriPad。

entries.en:
"Well done, $titlePL," she says. "One of my agents will help coordinate the arrangements with my- with Achilles' staff. And, of course, you are due compensation."

She taps her TriPad.
entries.zh:
"干得好，$titlePL，\"她说。\"我的一名手下会协助与我的——与 Achilles 的幕僚协调安排。当然，你理应得到报酬。"

她点了点 TriPad。

entries.en:
She catches herself with a small smile, and pauses, looking over you. Judging again.

"This brings me to a very important... request."
entries.zh:
她收住话头，微微一笑，停顿下来打量你。又在评判了。

"这就引出了我一个非常重要的...请求。"

entries.en: "Oh?" She puts her hands together, and listens.
entries.zh: "哦？"她双手交叠，听你说。

entries.en:
The comms snap into focus.

"Captain $PlayerLastName." He makes a thin smile. "I've seen a holo-cast that's been very unkind to your public image."

"Don't worry," he says, looking magnanimous. "I don't believe a word of it."
entries.zh:
通讯画面一下子清晰起来。

"$PlayerLastName 舰长。\"他挤出一个薄薄的笑。\"我看了一档全息节目，对你的公众形象相当不客气。"

"别担心，\"他说，一副宽宏大量的样子。\"我一个字都不信。"

o.en: Inesis. I want to discuss a problem in Askonia...
o.zh: Inesis。我想谈谈 Askonia 的一个问题...

o.en: Horus asked me to supply the Askonia Charterist rebels of Nortia. By the way.
o.zh: Horus 让我给 Nortia 的 Askonia 宪章派叛军供应武器。顺便说一句。

o.en: Reynard asked me to supply Imoinu Kato, of ARC, with weapons.
o.zh: Reynard 让我给 ARC 的 Imoinu Kato 供应武器。

entries.en:
You can tell Siyavong is suppressing some expression.

"I... wish you success, $titlePL," he says.
entries.zh:
你看得出，Siyavong 正压着某种表情。

"我...祝你成功，$titlePL，"他说。

o.en: So I'll do it if he approves. Is that good enough for you?
o.zh: 那只要他认可，我就去做。这样你满意吗？

entries.en: He raises an eyebrow skeptically, gives a small, affirmative nod, then picks up his datapad once more.
entries.zh: 他怀疑地挑起一边眉毛，微微颔首，然后又拿起数据板。

entries.en:
He raises an eyebrow skeptically, gives a small, affirmative nod. "We can work with that."

Then picks up his datapad once more.
entries.zh:
他怀疑地挑起一边眉毛，微微颔首。"这我们可以接受。"

然后又一次拿起数据板。

entries.en:
His half-smile grows the aspect of a smirk.

"We have mercenaries a-plenty, $titlePL. Your situation is somewhat unique, hence my... request."

"I suppose," he raises his eyes in long-suffering patience, "I ought to reiterate to you that Fleet Intelligence, and indeed the League - despite the boorishness of certain figureheads - understands that every relationship is a two-way exchange. And I view it as my duty to make good on it."

He drops the smirk.

"If my word is not good enough for you, then leave now. You've come to the wrong place."
entries.zh:
他那点半笑里，多出几分得意的意味。

"我们手底下的雇佣兵多得是，$titlePL。你的处境多少有些特殊，所以才有了我...这个请求。"

"我想，\"他抬起眼，摆出一副久经忍耐的神情，\"我该再向你重申一遍：舰队情报部，乃至整个联盟——尽管某些挂名的头面人物粗鄙无礼——都明白每一段关系都是双向的交换。而我认为，兑现这一点是我的职责。"

他收起了那副得意的神情。

"如果我的话还不足以让你信服，那就请现在离开。你找错地方了。"

entries.en:
It's up to you, then.

Or perhaps there is another interested party who would be more flexible, and willing to help...
entries.zh:
那就看你的了。

又或者，另有某位有意向的当事人，会更通融一些，也更愿意帮忙...

o.en: I told Oxana Hyder she should back Achilles.
o.zh: 我跟 Oxana Hyder 说过，她应该支持 Achilles。

entries.en:
"Probably," he says casually, "but I must respect your decision and leave that as an exercise for you to engage."

"Is that all?"
entries.zh:
"大概有，\"他轻描淡写地说，\"但我得尊重你的决定，剩下的事就留给你自己去费心吧。"

"就这些？"

entries.en: "Possibly," he says carefully. "But not within the parameters I have been assigned. They were quite specific, I'm afraid."
entries.zh: "也许有，\"他谨慎地说，\"但不在我被划定的权限范围之内。那些界线相当具体，恕我无能为力。"

entries.en:
"Our? Indeed," he says, pointedly. "I have, in fact, prepared for certain contingencies surrounding your involvement."

That half-smile appears again.

"I suppose it is obvious that you should first go to Achilles Andrada. Yesod, once more. Pledge your support for his cause. Publically."
entries.zh:
"我们？\"他刻意加重了语气，\"确实。事实上，围绕你的参与，我早已备好了几套应变方案。"

那半笑又浮了上来。

"我想，显然你应当先去见 Achilles Andrada。再去一趟 Yesod。公开表态支持他的事业。"

o.en: And when do I get paid?
o.zh: 那我什么时候能拿到报酬？

o.en: Horus Yaribay told me you could only give advice, not orders.
o.zh: Horus Yaribay 对我说过，你只能提建议，不能下命令。

o.en: Horus wants to back the Hegemony. I don't think Achilles is a part of his plan.
o.zh: Horus 想支持霸主。我不认为 Achilles 在他的计划之内。

o.en: Horus Yaribay told me you could only give advice, not orders.
o.zh: Horus Yaribay 对我说过，你只能提建议，不能下命令。

o.en: The Prime Demarchon told me I could back Achilles or not, it is my choice.
o.zh: 大统领对我说过，支不支持 Achilles 由我自己决定。

o.en: Look, Reynard wants to sabotage Fortuna. He's going to undermine Achilles.
o.zh: 听着，Reynard 想搞垮 Fortuna。他会去拆 Achilles 的台。

entries.en:
"I have, in fact, prepared for certain contingencies surrounding your involvement."

That half-smile appears again.

"You should first go to Achilles Andrada. Yesod, once more. Pledge your support for his cause. Publically. Given your feelings on the matter, I trust you will be amenable to my proposal?"
entries.zh:
"事实上，围绕你的参与，我早已备好了几套应变方案。"

那半笑又浮了上来。

"你应当先去见 Achilles Andrada。再去一趟 Yesod。公开表态支持他的事业。考虑到你在这件事上的态度，我相信你会乐意接受我的提议？"

entries.en:
"Good," he says.

"We'll also have to do something about the terrible defamation you've endured." He glances down at his TriPad, and taps something. "We've a department that specializes in this class of problem. I'll handle everything, $titlePL."
entries.zh:
"很好，"他说。

"你遭受的那场恶劣诽谤，我们也得处理一下。"他低头瞥了一眼 TriPad，点了点。"我们有个专管这类问题的部门。一切交给我，$titlePL。"

entries.en: "Good," he says.
entries.zh: "很好，"他说。

entries.en:
"Good," he says.

"We'll do something about the terrible defamation you've endured." He glances down at his TriPad, and taps something. "There is a department that specializes in this class of problem. I'll handle everything, $titlePL."
entries.zh:
"很好，"他说。

"你遭受的那场恶劣诽谤，我们会处理一下。"他低头瞥了一眼 TriPad，点了点。"有个部门专管这类问题。一切交给我，$titlePL。"

entries.en:

He places his own TriPad carefully back down on his desk.

"I look forward to seeing you at the ceremony, $titlePL."

A half-smile appears on his face as he reaches for the comms cut-off.

他伸手去按通讯切断键，脸上浮起那点半笑。

He places his own TriPad carefully back down on his desk.

"I will miss you at the ceremony, $titlePL. But I must leave you to your own designs," he says, looking away. "Good day, $titlePL."

A half-smile appears on his face as he reaches for the comms cut-off.

他把自己那块 TriPad 小心地放回桌上。

他伸手去按通讯切断键，脸上浮起那点半笑。

entries.en:
He lowers his datapad. Impatiently, you'd say.

"I shall not involve myself in any... outside arrangements you've made. That is your business."

The datapad comes back up. "My business is the welfare of the Persean League. To that point, we return to my proposal: Achilles. Will you pledge?"
entries.zh:
他放下数据板，动作里带着你能看出的不耐烦。

"我不会插手你那些...外部安排。那是你自己的事。"

数据板又举了起来。"我的事，是英仙座联盟的利益所在。说到这个，我们还是回到我的提议：Achilles。你愿意表态支持吗？"

entries.en:
Siyavong nods. "The situation is moving quickly, now, and it is necessary that he act... more openly."

He picks up his datapad and glances at it. Then back at you.

"Go to Yesod. Speak to Achilles. We'll arrange something to do about Macario's accusations."

A half-smile appears on his face as he reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
Siyavong 点了点头。"局势眼下变化很快，他必须...更公开地行动。"

他拿起数据板瞥了一眼，然后又看向你。

"去 Yesod，找 Achilles 谈。Macario 那些指控，我们会安排处理。"

一丝浅笑浮上他的脸，他伸手去按通讯切断键。

o.en: What are you going to do?

entries.en:
His smile grows a little, but he does not answer.

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
他的笑意深了一点，却没有回答。

通讯中断了。

entries.en:

"What a... lively sentiment," he says to himself.

"Well," he lifts his TriPad officiously and glances at it. "I'm afraid your proposed course of action does not align with the long-term stability and security of the Persean League."

He glances up at you. "Good day, captain."

他抬眼看向你。"日安，舰长。"

The comms cut.

Siyavong 清了清嗓子。

通讯切断。

Then cuts the comms.

随即切断通讯。

"Unfortunately it would be beyond our remit to dedicate League resources to your... personal problems."

He picks up a datapad and taps at it for a moment. Then looks back at you..

"Unless it became necessary to the pursuit of League interests, of course."

He taps at the datapad for a moment.
entries.zh:
"彻底？\"他歪了歪嘴角，沉吟片刻，然后拿起一块数据板，看了你一眼。\"是的，我想可以安排。前提是你在...现有的更大框架内予以配合。"

He leans forward, just slightly, speaking more quietly. "We do our best not to interfere with the Gens of Kazeron, $titlePL. We have a mission - I have a mission - and I mean to perform it to the best of my abilities."

He clears his throat.

"My request stands. Will you back Achilles?"

o.en: I get it. What do you want from me?

entries.en: "It would, of course, be beyond my remit to dedicate League resources to any... personal cause, whether your own or even a respected gens." He looks up. "Unless it became necessary for the pursuit of League interests."
entries.zh: "当然，把联盟的资源投入任何...私人事业，无论是你自己的，还是一位受尊敬的氏族的，都超出了我的职权范围。\"他抬起头，\"除非这成为推进联盟利益的必要之举。"

o.en: I get it. What do you want from me?

entries.en:
"Seeing as you bear a commission of the Persean League, I shall of course render what assistance I can." His eyes meet yours through the link.

"And I shall ask you to perform a patriotic act. This is not a matter of exchange or an order. Consider it an appeal to... a sense of duty and purpose."
entries.zh:
"既然你持有英仙座联盟的委任状，我当然会尽力协助。"他的目光透过通讯链路与你的相接。

"而我会请你做一件爱国之举。这不是交易，也不是命令。就当是...对你责任感和使命感的一次呼吁。"

o.en: I understand. What do you want me to do?
o.zh: 我明白了。你要我做什么？

entries.en:
"I am aware of Macario's assertions," she says regally. "I assume that is, broadly, why you are now here."

She waits, content to let you begin.
entries.zh:
"Macario 的那些说法我知道，\"她威严地说。\"我想，大致上，这就是你现在来这里的原因。"

她等着，乐意让你先开口。

o.en: I view us as partners. Helping me will help our joint venture.
o.zh: 我把我们看作伙伴。帮我，就是帮我们共同的事业。

o.en: My primary concern is the credits you've offered for my services.
o.zh: 我最关心的是你为我效劳开出的星币。

o.en: My primary concern is ensuring that Achilles defeats Hector.
o.zh: 我最关心的是确保 Achilles 击败 Hector。

o.en: Yes, he's somewhat dampened my mood.
o.zh: 是啊，他多少坏了我的心情。

entries.en:
"I am aware of Macario's assertions," she says regally. "I assume that is, broadly, why you are now here."

She waits only a moment.

"I have received word, however, that you have chosen Reynard Hannan dubious patronage."
entries.zh:
"Macario 的那些说法我知道，\"她威严地说。\"我想，大致上，这就是你现在来这里的原因。"

她只等了一瞬。

"不过，我收到消息说，你选择了 Reynard Hannan 那并不可靠的庇护。"

entries.en:
She produces a smile.

"Your dedication to the cause is noted. And yes, we must pay mind that Macario's slander will hinder your operations. A reply shall be given."
entries.zh:
她露出一个微笑。

"你对事业的忠诚，我记下了。是的，我们必须留意，Macario 的诽谤会妨碍你的行动。我们会给出回击。"

entries.en:
She produces a cold smile.

"Your dedication to the cause is noted. But mind that Macario's slander will hinder your operations so they must be given a reply."
entries.zh:
她露出一个冷淡的微笑。

"你对事业的忠诚，我记下了。但要注意，Macario 的诽谤会妨碍你的行动，所以必须给他一个回击。"

entries.en:
She produces a warm smile.

"Your dedication to the cause is noted. But mind that Macario's slander will hinder your operations so they must be given a reply"
entries.zh:
她露出一个温暖的微笑。

"你对事业的忠诚，我记下了。但要注意，Macario 的诽谤会妨碍你的行动，所以必须给他一个回击"

entries.en:
She produces a smile, almost certainly insincere.

"Your dedication to my cause is noted. And we must pay mind that Macario's slander will hinder your operations. A reply shall be given."
entries.zh:
她露出一个微笑，几乎可以肯定并非真心。

"你对我事业的忠诚，我记下了。而且我们必须留意，Macario 的诽谤会妨碍你的行动。我们会给出回击。"

entries.en:
Fortuna looks over and taps at a TriPad.

"I have professionals who will see to a media campaign. Their efforts will take some time to culminate."
entries.zh:
Fortuna 看了一眼，点了点一台 TriPad。

"我手下有专业的人去操办一场媒体攻势。他们的努力需要些时间才能见效。"

entries.en:
Her eyes flick to yours, through the link.

"-In due course. Meanwhile, I recall your expression of support for my cause and, by extension, that of Achilles."
entries.zh:
隔着通讯链路，她的目光扫向你。

"——到时候自会办妥。同时，我记得你表达过对我事业的支持，推而广之，也就是对 Achilles 的支持。"

entries.en:
"I will see you soon. On Yesod."

Fortuna holds her look on you through the comms for a moment,

"Until then, $titlePL," she says, then reaches for the cut-off.
entries.zh:
"我们很快会再见。在 Yesod。"

Fortuna 隔着通讯注视了你片刻，

"那就到时见，$titlePL，"她说着，伸手去按切断键。

entries.en:
"You'll see soon enough." A pause. "I wish for you to contact Achilles again, on Yesod, and personally pledge your support to him."

"Will you do this?"
entries.zh:
"你很快就会明白。\"顿了顿。\"我要你再联系一次 Yesod 上的 Achilles，亲口郑重承诺支持他。"

"你愿意吗？"

entries.en:
"You can," she says. "You are not a subject, an employee, or a slave. As with Achilles himself, I ask for willing partnership in a shared endeavor."

"If you decline, of course," her voice grows darker, "my goodwill will end. This is a shared endeavor which entails great risk, and great reward will only go to those who choose to share that risk."
entries.zh:
"可以，\"她说。\"你不是臣民，不是雇员，也不是奴隶。就像对 Achilles 本人一样，我请求的是在一项共同事业中的自愿合作。"

"当然，如果你拒绝，\"她的声音沉了下来，\"我的善意也就到此为止。这是一项共担风险的事业，而丰厚的回报只属于那些愿意分担风险的人。"

entries.en:
"Acceptable," she says.

"Next, I wish for you to contact Achilles again, on Yesod, and personally pledge your support to him. Will you do this?"
entries.zh:
"可以接受，"她说。

"接下来，我要你再联系一次 Yesod 上的 Achilles，亲口向他郑重承诺支持。你愿意吗？"

entries.en:
"There is no partnership between us," she says icily. "Consider it all undone. Do accept my apologies for wasting so much of your valuable time."

And as simple as that, the comms are cut.

And you're left alone.
entries.zh:
"我们之间没有什么伙伴关系，\"她冷冷地说。\"就当这一切都没发生过。浪费了你这么多宝贵时间，还请接受我的歉意。"

就这么简单，通讯断了。

只剩下你一个人。

entries.en:
"It will not," she says. "Macario's slander will be reversed. We'll see to that."

"What Achilles needs now is the threat of force. This is not a matter of moral superiority - it is a matter of violent force. If I could convince Warlord Kanta to back Achilles, I would accept her pledge."

"We need you now, $playerName."
entries.zh:
"不会的，\"她说。\"Macario 的诽谤会被推翻。我们会处理。"

"Achilles 现在需要的是武力的威胁。这不是道义上谁更高一筹的问题——这是暴力的问题。如果我能说服军阀 Kanta 支持 Achilles，我会接受她的效忠。"

"我们现在需要你，$playerName。"

entries.en: Fortuna looks perfectly stern and attentive as she awaits your answer.
entries.zh: Fortuna 神情肃然，专注地等着你的回答。

o.en: I will pledge my support to Achilles.
o.zh: 我会向 Achilles 郑重承诺支持他。

o.en: Must I do this openly? Might my... reputation damage his?
o.zh: 我必须公开这么做吗？我的...名声会不会连累他？

entries.en:
She nods a slow acknowledgement.

And in a brief moment, you think you see relief in her expression, though it is quickly replaced by her mask of self-assurance.

"There's one last matter."
entries.zh:
她缓缓点头，算是应允。

有那么一瞬，你仿佛在她脸上看到了释然，但那份神情很快又被她那副自信的面具盖了回去。

"还有最后一件事。"

entries.en:
She nods a slow acknowledgement.

And in a brief moment, you think you see relief in her expression, though it is quickly replaced by her mask of self-assurance.

"There's one last matter."
entries.zh:
她缓缓点头，算是应允。

有那么一瞬，你仿佛在她脸上看到了释然，但那份神情很快又被她那副自信的面具盖了回去。

"还有最后一件事。"

entries.en:
"As you provide your services and loyalty, I shall provide you with credits - and I have arranged for my Gens to transfer your care a local warehouse containing supplies and fuel."

"I assume you can put it all to good use toward our shared cause."
entries.zh:
"你付出服务与忠诚，我就给你星币——而且我已经安排我的氏族把一座存放补给与燃料的当地仓库移交给你照管。"

"我想你能把这一切都用在我们的共同事业上。"

o.en: I think I can do that, yes.

entries.en:
"You are here for credits. It is the agreement we made, after all. So credits I shall provide for your services and loyalty."

"My Gens shall also see that a local warehouse containing supplies and fuel is transferred into your care. I assume you can put it all to good use."
entries.zh:
"你来这里是为了星币。毕竟这是我们说好的。所以我为你的服务与忠诚提供星币。"

"我的氏族也会把一座存放补给与燃料的当地仓库移交给你照管。我想你能把这一切都用得上。"

o.en: I think I can do that, yes.

entries.en:
"Perhaps," she says, tapping her TriPad, "some credits might encourage a notable contact in Tri-Tachyon to fulfill contracts for us rather than Hector?"

"If you secure their cooperation I'll see you are compensated appropriately. As for your contact, they should consider the contracts that shall be awarded by the winning side of a succession crisis."
entries.zh:
"也许，\"她说着，点了点 TriPad，\"一些星币能让速子科技的一位重要联系人替我们履约，而不是替 Hector？"

"如果你能促成他们的合作，我会给你相应的报酬。至于你那位联系人，他该想想，继承危机中获胜的一方会给出怎样的合同。"

entries.en:
"Perhaps," she says, tapping her TriPad, "some credits might encourage a notable contact in Tri-Tachyon to fulfill contracts for us rather than Hector Andrada."

"If you secure their cooperation I'll pay a second instalment. As for him, he should consider the contracts that shall be awarded by the winning side of a succession crisis."
entries.zh:
"也许，\"她说着，点了点 TriPad，\"一些星币能让速子科技的一位重要联系人替我们履约，而不是替 Hector Andrada？"

"如果你能促成他们的合作，我会付第二笔款。至于他，他该想想，继承危机中获胜的一方会给出怎样的合同。"

entries.en:
"This, I think, would be a good time to call in any useful outside allies or contacts. Any mercenary, merchant, smuggler, or pirate who can be bought. An unstoppable force must rally behind Achilles, so that when-"

She catches herself with a small smile, and pauses, looking over you. Judging again.

"This brings me to a very important... request."
entries.zh:
"我想，现在是召集一切有用的外部盟友或联系人的好时机。任何能收买的雇佣兵、商人、走私贩、海盗。必须有一股不可阻挡的力量聚集在 Achilles 身后，这样等到——"

她收住话头，微微一笑，停顿下来打量你。又在评判了。

"这就引出了我一个非常重要的...请求。"

o.en: I can make no promise on another's behalf.
I can make no promise on another's behalf. But the credits will definitely help.
o.zh: 我不能替别人打包票。不过星币肯定能帮上忙。

entries.en:
The comm-link connects to the office of Horus Yaribay.

After a moment, his face appears and upon seeing you immediately grows a look of concern.

"Why, captain," he says, then pauses. "News of... you has caused quite a stir."
entries.zh:
通讯链路接到 Horus Yaribay 的办公室。

片刻之后，他的面孔出现在画面里，一见到你，立刻浮起忧色。

"哎呀，舰长，\"他说到一半顿住了，\"关于...你的消息，可是引起了不小的风波。"

o.en: Perhaps we can help each other.
o.zh: 也许我们可以互相帮个忙。

o.en: I've come to you for help.
I like to think that any publicity is good publicity.
o.zh: 我宁愿相信，什么宣传都是好宣传。

entries.en:
"You've been attacked by a major polity-level propaganda campaign, $titlePL. In light of our relationship, I consider this a form of attack upon myself and my Gens. Whatever the truth, a failure to act in light of the reputational damage would be negligent."

He places his hands together, and puts on a charitable look.
entries.zh:
"你遭到了一场政权级别的大规模宣传攻势，$titlePL。鉴于我们之间的关系，我认为这也算是对我本人和我的氏族的一种攻击。不管真相如何，眼看声誉受损却无所作为，那就是失职。"

他双手交叠，摆出一副宽厚的表情。

entries.en: "Perhaps," he says, with a certain noncommittal tone which suggests that you are far more in need of help than he is.
entries.zh: "也许吧，"他说，那语气不置可否，言下之意是你远比他更需要帮助。

entries.en: "Ah. Of course," he says with a certain noncommittal tone which suggests you are in need of quite a lot of help.
entries.zh: "啊。当然，"他说，那语气不置可否，言下之意是你需要的帮助相当不少。

entries.en: "I'm not sure I am able to fully endorse the sentiment," he says, look of concern only growing. "Nonetheless."
entries.zh: "我可不敢说完全赞同这种说法，\"他说，脸上的忧色愈发浓了，\"话虽如此，还是多谢你坦诚相告。"

entries.en: "I believe," he says, "that the Fleet Intelligence Service could be counted upon to assist the bearer of a Persean League commission. It is their remit, after all."
entries.zh: "我相信，\"他说，\"持有英仙座联盟委任状的人，可以指望舰队情报部出手相助。那毕竟在他们的职责范围之内。"

o.en: You're suggesting I go to Finlay Siyavong?
o.zh: 你是说，让我去找 Finlay Siyavong？

entries.en: "I believe that the Fleet Intelligence Service would be more than willing to assist a demarchon of the Persean League..."
entries.zh: "我相信，舰队情报部会很乐意协助一位英仙座联盟的统领..."

entries.en: "I believe that the Fleet Intelligence Service would be more than willing to assist a captain in good standing and friendly to the Persean League..."
entries.zh: "我相信，舰队情报部会很乐意协助一位声誉良好、对英仙座联盟友善的舰长..."

o.en: You're suggesting I speak with Finlay Siyavong?
o.zh: 你是说，让我去和 Finlay Siyavong 谈？

o.en: I've already spoken with Finlay Siyavong about the matter.
o.zh: 这件事我已经和 Finlay Siyavong 谈过了。

entries.en: "Precisely. And I do recall now that you've had contact with him before now. I-"
entries.zh: "正是。而且我现在想起来了，你之前就和他有过接触。我——"

entries.en: "Ah, yes of course! I recall now that you've had contact with him before now."
entries.zh: "啊，对，当然！我想起来了，你之前就和他有过接触。"

entries.en: "Ah! I see, of courses. Your initiative is commendable, no doubt. I-"
entries.zh: "啊！我明白了，当然。你的主动值得称许，毫无疑问。我——"

entries.en: "Ah! I see, of courses. Your initiative is commendable, no doubt."
entries.zh: "啊！我明白了，当然。你的主动值得称许，毫无疑问。"

entries.en: "Well," he says. "These are becoming interesting times, are they not?"
entries.zh: "嗯，\"他说，\"这日子是越来越有趣了，不是吗？"

o.en: We need to talk about Askonia.

entries.en: You've made it this far by your own ambition and quick-thinking. You'll make it through whatever Dolos Macario and the Sindrian Diktat throw at you next.
entries.zh: 你靠着自己的野心和机敏走到了今天。无论 Dolos Macario 和辛达强权接下来往你身上砸什么，你都能挺过去。

entries.en:
It seems that Horus Yaribay is unwilling to work with you.

You'll have to find someone else who might be willing to help. Or, you think, you might just handle this yourself and take what opportunities arise as the situation unfolds.
entries.zh:
看来 Horus Yaribay 不愿与你合作。

你得另找一个愿意帮忙的人。又或者，你心想，干脆自己处理，等局面展开，抓住随之而来的机会。

o.zh: 我去找 Finlay Siyavong。"  #"I'll go to Fortuna Kato."  #"I'll go to Reynard Hannan."  #"I'll go to Fortuna Kato."  #"I'll go to Reynard Hannan."  #"I'll go to Fortuna Kato."  #"I'll go to Reynard Hannan."  #"I'll go to Fortuna Kato."  #"I'll go to Reynard Hannan."  #"I'll go to Fortuna Kato."  #"I'll go to Reynard Hannan.

o.en: I can figure this out on my own.

entries.en: Siyavong seems to know where his sense of duty lies, at least.
entries.zh: 至少，Siyavong 似乎清楚自己的职责所在。

entries.en:
"I'm in the middle of- what?" A pause. A worried look grows, and he waves someone off.

"$TitlePL. There may be... news of great import. I shall have the feed forwarded so that we may both see it."

He gestures to someone off-link.
entries.zh:
"我这儿正谈到一半——什么？"他顿了顿。忧色一点点浮上来，他挥手示意那人退下。

"$TitlePL。恐怕有...极为重大的消息。我让他们把信号转过来，我们两个一起看。"

他朝通讯链路之外的人打了个手势。

entries.en: He interrupts himself to look over at someone off-link.
entries.zh: 他忽然收住话头，朝通讯链路之外望去——那里有个人。

entries.en:
Horus looks forward in anticipation, then frowns. The audio has cut, but you can see him speaking again to, presumably, his secretary.

He looks directly into the feed, at you, and holds up a finger. "Wait," it says.

The image freezes, then the feed goes blank. Words form.
entries.zh:
Horus 期待地望向前方，随即皱起眉。声音已经切断，但你能看见他又在对某人说话——多半是他的秘书。

他直视画面里的你，竖起一根手指。那口型分明是："等等。"

画面定格，随后链路一片空白。字句浮现出来。

entries.en:
"Considering the provocative nature of these... rumors, I don't think it is a good idea to associate myself or my Gens with you."

"I apologize," he says, sounding legitimately sorry. "I do not trust the word of Dolos Macario, but seeing as how you are an outsider without even a commission of the League... I cannot introduce vulnerability to Gens Yaribay out of mere charity or politeness."

"Good day, captain," he says, reaching for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
"考虑到这些...传闻的挑衅性质，我认为让我本人或我的氏族与你扯上关系，不是什么好主意。"

"我很抱歉，\"他说，听起来是真心感到歉意，\"我不信 Dolos Macario 的一面之词，可你毕竟是个外人，连联盟的委任状都没有...我不能仅仅出于善心或客气，就给 Yaribay 氏族招来隐患。"

"日安，舰长，"他说着，伸手去按通讯切断键。

entries.en:
"Considering the provocative claims, I don't think it is a good idea to associate myself or my Gens with you. I do apologize," he says, not sounding particularly sorry. "I do not trust the word of Dolos Macario, but seeing as how you are an outsider... I cannot introduce vulnerability to Gens Yaribay out of mere charity or politeness."

"Besides," his voice grows darker now, "there's the matter of the diplomatic credentials I gave you, which, in some oversight, still appear to be considered valid..."
entries.zh:
"考虑到这些挑衅性的指控，我认为让我本人或我的氏族与你扯上关系，不是什么好主意。我确实很抱歉，\"他说，语气里却听不出多少歉意，\"我不信 Dolos Macario 的一面之词，可你毕竟是个外人...我不能仅仅出于善心或客气，就给 Yaribay 氏族招来隐患。"

"再说，\"他的声音沉了下来，\"还有我给你的那套外交凭证。由于某处疏忽，它们似乎仍被视为有效..."

entries.en:
"It is possible I was too trusting. Or your security may be negligent," he says, looking increasingly displeased.

"There have been suggestions that the credentials of my Gens given to you have been used in inappropriate circumstances. We shall investigate, of course. And, of course, my staff shall immediately revoke said credentials - and it would be wise for us to end all association one with another."

"Now I bid you a good day, captain," he says, and reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
"也许是我太轻信了。也可能是你的安保太疏忽，"他说，神色越来越不悦。

"有迹象表明，我氏族交给你的凭证被用在了不恰当的场合。我们当然会调查。当然，我的下属也会立即吊销那些凭证——而我们双方最好就此断绝一切往来。"

"那么，日安，舰长，"他说着，伸手去按通讯切断键。

entries.en:
He nods.

"He's making his move. Big moves involve big risks. Replacing Philip Andrada with a clone... that's a very big move."
entries.zh:
他点点头。

"他在动手了。大动作意味着大风险。用一个克隆体替换 Philip Andrada...那可是个极大的动作。"

entries.en:
"Not at all," he says with a grin.

It drops as he speaks his next words.

"Macario's making his move. Big moves involve big risks, and replacing Philip Andrada is... a very big move."
entries.zh:
"一点也不，"他咧嘴一笑。

说到下一句时，笑容消失了。

"Macario 在动手了。大动作意味着大风险，而替换 Philip Andrada 是个...极大的动作。"

entries.en:
"It's been there before, captain," he says.

He drops the smile.

"Macario is making his move. Big moves involve big risks, and replacing Philip Andrada is a very big move."
entries.zh:
"我的脑袋以前也被套进准星过，舰长，"他说。

他收起了笑容。

"Macario 在动手了。大动作意味着大风险，而替换 Philip Andrada 就是个极大的动作。"

entries.en:
"Good." His grin is restrained, but genuine.

"I knew you'd be onboard from the first time we spoke."
entries.zh:
"很好。"他笑得很克制，却是真心的。
