"第一次谈话我就知道你会入伙。"

entries.en:
"First - let's get you running those supplies, fuel, and credits to our Charterist contact on Nortia. His name is Arnaud Iscare. I'll let our people know to set up a meeting."

"They like to use spacer bars. Can find all kinds of scum up to no good," he says with a wink.
entries.zh:
"首先——你把补给、燃料和星币送去给我们在 Nortia 的宪章派联络人。他叫 Arnaud Iscare。我会让人安排一次会面。"

"他们喜欢在船员酒吧碰头。那种地方，什么下三滥的勾当都能碰上，"他说着眨了眨眼。

o.en: What other rebel groups would I, we, be supporting?
o.zh: 我——我们还要支持哪些叛军组织？

entries.en:
Rao laughs.

"Yes, I'll have our quartermaster transfer some supplies and fuel to a storage bay in your name to pass on to rebels. And a little extra for your own operations. Ah, and," he taps a command, "credits of course."

He winks, now in full avuncular spirit.

"If you need more logistics to haul it all, I'm sure we've got some old hulls lined up for civilian resale in the shipyard."
entries.zh:
Rao 笑了。

"当然，我让军需官把一批补给和燃料转到一个挂你名字的仓库隔间，由你交给叛军。另外多备一点，供你自己行动用。啊，还有，\"他点了一下指令，\"星币，当然。"

他眨了眨眼，一副十足的长辈做派。

"要是你需要更多运力来拉这些东西，船坞里肯定有几条旧船壳排着队，等着当民用品转卖。"

entries.en: He checks a datapad. "Right. Looks like you've already given generously to our friends on Nortia. Can't procure quite so much as I'd hoped - didn't fill out the forms beforehand, right? - but we won't leave you wanting."
entries.zh: 他看了一眼数据板。"好。看来你已经对我们 Nortia 的朋友慷慨过了。那我能调拨的就没预想的多——事先没填表，对吧？——不过不会让你空手。"

entries.en: He checks a datapad. "Right. Looks like you've already given a bit to our friends on Nortia. Can't procure quite as much as I'd hoped - didn't fill out the forms beforehand, right? - but we won't leave you wanting."
entries.zh: 他看了一眼数据板。"好。看来你已经给我们 Nortia 的朋友送过一些了。那我能调拨的就没预想的多——事先没填表，对吧？——不过不会让你空手。"

o.en: What's the Hegemony's goal here? What's your endgame?
o.zh: 霸主在这里的目标是什么？你的终局又是什么？

entries.en:
Rao raises some fingers so he can tick them off for you.

"Take out Philip Andrada and everything that looks like him."

One finger down.

"Andrada must be brought low. An 'earned defeat' to prove that he's not some invincible genius, nor are his genes." He pauses with an impatient look. "Now I don't need some clever scheme to prove any of that to myself, but this is what the propaganda department says is going to stick."

"Next, total collapse of the Sindrian Mutiny government." Another finger down. "To be replaced by independent polities 'well-disposed to negotiate with the Hegemony'."

"Yes," he says with a look. "The diplomats are insisting on a soft approach. Even Daud's on-board."
entries.zh:
Rao 抬起几根手指，准备一条一条数给你听。

"除掉 Philip Andrada，还有一切长得像他的东西。"

一根手指按下。

"必须把 Andrada 打下去。一场'实打实的败仗'，证明他不是什么无敌的天才，他的基因也不是。\"他顿了顿，神情不耐。\"我自己不需要什么精妙方案来证明这些，但宣传部门说，只有这个说法才立得住。"

"下一步，辛达叛乱政府彻底垮台。\"又一根手指按下。\"由'对霸主抱有好意、愿意谈判'的独立政权取而代之。"

"对，\"他看了你一眼，\"外交官们坚持要软着来。连 Daud 都点头了。"

entries.en:
"Pretty much," he says, then indicates the remaining fingers.

"But while we're at it: no Persean League expansion." Tick. "No Pather takeovers." Tick.

He closes the fist and frowns. "And no more planet-killers. I don't believe I need to explain why."
entries.zh:
"差不多吧，"他说着，指了指剩下的手指。

"不过既然说到这儿：不许英仙座联盟扩张。"算一条。"不许左径接手。"算一条。

他握紧拳头，皱起眉头。"还有，别再弄什么行星杀手。我想我不需要解释原因。"

o.en: Will you provide me with supplies to run to the rebels?
o.zh: 你会给我补给，让我运去给叛军吗？

entries.en: "Yes," he says. "If you agree to the plan."
entries.zh: "会，\"他说，\"前提是你同意这个计划。"

entries.en: "Our intel says you've met Moyra Standfast already." He makes a quick smile acknowledging his spying. "On Volturn. She's a fighter. Supply her a little, but not too much - we don't want the Church taking over. And she's no Pather, but that's a risk too if the Volturnian Self Defense Covenant got out of hand."
entries.zh: "我们的情报说，你已经见过 Moyra Standfast 了。\"他飞快地笑了一下，算是承认自己在刺探。\"在 Volturn。她是个能打的人。给她一点支援，但别太多——我们不想让教会接手。她不是左径的人，可要是 Volturn 自卫公约失控，那也一样是个风险。"

entries.en:
"The Volturnian Self Defense Covenant on Volturn is a Luddic-aligned insurrection. Moyra Standfast, the local curate sacraria, might deny it, but she's in charge."

"Hard to get to the shrine though. The Mutiny has had it locked down for cycles while they purge Luddics. We've got a comms ID, but not sure how you'll get her to trust you."

He shrugs. "Religion isn't my field. Figure it out."

"If, and I mean if you make contact, don't give her too much. We don't want the Church taking over. She's no Pather, but I don't want to see the VSDC get out of hand."
entries.zh:
"Volturn 上的自卫公约是一支亲卢德的叛乱势力。当地的助理祭司 Moyra Standfast 也许不会承认，但说了算的是她。"

"不过那座圣殿不好接近。叛乱当局已经把它封了好几个星历年，一边还在清洗卢德信徒。我们有个通讯 ID，但不确定你怎么才能让她信任你。"

他耸了耸肩。"宗教不归我管。你自己想办法。"

"要是——我是说要是——你跟她接上了头，别给她太多。我们不想让教会接手。她不是左径的人，但我不想看到自卫公约失控。"

entries.en:
"On Umbra there's a stray kid from Gens Kato, Imoinu Kato. She's more disciplined than the other pirates pretending to be revolutionaries. You could give her a taste of what's required to tear down the Diktat, but no further."

He sweeps a hand in a spacer's cut-off hand-signal.

"She's an ANTI, through and through, fundamentally opposed to the Hegemony. And when, not if, she loses control, it's going to be the pirates in charge of anything left over."
entries.zh:
"Umbra 上有个 Kato 氏族流落在外的孩子，Imoinu Kato。她比那些装成革命者的海盗有纪律得多。你可以让她尝到一点推翻辛达强权需要什么滋味，但到此为止。"

他挥了下手，比出一个船员之间表示"到此为止"的手势。

"她是个彻头彻尾的 ANTI，从根本上反对霸主。而等她失控——不是如果——剩下的一切就都归海盗管了。"

entries.en:
"There's Imoinu Kato. You've contacted her on Umbra. Yes," he smirks, "we have informants. So does half the Sector - the so-called ARC is leaky as half the old hulls orbiting Ragnar."

"Just don't forget that she's a radicalized ANTI. Give her a taste of what's required to tear down the Diktat, but no further. She's anti-Hegemony, and when - not if - she loses control, it's going to be pirates in charge of anything left standing."

"It'd be embarrassing if our own materiel was used against us. So don't let it happen."
entries.zh:
"有 Imoinu Kato。你在 Umbra 上联系过她。没错，\"他咧嘴一笑，\"我们有线人。星域里一半势力都有——那个所谓的 ARC，漏得跟 Ragnar 轨道上那半数旧船壳一样。"

"只是别忘了，她是个激进化了的 ANTI。让她尝到一点推翻辛达强权需要什么滋味，但别过界。她反霸主，而等她——不是如果——失控，剩下的一切都会落到海盗手里。"

"要是我们自己的物资被拿去打我们自己，那就太难看了。所以别让这种事发生。"

entries.en:
"Tri-Tachyon has been supporting the Sindrian Mutiny, but they've always believed loyalty is negotiable. Your friend Rayan Arroyo is no exception, though we don't think he has much taste for black ops."

"But he does own a personal logistics network that could be turned to smuggling."

Rao shrugs.
entries.zh:
"速子科技一直在支持辛达叛乱，但他们向来认为忠诚是可以谈的。你那位朋友 Rayan Arroyo 也不例外，不过我们觉得他对黑色行动没什么兴趣。"

"但他手上确实有一套私人后勤网络，可以拿来走货。"

Rao 耸了耸肩。

entries.en:
"Tri-Tachyon has been supporting the Sindrian Mutiny, but they've always believed loyalty is negotiable. Our friend Provost Baird has a compromised contact in their executive class named Arroyo. But he isn't a fighter."

Rao shrugs. "Has a private logistics network, though. You'd have to get to him through Baird and the Galatia Academy."
entries.zh:
"速子科技一直在支持辛达叛乱，但他们向来认为忠诚是可以谈的。我们的朋友、院长 Baird 在他们高管层里有个被抓住把柄的联系人，叫 Arroyo。不过他不是能打的人。"

Rao 耸了耸肩。"不过他有一套私人后勤网络。你得通过 Baird 和 Galatia 学院才能搭上他。"

entries.en:
"We know you've made contact with Faro Inesis."

Rao's tone grows darker. "Connected to more than a few suspected TT black sites and reports of illegal tech. He's a canny operator with an impressive network, but he'd have to go against the company line to be of use to us."

"Me, I don't think he'll cross Director Glamor-Rotanev. That's going too high up. But you could try an angle... if you have one."
entries.zh:
"我们知道你跟 Faro Inesis 接上了头。"

Rao 的语气沉了下来。"他跟不止一处疑似速子科技的秘密站点有关联，还有关于非法技术的报告。他是个精明的操盘手，网络也很可观，但要为我们所用，他就得违背公司的立场。"

"要我说，我不觉得他会去顶总监 Glamor-Rotanev。那等于往上捅得太高。不过你可以找个切入点...如果你有的话。"

o.zh: 这一套听起来都挺费钱的...

entries.en: "There are other TT operatives with their fingers in highly illegal operations... from the point of view of the Hegemony, anyway. They're good at their work, but I don't think they can be trusted and I don't think they'll help. But if you found an angle..." He shrugs. "We'll work with what we can get."
entries.zh: "速子科技还有别的特工把手伸进了高度非法的买卖...至少从霸主的立场看是这样。他们干得不错，但我不觉得他们可信，也不觉得他们会帮忙。不过你要是找到切入点...\"他耸了耸肩。\"能拿到什么，我们就用什么。"

o.zh: 这一套听起来都挺费钱的...

entries.en: "As many as you can." He leans back. "Andrada's made enemies. But remember the ACA is first priority."
entries.zh: "能拉多少拉多少。\"他向后靠去。\"Andrada 树敌不少。但记住，宪章派联盟才是头等大事。"

entries.en:
The comm-link connects to the office of Admiral Orcus Rao.

"Ah," the old war hero looks you over. "If it isn't $PlayerName, scourge of the Persean Sector, terrorist leader and serial murderer of Andrada-clones."

He seems rather amused at the situation.
entries.zh:
通讯链路接通了 Orcus Rao 上将的办公室。

"啊，\"这位年迈的战争英雄打量着你，\"这不是 $PlayerName 吗——英仙座星域的祸害、恐怖分子头目，还有 Andrada 克隆体连环杀手。"

他似乎觉得这局面相当有趣。

entries.en:
The comm-link connects to the office of Admiral Orcus Rao.

"Ah," the old war hero looks you over. "If it isn't $PlayerName, scourge of the Persean Sector, terrorist leader and serial murderer of Andrada clones."

He seems rather amused at the situation.
entries.zh:
通讯链路接通了 Orcus Rao 上将的办公室。

"啊，\"这位年迈的战争英雄打量着你，\"这不是 $PlayerName 吗——英仙座星域的祸害、恐怖分子头目，还有 Andrada 克隆体连环杀手。"

他似乎觉得这局面相当有趣。

entries.en:
"You're sure about this, captain? I'm not going to take away your commission if you don't go along. But that's not the answer I wanted to hear."

His expression is cool.
entries.zh:
"你确定要这样吗，舰长？你不配合，我也不会撤你的委任。可这不是我想听到的答案。"

他的神情冷了下来。

o.en: You know what, you're right. About all of it. I accept your plan.
o.zh: 你知道吗，你说得对。全都对。我接受你的计划。

entries.en:
He's silent for a moment, a look somewhere between disappointment and an anger he's learned to set aside in the moment.

"Like I said, your commission means you don't have to take my orders - in this situation. The Hegemony Navy won't hold your refusal against you."

"As for me? We've got nothing more to talk about," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
他沉默了片刻，神情介于失望与愤怒之间——那愤怒他已经学会在这一刻压下去。

"我说过了，你的委任状意味着你不必听我的命令——在这种情况下。霸主海军不会因为你的拒绝而记恨你。"

"至于我？我们没什么好谈的了，"他说着，伸手去关通讯。

entries.en:
He's silent for a moment, a look somewhere between disappointment and an anger he's learned to set aside in the moment.

"Like I said, your commission means you don't have to take my orders - in this situation. The Hegemony Navy won't hold your refusal against you."

"As for me? We've got nothing more to talk about," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off. "And forget about Hyder. I'll deal with her myself."
entries.zh:
他沉默了片刻，神情介于失望与愤怒之间——那愤怒他已经学会在这一刻压下去。

"我说过了，你的委任状意味着你不必听我的命令——在这种情况下。霸主海军不会因为你的拒绝而记恨你。"

"至于我？我们没什么好谈的了，\"他说着，伸手去关通讯。\"还有，Hyder 的事你别管了。我自己处理。"

entries.en: "We make our own luck around here," he says, reaching for the comms cut-off.
entries.zh: "这地方，运气是我们自己挣的，"他说着，伸手去关通讯。

entries.en: "We make our own luck around here," he says, reaching for the comms cut-off. "And forget about Hyder. I'll deal with her myself."
entries.zh: "这地方，运气是我们自己挣的，\"他说着，伸手去关通讯。\"还有，Hyder 的事你别管了。我自己处理。"

o.en: You're on your own for this one. I have other plans.
o.zh: 这件事你自己想办法吧。我有别的打算。

entries.en:
You've chosen not to follow Rao's orders - the Hegemony's orders, really.

There may be other contacts out there. But if you don't take the initiative, you will simply have to wait for Hector or Achilles to make their first move and react as you see fit.
entries.zh:
你选择不服从 Rao 的命令——严格说，是霸主的命令。

外面也许还有别的联络人。但如果你不主动出击，就只能等 Hector 或 Achilles 先落子，再相机应对。

entries.en:
"I'm sure it'll be worth the wait," his smile is quick, then gone.

"That's it. You're outside the chain of command so use best judgement."

A pause. "I'll tell you if you screw up, though. So don't screw up. Good hunting."
entries.zh:
"我保证值得等。"他的笑容一闪即逝。

"就这样。你不在指挥链里，自己拿主意。"

他顿了顿。"不过你要是搞砸了，我会告诉你的。所以别搞砸。狩猎顺利。"

entries.en:
You close the link and consider your next move.

Your quartermaster has a particularly eager look you suspect has to do with the cargo bay Rao assigned to you, though they are polite enough not to interrupt your next command.
entries.zh:
你切断通讯，思量下一步。

你的军需官一脸格外热切，你猜这跟 Rao 划给你的那个货舱有关；不过对方很懂规矩，没有打断你接下来的命令。

entries.en: "By the way, we'll see what the folks down in MINCOM can do about your little reputational problem while we're at it."
entries.zh: "顺便说一句，你那个小小的名声问题，我们也看看 MINCOM 那帮人能怎么处理。"

o.en: I, uh, can't wait to see.
o.zh: 我，呃，真是等不及想看了。

o.en: I tried to talk to her. She didn't want to listen. At all.
o.zh: 我试着跟她谈过。她根本不想听。一点都不想。

o.en: I tried to talk to her. She said she doesn't trust me. At all.
o.zh: 我试着跟她谈过。她说她不信我。一点都不信。

entries.en:
Rao stares at you for another second.

"Not what I wanted to hear."
entries.zh:
Rao 又盯着你看了两秒。

"这可不是我想听到的。"

o.en: Ah. I tried to talk to her and she... didn't listen.
o.zh: 啊。我试过跟她谈，可她...没听进去。

entries.en:
Rao raises an eyebrow.

"Not what I wanted to hear."
entries.zh:
Rao 挑起一边眉毛。

"这可不是我想听到的。"

o.en: Yes, I spoke to her about the seven heirs of Andrada.
o.zh: 谈过，我跟她说了 Andrada 那七个继承人的事。

entries.en:
Rao raises an eyebrow.

"And?"
entries.zh:
Rao 挑起一边眉毛。

"然后呢？"

o.en: She was concerned about Macario's manipulations and unsure what to do.
o.zh: 她担心 Macario 在背后操纵，又拿不准该怎么办。

entries.en:
Rao raises an eyebrow.

"And?"
entries.zh:
Rao 挑起一边眉毛。

"然后呢？"

o.en: She wanted me to confirm all seven files before speaking to her again. I haven't, yet.
o.zh: 她要我先核实全部七份档案，再去跟她谈。我还没核完。

entries.en:
"I see." He looks down for a moment, brow furrowed.

"We're interested in where she'll go when the conflict goes hot," he says, looking up.

"So it sounds like you're due for another friendly chat."
entries.zh:
"明白了。"他低头看了片刻，眉头紧锁。

"我们关心的是，冲突烧起来以后她会站哪边。"他抬起头说。

"所以听起来，你该再去跟她友好地聊一次。"

o.en: With the entire Diktat Navy out to shoot me on-sight?
o.zh: 在辛达强权整个海军都盯着要当场击毙我的情况下？

entries.en:
Rao raises an eyebrow.

"And?"
entries.zh:
Rao 挑起一边眉毛。

"然后呢？"

o.en: I told her I'd ask you for some kind of... deal.
o.zh: 我跟她说，我会来问你要某种...条件。

o.en: Uh, what about her? I haven't told her anything. (lie)
o.zh: 呃，她怎么了？我什么都没跟她说过。 (说谎)

entries.en:
Rao raises an eyebrow.

"Then maybe you should have a chat with her."
entries.zh:
Rao 挑起一边眉毛。

"那你也许真该去跟她聊聊。"

o.en: With the entire Diktat Navy out to shoot me on-sight?
o.zh: 在辛达强权整个海军都盯着要当场击毙我的情况下？

o.en: She's in charge of the Diktat navy, right?
o.zh: 辛达强权的海军归她管，对吧？

entries.en:
"Yep," Rao says with a smirk.

"You'll be at the comm relay installing the hack anyway. Use it to contact her."
entries.zh:
"没错。"Rao 咧嘴一笑。

"反正你也要去通讯中继站装那套东西。顺便用它联系她。"

o.en: And what do you want me to say?

entries.en: "Good," he says, then picks up his datapad and gives it a glance.
entries.zh: "很好。"他说着，拿起数据板扫了一眼。

entries.en:
"Well..." He leans back, putting his hands behind his head.

"I'm not in a position to offer anything except enforcement of her sentence for conspiracy to mutiny concurrent with combat operations during a state of emergency, then enacting said mutiny during- etcetera..."

His eyes shift back to the comms-feed. "The Hegemony has a dim view of her acts during the First Askonia Crisis, you see."

"And she's smart enough to know not to accept anything from me anyway. So." He leans forward again. "Have a 'chat'. If she trusts you, maybe we'll get something to work with. If not."

He shrugs.
entries.zh:
"这个嘛..."他向后靠去，双手枕在脑后。

"我没什么能开出的条件，只有执行对她的判决：在紧急状态下的作战行动期间阴谋煽动叛乱，随后又真的发动了那场叛乱——诸如此类..."

他的目光移回通讯画面。"你知道，霸主对她在第一次 Askonia 危机期间的所作所为评价很低。"

"再说她也聪明得很，知道不该接我给的任何东西。所以，\"他又向前倾身，\"去'聊一聊'。要是她信你，也许我们能拿到点有用的东西。要是不信。"

他耸了耸肩。

entries.en:
"From the outside it looks like she's the most competent brass the Sindrian Diktat navy has in the roster, and she has command of their primary system defense fleet on a technicality. Could tip the outcome of a civil war, if you ask me. Dangerous place to be," he says, matter-of-fact. "She's probably also smart enough to realize it."

"We'll see," he concludes.
entries.zh:
"从外面看，她像是辛达强权海军名册上最能干的高级军官，而且凭着一条技术性条款，握着他们主力星系防御舰队的指挥权。照我看，她足以左右一场内战的结局。那是个危险的位置，\"他说得平平淡淡，\"她大概也聪明到能意识到这一点。"

"到时候看吧。"他这样收尾。

entries.en:
"It'd be useful if she wasn't."

Rao lets the statement hang in the air for a second.

"I'm not saying take her out and I'm not saying we're taking options off the table. We're interested in where she'll go when the conflict goes hot. So talk to her."
entries.zh:
"她不管那支舰队的话，对我们倒有用。"

Rao 让这句话在空气里悬了一秒。

"我不是说要把她做掉，也没说排除这个选项。我们关心的是冲突烧起来后她会站哪边。所以，去跟她谈。"

o.en: With the entire Diktat Navy out to shoot me on-sight?
o.zh: 在辛达强权整个海军都盯着要当场击毙我的情况下？

entries.en:
"So you screwed up." He raises a hand. "I don't want an explanation, it doesn't matter now."

"Hyder is probably the most competent, most senior brass in the Sindrian Diktat navy and she has command of their primary system defense fleet on a technicality. Could tip the outcome of a civil war. Dangerous place to be," he says, matter-of-fact. "She's probably also smart enough to realize it."

"We'll see what must be done," he concludes.
entries.zh:
"这么说，你搞砸了。\"他抬起一只手。\"别解释，现在已经没意义了。"

"Hyder 大概是辛达强权海军里最能干、资历最老的高级军官，而且凭着一条技术性条款，握着他们主力星系防御舰队的指挥权。她足以左右一场内战的结局。那是个危险的位置，\"他说得平平淡淡，\"她大概也聪明到能意识到这一点。"

"该做什么，到时候就知道。"他这样收尾。

entries.en:
"Don't worry about it," he says. "Yet."

"That's what Command is for. They'll fill my workstation with projection reports and contingency plans, I'll salute and make the right noises, then we'll do whatever we have to do."

He picks up his datapad and gives it a glance.
entries.zh:
"别操心，\"他说，\"暂时。"

"这就是司令部存在的意义。他们会用推演报告和应急预案把我的工作台堆满，我敬个礼，说几句该说的话，然后该干什么干什么。"

他拿起数据板，扫了一眼。

entries.en:
"Maybe." He sets down the datapad.

"I want to discuss Oxana Hyder. As relates to," he makes a broad motion with his hand. "This."
entries.zh:
"也许有。"他放下数据板。

"我想谈谈 Oxana Hyder。跟，\"他抬手画了个大圈，\"这个，有关。"

entries.en: "No." He smirks. "You've got enough to remember as is."
entries.zh: "没有。\"他笑了笑。\"你眼下要记的东西已经够多了。"

o.en: So what's your plan and how does it involve the destruction of Dolos Macario?
o.zh: 那你的计划是什么？其中又怎么安排除掉 Dolos Macario？

entries.en: This earns you a grim smile.
entries.zh: 这话换来他一个阴沉的笑。

o.en: So what's your plan and how can I help save the Persean Sector from Dolos Macario?
o.zh: 那你的计划是什么？我该怎么帮忙，把英仙座星域从 Dolos Macario 手里救出来？

entries.en: This earns you an approving look.
entries.zh: 这话换来他一个赞许的眼神。

entries.en: He nods, acknowledging your directness.
entries.zh: 他点点头，认可你的直率。

o.en: I talked to Hyder. Said you might make her an offer.
o.zh: 我跟 Hyder 谈过了。她说你也许会给她开个条件。

o.en: I talked to Hyder. Said you might make her an offer.
o.zh: 我跟 Hyder 谈过了。她说你也许会给她开个条件。

entries.en: You can tell from his expression that Rao did not expect this.
entries.zh: 从他的表情你能看出，Rao 没料到这一手。

entries.en: "And you've gone elsewhere to solve your problems, I hear." His tone grows a cold irony. "$TitleHeg."
entries.zh: "我听说，你跑到别处去解决你的问题了。\"他的语气里透出一股冷冷的讥讽。\"$TitleHeg。"

entries.en:
"There are many mercs in space, of course," he says. "Even a few commissioned with the Hegemony. One or two might actually believe in what I'm trying to do here."

He holds his look through the link for a moment then hits the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
"太空里当然有很多雇佣兵，\"他说，\"甚至有几个人拿着霸主的委任状。说不定还有一两个是真心相信我在这里想做的事。"

他隔着链路盯了你片刻，然后按下切断键。

entries.en:
"Now here's the fun part," he taps at his datapad again and an overlay of the Askonia system appears in your shared comms volume.

"See that comms relay? I want you to hack in and upload a software package. Got some pre-set activation signals for sleeper agents and a little extra business the techs have cooked up to give the mutineers trouble."

He looks at you over the datapad. "I don't worry about how it works, just that it does what they tell me it'll do."
entries.zh:
"接下来是有意思的部分，"他又点了点数据板，你们共用的通讯空间里浮出 Askonia 星系的投影。

"看到那个通讯中继站了吗？我要你黑进去，上传一个软件包。里面有几组预设的激活信号，发给潜伏特工，还有技术人员鼓捣出来的一点小玩意，专门给叛军添乱。"

他从数据板上方看向你。"我不操心它怎么起作用，只要它真像他们说的那样管用就行。"

entries.en:
"Now here's the fun part," he taps at his datapad again and an overlay of the Askonia system appears in your shared comms volume.

"See that comms relay? I want you to hack in and upload a software package. Got some pre-set activation signals for sleeper agents and a little extra business the techs have cooked up to give the mutineers trouble."

He looks at you over the datapad. "I don't worry about how it works, just that it does what they tell me it'll do."
entries.zh:
"接下来是有意思的部分，"他又点了点数据板，你们共用的通讯空间里浮出 Askonia 星系的投影。

"看到那个通讯中继站了吗？我要你黑进去，上传一个软件包。里面有几组预设的激活信号，发给潜伏特工，还有技术人员鼓捣出来的一点小玩意，专门给叛军添乱。"

他从数据板上方看向你。"我不操心它怎么起作用，只要它真像他们说的那样管用就行。"

o.en: I'm here about Macario. Specifically, how to take him out.
o.zh: 我来是为了 Macario 的事。具体说，是怎么除掉他。

o.en: Not bad for a bit of space trash, is it.
o.zh: 对一坨太空垃圾来说，干得不赖，是吧。

o.en: Laugh it up, Rao. It isn't your head in the crosshairs.
o.zh: 笑吧，Rao。准星套着的可不是你的脑袋。

entries.en:
"It's simple enough," he begins.

"The Strategic Assembly doesn't want to send in the navy. It'd look bad. No risk of mutiny - things are different now - but because that's how we got this problem in the first place. Appearances."

He snorts dismissively.

"So instead we're arming and supplying rebels, with priority given to the Charterists out of Nortia. They're ostensibly for full independence but the diplomats say the ACA leadership is 'open-minded'. Whatever that means."
entries.zh:
"很简单，"他开口道。

"战略议会不想派海军。那不好看。倒不是怕哗变——如今情况不同了——而是因为当初就是这么搞出这个烂摊子的。面子问题。"

他不屑地哼了一声。

"所以我们改为武装并补给叛军，优先照顾 Nortia 的宪章派。他们名义上是要完全独立，但外交官们说 ACA 的领导层'思想开明'。管他什么意思。"

o.en: What do you need me for, then?

entries.en: "Someone's got to make sure the supplies get through." He smirks. "Looks better if there's a little distance between us, too. You may have a commission, but it's a layer of deniability."
entries.zh: "总得有人确保补给送进去。\"他得意地一笑。\"我们之间有点距离，看起来也更好。你也许有一纸委任状，但那也是一层能让你撇清干系的缓冲。"

entries.en:
"Second... strategic says there's definitely going to be a fight between the Andrada clones, Hector and Achilles. War between their backers, more like."

His hand balls into a fist, perhaps unconsciously.

"We'll talk more about them when it starts to heat up."
entries.zh:
"第二...战略部门说，Andrada 家的克隆体之间，Hector 和 Achilles，必定会有一战。更确切地说，是他们背后靠山之间的战争。"

他的手握成了拳，也许是无意识的。

"等事情热起来，我们再细谈他们。"

entries.en:
"You're not navy, captain. And we're not in the midst of battle. Your commission gives you a great deal of leeway when it comes to how you interact with the chain of command, and I want to acknowledge that to you."

He pauses.

"Now that I've said that, are you in?"
entries.zh:
"你不是海军的人，舰长。而且我们也不在战斗之中。你的委任状让你在如何对待指挥链这件事上有很大的余地，这一点我要跟你说明白。"

他顿了顿。

"话我已经说清楚了，你入伙吗？"

entries.en:
You don't need the League. Maybe there's someone else, someone who understands your potential. Or maybe you don't need anyone at all.

You'll find your opening.
entries.zh:
你不需要联盟。也许还有别人，一个看得懂你潜力的人。又或者，你谁都不需要。

你会找到突破口的。

entries.en: With the help of Arroyo - and it might take a little negotiation or, failing that, bribery - you'll be able to identify an opening.
entries.zh: 有 Arroyo 帮忙——也许还得费一番谈判，谈不拢就只好行贿——你就能找到突破口。

entries.en: With the help of Inesis - and it might take a little negotiation or, failing that, bribery - you'll be able to identify an opening.
entries.zh: 有 Inesis 帮忙——也许还得费一番谈判，谈不拢就只好行贿——你就能找到突破口。

entries.en:
He pauses for a moment, politely, then continues.

"I am aware that certain alarming allegations have been made against you on behalf of a polity of some significance, $titlePL. Fleet Intelligence does not share their outlook."
entries.zh:
他礼貌地停顿片刻，然后继续说。

"我了解到，某个颇有分量的政权对你提出了若干骇人的指控，$titlePL。舰队情报部并不认同他们的看法。"

o.en: About that. I'd like your help.
o.zh: 关于这件事，我想请你帮忙。

o.en: About that... I need your help.
o.zh: 关于这件事...我需要你的帮助。

entries.en:
He pauses for a moment, politely, then continues.

"I have been made aware by the office of the Prime Demarchon that assistance from Fleet Intelligence has been requested to deal with... certain alarming allegations made against you on behalf of a polity of some significance."
entries.zh:
他礼貌地停顿片刻，然后继续说。

"大统领办公室已经知会我，有人请求舰队情报部出面处理...某个颇有分量的政权对你提出的若干骇人指控。"

o.en: Yes, I could use your help.
o.zh: 是的，我用得上你的帮助。

o.en: Look, you don't have to do this because Reynard asked you to.
o.zh: 听着，你不必因为 Reynard 开口就非得做这件事。

entries.en: He raises an eyebrow.
entries.zh: 他挑起一边眉毛。

entries.en: He raises an eyebrow.
entries.zh: 他挑起一边眉毛。

entries.en:
A small smile appears.

"I am glad," he says.
entries.zh:
一丝浅笑浮上来。

"我很高兴，"他说。

o.en: I've come to ask for your help.
I've come to you... to work together.

entries.en: He raises an eyebrow.
entries.zh: 他挑起一边眉毛。

entries.en: "I do, in fact," Siyavong says. "He is the Prime Demarchon."
entries.zh: "事实上，我确实认识，\"Siyavong 说，\"他就是大统领。"

entries.en:
"I must admit - and I'm sure you'll keep this between us - that you have a not insignificant file in the archives of Fleet Intelligence."

His coy, half-smile asserts itself more strongly than before.

"So it is not without consideration that I ask you: what, above all, do you want?"
entries.zh:
"我必须承认——我相信你会守口如瓶——你在舰队情报部的档案里，有一份分量不轻的卷宗。"

他那故作矜持的浅笑比先前更明显了。

"所以我并非没有考量地问你一句：说到底，你最想要什么？"

entries.en:
"And as you are a demarchon of the Persean League, it is my duty and pleasure to provide assistance to your polity and person on behalf of the Persean League."

"Collective defense against hostile acts is, after all, why the League exists." His tone is quite earnest. "How may we assist?"
entries.zh:
"而既然你是英仙座联盟的统领，代表英仙座联盟向你的政权和你本人提供协助，是我的职责，也是我的荣幸。"

"毕竟，联盟存在的意义，就是共同抵御敌对行为。\"他的语气颇为诚恳。\"我们该如何协助？"

entries.en:
An ironic half-smile appears.

"You bear... bore, rather - my apologies - a commission of the Sindrian Diktat. Your request might be seen as untoward. Are you sure you wouldn't rather speak," he waves a hand, then frowns.

"I suppose you are considered something of an outlaw by the authorities of the Diktat at present, aren't you."

He puts his hands together.

"What is the outcome you wish to see out of this, former disciple of the Lion of Sindria?"
entries.zh:
一丝带着讽刺的浅笑浮了上来。

"你持有...应该说，曾经持有——恕我失言——辛达强权的委任状。你的请求可能会被视为不妥。你确定不想去找，"他摆了摆手，随即皱起眉。

"我想，你现在在强权当局眼里，多少算个不法之徒，对吧。"

他双手交叠。

"你希望从这件事里看到什么结果，辛达瑞亚之狮从前的门徒？"

entries.en:
An ironic half-smile appears.

"You bear a commission of the Hegemony, captain. I'm afraid your request is rather... untoward. Are you sure you wouldn't rather speak with, oh," he waves a hand casually, "someone like Admiral Orcus Rao? I believe he's sometimes called 'the Rogue of Raesvelg'?"
entries.zh:
一丝带着讽刺的浅笑浮了上来。

"你持有霸主的委任状，舰长。恐怕你的请求相当...不妥。你确定不想去找，呃，\"他漫不经心地摆了摆手，\"像 Orcus Rao 上将那样的人谈谈？我记得他有时被称作'Raesvelg 的游侠'？"

o.en: You helped me on Yesod. That must have been for a reason.
o.zh: 你在 Yesod 帮过我。那总该有个理由。

o.en: If that's your answer, then perhaps I will.
o.zh: 如果这就是你的答复，那我也许真会去找他。

entries.en:
"Helped you demonstrate some discretion," a certain tone enters his voice, "yes."

He puts his hands together.

"What is the outcome you wish to see out of this, captain-auxiliary of the Hegemony?"
entries.zh:
"帮你展示了一点分寸感，\"他的语气里多了某种意味，\"没错。"

他双手交叠。

"你希望从这件事里看到什么结果，霸主的辅助舰长？"

entries.en:
"Then I bid you a good day, captain. Perhaps you might ask Orcus Rao how many sons of Andrada he's already had killed," he says, tone superficially quite pleasant. "He could, and would. Of that I have no doubt."

Siyavong reaches for the comms cut-off and terminates the connection.

You're left with the mute crest of Fleet Intelligence."
entries.zh:
"那么祝你日安，舰长。也许你可以去问问 Orcus Rao，他已经让人杀掉了几个 Andrada 的儿子，\"他说，语气表面上相当客气，\"他做得出，也愿意做。这一点我毫不怀疑。"

Siyavong 伸手按下通讯切断键，终止了连接。

屏幕上只剩下舰队情报部那枚沉默的徽记。

o.zh: 改去找 Orcus Rao 谈

o.en: Forget Siyavong and the Hegemony, all I need is myself
o.zh: 抛开 Siyavong 和霸主，我只需要我自己

entries.en:
Orcus Rao has the resources of the Hegemony behind him and, besides, you bear a commission.

He is sure to help you if you help him serve the cause of the Hegemony.
entries.zh:
Orcus Rao 背后有霸主的资源，况且你手上有委任状。

只要你帮他效力于霸主的事业，他一定会帮你。

entries.en:
"You bear a commission of the Persean League, of course. It is my duty and pleasure to provide assistance to your person on behalf of Fleet Intelligence."

"Collective defense against hostile acts is, after all, why the League exists. Whether a member polity, a citizen, or an acting commissioned naval adjunct." His tone is quite earnest. "How can we assist?"
entries.zh:
"当然，你持有英仙座联盟的委任状。代表舰队情报部向你本人提供协助，是我的职责，也是我的荣幸。"

"毕竟，联盟存在的意义，就是共同抵御敌对行为。无论对方是成员政权、公民，还是持委任状、代理海军职务的辅助人员。\"他的语气颇为诚恳。\"我们能怎么帮你？"

entries.en:
An ironic half-smile appears.

"You bear a commission of Tri-Tachyon, captain. Your request might be seen as... a touch untoward. Are you sure you wouldn't rather speak with some," he waves a hand casually, "ambitious senior executive interested in funding a 'risky venture'?"
entries.zh:
一丝带着讽刺的浅笑浮了上来。

"你持有速子科技的委任状，舰长。你的请求可能会被视为...有点不妥。你确定不想去找某位，\"他漫不经心地摆了摆手，\"有兴趣资助'高风险项目'的雄心勃勃的高管谈谈？"

o.en: You helped me on Yesod. That must have been for a reason.
o.zh: 你在 Yesod 帮过我。那总该有个理由。

o.en: If that's your answer, I'll go do just that.
o.zh: 如果这就是你的答复，那我就去找他们。

entries.en:
"Helped you demonstrate some discretion," a certain tone enters his voice, "yes."

He puts his hands together.

"What is the outcome you wish to see out of this, contract-captain for the Tri-Tachyon Corporation?"
entries.zh:
"帮你展示了一点分寸感，\"他的语气里多了某种意味，\"没错。"

他双手交叠。

"你希望从这件事里看到什么结果，速子科技公司的合同舰长？"

entries.en:
"Wonderful. Have a good day, $titlePL," he says crisply, then reaches for the comms cut-off.

You're left with the mute crest of Fleet Intelligence.
entries.zh:
"好极了。祝你日安，$titlePL，"他干脆地说，然后伸手去按通讯切断键。

屏幕上只剩下舰队情报部那枚沉默的徽记。

o.zh: 改去找 Faro Inesis 谈
改去找 Rayan Arroyo 谈

o.en: Forget Siyavong and Tri-Tachyon, all I need is myself
o.zh: 抛开 Siyavong 和速子科技，我只需要我自己

entries.en:
"I'm afraid it is against Fleet Intelligence policy to assist, ah, 'suspected' war criminals."

He makes an insincerely apologetic expression.

"I have full confidence in your ability to... assert a unique solution, $titlePL. Good day."

He hits the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
"恐怕协助，呃，'疑似'战犯，是有违舰队情报部政策的。"

他做出一副毫无诚意的歉意表情。

"我完全相信你有能力...自行提出一个独到的解决方案，$titlePL。日安。"

他按下了通讯切断键。

o.en: I don't need his help anyway
o.zh: 反正我也不需要他帮忙

entries.en:
"The ACA? On Nortia."

Siyavong's customary half-smile falters. "I see."

His expression is tight. "We shall... ask for clarification about the situation from Gens Yaribay, naturally."
entries.zh:
"ACA？在 Nortia。"

Siyavong 惯常的浅笑僵了一下。"我明白了。"

他的神情绷紧了。"我们自然会...向 Yaribay 氏族请求澄清目前的情况。"

o.en: Yes, that'd be a good idea. Now where were we...
o.zh: 对，这主意不错。我们刚才说到哪儿了...

o.en: Horus wants to support the Hegemony against the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: Horus 想支持霸主对抗辛达强权。

entries.en:
Siyavong looks up for a second, as if pleading with some higher power.

You swear he mutters something about "Gens" under his breath, but it's hard to say for sure before he returns to you with a professional, pleasant facade firmly in-place.

"Of course," he says. "We... shall ask for clarification. We need not discuss this matter further at this time, thank-you."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 抬眼望了一下，像是在向某个更高的存在祈求。

你发誓听见他低声嘀咕了一句关于"氏族"的话，但还没等你听真切，他已经换上一副职业而和善的面孔，重新面对你。

"当然，\"他说，\"我们会...请求澄清。此时不必再深入讨论此事，谢谢。"

entries.en:
"He... the ARC? On Umbra?"

Siyavong's customary half-smile falters. "I see. This is not... ah, the details of such an operation have not been forwarded to the FIS. Yet."

His expression is tight. "We shall... ask for clarification from the office of the Prime Demarchon."
entries.zh:
"他...ARC？在 Umbra？"

Siyavong 惯常的浅笑僵了一下。"我明白了。这并非...呃，这类行动的细节还没有转呈 FIS。暂时没有。"

他的神情绷紧了。"我们会...向大统领办公室请求澄清。"

o.en: Good. I'll proceed as requested, then.
Look. He's setting up Fortuna Kato to fail.
o.zh: 听着。他是在给 Fortuna Kato 做局，要让她失败。

entries.en:
Siyavong looks up for a second, as if pleading with some higher power.

You swear he mutters something about "Gens" under his breath, but it's hard to say for sure before he returns to you with a professional, pleasant facade firmly in-place.

"I see," he says. "We... shall ask for clarification from the office of the Prime Demarchon. We need not discuss this matter further at this time, thank-you."
entries.zh:
Siyavong 抬眼望了一下，像是在向某个更高的存在祈求。

你发誓听见他低声嘀咕了一句关于"氏族"的话，但还没等你听真切，他已经换上一副职业而和善的面孔，重新面对你。

"我明白了，\"他说，\"我们会...向大统领办公室请求澄清。此时不必再深入讨论此事，谢谢。"

o.en: Horus Yaribay asked me to speak with you.
o.zh: Horus Yaribay 让我来找你谈。

entries.en:
He folds his hands neatly.

"I expect he mentioned the possibility of assistance from Fleet Intelligence regarding certain alarming allegations made against you on behalf of a polity of some significance."
entries.zh:
他把双手整齐地交叠起来。

"我想他提过，某个颇有分量的政权对你提出了若干骇人的指控，而舰队情报部有可能提供协助。"

o.en: Yes, exactly. He said you'd help me.
I've come to ask for your help.
I've come to you... to work together.
Horus Yaribay asked me to speak with you.
o.zh: Horus Yaribay 让我来找你谈。

o.en: We need to talk about Askonia. And Dolos Macario.
o.zh: 我们得谈谈 Askonia。还有 Dolos Macario。

o.en: We need to talk about Askonia. And Achilles.
o.zh: 我们得谈谈 Askonia。还有 Achilles。

o.en: We need to talk about Askonia. And Hector.
o.zh: 我们得谈谈 Askonia。还有 Hector。

entries.en:
His smile grows a little, but he does not answer.

The comms cut, leaving you with the crest of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service.
entries.zh:
他的笑浓了一点，却没有回答。

通讯切断，屏幕上只剩下英仙座联盟舰队情报部的徽记。

entries.en:
"You don't have to like him, $titlePL," Siyavong explains patiently.

"All you need do is recognize that he represents an alternative to a worse outcome," he says.

"Besides, I am not asking you to 'like' him in pretense or truth. Do and say as you will! Just pledge him your support and appear to mean it."
entries.zh:
"你不必喜欢他，$titlePL，"Siyavong 耐心地解释。

"你只需要认清一点：他代表的，是一条可以替代更坏结局的路，"他说。

"再说，我并不是要你假装喜欢他，也不是要你真的喜欢。你想做什么、想说什么，尽管去！只要表态支持他，并且看着像那么回事就行。"

entries.en: "Very well, $titlePL," he says, then reaches for the comms cut-off. "Have a good day."
entries.zh: "好吧，$titlePL，\"他说着，伸手去按通讯切断键，\"祝你日安。"

o.en: What is this ceremony involving Achilles Andrada?
o.zh: 这个牵扯到 Achilles Andrada 的仪式，是怎么回事？

entries.en:
"$TitlePL." Siyavong says with a sigh.

His half-smile seems to have acquired a long-suffering aspect you hadn't quite noticed before.

"I would have Achilles Andrada explain himself."

He rubs his hands together. "I believe that is all?"

It isn't really a question.
entries.zh:
"$TitlePL。"Siyavong 叹了口气说。

他那点半笑似乎多了几分长期隐忍的意味，是你先前不曾留意的。

"我会让 Achilles Andrada 自己来解释。"

他搓了搓手。"我想，就这些了？"

这其实并不是个问句。

entries.en: Siyavong's expression is politely receptive.
entries.zh: Siyavong 的神情礼貌而专注，像是在倾听。

entries.en:
That half-smile appears.

"Go to Achilles Andrada. Yesod, once more. Pledge your support for his cause. Publically."
entries.zh:
那半笑浮了上来。

"去见 Achilles Andrada。再去一趟 Yesod。公开表态支持他的事业。"

entries.en:
"You- that is, Deputy Star Marshal Oxana Hyder?"

He opens his mouth, then closes it to process your words.

"Did she agree?"
entries.zh:
"你——你是说，副星际元帅 Oxana Hyder？"

他张了张嘴，又闭上，像是在消化你的话。

"她答应了？"

o.en: She didn't give an answer. But I think she trusts me.
o.zh: 她没有给出答复。但我觉得她信得过我。

o.en: I think so. I hope so.
o.zh: 我想是这样。我也希望如此。

entries.en:
He blinks, considers for a moment, then nods with apparent satisfaction.

"Good. Yes. Thank you, $titlePL. I shall only hope that she... takes your advice to, ah, heart."
entries.zh:
他眨了眨眼，沉吟片刻，然后带着显而易见的满意点了点头。

"很好。是的。谢谢你，$titlePL。我只希望她...能把你的建议，呃，放在心上。"

o.en: Tap into the relay to open a comms link...
o.zh: 接入中继站，建立通讯链路...

entries.en:
"Now away with you. I have a ceremony to attend; I'm sure you'll be watching."

He turns back to the link for just a moment.

"Have the dignity to die... soonish, will you?"

The comms snap off.
entries.zh:
"现在，滚吧。我还有一场典礼要出席；我猜你一定会看。"

他转向链路，只多停了片刻。

"有点尊严的话，就死得...早一点，行吗？"

通讯骤然中断。

entries.en:
You hear your comms officer's voice.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I apologize for the intrusion, but there's an alert."
entries.zh:
你听见通讯官的声音。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。抱歉打扰，但有条警报。"

entries.en:
"I already have."

His grin stretches painfully.
entries.zh:
"我已经做到了。"

他的笑容痛苦地咧开。

entries.en:
"You've already failed."

His grin stretches painfully.
entries.zh:
"你已经失败了。"

他的笑容痛苦地咧开。

entries.en:
"I've made it a point to forget how many times I've been told precisely that."

His face splits into a painful-looking grin.
entries.zh:
"我特意不去记有多少人对我说过一模一样的话。"

他脸上裂开一个看起来就很痛的笑容。

entries.en:
This earns you a look of surprise.

"Captain, I don't-" he begins, then halts, almost as if embarrassed.

"You'll have to explain what you mean."
entries.zh:
这让他露出意外的神色。

"舰长，我不——"他刚开口便停住，几乎像是有些难堪。

"你得解释一下你的意思。"

o.en: I am committed to the Andradan principles! Despite your wavering, I intend to uphold my pledge!
o.zh: 我坚守 Andrada 的原则！即便你动摇了，我也打算履行我的誓言！

o.en: You're a traitor, Macario, and I'll destroy you - to save the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: Macario，你是叛徒，我会毁了你——为了拯救辛达强权。

entries.en:
"How... how telling."

He wears a strange expression as he examines you anew through the link for a moment. Then he shifts his uniform, assembling a stern, proud look. Perfect for the holos.
entries.zh:
"多么...多么说明问题。"

他带着一种奇怪的表情，透过链路重新打量了你片刻。随后他整了整制服，摆出一副严厉而自豪的样子。正适合上全息。

entries.en:
He nods, now. "I see. I'm sure someone will find your devotion admirable, although..."

Then he shrugs, a mocking apology.
entries.zh:
他这才点了点头。"我明白了。我相信总会有人欣赏你的忠诚，只不过..."

然后他耸了耸肩，那是一种嘲弄式的歉意。

entries.en:
He speaks without awaiting a response.

"There is news of great import regarding the future of the Sindrian Diktat. I'll send a fleet to escort you so that your situation can be... corrected." He blinks. "You may yet prove your loyalty to the blood of Andrada by... serving as an example."

He lifts his cap, black, bearing the gold wings of the Diktat. He doesn't put it on quite yet.

Then the comms snap off, leaving you with only the darkness.
entries.zh:
他没等你回答便开口。

"有关于辛达强权未来的重大消息。我会派一支舰队护送你来，好让你的处境得到...纠正。\"他眨了眨眼，\"你或许还能以...充当反面典型的方式，证明你对 Andrada 血脉的忠诚。"

他抬起帽子——黑色的帽檐上缀着强权的金色翼徽。他还没有戴上。

随后通讯骤然中断，只留你与黑暗相对。

entries.en: Your tech officer gives a casual salute and looks to ops - who nods - then taps something on a datapad.
entries.zh: 你的技术军官随意地敬了个礼，看向行动长官——对方点了点头——随后在数据板上点了点什么。

entries.en:
"This'll take a minute," says Tech. "It's big. Don't know what Rao's cooked up, considering, uh."

With an apologetic look your tech officer shuts up and adopts a stiff at-attention posture as if to make up for the breach of protocol.
entries.zh:
"这要花上一分钟，\"技术官说，\"东西很大。考虑到眼下的情况，真不知道 Rao 都捣鼓了些什么，呃。"

你的技术军官带着歉意看了你一眼，闭上嘴，摆出一副僵硬的立正姿势，仿佛想以此弥补方才的失礼。

entries.en:
"That's it, ah, $playerSirOrMadam," Tech reports. "Confirmation ping returns true. Lots of traffic..."

A quick salute and they retreat to their post in a secondary ops-lab.
entries.zh:
"好了，啊，$playerSirOrMadam，\"技术官报告道，\"确认回执为真。通讯流量很大..."

一个干脆的敬礼之后，他们退回了副行动室的岗位。

entries.en:
"That's it, ah, $playerSirOrMadam," Tech reports. "Confirmation ping returns true. Lots of traffic..."

A quick salute and they retreat to their post in a secondary ops-lab.
entries.zh:
"好了，啊，$playerSirOrMadam，\"技术官报告道，\"确认回执为真。通讯流量很大..."

一个干脆的敬礼之后，他们退回了副行动室的岗位。

o.en: Open a link to Oxana Hyder's fleet
o.zh: 与 Oxana Hyder 的舰队建立通讯链路

o.en: Tap into the comms relay to upload a software package...
o.zh: 接入通讯中继站，上传软件包...

o.en: Tap into the comms relay to upload a software package...
o.zh: 接入通讯中继站，上传软件包...

entries.en:
"Captain."

Chief High Inspector-General Dolos Macario grins at you, a bony rictus.
entries.zh:
"舰长。"

首席总监察长 Dolos Macario 冲你咧嘴一笑，瘦骨嶙峋的脸上挤出狞笑。

entries.en:
"What a pleasant surprise. Oh-" He feigns concern, "were you trying to contact Horacio? I apologize; he's still... preparing himself."

Macario suppresses something- a laugh? - with an odd gulp.
entries.zh:
"真是个愉快的惊喜。哦——\"他装出关切的样子，\"你是想联系 Horacio 吗？我很抱歉；他还在...做准备。"

Macario 像是憋住了什么——一声笑？——古怪地咽了一口。

entries.en:
"I'm sure he'll be along shortly," he manages after a moment, then turns to look at what must be a mirror, attaches another medal to his coat, then adjusts his collar.

"Perfect."

He looks back into the feed, impishly.
entries.zh:
"我相信他很快就会过来，"他过了一会儿才勉强说道，然后转头看向某面镜子——想必是镜子——往外套上又别了一枚勋章，整了整衣领。

"完美。"

他带着促狭的神情转回镜头。

o.en: You're not going to get away with this.
I'm going to stop you, Dolos.
I'm going to kill you, Dolos.
You made a terrible mistake! My loyalty to the Sindrian Diktat is undiminished!
o.zh: 你犯了个大错！我对辛达强权的忠诚分毫未减！

entries.en:
Your tech officer gives a casual salute and looks to ops - who nods - then taps something on a datapad.

They were excited about the operation from the start; one is not often tested by hacking major faction-owned comm relays as the consequences are dire indeed - and that's if one survives the nearly inevitable hostile fleet action carried out at the first sign of someone tampering with 'essential infrastructure'.

"Intialized intrusion/search suite. Connecting, $playerSirOrMadam. Uploading package to remote datacore..."
entries.zh:
你的技术军官随意地敬了个礼，看向行动长官——对方点了点头——随后在数据板上点了点什么。

他们从一开始就对这次行动兴奋不已；毕竟，没多少人有机会去入侵大势力所拥有的通讯中继——后果确实极其严重，而且这还得建立在能挺过那场几乎必然的敌方舰队打击之上：只要有人碰一下【关键基础设施】，对方就会立刻出动。

"入侵与检索套件已初始化。正在连接，$playerSirOrMadam。正在将数据包上传至远程数据核心..."

o.en: Keep me posted. High-level. I don't need every detail.
o.zh: 随时汇报。只讲重点。细节我不需要。

entries.en: "Um. Um," Tech stutters. "$PlayerSirOrMadam?"
entries.zh: "呃。呃，\"技术官结巴道，\"$PlayerSirOrMadam？"

o.en: Yes? I said high-level updates only.
o.zh: 什么事？我说了，只报重点。

entries.en:
"Found a comms-ID," your technology officer says, disappointment cutting through their usual enthusiasm.

"Hector Andrada. Office of, uh. It says Office of Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat."

They turn to look at you.
entries.zh:
"找到一个通讯 ID，"你的技术军官说，失望压过了平日里那股热切。

"Hector Andrada。隶属，呃。上面写着辛达强权最高元首办公室。"

他们转头看向你。

o.en: That'd be him. Comms, put me through.
o.zh: 就是他了。通讯官，接过去。

entries.en:
The connection stutters through a series of hyperwave adjustment cycles, then proceeds to a holding signal- awaiting pickup.

Your comms officer assures you that the signal should appear to be from a lieutenant star marshal ensconced in the star fortress of Sindria. A priority signal, even.

The link shudders, flashes an ornate crest of the Supreme Executor, then returns to a holding pattern.
entries.zh:
连接在一连串超波校准周期中卡顿地推进，随后转入等待接通的保持信号。

你的通讯官向你保证，这通信号看上去会像是来自一位驻守 Sindria 恒星要塞的低阶星际元帅。而且还是优先级信号。

链路一阵震颤，闪过最高元首的华丽徽记，随后又回到保持状态。

entries.en:
"Captain."

Chief High Inspector-General Dolos Macario grins at you, a bony rictus.
entries.zh:
"舰长。"

首席总监察长 Dolos Macario 冲你咧嘴一笑，瘦骨嶙峋的脸上挤出狞笑。

entries.en:
"What a pleasant surprise."

"Oh-" He feigns concern, "were you trying to contact the Supreme Executor? I apologize; he's still... getting prepared."

Macario suppresses something- a laugh? - with a choked sound.
entries.zh:
"真是个愉快的惊喜。"

"哦——\"他装出关切的样子，\"你是想联系最高元首吗？我很抱歉；他还在...做准备。"

Macario 像是憋住了什么——一声笑？——喉咙里发出噎住似的声音。

entries.en:
"I'm sure he'll be along shortly."

He turns to look at what must be a mirror, and attaches another medal to his coat, then adjusts the collar.

"Perfect."

He looks back into the feed, impishly.
entries.zh:
"我相信他很快就会过来。"

他转头看向某面镜子——想必是镜子——往外套上又别了一枚勋章，然后整了整衣领。

"完美。"

他带着促狭的神情转回镜头。

o.en: You're not going to get away with this.
I'm going to stop you, Dolos.
I'm going to kill you, Dolos.
You made a terrible mistake! My loyalty to the Sindrian Diktat is undiminished!
o.zh: 你犯了个大错！我对辛达强权的忠诚分毫未减！

o.en: Are you trying to discard me, Dolos? You wouldn't be so foolish.
o.zh: Dolos，你是想抛弃我？你不会蠢到这个地步。

o.en: I want my commission back, Dolos.
You call this a ruse? The fleets of the Diktat are hunting me!
o.zh: 你管这叫诡计？强权的舰队正在追杀我！

o.en: I am loyal to the Sindrian Ditkat, Dolos. We can still fix this.
o.zh: Dolos，我忠于辛达强权。这件事还来得及补救。

o.en: I am loyal to Andrada, Dolos. Not you. You've gone too far.
o.zh: Dolos，我忠于 Andrada，不是忠于你。你做得太过分了。

entries.en:
"Captain."

Chief High Inspector-General Dolos Macario grins at you with a bony rictus.

"What a surprise," he says, unsurprised.
entries.zh:
"舰长。"

首席总监察长 Dolos Macario 冲你咧嘴一笑，瘦骨嶙峋的脸上挤出狞笑。

"真是个惊喜。"他说着，却毫无惊讶之意。

o.en: You seem to have misunderstood our... partnership.
o.zh: 看来你误解了我们的...合作关系。

entries.en:
"Oh, did-" His voice fills with feigned concern. "Did you hear troubling rumors on the holo? I owe you my most sincere apologies. A ruse becomes necessary from time to time, you see. It may be hard to appreciate from your position but I work... very hard." His eyes turn down as he adjusts his uniform. "Very hard to ensure my plans are..."

He turns to look at what must be a mirror to attach another medal to his coat, then straightens his collar.

"Perfect."

He turns back toward the feed with an impish look.
entries.zh:
"哦，你是——\"他的声音里填满了假惺惺的关切，\"你是在全息新闻上听到什么令人不安的传言了？那我得向你致以最诚挚的歉意。你知道，有时候诡计是必要的。从你的处境看，这或许很难理解，但我工作...非常努力。\"他垂下眼睛，整了整制服，\"非常努力，以确保我的计划..."

他转头看向某面镜子——想必是镜子——往外套上又别了一枚勋章，然后正了正衣领。

"完美。"

他带着一副促狭的神情转回镜头。

entries.en: He smirks knowingly.
entries.zh: 他心照不宣地笑了笑。

entries.en: He smirks, knowingly.
entries.zh: 他心知肚明地勾了勾嘴角。

entries.en:
He looks back to his mirror, adjusting a stray hair.

"You'll get everything you deserve, captain. Have faith." An odd sound escapes his throat. "There will be... news."

"You'll be watching, I trust?" His eyes dart to the feed. "What with having hacked into our comms relay. A capital crime, mind."

He gives a one-shoulder shrug, setting his medals ajingle.
entries.zh:
他转头看向镜子，理了理一缕乱发。

"舰长，你会得到你应得的一切。要有信心。\"他喉咙里挤出一种古怪的声音，\"会有...消息的。"

"我猜你会盯着看吧？\"他的目光飘向全息画面，\"毕竟你黑了我们的通讯中继。记住，这可是死罪。"

他耸了耸肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

o.en: Let's start with rescinding the kill order. Then my commission reinstated.
o.zh: 先把格杀令撤了。然后恢复我的委任。

o.en: Cutting me out would be a mistake. We could rule Askonia.
o.zh: 把我排除在外会是个错误。我们可以一起统治 Askonia。

o.en: I expected no less; power is a game. What's our next step?
o.zh: 我不指望别的；权力本就是一场游戏。下一步是什么？

o.en: Are you trying to discard me, Dolos? You wouldn't be so foolish.
o.zh: Dolos，你是想抛弃我？你不会蠢到这个地步。

o.en: Let's start with rescinding the kill order. Then my commission reinstated.
o.zh: 先把格杀令撤了。然后恢复我的委任。

o.en: I expected no less; power is a game. What's our next step?
o.zh: 我不指望别的；权力本就是一场游戏。下一步是什么？

o.en: I am loyal to the Sindrian Ditkat. We need to work together.
o.zh: 我忠于辛达强权。我们必须合作。

o.en: I am loyal to the Blood of Andrada, Dolos. Not you.
o.zh: Dolos，我忠于 Andrada 的血脉。不是忠于你。

entries.en:
He looks back to his mirror. Adjusts a stray hair.

"You'll get everything you deserve, captain. Hold faith. There will be some... very important news."

"You'll be watching?" His eyes dart to the feed. "Of course you will. What with having hacked into our comms relay. A capital crime, mind."

He gives a one-shoulder shrug, setting his medals ajingle.
entries.zh:
他转头看向镜子。理了理一缕乱发。

"舰长，你会得到你应得的一切。保持信心。会有一些...非常重要的消息。"

"你会盯着看的吧？\"他的目光飘向全息画面，\"你当然会。毕竟你黑了我们的通讯中继。记住，这可是死罪。"

他耸了耸肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

o.en: My demand stands. I swore an oath.
o.zh: 我的要求不变。我发过誓。

entries.en:
He looks back to his mirror, adjusting a stray hair.

"You will wait right there, captain. We have to, ah, link up. Keep faith! There is important news coming."

"You'll be watching the feeds, I trust," he says. "What with having hacked into our comms relay."

He gives a one-shoulder shrug, setting his medals ajingle.
entries.zh:
他转头看向镜子，理了理一缕乱发。

"舰长，你就在那儿等着。我们得，啊，会合。保持信心！马上就有重要消息。"

"我猜你会盯着这些频道吧，\"他说，\"毕竟你黑了我们的通讯中继。"

他耸了耸肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

o.en: You want me to wait here - for what? An ambush?
o.zh: 你要我在这儿等——等什么？等一场伏击？

entries.en:
He looks back to his mirror, adjusting a stray hair.

"And you've given them some good practice. Maintain your faith. There is... very important news coming."

"You'll be watching, I trust?" His eyes dart to the feed. "What with having hacked into our comms relay. A capital crime, mind."

He gives a one-shoulder shrug, setting his medals ajingle.
entries.zh:
他转头看向镜子，理了理一缕乱发。

"而且你给了他们不少练手的机会。保持你的信心。马上会有...非常重要的消息。"

"我猜你会盯着看吧？\"他的目光飘向全息画面，\"毕竟你黑了我们的通讯中继。记住，这可是死罪。"

他耸了耸肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

o.en: This isn't about faith. You need to call off the hunt.
o.zh: 这跟信心无关。你必须叫停这场追捕。

entries.en:
He looks back to his mirror, adjusting a stray hair.

"We all have our part to play, captain. Maintain your faith. There will be... very important news coming."

"You'll be watching, I trust?" His eyes dart to the feed. "What with having hacked into our comms relay. A capital crime against the Diktat, mind."

He gives a one-shoulder shrug, setting his medals ajingle.
entries.zh:
他转头看向镜子，理了理一缕乱发。

"舰长，我们各有各的角色要扮演。保持你的信心。马上会有...非常重要的消息。"

"我猜你会盯着看吧？\"他的目光飘向全息画面，\"毕竟你黑了我们的通讯中继。记住，这是对强权的死罪。"

他耸了耸肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

entries.en:
He looks back to his mirror, adjusting a stray hair. A smile flickers over his thin lips.

"I admire your loyalty, captain. We can't all be one of Andrada's New Men, can we? Hold that faith. There will be... important news concerning the future of the Sindrian Diktat."

"You'll be watching, I trust?" His eyes dart to the feed. "What with having hacked our comms relay. A capital crime, mind."

He gives a little one-shoulder shrug, setting medals ajingle.
entries.zh:
他转头看向镜子，理了理一缕乱发。一丝笑意掠过他薄薄的嘴唇。

"舰长，我欣赏你的忠诚。我们不可能人人都成为 Andrada 的新人，对吧？守住这份信心。会有...关于辛达强权未来的重要消息。"

"我猜你会盯着看吧？\"他的目光飘向全息画面，\"毕竟你黑了我们的通讯中继。记住，这可是死罪。"

他微微耸了下肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

o.en: You need me, Dolos. No one can do what I can do.
o.zh: Dolos，你需要我。我能做的事，没人能替代。

o.en: I'm going to clear my name with or without your help.
o.zh: 不管你帮不帮忙，我都要洗清自己的名声。

o.en: You put me in this position. Your 'ruse', your lies.
o.zh: 是你把我推到这一步的。你的'诡计'，你的谎言。

entries.en:
He lifts his cap, black, bearing the gold wings of the Diktat. He doesn't put it on quite yet.

"It'll soon be done," he says quietly, his eyes focused elsewhere.

The comms snap off, leaving you with the darkness.
entries.zh:
他抬起帽子——黑色的帽檐上缀着强权的金色翼徽。他还没有戴上。

"很快就结束了，"他低声说，目光落在别处。

通讯骤然中断，只留你与黑暗相对。

entries.en: Macario's teeth flash; it couldn't be called a smile.
entries.zh: Macario 的牙齿一闪；那实在称不上笑。

entries.en: "He will." Macario's teeth flash. "I'll make sure of it."
entries.zh: "他会的。\"Macario 牙齿一闪，\"我会确保如此。"

entries.en: Macario's teeth flash; it couldn't be called a smile.
entries.zh: Macario 的牙齿一闪；那实在称不上笑。

entries.en:
He blinks at you, perhaps even surprised.

"I have," he emphasizes the word outrageously, "made a mistake. I did not credit you with quite that scale of ambition."

He looks back to his mirror, adjusting a stray hair. "It doesn't become you," he says. Then an odd sound escapes his throat.

"You'll be watching the public comms, I trust?" His eyes dart back to the feed. "What with hacking our comms relay. A capital crime, mind."

He gives a one-shoulder shrug, setting medals ajingle.
entries.zh:
他眨了眨眼，看着你，甚至有些意外。

"我确实犯了个错误。\"他把【确实】咬得格外夸张，\"我没料到你竟有这般野心。"

他转头看向镜子，理了理一缕乱发。"这不合你的身份，"他说。接着他喉咙里挤出一种古怪的声音。

"我猜你会盯着公共通讯频道吧？\"他的目光又飘回全息画面，\"毕竟你刚黑了我们的通讯中继。记住，这可是死罪。"

他耸了耸肩，只动了一边肩膀，勋章叮当作响。

entries.en:
Tapping into a comms router involves breaking more than a handful of interfactional laws but, as you tell yourself, the circumstances are exceptional.

Ops gives a nod across the bridge, confirming that the zero-G squad has finished the physical breach of the comms relay hardware.
entries.zh:
接入一台通讯路由器，要违反的势力间法律不止一两条，不过你对自己说，眼下情况特殊。

行动长官在舰桥那头点了点头，确认零重力小队已经完成对通讯中继站硬件的实体突破。

entries.en:
"IO is green across the board, captain," your comms officer reports. Tech chimes in, "Source is spoofed to read as originating from Sindrian Diktat Command & Control."

You suspect they are both suppressing a grin.

Ops, of course, is frowning in anticipation of what is going to go wrong next.
entries.zh:
"IO 全绿，舰长，\"你的通讯官报告。技术官插话道，\"来源已伪装，读数显示发自辛达强权指挥控制中心。"

你猜这两人都在憋着笑。

行动长官自然是皱着眉，在预想接下来会出什么岔子。

entries.en: Your tech officer gives a casual salute and looks to Ops - who nods - then taps something on a datapad.
entries.zh: 你的技术军官随意地敬了个礼，看向行动长官——对方点了点头——随后在数据板上点了点什么。

entries.en:
"You truly believe I should?"

He looks strained.

"I suppose my Gens has much to gain if Fortuna's plans fail. To be second is no shameful thing. And I must look first to the safety of Gens Yaribay... our future which is inexorably bound to Gens Hannan."

He pauses, then muses, "There will always future opportunities."
entries.zh:
"您当真觉得我该这么做？"

他神色有些发紧。

"Fortuna 那套要是黄了，我这一族确有不少好处可捞。屈居第二也不算丢人。我总得先顾着 Yaribay 氏族的周全... 我们往后的路，早和 Hannan 氏族绑死在一处了。"

他顿了顿，慢悠悠地念了句："往后总还有机会。"

o.en: Do it. Gens Yaribay will be rewarded for your loyalty.
o.zh: 放手去做。您这份忠心，Yaribay 氏族会得到回报。

o.en: On second thought, there's much to consider. (back)
o.zh: 再想想，这事还得再琢磨琢磨。 (返回)

entries.en: "You speak with conviction and clarity. I shall seriously consider your counsel, $titlePL."
entries.zh: "您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我会认真想想您的劝，$titlePL。"

entries.en:
"You speak with conviction and clarity. I believe... I do believe I shall do as you suggest, $titlePL."

He still looks uneasy, but a sense of confidence in having made a hard decision settles in his expression.
entries.zh:
"您这话说得恳切，也说得明白。我想... 我确是打算照您说的办了，$titlePL。"

他神色仍有些不安，可难下的决心既已拿定，眉宇间倒添了几分沉稳。

o.en: You should back the Prime Demarchon against Fortuna Kato's scheme for Achilles.
o.zh: 您该站在大统领这边，别由着 Fortuna Kato 替 Achilles 张罗那套。

entries.en: You've had a moment to examine the drink that's been set before you and nearly come to the conclusion that it's potable when K-O Jove appears, sliding into the seat beside you.
entries.zh: 你刚有片刻工夫端详摆到面前的这杯东西，几乎要断定它还入口得下去——K-O Jove 就出现了，一滑身坐进你旁边的座位。

entries.en: "Friendly stars, stranger," he says, taking the drink and having a sip. "Mmm. Perfect."
entries.zh: "群星友善，陌生人，\"他说着，端起那杯酒啜了一口。\"嗯。完美。"

entries.en:
"Friendly stars, stranger," he says, then takes a look at the drink in front of you.

"What in Ludd's hells is that?"
entries.zh:
"群星友善，陌生人，"他说着，看了看你面前那杯东西。

"卢德的地狱在上，这玩意儿是什么？"

entries.en:
"You were supposed to order a Burn-home Flip," he says.

"Bartender!"

He rolls his eyes at you. "Now we have to wait."
entries.zh:
"你该点的是 Burn-home Flip，"他说。

"酒保！"

他冲你翻了个白眼。"这下得等了。"

entries.en: Jove performs a mini-bow, raising his off-hand with a flourish.
entries.zh: Jove 微微欠身一礼，另一只手夸张地一扬。

entries.en:
He performs a mini-bow, raising his off-hand with a flourish.

Then Jove goes silent, waiting until the bartender sets his preferred drink in front of him. Jove lifts it, inhales, and takes a long, slow sip, examines his drinking vessel, then carefully sets it down.

"You see, captain? That is how it is done." He looks at you. "Correctly."
entries.zh:
他微微欠身行了个礼，空着的那只手潇洒地一扬。

随后 Jove 沉默下来，一直等到酒保把他惯喝的那杯放到面前。Jove 端起杯子，闻了闻，长长地慢慢啜了一口，端详着杯身，然后小心地放下。

"看见了吗，舰长？事情就该这么办。\"他看向你，\"办得【正确】。"

entries.en: "I am," he says. "Thank you for asking."
entries.zh: "正是，\"他说。\"谢谢你问这一句。"

entries.en:
"I am," he says. "Thank you for asking."

Jove goes silent, waiting until the bartender sets his preferred drink in front of him. Jove lifts it, inhales, and takes a long, slow sip, examines his drinking vessel, then carefully sets it down.

"You see, captain? That is how it is done." He looks at you. "Correctly."
entries.zh:
"确实如此，\"他说，\"多谢关心。"

Jove 沉默下来，一直等到酒保把他惯喝的那杯放到面前。Jove 端起杯子，闻了闻，长长地慢慢啜了一口，端详着杯身，然后小心地放下。

"看见了吗，舰长？事情就该这么办。\"他看向你，\"办得【正确】。"

entries.en:
"We've come so far, captain, waited so long."

He takes another slow sip, examines his drinking vessel, then carefully sets it down.

"Savor the... anticipation."
entries.zh:
"我们走了这么远，舰长，等了这么久。"

他又缓缓啜了一口，端详着手里的杯子，然后小心地把它放下。

"细细品味这份...期待。"

entries.en:
"We've come so far, captain, waited so long."

Jove goes silent, waiting until the bartender sets his preferred drink in front of him. Jove lifts it, inhales, and takes a long, slow sip, examines his drinking vessel, then carefully sets it down.

"You see, captain? That is how it is done." He looks at you. "Correctly."
entries.zh:
"我们走了这么远，舰长，等了这么久。"

Jove 沉默下来，一直等到酒保把他惯喝的那杯放到面前。Jove 端起杯子，闻了闻，长长地慢慢啜了一口，端详着杯身，然后小心地放下。

"看见了吗，舰长？事情就该这么办。\"他看向你，\"办得【正确】。"

entries.en:
He makes a pristine TriPad appear, taps it lightly, then looks at you with a coy half-smile.

You recall a matter of 80,000 credits.
entries.zh:
他变出一台崭新的 TriPad，轻轻一点，然后带着几分故作腼腆的半笑看向你。

你想起那笔 80,000 星币的账。

entries.en: He makes the pristine TriPad reappear, taps it lightly, then looks to you with a coy half-smile.
entries.zh: 他让那台崭新的 TriPad 重新浮现，轻轻一点，然后带着故作腼腆的半笑看向你。

entries.en:
He makes a coy half-smile.

"We're going to Ilm."
entries.zh:
他露出一个故作腼腆的半笑。

"我们去 Ilm。"

entries.en: "Yes," he says, then stands. "Coming?
entries.zh: "没错，"他说着站起身，"来吗？"

entries.en:
He smiles, earnestly this time.

"I'm ready to go."
entries.zh:
他笑了，这回是真心的。

"我准备好了。"

o.en: Bring K-O Jove to your shuttle
o.zh: 带 K-O Jove 去你的穿梭机

entries.en:
"It is," he says. "I need to make sure you don't screw it up."

"Besides," he looks nonchalantly down the bar. "I want to see his face when he realizes he's been found."
entries.zh:
"有必要，\"他说，\"我得确保你别把事情搞砸。"

"再说，\"他若无其事地朝吧台那头望去，\"我想看看他发现自己被找到时的那张脸。"

entries.en:
"No?" A look of mild surprise.

"You're paid up, captain. If you don't want to catch him, then I suppose that's your decision." He shrugs. "I'm going to be disappointed to miss the opportunity to see the look on his face. But it's your quest for revenge, not mine."
entries.zh:
"不去？"他露出些许惊讶。

"钱你已经付清了，舰长。如果你不想抓他，那我想这是你的决定。\"他耸耸肩，\"错过亲眼看他那副表情的机会，我会失望。不过这是你的复仇，不是我的。"

o.en: Fine. Show me where he is.

entries.en:
"No?" A look of mild surprise.

"Reynard's paid up, captain. If you don't want to catch him, then I suppose that's your decision." He shrugs. "I'm going to be disappointed to miss the opportunity to see the look on his face. But it's your quest for revenge, not mine."
entries.zh:
"不去？"他露出些许惊讶。

"Reynard 已经付清了，舰长。如果你不想抓他，那我想这是你的决定。\"他耸耸肩，\"错过亲眼看他那副表情的机会，我会失望。不过这是你的复仇，不是我的。"

o.en: Fine. Show me where he is.

entries.en:
"No," he says. "You can't."

"He has what we might call a series of 'tripwires', in software and human form. Without me to dissuade them and disarm them - so to speak, though also literally - you're never going to find him."

"He'll slip away." Jove makes a scurrying sort of motion with his hand. "Again."
entries.zh:
"不，\"他说，\"你找不到。"

"他把一圈所谓的'绊线'布在了软件和活人身上。没有我去劝退、去拆除它们——比喻义，不过也是字面义——你永远找不到他。"

"他会溜掉。\"Jove 的手比了个仓皇逃窜的动作，\"又一次。"

entries.en: Jove makes a disappointed sound, and walks away.
entries.zh: Jove 发出一声失望的轻响，转身走开。

entries.en:
He disappears.

You look back to the bar.
entries.zh:
他消失在人群里。

你转回目光，看向吧台。

entries.en:
He stops, and looks coyly over one shoulder.

"You're not stupid, captain. Eventually."
entries.zh:
他停下脚步，带着几分做作的腼腆回头瞥了一眼。

"舰长，你终归不傻。"

o.en: Bring K-O Jove to your shuttle
o.zh: 带 K-O Jove 去你的穿梭机

o.en: So you found him? For real this time?
o.zh: 所以你找到他了？这回是真的？
付给 K-O Jove 80,000 星币

o.en: Tell me where he is first.

entries.en: K-O Joves comes along, as pleased with himself as ever, content to mutter into his discreet comms unit. Making arrangements, you assume, for your arrival on Ilm.
entries.zh: K-O Jove 跟了上来，一如既往地自鸣得意，心满意足地对着他那台隐蔽的通讯器低声絮语。你猜，他是在为你们抵达 Ilm 做安排。

entries.en: He gives you a weary look.
entries.zh: 他疲惫地看了你一眼。

entries.en:
He makes the TriPad disappear.

"We're going to Ilm."
entries.zh:
他让 TriPad 消失了。

"我们去 Ilm。"

entries.en:
He rolls his eyes.

"Yes, unfortunately you're not lying. You put me in a difficult position, captain. This opportunity has a strictly limited time window and I cannot guarantee that it can be reproduced."

Jove sounds more legitimately upset than you've ever heard him before, and he looks it as he rubs his temples.

After a moment, he sighs. Then speaks. "Here's the deal: you agree to pay me 100,000 credits later. We proceed with the job now."
entries.zh:
他翻了个白眼。

"是的，不幸的是你没撒谎。舰长，你让我很难办。这个机会的时间窗口极其有限，我没法保证还能再来一次。"

Jove 的语气里有着你从未听过的真切懊恼，他揉着太阳穴，表情也是如此。

过了一会儿，他叹了口气，开口道："那就这么办：你答应事后付我 100,000 星币。这活我们现在就干。"

o.en: Those terms seem unreasonable to me...
o.zh: 这条件在我看来不太合理...

entries.en:
He rolls his eyes.

"Yes you do. And you should know by now how I feel about quibbling over my quite extraordinarily reasonable prices."
entries.zh:
他翻了个白眼。

"不，你有。而且你到现在该知道，别人跟我这些格外公道的价钱讨价还价，我是什么态度。"

entries.en:
"Necessity."

He takes another sip of his drink, though with distinctly less relish than before.
entries.zh:
"迫不得已。"

他又啜了一口酒，只是远不如先前那样有滋有味。

entries.en:
He nods.

Then stands, and begins to walk toward the exit.

"Coming?
entries.zh:
他点点头。

然后站起身，朝出口走去。

"来吗？"

entries.en:
"No they don't," he says sharply.

"And You know how I feel about quibbling over my extraordinarily reasonable prices, so I request you desist. It demeans us both."
entries.zh:
"不，它们很合理。"他尖锐地说。

"而且你知道我对讨价还价是什么态度——尤其是我这些公道得不能再公道的价钱，所以请你别再磨了。这有失我们双方的身份。"

entries.en:
"If you don't want to catch him, then I suppose that's your decision." He shrugs, standing up.

"I'm going to be disappointed, very disappointed, to miss the opportunity to see the look on his face. But it's your quest for revenge, not mine..."
entries.zh:
"如果你不想抓他，那我想这是你的决定。"他耸耸肩，站起身。

"没能亲眼看到他脸上那副表情，我会很失望，非常失望。不过这是你的复仇，不是我的..."

o.en: Fine. Let's do this. Show me where he is.
o.zh: 好吧。这就动手。告诉我他在哪儿。

entries.en:
"You're not stupid, captain. Eventually."

He begins walking toward the exit, then pauses.

"Shall we?"
entries.zh:
"舰长，你终归不傻。"

他朝出口走去，随即又停下。

"走吧？"

entries.en:
He laughs.

"Not here," he says, looking around. "That much you can have for free."

He taps the TriPad again.
entries.zh:
他笑了。

"不在这儿，\"他环顾四周，说道，\"这一点，我可以免费告诉你。"

他又点了点 TriPad。

entries.en:
"If you don't want to catch him, then I suppose that's your decision." He shrugs, and stands.

"I'm going to be disappointed, very disappointed, to miss the opportunity to see the look on his face. But it's your quest for revenge, not mine..."
entries.zh:
"如果你不想抓他，那我想这是你的决定。"他耸耸肩，站起身来。

"没能亲眼看到他脸上那副表情，我会很失望，非常失望。不过这是你的复仇，不是我的..."

o.en: Fine. I do actually want to catch him.
I told you, I'm not interested.

entries.en:
You make eye contact with the bartender and, knowing how to spot the type of customer with credits to throw around, he approaches almost instantly.

"What'll it be?"
entries.zh:
你和酒保对上了视线。他看得出哪种客人会大把撒星币，几乎立刻就凑了过来。

"喝点什么？"

entries.en:
"Maximo." The bartender almost sneers. "You another of his 'customers'? Is that it? Look - I know you people do business here, and I support your trade. You make your deals and I provide a comfortable establishment and relaxing substances for a reasonable fee."

"But." out comes the accusing finger, not quite pointed at you. At Maximo?

"That doesn't mean I'll allow an employee to move 'product' through my business! There's rules and... and lines!" The finger draws a line, showing what must not be crossed.
entries.zh:
"Maximo。\"酒保几乎是嗤了一声，\"你也是他的'主顾'？是不是？听我说——我知道你们这些人在我这儿做生意，我也不反对。你们做你们的买卖，我收一份公道的钱，提供舒服的场子和让人放松的东西。"

"可是。"一根指责的手指伸了出来，并没有完全指向你。是在指 Maximo？

"这不代表我会允许一个雇员在我的店里走'货'！凡事都有规矩，还有...还有底线！"那根手指在空中划了一道线，标出不可逾越之处。

o.en: I'm not a customer of Maximo. I'm just looking for him.
o.zh: 我不是 Maximo 的主顾。我只是在找他。

entries.en:
"Looking for him. Ah," the bartender's attitude changes, a knowing smile appears. "I see, I see."

"Not surprised one bit," he says philosophically. "The man was nothing but trouble, and brought trouble. Not surprised trouble's now come a-looking for him."

"Not," he clears his throat, "saying you're trouble to anyone that doesn't deserve it."
entries.zh:
"找他。啊，\"酒保的态度变了，露出一抹会意的笑，\"明白了，明白了。"

"一点都不意外，\"他语带哲理地说，\"那人本身就是个麻烦，还总把麻烦带来。如今麻烦找上门来，我一点也不奇怪。"

"我可不是在说，\"他清了清嗓子，\"你会去麻烦那些不该被麻烦的人。"

entries.en:
He nods, magnanimous.

"And I'm not asking who you work for, not my business. I'm not one to make custom of informing upon anyone, no $playerSirOrMadam. I respect the privacy of my customers."

He waves a hand, taking in all the spacers and mercenaries and ne'er-do-wells... and poorly disguised corpo agents, slumming aristocrats, stiff-backed navy officers, part-time pirates, unlucky smugglers. The accreted scum of the Persean Sector.

"But an employee who sells his own product in my establishment? That's over the line."

The bartender nods to himself.
entries.zh:
他宽宏大量地点了点头。

"我也不问你在给谁做事，那不关我的事。我可没有告发别人的习惯，绝不，$playerSirOrMadam。我尊重客人的隐私。"

他一挥手，把满屋的太空客、雇佣兵、地痞...还有伪装拙劣的公司密探、跑来下层厮混的贵族、腰板笔直的军官、兼职海盗、不走运的走私犯都划了进去。英仙座星域沉淀下来的渣滓。

"可一个雇员在我的店里卖他自己的货？这就越线了。"

酒保自顾自地点了点头。

o.en: Couldn't agree more. So where is 'Maximo'?
o.zh: 再同意不过。那么'Maximo'在哪儿？

entries.en:
"No idea," he says, giving the counter a wipe.

"Fired him, oh, just five shifts or so ago. Horrible old man, anyway. Always acting like he knew better than you and talkin' weird. Upset the customers. Coughed in the drinks too, I'm pretty sure. Unacceptable."
entries.zh:
"不知道，"他一边擦着柜台一边说。

"炒了，哦，也就五个班次之前吧。那老头本来就讨人厌。总摆出一副比你懂得多的样子，讲话还怪腔怪调。把客人惹得不痛快。我挺肯定他还在酒里咳嗽过。这不能忍。"

o.en: What exactly was this 'product' he was selling?

entries.en:
The bartender leans in.

"Chems. Fancy drugs and the like that the League takes a dim view of transiting inter-system. Here on Salamanca we're more enlightened on matters of individual choice, you see, but the big boss around here, he knows we gotta play the part of controlling things for the benefit of our less open-minded friends in the League."

"Like I said, I don't care who sells what as a general principle. But an employee of my business needs to provide a cut for making use of my establishment! Fair's only fair, and I've worked hard to build a friendly reputation."
entries.zh:
酒保凑近了些。

"化学品。高级药品那一类东西，联盟对跨星系转运它们很看不上眼。在 Salamanca，我们对个人选择这件事开明得多，你明白；可这儿的大老板清楚，我们得装出严加管控的样子，好让联盟里那些脑子不那么开化的朋友满意。"

"我说过，原则上我不在乎谁卖什么。可我这店里的雇员，借我的场子做买卖，就得给我抽成！这才叫公平，我这'和气生财'的名声可是辛苦挣来的。"

entries.en:
"It was nothing," the bartender says. "This one's on me."

You're left with a small vessel of some eye-watering spirit.

And no sign of where 'Maximo' disappeared to.
entries.zh:
"没什么，\"酒保说，\"这杯算我的。"

你面前只剩下一小瓶烈得辣眼睛的酒。

至于'Maximo'去了哪儿，毫无头绪。

entries.en:
As you step out of the bar a young spacer, suit, rig and all, steps forward.

"Captain $PlayerLastName? Uh..."

The movements of your bodyguards, though subtle, makes it clear they have weapons trained on the kid. She doesn't even notice.
entries.zh:
你刚走出酒吧，一个年轻的女太空客就迎上前来，太空服、装具一概齐全。

"$PlayerLastName 舰长？呃..."

你的保镖动作细微，却明白无误地表明武器已对准这姑娘。她压根没察觉。

o.en: If you want a job, the answer is no.
o.zh: 你要是想找活干，答案是不行。

o.en: If you want a job, the answer is yes.
o.zh: 你要是想找活干，答案是可以。

entries.en:
She closes her eyes, takes a breath, and begins.

"I got paid to give you a message, and that's, um, that 'he' had a microsat at the jump-point that tagged your fleet, which is why 'he' isn't here."

Eyes open now.

"I was told to say 'Jove says it'll take more time', and this is a uh, something about fainting? So that 'he' can't find more credits?"
entries.zh:
她闭上眼，吸了口气，然后开口。

"有人付钱让我给你带个话，内容是，呃，'他'在跃迁点布了一颗微型卫星，标记了你的舰队，所以'他'才没在这儿。"

她睁开眼。

"他们让我带话说'Jove 说还得再花些时间'，还有什么，呃，'装晕'之类的？这样'他'就找不来更多星币了？"

o.en: A 'feint', yes. I suppose that makes sense.
o.zh: 一次'虚晃'，对。我想这说得通。
所以他是在浪费我的时间？

entries.en: "No? I mean, maybe? I didn't get a name, they just-"
entries.zh: "不是？我是说，也许？他们没告诉我名字，只是——"

entries.en: "Oh! No, I mean, that isn't why... I'll just-"
entries.zh: "哦！不，我是说，不是为了那个...我就是——"

entries.en: "Oh! Fantastic, thank you $playerSirOrMadam! But, that isn't why... I'll just-"
entries.zh: "哦！太好了，谢谢你，$playerSirOrMadam！可、可我不是为这个来的...我就是——"

entries.en: "That's all I was told," she says nervously.
entries.zh: "他们只跟我说了这些，"她紧张地说。

entries.en: "I... sorry, I don't know. That's all I was told."
entries.zh: "我...对不起，我不知道。他们只跟我说了这些。"

entries.en:
"I... sorry, I don't know. That's all I was told," she says, distressed.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Are you... do I still have that job?"
entries.zh:
"我...对不起，我不知道。他们只跟我说了这些，"她说着，满脸惶恐。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。那个...我那份活还在吗？"

entries.en:
"That's all I was told," she says, looking nervous.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Are you... do I still have that job?"
entries.zh:
"他们只跟我说了这些，"她说着，神色紧张。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。那个...我那份活还在吗？"

entries.en: The young spacer looks relieved, though still scared. One of your bodyguards forwards her to your purser.
entries.zh: 年轻的太空船员松了口气，可脸上仍带着惧色。你的一名保镖把她领到了你的事务长那里。

entries.en: The young spacer does just as you say, doing her best to hide a look of disappointment.
entries.zh: 年轻的太空船员照你说的做了，竭力掩住脸上的失望。

entries.en: The young spacer performs a passable salute, then scurries off before anything she says displeases you any more.
entries.zh: 年轻的太空船员敬了个勉强像样的礼，随即匆匆退开，生怕再说出什么惹你不快的话。

entries.en:
You catch a bartender's eye and before long they're standing in front of you, bar towel draped over one arm.

"Good shift, captain. What will you be having?"
entries.zh:
你与一名酒保对上了目光，没多久人就到了你面前，一条擦吧台的布搭在臂上。

"当班顺利，舰长。您要来点什么？"

o.zh: 你们这儿最好的 Eventide 白酒。

entries.en:
K-O Jove lounges in the seat of a locked-down control interface on your bridge.

"Ilm," he says. "Wouldn't mind the cold if it weren't for the people. Tedious as well as poor. The worst possible combination..."
entries.zh:
K-O Jove 懒洋洋地窝在你舰桥上一台已锁定的控制台的座椅里。

"Ilm，\"他说，\"要不是那些人，这地方的冷我倒不介意。那些人既乏味又穷。最糟的组合..."

entries.en:
As you descend, the mapping overlay presents a lonely image.

Jove directs your pilot to the least-developed hemisphere of Ilm, a fractured and barren surface strewn with teleoperated mines that send their extractions toward a handful of crewed first-pass refining outposts.

These are dismal places dominated by industrial machinery, orbital shuttle pads, and substance abuse.
entries.zh:
随着下降，地图叠加层呈现出一幅荒凉的图景。

Jove 把驾驶员引向 Ilm 开发程度最低的那半个球面——一片破碎荒芜的地表，散布着遥控矿场，把采出的东西送往少数几个有人值守的初炼前哨。

那些地方一片萧索，满眼是工业机械、轨道穿梭机坪，还有药物滥用。

entries.en:
With Jove's assistance, your shuttle's route finally locks onto a forgettable cluster of blocky, anonymous machinery named EEZ-22.

Local flight control seems bored, and even a little annoyed by your pilot's diligence in adhering to procedure, as you land and disembark.
entries.zh:
在 Jove 的协助下，你的穿梭机航线最终锁定在一处毫无特色的方块状无名机器群上，编号 EEZ-22。

你们降落、下机时，本地飞行管制显得百无聊赖，甚至对你驾驶员那种一丝不苟按规程办事的劲头有点不耐烦。

entries.en:
It's a poor company town like thousands of others across the Persean Sector. Despite their variety - hot, cold, enclosed, open - somehow they're always the same.

The same modular structures, life support units, heat and atmo regulators. The same models churned out by forges by the trillions over a thousand cycles of Domain history.

The locals stare, particularly at K-O Jove with his short, ostentatious jacket and gaudy jewelry.

"Time slot is short," Jove says. "Word quickly spreads in places like this."
entries.zh:
这是英仙座星域里成千上万座贫困的公司镇之一。酷热的、严寒的、封闭的、敞开的——尽管形态各异，它们到头来总是一模一样。

同样的模块化建筑、生命维持单元、温控与大气调节器。同样的型号，人之领千年的历史里，锻造厂以万亿计的产量将它们倾泻而出。

本地人盯着你们看，尤其是盯着 K-O Jove——他那件短得过分的招摇外套，还有那一身俗艳的首饰。

"时间窗口很短，\"Jove 说，\"这种地方，消息传得飞快。"

entries.en:
Two of your bodyguards accompany yourself and Jove directly, while another four are spread in a wide, loose formation doing their best to appear unassociated.

Their tactical chatter is a whisper in your ear.

Your party approaches a res corridor, interrupting some kind of argument. The participants stare blankly for a moment at your disparate (and subtly well-armed) party, then wisely choose to disappear into adjacent cells.

Jove checks something on his datapad, then stows it. He squints at a door unhappily, like he doesn't want to have to touch the grimy access pad.
entries.zh:
两名保镖紧跟着你和 Jove，另外四人则散成一片松散的大扇面，尽量显得与你们无关。

他们的战术通话在你耳边低语般响着。

你们一行人走近一条生活区走廊，打断了一场争执。争执的几方愣愣地看了你们这伙参差不齐 (且隐隐都带着家伙) 的人片刻，然后识趣地钻进旁边的舱室消失了。

Jove 在数据板上查了点什么，收了起来。他不太高兴地眯眼打量一扇门，像是懒得去碰那块脏兮兮的门禁板。

entries.en:
"No," says Jove.

The door opens, and what looks like a technician steps out, work-rig and all festooned with tools and sensors. At her collar is sewn a piece of handweave, a sign of devotion to piety through handcraft.

Jove smirks. "One of mine," he says, then steps forward to have a whispered conversation and consultation over a datapad.

Under the tech's padded hood you catch a gleam.

Silver-eyes.
entries.zh:
"不在，"Jove 说。

门开了，一个看样子是技术员的人走出来，身上那套作业外骨骼挂满了工具和传感器。她领口缝着一块手织布，那是借手工劳作敬奉虔诚的信物。

Jove 得意地一笑。"我的人，"他说，随即上前低声交谈，一起看一块数据板。

技术员厚兜帽的阴影里，你捕捉到一点微光。

Silver-eyes。

entries.en:
According to her, it's time to hurry up and wait.

You're led into the cramped habitation-cell and offered bad tea. You have to wait half an hour, Jove explains. Timing is key.

Pre-battle tedium is well within your experience, and you know how to make the time serve.
entries.zh:
按她的说法，眼下该快点就位，然后等着。

你被领进一间逼仄的居住舱，有人给你倒了杯难喝的茶。Jove 解释说，得等上半小时。时机是关键。

战前的枯燥你早已习惯，你知道怎么让这段时间为你所用。

entries.en:
* * *

After an exchange of nods, an uncharacteristically quiet Jove turns to indicate that it's time to move.

Silver-eyes leads your small party down side-corridors to an even more dilapidated sector of the outpost. These are warehousing modules in various states of neglect - still habitable, but the air is cold and stuffy. The life support has been turned to maintenance mode by the company's remote analysts to save credits.

One corridor stands out, well-lit by adhesive panel-lights. Almost inviting.

You check your weapon. K-O Jove checks his - a delicate custom-made pistol with red-chrome mirror finish. Its casing flashes in the light.

Typical Jove.

Silver-eyes holds up a hand.
entries.zh:
* * *

几人交换过眼神，一反常态沉默的 Jove 转过身，示意该动了。

Silver-eyes 带着你们这队人拐进侧廊，走向前哨站更破败的一片区域。那里是仓储模块，各处荒废程度不一——还能住人，但空气又冷又闷。为了省星币，公司的远程分析师把生命维持系统调成了维护模式。

有一条走廊格外显眼，贴片灯把它照得通亮。几乎称得上宜人。

你检查了自己的武器。K-O Jove 也检查了他的——一把精巧的定制手枪，红铬镜面。枪身在灯下闪了一闪。

典型的 Jove。

Silver-eyes 抬起一只手。

entries.en:
You hear the singing.

An untrained chorus of human voices.

A distinctly human, distinctly Luddic, affectation.

Silver-eyes whispers to Jove, then draws a squat autopistol with an unusually long magazine. It bears the icon for boarding rounds.

Jove leans toward you, speaking quietly. "Once they're done, the target is up. He'll be jabbering, which means he'll be distracted. I've got two armed friendlies in the crowd. They'll lock down the flock. Just make sure your guards know not to pop 'em," he glances at them.
entries.zh:
你听见了歌声。

一片没受过训练的合唱，人声。

一种十足人性、也十足卢德派的做派。

Silver-eyes 对 Jove 低语几句，然后拔出一把短粗的自动手枪，弹匣长得不寻常。枪身上有登舰弹的标识。

Jove 凑近你，压低声音。"等他们唱完，目标就上台了。他会喋喋不休，也就是说他会分神。人堆里我有两个带枪的自己人。他们会把信众控住。你只要确保你的保镖别把他们崩了，"他朝那几人瞥了一眼。

entries.en:
Your senior bodyguard murmurs into comms, transmitting instructions.

Jove smirks. "Got their EM sensors spoofed, you know. Otherwise that'd have given away the game. And-"  He actually shuts his mouth when Silver-eyes raises her off-hand again.

The singing has stopped. Silver-eyes jabs her hand toward the door. "Go," she says, voice gruff.
entries.zh:
你的资深保镖对着通讯器低声传达指令。

Jove 得意一笑。"你知道，我把他们的电磁传感器骗过去了。不然这一下就露底了。还有——"Silver-eyes 再次抬起闲着的左手，他竟真把嘴闭上了。

歌声停了。Silver-eyes 抬手朝门口一指。"走，"她说，嗓音粗哑。

entries.en:
Bright interior. Festooned with banners bearing Luddic symbols. Seating arranged in rows, like pews.

Sparsely populated. It's a young crowd - bewildered faces fresh from Mazalot, still dutiful to the faith their families imposed upon them.

A few at the back who gape at your party of newcomers, but the rest have their attention fixed upon the figure ranting at the head of the congregation from a raised platform,
entries.zh:
内部很亮堂。挂满带卢德派徽记的旗帜。座位排成一排排，像教堂的长椅。

人不多。是群年轻人——刚从 Mazalot 来的茫然面孔，还恪守着家里硬塞给他们的信仰。

后排有几个人张大嘴看着你们这伙闯入者，其余人的注意力都钉在集会前端高台上那个正慷慨激昂的身影上。

entries.en:
"-and did not Ludd cast OUT the machine-mind? For t'was A DEMON hidden among... Hark, it appears!"

A version of Dolos Macario stands behind the altar. Hair long, eyes sunken and wild with the mania of the street-preacher.

You must admit, he does look surprised.

And he's pointing at you.
entries.zh:
"——而且，Ludd 不曾把那机器心智逐出去吗？因为那是个藏在...里的恶魔！听哪，它现身了！"

祭坛后站着另一个版本的 Dolos Macario。长发，眼窝深陷，眼里燃着街头布道者那种狂乱。

你得承认，他看上去确实很吃惊。

而且他正指着你。

o.en: You'll pay for betraying the blood of Andrada!
o.zh: 背叛 Andrada 血脉，你要付出代价！

entries.en:
You ready your weapon.

Screams rise around you.
entries.zh:
你举起武器。

尖叫声在你四周腾起。

entries.en: You duck behind a stack of chairs as screams and shouts erupt around you.
entries.zh: 尖叫与喊声在四周炸开，你矮身躲到一摞椅子后面。

entries.en: Screams and shouts erupt around you.
entries.zh: 尖叫与喊叫在你四周炸开。

entries.en: Screams and shouts erupt around you.
entries.zh: 尖叫与喊叫在你四周炸开。

entries.en:
"The unholy splinter! Apostate and locust-bringer! Kill them all!" Macario shouts.

He leaps from the back of the platform toward the rear of the warehouse, batting aside a handweave banner and sending chairs toppling, breaking line of sight.

His panicked flock does nothing to obey.

Two among them, Jove's plants, begin shouting orders to evacuate, the sharp safety commands drilled into refining crews. You spot hands held to concealed weapons.
entries.zh:
"这不洁的碎片！叛教者，带来蝗灾的人！把他们全杀了！"Macario 吼道。

他从台后纵身跳向仓库深处，一把拨开手织布旗，撞翻成排的椅子，消失在视线之外。

他惊慌的信众们一点也没照办。

人群里有两人是 Jove 安插的，开始喊疏散命令，那是精炼厂班组被反复训练过的短促安全口令。你瞥见有人把手按向藏着的武器。

o.en: Head for the back of the warehouse

entries.en:
Gunfire crackles through the hall, like a slap against your ears.

A few bursts are sharp and close, others muffled by the module's internal dividers.
entries.zh:
枪声在大厅里爆响，像一记耳光抽在耳朵上。

几阵点射又急又近，另一些被模块内部的隔板闷住了。

entries.en:
Staccato tactical chatter in your ears.

You advance, moving from cover to cover, tense and ready to act. The atmo is filled with a fine haze, dust raised by the thunderclap of weapon discharge.

The lights flicker convulsively as EM pulses throb and break. You feel a cold draft and see the hanging dust begin to dance to the shrill siren of the atmo-breach alarm.
entries.zh:
耳边是断奏般的战术通话。

你逐段借掩体推进，绷紧了，随时准备动手。舱内弥漫着细尘，那是武器击发的轰鸣掀起来的。

电磁脉冲一阵阵涌动、断裂，灯光随之剧烈明灭。你感到一股冷风，看见悬着的尘埃开始随着失压警报尖利的鸣叫起舞。

entries.en:
It's a confused, running chase, the lead always several divisions away, or the next module over.

A body on the floor.

Very young. Cheap autopistol fallen from dead hand.

Jove's or Macario's?

Two of your guards keep close to cover you while the other four track Macario's retreat with Jove's team.

You catch only a glimpse of Jove's advance, a spot of bright color and the flash of his ridiculous pistol.
entries.zh:
追击混乱而奔忙，目标总隔着好几个舱段，或者就在隔壁模块。

地上有一具尸体。

很年轻。廉价的自动手枪从死者的手里滑落。

是 Jove 的人，还是 Macario 的人？

两名保镖贴着你护住你，另外四人跟着 Jove 的小队追踪 Macario 的退路。

你只瞥见 Jove 推进的一瞬：一点鲜亮的颜色，和他那把滑稽手枪的闪光。

entries.en:
* * *

The weapons quiet.

The atmo is thick with haze and smoke. The lights have restabilized. Distant emergency self-sealing units pop, spraying quick-drying foam. It cannot have lasted more than a minute.

A tentative all-clear is signalled, and you're led by your bodyguards to a grimy standard-issue airlock at the most wretched extent of this neglected outpost.

He is there.

His body lays over a bench, one leg in an emergency vac-suit, the other in a growing pool of blood.

Before it caught Macario, the stray bullet left a single hole in a cheap partition bearing the logo of some equipment manufacturer.
entries.zh:
* * *

枪声平息。

舱内弥漫着雾气和硝烟。灯光已经稳定下来。远处应急自封装置接连爆开，喷出速干泡沫。整场交火前后不过一分钟。

有人试探着发出解除警报的信号，保镖带你走到这座荒废前哨站最破败的尽头，那里有道污迹斑斑的制式气闸。

他在那里。

他的身体摊在一条长凳上，一条腿还套在应急真空服里，另一条腿浸在一摊正在扩大的血泊中。

那颗流弹在打中 Macario 之前，先在一块廉价隔板上钻了个洞，隔板上印着某家设备制造商的标志。

The weapons quiet.

The atmo is thick with haze and smoke. The lights have restabilized. Distant emergency self-sealing units pop, spraying quick-drying foam. It cannot have lasted more than a minute.

A tentative all-clear is signalled, and you're led by your bodyguards to a grimy standard-issue airlock at the most wretched extent of this neglected outpost.

The betrayer is dead.

His body lays over a bench, one leg in an emergency vac-suit, the other in a growing pool of blood.

Before it caught Macario, the stray bullet left a single hole in a cheap partition bearing the logo of some equipment manufacturer.
entries.zh:
* * *

枪声平息。

舱内弥漫着雾气和硝烟。灯光已经稳定下来。远处应急自封装置接连爆开，喷出速干泡沫。整场交火前后不过一分钟。

有人试探着发出解除警报的信号，保镖带你走到这座荒废前哨站最破败的尽头，那里有道污迹斑斑的制式气闸。

背叛者死了。

他的身体摊在一条长凳上，一条腿还套在应急真空服里，另一条腿浸在一摊正在扩大的血泊中。

那颗流弹在打中 Macario 之前，先在一块廉价隔板上钻了个洞，隔板上印着某家设备制造商的标志。

entries.en:
Somehow it does not feel like either righteous justice or cold revenge. He's simply dead.

Judging from the wound, the round was probably from one of his own ill-trained recruits. They'd have been the nucleus of yet another apocalyptic cult forming on the rough hinterlands of the Sector.

The discharge alarms go quiet, leaving only the soft hiss of atmo-leakage where the foam didn't quite seal.
entries.zh:
说不清为什么，这既不像正义的裁决，也不像冷酷的复仇。他只是死了。

从伤口看，那一枪多半出自他自己训练不精的某个新信徒之手。这帮人本来会成为又一场末世教派的核心，在星域荒僻的边缘地带生根。

枪击警报静了下来，只剩泡沫没能封严处漏气的轻微嘶声。

entries.en:
Somehow it feels too small, too mundane, too pathetic for the justice demanded by the Blood of Andrada. He's simply dead.

Judging from the wound, the round was probably from one of his own ill-trained recruits. They'd have been the nucleus of yet another apocalyptic cult forming on the rough hinterlands of the Sector.

The discharge alarms go quiet, leaving only the soft hiss of atmo-leakage where the foam didn't quite seal.
entries.zh:
不知怎的，这太轻、太寻常、太可悲，配不上 Andrada 血脉所要求的正义。他只是死了。

从伤口看，那一枪多半出自他自己训练不精的某个新信徒之手。这帮人本来会成为又一场末世教派的核心，在星域荒僻的边缘地带生根。

枪击警报静了下来，只剩泡沫没能封严处漏气的轻微嘶声。

entries.en:
