K-O Jove appears beside you, makes a philosophical expression, then draws a syringe and jabs it into Macario's thigh. He pulls a full vial of blood, then replaces the syringe in a case that snaps authoritatively shut. Silver-eyes takes the case and places it in a shielded satchel.

He flips the body over, and it falls to the ground, arm stuck at an unnatural angle.

You see Macario's face now, slack. Still surprised.

Jove positions his TriPad carefully for a scan.
entries.zh:
K-O Jove 出现在你身旁，摆出一副哲人神情，然后抽出一支注射器，扎进 Macario 的大腿。他抽满一管血，把注射器收回盒子，盒盖咔地一声利落合上。Silver-eyes 接过盒子，放进一只屏蔽挎包。

他把尸体翻了个面，尸体滑落到地上，一条手臂折在不自然的角度。

这下你看清了 Macario 的脸，松垮着。仍然带着惊讶。

Jove 仔细摆好 TriPad，进行扫描。

entries.en:
He steps back, checking his work.

"Okay... yes, that's confirmation." A flash of teeth.

"Caught holo of the whole op, got some good angles from my freelancers." He looks at you, proud of a job well done. "You'll get a copy."
entries.zh:
他退开一步，查看自己的成果。

"好...对，这就是确认了。"他露出一口白牙。

"整场行动的全息影像都拍下来了，我那几个自由人还抢到几个好机位。\"他看着你，为活儿干得漂亮而自得。\"会给你一份。"

o.zh: 你准备得可真够周全的。

o.en: Are you... trying to take credit?
o.zh: 你是想...把这功劳揽到自己头上？

entries.en: "Oh captain, my captain," he says, meeting your look. "This is what you hired me for, and I take my work very seriously."
entries.zh: "哦，舰长，我的舰长，\"他迎着你的目光说，\"你雇我来就是干这个的，而我对自己的活儿一向极其认真。"

entries.en: "Oh captain, my captain," he says, meeting your look. "This is what Reynard paid me for, and I take my work very seriously."
entries.zh: "哦，舰长，我的舰长，\"他迎着你的目光说，\"Reynard 付钱让我干的就是这个，而我对自己的活儿一向极其认真。"

entries.en:
"You wound me with the accusation, captain," Jove says with a hint of cold amusement.

"It is you, captain, it is you who are the primary mover in this story! All will know. And you were its patron, besides," he says, holding one hand to his chest.

"It is my intention to give all due acknowledgement to your initiative and," his an ironic smirk asserts itself, "heroism."
entries.zh:
"这指控可伤到我了，舰长，"Jove 说，语气里带着一丝冷嘲。

"主角是你，舰长，这故事里真正推动一切的人是你！所有人都会知道。再说，你还是这出戏的赞助人，"他一手按在胸口。

"我打算把你的主动进取，以及——"他脸上浮起一丝挖苦的笑意，"——你的英雄气概，都如实归到你名下。"

entries.en:
"Me?"

Jove lowers his head humbly for a moment.

"I will not mind being known as the man who found the Spider of Sindria," he says with a decidedly not-humble wink. "It's been the best opportunity to make my own name that I've ever had - and I have you to thank for paying me to do it."
entries.zh:
"我？"

Jove 谦卑地低了低头。

"被人称作找到辛达瑞亚的蜘蛛的那个人，我倒不介意，\"他眨了眨眼，那神情一点也不谦卑。\"这是我扬名立万的最好机会——而且多亏你出钱让我来干。"

entries.en:
"You wound me with the accusation, captain," Jove says with a hint of cold amusement.

"It is you, captain, it is you who are the primary mover of this story! All will know. Even if Reynard was its patron," he says, holding one hand to his chest.

"It is my intention to give all due acknowledgement to your initiative and," his an ironic smirk asserts itself, "heroism."
entries.zh:
"这指控可伤到我了，舰长，"Jove 说，语气里带着一丝冷嘲。

"主角是你，舰长，这故事里真正推动一切的人是你！所有人都会知道。就算这出戏的赞助人是 Reynard，"他一手按在胸口。

"我打算把你的主动进取，以及——"他脸上浮起一丝挖苦的笑意，"——你的英雄气概，都如实归到你名下。"

entries.en: He holds up a finger. "And credits."
entries.zh: 他竖起一根手指。"还有星币。"

entries.en: "And I to get paid," he says.
entries.zh: "我也该拿到我的钱，"他说。

entries.en: "And I to get paid," he says. "100,000 credits more, captain. Don't forget."
entries.zh: "我也该拿到我的钱，\"他说。\"还差十万星币，舰长。别忘了。"

entries.en: His smile is positively glowing.
entries.zh: 他的笑容简直在发光。

entries.en:
"Don't trouble yourself, captain," Jove says, walking away. "I've my own ride home."

His 'freelancers' fall in behind, weapons brandished, their humble Luddic affects dropping away like shields after a fleet action all-clear.

A blowout response team has arrived, followed by an out-of-breath MuniSec section-lead. All officiously refuse to acknowledge the heavily armed gang that interrupted a Luddic congregation.

K-O Jove gives them a little salute as he passes.
entries.zh:
"不劳你费心，舰长，\"Jove 转身走开，\"我自己有回家的船。"

他那些'自由人'提着武器跟在后头，那副谦卑的卢德派派头像舰队战解除警报后的护盾一样褪了下去。

一支应急堵漏队赶到了，后面跟着个气喘吁吁的 MuniSec 组长。所有人都公事公办地拒绝承认有这么一伙全副武装的匪徒打断过卢德派的集会。

K-O Jove 路过时朝他们略一敬礼。

entries.en:
You return to your shuttle, leaving behind this cold, sad place.

The Spider of Sindria is dead.

Caught in some numbered outpost on the back-face of Ilm, a place no one calls home, witnessed by a few wide-eyed Luddics, half of whom are going to end up as chem burnouts once the mines have no more use for them.

And in a few cycles, the outpost will be gone too, its modules lifted and moved to a more optimal position determined by the company's planning algorithms.

Forgotten.
entries.zh:
你回到穿梭机上，把这片阴冷、凄惨的地方留在身后。

辛达瑞亚的蜘蛛死了。

死在 Ilm 背面某座编号前哨站里，一个没人称作家的地方，目击者只有几个瞪大眼睛的卢德派信徒——其中一半人，等矿上不再需要他们，迟早会变成被化学品烧空的废人。

再过几个星历年，这座前哨站也会消失：它的模块会被整体吊起，搬到公司规划算法算出的更优位置。

被遗忘。

o.zh: 你准备得可真够周全的。

o.en: Are you... trying to take credit for Macario's death?
o.zh: 你是想...把 Macario 的死算作自己的功劳？

o.en: Why the blood sample and scan?
o.zh: 为什么要采血样、做扫描？

o.en: So you did this, all of this, for self-promotion?
o.zh: 所以这一整套，全是为了给自己贴金？

o.en: Well I'm glad to help out.

entries.en:
Macario's dead eyes stare up blankly from the floor, without judgement.

You both ignore them.
entries.zh:
Macario 那双死眼从地板上茫然地向上睁着，毫无评判。

你们俩都当作没看见。

entries.en:
He stands, stretches, and adjusts his jacket.

"We go to the surface. A remote extraction outpost. 'He' has a few followers who are definitely armed, though lightly. And I have a handful of freelancers already in place to handle most of, well, that."

"Depending on the outcome you desire," he half-shrugs, "you may wish to arm yourself."
entries.zh:
他站起身，伸了个懒腰，整了整外套。

"我们下到地表。一处偏远的采掘前哨。'他'有几个追随者，肯定带着武器，不过装备很轻。我这边已经安插了几个自由佣兵，那种事——嗯，大部分他们能处理。"

"取决于你想要什么样的结果，\"他半耸了下肩，\"你也许该给自己弄点装备。"

o.en: Call your armorer to the shuttle bay
o.zh: 叫你的军械员到穿梭机库

o.en: What should I be ready for?
Board the shuttle with Jove and your bodyguards
o.zh: 与 Jove 和你的卫兵一同登机

entries.en:
Your armorer is waiting for you, their immaculate metal cases already laid out for your inspection, along with your most combat-experienced bodyguards already donning various combinations of stealth-suit and plausibly local garb, checking weapons, assembling gear.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." Your armorer greets you with a formal nod. "The usual? Or we have a selection of less-lethal devices intended to disable a target..."

Jove invites himself over to admire the contents of the cases, hands politely held behind his back.
entries.zh:
你的军械员已等在那里，那些一尘不染的金属箱已经摆开任你检视；你最有实战经验的几名卫兵正在套上隐身服与看着像本地人的衣物，检查武器，整理装备。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。\"你的军械员郑重地点头致意，\"还是老一套？或者我们这儿也有几款低致命性的装置，专门用来制服目标..."

Jove 不请自来地凑过来欣赏箱子里的东西，双手礼貌地背在身后。

o.en: I need nothing special. This is all for the security team.
o.zh: 我不需要什么特别的。这些都是给安保队的。

entries.en:
Your armorer nods, pointedly closing the case that Jove was examining, then bringing a different one forward.

Stun pistol, multimode: sonic pulse, charged particle beam thunderclap, even a contact-anesthesic shot launcher.

You secure it in a discrete holster. You always have your usual sidearm, of course, in case the situation calls for it.
entries.zh:
军械员点点头，刻意合上 Jove 正在打量那只箱子，又拿了另一只过来。

多模式电击手枪：声波脉冲、带电粒子束式的雷鸣一击，甚至还有接触式麻醉弹发射器。

你把它收进一个不显眼的枪套。当然，你身上始终带着那把惯用的随身武器，以备不时之需。

entries.en:
Your armorer nods, pointedly closing the case that Jove was examining.

You already wear your standard sidearm, but also know that your best weapon is your clarity of purpose and leadership over your bodyguards and Jove's freelancers.
entries.zh:
军械员点点头，刻意合上了 Jove 正在打量的那只箱子。

你身上已经佩着惯用的随身武器，但你也清楚，你最好的武器是清晰的目标感，以及对卫兵和 Jove 那些自由佣兵的统御。

entries.en: Your armorer nods, pointedly closing the case that Jove was examining, then bringing a different one forward.
entries.zh: 军械员点点头，刻意合上 Jove 正在打量那只箱子，又拿了另一只过来。

entries.en:
Your armorer nods, pointedly closing the case that Jove was examining.

The only weapon you need is your body and mind joined together with clarity of purpose and deadly precision.
entries.zh:
军械员点点头，刻意合上了 Jove 正在打量的那只箱子。

你唯一需要的武器，是身心合一、目标清明、出手致命。

entries.en:
"Light handhelds, civie stuff," Jove says casually. "There'll be nothing your inestimable bodyguards can't handle. My people on the ground will ensure 'he' is... vulnerable."

He considers for a moment. "I do believe that Macario makes a habit of carrying a pistol." He grins. "I suppose you know that- Yes, I've heard the story, no need to repeat it."
entries.zh:
"轻型单兵武器，民用的东西，"Jove 漫不经心地说，"没什么是你那几位了不得的卫兵应付不了的。我在地面上的人会确保'他'...不堪一击。"

他沉吟片刻。"我确实相信，Macario 有随身带枪的习惯。"他咧嘴一笑，"我猜你早就知道——是，那件事我听说过，不必再讲一遍。"

entries.en:
"Like I said, somewhere remote." He smirks.

"I'll direct the shuttle as we descend. I've an arrangement with traffic control so we'll be logged as a routine supply run. One of my people has left a transponder with a pre-agreed code. "

He taps the side of his forehead. "And the code is in here. Seems in the spirit with, you know, all the Luddies around."
entries.zh:
"就像我说的，偏远的地方。"他得意地一笑。

"下降的时候我来给穿梭机指路。我跟空管那边有安排，我们会被记成一次例行补给飞行。我的人已经在那儿放了一台应答器，带着事先约定好的识别码。"

他敲了敲自己的太阳穴。"识别码在这儿。周围尽是卢德信徒，这样也算入乡随俗。"

entries.en:
* * *

The sphere of Ilm grows below you, like your shuttle is plummeting into a vast cold abyss.

Jove is up front, given a robust salvors' comms-nav unit. He finds his informant's beacon and begins giving instructions to the pilot.
entries.zh:
* * *

Ilm 的球体在下方渐渐变大，仿佛你的穿梭机正坠入一片辽阔而寒冷的深渊。

Jove 坐在前排，手里是一台结实的打捞者通讯导航仪。他找到线人的信标，开始给驾驶员下指令。

entries.en: You secure a clutch of small plastic grenades inside your coat. They are difficult to detect, concealable in the palm of your hand, and somehow perfectly weight to throw short to medium distances.
entries.zh: 你把一小把塑料手雷收进外套里。它们极难被探测到，正好能藏在掌心，而且重量配得恰到好处，适合中近距离投掷。

entries.en: You slip the vicious ceramic vibroknife into its concealed sheath. You can make it appear in your hand in a flash, and when activated, the edge becomes a subtle blur eager to delimb your enemies, even through light armor.
entries.zh: 你把那把凶悍的陶瓷振动刀插进隐蔽的刀鞘。它能在刹那间出现在你手中；一经启动，刃口便化作一道细微的残影，急着要把敌人的肢体连同轻甲一并卸下。

entries.en:
You inspect the small matte-black polycarbonate pistol. Difficult to detect, low profile, deadly at short range, and fully loaded.

It fits perfectly into a concealed holster.
entries.zh:
你检视着那把哑光黑的聚碳酸酯小手枪。难被探测，外形低矮，近距离致命，弹匣满载。

它严丝合缝地滑进一个隐蔽的枪套。

entries.en:
You secure the spray-poison device inside your cuff and ensure the safety is activated.

Simply hold your breath and flick your wrist- everything breathing within several meters will fall down dead (or merely unconscious, it is your choice). The poison denatures itself within seconds so that you may safely draw your next breath as your enemies lie senseless around you.
entries.zh:
你把喷毒装置固定在袖口内侧，确认保险已经扣上。

只要屏住呼吸，抖一下手腕——数米之内所有还在呼吸的东西都会倒下毙命 (或者只是昏迷，随你选)。毒剂会在几秒内自行分解，于是当敌人横七竖八地倒在你周围时，你可以安然吸下一口气。

entries.en: You secure the sword of an officer to your belt and feel the weight of thousands of cycles of tradition in the fine steel-alloy.
entries.zh: 你把一柄军官佩剑挂在腰间，从那精良的钢合金里感到数千星历年传统的分量。

entries.en: As subtle as it is merciless, a simple false fingertip that, adjusted just so, unspools with a small weight at the killing end, either to be held or swung with the effect of some highly evolved relation of madame guillotine.
entries.zh: 它既隐蔽又无情：一枚简单的假指尖，略作调整便会放出细线，末端坠着一小块重物，可以握持，也可以甩动——其效果，像是断头台夫人某种高度进化的远亲。

entries.en:
His amusement, if anything, grows.

"Help." Jove puts a finger to his lips. "Perhaps."

"I did note a distinct lack of mention of the Spider of Sindria from the Askonia Committee for whatever-and-all-else." He raises an eyebrow.

"Made me think, what would $playerName do?"
entries.zh:
他的笑意反倒更浓了。

"帮忙。\"Jove 把一根手指按在唇上。\"也许吧。"

"我确实注意到，Askonia 那个【别的什么都管】委员会，对辛达瑞亚的蜘蛛只字未提。"他挑起一边眉毛。

"让我不由得想：换成 $playerName 会怎么做？"

o.en: So how much will it cost?

entries.en: "Help." Jove puts a finger to his lips. "Perhaps."
entries.zh: "帮忙。\"Jove 把一根手指按在唇上。\"也许吧。"

entries.en:
His amusement, if anything, grows.

"Help." Jove puts a finger to his lips. "Perhaps."

"You quite assertively rejected my offer of assistance upon our previous contact." He gives you an odd look, almost hostile. "But no matter," his tone lightens. "I am terribly forgiving and open-minded, did you know that, captain? It's all business to me."

"Well." Jove gives you an indulgent look. "Maybe not all business. I do so love a good mystery. And the disappearance of Dolos Macario..."
entries.zh:
他的笑意反倒更浓了。

"帮忙。\"Jove 把一根手指按在唇上。\"也许吧。"

"上次见面，你可是相当坚决地拒绝了我的协助提议。"他古怪地看了你一眼，几乎带着敌意。"不过没关系，"他的语气轻快起来，"我这人特别宽宏大量、心胸开阔，你知道吗，舰长？对我来说，全是生意。"

"好吧。\"Jove 纵容地看你一眼。\"也许不全是生意。我实在太喜欢一桩好谜案了。而 Dolos Macario 的失踪..."

entries.en:
His amusement, if anything, grows.

"Reynard." Jove puts a finger to his lips. "Yes, there is an arrangement. I shudder to think of all that you did to 'earn' such favor."
entries.zh:
他的笑意反倒更浓了。

"Reynard。\"Jove 把一根手指按在唇上。\"是，确实有个安排。想到你为了'挣来'这份人情都干了些什么，我就不寒而栗。"

entries.en: He rubs his hands together, though thoughtfully. You suspect that's a good sign.
entries.zh: 他搓着双手，不过带着思量的意味。你觉得这是个好兆头。

o.en: I wish to deal with Dolos... personally.
o.zh: Dolos 的事...我想亲自了结。

o.en: He must answer to the people of the Sector for his crimes.
o.zh: 他必须为自己的罪行向星域的人民作答。

o.en: He must answer to the true heir of Andrada for his treason!
o.zh: 他必须为自己的叛国罪向 Andrada 真正的继承人作答！

o.en: He must answer to the new Supreme Executor for his crimes.
o.zh: 他必须为自己的罪行向新任最高元首作答。

o.en: It doesn't matter why. He must be stopped.
o.zh: 理由不重要。必须拦住他。

entries.en:
"I'll require a fee, a retainer, of 80,000 credits immediately then 80,000 credits upon 'delivery' of the target."

"It'll take time. But I'll know how to contact you." He smiles carnivorously. "It's what I do."

"Deal?" His eyes are bright. Keen, even.
entries.zh:
"我要收一笔费用，也就是定金：80,000 星币，立刻支付；目标'交付'之后，再付 80,000 星币。"

"这需要时间。不过我知道该怎么联系你。\"他露出掠食者般的笑容，\"这是我的本行。"

"成交？"他两眼发亮，甚至称得上锐利。

o.en: Perhaps we can negotiate the amount?
o.zh: 也许我们可以谈谈价钱？

entries.en:
"Beautiful," he says. "I'll find your spider, captain."

He picks up a TriPad, presses a finger to it and begins flicking the interface around, then halts. Looks up.

"I shall contact you as the situation... develops. In the meantime, may I presume that is all?"
entries.zh:
"漂亮，\"他说，\"我会替你找到那只蜘蛛，舰长。"

他拿起一台 TriPad，把手指按上去，开始划弄界面，随后停住，抬起头。

"等局势...有了进展，我会联系你。在那之前，我想就这些了？"

entries.en:
"Beautiful," he says. "I'll find your spider, captain. You just need to send him running."

He picks up a TriPad, presses a finger to it and begins flicking the interface around, then halts. Looks up.

"In the meantime, may I presume that is all?"
entries.zh:
"漂亮，\"他说，\"我会替你找到那只蜘蛛，舰长。你只需要把他惊动起来。"

他拿起一台 TriPad，把手指按上去，开始划弄界面，随后停住，抬起头。

"在那之前，我想就这些了？"

entries.en:
"Happily, I have been paid my retainer as well as a generous bonus," he says. "With double that on delivery. I'll find your spider, captain, if that's what pleases the Prime Demarchon."

He picks up a TriPad, presses a finger to it and begins flicking the interface around, then halts. Looks up.

"May I presume that is all? These things take time."
entries.zh:
"很乐意，定金已经到手，还外加一笔慷慨的奖金，\"他说，\"交付时还有双倍。我会替你找到那只蜘蛛，舰长——只要这能让大统领满意。"

他拿起一台 TriPad，把手指按上去，开始划弄界面，随后停住，抬起头。

"我想就这些了？这种事急不得。"

entries.en:
"As before, if you wish for me to find out where Dolos Macario has snuck himself away to, I'll require a retainer of 80,000 credits immediately and 80,000 credits upon final delivery."

He smiles, teeth flashing. "Do we have a deal?"
entries.zh:
"和之前一样，你要我去查 Dolos Macario 溜到哪儿藏了起来，我就得先收一笔定金：80,000 星币，立刻支付；最终交付时再付 80,000 星币。"

他一笑，露出白牙。"成交吗？"

entries.en:
"As before I'll require a retainer of 80,000 credits immediately and 80,000 credits upon final delivery. You, or your proxies, must unseat Dolos Macario from the office of Chief High Inspector-General. Once that is done, I will find where he runs and deliver him to you."

He smiles, teeth flashing. "Do we have a deal?"
entries.zh:
"和之前一样，定金 80,000 星币立刻支付，最终交付时再付 80,000 星币。你或者你的代理人，必须把 Dolos Macario 从首席总监察长的位子上赶下来。等这事办成，我就去查他逃到哪儿，再把他交到你手上。"

他一笑，露出白牙。"成交吗？"

entries.en:
"I'll require a fee, a retainer, of 80,000 credits immediately then 80,000 credits upon 'delivery' of the target. And you, or your proxies, must unseat Dolos Macario from the office of Chief High Inspector-General. Once that is done, I will do my part to find what hole he scurries off to hide in."

"It'll take time. But I'll know how to contact you." He smiles carnivorously. "It's what I do."

"Deal?" His eyes are bright. Keen, even.
entries.zh:
"我要收一笔费用，也就是定金：80,000 星币，立刻支付；目标'交付'之后，再付 80,000 星币。另外，你或者你的代理人，必须把 Dolos Macario 从首席总监察长的位子上赶下来。等这件事办完，我再来尽我的本分，找出他钻进了哪个洞里躲着。"

"这需要时间。不过我知道该怎么联系你。\"他露出掠食者般的笑容，\"这是我的本行。"

"成交？"他两眼发亮，甚至称得上锐利。

o.en: Perhaps we can negotiate the amount?
o.zh: 也许我们可以谈谈价钱？

entries.en: "That would be profoundly uninteresting to me," he says, his smile growing thinner.
entries.zh: "那对我来说就极其无趣了，"他说着，笑意淡了几分。

entries.en:
"Personally." His eyebrows raise. "I understand, captain."

"Personally," his smile grows, "I am interested in your credits. And I must admit there is some draw to an... interesting challenge."
entries.zh:
"亲自。\"他挑起眉毛。\"我明白，舰长。"

"就我个人而言，\"他的笑容加深，\"我感兴趣的是你的星币。而且我得承认，一项...有趣的挑战，确实有点吸引力。"

o.en: How interesting? In credits, I mean.
o.zh: 有多有趣？我是说，值多少星币。

entries.en:
"Personally." His eyebrows raise. "I understand, captain."

"Personally," his smile grows, "I am interested in Reynard's credits. And I must admit there is some draw to an... interesting problem."
entries.zh:
"为了私怨。\"他挑起眉毛，\"我明白，舰长。"

"为了私怨，\"他的笑意深了，\"那我就对 Reynard 的星币感兴趣了。而且我得承认，一个...有意思的难题，确实挺吸引我。"

entries.en:
"His crimes?" His eyebrows raise skeptically. "Okay."

"Truly, I'm not concerned with whatever justice you imagine this will serve. But your credits, those are of interest. And," he sighs, "I must admit there is some draw to an... interesting challenge."
entries.zh:
"他的罪行？\"他怀疑地挑起眉毛。\"行吧。"

"说实话，我不在乎你想让这事成全什么样的正义。但你的星币，那个我有兴趣。而且，\"他叹了口气，\"我得承认，一项...有趣的挑战，确实有点吸引力。"

o.en: How interesting? In terms of credits, that is.
o.zh: 有多有趣？我是说，按星币算。

entries.en:
"His crimes?" His eyebrows raise skeptically. "Okay."

"Truly, I'm not concerned with whatever justice you imagine this will serve. But Reynard's credits, those are of interest. And," he sighs, "I must admit there is some draw to an... interesting problem."
entries.zh:
"他的罪行？\"他怀疑地挑起眉毛，\"行吧。"

"说真的，你想借这事伸张什么正义，我一点也不关心。我感兴趣的是 Reynard 的星币。再说，\"他叹了口气，\"我得承认，一个...有意思的难题，确实挺吸引我。"

entries.en:
"True heir?" His eyebrows raise skeptically. "Okay."

"I'm not concerned with your political alignment. But your credits? Those are of interest. And," he sighs, "I must admit there is some draw to an... interesting challenge."
entries.zh:
"真正的继承人？\"他怀疑地挑起眉毛。\"行吧。"

"我不在乎你的政治立场。但你的星币？那个我有兴趣。而且，\"他叹了口气，\"我得承认，一项...有趣的挑战，确实有点吸引力。"

o.en: How interesting? In credits, I mean.
o.zh: 有多有趣？我是说，值多少星币。

entries.en:
"True heir?" His eyebrows raise skeptically. "Hector?"

Jove appears about to speak further, but instead catches himself and touches his lips with both hands to demonstrate that he is withholding comment.

"I leave your motivation to your own concern. But your credits? Those are of interest. And," he sighs, "I must admit there is some draw to an interesting challenge."
entries.zh:
"真正的继承人？\"他怀疑地挑起眉毛。\"Hector？"

Jove 似乎还想说下去，却及时收住，用双手碰了碰嘴唇，表示自己忍住不评论。

"你的动机，你自己操心就好。但你的星币？那个我有兴趣。而且，\"他叹了口气，\"我得承认，一项有趣的挑战，确实有点吸引力。"

o.en: How interesting? In credits, I mean.
o.zh: 有多有趣？我是说，值多少星币。

entries.en:
"True heir?" His eyebrows raise skeptically. "Okay."

"Truly, I'm not concerned with your political alignment. But Reynard's credits? Those are of interest. And," he sighs, "I must admit there is some draw to an... interesting problem."
entries.zh:
"正统继承人？\"他怀疑地挑起眉毛，\"行吧。"

"说真的，你的政治立场如何，我一点也不关心。不过 Reynard 的星币？那才叫人感兴趣。再说，\"他叹了口气，\"我得承认，一个...有意思的难题，确实挺吸引我。"

entries.en:
"The Supreme Executor?" His eyebrows raise skeptically. "Okay."

"Truly, I'm not concerned with your political alignment - but your credits, those are of interest. And," he sighs, "I must admit there is some draw to an... interesting challenge."
entries.zh:
"最高元首？\"他怀疑地挑起眉毛，\"行吧。"

"说真的，你的政治立场如何，我一点也不关心——我感兴趣的是你的星币。再说，\"他叹了口气，\"我得承认，一个...有意思的挑战，对我总有些吸引力。"

o.en: How interesting? In credits, I mean.
o.zh: 有多有趣？我是说，值多少星币。

entries.en:
"The Supreme Executor?" His eyebrows raise skeptically. "Okay."

"Truly, I'm not concerned with your political alignment - but Reynard's credits, those are of interest. And," he sighs, "I must admit there is some draw to an... interesting problem."
entries.zh:
"最高元首？\"他怀疑地挑起眉毛，\"行吧。"

"说真的，你的政治立场如何，我一点也不关心——我感兴趣的是 Reynard 的星币。再说，\"他叹了口气，\"我得承认，一个...有意思的难题，确实挺吸引我。"

entries.en:
"It doesn't matter?" His eyebrows raise skeptically. "Okay."

"Insatiable curiosity aside, I'm not concerned with your reason or purported lack thereof. But your credits, those are very much of interest."

"Besides," he sighs, "I admit there is the intrinsic draw to an... interesting challenge."
entries.zh:
"无关紧要？\"他怀疑地挑起眉毛，\"行吧。"

"撇开我这点贪得无厌的好奇心不谈，你的理由，或者你声称没有理由，我都不关心。可你的星币就大不一样了，我非常感兴趣。"

"再说，\"他叹了口气，\"我得承认，一个...有意思的挑战，本身就有种吸引力。"

o.en: How interesting? In terms of credits, that is.
o.zh: 有多有趣？我是说，按星币算。

entries.en:
"It doesn't matter?" His eyebrows raise skeptically. "Okay."

"Insatiable curiosity aside, I'm not concerned with your reason or purported lack thereof. But Reynard's credits, those are very much of interest."

"Besides," he sighs, "I admit there is the intrinsic draw to an... interesting problem."
entries.zh:
"无关紧要？\"他怀疑地挑起眉毛，\"行吧。"

"撇开我这点贪得无厌的好奇心不谈，你的理由，或者你声称没有理由，我都不关心。Reynard 的星币就大不一样了，我非常感兴趣。"

"再说，\"他叹了口气，\"我得承认，一个...有意思的难题，本身就有种吸引力。"

entries.en:
"Yes, Eventide!" Jove says, growing animated.

"A successful operation. You played your part," he catches himself, lowers his expression a valence. "Sufficiently."
entries.zh:
"对，Eventide！"Jove 来了精神。

"一次成功的行动。你尽到了你的本分，\"他话锋一顿，神色收敛了几分，\"算是尽到了。"

entries.en:
He quickly rattles off his counterpoints, "This is cheaper, more elegant, less conspicuous.

"And," he pauses for emphasis, "It's more fun."

"Let me work my way, captain, and I'll let you work yours. If you prefer to satbomb half the Persean Sector in the hopes of accidentally knocking off Macario along with millions of bystanders, that's your prerogative."

A pause.

"But please don't, come to think of it. I do prefer the comforts of civilization."
entries.zh:
他飞快地一口气列出理由："这样更便宜、更漂亮，也更不惹眼。"

"而且，"他顿了顿，以示强调，"还更有意思。"

"让我按我的方式来，舰长，我也让你按你的方式来。你要是宁愿把半个英仙座星域犁成焦土，指望顺手把 Macario 和几百万闲人一起送走，那是你的自由。"

一阵沉默。

"不过话说回来，还是别这么干。我到底还是喜欢文明世界的舒适。"

entries.en:
"Of course! Why do you think it keeps going so well?"

He leans closer, "You are one piece of many. Your role is to be loud, unsubtle. A blundering..." he pauses, and smiles. "An... underestimated force."

Jove seems satisfied with his tact.

"Patience, dear captain. You'll have your prize."
entries.zh:
"当然有！不然你以为事情怎么一直办得这么顺？"

他凑近了些："你只是众多棋子中的一枚。你的角色就是吵闹、张扬。一支横冲直撞的..."他顿住，笑了，"一支...被人低估的力量。"

Jove 似乎对自己这份机巧颇为满意。

"耐心点，亲爱的舰长。你的战利品跑不了。"

entries.en: "Soon," he says in a tone that seems to suggest he feels he's given you the answer your question deserves.
entries.zh: "快了。"他的语气像是在说，这个答复已经对得起你的问题了。

entries.en: "About time," he says, leaning back and putting his hands behind his head. "There's so much to do."
entries.zh: "早该如此，\"他向后一靠，双手枕在脑后，\"还有那么多事要办。"

o.en: You keep finding then losing Macario. Why not use overwhelming force?
o.zh: 你一次次找到 Macario，又一次次让他溜掉。为什么不动用压倒性的力量？

o.en: You keep throwing me at random planets. Don't you have your own agents?
o.zh: 你老是把我往莫名其妙的星球上扔。你自己就没有手下吗？

o.en: When are you going to deliver Macario?
o.zh: 你到底什么时候才把 Macario 交出来？

o.en: I'll let you get back to work.

entries.en:
"Yes, Eventide!" Jove says, growing animated. "I'll never understand what compels you to tell inconvenient truths in situations that call for, for," he rubs his fingers together, his expression pained.

"Perhaps you would appreciate if I described it as 'tactical flexibility'? You don't transmit your battle plans to your enemy, do you?"

A look of concern grows. "Do you?"
entries.zh:
"对，Eventide！"Jove 来了精神，"我永远弄不明白，是什么让你非要在那种需要——需要——的场合，讲那些不合时宜的实话，"他搓着手指，表情像是牙疼。

"要是我把这称作'战术灵活性'，你也许就能接受了？你总不会把作战计划直接发给敌人吧？"

他脸上的担忧浓了起来。"你会吗？"

o.en: It felt like the right thing to do. I don't overthink things.
o.zh: 我觉得那样做是对的。我不爱多想。

o.en: I don't lie to traffic control. It's dangerous.
o.zh: 我不对交通管制撒谎。那很危险。

o.en: It is immoral to knowingly tell a lie.
o.zh: 明知是谎话还去说，是不道德的。

o.en: Let's focus on catching Macario, shall we?
o.zh: 还是专心抓 Macario 吧，好吗？

entries.en:
He frowns.

"A gentle suggestion, $playerSirOrMadam, if I may. Figure out what you want then act accordingly."
entries.zh:
他皱起眉。

"容我提个温和的建议，$playerSirOrMadam。先想清楚自己要什么，再照着去做。"

entries.en:
He bows his head. You hear a sigh.

"Alright." He lifts his head, expression re-set.
entries.zh:
他低下头。你听见一声叹息。

"好吧。"他抬起头，神情重新归位。

entries.en:
He frowns.

"Sometimes you concern me, $playerLastName."
entries.zh:
他皱起眉。

"有时候你真让我担心，$playerLastName。"

entries.en: He nods with a concessionary expression.
entries.zh: 他点点头，神色里带着几分让步。

entries.en: "Let us focus on results. That's what you're here for, after all."
entries.zh: "我们只看结果。毕竟你到这儿来，就是为了这个。"

entries.en:
"That." He puts his hands together. "Yes, well done."

"Evidently Macario had high-value commodities stashed on Salamanca which he was attempting to liquidate, and quickly, when your appearance in-system triggered his early alert system."
entries.zh:
"就是这个。\"他双手一合，\"对，干得漂亮。"

"显然，Macario 在 Salamanca 囤了一批高价货物，正急着脱手；你的舰队一进星系，就触动了他那套提前预警的系统。"

o.en: If you knew where he was, couldn't you just... tell the authorities?
o.zh: 你既然知道他在哪儿，就不能...通知当局吗？

o.en: Did it really have to be me that went there?
o.zh: 非得是我去那儿不可吗？

entries.en:
"The 'authorities' were paid off by 'Maximo'. Besides, I'm to deliver Macario to you, not to 'the authorities'."

"And before you suggest it, no, they would not have believed some random tip-off that this 'Maximo' was Dolos Macario anyway."

He shrugs. "This was simpler."
entries.zh:
"'当局'早被'Maximo'买通了。再说，我是要把 Macario 交给你，不是交给'当局'。"

"在你开口之前先说明白：不会的。他们根本不会相信一封来路不明的密报，说这个'Maximo'就是 Dolos Macario。"

他耸耸肩。"这样更省事。"

o.en: You've got a reputation. Wouldn't they believe a tip-off from K-O Jove?
o.zh: 你名声在外。K-O Jove 递的密报，他们会不信？

o.en: Did it really have to be me that went there?
o.zh: 非得是我去那儿不可吗？

entries.en:
"Possibly not," he says with a shrug. "But I guessed that he would react more decisively to your presence. The response confirms certain of my speculations regarding his tactics, his character, and of the means he employs."

"Furthemore, he was forced to abandon a significant source of credits, and this restricts his operational flexibility."

"All in all," Jove puts his hands behind his head, "It's been a very productive first step."
entries.zh:
"也许真不信，\"他耸耸肩，\"但我猜，他对你的出现会反应得更果断。他的反应证实了我对他战术、性格以及所用手段的某些推测。"

"而且，他被迫放弃了一笔可观的星币来源，这就限制了他行动上的余地。"

"总而言之，\"Jove 双手枕在脑后，\"这第一步走得很有成效。"

o.en: I'd like to be fully informed the next time you pull a stunt like this.
o.zh: 下次你再玩这种花样，我要事先知道全部内情。

entries.en:
"Ah," his eyes shift. "No."

"The authorities of Salamanca hold an unhappy prejudice against my abilities. It's, it's..." he waves away the line of inquiry, "Old news. And of no great import to matters at hand."

"What's important is that Macario's response confirms certain elements of my evaluation of his character, tactics, and resources. And to that last point," now Jove looks very pleased with himself, "He was forced to abandon a significant stockpile of high-value commodities without making a sale, and this restricts his future operational flexibility."

"All in all," he puts his hands behind his head, "It's been a very productive first step."
entries.zh:
"啊，\"他眼神飘了一下，\"不行。"

"Salamanca 的当局对我的本事抱有一种不太愉快的偏见。那是，那是...\"他摆摆手，把这条追问打发掉，\"旧账了。跟眼前的事没多大干系。"

"重要的是，Macario 的反应证实了我对他性格、战术和资源的某些判断。说到最后一点，\"Jove 此刻显得颇为自得，\"他被迫丢下一大批高价货物，一件都没能卖出去，这限制了他日后的行动余地。"

"总而言之，\"他双手枕在脑后，\"这第一步走得很有成效。"

o.en: I'd like to be fully informed the next time you pull a stunt like this.
o.zh: 下次你再玩这种花样，我要事先知道全部内情。

entries.en:
"I'll contact you when a new opportunity presents itself."

Jove picks up a TriPad and starts poking at it. He looks up, "Until then?"
entries.zh:
"等有新的机会，我会联系你。"

Jove 拿起一台 TriPad，戳了几下，抬头道："在那之前，就这样？"

entries.en:
"Okay," he concedes, raising his hands. "You'll be informed. I'll contact you when a new opportunity presents itself."

Jove picks up a TriPad and starts poking at it. He looks up, "Until then?"
entries.zh:
"好，\"他举起双手让步，\"会让你知道的。等有新的机会，我会联系你。"

Jove 拿起一台 TriPad，戳了几下，抬头道："在那之前，就这样？"

entries.en:
A holo of K-O Jove appears. He doesn't waste time with niceties.

"Go to Salamanca. Spacer bar called Slow Burn Bianka's."

"Ask for Maximo."

The image freezes, message presumably complete.
entries.zh:
K-O Jove 的全息影像浮现出来。他懒得寒暄。

"去 Salamanca。找一家叫 Slow Burn Bianka's 的太空客酒吧。"

"找 Maximo。"

影像定格，这条消息大概就到这里。

entries.en:
A spacer bar is as good as anywhere, though Jove's message was frustratingly abrupt.

But you'll be armed. And well assured that your bodyguards know their craft.
entries.zh:
太空客酒吧并不比别处差，只是 Jove 这条消息简短得让人恼火。

不过你会带上武器，也确信保镖们懂得自己的行当。

entries.en: As your $shipOrFleet trades pings with traffic control, your comms officer calls for your attention. "$PlayerSirOrMadam, the local comms network has a message for you."
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet正与交通管制交换应答信号，通讯军官忽然请你注意。"$PlayerSirOrMadam，本地通讯网络上有你的一条消息。"

entries.en:
The image of K-O Jove appears again. Again, he does not waste time with a greeting. And although this message is clearly sent at the premium rate, he keeps his speech mercifully efficient.

"Eventide this time. Jensulte estate. You're a cousin of Balaram Rahu, come for a social call from Tartessus. Try to act Luddic."

"Balaram Rahu. Remember that." A smirk grows. "Blessed day."

The message freezes, the interface prompting you for input.
entries.zh:
K-O Jove 的影像再次出现。他照旧不浪费时间寒暄。这条消息显然是用最高一档的资费发来的，而他的话倒也还算简洁，叫人感激。

"这次是 Eventide。Jensulte 庄园。你是 Balaram Rahu 的表亲，从 Tartessus 过来走动走动。尽量装得像卢德信徒。"

"Balaram Rahu。记住了。\"他嘴角的笑意渐渐浮起。\"愿这一天蒙福。"

消息定格在最后一帧，界面等着你回应。

entries.en:
The image of K-O Jove appears again. Again, he does not waste time with a greeting. And although this message is clearly sent at the premium rate, he keeps his speech mercifully efficient.

"Eventide. Jensulte estate. You're a cousin of Balaram Rahu, come for a social call from Tartessus. Try to act Luddic."

"Balaram Rahu. Remember that." A smirk, "And so you're fully informed: I think he'll disappear, but this time I'll be watching even more carefully."

"Blessed day, captain," he says.

The message freezes on the final frame. The interface prompts you for input.
entries.zh:
K-O Jove 的影像再次出现。他照旧不浪费时间寒暄。这条消息显然是用最高一档的资费发来的，而他的话倒也还算简洁，叫人感激。

"Eventide。Jensulte 庄园。你是 Balaram Rahu 的表亲，从 Tartessus 过来走动走动。尽量装得像卢德信徒。"

"Balaram Rahu。记住了。\"他一笑，\"另外，让你心里有个底：我猜他会就此消失。不过这一回，我会盯得更紧。"

"愿这一天蒙福，舰长，"他说。

消息定格在最后一帧。界面等着你回应。

entries.en:
Eventide, Samarra system. Jensulte estate. Balaram Rahu.

Act Luddic.

Jove seems unable, or unwilling, to keep things simple.
entries.zh:
Eventide，Samarra 星系。Jensulte 庄园。Balaram Rahu。

装成卢德信徒。

Jove 似乎没法——或者说不愿——把事情办得简单些。

entries.en: As your $shipOrFleet trades pings with traffic control, your comms officer calls for your attention. "$PlayerSirOrMadam, the local comms network has a message for you."
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet正与交通管制交换应答信号，通讯军官忽然请你注意。"$PlayerSirOrMadam，本地通讯网络上有你的一条消息。"

entries.en:
The holo of K-O Jove appears. He doesn't waste any time.

"It's about your 'friend'. Come to Yesod, Zagan system. You've been there before, I know," his image winks. "Spacer bar called 'Orbital Decay'. Order a Burn-home Flip."

"Burn-home flip," he repeats. "Remember that."

The message freezes on the last frame. The interface awaits your command.
entries.zh:
K-O Jove 的全息影像亮起。他一句废话也没有。

"是关于你那位'朋友'。来 Zagan 星系的 Yesod。你以前去过那儿，我知道，\"影像里的他眨了眨眼。\"一家叫'Orbital Decay'的太空佬酒吧。点一杯 Burn-home Flip。"

"Burn-home Flip，\"他又念了一遍。\"记住了。"

消息定格在最后一帧。界面等着你的指令。

entries.en: As your $shipOrFleet trades pings with traffic control, your comms officer calls for your attention. "$PlayerSirOrMadam, the local comms network has a message for you."
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet正与交通管制交换应答信号，通讯军官忽然请你注意。"$PlayerSirOrMadam，本地通讯网络上有你的一条消息。"

entries.en:
Another spacer bar, this time on Yesod.

Maybe it's your imagination, but Jove seemed less flippant than usual in this recording.
entries.zh:
又一家太空佬酒吧，这回在 Yesod。

也许是你的错觉，可在这段录像里，Jove 似乎比平时少了几分轻佻。

o.en: Why did you send me to Salamanca if you knew Macario would be gone?
o.zh: 你既然知道 Macario 会走，为什么还派我去 Salamanca？

entries.en:
The comms crackle, then a professionally bored voice.

"This is Jensulte complex control. Please confirm your identity as $PlayerFirstName Rahu."
entries.zh:
通讯里一阵杂音，随后是一个职业性的、百无聊赖的声音。

"这里是 Jensulte 综合区管制。请确认你的身份：$PlayerFirstName Rahu。"

o.en: Uh. Yes, that's me. And a blessed day to you. (lie)
o.zh: 呃。对，是我。也祝你这一天蒙福。 (说谎)

o.en: I am $PlayerFirstName, here to see 'Balaram Rahu'.
No, I am $PlayerName. I'm here to find Dolos Macario. (truth)
o.zh: 不，我是 $PlayerName。我来找 Dolos Macario。 (实话)

entries.en: "Of course, of course; and once more I must offer my thorough apologies. This is quite unprecedented, and-"
entries.zh: "当然，当然；我必须再次向您致以最深的歉意。这事实在没有先例，而且——"

entries.en:
You watch the understeward's face as he tries to process this statement.

His thoughts appear to swing between considering himself the victim of some elaborate practical joke or in the presence of someone truly insane.
entries.zh:
你看着副管家的脸，看他试着消化这句话。

他的念头显然在两头摇摆：要么自己成了某人精心设计的一场恶作剧的受害者，要么眼前这位是真的疯了。

o.en: Best not to confuse the poor man further
o.zh: 还是别再为难这个可怜人了

o.en: Would it help to look at a picture? (show him Macario's image)
o.zh: 看一眼照片会有帮助吗？ (给他看 Macario 的影像)

entries.en:
You watch the understeward's face as he tries to process this statement.

He appears to swing between the conclusion that you have an appallingly crass sense of humor or - nearly as embarassing - you might be truly insane.
entries.zh:
你看着副管家的脸，看他试着消化这句话。

他似乎又在两个结论之间摇摆：要么你有一种粗劣得惊人的幽默感，要么——同样令人难堪——你是真的疯了。

o.en: Would it help to look at a picture? (show your TriPad)
o.zh: 看一眼照片会有帮助吗？ (给他看你的 TriPad)

entries.en:
It does seem to help the understeward for one of higher perceived social status to take control of the situation.

You show him a picture of Dolos Macario (though the understeward is surely familiar with the spymaster of the greatest traitor to the Hegemony).

"There's... a passing resemblance," he admits. "But. His hair was- But, but-" he sputters directionlessly, trying to form a new objection.

Setting aside the possibility of unfortunate coincidences, it is true that appearance can be sold and bought. All it takes is time and credits, with one able to substitute for the other up to a certain point. Jove's strategy appears to be to keep Macario from having much of either.

There's only one thing to do.
entries.zh:
看来，由一位地位更高的人来掌控局面，确实让副管家好受了些。

你把 Dolos Macario 的影像给他看 (尽管这位副管家多半早就认得，此人是霸主头号叛徒手下那位间谍头子)。

"有...几分像，"他承认。"可是。他的头发是——可是，可是——"他没了方向地嘟囔着，想再找出一条反驳。

且不说巧合这种不幸的可能——相貌确实是可以买卖的。所需的不过是时间与星币，而在某个限度之内，这两样可以互相顶替。Jove 的策略看来就是让 Macario 两样都不宽裕。

只剩一件事可做了。

entries.en: "Confirmed and thank-you. Transmitting approach."
entries.zh: "已确认，谢谢。正在发送进近数据。"

entries.en: "Confirmed and thank-you, $PlayerFirstName Rahu. Transmitting approach."
entries.zh: "已确认，谢谢，$PlayerFirstName Rahu。正在发送进近数据。"

entries.en:
"Confirmed and thank-you, $PlayerFirstName Rahu. Transmitting approach."

There is no acknowledgement in the voice that suggests you said anything amiss.

Jove's work? Surely. And is he being careful or is he showing a lack of faith in your ability, or willingness, to lie for his schemes?
entries.zh:
"已确认，谢谢，$PlayerFirstName Rahu。正在发送进近数据。"

那声音里没有半点迹象表明你说漏了什么。

Jove 的手笔？多半是。可他这么做，是出于谨慎，还是说你撒谎的本事——或者替他的盘算撒谎的意愿——让他放心不下？

entries.en:
* * *

In high-atmo now, the shuttle barely thrumming in the thin air, you can see the pillars of the Jensulte Estate rising on the horizon.

The radiant diamond-matrix columns shine in the mirrorlight, standing watch over a lush, sunny plateau above a vast dark plain dotted with marching spotlights that trace transport lines, warehouses, and low blocks of res-habs.
entries.zh:
* * *

穿梭机已进入高层大气，稀薄的空气里几乎听不到引擎的震动。地平线上，Jensulte 庄园的立柱一座座升起。

耀眼的菱形矩阵立柱在镜面反光里发亮，俯瞰着一片葱郁、向阳的高原；高原之下是广袤的暗色平原，点点移动的探照灯勾勒出运输线、仓库，以及一排排低矮的居住舱。

entries.en:
At the shuttle port an understeward meets you. He is accompanied by house guards in ceremonial dress, though their ready and relaxed pose suggests actual combat training.

"Ah, $PlayerSirOrMadam Rahu. Welcome to Jensulte Estate," the understeward says. He eyes your own bodyguards.

"I had no idea the cousin - by marriage, I must assume - of our new chief gardener was so... distinguished."

He bows.

"You are, of course, expected. Please, follow me. And, ah, I wish a blessed day for you," he adds with nearly condescending charity.
entries.zh:
穿梭机港上，一名副管家迎上前来。他身边跟着几名身着礼服的家族卫兵——那副既放松又随时能动的站姿，说明他们确曾受过实战训练。

"啊，$PlayerSirOrMadam Rahu。欢迎来到 Jensulte 庄园，"副管家说。他打量着你带来的保镖。

"我实在没想到，我们新任首席园丁的表亲——我想，是姻亲吧——竟是这般...体面的人物。"

他躬身行礼。

"您自然是贵客。请随我来。还有，呃，愿您这一天蒙福，"他补了一句，那份慈悲几乎带着居高临下的意味。

entries.en:
* * *

By the third chime at the door of the chief gardener's quarters in as many minutes, the understeward is growing increasingly embarrassed.
entries.zh:
* * *

三分钟之内，首席园丁住所的门铃第三次响起，副管家越来越挂不住脸。

entries.en:
"My apologies, there must be some malfunction," he explains as he draws out a small datapad and taps at it. "Um. He should be just inside according to the access bracelet."

"The new chief gardener is not a young man, I-" the understeward looks to you, even more embarrassed - and now worried - by his suggestion of ill-health in a family member.

Even if only by marriage.
entries.zh:
"抱歉，一定是哪里出了故障，\"他一边解释，一边掏出一块小数据板点着。\"呃。按出入腕带的记录，他应该就在里面。"

"新任首席园丁年纪不轻了，我——"副管家看向你，像是为自己暗示家族成员身体有恙而更加尴尬——眼下又添了几分担忧。

哪怕只是个姻亲。

o.en: We ought to check on him, don't you think?
o.zh: 我们该去看看他，你不觉得吗？

entries.en:
"Yes, of course," he says, looking relieved to be given permission to act.

The understeward speaks into a comms-unit, "Security. Understeward Zhou here. Confirmed. Would you kindly unlock the primary door of the chief gardener's quarters?"

His eyes meet yours and instantly retreat. "Possible medical emergency," he says into the comms.

A medical kit has appeared in the hands of one of the house guards, and the other's hand is ready, though relaxed, on what can only be a concealed weapon.

You find yourself similarly poised.

The door pings a friendly chime and you hear a small bolt unlatch itself.
entries.zh:
"是，当然，"他说着，得了行动的准许，神情一松。

副管家对着通讯器说："安保。我是副管家 Zhou。已确认。劳烦把首席园丁住所的主门打开。"

他的目光与你一碰，随即躲开。"可能有医疗紧急情况，"他对着通讯器说。

一名家族卫兵手里已经多了一只医疗箱，另一人的手看似随意地搭在一件只可能是暗器的家伙上，却随时能出手。

你发觉自己也摆出了同样的架势。

门发出一声友好的提示音，接着传来一道小门闩弹开的轻响。

entries.en:
The understeward cracks the door.

"Chief Gardener Rahu, are you well?" A polite delay of one, two, three seconds, then the understeward nods to the house guards.

Weapon-ready goes first, calling out for 'Chief Rahu' again. Medkit follows, then the understeward.

You watch their backs disappear into the quarters.
entries.zh:
副管家把门推开一条缝。

"首席园丁 Rahu，您还好吗？"礼貌地等了一秒、两秒、三秒，副管家才朝家族卫兵点了点头。

持枪的那个先进去，又喊了一声"Rahu 首席"。提医疗箱的跟上，然后是副管家。

你看着他们的背影没入住所深处。

entries.en:
They call out Macario's alias several more times as they clear each room in the suite, finding nothing untoward.

Nothing.

The understeward reappears in the doorway. "He isn't here, but..." The Understeward holds up a bracelet, tasteful silver with a band of some green gem inlaid.

"He left his access bracelet. I... I don't understand."
entries.zh:
他们一间间清查套房，又喊了几遍 Macario 的化名，没发现任何异常。

什么都没有。

副管家重新出现在门口。"他不在这儿，可是..."他举起一只腕带——雅致的银质，嵌着一圈绿色宝石。

"他把出入腕带留下了。我...我不明白。"

o.en: You're not going to find him.

entries.en:
* * *

The man called "Balaram Rahu" has completely disappeared. All of his belongings and the tools appropriate to his station - held for only a few short days - appear to be untouched. Only missing are a pair of workboots, shears, and a set of rugged civilian clothing.

The Jensulte house guards turn up a small pistol secreted into a false volume in a luggage case, though this is not viewed as particularly suspicious. The Sector is not a gentle place, and 'Balaram' had claimed previous experience in the security sector. It's part of what got him the job.

Your guide, the undersecretary, is beyond apologetic and explains that House Jensulte will demand a full investigation by the planetary authorities.
entries.zh:
* * *

那个名叫"Balaram Rahu"的人彻底消失了。他的全部私人物品，以及他在这职位上——才短短几天——该用的工具，看来都没被动过。少的只有一双工装靴、一把修枝剪，和一身结实的便装。

Jensulte 的家族卫兵在一只行李箱的假夹层里搜出一把小巧的手枪，不过这并不显得特别可疑。星域不是什么温柔的地方，而"Balaram"当初声称自己干过安保这一行——这也是他得到这份工作的原因之一。

你的向导，那位副管家，歉疚得无以复加，解释说 Jensulte 家族将要求行星当局展开全面调查。

o.en: You'll, uh, have my comms ID in case anything turns up.
o.zh: 呃，您拿着我的通讯号，万一查出什么来。
不必了。Balaram 根本不存在。

o.en: Look, you hired Dolos Macario as your gardener.
o.zh: 听我说，你们雇的园丁是 Dolos Macario。

entries.en:
You leave the understeward in the lobby of the estate's shuttleport. He's still not managed to resolve what exactly he thinks of the situation, as it is well outside his remit, which he's explained to you several times.

You've been used by Jove to flush out another of Macario's contingency plans.

Next time, perhaps.
entries.zh:
你把副管家留在了庄园穿梭机港的大厅里。他始终没能想明白自己究竟该怎么看这件事——这远远超出了他的职分，而这一点他已经跟你解释了好几遍。

你被 Jove 当成了引子，用来逼出 Macario 的另一手应变。

下一次吧，也许。

o.en: Take a shuttle to the Jensulte estate
o.zh: 乘穿梭机前往 Jensulte 庄园

entries.en:
Your shuttle performs a standard insertion into a low parking orbit. Standard procedure usually only involves a small wait as your pilot requests approach permission. The Jensulte estate, of course, has somewhat stricter requirements.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." Your pilot, via the shuttle intercom. "Traffic control, ah, would like to confirm certain matters."
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机按标准程序切入低轨道驻留点。按常规，这不过是等你的驾驶员申请进近许可的一小会儿。不过 Jensulte 庄园的要求，自然要严格一些。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。\"你的驾驶员的声音从穿梭机内通讯里传来。\"交管那边，呃，想确认几件事。"

entries.en: The understeward makes no comment upon your standard sidearm. As a starship officer on Eventide, it is expected.
entries.zh: 副管家对你随身的标准配枪未置一词。在 Eventide，作为星舰军官，这本是理所当然。

entries.en: You bear no hidden weapon - you know that your body, directed by a mind clear of purpose, is the deadliest weapon of all.
entries.zh: 你身上没藏任何武器——你知道，只要心智澄明、目标笃定，这具身躯本身就是最致命的武器。

entries.en: The understeward makes no comment upon the clutch of small, plastic grenades you've hidden within your coat. Whether they were not detected or it would be impolitic to mention, you can't be sure.
entries.zh: 副管家对你藏在大衣里的那几颗小型塑料手雷未置一词。是没被查出来，还是提出来有失体面，你拿不准。

entries.en: The understeward makes no comment upon your sidearm, a matte-black pistol.
entries.zh: 副管家对你那把哑光黑色的手枪未置一词。

entries.en: The understeward makes no comment upon the ceramic vibroknife hidden in your coat. Whether because it was not detected or it would be impolitic you can't be sure.
entries.zh: 副管家对你藏在大衣里的陶瓷振动刀未置一词。是没被查出来，还是提出来有失体面，你拿不准。

entries.en: The understeward makes no comment upon the poison spray device hidden in your sleeve. Whether because it was not detected or it would be impolitic you can't be sure.
entries.zh: 副管家对你藏在袖中的毒雾喷射器未置一词。是没被查出来，还是提出来有失体面，你拿不准。

entries.en: The understeward makes no comment upon the monomolecular wire hidden in a false fingertip. Whether because it was not detected or it would be impolitic you can't be sure.
entries.zh: 副管家对你藏在假指尖里的单分子线未置一词。是没被查出来，还是提出来有失体面，你拿不准。

entries.en: The understeward makes no comment upon the officer's sword you wear. It would, of course, be quite standard among the upper classes of Eventide to wear such a weapon.
entries.zh: 副管家对你佩的军官剑未置一词。在 Eventide 的上层圈子里，佩这样的兵器自然再寻常不过。

entries.en:
The link hangs, no response.

It is more than likely that Jove is not presently on Qaras.
entries.zh:
通讯接不通，没有回应。

Jove 眼下多半不在 Qaras。

o.en: I have a problem named Dolos Macario - perhaps you can help.
o.zh: 我有个麻烦，名叫 Dolos Macario——也许你能帮上忙。

o.en: I want to discuss the Macario problem again.
o.zh: 我想再谈谈 Macario 这个麻烦。

o.en: How goes the search for Macario?
o.zh: Macario 那边查得怎么样了？

o.en: The Prime Demarchon told me you can deliver Dolos Macario.
o.zh: 大统领告诉我，你能把 Dolos Macario 交出来。

entries.en:
"It goes, captain. It goes," he says languidly.

"Though I must, unfortunately, admit the truth. And that is that I think of little else in what time I may call 'spare'."

"It's a good little problem, you see... it's," he licks his lips. "Deliciously obtuse. I find myself meeting the mind of an old master - he's had many cycles more than I to build networks, lay traps and safehouses."
entries.zh:
"还在办，舰长。还在办，"他懒洋洋地说。

"不过很不幸，我得承认实情：在我能称作'空闲'的时间里，我几乎没想过别的事。"

"这是个很妙的小难题，你看...它，\"他舔了舔嘴唇，\"晦涩得恰到好处。我觉得自己是在和一位老宗师对弈——他比我多出许多个星历年，用来织网、设陷阱、布置安全屋。"

entries.en:
"It goes, captain," he says easily. "The more you bother me with your own impatience, the longer it will take."
OR
Jove sits up and looks around.

"He isn't here, so... I must not be done yet."

His tone is ironic, and more than a bit acidic. "Recall that I told you I'd tell you when I found him?"
OR
Jove leans back. Further. He takes a deep, slow breath, the very image of relaxation.

"Still looking. Hard at work."
entries.zh:
"还在办，舰长，\"他答得轻描淡写，\"你越拿自己的急性子来烦我，这事就拖得越久。"
OR
Jove 坐直身子，四下看了看。

"他不在这儿，所以...我大概还没办完。"

他语气里带着讥讽，还颇有些尖刻："记得我说过吗？找到他，我就告诉你。"
OR
Jove 向后靠，再向后。他深深缓缓地吸了口气，整个人就是一副放松到底的样子。

"还在找。正忙着呢。"

entries.en:
"But I think, captain, after so many cycles he grew lazy and soft in his vast web. More satisfied with his cleverness than respectful of fresh, young minds - and change. Old methods proved true, and proved true again. They signify patterns of thought, of methodology, which may be divined through careful examination of the trails Macario has left through his long career of spycraft..."

Jove is looking up and away, as if lost in conversation with his own imagined ghost of Macario.
entries.zh:
"可我认为，舰长，在那么多个星历年之后，他在自己那张大网里变得懒惰、迟钝了。他更满足于自己的那点聪明，而不是尊重年轻的新头脑——也不尊重变化。老办法一再应验，于是便一再照用。这些办法透露出思维与行事的路数，只要仔细检视 Macario 漫长间谍生涯中留下的痕迹，就能把它们推演出来..."

Jove 抬眼望向别处，仿佛沉溺于与自己想象出来的 Macario 亡魂对谈。

o.en: Leave him to his pondering (cut comms)
o.zh: 让他自己琢磨去吧 (切断通讯)

entries.en:
His gaze snaps back to you, through the link.

"Yes, of course. As I said before, I shall contact you when I may provide an actionable scenario."

His half-smile grows less thoughtful. "Mind that your credits are ready when it's time. 80,000."
entries.zh:
他的目光穿过通讯链接，猛地回到你身上。

"当然，有进展。我说过，等我能给出一个可执行的方案，就会联系你。"

他那半截笑意里少了些思量。"到时候记得把星币备好。80,000。"

entries.en:
His gaze snaps back to you, through the link.

"Yes, of course. As I said before, I shall contact you when I may provide an actionable scenario."

His half-smile grows less thoughtful. "Worry not, the thought of Reynard Hannan's credits is fresh in my mind."
entries.zh:
他的目光穿过通讯链接，猛地回到你身上。

"当然，有进展。我说过，等我能给出一个可执行的方案，就会联系你。"

他笑意里的思量淡了下去。"不必担心，Reynard Hannan 的星币我可一直记在心上。"

o.en: I have a problem named Dolos Macario - perhaps you can help.
o.zh: 我有个麻烦，名叫 Dolos Macario——也许你能帮上忙。

o.en: I have a problem named Dolos Macario - perhaps you can help.
o.zh: 我有个麻烦，名叫 Dolos Macario——也许你能帮上忙。

entries.en:
"She has, has she," he says, displeased. But not at you.

"If she does intend to back Caden, as you've suggested previously, then this new alliance might be a problem." Macario leans back, hands rubbing together, thinking aloud.

"A new story needs to appear. Caden loves stories - particularly about himself. Something to drive them apart..."
entries.zh:
"如此这般，真是如此？" 他不悦地说道，但是这不悦不针对于你。

"如果她真的如你刚才所说，打算支持 Caden，那这个新的联盟会是个问题。" Macario 靠在椅背上，两手相互揉搓地思考着。

"我们需要个新的故事。Caden 就喜欢故事 —— 尤其是关于他本人的故事。一个能分裂他们的故事..."

entries.en:
"She has, has she," he says, displeased. Possibly at you.

"You have previously suggested that Hyder intended to back my own ascension. This... development, it feels strange to me. Hyder is anything but mercurial."

His cold eyes are locked on yours, somehow, through the comms.
entries.zh:
"如此这般，真是如此？" 他不悦地说道，似乎是针对于你。

"你之前告诉过我 Hyder 打算支持我上位。这个... 发展，不太对劲。Hyder 不是反复之人。"

透过通讯台，他冰冷的眼光似乎直瞪着你的眼睛。

entries.en:
"She has, has she," he says, displeased. Possibly at you.

"If, as you've previously suggested, Hyder intends to make a grab for power, then bringing Caden in would be an obvious move to secure the backing of the Lion's Guard."

"However," his cold eyes lock on you, somehow, through the comms. "Caden would never back Hyder over himself. And Hyder is incapable of the deception required to turn Caden, even if she desired to arrange some monumental act of treachery."

"Something. Does not fit."
entries.zh:
"如此这般，真是如此？" 他不悦地说道，似乎是针对于你。

"如果按你之前所说，Hyder 想自己夺权，那拉拢 Caden 自然是为了获得狮心卫队的拥护。"

"然而，" 透过通讯台，他冰冷的眼光似乎直瞪着你的眼睛。"Caden 永远不会支持 Hyder 而非他本人上位。而 Hyder 使不出能够策反 Caden 的诈术，就算她有意犯下这滔天大逆。"

"这里头，有地方不对。"

entries.en:
"She has, has she," he says, displeased. Possibly at you.

"If, as you've previously suggested, Hyder intends to defect to the Hegemony, then turning Caden against me would be an obvious move to maximize chaos."

"However," his cold eyes lock on you, somehow, through the comms. "If Hyder betrayed the Diktat, then Caden would be driven to me. The play doesn't add up; even Hyder, obstinate as she is, can see that. Even Hegemony intelligence - or Rao, if he indeed is overseeing counter-Diktat operations - could see that."

"Something. Does not fit."
entries.zh:
"如此这般，真是如此？" 他不悦地说道，似乎是针对于你。

"如果，按你之前所说，Hyder 想叛向 霸主，那离间 Caden 和我自然是能够造成最大混乱的方式。"

"但是，" 透过通讯台，他冰冷的眼光似乎直瞪着你的眼睛。"如果 Hyder 背叛了强权 ，那只能逼着 Caden 倒向我。这计谋行不通；顽固如 Hyder 也应该能看出这一点。哪怕 霸主 的情报机构，或者 Rao，如果反强权行动的指挥者真的是他的话 —— 也都能看出来这一点。"

"这里头，有地方不对。"

entries.en:
"She has, has she," he says, displeased.

"If this is indeed a new alliance - a surprising development from that obstinate woman - then this could be a problem." Macario leans back, hands rubbing together, thinking aloud.

"Where did this come from? Hegemony meddling? Rao is capable of it. But who has he got on our inside?"
entries.zh:
"如此这般，真是如此？" 他不悦地说道。

"如果这个新联盟真的存在，那这会是个问题。就那个顽固女人来说这确实是个让人意外的进展。" Macario 靠在椅背上，两手相互揉搓地思考着。

"但这是从何而来的呢？霸主 的干预？Rao 能做到，但是他在我们这边的线人是谁？"

o.en: Prepare a raid to extract Caden's agent
o.zh: 准备一场劫掠以营救 Caden 的特工

entries.en:
The comms connection flickers, then resolves.

"This fleet operates by command of the Askonia Revolutionary Council. The wealth of exploiters is designated for redistribution to fund the cause of sector liberation!"
entries.zh:
通讯链接闪烁了一下，然后恢复正常。

"本舰队由 Askonia 革命者委员会指挥，剥削者的财富将被重新分配，用于资助本地的解放事业！"

entries.en:
The comms connection flickers, then resolves.

"Clear signal, comrade-captain. We're ARC-aligned, just about to set off on an operation."

$HeOrShe leans in with a conspiratorial grin. "Been hearing rumors about a shake-up in the Sindies' officer corps... might be a good opportunity to, ah, redistribute some wealth around here. The more of us are raiding, the fewer they catch, right?"
entries.zh:
通讯链接闪烁了一下，然后恢复正常。

"舰长同志，我方信号清晰。我方隶属于 Askonia 革命者委员会，行将出发，参与行动。"

$HeOrShe身体前倾，脸上忽然有了一抹阴谋得逞的微笑，说道："据说，辛达佬军官团里正改组着呢...看来是我们，啊，再分配他们手里财富的好机会呀。我们抢得越多，他们手里越少，对吧？"

entries.en:
The comms connection flickers, then resolves.

"In the name of the Askonia Revolutionary Council, you are to face justice for your service to Sindrian Diktat imperialism and exploiters generally!"

"Lower your shields! Peaceful cooperation with the redistribution of exploited wealth shall be taken into account when you face the revolutionary tribunal."
entries.zh:
通讯链接闪烁了一下，然后恢复正常。

"以 Askonia 革命者委员会之名，我方将审判你方为 辛达强权 帝国主义、为压迫阶级张目的恶行！"

"关闭护盾！你方若配合我方、和平分配你方压迫得来的不义之财，在革命法庭审判中，仍有从轻处置余地！"

entries.en:
The comms connection flickers, then resolves.

"In the name of the Askonia Revolutionary Council, we greet you. We were in the middle of a wealth redistribution operation when we received a high-priority alert from our comrades on Umbra. It seems that a mercenary working for the Sindrian exploiters has been causing trouble."

"I'm sure I can count on you to inform us if your sensors find anything." $HeOrShe glances at another screen, impatient, but friendly. "We've got to get back to it. Bright burns."
entries.zh:
通讯链接闪烁了一下，然后恢复正常。

"以 Askonia 革命者委员会之名，我方向你方致意。原本，我方正在执行财富再分配行动，但途中收到了 Umbra 驻扎同志发来的高优先级警报。看来 辛达强权 压迫者手下有一名佣兵挑起了某种事端。"

"我很肯定，如果你发现什么的话，你会通报我们的。" $HeOrShe不耐烦的盯着通讯界面旁边另外一个屏幕，却还勉强维持着友好的语气："我们得赶回去了，祝航行无阻。"

o.en: I am nothing but loyal to the Supreme Executor. I can prove it!
o.zh: 我对最高元首一片忠心。我能证明！

entries.en:
"So," Caden's eyes narrow on you.

"How does the Chief High Inspector-General of the Sindrian Diktat come to trust a spacer with such an essential matter of internal security?"

Here it comes. Time to work your angle.
entries.zh:
"所以，" Caden 看向你，眼神微眯。

"辛达强权 的最高检察长，怎么会信任一个太空佬，来处理如此关键的内部安全事务？"

来了，是时候展现你的手段了。

o.en: Macario is ensuring the loyalty of key figures for... the future.
o.zh: Macario 需要确保核心人物的忠诚... 为了将来。

o.en: Macario is manipulating you. He wants to control you.
o.zh: Macario 在利用你。他想要控制你。

o.en: Macario is simply doing his job through me. Purging traitors for the Supreme Executor.
o.zh: Macario 不过是通过我来完成他的工作罢了。替最高元首消灭叛徒。

o.en: I'm just a freelancer. I get paid and don't ask questions.
o.zh: 我就是个自由佣兵，拿钱办事不多问。

o.en: Your agent was a traitor, working for the rebels of Umbra.
o.zh: 你的特工是个叛徒，他在替 Umbra 的叛军做事。

o.en: Macario discovered that your agent was a traitor. I have proof.
o.zh: Macario 发现你的特工是个叛徒。我有证据。

o.en: I'm doing you a favor by rooting out treason. I have proof!
o.zh: 我在帮你挖出一桩叛国罪。我可以证明！

o.en: I am nothing but loyal to the Supreme Executor. I can prove it! (lie)
o.zh: 我对最高元首有绝对的忠诚。我可以证明！ (说谎)

o.en: I am not acting under Hegemony authority. Your agent is a traitor.
o.zh: 我没有受到 霸主 当局的指使。你的特工是个叛徒。

entries.en:
"I am the Guard High Deputy Executor of the Sindrian Diktat, spacer!" Caden shouts, turning red. "I do not need a... favor." He spits the hated word.

"Nonetheless, I shall judge the right of your claim. Demonstrate your loyalty now! Surrender this agent and explain yourself!"

He adjusts his uniform after all the exertion. "Quickly, now. The swift sword of justice does not rest easy in the Sindrian Diktat."
entries.zh:
"我可是辛达强权的卫队最高副首长，太空佬！" Caden 咆哮道，脸色变得通红，"我不需要你卖我什么...人情。" 他咬牙切齿地说出这个令他痛恨的词汇。

"但尽管如此，我仍会裁断你这声明的正确性。现在，证明你的忠诚！交出这个特工并且解释清楚！"

他理了理自己因为歇斯底里的吼叫后凌乱的制服。"快点，就现在。在辛达强权，正义的利刃可不会轻易停歇。"

entries.en:
"Then do so, spacer!" Caden shouts. "The swift sword of justice does not rest easy in the Sindrian Diktat!"

"Demonstrate your loyalty; transfer the agent to my fleet and I shall judge the situation and produce appropriate action." He lowers his voice dramatically, "Severe if necessary."
entries.zh:
"按要求去做，太空佬！" Caden 咆哮道，"在 辛达强权，正义的利刃可不会轻易停歇！"

"证明你的忠诚；把那个特工移交给我的舰队，我将视情况采取对应的行动。" 他猛地压低声音，"如有必要，那将相当严厉。"

entries.en:
"Then do so, spacer!" Caden shouts. "The swift sword of justice does not rest easy in the Sindrian Diktat!"

"Demonstrate your loyalty; transfer the agent to my fleet and I shall judge the situation and produce appropriate action." He lowers his voice dramatically, "Severe if necessary."
entries.zh:
"按要求去做，太空佬！" Caden 咆哮道，"在 辛达强权，正义的利刃可不会轻易停歇！"

"证明你的忠诚；把那个特工移交给我的舰队，我将视情况采取对应的行动。" 他猛地压低声音，"如有必要，那将相当严厉。"

entries.en:
Macario, of course, doesn't seem to particularly care about the fate of this agent. But his overstepping of authority might drive a wedge between him and Caden if you could put the idea in Caden's head.

"Do not test my patience, spacer!" Caden is turning redder again, "Here I am the representative of the Supreme Executor's ultimate will! To oppose my demand is tantamount to an attack on the state - degenerate terrorism, sedition, and treason!"
entries.zh:
显然，Macario 并不特别关心这位特工的命运。但如果，你能把他做了越权行径的想法植入到 Caden 脑子里，也许足以在他和 Caden 的关系间制造一道裂痕。

"不要考验我的耐心，太空佬！" Caden 的脸再次涨得通红，"我在此代表着最高元首至高无上的意志！反对我的要求与攻击整个 辛达强权 无异 —— 堕落的恐怖主义，煽动行为，叛国罪行！"

entries.en:
"What? Treachery in my sacred Guard?" Caden shouts, turning red. He takes a deep breath, consciously composing himself.

"Despite my doubts about his commitment to Andradan ideals," he says in a more level tone, "I must admit that the Chief High Inspector-General is adept at rooting out sedition. Glory to the Chief High Inspector-General."
entries.zh:
"什么？我的神圣卫队中居然会有叛徒？" Caden 咆哮道，面色涨红。他深吸一口气，努力地冷静下来。

"尽管我对于他是否忠于 Andrada 伟大愿景存疑，" 他用更平稳的语气说道，"我也必须承认，最高检察长大人相当擅长揪出叛徒。荣耀归于最高检察长大人！"

entries.en:
"First, surrender the agent to my fleet," he adjusts his uniform after all the exertion.

"Then transmit this 'proof'. My staff shall provide me with an executive overview so that I may lay the appropriate punishment upon this traitor."

"I expect it will be severe," he adds, as if there was any question.
entries.zh:
"首先，把特工交给我的舰队。" 他整理了下因为之前一系列动作略微凌乱的制服。

"接着再传输你所谓的 '证据'。我的属下会替我准备一套执行报告，以便我给这个叛徒降下他应得的惩罚。"

"我想这惩罚会相当严厉。" 他补充了一句，说得好像真有必要解释似的。

entries.en:
You hold a legitimate agent of the Askonian resistance. Turning them over to either Caden or Macario would only assist the Sindrian Diktat's repression.

On the other hand, emphasizing that Macario overstepped his authority might drive a wedge between him and Caden.

"Do not test my patience, spacer!" Caden is turning red again, "Here, I am the representative of the Supreme Executor's ultimate and unassailable will! To oppose my demand is tantamount to an attack on the state - degenerate terrorism, sedition, treason, corruption of the public corpus!"
entries.zh:
你手里所掌握的是 Askonia 抵抗组织一名正牌特工的命运。无论是将其转交给 Caden 或者 Macario 都只会助长 辛达强权 的镇压行动。

从另一方面来说，强调 Macario 所做的越权行动也许能在他和 Caden 的关系间制造一道裂痕。

"不要考验我的耐心，太空佬！" Caden 的脸再次涨得通红，"我在此代表着最高元首至高无上而无可动摇的意志！反对我的要求与攻击整个 辛达强权 无异 —— 堕落的恐怖主义，煽动行为，叛国罪行，公权腐败！"

entries.en:
You hold an agent of the Askonian resistance, and promised their safety in exchange for cooperation.

If Caden believes Macario has the agent, and Macario believes Caden does, then considering how little they appear to trust one another...

"Do not test my patience, spacer!" Caden's shout interrupts your thoughts. He's turning red again.

"Here, I alone represent the Supreme Executor's ultimate and unassailable will! To oppose my demand is tantamount to an attack on the state - degenerate terrorism, sedition, treason, corruption of the public corpus!"
entries.zh:
你控制着一名 Askonia 抵抗组织的特工，并承诺保障其安全以换取合作。

如果 Caden 认为特工在 Macario 手中，而 Macario 又相信 Caden 掌握着这位特工，再考虑到他们之间明显缺乏信任...

"不要考验我的耐心，太空佬！" Caden 的吼声打断了你的思绪，他的脸再次涨得通红。

"我个人在此代表着最高元首至高无上而无可动摇的意志！反对我的要求与攻击整个 辛达强权 无异 —— 堕落的恐怖主义，煽动行为，叛国罪行，公权腐败！"

entries.en: "Is that what Macario told you?" he says, leaping on the suggestion, "That my authority does not reign second to the Supreme Executor alone?"
entries.zh: "Macario 是那样给你说的？" 他抓住了你的暗示，讲道，"他说权力仅次于最高元首的人不是我？"

entries.en:
Caden turns away, fuming.

"The presumption of that two-faced traitor! He should not push me, for if I but willed it he would be executed - on the spot!"

"Spacer!" Caden is back, redder than ever. "Your ignorance is pitiable, so I shall correct it: in our great tower of authority Philip Andrada sits at the apex."

He raises a hand, fingers pinched, as if showing you a model.
entries.zh:
Caden 转过身，气得直冒烟：

"这两面三刀的叛徒在胡说八道！他不该逼我的，因为如果我一心要弄死他，他就会在街上被公开处决。"

"太空佬！" Caden 转身回来，脸比以往更红，"你的无知令人感到可怜，所以我必须纠正你：在我们伟大的权威之塔中，Philip Andrada 身居顶点。"

他举起一只手，手指捏在一起，仿佛在给你展示这座尖塔的模型。

entries.en:
"Beneath him is the Guard High Deputy Executor - myself - at the head of the personal guard of Philip Andrada, sworn to protect him in body and spirit; to uphold his transcendent Andradan ideology; to purge traitors and their degenerate thought from the universe!"

His hand lowers considerably.

"Dolos Macario is a mere bureaucrat, one of many who operate the ministries of the Supreme Executor's machinery of state. I'm afraid his excessive contact with terrorists and degenerates has given him impure imaginings regarding his position in our Great Movement. It is my duty to correct his errors."

Caden is marching back and forth on his bridge, the receptors and comms interpretation software struggling to maintain a steady positioning of the image.
entries.zh:
"在他之下，是卫队最高副首长 —— 也就是我 —— 带领着 Philip Andrada 的私人卫队，宣誓保护他的躯体与精神；坚定维护他卓越的 Andrada 伟大思想；在宇宙中清除那些叛徒与他们的堕落思想！"

"Dolos Macario 不过是个官僚，是负责操作最高元首的国家机器中各部门的千万人中的一个。恐怕他与恐怖分子和堕落者的过度接触，使他对自己在我们伟大的斗争运动中的地位产生了不纯的幻想。我有责任纠正他的错误想法。"

Caden 在舰桥上来回踱步，接收器和通信解码软件正努力维持着投影位置的稳定。

entries.en:
"The agent you have detained is under MY authority. And if they weren't, they would be by my decree in the name of the Supreme Executor."

Caden stops, and looks directly into the comms. "Now. Transfer the prisoner to my fleet."
entries.zh:
"你扣留的特工也在 '我 的' 权力管属下。就算不是，我也可以以最高元首的名义执行我的裁定。"

Caden 顿了一下，透过通讯直视过来："现在。把那囚犯移交到我的舰队里。"

o.en: But 'Andrada' is only a name now, isn't it.
o.zh: 但是 'Andrada' 现在只是个虚名了，不是吗。

o.en: Treason it is, I guess. Death to Andrada! Death to all oppressors!
o.zh: 叛就叛吧。Andrada 必死！所有压迫者必死！

entries.en:
"The agent you gave to Macario belongs under MY authority. And if they weren't, they would be by my decree in the name of the Supreme Executor."

Caden stops, and looks directly into the comms. "Your ignorance of the correct chain of authority is contemptible, scandalous, and approaches treason. I shall ponder upon an appropriate punishment to be administered at my will."

He pauses, looking satisfied with himself for this bullying threat.
entries.zh:
"你交给 Macario 的特工理应由我来管辖。即便原本不是，我也能以最高元首的名义下令将其归我调遣。"

Caden 停了下来，一边直视着通讯画面。"你对正确指挥链的无知是可鄙的、可耻的，且近乎叛国。我将斟酌在适当时机对你施以恰当的惩戒。"

他顿了顿，看上去似乎对这份威胁感到自我满足。

entries.en:
"Oh?" Caden makes a show of chuckling, rolls his eyes at this conspiratorial talk for his bridge crew, then activates a privacy field around his command station. He drops the expressions.

"And you are Macario's tool? Why admit it now? Spacers are all degenerate opportunists. Unreliable. Greedy. Cowardly." He snorts dismissively. "Speak!"
entries.zh:
"哦？" Caden 在他的舰桥船员面前装模做样地轻笑几声，仿佛对你这套阴谋论的说法嗤之以鼻。但他随即激活了他指挥台周围的隐私场。

"所以你是 Macario 的工具？为什么在这个时候主动承认这一点？你们这些太空佬都是下贱的投机分子，不可靠，贪婪，懦弱。" 他轻蔑地哼了一声 ，"有话快说！"

entries.en:
"A bold accusation from spacer trash!" Caden shouts, waving a fist. "But then perhaps you have heard how I despise traitors to our Glorious Movement!"

"You have chosen correctly, spacer, to bring this alleged traitor to me. The swift sword of justice does not rest long in the Sindrian Diktat!"

He adjusts his uniform after all the exertion. "Now; surrender this agent. Then I shall judge the situation and take appropriately decisive action."
entries.zh:
"你这太空垃圾佬也敢提如此大胆的指控！" Caden 挥舞着拳头咆哮道。"但你可能听说过，我是多么鄙夷背弃了我们光荣的斗争运动的叛徒们！"

"你做了正确的决定，太空佬，把这涉嫌谋反的叛徒交给了我。在 辛达强权，正义的利刃可不会轻易停歇！"

他理了理因为之前一系列动作略微凌乱的制服。"现在；把这个特工移交给我。我将视情况采取适当而果决的行动。"

entries.en:
"Ha! See now the quality of loyalty the decadent Hegemony inspires!" Caden seems to address his bridge crew, holding his arm out like a showman demonstrating wares.

"You have chosen correctly, spacer, to bring this alleged traitor to me. The swift sword of justice does not rest long in the Sindrian Diktat!"

He adjusts his uniform after all the exertion. "Now; surrender this agent. Then I shall judge the situation and take appropriately decisive action."
entries.zh:
"哈！看看腐败的 霸主 所能激发出的所谓忠诚！" Caden 似乎在向他舰桥上的船员们演说着，他挥起手臂，就像是拍卖会主持人在展示商品一样。

"你做了正确的决定，太空佬，把这涉嫌谋反的叛徒交给了我。在 辛达强权，正义的利刃可不会轻易停歇！"

他理了理因为之前一系列动作略微凌乱的制服。"现在；把这个特工移交给我。我将视情况采取适当而果决的行动。"

entries.en:
"Glory to the Supreme Executor and his Sindrian Diktat! Death to traitors!" he shouts.

You hear a muted repetition of Caden's last words, presumably from his bridge officers.

Caden turns back to you, "Your dutiful loyalty in purging a traitor from our glorious state will surely be rewarded. ...After the dictation-of-justice and public execution, of course."
entries.zh:
"荣耀归于最高元首和他的 辛达强权！叛徒必死！" 他大喊道。

你听见他的最后一句话在低声地反复回响，大概是他舰桥上的军官们在重复。

Caden 转过身来面向你："你为我们的光荣国度清除一个叛徒的忠诚必将得到回报...当然，是在正义宣判以及公开处刑之后。"

entries.en: Horacio Caden, Guard High Deputy Executor of the Sindrian Diktat appears before you, looking satisfied with himself.
entries.zh: Horacio Caden，辛达强权的最高副首长，出现在你的面前，看上去颇为得志意满。

o.en: So why are you channeling supplies away from Hyder's navy?
o.zh: 所以你为什么要调走本应提供给 Hyder 手下海军的补给？

entries.en: "A correction is required, spacer: it is the Sindrian Diktat's navy under command of Grand Star Marshal Baldr Charlton. He is a venerated officer and fiercely loyal follower of the Supreme Executor."
entries.zh: "你话里有一处需要更正，太空佬：是星际元帅 Baldr Charlton 指挥下的 辛达强权 海军。他是一位备受尊崇的将领，也是最高元首忠实的追随者。"

entries.en:
Caden paces, enjoying another chance to lecture you.

"Few of the Grand Star Marshal's many virtues apply to Vice Star Marshal Hyder, however. She does not burn with passion for the Andradan ideology as is fitting for senior officers in our glorious Sindrian Diktat."

"You see, from time to time the state requires a bitter medicine which kills the weak so that the strong may more fully thrive. Powers must be tipped toward a vigorous and stable future! The Supreme Executor saw sickness in the Hegemony, and that is exactly why he compelled the birth of a new order from the dying of the old!"
entries.zh:
Caden 来回踱步，享受着又一次向你说教的机会。

"然而副元帅 Hyder 几乎没有继承任何星际元帅身上的优良品德。她身上没有一个合格辛达军官对 Andrada 伟大思想应有的那般热情。"

"你看，每个政权都时不时需要咽下几口苦口良药来铲除弱者，以便强者能更加茁壮地成长。权力必须被用来创造一个稳定且充满活力的未来！正是最高元首在 霸主 内部所见的顽疾，让他下定决心从濒死的旧政权中创造了一个新政权！"

entries.en:
"Now." He halts, and turns.

"Mind your open talk, spacer." There's a threat in his tone.

"It could be considered support of terrorism, anti-Andradan sedition, and spreading malicious rumors to undermine legitimate authority. If," a smug smile grows, "I were to judge it so."
entries.zh:
"现在。" 他停了下来，转过身。

"太空佬，你有些太口无遮拦了。" 他的口气中有着威胁的意味。

"这话可以理解为支持恐怖主义，反辛达的煽动，以及散布针对正当政权的恶意谣言。只要..." 他脸上露出一个得意的笑容，"我如此认定。"

entries.en:
Caden goes deathly still.

"I don't believe I heard you correctly, spacer," he says quietly.
entries.zh:
Caden 陷入了死一般的沉寂。

"我想我一定是听错了，太空佬。" 他的声音异常平静。

o.en: I said I'm transferring the agent - in Andrada's name.
o.zh: 我说过我会移交这名特工 —— 以 Andrada 的名义。

o.en: I said Andrada is braindead, isn't he. So where's your authority come from now?
o.zh: 我说了，Andrada 已经脑死亡了，不是吗。所以你的权力现在又来自何处呢？

o.en: But... Macario said only his authority was second to the Supreme Executor... (lie)
o.zh: 但是... Macario 说只有他的权力是仅次于最高元首的... (说谎)

o.en: Treason it is, I guess. Death to Andrada! Death to all oppressors!
o.zh: 叛就叛吧。Andrada 必死！所有压迫者必死！

o.en: Macario ordered the arrest, so I must deliver the agent to him.
o.zh: Macario 发布了这项逮捕令，所以我必须得把这位特工移交给他。

o.en: Macario ordered the arrest, so I will deliver the traitor to him. (lie)
o.zh: Macario 发布了这项逮捕令，所以我必须得把这位特工移交给他。 (说谎)

o.en: Macario ordered the arrest. I've already delivered the agent to him. (lie)
o.zh: Macario 发布了这项逮捕令，而我已经把这位特工移交给了他。 (说谎)
荣耀归于 辛达强权。

o.en: Um, glory to the Sindrian Diktat?
o.zh: 呃，荣耀归于 辛达强权？

entries.en: "Of course!" Caden's eyes twitch, like he's trying to determine whether your comment contains subversive elements.
entries.zh: "当然！" Caden 的眼角抽动了一下，似乎在分析你这话是否有任何逆反意味。

entries.en:
"Your ignorance is pitiable, spacer, so I shall correct it: in our great tower of authority Philip Andrada sits at the apex." He raises a hand, fingers pinched, as if showing you a model.

"Beneath him is the Guard High Deputy Executor - myself - at the head of the personal guard of Philip Andrada, sworn to protect him in body and spirit; to uphold his transcendent Andradan ideology; to purge traitors and their degenerate thoughts from the universe."

"I am, of course, the natural successor when the tragic day comes that Andrada passes into the infinite. He shall live immortal in our hearts, our minds, and our glorious empire!"
entries.zh:
"太空佬，你的无知真可悲。所以我将矫正这一错误：伟大的 Philip Andrada 端坐于我们权力的宝塔之巅峰。" 他举起一只手比着手势，仿佛在向你展示一座模型。

"在他的下方是卫队最高副首长 —— 我 —— Philip Andrada 亲卫队的队长。我等宣誓守护他的肉体和灵魂；宣誓拥护他那高尚的 Andrada 伟大思想；宣誓将一切的叛徒和他们龌龊的思想从宇宙中抹除。

"当然，在 Andrada 不幸迈入无尽虚空的那一天，继承他遗志的自然会是我。他将在我们的心中，我们的思想中，我们的帝国中永生不朽！"

o.en: You seem pretty confident that you will be the next Supreme Executor...
o.zh: 看来你相当确信自己将成为下一任最高元首啊...

o.en: Yes sir! I already have my copy of 'Quotations from the Supreme Executor'.
o.zh: Yes sir! I already have my copy of 'Quotations from the Supreme Executor'.

entries.en: "Splendid! There may yet be a position for you in the future of our Great Movement. Nonetheless..." He frowns, examining you once more.
entries.zh: "精彩！也许将来，在我们伟大事业之中还会有你的一席之位。"

entries.en: He ignores or fails to perceive your tone.
entries.zh: 他忽略了或是根本没注意到你的语调。

o.en: Yes sir! I already have my copy of 'Quotations from the Supreme Executor'. (sarcastic)
o.zh: 是的长官！我已经有一本 '最高元首语录' 了。 (讽刺)

entries.en:
"Independent fleet captain!" he roars, standing, "You have crossed the will of the Supreme Executor."

Looking down at the comms, his voice lowered and gravelly, Caden adopts a practiced pose of menace and authority.

"A grave error, soon corrected."
entries.zh:
"独立舰队舰长！" 他咆哮着站起身，"你阻挠了最高元首的意志！"

他低头看下通讯器，摆出了一个明显排练过的姿势以体现他的权威和威吓力，随后才以低沉嘶哑的声音开口说道。

"这是致命的错误，但很快便会被更正。"

entries.en:
"Heed well, foreign terrorist and agitator!" he roars, standing, "I expected no less than this treachery from the simpering and decadent Hegemony!"

Looking down at the comms, his voice lowered and gravelly, Caden adopts a practiced pose of menace and authority. "A grave error, soon corrected."
entries.zh:
"听好了，外来的恐怖分子及煽动者！" 他咆哮着站起身，"我就知道虚伪腐败的 霸主 会耍这种下作的手段！"

他低头看下通讯器，摆出了一个明显排练过的姿势以体现他的权威和威吓力，随后以低沉嘶哑的声音开口道，"这是致命的错误，但很快便会被更正。"

entries.en:
"You! A captain pledged to the Sindrian Diktat auxiliary!" he roars, standing up. "Your actions are unbelievable! Crossing the will of the Supreme Executor?"

Looking down at the comms, his voice lowered and gravelly, Caden adopts a practiced pose of menace and authority. "A grave error, soon corrected."
entries.zh: "你！一个宣誓效忠于辛达强权辅助军的舰长！" 他咆哮着站起身，"你的行为真是不可理喻！竟敢阻挠最高元首的意志？" 他低头看下通讯器，摆出了一个明显排练过的姿势以体现他的权威和威吓力，随后以低沉嘶哑的声音开口道，"这是致命的错误，但很快便会被更正。"

entries.en:
"Hm," Caden looks worried, almost. "He is quite insistent about his loyalty to the vision of the Supreme Executor, and to myself personally."

He looks down, brow furrowed. "But Macario has played larger tricks before. He was born a liar. Did you know he came from a Luddic family?"

Caden smiles cruelly, "Oh yes. Of course, he had no faith. Never has and never will. And at the Battle of Salus he was a mere intelligence analyst, a junior officer! I suspect he's never accepted that Andrada did not truly favor him, and never completely trusted him."

"A web of intrigue is nothing compared to the might of a full warfleet. When the time comes, Dolos might realize this." Caden nods, satisfied at his own reasoning.
entries.zh:
"唔，" 忧虑差一点就要出现在 Caden 的脸上，"他本人可是坚持他对最高元首的愿景，以及对我个人都是一片忠心。"

他看向地面，眉头紧锁。"但 Macario 也耍过更大的把戏，他生来就是个骗子。你知不知道他来自一个卢德信徒家庭？"

Caden 残忍的笑道。"正是如此。当然，他没有信仰，之前没有过，将来也不会有。在 Salus 之战中，他只是个情报分析员，一个下级军官！Andrada 从未真正赏识他，也从未完全信任他，我怀疑他至今也没能对此释怀。

"情报网在一整只舰队的武力面前什么都不是。等时候到了，Dolos 或许就能认识到这一点了。" Caden 点了点头，对他自己的理论颇为满意。

o.en: A word of warning. Hyder and the navy won't back you.
o.zh: 一句忠告，Hyder 和海军不会支持你。

entries.en: "No?" Caden asks, annoyed. "What nonsense. Who else even exists?"
entries.zh: "不会？" Caden 不耐烦地问，"无稽之谈，除了我还能支持谁？"

o.en: She does. Hyder could make a play for Supreme Executorship.
o.zh: 她自己。Hyder 会试图争夺最高元首之位。

o.en: Macario. He only really believes in himself.
o.zh: Macario。那个人说到底只信任他自己。

o.en: I have reason to believe that Hyder intends to become Supreme Executor. (lie)
o.zh: 我有理由相信 Hyder 打算自己成为最高元首。 (说谎)

entries.en:
"You sound like Macario's more paranoid ramblings."

He flicks imagined dust from his uniform. "Hyder is a small woman of small vision. She sees only housekeeping of numbers and petty rules. The Lion's Guard under my command is invincible: outfitted with the best equipment and leadership inspired by Andradan principles; there is no finer fleet in the Sector. If it came to a contest of main-force..."

He pauses, and perhaps the calculus of what it would mean for the Diktat to expend its own navy on a civil war sinks in.

"It won't come to that," he concludes with an air of confidence.
entries.zh:
"你这话跟 Macario 最疑神疑鬼时胡扯的东西一个样子。"

他从军服上弹掉了些并不存在的灰尘。" Hyder 是个鼠目寸光的小人物。她只在乎无足轻重的规定和日常数据。我指挥的狮心卫队所向无敌：我们配有最好的装备，我们的领导遵循 Andrada 核心理念；整个星域里都找不出比我们更加优秀的舰队。如果要是轮到主力交战..."

他停顿了一下，或许他理解了将海军浪费在内战中会对强权造成的后果。

"不会走到那一步的。" 他颇为自信地做出了这一总结。

entries.en:
"Oh?" Caden makes a show of chuckling, rolls his eyes at this conspiratorial talk for his bridge crew, then activates a privacy field around his command station.

He drops the expression.

"Macario has sworn loyalty to the Supreme Executor. I have his personal assurances on matters of... the future. Speak plainly, spacer. What are you playing at?"
entries.zh:
"哦？" Caden 在他的舰桥船员面前装模做样地轻笑几声，仿佛对你这套阴谋论的说法嗤之以鼻。但他随即激活了他指挥台周围的隐私场。

他脸上的假笑消失了。

"Macario 已对最高元首宣誓效忠。他本人已在...未来的安排上给予了我他个人的担保。有话直说，太空佬。你在耍什么把戏？"

o.en: As I said. Macario believes he will rule the Diktat with you as his puppet.
o.zh: 如我所说，Macario 认为他可以通过以你为傀儡统治 辛达强权。

entries.en:
"Dolos Macario is a strange man to rely on you. Such an... unreliable element."

Caden waves a hand dismissively, "No personal offense intended of course. As an outsider you do not undergo the discipline and spiritual cleansing induced by total submission to transcendent Andradan ideology. I feel it would be more appropriate for matters within the Sindrian Diktat to be settled by true followers of the Great Movement, not decadent itinerants."

"Mark my words, spacer: When I reign, the slack shall be tightened. You would do well to study the teachings of the Supreme Executor, for they map the future of the Persean Sector - and indeed the galaxy."
entries.zh:
"Dolos Macario 真是个奇怪的人，会依赖于你这个... 不可靠因素。"

Caden 轻蔑地摆摆手。"当然没有冒犯的意思。作为一个局外人，你不会拥有彻底服从于无上的 Andrada 伟大思想所带来的纪律和精神上的净化。我觉得由 辛达强权 的那些伟大运动的真正追随者来解决这一切会更合适，而不是由颓废的流浪者。"

"记住我的话，太空佬：当我统治时，这一盘散沙将会聚在一起。你最好去学习最高元首的教义，因为它们描绘了英仙座星域的未来 —— 实际上也是银河系的未来"

entries.en:
"Dolos Macario is a strange man to rely on you. Such a fundamentally... unreliable element, despite the commission you bear."

Caden waves a hand dismissively, "No personal offense intended of course. As an outsider you do not undergo the discipline and spiritual cleansing induced by total submission to transcendent Andradan ideology. I feel it would be more appropriate for matters within the Sindrian Diktat to be settled by true followers of the Great Movement, not decadent itinerants... commission or no."

"Mark my words, spacer: When I reign, the slack shall be tightened. You would do well to continue to study the teachings of the Supreme Executor, for they map the future of the Persean Sector - and indeed the galaxy."
entries.zh:
"Dolos Macario 竟会倚重你，倒是怪事。说到底... 你这人根本靠不住，哪怕身上揣着委任状。"

Caden 不以为然地摆了摆手，"当然，绝无冒犯阁下之意。你是外人，没受过彻底皈依 Andrada 至高思想才有的纪律与灵魂洗礼。依我看，辛达强权内部的事，该由伟大运动真正的信徒来处置，而不是交给腐化的外来漂泊者... 有没有委任状都一样。"

"记牢我这话，太空人：等我掌了权，松掉的弦都得一根根绷紧。你最好接着研读最高元首的教诲，那上头写着的，是英仙座星域的前途 —— 乃至整个银河的前途。"

entries.en:
"Oxana Hyder? The ruler of the Sindrian Diktat?" Caden forces out a painful-sounding laugh.

"Unthinkable. If not for her obvious skill and faultless record, she would be subject to investigation for subversion. Her commitment to the Andradan ideology is lackluster at the best of times."
entries.zh:
"Oxana Hyder？统治 辛达强权？" Caden 挤出来一段让人听着耳痛的大笑。

"异想天开。如果不是因为她明显是个有能力的人，之前的记录也都毫无瑕疵，我定会以煽动颠覆对她进行调查。她驾驭 Andrada 伟大思想的能力撑死了也就是乏善可陈。"

entries.en:
You watch the thoughts ooze through Caden's head.

"Which... would be exactly why Macario would select her as his puppet. She possesses a mere handful of subjective beliefs that could be twisted by a man used to operating within the disorderly mindset of criminal degenerates..."

"It is preposterous," he shakes his head once, medals set a-jingle, disturbed by the notion that such forces would align against him. One can't help but suspect his dismissal of the idea is for show.
entries.zh:
你看着 Caden 脑袋里的思绪慢慢从他嘴里漏出来。

"这... 这正是 Macario 会用她当傀儡的原因。作为一个整天和罪犯脑袋里的混乱思维打交道的人，他可以轻易地扭曲她脑子里本就不多的主见..."

"荒唐。" 他摇了下头，带着他一身的勋章叮铃作响，有如此强大的势力在针对他的可能性明显地让他感到了不安。这很让人怀疑他刚刚对这一可能性的质疑只不过是面子功夫罢了。

entries.en:
"Oh?" Caden makes a show of chuckling, rolls his eyes at this conspiratorial talk for his bridge crew, then activates a privacy field around his command station.

He drops the expression.

"My loyalty to the vision of Philip Andrada is beyond reproach. I am his right hand. If what you say is true, spacer, then what exactly is Macario playing at?"
entries.zh:
"哦？" Caden 在他的舰桥船员面前装模做样地轻笑几声，仿佛对你这套阴谋论的说法嗤之以鼻。但他随即激活了他指挥台周围的隐私场。

他脸上的假笑消失了。

"我对 Philip Andrada 伟大愿景的忠心不容置疑。我乃他的右手。如果你所说属实，太空佬，Macario 在耍什么花招？"

o.en: Nothing. Your loyalty to the Lion is obviously beyond reproach.
o.zh: 什么都没耍，无人能够质疑你对雄狮的忠心。

o.en: As I said. Macario suspects you of deviation, and favors Hyder. (lie)
o.zh: 如我所说，Macario 怀疑你变心，打算偏向 Hyder。 (说谎)

o.en: As I said. Macario believes he will rule the Diktat with you as his puppet.
o.zh: 如我所说，Macario 认为他可以通过以你为傀儡统治 辛达强权。

entries.en:
"Me? A Puppet?" Caden forces out a painful-sounding laugh.

"That spider has been cooped up too long in his torture-bunker. Too far from the martial leadership that produces men of quality," Caden thumps his chest, setting medals jingling.
entries.zh:
"我？傀儡？" Caden 挤出一段让人听着耳痛的大笑。

"那只蜘蛛在他自己的酷刑地堡里缩太久了。他太远离能够培育有能之士的军队指挥层了。" Caden 拍了下胸口，一枚枚勋章叮铃作响。

o.en: He thinks he's smarter than you.
o.zh: 他认为他远比你要聪明。

entries.en: "I shall... let him talk as he wishes. Let him show his true nature," Caden says coldly. "Better that all recognize who he is now, so that his downfall will be all the more satisfying."
entries.zh: "我会...让他说他想说的。让他露出他本来的面目。" Caden 冷冷地说道，"最好现在就看清他是个什么东西，这样他倒台时才会更大快人心。"

entries.en:
You explain Macario's words describing Caden as liking to 'play dress-up and have parades' you can see the color rising again in his face.

"I shall... allow him to talk foolishness as he wishes. Let him show his true nature," Caden says with cold anticipation. "He will scheme his way into his own trap, and his downfall will be all the more satisfying."

He nods to himself, perhaps pondering how he will deal with Macario.
entries.zh:
你将 Macario 对 Caden '喜好打扮的装腔作势，沉迷阅兵' 的评价告知了 Caden，你可以看到他脸上又起了颜色。

"我会...让他说他想说的。让他露出他本来的面目，" Caden 言语里有着冷酷的期待，"他最终会把自己算进自己的陷阱之中，这样他倒台时才会更大快人心。"

他自己点了点头，或许是在思考如何应对 Macario。

entries.en: "Yes. Absolutely." Caden slams one fist into the other, for emphasis.
entries.zh: "是的。完全疯了。" Caden 狠狠将两拳相击以示他的强调。

entries.en: "Good. That I expect at the very least."
entries.zh: "好，至少这一点不出我所料。"

o.en: When the time comes, I will help you against Macario.
o.zh: 等时机来临时，我会帮你对付 Macario。

o.en: When the time comes, I will help you against Macario. (lie)
o.zh: 等时机来临时，我会帮你对付 Macario。 (说谎)

entries.en:
"Naturally, I do not need the assistance of outsiders like yourself. But."

He looks slightly up and to the side - a practiced pose to emphasize his retreating jawline.

"It is the sign of sound intuition to align yourself with the Great Movement, to pledge yourself toward a cause which, though you are ignorant of its particulars, shines with the genius of Philip Andrada. Study well his writings and you may begin to understand the glorious future which awaits."
entries.zh:
"自然，我用不上你这类外人协助。但是，"

他抬起头，稍稍偏向侧面 —— 这个久经练习的姿势可以凸显他干练的侧脸。"即使你对 Philip Andrada 的智慧光芒一无所知，投身并致力于伟大运动依然表明你拥有优秀的直觉。好好学习他的著作，你会理解将要来临的光辉未来。"

entries.en:
He turns, as if you're not worth addressing.

"You have captured an asset pledged to my authority. Surrender them immediately and I might contemplate leniency at the dictation of your punishment."
entries.zh: 他转过身，仿佛你根本不配与他正面交谈。"你抓捕了归属于我辖下的人员。立刻将其归还，我或许还能考虑在宣布对你的处分时开恩。"

entries.en: "Glory to the Sindrian Diktat! Victory to the Lion of Sindria!" Caden says fervently.
entries.zh: "荣耀归于辛达强权！胜利归于辛达瑞亚之狮！" Caden 狂热地说到。

entries.en:
Was it worth it to see that shade of red on Caden's face? Perhaps not.

But it felt good.

You have little time to relish it, however.
entries.zh:
只为看 Caden 脸上那抹愠色，这值得吗？也许并不。

但感觉真不错。

然而，你没有太多时间来欣赏这一刻。

entries.en:
Your technology officer makes quick work of cleaning up the core and setting up a short-range EM field interface.

It doesn't take long for a report: the contents of the filesystem held on the core are encrypted, of course, by Tri-Tachyon's best.

There is readable metadata, however.
entries.zh:
你的技术军官很快就清理了核心，同时还建立起一个短程电磁场传输接口。

不久，一份报告得以出具：核心文件系统内保存的内容受到了加密，加密程度可谓竭尽 速子科技 所能。

然而，还有元数据可读。

entries.en:
"It's hard to say," your tech officer looks hesitant. "I mean, Andrada. A list of names? I'd say family of some kind, but it doesn't match anything in the public demography file on Philip Andrada."
