"But um, it comes down to the metadata. If you examine that, all of the encrypted archives were created over a period of about a month back in cycle 182. And then all them except ANDRADA-PERSEUS have been updated within the last week or so."
entries.zh:
"不好说。" 你的技术军官有些犹豫，"我的意思是，为什么有一大堆标着 Andrada 的名字？我猜这是某种家族，但是这跟 Philip Andrada 在公共人口普查记录里的信息不符。"

"但，呃，说到底还是得看元数据。您看，检查以后我们发现所有加密数据库都是在 182 星历年时的某一个月内集中创建的。而且除了 ANDRADA-PERSEUS 以外，所有的数据库都在过去一周左右被更新过。"

entries.en:
"Or what didn't happen," your tech officer glances up, and, nervous at being seen as impertinent, quickly continues.

"Perseus was last updated near the end of cycle 205. As if, well, as if a telemetry feed stopped. Or lost contact."
entries.zh:
"或者有什么事没发生。" 你的技术军官抬头看向你，有些紧张地担心自己是否僭越了，然后继续说了下去。

"Perseus 的最后一次更新是 205 星历年的年底。就像是，呃，遥控观测停止了，或者联系中断了。"

entries.en:
Your technology officer nods at the implication.

"I'll throw the standard breakers at the decrypt job, but it's theoretically impossible it'll crack before the end of the universe. If you want to read these files, we're going to need another way in."

You have backups of the files made.

Whatever has Macario got his fingers into?
entries.zh:
你的技术军官点头认同了你的言外之意。

"我会用标准破解器去试一下解密，但理论上在宇宙终结之前它都不可能被破解。如果你想查阅这些文件的话，我们还需要另找些门路才行。"

你为所有文件做了备份。

Macario 到底把手伸进了什么地方？

entries.en:
Your technology officer nods at the implication.

"I'll throw the standard breakers at the decrypt job, but it's theoretically impossible it'll crack before the end of the universe. If you want to read these files, we're going to need another way in."

You have backups of the files made.

Whatever has Macario got his fingers into?

"我会用标准破解器去试一下解密，但理论上在宇宙终结之前它都不可能被破解。如果你想查阅这些文件的话，我们还需要另找些门路才行。"

你为所有文件做了备份。

Macario 到底把手伸进了什么地方？

entries.en:
Your sensors officer surveys the dead and cooling debris field; summary scans indicate no active vac-suits or intact ship compartments. Macario's agent is almost certainly dead.

The transponder, however, is still alive - barely.

A salvage drone retrieves the upper portion of a burnt and blasted corpse. Your ops chief personally extracts the intact datacore, just a quick twist with a pair of pliers.

It awaits your inspection.
entries.zh:
你的传感器技官调查了死寂且冰冷的残骸区；简略扫描显示没有仍活跃的真空服或完好的船舱。Macario 的特工基本上是死定了。

但应答器居然还在工作，至少勉强还在工作。

一架打捞无人机找回了一具尸体的被烧焦炸碎之后的上半身。你的行动长官亲自把完好无损的数据核心搞了出来，也就是用把钳子麻利地拧一下的事儿。

它等待着你的检查。

entries.en:
Her eyes fix on you. She doesn't like this question, not one bit.

"That is no business of yours."
entries.zh:
她的眼睛盯着你。她不喜欢这个问题，一点也不。

"这不关你事。"

entries.en:
Her eyes fix on you. She doesn't like the question.

"Too long," she says evenly.
entries.zh:
她的眼睛盯着你。她不喜欢这个问题。

"太长时间了。" 她语气平静。

o.en: He is not well, is he.

entries.en: Oxana Hyder appears on the comms, already seething.
entries.zh: Oxana Hyder 出现在通讯器画面里，早已火冒三丈。

entries.en:
"A commander should never abandon their command," Hyder states this like cold fact. "Never."

"Dereliction of duty is treason enough. Better to face Macario's machinations with an honorable death than let his lies and subterfuge corrupt our sacred duty."
entries.zh:
"舰队指挥官永远不可渎职。" Hyder 冰冷地抛出了既定事实，"那绝无可能。"

"渎职足以称为叛国。对叛国者来说，哪怕直面 Macario 阴谋，最终光荣赴死，也好过任由 Macario 的谎话连篇，Macario 的百般欺诈，继续腐蚀我们的光荣使命。"

entries.en:
"A crew's duty is to follow the orders of a superior officer. That officer assumes moral responsibility for failure. Disobedience requires court-martial for the grave crime of mutiny."

"It is better to face Macario's machinations with an honorable death than allow his subterfuge to corrupt sacred duty."
entries.zh:
"船员的职责，就是听命于他们的指挥官。即便面临失败，全体船员的道德负担也应当由指挥官一人担负。哗变者应当交由军事法庭，以哗变重罪论处。"

"对于哗变者，哪怕直面 Macario 阴谋，最终光荣赴死，也好过任由 Macario 的百般欺诈继续腐蚀我们的光荣使命。"

entries.en:
Hyder looks at you for a moment, her opinion perhaps shifting.

"I appreciate your honesty. It is more than I would expect from one of Macario's creatures."
entries.zh:
Hyder 盯着你看了一会，似乎她对你的看法发生了某种转变。

"我欣赏你的诚实，能从 Macario 手下的喽啰口中听到这种话，真是出乎意料。"

entries.en:
Hyder looks at you for a moment, her opinion perhaps shifting.

"I appreciate your honesty. It is the least I would expect from a bearer of a Hegemony commission. I can't say I understand why you are playing at being one of Macario's creatures."
entries.zh:
Hyder 盯着你看了一会，似乎她对你的看法发生了某种转变。

"我欣赏你的诚实，能接受 霸主 雇佣的人，好歹也该有这种品格。话虽如此，我不太理解你为什么这么胡搞，偏要去 Macario 手下当喽啰。"

entries.en:
She frowns. Then, instead of denying your claim, says "Typical of Macario. He mistakes cruelty for discipline and fear for obedience. He's a sad prototype of the Diktat's 'new man'."

Hyder looks at you for a moment, her opinion perhaps shifting. It's easy to see that she hates Macario, and easy to re-align her anger away from yourself.

"You are correct to conduct yourself honestly, despite the appearance of the circumstances," she says.
entries.zh:
她皱眉，但却没有反驳你的说法。"确实是 Macario 那家伙一贯的作风。他这个人错把残忍当做纪律，误将恐惧当成服从。辛达强权 治下 '新国民' 的模范竟然是他这副模样，真是令人悲哀。"

Hyder 盯着你看了一会，似乎她对你的看法发生了某种转变。显而易见，她不仅憎恨 Macario，也很容易就能转变愤怒的对象。

"虽然你闹出了这种事，但最终你还是悬崖勒马，老实坦白了，做得对。" 她说道。

entries.en:
"Following orders," Hyder grits her teeth, "even secret orders, from the highest authority of the navy to ensure the effective operation of military assets is not treason."

Disgust fully enters her voice now, "No matter how Macario tries to twist the truth."

"Half of the so-called 'intelligence operations' performed under his authority could well be called treason, but I don't make it my business to meddle as he does."
entries.zh:
"这是服从命令。" Hyder 咬着牙，说，"哪怕他服从的是海军最高层下达的密令，那也是为了保证军用设备高效周转，算不得叛国。" 说到此处，她的厌恶之情溢于言表，"这件事不能算叛国，无论 Macario 那宵小之辈如何极力扭曲真相。"

"他授意下进行的那些所谓的 '情报行动'，得有个一半都能算作叛国，但我和他不一样，我可不靠这 '叛国' 的勾当过活。"

entries.en:
Hyder looks displeased. "Then we find ourselves at an impasse, captain, with each sworn to uphold what each believes to be their duty."

A pause, then she continues, "Your conviction is as undeniable as it is misplaced, captain. Let us table the matter."

It sounds like she's going to let you get away with it without admitting it. Interesting. Best play along.
entries.zh:
Hyder 看起来非常不快。"然后我们将会发现我们现在陷入死局了，舰长，每个人都发誓要坚守自己认定的职责。"

一阵停顿，然后她继续说道："你的看法无可辩驳，舰长。让我们把这件事暂时搁置起来。"

听起来她会对你带着犯人逃走这件事睁一只眼闭一只眼。真是有趣，最好配合一下她。

entries.en: Hyder's expression hardens. "Does your oath of commission to the Sindrian Diktat mean nothing? You gave your word then. What of now?"
entries.zh: Hyder 的表情凝固了。"难道对 辛达强权 发下的就职宣誓对你来说毫无意义？你立下过誓言。那它们现在又算什么？"

o.en: You are right, the oath I swore is more important. I will make the report.
o.zh: 你是对的，我曾发过的誓更加重要。我将会做一份报告。

o.en: I would be a coward if I did not follow my judgment. I accept all consequences.
o.zh: 如果我连自己内心的正义都不遵从的话，那我只不过是一个懦夫，我自愿接受一切后果。

entries.en: She looks at you, calculating something that doesn't please her.
entries.zh: 她看着你，盘算着一些让她不高兴的事情。

entries.en:
"He conducts himself without a shred of honor while wrapped in the banner of the Supreme Executor. He twists the words of Philip Andrada to serve his own degenerate desires."

She pauses, seething.
entries.zh: "他在打着 最高元首 旗号行事之时毫无一丝荣耀。他恶意扭曲 Philip Andrada 的话语来满足自身腐败堕落的渴望。" 她停顿了一下，怒火中烧。

entries.en:
"He conducts himself without a shred of honor while wrapped in the banner of the Supreme Executor. He twists the words of Philip Andrada to serve his own degenerate desires."

She pauses, seething.
entries.zh: "他在打着 最高元首 旗号行事之时毫无一丝荣耀。他恶意扭曲 Philip Andrada 的话语来满足自身腐败堕落的渴望。" 她停顿了一下，怒火中烧。

entries.en: "Then I would demand you re-evaluate your perception of his goals," Hyder says haughtily.
entries.zh: "然后我需要你重新评估一下你对他目标的看法了。" Hyder 傲慢地说。

entries.en: "He did," she admits, and without hesitation continues: "Nonetheless, my officer failed their mission and their position. An officer who delivers defeat to their commander must face that fact honorably, not discard their uniform and duty to flee like a coward. To that point."
entries.zh: "Macario 确实难逃其咎。" 她先是承认，之后毫无迟疑的继续说了下去，"即便如此，的确还是我手下的那名军官最终未能完成任务，还犯下了渎职之罪。若有军官让自己的指挥者蒙受失败，他就该心怀荣耀，去面对自己行动的一切后果，而不是就这样脱掉制服甘当懦夫。言尽于此。"

entries.en:
"Your command-instinct to look to the wellbeing of the crew is admirable," she concedes.

Then her eyes narrow, "But beware over-indulgence in mercy; it will make you weak. As Andrada said, 'A true leader understands that victory is bought with casualties'."

"So: if the greatest good is to uphold the law, then this crew shall serve that cause by providing an example of its execution."
entries.zh:
"你很有指挥官的直觉，会关心船员的安危，值得钦佩。" 她承认道。

然后，她眯起双眼。"然而，小心你的宽容变为放纵，那样的话，你就会变得更加孱弱。Andrada 曾言道：'真正的领袖应当理解，胜利背后总要有牺牲。' "

"所以说，如果捍卫法律权威真是正道的话，这群船员也应当亲身证道，让大家看看，法律如何运作。"

entries.en: Her eyes narrow. "They are. And seeing as you are presently within the legal and ethical volume of the Sindrian Diktat, you must respect our laws."
entries.zh: 她眯起双眼："那名军官确实犯了叛国罪。而且，既然你现在身处 辛达强权 法律道德范围之内，你就得尊重我们的法律。"

o.en: Look, I just did the job. Your laws and your ethics are your business.
o.zh: 你看，所以我就出手了，你那 '法律'，'道德' 就是你自己的事了。

o.en: That seems harsh. It is Macario who manufactured the dilemma.
o.zh: 你的处置有点太严苛了，Macario 才是让那人身处两难局面的罪魁祸首。

o.en: The crew merely intended to uphold the law; it is Macario who manufactured the dilemma.
o.zh: 船员们只是想要捍卫法律尊严而已。Macario 才是让他们身处两难局面的罪魁祸首。

o.en: You're right. Mutiny is absolutely unacceptable in a warfleet.
o.zh: 你说得对。军舰舰队中决不能容许有哗变。

o.en: You're right. Mutiny is absolutely unacceptable in a warfleet. (lie)
o.zh: 你说得对。军舰舰队中决不能容许有哗变。 (说谎)

o.en: You're right, a true officer would stand by their position, even unto death.
o.zh: 你说得对，真正的指挥官就该恪守岗位，哪怕面对死亡威胁也不该渎职。

o.en: You're right, a true officer would stand by their position, even unto death. (lie)
o.zh: 你说得对，真正的指挥官就该恪守岗位，哪怕面对死亡威胁也不该渎职。 (说谎)

o.en: So you don't approve of Macario's methods.
o.zh: 所以你不同意 Macario 的方法。

o.en: He might interpret your own words as treason.
o.zh: 他可能会把你的话理解为叛国。

o.en: I approve of his goals, if not his methods.
o.zh: 我赞同他的目标，如果不是用他那套的话。

entries.en: "Macario says what is useful to himself. Observe the results of his actions: paranoia, inefficiency, and lawlessness."
entries.zh: 她继续说着："Macario 只讲自己用得上的话。看看他的行为都造成了什么：偏执、低效、目无法纪。"

entries.en: "Then we stand together on this matter of honor," she says with a nod.
entries.zh: "那么我们将在这个关乎荣誉的问题上站在一起。" 她点点头说。

entries.en: "He would in an instant," she spits, "if it served his next degenerate scheme."
entries.zh: "他立刻就会把我的话打成叛国。" 她唾骂道，"只要抹黑我能够推进他的阴谋，他立刻就会这么做的。"

entries.en: "I see," Hyder says flatly.
entries.zh: "我知道了。" Hyder 平静地说。

entries.en:
"I find difficulty in accepting your word in this matter, as you did not fight a battle with our patrol fleet while this officer was in command."

"I would be terribly disappointed if I discovered you were lying."
entries.zh:
"我发现在这件事上我很难接受你的说辞，因为你并没有在这名军官参与指挥的情况下与我们的巡逻队作战。"

"如果我发现你在撒谎，我将会非常非常地失望。"

o.en: I stand by my word. As an officer.
o.zh: 作为一名军官，我信守诺言。

o.en: With apologies, I promised to release this officer on an independent world.
o.zh: 抱歉，我承诺将这位军官释放到一个独立世界上。

o.en: With apologies, Macario also told me to lie about this to gauge your reaction. (lie)
o.zh: 抱歉，Macario 还让我在这件事上撒谎，以衡量你的反应。 (说谎)

entries.en: "Although dissatisfying, I shall accept your word as an officer that this is the truth."
entries.zh: "尽管我对此非常不满，但我作为一名军官仍接受你的说辞，那的确是对的。"

entries.en:
"Indeed," says Hyder.

You can see on her face that she believes you are lying and is choosing not to call you out on it in this moment. Macario was right- she would not make a good politician.
entries.zh:
"确实如此。" Hyder 说。

你可以从她的脸上看出她认为你在撒谎且选择不在此刻揭穿你。Macario 是对的 —— 她成不了一名优秀的政治家。

entries.en:
"I see," Hyder says flatly. "I appreciate that, as an officer, you are bound to keep your word. However the law of the ruling polity of a volume overrides the necessity to uphold your word."

"I offer this: your objection will be recorded, then you will transfer the prisoner. This will fulfill your honorable obligation as well as uphold the law."
entries.zh:
"我明白了。" Hyder 平静地说。"我很欣赏这一点，作为一个军官，你必须遵守诺言。不过无论如何，任何一卷统治国家的法律都凌驾于你的说辞之上。

"我的提议是：你的反对会被记录下来，然后你再转移犯人。这样在法律被维护的同时，你荣耀的承诺也得到了履行。"

o.en: I shall transfer the prisoner to your custody.
o.zh: 我将会把犯人交到你手上。

o.en: Macario issued the arrest warrant. I will take the officer to him.
o.zh: Macario 发出了逮捕令。我将会将这名军官交给他。

entries.en:
Hyder closes her eyes and rubs the bridge of her nose; it seems that she does not enjoy the prospect of lie and counter-lie.

"Typical Macario," she says finally, her anger now - mostly - directed away from yourself. "No more games! Transfer the prisoner to my custody so that a proper court-martial may proceed."

She fixes you with her glare. "Do this by the proper order of things, each in its place. This is the way of the Sindrian Diktat."
entries.zh:
Hyder 闭上了她的眼睛并擦了擦她的鼻梁；看来她不喜欢和你陷入谎言和反谎言的无尽泥潭中。

"这太 Macario 了。" 她最终说道，现在她的愤怒 —— 绝大部分 —— 都从你那里转移了，"游戏到此为止！现在立马把犯人给我交过来！只有这样才能进行正规的军事法庭审判。"

她对你怒目而视。"凡事都要按次序办，每个人都各司其职。这就是 辛达强权 的行事风格。"

o.en: I will transfer them to your custody immediately.
o.zh: 我马上就将那人交给你。

o.en: Macario issued the arrest warrant. I will take the prisoner to him.
o.zh: Macario 发布了这则逮捕令。我会把这位军官交给他。

entries.en:
Hyder closes her eyes and rubs the bridge of her nose; it seems that she does not enjoy the prospect of lie and counter-lie.

"Typical Macario," she says finally, her anger now - mostly - directed away from yourself.

"Tell Macario," she spits his name out like a morsel of rotten food, "that my loyalty to the Supreme Executor is unquestionable. And that I shall be making a report of his waste of naval resources to my superior."
entries.zh:
Hyder 闭上眼睛，揉着鼻梁；看来她并不喜欢这种谎言与真相交织的场面。

"这就是 Macario。" 她最后说。她的怒火，现在，大部分已从你的身上移开。

"告诉 Macario。" 她吐出他的名字，就像吐出已经腐烂的食物，"我对最高元首的忠诚是毋庸置疑的。我将向我的上司报告他挥霍海军资源的情况。"

entries.en:
"So you are a creature of Macario," says Hyder, her anger suppressed neatly under an officious demeanor. "I will take this matter all the way to the office of the Supreme Executor, if I must."

She takes a deep breath.
entries.zh:
"所以你是 Macario 手下的喽啰。" Hyder 说到，她的愤怒被一种戏谑的心态完全压住了，"如果有必要的话，我会把这件事一直闹到最高元首的办公室去。"

她深深地吸了一口气。

entries.en:
"I see," Hyder says flatly. "I appreciate that, as an officer, you are bound to keep your word. However the law of the ruling polity of a volume overrides your personal promise."

"I offer this: your objection will be recorded, then you will transfer the prisoner. This will fulfill your honorable obligation as well as uphold the law."
entries.zh:
"我明白了。" Hyder 平静地说。"我很欣赏这一点，作为一个军官，你必须遵守诺言。不过无论如何，任何一卷统治国家的法律都凌驾于你个人的承诺之上。"

"我的提议是：你的反对会被记录下来，然后你再转移犯人。这样在你履行了你荣耀的承诺的同时法律也得到了维护。"

o.en: Then, with objection, I shall transfer the prisoner to your custody.
o.zh: 这样的话，即便我反对，我也会将囚犯交到你手上。

o.en: I must insist. If my words mean nothing, then I am nothing.
o.zh: 我必须坚持自己的判断。如果我说过的话都毫无分量，说改就改的话，那我这个人也一样毫无分量了。

o.en: I must insist. If my words mean nothing, then I am nothing. (lie)
o.zh: 我必须坚持自己的判断。如果我说过的话都毫无分量，说改就改的话，那我这个人也一样毫无分量了。 (说谎)

entries.en:
Hyder looks thoughtful. "Then we find ourselves at an impasse, captain, with each sworn to uphold their highest duty and loyalty."

A pause, then she continues, "Your conviction is undeniable, captain. Let us table the matter."

It sounds like she's going to let you get away with the prisoner, without admitting it. Interesting. Best play along.
entries.zh:
Hyder 看起来正在思考。"然后我们将会发现我们现在陷入死局了，舰长，每个人都发誓要坚守自己的最高职责与忠诚。"

一阵停顿，然后她继续说道："你的看法无可辩驳，舰长。让我们把这件事暂时搁置起来。"

听起来她会对你带着犯人逃走这件事睁一只眼闭一只眼。真是有趣，最好配合一下她。

entries.en: Hyder's expression hardens. "Does your oath of commission to the Sindrian Diktat mean nothing? You gave your word then."
entries.zh: Hyder 的表情凝固了。"难道对 辛达强权 发下的就职宣誓对你来说毫无意义？你立下过誓言。"

o.en: You are right, that loyalty is higher. I will order the transfer.
o.zh: 你说得对，忠诚更重要。我会下令转交囚犯的。

o.en: I would be a coward and a liar if I did not follow my judgment. I accept all consequences.
o.zh: 若是我无法坚守自己立下的判断的话，那我就是懦夫、骗子了。我还是坚持我的判断，并且愿意承担一切责任。

entries.en:
"Interesting." She looks away for a moment, thinking another thought, but quickly returns focus to you.

"Your conviction is undeniable, captain, and that is worth something. Let us table the matter."

It sounds like she's going to let you get away with the prisoner, without admitting it. Interesting. Best play along.
entries.zh:
"有意思。"她的目光游离了一会，想了想别的什么事，但很快她的注意力又回到你身上。

"你的信念毋庸置疑，舰长，这种信念终究有所值。让我们先搁置这件事。"

听起来她会对你带着犯人逃走这件事睁一只眼闭一只眼。真是有趣，最好配合一下她。

entries.en:
"I see," Hyder says flatly. "I appreciate that, as an officer, you were bound to keep your word. However the law of the ruling polity of a volume overrides your personal promise."

She closes her eyes for a moment, sighs, then says "Provide me with a report of your last sighting of the officer in question. I shall consider this the least acceptable diligence in upholding our law."
entries.zh:
"我明白了。" Hyder 平静地说。"我很欣赏这一点，作为一个军官，你必须遵守诺言。不过无论如何，任何一卷统治国家的法律都凌驾于你个人的承诺之上。"

她闭上眼睛，思考一阵，轻叹了一口气，然后说道："给我一份你上次目击那名军官的报告，在我看来，若是还要维护法律权威，这已经是可接受范围内你最基础的职责了。"

o.en: I must insist on not doing so. If my word means nothing, then I am nothing.
o.zh: 我必须坚持自己的判断。如果我说过的话都毫无分量，说改就改的话，那我这个人也一样毫无分量了。

o.en: I must insist on not doing so. If my word means nothing, then I am nothing. (lie)
o.zh: 我必须坚持自己的判断。如果我说过的话都毫无分量，说改就改的话，那我这个人也一样毫无分量了。 (说谎)

entries.en:
You order your comms officer to write a brief report fulfilling the letter of Hyder's demands, and it is quickly sent off.

"I deem this sufficient," Hyder says after giving her datapad a quick glance.
entries.zh:
你命令你的通讯军官按照 Hyder 信中的需求去写一篇简短的报告，并迅速发出。

"我觉得这样就够了。" Hyder 在瞥了自己的数据平板一眼后说到。

entries.en:
You order your comms officer to write a brief report fulfilling the letter of Hyder's demands, and it is quickly sent off.

"I deem this sufficient," Hyder says after giving her datapad a quick glance.
entries.zh:
你命令你的通讯军官按照 Hyder 信中的需求去写一篇简短的报告，并迅速发出。

"我觉得这样就够了。" Hyder 在瞥了自己的数据平板一眼后说到。

entries.en:
"I see," Hyder says flatly.

"I offer this: your objection will be recorded, then you will transfer the prisoner. I shall assume responsibility for the question of jurisdiction. This will fulfill your obligation and leave the matter to the law of the Sindrian Diktat."
entries.zh:
"我明白了。" Hyder 平静地说。

"我的提议是：你的反对会被记录下来，然后你再转移犯人。我将承担关于管辖权问题的责任。这样你就履行了你的义务，把这件事交给 辛达强权 的法律去处理吧。"

o.en: I accept. I'll have the prisoner sent to you immediately.
o.zh: 我接受，我马上就把犯人交给你。

o.en: I must insist. This is Macario's prisoner.
o.zh: 你说得对，但是这是 Macario 的犯人。

entries.en: "Good," Hyder says, then gives orders to a subordinate to begin the process of prisoner transfer.
entries.zh: "好。" Hyder 说道，然后她命令下属开始转移囚犯的程序。

entries.en:
You had made a deal to set the officer free on the first independent world you visited. They will view you poorly for this breach of trust, but then, they are simply one rogue Sindrian Diktat officer with very few friends.

If it is any consolation, Hyder's court-martial is likely to be a less cruel fate than whatever Macario had in mind.
entries.zh:
你和那名军官商定将会把他释放到一个你去过的独立世界上。由于你的失信，这名军官将会看不起你，不过说到底，那名军官只不过是一个在英仙座星域没啥朋友的 辛达强权 流浪军官。

如果说有什么可以称得上安慰的话，Hyder 手下的军事法庭比起 Macario 脑子里的各种折磨点子，论残酷程度要轻上不少。

entries.en: The speed at which Hyder smashes the privacy field activation switch is impressive for a woman of her years.
entries.zh: Hyder 猛地按下隐私场激活的开关。她这个年纪的女人还有这种手速，令人印象深刻。

entries.en:
After a long moment, she sighs.

"Whatever Macario told you, whatever you believe and think you know, the future of the Sindrian Diktat... will be determined without your meddling."

She sounds more tired than ever before.
entries.zh:
许久之后，她叹了口气。

"无论 Macario 告诉你什么，无论你相信和认为你知道什么，辛达强权 的未来...将会在没有你干预的情况下决定。"

她听起来比之前更疲惫了。

entries.en:
She looks suddenly more tired than ever before.

"If the Supreme Executor was dead, we wouldn't be having this conversation. Macario would like to line his pieces up just right. And you're as good as one of them."
entries.zh:
她突然看起来比之前更疲惫了。

"如果最高元首已死，我们连这次对话的机会都不会有。Macario 会把他的棋子们排列得恰到好处。而你也不过只是其中之一罢了。"

entries.en:
"So Macario told you that much," she says, and sighs, looking more tired than ever before. She seems to think something over, and comes to a decision.

"The Supreme Executor isn't dead," she says, "not yet." She almost breathes the next word, "barely."

"I fear when he dies we shall be thrown into the crisis manufactured by Macario. It could undo everything we fought for." She rubs her face with her hands, "Would that the good ones who followed Admiral Andrada all those years ago were not taken from us. Would that the worst did not rise to the top."
entries.zh:
"这样啊，Macario 告诉了你那么多。" 她说完便叹了口气，看起来前所未有的疲惫。她看起来在仔细考虑什么事，并终于下定了决心。

"最高元首还没死呢。" 她说，"至少现在还没。" 说着说着，她的声音也越来越轻，说到最后近乎耳语，"但也不过是苟延残喘。"

"我怕，我怕他去世之后我们就要落入 Macario 亲手编织的危机之中。" 说着说着，她双手使劲揉了一下脸，"怎奈长久以来追随 Andrada 将军的善人们大都已离我们而去，怎奈奸邪之徒乘此机会擢得高位。"

entries.en: "I have little patience for this," she says. "Choose your words carefully."
entries.zh: "我对这件事没什么耐心。" 她说道，"注意你的措辞。"

entries.en:
"Enough," she says. "Make your report back to Macario. And consider your words carefully."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"够了，" 她说道，"向 Macario 汇报。并仔细考虑你的话。"

通讯中断了。

entries.en: "I have little patience for this," she says. "Choose your words carefully."
entries.zh: "我对这件事没什么耐心。" 她说道，"注意你的措辞。"

entries.en:
"Enough," she says. "Make your report back to Macario. And consider your words carefully."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
"够了，" 她说道，"向 Macario 汇报。并仔细考虑你的话。"

通讯中断了。

entries.en: Hyder smoothly hits the privacy field activation switch, blinks, then faces you.
entries.zh: Hyder 从容地按下了隐私场的按钮，眼神闪烁了几下，然后才看向你。

entries.en: "Silence yourself!" she almost snarls. "Speak no more treason to me."
entries.zh: "给我安静！" 她几乎是在咆哮，"别再跟我说叛国的歪理了！"

entries.en:
She looks at you for a long, long moment.

"I am, to them, a traitor. Do you know the justice a traitor-in-combat is served? Execution, by will of the commanding officer."

She pauses, watching you. "There is good reason this is so."

Which, you note, does not answer your question.
entries.zh:
她盯着你看了很久很久。

"在 霸主 他们看来，我已经是个叛徒了。你知道战场上对叛国罪的处罚是什么呢？死刑，由指挥官亲手执行。" 她顿了一下，看着你。"他们这么处理，可是有理由的。"

你注意到，她其实在答非所问。

entries.en: It feels like she trusts you. Or, at least, she respects the impression you have made so far and would like someone to trust.
entries.zh: 看起来她很相信你。最起码，她尊重你到目前为止给她留下的印象，并希望有个能信任的人。

entries.en: You've made a mixed impression; it feels like she doesn't quite trust you, but she is operating in a nest of vipers and wants to trust someone, somehow.
entries.zh: 你给她留下的印象非常复杂：好像她不太信任你，但是她现在身处毒蛇的巢穴之中，她希望，无论如何，能有人可以信任。

entries.en: She doesn't trust you. And she would like nothing more than to have an ally who she trusts and respects after operating alone in the regimented chaos of the Sindrian Diktat bureaucracy. You have only the briefest opening here.
entries.zh: 她并不相信你。在独自经历 辛达强权 官僚的死板式混乱后，她现在无比希望能有一个值得信赖与尊重的盟友。在拉拢她这件事上，你只打出了最小的切入口。

entries.en: She doesn't trust you. She doesn't like you. She thinks you're working for Macario, or at least working to be on his level. At least your position is clear.
entries.zh: 她不相信你，她也不喜欢你。她觉得你正在为 Macario 所工作，最起码也至少是为了达到他的水平而努力。最起码你的立场是明确的。

entries.en:
She lets out a joyless, cynical laugh.

"No, not me. I am not a great man like Philip Andrada. Give me a fleet, my orders, and my cause. That is all I need to do my duty."

She looks up and away, "He is... he was different. He had vision, and a surety of purpose that moved history by will alone."
entries.zh:
她发出愤世嫉俗的大笑。

"不，不会是我。我不是像 Philip Andrada 那样的伟人。给我一支舰队，我的命令和我的事业。这就是我履行职责所需的全部。"

她抬起头，然后移开视线，"他是...曾经是与众不同的。他有远见，他的目标坚定到仅靠意志就能推动历史。"

o.en: How about the Lion's Guard? Could Caden lead?
o.zh: 那狮心卫队怎么样？Caden 能当领袖吗？

o.en: Sometimes the best leaders are those who don't want the position. Consider it.
o.zh: 有时，不想当领袖的人反倒最适合当领袖，你再考虑考虑吧。

o.en: Let us talk of other things.

entries.en:
"Provided the navy did not stand in his way, provided the Supreme Executor was... dead. Then he would be the next in line."

"Could he lead?" She scoffs. "The Lion's Guard is his personal empire, his church, his cult, sucking up resources for a parade-navy. We could have made the Sindrian Diktat strong, even great, but Caden had to start a religion."

She looks away.

"Andrada enjoyed the... the worship. He favored Caden, and it blinded him, impaired his judgment. Caden would martyr us all to the idol he's built of Andrada. I doubt even Macario could really control him. I'm sure he thinks he can."
entries.zh:
"如果我们海军不去阻挡他的话，等到最高元首真的...真的逝去之时，他就是下一位元首了。"

"Caden 他能当领袖吗？" 她讥讽道，"依我看，狮心卫队早已变成只对他本人效忠的帝国、只信仰他本人的教会、只崇拜他本人的宗教啦！不过一支 '仪仗队'，却吸走了那么多资源！我们的海军本可以让 辛达强权 更强更伟大，可 Caden 偏要拿部队搞宗教崇拜！"

她看向别处，"Andrada 喜欢得到这种...崇拜。他对 Caden 很是青睐，青睐到昏了头，青睐到失去判断力！让 Caden 上位的话，怕是他会为了把 Andrada 打造成宗教偶像，让我们全部变成殉道者的。我甚至怀疑 Macario 是否真的有让他乖乖听话的手段，不过 Macario 肯定觉得自己能控制得住他吧。"

entries.en:
She just looks at you for a long moment, unspeaking.

The comms cut to a holding pattern.
entries.zh:
她盯着你看了很久，没有说话。

通讯断开，回到了等候界面。

entries.en:
She just looks at you for a long moment, unspeaking.

The comms cut to a holding pattern.
entries.zh:
她盯着你看了很久，没有说话。

通讯断开，回到了等候界面。

entries.en: "And you'll help him do it, I'm sure," she says acidly. "You test Fate's love for irony when you gloat for Macario before he's claimed victory."
entries.zh: "那你就会帮他把我撤掉的，这一点我很确定。" 她尖酸的讥讽道，"若是你在 Macario 还未能取得胜利的时候就如此沾沾自喜的话，你恐怕就要见识到造化弄人了。"

entries.en: "And yet he has not," Hyder says fiercely. "If he could fuel starships and feed their crews with lies alone, he would. But he cannot."
entries.zh: "但他还没法撤掉我呢。" Hyder 凶狠地吐出一句话来，"要是这货能拿他的谎言养活船员、驱动星舰的话，他才能撤掉我，可是他不能。"

entries.en:
"And yet has not," Hyder says fiercely. "He knows that he can't run the navy on threats and lies."

"I give my officers and my crew something to believe. With me, they will find strength in honor, duty, and discipline. These are concepts Macario cannot comprehend, and despite his misallocation of resources, we are stronger than he can imagine. Philip Andrada knew this."
entries.zh:
"但他还没法撤掉我呢。" Hyder 语气凶狠，"他知道，仅靠他的威胁与谎言，可没法让海军行动起来。"

"有我在，我手下的军官们、船员们才有东西可以相信。有我在，他们才能从荣耀、职责、纪律之中汲取力量。这些概念，Macario 可理解不了。无论那家伙怎么搅乱我们的资源配给，我们的强韧总会超乎他的想象。一直以来，Philip Andrada 都了解我们有多么坚韧的。"

o.en: With Philip Andrada as good as gone, what are you loyal to now?
o.zh: Philip Andrada 已经名存实亡，那现在你忠于什么？

o.en: Your superior is incapacitated in a clinic on Sindria, so... who do you report to?
o.zh: 你的上司正在 Sindria 的医疗禁区里卧病在床，这样的话...你该负责向谁汇报工作呢？

o.en: "Why does the Deputy Star Marshal of the Sindrian Diktat need to smuggle weapons?
o.zh: "堂堂 辛达强权 副星际元帅，为什么会需要走私武器呢？

o.en: Shouldn't you be Grand Star Marshal if the current one is incapacitated?
o.zh: 如果现任 星际元帅 无法履职，你不应该顶替他的位置吗？

o.en: And when is the last time you met with Andrada?
o.zh: 然后你最后一次碰见 Andrada 是什么时候？

o.en: Would you return to the Hegemony? I could talk to someone...
o.zh: 你想回到 霸主 吗 ？我可以和某人谈谈...
'若是 Andrada 尚有余心'？就是说，Andrada 已经没有行动能力了？

o.en: You 'would'? And when is the last time you met with Andrada?
o.zh: 你 '会'？那你最后一次碰见 Andrada 是什么时候？

o.en: Who should lead the Sindrian Diktat when Andrada is dead? You?
o.zh: 谁该在 Andrada 死后领导 辛达强权？你吗？

entries.en:
"Now then, I believe our business is concluded for the present," she says.

"Tell Macario," she spits his name out like a rotten piece of food, "that my loyalty to the Supreme Executor is unquestionable. And that I shall be making a report of his waste of naval resources to my superior."
entries.zh:
"然后现在，我想我们的交易到此为止了。" 她说。

"告诉 Macario。" 她吐出他的名字，就像吐出已经腐烂的食物，"我对最高元首的忠诚是毋庸置疑的。我将向我的上司报告他挥霍海军资源的情况。"

entries.en:
She pauses as she reaches toward the comms shut-off.

"What is it, captain."

Macario was right about one thing, at least: Hyder is not difficult to read.
entries.zh:
她正在伸手关闭通讯，听到你的话，一下子停了下来："什么事，舰长？"

Macario 至少在一件事上说对了：Hyder 的心思并不难猜。

entries.en: "The details of military arms procurement by the Sindrian Diktat navy is a matter of polity security," Hyder says with flat yet somehow seething affect. "It is not the business of an outsider. Or of meddlesome worms like Macario."
entries.zh: "辛达强权 海军军火订单的信息关乎国家安全。" Hyder 语调平静，却掩不住语气中的暗潮涌动，"这种信息，外人无权得知，更别说 Macario 那条爱管闲事的蛆虫。"

entries.en:
"Captain. Though not without some character befitting an officer, you are an outsider and cannot be expected to understand."

"The Diktat has enemies within and without; if it is fighting with itself, it will never survive. I must do what I must to maintain our strength even if I am put into," her lip curls, "an intolerable position."
entries.zh:
"舰长，虽然你身上也有些我们军官的特质，但你终归还是个外人，正因此，有些事我也不指望你能懂。"

"辛达强权 内外受敌，若是 辛达强权 内部还要内斗的话，它可没法生存下去。我必须采取一切必需手段保持我们国家的军力强盛 —— 哪怕会让我置身于..." 她唇角略微上扬，"哪怕会让我置身于无法忍受的情况下。"

entries.en:
"Captain. I shall be forthright out of respect for a fellow officer."

"It is," her lip curls in a sneer, "Intolerable. I have not been given due authority, yet I have responsibility for the System Defense Armada."

"Macario, through Caden, seeks to starve my fleets and make me look incompetent. Philip Andrada would never have stood for it, if he was capable. If he wasn't beguiled by flatterers and liars. If he was the Philip Andrada I pledged myself to during the Battle of Salus!"
entries.zh:
"舰长，出于对同僚的尊重，我将直言不讳。"

"怎么说呢，" 她冷笑着噘起嘴唇，"迄今为止我明明要负责管理行星防御舰队，但却完全没有得到应有的权力，这是完全不可接受的。"

"Macario，他想通过 Caden 让我的舰队挨饿，让我显得无能。如果 Philip Andrada 仍然大权在握，如果他没有被阿谀奉承者和说谎者所欺骗，如果他还是我在 Salus 之战所效忠的 Philip Andrada 的话，他绝不会容忍这一点。"

entries.en: Hyder smoothly hits the privacy field switch, blinks, then faces you.
entries.zh: Hyder 平静地按下隐私场的开关，眨了下眼，之后看向你。

entries.en:
"Who told you that?" she demands, "Macario?"

Settling her composure, she continues. "Regardless, the Supreme Executor sits above the senior ministry-level officers of the Sindrian Diktat. I report to him, of course."
entries.zh:
"谁跟你说的？" 她质问道，"Macario？"

在冷静下来之后，她继续道："无论如何，最高元首的地位比任何 辛达强权 高级部门军官都要高。我当然会向他负责。"

entries.en:
"I expect Macario told you that," she says, eyes seemingly fixed on yours through the comms. "Testing my resolve from every angle."

She looks aside for a moment, "It is no wonder the so-called Resistance has lasted this long with the Chief High Inspector-General so committed to doing anything other than his duty."

Settling her composure, she continues. "Regardless, the Supreme Executor sits above the Grand Star Marshal and all ministry-level offices of the Sindrian Diktat. I would report to him, of course."
entries.zh:
"我就知道 Macario 告诉过你这件事。" 她讲着话，双眼紧紧盯在你身上，"这是在从各个角度考验我的决心。"

她向一旁看了一会儿，"难怪所谓的抵抗组织如此难以根除，原来是因为最高检察长身居高位却玩忽职守。"

她镇定下来，继续开口。"不管怎样，最高元首的地位比 星际元帅 和任何 辛达强权高级部门军官都要高。我当然会向他负责。"

entries.en:
"I expect Macario told you that," she says, eyes fixed somewhere above the comms. "Testing my 'loyalty' from every angle, I am sure."

"But it is a problem. To maintain proper hierarchy of authority, the Supreme Executor should have assigned me that rank and the accompanying powers. Then I would be able to simply dictate around the supply deficit Macario and Caden conspired to create."

Still looking elsewhere, "But then, under Andrada, they wouldn't have dared..."
entries.zh:
"我就知道 Macario 告诉过你这件事。" 她讲着话，双眼却直愣愣的看向通讯面板上方某处，"想方设法从一切角度考验我的忠诚度，肯定是那样。"

"但这就是个问题了。若要保持权力阶层秩序森然，最高元首本就该把他的军衔，连带着他的权力，都移交给我的。若是这样，我就可以直接下令，绕开 Macario 与 Caden 两人同谋创造的补给不足问题了。"

她仍然看着别处，补充道："但，再说了，若是 Andrada 尚有余心，他们几个都不会敢这么..."

entries.en: Her face twitches, eyes fixed intensely on you for a moment.
entries.zh: 她的脸抽搐了一下，眼睛紧盯着你看了一会儿。

entries.en: "Yes," she says emphatically, with the weight of a stalled career and impossible position.
entries.zh: "是的。" 她语气同情，语调中满是事业停滞与身处极难境地带来的压力。

entries.en:
"That would be correct. Not, of course, to presume."

She looks conflicted.

"It would be... it is the responsibility of the Supreme Executor himself to assign that rank and office."
entries.zh:
"是的，理应如此。只是，我也无权擅自决定。" 她显得有些矛盾。

"安排官阶，指派官员，本该是... 这一事务是只能由最高元首本人亲自进行的。"

o.zh: 但是他不会，或者说他不能。

o.en: So why hasn't he? How long has it been?
o.zh: 所以他怎么还没传给你呢？这都多久了？

entries.en: "A meeting of the high ministers could theoretically agree to invoke the Articles of Succession, but Macario wants to ensure that it is he who dictates the result of that meeting. And he'll drain the lifeblood of the Sindrian Diktat for as long as it takes."
entries.zh: "理论上，只要高层开个会，就能定下来要启用继承条款，但 Macario 想要确保他自己能够独断高层会议的结果。这个人要将 辛达强权 的生命力攫取殆尽，无论会花上多长时间。"

entries.en:
She just nods, distracted perhaps by the implications of your conversation.

The comms cut to a holding pattern.
entries.zh:
她没说什么，就点了点头，或许还在思考你们两人对话的含义。

通讯断开，回到了等候界面。

entries.en:
She just looks at you. Like staring down the barrel of a coilgun.

The comms cut to a holding pattern.
entries.zh:
她看着你，神情更像是望向某一支线圈炮的炮管深处。

通讯断开，回到了等候界面。

o.en: That fleet was smuggling weapons. Macario calls it treason.
o.zh: 那支舰队当时在走私武器，Macario 说这是叛国行为。

o.en: That officer was smuggling weapons. Macario calls it 'treason'.
o.zh: 那名军官当时在走私武器，用 Macario 的话来讲，那叫 '叛国'。

o.en: The truth is that this is Macario's scheme to test your loyalty.
o.zh: 其实，这是 Macario 的计谋，他想测测你是否忠诚。

o.en: If it helps, it was Macario's idea. At least after he shot the man who thought it up first.
o.zh: 这件事都是 Macario 的主意，至少在他射杀原本想出这个点子的人之后是他的了，不知这么说你能不能好受点。

o.en: If it helps, they abandoned their command to flee Macario.
o.zh: 那人为了躲开 Macario 甚至渎职了，不知这么说你能不能好受点。

o.en: The crew mutinied and handed the officer over without a fight.
o.zh: 那支舰队的船员哗变了，一枪未发就把他们的军官送给我了。

entries.en: "You have kidnapped an officer of the Sindrian Diktat, an officer under my command. I offer you this one chance to stand down and surrender honorably before your fleet is destroyed."
entries.zh: "你绑架了 辛达强权 手下的一名军官，还是我手下的一名军官。我只给你一次机会，关闭武器，体面地投降，否则我就要摧毁你的舰队。"

entries.en: "You attacked a flotilla of the Sindrian Diktat navy and kidnapped the commanding officer - an officer acting under my direct orders. I offer you this one chance to stand down and surrender honorably before your fleet is destroyed."
entries.zh: "你攻击了 辛达强权 手下的一支舰队，掳走了该舰队的指挥官，还是直接听命于我的一名指挥官。我只给你一次机会，关闭武器，体面地投降，否则我就要毁灭你的舰队。"

o.en: I will transfer them to your custody immediately.
o.zh: 我马上就将那家伙交给你。

o.en: Macario issued the arrest warrant. I will take the officer to him.
o.zh: Macario 发布了这则逮捕令。我会把这位军官交给他。

o.en: I promised to release this officer on an independent world.
o.zh: 我承诺过要把这个军官带到一个独立世界去。

o.en: I promised to release them on an independent world, and I did.
o.zh: 我承诺过要把这个军官带到一个独立世界去，而我也这么做了。

o.en: Unfortunately, they were killed in battle. (lie)
o.zh: 很遗憾，那人在战斗中被击杀了。 (说谎)

entries.en: Hyder crosses her arms. "You have an officer subordinate to my command. I will take them into custody to deal with per a naval court-martial."
entries.zh: Hyder 交叉双臂说道。"你手下有一名我麾下的军官。我要把那人带上军事法庭接受审判。"

entries.en: "Speaking of the law." Hyder crosses her arms. "You have an officer subordinate to my command. I will take them into custody to deal with per naval court-martial."
entries.zh: "说到法律。" Hyder 交叉双臂说道，"你手下有一名我麾下的军官。我将把那人带上军事法庭接受审判。"

entries.en: "How far the Hegemony has fallen, if the Auxiliary has come to this," she adds under her breath.
entries.zh: "要是说连 霸主 辅助军都敢光天化日做这种勾当，那 霸主 得堕落成什么样子了呢。" 她小声嘟哝了一句。

entries.en:
After a short wait, Macario's image appears.

"Oh captain, so thoughtful of you to stop by on a social call," he says icily. "You do already have the file on the traitor, and the transponder code of their little flotilla. You have my full confidence in pulling this one off."

"Until then?" He says this like it's a question, but it isn't, because he's already killed the link.
entries.zh:
短暂等待之后，Macario 的形象出现在了通讯界面上。

"哦，是舰长啊，你路过我这里还能跟我聊几句，也算是有心了。" 说是这么说，他说这话的时候却没什么感情，"你肯定拿到叛徒本人的档案了，你也拿到那人小小舰队的应答器号码了，你更是有我助力，我可满怀自信，相信你能做成这件事呢。"

"到时候见咯？" 听起来他在问你，但其实他自己已有定论，因为刚说完他就关掉了通讯链接。

entries.en:
After a short wait, Macario's image appears.

"Captain, captain, captain," he smirks. "I eagerly await the results of your discussion with Vice Star Mashal Hyder."

"Until then?" He says this like it's a question, but it isn't, because he's already killed the link.
entries.zh:
短暂等待之后，Macario 的形象出现在了通讯界面上。

"舰长，舰长，舰长哟。" 他满脸堆笑，"我可是很期待你和副星际元帅 Hyder 谈出结果呢。"

"到时候见咯？" 听起来他在问你，但其实他自己已有定论，因为刚说完他就关掉了通讯链接。

entries.en:
After a short wait, Macario's image appears.

"Oh captain, so thoughtful of you to stop by," he says icily. "Do go check up on Horacio Caden, will you? I've been so worried about him."

"Until then?" He says this like it's a question, but it isn't, because he's already killed the link.
entries.zh:
短暂等待之后，Macario 的形象出现在了通讯界面上。

"哦，是舰长啊，你路过我这里还能跟我聊几句，也算是有心了。" 说是这么说，他说这话的时候却没什么感情，"你肯定能去看看 Horacio Caden 情况的，对吧？我可是对他很操心呢。"

"到时候见咯？" 听起来他在问你，但其实他自己已有定论，因为刚说完他就关掉了通讯链接。

entries.en:
He wastes no time with greetings or posturing.

"I would not be so naive to ask you to delete your copy of this data," Macario says with inhuman calm. "I'm sure your people are quite capable of creating a thorough charade of compliance."
entries.zh:
他没有在问候和故作姿态上浪费一刻时间。

"我不会天真到让你删除这份信息的备份。" Macario 以超乎常人的冷静说到，"我相信你这类人即使糊弄我也会做到天衣无缝。"

o.zh: 这七个 Andrada 都是谁？

o.en: Are these the heirs of Andrada? Only six left.
o.zh: 这些是 Andrada 的后裔吗？只剩六个了。

o.en: I appreciate you not wasting my time. So was Perseus your doing?
o.zh: 我感谢你不浪费我的时间。所以 Perseus 是你干的？

o.en: My silence is very much for sale.

entries.en:
After a short wait, Macario appears before you. He looks hungry.

"What an interesting time you must have had on Umbra, but never mind that- tell me, captain, what was your impression of Horacio Caden?"

He adopts a superficially eager and receptive look. Then raises a finger, "Ah, before I forget," and taps a datapad.
entries.zh:
短暂的等待后，Macario 出现在你面前，他看上去简直饥渴难耐。

"你在 Umbra 上肯定经历了段有趣的时光吧，不过不说这个了 —— 告诉我，舰长，你对 Horacio Caden 这个人怎么看？"

他做出了一个看上去在积极聆听的虚伪表情。然后他竖起一根手指。"啊，趁我还没忘记。" 轻点了一下他的数据平板。

o.en: He trusts you. You have nothing to worry about.
o.zh: 他相信你。你没什么需要担心的。

o.en: He trusts you. You have nothing to worry about. (lie)
o.zh: 他相信你。你没什么需要担心的。 (说谎)

entries.en:
After a brief wait, Macario appears before you.

"Oh captain, captain, captain. That didn't go very well, did it." He shakes his head. "You didn't follow my advice, did you."

He holds very still now. "You tried to get clever, didn't you. Do you see what happens when you try to be clever? All you had to do was follow instructions."

The muscles under his skin tighten, and he draws in breath to speak...
entries.zh:
短暂的等待后，Macario 出现在你的面前。

"哦，舰长，舰长，舰长。事情不太顺利，对吗。" 他摇摇头。"你没有听从我的建议，对吗？"

他现在一动不动。"你想变得聪明，对吗？你看见当你想变得聪明时会发生什么吗？你需要做的只是遵循指示。"

他皮肤下的肌肉收紧，然后他吸了一口气才说话...

entries.en: "Off you go now." He stretches, straightens his uniform, then hits the comms cut-off without another word.
entries.zh: "你可以走了。" 他伸了个懒腰，整了整制服，然后直接切断了通讯链接。

entries.en:
After a short wait, Macario's image appears. He looks like he is anticipating a tasty meal.

"Captain, I am so pleased to have you join me once again. Deputy Star Marshal Hyder was not too upset? You didn't offend her sense of honor too deeply? But no, I should allow you to speak." He winks and taps a datapad.
entries.zh:
短暂等待之后，Macario 的形象出现了。他看起来像是在期待着一场盛宴。

"舰长，我又一次非常庆幸你是我这边的人了。副星际元帅 Hyder 没有太生气吧？你没有把她的荣誉感冒犯得太过头吧？哦对，我应该让你来说的。" 他向你抛了个眼色并点了下数据平板。

entries.en:
After a short wait, Macario's image appears.

"Captain, captain, captain," he smirks. "I eagerly await the results of your discussion with my good friend the Guard High Deputy Executor."

"Until then?" He says this like it's a question, but it isn't. He's already killed the link.
entries.zh:
短暂等待之后，Macario 的形象出现在了通讯界面上。

"舰长，舰长，舰长哟。" 他满脸堆笑，"我可是很期待你和我那位担任卫队最高副首长的朋友谈出结果呢。"

"到时候见咯？" 听起来他在问你，但其实他自己已有定论，因为刚说完他就关掉了通讯链接。

entries.en:
Macario, unblinking, looks just a little bit delighted at your question.

"Someone must be. Philip knew this, in his time."
entries.zh:
Macario 眼睛也没眨，看起来对你提出的问题只是略微有些愉悦。

"总得有人有野心。Philip 在他的年代也明白这一点。"

entries.en:
"That question is no longer relevant," Macario's look hardens. "The question now is of who is prepared to carry on in his name."

You can only conclude that there is a power vacuum in the space Andrada should be. There's been no public announcement of death or illness, but the Sindrian Diktat keeps very tight control on its information sphere - and never shows signs of weakness.
entries.zh:
"那个问题已经没关系了。" Macario 的目光坚毅了起来。"现在的问题是谁准备好了以他的名誉继续向前。"

你也只能归结于，现在 Andrada 该在的位置有了一个权力真空。明面上没有过死亡或者病痛的通知，但 辛达强权 牢牢掌控着它的消息圈 —— 而且从不示弱。

entries.en: "Liar," Macario says gleefully. "And utterly perfect! You demonstrate precisely the bold duplicity I require."
entries.zh: "骗子。" Macario 快意道，"这真是太完美了！你展现出了正是我需要的那种大胆的奸诈。"

entries.en:
"Fascinating," Macario says, perhaps to himself.

"But would you die to serve the Diktat? No, no, don't speak. It is far too personal a question."

"Besides," he adds, "I require that you live. Which is why you do." He produces a ghastly smile.
entries.zh:
"真有意思。" Macario 大概是在自言自语，"那你会为侍奉强权而死吗？不，不，别说了。这是个过于私人的问题了。"

"再说了。" 他补充道，"我需要你活着。这也是为什么你会活着。" 他露出了一个毛骨悚然的笑容。

entries.en:
"Do my ears deceive, dear captain?" Macario says with mock disappointment.

"I beg of you, let us finish our nice conversation. Then we may think things over, mm?"
entries.zh:
"是我耳朵不好使了吗，亲爱的舰长？" Macario 话语中带着嘲讽性的失望。

"算我求求你，我们先把这段愉快的交谈说完，然后你再考虑考虑，嗯？"

entries.en:
"Influence, credits, advanced spacecraft hulls, experimental weapons..."

Macario spreads his hands wide, a river of generosity, then takes a moment to whisper into his cuff.

"That is a taste to ensure that I have your attention for the remainder of our conversation."

Within seconds, your personal comms ping a surprised response from your quartermaster.
entries.zh:
"影响力，星币，高级星舰船体，实验性武器..."

Macario 摊开手掌，仿佛比划着一条财宝聚成的河流。然后他花了点时间对着袖口低语。

"给你尝点甜头，这样接下来我们要谈的你就会认真听了。"

只是几秒内，你的私人通讯就传来了一条你的军需官诧异的回复。

entries.en:
"You didn't get to your position without knowing the meaning of ambition, captain." Macario pins you with ice-cold eyes, "You of all people know full well that ambitions will be attacked on all sides by lesser men, whether from brutish ignorance or degenerate ideologies."

"The Sector is in turmoil. Imagine if its might and resources were focused by the vision of a man with... ambition."
entries.zh:
"舰长，能混到你这个地步，你肯定不至于说不知道 '野心' 为何物。" Macario 眼神冰凉，死死盯着你，"世上那么多人里，唯独你肯定深入了解过，那些野蛮蠢货，那些意识形态走狗，那些堕落小人们会怎样对怀有野心的人群起而攻之。"

"整个星域尽是纷纷扰扰。想象一下，如果全星域的武力，全星域的资源集中起来，只为服务那一人的...野心，又会怎样。"

entries.en:
Macario smiles thinly.

"The plan is simple enough. In light of the Supreme Executor's upcoming... transition, we must root out treason and corruption at the highest level - by which I mean, of course, those arms of the state which project violent force: the navy, in the person of Oxana Hyder, and the Lion's Guard, in the person of Horacio Caden."

"I, of course, see to the reliability of my own ministry," his eyes flick to indicate Ram's corpse.

"Once the means of force are purged of traitors, they shall burn out the rot that has taken root in this Great Project: the so-called Volturnian resistance and the double-blight of Nortia and Umbra in rebellion. Once our power-base in Askonia is consolidated, the Diktat may turn its gaze outward."
entries.zh:
Macario 浅浅地笑了笑。

"计划够简单了。鉴于最高元首将要发生...过渡，我们必须要拔除最高层之中的叛国者，腐败者。当然，所谓最高层，指的就是那几个负责行使暴力的国家部门：Oxana Hyder 负责的海军部队，还有 Horacio Caden 负责的狮心卫队。"

"至于我自己的部门，那当然就要我亲自负责了，" 他眼睛略微眨了眨，示意看看 Ram 的尸体。

"一旦暴力机器中不再有叛徒，它们就该马力全开，碾碎辛达瑞亚伟大愿景之上扎根的几块脓疮：不仅是所谓的 Volturn 反抗军，还有 Nortia 与 Umbra 这两个祸害。只要强权在 Askonia 的根基稳固下来，我们就可以放眼星系之外了。"

entries.en: "An interesting question, captain."
entries.zh: "有趣的问题，舰长。"

entries.en:
"Of course not," Macario says, almost annoyed at the idea.

"Authority flows from power," he explains. "After I secure the future of the Diktat, the only traitors will be those who oppose me."
entries.zh:
"当然不是。" Macario 说道，都有点被这种想法惹恼了。

"权力源自于力量。" 他解释道。"在我确保了强权的未来后，叛徒就只有那些反对我的人了。"

entries.en:
"You are a rising independent power. Such shifts, even small, have a way of upsetting the balance kept so carefully these past cycles."

"Do you understand how you instill fear into strategic planners? Your motives are... erratic. You could do anything. It's perfect."
entries.zh:
"你是一股正在崛起的独立势力。此类影响，哪怕微小，也可能打破过去几个星历年里，各方小心翼翼保持着的那种平衡。"

"你明白你给战略规划师们带来了怎样的恐惧吗？你的动机... 毫无规律。你什么事都做得出来。这简直完美。"

entries.en:
"As the bearer of a commission of the Sindrian Diktat, you are already pledged to the grand vision of the Supreme Executor!"

"Hyder and Caden are more apt to trust you," Macario says, his tongue flicking around his teeth, "-and believe you; that they share whatever motives sleep in their hearts. Which we will discover."
entries.zh:
"作为 辛达强权 雇佣协议的签订者，你已经向 最高元首 的伟大宏远献身。"

"Hyder 和 Caden 会更倾向于信任你。" Macario 说着砸了咂舌，"—— 而且会听信你所言；这足以把他们内心沉睡的动机抖露出来。而我们要翻出来的就是这些动机。"

entries.en:
"You are hated among those of consequence in the Sindrian Diktat! You are to be shot on sight. Why, I should turn you in myself," Macario grins with genuine humor.

"But don't you see? As an outsider, a comrade of terrorists and traitors, you are my perfect friend: you will be trusted by internal enemies with traitorous intent."
entries.zh:
"辛达强权 的要员都对你恨之入骨！你应该被就地枪决。哦，我真该亲自送你上路的..." Macario 开怀大笑，带着几分诚挚的幽默。

"但你还没明白吗？作为一个局外人、一个恐怖分子和叛徒同党的你，是我完美的伙伴：你会被那些意图谋反的内敌分子所信任。"

entries.en:
"You are viewed as a friend of the Sindrian Diktat, particularly among those of any consequence: the officers, the officials, and of course the party."

"Hyder and Caden are more apt to trust you," Macario says, his tongue flicking around his teeth, "-and believe you; that they share whatever motives sleep in their hearts. Which we will discover."
entries.zh:
"你已经被视为 辛达强权 的朋友，尤其是对于那些重要人士：军官，要员，当然还有党派。"

"Hyder 和 Caden 会更倾向于信任你。" Macario 说着，他的舌头在齿间轻弹，"—— 而且会听信你所言；这足以把他们内心沉睡的动机抖露出来。而我们要翻出来的就是这些动机。"

entries.en:
"You are considered suspect among those of consequence in the Sindrian Diktat; the officers, the bureaucrats, the party members."

"As an outsider, a provocateur, you are expected to hold outrageous political opinions which provides you with credibility to those of traitorous intent."
entries.zh:
"辛达强权 的重要人士：军官，官僚，党派成员都怀疑你。"

"但你看到了吗？作为一个局外人，一个挑衅者，你被期待有令人愤慨的政治观点，这让那些有叛国意图的人相信你。"

entries.en:
"It was your work with the Galatia Academy, for Provost Baird, that first drew my interest." Macario seems delighted to tell you about this.

"Baird found in you an excellent..." he hesitates, searching for a different word, "-partner. An excellent and capable partner working toward great things for the Sector."

"Ah, that I might pry Baird's secrets away from the Hegemony," he adds quietly. "One day, one day."
entries.zh:
"你在 Galatia 学院为 Baird 院长工作的事情引起了我的关注，" 在 Macario 告诉你这些时，他似乎很高兴。

"Baird 发现你是一个卓越的..." 他犹豫了一下，斟酌着一个不同的词，"—— 合作伙伴。一个卓越而富有才能的合作伙伴，致力于为星域做出伟大的贡献。"

"啊，我多么希望能从 霸主 那儿发现 Baird 的秘密，" 他轻声补充道，"总有一天，总有一天。"

entries.en:
"Why, it is because you work for the enemy, the Hegemony!"

"The Diktat has always been a knife to their throat. Small, yes, but with a keen edge, a ruthlessness that the best of the officer corps could recognize, and those too craven to commit to Philip's vision look upon with jealousy. The children of Eventide wish they could dispense with the cloying ideology of the Domain and exercise a power truer and purer."

"And among us, there are now cowards who cringe from heroic destiny. You will sniff them out because you look like the possibility of defection."
entries.zh:
"你觉得呢，因为你为我们的敌人 霸主 效力！"

"辛达强权 一直是一柄架在 霸主 喉边的尖刀。没错，我们势力微弱，但即便是我们这把小刀，也有其锋芒。我们无情的战术，只有 霸主 最优秀的军官团识得，而其他那些无法为 Philip 之愿景尽力的懦夫，只能带着嫉妒仰视我们。Eventide 上的孩子们早就想要抛却 人之领 那陈腐到令人腻歪的意识形态，运用更加纯粹、更加真切的力量了。"

"现如今，我们中却也出了软脚虾，不愿为我们的英雄使命效力了。之所以你能够找到那帮叛徒，正是因为你简直和那帮叛徒一样软弱。"

entries.en:
"It was your appearance of devotion to that quaint religion that drew my attention. You, of all people, becoming a pilgrim?"

Macario nearly giggles at the thought. "It's a splendid ruse. So absurd that I could not even believe it until I had it confirmed. No one will suspect you! They'll think you're a mush-headed Luddic out to balance the scales on your imagined soul!"
entries.zh:
"你对于那别样宗教表现出的虔诚，令我很在意。世间那么多人，而偏偏你成了一名朝圣者？"

Macario 想着想着，差点就笑了出来。"真是妙计！你表现出的虔诚深到荒谬，即便是我，也只有亲自确认之后才能相信你并非真心。没人能怀疑到你！别人都只会觉得你是个卢德蠢蛋，要以你那所谓的 '灵魂' 去度量一切呢。"

entries.en:
"It was your appearance of devotion to that quaint religion that drew my attention. You, of all people, a mere Luddic?"

Macario nearly giggles at the thought. "It's a splendid ruse. Simply splendid, captain. So absurd that I could not even believe it until I had it confirmed. No one will suspect you! They'll think you're a mush-headed Luddic out to balance the scales on your imagined soul!"
entries.zh:
"你对于那别样宗教表现出的虔诚令我很在意。世间万物如此纷繁，你却甘做一介卢德教徒？"

Macario 想着想着，差点就笑了出来。"真是妙计，太妙了，舰长！你表现出的虔诚深到荒谬，即便是我，也只有亲自确认之后才能相信你并非真心。没人能怀疑到你！别人都只会觉得你是个卢德蠢蛋，要以你那所谓的 '灵魂' 去度量一切呢。"

entries.en:
"The answer is sheer power. You have an impressive independent fleet and no tremendously strong connection to any significant faction."

"Do you understand how that makes strategic planners fearful? Your motives are... erratic. You could do anything. It's perfect."
entries.zh:
"答案纯粹是力量使然。你手下有一支战力令人印象深刻的独立舰队，还与其他主要势力无甚瓜葛。"

"你明白这会给战略规划师们带来怎样的恐惧吗？你的动机... 毫无规律。你什么事都做得出来。这简直完美。"

o.en: What do you mean by 'turn its gaze outward'?
o.zh: '放眼星系之外' 是什么意思？

o.en: Does Andrada know about this plan?
Does the Supreme Executor know about this plan?
o.zh: 最高元首知道这个计划吗？

o.en: Doesn't this conspiracy make you the traitor?
o.zh: 你这么密谋不就也变成叛徒了吗？

o.en: Are you a man with... ambition?
What plan? Ram spoke of treason.
o.zh: 什么计划？Ram 说的可是叛国的歪理。
什么计划？就刚刚那人精神错乱的胡乱指责吗？
具体是什么计划？他说得乱七八糟的。
我参与这件事，有什么好处吗？

o.en: Why would you put such trust in me?
o.zh: 为什么，你就偏偏对我这么信任呢？

o.en: Why would I ever want to help you?
o.zh: 你怎么觉得，我会想要帮助你呢？

o.en: Of course. I live to serve the Sindrian Diktat. (lie)
o.zh: 当然了。我为侍奉辛达强权而活。 (说谎)

o.en: Of course. I live to serve the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 当然了。我为侍奉辛达强权而活。

o.en: I get it. What do you want done? Hypothetically.
o.zh: 明白了，那按照你的设想，我要做什么呢？

o.en: What do you wish done? Tell me how I may serve the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 您有何吩咐？请告诉我，该怎样为辛达强权效劳。

entries.en:
The comms open.

"Independent fleet," the merc says with bored professionalism. "I have been contracted to undertake an operation which is still ongoing. You must leave this volume immediately."
entries.zh:
通讯链接打开。

"独立舰队。" 雇佣兵带着无聊的专业语气说道，"我已签约执行一项仍在进行中的行动。你必须立即离开这片区域。"

entries.en:
The comms open with a soft chime.

"Independent $shipOrFleet," the merc says in a perfunctory monotone, "I have been contracted to destroy any ship or fleet," $heOrShe pauses politely so you may understand that you are just such a ship or fleet, "-which interferes with the debris field you just plundered. This communication is made not as a negotiation, but simply a matter of professional courtesy."

$HeOrShe produces a perfectly bland customer-service smile then hits the comms cut-off.
entries.zh:
随着一声轻柔的提示音，通讯链接开启了。

"独立$shipOrFleet。" 佣兵单调地背着例行公事的词，"我方已签约摧毁任何舰船或是舰队。" $heOrShe礼貌地顿了顿，就是为了让你理解你就是这样的舰船或舰队。"只要有舰船或舰队与你方刚刚打捞的残骸区有过交集，即刻摧毁。该通讯并非协商，仅为体现我方专业素养。"

$HeOrShe露出客服行业特有的完美空洞笑容，之后切断了通讯链接。

entries.en:
The comms open with a soft chime.

"Independent $shipOrFleet," the merc says in a perfunctory monotone, "I have been contracted to destroy any ship or fleet which interferes with the debris field you just salvaged. This communication is not a negotiation, but rather-"

The merc pauses, lifting a finger to $hisOrHer ear as if being told something on a private channel.

"You are $playerName," $heOrShe says, looking at you anew. "Commissioned auxiliary of the Hegemony."
entries.zh:
随着一声轻柔的提示音，通讯链接开启了。

"独立$shipOrFleet。" 佣兵单调地背着例行公事的词，"我方已签约摧毁任何舰船或是舰队。" $heOrShe礼貌地顿了顿，就是为了让你理解你就是这样的舰船或舰队。"只要有舰船或舰队与你方刚刚打捞的残骸区有过交集，即刻摧毁。该通讯并非协商，仅为 ——。"

佣兵突然停下了，伸出一根手指按在耳边，似乎有人在私人频道上向$hisOrHer讲了些什么。

"原来你是 $playerName。" $heOrShe继续说着，这下子换了副面孔，"你是受雇于 霸主 的辅助军。"

o.en: May I assume that this fact changes your disposition?
o.zh: 我是否可以认为，你之所以对我变了态度，就是因为我是辅助军？

entries.en:
"My apologies, captain. I have specific orders not to interfere with your activities, and," $heOrShe double-checks a datapad, "It seems I am to, um, render assistance insofar as it does not compromise my mission."

"You've put me in an awkward spot," the merc rubs $hisOrHer brow.  "But I suppose I must simply let you go. Bright burns?"
entries.zh:
"抱歉，舰长，我收到具体命令，不得干扰你方行动，而且..." $heOrShe看了眼数据平板，仔细确认了一下："看来我要，嗯，提供援助，只要不影响我的任务。"

"你这让我很难办了。" 佣兵揉了揉$hisOrHer的额头，"但我觉得我只能放你走了。祝航行无阻？"

entries.en: "You may," $heOrShe admits, almost embarrassed.
entries.zh: "的确可以。" $heOrShe面露难色，勉强承认道。

entries.en:
"My apologies, captain. I have specific orders not to interfere with your activities, and," $heOrShe double-checks a datapad, "It seems I am to, um, render assistance insofar as it does not compromise my mission."

"Ah, there was one more thing," the merc rubs $hisOrHer brow. "Oh yes. You should visit the Ragnar Complex, in the Valhalla system. Great opportunities for someone like... you." $HeOrShe pauses, eyes fixed and unblinking to ensure that you got the message.

That accomplished, $heOrShe transitions to a thin smile, as if this business was concluded to everyone's satisfaction. "Bright burns," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh:
"抱歉，舰长，我收到具体命令，不得干扰你方行动，而且..." $heOrShe看了眼数据平板，仔细确认了一下："看来我要，嗯，提供援助，只要不影响我的任务。"

"啊，还有一件事。" 佣兵揉了揉$hisOrHer的额头，"对了，你该去 Ragnar 综合设施看看，就在 Valhalla 星系。那里有些好机会，很适合...你这种人。" $HeOrShe停嘴，双眼一眨不眨的盯着你，想确定你听懂了$HeOrShe的意思。

确定了之后，$heOrShe轻轻地假笑了一下，仿佛这件事的结果大家都满意。"航行无阻。" $heOrShe说道。

o.en: Explain your meaning- why Ragnar Complex?
o.zh: 再解释一下 —— 为什么要去 Ragnar 综合设施？

entries.en:
$HeOrShe lifts a finger to $hisOrHer ear, and sits up as if $heOrShe has been told something important. "Wait, you are $playerName. Commissioned auxiliary of the Hegemony?"

"My apologies, captain. I have specific orders not to interfere with your activities, and," $heOrShe double-checks a datapad, "It seems I am to, um, render assistance insofar as it does not compromise my mission."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe将一根手指放在$hisOrHer的耳边，然后坐了起来，好像$heOrShe被告知了一些重要的事情。"等等，你是 $playerName。霸主 的雇佣辅助军？"

"抱歉，舰长。我接到的具体指令要求我不干扰你的行动，而且..." $heOrShe看了眼数据平板，仔细确认了一下："看来我要，嗯，提供援助，只要不影响我的任务。"

o.en: I was expecting to meet a ship or fleet here.
o.zh: 我在这等待一艘船或者一支舰队。

o.en: I'll be on my way, then.

entries.en:
"Mm," $heOrShe looks uncomfortable. "If you were expecting to meet someone on the small fleet I just destroyed, that puts us in a somewhat awkward position."

"Business, you know. ...I hope you weren't close?" The merc makes an awkward shrug.
entries.zh:
"嗯..." $heOrShe看起来很不舒服。"如果你在等待我刚刚摧毁的小舰队中的某个人，那会让我们处于一个有点尴尬的境地。"

"赚钱嘛，不寒碜...我希望你们之间不是很亲密吧？" 雇佣兵尴尬地耸耸肩。

entries.en:
The merc $post makes the vac-ops 'all safe' sign with $hisOrHer hand.

"Bright burns and profitable runs."
entries.zh:
雇佣兵 $post 比出了一个表示真空作业之后 '一切安全' 的手势。

"航行无阻，财源滚滚。"

entries.en:
"My apologies, but my orders are to not provide operational information to any outside party except insofar as is required to carry out the mission. Though, of course, your status confers something of a loophole..."

$HeOrShe thinks for a moment. "I have attacked and destroyed a few ships that my employer wished destroyed. I am to ensure there are no survivors, and allow no rescue attempt."
entries.zh:
"抱歉，我得到的命令是：不得向任何外部人员提供行动信息，除非是执行任务所必需。当然，您的特殊身份也确实能算是条款里的漏洞..."

$HeOrShe思考了一下。"我按雇主指示攻击并摧毁了几艘舰船。我要确保没有幸存者，没有救援。"

entries.en:
"Ah," $heOrShe frowns. "I am specifically required to not identify my employer. Mission parameters, you see."

The merc winks, "But I'm sure a clever captain could infer important facts due to the disposition I've been ordered to show toward a Hegemony-commissioned captain."

"And I must say," $heOrShe stretches and lets out a sigh. "The nightlife at Ragnar Complex is rather a disappointment."
entries.zh:
"啊。" $heOrShe皱眉，"我的雇主特地指示了我不得透露其身份，任务要求，你懂的。"

雇佣兵随后眨了眨眼。"但对您这样受雇于 霸主 的舰长所展现的态度也是出于雇主的命令，我估计聪明的舰长肯定能从这一点发现些有用的信息。"

"而且我得说一句，" $heOrShe伸了个懒腰，叹了口气。"Ragnar 综合设施的夜生活真令人失望。"

o.en: You are in Sindrian Diktat space! I give the orders here.
o.zh: 你正处于 辛达强权 的疆域内！我才是在这下命令的人 。

o.en: I was expecting to meet a ship or fleet here.
o.zh: 我在这等待一艘船或者一支舰队。

o.en: I must investigate that debris field.
o.zh: 我必须调查那个残骸区。

entries.en:
"You must not," the merc says without blinking.

"I shall inform you now that I have been tasked with using deadly force to ensure that the debris remains untouched."
entries.zh:
"你绝不能这么做，" 雇佣兵眼睛一眨不眨地说。

"我现在要告诉你，我的任务是使用致命武力确保残骸不被触碰。"

o.en: I'll be on my way, then.
Then use force to stop me.

entries.en:
"Mm," $heOrShe looks just a touch uncomfortable.

"Then I would suggest that waiting around will not be a productive use of time."
entries.zh:
"嗯。" $heOrShe看起来略显局促。

"那么我的建议是：在这里干等着也只是浪费时间。"

entries.en: "Burn bright... and far," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh: "航行无阻... 越远越好。" $heOrShe说到。

entries.en: $HeOrShe pauses for a moment, then carefully says "I... request... that you stay clear of the nearby debris field until it has dispersed."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe停顿了一下，然后小心地说："我...请求...你们远离附近的残骸区，直到它散去。"

entries.en: "Ah," $heOrShe frowns. "My mission parameters require that I not reveal the identity of my employer. Enormous penalty clause there."
entries.zh: "啊，" $heOrShe皱起眉头，"我的任务要求我不能透露雇主的身份。里头有巨额惩罚条款。"

entries.en: "As you will," the merc says, then cuts the feed.
entries.zh: "随你便。" 雇佣兵说道，然后切断了通讯链接。

entries.en:
The merc closes $hisOrHer eyes with a sigh. "You've put me in a difficult and, worse, potentially very expensive position, captain."

"Please don't mention this incident to anyone."

The comms cut. Your tactical officer informs you that the merc's fleet appears to be standing down.
entries.zh:
雇佣兵叹了一口气，闭上了$hisOrHer的眼睛。"你让我陷入了一个艰难的境地，更糟糕的是我可能会付出非常昂贵的代价，舰长。"

"请不要向任何人提及这件事。"

通讯链接中断了。你的战术军官通知你雇佣兵的舰队似乎正在离开。

entries.en:
The mercs eyebrows raise and $heOrShe takes a moment to refer to a secondary display as if to confirm your claim.

"I see," $heOrShe says. "Very inconvenient. Nonetheless, I must insist."
entries.zh:
雇佣兵挑了挑眉毛，$heOrShe看向一个辅助屏幕，似乎在确认你的说法是否属实。

"我明白了。" $heOrShe说到。"这很麻烦，但是我还是要坚持我的要求。"

entries.en: As you begin to speak, the link has already been terminated.
entries.zh: 你刚想张嘴说话，对方便终止了链接。

entries.en:
"Yes, glory to all of that. Of course," he says quickly.

"You are simply... the perfect specimen to serve the Supreme Executor."

A mix of expressions crosses his face as he continues to examine you, like something he found but did not expect. Then, like a phase-shift, he is suddenly calm.
entries.zh:
"是、是啊，荣耀归于那一切，自然，" 他说得很快。

"你简直... 是服侍最高元首的完美样本。"

他仍旧打量着你，脸上神色变换不定，像是捡到了件没料到的东西。紧接着，像切换了相位一般，他忽然平静下来。

entries.en: "On so few the future hangs, captain," Macario says hollowly, unblinking.
entries.zh: "可叹未来竟要寄托在寥寥数人身上，舰长。" Macario 空洞地说道，眼睛依旧一眨不眨。

entries.en:
"Did I?" He chuckles. "Mercenary to the end eh? I'll have arrangements made."

"I am so pleased that you value what I can provide. This will be important, and soon."
entries.zh:
"我提过？" 他笑道，"到最后都是个雇佣兵吗？我会做对应的安排。"

"我很高兴你能珍视我所能提供的利益。这点会很重要，很快就会。"

entries.en:
"Did I?" He chuckles. "Mercenary to the end eh? I'll have arrangements made."

"I am so pleased that you value what I can provide. This will be important, and soon."
entries.zh:
"我说过吗？\" 他轻笑一声。\"到头来还是个雇佣兵，嗯？我会安排好的。"

"你这么看重我拿得出手的东西，我真是欣慰。这事很快就要派上大用场了。"

entries.en:
"Power, of course. I'm just like you."

 He slowly rubs his hands together, watching.

"Don't bother denying it."
entries.zh:
"权力，还用说吗。你我都是一路人。"

他慢慢地两手交叉，观察着。

"不用浪费时间去否定这一点了。"

entries.en: "Tragic," Macario says automatically. "Isn't it."
entries.zh: "悲剧，" Macario 不假思索地说。"不是吗。"

entries.en:
"There will come a time soon when decisions must be made, dear captain," he takes a moment to tap at a datapad.

"I trust you have gained some appreciation for my... generous leadership style."
entries.zh:
"决断的一刻总会来临的，我亲爱的舰长。" 他按了下数据平板。

"我相信你应该能喜欢我...慷慨的领导方式。"

o.en: What are you loyal to, Macario?
You mentioned 'advanced spacecraft hull' in a previous conversation...
o.zh: 上次谈话时你提到了一个 '实验舰体' ...

entries.en:
"There will come a time soon when decisions must be made, dear captain," he takes a moment to tap at a datapad.

"I trust you have gained some appreciation for my... generous leadership style."
entries.zh:
"很快就要到必须做决断的时候了，亲爱的舰长，" 他腾出片刻，在数据板上点了几下。

"想必你已经领教了我这... 宽厚的处事风范。"

o.en: I serve the Sindrian Diktat. Glory to the Supreme Executor!
o.zh: 我为辛达强权效劳。荣耀归于最高元首！

o.en: What are you loyal to, Macario?
You mentioned 'advanced spacecraft hull' in a previous conversation...
o.zh: 你上回聊天时提到过'advanced spacecraft hull'...

entries.en: "Naturally," Macario says, taking a moment to tap at a datapad.
entries.zh: "自然。" Macario 按了下数据平板。

entries.en: Macario stares unblinking. "Have I so underestimated you?"
entries.zh: Macario 眼睛一眨不眨地盯着你。"我还真是低估你了。"

entries.en: "Andrada, of course." Macario simply raises an eyebrow, "I thought that was obvious."
entries.zh: "当然是 Andrada。" Macario 挑了下眉毛，"我以为这很明显。"

entries.en: "You wound me with the accusation, captain," Macario says with a hint of cold amusement.
entries.zh: "你这指控可真是让我伤心，舰长。" Macario 话语中带着一丝冷酷的愉悦。

entries.en:
This time $heOrShe is ready.

"You return! I hereby declare you a criminal and traitor for the crimes of falsifying official documents, threatening an officer, and attempting to undermine the authority of the Supreme Executor."

"A death in space is better than you deserve, terrorist scum." $HeOrShe looks over $hisOrHer shoulder and gives a wave. The comms cut out and the opposing fleet maneuvers to an attack posture.
entries.zh:
这回，$heOrShe准备充分。

"你还敢回来！我在此宣布，你是罪犯，是叛国者，你的罪名包括：伪造官方文件、威胁官员、试图损害最高元首权威！"

"你这恐怖分子，你这人渣！就这么死在太空都便宜你了！" $HeOrShe回头挥了挥手。通讯中断了，对方舰队开始机动，进入战斗阵型。

o.en: I'm here - again - to arrest order from Chief High Inspector Dolos Macario.
o.zh: 我重复一遍，我是来逮捕犯人的，逮捕命令来自最高检察长 Dolos Macario。

entries.en:
"You." $HisOrHer eyes narrow, already suspicious.

"I would not expect to see you again after making such outrageous and, dare I say, illegal claims. I could order your arrest already on suspicion of terrorist activities."
entries.zh:
"是你。" $HisOrHer眯起双眼，看来已经在怀疑你了。

"你说过那种惹人不快，而且 —— 我就这么说了 —— 违反法律的话之后，我真没想到还能看到你再跳出来。我早就该按疑似恐怖分子的标准，当场把你拿下的。"

entries.en:
You have your comms officer transmit your appeal on all channels: $PersonRank $PersonName is a traitor in the eyes of the Supreme Executor as per the warrant provided to you by his Chief High Inspector, Dolos Macario.

Anyone who assists this arrest will be doing their duty to the Sindrian Diktat. Anyone who interferes will be branded a traitor and abettor of terrorism to be dealt with as INTSEC sees fit.

With each word, you can watch $PersonRank $PersonName on a muted comm feed growing more enraged - and more unsure. In perfect silence, you see $himOrHer looking around wildly, shouting words you cannot hear, then arms from out-of-scene grab $himOrHer.

The comm-feed cuts out for a moment.
entries.zh:
你命令通讯军官用所有的频道发送了你的这段声明：在最高元首的眼中，$PersonRank $PersonName 是一名彻头彻尾的叛徒，你手中有最高检察长 Dolos Macario 开出的逮捕令为证。

任何协助逮捕的人员都将被视为对 辛达强权 效忠有功。而任何干预此次逮捕的人员，都将被打上叛徒和恐怖主义同情者的烙印，交由 INTSEC 全权处置。

随着声明逐字逐句地传达，你通过静音的通讯信道欣赏着 $PersonRank $PersonName 逐渐愈发愤怒但又愈发不安的全过程。犹如一出完美的默剧，你看着$himOrHer发了疯似的望向四周，高声叫喊着传不到你这边的话语，随后就被从画面之外伸进去的无数双手臂给拽了出去。

随后，通讯断开了有一阵子。

entries.en:
"This is the second-in-command now assuming control of this fleet in light of the previous commander's treason," they almost manage to hide their smirk at the usurpation of their superior officer.

"We shall now transfer the traitor to your authority to return to INTSEC for questioning, trial, and execution. Glory to the Lion of Sindria! Death to traitors!"

They salute.
entries.zh:
"本人为本舰队前副指挥官，鉴于前指挥官的叛国行径，现接管本舰队。" 此人脸上的笑容难以抑制，看来能夺上级的位子使其很是兴奋。

"本舰队将立刻把该叛国者移交至你方，由你方带回 INTSEC，接受审判和处决。荣耀尽归辛达瑞亚之狮！叛徒死无葬身之处！"

此人说着，敬了个礼。

o.en: I'm sure loyalty won't go unnoticed, lieutenant.
o.zh: 我必定不会让你的一片忠心被埋没的，上尉。

o.en: Uh, death to traitors to you, too.
o.zh: 呃，也祝你能让那叛徒死无葬身之处。

entries.en:
The second-in-command is good to their word, and their former commanding officer is handed over to you, not in chains, but held by a set of thick plastic restraints, stripped of uniform insignia, and dulled by sedatives.

You have them secured in the brig.

Now to have a difficult conversation with Deputy Star Marshal Hyder.
entries.zh:
那个副指挥官确实说话算话，把原本的舰队指挥官交给了你。这位前指挥官倒不是被铁链拴着送来的，而是被一套厚厚的塑料束缚具捆着送来的。那人制服上的各种徽章被撕了个精光，还用了些镇静剂，已经不甚清醒了。

你把这人关进了禁闭室，保护起来。

现在，该和副星际元帅 Hyder 来一场高难度会谈了。

o.en: Nav, get us out of here.
o.zh: 领航员，带我们离开这里。

entries.en:
$PersonRank $PersonName hears out your offer, and reluctantly agrees. Better a life on the run than a death in one of Macario's INTSEC torture sites.

In short order, a credits transfer comes in, and an officer-class escape pod is launched from the opposing flagship toward your $shipOrFleet.

Your comms officer interrupts as you oversee the 'rescue' operation.

"Captain. We have incoming priority comms from the Sindrian Diktat fleet."
entries.zh:
$PersonRank $PersonName 听着你开出的价码，虽然略有不甘，最终还是接受了。无论如何，总好过死在 Macario 手下的 INTSEC 黑牢里。

你立马收到了一笔星币转账，对方旗舰上，一个指挥官-级逃生舱腾空而起，直奔你的$shipOrFleet。

正当你饶有兴致，观摩这场 "救援" 行动时，你的通讯军官打断了你。

"舰长，我们接到一份高优先度通讯请求，来源是 辛达强权 舰队。"

entries.en:
Just what you needed, another Diktat officer.

"Rogue fleet," the upjumped lieutenant barks - a poor sign for your chances of coming to an understanding.

"You have picked up the escape pod of a traitor who has abandoned their post, an act of treason against the will of the Supreme Executor. Surrender the traitor now or prepare to be boarded!"

Your tactical officer pings you, alerting you to the fact that the Diktat patrol's disposition appears to be in disarray.
entries.zh:
又一位 辛达强权 军官，真就挑要紧的时候来。

"流浪舰队！" 趾高气扬的军官刚一接起通讯，便大喊了起来。看来，你很难从他这里寻得谅解。

"你捞起过一个装着渎职叛徒的逃生舱，那可是对抗最高元首意志的叛国罪行。现在，要么交出那个叛徒，要么就准备被登舰吧！"

你的战术军官向你发出了一条信息，提醒你 辛达强权 巡逻队的阵型似乎十分散乱。

o.en: It is you who is the traitor, and I have documents to prove it!
o.zh: 你才是叛徒，我有证据可以证明！

o.en: Lieutenant, is it? You're welcome for the promotion.
o.zh: 你还是上尉，是吧？你可以等着追授新官职了，不用谢我。

entries.en: The comm link is cut from the other end. It seems like they're not in the mood to talk.
entries.zh: 通讯链接从另一端被切断。看来对方没有心情对话。

entries.en: The comm link is cut from the other end. It seems like they're not in the mood to talk.
entries.zh: 通讯链接从另一端被切断。看来对方没有心情对话。

entries.en:
The former CO of the Sindrian Diktat fleet seems to have jumped ship without unlocking executive override. It'll take them a while to reassert control; Andrada learned from his own lessons when it came to mutinies.

Disengaging would be trivial.

After all, if this reaction is anything to go by, you're going to have a pressing engagement with Deputy Star Marshal Hyder.
entries.zh:
看来这位 辛达强权 的前指挥官跳船的时候没有解锁舰船的首长特级权限。其他船员恐怕得过一阵子才能重新控制舰船。看来 Andrada 的确从自己当年发动兵变的经历里总结了不少经验教训。

得益于此，脱离对方舰队易如反掌。

不管怎么样，如果要问这个反应让你有了什么想法的话，你只能说估计自己很快就不得不和副星际元帅 Hyder 会上一面了。

o.en: Nav, get us out of here.
o.zh: 领航员，带我们离开这里。

o.en: I can help you out of this... for a price.
o.zh: 我倒是能帮你脱身...就是得加点钱。

o.en: Convince $hisOrHer crew to turn $himOrHer over without a fight
o.zh: 说服$hisOrHer的船员，让他们不要反抗，交出$himOrHer

o.en: Oops, wrong comms-ID. I need to go now.
o.zh: 哎呀，拨错通讯 ID 了。我现在要离开了。

o.en: Do the right thing and surrender yourself without a fight.
o.zh: 乖乖投降，别再负隅顽抗，错上加错。

o.en: Surrender now, or I will attack.
o.zh: 立刻投降，否则我就下令攻击了。

o.en: Transmit the arrest warrant provided by Macario
o.zh: 发送 Macario 提供的逮捕令

entries.en:
"It's all about building the pieces of a story - and with Caden so eager to believe stories, Hyder so eager to follow rules, why, it makes my work simple!" He brings his hands together, satisfied.

"I tell you, captain, I would be bored silly if it weren't for the inventiveness of Luddic zealots and the Hegemony's meddling. Are you familiar with Orcus Rao? Oh, he's a character. A worthy opponent, I think. Indulge me a moment, I think you'll find the comparison with yourself amusing..."
entries.zh:
"重点就是搭建故事的每一个片段 —— Caden 轻信故事，Hyder 墨守成规，这让我的工作变得再容易不过了！" 他双手交叉，颇为满意。

"舰长，我跟你说，要不是卢德狂信徒和 霸主 的干涉还有点意思，我早就无聊傻了。你听说过 Orcus Rao 这个名字吗？哦，他可是个人物。是个配得上我的对手。给我点时间解释，我觉得你也会认为你们两人的对比会很有意思..."

entries.en: "Go now." He looks down, rubbing one hand with the other, genuine worry seeming to have infiltrated his expression.
entries.zh: "现在就去。" 他低下头，一只手与另一只手摩擦，脸上似乎充满了实打实的担忧。

o.en: What's so important about this information?
o.zh: 这份信息有什么这么重要的？

entries.en:
"No time," he snarls, "Go!"

The comm link cuts from his end.
entries.zh:
"没时间解释了，"他咆哮道，"快去！"

通讯链接从他的那一端切断

entries.en:
Macario closes his eyes for a moment. "A matter of great urgency and interest has arisen. I need you to make a fast intercept to this transponder location, coming in through the fringe jump-point. One of my, ah, agents who has been working in Tri-Tachyon space is being pursued. They have information of enormous value."

"Your reward upon securing the integrity of this information and, secondarily, this agent, would be commensurate with the value of said information."

He takes a breath. "That value is immense."
entries.zh:
Macario 闭眼片刻。"现在出现了一个十万火急的重大问题。我需要你立刻前往这个应答器坐标进行拦截，对方来自 边缘跳跃点 方向。我手下一个，呃，在 速子科技 疆域内行动的特工正遭受追捕。他手上有价值极高的信息。"

"如果你能确保这份信息安全，然后，确保这名特工的安全，你的报酬将与上述信息的价值相当。"

他吸了口气。"那份价值是无可估量的。"

entries.en: You see a flash of impatience cross his face.
entries.zh: 你看见他脸上掠过一丝不耐烦。

entries.en: The facade of a smile draws thinner, a delicate thing, like a razor's edge.
entries.zh: 微笑的面具变得越来越薄，就如刀片一般脆弱。

entries.en:
Some kind of alert chirps on Macario's side. He holds up a finger indicating that you should wait, and he turns aside with a killing look on his face.

He opens a secondary comms, "This had better be very important," he says, almost sing-song.

His expression goes slack, processing what he's being told. Then his brow furrows. "Acknowledged," he says, then turns back to you with a fragile smile.

"I must beg you for a quick favor, dear captain."
entries.zh:
Macario 身边传来某种警报声。他伸出一根手指示意你等一下，然后他转过身去，脸上带着杀气。

他打开了第二条通讯链接，"这最好非常重要，" 他几乎是在哼着小曲。

他的表情变得松弛，处理他被告知的事情。然后他的眉头皱了起来。"我收到了，" 他说，然后转身对你露出脆弱的微笑。

"我必须求您帮个快忙，亲爱的舰长。"

o.en: Of course. I serve the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 当然。我为辛达强权效劳。

entries.en:
"Well yes, that's obviously true and he should well know it without an unusually helpful spacer pointing it out for him."

Macario sighs, irritated. "I am surrounded, surrounded by idiots," he mutters.

"Captain," he sits up, speaking clearly now. "I suppose if it works, it works. I would be bored silly if it weren't for the inventiveness of Luddic zealots and the Hegemony's meddling. Are you familiar with Orcus Rao? Oh, he's a character. A worthy opponent, I think. Indulge me a moment, I think you'll find the comparison with yourself amusing..."
entries.zh:
"这当然，这事如此明显，用不了一个出奇乐于助人的太空佬提醒他自己也想得明白。"

Macario 不耐烦地叹了口气。"我被包围了，被一群傻子给包围了。" 他自言自语道。

"舰长，" 他直起身来，语音变得清楚。"反正事成了就成了吧。要不是卢德狂信徒和 霸主 的干涉还有点意思，我早就无聊傻了。你听说过 Orcus Rao 这个名字吗？哦，他可是个人物。是个配得上我的对手。给我点时间解释，我觉得你也会认为你们两人的对比会很有意思..."

entries.en:
Macario raises his hands to his brow as if he's suddenly developed a headache.

"That... is absurd." His hands come down, "And he believed it?"

"Perhaps I am simply too intelligent to place myself fully without the thought processes of such a thick-headed, pompous oaf. Captain," he looks up, the color back in his face, "You astound me."
entries.zh:
Macario 以手扶额，看起来就好像他突然头痛欲裂一般。

"那真是...荒谬。" 他放下手，"他居然相信了？"

"应该只是我太聪明了，我的智慧让我免于这种愚蠢自大的傻瓜思维，舰长。" 他抬起头，脸上恢复了血色，"你着实让我大吃一惊。"

entries.en:
Something tightens on Macario's face, but he plays casual. You've got him off-balance.

"Did he say that?" He chuckles, then assembles a smile. "The man must trust you."

"You see captain? Just follow my lead and you will get results. People are not so complex. You just need to know where to... pull."
entries.zh:
Macario 的脸上有些紧张，但他表现得很轻松。你让他失去了平衡。

"他是这么说的吗？" 他轻笑一声，随即挤出一个笑容，"那个男人肯定是信任你。"

"你瞧舰长？只要跟着我的指引，你就会得到结果。人没那么复杂。你只需要知道往哪里...拉一把。"

entries.en:
"No?" Macario goes very still. "And why not?"

This isn't what he wanted to hear.
entries.zh:
"不信？" Macario 突然不动了。"为什么？"

这不是他想听到的。

entries.en:
"No?" Macario goes very still. "And why not?"

He needs something plausible.
entries.zh:
"不信？" Macario 突然不动了。"为什么？"

他需要更可信的说法。

o.en: Caden told me you were raised by Luddics.
o.zh: Caden 告诉我你是被卢德教徒养大的。

o.en: Hyder has his backing for Supreme Executor. So he said.
o.zh: 他说他会支持 Hyder 成为最高元首。

o.en: He thinks you are unreliable in terms of loyalty to the, uh, ideology of Philip Andrada.
o.zh: 他认为你的忠诚不可靠...比如...在对 Philip Andrada 的意识形态方面。

o.en: He's latched onto the idea that you want to become Supreme Executor.
o.zh: 他已经认定了你想成为最高元首。

o.en: Caden told me you were raised by Luddics.
o.zh: Caden 告诉我你是被卢德教徒养大的。

o.en: Hyder has been in contact with Caden. (lie)
o.zh: Hyder 一直都在私下联系 Caden。 (说谎)

o.en: I told Caden that Hyder supports you taking the office of Supreme Executor.
o.zh: 我告诉 Caden 说 Hyder 会支持你成为最高元首。

o.en: Caden seemed to have the idea that you've overstepped your authority.
o.zh: Caden 似乎认为你现在所为已经跨出了你的职权范围。

o.en: He got it into his head that you intend to treat him as a puppet.
o.zh: 他认识到你计划把他作为傀儡。

o.en: Because, despite my commission, you are using me to purge traitors.
o.zh: 因为即便我拿着委任状，你还是在利用我铲除叛徒。

entries.en:
"He has, has he?" Macario rolls his eyes, "I can only speculate about where that pompous oaf discovered such a notion. It can't have come from his own head, that is assured."

He holds very still for a moment. His cold eyes swing to focus on you, somehow, through the comms.

"Captain. You wouldn't.... no, of course not. But..."
entries.zh:
"他还真这样想了啊。" Macario 翻了个白眼，"我也只能揣测这个装模做样的蠢货是从哪里得出这个想法的。可以肯定的是，这不可能来自他自己的脑子。"

他一动不动了一瞬，他冰冷的眼光似乎越过通讯平台注视着你。

"舰长。你不会... 不，你肯定不会。但..."

entries.en: The comms go unanswered. The crest of the Sindrian Diktat internal security ministry slowly turns.
entries.zh: 通讯请求无人应答。辛达强权 内部安全部的徽标慢慢转动着。

entries.en:
"Has he indeed," he says, not asking a question. "Given that I know with absolute certainty that the withered contents of Caden's correctly-shaped skull are incapable of original thought, a question is raised: from where - from whom - did he receive this troubling notion." Macario's tongue flickers at the side of his mouth, "Dear captain."

He pauses, meaningfully.

Then, eyes narrowing, draws a breath to speak.
entries.zh:
"他当然认识得到，" 他斩钉截铁的说："毕竟我也相当确定，他那形状正确的脑壳里只剩那么一点萎缩的东西了，让它独立思考可是太难了。那就有问题了：他是从哪里 —— 从谁那里 —— 听说了这种麻烦的想法呢？" Macario 的舌头在嘴角轻轻一抹，"亲爱的舰长。"

他顿了一下，意味深长。

随后，他眯起眼，深吸一口气，继续说话。

entries.en:
Macario rolls his eyes, and with a sigh, "Yes, I suppose I should have expected that."

His annoyed look fixes upon you.

"Surely you've made any kind of novel observation? Surely your commission hasn't made you as thick-headed as Caden? Pray tell me something I don't already know, captain."
entries.zh:
Macario 翻了个白眼，叹气道，"是啊，我早该料到你会这么说。"

他不耐烦的目光定在你身上。

"你就没有半点新鲜的见地？那张委任状总不至于把你也变得跟 Caden 一样死脑筋吧？行行好，说点我还不知道的，舰长。"

entries.en:
Macario looks pained, as if struck by a sudden migraine.

"Why... in the good name of Ludd's holy excrement, blessed be, would you say something as stupid as that?"

He brings his hands over his eyes, as if to wipe away the foolishness. You can't quite pin the sound he is making.
entries.zh:
Macario 如突然头痛一般，看上去很痛苦。

"为什么... 卢德神圣的粪坑在上，为什么你会说这种蠢话？"

他双手遮眼，似乎试图抹去他听到的蠢话。你说不太清楚他到底在发出什么声音。

entries.en:
"Hyder?" Macario barks out a single laugh and rocks back in his seat.

"And he believed it? Ah, but of course he did, of course he did."
entries.zh:
"Hyder？" Macario 干笑一声，然后靠回了他的椅背。

"然后他信了？啊，他当然会信，当然会信。"

entries.en: "You?" Macario barks out a single laugh. "A spontaneous display of false loyalty! I'm sure he enjoyed it. Well done, captain."
entries.zh: "你？" Macario 干笑一声，"你当机立断地表现了虚假的忠心！我肯定他喜欢这一套。干得好，舰长。"

entries.en: "Splendid. Excellent." Macario's tone doesn't match his words, as if he's disappointed.
entries.zh: "漂亮，太好了。" Macario 的口气和他的话语完全搭不上调，他似乎很失望。

entries.en:
"Splendid. Excellent." Macario's tone doesn't match his words, as if he's disappointed.

He needs something plausible.
entries.zh:
"漂亮，太好了。" Macario 的口气和他的话语完全搭不上调，他似乎很失望。

他需要更加可信的说法。

o.en: Caden told me you were raised by Luddics.
o.zh: Caden 告诉我你是被卢德教徒养大的。

o.en: I told him you are committed to taking down his rivals, particularly Hyder.
o.zh: 我告诉他你会专心解决掉他的对手，尤其是 Hyder。

o.en: I told him that you secretly admire his ideological commitment.
o.zh: 我告诉他你暗中钦佩他对于理念的奉献。

o.en: I told him you embody the Andradan virtues and possess unquestionable loyalty.
o.zh: 我告诉他你是 Andrada 美德的模范，而且忠心耿耿。

o.en: Caden told me you were raised by Luddics.
o.zh: Caden 告诉我你是被卢德教徒养大的。

o.en: I told Caden that Hyder wants to become Supreme Executor.
o.zh: 我告诉 Caden 说 Hyder 想成为最高元首。

o.en: I told Caden that I would support him becoming Supreme Executor.
o.zh: 我告诉 Caden 我会支持他成为最高元首。

entries.en:
"Hmm. Yes," Macario leans back, tapping his fingers together. "She is not wrong to see it. Ha! Caden. Imagine him in charge. Dress-up and parades while the worlds crumble."

"Not to worry," he says cheerfully, "Caden will perform quite adequately as figurehead provided he's given plenty of little distractions."
entries.zh:
"嗯，对。" Macario 向后靠着，几根手指随意敲着，"她的看法倒是没错。哈，Caden！想想他掌权是个什么样子：整个世界分崩离析之时，那货却还在纠结着穿着打扮，忙着组织阅兵！"

"不用担心。" 他愉快地说道，"只要给 Caden 足够多的小事，分散他的注意力，让他当个空架子领袖也挺合适。"

entries.en: Macario nods, thoughtfully rubbing his chin.
entries.zh: Macario 点了点头，若有所思地摩挲下巴。

entries.en: "Hmm," he says, thinking. "Continue."
entries.zh: "嗯，" 他若有所思地说道，"继续。"

entries.en: Macario's eyebrows raise just a little, like he's just a tiny bit impressed by that one.
entries.zh: Macario 的眼眉轻挑，似乎对这个略微有点印象。

entries.en: "Interesting," he lies.
entries.zh: "有趣，" 他撒谎道。

entries.en: "Only half?" Macario feigns surprise. "How charitable."
entries.zh: "只有一半？" Macario 假装惊讶道，"那我可真仁慈！"

entries.en: "Of course. Well done." He drums his fingers impatiently.
entries.zh: "当然。干得好。" 他说着说着，手指不耐烦地四处敲打着。

entries.en: "Yes," Macario says, "I know that already."
entries.zh: "是。" Macario 说，"我早就知道了。"

o.en: She said you would fuel starships and feed crews with only lies, if you could.
o.zh: 她说，如果你能的话，你会拿你的谎言养活船员、驱动星舰。

o.en: She said you cannot comprehend the concepts of honor, duty, and discipline.
o.zh: 她说你无法理解荣誉、职责和纪律的理念。

o.en: She called you a meddlesome worm.
o.zh: 她把你称作一条爱管闲事的蛆虫。

o.en: She said you've allowed the Volturnian Resistance to continue because you're incompetent and distracted.
o.zh: 她说你允许 Volturn 反抗军继续存在，是因为你不仅无能，还玩忽职守。

o.en: She says that half of the operations you authorize are treasonous.
o.zh: 她说你授权的一半行动都是叛国行径。

entries.en: "Fascinating! And what did she say?" He leans forward, attention focused. "Did she accept?"
entries.zh: "好！然后她说什么了？" 他身子猛的往前一倾，注意力忽的集中起来，"她接受了吗？"

o.en: She didn't really answer. Just something about treason and execution.
o.zh: 她答非所问，就说了一堆叛国呀，死刑呀的胡话。

entries.en:
"Damnation!" Macario pounds a fist on the table, but he can't help but continue grinning. "Excellent work. I shall have to pursue this angle."

"It will be," he furiously rubs his hands together,"... fun."
entries.zh:
"这个遭天谴的！" Macario 出拳猛砸桌子，却又情不自禁地偷笑起来，"干得好，那我就得猛攻这个方向了。"

"这事会很..." 他猛搓双手，"...很有意思的。"

entries.en: "Good! You can't run a polity like a battleship!" Macario shakes his head, "Now if she'd simply recognize that the business of ruling should be handled by someone more capable."
entries.zh: "很好！操弄战舰与操弄政治终究是两码事！" Macario 摇了摇头，"就看她能不能认识到，统治这种事应该交给更有能力的人。"

entries.en:
"Fascinating," he leans forward.

"She always did admire Andrada's boldness and genius. And while Caden is no Andrada, he might serve as an acceptable... substitute. The alternative would be chaos. Hyder can see that, and perhaps she is capable of putting aside her personal feelings for the greater good... yes, that could be it."
entries.zh:
"这想法，真是令人着迷。" 他说着，身子稍微前倾。

"她可实打实的一直在敬仰着 Andrada，她敬仰他的果敢，敬仰他的才华。虽说 Caden 不是 Andrada，让 Caden 替代 Andrada，倒也勉强可以接受 —— 没 Caden 上位的话，就要乱了套了。Hyder 也能看出让 Caden 上台的必要性，说不定，她还能放下自己的个人情感，顾全大局，请他上位... 对，这种事也有可能。"

entries.en:
"Truly?" He leans back, rubbing his chin.

"This is an unexpected turn. As a trained military commander, perhaps Hyder recognizes - despite her personal feelings - that aligning herself with a powerful leader will lead to the best outcome..."
entries.zh:
"真的？" 他说着，身子猛的向后一靠，若有所思地摩挲下巴。

"这么一出可真是出人意料。或许，Hyder 这样训练精良的军官能认清现状，无论个人好恶如何，她都能意识到只有与强势领袖做盟友，才能达到皆大欢喜。"

o.en: Consider some truths to tell Macario
o.zh: 向 Macario 坦白一些事实

o.en: If it comes to it, Hyder would back Caden's leadership. (lie)
o.zh: 如果有必要的话，Hyder 会支持 Caden 的领导。 (说谎)

o.en: Hyder will back you as leader, though she is reluctant. (lie)
o.zh: 尽管 Hyder 不情愿，但她会支持你作为领导者。 (说谎)

o.en: She thinks that no one could lead the Sindrian Diktat but herself. (lie)
o.zh: 她认为除了她自己，没人能够领导 辛达强权。 (说谎)

o.en: I believe that Hyder wants to defect to the Hegemony. (lie)
o.zh: 我认为 Hyder 更想叛逃去 霸主。 (说谎)

o.en: That's all I have to say.

entries.en: You've already lied once to Macario. It might test his patience to push further.
entries.zh: 你已经向 Macario 撒过一次谎。继续撒谎可能会考验他的耐心。

entries.en:
"No!" he exclaims, "And the Hegemony would have her?"

"This must be Daud's work." He starts rubbing his hands together furiously, "It fits, it fits. He possesses a low cunning honed during his criminal upbringing."
