He looks up at you, his hands stopping their frenetic activity as if he just realized you could see it. "I admire Daud, of course. To accomplish so much, arisen from the parasite class to the top of command? It is truly incredible. He chose well in making Rao his attack-hound."

His hands start up again, his gaze wandering. "There is... much to do, much to think about..."
entries.zh:
"不！" 他大惊失色，喊道，"那她就要归 霸主 了？"

"肯定是 Daud 搞鬼！" 他说着说着，双手开始猛搓，"对上了，对上了！他可是罪犯养大的，正是在社会底层磨炼过，才会如此狡猾！"

他抬头看了看你，双手终于不再乱动，好像这会他才反应过来，你其实能看到他的一举一动，"自然，我很钦佩 Daud。他居然能做到这么多，从社会的寄生虫，一路做到整个 霸主 的总指挥？真是了不起。"

说着说着，他的双手又开始不自觉的摩挲起来，目光也开始四处游移，"有很多...很多事得想，很多事得做..."

entries.en:
"Hyder? Leading the Sindrian Diktat?" He blurts out a single laugh, but his eyes are not amused.

"Nonsense, of course. But if she believes there was not another choice that could fit within her peculiar sense of ethics and psychological need for order... placing herself in what she thinks is control... yes, the motive could fit."

He sighs, looking up. "Ah, but what this would cost! The question then is how much of the navy will back her - a not insignificant number of that, let us be realistic, rather plebeian force even looks up to her. She's 'strict but fair', they say."

He shakes his head, distracted; working out risk analyses for future schemes.
entries.zh:
"Hyder？让她领导 辛达强权？" 他说着说着，突然大笑一声，但他的眼神仍然严肃如一。

"当然，这种事肯定是异想天开。但，如果说，她相信要想践行她心中那种奇妙的道德观念，满足她心中对秩序的渴求，别无他法的话...就要登上她自认为的领袖之位...对，这个动机说得通。"

他叹了口气，抬头望去，"啊，但她若是想这么来，代价又得有多大！到时候就得问问，整个海军中支持她的又会有多少？说的实际点，她的支持者肯定少不了，不说海军，连那些平民都很尊重她呢。那些平民说，她虽然严苛，却很公正呢。"

他心不在焉的摇了摇头，估计正暗自评估着以后行动的风险。

entries.en:
Macario taps an unseen datapad.

"The Lion's Guard has its own intelligence section, of course. Wild about strong-jawed young men enforcing correct ideology and demonstrations of loyalty," he adopts a patiently patronizing tone. "Light on tradecraft."

"Sadly, one of Caden's agents on Umbra has been working for the insurrectionists from the beginning," he says. "Take the agent by force. Once Caden calms down, he will... approve of you cleaning up this embarrassment, you'll see. Just let him think he's in charge, that's all it takes."
entries.zh:
Macario 在个你看不到的数据平板上敲了几下。

"狮心卫队 当然有它们自己的情报部门。拘泥于让一脸正气的年轻人去端正意识形态，示范热血忠诚。" 他的语气像是个很有耐心的恩师一样，"却不重视间谍情报技术。"

"可惜了，Caden 在 Umbra 上的一名特工从一开始就一直在为叛乱分子效力。" 他说道，"强行带走那名特工。等到 Caden 冷静下来之后，他应该会...准许你处理这个尴尬的局面的，你就等着瞧吧。只需要让他觉得自己还是掌局者就够了。"

o.en: Confront Caden with his double-agent. Right.
o.zh: 让 Caden 面对他的双面特工。好的。

o.en: So this agent is working for the Resistance?
o.zh: 所以这名特工在为抵抗组织效力？

o.en: How long have you known about this?

entries.en:
Macario smiles mirthlessly.

"You'll get along splendidly provided you can pretend your greatest aspiration is to lick Andrada's boots."
entries.zh: Macario 面带冷笑。"只要你能假装你最大的愿望是舔 Andrada 的靴子，你们会相处得很愉快的。"

entries.en:
Macario smiles mirthlessly.

"You're not without hope, captain."

"Now go nab that agent for the pompous clown. You'll get along splendidly with Caden provided you pretend that licking boots is your greatest aspiration."
entries.zh:
Macario 面带冷笑。"你并不是毫无希望，舰长。"

"现在将那个特工给抓住，并献给这个自大的小丑。只要你装作舔靴子是你最大的抱负，你会和 Caden 相处得很愉快的。"

entries.en:
"Indeed!" Macario says, wide-eyed.

"Imagine wasting years on such a hopeless cause! Then everything is undone because you were compromised by," he smiles with actual pleasure, dropping his voice into mock disappointment, "a friend."

"Oh, I shouldn't pay such attention to such small things. It is one of my few character flaws. But I do so enjoy the drama which plays between the lines of - and I'll be the first to admit - terribly dry intelligence reports. I do miss the old days, sometimes," he sighs.

"There was so much more time to conduct business... personally."
entries.zh:
"确实！" Macario 说道，双目圆睁。"想象一下你将多年的心血投入到这样一个毫无希望的泡影之上！然后一切都毁了，只因为你被别人陷害，" 他发自内心地微笑起来，以一种失望的口吻嘲讽道，"还是被一个朋友。"

"哦，我不应该对这样一件小事过于关注。这是我为数不多的性格缺陷当中的一个。但我实在是很享受这出在一摞摞 —— 我要第一个承认 —— 枯燥无味的情报报告中上演的好戏 。我的确怀念过去的那些美好时光，有时吧。" 他感叹道。

"那时有太多时间来开展一些...私人安排。"

entries.en: You have the Diktat patrol fleet officer in your brig for Macario. Best to address old business first.
entries.zh: 你的船上关着 Macario 指示的辛达强权巡逻队的指挥官。还是先处理好之前的事。

o.en: I have your traitorous officer ready to transfer.
o.zh: 我准备送回你的叛徒军官。

o.en: I promised to let the prisoner go free on an independent world.
o.zh: 我发誓过要把这个军官带到一个独立世界去。

o.en: I transferred the prisoner to Hyder's custody. (lie)
o.zh: 我已经把犯人交到 Hyder 的手上了。 (说谎)

o.en: Unfortunately the prisoner died between capture and the present. (lie)
o.zh: 很不幸，犯人已经在被捕后死亡了。 (说谎)

entries.en:
"You do?" Macario releases a quick breath, looking to the side, annoyed. "Fine, fine, send them over and we'll have that loose end trimmed."

He taps each hand once on his desk, then brings them together and looks at you attentively. "Now tell me about Hyder."
entries.zh:
"在你手里？" Macario 快速地呼出一口气，向一旁望去，生气地说道，"好吧，好吧，把那家伙送过来，我们得滴水不漏，不能徒增枝节。"

他两只手分别在桌子上敲了一下，然后将双手合拢，专注地看着你。"现在告诉我 Hyder 的情况。"

entries.en:
"Really?" Macario looks amused, "How charming."

"Well, it doesn't hurt to give my operatives a bit of a challenge. Wouldn't want to let them go soft, eh?"

He taps each hand once on his desk, then brings them together and looks at you attentively. "Now tell me about Hyder."
entries.zh:
"真的吗？" Macario 好像被逗乐了，"那你可真友好呢。"

"嗯，给我的特工们一点挑战也无妨。可不能让他们太软弱，是吧？"

他两只手分别在桌子上敲了一下，然后将双手合拢，专注地看着你。"现在告诉我 Hyder 的情况。"

entries.en: "Oh?" Macario's eyebrow raises. "But you didn't."
entries.zh: "哦？" Macario 的眼眉轻挑。"但是你并没有。"

o.en: I assure you that I did.
o.zh: 我向你保证，我已经这么做了。

o.en: Can you be absolutely certain about what I did and didn't do?
o.zh: 你能完全确定我做了什么，又没做什么吗？

entries.en:
"Interesting," he says, then leans forward. "Don't disappoint me, captain. I think you're too smart to think I'm stupid."

He leans back again, and flicks his fingers. "Have the prisoner. I don't care. They'll end up dead one way or another. We like to tidy up loose ends around here. Now, about Hyder."
entries.zh:
"有趣。" 他说，然后向前倾身，"不要让我失望，舰长。我可觉得你那么聪明，不至于当我傻来着。"

他再次向后靠，轻轻挥动手指。"你就留着囚犯吧，我不在乎。无论如何，天有绝人之路，我们喜欢处理这种细枝末节。现在，说说 Hyder 的事情吧。"

entries.en:
"Interesting," he says, then leans forward. "Don't disappoint me, captain. I think you're too smart to think I'm stupid."

He leans back again, and flicks his fingers. "Have the prisoner. I don't care. They'll end up dead one way or another. We like to tidy up loose ends around here. Now, about Hyder."
entries.zh:
"有趣。" 他说，然后向前倾身，"不要让我失望，舰长。我可觉得你那么聪明，不至于当我傻来着。"

他再次向后靠，轻轻挥动手指。"你就留着囚犯吧，我不在乎。无论如何，天有绝人之路，我们喜欢处理这种细枝末节。现在，说说 Hyder 的事情吧。"

entries.en:
"You're giving up so easily." he says, looking hurt. Then he leans forward. "Do as you will, captain, but do not disappoint me. You're too smart for that, aren't you?"

He leans back again, and flicks his fingers. "Well, do transfer the prisoner. We like to tidy up loose ends around here. Now, about Hyder."
entries.zh:
"你就这么轻易放弃了。" 他说着说着，看来有点伤心。然后他向前倾身，"那就把囚犯交给我吧，舰长，但别再让我失望了。你这么聪明，肯定不会再做蠢事了，对吧？"

他再次向后靠，轻轻挥动手指。"行，这回一定要把那货交给我，我们喜欢处理这种细枝末节。现在，说说 Hyder 的事情吧。"

entries.en: "Yes yes, very sad, accidents and so forth," he says impatiently. "Tell me about Hyder."
entries.zh: "对对对，非常遗憾，意外事故之类的。" 他不耐烦地说道，"还是跟我讲讲 Hyder 的事吧。"

entries.en: "Very good of her to notice," he says. "Pity there's nothing she can do about it."
entries.zh: "她能注意到这点真是太好了，" 他说道。"可惜她对此无能为力。"

o.en: She says you've conspired to hold back her promotion to Grand Star Marshal.
o.zh: 她说，你密谋阻止她晋升为星际元帅。

o.en: She doesn't believe Caden can successfully lead the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 她不相信 Caden 能够成功领导 辛达强权。

o.en: She doesn't want to lead the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 她并不想领导 辛达强权。

o.en: She blames you for the navy's supply problems.
o.zh: 她把舰队的补给问题归咎于你。

o.en: That's all I have to say.
I offered to arrange for her defection back to the Hegemony.
o.zh: 我主动提出安排她叛逃回 霸主 的事宜。

o.en: Consider some lies to tell Macario
o.zh: 想一些谎言去骗过 Macario

entries.en: It may be to your advantage to tell Macario certain lies. He seems perceptive, so it is unlikely that you can get away with telling too many.
entries.zh: 向 Macario 讲一些谎言可能对你有利。但他似乎很敏感，所以你可能无法蒙混过关太多次。

entries.en:
"At least she put it together," Macario checks a fingernail for dirt.

"Hyder will just have to use what she's got more effectively - and source her contraband more stealthily. I've found that many subordinates can thrive under pressure," he adds helpfully.

"Hmm," he considers, "subject to circumstances, naturally."
entries.zh:
"至少她把事情搞清楚了。" Macario 检查了一下指甲上有没有脏东西。

"这下子，Hyder 就得更有效地利用她手上的资源，还得更隐秘地搞违禁品了。我发现，许多下属受到压力之后，反倒能茁壮成长。" 他又补上了一句，语气像是他在帮忙似的。

"嗯..." 他考虑着，"当然，茁壮成长与否，终究要取决于具体情况。"

entries.en:
"I must admit that you've underwhelmed me, captain."

Macario leans back, hands held together, eyes on you. "Perhaps, stars forgive my manners, but perhaps you have not been entirely forthright?"

"I would so hate for the potential of our little collaboration to, how to put it... there's a Luddic expression, 'die on the vine' I believe? Now there's an image." He smiles charmlessly.

"Speaking of, let me provide you another opportunity to demonstrate your worth." He pauses a moment, then adds in a not-quite-threatening tone, "I'm sure by the end you'll agree that I can be very forgiving."
entries.zh:
"我必须承认，你让我感到失望，舰长。" Macario 向后靠着，双手握在一起，注视着你，"或许 —— 请繁星原谅我的举止 —— 但或许，你并没有完全坦诚？"

"我非常讨厌我们之间这次小小合作的潜能...怎么说呢，用一个卢德的说法，'无果而终'，我相信是这样说的吧？这么说形象点。" 他毫不迷人地微笑着。

"说到这里，让我给你另一个展示你价值的机会。" 他停顿了一下，然后以一种不完全威胁的语气补充道，"我相信到最后你会留下这样一个印象，那就是我可以非常宽容。"

entries.en:
He pauses, and seems to notice his own hands grasping one another, like they're trying to strangle each other. He lets them fall to the desk in a deliberate motion.

"That was of mild interest. Confirming, I suppose, other sources," he leans back. "Ah, the rote work of intelligence gathering. It can't all end with a single, dramatic gunshot, eh?"

"Lucky for you, however, that's exactly what I've lined up with you in mind." He catches himself, amused, "No, no, not for you. One of Caden's agents on Umbra. I shall explain."
entries.zh:
他停顿了一下，似乎注意到自己的双手紧紧握在一起，力度大到就像它们想要勒死彼此一样。他故意将手砸到桌上。

"我有些感兴趣了。不如，我觉得，再确认一下其他信源？" 他向后靠着，"啊，情报收集的例行工作哟，并不是所有事情都会以一声戏剧性的枪响作结，对吧？"

"但你很幸运，我为你考虑的工作就是如此。" 他把自己给逗乐了，"不，不，不是说要射杀你，而是要你处理 Caden 在 Umbra 的一名特工。让我解释一下。"

entries.en:
"To tell the truth," Macario pauses to suppress a strange sound, like a hiccup, "you've been illuminating."

He leans back, hands grasping one another. "You could make a reasonable agent, were you more discreet."

He smiles hollowly. "Far more discreet."

"Happily, I have just the thing, just the thing. The level of discretion is up to you; you'll find that I supervise with a light hand, contrary to the lies told about me. If you need to raze a few habs from orbit to extract an agent, why, then I accept your professional judgment. But let me explain..."
entries.zh:
"说实话，" Macario 停顿了一下，压制住了一个奇怪的声音，像是打嗝，"你给我提供了很多启示。"

他向后靠着，双手握在一起。"如果你更加谨慎的话，你可以成为一个合格的特工。" 他茫然地笑了笑。"要更加谨慎才行。"

"幸运的是，我刚好有合适的情况，正好合适。自行裁量的等级取决于你；你会发现，与他们在我身上撒的谎相反，我的监督非常宽松。如果你需要搞轨道轰炸轰平几个定居点来营救一个特工，那么我接受你的专业判断。但是让我来解释一下..."

entries.en:
He takes a deep breath with closed eyes, then looks on you with renewed vigor. "And you. You are an outsider, you are the perfect wedge for my plan to alter the course of history."

He holds a hand up to stop your reply.

"No, not yet. We must speak in the flesh," he taps something, and your comm-link receives coordinates - an address on Volturn. "There is a safehouse under my personal authority. OpSec will be assured."

$Rank Ram gives a quick nod and signs off.
entries.zh:
他闭上眼睛深吸了一口气，然后带着全新的活力看向你。"而你，你是个外人，你就是我改变历史进程的计划中最完美的楔子。"

他举起一只手打断了你的回复。

"不，还不到时候。我们必须面对面谈。" 他按了什么，接着你的通讯链接收到了一个坐标 —— Volturn 上的一个地点。"那儿有我私人管理的一个安全屋。可以保证行动安全。"

$Rank Ram 快速地点了一下头，然后断开了通讯。

entries.en:
You whisper the codeword under your breath.

Nothing.

Macario sighs expressively, pistol steady on your center of mass. "Your squad is detained. Some of them, anyway. Now, shall we have a civilized discussion?"
entries.zh:
你低声念出暗号。

没有回应。

Macario 意味深长地叹了口气，手枪依然稳稳地瞄准着你的正中心。"你的小队被拘留了。至少是他们中的一部分人。回到正题，我们现在可以开始文明地交流了吗？"

o.en: He was mine to kill. For justice.
o.zh: 本来我为了伸张正义，也要杀了他的。

o.en: He was mine to kill. For revenge.
o.zh: 本来我为了报仇雪恨，也要杀了他的。

o.en: Call your marine squad with the subvocal keyphrase
o.zh: 说出暗号，召来你的陆战队员

o.en: See if you can find a makeshift weapon while he's distracted
o.zh: 看你能否在他分心时找到把临时武器

o.en: See if you can find a makeshift weapon while he's distracted
o.zh: 看你能否在他分心时找到把临时武器

o.en: On second thought, cancel the flight for now
o.zh: 转念想想，暂时先取消航程

entries.en: You inspect the shuttle that will take you to the surface of Volturn. Your tech officer, armorer, personal guards, and pilot attend.
entries.zh: 你检查着带你去 Volturn 地表的穿梭机。你的技术军官，军械员，私人守卫，还有驾驶员也在场。

o.en: Board the shuttle and fly to Ram's Safehouse
o.zh: 登上穿梭机驶往 Ram 的安全屋

o.en: Bring a squad of marines as backup

entries.en:
You order a half-dozen of your most experienced marines to don stealth-op gear.

Their outer suits shimmer and rustle, and six sleek black marines in light armor transform before you into a group of civilian technicians wearing vague impressions of vac-safety gear and overalls.

You have to but whisper the code-phrase and they will perform a rapid assault - through airlock and bulkhead if necessary - to secure your position.
entries.zh:
你叫来六名经验最丰富的陆战队员并给他们穿上潜行装备。

在他们的外层战斗服一阵闪烁作响后，六名身着漆黑轻甲的陆战队员在你面前变化成了一群大众化到难有印象的，穿着真空防护装备的平民技工。

只需轻声说出暗语，他们就会迅速执行突击行动 —— 必要时突破气闸和舱壁 —— 以确保你所处位置的安全。

o.zh: 准备一把可以隐藏的武器

o.en: A clutch of small plastic grenades

entries.en:
Your armorer walks you through the process of activating as well as deactivating the grenades, and familiarizes you with their timing and throw-weight. You conceal a half-dozen of them about your uniform.

The infernal little things pack a devilish punch.
entries.zh:
你的军械员一步步讲解了激活和解除手榴弹的过程，且让你熟悉其引信时长和投掷重量。你在你的制服上藏了六个这样的东西。

这些可恶的小东西充满了邪恶的力量。

entries.en:
Your armorer demonstrates activating the knife; the blade blurs slightly and you hear the keening of a small insect at the edge of your hearing. This knife, when active, could slice a new opening into your shuttle.

Your armorer deactivates it, then expertly flips the knife around to offer you the handle. You conceal it on your person.
entries.zh:
你的军械员演示了如何激活这把刀。刀刃变得略微模糊，你似乎听到有只小虫子在你听力的上限附近发出了尖啸。这把刀启动之后能轻易地帮你在穿梭机上开个新出口。

你的军械员将其关闭，然后熟练地翻转刀子，将刀柄递给你。你把它贴身藏好。

o.en: No weapon; you don't need one

entries.en: Your ops chief lifts an eyebrow but manages to hide their smile. Your armorer merely nods compliance, then begins securing the miniature arsenal.
entries.zh: 你的行动长官挑了挑眉毛，但还是掩饰住了笑容。你的军械员只是点头称是，然后开始确保小型军火库的安全。

o.zh: 一把哑光黑的聚碳酸酯手枪

entries.en:
Your armorer ensures the pistol is unloaded, then hands it and two cellmags to you. It's a little shadow of a thing, and darker still, the armorer explains, on most personal scanners.

You load the pistol, ensure its status is green and safety is locked, then conceal it on your person. It weighs barely anything, but can punch a fist-sized hole through flesh without breaching standard bulkheads.
entries.zh:
你的军械员确保手枪已经退膛净空，然后将它和两个能量弹匣一起交给了你。军械员解释说，在大多数的个人扫描仪上，它看起来会像是某件杂物的小黑影，不过要更暗点。

你给手枪充能上膛，检查其状态良好之后锁上了保险，将其藏在自己身上。它几乎没什么分量，但可以在不破坏标准舱壁的前提下，将肉体打出一个拳头大小的洞。

entries.en:
Your armorer has a set of immaculate metal cases brought to the hangar for your inspection. Each is opened in turn, displaying an impressive variety of hand weapons. Matte black predominates; there are tiny plastic bombs, a spectrum of pistols, ceramic knives with powered or unpowered blades, a series of chemical sprays in hidden capsules, and even a false fingertip containing a monomolecular cutting filament.

What would Ram never expect?
entries.zh:
你的军械员把一整套整洁利落的各式金属箱带到了机库供你检查。每个箱子依次打开，展示出里面种类繁多的各式手持武器。大部分的武器都是哑光黑色的，其中有一些小型塑胶炸弹，大小不同的各式手枪，几把陶瓷制成的小刀和动力刃，一系列用隐蔽容器携带的化学喷剂，甚至还有个装了单分子切割丝的假指头。

还有哪些能让 Ram 大吃一惊的呢？

entries.en:
Your armorer affixes the sprays inside your uniform cuffs - they would pass for subtle fabric-stiffening clips - and, with safeties on, demonstrates the motion required to activate the spray.

With a mere flick of the hand and a demon's exhalation you could ensure the rapid loss of consciousness or death of a small cluster of adult humans within a range of a few meters. The poisons would then react with self-contained nanotech pseudo-proteins to dissolve into a wisp of molecules which could be plausibly found on any imperfectly maintained spacefaring vessel.
entries.zh:
你的军械员在制服袖口里贴上了喷雾器，就像些用来让衣物保持笔挺的小饰物一样不起眼。然后在保险工作的情况下，展示了激活喷雾器所需的动作。

只需轻轻一挥手，恶魔的吐息就会喷涌而出，你就保证能让几米范围内的一小群成年人迅速失去意识或死亡。随后，毒性物质会和一套纳米技术伪蛋白质发生反应，降解成随便在哪个有点小毛病的远航星舰上都可以见到的一些常见物质分子，能够以假乱真。

o.en: The sword of an officer, like you used on Eventide
o.zh: 军官佩剑，和你在 Eventide 决斗时用的那把一样

o.en: The sword of an officer, like you used on Eventide
o.zh: 军官佩剑，和你在 Eventide 决斗时用的那把一样

entries.en:
Your armorer lifts an eyebrow then gives a quiet order via hand-comms. Within the minute, a crewmember brings your sword, handing it off to your armorer who then offers the flat to you using two hands, as is correct.

You secure the scabbard to your belt in the style of the conservative elements of the Hegemony officer corps. The weight of hand-forged steel is reassuring.
entries.zh:
你的军械员眉头轻挑，用手势发出了一个无声的指令。不到一分钟的功夫，一位船员就找来你的佩剑把它转交给你的军械员。随后军械员双手平托着将佩剑呈给你，像是按照什么规定好的一样。

你遵照 霸主 军官团的传统风格将剑鞘系在腰间。手工锻造的钢铁之重，令你倍感安心。

entries.en:
"Ah," your armorer can't help but smile, "A classic."

They affix the false-fingertip to your hand, allowing it a moment to match the color and texture of your finger, then demonstrate how to unspool the weighted tip into a deadly filament which you can use like an molecule-width cutting garrote, or swing in a severing arc.
entries.zh:
"啊。" 你的军械员情不自禁地笑了，"经典之选。"

他们将假指尖贴在你的手上，让它和你手指的颜色和纹路相匹配，然后演示了如何用加重的尖端甩出一条致命的丝线。你可以用这只有几个分子宽的丝线绞断脖颈，或挥出一道能撕裂一切的弧线。

o.zh: 带一个隐秘的全息录像装置

entries.en:
Your technology officer proudly offers you a small case.

The holorec unit is a whisper of transmitter wire visible only when it catches the light, fine as a hair, and a couple small dermal patches to be placed around your face and head. Even without the passive-camo system active, it is difficult to see the individual components of the rec unit without knowing what to look for.
entries.zh:
你的技术军官自豪地递给你一个小盒子。

这个全息录像装置是一套传输线组成的弱信号传播报告器，只能在光照下被看到，其精细程度与头发丝无异。另有几片小的皮肤贴片，粘在了你的面部与头部周围。即使不去激活被动伪装系统，如果没有明确搜查的目标，也很难发现录像装置的各个组件。

entries.en:
"Greetings Captain $playerName," says $Rank Ram with detached authority. "I've been following your career for some time. You are, mm, quite ideally placed."

"I need you to help me save the Sindrian Diktat." He produces a painful-looking smile at this, and looks like he expects you to return it.
entries.zh:
"幸会，$playerName 舰长。" $Rank Ram 带着超然的权威说道，"我关注你的职业生涯有段时间了。你，嗯，处在一个绝妙的位置。"

"我需要你帮我拯救 辛达强权。" 他说着露出了一个痛苦的笑容，而且看来他希望得到你的回应。

o.en: As bearer of a Sindrian Diktat commission, it is my duty to help.
o.zh: 作为一名 辛达强权 的在职雇佣兵，这是我的职责。

o.en: What could you possibly want from me?
o.zh: 那你究竟想要让我做些什么呢？

o.en: Do you remember me? I remember you.
o.zh: 你还记得我吗？我可还记得你呢。

o.en: You had your thugs beat me. Now you want my help?
o.zh: 你手下给了我一顿好打，现在你又来找我帮忙？

o.en: I hate the Sindrian Diktat. I don't want to save it.
o.zh: 我憎恨 辛达强权，更不会想着去拯救它。

o.en: I'm in. Where do we start?
o.zh: 算我一个，从哪里开始动手？

entries.en:
"Yes, yes," Ram leans in, an odd gleam to his eyes now apparent.

"You see clearly that Philip Andrada's vision has been corrupted from the glorious early days. The ministries have fallen to infighting and corruption; our fleets are bloated with incompetents, our factories run by degenerate plunderers. The martial virtues which defined our once-glorious Diktat have been lost - we must reclaim them."

"The Supreme Executor is not himself, and may already be dead. We see holos, but who can say if they are true? Corrupt advisors are exploiting the situation for their own benefit, so it is up to us - the front-line officers loyal to the Movement, who know blood and sweat - to save the Diktat!"
entries.zh:
"是的，是的。" Ram 倾身靠了过来，眼中有什么奇怪的神情逐渐浮现。

"你很清楚，Philip Andrada 的愿景已经失去了往日的辉煌，完全腐朽殆尽。各部委都沉沦在内斗和腐败之中。我们的舰队里挤满了无才的渎职者，我们的工厂都掌控在堕落的贪污犯手里。曾让我们成就强权霸业的优良军事作风，现在也已经不复存在了 —— 我们必须夺回这一切。"

"最高元首已经不再是他本人了，说不定都已经去世了。我们都在看全息影像，但谁又能明白那些是真是假？营私舞弊的参谋们现在正忙着乘机谋取私利，因此重担就落在了我们这些铭记了鲜血和汗水，忠于伟大运动的前线军官身上了。我们要挺身而出，拯救强权！"

entries.en:
"Precisely," Ram leans in, an odd gleam to his eyes now apparent.

"It has become a hateful thing, hasn't it? It is nothing like the early days, when strong men pure of spirit knew what needed to be done. The course of state has strayed! It is obvious that Supreme Executor Andrada is no longer at the helm, that he no longer truly leads us. It is tragic, isn't it? A great man reduced to this by declining health and bad advisors. It is obvious but unsaid that the ministries have fallen to in-fighting and self-serving corruption."

"The great tower of authority, that great man which once gave order to the world... it is all crumbling. Something must be done!"
entries.zh:
"正是如此。" Ram 倾身靠了过来，眼中有什么奇怪的神情逐渐浮现。

"辛达强权 已经变成了一个让人厌恶的玩意，不是吗？已经和往日完全不同了，那时灵魂纯净强大的人知道该做什么。这个国家已经偏离轨道了！显然最高元首 Andrada 已经不再是掌舵人，不再真正的带领着我们。真是悲剧，不是吗？一个伟大的人堕落于此，全赖每况愈下的身体还有糟糕的顾问。显然各部委都沉沦在内斗和腐败之中，只是没人说出来而已。"

"权力的巨塔，那位曾经给世界带来秩序的大人...都在崩塌。必须要做点什么！"

entries.en:
"I knew who you were before entering that bar, yes," Ram says with a self-satisfied smirk.

"I am not merely a uniform. I follow orders, yes, but I have been watching the way of things for a long time. I have been speaking with like-minded officers loyal to the Andradan Movement, who know the blood and sweat of our struggle."

Ram leans in, an odd gleam to his eyes now apparent. "It is obvious that the Sindrian Diktat has fallen to rot. Do you imagine Andrada is truly in command? With the ministries fallen to self-serving infighting? He would never allow it. Things have changed since the old days. He would sooner die than let his vision come to this... this degeneracy! Something must be done!"
entries.zh:
"我早在踏入那个酒吧前就知道你是谁了，没错。" Ram 说着露出了一个自鸣得意的笑容。

"我不止是个普通军人。我确实遵从命令，但我观察事态发展也有段时间了。我一直在和想法相同、忠于 Andrada 伟大运动的军官交谈，他们知道我们争斗付出的血与汗。"

Ram 倾身靠了过来，眼中有什么奇怪的神情逐渐浮现。"显然 辛达强权 已经堕落腐烂。你以为 Andrada 真的还在掌权吗？他绝对不会允许各部委都沉沦在内斗之中。情况已经变得和往日不同了。他宁可死也不会让他的理想发展成这种...决疣溃痈的样子！必须得做点什么！"

entries.en:
"You survived," Ram says, with the barest hint of ruthless delight. "You are a survivor, yes? Stronger now for overcoming. In the words of the Supreme Executor, 'Pain's gift is clarity.'"

"You see, I was merely acting my part in the grand tower of authority necessary to maintain order. If it were not me in the uniform that day, it would have been another." Ram leans in, an odd gleam to his eyes now apparent. "Don't you see? It is bigger than me or you. Hold your animal instinct in check, and listen."

"The Sindrian Diktat is drifting, leaderless. Do you imagine Andrada is really in command? With the ministries fallen to infighting and self-serving corruption? He would never allow it. He would sooner die than let his vision come to this! Something must be done!"
entries.zh:
"你活下来了。" Ram 说道，带着一丝残忍的快感，"你是个幸存者，嗯？现在为了战胜困难变得更强了。用最高元首的话来说：'苦痛的礼物是明晰'。"

"要知道，我只是在做权力的高塔中维持秩序的必要的一部分而已。如果那天穿着制服的不是我，也会是另一个人。" Ram 倾身靠了过来，眼中有什么奇怪的神情逐渐浮现，"你还不明白吗？这是大于你我的事。控制住你的动物本能，好好听着。"

"辛达强权 此刻漂泊不定、群龙无首。你以为 Andrada 真的还在掌权吗？他绝对不会允许各部委都沉沦在内斗之中。他宁可死也不会让他的理想发展成这种样子！必须得做点什么！"

entries.en:
"The Sindrian Diktat has strayed from its course," says Ram, leaning in, an odd gleam to his eyes now apparent.

"The Supreme Executor is no longer at the helm of the ship of state; holos appear with his image, yes, but they can be faked. It is obvious that the ministries have fallen to in-fighting and self-serving corruption, our warfleets given to profit-driven bloat."

"Without the true vision of the Supreme Executor, the center cannot hold. Corrupt advisors rule now, and are influenced by shadowy forces funded by our enemies. Something must be done!"
entries.zh:
"辛达强权 偏离了它的航线。" Ram 倾身靠了过来，眼中有什么奇怪的神情逐渐浮现。

"最高元首已经不再是这座舰船的掌舵人；他的全息影像还会出现，没错，但那是能伪造的。显然各部委都沉沦在内斗和腐败之中，我们的舰队被贪求利益、鼻孔朝天的人掌控。"

"没了最高首长真正的指引，一切都会四分五裂。现在掌权的顾问不但腐败，他们还被藏在暗地里由我们的敌人资助的势力指使。必须要做点什么！"

entries.en: With a flash of the Sindrian Diktat's crest, the shuttle receives navigation instructions from orbital traffic control. The whorls of storms and rivers of clouds hang before you, over the shining Volturnian sea. Closer, you begin to make out the lights of floating habitats, sprawling farm envelopes, and transient mining platforms.
entries.zh: 随着 辛达强权 的徽标一闪而过，穿梭机收到了轨道交通管制中心的导航指令。风暴的漩涡与江河般流动的云层漂浮在你眼前，覆盖于闪亮的 Volturn 海面上。靠近些，你开始能分辨出浮动栖所，杂乱延伸着的农业舱和临时采矿平台。

entries.en:
The shuttle hits atmo with a barely perceptible change in the craft's harmonics.

As the surface grows closer, the glittering lights and reflections of artificial structures resolve into a sprinkling of garbage; plumes of smoke from processing plants, oil-slicks from extraction platforms, a spew of jetsam trailing from the overcrowded habs.

The current regime has allowed the industrial conglomerates to self-regulate provided they are politically reliable.
entries.zh:
穿梭机进入大气层时，其谐振频率产生了一点微不可查的变化。

随着地表越来越近，闪烁的灯光和人造结构的倒影融解为一片散落的垃圾堆：来自加工厂的滚滚浓烟、开采平台上的油污、拥挤不堪的栖息地后面抛洒的各种废弃物。

现政权已经允许工业巨头进行自我监管，只要它们在政治立场上足够可靠。

entries.en:
He holsters his pistol and, stepping over Ram's cooling body, draws a chair from the table.

"Let us sit for a moment. All this excitement... I would very much like to have a chat with you."
entries.zh: 他把枪插回枪套，随后径直走向桌边，踏过 Ram 尚有余温的尸体，从桌边又抽走了一把椅子。"我们坐一会吧。刚经历了这种刺激的事...我可很想和你聊聊。"

entries.en: Macario gives his soldiers a dismissive little wave. You expect that they'll be at the ready nearby.
entries.zh: Macario 向他的士兵微微挥手。你猜他们会在附近待命。

entries.en: You stand. Macario ignores this, giving his soldiers a dismissive little wave. You expect that they'll be at the ready nearby.
entries.zh: 你仍然站着。Macario 没管你，向他的士兵微微挥手。你猜他们会在附近待命。

entries.en: The squad's targeting lasers hold steady on you.
entries.zh: 对方整个小队纹丝不动，所有人的瞄准激光都稳稳的锁在你身上。

entries.en:
"But first," he dips his pistol once toward the floor. "Would you be so good?"

As you hesitate, he says "The grenades. All of them. Six, I believe."
entries.zh:
"但首先，" 他把手枪朝地面虚点了一下，"你能帮我个小忙吗？"

当你还没反应过来时，他说："手榴弹，全交出来，我相信你有六枚。"

entries.en:
"But first," he dips his pistol once toward the floor. "Would you be so good?"

As you hesitate, he says "Your clever little pistol. Drop it."
entries.zh:
"但首先，" 他把手枪朝地面虚点了一下，"你能帮我个小忙吗？"

当你还没反应过来时，他说："放下你那聪明的小手枪。"

entries.en:
"But first," he dips his pistol once toward the floor. "Would you be so good?"

As you hesitate, he says, enunciating sharply, "The knife."
entries.zh:
"但首先，" 他把手枪朝地面虚点了一下，"你能帮我个小忙吗？"

当你还没反应过来时，他说道，语音清晰而又尖锐，"刀。"

entries.en:
"But first," he dips his pistol once toward the floor. "Would you be so good?"

As you hesitate, he says "The spray capsules in your cuffs. All of them. Keep them pointed toward the ground."
entries.zh:
"但首先，" 他把手枪朝地面虚点了一下，"你能帮我个小忙吗？"

当你还没反应过来时，他说："你袖口里的喷雾胶囊，把它们全都对着地板。"

entries.en:
"But first," he dips his pistol once toward the floor. "Would you be so good?"

As you hesitate, he says "The monomolecular wire. I admire your verve, but let us be civilized about this."
entries.zh:
"但首先，" 他把手枪朝地面虚点了一下，"你能帮我个小忙吗？"

你正犹豫时，他说道："你的单分子线，我敬佩你的活力，但还是让我们做一回文明人吧。"

entries.en:
"But first," he dips his pistol once toward your scabbard, "Your clasp is loose."

As you hesitate, he says "The sword of an officer must be kept secure, yes? Mustn't have an accident, nor draw such a blade in haste."
entries.zh:
"但首先，" 他把手枪朝你的剑鞘虚点了一下，"你的扣环松了。"

你正犹豫时，他说道："军官的剑一定要保管好，对吧？不应该发生意外，也不应该仓促拔出这样的剑。"

entries.en: "I would expect you would know this, considering your misadventure on Eventide," he says with mock-concern. "But let us not open old wounds."
entries.zh: "考虑到你在 Eventide 上的不幸遭遇，我还以为你早该明白了，" 他一边说着，一边强装出一副关心你的样子，哪怕嘲讽之情早已溢于言表，"可是，我们还是别揭那块伤疤了吧。"

entries.en: "We need not repeat your little adventure on Eventide here, yes? You will find that we have a much more modern attitudes in Askonia."
entries.zh: "不用你再重复 Eventide 上的那场小冒险了，知道吗？想再来的话，你就能知道在 Askonia 我们的反应手段可要现代得多了。"

entries.en: Macario's eyes flick to lead yours to Ram's corpse on the floor. The blood is pooling.
entries.zh: Macario 眼睛一瞥，引得你也看向了地上 Ram 的尸体。血液在地上越积越多。

entries.en:
"Captain Ram was a traitor and has met the end which all traitors deserve," Macario leans back in the cheap folding chair, looking thoughtful.

"I am embarrassed to admit that he was also - in the broad strokes - correct in his assessment of the current state of our dear Sindrian Diktat. And his plan is a reasonable one."

"I have decided to enact it, with your cooperation."
entries.zh:
"Ram 上校是个叛徒，他的下场纯属罪有应得。" Macario 靠在那把便宜货折叠椅上，看起来若有所思。

 "但，说来尴尬，他那番发言不仅相当平实，对我们敬爱的 辛达强权 评价也是鞭辟入里。他的计划也甚是合理。"

 "我决定，要执行他的计划，还要你来与我合作，舰长。"

entries.en:
Ram's safehouse is in a logistics and warehousing complex attached to the spur of one such industrial cluster.

The air is thick with the sweet stench of petrochem.
entries.zh:
Ram 的藏身处毗邻某个工业园区的分支，处在一个物流和仓储区里。

空气中弥漫着石化产品那甜甜的油气味。

entries.en: A quick glance at your datapad shows your perspective in perfect miniature; the holorec unit is working perfectly.
entries.zh: 你快速瞥了一眼数据平板，上面完美显示着你的影像；全息录像正常运行。

entries.en: Your disguised marine squad fans out, passing plausibly for workers on a shift-break snacking on nutrition bars and igniting narcosticks.
entries.zh: 你那支伪装起来的陆战队员小队呈扇状散开，装成在班间休息时吃点营养棒或者抽麻醉烟的工人。

entries.en:
A plainclothes INTSEC goon - obvious from their demeanor - opens the door, looks you over disapprovingly, and relieves you of your holstered sidearm before leading you down metal stairs to a dark inner room below the street level.

Yannick Ram sits at a cheap conference table, dismissing the goon with a wave. The door thuds shut behind you, its weight suggesting armor or shielding.

"Captain, captain. I am so pleased that you have joined me. We have much to discuss, much to do," Ram stands with a chilly smile.
entries.zh:
一个便衣的 INTSEC 人员 —— 从他的行为举止可以明显察觉 —— 打开了门，不以为然地审视着你。解下你的随身武器后，他接着带领你沿着金属楼梯通往街区之下的一个漆黑的套间。

Yannick Ram 坐在一张廉价的会议桌后，轻轻挥手打发走那个便衣人员。在你身后，门重重地关上了，发出一声闷响。这扇门重到不寻常，说不定用到了装甲板，再或者是加了防护层。

"舰长啊舰长。我很高兴你加入了我。我们还有很多事情需要讨论，很多事情要去做，" Ram 站起身来，脸上挂着冷冷的微笑。

entries.en:
"Simply put, the plan - and my fellow patriots are in agreement - is to test and provoke the leaders of the Sindrian Diktat's three arms of power. They will either prove their loyalty to the vision of the Supreme Executor, Lion of Sindria, Philip Andrada, or they will show themselves to be corrupt cowards and traitors who must be executed to ensure the purity of the Great Cause."

"First, the navy. While the Grand Star Marshal is nominally in charge, he lies half-conscious in a clinic on Sindria. The Supreme Executor should have replaced him a cycle ago, but," Ram pauses significantly, "has not."

"In his place, Deputy Star Marshal Oxana Hyder commands the Askonia System Defense Armada. She is... unimaginative, and I suspect she regrets leaving the Hegemony behind during the Battle of Salus."
entries.zh:
"简而言之，计划 —— 我的爱国者同伴们一致同意了的 —— 是测试与煽动辛达强权三大派系的领导人。他们要么证明自己忠于最高元首，辛达瑞亚之狮 Philip Andrada 的伟大愿景，要么揭露自己是必须被处决的腐败懦夫与叛徒，以此确保伟业的纯粹性。"

"首先，是海军。尽管星际元帅名义上还是负责人，但他现在正半昏迷地躺在辛达瑞亚的诊所里。最高元首本应在一个星历年前就把他的职务移交出去，但是，" Ram 意味深长地停顿了一下，"并没有。"

"正坐在他位置上的，副星际元帅 Oxana Hyder 指挥着 Askonia 星系防御舰队。她这人...缺乏想象力，我怀疑她在 Salus 之战时就后悔离开了霸主。"

entries.en:
"Next, Guard High Deputy Executor Horacio Caden. By the decree of Diktat, he holds the second-in-command rank to the Supreme Executor, and leads the Lion's Guard which is sworn to protect the person of Philip Andrada and the integrity of his political and spiritual vision."

Ram clenches his jaw; anger now showing through. "Caden has clearly failed. He is a dogmatic simpleton, repeating the words of the Lion without feeling them, knowing them! They do not BURN in his heart as they do in ours!"

Captain Ram is almost shouting toward the ceiling. Perhaps addressing Caden and the other misguided followers of the Sindrian Diktat.
entries.zh:
"下一个，是卫队最高副首长 Horacio Caden。按照辛达的法规，他是 最高元首 之下第一人。而且，那宣誓保卫 Philip Andrada 人身安全，确保他那高远的政治精神愿景完美无缺的 狮心卫队，也在副队长的统领之下。"

Ram 咬牙切齿，怒火中烧。"Caden 很明显辜负了他的职责。他就是个照本宣科的白痴，只知道一遍遍重复雄狮的话语，却完全对它们无知无觉！雄狮的教导没有在他心中熊熊燃烧，而我们不同！"

海军上校 Ram 几乎是冲着天花板大喊大叫。也或许，这场演说是冲着 Caden 和 辛达强权 那些误入歧途的拥护者来的。

entries.en:
There's a muffled thump.

Ram's goon dropping something? But the weight of the door suggests it would take a great deal more force to make a sound which could be heard in this room.

"... Which brings me to Chief High Inspector-General Dolos Macario," Ram continues, almost spitting, "Head of the internal security services of which I am of course a part. Never was there a more..."

Ram pauses in his tirade, lifting a hand to his ear. He turns to you with a confused look.
entries.zh:
你听到了很模糊的咚咚声。

难不成是 Ram 的手下扔下了什么东西？但，既然藏身所的门这么厚重，如果有什么事情产生的声音能隔着这扇门听到，那...肯定要比扔东西用力来得猛得多。

 "...接下来，我就得讲讲最高检察长 Dolos Macario 了。" Ram 继续讲着，口水飞溅，简直像是在咒骂着，"他是内安部的首领，自然，和我是一个部门的。这世上，就没有过比他更..."

Ram 的长篇大论突然停下了。他抬起一只手，放在耳边，然后转身面向你，满脸疑惑。

entries.en:
The door flies open in a flash, the thud of a shockwave buffets you back a half-step, ears ringing.

Blurred shadows burst in, targeting lasers flickering, firearms covering you and Ram. Through the settling cloud of dust steps a man in a long black coat over a perfect black uniform.

Ram gapes, hands raised; now, mercifully, at a loss for words.
entries.zh:
随着一道剧烈的闪光，门在一瞬间被炸飞了。砰然而至的冲击波好好地赏了你一耳光，打得你双耳嗡嗡作响，不由得退了半步。

一群不速之客的模糊身影突入了房间，数不清的激光瞄准器闪烁着，表明你和 Ram 全身上下已经被一堆武器给瞄了个遍。踏过逐渐落定的尘埃，一位身着全黑制服，披着纯黑外套的男人走进了房间。

Ram 举起了自己的双手，被吓得目瞪口呆。谢天谢地，这家伙终于闭上他那张臭嘴了。

entries.en:
The pistol in the man's hand barks once.

Yannick Ram falls to the ground, dead.
entries.zh:
男人手里的枪发出一声爆鸣。

Yannick Ram 倒在地上，死去了。

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName," says Dolos Macario, head of the Sindrian Diktat internal security ministry, in-person.

The Spider of Sindria, they call him, who lurks in the Lion's shadow and strings up his enemies, extracts their secrets, and makes them suffer before they are 'disappeared'.

Macario's weapon is aimed at you, now.

"What an awkward first meeting." He glances down, then looks back up, smiling like a corpse. "My humblest apologies."
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长。" Dolos Macario，辛达强权内部安全部总指挥，其本人在你面前开口说道。

辛达瑞亚之蛛，人们颤抖着如此称呼。他潜伏在雄狮的阴影中，束缚每一个落入他手中的敌人，榨取殆尽每一分秘密，让他们在 "销声匿迹" 之前受尽折磨。

Macario 的武器正指着你。

"多么尴尬的初次会面。" 他低头瞥了一眼，然后抬起头来，脸上的微笑宛若尸骸，"我致以诚挚的歉意。"

entries.en: Macario looks at you reasonably, "In that we are agreed."
entries.zh: Macario 看向你，做出一副通情达理的样子，"我们在这方面看法倒是一致。"

entries.en: "Justice?" Macario raises his eyebrows, "How interesting."
entries.zh: "正义？" Macario 扬起了他的眉毛，"真有趣。"

entries.en: "Then it seems that I owe you a death," Macario says, nodding reasonably. "That I can provide."
entries.zh: "这么一说，看来我还抢了你杀人的机会了。" Macario 边说边点头，做出一副通情达理的样子。"就这种机会，我能还你一个的。"

o.en: Play it cool for now; let him talk more
o.zh: 暂时不动声色；让他再说

o.en: Let him keep talking for a moment
Enough of this; prepare your weapon
Let him talk; make sure the holorec is getting everything
o.zh: 让他说；确保你的全息录像记录一切

o.en: Prepare your weapon while he's distracted with himself
o.zh: 趁他分心时准备好你的武器

entries.en:
Your eyes dart around, looking for something useful. The table itself is light metal and plastic, as are the folding chairs. Their mass is insufficient for a bludgeon.

The lighting is provided by a few rapidly degrading peel-off glowstrips; useless. In the shadows of the room your eyes catch on some liquid storage barrels - water? - and  a few hand-cargo containers. Padded, with rounded corners for zero-G safety.

Ram has a sidearm on his belt. It would take him but a moment to draw it. Or if he came closer to you...
entries.zh:
你的眼睛快速地四处张望，寻找着能利用的东西。桌子本身是轻金属和塑料材质，折叠椅也是如此。它们的质量作为重器砸人有些不够看。

光照是由几条正在快速变暗的撕拉式荧光带提供的；毫无用处。你瞥到房间的阴影里有几桶液体 —— 淡水吗？—— 还有几个手提货物箱。它们都被软垫覆盖了，还是圆边角，确保了零重力环境下的安全。

Ram 的腰带上有把随身武器，他是不用废什么功夫就能轻松抽出来。但如果他靠你更近一些的话...

entries.en:
With Ram distracted by pacing and ranting, you take a peek at your datapad. The holorec rig reads all-green, but the signal seems to be rapidly degrading. There must be some kind of interference- an automated counter-signal unit in the safehouse?

Will Ram be alerted if you keep transmitting?
entries.zh:
在 Ram 怒吼着踱步分心时，你偷看了一眼自己的数据平板。全息录像装置的指标一切正常，但信号正在快速衰减。这安全屋里肯定是有什么干扰 —— 一个自动信号反制装置？

你继续传输的话 Ram 会不会发现？

o.en: Keep transmitting; more blackmail material means more leverage
o.zh: 继续传输；更多的黑料代表更多筹码

o.en: Turn off transmission; record to hard memory to not set off an alert
o.zh: 关闭传输；记录在硬盘内存上防止惊动对方

entries.en: With a light touch you feel the comforting mass of your weapon of choice. Ram sees nothing, distracted by his own monologue.
entries.zh: 你轻轻一碰自己选择的武器，它的质量让人安心。Ram 什么也没看见，继续专注在他自己的长篇大论中。

entries.en: You slip one of the grenades into your hand and hold it in place with your thumb.
entries.zh: 你将一枚手榴弹滑入手中，并用拇指将其固定到位。

entries.en: You slip the tiny pistol out of its hiding place by pretending to stretch your shoulders. You have it in your lap now, covered by your crossed hand.
entries.zh: 你假装伸了伸肩膀，把小手枪从它的藏处偷偷拿了出来。现在它在你的大腿上，被你交叉的双手盖着。

entries.en: You slip the vibroknife out of its hiding place by pretending to stretch. Now it is hidden in the cuff of your uniform, read to draw and activate.
entries.zh: 你假装伸了个懒腰，把震动刀从它的藏处偷偷拿了出来。它现在藏在你的制服的袖口里，随时可以拔出激活。

entries.en: You pull the cuffs of your uniform straighter, ensuring the deadly spray will hit your intended target, and flex your wrist in anticipation of deployment.
entries.zh: 你把自己制服的袖口拉直了点，确保致命的喷雾能击中你想要的目标，同时活动了一下手腕，做好了释放喷雾的预备动作。

entries.en: You rub your hands together, twisting the false fingertip just so. It is ready to deploy the deadly monomolecular wire with a flick of your hand.
entries.zh: 你搓了搓双手，微微扭了下假指尖。只要你一挥手它就能甩出致命的单分子金属丝。

entries.en: You brush the leg of your uniform as if clearing it of imagined dust, loosing the protective clasp that keeps the sword from drifting out of its scabbard. You tense your muscles, ready to draw steel in a single motion.
entries.zh: 你就像是在清理不存在的灰尘一样捋了捋自己制服的下摆，松开了套着剑不让它滑出剑鞘的保护扣。你绷紧了肌肉，准备好了一下拔出武器。

entries.en:
You whisper the codeword under your breath as Ram rants.

Nothing. You tap your earpiece, making as if you are scratching your ear, and it gives the tiny buzz denoting signal disconnection.

There must be some kind of active interference. This secure comms rig is outrageously overrated for even moderately fortified military defenses. Ram must be running a highly sophisticated automated counter-signal unit. Would it alert him to your attempt at comms?

His disposition, though agitated, seems unchanged.
entries.zh:
趁着 Ram 咆哮时，你低声说出暗号。

没有回应。你装作挠耳朵的样子轻敲了一下耳机，它发出了轻微的蜂鸣声，指示信号已断开。

一定是某种主动干扰。这套安全通讯装置厉害到能突破一般程度的军事强化防御措施。Ram 肯定启动了什么尖端的自动信号反制装置。它会因为你试图进行通讯而警告他吗？

他的神情依然暴躁，似乎没有变化。

entries.en: You consider your options for this encounter.
entries.zh: 你考虑着这件事上能做的准备。

entries.en:
He wants to set up some kind of secret meeting. It could not be a more perfect opportunity for revenge.

Your mind races with possibilities- a hidden weapon to cover the kinetic element, a secret holorec rig to record whatever treason or blackmail or scheme he has planned. It would not be so difficult to have a small squad of your most elite marines ready to move at an invisible signal.
entries.zh:
他想弄一个什么秘密会议。再也没有比这更完美的复仇机会了。

你的脑海里快速运转，考虑着各种可能 —— 一把将动能部分隐藏起来的暗器，一个用来录制他在计划的什么叛国勒索密谋的隐藏全息录像装置。带一小队你最精锐的陆战士兵也不太难，他们只要一个隐形的信号就能出动。

entries.en:
He wants to set up some kind of secret meeting. It is unclear whether his actions are legal within the Diktat, and unclear what power-play between competing ministries this might represent.

You would do well to have a hidden weapon, and a holorec rig to record whatever treason, blackmail, or other scheme Ram might be planning. It would not even be difficult to have a squad of elite marines ready to move at an invisible signal.
entries.zh:
他想弄一个什么秘密会议。也不知道他的行为在 辛达强权 内是否合法，或者这又代表了各部门之间权力斗争的哪部分。

你最好带一把隐秘的武器，一个用来录制 Ram 计划中的不管是什么叛国、勒索还是其他阴谋的全息录像装置。甚至带一小队你最精锐的陆战士兵也不太难，他们只要一个隐形的信号就能出动。

entries.en:
The former Sindrian Diktat fleet commander looks miserable and unsteady in a borrowed jumpsuit. They mumble some words of thanks and disappear into the human jetsam of the Persean Sector.

Whether they end up dead by the hand of a Diktat reprisal-assassin, crewing a pirate vessel, or joined up with some odd sect of Luddics, you have fulfilled a promise.
entries.zh:
辛达强权 前舰队指挥官穿上了一件借来的连体太空服，看起来既凄凉，又无助。那人低声谢过了不杀之恩，然后就汇入了 英仙座星域  被弃于船外的滚滚人流之中。

无论这个家伙以后究竟会怎么样 —— 是死在 辛达强权 派来报复的刺客手里，或是跑到某艘海盗船只上当船员，还是加入卢德某个奇怪教派，你都已经算是信守承诺了。

o.en: Release the Sindrian Diktat officer you promised to help escape
o.zh: 释放你曾经发誓过会提供帮助的 辛达强权 官员

entries.en:
His eyes open wide, "Don't you see it, captain? I have no need to emblazon my face upon history. Merely... " he grows quiet, "Mm, to direct it. Correct it. Trim the loose ends which hold us back, tie us down."

"That is all captain," he says, re-asserting a mask of calm. "For now. I'm sure we shall speak again soon."

The comms cut to the crest of the Sindrian Diktat internal security ministry.
entries.zh:
他双眼睁大。"你还看不出来吗，舰长？我不需要在历史上刻下我这张脸！只要..." 他声音低了下来。"嗯，引导历史，修正历史。除掉拖累，限制我们的累赘。"

"目前就这样吧，舰长。" 他重新带上了冷静的面具。"我相信我们很快会再联络的。"

通讯画面转换为了 辛达强权 内部安全部的徽标。

entries.en:
Stepping back onto what passes for a street, you look up at one of the ubiquitous flickering holos of Philip Andrada, Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat. You try to imagine the Lion of Sindria drooling and mindless, deep in some bunker-clinic, surrounded by increasingly panicked doctors.

Macario seems like a man who turns his capable subordinates into tools and his ambitious subordinates into corpses. But if you play along, for now, he readily provides generous rewards - and access to the heart of the Sindrian Diktat's upcoming power struggle.
entries.zh:
在从无名小路走回街道的途中，辛达强权 最高元首 Philip Andrada 的全息投影依然无处不在地闪耀着。你仰望起了其中一座，试着想象了一下着这位昔日的辛达瑞亚之狮，如今却嘴角流涎神志不清，不得不躺在地下深处的某个医疗地堡里，簇拥在旁的只剩下一群愈发惶恐的医生。

Macario 看来城府颇深，他习惯把安分称职的部下驯为能榨取价值的工具，也不介意把包藏野心的同僚化为用来垫脚爬权的尸骨。但是 —— 至少现在 —— 只要你配合，他就能给你备好厚赏，还能让你触及 辛达强权 接下来争权夺势的风暴眼。

entries.en:
"Ah," Macario raises a finger. "Just one thing, captain."

"You've been very, very bad," he wags his finger, scolding you. "I'll arrange matters to allow you to operate in Diktat space. But you must promise to behave. You'll behave?"

He doesn't wait for an answer, "Good."
entries.zh:
"啊，" Macario 用手势示意你噤声。"只是还有一件事，舰长。"

"你干过不少坏事，真是坏到极致了。" 他摇晃着食指数落你，"我会安排好你在辛达强权疆域内行动的相关事宜。但是你必须保证会守规矩。你能做到吗？"

他并没有等你给出确切回复，"很好。"

entries.en: There's a strange gleam in Macario's eyes at your words, but he seems to approve.
entries.zh: 听了你这话，Macario 眼里掠过一丝异样的光，不过看样子是赞许的。

entries.en: An idle thought prompts you to check the holorec's memory. It's been remote hacked; your feed has been replaced by an old Andrada propaganda experience. Macario's little joke, you suppose.
entries.zh: 你突然想起什么，检查了全息录像机的储存内容：有人远程骇入了你的全息录像机，把你拍摄的内容都替换成了某份古旧的 Andrada 宣传全息体验卡带内容。你猜，这可能是那位 Macario 开的小小玩笑。

entries.en:
"You begin to understand," says Macario. "Good."

"I shall provide you with a file. It concerns an officer under Deputy Star Marshal Hyder's command who she has ordered to meet with a smuggler to purchase armaments. This is, of course, treason."

"Hyder believes she must circumvent the bureaucracy to maintain the condition of the Defense Armada. She is correct; the Lion's Guard takes the lion's share," he makes a strange, suppressed noise at his own joke, "-of the military procurement budget. This provides us an opening; leverage."
entries.zh:
"你总算开始理解了。" Macario 说，"好啊。"

"我会发给你一份文件，内容关于 Hyder 副星际元帅手下某名军官。受 Hyder 所托，这位军官会私下面见某位走私贩子，从他那里购买武器。自然，这种行为算是叛国。"

"Hyder 相信，她必须绕开官方购买武器，才能保证星系防御舰队状态齐整。她倒是没错：狮心卫队确实经常狮子大开口。" Macario 一边自顾自的开着玩笑，一边发出某种沉郁的怪声 —— 或许是笑声，"准确的说，是在军备购入订单中，经常狮子大开口。总之，既然有她的把柄在手，你要与她对话就有切入口了，也就有杠杆可用了。"

entries.en:
"Confront this officer. Arrest them. Or kill them if they resist, even destroy the fleet and keep the smuggled weapons, I don't care. I shall ensure after the fact that you are seen as, at worst, performing an accidental service to the Diktat."

"The purpose of this is to draw out Hyder. I shall ensure that she knows you were behind the interception. She will want to confront and eliminate you herself due to the sensitive nature of the matter."

Macario is having fun; you can tell. He lives for this.
entries.zh:
"去面见这位军官，逮捕这个家伙，胆敢反抗的话就干掉，哪怕你顺便把这人属下的舰队全灭，把这货的军火私吞也随便，我不计较。我能保证，哪怕情况最糟，我也能让大家认为你是临时起意要为辛达强权锄奸。"

"做这一套，就是为了引出 Hyder。我会让她知道，她的军官是被你私下里截了。这么一来，再考虑下这件事的敏感程度，她八成就要面见你，干掉你，让你噤声。"

你能感觉出来，Macario 说的很开心。毕竟，他可是干这种事为生的。

entries.en:
"This is your opening. Explain yourself as acting upon my orders for the Diktat, or representing a weapon supplier seeking to replace her previous contact. I'm sure you'll come up with something good. The point is, you'll have her attention, and you'll have her compromised."

"Find out her intentions; if she is willing to engage in open treason, or if pushed, will she side with myself: the legitimate authority in the upcoming struggle. Her rivalry with Caden and the Lion's Guard is well known, so that may be a good axis upon which to turn her."
entries.zh:
"这么一来，就到你了。要么跟她挑明你在按照我的指令，为辛达强权效力，要么就谎称你是新来的武器贩子，想要顶掉她之前联系的那一位，不管怎么说，我相信你能想好到时候该怎么讲。重点是，你会吸引到她的注意，同时还要让她受制。"

"探明她的想法：如果她想要公然进行叛乱，或是被人逼着要叛乱的话，她会在混乱中站在我，站在法定的权威派别这边吗？毕竟她与 Caden，与狮心卫队素有不和，所以说这个问题很适合拿来拉拢她。"

entries.en: "You're welcome to try," Macario says smugly. "Without an opening, however, you will get nothing. I know how she works."
entries.zh: "你大可一试。" Macario 说着，满脸得意。"可是，不找个切入口的话，你和她什么都谈不成的，我可了解她的行事风格。"

entries.en:
Macario looses a breathy laugh.

"A fine and obvious suggestion, dear captain, but she hates me. That stubborn old woman won't have her mind changed by me, much less open her heart."
entries.zh:
Macario 长出了一口气，顺便笑了笑。

"亲爱的舰长，你的建议确实挺好，挺明白，但她可是恨着我呢。我不可能轻易让那个固执己见的老太太改变想法，让她敞开心扉的话更是别提。"

entries.en:
Macario produces a rictus of a smile.

"Play your part, captain. You will find the rewards incalculable."
entries.zh:
Macario 做了个咧嘴一笑的样子。

"完成你的职责，舰长。你会发现回报远超预期。"

entries.en:
"And throw the Sindrian Diktat into civil war? With her in command of the System Defense Armada?" Macario rolls his eyes, "Listen to yourself."

"Timing," he hisses, "The time must be correct."
entries.zh:
"把 辛达强权 推向内战？还是在她负责星系防御舰队指挥权的时候？" Macario 翻了个白眼："瞧你说的。"

"时机。" 他嘘声说道，"时机必须正确无误。"

entries.en:
"You don't know her like I do, captain. She is a capable admiral, a brilliant logistician, and a dreadful politician. She loathes contradiction, inefficiency, and above all lies. When she must participate in such squalid affairs, she will be put off-balance and seek stability. Provide it."

Macario looks pleased with himself. "It is trivial to manipulate her. I trust, with my help, you are capable of it."
entries.zh:
"舰长，你可不如我懂她。她是一位能干的将军、出色的后勤专家，却也是个糟糕的政客。她讨厌纷争、低效，最令她讨厌的则是谎言。如果说她必须参与叛国这种肮脏事的话，她的心境一定相当不平和，这种时候她就会想要寻求平衡，你给她平衡就好了。"

Macario 看起来相当得意："要操纵她可不需什么力气。我相信，只要有我帮忙，连你也能操纵她。"

o.en: I'll... see what I can do.
Why don't I just talk to her?
o.zh: 为什么我就不能直接和她谈谈呢？

o.en: Why don't you just talk to her about all of this?
o.zh: 为什么你不直接和她谈谈这一切？

o.en: If she is engaging in treason, technically, why not eliminate her now?
o.zh: 严格来讲，如果说她真的涉嫌叛国的话，为什么不直接干掉她？

o.en: How would killing her subordinate possibly make Hyder trust me?
o.zh: 杀了 Hyder 的下属，怎么可能再让 Hyder 信任我呢？

o.en: I don't want to do this.

entries.en: Your comms officer calls for your attention, "Captain, we have incoming from... um, an official channel. No ID provided." They forward the link to your personal interface.
entries.zh: 你的通讯军官呼叫你的注意，"舰长，我们收到了一个来自... 呃，官方频道，的来电。没提供 ID。" 他把那个链接转到了你的私人界面上。

entries.en: Your comms officer calls for your attention, "Captain, we have incoming from... um, an official channel. No ID provided." They forward the link to your personal interface.
entries.zh: 你的通讯军官呼叫你的注意，"舰长，我们收到了一个来自... 呃，官方频道，的来电。没提供 ID。" 他把那个链接转到了你的私人界面上。

entries.en: A Sindrian Diktat officer appears. You first recognize the uniform of the internal security ministry; the secret police. Then you recognize his face.
entries.zh: 一名 辛达强权 的官员出现在屏幕上。你先是辨认出了内部安全部的制服；秘密警察。随后，你认出了那张脸。

entries.en:
You were at a spacer bar, not too long ago. This officer led a raid, and his security troops beat some jumpy spacers near to death, and arrested others.

What game is he playing by contacting you like this? Does he even remember you?

He must.
entries.zh:
那是不久前的事情了，你当时在一家太空佬酒吧里。这位军官开展了一次袭击，让他手下的卫兵把几个发神经的船员揍了个半死，还逮捕了其他人。

他现在这样跑来联系你是要耍什么花样？难道他还记得你不成？

他绝对记得。

entries.en: You were at a spacer bar, not too long ago. This officer led a raid, and his security troops beat some jumpy spacers near to death, and arrested others. You told him what you thought of his actions, and for that he had you beaten.
entries.zh: 那是不久前的事情了，你当时在一家太空佬酒吧里。这位军官开展了一次袭击，让他手下的卫兵把几个发神经的船员揍了个半死，还逮捕了其他人。你直言对他行事手段的看法，结果换来一顿好打。

entries.en: And you swore that revenge would be yours. Now might be your chance, if you play this right. But what's his game here, why is he approaching you?
entries.zh: 而你发过誓要报这一箭之仇。搞不好现在正是个好机会，就看你能不能把握住了。但他这是在玩什么花样？他为什么要主动接近你？

entries.en:
And you understood that he was simply exercising the power he had, as he must from his position. Now he's back. What game is he playing? Does he even remember you?

He must.
entries.zh:
而你也理解他只是单纯地行使了他的权威，做他在职位上必须去做的事情而已。但现在他又来了。他这是要玩什么花样？难道他还记得你不成？

他绝对记得。

entries.en:
You returned to your ship where some fine med-tech did its work. Now he's back. What game is he playing? Does he even remember you?

He must.
entries.zh:
你当时回到了你的船上，让那些优秀医疗技术人员派上了用场。现在他回来了。但现在他又来了。他这是要玩什么花样？难道他还记得你不成？

他绝对记得。

entries.en:
Your sensors officer reports an officer-class escape pod floating in a spray of debris. A quick jaunt by a salvage crew confirms that the escape pod holds Macario's "traitor". You order them secured in the brig.

There is also an intact cargo pod containing an advanced weapon system - part of the shipment being smuggled under Hyder's orders.
entries.zh:
你的传感器技官报告，在一片残骸中漂浮着一个指挥官等级的逃生舱。打捞员们轻轻松松就探明了，逃生舱内就有 Macario 要的 "叛徒"。你命令船员把那人关进禁闭室里。

残骸中也发现了一个完好无损的货舱，其中装载着一款先进武器系统 —— 由 Hyder 授意走私货品的一部分。

entries.en:
A series of emotions flood across $hisOrHer face. Despair, betrayal, sadness. Anger, then rage.

"No," $heOrShe growls, then cuts the comms.

The opposing fleet assumes an aggressive posture.
entries.zh:
$hisOrHer脸上闪过一连串表情：先是绝望、背叛、悲伤，然后是愤怒，最后则成了暴怒。

"不行！" $heOrShe吼道，随后便切断了通讯链接。

对方舰队进入攻击阵型。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe laughs cruelly. "You would make such a demand, from that puny $shipOrFleet?"

"It is I who will see your fleet burn! I hereby declare you a criminal and traitor for the crimes of falsifying official documents, threatening an officer, and attempting to undermine the authority of the Supreme Executor."

"A death in space is better than you deserve, terrorist scum." $HeOrShe looks over $hisOrHer should and gives a wave. The comms cut out and the opposing fleet maneuvers to an attack posture.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe大笑起来，面露凶光："就凭你这弱小的$shipOrFleet，你怎么敢向我做出如此要求？"

"你打不赢的，我会看着你的$shipOrFleet燃烧殆尽！我在此宣布，你是罪犯，是叛国者，你的罪名包括：伪造官方文件、威胁官员、试图损害最高元首权威！"

"你这恐怖分子，你这人渣！就这么死在太空都便宜你了！" $HeOrShe回头挥了挥手。通讯中断了，对方舰队开始机动，进入战斗阵型。

entries.en: This fleet is transmitting the transponder code provided by Macario. It is commanded by the 'traitor' you must arrest or kill.
entries.zh: 这支舰队的应答器信号符合 Macario 提供的消息，这支舰队的指挥官，一定就是你得逮捕 —— 再或者杀掉 —— 的那个 '叛国者'。

o.en: You are under arrest by order of Chief High Inspector Dolos Macario.
o.zh: 根据最高检察长 Dolos Macario 的命令，你被逮捕了。

o.en: Bad news. You've been sold out by Dolos Macario.
o.zh: 坏消息。你们被 Dolos Macario 出卖了。

entries.en:
You watch the blood drain from $hisOrHer face. $HeOrShe knows that $heOrShe might have a very big problem.

"What is the meaning of this? You speak outrageous mockery and claim false authority! I should have you arrested for that alone."
entries.zh:
你看着$hisOrHer的脸逐渐变得面无血色，看来$heOrShe知道自己搞不好已经惹上大麻烦了。

"你这话是什么意思？你不仅戏耍我们，害我们生气，还敢冒充权威！光是后面这一条，我就该当场逮捕你的。"

entries.en: "Absurd!" $HeOrShe shouts, annoyed. "I should have you arrested for claiming false authority and making a mockery of the Sindrian Diktat!"
entries.zh: "简直荒谬！" $HeOrShe愤怒大喊，"我早就该逮捕你的，不仅因为你冒充权威，还因为你愚弄整个 辛达强权！"

entries.en:
Now you see true fear fall across $hisOrHer face. Macario's reputation doing its work.

"This... this could be faked. It must be a fake," the Diktat $rank's eyes dart around, looking for some escape. "Why would he send you?"
entries.zh:
这下子，你能从$hisOrHer的表情里看出来，$hisOrHer真的怕起来了。Macario 的恶名怕是把$hisOrHer吓得不轻。

"这...这东西可以造假的！这东西肯定是假的！" 这位 辛达强权 的 $rank 一边说着，一边到处乱瞟，怕是在找个脱身的法子。"他为什么要派你来？"

entries.en: "An agent?" $HeOrShe looks suspicious, "If you know anything about a Sindie spy on Umbra, tell me now and I'll have 'em before a revolutionary tribunal before the day is out."
entries.zh: "一名特工？" $HeOrShe看起来充满怀疑，"如果你知道在 Umbra 上有个当间谍的辛达佬的话，立刻告知我，我会在今天结束之前将那人送上革命法庭。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe is taken aback. "An agent? Here? I... I don't know what you're talking about. I mostly handle logistics."
entries.zh: $HeOrShe大吃一惊。"一个特工？就在这儿？我...我不知道你在说些什么。我主要负责后勤工作。"

entries.en:
"An agent. Here?"

A look of concern grows on her face.

"I can't say I'm surprised. If you have definitive intel about a Diktat spy on Umbra, then tell me. We'll assemble a revolutionary tribunal to sort this out."
entries.zh:
"一个间谍？在这里？" 她脸上浮现出担忧的神情。

"我对此并不感到意外。如果你掌握关于辛达强权间谍潜伏在 Umbra 的明确情报，那就告诉我。我们会组织革命法庭来彻查此事。"

o.en: Explain as if they were a triple-agent (lie)
o.zh: 把那人说成是三面特工 (说谎)

entries.en:
You explain that to get into Dolos Macario's trust, such as it is, you need to 'capture' an agent who Horacio Caden thinks is working for the Lion's Guard but has actually been working for the resistance.

As an asset, they're already useless because Macario knows about their betrayal of the Sindrian Diktat. Their last act as an operative can be to help you 'prove' your dedication to the Spider's schemes.

It will be risky, but it should be possible for this agent to slip out of a death sentence by taking advantage of inter-service rivalry in the Sindrian Diktat.

Imoinu is silent as you explain, her expression grim.
entries.zh:
你解释道，为了取得 Dolos Macario 的信任 —— 尽管这份信任相当微薄 —— 你需要 '抓获' 一名 Horacio Caden 认为是在狮心卫队工作，但实际上一直在为抵抗组织效力的特工。

作为资产，这名特工已经毫无用处，因为 Macario 早已知道那人对 辛达强权 的背叛。而这人作为特工的最后一搏，就是帮你 '证明' 你对蜘蛛阴谋网的忠诚。

这固然有风险，但通过利用 辛达强权 的部门间矛盾，这名特工仍有可能从死刑判决中逃脱。

在你解释时，Imoinu 一直沉默不语，脸上写满了深切的忧虑。

o.en: They're burned, Imoinu. This way still gets a win for the ARC and the United Front.
o.zh: 那个人暴露了，Imoinu。这种方式依然能为 Askonia 革命者委员会和统一战线带来胜利。

entries.en:
She looks down, and sighs. Taking a moment to process.

Then looks back up. Her expression is resolute.

"You're right. We can make this work."
entries.zh:
她低下头，叹了口气，需要一点时间来消化这一切。

随后她重新抬起头，表情也变得坚定。

"你说得对，我们能办成这件事。"

o.en: I'll ensure they come to no harm.
And they'll definitely come to no harm. (lie)
o.zh: 而且他绝对不会受到伤害。 (说谎)

entries.en:
Arrangements are made, the agent - the strong-jawed image of the perfect Lion's Guard recruit - is briefed, then quietly transferred to your $shipOrFleet in a volatiles tank modified for smuggling human passengers.

"I hope you know what you're doing," Imoinu says.
entries.zh:
一切安排就绪。那名特工 —— 他有着棱角分明的下颌，堪称狮心卫队模范新兵的典型形象 —— 接到了任务简报，随后被悄然转移至你的$shipOrFleet上，藏身于一个经过改装、用于偷运人员的挥发物储藏罐中。

"希望你清楚自己在做什么。" Imoinu 说道。

entries.en:
"Wait, what? You just said..."

$HeOrShe gives you a funny look.
entries.zh:
"等等，什么？你刚才明明说..."

$HeOrShe向你投来一个古怪的眼神。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe is taken aback, then does a double take at a secondary display.

"Wait, aren't you working for the Sindies? You've got some real jets coming and talking to me direct and admitting it." $HeOrShe turns aside, "Gonna have a real talk with traffic control... "

Then $heOrShe furiously taps something into a comm-interface. Self-satisfied, $heOrShe says "I've put out an alert. Might want to go running back to hide behind daddy Andrada."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe大吃一惊，盯向另外某个显示屏，才反应过来。

"等等，你丫不是在给辛达佬做事吗？直接赶来和我说话，还如此大言不惭，好大的胆子。" $HeOrShe转了下身，"那我得跟交通管理那边好好说道说道了... "

然后，$heOrShe对着某个通讯界面愤怒的敲了几下子。干完之后，$heOrShe似乎得意起来了："我发了份警告，你丫最好滚回去，到你那 Andrada 老爹身后藏好咯。"

entries.en:
A pause as she takes in your image. "You again? Get lost."

She slams the cut-off.
entries.zh:
她顿了顿，打量着你。"又是你？赶快滚蛋。"

她猛力切断了通讯。

entries.en:
You oversee the raid from your bridge; your cadre of merc officers who have collectively seen every side of every major Persean conflict of the last 50 cycles run tactical command.

Each squad is set up like a surgery, cool and precise. Then, all at once, hell is unleashed: breaching charges churn storms of dust and debris lit into strobing clouds of fire by weapon discharge. Sub-AIs build ghostly visualizations with milliradar, updating threat-tags in real-time for each marine's combat display.

The target is flagged off bone structure scanned by combat sensors and matched to Macario's file. The agent is bagged and restrained for extraction with only minor injuries.
entries.zh:
你在舰桥上监督着这场劫掠。你麾下佣兵的军官骨干们，共同见证过近 50 星历年来每一次重要冲突的每一方势力，战术指挥正是由他们负责。

每个小队的安排都如同外科手术一样，冷静而又精准。接着，地狱的一角被揭开了：破门炸药搅起尘埃的暴风，武器释放的火云频频闪烁，点燃了四散飞溅的碎屑。次级 AI 用毫米波雷达构筑出幽影般的可视化信息，实时更新着每一个陆战队员作战影像上的威胁标签。

根据作战传感器对骨骼结构的扫描结果，任务目标被精准地标记了出来，并与 Macario 的档案进行对比确认。该特工已被捕获并拘束以待撤出，仅受轻伤。

entries.en:
Your marine squads withdraw, leaving broken bulkheads, blaring alarms, and sporadic return-fire. The Umbran militia forces are still mobilizing and the port only now going into lockdown as the last marine shuttle lifts, jets kicking up volatile snow and dust to mix with leaking colonial atmo.

The double-agent is in the brig, attended to by medics. Broken bones, and lesser injuries. Par for the course.
entries.zh:
你的陆战队撤退了，把一片破损的舱壁连同无数响彻云霄的警报和一些零星还击抛在了身后。Umbra 的民兵部队还没完成动员，港口才刚刚进入封锁状态。但最后一架陆战队穿梭机已经离地起飞，只留下喷射气流掀起的挥发物尘雪，和殖民建筑泄露出来的大气一起混溶消散。

那位双面特工被关进了禁闭室，安排了医护人员照顾。这家伙断了一些骨头，还有不少其他轻伤，这都在预料之中。

entries.en:
Macario's file is highly detailed. It's clear that Sindrian Diktat intelligence has had sources embedded in both the Umbran ARC/ANTI-affiliated insurrectionists as well as the Lion's Guard for quite some time.

The double-agent's key locations are clearly described, though their schedule is erratic. A clean capture will involve multiple simultaneous strikes at insurrectionist bunkers, at which point the op will definitely go hot.

Sometimes a job simply requires making a bit of a mess.
entries.zh:
Macario 的档案非常详细。很明显，辛达强权 的情报人员在 Umbra 的革命者委员会和狮心卫队内部都有信息来源，而且时日不短。

虽然其日程安排并不规律，但这个双面特工出没的关键地点却有着非常清晰的描述。要想干净利落地将其抓获，势必要涉及对多个叛乱者堡垒的同步打击，届时，抓捕行动会十分激烈。

有时候动静闹得大一点，也是职责所在，不得不为。

entries.en: You approach $name and consider the double-agent you picked up from Umbra. This would not be an inappropriate place for them to start a new life.
entries.zh: 你接近了$name，同时考虑着从 Umbra 接来的那名双面特工。对那人而言，在此地开始新生活并非不合适。

entries.en: They accept your offer gladly, and with a skillset which can only be described as 'eclectic', your purser believes a useful position can be found in your $shipOrFleet.
entries.zh: 那人欣然接受了你的提议。凭借一套堪称 '博杂' 的技能组合，你的事务长认为可以在你的$shipOrFleet上为这家伙找到一个有用的职位。

entries.en:
"No," the former agent says with a melancholic smile. "It's best if I do this on my own."

"But I thank you, captain," they say, turning toward the shuttle. "Burn bright."
entries.zh:
"不。" 这名前特工带着一丝忧郁的微笑说道。"我还是自己单干比较好。"

"但我仍然要谢谢你，舰长。" 那人边说边转身走向穿梭机。"愿你航行无阻。"

entries.en:
You see the agent off from the shuttle bay.

"Thank you, captain," they say, before turning away. "Burn bright."
entries.zh:
你目送着特工登上穿梭机离开。"谢谢你，舰长。" 那人说道。

"愿你航行无阻。"

entries.en:
You explain that an agent who Horacio Caden thinks is working for the Lion's Guard, and who the resistance thinks is working for them, is in fact working for a separate branch of Sindrian Diktat intelligence entirely - under Dolos Macario's command.

A triple agent, in other words. How else would you have such detailed inside information 'stolen' directly from Macario's INTSEC database?

It's a complex story, but you begin to see your suggested truth sink in to $personName.

"So... they've been working for the Sindies that whole time," $heOrShe says, shocked. "But how did you get this information? Who do you work for?"
entries.zh:
你解释道，有这样一名特工，Horacio Caden 以为这人在为狮心卫队办事，反抗军以为这人在为反抗军效力，但其实这人完完全全只听命于 辛达强权 的另一套情报系统，也就是 Dolos Macario 治下的那一套。

换句话说，这人其实是个三面特工。但你又是如何从 Macario 那个 INTSEC 的数据库里直接 "偷" 出这么多数据的呢？

这就说来话长了，但你已经看得出，$personName 已经开始相信你说的那套所谓真相了。

"所以说，那货其实一直在为辛达佬效力..." $heOrShe惊叹道，"但你又是从哪知道这些消息的？你又为谁做事？"

entries.en:
"Of course. I appreciate your dedication to the cause. I'll have the traitor turned over to you, but... they really should properly be ours to subject to revolutionary justice."

$HeOrShe puts on a generous tone, "But we're for building bridges. For the United Front, right? So will come the day we will ask you for a favor, and we will expect it to be returned. For the Front."

"Can I trust," $heOrShe says darkly, "that you will see them to an appropriate end?"
entries.zh:
"当然了。我们不会忘记你的贡献。我会把叛徒交给你，但是... 原则上本应该让此等叛徒接受我们的革命审判才是。"

$HeOrShe说到此处，摆出一副大方的神态："不过，我们的目的是建立友谊。一切为了联合战线，是吧？所以当有一天我们向你寻求帮助的时候，希望你能将心比心。总而言之，一切为了联合战线。"

"我相信..." $heOrShe严肃地说，"你会让那叛徒罪有应得的，对吧？"

entries.en: Arrangements are made, and the agent - the strong-jawed image of the perfect Lion's Guard recruit - is bound, gagged and quietly transferred to your $shipOrFleet in a volatiles tank modified for smuggling human passengers.
entries.zh: 一切安排就绪。那名特工 —— 他有着棱角分明的下颌，堪称狮心卫队模范新兵的典型形象 —— 被五花大绑并塞住嘴巴，随后被悄然转移至你的$shipOrFleet上，藏身于一个经过改装、用于偷运人员的挥发物储藏罐中。

entries.en:
You explain that an agent who Horacio Caden thinks is working for the Lion's Guard, and who the resistance thinks is working for them, is in fact working for a separate branch of Sindrian Diktat intelligence entirely - under Dolos Macario's command.

A triple agent, in other words. How else would you have such detailed inside information 'stolen' directly from Macario's INTSEC database?

It's a complex story, but you begin to see your suggested truth sink in to $personName.

"You mean to tell me they've been working against the uprising the whole time," she says, her outrage growing. "How do you have this information?"
entries.zh:
你解释道，有这样一名特工，Horacio Caden 以为这人在为狮心卫队办事，反抗军以为这人在为反抗军效力，但其实这人完完全全只听命于 辛达强权 的另一套情报系统，也就是 Dolos Macario 治下的那一套。

换句话说，这人其实是个三面特工。但你又是如何从 Macario 那个 INTSEC 的数据库里直接 "偷" 出这么多数据的呢？

这就说来话长了，但你已经看得出，$personName 已经开始相信你说的那套所谓真相了。

"你的意思是，那货一直以来都在暗中破坏起义？" 她说道，语气中的怒气逐渐升腾，"你是从哪里得知这些信息的？"

entries.en:
You explain that an agent who Horacio Caden thinks is working for the Lion's Guard, and who the resistance thinks is working for them, is in fact working for a separate branch of Sindrian Diktat intelligence entirely - under Dolos Macario's command.

A triple agent, in other words. How else would you have such detailed inside information 'stolen' directly from Macario's INTSEC database?

It's a complex story, but you begin to see your suggested truth sink in to $personName.

"You mean to tell me they've been working against the uprising the whole time," she says, her outrage growing. "You've helped us before, captain... and now this."
entries.zh:
你解释道，有这样一名特工，Horacio Caden 以为这人在为狮心卫队办事，反抗军以为这人在为反抗军效力，但其实这人完完全全只听命于 辛达强权 的另一套情报系统，也就是 Dolos Macario 治下的那一套。

换句话说，这人其实是个三面特工。但你又是如何从 Macario 那个 INTSEC 的数据库里直接 "偷" 出这么多数据的呢？

这就说来话长了，但你已经看得出，$personName 已经开始相信你说的那套所谓真相了。

"你的意思是，那货一直以来都在暗中破坏起义？" 她说道，语气中的怒气逐渐升腾，"你之前就一直在支持我们，舰长...如今又做了这些。"

o.en: And I need this agent. To get into Macario's favor, infiltrate his schemes.
o.zh: 而我需要这名特工。这是为了赢得 Macario 的青睐，并渗透进他的阴谋之中。

entries.en:
She doesn't look pleased with the idea.

"We usually deal with traitors internally," she says. "And quickly."

"But considering your past contributions to the uprising, I think the revolutionary tribunal could be persuaded of the efficacy of giving you custody of the traitor."

Her chin raises, "For the United Front."
entries.zh:
她对这个主意似乎并不满意。

"我们通常在内部处理叛徒，" 她说道，"并且很迅速。"

"但考虑到你过去对起义的贡献，我想革命法庭或许能被说服，相信将叛徒交由你监管是有效的。"

她抬起下巴，"为了联合阵线。"

entries.en:
"Finlay Siyavong? Ha!"

You can hear the aristocrat in her laugh. It is bitter, and a skill for pointed cruelty lurks there.

"I've met him, you fool. You're not Siyavong. You're a liar. Who sent you, Macario?"
entries.zh:
"Finlay Siyavong？哈！"

她的笑声里透着贵族式的刻薄，显得十分苦涩，其间潜藏着一种尖锐刻薄的本事。

"我见过他，你这蠢货。你不是 Finlay Siyavong，你就是个骗子。谁把你派过来的，是 Macario？"

entries.en:
"I don't care, liar. Die in vacuum."

She slams the cut-off.

If you're going to pull off this trick on one of the ARC leaders, you'd better do it quick, before Imoinu warns them.
entries.zh:
"我不在乎，骗子。死在真空里吧。"

她猛力切断了通讯。

如果你想对 Askonia 革命者委员会的某位头目施展这个骗局，最好赶在 Imoinu 警告他们之前尽快行动。

o.en: I'm secretly a Hegemony agent working to undermine the Diktat. (lie)
o.zh: 我其实是 霸主 的秘密特工，致力于暗中妨害 辛达强权。 (说谎)

entries.en:
"A Heggie," $heOrShe scowls. "Of course! I knew it from the start."

"But we are a practical movement, $heOrShe adds thoughtfully, "and we will work with a hostile authoritarian power if it serves the Revolution."
entries.zh:
"原来你丫是 霸主崽子 呀。" $heOrShe皱了皱眉，"当然是啦！我一开始可就看出来了。"

"但我们的革命运动相当务实。" $heOrShe若有所思，补充道，"只要对我们的革命有利，我们也能接受和某个敌对的威权势力暂时合作。"

o.en: Very open-minded of you. So about this agent...
o.zh: 你真的很开明呢。既然如此，那个特工...

o.en: Myself. And I hate the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 只为我自己做事，而且，我讨厌 辛达强权。

entries.en: "Well," $heOrShe says. "Let me welcome you to the United Front of the Askonian Resistance. All of us anti-Diktat factions don't always get along, that's for sure. But at least we know who our enemy is."
entries.zh: "好吧。" $heOrShe致意道，"那就由我欢迎你来到 Askonia 反抗军统一战线吧。我们这些反 辛达强权 的小势力也不总是合得来，这是当然，但至少我们都清楚我们真正的敌人是谁。"

o.en: Thank you. So about this agent...
o.zh: 谢谢你。既然如此，那个特工...

o.en: Myself. And I hate the Sindrian Diktat. (lie)
o.zh: 只为我自己做事，而且，我讨厌 辛达强权。 (说谎)

entries.en: "Well," $heOrShe says. "Let me welcome you to the United Front of the Askonian Resistance. All of us anti-Diktat factions don't always get along, that's for sure. But at least we know who our enemy is."
entries.zh: "好吧。" $heOrShe致意道，"那就由我欢迎你来到 Askonia 反抗军统一战线吧。我们这些反 辛达强权 的小势力也不总是合得来，这是当然，但至少我们都清楚我们真正的敌人是谁。"

o.en: Thank you. So about this agent...
o.zh: 谢谢你。既然如此，那个特工...

o.en: A deep-cover ARC cell you've never heard of. (lie)
o.zh: 我来自某个你未曾听闻的 Askonia 革命者委员会秘密支部。 (说谎)

entries.en: "That... makes sense, yes," $heOrShe slowly nods. "Well, I am glad to meet you, comrade. We shall further the Revolution together!"
entries.zh: "那...没错，也说得通。" $heOrShe说着说着，慢慢点了几下头，"好吧，同志，很高兴能见到你。让我们齐心协力，将革命进行到底！"

o.en: So, about this triple-agent serving the forces of reaction...
o.zh: 那么，对于这个为反抗组织服务的三面特工...

entries.en:
"Huh. I guess you're not from a cell I've heard of. But that's good OPSEC." $HeOrShe slowly nods.

"Well, I am glad to meet you, comrade. We shall further the Revolution together!"
entries.zh:
"嗯，看来你不是我听说过的任何一个小组的人。不过这保密工作做得不错。" $HeOrShe说着说着，慢慢点了几下头。

"好吧，同志，很高兴能见到你。让我们齐心协力，将革命进行到底！"

o.en: So, about this triple-agent serving the forces of reaction...
o.zh: 那么，对于这个为反抗组织服务的三面特工...

o.en: I am of the Luddic faith and I fight our common enemy. (lie)
o.zh: 我信仰卢德教，我会与我们共同的敌人战斗。 (说谎)

o.en: I am of the Luddic faith and I fight our common enemy.
o.zh: 我信仰卢德教，我会与我们共同的敌人战斗。

entries.en:
"Oh, you're from the Self Defense Covenant? We may not see eye-to-eye on all matters, but we welcome your part in the resistance against the common enemy."

"And um, blessings upon you?" $HeOrShe says awkwardly.
entries.zh:
"哦，你是自卫盟约的人？我们两边不可能在所有问题上都达成共识，但欢迎你加入抵抗共同敌人的行列。"

"还有，呃...愿卢德赐福于你？" $HeOrShe略带尴尬地补充道。

o.en: And upon you. Now about this agent...
o.zh: 也赐福于你。那么，这个特工的事...

o.en: Persean League fleet intelligence. My real name is 'Siyavong'. (lie)
o.zh: 我来自 英仙座联盟 舰队情报部，我的真名是 'Siyavong'。 (说谎)

entries.en:
"Ah, the League." $HeOrShe raises $hisOrHer chin. "A militaristic federation of exploiters."

"But less odious than the Diktat by far. We shall accept your assistance, Citizen Siyavong" $heOrShe says magnanimously."
entries.zh: "啊，你从联盟来的呀。" $HeOrShe抬了抬$hisOrHer的下巴，"英仙座联盟 是一伙信奉军国主义的压迫者同盟，但和 辛达强权 相比，还不算那么可憎。Siyavong 公民，我方将接受贵方的援助。" $heOrShe说道，语气颇显大方。

o.en: Your broad-mindedness is a virtue. Now about this agent...
o.zh: 您的宽宏大量是一种美德。那么这个特工...

o.en: Trust me. I've helped the ARC before, just ask Imoinu.
o.zh: 相信我。我以前帮助过 Askonia 革命者委员会，不信可以去问 Imoinu。

entries.en:
"I will," $heOrShe says, then mutes the feed for a moment, turning to a secondary display.

You watch one side of a short conversation play out, and $heOrShe turns back to you, $hisOrHer expression much friendlier.

"I'm sorry for that, captain. Imoinu swears you're a friend of the United Front of the Askonian Resistance who has made valuable material contributions to the cause." $HeOrShe nods respectfully, "Then let me say that I'm proud to call you a comrade."
entries.zh:
"明白。" $heOrShe说道，随后将通讯静音了片刻，一边转向了一个副显示屏。

你看着一段简短的对话单方面进行着。之后，$heOrShe转回来面向你，$hisOrHer的表情也友善了许多。

"刚才很抱歉，舰长。Imoinu 发誓说你是 Askonian 联合抵抗阵线的朋友，并为事业做出了宝贵的物质贡献。" $HeOrShe尊敬地点了点头，"那么，请允许我自豪地称你为同志。"

o.en: Glad to hear it. Now about this agent...
o.zh: 很高兴听到这些。那么，这个特工的事...

entries.en:
You explain that an agent who Horacio Caden thinks is working for the Lion's Guard, and who the resistance thinks is working for them, is in fact working for a separate branch of Sindrian Diktat intelligence entirely - under Dolos Macario's command.

A triple agent, in other words. How else would you have such detailed inside information 'stolen' directly from Macario's INTSEC database?

It's a complex story. And $personName is not buying it.
entries.zh:
你解释道，有这样一名特工，Horacio Caden 以为这人在为狮心卫队办事，反抗军以为这人在为反抗军效力，但其实这人完完全全只听命于 辛达强权 的另一套情报系统，也就是 Dolos Macario 治下的那一套。

换句话说，这人其实是个三面特工。但你又是如何从 Macario 那个 INTSEC 的数据库里直接 "偷" 出这么多数据的呢？

这就说来话长了，而 $personName 显然并不买账。

entries.en:
"You're a liar." $HeOrShe looks at you suspiciously.

"Imoinu warned me about you. And your lies. I don't know who you're working for, or who you think you're working for, but I'm thinking this conversation is done."

$HeOrShe hits the cut-off.
entries.zh:
"你是个骗子。" $HeOrShe怀疑地注视你。

"关于你还有你的谎言，Imoinu 已经警告过我了。我不知道你是谁的人，或者你自以为替谁效命，但这次谈话到此为止。"

$HeOrShe切断了通讯。

o.en: I need to find an agent working for the Sindrian Diktat.
o.zh: 我要找一个替辛达强权卖命的特工。

o.en: Pretend to be capturing a triple-agent to assist the Resistance
o.zh: 假装抓捕一名三重间谍，以此协助抵抗组织

o.en: Prepare a shuttle to Yannick Ram's safehouse
o.zh: 准备一架去 Yannick Ram 的安全屋的穿梭机

entries.en: "I've acquired the latest $seco_faction facility defense security codes. They could provide a significant edge in a ground operation."
entries.zh: "我这里有最新的 $seco_faction 设施安全码。这些代码可以在进行地面行动时为你带来巨大优势。"

entries.en: At the bar, a shifty $seco_manOrWoman fiddling with a cybermod jack gives you a grim but significant look before turning away.
entries.zh: 酒吧里，一个鬼鬼祟祟的$seco_manOrWoman正在摆弄着一个电子设备，对方在转身离开前给了你一个严肃但意味深长的眼神。

o.en: Strike up a conversation with the shifty $seco_manOrWoman fiddling with a cybermod jack
o.zh: 去和摆弄电子设备的鬼鬼祟祟$seco_manOrWoman聊聊

entries.en:
You pretend to read the menu as the $seco_manOrWoman puts the jack down and explains that $seco_heOrShe saw your $shipOrFleet come in. "You look like someone who might find a use for the latest $seco_faction facility security codes," $seco_heOrShe says with a wink.

"They'd change all the codes once you pulled this trick, of course but breaching the security system at the right moment... " $HeOrShe trails off, leaving you to complete the thought: it would give you a significant one-time advantage in a ground operation. "And you'd have to use them soon," $heOrShe says with a shrug, "These codes get rotated, oh, maybe once a month. Depending."

The $seco_manOrWoman explains that the price is $seco_price credits, significantly more than the drink you were eying.
entries.zh:
你假装在看菜单，而那个$seco_manOrWoman放下电子设备，并解释说自己看见你的$shipOrFleet了。"你看起来像是会用到最新的 $seco_faction 设施安全码的人，" $seco_heOrShe眨了眨眼。

"一旦你用过了这玩意儿，他们就肯定会更改所有密码。不过在适当的时候让安全系统瘫痪..." $HeOrShe停了下来，让你自己体会下半句：它会为你在一次地面行动中提供显著优势。"你必须得尽快使用，" $heOrShe耸了耸肩，"这些代码定期更换，哦，应该一个月更换一次吧。具体得看情况。"

$seco_manOrWoman给出的价格是 $seco_price 星币，这可比你刚从菜单上看到的饮料要贵多了。

entries.en: $HeOrShe nods $hisOrHer head conspiratorially, "You see, a 'friend' acquired some $seco_faction security codes that'll give you the upper hand in any one ground operation - obviously they'll change the codes once they're used. I could let them go for $seco_price credits. Have to cover my 'friend's risks and of course include a reasonable resellers fee." The codes will be good for $seco_days days.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe阴森森地点了点$hisOrHer的头："你看，我的一个 '朋友' 获得了一些 $seco_faction 的安全码，它们可以让你在任何一次地面行动中占据上风 —— 当然，只要用了一次，对方就会立即改掉密码。我打算用 $seco_price 星币卖掉它们。毕竟总得为我 '朋友' 承担的风险提供补偿，当然也包括合理的转售费。" 安全码的有效期为 $seco_days 天。

entries.en:
"We don't know how you got our codes," the $theFactionLong $personRank says, seething, "But I find such subterfuge a personal affront to my honor as a warrior. My orders are simply to hunt you down and destroy you, but know that I consider this a duel between an officer and an unscrupulous coward."

"Prepare your $shipOrFleet for combat, captain," $heOrShe spits. "Let us see how you do in a fair fight."
entries.zh:
"我们不知道你是怎么搞到我们的安全码的。" $theFactionLong $personRank 愤怒地说道，"但这种诡计无疑侮辱了我作为一名战士的荣誉。我接到的命令不过是追捕并消灭你，但你要知道，这是一个军官和一个无耻的懦夫之间的决斗。"

"让你的$shipOrFleet做好战斗准备吧。" $heOrShe啐了一口，"让我们看看你在一场公平的战斗中表现如何。"

o.zh: 嘟囔一些关于信息安全的东西

entries.en:
Then the signal fuzzes, degrading over a long count of seconds into a blizzard of noise you recognize as the deployment of a top-end electronic warfare package.

A holding pattern.
entries.zh:
随后信号开始发毛，在长长的几秒里逐渐劣化，最终化作一片雪花般的噪音——你认得出来，这是顶级电子战套件出手了。

画面停在那里，保持着等待的姿态。

entries.en:
An image of Cruor, the sickly orb of Salus hanging over its broken crust.

A representative of the Reformed faction of the Sindrian Diktat appears, their uniform conspicuously less ostentatious than the previous regime, to announce the intention of the Transitional Oversight Committee of the Internal Security Ministry to implement an expedited sentence review process for so-called "legacy" prisoners.

In the meantime, however, economic and social stability must be secured, so it is "regrettably necessary" for prisoners to continue fulfilling their work-sentences.

The Diktat representative emphasizes that it will be a difficult process for everyone.
entries.zh:
Cruor 的影像浮现，Salus 那颗黯淡的光球悬在它破碎的地壳之上。

一位辛达强权改革派代表出现，其制服明显不如前政权那般招摇；此人宣布，内部安全部过渡监督委员会打算对所谓"遗留"囚犯实行加速刑期复核。

然而在此期间，经济与社会的稳定必须得到保障，因此囚犯继续服劳役乃是"令人遗憾的必要之举"。

这位辛达强权代表强调，这对所有人来说都将是一个艰难的过程。

entries.en:
An image of Cruor, the sickly orb of Salus hanging over its broken crust.

The commission recognizes Cruor as effectively under control of Achilles Andrada's reduced Sindrian Diktat - in effect becoming a sub-polity of the Persean League. The Commission expresses hope that the "excesses" of the previous administration might be curbed by League influence.

It is noted that Prime Demarchon Reynard Hannan has released a statement emphasizing that he has full confidence that the League's newest demarchon does not require intervention from the All-League council to carry out appropriate reforms.
entries.zh:
Cruor 的影像浮现，Salus 那颗黯淡的光球悬在它破碎的地壳之上。

委员会承认 Cruor 实际上已在 Achilles Andrada 那个缩水后的辛达强权控制之下——实质上成了英仙座联盟的附属政体。委员会表示，希望联盟的影响能遏制前政权的"过度之举"。

另据提到，大统领 Reynard Hannan 已发表声明，强调他完全相信联盟这位最新入列的统领无需全联盟议会干预，自会推行适当的改革。

entries.en:
The tortured moon, Cruor, appears.

Following the devastation of the Second Askonia Crisis, the reigning governor fled as local authority crumbled. The private paramilitary corporations operating the prison-trains, left unpaid and directionless, turned bandit and either conscripted their prisoners or abandoned them to a rapid (but not instant) death on the hellish surface.

The chair explains that the commission has approved a framework for aid and enforcement, but it is up to in-system authorities to take action.

The lack of any named entities to carry out this aid is conspicuous.
entries.zh:
受尽折磨的卫星 Cruor 浮现出来。

第二次 Askonia 危机之后，当地政权崩解，在任总督出逃。运营囚车的私营准军事公司拿不到钱，也没了指挥，索性落草为寇——要么把囚犯强征入伙，要么把他们丢在那地狱般的表面，任其速死 (倒也不是立刻就死)。

主席解释说，委员会已批准一套援助与执法的框架，但具体行动要由星系内当局自行采取。

这份援助最终由谁来执行，通篇没有一个具名实体——这一点颇为扎眼。

entries.en:
An image of Cruor, the sickly orb of Salus hanging over its broken crust.

A representative of the Sindrian Diktat appears, one of the earliest proclaimers for the Absolutist faction: Laverna Tell, whose dark reputation precedes her. By her black uniform and peaked cap she displays her peculiar position in the Internal Security Ministry.

Tell announces an expansion of the Cruror prison system, seven new penal trains with expectations of increased output pending a system-wide sweep for "traitorous elements".
entries.zh:
Cruor 的影像浮现，Salus 那颗黯淡的光球悬在它破碎的地壳之上。

一位辛达强权代表出现，她是绝对派最早的拥趸之一：Laverna Tell，此人的恶名早已先她而至。从她那身黑色制服与带檐军帽，便可看出她在内部安全部的特殊地位。

Tell 宣布扩建 Cruor 监狱系统，新增七列囚犯列车，并预计在全星系范围内清扫"叛国分子"之后，产出还将进一步提高。

entries.en:
The tortured moon, Cruor, appears.

Following the devastation of the Second Askonia Crisis, the governor fled and local officers charged with supervising the private paramilitary corporations overseeing the prison-trains were left unpaid and directionless. Most turned to warlordism and either conscripted their prisoners or abandoned them to a rapid (but not instant) death on the hellish surface.

The chair describes that the commission has agreed upon a framework for aid and enforcement, but it is up to in-system authorities to first take action. No concrete funding mechanism for this interfactional anti-piracy initiative has been agreed upon... yet.
entries.zh:
受尽折磨的卫星 Cruor 浮现出来。

第二次 Askonia 危机之后，总督出逃，负责监管那些运营囚车的私营准军事公司的当地军官断了饷，也没了方向。多数人索性做起了军阀，要么把囚犯强征入伙，要么把他们丢在那地狱般的表面，任其速死 (倒也不是立刻就死)。

主席说，委员会已就一套援助与执法的框架达成一致，但首先得由星系内当局采取行动。至于这项跨势力反海盗行动的具体经费机制，各方尚未谈成...暂时还没有。

entries.en:
After a moment, quiet settles over the commission.

The chair speaks, voice authoritative.

"We begin with the matter of Sindria..."

* * *
entries.zh:
片刻之后，委员会里静了下来。

主席开口，语气威严。

"我们先从 Sindria 的事说起..."

* * *

entries.en:
After a moment, quiet settles over the commission.

The chair speaks, voice authoritative.

"We shall begin with a moment of silence for the dead of Sindria..."
entries.zh:
片刻之后，委员会里静了下来。

主席开口，语气威严。

"开始之前，我们先为 Sindria 的死者默哀片刻..."

entries.en:
The chair is a mournful-looking archcurate of the Luddic Church, one of the most moderate of the conservative faction.

Old, but not too old. Forgiving, but not too forgiving. Pious, but not too pious.

He wears a long white beard, but his eyes are as bright and piercing as his voice. He moves with the energy of a man twenty cycles younger, calling for the declaration of findings to commence.
entries.zh:
主席是银河救赎教会一位面容悲悯的大牧师，属保守派中最温和的一翼。

年老，但不算太老。宽厚，但不算太宽厚。虔诚，但不算太虔诚。

他留着长长的白须，目光却和嗓音一样清亮锐利。举手投足间有股年轻二十个星历年的劲头，宣布开始宣读调查结论。

entries.en:
The chair is a wealthy independent politician, born on Opis, a refugee of the First Askonia Crisis - and criticized by many for a perceived conciliatory attitude toward Philip Andrada.

Their demeanor and sober dress suggests a gravity appropriate to the situation.

A voice practiced and stately calls for the declaration of findings to commence.
entries.zh:
主席是一位富有的独立政客，生于 Opis，是第一次 Askonia 危机的难民——许多人批评他对 Philip Andrada 的态度过于姑息。

此人的举止与素净的衣着，透出一种与场合相称的庄重。

一个训练有素、庄重沉稳的声音宣布：开始宣读调查结论。

entries.en:
The chair is a Hegemony admiral, uniform crowded by the ribbons and medals of a long career. Clearly they served during the First Askonia Crisis and Andrada's mutiny. Presumably they were among the fleet that stayed loyal to the Hegemony and made a hard-fought retreat.

Their countenance is appropriately grim as they call upon the declaration of findings to begin.
entries.zh:
主席是一位霸主上将，制服上密密缀满漫长军旅换来的绶带与勋章。此人显然经历过第一次 Askonia 危机与 Andrada 的叛乱。想来他当年就在那支效忠霸主、苦战之后被迫撤退的舰队里。

他面色凝重，与场合正相称，宣布开始宣读调查结论。

entries.en:
The chair is a prominent citizen of the Persean League - a client of Gens Kato, judging by their pronounced but deniable statement of loyalty in the (impeccable) fashion and colors with which they are adorned. Far enough from Fortuna for polite fictions about who paid for half the mercenaries that invaded the Askonia system.

They step forward, looking appropriately grave, and call for the declaration of findings to begin.
entries.zh:
主席是英仙座联盟的一位显要公民——看那身无可挑剔的衣装与配色，忠诚表白得张扬，却又留足了否认的余地，多半是 Kato 氏族的门客。此人与 Fortuna 的关系也够疏远，尽可维持那套体面说辞：入侵 Askonia 星系的雇佣兵有一半是谁出的钱，大家心照不宣。

此人迈步上前，面色恰如其分地凝重，宣布开始宣读调查结论。

entries.en:
The chair is a prominent Sindrian Diktat officer of the Reformer faction led by Achilles Andrada. Their uniform is traditional Diktat in its lines, but appears oddly spare due to a dearth of medals and ribbons.

This was, once, a prominent officer of the original mutiny and the navy of Philip Andrada's subsequent regime. The symbolism of their new loyalty cannot be missed.
