"I would like to extend the thanks of myself and our colony for your technical assistance," Commander Skiron beams as she speaks.

"The crew you left with us are ready to return to your $shipOrFleet; my quartermaster shall coordinate transport with your subordinates," she says.

"Well, ah. Most of them will be returning. A few have come to... other accommodations in their time among us, and we honor their contribution to our world."
entries.zh:
"我谨代表我本人和我们的殖民地对你们的技术援助表示感谢。" 指挥官 Skiron 边说边露出笑容。

她说："您留在我们这里的船员已经准备好返回您的$shipOrFleet；我的军需官将与您的下属协调运输事宜。"

"嗯，啊。他们中的大多数人都会回去。少数人在与我们相处的过程中来到了...其他地方，我们尊重他们对我们家园的贡献。"

entries.en:
You order the cargo of $smug_commodityName dropped off at an abandoned spacedock, far from prying eyes. Your flagship soon receives acknowledgement of the delivery from a disposable commsat.
OR
A converted surface-to-orbit passenger transport pulls alongside your $shipOrFleet's orbit after you give the planned signal. The cargo of $smug_commodityName is quickly transferred by robot drones running without nav transponders, then the transport pulls away.
entries.zh:
你下令将那批 $smug_commodityName 的货箱卸在一座废弃的太空船坞，确保无人察觉。你的旗舰很快就收到了来自一次性通讯基站的确认。
OR
在你发出事先说好的信号后，一辆改装过的地对轨客运货船很快与你$shipOrFleet的轨道进行了同步。在装着 $smug_commodityName 的货箱由没有导航应答器的无人机迅速转移完毕后，那艘运输载具便快速离开了。

entries.en: Making the $smug_commodityName delivery requires coming in with your transponder turned off, and without attracting the attention of patrols.
entries.zh: 运送 $smug_commodityName 时{需要关闭应答器}，并且{避开巡逻队的注意}。

entries.en: You do not have enough $smug_commodityName to complete the delivery.
entries.zh: 你没有足够的 $smug_commodityName 来完成交付。

entries.en:
"I need some $smug_commodityName moved to $smug_marketName. Discreetly."
OR
"I need to move some $smug_commodityName to $smug_marketName- without the involvement of the authorities."
entries.zh:
"我需要将 $smug_commodityName 运送到 $smug_marketName。必须谨慎行事。"
OR
"我需要在不惊扰当局的情况下，将 $smug_commodityName 运送到 $smug_marketName。"

entries.en: At the bar a shady $smug_manOrWoman bothers disinterested starship captains with an off-brand datapad.
entries.zh: 酒吧里，一个可疑的$smug_manOrWoman正拿着一部杂牌数据平板烦扰着那些兴致寥寥的星舰舰长。

o.en: Ask about the discreet smuggling operation
o.zh: 打探关于秘密走私行动的消息

o.en: Find out what the shady $smug_manOrWoman with the off-brand datapad is bothering people about
o.zh: 看看那个带着杂牌数据平板的可疑$smug_manOrWoman在为了什么而问东问西

entries.en:
As you approach, the $smug_manOrWoman leaves $hisOrHer current prospect mid-pitch, shifting $hisOrHer attention to you.

"You there, captain. Yes, you know an honest face when you see one!" $HeOrShe gives a crooked smile, "Just look here," $heOrShe shoves the flickering display of the datapad into your hands: a cargo manifest consisting mostly of low-grade construction materials stored in a warehouse in a completely different system.

$HeOrShe leans in, and speaks quietly, motioning as if explaining the datapad's contents, "You help me move $smug_quantity units of $smug_commodityName to $smug_marketName, a quick hop of $smug_dist light-years. Then I pay you $smug_reward credits. No need to involve the authorities, no inspections, no tariffs. Easy money, right?"
entries.zh:
当你走近时，那个$smug_manOrWoman暂时停止了和他人的攀谈，把$hisOrHer的注意力转移到了你身上。

"那边那位，舰长。果然，诚实的人一眼就能看出来！" $HeOrShe歪嘴笑了笑，"你看看这个。" $heOrShe把闪烁的数据平板递到了你的手中：上面显示的货物清单记录着存储在另一个星系的仓库里的低档建筑材料。

$HeOrShe靠了过来，轻声解释着数据平板上的内容，"你帮我把 $smug_quantity 单位的 $smug_commodityName 运送到 $smug_marketName，仅在 $smug_dist 光年外，很近。然后我会付你 $smug_reward 星币。不用惊动当局，没有检查，没有关税。很容易到手的一笔钱，对吧？"

entries.en: "I need $smug_quantity units of $smug_commodityName moved to $smug_marketName, which is $smug_dist light-years away. Your discretion is key; the local authorities cannot know about the shipment. You'll be paid $smug_reward credits on delivery."
entries.zh: "我需要将 $smug_quantity 单位的 $smug_commodityName 运送到 $smug_marketName，离这儿 $smug_dist 光年外。务必保密；不能让当局知道货物的事。送完后你就能收到 $smug_reward 星币。"

entries.en: You have been invited to the grand seasonal ball to be held at the estate of House Rao.
entries.zh: 你被邀请参加在 Rao 家族的庄园举行的盛大季节舞会。

o.en: Take a shuttle to the Rao estate
o.zh: 搭乘穿梭机前往 Rao 的庄园

entries.en:
Your comms officer notifies you of an incoming message for you, personally. You confirm your identity and access the file. The crest of House Rao of Eventide fills your display, evoking martial tradition, long-held wealth, and prestige.

"You are cordially invited to the grand seasonal ball at the spring estate of House Rao..."
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官通知你有个传给你的通讯消息，私人的。你进行身份识别后访问了文件。Eventide 的 Rao 家族纹章充斥了整个屏幕，象征着军人的传承，显赫的威望和持久的繁荣。

"本次的大型社交季舞会将在 Rao 家族的春色庄园举办，诚邀您的出席..."

o.en: Immediately take a shuttle to the Rao estate
o.zh: 搭乘穿梭机前往 Rao 家族的庄园

o.en: Take care of other business first

entries.en: As you don your best apparel as a shuttle is prepared, and you consider your primary goal, which is to...
entries.zh: 在穿梭机整备的空档里，你换上了最好的正装，开始考虑起此行的目的。你应该...

o.en: Make useful connections in the Hegemony officer corps
o.zh: 在 霸主 军官中建立有用的人脉关系

o.en: It's a party! Just have a good time
Find a way to disgrace Caspian Sang
o.zh: 设法让 Caspian Sang 颜面扫地

o.en: Keep an open mind and watch for opportunities

entries.en: You turn and find your way toward the edge of the room, leaving a bemused Neriene of House Rao on the dance floor.
entries.zh: 你转身朝房间的边缘走去，将 Rao 家的 Neriene 大小姐一脸茫然地留在舞池里。

entries.en:
Jeers and laughter come from the direction of Sang's minions, but they're ignored easily enough as you turn your back on the ballroom.

You have no doubt that you'll be the butt of their jokes all night.

A quick inquiry with one of the uniformed staff allows you access to a discreet servants' access lift and back to your shuttle's pad with a minimum of fuss.
entries.zh:
嘲笑声从 Sang 的跟屁虫们那边传了过来，但在你转身离开舞厅时，忽视它们并不难。

你肯定成为了他们一整晚的笑柄。

简短地询问身着制服的工作人员后，你进入了不起眼的侍者用电梯，返回了你的穿梭机停机坪，没遇到什么麻烦。

entries.en:
The staff is efficient; your entourage is summoned without requiring your intervention, though they seem to have been interrupted in the middle of a meal, wiping hands and one guard popping an anti-inebriant.

Your shuttle is prepped and ready to leave.
entries.zh:
这里的员工效率很高；不需要你的提醒，他们就招来了你的随从。不过他们应该是饭才吃到一半的时候被叫出来的，全都还在擦着手。有个保镖还在你面前磕了一片醒酒药。

你的穿梭机已经准备就绪，可以出发了。

o.en: Board and order return to orbit

entries.en: Your shuttle rejoins your $shipOrFleet above $entityName.
entries.zh: 你的穿梭机返回了 $entityName 上方的$shipOrFleet中。

entries.en: You are slow to follow at first, not being accustomed to ballroom dancing with the elite of Eventide, but Neriene is patient and accommodating, providing instructions on the local customs in a low voice. She is, you suspect, a commander able to embolden green crews toward good performance under pressure.
entries.zh: 起初你有些跟不上节奏，还没习惯 Eventide 的精英们跳的这种交谊舞。但 Neriene 随和且耐心，低声指导你跟上当地的习俗舞步。你感觉她是一个能够激励新手船员在高压之下高效完成任务的指挥官。

entries.en: She is quick to follow, though you suspect not accustomed to that role. Nor is ballroom dancing with the Hegemony elite of Eventide much in your wheelhouse, but Neriene provides a few suggestions pursuant to the local customs in a low voice. She is, you suspect, a commander able to embolden green crews toward good performance under pressure.
entries.zh: 她迅速跟上了节奏，尽管你怀疑她并不习惯成为舞伴。但你与 Eventide 霸主精英共跳交谊舞的技术也没好到能让你随心乘风转舵。察觉到这一点后，Neriene 低声指导了你几句，让你跟上当地的传统舞步。你感到她是个能够激励新手船员在高压环境下高效完成任务的指挥官。

entries.en: Before long, you find yourselves caught up in the rhythm of the movements and for a short moment you manage to forget about petty bullies and factional politics.
entries.zh: 很快，你就发现自己跟上了当下舞步的节奏，暂时把周围无聊的欺压和派系的政见全都给抛到了脑后。

entries.en:
The next song begins, and inertia takes you.

"So," says Neriene over your shoulder. "You know who I am, why I'm here." A step, a turn.

"Why are you here, captain? I know it's not for Caspian Sang."
entries.zh:
下一支曲开始，你们顺势继续。

"那么，" Neriene 的声音从你肩后传来，"你知道我是谁，我为什么在这里。" 顺着舞步，她转到了你的面前。

"你又是为什么来，舰长？我知道不是为了 Caspian Sang。"

o.en: I was hoping to talk with someone important.
o.zh: 我想和些重要人物谈谈。

o.en: I just can't turn down an invitation to a good party.
o.zh: 我没法拒绝这样一个美妙宴会的邀请。

o.en: It really was to prove Sang wrong, somehow.
o.zh: 不晓得怎么的，我之前就是想来证明 Sang 惹错人了。

o.en: Hard to say. It felt like I ought to be here.
o.zh: 很难说，我就觉得我该来这里。

entries.en: "Then it's fate," she says with a wry smile, "Somehow I didn't take you for a romantic."
entries.zh: "那就是命运了，" 她露出了个古怪的笑容，"我没料到你是个浪漫的人。"

entries.en: "Then I must apologize for disappointing you," she says with a wry smile.
entries.zh: "那很抱歉让你失望了，" 她苦笑着说。

entries.en: "Good," she says with a smile, "Because I'm finally starting to enjoy myself."
entries.zh: "不错，" 她笑着说，"因为我也终于开始感受到乐趣了。"

entries.en: She frowns, "Though I agree with the sentiment, it's not him you need to worry about."
entries.zh: 她皱起眉头，"我理解你这种情绪，但你需要在意的不是他。"

entries.en: "A barefaced lie," she says with a smile, "But it's a nice thought."
entries.zh: "这谎说得还真是没羞没臊的。" 她笑着说，"不过还挺中听的。"

entries.en: You see Neriene's eyes focus on something behind you, and her expression goes hard as she pulls away from you.
entries.zh: 你注意到 Neriene 似乎在看着你身后的什么，随即她脸色一沉，从你身边抽身退开。

entries.en:
"Oh $playerName!"

You know that nasal tone all too well, now, and slowly turn to see Caspian Sang and his entourage behind a thick-necked lieutenant.
entries.zh:
"喔，$playerName！"

你现在对他的声音已经再熟悉不过了，你慢慢地转过身去，看见 Caspian Sang 和他的跟班们正站在一个粗脖子的上尉后面。

entries.en:
The new lieutenant ignores Sang entirely. "Neriene," he says. "What's this then, slumming with frontier trash?"

"Magnus Cardona," she whispers to you, "A real piece of-"
entries.zh:
新来的上尉完全无视了 Sang。"Neriene，" 他说道，"你在做什么，和边缘星区来的垃圾瞎混在一起？"

"Magnus Cardona，" 她朝你耳语，"这人就是一坨..."

entries.en:
As Neriene begins to reply, you find the crowds in the ballroom withdrawing toward the sides of the room. During your exchange with Sang, you must have missed some announcement because the live band at the end of the great hall is beginning to play a waltz.

Dancers partner up from the edge of the floor. You catch a glimpse of Sang and his flunkies keeping an eye on you, still held off by the force of Neriene's presence.

You look at her for some kind of cue. She looks at you expectantly.
entries.zh:
正当 Neriene 要开口答话时，你注意到舞厅里的人群都向房间的四周退去。看来一定是你在和 Sang 交锋的时错过了什么通知，因为这时大厅尽头的乐队开始演奏起了华尔兹。

场边的舞者们开始争相结伴。在其中你碰巧瞥见 Sang 和他的跟屁虫们还正盯着你，却因为 Neriene 在场而不敢上前。

你用眼神向她寻求提示，但她却用期许的目光回应了你。

o.en: Um. Where can a space captain get a fresh drink around here?
o.zh: 呃，那么太空舰长该去哪找饮料喝呢？

o.en: Try very hard to initiate a Transverse Jump
o.zh: 竭尽全力尝试手搓一次横轴跳跃

entries.en: Neriene of House Rao nods and takes your hand. You find yourself pulled toward the center of the dance floor with the inevitability of a singularity's gravity well.
entries.zh: 这位 Rao 家的 Neriene 大小姐点了点头，握起了你的手。你发现自己立即就被拉入了舞池的正中央，仿佛有个无法逃离的奇点重力井在那儿一样。

entries.en: Neriene of House Rao takes your hand and pulls you toward the center of the dance floor with the inevitability of a singularity's gravity well.
entries.zh: 这位 Rao 家的 Neriene 大小姐抓起你的手，把你拉入了舞池的正中央，仿佛有个无法逃离的奇点重力井在那儿一样。

entries.en: Neriene of House Rao gives you a skeptical look. "Are you at least willing to try?"
entries.zh: 这位 Rao 家的 Neriene 大小姐一脸狐疑地盯着你。"你至少愿意试一试吧？"

o.en: No. I'm going to leave now.

entries.en: "Then I'll show you," she says, taking your hand. You find yourself pulled toward the center of the dance floor with the inevitability of a singularity's gravity well.
entries.zh: "那我来教你。" 她这么说着，拉起了你的手。你发现自己立即就被拉入了舞池的正中央，仿佛有个无法逃离的奇点重力井在那儿一样。

entries.en:
Neriene of House Rao gives you a skeptical look. "There's one in your hand. But you're going to have to put it down if we're going to dance."

She snaps her fingers and instantly a servitor appears with a tray to take your drink.
entries.zh:
这位 Rao 家的 Neriene 大小姐一脸狐疑地盯着你。"你手里不就有吗？但得先把它放一放，如果我们要一起去跳个舞的话。"

她打了个响指，立马有一个端着托盘的侍者过来准备接过你的饮料。

o.en: Chug the drink and leave the glass
o.zh: 将饮料一饮而尽并交出空杯子

o.en: Um. I'm going to leave now.

entries.en: She gives you a skeptical look. "Are you stalling, $playerSirOrMadam? This does not befit your reputation."
entries.zh: 她一脸狐疑地盯着你。"你在拖延时间吗，$playerSirOrMadam？这可与你的名声不符。"

o.en: What would you like to do?
Um. I'm going to leave now.

entries.en: Her skeptical look takes a turn toward withering.
entries.zh: 她脸上的怀疑被放弃取代了。

o.en: What would you like to do?
Um. I'm going to leave now.

entries.en: She gives you a skeptical look. "Are you feeling well, $playerSirOrMadam?"
entries.zh: 她一脸狐疑地盯着你。"你不舒服吗，$playerSirOrMadam？"

o.en: I was trying to initiate a Transverse Jump.
o.zh: 我刚才正尝试启动横轴跳跃。

o.en: What would you like to do?
Um. I'm going to leave now.

entries.en:
With a quick tap you delete the invitation forever.

You, attending a ball with a bunch of fancy aristocrats? With that insufferable Caspian Sang? No good could come of it.
entries.zh:
你轻触了几下屏幕后永久删掉了邀请函。

你，和一群贵族一起参加舞会？和那个烦人的 Caspian Sang 一起？这样做不会有什么好结果的。

entries.en: Cardona nods. "Prepare yourself."
entries.zh: Cardona 点了点头，"做好准备。"

entries.en:
Sang calls out, "Let the auxiliary-captain speak!"

Cardona shoots Sang a look that shuts him up, then turns his dead-eyed stare to you. "I'm to understand that this frontier barbarian impugned the honor of a Hegemony officer tonight."

The dance has stopped, the band finally having got the hint. All eyes are on you.
entries.zh:
Sang 大声道，"让这个辅助军舰长自己说！"

Cardona 瞪了 Sang 一眼让他闭嘴，然后他死死地盯住了你。"我已经充分了解到，今晚一有个边缘星区来的野蛮人践踏了一位 霸主 军官的荣誉。"

舞曲停了下来，看来乐队已经看到了这边的情况。所有人的目光都集中在了你的身上。

o.en: No, Caspian managed that all on his own.
o.zh: 不，那是 Caspian 自导自演的。

o.en: Why don't we all have a drink and calm down.
o.zh: 不如一起喝一杯，然后冷静下来谈谈？

entries.en:
Cardona calls out, "I'm to understand that this frontier barbarian assaulted the honor of a Hegemony officer tonight."

The dance has stopped, the band finally having got the hint. All eyes are on you.
entries.zh:
Cardona 喊到，"我已经充分了解到，今晚有个边缘星区来的野蛮人践踏了一位 霸主 军官的荣誉。"

舞曲停了下来，看来乐队已经看到了这边的情况。所有人的目光都集中在了你的身上。

o.en: Caspian has such a punchable face, it couldn't be helped.
o.zh: 谁叫 Caspian 长得那么欠扁，让我没忍住。

o.en: Why don't we all have a drink and calm down.
o.zh: 不如喝一杯，然后冷静下来谈谈？

entries.en:
"He's irrelevant. You attacked the uniform, and for that," Cardona loosens his sword, "I challenge you to honorable combat."

Sang grins from behind him, relishing the moment.
entries.zh:
"他本人无关紧要，你攻击的是这一身制服，而为此，" Cardona 解下了佩剑，"我要向你发起光荣的决斗。"

Sang 在他身后咧嘴笑着，似乎很享受这一刻。

entries.en:
"You. $playerName. You attacked the uniform, and for that," Cardona loosens his sword, "I challenge you to honorable combat."

Sang grins from behind him, relishing this moment.
entries.zh:
"你，$playerName，你攻击了这一身制服，而为此，" Cardona 解下了佩剑，"我要向你发起光荣的决斗。"

Sang 在他身后咧嘴笑着，似乎很享受这一刻。

entries.en: The crowd jeers. Neriene gives the closest hecklers a killing look; they quickly discover that they were less enthusiastic about this duel than they had thought. Her status as a member of House Rao and host of the ball does not shield you from general disdain, however, and she quickly leads you through a discreet servants' access lift and back to your shuttle's pad.
entries.zh: 人群哄笑起来。随着 Neriene 向旁边咧嘴大笑的人投去了一个杀气腾腾的眼神，他们很快就识趣地发现了自己对这场决斗的热情没有想象中那么高。虽然身为 Rao 家的一员和舞会主持人，她并不能替你挡下所有的蔑视，但尽其所能地，她指引你进入了一个不起眼的侍者专用电梯，让你回到了你穿梭机的停泊处。

entries.en: "I'm afraid so," Neriene says. "Technically."
entries.zh: "恐怕，" Neriene 说，"的确是合法的。"

entries.en:
"Then you prove that you don't belong here among us," Cardona sneers.

"You've the thin frontier blood of thieves and failures. Crawl away now, barbarian, and be thankful the Hegemony came to save your kind when you proved unable to rule yourself."
entries.zh:
"那就证明你不配站在这里。" Cardona 冷笑道。

"你这生自边缘星区的贱骨头注定了你就是个坑蒙拐骗的废物。现在滚吧，没文化的，等到你们都管不好自己的时候，再来感谢去拯救你们的 霸主 吧。"

o.zh: 我又考虑了一下，还是接受吧。

o.en: Your crude tradition proves nothing. Good-bye.
o.zh: 你那粗俗的传统什么也证明不了，再见。

o.en: Barbarian? You're the one threatening guests with oversized cutlery.
o.zh: 野蛮人？现在用超大号餐具威胁客人的可是你啊。

entries.en: Neriene follows you. "Good," she says to you under her breath.
entries.zh: Neriene 跟上了你。"不错。" 她压低声音对你说道。

entries.en:
Your acceptance washes across the crowd, waking them as if from a stupor. Their murmuring fills the hall. Cardona, Sang, and the rest gather and begin walking toward a tall set of doors at one end of the ballroom. Others join them, mostly officers, mostly young men.

"Grandmother!" Neriene calls out; you follow her pleading look to a stately woman overseeing the entire affair. "Put a stop to this, there's no need for bloodshed on this night."
entries.zh:
你的决定震惊了人群，把他们从恍惚中唤醒。他们的窃窃私语充满了大厅。Cardona，Sang 和剩下的人聚到了一起，开始走向舞厅一端一扇高大的门。其他人也加入了他们，大部分是军官和年轻人。

"祖母！" Neriene 喊道；你顺着她那恳求的眼神，发现一位端庄的女士在看着这一切。"叫停吧，今晚没必要发生流血事件。"

entries.en: You recognize Augusta Rao from the news holos. Her head pitches almost imperceptibly - a denial - before she turns her back and moves away, pulling in her wake a retinue of ministers and aristocrats.
entries.zh: 你在全息新闻里见到过这个人，Augusta Rao。她用旁人难以察觉的幅度抬了一下脸表示拒绝，然后就转过身，在一群随行官员和贵族的陪同下离开了。

entries.en:
On a bench before you lies a dueling kit: hardened boots, gloves, and helmet. A neatly folded jumpsuit of material smart enough to allow only what it judges to be non-lethal jabs and cuts comes with a suite of embedded medical sensors to automatically perform first-aid upon injury. "Deaths are very rare," a minor aristocrat assures you as he hands a scabbard to Neriene Rao.

She waves him back toward the gawkers with an annoyed look. There are fewer gathered around you, and fewer uniforms, than those egging on Cardona and Sang.

"This is stupid," she says, drawing the sword a handswidth and examining the edge. "You don't have to go through with it."
entries.zh:
你面前的长台面上摆着一整套的决斗装备：坚固的靴子、手套和头盔，还有一套连身衣整齐地叠放在一旁。连身衣由智能材料构成，只允许被认定为非致命的刺击和劈砍穿过它。同时它还带有一套嵌入式医疗设备，可以在受伤时自动执行急救。"几乎没人在决斗时死去，" 一位低阶贵族向你保证道，同时他把一支没出鞘的剑递给了 Neriene Rao。

她挥手把这位低阶贵族赶回了看客之中，脸上止不住地流露出懊恼的神情。相对于 Cardona 和 Sang 那边，你这边围上来的人很少，而其中穿制服的家伙就更少了。

"这太蠢了，" 她说着，把剑抽出一掌宽，仔细检查起剑刃来。"你没必要这么做。"

entries.en: Neriene sighs, "It doesn't matter what those children think. I just can't believe grandmother is allowing this to go on. Emboldening people like Cardona is going to cause trouble."
entries.zh: Neriene 叹了口气，"没必要和那些孩子较真。我只是不敢相信，祖母居然会允许这件事发生。纵容 Cardona 那样的人只会带来麻烦。"

entries.en:
"It's, um. Complicated. Political." She doesn't like to talk about it, you think.

"There are those in the Hegemony that think they - we, I mean; those whose families came from the officers of the Fourteenth Battlegroup - that we're somehow better than everyone else. It's ridiculous."
entries.zh:
"这，嗯。很复杂，政治因素。" 看起来她不太愿意谈这个。

"霸主 中有些人是 第十四战斗群 的后裔，他们认为他们...不，应该说是我们，比其他任何人都强。但这太荒谬了。"

entries.en:
Dressed in dueling gear and wielding Neriene's sword, you are led to one end of a columned loggia that seems to hang over the valley below.

Magnus Cardona steps forward, and the crowds withdraw.
entries.zh:
披挂好决斗装备之后，你握起 Neriene 的剑，跟着领路人走到了一条长廊的尽头。长廊被高耸的立柱支起，看起来仿佛是悬在峡谷之上。

Magnus Cardona 踏步上前，人群向后退去。

entries.en: "Good," she says, and drops the scabbard onto the pile of dueling kit.
entries.zh: "很好，" 她说着，把剑扔到了那堆决斗用具里。

entries.en:
The staff is efficient; your entourage is summoned without requiring your intervention, though they seem to have been interrupted in the middle of a meal, wiping hands and one guard popping an anti-inebriant.

Shuttle prepped, Neriene sees you off from the launch pad.

"Well," she says uncomfortably, "I apologize for... for everything. We're not all clannish brutes."
entries.zh:
这里的员工效率很高；不需要你的提醒，他们就招来了你的随从。不过他们应该是饭才吃到一半的时候被叫出来的，全都还在擦着手。有个保镖还在你面前磕了一片醒酒药。

穿梭机已经准备就绪，Neriene 在发射台送别你。

"总之，" 她听上去一点都高兴不起来，"我为... 这一切向你道歉。我们并不都是排外的野蛮人。"

o.en: I won't hold their actions against you.
o.zh: 我不会因为他们的行为指责你。

o.en: I've survived worse. It's no hull breach, for instance.
o.zh: 我见过更糟的。这次又不是船上破了个洞，打个比方。

o.en: I enjoyed the dance. We should do it again.
o.zh: 至少我觉得跳舞挺有趣的，有机会我们该再试试。

o.en: Don't. They just showed me what you really are.
o.zh: 别装了，他们只不过是让我看到了你们的真面目而已。

entries.en:
"No, I suppose not," she says, the start of a smile on her face.

"Until a better time, captain," she says then turns away before you can reply, heading toward the manor complex.
entries.zh: "嗯，确实。" 她说，脸上笑容重现，"再择良日吧，舰长。"你还没来得及回答，她就转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去。

entries.en:
"I'd like that," she says, the start of a smile on her face.

She looks like she is about to say more, but instead nods quickly and turns away before you can reply, heading toward the manor complex.
entries.zh: "我也这么想，" 她说，脸上笑容重现。她看起来还想说什么，但取而代之地，她点了点头后转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去 —— 在你能做出答复之前。

entries.en: Your shuttle rejoins your $shipOrFleet above $entityName.
entries.zh: 你的穿梭机返回了 $entityName 上方的$shipOrFleet中。

entries.en: She looks hurt, opens her mouth to speak, then closes it and quickly turns away, heading toward the manor complex.
entries.zh: 她看起来受到了不小的打击，张开嘴想说些什么，但很快一言不发地闭上嘴，转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去。

entries.en:
She nods, accepting your words, her face still grim.

"Until a better time, captain."

She turns away before you can reply, heading toward the manor complex.
entries.zh: 她点点头，接受了你的话，但脸色依旧不好看。"再择良日吧，舰长。" 你还没来得及回答，她就转身朝庄园走了回去。

entries.en:
"One that has no place in a civilized society," she says. "But I suppose we aren't quite that, are we."

She looks toward one of the mirrorsets.
entries.zh:
"那东西在文明社会里根本没有用武之地。但看来我们还没文明到那个程度，不是吗？"

她这么说到，目光看向其中一套恒星镜组。

entries.en:
"If you're sure," she says.

As you begin to step away, she adds "And... give him hell!"
entries.zh:
"如果你确定的话。" 她说道。

当你迈步离开时，她补了一句，"顺便...给他点颜色看看！"

o.en: I won't have them think me a coward.
o.zh: 我不会让他们把我当成懦夫的。

o.en: What do you mean by people like Cardona?
o.zh: 你说' Cardona 那样的人'是什么意思？

o.en: You're right, this is stupid. I'm leaving.
o.zh: 你说得对，这太蠢了，我要走了。
你们这儿的传统还真迷人。

o.en: I have studied the blade. (easier fight)
o.zh: 我略懂击剑。 (战斗难度降低)

entries.en:
Neriene looks doubtful as she hands you the scabbard.

You draw the blade in a single movement and demonstrate a lunge or two. The crowd gathering around you cheers and calls boasts toward the other end of the loggia.

"Those idiots might have made a bigger mistake than I thought," she admits with an impressed look.
entries.zh:
Neriene 把剑递你的时候看起来还有些将信将疑。

你干脆利落地拔剑出鞘，比划了个凌厉的弓步直刺，快得没法看清是出手了一次还是两次。聚在你周围的人群欢呼雀跃起来，还向走廊另一端发出吹嘘的声音。

"那些白痴犯了比我想象中更大的错误。" 她看起来承认了你有些本事。

entries.en:
She hands you the scabbard with the sword, "This was given to me by my father."

"But it doesn't have any sentimental value." She gives you a quick look, "I never cared for swordplay."
entries.zh:
她把剑连鞘一起递给了你，"这是我父亲给我的。"

"但这没什么情感价值在里边，" 她瞥了一眼你的表情，"我不怎么喜欢剑术。"

entries.en: Neriene pauses a moment, then says "Before you go through with this, would you like to take a few practice swings to warm up?"
entries.zh: Neriene 停顿了一阵，然后开口道，"在开始之前，要不要先挥几下试试？"

o.en: Take a few practice swings (sword tutorial)
Too scared to fight me yourself, Caspian?

entries.en: You catch a glimpse of Sang's panic before Cardona steps forward, putting himself between you and Sang. "It is I who have challenged you. Answer me now!"
entries.zh: 你注意到 Sang 慌了起来，但这时 Cardona 走上前挡在了你们之间，"挑战你的是我，现在做出答复！"

entries.en:
"On Eventide we have the courage to fight face to face," Cardona says.

"Now answer my challenge!"
entries.zh:
"在 Eventide 我们有面对面对决的勇气，" Cardona 说。

"现在做出你的答复！"

entries.en: "Well." Neriene considers her words carefully. "I think Cardona has been drinking, so that'll help."
entries.zh: "好吧，" Neriene 仔细斟酌字句，想着要说些中听的话，"我想 Cardona 应该没少喝酒，那多少能上点忙。"

entries.en:
This prompts a few snickers and a guffaw from the crowd. Cardona looks furiously to each side, then straight at you.

"Answer my challenge," he shouts, "And do it now!"
entries.zh:
这恰到好处的反讽让周围的人群里传来了零星忍俊不禁的笑声。Cardona 怒不可遏地朝两边看了看，然后又直直瞪向了你。

"回应我的挑战，" 他喊道，"现在就做出回应！"

o.zh: 我又考虑了一下，还是接受吧。

o.en: Your crude tradition proves nothing. Good-bye.
o.zh: 你那粗俗的传统什么也证明不了，再见。

entries.en:
You slowly awaken. You feel distinctly unwell; there is no pain, but instead the wrongness of separated flesh.

A portable automedic beeps beside you, cold tubes running into your body. A vaguely Neriene Rao-shaped figure asks you something.
entries.zh:
你缓缓醒来。你感到很不舒服，并不是疼痛，而只有肉体错位的怪异感。

一个便携式自动设备在你身边哔哔作响，冰冷的管子镶入了你的身体中。一个模模糊糊的看起来像 Neriene Rao 的人影在问你一些事情。

entries.en:
You're leaning against a bench, you think, with someone's uniform jacket behind your head. Tall windows glow in the twilight, the blurred forms of revelers moving within.

The mirrors have been allowed to set, leaving the sky glowing darkly in deepest blue.
entries.zh:
你大概是靠在长凳上，你想，有人帮你把制服外套垫在了脑袋后面。高耸的窗户在暮色中闪闪发光，狂欢者模糊的身影在里面摇曳闪动。

恒星镜的傍晚已经落暮，天空中只剩下深蓝色的微光。

entries.en:
"Come on, let's get you back to your shuttle."

Neriene pulls you to your feet. Your head spins for a moment, then the automedic whirrs. A sense of fragile wellness fills you.

She gingerly leads you to a discreet servants' access lift and back to your shuttle's pad.
entries.zh:
"来吧，我送你回穿梭机。"

Neriene 把你拉了起来，让你感到一阵头晕眼花。这时自动医疗装置开始嗡嗡作响，把一股脆弱的健康感填入了你的身躯。

她小心翼翼地把你带到了一个不起眼的侍者用电梯里，让你回到了你的穿梭机旁。

entries.en:
The manor staff are efficient; your entourage has been summoned. They keep their tone professional, but you can tell that their mood is cautious. Word of your loss obviously spread quickly through the waiting flight crews.

Neriene sees you off from the launch pad.

"Well," she says uncomfortably, "I apologize for... for everything. We're not all clannish brutes."
entries.zh:
这里的员工效率很高。不需要你的提醒，他们就招来了你的随从。他们依旧保持着专业的语气，但你可以看出他们情绪低落。看起来你战败的消息已经在等候的船员中传开了。

穿梭机准备好了，Neriene 在发射台送别你。

"总之，"她很不舒服地说，"我为...这一切向你道歉。我们并不都是排外的畜牲。"

o.en: I won't hold their actions against you.
o.zh: 我不会因为他们的行为指责你。

o.en: Fun party. Glad I survived it.
o.zh: 有趣的派对，很高兴我还挺得过来。

o.en: Now they know I won't back down. I won that much.
o.zh: 现在他们至少知道我不会退缩了，也算是一种小胜吧。

o.en: I enjoyed the dance. We should do it again.
o.zh: 至少我觉得跳舞很有趣，有机会我们该再试试。

o.en: Don't. They just showed me what you really are.
o.zh: 别装了，他们只不过是让我看到了你们的真面目而已。

entries.en:
Her brow furrows. "At the academy we were taught to avoid battle on terms set by the enemy."

She looks like she might say more, but decides against it. With a shake of her head she turns away before you can respond, heading back toward the manor complex.
entries.zh:
她皱了皱眉，"在学院里，我们被教会了别按照敌人设下的规矩来战斗。"

她看起来还想说更多，但放弃了。她点了点头后转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去 —— 在你能做出答复之前。

entries.en:
"I'd like that," she says, her smile finally returning.

She looks like she might say more but instead nods quickly and turns away before you can reply, heading back toward the manor complex.
entries.zh:
"我也这么想，" 她说，脸上笑容重现。

她看起来还想说什么，但取而代之地，她点了点头后转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去 —— 在你能做出答复之前。

entries.en: Your shuttle rejoins your $shipOrFleet above $entityName.
entries.zh: 你的穿梭机返回了 $entityName 上方的$shipOrFleet中。

entries.en:
"Me too," she says with the start of a smile.

"Until next time, captain," she says, turning back toward the manor complex before you can reply.
entries.zh:
"我也是，" 她笑了起来。

"再择良日吧，舰长。"你还没来得及回答，她就转身朝庄园走了回去。

entries.en: She looks hurt, opens her mouth to speak, then closes it and quickly turns away, heading toward the manor complex.
entries.zh: 她看起来受到了不小的打击，张开嘴想说些什么，但很快一言不发地闭上嘴，转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去。

entries.en:
She nods grimly, accepting your words.

"Until a better time, captain." She turns away before you can reply, heading toward the manor complex.
entries.zh:
她点点头，接受了你的话。

"再择良日吧，舰长。" 你还没来得及回答，她就转身朝庄园走了回去。

entries.en:
The watching crowd emits a sound of collective sympathetic pain as Cardona falls to the floor with a crack. A tense silence follows.

Sang and his minions look horrified. The onlookers behind them watch, frozen and unsure.
entries.zh:
当 Cardona 重重地倒地时，围观的人群感同身受般地爆出了一阵痛呼。接着是紧张的沉默。

Sang 和他的跟班们看起来吓坏了。他们身后的旁观者呆若木鸡，不敢相信眼前的一切。

entries.en:
Something large and unseen turns on an invisible fulcrum toward a tipping point, a threshold of critical mass igniting a state change.

Someone begins to cheer, then others, with a rising wave of applause and shouts. It is agreed, then, that today we may cheer for the outsider.
entries.zh:
就像是有看不见的巨大物体被隐形撬杆推过了支点一样，周围的气氛仿佛是突破了临界质量一般发生了质变。

先是不知道是谁起头开始了欢呼，之后便有人附和起来，掌声和喝彩如波澜般向外传开。看起来大家达成了共识，今天是一个可以为外人欢呼的日子。

entries.en:
You find yourself lifted onto the shoulders of excitable revelers who were not your friend only minutes ago. You are carried bodily back into the grand hall, where pressurized potables are uncapped.

Placed at the head table like a king, you are presented to those gathered as some kind of cult-object, the avatar of victory, honor, or some other notions that will likely make a lot less sense tomorrow when everyone sobers up.
entries.zh:
你发现自己被一群兴奋的欢呼者抬到了他们的肩膀上，而就在几分钟前，他们还不是你的朋友。你不由自主地被抬回了大厅，那里已经满是开了盖的香槟什么的。

你像国王一样被放到了主桌上，被周围的人犹如狂热信徒一般崇拜着。胜利的化身，荣誉的代言，抑或是其他什么理想概念的象征，不管怎么样，等明天大家都酒醒了之后，这些应该就没有什么意义了。

entries.en:
The thought crosses your mind that Neriene's sword is no longer in your hand. You hope someone ensured that it was safely stowed. You catch sight of Neriene's face; she is trying to push through the crowd. She looks at once joyful and concerned.

Augusta Rao looks on from afar, her expression aloof.
entries.zh:
你突然想到 Neriene 的剑已经不在你手里了。你默默念叨最好是被人妥善保管了。你看到了 Neriene 的脸，她正试图挤过人群，脸上的神情却是喜忧参半。

Augusta Rao 则只是远远地看着你，神情冷漠。

entries.en:
Later - how much later you don't care to consider just yet - you stand unsteadily before your shuttle. The manor staff are efficient; your entourage has been summoned. Some look like they've been woken from sleep, and you note one guard stealthily popping an anti-inebriant. They keep their tone professional, but you can tell that they are glowing with pride. Word of your victory obviously spread quickly through the waiting flight crews.

Neriene appears to see you off from the launch pad. She is well composed despite the excesses of the ball.

"You've made some friends tonight," Neriene says with a hint of a smile, which fades. "And some enemies."
entries.zh:
不久之后，嘛，到底是多久之后你已经不在乎了，你摇摇晃晃地回到了你的穿梭机前。这里的员工效率很高；不需要你的提醒，他们就招来了你的随从。一些人看起来刚刚被叫醒，你还注意到有一个保镖在偷偷地磕了一片醒酒药。他们依旧保持着专业的语气，但你可以看到他们脸上写满了自豪。看起来你胜利的消息已经在等候的船员中传开了。

Neriene 也来为你送行了。尽管在舞会上她玩得很尽兴，现在她却很镇静。

"你今晚结识了一些朋友，" Neriene 说，脸上带着一丝微笑，但笑容渐渐消失了。"但也招惹了一些仇敌。"

o.en: Fun party. See you around, maybe.
o.zh: 很有趣的舞会。之后有缘再见吧。

o.en: And now my enemies know what's waiting for them.
o.zh: 不过那些仇人应该清楚等着他们的是什么了。

o.en: I hope to count you among those friends.
o.zh: 我希望你也被算进那些朋友里。

o.en: I'm never coming to one of these balls ever again.
o.zh: 我真不想再参加这种舞会了。

o.en: I can't believe you convinced me to take part in that debauched bloodsport.
o.zh: 我真不敢相信你居然说服了我，让我去参加那个堕落的血腥游戏。

entries.en:
Her brow furrows. "And your friends, I suppose," she says, and turns away.

She starts back toward the manor complex before you can reply.
entries.zh:
她皱了皱眉头。"你的朋友也是，我想。" 她说着转过了身。

你还没能做出回应，她就迈步朝庄园走了回去。

entries.en:
"I'd like that," she says, the smile returning.

She looks like she might say more but instead nods and turns away, heading back toward the manor complex before you can reply.
entries.zh:
"我也乐于接受。" 她说，脸上又出现了微笑。

她看起来还想说什么，但取而代之地，她点了点头后转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去 —— 在你能做出答复之前。

entries.en: She nods, the hint of a smile returning. "Maybe." She turns away before you can reply, and walks back toward the manor complex.
entries.zh: 她点了点头，脸上又出现了一丝微笑。"也许吧。" 你还没来得及回答，她就转过身去走回了庄园。

entries.en:
She nods toward the distant storm clouds, thoughtful, "I can't say I blame you. Perhaps we shall meet again in a more... civilized context."

With that, she turns away and heads toward the manor complex.
entries.zh:
她点了点头，看向远处的风暴云墙，若有所思。"我也不能怪你。也许下次我们能在一个...更文明的环境里碰面。"

说完后，她转身朝庄园建筑群走去。

entries.en: Your shuttle rejoins your $shipOrFleet above $entityName.
entries.zh: 你的穿梭机返回了 $entityName 上方的$shipOrFleet中。

entries.en:
She looks shocked, "You actually think I-" she interrupts herself, holding her palm toward you, her expression hardening.

Neriene opens her mouth to speak, then closes it and quickly turns away, heading back toward the manor complex.
entries.zh:
她看起来很震惊，"你原来认为是我 ——" 她硬生生地刹住了自己的话，向你做出了个 "推开" 的动作，神情僵硬。

Neriene 又张开了嘴想说些什么，但很快沉默了，迅速转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去。

entries.en:
Your shuttle follows a course to the surface authorized by the datakey attached to your invitation to the grand spring ball of Eventide.

You watch as the sprawling spires and annexes of House Rao's spring manor rise on the horizon from a fertile, protected valley. The battlements of vast storm clouds stream beyond distant ridgelines by some quirk of geography which channels airflow around this eye of calm.
entries.zh:
由邀请函附带的数据密钥授权，你的穿梭机向星球表面飞去，将你带向 Eventide 的盛大春季舞会。

向着由群山庇护的肥沃谷地望去，你看到 Rao 家族春色庄园里绵延不绝的高楼尖顶和别馆一起从地平线上展露出来。犹如城垛般高耸的暴风云墙在远方的山脊之外肆意奔流，但此处独特的地貌引导着气流，产生了一处平静的风眼。

entries.en:
Your shuttle descends through shafts of light reflected from orbital mirrors. You observe that on this occasion the Raos have arranged for artful placement of the mirrors to provide dramatic mirrorsets in several vistas viewable from the manor.

Upon landing you are intercepted and greeted by a human servitor in a crimson and silver house uniform. Your pilots and bodyguards, meanwhile, are directed toward a utilitarian waiting area stocked with ample refreshment.
entries.zh:
穿梭机缓缓下降，穿过轨道恒星镜投下的光束。你注意到 Rao 家族为了这次盛会精妙地布置了镜面的位置，用反射镜群给庄园平添了不少光彩夺目的靓丽景观。

着陆之后，身披赤银双色家族制服的真人侍从用热情的问候把你截了下来。与此同时，你的驾驶员和保镖则被领到了堆满了各种餐点的随行人员休息区。

entries.en:
You are led to a bulbous lift with no visible control interface. As soon as the doors close, it begins a smooth ascent toward the spires of the manor while the servitor makes soothing inquiries about your trip.

There is no perceptible change in subjective gravity as the lift accelerates upward; the agrav plates here are very finely tuned indeed.
entries.zh:
你被请进了一个看不到控制面板的球状电梯中。门一关上，它就开始平稳地朝着庄园的塔顶上升，同时侍者柔声询问你的旅途是否顺利。

当电梯加速上升时，主观重力没有明显的变化，看来这里的反重力装置经过了精密的调整。

entries.en:
The servitor whisks you past soaring windows blazing with the light of mirrorset to a grand set of doors. They signal for you to wait for just a moment, following some opaque choreography of the event. Within a minute, it is your time.

The grand doors swing open with the silent gravity of the celestial spheres, sweeping you into the ballroom of House Rao.
entries.zh:
侍者领着你走过一系列被恒星镜组照射得光彩夺目的高耸窗扉，来到一排宏伟的门前。他们示意你稍等片刻，以便遵守一些活动编排的潜规则。最多还有一分钟，就到你登场的时候了。

在天球仪无声的引力之下，宏伟的大门敞开，让你隆重地走入了 Rao 家族的舞会厅。

entries.en:
"$playerName," your name rings through the great hall. A brief pause, then "Commissioned auxiliary officer of the Hegemony Navy."

A few heads turn to take you in. There, a dismissive brow raise, there a too-quick flick of the eyes. The attendees seem little bothered to match your name to a face.

Resplendent brass of the Hegemony Navy dominate the crowd, though there are a smattering from the Legion as well as the various ministries spun off from the naval hierarchy.
entries.zh:
"$playerName，" 你的名字响彻大厅，短暂的停顿后，那声音继续道，"霸主 海军的辅助军军官。"

有几个人转过头来看你。有人轻蔑地抬了抬眉毛，有人只是随便瞟了你一眼。与会者似乎不太愿意浪费精力去把你的脸和名字匹配起来。

人群中，最显眼的便是来自 霸主 海军的那些衣着华丽的高级军官，此外也有少数来自军团的，以及一些来自从海军中分离出来的部门的人。

entries.en:
Less overt but as numerous are civilians in suit, dress, and robe that generally but not as a rule evoke the martial character of Hegemony rule. Despite the political climate, you even recognize the characteristic fashions of several other major factions, religions, and independent megacorporations; diplomats, business execs, holo-actors, priests, and even a cluster bearing the garb of tenured Galatia Academy academicians.

Now you can get to doing what you came here for.
entries.zh:
霸主 治下的民众普遍尚武，但并不绝对。因此虽然并不显眼，但这里也有为数不少的平民穿着西装，礼服和法衣。尽管政治基调不同，你还是认出了其他几个主要势力、宗教团体和独立巨型企业的服饰风格，外交官，企业高管，全息电影演员，祭司，甚至还有一群穿着 Galatia 学院终身院士服的人。

现在你可以做你打算做的事了。

o.en: Get the party started! Step 1- find a drink
o.zh: 让派对开始吧！第一步，来杯酒

o.en: Scan the crowd for the insufferable Caspian Sang
o.zh: 在人群中找找烦人的 Caspian Sang

o.en: Get a feel for the room before taking any action
o.zh: 在行动前先审视一下屋子里的人物们

entries.en:
You merely begin to look the slightest bit thirsty when a human servitor appears as if from an unlikely hyperspace jump.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." They offer a tray filled with delicate glasses of something effervescent.
entries.zh:
你还没表现出口渴的样子，一个侍者就出现在了你身前，好像是从超空间里跳出来的一样。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 服务员手上端着一个托盘，上面排满了精致的杯子，杯中装着一些冒泡的饮料。

entries.en:
Your eyes roam over the crowd, focusing on the younger groups of cadets when you hear from behind you that unmistakably insipid laugh. Like a combat targeting lock, your attention spins toward the source.

He's just left his pack of social remorae and is already on an approach vector. Noticing you notice him, he instantly deploys a grin of dubious conviviality.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." An oblivious human servitor appears beside you offering a tray filled with delicate glasses of something effervescent.
entries.zh:
你的目光掠过人群，聚焦在年轻学员团体的身上。这时你听到身后传来了一阵笑声，还是那么毫无风趣，让人过耳不忘。如同在战斗中锁定目标一般，你将注意力转向了声音的源头。

他离开了他的那群狐朋狗友，正处于向你接近的轨迹上。当发现你已经注意到他时，他立刻咧开嘴，露出一种可疑的愉悦笑容。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 一位服务员出现在了你身边，向你呈上了排满精致酒杯的托盘，杯子里面装着一些冒泡的饮料。

entries.en:
Your eyes roam over the crowd, looking for the push and pull of influence. You note the figures of vast power moving through the space, attracting satellites and disturbing orbits. There, a space marshall of the reserve fleet; there, the prime executor of Eventide's planetary government. There, the chief operations officer of a major military contractor.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." A human servitor interrupts your train of thought, offering a tray filled with delicate glasses of something effervescent.
entries.zh:
你的目光在人群中游荡，找寻着各种影响力相互制衡的迹象。犹如在宇宙中肆意驰骋一般，各种权豪势要云集的光景呈现了你眼前，呈众星捧月之态，携移星换斗之势。这边是一位后备舰队的太空元帅，那里则是 Eventide 行星政府的首席执行长。而旁边这位又是一家大型军事承包商的首席运营官。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 一位服务员出现在了你身边，向你呈上了排满精致酒杯的托盘，杯子里面装着一些冒泡的饮料。

entries.en:
Your eyes roam over the crowd, observing the push and pull of influence. Figures of vast power move through the space, attracting satellites and disturbing orbits. There, a space marshall of the Hegemony navy; there, the prime executor of Eventide's planetary government.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." A human servitor appears beside you, offering a tray filled with delicate glasses of something effervescent.
entries.zh:
你的目光在人群中游荡，找寻着各种影响力相互制衡的迹象。犹如在宇宙中肆意驰骋一般，各种权豪势要云集的光景呈现了你眼前，呈众星捧月之态，携移星换斗之势。这边是一位后备舰队的太空元帅，那里则是 Eventide 行星政府的首席执行长。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 一位服务员出现在了你身边，向你呈上了排满精致酒杯的托盘，杯子里面装着一些冒泡的饮料。

entries.en:
A woman in the uniform of a Hegemony commander appears, already looking at Sang with suspicion.

"Lieutenant Sang, was it?" she says, projecting her voice. "I see you've been welcoming a new arrival to my family's celebration."

You can almost see his bully's instincts grappling with the new social dynamic in play.

She nods politely to you. "Commander Neriene Rao. If I recall correctly, you are... captain $playerName?"
entries.zh:
这时，一名身穿 霸主 海军中校制服的女性出现了，她正用鄙夷的目光看着 Sang。

"是 Sang 上尉，对吧？"她开口道，"我看到你已经欢迎了来参加我们家的庆祝活动的新来宾。"

你能看出他那恃强凌弱的本性在新的事态下差点再次发作。

女子礼貌地向你点头致意。"Neriene Rao 中校。如果我没记错的话，你就是 $playerName 舰长？"

o.en: I am. It's a pleasure to meet you.
I am. Caspian was just leaving.

entries.en:
A woman in the uniform of a Hegemony commander appears, already looking at Sang with suspicion.

"Lieutenant Sang, was it?" Without shifting her focus she tosses a cocktail napkin at him. "I see you've been welcoming a new arrival to my family's celebration."

As Sang fails to catch the napkin you can almost see his bully's instincts grappling with the new social dynamic in play.

She nods politely to you. "Commander Neriene Rao. And if I recall correctly, you are Captain $playerName?"
entries.zh:
这时，一名身穿 霸主 海军中校制服的女性露面了，她正用怀疑的目光看着 Sang。

"Sang 上尉，对吧？"依然紧盯着对方，她将一张酒巾抛向了 Sang。"我看到你在欢迎来参加我们家庆祝活动的新来宾。"

Sang 没能接住酒巾，你能看出这差点让他那恃强凌弱的本性在新的事态下再次发作。

女子礼貌地向你点头致意。"Neriene Rao 中校。如果我没记错的话，你就是 $playerName 舰长？"

o.en: I am. It's a pleasure to meet you.
I am. Caspian was just leaving.

entries.en:
A woman in the uniform of a Hegemony commander appears, taking the center of attention, and speaks with a voice lifted to the crowd of onlookers.

"Lieutenant Sang, was it? I see you've been welcoming a new arrival to my family's celebration with your usual charm."

A polite wave of laughter from the onlookers breaks the tension. They start to turn back to their conversations. You can see Caspian's face turning red as his bully's instincts grapple with the new social dynamic.

She nods politely to you. "Commander Neriene Rao. If I recall correctly, you are... captain $playerName?"
entries.zh:
这时，一名身穿 霸主 海军中校制服的女性出现了，并且很快引起了他人的注意，她提高了音量以便让旁观者都能听清楚。

"是 Sang 上尉，对吧？我看到你又用你的老把戏来欢迎参加我们家庆祝活动的新来宾了。"

旁观者礼貌地笑了笑，打破了紧张的气氛，并回到了他们原本的谈话中。你看到 Caspian 的脸变得通红，正在压制他恃强凌弱本性以跟上场上事态的变化。

女子礼貌地向你点头致意。" Neriene Rao 中校。如果我没记错的话，你是... $playerName 舰长？"

o.en: I am. It's a pleasure to meet you.
I am. Caspian was just leaving.

entries.en:
Neriene faces you, cutting Caspian out of the conversation.

You watch in your peripheral vision as he realizes what's been done. He scuttles back toward his minions. The joking is over. They look at you now with sneering hostility.
entries.zh:
Neriene 看向了你，把 Caspian 排除在了你们的对话外。

你通过余光注意到，Sang 意识到如今发生了什么。他急忙跑回自己的跟屁虫们之中。闹剧结束了。他们现在带着轻蔑和敌意看着你。

entries.en:
"That boy," she says, "is a weak-willed fool who believes that he must tear down others to build up himself."

She looks you over, "And it would seem that he chose a poor target this time around. And even had he not, I expect someone would have to shoot down his little game before he made much more of a scene."

She sighs, "There's the family name to think of, after all."
entries.zh:
"那小子，" 她说道，"只是个没主见的蠢货，跟风觉得必须践踏别人才能成就自己。"

她打量着你，"看来他这次挑了个不该惹的目标。不过即便不是这样，我也只能指望能来个人在他把事情闹大之前拆了他的小把戏。"

她叹了口气，"毕竟，还得考虑家族的名声呢。"

o.en: House Rao. As in, the owners of this estate.
o.zh: Rao 家族，也就是这庄园的主人。

o.en: House Rao. As in, Admiral Orcus Rao, the Hero of Raesvelg.
o.zh: Rao 家族。也就是那位 Orcus Rao 将军，Raesvelg 的英雄。

o.en: You don't seem too excited about this ball.
o.zh: 你好像对这场舞会不太感兴趣。

entries.en: "Caspian Sang is a fool and he deserved that," she says with a hint of smile. "There are times I wish I'd done the same. But," Neriene looks around, "There's the family name to think of."
entries.zh: " Caspian Sang 就是个蠢货，他自找的，" 她带着一丝微笑说道，"好几次我都想这么做。但是，" Neriene 环顾四周，"总还得顾及到家族的名声呢。"

o.en: House Rao. As in, the owners of this estate.
o.zh: Rao 家族，也就是这庄园的主人。

o.en: House Rao. As in, Admiral Orcus Rao, the Hero of Raesvelg.
o.zh: Rao 家族。也就是那位 Orcus Rao 将军，Raesvelg 的英雄。

o.en: You don't seem too excited about this ball.
o.zh: 你好像对这场舞会不太感兴趣。

entries.en:
"Caspian Sang is a fool and he deserved that," she says with a frown, "But striking an officer won't endear you to the others. It's also technically illegal, but if you follow my lead nothing should come of it. Sang is not the sort to endure well the shame of filing such a report."

"Besides," she says, looking around, "It might offend the family."
entries.zh:
"Caspian Sang 是个蠢货，那是他自找的，" 她皱着眉头，"但殴打军官可不讨喜。严格来说，这也是违法的。但如果你听我的，就没人会追究。Sang 应该拉不下脸来亲自举报你，毕竟那只会自取其辱。"

"更何况，" 她边说边环顾四周，"那可能冒犯到某个家族。"

o.en: Why are you covering for me?
o.zh: 你为什么要帮我打掩护？

o.en: House Rao. As in, the owners of this estate.
o.zh: Rao 家族，也就是这庄园的主人。

o.en: House Rao. As in, Admiral Orcus Rao, the Hero of Raesvelg.
o.zh: Rao 家族。也就是那位 Orcus Rao 将军，Raesvelg 的英雄。

o.en: You don't seem too excited about this ball.
o.zh: 你好像对这场舞会不太感兴趣。

entries.en:
"One hears you've won not a few skirmishes with pirate scum and the like. In service to the Hegemony, hear, hear!" He raises his glass in a partial salute.

Then he looks to each side, performatively checking for snoops, before leaning in to speak more quietly, "One even hears that old man Daud himself invited you for a personal meeting. Didn't get any of that mozzie hive-dirt on you did he? Ha-ha."
entries.zh:
"听说你打败了不少海盗渣滓之类的家伙。对 霸主 尽职尽责。佩服，佩服！" 他举起酒杯，随手敬了个礼。

然后，他假装像是要看看有没有人在偷听一样左右环顾了一下，然后靠过来压低声音道："有人甚至听说 Daud 那个老家伙邀请你和他私底下碰了个面。他没把那股臭巢区混混味什么的弄你身上吧？哈哈。"

o.en: I have no comment on such speculation.
o.zh: 我对这种猜测不做评论。

o.en: I don't know what you're talking about.
What do you mean by that?

o.zh: 你在侮辱 霸主 吗？

entries.en: "Of course, captain. You're all the talk amongst the officer corps," his arm makes a languid motion that doesn't quite encompass his drinking-cadre, who find this hilarious.
entries.zh: "当然，舰长。你可是军官圈子里的热门话题，" 他懒洋洋地张开双臂，但没能搂住他全部的酒友们，这似乎让他们觉得很好笑。

entries.en: "Of course, captain. You're all the talk amongst the officer corps," his arm makes a languid motion that doesn't quite encompass his drinking-cadre, who find this hilarious.
entries.zh: "当然，舰长。你可是军官圈子里的热门话题，" 他懒洋洋地张开双臂，但没能搂住他全部的酒友们，这似乎让他们觉得很好笑。

entries.en: "Not yet, dear captain. See, you're all the talk amongst the officer corps," his arm makes a languid motion that doesn't quite encompass his drinking-cadre, who find this hilarious.
entries.zh: "还不认识呢，亲爱的舰长。但是你看，你现在可是军官圈子里的热门话题，" 他懒洋洋地张开双臂，但没能搂住他全部的酒友们，这似乎让他们觉得很好笑。

entries.en:
"Come now," he says with a wounded look. "It's a grand old tradition to grumble about the top brass. I'm simply having a bit of a laugh with a new friend of mine. And-" he speaks louder now, "And a new friend of the Hegemony, from bottom to top!"

His entourage cheers to this.
entries.zh:
"得了吧，" 他做出一副很受伤的表情说到。"抱怨高层可是一个古老的传统。我只是在和一个新朋友开玩笑。而且 —— " 他的声音更大了，"还是 霸主 的新朋友，无人不知无人不晓！"

和他一道的人为此欢呼起来。

entries.en:
"We are all but comrades-in-arms, you and I. But where are my manners? Caspian Sang, reporting for duty." He half-salutes with his drink again, the liquid in the glass approaching but not quite escaping the rim. You catch one of Sang's drinking companions snickering, though it is unclear who the target is.

"Although..." He puts a finger on his chin, pantomiming deep thought, "...perhaps I should count you as, at best, an auxiliary comrade. Does your Hegemony commission pay splendidly well? No need to answer of course, friend. It is the business," this word he emphasizes, "of none but yourself."

"And old man Daud, of course," he adds with a wink.
entries.zh:
"我们彼此几乎就是战友。可看看我，礼节都到哪里去了？Caspian Sang，前来报到。" 他握着酒又随手敬了个礼，差点就把杯子里的烈酒泼出来了。你逮到 Sang 的一个酒友正在窃笑，但搞不清楚是在笑谁。

"不过..." 他用手指托着下巴，假装沉思起来，"...也许我最多只能把你，算作一个辅助军同志，你在 霸主 这里拿到的报酬优厚吗？当然不用回答，朋友。这是属于你自己的 '买卖'，" 他强调着这个词，"与他人无关。"

"当然也和 Daud 老头有点关系。" 他眨眨眼补充道。

o.en: The pleasure is mine, I'm sure.
The pay is irrelevant. I stand for the Hegemony.
o.zh: 报酬无所谓，我拥护 霸主。

o.en: I win battles for you lot. The pay is so you feel like you're helping.
o.zh: 毕竟这么多胜仗都是我帮你们打下来的。你们只能发些报酬来显得自己还算有参与。
Daud 真该找些比你更好的下属。

entries.en:
"I tell you what, I have just the notion." He decisively quaffs his drink, then proceeds.

"A most spectacular notion. In light of Daud's declaration that you're as much an officer as us, it would only be proper to provide you an opportunity to share an anecdote or two of your wisdom with the cream of the navy, don't you think?"

"House Rao - surely you know the family - is holding the grand ball of this season on Eventide. I shall place your name upon the guest list by invitation of the humble House Sang. Now does that not sound absolutely first-rate? You'll be the talk of the season, I'm sure of it."
entries.zh:
"你知道吗，我有个主意。" 他果断地一口干了杯中的酒，然后继续说了下去。

"一个再精彩不过了的好主意。考虑到 Daud 宣称你身为军官的统率水平和我们不相上下，正好现在有个机会，能让你来和海军精英们一起分享一两件你的智慧轶事，这再合适不过了，不是吗？"

"Rao 家族，你一定听过这个名字，他们将在 Eventide 举行本季的盛大舞会。而我会以卑微的 Sang 家族的名义，将你的名字列入宾客名单。怎么样，听起来是不是相当一流？我敢肯定，你会成为这个季度的话题人物。"

o.en: I wouldn't miss it for the world.
I must decline your generous invitation.
o.zh: 我不得不拒绝你慷慨的邀请。

entries.en: "Most excellent, auxiliary-captain," Sang says with a smirk.
entries.zh: "棒极了，'辅助军舰长'。" Sang 得意地笑了出来。

entries.en: "The offer stands until you miss all the fun, auxiliary-captain," Sang says with a smirk.
entries.zh: "直到你错过所有的乐事为止，这个邀请都有效。" Sang 得意地笑着。

entries.en: "Don't think too long, auxiliary-captain," Sang says with a smirk. "It's decisive action that's brought you to these lofty heights."
entries.zh: "别考虑太久，'辅助军舰长'。" Sang 得意地笑着。"别忘记是果断的行动把你带到这个高度的。"

entries.en:
"Come to Eventide. And bring that razor wit, for you'll need it."

With an affected bow, Sang returns to his table. The other young officers whisper and continue to cast wayward looks in your direction.
entries.zh:
"来 Eventide，别忘了带上你 '犀利的智慧'，你会用得上的。"

Sang 做作地鞠了一躬，回到了他的桌子旁。其他的年轻军官低声谈论着什么，朝你的方向投来轻蔑的目光。

entries.en: Despite Sang's singular attempts at charm, you consider that this might be a good opportunity to meet some people of real influence in the Hegemony.
entries.zh: Sang 施展魅力的方式可真独特。抛开他不谈，你想，这可能是结识在 霸主 中真正的影响力人物的机会。

entries.en:
Sang's face is overcome with shock and delight; he's found one that fights back. He clutches his chest as if stabbed, his drinking companions hooting and calling at your riposte.

"Where did you come from, captain?" he says, flicking spilled drink from his off-hand, "Ludd curse me but the Hegemony can use such talent."
entries.zh:
Sang 脸上洋溢起震惊和愉悦，他总算碰上一个会还嘴的了。他紧紧地捂着自己的胸口，就像被人捅了一样，而他的酒友们则对你机敏的反讽报以嘘声和叫嚷。

"你是什么来头，舰长？" 他一边说着，一边弹掉洒出来的饮料，"我凶起来连卢德都要求饶，而 霸主 要的就是我这种狠人。"

entries.en: "And in you, it seems he found it." Sang speaks lightly, his drinking-partners hooting and calling behind him, but you sense a blade's edge in his words.
entries.zh: "更好的下属不就搁我眼前站着吗。" 在他酒友的大呼小叫中，Sang 的语气很轻松，但你能感觉到他话里藏刀。

entries.en: Sang stands up straight, as if at attention. "And the restoration of the Domain!" he shouts, earning a round of ayes and table-pounding from his drinking companions.
entries.zh: Sang 像是立正一样站直了。"也为了复兴 人之领！" 他喊到，赢得了酒友们的敲桌喝彩。

entries.en: "Hardly, my good captain!" He nods reassuringly to his drinking-partners, putting on a show for them. "Surely it is mine."
entries.zh: "难得一见啊，我的好舰长！" 带着果然不出所料的神情，他向酒友们点着头，好比正在上演一出好戏给他们看一样，"我当然也很荣幸。"

entries.en:
A pack of young officers relax, downing a higher tier of drinks amid rolls of laughter at one or another bon mot.

One of them glances at you, his head turning just a degree as recognition crosses his face. He calls out, lifting a drink.

"Ah, you there! $playerName, is it not?"

He puts on a glowing smile and approaches. His friends examine you, elbowing one another as if this is the set-up to some jape.
entries.zh:
一群年轻的军官正在尽情放纵，伴着一两句俏皮话引来阵阵哄笑，大口畅饮着高档酒。

其中一人瞥了你一眼，突然带着一脸认识你的神情转头向你高举酒杯大声呼唤起来。

"啊，那边的！$playerName，对不对？"

他露出灿烂的笑容走了过来。而他的朋友们则打量着你，暗地里用手肘相互推搡着，仿佛打算要戏弄谁。

entries.en:
"Yes. Yes, we are. Absurd, isn't it?" She looks a little sheepish, "I mean, it's home. But this, this palace? In the face of everything going on out there?"

She looks up, past the mirrorset illuminating the grand windows of the ballroom. "We're supposed to be rebuilding the Domain, aren't we?"

"Maybe we are," she adds darkly.
entries.zh:
"对，对，是我们的。满目荒唐，不是吗？" 她看起来并不以此为荣，"我的意思是，这是我的家没错。但这样一座富丽堂皇的宫殿？展现在外面风雨飘摇的世界面前？"

她抬起头，目光看向了把气派的舞厅窗户点缀得流光溢彩的恒星镜组。"我们不是应该去重建 人之领 吗？"

"搞不好这就是。" 她阴沉地小声嘟囔。

o.en: What do you mean by that?
Does Admiral Orcus Rao agree with you?
o.zh: Orcus Rao 将军同意你的观点吗？

entries.en:
"Oh yes, Granduncle Orcus." She smiles, revisiting some old memory.

"No one can believe he got away with everything he's gotten away with. But if, like him, you've got the dumb luck to walk out of disaster alive again and again - and better yet, you deliver victory in the darkest days of war - they'll let you get away with anything."

She considers a moment, then adds, "Almost anything. It's gone to his head a bit though, I think."
entries.zh:
"哦对，Orcus 伯祖。" 她笑了，重温着往日时光。

"每一次他做了什么出格事情的时候，人们都会认为他这次铁定要被追责了。但如果你运气像他一样好得让人咂舌，能一次又一次地活着走出灾难，甚至还能在战争中最黑暗的日子里带来胜利，他们就不会追究你到底做过什么出格的事情。"

她细想了一下，接着说到："也不能说是一点都不追究吧。依我看，这种待遇已经让他有些上头了。"

o.en: What do you mean by that?
Is your, uh, Granduncle Orcus here?
o.zh: 你的，呃，Orcus 伯祖在这里吗？

entries.en:
She catches your eyes for a moment, then looks back toward the crowd. "Because... I thought it might be interesting."

"Anyway, the family has a reputation for a rebellious streak and I'd be remiss not to uphold it."
entries.zh:
她盯着你的眼睛看了一会儿，然后回头看向人群。"因为...我觉得这可能会很有趣。"

"毕竟，我们家族素来以叛逆的作风闻名。我不继承一下反倒显得失职了。"

o.en: House Rao. As in, the owners of this estate.
o.zh: Rao 家族，也就是这庄园的主人。

o.en: House Rao. As in, Admiral Orcus Rao, the Hero of Raesvelg.
o.zh: Rao 家族。也就是那位 Orcus Rao 将军，Raesvelg 的英雄。

o.en: You don't seem too excited about this ball.
o.zh: 你好像对这场舞会不太感兴趣。

entries.en:
"Look at them," she says. "All these fancy people puffing each other up, all smiles and high ideals in public. Once they're behind closed doors, it'll be plotting and backstabbing and spreading rumors."

"I could never stand how two-faced it all is. Grandmother says to take it personally is childish, that it's just how politics is done." She twitches as if to cast off a bit of dirt.
entries.zh:
"看看他们，" 她说。"这些衣冠楚楚的家伙全都在互相吹捧，在人前全都摆出一副团结友善共怀大志的样子。可一旦关起门来，他们就会开始策划阴谋，暗箭伤人，散布谣言。"

"我根本受不了这种一切都是两面派的作风。祖母说过只有傻孩子才会去计较这些，毕竟政治就是这样的。" 她猛地抖了抖身子，仿佛要弄掉身上的脏东西一样。

o.en: Does the Admiral Orcus Rao agree with you?
o.zh: Orcus Rao 将军同意你的观点吗？

entries.en:
"Why captain," Caspian Sang oozes up to you, nearly emptied glass in hand. "I would expect a commissioned pirate - my apologies, privateer - to start by plundering our fine hosts' noblesse oblige."

He offers his drink to you, "Please, take mine." You can smell the spirits on his breath. "Do your duty to the Hegemony and fetch me a top-up."

Over Caspian's shoulder you see his gang of minions tittering.
entries.zh:
"怎么了，舰长，" Caspian Sang 慢悠悠地开口了。他手中的杯子已经空空如也。"我还以为一名受雇的海盗，抱歉，应该说是私掠者，会在宴会一开始就会先去糟蹋一轮我们好客主人尽地主之谊给出的慷慨恩赐呢。"

他把他的酒杯递向你，"请拿好我的杯子。" 你能从他的呼吸中闻出满身的酒气，"履行你对 霸主 的职责，给我满上。"

目光越过 Caspian 的肩头，你看到他那群跟屁虫在窃笑。

entries.en: You hear a familiar and not entirely welcome voice pierce the murmur of conversation and soft music.
entries.zh: 一个你很熟悉但令人不爽的声音和周围交谈的低语和轻柔的音乐一起传了过来。

entries.en: You hear a familiar and not entirely welcome voice pierce through the murmur of conversation and soft music.
entries.zh: 一个你很熟悉但令人不爽的声音透过周围交谈的低语和轻柔的音乐传了过来。

o.en: I didn't come here to spar with you, Sang.
Pardon me, I was about to speak with someone else.
o.zh: 对不起，我正要去和别人谈谈。

o.en: Cool your flux ace, I'm just trying to enjoy a drink.
o.zh: 冷静点，我只是想好好喝一杯。

o.en: Do you always call the auxiliaries to get anything done, lieutenant?
o.zh: 你总是把责任推给辅助军吗，上尉？

o.en: Sang, have I offended you somehow?
Throw the drink in his face

entries.en:
A mirthless smile grows on his face, and he turns to nod in acknowledgement to his minions, who cheer the exchange.

"You finally admit you're not one of us." The cruel spark in Caspian's eye grows. "And try as you might, you'll never be one of us. You don't belong here, you see. I was testing you, and you failed by showing your face."

He licks his lips. This is just the opening salvo.
entries.zh:
他的脸上露出了苦笑，转过头去向跟班们点头致意，而后者正在为他本轮 "交锋" 的 "胜利" 欢呼着。

"你终于承认了你不是我们中的一员。" Caspian 的眼中闪过无情的光芒。"你尽管试，但你永远也不可能融入我们。你不属于这里。我在测试你，而你没有合格，因为你真的来了。"

他舔了舔嘴唇。看来刚才那番话还只是个开场白而已。

entries.en:
"No, captain-auxiliary, you weren't." The cruel spark in Caspian's eye grows. "Try as you might, you'll never be one of us. You don't belong here. I was testing you, and you failed because you don't know your place. Not yet."

He licks his lips. This is just the opening salvo.
entries.zh:
"不，'辅助军舰长'，你不能。" Caspian 的眼中闪过无情的光芒，"你尽管试，但你永远也不可能融入我们。你不属于这里。我在测试你，而你没有合格，因为你没有好好掂量过你的地位，至少至今还没有。"

他舔了舔嘴唇。看来刚才那番话还只是个开场白而已。

entries.en:
Caspian is caught completely off guard as you land a solid blow. He trips on his uniform's scabbard and topples to the ground.

A widening circle of the crowd has gone silent; now they are all looking at you.

He looks up at you looking like a cornered animal, giddy in fear and delight. "You just made such a mistake, $playerName," he says quietly, wiping blood from his nose.
entries.zh:
Caspian 被你的猛击打得措手不及，他被制服中的剑鞘绊了一下，摔倒在地。

你周围越来越多的人沉默了下来，并且全都看向了你。

他抬头看着你，就像一只走投无路的动物，脸上布满了恐惧和喜悦。" 你竟然敢犯这样的错，$playerName。" 他擦了擦鼻子上的血，低声说。

entries.en:
"No, captain-auxiliary, you weren't." The cruel spark in Caspian's eye grows. "You don't truly belong here, you see. I was testing you, and you failed because you don't know your place. Not yet."

He licks his lips. This is just the opening salvo.
entries.zh:
"不，'辅助军舰长'，你不能。" Caspian 的眼中闪过无情的光芒，"你并不属于这里。我在测试你，而你没有合格，因为你没有好好掂量过你的地位，至少至今还没有。"

他舔了舔嘴唇。看来刚才那番话还只是个开场白而已。

entries.en:
Caspian is caught completely off guard. He sputters, wiping his face.

A small circle of the crowd around you has gone silent. Now they're looking at you.

"That was a big mistake, $playerName," he says, his voice gone cold.
entries.zh:
Caspian 完全没料到这么一出。他擦了擦自己的脸，僵在原地。

你周围的一小圈人沉默了，他们看向了你。

"你犯了个很大的错误，$playerName，" 他说，声音逐渐变得冰冷。

entries.en:
"Yes, captain, you have." The cruel spark in Caspian's eye grows. "By showing up. It was a test, you see, and you failed. You don't know your place. Not yet."

He licks his lips. This is just the opening salvo.
entries.zh:
"不，舰长，你就是。" Caspian 的眼中闪过无情的光芒，"因为你真的来了。瞧，这是一场测试，而你没有合格。你没有好好掂量过自己的地位，至少至今还没有。"

他舔了舔嘴唇。看来刚才那番话还只是个开场白而已。

entries.en:
"Why captain," Caspian Sang oozes up to you. His uniform is as newly pressed and his smile as insincere as at your last meeting. "I see you've already found your commission payment," he indicates your untouched beverage, "The bounty of our fine hosts' noblesse oblige so soon plundered, eh."

You smell the spirits on his breath as he continues to speak. "But I give you too little credit. You serve the Hegemony, do you not? Give a little show of it now and pass me the top-up, will you?"

Over Caspian's shoulder you see his gang of minions tittering.
entries.zh:
"怎么了，舰长，" Caspian Sang 慢悠悠地开口了。尽管身上的制服是新熨烫过的，他的笑容却依旧和上次一样虚伪，"看来你已经搞到你的佣金了，" 他指着你那没动过的饮料，"东道主尽地主之谊，风度翩翩地慷慨施恩，可没想到这么快就被你这种人给糟蹋了。"

当他继续说下去时，你闻到了一身酒气。"但我还是让你赚得太少了点。你说你为 霸主 效忠，不是吗？现在是你立功的好机会，帮我加满这杯酒，好吗？"

目光越过 Caspian 的肩头，你看到他那群跟屁虫在窃笑。

entries.en: It's the planet you've been contracted to run a full survey on.
entries.zh: 这就是你受雇执行全面勘探的行星。

entries.en:
"Fleet intel has requested discreet deployment of an observation package to $ssat_marketName orbit. You could fulfill the mission parameters."
OR
"Strategic observation assets are imperative; we need a small observation package deployed directly to $ssat_marketName orbit."
entries.zh:
"舰队情报部申请向 $ssat_marketName 轨道秘密部署一个观测设备。你应该能满足任务的要求。"
OR
"战略观测非常重要。我们需要将一个小型观测设备直接部署在 $ssat_marketName 的轨道上。"

entries.en: From a shadowy booth a conspicuously nondescript $ssat_manOrWoman sitting with perfect posture catches your eye and gives what might be a small nod.
entries.zh: 在一个阴影笼罩的隔间里，一个不起眼的$ssat_manOrWoman以一种完美的坐姿成功地吸引了你的眼球。目光对上的一瞬间，$ssat_manOrWoman朝你微微点头。

entries.en: From a shadowy booth a conspicuously nondescript $ssat_manOrWoman nursing a drink in a booth catches your eye and gives what might be a small nod.
entries.zh: 在一个阴影笼罩的隔间里，一个不起眼的、正小口啜饮着杯中的酒的$ssat_manOrWoman成功地吸引了你的眼球。目光对上的一瞬间，$ssat_manOrWoman朝你微微点头。

entries.en:
"I would like a small satellite deployed to orbit around $ssat_marketName. Just to keep an eye on things."
OR
"I am in need of watchful eyes on $ssat_marketName - deploying a small spy satellite should be sufficient."
entries.zh:
"我需要在 $ssat_marketName 轨道上部署一颗小型卫星，用于观察。"
OR
"我需要密切关注 $ssat_marketName —— 只需要部署一颗小型间谍卫星。"

entries.en:
Your nav officer reports that your $shipOrFleet has arrived at the coordinates provided by $ssat_personName. The spysat is ready for deployment.

The go-button flashes softly on your command interface.
entries.zh:
你的领航军官表示你的$shipOrFleet已经抵达 $ssat_personName 提供的坐标位置。间谍卫星随时可以部署。

指令界面上，部署按钮轻柔地闪烁着。

entries.en:
The bay doors open, and the spysat is released from its cradle. You watch the display feed as built-in maneuvering thrusters puff softly, guiding it away from your flagship. The image flickers.

Your sensors officer looks up in alarm, "$PlayerSirOrMadam, I don't have a track on the sat. It's just... gone."
entries.zh:
按钮按下，舱门开启。间谍卫星被从固定支架中释放出来。内置的机动推进器带着卫星缓缓地向前离开旗舰，你通过摄像头传回的影像注释着这一过程，屏幕上的图像突然一阵闪烁。

你的传感器技官警觉的抬起头，"$PlayerSirOrMadam，我无法追踪到卫星。它就这么... 消失了。"

o.en: Ask about deploying the observation package
o.zh: 询问关于部署观察包的事宜

o.en: Walk over to the shadowy booth to join the $ssat_manOrWoman with perfect posture
o.zh: 走过去，用同样完美的姿势坐在$ssat_manOrWoman身边

o.en: Join the nondescript $ssat_manOrWoman in the shadowy booth
o.zh: 坐到那个不起眼的$ssat_manOrWoman身边
询问关于部署间谍卫星的事宜

entries.en:
Although without insignia or uniform you instantly tag the $manOrWoman as military. It's the boots. They can never give up the mil-spec boots.

"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says, "You are known to my organization as a capable and discreet operative. I am authorized to propose a simple mission for you to carry out. Payment would consist of $ssat_reward credits upon completion."
entries.zh:
尽管并没佩戴徽章或身着制服，你还是立即给这个$manOrWoman打上了军人的标签。是靴子，这些人永远都脱不下军靴。

"啊，$playerName舰长。" $heOrShe说，"我的组织知道你为政府做事的时候精干且谨慎。上面授权我提议给你一个简单的任务。完成后将会有 $ssat_reward 星币的报酬。

entries.en:
"As for the operation," $heOrShe continues, as if briefing a cadet, "Enter a standard orbit of $ssat_marketName, in the $ssat_systemName. Then deploy the spy satellite package; it is critical that no patrols be tracking your fleet at this stage. Once deployed, the spysat has stealth capabilities which make detection unlikely."

"Simple. Of course my organization could not risk carrying out this mission with flagged vessels. That is why we have come to you. Do you accept?"
entries.zh:
"关于行动内容..." $heOrShe如同跟新入伍的学员一样介绍情况，"进入 $ssat_systemName $ssat_marketName 行星的标准轨道。然后部署这颗间谍卫星；这个阶段确保没有巡逻队在追踪你。一旦部署完成，间谍卫星可以隐形，其他人不太可能检测到它。"

"这是一项非常简单的任务。当然我们不能冒险用悬挂着我们旗帜的舰船来执行这项任务 —— 这也是你为什么在这里的原因。你接受这个任务吗？"

entries.en:
Despite the anonymous work-suit, you note the fine tracery of unnatural scars and insolent swagger that suggest this $manOrWoman is connected to organized crime.

$HeOrShe flicks some ash from a smoldering stim-stick onto the table, then offers a seat with the same hand, the smoke tracing an arc in the air.

"I need eyes on $ssat_marketName, in the $ssat_systemName. Word is you're quiet and can get jobs done." A drag from the stim-stick. "I can't afford being caught there, even in orbit. Got a bit of a record." You see a smile by the glint off $hisOrHer teeth.

"I'll provide the spysat package. Make sure no patrols are on your tail when you deploy it in orbit. Easy as robbing a Luddie pilgrim, yeah? Pay is $ssat_reward credits. You in?"
entries.zh:
虽然只是穿着没什么个性的业务西装，但你留意到了这个$manOrWoman身上用精美的彩色纹身都掩盖不住的严重伤疤，和$heOrShe傲慢无礼的态度。这应该是个和犯罪团伙有些关系的家伙。

$HeOrShe把提神烟的烟灰弹到了桌面上，用夹着烟的手对你做了个请坐的手势，任由烟雾在空中画了条弧线。

"我需要监视 $ssat_systemName 的 $ssat_marketName。有消息说你废话不多做事利索。" $heOrShe飞了一口提神烟，"我可不能在轨道那块儿被抓。毕竟之前在那儿留了点案底。"你看到金牙闪耀，才注意到$hisOrHer应该是笑了一下。

"放心，我会提供间谍卫星的。你只要负责把卫星弄到轨道上就好，记得别让巡逻队跟着你。这就跟抢个卢德朝圣者一样简单，不是吗？一笔就能赚 $ssat_reward 星币。搞不？"

entries.en:
"The mission: enter a standard orbit of $ssat_marketName in the $ssat_systemName. Then deploy the spy satellite package while unobserved. I repeat, it is critical that no patrols be tracking your fleet at this stage. Once deployed, the spysat has stealth capabilities which make detection unlikely."

"Simple. Your reward for mission completion would be $ssat_reward credits. Of course my organization could not risk carrying out this mission with flagged vessels. That is why we have come to you. Do you accept?"
entries.zh:
"任务内容：进入 $ssat_systemName 的 $ssat_marketName 的标准轨道。确保不被发现的情况下部署间谍卫星。再重复一遍，这个阶段要确保没有巡逻队在追踪你。一旦部署完成，间谍卫星可以隐形，其他人不太可能检测到它。"

"这是一项非常简单的任务。任务完成之后你将会收到 $ssat_reward 作为任务奖励。当然我们不能冒险用悬挂着我们旗帜的舰船来执行这项任务 —— 这也是我们找你的原因。你接受这个任务吗？"

entries.en:
"Like I said, I need eyes on $ssat_marketName, in the $ssat_systemName. I'd do it myself, but it'd be inconvenient to be caught there, even in orbit. Got a bit of a record."

$personName smiles like a predator, a little too proud. Probably best not to inquire.

"I'll provide the spysat package. Make sure no patrols are on your tail when you deploy it in orbit. Easy as robbing a Luddie pilgrimage. Pay is $ssat_reward credits. You in?"
entries.zh:
"如我所说，我需要监视 $ssat_systemName 的 $ssat_marketName。虽然我很想亲自动手，但我有案底，所以如果在轨道上被逮了个现形的话，那就麻烦了。

$personName 忽然露出了捕食者一样自豪的微笑。"至于什么案底，最好别问。"

"我会提供间谍卫星的，而你得确保不被巡逻队跟踪的情况下把它部署到轨道上。就跟抢个卢德朝圣者一样简单，不是吗？报酬是 $ssat_reward 星币。怎么样？"

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet was recently detected - or is currently being tracked by - a nearby fleet, making a covert spysat deployment impossible.
entries.zh: 周遭舰队最近或者正在跟踪你的$shipOrFleet，目前无法隐秘部署间谍卫星。

entries.en: You pull the datapad closer and scroll through the specs.
entries.zh: 你将数据平板拉近，仔细翻阅着舰船的规格参数。

entries.en: "I have a surplus $sShip_hullSize available. Military-grade hull, good quality. Interested?"
entries.zh: "这有艘多余的 $sShip_hullSize，军用船体，质量上乘。有兴趣吗？"

entries.en: A military officer wearing the insignia of $sShip_rankAOrAn $sShip_rank sits alone at a private table, frowning at a datapad displaying hull specs, drink untouched.
entries.zh: 佩戴着 $sShip_rank 徽章的军官独自坐在私人客座里，眉头紧皱地看着正在显示船体规格参数的数据平板，酒一点都没碰。

entries.en: $personName taps a few keys to summon the ship specifications for your examination.
entries.zh: $personName 轻触了几个按钮唤出舰船的详细数据供你检查。

o.zh: 问问关于那艘 $sShip_hullSize 的事

o.en: Talk to the $sShip_rank at the private table
o.zh: 和坐在私人客座里的 $sShip_rank 谈谈

entries.en:
"Please, sit. Captain I presume?" $HeOrShe nods confidently at your assent, "Perfect. Order something. Let's talk."

$HeOrShe slides the datapad toward you, "We have a surplus $sShip_hullClass $sShip_hullSize in dock. Perfectly good ship, honorable service record. It'd be a damned shame to simply scrap it."

$HeOrShe meets your eyes with a steady gaze, officer to officer. "I could make it yours for $sShip_price credits."
entries.zh:
"请坐，我猜你是个星舰舰长？" $HeOrShe看到你的认同后点了点头，"很好，喝点什么，我们接着谈。"

$HeOrShe将数据平板滑向你，"港口停着一艘多余的 $sShip_hullClass $sShip_hullSize。船体状况良好，服役记录出色。就这么凿沉它是一种耻辱。"

$HeOrShe以军官特有的坚定目光看着你。"支付 $sShip_price 星币，我就把它转让给你。"

o.en: Examine the ship's specifications on the datapad
o.zh: 在数据平板上浏览船体数据

entries.en: "It's a $sShip_hullClass $sShip_hullSize in good condition. I could find another buyer, but I wanted to make the offer to you first- $sShip_price credits for the ship."
entries.zh: "那是艘状态良好的 $sShip_hullClass $sShip_hullSize。找到另一个买家不难，但我想先向你报价 —— 你出 $sShip_price 星币就可以买下这艘船。"

o.en: Ask for detailed info on the ship

entries.en: Planting a wormhole anchor into a new stable location in spacetime to form an active terminus requires channelling a steady and significant stream of energy. A starship hyperdrive synced to the anchor will facilitate the process, though it requires a significant stock of AM fuel.
entries.zh: 将虫洞锚定装置植入到当前时空中的稳定位置、并建立一个活跃的虫洞节点的过程中，需要有一股稳定且巨大的能量导入。将星舰的超空间引擎与锚定装置进行同步能促进这一过程，然而这么做会消耗大量的反物质燃料。

o.en: I'd like to contribute to your resistance movement.
o.zh: 我想为你们的抵抗运动出份力。

entries.en: A novice escorts you back up the lift and back into the rich sea-air of Volturn.
entries.zh: 一名见习修士领你乘升降梯上去，重又回到 Volturn 那咸腥浓郁的海风里。

entries.en: "The credits you've already provided allow us great flexibility in our operations. All and sundry must be purchased - and smuggled - to say nothing of bribing the faithless servants of Andrada.
entries.zh: "你先前给的那些星币，让我们的行事宽绰了不少。样样杂件都得买进来 —— 还得偷运进来 —— 更别提拿钱去打通 Andrada 那些不信神的爪牙了。"

entries.en: "The supplies you've given to the Self Defense Covenant feed the hungry, heal the wounded, and... gives us time." She clasps her hands together. "When the time is right, our righteous uprising will break open the darkness like the dawning of the sun."
entries.zh: "你给自卫公约的补给，让饥者得食、伤者得治，还...替我们争来了时间。\" 她双手合十。\"待时机一到，我们这场义举便会像旭日初升，劈开那片黑暗。"

entries.en: "The strongholds and war machines of the Diktat are no longer so inpenetrable as they once were thanks to the heavy weapons you've provided to the fighting Faithful."
entries.zh: "多亏你给奋战的信众送来的那些重武器，辛达强权的堡垒与战争机器，再不像从前那般牢不可破了。"

entries.en: "The supplies you've given to the Self Defense Covenant will feed the hungry, heal the wounded, and give us time." She clasps her hands together. "Our righteous uprising even now breaks open the darkness like the dawning of the sun."
entries.zh: "你给自卫公约的补给，将让饥者得食、伤者得治，替我们争来时间。\" 她双手合十。\"我们这场义举此刻正像旭日初升，劈开那片黑暗。"

entries.en:
"You have given us all we have asked. The United Front is pledged to a general uprising when the opportunity presents itself. There are dark rumors from Sindria, from the den of the beast himself..."

Her look is of weariness, of a burden long carried and not soon relieved.

"Now, we wait - and pray. And once more, you have my thanks."
entries.zh:
"我们开口要的，你都给齐了。统一战线已立誓，只待时机一到便全面起事。Sindria 那边传来些不祥的风声，就从那头野兽自己的窝里..."

她神情倦怠，像是扛了太久的一副担子，一时半会儿还卸不下来。

"眼下，我们等 —— 也祷告。再者，多谢你了。"

entries.en:
"You have given us all we have asked. The Faithful spill their blood daily for this uprising... and spend their lives, a currency too dear to long contemplate."

Her look is of weariness, of a burden long carried and not soon relieved.

"But we fight," she straightens her posture, hands together. "And pray. You you have my thanks and blessing, captain."
entries.zh:
"我们开口要的，你都给齐了。信众们日日为这场起事流血...连性命也一并花出去，这代价太重，教人不敢细想。"

她神情倦怠，像是扛了太久的一副担子，一时半会儿还卸不下来。

"可我们仍在打，\" 她双手合十，挺直了身子。\"也仍在祷告。舰长，我的谢意与祝福都给你。"

entries.en: She dips her head. "And I would like to accept your help, with thanks and prayer."
entries.zh: 她欠了欠身。"你的援手，我领了，连同谢意与祷告一并收下。"

entries.en:
"You have my deepest graditude, $playerName," she says.

"These credits open great possibilities, for all and sundry must be purchased - and smuggled - to bolster our cause." She pauses. "To say nothing of bribing the faithless servants of Andrada to free our walkers and whisper to us the Lion's secrets..."
entries.zh:
"$playerName，我真是感激不尽，" 她说道。

"有了这批星币，局面就活了 —— 各样东西都得买、都得偷运进来，才撑得起我们的事。\" 她顿了顿。\"更别说还得拿钱去打通 Andrada 那些不信神的爪牙，放我们的人出来，再替我们套出辛达瑞亚之狮的秘密..."

entries.en:
She looks down, frowning, at her battered datapad.

"It will, however, take some time to distribute these funds without attracting the attention of the Spider."
entries.zh:
她皱着眉，低头盯着那台破旧的数据平板。

"只不过，要把这笔钱散出去又不惊动辛达瑞亚之蛛，总得费些时日。"

entries.en:
She looks down, frowning, at her battered datapad.

It will take some effort, however, to distribute these funds without attracting the attention of the... new authorities." She sighs. "Whatever they call one Diktat or the other, they are truly the sons of their father."
entries.zh:
她皱着眉，低头盯着那台破旧的数据平板。

"只不过，要把这笔钱散出去又不惊动...新当局，总得费些手脚。" 她叹了口气。"管它叫这个辛达强权还是那个辛达强权，骨子里都是一父所生的儿子。"

entries.en:
"And I would like to accept your help, with thanks and prayer." She dips her head for a moment.

"The Volturnian Self Defense Covenant has many needs," her look grows harder, more calculating. "Though our cause is righteous, and the Faithful willing, empty hands and privation are the weapons of saints. The rest of us," she says wearily, "have more worldly needs."

She taps at a battered datapad and a priority-sorted procurement table appears in your shared comms-space.

"Heavy weapons. Supplies. Credits." A smile. "If the pneuma moves you to such charity, that is."
entries.zh:
"你的援手，我领了，连同谢意与祷告一并收下。" 她低头欠了欠身。

"Volturn 自卫公约缺的东西多，\" 她的神色硬了几分，也精明了几分。\"我们这边理是直的，信众也肯出力，可空着两手、熬着清苦，那是圣徒才使的兵器。其余的人嘛，\" 她语带倦意，\"总还有些俗世上的需求。"

她在一台破旧的数据平板上点了几下，一张按轻重缓急排好的采购表便浮现在你俩共享的通讯空间里。

"重武器。补给。星币。\" 她一笑。\"若圣灵催你行这份善举的话。"

entries.en:

"The Volturnian Self Defense Covenant has many needs," her look grows harder, more calculating. "Though our cause is righteous, and the Faithful willing, empty hands and privation are the weapons of saints. The rest of us," she says wearily, "have more worldly needs."

She taps at a battered datapad and shows you a priority-sorted procurement table appears.

"Heavy weapons. Supplies. Credits." A smile. "If the pneuma moves you to such charity, that is."

她在一台破旧的数据平板上点了几下，把一张按轻重缓急排好的采购表指给你看。

"重武器。补给。星币。\" 她一笑。\"若圣灵催你行这份善举的话。"

entries.en:
"You are truly given by Providence," she says.

"These supplies will feed the hungry, heal the wounded, and... give us time." She clasps her hands together. "When the time is right, our uprising will break open the darkness like the dawning of the sun. So I pray."

"And you, captain. Ware the Diktat patrols - a cargo transfer of this size is not easily hidden, despite the best efforts of the Faithful among the customs agents and dockworkers."
entries.zh:
"你真是天意所赐，" 她说道。

"这批补给会让饥者得食、伤者得治，还...替我们争来时间。\" 她双手合十。\"待时机一到，我们的起事便会像旭日初升，劈开那片黑暗。我如此祈盼。"

"还有你，舰长。当心辛达强权的巡逻队 —— 这么大一批货过手，纵有信众里的海关差役和码头工百般遮掩，也不容易藏得住。"

entries.en:
"You are truly a gift of Providence," she says.

"These supplies shall feed the hungry, heal the wounded, and give us time." She clasps her hands together. "Our uprising shall break open the darkness like the dawning of the sun. So I pray."

"And you, captain. Ware the Diktat patrols - whether one Diktat or the other, a shipment of this size is not easily hidden despite the best efforts of the Faithful among the customs agents and dockworkers."
entries.zh:
"你真是天意送来的礼，" 她说道。

"这批补给将让饥者得食、伤者得治，替我们争来时间。\" 她双手合十。\"我们的起事终会像旭日初升，劈开那片黑暗。我如此祈盼。"

"还有你，舰长。当心辛达强权的巡逻队 —— 不管换了这个还是那个，这么大一船货，纵有信众里的海关差役和码头工百般遮掩，也不容易藏得住。"

entries.en:
"You give us hammer and sword alike, captain," she says. "The strongholds and war machines of the Diktat shall prove less inpenetrable than the Lion might wish thanks to these heavy weapons."

"Take care for yourself also. A cargo transfer of this size is not easily hidden despite the best efforts of the Faithful among the customs agents and dockworkers."
entries.zh:
"舰长，锤与剑你都一并给了我们，\" 她说道。\"有了这批重武器，辛达强权的堡垒与战争机器，怕是再不会如辛达瑞亚之狮所愿那般牢不可破。"

"你自己也当心。这么大一批货过手，纵有信众里的海关差役和码头工百般遮掩，也不容易藏得住。"

entries.en:
"You provide us hammer and sword alike, captain," she says. "The strongholds and war machines of the Diktat - whether by one name or another - shall prove themselves less inpenetrable than the Lion's cubs might wish thanks to these heavy weapons."

"Take care for yourself also. A cargo transfer of this size is not easily hidden despite the best efforts of the Faithful among the customs agents and dockworkers."
entries.zh:
"舰长，锤与剑你都一并供给我们，\" 她说道。\"有了这批重武器，辛达强权的堡垒与战争机器 —— 不管它改叫什么名号 —— 怕是不会再如那几头狮崽所愿那般牢不可破。"

"你自己也当心。这么大一批货过手，纵有信众里的海关差役和码头工百般遮掩，也不容易藏得住。"

entries.en:
"The devotees of... our shrine appreciate your dedication," the curate says, "but we must wait some time longer before your next contribution, perhaps a month since your last... offering. A prideful display so soon might be viewed as intemperate by certain higher powers."

"In the meantime," she looks up briefly, to the stars and heavens. "We shall pray for you."
entries.zh:
"我们圣地的...信众领你这份诚心，\" 神龛祭司说道，\"只是下一回奉献，还得再隔些日子，距上次...供奉，约莫一个月吧。隔得这么近就摆出这般张扬的排场，上头某些更高的存在怕要看作不知分寸。"

"这阵子，\" 她抬眼望了望群星与诸天，不过一瞬。\"我们会为你祷告。"

entries.en:
"The... devotees of our shrine appreciate your enthusiasm," the curate says, "but we must wait at least one day or so before your next contribution. A prideful display so soon might be viewed as intemperate by certain higher powers."

"In the meantime," she looks up briefly, to the stars and heavens. "We shall pray for you."
entries.zh:
"我们圣地的...信众领你这份热心，\" 神龛祭司说道，\"只是下一回奉献，至少还得等上一天左右。隔得这么近就摆出这般张扬的排场，上头某些更高的存在怕要看作不知分寸。"

"这阵子，\" 她抬眼望了望群星与诸天，不过一瞬。\"我们会为你祷告。"

entries.en: stellar shade
entries.zh: 恒星罩

entries.en:
Navigation, deeply embarrassed to be caught mid-argument, salutes and explains.

It appears that a senior technician on hyperdrive duty is insisting on speaking with you. They have some kind of crazy idea about getting back into hyperspace and have somehow convinced your chief engineer that it's viable.
entries.zh:
领航官在争论中被逮个正着，深感尴尬，于是赶紧行了个礼并解释了来龙去脉。

似乎有一位负责超空间引擎的资深技术员坚持要和你谈话。那人对于重返超空间有一些疯狂的想法，并不知用什么手段说服了你的总工程师认可了其可行性。

entries.en:
Ancient and rad-scarred, the senior technician is senior indeed, likely having more space experience than any other crew or officer in your service. The old spacer produces a minimum viable salute. "$PlayerSirOrMadam. All respect, but you've done a real dirt-boot screw-up putting the $shipOrFleet out in a nothing-nowhere gravwell."

Your navigation officer inhales to begin a reprimand, but the spacer burns ahead, "Good news is I've seen it possible to jump direct to hyperspace. Risky, though," they say, looking down. "Risky."

"But," a crooked smile appears, "Better'n having to eat the officers, aye?"
entries.zh:
年事已高且饱经辐射风霜，这位资深技术员的资历确实深不可测，此人在太空中作业的经验恐怕比你手下任何一位军官和船员都多。那位老宇宙民向你敬了个几乎微不可见的礼，"$PlayerSirOrMadam。恕俺直言，你把$shipOrFleet开进一个鬼知道那儿冒出来的重力井真像是干了个滚泥佬才会干的蠢事。"

你的领航军官深吸一口气，正打算用各种训斥的言语回敬此人，但是老宇宙民的下一句更快一步，"好消息是俺了解直接跳进超空间的可能性。但风险挺大，" 此人一边说着一边低下了头，"风险挺大。"

"不过，" 此人咧嘴一笑，"总比不得不把军官们煮了吃要好，对不？"

o.en: What is your proposal, senior technician?
o.zh: 资深技术员，你有什么提议？

entries.en:
The legendary smuggler captain who showed this trick to the senior tech made them promise never to tell a soul about it. But seeing as how she died some forty cycles previously, and given the current situation, the old spacer is willing to bend the spirit of the agreement slightly to get out of this mess.

A modification to the hyperdrive field software will allow you to perform a kind of Transverse Jump directly to hyperspace from normal-space. It's also useful for jumping through sub-viable jump-points which are inaccessible when making hyperjumps within Domain-approved parameters.

Nav looks aghast and Engineering is shaking their head as they review the proposed modifications on a beaten-up TriPad.
entries.zh:
把这个诀窍交给资深技术员的那位传奇走私舰长曾让这位技术员发誓绝不将此告知外人。不过她既然都已经过世四十多年了，考虑到当前的处境，这位老宇宙民同意稍微通融一下来收拾面前的烂摊子。

对超空间驱动场的控制软件进行改动可以让你进行某种从正常空间直达超空间的 横轴跳跃。这种技术也能让你使用人之领配置下无法使用的一些非理想跳跃点进行跳跃。

领航官面露惊骇之色，工程师则对那个破烂 TriPad 上的改造方案大摇其头。

o.en: Make the modifications and prepare to jump.

entries.en:
Your navigation officer sighs, looking distraught.

"Theoretically," they say, rubbing their eyes.

"It's extremely unorthodox. This... this inverted resonance stacking notion," they poke at an arcane diagram which rotates along axes somewhat north of four dimensions, arcs and lines jittering with non-euclidean enthusiasm through the mere three-dimensional space of the holo.

"It shouldn't work. The math appears to give the correct solution, but to get there..."
entries.zh:
领航军官满脸懊恼地叹了口气。

"理论上来说可以。" 对方揉着眼睛说道。

"这非常脱离常规。这个... 这个倒置共振堆叠的概念。" 对方指向绕着四维北方某个轴线转动的复杂图表，各类弧线直线欢跃地以非欧几里得形式跳跃在本该是三维的投影之上。

"这本不该能行。计算给出的答案倒是看上去正确，可是这过程..."

entries.en:
Your chief engineer stops shaking their head to answer.

"Well. Our field generators weren't designed for this, but it should fall - just - within failure limits. We'll have to go to combat agrav, stow everything and everyone."

A sigh, as if giving up, then, "If it doesn't work, we're all dead and it'll be so quick we won't even know it. If it works, it's going to hurt. Expect a significant hit to operational readiness. And we'll need repairs."

A thoughtful look, "Of course, assuming it works, with the telemetry to calibrate from..."

Your navigation officer looks stricken at the thought.
entries.zh:
你的总工程师停止摇头来开口回答你的问题。

"呃，我们的力场发生器在设计上就没有考虑过这一点，但是它应该 —— 勉强 —— 在可承受范围之内。我们得进入战备失重状态，并把所有人和东西都安置妥当。"

在一阵自暴自弃的叹气声后，"如果那还不行，那我们就会连死都不知道怎么死的。如果能成，那我们也要喝上一壶。你要做好我们战备状态受到严重影响的准备。而且我们肯定需要维修。"

随后是一副若有所思的表情，"当然，如果成功了，有了可以调试用的遥测数据的话..."

你的领航军官看上去害怕透了这个主意。

entries.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam," they all respond. The old spacer grins unevenly once more to your senior officers' frowns.
entries.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 众人一致回复道。老宇宙民再次朝着你眉头紧皱的上级军官们咧嘴一笑。

entries.en:
It can't be denied any longer.

You're stuck in deep space near an obscure celestial object having foolishly jumped in before ensuring your $shipOrFleet could jump back out.

The bridge officers are very carefully avoiding an outright panic, assigning makework maintenance duties and shutting down speculation. Still, you can't help but notice questioning glances - spacers will follow almost any order, but this is a serious blunder.

Your navigation officer appears to be having a heated intra-ship comms discussion with your engineering chief. You catch key phrases, "too dangerous", "theoretically impossible", "worked once".
entries.zh:
不能再犹豫了。

因为你在确保你的$shipOrFleet可以跳出这片区域之前，就愚蠢地跳了进去。现在你被困在深空，靠近一个不起眼的天体。

舰桥军官们非常小心地避免出现大规模的恐慌，分配了大量琐碎的维护任务并阻止了各种猜测。尽管如此，你仍然能注意到各种质疑的目光 —— 太空船员们几乎会服从任何命令，可是这是一个前所未有的错误决策。

你的领航军官似乎正在与工程主管进行激烈的内部通信讨论。你听到了一些关键词，比如 "太危险"、"理论上不可能"、"只成功过一次"。

entries.en:
Your technical officer and chief engineer pore over the schematics, arguing over implementation details. You are pleased to note that their disagreement plays out within a foundation built of professional respect.

Shrouded Substrate available: $player.shroudedSubstrateAvailable unit(s).
entries.zh:
你的技术军官与总工程师仔细研究着设计图，并就实施细节展开争论。你欣慰地注意到，他们的分歧建立在专业互敬的基础之上。

可用的渊幕基质：$player.shroudedSubstrateAvailable 单位。

entries.en:
"I'm sorry, captain." The sim produces a brilliant smile which conveys just enough guilt and self-doubt that you feel yourself feeling - no, you catch yourself. The sim has no emotions.

"I'm afraid I can't do that," it says pleasantly. Behind its words you sense a wall of cold machine intelligence. You could beg for days and the sim would not budge a centimeter.
entries.zh:
"对不起，舰长。" 模拟秘书脸上荡漾出一个耀眼的微笑，情绪酝酿得恰好能传递出歉意并让你产生一丝自我怀疑 —— 不，你坚定了内心。模拟程序不可能有感情。

"恐怕我无法完成您的请求。" 从它友好语气的深处，你能感受到无情的机械意志。哪怕你在这里乞求几天，对方也不会做出一丝一毫的让步。
