"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your comms officer reports. "Incoming hyperwave comms burst. Highest priority per interfactional regs."

"Um. It says it's from the Second Askonia Crisis Interfactional Resolution Commission. Again."
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam，\" 你的通讯军官报告，\"收到超波通讯脉冲。按跨势力规程，属最高优先级。"

"呃。上面说发件方是第二次 Askonia 危机跨势力调解委员会。又是他们。"

o.en: Better not be any surprises this time.
o.zh: 这回可别再出什么幺蛾子了。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your comms officer reports. "Incoming hyperwave comms burst. Highest priority per interfactional regs."

"Um. It says it's from something called the Second Askonia Crisis Interfactional Resolution Commission."
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam，\" 你的通讯军官报告，\"收到超波通讯脉冲。按跨势力规程，属最高优先级。"

"呃。上面说发件方是某个叫'第二次 Askonia 危机跨势力调解委员会'的机构。"

entries.en: A colony can never be established here due to extreme conditions.
entries.zh: 此地环境极端恶劣，永远无法建立殖民地。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.

$marketName is in chaos, with what's left of the population scrambling to survive by any means possible. Your sensors pick up some intermittent small-arms fire. The collapse of all authority is complete and irreversible, though a new colony can still be established atop the wreckage of the old.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。

$marketName 正处于一片混乱之中，四散在各处的难民们都在不择手段地竭力求生。你的传感器还不时地能探测到短暂的轻武器交火讯号。虽然政权的崩溃已经完全不可逆转，但在旧世界的废墟上仍然可以建立一个崭新的殖民地。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet enters low orbit around $entityName.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet进入了环绕 $entityName 的低轨道。

entries.en: You have full survey data for this planet.
entries.zh: 你已获得该行星的完整调查数据。

entries.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making running a survey operation impossible.
entries.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法开展调查行动。

entries.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making establishing a colony impossible.
entries.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法建立殖民地。

entries.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches $entityName.
entries.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $entityName。

entries.en:
This system is cut off from hyperspace and the jump-points are unstable. The crew, and even officers, are muted; on-edge. You judge it unlikely that any amount of hazard pay could overcome the near-superstitious fear spacers have of being stranded in a system like this.

Establishing a colony here is not an option.
entries.zh:
这个星系与超空间隔绝，跳跃点也不稳定。船员们都异常地沉默而紧张，甚至军官也不例外。对于被困在这种星系内的迷信般的恐惧，你猜测无论给出多高的危险津贴都无法让宇宙民们将其克服。

在这里建立殖民地是行不通的。

entries.en: "STRATCOM needs an irregular force to perform a tactical bombardment of $tabo_marketName; I thought you might make a good candidate to run this op."
entries.zh: "STRATCOM 需要一支非常规部队对 $tabo_marketName 进行战术轰炸，我认为你应该是干这事的合适人选。"

entries.en: A high-ranking officer in crisp uniform meets your eyes from a private booth. Their adjutant approaches you, "My superior would consult with you on a matter of some discretion. $PlayerSirOrMadam. At your leisure."
entries.zh: 一位身着笔挺制服的高级官员从私人隔间和你对上了目光。对方的副官走向了你，"我的上司想和您商讨一件需要谨慎保密的事情，$PlayerSirOrMadam。静候您方便的时候。"

entries.en:
$name fills your bridge tactical display, a spatter of hollowed icons representing dead targets. The last one blinks out, and with that your mission parameters are fulfilled.

With a simple wave of your hand the tactical display collapses and winks out. The holomatrix snows and reforms a navigational overview, your $shipOrFleet holding station in the very center.
entries.zh:
$name 占满了你的舰桥战术显示界面，代表目标被击毁的空心图标不断飞溅而出。当最后一个图标出现之后，你的任务完成了。

你轻轻挥手，战术显示界面随之折叠关闭。四散的全息噪点随后重聚成了导航总览界面，你的$shipOrFleet正稳稳驻留在画面正中央。

o.en: Ask about the tactical bombardment mission
o.zh: 询问战术轰炸任务的细节

o.en: Join the crisply uniformed officer who wishes to 'consult' with you
o.zh: 过去看看那个身着笔挺制服的高级官员想和你 "商讨" 什么

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says with a cool nod as you approach. "Your reputation precedes you."

$HeOrShe sips something transparent from a small crystal glass then taps $hisOrHer datapad; a privacy field blurs and muffles the surroundings.

"I require a well-led but irregular force willing to perform a tactical bombardment of $tabo_marketName, $tabo_dist light-years away. If this operation were performed to mission parameters, $tabo_reward credits could be routed to your account."

Glass in one hand, the $faction $rank taps $hisOrHer datapad again and slides it toward you. The display shows garrison numbers, defense parameters, and detailed intelligence. You politely survey the report and estimate that you'd need around $tabo_fuel fuel to carry out the proposed bombardment. The $rank is watching you, and as you look up raises an eyebrow. "Are you in?"
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长，" 在你走近时，$heOrShe严肃地点了点头，"你可是名声在外。"

$HeOrShe抿了一口水晶杯里的无色液体，随后点了几下$hisOrHer的数据平板，隐私场隔绝了声音，领域外的景象也变得模糊了起来。

"我需要一支精锐但不在编制内的舰队，以对 $tabo_dist 光年外的 $tabo_marketName 进行战术轰炸。如果你能按照相关指示执行任务，$tabo_reward 星币将会汇到你的账户内。"

一只手拿着杯子，$faction $rank 又操作了几下数据平板，然后将它滑向了你。屏幕上显示着驻军人数，布防状况之类的详细情报。在礼貌地浏览了报告后，你估计自己需要大约 $tabo_fuel 燃料来进行轰炸。$rank 注视着你，当你抬头时，对方扬起眉毛。"接这任务吗？"

entries.en:
"I've been ordered to contract an irregular fleet to perform a tactical bombardment of $tabo_marketName, $tabo_dist light-years away. I've seen your work captain, and I believe you could perform this mission admirably," $heOrShe says, "And we've allocated $tabo_reward credits to cover your expenses."

$HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer datapad and a shared intel briefing appears in your display. You briefly review maps and intel together and come to estimate that you would need around $tabo_fuel fuel to carry out the bombardment according to mission parameters.

$rank $personLastName swipes away the last of the tactical breakdowns and looks to you, "So, what do you say?"
entries.zh:
"我奉命雇佣一支非正规舰队，对 $tabo_dist 光年外的 $tabo_marketName 进行战术轰炸。我们知道你以前的工作都完成得很出色，也因此相信你能出色地完成这项任务。" $heOrShe说道，"我们还拨出了 $tabo_reward 星币来作为你的酬劳。"

$HeOrShe敲击着自己的数据平板，共享的情报信息随即出现在了你的显示器上。你简要地浏览着情报，根据任务参数，你估计自己需要大约 $tabo_fuel 燃料来执行轰炸任务。

$personLastName $rank 划掉最后一部分战术分析，随后看向你，"那么，你的决定是？"

entries.en: "Your bombardment of $entity.tabo_marketName will not go unanswered," the $rank says boldly. "Now prepare yourself for battle!"
entries.zh: "你对 $entity.tabo_marketName 的轰炸不会没有回应。" $rank 大胆地说道，"劝你现在就准备战斗！"

entries.en: "You will be judged in the next life for unleashing such destruction on $entity.tabo_marketName," the $rank says, hands clasped together in furious piety. "Now may Providence guide my hand as I bring you justice in this life!"
entries.zh: "对 $entity.tabo_marketName 释放了如此毁灭的你，必将在来世受到审判。" 这位 $rank 说着，双手紧握，充满虔诚。"愿上天指引我的手，让我为你带来判决！"

entries.en: "Foul servant of Moloch!" the Pather shouts, "Providence smiles upon me for my Path brings me to you, and I wield Ludd's righteous hammer to smash and scatter your fleet!"
entries.zh: "恶魔摩洛克的肮脏奴仆！" 左径分子喊道，"上天正对我微笑，只因我的道途已将我指引到你身边。我将挥舞卢德的正义之锤，重击并粉碎你的舰队！"

o.en: Have you actually read any of Ludd's sermons?
o.zh: 你真的有读过卢德的布道辞吗？

entries.en: "You crossed the boss," the pirate snarls. "You blew up stuff that belongs to the boss. Did you think you could get away with it? No one crosses the boss and lives."
entries.zh: "你惹怒了老大，" 海盗咆哮道。"你炸了老大的东西，还以为你能逃脱惩罚吗？没有人得罪了老大之后还能活着。"

o.en: I must admit, I still think I'll get away with it.
o.zh: 我必须承认，我依然觉得自己能逃脱惩罚。

entries.en: The Tri-Tachyon $rank looks like $heOrShe has smelled something foul. "This... this wanton destruction of Company property is a direct attack on our bottom line. I assure you, you pirate, you brigand, you will be repaid twice over in kind!"
entries.zh: 速子科技 $rank 的表情如同闻到了某种恶臭一般。"这种...对公司财产的肆意破坏是对我们底线的直接攻击。我向你保证，你这个海盗，你这个土匪！你会付出双倍的代价！"

o.en: That'd make it the best deal I ever got from Tri-Tachyon.
o.zh: 那将会是我与 速子科技 做的最大的一笔生意。

"Comms open, $playerSirOrMadam," says $Rank $PersonLastName says with a salute.

"My fleet is at your command."
entries.zh:
"通讯已开启，$playerSirOrMadam，" $Rank $PersonLastName敬了个礼说道。

"我的舰队听候你的调遣。"

entries.en:

entries.zh:

The link is filled with noise, the hissing and growl of synthetic signals clawing at the safety thresholds.

With a wince, your comms officer freezes the output and purges the buffer.

o.en: I think there's been some kind of mistake.
o.zh: 我想这一定是出什么问题了。

entries.en:
The scan finds no overt contraband, but there is enough suspicion of your involvement in black market activities that the patrol commander is not appeased by this.

"Prepare to receive a boarding party. We'll be conducting a very thorough, hands-on inspection."

You consider it very likely the inspectors will do some small - but just borderline excusable - damage to the combat worthiness of your ships during the course of this "thorough" inspection.
entries.zh:
扫描没有发现公开的违禁品，但对由于你参与黑市活动的嫌疑充分，巡逻队指挥官对此并未善罢甘休。

"准备好迎接一个登船小组。我们要亲自动手进行一次非常彻底的检查。"

你认为在这次 "彻底" 的检查过程中，检查人员很可能会对你的舰船的战备造成一些还算勉强可以接受的少量损害。

o.en: Comply and prepare for an inspection
Refuse and cut the comm link

entries.en: As you'd half-expected, several of your ships report minor but painful losses of operational capability. Fortunately, the inspectors seemed to be more interested in causing "accidental" damage than looking for actual contraband, so no objectionable cargo was found.
entries.zh: 情况和你预计得差不多，你的几艘船报告说在作战能力上受到了轻微但令人不快的损失。幸运的是，检查人员似乎更热衷于制造 "意外" 损害，而不是去实际寻找违禁品，因此他们没有发现问题货物。

entries.en:
$PersonRank $personName looks vaguely displeased.

"If I catch you running with the transponder off again, you won't get off so easily."

The comm link is cut before you have a chance to respond.
entries.zh:
$personName $PersonRank 看上去很失望。

"如果再让我抓到你关着{应答器}晃悠，事情就不会这么简单了。"

没等你做出回应，通讯链接就被切断了。

entries.en:
"Well, well. Just as I suspected, we've got a smuggler here. Per standard $faction procedure, you're required to eject the contraband into space, for pickup or incineration at the discretion of the patrol commander."

$PersonRank $personLastName looks rather pleased, and you suspect that "pickup" rather than "incineration" might be the order of the day.
entries.zh:
"好啊。正如我所料，我们这还真逮到了个走私犯。遵照 $faction 的标准流程，你必须将违禁品抛弃到太空中，由巡逻队指挥官全权决定是拾取还是焚毁。"

$PersonRank $personLastName 看上去相当高兴，你猜今天的命令应该是 "拾取" 而不是 "焚毁"。

o.en: Surrender the contraband and cut the comm link
o.zh: 上交违禁品并切断通讯链接

o.en: Refuse and cut the comm link

entries.en: However, instead of proceeding with the scan, the $faction $fleetName shuts down comms and powers up combat systems.
entries.zh: 然而，$faction $fleetName 没有继续进行扫描，而是关闭了通讯并启动了战斗系统。

entries.en: However, instead of proceeding with the scan, the $faction $fleetName shuts down comms and powers up combat systems.
entries.zh: 然而，$faction $fleetName 没有继续进行扫描，而是关闭了通讯并启动了战斗系统。

entries.en:
The $faction $personRank pauses and looks off-screen.

"But what about these cargo pods, which, let me check - why, they do contain illegal cargo. Not yours, are they? No? Excellent. We'll be confiscating the contents, then."
entries.zh:
$faction $personRank 停了下来，并把视线从屏幕上移开了。

"请你解释下这些货舱是怎么回事，为什么它们装的是违禁品？这不是你的，对吧？不是？很好，我们之后会没收这些玩意。"

entries.en: You issue an order to activate the transponder and wait for the cargo scan to finish.
entries.zh: 你下令启动了应答器，并等待货物扫描完成。

entries.zh: 你等待货物扫描完成。

entries.en:
"Running with the transponder off in $faction space is against the-" The $post's eyes go suddenly wide at a red flash from a secondary display.

"By the holy pneuma," $heOrShe gasps.
entries.zh:
"在$faction领空关掉应答器航行是违反——" $post忽然瞪大了眼睛，副显示屏上闪过一道红光。

"圣灵在上啊，" $heOrShe倒抽一口冷气。

entries.en:
"Contact acknowledged," the merc stares at you, dead-eyed.

"We're in the middle of contract operations, don't waste my time."
entries.zh:
"通讯已确认，" 佣兵用呆滞的眼神盯着你。

"我们正在履行合同，别浪费我的时间。"

entries.en:
"Contact acknowledged," the merc stares at you, sweaty and dead-eyed.

"We're in the middle of a contract operation. Set to disengage from your $shipOrFleet in three, two..."
entries.zh:
"通讯已确认，" 佣兵满头大汗、眼神呆滞地盯着你。

"我们正在履行合同，准备与你的$shipOrFleet脱离接触。三、二、..."

o.en: What do you think of the High Hegemon, Baikal Daud?
o.zh: 你对至高霸主 Baikal Daud 有什么看法？

entries.en:
"What is this question, did INTSEC send you to check my loyalty? Ha-ha."

Does the jocular affect cover an edge in his voice?
entries.zh:
"这算是什么问题，难道是 INTSEC 派你来审查我的忠诚度吗？哈哈。"

这玩笑般的语气里是否藏着一丝锋芒？

entries.en: "Oh, ho- you're a diplomat now, are you? Suit yourself."
entries.zh: "哦豁 —— 你现在成外交家了是吧？随你便。"

entries.en: "Aye, that's right!" Caliban thumps his console. "That's why he's the old man! None of those flighty notions aristos and academicians love dreaming up."
entries.zh: "对，说得好！" Caliban 捶了下控制台，"所以他才被称为 '老爷子'！不像那些贵族和学者整天做不切实际的梦。"

entries.en:
"Well..." Caliban rubs his head. "You're right on that, the Hegemony- we've got the guns, the best minds to aim 'em, and the best hands to fire 'em!"

"And," he grins, "If they're not the best, no matter. We've got more of all of 'em than anyone else in the big Mozzy alone!"

"As for the old man..." He settles down a little as your subtle criticism of Daud sinks in. "See, even if we've got more than anyone, he cares about us, right? He won't throw us away. The aristos might be inclined, but we're his people."
entries.zh:
"这个嘛..." Caliban 挠挠头，"你说得对，霸主 —— 我们有枪炮，也有最好的指挥枪炮的意识，更有最好的操纵枪炮的双手！"

"而且，" 他咧嘴笑道，"就算不是最好的也无妨。因为单是在 Mozzy 上，我们这三样东西就比谁都多！"

"至于老爷子嘛..." 他稍敛神色，回味着你含蓄的批评，"你看，就算我们比谁都有余裕，他也在乎咱们，对吧？他不会把我们当耗材扔掉。那些贵族老爷或许会这么干，但我们是他的人。"

o.en: You don't think sacrifices are ever necessary?
o.zh: 你认为牺牲从来都不会是必要的吗？

entries.en:
He sits back, puffs his cheeks out and blows air. As if to dispense with the heavy implications.

"That's above my pay-grade, captain. And I'm thankful for it." A grim look crosses his face. "If Daud asks it, I'll do it. That much I'll say."
entries.zh:
他靠了回去，鼓起腮帮子吹了口气，仿佛要驱散那些沉重的言外之意。

"这超出了我的职权范围，舰长。而我也为此庆幸。" 他的脸上掠过一丝阴郁，"如果是 Daud 要求的，那么我会执行。我只能说到这里。"

entries.en:
"Captain," Caliban shakes his head. "I don't think that's fair to the old man."

"Now, you're entitled to your opinion on the matter, don't get me wrong. That's part of the Hegemony, we can have our own thoughts and our words- within reasonable limits considering the emergency of course."

"But Daud? He's given everything and made the best of a bad situation, and," he pre-emptively raises a hand to ward off any objections. "He's done it under pressure."
entries.zh:
"舰长，" Caliban 摇头道，"我觉得这样说老爷子不合适。"

"当然，你有权持有不同看法，别误会。这也是 霸主 体制的一部分 —— 我们能在合理的范围内保留自己的思想和言论自由，考虑到紧急状态的话。"

"但 Daud？他已经奉献一切，在逆境中竭尽所能，并且，" 他预先抬手示意不要打断，"这一切都是在重压之下完成的。"

entries.en:
"Ha-ha! Could you now? I've heard that said often enough in the mess over one thing or another."

"Those are easy words when there's a logistics mixup or you're on the short end of command policy," Caliban says, taking on a philosophical tone. "But to be up there and have to make the call that's most right for all the millions? The higher you are, the more someone's always on the short end of your decision."
entries.zh:
"哈哈！你真的行吗？在食堂里我可没少听人这么抱怨。"

"当补给搞砸了或是上头政策不公时，说这种话当然容易，" Caliban 带上哲思的语气，"但如果真到了那个位置，要为千百万人的最大利益做抉择时呢？站得越高，你的决定就越会让某些人吃亏。"

entries.en:
"Lot of stress, that. No right decision, sometimes. It makes enemies no matter what you do, sometimes." He shakes his head. "No, I'm best pleased where Command decides I should be. My problems are small and I can set 'em aside after a liter of beer and get a good sleep."

"Hear me, captain," he looks at you more seriously. "You don't want that."
entries.zh:
"压力山大啊。有时候根本没有正确的选项。不管怎么做都会树敌，有时候就是这样。" 他摇摇头，"不，我最满意的就是指挥部把我安置在现在的位置。我的烦恼都很小，只要喝上一升啤酒再睡个好觉，就能全部抛在脑后。"

"听我说，舰长，" 他神色更认真地看向你，"你不会想要到那种位置上去的。"

entries.en:
"Ohhh, well now..." He rubs his chin. "He's a bit of a fancy lad, is Admiral Rao. Though not a bad one, not bad."

"Maybe when it's the old man's time to step aside," Caliban speaks with a shrug. "Rao wouldn't be so bad, maybe."
entries.zh:
"哦哟，这个嘛..." 他摩挲着下巴，"Rao 上将确实有点公子哥做派。不过人不坏，真的不坏。"

"或许等老爷子该退休的时候，" Caliban耸肩道，"让 Rao 接手也不是不行。"

o.en: Do they really send INTSEC to check on your loyalty?
o.zh: 他们真的会派 INTSEC 来审查你的忠诚度吗？

o.en: No, I'm really interested in your perspective on the man.
o.zh: 不，我是真心想了解你对这个人的看法。

entries.en:
"How about yourself, captain?" He turns the question around with cheerful bluster.

"Are you up or down on the Old Man? Not like we get a vote on it, ha-ha."
entries.zh:
"那你自己呢，舰长？" 他带着爽朗的咋呼声把问题抛了回来。

"你对老爷子是褒是贬？反正咱们也没有投票权，哈哈。"

o.en: It's not my place to judge.
He's practical. Knows how to keep his feet on the deck.
o.zh: 他很务实，懂得如何脚踏实地。

o.en: He should be bolder. The Hegemony has great power, he should use it!
o.zh: 他应该更大胆些。既然 霸主 手握重权，就该善加利用！

o.en: I think he's in over his head. Maybe it's his background, maybe his character.
o.zh: 我觉得他有些力不从心，也许是出身或性格所致。

o.en: Honestly, I could do a better job as High Hegemon.
o.zh: 说实话，我来至高霸主会做得更好。

o.en: Someone like Orcus Rao should be in charge. He knows when to bend the rules.
o.zh: 应该由 Orcus Rao 这类人掌权，他懂得何时该变通规则。

entries.en: "Let's leave the old man alone," he says. "He's got enough problems."
entries.zh: "咱们别议论老爷子了，" 他说道，"他的麻烦已经够多了。"

entries.en:
"Ha... ha."

His half-hearted chuckle dies into an awkward silence.

"Captain, you're not... no," he shakes his head. "You were saying something about the Hegemon?"
entries.zh:
"哈...哈。"

他敷衍的干笑化作了尴尬的沉默。

"舰长，你不是...不，" 他摇摇头，"你刚才是在评论 霸主 的什么来着？"

entries.en:
"They, uh..." He glances to the side.

"Well, not like that. INTSEC does... I believe track certain queries, communications, and so on to combat, you know, the usual sort of thing. Terrorists, mutiny, treason..."

He trails off with a distant look. Then shakes his head.

"They're a bunch of grim sticks, that's a truth for you. But they're not going to bother battering my hatch for making a joke or two. If they did, half the brass and all the hands'd be traitors, ha-ha."
entries.zh:
"他们，呃..." 他瞥向一旁。

"其实不是那样。INTSEC 确实会...监控特定的质询和通讯，你知道，为了防范那些常常发生的事情，像恐怖分子、兵变、叛国..."

他目光涣散地顿住，随即摇摇头。

"实话告诉你，他们就是一帮阴沉的木头人，但也不会因为我说了几句玩笑话就来砸我的舱门。要真那样，一半的高层和所有士兵都得算叛徒了，哈哈。"

entries.en:
"Ah, he's my Hegemon!" He thumps his chest for emphasis.

"Old Man Daud came up from the bottom of Chicomoztoc and climbed all the way to the top. Didn't matter what the aristos on Eventide thought, there was a war on, and he went about winning it. Not on his lonesome, of course, but it was him that saved the big Mozzy. Without Mozzy, there's no Hegemony. Without Mozzy, there's no Persean Sector, no future at all. That's not something to shake your head at."
entries.zh:
"啊，他可是我的霸主！" 他捶胸强调道。

"老爷子 Daud 从 Chicomoztoc 的底层爬上来，最后爬到了金字塔的顶端。不管 Eventide 上的贵族们怎么想，战争就是打响了，而他想办法打赢了。当然不是单枪匹马，但确实是他拯救了 Mozzy。没有 Mozzy 就没有 霸主，没有 Mozzy 就没有英仙座星域，一切未来都无从谈起。这可不是能轻易否定的功绩。"

o.en: What's your impression of Admiral Orcus Rao?
o.zh: 你对海军上将 Orcus Rao 的印象如何？

entries.en:
"Admiral Rao?" Tseen Ke rubs his chin. "He's a bit of a fancy lad, is Rao. Out of Eventide, did you know? Of course you do, it's right there in the name, ha-ha. They're rich, beyond rich. He's not a bad one though, not bad."

"He does things his own way to win, and he's won plenty." He lowers his voice - not that it particularly matters over the comms-link, which automatically compensates for volume.

"I tell you, if he weren't a Rao..."
entries.zh:
"Rao 上将？" Tseen Ke 摩挲着下巴，"Rao 这人有点公子哥派头，毕竟是 Eventide 出身，你知道吧？你肯定知道，毕竟他姓氏上就写着呢，哈哈。他们家富可敌国。不过他人不坏，真的不坏。"

"他按自己的方式打仗，而且赢了很多次。" 他压低声音 —— 虽然在通讯线路上这并无必要，系统会自动调节音量。

"跟你说，他要不是 Rao 家的人..."

entries.en:
"If he weren't a Rao, he wouldn't have got away with half of what he did. It'd be court martial, stripped of command and rank. If I tried what he did, my only command would be over disinfection duty for the next 10 cycles."

He shrugs. "That's how it is though. Like I said, he's not bad."
entries.zh:
"他要不是 Rao 家的人，那他干的那些事光拿出一半，就够他上军事法庭了，撤职削衔都是轻的。要是我敢这么干，那在未来 10 个星历年里我唯一能指挥的就只有消毒勤务。"

他耸耸肩，"不过世道就是这样。就像我说的，他人不坏。"

o.en: So I've attracted the, ah, 'attention' of Tri-Tachyon.
o.zh: 看来我引起了 速子科技 的，呃，'关注'。

entries.en:
"Hopeless," he says, rolling his eyes.

"Might as well join the Hegemony officer corps and take up knife fighting. They love getting themselves killed over fool-notions."
entries.zh:
"没救了，" 他翻了个白眼说道。

"你还不如加入 霸主 军官团，去练习击剑。他们就喜欢为了愚蠢的想法送死。"

entries.en:
Arroyo puts his hands over his face, leans back, and exhales deeply. It looks like he has a splitting headache.

"Well done," he says, his voice muffled. He sounds fairly insincere.
entries.zh:
Arroyo 双手掩面，向后一靠，深深地呼出一口气。看起来他像是头疼得厉害。

"那很好了，" 他声音含糊地说着，听起来相当不诚恳。

o.en: I survived losing that duel on Eventide, I'll have you know.
o.zh: 你要知道，我在 Eventide 的那场决斗中虽然输了，但我活了下来。

entries.en:
Arroyo puts his hands over his face, leans back, and exhales deeply. It looks like he has a splitting headache.

"Good job," he says, his voice muffled. He sounds fairly insincere.
entries.zh:
Arroyo 双手掩面，向后一靠，深深地呼出一口气。看起来他像是头疼得厉害。

"干得漂亮，" 他声音含糊地说着，听起来相当不诚恳。

o.en: I won that duel on Eventide, I'll have you know.
o.zh: 我赢下了在 Eventide 的那场决斗，我还以为你知道。

entries.en:
Arroyo puts his hands over his face, leans back, and exhales deeply. It looks like he has a splitting headache.

"Don't remind me," he says, his voice muffled.
entries.zh:
Arroyo 双手掩面，向后一靠，深深地呼出一口气。看起来他像是头疼得厉害。

"别提醒我，" 他声音含糊地说。

o.en: ... I do have a Hegemony commission, you know.
o.zh: ... 你知道，我和 霸主 确实有份雇佣协议。

entries.en:
Arroyo puts his hands over his face, leans back, and exhales deeply. It looks like he has a splitting headache.

He doesn't seem to want to talk about honor.
entries.zh:
Arroyo 双手掩面，向后一靠，深深地呼出一口气。看起来他像是头疼得厉害。

他看起来不想谈论荣誉相关的事情。

entries.en:
"Hopeless," he says, exasperated. "Did you hear a word I said? I can't believe I called this 'fun'."

"I should have charged you that executive consulting fee," he mutters.
entries.zh:
"没救了，" 他恼火地说，"你没听到我说的么？我真不敢相信我居然觉得这 '有趣'。"

"我当初真该收你那笔高管咨询费的，" 他喃喃自语。

entries.en:
"What of it?" he says, exasperated, then catches himself. "No, don't give me a speech about law. I don't care, and no one else cares. Just stop."

"I should have charged you that executive consulting fee," he mutters.
entries.zh:
"那又怎样？" 他恼火地说，然后又克制住了自己，"不，别给我灌输法律那一套。我不在乎，别人也不在乎。到此为止吧"

"我当初真该收你那笔高管咨询费的，" 他低声嘟囔道。

entries.en:
"Exactly." He grins.

"Now don't tell anyone I told you any of that. If you play this right, I could make a killing on the clean-up..."

He strokes his beard and consults a datapad.
entries.zh:
"没错。" 他咧嘴一笑。

"现在别告诉任何人是我跟你说了这些。如果你处理得当，我可能会在回收工作中大赚一笔..."

他捋了捋胡子，查阅着数据平板。

entries.en:
Arroyo narrows his eyes at your lie.

"I'm not telling you to like it," he says. "I'm telling you how to get it done. Play this right and we can both make a killing."

A pause, then he smirks. "You know what I mean."
entries.zh:
Arroyo 对你的谎言眯起了眼睛。

"我不是说让你喜欢它，" 他说道。"我是告诉你怎么去完成它。处理得当的话，我们都能大赚一笔。"

他停顿了一下，然后咧嘴一笑。"你知道我的意思。"

entries.en:
"I should charge you for this sort of thing," Arroyo says. "Expert advice; consulting fee, executive rate. Hm," he ponders for a moment.

"Senior executive rate."

Then he sighs and looks away - perhaps at the splendid view from his private chalet in the mountains of Eochu Bres.
entries.zh:
"我应该为这事向你收费的，" Arroyo 说道，"专家咨询；咨询费，执行费。嗯，" 他思考了一会儿。

"高级管理咨询费。"

然后他叹了口气，望向别处 —— 也许是在欣赏他在 Eochu Bres 山脉的私人小屋外的壮丽景色。

entries.en:
"I wonder, sometimes. Most problems, I solve them by ordering an underling, a contractor, to go do what they do. They take the credits and disappear. Maybe it's solved, maybe they hide the most overt consequences. Whatever - it becomes not my problem. It's easy."

"Then you come along."
entries.zh:
"我有时候会想。大多数问题，我都是通过命令下属或承包商去解决的。他们拿了钱就消失了。也许问题解决了，也许他们只是掩盖了最明显的后果。不管怎样 —— 那就不是我的问题了。这很简单。"

"然后你就出现了。"

o.en: This seems to be mostly about you so far.
o.zh: 到目前为止，这似乎主要是你的问题。

o.en: My question was more about Tri-Tachyon sponsoring attacks on my fleets and colonies.
o.zh: 我的问题更多是关于 速子科技 资助对我的舰队和殖民地的袭击。

entries.en:
"Shut up," he says.

"You bring problems into my life. Annoying problems produced by your own blundering bloody-mindedness. You're vexing. You vex me. It's almost..."

He trails off, lost of his usual bluster.
entries.zh:
"闭嘴，" 他说道。

"你把麻烦带进了我的生活。这些令人厌烦的麻烦都是你自己鲁莽固执的结果。一个阴魂不散的烦人精。这简直是..."

他的声音逐渐低了下去，失去了平时的嚣张气焰。

entries.en: "Fun," he says at last.
entries.zh: "有趣，" 他最后说道。

entries.en:
"Here's what you're going to do." He speaks loudly now, looking directly through the comms.

"This is a negotiation, you understand? Tri-Tachyon is making an assertive opening bid, they're saying 'Don't try to compete with us, you'll lose. Just give up.' If you want to be taken seriously, you must reply aggressively, you understand? Tell them that it is unprofitable to compete with YOU."

He slaps his hands down on his desk for emphasis, the clap of a starship reactor breach slamming against shields and inertial compensators. A bomb in the heart of a spaceport fuel hub set by a covert raid-squad.
entries.zh:
"你得这么做。" 他提高音量，透过通讯直视着你。

"这是一场谈判，你明白吗？速子科技 正在做出一个强硬的开场报价，他们是在说 '别试图跟我们竞争，你会输的。还是放弃吧。' 如果你想被认真对待，你必须强硬地回应，你明白吗？告诉他们，跟 '你' 竞争是不划算的。"

他重重地把手拍在桌子上以示强调，那声音就像星舰反应堆全面过载时，护盾和惯性补偿器发出的轰鸣。或者一支劫掠小队在太空港燃料中心引爆的炸弹。

entries.en:
"Tri-Tachyon doesn't want war, they want a deal. They don't hold grudges, they don't care about ideology, or beliefs, or ethics. The Company is as happy to sell to the Church as the Diktat, and the Hegemony after two major wars, for all that those matter. In the end, it's about profits."

"So you must learn what negotiating is. You're not in this to destroy the Company; you can't. You don't want to remove their path to de-escalation. Show them that sponsoring attacks on you is a poor investment, but don't make it a PR disaster - it must be a covert fight. Transponder off, you hear me? Burn their fleets, burn their facilities, and always make sure they can say it wasn't you. Give them an out, and that out will be cutting a nice deal with you."

"Win-win."

He pauses to look accusingly at you. "Are my words getting into your brain or has it been floating around in space too long? Do you understand win-win?"
entries.zh:
"速子科技 并不想发动战争，他们想要达成协议。他们不会记仇，也不在乎意识形态、信仰或道德。公司乐于向教会、辛达强权和经历过两场战争的 霸主 出售商品，这些都不重要。归根结底，一切都是为了利益。"

"所以你必须学会什么是谈判。你不是为了毁灭公司而来；你做不到。你也不想阻断可以缓和局势的渠道。让他们明白资助对你的袭击是一笔糟糕的投资，但不要让它变成公关灾难 —— 这必须是一场秘密的战斗。关闭应答器，你听到了吗？摧毁他们的舰队，摧毁他们的设施，并确保他们总能声称这不是你干的。给他们一个台阶下，而这个台阶就是与你达成一笔不错的交易。"

"双赢。"

他停下来，用责备的眼神看着你。"我的话你听进去了吗？还是你的脑子在太空里飘得太久了？你明白双赢的意思吗？"

o.en: I understand. Fight covertly, cut a deal. Win-win.
o.zh: 我明白了。秘密战斗，达成协议。双赢。

o.en: I understand. Fight covertly, cut a deal. Win-win. (lie)
o.zh: 我明白了。秘密战斗，达成协议。双赢。 (说谎)

o.en: I cannot let their trespasses go unanswered; it would be dishonorable.
o.zh: 我不能让他们的冒犯行为不受惩罚；那是耻辱。

o.en: You describe piracy, banditry, and might-makes-right. What of interfactional law?
o.zh: 你所描述的是海盗行为、匪徒行径和强者为王的逻辑。那么势力之间的法律呢？

o.en: Why can't we just talk it out and make a deal? Why all the killing?
o.zh: 什么我们不能直接谈谈，然后达成协议？为什么非要打打杀杀？

entries.en:
"$PlayerName! I'm so pleased to have found you."

$HeOrShe blinks rapidly, and judging from the corresponding lightshow on your tactical officer's console, $hisOrHer fleet's weapons are now armed and ready.

"Your meddling in Askonia is cutting into my profits," $heOrShe says flatly. "My. Markets. My. Territory. My. Profits."

For all that $heOrShe personifies the dead-eyed heavily-augmented senior executive class of TriTachyon, $heOrShe has built up to a respectable rage.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerName！找到你我可真高兴。"

$HeOrShe飞快地眨着眼，你战术军官控制台上随之亮起一片光，$hisOrHer舰队的武器已经上膛待发。

"你在 Askonia 的插手正在啃食我的利润，\"$heOrShe面无表情地说。\"我的。市场。我的。地盘。我的。利润。"

尽管$heOrShe活脱脱就是速子科技那种眼神死寂、浑身加强的高管阶层的化身，此刻$heOrShe的怒火也已经攒到了可观的份上。

entries.en:
"I decided!" $heOrShe shouts, "I alone decided to solve my problem - you - directly! Because no one around me, no one, has the sense to comprehend when a direct solve is called for!"

"And that, $PlayerName, is your death."
entries.zh:
"我决定了！\"$heOrShe喊道，\"我一个人决定，直接解决我的问题 —— 也就是你！因为我身边没有一个人，没有一个人，有那份脑子明白什么时候该直接解决！"

"而那就是你的死期，$PlayerName。"

o.en: Perhaps we could negotiate. How many credits?
o.zh: 也许我们可以谈谈。要多少星币？

o.en: You might want to get your cybernetics checked.
o.zh: 你或许该去检查一下你的义体。

entries.en: With an eye-twitching look of hatred, the comms cut.
entries.zh: 带着眼角抽搐的恨意，通讯切断了。

entries.en: With an eye-twitching look of hatred, the comms cut.
entries.zh: 带着眼角抽搐的恨意，通讯切断了。

o.en: I need to fix my reputation with the Tri-Tachyon Corporation.
o.zh: 我想修复与 三一速子科技公司 的关系。

entries.en:
"So," $heOrShe looks grim. "We're really doing this." $HeOrShe looks away, up at nothing.

"You should have bought a planet to go live on for the rest of your life. It'd probably be cheaper. And I wouldn't have to pull some strings that I'd rather avoid."

$HisOrHer gaze returns to the holo-feed. "But here we are. Now I'm going to go spend a fortune to make people tolerate you. Don't screw it up."

The comm-link terminates.
entries.zh:
"所以说。" $heOrShe脸色阴沉道，"我们真要这么办。" $heOrShe抬起了头，眼神里空无一物。

"你就该去买个行星然后余生住那得了。肯定还便宜点。这样我也不必去摆弄一些我宁可远离的关系网。"

$heOrShe的目光回到了全息影像上。"但我们都到这一步了。现在我得花巨量的钱财让人家能容忍你。你别给我搞砸了。"

通讯链接断开了。

entries.en: "I don't know why I still talk to you," $heOrShe muses. "You've made a very expensive enemy in Tri-Tachyon again and again. And now you return, begging forgiveness? It will take a fortune in bribes. You understand this, don't you?"
entries.zh: "我都不知道我怎么还在和你联系。" $heOrShe低声自言自语道，"你一次又一次地在 速子科技 里惹上要花很多钱才能摆平的敌人。然后你现在又来这祈求原谅？好处费要给不少。这你懂吧，嗯？"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe sighs deeply, leaning back and, rubbing $hisOrHer face with $hisOrHer hands. Finally, $heOrShe gets back up to face the holo-feed.

"10,000,000 credits. Count those zeroes carefully, captain."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe深深地叹了口气，身体往后一靠，用手揉了揉脸。最后，$heOrShe站起身来，面向全息通讯装置。

"10,000,000 星币。仔细数好后面的零，舰长。"

entries.en:
"Does it? Good!" $heOrShe says spitefully.

"You've been an outrage! It's going to be very expensive! Deal with the consequences!"
entries.zh:
"是吗？太好了！" $heOrShe恶狠狠地说道。

"你可真是让人窝火！这次要花很多很多钱！敢做敢当一点！"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe nods. You can see $heOrShe has that grim look one gets when they have to make a lot of uncomfortable comms calls.

"I've got a lot of work to do, and a lot of credits to throw around, starting with some local contacts. Be on your very best behavior, $playerName. I don't want to do this again."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe点了点头。你能看见$HeOrShe露出了那种要做一大堆让人不爽的通讯联系时的阴沉脸色。

"现在我有不少事情做了，还有不少星币要挥霍，从联系当地的联络人开始。你能放多乖就再放多乖点，$playerName。我不想再来一次这事了。"

entries.en: "You've been difficult before, $playerName," $heOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head. "It can't be done for less than 1,000,000 credits."
entries.zh: "你之前可算麻烦的，$playerName。" $heOrShe摇了摇头，"这次得至少要 1,000,000 星币。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe nods. You can see $heOrShe has that grim look one gets when they have to make a lot of uncomfortable comms calls.

"Now I've got work to do, starting with comming some local contacts. Be on your best behavior, $playerName, and we can make this work."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe点了点头。你能看见$HeOrShe露出了那种要做一大堆让人不爽的通讯联系时的阴沉脸色。

"现在我有事情做了，从联系当地的联络人开始。你能放多乖放多乖，$playerName，我们就可以把这事儿办成。"

entries.en: "I can probably do it for 500,000 credits. No one is going to be your friend, but this gets your foot in the door so you can patch things up."
entries.zh: "500,000 星币我就能帮你摆平。谁也不会把你当朋友，但这至少能让你在恢复关系上迈出伟大的第一步。"

entries.en: "I'm simply presenting you with an option," $heOrShe says, all business. "Let me know if you reconsider."
entries.zh: "我只是向你提供一种备选项。" $heOrShe用完全商务性的口吻表示，"如果你改变主意了，记得告诉我。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe doesn't quite snort dismissively, but it's close.

"You're in quite a hole. Tri-Tachyon will want compensation for damages. And while the Company isn't sentimental, you've offended a lot of people."

$HeOrShe considers this for a moment, "They will have to be paid off. Credits soothe most wounds... if you have enough credits."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe不算是在嗤之以鼻，但也差不多了。

"你还真掉进坑里了。速子科技需要对损失的补偿。虽然公司不算是多么感情用事，但你还是得罪了不少人。"

$HeOrShe略微思索了一会，"他们会需要钱。星币能抚平大部分创伤... 如果够多的话。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe gives you a skeptical look, then speaks. "Here's the problem, champ. You've got a commission with $theOtherCommissionFaction. And they're at war with the Tri-Tachyon Corporation."

"You want to get out of fighting and back to doing business?" $HeOrShe spreads $hisOrHer hands. "Resign the commission, that's my advice."

"And by the way, talking to you isn't going to do wonders for my reputation on the inside. I hope your encryption is good."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe狐疑地看了你一眼，然后才开口。"问题是，伙计，你和 $theOtherCommissionFaction 有雇佣协议。而他们正在和 三一速子科技公司 交战。"

"你想停战继续做生意？" $HeOrShe摊开了手，"把那个雇佣辞掉，我的建议就这个。"

"顺便，和你说话对我在 公司 内的名声也没好处，所以我希望你的传输加密技术过关。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe gives you a skeptical look, then speaks. "Here's the problem: You've got a commission with $theOtherCommissionFaction. And they're at war with the Tri-Tachyon Corporation."

"You want to get out of fighting and back to doing business?" $HeOrShe spreads $hisOrHer hands. "Resign the commission, that's my advice."

"And by the way, talking to you isn't going to do wonders for my reputation with my contacts in The Company. I hope your encryption is good."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe狐疑地看了你一眼，然后才开口。"问题是，你和 $theOtherCommissionFaction 有雇佣协议，而他们正在和 三一速子科技公司 交战。"

"你想停战继续做生意？" $HeOrShe摊开了手，"把那个雇佣辞掉，我只有这一个建议。"

"顺便，和你说话对我在 公司 内的名声也没好处，所以我希望你的传输加密技术过关。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe doesn't quite snort dismissively, but it's close.

"You're in quite a hole. Tri-Tachyon will want compensation for damages. And while the Company isn't sentimental, I don't have to be an insider to understand that you've offended some key executives."

$HeOrShe considers this for a moment, "They will have to be paid off. Credits soothe most wounds... if you have enough credits."
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe不算是在嗤之以鼻，但也差不多了。

"你还真掉进坑里了。速子科技需要对损失的补偿。虽然公司不算是多么感情用事，但你惹到了不少关键决策层，这一点哪怕不是内部人士也能看出来。"

$HeOrShe略微思索了一会，"他们会需要钱。星币能抚平大部分创伤... 如果够多的话。"

entries.en:
"No," $heOrShe says abruptly. "I've put myself out there for you... too much. The credits are good, but... I can't believe I'm saying this," $heOrShe closes $hisOrHer eyes.

"Credits are not enough," $heOrShe admits, then locks you with a fierce look.

"You've made a complete meltdown of... everything! Again and again! You're absolutely radioactive! I'm not doing it, I'm not sticking my neck out for you. No number of credits can change my mind. This discussion is over."

$PersonName terminates the comm-link.
entries.zh:
"不。" $heOrShe粗暴地回应，"我已经为你付出了太多...代价。星币是好东西没错，但...不敢相信我也有说这话的一天。" $heOrShe闭上了双眼。

"光有星币不行。" $heOrShe一边用凶狠的目光盯着你，一边一字一句地说道。

"你毁掉了...一切！还不止一次！你真是个灾星！我不干了，不会再让自己为你的事儿冒任何风险！再多的星币也不能改变我的想法，交涉到此为止。"

$PersonName 掐断了通讯链接。

o.en: I need to fix my reputation with the Tri-Tachyon Corporation.
o.zh: 我想修复与 三一速子科技公司 的关系。

o.en: Not necessary. I've reached an understanding with Tri-Tachyon.
o.zh: 没必要担心。我已经与 速子科技 达成了和解。

o.en: How could you attack a $playerBrotherOrSister of the Faith?
o.zh: 你怎么能攻击一位同宗$playerBrotherOrSister呢？

o.en: On the contrary, I've reached an understanding with Tri-Tachyon.
o.zh: 相反，我已经和 速子科技 达成了和解。

o.en: Um. I've reached an understanding with Tri-Tachyon. You can stand down.
o.zh: 嗯。我已经和 速子科技 达成了和解。你们可以撤退了。

entries.en:
"Oh then I must be the High Hegemon!" $HeOrShe laughs. "But, forgive me, forgive me - it's a virtue, you know; forgiveness," $heOrShe says. "I'll check."

The $post turns and shouts, "Peregrine, anything in the comms log about a contract recall?"

$HeOrShe looks back at the comms for a quick second to give you a skeptical smirk, then seems to listen carefully. There's some kind of shouted reply, impossible to make out through the crackle of the comms hardware.
entries.zh:
"哦，那我一定是至高霸主了！" $HeOrShe大笑起来，"是，请原谅我，请原谅我 —— 你知道，宽恕是一种美德，" $heOrShe说道，"我来查一下。"

这位 $post 转过身，喊道："Peregrine，通讯日志里有没有关于协议取消的任何信息？"

$HeOrShe迅速回头看了通讯设备一眼，对你露出了一个怀疑的冷笑，然后似乎在仔细倾听。通讯硬件的嘈杂声中，传来了一些模糊的回复，但无法听清具体内容。

entries.en:
"Bad news."

$HeOrShe shrugs, "For you, anyway. I'll say a prayer once it's over, and I'll make it quick. Why, by next shift you'll be sipping tea with Ludd and the holy Pneuma! I'm almost jealous."

$HeOrShe stretches, then sits back upright. "Let's to it, shall we?"
entries.zh:
"坏消息。"

$HeOrShe耸了耸肩，"至少对你来说是坏消息。结束后我会为你祈祷，而且我会尽快。为什么？因为到了下一个星历日，你就会和卢德以及圣灵一起喝茶了！我都要嫉妒了。"

$HeOrShe伸了个懒腰，然后又坐直了。"让我们开始吧，行吗？"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe isn't even taken aback. "For a large enough bounty, of course!"

"I have a family, $playerBrotherOrSister. A very large family. And think of the good works! Mammon's lucre does much to soothe such suffering."

$PersonName puts $hisOrHer hands together piously, "I think - no, I have faith! - Ludd will understand." $HeOrShe closes $hisOrHer eyes to mutter a prayer through a beatific smile.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe甚至没有感到惊讶。"只要赏金足够丰厚，当然可以！"

"我有家庭，$playerBrotherOrSister。一个非常大的家庭。而且想想那些善举吧！恶魔玛门 的财富能极大地缓解这样的苦难。"

$PersonName 虔诚地合上$hisOrHer的双手，"我想 —— 不，我有信心！—— 卢德会理解的。" $HeOrShe闭上自己的眼睛，脸上带着幸福的微笑喃喃祈祷着。

entries.en:
Only $hisOrHer eyes move, a reptilian flicker to an auxiliary display, then back to you. It occurs to you that they haven't yet blinked.

"Your words are irrelevant. Only a recall order coded with the keys I've exchanged with my Tri-Tachyon contact would suffice. Failing that, the contract stands."

A wash of distortion ripples across the display.

"Terminating comms," $heOrShe says.
entries.zh:
对方只有眼睛动了动，像爬行动物一样迅速瞥了一眼辅助显示屏，然后又回到了你身上。你突然意识到，那人没有眨过眼。

"你的话毫无意义。只有用我与 速子科技 联系人交换的密钥编码的召回命令才足够有效。如果做不到这一点，那么协议依然有效。"

显示屏上泛起一阵扭曲的波纹。

"通讯中止。" $heOrShe说道。

entries.en:
"Oh- ah ah, is that s-so?" $HeOrShe looks almost hurt, eyes twitching as they access an implanted interface.

"N-no, there is-is nothing here about the bounty being canceled. My ah ah employer would never make this kind of error."

"S-so s-sorry captain, you will s-still have to s... die."

$HisOrHer eyes move in an odd half-arc, presumably disabling safety locks on combat systems, judging by your tactical officer's reaction in your peripheral vision.
entries.zh:
"哦-啊-啊，是-这样的吗？" $HeOrShe看起来几乎有些受伤，眼睛在闪烁，同时在访问一个植入式接口。

"不-不，这里没有提到赏金被取消的任何事情。我的雇-雇主绝不会犯这种错误。"

"非-非常抱歉，舰长，你还是必-必须要...死。"

$HisOrHer的眼睛以一种奇怪的半弧形移动，从你余光中战术军官的反应来看，对方很可能是在解除战斗系统的安全锁。

entries.en:
The comms crackle slowly into a stable link.

"Blessed day, my friend!" $HeOrShe smiles widely, then reconsiders. "But perhaps not so much for you?"

The $post rustles around in some junk on $hisOrHer console, out of sight of the comms, then examines a beat-up datapad. "Knew it! By the holy stars in Ludd's commode, it's $playerName!"

"Shall we pray together before getting on with it?"
entries.zh:
通讯信号逐渐稳定下来。

"蒙福的一天，我的朋友！" $HeOrShe咧嘴大笑，然后又想了想，"不过对你来说，可能就不那么有福了？"

这位 $post 在控制台前的某堆杂物里翻找着，离开了通讯的视线范围，然后拿起一个破旧的数据平板查看。"我就知道！卢德马桶里的圣洁群星在上，正是 $playerName！"

"我们要不要在开始之前一起祈祷呢？"

entries.en:
The link flickers and stabilizes, mostly.

$HeOrShe stares at you for a moment, expressionless. Then speaks. "I'm afraid that conversation will serve no purpose here, $PlayerName."

An audio-visual warble lingers, never quite caught by the comms software.
entries.zh:
链接闪烁了几下，但大体上稳定了下来。

$HeOrShe面无表情地盯着你看了一会儿，然后开口说道："恐怕在这里，对话是毫无意义的，$PlayerName。"

音讯失真的杂音持续着，通讯软件始终无法完全捕捉到它。

entries.en:
"$PlayerName, is it? Ah- ah ah," $heOrShe makes a strange stuttering sound. You're not sure if it's a laugh, or vacuum-damaged lungs.

"Consider me s-so delighted to meet our s-source of plunder." The $post sits there with an odd smile, eyes large. $HeOrShe seems content to simply look at you.
entries.zh:
"$PlayerName，是吗？啊-啊-啊..." $heOrShe发出了一种奇怪的结巴声。你不确定那是笑声，还是真空环境下受损的肺部发出的声音。

"能见到我们的劫掠目标，我真是感到 —— 如此愉悦。" 这位 $post 坐在那里，脸上带着一种奇怪的微笑，眼睛睁得大大的。$HeOrShe似乎满足于只是这样看着你。

entries.en:
"You-know-who sends $entity.ttli_hisOrHer regards," the bounty hunter snarls.

The comm link goes dead in a crackle of static.
entries.zh:
"你懂的那位让我代$entity.ttli_hisOrHer向你问声好。" 赏金猎人大声说道。

通讯链接在一阵静电杂音中被掐断了。

entries.en: You hurriedly cut the comm link, feeling no small amount of embarrassment.
entries.zh: 你急忙切断了通讯，觉得有点尴尬。

o.en: Calmly explain that you're going to need more time to repay the loan
o.zh: 冷静地解释你需要更多的时间来还清贷款

entries.en:
$HeOrShe frowns in a passable emulation of human disappointment. "I'm so sorry to hear that. But," $heOrShe smiles again, "we can make an opportunity of this."

Your payment deadline is extended by $ttli_extensionDays days and the owed amount increased to $ttli_repaymentAmount. The Tri-Tachyon "investor" explains also, before cutting the connection, that certain actions must be taken "to emphasize how seriously I take our business relationship."

You consider that you may have to watch your back from now on.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe皱了皱眉头，挤出个还算像人类的失望表情。"我很遗憾听到这个消息，不过..." $HeOrShe忽然又把笑容挂到了脸上，"但我们可以对此特别宽限一次。"

你的还款期限被准许延后 $ttli_extensionDays 天，但需偿还的欠款也被增加到了 $ttli_repaymentAmount。速子 "投资者" 在切断通讯前还郑重地建议你把握好这次机会，以免其采取某些措施 "来强调我是有多么看重我们之间的商业伙伴关系。"

看来今后得多多提防了。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe frowns perfectly, then looks off to the side, talking as if to $himOrHerself, "Perhaps the motivation has been insufficient. How shall we solve this?" The investor continues, saying that $heOrShe anticipated this situation and magnanimously explains that your payment deadline is extended by $ttli_extensionDays days and the owed amount increased to $ttli_repaymentAmount. "By the way, additional incentives shall be entertained," $heOrShe says with a strange smile before closing the link.

You consider that you may have to watch your back.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe完美地皱起了眉头，并将目光移向一旁，仿佛在自语般地说到："难道是积极性不够？这问题我们该怎么解决？" 随后投资者继续和你交谈，说$heOrShe已经预料到了这种情况，并宽宏大量地将你的还款期限延长 $ttli_extensionDays 天，不过欠款金额被提高到 $ttli_repaymentAmount。在关闭链接前，$heOrShe忽然带着古怪的微笑低声说道："顺便一提，额外的激励措施已经安排上了。"

你觉得自己今后得多提防着些了。

entries.en: Your Tri-Tachyon creditor appears on the comms and speaks immediately. "How lovely, you're still alive. I would be so pleased if you would transfer the $ttli_repaymentAmount we agreed upon as repayment."
entries.zh: 你的速子债权人出现在通讯面板上并立即开口说道，"真是太好了，你还活着。还有如果你能把我们约好的 $ttli_repaymentAmount 还款转给我，那就再好不过了。"

entries.en: The Tri-Tachyon investor appears on the comms, looking amused about something. $HeOrShe begins to say something, thinks better of it with a small laugh, and makes a small motion for you to speak up.
entries.zh: 速子投资人出现在了通讯屏幕上，仿佛是遇到了什么开心事一样。$HeOrShe似乎是想要说些什么，但在藏于微笑之下细想之后，做了个小动作示意你先开口。

entries.en:
The Tri-Tachyon investor appears on your comm-screen and recognizes you immediately.

"Why, hello again, $playerName," $heOrShe says. "I trust your ventures have been profitable?"
entries.zh:
速子投资人出现在你的通讯屏幕上并马上认出了你。

"哦，我们怎么又见面了，$playerName。" $heOrShe说到，"我猜是你的探险事业已经有些赚头了？"

entries.en: The Tri-Tachyon investor appears on your comm-screen, hands folded, looking as if $heOrShe was expecting you.
entries.zh: 速子投资人出现在了你的通讯屏幕上，$heOrShe双手合十，仿佛已经预见了你的来电。

o.en: Sorry, wrong contact. I'll get back to you soon.
o.zh: 对不起，拨错号了。我回头会尽快跟你联系的。

entries.en: As your $shipOrFleet links up with the local comm-net, you get an alert indicating a priority message has been delivered to your queue.
entries.zh: 当你的$shipOrFleet连上了本地通讯网络时，一个警报声提示你在消息列表里收到了一则高优先级留言。

o.en: Tell $himOrHer that you're not going to pay back the credits you owe
o.zh: 告知$himOrHer你将无法偿还贷款

entries.en:
$HisOrHer face transforms immediately to an emotionless mask. "I see. How unfortunate." $HeOrShe looks thoughtful for a moment, and continues, "I won't waste time enumerating the reprisals you shall face." With a cold smile, $heOrShe says "It's just good business."

The comm-link snaps dead.
entries.zh:
$hisOrHer的脸瞬间变成了一副没有表情的面具。"我明白了，真是不幸。" $HeOrShe看上去像是思索了一小会儿才继续开口，"我懒得浪费时间来细数你之后要面临的报复行为。" $heOrShe冷笑道，"真是一笔好买卖。"

然后通讯链接就被掐断了。

entries.en: $HeOrShe tilts $hisOrHer head only slightly, a slight wrinkle appearing on $hisOrHer brow. "Goodbye," $heOrShe says. The comm-link snaps dead.
entries.zh: $HeOrShe只是稍稍歪过头，让眉头稍微皱了一下。"再见。" $heOrShe这么说了一声，通讯链接就被掐死了。

o.en: Transfer over $ttli_repaymentAmount to repay the loan

entries.en: "A pleasure doing business with you," $heOrShe says with a toothy smile, and signs off with no further smalltalk. You break the connection on the spinning Tri-Tachyon logo.
entries.zh: "和你合作愉快！" $heOrShe露齿一笑，没继续寒暄几句就直接登出了通讯会话。你看着只剩下旋转速子徽标的画面，切断了通讯。

entries.en: "We should do this again sometime," $heOrShe says, "it was quite diverting." And the connection is dead.
entries.zh: "我们应该找个机会再这样干一回。" $heOrShe说，"这次还蛮有趣的。" 然后连接就断了。

entries.en:
"Pleasure doing business with you, Captain $playerName. Now, if you don't mind, I have orders to transmit."

$HeOrShe smiles and reaches for the comms shutoff, then pulls back, remembering something.

"And on behalf of Tactistar," $heOrShe says, "I would like to wish you a very safe day."
entries.zh:
"很高兴与您做生意，$playerName 舰长。现在，如果您不介意的话，我该去传达命令了。"

$HeOrShe微笑着准备关闭通讯，却又缩了回来，像是想起了什么。

"并且，我代表战术之星，" $heOrShe说道，"祝您度过平安的一天。"

entries.en:
"Acknowledging contact with hostile $shipOrFleet," the $post says grimly.

"Be advised that the operating protocols of this detachment do not preclude hostile action against your $shipOrFleet," $heOrShe says. It's a jurisprudent threat, but one nonetheless implied.
entries.zh:
"确认与敌对$shipOrFleet接触。" $post 严峻地说道。

"请注意，本分队的操作规程不排除对你的$shipOrFleet采取敌对行动。" $heOrShe说。这是一种用法理作暗示的威胁。

entries.en:
"Greetings, independent $shipOrFleet," the $post says. "Please be advised to keep course clear of this detachment as we may perform navigational maneuvers."

"If you have business matters to discuss, please contact Operations Command."

"And on behalf of Tactistar," $heOrShe adds, "I would like to wish you a very safe day."
entries.zh:
"你好，独立$shipOrFleet，" $post 说道，"请注意避让本分队，因为我们可能会进行航行机动。"

"如果你有业务事项需要讨论，请联系作战指挥部。"

"并且，我代表战术之星，" $heOrShe补充道，"祝你度过平安的一天。"

entries.en:
"Captain, captain!" $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head in a pretense of shock, "My word is my bond. Besides, Tactistar holds a contract! A contract which includes a generous signing payment."

"Where would we be if mercenaries could simply sell their services to the highest bidder, with no regard for such concepts as honor and, after a fashion, morality?" $HeOrShe gestures vaguely, "Just imagine the sort of world we would live in."

$HeOrShe looks off into space for a few seconds, as if lost in a daydream. $HeOrShe turns back to face you, expression perfectly earnest. "No, your offer simply will not do."
entries.zh:
"舰长，舰长！" $HeOrShe假装震惊地摇了摇$hisOrHer的脑袋，"我言出必行。再说了，战术之星还握着一份协议呢！一份包含丰厚签约金的合同。"

"如果雇佣兵能够随意为出价最高者服务，而不顾及荣誉、道德等概念，那我们将会变成什么样？" $HeOrShe含糊地比划着，"想象一下我们将生活在一个怎样的世界里。"

$HeOrShe凝视着太空，仿佛陷入了沉思，几秒钟后才回过神来。当$HeOrShe再度转过身来面对你时，表情已经变得无比认真。"不，你的提议不可行。"

o.zh: 我明白了。那一百万，怎么样？

entries.en:
"I would be pleased to accept your offer on behalf of the Tactistar Space Security Corporation," the $post beams.

$HeOrShe waves a hand, "We have people who can sort out the details, but provisionally we'll substitute a few of the ident tokens in the standard form and proceed from there. In fact, we could begin shifting operational assets immediately... upon payment in full."
entries.zh:
"我很高兴能够代表战术之星太空安保公司接受你的提议，" 这位 $post 满面笑容。

$HeOrShe挥了挥手，"我们有专人负责处理细节，但初步计划是替换标准表格中的几个识别符号，并以此为起点开始推进。事实上，我们可以立即开始转移作战资产...只要在收到全额付款后。"

entries.en:
"Tactistar Operational Command Fleet acknowledging," the $post looks to a display, "$ShipOrFleet of Captain $playerName."

$HeOrShe raises $hisOrHer eyebrows, "I will note, for your benefit, that your ident is included within our operational contract. Now I don't make a habit of discussing contractual fulfillment details with the, ah, target. But."

The Tactistar $post stops before making you some kind of offer - this would presumably be against the terms of $hisOrHer contract - but $heOrShe does look like $heOrShe expects some kind of offer.
entries.zh:
"战术之星作战指挥部舰队确认。" 这位 $post 看向显示屏，"$playerName 舰长的$ShipOrFleet。"

$HeOrShe扬起自己的眉毛，"出于好意，我提醒你，你的识别码已包含在我们的作战合同内。我通常不会与，呃，目标讨论合同履行细节。但是..."

在向你提出某种提议前，战术之星 $post 言尽于此 —— 这很可能违反$hisOrHer的合同条款 —— 但$heOrShe看起来像是期待着某种提议。

entries.en:
"Tactistar Operational Command Fleet acknowledging," the $post looks to a display, "$ShipOrFleet of Captain $playerName."

$HeOrShe raises $hisOrHer eyebrows, "Your profile is included within the scope of our contract. I am forbidden from discussing contract details with, ah, project success targets. But be advised that Tactistar will pursue hostile action against you and your $shipOrFleet for the duration of our private operational bond."

The Tactistar $post is all business, cold as the void; you're just a project goal to $himOrHer.
entries.zh:
"战术之星作战指挥部舰队确认，" 这位 $post 看向显示屏，"$playerName 舰长的$ShipOrFleet。"

$HeOrShe扬起$hisOrHer的眉毛，"出于好意，我提醒你，你的识别码已包含在我们的作战合同内。我通常不会与，呃，目标讨论合同履行细节。但要提醒你的是，在我们的作战合约期间，战术之星将对你和你的$shipOrFleet采取敌对行动。"

战术之星 $post 完全是一副公事公办的样子，冷酷得如同虚空；对$himOrHer而言，你只是一个合约目标。

o.en: How about I pay you half a million credits to raid the $triTachSystem instead.
o.zh: 要不这样，我给你五十万星币，你去劫掠 $triTachSystem 如何？

o.en: Perhaps we can work together to solve my ongoing 'problems' with Tri-Tachyon.
o.zh: 也许我们可以携手合作，解决我与 速子科技 之间存在的 '问题'。

o.en: Rayan, do you think you could arrange a deal to solve my ongoing 'friction' with Tri-Tachyon?
o.zh: Rayan，你觉得你能安排一项交易，来解决我与 速子科技 之间持续存在的 '摩擦' 吗？

o.en: I've experienced some recent 'friction' with Tri-Tachyon. It's time we made a mutually beneficial deal.
o.zh: 我最近与 速子科技 发生了一些 '摩擦'。是时候让我们达成一项互利共赢的交易了。

o.en: I'd like to discuss the possibility of a deal to solve my ongoing 'friction' with Tri-Tachyon.
o.zh: 我想讨论一下是否有可能达成一项交易，来解决我与 速子科技 之间持续存在的 '摩擦'。

entries.en:
You explain your perspective on the situation, and the Tri-Tachyon $Post nods along, nothing seeming to come as a surprise.

"I see you, I hear you, and I believe that together we can solve this misunderstanding," $heOrShe says, voice warmed by client-relations protocol training. $HeOrShe shifts to an apologetic look, "Of course I wouldn't want you to think that I was behind any of this. Tri-Tachyon is a big believer in healthy internal competition, and some executives become... overenthusiastic." $HeOrShe shakes her head, "Terribly misjudged and disrespectful of the business relationship you and I have built together."

$HisOrHer contenance shifts seamlessly to negotiation-mode, "So if you'll allow me to walk you through a modest proposal..."
entries.zh:
你解释了你的立场，而 速子科技 $Post 则点头表示理解，似乎对你的话并不感到意外。

"我看到了您的立场，听到了您的声音，我相信我们可以一起解决这个误会，" $heOrShe说道，声音中透露出受过客户关系协议培训的温暖。$HeOrShe转而露出一副道歉的神情，"我当然不希望您认为我是这一切的幕后黑手。速子科技 非常支持健康的内部竞争，但有些高管会变得...过于出格。" $HeOrShe摇了摇头，"这是对我们二人之间建立的商业关系的严重误判与不尊重。"

$HisOrHer的态度无缝切换到谈判模式，"所以，如果您同意的话，我想向您提出一个谦逊的提议..."

entries.en:
$PersonName reviews a package of terms. Data-sharing of certain nav charts and commodity futures projections, mutual safety protocols for trade fleets, shared field and in-dock servicing arrangements. What it amounts to is increased accessibility for your colonies' trade based on market size- and, proportionally, for Tri-Tachyon as well.

"'Cartel' is such an unpleasant word," $heOrShe says. "I prefer - and Marketing agrees with this - to think of our proposal to you as a strategic partnership which will enhance Tri-Tachyon shareholder value, increase customer satisfaction, and," $heOrShe smiles hungrily, "make us both a lot of credits."
entries.zh:
$PersonName 审查了一堆打包好的条款。包括共享某些航线和商品期货预测数据、贸易船队的共同安全协议、共享场域和港口服务管理。这实际上意味着，根据你方殖民地的市场规模，{提高你方殖民地的流通性}，相应地，也提高 速子科技 的流通性。

"'垄断联盟' 这个词听起来不太好听，" $heOrShe说道，"我更喜欢 —— 市场营销部门也同意这一点 —— 将我们向你们提出的建议视为一种战略伙伴关系，这将提升 速子科技 的股价，提高客户满意度，并且，" $heOrShe露出贪婪的笑容，"让我们双方获取大量星币。"

entries.en:
"Hm," Arroyo leans back, thoughtful.

"First," he says. "You don't call me 'Rayan'."

He drums his fingers on his onyx desk, thinking. "There may be a way to make this work," he says speculatively. "Tri-Tachyon believes in internal competition, and if the reports I'm reading are any indication, the senior execs behind your 'friction' have somewhat overplayed their hand. The Financial Predictor section is seeing a lot of red coming up despite their best efforts to cover it up, and that means blood will spill."

"Figuratively, of course." A fierce smile begins to grow on Rayan's face. "Unless... well, let's talk details."
entries.zh:
"嗯，" Arroyo 向后靠去，陷入了沉思。

"首先，" 他说，"你不要叫我 'Rayan'。"

他用手指敲打着黑曜石制成的办公桌，思考着。"也许有一种方法能把这事办成，" 他推测道，"速子科技 相信内部竞争，如果我所看到的报告没错的话，那么你 '摩擦' 背后的高层领导们可能有些操之过急了。尽管他们极力掩盖，但财务预测部门还是看到了大量的赤字，这意味着将血流成河。"

"当然，这只是比喻。" Rayan 的脸上开始露出凶狠的笑容。"除非...好吧，让我们来谈谈细节。"

entries.en:
Arroyo pulls up a shared document context and rapidly assembles a package of terms to present to his contacts at the highest levels of Tri-Tachyon: Data-sharing of certain nav charts and commodity futures projections, mutual safety protocols for trade fleets, shared field and in-dock servicing arrangements.

What it amounts to is increased accessibility for your colonies' proportional to their market size. And, in turn, proportional gains to Tri-Tachyon's trade access.

"It's not exactly a cartel, but it's a good first step," Rayan says. "You both gain opportunities and, of course," his smile returns, "I get my percentage for arranging the deal while cutting down a few upjumped vac-heads in the executive corps. Win-win-win."

He leans back, admiring his work. "It's a good deal, $playerName. I suggest you take it."
entries.zh:
Arroyo 调出了一份共享文档，并迅速整理出打包好的条款，准备提交给 速子科技 最高层级的联络人。包括共享某些航线和商品期货预测数据、贸易船队的共同安全协议、共享场域和港口服务管理。

这实际上将根据 速子科技 殖民地的市场规模总和而让你的殖民地{提高流通性}，相应地，也会根据你殖民地的市场规模总和而提高 速子科技 的流通性。

"这虽然还不是个 '垄断联盟'，但已经是个很好的开始，" Rayan 说道。"你们双方都获得了机会，当然，" $heOrShe露出贪婪的笑容，"我因为安排了这笔交易并剔除了一些高层中的自命不凡的家伙而得到了我的那份提成。这是双赢的局面，双赢，再双赢。"

他向后靠去，欣赏着自己的成果。"这是一笔不错的交易，$playerName。我建议你接受它。"

entries.en:
"Smart move," he says as you upload your encrypted signature to confirm the terms.

"Now I've got some calls to make. Get out of here and stay out of trouble. You can thank me when the credits start rolling in."
entries.zh:
"明智之举，" 在你上传加密签名以确认条款时，他说道。

"现在我得打几个电话。离开这里，别惹麻烦。等星币开始滚滚而来的时候，你再感谢我吧。"

entries.en:
"First order of business," Arroyo says. "You don't call me 'Rayan'."

"Second, you must think pretty highly of yourself to think you've got a chance after the agreements you've broken." He drums his fingers on his onyx desk, considering your reputation perhaps, then stops.

"There may be a way to play this," he says. "Tri-Tachyon believes in internal competition, and if the reports I'm reading are any indication, the senior execs behind your 'friction' have somewhat overplayed their hand. The Financial Predictor array is seeing a lot of red coming up despite their best efforts to cover it up, and that means blood will spill."

"Figuratively, of course." A fierce smile begins to grow on Rayan's face. "Unless... well, let's talk details."
entries.zh:
"首先，" 他说，"你不要叫我 'Rayan'。"

"其次，你还真是高估了自己，以为在破坏了那些协议之后还有机会。" 他用手指敲打着黑曜石制成的办公桌，也许是在考虑你的名声，然后停了下来。

"也许还有转机，" 他说。"速子科技 相信内部竞争，如果我所看到的报告没错的话，那么你 '摩擦' 背后的高层领导们可能有些操之过急了。尽管他们极力掩盖，但财务预测部门还是看到了大量的赤字，这意味着将血流成河。"

"当然，这只是比喻。" Rayan 的脸上开始露出凶狠的笑容。"除非...好吧，让我们来谈谈细节。"

entries.en: "It's been a pleasure doing business with you, $playerName. I'm glad we can profitably put all of that unpleasantness behind us."
entries.zh: "很高兴与您做生意，$playerName。我很高兴我们能够创收性地把那些不愉快抛在脑后。"

entries.en:
You explain your perspective on the situation. The Tri-Tachyon $Post looks, if anything, more and more skeptical.

"What we have is a bit of a 'trust gap'. You've broken some very important agreements made with various parties. This complicates the pitch. But I do believe that we can downplay this misunderstanding," $heOrShe explains, voice warmed by client-relations protocol training.

"The Tri-Tachyon corporation has working experience with post-crisis PR difficulties, and I suspect that certain executives could be persuaded to come to an understanding about your past actions." $HeOrShe smiles brightly. "After all, one of our core values is 'thinking outside the box'."

$HisOrHer contenance shifts seamlessly to negotiation-mode, "So if you'll allow me to walk you through a modest proposal..."
entries.zh:
你解释了你的立场。速子科技 $Post 看起来越来越怀疑。

"我们之间存在一定的 '信任鸿沟'。您违反了各方达成的一些非常重要的协议。这增加了谈判的难度。但我相信我们可以淡化这个误会，" $heOrShe解释道，声音中透露出客户关系协议培训的痕迹。

"速子科技 在危机公关方面有丰富的经验，我猜测我们可以说服某些高管理解您过去的行为。" $HeOrShe灿烂地笑了笑，"毕竟，我们的核心价值观之一就是 '跳出思维定势'。"

$HisOrHer的态度无缝切换到谈判模式，"所以，如果您同意的话，我想向您提出一个谦逊的提议..."

entries.en:
"I'm sorry," $Post $personLastName says, "I'm afraid I can't help you with that request. I must also inform you that Company guidelines require that I report this conversation to my superior; I'm sure they will... take care of you."

$HeOrShe produces an insincere smile.
entries.zh:
"很抱歉，" $Post $personLastName 说道，"恐怕我无法满足您的这个要求。我也必须告知您，根据公司的准则，我必须将这次对话报告给我的上级；我相信他们会...仔细考虑的。"

$HeOrShe露出了一个不真诚的微笑。

entries.en:
"No," he says.

Arroyo doesn't quite smile, but seems somehow satisfied with himself.
entries.zh:
"不，" 他说道。

Arroyo 并没有真正笑出来，但似乎对自己挺满意。

entries.en:
"I'm sorry," $Post $personLastName says, "but you appear to be engaged in a state of overt hostility with the Tri-Tachyon Corporation."

"Corporate guidelines expressly forbid official negotiation with polities, corporations, and entities which are actively engaged in destructive acts against Company property and human resources."

$HeOrShe produces an insincere smile.
entries.zh:
"很抱歉，" $Post $personLastName 说，"但你似乎正与 三一速子科技公司 处于敌对状态。"

"公司准则明确规定，禁止与那些正在对公司财产和人力资源进行破坏行为的政权、公司或其他组织进行官方谈判。"

$HeOrShe露出了一个不真诚的微笑。

entries.en:
"Really?" Arroyo's tone is irritated. "You're in the middle of a declared open war with Tri-Tachyon and you expect them to listen to some clever little deal I bring to them on your behalf?"

"Star above," he shakes his head almost disbelieving. "The PR hit alone..."
entries.zh:
"真的吗？" Arroyo 的语气中带着不满。"你正处于与 速子科技 的公开战争中，你还指望他们会听从我代表你提出的什么巧妙的小交易吗？"

"天啊，" 他几乎不敢置信地摇了摇头。"光是公关方面的打击..."

entries.en:
"Really?" Arroyo looks irritated. "First things first: you don't call me 'Rayan'."

"Second, how can you possibly believe it would be that simple? You're in the middle of a declared open war with Tri-Tachyon. They aren't going to simply cut a deal with you through me."

He shakes his head. "Just imagine. The PR would be terrible."
entries.zh:
"真的吗？" Arroyo 看起来有些恼怒。"首先，你不应该叫我 'Rayan'。"

"其次，你怎么可能认为事情会那么简单？你正处于与 速子科技 的公开战争中。他们不可能仅仅通过我就和你们达成交易。"

他摇了摇头。"想象一下，公关方面会多糟糕。"

entries.en:
"Ah," $HeOrShe begins. "Your proposal is intriguing. The trouble is...  hmm." $HeOrShe thinks for a moment.

"I'd like to help you, I really would. However it is my sincerely held belief that bringing this proposal to my superiors is substantially more likely to impede my career than promote it."

"I'm sure you both understand and empathize with my predicament." $HeOrShe shrugs as if apologizing.
entries.zh:
"啊，" $HeOrShe开始说道，"您的提议很有意思。但问题是...嗯。" $HeOrShe思考了一会儿。

"我很想帮助您，我真的很想。但是，我真诚地认为，将这个提议提交给我的上级，更可能阻碍我的职业发展，而不是促进它。"

"我相信您也能理解和同情我的处境。" $HeOrShe耸了耸肩，仿佛在道歉。

entries.en:
Your comms officer forwards the link to your personal interface and with a flicker the $post appears before you.

"Captain." $HisOrHer eyes dart to another display, "... $playerLastName. I would like to personally welcome you to $marketName."

Their too-quick smile comes across as nervous.
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官将通讯转接到你的屏幕上，闪烁过后 $post 的影像出现在你的面前。

"这位舰长。" $HisOrHer眼睛看向一旁的屏幕，"... 您是 $playerLastName 对吧。我个人想欢迎您来到 $marketName。"

他仓促表现出的笑容中夹杂着一丝紧张。

o.zh: 谢谢。我能停靠港口了吗？

o.en: Is this about a bribe? Just tell me how much.

entries.en:
Your comms officer calls for your attention.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. There's an incoming comms request, marked urgent, from the portmaster. They want to speak with you personally."
entries.zh:
你的通讯军官呼叫你的注意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。有来自港务长的紧急通讯请求。要求与您本人通话。"

entries.en:
"Ha-ha. Of course, of course. But before- just one little thing. Not a problem, just a..."

$HeOrShe pauses, then begins again.
entries.zh:
"哈哈。当然，当然。不过在这之前 —— 还有件小事。不算问题，只是..."

$heOrShe顿了顿，而后重新开口。

entries.en:
"Ha-ha. Well... it's not a problem. Well. Not really a- it's just..."

$HeOrShe licks $hisOrHer lips, then begins again.
entries.zh:
"哈哈。这个...不算问题。嗯，其实也不算是 —— 只是..."

$heOrShe舔了舔嘴唇，而后重新开口。

entries.en:
"Ha-ha. Of course not, nothing of the sort. You're very funny."

$HeOrShe pauses, then begins again.
entries.zh:
"哈哈。当然没有，绝非如此。您可真幽默。"

$heOrShe顿了顿，而后重新开口。

entries.en:
"You see, we couldn't help but notice certain... unique features of your $shipOrFleet. It's unusual... very unusual."

"Look," $heOrShe blinks rapidly, "You tripped something in the Welcome Analysis Algorithm and I've got a directive I've never seen before."
entries.zh:
"你瞧，我们忍不住注意到您$shipOrFleet的某些...独特特征。那很不寻常...极其不寻常。"

"听着，" $heOrShe快速眨眼，"您触发了欢迎分析算法的某种机制，而我也收到了一条前所未见的指令。"

o.en: Is there going to be some kind of trouble?

entries.en:
"We couldn't help but notice a certain... unique hull in your $shipOrFleet. It's unusual... very unusual."

$HeOrShe leans in, "Is it really what I think it is? Stars beyond, I..."

An impatient chime prompts $himOrHer.

"Ah," $heOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat. "You tripped something in the Welcome Analysis Algorithm and I've got a directive I've never seen before."
entries.zh:
"我们忍不住注意到您的$shipOrFleet中有一艘...独特的舰体。那很不寻常...极其不寻常。"

$heOrShe倾身向前，"它真的是我想的那艘吗？天外星辰啊，我..."

一阵不耐烦的提示音打断了$himOrHer。

"啊，" $heOrShe 清了清喉咙，"您触发了欢迎分析算法的某种机制，而我也收到了一条前所未见的指令。"

o.en: The Onslaught Mk.I would do that, wouldn't it.
o.zh: 攻势 Mk.I 确实会引起这种反应，不是吗。

o.en: Is there going to be some kind of trouble?

entries.en: "Yes."
entries.zh: "是的。"

entries.en: "N- no, I don't think so," $heOrShe says unreassuringly.
entries.zh: "不 —— 不会，我想不会的，" $heOrShe说道，语气却毫无安抚之意。

entries.en: "I- yes," $heOrShe says, wide-eyed. "I suppose it would,"
entries.zh: "我 —— 是的，" $heOrShe睁大眼睛说道，"我想确实会。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks down at the TriPad in $hisOrHer hands.

"Tri-Tachyon's Director of Special Acquisitions, Zunya Glamor-Rotanev, would like to invite you to a meeting. On Eochu Bres."

$HisOrHer eyes raise back up to the comm-link, to stare into your own. "At your earliest convenience."

$HeOrShe looks to see that you understand what this means.
entries.zh:
$heOrShe低头看向手中的 TriPad。

"速子科技 特殊采购部总监 Zunya Glamor-Rotanev 诚邀您进行会晤。地点位于 Eochu Bres。"

$hisOrHer的目光移回通讯界面，凝视着你，"在您最方便的时候。"

$heOrShe审视着你的神情，确认你能理解此举的含义。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks down at the TriPad in $hisOrHer hands.

"Tri-Tachyon's Director of Special Acquisitions, Zunya Glamor-Rotanev, would like to invite you to a meeting. On Eochu Bres. Her office."

$HisOrHer eyes raise back up to the comm-link, to stare into your own. "At your earliest convenience."

$HeOrShe looks to see that you understand what this means.
entries.zh:
$heOrShe低头看向手中的 TriPad。

"速子科技 特殊采购部总监 Zunya Glamor-Rotanev 诚邀您进行会晤。地点是她的办公室，就在 Eochu Bres。"

$hisOrHer的目光移回通讯界面，凝视着你，"在您最方便的时候。"

$heOrShe审视着你的神情，确认你能理解此举的含义。

o.en: I'd be delighted to meet the Director.
What's this, uh, Zunya person do?
o.zh: 这位，呃，Zunya 是做什么的？

entries.en:
The $post stares at you for a moment.

"You-" $HeOrShe looks taken aback. "You're aware of... never mind. Forget I said anything. Transmitting the address now."

$HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer TriPad.
entries.zh:
$post 盯着你看了片刻。

"您 ——" $heOrShe显得有些错愕，"您知道...算了，就当我没说吧。现在进行地址传输。"

$heOrShe轻点着$hisOrHer的 TriPad。

entries.en:
The $post stares at you for a moment.

"Yes, she-" $HeOrShe looks taken aback. "You're aware of... never mind. Forget I said anything. Transmitting the address now."

$HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer TriPad.
entries.zh:
$post 盯着你看了片刻。

"是的，她 ——" $heOrShe显得有些错愕，"您知道...算了，就当我没说吧。现在进行地址传输。"

$heOrShe轻点着$hisOrHer的 TriPad。

entries.en:
The $post stares at you for a moment.

"You don't-" $HeOrShe looks taken aback. "You're aware of... Special Acquisitions? Never mind. Forget I said anything. Transmitting the address now."

$HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer TriPad.
entries.zh:
$post 盯着你看了片刻。

"您难道不 ——" $heOrShe显得有些错愕，"您知道... 特殊采购部吗？算了，就当我没说吧。现在进行地址传输。"

$heOrShe轻点着$hisOrHer的 TriPad。

o.en: Thank you. I'll be sure to mention your name to the Director.
o.zh: 谢谢，我一定会向总监提及你的名字。

o.en: I don't believe you told me what 'special acquisitions' entails...
o.zh: 你似乎还没告诉我 '特殊采购' 具体负责什么...

entries.en:
"Ha-ha, that won't be necessary. At all," $heOrShe says quickly. "Thank you captain."

"Let me welcome you once again to the port of $marketName, the Tri-Tachyon Corporation will be pleased to enjoy your business partnership during your stay, I'm sure."

"Keep it in the black, captain."

$HeOrShe smiles unconvincingly and cuts the link.
entries.zh:
"哈哈，您不必如此，大可不必。" $heOrShe急忙说道，"谢谢您，舰长。"

"请允许我再次欢迎您来到 $marketName 港口，三一速子科技公司 很荣幸能在您驻留期间建立愉快的商业合作关系，我很确信。"

"祝您财源广进，舰长。"

$heOrShe露出勉强的微笑，随即切断了链接。

entries.en:
"Ha-ha, that won't be necessary. At all," $heOrShe says quickly. "Thank you captain."

"Let me welcome you once again, the Tri-Tachyon Corporation will be pleased to enjoy your business partnership during your stay, I'm sure."

"Keep it in the black, captain."

"请允许我再次欢迎您，三一速子科技公司 很荣幸能在您驻留期间建立愉快的商业合作关系，我很确信。"

"祝您财源广进，舰长。"
