"Welcome once again to the port of $marketName, the Tri-Tachyon Corporation will be pleased to enjoy your business partnership during your stay."

"Keep it in the black, captain."

$HeOrShe smiles unconvincingly, pretending $heOrShe didn't hear your implied question, then cuts the link.
entries.zh:
"请允许我再次欢迎您来到 $marketName 港口，三一速子科技公司 很荣幸能在您驻留期间建立愉快的商业合作关系。"

"祝您财源广进，舰长。"

$heOrShe露出勉强的微笑，假装没听出你话中的疑问，随即切断了链接。

entries.en:
"Welcome once again, the Tri-Tachyon Corporation will be pleased to enjoy your business partnership during your stay."

"Keep it in the black, captain."
entries.zh:
"请允许我再次欢迎您，三一速子科技公司 很荣幸能在您驻留期间建立愉快的商业合作关系。"

"祝您财源广进，舰长。"

entries.en: $HeOrShe quickly cuts the link before you can ask any more questions.
entries.zh: $heOrShe在你提出更多问题前迅速就切断了链接。

entries.en:
"On behalf of Tri-Tachyon, it is my pleasure to..."

The $post halts $hisOrHer cheerfully plastic greeting.

"Captain." $HisOrHer eyes dart to another display, "... $playerLastName. Please accept my greetings on behalf of the Tri-Tachyon corporation. I..."
entries.zh:
"我谨代表 速子科技，荣幸地..."

$post 停下了$hisOrHer那机械般欢快的问候语。

"舰长。" $hisOrHer的目光扫向另一块显示屏，"...$playerLastName。请接受我代表 速子科技 致以的问候。我..."

o.en: Is there some kind of problem, $post?
Is this about a bribe? Just tell me how much.
o.zh: 这是要索贿？直接给我报个数吧。

entries.en: "Yes, quite alright," $heOrShe says. "It's just I've never..."
entries.zh: "是的，一切正常，" $heOrShe说道，"只是我从未..."

entries.en: "No, not at all. Nothing to worry about. I think. I mean, no, but..."
entries.zh: "不，完全没有。没什么可担心的，我想。我是说，没有，但是..."

entries.en: "A bribe? Ah, no, not at all. Nothing like that, captain. It's- well, you see..."
entries.zh: "贿赂？啊，不，完全不是。没这回事，舰长。这是 —— 好吧，您瞧..."

entries.en:
$HeOrShe pauses, then begins again.

"Your $shipOrFleet features some unusual modifications." $HeOrShe glances at a secondary display. "Very unusual."

$HisOrHer eyes dart back to stare through the comm-link.
entries.zh:
$heOrShe顿了顿，而后重新开口道。

"您的$shipOrFleet进行了一些不寻常的改造。" $heOrShe瞥了眼副显示屏。"极其不寻常。"

$HisOrHer的目光转回通讯界面，凝视着你。

o.en: Is there going to be some kind of trouble?

entries.en:
$HeOrShe pauses, then begins again.

"You appear to be operating a very unusual ship, captain." $HeOrShe looks, wide-eyed in disbelief, at a secondary display.

$HisOrHer eyes dart back to stare through the comm-link.
entries.zh:
$heOrShe顿了顿，而后重新开口道。

"您似乎正在驾驶一艘极其不寻常的舰船，舰长。" $heOrShe睁大眼睛，难以置信地看着副显示屏。

$HisOrHer的目光转回通讯界面，凝视着你。

o.en: Is this about the Onslaught Mk.I?
o.zh: 是有关 攻势 Mk.I 吗？

o.en: Is there going to be some kind of trouble?

entries.en: "Yes. And... yes." $HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat.
entries.zh: "是的。而且...没错。" $heOrShe清了清$hisOrHer的喉咙。

entries.en:
A look of deep consternation crosses the $post's face. The answer is clearly 'no', but $heOrShe seems unable to say so. After several agonized seconds, $heOrShe manages to produce a response.

"I've... never seen anything like it."
entries.zh:
极度惊愕的神情掠过 $post 的脸庞。答案显然是 '不'，但$heOrShe似乎难以启齿。在煎熬的几秒后，$heOrShe终于挤出了回应。

"我...从未见过这样的存在。"

entries.en: "I don't... no, no trouble." $HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat.
entries.zh: "我不...不，没什么麻烦。" $heOrShe清了清嗓子。

entries.en: "...Yes," $heOrShe says. "Yes, I suppose it is."
entries.zh: "...是的，" $heOrShe说道，"是的，我想是的。"

entries.en:
"There's a message I am supposed to deliver." $HeOrShe looks at $hisOrHer secondary display.

"Tri-Tachyon's Director of Special Acquisitions, Zunya Glamor-Rotanev, would like to invite you to a meeting. On Eochu Bres."

$HeOrShe looks back to you. "'At your earliest convenience', it says. And something about a reward."
entries.zh:
"我奉命转达一条讯息。" $heOrShe瞥了眼副屏幕。

"速子科技 特殊采购部总监 Zunya Glamor-Rotanev 诚邀您进行会晤。地点位于 Eochu Bres。"

$heOrShe将视线转回你身上，"上面写着 '在您最方便的时候'，同时还提到了报酬。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks aside again. "My apologies, I wasn't meant to tell you that part. The reward is for me."

A smile breaks through $hisOrHer nervous demeanor. "-For finding you. I should thank you, Captain $playerLastName."

"So... Thank you."
entries.zh:
$heOrShe再次侧目。"抱歉，我不该透露这部分。这笔报酬是属于我的。"

一丝笑意穿透$hisOrHer紧张的神态。"—— 因为我找到了您。我该感谢您，$playerLastName 舰长。"

"所以...感谢您。"

entries.en:
$HeOrShe looks skeptical. "You don't... You haven't heard of Director Glamor-Rotanev? Hmm."

The $post takes a conflicted moment to think.

"Let's just say it's above my pay grade."
entries.zh:
$heOrShe面露疑色。"您没...您从未听说过 Glamor-Rotanev 总监？嗯。"

$post 迟疑片刻，似乎陷入了矛盾。

"这么说吧，这超出了我的薪资等级所能谈论的范围。"

o.en: Tell me, what does 'special acquisitions' entail?
o.zh: 告诉我，'特殊采购' 具体指什么业务？

entries.en: $HeOrShe pretends to cough, then says "I'll send you the attached address. Good luck."
entries.zh: $heOrShe佯装咳嗽，随后说道："我会把附件的地址发给您，祝您好运。"

o.en: I wish to submit a complaint regarding Tri-Tachyon interference in my operations.
o.zh: 我想就 速子科技 对我的活动进行干涉一事提出投诉。

entries.en:
$HeOrShe smiles automatically.

"Tri-Tachyon holds the philosophy that engaging in healthy - even hearty - competition in the field of interstellar commerce is in the best interests of both our customers and investors. We're very sorry for any inconvenience you may have suffered."

$HeOrShe drops the smile. "Though I must emphasize that any condolence I offer is purely in the interest of generalized emotional support and should not be taken as a legally binding admission of guilt to any activities deemed illegal under the Persean Sector Commercial Standards Accord. Due to the nature of your implied accusation, company protocol does not allow me to engage in further discussion of the matter."

"Tri-Tachyon," the smile comes back, "would like to wish you a safe and profitable day."

The comms cut.
entries.zh:
$HeOrShe露出自然的微笑。

"速子科技 秉持的理念是，在星际商业领域开展健康 —— 甚至激烈 —— 的竞争，最符合我们客户和投资者的利益。对于您可能遭受的任何不便，我们深感歉意。"

$HeOrShe收起了微笑。"我必须强调，我提供的任何安慰都纯粹是出于人道主义的情感支持，不应被视为对 [英仙座星域商业标准协定] 中任何可被认定为非法活动的条款的承认。鉴于您暗示的指控性质，公司规定不允许我进一步讨论此事。"

"速子科技，" $HeOrShe再次露出了微笑，"祝您度过安全且盈利的一天。"

通讯被切断了。

entries.en:
The Tri-Tach captain's face lights up, "Wonderful- let me transfer the credits immediately." A tap on the latest model TriPad, and you hear the soft tone of incoming credits. At your signal, your logistics officer oversees the transfer of the technology package via cargo drone.

"I am certain that we will have even more fruitful dealings in the future, aren't you?" $heOrShe says. "For now, captain, I bid you safe travels. Be sure to add me on TriLink when you receive my request, yes?"

You close the channel, then dismiss the notification on your TriPad without reading it.
entries.zh:
速子舰长的脸亮了起来，"太好了，让我立刻转账星币。" 随着对方在最新型的 TriPad 上轻轻一敲，你就听到了星币到账的轻响。在你的示意下。你的后勤官通过货运无人机监督技术包裹的转移。

"我确信，我们在未来会有更多的生意，您觉得呢？" $HeOrShe说道，"现在，舰长，我祝您一路顺风。当您收到我的申请，请务必在 TriLink 上添加我，好吗？"

你关闭了通讯，对自己 TriPad 上收到的通知则看都没看一眼。

entries.en:
"Ah. Well then." The Tri-Tach captain displays $hisOrHer disappointment in $hisOrHer face - but not so much as to be unseemly. A sadly missed opportunity, $heOrShe seems to say with a small gesture.

"I'm sure we can do business again in the future," $heOrShe says. "For now, captain, I bid you safe travels. Be sure to add me on TriLink when you receive my request, yes?"

You close the channel, then dismiss the notification on your TriPad without reading it.
entries.zh:
"啊，那好吧。" 速子舰长毫不掩饰$HeOrShe脸上的失望 —— 但不至于有失体面。错过这个机会可真遗憾，$HeOrShe似乎用一个小手势说道。

"我相信我们今后会再做生意。" $HeOrShe说道，"现在，舰长，我祝您一路顺风。当你收到申请的时候，请务必在 TriLink 上添加我，好吗？"

你关闭了通讯，对自己 TriPad 上收到的通知则看都没看一眼。

entries.en:
"Ah. Well then." The Tri-Tach captain displays $hisOrHer disappointment in $hisOrHer face - but not so much as to be unseemly. A sadly missed opportunity, $heOrShe seems to say with a small gesture.

"I'm sure we can do business again in the future," $heOrShe says. "For now, captain, I bid you safe travels. Be sure to add me on TriLink when you receive my request, yes?"

You close the channel, then dismiss the notification on your TriPad without reading it.
entries.zh:
"啊，那好吧。" 速子舰长毫不掩饰$HeOrShe脸上的失望 —— 但不至于有失体面。错过这个机会可真遗憾，$HeOrShe似乎用一个小手势说道。

"我相信我们今后会再做生意。" $HeOrShe说道，"现在，舰长，我祝您一路顺风。当你收到申请的时候，请务必在 TriLink 上添加我，好吗？"

你关闭了通讯，对自己 TriPad 上收到的通知则看都没看一眼。

entries.en:
The comms-link plays a catchy Tri-Tachyon jingle before the logo fades to show the finely-dressed Tri-Tachyon captain before you.

"Greetings, starfarer. Might I interest you in a little business proposal?" $HeOrShe holds up a hand covered in tastefully minimalist yet glittering rings, "Now I know you are carrying a very particular technological device in your cargo hold. Who's to say if it went missing before you even got here?"

$HeOrShe smiles, perfectly.

"Let me offer you $entity.ttwi_credits credits to transfer it to my ship, and we'll all go home enriched."
entries.zh:
通讯线路播放着朗朗上口的 速子科技 广告曲，紧接着 LOGO 逐渐消失，面前显示出衣着光鲜的速子舰长。

"您好，远行者。我这儿有个小小的商业提议，不知您是否感兴趣？" $HeOrShe举起一只手，上面戴着有品位的简约闪亮戒指，"现在我知道您的货舱里有一个非常特别的技术装置。谁能说得清，它是不是在您抵达这里之前就已经 '丢失' 了呢？"

$HeOrShe微笑着，很完美。

"让我出价 $entity.ttwi_credits 星币，以换取您把它转移到我的舰船上吧。这样我们都可以满载而归。"

entries.en: You contact the agent using a special comms ID and exchange passphrases to verify each others' identities. The agent then transmits a data file with recent raw sensor readings of the unstable jump-points.
entries.zh: 你用一个特殊的通讯 ID 和特工取得了联系，然后互通暗号确认了彼此的身份。随后特工传输了一个数据文件过来，其中包含了不稳定跳跃点近期的原始传感器读数。

entries.en:
Your connection request is accepted after a slight delay.

"Yes, and you are?" The $post gives you a look-over as your transmission is acknowledged. "Ah, you have a report for me. Let's just take a look."

$HeOrShe skims $hisOrHer datapad. "Galatia is back on the map? That's excellent news. Says here you had quite a hand in it, too."

$HisOrHer eyes rise to take you in anew. "That won't be forgotten."
entries.zh:
你的连接请求在片刻之后被接受了。

"你好？你是哪位？"  $post 在确认接收到你的通讯后，上下打量了你一番，"啊，你有份报告要给我。那么让我看看。"

$HeOrShe快速浏览着$hisOrHer的数据平板。"Galatia 重回星域了？那真是个好消息。而且，里面说你也有相当大的功劳。"

$HisOrHer的目光再度抬起，重新审视着你。"我们会记住这点的。"

entries.en:
"I don't have anything specific for you right now, but you've got options," $heOrShe says, setting the datapad aside.

"There's a bounty in this system right now due to unusually high pirate activity. You've already got some experience dealing with pirates, so that could be a good way to earn some credits."

"And, of course, you could always visit the dockside bars. Good opportunities there sometimes."
entries.zh:
"我暂时没有什么明确的指示给你，但你仍有几个选择。

由于海盗活动异常频繁，这个星系现在有一个悬赏。既然你已经有了一些对付海盗的经验，这可能是一个赚取星币的好办法。

当然，你也可以经常去码头边的酒吧转转。那里有时能接到些很好的差事。"

entries.en:
"If you prefer, you could try your hand at salvaging - load up on fuel, machinery, and supplies, and head for systems outside the core worlds."

"It's a good idea to pick up a mission first, so you're not running blind - someone's usually offering good money to analyze this planet or that derelict. And where there's one, there's often more."
entries.zh:
"你也可在打捞上试试手气，带足燃料、重型机械和补给，朝着核心星区外前进。

在出发之前最好先接个任务，这样你就不必盲目地行动。一些人总会出高价去找人来调查这个行星或那个遗弃船什么的，而既然知道那边有东西，你就能有更多收获。"

entries.en:
"Finally, you could take a commission with the Hegemony - due to the Galatia business, your standing is high enough that such a request would be accepted."

"You'll be expected to fight our enemies, though, so it's quite a commitment. If I were you, I'd hold off on it until you've got a more solid fleet behind you."
entries.zh:
"最后，你可以选择签订协议，在 霸主 担任军职。你在 Galatia 事件中的活跃已经为你积累了足够的声望，这样的请求应该会被接受。

不过你将有义务与我们的敌人作战，因此这是一份相当重的责任。如果我是你，我会暂缓此事，直到你有一支更坚实的舰队作为后盾。"

entries.en:
"A team from the Galatia Academy has been running experiments on the dormant gate in this system, trying to connect it back to the Domain's gate network.

Promising experiments, or so they thought - until an energy pulse we expected would get a response from the gate destabilized the jump-points leading into the system, cutting us off from the rest of the Sector.

It's rather like how the Sector is cut off from the Domain, writ small- the stars have a sense of irony, do they not?"
entries.zh:
"Galatia 学院的一个团队一直在本星系中的休眠星门上开展实验，尝试重新将它与人之领的星门网络连接起来。

实验前景乐观，至少他们是这么想的 —— 直到一次我们预期能引发星门响应的能量脉冲，破坏了星系入口跳跃点的稳定性，把我们与星域其他地方隔绝开来。

这就跟这星域与人之领隔绝的缩影一样 —— 看来群星也懂得讽刺，不是吗？"

entries.en:
Your connection request is accepted quickly.

"Yes? Did you need anything else?"
entries.zh:
你的连接请求被迅速地接受了。

"怎么了？你还需要些什么吗？"

entries.en:
Your connection request is accepted surprisingly quickly, given that a $personRank has many responsibilities.

"Ah, you've come - excellent! As you're well aware, recently... well, I suppose we can skip that part."
entries.zh:
尽管 $personRank 通常是个责任繁多的职位，你的连接请求接通的速度却出乎意料的快。

"啊，你已经到了 —— 很好！正如你所知，最近... 嗯，我觉得这些破事可以不用再提了。"

o.en: I could use a refresher on recent events.
o.zh: 我想再回顾一下最近发生的事件。

o.en: Yeah, we all know the situation is less than ideal. Now, where do I fit in?
o.zh: 是啊，我们都知道情况不太理想。那么，现在我该从哪开始着手？

entries.en:
"I'll send you the stabilization algorithm when the core works it up. Once you have it, it should be a simple matter of running it using your fleet's drive field as a means of interacting with the jump-point.

However, there's still the matter of the miners guarding both jump-points out of the system."
entries.zh:
"等核心完成计算后，我就把稳定算法发给你。有了它之后，你就可以用舰船的驱动场和跳跃点交互，这应该不是件难事儿。

不过，能离开星系的两个跳跃点都还被那些矿工守着，是个问题。"

o.en: And you've said their forces are significant?
o.zh: 而且你还说过他们有可观的兵力？

entries.en:
"Well, it's all relative. Our security detachment could handle them easily, but as I've mentioned, it's tied down defending Ancyra.

Your fleet, on the other hand... you might be able to handle them with some stellar piloting and a bit of luck, but it's best not to take such chances.

Especially not when there's an alternative."
entries.zh:
"好吧，这是相对而言的。我们的治安特遣队可以轻松处理掉他们。但和我说过的那样，他们正忙于守卫 Ancyra。

而另一方面，至于你的舰队... 也许你能够用优秀的驾驶技巧再加上一些运气来搞定他们，但最好还是别冒这个险。

特别是在有替代方案的时候。"

entries.en:
"There's a ship graveyard around Tetra. Ships that were deemed not worth the effort to restore, awaiting bulk transit to one of the ship-breaking facilities elsewhere.

Now, though, they'll serve our needs. Go there and recover all the ships you can - and break the ones you can't for supplies. Make sure to bring enough crew to operate the recovered ships - perhaps an extra hundred or so will do.

You'll need to transport them somehow, too - here, take this Mudskipper transport; consider it part of your reward."
entries.zh:
"Tetra 的附近有一片星舰墓地。那里都是些被认为不值得修复的舰船，正等着被拖去别处的拆船厂解体。

不过在现在这种情况下，它们也能凑合着用。到那去回收你能修复的所有舰船，并把修不了的船解体掉作为补给回收。记得一定要带上足够的船员来操作回收到的舰船，估计要再带上大概一百多人吧。

你还要找个法子把这么多人运过去 —— 这样吧，带上这艘输送舰弹涂鱼；就算作是你奖励的一部分吧。"

o.en: Thank you. I'll return with the ships.
o.zh: 谢谢你。我会带着那些船回来的。

entries.en:
"Yes - the system estimates it'd take about a cycle to analyze the data and come up with a stabilization algorithm. Naturally, by then, the data would be out of date and any algorithm based on it, meaningless.

If we had an AI core on hand, we could analyze the data more quickly. Fortunately, there's a survey probe somewhere in this system - one left over from the initial exploration of the Sector by the Domain. It should have at least one AI core serving as its brain."
entries.zh:
"是的 —— 系统预计大概需要一个星历年来分析数据，从而得出一套稳定算法。不用说，等到那时，这数据早失去时效性了，而任何基于它的算法，都将毫无意义。

如果我们手头有一个 AI 核心，我们可以更快地分析数据。幸运的是，在这个星系的某处有一个探测器 —— 那是人之领在首次探索本星域时留下的。应该至少有一个 AI 核心作为它的中枢。"

o.en: Where is it, and why hasn't it been salvaged before?
o.zh: 它在哪？为什么之前没有回收它？

entries.en:
"To answer your second question, Domain artifacts are usually protected by automated defenses that still function to this day, and this probe is no exception. And the Hegemony generally forbids civilian interference with Domain artifacts. For the sake of public safety of course."

"Desperate times, however..."
entries.zh:
"先回答你的第二个问题，这些人之领遗物通常都受自动化防御系统保护，这些防御系统至今仍在运作，而这个探测器也不例外。况且霸主通常禁止平民干涉人之领遗物。当然，是考虑到公众的安全。"

"但现在已经别无他法了..."

entries.en:
"As to where it is, my data indicates it's somewhere beyond the orbit of Pontus - get there, then head out beyond the asteroid belt, and use an "Active Sensor Burst". You should at the very least get a sensor contact with the probe.

Head towards it, perform salvage, and bring back an AI core.

("Pontus" is a gas giant in the outer system. To see its name on the map, you might have to turn off the "Inhabited" option in the map filter.)
entries.zh:
"至于它在哪儿，我这边的数据显示它应该在 Pontus 轨道外侧的某处 —— 飞到那，航行到小行星带的外侧，然后使用 '主动传感器扫描'。你至少会定位到那个探测器的传感器信号。

驶向那里，进行打捞，取回 AI 核心。"

("Pontus" 是该星系外部的一颗气态巨行星。想在地图上看到它的名字，你可能需在地图过滤器中关闭 "有人居住" 的选项。)

o.en: I'll see what I can do.

entries.en: "Solid work. I'll get my technicians working on this right away. In the meantime, this should cover your expenses, hopefully with a good amount left over."
entries.zh: "干得很到位。我马上就让技术团队处理这东西。与此同时，这些应该够报销你的支出了，搞不好还能多出来一些。"

entries.en:
"You have the data! Well done."

There's a brief wait as you transmit the datafile.

"Now, while the system is running a preliminary analysis of the data - I believe you're due a reward."
entries.zh:
"你拿到了数据！干得漂亮。"

传输数据文件花了些时间。

"趁着现在系统对数据进行初步分析的时候 —— 我认为你值得一份报酬。"

entries.en:
"Welcome back!

A bunch of rust buckets, aren't they? But put some weapons on them, get a proper refit done, and with a dedicated crew, they'll do alright. It's no worse than what the pirates have got, at any rate."
entries.zh:
"欢迎回来！

它们现在看起来只是一堆空空如也的锈桶子，对吧？但只要给装一些像样的武器，做一点必要的改装，配一批勇于献身的船员，它们就能有模有样地做事。无论如何，它们不会比海盗手里的家伙更糟。"

entries.en:
"Yeah, was just about to talk to you about that. Not much to buy on the open market, but we have some stores.

I've already ordered local storage space to be assigned to you, and some suitable weapons transferred there - along with enough supplies to speedily bring the new ships back to full combat readiness.

Use them to outfit your new ships, make sure you've got enough crew for a full complement on every ship, and then break the rogue miner defenses at the inner jump-point!"
entries.zh:
"对，正好要和你谈这个问题。虽然在公开市场上可买的货不多，但我们有一些库存。

我已经下令分配了一个这里的库房空间给你，并将一些适合的武器送到了那边。里面还有足够的补给，以便你迅速把新船的战备状态恢复就绪。

用这些武器来武装好你的新船，并确保好你的每艘船都有足够的船员，之后就去粉碎闹事矿工在星系内部跳跃点的防线！"

o.en: I take it you've got the stabilization algorithm, then?
o.zh: 这么说，你应该已经搞定稳定程序了吧？

entries.en:
"Correct! These cores seem like they can work miracles sometimes. Let me transmit the results.

Good luck to you! If you fail... well, we'll have to send the security force to do the job, and then it could get very messy."
entries.zh:
"对！这些核心有时简直能创造奇迹。我这就把结果传给你。

祝你好运！如果你失败了... 的话，我们就不得不派治安部队来干这事，到时候事态可能会乱得一塌糊涂。"

o.en: It's good to know you're already working on a Plan B.
o.zh: 很高兴知道你们已经着手准备 B 计划了。

entries.en:
"Come now, it's not so grim - I have every expectation you'll succeed, or I wouldn't send you. But it's my responsibility as commander to plan for every eventuality, and not rely on a miraculous savior.

Now, about those miners - the two fleets guarding the jump-point will aid each other if you engage one when the other is nearby, so it'll be an easier fight if you manage to separate them first. If you can't, it should still be a fight you can win, though."
entries.zh:
"别这样，事情没那么糟糕。我完全期待你的成功，否则我不会派你去。但作为指挥官，我有责任为各种可能的情况做好准备，而不是完全去依靠一个奇迹救世主。

现在再说下那些矿工。你在和守卫跳跃点的其中一支舰队接战时，如果另一支舰队距离很近，它们就会互相掩护。如果能把他们分开各个击破，事情就会简单很多。不过就算不能，那也不是一场你没有胜算的战斗。"

o.en: Copy that. I'll be back here when the job's done.
o.zh: 收到，顺利完成任务之后我会回来。

entries.en:
"Well done!"

$PersonPost $personLastName seems a bit giddy with excitement.

"We actually did it! You just never know with these things, it's such a relief not to be cooped up in this system anymore.

Here's your reward, well earned and with my gratitude. In addition, I've set you up with a monthly stipend from the Galatia Academy, in recognition of services rendered. It should run for three full cycles. Frankly, they don't have much room to complain right now - didn't even have to lean on them too hard to get this sorted out."
entries.zh:
"干得漂亮！"

$personLastName $PersonPost 看起来有些兴奋过头了。

"我们真的做到了！你应该也没想过，从星系里脱困是一件多么令人安心的事情。

这是你的报酬，你当之无愧，我个人也很感激你。此外，我还为你争取了一份 Galatia 学院的每月津贴，以表彰你所做出的贡献。津贴会连续发放三个星历年。坦率地说，他们现在没有太多抱怨的余地，我甚至没给他们施什么压就把这事敲定了。"

entries.en:
"Now, I expect the authorities at the headquarters on Jangala, in the Corvus system, would like to hear about the recent events. Would you deliver a report for me?

Ask to speak with $jangalaContactPost $jangalaContactLastName when you get there.

Oh, and make sure to take enough fuel to make the trip; flying in-system as you have been doesn't use fuel, so it's easy to forget that flying in hyperspace does. It's not too far, but with your current fleet you'll need at least $jangalaFuel units to get there."
entries.zh:
"现在，我想在 Corvus 星系的 Jangala 当局会想了解最近所发生的一切。你能为我交送一份报告过去吗？

当你到那里时，去和 $jangalaContactPost $jangalaContactLastName 谈谈。

哦，确保你带了足量的燃料来完成这次航行，像你之前那样在星系内航行不需要燃料，所以可能忘了在超空间航行需要。这次行程不是太远，但以你目前的舰队，也至少需要 $jangalaFuel 单位的燃料才能飞到那里。"

entries.en: "If you do manage to run out of fuel somehow, and get stuck in an uninhabited system - and that'd be a real feat on the Galatia-Corvus route, let me tell you - you can always issue a "Distress Call" and wait for help to arrive."
entries.zh: "如果你真的想方设法用光了燃料，并被困在一个无人定居的星系里 —— 我跟你讲，这在 Galatia 到 Corvus 的航路上还真是个前所未有的壮举 —— 不过就算真的那样，你总可以发出 "求救呼号"，等待救援到达就行。"

entries.en: "I'm also declaring a bounty on the remaining rogue miner fleets here. If you like, you can stick around here and help mop up before going to Corvus."
entries.zh: "我还对在这里闹事的其余矿工舰队颁布了悬赏。如果你愿意的话，也可以在去 Corvus 之前留在这里帮忙清理一下。"

entries.en: "Excellent. Thank you for being willing to help - come back when you've got the data. Good luck!"
entries.zh: "很好。感谢你愿意提供协助 —— 拿到数据之后就回来找我。祝你好运！"

entries.en:
"Then you're in trouble - activate "Emergency Burn" to get out of there, lose them, and then come back around to try again.

Don't e-burn unless you really need to, though. It's hard on the ships, and will cost you more supplies to recover from. Eats up a good chunk of fuel, too."
entries.zh:
"那你就有麻烦了 —— 立即激活 '紧急加速' 逃离那里，甩掉他们，然后绕回去再试一次。

不过，不到万不得已就不要用紧急加速，毕竟这对舰船的负担很大，而且会花费你更多的物资来恢复。更别说还会消耗很多燃料。"

entries.en:
"First off, make sure to turn off your transponder once you undock. I've instructed the security detachment not to give you any trouble about that.

If you're lucky, the pirates may even think you're one of their own and let you approach Derinkuyu without any trouble. Still, it makes sense to "Go Dark" as you get closer, to make sure they can't get too good a reading on your fleet. You can also approach along the asteroid belt - that'll give you almost perfect cover, as long as you're moving slowly."
entries.zh:
"首先，确保你离港后立即关掉{应答器}。我已经和治安特遣队打过招呼，他们不会来找你麻烦。

如果你足够走运，那些海盗甚至会把你当成是自己人，让你顺利靠近 Derinkuyu，畅通无阻。不过在你接近的时候，也可以考虑使用 '匿踪' 来避免他们过于清晰地获得你的舰队情报。你也可以沿着小行星带靠过去 —— 只要你保持缓速航行，它们能为你提供完美的掩护。"

o.en: And if they do notice me?
o.zh: 如果他们真的发现我了呢？

entries.en:
"The miners of Derinkuyu Station, which is also located in this system and was operating near a subsistence level, were hit the hardest. They turned to piracy, intercepting one of the last food shipments to come in - out of desperation, no doubt, but there were deaths, and they've put themselves well outside the law.

Their leaders know that if the jump-points are stabilized and the system is once again part of the Sector, they can look forward to a life sentence at a penal colony at absolute best."
entries.zh:
"同处于这个星系的 Derinkuyu 空间站上的矿工本来就挣扎在只能勉强维持生计的水平上，因此受到的打击最大。他们开始从事海盗行径，拦截了一批最后运抵的食物 —— 被逼无奈，毫无疑问。但由于已经造成了伤亡，他们早已公然凌驾于法律之上。

他们的头目知道，如果跳跃点重新稳定下来，使得星系再次成为星域的一部分，他们最好的结局也只能是在流放殖民地上接受终身判决。"

o.en: Alright - now, where do I fit in?
o.zh: 好的 —— 那么，现在我该从哪开始着手？

entries.en:
"The miners-turned-pirate are guarding the jump-points, preventing us from gathering recent readings and coming up with a way to stabilize them.

We do have a security detachment that could handle their forces, but they're tied up defending Ancyra.

The pirates are too much for you to take on, but fortunately you don't have to. We've got an agent on Derinkuyu Station who was able to gain access to recent sensor readings from the ships guarding the jump-points, but they have not been able to get to a long-range comm array to send the data to us.

That's where you come in - head to Derinkuyu and retrieve the data from our agent, then return here."
entries.zh:
"这些矿工摇身变成的海盗们目前正守在跳跃点附近，阻止我们获取近期读数，来防止我们找到稳定它的方法。

虽然我们有一支治安特遣队可以对付这些武装分子，但他们现在正忙于防守 Ancyra。

而这些海盗太多，你对付不过来。幸运的是，你不必直面他们。在 Derinkuyu 空间站有位特工已经设法从守卫跳跃点的舰船上获取了一份近期的传感器读数，但对方无法接近远程通讯阵列把数据发给我们。

你就从这里着手 —— 前往 Derinkuyu，从我方特工手中取得数据，然后回到这里。"

o.zh: 对我来说这有什么好处吗？

entries.en: "Ah, a mercenary. Some credits, naturally, with more along the way - and if all goes to plan, we'll be able to reconnect with the rest of the Sector, such as it is."
entries.zh: "啊，不愧是个雇佣兵。星币当然会有，看情况可能会多给你些。如果一切顺利的话，我们就可以重新取得与星域内其他区域的联系，尽管那边也不见得有多好。"

entries.en:
"Why not? I'm not exactly spoiled for choice, and you've shown some ability to handle ... difficulties.

It's not going to be a milk run, that's for sure."
entries.zh:
"为什么不？我又没得选，而你也证明了自己有本事对付... 可能发生的麻烦。

毕竟这可不是什么不会遭遇抵抗的例行巡逻任务。"

entries.en:
Your comms officer calls for your attention.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. There's an incoming comms request from the station commander."
entries.zh:
你的通讯官唤你注意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。空间站指挥官发来一条通讯请求。"

entries.en: "I've got a list of targets that need killing," $personName says nonchalantly. "You could earn yourself some good credits with one of these jobs."
entries.zh: "我有一张清单，上边都是需要被处理掉的人，" $personName 若无其事地说着。" 你可以在这些工作中赚到不少星币。"

entries.en: A $ucb_manOrWoman occupies a booth on the back wall, a pair of goons hidden in shadow but for the glow of their augmented eyes. You watch an obvious merc-slash-pirate approach for an exchange of words and tap of datapads. Farming out underworld hits?
entries.zh: 有个$ucb_manOrWoman包了个靠后墙的包厢。跟着的两个打手藏在暗处，只能看清他们的生化眼里有微光在闪烁。从他们相互交谈和敲击数据平板的方式中，你看得出这些人明显是佣兵或者海盗。这似乎是个提供脏活的地方？

o.en: I'd prefer a more manageable target.
o.zh: 我比较倾向于更容易拿捏的目标。

o.en: Whatever you've got works for me.
I can handle a more challenging target.
o.zh: 我可以处理更难搞定的目标。

o.en: I'd prefer a more manageable target.
o.zh: 我比较倾向于更容易拿捏的目标。

o.en: Whatever you've got works for me.
I can handle a more challenging target.
o.zh: 我可以处理更难搞定的目标。

o.en: Ask about taking on one of the bounty jobs
Approach the $ucb_manOrWoman contracting out underworld bounties
o.zh: 走向正在商谈黑道赏金的$ucb_manOrWoman。

entries.en:
As you approach, $heOrShe inspects you with professional detachment, subtle cybernetics flickering on the edge of IR. "An operator, are you? Like getting your hands dirty?"

$HeOrShe doesn't smile. The expression is closer to a predator baring its teeth.

"I might be able to arrange a job which matches your... talents," $heOrShe says, implants flickering in $hisOrHer eyes.
entries.zh:
当你走近时，$heOrShe以专业的目光审视着你，精密植入体闪烁着接近红外线的微光。"你是特工吗？喜欢干脏活的那种？"

$HeOrShe与其说是笑容绽放，不如说是猛兽在龇牙咧嘴。

"我也许能安排一份工作...适合你的才能的工作。" $heOrShe说，同时眼窝里的植入物不断闪烁着。

entries.en: "Would you like to get your hands dirty?" $HeOrShe bares $hisOrHer teeth in an expression that's too bloodthirsty to be called a smile. "I've got a few jobs here that might fit your talents."
entries.zh: "你不介意把手弄脏吗？" $HeOrShe露出了$hisOrHer的牙齿，那样的表情说是微笑来也太过血腥了，"我这儿有几份工作可能适合你的才能。"

o.en: Ask about one of the other targets
Ask about one of the other targets

entries.en:
"Oh, you're one of those? Easy! Just go kill some Sindies," with a laugh, $heOrShe mimes shooting a pistol.

"Any questions?"
entries.zh:
"哦，你搞这行的？好说！去杀点辛达佬就好。" $heOrShe笑着比了个开枪的手势。

"还有什么问题？"

entries.en:
"Oh, it's you asking? Imoinu warned me about you."

"Guess it doesn't hurt to give some free advice - listen, it's easy. Just go kill some Sindies," $heOrShe mimes shooting a pistol.

"Now I don't know what spy-game you're playing, but watch your back." $HeOrShe smirks, "I'm watching mine 'round you, truth."
entries.zh:
"哟，是你来问？Imoinu 可提醒过我提防你。"

"白送几句忠告也不亏 —— 听着，简单得很。去杀几个辛达佬就行，" $heOrShe比了个开枪的手势。

"我不知道你在玩什么间谍把戏，可当心背后。\" $HeOrShe咧嘴一笑，\"实话说，在你跟前我也盯着自己的后背呢。"

o.en: I want to help you fight the Diktat. What can I do?
o.zh: 我想帮忙抗击辛达强权。有什么我能做的？

entries.en:
A look of relief passes over your nav officer as control over the hyperdrive is returned; a quick status query checks out green on all subsystems.

The wormhole anchor has been successfully deployed.
entries.zh:
你的领航军官松了口气，超空间引擎的控制权已恢复正常；简单的状态检验显示所有子系统都正常运作。

虫洞锚定装置已成功部署。

entries.en:
According to the embedded documentation, a newly-deployed wormhole anchor will generally require many months to fully calibrate the nascent wormhole with its new position in spacetime. Attempting to traverse the wormhole early consistently results in unambiguous disaster and forms of particles of particular interest to theoretical physicists.

In this case, however, the work has already been done: the calibration data from the cache you discovered will allow this wormhole anchor to stabilize itself almost immediately.
entries.zh:
根据附件所述，新部署的虫洞锚定装置需要数个月的时间，才能将新产生的虫洞调节至正确的时空坐标之上。提前试图穿越虫洞无疑会带来灾难性的后果。

但是这次所需的工作已经完成：你找到的校准数据足以让这个虫洞锚定装置几乎立刻达到稳定状态。

entries.en: According to the embedded documentation, a newly-deployed wormhole anchor requires many months to fully calibrate the nascent wormhole to its new position in spacetime. Attempting to traverse the wormhole early consistently results in unambiguous disaster.
entries.zh: 根据附件所述，新部署的虫洞锚定装置需要数个月的时间，才能将新产生的虫洞调节至正确的时空坐标之上。提前试图穿越虫洞无疑会带来灾难性的后果。

entries.en:
"The Persean League has a rather permissive official relationship with the Sindrian Diktat, yes," he says. "At Reynard's command as Prime Demarchon."

"It is purely cynical. And that I might at least respect if it truly did forward League interests! But to make such allowance for brutish Andradaism demonstrates a cruel hypocrisy on behalf of the ideals the Persean League and its Prime Demarchon are supposed to embody."

He shakes his head, irritated.
entries.zh:
"英仙座联盟对辛达强权，官方上确实宽容得过分，是，\" 他说道，\"Reynard 以大统领的身份一句话定的调。"

"纯粹是拿利害算计。若真能替联盟挣来好处，我倒还敬他几分！可这般迁就野蛮的 Andrada 主义，对着英仙座联盟与它那位大统治理该守住的那些理念，简直是狠狠一记虚伪的耳光。"

他恼火地摇了摇头。

o.en: But... with Reynard, the gens. Isn't this what the League is?
o.zh: 可... 有 Reynard，有这些氏族，联盟不就是这么回事吗？

o.en: And I don't imagine the Hegemony approves.
o.zh: 想来霸主那边也不会点头吧。
您的意思我明白了。 (返回)

entries.en:
"No- yes, but."

Horus catches himself and gives you a consternated look.

"Do we simply give in to base motives or do we aim to uphold an ideal? That is the question. The former bears profit and power for some, but it is a... a disease, a parasite, that will eventually kill the host. Without the League, without some common cause, what are we but pirates?"
entries.zh:
"不——是，可是..."

Horus 自知失言，窘迫地看了你一眼。

"是索性向那些上不得台面的私欲低头，还是撑起一桩理想？问题就在这儿。前者能给某些人带来好处和权势，可那是... 是场病，是条寄生虫，早晚要把宿主拖死。没了联盟，没了点共同的念想，我们跟海盗还有什么两样？"

entries.en:
"No, of course not."

Horus crosses his arms.

"And I well understand the point you are getting at. I am no hypocrite for believing that support for the Diktat is foolish for its own sake as well as a barrier to my desire to approach a reconciliation with the Hegemony."
entries.zh:
"不，当然不会。"

Horus 抱起双臂。

"您想说什么，我明白。我一面觉得支持强权本身就蠢，一面又嫌它挡了我同霸主修好的路——这两样摆在一块，我可不觉得自己是伪君子。"

o.en: Heard from our mutual friend yet?
o.zh: 咱们那位共同的朋友，有回音了吗？

entries.en:
"I am pleased to say that I have been in contact with our mutual friend," Horus says with a wink. "As with all good things, it will take time for this effort to bear fruit."

"It appears I was right to trust you. Perhaps we shall have future dealings? Ah, and did I mention that despite the eroded morals of our youth, the name of Gens Yaribay is proving its academic prowess in this latest generation? Well, let me tell you..."

You manage to extricate yourself fairly quickly from hearing too many tales of the Yaribay offspring's latest success at the Galatia Academy.
entries.zh:
"我很高兴，我已经和我们共同的朋友取得了联系。" Horus 眨了眨眼，"如同所有美妙的事，享受这种通过努力取得的成果需要时间。"

"看来信任你是个正确的决定。也许我们以后还会进行一些交易。啊，我之前有没有提到，尽管道德层面或许有些污点，Yaribay 这个姓氏却在最新一代人身上证明着它的学术实力？好吧，让我告诉你..."

在被 Yaribay 后裔于 Galatia 学院取得的各种如传说般的成就塞满耳朵之前，你设法成功溜之大吉。

entries.en: "Unfortunately I have not yet received word from... our mutual friend," Horus says, his brow creased. "Perhaps it is simply a matter of time. Like all good things, one must suppose."
entries.zh: "不幸的是，我还没有收到来自...我们共同的朋友的消息。" Horus 皱着眉头说，"也许这只是时间问题。就像对所有美好的事物一样，我们必须得满怀期待。"

entries.en:
"These are exceedingly useful. We shall..." She pauses.

Then creates the approximation of a smile.

"Great things shall be made, captain. You will see."
OR
"Excellent," she says placidly, eyes seemingly focused elsewhere. "This will do much to advance my initiative."
OR
Her eyes are inhumanly still.

"We shall want more. You must bring more."
OR
"I eagerly anticipate investigation of these artifacts." Her eyes twitch disconcertingly.
entries.zh:
"这些都极具价值。我们将..." 她顿了一下。

随即展露近乎微笑的表情。

"将成就伟业，舰长。你会见证的。"
OR
"好极了，" 她平静地说道，目光似乎聚焦于别处，"这将极大推动我的计划。"
OR
她的双眼非人般地凝滞着。

"我们需要更多。你必须带来更多。"
OR
"我热切地期待着对这些遗物的研究。" 她的眼睑不自然地抽动着。

entries.en: A cool smile. "Of course. I just wanted to hear you say it." She pauses for a moment, then proceeds.
entries.zh: 她露出一抹冷淡的微笑。"当然。我只是想听你亲口说出来。" 她停顿片刻，而后继续开口。

entries.en:
"Of course." A cool smile. "I wanted to hear you say it."

Her eyes seem suddenly more engaged - focused and examining you intently, distantly. Like you're a lab experiment pinned to a dissection table.
entries.zh:
"当然。" 她露出一抹冷淡的微笑。"我只是想听你亲口说出来。"

她的目光突然变得锐利 —— 专注而疏离地审视着你，仿佛你是钉在解剖台上的实验样本。

entries.en:
"I see," she says as if she quite distinctly doesn't.

Her head tilts very slightly, perplexed.
entries.zh:
"明白了，" 她的行为和话语截然相反。

她微微歪着头，一脸困惑。

entries.en: "How admirable," she says with no attempt to inject sincerity into her words. It is a dismissal; she pauses for but a moment then proceeds.
entries.zh: "真令人钦佩，" 她的言语毫无真诚之意。这已经是逐客令；她仅停顿片刻便继续开口。

entries.en:
"How unexpected," she says, curious.

"I suppose one must concede that the Church is not without some wealth and not without need for services unclouded by... fanatic enthusiasm. I suppose you've found something of a niche market for yourself. However limited."
entries.zh:
"真是出人意料，" 她说道，语气好奇。

"看来我必须承认，教会并非没有财力，也并非不需要那些不受...狂热信仰影响的纯粹服务。你似乎为自己找到了某个利基市场，尽管相当有限。"

entries.en:
If her look could become any colder without freezing the local atmo, it would.

"An interest in your business is my business if we are to do business. I shall repeat the point for emphasis: it is important that I know where we stand." Her hands, neatly folded, gently draw apart and close. Not clenched into fists, but...

"Do you believe?"
entries.zh:
她的眼神愈发冰冷，而且只要空气还尚未结冰，她就不介意让自己的目光再冰冷几分。

"如果你我还有所关联，那么和你有关的事情就等同于和我有关。我必须重申要点以进行强调：明确我们的立场是至关重要的。" 她交叠的双手缓缓分开又合拢。并未攥成拳，但...

"你相信那些东西吗？"

entries.en:
"I see," she says as if she quite distinctly doesn't.

Her head tilts very slightly, perplexed.
entries.zh:
"明白了，" 她的行为和话语截然相反。

她微微歪着头，一脸困惑。

entries.en:
"How interesting," she says.

Her head tilts very slightly, perplexed.
entries.zh:
"多么有趣，" 她说道。

她微微歪着头，一脸困惑。

entries.en:
"Tell me, how is Rayan Arroyo? I've always admired his entrepreneurial spirit, but." She forms a little smile that might have been apologetic if it weren't so condescending.

"He doesn't have the killer instinct required for senior leadership. Isn't that funny? But we do need people like him."

"And we need people like you. Go-getters, achievers; builders and destroyers. And what we need, we at Tri-Tachyon pay for. Only the best."
entries.zh:
"告诉我，Rayan Arroyo 近况如何？我一直欣赏他的企业家精神，但是..." 她露出一个本该是歉意的微笑，却透着居高临下的意味。

"他缺乏高层领导所需的杀手本能。这很有趣，不是吗？但我们的确需要像他这样的人。"

"我们也需要你这样的人。行动派，实干家；建设者与毁灭者。而我们 速子科技 对于需要的事物，向来只聘用最顶尖的人才。"

entries.en:
"Your interest in matters of the Luddics has been noted. Even working with, perhaps for, an archcurate. I can only assume it's a charity case for one so evidently practical as yourself. Am I wrong? You don't actually believe in that stuff, surely."

She looks cooly astonished at the thought, inviting your denial.
entries.zh:
"你对卢德事务的关注已被记录在案，甚至正在与某位大祭司一同工作，或者可能是受雇于他。我只能认为这对你这种务实之人而言不过是一桩慈善业务罢了。我说错了吗？你总不会真信那些东西吧。"

她对这个想法露出冷淡的惊异表情，仿佛在期待你的否认。

entries.en:
"We see you've taken up an interest with the Luddi- pardon me, with the Church of Galactic Redemption. I can only assume it's a charity case for one so otherwise practical as yourself. Am I wrong? You don't actually believe in that stuff, surely."

She looks cooly astonished at the thought, inviting your denial.
entries.zh:
"我们注意到你开始关注卢德 —— 抱歉，是 银河救赎教会 的事务。我只能认为这对你这种务实之人而言不过是一桩慈善业务罢了。我说错了吗？你总不会真信那些东西吧。"

她对这个想法露出冷淡的惊异表情，仿佛在期待你的否认。

o.en: I don't see how that's your business.
I don't think about it. Like you said, I'm practical.
o.zh: 我不会考虑这个。如你所说，我很务实。

o.en: I do. I stand for the Church and the Church with me.
o.zh: 是的。我支持教会，教会也支持我。

o.en: I do believe, but not as does the Church. I follow Ludd's Word.
o.zh: 我确实信仰，但并非依循教会的信条。我追随卢德的圣言。

o.en: Not as such. My interest is humanitarian.
o.zh: 并非如此。我的关注是出于人道主义。

o.en: No, my interest is purely mercenary.
o.zh: 不，我的关注纯粹出于雇佣关系。

o.en: Of course not, that's an absurd question. You should know better.
o.zh: 当然不是，这问题太荒谬了。你该更明事理一些。

o.en: Of course not, that's an absurd question. You should know better. (lie)
o.zh: 当然不是，这问题太荒谬了。你该更明事理一些。 (说谎)

entries.en:
"You're not only an explorer, you're a builder - founding a new colony!"

"It is bold of you to strike out despite the anti-innovation measures sure to fall upon you from the major factions," she says. "I suspect you'll benefit from an injection of capital. For the builder must also ensure that their prosperity cannot be simply seized by the small-minded takers."
entries.zh:
"你不仅是探索者，更是建设者 —— 你正在建立新的殖民地！"

"在各大势力必将施加反创新措施的背景下，你的开拓之举堪称勇毅，" 她说道，"我认为资本的注入将助你一臂之力。因为建设者必须确保自己的繁荣果实不会被眼界狭隘的掠夺者轻易夺取。"

entries.en:
"We've noticed that Mr. Macario - apologies," she laughs like a wind chime, "'The Chief High Inspector' has taken you for one of his pawns."

"You and I both know you're more and better than that. I believe your innovative perspective could be worth more than his entire tin-pot slum-bully's secret budget of bribes and favors."

Her eyebrows lift precisely. "Do you?"
entries.zh:
"我们注意到 Macario 先生 —— 抱歉，" 她的笑声如风铃般清脆，"'最高检察长' 先生将你视为他的棋子之一。"

"你我都清楚，你远不止于此，且远胜于此。我相信你创新的视野，其价值远超他那套贫民窟恶霸式的秘密预算中的所有贿赂与人情。"

她精准地扬起眉毛，"你觉得呢？"

entries.en:
"We've noticed that Mr. Macario - apologies," she laughs like a wind chime, "'The Chief High Inspector' has taken you for one of his pawns."

"You and I both know you're more than that. Better than that. And I believe your innovative perspective could be worth more than his entire tin-pot slum-bully's secret budget of bribes and favors. That silly little battleship he gave you? A child's toy compared to what I offer."

She brushes one hand off with the other.
entries.zh:
"我们注意到 Macario 先生 —— 抱歉，" 她的笑声如风铃般清脆，"'最高检察长' 先生将你视为他的棋子之一。"

"你我都清楚，你远不止于此，且远胜于此。我相信你创新的视野，其价值远超他那套贫民窟恶霸式的秘密预算中的所有贿赂与人情。至于给你的那艘愚蠢的小战舰？与我提供的相比，那不过是孩童的玩具。"

她用一只手拂开另一只手。

entries.en:
"Old reports noted your service to Mr. Macario - sorry, 'The Chief High Inspector' - and took has taken you for one of his pawns. But you've managed both to unseat him and follow through with his elimination. Well done."

"Nonetheless, you and I both know you're more and better than service to that blinkered tin-pot dictatorship. I believe your potential could be worth more than those little bribes and medals they distribute."

Her eyebrows lift precisely. "Don't you agree?"
entries.zh:
"旧档案里记着你替 Macario 先生办过事——抱歉，是'最高检察长'先生——便把你当他的一枚棋子。可你不光把他掀下台，还一路送他上了绝路。干得漂亮。"

"话虽如此，你我心里都清楚，替那个目光短浅的小独裁政权当差，未免埋没了你。我看你的本事，值的可不止他们发的那点贿赂和勋章。"

她精确地挑了挑眉。"你说是不是？"

entries.en:
"Old reports described you as a pawn of Mr. Macario, the former 'Chief High Inspector' of the Sindrian Diktat. But it seems they got you wrong."

She laughs like a wind chime. "It appears that through your service to Philip's clone - Achilles, I believe it's name is - you've managed to unseat him from his position."

"But Achilles? I believe your potential could be worth more than his tin-pot slum-bully's bribes, medals, and chant of 'reforms'. It soothes the ears of small men with small greeds. But I," she smiles oddly, "am no such man."
entries.zh:
"旧档案把你写成 Macario 先生的棋子——辛达强权的前任'最高检察长'。看来是他们看走眼了。"

她的笑声如风铃般清脆。"看来你借着替 Philip 的克隆体办事——好像叫 Achilles——把他从位子上掀了下来。"

"可 Achilles？我看你的本事，值的不止他那套小恶霸式的贿赂、勋章和'改革'口号。那套话哄得住贪小便宜的小人物，可我，\" 她笑得有些古怪，\"可不是那种人。"
