entries.en: "I believe that's enough of that, captain," she says stonily.
entries.zh: "我想这个话题可以到此为止了，舰长，" 她冷硬地说道。

entries.en:
Her expression is blank for a moment.

"On second thought, I feel no need to justify myself," she says stonily.
entries.zh:
她的表情凝固了片刻。

"转念一想，我觉得我无需自证，" 她冷硬地说道。

entries.en:
"You're proving useful to Provost Baird - an admirable figure generally - yet one who stubbornly ties herself to the Hegemony bureaucracy."

"If it weren't for Kallichore's blundering..." Her eyes grow distant - more distant - for a moment, then return to their usual unblinking detachment.

"Here at Tri-Tachyon, we put the highest value in unrestrained R&D. Especially its dividends." She smiles coyly. "So, I think, do you."
entries.zh:
"你对 Baird 院长 —— 一位总体而言值得敬佩的人物 —— 很有助益，可惜她固执地将自己捆绑在霸主的官僚体系上。"

"若非 Kallichore 的愚蠢行径..." 她的目光变得遥远 —— 更加遥远 —— 片刻后又恢复惯常的漠然。

"在 速子科技，我们最看重的就是不受束缚的研发。特别是其红利。" 她狡黠一笑，"我想，你也这么认为。"

entries.en:
"You've proven useful to Provost Baird. And your accomplishment with the Gates..."

She puts her hands together, not quite a single clap for all you've done. Her politely mechanical smile contains some bitterness, you sense.

"I admire Baird, truly I do. Her ability to overcome Hegemony stone-walling, and herding those academics with their notions... sadly, though, it appears as though her grip was too tight. Pity to lose top talent."

The bitterness, you see, has left Glamor-Rotanev's smile to be replaced with something more carnivorous.

"Our R&D is cutting-edge, eminently practical, and there's very little risk of runaways. Our results might match your ambitions, I think."
entries.zh:
"你已向 Baird 院长证明了自己。而你在星门方面的成就..."

她双手合十，却未能为你所做的一切拍响掌声。你察觉到她那礼貌机械的微笑中带着一丝苦涩。

"我敬佩 Baird，真心实意。她突破 霸主 阻挠的能力，以及她驾驭那些学者们的理念...可惜，似乎她抓得太紧了。损失顶尖人才总是遗憾。"

你看见那抹苦涩已从 Glamor-Rotanev 的微笑中褪去，取而代之的是某种更食肉性的神色。

"我们的研发是最前沿的，极为务实，且失控风险极低。我想，我们的成果或许能匹配你的抱负。"

entries.en:
"I must applaud your patriotism - the Hegemony, the restoration of the Domain!

She makes as if to clap, daintily, but stops her hands before they meet. Then turns her expression toward something far more cynical.

"You may earn the favor of that stubborn 'Old Man Daud'. But is that enough? Surely you tire of that paltry government stipend, the endless regulation? It must stifle your ambition. You must yearn for a truly dynamic enterprise. One in which someone like yourself can change the Sector..."
entries.zh:
"我必须为你的爱国情怀喝彩 —— 为了 霸主，为了 人之领 的复兴！"

她优雅地摆出鼓掌的架势，却在双手相触前停下。随即换上一副远为讥诮的表情。

"你或许能赢得那位固执的 'Daud 老爷子' 的青睐，但这足够吗？你定然已经厌倦那微薄的政府津贴和无尽的规章吧？那必定扼杀了你的雄心。你必然渴望真正充满活力的事业，一个能让你这样的人改变这片星域的事业..."

entries.en:
"You've a League commission. They see value in you, but not so much that they've invited you to share power as a member," she says.

"Why play the mercenary for below-market rates? You're better than that, I think."
entries.zh:
"你持有联盟的雇佣协议。他们看到了你的价值，但并未邀请你作为成员共享权力，" 她说道。

"为何要以低于市场的价格扮演雇佣兵？我想，你值得更好的待遇。"

entries.en:
"You've a League commission. They see value in you," she looks down, and aside, placing a hand on the empty expanse of her enormous desk.

"But not enough to invite you to become a full member of the League, despite your colonial enterprise." She makes a small sound, halfways between pity and disappointment.

"Consider what you will gain from being a partner rather than a subject."
entries.zh:
"你持有联盟的雇佣协议。他们看到了你的价值，" 她垂目侧视，将手放在自己那空阔的巨大桌面上。

"但尽管你有殖民事业，但他们仍未邀请你成为联盟的正式成员。" 她发出轻微的声响，介于怜悯与失望之间。

"不妨想想成为合作伙伴而非从属者后，你将获得什么。"

entries.en:
"You're a member of the League. A junior member, however. Perhaps not in name, but... tell me, do the gens respect you as a peer?"

"Or are you just another vassal to their little empire? Consider your future, captain, and how you might truly achieve greatness."

Her eyes narrow. "As a partner rather than a subject."
entries.zh:
"你是联盟的一员，尽管只是下级成员。或许名义上不是，但...告诉我，氏族势力可曾将你视为平辈？"

"抑或你只是他们那小小帝国的又一个附庸？考量你的未来吧，舰长，思考你该如何真正地成就伟业。"

她眯起眼睛，"以合作伙伴的身份，而非臣属。"

entries.en:
"Tell me the truth, are you content to be a mere lackey of our mutual friend Reynard Hannan? He drains you like a leech from atop his so-called League. Let me give you a taste of real business, of real credits."

Her eyes narrow. "As a partner rather than a subject."
entries.zh:
"说实话，你甘于当我们共同朋友 Reynard Hannan 的区区仆从吗？他高踞在所谓的联盟顶端，如蚂蟥般榨取你的价值。不妨让我带你体验真正的生意，真正的星币。"

她眯起眼睛，"以合作伙伴的身份，而非臣属。"

entries.en:
"You've had a taste of working for the Company. A mundane commission, mercenary fare. Boilerplate. Busywork. We'd have automated all that sort of thing long ago, of course, if not for-"

She pulls her gaze back down. "I digress. You're capable of much more. Think of this as the next step."
entries.zh:
"你已浅尝过为公司效力的滋味。无聊的差事，雇佣兵的薪酬。千篇一律。无谓的忙碌。若非某些原因，我们早该将这类工作全面自动化了 ——"

她将视线收回，"好吧，我有些离题了。我相信你有能力成就更多，远不止于此。请将此视为迈向更高层级的阶梯。"

entries.en:
"You cut a deal with the Company after some... assertive negotiations. To our mutual benefit. I applaud your audacity."

Her teeth glisten.

"Such fierce initiative is exactly what Tri-Tachyon needs."
entries.zh:
"经过一番...强势谈判后，你与公司达成了协议。这对我们双方都有利，我赞赏你的胆识。"

她的牙齿闪闪发光。

"如此凌厉的进取心正是 速子科技 所需要的。"

o.en: I have questions about the 'specimens' I've sold you...
o.zh: 关于卖给你的那些 '样本'，我有些问题想问...

entries.en:
She says nothing, but her eyebrow raises fractionally. It is not an invitation to continue.

Nonetheless.
entries.zh:
她一言不发，只是微不可察地挑了挑眉毛。沉默便是她的回应。

...尽管如此。

o.en: DEV give some special junk and set encountered weirdness
o.zh: DEV give some special junk and set encountered weirdness

entries.en: "Fitting to your talents, I think," she says. "Allow me to iterate your accomplishments briefly so that you know where we stand."
entries.zh: "我认为这符合你的才能，" 她说道，"请允许我简要回顾你的成就，以让你清楚我们现在的立场。"

entries.en:
"Risk of annihilation," she answers placidly. "For which you'll be appropriately compensated."

"Allow me to iterate your accomplishments briefly so that you know I do not make my offer without consideration."
entries.zh:
"尸骨无存的风险，" 她平静地答道，"对此你也将获得相应的补偿。"

"请允许我简要回顾你的成就，以便你知道我的提议并非是轻率之举。"

entries.en:
"The demand for my time is great, thus its premium."

Her lip quirks; not quite worth a smile.

"You must appreciate what I've already invested in you. Further to that point: allow me to iterate your accomplishments briefly so that you know where we stand."
entries.zh:
"我的时间总是供不应求，因此价格不菲。"

她嘴角微动；但并没有露出微笑。

"你必须感谢我对你作出的那些投入。进一步而言：请允许我简要回顾你的成就，以让你清楚我们现在的立场。"

o.zh: 我最爱听这个话题，请继续。

entries.en: The intimation of a smile flits over her expression, though her eyes remain chillingly distant.
entries.zh: 一抹近似微笑的弧度掠过她的面容，但她的双眼依旧保持着令人心寒的疏离感。

entries.en: She gives you a curt look, but no comment.
entries.zh: 她向你投来一个简短的眼神，但未置一词。

entries.en:
Jagged mountain peaks ring the horizon. Gleaming monoliths glitter, spears of capital upthrust through the glowering flesh of the world. Skyarco II grows before you, prismatic.

Your shuttle alights on a landing pad held at some distance from the facade by an airy support rib. It looks impossibly thin, but on touch down feels as solid as a coherent M-type asteroid.
entries.zh:
锯齿状的山峰环绕着地平线。闪闪发光的石碑群是如此璀璨夺目，如同刺穿星球阴郁躯壳的资本长矛。Skyarco II 在你眼前铺展开来，折射着斑斓的光彩。

你的穿梭机降落在停机坪上，这片平台由轻盈的支撑肋骨托举悬空于建筑立面之外。它看似脆弱得不可思议，但着陆时却坚实如一块完整的 M 型小行星。

entries.en:
You step onto a perfectly dry pad. A shimmer as wind drives a burst of rain into the atmo-field betrays the artifice of this pocket of calm.

You are invited inside by an obsequious corporate usher.
entries.zh:
你踏上保持着完美干燥的停机坪。一阵风将雨水卷进大气防护场时泛起的微光，揭示了这片宁静表象的人工本质。

一位殷勤的企业礼宾员将你引入了室内。

entries.en:
The architecture of Skyarco II's interior and its integrated art-installations are titanic in scale and inhuman in affect. Your attention is subtly drawn toward geometric motifs suggestive of a mathematical intricacy which would reward close study with nothing less than delight, and...

"It was designed by an Artificial Intelligence," the cheerful secretary behind the reception desk informs you, breaking the trance. "Before the ban imposed by the Hegemony, of course."

"The piece is explicitly referent-free to reflect the pure universe of interstellar markets which invite every new partner to participate in Tri-Tachyon's enterprise!"
entries.zh:
Skyarco II 的内部建筑与融合在其中的艺术装置，其规模堪称泰坦巨构，氛围却透着非人的冷峻。你的注意力被微妙地引向几何图案 —— 它们暗示着数学般的精妙结构，如果细细品味，必将收获无上的愉悦，并且...

"这是由人工智能设计的，" 前台那位笑容可掬的秘书打破了你的出神状态，"当然是在 霸主 颁布禁令之前。"

"这件作品刻意避免了任何参照物，旨在映射纯粹的星际市场宇宙 —— 它正邀请每位新伙伴加入 速子科技 的商业版图！"

o.en: I'm here to see Director Glamor-Rotanev.
o.zh: 我来这儿是为了见 Glamor-Rotenev 总监。

entries.en: "It is, isn't it?" the secretary agrees cheerfully.
entries.zh: "确实如此，不是吗？" 秘书欢快的附和道。

entries.en:
"Of course, $playerSirOrMadam," the secretary says with a smile. "The Director asked that you head right in."

The lighting of the richly furnished entryway - is that a mercury fountain? - warms slightly, inviting you to proceed.
entries.zh:
"当然，$playerSirOrMadam，" 秘书微笑着说。"总监请您直接进去。"

华贵装潢的门厅里 —— 那是个水银喷泉吗？—— 灯光微微转暖，邀请你前行。

o.en: Enter the office of the Director of Special Acquisitions
o.zh: 进入特殊采购部总监的办公室。

entries.en:
A plane of glass - diamond-matrix, naturally - stretches in both directions to the edge of your peripheral vision, its extent blocked only by a set of cyclopean interior columns. Misty mountains and towering arcologies wreathed in rain clouds hang in the vista beyond.

Before you, a figure sits - now stands - behind a monolithic desk stark as a planetoid scraped bare by pulsar beam.

The Director of "Special Acquisitions".

A hand raises, open, to invite you to sit. A seat appears.
entries.zh:
一片玻璃平台 —— 自然是由金刚石方窗组成 —— 向两侧延伸至视野尽头，边界仅被一排独眼巨人般的室内立柱所阻隔。朦胧的群山和耸立的生态都市群间缭绕着雨云，悬垂天边。

在你面前，一道身影端坐 —— 旋即起身 —— 于一张浑如小行星般的巨大办公桌后，桌面光洁如同被脉冲星冲刷过一样。

"特殊采购部" 的总监。

她抬手，手掌打开，邀你入座。一张座椅旋即出现。

entries.en:
"Captain $playerName. I offer vast wealth in exchange for your unique facility in navigating exceptional scenarios."

She blinks once. Her gaze is fixed on you, but you can't help but feel it is slightly vague, apparently attentive but not present in spirit. The look of a cyber-aug.

Her tech must be absolutely top-of-the-line, of course.
entries.zh:
"$playerName 舰长。我愿以巨额的财富，换取您于特殊情境中那无可替代的航行才能。"

她眨了下眼，目光锁定在你身上。但你不禁感觉那眼神有点飘忽，看似专注却神游他处 —— 那是神经植入体使用者特有的眼神。

她的技术植入体肯定是最顶级的，毋庸置疑。

o.en: I'll hear you out. What's the proposal?
o.zh: 我洗耳恭听，你的提议是什么？

o.en: Directly to business, huh? No small-talk?
o.zh: 这就直奔主题了，嗯？不先寒暄几下？

entries.en: Glamor-Rotanev remains standing to match.
entries.zh: Glamor-Rotanev 保持站立来配合高度。

o.en: Take a shuttle to visit Director of Special Acquisitions Glamor-Rotanev
o.zh: 搭乘穿梭机前往拜访特殊采购部总监 Glamor-Rotanev

entries.en:
Your shuttle descends into the young atmosphere of Eochu Bres, through towering battlements of clouds. A spray of rain darkens your viewport for a moment before it is wiped clean by the heat and speed of your descent.

The flight path immediately deviates from the general approach corridor which had started ticking off minor use-fees from the Tri-Tachyon owned flight control: general volume access fee, priority flight lane fee, service fee, customer satisfaction insurance charge, advertisement bypass fee.

The notifications self-delete, their fees automatically refunded, as the towering central arcologies of Xanadu emerge from the mist.
entries.zh:
你的穿梭机降入了 Eochu Bres 刚形成不久的大气层，在犹如城垛般的高耸云层间穿行。一阵雨雾喷洒在你的视窗上，又随即被降下时的热量和速度擦拭干净。

飞行路线立刻就偏离了一般的进场通道，并引发了一堆来自 速子科技 航空管制的小额扣费：基本空域通行费、优先航路附加费、服务费、客户满意度保险费、广告屏蔽费，

当 Xanadu 高耸的核心生态都市群从薄雾中显现时，这些通知便自行删除了，所有费用也自动进行了退还。

entries.en:
Your comms are routed through a secretary, either a holosim or product of uncanny cosmetic and behavior tuning, then, after a brief wait, the link blinks to Director Glamor-Rotanev.

"Captain $playerLastName," she says with diminishing breeziness.
entries.zh:
你的通讯经由秘书转接 —— 可能是全息模拟体，也可能经过精妙外貌与行为调校的仿生体。短暂等待后，链接闪烁切换至 Glamor-Rotanev 总监的画面。

"$playerLastName 舰长，" 她的语气逐渐凝重。

entries.en:
Your comms are routed through a secretary, either a holosim or product of uncanny cosmetic and behavior tuning, then, after a brief wait, the link blinks to Director Glamor-Rotanev.

"Captain $playerLastName," she says, then pauses. "You found something, didn't you."
entries.zh:
你的通讯经由秘书转接 —— 可能是全息模拟体，也可能经过精妙外貌与行为调校的仿生体。短暂等待后，链接闪烁切换至 Glamor-Rotanev 总监的画面。

"$playerLastName 舰长，" 她说道，随后顿了顿，"你有所发现，是吗。"

o.en: I found... many things. And an Onslaught Mk.I.
o.zh: 我发现了...许多东西，以及一艘 攻势 Mk.I。

o.en: I believe I found what you're looking for. And more.
o.zh: 我相信我找到了你一直在寻找的东西，而且更多。

o.en: I found something... hostile. In the Abyss.
o.zh: 我发现了某些...敌对个体，就在深渊中。

entries.en:
The comms flick into an active feed nearly instantly.

"Captain," Director Glamor-Rotanev greets you, simply. "I was just admiring your new acquisition."

Her eyes flicker oddly, and you detect what might be a rare spark of genuine amusement.

"Or perhaps it is better described as your very, very old acquisition."
entries.zh:
通讯几乎在瞬间切入了激活状态。

"舰长，" Glamor-Rotanev 总监简单地打了招呼，"我方才正在欣赏你的新藏品。"

她的眼眸不自然地闪烁着，你察觉到其中或许夹杂着一丝罕见的真切趣味。

"或许称之为你极其、极其古老的藏品更为贴切。"

o.en: I believe I've found what you're looking for.
o.zh: 我相信我找到了你一直在寻找的东西。

o.en: Yes, I have an Onslaught Mk.I.
o.zh: 是的，我得到了一艘 攻势 Mk.I。
是的，我确实找到了一些东西。

entries.en:
She blinks. Her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time. And she stares for several seconds, motionless.

"You're telling the truth," she says, outwardly cool.

"Would you part with recordings of your encounters with both of these... forces? I offer 150,000 credits for immediate transfer."
entries.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注。她凝视数秒，纹丝不动。

"你说的是真话，" 她说道，外表依然冷静。

"你是否愿意出售你与这两股...势力遭遇的影像记录？我出 150,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

entries.en: "So you are open to dealing," she says. "Good."
entries.zh: "所以你愿意交易，" 她说道，"很好。"

entries.en: "You've been most useful," she says, almost actually smiling. It looks uncomfortable.
entries.zh: "你贡献卓著，" 她说道，几乎真的露出了微笑，看上去极不自然。

entries.en:
"Old records," she says curtly.

"The Galatia Academy doesn't know what it has, much less how to make good use of it. Their lack of self-motivation is self-evident."
entries.zh:
"旧档案，" 她简短地说道。

"Galatia 学院根本不清楚自己拥有什么，更别说善加利用。他们缺乏主观能动性的事实显而易见。"

entries.en:
"Crews talk, TriPads listen. There is little I cannot know if I so wish," she says, injecting a tone of boredom into her words.

"Accept it. Now let's speak of business."
entries.zh:
"船员会闲聊，TriPad 会监听。只要我意愿，便鲜有不能知晓之事，" 她的话语中掺入一丝厌倦的腔调。

"接受现实吧。现在让我们谈谈正事。"

entries.en:
She laughs with a buzz like a malfunctioning agrav plate.

"Oh, no. That'd be far too provocative to..." She gives a little flick of the hand, indicating enemies too irrelevant to bother acknowledging in speech.

The Hegemony, maybe.

"However," she fixes upon you. "I would gladly pay for the opportunity to have my people take a close look at it. And take a few samples, very small, nothing damaging."
entries.zh:
她的笑声像故障的反重力板般震颤作响。

"哦，不。那未免过于挑衅..." 她轻轻摆手，示意某些敌人不值一提，甚至不配被言语提及。

那或许是指 霸主。

"不过，" 她的目光锁定于你，"我很乐意为我的团队争取近距离研究的机会，并提取少量样本 —— 极其微小，绝无损害。"

o.en: You can't detect them, can you. That's what you want.
o.zh: 你无法探测到它们，对吧。这就是你想要的。

entries.en:
She blinks. "Detect them?"

Her voice is emotionless.
entries.zh:
她眨了眨眼。"探测它们？"

她的声音没有任何情绪。

o.en: The Threat. They're all but invisible to you.
o.zh: '威胁'，它们对你而言几乎不可见。

entries.en:
Her face arranges itself into a shape suggesting dismissive amusement.

"What an interesting theory, captain. Whatever my motives, will you agree to my proposal? A simple look, a few scans. A few samples."
entries.zh:
她的脸上显露出一种轻蔑的趣味。

"多么有趣的理论，舰长。无论我的动机如何，你是否同意我的提议？只需要简单的观察，几次扫描，以及少许样本。"

entries.en:
"Fine," she says, the spite cold in her voice.

"You've seen them. The Threat. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss. And you lived." She is quite collected, suddenly, as she speaks.

"Would you part with recordings of your encounter with the Threat? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
entries.zh:
"很好，" 她说道，声音里的恶意冰冷而刺骨。

"你见过它们了。'威胁'。深渊深处古老的自动化作战舰队。而你活了下来。" 在陈述时，她突然变得异常冷静。

"你是否愿意出售你与威胁遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

entries.en: She says nothing, her disapproval resounding in the silence.
entries.zh: 她不置一词，异议在沉默中掷地有声。

entries.en:
A long pause. Her eyes flicker, accessing. Calculating.

"This is possible." She speaks with an emotion suddenly present - quiet displeasure, presumably at your maneuvering.

"You ask for much, captain."
entries.zh:
通讯陷入了漫长的沉默。她眼眸闪烁，表明她正在访问数据，计算权衡。

"这是可行的。" 她的语气突然有了一些情绪 —— 一种平静的不悦，大概由于你的迂回策略。

"你要价不菲，舰长。"

o.en: Tri-Tachyon's Director of Special Acquisitions can afford a mere million credits. I accept.
o.zh: 速子科技 的特殊采购部总监还是出得起一百万星币的。我接受。

entries.en:
"Done," she says, her voice as empty as the Abyss.

Almost instantly, your TriPad pings with several alerts - credits transfer, but also notification from your tactical officer concerning an approaching Tri-Tachyon portside-tender, swarming with engineering drones, and your comms, forwarding certain docking requests directly to the Onslaught Mk.I.

"Take a moment to ensure your affairs are in order, captain," Glamor-Rotanev says.

You'd think she enjoys overwhelming your officers with the speed of her response.
entries.zh:
"成交，" 她的声音像深渊一样空洞。

几乎同时，你的 TriPad 接连弹出数条通知 —— 星币到账，而你的战术军官也发来警示：一艘 满载工程无人机的 速子科技 泊位服务艇正逐步靠近，同时通讯系统也开始将某些对接请求直接转发至 攻势 Mk.I。

"请花些时间确认事务已安排妥当，舰长，" Glamor-Rotanev 说道。

你不禁怀疑她很享受用这种迅捷的回应让你的部下疲于应付的快感。

entries.en:
Director Glamor-Rotanev takes a moment to turn and appear to look out over her spectacular view of the Xanadu Geodivision.

You're certain she's watching her teams as they board the Onslaught Mk.I through what are no doubt top-of-the-line cybernetic implants and neural integrations.

And, doubtless, watching your comms. Because just as you are finished, she turns back, resettling her facial muscles with a twitch.
entries.zh:
Glamor-Rotanev 总监稍作停顿，随即便转身望向窗外 Xanadu 地质区划那壮丽的景色。

你确信她正通过顶级的赛博植入体与神经集成系统，监控着她的团队登上 攻势 Mk.I 的过程。

并且，毫无疑问，她也正在监视着你的通讯。因为就在你刚刚结束事务时，她便转回身，面部肌肉抽动着重新调整着表情。

entries.en:
"As I was saying, I have a great interest in... specimens. Artifacts. Like yours. And like what I presume it was built to fight," she says.

"You have been far more successful than the others. I would propose you repeat that success."
entries.zh:
"正如我所说，我对...标本有着浓厚的兴趣。遗物，像你拥有的那种，以及我推测它被制造出来所要对抗的那种东西。" 她说道。

"你比其他人成功得多，而我提议你应该重现那份成功。"

o.en: So there was another expedition before me?
o.zh: 所以在我之前还有另一支科考队？

entries.en:
"As I was saying, I have a great interest in... specimens. Artifacts. Like yours. And like what I presume it was built to fight," she says.

"You have been far more successful than the others. I would propose you repeat that success."
entries.zh:
"正如我所说，我对...标本有着浓厚的兴趣。遗物，像你拥有的那种，以及我推测它被制造出来所要对抗的那种东西。" 她说道。

"你比其他人成功得多，而我提议你应该重现那份成功。"

entries.en:
Her eyes flicker subtly, her expression more glazed and vacant than before.

"Very... good, captain," she says. Her words come more rapidly. "You've seen them. The Threat. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss. And you lived."

"Would you part with recordings of your encounter with the Threat? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
entries.zh:
她的眼睑微微地颤动着，神情比先前更加呆滞与空洞。

"非常...好，舰长，" 她说道，语速明显加快，"你见过它们了。'威胁'。深渊深处古老的自动化作战舰队。而你活了下来。"

"你是否愿意出售你与威胁遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

entries.en:
"That is speculation for the research division. Or perhaps you would care to ask a philosopher? Or a curate?" This last idea appears to amuse her, insofar as she is capable of expressing that, or any, emotion.

"My interest is in what these specimens, these phenomena, can DO. For me. Or the Company."

She pulls her glassy eyes back to the comm-link.

"For humanity. At least that small percentage of it willing to accept the radical and necessary future."
entries.zh:
"那是研究部门的推测范畴。或许你更倾向于询问哲学家？或是祭司？" 最后这个念头似乎令她感到有趣 —— 在她所能表达的情绪范围内。

"我的兴趣在于这些样本，这些现象，能 '做什么'。为我，为公司。"

她将玻璃般的眼睛重新聚焦到通讯链接上。

"为人类。至少是为那些愿意接受这激进而必要的未来的那少数人。"

o.en: Do you know what these 'other' specimens... are?
o.zh: 你知道这些 '其他' 样本...是什么吗？

entries.en:
"Research and development."

The Director releases a deliberate breath.

"We know it isn't human. We know it is powerful. The return on investment, therefore, is beyond human imagination."

She looks satisfied with the thought.
entries.zh:
"研究与开发。"

总监长吁了一口气。

"我们知道那不是人类。我们知道它力量强大。因此，投资的回报将超乎人类的想象。"

她对这番构想显得心满意足。

o.en: The 'other' specimens- what do you intend to do with them?
o.zh: 那些 '其他' 的样本 —— 你打算如何处置它们？

o.en: I've been thinking about your offer concerning the Onslaught Mk.I.
o.zh: 我一直在考虑你是否会提出一些关于 攻势 Mk.I 的提议。

entries.en:
Her eyes flicker oddly.

"You've revised your position?"
entries.zh:
她的眼睛异样地闪动着。

"你改变主意了？"

o.en: My position is one million credits.
o.zh: 我的主意是一百万星币。

entries.en:
She leans back ever so slightly, but makes no outward response.

Her expression hasn't changed, but it feels somehow more impatient.
entries.zh:
她极其轻微地向后靠了靠，但未流露出任何外在反应。

她的表情虽无变化，却莫名透出更多的不耐烦。

entries.en:
She leans back ever so slightly, but makes no outward response.

Her expression hasn't changed, but it feels somehow more impatient.
entries.zh:
她极其轻微地向后靠了靠，但未流露出任何外在反应。

她的表情虽无变化，却莫名透出更多的不耐烦。

entries.en:
Her eyes flicker subtly, her expression more glazed and vacant than before.

"Very... good, captain," she says.
entries.zh:
她的眼睑微微地颤动着，神情比先前更加呆滞与空洞。

"非常...好，舰长，" 她说道。

o.en: I understand you've been funding Cornelius Elek. Giving him ideas.
o.zh: 据我所知，你一直在资助 Cornelius Elek，还为他出了许多主意。

entries.en:
The Director's face creates a smile.

"He wasn't supposed to tell anyone. But this is Cornelius Elek, so I cannot be surprised."

Her face, and tone, go blank again.

"You have something more to say about Elek. Proceed."
entries.zh:
总监的脸上勉强挤出一个微笑。"他不该告诉任何人的。不过 Cornelius Elek 就是这样，总管不住自己的嘴。"

她的表情和语调平淡下去。

"关于 Elek，你还有什么想问的就问吧。"

o.en: He was looking into an old sensor array. It found the Onslaught Mk.I.
o.zh: 他在调查一个老旧的传感器阵列。而这传感器阵列带我找到了 攻势 Mk.I。

entries.en:
"Old records," she says.

"The Galatia Academy doesn't know what it has, much less how to make good use of it. They lack appropriate motivation to exploit their own resources."
entries.zh:
"旧档案，" 她简短地说道。

"Galatia 学院根本不清楚自己拥有什么，更别说善加利用。他们缺乏主观能动性的事实显而易见。"

o.en: Elek prefers his science abstract and very far away, I think.
o.zh: 我觉得 Elek 更偏爱抽象且十分遥远的科学。

o.en: You prompted him. How did you know what that sensor array found?
o.zh: 是你推动了他。你怎么知道那个传感器阵列发现了什么？

o.en: Do you want to buy the Onslaught Mk.I from me?
o.zh: 你想从我这儿买下 攻势 Mk.I 吗？

o.en: I've been thinking about your offer concerning the Onslaught Mk.I.
o.zh: 我一直在考虑你是否会提出一些关于 攻势 Mk.I 的提议。
我们还是谈谈别的事吧。

entries.en:
She nods slowly, once.

"It will take some time, and credits, for him to become a useful asset again. It is much as any investment."
entries.zh:
她缓缓地点了一下头。

"让他重新成为可用的资产需要时间，也需要星币。这与任何投资都无异。"

o.en: So was the payoff worth the investment?
o.zh: 那么你的投资是否得到了相称的回报？

o.en: That's a cold way to put it. He's a human being, even if he's.. him.
o.zh: 这种说法真是冷酷。他也是人类，即便他...是那样的人。

entries.en: "I cannot answer, as that investment has not fully matured," she says. "Which brings me to business."
entries.zh: "我无法回答，因为这项投资尚未完全成熟，" 她说道，"这便引出了正题。"

entries.en: "Your impulse to moralize is irrelevant to my interests," she says. "Let us return to business."
entries.zh: "你道德化的冲动与我的利益无关，" 她说道，"让我们回归正题。"

entries.en: Her eyes fix upon you through the link. "And that business is the Onslaught Mk.I, which you found."
entries.zh: 她的目光透过通讯链接锁定着你。"而正题便是 攻势 Mk.I，也就是你所发现的那艘舰船。"

entries.en: Her eyes fix upon you through the link. "And that business is acquisition of additional samples from the Abyss."
entries.zh: 她隔着链接定定地看着你。"那桩差事，就是从深渊再多弄些样本回来。"

entries.en: "What made you think that, I wonder," she says.
entries.zh: "是什么让你这么想的，我很好奇。" 她说道。

o.en: Because you're Tri-Tachyon's Director of 'Special Acquisitions'.
o.zh: 因为你是 速子科技 的 '特殊采购部' 总监

entries.en:
Glamor-Rotanev creates a smile for you.

"Yes, I was admiring your new acquisition." Her eyes flicker oddly, and you detect what might be a rare spark of genuine amusement.

"Or perhaps I should call it your very, very old acquisition."
entries.zh:
Glamor-Rotanev 向你展示出一个微笑。

"不错，我方才正在欣赏你的新藏品。" 她的眼眸不自然地闪烁着，你察觉到其中或许夹杂着一丝罕见的真切趣味。

"或许我该称之为你极其、极其古老的藏品。"

entries.en:
Glamor-Rotanev creates a smile for you.

"And you acquired something special indeed. Elek was distraught, I am to understand."

Her eyes flicker oddly, and you detect what might be a rare spark of genuine amusement.
entries.zh:
Glamor-Rotanev 向你展示出一个微笑。

"然后你找到了它。" 她对这消息听起来并不惊讶，"据我所知，Elek 当时悲痛欲绝。"

她的眼眸不自然地闪烁着，你察觉到其中或许夹杂着一丝罕见的真切趣味。

entries.en:
Glamor-Rotanev creates a smile for you.

"And you found what he didn't know he was looking for." She sounds unsurprised. "Elek was distraught, I am to understand."

Her eyes flicker oddly, and you detect what might be a rare spark of genuine amusement.
entries.zh:
Glamor-Rotanev为你展露一个微笑。

"而你找到了那件东西，那件他不曾自知在寻找的东西。" 她的语气毫无意外，"据我所知，Elek 当时悲痛欲绝。"

她的眼眸不自然地闪烁着，你察觉到其中或许夹杂着一丝罕见的真切趣味。

entries.en: "Oh?" The Director's face is immobile.
entries.zh: "哦？" 总监的面容纹丝不动。

o.en: Yes. I thought you might be involved.
o.zh: 是的，我觉得你可能会牵涉其中。

entries.en: She makes no response.
entries.zh: 她没有回答。

entries.en:
"Then this topic serves no more purpose," she says frostily.

"Anything else?"
entries.zh:
"那么这个话题已经没有继续的必要了，" 她冷冰冰地说道。

"还有其他事吗？"

entries.en:
"I am satisfied, $playerName."

It's not that her tone is warm, more that it lacks a certain otherwise ubiquitous contempt perceivable only now by its absence.

Presumably temporary, of course.
entries.zh:
"我很满意，$playerName。"

并非是她的语气变得温暖，而是缺少了某种无处不在的轻蔑 —— 这种轻蔑此刻因缺席而格外明显。

当然，这大概只是暂时的。

entries.en: "It was not the 'Threat'," she says. It doesn't sound like a question.
entries.zh: "那不是 '威胁'，" 她说道，这句话听来并非是疑问。

o.en: No. But you already know that, don't you.
o.zh: 没什么。但你早就知道了，不是吗。

entries.en: "Tell me what you found."
entries.zh: "告诉我你都找到了什么。"

entries.en:
She blinks once.

"Tell me what you found."
entries.zh:
她眨了一下眼。

"告诉我你都找到了什么。"

entries.en: "Tell me what you found."
entries.zh: "告诉我你都找到了什么。"

entries.en:
Her eyes, previously distant, stare at you through the link for a several seconds before she replies.

"I am eager to reward you for your work." Her tone is not inviting. "CEO Sun is in full agreement. There are extraordinary discoveries and profits to be made. I am uninterested in an obstinate parody of negotiation."
entries.zh:
她原本疏离的目光，此刻透过链接凝视着你数秒之久，才终于回应。

"我也渴望为你的工作支付酬劳。" 她的语气毫无示好之意，"CEO Sun 完全赞同，那其中蕴含着非凡的发现与利润潜力。而我对这种顽固的谈判闹剧毫无兴趣。"

o.en: And I am eager to be paid. You got me.
o.zh: 我正渴望着报酬呢，你可踩到我的点了。

entries.en:
"Don't act this obstinate pretense of negotiation. You $shipOrFleet has been scanned. And we knew what you found well before you arrived anyway." She pauses quite consciously.

"I am... most eager to reward your work."

Despite her words, the tone is icy. "CEO Sun is in full agreement. We may share in extraordinary discoveries and profits."
entries.zh:
"别摆出这副顽固的谈判姿态，你的$shipOrFleet已被扫描。而且早在你抵达之前，我们就已知晓你的发现。" 她有意识地顿了顿。

"而我...也极度渴望酬谢你的工作。"

尽管措辞如此，她的语气却依然冰冷刺骨。"CEO Sun 完全赞同，我们可以共享非凡的发现与利润。"

o.en: What I found was... hostile. And Inhuman.
o.zh: 我发现了...敌对个体，而且是非人的。

entries.en: Her expression remains frozen with disdainful impatience.
entries.zh: 她的表情依然凝固着轻蔑的烦躁。

entries.en:
"Something." She raises an eyebrow.

"It was not human or AI-derived." This doesn't sound like a question.
entries.zh:
"某些个体。" 她挑起一侧眉毛。

"那不是人类或 AI 的产物。" 这听来并非是疑问。

entries.en:
"Excellent."

To your shock, her smile is nearly human. The mask is replaced almost instantly, though a slackening echo of the expression remains on her lips.

"I, and my researchers, are most eager to examine your findings. And you to be paid, no doubt."
entries.zh:
"好极了。"

令你震惊的是，她的微笑竟近乎人类。虽然那副面具在转瞬间便恢复原状，但那抹神情的余韵仍在她的唇边萦绕不去。

"我和我的研究员们都十分渴望检视你的发现，而你无疑也渴望获得报酬。"

entries.en:
"It pleases me to hear that." She doesn't smile.

"I, and my researchers, are most eager to examine your findings. And you to be paid, no doubt.
entries.zh:
"这消息让我很高兴。" 她并没有微笑。

"我和我的研究员们都十分渴望检视你的发现，而你无疑也渴望获得报酬。"

entries.en:
The link settles on feed of volatiles futures scrolling across the crest of the Tri-Tachyon corporation for just a moment before the comm-link connects you with a perfectly coiffed junior secretary.

"The Tri-Tachyon Corporation welcomes you to Eochu Bres." Their smile is uncannily bright. "May we presume you wish to accept Director Glamor-Rotanev's invitation?"
entries.zh:
链接短暂定格在 三一速子科技公司 徽标背景上滚动显示的挥发物期货界面，随即一位梳妆打扮十分完美的下级秘书接受了你的通讯请求。

"速子科技 欢迎您莅临 Eochu Bres。" 那人的笑容异常灿烂，"请问您是否准备接受 Glamor-Rotanev 总监的邀请？"

o.en: Yes, I'd like to hear her proposal.
o.zh: 是的，我想听听她的提议。

entries.en:
"Fantastic. A priority flight path has been pre-approved for your convenience. The Tri-Tachyon Corporation is pleased to wish you a most profitable meeting with the Director of Special Acquisitions."

The uncanny smile re-appears, perfectly, once more. It's a little unsettling.
entries.zh:
"太好了。为方便您出行，我们已经预先核准了一条优先飞行航线。三一速子科技公司 谨祝您与特殊采购部总监的会晤收获丰硕。"

那瘆人的标准完美笑容再次浮现，略微令人不适。

o.en: Take a shuttle to visit Director of Special Acquisitions Glamor-Rotanev
o.zh: 搭乘穿梭机前往拜访特殊采购部总监 Glamor-Rotanev

entries.en:
"Fantastic." The face maintains an uncanny smile. "The Director is most eager to meet you."

An apologetic - but not guilty - expression forms. "Unfortunately, the automated defenses of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation have flagged your ID as a hostile and your shuttle would be gunned down upon approach. Please contact customer service to resolve this misunderstanding."

"We hope you have a pleasant and profitable day."

The smile re-appears.
entries.zh:
"太好了。" 那张面孔维持着瘆人的微笑，"总监非常期待与您会面。"

一个抱歉 —— 却非愧疚 —— 的表情随即浮现。"遗憾的是，三一速子科技公司 的自动化防御系统已将您的 ID 标记为敌对单位，您的穿梭机将在接近时遭受火力拦截。请联系客服部门以化解此次误会。"

"祝您度过愉快且收益丰厚的一天。"

那微笑又再度浮现。

entries.en: "Now allow me to explain the shape of our partnership."
entries.zh: "现在请允许我阐明我们合作关系的框架。"

entries.en: "Whatever your other, lesser accomplishments, there is one in particular which is why you are here. You found something very old in the Abyss. Something known to history as the Onslaught Mk.I, which is of interest to me."
entries.zh: "无论你有哪些次要的收获，唯有一项收获令你此刻站在这里。你在深渊中发现了非常古老的存在，历史上被称为 攻势 Mk.I 的存在，而这正令我产生兴趣。"

entries.en: "Whatever your other, lesser accomplishments, there is one in particular which is why you are here. The ship is in your fleet - what is known to history as the Onslaught Mk.I, which is of interest to me."
entries.zh: "无论你有哪些次要的收获，唯有一项收获令你此刻站在这里。那所正位于你舰队中的舰船 —— 历史上被称为 攻势 Mk.I 的存在，而这正令我产生兴趣。"

entries.en:
She pauses a moment, eyes black.

"I shall make my proposal shortly. First, allow me to elaborate on a shape for our partnership."
entries.zh:
她停顿片刻，双眼漆黑。

"我将很快提出我的方案。首先，请允许我进一步阐述我们合作关系的框架。"

entries.en: "You know my title. I take a portion of surplus capital from the Company and invest it in what we like to call 'black sky initiatives'."
entries.zh: "你知道我的头衔。我从公司提取部分盈余的资本，投入我们称之为 '黑天计划' 的领域。"

entries.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting your expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."
entries.zh: "我坚持要求你不计成本地为科考任务配给物资，携带远超预估需求的燃料与补给，以免像那些 —— 算了，不提他们了。你是赢家，而我们只押注赢家。"

o.en: Like the who? Was there another expedition before me?
o.zh: 像哪些人？难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

entries.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting another expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."
entries.zh: "我要求你不惜工本，再备一支探险队。燃料和补给，比你估摸着够用的再多带些，免得落得像那——算了，不提他们。你是赢家，我们只押赢家。"

o.en: Like the who? Was there another expedition before me?
o.zh: 像谁？我之前还有过一支探险队？

entries.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting your expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."
entries.zh: "我要求你不惜工本，把队伍装备停当。燃料和补给，比你估摸着够用的再多带些，免得落得像那——算了，不提他们。你是赢家，我们只押赢家。"

o.en: Like the who? Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?
o.zh: 像谁？我之前还有一支成了事的探险队？

entries.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting another expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."
entries.zh: "我要求你不惜工本，再备一支探险队。燃料和补给，比你估摸着够用的再多带些，免得落得像那——算了，不提他们。你是赢家，我们只押赢家。"

o.en: Like the who? Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?
o.zh: 像谁？我之前还有一支成了事的探险队？

entries.en:
"'Was there another...'" she says, repeating your words.

"Dozens! Some returned with nothing, others not at all. I won't conceal the fact from you. Maybe you'll find them, though don't feel compelled to render assistance on behalf of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. These were independent contractors who accepted and assumed the risk. Then failed."

"If anything," she says quietly, "we have grounds to sue them if they ever manage to get back to the Core Worlds."
entries.zh:
"'还有另一支...' 她重复你的话。

"还有几十支！他们有的空手而归，有的杳无音信，我不会对你隐瞒事实。或许你会遇到他们，但不必代表 三一速子科技公司 施以援手。这些都是接受并承担了风险的独立承包商，然后失败了。"

"甚至可以说，" 她低声道，"如果他们能侥幸返回核心世界，我们完全有理由起诉他们。"

entries.en:
"Return with something useful," she says, turning her back to you to look upon the vista of mountaintops and shining arcologies growing like crystals from the slums of Eochu Bres.

"And I'll make you glitter."
entries.zh:
"带回有价值的东西，" 她转身背对你，望向地平线上如水晶般的，从 Eochu Bres 贫民窟生长而出的闪亮生态都市群。

"之后我就将让你光芒万丈。"

entries.en:
"Bring me more... samples. From the Abyss," she says, turning her back to you to look upon the vista of mountaintops and shining arcologies growing like crystals from the slums of Eochu Bres.

"And I'll make you glitter."
entries.zh:
"再给我多带些...样本。从深渊里带，" 她说着背过身去，望向窗外——Eochu Bres 的贫民窟里，群峰与闪亮的生态巨城像水晶一样拔地而起。

"我会让你也闪闪发光。"

entries.en:
"Return with more finds," she says, turning her back to you to look upon the vista of mountaintops and shining arcologies growing like crystals from the slums of Eochu Bres.

"And I'll make you glitter."
entries.zh:
"带回更多的发现，" 她转身背对你，望向地平线上如水晶般的，从 Eochu Bres 贫民窟生长而出的闪亮生态都市群。

"之后我就将让你光芒万丈。"

entries.en:
"There are unimaginable possibilities out there." She raises an arm, hand extended, fingers like rays into the far, dark corners of the cavernous office.

You sense the lights dim slightly - a dramatic effect triggered by her cybernetic implants, no doubt.
entries.zh:
"那里蕴藏着无法想象的可能性。" 她抬起手臂，伸出手掌，手指如光芒般射向这间巨型办公室深处幽暗的角落。

你察觉到灯光变得略微黯淡 —— 无疑是她的赛博植入体触发的浮夸效果。

entries.en:
"I take the very long shots. There are things," she stresses the word oddly, "Such things out there, captain. Technologies and phenomena the Human Domain hid away, and from. They locked such wonders and treasures up in red-tape concocted by fearful, jealous little minds. They suffocated these opportunities, blinded themselves to unimaginable possibilities."

"The returns from exploitation would be... astronomical. Or perhaps," her eyes glint in the filtered starlight, "They may prove to be of value well beyond that of mere stars."
entries.zh:
"我专攻那些极低概率的机会。那里存在着，" 她异常地重读这个词，"那样的事物，舰长。人之领 曾隐藏 —— 并逃避 —— 的技术与现象。他们用怯懦而狭隘的头脑炮制的官僚程序，将这些奇迹与珍宝禁锢起来。他们扼杀了这些机遇，对无法想象的可能性视而不见。"

"开发这些事物带来的回报将是...天文数字。或者，" 她的眼眸在过滤的星光下闪烁着，"它们可能被证明拥有远超星辰的价值。"

o.en: Returns, you say. That sounds like a lot of credits.
o.zh: 你说回报吗？听起来是笔巨款。

o.en: Exploration and new technology are of interest to me.
o.zh: 探索与新技术正是我的兴趣所在。

o.en: You speak of meddling in things which should be left alone.
o.zh: 你这是在干涉本应该保持原状的事物。

o.en: I found some mercs in the Abyss who appeared to regret their deal with you.
o.zh: 我在深渊里遇到了一些佣兵，他们似乎对和你的交易颇为后悔。

o.en: Returns, you say. That sounds like a lot of credits.
o.zh: 你说回报吗？听起来是笔巨款。

o.en: Exploration and new technology is of interest to me.
o.zh: 探索与新技术正是我的兴趣所在。

o.en: You speak of meddling in things which should be left alone.
o.zh: 你这是在干涉本应该保持原状的事物。

entries.en: "It is," she smiles, teeth jewel-like. "And I'll ensure that you receive your share."
entries.zh: "是的，" 她微笑着，牙齿如珠宝般闪烁，"我会确保你获得应得的份额。"

entries.en: "Then I think we shall work well together," she says.
entries.zh: "那么我想我们会合作得很愉快，" 她说道。

entries.en: "Yes. Does that frighten you?" she asks.
entries.zh: "是的。这让你感到恐惧吗？" 她问道。

o.en: Yes. I'd be a fool if I did not fear what's out there.
o.zh: 是的。如果不对那里的存在心怀敬畏，那我才真是愚蠢。

o.en: Yes. Which is why I require adequate compensation.
o.zh: 是的。正因如此，我需要获得充分的补偿。

entries.en: "Of course," she says, allowing a trace of amusement to enter her voice.
entries.zh: "当然，" 她说道，话音里渗入了一丝玩味。

entries.en:
"I see," she says after a moment.

"I trust that you shall ensure your executive judgment is merely tempered, not impaired, by such sentiment."
entries.zh:
"我明白了，" 她停顿片刻后说道。

"我相信你会确保这种情绪仅仅只会调节，而非削弱你的决策判断力。"

entries.en:
She pauses a moment, making no outward reaction to your bravado.

"I see," she allows, finally.
entries.zh:
她停顿片刻，对你的虚张声势未表现出任何外在反应。

"我明白了，" 她最终允许道。

entries.en:
She pauses a moment, making no outward reaction to your pretense of bravado.

"I see," she allows, finally.
entries.zh:
她停顿片刻，对你佯装的虚张声势未表现出任何外在反应。

"我明白了，" 她最终允许道。

entries.en:
Her head gives a small twitch.

"Regret, you say."
entries.zh:
她的头部微微抽动了一下。

"后悔，你是说。"

o.en: They used rather stronger language to express the sentiment.
o.zh: 他们表达的措辞可激烈得多。

o.en: They came to a poor end. I should like to avoid that for myself.
o.zh: 他们的结局很糟，我想让自己避免那种下场。

entries.en:
"I see," she says.

"You found them. In the Abyss. And returned." The Director pauses a moment. "This simply proves your fitness for the operation."
entries.zh:
"我明白了，" 她说道。

"你找到了他们，在深渊里，并且回来了。" 总监停顿片刻，"这恰恰证明了你是执行这项任务的最佳人选。"

o.en: That's one way of looking at it.
It's dangerous out there. Very dangerous.

entries.en:
"Evidently, you already have," she says.

"This simply proves your fitness for the operation."
entries.zh:
"显然，你已经做到了，" 她说道。

"这恰恰证明了你是执行这项任务的最佳人选。"

o.en: That's one way of looking at it.
It's dangerous out there. Very dangerous.

entries.en: "You know of the Perseus-Orion Abyss; a melodramatic name. I find spacers are a superstitious lot, excepting present company. Self-limiting mythology is best discarded if one means to ascend to the fullest of human potential." She looks away for a moment, making a dismissive flick with her flingers.
entries.zh: "你听说过 英仙座-猎户座深渊 吗？真是一个夸张的名称。我发现宇宙民大多迷信 —— 当然在座的除外。若想攀登人类潜力的顶峰，最好摒弃这类自我设限的神话。" 她移开视线片刻，手指做了个轻蔑的弹动。

entries.en:
"It is true, however, that the Abyss is hostile to our hyperspace technology. That is precisely why the secrets it holds may be all the more profitably disruptive."

She turns to look you full-on, once more. "I want you to go there. I have data... there is something to find. Very old. Very dangerous. Very valuable. Bring me scans, samples. You will be paid handsomely for tangible specimens."
entries.zh:
"但深渊确实对我们的超空间技术充满敌意。而这恰恰意味着其中隐藏的秘密可能带来更具颠覆性的利润。"

她再度转过身来直视着你，"我要你去往那里。我掌握着数据...那里存在值得探查的事物，非常古老，极度危险，也价值连城。为我带回扫描数据，采集样本。对于实体标本，你将获得丰厚的酬劳。"

o.en: You haven't said exactly what I'm looking for. Salvage?
o.zh: 你还没具体说明我要寻找什么。是要打捞物品吗？

entries.en:
"You know the Perseus-Orion Abyss. You went there, and there you found the Onslaught Mk.I... and the 'Threat'."

She looks at you anew, more present somehow.

"I very much desire to have a look at the Mk.I."
entries.zh:
"你知道 英仙座-猎户座深渊。你去过那里，并在那里发现了 攻势 Mk.I...以及 '威胁'。"

她重新审视着你，目光也变得异常专注。

"我非常希望能亲自看看 Mk.I。"

entries.en:
"You know the Perseus-Orion Abyss. You know of the 'Threat'." She looks away. "A typically non-descriptive name passed to us from some primitive government committee, I'm sure."

"You found Academician Cornelius Elek's enigma, the Onslaught Mk.I... among other things."

She looks at you anew, more present somehow.

"This is what I want."
entries.zh:
"你知道 英仙座-猎户座深渊。你也知道 '威胁'。" 她移开视线，"我敢肯定，这又是某个简陋的政府委员会所传达给我们的一个毫无描述性的名字。"

"你找到了 Cornelius Elek 院士的谜题，攻势 Mk.I...以及其他东西。"

她重新审视着你，目光也变得异常专注。

"这正是我想要的。"

entries.en: "The Perseus-Orion Abyss is a melodramatic name. I find spacers are a superstitious lot, present company excepted. Self-limiting mythology is best discarded if one means to ascend to the fullest of human potential." She looks away for a moment, making a dismissive flick with her flingers.
entries.zh: "英仙座-猎户座深渊 是一个夸张的名称。我发现宇宙民大多迷信 —— 当然在座的除外。若想攀登人类潜力的顶峰，最好摒弃这类自我设限的神话。" 她移开视线片刻，手指做了个轻蔑的弹动。

entries.en: She makes no outward reaction to your implication, simply proceeding as if you'd said nothing at all.
entries.zh: 她对你的暗示毫无表露，只是继续着，仿佛你未曾开口一般。

entries.en: "Not exactly," she says, self-satisifed. "Something more valuable."
entries.zh: "不完全是，" 她自得地说道，"是更有价值的东西。"

o.en: Is this about remnants of the AI War fleets?
o.zh: 这与余辉的 AI 战争舰队有关吗？

o.en: Yes, but you haven't said what.
o.zh: 是的，但你还没具体说明要找什么。

entries.en:
"Those old things?" She gives her head an abbreviated shake.

"No, we have people for that. Although," she fixes you with a look, "they've made quite a mess of it, haven't they? The wasted possibilities... but no, we're looking for something older... different."
entries.zh:
"那些旧东西？" 她简短地摇了摇头。

"不，我们有专人负责那些。不过，" 她凝视着你，"它们确实搞得一团糟，不是吗？那些被浪费的可能性...但我们寻找的是更古老的...不同的东西。"

entries.en:
"No, nothing like that." She emits a joyless laugh, like a machine, then pauses suddenly.

"Although if you did happen to find alien technology... provide me with exclusive access and I would ensure you credits enough to purchase your own solar system. Or," she waves a hand in an unconscious arc, "Build yourself a new one out of dross, if that's what you enjoy."
entries.zh:
"不，不是那种东西。" 她发出机器般毫无欢愉的笑声，随即突然停顿。

"不过，如果你真的偶然发现了外星技术...那就向我提供独家接触权限，我会确保你获得足以买下一整个恒星系的财富。或者，" 她无意识地挥手划了个弧线，"如果你喜欢，用废料给自己造个新的也行。"

entries.en: "There's no need. Our strategic indicators forecast a reasonably likely chance of your survival if your outlook is unbiased by speculation, so take heart." She trails off.
entries.zh: "没必要。我们的战略指标预测，如果你不受主观臆断影响，那么你的存活概率将相当可观，所以振作些。" 她的声音渐渐低了下去。

entries.en: Sensing the insufficiency of her pep-talk, she begins anew: "What it is, is old. Early Domain. Pre-Persean Frontier, but we have reason to believe some part of it is out... here. Whether it followed us or we followed it. Whatever it is, wherever there is."
entries.zh: 察觉到自己的鼓舞之辞不够有力，她重新开口道："重点是，它很古老。早于 人之领 时期，在英仙座边境形成之前，但我们有理由相信它的某些部分就在...这里。不知是它尾随而来，还是我们追寻至此。无论它是什么，无论它在何处。"

entries.en: "Not exactly," she says, self-satisfied. "Something more valuable."
entries.zh: "不完全是，" 她自得地说道，"是更有价值的东西。"

o.en: You've been prompting Elek. How'd you know where to make him look?
o.zh: 你一直在诱导 Elek，你怎么知道该让他往哪里探索？

o.en: ...You want to buy the Onslaught Mk.I from me?
o.zh: ...你想从我这儿买下 攻势 Mk.I？

o.en: You know a lot about what I've been doing.
o.zh: 你很了解我做过的事情。

o.en: How will I know when I find it?
o.zh: 我怎么知道自己找到了它？

o.en: I've seen them. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss.
o.zh: 我见过它们。那潜伏在深渊深处的，古老的自动化作战舰队。

o.en: I've encountered... entities in the Abyss. Non-material, high energy. Hostile.
o.zh: 我在深渊中遭遇过...一些实体，它们没有物质形态，能量极高，且敌对。

o.en: I've seen ancient warfleets deep in the abyss. And... non-material hostile entities.
o.zh: 我见过深渊深处古老的作战舰队。还有... 非物质态的敌对实体。

o.en: I've never encountered such a thing. (lie)
o.zh: 我从未遭遇过这种东西。 (说谎)

entries.en: "A threat, presumably. The hostile connotation lives in the name." A quick, bloodless smile. "You'll prepare yourself for anything, I'm sure."
entries.zh: "一种威胁，大概如此，敌意就蕴含在这个名称里。" 她露出一个迅速而苍白的微笑，"我相信你会做好应对任何情况的准备。"

entries.en: "Something which threatened the Domain, presumably." A quick, bloodless smile. "You'll prepare yourself for anything, I'm sure."
entries.zh: "想来是曾危及人之领的什么东西。\" 她飞快地一笑，笑里没有半点温度。\"你必定会做好万全准备，这我信得过。"

entries.en:
"We assume it'll engage in some sort of hostile action against you or your $shipOrFleet," she says indifferently. "Only this won't be pirate, Pather, or tariff patrol."

"Nor," she fixes you with a cool look, "Some remnant AI warfleet. Those, those we know about."

"Disappointing conversationalists," she mutters. "Superintelligence with no mind for business. Simply unbelievable..."
entries.zh:
"我们推测它会对你或你的$shipOrFleet采取某种敌对行动，" 她漠然说道，"但这并非是海盗、左径分子，或关税巡逻队。"

"也并非是，" 她投来冷静的目光，"某支残存的 AI 战争舰队。那些东西，那些我们有所了解的东西。"

"令人失望的对话对象，" 她低语道，"具有超常的智能却毫无商业头脑，简直难以置信..."

entries.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings.
entries.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的 TriPad 响了。

o.en: So you knew what you were asking for. Was there another expedition before me?
o.zh: 所以你清楚自己所需要的是什么，难道在我之前还有另一支考察队吗？

entries.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings.
entries.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的 TriPad 响了。

o.en: So you knew what you were asking for. Was there another expedition that succeeded?
o.zh: 所以你清楚自己所需要的是什么，难道还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

entries.en:
She blinks. Her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time.

"That does not... quite fit with our working knowledge of the issue. Would you part with recordings of your... encounter with these entities? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
entries.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注。

"这与我们对该问题的现有认知不...甚吻合。你是否愿意出售你与这些实体...遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

entries.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings a credits transfer.

"Fascinating," she says, and releases a breath. "This is unlike previous reports."
entries.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的TriPad 响起星币到账的提示。

"令人着迷，" 她说道，一边轻吁一口气，"这与先前的报告截然不同。"

o.en: 'Previous'? Was there another expedition before me?
o.zh: '先前的'？难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

entries.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings a credits transfer.

"Fascinating," she says, and releases a breath. "This is unlike previous reports."

"令人着迷，" 她说道，一边轻吁一口气，"这与先前的报告截然不同。"

o.en: 'Previous'? Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?
o.zh: '先前的'？难道在我之前还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

entries.en:
She blinks and her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time. And they narrow slightly.

"Of course not," she says. "But when you do, I'm sure you'll quickly realize why no one else in the Sector is prepared to deal seriously with this... Threat. It is in your interest to work with me."
entries.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注，眼睛也微微眯起。

"当然没有，" 她说道，"但等到你真的遇到时，我相信你会立刻明白为何星域内没有其他势力准备认真应对这个...威胁。与我合作符合你的利益。"

o.en: You say 'when'. Was there another expedition before me?
o.zh: 你是说 '等到'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

"Of course not," she says. "But when you do, I'm sure you'll quickly realize why no one else in the Sector is prepared to deal seriously with this... Threat. It is in your interest to work with me."

o.zh: 你是说 '等到'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

entries.en:
"Perhaps," she says coldly, meaning 'perhaps not'.

"And disappointing. It would be useful to compare your data to our baseline. I must emphasize my interest - my financial interest - in procuring specimens of the type described."
entries.zh:
"或许吧，" 她冷冰冰地说道，言下之意是 '或许没有'。

"真是令人失望，将你的数据与我们的基线进行比较本会很有效用。我必须强调我对此类样本的收购意愿 —— 以及背后可以提供的财务利益。"

o.en: You said 'compare'. Was there another expedition before me?
o.zh: 你是说 '比较'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

entries.en:
"Perhaps," she says, repeating you rather frostily.

"And disappointing. It would be useful to compare your data to our baseline. I must emphasize my interest - my financial interest - in procuring more information about the Threat."
entries.zh:
"或许吧，" 她颇为冷淡地重复着你的话。

"真是令人失望，将你的数据与我们的基线进行比较本会很有效用。我必须强调我对 '威胁' 有关的更多信息的获取意愿 —— 以及背后可以提供的财务利益。"

o.en: You said 'compare'. Was there another expedition before me?
o.zh: 你是说 '比较'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

o.zh: 你是说 '比较'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

entries.en:
She blinks. Her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time.

"And you lived to tell it," she says, outwardly cool. You suspect, however, that you've impressed the Director because she pauses a moment to consider your words.

"Would you part with recordings of your encounter with the Threat? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
entries.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注。

"而你活着讲述了它，" 她说道，神色冷酷。然而，你怀疑自己已经给这位总监留下了深刻的印象，因为她停顿了片刻以琢磨你的话语。

"你是否愿意出售你与威胁遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

entries.en: "So you are open to dealing," she says. "Good."
entries.zh: "所以你愿意交易，" 她说道，"很好。"

entries.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings a credits transfer.

"Interesting," she says, and releases a breath. "Yes. This is what I am looking for."
entries.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的 TriPad 响起星币到账的提示。

"有意思，" 她说道，一边轻吁一口气，"没错，这正是我所寻找的。"

o.zh: 所以你已经知道那是什么了，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

你的 TriPad 响起星币到账的提示。

"有意思，" 她说道，一边轻吁一口气，"没错，这正是我所寻找的。"

o.en: So you know what it is. Was there another expedition that succeeded?
o.zh: 所以你已经知道那是什么了，难道还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

o.en: I believe we've come to an arrangement.
o.zh: 我相信我们已经达成了共识。

o.en: I've considered your offer. One million credits for scan and samples from the Onslaught Mk.I. Agreed?
o.zh: 我考虑过你的提议了。一百万星币，用于扫描 攻势 Mk.I 并进行采样。同意吗？

o.en: I could use fuel. Lots of fuel. And tankers to carry it.
o.zh: 我需要燃料。大量的燃料。还有运载燃料的油轮。

entries.en:
"Done." She speaks without turning.

Your TriPad pings a notification from your purser.
entries.zh:
"成交。" 她头也不回地说道。

你的 TriPad 响起事务长发来的通知。

entries.en:
She looks at you over her shoulder.

"You'll find that my charity is a shallow well, captain. I will trust in your boundless initiative," $personLastName says.
entries.zh:
她侧过头看向你。

"你会发现我的慷慨不过是口浅井，舰长。我将仰赖你无限的进取心，" $personLastName 说道。

o.en: I'm going to need supplies. And a freighter to carry them.
o.zh: 我需要补给，以及一艘运载它们的货舰。

entries.en:
"Can't let you starve on the road to glory, can we." She speaks without turning.

Your TriPad pings a notification from your purser.
entries.zh:
"总不能让你在通往荣耀的路上挨饿吧。" 她头也不回地说道。

你的 TriPad 响起事务长发来的通知。

entries.en: "You'll find that my charity is a shallow well, captain. I shall trust your initiative on this matter," $personLastName says, rocking on her heels impatiently.
entries.zh: "你会发现我的慷慨不过是口浅井，舰长。在这件事上我将仰赖你的进取心，" $personLastName 说道，一边不耐烦地轻轻摇晃着鞋跟。

o.en: What are you offering to pay me. Specifically.
o.zh: 你打算给我多少报酬？具体讲讲。

entries.en:
* * *

You expect the Director will shed no tears if you and your crew perish. But she has a reputation for effective, if shadowy, investment and development.

And for brutally cutting underperforming elements while rewarding success.

You could make good money and powerful connections. Or die in the Abyss, screaming to yourself in a darkness blacker than space.
entries.zh:
* * *

你能够预料，如果你和你的团队全军覆没，那位总监也不会掉半滴眼泪。但她以高效 —— 尽管隐秘 —— 的投资开发能力而著称。

同时也以残酷地剔除低效元素，同时重赏成功者而著称。

你能借此赚取丰厚报酬并建立强大的人脉，又或是在深渊中嘶吼着死去，沉入比太空更浓稠的黑暗。

entries.en:
"You'll get no better," she says, her tone a dismissal.

* * *

You expect the Director will shed no tears if you and your crew perish. But she has a reputation for rewarding success and effective, if shadowy, investment and development.

And for brutally cutting underperforming elements.

You could make good money and powerful connections. Or die in the Abyss, screaming to yourself in a darkness blacker than space.
entries.zh:
"你找不到更好的条件，" 她说道，语气已是在下逐客令。

* * *

你能够预料，如果你和你的团队全军覆没，那位总监也不会掉半滴眼泪。但她以高效 —— 尽管隐秘 —— 的投资开发能力而著称。

同时也以残酷地剔除低效元素，同时重赏成功者而著称。

你能借此赚取丰厚报酬并建立强大的人脉，又或是在深渊中嘶吼着死去，沉入比太空更浓稠的黑暗。

entries.en: "Credits. Next question."
entries.zh: "星币。下一个问题。"

o.en: An Academician Elek said something funny- that he was being funded by Tri-Tachyon.
o.zh: 一位叫 Elek 的院士说了件有趣的事 —— 他说自己在接受 速子科技 的资助。

entries.en:
Glamor-Rotanev creates a smile for you.

"I am a patron of the sciences. Didn't you hear?"
entries.zh:
Glamor-Rotanev 向你展示出一个微笑。

"我是科学的赞助人。你没听说吗？"

o.en: Academician Elek. You funded his research. And directed it.
o.zh: Elek 院士。你资助了他的研究，并且主导了研究方向。

o.en: I have nothing for you right now.
o.zh: 我目前没有能提供给你的东西。

entries.en: "I am particularly interested in the hull you recovered from the Abyss. The Onslaught Mk.I is... unmistakable."
entries.zh: "我对你从深渊打捞的那艘舰船尤其感兴趣，那艘 攻势 Mk.I 的特征...无可混淆。"

o.en: Why? Are you going to make me an offer for it?
o.zh: 为什么？难道你要出价买它吗？

o.en: I've considered your offer. One million credits for access and scanning of the Mk.I.
o.zh: 我考虑过你的提议了。一百万星币，换取接触并扫描 Mk.I 的权利。

entries.en: "I am particularly interested in the hull you recovered from the Abyss. The Onslaught Mk.I is unmistakable."
entries.zh: "我对你从深渊打捞的那艘舰船尤其感兴趣，那艘 攻势 Mk.I 的特征无可混淆。"

o.en: Why? Are you going to make me an offer for it?
o.zh: 为什么？难道你要出价买它吗？

entries.en: "Fine," she says briskly.
entries.zh: "很好，" 她干脆地回应道。

entries.en: "Fine," she says briskly.
entries.zh: "很好，" 她干脆地回应道。

o.en: I've found some 'interesting' specimens for you...
o.zh: 我为你找到了一些 '有趣的' 样本...

o.en: I have more 'interesting' specimens for you...
o.zh: 我为你准备了更多 '有趣的' 样本...

entries.en: "I should like to discuss the hull you recovered from the Abyss, the Onslaught Mk.I."
entries.zh: "我想谈谈你从深渊打捞回来的那具舰体，攻势 Mk.I。"

o.en: Why? Are you going to make me an offer for it?

entries.en: "Oh?" Her eyes give a disconcerting twitch. "I should like to examine your discoveries."
entries.zh: "哦？" 她的眼睑令人不安地抽动了一下，"我倒想看看你的发现。"

entries.en: For a moment her brow develops a wrinkle. "More?" she says, and it disappears.
entries.zh: 片刻间她额头浮现出一道皱纹。"更多？" 她说道，那皱痕也随即消失。

entries.en: "My strategic predictors tagged you with reasonable odds of success," she says. "I must congratulate their operators."
entries.zh: "我的战略预测系统曾以合理的概率标注你具备成功的潜力，" 她说道，"我必须祝贺那些算法工程师。"

entries.en: Glamor-Rotanev gives you a frosty look.
entries.zh: Glamor-Rotanev 向你投来了冰冷的一瞥。

entries.en: "You've been most useful," she says ominously.
entries.zh: "你贡献卓著，" 她意味深长地说道。

entries.en:
"You've been most useful," she says ominously.

"I have an agent, an analyst; Faro Inesis, assigned to Achaman Enterprise Station in the Magec system. You may bring specimens to him as well, as proves convenient."

"He is fully authorized to pay you in full."

A comms ID appears in your interface. She didn't even blink.
entries.zh: "你贡献卓著，" 她意味深长地说道。

entries.en:
"These are quite... unique."

A rare smile flits on the Director's lips.

"You must find more for me, captain."
entries.zh:
"这些都相当...独特。"

一抹罕见的笑意掠过总监的唇角。

"你必须为我寻找更多，舰长。"

entries.en:
"More fascinating specimens." Her voice is dark.

"Our results have already proven to be most stimulating."
OR
"Breathtaking," the Director of Special Acquisitions says softly.

Her eyes twitch inhumanly.
entries.zh:
"更令人着迷的样本。" 她声音低沉。

"我们的研究成果已被证明极具启发性。"
OR
"叹为观止，" 特殊采购部总监轻声道。

她的眼睑非人地抽动着。

entries.en:
"A marvelous find, captain," the Director says softly.

"This is precisely what I have been searching for. You've been... quite essential."

Her eyes are very still, like a corpse.
entries.zh:
"绝妙的发现，舰长，" 总监轻声说道。

"这正是我一直在寻找的。你变得...至关重要了。"

她的眼睛异常平静，如同尸体。

o.en: That's all I wanted to ask.

entries.en: "Good," she says.
entries.zh: "很好"，她说道。

entries.en: "You've asked quite enough for today," she says. "Captain."
entries.zh: "你今天的问题已经够多了，" 她说道，"舰长。"

entries.en:
"These are not artificial intelligences," she says decisively.

"Not that such distinction is necessary to Hegemony regulators. Whatever future war the Hegemony initiates, whatever new oppressions they conceive, it will be a consequence of leadership as paranoid as their masses are ignorant."

"Besides," she says, self-satisfied, "if I am right about everything, there will be no need for a war."
entries.zh:
"这些东西并非是人工智能，" 她斩钉截铁地说道。

"当然这对 霸主 的监管机构而言无关紧要。无论 霸主 在未来发动何种战争，构想何种新的压迫手段，都将是其领导层的偏执与民众的蒙昧所共同作用的产物。"

"况且，" 她自得地补充道，"若我关于一切的推测都正确，战争将不再会有必要。"

o.en: Does exploitating this technology not risk another AI War?
o.zh: 开发利用这项技术，是否可能会引发另一场 AI 战争？

entries.en:
"Is a machine alive? Is a virus?" She pauses for a fraction of a second before providing her own answer.

"I don't care."
entries.zh:
"机器算是活的吗？病毒又算是活的吗？" 她停顿了一瞬，随后给出了自己的答案：

"我不在乎。"

entries.en:
"Functionally the 'Threat' phenomenon demonstrates no attempt to present a sense of selfhood, collective or otherwise. What passes for communication is hostile and garbled; the loose ends of automatic warnings and obsolete Domain decrees. If it is conscious in any form, it is impossibly solipsistic."

"Which is just as well," the Director produces a robotic half-smile. "It will be a better tool that way."
entries.zh:
"仅从功能上看，'威胁' 现象并未表现出任何自我意识的迹象，无论是个体层面还是集体层面。它们仅有的沟通，充其量只是充满敌意的噪声：残缺的自动化警告音和过时的 人之领 法令。即使它们在某种意义上真的具备意识，那这种意识也是彻底的唯我论。"

"这样也很好，" 她露出一个机械般的、几乎无法称之为笑容的笑容，"工具不需要有意识。"

o.en: So the 'Threat' are not alive, not intelligent?
o.zh: 这么说，'威胁' 并不是活体，也不具备智能？

entries.en:
"In the simplest terms," her voice contains more than a hint of condescension, "they are autonomous self-fabricating, self-modifying constructs derived from ancient Domain designs. Their intent, so far as they could be said to have intent, is destructive toward our technological base."

"'Why' is a more difficult question."

Her dead eyes move oddly. "I find it amusing that the Luddics would recoil in horror, but they could not find a better ally to their cause."
entries.zh:
"用最简单的话说，" 她的语气中透露着毫不掩饰的居高临下感，"所谓 '威胁'，本质上是一群不断自我复制、自我改写的无人构造体，它们的设计可追溯至 人之领 时期。如果你喜欢更拟人的说法，它们的目的无非是：摧毁我们现有的科技体系。

"至于其敌对行为的原因，那就无从得知了。"

她的眼睛怪异地动了动。"不觉得很有意思吗。卢德信徒们见了这些东西只会本能地惊惶逃窜，却没能意识到他们双方追求的结果并无二致。"

o.en: Do you know what the 'Threat' are, or where they came from?
o.zh: 这些 '威胁' 到底是什么东西，又是从何而来？

entries.en:
"Research and development," she says. Her expression isn't quite a smirk.

"These components are obviously derived from a neglected branch of Domain-era technology. This makes them fundamentally human technology. The path to profitable exploitation is fundamentally open, albeit complex. The Tri-Tachyon corporation is ideally placed to exploit them."
entries.zh:
"研究与开发，" 她说道，那神情算不上讥讽。

"这些组件明显源自某个被忽视的 人之领 时代技术分支，这使它们本质上属于人类技术。虽然过程复杂，但盈利性开发的道路在根本上是敞开的。而 速子科技 正处于开发利用它们的理想位置。"

o.en: What are you going to do with the 'Threat' artifacts?
o.zh: 你打算如何处理这些 '威胁' 遗物？

entries.en:
A final terrific explosion blanks the external visual pickups. A few seconds later, backups are extruded through the hull.

Your sensors officer reports in a hushed voice that no escape pods were detected leaving the ship at any point.
entries.zh:
巨大的爆炸损坏了外部摄像头。过了几秒后备用摄像头才从船体中弹出。

你的传感器技官低沉着声音报告说，整个过程中没有检测到逃生舱离开那艘舰船。

entries.en:
Your tactical officer rapidly taps a few buttons; holodisplays flicker through status updates.

"If the shuttle power cores were overloaded simultaneously, well, with the shuttles so close to the wreck? The hull would have likely been damaged past any hope of recovery. In addition to killing the salvor crews, of course. But I don't think that was their goal; there are easier ways to kill salvage crews."

As you indicate to your operations chief to ready the salvage teams for a second attempt, your tactical officer adds, "It comes to mind that what we just experienced was an attempt at an old Tri-Tach trick from the Second AI War. They left black-box EW traps to keep the Hegemony from recovering intel and tech from disabled hulls. And it worked. For a while, anyway. I'm just glad we kept that legacy commsec package installed."
entries.zh:
你的战术军官快速地摁了几个按钮，全息投影上闪现出了更新过的数据。

"假如在距离残骸这么近的情况下，所有穿梭机的能量核心同时被过载的话会怎么样？那这船体就可能受到严重的损伤，没有修复的希望了。当然也会杀死打捞小组，但我认为这并不是他们的目的，毕竟明显有比这更容易杀死打捞小组的办法。"

当你指示行动长官让打捞小组做好开展第二次尝试的准备的时候，战术军官补充道，"长官，看起来刚刚我们遇到的应该是第二次 AI 战争时 速子科技 用的小把戏罢了。他们会在黑匣子上留下电磁脉冲陷阱，防止 霸主 从他们停机的船体里回收提取有价值的信息和科技。这方法挺管用的，至少管用过一段时间。我还蛮高兴那些旧的通讯链接安全包都还装着没被卸掉。"

entries.en:
You dismiss your tactical officer and ponder the situation as the call-and-return proceeds between your command crew and the salvage teams waiting at standby. Reports trickle up through the hierarchy, from junior officers in after-action/sim analyst teams to your bridge crew. A picture begins to form that has too many gaps for your liking: The core-collapse signal appears to have originated not exactly in, but uncomfortably near to a secure cargo bay holding an Alpha Core. The core was shielded in complete isolation at the time, and it denies any responsibility as effortlessly as it offers you its service and advice during this crisis, if you would be so kind as to open up a small data-link. You curtly terminate the secured comm-channel and order the AI put back in isolated lock-down.

Your comms officer reports that there is uncertainty whether the AI was involved, or if the signal was sent from that location to throw suspicion onto the core. Both possibilities have troubling implications. In the meantime, however, your ops chief calls in, requesting the order to enter the wreck.
entries.zh:
你结束了与战术军官的讨论，一边考量着当前的情况，一边听着指挥人员和原地待命的打捞小组之间维持着呼叫-应答流程。行动后/模拟分析小组的下级军官们的报告逐层汇总，集中在了你和你的舰桥船员面前。虽然还远不能让你满意，但事件的全貌逐渐被拼凑完全了：这艘舰船上有个装载有 Alpha 核心的安全货舱，发出能量核心崩溃指令的信号源虽然并不在那个货舱内部，但位置近得令人不安。AI 核心在事件发生时正受到屏蔽，与外界完全隔绝，而它一边拒绝为此事件负责，一边积极地自荐要在这场危机中为你提供帮助和建议，只要你能好心地帮它打开一个小小的数据链接。你毫不客气地终止了 Alpha 核心的隔离通讯频道，并下令把它重新放进隔离舱。

你的通讯军官汇报道，并不确定这次是 AI 参与了这一事件，还是信号源被故意放在核心附近，以便将怀疑引向核心。这两种可能性细推下去都令人感到担忧。然而，就在这时，行动长官接入通讯，申请再次进入残骸中。

entries.en:
A disposable navigation satellite set to a decaying orbit identifies the radiation-ravaged rock below as "Alpha Site".

A scan of the surface reveals an expansive research facility spilling out of a mid-sized crater. The shield array apparently failed spectacularly some time ago, leaving the ruins awash in heavy radiation. Any material salvage operation would be unprofitable.

However, you might be able to send a salvage team down for a short period to see if any intel can be found about the purpose of this facility. Someone clearly put a lot of resources toward building it in a most inhospitable environment, far from prying eyes. Someone with something valuable to hide.
entries.zh:
位于衰减轨道上的一次性导航信标将下方被辐射摧残的岩质行星识别为 "阿尔法研究站"。

对地表的扫描让你们发现了一处于陨石坑内崩塌四散的巨大研究设施。它原先的护盾阵列应该在不久前彻底失效，这导致整个建筑残骸都被强辐射清洗殆尽。换句话说，任何打捞作业都将无利可图。

不过，你也许可以派遣打捞小组在短时间内试着回收与这个设施有关的情报。看起来有人为了远离他人的窥探，在这个鸟不拉屎的环境里投入了大量资源，以建造这个研究设施来藏匿更有价值的东西。

o.en: Send a salvage team down to the facility
o.zh: 派遣一支打捞小组前往设施

entries.en:
A small satellite on a decaying orbit identifies the radiation-ravaged rock below as "Alpha Site". You estimate it doesn't have much time left until it crashes into the planet - a couple of cycles, at the very most.

On a whim, you pull up the recording of your first visit here.
entries.zh:
一枚位于衰减轨道上的小型卫星将下方被辐射摧残的岩质行星识别为 "阿尔法研究站"。你估计不久后它就会坠毁到星球上 —— 最多几个星历年。

你心血来潮，调出了第一次拜访这里的记录。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet goes into orbit around the radiation-ravaged rock known as "Alpha Site".

The navigation satellite which once identified this celestial body is now gone; a few taps to your display shows you the small impact crater it left when it hit the surface, a bright smudge in a plain of rad-decayed regolith. In the absence of an atmosphere, it's likely the crater will last longer than the satellite ever did, by many millions of cycles.

On a whim, you pull up the recording of your first visit here.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet来到了被辐射摧残的岩质行星，即所谓的 "阿尔法研究站" 的轨道上。

原先用于识别这个天体的导航卫星已经不知所踪，操作了一番后，你眼前的屏幕上显示出了一个位于饱经辐射炙烤的风化平原上的亮斑，那便是卫星撞击地表时留下的浅坑。由于这颗星球没有大气层，撞击坑存续的时间将比那颗卫星的存续时间更久，会长达数百万年。

你心血来潮，调出了第一次拜访这里的记录。

entries.en:
After extensive preparation (and reiteration of the hazard pay policy) a volunteer salvor team is sent down on a heavily-shielded shuttle.

They land near what appears to be the main entrance and report ingress to the facility without difficulty. On a display projected into your flagship's bridge, you watch as a hardsuited salvor brushes past the clouded-over sensor unit of a defense turret; it collapses into itself at a mere touch. Anything exposed to the merciless sky is slowly crumbling on the chemical level; it appears that all groundside security systems have been destroyed by radiation.
entries.zh:
在经过严密并且冗长的准备 (和反复重申对应的危险津贴政策) 之后，一组自愿参与的打捞小组乘坐加强辐射屏蔽的重装穿梭机出发了。

他们在设施的主要入口附近着陆，随后向指挥中心汇报这次入侵没有受到任何阻碍。在你旗舰的舰桥的投影屏幕上，一群重装打捞人员掠过被粒子云笼罩的防御炮塔；仅仅只是轻触，这些炮台就土崩瓦解。暴露在无情深空之下的任何物体都会从分子层面被侵蚀，瓦解，似乎所有的安全系统都被辐射所摧毁。

entries.en:
The interior of the facility has been breached, leaving it unpressurized. While the structure's bulk provides some protection, the delicate computer systems are fried beyond repair. No data is recoverable.

With no chance of an easy find, the team spreads out for the remaining rad-safe duration to document the facility and see if anything useful can be inferred from the ruin. While exploring, one salvor enters the quarters of a high-ranking member of the facility staff and discovers the journal, a physical book bound in natural materials, of its presumably deceased occupant.
entries.zh:
设施内部因为大门被摧毁已经失压。虽然设施的外壳具有一定的保护作用，但内部娇贵的计算机系统已经被辐射炸得酥脆。修复已不太可能，也没什么可以回收的数据。

为了加快搜索，小队成员在抗辐射药剂剩余的安全时间里原地解散，开始分头寻找遗迹中任何可能有用的物品。搜寻过程中，一位打捞员进入了一间该设施高级成员的房间，并且发现了房间已故主人的一本纯天然材料制成的日记。

entries.en:
You examine the journal in the quarantine bay.

The fine leather cover is discolored, but you can make out the embossed gold leaf Tri-Tachyon logo. Your salvage team has already scanned the text without opening the delicate pages of the book. The data has been placed in a secure cache for your review.
entries.zh:
你在隔离区亲自检查了这本日志。

精美的皮革封面已经褪色，但烫金的 速子科技 标志依然清晰可辨。打捞小组在未打开这本书的情况下已经完整地扫描了这本精美的书。那些扫描页被置于系统的安全缓存中等待你随时读取。

entries.en:
Scrolling the virtual pages, you find that the journal appears to hold the private thoughts of the chief technology officer of this facility.

It begins with vague complaints of being ordered to disregard safety protocols during tests, and frustration with demands made by Kelise Astraia. From what you understand, this is an effort to establish a hardcopy trail in case of the blame-shifting and record-altering which is common practice for high-ranking Tri-Tachyon executives involved in failed projects.

Concerns about "going outside" feature prominently in the entries. Understandable, given the surface conditions, but the increasingly intense obsessiveness of the writing seems to reflect a growing phobia on the part of the author.
entries.zh:
翻动着日志的扫描件，你仿佛进入了这个速子设施技术主管的私人世界。

从最初对于在测试中被命令无视安全协议的含糊抱怨，以及对 Kelise Astraia 提出的要求的沮丧态度。以你对 速子科技 的了解，参与过失败项目的高管常常被当做替罪羊 —— 这显然是为避免记录被篡改而有意写下的备份。

高管本人对 "能否走出这里" 的担忧在显著地逐渐增加。表面情况下确实可以理解，但高管在书中的语气愈发地凸显出他日益增长而不曾消退的恐惧。

entries.en:
The remainder of the journal is difficult to read; most of the pages are torn or defaced, leaving a patchy, noisy scan in your display. Little of what's readable is coherent.

At the very end, there's one line, written in a clear, strong hand. "They sing to me. Everything will be alright."
entries.zh:
日记的剩余部分逐渐无法阅读；剩下的页面不是被污渍染得看不清，就是被撕得稀巴烂，在显示屏上留下斑驳的扫描噪点。少数能读的部分也字不成句。

在日记的终末，手写着一行字迹清晰而笔迹沉重的话。"对我歌唱了...我真的听到了！...一切都会好起来！！"

entries.en:
An autonomous warning beacon has been left emitting a distorted wail between official channels.

Your comms officer reports an easily-defeated software intrusion attempt by what remains of the beacon's security systems.
entries.zh:
一个警告信标在附近的官方信道里发出扭曲的哀嚎声。

你的通讯军官报告，信标中遗留的安全系统试图进行简单的软件黑入，但是被抵挡了下来。

entries.en:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches a lonely clutch of shielded cargo containers drifting through space. They bear no ID-badge, no insignia, no reactive transponders.

A steady stream of high-energy neutrinos from one particular container spinning outward from the main cluster washes over your sensors in time with its rotation; some sleeping chamber of exotic matter must have given out over the cycles - decades? - since it was left here.
entries.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet靠近了一批漂流在太空中的屏蔽货箱。上面没有身份认证，没有徽章，也没有任何应答装置。

其中有一个货柜脱离了主集群，随着它的转动，一股稳定的高能中微子流会定时扫过你的传感器。这批货箱被遗留在此后已经沉睡了数年甚至数十年 ，肯定是其中的某些储存有奇特物质的储罐泄露了。

entries.en:
The connection request hangs for some time then a wave of holo-noise flickers through the main display before generating a series of error codes. Your comms officer works their console in consternation.

The soft sounds of the error notifications align just so, almost forming a melody you must have heard somewhere once. Or perhaps not. You return your attention to your command. No time for daydreaming.
entries.zh:
连接请求被挂起片刻，随后一阵全息噪音的波动在显示区域疯狂地闪烁着，持续到一阵错误代码将其中断为止。你的通讯军官在控制台前慌张地进行操作。

错误提示音变得柔软，恰到好处地嵌入到一股似曾相识的旋律之中，你也许听过它，但又完全没有印象。你没给自己留下做白日梦的时间，再度回过神来重新专注于自己的命令中。

entries.en:
The capital-class construct appears to be a phase ship due to presenting features common to the type, though its design is otherwise exotic.

There also appear to be small, bright EM sources, "-Only partially overlapping the visual spectrum," your sensors officer reports. They periodically appear and dissipate in a volume encompassing the mysterious ship. Your bridge crew murmurs speculation between their stations: a new form of shielding? Microsat thruster bursts? Your sensors officer shakes their head.

You order a high-resolution scan performed, and the raw data placed into secure storage.
entries.zh:
根据这个主力舰级别的结构具备的典型特征，可认定它是一艘相位舰，尽管它的设计十分奇异。

此外还发现了这些小而明亮的电磁脉冲源， "——仅仅与部分可见光谱重叠。" 你的传感器技官是这样报告的。它们周期性地出现在这艘谜团一般的船上并且被排放出来。舰桥里的船员都开始交头接耳，窃窃私语地猜测着：是某种新型的防御手段？还是微型卫星的推进器激冲？你的传感器技官摇了摇头。

你命令你的舰队以最高的清晰度对这艘船进行扫描，并将这批原始数据放进安全储存库里。

entries.en:
Your attention strays as the impression of something not unlike distant music insinuates itself into your consciousness; as if a chorus was singing at some great distance, their voices brought to you by a chance gust of wind. When you attempt to focus on the music the impression slips away.

You become suddenly aware that your bridge crew is staring expectantly, waiting for your next command.
entries.zh:
宛如合唱团站在山的那头，遥远的旋律乘风而来，犹如午后清风一样将你的注意力一点、一点地剥离。但当你试图去追寻这旋律之时，它又随风而去。

回过神来时，你意识到整个舰桥的船员都忧心忡忡地看着你，等待着你的下一个命令。

They periodically appear and dissipate in a volume encompassing the mysterious ship. Your bridge crew murmurs speculation between their stations: a new form of shielding? Microsat thruster bursts? Your sensors officer shakes their head.

宛如合唱团站在山的那头，遥远的旋律乘风而来，犹如午后清风一样将你的注意力一点、一点地剥离。但当你试图去追寻这旋律之时，它又随风而去。回过神来时，你突然意识到你的舰桥船员正满怀期待地注视着你，等待着你的下一个命令。

entries.en:
After a few tense minutes, reports start to come in - the vessel is heavily damaged, and though of exotic design, it is theoretically recoverable.

Your operations chief reports that for all of the fancy hull features, it is clear that this ship requires crew to operate. But there are no traces of a crew, not even a single body caught in the battle damage, and the escape pods are all in their berths.

The operation proceeds with telemetry feeds, salvors' reports, and authorization orders flowing around you, through the bridge of your flagship. You catch yourself listening for that unheard music in a quiet moment, and shake your head just as a comms request from your technology officer appears, bringing you back from your reverie. You accept as a matter of course.
entries.zh:
度过了焦灼的几分钟后，各种报告终于开始汇总了上来 —— 尽管目标舰船构造奇特且受损严重，但理论上还是可以恢复的。

行动长官的报告中描述虽然该船体外观复杂花俏，但这艘船仍需要船员进行操纵。然而打捞小组在调查中并未发现任何船员留下的痕迹，连一具因战损而留下的尸体都没有，甚至连逃生舱也全都原封不动地留在发射槽上。

随着行动的开展，各种遥测回馈、打捞汇报和指令传达的信息在喷涌在你身旁，向旗舰舰桥的各处奔去。你猛然意识到自己正倾听着那一段之前未曾听闻过的旋律，失神了有好一会儿了。你甩了甩头试图让自己回过神，而总工程师的通讯申请这时正巧也传了过来，一同把你拉回了现实。你就如同无事发生一样接受了通讯请求。

entries.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam, if I understand half of these systems, this ship is truly one of a kind," your technology officer speaks with genuine excitement.

"I've found a device that appears to generate and control - I'm not sure that either is the right word, really - these ... swarming motes, the EM anomalies. The device appears to have two stages, the first as I've described, and what appears to be a later addition which is, unfortunately, damaged beyond repair."

"Judging by the complexity of the components and the bizarre discharge pattern... this is the work of a team of specialists doing bleeding-edge work. It's amazing! A device like this, it's simply unheard of nowadays. Except," Tech looks abashed suddenly, "Rumors. You know, people talk."
entries.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam，如果我的结论没错，这就是一艘独一无二的舰船。" 你的技术军官的声音里按耐不住其发自内心的兴奋。

"我发现了船上一个负责生成与控制的装置 —— 我真的，不确定我的用词是否准确，那些...尘埃，奇特的电磁脉冲源。这个装置明显有两个阶段，第一个就是我刚刚说的，而第二个...很可惜，坏得彻底。

根据这个设备的复杂度和放电模式...这可是一群专家的最前沿成果。太棒了！这样的装置现今根本无从听闻，除了..." 技官脸一红，"...传说。你知道的，人们喜欢谈的那种。"

entries.en: Your technology officer clears their throat, then continues "I think I can get the main part of this device working again, though I can't claim to understand why it works. Not at all. The ship itself will be fit to fly, too, if we do the usual repairs. Should we proceed with recovery?"
entries.zh: 技术军官清了清嗓子，随后继续说了下去。"我觉得，我可以让这个装置的主要部分再度正常工作，但我得说我一点都不知道它是怎么运作的。如果执行维修，大概就能让这艘船重新飞起来。所以，我们要开始恢复吗？"

entries.en: Your salvage teams dock shuttles at various entry points along the vessel's massive hull.
entries.zh: 你的多支打捞小组分别对接在这艘巨舰船体上的各个入口上。

entries.en:
Salvage teams dock their drone-shuttles at various entry points along the massive vessel's hull. At the precise moment the go-order is given, all telemetry feeds from the shuttles simultaneously blank out.

Your bridge officers initiate fallback procedures with practiced speed, contacting subordinates, performing checks and reinitializations to establish precisely where the systems fault occurred - and determine if it was a hostile act. Several agonizing minutes later, the salvage teams' data-feed and comms snap back to life.

"Captain!" Your tactical officer salutes, then launches into a status report, "Someone or something just tried to send a power core collapse signal to the shuttles' computers. Fortunately the security package caught it in time, but they had to perform a full systems shutdown and manually switch to backups; that's why their telemetry cut off. All salvage teams are now reporting all-green and are standing by."
entries.zh:
打捞小组将他们的无人穿梭机部署并对接在这艘巨型船体的各个入口处。在舰桥下令进入的时候，同一时间的所有的遥测信息反馈都消失了。

舰桥立即发出撤退指令，并且联络下属开始执行检查并试图初始化无人机，以精准定位系统故障的位置 —— 同时试图判断这是不是敌对行为。整个舰桥这几分钟都像热锅上的蚂蚁，打捞小组的通讯和数据反馈终于恢复了。

"长官！" 你的战术军官在你面前标准地敬了一个礼，并且开始向你报告状况，"有人试图对我们的穿梭机的内部电脑发送动力系统崩溃指令。幸运的是安全系统及时拦截了它，但我们不得不重启整个系统并且手动切换到备份上；以上是遥测被切断的原因。现在整个打捞小组随时可以出动。"

o.en: Whoever tried this, what did they hope to accomplish?
o.zh: 无论是谁干的，他们到底是想要干什么？

entries.en: The broken phase vessel, now quite dormant, is drifting through space.
entries.zh: 这艘损坏的相位舰船，此刻终于平静了下来，缓缓地在宇宙中飘荡着。
